english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: «Bukɔ wʋlʋ ta na yǝri baarʋ tɩn wʋ́ ba o ja pugǝ o lʋ bǝkǝrǝ, yɩ baá bǝŋi bu wʋm yɩrɩ nɩ Emanuyɛlɩ.» O yɩrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ kuri mʋ yɩ Wɛ wʋra dɩdaanɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: From David to the time of the exile in Babylonia, the ancestors of Jesus were: David, Solomon , Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram; Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, Josiah, and Jehoiachin and his brothers.
translation_verse: Zʋzɩasɩ ma lʋ Yɩkonɩa dɩ o nyaana. Yɩkonɩa mɩmaŋa kam nɩ mʋ ba jaanɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam ba vu ba yagɩ Babilɔnɩ tɩʋ nɩ.

english_verse: From the exile to the birth of Jesus, his ancestors were: Jehoiachin, Shealtiel, Zerubbabel, Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Zadok, Achim; Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob, and Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
translation_verse: Zakɔbɩ ma lʋ Zʋzɛfʋ, wʋntʋ mʋ jigi Mari barʋ. Mari dɛɛn ma ba o lʋ Zezi wʋlʋ ba na bǝŋi nɩ Krisi.

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azori ma lʋ Sadoki. Sadoki ma lʋ Akimi. Akimi ma lʋ Eliyudi.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba na lʋgɩ Zezi Krisi te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ. O nu Mari dɩ Zʋzɛfʋ tiinǝ maama dɛɛn ya sɛ sɩ ba pa ba zʋ daanɩ, yɩ Mari daa ta wʋ ve o barʋ wʋm te. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ o ma ba o ja pugǝ dɩ Wɛ Joro dam.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ wʋlʋ o na lagɩ o zʋ tɩn maa yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm. O maa ba lagɩ sɩ o pa cavɩɩra ja o kaanɩ wʋm nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ. O ma bʋŋɩ sɩ o daanɩ o yag-o, sɩ nɔɔna yɩ zaŋɩ ba lwarɩ.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: O na bʋŋɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma ba o te o dɩndwɩa wʋnɩ, yɩ ka ta dɩd-o ka wɩ: «Zʋzɛfʋ, Pɛ Davidi dwi tu, yɩ pa n wʋ cɔgɩ sɩ n joŋi Mari n ma n ji n kaanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, o na jɩgɩ pugǝ kam tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: O lagɩ o lʋ bǝkǝrǝ mʋ, sɩ n pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zezi, bɛŋwaanɩ oó ba o vrɩ o nɔɔna ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ o yagɩ.»

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ na dɔ o zaŋɩ tɩn, o ma sɛ o kɩ Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka kam na tagɩ nɩ o kɩ te tɩn. O ma sɛ o joŋi Mari o ja vu sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: O ma wʋ pǝni dɩd-o sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi o na lʋgɩ bu wʋm maŋa kalʋ tɩn. O laan ma pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zezi.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn lʋgɩ Zezi Zude tɩʋ kʋdoŋ nɩ mʋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Betelɩhɛm. Kʋ maa yɩ maŋa kalʋ Erɔdɩ dɛɛn na yɩ pɛ tɩn. Yiyǝn-yeenǝ badaara dɛɛn ma nuŋi wa-puli seeni ba ba ba yi Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: Ba laan ma bwe nɔɔna ba wɩ: «Bu wʋm ba na lʋgɩ sɩ o ji Zwifǝ pɛ tɩn wʋ yǝn mʋ? Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam nɛ calɩcʋa kalʋ na brɩ o lʋra kam tɩn na nuŋi bri-kwaga seeni, yɩ dɩbam ba sɩ dɩ́ zul-o.»

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɛ Erɔdɩ dɛɛn na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, liǝ maa jɩg-o dɩ nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: O laan ma bǝŋi Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam maama, dɩdaanɩ Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam, yɩ ba la daanɩ. O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Yǝn mʋ ba maŋɩ sɩ ba lʋ Krisi wʋm?»

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Kʋʋ́ ta yɩ Betelɩhɛm nɩ mʋ, Zude tɩʋ nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnu wʋdoŋ pʋpʋnɩ o wɩ:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: ‹Betelɩhɛm, tɩʋ kʋlʋ na yɩ balaŋa Zude tɩɩnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn, daɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na muri tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ wʋnɩ mʋ baá lʋ dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ ta nii a nɔɔna balʋ na yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ tɩn baŋa nɩ.› »

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma daanɩ o bǝŋi yiyǝn-yeenǝ bam sɩ ba ba o te. O ma kwaanɩ o bwe-ba, sɩ o lwarɩ dɛ dɩm calɩcʋa kam na puli ka nuŋi tɩn.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: O laan ma tʋŋɩ-ba sɩ ba vu Betelɩhɛm, yɩ o wɩ: «Ve-na á kwaanɩ á beeri bu wʋm jǝgǝ, sɩ á na nɛ-o, sɩ á joori á ba á ta á brɩ-nɩ, sɩ a dɩ vu a zul-o.»

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm na tagɩ kʋntʋ dɩ ba tɩn, ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba maa kɛa. Ba na maa kɛ tɩn, ba ma da ba na calɩcʋa kalʋ ba ya na maŋɩ ba na wa-puli seeni tɩn. Ka laan maa wʋ ba yigǝ nɩ wɛyuu nɩ ka veǝ, yɩ ka vu ka zɩgɩ ka maŋɩ dɩ bu wʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma pa ba tiini ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ. Ba ma na bu wʋm dɩ o nu Mari. Ba ma kuni doonǝ ba zul-o. Ba laan ma bwǝli ba zɩla ba lɩ pɛɛra ba pa-o. Ba pɛɛra yam yɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa, dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na zwɛ yɩ tɩ lwǝm ywǝmmǝ tɩn, dɩ tralɩ nugǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Miiri tɩn.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa ba lwarɩ ba dɩndwɩa wʋnɩ, nɩ ba daa yɩ joori ba da Erɔdɩ te. Ba laan ma tɔgɩ cwǝ-gaa ba joori ba vu ba tɩʋ kʋm. Erɔdɩ na kwaanɩ sɩ o gʋ bu wʋm te tɩn

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Yiyǝn-yeenǝ bam na kɛ ba daarɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma da ka ba Zʋzɛfʋ te o dɩndwɩa wʋnɩ, yɩ ka wɩ: «Zaŋɩ n ja bu wʋm dɩ o nu n ja n duri n vu Ezipi tɩʋ, sɩ á taá zʋʋrɩ da, sɩ kʋ yi maŋa kam a na wʋ́ pa abam ni sɩ á nuŋi Ezipi á joori á ba tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ Erɔdɩ mʋ lagɩ o zaŋɩ o beeri bu wʋm sɩ o gʋ-o.»

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o ja bu wʋm dɩ o nu wʋm, o nuŋi tɩtɩɩ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ o vu Ezipi.

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ dɛɛn na tu o lwarɩ nɩ yiyǝn-yeenǝ bam lʋʋrɩ o yigǝ nɩ ba viiri tɩn, o bam ma tiini dɩ zaŋɩ. O ma pa ni sɩ o nɔɔna vu Betelɩhɛm dɩ kʋ tɩ-balwa bam maama wʋnɩ, ba gʋ bǝkǝri-balɛ sɩlʋ na yi bɩna yale dɩ balʋ na muri bɩna yale tɩn maama. O nan kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ yiyǝn-yeenǝ bam na pɛ o lwarɩ maŋa kalʋ calɩcʋa kam na nuŋi tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Biǝ bam gʋm dɩm ma pa Wɛ nijoŋnu Zeremi na tagɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kalʋ faŋa faŋa tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ.

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: O dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: «Sɔɔ mʋ zaŋɩ Rama tɩʋ wʋnɩ. Nɔɔna mʋ wʋra ba keerǝ, yɩ ba coosǝ zanzan. Rasɛɛlɩ mʋ tiini o keerǝ o biǝ ŋwaanɩ, o maa ba sɛ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gan-o, o biǝ bam na tɩga tɩn ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ dɛɛn ma ba o tɩ, yɩ Zʋzɛfʋ daa ta wʋ Ezipi nɩ. Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma daa ba Zʋzɛfʋ te o dɩndwɩa wʋnɩ, yɩ ka wɩ:

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: «Zaŋɩ n ja bu wʋm dɩ o nu n joori n vu Yisɩrayɛlɩ tɩʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ ya na lagɩ sɩ o gʋ bu wʋm tɩn laan tɩga.»

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: O laan ma vu o yi tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Nazarɛtɩ, yɩ o zʋʋrɩ da. Kʋ laan ma pa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝrǝ faŋa faŋa te tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ. Ba dɛɛn tagɩ ba wɩ: «Baá bǝŋ-o nɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu.»

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Zan dɛɛn zʋʋrɩ gɔrɔ kʋlʋ ba na sɔgɩ dɩ yogondi kʋrʋ tɩn mʋ. O maa maɩ kilǝ o ma ja o tǝŋǝ. O wʋdiu mʋ yɩ kayɩra dɩ tʋʋrʋ.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan maa yǝni ba nuŋi Zeruzalɛm, dɩ Zude tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama, dɩ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ ni je sɩm, ba ve o te.

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: Ba maa tɛ ba brɩ kʋlʋ ba na kɩ ba cɔgɩ tɩn. O laan maa paɩ ba tu Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam wʋnɩ, yɩ o miisi-ba na wʋnɩ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Zan na wʋra o miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn, o nɛ nɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ dɩ Sadusɩan tiinǝ zanzan tui o te. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam nyɩ dɩ bɩsankwɩ-dwǝ mʋ. Wɔɔ mʋ brɩ abam sɩ á kwaanɩ á lu cam dɩlʋ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ pa nabiinǝ na tɩn wʋnɩ?

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan ze zʋŋ-kɔgɔ mʋ sɩ o ma caarɩ o mɩna o pɛ o kɩ o tulǝ nɩ, sɩ o daarɩ mɩn-swaanʋ tɩm o zwɛ dɩ mini dɩlʋ na ba di dɩ dwe tɩn. Mʋ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna daanɩ DƖ kɩ-ba te tɩn.» Zan na miisi Zezi na wʋnɩ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Zan dɛɛn na wʋ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam ni nɩ tɩn, Zezi ma nuŋi Galile tɩʋ nɩ o vu o te sɩ o miis-o na wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Zan dɛɛn ya wʋ sɛ, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ a ba nmʋ te sɩ n miisi-nɩ na wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nmʋ mʋ wʋ́ ba amʋ te sɩ a miisi-m na wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Yagɩ sɩ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ lele, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa tɩn.» O laan ma sɛ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Zezi na miisi na kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma da o nuŋi na bam wʋnɩ. O laan ma na wɛyuu na pʋrɩ o baŋa nɩ, yɩ o na Wɛ Joro kʋm na dɛ da kʋ tu o baŋa, yɩ kʋ nyɩ dɩ kunkwǝŋǝ te.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ wɛyuu nɩ ka wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ bu-dʋa a na so-o dɩ a wʋ maama. O ma yǝni o pa a wʋ poli zanzan.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na lwarɩ nɩ ba jaanɩ Zan ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn, o ma joori o vu Galile.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: O maa daa wʋ maŋɩ Nazarɛtɩ nɩ, yɩ o kɛ o vu Galile tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Kapɛrnawum, o zʋʋrɩ da. Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ wʋ nɩnɩʋ ni nɩ mʋ, dɩ je sɩlʋ Zabulɔn dwi tiinǝ dɩ Nɛfitali dwi tiinǝ ya na zʋʋrɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Sʋtaanɩ laan ma ba o te, yɩ dɩ ta dɩd-o dɩ wɩ: «Nmʋ na sɩɩnɩ n yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu, sɩ n ta dɩ kandwa yantʋ sɩ ya ji wʋdiu sɩ n di.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Kʋ ta pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: ‹Yɩ zaŋɩ n maŋɩ n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ n nii.› »

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Sʋtaanɩ daa ma ja-o dɩ ja vu dɩ di piu kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ dwara tɩn yuu. Dɩ laan ma brɩ-o lʋgʋ baŋa tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama dɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama na wʋra tɩn.

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: Dɩ ma ta dɩd-o dɩ wɩ: «Nmʋ na sɛ n kuni doonǝ n zuli amʋ, aá pa n ta n te wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama.»

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: O dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ Zabulɔn dɩ Nɛfitali tɩɩnɩ dɩm, dɩ je sɩlʋ na wʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm seeni tɩn, dɩ je sɩlʋ na wʋ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam bubɛ dɩdoŋ dɩm kwaga nɩ tɩn, dɩ Galile je sɩlʋ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn,

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma zaŋɩ lɩla ba yagɩ ba bʋrɩ sɩm, yɩ ba vu ba tɔgɩ o kwaga.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn maa wʋ Galile nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ o veǝ. O ma na nɔɔna bale, ba yɩ cʋrʋ mʋ. Ba dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn, o yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ maa yɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ. Wʋdoŋ wʋm maa yɩ o nyaanɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Andre. Ba yɩ kalǝŋ-jara mʋ, yɩ ba wʋ na bam wʋnɩ ba dʋlɩ bʋrɩ ba ma jaanɩ kale.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: O na bǝŋi-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma zaŋɩ lɩla ba yagɩ ba ko wʋm dɩ naboro kʋm, yɩ ba vu ba tɔg-o.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma ba ba ni o ŋwa je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, dɩ Siiri tɩʋ kʋm maama wʋnɩ. Ba maa yǝni ba jaanɩ yawɩɩna dwi dwi ba tu o te, balʋ yɩra na tiini ya wɔɛ tɩn, kʋ wǝli dɩ balʋ ciciri na yaarɩ-ba tɩn, dɩ balʋ na saɩ kɔɔrʋ tɩn, dɩ kwaarʋ. Ba na tu Zezi te kʋntʋ tɩn, o maa yǝni o pa ba na yazurǝ.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ zanzan dɛɛn ma nuŋi Galile tɩɩnɩ dɩm, dɩ je sɩlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Tɩɩnɩ Fugǝ tɩn, dɩ Zeruzalɛm, dɩ Zude maama, dɩ je sɩlʋ na wʋ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam bubɛ dɩdoŋ dɩm nɩ tɩn ba tɔgɩ dɩd-o.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na nɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ na tɔg-o tɩn, o ma vu o di piu kʋdoŋ yuu o jǝni da. O na je tɩn, o karabiǝ bam ma ba o te.

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Á nan taá ye nɩ, abam na wʋ sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam á dwǝni á cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam, á bá wanɩ á na cwǝŋǝ sɩ á tɔgɩ á zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋ.» Ban-zɔŋɔ na nyɩ dɩ nɔn-gʋra te tɩn

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nmʋ na lagɩ n kwe n pɛɛrɩ n pa Wɛ, yɩ n laan na guli nɩ n ko-bu jɩgɩ n ban-zɔŋɔ,

english_verse: and he taught them:
translation_verse: O laan ma puli o brɩ-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: «Balʋ na ye nɩ ba yɩ yinigǝ tiinǝ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, ba na wʋ́ tɔgɩ ba di Wɛ paarɩ dɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: Balʋ wʋrʋ na cɔgɩ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, Wɛ na wʋ́ pa-ba wʋ-zuru tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Balʋ na jɩgɩ ban-pʋnʋ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, Wɛ na wʋ́ pa ba taa te lʋgʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Balʋ na jɩgɩ nɔɔna ŋwaŋa tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, Wɛ na wʋ́ duri ba dɩ ŋwaŋa tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: Balʋ na yɩ wʋ-poŋo tiinǝ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, ba na wʋ́ ba ba na Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Abam nyɩ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pooni mʋ nabiinǝ tɩtarɩ nɩ. Tɩʋ kʋlʋ ba na lɔgɩ piu yuu nɩ tɩn bá wanɩ kʋ sǝgi, kʋ naɩ mʋ jaja.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta a brɩ abam sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á du dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Yɩ zaŋɩ á du durǝ dɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ, bɛŋwaanɩ dáanɩ mʋ yɩ Wɛ jǝŋǝ je.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: Yɩ du-na dɩ tɩga baŋa dɩ, ka na yɩ Wɛ nɛ cwiim jǝgǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Nan yɩ du-na dɩ Zeruzalɛm dɩ, sɩ kʋntʋ yɩ Wɛ pa-farʋ wʋm tɩʋ mʋ.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: Yɛ na paɩ wʋdiu ywǝnǝ te tɩn, abam dɩ nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá paɩ ywǝǝni taa wʋ nabiinǝ tee nɩ. Yɛ ywǝǝni nan na ti, n daa n bá wanɩ n pa dɩ joori dɩ ja ywǝǝni. Dɩ daa ba jɩgɩ kuri. Baá dɩ-dɩ ba yagɩ mʋ, sɩ nɔɔna taa nwanɩ dɩ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá sɛ o tarɩgɩ kanɩa o pu tɩtɔgɔ kuri nɩ. Oó kwe-ka o palɩ wɛɛnɩ mʋ, sɩ ka pooni dɩm taa naɩ dɩ paɩ nɔɔna balʋ maama na wʋ digǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: «Abam ye nɩ ba dɛɛn brɩ dɩbam kwǝ bam ba wɩ: ‹Yɩ zaŋɩ n gʋ nɔɔnʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na gʋ nɔɔnʋ, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba di o taanɩ mʋ.›

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a nan lagɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ ban-zɔŋɔ dɩ o ko-bu, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba di kʋntʋ tu dɩ taanɩ mʋ. Wʋlʋ na tagɩ dɩ o ko-bu o wɩ, o ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam mʋ di kʋntʋ tu taanɩ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ dɩ na tagɩ dɩ o ko-bu o wɩ, o yɩ joro, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋntʋ tu zʋ min-tɩʋ mʋ.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: sɩ n tiŋi n pɛɛrɩ dɩm, sɩ n joori n vu n ko-bu wʋm te sɩ á fɔgɩ daanɩ. Nmʋ na kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ n laan joori n ba n kwe n pɛɛrɩ dɩm n pa Wɛ.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ nan na jaanɩ-m o vu o saŋɩ, sɩ n kɩ lɩla n pa á fɔgɩ daanɩ yɩ á daa ta wʋ yi sarɩya yam dim jǝgǝ kam. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, o laan wʋ́ kɩ nmʋ sarɩya-diru wʋm jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ o pa n na cam. Wʋntʋ dɩ laan wʋ́ kɩ-m o tɩntʋŋnʋ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ o ja-m o vu o kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ nmʋ sɩ, nń ta n wʋra taan. Nmʋ na wʋ ŋwɩ jɩnɩ dɩm maama n ti, ba bá yagɩ-m.» Ka-laga na yɩ kǝm-balɔrɔ te tɩn

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: «Ba maŋɩ ba ta ba wɩ: ‹Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na yagɩ o kaanɩ, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o pa-o tɔnɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ brɩ nɩ ba yagɩ daanɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: «Abam maŋɩ á ye nɩ ba dɛɛn brɩ dɩbam kwǝ bam ba wɩ: ‹Yɩ zaŋɩ n kwanɩ n ni, dɩ nmʋ na dugǝ n wɩ nń kɩ kʋlʋ n pa n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tɩn.›

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: «Abam maŋɩ á ni sɩ ba tagɩ ba wɩ: ‹Nɔɔnʋ na pi n yi, sɩ ba pi kʋntʋ tu dɩ yi. Nɔɔnʋ nan na guri n yǝli, sɩ ba guri kʋntʋ tu dɩ yǝli.›

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta a brɩ abam nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na kɩ-m lwarɩm, sɩ n dɩ daa yɩ kɩ-o lwarɩm n ma n ŋwɩ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na lɔgɩ n jazɩm pʋpɔŋɔ, sɩ n guni kʋdoŋ kʋm dɩ, sɩ o lɔ o wǝli da.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na saŋɩ-m sɩ o joŋi n gwar-bu o jɩnɩ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ n pa o kwe n gwar-bwǝrǝ dɩ o wǝli da.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ nan na fɩ-m sɩ n zɩŋɩ o zɩla n vu nabaa yi mʋrʋ, sɩ n zɩŋɩ n vu nabaa yi mʋrr-tɩle.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na loori-m woŋo, sɩ n kwaanɩ n pa-o-kʋ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na lagɩ sɩ o jɩnɩ woŋo n tee nɩ, sɩ n yɩ van-o.» Sono taanɩ (Luki

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam nɩ, á taá soe á dʋna, sɩ á daarɩ á taá loori Wɛ á pa balʋ na jɩgɩ abam ba bɛɛsɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: Á na kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, kʋʋ́ brɩ nɩ abam yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ biǝ mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩntʋ ba pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna daanɩ, DƖ paɩ wɩa nyɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ dɩ nɔn-ŋʋna maama baŋa nɩ. DƖ ta kwǝri DƖ paɩ dʋa nɩ ka paɩ balʋ na kɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ balʋ na kɩ balɔrɔ tɩn maama.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Abam nan na soe balʋ dɩ na soe abam tɩn yɩranɩ, bɛɛ nyɔɔrɩ mʋ á wʋ́ na Wɛ tee nɩ? Lampo-joŋnǝ dɩ yǝni ba kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Abam nan na zuli á cʋrrʋ yɩranɩ mʋ, abam kɩ á dwe á donnǝ bam na? Balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn dɩ nan yǝni ba kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: «Á taá yɩrɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yɩ taá brɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩlʋ á na kɩ tɩn nɔɔna yigǝ nɩ. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, kʋ bá pa á na nyɔɔrɩ á Ko Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: Abam na yǝni á lagɩ á warɩ Wɛ, sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á taá brɩ á tɩtɩ nɩ pipiri-nyɩna bam na kɩ te tɩn. Bantʋ soe sɩ ba taa zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ mʋ ba warɩ Wɛ ba Wɛ-di sɩm wʋnɩ dɩ pooni yigǝ nɩ, sɩ nɔɔna maama taa na-ba. A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, bantʋ maŋɩ ba na ba ŋwɩɩrʋ ba ti.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan na lagɩ n warɩ Wɛ, zʋ digǝ wʋ n ja ka ni n pɩ, sɩ n laan warɩ n Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na wʋ jǝgǝ kalʋ na sǝgi tɩn nɩ. Dɩntʋ nan naɩ kʋlʋ n na sǝgi n kɩ tɩn. DƖ laan wʋ́ pa n na nyɔɔrɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: Abam na wʋra á warɩ Wɛ, á yɩ taá tiini á ŋɔɔnɩ bɩtar-yɔɔrʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn na yǝni ba ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn. Bantʋ yǝni ba bʋŋɩ nɩ, ba na tiini ba ŋɔɔnɩ ta-farɩ mʋ, Wɛ wʋ́ lǝri ba loro.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá warɩ Wɛ tɩntʋ doŋ mʋ: ‹Dɩbam Ko wʋlʋ na wʋ wɛɛnɩ tɩn, sɩ nmʋ yɩrɩ na tiǝ dɩ zulǝ,

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: sɩ nmʋ paarɩ ba, sɩ nmʋ wʋbʋŋa kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, nɩ kʋ na kɩ n sɔŋɔ nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Abam na yagɩ á ma cɛ nɔɔna balʋ na kɩ abam lwarɩm tɩn, á Ko Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ yagɩ abam lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, abam na wʋ yagɩ á ma cɛ balʋ na kɩ abam lwarɩm tɩn, á Ko Wɛ dɩ bá yagɩ abam lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam.

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá lwarɩ nɩ n vɔgɩ ni. N Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na wʋ jǝgǝ kalʋ na sǝgi nɩ tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ ye. Dɩntʋ nan naɩ kʋlʋ n na sǝgi n kɩ tɩn. DƖ laan wʋ́ pa n na nyɔɔrɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.» Wɛ-sɔŋɔ jɩjɩgɩrʋ taanɩ (Luki

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ sɩ á da yigǝ á beeri Baŋa-Wɛ paarɩ dɩm dɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa tɩn. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ, Wɛ laan wʋ́ wǝli abam wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na daarɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama tui dɩ dɩ tɩtɩ cam mʋ. Á nan yɩ taá pa liǝ jɩgɩ abam dɩ jwa woŋo. Yagɩ-na sɩ jwa dɛ dɩm tɩtɩ wʋ́ nii dɩ tɩtɩ woŋo.»

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á tiŋi á jɩjɩgɩrʋ zanzan Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ mʋ. Dáanɩ mʋ tʋa daa bá wanɩ ka mu-tɩ, yɩ tɩ bá sʋŋɩ tɩ cɔgɩ, yɩ ŋwɩɩna dɩ bá wanɩ ba ŋɔ-tɩ.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, abam jɩjɩgɩrʋ na tigi mɛ tɩn, á bɩcara dɩ tigi dáanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Nmʋ yiǝ nan na ba lana, kʋ paɩ n yɩra maama wʋ lim wʋnɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, nmʋ yiǝ ya na maŋɩ sɩ ya taa yɩ pooni tɩn nan na yɩ lim, kʋ laan wʋ́ ta tiini kʋ yɩ lim kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ, sɩ o ma tʋŋɩ o pa o yuutiinǝ bale. Oó ta culi dɩdʋ wʋm yɩ o daarɩ o soe wʋdoŋ wʋm, naa oó ta nɩgɩ dɩdʋ wʋm yɩ o daarɩ o gooni wʋdoŋ wʋm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ abam bá wanɩ á pa sɩ Wɛ taa yɩ á yuutu, sɩ á daarɩ á pa sǝbu dɩ taa yɩ á yuutu.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, á yɩ taá liǝ dɩ á na wʋ́ di woŋo kʋlʋ naa á na wʋ́ zʋ woŋo kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a lagɩ a ta abam, sɩ á yɩ taá liǝ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa kʋlʋkʋlʋ, kʋ na yɩ á ni-wʋdiu, naa á na wʋ́ zʋ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ á ŋwɩa garɩ wʋdiu. Yɩra yalʋ Wɛ na pɛ abam tɩn dɩ maa garɩ gwaarʋ.

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nan maanɩ-na á nii zunǝ na yɩ te tɩn. Bantʋ ba duǝ, yɩ ba ba zagɩ mɩna ba kɩ tuli nɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ á Ko Wɛ mʋ nii ba baŋa nɩ dɩ ba ni-wʋdiu. Abam nan ba jɩgɩ kuri á dwe zunǝ bam na?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ á kɩ liǝ dɩ gwaarʋ woŋo? Maanɩ-na á nii ga-punnu tɩm lam na yɩ te tɩn. Tɩntʋ nan warɩ tɩ tʋŋɩ yɩ tɩ warɩ gwaarʋ tɩ sɔ.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Nan taá ye-na nɩ, tɩntʋ jɩgɩ lam tɩ dwe Pɛ Salɔmɔn dɛɛn na maŋɩ o zʋʋrɩ gwar-ŋʋnnʋ tɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ gaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ, tɩntʋ ba jɩgɩ dɛ dɩ nɔɔna na zwɛ-tɩ. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ Wɛ ta mʋ paɩ tɩ jɩgɩ lam kʋntʋ doŋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ na yɩ abam, Wɛ bá nii abam baŋa nɩ cɩga? Bɛɛ nan yɩ á ba kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ?

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn mʋ tiini ba bʋŋɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama wʋbʋŋa. Abam Ko Wɛ nan maŋɩ DƖ ye woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: «Abam yɩ taá ŋɔɔnɩ á donnǝ wǝǝnu, sɩ Wɛ yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ abam dɩ wǝǝnu.

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Daa na wʋ nmʋ yi nɩ tɩn, nń kɩ ta mʋ n ta dɩ n doŋ nɩ o pa n lɩ gaa o yi nɩ n yagɩ?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Nmʋ yɩ pipiri-nyɩm dɩ nmʋ na kɩ n doŋ te tɩn. Nmʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ n lɩ n tɩtɩ yi daa kam mʋ, sɩ n laan wanɩ n nii lanyɩranɩ sɩ n lɩ n doŋ yi gaa kam.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Awo. Abam wʋrʋ na ba lana yɩ á ta ye sɩ á taá paɩ á biǝ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ ba na lagɩ tɩn, á Ko Wɛ na lamma DƖ dwe abam tɩn bá kwe wo-laarʋ DƖ pa balʋ na loori-DƖ tɩn na?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ bu yɩ o na loori-m wʋdiu, nmʋ wʋ́ sɛ n kwe kandwɛ n pa-o na?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: «Á taá loori Wɛ, sɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn. Beeri-na kʋlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn, sɩ á wʋ́ na. Magɩ-na boro, sɩ baá pʋrɩ ba pa abam.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ maama na loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa-o woŋo tɩn wʋ́ joŋi. Wʋlʋ maama na beeri woŋo tɩn wʋ́ na-kʋ. Baá pʋrɩ ba pa wʋlʋ maama na magɩ boro tɩn.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Naa o na loori-m kalǝŋǝ, nń sɛ n pa-o bɩsankwɩa na?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Á taá kɩ á donnǝ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ á na lagɩ sɩ bantʋ taa kɩ abam te tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ cɩga kalʋ Moyisi dɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam zaasɩm dɩm na maŋɩ dɩ brɩ tɩn.» Zezi karabiǝ na wʋ́ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ tɩn (Luki

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: «Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, wʋlʋ maama na cǝgi a taanɩ dɩm yɩ o kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu nyɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋa tu wʋlʋ na cwi o sɔŋɔ kuri pulɔrɔ baŋa nɩ yɩ o laan lɔ-kʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ nmʋ na wʋ́ da sɩ n vu n joŋi ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn ni yɩ mɩmɩna mʋ, yɩ ka pɩɩnɩ. Nɔɔna fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ.» Ba lwarɩ tiu kʋ biǝ lǝrim nɩ mʋ (Luki

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Tu-ŋʋŋʋ mʋ lǝri bu-ŋʋna. Tu-balɔrɔ dɩ maa lǝri bu-balwaarʋ.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tu-ŋʋŋʋ tǝrǝ kʋ na wʋ́ lǝ bu-balwaarʋ. Tu-balɔrɔ dɩ nan tǝrǝ kʋ na wʋ́ lǝ bu-ŋʋna.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Tiu kʋlʋ maama na ba lǝri bu-ŋʋna tɩn, baá go-kʋ ba dɩ mini nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, ba tɩtʋŋa mʋ wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ ba na yɩ balʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ maama nan na cǝgi a taanɩ dɩm yɩ o ba kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn nyɩ dɩ nɔn-joro na lɔgɩ kʋ sɔŋɔ kasʋlʋ baŋa nɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Dʋa ma ba ka nɩ ka pa bwi su sɩ pɛɛlɩ, yɩ vu-dɩʋ dɩ magɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm, kʋ pa kʋ tiini kʋ tʋ tɩga nɩ buri buri.»

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ nɩ balʋ maama na bǝ amʋ nɩ ‹Yuutu, Yuutu› tɩn mʋ wʋ́ tɔgɩ ba zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ balʋ na sɩɩnɩ ba tɔgɩ amʋ Ko Wɛ wʋbʋŋa tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Sarɩya dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, nɔɔna zanzan wʋ́ ta dɩ amʋ ba wɩ: ‹Dɩ́ Yuutu, dɩbam dɛɛn tɔgɩ nmʋ yɩrɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ, yɩ dɩ́ ma nmʋ yɩrɩ dɩm dɩ́ zǝli ciciri nɔɔna yɩra nɩ, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ ma dɩ́ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla zanzan.›

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: A laan wʋ́ ta dɩ ba a wɩ: ‹A maŋɩ a yǝri abam. Ve-na daa nɩ, abam kǝm-balwaarʋ tiinǝ-ba.› » Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ Wɛ taanɩ te tɩn (Luki

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Dʋa ma ba ka nɩ ka pa bwi su sɩ pɛɛlɩ. Vu-dɩʋ dɩ ma ba kʋ magɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm, yɩ kʋ wʋ tʋ, kʋ kuri na cwi pulɔrɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ o ni-taanɩ dɩm jɩgɩ dam dɩ dwe ba tɩtɩ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ balʋ ya na maŋɩ sɩ ba zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋ tɩn, bantʋ daa bá na cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ. Wɛ wʋ́ zǝli-ba DƖ yagɩ lim je nɩ, mɛ nɔɔna na yaara yɩ ba keerǝ yɩ ba dʋnɩ ba nwa tɩn.»

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Tɩga na tu ka wʋra ka yi tɩn, nɔɔna maa jaanɩ ciciri na jɩgɩ balʋ tɩn zanzan ba tui Zezi te. O maa yǝni o ma o ni-taanɩ o zǝli ciciri sɩm, yɩ o daarɩ o pa yawɩɩna bam maama na yazurǝ.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: O na maa kɛ tɩn, nanyɔŋɔ kʋdoŋ ma vu o te, yɩ kʋ kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ kʋ loor-o kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ tu, nmʋ na laga, nń wanɩ n pa a na yazurǝ a ji lanyɩranɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Zezi ma sɛ. O ma twɩ o jɩŋa o dwe-o, yɩ o wɩ: «Ɛɛn, a laga. Zaŋɩ dɩ yazurǝ sɩ n ji lanyɩranɩ.» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn, mʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋm nanywaanʋ tɩm dɛ tɩ je yɩ o yɩra ji lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Aá da a vu sɩ a pa o na yazurǝ.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Zezi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ sʋ-o. O ma ta dɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ ba wʋra tɩn o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, a wʋ nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa te tɩn, kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam wʋnɩ dɩ.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ pamaŋna yigǝ tu wʋm o wɩ: «Nan ve. Nmʋ na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa kʋ kɩ.» Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔ́ɔ mʋ o tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm sɩɩnɩ o na yazurǝ. Zezi na pɛ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩnkaanɩ dɩ yawɩɩna zanzan na yazurǝ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Ba ma kaasɩ baŋa baŋa ba wɩ: «Baŋa-Wɛ Bu, nmʋ tu dɩbam te sɩ n kɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Nmʋ tu sɩ n yaarɩ dɩbam yɩ Wɛ sarɩya dɛ dɩm ta wʋ yi mʋ na?»

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma pa tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam maama nuŋi ba vu sɩ ba jeeri Zezi. Ba na nɛ-o tɩn, ba ma loor-o sɩ o nuŋi ba tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ o viiri.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma vu Pɩyɛɛrɩ-ba sɔŋɔ. O ma na Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩnkaanɩ na tigǝ o ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ. Kʋ yɩ paa mʋ jɩg-o.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Zezi ma vu o ja o jɩŋa, yɩ paa kam nuŋi o yɩra nɩ. Kaanɩ wʋm laan ma zaŋɩ o kɩ wʋdiu o pa-o.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: O kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi na maŋɩ o ta kʋlʋ faŋa faŋa tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ, nɩ o dɛɛn na tagɩ o wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ joŋi dɩbam cam dɩ dɩ́ yawɩɩrʋ maama o zɩŋɩ.» Balʋ na lagɩ sɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn na maŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ te tɩn (Luki

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Ba daa ta na wʋ kɛ tɩn, Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tu wʋdoŋ ma vu o te, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Karanyɩna, nmʋ na lagɩ n vu je sɩlʋ maama tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ tɔgɩ a vu.»

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam ma vu ba zaŋ-o ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu, vrɩ dɩbam n yagɩ, sɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ tɩ.»

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam laan ma vu ba zʋ naboro wʋ sɩ ba kɛ.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Vu-fɔrɔ ma da kʋ zaŋɩ kʋ magɩ boro kʋm, yɩ kʋ wʋra kʋ miisi na bam kuri nɩ, dɩ Zezi ya tigi o dɔa.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Kʋ ma tiini kʋ kɩ nɔɔna bam yǝǝu, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ, yɩ viu dɩ na dɩ ta sɛ o ni?» Zezi na zǝli ciciri nɔɔna bale yɩra nɩ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma vu ba bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni dɩdoŋ dɩm, mɛ Gadara tiinǝ na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn. Nɔɔna bale maa wʋra ciciri na jɩgɩ-ba sɩ yaara. Bantʋ tigi yibeelǝ je nɩ mʋ, yɩ ba jɩgɩ fʋʋnɩ, kʋ paɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ warɩ o tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ o kɛ. Ba laan ma nuŋi yibeelǝ je sɩm nɩ ba vu ba jeeri Zezi.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ tǝrǝ zanzan mʋ ya wʋra ba beeri ba di.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Ciciri sɩm ma loori Zezi sɩ wɩ: «Nmʋ na lagɩ n zǝli dɩbam, sɩ n pa dɩ́ vu dɩ́ zʋ tǝrǝ bantʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: O ma ta o wɩ, sɩ ve. Sɩ ma sɩɩnɩ sɩ nuŋi nɔɔna bam yɩra nɩ sɩ vu sɩ zʋ tǝrǝ bam. Tǝrǝ bam maama ma duri ba tu ba tʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ ba li na ba tɩ.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ ya na nii tǝrǝ bam tɩn ma duri ba vu tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Ba ma ta kʋlʋ maama na kɩ tɩn, dɩ Zezi na zǝli ciciri sɩm nɔɔna bale bam yɩra nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma joori o vu o zʋ naboro kʋm. O ma bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm o vu o yi o tɩtɩ tɩʋ Kapɛrnawum.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ dɩ nan bá sɛ o kwe sa-dʋŋa o lo o kɩ lɔ-doŋo wʋnɩ. O na kɩ kʋntʋ yɩ sana kam na keeri, kaá pa lɔɔ kʋm bagɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ sana kam wʋ́ lo, yɩ lɔɔ kʋm dɩ cɔgɩ. Nɔɔnʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ o kwe sa-dʋŋa o kɩ lɔ-dʋŋʋ wʋnɩ mʋ, sɩ tɩ maama maŋɩ daanɩ.» Zezi na pɛ kaanɩ na yazurǝ yɩ o bi Zwifǝ yigǝ tu bukɔ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: O kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ ma jagɩ dɩ yi tɩʋ kʋm je sɩm maama. Zezi na puri lilwǝ bale yiǝ te tɩn

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ badonnǝ maa wʋra, yɩ ba bwɛ ba tɩtɩ nɩ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ ŋɔɔnɩ o twɩ Wɛ mʋ o paɩ o dɩ Wɛ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ ba na bʋŋɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ tɩntʋ á wʋnɩ?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Amʋ nan wʋ́ pa abam lwarɩ nɩ, amʋ na yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm tɩn jɩgɩ dam lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ a yagɩ nɔɔna lwarɩm a ma cɛ-ba.» O laan ma ta dɩ kɔrɔ kʋm o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ sɩ n kwe n gungolo kʋm n ja n vu sɔŋɔ.»

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o vu sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, ‘Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others.’ I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Mark
translation_verse: Wɛ tɩtɩ maŋɩ DƖ ta DƖ wɩ: ‹A lagɩ sɩ nabiinǝ taa jɩgɩ da-ŋwaŋa mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ ba taa maɩ ba wǝǝnu mʋ ba kaanɩ-nɩ.› Ve-na á zaasɩ taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ kuri cɩga. Amʋ na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ a bǝŋi balʋ na maŋɩ ba yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna tɩn, amʋ nan tu sɩ a bǝŋi nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ sɩ ba ba amʋ te.» Zezi zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ zaasɩm-dʋʋrɩ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ o maa kɛa. O na maa ve tɩn, lilwǝ bale ma zaŋɩ ba tɔgɩ o kwaga, yɩ ba tɛ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Pɛ Davidi dwi tu! Duri dɩbam yibwǝnǝ!»

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ ba na maa kɛ tɩn, nɔɔna badonnǝ ma ja mɩmaa ba ba Zezi te. Kʋ yɩ cicirǝ mʋ tɔg-o ka pa o warɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma nuŋi o maa kɛa. O ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Matiyu. O dɛɛn je mɛ seeni o na yǝni o joŋi lampoo tɩn mʋ. Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ n ta n tɔgɩ-nɩ.» O ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o tɔgɩ o kwaga.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma vu Matiyu sɔŋɔ sɩ o di wʋdiu, o dɩ o karabiǝ bam. Lampo-joŋnǝ dɩ nɔn-cɩcɔgɩrʋ zanzan dɩ maa tɔgɩ ba wʋra ba di wʋdiu kʋm dɩ ba.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ yigǝ tu wʋdoŋ ma ba o te. O kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ yɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ bukɔ mʋ tɩga lele kʋntʋ. Nan ba sɩ n ma n jɩŋa n dwe-o, sɩ o joori o na ŋwɩa.»

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: O na dwe-o kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma pipiri o nii-o yɩ o wɩ: «A bukɔ, kɩ pu-dɩa. Nmʋ na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ te tɩn mʋ pɛ n na yazurǝ.» Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔ́ɔ mʋ kaanɩ wʋm sɩɩnɩ o na yazurǝ.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma zǝli cicirǝ kam o yɩra nɩ, yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm laan waɩ o ŋɔɔna. Kʋ ma sʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ wʋ nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩntʋ doŋ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tɩʋ nɩ.»

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Zan karabiǝ dɛɛn ma vu Zezi te, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam yǝni dɩ́ vɔ ni maŋa zanzan. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ nmʋ karabiǝ bam ba vɔ ni kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ dɩ nan bá sɛ o kwe garyi-dʋʋrɩ o ma fǝri gwar-doŋo kʋlʋ na kaarɩ tɩn. O na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋ fǝrim dɩm laan wʋ́ vuuri gɔrɔ kʋm kʋ pa kʋ tiini kʋ cɔgɩ zanzan.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Zezi ma zaŋɩ o tɔg-o, dɩ o karabiǝ bam maama.

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ-na á nuŋi, sɩ bu wʋm wʋ tɩgɩ, o tigi o dɔ mʋ.» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna bam maa jɩg-o ba mwana.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Ba na pɛ kɔgɔ kʋm maama nuŋi tɩn, Zezi laan ma vu o zʋ digǝ kam bu wʋm na wʋra tɩn. O ma ja o jɩŋa o pa o bi o zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: O ma vu o zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋdoŋ. Lilwǝ bale bam ma tɔgɩ ba zʋ da. O laan ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Abam bʋŋɩ sɩ aá wanɩ a kɩ á na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn a pa abam na?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam tu, ɛɛn, nń wanɩ n kɩ.»

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba yiǝ yam ma sɩɩnɩ ya joori ya puri. O ma kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba yɩ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ lwarɩ kʋ ni nɩ.

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: O na kaanɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ta zaŋɩ ba karɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ o taanɩ je sɩm maama nɩ. Zezi na pɛ mɩmaa ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam dɛɛn wʋ sɛ, yɩ ba wɩ: «Wʋntʋ na waɩ o zǝli sʋtaana tɩn, kʋ yɩ sʋtaana-pɛ dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn maa kaagɩ tɩ-kamunǝ dɩ tɩ-balɛ sɩm maama wʋnɩ. O maa yǝni o zʋʋrɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-di sɩm o brɩ-ba Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, dɩ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ di paarɩ nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ te tɩn. O maa paɩ nɔɔna na yazurǝ dɩ ba yawɩɩrʋ dwi dwi.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Kʋ nyɩ dɩ faa na kɩ lanyɩranɩ yɩ tɩntʋŋna fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra sɩ ba kɩ-kʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Nan loori-na faa kʋm tu sɩ o tʋŋɩ nɔɔna zanzan, sɩ ba vu ba kɩ o faa kʋm ba pa-o.»

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Filipi dɩ Batelemi, Toma dɩ Matiyu wʋlʋ ya na yɩ lampo-joŋnu tɩn, Zakɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Alɩfɩ bu tɩn, dɩ Tadɩ,

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Ba nan na jaanɩ abam ba vu ba saŋɩ, sɩ á yɩ taá liǝ dɩ á na wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ tɩn naa á na wʋ́ ta te tɩn. Á na wʋ́ taá zɩgɩ ba yigǝ nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ á na wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: Á nan maŋɩ sɩ á vu Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam te, bɛŋwaanɩ bantʋ nyɩ dɩ peeni sɩlʋ na je tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ Zelɔtɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, dɩ Zudasɩ Yiskarɩyo wʋlʋ na wʋ́ ba o yǝgi Zezi o pa nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: Nan yɩ kwe-na tampɔgɔ kʋlʋ ba na kɩ wʋdiu da tɩn. Á nan yɩ kwe gwaarʋ tɩle tɩle naa natra naa nacǝgǝ á wǝli da. Bɛŋwaanɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ maŋɩ dɩ o ni-wʋdiu mʋ.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: Abam nan na ve á yi tɩʋ kʋlʋ maama, sɩ á lagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ jeeri abam dɩ wʋpolo tɩn, á vu o sɔŋɔ á taá wʋra sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi á viirim.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, Wɛ sarɩya dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, Sodɔm dɩ Gomɔɔrɩ tiinǝ bá tiini ba na lɛɛrʋ nɩ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɔɔna te.

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ wʋ́ ja ba tɩtɩ cʋrrʋ ba kɩ nɔɔna jɩa nɩ sɩ ba gʋ-ba. Kwǝ dɩ wʋ́ kɩ ba biǝ kʋntʋ doŋ. Biǝ dɩ wʋ́ zaŋɩ ba pa ba ja ba niinǝ dɩ ba kwǝ ba gʋ.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Á taá cʋ á tɩtɩ, sɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam tee nɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba magɩ abam ba Wɛ-di sɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔgɩ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, baá ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ dɩdɛɛra dɩ pwa tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ á wʋ́ wanɩ á brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kam, yɩ á daarɩ á brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ abam tɩtɩ mʋ wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ, kʋ yɩ á Ko Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ wʋ́ pa abam taanɩ dɩlʋ á na wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ta culi abam, á na yɩ amʋ nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋlʋ maama nan na tiini o zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi yaara yam tiim tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ kʋntʋ tu ŋwɩa.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Ba nan na bɛɛsɩ abam tɩʋ kʋlʋ nɩ, sɩ á duri á vu kʋdoŋ. A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam bá wanɩ á tʋlɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ maama na wʋ Yisɩrayɛlɩ nɩ tɩn á ti, yɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm daa ta wʋ joori a ba.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: Karabu nan tǝrǝ o na dwe o karanyɩna. Tɩntʋŋnʋ dɩ nan tǝrǝ o na dwe o yuutu.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Karabu nan na tu o yɩ nɩ o karanyɩna te, kʋ maŋɩ kʋntʋ. Tɩntʋŋnʋ dɩ nan na tu o yɩ nɩ o yuutu te, kʋ maŋɩ kʋntʋ. Ba na jɩgɩ sɔŋɔ tu ba bǝ ba wɩ ‹Sʋtaana-pɛ Belizebuli› tɩn, ba laan wʋ́ tiini ba twɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam sɩ kʋ dwǝni kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Abam yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ ba gʋ á yɩra yam yɩ ba bá wanɩ á jwǝǝru ba gʋ tɩn. Á nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá kwarɩ Wɛ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩntʋ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ pa á yɩra dɩ á jwǝǝru maama cɔgɩ min-tɩʋ nɩ.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kabǝmbǝli, sɩntʋ yǝlo yɩ mwalɩ mwalɩ mʋ. Á Ko Wɛ nan nii sɩ baŋa nɩ, yɩ sɩ dɩdʋa bá wanɩ ka tʋ tɩga nɩ ka tɩ dɩ Wɛ na wʋ sɛ.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, Wɛ ye abam yuuywe sɩm ni na maɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, á yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa tiini á jɩgɩ kuri á dwe kabǝmbǝli zanzan.

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na zɩgɩ nabiinǝ yigǝ nɩ o brɩ jaja nɩ wʋntʋ yɩ amʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, amʋ dɩ nan wʋ́ zɩgɩ kʋntʋ tu kwaga nɩ a brɩ nɩ o yɩ a nɔɔnʋ a Ko Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na vɩn amʋ nabiinǝ yigǝ nɩ tɩn, amʋ dɩ wʋ́ vɩn kʋntʋ tu a Ko Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: A na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, á yɩ taá bʋŋɩ nɩ, kʋ yɩ sɩ a pa nɔɔna mʋ na ywǝǝni daanɩ. A nan tu sɩ a pa nabiinǝ mʋ pɔɔrɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma wʋ́ pa nɔɔnʋ dɩ o tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ tiinǝ taa culi daanɩ.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na soe o nu dɩ o ko o dwe amʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ a nɔɔnʋ. Wʋlʋ maama na soe o biǝ o dwe amʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ a nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na wʋ sɛ sɩ o tɔgɩ amʋ kwaga, sɩ o na yaara nɩ wʋlʋ na zɩŋɩ tʋʋn-dagara o maa ve o tʋʋnɩ jǝgǝ te tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ amʋ nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na lagɩ sɩ o yɩrɩ o tɩtɩ ŋwɩa tɩn, oó ga-ka mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ na sɛ sɩ o ga o ŋwɩa amʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, oó na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na jeeri Wɛ nijoŋnu lanyɩranɩ tɩn, dɩ Wɛ na tʋŋ-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu dɩ tɔgɩ o na nyɔɔrɩ nɩ DƖ nijoŋnu wʋm te. Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jeeri nɔn-ŋʋm lanyɩranɩ o nɔn-ŋʋnɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu dɩ tɔgɩ o na nyɔɔrɩ dɩlʋ DƖ na wʋ́ pa nɔn-ŋʋm wʋm tɩn.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jeeri abam lanyɩranɩ tɩn, kʋ tu jeeri amʋ mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jeeri amʋ lanyɩranɩ tɩn, kʋ tu jeeri Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o kɩ na-zurǝ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ o pa amʋ nɔɔna bam wʋ dɩdʋa, o na yɩ a karabu tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ tu wʋ́ na nyɔɔrɩ Wɛ tee nɩ.»

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Zan karabiǝ bam na ma viiri tɩn, Zezi laan ma ta Zan taanɩ o brɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm o wɩ: «Abam dɛɛn na ve Zan te kagʋa wʋnɩ tɩn, á bʋŋɩ nɩ á wʋ́ na bɛɛ mʋ? Á ve sɩ á nii miu kʋlʋ viu na jɩgɩ kʋ zuuli tɩn mʋ na?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Zan na tu tɩn, o pɩɩnɩ o kana mʋ yɩ o ba nyɔ sana. Nɔɔna na nɛ-o tɩn, ba maa jɩg-o ba yáala ba wɩ, kʋ yɩ cicirǝ mʋ tɔg-o.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Zan wʋlʋ na miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn dɛɛn maa wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. O ma ni wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Zezi Krisi na kɩ tɩn. O ma tʋŋɩ o karabiǝ badonnǝ sɩ ba vu o te,

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: sɩ ba bwe-o ba nii: «Nmʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ na tagɩ dɩ dɩbam nɩ nń ba tɩn na, naa dɩ́ ta wʋ́ ta cǝgi nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ mʋ?»

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: «Á taá brɩ-o nɩ lilwǝ yiǝ puri, kwaarʋ dɩ waɩ tɩ veǝ, nanywaanʋ yɩra dɩ joori ya kwɛ lanyɩranɩ, zwa-kwarʋ dɩ zwa ni, twa dɩ joori ba bi. Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, yinigǝ tiinǝ dɩ maa ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na ba joori amʋ kwaga nɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ yu-yoŋo tu.»

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Aye, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Sɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Á ve sɩ á nii nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na zʋ gwar-ŋʋnnʋ tɩn mʋ na? Aye, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Nɔɔna balʋ na zʋ gwar-ŋʋnnʋ tɩn zʋʋrɩ sɔ-ŋʋnnʋ wʋnɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ kagʋa wʋnɩ.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nan mʋ á ve sɩ á nii? Á ve sɩ á na Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ na? Ɛɛn, kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Á nan na nɛ wʋlʋ tɩn tiini o dwe faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na yɩ te tɩn.

translation_verse: Maŋa kantʋ nɩ, Zezi laan ma kɩ o Ko Baŋa-Wɛ le yɩ o wɩ: «A Ko, nmʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na te wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa maama tɩn. Nmʋ nan mʋ pɛ n cɩga kam sǝgi swan tiinǝ dɩ yiyiu tiinǝ tee nɩ, yɩ n daarɩ n pa balʋ na nyɩ dɩ bu-balɛ te tɩn lwarɩ ka kuri.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: O laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «A Ko Wɛ nan kwe woŋo maama o kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm, kʋ na daɩ o Ko yɩranɩ. english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: Á ba-na amʋ te, abam balʋ bam maama á na bwǝni yɩ á zɩŋɩ zɩla yalʋ na dunǝ tɩn, sɩ amʋ wʋ́ pa á na siun.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Á sɛ-na sɩ á tʋŋɩ á pa amʋ, sɩ á zaasɩ kʋlʋ a na lagɩ a brɩ abam tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ a yɩ wʋ-bono tu mʋ yɩ a yɩ tu-n-tɩtɩ tu. Aá pa á wʋbʋŋa taa tigi jǝgǝ dɩdʋa.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ tɩtʋŋa yam ba cana, yɩ a na lagɩ sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ mwalɩ mwalɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Some Pharisees noticed this and said to Jesus, “Why are your disciples picking grain on the Sabbath? They are not supposed to do this!”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ dɩ ma tɔgɩ ba wʋra. Ba ma na ba na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba laan ma ta dɩ Zezi ba wɩ: «Nii nmʋ karabiǝ bam na kɩ kʋlʋ. Ba tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ na cɔgɩ dɩbam siun dɛ cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: The crowds were so amazed they asked, “Could Jesus be the Son of David?”
translation_verse: Kʋ ma sʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Pɛ Davidi dwi tu wʋlʋ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ tɩn na?»

english_verse: But when I force out demons by the power of God's Spirit, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam mʋ a ma a zǝli sʋtaana. Kʋntʋ maa brɩ nɩ Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ba abam te, sɩ DƖ di paarɩ nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Naa, abam ta wʋ fɔgɩ á karɩmɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na brɩ nɩ, Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ bam yǝni ba cɔgɩ siun dɛ culu kʋm dɩ ba na tʋŋɩ DƖ digǝ kam tɩtʋŋa siun dɛ maama wʋnɩ tɩn? Ba nan na yǝni ba tʋŋɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ta jɩgɩ bʋra kʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, “Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others?” If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.
translation_verse: Wɛ tagɩ DƖ wɩ: ‹Amʋ lagɩ sɩ nabiinǝ taa jɩgɩ da-ŋwaŋa mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ a lagɩ sɩ ba taa maɩ ba wǝǝnu mʋ ba kaanɩ-nɩ.› Abam ya na lwarɩ taanɩ dɩntʋ kuri, á ya bá di balʋ na jɩgɩ bʋra tɩn taanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues,
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma nuŋi jǝgǝ kantʋ nɩ o vu o zʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “Hold out your hand.” The man did, and it became as healthy as the other one.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ jɩŋa kam na tɩgɩ tɩn o wɩ: «Twɩ n jɩŋa kam.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma sɩɩnɩ o twɩ-ka. O jɩŋa kam ma joori ka ji lanyɩranɩ nɩ o jɩ-ŋʋŋa kam te.

english_verse: When Jesus found out what was happening, he left there and large crowds followed him. He healed all of their sick,
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma lwarɩ ba na lagɩ ba kɩ-o te tɩn. O ma nuŋi jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ. Nɔn-kɔgɔ zanzan dɛɛn maa tɔg-o. O ma pa ba maama na yazurǝ dɩ ba yawɩɩrʋ.

english_verse: but warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o kaanɩ-ba o wɩ, ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba pa nɔɔna lwarɩ o ni nɩ.

english_verse: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama nan na daɩ a nɔɔnʋ tɩn, o yɩ a dʋm mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama nan na ba tɔgɩ o laɩ amʋ nɔɔna o kɩ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa tɩn, o jagɩ-ba mʋ.

english_verse: Some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon in him. Jesus healed the man, and then he was able to talk and see.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɛɛn ma ja lilwe, yɩ o kwǝri o yɩ mɩmaa ba ba Zezi te. Bɛŋwaanɩ cicirǝ dɛɛn mʋ jɩg-o ka yaara. Zezi ma pa nɔɔnʋ wʋm na yazurǝ. O yiǝ ma joori ya naɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o waɩ o ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he said to them: Any kingdom where people fight each other will end up ruined. And a town or family that fights will soon destroy itself.
translation_verse: Zezi na lwarɩ ba wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn, o ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Tɩʋ kʋlʋ paarɩ na pɔɔrɩ kuni bɩle yɩ ba jɩgɩ daanɩ tɩn, kʋ bá daanɩ kʋ cɔgɩ. Tɩʋ kʋlʋ maama naa sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ maama na pɔɔrɩ kʋ tɩtɩ wʋnɩ kuni bɩle tɩn, kʋʋ́ tʋ mʋ.

translation_verse: Ka laan ma joori ka vu ka lagɩ ciciri sɩrpɛ sɩlʋ na tiini sɩ yɩ balwaarʋ sɩ dwe ka tɩtɩ tɩn. Sɩ ma tɔgɩ daanɩ sɩ vu sɩ zʋʋrɩ da. Kʋntʋ, nɔɔnʋ wʋm laan wʋ́ tiini o na cam kʋ dwǝni faŋa. Mʋ kʋ na lagɩ kʋ kɩ zɩm nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩm dɩ te.» Zezi nu dɩ Zezi nyaana na yɩ balʋ tɩn (Marɩkɩ

translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba ta dɩ Zezi ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩbam lagɩ sɩ n kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ brɩ dɩbam nɩ n nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ.»

translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Zɩm nɔɔna bantʋ yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ, ba ba tɔgɩ Wɛ dɩ cɩga, yɩ ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ a brɩ-ba. Ba nan bá na, kʋ na daɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ kɩ dɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Zonasɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ dɛɛn kɩ da yatɔ mʋ wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama kalǝŋ-kamunu wʋnɩ. Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ kʋ kɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ, amʋ dɩ wʋ́ kɩ da yatɔ mʋ wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama yibeeli wʋnɩ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Nineveh will stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.
translation_verse: Zonasɩ dɛɛn na ve Niniivi tiinǝ te o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ ba tɩn, bantʋ lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ. Wʋlʋ na dwe Zonasɩ tɩn nan wʋ abam tee nɩ yɩ á wʋ sɛ kʋ tu. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, Wɛ sarɩya dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, Niniivi tiinǝ laan wʋ́ zaŋɩ ba brɩ nɩ abam ba jɩgɩ bʋra.

english_verse: it says, “I will go back to the home I left.” When it gets there and finds the place empty, clean, and neat,

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers came and stood outside because they wanted to talk with him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ta na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, o nu dɩ o nyaana ma ba ba zɩgɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm mancoŋo nɩ, yɩ ba lagɩ sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o.

english_verse: Someone told Jesus, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to talk with you.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ ma ta dɩ Zezi o wɩ: «N nu dɩ n nyaana tu ba wʋ cicwǝŋǝ nɩ, yɩ ba lagɩ sɩ ba na-m.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who is my mother and who are my brothers?”

translation_verse: O laan ma nii o karabiǝ bam seeni yɩ o wɩ: «A nu dɩ a nyaana mʋ tɩntʋ.

translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ a Ko Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ yɩ a nyaanɩ dɩ a nakɔ dɩ a nu.»

english_verse: Then he taught them many things by using stories. He said: A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.
translation_verse: O ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋa o brɩ-ba wǝǝnu zanzan o wɩ: «Valʋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra. O ma zaŋɩ o vu kara sɩ o du.

english_verse: Other seeds fell on thin, rocky ground and quickly started growing because the soil wasn't very deep.
translation_verse: Tɩdonnǝ ma tʋ kandwa jǝgǝ nɩ valɩm na ba daga mɛ tɩn. Tɩ ma wʋ daanɩ tɩ puli, valɩm dɩm na ba lirǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked the plants.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ wo-duuru tɩdonnǝ ma tʋ sabarɩ wʋnɩ. Tɩ na puli tɩn, sabarɩ sɩm laan ma zaŋɩ sɩ li-tɩ sɩ gʋ.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, “Why do you use stories to speak to the people?”
translation_verse: Zezi na maŋɩ mɩmaŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o karabiǝ bam laan ma vu o te, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ nmʋ yǝni n maŋɩ mɩmaŋa n brɩ nɔɔna bam?»

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “These people will listen and listen, but never understand. They will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi dɛɛn na tagɩ kʋlʋ faŋa faŋa tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ bantʋ tee nɩ. O dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: ‹Abam wʋ́ fɔgɩ á cǝgi Wɛ taanɩ dɩm dɩ á zwa, yɩ á bá ni dɩ kuri. Abam wʋ́ fɔgɩ á nii dɩ á yiǝ, yɩ á bá na.

english_verse: Many prophets and good people were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear. Jesus Explains the Story about the Farmer (Mark

translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kunkwǝǝnu tɩlʋ na nyɩɩnɩ tɩn ma ba tɩ kwǝli-ba. Ba laan ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ tɩ wʋnɩ ka wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ bu-dʋa a na soe dɩ a wʋ maama, yɩ o yǝni o pa a jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Á nan taá cǝgi o taanɩ lanyɩranɩ.»

translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam na ni kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma vi ba yigǝ tɩga nɩ, fʋʋnɩ na tiini dɩ zʋ-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.

translation_verse: Zezi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta o wɩ: «Abam zɩm nɔɔna bam brɩ á ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ, yɩ á ba kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Amʋ wʋ́ daanɩ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kɔɔ? Amʋ wʋ́ kɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ abam sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kɔɔ? Ja-na bu wʋm á ba yo seeni.»

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma bagɩ cicirǝ kalʋ na jɩgɩ bu wʋm tɩn, o pa ka nuŋi ka yag-o. O ma da o na yazurǝ maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔ́ɔ.

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma lǝri o wɩ: «O ŋwɩa.» O laan ma joori o vu o zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ ba na wʋra tɩn. Zezi ma da yigǝ o bwe-o o wɩ: «Simɔn, nmʋ wʋbʋŋa yɩ tɩta mʋ? Lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam yǝni ba joŋi lampoo nɔɔna bra tee nɩ mʋ? Ba yǝni ba joŋi-kʋ ba tɩtɩ tɩʋ biǝ tee nɩ mʋ naa nɔɔna badonnǝ tee nɩ mʋ?»

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: Balʋ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn, ba na maŋɩ ba muri nɩ bu-balwa te dɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na pɛ ba dɩdʋa yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm tɩn, ba na lǝgi kandwɛ kamunu mʋ kʋntʋ tu ba nɩ ba dɩ-o nɩnɩʋ wʋnɩ yɩ o tɩ, kʋʋ́ ta garɩ cam dɩlʋ o na wʋ́ ba na Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma vu Zezi te, yɩ o bwe-o o wɩ: «A Yuutu, amʋ ko-bu na kɩ-nɩ lwarɩm, kuni bɩgra mʋ a maŋɩ sɩ a yagɩ a ma cɛ-o? Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ yi kuni bɩrpɛ mʋ naa?»

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ pɛ wʋdoŋ na lagɩ o jeeli o sǝbu o tɩntʋŋna tee nɩ o nii te tɩn mʋ.
