translation_verse: O na puli sɩ o jeeli-kʋ tɩn, ba laan ma ja o tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋdoŋ na jɩgɩ o jɩnɩ zanzan nɩnɛɛnɩ sǝbu-dala mʋrr-fugǝ te tɩn (

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ maa warɩ o ŋwɩ o jɩnɩ dɩm. Pɛ wʋm laan ma pa ni sɩ ba ja nɔɔnʋ wʋm dɩ o kaanɩ dɩ o biǝ ba yǝgi, kʋ wǝli dɩ o wǝǝnu maama, sɩ ba ma sǝbu kʋm kʋntʋ ba ŋwɩ jɩnɩ dɩm.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma vu o kuni doonǝ pɛ wʋm yigǝ nɩ o loor-o o wɩ: ‹Amʋ tu, popo ja n banɩ dɩ amʋ, sɩ amʋ wʋ́ ŋwɩ n jɩnɩ dɩm maama a pa-m.›

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm ma duri o ŋwaŋa yɩ o yagɩ jɩnɩ dɩm o ma cɛ-o, yɩ o daa wʋ kɩ-o kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma kuni doonǝ o doŋ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm yigǝ nɩ o loor-o o wɩ: ‹Popo ja n banɩ dɩ amʋ, sɩ amʋ wʋ́ ŋwɩ n jɩnɩ dɩm a pa-m.›

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: O ma wʋ sɛ, yɩ o ja nɔɔnʋ wʋm o vu o kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kam o na wʋ́ ŋwɩ o jɩnɩ dɩm tɩn.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm tɩntʋŋna badonnǝ na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa ba wʋrʋ tiini tɩ cɔgɩ. Ba laan ma vu ba ta ba brɩ pɛ wʋm kʋlʋ maama na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm laan ma bǝŋi o tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: ‹Nmʋ yɩ nɔn-balɔrɔ mʋ. Amʋ yagɩ nmʋ jɩ-farɩ dɩm maama mʋ a ma cɛ-m, nmʋ na loori-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm banɩ ma tiini dɩ zaŋɩ zanzan dɩ o tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm. O ma kɩ-o o tɩntʋŋna bam jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba pa o na cam, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kalʋ o na wʋ́ ŋwɩ o jɩnɩ dɩm maama tɩn.

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, abam wʋlʋ maama na wʋ yagɩ o ma cɛ o ko-bu dɩ o wʋ maama tɩn, amʋ Ko Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ pa abam na cam kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.»

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na brɩ-ba wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama o ti tɩn, o laan ma zaŋɩ Galile nɩ o vu o yi Zude tɩ-niǝ yam, Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam ni dɩdoŋ dɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ ma tɔg-o kʋ vu, yɩ o pa ba yawɩɩna na yazurǝ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ badaara dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba vu Zezi te. Ba maa lagɩ sɩ ba maŋ-o ba nii, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o vɩn o kaanɩ, kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ kʋlʋ maama ŋwaanɩ na?»

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ na di kaanɩ, o maŋɩ sɩ o pɔɔrɩ o tɩtɩ o nu dɩ o ko tee nɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o pa o dɩ o kaanɩ wʋm jǝni daanɩ. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa ba laan ji nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa.

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, ba daa daɩ nɔɔna bale, ba laan yɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ. Wɛ na kɩ nɔɔna balʋ daanɩ tɩn, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o pɔɔrɩ-ba daanɩ.»

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam daa ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ Moyisi dɛɛn pa ni, nɩ nɔɔnʋ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ o pa o kaanɩ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ o vɩ-o?»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam wʋrʋ na dana tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Moyisi dɩ sɛ sɩ á vɩn á kaana. Kʋ na zɩgɩ pulim maŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋ ya wʋ maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔna vɩn ba kaana.

english_verse: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.”
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a ta abam sɩ, nɔɔnʋ na vɩn o kaanɩ, yɩ kʋ na daɩ nɩ o cɔgɩ dɩ baara, yɩ o daarɩ o di kaanɩ wʋdoŋ, kʋntʋ tu kǝm dɩm yɩ balɔrɔ nɩnɛɛnɩ o na pǝni dɩ o doŋ kaanɩ te tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ nan daɩ nɔɔna maama mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ ba ni taanɩ dɩntʋ kuri, kʋ yɩ balʋ yɩranɩ Wɛ na zǝni-ba sɩ ba wanɩ ba joŋi-dɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɛɛn ma ja bu-balwa ba vu Zezi te, sɩ o daŋɩ o jɩa ba yuu nɩ sɩ o warɩ Wɛ o pa-ba. O karabiǝ bam ma zaŋɩ ba kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba yɩ taa kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: “Which ones?” the man asked. Jesus answered, “Do not murder. Be faithful in marriage. Do not steal. Do not tell lies about others.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma bwe-o o wɩ: «DƖ cullu tɔɔ mʋ kʋntʋ?» Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Yɩ zaŋɩ n gʋ nɔɔnʋ. Yɩ zaŋɩ n pǝni dɩ n doŋ kaanɩ. Yɩ zaŋɩ n ŋɔ. Yɩ fɔ vwan n pa n doŋ.

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ ta mʋ yɩ n bwe amʋ sɩ n lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na lana tɩn sɩ n kɩ? Wɛ yɩranɩ mʋ lana. Nmʋ na lagɩ sɩ n na ŋwɩa DƖ tee nɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ n ta n tɔgɩ DƖ cullu tɩm mʋ.»

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Yagɩ-na sɩ biǝ bam taa tui a te, sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á cɩ-ba. Bɛŋwaanɩ balʋ na nyɩ nɩ bu-balwa te tɩn mʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Respect your father and mother. And love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Ta n zuli n nu dɩ n ko. Ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te.»

english_verse: The young man said, “I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do?”
translation_verse: Nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm laan ma ta o wɩ: «A maŋɩ a tɔgɩ cullu tɩntʋ maama. Kʋ nan ta gɛ bɛɛ mʋ sɩ a kɩ?»

english_verse: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa o wʋ cɔgɩ zanzan, o jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm na tiini tɩ daga tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O ma viiri Zezi tee nɩ.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, nadum na lagɩ sɩ o zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, kʋʋ́ ta tiini kʋ cana kʋ pa-o.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: A nan ta lagɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ, kʋʋ́ ta yɩ mwalɩ sɩ yogondi da gar-lwe bɔɔnɩ dɩ nuŋi kʋ dwe nadum na lagɩ sɩ o zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋ.»

english_verse: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, “How can anyone ever be saved?”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ sʋ-ba. Ba maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Kʋ nan na yɩ kʋntʋ, wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ?»

english_verse: Jesus looked straight at them and said, “There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma nii-ba yɩ o wɩ: «Nabiinǝ mʋ bá wanɩ ba kɩ, sɩ Wɛ waɩ woŋo maama DƖ kɩa.»

english_verse: Peter replied, “Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma ta o wɩ: «Nii. Dɩbam yagɩ dɩ́ woŋo maama mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ nmʋ. Bɛɛ mʋ dɩbam lagɩ dɩ́ na Wɛ tee nɩ?»

english_verse: Jesus answered: Yes, all of you have become my followers. And so in the future world, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, I promise you will sit on twelve thrones to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam balʋ na tɔgɩ amʋ tɩn wʋ́ ba á tɔgɩ á di paarɩ, maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ kɩ wǝǝnu maama sɩ tɩ taa yɩ nadʋnnʋ tɩn. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm wʋ́ ba a jǝni a paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ, yɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ jǝni paarɩ jangwaanʋ fugǝ-tɩle baŋa nɩ, sɩ á tɔgɩ á di Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ kuri fugǝ-bɩle dɩm taanɩ.

english_verse: As Jesus was telling what the kingdom of heaven would be like, he said: Early one morning a man went out to hire some workers for his vineyard.
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma daarɩ o wɩ: «Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ na jɩgɩ o kara. O ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi zɩzɩŋa nɩ o vu sɩ o lagɩ nɔɔna balʋ na varɩ ba joŋi sǝbu tɩn, sɩ ba vu ba tʋŋɩ o kara kam nɩ.

english_verse: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.
translation_verse: O ma sɛ sɩ o ŋwɩ-ba sǝbu kʋlʋ ba na maŋɩ sɩ ba joŋi dɛ wʋnɩ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ sǝbu-dalɩ dɩdʋa mʋ. Ba na ŋɔɔnɩ ba maŋɩ daanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma tʋŋɩ-ba sɩ ba vu o kara kam ba taa tʋŋa.

english_verse: About nine that morning, the man saw some other people standing in the market with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Wɩa na bɩgɩ fɩnfɩɩn nɩnɛɛnɩ luu nʋgʋ maŋa nɩ te tɩn, o daa ma vu yaga o na nɔɔna badonnǝ na wʋra, yɩ ba ba jɩgɩ tɩtʋŋa.

english_verse: He promised to pay them what was fair, if they would work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: ‹Abam dɩ ba á tɔgɩ á tʋŋɩ a kara kam nɩ, sɩ amʋ wʋ́ ŋwɩ abam te na maŋɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Ba ma sɛ ba vu. Wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ o daa ma joori o vu o lagɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ o wǝli da. Wɛ-gunim maŋa nɩ o daa ta ma vu o lagɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ dɩ o wǝli da.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Dɩdaan-ni nɩ o daa ma vu yaga o na nɔɔna badonnǝ ta na zɩgɩ da. O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: ‹Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam zɩgɩ yo seeni dɛ dɩm wʋnɩ maama, yɩ á ba kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ?›

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: ‹Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ kwe dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa-o.› O ma ta dɩ bantʋ dɩ, sɩ ba vu ba tɔgɩ ba tʋŋɩ o kara kam nɩ.

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: Tɩga na lagɩ ka yi tɩn, o laan ma ta dɩ o tɩtʋŋa yigǝ tu wʋm sɩ o ta dɩ tɩntʋŋna bam, sɩ ba zaŋɩ ba ba ba joŋi ba ŋwɩɩrʋ. O ma ta dɩd-o sɩ o puli o ŋwɩ tɩntʋŋna balʋ na tu ba kweeli tɩn.

english_verse: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tu ba sɩŋɩ tɩtʋŋa dɩdaan-ni nɩ tɩn ma ba sɩ ba joŋi ba ŋwɩɩrʋ. Ba ma ŋwɩ-ba sǝbu-dalɩ dɩdʋa dɩdʋa.

english_verse: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba ma joŋi ba sǝbu, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pʋʋna dɩ kara kam tu wʋm ba wɩ:

english_verse: They said, “The ones who were hired last worked for only one hour. But you paid them the same that you did us. And we worked in the hot sun all day long!”
translation_verse: ‹Balʋ na tu kwaga tɩn tʋŋɩ fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ, nɩnɛɛnɩ luu dɩdʋa te. Dɩbam nan tu dɩ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ mʋ, kʋ cɛ dɩ́ yɩra wɩa yigǝ nɩ dɛ dɩm maama wʋnɩ, yɩ nmʋ pa bantʋ ŋwɩʋ maɩ dɩ dɩbam na joŋi te tɩn.›

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.
translation_verse: Kara kam tu wʋm ma lǝri ba dɩdʋa o wɩ: ‹A ciloŋ, nii yo. A wʋ kɩ nmʋ kampinǝ, bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ sɛ sɩ n tʋŋɩ n joŋi sǝbu-dalɩ dɩdʋa mʋ dɛ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?
translation_verse: Nan ja n sǝbu kʋm n viiri, sɩ taanɩ tǝrǝ. Amʋ laga, yɩ a ŋwɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na tu kwaga o tʋŋɩ tɩn, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ nmʋ na joŋi te tɩn.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: A nan ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ma a sǝbu kʋm a kɩ kʋlʋ a na lagɩ tɩn na? Nmʋ nan jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ a na jɩgɩ wʋ-yoŋo tɩn mʋ na?›

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri, balʋ na wʋ kwaga nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ba ba ji yigǝ tiinǝ, yɩ balʋ na wʋ yigǝ nɩ tɩn wʋ́ joori ba ji kwaga tiinǝ.» Zezi daa na ŋɔɔnɩ o tʋʋnɩ taanɩ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Zezi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma zɩgɩ yɩ o bǝŋi-ba o bwe o wɩ: «Abam lagɩ sɩ a kɩ bɛɛ mʋ a pa abam?»

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Zezi ma duri ba ŋwaŋa. O ma twɩ o jɩŋa o dwe ba yiǝ yam, yɩ ya joori ya naɩ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ. Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba tɔgɩ o kwaga.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm ma kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba pu ba niǝ. Ba laan ma tiini ba kaasɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Yuutu! Pɛ Davidi dwi tu! Duri dɩbam yibwǝnǝ!»

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba maa kɛ Zeruzalɛm. Ba na wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn, o ma pɔɔrɩ o karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ o pa ba tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba veǝ.

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: Ba laan wʋ́ daarɩ ba kɩ-nɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam jɩŋa nɩ. Bantʋ dɩ wʋ́ mwanɩ amʋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba magɩ-nɩ dɩ balaara. Ba laan wʋ́ ja-nɩ ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ. Da yatɔ dɛ nɩ, a laan wʋ́ joori a bi a yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.» Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam na jɩgɩ yaara te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Zebede biǝ bam nu dɛɛn ma vu Zezi te dɩ o biǝ bale bam. O ma kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ sɩ o loor-o.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ n laga?» O ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Popo, pa ni sɩ n na tu n di n paarɩ dɩm, sɩ n pa a biǝ bale bantʋ jǝni nmʋ tee nɩ, n jazɩm nɩ dɩ n jagwiǝ nɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam tɩtɩ yǝri á na loori kʋlʋ tɩn. Abam wʋ́ wanɩ á tɔgɩ á yaarɩ nɩ a na lagɩ a ba a na yaara yalʋ tɩn na?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Ɛɛn, dɩ́ wʋ́ wanɩ.»

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: O karabiǝ fugǝ kam na lwarɩ ba donnǝ bale bam na loori kʋlʋ Zezi tee nɩ tɩn, ba bana ma tiini ya zaŋɩ dɩ ba.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma bǝŋi ba maama, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam maŋɩ á ye lʋgʋ baŋa pwa na yǝni ba jɩgɩ ba nɔɔna ba bɛɛsɩ te tɩn, yɩ ba dɩdɛɛra mʋ di dam ba baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, abam wʋlʋ na lagɩ sɩ o ji nɔn-kamunu á wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o ji abam maama tɩntʋŋnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na lagɩ sɩ o ji abam yigǝ tu tɩn, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o ji á gambaa mʋ.

english_verse: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men (Mark
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ, amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm wʋ tu sɩ nɔɔna tʋŋɩ ba pa-nɩ. Amʋ nan tu sɩ a tʋŋɩ a pa nabiinǝ mʋ, sɩ a daarɩ a kwe a ŋwɩa a ma lǝni nɔɔna zanzan ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.» Zezi na puri lilwǝ bale yiǝ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam dɛɛn ma nuŋi Zeriko nɩ ba maa kɛa. Ba na maa kɛ tɩn, nɔn-kɔgɔ maa tɔgɩ-ba.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Lilwǝ bale dɛɛn ma je cwǝŋǝ kam ni nɩ. Ba na lwarɩ nɩ Zezi mʋ tɔgɩ dáanɩ o maa kɛ tɩn, ba laan ma kaasɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu! Pɛ Davidi dwi tu! Duri dɩbam yibwǝnǝ!»

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta o wɩ: «A lagɩ a maŋɩ mɩmaŋɩ dɩdoŋ a brɩ abam, sɩ á bʋŋɩ á nii. Nɔɔnʋ mʋ wʋra dɩ o biǝ bale. O ma ta dɩ bu-kwɩan kam o wɩ: ‹Ve n tʋŋɩ a kara nɩ zɩm dɛ dɩm nɩ.›

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: O bu wʋm na maa ve yɩ nɔɔna bam na-o tɩn, ba maa ŋɔɔnɩ daanɩ ba wɩ: ‹Mʋ gaarɩ dɩm tu bu, wʋntʋ mʋ lagɩ o ba o taa te o ko wʋm wǝǝnu tɩm. Nan pa-na dɩ́ gʋ-o, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ taa te o wǝǝnu tɩm.›

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na bwe abam sɩ woŋo, sɩ á ta dɩd-o nɩ, kʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm mʋ lagɩ-sɩ. Kʋ tu wʋ́ sɛ o yagɩ o pa abam, yɩ á ja á ba.»

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: «Ve-na á ta dɩ Siyɔn tiinǝ bam nɩ: ‹Nii-na á pɛ wʋm, o maa bɩɩnɩ á te. Wʋntʋ tu o tɩtɩ mʋ, yɩ o di bɩnaga o maa bɩɩna. Ka yɩ bɩna-pɔla mʋ o diinǝ, yɩ ka nu mɩ zɩla zɩŋɩm.› »

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bale bam ma sɩɩnɩ ba tɔgɩ yigǝ, ba vu ba kɩ kʋlʋ o na tagɩ sɩ ba kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja bɩna-kwɩʋn kʋm dɩ bɩna-pɔla kam ba ba, yɩ ba lɩ ba gwaarʋ ba daŋɩ sɩ baŋa nɩ. Zezi laan ma di bɩna-pɔla kam, yɩ ba ve ba maa kɛa.

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.

translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, abam na loori woŋo kʋlʋ maama Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ á na kɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa nɩ á wʋ́ na, Wɛ wʋ́ pa á sɩɩnɩ á na-kʋ.» Nɔɔna na bwe Zezi dam dɩm na nuŋi mɛ tɩn (Marɩkɩ

translation_verse: O laan ma zaŋɩ ba tee nɩ o viiri. O ma nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm nɩ o vu Betani, yɩ o pǝni dáanɩ. Zezi na sɔɔlɩ kapʋrʋ yɩ kʋ tɩ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A dɩ jɩgɩ bwiǝ a lagɩ a bwe abam. Á na lǝri á pa-nɩ, sɩ a laan brɩ abam wʋlʋ na pɛ amʋ ni sɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city,
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ tɩn, o ma zaŋɩ sɩ o joori o vu Zeruzalɛm. O na wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn, o kana maa wɔɛ.

english_verse: But Jesus said to them, “If you have faith and don't doubt, I promise you can do what I did to this tree. And you will be able to do even more. You can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ yɩ á ba jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa, abam dɩ wʋ́ wanɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ kapʋrʋ kʋm tɩn doŋ. english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma joori o vu o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ. O maa wʋra o brɩ nɔɔna bam. Zwifǝ nakwa bam dɩ ba kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam ma vu o te ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Wɔɔ dam mʋ n ma n kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama n na kɩ tɩn? Wɔɔ mʋ pɛ nmʋ ni sɩ n ta n kɩ kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?” They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a bwe abam a nii, Zan na miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o cwǝŋǝ naa nabiinǝ mʋ?» O na bwe-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maa wʋra ba bwɛ daanɩ sɩ ba nii, ba na wʋ́ lǝr-o te tɩn. Ba maa wɩ: «Dɩbam na lǝri dɩ́ wɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ, o laan wʋ́ bwe dɩbam o nii, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ nan wʋ sɛ Zan taanɩ dɩm?

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, dɩ́ na wɩ kʋ yɩ nabiinǝ mʋ pɛ-o cwǝŋǝ, nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ́ ja dɩ dɩbam, dɩ ba maama na paɩ Zan yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu tɩn ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: His son told him he would not do it, but later he changed his mind and went.

translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, biǝ bam kʋntʋ bale wʋnɩ, wɔɔ mʋ sɩɩnɩ o kɩ ba ko wʋm na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ bu nakwɩ wʋm mʋ.» Ba na lǝri kʋntʋ tɩn, Zezi laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, nɔn-cɩcɔgɩrʋ, kʋ na yɩ lampo-joŋnǝ dɩ ka-bwǝǝru, wʋ́ zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ ba daarɩ abam.

english_verse: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe. Renters of a Vineyard (Mark
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, Zan na tu abam te tɩn, o dɛɛn brɩ abam cwǝŋǝ kalʋ á na wʋ́ da sɩ á na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, yɩ á wʋ sɛ o taanɩ dɩm. english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: O tɩntʋŋna bam na tu tɩn, nɔɔna bam ma ja-ba, ba magɩ dɩdʋa lanyɩranɩ, ba gʋ wʋdoŋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba dʋlɩ dɩdʋa dɩ kandwa ba gʋ.

english_verse: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.
translation_verse: Gaarɩ dɩm tu wʋm ta ma joori o tʋŋɩ o tɩntʋŋna badonnǝ nɔɔna bam tee nɩ. Bantʋ kɔgɔ dwe dayigǝ nɔɔna bam. Nɔɔna bam daa ta ma kɩ bantʋ dɩ kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Kʋ kweelim nɩ tɩn, o laan ma tʋŋɩ o tɩtɩ bu nɔɔna bam tee nɩ, yɩ o bʋŋɩ nɩ, baá nɩgɩ wʋntʋ.

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ja-o ba vaŋɩ ba ja nuŋi gaarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, ba mag-o ba gʋ.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, gaarɩ dɩm tu wʋm laan na tuǝ, oó kɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ tɩta mʋ?»

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Zezi na bwe-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba laan ma lǝri ba wɩ: «O maŋɩ sɩ o gʋ nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ mʋ, sɩ o daarɩ o kwe gaarɩ dɩm o pa nɔɔna badonnǝ sɩ ba taa nii-dɩ, sɩ tweeru tɩm biǝ bam gwǝrim maŋa na yiǝ, sɩ ba taa pa-o o tweeru tɩm biǝ bam.»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: ‹Kandwɛ dɩlʋ lwara na vɩn tɩn laan mʋ joori dɩ ba dɩ ji kandwɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm dana tɩn. Kʋntʋ yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ kɩa, yɩ kʋ yɩ wo-kamunu kʋ pa dɩbam.› Abam maŋɩ á wʋ karɩmɩ kʋntʋ na?

translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam laan ma zaŋɩ ba vu sɩ ba banɩ ba nii, ba na wʋ́ kɩ te ba pa Zezi ŋɔɔnɩ o tusi sɩ ba ja-o tɩn.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba ta dɩ Zezi ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, Moyisi dɛɛn brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɩga, yɩ o dɩ o kaanɩ na ba jɩgɩ biǝ daanɩ, o nu-bu mʋ maŋɩ sɩ o di kadǝm wʋm sɩ ba lʋ biǝ o cʋrʋ kʋlʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋɩ dɩdoŋ o brɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ:

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: «Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nyɩ dɩ pɛ wʋdoŋ na lagɩ sɩ o kɩ kadiri candiǝ o pa o bu te tɩn.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: O laan ma joori o tʋŋɩ o tɩntʋŋna badonnǝ, sɩ ba vu nɔɔna bam te ba ta dɩ ba nɩ: ‹Ba-na, sɩ amʋ ti woŋo maama yɩ a pa ba gʋ na-paala dɩ varɩ-nunuguru. Nan ba-na sɩ dɩ́ di candiǝ kam.›

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ ba na bǝŋi kʋntʋ tɩn ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba wʋbʋŋa je, ba na ba nɩgɩ o beeri dɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba dɩdʋa ve o kara mʋ. Dɩdʋa ma vu sɩ o kɩ o pipiu.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na daarɩ tɩn ma ja pɛ wʋm tɩntʋŋna bam, ba bɛɛsɩ-ba ba gʋ.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm banɩ ma tiini dɩ zaŋɩ. O ma tʋŋɩ o pamaŋna sɩ ba vu ba gʋ nɔn-gʋra bam kʋntʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba zwɛ ba tɩʋ kʋm maama.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ o tɩntʋŋna bam o wɩ: ‹Kadiri dɩm woŋo maama ti kʋ yigǝ sɩ dɩ́ di. A nan na bǝŋi balʋ sɩ dɩ́ di candiǝ kam tɩn ya wʋ maŋɩ dɩ ka.

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm laan ma nuŋi sɩ o zaanɩ nɔɔna bam. O ma na nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa na wʋra o na wʋ zʋ gwar-ŋʋŋʋ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ kadiri dim tɩn.

translation_verse: O dɩ ma tɩ o daar-o. Batɔ tu wʋm dɩ daa ma di-o. Kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ dɩ ba maama barpɛ, yɩ ba wʋ lʋgɩ bu dɩ kaanɩ wʋm.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ba ma lɩ ba karabiǝ badonnǝ, sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩ Pɛ Erɔdɩ kwaga nɔɔna badonnǝ ba vu Zezi te. Ba ma vu ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩbam ye nɩ nmʋ yɩ cɩga tu mʋ, yɩ n yǝni n brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam cɩga. Nmʋ yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ nɔɔna na bʋŋɩ kʋlʋ ba pa nmʋ tɩn, nmʋ nan ba kuri nɔɔna daanɩ.

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Nan brɩ-na-nɩ sǝbu-dalɩ dɩlʋ dɩ́ na yǝni dɩ́ ma ŋwɩ lampoo tɩn.» Ba ma lɩ sǝbu-dalɩ dɩm ba brɩ-o.

translation_verse: O na lǝri-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba zanzan. Ba laan ma yag-o yɩ ba viiri. Twa biim taanɩ (Marɩkɩ

translation_verse: Moyisi zaasɩm dɩm dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam zaasɩm dɩm maama yɔɔrɩ dɩ puli niǝ yantʋ yale baŋa nɩ mʋ.» Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn yɩ Davidi Yuutu mʋ (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, Sadusɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba vu Zezi te. Bantʋ mʋ brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɩga o daa bá joori o bi tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam tiini á tusi mʋ. Abam nan wʋ ni Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm zaasɩm dɩm kuri dɩ, yɩ á yǝri Wɛ dam dɩm na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔna na tu ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, baá ta nyɩ dɩ Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm na yɩ te tɩn mʋ, baara daa bá di kaana, kaana dɩ nan daa bá zʋ banna dɩ.

english_verse: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said,
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ twa biim dɩm dɩ, abam maŋɩ á wʋ karɩmɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ na tagɩ DƖ brɩ abam yɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ DƖ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn na?

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: DƖ tagɩ DƖ wɩ: ‹Amʋ yɩ Abraham Wɛ, dɩ Yizakɩ Wɛ, dɩ Zakɔbɩ Wɛ mʋ.› Kʋ brɩ nɩ bantʋ daa ta jɩgɩ ŋwɩa mʋ DƖ tee nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ naŋʋna Wɛ mʋ sɩ DƖ daɩ twa Wɛ.»

english_verse: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching. The Most Important Commandment (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm na ni Zezi zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ te tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ sʋ-ba. Wɛ niǝ yam wʋnɩ dɔɔ mʋ yɩ kamunu dɩ dwe? (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: «Karanyɩna, Wɛ niǝ yam maama wʋnɩ dɔɔ mʋ yɩ kamunu dɩ dwe?»

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ nan mʋ yɩ Wɛ dayigǝ ni yɩ dɩ yɩ kamunu.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Dɩlʋ na saŋɩ tɩn dɩ nyɩ dɩ dɩntʋ mʋ, dɩ tagɩ dɩ wɩ, ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te.

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma ba ba kikili daanɩ. Zezi ma zaŋɩ o bwe-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: ‹Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tagɩ dɩ a Yuutu DƖ wɩ: Ba n jǝni a jazɩm nɩ, sɩ aá kɩ nmʋ dʋna maama n nɛ kuri nɩ.›

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: «Kʋ na yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ tɩn, abam bʋŋɩ nɩ oó ta yɩ wɔɔ dwi tu mʋ?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Oó ta yɩ Pɛ Davidi dwi tu mʋ.»

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: Davidi nan na sɩɩnɩ o bǝŋi Krisi wʋm o wɩ o Yuutu tɩn, o nan daa wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ o taa yɩ Davidi naa daga?»

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa maa warɩ sɩ o lǝri kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Kʋ na zɩgɩ dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ tɩn, nɔɔna bam maama maa kwarɩ sɩ ba daa bwe-o taanɩ.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, wʋlʋ na zǝŋi o tɩtɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ tu kʋntʋ tu. Wʋlʋ nan na tu o tɩtɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ zǝŋi kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: And now your temple will be deserted.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ abam tɩʋ kʋm laan wʋ́ ba kʋ ji di-dwǝǝnu.

english_verse: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.
translation_verse: Abam nɔn-kamunu mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ á wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: «Hǝii! Zeruzalɛm tiinǝ-ba, á yǝni á gʋɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ, yɩ á dʋlɩ nɔɔna balʋ Wɛ na tʋŋɩ abam tee nɩ tɩn dɩ kandwa. Kuni zanzan mʋ a ya lagɩ sɩ a la abam nɔn-biǝ a kɩ daanɩ, sɩ a taa nii á baŋa nɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ coro na kukwǝri kʋ biǝ kʋ kɩ kʋ vwana kuri nɩ te tɩn. Abam maa ba sɛa.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ o karabiǝ bam dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ á maŋɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ kʋlʋ maama ba na brɩ abam tɩn. Á nan yɩ zaŋɩ á lwǝni ba na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ ba tɩtɩ ba tɔgɩ kʋlʋ ba na brɩ nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, ba yǝni ba brɩ ba kǝm-laarʋ tɩm jaja mʋ sɩ nɔɔna maama taa naɩ. Ba yǝni ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ nɔɔna yigǝ nɩ, nɩ ba jɩgɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm sono, dɩ ba na tiini ba vɔ-tɩ ba yɩra nɩ jaja tɩn. Ba ma kɩ zala zanzan ba gwaarʋ yɩra nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna taa zuli-ba.

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: Ba na ve yaga, ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama taa tui ba zuli-ba mʋ, yɩ ba ta lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna taa bǝ-ba nɩ ‹Karanyɩna›.

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, á yɩ taá lagɩ sɩ ba taa bǝ abam nɩ ‹Karanyɩna›, bɛŋwaanɩ á maama yɩ nu-biǝ mʋ daanɩ, yɩ á jɩgɩ Karanyɩna dɩdʋa mʋ.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á ma nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ á ma bǝŋi nɩ á ‹Ko› lʋgʋ baŋa yo, Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ abam maama jɩgɩ Ko dɩdʋa mʋ, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Á yǝni á ganɩ kadǝnǝ á joŋi ba wǝǝnu. Á kwǝri á kɩ Wɛ-lor-dɩdwaarʋ sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ nɩ á yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna mʋ te. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Wɛ wʋ́ tiini DƖ pa abam na cam kʋ ja gaalɩ.]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Á yǝni á beeri lʋgʋ baŋa je maama mʋ sɩ á nii, á wʋ́ wanɩ á pa dwi-gɛ tu dɩdʋa ba o tɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam tɩn na. Bantʋ dɩdʋa nan na tu o sɛ Wɛ, á laan wʋ́ brɩ-o á tɩtɩ cullu mʋ, sɩ á pa o tiini o ji min-tɩʋ nɔɔnʋ kʋ dwǝni abam tɩtɩ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: Lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam nyɩ dɩ lilwǝ na vaŋɩ ba donnǝ lilwǝ te tɩn mʋ. Abam yǝni á brɩ nɔɔna á wɩ, nɔɔnʋ na dugi durǝ dɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm, kʋntʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Á ma daarɩ á brɩ á wɩ, nɔɔnʋ nan na dugi dɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa kalʋ na wʋ Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ fɩfɩʋn mʋ sɩ kʋntʋ tu kɩ kʋlʋ o na dugi dɩ kʋ tɩn.

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Abam daa ta brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na dugi dɩ Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm, kʋntʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Á ma daarɩ á brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na dugi dɩ kaanɩm wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na tigi bimbim dɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ fɩfɩʋn mʋ sɩ kʋntʋ tu kɩ kʋlʋ o na dugi dɩ kʋ tɩn.

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ dɩ na dugi dɩ Wɛ-digǝ kam tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋntʋ tu dugi dɩ Wɛ mʋ, Wɛ na wʋ ka wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ dɩ nan na dugi dɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ kʋm tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋntʋ tu dugi dɩ Wɛ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm mʋ, kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋntʋ tu dugi dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ dwǝ dwi maama, ba zɩ ba daga dɩ, á yǝni á lɩ Wɛ tǝri á pa-DƖ. Kʋ lana. Kʋ daarɩ á yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ Wɛ niǝ yadaara yalʋ na tiini ya yɩ kamunǝ tɩn, nɩnɛɛnɩ cɩga tɔgɩm dɩ yibwǝn-durǝ dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa kǝm. Kʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ á taá kɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ mʋ sɩ á yɩ yagɩ Wɛ niǝ yadaara yam.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Abam ŋwɩa kam nyɩ dɩ ba na sɩn zwɩ dɩ kabǝli kwɛ sɩ kʋ tɔgɩ cullu na brɩ te yɩ sɩ wʋ su dɩ digiru te tɩn mʋ. Abam wʋrʋ su dɩ kampinǝ dɩ pu-sɩŋa mʋ.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Farizɩan tu, nmʋ nyɩ dɩ lilwe mʋ te. Nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n da yigǝ n sɩn n zwɩ wʋ mʋ, sɩ sɩ kwɛ dɩ daa yɩ taa jɩgɩ digiru.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Abam nyɩ dɩ yibeelǝ yalʋ ba na fɔgɩ ya kwaga sɩ ya taa lana nɔɔna yibiyǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ. Yibeelǝ yam kʋntʋ wʋ ma su dɩ twa kwi, yɩ ya tiini ya yɩ digiru yɩranɩ.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Abam dɩ nan yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Á paɩ á jɩgɩ cɩga mʋ nɔɔna yibiyǝ nɩ, yɩ á wʋrʋ laan su dɩ lwarɩm yɩranɩ, dɩdaanɩ pipirǝ kikiǝ.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Abam yǝni á fɔgɩ á kɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam yibeelǝ, yɩ á daarɩ á kwɛ Wɛ nɔn-ŋʋna bam yibeelǝ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: Á ma daarɩ á tɛ á wɩ, abam dɛɛn ya na wʋra á kwǝ nakwa bam maŋa kam nɩ, á ya bá sɛ á wǝli dɩ ba á gʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam.

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Abam tɩtɩ ni-taanɩ nan mʋ brɩ nɩ á yɩ balʋ na gʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam tɩn biǝ.

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Abam dɩ á kwǝ bam maama nyɩ dɩ bɩsankwɩ-dwǝ mʋ. Á brɩ á bá lu min-tɩʋ cam dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, nɔɔna bantʋ maama caa wʋ́ ta tɔgɩ zɩm nɔɔna bam.» Zezi wʋ na cɔgɩ Zeruzalɛm tiinǝ ŋwaanɩ te tɩn (Luki

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nan taá ye-na nɩ, á daa bá na-nɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ á na wʋ́ ta á wɩ: ‹Zuli-na wʋlʋ na bɩɩnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.› »

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam wʋ nɛ ka na yɩ te tɩn na? A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, ka maama wʋ́ ba ka tʋ tɩga nɩ ka cɔgɩ maama. Kandwɛ daa bá daŋɩ dɩ doŋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna zanzan wʋ́ ba abam te, yɩ baá ma amʋ yɩrɩ ba ma ganɩ abam ba wɩ, bam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa mʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ baá ganɩ nɔɔna zanzan.

english_verse: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.
translation_verse: Á wʋ́ ba á na tigurǝ na wʋ abam je sɩm nɩ, yɩ á kwǝri á ni ka ŋwa tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ na baŋwɛ tɩn nɩ. Nan yɩ pa-na fʋʋnɩ zʋ abam, bɛŋwaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama maŋɩ sɩ tɩ kɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋ ta daɩ lʋgʋ tiim maŋa.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma vu o jǝni Olivi piu kʋm yuu nɩ. O karabiǝ bam yɩranɩ ma vu o te, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Maŋa kɔɔ mʋ Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋ́ ba ka tʋ kʋntʋ? Bɛɛ mʋ lagɩ kʋ kɩ maana kʋ brɩ dɩbam nɩ maŋa kam yi sɩ nmʋ joori n ba lʋgʋ baŋa, sɩ lʋgʋ tiim mɩmaŋa laan yi?»

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Dwi wʋ́ zaŋɩ dɩ kɩ jara dɩ dwi dɩdoŋ, yɩ tɩʋ dɩ kʋ doŋ wʋ́ zaŋɩ tɩ magɩ jara. Kana dɩ wʋ́ ba ka taa wʋ je zanzan nɩ, yɩ tɩga dɩ wʋ́ sisiŋi je sɩdonnǝ nɩ.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ kʋʋ́ tiini kʋ taa yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ kaana balʋ na jɩgɩ pwi tɩn, dɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ biǝ yɩ ba ŋɔgɩ yɩlɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ ja abam ba kɩ dɩdɛɛra jɩa nɩ sɩ ba bɛɛsɩ abam, yɩ ba daarɩ ba gʋ abam. Abam na yɩ amʋ nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ, lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ta culi abam.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan wʋ́ ba ba brɩ nɩ ba yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ mʋ yɩ ba daɩ, yɩ baá ganɩ nɔɔna zanzan.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Nan taá loori-na Wɛ, sɩ cam durim dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ zaŋɩ dɩ ba taa yɩ waarʋ mɩmaŋa nɩ naa siun dɛ dɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: Abam nan wʋ́ ba á na wo-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na yɩ cɔgɩnʋ tɩn na wʋ́ ba kʋ zʋ kʋ zɩgɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ cɔgɩ-ka. Wɛ nijoŋnu Daniyɛlɩ maŋɩ o ta wo-lɔŋɔ kʋm kʋntʋ taanɩ.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na wʋ kara nɩ tɩn, o dɩ yɩ joori sɔŋɔ sɩ o kwe o gɔrɔ o zʋ.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ na wʋ pɛ yaara yam da yam tri, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wǝri. Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam DƖ na kuri tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ wʋ́ pa yaara yam da yam tri.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Nabiin-bu wʋm na wʋ́ joori o ba maŋa kalʋ tɩn, kʋʋ́ ta nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ dɛɛn na kɩ Nowe maŋa kam nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.
translation_verse: Kʋ na wʋ́ loori dʋ-fara kam nɩnɩm tɩn, nɔɔna dɛɛn di ba wʋdiiru, yɩ ba daarɩ ba di kaana, yɩ kaana dɩ zʋʋrɩ banna, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dɛ dɩm Nowe na zʋ naboro kamunu kʋm wʋ tɩn.

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn wʋ lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na lagɩ kʋ ba kʋ kɩ tɩn, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kalʋ dʋ-fara kam na bam na tu ba li nɔɔna bam maama tɩn. Nabiin-bu wʋm dɩ lagɩ o ba kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ, nɔɔna bale na wʋ kara nɩ ba tʋŋa, Wɛ wʋ́ lɩ ba dɩdʋa DƖ daarɩ wʋdoŋ wʋm.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yǝri dɛ dɩm á Yuutu wʋm na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Lwarɩ-na sɩ, sɔŋɔ tu ya na lwarɩ maŋa kalʋ ŋwɩɩnʋ na lagɩ o ba tɩtɩɩ nɩ o ŋɔ tɩn, o ya wʋ́ yɩrɩ o sɔŋɔ kʋm, sɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ wʋm yɩ na cwǝŋǝ o zʋ o ŋɔ.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, abam maŋɩ sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm lagɩ a ba maŋa kalʋ abam na ba bʋŋɩ nɩ aá ba tɩn mʋ.» Tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm dɩ tɩntʋŋ-balɔrɔ mɩmaŋa (Luki

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: O nan na yɩ tɩntʋŋ-balɔrɔ yɩ o bʋŋɩ nɩ, o yuutu wʋm daanɩ zanzan yɩ o ba tui,

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: «Wɔɔ mʋ yɩ tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa tɩn? O nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ o yuutu na yagɩ o tɩtʋŋa o pa-o yɩ o daarɩ o vu cwǝŋǝ tɩn. O yuutu wʋm ma lɩ-o sɩ o taa nii o donnǝ tɩntʋŋna bam baŋa nɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o taa pa-ba ba ni-wʋdiu maŋa maama.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, o yuutu wʋm laan wʋ́ pa o taa nii o jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm maama baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.

translation_verse: O laan ma fʋfɔ o vu daa. O ma vi o yigǝ tɩga nɩ o wʋra o loori Wɛ yɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ Ko, kʋ na waɩ, sɩ n pa cam dɩlʋ na lagɩ dɩ ba amʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn kɛ. Nmʋ nan kɩ te na yi nmʋ wʋbʋŋa tɩn, sɩ n yɩ kɩ amʋ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.»

translation_verse: Zudasɩ ya maŋɩ o pa kɔgɔ kʋm lwarɩ nɩ, o na ve o kukwǝri nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ tɩn, sɩ ba ja kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Hello, teacher.” Then Judas kissed him.
translation_verse: O laan ma yɔɔrɩ o yi Zezi te o jɔɔn-o yɩ o wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩnle», yɩ o daarɩ o kukwǝr-o.

translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na maŋɩ ba wʋ Zezi tee nɩ tɩn dɩdʋa ma lɩ o sʋgʋ o ma zagɩ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm tɩntʋŋnʋ zwɛ o go.

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, “With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?”
translation_verse: Zezi maa cɩm. Kaanɩm yuutu wʋm laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Kwarɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ n ta n brɩ dɩbam, nmʋ yɩ Wɛ Bu Krisi wʋm DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ na?»

english_verse: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, “This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.”
translation_verse: O ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi mancoŋo ni. Tɩntʋŋ-kana kadoŋ dɩ daa ma na-o, yɩ o ta dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋra tɩn o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ tɔgɩ dɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi mʋ.»

english_verse: After Jesus had been arrested, he was led off to the house of Caiaphas the high priest. The nation's leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses were meeting there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tu ba ja Zezi tɩn ma ja-o ba vu ba kaanɩm yuutu Kayifu sɔŋɔ, mɛ Zwifǝ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ dɩ ba nakwa bam na maŋɩ ba kikili da tɩn.

english_verse: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma dalɩ o tɔgɩ ba kwaga, o da o vu o yi kaanɩm yuutu wʋm sɔŋɔ. O ma zʋ o jǝni sɔŋɔ kʋm tɩntʋŋna bam tee nɩ, sɩ o nii kʋlʋ na lagɩ kʋ kɩ Zezi tɩn.

english_verse: The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam maama maa kwaanɩ sɩ ba na nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ́ fɔ vwan ba pa Zezi tɩn, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o.

english_verse: and said, “This man claimed he could tear down God's temple and build it again in three days.”
translation_verse: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ tagɩ o wɩ, wʋm wʋ́ wanɩ o magɩ dɩbam Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm maama o dɩ tɩga nɩ, yɩ o joori o ma da yatɔ o lɔ-ka.»

english_verse: “That is what you say!” Jesus answered. “But I tell all of you, ‘Soon you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God All-Powerful and coming on the clouds of heaven.’ ”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Mʋ ka da n taga. Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ, abam wʋ́ ba á na Nabiin-bu wʋm o na je Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ jazɩm nɩ, yɩ á ta wʋ́ daarɩ á na-o o na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ o maa bɩɩnɩ kunkwǝǝnu wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: While Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, a servant girl came up to him and said, “You were with Jesus from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ maa je kʋnkɔlɔ kʋm wʋnɩ. Kaanɩm yuutu wʋm sɔŋɔ tɩntʋŋ-kana ma vu o te, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ dɩ tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi, Galile tu wʋm mʋ.»

english_verse: But in front of everyone Peter said, “That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about!”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma fʋ ba maama yigǝ nɩ o wɩ: «A yǝri woŋo kʋlʋ nmʋ na tɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, “We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.”
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn tɩn, nɔɔna badonnǝ ma vu ba ta dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ ba wɩ: «Nmʋ sɩɩnɩ n yɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ. Nmʋ ŋwaŋa kam mʋ brɩ nɩ n sɩɩnɩ n nuŋi dáanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: and Peter remembered that Jesus had said, “Before a rooster crows, you will say three times you don't know me.” Then Peter went out and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma guli Zezi ya na tagɩ kʋlʋ dɩd-o o wɩ: «Kʋ na wʋ́ loori sɩ cɩbwɩʋ keeri tɩn, nmʋ wʋ́ fʋ kuni bɩtɔ nɩ n yǝri amʋ.» O na guli kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma nuŋi, yɩ o tiini o keeri zanzan.

english_verse: On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.

english_verse: Jesus was brought before Pilate the governor, who asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words!” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Zezi ma zaŋɩ o zɩgɩ gʋvɩrma tu Pilatɩ yigǝ nɩ. Gʋvɩrma tu wʋm ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ mʋ yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ wʋm na?» Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Mʋ ka da n taga.»

english_verse: Pilate saw that there was nothing he could do and that the people were starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them and said, “I won't have anything to do with killing this man. You are the ones doing it!”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ ma lwarɩ nɩ kʋ ba jɩgɩ kuri sɩ o taa ŋɔɔnɩ taan taan, kʋ na lagɩ kʋ ja bʋbwaka kʋ ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O ma joŋi na o ma san o jɩa nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o wɩ: «A yigǝ tɔgɩ ka tǝri nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ tʋʋnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ. Kʋ yɩ abam yigǝ mʋ.»

english_verse: Everyone answered, “We and our own families will take the blame for his death!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Yagɩ sɩ o tʋʋnɩ dɩm caa taa tɔgɩ dɩbam dɩ dɩ́ biǝ.»

english_verse: They made a crown out of thorn branches and placed it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. The soldiers knelt down and pretended to worship him. They made fun of him and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!”
translation_verse: Ba ma sɔ sabarɩ yipugǝ ba pu o yuu nɩ. Ba ma kwe miu ba ma ji nacǝgǝ ba kɩ o jazɩm nɩ. Ba laan ma yáal-o ba mwana, yɩ ba ve ba kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Zwifǝ bam pɛ, dɩnle.»

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.

english_verse: There they gave Jesus some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain. But when Jesus tasted what it was, he refused to drink it.
translation_verse: Ba na yi da tɩn, ba ma kɩ sana ba gwaanɩ dɩ liri sɩlʋ ni na cana tɩn ba pa Zezi sɩ o nyɔ. O ma laŋɩ o nii, yɩ o wʋ sɛ sɩ o nyɔ.

english_verse: Then they sat down to guard him.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma je da ba yɩr-o.

translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn ma tanɩ tɔnɔ dagara kam yɩra nɩ Zezi yuu baŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ brɩ kʋlʋ o na kɩ o cɔgɩ yɩ ba gʋ-o tɩn. Ba dɛɛn pʋpʋnɩ ba wɩ: «Wʋntʋ yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: Others said, “Wait! Let's see if Elijah will come and save him.”

english_verse: They left their graves, and after Jesus had risen to life, they went into the holy city, where they were seen by many people.
translation_verse: yɩ ba nuŋi ba yibeelǝ wʋnɩ, maŋa kalʋ Zezi tɩtɩ na tu o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn kwaga nɩ. Bantʋ laan ma vu ba zʋ Wɛ tɩtɩ tɩʋ Zeruzalɛm wʋ ba pa nɔɔna zanzan na-ba.

english_verse: The officer and the soldiers guarding Jesus felt the earthquake and saw everything else that happened. They were frightened and said, “This man really was God's Son!”
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu wʋm dɩ o nɔɔna balʋ na wʋra ba yɩrɩ Zezi tɩn ma na tɩga kam sisiŋim dɩm, dɩ kʋlʋ maama na kɩ tɩn. Fʋʋnɩ ma tiini dɩ zʋ-ba, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ ya sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu mʋ.»

english_verse: Many women had come with Jesus from Galilee to be of help to him, and they were there, looking on at a distance.
translation_verse: Kaana zanzan dɩ tɔgɩ ba wʋra, ba ma zɩgɩ yigǝ yigǝ yɩ ba niǝ. Bantʋ dɛɛn ya tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi mʋ ba nuŋi Galile ba ba, yɩ ba yǝni ba tɔgɩ ba zǝn-o.

english_verse: who took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.

english_verse: The followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees often went without eating. Some people came and asked Jesus, “Why do the followers of John and those of the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”

translation_verse: O maa bʋŋɩ o wɩ: «A na maŋɩ a dwe o gɔrɔ kʋm má dɩ, aá na yazurǝ.»

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace! You are healed, and you will no longer be in pain.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A bukɔ, nmʋ na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ te tɩn mʋ pɛ n na yazurǝ. Ve sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wǝli-m, sɩ n sin dɩ n yawɩʋ kʋm.»

english_verse: She had gone to many doctors, and they had not done anything except cause her a lot of pain. She had paid them all the money she had. But instead of getting better, she only got worse.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn tiini o yaarɩ dɔgɩta tiinǝ zanzan tee nɩ. O dɛɛn cɔgɩ o sǝbu maama o yawɩʋ kʋm baŋa nɩ, yɩ kʋ ta ba garɩ kʋ pa-o, kʋ fɔgɩ kʋ jiri lɛɛrʋ mʋ o yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: Then Jesus went inside and said to them, “Why are you crying and carrying on like this? The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: O ma zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm, yɩ o ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ á kɩ sɔɔ yɩ á keerǝ? Bu wʋm wʋ tɩgɩ, o dɔ mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed Lake Galilee and came to shore near the town of Gerasa.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni dɩdoŋ dɩm mɛ Zeraaza tiinǝ na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn.

english_verse: Night and day he was in the graveyard or on the hills, yelling and cutting himself with stones.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ o beeri yibeelǝ je sɩm nɩ dɩ pweeru yuu nɩ mʋ, yɩ o kaasa. O maa yǝni o magɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ kandwa o fwǝlǝ.

english_verse: He shouted, “Jesus, Son of God in heaven, what do you want with me? Promise me in God's name that you won't torture me!”
translation_verse: yɩ o kaasɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Zezi, Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ Bu, n tu amʋ te sɩ n kɩ bɛɛ mʋ? A loori-m dɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ, sɩ n yɩ zaŋɩ n yaarɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: Over on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Tǝrǝ zanzan dɛɛn ma wʋ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ ba beeri piu kʋm tǝŋǝ nɩ ba di.

english_verse: So the evil spirits begged Jesus, “Send us into those pigs! Let us go into them.”
translation_verse: Ciciri sɩm ma loori Zezi sɩ wɩ: «Pa dɩbam cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ zʋ tǝrǝ bam.»

english_verse: The men taking care of the pigs ran to the town and the farms to spread the news. Then the people came out to see what had happened.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ ya na nii tǝrǝ bam baŋa nɩ tɩn ma duri ba vu tɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ dɛ sɩm maama nɩ, ba ta dɩ nɔɔna bam kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn. Nɔɔna bam ma nuŋi ba vu sɩ ba nii kʋ na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had once been full of demons. He was sitting there with his clothes on and in his right mind, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi Zezi te. Ba ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ ciciri kɔgɔ kʋm ya na jɩg-o tɩn. O maa je yɩ o wʋbʋŋa joori ya ba o tɩtɩ yɩ o zʋ gwaarʋ. Ba na nɛ-o kʋntʋ tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ-ba.

english_verse: Everyone who had seen what had happened told about the man and the pigs.
translation_verse: Balʋ yiǝ na nɛ kǝm dɩm tɩn ma ta ba brɩ nɔɔna bam kʋ na kɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm te tɩn, dɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tǝrǝ bam dɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Then the people started begging Jesus to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam laan ma loori Zezi sɩ o nuŋi ba tɩʋ kʋm nɩ o viiri.

translation_verse: O ma wʋ sɛ. O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ve sɔŋɔ, sɩ n ta dɩ n sɔŋɔ tiinǝ n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ na duri nmʋ ŋwaŋa dɩ DƖ na kɩ woŋo kʋlʋ maama DƖ pa-m tɩn.»

translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm laan ma kɛ o vu je sɩlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Tɩɩnɩ Fugǝ tɩn, yɩ o tɛ o brɩ nɔɔna bam Zezi na kɩ kʋlʋ o pa-o tɩn. Balʋ maama na ni o taanɩ dɩm tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba. Zezi na bi Zayirusi bukɔ yɩ o pa kaanɩ wʋdoŋ na yazurǝ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Once again Jesus got into the boat and crossed Lake Galilee. Then as he stood on the shore, a large crowd gathered around him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma joori o da nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ naboro o bɛ bubɛ dɩdoŋ dɩm. O na zɩgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ tɩn, nɔn-kɔgɔ ma ba o te ba gilim-o.

english_verse: The person in charge of the synagogue was also there. His name was Jairus, and when he saw Jesus, he went over to him. He knelt at Jesus' feet
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zayirusi. O yɩ Wɛ-digǝ kam yigǝ tiinǝ wʋ dɩdʋa mʋ. O na nɛ Zezi tɩn, o ma kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ,

english_verse: and started begging him for help. He said, “My little daughter is about to die! Please come and touch her, so she will get well and live.”

english_verse: Jesus went with Jairus. Many people followed along and kept crowding around.
translation_verse: Zezi ma sɛ yɩ o tɔgɩ dɩd-o o ma ve. Kɔ-fɔrɔ dɩ maa tɔg-o, yɩ ba pɩɩn-o zanzan.

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, o na wɔɛ ka-wʋ taan bɩna fugǝ-yale.

english_verse: The woman had heard about Jesus, so she came up behind him in the crowd and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: O laan na ni Zezi ŋwa tɩn, o ma tɔgɩ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ o kɛ o kwaga o vu o dwe o gɔrɔ.

english_verse: As soon as she touched them, her bleeding stopped, and she knew she was healed.
translation_verse: O na dwe-o kʋntʋ tɩn, jana kam ma da ka kɔ. O ma lwarɩ nɩ o yawɩʋ kʋm sɩɩnɩ kʋ je o yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: At that moment Jesus felt power go out from him. He turned to the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
translation_verse: Bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ mʋ Zezi maanɩ nɩ dam nuŋi o yɩra nɩ. O maa zɩgɩ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ o pipiri o nii, yɩ o bwe o wɩ: «Wɔɔ mʋ dwe a gɔrɔ?»

english_verse: His disciples said to him, “Look at all these people crowding around you! How can you ask who touched you?”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ nɛ nɔɔna bam maama na yigi ba pɩɩnɩ nmʋ te tɩn na? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n bwe nɩ, wɔɔ mʋ dwe-m?»

english_verse: But Jesus turned to see who had touched him.
translation_verse: O daa ta maa fɔgɩ o nii kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ sɩ o lwarɩ wʋlʋ na dwe-o tɩn.

english_verse: The woman knew what had happened to her. So she came trembling with fear and knelt down in front of Jesus. Then she told him the whole story.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ laan maa jɩgɩ kaanɩ wʋm yɩ o yɩra saɩ, o na ye kʋlʋ na kɩ-o yɩ o na yazurǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O ma vu Zezi te o kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o ta o cɩga maama dɩd-o.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Zezi ta na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna badonnǝ ma nuŋi Zayirusi sɔŋɔ ba ba, ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «N bukɔ wʋm tɩga. Daa n yɩ ta n jɩgɩ karanyɩna kam n yaara.»

english_verse: Jesus heard what they said, and he said to Jairus, “Don't worry. Just have faith!”
translation_verse: Zezi maa cɩm, yɩ o ta dɩ Zayirusi o wɩ: «Yɩ pa fʋʋnɩ ja-m. Za n weeni n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus did not let anyone go with him except Peter and the two brothers, James and John.
translation_verse: Zezi ma wʋ sɛ sɩ nɔɔna tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba vu Zayirusi sɔŋɔ kʋm, kʋ na daɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zakɩ dɩ o nyaanɩ Zan yɩranɩ.

english_verse: They went home with Jairus and saw the people crying and making a lot of noise.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi sɔŋɔ kʋm. Zezi ma ni nɩ sɔɔ yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra bɔgɩ bɔgɩ, yɩ nɔɔna keerǝ yɩ ba coosǝ.

english_verse: He took the twelve-year-old girl by the hand and said, “Talitha, koum!” which means, “Little girl, get up!” The girl got right up and started walking around. Everyone was greatly surprised.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, bɩsankana kam ma da ka zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ ka veǝ. O bɩna dɛɛn yɩ fugǝ-yale mʋ. Ba na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened. Then he said, “Give her something to eat.”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma kaanɩ-ba o wɩ, ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn. O ma daarɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ, ba kɩ wʋdiu ba pa bu wʋm sɩ o di.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and brought the boat to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba bɛ ba yi bubɛ dɩdɩm dɩm. Ba ma ja naboro kʋm ba ja nuŋi ba zɩgɩ da. Ba na yi je sɩlʋ tɩn yɩrɩ mʋ Zenezarɛtɩ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their relatives and their own family.”
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ na yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu, nɔɔna yǝni ba pa-o zulǝ lanyɩranɩ, kʋ daarɩ o tɩtɩ tɩʋ tiinǝ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ dɩ o cʋrrʋ nan bá nɩg-o.»

english_verse: After the apostles returned to Jesus, they told him everything they had done and taught.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam ma joori ba ba o te. Ba ma ta ba brɩ-o kʋlʋ maama ba na kɩa, dɩ ba na brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn.

translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ na yi tɩn, o ma vu o zʋ ba Wɛ-digǝ kam yɩ o puli sɩ o brɩ-ba Wɛ taanɩ. Nɔɔna zanzan maa wʋra yɩ ba cǝgi o zaasɩm dɩm. Ba na ni tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba lanyɩranɩ. english_verse: Isn't he the carpenter, the son of Mary? Aren't James, Joseph, Judas, and Simon his brothers? Don't his sisters still live here in our town?” The people were upset because of what he was doing.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ wʋm mʋ yɩ da-lwarʋ wʋm na? Wʋm mʋ daɩ Mari bu wʋm na? Kʋ daɩ wʋm nyaana mʋ yɩ Zakɩ dɩ Zʋzɛfʋ dɩ Zudasɩ dɩ Simɔn na? Kʋ daɩ wʋm nakwa mʋ wʋ dɩbam tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn na?» Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba dɛɛn wʋ sɛ nɩ Zezi sɩɩnɩ o nuŋi Wɛ te.

translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Erɔdɩadɩ culi Zan. O maa lagɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o, yɩ o wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ,

translation_verse: Bukɔ wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma nuŋi o vu o nu te o bwe-o o wɩ: «Bɛɛ woŋo mʋ amʋ wʋ́ loori?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «Ve n ta nɩ n lagɩ sɩ o go Zan yuu mʋ o pa-m.»

english_verse: The girl hurried back and told Herod, “Here and now on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Bukɔ wʋm ma kɩ lɩla o joori o zʋ pɛ wʋm te, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A lagɩ sɩ n go Zan yuu mʋ n kɩ zʋŋ-tanlaŋa wʋnɩ n pa-nɩ lele.»

english_verse: Herod was very sorry for what he had said. But he did not want to break the promise he had made in front of his guests.
translation_verse: Pɛ Erɔdɩ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o wʋ ma tiini kʋ cɔgɩ zanzan. O nan na tagɩ o du vǝrǝ bam yigǝ nɩ tɩn, o maa ba lagɩ sɩ o vɩn.

english_verse: The guard put the head on a serving plate and took it to the girl. Then she gave it to her mother.
translation_verse: O ma kwe-kʋ o kɩ zʋŋ-tanlaŋa wʋnɩ o ja ba o pa bukɔ wʋm. O ma joŋi o ja vu o pa o nu.

translation_verse: Zan karabiǝ bam na lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn, ba ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba kwe o yɩra yam ba ja vu ba kɩ. Zezi na pɛ kɔ-fɔrɔ di wʋdiu ba su te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “How much bread do you have? Go and see!” They found out and answered, “We have five small loaves of bread and two fish.”
translation_verse: O laan ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Abam jɩgɩ dɩpwa yagra mʋ? Ve-na á nii.» Ba na ve ba nii tɩn, ba ma joori ba ba, ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Ya yɩ dɩpwa yanu dɩ kale sɩle yɩranɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to tell the people to sit down on the green grass.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma pa o karabiǝ bam ni, sɩ ba pa nɔɔna bam pɔɔrɩ kɔgɔ kɔgɔ ba jǝni tɩga nɩ ga-lɩʋ kʋm baŋa nɩ.

translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ ba maama nɛ-o yɩ fʋʋnɩ zʋ-ba zanzan. Zezi laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba o wɩ: «Pa-na á wʋrʋ kɩ dam, sɩ kʋ yɩ amʋ mʋ. Á yɩ pa fʋʋnɩ taa jɩgɩ abam.»

english_verse: Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples to give to the people. He also divided the two fish, so everyone could have some.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma kwe dɩpwa yanu yam dɩ kale sɩle sɩm, yɩ o kwǝni o yuu wɛɛnɩ o kɩ Wɛ le tɩ ŋwaanɩ. O ma fɔ fɔ dɩpwa yam o maŋɩ o pa o karabiǝ bam, sɩ ba laan joŋi-ya ba ja vu ba maŋɩ ba pa nɔɔna bam. O ma daarɩ o maŋɩ kale sɩle sɩm dɩ o pa ba maama sɩ ba di.

english_verse: After everyone had eaten all they wanted,
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama ma di ba su ba daarɩ.

translation_verse: O na pɛ ba viiri tɩn, o ma vu o di piu yuu sɩ o warɩ Wɛ.

translation_verse: Tɩga ma ba ka yi. Naboro kʋm maa wʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm tɩtarɩ nɩ, yɩ Zezi ta wʋ buburu kʋm nɩ o yɩranɩ.

english_verse: He could see that the disciples were struggling hard, because they were rowing against the wind. Not long before morning, Jesus came toward them. He was walking on the water and was about to pass the boat.
