translation_verse: Zezi nan maŋɩ o ye ba na yɩ pipiri-nyɩna te tɩn. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ á lagɩ sɩ á maŋɩ-nɩ á nii? Ja-na sǝbu-dalɩ dɩdʋa á ba sɩ a nii.»

english_verse: You surely know about people being raised to life. You know that in the story about Moses and the burning bush, God said, “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ twa biim dɩm dɩ, Moyisi na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn brɩ nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ ba bi. Abam maŋɩ á wʋ karɩmɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ na tagɩ dɩ Moyisi DƖ na brɩ DƖ tɩtɩ dɩd-o sabarɩ puŋu kʋm wʋnɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn na? Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ DƖ wɩ: ‹Amʋ yɩ Abraham Wɛ, dɩ Yizakɩ Wɛ, dɩ Zakɔbɩ Wɛ mʋ.›

english_verse: The Pharisees got together with Herod's followers. Then they sent some men to trick Jesus into saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam dɛɛn ma lɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɩ Pɛ Erɔdɩ kwaga nɔɔna badonnǝ sɩ ba vu Zezi te. Ba maa lagɩ sɩ ba pa o ŋɔɔnɩ o tusi, sɩ ba wanɩ ba ja-o.

english_verse: They went to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are. And you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. Tell us, should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Ba ma yi o te, yɩ ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩ́ ye nɩ nmʋ yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. Nmʋ yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ nɔɔna na bʋŋɩ kʋlʋ ba pa nmʋ tɩn, nmʋ nan ba kuri nɔɔna daanɩ. Nmʋ nan yǝni n brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cwǝŋǝ dɩ cɩga mʋ. Dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ bwe dɩ́ nii, dɩbam Zwifǝ bam culu pɛ ni sɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ lampoo dɩ́ pa lʋgʋ kʋm pa-farʋ wʋm naa kʋ wʋ maŋɩ? Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ naa dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ?»

english_verse: They brought him a silver coin, and he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: Ba ma lɩ sǝbu-dalɩ dɩm ba brɩ-o. O ma nii yɩ o bwe-ba o wɩ: «Wɔɔ nyɩnyʋgʋ dɩ o yɩrɩ mʋ pʋpʋnɩ dɩ baŋa nɩ?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ.»

english_verse: Then Jesus told them, “Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.” The men were amazed at Jesus. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ lamma. Á nan taá ŋwɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ pa-farʋ wʋm nyɩm tɩn á pa-o, sɩ á daarɩ á taá paɩ Wɛ kʋlʋ dɩ na yɩ DƖ nyɩm tɩn.» O na lǝri-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba zanzan. Ba na bwe Zezi twa biim woŋo te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and pray long prayers just to show off. They will be punished most of all. A Widow's Offering (Luke
translation_verse: Ba maa yǝni ba ganɩ kadǝnǝ ba joŋi kʋlʋ maama ba na jɩgɩ tɩn, yɩ ba kwǝri ba loori Wɛ dɩ bɩtar-dɩdwaarʋ, sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ nɩ ba yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna mʋ te. Wɛ wʋ́ tiini DƖ pa bantʋ na cam kʋ ja gaalɩ.» Kadǝm na pɛ Wɛ pɛɛrɩ te tɩn (Luki

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Sadusɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba vu Zezi te. Bantʋ mʋ brɩ ba wɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɩga, o daa bá joori o bi.

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam tiini á tusi mʋ. Abam wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm zaasɩm dɩm kuri, yɩ á ta yǝri Wɛ dam dɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Á wʋ tusi cɩga na?

english_verse: When Jesus saw that the man had given a sensible answer, he told him, “You are not far from God's kingdom.” After this, no one dared ask Jesus any more questions. About David's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi na nɛ nɩ o lǝri taanɩ dɩm lanyɩranɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna tɩn, o ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ batwarɩ dɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm.» Kʋ na zɩgɩ maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa maa kwarɩ sɩ o bwe-o taanɩ. Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn yɩ Davidi Yuutu mʋ (Matiyu

english_verse: One of the teachers of the Law of Moses came up while Jesus and the Sadducees were arguing. When he heard Jesus give a good answer, he asked him, “What is the most important commandment?”
translation_verse: Ba na wʋra ba ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tu wʋdoŋ ma yi ba te, yɩ o ni ba taanɩ dɩm. O ma lwarɩ nɩ Zezi tiini o kwaanɩ dɩ o na lǝri Sadusɩan tiinǝ bam te tɩn. O laan ma twɛ Zezi te, yɩ o bwe o wɩ: «Wɛ niǝ yam maama wʋnɩ dɔɔ mʋ yɩ kamunu dɩ dwe?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The most important one says: ‘People of Israel, you have only one Lord and God.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Wɛ ni dɩlʋ na yɩ kamunu dɩ dwe ya maama tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: ‹Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ-ba, cǝgi-na. Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Yuutu dɩdʋa má.

english_verse: You must love him with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength.’
translation_verse: Ta n soe n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ n bɩcarɩ maama, dɩ n wʋ maama, dɩ n wʋbʋŋa maama, dɩ n dam maama.›

english_verse: The second most important commandment says: ‘Love others as much as you love yourself.’ No other commandment is more important than these.”
translation_verse: Wɛ ni dɩlʋ na saŋɩ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: ‹Ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te.› Wɛ ni dɩdoŋ daa tǝrǝ dɩ na yɩ kamunu dɩ dwe niǝ yantʋ yale.»

english_verse: Jesus was sitting in the temple near the offering box and watching people put in their gifts. He noticed that many rich people were giving a lot of money.
translation_verse: Zezi ma vu o jǝni Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ, jǝgǝ kalʋ daka na zɩgɩ da yɩ nɔɔna dɩ Wɛ pɛɛra ka wʋnɩ tɩn tɩkǝri nɩ. O maa je o nii nɔɔna bam na ve ba dɩ ba sǝbiǝ ka wʋnɩ te tɩn. Nadunǝ zanzan ma ba ba dɩ sǝbu zanzan ka wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had. Now she doesn't have a cent to live on.
translation_verse: Bantʋ maama lɩ ba daarɩ sǝbiǝ mʋ tata. Kadǝm wʋm nan yɩ yinigǝ tu mʋ, yɩ o kwe woŋo kʋlʋ maama o na jɩgɩ sɩ o ma yǝgi o ni-wʋdiu tɩn o dɩ da.»

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, “How can the teachers of the Law of Moses say the Messiah will come from the family of King David?
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn maa wʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm nɩ o brɩ nɔɔna, yɩ o ta o wɩ: «Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam yǝni ba brɩ nɩ, Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn yɩ Pɛ Davidi dwi tu mʋ. Kʋ nan wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ taa yɩ kʋntʋ na?

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be his son?” The large crowd enjoyed listening to Jesus teach. Jesus Condemns the Pharisees and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Davidi tɩtɩ nan na sɩɩnɩ o bǝŋi Krisi wʋm o wɩ o Yuutu tɩn, dɩbam nan daa wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ dɩ́ bǝŋ-o nɩ Davidi naa daga?» Zezi na brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na je kʋ cǝgi tɩn wʋ poli zanzan. Zezi kaanɩ nɔɔna, sɩ ba yɩ lwǝni cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam (Matiyu

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching, he said: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes and be greeted in the market.
translation_verse: O daa ta ma brɩ-ba yɩ o wɩ: «Taá yɩrɩ-na á tɩtɩ dɩ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam. Bantʋ soe sɩ ba taa zʋʋrɩ gwar-dɩdwaarʋ, sɩ ba taa beerǝ yɩ nɔɔna nii-ba. Ba na ve yaga, ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama taa tui ba zuli-ba mʋ.

english_verse: Finally, a poor widow came up and put in two coins worth only a few pennies.
translation_verse: Kadǝm wʋdoŋ na yɩ yinigǝ tu tɩn ma ja sǝbu-dal-balwa bale, o ja vu o dɩ da.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples to gather around him. Then he said: I tell you that this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
translation_verse: Zezi na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma bǝŋi o karabiǝ bam, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, kadǝm wʋntʋ na yɩ yinigǝ tu tɩn, o dɩ sǝbu kʋ dwǝni nɔɔna balʋ maama na dɩ da tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these huge buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ nɛ ka na daga te tɩn na? Ka maama nan wʋ́ ba ka tʋ tɩga nɩ ka cɔgɩ. Kandwɛ daa bá daŋɩ dɩ doŋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: Watch out and don't let anyone fool you!
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yɩ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ganɩ abam.

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will use my name and fool many people.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna zanzan wʋ́ ba abam te, yɩ baá ma amʋ yɩrɩ ba ma ganɩ abam ba wɩ, bantʋ dɩdʋa dɩdʋa mʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn, yɩ baá ganɩ nɔɔna zanzan.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him in private.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma vu o jǝni Olivi piu kʋm yuu nɩ, yɩ o tʋlɩ o na Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm o yigǝ nɩ. O na je kʋntʋ tɩn, Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zakɩ dɩ Zan dɩ Andre yɩranɩ ma vu o te, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ:

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” where it should not be. Everyone who reads this must try to understand! If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.
translation_verse: Abam nan wʋ́ ba á na wo-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na yɩ cɔgɩnʋ tɩn na wʋ́ ba kʋ zɩgɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ na wʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa zɩgɩ da tɩn.» «Abam na nɛ wo-lɔŋɔ kʋm kʋntʋ, sɩ abam balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Zude nɩ tɩn kɩ lɩla á nuŋi á duri á vu pweeru yum á sǝgi da.

english_verse: They asked, “When will these things happen? What will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
translation_verse: «Maŋa kɔɔ mʋ Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋ́ ba ka cɔgɩ kʋntʋ? Bɛɛ mʋ lagɩ kʋ kɩ maana kʋ brɩ dɩbam, sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama lagɩ tɩ kɩ?»

english_verse: Be on your guard! You will be taken to courts and beaten with whips in their synagogues. And because of me, you will have to stand before rulers and kings to tell about your faith.
translation_verse: Á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa tee nɩ. Ba ta wʋ́ ja abam ba magɩ ba Wɛ-di sɩm wʋnɩ. Baá ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ dɩdɛɛra dɩ pwa tee nɩ, abam na tɔgɩ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa á wanɩ á brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kam.

english_verse: But before the end comes, the good news must be preached to all nations.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan fɩn mʋ sɩ ba da yigǝ ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ba brɩ dwi maama tiinǝ, sɩ woŋo maama tiim laan yi.

english_verse: When you are arrested, don't worry about what you will say. You will be given the right words when the time comes. But you will not really be the ones speaking. Your words will come from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba na jaanɩ abam ba vu ba saŋɩ, sɩ á yɩ taá liǝ dɩ á na wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ tɩn. Á na wʋ́ taá zɩgɩ ba yigǝ nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, sɩ á laan ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ pa abam tɩn. Kʋ daɩ abam tɩtɩ mʋ wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ á na wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray each other and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ wʋ́ ja ba tɩtɩ cʋrrʋ ba kɩ nɔɔna jɩa nɩ sɩ ba gʋ-ba. Kwǝ dɩ wʋ́ kɩ ba biǝ kʋntʋ doŋ. Biǝ dɩ wʋ́ zaŋɩ ba pa ba ja ba niinǝ dɩ ba kwǝ ba gʋ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you keep on being faithful right to the end, you will be saved. The Horrible Thing (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ta culi abam, á na yɩ a nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋlʋ maama nan na kɩ pu-dɩa o zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi kweelim tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ kʋntʋ tu ŋwɩa.

english_verse: If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na wʋ nayuu nɩ, o daa yɩ tu o zʋ digǝ sɩ o kwe kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: If the Lord doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of his chosen and special ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ nan na wʋ pɛ yaara yam da yam tri, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wǝri. Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ nɔɔna balʋ DƖ na kuri tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, DƖ wʋ́ pa yaara yam da yam tri.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na wʋ kara nɩ tɩn, o daa yɩ joori sɔŋɔ sɩ o kwe o gɔrɔ o zʋ.

english_verse: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ kʋʋ́ ta tiini kʋ yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ kaana balʋ na jɩgɩ pwi tɩn, dɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ biǝ yɩ ba ŋɔgɩ yɩlɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Pray that it won't happen in winter.
translation_verse: Nan taá loori-na Wɛ, sɩ cam dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ ba waarʋ mɩmaŋa nɩ.

english_verse: But be on your guard! That's why I am telling you these things now. When the Son of Man Appears (Matthew
translation_verse: Á taá cʋ á tɩtɩ, sɩ a wuuri a ta a brɩ abam mʋ yɩ wǝǝnu tɩm maŋa daa ta wʋ yi.» Nabiin-bu wʋm na wʋ́ ba lʋgʋ baŋa te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ á na tu á na wǝǝnu tɩlʋ a na tagɩ a brɩ abam tɩn na wʋra tɩ kɩa, sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ maŋa kam laan twɛ ka ti.

english_verse: The sky and the earth will not last forever, but my words will. No One Knows the Day or Time (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa maama wʋ́ ba tɩ kɛ, yɩ amʋ taanɩ dɩm bá kɛ maŋa dɩ maŋa.

english_verse: The stars will fall, and the powers in the sky will be shaken.”
translation_verse: Wɛyuu wʋ́ sisiŋi yɩ calɩcwɩ sɩm kwǝri sɩ tʋ tɩga nɩ, yɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ tɩn wʋ́ vugimi daanɩ.›

english_verse: Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near.
translation_verse: Nan maanɩ-na á nii kapʋrʋ na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ na yǝni kʋ wʋra kʋ kwi vɔɔrʋ, á yǝni á lwarɩ nɩ kʋ twɛ yadɛ.

english_verse: Then the Son of Man will be seen coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ na Nabiin-bu wʋm na maa bɩɩnɩ lʋgʋ baŋa. Oó ta wʋ kunkwǝǝnu wʋnɩ o bɩɩnɩ dɩ dam, yɩ Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ wʋ o tee nɩ zanzan.

english_verse: He will send his angels to gather his chosen ones from all over the earth. A Lesson from a Fig Tree (Matthew
translation_verse: O laan wʋ́ pa o malɛsɩ sɩm nuŋi sɩ jagɩ sɩ vu lʋgʋ baŋa je maama, kʋ na yɩ wa-puli dɩ wa-zʋʋrɩ, jazɩm dɩ jagwiǝ, sɩ la o nɔɔna balʋ Wɛ na kuri tɩn je maama sɩ kɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: So be alert! You don't know when the master of the house will come back. It could be in the evening or at midnight or before dawn or in the morning.
translation_verse: Abam dɩ maŋɩ sɩ á fɔgɩ á taá yɩrɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ á yǝri maŋa kalʋ sɔŋɔ tu wʋm na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn. O waɩ o tui dɩdaan-ni nɩ naa tɩtɩɩ kʋnkʋrʋ nɩ, naa tɩ-bra-pʋra nɩ naa wa-puli maŋa nɩ.

english_verse: So watch out and be ready! You don't know when the time will come.
translation_verse: Á taá fɔgɩ á cʋ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yǝri maŋa kam o na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama wʋ́ ba tɩ wʋra tɩ kɩa, yɩ zɩm nɔɔna bam ta wʋ tɩgɩ ba ti.

english_verse: But if he comes suddenly, don't let him find you asleep.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, o na tu bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ, sɩ o yɩ darɩ abam dɩ á tigi á dɔa.

english_verse: It is like what happens when a man goes away for a while and places his servants in charge of everything. He tells each of them what to do, and he orders the guard to keep alert.
translation_verse: Kʋʋ́ ta nyɩ dɩ sɔŋɔ tu na nuŋi sɩ o beeri o vu yigǝ yigǝ te tɩn. O ma pa o tɩntʋŋna bam ni sɩ ba taa nii o sɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ. O ma pa ba nɔɔnʋ maama o tɩtʋŋɩ. O ma ta dɩ ba dɩdʋa, sɩ o taa yɩrɩ o mancoŋo kʋm lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: I tell everyone just what I have told you. Be alert!
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta dɩ abam dɩ nɔɔna bam maama nɩ, á maŋɩ sɩ á taá cʋ á tɩtɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: They were saying, “We must not do it during the festival, because the people will riot.” At Bethany (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ ja-o candiǝ kam maŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋʋ́ pa vuvugǝ jǝni nɔɔna bam tɩtarɩ nɩ.» Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ na zuli Zezi te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, “Teacher!” Then Judas kissed him,

translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam laan ma ja Zezi ba vu ba zʋ gʋvɩrma tu Pilatɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm kʋnkɔlɔ. Ba ma pa pamaŋna bam kɔgɔ kʋm maama gilimi da,

english_verse: And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot.
translation_verse: Pɩɩnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn maa wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Barabasɩ. Ba dɛɛn ya pɩ-o dɩ balʋ na wǝli daanɩ ba kɩ jara dɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ yɩ ba gʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma ba ba la kɔgɔ, yɩ ba ta dɩ Pilatɩ sɩ o lɩ pɩɩnʋ dɩdʋa o pa-ba, nɩ o na yǝni o kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Pilate asked them, “Do you want me to free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Á lagɩ sɩ a lɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ wʋm mʋ a pa abam na?»

english_verse: Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn bwe-ba kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o ye nɩ kʋ yɩ wʋ-gʋrʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam ya jaanɩ Zezi ba kɩ o jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Then Pilate asked the crowd, “What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ laan ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Sɩ wʋlʋ á na bǝ-o nɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ tɩn, abam lagɩ sɩ a kɩ-o ta mʋ?»

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ba na yaalɩ yaal-o ba ti tɩn, ba ma lɩ gwar-sʋŋʋ kʋm, yɩ ba joori ba zʋ-o o tɩtɩ gɔrɔ kʋm. Ba laan ma ja-o ba nuŋi ba vu sɩ ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ.

english_verse: Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba na maa kɛ tɩn, ba ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn. O nuŋi Sirɛɛnɩ mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Alɛsandrɩ dɩ Rufusi ko. O dɛɛn ya nuŋi kara mʋ o ba o yi tɩʋ wʋ o maa kɛa. Pamaŋna bam na nɛ-o tɩn, ba ma fɩ-o sɩ o kwe tʋʋn-dagara kam o zɩŋɩ sɩ ba vu.

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, “He saved others, but he can't save himself.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam dɩ maa twɩ-o ba brɩ daanɩ ba mwana. Ba maa tɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «O yǝni o vrɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ ŋwɩa, yɩ o laan warɩ o tɩtɩ ŋwɩa o vrɩ.

english_verse: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ na lwarɩ nɩ Zezi maŋɩ o tɩ tɩn, mʋ kʋ sʋ-o lanyɩranɩ. O ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu ba bǝŋi pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu wʋm sɩ o ba. O na tu tɩn, o ma bwe-o sɩ o nii, Zezi sɩɩnɩ o tɩ mʋ na.

english_verse: The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.”
translation_verse: Ba ma ja Zezi ba vu ba yi jǝgǝ kalʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Goligota tɩn. Yɩrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ kuri mʋ Yukol-pʋa piu.

english_verse: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, “Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ da ba kɛ tɩn maa niǝ, yɩ ba gɔgɩsɩ ba yuni ba twɩ-o. Ba ma yáal-o yɩ ba wɩ: «Nii. Nmʋ ya na bʋŋɩ sɩ n cɩcʋgɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm mʋ n dɩ tɩga nɩ, sɩ n daarɩ n ma da yatɔ n joori n fɔgɩ n lɔ-ka tɩn,

english_verse: If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe.” The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus. The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: O brɩ o tɩtɩ nɩ o yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn, dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ pɛ. O nan tu dagara kam yuu nɩ lele sɩ dɩ́ nii. Dɩ́ na nɛ kʋntʋ, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ sɛ-o.» Nɔɔna balʋ ba na pagɩ dagarɩ sɩm baŋa nɩ ba wǝli da tɩn dɩ maa jɩg-o ba twɩa.

english_verse: After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.
translation_verse: O na lwarɩ nɩ o tɩgɩ tɩn, o ma sɛ sɩ Zʋzɛfʋ vu o kwe o yɩra yam o kɩ.

english_verse: Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ luu batɔ te tɩn, Zezi laan ma kaasɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Eli, Eli, lɛma sabakɩtani?» Taanɩ dɩntʋ kuri mʋ: «Amʋ Wɛ, amʋ Wɛ, bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ n yagɩ amʋ?»

english_verse: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na zɩgɩ da yɩ ba ni taanɩ dɩm tɩn badaara maa wɩ: «Cǝgi-na. O lagɩ o bǝŋi Eli mʋ sɩ o ba.»

english_verse: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!”
translation_verse: Ba dɩdʋa laan ma duri o vu o kwe sɩpɔɔ o dɩ sa-nywana wʋnɩ, o kɩ-kʋ miu ni nɩ o vu o te o pa Zezi sɩ o nyɔ. O daarɩ o wɩ: «Yagɩ sɩ dɩ́ cǝgi dɩ́ nii, Eli wʋ́ ba o pa o tu dagara kam yuu nɩ na?»

english_verse: Some women were looking on from a distance. They and many others had come with Jesus to Jerusalem. But even before this they had been his followers and had helped him while he was in Galilee. Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of the younger James and of Joseph were two of these women. Salome was also one of them. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Kaana bantʋ dɛɛn ya tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Galile nɩ mʋ, yɩ ba yǝni ba tʋŋɩ ba zǝn-o. Kaana badaara zanzan dɩ maa wʋra, ba ya na tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba ba Zeruzalɛm. Ba na kɩ Zezi bɔɔnɩ wʋnɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ ma nuŋi o vu o yǝgi gar-jalɩ dɩlʋ na lana tɩn. O ma vu o parɩ Zezi yɩra yam dagara kam yuu nɩ. O ma kwe gɔrɔ kʋm o ma pipir-o, yɩ o daarɩ o ja vu o tiŋi piu bɔɔnɩ wʋnɩ. Dɩntʋ yɩ yibeeli dɩlʋ ba dɛɛn na lugi-dɩ piu yɩra nɩ tɩn mʋ. O laan ma bibili kandwɛ-pulɔgɔ o ma pɩ bɔɔnɩ dɩm ni.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_verse: Mari wʋlʋ na nuŋi Magɩdala dɩ Mari wʋlʋ na yɩ Zʋzɛsɩ nu tɩn maa zɩgɩ ba nii o na tiŋi Zezi yɩra yam mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.
translation_verse: Kʋ kwaga seeni, Zezi ma lǝni o yibiyǝ yɩ o brɩ o tɩtɩ o karabiǝ bale. Ba ya nuŋi Zeruzalɛm mʋ ba maa ve tɩ-balaŋa kadoŋ.

english_verse: Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩlʋ na saŋɩ siun dɛ dɩm tɩn, ba maa zaŋɩ ba go tɩga dɩ wɛ wʋra dɩ pulǝ, ba vu yibeeli dɩm jǝgǝ kam.

english_verse: On their way, they were asking one another, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us?”
translation_verse: Ba na maa ve tɩn, ba ma bwɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «Wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ bibili kandwɛ dɩlʋ na pɩ yibeeli dɩm ni tɩn o yagɩ daa nɩ o pa dɩbam?»

english_verse: But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!
translation_verse: Kandwɛ dɩm na yɩ kamunu tɩn mʋ te ba ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ. Ba na yi jǝgǝ kam tɩn, ba ma fɔgɩ ba nii ba na dɩdaanɩ kandwɛ dɩm bibili dɩ tigi daa nɩ.

english_verse: The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zʋ bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋ. Ba na zʋ tɩn, ba ma na nɔn-dʋŋʋ, kʋ na je ba jazɩm seeni. O zʋ gwar-poŋo dɩdɔrɔ mʋ. Ba na nɛ-o tɩn, kʋ ma pa ba yɩra sɔɔrɩ.

english_verse: Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.”
translation_verse: Nan ve-na á ta dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam maama nɩ, o lagɩ o da yigǝ o vu o taa cǝgi abam Galile nɩ. Dáanɩ mʋ abam wʋ́ vu á na-o. Kʋʋ́ kɩ nɩ o na maŋɩ o ta kʋlʋ o brɩ abam tɩn.»

english_verse: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Ba na jaanɩ bɩsankwɩ dɩ ba jɩa, sɩ bá kɩ-ba kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Ba na nyɔgɩ coŋo, kʋ bá kɩ-ba kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Ba na daŋɩ ba jɩa yawɩɩna baŋa nɩ, baá na yazurǝ.»

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ-o tɩn, ba ma joori ba vu Zeruzalɛm ba ta ba brɩ ba donnǝ karabiǝ bam. Ba maa daa ta wʋ sɛ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga.

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na ŋɔɔnɩ o brɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ laan ma pa o zaŋɩ o di DƖ sɔŋɔ. O ma vu o jǝni Baŋa-Wɛ jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, Zezi laan ma ba o brɩ o tɩtɩ o karabiǝ fugǝ-dɩdʋa kam, ba na wʋra ba di wʋdiu maŋa kalʋ tɩn. O ma kaanɩ-ba dɩ ba wʋbʋŋa na muri yɩ ba wʋ sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ ba vɩn sɩ ba sɛ balʋ na tagɩ ba brɩ-ba nɩ wʋntʋ joori o bi yɩ ba na-o tɩn.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ-na á vu lʋgʋ baŋa je maama, sɩ á tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam á brɩ nabiinǝ maama.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Balʋ na sɛ amʋ tɩn wʋ́ wanɩ ba taa kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na brɩ Wɛ dam tɩn. Baá da amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ ba zǝli ciciri nɔɔna yɩra nɩ. Baá ta ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ.

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, aá wanɩ a pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ na kɩ te tɩn, sɩ n wanɩ n lwarɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na tagɩ ba brɩ nmʋ tɩn sɩɩnɩ tɩ yɩ cɩga. Zakari bu Zan lʋra kam taanɩ

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Erɔdɩ dɛɛn na yɩ Zude pɛ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zakari. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tu. O nuŋi Abɩa dwi tiinǝ wʋnɩ mʋ. O kaanɩ yɩrɩ mʋ Elizabɛtɩ. Wʋntʋ dɩ dɛɛn nuŋi kaanɩm tu Aarɔn dwi dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Bantʋ maama kɩ lanyɩranɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, yɩ ba sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam dɩ DƖ cullu tɩm maama.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Elizabɛtɩ dɛɛn yɩ ka-dʋgʋ mʋ yɩ o ba jɩgɩ bu. Ba maama dɛɛn kwɩn mʋ.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Maŋa ma ba yi sɩ Abɩa dwi tiinǝ bam zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm ba taa tʋŋɩ ba pa Wɛ. Zakari maa tɔgɩ o wʋra o tʋŋa.

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ bam yǝni ba ta jɔrɔ mʋ sɩ ba nii, ba wʋnɩ wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ zʋ Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋnɩ o zwɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ lwǝm na ywǝmmǝ tɩn o pa Wɛ. Ba ma ta jɔrɔ yɩ Zakari di.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka laan ma da ka ba o te, ka zɩgɩ wǝǝnu zwɛɛm bimbim dɩm jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Zakari na nɛ-ka tɩn, o maa yɩ yǝǝu yɩ fʋʋnɩ zʋ-o lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam ma ta dɩd-o ka wɩ: «Zakari, yɩ ta n kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ Wɛ ni nmʋ na loori-DƖ kʋlʋ tɩn. Nmʋ kaanɩ wʋm laan wʋ́ ja pugǝ o lʋ bu o pa-m, sɩ n pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zan.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: O lʋra kam wʋ́ pa n na wʋpolo zanzan. Nɔɔna zanzan dɩ wʋ́ tiini ba taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ o lʋra kam.

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: Oó ta yɩ nɔn-kamunu Baŋa-Wɛ tee nɩ. O nan yɩ zaŋɩ o nyɔ sana naa woŋo kʋlʋ na kɩkarɩ yiǝ tɩn. Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ́ ta wʋ o tee nɩ maŋa maama, kʋ na wʋ́ sɩŋɩ o lʋra kam maŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: O nan wʋ́ pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ zanzan wʋbʋŋa joori ya taa tɔgɩ ba Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: Oó tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yigǝ, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam wʋ́ ta wʋ o tee nɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Eli dɛɛn na yɩ te tɩn. Oó pa kwǝ joori ba taa soe ba biǝ, yɩ o kwǝri o pa vɩnvɩɩna joori ba taa jɩgɩ nɔn-ŋʋna wʋbʋŋa, sɩ o fɔgɩ o kwɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɔɔna bam yigǝ o pa-o.»

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam ma lǝr-o ka wɩ: «Amʋ nan yɩ Gabrɩyɛlɩ mʋ, wʋlʋ na zɩgɩ Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn. DƖ tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a ba a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nmʋ, sɩ a ta ta-ŋʋm dɩm a brɩ-m.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan na wʋ sɛ a taanɩ dɩm tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa n ni mǝǝri. Maŋa kam na yiǝ, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ a na tagɩ a brɩ-m tɩn wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ tɩ kɩ. Nan ta n ye sɩ nmʋ bá wanɩ n ŋɔɔnɩ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam wǝǝnu tɩm na wʋ́ kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maama na wʋra kʋ kɩ tɩn, nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maa zɩgɩ ba cǝgi Zakari sɩ o nuŋi Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋnɩ. Ba ma cǝg-o taan ba ga. Kʋ ma kɩ-ba yǝǝu dɩ o na daanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: O laan ma ba nuŋi, yɩ o warɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba. O ni na mǝǝri tɩn, o maa maɩ o jɩa o maŋɩ o brɩ-ba. Ba ma maanɩ sɩ o nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ mʋ Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Da yalʋ o na maŋɩ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn ma ba ya ti. O ma joori o vu sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Da yantʋ na kɛ tɩn, o kaanɩ wʋm laan ma ja pugǝ. O maa wʋ sɔŋɔ nɩ taan, canɩ sɩnu.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Ka ma zʋ o te ka jɔɔn-o yɩ ka wɩ: «Kɩ wʋpolo, n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ sɩ DƖ zǝni-m lanyɩranɩ.»

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Mari na ni ka na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, o bɩcarɩ ma di. O ma bʋŋɩ o wɩ: «Taanɩ dɩntʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ?»

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Malɛka kam laan ma ta ka wɩ: «Mari, yɩ ta n kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ Baŋa-Wɛ kɩ nmʋ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋ́ ba n ja pugǝ n lʋ bǝkǝrǝ, sɩ n pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zezi.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ nɔn-kamunu. Baá ta bǝ-o ba wɩ, Baŋa-Wɛ Bu. Dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ wʋ́ pa o di paarɩ nɩ o ko-nakwɩ Davidi dɛɛn na di paarɩ faŋa faŋa te tɩn.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: O ma wʋ́ ta yɩ Zakɔbɩ dwi tiinǝ bam pɛ maŋa maama. O paarɩ dɩm daa bá ti maŋa dɩ maŋa.»

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Mari ma lǝri malɛka kam o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ wʋ́ kɩ tɩta mʋ kʋ kɩ, yɩ a ta wʋ zʋ barʋ?»

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam ma lǝri ka wɩ: «Kʋ na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn, Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ́ ba nmʋ te, yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ tɩtɩ dam-fɔrɔ kʋm wʋ́ ba kʋ kwǝli nmʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ bu wʋlʋ n na wʋ́ lʋ tɩn wʋ́ ta yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ nyɩm, yɩ ba taa bǝ-o nɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Maanɩ n nii nmʋ cʋrʋ Elizabɛtɩ na yɩ te. Wʋntʋ jaanɩ pugǝ mʋ sɩ o lʋ bu, yɩ o maŋɩ o kwɩn. Nɔɔna ya bʋŋɩ sɩ o yɩ ka-dʋgʋ mʋ, yɩ o laan jɩgɩ pugǝ ka yi nɩnɛɛnɩ canɩ sɩrdʋ.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ Baŋa-Wɛ na bá wanɩ DƖ kɩ.»

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Mari ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ tɩntʋŋ-kana mʋ. Wɛ nan pa kʋ kɩ nɩ n na tagɩ te dɩ amʋ tɩn.» Malɛka kam laan ma viiri. Mari na zaŋɩ o vu o na Elizabɛtɩ te tɩn

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Da yam kʋntʋ ni nɩ Mari ma zaŋɩ o kɩ lɩla o maa diini Zude tɩʋ kʋdoŋ na wʋ pweeru tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Elizabɛtɩ na ni Mari na jɔɔn-o tɩn, o bu wʋm na tigi o wʋnɩ tɩn ma pipiri. Wɛ Joro kʋm ma ba Elizabɛtɩ te,

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Wɛ tiini DƖ kɩ nmʋ yu-yoŋo DƖ dwǝni kaana maama. Kʋ na yɩ bu wʋlʋ na wʋ n wʋnɩ tɩn, Wɛ kɩ-o yu-yoŋo lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Amʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ sɩ a Yuutu nu ba amʋ te?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: N jɔɔnɩm dɩm na tu dɩ tʋ a zwɛ nɩ tɩn, bu wʋm na wʋ a wʋnɩ tɩn tigi o pipiri mʋ, o na jɩgɩ wʋpolo tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Nmʋ na sɛ nɩ Baŋa-Wɛ jɩgɩ cɩga tɩn, nmʋ yɩ yu-yoŋo tu. Kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na tagɩ DƖ brɩ-m tɩn wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ.» Mari na tee Baŋa-Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Mari laan ma ta o wɩ: «Aá pa a Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ zulǝ dɩ a bɩcarɩ maama.

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ na yɩ a Vɩrnʋ tɩn mʋ pɛ a na wʋpolo dɩ a wʋ maama.

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋ-kana balaŋa mʋ, yɩ DƖ nii amʋ baŋa nɩ. Kʋ na zɩgɩ zɩm kʋ ta maa ve, nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ta wɩ, a yɩ yu-yoŋo tu,

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: dɩdaanɩ Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ na kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ pa-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu cɩga.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na kwarɩ-DƖ tɩn, DƖ jɩgɩ ba ŋwaŋa lanyɩranɩ maŋa maama.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Wɛ kwe DƖ jɩŋa mʋ DƖ ma kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla. DƖ ma pa banɩ-nyɩna jagɩ da-yigǝ nɩ dɩ ba wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ tɩm.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: DƖ joŋi balʋ na yɩ pwa tɩn paarɩ, yɩ DƖ paɩ balʋ na yɩ nabwǝnǝ tɩn na zulǝ.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: DƖ maa paɩ balʋ yinigǝ na jɩgɩ-ba tɩn wo-laarʋ zanzan, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa nadunǝ viiri dɩ jɩ-kʋrɩ.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna mʋ. DƖ guli ba gulǝ, DƖ duri ba ŋwaŋa yɩ DƖ zǝni-ba,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: nɩ DƖ na goni ni dɩdaanɩ dɩbam kwǝ-nakwa tɩn, dɩdaanɩ Abraham dɩ o dwi tiinǝ bam maama, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Mari dɛɛn ma maŋɩ Elizabɛtɩ tee nɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ canɩ sɩtɔ. O laan ma joori sɔŋɔ. Zan lʋra kam na dɛ te tɩn

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: O tɩʋ kʋm tiinǝ dɩ o cʋrrʋ dɩ ma ni, Baŋa-Wɛ na tiini DƖ duri o ŋwaŋa yɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ pa-o tɩn. Ba maama dɩ ma jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Bu wʋm da na yi nana tɩn, ba ma pa ba go-o, nɩ Moyisi cullu tɩm na brɩ sɩ ba taa goni ba bǝkǝri te tɩn. Ba ma lagɩ sɩ ba pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zakari, nɩ o ko yɩrɩ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: O nu wʋm ma wʋ sɛ yɩ o wɩ: «Awo, á pa o yɩrɩ nɩ Zan.»

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ n ta kʋntʋ? Nɔɔnʋ maŋɩ o tǝri á sɔŋɔ nɩ o yɩrɩ na yɩ Zan.»

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Ba ma daarɩ ba ma ba jɩa ba maŋɩ ba brɩ o ko wʋm sɩ ba nii, o na lagɩ sɩ ba pa o bu wʋm yɩrɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ dɛɛn ma ja ba tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam maama. Balʋ maama dɛɛn na zʋʋrɩ Zude pweeru tɩm je sɩm nɩ tɩn dɩ dɛɛn ma ni wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na kɩ tɩn, yɩ ba jɩgɩ tɩ taanɩ ba ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ba maa jɩgɩ kʋlʋ ba na ni tɩn ba wʋrʋ nɩ, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Bu wʋntʋ nan lagɩ o ji wɔɔ mʋ?» Bɛŋwaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dam dɛɛn wʋ bu wʋm tee nɩ. Zakari na brɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ te tɩn

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm dɛɛn ma ba bu wʋm ko Zakari te, yɩ kʋ pa o ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ o wɩ:

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: «Pa-na dɩ́ zuli Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na te Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ DƖ tu DƖ nɔɔna bam te, sɩ DƖ vrɩ-ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ DƖ yagɩ.

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: DƖ ma pa wʋlʋ na yɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ Davidi dwi tu tɩn zaŋɩ dɩ́ wʋnɩ, sɩ o ba o ji dɩbam vɩrnʋ.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Kʋ ma sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ nɩ Baŋa-Wɛ na pɛ DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam maŋɩ ba ta kʋlʋ faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn tagɩ ba wɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ dɩbam dɩ́ dʋna jɩa nɩ, dɩ balʋ maama na culi dɩbam tɩn jɩa nɩ.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: DƖ daa ta duri dɩbam kwǝ-nakwa yibwǝnǝ,

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn wɩ, DƖ wʋ́ joŋi dɩbam dɩ́ dʋna jɩa nɩ DƖ yagɩ, yɩ dɩ́ daa bá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá tʋŋa nɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: A bu, kʋ na yɩ nmʋ, baá bǝŋi nmʋ nɩ Baŋa-Wɛ nijoŋnu, bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ wʋ́ da dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yigǝ, sɩ n fɔgɩ n kwɛ o cwǝŋǝ kam, o na lagɩ o ba o da da tɩn.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Nmʋ ta wʋ́ pa Wɛ nɔɔna bam lwarɩ sɩ DƖ wʋ́ vrɩ-ba, dɩ DƖ na wʋ́ yagɩ ba lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Wɛ maa jɩgɩ dɩbam ŋwaŋa lanyɩranɩ. DƖ ma wʋ́ pa pooni nuŋi wɛyuu dɩ ba dɩbam te dɩ nyɩɩna, nɩ wɩa na puli tɩtɩɩtɩ te tɩn,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: sɩ dɩ pa nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ lim wʋnɩ tɩn dɩ balʋ na kwarɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn na pooni, sɩ dɩ pa dɩ́ da yazurǝ cwǝŋǝ.»

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Zakari bu Zan dɛɛn ma kɩ nɔɔnʋ yɩ o wʋbʋŋa bɩ lanyɩranɩ. O dɛɛn ma zʋʋrɩ kagʋa nɩ taan, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dɛ dɩm o na wʋ́ nuŋi Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam tɩtarɩ nɩ o brɩ-ba Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam tɩn.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ lʋgʋ kʋm pa-farʋ wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Ogusi tɩn dɛɛn ma pa ni, sɩ ba ga o tɩʋ kʋm maama nɔn-biǝ bam sɩ o lwarɩ ba ni.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn maa zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simeyon. O yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ, yɩ o kwarɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ. O maa yɔɔrɩ o cǝgi dɛ dɩm Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ joŋi Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam tɩn. Wɛ Joro kʋm maa wʋ o tee nɩ.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Garɩm dɩntʋ maa yɩ pulim garɩm, yɩ dɩ kɩ maŋa kalʋ Kwirini dɩ dɛɛn na yɩ Siiri tɩɩnɩ dɩm yuutu tɩn.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Garɩm dɩm maŋa na yi tɩn, nɔɔnʋ maama ma vu o tɩtɩ tɩʋ sɩ ba ga-o.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ dɩ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi Nazarɛtɩ kʋ na yɩ Galile tɩʋ tɩn. O ma vu Zude tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Betelɩhɛm, ba na lʋgɩ faŋa faŋa Pɛ Davidi mɛ tɩn. O dɛɛn ve daanɩ, o na yɩ Davidi dwi tu tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Mari wʋlʋ ba na sɛ sɩ o taa yɩ Zʋzɛfʋ kaanɩ tɩn dɩ ma tɔgɩ dɩd-o o vu sɩ ba ga-ba. O dɛɛn jɩgɩ pugǝ mʋ.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: O ma lʋ bǝkǝrǝ. Mʋ o dayigǝ bu. O ma kwe bu wʋm o ma gwaarʋ o kukwǝr-o o tiŋi vara wʋdiu dim jǝgǝ nɩ. Ba dɛɛn tigi vara digǝ nɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ vǝrǝ mʋ su tɩʋ kʋm maama, yɩ ba wʋ nɛ digǝ sɩ ba zʋ. Nayɩra na ni Zezi lʋra kam taanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Nayɩra dɩ dɛɛn mʋ wʋ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, gaa kʋm wʋnɩ, ba yɩrɩ ba vara tɩtɩɩ nɩ.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma nuŋi ba yigǝ nɩ, yɩ Wɛ zǝŋi DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam pooni ba baŋa nɩ, yɩ dɩ nyɩɩnɩ dɩ gilimi-ba. Fʋʋnɩ ma tiini dɩ zʋ-ba zanzan.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ zɩm dɛ dɩm nɩ ba lʋgɩ abam Vɩrnʋ wʋm Davidi tɩʋ Betelɩhɛm nɩ. Wʋntʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ. Wʋm mʋ yɩ abam Yuutu.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Á na ve á nii, á wʋ́ na bu-sɩsɩŋa ba na kukwǝri dɩ gwaarʋ ba tiŋi vara wʋdiu dim jǝgǝ nɩ. Mʋ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ brɩ abam nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ a taga.»

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Malɛka kam na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ malɛsɩ kɔgɔ zanzan ma da sɩ nuŋi sɩ wǝli dɩ ka. Sɩ maama ma tee Wɛ sɩ wɩ:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: «Wɛ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ wɛyuu nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ tɩga baŋa nɩ, balʋ na tigi Wɛ bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta zʋʋrɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ wʋ-zuru.»

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Malɛsɩ sɩm laan ma joori Wɛ-sɔŋɔ. Sɩ na kɛ tɩn, nayɩra bam ma ta daanɩ ba wɩ: «Ba-na dɩ́ vu Betelɩhɛm dɩ́ nii kʋlʋ na kɩ da yɩ Wɛ pa dɩ́ lwarɩ tɩn.» Nayɩra na ve sɩ ba na Zezi te tɩn

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋɩ lɩla ba kɛ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Ba ma vu ba na Mari dɩdaanɩ Zʋzɛfʋ. Ba ma na bu wʋm na tigi vara wʋdiu dim jǝgǝ nɩ.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ-o kʋntʋ tɩn, ba laan ma ta malɛka kam na maŋɩ ka ta bu wʋm taanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Mari dɩ na ni wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na kɩ tɩn, o maa bʋŋɩ-tɩ o wʋ nɩ.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Nayɩra bam ma joori ba viiri yɩ ba zuli Wɛ, yɩ ba tee-DƖ dɩ kʋlʋ ba na ni yɩ ba ta kwǝri ba na tɩn. Kʋ dɛɛn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ malɛka kam na tagɩ ka brɩ-ba te tɩn. Ba na pɛ bu wʋm yɩrɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Bu wʋm na yi da nana tɩn, ba ma pa sɩ ba go-o, nɩ Moyisi cullu tɩm na brɩ sɩ ba taa goni ba bǝkǝri te tɩn. Ba ma pa o yɩrɩ ba wɩ Zezi. Mʋ yɩrɩ dɩlʋ malɛka kam na maŋɩ ka pa-o, yɩ ba ta wʋ jaanɩ o pugǝ tɩn. Ba na pɛ Zezi Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Maŋa kam laan ma yi sɩ Mari zarɩ o digiru tɩm sɩ o kwɛ o tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ, sɩ kʋ tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ na brɩ te tɩn. Zʋzɛfʋ dɩ Mari ma zaŋɩ ba ja bu wʋm ba vu Zeruzalɛm, sɩ ba vu ba zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ, sɩ ba pa-o ba Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: just as the Law of the Lord says, “Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.”

translation_verse: O dɛɛn yǝni o ve mɛ seeni nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ na tǝrǝ tɩn mʋ o warɩ Wɛ. Zezi na pɛ kɔrɔ zaŋɩ kʋ vu te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ nɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o. O ma ta o wɩ: «A badoŋ, nmʋ lwarɩm dɩm ti.»

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Naboro dɩdʋ kʋm yɩ Simɔn nyɩm mʋ. Zezi ma zʋ kʋ wʋnɩ. O ma ta dɩdaanɩ Simɔn o wɩ: «Co boro kʋm n ja n vu yigǝ fɩnfɩɩn n pa-nɩ.» O na cogǝ o ja o yi yigǝ tɩn, Zezi laan ma je naboro kʋm wʋnɩ o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ o brɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A Yuutu, dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ dɩ bʋrɩ sɩm taan dɩ́ pʋʋrɩ tɩga, yɩ dɩ́ wʋ nɛ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Nmʋ nan na wɩ, dɩ́ daa joori dɩ́ dɩ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ dɩ-sɩ sɩ dɩ́ nii.»

english_verse: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.
translation_verse: Ba ma yɩgɩsɩ jɩa ba bǝŋi ba donnǝ bam naboro kʋkʋm kʋm wʋnɩ, sɩ ba ba ba wǝli-ba. Bantʋ dɩ ma ja ba boro kʋm ba vu ba zǝni-ba. Bwǝǝru tɩm tɩle maama ma su dɩ kale. Tɩ ma ga fɩnfɩɩn sɩ tɩ miisi na bam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The men pulled their boats up on the shore. Then they left everything and went with Jesus. Jesus Heals a Man (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ma joori ba ja nabwǝǝru tɩm ba nuŋi ba tiŋi buburu kʋm ni nɩ. Ba na kɩ kʋntʋ ba ti tɩn, ba yagɩ ba wǝǝnu maama, yɩ ba laan daarɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi. Zezi na pɛ nanyɔŋɔ na yazurǝ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: News about Jesus kept spreading. Large crowds came to listen to him teach and to be healed of their diseases.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, nɔɔna zanzan dɛɛn ni Zezi ŋwa je maama. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ zanzan maa ve o te sɩ ba taa cǝgi o ni-taanɩ dɩm, sɩ ba daarɩ ba na yazurǝ.

english_verse: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they went up on the roof, where they removed some tiles and let the mat down in the middle of the room.
translation_verse: Ba maa warɩ, kɔgɔ kʋm na daga tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba ma wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ. Ba ma ja-o ba di nayuu. Ba ma puri bɔɔnɩ yɩ ba daarɩ ba pa gungolo kʋm tɔgɩ da kʋ tu digǝ kam wʋnɩ. Kʋ pǝni nɔɔna bam tɩtarɩ nɩ Zezi yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Kɔɔ mʋ yɩ mwalɩ kʋ dwe, amʋ na tagɩ dɩ kɔrɔ kʋm a wɩ: ‹Nmʋ lwarɩm dɩm ti› mʋ yɩ mwalɩ, naa a na tagɩ a wɩ: ‹Zaŋɩ n ta n veǝ› mʋ yɩ mwalɩ?

english_verse: But now you will see that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” Jesus then said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk home.”
translation_verse: Amʋ nan wʋ́ pa abam lwarɩ sɩ a na yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm tɩn jɩgɩ dam lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ a yagɩ nɔɔna lwarɩm a ma cɛ-ba.» O laan ma ta dɩ kɔrɔ kʋm o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta nmʋ, zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ sɩ n kwe n gungolo kʋm n ja n vu sɔŋɔ.»

english_verse: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ mʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋm zaŋɩ ba maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o kwe o gungolo kʋm o ya na tigi kʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn o zɩŋɩ o maa ve sɔŋɔ, yɩ o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, “We have seen a great miracle today!” Jesus Chooses Levi (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama na nɛ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn, mʋ kʋ kɩ-ba yǝǝu. Fʋʋnɩ ma ja-ba. Ba ma zuli Wɛ, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ zɩm nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩla!» Zezi na bǝŋi Leevi sɩ o taa tɔg-o te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Leevi ma zaŋɩ o yagɩ o woŋo maama yɩ o tɔgɩ o kwaga.

english_verse: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.
translation_verse: O ma vu sɔŋɔ o kɩ wʋdiiru zanzan o ma kɩ candiǝ o pa Zezi. Lampo-joŋnǝ zanzan dɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ ma ba ba tɔgɩ ba di.

english_verse: The Pharisees and some of their teachers of the Law of Moses grumbled to Jesus' disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with these tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ dɩ ba cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma vu Zezi karabiǝ bam te ba ŋɔɔna yɩ ba pʋʋna ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ abam di wʋdiu dɩdaanɩ lampo-joŋnǝ dɩ nɔn-cɩcɔgɩrʋ tɩm kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: I didn't come to invite good people to turn to God. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Matthew
translation_verse: Amʋ na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ a bǝŋi balʋ na maŋɩ ba yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna tɩn, a nan tu sɩ a bǝŋi nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ, sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ.» Zezi zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ zaasɩm-dʋʋrɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Some people said to Jesus, “John's followers often pray and go without eating, and so do the followers of the Pharisees. But your disciples never go without eating or drinking.”
translation_verse: Ba daa ta ma ta dɩ Zezi ba wɩ: «Zan karabiǝ bam yǝni ba vɔ ni mʋ maŋa zanzan yɩ ba daarɩ ba warɩ Wɛ. Farizɩan karabiǝ bam dɩ yǝni ba kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ nmʋ karabiǝ bam ba vɔ ni kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.”
translation_verse: Maŋa nan wʋ́ ba yi, yɩ ba ja kan-barʋ wʋm ba viiri. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ yɩ o daa na ba ta wʋ ba tee nɩ tɩn, mʋ ba laan wʋ́ vɔ ni.»

english_verse: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋɩ dɩdoŋ o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá sɛ o kwe gwar-dʋŋʋ o kaarɩ sɩ o ma fǝri gwar-doŋo. O nan na kɩ kʋntʋ oó kaarɩ gwar-dʋŋʋ kʋm o cɔgɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋ bá wanɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ gwar-doŋo kʋm.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The new wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ dɩ nan bá sɛ o kwe sa-dʋŋa o lo o kɩ lɔ-doŋo wʋnɩ. O na kɩ kʋntʋ, yɩ sana kam na keeri, kaá pa lɔɔ kʋm bagɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ sana kam wʋ́ lo, yɩ lɔɔ kʋm dɩ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: New wine must be put only into new wineskins.
translation_verse: Sa-dʋŋa nan maŋɩ sɩ n lo n kɩ lɔ-dʋŋʋ wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, “The old wine is better.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na nyɔgɩ sa-doŋǝ o mɩ, o daa bá lagɩ sɩ o nyɔ sa-dʋŋa. Oó ta wɩ: ‹Sa-doŋǝ kam tiini ka lamma›.»

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he told the man to stand up where everyone could see him. And the man stood up.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ ba na bʋŋɩ te tɩn. O ma ta dɩ jɩ-tɩga kam tu o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ n ba n zɩgɩ nɔɔna bam maama tɩtarɩ nɩ.» O ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi o zɩgɩ da.

english_verse: Some Pharisees said, “Why are you picking grain on the Sabbath? You're not supposed to do that!”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma bwe ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ na cɔgɩ dɩbam siun dɛ cullu tɩm tɩn?»

english_verse: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ ba na kɩ abam kʋntʋ tɩn, taá faŋɩ-na á caka dɩ wʋpolo, á ŋwɩɩrʋ na yɩ zanzan Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Taá ye-na sɩ ba kwǝ-nakwa dɩ dɛɛn kɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na sɔɔlɩ sɩ kʋ cɔgɩ abam tɩn, sɩ á loori-na Wɛ sɩ DƖ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ. Loori-na Wɛ á pa balʋ na jɩgɩ abam ba bɛɛsɩ tɩn.

english_verse: One was Simon, and Jesus named him Peter. Another was Andrew, Peter's brother. There were also James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
translation_verse: Ba yɩra mʋ tɩntʋ: Simɔn wʋlʋ Zezi na pɛ o yɩrɩ o wɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩn, Andre wʋlʋ na yɩ Simɔn nyaanɩ tɩn, Zakɩ, Zan, Filipi, Batelemi,

english_verse: On another Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue, and a man with a paralyzed right hand was there.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ na kɛ tɩn, siun dɛ dɩdɩm daa ma yi. Zezi ma vu o zʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ. O maa wʋra o brɩ-ba Wɛ taanɩ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, o jazɩm jɩŋa na tɩga.

english_verse: The teachers and the Pharisees were furious and started saying to one another, “What can we do about Jesus?” Jesus Chooses His Twelve Apostles (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma fʋlɩ dɩdaanɩ Zezi, yɩ ba banɩ daanɩ sɩ ba nii ba na wʋ́ wanɩ ba kɩ-o te tɩn. Zezi na kuri o karabiǝ fugǝ-bale te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama maa kwaanɩ sɩ ba dwe-o, bɛŋwaanɩ dam nuŋi o yɩra nɩ dɩ pa ba na yazurǝ. Wʋpolo dɩ lɛɛrʋ taanɩ (Matiyu

english_verse: Matthew, Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus. The rest of the apostles were Simon, known as the Eager One,
translation_verse: Matiyu, Toma, Zakɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Alɩfɩ bu tɩn, Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ Zelɔtɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn,

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Abam balʋ na jɩgɩ wʋ-fwaarʋ á di lele tɩn, kʋ yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ abam, á na wʋ́ ba á yaarɩ dɩ kana tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Abam balʋ na jɩgɩ wʋpolo lele tɩn, kʋ yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ abam, á na wʋ́ ba á keeri yɩ á yi-na lu tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn tu Zezi te sɩ ba cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm, sɩ ba kwǝri ba na yazurǝ dɩ ba yawɩɩrʋ. Nɔɔna badaara wʋra ciciri na jɩgɩ-ba sɩ yaara, yɩ ba na yazurǝ.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Kana na jɩgɩ abam balʋ lele tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, Wɛ na wʋ́ pa abam kʋ daga tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Abam balʋ wʋrʋ na cɔgɩ lele tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, Wɛ na wʋ́ pa abam wʋpolo tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna na culi abam, yɩ ba na vaɩ abam, naa ba na twɩ abam, naa ba na jɩgɩ abam ba goonǝ, á na tɔgɩ amʋ na yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ, á jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo mʋ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies. Love for Enemies (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama na jɩgɩ abam ba zulǝ, kʋ yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ abam. Á taá ye-na sɩ ba kwǝ-nakwa dɩ dɛɛn zuli balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ tɩn.» Sono taanɩ (Matiyu

english_verse: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.
translation_verse: Pa-na á donnǝ woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ á pa-ba tɩn, sɩ Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ pa abam woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ DƖ pa abam tɩn. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam lanyɩranɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba na kwe bwaŋ-kamunu ba maŋɩ ba vuuri ka ni yɩ kʋ siiri te tɩn. Bwaŋa kalʋ abam na ma á maŋɩ á pa nɔɔna tɩn, Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ ma kantʋ mʋ DƖ maŋɩ DƖ pa abam dɩ.»

english_verse: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na lagɩ o lɔ o sɔŋɔ yɩ o kʋ goŋo o yi pulɔrɔ yɩ o laan cwi sɔŋɔ kʋm kuri pulɔrɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ. Dʋ-na na daga yɩ ba magɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm, ba bá wanɩ ba coori-kʋ, o na lɔgɩ-kʋ lanyɩranɩ yɩ kʋ dana tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na lɔgɩ n pʋpɔŋɔ, sɩ n guni kʋdoŋ kʋm sɩ o lɔ o wǝli da. Nɔɔnʋ na vrɩ n gwar-bwǝrǝ, yɩ cʋ-o sɩ o vrɩ n gwar-bu dɩ.

english_verse: Give to everyone who asks and don't ask people to return what they have taken from you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na loori woŋo nmʋ tee nɩ tɩn, sɩ n pa-o. Nɔɔnʋ na kwe nmʋ woŋo o ja viiri, yɩ bwe kʋ bwiǝ sɩ n joŋi.

english_verse: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.
translation_verse: Abam nan na soe balʋ dɩ na soe abam tɩn yɩranɩ, á wʋ́ na pɛɛrɩ na? Nɔɔna balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Wɛ tɩn dɩ soe balʋ na soe-ba tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you. Judging Others (Matthew
translation_verse: Á taá jɩgɩ nɔɔna ŋwaŋa, nɩ á Ko Wɛ na jɩgɩ nɔɔna ŋwaŋa te tɩn.» Yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ n doŋ wǝǝnu (Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus said: Don't judge others, and God won't judge you. Don't be hard on others, and God won't be hard on you. Forgive others, and God will forgive you.
translation_verse: «Abam yɩ taá ŋɔɔna á donnǝ wǝǝnu, sɩ Wɛ yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ abam dɩ wǝǝnu. Yɩ taá lwɛ-na nɔɔna, sɩ Wɛ yɩ zaŋɩ DƖ ba DƖ lwɛ abam dɩ. Nan yagɩ-na á donnǝ lwarɩm á ma cɛ-ba, sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ abam lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam dɩ.

english_verse: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋa o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «Lilwe wʋ́ wanɩ o vaŋɩ o doŋ lilwe na? Ba na vaŋɩ daanɩ, ba maama bá tʋ goŋo wʋnɩ na?

english_verse: Are students better than their teacher? But when they are fully trained, they will be like their teacher.
translation_verse: Karabu bá wanɩ o dwǝni o karanyɩna. Karabu nan na zaasɩ o ti maama, o dɩ o karanyɩna kam maɩ daanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Abam nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na nii o doŋ yi nɩ o na gaa balaŋa da, yɩ o ba lagɩ sɩ o lwarɩ nɩ o tɩtɩ yi jɩgɩ daa tɩn. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ na?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Nmʋ na wʋ nɛ daa na wʋ nmʋ yi nɩ tɩn, nmʋ wʋ́ kɩ ta n ta n doŋ nɩ o ba sɩ n lɩ gaa o yi nɩ? Nmʋ yɩ pipiri-nyɩm dɩ nmʋ na kɩ n doŋ te tɩn. Nmʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ n lɩ n tɩtɩ yi daa kam mʋ, sɩ n laan wanɩ n nii lanyɩranɩ sɩ n lɩ n doŋ yi gaa kam.» Nɔɔnʋ kǝm mʋ pa ba lwarɩ o na yɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: «Tu-ŋʋŋʋ bá wanɩ kʋ lǝ bu-balwaarʋ. Tu-balɔrɔ dɩ nan bá wanɩ kʋ lǝ bu-ŋʋna.

english_verse: You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces. You cannot pick figs or grapes from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Abam na lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ tiu maama na yɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, á wʋ́ ma kʋ biǝ mʋ á lwarɩ. Nmʋ bá na mɔɔla sabara yuu nɩ, asawɛ n na swan kaligoŋo kuri nɩ n twɛ.

english_verse: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart. Two Builders (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋʋm ŋɔɔnɩ wo-ŋʋnnʋ tɩlʋ na wʋ o wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ. Nɔn-balɔrɔ dɩ ma ŋɔɔnɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ na wʋ o wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn. Woŋo kʋlʋ maama na wʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ tɔgɩ o ni kʋ nuŋǝ.» Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ Wɛ taanɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Why do you keep on saying that I am your Lord, when you refuse to do what I say?
translation_verse: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ á bǝ amʋ sɩ ‹Yuutu, Yuutu›, yɩ á ba kɩ a na wɩ á kɩ te tɩn?

translation_verse: Kʋlʋ maama zɩm na sǝgi nɔɔna tee nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ba kwɩn. Kʋlʋ maama na pugi tɩn wʋ́ ba kʋ puri mʋ, sɩ nɔɔna lwarɩ kʋ kuri na yɩ te.

english_verse: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.
translation_verse: Ba na maa kɛ tɩn, Zezi ma tʋ dɔɔm nɩ. Vu-fɔrɔ ma da kʋ zaŋɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm baŋa nɩ, kʋ magɩ boro kʋm kʋ pa kʋ wʋra kʋ miisǝ na bam kuri nɩ. Ba dɛɛn maa wʋ cam wʋnɩ ba lagɩ ba tɩ.

english_verse: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message,

translation_verse: Tɩ-ywǝŋǝ jǝgǝ kam wo-duuru tɩm na tʋ da tɩn maa maŋɩ balʋ na ni Wɛ taanɩ dɩm yɩ ba joŋi-dɩ lanyɩranɩ ba kɩ ba bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn mʋ. translation_verse: O ma bwe o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ?» Fʋʋnɩ ma ja-ba, yɩ kʋ kɩ-ba yǝǝu. Ba ma bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Wʋntʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ, yɩ o ta wanɩ o bagɩ viu dɩdaanɩ na, yɩ tɩ sɛ o ni?» Zezi na zǝli ciciri nɔɔnʋ yɩra nɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ kanɩa, o bá sɛ sɩ o tarɩgɩ-ka o pu tɩtɔgɔ kuri nɩ, naa o zɩgɩ-ka gadogo kuri nɩ. Oó kwe-ka o palɩ wɛɛnɩ mʋ, sɩ ka taa jɩgɩ pooni ka paɩ balʋ na lagɩ ba zʋ digǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ nɔɔnʋ mʋ dwe-nɩ. Amʋ ye sɩ dam nuŋi a yɩra nɩ.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, “Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.”
translation_verse: Zezi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta dɩ Zayirusi o wɩ: «Yɩ ta n fʋna. Za n weeni n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ, sɩ oó na yazurǝ.»

english_verse: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.
translation_verse: Ciciri sɩm ma loori Zezi, sɩ o yɩ zǝli-sɩ o pa sɩ zʋ curu goŋ-luŋu kʋm wʋ.

english_verse: The people went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they also found the man. The demons had gone out of him, and he was sitting there at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on and was in his right mind. But the people were terrified.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma nuŋi ba vu sɩ ba nii kʋ na kɩ te tɩn. Ba ma vu ba yi Zezi te. Ba ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ cicirǝ kam na yag-o tɩn. O maa je Zezi tee nɩ dɩdaanɩ o swan joori ya ba, yɩ o zʋ gwaarʋ. Ba na nɛ-o kʋntʋ tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ-ba.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.
translation_verse: Zezi nu dɩ o nyaana ma ba o te sɩ ba na-o. Ba ma warɩ ba yi o te, kɔgɔ kʋm na daga tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.
translation_verse: Zezi ma nuŋi naboro kʋm wʋnɩ. Tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa ma ba o jeer-o. Ciciri mʋ jɩg-o sɩ yaara. Kʋ tiini kʋ daanɩ o na wʋ zʋ kʋlʋkʋlʋ yɩ o ba zʋʋrɩ sɔŋɔ nɩ. O yǝni o tigi yibeelǝ je nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, “Let's cross the lake.” They started out,
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam ma zʋ naboro. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Pa-na dɩ́ bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni dɩdoŋ dɩm.» Ba ma sɩŋɩ ba yɛ ba maa kɛa.

english_verse: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, “Master, Master! We are about to drown!” Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zaŋɩ Zezi dɔɔm nɩ, yɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu, zaŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ li na dɩ́ tɩ.» O laan ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ. O ma bagɩ viu kʋm dɩ na bam sɩ tɩ yagɩ. Viu kʋm laan ma yagɩ, yɩ na bam dɩ maŋɩ da cɩmm.

english_verse: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, “Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me!”
translation_verse: O na nɛ Zezi tɩn, o ma sɩŋɩ o kaasɩ wɛwɛ. O ma vu o tʋ Zezi yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o kaasɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Zezi, Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ Bu, nmʋ tu amʋ tee nɩ sɩ n kɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Popo, yɩ zaŋɩ n yaarɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ ya na nii tǝrǝ bam baŋa nɩ tɩn na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma duri ba vu ba ta kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn tɩʋ wʋnɩ dɩdaanɩ dɛ sɩm maama ba brɩ nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: He said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to go out of him. The man had often been attacked by the demon. And even though he had been bound with chains and leg irons and kept under guard, he smashed whatever bound him. Then the demon would force him out into lonely places.
translation_verse: O tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi maŋɩ o pa cicirǝ kam ni sɩ ka nuŋi ka yagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm. Kʋ daanɩ cicirǝ kam na maŋɩ ka jɩg-o. english_verse: Jesus asked the man, “What is your name?” He answered, “My name is Lots.” He said this because there were “lots” of demons in him.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma bwe-o o wɩ: «N yɩrɩ mʋ bɛɛ?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A yɩrɩ mʋ Kɔgɔ», bɛŋwaanɩ ciciri zanzan mʋ tɔg-o.

english_verse: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.
translation_verse: Tǝrǝ kɔgɔ zanzan dɛɛn ma wʋ je sɩm nɩ ba beeri piu yuu nɩ ba di. Ciciri sɩm ma loori Zezi, sɩ o pa-sɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ sɩ vu sɩ zʋ tǝrǝ bam wʋ. O ma sɛ.

english_verse: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Ciciri sɩm laan ma yagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm yɩra, yɩ sɩ vu sɩ zʋ tǝrǝ bam. Tǝrǝ bam maama ma duri ba tu ba tʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ ba li na ba tɩ.

english_verse: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back,

english_verse: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said,

translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm o wɩ: «Joori n vu n sɔŋɔ tiinǝ te, sɩ n ta kʋlʋ Wɛ na kɩ DƖ pa nmʋ tɩn n brɩ-ba.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma vu o tʋlɩ tɩʋ kʋm maama wʋnɩ o tɔɔlɩ kʋlʋ maama Zezi na kɩ o pa-o tɩn. Zezi na pɛ Zayirusi bukɔ dɩ kaanɩ wʋdoŋ na yazurǝ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ dɩ maa wʋra o na wɔɛ ka-wʋ taan bɩna fugǝ-yale. O ya kwe o jɩjɩgɩrʋ maama o pa liri tiinǝ sɩ ba soon-o, yɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩ dɩdʋa wʋ wanɩ o soon-o.

english_verse: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma joori o bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni dɩdoŋ dɩm dɩdaanɩ kɔgɔ zanzan mʋ maŋɩ kʋ gilimi daanɩ kʋ cǝg-o. Ba na nɛ-o tɩn, ba ma jeer-o lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.
translation_verse: O ma kɛ Zezi kwaga o vu o laarɩ o dwe o gɔrɔ kʋm ni. O na dwe-o kʋntʋ tɩn, jana bam ma kɔ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma lwarɩ sɩ o bá wanɩ o sǝgi dɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn. Fʋʋnɩ maa jɩg-o yɩ o yɩra saɩ. O ma vu o tʋ Zezi yigǝ nɩ. O ma ta dɩd-o kʋlʋ maama na pɛ o dwe-o kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ o na nɛ yazurǝ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ te tɩn. Kɔgɔ kʋm maama ma ni o na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A bukɔ, nmʋ na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ te tɩn mʋ pɛ n na yazurǝ. Ve sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wǝli-m.»

english_verse: While Jesus was speaking, someone came from Jairus' home and said, “Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore?”
translation_verse: Zezi ta na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ ma nuŋi Zayirusi sɔŋɔ o ba o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «N bukɔ wʋm tɩga. Daa yɩ ta n yaarɩ karanyɩna kam.»

english_verse: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi sɔŋɔ kʋm. Zezi ma zʋ. O ma wʋ sɛ sɩ nɔɔna da-o ba zʋ, kʋ na daɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɩ Zakɩ, dɩ bu wʋm nu dɩ o ko yɩranɩ.

english_verse: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, “The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na maŋɩ ba wʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn maa keerǝ ba coosǝ bɩsankana kam ŋwaanɩ. Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Á yɩ taá keerǝ, sɩ o wʋ tɩgɩ, o dɔ mʋ.»

english_verse: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maama ma mwan-o, bɛŋwaanɩ ba ye nɩ bu wʋm sɩɩnɩ o tɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, “Child, get up!”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma vu o ja bɩsankana kam jɩŋa, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A bu, zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ.»

english_verse: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ŋwɩa ma joori. O ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ. Zezi ma ta dɩ ba sɩ ba kɩ wʋdiu ba pa bu wʋm sɩ o di.

english_verse: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma sʋ bu wʋm nu dɩ o ko lanyɩranɩ. Zezi ma kaanɩ-ba o wɩ, ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba ta ba brɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ woŋo kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam dɛɛn ma joori ba vu o te. Ba ma ta ba brɩ-o ba na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn. O ma pa ba tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba vu jǝgǝ kadoŋ ba yɩranɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm. Jǝgǝ kam ba na ve tɩn batwarɩ dɩ tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Betisayida.

english_verse: They did this, and all the people sat down.
translation_verse: Ba ma kɩ kʋntʋ. Nɔɔna bam maama ma jǝni tɩga nɩ.

translation_verse: Galile Pɛ Erɔdɩ dɛɛn ni kʋlʋ maama Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam na wʋra ba kɩ tɩn. Kʋ ma pa o wʋbʋŋa vugimi daanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna badaara tɛ Zezi woŋo ba wɩ, Zan mʋ joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: He told them, “Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Á na maa ve, á yɩ zaŋɩ á kwe kʋlʋkʋlʋ á wǝli da á ja vu. Á yɩ kwe nacǝgǝ naa tampɔgɔ naa wʋdiu naa sǝbu. Á yɩ kwe gwaarʋ tɩle tɩle á wǝli da.

english_verse: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.
translation_verse: Á na ve á zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ maama á pǝni da, sɩ á taá zʋʋrɩ dáanɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi á viirim mɩmaŋa.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, “Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ wɛ na wʋra dɩ zʋʋrɩ tɩn, Zezi karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam ma ba o te ba wɩ: «Pa nɔɔna bam vu sam wʋnɩ ba lagɩ wʋdiu ba di, dɩ pwǝgǝ je ba pǝni, bɛŋwaanɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ dɩbam na wʋra tɩn yɩ gaa wʋ mʋ. Wʋdiu tǝri yo.»

english_verse: “Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.”
translation_verse: «Cǝgi-na taanɩ dɩlʋ a na lagɩ a ta dɩ abam tɩn, sɩ á joŋi-dɩ lanyɩranɩ. Baá ja amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm ba kɩ nɔɔna jɩŋa nɩ.»

translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Á ya wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á cɩ-o. Wʋlʋ maama na ba culi abam tɩn yɩ abam nɔɔnʋ mʋ.» Samari tɩʋ kʋdoŋ nɔɔna wʋ sɛ sɩ ba jeeri Zezi

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na lagɩ sɩ o yɩrɩ o ŋwɩa tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ ga-ka mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ maama na sɛ sɩ o ga o ŋwɩa amʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na nɛ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu tɩm maama, yɩ o laan na gɛ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ, kʋ jɩgɩ bɛɛ nyɔɔrɩ mʋ kʋ pa-o?

english_verse: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na kwarɩ cavɩɩra amʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ a taanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, cavɩɩra wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm kʋntʋ tu ŋwaanɩ, maŋa kam a na wʋ́ joori a ba lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ paarɩ-zulǝ, nɩ a Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ malɛsɩ sɩm na jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ te tɩn.
