english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.
translation_verse: O na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ kunkwǝǝnu tu tɩ ba tɩ kwǝli-ba. Tɩ na kwǝli-ba tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma ja Zezi karabiǝ bam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: From the cloud a voice spoke, “This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ kunkwǝǝnu tɩm wʋnɩ ka wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ Bu wʋm a na kuri tɩn. Á nan taá cǝgi o taanɩ lanyɩranɩ.»

english_verse: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kam na ŋɔɔnɩ ka ti tɩn, ba ma daa wʋ nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ba wǝli Zezi nɩ. Da yam kʋntʋ ni nɩ ba ma cɩm, yɩ ba wʋ tagɩ kʋlʋ ba na nɛ tɩn ba brɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ. Zezi na zǝli cicirǝ bu wʋdoŋ yɩra nɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam cicirǝ kam na yǝni ka zaŋ-o tɩn, o da o kaasɩ mʋ, yɩ o yɩra saɩ pɔgɩ pɔgɩ, yɩ lile-puŋǝ tɔgɩ o ni ka nuŋǝ. Ka ma tiini ka yaar-o maŋa maama, yɩ ka na yǝni ka zaŋ-o, ka ba nuŋi o yɩra nɩ mwalɩ mwalɩ.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you?” Then Jesus said to the man, “Bring your son to me.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Abam zɩm nɔɔna bam brɩ á ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ, yɩ á ba kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Amʋ wʋ́ daanɩ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ a kɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ abam sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kɔɔ?» O laan ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm o wɩ: «Ja n bu wʋm n ba.»

english_verse: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
translation_verse: Bu wʋm na maa ve o te kʋntʋ tɩn, cicirǝ kam daa ta ma dʋl-o ka dɩ tɩga nɩ, yɩ ka paɩ o yɩra saɩ pɔgɩ pɔgɩ. Zezi ma bagɩ cicirǝ kam o pa ka yag-o. O ma pa bu wʋm na yazurǝ. O laan ma joori o kɩ-o o ko wʋm jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at God's great power. Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama ma na Wɛ dam dɩm na gaalɩ te, yɩ kʋ sʋ-ba zanzan. Zezi daa na ŋɔɔnɩ o tʋʋnɩ taanɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ma wʋ ni o taanɩ dɩm kuri. Dɩ kuri dɩm sǝgi mʋ dɩ ba, yɩ ba wʋ wanɩ ba joŋi-dɩ. Ba ma kwarɩ sɩ ba bwe-o ba nii. Wɔɔ mʋ yɩ nɔn-kamunu Wɛ tee nɩ? (Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ ba na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ ba wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn. O ma ja bu balaŋa o pa o zɩgɩ o tee nɩ.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.” For or against Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ maama na nɩgɩ bu wʋntʋ doŋ amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu nɩgɩ amʋ mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama nan na nɩgɩ amʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ o nɩgɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn dɩ mʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na yɩ balaŋa abam maama wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ nɔn-kamunu cɩga cɩga.»

english_verse: John said, “Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.”
translation_verse: Zan ma ta o wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu, dɩ́ ya nɛ nɔɔnʋ na zǝli ciciri nɔɔna yɩra nɩ dɩ nmʋ yɩrɩ. O nan na daɩ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, dɩ́ ma kwaanɩ sɩ dɩ́ cɩ-o, sɩ o daa yɩ taa kɩ kʋntʋ.»

english_verse: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam dɛɛn ma ba ka twɛ sɩ Wɛ kwe Zezi DƖ ja di DƖ sɔŋɔ. Zezi ma lɩ bʋŋa sɩ o yɔɔrɩ o kwe cwǝŋǝ o vu Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.
translation_verse: O ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba da o yigǝ ba vu. Ba ma vu ba yi Samari tiinǝ tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, sɩ ba ti wǝǝnu maama yigǝ sɩ o laan ba.

english_verse: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam ma wʋ sɛ sɩ ba jeer-o, ba na lwarɩ dɩ o maa ve Zeruzalɛm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people?”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam bale Zakɩ dɩ Zan na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu, n lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa mini nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ dɩ ba dɩ cɔgɩ-ba na?»

english_verse: But Jesus turned and corrected them for what they had said.
translation_verse: Zezi ma pipiri o nii-ba, yɩ o bagɩ-ba [o wɩ: «Abam yǝri joro kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ yirǝ, bantʋ jɩgɩ bɔɔna ba tigi da. Zunǝ dɩ jɩgɩ pwǝru ba tigi da. Kʋ daarɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm ba jɩgɩ jǝgǝ sɩ a pǝni da a sin.»

english_verse: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, “Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ n ta n tɔgɩ-nɩ.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma ta o wɩ: «A Yuutu, yagɩ sɩ a vu a kɩ a ko luǝ, sɩ a laan ba a tɔgɩ nmʋ.»

english_verse: Then someone said to Jesus, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A Yuutu, aá ba a taa tɔgɩ nmʋ. Nan pa-nɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a vu a banɩ a sɔŋɔ tiinǝ, sɩ a laan joori a ba.»

english_verse: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.
translation_verse: O na lagɩ o tʋŋɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, mʋ o tagɩ dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ nyɩ dɩ faa na kɩ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ tɩntʋŋna fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra sɩ ba kɩ-kʋ te tɩn. Nan loori-na faa kʋm tu, sɩ o tʋŋɩ nɔɔna zanzan, sɩ ba vu ba kɩ o faa kʋm ba pa-o.»

english_verse: Now go, but remember, I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o wɩ: «Ve-na! A na tʋŋɩ abam je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ tɩn, abam nyɩ dɩ pǝlbiǝ na maa ve sɩ ba gwaanɩ nywǝnkuri wʋnɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.
translation_verse: Á na maa ve, yɩ kwe-na sǝbiǝ gan-lɔgɔdɩ, nan yɩ kwe-na tampɔgɔ, naa á taá jɩgɩ natra á wǝli da. Yɩ zɩgɩ-na cwǝŋǝ nɩ á daanɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ pwǝgǝ.

english_verse: As soon as you enter a home, say, “God bless this home with peace.”
translation_verse: Á nan na yi sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ maama á na lagɩ á zʋ tɩn, sɩ á ta dɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm tiinǝ nɩ: ‹Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ.›

english_verse: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na wʋra yɩ o soe wʋ-zuru, á yazurǝ yam wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩd-o. Wʋ-zuru-nyɩm nan na tǝrǝ, á yazurǝ yam wʋ́ joori ya ba á tɩtɩ te mʋ.

english_verse: Heal their sick and say, “God's kingdom will soon be here!”
translation_verse: sɩ á pa yawɩɩna na yazurǝ, á daarɩ á ta dɩ ba nɩ: ‹Maŋa twɛ sɩ Baŋa-Wɛ di paarɩ á tɩtarɩ nɩ.›

english_verse: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say,
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, á na zʋ tɩʋ kʋlʋ maama yɩ ba na wʋ sɛ sɩ ba jeeri abam, sɩ á nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm cwe wʋnɩ á ta dɩ ba nɩ:

english_verse: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town! The Unbelieving Towns (Matthew
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a ta abam sɩ, Wɛ sarɩya dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, Sodɔm tiinǝ bá tiini ba na lɛɛrʋ nɩ tɩʋ kʋntʋ tiinǝ na wʋ́ na lɛɛrʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven! Jesus Thanks His Father (Matthew
translation_verse: Á nan yɩ kɩ wʋpolo dɩ ciciri na sɛ abam ni tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Nan za á kɩ-na wʋpolo dɩ á yɩra na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ ŋwɩa tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.» Zezi na kɩ wʋpolo te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.” The Good Samaritan
translation_verse: Lwarɩ-na sɩ, faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ zanzan dɩ pwa zanzan dɛɛn jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ ba ya na kʋlʋ maama abam na naɩ lele tɩn, yɩ ba wʋ wanɩ ba na. Ba dɛɛn jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ ba ya ni Wɛ taanɩ dɩlʋ abam na ni tɩn, yɩ ba wʋ wanɩ ba ni-dɩ.» Wɔɔ mʋ yɩ a doŋ? mɩmaŋa

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.
translation_verse: Wɛ sarɩya dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, Tiiri dɩ Sidɔn tiinǝ bá tiini ba na lɛɛrʋ nɩ abam na wʋ́ na lɛɛrʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!
translation_verse: Abam Kapɛrnawum tiinǝ, á ga bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ lagɩ DƖ zǝŋi abam wɛyuu nɩ mʋ na? Aye. Abam nan lagɩ á tʋ tɩga nɩ mʋ á tu á kwaarɩ curu.»

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Nii-na, a pɛ abam dam sɩ á nɔ bɩsankwɩ dɩ nwaanʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ á wanɩ sʋtaanɩ dɩ dɩ dam maama, yɩ tɩ tɩlʋtɩlʋ bá wanɩ abam woŋo tɩ kɩ.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna dɩdʋa dɛɛn tu Zezi te, sɩ o maŋ-o o nii o swan na yɩ te tɩn. O ma zaŋɩ o bwe-o o wɩ: «Karanyɩna, amʋ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ sɩ a joŋi ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ?»

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma lǝri o wɩ: «Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ, ta n soe n Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ n bɩcarɩ maama, dɩ n wʋ maama, dɩ n dam maama, dɩ n wʋbʋŋa maama, sɩ n kwǝri n ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te.»

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ, Wɛ Joro kʋm dɛɛn pɛ Zezi na wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ. O laan ma kɩ o Ko Baŋa-Wɛ le o wɩ: «A Ko, nmʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na te wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa maama tɩn. Nmʋ nan mʋ pɛ n cɩga kam sǝgi swan tiinǝ dɩ yiyiu tiinǝ tee nɩ, yɩ n daarɩ n pa balʋ na nyɩ dɩ bu-balɛ te tɩn lwarɩ ka kuri. A Ko, a kɩ nmʋ le. Nmʋ na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ n wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: «A Ko nan pɛ-nɩ dam wǝǝnu maama baŋa nɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm na yɩ wʋlʋ, kʋ na daɩ o Ko yɩranɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ dɩ nan bá wanɩ o lwarɩ a Ko Wɛ na yɩ wʋlʋ, kʋ na daɩ amʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ DƖ Bu wʋm tɩn yɩranɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ amʋ na lagɩ sɩ a pa nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama lwarɩ DƖ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: O laan ma pipiri o nii o karabiǝ bam seeni, yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ bantʋ ba yɩranɩ o wɩ: «Á jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo dɩ á yiǝ na naɩ wo-kamunnu tɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ? Bɛɛ mʋ n yǝni n karɩmɩ da?»

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «N tagɩ cɩga. Nan ta n kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ nń na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.»

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma lagɩ sɩ o pa o tɩtɩ bʋra. O ma daa bwe Zezi o wɩ: «Amʋ doŋ mʋ wɔɔ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋa o ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ mʋ zɩgɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ o nuŋi o maa ve tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Zeriko. O ma vu o maŋɩ dɩ nɔn-vɩrna. Nɔn-vɩrna bam ma zi-o ba vrɩ o gwaarʋ dɩ o wǝǝnu maama. Ba ma mag-o ba bǝri, yɩ ba daarɩ ba duri ba viiri.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: O na tigi da kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ kaanɩm tu dɩdʋa dɩ ya wʋ cwǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ o maa ve. O na maa ve tɩn, o ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋm na tigi o yigǝ nɩ. O ma ywǝri o tɔgɩ daa o kɛ.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Wɛ-digǝ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ Leviti tu tɩn dɩ maa tɔgɩ da o maa kɛa. O na yi jǝgǝ kam tɩn, o ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋm na tigǝ. O dɩ daa ma ywǝri o tɔgɩ daa o kɛ.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Samari tu wʋdoŋ dɩ dɛɛn maa wʋ bǝrǝ nɩ. O ma vu o yi nɔɔnʋ wʋm na tigi mɛ tɩn. O na nɛ-o tɩn, o ŋwaŋa ma zʋ-o.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: O ma vu o te. O ma kwe nugǝ dɩ sana o ma zarɩ o fufwǝlǝ yam, yɩ o daarɩ o vɔ-ya. O laan ma kwe-o o daŋɩ o tɩtɩ bɩnaga baŋa nɩ o ja vu nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ vǝrǝ-digǝ. Ba na yi da tɩn, o maa jɩg-o o nii lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ tɩn, bantʋ batɔ wʋnɩ, wɔɔ mʋ yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nɔn-vɩrna bam na vrɩ tɩn doŋ cɩga cɩga?»

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Karanyɩna kam ma lǝri o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ wʋm na jaanɩ o ŋwaŋa tɩn.» Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nan ve sɩ n dɩ ta n kɩ kʋntʋ.» Zezi wʋ Marɩtɩ dɩ Mari-ba sɔŋɔ nɩ

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam daa maa wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ ba veǝ. O ma vu o yi tɩʋ kʋdoŋ. Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ maa wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Marɩtɩ. O ma jeeri Zezi lanyɩranɩ ba sɔŋɔ nɩ.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Marɩtɩ nyaanɩ dɩ maa wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Mari. O ma jǝni tɩga nɩ Zezi tee nɩ, yɩ o cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm maama.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Mari na je kʋntʋ tɩn, Marɩtɩ ma tiini o cɛ tɩtʋŋa nɩ yɩ o liǝ. O ma vu Zezi te o wɩ: «A Yuutu, nii amʋ na zɩgɩ a tʋŋa a yɩranɩ, yɩ a nyaanɩ wʋm cɩm. Nmʋ yigǝ tǝrǝ na? Ta dɩd-o sɩ o zaŋɩ o wǝli-nɩ.»

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Marɩtɩ, Marɩtɩ, nmʋ na li zanzan tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ-m kʋ yaara.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋdoŋ yɩranɩ mʋ daarɩ. Mari mʋ lɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn sɩ o kɩ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o cɩ-kʋ.»

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a ta abam sɩ á loori-na Wɛ, sɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn. Beeri-na kʋlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn, sɩ á wʋ́ na. Magɩ-na boro, sɩ baá pʋrɩ ba pa abam.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Aye. Abam wʋrʋ na ba lana yɩ á ta ye sɩ á pa á biǝ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ ba na lagɩ tɩn, dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ yɩ DƖ lana DƖ dwe abam tɩn bá pa nɔɔna balʋ na loori-DƖ DƖ Joro kʋm tɩn na?» Wɔɔ dam mʋ Zezi maɩ o zǝli sʋtaana? (Matiyu

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ ciloŋ wʋm maa zɩgɩ digǝ kam wʋnɩ o ta dɩ nmʋ o wɩ: ‹Yɩ ta n jɩgɩ-nɩ n yaara, sɩ mancoŋo pɩ yɩ amʋ dɩ a biǝ maama nan tigi dɩ́ dɔ mʋ. A bá wanɩ a zaŋɩ a wǝli-m.›

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ bu yɩ o na loori-m kalǝŋǝ, nmʋ wʋ́ sɛ n pa-o bɩsankwɩa na?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam na lagɩ á warɩ Wɛ, sɩ á taá warɩ tɩntʋ doŋ: ‹Dɩbam Ko, sɩ nmʋ yɩrɩ na tiǝ dɩ zulǝ, sɩ n paarɩ ba.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Yagɩ dɩ́ lwarɩm n ma n cɛ dɩbam, nɩ dɩbam dɩ na yagɩ dɩ́ cɛ balʋ na kɩ dɩbam lwarɩm tɩn. Yɩ pa dɩ́ na maŋɩm dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa dɩ́ tʋ tɩn.› »

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ maama na loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa-o woŋo tɩn wʋ́ joŋi. Wʋlʋ maama na beeri woŋo Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn wʋ́ na-kʋ. Baá pʋrɩ ba pa wʋlʋ maama na magɩ boro tɩn.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ dɛɛn brɩ Wɛ dam Niniivi tiinǝ tee nɩ, sɩ kʋ taa yɩ maana kʋ pa-ba. Amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm dɩ wʋ́ ji maana zɩm nɔɔna bam ŋwaanɩ, nɩ kʋ dɛɛn na kɩ Zonasɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Zezi na zɩgɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kaanɩ wʋdoŋ tɔgɩ o wʋ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, o ma ta dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Kaanɩ wʋlʋ na lʋgɩ-m yɩ n ŋɔgɩ o yɩlɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ yu-yoŋo tu.»

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdʋa mʋ Zezi dɛɛn zǝli cicirǝ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ yɩra nɩ. Cicirǝ kam ya pɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋm ji mɩmaa mʋ. Ka na yagɩ o yɩra tɩn, o laan maa ŋɔɔna. Kʋ ma sʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Ba badaara maa kwaanɩ sɩ ba maŋɩ o dam dɩm ba nii, yɩ ba wɩ, o maŋɩ sɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ brɩ-ba nɩ o dam dɩm sɩɩnɩ dɩ nuŋi Wɛ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ ba wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Tɩʋ kʋlʋ paarɩ na pɔɔrɩ kuni bɩle yɩ ba jɩgɩ daanɩ tɩn, kʋ bá daanɩ kʋ cɔgɩ. Kampwara na zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ wʋ tɩn, kʋʋ́ tʋ mʋ.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Sʋtaana-pɛ dam dɩm na sɩɩnɩ dɩ pɔɔrɩ bɩle, dɩ paarɩ dɩm bá daanɩ dɩ cɔgɩ. Abam na tɛ á wɩ, kʋ yɩ Belizebuli dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ a waɩ a zǝli sʋtaana tɩn, mʋ pɛ a ta kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Kʋ na sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ amʋ jɩgɩ Belizebuli dam mʋ a maa zǝli sʋtaana, abam nɔɔna bam dɩ nan maɩ dam dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ ba maa zǝli-ya na? Abam tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam na kɩ te tɩn mʋ brɩ sɩ cɩga tǝri á tee nɩ.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: Sʋtaana-pɛ nan nyɩ dɩ nɔn-dɩdɛɛrʋ na jɩgɩ taŋa dɩ cɩna o maa yɩrɩ o sɔŋɔ te tɩn. O na yɩrɩ-kʋ tɩn, o jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm bá je.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Abam Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, á na zʋ á Wɛ-di sɩm, á lagɩ je-kamunnu mʋ sɩ á taá je yigǝ nɩ. Á na ve yaga, á lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama taa tui ba zuli abam.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna dɩdʋa ma lǝri Zezi taanɩ dɩm o wɩ: «Karanyɩna, nmʋ na jɩgɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ n ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn, n twɩ dɩbam dɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: «Cicirǝ na nuŋi nɔɔnʋ yɩra nɩ, ka laan wʋ́ vu ka beeri kapwǝrǝ yigǝ mʋ, sɩ ka lagɩ je ka sin da. Ka nan na beeri ka ga, ka laan wʋ́ ta ka wɩ: ‹Aá joori a vu a na nuŋi mɛ tɩn mʋ, a taa wʋra.›

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Ka na joori ka vu nɔɔnʋ wʋm te yɩ ka na sɩ jǝgǝ kam fɔgɩ ka kwɛ lanyɩranɩ,

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: ka laan wʋ́ joori ka vu ka lagɩ ciciri sɩrpɛ sɩlʋ na tiini sɩ yɩ balwaarʋ sɩ dwe ka tɩtɩ tɩn. Sɩ ma tɔgɩ daanɩ sɩ vu sɩ zʋʋrɩ da. Kʋntʋ, nɔɔnʋ wʋm laan wʋ́ tiini o na cam kʋ dwǝni faŋa.» Balʋ na sɛ Wɛ taanɩ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Balʋ na ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ yɩ ba sɛ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo ba dwe dɩdɩ.» Balʋ na vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn wʋ́ na bʋra na? (Matiyu

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Farizɩan tu wʋm ma na sɩ Zezi wʋ sanɩ o jɩa sɩ kʋ tɔgɩ ba cullu tɩm cwǝŋǝ. Kʋ ma sʋ-o.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Abam Farizɩan tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ dwǝ dwi maama ba zɩ ba daga dɩ, á yǝni á lɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ nyɩm tɩn á pa-DƖ. Kʋ lana. Kʋ daarɩ abam yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ cɩga tɔgɩm dɩ Wɛ sono. Kʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ á taá kɩ tɩntʋ wǝǝnu tɩm mʋ, sɩ á yɩ yagɩ Wɛ niǝ yadaara yam.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm ma tiini kʋ pɩɩnɩ daanɩ. Zezi daa ma ta o wɩ: «Zɩm nɔɔna yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ. Ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ mʋ a brɩ-ba, sɩ kʋ taa yɩ maana kʋ pa-ba. Ba nan bá na, kʋ na daɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ kɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Zonasɩ tee nɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Niniivi tiinǝ dɩ wʋ́ zaŋɩ dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ ba di zɩm nɔɔna bantʋ sarɩya, bɛŋwaanɩ Zonasɩ na ve ba te o tɔɔlɩ-ba Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam tɩn, ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ. Wʋlʋ na dwe Zonasɩ tɩn nan wʋ abam tee nɩ, yɩ á wʋ sɛ-o.» Wɛ cɩga kam na paɩ dɩbam pooni te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: «Nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ kanɩa, o bá sɛ o tarɩgɩ-ka o zɩgɩ gugoro nɩ, naa o pu-ka tɩtɔgɔ kuri nɩ. O nan wʋ́ kwe-ka o palɩ wɛɛnɩ mʋ, sɩ balʋ na zʋ digǝ kam wʋ tɩn taa naɩ pooni dɩm.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Nmʋ yiǝ mʋ nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kanɩa kalʋ na paɩ n yɩra jɩgɩ pooni te tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, n yiǝ na lana, kʋ paɩ n yɩra maama wʋ pooni wʋnɩ mʋ. N yiǝ nan na ba lana, kʋ paɩ n yɩra maama wʋ lim wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Abam yɩ jwǝǝru mʋ. Wɛ nan mʋ wʋ kɩ wǝǝnu maama wʋrʋ dɩ tɩ kwɛ na?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ abam yǝni á fɔgɩ á kɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam yibeelǝ. Kʋ nan yɩ á kwǝ-nakwa mʋ gʋ-ba.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, Farizɩan tu dɩdʋa ma bǝŋ-o, sɩ o da o vu o sɔŋɔ o di wʋdiu. O ma vu o zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm o jǝni sɩ o di.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ei! Abam Farizɩan tiinǝ na lagɩ á di wʋdiu, á yǝni á fɔgɩ á sɩn á zwɩ dɩ á kabǝli kwɛ lanyɩranɩ. Kʋ daarɩ abam tɩtɩ nan su dɩ digiru mʋ. Á wʋrʋ su dɩ ŋwɩɩnɩ dɩ wo-balwaarʋ kǝm.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Á nan maŋɩ sɩ á kwe á na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn á pa yinigǝ tiinǝ dɩ á wʋrʋ maama. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ, á kʋlʋkʋlʋ daa bá ta jɩgɩ digiru.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ á nyɩ dɩ yibeelǝ yalʋ na saarɩ ya daarɩ tɩga yɩ nɔɔna tɔgɩ ya baŋa ba kɛa yɩ ba yǝri ya ni nɩ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Á kǝm dɩm brɩ nɩ á sɛ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ á kwǝ-nakwa bam na kɩ tɩn. Bantʋ dɛɛn gʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam, yɩ abam tɩtɩ laan fɔgɩ á kwɛ ba yibeelǝ yam.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Abam na tɔgɩ á kwǝ kǝnǝ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ DƖ ye wǝǝnu maama tɩn tagɩ abam ŋwaanɩ DƖ wɩ: ‹Aá tʋŋɩ a nijoŋnǝ dɩ a tɩntʋŋna ba tee nɩ. Ba ma wʋ́ ja ba badaara ba gʋ, yɩ baá yaarɩ badaara.›

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Wɛ wʋ́ pa á na cam zanzan, nɩ kʋ yɩ abam tɩtɩ mʋ gʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ balʋ maama ba na gʋ lʋgʋ pulim nɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm tɩn,

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: kʋ na puli Abɛlɩ nɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ kweeli dɩ Zakari wʋlʋ ba na gʋ Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm dɩ DƖ di-laa kʋm tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn. A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ maama caa wʋ́ ta wʋ zɩm nɔɔna bam yuu nɩ.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ-ba, lɛɛrʋ wʋ á yuu nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ á yǝni á cɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba yɩ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam. Abam tɩtɩ wʋ sɛ sɩ á joŋi-ka, yɩ á daarɩ á wʋ pɛ balʋ na lagɩ ba joŋi-ka tɩn cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba joŋi.»

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma nuŋi jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ o viiri. Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam maa ba lagɩ o taanɩ dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ. Ba ma yaar-o dɩ bwiǝ zanzan.

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Ba maa lagɩ sɩ ba pa o ŋɔɔnɩ o tusi, sɩ ba wanɩ ba ja-o.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ kɔ-fɔrɔ zanzan ya lagɩ daanɩ Zezi tee nɩ. Ba dɛɛn yi nɔɔna mʋrrʋ mʋrrʋ mʋ. Ba tiini ba pɩɩnɩ daanɩ yɩ ba nɔnɩ daanɩ. Zezi ma puli o ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yɩ pa Farizɩan tiinǝ bam dɩ abam ba dabɩlɩ dɩm, dɩ ba na yɩ pipiri-nyɩna yɩ ba sǝgi ba kɩ wo-balwaarʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ gaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ, tɩntʋ ba jɩgɩ dɛ dɩ nɔɔna na zwɛ-tɩ. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, Wɛ ta mʋ paɩ tɩ jɩgɩ lam kʋntʋ doŋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ na yɩ abam, Wɛ tiini DƖ nii abam baŋa nɩ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á ba kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ?

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ sɩ á pa á wʋbʋŋa taa tɔgɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm mʋ. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ, Wɛ laan wʋ́ wǝli abam woŋo kʋlʋ na daarɩ tɩn.

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: A cilonnǝ-ba, a lagɩ a ta abam sɩ á yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ dɩ balʋ na waɩ ba gʋɩ á yɩra yam yɩ ba daa warɩ ba kɩ abam kʋlʋkʋlʋ ba wǝli da tɩn.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ye abam yuuywe sɩm ni na maɩ te tɩn. Á yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa jɩgɩ kuri á dwe kabǝmbǝli zanzan.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Kwe-na á jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm á yǝgi, sɩ á daarɩ á maŋɩ tɩ sǝbu kʋm á ma wǝli yinigǝ tiinǝ. Kʋntʋ mʋ á kwe á jɩjɩgɩrʋ á tiŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ, sǝbiǝ gan-lɔgɔdɩ na bá cɔgɩ mɛ tɩn. Á na tiŋi jɩjɩgɩrʋ Wɛ tee nɩ, tɩ daa bá je. Ŋwɩɩna daa bá wanɩ ba ŋɔ-tɩ, yɩ tʋa bá wanɩ ka mu-tɩ ka cɔgɩ.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ á na maŋɩ sɩ á ta kʋlʋ tɩn.» Jɩjɩgɩrʋ na bá wanɩ tɩ pa ŋwɩa te tɩn taanɩ

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Wɛ ma ta dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ joro mʋ. Tɩtɩɩ dɩntʋ wʋnɩ aá joŋi n ŋwɩa. Kʋntʋ tɩn, wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ ta te wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama n ya na jɩgɩ tɩn?»

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ maama na vɩn amʋ nabiinǝ yigǝ nɩ tɩn, amʋ dɩ wʋ́ vɩn kʋntʋ tu Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wʋ́ ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ Zwifǝ nakwa tee nɩ dɩ tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ tee nɩ dɩ dɩdɛɛra tee nɩ. Ba na kɩ abam kʋntʋ, sɩ á yɩ taá liǝ dɩ á na wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ sɩ á ma vrɩ á tɩtɩ, naa á na wʋ́ tʋlɩ taanɩ dɩm te tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A ciloŋ. Wɔɔ mʋ tiŋi amʋ sɩ a di abam taanɩ naa sɩ a maŋɩ á jɩjɩgɩrʋ a pa abam?»

english_verse: Then he said to the crowd, “Don't be greedy! Owning a lot of things won't make your life safe.”
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba maama o wɩ: «Á taá yɩrɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ wo-swǝnǝ zanzan. Nɔɔnʋ jɩjɩgɩrʋ na daga te, tɩ bá wanɩ o ŋwɩa tɩ yɩrɩ, o na maŋɩ o yɩ nadum te dɩ.»

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: O ma bʋŋɩ o wɩ: A nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ? Je daa tǝrǝ sɩ a kɩ a wʋdiiru tɩm maama da.»

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: O laan ma bʋŋɩ o wɩ: «A na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn, aá magɩ a tuli sɩm maama mʋ a dɩ tɩga nɩ, sɩ a daarɩ a lɔ tuli-zɛ, sɩ a wanɩ a pɛ a wo-vaalʋ tɩm dɩ a wǝǝnu tɩm maama a kɩ da.»

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a lagɩ a ta abam sɩ á yɩ taá jɩgɩ liǝ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa kʋlʋkʋlʋ, kʋ na yɩ á ni-wʋdiu, naa á na wʋ́ zʋ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Maanɩ-na á nii ga-punnu tɩm lam na yɩ te tɩn. Tɩntʋ nan warɩ tɩ tʋŋɩ, yɩ tɩ warɩ gwaarʋ tɩ sɔ. Nan taá ye-na nɩ, tɩntʋ jɩgɩ lam tɩ dwe Pɛ Salɔmɔn dɛɛn na maŋɩ o zʋʋrɩ gwar-ŋʋnnʋ tɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn mʋ tiini ba bʋŋɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama wʋbʋŋa. Abam Ko Wɛ nan maŋɩ DƖ ye nɩ abam maŋɩ sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm nan na bʋŋɩ o wɩ, o yuutu wʋm daanɩ zanzan yɩ o ba tui, yɩ o na jɩgɩ o donnǝ tɩntʋŋ-baara dɩ tɩntʋŋ-kaana bam o maga, o di o gaala, yɩ o nyɔ sana o bugǝ,

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Amʋ na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, á bʋŋɩ sɩ kʋ yɩ sɩ a pa nɔɔna fɔgɩ daanɩ mʋ na? Aye. A tu sɩ a pa nɔɔna pɔɔrɩ daanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Ba yuutu wʋm na joori o ba, yɩ tɩntʋŋna balʋ na zɩgɩ ba niǝ yɩ ba ba dɔ tɩn, kʋʋ́ ji wʋpolo dɩ ba. A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, ba yuutu wʋm laan wʋ́ pa ba jǝni ba di wʋdiu. O ma wʋ́ vɔ o gɔrɔ dɩ vʋa, sɩ o kwe wʋdiu kʋm o vu o zɩgɩ sɩ ba di.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: O nan na joori o ba tɩtɩɩ kʋrʋ nɩ dɩ, yɩ o tɩntʋŋna bam ta na zɩgɩ ba niǝ yɩ ba ba dɔa, kʋʋ́ ji wʋpolo dɩ ba.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Á taá ye sɩ, sɔŋɔ tu ya na lwarɩ maŋa kalʋ ŋwɩɩnʋ na lagɩ o ba tɩn, o ya bá pa ŋwɩɩnʋ wʋm na cwǝŋǝ o zʋ o ŋɔ.

english_verse: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ abam maŋɩ sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ mʋ, sɩ amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm lagɩ a ba maŋa kalʋ abam na ba tɩɩna nɩ aá ba tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma bwe Zezi o wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu, nmʋ na maŋɩ mɩmaŋa yantʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ dɩbam yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ naa nɔɔna maama ŋwaanɩ mʋ?»

english_verse: The Lord answered: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Wɔɔ mʋ yɩ tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa tɩn? O nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ o yuutu na yagɩ o tɩtʋŋa o pa-o yɩ o daarɩ o vu cwǝŋǝ tɩn. O yuutu wʋm ma lɩ-o sɩ o taa nii o donnǝ tɩntʋŋna bam baŋa nɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o taa pa-ba ba ni-wʋdiu dɛ maama.

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, o yuutu wʋm laan wʋ́ pa o taa nii o jɩjɩgɩrʋ maama baŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ yuutu wʋm laan wʋ́ joori o ba, dɛ dɩm tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm na ba jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ maŋa kalʋ o na wʋ́ ba tɩn. O yuutu wʋm na tu o pɩɩr-o kʋntʋ, o laan wʋ́ pa o na cam, yɩ o daarɩ o pa o da dɩ balʋ na vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn o na yaara zanzan.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ maama na lwarɩ o yuutu wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ sɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ o na wʋ sɛ sɩ o ja o tɩtɩ o kɩ-kʋ, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ na magɩrʋ zanzan.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ na yǝri o yuutu na lagɩ sɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ o na kɩ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ ba mag-o tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ na magɩrʋ fɩnfɩɩn mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama ba na pɛ wǝǝnu zanzan tɩn, baá bwe-o wǝǝnu zanzan bwiǝ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na joŋi wǝǝnu zanzan sɩ o taa nii-tɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ bwe-o wǝǝnu zanzan kʋ ja gaalɩ.»

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ a zʋ yaara wʋ, nɩnɛɛnɩ a na wʋ́ miisi na wʋnɩ te tɩn mʋ. A nan wʋ wʋ-cɔgɔ wʋnɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam kʋ na wʋ́ kɩ kʋ ti tɩn.

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: Kʋ na puli zɩm kʋ maa ve, sɔŋɔ dɩdʋa wʋnɩ nɔɔna banu na wʋra, baá pɔɔrɩ daanɩ batɔ dɩ bale.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ko dɩ o bu wʋ́ pɔɔrɩ daanɩ. Nu dɩ o bukɔ dɩ wʋ́ pɔɔrɩ daanɩ. Kaanɩ dɩ o barʋ nu dɩ wʋ́ pɔɔrɩ daanɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus said to all the people: As soon as you see a cloud coming up in the west, you say, “It's going to rain,” and it does.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm o wɩ: «Á na nɛ kunkwǝǝnu na wʋra tɩ zaŋa mɛ seeni dʋa na zɩgɩ da ka nɩ tɩn, á yǝni á ta lɩla sɩ dʋa lagɩ ka nɩ, yɩ kaá sɩɩnɩ ka nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ gungun-kʋrrʋ viu na wʋra kʋ fulǝ, á yǝni á wɩ lʋn-wɩa maa bɩɩna, yɩ kʋʋ́ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Abam waɩ á nii wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa á ma lwarɩ tɩga kam yibiyǝ na wʋ́ ta yɩ te tɩn. Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ á warɩ á lwarɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na wʋra tɩ kɩ lele tɩn kuri?

english_verse: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ abam ba bʋŋa, sɩ á lwarɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn sɩ á taá kɩa?

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na jaanɩ-m o vu o saŋɩ sarɩya jǝgǝ nɩ te tɩn. Abam ta na wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ á maa ve tɩn, sɩ n kwaanɩ n pa á fɔgɩ daanɩ. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, o laan wʋ́ ja nmʋ o kɩ sarɩya-diru wʋm jɩŋa nɩ. Wʋntʋ dɩ laan ma wʋ́ kɩ nmʋ o tɩntʋŋnʋ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ o kɩ nmʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta nmʋ sɩ nń ta n wʋra taan. N na wʋ ŋwɩ jɩnɩ dɩm maama n ti, ba bá yagɩ-m.»

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ maa ba Zezi te, yɩ ba ta dɩd-o Galile tiinǝ badonnǝ taanɩ. Gʋvɩrma tu Pilatɩ dɛɛn jaanɩ bantʋ o gʋ maŋa kalʋ ba na wʋra ba kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ tɩn, o pa ba jana nuŋi ka gwaanɩ dɩ vara jana.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Galile tiinǝ bantʋ na tiini ba na cam kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, á bʋŋɩ sɩ kʋ yɩ ba na tiini ba yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ ba dwe ba donnǝ bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Aye, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Abam tɩtɩ dɩ na wʋ lǝni á wʋrʋ á yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm, abam maama dɩ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus said, “What is God's kingdom like? What can I compare it with?
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta o wɩ: «Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nyɩ dɩ bɛɛ? A ma bɛɛ mʋ a maŋɩ-dɩ a brɩ abam?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Aye, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Abam tɩtɩ na wʋ lǝni á wʋrʋ á yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm, abam maama dɩ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.» Kapʋrʋ kʋlʋ na ba jaanɩ tɩn mɩmaŋa

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋa o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ mʋ wʋra. O ma jǝri kapʋrʋ o kara wʋnɩ. O ma vu sɩ o nii, oó na kʋ biǝ o gwǝri na. O ma wʋ nɛ.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm ma lǝr-o o wɩ: ‹A yuutu, yagɩ sɩ kʋ daa kɩ bɩnɩ dɩdʋa kʋ wǝli da. Aá kʋ goŋo a kaagɩ kʋ maama yɩ a kɩ pʋpɔnɔ da.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Bɩnɩ daa na yiǝ yɩ kʋ na lǝgi biǝ, kʋ lana. Kʋ nan daa ta na wʋ lǝgi, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ go-kʋ dɩ́ dɩ tɩga nɩ.› » Zezi na pɛ kaanɩ wʋdoŋ na yazurǝ ba siun dɛ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: and a woman was there who had been crippled by an evil spirit for
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, cicirǝ na jɩg-o ka yaara dɩ yawɩʋ taan bɩna fugǝ-nana, ka pa o tii mʋ, o warɩ o kwǝni wɛɛnɩ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the woman, he called her over and said, “You are now well.”
translation_verse: Zezi na nɛ-o tɩn, o ma ta dɩd-o sɩ o ba o te. O laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Kaanɩ, n nɛ bwǝlim, n sin dɩ n yaara yam.»

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Are you trying to fool someone? Won't any one of you untie your ox or donkey and lead it out to drink on a Sabbath?
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Abam yɩ pipiri-nyɩna mʋ. Abam wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ o nabɩa naa o bɩnaga yɩ o ba bwǝli-ka o ja vu sɩ ka nyɔ na siun dɛ dɩm nɩ?

english_verse: Jesus' words made his enemies ashamed. But everyone else in the crowd was happy about the wonderful things he was doing. A Mustard Seed and Yeast (Matthew
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa balʋ na vɩ-o tɩn na cavɩɩra. Kʋ daarɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan dɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ maama o na kɩ tɩn. Wɛ paarɩ dɩm na yɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, “You had better get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ Farizɩan badonnǝ tu Zezi te, yɩ ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Yagɩ yo seeni sɩ n vu jǝgǝ kadoŋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ Pɛ Erɔdɩ lagɩ sɩ o pa ba gʋ nmʋ.»

english_verse: But I am going on my way today and tomorrow and the next day. After all, Jerusalem is the place where prophets are killed. Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: A nan maŋɩ sɩ a daa kwe a cwǝŋǝ a taa kɛa zɩm dɩ jwaanɩ dɩ jwa yigǝ nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ bá wanɩ sɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu tɩn ga o ŋwɩa yɩ kʋ daɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ.

english_verse: There the ones who are now least important will be the most important, and those who are now most important will be least important. Jesus and Herod
translation_verse: Á taá ye nɩ, nɔɔna badaara zɩm na yɩ kwaga tiinǝ tɩn wʋ́ ba ba ji yigǝ tiinǝ. Badaara dɩ na maŋɩ ba yɩ yigǝ tiinǝ tɩn wʋ́ joori ba ji kwaga tiinǝ.» Zezi wʋ na cɔgɩ Zeruzalɛm tiinǝ ŋwaanɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus said to them: Go tell that fox, “I am going to force out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and three days later I'll be through.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Ve-na á ta á brɩ nasɩa kam nɩ, zɩm da yantʋ nɩ a maŋɩ sɩ a taa zǝli sʋtaana, sɩ a kwǝri a pa nɔɔna na yazurǝ. Da yatɔ dɛ nɩ, a laan wʋ́ yi a kweelim jǝgǝ.

english_verse: It is like what happens when someone plants a mustard seed in a garden. The seed grows as big as a tree, and birds nest in its branches.”
translation_verse: Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na kwe wo-duu na yɩ mɩmɩɩnʋ o vu o du o kadugǝ nɩ. Wo-duu kʋm kʋntʋ ma nuŋi, yɩ kʋ tiini kʋ ji tu-kamunu. Zunǝ laan ma ba ba sɔ ba pwǝru tiu kʋm yuu nɩ.»

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he taught the people in the towns and villages.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ o maa ve Zeruzalɛm. O na maa ve tɩn, o tʋlɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama yɩ o brɩ-ba Wɛ taanɩ.

english_verse: Do all you can to go in by the narrow door! A lot of people will try to get in, but will not be able to.
translation_verse: «Á taá cʋ á tɩtɩ sɩ á kwaanɩ á da ni dɩlʋ na pɩɩnɩ tɩn á zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋ. A lagɩ a ta abam sɩ nɔɔna zanzan wʋ́ ba ba beeri sɩ ba zʋ, yɩ ba bá wanɩ ba na cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: Once the owner of the house gets up and locks the door, you will be left standing outside. You will knock on the door and say, “Sir, open the door for us!” But the owner will answer, “I don't know a thing about you!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam na yiǝ, yɩ sɔŋɔ tu zaŋɩ o pɩ o mancoŋo, abam laan wʋ́ ba á zɩgɩ pooni nɩ á magɩ boro, yɩ á loori á wɩ: ‹Dɩ́ Yuutu, popo, pʋrɩ sɩ dɩ́ zʋ.› O laan wʋ́ lǝri o wɩ: ‹A yǝri abam na nuŋi mɛ.›

english_verse: But he will say, “I really don't know who you are! Get away from me, you evil people!”

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.
translation_verse: Taá ye-na sɩ maŋa wʋ́ ba, yɩ á dʋna wʋ́ ba ba gilimi á tɩʋ kʋm maama. Baá cɩ kʋ niǝ yam maama sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa yɩ wanɩ o nuŋi kʋ wʋnɩ,

translation_verse: Zezi ma vu o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ. O ma na balʋ na je da ba pipi tɩn. O ma puli sɩ o zǝli-ba sɩ ba nuŋi.

english_verse: He told them, “The Scriptures say, ‘My house should be a place of worship.’ But you have made it a place where robbers hide!”
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, nɩ Wɛ mʋ wɩ: ‹Amʋ digǝ kantʋ maŋɩ sɩ ka taa yɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ nɔɔna na wʋ́ ta tui ba warɩ amʋ da tɩn mʋ.› Abam nan pɛ ka ji ŋwɩɩna joro jǝgǝ.»

english_verse: Each day, Jesus kept on teaching in the temple. So the chief priests, the teachers of the Law of Moses, and some other important people tried to have him killed.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama Zezi maa wʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ o brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ taanɩ dɩm. Kʋ daarɩ Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ ba cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam dɩ tɩʋ kʋm dɩdɛɛra bam maa kwaana, sɩ ba na cwǝŋǝ ba gʋ-o.

english_verse: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.
translation_verse: Ba maa yǝri ba na wʋ́ kɩ te, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna bam maama cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: The spies said to him, “Teacher, we know you teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Bantʋ ma vu Zezi te ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩ́ ye nɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ nmʋ na yǝni n tɛ n brɩ nɔɔna tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ. Nmʋ ba pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna daanɩ dɩ n na kɩ-ba te tɩn. Nmʋ nan yǝni n brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cwǝŋǝ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus
translation_verse: Sadusɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ ba vu Zezi te. Bantʋ zaasɩm mʋ brɩ sɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɩga, o daa bá joori o bi.

english_verse: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? All seven brothers had married her.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maama barpɛ na di kaanɩ wʋm tɩn, ba laan na tu ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, bantʋ wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ ta te kaanɩ wʋm?»

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?”
translation_verse: Zan na miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o cwǝŋǝ naa nabiinǝ mʋ?»

english_verse: They talked this over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: O na bwe-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maa wʋra ba bwɛ daanɩ sɩ ba nii, ba na wʋ́ lǝr-o te tɩn. Ba laan ma wɩ: «Dɩbam na lǝri dɩ́ wɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ, o laan wʋ́ bwe dɩbam nɩ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ nan wʋ sɛ Zan taanɩ dɩm?

english_verse: And we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize. The crowd will stone us to death, because they think John was a prophet.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na wɩ, kʋ yɩ nabiinǝ mʋ pɛ-o cwǝŋǝ, nɔɔna bam maama wʋ́ dʋlɩ dɩbam dɩ kandwa mʋ ba gʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba maama paɩ sɩ Zan yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.” Renters of a Vineyard (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ, amʋ dɩ bá sɛ sɩ a ta wʋlʋ na pɛ amʋ ni sɩ a taa tʋŋɩ tɩn.» Nɔɔnʋ dɩ o gaarɩ mɩmaŋa (Matiyu

english_verse: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes, and they like to be greeted in the market. They want the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.
translation_verse: «Taá yɩrɩ-na á tɩtɩ dɩ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam. Bantʋ soe sɩ ba taa zʋʋrɩ gwar-dɩdwaarʋ ba beerǝ, sɩ nɔɔna taa nii-ba. Ba na ve yaga, ba soe sɩ nɔɔna maama taa tui ba zuli-ba. Ba na yǝni ba zʋ ba Wɛ-di sɩm, ba ta lagɩ je-kamunnu mʋ sɩ ba taa je yigǝ nɩ. Ba na ve nɔɔnʋ sɔŋɔ sɩ ba di candiǝ, kʋ yɩ je-ŋʋŋa je mʋ ba lagɩ sɩ ba taa je da.

english_verse: When it was time to harvest the crop, he sent a servant to ask the renters for his share of the grapes. But they beat up the servant and sent him away without anything.
translation_verse: Tweeru tɩm biǝ gwǝrim maŋa ma yi. O ma tʋŋɩ o tɩntʋŋnʋ sɩ o vu nɔɔna balʋ na nii o gaarɩ dɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn te, sɩ ba cɛ o tǝri ba pa-o. Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm na yi ba te tɩn, ba ma mag-o. Ba daarɩ ba pa o viiri dɩ jɩ-kʋrɩ.

english_verse: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na nɛ-o tɩn, ba ma bwɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: ‹Mʋ gaarɩ dɩm tu bu. Wʋntʋ mʋ lagɩ o ba o taa te o ko wʋm wǝǝnu tɩm. Pa-na dɩ́ gʋ-o, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ taá te o wǝǝnu tɩm.›

english_verse: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard.” When the people heard this, they said, “This must never happen!”
translation_verse: O maŋɩ sɩ o ba o gʋ-ba mʋ, sɩ o daarɩ gaarɩ dɩm o pa nɔɔna badonnǝ sɩ ba taa niǝ.» Nɔɔna bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Wɛ pa kʋ yɩ kɩ kʋntʋ!»

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses knew that Jesus was talking about them when he was telling this story. They wanted to arrest him right then, but they were afraid of the people. Paying Taxes (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ ma lwarɩ sɩ o maŋɩ mɩmaŋɩ dɩm bam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma kwaanɩ ba lagɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba ja-o lɩla. Ba maa warɩ, ba na kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Lampoo ŋwɩɩm taanɩ (Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus' enemies kept watching him closely, because they wanted to hand him over to the Roman governor. So they sent some men who pretended to be good. But they were really spies trying to catch Jesus saying something wrong.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn ma yɩrɩ Zezi, sɩ ba daa ta nii o na wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba ma lɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu Zezi te nɩnɛɛnɩ ba yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna mʋ te, sɩ ba laan kwaanɩ ba ja-o dɩ o taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: “Show me a coin.” Then he asked, “Whose picture and name are on it?” “The Emperor's,” they answered.
translation_verse: «Kwe-na sǝbu dalɩ á brɩ-nɩ. Dɩ jɩgɩ wɔɔ nyɩnyʋgʋ dɩ o yɩrɩ mʋ dɩ baŋa nɩ?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus' enemies could not catch him saying anything wrong there in front of the people. They were amazed at his answer and kept quiet. Life in the Future World (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ dɩ ba tɩn, ba maa warɩ ba ja-o nɔɔna bam maama yigǝ nɩ dɩ o na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. O na lǝri-ba te tɩn sʋ-ba zanzan yɩ ba cɩm. Wɛ-sɔŋɔ ŋwɩa na wʋ́ ta yɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: and said: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, Moyisi dɛɛn na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ o tiŋi o pa dɩbam tɩn, o brɩ sɩ, nɔɔnʋ nu-bu na tɩga yɩ o daarɩ kaanɩ, yɩ ba na wʋ lʋgɩ biǝ, tʋ wʋm cʋrʋ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ o di kaanɩ wʋm sɩ ba wanɩ ba lʋ biǝ o nu-bu wʋlʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: There were once seven brothers. The first one married, but died without having any children.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, nu-biǝ barpɛ mʋ ya wʋra. Ba dɩdʋa ma di kaanɩ yɩ o tɩ o daar-o, yɩ ba ba jɩgɩ biǝ daanɩ.

english_verse: The second one married his brother's widow, and he also died without having any children.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na saŋɩ tɩn ma di kadǝm wʋm.

english_verse: The same thing happened to the third one. Finally, all seven brothers married this woman and died without having any children.
translation_verse: O dɩ ma tɩ o daar-o. Batɔ-tu wʋm dɩ daa ma di-o. Kʋ ma kɩ ba maama kʋntʋ doŋ. Ba maama barpɛ ma tɩ, yɩ ba wʋ lʋgɩ bu dɩ kaanɩ wʋm.

english_verse: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses said, “Teacher, you have given a good answer!”
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ badonnǝ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, n tagɩ cɩga.»

english_verse: In the book of Psalms, David himself says, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right side
translation_verse: Davidi tɩtɩ nan pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ lǝŋ-ŋwɩ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ o wɩ: ‹Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tagɩ dɩ a Yuutu DƖ wɩ: Ba n jǝni a jazɩm nɩ,

english_verse: until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: sɩ aá kɩ nmʋ dʋna maama n nɛ kuri nɩ sɩ n nɔ-ba nɩ tɩga te.›

english_verse: David spoke of the Messiah as his Lord, so how can the Messiah be his son?” Jesus and the Teachers of the Law of Moses (Matthew
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, Davidi tɩtɩ na sɩɩnɩ o bǝŋi Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn nɩ o Yuutu tɩn, kʋʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ sɩ o daa joori o taa yɩ Davidi naa?» Zezi kaanɩ o karabiǝ sɩ ba yɩ lwǝni cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam (Matiyu

english_verse: While everyone was listening to Jesus, he said to his disciples:
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama ta na wʋra kʋ cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ:

english_verse: But they cheat widows out of their homes and then pray long prayers just to show off. These teachers will be punished most of all.
translation_verse: Ba nan yǝni ba ganɩ kadǝnǝ ba joŋi kʋlʋ maama ba na jɩgɩ tɩn. Ba kwǝri ba kɩ Wɛ-lor-dɩdwaarʋ, sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ nɩ ba yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna mʋ te. Wɛ wʋ́ tiini DƖ pa bantʋ na cam kʋ ja gaalɩ.»

english_verse: Before all this happens, you will be arrested and punished. You will be tried in your synagogues and put in jail. Because of me you will be placed on trial before kings and governors.
translation_verse: Kʋ na wʋ́ loori wǝǝnu tɩntʋ kǝm tɩn, nɔɔna wʋ́ ja abam dam ba pa á na yaara. Baá ja abam ba vu ba saŋɩ ba Wɛ-di sɩm nakwa tee nɩ, yɩ ba kɩ abam pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Baá ja abam ba pa á zɩgɩ pwa dɩ dɩdɛɛra yigǝ nɩ, abam na tɔgɩ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had.” The Temple Will Be Destroyed (Matthew
translation_verse: Bantʋ maama lɩ ba daarɩ mʋ. Kadǝm wʋm nan yɩ yinigǝ tu mʋ, yɩ o kwe kʋlʋ maama o na jɩgɩ sɩ o ma yǝgi o ni-wʋdiu tɩn o dɩ da.» Lɛɛrʋ na wʋ́ ba lʋgʋ baŋa te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Some people were talking about the beautiful stones used to build the temple and about the gifts that had been placed in it. Jesus said,
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɛɛn ma tɛ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm taanɩ yɩ ba wɩ: «Nii-na kandwa yam ba na mɛ ba lɔ-ka tɩn na tiini ya lana te, yɩ ba ma pɛɛra yalʋ ba na pɛ Wɛ tɩn ba ma kɩ-ka lanyɩranɩ.» Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: “Do you see these stones? The time is coming when not one of them will be left in place. They will all be knocked down.” Warning about Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: «Kʋ na yɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ á na naɩ tɩn, maŋa wʋ́ ba ba, sɩ ba dɩ tɩ maama tɩga nɩ. Kandwɛ daa bá daŋɩ dɩdoŋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Some people asked, “Teacher, when will all this happen? How can we know when these things are about to take place?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, maŋa kɔɔ mʋ kʋntʋ woŋo wʋ́ kɩ? Bɛɛ mʋ lagɩ kʋ kɩ maana kʋ brɩ dɩbam, sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ lagɩ tɩ kɩ?»

english_verse: When you hear about wars and riots, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but this isn't the end.
translation_verse: Á wʋ́ ba á ni tigurǝ dɩ jara ŋwa. Á nan yɩ pa fʋʋnɩ zʋ abam. Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama maŋɩ sɩ tɩ da yigǝ tɩ kɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋ ta daɩ lʋgʋ tiim mɩmaŋa.»

english_verse: There will be great earthquakes, and in many places people will starve to death and suffer terrible diseases. All sorts of frightening things will be seen in the sky.
translation_verse: Tɩga ma wʋ́ sisiŋi zanzan. Kana dɩ wʋ́ ba ka taa wʋ je sɩdonnǝ nɩ, yɩ yawɩ-loŋnu dɩ wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔna zanzan. Wɛ wʋ́ pa wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na brɩ DƖ dam tɩn taa kɩ wɛyuu nɩ, yɩ fʋʋnɩ wʋ́ ja nɔɔna ya ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You will be betrayed by your own parents, brothers, family, and friends. Some of you will even be killed.
translation_verse: Abam tɩtɩ kwǝ dɩ á niinǝ, dɩ á cʋrrʋ dɩ á cilonnǝ wʋ́ ja abam ba kɩ dɩdɛɛra jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ baá gʋ abam badonnǝ.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be hated by everyone.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ta culi abam á na yɩ a nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: If you are living in Judea at this time, run to the mountains. If you are in the city, leave it. And if you are out in the country, don't go back into the city.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ, abam balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Zude nɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ á kɩ lɩla á nuŋi á duri á beeri pweeru je á sǝgi da. Balʋ na wʋ tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ á nuŋi lɩla. Balʋ dɩ na wʋ ba karɩ nɩ tɩn daa yɩ ve á zʋ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ.

english_verse: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by soldiers, you will know that it will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Abam nan wʋ́ ba á na pamaŋna na gilimi Zeruzalɛm tɩʋ kʋm maama ba pu. Á na nɛ kʋntʋ, á laan wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ maŋa kam yiǝ sɩ ba cɔgɩ-kʋ.

english_verse: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children! Everywhere in the land people will suffer horribly and be punished.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ kʋʋ́ tiini kʋ taa yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ kaana balʋ na jɩgɩ pwi tɩn, dɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ biǝ yɩ ba ŋɔgɩ yɩlɩ tɩn. Yaara zanzan wʋ́ ba tɩʋ kʋntʋ dɩ kʋ nɔɔna maama baŋa nɩ, yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ kwe DƖ bam ba yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: Then Jesus told them a story: When you see a fig tree or any other tree
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma maŋɩ mɩmaŋa o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «Maanɩ-na á nii kapʋrʋ dɩ tweeru maama na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Then the Son of Man will be seen, coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ na Nabiin-bu wʋm na maa bɩɩnɩ lʋgʋ baŋa. Oó ta wʋ kunkwǝǝnu wʋnɩ o bɩɩnɩ dɩ dam, yɩ Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ wʋ o tee nɩ zanzan.

english_verse: Strange things will happen to the sun, moon, and stars. The nations on earth will be afraid of the roaring sea and tides, and they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: «Maŋa wʋ́ ba sɩ Wɛ pa wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na brɩ DƖ dam tɩn taa kɩ wɩa wʋnɩ dɩ cana dɩ calɩcwɩ sɩm wʋnɩ. Liǝ wʋ́ ja lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama, yɩ ba wʋbʋŋa vugimi dɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm na bam na pɔgɩla dɩ sɔɔ zanzan tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: People will be so frightened that they will faint because of what is happening to the world. Every power in the sky will be shaken.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ zanzan wʋ́ pa nɔɔna wʋbʋŋa je ba na bʋŋɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na bɩɩnɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ wɛyuu wʋ́ sisiŋi kʋ pa wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ tɩn maama vugimi daanɩ.

english_verse: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all of this takes place.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama wʋ́ ba wʋra tɩ kɩa, yɩ zɩm nɔɔna bam ta wʋ tɩgɩ ba ti.

english_verse: putting out leaves, you know that summer will soon come.
