translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam laan ma ja Zezi ba maa kɛa. Nɔɔna bam maama maa tɔga. Ba na maa ve tɩn, ba ma jeeri nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn. O nuŋi Sirɛɛnɩ mʋ. O dɛɛn ya nuŋi gaa mʋ o ba o yi tɩʋ wʋnɩ o maa kɛa. Pamaŋna bam ma ja-o, yɩ ba pa o zɩŋɩ dagara kam o bakalɩ nɩ o tɔgɩ Zezi kwaga.

english_verse: Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ ma pa kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ nakwa bam dɩ nɔɔna bam maama la daanɩ o tee nɩ.

english_verse: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ na lagɩ sɩ o lɩ Zezi o yagɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, o daa ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba sɛ sɩ o yagɩ Zezi.

english_verse: Pilate spoke to them a third time, “But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.”
translation_verse: O daa ta ma ta dɩ ba o kɩ bɩtɔ o wɩ: «Bɛɛ wo-lɔŋɔ mʋ o kɩa? A wʋ nɛ kʋlʋ o na kɩ o cɔgɩ pa kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ gʋ-o tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, aá pa ba mag-o, yɩ a daarɩ a yag-o.»

english_verse: He freed the man who was in jail for rioting and murder, because he was the one the crowd wanted to be set free. Then Pilate handed Jesus over for them to do what they wanted with him. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma pa ni sɩ ba lɩ Barabasɩ wʋlʋ ba na lagɩ sɩ o yagɩ o pa-ba tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ ba ya na jaanɩ ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ, o na kɩ jara dɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm dɩdɛɛra yɩ o gʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Pilatɩ ma daarɩ o kɩ Zezi pamaŋna jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba kɩ-o nɩ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn. Ba na jaanɩ Zezi ba vu ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?
translation_verse: Taá nii-na, da-lɩa na jɩgɩ mini ka di tɩntʋ tɩn, kʋ laan na yɩ da-kʋra, kaá kɩ ta?»

english_verse: Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma vu kʋ yi maŋa kam wɛ na tu dɩ yi yuparɩ baŋa tɩn. Lʋgʋ kʋm maama ma ji lim taan, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi luu batɔ.

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn ma ja nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩle ba vu sɩ ba wǝli dɩ Zezi ba gʋ.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maa zɩgɩ da ba niǝ. Zwifǝ bam nakwa bam ma kɩ-o cavɩɩra, yɩ ba mwana ba wɩ: «O yǝni o vrɩ nɔɔna ŋwɩa. O na sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na kuri tɩn, sɩ o vrɩ o tɩtɩ ŋwɩa sɩ dɩ́ nii.»

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam dɩ maa mwan-o, yɩ ba jɩgɩ sa-nywana ba suŋi o yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: Ba maa wɩ: «Nmʋ na sɩɩnɩ n yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ, sɩ n vrɩ n tɩtɩ ŋwɩa sɩ dɩ́ nii.»

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Nɔn-balɔrɔ kʋdoŋ kʋm ma kaanɩ kʋkʋm kʋm kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ ba kwarɩ Wɛ fʋʋnɩ na? Ba lagɩ ba gʋ dɩbam maama mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ nmʋ sɩ, nmʋ wʋ́ jǝni dɩ amʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ zɩm dɛ dɩm nɩ.»

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: Wɩa kam daa ba jɩgɩ pooni. Gɔrɔ kʋlʋ ba na lǝgǝ ba ma cɩ Wɛ-di-laa kam tɩn ma kaarɩ bɩle.

english_verse: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma joori ba vu sɔŋɔ. Ba ma vu ba lagɩ tralɩa nwi dwi dwi, sɩ ba ma turi Zezi yɩra yam. Ba siun dɛ dɩm nɩ ba ma sin dɩ ba tɩtʋŋa yam nɩ Wɛ cullu na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Kɔgɔ kʋlʋ maama na tu sɩ kʋ nii kǝm dɩm tɩn ma sɩɩnɩ ba na kʋ na kɩ te tɩn. Ba na ma joori sɔŋɔ tɩn, ba maa frɩ ba tɩtɩ ba veǝ, ba wʋ na cɔgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ balʋ maama na maŋɩ ba ye-o tɩn dɩ kaana balʋ ya na tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba nuŋi Galile ba ba tɩn maa zɩgɩ daa nɩ ba niǝ. Ba na kɩ Zezi bɔɔnɩ wʋnɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zʋzɛfʋ. O nuŋi Zwifǝ tɩʋ kʋdoŋ mʋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Arimatɩ. O maa yɩ Zwifǝ bam nakwa kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ. O ma kwǝri o yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm, yɩ o tɔgɩ Wɛ dɩ cɩga. Ba kɔgɔ kʋm ya na kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba ja Zezi tɩn, o wʋ sɛ ba na bʋŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ-o kʋlʋ tɩn. O maa jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋ́ ba nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ na sɛ tɩn, Zʋzɛfʋ ma vu o parɩ Zezi dagara kam yuu nɩ. Ba ma kwe gar-jalɩ ba ma pipir-o, yɩ ba daarɩ ba ja-o ba vu ba kɩ piu bɔɔnɩ wʋnɩ. Dɩntʋ yɩ bɔɔnɩ dɩlʋ ba dɛɛn na lugi-dɩ piu yɩra nɩ yɩ ba maŋɩ ba wʋ kɩ nɔɔnʋ da tɩn.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Kaana balʋ ya na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi ba nuŋi Galile tɩn dɛɛn ma da Zʋzɛfʋ kwaga, ba vu ba na bɔɔnɩ dɩm dɩ ba na tiŋi Zezi te tɩn.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Kaana bam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Mari wʋlʋ na nuŋi Magɩdala, dɩ Zannɩ, dɩ Mari wʋlʋ na yɩ Zakɩ nu tɩn, kʋ wǝli dɩ kaana balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ ba tɩn. Bantʋ maama maa wʋra ba tɛ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn ba brɩ Zezi karabiǝ fugǝ-dɩdʋa kam.

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zʋ bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋ. Ba wʋ nɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi da.

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ ma ja kaana bam. Ba ma cɔɔlɩ ba yum tɩga nɩ. Nɔɔna bam laan ma ta dɩ ba ba wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ á karɩ á beeri wʋlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn twa wʋnɩ?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: yɩ o ta o wɩ, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba ja wʋm Nabiin-bu ba kɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ, sɩ o laan joori o bi da yatɔ dɛ nɩ.»

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ dɛ dɩm nɩ mʋ Zezi karabiǝ bam bale wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ ba maa ve tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Emayusi. Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kilomɛtra fugǝ-dɩdʋa mʋ dɩ Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Zezi ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Bɛɛ woŋo mʋ abam jɩgɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ á veǝ?» Ba na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma zɩgɩ yɩ ba yigǝ nywanɩ.

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan ya jɩgɩ tɩɩna, sɩ wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na lagɩ o vrɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam o yagɩ tɩn. Dɩ kʋntʋ maama, zɩm mʋ jɩgɩ da yatɔ woŋo kʋntʋ na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm kaana badonnǝ ve o yibeeli dɩm jǝgǝ kam ba na kʋlʋ na sɔɔrɩ dɩbam yɩra. Ba ya ve tɩtɩɩtɩ mʋ,

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nɔɔna bam badonnǝ dɩ ma zaŋɩ ba vu yibeeli dɩm nɩ. Ba ma na nɩ kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kaana bam na tagɩ te tɩn mʋ, kʋ daarɩ Zezi tɩtɩ mʋ ba wʋ nɛ.»

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Á ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa na? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á warɩ á sɛ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kalʋ DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ mʋ Krisi wʋm na maŋɩ sɩ o na yaara yalʋ sɩ o daarɩ o di Wɛ-sɔŋɔ o joŋi o paarɩ tɩn na?»

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma wʋ sɛ, yɩ ba loor-o ba wɩ: «Tɩga lagɩ ka yi. Nan zʋ n pǝni dɩbam tee nɩ.» O ma sɛ yɩ o da o zʋ.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: O ma jǝni sɩ o di wʋdiu dɩ ba. O ma kwe dɩpɛ yɩ o kɩ Wɛ le dɩ ŋwaanɩ. O laan ma fɔ fɔ dɩpɛ dɩm o maŋɩ o pa-ba.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ta daanɩ ba wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ nɛ na? Dɩ́ ya na tɔgɩ daanɩ cwǝŋǝ nɩ yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o brɩ dɩbam Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wǝǝnu tɩm kuri na yɩ te tɩn, dɩ́ ya ba tiini dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋpolo na?»

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋɩ lɩla ba joori ba vu Zeruzalɛm tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Ba na yi da tɩn, ba ma na Zezi karabiǝ fugǝ-dɩdʋa kam dɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ bam na lagɩ daanɩ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa.

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: Bantʋ ma tɛ ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi sɩɩnɩ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. O tu o brɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ Simɔn mʋ.»

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bale bam dɩ ma maŋɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn ba brɩ-ba. Ba daarɩ ba maŋɩ Zezi na fɔgɩ dɩpɛ dɩm yɩ ba laan lwar-o te tɩn. Zezi na brɩ o tɩtɩ o karabiǝ bam te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Ba bɩcara ma di yɩ fʋʋnɩ ja-ba zanzan. Ba ma bʋŋɩ nɩ ba nɛ ciru mʋ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ kʋ sʋ abam kʋntʋ? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa dɩ amʋ?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ-na á nii amʋ jɩa dɩ a nɛ na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ amʋ. Taanɩ-na amʋ á nii. Ciru ba jɩgɩ ya-nwana dɩ kwi, nɩ á na naɩ amʋ na yɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma brɩ-ba o jataala dɩ o nɛ.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Kʋ na tiini kʋ jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ pa-ba tɩn, ba ta warɩ ba sɛ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga, yɩ kʋ sʋ-ba zanzan. O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Á jɩgɩ wʋdiu yo nɩ sɩ dɩ́ di na?»

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Ba ma twǝri kalǝŋ-saŋa ba pa-o.

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: O ma joŋi-ka o di ba yibiyǝ nɩ.

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: O ma ta o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «Ba pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ ba wɩ: ‹Krisi wʋm lagɩ o na yaara zanzan mʋ sɩ o tɩ, yɩ o laan wʋ́ joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ da yatɔ dɛ nɩ.›

english_verse: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: A nan wʋ́ tʋŋɩ wʋlʋ wʋm a Ko na goni ni sɩ o ba abam te tɩn, yɩ o na tuǝ, oó pa abam na dam dɩlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ te tɩn. Maŋɩ-na Zeruzalɛm nɩ, sɩ á taá cǝgǝ dam dɩlʋ a na tɛ tɩn.» Zezi na joori o vu Wɛ-sɔŋɔ te tɩn (Marɩkɩ

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: O na kɩ-ba yu-yoŋo kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma yagɩ-ba yɩ Wɛ kwe-o DƖ ja di DƖ sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Ba ma kuni doonǝ ba zul-o, yɩ ba laan daarɩ ba joori Zeruzalɛm dɩ wʋpolo zanzan.

english_verse: They spent their time in the temple, praising God.
translation_verse: Ba na wʋra tɩn, ba wʋ fɔgɩ ba kwɛ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm vǝŋǝ, yɩ ba zuli Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: O maŋɩ o wʋ Wɛ tee nɩ mʋ pulim nɩ.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Wʋm mʋ paɩ nabiinǝ na ŋwɩa. Ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ nan mʋ paɩ nabiinǝ na pooni.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Pooni dɩm kʋntʋ na tu tɩn, dɩ zǝli lim, yɩ lim daa warɩ pooni dɩm dɩ zǝli.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn tʋŋɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zan.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: O tu sɩ o ta wʋlʋ na yɩ pooni dɩm tɩn taanɩ mʋ o brɩ nɔɔna, sɩ nabiinǝ maama wanɩ ba lwar-o sɩ ba daarɩ ba sɛ-o.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn ma ba lʋgʋ baŋa o wʋra. Kʋ ya dɛ dɩ wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ kɩ lʋgʋ. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, nabiinǝ daa ta wʋ lwar-o.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: O ma ba o tɩtɩ tɩʋ, yɩ o dwi tiinǝ wʋ jeer-o lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Ba na jigi Wɛ biǝ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ na lʋrɩ te tɩn, naa nɔɔna yɩra lagɩm, naa nɔɔna wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn. Kʋ nan yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ pɛ ba ji DƖ biǝ.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Bɩtara kam dɛɛn ma ji nabiinu, yɩ o zʋʋrɩ dɩbam tɩtarɩ nɩ. Wɛ zaanɩ dɩ DƖ cɩga maama tiini ka wʋ o tee nɩ. Dɩ́ ma na o paarɩ-zulǝ na dagɩ te, o na yɩ o Ko Wɛ Bu-dʋa tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ yǝni o pa dɩbam maama na zaanɩ zanzan, o na tiini o jɩgɩ Wɛ zaanɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like. John the Baptist Tells about Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ta maŋɩ o wʋ nɛ Baŋa-Wɛ. Kʋ daarɩ DƖ Bu-dʋa kam mʋ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ-DƖ. Wʋntʋ dɩ Wɛ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. O maa wʋ o Ko Baŋa-Wɛ tɩkǝri nɩ. Zan na ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi taanɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Zan ma vɩɩrɩ o ta-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ amʋ mʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Ba ta ma joori ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ nan yɩ wɔɔ mʋ za? Nmʋ yɩ Eli mʋ na?» O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ, wʋm daɩ Eli. Ba daa ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu wʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ o ba tɩn mʋ na?» O maa wɩ: «Awo.»

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ta ba wɩ: «Nmʋ nan yɩ wɔɔ? Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ ja nmʋ na lǝri te tɩn mʋ, dɩ́ vu dɩ́ ta dɩ́ brɩ balʋ na tʋŋɩ dɩbam tɩn. Ta n brɩ dɩbam nmʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Zan ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ amʋ, a yǝni a miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ mʋ. Abam nan na zɩgɩ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋ á tɩtarɩ nɩ yɩ á yǝr-o.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ lagɩ o saŋɩ amʋ kwaga o ba, yɩ a wʋ maŋɩ sɩ a lɩ o nɛ natra dɩ.»

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Zan ma na Zezi na ve o maa bɩɩnɩ o te. O ma ta dɩ balʋ na wʋra tɩn o wɩ: «Nii-na Wɛ Pǝlbu wʋlʋ na lɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm tɩn.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: A ya tagɩ a wɩ: ‹Nɔɔnʋ wʋ́ saŋɩ amʋ kwaga o ba, yɩ o yɩ kamunu o dwe amʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o maŋɩ o wʋra yɩ amʋ yaa ta tǝrǝ.› Kʋ nan yɩ wʋntʋ taanɩ mʋ a tɛa.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Amʋ tɩtɩ dɛɛn maŋɩ a yǝri o na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ a laan ba a lwar-o. A nan tu sɩ a pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ mʋ lwar-o. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a yǝni a miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Before this I didn't know who he was. But the one who sent me to baptize with water had told me, “You will see the Spirit come down and stay on someone. Then you will know that he is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Zan daa ta ma ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi taanɩ o brɩ-ba o wɩ: «A ya yǝri Wɛ Bu wʋm na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn. Wʋlʋ nan na tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a ba a miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn tagɩ o wɩ, a na nɛ Wɛ Joro kʋm tu kʋ wʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ miisi nɔɔna Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn. A laan nan nɛ Wɛ Joro kʋm na nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ kʋ tu kʋ ba kʋ wʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ baŋa nɩ, yɩ kʋ nyɩ dɩ kunkwǝŋǝ te.

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Amʋ sɩɩnɩ a na kʋlʋ Wɛ na tagɩ tɩn, yɩ a lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ abam sɩ wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm.» Zezi na dɛ yigǝ o bǝŋi o karabiǝ balʋ tɩn

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Zan dɩ o karabiǝ bale daa ta maa wʋra.

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: Zan ma na Zezi na ve o maa kɛa. O ma ta o wɩ: «Nii-na Wɛ Pǝlbu wʋm.»

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Zan karabiǝ bale bam ma ni o na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba ma pɛ Zezi kwaga ba pu.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma pipiri o nii o na ba na tɔg-o tɩn. O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Abam beeri bɛɛ mʋ?» Ba ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Rabi, nmʋ zʋʋrɩ yǝn mʋ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Ba-na sɩ á wʋ́ na.» Ba ma tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba vu ba na o na zʋʋrɩ mɛ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ dɩdaan-ni nɩ mʋ. Ba ma maŋɩ o tee nɩ ba tʋ wɛ.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bale balʋ na ni Zan na tagɩ Zezi taanɩ dɩm te yɩ ba daarɩ ba tɔg-o tɩn dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Andre. O yɩ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ nyaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Ba na joori tɩn, Andre ma kɩ lɩla o vu o zɩmbaarʋ Simɔn te, o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Dɩbam nɛ Mesi wʋm.»

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: O laan ma ja-o o vu Zezi te. Zezi ma nii o yibiyǝ nɩ yɩ o wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ Zan bu tɩn mʋ. Nmʋ yɩrɩ laan wʋ́ ta yɩ Sɩfasɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Nathanael asked, “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Philip answered, “Come and see.”
translation_verse: Natanayɛlɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Wo-laa kʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ nuŋi Nazarɛtɩ na?» Filipi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Ba sɩ n na.»

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Ba na maa ve tɩn, Zezi ma na Natanayɛlɩ na maa bɩɩnɩ o te. O ma ta o taanɩ o wɩ: «Wʋntʋ sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tu mʋ cɩga cɩga, o wʋ lana.»

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanayɛlɩ ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ kɩ ta mʋ n ye amʋ?» O ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A ya nɛ nmʋ maŋa kam n na wʋ kapʋrʋ kʋm kuri nɩ kʋ loori Filipi na bǝŋi nmʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanayɛlɩ ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Karanyɩna, nmʋ yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu mʋ, yɩ n ta yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ pɛ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ na sɛ amʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ a na tagɩ a wɩ, a ya nɛ nmʋ kapʋrʋ kʋm kuri nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nmʋ nan wʋ́ na wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na tiini ya dana ya dwe kʋntʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: I tell you for certain you will see heaven open and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of Man.”
translation_verse: O laan ma ta o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam wʋ́ ba á na wɛyuu na pʋrɩ, yɩ Wɛ malɛsɩ tɔgɩ da sɩ diinǝ yɩ sɩ tuǝ Nabiin-bu wʋm baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Da yale dɛɛn na kɛ tɩn, ba maa wʋra ba kɩ kadiri candiǝ Galile tɩʋ kʋdoŋ nɩ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Kana. Zezi nu maa tɔgɩ o wʋra.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn bǝŋi Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam kadiri candiǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «A nu, nmʋ lagɩ n brɩ-nɩ a na wʋ́ kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn na? A maŋa kam daa ta wʋ yi.»

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: O nu wʋm laan ma ta dɩ wʋdi-maŋna bam o wɩ: «O na tagɩ kʋlʋ maama dɩ abam, sɩ á kɩ.»

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Kandwa kambi-zɛ sɩrdʋ dɛɛn maa zɩgɩ da. Sɩ dɩdʋa maama jɩgɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ litra fusɩrdʋ naa bi mʋ. Sɩ dɛɛn zɩgɩ da sɩ nɔɔna ta maa sɩn ba jɩa dɩ ba zwɩ mʋ, nɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ wʋdi-maŋna bam sɩ ba mɔ na ba su kambi sɩm ni. Ba ma mɔ na ba su sɩ ni ba pɛɛlɩ.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: O daa ma ta-ba o wɩ, ba laan mɔ na bam ba vu ba pa wʋlʋ na nii candiǝ kam wǝǝnu tɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn. Ba ma mɔ ba pa-o.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: O ma nyɔ na bam, dɩdaanɩ ba maŋɩ ba ji tweeru biǝ sana. O ma wʋ lwarɩ sana kam kʋntʋ na nuŋi mɛ, yɩ wʋdi-maŋna balʋ na mɔɔnɩ na bam tɩn nan ye. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na nii candiǝ kam baŋa nɩ tɩn laan ma bǝŋi kan-barʋ wʋm o ta dɩd-o o wɩ:

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: «Nɔɔnʋ maama yǝni o pa sa-ŋʋŋa mʋ yigǝ yɩ ba nyɔ. Ba laan na yǝni ba nyɔ ba su, o ma pa-ba sana kalʋ na ba tiini ka ywǝnǝ tɩn yɩ ba nyɔ. Nmʋ nan kwe sa-ŋʋŋa kam mʋ n zɩgɩ, yɩ n laan ba n kwe-ka n pa dɩbam kʋ kwaga nɩ.»

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Zezi nan ya na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-digǝ kam taanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ o tɩtɩ yɩra yam taanɩ mʋ o taga.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn ma daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ Zwifǝ bam di ba candiǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Pakɩ tɩn. Zezi ma zaŋɩ o vu Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: O ma kwe ŋʋnɩ o ma kɩ balaarɩ o zǝli peeni sɩm dɩ naanɩ dɩm maama, o pa dɩ nuŋi. O ma daarɩ o yigi sǝbu-lǝnnǝ bam taabʋllʋ tɩm o dɩ tɩga nɩ, o pa ba sǝbu kʋm jagɩ.

english_verse: “Destroy this temple,” Jesus answered, “and in three days I will build it again!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam na magɩ Wɛ-digǝ kantʋ maama á dɩ tɩga nɩ, amʋ wʋ́ ma da yatɔ mʋ a joori a lɔ-ka a zɩgɩ.»

english_verse: years to build this temple. What makes you think you can rebuild it in three days?”
translation_verse: ) ba ma lɔ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋntʋ ba ti. Nmʋ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ n ma da yatɔ yɩranɩ n joori n lɔ-ka n zɩgɩ?»

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: O na yi da tɩn, o ma vu Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm nɩ. O ma na nɔɔna na jɩgɩ naanɩ dɩ peeni dɩ kunkwǝn-pulǝ ba yǝgǝ ka kʋnkɔlɔ kʋm nɩ. Sǝbu-lǝnnǝ dɩ maa je da ba lǝni ba sǝbiǝ.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o ta nɔɔna balʋ dɩ na jɩgɩ kunkwǝn-pulǝ bam ba yǝgi tɩn o wɩ: «Ja-na-ba á ja nuŋi yo. Á yɩ zaŋɩ á pa a Ko Wɛ digǝ kam taa yɩ pipiu jǝgǝ.»

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam laan ma bwe Zezi ba wɩ: «Wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɔɔ nmʋ wʋ́ kɩ, sɩ kʋ pa dɩbam lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ jɩgɩ ni sɩ n zǝli nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn na tu kʋ yi maŋa kam Zezi na tɩgɩ yɩ o joori o bi tɩn, o karabiǝ bam ma guli o dɛɛn na tagɩ te tɩn. Ba ma sɛ kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, dɩ Zezi na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ Pakɩ candiǝ kam maŋa nɩ tɩn, nɔɔna zanzan ma na wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ o na kɩ tɩn, yɩ ba laan sɛ-o.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn nan wʋ pɛ-ba o wʋ maama, bɛŋwaanɩ o ye nɔɔnʋ maama na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: O maa ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ brɩ-o nabiinǝ na yɩ te tɩn, o na maŋɩ o ye kʋlʋ na wʋ nabiinu maama bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Nikodɛm. O nuŋi Farizɩan tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ. O maa tɔgɩ o yɩ Zwifǝ bam yigǝ tu dɩdʋa.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ nmʋ sɩ, ba na wʋ joori ba lʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu bá wanɩ o na Wɛ paarɩ dɩm na yɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ nmʋ sɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ Wɛ na wʋ mɛ na dɩ DƖ Joro kʋm DƖ pa o na lʋr-dʋŋa tɩn, kʋntʋ tu bá wanɩ o zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nabiinǝ na lʋgɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa ŋwɩa mʋ o jɩga. Kʋ daarɩ, Wɛ Joro kʋm na lʋgɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm ŋwɩa mʋ o jɩga.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Yɩ pa kʋ sʋ-m dɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba joori ba lʋ abam tɩn.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ viu, kʋ yǝni kʋ dʋlɩ mɛ dɩ mɛ kʋ na lagɩ tɩn mʋ. N yǝni n ni kʋ sɔɔ kʋm, yɩ n yǝri kʋ na nuŋi mɛ dɩ kʋ na maa ve mɛ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ wʋlʋ maama ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn.»

english_verse: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
translation_verse: Nikodɛm ma bwe o wɩ: «Kʋʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Zwifǝ bam karanyɩna mʋ, yɩ n daa n ta yǝri wǝǝnu tɩntʋ?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ nmʋ sɩ, dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ tɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ dɩ́ na ye tɩn mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ dɩ́ na nɛ tɩn dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, á ta ba sɛ dɩbam taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: A na tɛ lʋgʋ kʋntʋ baŋa wǝǝnu taanɩ a brɩ abam yɩ á ba sɛ a ni tɩn, a laan na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu a brɩ abam, á wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ á sɛ a ni?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na diini Wɛ-sɔŋɔ, kʋ na daɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm na zɩgɩ da o tu tɩn yɩranɩ.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Nɩ Moyisi dɛɛn na zǝŋi can-na bɩsankwɩa kam o palɩ daa yuu nɩ kagʋa kam wʋnɩ te tɩn, ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba kwe Nabiin-bu wʋm dɩ ba zǝŋi wɛyuu nɩ kʋntʋ mʋ,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ na tiini DƖ soe nabiinǝ tɩn mʋ pɛ DƖ tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu-dʋa sɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa, sɩ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn daa yɩ cɔgɩ, sɩ o na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Wɛ na tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu wʋm sɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ o di nabiinǝ taanɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ-ba, kʋ nan yɩ sɩ o vrɩ-ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ mʋ o yagɩ.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, ba daa bá di o taanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ maama na wʋ sɛ-o tɩn maŋɩ o ga bʋra mʋ, o na vɩn sɩ o sɛ Wɛ Bu-dʋa kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Wɛ na di nabiinǝ taanɩ te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Wɛ pɛ wʋlʋ na yɩ pooni tɩn mʋ ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Nabiinǝ nan soe lim ba dwe pooni dɩm ba tɩtʋŋ-balwaarʋ tɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn culi pooni dɩm mʋ, o bá sɛ sɩ o nuŋi dɩ yigǝ nɩ, sɩ o wo-balwaarʋ tɩm wʋ́ jalɩ jaja.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ tɩn wʋ́ nuŋi pooni dɩm yigǝ mʋ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ o tɩtʋŋa maama tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa mʋ. Zan daa na ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi taanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam ma vu ba beeri Zude tɩ-balwa bam wʋnɩ. Ba ma daanɩ jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ, yɩ o miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Zan karabiǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ Zwifu wʋdoŋ, dɩ nɔɔna na maŋɩ sɩ ba zarɩ ba tɩtɩ te sɩ kʋ tɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm cwǝŋǝ tɩn.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ba ma vu Zan te ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩ́ nɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ dɛɛn na wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ yɩ n wʋ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam bubɛ dɩdoŋ dɩm nɩ tɩn. Nmʋ tagɩ o taanɩ n brɩ dɩbam. Lele kʋntʋ, o laan wʋra o miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ, yɩ nɔɔna zanzan tiini ba ve o te ba daarɩ dɩbam.»

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Zan ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ ba cɔga. Nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o na woŋo, yɩ kʋ na daɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o-kʋ.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Abam tɩtɩ maŋɩ á yɩ amʋ maana tiinǝ dɩ a na tagɩ a wɩ, amʋ daɩ Krisi wʋm, sɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a tɔgɩ Krisi wʋm yigǝ a ba.

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na di kaanɩ te tɩn mʋ, kʋ yɩ kan-barʋ wʋm tɩtɩ mʋ te kaanɩ wʋm. Ka-yiginu wʋm maa zɩgɩ daa nɩ yɩ o cǝgǝ. O na nɛ nɩ kan-barʋ wʋm jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ o kaanɩ wʋm, o dɩ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Kʋntʋ, a dɩ jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ o ji nɔn-kamunu mʋ, sɩ amʋ joori a ji nɔn-balaŋa.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ te tɩn mʋ yɩ nɔn-kamunu o dwe nɔɔnʋ maama. Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ na nuŋi lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn yɩ lʋgʋ nyɩm mʋ. O ni-taanɩ dɩ maa yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm. Wʋlʋ nan na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ tɩn mʋ dwe maama.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: O yǝni o tɛ kʋlʋ o na niǝ yɩ o kwǝri o na tɩn mʋ o brɩ nɔɔna. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, nɔɔna ta ba sɛ o zaasɩm dɩm.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na sɛ o zaasɩm dɩm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu sɩɩnɩ o brɩ nɩ Wɛ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, kʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn, Wɛ pɛ-o DƖ Joro kʋm kʋ tiini kʋ ja gaalɩ, yɩ kʋ paɩ o tɛ Wɛ tɩtɩ ni-taanɩ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Ko Baŋa-Wɛ soe DƖ Bu wʋm yɩ DƖ pa-o dam woŋo maama baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na vɩn Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn bá fɔgɩ o na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ nan wʋ́ ta wʋ o yuu nɩ.»

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: O na maa ve kʋntʋ tɩn, o maŋɩ sɩ o tɔgɩ Samari wʋnɩ mʋ o kɛ.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma ta dɩ Zezi o wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Zwifu mʋ, yɩ amʋ yɩ Samari tu. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n ta n wɩ, a kɩ na a pa-m?» Kaanɩ wʋm tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Zwifǝ bam dɩ Samari tiinǝ dɛɛn warɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A tu, nmʋ ba jɩgɩ goŋo yɩ vʋlɩ dɩm luunǝ. Nmʋ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ n mɔ na balʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Dɩbam nabaarʋ Zakɔbɩ mʋ kʋgɩ vʋlɩ dɩntʋ o pa dɩbam. Wʋntʋ tɩtɩ dɩ o biǝ dɩ o vara maama dɛɛn mɔɔnɩ na yo mʋ faŋa faŋa ba nyɔa. Nmʋ nan bʋŋɩ n paɩ n dwe Zakɔbɩ mʋ naa?»

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ na balʋ amʋ na wʋ́ pa tɩn, na-nyɔm daa bá ja wʋlʋ na nyɔgɩ-ba tɩn. Na balʋ a na wʋ́ pa tɩn wʋ́ ji nɩnɛɛnɩ buli-yi mʋ te o wʋnɩ, yɩ dɩ wʋ́ ta burǝ na balʋ na paɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm daa ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A tu, nan pa-nɩ na bam kʋntʋ, sɩ na-nyɔm daa yɩ ja-nɩ sɩ a taa tui yo a mɔɔnɩ na.»

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ ya n zʋ banna banu mʋ, yɩ nmʋ na wʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ tee nɩ lele kʋntʋ tɩn daɩ n barʋ. Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ n tagɩ n brɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A tu, amʋ lwarɩ nɩ n yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Dɩbam Samari tiinǝ nabaara bam dɛɛn tui piu kʋntʋ yuu mʋ ba zuli Wɛ. Kʋ daarɩ abam Zwifǝ bam brɩ nɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔna taa zuli Wɛ Zeruzalɛm nɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Kaanɩ, sɛ a taanɩ dɩm. Maŋa wʋ́ ba, yɩ abam daa bá ta ve piu kʋntʋ yuu naa Zeruzalɛm sɩ á zuli dɩ́ Ko Wɛ da.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Abam Samari tiinǝ yǝri wʋlʋ á na zuli tɩn. Dɩbam Zwifǝ bam nan ye wʋlʋ dɩ́ na zuli tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ tɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam jɩŋa mʋ DƖ vrɩ nabiinǝ ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa maa bɩɩnɩ lele kʋntʋ, yɩ balʋ na sɩɩnɩ ba zuli dɩ́ Ko Wɛ cɩga tɩn, baá zuli-DƖ dɩ Wɛ Joro dam dɩ cɩga. Mʋ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ nabiinǝ taa zuli-DƖ te tɩn.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Wɛ yɩ joro mʋ. Balʋ maama na lagɩ ba zuli-DƖ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba zuli-DƖ dɩ Wɛ Joro dam dɩ cɩga mʋ.»

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ ye sɩ Mesi wʋlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Krisi tɩn wʋ́ ba. O nan na tuǝ, oó ta Wɛ cɩga kam maama o brɩ dɩbam.»

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ amʋ mʋ kʋntʋ, a zɩgɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nmʋ.»

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam laan ma joori ba ba. Ba na nɛ Zezi na zɩgɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kaanɩ wʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-ba. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ nan wʋ bwe o nii, «bɛɛ mʋ o laga?» naa, «bɛɛ mʋ yɩ Zezi ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kaanɩ wʋm?»

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm laan ma yagɩ o kɔɔrʋ wʋm, yɩ o daarɩ o vu tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. O na yi da tɩn, o ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ:

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: «Ba-na á nii nɔɔnʋ, o na tagɩ amʋ na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn o brɩ-nɩ. A yǝri wʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn naa?»

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam ma ta dɩd-o sɩ o di wʋdiu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A maŋɩ a jɩgɩ wʋdiu. Abam nan yǝri kʋ na yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam laan ma bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ mʋ nan ga jaanɩ wʋdiu o ba o pa-o naa?»

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ wʋdiu kʋm yɩ sɩ a tɔgɩ wʋlʋ wʋm na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa mʋ, sɩ a tʋŋɩ o tɩtʋŋa yam a ti.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á tɛ nɩ: ‹Kʋ daarɩ canɩ sɩna mʋ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ faa.› Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam sɩ á fɔgɩ á nii karɩ sɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Faa kʋm bɩga, kʋ laan daarɩ zagɩm mʋ.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam yiǝ, sɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ faa kʋm tɩn joŋi o ŋwɩɩrʋ. Faa kʋm nyɩ dɩ nɔɔna balʋ Wɛ na vrɩ DƖ pa ba na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn mʋ, sɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na dugi tɩn dɩ wʋlʋ na zagɩ tɩn maama wǝli daanɩ ba na wʋpolo.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Taanɩ dɩntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ: ‹Nɔɔnʋ mʋ dugǝ, yɩ wʋdoŋ zagɩ.›

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samari tiinǝ kaanɩ wʋm dɛɛn na tagɩ o brɩ o tɩʋ kʋm tiinǝ nɩ Zezi tagɩ wʋm na kɩ kʋlʋ maama o brɩ-o tɩn, kʋ ma pa Samari tiinǝ zanzan kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Samari tiinǝ bam ma vu Zezi te, ba loor-o sɩ o maŋɩ ba tee nɩ. O ma kɩ da yale dɩ ba.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan daa ta ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o o ni-taanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ma ta dɩ kaanɩ wʋm ba wɩ: «Dɩbam laan kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, yɩ kʋ daa daɩ nmʋ na tagɩ kʋlʋ n brɩ dɩbam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩbam tɩtɩ ni o taanɩ dɩm, yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ wʋntʋ mʋ sɩɩnɩ o yɩ wʋlʋ na vrɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm wʋnɩ tɩn.» Zezi na pɛ dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋdoŋ bu na yazurǝ te tɩn

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Zezi tɩtɩ dɛɛn mʋ tagɩ o wɩ, ba ba nɩgɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu o tɩtɩ tɩʋ nɩ.

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Zezi nan na ve o yi Galile tɩn, nɔɔna ma jeer-o lanyɩranɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba ya na ve Zeruzalɛm sɩ ba di Pakɩ candiǝ kam tɩn, ba nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ maama o na kɩ da tɩn.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma joori o vu Kana, Galile tɩʋ nɩ. Kʋ yɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ o ya na pɛ na bam ji tweeru biǝ sana tɩn mʋ. Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋdoŋ maa wʋ Kapɛrnawum nɩ, yɩ o bu ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: O na lwarɩ nɩ Zezi nuŋi Zude nɩ o ba Galile tɩn, o ma zaŋɩ o vu o te, o loor-o sɩ o vu Kapɛrnawum o pa o bu wʋm na yazurǝ, o na lagɩ o tɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Abam na wʋ nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na brɩ nɩ Wɛ tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn, abam bá fɔgɩ á sɛ amʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ve sɔŋɔ, sɩ n bu wʋm daa bá tɩ.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi na tagɩ te tɩn, yɩ o zaŋɩ o viiri.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: O ta na wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ o maa ve sɔŋɔ tɩn, mʋ o tɩntʋŋna tu ba jeer-o, yɩ ba ta ba wɩ: «N bu wʋm nɛ yazurǝ.»

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: O ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Maŋa kɔɔ mʋ kʋ garɩ bu wʋm yɩra nɩ?» Ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ diin, wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ mʋ, o paa kam yag-o.»

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma guli nɩ kʋ yɩ maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔ́ɔ mʋ Zezi tagɩ o wɩ, o bu wʋm daa bá tɩ. O dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama laan ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Mʋ Zezi na kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩlʋ, o kɩ kuni bɩle Galile nɩ, o na nuŋi Zude o joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ Zezi ma zaŋɩ o vu Zeruzalɛm, sɩ o tɔgɩ o di Zwifǝ bam candiǝ kadoŋ.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Bugǝ kadoŋ mʋ wʋra, ka na batwarɩ dɩ tɩʋ kʋm ni dɩlʋ peeni na tɔgɩ da tɩn. Ka yɩrɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam taanɩ mʋ yɩ Betizata. Ba dɛɛn te pwe sɩnu mʋ ka ni nɩ.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn ma wʋra, o na ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ kʋ yi nɩ bɩna fiintɔ nana (

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Abam wʋ joŋi DƖ taanɩ dɩm á kɩ á wʋ nɩ. Á na wʋ sɛ wʋlʋ wʋm DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ brɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Zezi ma na o na tigi da tɩn, yɩ o lwarɩ nɩ o ya maŋɩ o ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ kʋ daanɩ. O ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm o wɩ: «Nmʋ lagɩ sɩ n na yazurǝ na?»

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Yawɩɩnʋ wʋm ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A tu, bugǝ kam na bam na yǝni ba pɔgɩlɩ, a ba jɩgɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ kwe-nɩ o ja tu na bam wʋnɩ tɩn. A na yǝni a kwaanɩ sɩ a tu, nɔɔnʋ mʋ wʋ́ tu o loori amʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ, sɩ n kwe n sara kam n ta n veǝ.»

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma sɩɩnɩ o na yazurǝ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ, yɩ o zaŋɩ o kwe o sara kam o veǝ. Kʋ yɩ Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ nɩ mʋ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam ma ta dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba wɩ: «Zɩm yɩ dɩbam siun dɛ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ culǝ sɩ n ta n ze n sara kam.»

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na pɛ amʋ na yazurǝ tɩn mʋ tagɩ o wɩ, a kwe a sara kam a taa veǝ.»

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ, yɩ o wɩ n kwe n sara kam n ta n veǝ?»

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: O maa daa yǝri wʋlʋ na pɛ o na yazurǝ yam tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi zʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ yɩ o daa wʋ nɛ-o.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn tɩn, Zezi ma vu o jeer-o Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ. O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nii, nmʋ laan nɛ yazurǝ. Nan daa n yɩ kɩ lwarɩm, sɩ wo-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na dwe kʋntʋ tɩn daa yɩ kɩ-m.»

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm laan ma vu o ta dɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ Zezi ya mʋ pɛ a na yazurǝ.» Zezi na jɩgɩ dam te tɩn

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn maa wʋra ba yaarɩ Zezi, dɩ o na pɛ yawɩɩnʋ wʋm na yazurǝ ba siun dɛ dɩm nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A Ko Wɛ yǝni DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn mʋ maŋa maama. Amʋ dɩ nan kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.»

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam laan tiini ba bʋŋɩ o gʋm. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ ba na wɩ o cɔgɩ ba siun dɛ cullu tɩm tɩn má ŋwaanɩ, kʋ yɩ o na tagɩ o wɩ Wɛ yɩ o tɩtɩ Ko tɩn mʋ. O taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ o dɩ Wɛ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, amʋ na yɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, a bá wanɩ a kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ a tɩtɩ nɩ, kʋ na daɩ kʋlʋ a na nɛ a Ko Wɛ na kɩ tɩn. A Ko na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ amʋ dɩ wʋ́ kɩ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ soe DƖ Bu wʋm yɩ DƖ maa brɩ-o kʋlʋ maama DƖ tɩtɩ na kɩ tɩn. DƖ nan wʋ́ brɩ-o wo-kamunnu tɩlʋ na dwe tɩntʋ tɩn sɩ o kɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ sʋ abam.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Baŋa-Wɛ na bi nɔɔna DƖ pa ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ yɩ DƖ pa-ba ŋwɩ-dʋŋa te tɩn, DƖ Bu wʋm dɩ wʋ́ pa balʋ o na lagɩ tɩn na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ tɩtɩ bá di nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ taanɩ. DƖ nan pɛ DƖ Bu wʋm ni sɩ o di nabiinǝ maama taanɩ.

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna maama zuli Wɛ Bu wʋm, nɩ ba na zuli o Ko Wɛ te tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na ba zuli Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, o ba zuli o Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na tʋŋ-o tɩn dɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wʋlʋ maama na ni a taanɩ dɩm yɩ o daarɩ o kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Ba daa bá di o taanɩ. Kʋntʋ tu nuŋi tʋʋnɩ wʋnɩ mʋ, o zʋ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga dɩ abam sɩ, maŋa maa bɩɩna lele kʋntʋ, yɩ balʋ na ba jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ni amʋ Wɛ Bu wʋm kwǝrǝ. Balʋ na sɛ-ka tɩn wʋ́ na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Wɛ na yɩ ŋwɩa tu tɩn, mʋ DƖ pɛ wʋlʋ na yɩ DƖ Bu wʋm tɩn dɩ ji ŋwɩa tu.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: DƖ ma kwǝri DƖ pa-o ni sɩ o di nabiinǝ taanɩ, o na yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Yɩ pa-na kʋ sʋ abam dɩ a na tagɩ woŋo kʋlʋ tɩn. Maŋa maa bɩɩna, yɩ balʋ maama na tɩgɩ tɩn wʋ́ ni amʋ kwǝrǝ,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: yɩ ba nuŋi ba yibeelǝ wʋnɩ. Balʋ maama na kɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn wʋ́ bi ba taa ŋwɩ Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ balʋ maama na kɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩn wʋ́ bi, yɩ ba di ba taanɩ, yɩ ba na cam.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: A bá wanɩ a kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ amʋ tɩtɩ nɩ. Amʋ tɔgɩ a Ko ni mʋ a maa di nabiinǝ taanɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ amʋ sarɩya dim dɩm yɔɔrɩ dɩ yɩ cɩga mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ba kwaanɩ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ amʋ tɩtɩ na lagɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ na lagɩ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ nan mʋ zɩgɩ amʋ cɩga kam kwaga nɩ, kʋ yɩ amʋ Ko Wɛ mʋ, yɩ a ye nɩ wʋntʋ jɩgɩ cɩga dɩ o na tɛ amʋ taanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Abam ya tʋŋɩ nɔɔna Zan tee nɩ yɩ o ta amʋ cɩga o brɩ-ba.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ, a ya ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ pa amʋ cɩga kam maana. A nan tagɩ Zan taanɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ wǝli abam sɩ á na vrɩm lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Zan dɛɛn nyɩ dɩ kanɩa mini na tiini dɩ jɩgɩ pooni te tɩn mʋ. Abam ma sɛ sɩ á tɔgɩ o taanɩ dɩm dɩ wʋpolo maŋa fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ, yɩ á laan kwe á yagɩ.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: A nan jɩgɩ maana yalʋ na daga ya dwe Zan na pɛ yalʋ tɩn. Tɩtʋŋa yam a Ko Wɛ na pɛ-nɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩn, yantʋ mʋ a jɩgɩ a tʋŋa, yɩ yantʋ mʋ pa-nɩ cɩga nɩ Wɛ mʋ sɩɩnɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: A Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn zɩgɩ a cɩga kam kwaga nɩ. Abam nan maŋɩ á wʋ cǝgi DƖ kwǝrǝ, naa á na DƖ na nyɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á kwaanɩ á zaasɩ Wɛ twaanʋ tɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ á bʋŋɩ nɩ tɩntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ á wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Kʋ nan yɩ amʋ taanɩ mʋ twaanʋ tɩm kʋntʋ tɛa.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: A nan ba bʋŋɩ sɩ nabiinǝ ta pa amʋ zulǝ.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ abam, amʋ ye á wʋrʋ. A ye nɩ Wɛ sono tǝri á bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jaanɩ a Ko yɩrɩ mʋ a ba, yɩ abam vɩn sɩ á jeeri-nɩ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na jaanɩ o tɩtɩ yɩrɩ o ba, á wʋ́ jeeri kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Abam nan lagɩ sɩ á taá joŋi zulǝ mʋ da-tee nɩ, yɩ á ba lagɩ sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa á na zulǝ Wɛ dɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ doŋ tɩn tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ á warɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ.

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Á yɩ taá bʋŋɩ nɩ, amʋ mʋ wʋ́ vɩn abam bʋra a Ko Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ yɩ Moyisi wʋm abam ya na bʋŋɩ sɩ á wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ o ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ wʋ́ vɩn abam bʋra.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Abam ya na sɩɩnɩ á sɛ Moyisi na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, á ya wʋ́ sɛ amʋ dɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ wʋntʋ pʋpʋnɩ amʋ taanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ á wʋ sɛ o na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, á nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ á sɛ amʋ na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn?»

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Ba ma twɛ tɩ maama ba su tɩtwarʋ fugǝ-tɩle. Dɩpwa yanu yam ba na di ba daarɩ tɩn cicwǝǝru yɩranɩ mʋ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Ba ma bʋŋɩ sɩ ba pa Zezi zʋ naboro kʋm, dɩ ba dɛ ba yi buburu ni, jǝgǝ kalʋ ba ya na maa ve tɩn. Zezi mʋ paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Ba ma ta bwe-o ba wɩ: «Wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɔɔ mʋ nmʋ wʋ́ kɩ, sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ mʋ sɩɩnɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ nmʋ, sɩ dɩ́ laan sɛ-m? Nmʋ wʋ́ kɩ bɛɛ mʋ n brɩ dɩbam?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ba amʋ te, kʋ na daɩ a Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn mʋ vaŋɩ kʋntʋ tu jɩŋa sɩ o ba amʋ te. Amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu joori o bi lʋgʋ tiim dɛ dɩm nɩ.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: «Nii, bu wʋdoŋ mʋ wʋ yo seeni, o jɩgɩ dɩpwa yanu dɩ kalǝŋ-balɛ sɩle. Kʋ nan bá wanɩ kʋ yi nɔɔna bantʋ maama dim.»

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: Ba ma zʋ naboro ba tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ ba maa ve Kapɛrnawum. Tɩga maa tiini ka yi, yɩ Zezi daa ta wʋ tu ba te.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ zanzan maa tɔgɩ o kwaga, bɛŋwaanɩ ba nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ o na kɩ o pa yawɩɩna na yazurǝ tɩn.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn twɛ sɩ Zwifǝ bam di ba candiǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Pakɩ tɩn. Zezi ma vu o di piu yuu o jǝni da dɩ o karabiǝ bam.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Filipi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Dɩ́ na lagɩ dɩ́ yǝgi dɩpɛ sɩ nɔɔnʋ maama na fɩnfɩɩn o di, kʋ sǝbu kʋm wʋ́ dwǝni sǝbu-dala biǝ-yale (

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam dɩdʋa, Andre wʋlʋ na yɩ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ nyaanɩ tɩn, ma ta o wɩ:

english_verse: men were in the crowd.
translation_verse: ), kʋ wǝli dɩ kaana dɩ biǝ.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Zezi ma kwe dɩpwa yam yɩ o kɩ Wɛ le ya ŋwaanɩ. O ma daarɩ o maŋɩ-ya o pa nɔɔna bam na je tɩga nɩ tɩn. O ma kɩ Wɛ le kale sɩm dɩ ŋwaanɩ yɩ o pa-ba. Nɔɔna bam maama ma di nɩ ba na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Ba ma di ba su ba daarɩ. Zezi ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Ve-na á twɛ cicwǝǝru tɩlʋ na daarɩ tɩn, sɩ á yɩ yagɩ sɩ tɩ cɔgɩ.»

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Dɩdaanɩ na yi tɩn, Zezi karabiǝ bam ma vu ba yi nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni.

translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam ma co naboro kʋm ba vu ba yi nɩnɛɛnɩ kilomɛtra yanu naa yardʋ te. Ba laan ma na Zezi na ve na bam baŋa nɩ o maa bɩɩnɩ ba te. Fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ-ba.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Á yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ amʋ.»

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na lwarɩ nɩ Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam daa tǝrǝ tɩn, ba ma zʋ nabwǝǝru tɩm wʋ ba maa ve Kapɛrnawum sɩ ba beer-o.

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na bɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm tɩn, ba ma na Zezi. Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, maŋa kɔɔ mʋ n tu yoba?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam na karɩ á beeri amʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ á na nɛ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na brɩ nɩ Wɛ tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ yɩ á na di wʋdiiru tɩm á su tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ á beeri amʋ.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ, sɩ dɩ́ taá tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ Wɛ na lagɩ tɩn?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ abam tʋŋɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ á sɛ wʋlʋ DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, dɩbam nabaara dɛɛn na wʋ kagʋa wʋnɩ maŋa kalʋ nɩ tɩn, ba di wʋdiu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ ‹Maanɩ› tɩn mʋ, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ te kʋ wɩ: ‹O pɛ-ba wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn yɩ ba di.› »

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, kʋ daɩ Moyisi mʋ pɛ abam wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Kʋ nan yɩ a Ko Wɛ mʋ paɩ abam wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ yɩ kʋ yɩ wʋdiu cɩga cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ Wɛ na paɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na nuŋi DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ o tu o ba lʋgʋ baŋa o paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn.»

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam tu, ta n paɩ dɩbam wʋdiu kʋm kʋntʋ maŋa maama.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na tu amʋ te tɩn, kana daa bá ja kʋntʋ tu. Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn, na-nyɔm daa bá ja kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: A nan maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam nɩ, á nɛ amʋ yɩ á ta ba sɛ-nɩ.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ maama a Ko Wɛ na pɛ amʋ tɩn wʋ́ ba amʋ te. Wʋlʋ maama nan na tu amʋ te tɩn, a bá fɔgɩ a vɩn kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ a ba sɩ a kɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ a tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ a yɩ yagɩ a pa balʋ maama DƖ na pɛ-nɩ tɩn wʋlʋwʋlʋ je, sɩ a daarɩ a pa ba maama joori ba bi lʋgʋ tiim dɛ nɩ.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
