english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam maa pʋʋna dɩ o na tagɩ o wɩ, wʋm mʋ yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Ba maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ daɩ Zʋzɛfʋ bu Zezi wʋm na? Dɩ́ ye o nu dɩ o ko. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ o laan nan ta wɩ, o nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ mʋ o ba?»

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Yagɩ-na, á yɩ taá pʋʋna.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ mʋ nɛ a Ko Wɛ, kʋ yɩ amʋ na nuŋi DƖ te tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ nɛ-DƖ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Amʋ yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kʋntʋ yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ, yɩ wʋlʋ na di-kʋ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ daa bá ja kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Amʋ yɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ ŋwɩa kʋ paɩ nabiinǝ tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na di wʋdiu kʋm kʋntʋ tɩn wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ mʋ maŋa maama. Wʋdiu kʋlʋ a na wʋ́ pa nabiinǝ tɩn yɩ a yɩra yam mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa nabiinǝ taa jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam na wʋ di amʋ Nabiin-bu wʋm yɩra yam, yɩ á daarɩ á wʋ nyɔgɩ a jana kam, á ba jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na di a yɩra yam yɩ o daarɩ o nyɔ a jana kam tɩn, kʋntʋ tu jɩgɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ joori a bi kʋntʋ tu lʋgʋ tiim dɛ dɩm nɩ.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ a yɩra yam mʋ yɩ wʋdiu cɩga, yɩ a jana kam yɩ wo-nyɔɔrʋ cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na di a yɩra yam yɩ o daarɩ o nyɔ a jana kam tɩn wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ dɩ amʋ, yɩ amʋ ŋwɩ kʋntʋ tu wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: A Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa tu tɩn mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ dɩntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ dɩ jɩgɩ ŋwɩa. Kʋntʋ, wʋlʋ na di a yɩra yam tɩn, kʋntʋ tu dɩ wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ amʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Mʋ wʋdiu kʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ nan ba nyɩ dɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ abam nabaara bam dɛɛn na di yɩ ba daa ta tɩ tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na di wʋdiu kʋntʋ tɩn wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ mʋ maŋa maama.»

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Mʋ Zezi dɛɛn na brɩ nɔɔna bam tɩte Kapɛrnawum Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam zanzan na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ta ba wɩ: «O taanɩ dɩm tiini dɩ cana. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o joŋi-dɩ.»

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ kʋntʋ, á na nɛ Nabiin-bu wʋm na maa joori o diini o ya na maŋɩ o wʋ mɛ tɩn, á laan wʋ́ kɩ tɩta mʋ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ paɩ nɔɔna ŋwɩa. Kʋ daarɩ nabiinǝ dam bá wanɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ kɩ. A na tagɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ dɩ abam tɩn mʋ pɛ abam Wɛ Joro kʋlʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, abam badaara ta wʋ sɛ.» Zezi tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ pulim nɩ mʋ o maŋɩ o ye balʋ na bá sɛ-o tɩn, dɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ ba o yǝg-o o pa nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: O daa ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tagɩ a brɩ abam nɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ba amʋ te, yɩ kʋ na daɩ a Ko Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o cwǝŋǝ.»

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ na kɩ tɩn, o karabiǝ zanzan ma joori o kwaga nɩ, yɩ ba daa ba tɔg-o.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam o wɩ: «Abam dɩ ba lagɩ sɩ á yagɩ amʋ na?»

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A yuutu, dɩbam wʋ́ yagɩ nmʋ, sɩ dɩ́ daa vu wɔɔ te mʋ? Nmʋ jɩgɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Dɩbam sɛ nmʋ, yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ yɩ Wʋ-poŋo Tu wʋlʋ Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ kuri abam fugǝ-bale bam, abam dɩdʋa nan yɩ sʋtaanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Zudasɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Simɔn Yiskarɩyo bu tɩn taanɩ mʋ o tɛa. Wʋntʋ tɔgɩ o wʋ karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam wʋnɩ, yɩ wʋm mʋ lagɩ o ba o yǝgi Zezi o pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn maa wʋ Galile nɩ o beerǝ. O dɛɛn ba lagɩ sɩ o vu Zude o beeri da, bɛŋwaanɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ balʋ na wʋ dáanɩ tɩn lagɩ cwǝŋǝ mʋ sɩ ba gʋ-o.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn ma daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ Zwifǝ bam di ba candiǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ vwǝ candiǝ tɩn.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Zezi nyaana ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ, o yagɩ Galile je sɩm sɩ o daarɩ o vu Zude, sɩ o karabiǝ bam wanɩ ba na tɩtʋŋa yalʋ o na jɩgɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ba ta maa ta ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na lagɩ sɩ ba taa ye-o lanyɩranɩ tɩn ba sǝgi kʋlʋ o na kɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nmʋ na kɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ tɩn, n maŋɩ sɩ n ta n kɩ-tɩ nabiinǝ maama yigǝ nɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Ba na tagɩ te tɩn brɩ nɩ ba tɩtɩ ta wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Nabiinǝ bá wanɩ ba taa culi abam. Ba nan culi amʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ yɔɔrɩ a tɛ-ba jaja mʋ, nɩ ba tɩtʋŋa ba tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Abam nan ve-na á di candiǝ kam, sɩ amʋ ta bá vu lele, bɛŋwaanɩ a maŋa kam ta wʋ yi ka ti sɩ a vu.»

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma maŋɩ Galile nɩ. Zezi na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ o brɩ nɔɔna te tɩn

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ balʋ na wʋ candiǝ kam nɩ tɩn maa karɩ ba beer-o, yɩ ba bwe ba wɩ: «O wʋ yǝn mʋ?»

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋra tɩn maa tiini ba jɩgɩ o taanɩ ba waasa. Nɔɔna badonnǝ maa tɛ ba wɩ: «O yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ.» Badaara maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Aye, o daɩ nɔn-ŋʋm, sɩ o jɩgɩ nɔɔna bam o ganɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan wʋ tagɩ o taanɩ jaja, bɛŋwaanɩ ba kwarɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ba na di candiǝ kam ba yi ka da yam tɩtarɩ tɩn, Zezi laan ma vu o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm o wʋra o brɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn daɩ amʋ tɩtɩ nyɩm, kʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn nyɩm mʋ.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ o tɩtɩ dam tɩn, kʋntʋ tu kwaanɩ sɩ o na yɩrɩ mʋ o pa o tɩtɩ. Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ nan na kwaanɩ sɩ o lagɩ yɩrɩ o pa wʋlʋ na tʋŋ-o tɩn, kʋntʋ tu mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ cɩga tɩn, yɩ o ba tusi kʋlʋkʋlʋ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Moyisi nan maŋɩ o pa abam lwarɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm. Abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ nan ba tɔgɩ-tɩ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam kwaanɩ á lagɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ á gʋ amʋ?»

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «N yirisi mʋ. Wɔɔn beeri nmʋ sɩ o gʋ?»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunu dɩdʋ mʋ siun dɛ nɩ, yɩ kʋ sʋ abam.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Moyisi dɛɛn pɛ abam ni sɩ á taá goni á bǝkǝri. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ Moyisi mʋ puli-kʋ. Kʋ puli dɩ abam nabaara mʋ. Moyisi na pɛ abam ni dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, abam maa goni á bǝkǝri dɩ siun dɛ nɩ dɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ pa á cɔgɩ ni dɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Abam na waɩ á goni bǝkǝri siun dɛ dɩm nɩ sɩ á yɩ cɔgɩ Moyisi culu kʋm, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á bana zaŋɩ dɩ amʋ, dɩ a na pɛ yawɩɩnʋ na yazurǝ fasɩ siun dɛ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn badaara laan maa ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi taanɩ ba wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ mʋ ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba gʋ tɩn na?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Nii-na o na zɩgɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ jaja, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ba tɛ kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ ba cɩ-o. Dɩbam yigǝ tiinǝ bam laan bʋŋɩ nɩ wʋntʋ mʋ sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn naa?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Krisi wʋm mʋ na tuǝ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ o na nuŋi mɛ tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ dɩbam maama ye wʋntʋ na nuŋi mɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na wʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ o brɩ nɔɔna tɩn, o ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Abam bʋŋɩ nɩ á sɩɩnɩ á ye amʋ, yɩ á kwǝri á ye a na nuŋi mɛ tɩn. A nan wʋ tu a tɩtɩ nɩ, wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. Abam nan yǝr-o.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Amʋ mʋ ye-o, bɛŋwaanɩ a nuŋi wʋntʋ te mʋ, yɩ wʋm mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba laan ma lagɩ sɩ ba ja-o. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o kɩ-o kʋlʋkʋlʋ, o maŋa kam ta na wʋ yi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔna zanzan ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Krisi wʋm na tuǝ, o bá wanɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla zanzan sɩ kʋ dwǝni wʋntʋ na maŋɩ o kɩ te tɩn.» Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam na kwaanɩ sɩ ba ja Zezi te tɩn

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam ma ni nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm na jɩgɩ Zezi taanɩ ba waasa te tɩn. Ba dɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam laan ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu ba ja Zezi.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ bá tiini a daanɩ abam tee nɩ. Kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn, aá vu wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn te.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Abam nan wʋ́ ba á beeri amʋ je á ga, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ na wʋ mɛ tɩn, abam bá wanɩ da á vu.»

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam maa ŋɔɔnɩ daanɩ ba wɩ: «O lagɩ o vu yǝn mʋ yɩ dɩbam bá na-o? O ga lagɩ o vu Zwifǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn te mʋ, sɩ o taa brɩ-ba na?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: O taanɩ dɩm kuri mʋ bɛɛ? O na tagɩ o wɩ, dɩbam wʋ́ ba dɩ́ beeri wʋm jǝgǝ dɩ́ ga, yɩ o ta o wɩ, wʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn, dɩbam bá wanɩ da dɩ́ vu tɩn, kʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ?» Na balʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn ma ba kʋ yi candiǝ kam tiim dɛ. Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ candiǝ kam dɛ kamunu. Zezi maa zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Na-nyɔm na jɩgɩ wʋlʋ maama tɩn, sɩ o ba amʋ te o nyɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ na bam taanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ o brɩ Wɛ na wʋ́ kɩ DƖ Joro kʋm balʋ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn bɩcara nɩ te tɩn mʋ. Kantʋ maŋa nɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm daa ta wʋ tu ba te, bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi daa ta wʋ tɩgɩ o joori o bi o na paarɩ-zulǝ Wɛ tee nɩ. Nɔn-kɔgɔ na pɔɔrɩ daanɩ Zezi ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm dɛɛn na ni Zezi na tagɩ te tɩn, badaara maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu wʋlʋ ya na maŋɩ sɩ o ba tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm brɩ nɩ Krisi wʋm wʋ́ ta yɩ Pɛ Davidi dwi tu mʋ, yɩ o nuŋi Betelɩhɛm, tɩʋ kʋlʋ Davidi dɛɛn na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn.»

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kampwara dɛɛn ma ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ Zezi ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Badaara lagɩ sɩ ba ja-o, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o kɩ-o kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam na tʋŋɩ nɔɔna balʋ tɩn ma joori ba ba ba te. Ba ma bwe-ba ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á wʋ jaan-o á ba?»

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma lǝri-ba ba wɩ: «Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ maŋɩ o wʋ ŋɔɔnɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam ma ta-ba ba wɩ: «Abam pɛ o ganɩ abam dɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ dɩbam yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam wʋlʋwʋlʋ wʋ sɛ-o na?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm, bantʋ yǝri Wɛ cullu tɩm Moyisi na tiŋi o pa dɩbam tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋʋ́ cɔgɩ-ba.»

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam wʋ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa dɛɛn maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Nikodɛm. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ ya na maŋɩ o vu Zezi te tɩn. O ma zaŋɩ o ta dɩ o donnǝ bam o wɩ:

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: «Kʋ na yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm Moyisi na brɩ tɩn, kʋ culǝ sɩ dɩ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔnʋ, yɩ dɩ́ daa ta wʋ bwe-o sɩ dɩ́ ni o na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ba laan ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Nmʋ dɩ yɩ Galile tu mʋ na? Nan karɩmɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ wʋnɩ n nii, sɩ n na nɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu tǝrǝ o na wʋ́ nuŋi Galile nɩ.»

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Ba maama laan ma jagɩ ba vu sam.

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zezi dɛɛn ma vu Olivi piu kʋm yuu.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ puru tɩn, Zezi ma joori o vu o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama ma ba kʋ gilim-o. O ma jǝni tɩga nɩ o wʋra o brɩ-ba.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ dɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ ma ja kaanɩ wʋlʋ ba na pɩɩr-o boorim baŋa nɩ tɩn, ba ja ba ba zɩgɩ ba maama yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Ba ma ta dɩ Zezi ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, dɩbam pɩɩrɩ kaanɩ wʋntʋ boorim baŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Moyisi na pɛ dɩbam Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ tɩn pɛ dɩbam ni sɩ, kaanɩ na kɩ kǝm dɩntʋ doŋ, sɩ dɩ́ dʋl-o dɩ́ gʋ mʋ. Kʋ nan na yɩ nmʋ, nmʋ wɩ dɩ́ kɩ ta mʋ?»

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Ba na bwe-o kʋntʋ tɩn, ba lagɩ sɩ ba maŋɩ Zezi mʋ ba nii, baá wanɩ ba saŋ-o na? Zezi ma tiiri o ma o nʋa o la tɩga nɩ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Ba maa ta joori ba bwe Zezi taan. O laan ma kwǝni wɛɛnɩ, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam wʋlʋ na wʋ kɩ lwarɩm tɩn, sɩ o da yigǝ o kwe kandwɛ o ma dʋlɩ kaanɩ wʋm.»

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: O laan ma joori o tiiri o wʋra o la tɩga nɩ dɩ o nʋa.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: O ma kwǝni wɛɛnɩ, yɩ o bwe kaanɩ wʋm o wɩ: «Balʋ na saŋɩ nmʋ tɩn wʋ yǝn? Ba nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa wʋ daarɩ sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o cɔgɩ nmʋ na?»

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: O ma lǝri o wɩ: «Aye, a tu, ba nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa wʋ daarɩ.» Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ dɩ nan bá di nmʋ sarɩya. Ve, nan daa n yɩ kɩ lwarɩm.» Zezi na brɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ cɩga te tɩn

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ yɩ pooni a paɩ nabiinǝ maama. Wʋlʋ nan na tɔgɩ amʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu daa bá vu lim wʋnɩ. Kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ na pooni dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa-o ŋwɩa cɩga cɩga tɩn.»

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ na paɩ n tɩtɩ cɩga tɩn, n taanɩ dɩm ba jɩgɩ kuri.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A na maŋɩ a paɩ a tɩtɩ cɩga dɩ, kʋ ta yɩ cɩga mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ye a na nuŋi mɛ tɩn. Abam nan yǝri amʋ na nuŋi mɛ dɩ mɛ a na maa ve tɩn.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á di nɔɔna taanɩ nɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ. Amʋ nan ba di nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ taanɩ.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, amʋ na lagɩ a di nɔɔna taanɩ, amʋ taanɩ dim dɩm wʋ́ ta yɩ cɩga mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ Ko mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ. O nan wʋra dɩ amʋ, kʋ daɩ amʋ yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ́ di nɔɔna taanɩ.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Amʋ paɩ a tɩtɩ cɩga, yɩ a Ko wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn dɩ paɩ amʋ cɩga.»

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «N ko wʋm bɛɛ?» O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam yǝri amʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ á yǝri a Ko wʋm dɩ. Á ya na ye amʋ, á ya wʋ́ lwarɩ a Ko wʋm dɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ o brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ, jǝgǝ kalʋ nɔɔna na ve ba dɩ sǝbu da ba pa Wɛ tɩn mʋ. O na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o ja-o, o maŋa kam ta na wʋ yi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm o wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ viiri, yɩ abam wʋ́ beeri amʋ jǝgǝ á ga, bɛŋwaanɩ abam wʋ́ tɩ á lwarɩm dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ. A na maa ve mɛ tɩn, abam bá wanɩ da á vu.»

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam maa tɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «O na tagɩ o wɩ, dɩbam bá wanɩ dɩ́ vu o na maa ve mɛ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ o lagɩ o gʋ o tɩtɩ mʋ na?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna mʋ, amʋ nan nuŋi wɛyuu mʋ. Abam kugu je yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa yo mʋ. Amʋ kugu je nan daɩ lʋgʋ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ a tagɩ a brɩ abam nɩ, abam wʋ́ tɩ á lwarɩm dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ abam na wʋ sɛ nɩ amʋ sɩɩnɩ a yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋra maŋa maama tɩn, á wʋ́ tɩ á lwarɩm dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?» O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ kʋlʋ a na maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Amʋ ya jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ a ma di abam taanɩ. Wʋlʋ nan na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn tiini o yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. A na ni kʋlʋ o tee nɩ tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ a tɛ a brɩ nabiinǝ.»

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, ba wʋ lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ o Ko Baŋa-Wɛ taanɩ mʋ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Maŋa wʋ́ ba, yɩ á kwe amʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm tɩn á zǝŋi wɛɛnɩ. Á laan wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ amʋ sɩɩnɩ a yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋra maŋa maama tɩn. Abam ta wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ amʋ ba kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ a tɩtɩ nɩ. A nan yǝni a tɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ a Ko wʋm na brɩ-nɩ tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ a brɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn wʋ amʋ tee nɩ, o wʋ yagɩ-nɩ a yɩranɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ a yǝni a kɩ kʋlʋ na poli o wʋ tɩn mʋ maŋa maama.»

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, nɔɔna zanzan laan ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o. Biǝ na tɔgɩ ba kwǝ kǝm te tɩn

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na sɛ-o tɩn o wɩ: «Abam na sɛ amʋ zaasɩm dɩm yɩ á wʋ yagɩ, á wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ á ji amʋ karabiǝ cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: Abam laan wʋ́ ba á lwarɩ cɩga, yɩ cɩga kam wʋ́ vrɩ abam ka yagɩ sɩ á taá te á tɩtɩ.»

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam yɩ Abraham dwi tiinǝ mʋ, dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ wʋ jigi nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gambɛ. Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ n ta n wɩ, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta te dɩ́ tɩtɩ tɩn?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wʋlʋ maama na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn yɩ lwarɩm gambaa mʋ.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, Wɛ Bu wʋm na vrɩ abam o yagɩ, á wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ á taá te á tɩtɩ.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye nɩ abam yɩ Abraham dwi tiinǝ mʋ, yɩ abam ta kwaanɩ sɩ á gʋ amʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ á ba sɛ a zaasɩm dɩm.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Amʋ ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ a na nɛ amʋ Ko tee nɩ tɩn mʋ. Abam dɩ nan kɩ kʋlʋ á na niǝ abam ko tee nɩ tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam ko mʋ Abraham.» O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam ya na sɩɩnɩ á yɩ Abraham biǝ, á ya wʋ́ taá kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Abraham dɛɛn na kɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Amʋ tagɩ cɩga kalʋ a na ni Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn a brɩ abam, yɩ abam kwaanɩ sɩ á gʋ-nɩ. Abraham dɛɛn nan ba kɩ abam kǝm dɩm doŋ.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á kɩ kǝnǝ yalʋ á ko na kɩ tɩn mʋ.» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam daɩ tampirǝ. Wɛ tɩtɩ yɩranɩ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Ko.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Baŋa-Wɛ ya na yɩ abam Ko, á ya wʋ́ taá soe amʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ a ba a wʋra dɩ abam. A wʋ tu a tɩtɩ nɩ. Wɛ mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam ba ni a taanɩ dɩm kuri? Kʋ yɩ abam na ba lagɩ sɩ á sɛ a taanɩ dɩm tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Abam yɩ á ko sʋtaanɩ biǝ mʋ. Á maa lagɩ sɩ á taá kɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn. Pulim nɩ tɩn sʋtaanɩ maŋɩ dɩ yɩ nɔn-gʋrʋ mʋ. Dɩ ba fɔgɩ dɩ tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ, bɛŋwaanɩ cɩga tǝri dɩ wʋnɩ. Dɩ na yǝni dɩ fɔ vwan, kʋ yɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋa na maŋɩ ya yɩ te tɩn mʋ. Dɩ yɩ vwa-fɔrʋ mʋ. Dɩntʋ nan mʋ yɩ vwa-nyɩna ko.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ, a yǝni a tɛ cɩga mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ abam ba sɛ amʋ.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Abam wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o brɩ nɩ amʋ kɩ a cɔgɩ? Amʋ nan na ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga tɩn, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á ba sɛ-nɩ?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔnʋ tɩn cǝgi Wɛ taanɩ mʋ. Abam nan na daɩ Wɛ nɔɔna tɩn mʋ paɩ á ba cǝgǝ.» Zezi na brɩ nɩ o dwe Abraham te tɩn

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam ma lǝri Zezi ba wɩ: «Dɩbam jɩgɩ bʋra sɩ dɩ́ ta nɩ, nmʋ sɩɩnɩ n yɩ Samari tu mʋ. N yirisi mʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A ba yirisǝ. Amʋ paɩ a Ko mʋ zulǝ. Kʋ daarɩ abam nan gooni amʋ mʋ.

english_verse: years old!” they said. “How could you have seen Abraham?”
translation_verse: A nan ba beeri a tɩtɩ zulǝ. Wɛ yɩranɩ mʋ pa-nɩ zulǝ, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ di nabiinǝ taanɩ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wʋlʋ maama na sɛ yɩ o kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ daa bá ja kʋntʋ tu.»

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam laan ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «N taanɩ dɩm n na tagɩ tɩn pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ n yirisi mʋ. Abraham dɛɛn tɩga, yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam maama dɩ tɩ. Nmʋ nan ta tagɩ n wɩ, wʋlʋ na sɛ yɩ o kɩ n na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ daa bá ja kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Nmʋ yɩ nɔn-kamunu n dwe dɩbam ko Abraham mʋ na? Wʋntʋ nan tɩga. Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɩ ma tɩ. Nmʋ bʋŋɩ n paɩ n yɩ wɔɔ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A ya na lagɩ yɩrɩ a pa a tɩtɩ, kʋntʋ ya yɩ kafɛ mʋ. Kʋ yɩ a Ko Wɛ mʋ zǝŋi a yɩrɩ, kʋ yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ abam yǝni á tɛ á wɩ: ‹Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Wɛ tɩn.›

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Abam nan yǝri-DƖ, amʋ nan ye-DƖ. A ya na tagɩ a wɩ, a yǝri-DƖ, a ya yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ abam te. Amʋ nan sɩɩnɩ a ye-DƖ, yɩ a sɛ a kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ na tagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba laan ma kwe kandwa sɩ ba ma dʋl-o ba gʋ. O ma sǝgi o nuŋi Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma vu o maa kɛa. O ma na nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ ba na maŋɩ ba lʋ-o yɩ o yɩ lilwe.

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn tɩtʋŋa yam yɩ wɩa ta wʋra mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ tɩga yi, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa bá wanɩ o tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam a ta na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, amʋ yɩ pooni mʋ a paɩ nabiinǝ.»

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o laan ma twɩ lileeru o dɩ tɩga nɩ. O ma viiri tɩɩrʋ, yɩ o kɩ-tɩ o bǝ lilwe wʋm yiǝ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ve n su n yiǝ yam Silʋa bugǝ kam nɩ.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma vu o su o yiǝ yam. O ma joori o ba, yɩ o laan naɩ.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Balʋ na zʋʋrɩ o tɩkǝri nɩ dɩ balʋ na maŋɩ ba ye nɩ o yɩ looru tɩn ma na-o, yɩ ba bwɛ ba wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ mʋ yǝni o je o loori tɩn na?»

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Badaara maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ.» Badonnǝ maa wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ wʋntʋ, sɩ ba nyɩ daanɩ mʋ.» Nɔɔnʋ wʋm tɩtɩ ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ amʋ kʋntʋ.»

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ yiǝ yam kɩ ta mʋ ya puri?»

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Zezi tɩn mʋ kɩ tɩɩrʋ o ma bǝ a yiǝ yam baŋa, yɩ o ta-nɩ o wɩ, a ve Silʋa bugǝ kam a su-ya. A ma vu a su, yɩ a laan naɩ.»

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ bɛ?» O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A yǝri o je.»

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm Zezi na kɩ tɩɩrʋ tɩm o ma puri nɔɔnʋ wʋm yiǝ yam tɩn ya yɩ Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ mʋ.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam dɩ daa bwe nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba wɩ: «N yiǝ yam kɩ ta mʋ ya puri?» O ma ta-ba o wɩ: «O kɩ tɩɩrʋ mʋ o ma bǝ a yiǝ baŋa. A ma su-ya, yɩ a laan naɩ.»

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Farizɩan tiinǝ bam badaara ma ta ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋm na kɩ te tɩn, o wʋ nuŋi Wɛ te, bɛŋwaanɩ o cɔgɩ siun dɛ cullu tɩm.» Badonnǝ dɩ maa tɛ ba wɩ: «O na yɩ nɔn-balɔrɔ, o bá wanɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yantʋ doŋ.» Kʋntʋ ma pa kampwara ba ba tɩtarɩ.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma joori ba bwe nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba wɩ: «O nan na pɛ n yiǝ yam puri tɩn, nmʋ tɛ n wɩ, o yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «O yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ.»

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-ba ba wɩ: «Wʋntʋ yɩ abam bu mʋ na? Á lʋg-o dɩ o maŋɩ o yɩ lilwe mʋ na? O nan kɩ ta mʋ o naɩ lele kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm tiinǝ bam ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Dɩbam ye nɩ o yɩ dɩbam bu mʋ. Dɩ́ ye nɩ dɩ́ lʋg-o dɩ o yɩ lilwe mʋ.

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan yǝri o laan na kɩ te o naɩ, yɩ dɩ́ yǝri wʋlʋ na puri o yiǝ yam dɩ. Abam nan bwe-na o tɩtɩ, sɩ o yɩ nɔn-kwɩʋn mʋ, o tɩtɩ wʋ́ wanɩ o lǝri.»

english_verse: The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri o tiinǝ bam cɩm, yɩ ba ta ba wɩ, ba bwe o tɩtɩ sɩ o yɩ nɔn-kwɩʋn mʋ tɩn.

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ba ma joori ba bǝŋi nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba na lʋg-o dɩ lilweem tɩn, yɩ ba ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Nan kwarɩ Wɛ, sɩ n ta cɩga, sɩ dɩbam ye nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ yɩ nɔn-balɔrɔ mʋ.»

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Amʋ yǝri nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ yɩ nɔn-balɔrɔ naa o daɩ. Kʋlʋ yɩranɩ a na ye tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ, a dɛɛn yɩ lilwe mʋ, yɩ a laan naɩ lele kʋntʋ.»

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «O kɩ ta mʋ o puri nmʋ yiǝ yam?»

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma lǝri o wɩ: «A maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam, yɩ á wʋ sɛ sɩ á cǝgi. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam daa lagɩ sɩ á bwe á nii? Abam dɩ ga lagɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ á yɩ o karabiǝ mʋ na?»

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma twɩ-o yɩ ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ nmʋ mʋ tɔgɩ o kwaga, sɩ kʋ daɩ dɩbam mʋ tɔg-o. Dɩbam tɔgɩ Moyisi cullu tɩm mʋ.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Dɩbam ye nɩ Wɛ dɛɛn ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Moyisi mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ, dɩ́ brɩ dɩ́ yǝri o na nuŋi mɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Aa. Kʋ yɩ kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ sʋ amʋ tɩn. Abam yǝri o na nuŋi mɛ, yɩ wʋntʋ nan mʋ puri a yiǝ yam.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ye nɩ Wɛ ba cǝgi nɔn-balwaarʋ taanɩ. Kʋ yɩ nɔɔna balʋ na nɩgɩ-DƖ yɩ ba kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ DƖ cǝgǝ.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Kʋ na zɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pulim nɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm tɩn, dɩ́ daa ta wʋ ni nɩ nɔɔnʋ puri wʋlʋ ba na lʋg-o dɩ lilweem tɩn yiǝ.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ na sɩɩnɩ o wʋ nuŋi Wɛ te, o ya bá wanɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩntʋ doŋ.»

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Ba lʋgɩ nmʋ yɩ n maama maŋɩ n yɩ lwarɩm punǝ mʋ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n bʋŋɩ sɩ n brɩ dɩbam?» Ba laan ma zǝl-o, sɩ o daa yɩ tɔgɩ o zʋ ba Wɛ-digǝ kam.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma ni nɩ ba lɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋnɩ. O ma vu o jeer-o, yɩ o bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ sɛ Nabiin-bu wʋm dɩ n wʋ maama na?»

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma lǝri o wɩ: «A yuutu, ta n brɩ-nɩ o na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, sɩ a wanɩ a sɛ-o.»

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ maŋɩ n na-o. Amʋ mʋ yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm, a zɩgɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nmʋ.»

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta o wɩ: «A Yuutu, a sɛ-m.» O ma kuni doonǝ Zezi yigǝ nɩ o zul-o.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ tu lʋgʋ kʋntʋ baŋa sɩ a pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna balʋ na jɩgɩ bʋra dɩ balʋ na ba jɩgɩ bʋra tɩn mʋ daanɩ, sɩ balʋ na yɩ lilwǝ tɩn yiǝ puri, sɩ balʋ yiǝ na naɩ tɩn joori ya dwe.»

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: O na lagɩ o zʋ, wʋlʋ na nii najɩrɩ dɩm ni baŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ́ pʋrɩ o pa o zʋ. Peeni sɩm wʋ́ ni o kwǝrǝ, yɩ oó bǝŋi o tɩtɩ peeni sɩm yɩra, yɩ sɩ da-o sɩ nuŋi.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: O na jaanɩ-sɩ o nuŋi, oó ta tɔgɩ sɩ yigǝ, yɩ peeni sɩm tɔgɩ o kwaga, bɛŋwaanɩ sɩ ye o kwǝrǝ.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ nɔn-gaa, sɩ bá sɛ sɩ tɔg-o. Sɩ wʋ́ duri sɩ viiri mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ sɩ yǝri o kwǝrǝ.»

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ o brɩ-ba tɩn, ba ma wʋ lwarɩ o taanɩ dɩm kuri.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Zezi daa ma ta o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, amʋ mʋ nyɩ dɩ ni dɩlʋ peeni sɩm na tɔgɩ da tɩn.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na dɛ yigǝ ba ba ba zʋ ba loori amʋ tɩn nyɩ dɩ ŋwɩɩna dɩ vɩrna mʋ. Peeni sɩm ma wʋ sɛ ba ni.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Amʋ mʋ yɩ ni dɩm. Wʋlʋ maama na tɔgɩ amʋ o zʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ na vrɩm. O nan wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ywǝmmǝ tɩn, nɩ peeni na tɔgɩ najɩrɩ ni sɩ nuŋi sɩ di yɩ sɩ joori sɩ zʋʋrɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Ŋwɩɩnʋ na tu o zʋ, o lagɩ sɩ o ŋɔ mʋ o gʋ o daarɩ o ja o cɔgɩ. Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ, a tu sɩ a pa nabiinǝ mʋ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ywǝnǝ tɩn cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: Amʋ mʋ nyɩ dɩ nayɩr-ŋʋm cɩga cɩga, yɩ a soe a nɔɔna. Nayɩr-ŋʋm sɛ tʋʋnɩ mʋ o peeni ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ peeni sɩm o joŋi sǝbu tɩn, wʋntʋ daɩ nayɩrʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ peeni sɩm tu tɩn. Wʋntʋ na nɛ nywǝnkurǝ na maa bɩɩna, oó duri mʋ o daarɩ peeni sɩm. Nywǝnkurǝ kam wʋ́ zʋ peeni sɩm wʋ ka ja-sɩ ka pa sɩ jagɩ.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Oó duri o viiri, bɛŋwaanɩ o tɔgɩ peeni sɩm sǝbu ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ o ba jɩgɩ sɩ ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Amʋ mʋ yɩ nayɩr-ŋʋm cɩga cɩga. Amʋ ye a nɔɔna bam, yɩ ba dɩ ye amʋ,

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ Ko na ye-nɩ yɩ amʋ dɩ ye-o te tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ sɛ sɩ a tɩ a nɔɔna bam ŋwaanɩ, nɩ nayɩr-ŋʋm na sɛ sɩ o tɩ o peeni ŋwaanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: A daa ta jɩgɩ peeni sɩdaara, sɩ na tǝri najɩrɩ dɩntʋ wʋnɩ. A nan maŋɩ sɩ a vu a kalɩ-sɩ mʋ a ja ba a kɩ daanɩ. Peeni sɩntʋ dɩ wʋ́ ni amʋ kwǝrǝ. Kʋntʋ, a peeni sɩm maama wʋ́ la jǝgǝ dɩdʋa, yɩ nayɩrʋ dɩdʋa nii-sɩ.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: A Ko Wɛ soe amʋ, dɩ a na sɛ sɩ a tɩ nabiinǝ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ a joori a bi a na ŋwɩa tɩn.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o pa a ga a ŋwɩa. Amʋ tɩtɩ nan mʋ lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a ga-ka. A jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ga a ŋwɩa kam. A nan ta jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a joori a bi a na-ka. Mʋ woŋo kʋlʋ a Ko na pɛ-nɩ ni sɩ a kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, kampwara daa ma ba Zwifǝ bam wʋ o taanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Ba zanzan maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Cicirǝ mʋ jɩg-o, o yuu mʋ tǝrǝ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á cǝgi o taanɩ?»

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ badaara maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Wʋlʋ yuu na tǝrǝ tɩn bá wanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ tɩntʋ doŋ. Cicirǝ na jɩgɩ wʋlʋ tɩn bá wanɩ o puri lilwe yiǝ.» Zezi na brɩ nɩ o dɩ o Ko Wɛ yɩ bɩdwɩ te tɩn

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn ma vu Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm. O maa wʋ Salɔmɔn kʋnkɔlɔ kʋm nɩ o kaaga.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ badaara laan ma ba ba gilim-o, yɩ ba bwe-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn na? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n pa kʋ tiini kʋ yɩ wʋbʋŋa zanzan dɩ dɩbam? Ta cɩga n brɩ dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ kɔ joro.»

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam, yɩ á ba sɛ a ni. Tɩtʋŋa yalʋ a Ko Wɛ na pɛ a tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ brɩ nɩ a jɩgɩ cɩga.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Abam nan ba sɛ a ni, bɛŋwaanɩ abam daɩ amʋ nɔɔna.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam nyɩ dɩ peeni sɩlʋ na cǝgi amʋ kwǝrǝ tɩn mʋ. A maa ye-sɩ, yɩ sɩ tɔgɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: Amʋ paɩ a nɔɔna bam na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn mʋ, yɩ ba bá fɔgɩ ba cɔgɩ maŋa dɩ maŋa. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o vrɩ-ba amʋ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ a Ko Wɛ mʋ kwe-ba DƖ kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ. Dɩntʋ nan mʋ dwe woŋo maama. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o vrɩ-ba DƖ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɩ a Ko Wɛ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam daa ma kwe kandwa sɩ ba ma dʋl-o ba gʋ.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ Ko pɛ a tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna zanzan mʋ a brɩ abam. Tɩtʋŋa yantʋ wʋnɩ dɔɔ tɩtɩ mʋ pɛ abam kwaanɩ sɩ á gʋ amʋ dɩ kandwa?»

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ dʋlɩ-m dɩ́ gʋ. Kʋ yɩ nmʋ na twɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nmʋ yɩ nabiinu mʋ, yɩ n paɩ n yɩ Wɛ mʋ.»

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ dɛɛn pɛ DƖ kwǝrǝ nɔɔna bantʋ mʋ, yɩ DƖ bǝŋi-ba nɩ DƖ nyɩnyʋgʋ. Kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn bá wanɩ kʋ ji kafɛ.

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan yɩ wʋlʋ a Ko Wɛ na lɩ sɩ a kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa, yɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a ba lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ, a na tagɩ nɩ a yɩ Wɛ Bu tɩn, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á ba sɛa? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á brɩ nɩ a twɩ Wɛ mʋ?

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Maanɩ-na á nii a tɩtʋŋa yam na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋ na daɩ a Ko Wɛ tɩtʋŋa mʋ a tʋŋa, sɩ á yɩ sɛ-nɩ.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa, á na maŋɩ á ba sɛ amʋ, sɩ á sɛ tɩtʋŋa yam na brɩ te tɩn. Á na sɛ tɩtʋŋa yam kʋntʋ, á wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ á lwarɩ nɩ a Ko wʋra dɩ amʋ, yɩ amʋ dɩ wʋra dɩ a Ko.»

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Zezi ma joori o vu o bɛ Zʋrdɛn bugǝ kam. O ma vu je sɩlʋ Zan dɛɛn na yǝni o miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ tɩn, o zʋʋrɩ da.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan dɛɛn maa tui o te. Ba maa yǝni ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Zan nan wʋ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla. Kʋ daarɩ o na tagɩ kʋlʋ maama Zezi ŋwaanɩ tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ.»

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ nɔɔna zanzan ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Mari dɩdaanɩ Marɩtɩ ma tʋŋɩ ni ba pa Zezi ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Yuutu, nmʋ ciloŋ-sono kʋm ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ.»

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Zezi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o maa wɩ: «Yawɩʋ kʋntʋ kweelim je bá ta yɩ o tʋʋnɩ. Kʋ nan kɩ sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ mʋ na zulǝ, sɩ amʋ Wɛ Bu wʋm dɩ na zulǝ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: yɩ o laan daarɩ o ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Pa-na dɩ́ joori dɩ́ vu Zude.»

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Karanyɩna, Zwifǝ bam daama na lagɩ sɩ ba dʋlɩ nmʋ dɩ kandwa ba gʋ tɩn, n swe mʋ na? Yɩ n daa ta lagɩ sɩ n joori n vu da.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ a vu mʋ. Luu fugǝ-bale mʋ wʋra wɩa nɩ. Kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ na? Nɔɔnʋ na ve wɩa nɩ, o daa ba tri o tʋɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pooni dɩm paɩ o naɩ.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: O nan na ve tɩtɩɩ nɩ, o tri o tʋ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ pooni tǝri o tee nɩ.»

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o daa ma ta o wǝli da o wɩ: «Dɩbam ciloŋ Lazaarɩ dɔ mʋ. A nan maa ve sɩ a pa o zaŋɩ.»

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: O karabiǝ bam ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam yuutu, o na dɔa, kʋʋ́ garɩ o yɩra nɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Zezi nan na tagɩ te tɩn brɩ nɩ Lazaarɩ tɩgɩ mʋ. Bantʋ maa bʋŋɩ nɩ Zezi ŋɔɔnɩ dɔɔm tɩtɩ woŋo mʋ.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jɩgɩ wʋpolo abam ŋwaanɩ dɩ a na tǝri o tee nɩ tɩn. Kʋʋ́ pa á wanɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ. Nan pa-na dɩ́ vu o te.»

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Toma wʋlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Yiywɛ tɩn ma ta dɩ o donnǝ bam o wɩ: «Pa-na dɩ́ maama tɔgɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ wǝli dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu dɩ́ tɩ.»

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Zezi ma vu o yi Betani dɩ ba kwe Lazaarɩ ba kɩ kʋ jɩgɩ da yana mʋ.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Betani batwarɩ dɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩnɛɛnɩ kilomɛtra yale mʋ te.

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ zanzan dɛɛn ya tu sɩ ba kɩ Marɩtɩ dɩ Mari le dɩ ba nabɔ wʋm tʋʋnɩ dɩm.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Marɩtɩ na ni nɩ Zezi maa bɩɩnɩ tɩn, o ma nuŋi o vu sɩ o jeer-o. Mari ma maŋɩ sɔŋɔ nɩ.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Marɩtɩ na yi Zezi te tɩn, o ma ta o wɩ: «A yuutu, nmʋ ya na wʋ yo, a nabɔ wʋm ya bá tɩ.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «N nabɔ wʋm wʋ́ joori o bi.»

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”

translation_verse: Zezi ma ta o wɩ: «A wʋ mʋ cɔgɩ zanzan. A nan wʋ́ ta nɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Aá loori a Ko mʋ sɩ o vrɩ-nɩ yaara yantʋ wʋnɩ na? Awo. Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ maŋɩ a ba sɩ a yaarɩ.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na zɩgɩ da tɩn ma ni kwǝrǝ kam, yɩ ba ta ba wɩ, dʋa mʋ mumunǝ. Badaara maa wɩ, kʋ yɩ malɛka mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ amʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ kwǝrǝ kantʋ ŋɔɔnɩ, kʋ yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ ka ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Maŋa laan yiǝ sɩ Wɛ di nabiinǝ taanɩ, sɩ DƖ zǝli lʋgʋ baŋa pɛ wʋm.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ amʋ, maŋa kalʋ ba na wʋ́ zǝŋi amʋ wɛɛnɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa nabiinǝ maama ba amʋ te.»

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o brɩ o na lagɩ o tɩ tʋʋnɩ dwi dɩlʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm ma lǝr-o kʋ wɩ: «Dɩbam ni nɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ, Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ mʋ maŋa maama. Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ n ta n wɩ, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba zǝŋi Nabiin-bu wʋm wɛɛnɩ? Nabiin-bu wʋntʋ nan yɩ wɔɔ?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Pooni bá tiini dɩ daanɩ abam tee nɩ. Pooni dɩm ta na wʋ á tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, sɩ á taá veǝ, sɩ lim yɩ ba dɩ yi abam. Wʋlʋ na ve lim wʋnɩ tɩn yǝri o na ve mɛ.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Pooni dɩm ta na wʋ á tee nɩ tɩn, á nan sɛ wʋlʋ na yɩ pooni dɩm tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á taá yɩ pooni dɩm biǝ.» Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o ma nuŋi ba tɩtarɩ nɩ o vu o sǝgi.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Dɩ o na maŋɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla zanzan ba yibiyǝ nɩ tɩn, ba daa ta wʋ sɛ-o.

english_verse: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, “Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ma pa kʋlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi dɛɛn na tagɩ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ. O dɛɛn tagɩ faŋa faŋa o wɩ: «Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ sɛ dɩ́ na tagɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ dɩ́ brɩ-ba tɩn. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan wʋ lwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dam dɩm na yɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Ba wʋ wanɩ ba sɛ Zezi taanɩ dɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ Ezayi ta tagɩ o wɩ:

english_verse: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.
translation_verse: Ezayi dɛɛn tagɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm taanɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o wuuri o na Zezi paarɩ-zulǝ na yɩ te yɩ o daa ta wʋ tu lʋgʋ baŋa.

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ zanzan dɩ ta kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi. Ba na kwarɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, ba wʋ ŋɔɔnɩ-kʋ jaja, sɩ baá zǝli-ba ba Wɛ-digǝ kam nɩ.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Ba na kɩ te tɩn brɩ nɩ ba soe sɩ nabiinǝ wʋrʋ poli dɩ ba kʋ dwe Wɛ wʋ na poli dɩ ba. Zezi na tu sɩ o vrɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm wʋnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ o sɛ amʋ yɩranɩ mʋ, kʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn mʋ o sɛ.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na nɛ amʋ tɩn nɛ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Amʋ tu lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ a taa yɩ pooni mʋ a paɩ nabiinǝ, sɩ wʋlʋ maama na sɛ amʋ tɩn daa yɩ maŋɩ lim wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na ni a taanɩ dɩm yɩ o wʋ sɛ sɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ a na tagɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ amʋ mʋ cɔgɩ kʋntʋ tu, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ a di nabiinǝ taanɩ sɩ a cɔgɩ-ba. Kʋ nan yɩ sɩ a vrɩ-ba ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ a tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ a ŋɔɔna. Kʋ yɩ a Ko wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ-nɩ ni sɩ a ta kʋlʋ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn, yɩ DƖ ta brɩ-nɩ kʋlʋ a na wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ na daarɩ sɩ ba di Pakɩ candiǝ kam tɩn, Zezi dɛɛn maa ye nɩ o maŋa kam yiǝ, sɩ o yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ o daarɩ o vu o Ko te. O maa soe balʋ na yɩ o nɔɔna lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, yɩ o tiini o so-ba kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o karabiǝ bam maa je ba di wʋdiu tɩtɩɩ nɩ, dɩ sʋtaanɩ ya maŋɩ dɩ pa Zudasɩ Yiskarɩyo wʋlʋ na yɩ Simɔn bu tɩn lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ o yǝgi Zezi o pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Zezi maa ye nɩ o Ko Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o dam woŋo maama baŋa nɩ, yɩ o ye nɩ o nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ, o nan ta wʋ́ joori o vu Wɛ te.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Ba na wʋra ba di tɩn, o ma zaŋɩ da. O lɩ o na zʋ gɔrɔ kʋlʋ o daŋɩ tɩn, yɩ o daarɩ o vɔ pʋpaa o tǝŋǝ nɩ.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: O ma kɩ na o kɩ kacuǝ wʋnɩ o wʋra o maa zarɩ o karabiǝ bam nɛ, yɩ o ma pʋpaa kʋm o ma guguni-sɩ.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: O ma ba o yi Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ te. Wʋntʋ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A yuutu, nmʋ mʋ wʋ́ zarɩ amʋ nɛ na?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ bá lwarɩ amʋ na wʋra a kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn kuri lele, n nan wʋ́ ba n lwarɩ kʋ kuri.»

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta o wɩ: «N brɩ n bá zarɩ a nɛ maŋa dɩ maŋa.» Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A na wʋ zarɩ n nɛ sɩm, n bá n wanɩ n ta n yɩ amʋ nɔɔnʋ.»

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ, a yuutu, yɩ zarɩ a nɛ yɩranɩ, zarɩ a jɩa dɩ a yuu dɩ n wǝli da.»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na swɛ o yɩra tɩn daa ba jɩgɩ digiru, yɩ o daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o swɛ o yɩra, kʋ na daɩ o nɛ yɩranɩ. Abam ba jɩgɩ digiru, kʋ nan daɩ á maama.»

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi maŋɩ o ye wʋlʋ na lagɩ o yǝg-o o pa nɔɔna tɩn. Mʋ kʋ kuri o tagɩ o wɩ, kʋ daɩ ba maama mʋ ba jɩgɩ digiru tɩn.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Zezi na zarɩ ba nɛ sɩm o ti tɩn, o ma joori o zʋ o gɔrɔ kʋm, yɩ o vu o jǝni o jǝŋǝ je nɩ. O laan ma bwe-ba o wɩ: «Abam lwarɩ kʋlʋ amʋ na kɩ dɩ abam tɩn kuri na?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á bǝ amʋ nɩ, Karanyɩna naa á Yuutu mʋ. Abam na bǝ te tɩn kʋ maŋɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ sɩɩnɩ a yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan kɩ a brɩ abam, sɩ á lwǝni amʋ na kɩ abam te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, gambaa tǝrǝ ka na dwe ka tu. Tɩntʋŋnʋ nan tǝrǝ o na dwe wʋlʋ na tʋŋ-o tɩn.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ abam maama taanɩ mʋ a tɛa. A ye balʋ a na kuri tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ kʋ kɩ mʋ. Kʋ tagɩ kʋ wɩ: ‹Wʋlʋ na jǝni o di wʋdiu dɩ amʋ tɩn mʋ joori o zɩgɩ amʋ zɩga.›

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: A nan wuuri a ta a brɩ abam mʋ yɩ kʋ ta wʋ kɩ, sɩ kʋ na tu kʋ kɩ, sɩ á wanɩ á sɛ nɩ amʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋra maŋa maama tɩn.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma fɔɔrɩ o yi Zezi o sal-o, yɩ o bwe o wɩ: «A Yuutu, kʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?»

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o wʋ ma tiini kʋ cɔgɩ kʋ pa o ŋɔɔnɩ jaja o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam dɩdʋa mʋ lagɩ o yǝgi amʋ o pa nɔɔna.»

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ Zezi na soe lanyɩranɩ ba wʋnɩ tɩn maa je o tɩkǝri nɩ.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma yɩgɩsɩ o jɩŋa o brɩ wʋntʋ, sɩ o bwe Zezi o nii, kʋ yɩ wɔɔ taanɩ mʋ o tɛa.

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na je ba di tɩn wʋlʋwʋlʋ ma wʋ lwarɩ Zezi na tagɩ kʋlʋ dɩd-o tɩn kuri.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Zudasɩ nan na nii ba kɔgɔ kʋm sǝbu kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn, ba badaara maa bʋŋɩ nɩ Zezi tʋŋ-o sɩ o vu o yǝgi wʋdiu mʋ sɩ ba ma di candiǝ kam, naa o ga tʋŋ-o sɩ o vu o pa yinigǝ tiinǝ wǝǝnu mʋ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Zudasɩ na joŋi dɩpɛ dɩm tɩn, o ma da o zaŋɩ o nuŋi. Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ tɩtɩɩ nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Wɛ na nɛ zulǝ amʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, DƖ laan wʋ́ pa a na paarɩ-zulǝ DƖ tɩtɩ tee nɩ. Wɛ nan wʋ́ pa a na zulǝ lele kʋntʋ.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: A biǝ-ba, a daa bá tiini a daanɩ abam tee nɩ. Abam nan wʋ́ ba á beeri amʋ jǝgǝ. A nan lagɩ a ta a brɩ abam kʋlʋ a na maŋɩ a ta a brɩ Zwifǝ bam a wɩ, amʋ na lagɩ a vu mɛ tɩn, abam bá wanɩ da á vu.

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta o wɩ: «A yuutu, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ a bá wanɩ a tɔgɩ nmʋ lele kʋntʋ? Amʋ wʋ́ sɛ sɩ a tɩ nmʋ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ n sɛ sɩ n tɩ amʋ ŋwaanɩ na? A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ nmʋ sɩ, kʋ na wʋ́ loori sɩ cɩbwɩʋ keeri tɩn, nmʋ wʋ́ fʋ kuni bɩtɔ nɩ n yǝri amʋ.»

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Zezi laan ma ta dɩ o karabiǝ bam o wɩ: «Á yɩ pa á bɩcara taa maga. Kɩ-na á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, sɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ dɩ.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: A Ko wʋm sɔŋɔ nɩ, je zanzan mʋ wʋra. A nan lagɩ a vu a kwɛ je mʋ a pa abam. Kʋ na daɩ cɩga, a ya bá ta dɩ abam.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: A na ve a kwɛ je sɩm a ti abam ŋwaanɩ, a laan wʋ́ joori a ba a ja abam, sɩ á tɔgɩ á vu á taá wʋ amʋ na wʋ mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Abam nan ye a na maa ve tɩn cwǝŋǝ.»

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Toma ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A yuutu, dɩbam yǝri nmʋ na lagɩ n vu mɛ tɩn. Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ dɩ́ lwarɩ ka cwǝŋǝ?»

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ yɩ cwǝŋǝ dɩ cɩga tu dɩ ŋwɩa tu. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o vu a Ko Wɛ te dɩ o na wʋ dɛ amʋ o vu.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Abam na ye amʋ, á wʋ́ lwarɩ a Ko wʋm dɩ. Lele kʋntʋ abam lwar-o, á nan nɛ-o dɩ.»

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipi ma ta o wɩ: «A yuutu, brɩ dɩbam n Ko wʋm, sɩ kʋntʋ wʋ́ maŋɩ dɩbam.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Filipi, amʋ daanɩ abam tee nɩ yɩ nmʋ ta yǝri amʋ na? Wʋlʋ maama na nɛ amʋ tɩn nɛ amʋ Ko wʋm mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ n ta n wɩ, a brɩ abam a Ko wʋm?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋ sɛ nɩ amʋ wʋra dɩ a Ko yɩ a Ko wʋra dɩ amʋ na? Taanɩ dɩlʋ amʋ na tagɩ a brɩ abam tɩn daɩ amʋ tɩtɩ nyɩm. Kʋ yɩ amʋ Ko wʋm mʋ ŋwɩ amʋ wʋnɩ, yɩ o tʋŋɩ o tɩtʋŋa.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Taá jɩgɩ-na wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ, sɩ amʋ wʋra dɩ a Ko yɩ a Ko wʋra dɩ amʋ. Á na wʋ kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ a taanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ, á weeni á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ amʋ na tʋŋɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn wʋ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ doŋ amʋ na tʋŋɩ tɩn. O nan wʋ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunǝ sɩ ya taa dwe amʋ na kɩ te tɩn, amʋ na lagɩ a vu a Ko te tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ maama abam na wʋ́ loori amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, aá kɩ-kʋ a pa abam sɩ a Ko Wɛ na zulǝ amʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Abam na loori woŋo kʋlʋ maama amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ kɩ-kʋ a pa abam.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Abam na soe amʋ, á wʋ́ sɛ a niǝ yam.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: A nan wʋ́ loori a Ko wʋm sɩ o pa abam Zǝnnu wʋdoŋ. Wʋntʋ wʋ́ ta wʋ abam tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tu tɩn. Nɔɔna balʋ kugu je na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn bá wanɩ ba sɛ-o, bɛŋwaanɩ ba bá wanɩ ba na-o, yɩ ba bá wanɩ ba lwar-o dɩ. Kʋ daarɩ abam nan ye-o, bɛŋwaanɩ o wʋra dɩ abam, yɩ oó ta ŋwɩ abam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: Amʋ bá yagɩ abam á yɩranɩ. Aá joori a ba abam te.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn, lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam daa bá na amʋ. Abam nan wʋ́ na-nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, amʋ na jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, abam dɩ wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ á wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ a wʋra dɩ a Ko Wɛ, yɩ abam dɩ wʋra dɩ amʋ, yɩ amʋ dɩ wʋra dɩ abam.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na sɛ a niǝ yam yɩ o tɔgɩ-ya tɩn mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na soe amʋ tɩn. A Ko Wɛ wʋ́ ta soe kʋntʋ tu. A dɩ nan wʋ́ ta so-o, yɩ a kwǝri a pa o lwarɩ amʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɩ yɩrɩ na yɩ Zudasɩ yɩ kʋ daɩ Zudasɩ Yiskarɩyo tɩn ma lǝri o wɩ: «A yuutu, nmʋ wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ n pa dɩbam lwarɩ nmʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam bá lwarɩ?»

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na soe amʋ tɩn wʋ́ sɛ o kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ. A Ko wʋ́ ta soe kʋntʋ tu, yɩ amʋ dɩ a Ko wʋ́ ba o te dɩ́ taá wʋra dɩd-o.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na ba soe amʋ tɩn bá sɛ o kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Taanɩ dɩlʋ abam nan na ni tɩn daɩ amʋ nyɩm, dɩ nuŋi a Ko wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn te mʋ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: A maŋɩ a ta wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ a brɩ abam maŋa kam a ta na wʋ abam tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, Zǝnnu wʋlʋ na wʋ́ ba abam te tɩn, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm a Ko Wɛ na wʋ́ tʋŋɩ sɩ kʋ ba amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ brɩ abam woŋo maama, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa á guli kʋlʋ maama amʋ na maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Amʋ yagɩ wʋ-zuru mʋ a pa abam. Kʋ yɩ amʋ tɩtɩ wʋ-zuru mʋ a pɛ abam. Amʋ na pɛ abam wʋ-zuru kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm. Á yɩ pa á bɩcara taa maga, á nan yɩ taá jɩgɩ liǝ dɩ.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ á ni amʋ na tagɩ dɩ abam nɩ, a lagɩ a viiri, yɩ a ta wʋ́ joori a ba abam te. Abam ya na soe amʋ, á wʋ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩdaanɩ amʋ na lagɩ a vu a Ko Wɛ te tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ a Ko Wɛ dwe amʋ.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a brɩ abam lele kʋntʋ yɩ tɩ daa ta wʋ kɩ, sɩ tɩ na tu tɩ kɩ, sɩ á wanɩ á sɛ a taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa bá ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ zanzan dɩ abam, lʋgʋ baŋa pɛ sʋtaanɩ na maa bɩɩnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ nan bá jɩgɩ dam dɩ amʋ.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: A nan maŋɩ sɩ a pa lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna lwarɩ nɩ a soe a Ko wʋm, kʋntʋ mʋ a kɩ kʋlʋ maama a Ko na pɛ-nɩ ni sɩ a kɩ tɩn mʋ. Á zaŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ viiri.»

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ yɩ vinyǝ tiu cɩga cɩga. A Ko maa yɩ tiu kʋm tu, yɩ o nii kʋ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Naga kalʋ na nuŋi tiu kʋm yɩra nɩ yɩ ka ba lǝri biǝ tɩn, oó go-ka o yagɩ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ naga kalʋ na lǝri biǝ tɩn, oó farɩsɩ-ka mʋ, sɩ ka taa lana, sɩ ka taa fɔgɩ ka lǝri biǝ zanzan.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Taá wʋra dɩ amʋ, sɩ amʋ dɩ wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ abam wʋnɩ. Tiu naga bá wanɩ ka lǝ biǝ ka yɩranɩ yɩ ka tǝri tiu kʋm yɩra nɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ abam. Abam maŋɩ sɩ á taá wʋra dɩ amʋ mʋ, sɩ á laan wanɩ á taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
