translation_verse: Amʋ mʋ yɩ tiu kʋm, yɩ abam yɩ kʋ nɛ sɩm. Wʋlʋ maama na wʋra dɩ amʋ yɩ amʋ ŋwɩ kʋntʋ tu wʋnɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta kɩ kǝm-laarʋ mʋ, nɩ naga kalʋ na lǝri biǝ zanzan tɩn. Amʋ nan na tǝri á bɩcara nɩ, á bá wanɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ á kɩ.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na tǝrǝ dɩ amʋ tɩn nyɩ dɩ tiu naga kalʋ ba na goni ba yagɩ yɩ ka kʋ tɩn mʋ. Tiu nɛ sɩlʋ na kʋgɩ tɩn, baá pɛ-sɩ ba kɩ mini nɩ mʋ yɩ sɩ di.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Abam nan na wʋra dɩ amʋ, yɩ amʋ taanɩ dɩm na wʋ á bɩcara nɩ, á wʋ́ wanɩ á loori kʋlʋ maama á wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn, yɩ á wʋ́ na-kʋ.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Nɩnɛɛnɩ a Ko na soe amʋ te tɩn, amʋ dɩ soe abam kʋntʋ mʋ. Taá jɩgɩ-na amʋ sono kʋm á bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, á wʋ́ wanɩ á taá jɩgɩ amʋ sono kʋm kʋntʋ, nɩ amʋ dɩ na kɩ a Ko na tagɩ kʋlʋ yɩ a jɩgɩ o sono kʋm a bɩcarɩ nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: A tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a brɩ abam, sɩ wʋpolo kʋlʋ a na jɩgɩ tɩn mʋ taa wʋ abam wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ pa abam wʋpolo kʋm ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Ni dɩlʋ amʋ na lagɩ a pa abam tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Á taá soe daanɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ a na soe abam te tɩn.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Sono tǝrǝ kʋ na dwe tɩntʋ, sɩ nɔɔnʋ sɛ sɩ o tɩ o donnǝ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, á wʋ́ ta yɩ a cilonnǝ mʋ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa bá ta bǝ abam nɩ a tɩntʋŋna. Bɛŋwaanɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ yǝri kʋlʋ o yuutu na lagɩ o kɩ tɩn. Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, a tagɩ kʋlʋ maama a na ni a Ko Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn a brɩ abam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a laan bǝ abam nɩ a cilonnǝ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ abam mʋ kuri amʋ. Kʋ yɩ amʋ mʋ kuri abam, yɩ a daarɩ a pa abam ni sɩ á taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ. Kǝm-laarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ wʋ́ ta wʋra maŋa maama. Abam na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ, a Ko wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ maama á na wʋ́ loori o tee nɩ amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Abam ya na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm, kʋ nɔɔna bam ya wʋ́ ta soe abam, á na yɩ kʋ nyɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Amʋ nan mʋ kuri abam lʋgʋ nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ, yɩ á daa daɩ ba nyɩm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ balʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna tɩn wʋ́ ta culi abam.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Guli-na a na maŋɩ a ta kʋlʋ a brɩ abam tɩn: Tɩntʋŋnʋ tǝrǝ o na dwe o yuutu. Ba na yaarɩ amʋ tɩn, baá yaarɩ abam dɩ mʋ. Ba nan na sɛ amʋ ni-taanɩ dɩm, baá sɛ abam dɩ ni-taanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ́ kɩ abam tɩntʋ wǝǝnu tɩm maama amʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba yǝri wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya na wʋ tu a ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga a brɩ-ba, lwarɩm ya bá ta wʋ ba yuu nɩ. Lele kʋntʋ ba nan daa bá wanɩ ba ta nɩ ba jɩgɩ bʋra.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na culi amʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu culi a Ko wʋm dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Amʋ kɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna yalʋ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ta na wʋ kɩ ya doŋ tɩn a brɩ-ba. A ya na wʋ kɩ a brɩ-ba, lwarɩm ya bá ta wʋ ba yuu nɩ. Ba nan nɛ a na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ ba ta culi amʋ dɩ a Ko wʋm maama.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan kɩ sɩ kʋ pa kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ, dɩ kʋ na wɩ: ‹Ba culi amʋ, yɩ a wʋ kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ.›

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Zǝnnu wʋm nan wʋ́ nuŋi a Ko te o ba. Wʋm mʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tu tɩn. A nan wʋ́ tʋŋ-o yɩ o ba abam te, yɩ o laan wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ a cɩga kam o brɩ abam.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Abam dɩ nan wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ a cɩga kam taanɩ á brɩ nɔɔna, bɛŋwaanɩ abam maŋɩ á wʋra dɩ amʋ pulim nɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: «A nan ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a brɩ abam sɩ kʋ pa á yɩ zaŋɩ á yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm mʋ.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ́ lɩ abam ba Wɛ-di sɩm wʋnɩ. Maŋa nan wʋ́ ba ka yi, yɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ gʋ abam, yɩ ba bʋŋɩ nɩ ba tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋm mʋ ba pa Wɛ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ́ kɩ abam wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba yǝri a Ko wʋm, ba nan yǝri amʋ dɩ.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: A tɛ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama a brɩ abam, sɩ maŋa kam na yiǝ ba na kɩ abam kʋntʋ, sɩ á wanɩ á guli nɩ amʋ maŋɩ a ta-tɩ a brɩ abam.» Wɛ Joro kʋm na wʋ́ brɩ nɔɔna cɩga te tɩn «A wʋ tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ a brɩ abam pulim nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ya wʋ abam tee nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ a lagɩ a vu wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ tɩn te. Abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ nan wʋ bwe-nɩ á nii, a lagɩ a vu yǝn mʋ?

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, amʋ na viiri, kʋʋ́ ta lana kʋ pa abam. Bɛŋwaanɩ, amʋ na wʋ viiri, Zǝnnu wʋm bá ba abam te. A nan na veǝ, a laan wʋ́ tʋŋ-o yɩ o ba abam te.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: O nan na tuǝ, oó pa lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna lwarɩ nɩ ba tusi mʋ ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ, dɩ Wɛ cɩga kam laŋa nɩ, dɩ Wɛ na wʋ́ di nɔɔna taanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: Oó brɩ-ba nɩ ba na wʋ sɛ amʋ tɩn ba kɩ lwarɩm mʋ.

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: Oó brɩ-ba nɩ ba tusi Wɛ cɩga kam wʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ lagɩ a vu a Ko Wɛ te, yɩ á daa bá na-nɩ.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: O ta wʋ́ brɩ-ba nɩ ba tusi Wɛ sarɩya dim dɩm wʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pɛ wʋm tɩn maŋɩ o ga bʋra.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya ta jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan sɩ a ta a brɩ abam, tɩ nan wʋ́ ta tiini tɩ camma dɩ abam lele.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. Kʋ na tuǝ, kʋ laan wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ cɩga kam maama. Kʋ nan daɩ kʋ tɩtɩ taanɩ mʋ kʋ lagɩ kʋ ŋɔɔnɩ. Kʋʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ kʋ na ni Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn mʋ, kʋ ma daarɩ kʋ ta wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na lagɩ tɩ ba tɩn kʋ brɩ abam.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan wʋ́ pa amʋ na zulǝ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋʋ́ brɩ abam amʋ cɩga kam maama.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: A Ko wʋm na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn yɩ amʋ dɩ nyɩm mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tagɩ a wɩ, DƖ Joro kʋm wʋ́ brɩ abam amʋ cɩga kam maama.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn, abam daa bá na amʋ, yɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn na wǝli da, á wʋ́ joori á na-nɩ, [a na maa ve a Ko te tɩn ŋwaanɩ.]» Wʋ-cɔgɔ na wʋ́ lǝni kʋ ji wʋpolo te tɩn

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o karabiǝ badaara maa tɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «O na tagɩ o wɩ, kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn dɩ́ daa bá na-o, yɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn na wǝli da dɩ́ daa wʋ́ joori dɩ́ na-o tɩn, kʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ? O na tagɩ o wɩ, o lagɩ o vu o Ko te tɩn, dɩ́ yǝri kʋ kuri.»

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Ba ta maa tiini ba bwɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «O na tagɩ o wɩ, kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn tɩn, kʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ? Dɩ́ yǝri o na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn kuri.»

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lwarɩ nɩ ba lagɩ sɩ ba bwe-o taanɩ dɩm kuri. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A na tagɩ a wɩ, kʋ na kɩ fɩɩn á daa bá na-nɩ, yɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn na wǝli da á wʋ́ joori á na-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ á bwɛ daanɩ na?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, abam wʋ́ ba á keeri á coosi. Kʋ daarɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Abam wʋrʋ wʋ́ ba tɩ cɔgɩ, yɩ á wʋ-cɔgɔ kʋm laan wʋ́ lǝni kʋ ji wʋpolo.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ kaanɩ na lagɩ o lʋ bu tɩn, o jɩgɩ liǝ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o canɛɛrɩ maŋa yiǝ. O nan na lʋgɩ bu wʋm, o laan wʋ́ swe o cam dɩm ni nɩ, yɩ o jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ o na lʋgɩ bu wʋm tɩn.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ abam dɩ. Lele kʋntʋ á jɩgɩ liǝ. Amʋ nan daa ta wʋ́ joori a na abam, yɩ kʋ pa á tiini á na wʋpolo, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa bá wanɩ-kʋ o cɔgɩ.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ na yiǝ, abam daa bá bwe amʋ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, a Ko wʋm wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ maama abam na wʋ́ loori amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Abam nan ta maŋɩ á wʋ loori kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ amʋ yɩrɩ. Nan loori-na, sɩ á wʋ́ na, sɩ kʋ pa abam wʋpolo kʋm tiini kʋ gaalɩ.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: A na tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a brɩ abam tɩn, kʋ yɩ mɩmaŋa mʋ a mɛ a ta. Maŋa nan wʋ́ ba, yɩ a daa bá maŋɩ mɩmaŋa a ma brɩ abam. A laan wʋ́ ba a ŋɔɔnɩ a Ko Wɛ taanɩ dɩm jaja mʋ a brɩ abam.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, amʋ daa bá loori a Ko Wɛ abam ŋwaanɩ. Abam mʋ wʋ́ loori-DƖ amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ maŋɩ DƖ soe abam, abam na soe amʋ yɩ á kwǝri á sɛ nɩ a nuŋi DƖ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Amʋ sɩɩnɩ a nuŋi a Ko Baŋa-Wɛ te mʋ a ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Lele kʋntʋ a nan lagɩ a yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ a joori a vu DƖ te.»

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o karabiǝ bam laan ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Nii, nmʋ laan ŋɔɔnɩ jaja mʋ, n daa wʋ mɛ mɩmaŋa n maŋɩ.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ, dɩ́ laan lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ ye woŋo maama. Nmʋ daa n ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bwe-m taanɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩbam sɛ nɩ nmʋ sɩɩnɩ n nuŋi Wɛ te.»

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Lele kʋntʋ á laan sɛ na?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Nii-na, maŋa maa bɩɩnɩ, ka nan yi ka ti, yɩ abam wʋ́ jagɩ, yɩ á dɩdʋa dɩdʋa wʋ́ joori o kwe o cwǝŋǝ o daarɩ amʋ yɩranɩ. A nan bá ta yɩ a yɩranɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ a Ko wʋm wʋ́ ta wʋ a tee nɩ.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Amʋ tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a brɩ abam sɩ kʋ pa á na wʋ-zuru mʋ amʋ tɔgɩm dɩm wʋnɩ. Lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ á wʋ́ na yaara. Nan taá jɩgɩ-na pu-dɩa, sɩ amʋ wanɩ lʋgʋ.»

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Zezi na tagɩ taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o ma kwǝni o yuu wɛɛnɩ yɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ Ko, a tʋʋnɩ maŋa kam laan yiǝ. Amʋ yɩ nmʋ Bu mʋ. Nan pa a na zulǝ, sɩ amʋ dɩ wʋ́ pa n na zulǝ.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ pɛ-nɩ dam nabiinǝ maama baŋa nɩ, sɩ a wanɩ a pa balʋ maama nmʋ na pɛ-nɩ tɩn na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ nabiinǝ wanɩ ba lwarɩ nmʋ wʋlʋ yɩranɩ na yɩ Cɩga Tu Baŋa-Wɛ tɩn, sɩ ba daarɩ ba taa ye amʋ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ nmʋ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: A pɛ nɔɔna lwarɩ nmʋ zulǝ yam lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. A ti tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm nmʋ na pɛ-nɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Amʋ Ko, pa a na paarɩ-zulǝ nmʋ tee nɩ lele kʋntʋ, paarɩ-zulǝ yalʋ a na maŋɩ a jɩgɩ dɩ nmʋ kʋ loori lʋgʋ baŋa ta na wʋ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: Amʋ pɛ nɔɔna balʋ nmʋ na kuri lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ n kɩ amʋ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn lwarɩ nmʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ. Bantʋ yɩ nmʋ nyɩm mʋ, yɩ n kwe-ba n kɩ amʋ jɩŋa nɩ. Ba nan sɛ nmʋ ni-taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ ba lwarɩ nɩ, kʋlʋ maama nmʋ na pɛ amʋ tɩn nuŋi nmʋ te mʋ.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kwǝrǝ kalʋ nmʋ na pɛ amʋ tɩn mʋ a pɛ-ba, yɩ ba sɛ. Ba nan lwarɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ amʋ nuŋi nmʋ te mʋ, yɩ ba ta sɛ nɩ nmʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: A nan loori nmʋ bantʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ a ba loori nmʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ yɩ nɔɔna balʋ nmʋ na kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ bantʋ yɩ nmʋ nyɩm mʋ.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa bá ta wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, bantʋ nan ta wʋra mʋ. A maa bɩɩnɩ nmʋ te mʋ. Amʋ Ko, Wʋ-poŋo Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, maɩ nmʋ yɩrɩ dam dɩm n ta n maɩ n nii n nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ, yɩrɩ dɩlʋ nmʋ na pɛ amʋ tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa ba taa yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa, nɩ nmʋ dɩ amʋ na yɩ dɩdʋa te tɩn.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: A na wʋra dɩ ba maŋa kalʋ tɩn, nmʋ yɩrɩ dam dɩm n na pɛ-nɩ tɩn mʋ a mɛ a nii ba baŋa nɩ, a ma cɩ-ba yɩ ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ wʋ je, kʋ na daɩ wʋlʋ wʋm na maŋɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ tɩn yɩranɩ. Nmʋ tɔnɔ kʋm brɩ nɩ wʋntʋ maŋɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ amʋ maa bɩɩnɩ nmʋ te, a nan tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa nmʋ nɔɔna bam taa jɩgɩ amʋ wʋpolo kʋm doŋ ba wʋnɩ, sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ gaalɩ.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: A ma pa-ba nmʋ taanɩ dɩm. Balʋ kugu je na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn ma culi-ba, ba na daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ, nɩ amʋ dɩ na daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm te tɩn.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ a loori nmʋ sɩ n lɩ-ba lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. A loori nmʋ sɩ n cɩ-ba sʋtaanɩ na yɩ wo-lwaanʋ tu tɩn jɩŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Ba daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm, nɩ amʋ dɩ na daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm te tɩn.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ n kwɛ-ba dɩ n cɩga kam sɩ ba taa yɩ nmʋ nyɩm. Nmʋ taanɩ dɩm yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Amʋ tʋŋɩ-ba lʋgʋ wʋnɩ, nɩ nmʋ dɩ na tʋŋɩ amʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bantʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kwe a tɩtɩ a kɩ nmʋ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa bantʋ dɩ wanɩ ba taa yɩ nmʋ nyɩm cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: A nan ba loori nmʋ a paɩ bantʋ yɩranɩ má, kʋ yɩ balʋ dɩ na wʋ́ ba ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ bantʋ taanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: A nan loori nmʋ, sɩ kʋ pa ba maama taa yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ. Amʋ Ko, nmʋ ŋwɩ amʋ wʋnɩ, yɩ amʋ dɩ ŋwɩ nmʋ wʋnɩ. Nan pa bantʋ dɩ taa ŋwɩ dɩ dɩbam kʋntʋ doŋ, sɩ ba taa yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa, sɩ kʋ pa lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna sɛ nɩ nmʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: A pɛ-ba zulǝ yalʋ nmʋ na pɛ amʋ tɩn, sɩ ba wanɩ ba taa yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa, nɩ amʋ dɩ nmʋ na yɩ dɩdʋa te tɩn.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Amʋ ŋwɩ ba wʋnɩ yɩ nmʋ ŋwɩ amʋ wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ pa ba sɩɩnɩ ba taa yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa, sɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna wanɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ mʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ, yɩ nmʋ soe nmʋ nɔɔna bam, nɩnɛɛnɩ nmʋ na soe amʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Amʋ Ko, a lagɩ sɩ balʋ nmʋ na kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ tɩn taa tɔgɩ ba wʋ amʋ na wʋ mɛ tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa ba na amʋ paarɩ-zulǝ yalʋ nmʋ na pɛ-nɩ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ maŋɩ n soe amʋ kʋ loori lʋgʋ baŋa daa ta na wʋ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Amʋ Ko, nmʋ yɩ Cɩga Tu. Lʋgʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam nan yǝri nmʋ. A nan ye nmʋ, yɩ a nɔɔna bam dɩ ye nɩ nmʋ tʋŋɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan pɛ ba lwarɩ nmʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ a daa ta wʋ́ pa ba lwarɩ nmʋ, sɩ kʋ pa sono kʋlʋ nmʋ na jɩgɩ amʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn taa wʋ ba wʋnɩ, sɩ amʋ tɩtɩ taa ŋwɩ ba wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm tɩntʋŋnʋ dɩdʋa, wʋlʋ cʋrʋ Pɩyɛɛrɩ na zagɩ o zwɛ o go tɩn, ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ nɛ abam daanɩ gaarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ na?»

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: O ma joori o bwe-ba o wɩ: «Wɔɔ mʋ abam laga?» Ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Zezi wʋlʋ na yɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu tɩn mʋ dɩ́ laga.»

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A maŋɩ a ta a brɩ abam nɩ, amʋ mʋ kʋntʋ. Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ mʋ á laga, sɩ á yagɩ bantʋ sɩ ba viiri.»

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ maa jɩgɩ sʋ-lɔŋɔ. O ma lɩ-kʋ o ma zagɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm tɩntʋŋnʋ jazɩm zwɛ o go. Tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Malɩkusi.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam kɔgɔ kʋm dɩ ba dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm dɩ Zwifǝ bam nɔɔna bam laan ma ja Zezi ba vɔ.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma maŋɩ mancoŋo ni nɩ o zɩga. Zezi karabu wʋlʋ dɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm na ye daanɩ tɩn ma joori o nuŋi o ta dɩ bɩsankana kalʋ na nii mancoŋo kʋm ni dɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn, yɩ o daarɩ o ja Pɩyɛɛrɩ o zʋ.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Bɩsankana kam ma bwe Pɩyɛɛrɩ ka wɩ: «Nmʋ tɔgɩ n yɩ Zezi karabu mʋ na?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A daɩ o karabu.»

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Waarʋ dɛɛn ma wʋra. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ nɔɔna bam ma dwe mini ba zɩgɩ ba weerǝ. Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ ma vu o tɔgɩ o zɩgɩ da o weeri mini dɩm. Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm na bwe Zezi taanɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm laan ma bwe Zezi o karabiǝ bam laŋa, dɩ o zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ n bwe amʋ sɩ n nii? Nan bwe balʋ na cǝgi amʋ taanɩ dɩm tɩn n nii a na tagɩ kʋlʋ dɩ ba tɩn, sɩ bantʋ mʋ ye a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Annɩ laan ma pa ba ja-o ba vu Kayifu wʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu tɩn te, yɩ ba ta wʋ bwǝl-o. Pɩyɛɛrɩ ta na joori o fʋ nɩ o yǝri Zezi te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ja Zezi ba nuŋi Kayifu sɔŋɔ nɩ ba vu Rom gʋvɩrma tu wʋm sɔŋɔ. Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ mʋ. Zwifǝ bam ma wʋ dɛ ba zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ ba cullu tɩm ŋwaanɩ. Ba maŋɩ sɩ ba cɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ digiru sɩ ba wanɩ ba na cwǝŋǝ ba di Pakɩ candiǝ kam.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Gʋvɩrma tu Pilatɩ ma nuŋi ba te, yɩ o bwe-ba o wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam saŋɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ?»

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ ya na wʋ kɩ o cɔgɩ, dɩ́ ya bá ja-o dɩ́ ba nmʋ te.»

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ laan ma joori o zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ o bǝŋi Zezi, yɩ o bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ mʋ na?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Zezi ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa taanɩ mʋ naa nɔɔna mʋ tagɩ a taanɩ dɩ nmʋ?»

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri o wɩ: «Amʋ daɩ Zwifu. Kʋ yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ dwi tiinǝ dɩ ba kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam mʋ jaanɩ nmʋ ba ba ba kɩ amʋ jɩŋa nɩ. Kɔɔ mʋ n kɩa?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Amʋ paarɩ dɩm wʋ nuŋi lʋgʋ baŋa, sɩ dɩ ya na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm, a nɔɔna bam ya wʋ́ kɩ jara sɩ ba cɩ sɩ Zwifǝ bam yɩ wanɩ ba ja amʋ. Kʋ nan na yɩ te tɩn, amʋ paarɩ dɩm daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm.»

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ, nmʋ za yɩ pɛ mʋ na?» Zezi ma lǝri o wɩ: «Nmʋ tɩtɩ mʋ tagɩ n wɩ, a yɩ pɛ. A tu sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga mʋ a brɩ nɔɔna lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba lʋgɩ amʋ. Wʋlʋ maama na yɩ cɩga nɔɔnʋ tɩn mʋ cǝgi amʋ taanɩ.»

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Abam nan yǝni á jɩgɩ mɩʋ kʋdoŋ: Pakɩ candiǝ kam maŋa nɩ, amʋ yǝni a lɩ abam pɩɩnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ a yagɩ yɩ o viiri. Abam nan lagɩ sɩ a yagɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ wʋm mʋ na?»

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Ba ma kaasɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ wʋntʋ, kʋ yɩ Barabasɩ mʋ dɩ́ laga sɩ n yagɩ.» Barabasɩ ya yɩ nɔn-vɩrnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ laan ma pa ba ja Zezi ba magɩ dɩ balaara.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam ma kɩ sabarɩ ba ma sɔ yipugǝ ba pu o yuu nɩ. Ba ma kwe gwar-sʋŋʋ ba zʋ-o, yɩ ba mwan-o.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Ba maa ve o te, yɩ ba tɛ dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Zwifǝ bam pɛ, dɩnle», yɩ ba lɔɛ o pʋpwaanʋ.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ daa ta ma joori o nuŋi pooni, yɩ o ta dɩ kɔgɔ kʋm o wɩ: «Nii-na, aá pa nɔɔnʋ wʋm nuŋi o ba o zɩgɩ abam yigǝ nɩ, sɩ á wanɩ á lwarɩ nɩ amʋ wʋ nɛ o na kɩ kʋlʋ o cɔgɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Zezi ma nuŋi dɩ o yuu sabarɩ yipugǝ kam dɩ o gwar-sʋŋʋ kʋm. Pilatɩ ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Nii-na nɔɔnʋ wʋm da.»

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba nɔɔna bam na nɛ-o tɩn, ba maa tɛ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ n gʋ. Pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ n gʋ.» Pilatɩ ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam tɩtɩ nan ja-o á pa dagara baŋa nɩ á gʋ, sɩ amʋ wʋ nɛ kʋlʋ o na cɔgɩ sɩ a ma di o taanɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam ma joori ba lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam jɩgɩ culu kʋlʋ na brɩ nɩ o maŋɩ sɩ o tɩ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ o brɩ o tɩtɩ nɩ o yɩ Wɛ Bu mʋ.»

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Pilatɩ na ni ba na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma tiini dɩ zʋ-o.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: O ma joori o zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ, yɩ o bwe Zezi o wɩ: «Nmʋ nuŋi yǝn mʋ?» Zezi maa cɩm yɩ o wʋ lǝr-o kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ ba lagɩ sɩ n lǝri amʋ na? Nmʋ yǝri nɩ amʋ jɩgɩ dam sɩ a pa ba yagɩ-m naa sɩ a pa ba pa-m tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ na?»

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ ya n ba jɩgɩ dam amʋ baŋa nɩ, kʋ na daɩ dam dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-m tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jaanɩ amʋ o kɩ nmʋ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ tiini o kɩ wo-lɔŋɔ o dwǝni nmʋ.»

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Pilatɩ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o maa kwaanɩ o lagɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o pa ba yagɩ Zezi. Kʋ daarɩ Zwifǝ bam maa tiini ba tɛ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Nmʋ na yagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ brɩ nɩ n culi lʋgʋ kʋm pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na pɛ o tɩtɩ paarɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu yɩ pa-farʋ wʋm dʋm mʋ.»

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma pa ba ja Zezi ba nuŋi, yɩ o daarɩ o jǝni taanɩ dim jǝŋǝ kam je nɩ. Ba bǝ jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ, Kandwa-pulwaarʋ je mʋ. Ka yɩrɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam taanɩ mʋ yɩ Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ mʋ, dɛ dɩm tɩga na wʋ́ pʋʋrɩ sɩ Pakɩ candiǝ kam di tɩn. Pilatɩ laan ma ta dɩ Zwifǝ bam o wɩ: «Nii-na á pɛ wʋm.»

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilatɩ laan ma kɩ Zezi pamaŋna bam jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ. Ba na jaanɩ Zezi ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, pamaŋna bam ma vu balʋ ba na pagɩ ba wǝli dɩ Zezi tɩn te, yɩ ba magɩ dayigǝ nɔɔnʋ wʋm nɛ ba bwǝri, dɩ o doŋ wʋm nɛ.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam na nɛ tɩn, ba ma vu ba ta dɩ Pilatɩ ba wɩ: «Kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ n pʋpʋnɩ nɩ ‹Zwifǝ bam pɛ›. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ n pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: ‹Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ mʋ brɩ o tɩtɩ o wɩ, o yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ mʋ.› »

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Zezi na nɛ o nu wʋm dɩ o karabu wʋlʋ o na soe lanyɩranɩ ba zɩgɩ da tɩn, o ma ta dɩ o nu wʋm o wɩ: «A nu, nii wʋntʋ laan mʋ yɩ n bu.»

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ dáanɩ mʋ ba pag-o tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ. Ba ma ja nɔɔna badonnǝ bale dɩ, ba pa dagarɩ baŋa nɩ. Zezi maa wʋ bantʋ bale tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Pilatɩ ma pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ o pa ba tanɩ-kʋ dagara kam yuu nɩ. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi wʋlʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ bam pɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam zanzan ma karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋm, bɛŋwaanɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ ba na pagɩ Zezi da tɩn batwarɩ dɩ tɩʋ kʋm ni. Kʋ ma pʋpʋnɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam taanɩ dɩ Rom tiinǝ taanɩ dɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ taanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ te tɩn maŋɩ.»

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ta daanɩ ba wɩ: «Yɩ pa-na dɩ́ kaarɩ-kʋ. Nan pa-na dɩ́ ta jɔrɔ sɩ dɩ́ nii wʋlʋ na wʋ́ joŋi-kʋ tɩn.» Kʋ dɛɛn kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ, nɩ kʋ na wɩ: «Ba cɛ amʋ gwaarʋ ba pa daanɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba ta jɔrɔ amʋ gwar-bu wʋm ŋwaanɩ.» Pamaŋna bam ma sɩɩnɩ ba kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Balʋ dɛɛn na zɩgɩ ba batwarɩ dɩ Zezi dagara kam tɩn mʋ yɩ o nu wʋm dɩ o nu nyaanɩ, dɩ Mari wʋlʋ na yɩ Klopasɩ kaanɩ tɩn, dɩ Mari wʋlʋ na nuŋi Magɩdala tɩn.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi Zezi. Ba ma na nɩ o maŋɩ o tɩ mʋ, yɩ ba daa wʋ bwǝri wʋntʋ nɛ.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Gaara mʋ wʋ jǝgǝ kalʋ ba na pagɩ Zezi dagara baŋa nɩ tɩn. Piu ma wʋ gaara yam wʋnɩ, bɔn-dʋʋrɩ maa wʋ piu kʋm yɩra nɩ ba ta na wʋ kɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ da.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ Zezi maa ye nɩ woŋo maama kɩ kʋ ti. O maa wɩ, na-nyɔm jɩg-o. O tagɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ.

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Zʋŋa dɛɛn mʋ zɩgɩ da, ka na su dɩ sana kalʋ na nywana tɩn. Ba ma kwe sɩpɔɔ ba dɩ sana kam wʋnɩ, yɩ ba vɔ-kʋ miu ni nɩ ba te ba pa kʋ yi Zezi ni.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Zezi na laŋɩ sa-nywana kam tɩn, o ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋ laan kɩ kʋ ti.» O ma daarɩ o cɔɔlɩ o yuu tɩga nɩ, yɩ o pa o siun ti.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ dɛ dɩlʋ Zwifǝ bam na yǝni ba ti ba yigǝ sɩ ba siun dɛ dɩm laan yi tɩn mʋ. Tɩga na wʋ́ pʋʋrɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ ba siun dɛ kamunu kʋm tɩn, ba maa ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna bam yɩra yam taa wʋ dagarɩ sɩm baŋa nɩ dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam ma vu Pilatɩ te, ba ta dɩd-o sɩ o pa cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba bwǝri nɔɔna bam nɛ sɩ ba tɩ, sɩ ba laan parɩ-ba ba kɩ.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ pamaŋnʋ dɩdʋa ma kwe o cicwe o ma zɔ Zezi saŋa nɩ. Jana dɩ na ma da ba nuŋǝ.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ yi na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋ woŋo, sɩ kʋ pa abam dɩ wanɩ á sɛ. O nan ye nɩ o na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ, yɩ o zɩgɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ nan kɩ sɩ kʋ pa kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ, nɩ kʋ na wɩ: «O kuǝ dɩ dɩdʋa dɩ bá bwǝri.»

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm ta tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔna wʋ́ fɔgɩ ba nii wʋlʋ wʋm ba na zɔgɩ tɩn.» Ba na kwe Zezi ba kɩ bɔɔnɩ nɩ te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ dɛ dɩlʋ tɩga na wʋ́ pʋʋrɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ ba siun dɛ dɩm tɩn, ba ma kwe Zezi ba tiŋi bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, dɩ je na batwarɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ na nuŋi Arimatɩ o yɩrɩ mʋ Zʋzɛfʋ tɩn ma zaŋɩ o vu Pilatɩ te. O dɛɛn yɩ Zezi karabu mʋ, yɩ o ba brɩ o tɩtɩ jaja o na kwarɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O ma vu o bwe Pilatɩ sɩ o nii, oó wanɩ o kwe Zezi yɩra yam na. Pilatɩ ma sɛ sɩ o kwe. Zʋzɛfʋ ma vu o par-o dagara kam yuu nɩ.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ dɩ Nikodɛm ma kwe Zezi yɩra yam ba turi-ya dɩ tralɩ nugǝ kam, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pri-o dɩ gar-jalɩ, nɩ Zwifǝ bam na yǝni ba kɩ ba twa te tɩn.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Toma ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ a Yuutu dɩ amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ.»

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩlʋ na saŋɩ ba siun dɛ dɩm tɩn, Mari wʋlʋ na nuŋi Magɩdala tɩn ma zaŋɩ o go tɩga o vu Zezi yibeeli dɩm jǝgǝ. O ma na nɩ kandwɛ dɩlʋ ya na pɩ bɔɔnɩ dɩm ni tɩn tigi daa nɩ.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Karabu wʋlʋ ya na yi da yigǝ tɩn dɩ laan ma zʋ bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋ. O ma na kʋlʋ na wʋra tɩn, yɩ o daarɩ o sɛ nɩ kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Toma wʋlʋ ba na ma bǝ nɩ Yiywɛ yɩ o wʋ Zezi karabiǝ fugǝ-bale bam wʋnɩ tɩn ya tǝrǝ maŋa kam Zezi na tu o karabiǝ bam te tɩn.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: O ma na malɛsɩ sɩle na zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu, sɩ je mɛ seeni Zezi yɩra yam ya na tigi da tɩn. Dɩdʋa maa wʋ o yuu seeni, yɩ kadoŋ kam wʋ o nɛ seeni.

english_verse: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: O ma duri o joori o vu o ta dɩ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ karabu wʋlʋ Zezi na soe tɩn o wɩ: «Ba kwe dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩra yam yibeeli dɩm wʋnɩ, dɩ́ nan yǝri ba na kɩ-o mɛ.»

english_verse: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ karabu wʋdoŋ wʋm ma zaŋɩ ba duri ba maa ve bɔɔnɩ dɩm jǝgǝ. Karabu wʋntʋ ma duri o loori Pɩyɛɛrɩ bɔɔnɩ dɩm ni nɩ.

english_verse: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.
translation_verse: O ma tiiri o nii bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ o na gar-jalɩ dɩm na tigi da, yɩ o wʋ zʋ dɩ wʋ.

english_verse: When Simon Peter got there, he went into the tomb and saw the strips of cloth.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma da o kwaga o ba o yi. O ma kɛ o zʋ bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋ o na gar-jalɩ dɩm na tigi da,

english_verse: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.
translation_verse: yɩ o na gɔrɔ kʋlʋ ba ya na mɛ ba ba Zezi yuu tɩn. Kʋntʋ nan pri mʋ kʋ tigi kʋ yɩra.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down
translation_verse: Mari daa ta maa zɩgɩ yibeeli dɩm ni nɩ o keerǝ. O na keerǝ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma tiiri o nii bɔɔnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The angels asked Mary, “Why are you crying?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord's body! I don't know where they have put him.”
translation_verse: Sɩ ma bwe-o sɩ wɩ: «A nakɔ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n keerǝ?» O ma ta dɩ sɩ o wɩ: «Ba kwe a Yuutu wʋm yɩra yam mʋ ba ja viiri, a nan yǝri ba na kwe-o ba kɩ mɛ.»

english_verse: Jesus asked her, “Why are you crying? Who are you looking for?” She thought he was the gardener and said, “Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma bwe-o o wɩ: «A nakɔ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n keerǝ? Wɔɔ mʋ nmʋ beerǝ?» Mari maa bʋŋɩ nɩ o yɩ gaarɩ dɩm tu mʋ. O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ tu, kʋ na yɩ nmʋ na kwe-o n ja n viiri, sɩ n brɩ-nɩ n na kɩ-o mɛ tɩn, sɩ a vu a kwe-o.»

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Yɩ ta n dwe-nɩ, sɩ amʋ daa ta wʋ joori a vu a Ko wʋm te. Nan ve n ta n brɩ a ko-biǝ bam nɩ, amʋ laan maa ve a Ko wʋm te, wʋlʋ na yɩ abam dɩ Ko tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ, amʋ Tu dɩ abam dɩ Tu.»

english_verse: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma brɩ-ba o jɩa dɩ o saŋa kam. O karabiǝ bam maa tiini ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ ba na nɛ ba Yuutu wʋm tɩn.

english_verse: The disciples were afraid of the Jewish leaders, and on the evening of that same Sunday they locked themselves in a room. Suddenly, Jesus appeared in the middle of the group. He greeted them
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ dɩdaan-ni nɩ mʋ Zezi karabiǝ bam lagɩ daanɩ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa. Ba fɔgɩ ba pɩ digǝ kam ni dɩ borbu, ba na kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ dɩ Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Zezi laan ma da o ba o zɩgɩ ba tɩtarɩ nɩ. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Yazurǝ wʋ́ jǝni dɩ abam.»

english_verse: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, “I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.”
translation_verse: O daa ta ma joori o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Yazurǝ wʋ́ jǝni dɩ abam. A Ko Wɛ na tʋŋɩ-nɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ te tɩn, amʋ dɩ tʋŋɩ abam lʋgʋ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.»

english_verse: Then he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma fuli ba seeni yɩ o wɩ: «Joŋi-na Wɛ Joro kʋm.

english_verse: If you forgive anyone's sins, they will be forgiven. But if you don't forgive their sins, they will not be forgiven.” Jesus and Thomas
translation_verse: Abam na yagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ lwarɩm á ma cɛ-o tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ DƖ yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ kʋ tu. Kʋ daarɩ, abam na wʋ yagɩ á ma cɛ wʋlʋ tɩn, Wɛ dɩ bá yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ-o.» Toma na tu o sɛ Zezi te tɩn

english_verse: So they told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But Thomas said, “First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this!”
translation_verse: Karabiǝ badonnǝ bam ma ta ba brɩ-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam ya nɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm.» O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ yi na wʋ nɛ cɩna yam niǝ o jɩ sɩm nɩ, sɩ a kɩ a nʋa da a nii, sɩ a daarɩ a kɩ a jɩŋa o saŋa kam nɩ, amʋ bá sɛ.»

english_verse: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples
translation_verse: Da nana na kɛ tɩn, Zezi karabiǝ bam daa ma la daanɩ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa, yɩ Toma dɩ laan wʋra. Ba ma fɔgɩ ba pɩ digǝ kam ni dɩ borbu. Zezi ma da o ba o zɩgɩ ba tɩtarɩ nɩ. O ma ta o wɩ: «Yazurǝ wʋ́ jǝni dɩ abam.»

english_verse: and said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at my hands! Put your hand into my side. Stop doubting and have faith!”
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ Toma o wɩ: «Ma n nʋa n taanɩ a jɩ sɩm yo seeni n nii, n daarɩ n tʋrɩ n jɩŋa a saŋa kam nɩ. Yagɩ bʋbwɛa, sɩ n daarɩ n sɛ.»

english_verse: Jesus said, “Thomas, do you have faith because you have seen me? The people who have faith in me without seeing me are the ones who are really blessed!” Why John Wrote His Book
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ na nɛ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ n laan sɛ na? Balʋ nan na sɛ amʋ yɩ ba ta wʋ nɛ-nɩ tɩn mʋ tiini ba jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo.» Woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ Zan na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ tɩn

english_verse: Jesus worked many other miracles for his disciples, and not all of them are written in this book.
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yadonnǝ zanzan o karabiǝ bam tɩtarɩ nɩ, yɩ tɩ maama nan wʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But these are written so that you will put your faith in Jesus as the Messiah and the Son of God. If you have faith in him, you will have true life.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ tɩn yɩ sɩ á wanɩ á sɛ, nɩ Zezi mʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn, yɩ o kwǝri o yɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm. Á nan na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, á wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɛɛn wʋra, dɩ Toma wʋlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Yiywɛ tɩn. Natanayɛlɩ dɩ wʋra, wʋlʋ na nuŋi Galile tɩʋ Kana tɩn, dɩdaanɩ Zebede biǝ bam dɩ Zezi karabiǝ badonnǝ bale. Bantʋ bam maama mʋ wʋ daanɩ.

english_verse: Simon Peter said, “I'm going fishing!” The others said, “We will go with you.” They went out in their boat. But they didn't catch a thing that night.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A maa ve a ja kale mʋ.» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩ nmʋ dɩ́ vu.» Ba ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba zʋ naboro kʋm. Tɩtɩɩ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ ba ma kwaanɩ sɩ ba ja kale, yɩ ba wʋ nɛ kʋlʋkʋlʋ ba ja.

english_verse: Early the next morning Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize who he was.
translation_verse: Tɩga na wʋra ka pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Zezi maa zɩgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ, yɩ ba wʋ lwar-o.

english_verse: So he told them, “Let your net down on the right side of your boat, and you will catch some fish.” They did, and the net was so full of fish that they could not drag it up into the boat.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Nan dɩ-na á bʋra kam naboro kʋm jazɩm seeni, sɩ á wʋ́ ja.» Ba ma sɩɩnɩ ba dɩ bʋra kam, yɩ ba daa warɩ ba vaŋɩ-ka ba lɩ ba dɩ boro kʋm wʋnɩ, kale sɩm na tiini sɩ dagɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, “It's the Lord!” When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.
translation_verse: Zezi karabu wʋlʋ o na soe tɩn ma ta dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ o wɩ: «Dɩbam Yuutu wʋm mʋ.» Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ na lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ ba Yuutu wʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma kwe o gɔrɔ kʋlʋ o ya na lɩ tɩn o zʋ, yɩ o laan daarɩ o faŋɩ o cu na bam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: When the disciples got out of the boat, they saw some bread and a charcoal fire with fish on it.
translation_verse: Ba na bɛ bubɛ dɩm tɩn, ba ma na min-cala na wʋra, yɩ kale wʋ ya yuu nɩ. Dɩpɛ dɩ maa tigi da.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “Bring some of the fish you just caught.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Twǝri-na kale sɩlʋ á na jaanɩ lele tɩn sɩdaara á ja á ba.»

english_verse: Simon Peter got back into the boat and dragged the net to shore. In it were
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma vu o zʋ naboro kʋm wʋ o vaŋɩ bʋra kam o dɩ tɩga nɩ. Ka su dɩ kalǝŋ-kamunǝ mʋ, sɩ maama yɩ bi dɩ fiinnu sɩtɔ mʋ (

english_verse: large fish, but still the net did not rip.
translation_verse: ). Dɩ kale sɩm na daga kʋntʋ tɩn dɩ, bʋra kam wʋ kaarɩ.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Come and eat!” But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Ba-na á gʋ á ni-cɛɛrɩ.» O karabiǝ bam maama ma kwarɩ sɩ ba bwe-o ba nii nɩ o yɩ wɔɔ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba maŋɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ ba Yuutu wʋm mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.
translation_verse: Zezi ma zaŋɩ o vu o kwe dɩpɛ dɩm o pa-ba, yɩ o daarɩ o kwe kale sɩm dɩ o pa-ba.

english_verse: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death. Jesus and Peter
translation_verse: Zezi na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ mʋ kɩ kuni bɩtɔ o na brɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ o karabiǝ bam. Zezi na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ te tɩn

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do?” Simon Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I do!” “Then feed my lambs,” Jesus said.
translation_verse: Ba na di ba ti tɩn, Zezi laan ma bwe Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ o wɩ: «Zan bu Simɔn, nmʋ soe amʋ n dwe bantʋ na?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A Yuutu, ɛɛn, nmʋ ye nɩ amʋ soe nmʋ.» Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nan ta n nii a pǝlbiǝ bam baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter answered, “Yes, Lord, you know I love you!” “Then take care of my sheep,” Jesus told him.
translation_verse: O ma joori o bwe Pɩyɛɛrɩ o kɩ bɩle o wɩ: «Zan bu Simɔn, nmʋ soe amʋ na?» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A Yuutu, ɛɛn, nmʋ ye nɩ amʋ soe nmʋ.» Zezi ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nan ta n nii amʋ peeni sɩm baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, “Lord, you know everything. You know I love you.” Jesus replied, “Feed my sheep.
translation_verse: O daa ma bwe Pɩyɛɛrɩ o kɩ kuni bɩtɔ o wɩ: «Zan bu Simɔn, nmʋ soe amʋ na?» Pɩyɛɛrɩ wʋ ma cɔgɩ dɩ Zezi na bwe-o kuni bɩtɔ o wɩ o so-o na tɩn. O ma ta dɩ Zezi o wɩ: «Amʋ Yuutu, nmʋ ye woŋo maama. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ nmʋ ye nɩ amʋ soe nmʋ.» Zezi laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nan ta n nii amʋ peeni sɩm baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that when you were a young man, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted to go. But when you are old, you will hold out your hands. Then others will wrap your belt around you and lead you where you don't want to go.”
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ nmʋ sɩ, nmʋ dɛɛn na yɩ nɔn-dʋŋʋ tɩn, nmʋ yǝni n vɔ n kilǝ n tɩtɩ nɩ mʋ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ n daarɩ n ve nmʋ na lagɩ mɛ tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ nmʋ nan na kwɩn, n laan wʋ́ zǝŋi n jɩa mʋ wɛɛnɩ, yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ vɔ-ka o pa-m, yɩ o daarɩ o ja-m o vu nmʋ na ba lagɩ mɛ sɩ n vu tɩn.»

english_verse: Jesus said this to tell how Peter would die and bring honor to God. Then he said to Peter, “Follow me!” Jesus and His Favorite Disciple
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn tagɩ kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ brɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ na wʋ́ tɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩlʋ dwi sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ na zulǝ tɩn mʋ. O laan ma daarɩ o ta dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ o wɩ: «Ta n tɔgɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma pipiri o nii o kwaga nɩ, yɩ o na Zezi karabu wʋlʋ o na soe tɩn na tɔgɩ-ba. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ ya na jǝni o salɩ Zezi wʋdiu kʋm dim maŋa nɩ yɩ o bwe-o o wɩ: «A Yuutu, wɔɔ mʋ lagɩ o yǝgi nmʋ o pa?» tɩn.

english_verse: When Peter saw this disciple, he asked Jesus, “Lord, what about him?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na nɛ-o tɩn, o ma bwe Zezi o wɩ: «A Yuutu, sɩ wʋntʋ, bɛɛ mʋ lagɩ kʋ kɩ-o?»

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.”
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Amʋ na lagɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam amʋ na wʋ́ joori a ba tɩn, kʋntʋ daɩ nmʋ yigǝ. Nmʋ za n weeni n ta n tɔgɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, “What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Zezi karabiǝ bam dɛɛn jɩgɩ-ka ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba wɩ, Zezi karabu wʋm kʋntʋ bá tɩ maŋa dɩ maŋa. Zezi nan wʋ tagɩ o wɩ, o bá tɩ. O dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ na lagɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam a na wʋ́ joori a ba tɩn, kʋntʋ daɩ nmʋ yigǝ.»

english_verse: This disciple is the one who told all of this. He wrote it, and we know he is telling the truth.
translation_verse: Zezi karabu wʋlʋ o na tagɩ o taanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ amʋ wʋlʋ na brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam yɩ a daarɩ a pʋpʋnɩ-ka a tiŋi tɩn. Dɩbam maama nan ye nɩ a na brɩ te tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.
translation_verse: Zezi ta kɩ wǝǝnu zanzan o wǝli da. Tɩ maama dɩdʋa dɩdʋa nan ya na lagɩ tɩ pʋpʋnɩ tɩ tiŋi, a bʋŋɩ nɩ lʋgʋ baŋa ya bá na je sɩ twaanʋ tɩm kʋntʋ pǝni da.

english_verse: until he was taken up to heaven. But before he was taken up, he gave orders to the apostles he had chosen with the help of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dɛ dɩm Wɛ na kwe-o DƖ ja di DƖ sɔŋɔ tɩn. Kʋ na wʋ́ loori sɩ o di Wɛ-sɔŋɔ kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma brɩ o tɩntʋŋna balʋ o na kuri tɩn dɩ Wɛ Joro dam, yɩ o brɩ-ba ba na maŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: While he was still with them, he said: Don't leave Jerusalem yet. Wait here for the Father to give you the Holy Spirit, just as I told you he has promised to do.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ Zezi na wʋra o brɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma kaanɩ-ba o wɩ, ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba nuŋi Zeruzalɛm wʋnɩ, sɩ ba taa cǝgi wʋlʋ wʋm o Ko na goni ni sɩ o ba ba te tɩn, nɩ o na maŋɩ o ta dɩ ba te tɩn.

english_verse: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. Jesus Is Taken to Heaven
translation_verse: Zezi ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Zan dɛɛn yǝni o miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ mʋ, da fɩnfɩɩn nan na wǝli da, Wɛ wʋ́ miisi abam DƖ Joro kʋm wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, “Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again?”
translation_verse: Zezi dɩ o tɩntʋŋna bam dɛɛn na kikili daanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma bwe-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Yuutu, kʋ yɩ lele kʋntʋ mʋ n lagɩ n pa dɩbam Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam joori dɩ́ di paarɩ na?»

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.
translation_verse: Zezi ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ sɩ abam lwarɩ maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na lɩ dɩdaanɩ DƖ tɩtɩ ni sɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.”
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm nan wʋ́ ba abam yuu nɩ kʋ pa á joŋi dam dɩlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn. Abam laan wʋ́ ji a maana tiinǝ sɩ á brɩ nɔɔna amʋ cɩga kam je maama nɩ, kʋ na sɩŋɩ dɩ Zeruzalɛm dɩ Zude dɩ Samari tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama, dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa je maama nɩ.»

english_verse: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him,
translation_verse: Zezi dɛɛn na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ dɩ ba o ti tɩn, o ma zaŋɩ o maa diini Wɛ-sɔŋɔ, yɩ ba zɩgɩ ba nii-o. Kunkwǝǝnu ma ba tɩ kwǝl-o kʋ pa ba daa warɩ ba na-o.

english_verse: but as he went up, they kept looking up into the sky. Suddenly two men dressed in white clothes were standing there beside them.
translation_verse: O na maa diini kʋntʋ tɩn, ba daa ta ma kwǝni ba nii wɛyuu nɩ. Ba na zɩgɩ ba nii kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna bale ma da ba ba ba zɩgɩ ba tee nɩ. Ba zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu mʋ.

english_verse: They said, “Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.” Someone To Take the Place of Judas
translation_verse: Ba ma ta dɩ ba ba wɩ: «Galile tiinǝ-ba, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á zɩgɩ yoba á kwǝni á nii wɛɛnɩ? Abam na nɛ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ kwe Zezi DƖ ja di DƖ sɔŋɔ. Wʋntʋ tɩtɩ nan ta wʋ́ joori o ba kʋntʋ doŋ, nɩ abam na nɛ-o o na maa diini te tɩn.»

english_verse: The Mount of Olives was about a kilometer from Jerusalem. The apostles who had gone there were Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas the son of James. After the apostles returned to the city, they went upstairs to the room where they had been staying.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zʋ tɩʋ kʋm ba kɛ ba vu sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ ba na maŋɩ ba zʋʋrɩ da tɩn, ba di wɛyuu digǝ kam. Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ yɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɩ Zakɩ dɩ Andre, kʋ wǝli dɩ Filipi dɩ Toma, dɩdaanɩ Batelemi dɩ Matiyu, kʋ wǝli dɩ Zakɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Alɩfɩ bu tɩn, dɩ Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ Zelɔtɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, dɩdaanɩ Zudasɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Zakɩ bu tɩn.

english_verse: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama bantʋ dɛɛn yǝni ba wʋ daanɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ mʋ, yɩ ba warɩ Wɛ. Kaana badonnǝ dɩdaanɩ Zezi nu Mari dɩ Zezi nyaana dɩ tɔgɩ ba wʋra dɩ ba. Ba na kuri nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ sɩ o lǝni Zudasɩ yuu nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: of the Lord's followers meeting together, and Peter stood up to speak to them.
translation_verse: ). Ba na wʋra kʋntʋ tɩn, Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma zaŋɩ ba wʋnɩ o zɩgɩ wɛɛnɩ sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ.

english_verse: Then Judas bought some land with the money he was given for doing that evil thing. He fell headfirst into the field. His body burst open, and all his insides came out.
translation_verse: Zudasɩ na kɩ te tɩn, o dɛɛn kwe sǝbu kʋlʋ o na joŋi o kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn o ma yǝgi tɩga mʋ. O daarɩ o tʋ tɩga nɩ o tɩ. O pugǝ ma bagɩ yɩ o lʋrʋ pi tɩ nuŋi.

english_verse: When the people of Jerusalem found out about this, they called the place Akeldama, which in the local language means “Field of Blood.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn ma ni kʋlʋ na kɩ-o tɩn, kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba bǝŋi tɩga kam kʋntʋ nɩ Akɩlɩdama dɩ ba tɩtɩ taanɩ. Kʋ kuri mʋ Jana tɩga.

english_verse: So we need someone else to help us tell others that Jesus has been raised from death. He must also be one of the men who was with us from the very beginning. He must have been with us from the time the Lord Jesus was baptized by John until the day he was taken to heaven.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔnʋ wǝli dɩbam Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam wʋnɩ o ji maana tu, sɩ o taa ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cɩga kam dɩ o na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ tu nan maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ wʋlʋ dɛɛn na tɔgɩ o wʋ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ maŋa maama dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɛɛn na tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam o beeri tɩn mʋ, kʋ sɩŋɩ maŋa kam Zan na miisi Zezi na wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kam Zezi na yagɩ dɩbam te yɩ o di Wɛ-sɔŋɔ tɩn.»

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, ba ma lɩ nɔɔna bale. Dɩdʋa mʋ yɩ Zʋzɛfʋ wʋlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Basaba yɩ ba daa ta bǝ-o nɩ Zusitu tɩn. Wʋdoŋ wʋm maa yɩ Matɩasɩ.

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ Zudasɩ na kwe o yagɩ yɩ o daarɩ o vu o na maŋɩ sɩ o vu mɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Sɔɔ ma da kʋ nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ vu-dɩʋ na fufugi te tɩn. Sɔŋɔ kʋm ba na je kʋ wʋnɩ tɩn maama ma su dɩ sɔɔ kʋm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm ma ba ba maama tee nɩ dɩ dam, yɩ ba sɩŋɩ sɩ ba taa ŋɔɔnɩ taana dwi dwi, nɩnɛɛnɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ-ba dam sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ba yɩra ma sɔɔrɩ yɩ kʋ kɩ-ba yǝǝu. Ba ma ta ba wɩ: «Nii, bantʋ maama yɩ Galile tiinǝ mʋ, yɩ ba zɩgɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ taana yantʋ doŋ.

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan kɩ ta mʋ yɩ dɩbam maama ni ba na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩbam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa dwi taanɩ?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Dɩbam nuŋi je dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ. Dɩbam badonnǝ nuŋi Parɩtɩ dɩ Meedi dɩ Elam, kʋ wǝli dɩ Mesopotami dɩ Zude dɩ Kapadɔsɩ, dɩdaanɩ Pɔn dɩ Azi tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama.

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Dɩbam yɩ Zwifǝ mʋ, kʋ wǝli dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na tɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam tɩn. Dɩbam badonnǝ maa nuŋi Krɛtɩ dɩ Arabi. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, dɩbam maama nan ta ni ba na maɩ dɩbam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa dwi taanɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ wo-kamunnu tɩlʋ Wɛ na kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na yɩ yǝǝu yɩ ba wʋbʋŋa vugimi daanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maa bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Kǝm dɩntʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ?»

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Ba badaara laan maa jɩgɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam ba mwana, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ nyɔgɩ sana mʋ ba su.» Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ Pantɩkoti dɛ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ dɩdaanɩ o donnǝ fugǝ-dɩdʋa kam. O ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o ta dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm o wɩ: «A badonnǝ-ba, Zwifǝ-ba dɩ abam balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn, cǝgi-na sɩ a ta kǝm dɩntʋ kuri a brɩ abam.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Abam na bʋŋɩ nɩ nɔɔna bantʋ nyɔgɩ sana mʋ ba su tɩn, kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋ daa ta yɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ mʋ, wɩa ta wʋ bɩgɩ sɩ ba nyɔ sana.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnu Zʋwɛlɩ dɛɛn na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋ taanɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: O tagɩ sɩ Baŋa-Wɛ wɩ: ‹Lʋgʋ tiim maŋa na yiǝ, amʋ wʋ́ pwǝri a Joro kʋm sɩ kʋ taa wʋ nabiinǝ maama tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ nan wʋ́ pa abam biǝ dɩ á bukwa ŋɔɔnɩ amʋ yiyiu-ŋwɛ. Aá pa abam nɔn-dʋnnʋ na vɩɩrɩm, kʋ daarɩ sɩ á nankwɩn dwɛ dɩndwɩa.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga sɩ da yam kʋntʋ nɩ, kʋ na yɩ a tɩntʋŋ-baara dɩ kaana dɩ, aá pwǝri a Joro kʋm a pa ba maama, sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ amʋ yiyiu-ŋwɛ.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: A ta wʋ́ pa wo-kɩnkagɩla taa kɩ wɛyuu nɩ, yɩ a daarɩ a kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ a dam tɩn tɩga baŋa nɩ. Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ jana wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩ mini dɩ nyʋa kalʋ na tiini ka zwǝrǝ tɩn.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Wɩa kam wʋ́ ji lim, yɩ cana kam dɩ wʋ́ ji nasʋŋʋ nɩ jana te, kʋ na wʋ́ loori sɩ amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ sarɩya dɛ kamunu kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ zulǝ ba dɩ yi tɩn.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, wʋlʋ maama na wʋ́ bǝŋi dɩ́ Yuutu yɩrɩ o ma loori zǝnǝ tɩn, oó na vrɩm.›

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ye kʋ na wʋ́ ta yɩ te tɩn. DƖ dɛɛn ma lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ abam ja Zezi á kɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ. Á kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ á ma á gʋ-o.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. DƖ ma joŋ-o tʋʋnɩ yaara yam wʋnɩ DƖ yagɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ tʋʋnɩ dɛɛn wʋ wanɩ dɩ cǝŋ-o dɩ yagɩ yibeeli dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, Pɛ Davidi dɛɛn tagɩ wʋntʋ taanɩ o wɩ: ‹A naɩ a Yuutu Wɛ a yigǝ nɩ maŋa maama. DƖ wʋ a jazɩm nɩ, sɩ DƖ zǝni-nɩ sɩ a yɩ tʋ.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri a jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ, yɩ a ni-taanɩ dɩ jɩgɩ ywǝǝni. Dɩ a yɩra bwǝni dɩm maama a nan ta jɩgɩ tɩɩna nmʋ Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, a na tɩga, nmʋ Baŋa-Wɛ bá yagɩ-nɩ sɩ a maŋɩ curu nɩ. Nmʋ bá sɛ sɩ n tɩtɩ Wʋ-poŋo Tu wʋm yɩra pɔ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ pɛ a lwarɩ cwe sɩlʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa cwe tɩn sɩ a taa tɔga. Nmʋ wʋ́ pa a na ywǝǝni zanzan nmʋ tee nɩ.›

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, mʋ kʋlʋ dɩbam nabaarʋ Davidi dɛɛn na tagɩ tɩn. A nan lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ wʋntʋ taanɩ mʋ jaja a brɩ abam nɩ o tɩga, yɩ ba kwe-o ba kɩ. O yibeeli ta wʋra dɩ zɩm maama.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn nan yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ, yɩ o guli Wɛ na goni ni DƖ pa-o DƖ wɩ, DƖ wʋ́ pa o dwi tiinǝ bam dɩdʋa zaŋɩ o di paarɩ o jǝŋǝ kam je nɩ.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Davidi nan maŋɩ o da yigǝ o lwarɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ kɩ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn tʋʋnɩ biim woŋo mʋ o tagɩ o wɩ: ‹Wɛ wʋ sɛ sɩ DƖ yag-o curu nɩ. O yɩra yam dɩ nan wʋ pɔgɩ.›

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bi-o tɩn, DƖ zǝŋ-o DƖ jǝni DƖ jazɩm nɩ. Zezi laan ma joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm o Ko Wɛ tee nɩ, nɩ Wɛ na maŋɩ DƖ go ni sɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa-o te tɩn, yɩ o pwǝri-kʋ dɩbam baŋa nɩ. Mʋ kʋlʋ abam zɩm na naɩ yɩ á kwǝri á ni tɩn.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ Davidi tɩtɩ mʋ diini Wɛ-sɔŋɔ. Wʋntʋ nan tagɩ o wɩ: ‹Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tagɩ dɩ a Yuutu DƖ wɩ: Ba n jǝni a jazɩm nɩ,

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: sɩ aá kɩ nmʋ dʋna maama n nɛ kuri nɩ, sɩ n nɔ-ba nɩ tɩga te.›

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi maama nan maŋɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ, Zezi wʋlʋ abam na pagɩ tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ á gʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ tɩtɩ nɔ́ɔ mʋ Wɛ laan pɛ sɩ o taa yɩ Krisi wʋm, yɩ o kwǝri o yɩ dɩbam Yuutu.»

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na ni Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tagɩ kʋlʋ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ cɔgɩ ba wʋrʋ zanzan. Ba ma bwe Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna badonnǝ bam ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ?»

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Abam maama maŋɩ sɩ á lǝni á wʋrʋ á yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm, sɩ á daarɩ á pa ba miisi abam na wʋnɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ á lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam. Wɛ laan wʋ́ pa DƖ Joro kʋm taa wʋ abam tee nɩ.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Mʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ kɩ te tɩn. DƖ goni ni dɩntʋ DƖ pa abam dɩ á biǝ, kʋ wǝli dɩ balʋ maama na baŋwɛ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ balʋ maama dɩbam Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ na wʋ́ bǝŋi sɩ ba taa tɔg-o tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma joori o fɔgɩ o ma bɩtarɩ dwi dwi o brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kam, yɩ o kaanɩ-ba o wɩ: «Sɛ-na sɩ Baŋa-Wɛ vrɩ abam zɩm nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩm tɩtarɩ nɩ.»

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ nɔɔna bam maama, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ dɛɛn pɛ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu zanzan na brɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dam tɩn.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam maama dɛɛn yǝni ba wʋ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa mʋ, yɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na jɩgɩ tɩn yɩ ba maama nyɩm.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Ba maa yǝni ba kwe ba jɩjɩgɩrʋ dɩ ba zɩla ba yǝgǝ, yɩ ba maŋɩ tɩ sǝbu kʋm ba pa daanɩ, kʋ maŋɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ maama na lagɩ zǝnǝ te tɩn.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Ba maa zuli Wɛ maŋa maama, yɩ ba jɩgɩ zulǝ nɔɔna maama yibiyǝ nɩ. Dɛ maama dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm maa paɩ balʋ na nɛ vrɩm tɩn tui ba wǝli ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ mʋ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɛɛn zaŋɩ ba vu Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm, maŋa kalʋ nɔɔna na yǝni ba ve ba warɩ Wɛ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ wɛ-gunim maŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi digǝ kam ni dɩlʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Ni-laa tɩn. Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, o yɩ kɔrɔ mʋ kʋ na puli o lʋra kam maŋa nɩ. O nɔɔna maa yǝni ba zɩŋ-o ba vu ba jǝni da dɛ maama, sɩ o taa loori sǝbiǝ nɔɔna balʋ na tui ba tɔgɩ da ba zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ tɩn tee nɩ.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma na Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan na maa zʋʋrɩ Wɛ-digǝ kam. O ma loori-ba sɩ ba pa-o woŋo.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Ba ma nii-o ziin. Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Nii dɩbam seeni.»

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: O ma sɩɩnɩ o nii-ba yɩ o jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ baá pa-o woŋo.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «A ba jɩgɩ sǝbu sɩ a pa-m. A nan wʋ́ pa nmʋ a na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Dɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, zaŋɩ n ta n veǝ.»

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma ja o jazɩm o zǝn-o o pa o zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ. O na zaŋɩ kʋntʋ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn, mʋ o nɛ sɩm dɩ o nakwǝǝlu tɩm maama kɩ dam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma faŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o joori o ba o cwi o nɛ baŋa nɩ yɩ o sɩŋɩ vǝŋǝ. O ma tɔgɩ-ba o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ. O maa veǝ yɩ o faŋa wɛɛnɩ yɩ o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm ma na o na veǝ yɩ o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Ba ma lwarɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ looru wʋlʋ ya na je Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm Ni-laa kʋm nɩ tɩn. Kʋ ma tiini kʋ sɔɔrɩ-ba, yɩ kʋ kɩ-ba yǝǝu dɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn. Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma yɔɔrɩ o mǝǝli Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan. Nɔɔna bam maama maa yɩ yǝǝu. Ba ma zaŋɩ ba duri ba vu ba te, kʋnkɔlɔ kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ pwǝŋǝ yɩ ba maa bǝ nɩ Salɔmɔn kʋnkɔlɔ tɩn nɩ.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na nɛ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A badonnǝ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ-ba, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ abam yɩ yǝǝu dɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn? Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam yɔɔrɩ á nii dɩbam kʋntʋ? Abam bʋŋɩ sɩ kʋ yɩ dɩbam tɩtɩ dam mʋ pɛ o zaŋɩ o ve na? Á bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ dɩbam na kwarɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ o zaŋɩ o ve na?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ te tɩn, dɩbam nabaara Abraham dɩ Yizakɩ dɩ Zakɔbɩ Baŋa-Wɛ laan mʋ pɛ DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ Zezi joŋi paarɩ dɩ zulǝ. Abam jaanɩ wʋntʋ mʋ á pa ba gʋ-o. Pilatɩ dɛɛn bʋŋɩ sɩ o yag-o yɩ abam wʋ sɛ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu mʋ dɩ cɩga tu. Abam nan vɩ-o, yɩ á daarɩ á loori Pilatɩ sɩ o yagɩ nɔn-gʋrʋ mʋ o pa abam.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ te tɩn, á gʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa tu tɩn mʋ, yɩ Wɛ joori DƖ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Dɩbam yɩ maana tiinǝ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna cɩga kam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ dam dɩm ŋwaanɩ, dɩ dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn mʋ pɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ abam na nɛ yɩ á ye tɩn na dam. Kʋ yɩ o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn mʋ pɛ o na yazurǝ abam maama yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam dɩ á yigǝ tiinǝ bam na kɩ Zezi te tɩn, a ye nɩ abam ya yǝri woŋo kʋlʋ á na kɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam wʋrʋ taa zurǝ maŋa dɩ maŋa, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ Krisi wʋm DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ kuri sɩ DƖ pa abam tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: O maŋɩ sɩ o taa wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ fɔgɩ DƖ kwɛ wǝǝnu maama tɩn, nɩ Wɛ na maŋɩ DƖ pa DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝrǝ faŋa faŋa te tɩn.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Moyisi dɛɛn na tagɩ o wɩ: ‹Abam Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam dwi tu dɩdʋa mʋ zaŋɩ o taa yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, nɩ DƖ na tʋŋɩ amʋ Moyisi te tɩn. Wʋntʋ nan na tuǝ, abam maŋɩ sɩ á sɛ taanɩ dɩlʋ maama o na wʋ́ ta o brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
