translation_verse: Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam DƖ dɛɛn na pɛ DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam sɩ ba tɔɔlɩ tɩn yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Wɛ ni dɩm DƖ dɛɛn na goni DƖ pa dɩbam nabaara bam tɩn dɩ daa ta yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. DƖ dɛɛn goni ni dɩ Abraham DƖ wɩ: ‹Nmʋ dwi dɩm ŋwaanɩ amʋ wʋ́ kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama lanyɩranɩ.›

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɛ yigǝ DƖ tʋŋɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋm abam tee nɩ mʋ, sɩ o kɩ abam lanyɩranɩ dɩ o na pa abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa yagɩ á kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm.»

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɛɛn na wʋra ba ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ doŋ ba brɩ nɔɔna bam tɩn, Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm tiinǝ dɩdaanɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm yɩrɩna bam yigǝ tu wʋm dɩ Sadusɩan tiinǝ badonnǝ ma zaŋɩ ba ba ba te.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ba bana tiini ya zaŋɩ dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɩ ba na ŋɔɔnɩ te ba wɩ, Zezi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, yɩ kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ twa dɩ wʋ́ wanɩ ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Tɩga na yi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, ba ma yagɩ-ba da sɩ tɩga pʋʋrɩ.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna zanzan ma sɛ taanɩ dɩlʋ ba na ni tɩn, yɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi. Balʋ na sɛ tɩn kɔgɔ kʋm dɛɛn yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ nɔɔna mʋrr-tɩnu (

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba nakwa bam dɩ ba cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam ma la daanɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Ba ma jeeri dɩdaanɩ Annɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ ba kaanɩm yuutu tɩn, dɩ Kayifu dɩ Zan dɩ Alɛsandrɩ, dɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ ba yɩ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm sɔŋɔ tiinǝ tɩn.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ba ma pa Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan ba ba zɩgɩ ba yigǝ nɩ. Ba ma bwe-ba ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ dɩ bɛɛ dam mʋ, dɩ wɔɔ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, abam mɛ á kɩ kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm laan ma ba Pɩyɛɛrɩ te dɩ dam. O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ nakwa-ba,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: abam zɩm na bwe dɩbam kʋlʋ taanɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ dɩbam na zǝni kɔrɔ kʋm yɩ kʋ na yazurǝ tɩn,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: dɩ́ wʋ́ pa abam dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam maama lwarɩ kʋ na kɩ te. Á taá ye nɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ na yazurǝ, yɩ o laan ba o zɩgɩ abam yigǝ nɩ. Abam nan pagɩ Zezi Krisi tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ á gʋ, yɩ Wɛ joori DƖ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na maŋɩ kʋ ta o taanɩ nɩ: ‹Kandwɛ dɩlʋ abam lwara bam na vɩn tɩn laan mʋ joori dɩ ba dɩ ji kandwɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm dana tɩn.›

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ daa tǝri lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ Wɛ na pɛ nabiinǝ sɩ dɩ wanɩ dɩ pa ba na vrɩm. Kʋ na daɩ Zezi Krisi yɩranɩ mʋ waɩ o vrɩ nɔɔna o yaga.»

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ nakwa bam na nɛ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan na jɩgɩ baarɩ dɩ ba na ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn, kʋ ma kɩ-ba yǝǝu dɩ ba na yɩ nɔɔna balʋ na yǝri kʋlʋkʋlʋ yɩ ba daɩ yi-pʋrɩ-nyɩna tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba ma lwarɩ nɩ bantʋ dɛɛn tɔgɩ ba wʋ dɩ Zezi mʋ.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ kɔrɔ kʋm na zɩgɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan tee nɩ yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ yazurǝ tɩn, ba maa warɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ ba daa ta.

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ kɩ nɔɔna bantʋ ta mʋ? Nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn lwarɩ nɩ bantʋ mʋ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm kʋntʋ. Dɩ́ daa bá wanɩ dɩ́ ta nɩ vwan.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na lagɩ sɩ kǝm dɩntʋ yɩ jagɩ dɩ vu yigǝ tɩn, dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kaanɩ nɔɔna bam mʋ, sɩ ba daa yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi woŋo dɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ.»

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma joori ba bǝŋi-ba, yɩ ba zʋ. Ba ma ta dɩ ba ba wɩ, ba ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba daa ŋɔɔnɩ Zezi woŋo, naa sɩ ba taa brɩ nɔɔna dɩ wʋntʋ yɩrɩ.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan ma lǝri-ba ba wɩ: «Abam tɩtɩ bʋŋɩ-na á nii. Kɔɔ mʋ lana Wɛ yigǝ nɩ? Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ abam dɩ́ dwǝni Baŋa-Wɛ na?

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan bá wanɩ dɩ́ yagɩ kʋlʋ dɩ́ na nɛ yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ ni tɩn ŋwaŋa.»

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm na kɩ o baŋa nɩ yɩ o na yazurǝ tɩn dwe bɩna fiinna o ya na yɩ kɔrɔ. Zezi karabiǝ bam na tʋŋɩ dɩ Wɛ Joro dam te tɩn

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Ba na yagɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma joori ba vu ba kɔgɔ kʋm te. Ba ma ta dɩ ba Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm nakwa bam na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ba na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maama ma wǝli daanɩ ba warɩ Wɛ yɩ ba wɩ: «Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ mʋ kɩ wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa dɩ na-fara dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ tɩ wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nabaarʋ Davidi dɛɛn mʋ yɩ nmʋ tɩntʋŋnʋ. Nmʋ dɛɛn ma pa n Joro kʋm pa o ta nmʋ kwǝrǝ kam o wɩ: ‹Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tiinǝ dwi tǝri tǝri bana zaŋɩ yɩ ba bʋŋɩ wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Ba pwa bam ti ba yigǝ sɩ ba kɩ jara. Ba yum tiinǝ dɩ ma la daanɩ sɩ ba kɩ jara dɩdaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ Krisi wʋm DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Tɩʋ kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ Erɔdɩ dɩ Pɔnsɩ Pilatɩ jǝni daanɩ dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ, sɩ ba ja dɩ nmʋ tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm Zezi wʋlʋ nmʋ na kuri tɩn.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Ba na bwɛ daanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba kɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ nmʋ na maŋɩ n lɩ wʋbʋŋa dɩ n dam dɩm sɩ kʋlʋ wʋ́ kɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ, nii ba na lagɩ ba yaarɩ dɩbam te tɩn! Dɩbam nan yɩ nmʋ tɩntʋŋna mʋ. Nan pa dɩbam dam, sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ taá tɔɔlɩ nmʋ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ baarɩ.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Nan twɩ n jɩ-dɩa kam n pa nɔɔna taa naɩ yazurǝ, sɩ n pa wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ n dam tɩn taa kɩ nmʋ tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm Zezi yɩrɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ba na warɩ Wɛ ba ti tɩn, jǝgǝ kam ba na lagɩ daanɩ mɛ tɩn ma sisiŋǝ. Wɛ Joro kʋm laan ma ba ba maama te dɩ dam, yɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ baarɩ.

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam kɔgɔ kʋm maama wʋbʋŋa dɩ ba ŋwɩa maama dɛɛn yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. Ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ wʋ tagɩ nɩ wʋm yɩranɩ mʋ te o wǝǝnu. Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na jɩgɩ tɩn yɩ ba maama nyɩm mʋ.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam maa jɩgɩ dam kamunu, yɩ ba fɔgɩ ba brɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cɩga kam nɩ o sɩɩnɩ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Wɛ ma zǝni ba maama dɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝri ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ o na yɩ yinigǝ tu. Balʋ na jɩgɩ karɩ naa sam tɩn yǝni ba yǝgi-tɩ mʋ,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: O ma twǝri sǝbu kʋm wʋnɩ sɩ o ta jɩga, yɩ o kaanɩ dɩ ye kʋ ni nɩ. O laan ma kwe kʋlʋ na daarɩ tɩn o ja vu o pa Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: O na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ananiya, bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ nmʋ pa sʋtaanɩ wanɩ nmʋ kʋntʋ doŋ, yɩ n fɔ vwan dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩ nmʋ na twǝri kara kam sǝbu kʋm wʋnɩ sɩ n ta n jɩgɩ tɩn?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam nmʋ ta na wʋ yǝgi kara kam tɩn, ka ya yɩ nmʋ nyɩm mʋ. Nmʋ nan na kwe n yǝgi tɩn, sǝbu kʋm ta yɩ nmʋ nyɩm mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ n bʋŋɩ n wʋ nɩ, yɩ nmʋ kɩ kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ? Nmʋ na fɔgɩ vwan kʋntʋ tɩn, n fɔgɩ n pa Wɛ mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ.»

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Ananiya na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma tʋ tɩga nɩ o tɩ. Kʋ dɛɛn ma pa fʋʋnɩ ja balʋ maama na lwarɩ kʋ ni nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Nɔn-dʋnnʋ ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba pri tʋ wʋm ba ja nuŋi ba kɩ.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɛ nɩ luu tɩtɔ te tɩn, o kaanɩ wʋm dɩ daa ma ba o zʋ Pɩyɛɛrɩ-ba te. O ma daa ta wʋ lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ta n brɩ-nɩ, mʋ sǝbu kʋlʋ maama nmʋ dɩ n barʋ wʋm na joŋi á kara kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn na?» O ma sɛ o wɩ: «Ɛɛn, kʋ maama mʋ kʋntʋ.»

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ nmʋ dɩ n barʋ wʋm kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ á maŋɩ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ Joro kʋm á nii? Nɔɔna balʋ na kwe n barʋ wʋm ba kɩ tɩn ta zɩgɩ digǝ kam ni nɩ lele kʋntʋ. Ba nan wʋ́ zɩŋɩ nmʋ dɩ ba ja nuŋi.»

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ mʋ kaanɩ wʋm tʋ tɩga nɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ yigǝ nɩ o tɩ. Nɔn-dʋnnʋ tɩm ma ba tɩ yi dɩ o tɩga. Ba ma kwe-o ba ja nuŋi ba kɩ o barʋ wʋm tɩkǝri nɩ.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ dɛɛn ma ja Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm dɩ nɔɔna balʋ maama dɩ na ni kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn pɛ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ DƖ dam tɩn dɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla zanzan nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ. Zezi nɔɔna bam maama dɛɛn yǝni ba jeeri daanɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ mʋ faŋa faŋa Pɛ Salɔmɔn kʋnkɔlɔ kʋm nɩ.

english_verse: No one outside their group dared join them, even though everyone liked them very much.
translation_verse: Balʋ na daɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔna tɩn, ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ wʋ dɛ o wǝli ba wʋnɩ. Kʋ daarɩ tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam maama ma tee Zezi nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Zezi nɔɔna bam na yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna maa zɩŋɩ yawɩɩna ba nuŋi ba tiŋi cwe niǝ nɩ. Ba dɛɛn tiŋi-ba sarɩ dɩ gungwǝǝlu baŋa nɩ mʋ, sɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ na maa tɔgɩ da o kɛa, sɩ o luluŋu kʋm má wanɩ kʋ tɔgɩ ba badonnǝ baŋa.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan maa yǝni ba nuŋi Zeruzalɛm sa-tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama wʋnɩ ba jaanɩ yawɩɩna dɩ balʋ ciciri na jɩgɩ-ba sɩ yaarɩ tɩn ba tui, yɩ ba maama nɛ yazurǝ. Ba na jɩgɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam ba yaarɩ te tɩn

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba ja-ba ba ja vu ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Tɩga na yi tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma ba ka pʋrɩ pɩɩna digǝ kam niǝ yam, yɩ ka pa Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam nuŋi. Ka ma ta dɩ ba ka wɩ:

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: «Ve-na á zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm, sɩ á taá brɩ nɔɔna bam Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam na yɩ te tɩn maama.»

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Ba ma sɛ Wɛ malɛka kam ni. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ tɩn, ba ma vu ba zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm ba wʋra ba brɩ nɔɔna bam. Kaanɩm yuutu wʋm dɩ o nɔɔna bam laan ma bǝŋi Zwifǝ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa dɩ Zwifǝ nakwa bam kɔgɔ kʋm maama sɩ ba kikili daanɩ. Ba ma daarɩ ba tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu ba lɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ ba ja ba ba pa-ba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔna bam na yi da tɩn, mʋ ba wʋ nɛ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ. Ba ma joori ba vu Zwifǝ nakwa bam te yɩ ba wɩ:

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: «Dɩ́ na yi da tɩn, pɩɩna digǝ kam niǝ yam pɩ mʋ lanyɩranɩ. Nɔɔna balʋ na wʋra ba yɩra sɩ pɩɩna bam yɩ lu tɩn maa zɩgɩ da. Dɩ́ nan na pʋrɩ digǝ kam tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ka wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm yɩrɩna bam yigǝ tu wʋm dɩdaanɩ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba wʋbʋŋa vugimi daanɩ yɩ ba yǝri kʋlʋ na kɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam tɩn.

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Yɩrɩna bam yigǝ tu wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o dɩ o nɔɔna bam ma joori ba vu ba ja Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam ba ba. Ba daa wʋ jaanɩ-ba dɩ dam, bɛŋwaanɩ ba kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ́ dʋlɩ-ba dɩ kandwa.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ba laan ma pa ba zʋ ba zɩgɩ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam yigǝ nɩ. Kaanɩm yuutu wʋm laan ma bwe-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ á kɩ kʋntʋ? Dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ kaanɩ abam sɩ á daa yɩ taá brɩ nɔɔna dɩ yɩrɩ dɩntʋ. Nii abam na kɩ te. Á pɛ abam zaasɩm dɩm yɩranɩ mʋ jagɩ Zeruzalɛm maama wʋnɩ, yɩ á ta lagɩ sɩ wʋntʋ caa kʋm tɔgɩ dɩbam.»

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ o donnǝ tɩntʋŋna bam ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Dɩbam maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ Wɛ ni mʋ kʋ dwǝni nabiinǝ ni.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Zezi wʋlʋ abam na jaanɩ á pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ á gʋ tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ dɩbam nabaara bam na tɔgɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ Baŋa-Wɛ zǝŋ-o DƖ jǝni DƖ jazɩm nɩ, sɩ o taa yɩ dɩbam Pɛ dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ, sɩ o pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ na cwǝŋǝ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ, sɩ Wɛ laan yagɩ ba lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-ba.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Dɩbam dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋlʋ Wɛ na pɛ balʋ maama na sɛ DƖ ni tɩn yɩ cɩga kantʋ maana tiinǝ.»

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ nakwa bam na ni Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn, ba bana ma tiini ya zaŋɩ dɩ ba, yɩ ba lagɩ sɩ ba gʋ-ba.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam dɩdʋ ma zaŋɩ ba tɩtarɩ nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Gamalɩyɛlɩ. O yɩ Farizɩan tu yɩ o ta yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm karanyɩn-kamunu. Nɔɔna maama maa pa-o zulǝ. O na zaŋɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, o maa wɩ, ba ja Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam ba nuŋi pooni sɩ ba cǝgi fɩɩn.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o ta dɩ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam o wɩ: «Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ-ba, á cʋ-na á tɩtɩ dɩ á na bʋŋɩ sɩ á kɩ nɔɔna bantʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: men joined him. But he was killed, and all his followers were scattered. That was the end of that.
translation_verse: ) te. Ba dɛɛn gʋ-o mʋ yɩ o karabiǝ bam jagɩ da yigǝ nɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa wʋ daarɩ.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ Galile tu wʋdoŋ dɩ daa ma zaŋɩ o yɩrɩ mʋ Zudasɩ. Maŋa kam ba dɛɛn na wʋra ba garɩ dɩ́ lʋgʋ kʋm nɔn-biǝ tɩn, mʋ o zaŋɩ o la kɔgɔ o kɩ o kwaga nɩ. Ba ma gʋ wʋntʋ dɩ. O dɩ kwaga nɔɔna bam maama ma jagɩ da yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a lagɩ a ta abam sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á kɩ nɔɔna bantʋ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Yagɩ-na-ba, bɛŋwaanɩ ba wʋbʋŋa yam dɩ ba tɩtʋŋa yam maama na yɩ nabiinǝ nyɩm mʋ, yaá ba ya ji kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ nyɩm mʋ, abam bá wanɩ á cɩ-ba. Yɩrɩ-na á tɩtɩ sɩ á yɩ ba á ja dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ.» Gamalɩyɛlɩ na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, ba ma sɛ o taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ba ma bǝŋi Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam sɩ ba joori ba zʋ ba te. Ba ma magɩ-ba dɩ balaara, yɩ ba daarɩ ba kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba daa yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ Zezi yɩrɩ. Ba laan ma yagɩ-ba yɩ ba viiri.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam ma nuŋi sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam tee nɩ, yɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ ba na maŋɩ sɩ ba na yaara Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama ba maa yǝni ba jeeri daanɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tʋlɩ sam ba brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cɩga kam. Ba ma tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, nɩ Zezi mʋ yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam kɔgɔ kʋm maa wʋra kʋ pulǝ zanzan. Ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na yɩ vǝrǝ yɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ taanɩ dɩm tɩn maa jɩgɩ balʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ba tɩtɩ Zwifǝ taanɩ dɩm tɩn ba pʋʋna, dɩ ba na ba paɩ ba kadǝnǝ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ ba pa-ba ba ni-wʋdiu ŋwaanɩ dɛ maama tɩn.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna fugǝ-bale bam ma bǝŋi ba kɔgɔ kʋm maama ba kɩ daanɩ, yɩ ba ta ba wɩ: «Kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam yagɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm zaasɩm, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ taá maŋɩ wʋdiiru.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Sɩ dɩbam dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ nii Wɛ warɩm dɩ DƖ taanɩ dɩm zaasɩm baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ba na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma poli ba kɔgɔ kʋm maama wʋ. Ba ma kuri nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Etiyɛnɩ. Wʋntʋ jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ o tee nɩ. Ba ma wǝli Filipi dɩ Prokori dɩ Nikano dɩ Timɔn dɩ Pamɩna dɩ Nikola wʋlʋ na nuŋi Antɩɔsɩ, o yɩ dwi-gɛ tu yɩ o ba o tɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam tɩn.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Ba ma lɩ-ba ba ja vu ba zɩgɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam yigǝ nɩ. Ba ma warɩ Wɛ ba pa-ba yɩ ba daŋɩ ba jɩa ba baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɛɛn ma fɔgɩ ka jagɩ ka ve yigǝ yɩ nɔɔna sɛ-ka. Zezi karabiǝ bam kɔgɔ kʋm maa pulǝ zanzan Zeruzalɛm nɩ. Zwifǝ kaanɩm tiinǝ zanzan dɩ dɛɛn ma ba ba sɛ Zezi cɩga kam. Ba na jaanɩ Etiyɛnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ maa zaŋɩ ba magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩd-o. Bantʋ nuŋi Zwifǝ kɔgɔ kʋlʋ ya na yɩ gambɛ yɩ ba laan ba ba te ba tɩtɩ tɩn wʋnɩ mʋ. Ba dɛɛn nuŋi Sirɛɛnɩ dɩ Alɛsandrɩ mʋ. Ba ma tɔgɩ ba wǝli dɩ Zwifǝ badaara na nuŋi Silisi dɩ Azi tɩn.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Ba na magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩd-o tɩn, o ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ bʋŋɩm dam nɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ-o te tɩn, kʋ pa ba daa warɩ o taanɩ ba lǝri.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Ba laan ma nuŋi ba kɩ ni dɩdaanɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ, sɩ ba fɔ vwan ba ta wɩ: «Dɩbam ni nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ o twɩ Moyisi dɩ Wɛ.»

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ba ma pa tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna dɩ ba nakwa bam dɩ ba cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ bam bana zaŋɩ, yɩ ba ja Etiyɛnɩ ba ja vu ba sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam yigǝ sɩ ba di o taanɩ.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba ma pa nɔɔna badonnǝ zʋ ba fɔ vwan ba pa-o, yɩ ba ta ba wɩ: «Maŋa maama nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ sɩɩnɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ ta-balwaarʋ mʋ o paɩ dɩbam Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm dɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma ni o na tagɩ o wɩ, Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi mʋ wʋ́ ba o cɔgɩ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm, yɩ o pipiri mɩʋ kʋlʋ maama Moyisi dɛɛn na brɩ dɩ́ nabaara sɩ dɩ́ taá tɔgɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ nakwa balʋ maama na je da tɩn laan maa yɔɔrɩ ba nii Etiyɛnɩ cɔɔn. Ba ma nii ba na o yibiyǝ na lǝni nɩ malɛka yibiyǝ te.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn ma ta dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: ‹Yagɩ n tɩtɩ tɩʋ kʋm dɩ n sɔŋɔ tiinǝ, sɩ n daarɩ n vu tɩʋ kʋlʋ amʋ na wʋ́ brɩ nmʋ tɩn.›

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: O ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o nuŋi Kalɩdɩan tiinǝ tɩʋ kʋm nɩ o vu o yi Aaran o zʋʋrɩ da. O na wʋ dáanɩ tɩn, o ko ma tɩ. Wɛ ma pa o daa nuŋi o fɔɔrɩ o vu o yi tɩʋ kʋntʋ abam na zʋʋrɩ zɩm tɩn.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ pɛ Abraham tɩga yo seeni sɩ o taa te, dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ. Wɛ dɛɛn goni ni mʋ dɩd-o DƖ wɩ, wʋm wʋ́ pa-o tɩga kantʋ sɩ o taa te, yɩ o na tɩgɩ o daarɩ, sɩ o dwi tiinǝ ta ta te-ka. Wɛ na goni DƖ ni dɩm tɩn, Abraham ta ba jɩgɩ bu.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Mʋ Wɛ na tagɩ kʋlʋ dɩd-o tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: ‹Abraham, nmʋ dwi tiinǝ wʋ́ vu ba taa zʋʋrɩ tʋ-gaa nɩ. Baá ta yɩ gambɛ mʋ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ, yɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ bɛɛsɩ-ba taan bɩna biǝ-yana (

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Amʋ Wɛ nan wʋ́ di balʋ na fɩ-ba sɩ ba tʋŋɩ gambɛɛm tɩtʋŋa tɩn taanɩ sɩ ba na cam. Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, ba laan wʋ́ nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ ba ba, ba taa zuli amʋ jǝgǝ kantʋ nɩ.›

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ ma daarɩ DƖ go ni DƖ pa Abraham DƖ wɩ, Abraham dwi tiinǝ taa goni ba bǝkǝri sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ ba sɛ DƖ ni. Kʋntʋ, Abraham na lʋgɩ Yizakɩ tɩn, da nana dɛ nɩ o ma go-o. Yizakɩ dɩ dɛɛn ma ba o lʋ Zakɔbɩ, o dɩ ma go-o. Zakɔbɩ ma lʋ dɩ́ nabaara fugǝ-bale bam yɩ o go-ba dɩ.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: Nabaara bam dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Zʋzɛfʋ. O cʋrrʋ tɩm dɛɛn maa jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋrʋ dɩd-o. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba jaan-o ba yǝgi ba pa o vu Ezipi sɩ o taa yɩ gambaa. Wɛ ta maa wʋra dɩd-o.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: DƖ ma pa o nuŋi cam maama wʋnɩ dɩ yazurǝ. Zʋzɛfʋ na tu o zɩgɩ Ezipi pa-farʋ wʋm yigǝ nɩ tɩn, Wɛ pɛ-o wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna yɩ pɛ wʋm yi su Zʋzɛfʋ lanyɩranɩ. Pɛ wʋm ma pa o ji o sɔŋɔ kʋm tu dɩ Ezipi tɩʋ kʋm maama yuutu.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Kana dɛɛn ma ba ka wʋ Ezipi dɩ Kanaan tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama nɩ. Kʋ ma tiini kʋ cɛ ba yɩra nɩ. Dɩ́ nabaara bam maa warɩ sɩ ba na wʋdiu ba di.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Zakɔbɩ dɛɛn ma ni nɩ wʋdiu wʋ Ezipi nɩ. O ma tʋŋɩ dɩ́ nabaara bam sɩ ba vu ba yǝgi.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ ba daa ma joori ba vu ba kɩ bɩle. Zʋzɛfʋ laan ma pa o cʋrrʋ tɩm lwar-o. Ezipi pa-farʋ wʋm dɩ laan ma ba o lwarɩ Zʋzɛfʋ dwi dɩm na nuŋi mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Zakɔbɩ ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o vu Ezipi. Dáanɩ mʋ wʋntʋ tɩga. Dɩbam nabaara bam dɩ ma ba ba tɩ.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja ba yɩra yam ba joori ba vu Sisɩm ba kɩ-ba yibeeli dɩlʋ Abraham na yǝgi dɩ sǝbu Emori biǝ bam tee nɩ tɩn nɩ.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ma twɛ sɩ Baŋa-Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ dɛɛn na goni ni dɩ Abraham tɩn. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ dɩbam nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Ezipi nɩ tɩn maa tiini ba wʋra ba puli zanzan.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Pa-farʋ wʋdoŋ dɩ daa ma zaŋɩ sɩ o taa te Ezipi. O maa yǝri Zʋzɛfʋ ni nɩ.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn maa jɩgɩ dɩbam nabaara bam o bɛɛsa. O dɛɛn kɩ swan mʋ o fɩ-ba sɩ ba kwe ba bu-sɩsɩn ba jaanɩ ba ve ba yaga, sɩ ba taa tʋa.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ mʋ ba lʋgɩ Moyisi. O dɛɛn maa yɩ bu-ŋʋm Wɛ yibiyǝ nɩ. Ba maa jɩg-o ba kɔna o ko sɔŋɔ nɩ canɩ sɩtɔ.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ja-o ba nuŋi ba vu ba yagɩ. Pa-farʋ wʋm bukɔ ma kwe-o o jɩgɩ o niǝ, nɩ o yɩ o tɩtɩ bu mʋ te.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ba ma brɩ Moyisi Ezipi tiinǝ yi-pʋrʋ kʋm maama. O ma ji nɔn-babɩa o ni-taanɩ dɩ o kǝm maama baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: O na ve tɩn, o ma na Ezipi tu wʋdoŋ na jɩgɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tu o maga. Moyisi ma vu sɩ o wǝli o tɩtɩ dwi tu wʋm jara yam wʋnɩ. O ma magɩ Ezipi tu wʋm o gʋ.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn ya bʋŋɩ nɩ o tɩtɩ dwi tiinǝ bam wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ lagɩ DƖ pa wʋntʋ mʋ joŋi-ba Ezipi tiinǝ bam jɩŋa nɩ o yagɩ. Ba nan wʋ lwarɩ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, o daa ma na Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bale na jɩgɩ daanɩ. O ma kwaanɩ sɩ o lo-ba, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: ‹A ko-biǝ-ba, abam yɩ cʋrrʋ mʋ daanɩ. Bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ abam daa jɩgɩ daanɩ?›

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Nmʋ lagɩ sɩ n gʋ amʋ dɩ mʋ, nɩ n diin na gʋ Ezipi tu wʋm te tɩn na?›

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Moyisi na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma duri o nuŋi Ezipi nɩ o vu o zʋʋrɩ Madɩan tɩʋ nɩ. Dáanɩ mʋ o di kaanɩ yɩ ba lʋ biǝ bale.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Bɩna fiinna dɛɛn na kɛ tɩn, Wɛ malɛka ma ba Moyisi te kagʋa wʋnɩ Sinayi piu kʋm tɩkǝri nɩ. O ma na min-vʋgʋ na jɩgɩ puŋu kʋ di, yɩ malɛka kam wʋ mini dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Moyisi yɩra ma sɔɔrɩ dɩ o na nɛ kʋlʋ tɩn. O ma fɔɔrɩ o yi mini dɩm te sɩ o nii. O laan ma ni Baŋa-Wɛ kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o ka wɩ:

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‹Amʋ yɩ nmʋ nabaara bam Baŋa-Wɛ. Amʋ mʋ yɩ Abraham Baŋa-Wɛ, dɩ Yizakɩ dɩ Zakɔbɩ Baŋa-Wɛ.› Moyisi yɩra maa saɩ, yɩ o daa warɩ o nii.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ ma ta dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: ‹Lɩ n natra yam, sɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ nmʋ na zɩgɩ da tɩn yɩ amʋ tɩtɩ jǝgǝ mʋ.›

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ma ta DƖ wɩ: ‹A nɛ a nɔɔna bam na wʋ Ezipi nɩ ba yaara te tɩn, yɩ a kwǝri a ni ba na kʋnɩ te tɩn. Amʋ nan tu sɩ a joŋi-ba mʋ a yagɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, a lagɩ a tʋŋɩ nmʋ sɩ n joori n vu Ezipi.› »

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Etiyɛnɩ ta ma ta o wɩ: «Moyisi dɛɛn yɩ wʋlʋ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na vɩ-o tɩn. Ba dɛɛn bwe-o ba wɩ: ‹Wɔɔ mʋ pɛ nmʋ ni, sɩ n ta n yɩ dɩbam yuutu sɩ n daarɩ n ŋɔɔnɩ dɩbam taanɩ?› Moyisi wʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ tʋŋɩ sɩ o vu o taa te DƖ nɔɔna bam, sɩ o daarɩ o joŋi-ba o yagɩ. Wɛ ma tʋŋɩ DƖ malɛka, yɩ ka nuŋi o yigǝ nɩ puŋu wʋnɩ ka brɩ-o kʋntʋ maama.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Moyisi daa ta mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tagɩ dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam o wɩ: ‹Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam dwi tu dɩdʋa zaŋɩ o taa yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, nɩ DƖ na tʋŋɩ amʋ Moyisi te tɩn.›

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Moyisi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ dɛɛn na wʋra dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm kagʋa kam wʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ o wʋra dɩdaanɩ dɩbam nabaara bam, dɩ malɛka kalʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o Sinayi piu kʋm yuu nɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ joŋi Wɛ bɩtarɩ sɩlʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn o pa dɩbam.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ maama, dɩ́ nabaara bam dɛɛn ba lagɩ sɩ ba sɛ Moyisi ni. Ba ma vɩ-o, yɩ ba daarɩ ba bʋŋɩ sɩ ba joori ba vu Ezipi.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ ba ma sɩɩnɩ ba mɔ kamɔgɔ kʋ nyɩ dɩ nʋa, yɩ ba pa kʋ yɩ ba jwǝni. Ba maa jɩgɩ-dɩ ba kaana. Ba ma daarɩ ba kɩ wʋpolo dɩ ba tɩtɩ na mɛ ba jɩa ba ma mɔ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Ba na kaanɩ jwǝni dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ ma pipiri DƖ kwaga DƖ ya-ba. DƖ ma yagɩ-ba sɩ ba taa zuli calɩcwɩ sɩlʋ na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ tɩn. Kʋ kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: ‹Abam Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ-ba, á dɛɛn na gʋ vara á ma kaanɩ jwǝnǝ kagʋa kam wʋnɩ bɩna fiinna tɩn, kʋ daɩ amʋ mʋ á kaanɩ á pa kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Moloki jwǝni dɩm vwe mʋ abam dɛɛn zɩŋɩ, dɩdaanɩ calɩcʋa kalʋ na yɩ abam jwǝni Rifanɩ tɩn. Tɩntʋ maama nan yɩ kamwarʋ tɩlʋ á na kɩ sɩ á taá zuli-tɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ amʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna zǝli abam ba ja vu ba gaalɩ Babilɔnɩ na wʋ mɛ tɩn.›

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nabaara bam na beeri kagʋa kam wʋnɩ tɩn, ba dɛɛn jɩgɩ Wɛ vwe dɩlʋ na brɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ ba tee nɩ tɩn mʋ. Wɛ dɛɛn brɩ Moyisi o na wʋ́ kɩ te sɩ o ma pu vwe dɩm tɩn. Ba dɛɛn sɩɩnɩ ba kɩ-dɩ nɩ Wɛ na brɩ sɩ ba kɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Kʋ kwaga seeni tɩn, dɩbam nabaara bam mʋ joŋi vwe dɩm ba kwǝ tee nɩ ba zɩŋɩ-dɩ ba ja tɔgɩ Zozwe kwaga. Ba ma vu ba wanɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ pa-ba sɩ ba taa zʋʋrɩ da tɩn. Wɛ dɛɛn zǝli je sɩm nɔɔna bam DƖ yagɩ ba yigǝ nɩ. Vwe dɩm maa wʋra taan, kʋ ba kʋ yi Davidi na zaŋɩ o ji pɛ maŋa kalʋ tɩn.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Davidi bu Salɔmɔn mʋ lɔgɩ digǝ kam o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ kamunu tɩn nan ba zʋʋra di sɩlʋ nabiinǝ na lɔgɩ tɩn wʋnɩ. Wɛ nijoŋnu dɩdʋa dɛɛn mʋ tagɩ o wɩ:

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‹Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ wɩ: Wɛyuu mʋ yɩ amʋ jǝŋǝ je, kʋ daarɩ tɩga baŋa maa yɩ amʋ nɛ cwiim je. Digǝ kɔɔ dwi mʋ abam wʋ́ wanɩ á lɔ á pa amʋ? Jǝgǝ kɔɔ mʋ amʋ wʋ́ vu a pǝni da a sin?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam wʋnɩ wʋlʋwʋlʋ tǝrǝ abam nabaara bam na wʋ bɛɛs-o. Ba dɛɛn gʋ balʋ na brɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ tʋŋɩ Cɩga Tu wʋm sɩ o ba tɩn. Lele kʋntʋ abam nan mʋ jaanɩ wʋntʋ á kɩ nɔɔna jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ á kɩ daanɩ á gʋ-o.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Abam yɩ balʋ na joŋi Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na tɔgɩ malɛsɩ jɩŋa DƖ pa abam tɩn mʋ. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ á ta wʋ sɛ-tɩ.» Ba na gʋ Etiyɛnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.
translation_verse: Etiyɛnɩ na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, kʋ ma pa Zwifǝ nakwa bam bana zaŋɩ dɩd-o zanzan, yɩ ba dʋnɩ ba yǝlǝ.

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm maa wʋ Etiyɛnɩ tee nɩ lanyɩranɩ. O ma kwǝni o yuu wɛɛnɩ o nii Wɛ-sɔŋɔ seeni yɔɔrɔ-tɔtɔ, yɩ o na Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ na dagɩ te. O ma daarɩ o nii o na Zezi na zɩgɩ Baŋa-Wɛ jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: O laan ma ta o wɩ: «Nii-na, amʋ nɛ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ ni na pʋrɩ yɩ Nabiin-bu wʋm zɩgɩ Baŋa-Wɛ jazɩm nɩ.»

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Ba ma vaŋ-o ba pa o nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm daa. Ba laan ma daarɩ ba jɩg-o ba dʋlɩ dɩ kandwa sɩ ba gʋ. Balʋ na dʋl-o dɩ kandwa tɩn ma lɩ ba gwaarʋ ba pa nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋdoŋ sɩ o ta niǝ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Sooli.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Ba na jɩgɩ Etiyɛnɩ ba dʋlɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma loori Wɛ o wɩ: «A Yuutu Zezi, joŋi a joro.»

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: O laan ma kuni doonǝ tɩga nɩ o kaasɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «A Yuutu, yɩ kwe ba taalɩ ba kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ.» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o laan ma tɩ.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Sooli maa kwaanɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm maama. O maa yǝni o tʋlɩ sam dɩm wʋnɩ o jaanɩ baara dɩ kaana balʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn o ve o kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na jagɩ te tɩn

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ balʋ na duri ba jagɩ tɩn maa yǝni ba ve je maama ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filipi ma zaŋɩ o vu Samari tɩʋ kʋdoŋ o tɔɔlɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn kwǝrǝ o brɩ nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama maa kwaanɩ ba cǝgi Filipi na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba maama cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm, yɩ ba kwǝri ba na wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ o na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Ba ma na ciciri na nuŋi sɩ yagɩ nɔɔna zanzan yɩ sɩ kaasa dɩ kwǝr-dɛ. Kwaarʋ zanzan dɩ gwanɩ dɩ ma na yazurǝ.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ wʋpolo dɛɛn maa tiini kʋ wʋ tɩʋ kʋntʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ nɔɔnʋ dɛɛn ya wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn. O dɛɛn jɩgɩ liri mwaanʋ mʋ o kɩa. Kʋ maa paɩ Samari tiinǝ bam yɩ yǝǝu dɩd-o. O maa brɩ o tɩtɩ nɩ o yɩ nɔn-kamunu mʋ.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna maama maa kwaanɩ ba cǝgi o taanɩ lanyɩranɩ, dɩdɛɛra dɩ nabwǝnǝ maama. Ba maa paɩ Wɛ dam mʋ wʋ o tee nɩ, yɩ ba jɩg-o ba bǝ ba wɩ Dam-fɔrɔ tu.

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn ya paɩ ba yɩ yǝǝu dɩ o liri mwaanʋ tɩm taan yɩ kʋ daanɩ zanzan. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba kwaanɩ ba cǝg-o lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Filipi laan ma ba o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ o brɩ-ba Wɛ paarɩ dɩm taanɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ dɩm. O na brɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna bam ma sɛ o taanɩ dɩm. Ba pa ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, baara dɩ kaana maama.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Simɔn tɩtɩ dɩ ma sɛ, yɩ o daarɩ o pa ba miis-o na wʋnɩ. O ma tɔgɩ dɩdaanɩ Filipi yɩ o naɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ Wɛ dam tɩn. O na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma sʋ-o.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna balʋ na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn ma ni nɩ Samari tiinǝ bam sɛ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm. Ba ma tʋŋɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan ba tee nɩ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba na ve ba yi da tɩn, ba ma loori Wɛ ba pa balʋ na sɛ Zezi tɩn sɩ ba wanɩ ba joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm daa ta wʋ tu bantʋ wʋlʋwʋlʋ te. Ba dɛɛn pɛ ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ má mʋ.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan laan ma daŋɩ ba jɩa ba baŋa nɩ, yɩ ba joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm ba bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam na daŋɩ ba jɩa nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ yɩ ba joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, yɩ Simɔn na nɛ kʋ na kɩ te tɩn, o ma kwe sǝbu o ma loori Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan o wɩ:

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: «A lagɩ sɩ á pa amʋ dɩ taa jɩgɩ dam dɩntʋ doŋ, sɩ a na kwe a jɩa a daŋɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋntʋ tu dɩ joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm.»

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ nmʋ dɩ n sǝbu kʋm maama, dɩ nmʋ na bʋŋɩ sɩ nń wanɩ n ma n sǝbu n yǝgi Wɛ pɛɛrɩ dɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋbʋŋa ba tɔgɩ cɩga Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, n bá na cwǝŋǝ sɩ n tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam n tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ a nɛ sɩ n jɩgɩ pu-sɩŋa zanzan, yɩ n wʋ lwarɩm gambɛɛm wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Simɔn ma lǝri o wɩ: «Nan loori-na Wɛ á pa-nɩ, sɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama á na tagɩ amʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn yɩ ba tɩ cɔgɩ-nɩ.»

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan dɛɛn ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi taanɩ dɩm ba brɩ nɔɔna bam. Ba laan ma joori ba maa ve Zeruzalɛm. Ba na maa joori tɩn, ba ma tʋlɩ Samari tɩ-niǝ yam wʋnɩ ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Filipi na pɛ dɩdɛɛrʋ lwarɩ Wɛ taanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Filipi ma zaŋɩ o maa kɛa. Etiyopi tu dɩ dɛɛn maa wʋ cwǝŋǝ kam nɩ o maa ve sɔŋɔ. Wʋntʋ mʋ tʋŋɩ o paɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm pa-kana kalʋ ba na bǝ ba wɩ Kandaasɩ tɩn. O yɩ dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋlʋ na nii o jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm maama baŋa nɩ. O dɛɛn ya ve Zeruzalɛm mʋ sɩ o zuli Wɛ,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: yɩ o laan maa joori o ve sɔŋɔ dɩ tǝriko kʋlʋ sise na vaɩ tɩn. O na maa kɛ dɩ o tǝriko kʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, o maa je o karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi na pʋpʋnɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm ma brɩ Filipi kʋ wɩ: «Ve n ta n tɔgɩ dɩ tǝriko kʋm.»

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: O ma duri o vu o yi tǝriko kʋm yɩ kʋ veǝ. O ma ni nɔɔnʋ wʋm na jɩgɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi tɔnɔ kʋm o karɩma. O ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ ni n na karɩmɩ kʋlʋ tɩn kuri na?»

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ a ni kʋ kuri, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ maŋɩ-kʋ o brɩ-nɩ?» O laan ma loori Filipi sɩ o di tǝriko kʋm baŋa o jǝni o tee nɩ.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: O na wʋra o karɩmɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: «Wʋntʋ dɛɛn mʋ nyɩ dɩ piǝ kalʋ nɔɔnʋ na vaŋɩ o ja o vu sɩ ba gʋ tɩn. O ta nyɩ dɩ pǝlbu wʋlʋ ba na fanɩ o kʋrʋ yɩ o wʋ kɩ sɔɔ tɩn. O nan wʋ puri o ni o ta kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa goon-o, yɩ ba wʋ di o taanɩ dɩ cɩga. Wɔɔn wʋ́ wanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ wʋntʋ dwi dɩm ŋwaŋa? Bɛŋwaanɩ ba lɩ o ŋwɩa lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma ta dɩ Filipi o wɩ: «A lagɩ a bwe a nii, wɔɔ taanɩ mʋ Wɛ nijoŋnu wʋm tɛa, o tɩtɩ mʋ o tɛ naa nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ mʋ?»

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Filipi ma joori o puli nɔɔnʋ wʋm na karɩmɩ mɛ tɩn o brɩ-o kʋ kuri, yɩ o daarɩ o ta Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam maama o brɩ-o.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Filipi ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ na sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ n wʋ maama, aá wanɩ a miisi-m na wʋnɩ.» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A sɛ sɩ Zezi Krisi yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu mʋ.»]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm laan ma pa tǝriko kʋm zɩgɩ. O dɩ Filipi ma tu tɩga ba vu ba zʋ na bam wʋ, yɩ Filipi miis-o na bam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ba ma nuŋi na bam wʋnɩ. Ba na nuŋi tɩn, dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ Joro kʋm ma kwe Filipi kʋ ja viiri. Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma daa wʋ nɛ-o. O ma joori o kwe cwǝŋǝ o maa kɛa, yɩ o jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Filipi ma na nɩ o wʋ Azoti nɩ mʋ. O ma tʋlɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam taan, o vu o yi Sezaarɩ.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Sooli dɛɛn maa ve yigǝ dɩ baarɩ zanzan, yɩ o brɩ nɔɔna bam nɩ Zezi mʋ sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn. Kʋ ma paɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Damasɩ nɩ tɩn daa warɩ o ni-taanɩ ba lǝri.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Nan zaŋɩ n zʋ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Nmʋ na yi da, ba laan wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ nmʋ na maŋɩ sɩ n kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Amʋ tɩtɩ nan wʋ́ brɩ-o yaara yalʋ maama o na maŋɩ sɩ o na amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sooli laan ma vu Zeruzalɛm. O maa kwaanɩ sɩ o tɔgɩ o wǝli Zezi karabiǝ bam wʋnɩ. Ba maama maa fʋna dɩd-o, yɩ ba ba bʋŋɩ nɩ o sɩɩnɩ o ji Zezi karabu.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: Vɩɩrɩm wʋnɩ mʋ o nɛ nɔɔnʋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Ananiya. O ma na-o yɩ o ba o daŋɩ o jɩa o baŋa nɩ, sɩ o yiǝ yam joori ya taa naɩ.»

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Sooli dɛɛn maa kwaana o yaarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi karabiǝ bam, yɩ o lagɩ sɩ o gʋ-ba. O ma zaŋɩ o vu Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm yuutu wʋm te.

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: O ma loor-o sɩ o pʋpʋnɩ twaanʋ o pa Zwifǝ Wɛ-di sɩm na wʋ Damasɩ nɩ tɩn, nɩ wʋm na nɛ nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam, oó ja baara dɩ kaana o ja vu o kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: O na nɛ twaanʋ tɩm tɩn, o ma zaŋɩ o maa ve Damasɩ. O na twɛ tɩʋ kʋm tɩn, pooni ma da dɩ nuŋi wɛyuu dɩ pɩpɩlɩ dɩ gilim-o.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: O ma tʋ tɩga nɩ, yɩ o ni kwǝrǝ na bǝŋi o yɩrɩ ka wɩ: «Sooli, Sooli, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ n jɩgɩ amʋ n bɛɛsɩ kʋntʋ?»

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: O ma bwe o wɩ: «A tu, nmʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?» Kwǝrǝ kam ma ta ka wɩ: «Amʋ yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ nmʋ na jɩgɩ n bɛɛsɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ Sooli tɩn maa zɩgɩ da, yɩ ba warɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ ba ta. Ba dɛɛn ni kwǝrǝ kam, yɩ ba nan wʋ nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sooli ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o puri o yiǝ yɩ o daa ba naɩ. Ba ma ja-o o jɩŋa nɩ, ba vaŋ-o ba ja zʋ Damasɩ wʋ.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn jɩgɩ da yatɔ mʋ o yiǝ na dwe. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ o wʋ di, o nan wʋ nyɔgɩ.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Zezi karabu wʋdoŋ dɛɛn maa wʋ Damasɩ nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Ananiya. O ma na vɩɩrɩm wʋnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o. O ma bǝŋi o yɩrɩ o wɩ: «Ananiya!» O ma lǝri o wɩ: «A yuutu, nii-nɩ.»

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Zaŋɩ n vu Zudasɩ sɔŋɔ, kʋ na zɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ ‹Yɔɔrɔ-tɔtɔ› tɩn ni nɩ. Nmʋ na yi da, sɩ n bwe nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Sooli tɩn bwiǝ. O yɩ Tarɩsɩ tu mʋ. Nmʋ wʋ́ na o na wʋra o warɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ananiya na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma lǝri o wɩ: «A yuutu, nɔɔna zanzan maŋɩ ba ta nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ taanɩ ba brɩ amʋ, dɩ o na kɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama o ma cɔgɩ nmʋ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: O nan tu yo dɩ ni dɩlʋ o na joŋi Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam tee nɩ tɩn mʋ, sɩ o ma ja balʋ maama na bǝ nmʋ nɩ ba Yuutu tɩn.»

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Ananiya laan ma zaŋɩ o vu o yi sɔŋɔ kʋm o zʋ. O ma na Sooli yɩ o daŋɩ o jɩa o baŋa nɩ o wɩ: «A ko-bu Sooli, dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩtɩ mʋ tʋŋɩ amʋ nmʋ tee nɩ. Wʋntʋ ya mʋ brɩ o tɩtɩ nmʋ yigǝ nɩ maŋa kalʋ n ya na wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ n maa n bɩɩnɩ tɩn. O tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a ba a pa n joori n ta n naɩ mʋ, sɩ n daarɩ n joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm dam.»

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: O laan ma di wʋdiu yɩ o dam joori dɩ ba. O ma maŋɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam tee nɩ Damasɩ nɩ da fɩnfɩɩn.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Sooli dɛɛn na wʋ Damasɩ nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o maa yǝni o vu Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-di sɩm o brɩ-ba Zezi taanɩ. O maa tɛ o wɩ: «Zezi yɩ Wɛ Bu mʋ.»

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Kʋ ma sʋ nɔɔna balʋ maama na ni o zaasɩm dɩm tɩn. Ba ma bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Kʋ daɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ o cɔgɩ balʋ na ma Zezi ba bǝ nɩ ba Yuutu tɩn na? Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ o tu yo seeni, sɩ o taa jaanɩ Zezi karabiǝ o ve o paɩ Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam na?»

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Da zanzan na kɛ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam ma kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba gʋ Sooli.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: O ma lwarɩ ba na bʋŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ-o kʋlʋ tɩn. Dɛ maama wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ ba zɩgɩ ba yɩrɩ tɩʋ kʋm niǝ yam mʋ, sɩ Sooli na tu sɩ o da da, sɩ ba laan gʋ-o.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ tɩtɩɩ nɩ mʋ o karabiǝ bam ma pa o zʋ tɩtɔgɔ wʋ, yɩ ba lǝ ŋʋna kʋ ni nɩ ba pa o da kǝbrǝ o tu tɩga yɩ o lu.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Banabasɩ ma vu o zǝn-o, yɩ o ja-o o vu Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam te. O ma ta o brɩ-ba Sooli na nɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cwǝŋǝ nɩ yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o te tɩn. O ta ma ta o brɩ-ba Sooli na kwaanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ baarɩ o pa balʋ na wʋ Damasɩ nɩ tɩn lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ Zezi yɩrɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Sooli ma maŋɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam tee nɩ, yɩ o tʋlɩ Zeruzalɛm ni maama o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ o brɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: O maa yǝni o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ taanɩ tɩn, yɩ o magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ ba. Ba laan maa kwaanɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam na lwarɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ja-o ba ja vu Sezaarɩ, yɩ ba pa o kɛ o vu Tarɩsɩ.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna balʋ maama na wʋ Zude dɩ Galile dɩ Samari je sɩm nɩ tɩn dɛɛn ma na siun dɩ ba yaara yam. Ba kɔgɔ kʋm ma fɔgɩ kʋ pulǝ kʋ wǝli da, Wɛ Joro kʋm na zǝni-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba maa tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu yɩ ba sɛ-o ba ŋwɩa maama wʋnɩ. Ene na nɛ yazurǝ te tɩn

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɛɛn yǝni o beeri o ve je maama mʋ o nii Zezi karabiǝ bam. Dɛ dɩdwɩ o daa ma zaŋɩ o vu sɩ o nii karabiǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Lidi nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: O na yi da tɩn, o ma na nɔɔnʋ o yɩrɩ mʋ Ene. O dɛɛn yɩ kɔrɔ mʋ, yɩ o tigi bɩna nana o warɩ o zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na nɛ-o tɩn, o ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ene, Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa-m yazurǝ. Nan zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ sɩ n pri n sara kam n tiŋi.» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn, mʋ Ene zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Lidi nɩ dɩ Sarɔn je sɩm maama nɩ tɩn ma na Ene na nɛ yazurǝ. Ba laan ma ba ba tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi. Tabita na joori o bi te tɩn

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋ Zope nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Tabita. O maa yɩ Zezi karabu. O maa kɩ lanyɩranɩ yɩ o wǝli yinigǝ tiinǝ zanzan.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ, o ma ba o ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ yɩ o tɩ. Nɔɔna ma kwe-o ba swɛ, yɩ ba ja-o ba di wɛyuu digǝ ba tiŋi da.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Zope nan batwarɩ dɩdaanɩ Lidi. Kʋntʋ tɩn, Zezi karabiǝ balʋ na wʋ Zope nɩ tɩn ma lwarɩ nɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tu Lidi o wʋra. Ba ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna bale o tee nɩ. Ba ma vu ba loor-o ba wɩ: «Popo, kɩ lɩla n ba dɩbam tɩʋ kʋm.»

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma zaŋɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ ba o kɛ. O na yi Zope tɩn, ba ma ja-o ba di wɛyuu digǝ kam. Kadǝnǝ bam maama maa zɩgɩ ba gilim-o yɩ ba keerǝ. Ba ma brɩ-o gwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama Dɔrkasɩ ya na ŋwɩ yɩ o nyaanɩ-tɩ o pa-ba tɩn.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma pa ba maama nuŋi pooni ba daar-o. O ma kuni doonǝ tɩga nɩ o warɩ Wɛ. O laan ma pipiri o nii tʋ wʋm yɩ o wɩ: «Tabita, zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ.» O ma puri o yiǝ o na Pɩyɛɛrɩ. O ma zaŋɩ o je.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma twɩ o jɩŋa o ja-o o pa o zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o zɩgɩ. O laan ma bǝŋi kadǝnǝ bam dɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam maama. O ma pa Tabita zɩgɩ ba yigǝ nɩ yɩ o brɩ-ba sɩ o ŋwɩ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Zope je sɩm nɔɔna bam maama ma ni kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ ŋwa. Kʋ ma paɩ nɔɔna zanzan kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma maŋɩ Zope nɩ taan da zanzan. O dɛɛn zʋʋrɩ tɔn-gɔgɔ kʋdoŋ tee nɩ mʋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ. O maa zʋʋrɩ Sezaarɩ nɩ. O dɛɛn yɩ Rom pamaŋna dɩdɛɛrʋ mʋ. Pamaŋna kɔgɔ kʋlʋ o na tɔgɩ o wʋ kʋ wʋnɩ tɩn yɩrɩ mʋ Yitali tiinǝ kɔgɔ.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn kwarɩ Wɛ, yɩ o dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama zuli Wɛ lanyɩranɩ. O maa kɩ wǝǝnu zanzan o wǝli Zwifǝ yinigǝ tiinǝ bam. O maa yǝni o warɩ Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ wɛ na guni maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o nɛ vɩɩrɩm. O ma na Wɛ malɛka na tu ka bǝŋi o yɩrɩ ka wɩ: «Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ!»

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: O maa nii malɛka kam yɩ fʋʋnɩ jɩg-o. O ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ ta, a tu.» Malɛka kam ma lǝr-o ka wɩ: «Nmʋ na yǝni n warɩ Wɛ yɩ n kwǝri n wǝli yinigǝ tiinǝ tɩn, kʋ yi Baŋa-Wɛ wʋbʋŋa. DƖ nan guli nmʋ gulǝ.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Laan nan tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu Zope ba bǝŋi nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: O yɩ vǝru mʋ o wʋ Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ tɔn-gɔgɔ tɩn sɔŋɔ nɩ, nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ.»

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam na tagɩ dɩd-o kʋntʋ ka ti tɩn, ka ma viiri. Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ ma bǝŋi o sɔŋɔ kʋm tɩntʋŋna bale dɩ pamaŋnʋ dɩdʋa wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ o pa-o yɩ o dɩ kwarɩ Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: O ma ta kʋlʋ maama na kɩ tɩn o brɩ-ba, yɩ o daarɩ o tʋŋɩ-ba sɩ ba vu Zope.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ yɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ cwǝŋǝ nɩ ba ma twɛ Zope tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ diini sɔŋɔ kʋm nayuu sɩ o warɩ Wɛ wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Kana laan maa jɩg-o yɩ o lagɩ wʋdiu sɩ o di. Ba na wʋra ba kɩ wʋdiu kʋm tɩn, Wɛ ma pa o na wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ nɩ dɩndwɩa mʋ te.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: O nɛ wɛyuu na pʋrɩ o baŋa nɩ, yɩ woŋo nuŋi da kʋ maa tu tɩga. Woŋo kʋm nyɩ dɩ gɔrɔ kamunu mʋ, yɩ ba jɩgɩ kʋ niǝ yana, yɩ kʋ maa tu tɩga.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Vara dwi maama mʋ wʋ kʋ wʋnɩ, dɩdaanɩ tɩga wo-vǝǝlu dɩ zunǝ.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: O na nɛ tɩn, o ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o ka wɩ: «Pɩyɛɛrɩ, zaŋɩ n gʋ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ n di.»

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma lǝri o wɩ: «Amʋ tu, a bá sɛ. A ta wʋ fɔgɩ a di dɩbam cullu woŋo naa kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ dɩ dim tɩn.»

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: O daa ta ma joori o ni kwǝrǝ kam na wɩ: «Yɩ zaŋɩ n culi woŋo kʋlʋ Wɛ na wɩ kʋ yɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ kuni bɩtɔ. Wǝǝnu tɩm laan ma joori tɩ vaŋɩ tɩ di wɛyuu.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ maa bwɛ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm o na nɛ tɩn kuri. Ka maŋa kam nɩ mʋ nɔɔna balʋ Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ na tʋŋɩ o tee nɩ tɩn bwe ba lwarɩ Simɔn sɔŋɔ kʋm je. Ba laan ma vu ba yi mancoŋo kʋm ba zɩga.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Ba ma bǝŋi nɔɔnʋ ba bwe ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ zʋʋrɩ yo o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ na?»

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ daa ta na wʋra o bwɛ sɩ o lwarɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm kuri tɩn, Wɛ Joro kʋm ma ta dɩd-o kʋ wɩ: «Nii, nɔɔna batɔ mʋ tu ba lagɩ nmʋ.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Zaŋɩ n tu tɩga. Yɩ ta n bwɛa, sɩ n tɔgɩ dɩ ba n vu, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ mʋ tʋŋɩ-ba.»

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma tu tɩga, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ abam na lagɩ tɩn. Bɛɛ mʋ jaanɩ abam kʋ ba?»

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Pamaŋna dɩdɛɛrʋ Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ mʋ tʋŋɩ dɩbam. O yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ yɩ o kwarɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ. Zwifǝ bam maama maa zul-o. Wɛ malɛka mʋ tagɩ dɩd-o sɩ o bǝŋi nmʋ o sɔŋɔ nɩ, sɩ o wanɩ o ni kʋlʋ nmʋ na lagɩ n ta tɩn.»

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma pa ba zʋ sɔŋɔ kʋm ba pǝni. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn o ma zaŋɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ ba o vu. Zezi karabiǝ badaara dɩ ma zaŋɩ Zope nɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba vu.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Tɩga daa na pʋʋrɩ tɩn mʋ o yi Sezaarɩ. O yi da dɩdaanɩ Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ dɩ o badonnǝ balʋ o na bǝŋi tɩn maŋɩ ba je ba cǝg-o.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na yi sɔŋɔ kʋm yɩ o maa zʋʋrɩ tɩn, Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi o jeer-o, yɩ o kuni doonǝ o yigǝ nɩ o jɔɔn-o.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma pa o zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o zɩgɩ, yɩ o ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Amʋ dɩ yɩ nabiinu mʋ.»

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: O ta maa ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o yɩ ba maa zʋʋrɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm. O ma na nɔn-kɔgɔ na kikili da ba je.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Abam maŋɩ á ye nɩ kʋ culǝ sɩ Zwifu taa zʋʋrɩ dɩdaanɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ, naa o taa tɔgɩ dɩ ba. Wɛ nan mʋ brɩ amʋ nɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ a taa culi nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ naa a paɩ o taa yɩ nɔn-diku.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, abam na tʋŋɩ á bǝŋi-nɩ tɩn, a wʋ vɩn yɩ a ba. A nan lagɩ a bwe a nii, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ á tʋŋɩ á bǝŋi-nɩ?»

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ ma ta o wɩ: «Zɩm mʋ jɩgɩ da yana, kʋ maŋɩ dɩ maŋa kantʋ nɩ wɛ na guni tɩn, dɩ a wʋra a warɩ Wɛ a sɔŋɔ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ ma da o ba o zɩgɩ a yigǝ nɩ. O zʋ gwaarʋ tɩ na nyɩɩna.

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: O ma ta dɩ amʋ o wɩ: ‹Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ, Wɛ mʋ joŋi n loro kʋm. Nmʋ na wǝli yinigǝ tiinǝ tɩn mʋ DƖ guli nmʋ gulǝ.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Nan tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu Zope ba bǝŋi nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ. O yɩ vǝru mʋ, o wʋ Simɔn wʋlʋ na yɩ tɔn-gɔgɔ tɩn sɔŋɔ nɩ. O zʋʋrɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ mʋ.›

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, a ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna lɩla sɩ ba vu ba bǝŋi nmʋ sɩ n ba. Nmʋ na tu tɩn, n kɩ cɩga. Dɩbam maama nan zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ mʋ dɩ́ cǝgi, sɩ dɩ́ ni kʋlʋ maama dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na pɛ-m sɩ n ta tɩn.»

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma zaŋɩ o ta o wɩ: «A zɩm lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ sɩ Wɛ ba kuri nɔɔna daanɩ.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Wɛ joŋi nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na kwarɩ-DƖ yɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn mʋ, kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ dwi dɩlʋ nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ á ye Wɛ na tagɩ DƖ taanɩ dɩm DƖ brɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam, nɩ Zezi Krisi mʋ waɩ o joŋi nɔɔna o fɔgɩ ba dɩ Wɛ daanɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ nabiinǝ maama Yuutu.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Abam ta ye wo-kamunnu tɩlʋ maama na kɩ Zude nɩ tɩn. Kʋ dɛɛn puli Galile nɩ mʋ, maŋa kam Zan na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ dɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba miisi na wʋnɩ tɩn kwaga nɩ.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ á ye Wɛ na pɛ DƖ Joro kʋm Nazarɛtɩ tu Zezi yɩ DƖ kwǝri DƖ pa-o dam te tɩn. Wɛ na wʋ o tee nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o yǝni o ve je maama o kɩ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ, yɩ o kwǝri o vrɩ balʋ na wʋ sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn o yaga.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan mʋ nɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama o na kɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ dɩ Zwifǝ tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama nɩ tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ yɩ cɩga kantʋ maana tiinǝ. Ba dɛɛn jaan-o mʋ ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa o joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ da yatɔ dɛ nɩ. DƖ ma pa o brɩ o tɩtɩ nɔɔna yigǝ nɩ sɩ ba na-o.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ nɔɔna maama mʋ nɛ-o, kʋ yɩ dɩbam balʋ Wɛ na maŋɩ DƖ kuri sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ o maana tiinǝ tɩn mʋ nɛ-o. Zezi na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn, dɩbam tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ di wʋdiu yɩ dɩ́ nyɔ na.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: O ma pa dɩbam ni sɩ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna, dɩ́ pa ba lwarɩ nɩ wʋm mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ na tiŋi sɩ o di naŋʋna dɩ balʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn taanɩ.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam maama dɛɛn tagɩ wʋntʋ taanɩ ba wɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ kʋntʋ tu lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-o wʋntʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ta na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ Joro kʋm ma tu balʋ maama na je ba cǝgi o taanɩ dɩm tɩn yuu nɩ.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ DƖ Joro kʋm dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ tɩn, kʋ darɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na maŋɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi yɩ ba da dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ ba ba tɩn.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ ba ni ba na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ yɩ ba kwǝri ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ laan ma ta o wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ sɩɩnɩ ba joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm nɩ dɩbam dɩ na joŋi te tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ cɩ ba yigǝ sɩ ba yɩ miisi na wʋnɩ dɩ Zezi yɩrɩ na?»

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o pa ni sɩ ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ. Ba laan ma loori Pɩyɛɛrɩ sɩ o maŋɩ ba tee nɩ da fɩnfɩɩn.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o karabiǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Zude nɩ tɩn ma ni nɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ laan sɛ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɛɛn ma zaŋɩ o vu Zeruzalɛm. O na yi da tɩn, Zwifǝ balʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn ma magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩd-o.

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma zaŋɩ o tʋlɩ kʋlʋ maama na kɩ tɩn o brɩ-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: «A ya wʋ Zope nɩ mʋ a warɩ Wɛ. Wɛ ma pa a na vɩɩrɩm. A nɛ wo-kamunu na nuŋi wɛyuu kʋ maa tu tɩga. Kʋ nyɩ dɩ gɔrɔ kamunu mʋ, yɩ ba jɩgɩ kʋ niǝ yana ba pa kʋ maa tu tɩga. Kʋ ma ba kʋ zɩgɩ a yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
