translation_verse: A ma nii kʋ wʋnɩ yɩ a na vara na wʋra, sɔŋɔ vara dɩ ga-vara dɩ tɩga wo-vǝǝlu dɩ zunǝ.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: A laan ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ amʋ ka wɩ: ‹Pɩyɛɛrɩ, zaŋɩ n gʋ n di.›

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: A ma lǝri a wɩ: ‹A tu, aye a bá sɛ. A maŋɩ a wʋ di dɩbam cullu woŋo naa kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ dɩ dim tɩn.›

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kam daa ta ma joori ka zɩgɩ wɛyuu nɩ ka ŋɔɔnɩ ka wɩ: ‹Yɩ zaŋɩ n culi woŋo kʋlʋ Wɛ na wɩ kʋ yɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma kɩ kʋntʋ taan kuni bɩtɔ, yɩ wǝǝnu tɩm maama joori tɩ vaŋɩ tɩ di wɛyuu.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Maŋa kantʋ nɩ nɔɔna batɔ dɛɛn tu ba zɩgɩ sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ amʋ na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn ni nɩ. Ba ya tʋŋɩ-ba Sezaarɩ nɩ mʋ sɩ ba ba amʋ te.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm ma ta kʋ brɩ-nɩ kʋ wɩ, a yɩ taa bwɛa, sɩ a tɔgɩ dɩ ba a vu. Dɩ́ ko-biǝ bantʋ bardʋ dɩ ma da amʋ ba vu. Dɩ́ maama ma vu dɩ́ yi Sezaarɩ, yɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ zʋ Kɔrɩnɛɛlɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: O ma ta o brɩ dɩbam o na nɛ Wɛ malɛka na tu o sɔŋɔ ka zɩgɩ yɩ ka ta dɩd-o ka wɩ: ‹Tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu Zope ba bǝŋi nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ o yɩrɩ na yɩ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩn sɩ o ba.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ na tuǝ, o laan wʋ́ ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa nmʋ dɩ n sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam maama na vrɩm tɩn.›

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: A na sɩŋɩ sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba tɩn, mʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm tu ba te nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ tu dɩbam te pulim nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: A laan ma guli dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɛɛn na tagɩ te o wɩ: ‹Zan dɛɛn miisi nɔɔna bam na wʋnɩ mʋ, Wɛ nan wʋ́ miisi abam DƖ Joro kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ.›

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ nɩ Wɛ pɛ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bantʋ DƖ pɛɛrɩ dɩm, nɩ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ pa dɩbam dɩ, maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, a nan yɩ wɔɔ mʋ sɩ a cɩ Wɛ yigǝ?»

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na tagɩ kʋntʋ yɩ ba ni tɩn, ba ma yagɩ taanɩ dɩm yɩ ba daarɩ ba zuli Wɛ. Ba maa wɩ: «Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ pa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba na DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam.» Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ tɩn na kɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ba dɛɛn na gʋ Etiyɛnɩ tɩn, nɔɔna yaarɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam kʋ pa ba jagɩ da-yigǝ nɩ. Balʋ na jagɩ tɩn badonnǝ ma vu ba yi Fenisi dɩ Sipri dɩ Antɩɔsɩ. Ba na jagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba yǝni ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam ba brɩ Zwifǝ bam yɩranɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zezi karabiǝ badaara na nuŋi Sipri dɩ Sirɛɛnɩ tɩn ma zaŋɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ ba tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ba brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ dam maa wʋ ba tee nɩ. Nɔɔna zanzan ma kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩ ba tɔg-o.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn ma ni kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn. Ba ma tʋŋɩ Banabasɩ sɩ o vu Antɩɔsɩ o nii.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: O na ve o yi da tɩn, o ma na Wɛ na sɩɩnɩ DƖ kɩ nɔɔna bam lanyɩranɩ te tɩn. O maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ. O ma kwe ba maama kwiǝ yalʋ na wʋ́ pa ba taa tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dɩ ba wʋ maama sɩ ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba yagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Banabasɩ dɛɛn yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm. O maa tiini o jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ o tee nɩ dɩ dam. Nɔɔna zanzan dɛɛn ma ba ba tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm, yɩ ba dɩ wǝli o kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Banabasɩ laan ma zaŋɩ o vu Tarɩsɩ sɩ o beeri Sooli je.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: O na ve o na-o tɩn, o ma ja-o o joori Antɩɔsɩ. Ba na wʋra tɩn, ba maa yǝni ba wǝli daanɩ ba brɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm Wɛ taanɩ. Ba kɩ kʋntʋ taan sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi bɩm, yɩ nɔɔna balʋ ba na brɩ tɩn dagɩ zanzan. Kʋ yɩ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ mʋ ba puli sɩ ba bǝŋi Zezi karabiǝ bam nɩ Krisi biǝ.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Da yam kʋntʋ nɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ badonnǝ ma zɩgɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Ba dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Agabusi. Wɛ Joro kʋm ma pa o ta Wɛ kwǝrǝ, nɩ kana lagɩ ka ba ka tiini ka zʋ lʋgʋ maama.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ Pɛ Erɔdɩ ma zaŋɩ o ja Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔna badonnǝ sɩ o yaarɩ-ba.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: O ma ja Zakɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Zan zɩmbaarʋ tɩn o pa ba gʋ-o dɩ sʋ-zɔɔ.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ maa wʋ pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ taan, yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam tiini ba loori Wɛ o ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ tɩtɩɩ dɩlʋ tɩga na wʋ́ pʋʋrɩ sɩ Erɔdɩ pa Pɩyɛɛrɩ nuŋi pooni sɩ o di o taanɩ tɩn. Pɩyɛɛrɩ ya tigi pamaŋna bale tɩtarɩ nɩ mʋ o dɔa. Ba ya vɔg-o dɩ capʋnnʋ tɩle mʋ. Pamaŋna badonnǝ dɩ ma wʋ pɩɩna digǝ kam ni nɩ ba yɩra.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka laan ma da ka tu ka zɩgɩ da. Pooni maa da zǝŋi digǝ kam wʋnɩ. Malɛka kam ma pɩpagɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩkǝri nɩ ka pa o zaŋɩ, yɩ ka ta-o ka wɩ: «Kɩ lɩla n zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ!» Capʋnnʋ tɩm ma kɔ Pɩyɛɛrɩ jɩa nɩ tɩ tʋ tɩga nɩ.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Malɛka kam ma ta-o ka wɩ: «Fɔgɩ n vɔ n vɔɔrʋ tɩm sɩ n zʋ n natra yam.» O ma sɩɩnɩ o kɩ kʋntʋ. Ka daa ma ta ka wɩ: «Kwe n kasaa kʋm n zʋ, sɩ n ta n tɔgɩ amʋ.»

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba gaalɩ dayigǝ yɩrɩna bam dɩ kwaga yɩrɩna bam. Ba laan ma vu ba yi luu-bor-zɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na pʋrɩ kʋ yɔɔrɩ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ tɩn. Boro kʋm tɩtɩ ma pʋrɩ, yɩ ba kɛ ba nuŋi. Ba ma kwe cwǝŋǝ ba ve ba maa kɛa. Malɛka kam laan ma da ka viiri ka daarɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Kʋ laan ma ba Pɩyɛɛrɩ wʋbʋŋa. O ma ta o wɩ: «A laan lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Wɛ mʋ sɩɩnɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ DƖ malɛka sɩ ka ba ka joŋi-nɩ Erɔdɩ jɩŋa nɩ ka yagɩ, sɩ Zwifǝ bam daa yɩ wanɩ ba kɩ amʋ nɩ ba na bʋŋɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ na maanɩ kʋ na yɩ te tɩn, o ma vu Mari-ba sɔŋɔ. Wʋntʋ yɩ Zan Marɩkɩ nu mʋ. Nɔɔna zanzan dɛɛn mʋ kikili daanɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ ba wʋra ba warɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: O na ve tɩn, o ma lwarɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ kwǝrǝ. O maa tiini o jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan kʋ pa o duri o joori, yɩ o wʋ pʋrɩ boro kʋm. O ma vu o ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Pɩyɛɛrɩ mʋ zɩgɩ cicwǝŋǝ nɩ.»

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ, o co mʋ. O maa cɩm yɩ o ta o wɩ: «Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.» Ba daa ma lǝri ba wɩ: «Kʋ ga yɩ o ciru mʋ.»

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Pɩyɛɛrɩ daa ta maa zɩgɩ o magɩ boro kʋm taan. Ba laan ma ba ba pʋrɩ. Ba na nɛ-o tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ sʋ-ba.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: O ma zǝŋi o jɩa o wɩ, ba cǝgi sɔɔ. O ma daarɩ o maŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na kɩ te o ja-o o nuŋi pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ tɩn. O ta ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ, ba ve ba ta kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn ba brɩ Zakɩ dɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam maama. O laan ma yagɩ-ba yɩ o vu jǝgǝ kadoŋ.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩtɩɩtɩ tɩn, pamaŋna balʋ ya na yɩrɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa vugimi. Ba ma bwe daanɩ ba wɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ tǝrǝ?»

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ ma pa ni sɩ ba kwaanɩ ba beeri o jǝgǝ. Ba ma beer-o taan ba ga. Erɔdɩ ma bwe pamaŋna bam o nii, ba kɩ ta mʋ yɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ nuŋi, yɩ o daarɩ o pa ni sɩ ba gʋ-ba. Kʋntʋ na kɩ kʋ kɛ tɩn, Erɔdɩ ma zaŋɩ Zude nɩ o vu Sezaarɩ o zʋʋrɩ da. Kʋ na kɩ te yɩ Erɔdɩ tɩ tɩn

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ banɩ dɛɛn tiini dɩ zaŋɩ dɩ Tiiri dɩ Sidɔn tiinǝ. Je sɩm kʋntʋ nɔɔna bam ma zaŋɩ ba la kɔgɔ sɩ ba vu ba tʋ Erɔdɩ sɩ o yagɩ. Erɔdɩ dɛɛn jɩgɩ dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋlʋ na nii o sɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Bɩlasɩtɩ. Nɔɔna bam ma puli ba di ciloŋo dɩdaanɩ wʋntʋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba vu Erɔdɩ te ba ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o sɩ o yagɩ o ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm. Ba dɛɛn lagɩ sɩ ba ni daanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba tɩtɩ tɩʋ kʋm yǝni kʋ joŋi kʋ wʋdiiru pɛ wʋntʋ tɩʋ kʋm nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Ba ma lɩ dɛ sɩ ba jǝni daanɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩm. Dɛ dɩm na yi tɩn, Erɔdɩ ma kwe o paarɩ gwar-fwaarʋ o zʋ. O laan ma jǝni o paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Erɔdɩ na sɛ ba zulǝ yam yɩ o wʋ pɛ Wɛ DƖ zulǝ tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ malɛka ma pa yawɩʋ ja-o lɩla. Kanzwa ma zʋ o wʋ ya di-o ya gʋ.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabasɩ dɩ Sooli ma ti tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ ba na ve Zeruzalɛm sɩ ba tʋŋɩ tɩn. Ba laan ma ja Zan Marɩkɩ ba wǝli ba tɩtɩ nɩ, yɩ ba nuŋi Zeruzalɛm ba joori ba vu Antɩɔsɩ.

english_verse: While they were worshiping the Lord and going without eating, the Holy Spirit told them, “Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do the work for which I have chosen them.”
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ ba maa wʋra ba zuli Baŋa-Wɛ, yɩ ba ta kwǝri ba vɔ ni. Wɛ Joro kʋm laan ma ta kʋ brɩ-ba kʋ wɩ: «Lɩ-na Banabasɩ dɩ Sooli amʋ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ ba taa tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ amʋ na kuri-ba sɩ ba tʋŋɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba daa ma vɔ ni yɩ ba loori Wɛ ba pa-ba. Ba ma daarɩ ba daŋɩ ba jɩa ba baŋa nɩ, yɩ ba laan banɩ-ba yɩ ba viiri. Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ na wʋ Sipri nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm dɛɛn na tʋŋɩ Banabasɩ dɩ Sooli kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma vu ba yi Seliusi. Ba ma zʋ naboro ba tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ ba vu ba bɛ ba yi Sipri.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba zʋ Sipri tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Salamini. Ba na yi da tɩn, ba maa zʋʋrɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-di sɩm ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ. Zan Marɩkɩ maa wʋ ba tee nɩ o wǝli-ba.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋɩ Salamini nɩ ba tʋlɩ je sɩm maama ba kɛ. Ba ma vu ba yi Pafɔsɩ. Ba ma jeeri liri tu wʋdoŋ dáanɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Bar-Zezi, yɩ o yɩ Zwifu. O dɛɛn paɩ o yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ yɩ o daɩ.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: O maa yɩ gʋvɩrma tu Sɛrɩziu Polusi kwaga nɔɔnʋ mʋ. Gʋvɩrma tu wʋm maa jɩgɩ swan lanyɩranɩ. O ma bǝŋi Banabasɩ dɩ Sooli o pa ba ba o te. O maa lagɩ sɩ o ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Liri tu wʋm ma zaŋɩ o wʋra o culi ba brɩm dɩm. O maa kwaanɩ sɩ o cɩ gʋvɩrma tu wʋm sɩ o yɩ sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam. Liri tu wʋm yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ mʋ yɩ Elimasɩ dɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ taanɩ.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Sooli wʋlʋ yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ ta na yɩ Pooli tɩn dɛɛn jɩgɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam lanyɩranɩ. O ma nii liri tu wʋm vɩrr, yɩ o wɩ:

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: «N wʋ su dɩ sɩsɩɩna mʋ dɩdaanɩ balɔrɔ. Nmʋ yɩ sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ mʋ. Nmʋ culi wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na lana tɩn. Nmʋ tiini n kwaana sɩ n pipiri dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm cɩga kam sɩ ka ji vwan mʋ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Nii, Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ ba DƖ magɩ-m dɩ DƖ jɩ-dɩa lele kʋntʋ. Nń ji lilwe yɩ n daa n bá na wɩa pooni, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na lagɩ tɩn.» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ mʋ Elimasɩ yiǝ dwe, yɩ o zɩgɩ lim wʋnɩ. O maa ve o kɩkara, yɩ o lagɩ vaŋɩnʋ sɩ o ja o jɩŋa.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Gʋvɩrma tu wʋm na nɛ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn, o laan ma kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi. Dɩ́ Yuutu cɩga kam ba na brɩ-o tɩn ma sʋ-o. Pooli-ba na wʋ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ o badonnǝ bam laan ma zaŋɩ Pafɔsɩ nɩ ba zʋ naboro ba vu ba yi Pamfili tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Pɛrɩzɩ. Zan Marɩkɩ ma yagɩ-ba dáanɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o joori Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ba daa maa zɩgɩ Pɛrɩzɩ nɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ Pisidi nɩ tɩn. Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ dɩm na yi tɩn, ba ma vu ba zʋ ba Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋ ba je da.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma zaŋɩ ba karɩmɩ Moyisi cullu twaanʋ tɩm dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam twaanʋ tɩm wʋnɩ. Ba na karɩmɩ ba ti tɩn, ba yigǝ tiinǝ bam ma tʋŋɩ ni ba pa Pooli-ba, yɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam na jɩgɩ kwiǝ yalʋ na wʋ́ zǝni nɔɔna bam tɩn, sɩ á zaŋɩ á ta.»

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Pooli ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ o zǝŋi o jɩŋa, yɩ o laan daarɩ o ta o wɩ: «Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ-ba dɩdaanɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na kwarɩ Wɛ tɩn, cǝgi-na a na lagɩ a ta kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Nan taá yɩrɩ-na á tɩtɩ, sɩ lɛɛrʋ tɩlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na pʋpʋnɩ tɩ taanɩ tɩn yɩ zaŋɩ tɩ yi abam.

english_verse: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.
translation_verse: Ba na zʋ Kanaan tɩn, DƖ ma pa tɩʋ kʋm dwi dwi tiinǝ kuni bɩrpɛ cɔgɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam taa te tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn ma ba DƖ lɩ Sayuli paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa Davidi ji ba pɛ. Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ wʋntʋ taanɩ DƖ wɩ: ‹Zese bu Davidi yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na su amʋ wʋ tɩn. Wʋntʋ wʋ́ kɩ kʋlʋ maama a wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ wʋntʋ dwi dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ Wɛ pɛ Zezi ba. Wɛ ma tɔgɩ ni dɩlʋ DƖ na goni tɩn DƖ pa Zezi ji dɩbam Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam Vɩrnʋ.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Kʋ na tu kʋ daarɩ fɩnfɩɩn sɩ Zan ti o tɩtʋŋa yam tɩn, o ma bwe nɔɔna bam o wɩ: ‹Abam bʋŋɩ sɩ amʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ? Amʋ daɩ wʋlʋ wʋm á na tɩɩnɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ nan lagɩ o saŋɩ a kwaga mʋ o ba, yɩ a wʋ maŋɩ sɩ a bwǝli o nɛ natra dɩ.›

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, Abraham dwi tiinǝ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na kwarɩ Wɛ tɩn, kʋ yɩ dɩbam mʋ Wɛ pɛ sɩ dɩ́ ni DƖ taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ, sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ DƖ na lagɩ DƖ vrɩ dɩbam DƖ yagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The people of Jerusalem and their leaders didn't realize who Jesus was. And they didn't understand the words of the prophets they read each Sabbath. So they condemned Jesus just as the prophets had said.
translation_verse: Zeruzalɛm tiinǝ bam dɩ ba yigǝ tiinǝ bam nan wʋ lwarɩ Zezi na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn. Kʋ daa zɩ yɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na pʋpʋnɩ ba tiŋi yɩ nɔɔna yǝni ba karɩmɩ-tɩ ba siun da yam maama nɩ tɩn, ba ba ni wǝǝnu tɩntʋ kuri dɩ. Ba nan na pɛ Zezi na cam tɩn, kʋ pɛ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Ba ma kɩ kʋlʋ maama na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ yɩ kʋ ta o taanɩ tɩn ba ti. O na tɩgɩ tɩn, ba laan ma par-o tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ ba ja vu ba kɩ yibeeli wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Wɛ laan ma pa o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: DƖ laan sɩɩnɩ DƖ kɩ DƖ pa dɩbam balʋ na yɩ ba naarʋ tɩn. Mʋ kʋntʋ mʋ DƖ bi Zezi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Kʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ lǝŋ-ŋwɩ tɔnɔ pɔɔrɩm bɩle tu wʋnɩ te tɩn kʋ wɩ: ‹Nmʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ Bu yɩ zɩm amʋ dɩ jigi nmʋ Ko.›

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm daa ta brɩ Wɛ na wʋ́ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, sɩ o yɩra yɩ pɔ. Kʋ ma ta kʋ wɩ: ‹Aá pa n na wo-laarʋ cɩga cɩga, nɩ a na maŋɩ a go ni sɩ a pa Davidi na-tɩ te tɩn.›

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm jǝgǝ kadoŋ nɩ Davidi pʋpʋnɩ o wɩ: ‹Nmʋ Wɛ bá sɛ sɩ n tɩtɩ Wʋ-poŋo Tu wʋm yɩra pɔ.›

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Davidi tɩtɩ, wʋntʋ dɛɛn tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam maŋa kalʋ o na ŋwɩ tɩn, yɩ o laan ba o tɩ. Ba ma kwe-o ba kɩ o nabaara bam tee nɩ. O yɩra yam ma sɩɩnɩ ya pɔ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ wʋm Wɛ na pɛ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn, wʋntʋ yɩra nan wʋ pɔgɩ.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam maŋɩ sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ Zezi ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ yagɩ á lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam.

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma zaŋɩ ba jagɩ. Ba zanzan ma tɔgɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ, Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na nɩgɩ Wɛ yɩ ba tɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam tɩn dɩ maa tɔga. Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ maa ta dɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba ta kwaanɩ ba dalɩ Wɛ DƖ zaanɩ dɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam na nɛ kɔgɔ kʋm na su je sɩm maama tɩn, ba maa tiini ba jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋrʋ dɩ ba. Ba ma yáalɩ Pooli na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ ba kwǝri ba twɩ-o.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ laan ma fɔgɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ baarɩ, yɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ ya maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ puli abam tee nɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam. Abam nan na maŋɩ á wʋ sɛ-ka tɩn, abam ba bʋŋɩ nɩ á maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te dɩ́ daarɩ abam.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na pɛ dɩbam ni dɩlʋ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: ‹Amʋ Wɛ tiŋi nmʋ sɩ n ja a pooni dɩm n vu n pa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam, sɩ n wanɩ n pa nabiinǝ na vrɩm lʋgʋ baŋa je maama nɩ.› »

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na wʋra yɩ ba ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo, yɩ ba pa Baŋa-Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam jɩgɩ dam. Balʋ maama na maŋɩ sɩ ba na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam ma jagɩ je sɩm kʋntʋ maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zwifǝ bam ma kwaanɩ ba pa kaana balʋ jɩŋa na jɩgɩ yɩ ba nɩgɩ Wɛ tɩn dɩ tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ bam bana zaŋɩ dɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ. Ba dɛɛn ma pa ba yaarɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba zǝli-ba ba pa ba nuŋi ba tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ba na kɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ ma pɩɩsɩ ba nɛ fogo kʋm ba yagɩ da, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ ba wʋ kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Ba laan ma daarɩ ba vu Yikon.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam dɛɛn tiini ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ ba tee nɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas spoke in the synagogue in Iconium, just as they had done at Antioch, and many Jews and Gentiles put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ na wʋ Yikon nɩ tɩn, ba daa ta ve Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam. Ba ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm ba brɩ nɔɔna bam, yɩ ba zanzan kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi, Zwifǝ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zwifǝ badonnǝ vɩn Wɛ taanɩ dɩm. Bantʋ ma zaŋɩ ba vugimi dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam wʋbʋŋa ba pa ba wʋrʋ cɔgɩ dɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ maa zʋʋrɩ da taan. Ba na wʋra kʋntʋ tɩn, ba maa ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi taanɩ dɩ baarɩ yɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o. Ba maa tɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na kɩ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ te tɩn, yɩ o zɩgɩ ba taanɩ dɩm kwaga nɩ dɩ o na pɛ-ba dam sɩ ba taa kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ Wɛ dam tɩn.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam dɛɛn pɔɔrɩ bɩle mʋ. Badaara tɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam mʋ, yɩ badonnǝ dɩ tɔgɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ Zwifǝ badonnǝ dɛɛn ma lɩ wʋbʋŋa ba wǝli dɩdaanɩ ba yigǝ tiinǝ bam, sɩ ba yaarɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam, sɩ ba dʋlɩ-ba dɩ kandwa.

english_verse: But when the two apostles found out what was happening, they escaped to the region of Lycaonia. They preached the good news there in the towns of Lystra and Derbe and in the nearby countryside. Paul and Barnabas in Lystra
translation_verse: Ba na wʋra tɩn, ba maa tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ba brɩ nɔɔna. Kʋ na kɩ te Lisitri nɩ tɩn

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋ Lisitri nɩ, o yɩ kɔrɔ mʋ. Kʋ na zɩgɩ o lʋra maŋa nɩ o maŋɩ o warɩ o vu.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: O dɛɛn maa tɔgɩ o je o cǝgi Pooli na ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ tɩn. Pooli ma nii-o ziin, yɩ o lwarɩ nɩ o kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi sɩ o wanɩ o na yazurǝ.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm na nɛ kʋlʋ Pooli na kɩ tɩn, ba maa tiini ba ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ ba tɩtɩ dwi taanɩ dɩm ba wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ dɩbam wa yam mʋ jigi nabiinǝ ya tu ya ba dɩbam te.»

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ba ma pa Banabasɩ yɩrɩ nɩ Ziusi. Pooli dɩ yɩrɩ maa yɩ Ɛrmɛsɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ ya mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn maa jɩgɩ digǝ ba tɩʋ kʋm daa nɩ ba na yǝni ba kaanɩ ba wɛ Ziusi da tɩn. Ba kaanɩm tu wʋm ma zaŋɩ o ja nabɛ dɩ tweeru punnu tɩlʋ ba na sɔgɩ tɩn o ba o zɩgɩ tɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ. Wʋntʋ dɩdaanɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama dɛɛn maa lagɩ sɩ ba gʋ nabɛ sɩm ba ma kaanɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam.

english_verse: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: «Nɔɔna-ba, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ abam lagɩ á kɩ kʋntʋ? Dɩbam yɩ nabiinǝ mʋ, nɩ abam dɩ te. Dɩbam nan tu yo seeni sɩ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam mʋ dɩ́ brɩ abam, sɩ á yagɩ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm, sɩ á daarɩ á taá tɔgɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ. Dɩntʋ mʋ kɩ wɛyuu dɩ tɩga dɩ na-fara dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ tɩ wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: In times past, God let each nation go its own way.
translation_verse: Faŋa tɩn, Wɛ dɛɛn yagɩ dwi maama sɩ dɩ kɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, DƖ ta yǝni DƖ kɩ abam lanyɩranɩ, sɩ kʋ pa á lwarɩ nɩ DƖ yɩ Wɛ cɩga cɩga. DƖ yǝni DƖ pa dʋa nɩa yɩ wʋdiiru kɩ tɩ maŋa nɩ. DƖ paɩ abam wʋdiu yɩ á di, yɩ DƖ paɩ abam wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ.»

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ya gɛ fɩnfɩɩn mʋ sɩ nɔɔna bam kwe wǝǝnu tɩm ba ma kaanɩ-ba, yɩ ba laan yagɩ.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ badonnǝ ya nuŋi Antɩɔsɩ mʋ Pisidi tɩʋ nɩ ba ba. Badaara dɩ ma nuŋi Yikon ba ba. Bantʋ ma pa kɔgɔ kʋm maama wʋrʋ lǝni dɩ Pooli. Ba laan ma dʋl-o dɩ kandwa, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tuur-o ba ja nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ. Ba ya bʋŋɩ nɩ o tɩgɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam laan ma vu ba gilim-o. O ma zaŋɩ ba tɩtarɩ nɩ o joori o zʋ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, o ma tɔgɩ dɩdaanɩ Banabasɩ yɩ ba vu Dɛrɩbɩ. Ba na joori ba vu Antɩɔsɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ na wʋ Dɛrɩbɩ nɩ tɩn, ba ma tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam yɩ nɔɔna zanzan ji Zezi karabiǝ. Ba daa ma joori ba vu Lisitri dɩ Yikon, yɩ ba daarɩ ba kɛ ba yi Antɩɔsɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ Pisidi wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Je sɩlʋ maama ba na ve tɩn, ba lɩ nakwa Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ sɩ ba taa nii-ba. Ba maa yǝni ba vɔ ni ba loori Wɛ ba pa nakwa bam, yɩ ba kɩ-ba dɩ́ Yuutu jɩŋa nɩ, o na yɩ wʋlʋ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn ma da Pisidi ba kɛ. Ba ma vu ba yi Pamfili je sɩm.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Ba na wʋra tɩn, ba ma vu Pɛrɩzɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm da, yɩ ba daarɩ ba vu Atali.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ba na yi Antɩɔsɩ tɩn, ba ma pa Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm la daanɩ, yɩ ba laan tʋlɩ kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ dɩ ba tɩn ba brɩ-ba, dɩ DƖ na pʋrɩ cwǝŋǝ DƖ pa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ sɩ ba wanɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Ba ma zʋ Zezi karabiǝ bam tee nɩ ba daanɩ.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ ma zaŋɩ Zude nɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ. Ba maa wʋra ba brɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam ba wɩ: «Abam na wʋ sɛ á tɔgɩ Moyisi cullu tɩm na brɩ te sɩ á go á bǝkǝri, á bá wanɩ á na vrɩm.»

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma tiini ba magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ nɔɔna bam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm ma lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ ba lɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ dɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ ba wʋnɩ, sɩ ba ja taanɩ dɩm ba vu Zeruzalɛm ba kɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ nakwa bam jɩa nɩ.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm ma banɩ-ba yɩ ba kɛ. Ba ma vu ba da Fenisi dɩ Samari je sɩm. Ba na maa ve tɩn, ba maa tɛ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ na lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba sɛ Wɛ te tɩn ba brɩ nɔɔna bam. Zezi karabiǝ bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa ba maama jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi Zeruzalɛm. Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm maama dɩ ba nakwa bam ma jeeri-ba lanyɩranɩ. Ba laan ma maŋɩ ba brɩ-ba Wɛ na kɩ kʋlʋ dɩ ba tɩn.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ badaara balʋ na wʋ Farizɩan kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ yɩ ba ba ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn ni taanɩ dɩm. Ba ma zaŋɩ ba ta ba wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba go ba bǝkǝri mʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba sɛ Moyisi cullu tɩm maama na brɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam ma la daanɩ sɩ ba bwɛ taanɩ dɩm ba nii.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ba na magɩ kantɔgɔ taan tɩn, Pɩyɛɛrɩ ma zaŋɩ ba wʋnɩ o ta o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, abam ye sɩ Wɛ dɛɛn kuri amʋ abam wʋnɩ, sɩ a vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te sɩ a brɩ-ba DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, sɩ ba daarɩ ba sɛ-ka.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ye nɔɔna wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn, DƖ ma pa-ba DƖ Joro kʋm, nɩ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ pa dɩbam te tɩn, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ DƖ sɩɩnɩ DƖ vrɩ-ba ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: DƖ ma wʋ pɔɔrɩ bantʋ dɩ dɩbam daanɩ. DƖ fɔgɩ DƖ kwɛ ba wʋbʋŋa mʋ dɩ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ á bʋŋɩ sɩ á maŋɩ Wɛ á nii dɩ á na lagɩ á pa Zezi karabiǝ bam zɩŋɩ zɩla yalʋ na dummǝ ya dwe-ba tɩn? Kʋ na yɩ dɩbam nabaara bam naa dɩbam tɩtɩ dɩ, dɩ́ warɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ kǝnǝ yantʋ cwǝŋǝ, yɩ á lagɩ á pa bantʋ tɔgɩ-ka.

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ. Wɛ na joŋi dɩbam DƖ yagɩ te tɩn, kʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ, dɩ dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ bantʋ dɩ.»

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba kɔgɔ kʋm maa je, yɩ ba cǝgi sɔɔ sɩ ba ni taanɩ dɩm. Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ ma zaŋɩ ba ta Wɛ na dɛ bantʋ jɩŋa DƖ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ DƖ dam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te tɩn.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Ba na ŋɔɔnɩ ba ti tɩn, Zakɩ ma zaŋɩ o ta o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, á cǝgi-na a na lagɩ a ta kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ maŋɩ o ta o brɩ dɩbam, Wɛ na sɩŋɩ DƖ brɩ DƖ tɩtɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam tee nɩ yɩ DƖ lɩ nɔɔna ba wʋnɩ sɩ ba taa yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna te tɩn.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‹Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ amʋ Wɛ wʋ́ joori a ba, yɩ a daa lɔ Davidi sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ ya na cɔgɩ tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ fɔgɩ a lɔ di-doŋo kʋm, sɩ kʋ ji sɔ-dʋŋʋ.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Zakɩ ta ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ amʋ bʋŋɩ sɩ, dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ yaarɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na tu ba sɛ Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na wʋ́ kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ mʋ dɩ́ pa-ba, sɩ dɩ́ brɩ-ba nɩ ba daa yɩ taa di wʋdiu kʋlʋ nɔɔna na mɛ ba kaanɩ jwǝnǝ yɩ kʋ ba lana tɩn, sɩ ba yɩ cɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ kaana, sɩ kaana dɩ yɩ cɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ baara. Dɩ́ wʋ́ ta dɩ ba sɩ ba yɩ di varɩm wʋlʋ ba na jujugi ba gʋ tɩn, sɩ ba yɩ di jana dɩ.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, kʋ na sɩŋɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn, ba maŋɩ ba karɩmɩ Moyisi tɔnɔ kʋm Zwifǝ Wɛ-di sɩm nɩ ba siun dɛ maama wʋnɩ, yɩ nɔɔna yǝni ba brɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ da tɩn tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ba maama na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam maa lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ ba lɩ nɔɔna ba wʋnɩ, sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ. Ba dɛɛn ma lɩ nɔɔna bale balʋ na yɩ yigǝ tiinǝ ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn. Ba dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Zudi wʋlʋ yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ na yɩ Basaba tɩn. Wʋdoŋ wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Silasɩ.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ba ma pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ sɩ ba tʋŋɩ-ba dɩ kʋ, yɩ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Dɩbam balʋ na yɩ á ko-biǝ tɩn, Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam, dɩ́ jɔɔnɩ abam, dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na tu á tɔgɩ Zezi yɩ á zʋʋrɩ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ, dɩ Siiri dɩ Silisi nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Dɩbam ni nɩ dɩ́ kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna badonnǝ mʋ zaŋɩ ba ba abam te, ba yaarɩ abam ba pa á wʋbʋŋa cɔgɩ dɩ kʋlʋ ba na brɩ abam tɩn. Dɩbam nan wʋ pɛ-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam maama mʋ kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ dɩ́ lɩ nɔɔna dɩ́ tʋŋɩ-ba abam tee nɩ, sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam cilon-sonnu Banabasɩ dɩ Pooli ba ba.

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ na kwe ba ŋwɩa maama ba pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan mʋ tʋŋɩ Zudi dɩ Silasɩ abam tee nɩ, sɩ ba ba ba fɔgɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba brɩ abam kʋlʋ dɩ́ na pʋpʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩdaanɩ dɩbam maama bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ yaarɩ abam zanzan. Woŋo kʋlʋ yɩranɩ na yɩ fɩfɩʋn sɩ á yɩ kɩ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ:

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á di wʋdiu kʋlʋ ba na mɛ ba kaanɩ jwǝnǝ tɩn. Á yɩ di jana. Á yɩ di varɩm wʋlʋ ba na jujugi ba gʋ tɩn. Á yɩ cɔgɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ kaana, sɩ kaana dɩ yɩ cɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ baara. Á na jɩgɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama, á wʋ́ taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ.»

english_verse: The four men left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. Then they called the church members together and gave them the letter.
translation_verse: Ba na pʋpʋnɩ kʋntʋ ba ti tɩn, ba laan ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba vu Antɩɔsɩ. Ba na yi da tɩn, ba ma la ba kɔgɔ kʋm maama daanɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pa-ba tɔnɔ kʋm sɩ ba karɩmɩ.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋm tɩn, ba maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ kʋ na fɔgɩ kʋ zǝni ba wʋbʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Zudi dɩ Silasɩ na yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ tɩn dɛɛn ma tiini ba ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam ba pa ba na pu-dɩa dɩ baarɩ.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Ba maa daanɩ ba tee nɩ, yɩ ba ba ba lagɩ ba viiri. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam ma banɩ-ba, yɩ ba joori ba vu balʋ na tʋŋɩ-ba tɩn te dɩ yazurǝ. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ dɩ ma maŋɩ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ. Ba dɛɛn maa tɔgɩ dɩ nɔɔna zanzan ba tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam yɩ ba brɩ DƖ cɩga kam. Pooli dɩ Banabasɩ na pɔɔrɩ daanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Ba na daanɩ da da yagratʋ tɩn, Pooli ma ta dɩ Banabasɩ o wɩ: «Pa dɩ́ joori dɩ́ vu dɩ́ nii dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ maama wʋnɩ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm kwǝrǝ kam da tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ nii kʋ na yɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabasɩ ma sɛ yɩ o lagɩ sɩ Zan Marɩkɩ taa tɔgɩ dɩdaanɩ ba o tʋŋa.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Pooli maa bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o tɔgɩ o wǝli ba wʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ maŋa kalʋ ba dɛɛn na wʋ Pamfili nɩ tɩn wʋntʋ yagɩ-ba mʋ, yɩ o daa ba tɔgɩ dɩ ba o tʋŋa.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ba ma tiini ba magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ, yɩ kʋ pa ba pwɛ da-tee nɩ. Banabasɩ ma ja Zan Marɩkɩ yɩ ba vu ba zʋ naboro sɩ ba vu Sipri.

english_verse: but Paul took Silas and left after the followers had placed them in God's care.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ ma lɩ Silasɩ sɩ ba tɔgɩ daanɩ ba vu. Zezi karabiǝ bam ma kɩ-ba dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm jɩŋa nɩ sɩ o zǝni-ba. Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba kɛ.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pooli daa ta ma vu o yi Dɛrɩbɩ dɩ Lisitri. Zezi karabu wʋdoŋ maa wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Timoti. O nu maa yɩ Zwifu yɩ o dɩ kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi. O ko maa yɩ Grɛkɩ tu.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Lisitri nɩ dɩ Yikon nɩ tɩn maa tɛ ba wɩ, o yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: and Paul wanted him to go with them. But Paul first had him circumcised, because all the Jewish people around there knew that Timothy's father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pooli maa lagɩ sɩ o ja-o, sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ daanɩ ba tʋŋa. Zwifǝ balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ tɩn maa ye nɩ Timoti ko yɩ Grɛkɩ tu mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Pooli ma pa ba go-o, nɩ Moyisi dɛɛn na brɩ Zwifǝ bam sɩ ba taa goni ba bǝkǝri te tɩn.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba tʋlɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm sɩ ba nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam maama. Ba maa brɩ-ba niǝ yalʋ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam na lɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn. Ba ma ta dɩ ba sɩ ba taa sɛ niǝ yam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ pɛ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam na wʋ je sɩlʋ maama tɩn na dam dɩ ba Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm, yɩ dɛ maama ba kɔgɔ kʋm fɔgɩ kʋ pulǝ kʋ wǝli da. Pooli na nɛ vɩɩrɩm Trʋasɩ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba yi Miizi sisǝm dɩm ni. Ba maa kwaanɩ sɩ ba zʋ Bitini wʋ. Zezi Joro kʋm ma wʋ pɛ-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ da.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Ba na kwaanɩ ba ga kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma tɔgɩ Miizi wʋ ba kɛ, yɩ ba vu ba yi Trʋasɩ.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Ba na yi da tɩn, tɩtɩɩ nɩ Pooli ma dwɛ o na nɔɔnʋ na zɩgɩ o yigǝ nɩ. O yɩ Masɩdʋanɩ tu mʋ. O ma loori Pooli o wɩ: «Popo, zaŋɩ n tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ n bɛ n ba Masɩdʋanɩ, n zǝni dɩbam.»

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Pooli na dwɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩbam ma kɩ lɩla dɩ́ ti dɩ́ yigǝ sɩ dɩ́ vu Masɩdʋanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ maanɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ bǝŋi dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna bam DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dáanɩ. Lidɩa na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi te tɩn

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ laan ma kwe naboro Trʋasɩ nɩ dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ Samotrasɩ. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, dɩ́ daa ma zaŋɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm dɩ́ vu Nɩapolisi.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ laan ma zɩgɩ dáanɩ dɩ́ vu tɩga nɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Filipi. Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ yɩ Masɩdʋanɩ tɩ-niǝ yam dayigǝ tɩʋ mʋ. Rom tiinǝ mʋ te-kʋ. Dɩ́ ma kɩ da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ dɩm na yi tɩn, dɩ́ ma nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu bugǝ ni. Dɩ́ ya bʋŋɩ nɩ jǝgǝ wʋ́ ta wʋ dáanɩ Zwifǝ bam na yǝni ba ve ba warɩ Wɛ da. Dɩ́ na nɛ jǝgǝ kam tɩn, dɩ́ ma jǝni tɩga nɩ yɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kaana balʋ na lagɩ daanɩ jǝgǝ kam nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn tɔgɩ o wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Lidɩa. O nuŋi Tiyatiiri mʋ, yɩ o nɩgɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ. O maa jɩgɩ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ na tiini tɩ jɩgɩ nɩnwaŋa tɩn o yǝgǝ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ma pʋrɩ o wʋbʋŋa yɩ o sɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Pooli na jɩgɩ o tɛ tɩn.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: O dɛɛn ma pa dɩ́ miis-o dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama na wʋnɩ Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ. O laan ma zaŋɩ o loori dɩbam o wɩ: «Abam na sɛ nɩ a sɩɩnɩ a kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi, sɩ á ba á taá zʋʋrɩ dɩbam sɔŋɔ nɩ.» O ma wʋ sɛ sɩ dɩ́ viiri. Ba na kɩ Pooli dɩ Silasɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ yɩ kʋ kɩ te tɩn

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ́ zaŋɩ dɩ́ maa ve Wɛ warɩm jǝgǝ kam. Dɩ́ na maa ve tɩn, dɩ́ ma jeeri bɩsankana kalʋ na yɩ nɔɔna gambaa tɩn. Cicirǝ dɛɛn maa tɔg-o ka pa o pwǝrisǝ. O na yǝni o pwǝrisǝ o tɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na lagɩ tɩ ba tɩ kɩ tɩn, mʋ o yuu tiinǝ bam dɛɛn nɛ sǝbu zanzan kʋ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: O ma tɔgɩ Pooli dɩ dɩbam kwaga, yɩ o tɔɔlɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ yɩ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tɩntʋŋna mʋ. Ba tu sɩ ba brɩ abam cwǝŋǝ mʋ sɩ á tɔgɩ da á na vrɩm.»

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn tɔgɩ dɩbam kwaga o kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ taan da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. Pooli wʋ laan ma cɔgɩ. O ma pipiri o ta dɩ cicirǝ kam o wɩ: «A lagɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, nuŋi sɩ n daar-o!» O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, cicirǝ kam ma nuŋi ka daar-o bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Bɩsankana kam yuu tiinǝ bam ma maanɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ ba daa bá wanɩ ba na sǝbu o ŋwaanɩ. Ba ma ja Pooli dɩ Silasɩ ba vaŋɩ ba ja ba vu yaga, sɩ ba saŋɩ-ba dɩdɛɛra bam tee nɩ.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Ba brɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na cɔgɩ dɩbam cullu tɩm mʋ. Dɩbam nan yɩ Rom tiinǝ mʋ, dɩ́ bá wanɩ dɩ́ sɛ bantʋ na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Kɔgɔ kʋm maama ma tɔgɩ ba jɩgɩ dɩ Pooli dɩ Silasɩ. Rom tiinǝ dɩdɛɛra bam ma ja-ba ba vaŋɩ ba gwaarʋ tɩm ba kaarɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pa nɔɔna magɩ-ba dɩ balaara.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ba na tiini ba magɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, ba laan ma kɩ-ba pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Dɩdɛɛra bam ma ta dɩ wʋlʋ na nii pɩɩna digǝ kam baŋa nɩ tɩn, sɩ o fɔgɩ o pɩ nɔɔna bam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma pa ba zʋ tɩtarɩ digǝ kam wʋ, yɩ o daarɩ o kwaarɩ-ba dɩ dɛ.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ tɩga na kwɩɩrɩ tɩn, Pooli dɩ Silasɩ maa wʋra ba warɩ Wɛ yɩ ba leenǝ ba zuli Wɛ. Pɩɩna badonnǝ bam maa je ba cǝgǝ.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Tɩga kam laan ma da ka sisiŋi, yɩ pɩɩna digǝ kam sisiŋi dɩ ka kuri maama. Digǝ kam bwǝǝru tɩm maama ma da tɩ pʋrɩ, pɩɩna bam capʋnnʋ tɩm maama ma kɔ tɩ tʋ.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na yɩrɩ digǝ kam tɩn ma zaŋɩ yɩ o na pɩɩna digǝ kam niǝ na pʋrɩ. O ma bʋŋɩ nɩ pɩɩna bam maama nuŋi ba duri mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ o ma lɩ sʋ-zɔɔ sɩ o ma gʋ o tɩtɩ.

english_verse: But Paul shouted, “Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.”
translation_verse: Pooli laan ma bagɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Yɩ zaŋɩ n gʋ n tɩtɩ, sɩ dɩbam maama wʋ yo.»

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm ma bǝŋi sɩ ba ja mini ba ba ba pa-o. O ma kɩ lɩla o zʋ digǝ kam wʋ o vu o tʋ Pooli dɩ Silasɩ yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o yɩra saɩ.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: O ma pa ba nuŋi pooni, yɩ o daarɩ o bwe-ba o wɩ: «A yuu tiinǝ-ba, a nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ sɩ a ma na vrɩm?»

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa mʋ dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi, sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ nmʋ dɩ n sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama.»

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba ma daarɩ ba ta Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam ba brɩ-o dɩ balʋ maama na wʋ o sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Tɩtɩɩ dɩm maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ o jaanɩ-ba o vu o zarɩ ba fufwǝlǝ yam maama. O na kɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, mʋ o dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam maama dɛ ba pa ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o pa Pooli dɩ Silasɩ zʋ o sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ. O ma kɩ wʋdiu o pa ba di. O na tu o sɛ Wɛ dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa tɩn, o maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam maama.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Rom tiinǝ dɩdɛɛra bam ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba vu pɩɩna digǝ kam yɩrɩnʋ wʋm te, ba ta dɩd-o nɩ o yagɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba viiri.

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Pɩɩna digǝ kam yɩrɩnʋ wʋm ma ta o brɩ Pooli dɩdɛɛra bam na tagɩ te sɩ o yagɩ-ba tɩn. O maa wɩ: «Ba pɛ abam cwǝŋǝ sɩ á viiri. Nan ve-na dɩ yazurǝ.»

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Pooli laan ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Dɩbam nan yɩ Rom tɩʋ kʋm jɩŋa nɔɔna mʋ. Ba nan wʋ di dɩbam taanɩ sɩ ba na dɩ́ kǝm-balɔrɔ, yɩ ba garɩ ba ja dɩbam ba magɩ nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba kɩ dɩbam pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ ba laan lagɩ sɩ ba sǝgi ba pʋrɩ dɩbam ba yagɩ? Dɩ́ bá sɛ. Ba tɩtɩ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba ba ba pʋrɩ dɩbam ba yagɩ.»

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Ba ma vu ba koori Pooli dɩ Silasɩ sɩ ba yagɩ taanɩ dɩm sɩ kʋ ti. Ba ma daarɩ ba pʋrɩ-ba ba yagɩ, yɩ ba loori-ba ba wɩ, ba nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ ba viiri.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Pooli dɩ Silasɩ ma nuŋi pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ ba vu ba zʋ Lidɩa-ba sɔŋɔ. Dáanɩ mʋ ba jeeri Zezi karabiǝ bam, yɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba ba pa-ba dam dɩ baarɩ. Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba viiri.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn ma da Afipolisi dɩ Apoloni ba kɛ ba vu ba yi Tesaloniki. Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ wʋra.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Pooli ma vu da, nɩ o na maŋɩ o yǝni o kɩ te tɩn. O dɛɛn kɩ siun da yatɔ mʋ dɩ ba. O maa karɩmɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm, yɩ o brɩ-ba kʋ kuri sɩ ba ni.

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba badonnǝ ma sɛ o na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ ba laan tɔgɩ ba wǝli Pooli dɩ Silasɩ nɩ. Grɛkɩ tiinǝ balʋ na nɩgɩ Wɛ tɩn kɔgɔ zanzan dɩ ma sɛ Pooli taanɩ dɩm, dɩdaanɩ kaana zanzan balʋ jɩa na garɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ badaara maa jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋrʋ dɩ ba. Ba ma vu yaga ba la zwabani-nyɩna ba pa ba tɔgɩ daanɩ, yɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm ma pa tɩʋ kʋm maama vugimi dɩ sɔɔ bɔgɩ bɔgɩ. Ba ma vu ba ciŋi jara Zazɔn sɔŋɔ nɩ, yɩ ba kwaanɩ ba lagɩ Pooli dɩ Silasɩ jǝgǝ, sɩ ba ja-ba ba ja nuŋi ba kɩ nɔɔna bam jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Ba ma wʋ nɛ-ba. Ba ma ja Zazɔn dɩ Zezi karabiǝ badonnǝ ba ja vu tɩʋ kʋm dɩdɛɛra bam te, yɩ ba tɔɔlɩ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ mʋ yǝni ba beeri lʋgʋ baŋa je maama ba vugimi nɔɔna wʋbʋŋa. Bantʋ nan mʋ tu yo.

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: Zazɔn mʋ pɛ ba zʋʋrɩ o sɔŋɔ nɩ. Bantʋ maama mʋ vɩn dɩ́ pa-farʋ wʋm cullu tɩm, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ, pɛ wʋdoŋ mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zezi.»

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm dɩdɛɛra bam dɩ kɔgɔ kʋm maama na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba bana ma zaŋɩ zanzan dɩ ba.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛra bam ma pa Zazɔn dɩ o donnǝ bam tiŋi sǝbu kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba vrɩ ba tɩtɩ tɩn. Ba laan ma yagɩ-ba ba pa ba viiri. Kʋ na kɩ te Beere nɩ tɩn

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Tɩga na tu ka yi tɩn, Zezi karabiǝ bam ma pa Pooli dɩ Silasɩ nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm nɩ ba vu Beere. Ba na ve ba yi da tɩn, ba ma vu ba zʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋ.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ Zwifǝ bam maa jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna ba dwe Tesaloniki nɔɔna bam. Ba ma cǝgi Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam lanyɩranɩ dɩ ba wʋ maama. Dɛ maama wʋnɩ ba yǝni ba karɩmɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm sɩ ba nii, Pooli na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga na.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Ba zanzan ma sɛ Pooli taanɩ dɩm, Grɛkɩ tiinǝ zanzan dɩ maa sɛ, baara dɩ kaana balʋ jɩa na garɩ tɩn zanzan dɩ maa sɛ.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Tesaloniki Zwifǝ bam ma ni nɩ Pooli wʋ Beere nɩ o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam. Ba ma zaŋɩ ba vu Beere ba la kɔgɔ ba pa tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam bana zaŋɩ dɩ Pooli.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam na nɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma pa Pooli zaŋɩ lɩla o nuŋi o vu nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni. Kʋ ma daarɩ Silasɩ dɩ Timoti mʋ maŋɩ Beere nɩ.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na kogili Pooli tɩn ma da dɩd-o ba vu ba yi Atɛɛnɩ. Ba na maa joori tɩn, Pooli ma pa-ba ni sɩ ba vu ba ta Silasɩ dɩ Timoti nɩ ba zaŋɩ ba tɔgɩ o kwaga ba ba lɩla. Kʋ na kɩ te Atɛɛnɩ nɩ tɩn

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Pooli dɛɛn na wʋ Atɛɛnɩ nɩ o cǝgi Silasɩ dɩ Timoti sɩ ba ba tɩn, o wʋ ma tiini kʋ cɔgɩ dɩ o na nɛ nɩ jwǝnǝ zanzan su tɩʋ kʋm tɩn.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: O maa yǝni o zʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam wʋ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba dɩdaanɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na nɩgɩ Wɛ tɩn. Dɛ maama o maa yǝni o ve yaga ni o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ balʋ na wʋra tɩn.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Yi-pʋrʋ tiinǝ badonnǝ dɩ ma ba ba maŋɩ dɩd-o. Ba badaara dɛɛn tɔgɩ Epikuri zaasɩm dɩm mʋ, babam dɩ maa tɔgɩ Sitoyisi zaasɩm dɩm. Ba badaara ma ta ba wɩ: «Ŋwaŋ-fara tu wʋntʋ bʋŋɩ sɩ o brɩ bɛɛ mʋ?» Badonnǝ dɩ ma ta ba wɩ: «Kʋ nyɩ dɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ jwǝnǝ taanɩ mʋ te.» Ba tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o tɔɔlɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ twa biim taanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma ja-o ba vu Arɩpaazɩ, . Ba ma ta-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam ya lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ zaasɩm-dʋʋrɩ dɩm nmʋ na jɩgɩ n zaasɩ tɩn kuri mʋ.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ nmʋ na brɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ta wʋ fɔgɩ dɩ́ ni tɩ dwi. Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ tɩ kuri na yɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Atɛɛnɩ tiinǝ bam maama dɩdaanɩ vǝrǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ ba tee nɩ tɩn dɛɛn tiini ba lagɩ sɩ ba taa larɩ daanɩ mʋ maŋa maama, sɩ ba taa cǝgi wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na yɩ wo-dʋnnʋ tɩn.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Pooli ma zaŋɩ o zɩgɩ Arɩpaazɩ yigǝ tiinǝ bam tɩtarɩ nɩ o wɩ: «Atɛɛnɩ tiinǝ-ba, amʋ na nii tɩn, abam ŋwɩa kam maama wʋnɩ á tiini á zuli jwǝnǝ mʋ zanzan.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: A na beeri abam tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, a nɛ je sɩm maama á na zuli á jwǝnǝ da tɩn. A na beeri tɩn mʋ a nɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩdʋa, yɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ dɩ yɩra nɩ kʋ wɩ: ‹Wɛ dɩlʋ dɩ́ na yǝri tɩn›. Kʋntʋ, Wɛ dɩlʋ abam na jɩgɩ á zuli yɩ á ta yǝri-DƖ tɩn kwǝrǝ mʋ a lagɩ a tɔɔlɩ a brɩ abam.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ kʋ wʋnɩ tɩn. DƖ maa te wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa maama, yɩ DƖ ba zʋʋrɩ di sɩlʋ nabiinǝ na lɔgɩ ba pa-DƖ tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ gɛ kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ nabiinǝ taa tʋŋa ba pa-DƖ, kʋ na yɩ dɩntʋ tɩtɩ mʋ kwe ŋwɩa dɩ siun dɩ woŋo maama DƖ pa nabiinǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: Wɛ na kɩ nabiinǝ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ ba taa lagɩ-DƖ mʋ. Ba maŋɩ sɩ ba beeri-DƖ mʋ ba na DƖ jǝgǝ, sɩ ba ma wanɩ ba lwarɩ-DƖ. Wɛ nan maŋɩ DƖ daɩ yigǝ yigǝ dɩdaanɩ dɩbam maama.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ na tagɩ o wɩ: ‹Dɩntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋwɩ, dɩ́ wʋra yɩ dɩ́ veǝ.› Abam tɩtɩ lǝŋ-leenu dɩdʋa dɩ tagɩ kʋntʋ doŋ o wɩ: ‹Dɩbam dɩ maŋɩ dɩ́ yɩ DƖ dwi tiinǝ mʋ.›

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ yɩ Wɛ dwi tiinǝ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ ta nyɩ dɩ kamɔgɔ kʋlʋ nabiinu na mɛ sǝbu-sɩŋa naa luguru naa kandwa o ma o kɩ dɩ o tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa yɩ nabiinǝ ta yǝri kʋlʋ na lana sɩ ba taa kɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ kwe-kʋ DƖ kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, DƖ laan pɛ ni nɩ nɔɔna maama lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ maŋɩ sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ wo-balwaarʋ kǝm.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ DƖ lɩ dɛ mʋ sɩ DƖ ma DƖ di nabiinǝ maama taanɩ. DƖ nan wʋ́ tɔgɩ cɩga mʋ DƖ ma di ba taanɩ dɩm. DƖ nan maŋɩ DƖ kuri wʋlʋ DƖ na wʋ́ tɔgɩ o ŋwaanɩ DƖ ma di ba taanɩ tɩn. DƖ pɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ mʋ bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna maama lwarɩ nɩ kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.»

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Pooli na ŋɔɔnɩ twa biim taanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna bam badonnǝ maa jɩg-o ba mwana. Kʋ daarɩ badaara maa tɛ ba wɩ: «Dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ n joori n ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ sɩ dɩ́ cǝgi dɛ dɩdoŋ nɩ.»

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Pooli laan ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi ba tee nɩ.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɛɛn ma sɛ ba tɔgɩ Pooli, yɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi. Ba dɩdʋa yɩrɩ mʋ Denisi. O tɔgɩ o wʋ Arɩpaazɩ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ. Kaanɩ wʋdoŋ dɩ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Damarisi. Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɩ tɔgɩ ba wǝli da ba na sɛ Zezi.

english_verse: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, Pooli dɛɛn ma zɩgɩ Atɛɛnɩ nɩ o vu Korɛntɩ.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: O na yi da tɩn, o ma maŋɩ dɩdaanɩ Zwifu wʋdoŋ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Akwila. Ba dɛɛn lʋg-o Pɔn nɩ mʋ. Maŋa kalʋ Pooli na nɛ-o tɩn, o ya nuŋi Yitali mʋ o ba, dɩ o kaanɩ Prisili, bɛŋwaanɩ Rom pa-farʋ Kloodi dɛɛn ya zǝli Zwifǝ bam maama o pa ba nuŋi Rom nɩ ba viiri. Pooli ma zaŋɩ o vu ba te,

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: yɩ o zʋʋrɩ dɩ ba sɩ ba taa tʋŋɩ daanɩ, ba dɛɛn na tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩdwɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba dɛɛn nyaanɩ gwaarʋ mʋ yɩ ba yǝgi ba ma pu vwǝ.

english_verse: Every Sabbath, Paul went to the synagogue. He spoke to Jews and Gentiles and tried to win them over.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam siun dɛ maama o maa yǝni o zʋ ba Wɛ-digǝ kam o ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩ ba. O maa kwaanɩ sɩ o pa Zwifǝ bam dɩ Grɛkɩ tiinǝ bam maama sɛ o taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, he spent all his time preaching to the Jews about Jesus the Messiah.
translation_verse: Silasɩ dɩ Timoti dɛɛn zɩgɩ Masɩdʋanɩ nɩ ba ba Pooli te. Ba na tu tɩn, Pooli laan ma cɛ dɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm zaasɩm. O maa kwaanɩ o pa Zwifǝ bam lwarɩ nɩ Zezi yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ba ma wʋ sɛ o taanɩ dɩm yɩ ba twɩ-o. O laan ma ja o gwaarʋ tɩm o pupugi tɩ fogo kʋm ba yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam na nɛ lɛɛrʋ Wɛ tee nɩ, kʋ yɩ abam tɩtɩ yigǝ mʋ. Kʋ daa daɩ amʋ yigǝ. Kʋ na sɩŋɩ lele kʋntʋ tɩn, a laan wʋ́ vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te a daarɩ abam.»

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: O ma sɩɩnɩ o nuŋi Zwifǝ bam tee nɩ o daarɩ o vu o zʋʋrɩ dwi-gɛ tu wʋdoŋ sɔŋɔ nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Titiu Zusitu. Wʋntʋ maa nɩgɩ Wɛ. O sɔŋɔ kʋm maa zɩgɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam tɩkǝri nɩ.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: Wɛ-digǝ kam yuutu wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Krisipu. Wʋntʋ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam maama dɛɛn tu ba tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi. Korɛntɩ tiinǝ zanzan dɩ dɛɛn ma ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam yɩ ba sɛ. Ba laan ma pa ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ tɩtɩɩ nɩ mʋ Pooli dwɛ o na vɩɩrɩm wʋnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o o wɩ: «Yɩ ta n kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ. Ta ta n ŋɔɔna, sɩ n yɩ ta n cɩm,

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: sɩ amʋ wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o kɩ nmʋ lwarɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ tɩʋ kʋntʋ wʋnɩ nɔɔna zanzan mʋ wʋra ba na yɩ amʋ tɩtɩ nɔɔna.»

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Pooli dɛɛn maa zʋʋrɩ da taan bɩnɩ dɩ canɩ sɩrdʋ. O na wʋra tɩn, o ma brɩ-ba Wɛ taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn tu o ji Akayi tɩɩnɩ dɩm gʋvɩrma tu, o yɩrɩ mʋ Galɩʋ. O na wʋra maŋa kalʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam ma kɩ ni-dɩdwɩ yɩ ba ja Pooli ba vu saŋɩ o tee nɩ.

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta dɩ Galɩʋ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ mʋ jɩgɩ nɔɔna o sʋga, o pa ba tɔgɩ Wɛ kʋ na wʋ maŋɩ dɩ cullu na brɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Pooli ya maa bʋŋɩ sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ, yɩ Galɩʋ wuuri o ta dɩ Zwifǝ bam o wɩ: «Kʋ ya na yɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ taanɩ naa kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋdoŋ taanɩ mʋ á jɩgɩ sɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ, kʋ yaá maŋɩ sɩ a zuri a yɩra a cǝgi abam.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam na magɩ kantɔgɔ abam tɩtɩ cullu tɩm baŋa nɩ yɩ kʋ yɩ bɩtarbiǝ dɩ nɔɔna yɩra ŋwaanɩ mʋ tɩn, abam tɩtɩ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ á nii kʋ baŋa nɩ. A bá sɛ sɩ a di abam taana yantʋ donnǝ.»

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama laan ma zaŋɩ ba ja Sositɛnɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ ba Wɛ-digǝ kam yuutu tɩn, ba mag-o taanɩ dɩm dim jǝgǝ kam nɩ. Galɩʋ yigǝ nan maŋɩ ka tǝrǝ dɩ ba kǝm dɩm. Pooli daa ta na beeri yɩ o kɩ te tɩn

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Pooli dɛɛn ma kɩ da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ Korɛntɩ nɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam tee nɩ. O laan ma zaŋɩ o banɩ-ba sɩ o viiri. O ma pa Prisili dɩ Akwila tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba zʋ naboro sɩ ba vu Siiri. Ba ta na wʋ zʋ naboro kʋm sɩ ba kɛ tɩn, Pooli ya zɩgɩ Sankrɩ nɩ o pa ba fanɩ o yuu, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ o goni o ni dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
translation_verse: Ba ma tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ ba vu ba yi Efɛɛzɩ. Pooli ma yagɩ Prisili dɩ Akwila dáanɩ. O ma vu o zʋ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba.

english_verse: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.
translation_verse: Ba ma loor-o sɩ o maŋɩ ba tee nɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn. O ma wʋ sɛ.

english_verse: He told them goodbye and said, “If God lets me, I will come back.”
translation_verse: O ma banɩ-ba, yɩ o ta o wɩ: «Wɛ na sɛ, aá joori a ba a na abam.» O daa ma zʋ naboro Efɛɛzɩ nɩ o kɛ.

english_verse: After staying there for a while, he left and visited several places in Galatia and Phrygia. He helped the followers there to become stronger in their faith. Apollos in Ephesus
translation_verse: O ma daanɩ da da fɩnfɩɩn, yɩ o laan zaŋɩ o kɛ. O ma vu o tʋlɩ Galatɩ dɩ Friizi tɩɩnɩ dɩm wʋ, yɩ o pa Zezi karabiǝ bam maama fɔgɩ ba zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ. Apolɔsɩ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ te tɩn

english_verse: A Jewish man named Apollos came to Ephesus. Apollos had been born in the city of Alexandria. He was a very good speaker and knew a lot about the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Zwifu wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Apolɔsɩ. Ba lʋg-o Alɛsandrɩ nɩ mʋ. Wʋntʋ ma ba Efɛɛzɩ. O dɛɛn yɩ wʋlʋ na waɩ taanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ pʋrɩ pʋrɩ tɩn mʋ. O maa kwǝri o ye Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wǝǝnu tɩm kuri maama lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.
translation_verse: O ma puli sɩ o ta ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ baarɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam nɩ. Prisili dɩ Akwila ma ba ba lwarɩ o zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Ba ma pa o tɔgɩ o zʋʋrɩ dɩ ba, yɩ ba fɔgɩ ba maŋɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam cɩga na yɩ te tɩn ba brɩ-o.

english_verse: Apollos decided to travel through Achaia. So the Lord's followers wrote letters, encouraging the followers there to welcome him. After Apollos arrived in Achaia, he was a great help to everyone who had put their faith in the Lord Jesus because of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Apolɔsɩ laan ma bʋŋɩ sɩ o nuŋi Efɛɛzɩ nɩ o kɛ o vu Akayi. Zezi karabiǝ bam ma pu o wʋbʋŋa yam kwaga nɩ. Ba ma pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ sɩ ba pa Zezi karabiǝ balʋ na wʋ Akayi nɩ tɩn, ba ta dɩ ba sɩ ba fɔgɩ ba jeer-o lanyɩranɩ. O ma sɩɩnɩ o zaŋɩ o kɛ. O na yi Akayi tɩn, o ma tiini o wǝli balʋ na sɛ Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm tɩn sɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: O ma kwaanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ o magɩ kantɔgɔ o wanɩ-ba, dɩ o na mɛ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm o brɩ-ba nɩ Zezi sɩɩnɩ o yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Apolɔsɩ dɛɛn ta na wʋ Korɛntɩ nɩ tɩn, Pooli ma zaŋɩ o beeri o tɔgɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm tɩtarɩ o vu o yi Efɛɛzɩ. O na yi da tɩn, o ma na Wɛ cwǝŋǝ karabiǝ badonnǝ,

english_verse: He asked them, “When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit?” “No!” they answered. “We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: yɩ o bwe-ba o wɩ: «Abam na tu á sɛ Wɛ tɩn, á joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm na?» Ba ma lǝr-o ba wɩ: «Aye, dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ dɩ́ wʋ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ Joro wʋra.»

english_verse: Paul replied, “John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.”
