translation_verse: Pooli laan ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ Zan na miisi nɔɔna na wʋnɩ te tɩn, wʋntʋ dɛɛn brɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm, sɩ ba daarɩ ba pa ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ. O ma ta dɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ wʋlʋ wʋm na wʋ́ saŋɩ o kwaga o ba tɩn. Zezi mʋ wʋntʋ.»

english_verse: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma pa ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Then Paul placed his hands on them. The Holy Spirit was given to them, and they spoke unknown languages and prophesied.
translation_verse: Pooli ma daŋɩ daŋɩ o jɩa ba baŋa nɩ. Wɛ Joro kʋm laan ma ba ba te. Ba ma ŋɔɔnɩ dwi-gɛ taana tǝri tǝri, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam.

english_verse: There were about twelve men in this group.
translation_verse: Ba maama dɛɛn yi nɩnɛɛnɩ baara fugǝ-bale mʋ te.

english_verse: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over,
translation_verse: Pooli dɛɛn ma kɩ canɩ sɩtɔ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ. O maa yǝni o ve o zʋʋrɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-digǝ kam o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ baarɩ o brɩ-ba. O ma kwaanɩ o magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ ba, sɩ o pa ba lwarɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: but some of them were stubborn and refused to believe. In front of everyone they said terrible things about God's Way. Paul left and took the followers with him to the lecture hall of Tyrannus. He spoke there every day
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam badonnǝ ma kwarɩmɩ ba zwa, yɩ ba vɩn sɩ ba sɛ o taanɩ dɩm. Ba maa jɩgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm ba goonǝ nɔɔna bam maama yigǝ nɩ. Pooli ma zaŋɩ o nuŋi ba wʋnɩ, yɩ o pwɛ balʋ na sɛ ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn sɩ ba ta wʋ o tee nɩ. Dɛ maama o maa yǝni o ŋɔɔnɩ o brɩ nɔɔna bam Tiranusi karadigǝ kam nɩ.

english_verse: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn ma tɔgɩ Pooli jɩŋa DƖ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ doŋ na maŋɩ ya wʋ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn, nɔɔna yǝni ba kwe garyiǝ dɩ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ na dwe Pooli yɩra tɩn ba ja vu ba ma dwe yawɩɩna, yɩ kʋ pa ba na yazurǝ, yɩ ciciri dɩ nuŋi sɩ yagɩ-ba.

english_verse: Some Jewish men started going around trying to force out evil spirits by using the name of the Lord Jesus. They said to the spirits, “Come out in the name of that same Jesus that Paul preaches about!”
translation_verse: Zwifǝ liri tiinǝ badonnǝ dɩ maa wʋra ba na yǝni ba beeri ba zǝli ciciri nɔɔna tee nɩ. Bantʋ dɩ dɛɛn ma kwaanɩ sɩ ba zǝli ciciri sɩm dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ. Ba maa yǝni ba tɛ dɩ ciciri sɩm ba wɩ: «Zezi wʋlʋ Pooli na brɩ o taanɩ tɩn yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tɛ abam sɩ á nuŋi á viiri.»

english_verse: when an evil spirit said to them, “I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you?”
translation_verse: Cicirǝ kadoŋ laan ma ta dɩ ba ka wɩ: «A maŋɩ a ye Zezi. A ye Pooli dɩ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn. Sɩ abam nan yɩ bra mʋ?»

english_verse: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and beat them up. They ran out of the house, naked and bruised.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋm cicirǝ kam na tɔg-o tɩn laan ma zaŋɩ o puuri-ba. O ma wanɩ-ba o pa ba maama duri ba nuŋi o sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ, yɩ ba gwaarʋ kaarɩ kaarɩ yɩ ba yɩra dɩ fwǝli fwǝli.

english_verse: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ tɩn ma lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ maama. Fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ-ba zanzan. Kʋ ma pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ tiini dɩ zaŋɩ dɩ zulǝ.

english_verse: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tu ba sɛ Zezi tɩn zanzan ma zaŋɩ ba zɩgɩ nɔɔna bam maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ ba ta ba brɩ kʋlʋ ba na kɩ ba cɔgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: After all this had happened, Paul decided to visit Macedonia and Achaia on his way to Jerusalem. Paul had said, “From there I will go on to Rome.”
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ dɛɛn na kɩ tɩ kɛ tɩn, Pooli ma lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ o beeri o tɔgɩ Masɩdʋanɩ dɩ Akayi wʋ, sɩ o laan kɛ o vu Zeruzalɛm. O ma bʋŋɩ o wɩ: «A na ve a wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ, a maŋɩ sɩ a vu Rom dɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.
translation_verse: O ma tʋŋɩ nɔɔna bale sɩ ba da o yigǝ ba vu Masɩdʋanɩ. Bantʋ maa yɩ Timoti dɩ Erasɩtɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ ba tʋŋɩ ba pa-o tɩn. O tɩtɩ ma maŋɩ Azi nɩ o daanɩ fɩnfɩɩn.

english_verse: At that time there was serious trouble because of the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: Da yam kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ vuvugǝ zanzan tuǝ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɛɛn mʋ wʋ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Demɛtrisi. O yɩ gɔgɔ mʋ, yɩ o maɩ sǝbu-pwǝǝnu o maa mɔɔnɩ kamwarʋ o paɩ tɩ nyɩ dɩ digǝ kalʋ ba na zuli ba wɛ Atɩmisi ka wʋnɩ tɩn. O tɩtʋŋa yam maa jaanɩ nyɔɔrɩ zanzan ya paɩ o tɩntʋŋ-donnǝ bam.

english_verse: But you have surely seen and heard how this man Paul is upsetting a lot of people, not only in Ephesus, but almost everywhere in Asia. He claims that the gods we humans make are not really gods at all.
translation_verse: Abam nan nɛ yɩ á kwǝri á ni Pooli wʋntʋ na kɩ te tɩn. O yǝni o tɛ nɩ nabiinǝ na mɛ ba jɩa ba kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɩn bá wanɩ tɩ taa yɩ wa cɩga cɩga, dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ zuli-ya. O kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ o sʋgɩ nɔɔna zanzan o pa ba sɛ o taanɩ dɩm, yɩ kʋ daɩ Efɛɛzɩ yɩranɩ wʋnɩ mʋ o kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋ gɛ fɩɩn mʋ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ Azi tɩʋ kʋm maama.

english_verse: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maama waɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ dɩbam tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm. Kʋ ta wǝli da, ba laan wʋ́ gooni dɩbam wɛ kamunu Atɩmisi digǝ kam, yɩ baá pa ka taa yɩ kafɛ. Kʋlʋ na daarɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ Atɩmisi tɩtɩ yɩrɩ dɩm wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔna tee nɩ, yɩ wʋntʋ ya yɩ wɛ dɩlʋ nɔɔna maama na zuli Azi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa maama wʋnɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: When the workers heard this, they got angry and started shouting, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba bana ma tiini ya zaŋɩ zanzan yɩ ba kaasɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Efɛɛzɩ tiinǝ wɛ Atɩmisi mʋ jɩgɩ dam!»

english_verse: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.
translation_verse: Sɔɔ laan ma tiini kʋ kɩ tɩʋ kʋm maama wʋnɩ bɔgɩ bɔgɩ. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm ma vu ba ja Gayusi dɩ Arisarɩkɩ, yɩ ba kɩ lɩla ba vaŋɩ-ba ba ja vu tɩʋ kʋm joro jǝgǝ kam. Nɔɔna bantʋ bale ya tɔgɩ dɩ Pooli mʋ ba nuŋi Masɩdʋanɩ ba ba.

english_verse: Paul wanted to go out and speak to the people, but the Lord's followers would not let him.
translation_verse: Pooli ma bʋŋɩ sɩ o vu o zɩgɩ kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba. Zezi karabiǝ bam ma wʋ sɛ ba pa-o cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: A few of the local officials were friendly to Paul, and they sent someone to warn him not to go.
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm dɩdɛɛra badonnǝ ya di ciloŋo dɩ Pooli. Ba ma tʋŋɩ ni ba loor-o sɩ o yɩ zaŋɩ o vu joro kʋm jǝgǝ.

english_verse: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
translation_verse: Ba ma kɩ sɔɔ bɔgɩ bɔgɩ joro jǝgǝ kam nɩ. Nɔɔnʋ maama maa tiini o ŋɔɔnɩ o wʋbʋŋa taanɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa. Kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna zanzan ma wʋ lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ ba na jeeri daanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Several of the Jewish leaders pushed a man named Alexander to the front of the crowd and started telling him what to say. He motioned with his hand and tried to explain what was going on.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam ma lɩ Alɛsandrɩ sɩ o nuŋi o zɩgɩ kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ. Kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna badonnǝ ma kwaanɩ ba brɩ-o o na wʋ́ kɩ te. O ma zǝŋi o jɩŋa sɩ ba cǝgi sɔɔ kʋm, yɩ o sɩŋɩ sɩ o tʋlɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn o brɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm.

english_verse: But when the crowd saw that he was Jewish, they all shouted for two hours, “Great is Artemis, the goddess of the Ephesians!”
translation_verse: Ba nan na lwarɩ nɩ o yɩ Zwifu tɩn, ba maama maa tɔgɩ daanɩ ba tiini ba bagɩ bɩdwɩ ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Efɛɛzɩ tiinǝ wɛ Atɩmisi jɩgɩ dam!» Ba kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ taan, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi nɩnɛɛnɩ luu tɩle te.

english_verse: Finally, a town official made the crowd be quiet. Then he said: People of Ephesus, who in the world doesn't know that our city is the center for worshiping the great goddess Artemis? Who doesn't know that her image which fell from heaven is right here?
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm twan-pʋpʋnʋ laan ma kwaanɩ o pa kɔgɔ kʋm bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ. O ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A badonnǝ Efɛɛzɩ tiinǝ-ba, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na yǝri nɩ dɩbam wɛ kamunu Atɩmisi digǝ kam zɩgɩ Efɛɛzɩ wʋnɩ yoba seeni, yɩ dɩbam mʋ nii ka baŋa nɩ. Dɩ́ ta kwǝri dɩ́ jɩgɩ dɩ kamɔgɔ kʋlʋ na nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ kʋ tʋ tɩga nɩ tɩn dɩ́ niǝ.

english_verse: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ta nɩ kʋntʋ yɩ vwan. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á pa á bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ, sɩ á yɩ garɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You have brought men in here who have not robbed temples or spoken against our goddess.
translation_verse: Nii-na, abam jaanɩ nɔɔna bantʋ bale á ba yo, yɩ ba wʋ ŋɔgɩ dɩbam wɛ digǝ kam wǝǝnu naa ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ dɩbam wɛ dɩm yuu.

english_verse: If Demetrius and his workers have a case against these men, we have courts and judges. Let them take their complaints there.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Demɛtrisi dɩ o nɔɔna bam, ba na jɩgɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm taanɩ, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba vu sarɩya dim jǝgǝ nɩ ba saŋ-o dɩdɛɛra bam yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: After saying this, he told the people to leave.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o ma ta dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm sɩ ba viiri.

english_verse: As he traveled from place to place, he encouraged the followers with many messages. Finally, he went to Greece
translation_verse: O maa tʋlɩ je sɩm kʋntʋ maama o ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu zanzan o brɩ nɔɔna bam o pa ba na baarɩ. O daa ma kɛ o vu o yi Grɛkɩ tɩʋ.

english_verse: and stayed there for three months. Paul was about to sail to Syria. But some of the Jewish leaders plotted against him, so he decided to return by way of Macedonia.
translation_verse: O ma kɩ canɩ sɩtɔ dáanɩ. O laan ma ti o yigǝ sɩ o zʋ naboro o vu Siiri. O ma ba o lwarɩ nɩ Zwifǝ bam kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba kwaanɩ ba cɔg-o. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ o ma lǝni o wʋbʋŋa yɩ o bʋŋɩ sɩ o vu tɩga nɩ o tɔgɩ Masɩdʋanɩ cwǝŋǝ kam o joori o vu Siiri.

english_verse: With him were Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, and Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica. Gaius from Derbe was also with him, and so were Timothy and the two Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.
translation_verse: Balʋ na zaŋɩ sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩd-o tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Sopatɛɛrɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Pirusi bu yɩ o nuŋi Beere tɩn, Arisitakɩ dɩ Sɩkɔn, bantʋ nuŋi Tesaloniki mʋ, Gayusi wʋlʋ na nuŋi Dɛrɩbɩ tɩn, Timoti, Tisiki dɩ Trofim, ba na yɩ Azi tiinǝ tɩn.

english_verse: They went on ahead to Troas and waited for us there.
translation_verse: Bantʋ mʋ dɛ yigǝ ba loori ba vu Trʋasɩ ba cǝgi dɩbam da.

english_verse: In the upstairs room where we were meeting, there were a lot of lamps.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ya lagɩ daanɩ wɛyuu digǝ kalʋ na yɩ bɩtɔ tu tɩn wʋnɩ mʋ. Ba ma tarɩgɩ min-zwǝǝnu zanzan ba zɩgɩ da.

english_verse: A young man by the name of Eutychus was sitting on a window sill. While Paul was speaking, the young man got very sleepy. Finally, he went to sleep and fell three floors all the way down to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.
translation_verse: Nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋdoŋ maa tɔgɩ o wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Yutiki. O maa je tǝkoro ni nɩ. Pooli na tiini o ŋɔɔnɩ o daanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm maa je o dɔ o vɩɩla. O laan ma ba o dɔ fasɩ o kɛ. O ma tɔgɩ tǝkoro kʋm o tʋ tɩga nɩ. Ba ma tu ba kwe-o dɩ o tɩga.

english_verse: Paul went down and bent over Eutychus. He took him in his arms and said, “Don't worry! He's alive.”
translation_verse: Pooli tɩtɩ ma tu o vu o pǝni nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm baŋa nɩ o kukwǝr-o dɩ o jɩa yɩ o wɩ: «Á yɩ pa á yɩra sɔɔrɩ, sɩ o ta ŋwɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: After Paul had gone back upstairs, he broke bread, and ate with us. He then spoke until dawn and left.
translation_verse: Pooli ma joori o di wɛyuu digǝ kam. O ma fɔ dɩpɛ dɩm o di. O daa ta ma larɩ dɩ ba taan, yɩ tɩga ba ka pʋʋrɩ. O laan ma viiri.

english_verse: Then the followers took the young man home alive and were very happy. The Voyage from Troas to Miletus
translation_verse: O na viiri tɩn, nɔɔna bam ma ja nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm ba ja vu sɔŋɔ dɩ yazurǝ. Ba bɩcara ma pǝni tɩga nɩ yɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Pooli na kaanɩ Efɛɛzɩ nakwa bam yɩ o banɩ-ba te tɩn

english_verse: Paul decided to travel by land to Assos. The rest of us went on ahead by ship, and we were to take him aboard there.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ma yagɩ Pooli, yɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ zʋ naboro kʋm sɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ yigǝ dɩ́ da nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu Asɔsɩ. Dɩ́ ya kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ dɩ́ jeeri Pooli Asɔsɩ nɩ mʋ, o na lagɩ sɩ o vu tɩga nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When he met us in Assos, he came aboard, and we sailed on to Mitylene.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na nɛ daanɩ Asɔsɩ nɩ tɩn, Pooli laan ma zʋ naboro kʋm, yɩ dɩ́ maama tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Mitilɛɛnɩ.

english_verse: The next day we came to a place near Chios, and the following day we reached Samos. The day after that we sailed to Miletus.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma zɩgɩ dáanɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ kɛ. Tɩga ma pʋʋrɩ, yɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ tɔgɩ Kiyo buburu kʋm dɩ́ kɛ. Tɩga daa ma pʋʋrɩ, dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ bɛ dɩ́ yi Samɔsɩ. Tɩga daa ta na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ yi Mileti.

english_verse: Paul had decided to sail on past Ephesus, because he did not want to spend too much time in Asia. He was in a hurry and wanted to be in Jerusalem in time for Pentecost. Paul Says Goodbye to the Church Leaders of Ephesus
translation_verse: Pooli dɛɛn ya bʋŋɩ sɩ o da Efɛɛzɩ mʋ o kɛ sɩ o yɩ zɩgɩ da. O ya ba lagɩ sɩ o daanɩ Azi nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ o lagɩ lɩla mʋ sɩ o na waɩ, sɩ o vu o yi Zeruzalɛm dɩ Pantɩkoti candiǝ kam ta wʋ yi.

english_verse: From Miletus, Paul sent a message for the church leaders at Ephesus to come and meet with him.
translation_verse: Dɩbam dɛɛn na wʋ Mileti nɩ tɩn, Pooli ma tʋŋɩ ni o pa Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam Efɛɛzɩ nɩ o wɩ, ba ba.

english_verse: When they got there, he said: You know everything I did during the time I was with you when I first came to Asia.
translation_verse: Ba na tu tɩn, o ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Abam maŋɩ á ye a dɛɛn na zʋʋrɩ abam tee nɩ yɩ a kɩ te maŋa maama, kʋ na zɩgɩ dɛ dɩlʋ a na sɩŋɩ a ba Azi tɩn.

english_verse: Some of the Jews plotted against me and caused me a lot of sorrow and trouble. But I served the Lord and was humble.
translation_verse: A tʋŋɩ a pa dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dɩ tu-n-tɩtɩ mʋ, a yi-na nuŋi, yɩ a na yaara dɩ Zwifǝ bam na kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba cɔgɩ amʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: When I preached in public or taught in your homes, I didn't hold back from telling anything that would help you.
translation_verse: Abam ta ye nɩ, a wʋ yagɩ sɩ a ta woŋo kʋlʋ maama na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ wǝli abam tɩn a brɩ abam. A ma kwaanɩ a brɩ abam Wɛ cɩga kam nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ dɩ á tɩtɩ sam nɩ.

english_verse: I told Jews and Gentiles to turn to God and have faith in our Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: A ma tiini a brɩ Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ maama sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba sɛ Wɛ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi.

english_verse: I don't know what will happen to me in Jerusalem, but I must obey God's Spirit and go there.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ a laan maa ve Zeruzalɛm. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ fɩ-nɩ sɩ a vu, yɩ a yǝri kʋlʋ na wʋ́ vu kʋ kɩ amʋ da tɩn.

english_verse: In every city I visit, I am told by the Holy Spirit that I will be put in jail and will be in trouble in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: A na ye kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm yǝni kʋ brɩ amʋ tɩʋ maama nɩ, nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ ja-nɩ ba vɔ yɩ ba kwǝri ba bɛɛsɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: But I don't care what happens to me, as long as I finish the work the Lord Jesus gave me to do. And this work is to tell the good news about God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: A nan na bʋŋɩ te tɩn, a ba paɩ sɩ a ŋwɩa taa jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ ka pa-nɩ. Kʋlʋ na yɩ wo-ŋʋŋʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩn a ti. Tɩtʋŋa yam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ sɩ a kwaanɩ a brɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ DƖ na kɩ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I have gone from place to place, preaching to you about God's kingdom, but now I know that none of you will ever see me again.
translation_verse: A nan ye nɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ daa bá na amʋ, abam nan yɩ balʋ a na beeri á wʋnɩ a brɩ abam Wɛ paarɩ dɩm cɩga kam tɩn.

english_verse: I have told you everything God wants you to know.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ a tɔɔlɩ cɩga kalʋ maama na tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa tɩn a brɩ abam, yɩ a wʋ sǝgi abam kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: Look after yourselves and everyone the Holy Spirit has placed in your care. Be like shepherds to God's church. It is the flock he bought with the blood of his own Son.
translation_verse: Nan fɔgɩ-na á taá nii á tɩtɩ baŋa nɩ, dɩdaanɩ kɔgɔ kʋlʋ maama Wɛ Joro kʋm na kwe kʋ kɩ abam jɩŋa nɩ sɩ á taá nii tɩn. Á taá nii Wɛ kɔgɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ, nɩ nayɩra na nii ba peeni te tɩn. Wɛ mɛ DƖ tɩtɩ bu wʋm jana mʋ DƖ ma vrɩ DƖ kɔgɔ kʋm sɩ kʋ taa yɩ DƖ nyɩm.

english_verse: I now place you in God's care. Remember the message about his gift of undeserved grace! This message can help you and give you what belongs to you as God's people.
translation_verse: A laan lagɩ a kɩ abam Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ á taá tɔgɩ DƖ zaanɩ kwǝrǝ kam. Kaá wanɩ ka kwɛ abam lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á laan ba á tɔgɩ dɩ balʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ nɔɔna tɩn á na ywǝǝni DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: I have never wanted anyone's money or clothes.
translation_verse: A wʋ joŋi sǝbu naa sǝbu-sɩŋa naa gwaarʋ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ tee nɩ.

english_verse: You know how I have worked with my own hands to make a living for myself and my friends.
translation_verse: Abam tɩtɩ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, a mɛ a tɩtɩ jɩa mʋ a tʋŋɩ sɩ a dɩ a tɔgɩ-donnǝ bam wanɩ dɩ́ na dɩ́ ni-wʋdiu.

english_verse: After Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, ba maama ma kuni doonǝ yɩ o loori Wɛ o pa-ba.

english_verse: Everyone cried and hugged and kissed him.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋɩ yɩ ba maama tiini ba keerǝ. Ba ma kukwǝri Pooli lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: They were especially sad because Paul had told them, “You will never see me again.” Then they went with him to the ship.
translation_verse: Ba wʋrʋ ma tiini tɩ cɔgɩ, dɩ o na tagɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ o brɩ-ba nɩ ba daa bá joori ba na-o tɩn. Ba ma zaŋɩ ba kogil-o ba ja vu naboro kʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn ba yag-o.

english_verse: After saying goodbye, we sailed straight to Cos. The next day we reached Rhodes and from there sailed on to Patara.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ laan ma banɩ-ba yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ viiri. Dɩ́ ma kwe dɩ́ yigǝ dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Kosi. Tɩga ma pʋʋrɩ, dɩ́ daa ma yi Rodi. Dɩ́ ma zɩgɩ dáanɩ dɩ́ vu Patara.

english_verse: We found a ship going to Phoenicia, so we got on board and sailed off.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na yi dáanɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ma na naboro kʋdoŋ kʋ na lagɩ kʋ vu Fenisi. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ zʋ kʋ wʋ sɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ vu.

english_verse: We came within sight of Cyprus and then sailed south of it on to the port of Tyre in Syria, where the ship was going to unload its cargo.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na maa ve tɩn, dɩ́ ma tʋlɩ dɩ́ na Sipri. Dɩ́ ma yagɩ-kʋ dɩ́ jagwiǝ nɩ, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ kɛ. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ yi Siiri. Dɩ́ na yi da tɩn, dɩ́ ma zɩgɩ Tiiri nɩ. Kʋ yɩ dáanɩ mʋ ba maŋɩ sɩ ba lɩ naboro kʋm zɩla yam.

english_verse: But when the week was over, we started on our way again. All the men, together with their wives and children, walked with us from the town to the seashore. We knelt on the beach and prayed.
translation_verse: Da yarpɛ yam na kɛ tɩn, dɩ́ ma zaŋɩ dɩ́ kwe dɩ́ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ viiri. Zezi nɔɔna bam dɩ ba kaana dɩ ba biǝ maama ma ja dɩbam ba nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ ba vu sɩ ba yagɩ. Dɩ́ na ve dɩ́ yi nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni tɩn, dɩbam maama ma kuni doonǝ tɩga nɩ dɩ́ warɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Then after saying goodbye to each other, we got into the ship, and they went back home.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na warɩ Wɛ dɩ́ ti tɩn, dɩ́ ma banɩ daanɩ dɩ yi-na, yɩ dɩ́ zʋ naboro kʋm. Bantʋ ma joori sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The next day we went to Caesarea and stayed with Philip, the preacher. He was one of the seven men who helped the apostles,
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ma zaŋɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Sezaarɩ. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ pǝni Filipi-ba sɔŋɔ nɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, yɩ o tɔgɩ o yɩ nɔɔna barpɛ balʋ ba na lɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn wʋ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa.

english_verse: We had been in Caesarea for several days, when the prophet Agabus came to us from Judea.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na kɩ da fɩnfɩɩn dáanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ ma nuŋi Zude o ba dɩbam te. O yɩrɩ mʋ Agabusi. O yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu mʋ.

english_verse: He took Paul's belt, and with it he tied up his own hands and feet. Then he told us, “The Holy Spirit says that some of the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will tie up the man who owns this belt. They will also hand him over to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: O na tu dɩbam te kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma lɩ Pooli kilǝ o tǝŋǝ nɩ o ma vɔ o tɩtɩ nɛ dɩ o jɩa o kɩ daanɩ. O laan ma ta o wɩ: «Mʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn kʋ wɩ: Zwifǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ja kilǝ kantʋ tu ba vɔ tɩntʋ doŋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba kɩ-o dwi-gɛ tiinǝ jɩŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: After Agabus said this, we and the followers living there begged Paul not to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩbam dɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ ba wʋra tɩn maa kwaanɩ dɩ́ loori Pooli sɩ o yɩ zaŋɩ o vu Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: But Paul answered, “Why are you crying and breaking my heart? I am not only willing to be put in jail for the Lord Jesus, but I am even willing to die for him in Jerusalem!”
translation_verse: O ma lǝri o wɩ: «Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ abam keerǝ, yɩ á pa a wʋ cɔgɩ? Ba na lagɩ ba vɔ-nɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ naa ba na lagɩ ba gʋ-nɩ dɩ, amʋ wʋ́ sɛ sɩ a tɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: Since we could not get Paul to change his mind, we gave up and prayed, “Lord, please make us willing to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na loor-o taan dɩ́ ga tɩn, dɩ́ ma yagɩ yɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ wɩ: «Wɛ wʋ́ kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Some of the followers from Caesarea went with us and took us to stay in the home of Mnason. He was from Cyprus and had been a follower from the beginning. Paul Visits James
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ badaara ma zaŋɩ Sezaarɩ nɩ ba kogili dɩbam. Ba ma ja dɩbam ba vu nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ sɔŋɔ dɩ́ na lagɩ dɩ́ pǝni da tɩn. O yɩrɩ mʋ Mɩnasɔn. O yɩ Sipri tu mʋ o na maŋɩ o yɩ Zezi karabu faŋa faŋa. Pooli na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ yɩ kʋ kɩ-o te tɩn

english_verse: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the Lord's followers gladly welcomed us.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na yi Zeruzalɛm tɩn, dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam ma jeeri dɩbam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Paul went with us to see James the next day, and all the church leaders were present.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Pooli ma zaŋɩ o tɔgɩ dɩdaanɩ dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ na Zakɩ. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam maama maa tɔgɩ ba wʋra.

english_verse: Paul greeted them and told how God had used him to help the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Pooli ma jɔɔnɩ-ba. O ma tʋlɩ kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam tee nɩ o tɩtʋŋa yam wʋnɩ tɩn o brɩ-ba.

english_verse: Everyone who heard this praised God and said to Paul: My friend, you can see how many tens of thousands of our people have become followers! And all of them are eager to obey the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba na ni kʋlʋ maama o na tagɩ tɩn, ba ma kɩ Wɛ le kʋ ŋwaanɩ. Ba laan ma ta dɩ Pooli ba wɩ: «Dɩbam ko-bu, ni kʋ na yɩ te tɩn. Zwifǝ bam mʋrrʋ kɔgɔ kɔgɔ laan mʋ tu ba sɛ Zezi, yɩ ba ta tɔgɩ Wɛ ni-doorǝ yam dɩ ba wʋ maama.

english_verse: But they have been told that you are teaching those who live among the Gentiles to disobey this Law. They claim that you are telling them not to circumcise their sons or to follow our customs.
translation_verse: Ba ni nɩ nmʋ yǝni n brɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ ba yagɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ tɩn. Ba ni nɩ n tɛ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ sɩ ba daa yɩ ta goni ba bǝkǝri, sɩ ba daa yɩ ta tɔgɩ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam mɩʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: What should we do now that our people have heard you are here?
translation_verse: Zwifǝ balʋ na wʋ yo seeni tɩn wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ tuǝ. Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ?

english_verse: Please do what we ask, because four of our men have made special promises to God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ nan wʋ́ brɩ-m n na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn. Nɔɔna bana wʋ dɩbam tee nɩ ba na goni ba ni dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Join with them and prepare yourself for the ceremony that goes with the promises. Pay the cost for their heads to be shaved. Then everyone will learn that the reports about you are not true. They will know you do obey the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba na lagɩ ba vu Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm sɩ ba kwɛ ba tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ, nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n tɔgɩ n vu mʋ, sɩ n daarɩ n ŋwɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa ba na cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba fa ba yuni tɩn. N na kɩ kʋntʋ, nɔɔna bam maama wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ ba na tɛ kʋlʋ ba pa nmʋ tɩn daɩ cɩga. Ba nan wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm na brɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Some while ago we told the Gentile followers what we think they should do. We instructed them not to eat anything offered to idols. They were told not to eat any meat with blood still in it or the meat of an animal that has been strangled. They were also told not to commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na tu ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn, dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ dɩ́ pa-ba yɩ dɩ́ ta kʋlʋ dɩ́ na bʋŋɩ tɩn. Dɩbam tagɩ-ba sɩ ba yɩ zaŋɩ ba di wʋdiu kʋlʋ nɔɔna na mɛ ba kaanɩ jwǝnǝ tɩn, naa ba di jana, naa ba di varɩm wʋlʋ ba na jujugi ba gʋ tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ ba sɩ ba yɩ cɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ kaana, sɩ kaana dɩ yɩ cɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ baara.»

english_verse: The next day Paul took the four men with him and got himself ready at the same time they did. Then he went into the temple and told when the final ceremony would take place and when an offering would be made for each of them. Paul Is Arrested
translation_verse: Ba na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Pooli ma sɛ ba taanɩ dɩm. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, o ma ja nɔɔna bam o vu sɩ o tɔgɩ o kwɛ o tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ. O ma daarɩ o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ, sɩ o ta o brɩ ka yigǝ tiinǝ bam da yalʋ ni na daarɩ sɩ nɔɔna bam kwɛ ba tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ ba ti tɩn, sɩ ba laan ja ba wǝǝnu tɩm ba ja ba, sɩ ba ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ ba pa ba dɩdʋa dɩdʋa.

english_verse: When the period of seven days for the ceremony was almost over, some of the Jewish people from Asia saw Paul in the temple. They got a large crowd together and started attacking him.
translation_verse: Da yarpɛ yam ni na daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ ya ti tɩn, Zwifǝ badaara ma na Pooli Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ. Bantʋ nuŋi Azi tɩʋ kʋdoŋ mʋ. Ba ma pa nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama na wʋra tɩn bana zaŋɩ dɩ Pooli. Ba ma ja-o,

english_verse: Some of them thought that Paul had brought Trophimus from Ephesus into the temple, because they had seen them together in the city.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn tagɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba ya nɛ Trofim dɩ Pooli na tɔgɩ daanɩ tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ, yɩ o yɩ dwi-gɛ tu na nuŋi Efɛɛzɩ tɩn. Ba dɛɛn bʋŋɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ mʋ Pooli jaanɩ o zʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ.

english_verse: The whole city was in an uproar, and the people turned into a mob. They grabbed Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Then suddenly the doors were shut.
translation_verse: Vuvugǝ ma zaŋɩ tɩʋ kʋm maama wʋnɩ. Nɔn-kɔgɔ ma duri kʋ vu jǝgǝ kam. Ba laan ma ja Pooli ba tuur-o ba ja nuŋi Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pɩ ka niǝ yam maama.

english_verse: The people were about to kill Paul when the Roman army commander heard that all Jerusalem was starting to riot.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maa kwaana sɩ ba gʋ Pooli. Rom pamaŋna bam dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma ni nɩ Zeruzalɛm tɩʋ kʋm maama vugimi.

english_verse: So he quickly took some soldiers and officers and ran to where the crowd had gathered. As soon as the mob saw the commander and soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
translation_verse: O na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma lɩ pamaŋna bam dɩ ba yigǝ tiinǝ badaara, yɩ ba duri lɩla ba vu ba yi kɔgɔ kʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn. Nɔɔna bam na nɛ-o dɩ o pamaŋna bam kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma yagɩ Pooli magɩm.

english_verse: The army commander went over and arrested him and had him bound with two chains. Then he tried to find out who Paul was and what he had done.
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma vu o twɛ Pooli te, yɩ o pa ba ja-o. O ma pa ba kwe capʋnnʋ tɩle ba ma vɔ-o. O ma daarɩ o bwe sɩ o lwarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, dɩ o na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Part of the crowd shouted one thing, and part of them shouted something else. But they were making so much noise that the commander could not find out a thing. Then he ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress.
translation_verse: O na bwe kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna badaara ma kaasa kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ yɩ ba tɛ n ni n ni. Sɔɔ kʋm na daga kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm warɩ sɩ o lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ cɩga cɩga tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ o ma pa o nɔɔna bam ni, sɩ ba ja Pooli ba vu ba pamaŋna bam pɩɩna digǝ kam.

english_verse: As they reached the steps, the crowd became so wild that the soldiers had to lift Paul up and carry him.
translation_verse: Ba na jaan-o ba yi natǝnǝ yam diinim jǝgǝ tɩn, pamaŋna bam kwe-o mʋ ba zɩŋɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm yiǝ tiini ya sɩɩnɩ o baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The crowd followed and kept shouting, “Kill him! Kill him!” Paul Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama ma pɛ ba pu o kwaga, yɩ ba kaasɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Gʋ-o-na!»

english_verse: When Paul was about to be taken into the fortress, he asked the commander, “Can I say something to you?” “How do you know Greek?” the commander asked.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam na lagɩ ba ja Pooli ba zʋ ba pɩɩna digǝ kam tɩn, o ma ta dɩ ba dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm o wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ́ pa-nɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ta taanɩ a brɩ-m na?» Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma bwe Pooli o wɩ: «Nmʋ kɩ ta mʋ n ni Grɛkɩ tiinǝ taanɩ?

english_verse: “No!” Paul replied. “I am a Jew from Tarsus, an important city in Cilicia. Please let me speak to the crowd.”
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝri o wɩ: «Aye. Amʋ yɩ Zwifu mʋ. Ba lʋgɩ amʋ Silisi tɩʋ Tarɩsɩ nɩ mʋ. A yɩ tʋ-kamunu kʋm kʋntʋ nɔn-bu mʋ. A loori-m sɩ n pa-nɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm.»

english_verse: The commander told him he could speak, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the people. When they were quiet, he spoke to them in Aramaic:
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma sɛ. Pooli ma zaŋɩ o zɩgɩ natǝnǝ yam baŋa nɩ. O ma zǝŋi o jɩŋa kɔgɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ. Ba maama ma cǝgi sɔɔ. O ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ ba dɩ ba tɩtɩ Zwifǝ taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: “My friends and leaders of our nation, listen as I explain what happened!”
translation_verse: O ma ta o wɩ: «A kwǝ-ba dɩ a ko-biǝ-ba, á fɔgɩ á cǝgi sɩ a tʋlɩ kʋ na yɩ te tɩn a brɩ abam.»

english_verse: When the crowd heard Paul speak to them in Aramaic, they became even quieter. Then Paul said:
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam na lwarɩ nɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ ba tɩtɩ dwi taanɩ mʋ tɩn, ba ma fɔgɩ ba cǝgi sɔɔ.

english_verse: I am a Jew, born in the city of Tarsus in Cilicia. But I grew up here in Jerusalem where I was a student of Gamaliel and was taught to follow every single law of our ancestors. In fact, I was just as eager to obey God as any of you are today.
translation_verse: O laan ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Amʋ yɩ Zwifu mʋ. Ba lʋgɩ-nɩ Silisi tɩʋ Tarɩsɩ nɩ mʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ Zeruzalɛm yo mʋ a kɩ nɔɔnʋ. Gamalɩyɛlɩ mʋ brɩ amʋ dɩbam nabaara cullu tɩm na yɩ te tɩn cɩga cɩga. A dɛɛn cɛ lanyɩranɩ a kwe a tɩtɩ a pa Wɛ nɩnɛɛnɩ abam zɩm dɩ na kɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: I made trouble for everyone who followed the Lord's Way, and I even had some of them killed. I had others arrested and put in jail. I didn't care if they were men or women.
translation_verse: A dɛɛn yaarɩ balʋ na sɛ ba tɔgɩ Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam tɩn, yɩ a daarɩ a pa ba gʋ badaara. A maa yǝni a jaanɩ baara dɩ kaana a kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: The high priest and all the council members can tell you this is true. They even gave me letters to the Jewish leaders in Damascus, so that I could arrest people there and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
translation_verse: Dɩbam kaanɩm yuutu wʋm dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ nakwa kɔgɔ kʋm maama wʋ́ wanɩ ba ta nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga. Maŋa kadoŋ nɩ a ve bantʋ te mʋ a joŋi twaanʋ tɩlʋ a na wʋ́ kwe a brɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na wʋ Damasɩ nɩ tɩn, sɩ ba pa-nɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ja balʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam tɩn, a vɔ-ba a ja a ba Zeruzalɛm sɩ ba na cam.

english_verse: One day about noon I was getting close to Damascus, when a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around me.
translation_verse: A na maa ve yɩ a daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ a yi Damasɩ tɩn, kʋ na maŋɩ dɩ wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn, mʋ pooni dɛ dɩ nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ dɩ ba dɩ pɩpɩlɩ dɩ kaagɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: I fell to the ground and heard a voice asking, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: A ma tʋ tɩga nɩ, yɩ a ni kwǝrǝ na bǝŋi-nɩ ka wɩ: ‹Sooli, Sooli! Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ n jɩgɩ amʋ n bɛɛsɩ kʋntʋ?›

english_verse: “Who are you?” I answered. The Lord replied, “I am Jesus from Nazareth! I am the one you are so cruel to.”
translation_verse: A ma bwe a wɩ: ‹A tu, nmʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?› O ma lǝri o wɩ: ‹Amʋ yɩ Zezi mʋ, Nazarɛtɩ tu wʋlʋ nmʋ na jɩgɩ n bɛɛsɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: Those who were traveling with me saw the light, but did not hear the voice.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn ma na pooni dɩm, yɩ ba wʋ ni wʋlʋ kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn.

english_verse: I asked, “Lord, what do you want me to do?” Then he told me, “Get up and go to Damascus. When you get there, you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: A laan ma bwe a wɩ: ‹A tu, bɛɛ mʋ a nan wʋ́ kɩ?› Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ma lǝri-nɩ o wɩ: ‹Zaŋɩ n vu n zʋ Damasɩ, sɩ dáanɩ mʋ ba laan wʋ́ brɩ-m kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na pɛ ni sɩ n kɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: The light had been so bright that I couldn't see. And the others had to lead me by the hand to Damascus.
translation_verse: A ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ, yɩ a yiǝ daa ba naɩ, pooni dɩm na tiini dɩ pɩpɩlɩ-ya tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ, balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn ma ja a jɩŋa ba vaŋɩ-nɩ ba ja zʋ Damasɩ tɩʋ kʋm wʋ.

english_verse: In that city there was a man named Ananias, who faithfully obeyed the Law of Moses and was well liked by all the Jewish people living there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ maa wʋra, o yɩrɩ mʋ Ananiya. O maa nɩgɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ o tɔgɩ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm. Zwifǝ balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Damasɩ nɩ tɩn maa tɛ o taanɩ ba wɩ, o yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm.

english_verse: He came to me and said, “Saul, my friend, you can now see again!” At once I could see.
translation_verse: O laan ma ba o zɩgɩ amʋ tee nɩ yɩ o wɩ: ‹A ko-bu Sooli, joori n ta n naɩ!› O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ mʋ a yiǝ yam puri yɩ a na o yibiyǝ.

english_verse: Then Ananias told me, “The God that our ancestors worshiped has chosen you to know what he wants done. He has chosen you to see the One Who Obeys God and to hear his voice.
translation_verse: O ma ta o wɩ: ‹Dɩbam nabaara Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ lɩ nmʋ sɩ n lwarɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, sɩ n daarɩ n na Wʋ-poŋo Tu wʋm sɩ n ni o na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ o tɩtɩ kwǝrǝ.

english_verse: What are you waiting for? Get up! Be baptized, and wash away your sins by praying to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ n da n daanɩ. Zaŋɩ sɩ n loori Wɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ n daarɩ n pa ba miisi-m na wʋnɩ, sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ n lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-m.›

english_verse: After this I returned to Jerusalem and went to the temple to pray. There I had a vision
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ na kɛ tɩn, a laan ma joori a vu Zeruzalɛm. A ma vu Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋ a wʋra a warɩ Wɛ. A na wʋra tɩn, Wɛ ma pa a na wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ nɩ dɩndwɩa te.

english_verse: of the Lord who said to me, “Hurry and leave Jerusalem! The people won't listen to what you say about me.”
translation_verse: A ma na dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ amʋ o wɩ: ‹Zaŋɩ n kɩ lɩla n duri n nuŋi Zeruzalɛm nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ tɩʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam bá sɛ kʋlʋ nmʋ na wʋ́ ta amʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.›

english_verse: I replied, “Lord, they know that in many of our synagogues I arrested and beat people who had faith in you.
translation_verse: A ma lǝri a wɩ: ‹A yuutu, nɔɔna bam ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ amʋ dɛɛn yǝni a tʋlɩ Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-di sɩm, yɩ a jaanɩ nɔɔna balʋ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ nmʋ tɩn a pa ba pɩ-ba, yɩ ba daarɩ ba magɩ-ba.

english_verse: Stephen was killed because he spoke for you, and I stood there and cheered them on. I even guarded the clothes of the men who murdered him.”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ ba na gʋ Etiyɛnɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ nmʋ maana tu o brɩ nmʋ cɩga kam tɩn, a tɩtɩ wʋra yɩ a sɛ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o. Amʋ dɛɛn mʋ zɩgɩ a nii ba gwaarʋ tɩm ba na lɩ ba tiŋi sɩ ba daarɩ ba dʋl-o ba gʋ tɩn.›

english_verse: But the Lord told me to go, and he promised to send me far away to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm laan ma ta dɩ amʋ o wɩ: ‹Nan ve, sɩ amʋ wʋ́ tʋŋɩ-m yigǝ yigǝ sɩ n vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te.› »

english_verse: They kept shouting. They waved their clothes around and threw dust into the air. Paul and the Roman Army Commander
translation_verse: Ba maa nanɩ baarɩ yɩ ba vuvugǝ ba gwaarʋ wɛɛnɩ, yɩ ba mɔɔnɩ fogo ba caara.

english_verse: The Roman commander ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress and beaten with a whip. He did this to find out why the people were screaming at Paul.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm na nɛ kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩn, o ma pa o nɔɔna bam ni sɩ ba ja Pooli ba zʋ ba pɩɩna digǝ kam. O ma ta dɩ ba sɩ ba mag-o dɩ balaara, sɩ o ta o pa ba lwarɩ o na kɩ kʋlʋ yɩ Zwifǝ bam nanɩ baarɩ o baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: While the soldiers were tying Paul up to be beaten, he asked the officer standing there, “Is it legal to beat a Roman citizen before he has been tried in court?”
translation_verse: Ba na vɔg-o ba ti sɩ ba daarɩ ba mag-o tɩn, Pooli ma ta dɩ pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu wʋlʋ na zɩgɩ da tɩn o wɩ: «Abam jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ á ja Rom tɩʋ jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ á magɩ, yɩ ba ta wʋ bwe-o ba nii o na cɔgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn na?»

english_verse: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and said, “What are you doing? This man is a Roman citizen!”
translation_verse: Pamaŋna yigǝ tu wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma vu o ta dɩ o dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm o wɩ: «Nmʋ nan lagɩ n kɩ ta mʋ? Nɔɔnʋ wʋm yɩ Rom tɩʋ jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ mʋ.»

english_verse: The commander then said, “I paid a lot of money to become a Roman citizen.” But Paul replied, “I was born a Roman citizen.”
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ ŋwɩ sǝbu-fɔrɔ mʋ yɩ a daarɩ a ji Rom tɩʋ kʋm jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ.» Pooli ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A nan maŋɩ a yɩ Rom tɩʋ kʋm jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ a lʋra maŋa nɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: The men who were about to beat and question Paul quickly backed off. And the commander himself was frightened when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains. Paul Is Tried by the Council
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ ya na zɩgɩ sɩ ba mag-o sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma kwe o yɩra ba yagɩ lɩla. Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm dɩ na lwarɩ nɩ Pooli yɩ Rom tɩʋ kʋm jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma ja-o dɩ o na pɛ ba vɔ-o dɩ capʋnnʋ tɩn. Pooli na zɩgɩ nakwa bam yigǝ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: The next day the commander wanted to know the real reason why the Jewish leaders had brought charges against Paul. So he had Paul's chains removed, and he ordered the chief priests and the whole council to meet. Then he had Paul led in and made him stand in front of them.
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm dɛɛn maa lagɩ sɩ o lwarɩ kʋlʋ na kɩ yɩ Zwifǝ bam saŋɩ Pooli tɩn. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, o ma pa ba bwǝli Pooli ba yagɩ. O ma daarɩ o pa ni sɩ Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam maama jeeri daanɩ. O laan ma ja Pooli o vu o pa o zɩgɩ ba yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Paul looked straight at the council members and said, “My friends, to this day I have served God with a clear conscience!”
translation_verse: Pooli ma nii sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam seeni yɩ o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋlʋ maama a na kɩ a ŋwɩa wʋnɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm tɩn, fʋʋnɩ tǝri a bɩcarɩ nɩ, yɩ Wɛ dɩ ye kʋ ni nɩ.»

english_verse: Paul turned to the high priest and said, “You whitewashed wall! God will hit you. You sit there to judge me by the Law of Moses. But at the same time you order men to break the Law by hitting me.”
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝri Ananiya o wɩ: «Wɛ wʋ́ magɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ mʋ. Nmʋ nyɩ dɩ kǝbrǝ kalʋ nɔɔna na fɔgɩ tɩn mʋ. Nmʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na je sɩ n di amʋ taanɩ sɩ kʋ tɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm mʋ, yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ mʋ cɔgɩ-tɩ dɩ n na pɛ ni sɩ ba magɩ amʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: The men standing beside Paul asked, “Don't you know you are insulting God's high priest?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na zɩgɩ Pooli tee nɩ tɩn ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Nmʋ jɩgɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm mʋ n twɩa!»

english_verse: Paul replied, “Oh! I didn't know he was the high priest. The Scriptures do tell us not to speak evil about a leader of our people.”
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, a maŋɩ a yǝri nɩ o yɩ kaanɩm yuutu mʋ. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ, n yɩ zaŋɩ n ŋɔɔnɩ n cɔgɩ dɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ abam yuutu tɩn.»

english_verse: When Paul saw that some of the council members were Sadducees and others were Pharisees, he shouted, “My friends, I am a Pharisee and the son of a Pharisee. I am on trial simply because I believe that the dead will be raised to life.”
translation_verse: Pooli na lwarɩ nɩ kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna badaara yɩ Sadusɩan tiinǝ yɩ badaara dɩ yɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ tɩn, o laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ yɩ Farizɩan tu mʋ yɩ a kwǝri a yɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bu. Ba zɩm saŋɩ amʋ sɩ ba di a taanɩ, dɩ a na jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ twa wʋ́ joori ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: As soon as Paul said this, the Pharisees and the Sadducees got into a big argument, and the council members started taking sides.
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, Farizɩan tiinǝ bam dɩ Sadusɩan tiinǝ bam ma sɩŋɩ ba wʋra ba magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ. Ba kɔgɔ kʋm ma pɔɔrɩ bɩle.

english_verse: The Sadducees do not believe in angels or spirits or that the dead will rise to life. But the Pharisees believe in all of these,
translation_verse: Sadusɩan tiinǝ bam maa brɩ nɩ twa biim tǝrǝ, yɩ ba tɛ nɩ malɛsɩ dɩ cirǝ dɩ tǝrǝ. Kʋ daarɩ Farizɩan tiinǝ bam maa brɩ nɩ tɩntʋ maama wʋra.

english_verse: and so there was a lot of shouting. Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees. Finally, they became angry and said, “We don't find anything wrong with this man. Maybe a spirit or an angel really did speak to him.”
translation_verse: Ba maama maa kɩ sɔɔ kʋ tiini kʋ ja gaalɩ. Wɛ cullu karanyɩna tiinǝ badaara na nuŋi Farizɩan kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn ma zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ ba twanɩ dɩ dam ba wɩ: «Dɩbam wʋ nɛ kʋlʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ na cɔgɩ tɩn. Dɛ doŋ kʋ waɩ kʋ yɩ ciru naa malɛka mʋ sɩɩnɩ ka ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o.»

english_verse: The argument became fierce, and the commander was afraid that Paul would be pulled apart. So he ordered the soldiers to go in and rescue Paul. Then they took him back into the fortress.
translation_verse: Ba kantɔgɔ kʋm na tiini kʋ daga tɩn, kʋ ma pa fʋʋnɩ zʋ pamaŋna bam dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm, o ya bʋŋɩ sɩ ba ga wʋ́ ja Pooli ba vaŋɩ ba tʋrɩ mʋ. O ma pa ni sɩ o pamaŋna bam zʋ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ ba ja Pooli ba ja nuŋi, sɩ ba daarɩ ba ja-o ba joori ba vu ba pɩɩna digǝ kam.

english_verse: Then some of them went to the chief priests and the nation's leaders and said, “We have promised God that we would not eat a thing until we have killed Paul.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma zaŋɩ ba vu ba kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba nakwa bam te ba ta ba wɩ: «Dɩbam maama kɩ ni daanɩ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ du dɩ Wɛ dɩ́ wɩ, dɩ́ daa bá di kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ na wʋ́ gʋ Pooli tɩn.

english_verse: You and everyone in the council must go to the commander and pretend that you want to find out more about the charges against Paul. Ask for him to be brought before your court. Meanwhile, we will be waiting to kill him before he gets there.”
translation_verse: Kʋ laan daarɩ sɩ abam dɩ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam maama mʋ tʋŋɩ ni pamaŋna dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm tee nɩ, sɩ ba ja Pooli ba nuŋi ba ba ba pa abam. Abam wʋ́ kɩ sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ á lagɩ sɩ á fɔgɩ á ni o taanɩ dɩm woŋo mʋ te. Kʋ daarɩ dɩbam wʋ́ vu dɩ́ ti dɩ́ yigǝ, sɩ dɩ́ gʋ-o cwǝŋǝ nɩ yɩ o daa ta wʋ yi abam te.»

english_verse: When Paul's nephew heard about the plot, he went to the fortress and told Paul about it.
translation_verse: Pooli nakɔ bu dɛɛn ma ni kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ ŋwa. O ma zaŋɩ o vu o zʋ pamaŋna bam pɩɩna digǝ kam o ta o brɩ Pooli.

english_verse: So Paul said to one of the army officers, “Take this young man to the commander. He has something to tell him.”
translation_verse: Pooli na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma bǝŋi pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu dɩdʋa sɩ o ba. O ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Ja nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋntʋ n vu dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm te, sɩ o jɩgɩ taanɩ mʋ sɩ o ta dɩd-o.»

english_verse: The officer took him to the commander and said, “The prisoner named Paul asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to tell you.”
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu wʋm ma tɔgɩ o yigǝ o ja-o o vu dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm te. O ma ta o wɩ: «Pooli wʋlʋ na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ bǝŋi amʋ o ta o wɩ, a ja nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋntʋ a ba nmʋ te, sɩ o jɩgɩ taanɩ mʋ sɩ o ta o brɩ-m.»

english_verse: The commander took the young man aside and asked him in private, “What do you want to tell me?”
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm ma ja o jɩŋa o vaŋ-o o ja nuŋi daa. O ma bwe-o o wɩ: «Nmʋ jɩgɩ bɛɛn n lagɩ n ta n brɩ amʋ?»

english_verse: He answered, “Some men are planning to ask you to bring Paul down to the Jewish council tomorrow. They will claim they want to find out more about him.
translation_verse: O ma ta o wɩ: «Zwifǝ bam mʋ kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba jwa tʋŋɩ ni nmʋ tee nɩ, sɩ n ja Pooli n vu ba sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam te, sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba lagɩ sɩ ba fɔgɩ ba ni o taanɩ dɩm mʋ te.

english_verse: The commander sent the young man away after saying to him, “Don't let anyone know you told me this.” Paul Is Sent to Felix the Governor
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta dɩd-o o wɩ: «Yɩ zaŋɩ n ta n brɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nɩ n tu n ta kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ dɩ amʋ.» O ma daarɩ o pa nɔn-dʋŋʋ kʋm viiri.

english_verse: The commander called in two of his officers and told them, “By nine o'clock tonight have
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm laan ma bǝŋi o yigǝ tiinǝ bale o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Lɩ-na pamaŋna biǝ-yale (

english_verse: men on horseback and
translation_verse: ) dɩ cicwǝ dʋlɩna biǝ-yale (

english_verse: Get a horse ready for Paul and make sure he gets safely through to Felix the governor.”
translation_verse: Lɩ-na sise á pa Pooli sɩ o di, sɩ o wanɩ o vu o yi gʋvɩrma tu Felisi te dɩ yazurǝ.»

english_verse: The commander wrote a letter that said:
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋm laan ma pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ o wɩ:

english_verse: Some Jews grabbed this man and were about to kill him. But when I found out that he was a Roman citizen, I took some soldiers and rescued him.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ badonnǝ mʋ jaanɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ, yɩ ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o. Amʋ nan lwarɩ nɩ o yɩ Rom tɩʋ kʋm jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ dɩ a pamaŋna bam ma vu dɩ́ joŋ-o dɩ́ yagɩ.

english_verse: I wanted to find out what they had against him. So I brought him before their council
translation_verse: A ya lagɩ sɩ a lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ ba na jaan-o ba ba ba saŋɩ tɩn mʋ. Mʋ kʋ kuri a jaan-o a vu a zɩgɩ ba sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: and learned that the charges concern only their religious laws. This man isn't guilty of anything for which he should die or even be put in jail.
translation_verse: A ma lwarɩ nɩ ba saŋ-o ba tɩtɩ cullu tɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Kʋlʋkʋlʋ nan tǝrǝ kʋ na brɩ nɩ ba maŋɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o naa ba pɩ-o.

english_verse: As soon as I learned that there was a plot against him, I sent him to you and told their leaders to bring charges against him in your court.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan mʋ tagɩ o brɩ-nɩ, nɩ Zwifǝ badaara mʋ kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba gʋ nɔɔnʋ wʋm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tʋŋ-o nmʋ tee nɩ. A ma ta dɩ balʋ na saŋ-o tɩn, nɩ ba ba nmʋ te ba ta kʋlʋ o na kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: The soldiers obeyed the commander's orders, and that same night they took Paul to the city of Antipatris.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam laan ma zaŋɩ ba ja Pooli ba nuŋi nɩ ba na pɛ-ba ni sɩ ba kɩ te tɩn. Ba ma ja-o tɩtɩɩ dɩm kʋntʋ ba vu ba yi Antipatrisi.

english_verse: The next day the foot soldiers returned to the fortress and let the soldiers on horseback take him the rest of the way.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, pamaŋna balʋ na ve tɩga nɩ tɩn ma zɩgɩ dáanɩ ba joori ba vu ba jǝgǝ kam. Ba ma daarɩ sise diinǝ bam yɩranɩ mʋ sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩ Pooli ba vu.

english_verse: When they came to Caesarea, they gave the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja-o ba vu ba yi Sezaarɩ. Ba na yi da tɩn, ba ma kwe tɔnɔ kʋm ba pa gʋvɩrma tu wʋm yɩ ba kɩ Pooli o jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The governor read the letter. Then he asked Paul and found out that he was from Cilicia.
translation_verse: O ma karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋm, yɩ o daarɩ o bwe Pooli o wɩ, tɩʋ kɔɔ mʋ o nuŋi? O na lwarɩ nɩ o nuŋi Silisi tɩn,

english_verse: The governor said, “I will listen to your case as soon as the people come to bring their charges against you.” After saying this, he gave orders for Paul to be kept as a prisoner in Herod's palace.
translation_verse: o ma ta o wɩ: «Nmʋ saŋɩna bam na tuǝ, aá bwe nmʋ taanɩ dɩm a nii.» O ma daarɩ o pa ni o wɩ, ba ja Pooli ba vu sɔŋɔ kʋlʋ Pɛ Erɔdɩ dɛɛn na lɔgɩ tɩn ba pɩ-o da sɩ ba taa yɩr-o.

english_verse: Five days later Ananias the high priest, together with some of their leaders and a lawyer named Tertullus, went to the governor to present their case against Paul.
translation_verse: Da yanu na kɛ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm yuutu Ananiya laan ma ba dɩdaanɩ nakwa badaara, dɩ bɩtar-yeenu wʋlʋ na yɩ ba zǝnnu tɩn o yɩrɩ mʋ Tɛtuli. Ba ma vu ba jǝni gʋvɩrma tu wʋm yigǝ nɩ, sɩ ba tʋlɩ kʋlʋ Pooli na kɩ tɩn ba brɩ-o.

english_verse: So Paul was called in, and Tertullus stated the case against him: Honorable Felix, you have brought our people a long period of peace, and because of your concern our nation is much better off.
translation_verse: Ba ma bǝŋi Pooli sɩ o ba. Tɛtuli laan ma puli sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩm. O ma tʋlɩ o wɩ: «Dɩbam yuutu Felisi, dɩbam maama ye nɩ nmʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩbam lʋgʋ kʋm jɩgɩ ywǝǝni dɩ yazurǝ. Nmʋ na jɩgɩ dɩbam te tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩbam lʋgʋ kʋm fɔgɩ kʋ ve yigǝ.

english_verse: All of us are always grateful for what you have done.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na kɩ kʋlʋ maŋa maama naa je dɩ je n pa dɩbam tɩn, dɩ́ kɩ nmʋ le zanzan kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I don't want to bother you, but please be patient with us and listen to me for just a few minutes.
translation_verse: A nan ba lagɩ sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ zanzan sɩ kʋ yaarɩ nmʋ. A nan loori-m sɩ n cǝgi dɩbam na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ fɩnfɩɩn sɩ dɩ́ ta tɩn.

english_verse: This man has been found to be a real pest and troublemaker for our people all over the world. He is also a leader of a group called Nazarenes.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maanɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ jɩgɩ nakɔɔrɩ zanzan. O yǝni o paɩ Zwifǝ bam magɩ kantɔgɔ yɩ ba pɔɔrɩ daanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa je maama nɩ. O maa kwǝri o yɩ Nazarɛtɩ tiinǝ vwan kara kam yigǝ tu.

english_verse: When he tried to disgrace the temple, we arrested him. If you question him, you will find out for yourself that our charges are true.
translation_verse: O ma pa ni nɩ balʋ na saŋɩ Pooli tɩn ba nmʋ te.] Nmʋ nan na bwe-o taanɩ, nmʋ tɩtɩ laan wʋ́ lwarɩ kʋlʋ o na kɩ yɩ dɩ́ saŋ-o tɩn.»

english_verse: The Jewish crowd spoke up and agreed with what Tertullus had said. Paul Defends Himself
translation_verse: Tɛtuli na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam ma pu o kwaga ba wɩ, o na tagɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: The governor motioned for Paul to speak, and he began: I know that you have judged the people of our nation for many years, and I am glad to defend myself in your court.
translation_verse: Gʋvɩrma tu wʋm laan ma yɩgɩsɩ o jɩŋa sɩ Pooli dɩ daa tʋlɩ o kwǝrǝ. Pooli ma ta o wɩ: «Amʋ ye nɩ nmʋ te lʋgʋ kʋntʋ yɩ n yɩ sarɩya-diru bɩna zanzan na kɛ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo sɩ a zɩgɩ nmʋ yigǝ nɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ a joŋi a tɩtɩ.

english_verse: It was no more than twelve days ago that I went to worship in Jerusalem. You can find this out easily enough.
translation_verse: Nmʋ tɩtɩ nan wʋ́ wanɩ n lwarɩ nɩ a na ve Zeruzalɛm sɩ a zuli Wɛ tɩn, kʋ ta wʋ dwǝni da fugǝ-yale zɩm dɛ dɩm nɩ.

english_verse: There is no way that they can prove these charges they are now bringing against me.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na wɩ a kɩ tɩn, ba bá wanɩ ba brɩ nɩ tɩ yɩ cɩga.

english_verse: I admit that their leaders think the Lord's Way which I follow is based on wrong beliefs. But I still worship the same God that my ancestors worshiped. And I believe everything written in the Law of Moses and in the Prophets.
translation_verse: A nan na wʋ́ ta kʋlʋ dɩ nmʋ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: A zuli Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩbam nabaara Wɛ tɩn mʋ, yɩ a tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝ-dʋŋa kalʋ nɔɔna bantʋ na tɛ ba wɩ ka yɩ vwan tɩn. A nan sɛ a tɔgɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam twaanʋ tɩm wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I am just as sure as these people are that God will raise from death everyone, good or evil.
translation_verse: A nan jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ, nɩ nɔɔna bantʋ dɩ na jɩgɩ tɩɩna te, nɩ twa maama wʋ́ joori ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, kʋ na yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna dɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ maama.

english_verse: And because I am sure, I try my best to have a clear conscience in whatever I do for God or for people.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tiini a kwaana, sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ maama na lana Wɛ dɩ nabiinǝ tee nɩ tɩn, yɩ fʋʋnɩ tǝri a bɩcarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: After being away for several years, I returned here to bring gifts for the poor people of my nation and to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: A dɛɛn ya tǝri Zeruzalɛm nɩ bɩna zanzan na kɛ tɩn, yɩ a laan joori a ba. A jaanɩ sǝbu pɛɛra mʋ a ba sɩ a pa a tɩʋ kʋm yinigǝ tiinǝ, yɩ a daarɩ a jɩgɩ pɛɛra sɩ a ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: This is what I was doing when I was found going through a ceremony in the temple. I wasn't with a crowd, and there was no uproar.
translation_verse: A na wʋra a kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam ma ba ba na amʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ. Ba na nɛ-nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ amʋ maŋɩ a kwɛ a tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ a ti. Nɔn-kɔgɔ dɩ maa tǝri a tee nɩ. Vuvugǝ dɩ nan tǝrǝ.

english_verse: Some Jews from Asia were there at that time, and if they have anything to say against me, they should be here now.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zwifǝ badaara na nuŋi Azi tɩɩnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn dɛɛn mʋ tɔgɩ ba wʋra. Bantʋ ya na jɩgɩ woŋo dɩ amʋ, bantʋ mʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ ba ba ba zɩgɩ nmʋ yigǝ nɩ sɩ ba ta kʋlʋ a na cɔgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Or ask the ones who are here. They can tell you that they didn't find me guilty of anything when I was tried by their own council.
translation_verse: Ba nan na tǝrǝ tɩn, pa nɔɔna bantʋ na zɩgɩ yo seeni tɩn ta ba na nɛ kʋlʋ amʋ na kɩ a cɔgɩ, maŋa kalʋ a na zɩgɩ Zwifǝ sarɩya-dirǝ nakwa bam yigǝ nɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The only charge they can bring against me is what I shouted out in court, when I said, “I am on trial today because I believe that the dead will be raised to life!”
translation_verse: Ba wʋ nɛ kʋlʋ a na cɔgɩ tɩn, kʋ na daɩ woŋo dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ a taga. A na zɩgɩ ba wʋnɩ tɩn, a ya tagɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa a wɩ: ‹Abam zɩm nan jɩgɩ amʋ taanɩ mʋ á di, a na sɛ nɩ twa wʋ́ joori ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.› »

english_verse: Felix knew a lot about the Lord's Way. But he brought the trial to an end and said, “I will make my decision after Lysias the commander arrives.”
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, Felisi ma pa ba tiŋi taanɩ dɩm. Wʋm tɩtɩ dɛɛn maŋɩ o ye Wɛ cwǝ-dʋŋa kam cɩga na yɩ te tɩn. O ma ta o wɩ: «Pamaŋna bam dɩdɛɛrʋ Lizɩa na tuǝ, a laan wʋ́ di abam taanɩ dɩm a ti.»

english_verse: He then ordered the army officer to keep Paul under guard, but not to lock him up or to stop his friends from helping him. Paul Is Kept under Guard
translation_verse: O ma pa pamaŋna bam yigǝ tu wʋm ni sɩ o ja Pooli o vu o taa yɩr-o, sɩ o daarɩ o pa-o pwǝlǝ sɩ o cilonnǝ taa waɩ ba zǝn-o dɩ kʋlʋ o na lagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Several days later Felix and his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish, went to the place where Paul was kept under guard. They sent for Paul and listened while he spoke to them about having faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Da fɩnfɩɩn na kɛ tɩn, Felisi ma tɔgɩ dɩ o kaanɩ Drusili o ba. Wʋntʋ yɩ Zwifu mʋ. Felisi ma pa ba bǝŋi Pooli sɩ o ba. Ba ma cǝgi Pooli na wʋra o tɛ Zezi Krisi cwǝŋǝ kam na yɩ te yɩ nɔɔna kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn.

english_verse: But Felix was frightened when Paul started talking to them about doing right, about self-control, and about the coming judgment. So he said to Paul, “That's enough for now. You may go. But when I have time I will send for you.”
translation_verse: Pooli ma daarɩ o wʋra o tɛ kǝm-laarʋ tɔgɩm taanɩ, dɩ nɔɔna na maŋɩ sɩ ba ja ba tɩtɩ te tɩn. O ta ma ta o brɩ-ba Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ di nɔɔna sarɩya te tɩn. Pooli na wʋra o tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, fʋʋnɩ ma zʋ Felisi. O ma ta o wɩ: «Kʋ maŋɩ. Nan ve sɩ maŋa kalʋ a na lagɩ-m tɩn, a laan wʋ́ bǝŋi-m.»

english_verse: After this, Felix often sent for Paul and talked with him, because he hoped that Paul would offer him a bribe.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn ya bʋŋɩ nɩ Pooli wʋ́ ma sǝbu mʋ o loor-o sɩ o yag-o. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ o yǝni o bǝ-o maŋa maama o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩd-o.

english_verse: Two years later Porcius Festus became governor in place of Felix. But since Felix wanted to do the Jewish leaders a favor, he kept Paul in jail.
translation_verse: Bɩna yale ma ba ya yi. Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ ma ba o lǝni Felisi yuu nɩ sɩ o taa yɩ lʋgʋ kʋm tu. Wʋntʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Porisiu Fɛsitu. Felisi dɛɛn na lagɩ sɩ o pa Zwifǝ bam wʋ poli dɩd-o tɩn, o ma yagɩ Pooli pɩɩna digǝ kam nɩ tata.

english_verse: Three days after Festus had become governor, he went from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Fɛsitu dɛɛn na tu o ji lʋgʋ kʋm tu tɩn, kʋ da yatɔ dɛ nɩ mʋ o zaŋɩ Sezaarɩ nɩ o vu Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: There the chief priests and some Jewish leaders told him about their charges against Paul. They also asked Festus
translation_verse: O na ve o wʋra kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ bam ma vu o te ba saŋɩ Pooli.

english_verse: if he would be willing to bring Paul to Jerusalem. They begged him to do this because they were planning to attack and kill Paul on the way.
translation_verse: Ba ma loor-o sɩ o wǝli-ba o pa Pooli joori o ba Zeruzalɛm. Kʋ yɩ ba na kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba gʋ Pooli cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba loori Fɛsitu sɩ o kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: But Festus told them, “Paul will be kept in Caesarea, and I am soon going there myself.
translation_verse: O ma lǝri-ba o wɩ: «Pooli wʋ Sezaarɩ nɩ mʋ, yɩ ba jɩg-o ba yɩra. Kʋ nan bá daanɩ sɩ a tɩtɩ joori a vu da.

english_verse: If he has done anything wrong, let your leaders go with me and bring charges against him there.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ o kɩ woŋo mʋ o cɔgɩ, á pa á yigǝ tiinǝ bam tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ ba vu sɩ á laan saŋ-o dáanɩ.»

english_verse: Festus stayed in Jerusalem for eight or ten more days before going to Caesarea. Then the next day he took his place as judge and had Paul brought into court.
translation_verse: Fɛsitu na kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ da nana naa da fugǝ ba tɩʋ kʋm nɩ tɩn, o laan ma zaŋɩ o joori o vu Sezaarɩ. O na yi da yɩ tɩga pʋʋrɩ tɩn, o ma nuŋi o jǝni sɩ o di taanɩ dɩm. O ma pa ni sɩ ba ja Pooli ba ba.

english_verse: As soon as Paul came in, the leaders from Jerusalem crowded around him and said he was guilty of many serious crimes. But they could not prove anything.
translation_verse: Pooli na tu o ba o yi ba te tɩn, Zwifǝ balʋ na nuŋi Zeruzalɛm ba ba tɩn maa zɩgɩ ba gilim-o. Ba ma puli sɩ ba taa tɛ wo-lwaan-kamunnu zanzan ba pa-o, yɩ ba warɩ ba ta kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga.

english_verse: Then Paul spoke in his own defense, “I have not broken the Law of my people. And I have not done anything against either the temple or the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Pooli maa ŋɔɔnɩ o joŋi o tɩtɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ cɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm dɩ ba Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm cullu tɩm tɩn. A nan wʋ kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ Rom pa-farʋ wʋm yuu tɩn.»

english_verse: Festus wanted to please the leaders. So he asked Paul, “Are you willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried by me on these charges?”
translation_verse: Fɛsitu dɛɛn maa lagɩ sɩ o pa Zwifǝ bam wʋ poli dɩd-o. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ o ma bwe Pooli o wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋ́ sɛ sɩ n vu Zeruzalɛm sɩ a di nmʋ taanɩ dáanɩ na?»

english_verse: Paul replied, “I am on trial in the Emperor's court, and that's where I should be tried. You know very well I have not done anything to harm the Jewish nation.
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «A nan maŋɩ a zɩgɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ Rom pa-farʋ wʋm na pɛ-o ni sɩ o di dɩbam taanɩ tɩn yigǝ nɩ mʋ, kʋ yɩ Rom nɩ mʋ ba maŋɩ sɩ ba di a taanɩ dɩm. Kʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ bam, a wʋ cɔgɩ ba kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Nmʋ tɩtɩ nan maŋɩ n ye nɩ kʋntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: If I had done something deserving death, I would not ask to escape the death penalty. But I am not guilty of any of these crimes, and no one has the right to hand me over to these people. I now ask to be tried by the Emperor himself.”
translation_verse: A nan na kɩ a tusi yɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ a tɩ tɩn, a sɛ tʋʋnɩ. Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Zwifǝ bam nan na ŋɔɔnɩ ba pa amʋ tɩn na ba jɩgɩ cɩga, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o ja amʋ o kɩ ba jɩŋa nɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a laan lagɩ sɩ a vu Rom pa-farʋ wʋm tɩtɩ te mʋ, sɩ wʋntʋ di a taanɩ dɩm.»

english_verse: After Festus had talked this over with members of his council, he told Paul, “You have asked to be tried by the Emperor, and to the Emperor you will go!” Paul Speaks to Agrippa and Bernice
translation_verse: Fɛsitu na ni kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ o kwaga nɔɔna bam, yɩ o laan daarɩ o ta dɩ Pooli o wɩ: «Nmʋ na wɩ n lagɩ sɩ Rom pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ di n taanɩ dɩm tɩn, n nan wʋ́ vu dáanɩ mʋ.» Pooli na zɩgɩ Agripa dɩ Bɩrɩnisi yigǝ nɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn

english_verse: They had been there for several days, when Festus told the king about the charges against Paul. He said: Felix left a man here in jail,
translation_verse: Ba na kɩ da fɩnfɩɩn da tɩn, Fɛsitu ma ta taanɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ Pooli yuu nɩ tɩn o brɩ pɛ wʋm o wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ mʋ wʋ yo seeni Felisi na jaan-o o kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ yɩ o yag-o da.

english_verse: and when I went to Jerusalem, the chief priests and the Jewish leaders came and asked me to find him guilty.
translation_verse: A nan ve Zeruzalɛm yɩ Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ ba nakwa bam ta o taanɩ ba brɩ amʋ. Ba ma ta ba wɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ a di o taanɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o mʋ.

english_verse: I told them it isn't the Roman custom to hand a man over to people who are bringing charges against him. He must first have the chance to meet them face to face and to defend himself against their charges.
translation_verse: A ma ta dɩ ba a wɩ, dɩbam Rom tiinǝ ba jaanɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩ́ kɩ nɔɔna jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ o ta wʋ zɩgɩ balʋ na saŋ-o tɩn yigǝ nɩ sɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o joŋi o tɩtɩ dɩ ba na saŋ-o kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: So when they came here with me, I wasted no time. On the very next day I took my place on the judge's bench and ordered him to be brought in.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ ba ba yo seeni. A ma wʋ pɛ taanɩ dɩm dim daanɩ. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, a ma zaŋɩ a nuŋi sɩ a di taanɩ dɩm. A ma pa ni sɩ ba ja nɔɔnʋ wʋm ba ba.

english_verse: But when the men stood up to make their charges against him, they did not accuse him of any of the crimes that I thought they would.
translation_verse: Balʋ na saŋ-o tɩn ma zaŋɩ sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ. A ya maa bʋŋɩ nɩ ba lagɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ wo-lwaanʋ mʋ ba pa-o. Ba nan wʋ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Instead, they argued with him about some of their beliefs and about a dead man named Jesus, who Paul said was alive.
translation_verse: Ba na zaŋɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ kantɔgɔ bɩtarɩ mʋ ba tɩtɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ ma wǝli dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ na tɩga, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zezi, yɩ Pooli tɛ o wɩ, o ŋwɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Since I did not know how to find out the truth about all this, I asked Paul if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and be put on trial there.
translation_verse: A wʋbʋŋa ma vugimi dɩ a na wʋ́ kɩ te a di ba taanɩ dɩm tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a ma bwe Pooli, sɩ o na wʋ́ sɛ o vu Zeruzalɛm sɩ a di o taanɩ dɩm dáanɩ.

english_verse: But Paul asked to be kept in jail until the Emperor could decide his case. So I ordered him to be kept here until I could send him to the Emperor.
translation_verse: Pooli ma loori sɩ dɩ́ taá nii-o, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ yagɩ taanɩ dɩm sɩ dɩ́ yuutu Rom pa-farʋ wʋm tɩtɩ laan di o taanɩ dɩm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a ma pa ni sɩ ba taa yɩr-o, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ a na wʋ́ wanɩ a pa o vu pa-farʋ wʋm te tɩn.»

english_verse: Then Agrippa said to Festus, “I would also like to hear what this man has to say.” Festus answered, “You can hear him tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Fɛsitu na tagɩ kʋntʋ dɩd-o o ti tɩn, Agripa laan ma ta o wɩ, wʋm tɩtɩ wʋ́ ta lagɩ sɩ o ni nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ ni-taanɩ. Fɛsitu ma lǝr-o o wɩ: «Jwaanɩ mʋ, nmʋ wʋ́ ni o taanɩ dɩm.»

english_verse: The next day Agrippa and Bernice made a big show as they came into the meeting room. High ranking army officers and leading citizens of the town were also there. Festus then ordered Paul to be brought in
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, Agripa dɩ Bɩrɩnisi ma zaŋɩ ba kwɛ nɩnwaŋa lanyɩranɩ ba nuŋi. Pamaŋna bam dɩdɛɛra dɩdaanɩ tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ maa tɔgɩ ba kwaga, yɩ ba vu ba zʋ taanɩ dɩm dim jǝgǝ kam. Fɛsitu laan ma pa ni sɩ ba ja Pooli ba ba.

english_verse: I have not found him guilty of any crime deserving death. But because he has asked to be judged by the Emperor, I have decided to send him to Rome.
translation_verse: A nan wʋ nɛ o na kɩ kʋlʋ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ gʋ-o tɩn. O tɩtɩ nan na wɩ o lagɩ sɩ Rom pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ di o taanɩ tɩn, amʋ lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a pa o vu dáanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I have to write some facts about this man to the Emperor. So I have brought him before all of you, but especially before you, King Agrippa. After we have talked about his case, I will then have something to write.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a nan ba jɩgɩ o woŋo kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ kuri tɩn sɩ a pʋpʋnɩ a pa dɩbam yuutu wʋm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a pɛ o ba o zɩgɩ abam yigǝ nɩ sɩ á nii, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ nmʋ Pɛ Agripa yigǝ nɩ. Dɩ́ nan na bwe-o dɩ́ ti, kʋ waɩ kʋ paɩ a naɩ o woŋo kʋlʋ a na wʋ́ pʋpʋnɩ a pa pa-farʋ wʋm tɩn.

english_verse: It makes no sense to send a prisoner to the Emperor without stating the charges against him.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ a bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ bá ta jɩgɩ kuri sɩ a tʋŋɩ pɩɩnʋ sɩ o vu pa-farʋ wʋm te, yɩ a wʋ tagɩ o na jɩgɩ taanɩ woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: King Agrippa, I am glad for this chance to defend myself before you today on all these charges my own people have brought against me.
translation_verse: O maa wɩ: «Pɛ Agripa, a zɩm jɩgɩ wʋpolo, dɩ a na zɩgɩ nmʋ yigǝ nɩ sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ a joŋi a tɩtɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam na saŋɩ-nɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You know a lot about our religious customs and the beliefs that divide us. So I ask you to listen patiently to me.
translation_verse: Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ dɩ a na wɩ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ ye Zwifǝ bam mɩʋ dɩ ba kantɔgɔ na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a loori-m sɩ n kwaanɩ n cǝgi a taanɩ dɩm dɩ wʋ-zuru.

english_verse: All the Jews have known me since I was a child. They know what kind of life I have lived in my own country and in Jerusalem. And if they were willing, they could tell you I was a Pharisee, a member of a group that is stricter than any other.
translation_verse: Ba maa maŋɩ ba ye nɩ kʋ yɩ pulim nɩ mʋ a maŋɩ a tɔgɩ a wʋ Farizɩan bam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ yɩ a tɔgɩ a sɛ ba cullu tɩm, yɩ bantʋ cullu tɩm tiini tɩ damma tɩ dwe dɩbam Wɛ cullu tɩm maama. Ba na laga, ba ya wʋ́ wanɩ ba ta nɩ kʋntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: Day and night our twelve tribes have earnestly served God, waiting for his promised blessings. King Agrippa, because of this hope, some of our leaders have brought charges against me.
translation_verse: Dɩbam Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ maama tiini dɩ́ zuli Wɛ, yɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa-DƖ wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ dɩ́ na Wɛ na goni DƖ ni sɩ DƖ kɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ doŋ tɩn. Amʋ tu pɛ, a na jɩgɩ tɩɩna yam kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ pɛ Zwifǝ bam jɩgɩ dɩ amʋ.

english_verse: Why should any of you doubt that God raises the dead to life?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ abam warɩ sɩ á bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ bi twa DƖ pa ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ?

english_verse: I once thought that I should do everything I could to oppose Jesus from Nazareth.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ tɩtɩ dɩ, a dɛɛn bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ maama na wʋ́ ma cɔgɩ Zezi na yɩ Nazarɛtɩ tu tɩn yɩrɩ dɩm mʋ.

english_verse: I did this first in Jerusalem, and with the authority of the chief priests I put many of God's people in jail. I even voted for them to be killed.
translation_verse: Amʋ kɩ kʋntʋ maama Zeruzalɛm nɩ. Zwifǝ kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn mʋ pɛ-nɩ cwǝŋǝ, yɩ a jaanɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam a kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. Ba na yǝni ba gʋ-ba, amʋ yǝni a sɛ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ.

english_verse: I often had them punished in our synagogues, and I tried to make them give up their faith. In fact, I was so angry with them, that I went looking for them in foreign cities.
translation_verse: Kuni zanzan a yǝni a karɩ a ve Zwifǝ bam Wɛ-di sɩm maama, yɩ a jaanɩ-ba a pa ba na cam. A maa kwaanɩ a fɩ-ba sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ ba Yuutu wʋm. A banɩ na tiini dɩ zaŋɩ dɩ ba tɩn, a yǝni a tɔgɩ ba nɛ a ve tɩɩnɩ yigǝ yigǝ, yɩ a jaanɩ-ba a bɛɛsa.

english_verse: King Agrippa, one day I was on my way to Damascus with the authority and permission of the chief priests.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩdwɩ mʋ a zaŋɩ a maa ve Damasɩ sɩ a yaarɩ Zezi karabiǝ bam. Zwifǝ bam kaanɩm yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn pɛ-nɩ cwǝŋǝ dɩ dam sɩ a vu da a yaarɩ-ba.

english_verse: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice say to me in Aramaic, “Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me? It's foolish to fight against me!”
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama ma tʋ tɩga nɩ. A ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam taanɩ ka wɩ: ‹Sooli, Sooli, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n jɩgɩ amʋ n bɛɛsɩ kʋntʋ? Nmʋ kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ nabɩa na kwaanɩ sɩ ka ta wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ-ka o pa tɩn mʋ. Nmʋ wʋ́ joori n cɔgɩ n tɩtɩ mʋ.›

english_verse: “Who are you?” I asked. Then the Lord answered, “I am Jesus! I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: A ma bwe a wɩ: ‹A tu, nmʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ?› Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ma lǝri o wɩ: ‹Amʋ yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ nmʋ na jɩgɩ n bɛɛsɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Now stand up. I have appeared to you, because I have chosen you to be my servant. You are to tell others what you have learned about me and what I will show you later.”
translation_verse: Nan zaŋɩ n zɩgɩ wɛɛnɩ. A brɩ a tɩtɩ dɩ nmʋ sɩ a lɩ-m sɩ n ta n yɩ a tɩntʋŋnʋ mʋ dɩ a maana tu, sɩ n daarɩ n pa nɔɔna lwarɩ nmʋ zɩm na nɛ kʋlʋ amʋ tee nɩ dɩ kʋlʋ a na wʋ́ brɩ nmʋ tɩn.

english_verse: The Lord also said, “I will protect you from the Jews and from the Gentiles that I am sending you to.
translation_verse: Aá joŋi nmʋ Zwifǝ bam jɩŋa nɩ a yagɩ, dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam jɩŋa nɩ. A laan nan wʋ́ tʋŋɩ nmʋ sɩ n vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te,

english_verse: I want you to open their eyes, so they will turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God. Then their sins will be forgiven, and by faith in me they will become part of God's holy people.”
translation_verse: sɩ n puri ba yiǝ sɩ ba yagɩ lim, sɩ ba taa ŋwɩ pooni yigǝ nɩ. Nmʋ wʋ́ pa ba nuŋi sʋtaanɩ dam wʋnɩ n daarɩ n kɩ-ba Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ ba lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-ba sɩ ba na jǝŋǝ je DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ, ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.›

english_verse: First I preached to the people in Damascus, and then I went to Jerusalem and all over Judea. Finally, I went to the Gentiles and said, “Stop sinning and turn to God! Then prove what you have done by the way you live.”
translation_verse: A puli a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam a brɩ nɔɔna Damasɩ nɩ mʋ dɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ Zwifǝ bam tɩʋ kʋm maama nɩ, dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ tee nɩ. A brɩ-ba sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba pipiri ba taa tɔgɩ Wɛ, sɩ ba taa kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ brɩ nɩ ba sɩɩnɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: That is why some men grabbed me in the temple and tried to kill me.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Zwifǝ bam jaanɩ-nɩ maŋa kalʋ a na wʋ Wɛ-di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba gʋ-nɩ.

english_verse: But all this time God has helped me, and I have preached both to the rich and to the poor. I have told them only what the prophets and Moses said would happen.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ wǝli-nɩ yɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a zɩgɩ yo sɩ a ta cɩga a brɩ nɔɔna maama, kʋ na yɩ nɔn-kamunǝ naa nɔɔnʋ dɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩ. A na yǝni a tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɩ Moyisi tɩtɩ dɛɛn na tagɩ nɩ kʋlʋ wʋ́ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I told them how the Messiah would suffer and be the first to be raised from death, so he could bring light to his own people and to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kʋ tagɩ kʋ wɩ, nɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o na yaara, sɩ o ji wʋlʋ na wʋ́ da yigǝ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ o daarɩ o pa Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ na pooni, sɩ Wɛ vrɩ-ba ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Before Paul finished defending himself, Festus shouted, “Paul, you're crazy! Too much learning has driven you out of your mind.”
translation_verse: Pooli na wʋra o ŋɔɔnɩ sɩ o ma joŋi o tɩtɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Fɛsitu ma zaŋɩ o ta dɩ kwǝr-dɩa o wɩ: «Pooli, nmʋ co mʋ! Nmʋ na tiini n zaasɩ tɔnɔ zanzan kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ pɛ n wʋbʋŋa tǝrǝ.»

english_verse: But Paul replied, “Honorable Festus, I am not crazy. What I am saying is true, and it makes sense.
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝri o wɩ: «Dɩbam tu Fɛsitu, kʋ daɩ nɩ a wʋbʋŋa mʋ tǝrǝ. A na zɩgɩ a tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ, yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ kuri lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: None of these things happened off in a corner somewhere. I am sure that King Agrippa knows what I am talking about. That's why I can speak so plainly to him.”
translation_verse: Pɛ Agripa maŋɩ o ye wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ ni nɩ. Aá wanɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ a taanɩ dɩd-o jaja. A ye nɩ a na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn daɩ wo-dʋŋʋ dɩd-o, bɛŋwaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ wʋ sǝgi tɩ kɩ gugoro nɩ.

english_verse: Then Paul said to Agrippa, “Do you believe what the prophets said? I know you do.”
translation_verse: Pɛ Agripa, nmʋ sɛ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn na? Amʋ ye nɩ n sɛ.»

english_verse: Agrippa asked Paul, “In such a short time do you think you can talk me into being a Christian?”
translation_verse: Agripa ma ta dɩ Pooli o wɩ: «Kʋ gɛ fɩnfɩɩn sɩ n taanɩ dɩm pa amʋ ji Zezi Krisi bu.»

english_verse: Paul answered, “Whether it takes a short time or a long time, I wish you and everyone else who hears me today would become just like me! Except, of course, for these chains.”
translation_verse: Pooli ma lǝri o wɩ: «Kʋ na gɛ fɩnfɩɩn naa kʋ na daanɩ dɩ, a loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa nmʋ dɩ balʋ maama zɩm na je ba cǝgi a taanɩ dɩm tɩn dɩ ji nɩ amʋ na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋ na daɩ capʋnnʋ tɩm yɩranɩ mʋ a ba lagɩ sɩ ba ma vɔ abam dɩ.»

english_verse: Then King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and everyone who was with them got up.
translation_verse: Pɛ wʋm dɩ gʋvɩrma tu Fɛsitu dɩ Bɩrɩnisi dɩ balʋ maama na wʋra tɩn laan ma zaŋɩ ba nuŋi.

english_verse: But before they left, they said, “This man isn't guilty of anything. He doesn't deserve to die or to be put in jail.”
translation_verse: Ba na nuŋi tɩn, ba maa ŋɔɔnɩ daanɩ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ wʋ kɩ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o naa sɩ ba kɩ-o pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Agrippa told Festus, “Paul could have been set free, if he had not asked to be tried by the Roman Emperor.”
translation_verse: Agripa ma ta dɩ Fɛsitu o wɩ: «Dɩ́ ya wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ dɩ́ yagɩ, kʋ na daɩ o tɩtɩ na wɩ o lagɩ sɩ pa-farʋ wʋm mʋ di o taanɩ dɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: When it was time for us to sail to Rome, Captain Julius from the Emperor's special troops was put in charge of Paul and the other prisoners.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn laan na lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ ba pa dɩ́ zʋ naboro dɩ́ vu Yitali tɩn, ba ma ja Pooli dɩ pɩɩna badonnǝ ba kɩ pamaŋna yigǝ tu wʋdoŋ jɩŋa nɩ, o yɩrɩ mʋ Zuliyusi. O nuŋi pa-farʋ wʋm pamaŋna bam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We went aboard a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail to some ports along the coast of Asia. Aristarchus from Thessalonica in Macedonia sailed on the ship with us.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma na naboro, kʋ nuŋi Adramiti yɩ kʋ lagɩ kʋ vu tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ Azi nɩnɩʋ kʋm ni nɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ zʋ kʋ wʋ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ kɛ. Arisarɩkɩ dɩ ma tɔgɩ dɩbam o kɛ. Wʋntʋ nuŋi Masɩdʋanɩ tɩʋ kʋdoŋ mʋ, kʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Tesaloniki tɩn.

english_verse: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ yi Sidɔn. Zuliyusi ma duri Pooli ŋwaŋa, yɩ o pa-o cwǝŋǝ sɩ o vu o badonnǝ te, sɩ ba kɩ kʋlʋ o na lagɩ tɩn ba pa-o.

english_verse: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma zaŋɩ dɩ́ nuŋi dáanɩ dɩ́ zʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ. Vu-dɩʋ maa jeeri dɩbam kʋ maga. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ma dalɩ Sipri tɩʋ buburu kʋm yɩra dɩ́ kɛ.

english_verse: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma daarɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ da Silisi dɩ Pamfili te dɩ́ kɛ. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ yi Liizi tɩʋ kʋdoŋ, kʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Miira.

english_verse: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na yi da tɩn, pamaŋna yigǝ tu wʋm ma na naboro kʋdoŋ kʋ na nuŋi Alɛsandrɩ kʋ maa ve Yitali. O ma pa dɩ́ zʋ kʋ wʋ.

english_verse: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ maa wʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ dɩ́ ve fɩɩn fɩɩn yɩ dɩ́ kɩ da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ, kʋ na tiini kʋ camma tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ yi Kinidi na batwarɩ mɛ tɩn. Viu kʋm na jeeri dɩbam kʋ magɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ daa ma warɩ dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ yigǝ dɩ́ vu. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ma vu dɩ́ dalɩ Krɛtɩ buburu kʋm yɩra dɩ́ kɛ dɩ́ da Salɩmɔnɩ je sɩm.

english_verse: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ dalɩ buburu kʋm yɩra yɩ dɩ́ na cam zanzan, yɩ dɩ́ laan vu dɩ́ yi jǝgǝ kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Nabwǝǝru Zɩgɩm Je-ŋʋŋa tɩn. Laazɩ tɩʋ kʋm batwarɩ dɩ jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ma tiini dɩ́ daanɩ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ. Kʋ ma ba kʋ yi maŋa kam kʋ na damma sɩ nɔɔna ja naboro ba zʋ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ tɩn. Zwifǝ bam ni-vɔɔm dɛ dɩm maŋɩ dɩ kɛ yɩ kʋ daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ bɩnɩ dɩm ti. Pooli ma kaanɩ-ba o wɩ:

english_verse: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, “Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.”
translation_verse: «A badonnǝ-ba, a na nɛ kʋlʋ tɩn, dɩ́ na zaŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ daa kɛ, dɩ́ wʋ́ na yaara zanzan. Dɩ́ wǝǝnu tɩm maama lagɩ tɩ cɔgɩ mʋ. Kʋ daɩ naboro kʋm dɩ kʋ zɩla yam yɩranɩ má, kʋ waɩ sɩ dɩbam tɩtɩ dɩ ga dɩ́ ŋwɩa.»

english_verse: The harbor at Fair Havens wasn't a good place to spend the winter. Because of this, almost everyone agreed that we should at least try to sail along the coast of Crete as far as Phoenix.
