It had a harbor that opened toward the southwest and northwest, and we could spend the winter there. The Storm at Sea
translation_verse: Nabwǝǝru gugoro kʋm mɛ ba na wʋra tɩn ba lana sɩ ba taa tigi da, sɩ vu-dɩʋ kʋm maŋa kam ba ka kɛ. Nɔɔna bam zanzan ma lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ ba zaŋɩ ba kɛ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ, sɩ ba kwaanɩ ba nii baá wanɩ ba yi Feniki na. Feniki wʋ Krɛtɩ nɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ nabwǝǝru gugoro kʋlʋ kwaga na yagɩ viu kʋm tɩn. Ba na yi dáanɩ, baá wanɩ ba taa tigi da sɩ viu kʋm maŋa kɛ. Vu-fɔrɔ na jaanɩ-ba na baŋa nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: When a gentle wind from the south started blowing, the men thought it was a good time to do what they had planned. So they pulled up the anchor, and we sailed along the coast of Crete.
translation_verse: Viu laan ma zaŋɩ jagwiǝ baŋa nɩ kʋ fulǝ. Nɔɔna bam maa bʋŋɩ nɩ baá wanɩ ba na cwǝŋǝ ba kɩ kʋlʋ ba na bʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ. Ba ma ti ba yigǝ sɩ ba kwe naboro kʋm ba kɛ. Ba maa dalɩ Krɛtɩ buburu kʋm yɩra ba maa kɛa.

english_verse: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.
translation_verse: Viu kʋm na tiini kʋ magɩ dɩbam kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ daa ma warɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa naboro kʋm yɔɔrɩ viu kʋm na nuŋi mɛ tɩn. Dɩ́ na kwaanɩ dɩ́ ga tɩn, dɩ́ ma yagɩ naboro kʋm dɩ́ pa viu kʋm.

english_verse: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.
translation_verse: Ba na pɛ kʋ zʋ naboro kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, ba ma kwe ŋʋnɩ ba pa sɩ tɔgɩ naboro kamunu kʋm kuri yɩ ba vɔ kʋ maama. Ba maa kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ nɩ kʋʋ́ ja-ba kʋ vu na-kʋla je sɩlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Siriti tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba ma kwaanɩ ba cǝŋi naboro kʋm ba pa kʋ daa ba tiini kʋ durǝ, yɩ ba yagɩ-kʋ ba pa viu kʋm.

english_verse: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.
translation_verse: Tɩga daa na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, ba tɩtɩ ma ma ba jɩa ba lɩ naboro kʋm yɩra wǝǝnu ba dɩ na bam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn yɩ da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ mʋ dɩbam na wʋ nɛ wɩa dɩ calɩcwɩ. Vu-dɩʋ kʋm daa ta maa tiini kʋ magɩ dɩbam yɩ kʋ ba yaga. Dɩbam daa ba tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ wǝri.

english_verse: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maa na ve taan yɩ ba ba di wʋdiu tɩn, Pooli ma zaŋɩ o zɩgɩ ba wʋnɩ o ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A badonnǝ-ba, abam ya na sɛ a ni yɩ dɩ́ wʋ zaŋɩ dɩ́ yagɩ Krɛtɩ, dɩ́ ya bá na cɔgɩm dɩ yaara yantʋ doŋ.

english_verse: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.
translation_verse: A laan nan loori abam sɩ á taá jɩgɩ pu-dɩa. Amʋ ye sɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ bá ga o ŋwɩa, kʋ yɩ naboro kʋm yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ́ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ diin tɩtɩɩ nɩ mʋ, Wɛ dɩlʋ na te amʋ yɩ a yɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn tʋŋɩ DƖ malɛka amʋ tee nɩ.

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: Ka ma ta ka wɩ: ‹Pooli, yɩ ta n kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n vu n zɩgɩ pa-farʋ wʋm yigǝ nɩ mʋ. Wɛ yɩ ŋwaŋa tu, yɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ ba wʋ naboro kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn dɩ na ŋwɩa.›

english_verse: Cheer up! I am sure that God will do exactly what he promised.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a badonnǝ-ba, á taá jɩgɩ-na pu-dɩa. A jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Wɛ, nɩ malɛka kam na tagɩ kʋlʋ ka brɩ-nɩ tɩn wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ.

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Ba ma go ŋʋnɩ sɩlʋ na lǝgi naboro kʋm zɩgɩm luguru tɩm tɩn ba yagɩ na bam wʋnɩ. Ba ma daarɩ ba bwǝli ŋʋnɩ sɩlʋ na vɔgɩ naboro kʋm naywi sɩm tɩn, sɩ ba taa paɩ kʋ ve nɩ ba na lagɩ te tɩn. Ba laan ma kwe naboro gɔrɔ ba lǝ naboro kʋm yigǝ nɩ sɩ viu kʋm taa magɩ-kʋ, sɩ naboro kʋm wanɩ kʋ bɛ.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Naboro kʋm coonǝ bam ma bʋŋɩ sɩ ba lu sɩ ba daarɩ naboro kʋm. Ba ma lɩ naboro balaŋa kam ba dɩ na bam wʋnɩ, yɩ ba kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba lagɩ ba vu ba lɩ naboro kʋm yigǝ luguru tɩm mʋ sɩ ba ma zɩgɩ-kʋ te.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Ba maa kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ viu kʋm wʋ́ magɩ naboro kʋm, kʋ ja vu kʋ magɩ dɩ pweeru. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba ma lɩ naboro kʋm zɩgɩm luguru tɩna kʋ kwaga nɩ ba dɩ na bam wʋnɩ sɩ kʋ ma zɩgɩ. Ba ma daarɩ ba loori Wɛ sɩ tɩga pʋʋrɩ lɩla.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Pooli na lwarɩ ba na bʋŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ te tɩn, o ma ta dɩ pamaŋna yigǝ tu wʋm dɩ o nɔɔna bam o wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ na nuŋi ba daarɩ naboro kʋm, abam daa bá wanɩ á lu.»

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, pamaŋna bam ma go ŋʋnɩ sɩlʋ ba na mɛ ba lǝ boro balaŋa kam tɩn ba dɩ-ka ba yagɩ.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: A nan loori abam sɩ á zaŋɩ á di wʋdiu. Á na wʋ kɩ kʋntʋ, á bá wǝri. Á taá ye nɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ bá lagɩ á yuuyuǝ tɩtɩ dɩ á ga.»

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ o ti tɩn, o ma kwe dɩpɛ o zɩgɩ ba maama yigǝ nɩ o kɩ Wɛ le, yɩ o daarɩ o fɔ-dɩ o wʋra o di.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma pa ba maama pu-dɩa yɩ ba dɩ di wʋdiu.

english_verse: people on the ship,
translation_verse: ) naboro kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Ba maama na di ba zaŋɩ tɩn, ba ma lɩ mɩna ywǝǝlu tɩm naboro kʋm wʋnɩ ba dɩ na bam wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ daa yɩ ta dunǝ.

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Tɩga laan na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, nɔɔna bam maa yǝri buburu kʋlʋ ni nɩ ba na wʋra tɩn. Ba ma nii ba na gugoro na na ve ba tigi da tɩn. Ba maa bʋŋɩ sɩ ba nii ba na wʋ́ wanɩ ba pa naboro kʋm tɔgɩ dáanɩ kʋ bɛ.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Naboro kʋm ma vu kʋ yi na-kʋla jǝgǝ kʋ cǝŋi da. Kʋ yigǝ kam maa mʋʋrɩ kasʋla wʋnɩ, yɩ ka daa warɩ ka lɩ. Kʋ daarɩ na bam maa tiini ba pɔgɩla, yɩ ba magɩ naboro kʋm kwaga kam ba pa ka wʋra ka cɔga.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Pamaŋna bam dɛɛn ma kɩ ni daanɩ sɩ ba ja pɩɩna bam ba gʋ, sɩ ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o dɩn na bam o vrɩ o tɩtɩ ba jɩa nɩ.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Ba yigǝ tu wʋm maa lagɩ sɩ o vrɩ Pooli ŋwɩa o yagɩ. O ma cɩ-ba sɩ ba yɩ kɩ kʋlʋ ba na bʋŋɩ tɩn. O ma daarɩ o pa ni, sɩ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ ba dɩn ba nuŋi tɩn da yigǝ ba faŋɩ ba cu na bam wʋnɩ sɩ ba dɩn ba bɛ,

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: sɩ balʋ na daarɩ tɩn kwe naboro kʋm da-dɩdwaarʋ tɩm naa kʋ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na bwǝri tɩn ba ma dɩn ba bɛ. Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩbam maama kɩ dɩ́ ma joŋi dɩ́ tɩtɩ.

english_verse: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na lugi yɩ dɩ́ bɛ bubɛ dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, mʋ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ bubɛ dɩm kʋntʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Malɩtɩ.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na zʋʋrɩ dáanɩ tɩn maa ja dɩbam ŋwaŋa zanzan. Dʋa maa sɩŋɩ ka wʋra ka nɩa, ka pa waarʋ wʋra. Ba ma dwe mini ba pa dɩbam maama sɩ dɩ́ weeri.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pooli ma puuri dɛ o wʋra o kɩ mini dɩm wʋnɩ. Mini dɩm wulim ma pa bɩsankwɩa nuŋi dɛ sɩm wʋnɩ ka karɩ Pooli jɩŋa ka lǝgi da.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm tiinǝ bam na nɛ bɩsankwɩa kam na lǝgi Pooli jɩŋa kam nɩ tɩn, ba maa tɛ daanɩ ba wɩ: «Kǝm dɩntʋ brɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ yɩ nɔn-gʋrʋ mʋ. Dɩ o na lugi nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn dɩ, kʋ ta wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ. Wɛ wʋ sɛ sɩ o wǝri.»

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Pooli ma mi bɩsankwɩa kam o dɩ mini dɩm wʋnɩ, yɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ wʋ kɩ-o.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maa bʋŋɩ nɩ, o yɩra ga wʋ́ fʋlɩ mʋ naa oó da o tʋ tɩga nɩ mʋ o tɩ. Ba na cǝgi kʋntʋ taan tɩn, ba ma wʋ nɛ nɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ kɩ-o. Ba ma lǝni ba wʋbʋŋa yɩ ba daarɩ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ yɩ wɛ dɩdoŋ mʋ!»

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ seeni nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ kara batwarɩ da. Nɔɔnʋ wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Pubilu. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ dɩdɛɛrʋ. O ma joŋi dɩbam lanyɩranɩ o sɔŋɔ nɩ. Dɩ́ ma kɩ da yatɔ da.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: O ko maa tigi o ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ. Paa dɩ wʋ-zuru mʋ jɩg-o. Pooli ma zʋ o digǝ kam sɩ o na-o. O ma daŋɩ o jɩa o baŋa nɩ o loori Wɛ o pa-o, yɩ o yawɩʋ kʋm je.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: O na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, tɩʋ kʋm tiinǝ balʋ maama na ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ tɩn maa tui o te, yɩ ba na yazurǝ.

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ dɛɛn kɩ canɩ sɩtɔ mʋ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nɩ, yɩ dɩ́ laan na naboro kʋdoŋ kʋlʋ ba na ma bǝ nɩ Wa-yiywa tɩn. Kʋ dɛɛn nuŋi Alɛsandrɩ mʋ kʋ ba kʋ zɩgɩ bubɛ dɩm kʋntʋ ni nɩ taan, yɩ vu-dɩʋ kʋm maŋa kɛ. Dɩ́ dɛɛn ma zʋ kʋ wʋ sɩ dɩ́ kɛ.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Sirakusi. Dɩ́ ma pǝni da da yatɔ.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma zaŋɩ dáanɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Rɩgiu. Tɩga na pʋʋrɩ tɩn, viu ma daa zaŋɩ dɩ́ kwaga nɩ kʋ sɩŋɩ kʋ maga. Dɩ́ ma kɩ da yale, yɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi Pusoli dɩ́ zɩgɩ da.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma nuŋi naboro kʋm wʋnɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ Zezi karabiǝ badonnǝ. Ba ma loori dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ kɩ da yarpɛ ba tee nɩ. Dɩ́ ma kɩ da yarpɛ dáanɩ, yɩ dɩ́ laan vu dɩ́ yi Rom.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ balʋ na wʋ Rom nɩ tɩn ma ni dɩbam ŋwa. Ba ma zaŋɩ Rom nɩ sɩ ba nuŋi ba jeeri dɩbam cwǝŋǝ nɩ. Ba dɛɛn tu ba yi Apiusi yaga kam na wʋ mɛ tɩn, yɩ badaara dɩ dɛɛn ba jǝgǝ kalʋ ba na bǝ nɩ Vǝrǝ Di Sɩtɔ tɩn, sɩ ba jeeri dɩbam. Pooli na nɛ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma kɩ Wɛ le yɩ kʋ pa-o baarɩ.

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na ve dɩ́ yi Rom kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma pa Pooli cwǝŋǝ sɩ o taa zʋʋrɩ o na lagɩ mɛ tɩn, yɩ ba pa pamaŋnʋ tɔgɩ o yɩr-o. Pooli na brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam Rom nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ na kɛ tɩn, Pooli ma bǝŋi tɩʋ kʋm Zwifǝ bam yigǝ tiinǝ sɩ ba jeeri daanɩ. Ba na tu tɩn, Pooli ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «A ko-biǝ-ba, a wʋ kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ a cɔgɩ dɩbam nɔɔna bam wʋ, naa a cɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ dɩbam nabaara na tiŋi ba pa dɩbam tɩn. Dɩ kʋ dɩ, ba jaanɩ amʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ mʋ ba kɩ Rom tiinǝ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ ba pɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn ma bwe-nɩ taanɩ sɩ ba nii a na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba ma wʋ nɛ a na kɩ kʋlʋ a cɔgɩ sɩ kʋ pa ba gʋ-nɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba ya maa lagɩ sɩ ba yagɩ-nɩ.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ bam ma wʋ sɛ kʋntʋ. Mʋ kʋ kuri kʋ dɛɛn yɩ fɩfɩʋn sɩ a ta sɩ Rom pa-farʋ wʋm tɩtɩ di a taanɩ dɩm. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ amʋ ga jɩgɩ taanɩ mʋ dɩ a tɩtɩ dwi tiinǝ bam.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a bǝŋi abam sɩ á ba, sɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ daanɩ dɩ́ nii. Ba na vɔgɩ amʋ dɩ capʋnnʋ tɩm tɩn, kʋ yɩ a na sɛ wʋlʋ wʋm Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na jɩgɩ o tɩɩna tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Pooli na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ta dɩd-o ba wɩ: «Dɩbam nan wʋ joŋi tɔnɔ Zude tiinǝ bam tee nɩ ba na pʋpʋnɩ ba ta nmʋ taanɩ tɩn. Dɩbam ta wʋ nɛ dɩ́ ko-bu wʋlʋ na nuŋi da o ba o ta nmʋ taanɩ o brɩ dɩbam, naa o ta wo-balɔrɔ o pa nmʋ.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan wʋ́ ta lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nmʋ na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ n wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ, nmʋ na tɔgɩ cwǝ-dʋŋa kalʋ tɩn, nɔɔna yǝni ba ŋɔɔna ba yáalɩ-ka je maama.»

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma lagɩ dɛ ba pa Pooli sɩ ba jeeri daanɩ. Dɛ dɩm na yi tɩn, nɔɔna zanzan ma ba jǝgǝ kalʋ Pooli na zʋʋrɩ da tɩn. Ba na tu tɩn, o ma tiini o ŋɔɔnɩ taan o brɩ-ba, kʋ zɩgɩ zɩzɩŋa nɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dɩdaan-ni. O ma ta Wɛ paarɩ dɩm na yɩ te tɩn o brɩ-ba. O ma ma Wɛ cɩga kalʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Moyisi cullu tɔnɔ kʋm dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam twaanʋ tɩm wʋnɩ tɩn o brɩ-ba, yɩ o kwaanɩ sɩ o pa ba sɛ cɩga kalʋ o na tɛ Zezi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: O na brɩ-ba kʋntʋ tɩn, badaara ma sɛ o taanɩ dɩm. Badaara dɩ ma wʋ sɛ.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋɩ sɩ ba viiri, yɩ ba magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ dɩ Pooli na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Ba ta na wʋ viiri tɩn, mʋ Pooli tagɩ taanɩ dɩdoŋ o wǝli da o wɩ: «Wɛ Joro kʋm dɛɛn tɔgɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu Ezayi kwǝrǝ mʋ kʋ ta cɩga dɩ abam nabaara bam kʋ wɩ:

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Ve a nɔɔna bam te sɩ n ta dɩ ba nɩ: Abam wʋ́ fɔgɩ á cǝgi Wɛ taanɩ dɩm dɩ á zwa, yɩ á bá ni dɩ kuri. Abam wʋ́ fɔgɩ á nii dɩ á yiǝ, yɩ á bá na.

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ wʋbʋŋa tɩgɩ mʋ. Ba zwa dɩ ma kwarɩmɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pu ba yiǝ, sɩ ba yiǝ yɩ zaŋɩ ya na, sɩ ba zwa yɩ zaŋɩ ya ni, sɩ ba wʋbʋŋa yɩ zaŋɩ ya lwarɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm kuri. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, ba ya wʋ́ pipiri ba sɛ amʋ Wɛ yɩ a pa-ba yazurǝ.»

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: O na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam ma nuŋi o tee nɩ. Ba na maa viiri tɩn, ba ma tiini ba magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ.]

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: O maa yǝni o brɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm cɩga kam, yɩ o tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi kwǝrǝ. O dɛɛn ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ baarɩ mʋ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ cɩgɩ o yigǝ.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ na yɩ Zezi Krisi gamba-sono tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ. Wɛ mʋ kuri-nɩ sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ, sɩ a taa tɔɔlɩ o kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: DƖ kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ nan yɩ DƖ Bu wʋm taanɩ mʋ, wʋlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩn. Wʋntʋ na jigi nabiinu tɩn, ba lʋg-o Pɛ Davididwi tiinǝ bam wʋnɩ mʋ. Wɛ Jorokʋm nan wʋ o tee nɩ dɩ dam, yɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ o yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ Bu mʋ maŋa kalʋ o na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ kɩ dɩbam yu-yoŋo lanyɩranɩ, yɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna sɩ dɩ́ vu dwi maama tiinǝ te dɩ́ pa ba sɛ o kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, sɩ ba daarɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, yɩ kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa Zezi Krisi na zulǝ.

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Abam dɩ tɔgɩ á yɩ balʋ Wɛ na kuri sɩ á taá yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: A pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam balʋ na wʋ Rom nɩ yɩ Wɛ soe abam yɩ DƖ kuri abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn mʋ. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Pooli bʋŋɩ sɩ o vu o na Rom tiinǝ bam

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ woŋo yɩ, amʋ lagɩ a tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kɩ a Yuutu Wɛ le abam maama ŋwaanɩ, dɩ nɔɔna na tɛ abam taanɩ je maama nɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Amʋ yǝni a loori Wɛ abam ŋwaanɩ maŋa maama, yɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ a na tʋŋɩ a paɩ dɩ a wʋ maama dɩ a na tɔɔlɩ DƖ Bu Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn ye nɩ amʋ tɛ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: A ta yǝni a loori-DƖ sɩ DƖ pa-nɩ cwǝŋǝ, sɩ a laan wanɩ a ba abam te.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Abam fra tiini ya jɩgɩ amʋ. A lagɩ sɩ a na abam, sɩ Wɛ Jorokʋm laan wanɩ kʋ tɔgɩ amʋ kʋ zǝni abam dɩ Wɛ-pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa á zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: A na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ na baarɩ da-tee nɩ, dɩbam maama na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á taá ye nɩ a kwaanɩ kuni zanzan mʋ sɩ a na nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ba a na abam, yɩ a daa ta wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ dɩ zɩm maama. A lagɩ sɩ a ba sɩ a wanɩ a tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ ja kuri tɩn mʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, nɩ a na maŋɩ a kɩ te dwi tiinǝ badonnǝ dɩ tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ tiini a lagɩ sɩ a ba a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam a brɩ abam balʋ na wʋ Rom nɩ tɩn dɩ. Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na jɩgɩ dam te tɩn

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amʋ ba kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ a brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ jɩgɩ dam, yɩ Wɛ ma-dɩ DƖ vrɩ nɔɔna balʋ maama na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn, kʋ puli dɩ Zwifǝbam mʋ, yɩ kʋ laan ba kʋ wǝli dwi-gɛtiinǝ dɩ da.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam mʋ brɩ nɔɔna DƖ na wʋ́ pa ba na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ te tɩn. Kʋ maama nan zɩgɩ ba na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm maŋɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ: «Wʋlʋ maama na jɩgɩ cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn, oó na ŋwɩa cɩga cɩga.» Nabiinǝ maama na gɛ bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ nan brɩ nɔɔna DƖ banɩ na zaŋɩ dɩ ba ba lwarɩm dɩ ba kǝm-lwaanʋ tɩm maama ŋwaanɩ. Ba na kɩ wo-lwaanʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pa ba yǝni ba cɩ cɩga kam nɔɔna tee nɩ.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan vaŋɩ ba zwa, bɛŋwaanɩ DƖ maŋɩ DƖ pa nɔɔna cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba lwarɩ DƖ cɩga kam. Wɛ tɩtɩ brɩ-ba DƖ cɩga kam jaja yɩ ba wʋ sɛ.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba maŋɩ ba ye Wɛ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ ba nan ba zuli-DƖ nɩ ba Wɛ, naa ba taa kɩ-DƖ le. Kʋ maa pa ba wʋbʋŋa tɩ, yɩ ba bɩcara yam laan yɩ lim, yɩ ba yǝri woŋo kʋlʋ na lana tɩn.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Ba maa paɩ ba jɩgɩ swan mʋ, yɩ ba laan yɩ jwǝǝru.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Ba ba sɛ sɩ ba taa zuli Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba zuli wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba tɩtɩ na mɔɔnɩ dɩ ba jɩa tɩn. Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ mʋ nyɩ dɩ nabiinǝ balʋ na tʋ tɩn, dɩ zunǝ dɩ vara dɩ tɩga wo-vǝǝlu.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ yagɩ-ba, sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ ba tɩtɩ fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn. Ba maa yǝni ba kɩ wo-digiru, yɩ ba tɔgɩ boorim kikiǝ yalʋ na yɩ ba cavɩɩra tɩn.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ yagɩ-ba, yɩ ba kɩ wo-digiru kikiǝ yalʋ ba fra na zʋʋrɩ yɩ ya jɩgɩ cavɩɩra tɩn. Kaana ma yǝni ba yagɩ ba banna, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tigi dɩ ba donnǝ kaana, nɩ baarʋ dɩ o kaanɩ na tigi daanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ baara dɩ. Ba dɩ ba lagɩ kaana, yɩ ba daarɩ ba paɩ ba fra zʋʋrɩ ba donnǝ baara ba ma tigi dɩ ba, yɩ kʋ ya wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kɩ kʋntʋ. Baara yǝni ba kɩ cavɩɩra kǝnǝ yantʋ doŋ mʋ daanɩ, yɩ kʋ pa ba na cam dɩlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ ba lwarɩm kikiǝ yam tɩn.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ nan bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ cɩga kam ba jɩgɩ kuri mʋ sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ-ka ba wʋbʋŋa nɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ yagɩ-ba, sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ ba wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ tɩm kwaga, yɩ ba kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba ya na wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Ba wʋbʋŋa maa su dɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ na ba tɔgɩ cɩga kam cwǝŋǝ tɩn, dɩ kǝm-lwaanʋ dwi maama. Ba yi maa zʋ wǝǝnu zanzan. Ba tiini ba jɩgɩ pu-sɩŋa, yɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ. Ba ma lagɩ nɔɔna gʋm, yɩ ba kwǝri ba jaanɩ daanɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba ganɩ ba donnǝ. Ba maa bʋŋɩ wo-balwaarʋ ba paɩ ba donnǝ, yɩ ba yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna.

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: Ba maa ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ ba donnǝ yum. Ba maa culi Wɛ, yɩ ba twɩ ba donnǝ. Ba ta kwǝri ba yɩ banɩ-nyɩna, yɩ ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ nɔɔna yigǝ nɩ. Ba ta ma tiini ba bʋŋɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ wʋbʋŋa, yɩ ba ba nɩgɩ ba tiinǝ balʋ na lʋgɩ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: Ba yǝri kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ tɩn. Ba maa jɩgɩ niǝ yale yale. Ba ma ba soe ba donnǝ, yɩ ba ba jɩgɩ ba ŋwaŋa dɩ.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Ba nan maŋɩ ba ye Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam na brɩ kʋlʋ, nɩ balʋ na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩntʋ doŋ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba tɩ mʋ. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, ba ta yǝni ba kɩ-tɩ mʋ, yɩ ba tɛ dɩ balʋ na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn dɩ, nɩ kʋ lana.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋlʋ na co n donnǝ tɩn, kʋ yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ mʋ n coǝ, bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ dɩ kɩ wo-lwaanʋ tɩm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, n bá wanɩ n na bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ di nɔɔna balʋ na kɩ wo-lwaanʋ tɩm kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn taanɩ dɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋlʋ na co n donnǝ kikiǝ yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ dɩ kɩ-ya mʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ nmʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ nń wanɩ n lu Wɛ sarɩya yam wʋnɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Wɛ nan tiini DƖ jɩgɩ nɔɔna ŋwaŋa dɩ ban-pʋnʋ dɩ wʋ-zuru. Nmʋ nan paɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ yɩ kafɛ mʋ na? Ta n ye nɩ, Wɛ na jɩgɩ nmʋ ŋwaŋa tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ pa nmʋ wanɩ n lǝni n wʋ mʋ n yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ.

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan tiini n kʋ n bɩcarɩ mʋ yɩ n vɩn sɩ n lǝni n wʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa n cam dɩm tiini dɩ puli dɛ dɩm Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ brɩ DƖ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ di nabiinǝ sarɩya dɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Wɛ laan wʋ́ pa nɔɔnʋ maama na o nyɩm sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ o tɩtʋŋa yam na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara yǝni ba vɔ ba wʋrʋ mʋ yɩ ba kɩ wo-laarʋ, sɩ kʋ pa ba na paarɩ dɩ zulǝ dɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba cɔgɩ tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ nan wʋ́ pa bantʋ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara nan wʋra ba na lagɩ bam tɩtɩ yɩranɩ zǝnǝ mʋ. Ba maa vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tɔgɩ wo-balwaarʋ kǝnǝ. Wɛ cam dɩm dɩ DƖ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm nan wʋ́ ba bantʋ baŋa.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nabiinǝ balʋ maama na kɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩn wʋ́ na yaara dɩ cam, kʋ na puli dɩ Zwifǝ bam, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, balʋ maama na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa-ba paarɩ dɩ zulǝ dɩ ywǝǝni, kʋ na puli dɩ Zwifǝ bam sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Balʋ na kɩ lwarɩm yɩ ba yǝri Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na kɩ Moyisijɩŋa nɩ tɩn, baá cɔgɩ mʋ yɩ kʋ daɩ DƖ cullu tɩm ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ, balʋ na ye Wɛ cullu tɩm na kɩ ba cɔgɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ tɔgɩ DƖ cullu tɩm kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ ma di ba taanɩ.

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nmʋ wʋlʋ na brɩ n tɩtɩ nɩ n yɩ Zwifu tɩn, nmʋ yǝni n dalɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm yɩra nɩ mʋ, yɩ n kɩ tɩɩra dɩ n Wɛ tɔga kam.

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: Nmʋ maŋɩ n ye Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ sɩ n kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Nmʋ na zaasɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ pɛ n lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: Nmʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ n jɩgɩ Wɛ pooni mʋ n paɩ balʋ ta na wʋ lim wʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ n nyɩ dɩ lilwe vaŋɩnʋ na lagɩ sɩ o pa nɔɔna tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ te tɩn.

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan na yǝni n zaasɩ n donnǝ tɩn, bɛɛ mʋ kɩ yɩ n ba zaasɩ n tɩtɩ? Nmʋ yǝni n brɩ nɔɔna nɩ ba yɩ taa ŋɔna, yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ ŋɔnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: N tɛ nɩ ba yɩ kɩ boorim, yɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ boori mʋ. Nmʋ culi jwǝnǝ, yɩ n laan daarɩ n di nyɔɔrɩ ya baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ abam Zwifǝ bam kikiǝ ŋwaanɩ mʋ paɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ.»

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á goni á bǝkǝri sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ á yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. Á nan na kwaanɩ á sɛ Wɛ cullu tɩm, á bǝkǝrigonim dɩm jɩgɩ kuri. Kʋ daarɩ, á na cɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm, á bǝkǝri sɩm gwǝŋǝ yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiinǝ wʋ́ brɩ nɩ abam Zwifǝ bam ba jɩgɩ bʋra. Bɛŋwaanɩ á jɩgɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm á jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ á goni á bǝkǝri. Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, á ta yǝni á cɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm mʋ. Bantʋ nan ba goni ba bǝkǝri, yɩ ba nan tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, Zwifu cɩga cɩga yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ na lǝni o bɩcarɩ tɩn mʋ. Wʋlʋ bɩcarɩ na fɔgɩ dɩ kwɛ tɩn mʋ nyɩ dɩ o goni mʋ cɩga cɩga. Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm bá wanɩ kʋ kwɛ nɔɔnʋ bɩcarɩ, kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ Jorokʋm mʋ waɩ kʋ kwɛ nɔɔnʋ bɩcarɩ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋntʋ doŋ naɩ zulǝ Wɛ tee nɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ tee nɩ.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Zwifǝ nan jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo ba dwe dwi-gɛtiinǝ na? Zwifǝ na goni ba bǝkǝritɩn, kʋ jɩgɩ zǝnǝ kʋ pa-ba na?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Ɛɛn, kʋ tiini kʋ jɩgɩ kuri. Bɛŋwaanɩ dayigǝ tɩn, Zwifǝ bam mʋ yɩ balʋ Wɛ na kwe DƖ ni-bɩtarɩ sɩm DƖ kɩ ba jɩŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Ba badaara nan wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ. Kʋntʋ nan bá wanɩ kʋ pa Wɛ kwanɩ DƖ ni-taanɩ dɩm.

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama na maŋɩ ba yɩ vwa-nyɩna, Wɛ ta yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ Wɛ jɩgɩ cɩga dɩ nmʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ maama tɩn. Nɔɔna na maŋɩ ba co nmʋ dɩ, nmʋ ta yɩ cɩga tu mʋ.»

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, dɩbam na kɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ tɩn ta na brɩ nɩ Wɛ yɩ cɩga tu mʋ, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta nɩ bɛɛ? Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna taa tɛ nɩ, Wɛ na pɛ ba na cam ba lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, DƖ wʋ kɩ cɩga na?

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ. Wɛ ya na daɩ cɩga tu, DƖ wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ DƖ di nabiinǝ taanɩ?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ta waɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Amʋ na yǝni a fɔ vwan tɩn, kʋ pɛ nɔɔna lwarɩ jaja nɩ Wɛ tiini DƖ yɩ cɩga tu, yɩ DƖ na zulǝ kʋ ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ a maŋɩ sɩ a na cam a kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm ŋwaanɩ?»

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ya na yɩ cɩga, dɩ́ ya wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ wɩ: «Pa-na dɩ́ taá tʋŋɩ lwarɩm, sɩ kʋʋ́ ja lanyɩranɩ kʋ ba.» Nɔɔna badonnǝ yǝni ba fɔ vwan ba pa amʋ ba wɩ, amʋ tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Ba nan lagɩ sɩ ba cɔgɩ amʋ yɩrɩ mʋ. Ba nan wʋ́ na cɔgɩm sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na jɩgɩ cɩga Wɛ yigǝ nɩ

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩbam Zwifǝ bam garɩ dwi-gɛtiinǝ bam mʋ na? Awo. A ya maŋɩ a ta nɩ nɔɔna maama wʋ lwarɩm gambɛɛm wʋnɩ mʋ, kʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ naa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ,

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na ye kʋlʋ na maŋɩ tɩn. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na lagɩ sɩ o lwarɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Ba maama mɛ ba kwaga mʋ ba ya Wɛ, yɩ ba maama tusi. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na kɩ lanyɩranɩ, dɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa dɩ.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Ba niǝ maa ŋɔɔrɩ nɩ yibeelǝ niǝ na pʋrɩ te tɩn. Ba maa maɩ ba dindǝlimǝ ba ma ganɩ daanɩ. Ba niǝ ma cana nɩ bɩsankwɩ na jɩgɩ vɩan sɩ gʋɩ nɔɔna te tɩn.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Ba maa sɔɔlɩ wo-balwaarʋ ba pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ba maa yǝri ywǝǝni cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba tɔgɩ.

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: Ba maa brɩ ba ba kwarɩ Wɛ.»

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ kʋlʋ maama Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm na brɩ tɩn, kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋ pa balʋ cullu tɩm na te-ba tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nabiinǝ maama wʋ́ ba ba zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ sɩ DƖ di ba taanɩ, yɩ ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ bá wanɩ o ni o puri sɩ o ma ŋɔɔnɩ o joŋi o tɩtɩ.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ, o na tɔgɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ cullu tɩm nan paɩ nabiinǝ mʋ lwarɩ nɩ ba kɩ ba tusi. Dɩ́ na wʋ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Wɛ laan nan pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ DƖ na paɩ nɔɔna naɩ cɩga DƖ tee nɩ te tɩn, yɩ kʋ wʋ zɩgɩ cullu tɔgɩm baŋa nɩ. Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm dɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɩ nan maŋɩ ba brɩ cwǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Nabiinǝ maama kɩ lwarɩm mʋ yɩ ba daa wʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan paɩ nɔɔna na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ zaanɩ mʋ, Zezi Krisi na ŋwɩ ba lwarɩm jɩnɩ o ma joŋi-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ paɩ nɔɔna DƖ zaanɩ dɩm kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ Wɛ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ DƖ yɩ cɩga tu, dɩ DƖ na joŋi nɔɔna ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ maa brɩ nɩ Wɛ jɩgɩ cɩga, yɩ DƖ ta paɩ balʋ maama na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn dɩ ta na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ, dɩ́ wʋ́ magɩ dɩ́ nyɔɔna bɛɛ baŋa nɩ mʋ? Kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, kʋ daɩ dɩ́ na tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩ́ na cɩga, kʋ yɩ dɩ́ na sɛ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ Zwifǝ bam yɩranɩ Wɛ mʋ na? DƖ daɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ Wɛ na? Ɛɛn, DƖ yɩ nabiinǝ maama Wɛ mʋ.

english_verse: Well then, what can we say about our ancestor Abraham?
translation_verse: Á pa dɩ́ nii dɩ́ nabaarʋ Abrahamdɛɛn na yɩ te yɩ o na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ ya na pɛ-o cɩga o na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, o ya wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ woŋo sɩ o magɩ o nyɔɔnɩ kʋ baŋa nɩ. O nan ba jɩgɩ woŋo sɩ o magɩ o nyɔɔnɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm nan brɩ dɩbam kʋ wɩ: «Abraham kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, yɩ Wɛ pa o na cɩga kʋ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ nɔɔnʋ na tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ, o maŋɩ sɩ o joŋi o ŋwɩɩrʋ mʋ o tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ, kʋntʋ nan daɩ pɛɛrɩ mʋ o joŋi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Pɛ Davididɩ maŋɩ o ta kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. O dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ Wɛ na pɛ o na cɩga yɩ kʋ daɩ o kǝm-laarʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn yɩ yu-yoŋo tu mʋ.

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kɩ lwarɩm yɩ Wɛ yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ-o yɩ DƖ daa ba kɩ-dɩ DƖ bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo.»

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Davidi na ŋɔɔnɩ wʋpolo taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, o ŋɔɔnɩ balʋ na goni ba bǝkǝritɩn yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ na? Aye. O ŋɔɔnɩ balʋ na ba goni ba bǝkǝri tɩn dɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ: «Abraham kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ mʋ, yɩ Wɛ pa o na cɩga kʋ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ o na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ maŋa kalʋ o na goni tɩn mʋ na? Awo, kʋ yɩ o ta na wʋ goni maŋa kalʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋ kwaga nɩ mʋ Wɛ pɛ o go sɩ kʋ taa yɩ maana kʋ brɩ nɩ, Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ pa o na cɩga o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ loori o na wʋ́ go tɩn. Kʋntʋ, balʋ maama dɩ na wʋ goni yɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ yɩ kʋ pa ba na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ tɩn, ba dɩ yɩ Abraham dwi tiinǝ cɩga cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ Abrahamna tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Wɛ go DƖ ni dɩ Abraham dɩ o dwi tiinǝ bam. Kʋ nan yɩ Abraham na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ yɩ o na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Wɛ go ni DƖ wɩ, DƖ wʋ́ pa o ba o taa te lʋgʋ kʋm.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ya na yɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ wʋ́ ba ba taa te lʋgʋ kʋm, dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn ya daa ba jɩgɩ kuri, yɩ Wɛ ni-gonim dɩm dɩ ya wʋ́ ji kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu tɩm vɩʋn mʋ paɩ DƖ banɩ zaŋɩ dɩ nɔɔna, ba na cɔgɩ-tɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Cullu nan na tǝrǝ, nɔɔna bá wanɩ ba cɔgɩ-tɩ.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ Abraham na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ Wɛ go ni dɩd-o, sɩ kʋ taa yɩ zaanɩ pɛɛrɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, Abraham dwi tiinǝ bam maama wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ ba na wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa-ba tɩn. Kʋ daɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ́ na-tɩ, kʋ yɩ balʋ dɩ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ nɩ Abraham dɩ dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam maama wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ bǝŋi Abraham nɩ dɩ́ nabaarʋ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ dɩ Abraham DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ goni a ni sɩ a pa n ji dwi zanzan nabaarʋ mʋ.» Abraham na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn, o sɩɩnɩ o ji dɩ́ nabaarʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ dɩntʋ mʋ bi nɔɔna DƖ pa ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ pa woŋo maama kɩ maŋa kalʋ kʋlʋkʋlʋ ya ta na tǝrǝ tɩn.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: O maa ba jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa dɩ Wɛ na goni DƖ ni sɩ DƖ pa-o kʋlʋ tɩn. O na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn, kʋ paɩ o zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ, yɩ kʋ pa Wɛ na zulǝ.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: O maa sɩɩnɩ o ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ DƖ na goni DƖ ni sɩ DƖ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ ma pa o na cɩga» tɩn, kʋ daɩ Abraham yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ dɩbam dɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ wʋ́ pa dɩbam dɩ na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ, dɩ dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩntʋ mʋ bi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ kɩ Zezi nabiinǝ jɩŋa nɩ DƖ pa o tɩ dɩbam lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ. DƖ ma daarɩ DƖ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ o joori o na ŋwɩa, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ, dɩbam dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Zezi mʋ pɛ dɩbam yi Wɛ yigǝ, yɩ Wɛ kɩ dɩbam yu-yoŋo dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na paarɩ-zulǝ Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ kʋ paɩ dɩbam jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ́ yaara yam wʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ yaara waɩ ya paɩ dɩ́ fɔgɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ dɩ pu-dɩa.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na jɩgɩ tɩɩna kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ bá pa dɩ́ na dɩ́ cavɩɩra, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ tiini DƖ kɩ DƖ sono dɩbam bɩcara nɩ, dɩ DƖ na pɛ DƖ Jorokʋm wʋ dɩbam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Kʋ cana sɩ nɔɔnʋ sɛ o tɩ o doŋ ŋwaanɩ, dɩ o na wʋ́ tɩ wʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn na maŋɩ o yɩ cɩga tu te dɩ. Kʋ nan waɩ kʋ kɩ sɩ nɔɔnʋ bá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ o tɩ nɔn-ŋʋm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ, dɩntʋ brɩ dɩbam DƖ na tiini DƖ soe dɩbam te tɩn, dɩ DƖ na pɛ Zezi Krisi ba o tɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ ya ta na yɩ lwarɩm kǝrǝ tɩn.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Zezi na tɩga yɩ o jana kam nuŋi tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ nan na dwe dɩdɩ tɩn, o laan wʋ́ joŋi dɩbam Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ya yɩ Wɛ dʋna mʋ. DƖ Bu wʋm tʋʋnɩ dɩm nan mʋ pɛ dɩbam dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ. Kʋ nan na dwe dɩdɩ, dɩbam laan na jigi Wɛ nɔɔna tɩn, DƖ Bu wʋm wʋ́ vrɩ dɩbam, o na joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ ta na wǝli da tɩn, dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ Wɛ, dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi na pɛ dɩbam dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Adam na vɩn Wɛ ni tɩn mʋ pɛ tʋʋnɩ ba, Zezi maa ja ŋwɩa o ba

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dɩdʋa ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ lwarɩm ba lʋgʋ baŋa, yɩ lwarɩm dɩ ja tʋʋnɩ dɩ wǝli da dɩ ba. Kʋntʋ tɩn, nabiinǝ maama maŋɩ sɩ ba tɩ mʋ, ba maama na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Kʋ na wʋ́ loori sɩ Wɛ kɩ DƖ cullu tɩm DƖ nɔɔna bam jɩŋa nɩ tɩn, dɩ lwarɩm maŋɩ dɩ wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ mʋ. Cullu tɩm nan ya ta na tǝrǝ tɩn, Wɛ ba jeeli nɔɔna lwarɩm.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Kʋ na zɩgɩ Adammaŋa kam nɩ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi Moyisi maŋa kam tɩn, tʋʋnɩ ya maŋɩ dɩ wʋra mʋ yɩ dɩ waɩ nabiinǝ. Dɩ maa waɩ balʋ dɩ na kɩ ba tusi, yɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ Adam dɛɛn na kɩ lwarɩm o vɩn Wɛ ni te tɩn. Adam nan brɩ dɩbam Zezi na lagɩ o ba tɩn nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Ba nan daɩ bɩdwɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ Adam dɛɛn na kɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ tɩn daɩ bɩdwɩ dɩ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ zaanɩ tɩn. Nabiinu dɩdʋa kam kʋntʋ lwarɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ nɔɔna zanzan tɩ. Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm nan dwe kʋntʋ, yɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ nabiinu dɩdʋa, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi, sɩ o kɩ nɔɔna zanzan yu-yoŋo kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ pɛɛrɩ dɩm nɔɔna zaanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ bɩdwɩ nɩ Adam na kɩ lwarɩm te tɩn. Wʋntʋ na kɩ lwarɩm o vɩn Wɛ ni bɩdwɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ Wɛ di nɔɔna sarɩya. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔna zanzan na kɩ ba tusi tɩn, Wɛ pɛɛrɩ dɩm nan pɛ ba lwarɩm zanzan ti yɩ ba na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dɩdʋa kam lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ tʋʋnɩ tɔgɩ da dɩ jaanɩ nɔɔna. Kʋ nan na dwe dɩdɩ tɩn, balʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ-ba yu-yoŋo kʋ ja gaalɩ, yɩ DƖ kwǝri DƖ pa ba na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ tɩn, mʋ wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ nabiinu dɩdʋa wʋlʋ na yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan lwarɩ nɩ Adam na kɩ o tusi bɩdwɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ nabiinǝ maama na cɔgɩm Wɛ tee nɩ. Zezi Krisi yɩranɩ kǝm-laa kʋm dɩ nan mʋ pɛ nɔɔna na cɩga yɩ ba jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dɩdʋa kam na vɩn Wɛ ni dɩm tɩn mʋ pɛ nɔɔna zanzan yɩ lwarɩm kǝrǝ. Nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa kam na yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn nan na sɛ Wɛ ni tɩn dɩ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna zanzan na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn kɩ DƖ cullu tɩm nɔɔna jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa lwarɩm fɔgɩ dɩ puli. Lwarɩm nan na puli kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ na kɩ nɔɔna zaanɩ te tɩn wʋ́ tiini kʋ puli zanzan kʋ dwǝni.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, lwarɩm tɔgɩ tʋʋnɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ maa te nɔɔna. Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm nan tɔgɩ DƖ na paɩ nɔɔna cɩga te tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ maa di paarɩ nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ, sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ ta nɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Dɩ́ wʋ́ ta kɩ lwarɩm mʋ, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ pa Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm tiini dɩ puli dɩ́ tee nɩ na?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Aye, dɩ́ bá ta kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ. Kʋ na yɩ dɩ lwarɩm jǝgǝ nɩ, dɩbam nyɩ dɩ twa mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ daa wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ lwarɩm wʋnɩ?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ, dɩbam balʋ maama ba na miisi na wʋnɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ wǝli dɩd-o o tʋʋnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, ba na miisi dɩbam na wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ dɩ́ tɩgɩ dɩd-o mʋ yɩ ba kɩ dɩbam dɩd-o. Kʋntʋ ma pa dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ́ ŋwɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam, nɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ na mɛ DƖ paarɩ dam dɩm DƖ ma bi Zezi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ yɩ o na ŋwɩa te tɩn.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩbam na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi dɩ́ tɩ tɩn, dɩ́ laan jigi woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ dɩd-o, yɩ dɩ́ daa ta wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ bi dɩ́ yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ, ba na pagɩ Zezi tʋʋn-dagarakam baŋa nɩ ba gʋ tɩn, dɩbam lwarɩm ŋwɩ-doŋǝ kam dɩ tɔgɩ ka tɩ mʋ, kʋ pa lwarɩm daa warɩ dɩbam. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ laan te dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ lwarɩm jɩŋa nɩ,

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ lwarɩm daa bá wanɩ dɩ taa te wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi o tɩ tɩn.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ́ tɩ tɩn, dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ na ŋwɩa.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ Zezi Krisi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ yɩ o daa bá joori o tɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ tʋʋnɩ daa ba jɩgɩ dam o baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Zezi na tɩgɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ lwarɩm dam mʋ. O tɩgɩ bɩdwɩ yɩranɩ mʋ o ma kweeli. O laan nan na ŋwɩ tɩn, o ŋwɩa kam zuli Wɛ mʋ.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ abam dɩ. Kʋ na yɩ dɩ lwarɩm jǝgǝ nɩ, lwarɩ-na nɩ á nyɩ dɩ twa mʋ te. Kʋ nan na yɩ abam dɩ Wɛ laŋa nɩ, á ŋwɩ mʋ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ abam daa yɩ pa lwarɩm di dam á yɩra yalʋ na tʋ tɩn baŋa nɩ. Á nan yɩ sɛ á pa wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ á fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn wanɩ abam.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Yɩ sɛ-na á pa lwarɩm taa te abam sɩ kʋ pa á taá kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ. Nan kwe-na á tɩtɩ á kɩ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ á nyɩ nɩ balʋ na tɩgɩ yɩ Wɛ pa á joori á bi á na ŋwɩa tɩn mʋ. Kwe-na á maama á pa Wɛ, sɩ DƖ ma tʋŋɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Lwarɩm daa ba te abam, bɛŋwaanɩ á na jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ á taá ŋwɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ, kʋ yɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ mʋ maŋa maama

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Kʋ nan brɩ dɩbam nɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Dɩ́ na jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ yɩ kʋ daɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ lwarɩm mʋ na? Awo, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: A nan kɩ Wɛ le, dɩ abam dɛɛn ya na yɩ lwarɩm gambɛ yɩ á laan kwe á tɩtɩ á pa Wɛ cɩga kam zaasɩm yɩ á sɛ-ka dɩ á wʋ maama tɩn.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ vrɩ abam lwarɩm jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ á laan ji DƖ cɩga kam tɩntʋŋna.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Abam wʋbʋŋa ta na wʋ bɩgɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ a kwe nabiinǝ mɩmaŋa a ma maŋɩ a brɩ abam kʋntʋ doŋ. Abam dɛɛn kwe á maama mʋ á pa wo-digiru dɩ lwarɩm kikiǝ yɩ á yɩ tɩ gambɛ, yɩ á tʋŋɩ wo-lwaanʋ kʋ ja gaalɩ. Lele kʋntʋ, á laan nan maŋɩ sɩ á kwe á maama mʋ á pa Wɛ cɩga kam, sɩ á taá yɩ ka gambɛ sɩ á taá ŋwɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn na yɩ lwarɩm gambɛ tɩn, Wɛ cɩga kam ya ba te abam.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ tɩn dɛɛn jɩgɩ bɛɛ nyɔɔrɩ mʋ tɩ pa abam? Tɩ laan nan jɩgɩ cavɩɩra mʋ dɩ abam. Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ kweelim je nan yɩ tʋʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ Wɛ vrɩ abam lwarɩm gambɛɛm wʋnɩ, yɩ á laan yɩ DƖ gambɛ-sonnu mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ á jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ dɩ á na ŋwɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo tɩn, yɩ kʋ kweelim je nɩ á wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á maama ye cullu laŋa na yɩ te. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ á ye nɩ cullu na te nɔɔnʋ, kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve o tʋʋnɩ mʋ. O nan na tɩga, tɩ daa ba te-o.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ nɩ kaanɩ na zʋ barʋ te tɩn mʋ. Culu brɩ nɩ o barʋ wʋm ta na ŋwɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o yagɩ o barʋ wʋm. O barʋ wʋm nan na tɩga, o laan jɩgɩ ni sɩ o zʋ barʋ wʋdoŋ, culu daa wʋ vɔgɩ-ba daanɩ.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, o barʋ wʋm ta na ŋwɩ, yɩ kaanɩ wʋm na ve o zʋ barʋ wʋdoŋ, o cɔgɩ mʋ. O barʋ wʋm nan na tɩga, culu kʋm daa wʋ vɔgɩ-ba daanɩ. O laan na zʋ barʋ wʋdoŋ, o daa wʋ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ abam dɩ. Kʋ na yɩ cullu tɩm laŋa nɩ, abam maama nyɩ dɩ twa mʋ te, Zezi Krisi na tɩgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ ma pa dɩ́ yigǝ lɩ cullu tɩm wʋnɩ, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ jɩŋa nɩ, wʋntʋ yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn. Kʋ maa paɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna dɩ́ pa Wɛ.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ dɛɛn kɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn. Wɛ cullu tɩm nan brɩ dɩbam kʋlʋ na yɩ lwarɩm tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ fra ta yǝni ya zʋʋrɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ. Kʋ dɛɛn ma pa dɩ́ kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ na jɩgɩ dɩbam tɩ ve tʋʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Cullu tɩm dɛɛn tiini tɩ pɩɩnɩ dɩbam mʋ dɩ dam. Lele kʋntʋ tɩ nan daa ba te dɩbam, dɩ́ na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi dɩ́ tɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ na tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam te tɩn, kʋ yɩ DƖ Jorokʋm na wʋ dɩ́ bɩcara nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩ́ laan tɔgɩ cwǝ-dʋŋa kam kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ cwǝ-doŋǝ kalʋ na yɩ cullu tɩlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ tɩ tiŋi tɔnɔ wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ cullu tɩm brɩ dɩbam lwarɩm na yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Bɛɛ mʋ dɩ́ nan wʋ́ ta cullu tɩm laŋa nɩ? Tɩ yɩ lwarɩm mʋ na? Aye, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Wɛ cullu tɩm nan mʋ pɛ a lwarɩ lwarɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Tɩ ya na wʋ brɩ nɩ: «Yɩ pa n yi zʋ n donnǝ wǝǝnu», a ya bá ta ye nɩ a yi na zʋ a donnǝ wǝǝnu, kʋ yɩ lwarɩm mʋ.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Culu kʋm kʋntʋ nan mʋ pɛ lwarɩm na cwǝŋǝ dɩ zʋ a wʋbʋŋa kʋ pa a yi zʋ wǝǝnu zanzan. Cullu nan na tǝrǝ, lwarɩm bá ta jɩgɩ dam.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: A dɛɛn ya ta na yǝri Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn, a ŋwɩ mʋ a ya ba liǝ. A laan nan na tu a lwarɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ pɛ lwarɩm jɩgɩ dam a baŋa nɩ,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: yɩ a nyɩ nɩ a tɩgɩ mʋ te. Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ ya na maŋɩ sɩ tɩ pa nɔɔna ŋwɩa tɩn laan pɛ tʋʋnɩ mʋ ja-nɩ.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, a na ni cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ pɛ lwarɩm laan na cwǝŋǝ dɩ ganɩ-nɩ, yɩ dɩ tɔgɩ cullu tɩm ŋwaanɩ dɩ pa tʋʋnɩ ja-nɩ.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɔgɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ. Amʋ nan yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nabiinu mʋ, yɩ a yɩ lwarɩm gambaa.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: A nan yǝri woŋo kʋlʋ a na kɩ tɩn kuri. Amʋ yǝni a ba kɩ kʋlʋ a na lagɩ tɩn, yɩ a laan daarɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ a na culi tɩn.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: A na yǝni a kɩ kʋlʋ a na ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ a sɛ nɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋ daɩ nɩ a tɩtɩ mʋ paalɩ a kɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ, kʋ nan yɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ na wʋ a wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ pa a kɩa.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: A nan ye nɩ lanyɩranɩ tǝri a wʋnɩ, dɩ a na yɩ nabiinu yɩ a fra zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ, a na yǝni a jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a kɩ lanyɩranɩ, a ta warɩ lanyɩranɩ wʋm a kɩ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: A na yǝni a kɩ kʋlʋ a wʋbʋŋa na ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋ daɩ a tɩtɩ mʋ paalɩ a kɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ, kʋ yɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ na wʋ a wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ paɩ a kɩa.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: A nan lwarɩ kʋ na yǝni kʋ kɩ amʋ te tɩn: A na yǝni a bʋŋɩ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn, kʋ yɩ lwarɩm yɩranɩ mʋ aá kɩ.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: A tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo a bɩcarɩ nɩ dɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Lɛɛrʋ maa jɩgɩ-nɩ, lwarɩm dɩlʋ na wʋ a wʋnɩ tɩn na lagɩ sɩ dɩ pa tʋʋnɩ ja-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o vrɩ-nɩ o yagɩ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Amʋ kɩ Wɛ le dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ joŋi-nɩ. Kʋ na yɩ a wʋbʋŋa yam wʋnɩ, a sɛ Wɛ cullu tɩm mʋ. A nan na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nabiinu tɩn mʋ paɩ a tɔgɩ lwarɩm cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, balʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, Wɛ daa bá di ba taanɩ sɩ DƖ cɔgɩ-ba.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Wɛ Jorokʋm mʋ paɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ Joro kʋm dam dɩm mʋ pɛ dɩ́ na vrɩm lwarɩm dɩ tʋʋnɩ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na yɩ nabiinǝ yɩ dɩ́ bwǝnǝ tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ warɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm dɩ́ da. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ daa bá wanɩ dɩ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ. Woŋo kʋlʋ cullu tɩm na wʋ wanɩ tɩ kɩ tɩn, Wɛ mʋ kɩa, dɩ DƖ na tʋŋɩ DƖ tɩtɩ Bu sɩ o ba o ji nabiinu, yɩ o nyɩ dɩ nabiinǝ balʋ lwarɩm na waɩ-ba tɩn. O ma ba o tɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ, sɩ o ma cɔgɩ lwarɩm na jɩgɩ dam dɩlʋ nabiinǝ baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋbʋŋa na tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nabiinǝ fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ wʋ́ ja kʋntʋ tu. Wʋlʋ wʋbʋŋa nan na tɔgɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm cwǝŋǝ kam tɩn wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ wʋ-zuru.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɔgɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ tɩm, o yɩ Wɛ dʋm mʋ, o ba kɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ niǝ yam na brɩ tɩn, o nan warɩ-ya dɩ o sɛ.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn bá wanɩ ba pa Wɛ wʋ poli.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Abam nan ba tɔgɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Á tɔgɩ Wɛ Jorokʋm na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ, kʋ na wʋ á bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Zezi Krisi Joro kʋm nan na tǝri nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn, o daɩ Zezi nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi na wʋ á bɩcara nɩ tɩn, o Joro kʋm mʋ paɩ á ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ, á na nɛ cɩga DƖ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Á yɩra yam nan maŋɩ sɩ ya tɩ mʋ lwarɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, á na tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ wʋ́ ja abam. Kʋ daarɩ, á nan na tɔgɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam ŋwaanɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ á fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn, á wʋ́ na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na paɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm brɩ-ba cwǝŋǝ tɩn yɩ Wɛ biǝ mʋ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Joro kʋlʋ Wɛ na kɩ á bɩcara nɩ tɩn ba paɩ fʋʋnɩ jɩgɩ abam daga nɩ gambɛ te. Wɛ Joro kʋm nan paɩ á yɩ Wɛ biǝ mʋ. Kʋ maa paɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ bǝŋi Wɛ nɩ Dɩ́ Ko Baba.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ paɩ dɩbam jwǝǝru tɩm lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ yɩ Wɛ biǝ mʋ.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na yɩ Wɛ biǝ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ ba dɩ́ na wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama DƖ na tiŋi sɩ DƖ pa DƖ biǝ bam tɩn. Dɩ́ wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi dɩ́ joŋi kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na tiŋi sɩ DƖ pa-o tɩn. Dɩ́ na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi dɩ́ na yaara, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ ba dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ na paarɩ zulǝ. Dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na paarɩ-zulǝ Wɛ tee nɩ

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye nɩ dɩ́ na jɩgɩ yaara yalʋ lele tɩn bá wanɩ ya taa maɩ dɩ paarɩ-zulǝ yalʋ dɩ́ na wʋ́ na Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Wɛ na kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama tɩn tiini tɩ lagɩ sɩ tɩ na dɛ dɩm Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ brɩ DƖ biǝ bam paarɩ-zulǝ jaja tɩn.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ tɩn tu tɩ daa ba jɩgɩ kuri. Kʋ nan daɩ wǝǝnu tɩm tɩtɩ mʋ lagɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ tɩ ji kafɛ, yɩ DƖ nan paɩ tɩ ta jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ,

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ tɩn jɩgɩ cam mʋ dɩ zɩm maama, nɩ kaanɩ na vri pugǝ yɩ o kʋnɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ yɩranɩ, kʋ yɩ dɩ dɩbam balʋ Wɛ na kɩ DƖ Jorokʋm dɩ́ bɩcara nɩ tɩn dɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ dayigǝ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ na brɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ ba dɩ́ na DƖ wo-laarʋ tɩm maama. Dɩbam dɩ nan kʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ́ cǝgi maŋa kam Wɛ na wʋ́ pa dɩ́ ji DƖ tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ biǝ, sɩ DƖ vrɩ dɩ́ yɩra yam yaara maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ta jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na Wɛ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ dɩ́ ta na wʋ nɛ tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ zuri dɩ́ yɩra dɩ́ cǝgi tɩ maŋa kam.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩ nan wǝli dɩbam, dɩ́ na bwǝnǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩbam yǝri dɩ́ na wʋ́ loori Wɛ te sɩ kʋ maŋɩ tɩn. DƖ Joro kʋm nan loori-DƖ kʋ pa dɩbam dɩ ŋwana yalʋ na bá wanɩ ya ta dɩ nabiinǝ bɩtarɩ tɩn.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan ye dɩ́ bɩcara na yɩ te tɩn, yɩ DƖ kwǝri DƖ ye DƖ Joro kʋm dɩ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ, yɩ kʋ loori Wɛ kʋ pa dɩbam balʋ na yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ balʋ na soe Wɛ yɩ DƖ bǝŋi-ba nɩ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ lɩ wʋbʋŋa te tɩn, DƖ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ woŋo maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn maŋɩ DƖ jɩgɩ bantʋ wʋbʋŋa DƖ bɩcarɩ nɩ faŋa faŋa mʋ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ kuri-ba sɩ ba laan ba ba taa nyɩ nɩ DƖ Bu wʋm na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ ma wʋ́ pa Wɛ Bu Zezi na nyaana zanzan, balʋ dɩ na yɩ Wɛ biǝ yɩ ba saŋɩ o kwaga tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta nɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Wɛ na wʋra dɩ dɩbam tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o cɔgɩ dɩbam?

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ vɩn sɩ DƖ tɩtɩ Bu wʋm na yaara, yɩ DƖ sɛ DƖ kɩ-o nabiinǝ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ o tɩ dɩbam maama ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam DƖ Bu wʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, DƖ ta wʋ́ kwe wo-laarʋ maama DƖ pa dɩbam zaanɩ DƖ wǝli da.

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o co dɩbam balʋ Wɛ na kuri tɩn DƖ yigǝ nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ pɛ dɩ́ na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o pa dɩ́ ga bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ mʋ tɩgɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ, yɩ o joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ o jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ. O laan maa je Wɛ jazɩm nɩ yɩ o loori Wɛ o pa dɩbam.

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Dɩbam na yɩ nmʋ Wɛ nɔɔna tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ tʋʋnɩ wʋ dɩ́ kɛ dɛ maama. Ba kwe dɩbam ba ma ji nɩ peeni sɩlʋ ba na jɩgɩ ba ve ba gʋ te tɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan na soe dɩbam tɩn, DƖ tiini DƖ paɩ dɩbam wɔnɔ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Amʋ na yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔnʋ tɩn, a ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga mʋ sɩ kʋ daɩ vwan. Wɛ Jorokʋm na wʋ a bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn mʋ paɩ a ye nɩ kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ,

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: A ya wʋ́ ta lagɩ sɩ Wɛ cɔgɩ amʋ tɩtɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pɔɔrɩ-nɩ Zezi Krisi tee nɩ, dɩ kʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ pa a ko-biǝ Zwifǝ bam na vrɩm.

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Ba yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩdwi tiinǝ mʋ. Kʋ yɩ bantʋ mʋ Wɛ dɛɛn pɛ ba ji DƖ biǝ, yɩ DƖ pa-ba DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam. DƖ ma go ni nɩ DƖ wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩ ba, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ kɩ DƖ cullu tɩm ba jɩŋa nɩ. DƖ ma brɩ-ba ba na maŋɩ sɩ ba taa zuli-DƖ te tɩn. DƖ ma daarɩ DƖ go niǝ dɩ ba.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: A nan ba lagɩ a ta nɩ Wɛ na goni DƖ ni sɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn jigi kafɛ. Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam maama mʋ sɩɩnɩ ba yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ cɩga cɩga Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ tee nɩ, kʋ daɩ biǝ balʋ maama Abraham na lʋgɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ Wɛ biǝ cɩga cɩga. Kʋ nan yɩ biǝ balʋ Wɛ na goni ni ba ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ sɩɩnɩ ba yɩ DƖ biǝ cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ dɛɛn goni ni DƖ wɩ: «Maŋa kam kʋntʋ na joori ka yi, amʋ wʋ́ joori a ba dɩ Saralʋgɩ bǝkǝrǝ.»

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛ kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam nabaarʋ Yizakɩ kaanɩ Rabɛka dɛɛn ja pugǝ o lʋ yiywa bale.

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Rabɛka ta na wʋ lʋgɩ o biǝ bale bam yɩ ba daa ta yǝri lanyɩranɩ naa balɔrɔ tɩn, Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: «Nakwɩ wʋm mʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ o nyaanɩ wʋm tɩntʋŋnʋ.» Kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ Wɛ na kuri-ba daanɩ te tɩn mʋ tɔgɩ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ lɩ wʋbʋŋa te tɩn. Kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ kurim dɩm tɔgɩ DƖ na bǝŋi wʋlʋ sɩ o taa yɩ DƖ nɔɔnʋ tɩn mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm tɩtʋŋa ŋwaanɩ,

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: nɩ kʋ daa ta na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ soe Zakɔbɩ, yɩ a daarɩ a yagɩ Ezayu.»

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, nɩ Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ dɩ Ezipipa-farʋ wʋm DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ pɛ n di paarɩ sɩ a wanɩ a tɔgɩ nmʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a brɩ nɔɔna amʋ dam dɩm na maɩ te tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna taa zǝŋi amʋ yɩrɩ dɩm lʋgʋ baŋa maama nɩ.»
