english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ duri balʋ ŋwaŋa DƖ na lagɩ tɩn mʋ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa badonnǝ ta kʋ ba wʋrʋ nɩ DƖ na lagɩ te tɩn. Wɛ jɩgɩ ni sɩ DƖ kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Abam wʋ dɩdʋa waɩ o bwe amʋ nɩ: «Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ Wɛ nan brɩ nɩ nɔɔna kɩ ba cɔgɩ? Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o vɩn kʋlʋ Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ o kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Nabiinu yɩ wɔɔ mʋ sɩ o wanɩ o magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ Wɛ? Kʋntʋ tɩn, kamɔgɔ wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ bwe kʋ mɔrʋ wʋm nɩ: «Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n mɔ-nɩ tɩntʋ doŋ» na?

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: sɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa nɔɔna balʋ DƖ na jɩgɩ ba ŋwaŋa tɩn tɔgɩ ba na DƖ paarɩ dɩm na tiini dɩ jɩgɩ zulǝ te tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ lɩ sɩ ba zʋ DƖ paarɩ zulǝ yam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Oze tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ te tɩn. Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ DƖ wɩ: «Nɔɔna balʋ ya na daɩ amʋ nɔɔna tɩn, mʋ a laan wʋ́ bǝŋi-ba nɩ amʋ nɔɔna. Dwi tiinǝ balʋ amʋ ya na ba soe tɩn, mʋ a laan wʋ́ bǝŋi-ba nɩ amʋ nɔn-sonnu.»

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: «Je sɩlʋ nɩ nɔ́ɔ Wɛ ya na tagɩ dɩ ba DƖ wɩ, ba daɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn, kʋ yɩ dáanɩ mʋ ba laan wʋ́ bǝŋi-ba nɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ biǝ.»

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Ezayidɩ dɛɛn tagɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩtiinǝ bam taanɩ o wɩ: «Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na maŋɩ ba tiini ba daga nɩ bugǝ ni kasʋllʋ na daga te tɩn, ba fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ́ na vrɩm.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ bá daanɩ sɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ maama DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ DƖ kɩ tɩn lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Kʋ ta yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Ezayi na maŋɩ o ta te o wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ ya na wʋ daarɩ dɩbam biǝ badaara DƖ yagɩ, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ dwi dɩm toŋi, dɩ́ ya wʋ́ ti mʋ, nɩ Sodɔmdɩ Gomɔɔrɩ tiinǝ bam dwi dɩm dɛɛn na ti te tɩn.»

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ ta nɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Dwi-gɛtiinǝ balʋ ya na ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn laan mʋ tu ba na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ, ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ ba nan wʋ nɛ cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ? Bantʋ ya bʋŋɩ sɩ ba na cɩga ba kǝm-laarʋ tɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ. Ba na vɩn sɩ ba sɛ Wɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ maa nyɩ dɩ ba magɩ ba naga mʋ dɩ kandwɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna tri ba tʋɩ tɩn,

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nii-na, amʋ Wɛ lagɩ a cwi kandwɛ mʋ Siyɔnnɩ. Dɩ maa yɩ kandwɛ dɩlʋ nɔɔna na wʋ́ magɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ dɩ ba tʋ tɩga nɩ tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ kandwɛ dɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, cavɩɩra bá fɔgɩ ya ja kʋntʋ tu.»

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ tiini a laga sɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na vrɩm, yɩ a yǝni a loori Wɛ a pa-ba kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Moyisi dɛɛn pʋpʋnɩ nɔɔnʋ na wʋ́ kɩ te sɩ o ma na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn. O pʋpʋnɩ o wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na kɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm na wɩ te tɩn wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kʋ ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: «Nan yɩ bwe n tɩtɩ nɩ, wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o tu curu?» Kʋ lagɩ kʋ ta nɩ, sɩ o pa Zezi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ sɩ o joori o ba.

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ taanɩ dɩm daɩ yigǝ yigǝ dɩ nmʋ, dɩ wʋ nmʋ ni nɩ dɩ n bɩcarɩ nɩ.» Kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ dɩbam tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Kʋ tagɩ kʋ wɩ, nmʋ na tagɩ dɩ n ni nɩ Zezi mʋ yɩ woŋo maama Yuutu, yɩ nmʋ na sɛ n bɩcarɩ nɩ, sɩ Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ-m.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn, cavɩɩra bá ja kʋntʋ tu.»

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ nɔɔna maama, kʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ. Ba maama Yuutu yɩ dɩdʋa mʋ, yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ yǝni o paɩ balʋ maama na loor-o tɩn zǝnǝ zanzan.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, «wʋlʋ maama na loori zǝnǝ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn wʋ́ na vrɩm.»

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔna wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ ba loori zǝnǝ o tee nɩ, yɩ ba wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o? Ba nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, yɩ ba wʋ ni o kwǝrǝ? Ba nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ ba ni o kwǝrǝ yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ tɔɔlɩ-ka o brɩ-ba?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ o vu o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam o brɩ-ba dɩ ba na wʋ tʋŋ-o? Kʋ nan pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Balʋ na beeri ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ba brɩ nɔɔna tɩn vǝŋǝ jɩgɩ wʋpolo mʋ.»

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ nɔɔna maama mʋ sɛ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Ezayidɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: «Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, wɔɔ mʋ joŋi dɩbam ni-taanɩ dɩm?»

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Amʋ lagɩ a bwe a nii, Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam wʋ ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam mʋ na? Kʋ yɩ cɩga ba ni-ka, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Ba tɔɔlɩ o kwǝrǝ kam lʋgʋ baŋa je maama, yɩ ba ni-taanɩ jagɩ dɩ yi je maama.»

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Amʋ ta lagɩ a bwe a nii, Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam sɩɩnɩ ba wʋ ni Wɛ taanɩ dɩm kuri mʋ na? Ba niǝ. Dayigǝ tɩn, Wɛ dɛɛn tɔgɩ Moyisiŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ ta dɩ ba DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ pa abam taá jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ dwi tiinǝ balʋ na daɩ amʋ nɔɔna tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ pa abam bana zaŋɩ dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na yǝri kʋlʋkʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ Ezayi dɛɛn nɛ baarɩ yɩ o ta o wɩ: «Nɔɔna balʋ ya na ba bʋŋɩ sɩ ba ba ba sɛ amʋ Wɛ tɩn, bantʋ laan mʋ tu ba sɛ amʋ. Amʋ pɛ balʋ na maŋɩ ba wʋ bwe amʋ bwiǝ tɩn mʋ ba ba lwarɩ amʋ.»

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam, Wɛ tagɩ DƖ wɩ: «Dɛ maama wʋnɩ amʋ te a jɩa sɩ a ma joŋi abam, yɩ á vɩn sɩ á ba amʋ te.»

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ ta lagɩ a bwe a nii, Wɛ vɩn DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna Yisɩrayɛlɩtiinǝ bam mʋ na? Aye! Kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Amʋ tɩtɩ dɩ yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tu mʋ. A yɩ Abrahamnaa mʋ, yɩ a nuŋi Bɛnzamɛndwi dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ vɩn DƖ nɔɔna balʋ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ kuri pulim nɩ tɩn. Abam nan maŋɩ á ye Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ Eli taanɩ te, dɩ o na warɩ Wɛ o ta Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na kɩ te yɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: O dɛɛn warɩ Wɛ o wɩ: «Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, ba gʋ nmʋ nijoŋnǝ bam maama, yɩ ba daarɩ ba cɔgɩ nmʋ kaanɩm bimbinǝ yam. Kʋ laan daarɩ amʋ yɩranɩ mʋ, yɩ ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba gʋ amʋ dɩ.»

english_verse: But the Lord told Elijah, “I still have
translation_verse: Wɛ nan lǝr-o DƖ wɩ bɛɛ mʋ? DƖ dɛɛn wɩ: «Amʋ lɩ nɔɔna mʋrr-tɩrpɛ mʋ (

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam wʋ nɛ cɩga kalʋ ba na kwaanɩ sɩ ba na Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn. Nɔɔna balʋ Wɛ na kuri tɩn nan mʋ nɛ-ka. Balʋ na daarɩ tɩn bɩcarɩ digili.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ta yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ zɩm maama. Nɔɔna fɩnfɩɩn ta mʋ daarɩ, Wɛ na tɔgɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ DƖ kuri-ba tɩn.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kuri-ba, sɩ kʋ daɩ ba tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ ya na yɩ ba tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ kuri-ba, kʋ ya daa bá ta yɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm DƖ na pɛ-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa ba yiǝ dwe yɩ ba daa bá ta naɩ. DƖ maa wʋ́ pa ba yɩra cɛ dɩ yaara taan, maŋa maama.»

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Amʋ ta lagɩ a bwe a nii, Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na tri ba tʋ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ ba daa bá wanɩ ba zaŋɩ ba joori ba fɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ mʋ na? Aye! Bantʋ na vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn mʋ pɛ dwi-gɛtiinǝ wanɩ ba na vrɩm Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam mʋ taa jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ ba.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ dɩ abam dwi-gɛtiinǝ mʋ a lagɩ a ta taanɩ dɩntʋ. Amʋ na yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ sɩ a taa tɔɔlɩ o kwǝrǝ kam a brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ tɩn, a brɩ nɩ kʋ tiini kʋ yɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunu mʋ.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Amʋ kwaanɩ a tʋŋɩ sɩ kʋ pa wʋ-gʋʋ mʋ ja a donnǝ Yisɩrayɛlɩtiinǝ bam, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ pa Wɛ vrɩ ba badonnǝ amʋ tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Wɛ na yagɩ bantʋ tɩn, kʋ pɛ lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama laan ba ba fɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ. Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ joori DƖ joŋi-ba tɩn, kʋʋ́ ta nyɩ dɩ twa na joori ba na ŋwɩa te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ, nmʋ na dɛ yigǝ n fɔ dɩpɛ n tiŋi Wɛ ŋwaanɩ, dɩlʋ maama na daarɩ tɩn daa ta yɩ Wɛ nyɩm mʋ. Tiu kuri na yɩ Wɛ nyɩm, kʋ nɛ sɩm maama dɩ yɩ Wɛ nyɩm mʋ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam nyɩ dɩ Olivitiu ba na jǝri gaarɩ wʋnɩ te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Wɛ mʋ goni tiu kʋm kʋntʋ nɛ sɩdaara DƖ yagɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ kwe Olivi tiu kʋlʋ na wʋ gaa wʋnɩ tɩn nɛ DƖ toŋi DƖ gwaanɩ nɛ sɩdonnǝ sɩm wʋnɩ. Abam balʋ na yɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ tɩn nyɩ dɩ nɛ sɩlʋ ba na toŋi tɩn mʋ. Sɩ laan ma wǝri yɩ sɩ tɔgɩ sɩ naɩ tiu kʋm kugu kʋm nyʋa kam.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nmʋ yɩ ta n gooni nɛ sɩlʋ ba na goni ba yagɩ tɩn. Nmʋ na brɩ n tɩtɩ kʋntʋ, ta n ye sɩ kʋ daɩ nmʋ mʋ paɩ tiu kʋm kugu kʋm zɩga. Kʋ yɩ kugu kʋm mʋ jɩgɩ nmʋ.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan waɩ n tɛ nɩ: «Wɛ goni nɛ sɩm kʋntʋ DƖ yagɩ, kʋ daarɩ sɩ amʋ mʋ na jǝgǝ a toŋi tiu kʋm yɩra nɩ.»

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Wɛ nan goni nɛ sɩm kʋntʋ DƖ yagɩ, ba na wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nmʋ nan na wanɩ n toŋi tiu kʋm yɩra nɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ n na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nan yɩ zaŋɩ n ta n kɩ kamunni, za n ta n kwarɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Kʋ maama nan brɩ Wɛ na kɩ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ te, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ vaŋɩ nɔɔna zwa te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na kɩ ba cɔgɩ tɩn, DƖ vaŋɩ ba zwa mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ, nmʋ nan na wʋ yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm, DƖ wʋ́ ta kɩ nmʋ lanyɩranɩ. Nmʋ nan na yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam, DƖ laan wʋ́ go nmʋ dɩ DƖ yagɩ mʋ nɩ tiu naga te.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam nan na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa ba sɛ Wɛ, baá joori ba na ba jǝgǝ kam. Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ joori DƖ toŋi-ba da.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, nmʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ dwi-gɛ tu tɩn nyɩ dɩ naga kalʋ Wɛ na goni Olivi tiu kʋlʋ na wʋ gaa wʋnɩ tɩn yɩra nɩ mʋ. DƖ ma pa nmʋ toŋi Olivi tiu kʋlʋ na wʋ gaarɩ wʋnɩ tɩn yɩra nɩ, yɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ nɔɔna na yǝni ba kɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ bá ta cana dɩ Wɛ sɩ DƖ joori DƖ toŋi nɛ sɩlʋ DƖ ya na goni tɩn sɩ tɩtɩ kugu kʋm je nɩ. Wɛ jɩgɩ nɔɔna maama ŋwaŋa sɩ DƖ vrɩ-ba

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kalʋ dɛɛn na sǝgi tɩn mʋ. Abam na sɩɩnɩ á lwarɩ kʋntʋ, á daa bá ta bʋŋɩ nɩ á yɩ swan tiinǝ. Kʋ na yɩ te tɩn, lele kʋntʋ Yisɩrayɛlɩtiinǝ badaara wʋrʋ digili yɩ ba warɩ Wɛ cɩga kam kuri ba ni. Kʋ nan wʋ́ ta yɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kam dwi-gɛtiinǝ balʋ na sɛ Wɛ tɩn kɔgɔ kʋm na wʋ́ puli kʋ ti tɩn.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm maama laan wʋ́ na vrɩm, nɩ kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna na vrɩm tɩn wʋ́ nuŋi Siyɔnnɩ o ba, yɩ oó pa Zakɔbɩdwi tiinǝ bam lwarɩm dɩm ti.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Amʋ Wɛ wʋ́ go ni dɩntʋ a pa-ba, nɩ amʋ wʋ́ saarɩ ba lwarɩm dɩm a yagɩ.»

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na vɩn Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn, ba jigi Wɛ dʋna mʋ, yɩ kʋntʋ laan pa abam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam na vrɩm Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ Wɛ na kuri nɔɔna sɩ ba taa yɩ DƖ nɔɔna te tɩn laŋa nɩ, DƖ soe Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam, DƖ dɛɛn na goni ni dɩ ba nabaara bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan ba kɩ a ya na maanɩ, dɩ DƖ na kuri nɔɔna yɩ DƖ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Abam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɛɛn ya vɩn Wɛ mʋ, yɩ á laan ba á lwarɩ DƖ yibwǝn-durǝ kam, Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na vɩn Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan pɛ nɔɔna maama nyɩ nɩ ba wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ mʋ te, ba na vɩn DƖ ni tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ DƖ laan wanɩ DƖ duri ba maama yibwǝnǝ.

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: «Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ Baŋa-Wɛ wʋbʋŋa, naa o brɩ-DƖ DƖ na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o kwe o woŋo o jɩnɩ Wɛ.»

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ wǝǝnu maama nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ nii tɩ maama baŋa nɩ, yɩ tɩ maama yɩ dɩntʋ nyɩm mʋ. Wɛ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ mʋ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, Wɛ na tiini DƖ jɩgɩ abam ŋwaŋa kʋntʋ tɩn, a loori abam sɩ á kwe á tɩtɩ á pa Wɛ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba na mɛ woŋo ba kɩ kaanɩm ba pa Wɛ tɩn, sɩ á taá ŋwɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo, sɩ kʋ poli Wɛ wʋ lanyɩranɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ zulǝ yalʋ na maŋɩ sɩ á pa Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa á wʋbʋŋa taa tɔgɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn cwe sɩm. Kwaanɩ-na sɩ Wɛ pa á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dʋʋra, sɩ kʋ lǝni á ŋwɩa kam maama. Abam laan wʋ́ ba á lwarɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ á wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ kʋ tiini kʋ lana cɩga cɩga yɩ kʋ poli DƖ wʋ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Wɛ na kɩ-nɩ yu-yoŋo sɩ a taa yɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn, a lagɩ a ta dɩ abam maama sɩ á yɩ taá bʋŋɩ kamunni á pa á tɩtɩ, nɩ á dwe á na maŋɩ á yɩ te tɩn. Á nan taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ na pɛ abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa pɛɛrɩ te á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Nabiinu yɩra yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ, yɩ ya laan pɔɔrɩ je dwi tǝri tǝri. Jǝgǝ maama nan jɩgɩ ka tɩtʋŋa mʋ yɩra yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ dɩbam balʋ dɩ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn. Dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ daga, yɩ dɩ́ nan yɩ kɔgɔ dɩdʋa mʋ. Dɩbam maama dɩdʋa dɩdʋa maa tʋŋɩ dɩ́ wǝli daanɩ, nɩ yɩra yam je sɩm dwi tǝri tǝri na tʋŋɩ sɩ zǝni daanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Wɛ-pɛɛra yalʋ DƖ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn yɩ dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ, nɩ DƖ na pɛ dɩbam zaanɩ te tɩn. Wɛ na pɛ wʋlʋ waɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ yiyiu-ŋwɛ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o taa tɔgɩ o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn mʋ o ma ŋɔɔnɩ-sɩ.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ wʋlʋ waɩ o kwe nɔɔna sɩ ba na baarɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Wʋlʋ dɩ na cɛ o wǝǝnu o maa zǝni o donnǝ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o ma o wʋ-yoŋo mʋ o wǝli-ba lanyɩranɩ. Wʋlʋ nan na yɩ nɔɔna yigǝ tu tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o kwaanɩ o taa brɩ-ba cwǝŋǝ lanyɩranɩ. Wʋlʋ nan na duri o donnǝ yibwǝnǝ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa kɩ-kʋ dɩ wʋpolo mʋ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Á taá soe daanɩ dɩ cɩga. Á taá culi wo-lwaanʋ dwi maama, sɩ á daarɩ á taá kɩ kʋlʋ maama na lana tɩn.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Á na yɩ ko-biǝ daanɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn, á taá soe daanɩ dɩ á wʋrʋ maama, sɩ á taá nɩgɩ daanɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Á na jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Wɛ te tɩn, á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ ŋwaanɩ. Yaara na yi abam, sɩ á vɔ pu-dɩa. Kwaanɩ-na á taá loori Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Cɛ-na á wǝǝnu á ma zǝni balʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ yinigǝ jɩgɩ-ba tɩn. Á taá jeeri vǝrǝ lanyɩranɩ á sam nɩ.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ abam ba bɛɛsɩ tɩn, sɩ á taá loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ. Á nan yɩ sɔɔlɩ á cɔgɩ-ba.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Kɩ-na wʋpolo dɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ wʋpolo tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á wǝli dɩ balʋ na keeri tɩn á keeri.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Á taá jɩgɩ-na wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ. Á yɩ taá kɩ kamunni. Tu-na á tɩtɩ sɩ á taá tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-balɛ dɩ. Á yɩ taá bʋŋɩ á pa á jɩgɩ swan.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na kɩ abam lwarɩm, á dɩ daa yɩ joori á kɩ-o lwarɩm á ma ŋwɩ. Nan kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá kɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na lanyɩranɩ sɩ á taá zʋʋrɩ dɩ ywǝǝni nɔɔna maama tɩtarɩ nɩ, nɩ á na waɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ta pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ dʋm kana na wɔɛ, sɩ n pa-o wʋdiu sɩ o di. Na-nyɔm na jɩg-o, sɩ n pa-o na sɩ o nyɔ. N na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa cavɩɩra tiini ya ja-o.»

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Abam nan yɩ pa lwarɩm wanɩ abam. Á taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ sɩ tɩ wanɩ lwarɩm dam tɩ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Abam maama maŋɩ sɩ á sɛ dɩdɛɛra balʋ na te á tɩɩnɩ dɩm tɩn ni, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ba jɩgɩ dam sɩ o taa te o doŋ yɩ Wɛ wʋ pɛ kʋ tu cwǝŋǝ. Dɩdɛɛra balʋ na wʋra tɩn yɩ Wɛ mʋ tiŋi-ba.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na vɩn dɩdɛɛra bam kʋntʋ ni tɩn, kʋ tu vɩn cwǝŋǝ kalʋ Wɛ na tiŋi tɩn mʋ. Balʋ na kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn wʋ́ na cam.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Dɩdɛɛra bam nan ba paɩ fʋʋnɩ jɩgɩ balʋ na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩn. Fʋʋnɩ jɩgɩ balʋ na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn mʋ. Nmʋ na ba lagɩ sɩ fʋʋnɩ taa jɩgɩ-m dɩ dɩdɛɛra bam, n maŋɩ sɩ n ta n kɩ kǝm-laarʋ mʋ sɩ kʋ pa n na zulǝ ba tee nɩ.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan tiŋi dɩdɛɛra bam sɩ ba taa tʋŋɩ ba pa-DƖ abam zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Abam nan na kɩ wo-balwaarʋ, á maŋɩ sɩ á taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩdɛɛra bam sɩɩnɩ ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba pa nɔɔna na cam. Bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ Wɛ na tiŋi sɩ ba tɔgɩ DƖ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm ŋwaanɩ ba ma pa balʋ na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn na cam.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ á maŋɩ sɩ á sɛ ba ni. Kʋ daɩ ba na wʋ́ pa á na cam tɩn yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ. Á sɛ-ba, bɛŋwaanɩ á ye á bɩcara nɩ, nɩ á maŋɩ sɩ á tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ mʋ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Kʋ ta yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ á maŋɩ sɩ á taá ŋwɩ lampoo. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩdɛɛra bam tʋŋɩ ba pa Wɛ mʋ, dɩ ba na kwaanɩ ba tʋŋɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu tɩm brɩ nɩ: «Yɩ kɩ boorim, yɩ gʋ nɔɔnʋ, yɩ ŋɔnɩ, yɩ pa n yi zʋ n donnǝ wǝǝnu.» Cullu tɩm kʋntʋ dɩdaanɩ Wɛ niǝ yam maama nan tɔgɩ ni dɩdʋa mʋ. Ni dɩntʋ nan mʋ wɩ: «Ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te.»

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Á taá kɩ-na kʋntʋ, sɩ abam ye maŋa kalʋ wʋnɩ dɩ́ na wʋra tɩn. Maŋa yi sɩ á zaŋɩ á yagɩ dɔɔm. Maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ vrɩ dɩbam tɩn daarɩ fɩɩn sɩ ka yi, yɩ kʋ daa daɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ dɛɛn na puli dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ balʋ na wʋ pooni wʋnɩ te tɩn. Á nan pa-na dɩ́ yagɩ nɔn-kwǝlim dɩ sa-nyɔrɩ dɩ boorim dɩ wo-digiru kikiǝ maama. Á yɩ taá jaanɩ daanɩ naa á taá kɩ wʋ-gʋʋ daanɩ.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Pa-na abam ŋwɩa kam dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwɩa kam taa yɩ bɩdwɩ. Nan yɩ pa-na á wʋbʋŋa taa tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ á fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Joŋi-na nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ wʋbʋŋa ta na wʋ bɩgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn lanyɩranɩ. Á nan yɩ magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ o na bʋŋɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋra o wʋbʋŋa na bɩga Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, kʋ ma pa o ba culi kʋlʋkʋlʋ dim. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ wʋra o wʋbʋŋa na wʋ bɩgɩ yɩ kʋ pa o culi nwam.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Nmʋ yɩ wɔɔ mʋ sɩ n co nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ tɩntʋŋnʋ? Kʋ yɩ o tɩtɩ yuutu wʋm mʋ maŋɩ sɩ o nii o kɩ cɩga naa o wʋ kɩ. Wʋlʋ na yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɔɔnʋ tɩn kɩ lanyɩranɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ wanɩ o pa o taa kɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋra o na lɩ dɛ o pa dɩ dwe da yadonnǝ yam. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɩ maa wʋra o na ba kuri da yam daanɩ. Nɔɔnʋ maama nan maŋɩ sɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ o na ye o bɩcarɩ nɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Dɩbam wʋlʋwʋlʋ ba ŋwɩ o tɩtɩ yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ wʋlʋ nan na tɩgɩ dɩ, kʋ ta daɩ o tɩtɩ yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi tɩgɩ yɩ o joori o bi o na ŋwɩa, sɩ o taa yɩ twa dɩ naŋʋna Yuutu mʋ.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n co n ko-bu? Sɩ nmʋ dɩ, bɛɛ mʋ yɩ n gooni n ko-bu? Dɩbam maama nan lagɩ dɩ́ ba dɩ́ zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ mʋ, sɩ DƖ di dɩbam taanɩ.

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ dɩbam maama lagɩ dɩ́ ba dɩ́ zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ mʋ, sɩ nɔɔnʋ maama ta kʋlʋ o na kɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa dɩ́ ko-bu tusi Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ daa yɩ ta co dɩ́ donnǝ. Nan lɩ-na wʋbʋŋa sɩ á yɩ kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa á ko-bu tusi naa o yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm tɩn.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Amʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn, amʋ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ wʋdiu tǝrǝ kʋ tɩtɩ na yɩ wo-digiru Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na pɛ woŋo kʋlʋ yɩ culu, kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ culu mʋ kʋ pa nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan na pɛ n ko-bu wʋ cɔgɩ dɩ n na di wʋdiu kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ n daa n ba tɔgɩ sono cwǝŋǝ mʋ. Yɩ pa nmʋ na di wʋdiu kʋlʋ tɩn cɔgɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩ Wɛ daanɩ, yɩ o yɩ wʋlʋ Zezi Krisi na tɩgɩ o ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Yɩ pa nɔɔna na cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba co woŋo kʋlʋ na lana dɩ nmʋ tɩn.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na yɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm nɔɔna te tɩn ba tɔgɩ wʋdiiru dim ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan tɔgɩ dɩ́ na kɩ cɩga Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, dɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ wʋpolo, nɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na paɩ dɩbam te tɩn.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na tʋŋɩ o pa Zezi Krisi kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ poli Wɛ wʋ, yɩ nɔɔna dɩ wʋ́ pa-o cɩga.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ kʋlʋ maama na paɩ nɔɔna jɩgɩ ywǝǝni daanɩ yɩ kʋ zǝni-ba sɩ ba bɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Yɩ pa wʋdiiru dim cɔgɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa. Wʋdiiru maama maŋɩ dim mʋ. Nmʋ nan na di kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa n doŋ wʋ cɔgɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, sɩ n yagɩ kʋ dim.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kʋ lana sɩ n yɩ kɩ kʋlʋ maama na wʋ́ pa n ko-bu tusi Wɛ cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ nwana dim naa sana nyɔm naa kʋlʋ maama dɩ.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na ye kʋlʋ n wʋbʋŋa nɩ kantʋ laŋa nɩ tɩn, ta n jɩgɩ-kʋ nmʋ dɩ Wɛ laŋa nɩ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ye kʋlʋ na lana sɩ o kɩ yɩ o ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa yale kʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa dɩ o na di wʋdiu kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu bá na bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ brɩ nɩ o ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa o dim dɩm wʋnɩ. Woŋo kʋlʋ maama nmʋ na wʋ́ kɩ yɩ n ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa tɩn, kʋ yɩ lwarɩm mʋ.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Dɩbam balʋ wʋbʋŋa na bɩgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá wǝli balʋ wʋbʋŋa ta na wʋ bɩgɩ tɩn mʋ, ba wʋbʋŋa ta na bwǝnǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ kʋlʋ na poli dɩbam yɩranɩ wʋrʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi dɛɛn nan wʋ kɩ kʋlʋ na poli o yɩranɩ wʋ tɩn, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ te kʋ wɩ: «Trʋ tɩlʋ nɔɔna na twɩ nmʋ Baŋa-Wɛ tɩn mʋ joori tɩ tʋ amʋ yuu nɩ.»

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna pu-dɩa dɩ baarɩ tɩn, yɩ dɩntʋ wʋ́ pa á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa abam maama sɛ daanɩ yɩ á taá jɩgɩ ni dɩdwɩ á ma zuli Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi Ko tɩn.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam nɩ Zezi Krisi tu sɩ o tʋŋɩ o pa Zwifǝbam mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ na goni ni dɩ ba nabaara bam te tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ yɩ cɩga tu.

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: O tum dɩm ta yɩ sɩ kʋ pa dwi-gɛtiinǝ bam dɩ mʋ ba ba zuli Wɛ DƖ na jɩgɩ ba yibwǝnǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ te kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ wǝli dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam a zuli nmʋ, yɩ a leeni a tee nmʋ yɩrɩ.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Kʋ ta pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Abam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam wǝli-na dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama á taá kɩ wʋpolo.»

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Kʋ ta wɩ: «Abam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam maama taá zuli-na Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ. Pa-na lʋgʋ baŋa dwi maama taa tee-DƖ.»

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Ezayidɩ dɛɛn tagɩ o wɩ: «Zesedwi dɩm tu dɩdʋa wʋ́ zaŋɩ o ba sɩ o taa te lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama, yɩ bantʋ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ tɩɩna o ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Wɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ á jɩgɩ tɩɩna tɩn wʋ́ pa á tiini á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ wʋ-zuru, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ Joro kʋm dam laan wʋ́ pa á na jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Wɛ te tɩn fɔgɩ kʋ puli kʋ ja gaalɩ. Pooli na ŋɔɔnɩ o tɩtʋŋa yam woŋo te tɩn

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ tɩtɩ ye nɩ abam kɩ kǝm-laarʋ zanzan mʋ, yɩ á tiini á jɩgɩ yǝno kʋ paɩ á waɩ á brɩ daanɩ dɩ Wɛ cɩga kam.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Amʋ pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩdonnǝ dɩ baarɩ mʋ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ wʋnɩ, sɩ a maa guli abam wǝǝnu tɩlʋ á na maŋɩ á zaasɩ tɩn. Amʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋntʋ dɩ Wɛ na pɛ-nɩ yu-yoŋo,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ dwi-gɛtiinǝ bam ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ. Amʋ na tʋŋɩ a pa Wɛ te tɩn yɩ sɩ a yǝni a tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam mʋ, sɩ a wanɩ a joŋi dwi-gɛ tiinǝ a kɩ-ba Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ ba pa DƖ wʋ poli, DƖ Jorokʋm na fɔgɩ kʋ kwɛ ba bɩcara tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, amʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, a kɩ wʋpolo dɩ a na tʋŋɩ a pa Wɛ te tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ba jɩgɩ baarɩ sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ, kʋ na daɩ Zezi Krisi na mɛ amʋ o kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩranɩ. Kʋ yɩ Zezi mʋ pɛ kʋ tɔgɩ dɩ a ni-taanɩ dɩ a tɩtʋŋa yɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam sɛ Wɛ.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: Ba ma sɛ Wɛ dɩ DƖ na dɛ DƖ Joro kʋm dam ŋwaanɩ DƖ pa ba na wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ maana yalʋ na brɩ DƖ dam tɩn. Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ amʋ zɩgɩ Zeruzalɛm nɩ a tʋlɩ je sɩm maama a vu a yi Yiliiri, yɩ a brɩ Wɛ cɩga kalʋ maama na yɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ te kʋ wɩ: «Ba ta na wʋ tɔɔlɩ o kwǝrǝ ba brɩ balʋ tɩn laan wʋ́ ba ba lwarɩ-ka. Balʋ ta na wʋ ni o ŋwa tɩn laan wʋ́ ba ba ni o cɩga kam kuri.» Pooli na bʋŋɩ sɩ o vu o na Rom tiinǝ bam te tɩn

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri amʋ gɛ laŋa kuni zanzan sɩ a ba abam te.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ jǝgǝ daa tǝrǝ ba na wʋ ni Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam da. Abam fra na maŋɩ ya jɩgɩ amʋ bɩna zanzan sɩ a ba a na abam tɩn,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: amʋ laan bʋŋɩ sɩ a ba maŋa kalʋ a na lagɩ a zaŋɩ a vu Ɛsɩpanyɩ tɩn. Amʋ lagɩ sɩ a tɔgɩ abam te, sɩ a wanɩ a kɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam maŋa fɩnfɩɩn, sɩ á laan wanɩ á wǝli-nɩ sɩ a kwe cwǝŋǝ a kɛ.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Masɩdʋanɩ dɩ Akayi tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn mʋ mɛ ba wʋbʋŋa ba la sǝbu, sɩ ba ma wǝli Zezi nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ yɩ yinigǝ jɩgɩ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ ba tɩtɩ mʋ mɛ ba wʋbʋŋa ba kɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ ba wǝli-ba kʋntʋ doŋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Zwifǝ bam ya maŋɩ ba kwe wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Wɛ Jorona pɛ-ba tɩn mʋ ba cɛ dɩ dwi-gɛtiinǝ bam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam maŋɩ sɩ ba dɩ daa wǝli Zwifǝ bam dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na yɩ ba yɩra zǝnǝ nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Amʋ na ti tɩtʋŋɩ dɩntʋ yɩ a kwe sǝbu kʋm maama a kɩ nɔɔna bam jɩŋa nɩ, amʋ laan wʋ́ tɔgɩ abam te, yɩ a daarɩ a kɛ a vu Ɛsɩpanyɩ.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ye nɩ, a na tu abam te, Zezi Krisi wʋ́ kɩ abam lanyɩranɩ kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ nan lagɩ a loori abam dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, dɩ sono kʋlʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ dɩbam tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ á tɔgɩ á wǝli-nɩ á taá tiini á loori Wɛ á pa-nɩ a tɩtʋŋ-cɛɛra yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Loori-na Wɛ, sɩ DƖ joŋi-nɩ balʋ na wʋ Zude nɩ yɩ ba vɩn Zezi tɩn jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa Zezi nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn joŋi kʋlʋ amʋ na wʋ́ pa-ba tɩn dɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Wɛ na sɛ, amʋ laan wʋ́ wanɩ a ba abam te dɩ wʋpolo, yɩ a di ywǝǝni dɩ abam.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Bɩcarɩ-zuru Tu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ ta wʋ abam tee nɩ. Amina.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a brɩ abam dɩ́ ko-bu Feebe na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn mʋ. Wʋntʋ yɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ o wǝli Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Sankrɩ nɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á joŋ-o lanyɩranɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ, nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ sɩ Wɛ nɔɔna taa kɩ te tɩn. Á taá wǝl-o dɩ kʋlʋ maama o na lagɩ abam tee nɩ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ zǝni nɔɔna zanzan, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ dɩ amʋ dɩ.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Prisili dɩ Akwila á pa-nɩ. Bantʋ mʋ tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ yɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa Zezi Krisi.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ba ya gɛ fɩɩn sɩ ba tɩ amʋ ŋwaanɩ. Amʋ nan kɩ-ba le, kʋ nan daɩ amʋ yɩranɩ, kʋ yɩ dwi-gɛtiinǝ balʋ maama na tu ba sɛ Zezi tɩn dɩ mʋ kɩ-ba le.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ tɩn á pa-nɩ. Jɔɔnɩ-na amʋ ciloŋ-sono Yipayinɛtɩ á pa-nɩ, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na dɛ yigǝ o sɛ Zezi Krisi Azi tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Mari wʋlʋ na tiini o tʋŋɩ o pa abam tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na amʋ dwi tiinǝ Andronikusi dɩ Zuniyasɩ. Bantʋ mʋ ya tɔgɩ ba wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ dɩ amʋ. Ba yɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ yɩr-ŋʋm Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam wʋnɩ, yɩ bantʋ sɛ Zezi Krisi ba loori amʋ.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Ampiliatusi wʋlʋ na yɩ a ciloŋ-sono dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn á pa-nɩ.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Yuribɛn wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam o tʋŋɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtʋŋa tɩn, dɩdaanɩ amʋ ciloŋ-sono Sɩtakisi dɩ.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Apeeli wʋlʋ na brɩ nɩ o yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ cɩga cɩga tɩn á pa-nɩ. Jɔɔnɩ-na Arisobuli sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam dɩ.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na amʋ dwi tu Erodiyɔn á pa-nɩ. Jɔɔnɩ-na balʋ na yɩ Narisisi sɔŋɔ tiinǝ yɩ ba yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɔɔna tɩn á pa-nɩ.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Trifɛnɩ dɩ Trifɔsɩ, bantʋ mʋ yɩ kaana balʋ na tiini ba tʋŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩtʋŋa yam tɩn. Jɔɔnɩ-na a ko-bu-sono Pɛɛrsidi, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ dɩ na tiini o tʋŋɩ o pa dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Rufusi wʋlʋ na yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm tɩn, dɩ o nu wʋlʋ na kɩ amʋ lanyɩranɩ nɩ o tɩtɩ bu te tɩn.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Asɩnkriti dɩ Filigon dɩ Ɛrmɛsɩ dɩ Patrobasɩ dɩ Ɛrmasɩ, dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ maama na wʋ ba tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Filologi dɩ Zuli, dɩ Neere dɩ o nakɔ, dɩ Olimpa, dɩdaanɩ Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ maama na wʋ ba tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Á na jeeri daanɩ, sɩ á taá jɔɔnɩ daanɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ sono dɩ wʋ-poŋo. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm na wʋ je sɩlʋ maama nɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a nan loori abam sɩ á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ balʋ na jaanɩ kampwara ba tui nɔɔna tɩtarɩ, yɩ ba paɩ ba tusi Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ jɩgɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ ba na brɩ abam tɩn ba yáala. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ja-na á tɩtɩ dɩ ba.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama ye abam na tɔgɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ te tɩn, kʋntʋ mʋ paɩ amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam. Amʋ nan lagɩ sɩ abam taá jɩgɩ swan mʋ sɩ á taá kɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á taá ye á tɩtɩ sɩ lwarɩm yɩ cɔgɩ abam.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna wʋ-zuru tɩn bá daanɩ DƖ cɔgɩ sʋtaanɩdam, yɩ DƖ laan pa á nɔ-dɩ dɩ á nɛ. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Timoti wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ o tʋŋɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam. Amʋ dwi tiinǝ Lukiyusi dɩ Zazɔn dɩ Sosipatɛɛrɩ dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Amʋ Tɛrɩtiyusi mʋ pʋpʋnɩ Pooli ni-taanɩ dɩntʋ yɩ o pa abam, amʋ dɩ nan jɔɔnɩ abam dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo. Amina.] Pooli na kɩ Wɛ le te o ma guri tɩn

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le, dɩntʋ dam dɩm mʋ paɩ á fɔgɩ á zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ á na sɛ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ amʋ na tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ abam laan tu á lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kalʋ dɛɛn ya na sǝgi faŋa faŋa tɩn.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ Wɛ na kuri dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ, yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Sositɛnɩ dɩ tɔgɩ o wǝli-nɩ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Maŋa maama a yǝni a kɩ Wɛ le abam ŋwaanɩ, dɩ DƖ na pɛ abam yu-yoŋo Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, dɩ́ dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝrǝ kam dɩ abam tɩn, ka tiini ka ja kuri abam tee nɩ.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Á nɛ Wɛ pɛɛra yalʋ maama á na lagɩ tɩn, yɩ á cǝgi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi sɩ o joori o ba sɩ dɩ́ na-o.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Wɛ yɩ cɩga tu, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ kuri abam sɩ á taá ŋwɩ dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi, o na yɩ dɩbam Yuutu tɩn. Korɛntɩ tiinǝ ya na pɔɔrɩ daanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a loori abam dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ sɩ á taá jɩgɩ ni-mɔrɔ, sɩ á yɩ taá pɔɔrɩ daanɩ. Á nan kwaanɩ-na á kɩ á wʋbʋŋa daanɩ, sɩ á kɩ ni dɩdwɩ.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: A tagɩ kʋntʋ, Klowe-ba sɔŋɔ tiinǝ na tagɩ dɩ amʋ ba wɩ á magɩ kantɔgɔ mʋ daanɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Abam badaara wɩ, á tɔgɩ Pooli mʋ. Abam badonnǝ maa wɩ, á tɔgɩ Apolɔsɩ mʋ. Badonnǝ maa wɩ, ba tɔgɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ mʋ. Babam dɩ maa wɩ, ba tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi mʋ.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Abam bʋŋɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi pɔɔrɩ yɩra yɩra mʋ na? Amʋ Pooli mʋ tɩgɩ tʋʋn-dagarakam baŋa nɩ abam ŋwaanɩ na? Ba miisi abam na wʋnɩ amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: A kɩ Wɛ le, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ wʋ miisi abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ na wʋnɩ, kʋ na daɩ Krisipu dɩ Gayusi yɩranɩ.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ta nɩ a miisi abam na wʋnɩ amʋ yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Ah, a guli a ta na miisi Sɩtefanasɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ dɩ, kʋ daarɩ kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, wʋlʋ na wǝli da, a daa wʋ guli.

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi tʋʋnɩ dɩm dagara kam baŋa nɩ tɩn taanɩ dɩm yɩ jwǝrim mʋ balʋ yigǝ na tǝrǝ dɩ Wɛ tɩn tee nɩ. Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam balʋ Wɛ na vrɩ lwarɩm wʋnɩ tɩn, taanɩ dɩntʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ dam mʋ dɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ swan tiinǝ wʋbʋŋa, yɩ a daarɩ a pa yi-pʋrɩ-nyɩna yi-pʋrʋ kʋm yáalɩ.»

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Swan tiinǝ swan yam daa jɩgɩ kuri na? Tɔn-yeenǝ dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na ye ŋwaŋa tɩn yi-pʋrʋ kʋm jɩgɩ kuri na? Wɛ nan brɩ dɩbam nɩ lʋgʋ baŋa swan yam maama yɩ jwǝrim mʋ.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Wɛ swan yam ŋwaanɩ nabiinǝ bá wanɩ ba ma ba tɩtɩ swan ba lwarɩ-DƖ. Wɛ nan lɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa sɩ DƖ tɔgɩ kwǝrǝ kalʋ dɩ́ na brɩ nɔɔna yɩ ba paɩ ka yɩ jwǝrim tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, DƖ ma vrɩ balʋ na sɛ kwǝrǝ kam tɩn DƖ yagɩ.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na tɩgɩ tʋʋn-dagarabaŋa nɩ tɩn kwǝrǝ mʋ. Kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ maa yɩ ta-balɔrɔ mʋ Zwifǝ bam tee nɩ, yɩ ka yɩ jwǝrim mʋ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam dɩ.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ nɔɔna na paɩ kʋ yɩ jwǝrim Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn garɩ nabiinǝ swan maama, yɩ kʋlʋ na bwǝmmǝ DƖ tee nɩ tɩn dana kʋ dwe nabiinǝ dam maama.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á bʋŋɩ á dɛɛn na yɩ te yɩ Wɛ laan ba DƖ kuri abam tɩn. Kʋ daɩ á zanzan yi dɛɛn mʋ pʋʋrɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ nabiinǝ na lagɩ yi-pʋrʋ kʋlʋ tɩn. Kʋ daɩ á zanzan mʋ yɩ dɩdɛɛra, naa á zanzan mʋ nuŋi nadunǝ sam.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan kuri balʋ nabiinǝ na paɩ ba yɩ jwǝǝru tɩn mʋ, sɩ DƖ ma pa cavɩɩra di swan tiinǝ. DƖ ma kuri balʋ nabiinǝ na paɩ ba yɩ nabwǝnǝ tɩn, sɩ DƖ ma pa cavɩɩra di dam tiinǝ.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: DƖ ma daarɩ DƖ kuri balʋ nabiinǝ na gooni yɩ ba ba nɩgɩ tɩn, sɩ DƖ ma pa wǝǝnu tɩlʋ nabiinǝ na paɩ tɩ jɩgɩ kuri tɩn ji kafɛ.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Wɛ kuri nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ, sɩ nabiinǝ yɩ zaŋɩ ba wanɩ ba tee ba tɩtɩ DƖ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ dɛɛn na tu abam te tɩn, a wʋ ŋɔɔnɩ swan naa yiyiu-ŋwɛ zanzan dɩ abam, dɩ a na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam a brɩ abam te tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: A wʋ kɩ a wʋbʋŋa nɩ sɩ a brɩ abam woŋo kʋdoŋ, kʋ na daɩ Zezi Krisi taanɩ dɩm yɩranɩ dɩ o tʋʋnɩ dɩm dagara kam baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: A taanɩ dɩm dɩ a na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam te tɩn, kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ swan mʋ a ma a tɔɔlɩ-ka sɩ a pa á sɛ. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ Jorokʋm dam mʋ pɛ abam lwarɩ nɩ taanɩ dɩm yɩ cɩga.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ dam dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ swan ŋwaanɩ. Baŋa-Wɛ swan na yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan yǝni dɩ́ brɩ balʋ wʋbʋŋa na bɩgɩ tɩn mʋ swan, ya nan daɩ nabiinǝ swan naa lʋgʋ baŋa dɩdɛɛra bam swan. Bantʋ wʋ́ ba ba cɔgɩ dɩ ba dam dɩm maama.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa dɩdɛɛra bam wʋlʋwʋlʋ nan wʋ lwarɩ ya kuri. Ba ya na ye, ba ya bá ja Wɛ-sɔŋɔ paarɩ tu Zezi ba pa tʋʋn-dagarabaŋa nɩ ba gʋ.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan kɩ nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ fɔgɩ DƖ kɩ wo-laarʋ DƖ tiŋi sɩ DƖ pa balʋ na so-DƖ tɩn. Nabiinǝ yi wʋ nɛ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ doŋ, yɩ ba zwa wʋ ni tɩ ŋwa, yɩ ba ba jɩgɩ tɩ wʋbʋŋa dɩ.»

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan tagɩ DƖ Jorokʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ ma pa dɩ́ lwarɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ. Wɛ Joro kʋm ye woŋo maama kuri, yɩ kʋ ye Wɛ wʋbʋŋa maama dɩ.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ nabiinu wʋbʋŋa o lwarɩ, kʋ na daɩ o tɩtɩ joro? Kʋ nan yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ Wɛ dɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yǝri Wɛ wʋbʋŋa, kʋ na daɩ DƖ tɩtɩ Joro kʋm yɩranɩ.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Joro kʋlʋ Wɛ na kɩ dɩbam bɩcara nɩ tɩn daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm. Kʋ nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ lwarɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ dɩbam zaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm na tǝri wʋlʋ bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn ba sɛ sɩ o joŋi cɩga kalʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm na brɩ tɩn. Ka yɩ wo-jwǝǝru mʋ o tee nɩ. O bá wanɩ o lwarɩ ka kuri, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ brɩ ka kuri cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama Wɛ Joro kʋm na wʋ o bɩcarɩ nɩ tɩn mʋ waɩ o ye woŋo maama kuri. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o na kʋntʋ tu wo-lɔŋɔ o ta.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋbʋŋa, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o brɩ-o o na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn.» Wɛ nan na pɛ dɩbam DƖ Joro kʋm tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩbam dɩ jɩgɩ Zezi Krisi wʋbʋŋa yam.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a dɛɛn na wʋ abam tee nɩ tɩn, a warɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm dɩ abam nɩ Wɛ Jorokʋm na wʋ balʋ tee nɩ tɩn. A dɛɛn ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ abam nɩnɛɛnɩ á yɩ balʋ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu fra na jɩgɩ-ba tɩn, yɩ á ta nyɩ nɩ bu-balwa mʋ te Zezi Krisi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ á ta yɩ balʋ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu fra na jɩgɩ tɩn mʋ. Abam jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ yɩ á magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ. Kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ fra mʋ taa jɩgɩ abam, yɩ á kɩ nɩ balʋ ta na yǝri Wɛ tɩn mʋ te. Kʋ yɩ vwan mʋ a fɔgɩ na?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Abam wʋ nɔɔna badonnǝ na tɛ ba wɩ, bam tɔgɩ Pooli mʋ, yɩ badonnǝ dɩ wɩ, ba tɔgɩ Apolɔsɩ mʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn kikiǝ mʋ kʋntʋ na?

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nyɩ nɩ vala mʋ te, amʋ Pooli mʋ jǝri wǝǝnu yɩ Apolɔsɩ yagɩ na. Kʋ daarɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ paɩ tɩ bɩra.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri wʋlʋ na jǝri dɩ wʋlʋ na yagɩ na da tɩn maama daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Wɛ yɩranɩ mʋ waɩ DƖ paɩ DƖ taanɩ dɩm kɩ dam nɔɔna bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na jǝri dɩ wʋlʋ na yagɩ na tɩn maama yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa ba maama joŋi ba ŋwɩɩrʋ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba na tʋŋɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ amʋ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ sɩ a ma tʋŋɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ amʋ cwi digǝ kam kuri mʋ lanyɩranɩ nɩ lwar-ŋʋm te. Nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ dɩ maa wʋra o lɔ o daŋɩ da. Wʋlʋ maama nan na lagɩ sɩ o lɔ o daŋɩ da tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa ye o na lɔ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama na tʋŋɩ kʋlʋ tɩn nan wʋ́ ba kʋ lwarɩ jaja dɛ dɩm Zezi Krisi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn, mini mʋ wʋ́ brɩ nɔɔnʋ maama tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Balʋ na lɔgɩ dɩ wo-laarʋ yɩ mini dɩm wʋ wanɩ dɩ di tɩn wʋ́ joŋi ba ŋwɩɩrʋ.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, balʋ mini dɩm na wanɩ dɩ di ba lɔɔm dɩm tɩn, ba bá na kʋlʋkʋlʋ Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ za wʋ́ vrɩ ba tɩtɩ DƖ yagɩ. Ba nan wʋ́ ta nyɩ dɩ mini na di nɔɔnʋ yɩ o wǝri te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ, Wɛ Joro kʋm na wʋ abam bɩcara nɩ tɩn, á nyɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ digǝ mʋ DƖ na zʋʋrɩ ka wʋnɩ na?

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o ganɩ o tɩtɩ. Abam wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ swan nɩ zɩm lʋgʋ baŋa swan na yɩ te tɩn, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o joori o ji joro mʋ, sɩ o laan wanɩ o na swan cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa swan yɩ jwǝrim mʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ vugimi swan tiinǝ swan DƖ pa ya joori ya ja-ba.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daa ta pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ ye nɩ swan tiinǝ wʋbʋŋa maama yɩ kafɛ mʋ.»

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ Pooli dɩ Apolɔsɩ dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ, dɩbam dɩ yɩ abam nɔɔna mʋ. Kʋ nan na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ ŋwɩa dɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩ zɩm dɩ jwa dɩ, abam mʋ te tɩ maama.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi nan mʋ te abam, yɩ Wɛ dɩ te Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ dɩ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Ba nan na kwe woŋo ba kɩ nɔɔnʋ jɩŋa nɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa nii kʋ baŋa nɩ dɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kwe a tɩtɩ dɩdaanɩ Apolɔsɩ a ma maŋɩ a brɩ abam, sɩ á wanɩ á nii dɩbam, á ma lwarɩ á na wʋ́ taá kɩ te tɩn, sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á gaalɩ kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa yɩ zaŋɩ o kɩ kamunni o zuli nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ o daarɩ o gooni o doŋ.

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Abam bʋŋɩ nɩ á maŋɩ á jɩgɩ kʋlʋ maama á na lagɩ tɩn, á kwǝri á yɩ nadunǝ, yɩ á ta bʋŋɩ nɩ abam di paarɩ á daarɩ dɩbam. Kʋ ya lana sɩ á sɩɩnɩ á di paarɩ, sɩ dɩbam dɩ taá tɔgɩ dɩ́ di paarɩ dɩ abam.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Amʋ na bʋŋɩ te tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ Wɛ pɛ dɩbam balʋ na yɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋna tɩn ji kwaga tiinǝ mʋ nɔɔna bam maama wʋnɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ balʋ ba na di ba taanɩ ba lagɩ ba gʋ-ba te tɩn. Dɩbam nyɩ dɩ nɔn-mwaanʋ mʋ lʋgʋ kʋm nɔɔna bam dɩ malɛsɩdɩ yibiyǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Dɩbam jigi jwǝǝru mʋ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ, abam nan pa á yɩ swan tiinǝ mʋ Zezi Krisi tɔgɩm dɩm wʋnɩ. Dɩbam yɩ nabwǝnǝ mʋ, abam maa paɩ á yɩ dɩdɛɛra. Nɔɔna zuli abam, yɩ ba daarɩ ba gooni dɩbam.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Dɩ zɩm maama dɩ, kana dɩ na-nyɔm jɩgɩ dɩbam, yɩ gwaarʋ muri dɩbam. Nɔɔna maa bɛɛsɩ dɩbam, yɩ dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ cirigim jǝgǝ.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna na ŋɔɔnɩ wo-lwaanʋ ba pa dɩbam, dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ joori dɩ́ lǝri-ba lanyɩranɩ mʋ. Dɩbam nyɩ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa weeru mʋ. Dɩ zɩm maama, dɩ́ nyɩ dɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ mʋ nɔɔnʋ maama tee nɩ.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: A na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ tɩn, a pʋpʋnɩ sɩ a ma kwe abam mʋ, á na yɩ amʋ bu-sonnu tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ a lagɩ sɩ a kɩ abam cavɩɩra mʋ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Abam ya na maŋɩ á jɩgɩ karanyɩna tiinǝ mʋrr-fugǝ mʋ ba na brɩ abam Zezi Krisi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, á ko yɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ. Amʋ yɩ á ko, dɩ a na brɩ abam Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam yɩ á na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri a loori abam sɩ á taá lwǝni amʋ na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tʋŋɩ Timoti á tee nɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ a bu-sono Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, yɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɩ cɩga. Wʋntʋ wʋ́ guli abam amʋ ŋwɩa kam na yɩ te Zezi Krisi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ nɩ amʋ na yǝni a brɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm je maama nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Abam badaara paɩ á tɩtɩ kamunni mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ á daa ba bʋŋɩ nɩ amʋ wʋ́ joori a ba abam te.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan na sɛ, aá ba abam te lele. A na tuǝ, a laan wʋ́ wanɩ a lwarɩ kamun-nyɩna bam kʋntʋ na jɩgɩ dam dɩlʋ ba ma kɩ tɩn, yɩ kʋ daa daɩ ba ni-ŋwaŋa yɩranɩ má.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Abam lagɩ sɩ a ba abam te a vaŋɩ á zwɛ mʋ naa á lagɩ sɩ a brɩ abam sono dɩ wʋ-bono mʋ?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ni abam labaarɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ karɩ o boorǝ. Ba wɩ, abam wʋnɩ baarʋ dɩdʋa mʋ tigi dɩ o ko kaanɩ. Balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɩn dɩ maŋɩ ba ba sɛ ba kɩ wo-zɔɔna yantʋ doŋ.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ kamunni te tɩn, kʋ wʋ maŋɩ. Á ye nɩ dabɩlɩ fɩnfɩɩn na wʋ dɩpɛ muni dɩlʋ ba na viiri tɩn wʋnɩ, kʋ laan wʋ́ pa dɩ maama fʋlɩ mʋ.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ di candiǝ nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ te tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ lɩ lwarɩm dɩdaanɩ tɩtʋŋ-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama na nyɩ nɩ dabɩlɩ-doori te tɩn dɩ́ wʋnɩ, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo dɩ cɩga, nɩ dɩpɛ dɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ dabɩlɩ dɩ wʋnɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na dɛ yigǝ a pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋlʋ a pa abam tɩn, a tagɩ dɩ abam sɩ á yɩ taá tɔgɩ dɩdaanɩ balʋ na karɩ ba boori tɩn.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Amʋ na kaanɩ abam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ yɩ ba boori tɩn, naa ba yɩ wo-swǝn-nyɩna naa ŋwɩɩna naa jwǝ-kaana tɩn taanɩ mʋ a tɛa. Abam bá wanɩ á pwɛ á tɩtɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ kʋ na daɩ nɩ á yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa.

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam mʋ wʋ́ ba ba di nabiinǝ maama taanɩ na? Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, bɛɛ mʋ kɩa yɩ á tɩtɩ warɩ á kwɛ wo-balwa balʋ na wʋ á tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ dɩbam mʋ wʋ́ di malɛsɩsɩm taanɩ na? Kʋ nan na yɩ kʋntʋ, dɩ́ bá wanɩ zɩm lʋgʋ kʋntʋ taanɩ dɩ́ di na?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Abam nan na jɩgɩ taanɩ dɩntʋ doŋ á tɩtarɩ nɩ, á wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á ja á vu balʋ na tɔgɩ ba tǝri Zezi nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ tɩn te.

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: A tagɩ kʋntʋ sɩ cavɩɩra mʋ ja abam. Kʋntʋ, swan tu dɩ dɩdʋa tǝri abam wʋnɩ sɩ o wanɩ o fɔgɩ abam balʋ na yɩ ko-biǝ Zezi ŋwaanɩ tɩn daanɩ na?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Abam na saŋɩ daanɩ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ á tusi mʋ. N ko-bu na kɩ-m lwarɩm, naa o na ŋɔgɩ-m, kʋ ya lana sɩ n yagɩ n ma n cɛ-o mʋ.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ balʋ na ba tɔgɩ cɩga tɩn bá na jǝŋǝ je Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ na? Yɩ zaŋɩ-na á ganɩ á tɩtɩ. Balʋ na boori tɩn, naa jwǝ-kaana naa ka-lagɩna, naa baara balʋ na tigi dɩ ba donnǝ ba maa jiri kaana tɩn,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: naa ŋwɩɩna naa wo-swǝn-nyɩna, naa sa-nyɔra naa nɔn-twɩɩna naa vɩnvɩrna bá na jǝŋǝ je Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Abam badaara dɛɛn yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Wɛ nan yagɩ á lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam. DƖ ma pa á ji DƖ nɔɔna yɩ á jɩgɩ cɩga DƖ tee nɩ. Wɛ dɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɩ DƖ Jorokʋm dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ kʋntʋ DƖ pa abam. Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kwe dɩ́ yɩra yam dɩ́ maa tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa Wɛ mʋ

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Abam badaara tɛ á wɩ, á jɩgɩ ni sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ maama á na lagɩ tɩn. Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam nɩ, kʋ daɩ woŋo maama mʋ jɩgɩ zǝnǝ kʋ pa abam. Amʋ dɩ jɩgɩ ni sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋ maama a na lagɩ tɩn, a nan bá sɛ sɩ a pa a ji kʋlʋkʋlʋ gambaa.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á tɛ á wɩ, Wɛ kɩ wʋdiu kana ŋwaanɩ mʋ, yɩ DƖ kɩ kana dɩ wʋdiu ŋwaanɩ. Maŋa nan wʋ́ ba, yɩ Wɛ cɔgɩ wʋdiu dɩ kana maama. Wɛ nan wʋ kɩ dɩbam yɩra yam sɩ dɩ́ ta maa kɩ boorim. Wɛ mɔɔnɩ dɩ́ yɩra yam sɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi mʋ taa te-ya, sɩ dɩ́ ta maa tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa-o.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ bi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi DƖ pa-o o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Maŋa nan wʋ́ ba, yɩ DƖ ma DƖ dam dɩm DƖ bi dɩbam dɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ á yɩra yam yɩ Zezi Krisi yɩra yam daa dɩdʋa mʋ na? Abam yɩra yam dɩ Zezi yɩra yam na yɩ bɩdwɩ tɩn, á yɩ zaŋɩ á kwe-ya á ma pǝni dɩ ka-tʋla, sɩ yaá ji yɩra dɩdʋa dɩdaanɩ ka-tʋla kam yɩra yam. Á brɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, wʋlʋ na pǝni dɩ ka-tʋla tɩn, o dɩ ka-tʋla kam maama laan jigi yɩra dɩdʋa mʋ. Á yǝri kʋntʋ na? Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Baarʋ dɩ kaanɩ wʋ́ wǝli daanɩ sɩ ba ji nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ.»

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn, o joro dɩ Zezi Joro maama yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Á nan yagɩ boorim kǝm dwi maama. Kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama nɔɔnʋ na wʋ́ kɩ tɩn, o bá kɩ o yagɩ o yɩra wʋnɩ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na boori, kʋntʋ yɩ kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋlʋ o na kɩ o yagɩ o yɩra wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Abam yǝri nɩ á yɩra yam nyɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ digǝ mʋ DƖ Jorokʋm na zʋʋrɩ ka wʋnɩ na? Wɛ kɩ DƖ Joro kʋm á bɩcara nɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ daa daɩ abam tɩtɩ mʋ te á yɩra yam.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: A lagɩ a lǝri á na pʋpʋnɩ á bwe amʋ taana yalʋ tɩn mʋ a pa abam. Kʋ ya lana dɩ baarʋ na wʋ di kaanɩ.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kaanɩ ba te o tɩtɩ yɩra, kʋ yɩ o barʋ mʋ te-ya. Barʋ dɩ nan ba te o tɩtɩ yɩra, kʋ yɩ o kaanɩ dɩ mʋ te-ya.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ-na á vɩn sɩ á taá wʋra daanɩ, kʋ na daɩ nɩ á maama mʋ sɛ sɩ á lɩ pwǝlǝ á yagɩ da-pwǝgǝ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn, sɩ á wanɩ á nywanɩ á yigǝ á loori Wɛ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ á na lagɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, sɩ á joori á taá wʋra daanɩ. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, sʋtaanɩ wʋ́ sʋgɩ abam dɩ pa á tusi dɩ á na warɩ á tɩtɩ á ja tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, a tagɩ sɩ kʋ wǝli abam mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ nɩ a lagɩ a fɩn abam.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya wʋ́ ta lagɩ sɩ nɔɔnʋ maama taa yɩ nɩ amʋ na yɩ badǝm te tɩn. Wɛ-pɛɛra nan yɩ tǝri tǝri mʋ yɩ DƖ pa nɔɔnʋ maama o nyɩm.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam balʋ na yɩ badǝnǝ dɩ kadǝnǝ tɩn, a lagɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ kʋ lana sɩ á taá yɩ á yɩranɩ kʋntʋ, nɩ amʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Á nan na warɩ á tɩtɩ á ja, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á di kaana naa á zʋ banna mʋ. Kʋntʋ garɩ á na paɩ ka-laga fra tiini ya jɩgɩ abam.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
