translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, baarʋ wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn na jɩgɩ kaanɩ, yɩ kaanɩ wʋm na ba tɔgɩ Zezi yɩ o sɛ sɩ ba taa zʋʋrɩ daanɩ, kʋntʋ tu yɩ zaŋɩ o vɩn o kaanɩ wʋm. Kʋ yɩ amʋ mʋ pɛ ni dɩm kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ daɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn na bʋŋɩ sɩ o viiri, kʋ na yɩ kaanɩ wʋm naa barʋ wʋm dɩ, sɩ á yag-o sɩ o viiri. Wʋlʋ na daarɩ yɩ o tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn laan wʋ́ ta te o tɩtɩ. Wɛ na bǝŋi dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ taá tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá zʋʋrɩ daanɩ dɩ ywǝǝni mʋ.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn na yɩ te yɩ Wɛ bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn, á ta taá yɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na pɛ abam ŋwɩa kalʋ tɩn. Mʋ kʋlʋ a na brɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm jǝgǝ maama nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: N na gonǝ naa n zɩ wʋ goni dɩ, kʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Woŋo kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ kuri tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ nɔɔnʋ maama kwaanɩ o sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama dɛɛn na yɩ te yɩ Wɛ bǝŋ-o tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o ta taa yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Á yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. DƖ yǝgi abam dɩ yǝlo kʋlʋ na cana tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, yɩ zaŋɩ á sɛ sɩ á ji nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gambaa.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a laan lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ balʋ na wʋ zʋ banna dɩ balʋ na wʋ di kaana tɩn woŋo mʋ. Kʋ daɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi mʋ pɛ-nɩ ni dɩntʋ, kʋ yɩ amʋ tɩtɩ na bʋŋɩ te tɩn mʋ, yɩ á wʋ́ taá jɩgɩ amʋ cɩga, dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na wʋra dɩ amʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ, yaara yalʋ na wʋ dɩbam baŋa nɩ lele kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋʋ́ ta lamma sɩ nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o di kaanɩ.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o jɩgɩ kaanɩ, o daa yɩ zaŋɩ o yag-o. Wʋlʋ nan na ba jɩgɩ kaanɩ, o daa yɩ zaŋɩ o taa kwaanɩ sɩ o di kaanɩ.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ nɩ, n na di kaanɩ, n ga n kɩ wo-lɔŋɔ. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ, bukɔ na zʋ barʋ, o kɩ wo-lɔŋɔ. Banna dɩ ba kaana nan bá lu lʋgʋ baŋa yaara yam wʋnɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ a ba lagɩ sɩ abam dɩ tɔgɩ á na yaara yam kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ sɩ balʋ na tʋŋɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tɩtʋŋa tɩn taa tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam nɩ ba ba jɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tɩtʋŋa mʋ te. Bɛŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ kʋm lagɩ kʋ ti mʋ dɩ kʋ wǝǝnu tɩm maama.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ kaanɩ tɩn yǝni o kwe o wʋbʋŋa o kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ o kwaanɩ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ o poli o kaanɩ wʋ.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma brɩ nɩ o wʋbʋŋa yam cɛ kuni bɩle mʋ. Kʋ yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ bukɔ naa kaanɩ wʋlʋ na ba jɩgɩ barʋ tɩn dɩ. Wʋntʋ kwe o wʋbʋŋa maama mʋ o pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ, o na lagɩ sɩ o yɩra dɩ o joro maama taa yɩ Wɛ nyɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ barʋ tɩn kwe o wʋbʋŋa o kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ o kwaanɩ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ o poli o barʋ wʋ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan tɛ bɩtarɩ sɩntʋ sɩ kʋ wǝli abam mʋ. Kʋ daɩ nɩ a lagɩ sɩ a fɩn abam. A nan lagɩ sɩ a pa á taá tɔgɩ cwǝ-laa mʋ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á nywanɩ á yigǝ á taá tʋŋɩ á pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi, sɩ á yɩ taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa yale yale.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o wʋ kɩ o katɔgɔ lanyɩranɩ o na wʋ di-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ, yɩ o fra na tiini ya zʋ o katɔgɔ kʋm kʋ pa o daa warɩ o tɩtɩ o ja, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o di-o mʋ nɩ o na bʋŋɩ te tɩn. O na kɩ kʋntʋ, o wʋ kɩ wo-lɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ o yɩ di o katɔgɔ kʋm yɩ o waɩ o tɩtɩ o jaana, sɩ o daa yɩ di kaanɩ tɩn, o kɩ lanyɩranɩ mʋ.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, wʋlʋ na di kaanɩ tɩn kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Wʋlʋ nan na wʋ di kaanɩ tɩn mʋ tiini o kɩ lanyɩranɩ o dwǝni.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ na jɩgɩ barʋ, yɩ o barʋ wʋm ta na ŋwɩ, o ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o yag-o. O barʋ wʋm nan na tɩga, o laan jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o zʋ o na lagɩ wʋlʋ tɩn. O nan maŋɩ sɩ o zʋ wʋlʋ dɩ na sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: A laan lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ jwǝnǝ nwana taanɩ mʋ dɩ abam. Kʋ yɩ cɩga, dɩ́ maama jɩgɩ yǝno, nɩ abam na tɛ te tɩn. Nan taá ye-na nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ yǝno, kʋ pa-o kamunni mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na jɩgɩ sono, kʋ jɩgɩ zǝnǝ kʋ paɩ o ve yigǝ mʋ.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ yǝno, kʋ brɩ nɩ o ta yǝri kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ o taa ye tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ nan na soe Wɛ tɩn, Wɛ ye kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ jwǝnǝ nwana yam dim taanɩ, dɩ́ ye nɩ jwǝnǝ ba ŋwɩ, Baŋa-Wɛ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Wɛ tɩn jɩgɩ wǝǝnu tɩdonnǝ mʋ ba maa bǝ ba wa. Wǝǝnu dwi zanzan mʋ nɔɔna bǝ-tɩ nɩ ba wa dɩ ba yuu tiinǝ, kʋ na yɩ tɩga baŋa wǝǝnu dɩ wɛyuu wǝǝnu.

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Ko wʋlʋ na kɩ woŋo maama, yɩ dɩntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋwɩ. Dɩ́ ta ye nɩ, dɩbam Yuutu yɩ dɩdʋa mʋ, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ Wɛ na tagɩ o ŋwaanɩ DƖ kɩ woŋo maama tɩn, yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ paɩ dɩbam ŋwɩa.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɔɔnʋ maama mʋ ye nɩ jwǝnǝ ba jɩgɩ dam. Nɔɔna badaara dɛɛn ŋwɩ dɩ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm mʋ, yɩ ba laan ba ba sɛ Wɛ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ yɩ ba bʋŋɩ nɩ, ba na di jwǝni wʋdiu, kʋʋ́ ta nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba joori ba sɛ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm mʋ. Ba wʋbʋŋa ta na wʋ bɩgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ tɩn, ba bʋŋɩ nɩ ba kɩ ba cɔgɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Wʋdiu dim nan bá wanɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ twɛ Wɛ. Dɩ́ na culi wʋdiiru naa dɩ́ zɩ ba culǝ dɩ, kʋ ba zǝni dɩbam dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ naa dɩ́ ga kʋlʋkʋlʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋlʋ na paɩ n jɩgɩ yǝno tɩn na ve n zʋ jwǝni digǝ n tɔgɩ n di dɩ wʋdiu kʋm, yɩ n ko-bu wʋlʋ wʋbʋŋa na wʋ bɩgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ tɩn na nɛ-m, kʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ gan-o sɩ o dɩ vu o tɔgɩ o di.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, wʋdiu dim na lagɩ kʋ pa a ko-bu tusi Wɛ cwǝŋǝ nɩ, a daa bá fɔgɩ a di wʋdiu kʋm kʋntʋ, a na ba lagɩ sɩ a pa a ko-bu tusi Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Nɔɔna na lwɛ amʋ, a na wʋ́ lǝri-ba te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ:

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ya ba jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ di kaana balʋ na sɛ Zezi tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ taá tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ beerǝ, nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩntʋŋna babam bam dɩ o nyaana dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ na yǝni ba kɩ te tɩn na?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Amʋ dɩ Banabasɩ yɩranɩ nan mʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá tʋŋɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ ni-wʋdiu na?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na yɩ pamaŋnʋ, o bá wanɩ o joori o ŋwɩ o tɩtɩ. Nɔɔnʋ jɩgɩ kara yɩ o ba di ka wǝǝnu na? Nɔɔnʋ jɩgɩ naanɩ o tɔga yɩ o ba di dɩ nayɩla na?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ Moyisitɩn tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ na jɩgɩ nabɩa n ma n nwanɩ wo-vaalʋ, yɩ kɩ tampɔgɔ ka ni nɩ.» Wɛ na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ nabɩa kam yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ na?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Aye, kʋ yɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na vagɩ dɩ wʋlʋ na wʋra o kɩ faa tɩn maama tɩɩnɩ nɩ baá na ba tǝri mʋ.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ abam tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ dɩ́ dugi Wɛ cɩga kam mʋ á bɩcara nɩ. Kʋ nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ joŋi dɩ́ ni-wʋdiu abam tee nɩ na?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Abam na paɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ ba ni-wʋdiu tɩn, kʋ ya wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam joŋi dɩ́ dwǝni bantʋ na? Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, dɩbam wʋ bwe sɩ dɩ́ joŋi dɩ́ ni-wʋdiu abam tee nɩ, nɩ dɩ́ ya na jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ te tɩn. Dɩ́ nan vɔgɩ dɩ́ wʋ mʋ woŋo maama baŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ wanɩ kʋ cɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Á tɩtɩ maŋɩ á ye nɩ balʋ na tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa DƖ di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn yǝni ba joŋi ba ni-wʋdiu dáanɩ mʋ. Balʋ dɩ na joŋi vara ba ma kaanɩ Wɛ tɩn dɩ joŋi ba tǝri kʋ wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ balʋ dɩ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi pɛ ni nɩ ba dɩ maŋɩ sɩ ba joŋi ba ni-wʋdiu tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, amʋ wʋ bwe sɩ a joŋi kʋlʋkʋlʋ abam tee nɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ a pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ sɩ a ma joŋi woŋo mʋ abam tee nɩ. Aá tɩ mʋ, sɩ a bá fɔgɩ a za a na yɩ te tɩn. A bá sɛ a pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o cɔgɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na yɩ amʋ wʋpolo nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: A bá wanɩ a magɩ a nyɔɔnɩ a na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ yɩ fɩfɩʋn mʋ sɩ a kɩ. Amʋ ya na yagɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɔɔlɩm, kʋʋ́ ta yɩ lɛɛrʋ mʋ dɩ amʋ.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Amʋ tɩtɩ mʋ nan ya na lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, a ya wʋ́ ta tɩɩnɩ sɩ a joŋi ŋwɩɩrʋ mʋ kʋ ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ a tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ a kɩa, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ kwe-ka DƖ kɩ amʋ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, bɛɛ ŋwɩɩrʋ mʋ amʋ wʋ́ joŋi? Amʋ nyɔɔrɩ mʋ yɩ a na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam zaanɩ, yɩ a ba bwe sɩ a joŋi kʋlʋkʋlʋ kʋ ŋwaanɩ, nɩ a ya na jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: A te a tɩtɩ mʋ, a daɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gambaa. Amʋ tɩtɩ nan mʋ pɛ a ji gambaa nɔɔna maama tee nɩ, sɩ a wanɩ a joŋi nɔɔna zanzan a kɩ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a na yǝni a wʋ dwi-gɛtiinǝ balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn tee nɩ, a dɩ tɔgɩ a kɩ nɩ bantʋ na kɩ te tɩn mʋ, sɩ a ma wanɩ a joŋi-ba a kɩ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ a yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩdaanɩ Wɛ niǝ yam, kʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi niǝ yam mʋ te amʋ.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Amʋ nan kɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama sɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam mʋ wanɩ ka vu yigǝ, sɩ a dɩ tɔgɩ a na a pɛɛrɩ DƖ wo-laarʋ tɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, amʋ ba duri nɩ wʋlʋ na yǝri durim yɩ o duri yɔɔ yɔɔ te tɩn. A nan ba magɩ jara nɩ wʋlʋ na yǝri jara magɩm yɩ o magɩ yɔɔ yɔɔ te tɩn.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn ma pa ba maama di wʋdiu dɩdʋa,

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, Wɛ wʋ dɛɛn wʋ poli dɩ nɔɔna zanzan ba wʋnɩ. DƖ dɛɛn ma pa ba zanzan tɩ ba maŋɩ kagʋa kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama nan kɩ sɩ tɩ brɩ dɩbam mʋ, sɩ dɩ́ daa yɩ ta pa dɩ́ fra zʋʋrɩ wo-balwaarʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ bantʋ na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á zuli jwǝnǝ, nɩ bantʋ badaara dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn jǝni ba di wʋdiu ba daarɩ ba nyɔ, yɩ ba laan zaŋɩ ba sa ba kwɛɛra.»

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á pa dɩ́ taá boorǝ, nɩ bantʋ badaara dɛɛn na kɩ te yɩ ba nɔɔna mʋrr-fiinle-tɩtɔ (

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Abam badaara na tɛ á wɩ, á jɩgɩ ni sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ maama á na lagɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ cɩga. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ woŋo maama mʋ jɩgɩ kuri kʋ pa dɩbam. Kʋ ta daɩ nɩ woŋo maama mʋ jɩgɩ zǝnǝ.

english_verse: died. Don't do shameful things as they did.
translation_verse: ) tɩ dɛ dɩdʋa wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa-na dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ dam dɩ́ nii, nɩ bantʋ badaara dɛɛn na kɩ te yɩ bɩsankwɩ dʋ-ba sɩ gʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Á yɩ taá pʋʋnɩ dɩ Wɛ, nɩ bantʋ badaara dɛɛn na kɩ te yɩ tʋʋnɩ malɛka kam gʋ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama dɛɛn nan kɩ dɩ́ kwǝ nakwa bam, sɩ tɩ taa yɩ maana mʋ tɩ pa dɩbam. Tɩ nan pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ kaanɩ dɩbam balʋ ta na ŋwɩ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tiim da yam batwarɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn nan fɔgɩ o yɩrɩ o tɩtɩ sɩ o yɩ tʋ.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ maama na maŋɩ abam sɩ á tusi tɩn waɩ kʋ yi nɔɔnʋ maama. Wɛ nan yɩ cɩga tu mʋ, DƖ bá sɛ sɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ abam tɩn dwǝni abam dam. DƖ nan wʋ́ pa abam dam, sɩ á wanɩ á na cwǝŋǝ á nuŋi kʋ wʋnɩ maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a badon-sonnu-ba, lɩ-na á tɩtɩ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ abam nɩ swan tiinǝ mʋ te, sɩ á bʋŋɩ á nii a taanɩ dɩm yɩ cɩga mʋ naa vwan mʋ.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama na fɔgɩ dɩpɛ dɩdʋa kam dɩ́ di tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩbam maama yɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ, dɩ́ ya zɩ maŋɩ dɩ́ daga te maama dɩ.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Nan bʋŋɩ-na Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam na yǝni ba ma wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba kaanɩ Wɛ yɩ ba daarɩ ba di tɩn woŋo. Balʋ maama na dɛ ba di tɩn dɩ tɔgɩ ba sɛ kaanɩm dɩm mʋ.

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Amʋ na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn brɩ bɛɛn? Kʋ brɩ nɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ ba na mɛ ba kaanɩ jwǝnǝ tɩn jɩgɩ kuri mʋ na? Naa kʋ brɩ nɩ jwǝnǝ yam tɩtɩ mʋ jɩgɩ kuri?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Awo, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Amʋ lagɩ a brɩ abam nɩ, jwǝ-kaana na kaanɩ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɩn, ba paɩ ciciri mʋ sɩ kʋ daɩ Wɛ. Amʋ nan ba lagɩ sɩ abam na wǝl-dɔnɔ dɩ ciciri.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á nyɔ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wo-nyɔɔrʋ tɩm, sɩ á kwǝri á vu á nyɔ dɩ ciciri. Abam nan bá wanɩ á jǝni á di dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tʋʋnɩ gulim wʋdiu kʋm, sɩ á kwǝri á vu á da á di wʋdiu kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa á taá ŋwɩ dɩ ciciri tɩn.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa-na dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ zaŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ tɩn. Abam bʋŋɩ á paɩ dɩbam jɩgɩ dam dɩ́ dwe wʋntʋ mʋ na? Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa Wɛ na zulǝ mʋ dɩ́ tɩtʋŋa maama wʋnɩ

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Á jɩgɩ ni sɩ á yǝgi nwana yalʋ maama ba na jɩgɩ ba yǝgi yaga nɩ tɩn á di. Nan yɩ bwe-na á nii ya yɩ jwǝnǝ nwana mʋ na, sɩ kʋʋ́ pa liǝ ja abam kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ kʋ wǝǝnu maama yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ nyɩm mʋ.»

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn na bǝŋi abam sɩ á vu o sɔŋɔ á di wʋdiu dɩd-o, yɩ á na sɛ á vu, o na kwe wʋdiu kʋlʋ maama o pa abam tɩn, sɩ á di. Á yɩ zaŋɩ-na á bwe kʋ kuri, sɩ kʋʋ́ ta jɩgɩ liǝ dɩ abam.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ nɩ á yagɩ kʋ dim liǝ na wʋ́ zʋ abam tɩtɩ bɩcarɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ yɩ liǝ na wʋ́ ja wʋlʋ na tagɩ o brɩ abam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɛdoŋ abam waɩ á bwe amʋ á nii, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ yagɩ dɩ́ na jɩgɩ ni sɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ liǝ na wʋ́ zʋ nɔɔna badonnǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Abam daa ta waɩ á bwe amʋ nɩ, dɩ́ na kɩ Wɛ le wʋdiu kʋm ŋwaanɩ yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ di tɩn, nɔɔnʋ daa wʋ́ lwɛ dɩbam bɛɛ ŋwaanɩ mʋ?

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Á yɩ taá kɩ-na kʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔna wʋbʋŋa tɩn, kʋ ya zɩ yɩ Zwifǝ bam naa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ naa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm dɩ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Taá lwǝni-na amʋ, nɩ amʋ na lwǝni Zezi Krisi te tɩn. Zezi mʋ yɩ baara dɩ kaana maama yuutu

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Abam kɩ cɩga lanyɩranɩ dɩdaanɩ á na yǝni á guli amʋ gulǝ, yɩ á kwǝri á sɛ zaasɩm dɩlʋ maama a na brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ sɩ abam lwarɩ nɩ, Zezi Krisi mʋ yɩ nɔɔnʋ maama yuutu. Kaanɩ dɩ yuutu maa yɩ o barʋ. Baŋa-Wɛ nan mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ yuutu.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ dɩ nan na zaŋɩ sɩ o loori Wɛ naa o ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ, yɩ o na wʋ mɛ woŋo o kwǝli o yuu, o dɩ yáalɩ o yuutu wʋm mʋ. O na kɩ kʋntʋ, o dɩ wʋlʋ na ceeri o yuu tɩn maama yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ na wʋ sɛ sɩ o kwǝli o yuu, kʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ o cɔ-kʋ mʋ naa o ceeri-kʋ. Kʋ nan na jɩgɩ cavɩɩra sɩ kaanɩ kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa kwǝli-kʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Baara nan ba jɩgɩ sɩ ba kwǝli ba yuni, bɛŋwaanɩ bantʋ jɩgɩ Wɛ nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ, yɩ ba brɩ DƖ zulǝ na yɩ te. Kʋ nan na yɩ kaana, bantʋ mʋ brɩ baara zulǝ na yɩ te.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ mɛ baarʋ yɩra mʋ DƖ kɩ kaanɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ kaanɩ yɩra mʋ DƖ mɛ DƖ kɩ baarʋ.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Wɛ wʋ kɩ baarʋ kaanɩ ŋwaanɩ, DƖ kɩ kaanɩ mʋ baarʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, dɩ Wɛ malɛsɩsɩm ŋwaanɩ, kaana maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kwǝli ba yuni, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ ba jɩgɩ ni sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ ma baarʋ yɩra mʋ DƖ kɩ kaanɩ, yɩ kaanɩ dɩ nan mʋ lʋrɩ baarʋ. Woŋo maama nan nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Abam tɩtɩ nan bʋŋɩ-na á nii. Kaanɩ na zaŋɩ sɩ o loori Wɛ, yɩ o na wʋ kwe woŋo o ma kwǝli o yuu, kʋ lamma na?

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na wʋ sɛ amʋ zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ o magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu taa ye nɩ dɩbam maama tɔgɩ kantʋ cwǝŋǝ kam mʋ, yɩ Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm je maama nɩ tɩn dɩ tɔgɩ kantʋ mʋ. Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ di Zezi tʋʋnɩ gulim wʋdiu kʋm te tɩn (Matiyu

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ amʋ na lagɩ a ta dɩ abam tɩn, a ba lagɩ a tee abam nɩ á kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Abam na yǝni á jeeri daanɩ tɩn, á cɔgɩm mʋ dwe á fɔgɩm.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ woŋo, amʋ ni nɩ á na yǝni á jeeri daanɩ sɩ á zuli Wɛ, á jɩgɩ kampwara mʋ daanɩ. Amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋʋ́ ta yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan fɩn mʋ sɩ kampwara taa wʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, sɩ kʋ brɩ balʋ na sɩɩnɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ maama yǝni o lɔgɩrɩ o di o tɩtɩ wʋdiu kʋm mʋ. Abam nan na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ pɛ kana jɩgɩ badonnǝ, yɩ á badonnǝ nyɔ á su á ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na di dɩpɛ dɩm yɩ o kwǝri o nyɔ wo-nyɔɔrʋ tɩm dɩ goonǝ tɩn wʋ maŋɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩra yam mʋ, kʋntʋ tu vaŋɩ taanɩ mʋ o daŋɩ o tɩtɩ yuu nɩ.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ba na di ba ti tɩn, o daa ma kwe zʋŋa dɩ ka wʋ wo-nyɔɔrʋ yɩ o kɩ Wɛ le tɩ ŋwaanɩ, yɩ o wɩ: «Wo-nyɔɔrʋ tɩntʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ goni ni-dʋʋrɩ mʋ dɩdaanɩ nabiinǝ amʋ jana kam ŋwaanɩ. Maŋa kalʋ maama á na lagɩ á nyɔ-tɩ tɩn, sɩ á kɩ-na kʋntʋ á taá ma guli amʋ gulǝ.»

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Cɩga kalʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na brɩ-nɩ o tʋʋnɩ gulim wʋdiu kʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ a zaasɩ abam, kʋ yɩ sɩ tɩtɩɩ dɩlʋ ba na jaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn mʋ o kwe dɩpɛ,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: yɩ o kɩ Wɛ le dɩ ŋwaanɩ o daarɩ o fɔ fɔ o pa o karabiǝ bam, yɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ yɩra yam mʋ tɩntʋ, ya na lagɩ ya cɔgɩ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Taá kɩ-na kʋntʋ doŋ sɩ á taá ma guli amʋ gulǝ.»

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na di dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tʋʋnɩ gulim dɩpɛ dɩm naa o nyɔ wo-nyɔɔrʋ tɩm, yɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu kɩ kǝm-balɔrɔ mʋ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩra yam dɩ o jana kam.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ nan mʋ paɩ á zanzan ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ, yɩ á badaara bwǝnǝ, yɩ á badonnǝ tʋa.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a ko-biǝ-ba, á na jeeri daanɩ sɩ á di Zezi tʋʋnɩ gulim wʋdiu kʋm, sɩ á zuri á yɩra á cǝgi daanɩ.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Abam ye nɩ, maŋa kalʋ á dɛɛn ta na wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ tɩn, á dɛɛn tɔgɩ jwǝnǝ yalʋ na yɩ kafɛ tɩn mʋ, yɩ ya ganɩ abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ maama ya na lagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a lagɩ a pa á lwarɩ nɩ, Wɛ Joro kʋm bá ganɩ abam. Kʋntʋ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Wɛ Joro dam tɩn bá wanɩ o twɩ Zezi. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o ta nɩ, Zezi mʋ yɩ o Yuutu, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm tǝri o tee nɩ.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm pɛɛra yam yɩ dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ, yɩ DƖ Joro kʋm dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ paɩ-ya DƖ nɔɔna.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam dam sɩ dɩ́ ma tʋŋɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa te tɩn dɩ yɩ dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ. Wɛ nan yɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ pɛ dɩbam maama dam dɩm kʋntʋ maama.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm nan pɛ nɔɔnʋ maama pɛɛrɩ sɩ o wanɩ o maa zǝni o donnǝ.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm paɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ dam sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ swan taanɩ, yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ ta paɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ dam sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ yǝno taanɩ dɩ.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ nan ta mʋ paɩ badonnǝ dam sɩ ba ta maa kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla, kʋ daarɩ sɩ badonnǝ taa waɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ. Kʋ daa ta maa paɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ waɩ ba pɔɔrɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm nyɩm dɩ kʋlʋ na daɩ kʋ nyɩm tɩn daanɩ. Kʋ ta paɩ badonnǝ waɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ, yɩ badonnǝ dɩ waɩ ba lwarɩ ta-gɛ sɩm kʋntʋ kuri yɩ ba tɛ ba brɩ ba donnǝ.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm kʋntʋ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ jɩgɩ pɛɛra yam kʋntʋ dwi tǝri tǝri, yɩ kʋ paɩ nɔɔnʋ maama nɩ kʋ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ yɩra na yɩ te tɩn mʋ

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama na pɛ ba miisi dɩbam na wʋnɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩdʋa dam ŋwaanɩ tɩn, dɩ́ laan jigi nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ. Kʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ naa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ, naa gambɛ naa balʋ na te ba tɩtɩ tɩn maama, Wɛ Joro kʋm kʋntʋ yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ dɩbam maama tee nɩ.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Nabiinu yɩra pɔɔrɩ je tǝri tǝri mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ jǝgǝ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Naga na tagɩ ka wɩ, kantʋ daɩ jɩŋa, kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ yɩra yam ba te-ka, kʋntʋ bá sɩɩnɩ kʋ pa ka taa tɔgɩ ka tǝri yɩra yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Zwɛ dɩ nan na wɩ, dɩntʋ daɩ yi, sɩ yɩra yam ba te-dɩ, kʋntʋ bá sɩɩnɩ kʋ pa dɩ taa tɔgɩ dɩ tǝri yɩra yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Yɩra yam maama nan ya na yɩ yi yɩranɩ mʋ, yaá kɩ ta mʋ ya taa ni taanɩ? Ya nan ya na yɩ zwɛ yɩranɩ mʋ, yaá kɩ ta mʋ ya taa ni lwǝm?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ mʋ kɩ je sɩm dwi tǝri tǝri DƖ kɩ yɩra yam wʋnɩ, kʋ maŋɩ dɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ya maama nan ya na yɩ yɩra yam jǝgǝ dɩdʋa mʋ, yaá kɩ ta mʋ ya ji yɩra?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, je dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ wʋra, yɩ sɩ maama laan yɩ yɩra dɩdʋa.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, yi bá wanɩ dɩ ta dɩ jɩŋa nɩ dɩ ba lagɩ-ka, naa yuu ta dɩ naga nɩ kʋ ba lagɩ-ka.

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta cɩga mʋ dɩ abam nɩ, dɩbam yɩra yam je sɩlʋ dɩ́ na bʋŋɩ nɩ sɩ tiini sɩ bwǝnǝ tɩn jɩgɩ kuri zanzan.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ yɩra yam je sɩlʋ dɩ́ na bʋŋɩ nɩ sɩ ba tiini sɩ jɩgɩ kuri tɩn mʋ dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ zuli lanyɩranɩ. Je sɩlʋ na jɩgɩ cavɩɩra tɩn, mʋ dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ fɔgɩ dɩ́ kwǝli-sɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ ya je sɩlʋ na lana tɩn, dɩ́ daa ba fɔgɩ dɩ́ nii sɩ baŋa nɩ. Wɛ mʋ kɩ nabiinu yɩra yam je sɩm maama DƖ kɩ daanɩ, yɩ DƖ paɩ je sɩlʋ na gɛ zulǝ tɩn na zulǝ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kampwara tǝri yɩra yam wʋnɩ. Ya je sɩm maama zǝni daanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Kʋ na cana yɩra yam daa kalʋ nɩ, yɩra yam maama wʋ́ tɔgɩ ya na cam dɩm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ daa kalʋ na nɛ zulǝ tɩn, yɩra yam maama dɩ wʋ́ tɔgɩ ya na wʋpolo mʋ.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Abam maama yɩ Zezi Krisi yɩra yam mʋ, yɩ á dɩdʋa dɩdʋa yɩ o je sɩm dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ.

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ dɩ́ maama mʋ Wɛ pɛ dam sɩ dɩ́ taá ma paɩ yawɩɩna naɩ yazurǝ, naa dɩ́ maama mʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm pɛ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ, naa dɩ́ maama mʋ waɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ sɩ kuri dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Nan kwaanɩ-na sɩ á joŋi Wɛ-pɛɛra yalʋ na jɩgɩ kuri kʋ ja gaalɩ tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ, a nan lagɩ a brɩ abam woŋo kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ lana kʋ dwe dɩdɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Amʋ na maŋɩ a waɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ nabiinǝ dwi tǝri tǝri taana, dɩ malɛsɩsɩm taanɩ dɩ, yɩ a na ba jɩgɩ sono, kʋ nyɩ dɩ sɔɔ mʋ a kɩa, nɩnɛɛnɩ ba na magɩ kwaŋa dɩ loŋini yɩ tɩ kɩ sɔɔ te tɩn.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Amʋ na maŋɩ a kwe a jɩjɩgɩrʋ maama a maŋɩ a pa yinigǝ tiinǝ, yɩ a ta kwǝri a sɛ sɩ ba kwe a yɩra yam ba dɩ mini nɩ, yɩ a na ba jɩgɩ sono, kʋ ta maŋɩ kʋ ba jɩgɩ kuri kʋ pa-nɩ.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Sono tu ba kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ tɩn, o nan ba beeri o tɩtɩ yɩranɩ zǝnǝ má. O nan jɩgɩ ban-pʋnʋ. Nɔɔnʋ na kɩ-o lwarɩm, o ba kwe o kɩ o wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Sono ba tiǝ. Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ sɩlʋ nɔɔna na ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn wʋ́ ba sɩ kɛ. Wɛ-pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ nɔɔna na maa ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ tɩn dɩ wʋ́ ba dɩ kɛ. Yǝno dɩ wʋ́ ba kʋ kɛ.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ ba fɔgɩ wǝǝnu maama DƖ pa tɩ maŋɩ fasɩ tɩn, wo-cicwǝǝru tɩm maama laan wʋ́ je mʋ.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ a na yɩ bu tɩn, a dɛɛn ŋɔɔnɩ biim mʋ, yɩ a kwǝri a bʋŋɩ nɩ bu te, yɩ a jeeli nɩ bu te. Lele kʋntʋ, a na kɩ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, a kwe busɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩm maama a yagɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ, dɩ́ na lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn, kʋ taa nyɩ dɩ niu mʋ dɩ́ jɩgɩ dɩ́ nii kʋ wʋnɩ liirǝ liirǝ. Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kam kʋntʋ na yiǝ, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ ta naɩ jaja mʋ. Lele kʋntʋ yǝno kʋlʋ a na jɩgɩ tɩn yɩ cicoro mʋ. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ, a laan wʋ́ ta ye wǝǝnu maama kuri a tiǝ, nɩ Wɛ na ye amʋ DƖ ti te tɩn.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ wǝǝnu tɩtɔ mʋ wʋ́ ta wʋra maŋa maama. Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ tɩɩna dɩ sono. Kʋlʋ nan na dwe tɩ maama tɩn mʋ yɩ sono.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá jɩgɩ sono, sɩ á daarɩ á kwaanɩ á joŋi Wɛ-pɛɛra yalʋ DƖ Jorokʋm na paɩ nɔɔna tɩn á wǝli da, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ sɩ á wanɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm tɩn ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Wɛ mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ dɩ nabiinǝ, ba na ba ni o taanɩ dɩm kuri tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ paɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na sǝgi tɩn.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na waɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ tɩn ŋɔɔnɩ o brɩ nabiinǝ mʋ, sɩ kʋ kwe-ba kʋ daarɩ kʋ zǝni-ba sɩ ba taa fɔgɩ ba zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm tɩn, kʋ wǝli o tɩtɩ yɩranɩ mʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ tɩn, kʋ wǝli Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm maama mʋ.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya lagɩ sɩ abam maama taa waɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm, a nan tiini a lagɩ sɩ á taá waɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ sɩm mʋ á dwe dɩdɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ tɩn tiini o jɩgɩ zǝnǝ o dwe wʋlʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ tɩn, kʋ na daɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ na wʋra sɩ o wanɩ o pipiri o taanɩ dɩm kuri sɩ kʋ zǝni Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm maama.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, a ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ na tu abam te, yɩ a na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ yɩranɩ mʋ dɩ abam, bɛɛ nyɔɔrɩ mʋ á lagɩ á na? Kʋlʋ na wʋ́ wǝli abam tɩn mʋ yɩ a na ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa á na vɩɩrɩm, naa dɩ pa á na yǝno, naa a ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ, naa a zaasɩ abam Wɛ cɩga kam.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na jɩgɩ jara nabɔnɔ o wui yɔɔ yɔɔ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ nɩ jara mʋ wʋra sɩ o nuŋi o vu.

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ n na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ warɩ sɩ kuri o pipiri, nɔɔna wʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ ba lwarɩ n na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn kuri? Kʋntʋ nan brɩ nɩ n ŋɔɔnɩ n yagɩ gaa wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ a na ba ni tɩn dɩ amʋ, kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ dɩbam maama bale yɩ vǝrǝ mʋ da-tee nɩ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, abam wʋlʋ na waɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ, sɩ o tiini o loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa o taa waɩ sɩ kuri dɩ o tɛa.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Amʋ na mɛ ta-gɛ sɩm a ma a warɩ Wɛ, kʋ yɩ a joro mʋ ŋɔɔna, sɩ amʋ tɩtɩ ba ni sɩ kuri.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ a kɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ a warɩ Wɛ dɩ a wʋbʋŋa maama dɩ a joro maama, sɩ a daarɩ a taa leeni dɩ a wʋbʋŋa maama dɩ a joro maama a taa zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na daɩ kʋntʋ, yɩ n na mɛ ta-gɛ sɩm n ma n zuli Wɛ, yɩ nɔn-gaa na je o cǝgǝ, o bá wanɩ o ni sɩ kuri. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, oó kɩ ta mʋ o tɔgɩ o sɛ nmʋ na zuli Wɛ te tɩn sɩ o dɩ ta nɩ «Amina»?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na zuli Wɛ te tɩn na maŋɩ kʋ lamma te, kʋ bá zǝni nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ, a kɩ Wɛ le dɩ DƖ na pɛ-nɩ dam sɩ a taa ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm a dwe abam maama tɩn.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, a na wʋ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, a tiini a lagɩ sɩ a taa maɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ ba na ni tɩn mʋ a ma ŋɔɔnɩ a brɩ-ba. A na ŋɔɔnɩ bɩtarɩ sɩnu má yɩranɩ, kʋ garɩ a na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm bɩtarbiǝ mʋrr-fugǝ yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ba ni sɩ kuri.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ tʋŋɩ vǝrǝ, sɩ ba ba ba ŋɔɔnɩ amʋ ni-taanɩ dɩm dɩ abam. Baá ŋɔɔnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ á na ba ni tɩn dɩ abam. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, á ta bá sɛ a ni.»

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ maɩ ta-gɛ DƖ maa brɩ DƖ dam balʋ na wʋ sɛ-DƖ tɩn tee nɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ balʋ na sɛ-DƖ tɩn tee nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ sɩm mʋ brɩ DƖ dam balʋ na sɛ-DƖ tɩn tee nɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ balʋ na wʋ sɛ-DƖ tɩn tee nɩ.

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Abam maama nan na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ á brɩ daanɩ, yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ doŋ na tu o zʋ á wʋ, wʋntʋ wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ dam mʋ wʋ á tee nɩ. O na ni kʋlʋ maama tɩn wʋ́ pa o lwarɩ nɩ o ba jɩgɩ bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ o kwǝri o lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ lagɩ DƖ di o taanɩ.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Wʋbʋŋa yalʋ maama ya na sǝgi o wʋnɩ tɩn laan wʋ́ ba ya lwarɩ jaja mʋ, yɩ o laan wʋ́ kɩ o yuu tɩga nɩ o zuli Wɛ, yɩ o sɛ nɩ Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ wʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm na maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa tʋŋɩ kʋ tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ tɩn

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam na jeeri daanɩ sɩ á zuli Wɛ, á na maŋɩ sɩ á kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Abam dɩdʋa mʋ wʋ́ zaŋɩ o pa lǝŋǝ. Dɩdʋa dɩ ma zaŋɩ o brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam. Wʋdoŋ dɩ ma zaŋɩ o ta vɩɩrɩm dɩlʋ Wɛ na brɩ-o tɩn. Wʋwʋm dɩ ma zaŋɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ, yɩ wʋdoŋ dɩ ma zaŋɩ o ta ta-gɛ sɩm kuri o brɩ á kɔgɔ kʋm. Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama zǝni Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm sɩ kʋ fɔgɩ kʋ zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Abam badaara na lagɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá yɩ bale naa batɔ yɩranɩ mʋ. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá zaŋɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ á daarɩ á pa daanɩ mʋ, sɩ á dɩdʋa zaŋɩ o ta ŋwɛ sɩm kuri.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan na tǝri á wʋnɩ sɩ o wanɩ o ta ŋwɛ sɩm kuri, balʋ ya na lagɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ-sɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba yagɩ mʋ, sɩ ba na wʋ ba yɩranɩ, sɩ ba taa ŋɔɔnɩ-sɩ dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, abam maama waɩ á ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ sɩm dɩdʋa dɩdʋa, sɩ kʋ pa á zaasɩ Wɛ cɩga kam da-tee nɩ, sɩ á taá fɔgɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Wɛ lagɩ sɩ woŋo maama taa tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ mʋ dɩ yazurǝ, sɩ DƖ ba lagɩ yɔɔ yɔɔ kǝm.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ba na lagɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ kuri, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba bwe ba banna mʋ sɔŋɔ nɩ, sɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ kaanɩ zaŋɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ á kikilǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Abam bʋŋɩ á paɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm nuŋi abam te mʋ na? Mʋ naa á bʋŋɩ á paɩ abam yɩranɩ mʋ ye Wɛ taanɩ dɩm na?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu naa o joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm pɛɛrɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa ye nɩ, amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ a pa abam tɩn yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm kwǝrǝ mʋ.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na vɩn amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ vɩn kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, a ko-biǝ-ba, kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ yiyiu-ŋwɛ sɩm. Á nan yɩ zaŋɩ á cɩ balʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ta-gɛ sɩm Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ tɩn.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Amʋ na pɛ á lwarɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam te tɩn, á na wʋ joori ka kwaga nɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ abam DƖ yagɩ kantʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, á na sɛ Zezi Krisi te tɩn yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Wɛ cɩga kalʋ na dwe maama tɩn mʋ yɩ kalʋ amʋ na dɛ yigǝ a joŋi yɩ a laan daarɩ a brɩ abam tɩn. Kantʋ mʋ tɩntʋ: Zezi Krisi tɩgɩ dɩbam lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na maŋɩ kʋ ta te tɩn.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ba ma kɩ-o bɔɔnɩ nɩ. Da yatɔ dɛ nɩ o ma joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na maŋɩ kʋ ta te tɩn.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, o ma brɩ o tɩtɩ o karabiǝ zanzan bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ, bantʋ dwe nɩ nɔɔna biǝ yanu (

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Zakɩ dɩ ma na-o, yɩ o daarɩ o pa o tɩntʋŋna bam maama na-o.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, o laan ma pa amʋ na nyɩ dɩ bu wʋlʋ ba na lʋga yɩ o lʋra maŋa ta wʋ yi tɩn dɩ na-o.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ tiini a muri Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam maama wʋnɩ. A ya brɩ a wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba taa bǝ-nɩ nɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ, a dɛɛn na bɛɛsɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan na kɩ-nɩ yu-yoŋo tɩn mʋ pɛ a yɩ a na yɩ wʋlʋ zɩm tɩn. DƖ na kɩ-nɩ yu-yoŋo te tɩn daɩ kafɛ. Amʋ tiini a tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam a dwǝni DƖ tɩntʋŋna bam maama. Kʋ nan daɩ a tɩtɩ dam ŋwaanɩ mʋ a waɩ a tʋŋa. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ na kɩ-nɩ yu-yoŋo yɩ DƖ dam dɩm wʋ amʋ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Dɩbam balʋ na yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna tɩn maama yǝni dɩ́ brɩ cɩga dɩdʋa mʋ. Kʋ na yɩ amʋ na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, naa bantʋ dɩ na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ cɩga kalʋ abam na sɛ tɩn mʋ. Twa biim taanɩ

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam te tɩn, dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna nɩ Zezi Krisi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ mʋ. Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ abam badonnǝ tɛ á wɩ, twa biim tǝrǝ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Kʋ ya na yɩ cɩga nɩ twa biim tǝrǝ, kʋ brɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ dɩ wʋ bi mʋ.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan ya na wʋ bi, dɩbam kwǝr-tɔɔla kam yɩ kafɛ mʋ, abam dɩ na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ ka te tɩn dɩ ya yɩ kafɛ mʋ,

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: yɩ dɩbam dɩ na brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn ya yɩ vwan mʋ, dɩ́ na yǝni dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna nɩ Wɛ mʋ bi Zezi Krisi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Twa biim nan ya na sɩɩnɩ dɩ tǝrǝ, kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ bi Zezi mʋ.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, twa biim ya na tǝrǝ, kʋ brɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ dɩ maŋɩ o wʋ bi mʋ.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan ya na wʋ bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, kʋ brɩ nɩ abam na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o te tɩn yɩ kafɛ mʋ, yɩ á lwarɩm dɩm ya ta wʋ á yuu nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ta brɩ nɩ, balʋ na sɛ Zezi Krisi yɩ ba laan tɩ tɩn ya wʋ́ ga ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ: Zezi Krisi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na dɛ yigǝ o bi o vu Wɛ te, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ balʋ dɩ na tɩgɩ tɩn wʋ́ bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Tʋʋnɩ zɩgɩ nabiinu dɩdʋa yɩra nɩ mʋ dɩ ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Kʋ nan ta yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ twa biim dɩ, nabiinu dɩdʋa dɩ mʋ jaanɩ twa biim o ba.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama dɩ o jǝgǝ mʋ. Zezi Krisi mʋ dɛ yigǝ o bi o vu Wɛ te. Kʋ daarɩ balʋ na yɩ o nɔɔna tɩn dɩ wʋ́ bi maŋa kam o na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Tʋʋnɩ nan mʋ yɩ dʋm wʋlʋ o na wʋ́ cɔgɩ o ma kweeli tɩn.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ Zezi na wʋ́ ba o taa te wǝǝnu maama tɩn, wʋm tɩtɩ na yɩ Wɛ Bu tɩn wʋ́ kwe o tɩtɩ o pa o Ko Wɛ. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ yɩ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ DƖ kɩ wǝǝnu maama DƖ Bu wʋm dam kuri nɩ tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ mʋ te wǝǝnu maama dɩ DƖ dam maama.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Á nan bʋŋɩ nɔɔna balʋ na yǝni ba paɩ ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ ba twa ŋwaanɩ tɩn woŋo á nii. Ba na ba bʋŋɩ nɩ twa biim wʋra, bɛŋwaanɩ mʋ yɩ ba paɩ ba miisi-ba na wʋnɩ twa bam ŋwaanɩ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, dɛ maama amʋ yǝni a tɔgɩ tʋʋnɩ te mʋ a kɛa. Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam á na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Mʋ kʋ kuri a tagɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Pa-na á wʋbʋŋa joori ya taa tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ, sɩ á daarɩ á yagɩ kǝm-lwaanʋ tɩm. Abam badaara ta yǝri Wɛ. A tagɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa cavɩɩra mʋ zʋ abam. Nɔɔna na wʋ́ bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩ yɩra yalʋ tɩn

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Abam dɩdʋa waɩ o bwe nɩ: «Kʋʋ́ kɩ ta mʋ sɩ twa bi? Ba nan na joori ba bi, ba yɩra wʋ́ ta yɩ tɩta mʋ?»

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋbʋŋa mʋ muri na? N na kwe woŋo n du tɩga nɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ puli mʋ kʋ nuŋi, kʋ daarɩ sɩ kʋ bu wʋm pɔ.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na ŋwɩ tɩn ya-nwana mʋ yɩ bɩdwɩ. Nabiinǝ dɩ vara dɩ zunǝ dɩ kale maama jɩgɩ ya-nwana yɩra yɩra mʋ.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu wǝǝnu dɩ wʋra mʋ, yɩ tɩga baŋa wǝǝnu dɩ wʋra. Wɛyuu wǝǝnu tɩm dɩ jɩgɩ tɩ lam mʋ, yɩ tɩga baŋa wǝǝnu tɩm dɩ jɩgɩ tɩ lam.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Wɩa kam dɩ jɩgɩ ka lam mʋ, yɩ cana kam dɩ jɩgɩ ka lam. Calɩcwɩ sɩm dɩ maa jɩgɩ sɩ lam, yɩ sɩ lam dɩm nan daɩ bɩdwɩ.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama nan brɩ twa biim na yɩ te tɩn mʋ. Nɔɔnʋ na tɩga, o yɩra yam ba na kɩ tɩn yɩ yɩra yalʋ na wʋ́ pɔ tɩn mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ o yɩra yalʋ na wʋ́ bi ya yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn daa bá pɔ maŋa dɩ maŋa.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Pulim nɩ tɩn Wɛ kɩ Adammʋ DƖ pa o jɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa yɩra yɩ o ŋwɩ.» Kʋ daarɩ Zezi mʋ yɩ Adam wʋlʋ na kweeli tɩn, yɩ o jɩgɩ Joro kʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa ŋwɩa kam mʋ tui yigǝ, yɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam laan saŋɩ ka ba.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Wɛ mɛ tɩɩrʋ mʋ DƖ kɩ nabiinu wʋlʋ na tu yigǝ tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ wʋntʋ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ nabiinu wʋlʋ nan na tu kwaga tɩn nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ mʋ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam maama nyɩ dɩ Wɛ na mɛ tɩɩrʋ DƖ kɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ dayigǝ tɩn mʋ. Nɔɔna balʋ maama nan na yɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nyɩm tɩn nyɩ dɩ wʋlʋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩbam na jɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔnʋ wʋm nyɩnyʋgʋ tɩn, dɛ wʋra dɩ́ wʋ́ ba dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɔɔnʋ wʋm dɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a lagɩ a ta a brɩ abam nɩ, dɩ́ lʋgʋ baŋa yɩra yam bá wanɩ ya na jǝŋǝ je Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ. Yɩra yalʋ na wʋ́ pɔ tɩn bá wanɩ ya maŋɩ dɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Kʋʋ́ da kʋ kɩ yibʋgɩsa wʋnɩ mʋ, maŋa kam ba na wʋ́ wu kweelim nabɔnɔ kʋm tɩn. Nabɔnɔ kʋm na wugǝ, twa wʋ́ bi ba zaŋɩ dɩ yɩra yalʋ na ba pɔɛ tɩn, yɩ dɩbam dɩ yɩra wʋ́ lǝni.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maama na kɩa, kʋ laan wʋ́ pa kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn kɩ, nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ ta te kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ wanɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩ dɩ dam dɩm maama.»

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: «Tʋʋnɩ, n dam dɩm daa bɛɛ? N daa n wʋ́ wanɩ n cɔgɩ nɔɔna na?»

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ tʋʋnɩ jɩgɩ dam sɩ dɩ cɔgɩ nɔɔna. Lwarɩm dɩ nan nɛ dɩ dam Wɛ cullu tɩm vɩʋn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan kɩ Wɛ le dɩ DƖ na paɩ dɩbam wɔnɔ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩ dɩ dam dɩm maama tɩn.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, a ko-bu-sonnu-ba, fɔgɩ á zɩgɩ-na kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa, sɩ á cɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu tɩtʋŋa yam maŋa maama, dɩ á na ye nɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ maama á na tʋŋɩ á pa dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn na daɩ kafɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ sǝbu kʋlʋ á na laɩ á maa zǝni Wɛ nɔɔna bam tɩn, á taá kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ na maŋɩ a brɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Galatɩ tɩ-niǝ yam nɩ sɩ ba taa kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Siun dɛ maama na yiǝ, sɩ nɔɔnʋ maama lɩ sǝbu kʋlʋ o na nɛ tɩn wʋnɩ o tiŋi, sɩ amʋ na tuǝ, sɩ á daa yɩ taá zɩgɩ á laɩ sǝbu.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Amʋ na tu abam te, abam na lɩ nɔɔna balʋ tɩn, a laan wʋ́ la tɔnɔ a tʋŋɩ-ba dɩ á sǝbu kʋm sɩ ba ja vu Zeruzalɛm.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daa na maŋɩ sɩ amʋ tɩtɩ mʋ vu, dɩ́ wʋ́ tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ vu. Pooli na lagɩ sɩ o na Korɛntɩ tiinǝ bam te tɩn

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: A lagɩ sɩ a da Masɩdʋanɩ mʋ, sɩ a laan daarɩ a ba abam te.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: A na tu abam te, a lagɩ sɩ a daanɩ fɩɩn mʋ, dɛdoŋ aá ti waarʋ mɩmaŋa kam dáanɩ. Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, á laan wʋ́ wanɩ á zǝni-nɩ sɩ a vu a daa na wʋ́ vu mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Amʋ ba lagɩ sɩ a wuuri a ba abam te maŋa fɩnfɩɩn, sɩ a joori a viiri. Wɛ nan na sɛ, amʋ ya lagɩ sɩ a ba a daanɩ abam tee nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ pʋrɩ cwǝŋǝ lanyɩranɩ DƖ pa-nɩ, sɩ a tiini a tʋŋɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa yo seeni. Nɔɔna zanzan nan mʋ wʋra ba kwaana sɩ ba cɩ a yigǝ.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Timoti nan na tu abam te, sɩ á jeer-o lanyɩranɩ sɩ kʋ yɩ pa fʋʋnɩ taa jɩg-o. Bɛŋwaanɩ o dɩ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu tɩtʋŋa yam mʋ nɩ amʋ te.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o goon-o. Kwaanɩ-na sɩ á wǝl-o o cwǝŋǝ kam vǝŋǝ wʋnɩ, sɩ o wanɩ o vu dɩ yazurǝ o ba amʋ te. Amʋ dɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam nan nii-o cwǝŋǝ nɩ sɩ o ba.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Apolɔsɩ, amʋ tiini a loor-o mʋ sɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam o ba abam te. Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, o ta wʋ lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ o ba lele. O nan na nɛ cwǝŋǝ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, oó ba. Tiim kwǝrǝ

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Taá cʋ-na á tɩtɩ, sɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ. Taá jɩgɩ-na baarɩ dɩ dam.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Á taá kɩ-na woŋo maama dɩ sono.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á maŋɩ á ye Sɩtefanasɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ na tɔgɩ Wɛ te tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ dɛ yigǝ ba sɛ Zezi Akayi nɩ, yɩ ba sɛ ba tʋŋɩ ba zǝni Wɛ nɔɔna bam dɩ ba wʋ maama.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, a loori abam sɩ á sɛ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ dwi ni, dɩdaanɩ balʋ maama na tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam nɩ bantʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Amʋ jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ Sɩtefanasɩ dɩ Fɔtunatusi dɩ Akayikusi na tu amʋ te tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ pɛ a wʋ lwarɩ nɩ abam tǝrǝ.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Bantʋ mʋ pɛ a jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru, nɩ ba na pɛ abam dɩ jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru te tɩn. Kʋntʋ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá nɩgɩ nɔɔna bantʋ dwi.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm maama Azitɩ-niǝ yam wʋnɩ tɩn jɔɔnɩ abam. Akwila dɩ Prisili dɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam lanyɩranɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam maama dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam. Á taá jɔɔnɩ daanɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ sono dɩ wʋ-poŋo.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli mʋ jɔɔnɩ abam. A tɩtɩ laan mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ dɩ a jɩŋa.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na ba soe dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋ tu. Marana ta!

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Amʋ soe abam maama dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ Wɛ na kuri dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ, yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Timoti mʋ tɔgɩ o wǝli-nɩ. Dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa abam balʋ na yɩ Wɛ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔna yɩ á zʋʋrɩ Korɛntɩ nɩ tɩn, kʋ wǝli dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna maama balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Akayi tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Wɛ na tiini DƖ zǝni dɩbam te tɩn

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi Ko, yɩ DƖ yɩ dɩbam Ko wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ dɩbam ŋwaŋa tɩn. DƖ maa yɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na zǝni nɔɔna sɩ ba bɩcara taa zurǝ maŋa maama tɩn.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩbam jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ abam, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ, abam na tɔgɩ á na dɩbam yaara yam doŋ tɩn, á dɩ wʋ́ tɔgɩ á na zǝnǝ Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ pa abam lwarɩ yaara yalʋ maama dɩ́ na nɛ Azi tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn mʋ. Dɩ́ na nɛ cam dɩlʋ tɩn tiini dɩ dana dɩ dwe dɩbam, yɩ dɩ́ yaá bʋŋɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ ga dɩ́ ŋwɩa.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na zɩgɩ tʋʋnɩ yigǝ nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ daa yɩ taá tɩɩgɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ dam mʋ, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na jɩgɩ dam DƖ paɩ nɔɔna bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ vrɩ dɩbam yaara yalʋ na cana nɩ tʋʋnɩ te tɩn wʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ ta wʋ́ vrɩ dɩbam kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Dɩ́ maa jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ, nɩ DƖ ta wʋ́ vrɩ dɩbam tʋʋnɩ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na jɩgɩ wʋpolo tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ ye dɩ́ bɩcarɩ nɩ, nɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ dɩ wʋ-poŋo mʋ, dɩ dɩ́ na brɩ dɩ́ wʋ dɩ abam te tɩn. Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ mʋ zǝni dɩbam yɩ dɩ́ yɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋ daɩ dɩ nabiinǝ swan, kʋ yɩ Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kʋntʋ doŋ nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ abam yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ dɩ́ pa abam tɩn ba jɩgɩ wo-sǝgiru. Á wʋ́ wanɩ á karɩmɩ yɩ á ni tɩ kuri.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nan yɩ cɩga tu yɩ DƖ ye nɩ dɩbam na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn daɩ niǝ yale, nɩnɛɛnɩ ɛɛn dɩ awo na gwaanɩ daanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan na brɩ abam Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn, amʋ dɩ Silivɛn dɩ Timoti pɛ á lwarɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn na yɩ te. Wʋntʋ daɩ niǝ yale yale tu. Wʋntʋ nan mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wɩ ɛɛn yɩranɩ tɩn.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ paɩ dɩbam dɩ abam maama zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ Zezi Krisi tɔgɩm dɩm wʋnɩ. Kʋ ta yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ kuri dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋna.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri a joori a bʋŋɩ a wʋnɩ, sɩ a daa yɩ ba abam te, sɩ kʋ yɩ pa wʋ-cɔgɔ daa ta wʋra.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Abam mʋ yɩ balʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ á pa amʋ taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo tɩn. Kʋntʋ, amʋ na tu abam te, yɩ kʋ pa á wʋ cɔgɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa bá ta wʋra o na wʋ́ wanɩ o pa a na wʋpolo.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a ya pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋm a pa abam. Amʋ dɛɛn ba lagɩ sɩ a ba abam te, sɩ kʋ pa amʋ wʋ cɔgɩ dɩ abam. Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá yɩ balʋ na paɩ amʋ wʋ poli tɩn mʋ. Amʋ nan jɩgɩ abam cɩga nɩ, amʋ na jɩgɩ wʋpolo abam dɩ jɩgɩ wʋpolo mʋ.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋm a pa abam tɩn, a wʋ tiini kʋ cɔgɩ zanzan, yɩ liǝ jɩgɩ-nɩ kʋ pa a yi-na nuŋi zanzan abam ŋwaanɩ. Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ te tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ kʋ pa á wʋrʋ cɔgɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ sɩ á wanɩ á lwarɩ amʋ na tiini a soe abam kʋ ja gaalɩ te tɩn mʋ. Á maŋɩ sɩ á yagɩ á ma cɛ wʋlʋ na kɩ o cɔgɩ tɩn

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kɩ o cɔgɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ amʋ yɩranɩ wʋ mʋ cɔgɩ dɩd-o, kʋ yɩ abam maama mʋ, sɩ a nan yɩ zaŋɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ a ja gaalɩ, a ye sɩ abam zanzan wʋrʋ mʋ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Abam zanzan na pɛ o na cam tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á laan yag-o mʋ.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ a loori abam sɩ á pa o lwarɩ nɩ á so-o.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋm tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ a maasɩ abam a nii, á wʋ́ sɛ á tɔgɩ amʋ ni dɩm woŋo maama baŋa nɩ naa á bá sɛ mʋ.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Abam na yagɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ kǝm á ma cɛ-o, amʋ dɩ wʋ́ yagɩ a ma cɛ-o mʋ. Kʋ na maŋɩ sɩ a yagɩ a ma cɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ, kʋ yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kɩ kʋntʋ Zezi Krisi yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ duri nɔɔnʋ wʋm ŋwaŋa kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ yɩ pa sʋtaanɩ na cwǝŋǝ dɩ wanɩ dɩbam. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ ye dɩntʋ na bʋŋɩ sɩ dɩ pa dɩbam tusi te tɩn. Liǝ na jaanɩ Pooli Trʋasɩ nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Amʋ na ve a yi tɩʋ kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Trʋasɩ sɩ a tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam a brɩ nɔɔna tɩn, a nɛ nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ya pɛ-nɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a tɔɔlɩ-ka.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, a wʋ nɛ wʋ-zuru dɩ a na beeri dɩ́ ko-bu Titi je a ga tɩn. A na wʋ nɛ-o tɩn, a ma banɩ nɔɔna bam yɩ a daarɩ a kɛ Masɩdʋanɩ. Dɩ́ na nɛ wɔnɔ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Nan pa-na dɩ́ taá kɩ Wɛ le. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩntʋ mʋ paɩ Zezi Krisi wɔnɔ, yɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ o kwaga maŋa maama, sɩ dɩ́ taá paɩ nɔɔna lwarɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam je maama, nɩnɛɛnɩ woŋo kʋlʋ lwǝm na ywǝnǝ yɩ dɩ zaŋɩ dɩ jagɩ je maama te tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nyɩ dɩ lwǝm dɩlʋ na ywǝnǝ tɩn mʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, dɩ́ na brɩ nɔɔna Zezi Krisi cɩga kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩbam nyɩ dɩ lwǝm dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ nɔɔna maama tee nɩ. Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na lagɩ ba ga ba ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, lwǝm dɩm kʋntʋ maa paɩ ba ye nɩ tʋʋnɩ wʋ́ ja-ba. Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ Wɛ na vrɩ ba ŋwɩa tɩn, lwǝm dɩm wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ ywǝǝni ba tee nɩ, dɩ pa ba ye nɩ baá na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam. Wɔɔ mʋ yi sɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunu kʋm kʋntʋ?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan na brɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam te tɩn, ba paɩ kʋ nyɩ dɩ pipiu mʋ sɩ ba na nyɔɔrɩ kʋ baŋa nɩ. Dɩbam nan daɩ kʋntʋ doŋ. Wɛ na tʋŋɩ dɩbam tɩn, dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ kwe dɩ́ wʋ maama mʋ dɩ́ maa brɩ DƖ cɩga kam, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋɔɔna, dɩ́ na yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋna tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Abam na jɩgɩ á ŋwɩa te tɩn nyɩ dɩ tɔnɔ mʋ Zezi Krisi na tɔgɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ o pʋpʋnɩ. O nan na pʋpʋnɩ te tɩn, o mɛ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ o pʋpʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ bǝrǝ mʋ o mɛ o pʋpʋnɩ. Pʋpʋnɩm dɩm kʋntʋ nan wʋ kɩ kandwa-pɩlɛ baŋa nɩ, o pʋpʋnɩ-dɩ nabiinǝ bɩcara nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ kʋntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, dɩ Zezi Krisi na pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ mʋ tʋŋɩ dɩbam tɩn.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ dɩ dɩbam tɩtɩ dam mʋ dɩ́ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ ma tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ paɩ dɩbam dam yɩ dɩ́ maa tʋŋa.

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Wɛ na kwe DƖ cullu tɩm DƖ kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ sɩ o pa DƖ nɔɔna bam tɩn, DƖ dɛɛn pʋpʋnɩ-tɩ DƖ kɩ kandwa-pɩlɛ baŋa nɩ mʋ. Wɛ dɛɛn na kwe-tɩ DƖ kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam maa tiini ya wʋra, yɩ kʋ pa Moyisi yibiyǝ tiini ka nyɩɩna. O yibiyǝ kam nyɩɩnɩm dɩm na pɩpɩlɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam yiǝ dɩ pa ba warɩ ba nii o seeni tɩn wʋ́ ba kɛ. Nan dɩ cullu tɩm na jaanɩ tʋʋnɩ mʋ tɩ ba tɩn, tɩ daa ta jɩgɩ Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ.

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm nan na wǝli nɔɔna te tɩn laan wʋ́ pa Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ yam tiini ya ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn, woŋo kʋlʋ ya na jɩgɩ zulǝ tɩn daa ba jɩgɩ zulǝ, zɩm woŋo kʋm na tiini kʋ jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ kʋ ja gaalɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu tɩm dɛɛn wʋra dɩ DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam, yɩ tɩntʋ ba tɩ kɛ. Kʋ daarɩ DƖ zǝnǝ yalʋ na wʋ́ ta wʋra maŋa maama tɩn wʋ́ pa DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam tiini ya ta wʋra ya ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan bá sǝgi kʋlʋkʋlʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ Moyisi dɛɛn na kwe gɔrɔ o ma kwǝli o yiǝ tɩn. O dɛɛn kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam mʋ yɩ taa naɩ o yibiyǝ kam nyɩɩnɩm dɩm na wʋra dɩ ti tɩn.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Nan dɩ zɩm maama dɩ, bantʋ na karɩmɩ Moyisi twaanʋ tɩm, ba ba ni kʋ kuri, gɔrɔ kʋm kʋntʋ na kwǝli ba yiǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na lǝni o wʋ o sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm, kʋʋ́ pa gɔrɔ kʋm dwanɩ kʋntʋ tu yiǝ nɩ.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Dɩbam bá ga baarɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ kǝm dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ pɛ dɩbam tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
