translation_verse: Dɩbam nan jɩgɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ nɔɔna na sǝgi ba kɩ yɩ tɩ jɩgɩ cavɩɩra tɩn. Dɩ́ nan ba ganɩ nɔɔna dɩ swan, naa dɩ́ lǝni Wɛ taanɩ dɩm. Dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam mʋ jaja, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna maama lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ na kɩ te tɩn tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Bantʋ ba sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam, bɛŋwaanɩ sʋtaanɩ dɩlʋ na di dam lʋgʋ kʋntʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ ba wʋbʋŋa vugimi. Dɩ kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ ba yɩ wanɩ ba na pooni dɩlʋ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na lagɩ ka pa-ba tɩn mʋ. Kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ brɩ Zezi Krisi paarɩ-zulǝ na yɩ te tɩn mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ nyɩ dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ fasɩ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o ta o wɩ: «Pooni zǝŋi lim wʋnɩ». Dɩntʋ nan ta mʋ yɩ dɩlʋ na pɛ pooni ba dɩ zǝŋi dɩ́ bɩcara nɩ tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam na yɩ te, yɩ yantʋ mʋ dɩ́ naɩ Zezi Krisi yibiyǝ nɩ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Yaara zanzan yǝni ya yi dɩbam, yɩ ya warɩ dɩ́ yigǝ ya cɩ. Liǝ yǝni ya tiini ya ja dɩbam, yɩ ya warɩ dɩbam wʋbʋŋa ya cɔgɩ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna yǝni ba bɛɛsɩ dɩbam, Wɛ nan ba fɔgɩ DƖ yagɩ dɩbam. Dɩ́ dʋna yǝni ba magɩ dɩbam ba dɩ tɩga nɩ, yɩ ba ba fɔgɩ ba gʋɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ŋwɩa kam wʋnɩ maŋa maama dɩ́ wʋ tʋʋnɩ ni nɩ mʋ, dɩ́ na sɛ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ pa Zezi ŋwɩa kam taa wʋ dɩ́ yɩra yalʋ na wʋ́ ba ya tɩ tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩbam zɩgɩ tʋʋnɩ yigǝ nɩ mʋ maŋa maama, sɩ abam wanɩ á na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Kʋ maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Amʋ na kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ a ŋɔɔna.» Dɩbam dɩ na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ DƖ cɩga kam.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ye nɩ Wɛ mʋ bi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ ta wʋ́ bi dɩbam dɩ, sɩ dɩ́ na ŋwɩa DƖ tee nɩ dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ wʋ́ pa dɩbam dɩ abam maama tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ zɩgɩ DƖ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na kɩ te maama tɩn yɩ abam zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ vrɩ nɔɔna zanzan DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa ba taa kɩ-DƖ le zanzan yɩ ba zuli-DƖ kʋ ja gaalɩ. Dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa maŋɩ sɩ ya taa tɔgɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩm mʋ

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Dɩbam yɩra yam dɩ́ na jɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn nyɩ dɩ vwe mʋ dɩ́ na zʋʋrɩ dɩ wʋnɩ. Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ, vwe dɩm kʋntʋ na cɔgɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ pa dɩ́ na digǝ DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá zʋʋrɩ da. Kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ mʋ lɔgɩ digǝ kam kʋntʋ. Ka nan wʋ́ ta wʋra maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ dɩ́ zʋ digǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩ́ na zʋ gɔrɔ te tɩn, dɩ́ daa bá ta nyɩ nɩ nɔn-kalambwǝǝlu te.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ta na zʋʋrɩ dɩ́ lʋgʋ baŋa vwe dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn, dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ kʋnɩ mʋ nɩ dɩ́ zɩŋɩ zɩla mʋ te. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ dɩ dɩ́ yɩra yam mʋ dɩ́ yagɩ. Dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ zʋ ya-dʋʋra yalʋ Wɛ na tiŋi DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ sɩ DƖ pa dɩbam tɩn mʋ, sɩ DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam laan pa dɩ́ yɩra yalʋ na wʋ́ tɩ tɩn daa yɩ taa jɩgɩ kuri.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ jɩgɩ pu-dɩa maŋa maama, yɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ, dɩ́ ta na jɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa yɩra yam tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ ta wʋ ve dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ poli dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ maŋa maama tɩn, dɩ́ na wʋ tɩga baŋa nɩ naa dɩ́ zɩ ve Wɛ-sɔŋɔ dɩ.

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá kwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm te. Mʋ kʋ kuri dɩ́ kwaana sɩ dɩ́ pa nɔɔna lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam. Wɛ ye dɩbam wʋ lanyɩranɩ. Amʋ nan bʋŋɩ nɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ ta ye kʋntʋ á bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ dɩbam lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ brɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ dɩ abam. Dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ zǝni abam mʋ, sɩ á wanɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩbam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ á wʋ́ wanɩ á vɩn balʋ na tu abam te, yɩ ba jɩgɩ tɩɩra dɩ ba na brɩ ba tɩtɩ te, yɩ ba yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ ba wʋrʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Abam paɩ dɩbam ba jɩgɩ swan mʋ na? Kʋ nan na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩ́ nan jɩgɩ swan, kʋ yɩ abam zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn, kʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi sono kʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa mʋ tɩga o lǝni nɔɔna maama yuu nɩ, yɩ kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ ba maama dɩ tɔgɩ dɩd-o ba tɩ mʋ.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Zezi tɩgɩ ba maama ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ balʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn daa yɩ taa ŋwɩ nɩ ba tɩtɩ na lagɩ te tɩn, sɩ ba taa ŋwɩ wʋlʋ na lǝni ba yuu nɩ o tɩ yɩ o joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam daa ba kuri nɔɔna da-wʋnɩ nɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. Dɩbam dɛɛn ya jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa yantʋ doŋ mʋ dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ na nii Zezi Krisi te tɩn. Lele kʋntʋ dɩ́ nan daa ba jeeli kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam mʋ, yɩ o ŋwɩ-doŋǝ kam kɛ. O ŋwɩa kam maama laan lǝni ka ji ŋwɩ-dʋŋa mʋ.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ kɩ kʋ maama. Dɩntʋ mʋ tagɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ DƖ fɔgɩ dɩbam dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ daanɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa dɩbam tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ, sɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna nɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɛ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ fɔgɩ nabiinǝ dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ daanɩ, kʋ pa Wɛ daa ba jeeli ba lwarɩm. DƖ ma tʋŋɩ dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ taá brɩ nɔɔna DƖ fɔgɩm dɩm kʋntʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ dɩbam lǝni Zezi Krisi yuu nɩ mʋ sɩ dɩ́ taá brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ. Kʋ maa nyɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ tɔgɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ DƖ ŋɔɔna dɩ abam. Dɩ́ nan loori abam Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ sɩ á sɛ, sɩ á dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na ba jɩgɩ lwarɩm tɩn. Wɛ nan pɛ dɩbam lwarɩm dɩm tɔgɩ wʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ cɩga mʋ Wɛ tee nɩ wʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na wǝli dɩ Wɛ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa yam tɩn, dɩ́ loori abam sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á pa Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm DƖ na pɛ abam tɩn ji kafɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ta DƖ wɩ: «Maŋa kalʋ na maŋɩ dɩ a wʋbʋŋa tɩn, amʋ sɛ nmʋ loro kʋm. Dɛ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ a vrɩ nmʋ tɩn, amʋ zǝni nmʋ.» Nii-na! Wɛ zǝnǝ maŋa kam yiǝ. Kʋ yɩ zɩm mʋ DƖ lagɩ DƖ vrɩ abam. Pooli na yaarɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na tʋŋɩ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ na cwǝŋǝ o lwɛ dɩ́ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ ba kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋ sɩ o yɩ da Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan kwaanɩ dɩ́ brɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ nɩ dɩ́ yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋna mʋ woŋo maama wʋnɩ. Dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ vɔ dɩ́ wʋ mʋ, kʋ na yɩ yaara naa cam dɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ba magɩ dɩbam yɩ ba jaanɩ dɩbam ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ kuni zanzan. Ba maa yeeri dɩbam. Dɩ́ maa yǝni dɩ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-cɛɛra. Dɩ́ maa ba dɔ dɩ́ sui, yɩ dɩ́ pɩɩnɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ dɩ kana.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma maɩ wʋ-poŋo dɩ yǝno dɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ́ maa tʋŋa, yɩ dɩ́ ta kwǝri dɩ́ kɩ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ. Dɩ́ maa jɩgɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam dɩ sono cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ maa ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ Wɛ dam dɩ́ ma dɩ́ tʋŋa. Dɩ́ na yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ te tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ dɩ́ na ze jara zɩla jazɩm dɩ jagwiǝ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badonnǝ paɩ dɩbam zulǝ, yɩ badaara gooni dɩbam. Babam maa twɩ dɩbam, yɩ badaara paɩ dɩbam cɩga. Badonnǝ maa paɩ dɩ́ yɩ balʋ na ganɩ nɔɔna tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ nan yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Badaara tɛ ba wɩ, ba yǝri dɩbam, yɩ nɔɔna maama yagɩ ba ye dɩbam lanyɩranɩ. Badonnǝ ma paɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ tɩ mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ nan ta ŋwɩ. Ba paɩ dɩ́ naɩ cam, yɩ ba nan wʋ wanɩ ba gʋ dɩbam.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa paɩ dɩ́ wʋ cɔga, yɩ dɩ́ nan ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo maŋa maama. Nɔɔna paɩ dɩ́ yɩ yinigǝ tiinǝ mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ yagɩ dɩ́ wǝli nɔɔna zanzan dɩ wo-laarʋ. Nɔɔna paɩ dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ nan jɩgɩ woŋo maama Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ badonnǝ Korɛntɩ tiinǝ-ba, dɩ́ kwe dɩ́ bɩcara maama mʋ dɩ́ ma ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ abam jaja. Dɩbam tiini dɩ́ soe abam dɩ dɩ́ bɩcara maama.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ dɩbam mʋ cɩgɩ sono kʋlʋ na wʋ dɩbam dɩ abam laŋa nɩ tɩn daanɩ, kʋ yɩ abam mʋ cɩga.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Amʋ nan loori abam nɩ á yɩ a biǝ mʋ te, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ amʋ sono kʋm doŋ á bɩcara nɩ. Jwǝnǝ dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ na ba tʋŋɩ daanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Abam nan yɩ zaŋɩ á kwe á tɩtɩ á wǝli dɩ balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn, sɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ balɔrɔ ba jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ daanɩ. Pooni dɩ lim dɩ nan ba jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ.

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi dɩ sʋtaanɩ bá wanɩ ba taa jɩgɩ ni-dɩdwɩ. Wʋlʋ na sɛ Zezi tɩn dɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ sɛ-o tɩn bá wanɩ ba taa jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Jwǝnǝ nan bá wanɩ ya taa jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ dɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ digǝ. Dɩbam nan mʋ nyɩ dɩ Wɛ digǝ kam DƖ na zʋʋrɩ ka wʋnɩ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ta DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ ta zʋʋrɩ a nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ, yɩ a wʋra dɩ ba. Amʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ bantʋ Wɛ, yɩ ba dɩ wʋ́ ta yɩ amʋ nɔɔna.»

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ abam Ko, yɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ ta yɩ amʋ biǝ.» Mʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na jɩgɩ dam wǝǝnu maama baŋa nɩ tɩn na tagɩ te.

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, Wɛ na goni DƖ ni dɩm DƖ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ maama yɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Mʋ kʋ kuri, á pa-na dɩ́ lɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ wo-zɔɔna yalʋ maama dɩ́ na wʋ́ kɩ yɩ ya cɔgɩ dɩ́ yɩra dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa tɩn wʋnɩ. Pa-na dɩ́ taá kwaana dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo fasɩ, dɩ́ na kwarɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Pooli na jɩgɩ wʋpolo woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ tɩn

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩbam sono taa wʋ á bɩcara nɩ. Dɩbam nan wʋ kɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ wo-balɔrɔ. Dɩ́ wʋ kɩ dɩ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yigǝ. Dɩ́ nan wʋ pini abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ woŋo.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ tagɩ kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ yáalɩ abam. Amʋ maŋɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ, kʋlʋkʋlʋ bá wanɩ kʋ pɔɔrɩ dɩbam dɩ abam sono kʋm daanɩ, kʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa naa tʋʋnɩ dɩ.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ abam cɩga, yɩ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan abam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, yaara yalʋ maama na jɩgɩ dɩbam tɩn, amʋ ta jɩgɩ baarɩ yɩ a tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, dɩbam na ve dɩ́ yi Masɩdʋanɩ tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ nɛ siun dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ. Cana dwi tǝri tǝri tiini ya ja dɩbam. Nɔɔna dɛɛn magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ dɩbam, yɩ fʋʋnɩ tiini dɩ zʋ dɩbam.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan yɩ dɩlʋ na zǝni nɔɔna balʋ wʋrʋ na cɔgɩ tɩn, yɩ DƖ pa ba bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ. DƖ ma pa dɩbam dɩ bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ, dɩ DƖ na pɛ Titi ba dɩbam te tɩn.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ye nɩ, a na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋlʋ a pa abam tɩn mʋ pɛ á jɩgɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ. Amʋ nan ta wʋ joori a za wʋbʋŋa dɩ a na pʋpʋnɩ-kʋ te tɩn. Kʋ-yigǝ nɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋbʋŋa ya waɩ ya zaɩ dɩ a tɔnɔ kʋm na pɛ abam wʋ cɔgɩ tɩn, kʋ nan wʋ tiini kʋ daanɩ.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan nan jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Kʋ daɩ abam wʋ na cɔgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo, kʋ yɩ á wʋ-cɔgɔ kʋm na pɛ á lǝni á wʋ te tɩn mʋ. Á wʋ-cɔgɔ kʋm maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ, sɩ dɩbam wʋ kɩ abam wo-lɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa tɩn, kʋʋ́ pa o lǝni o wʋ o daarɩ o na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ kʋntʋ bá wanɩ kʋ pa o ta nɩ, o ya na maanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ nan na jɩgɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ nɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn te, kʋʋ́ pa wʋntʋ ga o ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋm a pa abam tɩn, kʋ daɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ o cɔgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ nan daɩ o na kɩ lwarɩm dɩm dɩ wʋlʋ tɩn dɩ. Amʋ nan lagɩ sɩ a pa abam mʋ lwarɩ jaja Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, nɩ abam kwaanɩ zanzan dɩbam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ yɩranɩ má. Dɩbam ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ ja gaalɩ, dɩ́ na nɛ sɩ Titi wʋ poli dɩ abam tɩn ŋwaanɩ dɩ abam na pɛ o na baarɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Amʋ na lagɩ a tʋŋ-o sɩ o ba abam te tɩn, amʋ tee abam fɩnfɩɩn a brɩ-o. Abam nan wʋ pɛ cavɩɩra ja amʋ dɩ a na tee abam te tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩbam na tee abam dɩ́ brɩ Titi te tɩn jɩgɩ cɩga mʋ, nɩ dɩ́ na yǝni dɩ́ tɛ cɩga dɩ abam maŋa maama te tɩn.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: O na tu abam te tɩn, á jeer-o lanyɩranɩ dɩ ya-sɩʋ, yɩ á daarɩ á sɛ o ni. Kʋntʋ, o na yǝni o guli abam gulǝ, kʋ paɩ o tiini o jɩgɩ abam sono kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam, a na jɩgɩ abam cɩga woŋo maama wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa abam lwarɩ Wɛ na kɩ Zezi nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Masɩdʋanɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn yu-yoŋo te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, ba wǝli nɔɔna kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba tɩtɩ na jɩgɩ te tɩn, yɩ ba ta yǝni ba paɩ kʋ dwǝni ba tɩtɩ na wʋ́ daarɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Ba tɩtɩ nan mʋ mɛ ba wʋbʋŋa ba loori dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ pa-ba cwǝŋǝ, sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ ba wǝli Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ yinigǝ na jɩgɩ-ba Zeruzalɛm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ loori Titi wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o puli o joŋi abam sǝbu-lɩʋ kʋm tɩn, sɩ o joori o ba abam te o wǝli abam sɩ á tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ á ti.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ te tɩn maŋɩ kʋ lana kʋ ja gaalɩ, dɩ á na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ yɩ á tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝrǝ kam lanyɩranɩ yɩ á jɩgɩ yǝno te tɩn. Á ta kwǝri á kwaanɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam, yɩ á tiini á soe dɩbam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá pa á wʋrʋ ywǝmmǝ dɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ba lagɩ sɩ a fɩn abam dɩ á na wʋ́ la sǝbu kʋm te tɩn. Amʋ nan pɛ abam mʋ lwarɩ nɔɔna badaara na tiini ba kwaanɩ ba wǝli ba donnǝ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ abam wʋ́ wanɩ á brɩ nɩ á sɩɩnɩ á soe á donnǝ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Nan tʋŋɩ-na tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ á vu á ti dɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna, nɩ á na maŋɩ á lɩ wʋbʋŋa te tɩn, sɩ á taá paɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ á na jɩgɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ amʋ lagɩ sɩ a pa abam taá wǝli nɔɔna sɩ bantʋ sin, sɩ abam tɩtɩ daarɩ á ji yinigǝ tiinǝ mʋ. Kʋ yɩ sɩ á taá tǝli daanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ abam jɩŋa gara, yɩ á wʋ́ wanɩ á wǝli balʋ yinigǝ na jɩgɩ-ba tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ, yinigǝ na tu ka ja abam dɩ, bantʋ dɩ daa wʋ́ wanɩ ba wǝli abam dɩ ba na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ á maama wʋ́ ta tǝli daanɩ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na nɛ wʋdiu zanzan tɩn daa wʋ daarɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na nɛ fɩnfɩɩn tɩn nyɩm daa wʋ mur-o.»

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan kɩ Wɛ le dɩ DƖ na pɛ Titi wʋbʋŋa sɩ o kwaanɩ o wǝli abam, nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩbam na lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ wǝli abam te tɩn.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: O ma sɛ dɩbam na loor-o sɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ abam wǝlim ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ tɩtɩ nan maŋɩ o lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ o ba abam te, bɛŋwaanɩ o tiini o lagɩ sɩ o wǝli abam.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa dɩ́ ko-bu wʋdoŋ mʋ tɔgɩ dɩ wʋntʋ o ba. O maa yɩ wʋlʋ Zezi nɔɔna bam maama na nɩg-o dɩ o na brɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam te tɩn.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma kwǝri ba lɩ-o sɩ o taa tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam o jaanɩ sǝbu kʋlʋ dɩ́ na ma dɩ́ zǝni yinigǝ tiinǝ tɩn o ve Zeruzalɛm. Dɩ́ na wǝli nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm mʋ na zulǝ, yɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá wǝli nɔɔna.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan kwaanɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ na lana dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yigǝ nɩ dɩ nabiinǝ dɩ yigǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ daa ta lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ ko-bu wʋdoŋ sɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ bantʋ o ba á te. Wǝǝnu zanzan wʋnɩ mʋ dɩ́ maas-o, yɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ o kwaana dɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam. O jɩgɩ abam cɩga lanyɩranɩ, yɩ kʋ pa o tiini o bʋŋɩ sɩ o wǝli abam.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Titi, dɩbam mʋ tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ abam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ badaara bam, kʋ yɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam mʋ lɩ-ba sɩ ba taa tʋŋa, sɩ kʋ pa Zezi Krisi na zulǝ.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kwaanɩ-na sɩ kʋ pa ba lwarɩ nɩ á soe á donnǝ, sɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam lwarɩ kʋ ni nɩ. Kʋntʋ, ba laan wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ, dɩ́ na jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam te tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ a maŋɩ a ye nɩ abam jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ á wǝli-ba, yɩ a tee abam Masɩdʋanɩ tiinǝ bam yigǝ nɩ. A brɩ-ba nɩ, abam balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Akayi tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn maŋɩ á ti á yigǝ sɩ á la sǝbu kʋm, kʋ zɩgɩ deen bɩm dɩm nɩ mʋ. Masɩdʋanɩ tiinǝ bam na lwarɩ abam na tiini á kwaanɩ sɩ á wǝli nɔɔna te tɩn, kʋ ma pa sɩ ba zanzan wʋbʋŋa tɔgɩ kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan bʋŋɩ sɩ a pa dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam ba abam te, sɩ kʋ pa dɩbam na tee abam te tɩn yɩ ba kʋ ji kafɛ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa á wanɩ á ti á yigǝ nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ na maŋɩ a ta kʋlʋ a brɩ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, Masɩdʋanɩ tiinǝ bam na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ ba ba abam te yɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ á ta wʋ ti á yigǝ, kʋʋ́ pa cavɩɩra ja dɩbam dɩ dɩ́ na wɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ á cɩga te tɩn. Kʋ ma wʋ́ pa cavɩɩra ja abam dɩ.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ a loori dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam, sɩ ba da yigǝ ba wuuri ba ba abam te. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa á wanɩ á la pɛɛra yam á ti, nɩnɛɛnɩ á na maŋɩ á ta nɩ á wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ laan ba dɩ́ joŋi. Amʋ lagɩ sɩ á ma á wʋ-yoŋo mʋ á pa sǝbu kʋm, sɩ á yɩ ta kɔrɔ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na dugi wǝǝnu fɩnfɩɩn te tɩn mʋ, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ ba o na fɩnfɩɩn mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ na dugi zanzan tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ ba o na zanzan mʋ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan maŋɩ sɩ o pa sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ o na lɩ o wʋbʋŋa te tɩn mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ dɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ naa nɔɔnʋ na fɩ-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋlʋ na paɩ dɩ wʋpolo tɩn, Wɛ soe kʋntʋ tu mʋ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan jɩgɩ dam sɩ DƖ pa abam DƖ zaanɩ dɩm maama, sɩ kʋ pa á taá jɩgɩ kʋlʋ maama á na lagɩ tɩn maŋa maama, yɩ á daa ta wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ kʋ gaalɩ sɩ á taá ma kɩ wo-laarʋ dwi maama,

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔn-ŋʋm pɔɔrɩ o wǝǝnu mʋ o paɩ yinigǝ tiinǝ, yɩ o kǝm-laarʋ tɩm wʋ́ ta wʋra mɩmaŋa maama.»

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa á taá jɩgɩ wo-laarʋ dwi maama, sɩ á wanɩ á taá wǝli nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna zanzan taa kɩ Wɛ le, ba na joŋi abam zǝnǝ yam dɩbam tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Abam na jɩgɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam á wǝli te tɩn mʋ paɩ ba naɩ kʋlʋ ba ya na gɛ tɩn. Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ yɩranɩ, kʋ ta wʋ́ pa nɔɔna zanzan tiini ba taa kɩ Wɛ le kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Abam zǝnǝ yam kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ brɩ nɩ á tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga cɩga, yɩ kʋ pa DƖ na zulǝ zanzan, dɩ nɔɔna bam na lwarɩ nɩ á sɩɩnɩ á sɛ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam nɩ á na maŋɩ á ta te tɩn. Wɛ ta wʋ́ na zulǝ nɔɔna tee nɩ, dɩ á na lɩ á wǝǝnu á ma zǝni-ba, yɩ á daarɩ á pa nɔɔna badonnǝ dɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Ba ma wʋ́ ta loori Wɛ abam ŋwaanɩ, yɩ baá ta soe abam dɩ ba wʋ maama, dɩ Wɛ na tiini DƖ kɩ abam yu-yoŋo kʋ ja gaalɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le DƖ na wǝli dɩbam maama dɩ DƖ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ doŋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: yɩ dɩ́ yáalɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ maama na zaŋɩ sɩ dɩ cɩ nabiinǝ Wɛ cɩga kam wʋnɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ maa wanɩ wʋbʋŋa yam kʋntʋ maama dam, yɩ dɩ́ paɩ ya lǝni ya sɛ Zezi Krisi ni.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Maanɩ-na á nii kʋ na yɩ te tɩn. Abam wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ cɩga nɩ o yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔnʋ, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o lwarɩ nɩ dɩbam dɩ yɩ Zezi nɔɔna mʋ nɩ wʋntʋ te.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ na tiini a brɩ abam a tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam ni dɩlʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, amʋ ba kwarɩ cavɩɩra dɩ kʋntʋ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm pɛ dɩbam ni dɩm kʋntʋ, sɩ dɩ́ taá ma dɩ́ kwɛ abam mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ sɩ dɩ́ ma cɔgɩ abam.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Amʋ ba lagɩ sɩ abam bʋŋɩ nɩ a pʋpʋnɩ a twaanʋ tɩm sɩ a ma fugi abam mʋ.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Abam badaara tɛ nɩ, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ a twaanʋ tɩm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ cana, yɩ tɩ ta kwǝri tɩ dana. Kʋ daarɩ, amʋ tɩtɩ na wʋ á tee nɩ, a yɩ zurim yɩranɩ mʋ, yɩ a ni-taanɩ ba kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Balʋ na yǝni ba tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ, dɩ́ na tǝri abam tee nɩ yɩ dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama tɩn yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ dɩ́ na wʋ abam tee nɩ yɩ dɩ́ kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ ba lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ tee dɩ́ tɩtɩ sɩ kʋ gaalɩ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ sɩ dɩ́ taá tʋŋɩ tɩn. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ dɩbam tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ sɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, yɩ dɩbam maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ wʋpolo dɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩbam wʋ gaalɩ sisǝm dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn, dɩ dɩ́ na tu abam te dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ba tee dɩ́ tɩtɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ tɩtʋŋa baŋa nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ gaalɩ sisǝm dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn. Dɩ́ nan jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ á na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn wʋ́ fɔgɩ kʋ kɩ dam, sɩ kʋ pa tɩtʋŋa yalʋ dɩ́ na tʋŋɩ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn wanɩ ya puli zanzan, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Kʋ daa ta wʋ́ pa dɩ́ na cwǝŋǝ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ gaalɩ abam na zʋʋrɩ je sɩlʋ nɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ ba tee dɩ́ tɩtɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ DƖ tɩntʋŋna badonnǝ na maŋɩ ba tʋŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jɩgɩ liǝ mʋ dɩ abam nɩ nɔɔna badaara wʋ́ sʋgɩ abam sɩ á daa yɩ sɛ Zezi Krisi dɩ á bɩcara maama, nɩnɛɛnɩ sʋtaanɩ dɛɛn na jigi bɩsankwɩa dɩ kɩ swan dɩ ganɩ Awa te tɩn.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ na tu abam te yɩ o brɩ abam wǝǝnu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ yɩ tɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩbam zaasɩm dɩm, á yǝni á sɛ mʋ mwalɩ mwalɩ. Á maa yǝni á sɛ joro kʋlʋ na daɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm á na maŋɩ á joŋi tɩn, yɩ á daa ta sɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ, ka na daɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ dɩbam na brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Amʋ na maŋɩ a warɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ nɩ bantʋ te, a swan vɩɩrɩ a ye kʋlʋ a na ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn, yɩ maŋa maama dɩ́ maa yǝni dɩ́ pa á lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ swan woŋo maama wʋnɩ jaja.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Amʋ na yǝni a ga woŋo maŋa kam a na wʋ á tee nɩ tɩn, a ba yaarɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ na nuŋi Masɩdʋanɩ ba ba tɩn mʋ jaanɩ kʋlʋ maama a na lagɩ tɩn ba ba ba pa-nɩ. Amʋ dɛɛn na maŋɩ a ba yaarɩ abam tɩn, a daa ta bá yaarɩ abam.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Amʋ na jɩgɩ Zezi Krisi cɩga kam te tɩn, a na beeri a vu je dɩ je Akayi nɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o cɩ amʋ yigǝ dɩ wʋpolo kʋlʋ a na jɩgɩ a ma tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam zaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ a ba soe abam mʋ na? Wɛ nan ye nɩ amʋ soe abam.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ta wʋ́ ta tʋŋɩ zaanɩ nɩ a na maŋɩ a kɩ te tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa balʋ na lagɩ sɩ ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ nɩ ba tʋŋɩ nɩ dɩbam te tɩn daa yɩ na cwǝŋǝ ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Bantʋ na kɩ te tɩn, kʋ yɩ ba ganɩ nɔɔna mʋ. Ba maa paɩ ba yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋna mʋ, yɩ kʋ nan yɩ vwan mʋ.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ nan daɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ. Sʋtaanɩ tɩtɩ waɩ dɩ lǝni dɩ brɩ nɩ dɩ yɩ malɛka kalʋ na jɩgɩ Wɛ pooni tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ ba cana sɩ sʋtaanɩ tɩntʋŋna dɩ lǝni ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ nɩ ba yɩ tɩntʋŋna balʋ na tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn. Kʋ kweelim je nɩ mʋ bantʋ nan wʋ́ ba na cam sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. Pooli na yaarɩ te Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ tɩn

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ta joori a loori abam sɩ á yɩ bʋŋɩ nɩ amʋ yɩ joro mʋ. Abam nan na maŋɩ á bʋŋɩ nɩ a yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, sɩ á kwaanɩ á ja á bɩcara, sɩ a wanɩ a na cwǝŋǝ a brɩ a tɩtɩ fɩnfɩɩn nɩ bantʋ te.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Amʋ na lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ te a ma brɩ a tɩtɩ dagɩm tɩn, kʋ ba tɔgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋbʋŋa, kʋ nyɩ dɩ jwǝrim mʋ te.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna zanzan nan na yǝni ba tɔgɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa ba ma brɩ ba tɩtɩ tɩn, amʋ dɩ waɩ a brɩ kʋntʋ doŋ.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á sɛ balʋ na yɩ jwǝǝru tɩn mwalɩ mwalɩ dɩ wʋpolo, yɩ á paɩ kʋ yɩ swan mʋ á jɩga.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á sɛ wʋlʋ maama na tu abam te yɩ o jɩgɩ fɩfɩʋn naa o di nyɔɔrɩ á baŋa nɩ tɩn, naa o na ganɩ abam o vrɩ tɩn, naa o na gooni abam tɩn, naa o na lɔɛ abam pʋpwaanʋ tɩn.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ bwǝnǝ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ dɩ́ kɩ abam kʋntʋ doŋ. Kʋntʋ nan wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ cavɩɩra na? Nɔɔnʋ nan na wʋ kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ o brɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ kʋlʋ o na kɩ tɩn, amʋ dɩ bá kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ a kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ jwǝrim.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Bantʋ brɩ nɩ ba tʋŋɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtʋŋa mʋ, amʋ nan tʋŋɩ-ya a dwe-ba. Amʋ na tʋŋɩ a pa Zezi te tɩn tiini kʋ cɛ a yɩra kʋ dwǝni bantʋ. Ba jaanɩ amʋ ba kɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ kuni zanzan kʋ dwǝni bantʋ. Ba daa ta ma magɩ amʋ zanzan kʋ dwǝni bantʋ. Amʋ dɛ tʋʋnɩ te kuni zanzan a kɛ.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Zwifǝ yigǝ tiinǝ bam jaanɩ amʋ kuni bɩnu ba magɩ balaarɩ yi fiintɔ-nʋgʋ (

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Rom tiinǝ bam dɩ ma ja-nɩ kuni bɩtɔ ba magɩ dɩ da-lɔŋɔ. Maŋa kadoŋ nɩ nɔn-kɔgɔ ma dʋlɩ-nɩ dɩ kandwa sɩ ba gʋ. Kuni bɩtɔ mʋ a zʋ naboro a tɔgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋ, yɩ kʋ ba kʋ cɔgɩ kʋ maŋɩ na bam wʋnɩ. Kuni bɩdwɩ mʋ amʋ dɩn na bam baŋa nɩ tɩtɩɩ dɩ wɩa maama.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amʋ na yǝni a beeri maŋa maama tɩn, a nɛ cana zanzan, kʋ na yɩ dɩ bwi na su sɩ pɛɛlɩ, dɩ vɩnvɩrna tee nɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ amʋ tɩtɩ dwi tiinǝ Zwifǝ bam tee nɩ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ tee nɩ. Amʋ daa ta nɛ cana tɩɩnɩ dɩm wʋnɩ dɩ kagʋa wʋnɩ dɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ, kʋ ta wǝli dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ tɩn tee nɩ.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Amʋ yǝni a tiini a tʋŋɩ zanzan kʋ cɛ a yɩra nɩ. Kuni zanzan kʋ ma pa a ba dɔ a sui. Kana dɩ na-nyɔm dɩ maa jaanɩ-nɩ yɩ a pɩɩnɩ a tɩtɩ kuni zanzan. Waarʋ maa yǝni tɩ zʋ-nɩ yɩ a ba jɩgɩ gwaarʋ.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na fɩn sɩ a brɩ a tɩtɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ brɩ a tɩtɩ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ nɩ a bwǝnǝ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ ye nɩ amʋ ba fɔ vwan. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Ko, yɩ DƖ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na wʋ Damasɩ tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, gʋvɩrma tu wʋlʋ na nii tɩʋ kʋm o pa Pɛ Arɩta tɩn mʋ tiŋi nɔɔna tɩʋ kʋm niǝ yam nɩ, sɩ ba yɩrɩ amʋ ba ja ba pa-o.

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: Zezi karabiǝ bam ma kwe-nɩ ba kɩ tɩtɔgɔ wʋnɩ, yɩ ba lǝ ŋʋna kʋ ni nɩ ba pa a tɔgɩ tɩʋ kʋm kǝbrǝ kam tǝkoro a tu yɩ a lu.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan fɩn mʋ sɩ a brɩ a tɩtɩ dɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ ba jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ dɩ, yɩ a ta wʋ́ ta dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na pɛ a yi na Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na sǝgi tɩn, dɩdaanɩ o na mɛ o cɩga kam o ma vɩɩrɩ-nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Amʋ na ti a yigǝ sɩ a ba abam te lele kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ laan lagɩ kʋ kɩ kuni bɩtɔ mʋ. Amʋ nan daa ta bá yaarɩ abam sɩ á pa-nɩ zǝnǝ. Kʋ nan daɩ á wǝǝnu naa á sǝbu mʋ a laga, kʋ yɩ á tɩtɩ mʋ. Kʋ yɩ kwǝ mʋ lagɩ wǝǝnu ba tiŋi ba biǝ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ biǝ mʋ wʋ́ kɩ kʋntʋ ba pa ba kwǝ. Abam nan nyɩ dɩ amʋ biǝ mʋ te.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya na bʋŋɩ sɩ a brɩ a tɩtɩ, kʋ bá ta yɩ jwǝrim a na tɛ cɩga tɩn ŋwaanɩ. A nan bá brɩ a tɩtɩ kʋntʋ. A ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bʋŋɩ kʋlʋ na dwe amʋ tɩn o pa-nɩ, sɩ o laan taa nii a tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te dɩ a ni-taanɩ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Wɛ ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ kamunni dɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ zanzan a na nɛ tɩn. Mʋ kʋ kuri DƖ pɛ cam wʋ a yɩra wʋnɩ, nɩ sabarɩ na zɔ-nɩ te tɩn. Sʋtaanɩ ma tɔgɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ sɩ dɩ yaarɩ-nɩ, sɩ a daa yɩ wanɩ a kɩ kamunni.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Kuni bɩtɔ mʋ a loori dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm sɩ o lɩ cam dɩm kʋntʋ a yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: O maa wʋ sɛ, yɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ zaanɩ dɩm maŋɩ nmʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ dam dɩm wʋ́ tiini dɩ tʋŋɩ balʋ na bwǝnǝ tɩn tee nɩ mʋ.» Mʋ kʋ kuri amʋ kɩ wʋpolo zanzan dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ nɩ a bwǝnǝ tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa Zezi Krisi dam dɩm taa kwǝli-nɩ.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ, a na yǝni a bwǝnǝ, naa nɔɔna na jɩgɩ-nɩ ba twɩa, naa cam dɩ bɛɛsɩm dɩ liǝ na jɩgɩ-nɩ, amʋ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ kʋntʋ maama Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, a na yǝni a bwǝnǝ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, kantʋ maŋa nɩ mʋ Zezi pa-nɩ dam. Pooli na li Korɛntɩ tiinǝ bam ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Amʋ na brɩ a tɩtɩ te tɩn yɩ jwǝrim mʋ, yɩ kʋ yɩ abam fɩfɩʋn ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋ yɩ abam mʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ á brɩ amʋ cɩga kam. Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ nɩ amʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna yɩ ba pa ba dwe maama tɩn, a wʋ muri bantʋ yigǝ nɩ dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na wʋ abam tee nɩ tɩn, amʋ tʋŋɩ dɩ pu-dɩa mʋ, yɩ Wɛ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na brɩ nɩ amʋ sɩɩnɩ a yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Abam nan bʋŋɩ nɩ a wʋ kɩ abam lanyɩranɩ nɩ a na kɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam je sɩdonnǝ nɩ te tɩn mʋ na? Kʋ nan yɩ cɩga mʋ nɩ a wʋ yaarɩ abam sɩ á pa-nɩ zǝnǝ. Á nan yagɩ kʋntʋ woŋo kʋm á ma cɛ-nɩ.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo sɩ a kwe a wǝǝnu maama a cɔgɩ kʋ wǝli dɩ a tɩtɩ yɩra abam ŋwaanɩ. Amʋ na tiini a soe abam te tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ abam taá ba soe amʋ na?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Abam laan lwarɩ nɩ a dɛɛn ba yaarɩ abam amʋ zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ. Nɔɔna badaara nan tɛ nɩ, amʋ kɩ swan mʋ a ma joŋi á sǝbiǝ.

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Titi, a dɛɛn loor-o mʋ sɩ o ba abam te, yɩ a tʋŋɩ dɩ́ ko-bu wʋdoŋ sɩ o tɔgɩ dɩd-o o ba. Titi nan wʋ pini abam kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Abam paɩ sɩ Titi dɩ amʋ wʋbʋŋa daɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ na? Dɩbam nan tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ dɩdʋa mʋ.

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Abam bʋŋɩ nɩ dɩ́ na ŋɔɔnɩ tɩntʋ maama tɩn, kʋ yɩ abam yigǝ nɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ sɩ dɩ́ ma joŋi dɩ́ tɩtɩ na? Dɩ́ nan na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ mʋ dɩ́ ŋɔɔna. A badon-sonnu-ba, dɩ́ na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn yɩ sɩ dɩ́ zǝni abam mʋ, sɩ á vu yigǝ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jɩgɩ liǝ mʋ abam ŋwaanɩ sɩ, a na tu abam te, abam bá ta yɩ nɩ amʋ na lagɩ te tɩn, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa amʋ dɩ bá ta yɩ nɩ abam na lagɩ te tɩn. Amʋ ta maa jɩgɩ liǝ sɩ á wʋ́ ta magɩ kantɔgɔ daanɩ, yɩ á jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋrʋ dɩ ban-zɔŋɔ, yɩ á lagɩ á yɩratʋ zǝnǝ, yɩ á twɩ daanɩ, yɩ á yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna, yɩ á gooni daanɩ, yɩ á kwǝri á kɩ yɔɔ yɔɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ta jɩgɩ liǝ mʋ dɩ abam sɩ, amʋ na joori a ba á te, amʋ Tu Wɛ wʋ́ pa a na cavɩɩra abam ŋwaanɩ, dɩ abam zanzan na wʋ lǝni á wʋ dɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ á na maŋɩ á kɩ tɩn. Amʋ na nɛ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa a wʋ cɔgɩ zanzan dɩ á ta na kɩ wo-digiru dɩ boorim kikiǝ dwi maama yɩ á ba yagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Amʋ na lagɩ a ba abam te lele tɩn, kʋ laan lagɩ kʋ kɩ kuni bɩtɔ mʋ. Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm nan tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ na lagɩ sɩ o saŋɩ o doŋ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔna bale naa batɔ mʋ taa yɩ o maana tiinǝ.»

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ cɩga, o sɛ o tu o tɩtɩ o ji nabwǝm yɩ ba pa-o tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ o laan nan jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ dam dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩbam na yɩ o nɔɔna tɩn, dɩbam dɩ bwǝnǝ mʋ, dɩ́ nan na ŋwɩ dɩd-o tɩn, dɩ́ na wʋ́ kɩ te dɩ abam tɩn yɩ Wɛ dam dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á maanɩ á tɩtɩ mʋ á nii, á jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi na. Abam na maanɩ á tɩtɩ kʋntʋ, á bá lwarɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi wʋra dɩ abam na? Naa kʋ yɩ abam maŋɩ á tɩtɩ mʋ yɩ á maŋɩ á ga?

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ á maanɩ á lwarɩ nɩ dɩbam sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋna mʋ.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ loori Wɛ dɩ́ pa abam, sɩ á yɩ taá kɩ lwarɩm mʋ. Kʋ daɩ nɩ dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna mʋ nɩ dɩ́ yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna. Dɩ́ nan lagɩ sɩ á taá kɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn mʋ, dɩ nɔɔna na maŋɩ ba brɩ nɩ dɩbam mʋ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ ga dɩ.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Dɩbam bá sɛ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta kɩ te na wʋ́ zǝni-ka tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Abam na jɩgɩ Wɛ dam dɩm, yɩ dɩbam na maŋɩ dɩ́ bwǝnǝ, dɩ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ ta loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ zǝni abam, sɩ á bɩ lanyɩranɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a pa abam yɩ a tǝri á tee nɩ, sɩ a na tu á te, sɩ a daa yɩ kɩ kǝm-cɛɛrɩ dɩ abam dɩ dam dɩlʋ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na pɛ-nɩ tɩn. Dam dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ sɩ a ma fɔgɩ abam mʋ, sɩ kʋ daɩ sɩ a ma cɔgɩ abam. Pooli na jɔɔnɩ Korɛntɩ tiinǝ bam o ma kweeli te tɩn

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, Wɛ wʋ́ pa á jǝni lanyɩranɩ. Kwaanɩ-na sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ pa á bɩ lanyɩranɩ DƖ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ. Á nan kɩ-na nɩ amʋ na loori abam te tɩn. Á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá jɩgɩ bɩcarɩ-zuru, sɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ sono dɩ bɩcarɩ-zuru tɩn wʋ́ ta wʋ abam tee nɩ.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Á na jeeri daanɩ, sɩ á taá jɔɔnɩ daanɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ sono dɩ wʋ-poŋo. Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo, Baŋa-Wɛ sono kʋm wʋ́ ta wʋ á tee nɩ, yɩ DƖ Joro kʋm wʋ́ pa á taá ŋwɩ daanɩ dɩ ywǝǝni.

english_verse: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ maama na wʋ amʋ tee nɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam balʋ na yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔna yɩ á zʋʋrɩ Galatɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi nan mʋ dɛ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn maama yɩ o sɛ sɩ o tɩ dɩbam lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ, sɩ o ma wanɩ o vrɩ dɩbam zɩm lʋgʋ baŋa wo-balwaarʋ tɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ te tɩn nan mʋ pɛ amʋ yɩra sɔɔrɩ. Wɛ dɛ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kuri abam zaanɩ sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna, yɩ á laan da á zaŋɩ á ma á kwaga á ya dɩntʋ, sɩ á daarɩ á sɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ daa tǝrǝ, kʋ na daɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn yɩranɩ. Amʋ nan tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna badaara mʋ wʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ ba na kwaanɩ sɩ ba pipiri Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, yɩ ba paɩ á wʋbʋŋa vugimǝ.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na tu á te yɩ o brɩ abam kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ, yɩ ka daɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn, sɩ á yɩ sɛ kʋntʋ tu. Kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ dɩbam tɩtɩ wʋ nɔɔnʋ, naa kʋ na yɩ malɛka mʋ zɩ nuŋi wɛyuu, yɩ ka na brɩ abam kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ, Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋ tu.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ta wʋ́ joori a fɔgɩ a ta nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩbam na maŋɩ dɩ́ ta kʋlʋ dɩ abam tɩn. Nɔɔnʋ na brɩ abam kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kadoŋ, yɩ kʋ daɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ á na maŋɩ á sɛ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋ tu.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: A na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ a lagɩ sɩ nabiinǝ mʋ sɛ nɩ a na kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn maŋɩ, kʋ yɩ sɩ Wɛ mʋ sɛ nɩ a na kɩ te tɩn maŋɩ. A nan ba lagɩ sɩ a pa nabiinǝ wʋrʋ poli dɩ amʋ. A ya na lagɩ kʋntʋ, a bá wanɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ. Kʋ na kɩ te yɩ Pooli ji Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ amʋ dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ a brɩ abam tɩn wʋ nuŋi nabiinǝ te.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ nabiinu mʋ kwe-ka o pa-nɩ sɩ a tɔɔlɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan wʋ zaasɩ-nɩ-ka. Kʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ mʋ vɩɩrɩ amʋ o kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Abam maŋɩ á ni amʋ dɛɛn na tɔgɩ Zwifǝ cullu tɩm cwǝŋǝ kam yɩ a kɩ te tɩn. A dɛɛn tiini a bɛɛsɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam, yɩ a ya kwaana sɩ a cɔgɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm maama.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ a yuu donnǝ bam wʋnɩ, a dɛɛn sɛ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm a dwǝni ba zanzan, amʋ dɛɛn na kwaanɩ a tɔgɩ dɩ́ nabaara bam cwe sɩm lanyɩranɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn mʋ DƖ vɩɩrɩ-nɩ sɩ a lwarɩ DƖ Bu wʋm, sɩ a daarɩ a tɔɔlɩ o kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam a brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ. Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ a wʋ ve a bwe nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ woŋo ka ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ ve Zeruzalɛm sɩ a na balʋ na maŋɩ ba yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna ba loori amʋ tɩn. A nan yɔɔrɩ Arabi mʋ a vu. Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ mʋ a laan joori a ba Damasɩ.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Bɩna yatɔ na kɛ tɩn, a laan ma zaŋɩ a vu Zeruzalɛm sɩ a na Pɩyɛɛrɩ, sɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ daanɩ. A ma kɩ da fugǝ-yanu o tee nɩ.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa wʋ nɛ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋdoŋ a wǝli da, kʋ na daɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi nyaanɩ Zakɩ yɩranɩ mʋ a nɛa.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: A na pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ. Wɛ ye amʋ wʋ. Kʋ nan daɩ vwan mʋ a fɔga.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, a laan ma zaŋɩ a tʋlɩ a vu Siiri dɩ Silisi tɩɩnɩ dɩm.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Zude tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn ya daa ta wʋ nɛ amʋ dɩ ba yi.

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ba na ni amʋ taanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa ba zuli Wɛ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Bɩna fugǝ yana na kɛ tɩn, amʋ dɩ Banabasɩ ma joori dɩ́ vu Zeruzalɛm. A ma ja Titi dɩ a wǝli da.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ mʋ brɩ-nɩ sɩ a vu dáanɩ. A ma vu a na balʋ ba na nii nɩ ba yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ tɩn. A na nɛ-ba tɩn, amʋ dɩ bantʋ yɩranɩ ma jǝni daanɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ, sɩ a pa ba lwarɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ a na yǝni a brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ba lagɩ sɩ a na puli a brɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ tɩn dɩ a ta na jɩgɩ kalʋ a brɩ lele tɩn ji kafɛ.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Titi wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ o vu Zeruzalɛm tɩn maa yɩ Grɛkɩ tu. Ba nan wʋ fɩ-o ba pa o go nɩ Zwifǝ bam na goni ba bǝkǝri te tɩn.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara nan mʋ wʋra ba na paɩ ba yɩ Zezi karabiǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ. Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ ya ŋɔgɩ mʋ ba zʋ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ, sɩ ba maanɩ dɩbam ba nii dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi yɩ dɩ́ te dɩ́ tɩtɩ te tɩn. Ba nan lagɩ sɩ ba pa dɩ́ joori dɩ́ ji gambɛ mʋ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan wʋ sɛ-ba dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ, sɩ ba yɩ wanɩ ba cɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ abam na maŋɩ á lwarɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na ve a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ balʋ ba na wɩ ba yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ tɩn, ba wʋ nɛ woŋo sɩ ba wǝli amʋ zaasɩm dɩm nɩ. Ba nan na sɩɩnɩ ba yɩ yigǝ tiinǝ, naa ba na daɩ dɩ, kʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ amʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ ba kuri nɔɔna daanɩ.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Bantʋ nan nɛ nɩ Wɛ mʋ sɩɩnɩ DƖ kɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam amʋ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ a ja vu a brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ, nɩ DƖ na kɩ-ka Pɩyɛɛrɩ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ o ma brɩ Zwifǝ bam te tɩn.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dam sɩ o taa yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ Zwifǝ bam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ dɩntʋ dɩ mʋ pɛ amʋ dam sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋnʋ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Zakɩ dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɩ Zan balʋ ba na nii nɩ ba yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm dɩdɛɛra tɩn ma lwarɩ nɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ-nɩ yu-yoŋo sɩ a taa tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba ma sɛ sɩ amʋ dɩ Banabasɩ taa tʋŋɩ dɩ ba, yɩ ba ja dɩ́ jɩa. Dɩ́ maama ma sɛ nɩ amʋ dɩ Banabasɩ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ vu dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam te mʋ dɩ́ brɩ-ba Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, sɩ bantʋ dɩ maŋɩ Zwifǝ bam tee nɩ ba brɩ-ka.

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ Pɩyɛɛrɩ dɛɛn na tu o wʋ Antɩɔsɩ nɩ tɩn, mʋ amʋ kaan-o jaja, sɩ a brɩ-o nɩ o wʋ kɩ cɩga.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ a nɛ nɩ ba daa ba tɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na brɩ tɩn. A laan ma zɩgɩ ba maama yigǝ nɩ, yɩ a ta dɩ Pɩyɛɛrɩ a wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Zwifu mʋ, yɩ n kɩ nɩ n yɩ dwi-gɛ tu mʋ te yɩ n daa ba tɔgɩ Zwifǝ cullu tɩm. Bɛɛ nan mʋ yɩ n laan lagɩ sɩ n fɩn dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam sɩ ba sɛ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm?»

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Dɩbam balʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ. Kʋ nan ya na yɩ cɩga nɩ dɩbam balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm tɩn yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, kʋ brɩ nɩ Zezi tɩtɩ mʋ ganɩ dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ tusi na? Aye. Kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan na joori a pipiri a sɛ Zwifǝ cullu tɩm a ya na maŋɩ a yagɩ tɩ tɔgɩm tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ a yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kɩ o cɔgɩ cullu tɩm tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩtɩ mʋ brɩ nɩ amʋ nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn mʋ te, tɩ nan daa ba jɩgɩ dam amʋ baŋa nɩ Zezi na vrɩ-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan kɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa a taa ŋwɩ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: A bá sɛ sɩ a vɩn Wɛ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ-nɩ zaanɩ tɩn. Nɔɔnʋ ya na wʋ́ wanɩ o na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ o na tɔgɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ brɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi tʋʋnɩ dɩm ya yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Abam Galatɩ tiinǝ-ba, á kikiǝ nyɩ dɩ ba tulimi abam mʋ ba pa á swan daa tǝrǝ te. Ba dɛɛn tɔɔlɩ ba brɩ abam jaja kʋ na kɩ te yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩ tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a bwe abam woŋo dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ a nii. Abam dɛɛn na joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm yɩ kʋ wʋ á wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ á tɩtʋŋa na tɔgɩ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ na? Awo. Kʋ yɩ á na ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam yɩ á sɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á ba jɩgɩ swan kʋntʋ? Abam na puli á tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm dam tɩn, á laan lagɩ sɩ á pipiri á da-o dɩ á tɩtɩ dam mʋ á vu á guri na?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na kɩ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ji kafɛ mʋ na? Aye. Amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ tɩ bá ji kafɛ.

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ abam DƖ Joro kʋm yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla abam tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn, DƖ kɩ kʋntʋ abam tɩtʋŋa na tɔgɩ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ na? Aye. Kʋ yɩ á na ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam yɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ nɩ Abraham dwi tiinǝ cɩga cɩga yɩ balʋ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn kʋ maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: Wɛ wʋ́ pa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ, dɩ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Mʋ kʋ kuri Wɛ dɛ yigǝ DƖ ta DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ Abraham DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ ta nmʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dwi maama lanyɩranɩ.»

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, balʋ maama dɩ na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ nɩ Abraham dɛɛn na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ te tɩn, Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ balʋ na tɩɩgɩ cullu tɩm sɩ ba ma na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn wʋ́ na cɔgɩm. Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wʋlʋ maama na wʋ tɔgɩ kʋlʋ maama na pʋpʋnɩ kʋ kɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋntʋ tu.»

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi dɛɛn sɛ o tɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ pa Wɛ kɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ dɩ lanyɩranɩ, nɩ DƖ dɛɛn na goni ni dɩ Abraham te tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm, nɩ DƖ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa dɩbam te tɩn, dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ na goni ni DƖ pa Abraham te tɩn

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn na goni ni dɩ Abraham tɩn, kʋ yɩ dɩ o naa kʋm dɩ mʋ. Kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ te tɩn, kʋ wʋ tagɩ nɩ o naarʋ. Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ o naa mʋ. Kʋ brɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa taanɩ mʋ, yɩ o naa kʋm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi.

english_verse: What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ amʋ na lagɩ a ta tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ, Wɛ dɛɛn goni ni dɩ Abraham, yɩ kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, bɩna biǝ yana dɩ fiintɔ (

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Wɛ ya na pɛ nɔɔna DƖ pɛɛrɩ dɩm ba na tɔgɩ DƖ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, DƖ ni-gonim dɩm ya daa ba jɩgɩ kuri. Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ, Wɛ pɛ Abraham DƖ pɛɛrɩ dɩm DƖ na goni ni dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Wɛ cullu tɩm kuri na yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Yiginu na wʋ nɔɔna bale tɩtarɩ nɩ, o ba wʋra nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa ŋwaanɩ, Wɛ nan yɩ dɩdʋa mʋ. DƖ na goni DƖ ni dɩ Abraham tɩn, DƖ yɔɔrɩ DƖ ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ Abraham tɩtɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maama nan brɩ nɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm warɩ tɩ maŋɩ dɩ DƖ ni-gonim dɩm mʋ na? Awo, kʋ daɩ kʋntʋ. Cullu tǝrǝ tɩ na wʋ́ wanɩ tɩ pa nɔɔna na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ. Cullu tɩntʋ doŋ ya na wʋra, tɩ ya wʋ́ wanɩ tɩ pa nɔɔna na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ cullu tɩm dɛɛn jɩgɩ dɩbam tɩ kweǝ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kam dɩ́ na lwarɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ laan na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ́ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Dɩbam laan nan na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn, woŋo daa tǝrǝ kʋ na wʋ́ ta te dɩbam.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Abam na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, á maama yɩ Wɛ biǝ mʋ á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ maama ba na miis-o na wʋnɩ tɩn laan ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi mʋ, yɩ o nyɩ dɩ Zezi tɩtɩ mʋ te.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, kampwara daa tǝri Zwifu dɩ dwi-gɛ tu laŋa nɩ. Kampwara nan ta tǝri gambaa dɩ wʋlʋ na te o tɩtɩ tɩn laŋa nɩ. Kampwara nan tǝri baarʋ dɩ kaanɩ laŋa nɩ dɩ. Abam na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, á maama yɩ woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Abam na yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn, kʋ pɛ á tɔgɩ á yɩ Abraham naarʋ mʋ, yɩ á wʋ́ joŋi pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa Abraham naarʋ tɩm tɩn.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ dɩbam dɩ. Dɩ́ dɛɛn ta na wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam na yɩ te tɩn, lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ mʋ te dɩbam nɩ dɩ́ yɩ gambɛ mʋ te.

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: sɩ o wanɩ o vrɩ nɔɔna balʋ cullu tɩm na te tɩn. O ma ŋwɩ dɩ́ lwarɩm jɩnɩ sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ ji Wɛ biǝ.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Á nan na sɩɩnɩ á ji Wɛ biǝ tɩn, DƖ laan tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu wʋm Joro mʋ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ taa wʋ á bɩcara nɩ, yɩ kʋ paɩ dɩ́ bǝ Wɛ nɩ dɩ́ Ko Baba.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Amʋ jɩgɩ liǝ mʋ abam ŋwaanɩ, sɩ dɛdoŋ amʋ tɩtʋŋa yam maama a na tʋŋɩ abam tee nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ji kafɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a loori abam sɩ á taá lwǝni amʋ á tɔgɩ Wɛ nɩ amʋ na tɔgɩ-DƖ te tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ dɩ yɩ nɩ abam na yɩ te tɩn mʋ. A dɛɛn na wʋ abam tee nɩ tɩn, á wʋ kɩ-nɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ á cɔgɩ.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Á wʋ́ wanɩ á guli nɩ, kʋ yɩ amʋ yawɩʋ kʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ a maŋɩ abam tee nɩ a puli a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam a brɩ abam.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, a yawɩʋ kʋm na tiini kʋ yaarɩ abam te tɩn, á wʋ sɛ sɩ á yáalɩ-nɩ, á nan wʋ yagɩ-nɩ. Abam nan kɩ-nɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ Wɛ malɛka mʋ te, yɩ á joŋi-nɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ mʋ te.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ amʋ. A ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, á na jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ amʋ te tɩn, á ya na waɩ á yiǝ tɩtɩ dɩ á lǝnǝ, á ya wʋ́ lǝni-ya á pa-nɩ. Bɛɛ nan mʋ kɩa yɩ á wʋpolo kʋm kʋntʋ je?

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Amʋ nan na tagɩ cɩga dɩ abam tɩn laan mʋ pɛ a ji á dʋm na?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ nɔɔna balʋ na pipiri Wɛ cɩga kam yɩ a maŋɩ a ta ba taanɩ tɩn, bantʋ kwaanɩ sɩ ba pa á wʋbʋŋa taa tɔgɩ-ba mʋ, yɩ kʋ nan ba zǝni abam. Ba lagɩ sɩ ba cɔgɩ amʋ dɩ abam mʋ daanɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá tɔgɩ bantʋ.

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Abam balʋ na lagɩ sɩ á sɛ Wɛ cullu tɩm, á daa ta wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cullu tɔnɔ kʋm na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm brɩ dɩbam nɩ dɩ́ nabaarʋ Abraham dɛɛn jɩgɩ bǝkǝri sɩle mʋ. O lʋgɩ dɩdʋa kam dɩ gamba-kana na wʋ o sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ o tɩtɩ kaanɩ wʋm dɩ ma lʋ bǝkǝrǝ o wǝli da. O tɩtɩ kaanɩ wʋm yɩrɩ mʋ Sara, kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ gambaa tɩn yɩrɩ mʋ Agaarɩ.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Bǝkǝrǝ kalʋ gamba-kana kam na lʋgɩ tɩn lʋra kam dɛ nabiinǝ lʋra cwǝŋǝ na yɩ te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ bǝkǝrǝ kalʋ o tɩtɩ kaanɩ wʋm na lʋgɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ na goni ni DƖ pa-o nɩ oó lʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ o lʋga.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Kʋ maa yɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ dɩ kaana bam kʋntʋ bale, sɩ kʋ brɩ dɩbam cwe sɩle tɔgɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Kaana bale bam kʋntʋ ta brɩ dɩbam Wɛ na goni DƖ ni DƖ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam kuni bɩle te tɩn mʋ. Agaarɩ mʋ nyɩ dɩ cullu tɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ Zwifǝ bam Sinayi piu kʋm yuu nɩ tɩn. Balʋ na tɔgɩ cullu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn nyɩ dɩ gambɛ mʋ, nɩ Agaarɩ dɩ o biǝ na yɩ gambɛ te tɩn.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ ka-dʋgʋ yɩ n wʋ jaanɩ pugǝ n lʋ tɩn, ta n kɩ wʋpolo sɩ n ta n caka, nmʋ na wʋ́ di ywǝǝni tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ barʋ ya na yag-o tɩn laan wʋ́ ba o taa jɩgɩ biǝ zanzan o dwǝni kaanɩ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ barʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, Abraham bu wʋlʋ lʋra kam na dɛ nabiinǝ lʋra na tɔgɩ te tɩn mʋ bɛɛsɩ o bu wʋlʋ lʋra na tɔgɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. Dɩ zɩm maama dɩ, Wɛ tɩtɩ biǝ bam ta naɩ bɛɛsa kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm nan brɩ dɩbam kʋ wɩ: «Zǝli kaanɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ gambaa tɩn dɩ o bu wʋm, sɩ ba nuŋi n sɔŋɔ nɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ bu wʋm kʋntʋ tɔgɩ dɩ n tɩtɩ kaanɩ wʋm bu wʋm o taa te nmʋ wǝǝnu tɩm.»

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi na vrɩ dɩbam o yagɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá te dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á daa yɩ sɛ á tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ na wʋ́ pa á joori á ji gambɛ tɩn.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Abam balʋ na bʋŋɩ sɩ á na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, abam pɔɔrɩ mʋ dɩ Zezi Krisi, yɩ o zaanɩ dɩm daa tǝri á tee nɩ.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm nan wʋ dɩbam balʋ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn tee nɩ, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna lanyɩranɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, dɩ́ na goni dɩ́ bǝkǝri naa dɩ́ zɩ wʋ goni dɩ, kʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Woŋo kʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ kuri tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn yɔɔrɩ á tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ lanyɩranɩ mʋ. Wɔɔ nan mʋ cɩgɩ á cwǝŋǝ sɩ á daa yɩ sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na brɩ abam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩn, amʋ ye nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdʋa mʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ abam wʋbʋŋa o vugimi tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ kʋntʋ tu o kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋm ŋwaanɩ, dɩ o na maŋɩ o yɩ te dɩ.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, amʋ ba brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na tɔgɩ Wɛ, o maŋɩ sɩ o go. A ya na brɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, nɔɔna bá bɛɛsɩ-nɩ a zaasɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ a na brɩ Zezi na tɩgɩ te tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ tɩn ya bá ta yɩ ta-lɔŋɔ dɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
