translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ á laan taá te á tɩtɩ mʋ. Á nan na sɩɩnɩ á te á tɩtɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ á wʋ́ ta kɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ maama á wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn. Á nan taá tiini á zǝni daanɩ dɩ sono.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ niǝ yam maama brɩ woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ, nɩ nɔɔnʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa soe o doŋ nɩ o na soe o tɩtɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Abam nan na jɩgɩ daanɩ nɩ vara na yǝni ba jɩgɩ daanɩ yɩ ba dʋnɩ daanɩ te tɩn, á taá ye sɩ á wʋ́ ba á cɔgɩ daanɩ dɩdʋa dɩdʋa á ti. Wɛ Joro kʋm na paɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ tɩn

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm nan na vaŋɩ abam, cullu tɩm daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ tɩ taa te abam.

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: dɩ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm, dɩ liri dim, dɩ ka culi daanɩ, dɩ ka ja daanɩ, dɩ wʋ-gʋʋ, dɩ ban-zɔŋɔ, dɩ ka beeri ka yɩratʋ zǝnǝ, dɩ ka yɩ sɛ daanɩ, dɩ ka pɔɔrɩ daanɩ,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: dɩ wo-swǝnǝ, dɩ sa-nyɔrɩ, dɩ nɔn-kwǝlim, dɩ ka kɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩdonnǝ. A nan ta wʋ́ fɔgɩ a kaanɩ abam a wǝli da nɩ, balʋ na yǝni ba kɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ dwi tɩn, ba bá tɔgɩ ba zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: dɩ wʋ-bono, dɩ ka ja n tɩtɩ. Culu nan tǝrǝ kʋ na vɩn wo-laarʋ tɩntʋ.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ dɩ́ na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa tɩn, dɩ́ pa-na kʋ taa vaŋɩ dɩbam dɩ́ ŋwɩa maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan yɩ kɩ kamunni da-yɩranɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa da-wʋrʋ zaŋɩ naa dɩ́ taa jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ daanɩ.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á na nɛ nɩ nɔɔnʋ kɩ kǝm o tusi, abam balʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm na vaŋɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ á zuri á yɩra mʋ á brɩ-o dɩ wʋ-bono, sɩ o joori o tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ. Á nan taá yɩrɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ pa abam dɩ daa tusi.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Á taá zǝni daanɩ á cana wʋnɩ, sɩ á na kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ á sɛ Zezi Krisi ni dɩm o na pɛ tɩn.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ o paɩ o yɩ kamunu yɩ o yagɩ o daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu ganɩ o tɩtɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ maama maŋɩ sɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-o tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ ba na zaas-o Wɛ taanɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o kɩ o na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ o pa wʋlʋ na zaas-o tɩn.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, dɩ́ nan yɩ pa yawɔrɔ zʋ dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ yagɩ lanyɩranɩ kǝm. Dɩ́ na fɔgɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ ba dɩ́ na nyɔɔrɩ dɩlʋ na lana tɩn.

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Nii-na, amʋ tɩtɩ laan mʋ mɛ a jɩŋa a pʋpʋnɩ pʋpʋn-bu-kamunǝ yantʋ sɩ a pa abam.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ, woŋo kʋlʋ yɩranɩ amʋ na wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ wʋpolo tɩn yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi na tɩgɩ tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ o ma vrɩ nɔɔna te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ Zezi Krisi tʋʋn-dagara kam ŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ kʋntʋ wǝǝnu tɩm nyɩ nɩ tɩ tɩgɩ mʋ, tɩ daa ba jɩgɩ kuri dɩ amʋ, yɩ a dɩ nyɩ dɩ tʋ mʋ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na gonǝ, naa n na wʋ goni dɩ, kʋntʋ daɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Woŋo kʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ kuri tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ n na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ na sɛ kwiǝ yam kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa-ba wʋ-zuru yɩ DƖ duri ba ŋwaŋa lanyɩranɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ balʋ maama na yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna cɩga cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: A daa ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ joori o yaarɩ-nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ na maŋɩ a jɩgɩ ŋwandaala yalʋ a yɩra nɩ tɩn brɩ nɩ Zezi mʋ te-nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo. Amina.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ Wɛ na kuri dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ. A pʋpʋnɩ sɩ a pa abam balʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ á zʋʋrɩ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ tɩn, abam balʋ na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Wɛ na zǝni DƖ biǝ te tɩn

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Kʋ na loori sɩ Wɛ kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, DƖ maŋɩ DƖ da yigǝ DƖ kuri dɩbam mʋ sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo DƖ yigǝ nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ yɩ tusi.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Wɛ na soe dɩbam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ wuuri DƖ kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa nɩ, sɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ ji DƖ biǝ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ zuli-na Wɛ, DƖ pɛɛrɩ dɩm na yɩ kamunu yɩ dɩ ba jɩgɩ doŋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. DƖ kwe-dɩ DƖ pa dɩbam zaanɩ, DƖ Bu-sono Zezi na vrɩ dɩbam lwarɩm wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding,
translation_verse: yɩ DƖ ma-dɩ DƖ zǝni dɩbam kʋ ja gaalɩ. DƖ ma pa dɩ́ na swan dwi maama dɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ dɩbam balʋ na dɛ yigǝ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn mʋ Wɛ dɛɛn kuri, sɩ dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ te na wʋ́ pa DƖ na zulǝ DƖ zaanɩ kamunu kʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a yǝni a kɩ Wɛ le, yɩ a kwǝri a loori-DƖ a pa abam.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: A loori dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ tɩn, sɩ DƖ pa DƖ Joro kʋm zǝni abam sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna, sɩ DƖ vɩɩrɩ abam sɩ á wanɩ á lwarɩ DƖ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Amʋ loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa á wʋ vɩɩrɩ, sɩ á wanɩ á lwarɩ DƖ na kuri abam sɩ á taá jɩgɩ tɩɩna yalʋ DƖ tee nɩ tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á lwarɩ DƖ wo-laarʋ tɩm na tiini tɩ daga yɩ tɩ ba jɩgɩ doŋ te. DƖ tiŋi-tɩ sɩ DƖ ba DƖ kwe DƖ pa balʋ na yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Amʋ ta loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa á lwarɩ DƖ dam dɩm na daga dɩ ja gaalɩ te, yɩ DƖ ma-dɩ DƖ zǝni dɩbam balʋ maama na sɛ-DƖ tɩn. DƖ dam-fɔrɔ kʋm kʋntʋ mʋ DƖ mɛ DƖ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunǝ yam.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: Dam dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ DƖ mɛ DƖ bi Zezi Krisi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ ma-dɩ DƖ zǝŋ-o DƖ pa o jǝni DƖ jazɩm nɩ DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma kwe wǝǝnu maama DƖ kɩ Zezi Krisi dam kuri nɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ tiŋ-o sɩ o taa yɩ o nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm yuutu, sɩ o taa te woŋo maama.

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm mʋ nyɩ dɩ o yɩra yam, kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ ŋwɩ ba wʋnɩ, yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ paɩ woŋo maama wʋra wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa je maama nɩ.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn yɩ nɔɔna balʋ na ba jɩgɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na nuŋi Wɛ te, á na vɩn Wɛ ni yɩ á kɩ lwarɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Á dɛɛn ma tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ cwe tɩn, yɩ á daarɩ á tɔgɩ sʋtaana-pɛ wʋlʋ na te wɛyuu tɩlampolo ciciri sɩm tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ sʋtaanɩ dɩlʋ laan na te balʋ na vɩn Wɛ ni tɩn.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ pɛ dɩbam maama DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ na zǝni dɩbam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩbam dɛɛn na je dɩ́ lwarɩm dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ. Wɛ vrɩ dɩbam DƖ yagɩ zaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi dɩ́ bi dɩ́ na DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ zǝŋi dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ na jǝŋǝ je DƖ sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Wɛ na kɩ dɩbam lanyɩranɩ Zezi ŋwaanɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ taa brɩ nɔɔna maŋa kalʋ na bɩɩnɩ tɩn nɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm tiini dɩ daga mʋ.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ vrɩ abam lwarɩm wʋnɩ zaanɩ mʋ, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ daɩ abam tɩtɩ dam, kʋ yɩ Wɛ pɛɛrɩ mʋ.

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: Kʋ daɩ abam tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ŋwaanɩ, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o ba o tee o tɩtɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ mɔɔnɩ dɩbam. DƖ ma pa dɩbam DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩlʋ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ tiŋi DƖ pa dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ kɩ tɩn. Balʋ na sɛ Zezi tɩn laan jigi dwi dɩdʋa mʋ

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ, abam dɛɛn yǝri Zezi Krisi. Á dɛɛn tɔgɩ á tǝri Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ balʋ Wɛ na kuri tɩn wʋnɩ. Abam yigǝ dɛɛn tɔgɩ ka tǝrǝ dɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na mɛ DƖ go ni dɩ DƖ nɔɔna bam tɩn wʋnɩ. Á dɛɛn na ŋwɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, Wɛ tǝri á tee nɩ, yɩ á ba jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ abam na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ na tɩgɩ yɩ o jana kam nuŋi tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ á twɛ dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ, yɩ abam dɛɛn ya baŋwɛ dɩ DƖ.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi mʋ pɛ dɩbam wʋ-zuru, yɩ o paɩ ywǝǝni wʋ dɩbam tɩtarɩ nɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ pɛ Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam maama ji dwi dɩdʋa. O ma saarɩ sisǝni dɩlʋ ya na pwɛ-ba yɩ ba culi daanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: O na sɛ o pa o tɩtɩ sɩ ba gʋ-o tɩn mʋ pɛ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm dɩ tɩ na brɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn ji kafɛ. Kʋntʋ mʋ o fɔgɩ Zwifǝ bam dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam o kɩ daanɩ, sɩ ba maama ji dwi dɩdʋa ba na ŋwɩ dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Ba maama laan na jigi dwi dɩdʋa kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma kwɛ ba dɩ Wɛ daanɩ, o na tɩgɩ tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O tʋʋnɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ o pɛ ba daa ba culi daanɩ.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi mʋ tu o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam sɩ dɩbam maama dɩ Wɛ fɔgɩ daanɩ, kʋ na yɩ abam dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ dɛɛn na baŋwɛ dɩ DƖ tɩn, naa dɩbam Zwifǝ balʋ na maŋɩ dɩ́ batwarɩ dɩ DƖ tɩn.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ, dɩbam maama jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ twɛ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ te, Wɛ Joro kʋm na yɩ dɩdʋa yɩ kʋ wʋ dɩ́ maama tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, abam balʋ na yɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ tɩn, á daa daɩ vǝrǝ, á nan daɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ daga. Abam laan yɩ dwi dɩdʋa mʋ dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam, yɩ á tɔgɩ á yɩ DƖ sɔŋɔ kʋm biǝ.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: O maa pa digǝ kam lɔɔm maama tɔgɩ daanɩ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ o pa ka puli ka daga, sɩ ka taa yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nyɩm o nɔɔna bam na wʋ́ ta zul-o da tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Abam nan ni nɩ, tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-nɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ a tɔɔlɩ DƖ zaanɩ kwǝrǝ kam mʋ a brɩ abam.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ vɩɩrɩ amʋ sɩ a wanɩ a lwarɩ DƖ cɩga kalʋ na sǝgi tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ amʋ maŋɩ a pʋpʋnɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ taanɩ fɩnfɩɩn a brɩ abam.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Abam nan na karɩmɩ amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, á wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ amʋ ni Zezi Krisi cɩga kalʋ na sǝgi tɩn kuri lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn Wɛ wʋ pɛ nabiinǝ lwarɩ DƖ cɩga kam kʋntʋ. DƖ laan nan mɛ DƖ Joro kʋm mʋ DƖ vɩɩrɩ Zezi tɩntʋŋna bam dɩ DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam sɩ ba lwarɩ-ka.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Cɩga kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ sɩ DƖ pa dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn tɔgɩ ba na wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ DƖ na lagɩ DƖ pa Zwifǝ balʋ na sɛ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn, sɩ ba dɩ tɔgɩ ba ji dwi dɩdʋa dɩ Zwifǝ bam, sɩ ba laan joŋi kʋlʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam tɩn.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ yu-yoŋo mʋ yɩ Wɛ kuri-nɩ sɩ a ji DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩntʋŋnʋ, yɩ DƖ pa-nɩ dam DƖ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tiini a muri Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ Wɛ daa ta pa-nɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋm dɩm kʋntʋ, sɩ a taa ve dwi-gɛ tiinǝ te a brɩ-ba DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, sɩ ba lwarɩ Zezi Krisi wo-laarʋ tɩm na tiini tɩ dagɩ te, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o lwarɩ-tɩ o ti.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ a pa nabiinǝ mʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam na tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ tɩn. Kʋ na zɩgɩ pulim nɩ tɩn, Wɛ dɩlʋ na kɩ wǝǝnu maama tɩn mʋ pɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ sǝgi, kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: DƖ laan ma tɔgɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm ŋwaanɩ DƖ pa dɩdɛɛra dɩ pwa balʋ maama na jɩgɩ dam wɛyuu tɩlampolo kʋm nɩ tɩn lwarɩ DƖ swan yam dwi tǝri tǝri na yɩ te.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Wɛ tagɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ kʋntʋ, nɩ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ pulim nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Abam nan yɩ pa á wʋrʋ cɔgɩ sɩ á ga baarɩ dɩ amʋ na yaarɩ te abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn, sɩ kʋ yɩ abam yuu zǝŋim ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Zezi sono kʋm na yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Amʋ yǝni a loori Wɛ mʋ, sɩ DƖ pa DƖ Joro kʋm pa á bɩcara na dam, DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ na dagɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: sɩ Zezi Krisi taa tigi á wʋbʋŋa nɩ, dɩ á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Amʋ ta loori-DƖ mʋ sɩ DƖ pa á taá ŋwɩ sono wʋnɩ, sɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ nɩ tiu nɛ na kwaarɩ tɩga nɩ te tɩn,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: O sono kʋm nan dwe sɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩ kʋ na yɩ te tɩn. Wɛ nan wʋ́ pa abam lwarɩ-kʋ, sɩ DƖ ŋwɩa kam laan su á bɩcara maama.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ maŋɩ sɩ DƖ na zulǝ DƖ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama tee nɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Amʋ na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, a loori abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ cwǝ-laa sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á tu á tɩtɩ mʋ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-bono maŋa maama, sɩ á daarɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru, sɩ á taá wǝli daanɩ dɩ sono.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ nɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ abam te, sɩ á wǝli daanɩ sɩ yazurǝ taa wʋ á tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm yɩ dwi dɩdʋa mʋ, Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩ yɩ dɩdʋa mʋ, nɩ Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ yɩ á jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ te tɩn.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Wɛ yɩ dɩdʋa mʋ, DƖ maa yɩ dɩbam maama Ko. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam maama Yuutu, yɩ DƖ wʋ dɩbam maama tee nɩ, yɩ DƖ kwǝri DƖ wʋ dɩbam maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: nɩ kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «O na diini wɛyuu tɩn, o kalɩ o dʋna bam o pɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o maŋɩ o pɛɛra yam o pa nɔɔna.»

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wɩ, o diini tɩn, kʋ kuri mʋ bɛɛ? Kʋ lagɩ kʋ ta nɩ o dɛ yigǝ o tu tɩga baŋa yɩ o tu o kwaarɩ ka kuri mʋ.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na tu tɩga baŋa kʋntʋ tɩn daa ta mʋ diini wɛyuu, o kɛ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩm maama yigǝ, sɩ o pa wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋra tɩn taa jɩgɩ kuri.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ maama laan ji woŋo dɩdʋa dɩ́ na lwarɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm yɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa laan wʋ́ tiini ya bɩ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi na maŋɩ fasɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan wʋ́ ta brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ sono mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ bɩ woŋo maama wʋnɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Yuutu tɩn.

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a kaanɩ abam dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ŋwaanɩ, sɩ á daa yɩ taá tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn na tɔgɩ dɩ ba wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ tɩm tɩn.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Bantʋ wʋbʋŋa yɩ lim mʋ, yɩ ba ŋwɩa kam ba tɔgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩa na yɩ te tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ ba wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam ba wʋbʋŋa na tɩgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Abam nan na ni Zezi taanɩ dɩm, yɩ ba sɩɩnɩ ba brɩ abam o cɩga kam tɩn,

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: ba brɩ abam sɩ á yagɩ á ŋwɩ-doŋǝ kam mʋ dɩ ka na pɛ á yɩ te tɩn. Á ŋwɩ-doŋǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ lagɩ ka cɔgɩ abam, dɩ ka na ganɩ abam sɩ á fra taa zʋʋrɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Á wʋbʋŋa maama nan maŋɩ sɩ ya lǝni ya ji wʋbʋŋ-dʋʋra mʋ,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: sɩ á daarɩ á taá ŋwɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ DƖ na pɛ abam tɩn. Ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam kʋntʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ ŋwɩa mʋ, yɩ ka paɩ á tɔgɩ cɩga dɩ wʋ-poŋo cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ yagɩ vwan fɔm, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ taá tɛ cɩga dɩ́ brɩ daanɩ, dɩ́ maama na yɩ dwi dɩdwɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á pa sʋtaanɩ na laŋa dɩ wanɩ abam.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ ya na ŋɔnɩ tɩn daa yɩ taa ŋɔna. O nan maŋɩ sɩ o kwaanɩ o tʋŋɩ o pa o tɩtɩ mʋ dɩ cɩga, sɩ o daarɩ o wanɩ o zǝni balʋ yinigǝ na jɩgɩ-ba tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa á ni-taanɩ taa jɩgɩ lwarɩm. Nan taá ŋɔɔnɩ-na taanɩ dɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa nɔɔna na dam Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, yɩ dɩ daarɩ dɩ zǝni-ba lanyɩranɩ nɩ ba na lagɩ zǝnǝ te tɩn.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Yagɩ-na pu-sɩŋa dɩ ka-culi-daanɩ dɩ ban-zɔŋɔ, sɩ á daarɩ á yagɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ trʋ dɩ wʋ-lʋŋʋ dwi maama.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Taá nɩgɩ-na daanɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá jɩgɩ da-ŋwaŋa. Taá yagɩ-na á ma cɛ daanɩ, nɩ Wɛ na yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ abam Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Abam na yɩ Wɛ bu-sonnu tɩn, á taá kɩ nɩ Wɛ na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ cɔgɩm-ŋwɛ dɩ bɩtar-jwǝǝru dɩ bɩtar-digiru dwi maama, tɩntʋ wʋ maŋɩ dɩ abam. Á nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá kɩ Wɛ le mʋ maŋa maama.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Nan taá ye-na nɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na kɩ wo-zɔɔna naa boorim, naa wʋlʋ na yɩ wo-swǝn-nyɩm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu bá fɔgɩ o na kʋlʋkʋlʋ Zezi Krisi dɩ Baŋa-Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ. Nɔɔnʋ na yɩ wo-swǝn-nyɩm, kʋ brɩ nɩ o pa tɩntʋ mʋ zulǝ, yɩ o daarɩ Wɛ o yagɩ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nan yɩ pa-na nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ganɩ abam dɩ bɩtar-yɔɔrʋ. Kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ lagɩ tɩ pa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm sɩɩnɩ kʋ ba kʋ cɔgɩ balʋ na vɩn DƖ ni tɩn.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ja-na á tɩtɩ dɩ balʋ na kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn ya yǝri Wɛ, yɩ kʋ pa á wʋ lim wʋnɩ. Abam nan na tu á ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩn, kʋ pɛ pooni laan wʋ á tee nɩ. Á taá ŋwɩ-na sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ balʋ na ve pooni wʋnɩ tɩn na ŋwɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kǝnǝ yalʋ maama na yɩ pooni nyɩm tɩn mʋ yɩ lanyɩranɩ, dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na jɩgɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Ja-na á tɩtɩ sɩ á yɩ tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ na yɩ lim nyɩm tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á pa nɔɔna lwarɩ jaja nɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ ba lana.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ na yǝni ba sǝgi ba kɩ tɩn tiini tɩ jɩgɩ cavɩɩra sɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ-tɩ.

english_verse: But the light will show what these things are really like.
translation_verse: Abam nan na pɛ Wɛ pooni dɩm brɩ woŋo maama kuri jaja, nɔɔna laan wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ tɩ yɩ balɔrɔ.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ woŋo kʋlʋ maama kuri na lwarɩ jaja tɩn laan wʋ pooni yigǝ nɩ mʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ kʋ tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na dɔ tɩn zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ, sɩ n bi n yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, sɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwɩa kam pooni taa wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ.»

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Á yɩ taá tɔgɩ-na jwǝrim cwǝŋǝ, á nan kwaanɩ á lwarɩ kʋlʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na lagɩ sɩ á taá kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Á taá leeni Wɛ lǝŋ-ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ tiǝ le dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ abam le sɩlʋ tɩn á brɩ daanɩ. Taá leeni-na zulǝ le sɩm kʋntʋ á pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi dɩ á wʋ maama,

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: sɩ á taá kɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ le maŋa maama dɩ woŋo kʋlʋ maama DƖ na pɛ abam tɩn dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ. Baara dɩ ba kaana na maŋɩ sɩ ba taa soe daanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Honor Christ and put others first.
translation_verse: Á taá sɛ daanɩ á na kwarɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaana maŋɩ sɩ ba taa sɛ ba banna, nɩ ba na sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi te tɩn.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kaanɩ barʋ mʋ yɩ o yuutu, nɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ na yɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm Yuutu te tɩn. O kɔgɔ kʋm nyɩ dɩ o yɩra mʋ, yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ vrɩ-ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kaana dɩ maŋɩ sɩ ba sɛ ba banna mʋ woŋo maama wʋnɩ, nɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam na sɛ o ni te tɩn.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam banna-ba, á maŋɩ sɩ á taá soe á kaana, nɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ na soe o kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam yɩ o sɛ o tɩ ba ŋwaanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: O nan tɩgɩ sɩ o pa ba taa yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. O ma kwɛ-ba dɩ o taanɩ dɩm sɩ ba ji lanyɩranɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba na zarɩ woŋo dɩ na te tɩn.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kan-banna maŋɩ sɩ ba taa soe ba kaana, nɩnɛɛnɩ ba na soe ba tɩtɩ yɩra yam te tɩn. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na soe o kaanɩ tɩn soe o tɩtɩ mʋ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na vaɩ o yɩra kwɛɛm. O nan nii o yɩra yam baŋa nɩ mʋ, yɩ o di wʋdiu o ma kɔnɩ-ya. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ Zezi Krisi na nii dɩbam balʋ na yɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ te tɩn,

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: dɩ́ na nyɩ dɩ o yɩra yam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm nan tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ na di kaanɩ, o maŋɩ sɩ o pɔɔrɩ o tɩtɩ o ko dɩ o nu tee nɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o jǝni dɩ o kaanɩ wʋm, sɩ ba laan ji nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa.»

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Taanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ ta-ŋʋm mʋ, yɩ dɩ kuri ya sǝgi. Amʋ nan kwe-dɩ a ma maŋɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm woŋo mʋ.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ cɩga mʋ dɩ abam dɩ, kan-barʋ maama maŋɩ sɩ o taa soe o kaanɩ nɩ o na soe o tɩtɩ te tɩn. Kaanɩ maama dɩ maŋɩ sɩ o taa zuli o barʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Biǝ-ba, abam na sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá sɛ á tiinǝ ni, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: «Nmʋ na zuli n ko dɩ n nu, nń na ywǝǝni dɩ mʋmwɛ-dɛɛrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ abam balʋ na yɩ gambɛ tɩn, á taá tʋŋɩ á tɔgɩ á yum tiinǝ wʋbʋŋa. Taá kwarɩ-na-ba sɩ á tʋŋɩ dɩ yawala, nɩnɛɛnɩ á na wʋ́ tʋŋɩ á pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi te tɩn.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ ba na zɩgɩ ba nii abam maŋa kalʋ tɩn yɩranɩ mʋ á wʋ́ ta tʋŋɩ kʋntʋ sɩ ba tee abam. Taá tʋŋɩ-na dɩ á wʋ maama, sɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn nɩnɛɛnɩ á yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ gambɛ mʋ te.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Taá tʋŋɩ-na dɩ wʋpolo nɩnɛɛnɩ á tʋŋɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ te, sɩ kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ abam ye nɩ nɔɔnʋ maama wʋ́ na ŋwɩɩrʋ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tee nɩ dɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama o na kɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ gambaa naa nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na te o tɩtɩ tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na á joŋi Wɛ zǝnǝ yam maama nɩnɛɛnɩ jara zɩla te, sɩ á wanɩ á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ sʋtaanɩ yɩ wanɩ abam dɩ dɩ sɩsɩɩna yam maama.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Jara yam kʋntʋ nan daɩ dɩbam dɩ nabiinǝ jara. Kʋ yɩ dɩdaanɩ ciciri sɩlʋ maama na jɩgɩ dam wɛyuu tɩlampolo nɩ tɩn mʋ. Sɩntʋ mʋ yɩ sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa dɩdɛɛra, yɩ sɩ jɩgɩ dam lʋgʋ kʋntʋ na yɩ lim tɩn baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, joŋi-na Wɛ zǝnǝ yam maama á ma fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á wanɩ á vɩn sʋtaanɩ sɩ á zɩgɩ dɩ baarɩ maŋa kalʋ na cana tɩn wʋnɩ, sɩ á na wanɩ jara yam, sɩ á ta taá zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ á zɩga kam je nɩ.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Á taá jɩgɩ-na wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ maŋa maama, nɩnɛɛnɩ á na ze tɔn-tɩʋ kʋm ba na ma kɔŋɩ cɩna tɩn, sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ cɩ-dɛɛra yam ya na jɩgɩ minǝ tɩn, sɩ á wanɩ á pa ya maama dwe.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a taa brɩ nɔɔna. Ba nan kɩ-nɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ a na brɩ-ka tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nan taá loori-na Wɛ sɩ DƖ zǝni-nɩ, sɩ a taa waɩ a tɔɔlɩ-ka dɩ baarɩ nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ sɩ a taa kɩ te tɩn. Tiim kwǝrǝ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam maama yazurǝ, sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ da-sono dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa balʋ maama na jɩgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi sono kʋlʋ na ba ti tɩn yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Pooli na loori Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amʋ na guli abam gulǝ, a yǝni a kɩ a Tu Wɛ le mʋ abam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama a na loori Wɛ a pa abam maama, a jɩgɩ wʋpolo mʋ,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: dɩ abam na tɔgɩ á wǝli-nɩ dɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩtʋŋa yam kʋ zɩgɩ pulim nɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm tɩn.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, Wɛ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ DƖ puli tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna yam kʋntʋ abam bɩcara nɩ tɩn, dɩntʋ daa ta wʋ́ pa ya vu ya guri dɛ dɩm Zezi Krisi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Amʋ tiini a soe abam dɩ a bɩcarɩ maama. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ paɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ amʋ taa jɩgɩ á wʋbʋŋa a wʋnɩ kʋntʋ doŋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ abam maama tɔgɩ á na yu-yoŋo kʋm nɩ amʋ dɩ na nɛ te tɩn, lele kʋntʋ ba na kɩ-nɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn, dɩ maŋa kalʋ a ya na kaagɩ a beeri je maama a ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga a pa Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam jɩgɩ kuri tɩn.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Abam fra jɩgɩ amʋ, nɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ na soe abam te tɩn mʋ. Wɛ tɩtɩ ye nɩ a na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ á wʋ́ wanɩ á kuri kʋlʋ na lamma tɩn á kɩ, sɩ Zezi Krisi dɛ dɩm na yiǝ, sɩ digiru yɩ taa wʋ á bɩcara nɩ, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o na á wo-lɔŋɔ o ta.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, á pa á kǝm maama taa tɔgɩ cɩga lanyɩranɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi na zǝni abam te tɩn. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa Wɛ na zulǝ dɩ tiǝ. Zezi mʋ yɩ ŋwɩa cɩga cɩga

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ yaara yalʋ na yi amʋ tɩn nan pɛ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam jagɩ ka yi yigǝ mʋ.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ sɩ nɔɔna badaara tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝrǝ kam dɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ kantɔgɔ mʋ amʋ ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ badaara nan tɔɔlɩ-ka dɩ ba wʋbʋŋ-laarʋ mʋ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Bantʋ tɔɔlɩ dɩ sono mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba ye nɩ Wɛ mʋ pɛ-nɩ ni sɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ cɩga a pa DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ja kuri.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Badonnǝ bam nan tɔɔlɩ Zezi kwǝrǝ kam sɩ kʋ pa ba tɩtɩ mʋ kamunni, sɩ ba ba jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo. Ba nan bʋŋɩ sɩ ba pa amʋ yaara yam mʋ tiini ya puli, a na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ba cɔga. A ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ ba maama na jɩgɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝrǝ kam ba tɔɔlɩ ba brɩ nɔɔna te tɩn. Ba na tɔɔlɩ-ka dɩ wʋbʋŋ-laarʋ naa wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ dɩ, kʋ yɩ Zezi kwǝrǝ kam mʋ ba tɔɔla. Amʋ nan ta tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ye nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ joŋi-nɩ DƖ yagɩ, abam na loori-DƖ á pa-nɩ yɩ Zezi Krisi Joro kʋm dɩ zǝni-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan tiini a jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ a bá kɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa a na a cavɩɩra tɩn. Kʋ na yɩ lele kʋntʋ dɩ maŋa maama, aá ta jɩgɩ pu-dɩa, sɩ a na ŋwɩ naa a na tɩga, sɩ Zezi Krisi na zulǝ a ŋwɩa kam maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ amʋ, a ŋwɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ. A nan na tɩgɩ dɩ, kʋʋ́ ta jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ kʋ pa-nɩ.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ta na ŋwɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, a tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ wǝli nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, a yǝri a na wʋ́ twǝri kʋlʋ sɩ a daarɩ kʋlʋ.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: A ye nɩ kʋntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, yɩ kʋ pɛ a lwarɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ a ta wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. Amʋ wʋ́ ta wʋ abam maama tee nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa á fɔgɩ á tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo ka ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ na joori a ba a wʋ abam tee nɩ, kʋʋ́ pa á tiini á taá zuli Zezi Krisi dɩ wʋpolo amʋ yagɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ yɩranɩ na jɩgɩ kuri tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ á pa á tɩtʋŋa maama taa tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na brɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ, amʋ na nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ a ba abam te, naa a na wʋ nɛ, a ta wʋ́ lwarɩ nɩ abam zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ, yɩ á wǝli daanɩ á kwaana á tʋŋa, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Á yɩ sɛ sɩ á dʋna bam pa fʋʋnɩ zʋ abam dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ. Á na jɩgɩ baarɩ, kʋʋ́ brɩ nɩ bantʋ wʋ́ ba ba cɔgɩ yɩ abam na vrɩm. Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ wʋ́ pa kʋ kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ abam yu-yoŋo kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ á sɛ Zezi Krisi dɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa yɩranɩ má, kʋ yɩ sɩ á kwǝri á na yaara dɩ mʋ o ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Kʋ na sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, a loori abam sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ mʋ daanɩ dɩ sono dɩdʋa, sɩ á daarɩ á taá jɩgɩ ni-dɩdʋa dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa. Abam na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa a taa tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Á wʋbʋŋa yam maŋɩ sɩ ya taa yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Zezi Krisi wʋbʋŋa yam mʋ.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: O nan tiŋi wǝǝnu tɩntʋ maama daa nɩ mʋ, yɩ o daarɩ o ba o ji nabiinu. O yɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ laan pɛ Zezi yuu tiini kʋ zaŋɩ wɛɛnɩ dɩ zulǝ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa-o yɩrɩ dɩlʋ na dwe yɩra maama tɩn.

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri maŋa wʋ́ ba, yɩ balʋ maama na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ naa tɩga baŋa nɩ naa tɩga kuri nɩ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba kuni doonǝ ba zuli Zezi o yɩrɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Ba maama wʋ́ ta dɩ ba niǝ jaja nɩ, Zezi Krisi mʋ yɩ ba Yuutu. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa o Ko Wɛ na zulǝ lanyɩranɩ. Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa pooni taa wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a cilon-sonnu-ba, abam dɛɛn na maŋɩ á sɛ amʋ zaasɩm dɩm maŋa kalʋ amʋ ya na wʋ á tee nɩ tɩn, á nan ta maŋɩ sɩ á sɛ á dwǝni lele kʋntʋ a daa na tǝri abam tee nɩ dɩ tɩn. Taá kwarɩ-na Wɛ lanyɩranɩ dɩ ya-sɩʋ, sɩ á kwaanɩ á tʋŋɩ á pa vrɩm dɩlʋ á na nɛ tɩn ja kuri.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ mʋ yǝni DƖ tʋŋɩ abam bɩcara nɩ, DƖ pa á beeri kǝnǝ yalʋ na wʋ́ poli DƖ wʋ, yɩ DƖ pa á wanɩ-ya á kɩ.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ á wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ á jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo. Á wʋ́ ta yɩ Wɛ biǝ balʋ na ba jɩgɩ wo-lɔŋɔ, yɩ á zʋʋrɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ wʋbʋŋa na ba tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ tɩn tɩtarɩ nɩ. Á wʋ́ ta yɩ nɩ pooni á pa lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna nɩ calɩcwɩ te,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: dɩ á na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩlʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa á brɩ nɔɔna tɩn. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, kʋʋ́ brɩ nɩ a na cɛ a tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam abam ŋwaanɩ te tɩn wʋ jigi kafɛ, yɩ aá ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ abam dɛ dɩm Zezi Krisi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Abam na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa á sɛ Zezi tɩn nyɩ dɩ á kwe woŋo mʋ á ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ kʋ poli DƖ wʋ. Amʋ na maŋɩ a lagɩ a ga a ŋwɩa mʋ dɩ, aá sɛ sɩ ka wǝli abam kaanɩm dɩm nɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Dɩ kʋ dɩ, aá ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo, yɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ wǝli dɩ amʋ á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ abam dɩ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ, sɩ amʋ dɩ wǝli dɩ abam a kɩ wʋpolo. Pooli lagɩ o tʋŋɩ Timoti dɩ Epafroditi Filipi tiinǝ tee nɩ

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Dɩbam Yuutu Zezi na sɛ, amʋ bʋŋɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ Timoti sɩ o ba abam te lele. Kʋntʋ, o na joori o ba amʋ te, oó pa-nɩ abam labaarɩ sɩ a daa yɩ ta jɩgɩ liǝ.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa tǝri amʋ tee nɩ, o na jɩgɩ a wʋbʋŋa yam doŋ, sɩ o sɩɩnɩ o taa ye abam zǝnǝ ni nɩ, kʋ na daɩ Timoti yɩranɩ.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na daarɩ tɩn beeri ba tɩtɩ wǝǝnu yɩranɩ mʋ, yɩ ba yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na yɩ Zezi Krisi nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Timoti, abam maŋɩ á ye o wʋ na tɔgɩ cɩga te tɩn. O dɛɛn tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, nɩnɛɛnɩ bu na tɔgɩ dɩ o ko o tʋŋɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ a bʋŋɩ sɩ a tʋŋ-o abam tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ a na wʋ́ lwarɩ ba na wʋ́ di a taanɩ dɩm te tɩn.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɩ baá pʋrɩ-nɩ ba yagɩ lele, yɩ a laan ba abam te.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ a tʋŋɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Epafroditi sɩ o joori o ba abam te. O tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ yɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa, yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ na cam ya baŋa nɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ abam tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ á na lɩ sɩ o ja zǝnǝ o ba o pa-nɩ a yaara yam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Abam fra maa jɩg-o yɩ o lagɩ sɩ o daa na abam. O wʋ ya cɔgɩ dɩ á na ni nɩ o ya ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ nɩ o ya ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ, yɩ o ga fɩɩn sɩ o tɩ. Wɛ nan duri o ŋwaŋa. Kʋ nan daɩ wʋntʋ yɩranɩ ŋwaŋa mʋ DƖ duri. Wɛ duri amʋ dɩ ŋwaŋa, dɩ DƖ na pɛ o wǝri yɩ a wʋ daa wʋ cɔgɩ zanzan tɩn.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a tiini a kwaanɩ a lagɩ sɩ o yi abam te lɩla, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ á na wʋ́ joori á na-o tɩn, sɩ amʋ dɩ liǝ yam laan ti.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ o ya gɛ fɩɩn mʋ sɩ o tɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ. O dɛɛn lagɩ o ga o ŋwɩa dɩ o na lǝni abam yuu nɩ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ o wǝli-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋlʋ na daarɩ sɩ a ta a wǝli da tɩn, á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ á na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn. A na maŋɩ a pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ a ma brɩ abam tɩn, kʋ ba camma sɩ a ta joori a brɩ-kʋ abam, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ cɩ abam wo-lwaanʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ-na á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tiinǝ balʋ na kwaanɩ sɩ ba taa goni nɔɔna yɩra ba yagɩ tɩn. Bantʋ nyɩ dɩ kakuri mʋ.

english_verse: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa cullu tɩm ya na jɩgɩ kuri, amʋ tɩtɩ ya wʋ́ wanɩ a tɩɩgɩ-tɩ. Nɔɔnʋ nan na bʋŋɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ bʋra sɩ o tɩɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa cullu tɩm, amʋ ya jɩgɩ bʋra a dwe.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na yi da nana tɩn, mʋ ba goni-nɩ nɩ dɩbam Zwifǝ cullu tɩm na brɩ te tɩn. A yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tu mʋ, yɩ a nuŋi Bɛnzamɛn dwi dɩm wʋnɩ. Amʋ sɩɩnɩ a yɩ Zwifu mʋ. Zwifǝ bam mʋ lʋgɩ-nɩ. Kʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɔgɩm, amʋ dɛɛn wʋ Farizɩan tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam laŋa nɩ, amʋ dɛɛn kwaanɩ a tʋŋɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ a na bɛɛsɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna bam te tɩn. Kʋ nan daa na yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm sɛɛm, a dɛɛn sɛ-tɩ dɩ cɩga yɩ tusim tǝrǝ.

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ a na kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ daa daɩ a tɩtɩ tɩtʋŋa dɩ a na tɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ paɩ a jɩgɩ cɩga dɩ a na kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ a maŋɩ a yi wǝǝnu tɩlʋ a na lagɩ sɩ a yi tɩn. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ a bɩcarɩ fɔgɩ dɩ kwɛ fasɩ yɩ lwarɩm daa tǝrǝ. Amʋ nan kwaanɩ a jaŋɩ mʋ a ve yigǝ, sɩ a laan wanɩ a joŋi pɛɛrɩ Zezi Krisi tee nɩ. Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ o joŋi-nɩ sɩ a taa yɩ o nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, amʋ kwaana sɩ a yɔɔrɩ a duri a vu a yi kweelim je mʋ, sɩ a joŋi pɛɛrɩ dɩm Wɛ tee nɩ. Pɛɛrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ Wɛ na bǝŋi-nɩ sɩ a ba a joŋi DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ dɩbam balʋ wʋbʋŋa na bɩgɩ dɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam maama sɛ nɩ amʋ na tagɩ te tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ. Abam badaara wʋbʋŋa nan na daɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, Wɛ wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋ dɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ taá tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ kalʋ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ ka yɩ cɩga tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá lwǝni amʋ na kɩ te tɩn mʋ, sɩ á fɔgɩ á nii balʋ na tɔgɩ cwǝ-laa nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩ́ na brɩ abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ba yǝni ba lagɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ fra na jɩgɩ-ba tɩn mʋ kʋ dwe Wɛ. Ba maa jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ ba cavɩɩra tɩn, yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ wʋbʋŋa jɩgɩ-ba. Ba kweelim je nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ-ba mʋ.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ kugu je wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ mʋ. Dɩbam cǝgi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi sɩ o nuŋi dáanɩ mʋ o ba. Wʋntʋ mʋ vrɩ dɩbam lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a soe abam lanyɩranɩ yɩ á fra jɩgɩ-nɩ. Abam paɩ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo, yɩ á ta wʋ́ pa a yuu zǝŋi Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. A cilon-sonnu-ba, kwaanɩ-na á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ́ Yuutu tɔgɩm dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: A nan loori Evodi dɩ Sintisi lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ á na sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: A loori nmʋ dɩ, wʋlʋ na yɩ a doŋ tɩntʋŋnʋ cɩga cɩga tɩn, sɩ n zǝni kaana bantʋ sɩ ba taa sɛ daanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba dɛɛn tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ yɩ dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, dɩ Klɩman dɩ balʋ maama na tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ ba tʋŋɩ tɩn. Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ pʋpʋnɩ bantʋ yɩra DƖ ŋwɩa tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Taá kɩ-na wʋpolo maŋa maama á na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. A ta lagɩ a joori a ta nɩ, á taá kɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Pa-na nɔɔna maama lwarɩ á lanyɩranɩ wʋm ni nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm maa bɩɩnɩ lele.

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ-na á taá liǝ dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Woŋo maama wʋnɩ sɩ á taá warɩ Wɛ, á brɩ-DƖ kʋlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn sɩ DƖ zǝni abam, sɩ á kwǝri á taá kɩ DƖ le maŋa maama.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ wʋ́ pa á bɩcara taa zurǝ, sɩ kʋ dwǝni nabiinǝ na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋlʋ ba lwarɩ tɩn. Kʋ maa pa kʋlʋkʋlʋ bá wanɩ kʋ cɔgɩ á bɩcara dɩ á wʋbʋŋa maama, abam na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Á taá kɩ-na wǝǝnu tɩlʋ amʋ na brɩ abam yɩ á sɛ-tɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ á na ni kʋlʋ a na taga, yɩ á na kʋlʋ a na kɩ tɩn. Á na sɩɩnɩ á kɩ kʋntʋ, Wʋ-zuru Tu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ ta wʋ á tee nɩ. Pooli kɩ Filipi tiinǝ bam le ba na zǝn-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: A na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn, amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ daanɩ zanzan yɩ abam daa wʋ guli a gulǝ sɩ á wǝli-nɩ, yɩ lele kʋntʋ á laan zǝni-nɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ abam ba jɩgɩ a wʋbʋŋa mʋ ya, kʋ yɩ á wʋ nɛ cwǝŋǝ mʋ sɩ á wǝli-nɩ.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: A na tagɩ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ a na gɛ woŋo tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Woŋo maama wʋnɩ, amʋ mɩ sɩ a taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ kʋlʋ a na jɩgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Yinigǝ na jɩgɩ-nɩ, amʋ ye a na wʋ́ ja a tɩtɩ te. A jɩjɩgɩrʋ nan na daga dɩ, a ta ye a na wʋ́ kɩ te. Woŋo maama wʋnɩ, amʋ ye a na wʋ́ kɩ te sɩ a taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo. A na jɩgɩ a di a wʋbʋŋa naa kana na jɩgɩ-nɩ, a jɩjɩgɩrʋ na daga naa tɩ na muri, amʋ ta ye a na wʋ́ kɩ te sɩ a taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: Amʋ waɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama a kɩa, Zezi Krisi na pa-nɩ dam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, á kɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ á na zǝni-nɩ a yaara yam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Abam Filipi tiinǝ tɩtɩ dɩ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, maŋa kalʋ a na puli a wʋra a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam a brɩ abam yɩ a laan nuŋi Masɩdʋanɩ nɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ abam yɩranɩ mʋ wǝli-nɩ. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋdoŋ daa tǝrǝ kʋ dɩ na pɛ amʋ woŋo, kʋ na daɩ abam yɩranɩ.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: A dɛɛn na wʋ Tesaloniki nɩ tɩn, abam tʋŋɩ a na lagɩ zǝnǝ yalʋ tɩn á pa-nɩ, yɩ kʋ daɩ kuni bɩdwɩ yɩranɩ.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ nɩ amʋ lagɩ sɩ a taa joŋi abam pɛɛra yam má mʋ, kʋ yɩ nyɔɔrɩ dɩlʋ abam na wʋ́ na Wɛ tee nɩ ya ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ a jɩgɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Amʋ joŋi pɛɛra yalʋ maama abam na pɛ amʋ tɩn kʋ ja gaalɩ. A joŋi pɛɛra yalʋ á na kɩ Epafroditi jɩŋa nɩ sɩ o ja ba o pa-nɩ tɩn, yɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ daa wʋ muri-nɩ. Abam pɛɛra yam nyɩ dɩ woŋo kʋlʋ á na mɛ á kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ kʋ lwǝm ywǝmmǝ tɩn mʋ. Wɛ nan joŋi á kaanɩm dɩm dɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Amʋ Tu Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam kʋlʋ maama á na gɛ tɩn Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, DƖ na jɩgɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ na tiini tɩ dagɩ yɩ tɩ jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ tɩn.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Ko tɩn maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ mʋ maŋa maama. Amina.

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn maama á pa-nɩ. Dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ na wʋ amʋ tee nɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama jɔɔnɩ abam, kʋ na fɔgɩ kʋ dwe dɩdɩ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Rom Pa-farʋ wʋm sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Dɩbam Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ Wɛ na kuri dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ, yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Timoti tɔgɩ o wǝli-nɩ.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ sɩ dɩ́ pa abam balʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ á zʋʋrɩ Kolɔsɩ nɩ tɩn. Abam mʋ yɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Pooli na kɩ Wɛ le ba ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama dɩbam na yǝni dɩ́ loori Wɛ dɩ́ pa abam, dɩ́ taá kɩ DƖ le mʋ abam ŋwaanɩ. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi Ko.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam ni abam na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi yɩ á kwǝri á soe Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama te tɩn.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, abam na dɛ yigǝ á ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn mʋ pɛ á jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ á wʋ́ na wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Wɛ na tiŋi DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kalʋ na sɩɩnɩ ka yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ laan jagɩ ka yi lʋgʋ baŋa je maama yɩ ka kwɛ nɔɔna lanyɩranɩ, nɩ ka na jagɩ ka yi abam te yɩ ka kwɛ abam te tɩn. Kʋ zɩgɩ maŋa kalʋ á na puli á ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam yɩ á lwarɩ Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm na sɩɩnɩ dɩ yɩ cɩga te tɩn.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ Epafrasɩ dɛɛn mʋ brɩ abam Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam ko-bu-sono, yɩ o tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam o tʋŋɩ dɩ o wʋ maama o pa Zezi Krisi abam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ ta mʋ tagɩ o brɩ dɩbam Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ abam jɩgɩ da-sono te tɩn.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ warɩ Wɛ maŋa maama dɩ́ pa abam, kʋ na puli maŋa kam dɩ́ na ni á woŋo kʋntʋ tɩn. Dɩ́ loori-DƖ sɩ DƖ pa á taá ye DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, sɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa á na swan dɩ yǝno maama nɩ DƖ Joro kʋm na paɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, abam laan wʋ́ wanɩ á tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na lagɩ te tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa o wʋ poli á tɩtʋŋa maama ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ wǝli abam sɩ á taá kɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna dwi tǝri tǝri lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á fɔgɩ á lwarɩ Wɛ á wǝli da.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Á taá kɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ le dɩ wʋpolo, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩntʋ mʋ pɛ abam cwǝŋǝ, sɩ á tɔgɩ á na wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ DƖ na tiŋi sɩ DƖ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam tɩn jǝgǝ kalʋ na yɩ pooni tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ mʋ lɩ dɩbam lim wʋnɩ, sɩ wo-lwaanʋ daa yɩ taa waɩ dɩbam. DƖ ma daarɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ zʋ DƖ tɩtɩ Bu-sono kʋm paarɩ dɩm wʋ.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Zezi yɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ nabiinǝ na ba naɩ tɩn nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ. O yɩ Wɛ Bu-dʋa mʋ. Wʋntʋ maŋɩ o wʋra mʋ kʋ loori wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛ wʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ wǝǝnu maama, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ dɩ tɩga baŋa nɩ tɩn, tɩlʋ nɔɔna na naɩ dɩ tɩlʋ ba na warɩ ba naɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ malɛsɩ dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na jɩgɩ dam yɩ tɩ di paarɩ nabiinǝ baŋa nɩ tɩn. Wɛ dɛ Zezi ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ tɩ maama, sɩ kʋ pa o na zulǝ tɩ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Zezi maŋɩ o wʋra mʋ pulim nɩ yɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ daa ta tǝrǝ. Kʋ yɩ wʋntʋ mʋ paɩ woŋo maama zɩgɩ kʋ jǝgǝ nɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ o nɔɔna bam yuutu, yɩ ba kɔgɔ kʋm nyɩ dɩ o yɩra yam. Wʋm mʋ puli o kɔgɔ kʋm kuri. Kʋ yɩ Zezi mʋ dɛ yigǝ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Kʋ ma pa o yɩ yigǝ tu woŋo maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ lagɩ sɩ DƖ Bu Zezi taa nyɩ dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ fasɩ.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ lɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ, sɩ DƖ da DƖ Bu wʋm ŋwaanɩ DƖ pa wǝǝnu maama joori tɩ fɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ DƖ. DƖ Bu Zezi na tɩgɩ tʋʋn-dagara kam baŋa nɩ yɩ o jana nuŋi tɩn mʋ pɛ wǝǝnu maama joori tɩ fɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ Wɛ, kʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu dɩ wɛyuu wǝǝnu maama.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, abam dɛɛn baŋwɛ dɩ Wɛ, á yɩ Wɛ dʋna mʋ. Abam wʋbʋŋa dɩ á tɩtʋŋa maama dɛɛn lagɩ wo-lwaanʋ yɩranɩ mʋ sɩ á taá kɩa.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, Wɛ laan pɛ á fɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ DƖ, DƖ Bu wʋm na jigi nabiinu yɩ o daarɩ o tɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ á wanɩ á ba á zɩgɩ DƖ yigǝ nɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo mʋ, sɩ á taá yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna balʋ na ba jɩgɩ wo-lɔŋɔ tɩn.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa, sɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ. Á wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á pa á wʋbʋŋa lǝni dɩ tɩɩna yalʋ á na jɩgɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kwǝrǝ kalʋ abam na maŋɩ á ni yɩ ba tɔɔlɩ-ka ba brɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna maama tɩn. Amʋ Pooli nan yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ sɩ a taa tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ. Pooli na tʋŋɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Amʋ jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ a na yaarɩ te abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Kʋ na cɛ a yɩra nɩ te tɩn, kʋ nyɩ nɩ Zezi Krisi na yaarɩ te tɩn mʋ. A yaarɩ yaara yalʋ na daarɩ sɩ dɩ́ yaarɩ Zezi tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ, sɩ kʋ zǝni o nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm na nyɩ dɩ o yɩra yam tɩn lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Wɛ tʋŋɩ-nɩ sɩ a taa tʋŋa a pa-ba mʋ. Tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ sɩ a kwaanɩ a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam maama a brɩ abam.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Kʋ na zɩgɩ pulim nɩ tɩn, Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ dɛɛn sǝgi mʋ nabiinǝ tee nɩ, yɩ Wɛ laan pa balʋ na yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn ba ba lwarɩ-ka.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam yǝni dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝrǝ mʋ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna maama, yɩ dɩ́ kaanɩ-ba dɩ swan yalʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ pa ba maama laan wanɩ ba ba ba zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, nɩ balʋ wʋbʋŋa na bɩga dɩ Zezi Krisi tɔgɩm dɩm tɩn.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ amʋ nan tiini a kwaanɩ a tʋŋa. Kʋ nan yɩ Zezi dam-fɔrɔ kʋm o na pɛ-nɩ tɩn mʋ paɩ a jɩgɩ dam a ma a tʋŋɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Amʋ lagɩ sɩ abam lwarɩ a na tiini a tʋŋɩ te abam ŋwaanɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Lawodise nɩ, dɩ nɔɔna zanzan balʋ yi ta na wʋ nɛ amʋ tɩn dɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Amʋ tiini a kwaanɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wanɩ ba taa jɩgɩ baarɩ mʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba taa ŋwɩ daanɩ dɩ sono. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa ba zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ ba na tiini ba lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam te tɩn, sɩ ba lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kalʋ ya na sǝgi tɩn, yɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: A nan tagɩ kʋntʋ a brɩ abam, sɩ á yɩ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ganɩ abam, dɩ o na maŋɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ swan taanɩ te maama dɩ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ na tǝri abam tee nɩ tɩn dɩ, a wʋbʋŋa maama wʋra dɩ abam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ pɛ-nɩ wʋpolo dɩ a na lwarɩ nɩ á tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ yɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ, á na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ dɩ́ na jɩgɩ Zezi ŋwaanɩ tɩn

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Abam nan na sɛ sɩ Zezi Krisi taa yɩ abam Yuutu tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá ŋwɩ dɩd-o mʋ.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Nan fɔgɩ-na á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ nɩ tiu bʋnnʋ na zʋ tɩga te tɩn, sɩ á daarɩ á kwaanɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o nɩ ba na maŋɩ ba zaasɩ abam te tɩn, sɩ á taá kɩ Wɛ le zanzan maŋa maama.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Á nan cʋ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yɩ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ ganɩ abam dɩ o swan yalʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn. Yantʋ yɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa yalʋ na tɔgɩ ba nabaara mɩʋ tɩn mʋ. Ya yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm mʋ, sɩ ya daɩ Krisi nyɩm.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Abam na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi tɩn, á maŋɩ á na Wɛ wo-laarʋ tɩm maama á joŋi o tee nɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ te woŋo kʋlʋ maama na jɩgɩ dam nabiinǝ baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, ba na miisi abam na wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ ba ya kɩ abam dɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ Zezi Krisi na tɩgɩ yɩ ba kɩ-o te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ kwǝri kʋ brɩ nɩ á joori á bi á na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam, bɛŋwaanɩ á jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ na mɛ DƖ dam dɩm DƖ bi Zezi DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: Ba na pagɩ Zezi Krisi tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ ba pagɩ cullu tɔnɔ kʋlʋ na brɩ nɩ dɩbam kɩ dɩ́ cɔgɩ tɩn mʋ. Wɛ brɩ nɩ tɔnɔ kʋm kʋntʋ daa ba jɩgɩ kuri, yɩ dɩbam lwarɩm dɩm maama ti.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, abam yɩ sɛ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ pa abam culu dɩ á na di kʋlʋ naa á na nyɔ kʋlʋ tɩn. Á yɩ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ brɩ abam á na wʋ́ lɩ da yalʋ sɩ ya taa yɩ candiǝ da naa can-dʋŋa dɛ naa siun dɛ ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Cullu tɩm kʋntʋ daa ba jɩgɩ kuri. Tɩ dɛɛn yɩ luluŋu mʋ, sɩ tɩ brɩ cɩga kalʋ na lagɩ ka ba tɩn. Cɩga kam kʋntʋ nan mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Á yɩ sɛ á pa nɔɔna balʋ na yaarɩ ba tɩtɩ yɩ ba zuli malɛsɩ dɩ vwan tu-n-tɩtɩ tɩn ganɩ abam. Ba yǝni ba tɛ ba wɩ, Wɛ mʋ brɩ-ba kʋntʋ woŋo, yɩ ba wʋbʋŋa nan daɩ Wɛ nyɩm. Kʋ yɩ ba zǝŋi-n-tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋ-kamunǝ mʋ ba jɩga, kʋ nan yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Bantʋ nan daa ba ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Yuutu, yɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ dɩd-o nɩnɛɛnɩ nɔɔnʋ yɩra na toŋi dɩ o yuu te tɩn. Zezi ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ wǝli daanɩ dɩ́ tʋŋa, nɩ nɔɔnʋ yɩra na jɩgɩ pɔɔrɩm dwi tǝri tǝri yɩ ya tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩdʋa te tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ zǝni dɩbam yɩ dɩ́ ve yigǝ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ nɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ Zezi Krisi tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ á tɔgɩ dɩd-o á tɩ mʋ te. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wʋbʋŋ-yɔɔrʋ tɩm daa ba jɩgɩ dam abam baŋa nɩ. Bɛɛ mʋ yɩ á nan ta kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ á yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm mʋ te?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Cullu tɩm kʋntʋ nan wʋra wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na wʋ́ ba tɩ cɔgɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Cullu tɩlʋ ba na brɩ abam kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn yɩ nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa mʋ. Tɩ wʋ nuŋi Wɛ te.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ nyɩ nɩ swan mʋ ba na maɩ ba tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa ba ma zuli-tɩ. Ba ma tu ba tɩtɩ yɩ ba bɛɛsɩ ba yɩra. Cullu tɩm kʋntʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ tɩ jɩgɩ kuri mʋ te, tɩ nan yɩ kafɛ mʋ. Tɩ warɩ tɩ wǝli nɔɔna sɩ ba ja ba tɩtɩ dɩ wo-zɔɔna yalʋ ba fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Abam na nɛ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ á tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi mʋ á joori á bi á yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩm taa jɩgɩ fra dɩ abam, sɩ dáanɩ mʋ Zezi Krisi je Baŋa-Wɛ jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Pa-na á wʋbʋŋa tiini ya zʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wo-laarʋ tɩm, sɩ kʋ yɩ taa yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Abam na yagɩ lwarɩm cwǝŋǝ tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ á tɩgɩ mʋ te, yɩ á laan na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa dɩ Zezi Krisi, yɩ á ŋwɩa kam sǝgi Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Wo-balwaarʋ tɩntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ banɩ wʋ́ zaŋɩ [dɩ nabiinǝ balʋ maama na vɩn DƖ ni tɩn].

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Abam dɩ ŋwɩa kam maama dɛɛn yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, á maŋɩ sɩ á lɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ maama mʋ á bɩcara nɩ. Kʋ na yɩ ban-zɔŋɔ dɩ ka-culi-daanɩ dɩ pu-sɩŋa. Á yɩ taá twɩ nɔɔna. Á yɩ taá maɩ á niǝ á ŋɔɔnɩ wo-zɔɔna ŋwɛ.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á fɔ vwan á pa daanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ abam yagɩ á ŋwɩ-doŋǝ kam dɩ ka kikiǝ maama,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: yɩ á laan daarɩ á jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa mʋ. Wɛ mʋ pɛ abam ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam kʋntʋ. DƖ maa kwɛ-ka sɩ ka taa nyɩ dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ ŋwɩa, sɩ á wanɩ á fɔgɩ á lwarɩ DƖ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, balʋ na jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam tɩn, kampwara daa tǝri ba wʋnɩ. Zwifǝ dɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ maama yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. Balʋ na goni ba bǝkǝri dɩ balʋ na wʋ goni tɩn maama yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. Balʋ yi na wʋ pʋʋrɩ dɩ balʋ ba na ba nɩgɩ tɩn, kʋ wǝli dɩ gambɛ dɩ balʋ na te ba tɩtɩ tɩn maama yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ. Ba maama wʋra Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ, yɩ o ŋwɩ dɩ ba maama.
