english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ kuri abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna, yɩ DƖ soe abam. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, taá jɩgɩ-na da-ŋwaŋa, sɩ á taá kɩ-da lanyɩranɩ. Taá tu-na á tɩtɩ da-tee nɩ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-bono dɩ wʋ-zuru.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Á taá jɩgɩ-na wʋ-zuru da-ŋwaanɩ. Abam wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ jʋʋ dɩ o doŋ, sɩ á yagɩ á ma cɛ daanɩ, nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na yagɩ á lwarɩm o ma cɛ abam te tɩn.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na dwe maama tɩn, taá soe-na daanɩ, sɩ kʋ pa á wanɩ á taá jɩgɩ ni dɩdʋa lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Pa-na wʋ-zuru kʋlʋ Zezi Krisi na pɛ abam tɩn taa te á wʋbʋŋa maama. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ kuri abam sɩ á ji woŋo dɩdʋa mʋ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru kʋntʋ doŋ. Maŋa maama sɩ á taá kɩ Wɛ le.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Pa-na Zezi Krisi taanɩ dɩm tiini dɩ zʋ á bɩcara, sɩ á taá maɩ swan yalʋ Wɛ na pɛ abam tɩn á kwe daanɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá kaanɩ daanɩ. Taá leeni-na Wɛ lǝŋ-ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ tiǝ le dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na pɛ abam le sɩlʋ tɩn. Á taá leeni kʋntʋ á zuli Wɛ, sɩ á taá kɩ DƖ le.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ maama abam na wʋ́ kɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ á ni-ŋwaŋa naa á jɩŋa tɩtʋŋɩ, sɩ á pa kʋ taa yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá kɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ le Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ. Nɔɔnʋ maama na maŋɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ te ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam wʋnɩ tɩn

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaana-ba, á maŋɩ sɩ á taá sɛ á banna, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋntʋ yɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi wʋbʋŋa tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kan-banna-ba, á dɩ maŋɩ sɩ á taá soe á kaana, sɩ á yɩ taá kɩ cɩa dɩ ba.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam balʋ na yɩ biǝ kwǝ tɩn, á yɩ taá tiini á fɩ-ba, sɩ kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa ba wʋrʋ cɔgɩ yɩ ba ga baarɩ.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ abam balʋ na yɩ gambɛ tɩn, á taá tʋŋɩ á tɔgɩ á yum tiinǝ wʋbʋŋa woŋo maama wʋnɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ ba na zɩgɩ ba nii abam maŋa kalʋ yɩranɩ tɩn mʋ á wʋ́ kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ ba tee abam. Nan taá tʋŋɩ-na dɩ á wʋ maama, á na kwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ maama á na wʋ́ tʋŋɩ tɩn, á taá tʋŋɩ dɩ á wʋ maama. Pa-na á na kɩ te tɩn taa yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ taa daɩ nabiinǝ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ abam ye nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ o na tiŋi sɩ o pa o nɔɔna bam Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ á yuutu wʋlʋ á na tʋŋɩ á pa-o tɩn.

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Á tiini á kwaanɩ á taá loori Wɛ, sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á taá kɩ DƖ le.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Á nan taá loori Wɛ á pa dɩbam dɩ, sɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ na cwǝŋǝ dɩ́ taá tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi cɩga kalʋ na sǝgi tɩn kwǝrǝ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna. Kʋ nan yɩ amʋ na tɔɔlɩ Zezi kwǝrǝ kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ a wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Pa-na á ni-taanɩ taa lana, sɩ dɩ taa jɩgɩ ywǝǝni, sɩ á daarɩ á taá ye á na wʋ́ lǝri nɔɔnʋ maama taanɩ te tɩn. Tiim kwǝrǝ

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a tʋŋɩ dɩ́ ko-bu-sono Tisiki sɩ o ba abam te. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tʋŋɩ o pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɩ cɩga tɩn. Dɩbam maama wǝli daanɩ mʋ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ paɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ko-bu-sono Onisim dɩ wʋ́ tɔgɩ o ba. Wʋntʋ nuŋi abam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ o tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ cɩga. Bantʋ bale mʋ wʋ́ ta woŋo kʋlʋ maama na wʋra kʋ kɩ yo seeni tɩn ba brɩ abam.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Arisarɩkɩ wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ o wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn jɔɔnɩ abam. Marɩkɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Banabasɩ cʋrʋ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam. Abam maŋɩ á joŋi ni nɩ, o na tuǝ, á wʋ́ jeer-o lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Zusitu wʋlʋ yɩrɩ dɩdoŋ na yɩ Zezi tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam. Kʋ na yɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na tu ba sɛ Zezi tɩn, nɔɔna bantʋ batɔ yɩranɩ mʋ yɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ ba tʋŋɩ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm tɩtʋŋa ba wǝli amʋ tɩn. Ba tiini ba paɩ a wʋ zurǝ.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafrasɩ wʋlʋ na nuŋi abam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ yɩ o tʋŋɩ o pa Zezi Krisi tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam. O kwaanɩ o loori Wɛ mʋ maŋa maama o pa abam, sɩ á wanɩ á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ baarɩ, sɩ á wʋbʋŋa bɩ dɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm, sɩ á taá kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Amʋ tɩtɩ wʋ́ wanɩ a ta a brɩ abam nɩ o sɩɩnɩ o tiini o tʋŋɩ o wǝli abam, kʋ wǝli dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na zʋʋrɩ Lawodise dɩ Yɩrapolisi nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Dɩbam badoŋ-sono Luki wʋlʋ na yɩ dɔgɩta tu tɩn dɩdaanɩ Demasɩ dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi yɩ ba zʋʋrɩ Lawodise nɩ tɩn á pa dɩbam, kʋ wǝli dɩ Nimfa dɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na yǝni kʋ jeeri daanɩ o sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Abam na joŋi amʋ tɔnɔ kʋm yɩ á na karɩmɩ á ti, sɩ á laan pa-kʋ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na zʋʋrɩ Lawodise nɩ tɩn, sɩ ba dɩ karɩmɩ. Kʋ daarɩ sɩ abam dɩ joŋi amʋ tɔnɔ kʋdoŋ bantʋ dɩ tee nɩ á dɩ karɩmɩ.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Ta-na á brɩ Arisipi sɩ o kwaanɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na pɛ-o sɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩn o ti.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli mʋ jɔɔnɩ abam. A tɩtɩ laan mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ dɩ a jɩŋa. Á yɩ zaŋɩ á swe a na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn ni nɩ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli dɩdaanɩ Silasɩ dɩ Timoti mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ sɩ dɩ́ pa abam Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Tesaloniki nɩ yɩ á yɩ dɩ́ Ko Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Tesaloniki tiinǝ na tɔgɩ Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Maŋa maama dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le mʋ abam maama ŋwaanɩ, yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ loori-DƖ dɩ́ pa abam.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ mʋ soe abam yɩ DƖ kuri abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, dɩbam dɛɛn na tu dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn, kʋ daɩ dɩ ni-taanɩ má. Wɛ dam dɩm mʋ wʋ dɩbam tee nɩ dɩ DƖ Joro kʋm, yɩ dɩ́ brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ dɩ́ wʋ maama. Dɩbam dɛɛn na wʋ á tee nɩ tɩn, á nɛ dɩbam na yɩ tɩte sɩ kʋ ma zǝni abam.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Abam lwǝni dɩbam dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na kɩ te tɩn. Á na joŋi Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn, kʋ pɛ á na yaara zanzan. Á nan ta joŋi-ka dɩ wʋpolo Wɛ Joro kʋm na zǝni abam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, abam na tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm kwǝrǝ kam á brɩ nɔɔna te tɩn, ka jagɩ Masɩdʋanɩ dɩ Akayi nɩ ka gaalɩ ka kɛ ka yi je maama, yɩ nɔɔna maama lwarɩ á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te. Mʋ kʋ kuri kʋ daa daɩ fɩfɩʋn sɩ dɩ́ ta kʋlʋkʋlʋ kantʋ laŋa nɩ.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: yɩ á kwǝri á cǝgi DƖ Bu wʋm tum dɩm. Wɛ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ oó zɩgɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ na wʋ́ vrɩ dɩbam Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ ba nɔɔna baŋa nɩ ba lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam tɩtɩ ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ, dɩ́ na tu abam te tɩn, kʋ daɩ kafɛ.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Abam ye ba na maŋɩ ba bɛɛsɩ dɩbam yɩ ba twɩ dɩbam te Filipi nɩ yɩ dɩ́ laan ba abam te tɩn. Nɔɔna dɛɛn kwaanɩ sɩ ba cɩ dɩbam cwǝŋǝ. Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, dɩ́ Tu Wɛ pɛ dɩbam pu-dɩa sɩ dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ brɩ abam dɩ baarɩ.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Kwiǝ yalʋ dɩ́ na yǝni dɩ́ kwe abam tɩn, kʋ daɩ dɩ tusim, naa dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ mʋ. Kʋ nan daɩ swan mʋ dɩ́ kɩa, sɩ dɩ́ ma dɩ́ ganɩ abam.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ abam naa nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama dɩ, dɩ́ wʋ kɩ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa nɩ sɩ nabiinǝ taa zuli dɩbam.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋna tɩn, dɩ́ ya jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ pa á taá nii dɩbam nɩ nɔn-kamunǝ te. Dɩ́ nan wʋ kɩ kʋntʋ. Dɩ́ dɛɛn tu dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ nɩ biǝ te, yɩ dɩ́ laan nii abam lanyɩranɩ nɩ kaanɩ na jɩgɩ o biǝ o nii te tɩn.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na tiini dɩ́ soe abam tɩn, dɩ́ sɛ sɩ dɩ́ kwe Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam, yɩ dɩ́ kwe dɩ́ ŋwɩa maama dɩ mʋ dɩ́ wǝli da dɩ́ pa abam, á na tiini á tigi dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam wʋ́ wanɩ á guli dɩbam dɛɛn na tʋŋɩ dɩ́ bwǝni zanzan abam ŋwaanɩ te maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ na wʋra dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn. Dɩ́ dɛɛn ba lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ yaarɩ abam dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ ta yǝni dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ tʋŋɩ wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama sɩ dɩ́ ma na dɩ́ ni-wʋdiu.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Á ye nɩ dɩ́ dɛɛn jɩgɩ abam maama dɩ jɩ sɩle mʋ, nɩ ko na yǝni o jɩgɩ o biǝ te tɩn.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ kwe abam dɩ kwiǝ yalʋ na paɩ á bɩcara zurǝ tɩn mʋ. Dɩ́ ma daarɩ dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ kaanɩ abam, sɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ mʋ kuri abam sɩ á zʋ DƖ paarɩ dɩm wʋ sɩ á na paarɩ-zulǝ DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na jaanɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ ba dɩ́ tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn, á sɛ yɩ á joŋi-ka lanyɩranɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le maŋa maama abam ŋwaanɩ. Á sɛ nɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ mʋ sɩ kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ nyɩm. Kʋ yɩ cɩga, kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam sɩɩnɩ ka yɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ mʋ, yɩ ka zǝni abam balʋ na sɛ Zezi tɩn wʋbʋŋa dɩ dam.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam na nɛ yaara yalʋ tɩn, Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Zude tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn dɩ nɛ yaara yantʋ doŋ mʋ. Abam dwi tiinǝ bam yaarɩ abam nɩnɛɛnɩ Zwifǝ bam dɩ na yaarɩ Zwifǝ balʋ na sɛ Zezi te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Zwifǝ bam kʋntʋ mʋ gʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam, yɩ ba kwǝri ba bɛɛsɩ dɩbam dɩ. Ba maa paɩ Wɛ wʋ cɔgɩ dɩ ba, yɩ ba yɩ nɔɔna maama dʋna.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Ba dɛɛn kwaanɩ sɩ ba cɩ dɩbam, sɩ dɩ́ yɩ tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ́ brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ sɩ ba na vrɩm ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ. Ba na vɩn Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma pa ba na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maŋa maama tɩn fɔgɩ tɩ puli tɩ wǝli da. Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm laan nan tu ba baŋa. Pooli na lagɩ sɩ o joori o na Tesaloniki tiinǝ bam te tɩn

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ na pɔɔrɩ dɩ abam maŋa fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa mʋ pɔɔrɩ daanɩ, kʋ yɩ dɩ́ yiǝ na warɩ ya na daanɩ tɩn mʋ. Abam fra tiini ya jɩgɩ dɩbam, yɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ sɩ dɩ́ joori dɩ́ na abam.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ ba abam te. Amʋ Pooli ya kwaanɩ sɩ a ba abam te, kʋ daɩ kuni bɩdwɩ yɩranɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ sʋtaanɩ mʋ cɩgɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ abam wʋbʋŋa mʋ tiini ya jɩgɩ dɩbam. Kʋ yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ wʋpolo. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na joori o ba, dɩ́ wʋ́ taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ́ na wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɩ abam dɛ dɩbam jɩŋa á na vrɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, abam mʋ sɩɩnɩ á paɩ dɩbam na zulǝ dɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: sɩ yaara yalʋ á na nɛ tɩn yɩ pa á wʋlʋwʋlʋ joori kwaga. Abam tɩtɩ maŋɩ á ye nɩ dɩbam maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ na yaara yam kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Dɩbam dɛɛn ta na wʋ abam tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ brɩ abam nɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ bɛɛsɩ dɩbam. Kʋ nan sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ nɩ abam na maŋɩ á ye kʋ ni nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Abam liǝ na tiini ya jɩgɩ-nɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ a tʋŋɩ Timoti abam tee nɩ, sɩ o ba o nii á daa ta tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ á wʋ maama na, a na kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ sʋtaanɩ wʋ́ zɩgɩ dɩ ba dɩ ganɩ abam sɩ á ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ nɩ sɩ kʋ pa dɩ́ tɩtʋŋa yam maama ji kafɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ, Timoti laan joori o ba dɩbam te, yɩ o pa dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa pǝni tɩga nɩ. O tagɩ o wɩ, á ta tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ á wʋ maama dɩ sono. O daa ta tagɩ o wɩ, á tiini á jɩgɩ dɩbam wʋbʋŋa dɩ wʋpolo, yɩ á lagɩ sɩ á na dɩbam nɩ dɩbam dɩ na lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ na abam te tɩn.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ na ni nɩ á tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ á wʋ maama tɩn, kʋ pɛ dɩ́ bɩcara pǝni tɩga nɩ, yɩ dɩ́ na baarɩ dɩ́ yaara dɩ dɩ́ cana yam maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Lele kʋntʋ, dɩ́ laan ŋwɩ dɩ wʋpolo á na zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɔgɩm dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Dɩ́ bá wanɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ Tu Wɛ le dɩ́ ti abam ŋwaanɩ, dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ na nɛ wʋpolo kʋlʋ zanzan DƖ yigǝ nɩ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi nan wʋ́ pa dɩbam cwǝŋǝ sɩ dɩ́ ba dɩ́ na abam.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ pa á sono kʋm puli zanzan kʋ ja gaalɩ, sɩ á taá soe á donnǝ dɩ nɔɔna maama lanyɩranɩ, nɩ dɩbam dɩ na soe abam te tɩn.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, oó pa á bɩcara kɩ dam, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo fasɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ yigǝ nɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba dɩ o kɔgɔ kʋm maama tɩn.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, kʋlʋ na daarɩ tɩn, dɩ́ loori abam dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi ŋwaanɩ sɩ á da cwǝŋǝ sɩ kʋ poli Wɛ wʋ. Dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam cwǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ, yɩ á tɔgɩ-ka dɩ zɩm maama. Dɩ́ nan ta tiini dɩ́ loori abam sɩ á kwaanɩ sɩ kʋ dwǝni á na maŋɩ á kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Abam ye wǝǝnu tɩlʋ dɩ́ na brɩ abam yɩ tɩ yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ á taá yɩ te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: DƖ lagɩ sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo mʋ DƖ yigǝ nɩ, sɩ á yɩ taá boorǝ.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Á nan yɩ pa boorim wʋbʋŋa wanɩ abam, nɩ nɔɔna balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Kadiri laŋa nɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o kɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ o ko-bu wʋ tɩn, naa o joŋi kʋlʋ na yɩ o ko-bu nyɩm tɩn. Dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ kaanɩ abam lanyɩranɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na kɩ wo-zɔɔna yantʋ doŋ, dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ pa o na cam.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na vɩn dɩ́ na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nabiinǝ mʋ o vɩa, kʋ yɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na kɩ DƖ Joro kʋm abam bɩcara nɩ tɩn mʋ o vɩa.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ á na wʋ́ ta soe á ko-biǝ te tɩn, kʋ daa daɩ fɩfɩʋn sɩ dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam. Wɛ tɩtɩ maŋɩ DƖ brɩ abam á na wʋ́ ta soe daanɩ te.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, á sɩɩnɩ á soe á ko-biǝ balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Masɩdʋanɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ nan ta loori abam sɩ á tiini á taá soe daanɩ kʋ dwǝni faŋa.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá zʋʋrɩ daanɩ dɩ wʋ-zuru. Á taá nii á tɩtɩ baŋa nɩ. Nɔɔnʋ maama kwaanɩ o tʋŋɩ sɩ o na o ni-wʋdiu, nɩ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ ta abam te tɩn.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa balʋ na daɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna tɩn taa nɩgɩ abam lanyɩranɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa á daa bá tɩɩgɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na wʋ́ joori o ba te tɩn

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ na yɩ nɔɔna balʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn, dɩ́ lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ cɩga mʋ sɩ á daa yɩ taá bwɛa, sɩ á wʋ daa yɩ cɔgɩ tʋʋnɩ ŋwaanɩ, nɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn na ba jɩgɩ tɩɩna te tɩn.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Dɩbam sɛ nɩ Zezi tɩgɩ mʋ, yɩ o laan joori o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ na yɩ balʋ na sɛ-o yɩ ba tɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ pa ba taa wʋ Zezi tee nɩ.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ na brɩ abam kʋlʋ tɩn yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm kwǝrǝ mʋ. Dɛ dɩm dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn, dɩbam balʋ na daarɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ dɩ́ ta ŋwɩ tɩn bá loori balʋ na maŋɩ ba tɩ tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ wʋ́ ba dɩ́ ni kwǝrǝ na bagɩ wɛyuu nɩ, dɩ malɛsɩ pɛ wʋm kwǝrǝ, dɩdaanɩ Wɛ nabɔn-zɔŋɔ kʋm wum, yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩtɩ zɩgɩ wɛyuu nɩ o tu. Balʋ na sɛ Zezi Krisi yɩ ba tɩ tɩn wʋ́ da yigǝ ba bi ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Wɛ laan wʋ́ pa dɩbam balʋ na daarɩ yɩ dɩ́ daa ta ŋwɩ tɩn la daanɩ dɩ bantʋ, yɩ DƖ zǝŋi dɩbam kunkwǝǝnu wʋnɩ sɩ dɩ́ vu dɩ́ jeeri dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wɛyuu nɩ. Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta wʋ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tee nɩ maŋa maama.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam daa ba taá lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ brɩ abam maŋa kalʋ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ na wʋ́ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ abam tɩtɩ maŋɩ á ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dɛ dɩm lagɩ dɩ ba dɩ darɩ nɔɔna mʋ, nɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ na yǝni o ba tɩtɩɩ nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ nɔɔna na tɛ ba wɩ yazurǝ wʋra yɩ ywǝǝni wʋra tɩn, kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ mʋ cam wʋ́ da dɩ ba ba baŋa, yɩ ba bá lu. Kʋʋ́ ta nyɩ dɩ kaanɩ pugǝ na dɛ ka vri yɩ ka wɔɛ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam nan daa tǝri lim wʋnɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dɛ dɩm bá ba dɩ darɩ abam nɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ te.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Abam maama wʋ Wɛ pooni wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ á tɩtʋŋa maama kɩ wɩa nɩ jaja. Dɩbam daɩ tɩtɩɩ nɔɔna, dɩ́ tɩtʋŋa dɩ nan daɩ lim tɩtʋŋa.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Tɩtɩɩ nɩ mʋ nɔɔna yǝni ba dɔa, yɩ badonnǝ nyɔ ba bugǝ.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, á taá kwe daanɩ sɩ kʋ pa á bɩcara taa tigi jǝgǝ dɩdʋa, sɩ á fɔgɩ á zǝni daanɩ dɩ baarɩ nɩ á na maŋɩ á kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ nan loori abam sɩ á taá nɩgɩ nɔɔna balʋ na tʋŋɩ dɩ abam yɩ ba nii abam baŋa nɩ yɩ ba kwe abam dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Á taá zuli-ba lanyɩranɩ dɩ sono ba tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ. Á pa ywǝǝni ta wʋ á tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ loori abam sɩ á taá kaanɩ yawɔrɩ-nyɩna, sɩ á pa balʋ na kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ tɩn na baarɩ, sɩ á taá zǝni nabwǝnǝ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Á taá yɩrɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ ma lwarɩm o joori o ma o ŋwɩ o doŋ lwarɩm. Maŋa maama sɩ á kwaanɩ á taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ á ko-biǝ dɩ nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo maŋa maama.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Á taá loori Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ maama na kɩa, sɩ á taá kɩ Wɛ le. Mʋ Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ á taá kɩ te, á na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Yɩ cʋ-na Wɛ Joro kʋm tɩtʋŋa.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Á nan maanɩ-na woŋo maama á nii. Kʋlʋ na lana tɩn sɩ á sɛ-kʋ.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Á nan fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ wo-balwaarʋ dwi maama.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ nɔɔna wʋ-zuru tɩn wʋ́ pa á taá yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo fasɩ, sɩ á ŋwɩa maama taa jɩgɩ cɩga, kʋ na yɩ á yɩra dɩ á jwǝǝru dɩ á wʋbʋŋa maama. Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi na tuǝ, á bá ta jɩgɩ digiru Wɛ yigǝ nɩ dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɩlʋ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. DƖ nan wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ DƖ zǝni abam kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, á taá loori Wɛ á pa dɩbam dɩ.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam maama lanyɩranɩ dɩ sono.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a loori abam dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ sɩ á karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ á brɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam maama.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli dɩdaanɩ Silasɩ dɩ Timoti mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ sɩ dɩ́ pa abam Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ Tesaloniki nɩ yɩ á yɩ dɩ́ Ko Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Tesaloniki tiinǝ na tɔgɩ Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le maŋa maama abam ŋwaanɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ na maŋɩ te tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi kʋ ja gaalɩ, yɩ á maama tiini á soe daanɩ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ á sono kʋm wʋra kʋ puli zanzan.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ tɛ á taanɩ dɩ́ brɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm na wʋ jǝgǝ kalʋ maama nɩ tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋpolo abam ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ tɛ dɩ ba nɩ, nɔɔna bɛɛsɩ abam yɩ ba yaarɩ abam zanzan, yɩ á daa ta zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ pu-dɩa, yɩ á kwǝri á tɔgɩ Zezi dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ jaja nɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ di nabiinǝ sarɩya dɩ cɩga mʋ. DƖ wʋ́ pa á na cɩga, yɩ á maŋɩ sɩ á tɔgɩ á wǝli DƖ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ abam sɩɩnɩ á na yaara Wɛ paarɩ dɩm kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ́ kɩ abam cɩga, yɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa balʋ na yaarɩ abam tɩn joori ba na cam.

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: DƖ ma wʋ́ daarɩ DƖ pa abam balʋ na yaarɩ tɩn dɩ dɩbam maama na siun, maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba sɩ nabiinǝ maama na-o tɩn. Wʋntʋ wʋ́ nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ dɩ o malɛsɩ dɩdɛɛra bam,

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: yɩ min-vwɩ zaŋɩ sɩ kaagɩ-ba. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi wʋ́ pa balʋ na vɩn Wɛ yɩ ba wʋ sɛ wʋm kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn na cam.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ wʋ́ na cam nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ dɩ ba te tɩn. Baá na lɛɛrʋ tɩlʋ na ba ti tɩn. Baá pɔɔrɩ-ba ba yɩra, yɩ ba taa baŋwɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm, yɩ ba daa bá na o paarɩ dam-fɔrɔ zulǝ yam.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maama wʋ́ ba kʋ kɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn. Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ, oó na zulǝ o tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam tee nɩ. Balʋ maama na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn wʋ́ pa-o tiǝ zanzan. Abam nan wʋ́ ta wʋ bantʋ wʋnɩ dɩ á na sɛ Wɛ cɩga kalʋ dɩ́ na brɩ abam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ yǝni dɩ́ loori dɩ́ Tu Wɛ maŋa maama dɩ́ pa abam, sɩ DƖ pa á maŋɩ dɩ DƖ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm, nɩ DƖ na kuri abam sɩ á taá yɩ te tɩn. Dɩ́ loori-DƖ sɩ DƖ pa abam dam, sɩ á wanɩ á kɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ á wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn maama, sɩ á taá kɩ tɩtʋŋa yalʋ maama na lana tɩn, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi taa naɩ zulǝ abam tee nɩ, yɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ na zulǝ, dɩ́ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi na pɛ abam yu-yoŋo tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Á yɩ zaŋɩ á pa á wʋbʋŋa vugimi, dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na tɛ ba wɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi dɛ dɩm maŋɩ dɩ yi tɩn. Nɔɔna na tɛ dɩ abam ba wɩ, Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ brɩ kʋntʋ, naa ba na wɩ kʋ yɩ dɩbam taanɩ mʋ, naa ba na pɛ abam tɔnɔ yɩ ba wɩ kʋ nuŋi dɩbam tee mʋ,

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: A ya na wʋ abam tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, a maŋɩ a brɩ abam wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ. Á nan wʋ guli-tɩ na?

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Kǝm-lwaanʋ dam dɩlʋ na sǝgi nɔɔna yiǝ nɩ tɩn maŋɩ dɩ wʋra dɩ cɔgɩ nabiinǝ. Kʋ nan na yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋra o cʋ kǝm-lwaanʋ tɩm cwǝŋǝ lele sɩ tɩ yɩ kɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu wʋ́ ba o viiri.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ, kǝm-balwaarʋ tu wʋm laan wʋ́ brɩ o tɩtɩ jaja. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o laan wʋ́ ma o ni-viu o cɔgɩ wʋntʋ fasɩ. Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba dɩ dam-fɔrɔ tɩn, mʋ o laan wʋ́ cɔgɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tu wʋm.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kǝm-balwaarʋ tu wʋm na wʋ́ ba tɩn, oó joŋi dam-fɔrɔ sʋtaanɩ tee nɩ o ma kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dwi tǝri tǝri ya na daɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: O ma wʋ́ kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ dwi maama o ma ganɩ balʋ na wʋ́ ga ba ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn. Kʋʋ́ kɩ-ba kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba ba sɛ sɩ ba joŋi Wɛ cɩga kam dɩ sono, sɩ kʋ pa DƖ vrɩ-ba ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na wʋ sɛ DƖ cɩga kam yɩ ba daarɩ ba soe kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ di ba taanɩ yɩ ba na cam. Wɛ na kuri dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna te tɩn

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ Wɛ le maŋa maama abam ŋwaanɩ, á na yɩ balʋ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm na soe tɩn. Kʋ zɩgɩ pulim nɩ mʋ Wɛ kuri abam sɩ DƖ vrɩ abam DƖ yagɩ. DƖ mɛ DƖ Joro kʋm dam mʋ DƖ pa á ji DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna, dɩ á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ cɩga kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá yɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ dɛ dɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩ́ na tɔɔlɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, sɩ DƖ pa á tɔgɩ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi á na zulǝ.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi dɩdaanɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ soe dɩbam yɩ DƖ pa dɩbam yu-yoŋo, dɩ DƖ na pɛ dɩ́ jɩgɩ baarɩ dɩlʋ na bá fɔgɩ dɩ ti tɩn, dɩdaanɩ tɩɩna yalʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ wʋ́ zǝni abam dɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna sɩ á taá jɩgɩ dam, sɩ á wanɩ á taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ á tɩtʋŋa dɩ á ni-taanɩ maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, kʋlʋ na daarɩ tɩn, á taá loori Wɛ á pa dɩbam, sɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam jagɩ ka yi je maama, sɩ nɔɔna sɛ-ka lanyɩranɩ nɩ abam dɩ na sɛ-ka te tɩn.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Loori-na Wɛ sɩ DƖ joŋi dɩbam nɔn-balwaarʋ jɩa nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ daɩ nɔɔna bam maama mʋ sɛ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nan yɩ cɩga tu mʋ, oó wǝli abam dɩ dam, yɩ o cɩ abam sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ dɩ yɩ cɔgɩ abam.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Á na yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɔɔna tɩn mʋ dɩ́ jɩgɩ abam cɩga sɩ á tɔgɩ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam kʋlʋ tɩn, yɩ á ta wʋ́ ta kɩ kʋntʋ nɩ dɩ́ na maŋɩ dɩ́ ta te tɩn.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ pa á wʋbʋŋa tiini ya zʋ Wɛ sono kʋm, yɩ o daarɩ o pa á zɩgɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ pu-dɩa nɩ Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ na zɩgɩ te tɩn. Yawɔrɩ-nyɩna kweǝ

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ kaanɩ abam dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ mʋ, sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ á ko-bu wʋlʋ maama na yɩ yawɔrɩ-nyɩm yɩ o ba tɔgɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ dɩ́ na brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Abam nan ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ á maŋɩ sɩ á lwǝni dɩbam tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn mʋ. Dɩ́ dɛɛn na wʋ á tee nɩ tɩn, dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ yawɔrɔ.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ wʋ joŋi wʋdiu nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tee nɩ kafɛ. Dɩ́ nan tiini dɩ́ tʋŋɩ mʋ yɩ kʋ cɛ dɩ́ yɩra wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ, sɩ dɩ́ yɩ yaarɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ wʋdiu ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ tagɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ ni nɩ abam badonnǝ yɩ yawɔrɩ-nyɩna mʋ. Ba ba lagɩ tɩtʋŋa, yɩ ba karɩ je maama ba kɩkarɩ ba donnǝ yiǝ.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ́ tɛ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ, yɩ dɩ́ kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba ja ba tɩtɩ cɩm ba tʋŋɩ, sɩ ba wanɩ ba nii ba tɩtɩ baŋa nɩ dɩ ba ni-wʋdiu.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ-ba, abam tɩtɩ nan yɩ zaŋɩ á bwǝni dɩ lanyɩranɩ kǝm.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na wʋ sɛ dɩ́ na pʋpʋnɩ te tɔnɔ kʋntʋ wʋnɩ dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn, sɩ á taá ye kʋntʋ tu, sɩ á wanɩ á ja á tɩtɩ dɩd-o, sɩ kʋ pa cavɩɩra ja-o.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Á nan yɩ pa o ji á dʋm. Á taá kaan-o nɩ á ko-bu te.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩ wʋ-zuru tu mʋ, yɩ oó pa abam taá jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru maŋa maama woŋo maama wʋnɩ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩ abam maama.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Nmʋ yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ tɩtɩ bu mʋ te, n na sɛ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa nmʋ yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo, yɩ o daarɩ o duri nmʋ ŋwaŋa. Cʋ-na á tɩtɩ dɩ vwan karanyɩna tiinǝ bam zaasɩm dɩm

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam amʋ dɛɛn na maa ve Masɩdʋanɩ tɩn, a loori nmʋ sɩ n maŋɩ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ sɩ n kaanɩ nɔɔna balʋ na brɩ kʋlʋ na daɩ cɩga tɩn sɩ ba yagɩ.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: Nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n ta-ba sɩ ba yagɩ ba wʋbʋŋa sɩnswalɩ sɩlʋ na daɩ cɩga tɩn, sɩ ba daarɩ ba yagɩ ba kwǝ dwi natɔga kalʋ na ba jɩgɩ gurim je tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ paɩ nɔɔna magɩ kantɔgɔ mʋ kafɛ. Tɩ ba wǝli nɔɔna sɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ-DƖ.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ nan ywǝri cɩga kam kʋntʋ wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ bɩtarɩ sɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Ba lagɩ sɩ ba taa yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm karanyɩna tiinǝ mʋ. Ba tɩtɩ nan ba ni ba na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn kuri, yɩ ba yǝri ba na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋlʋ dɩ ba wʋ maama tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm lana dɩ wʋlʋ na ni tɩ kuri nɩ kʋ na maŋɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan ye nɩ, Wɛ na pɛ DƖ cullu tɩm tɩn, DƖ wʋ pɛ-tɩ nɔn-ŋʋna ŋwaanɩ. DƖ nan pɛ-tɩ balʋ na yɩ cullu cɔgɩna tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ, dɩdaanɩ vɩnvɩɩna dɩ balʋ yigǝ na tǝrǝ dɩ DƖ tɩn, dɩ wo-lwaanʋ kǝrǝ dɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ, dɩ balʋ na ba nɩgɩ-DƖ tɩn, dɩ balʋ dɩ na gʋ ba kwǝ naa ba niinǝ naa ba donnǝ tɩn mʋ,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: dɩ balʋ na boori tɩn, dɩ baara balʋ na maɩ ba donnǝ ba jiri kaana tɩn, dɩdaanɩ balʋ na cʋ ba jaanɩ nɔɔna dɩ dam ba yǝgi tɩn, dɩdaanɩ balʋ na fɔ vwan tɩn, dɩ balʋ na du dɩ Wɛ yɩ kʋ yagɩ kʋ daɩ cɩga tɩn. DƖ nan pɛ DƖ cullu tɩm balʋ maama na cɔgɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga yɩ dɩ tɔgɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam na brɩ te tɩn dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: Kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ nuŋi Wʋpolo Tu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ tɩn te mʋ, yɩ dɩntʋ kɩ-ka amʋ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ a taa tɛa. Pooli na kɩ Wɛ le DƖ zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi mʋ pɛ amʋ dam sɩ a taa tʋŋɩ a pa-o. A kɩ o le dɩdaanɩ o na nɛ nɩ amʋ jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa yɩ o lɩ-nɩ sɩ a taa tʋŋɩ a pa-o tɩn.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Faŋa tɩn, a dɛɛn yǝni a ŋɔɔnɩ a cɔgɩ Zezi yɩrɩ, yɩ a kwǝri a twɩ-o, yɩ a ta yaarɩ o nɔɔna bam. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, o nan ta duri a ŋwaŋa, bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ya wʋ sɛ-o yɩ kʋ pa a yǝri woŋo kʋlʋ a na jɩgɩ a kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi mʋ kɩ-nɩ yu-yoŋo zanzan kʋ ja gaalɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o pa a taa jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o dɩ sono, a na ŋwɩ dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Taanɩ dɩntʋ yɩ cɩga yɩ dɩ maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama sɛ-dɩ mʋ: «Zezi Krisi tu lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ o vrɩ nɔn-cɩcɔgɩrʋ mʋ ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ.» Amʋ nan mʋ kɩ lwarɩm a dwǝni nɔɔna maama,

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: yɩ Wɛ ta duri a ŋwaŋa sɩ kʋ pa Zezi Krisi brɩ o wʋ-zuru kʋm na yɩ te dɩ amʋ. O na tiini o kɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ amʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ nɔn-cɩcɔgɩrʋ tɩm yigǝ tu tɩn, kʋ yɩ maana mʋ kʋ paɩ nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ́ da a kwaga ba ba ba sɛ-o, sɩ ba daarɩ ba na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ pɛ wʋlʋ paarɩ na bá ti maŋa dɩ maŋa tɩn mʋ. DƖ yɩ ŋwɩa tu mʋ, ba ba na-DƖ dɩ yiǝ, yɩ DƖ ba jɩgɩ doŋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ zulǝ dɩ tiǝ taa wʋ DƖ tee nɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: A bu Timoti, a lagɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ sɩ n ta n tʋŋɩ n pa Wɛ, nɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn na tagɩ nmʋ taanɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, kwaanɩ n guli ba na tagɩ te tɩn sɩ n tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa lanyɩranɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ n na lagɩ n magɩ jara cɩga cɩga te tɩn.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Yimene dɩ Alɛsandrɩ mʋ tɔgɩ ba wʋ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ wʋnɩ. Amʋ nan yagɩ-ba sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ sɩ ba na cam, sɩ ba daa yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ a na lagɩ a da yigǝ a ta tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ. Á maŋɩ sɩ á taá loori Wɛ á pa nɔɔna maama. Loori-na Wɛ sɩ DƖ taa nii ba baŋa nɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá kɩ DƖ le ba ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na lamma yɩ kʋ poli Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ tɩn wʋ.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ mʋ lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama na vrɩm, sɩ ba kwǝri ba lwarɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ wʋra. Wʋlʋ dɩ na fɔgɩ nabiinǝ dɩ Wɛ daanɩ tɩn dɩ yɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na yɩ nabiinu tɩn.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ pɛ a ji DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ, sɩ a tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝrǝ kam a brɩ nɔɔna. Cɩga mʋ a ŋɔɔna, sɩ kʋ daɩ vwan. Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ-nɩ mʋ sɩ a taa brɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ, sɩ ba sɛ DƖ cɩga kam ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Amʋ lagɩ sɩ jǝgǝ maama baara taa warɩ Wɛ. Ba na zǝŋi ba jɩa wɛɛnɩ sɩ ba warɩ Wɛ, sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo mʋ, sɩ ba yɩ taa jɩgɩ ban-zɔŋɔ naa kantɔgɔ dɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kɩ kǝm-laarʋ mʋ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ ba yɩ kaana balʋ na sɛ Wɛ cɩga cɩga tɩn.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ sɛ sɩ kaana taa brɩ baara naa ba taa te-ba. Ba maŋɩ sɩ ba taa je cɩm mʋ.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Kʋ dɛɛn daɩ Adam mʋ sʋtaanɩ ganɩ, kʋ yɩ kaanɩ wʋm mʋ dɩ ganɩ dɩ pa o vɩn Wɛ ni.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ te kaana lʋrɩ dɩ cam, Wɛ nan wʋ́ vrɩ-ba, dɩ ba na sɛ ba tɔgɩ Wɛ dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ sono dɩ wʋ-poŋo yɩ ba jɩgɩ ba tɩtɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Taanɩ dɩntʋ sɩɩnɩ dɩ yɩ cɩga mʋ: «Nɔɔnʋ na lagɩ sɩ o ji Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ tu, kʋntʋ tu lagɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋm mʋ.»

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: O nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ sa-nyɔrʋ naa najajarʋ naa nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ banɩ na lʋmma tɩn. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ nɔn-yoŋo mʋ dɩ nɔɔnʋ maama. O nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ sǝbu-swǝn-nyɩm.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: O maŋɩ sɩ o taa waɩ o nii o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ baŋa nɩ mʋ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o pa o biǝ sɛ-o dɩ zulǝ yalʋ na maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ na warɩ o nii o tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ tiinǝ baŋa nɩ, oó kɩ ta mʋ o nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ nɔn-dʋʋrʋ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ o yɩ zaŋɩ o ba o zǝŋi o tɩtɩ, sɩ Wɛ di o taanɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ DƖ na di sʋtaanɩ taanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ ya na sǝgi yɩ Wɛ laan vɩɩrɩ-ba DƖ taanɩ dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn, ba na ye ba bɩcarɩ nɩ nɩ kʋ lamma tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na lagɩ sɩ o ji Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm zǝnzǝnnu, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba da yigǝ ba maan-o mʋ ba nii, o na ba jɩgɩ wo-lɔŋɔ, sɩ ba laan pa o puli o tɩtʋŋa.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba kaana dɩ taa yɩ balʋ nɔɔna na nɩgɩ tɩn mʋ, sɩ ba yɩ taa yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna. Ba maŋɩ sɩ ba taa yɩrɩ ba tɩtɩ mʋ, sɩ nɔɔna taa jɩgɩ ba cɩga woŋo maama baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm zǝnzǝnnu maŋɩ sɩ o taa jɩgɩ kaanɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ, sɩ o daarɩ o taa waɩ o nii o biǝ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama baŋa nɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ zǝnzǝnnu wʋlʋ maama na tʋŋɩ o tɩtʋŋa lanyɩranɩ tɩn wʋ́ na zulǝ zanzan nɔɔna tee nɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o na baarɩ dɩ wʋpolo o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Amʋ bʋŋɩ sɩ a ba nmʋ te lele. A nan pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ a pa nmʋ sɩ,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: a na daanɩ fɩnfɩɩn, sɩ n wanɩ n lwarɩ n na wʋ́ ja Baŋa-Wɛ nɔɔna bam te. Bantʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi nɔɔna yɩ ba tɔgɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ. Bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ na kwaanɩ ba wǝli ba nii zaasɩm dɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn baŋa nɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ ywǝ na wǝli digǝ sɩ ka yɩ vi te tɩn.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ tɔgɩm yɩ wo-kamunu mʋ. Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ dɛɛn ya sǝgi mʋ, yɩ DƖ laan pa dɩ́ lwarɩ wʋlʋ wʋm DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn: Wʋntʋ mʋ jigi nabiinu o ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Wɛ Joro kʋm ma brɩ nɩ o yɩ cɩga tu. Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm ma na o zulǝ. Nɔɔna ma ja o kwǝrǝ ba zʋ dwi maama wʋ ba tɔɔlɩ. Lʋgʋ baŋa nabiinǝ ma sɛ-o. O ma zaŋɩ dɩ zulǝ o di Wɛ-sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm dɩ dɩbam Wɛ-loro kʋm mʋ kwɛ woŋo maama kʋ pa kʋ lana Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm na maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n ta wǝǝnu tɩntʋ mʋ n brɩ n ko-biǝ bam. N na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa n ta n yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋm. N na sɩɩnɩ n sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam taanɩ dɩm dɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga yɩ n maŋɩ n tɔgɩ-dɩ tɩn, nń bɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ n cǝgi sɩnswalɩ sɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri yɩ sɩ ba wǝli Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɩn. Nan tiini n kwaanɩ n ta n tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ paɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ tʋŋa, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ. Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ nɔɔna maama Vɩrnʋ, kʋ na fɔgɩ kʋ dwe dɩdɩ balʋ na sɛ-DƖ tɩn.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ta n brɩ nɔɔna bam wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ sɩ n zaasɩ-ba.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ n pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gooni-m n na yɩ bu tɩn ŋwaanɩ. N maŋɩ sɩ n ma n tɩtɩ mʋ n brɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam ba na wʋ́ ta kɩ te. Kʋ na yɩ nmʋ ni-ŋwaŋa dɩ n tɩtʋŋ-naga, dɩ n sono dɩ n na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn, dɩ n wʋ-poŋo maama mʋ n maŋɩ sɩ n ma n brɩ-ba.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Ta n kwaanɩ n karɩmɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm dɩ nɔɔna bam, sɩ n daarɩ n brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kam, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam a na wʋ́ ba tɩn.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ n yagɩ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ nmʋ, maŋa kalʋ DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn na tagɩ nmʋ taanɩ te yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam dɩ daŋɩ ba jɩa nmʋ baŋa nɩ ba warɩ Wɛ n ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Ta n yɩrɩ n tɩtɩ, sɩ n daarɩ n ta n yɩrɩ n zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ te tɩn dɩ. Kwaanɩ n zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ wʋnɩ, sɩ nmʋ tɩtɩ wʋ́ na vrɩm, yɩ n ta wʋ́ pa balʋ na cǝgi-m tɩn dɩ na vrɩm.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ n bagɩ nankwɩan dɩ baarɩ. N maŋɩ sɩ n kwe-o nɩ n ko mʋ te. Kʋ na yɩ nɔn-dʋnnʋ, n maŋɩ sɩ n kwe-ba nɩ n nyaana mʋ te.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ kazɩna, n maŋɩ sɩ n kwe-ba nɩ n niinǝ mʋ te. Kʋ na yɩ ka-bwǝnǝ, n maŋɩ sɩ n kwe-ba nɩ n nakwa mʋ te dɩ wʋ-poŋo. Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá zǝni kadǝnǝ te tɩn

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Ta n zuli kadǝnǝ balʋ na sɩɩnɩ ba ba jɩgɩ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, sɩ n ta n nii ba baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, kadǝm na jɩgɩ biǝ naa naarʋ, bantʋ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba taa nii-o, ba na yɩ o tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ tiinǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Mʋ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ zaasɩm dɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Kadǝm biǝ na zǝn-o kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa ba joori ba ŋwɩ ba tiinǝ jɩnɩ dɩ ba na yaarɩ ba ŋwaanɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ nan mʋ poli Wɛ wʋ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋlʋ na sɩɩnɩ o yɩ kadǝm yɩ o ba jɩgɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ sɩ o taa nii o baŋa nɩ tɩn tiŋi o tɩɩna Wɛ baŋa nɩ mʋ. Tɩtɩɩ dɩ wɩa maama o tiini o warɩ Wɛ mʋ yɩ o loori zǝnǝ DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kadǝm wʋlʋ na lagɩ sɩ o taa ŋwɩ paweeni wʋnɩ tɩn maŋɩ o tɩ mʋ yɩ o ta beerǝ.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Nan pa ba maama lwarɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ ni nɩ, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ wanɩ o na ba wo-lɔŋɔ o ta.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ yigǝ na tǝrǝ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ, kʋ na tiini kʋ dwe dɩdɩ dɩ o tɩtɩ digǝ tiinǝ, kʋntʋ tu yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ mʋ. O nan tiini o yɩ nɔn-balɔrɔ o dwe balʋ na maŋɩ ba ba tɔgɩ Wɛ tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: O maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔna taa ye o tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ni nɩ lanyɩranɩ. O na nii o biǝ baŋa nɩ lanyɩranɩ, naa o na jeeri vǝrǝ lanyɩranɩ, naa o na tu o tɩtɩ o zarɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam nɛ, naa o na zǝni balʋ na wʋ cam wʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ o na kwaanɩ o tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna dwi maama, abam waɩ á gar-o á wǝli da.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kadǝnǝ balʋ na yɩ ka-bwǝnǝ tɩn, abam wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á ga-ba á wǝli da. Bɛŋwaanɩ, bantʋ wʋbʋŋa daa na lǝni yɩ ba warɩ ba tɩtɩ ba ja, baá yagɩ ni dɩlʋ ba na goni dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn, yɩ ba daarɩ ba daa zʋ banna.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, á na pʋpʋnɩ kadǝnǝ balʋ na yɩ ka-bwǝnǝ tɩn á wǝli da, baá ji yawɔrɩ-nyɩna yɩ ba ta tʋlɩ sam. Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ yɩranɩ, baá ji bɩbarɩ-nyɩna dɩ ŋwaŋ-yɔɔrʋ tiinǝ, yɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na daɩ sɩ ba ya ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri amʋ bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋʋ́ ta lamma sɩ kadǝnǝ balʋ na yɩ ka-bwǝnǝ tɩn taa zʋʋrɩ banna sɩ ba lʋ biǝ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba taa nii ba tɩtɩ sam baŋa nɩ. Ba na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa dɩbam dʋna daa bá na cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ wo-lwaanʋ ba pa dɩbam.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kadǝnǝ badaara maŋɩ ba ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba tɔgɩ sʋtaanɩ.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Baarʋ naa kaanɩ wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ yɩ kadǝnǝ wʋ o sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn, wʋntʋ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa nii ba baŋa nɩ. Kʋ daɩ sɩ o yagɩ-ba o pa Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm. O na yagɩ-ba kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ yaarɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam kʋ pa ba daa bá wanɩ ba nii kadǝnǝ balʋ na ba jɩgɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tɩn baŋa nɩ. Kʋ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ nakwa tiinǝ bam te tɩn

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nmʋ na jɩgɩ nabɩa n ma n nwanɩ wo-vaalʋ, yɩ kɩ tampɔgɔ ka ni nɩ.» Kʋ ta tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Tɩntʋŋnʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa joŋi o ŋwɩɩrʋ mʋ.»

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na tagɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam wʋ nɔɔnʋ bɩtar-lwaŋa dɩ nmʋ, yɩ zaŋɩ n sɛ, kʋ na daɩ nɩ nɔɔna bale naa batɔ yi mʋ nɛ o kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nakwa balʋ na sɩɩnɩ ba kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn, sɩ n kaanɩ-ba ba maama yigǝ nɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa fʋʋnɩ ja badaara bam dɩ.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ a kaanɩ-m mʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi yigǝ nɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ malɛsɩ sɩm yigǝ nɩ, sɩ n yɔɔrɩ n sɛ kʋlʋ a na tagɩ tɩn. Yɩ kuri nɔɔna daanɩ, kɩ nɔɔnʋ maama te na maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Yɩ lɔgɩrɩ n daŋɩ n jɩa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ baŋa nɩ sɩ n pa o ji Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ. Yɩ zaŋɩ n pa nɔɔna kǝm-lwaanʋ loŋi-m. Fɔgɩ n ja n tɩtɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ sɩ, n wʋ kʋm na yǝni kʋ wɔɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ n ta n nyɔ sana fɩnfɩɩn sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ zǝni-m, sɩ n yɩ ta n nyɔ na yɩranɩ.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara wo-lwaanʋ tiini tɩ naɩ dɩ yi mʋ jaja, yɩ ba daa ta wʋ di bantʋ taanɩ. Kʋ daarɩ babam wo-lwaanʋ nan wʋ́ ba tɩ na kʋ kwaga nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ta yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ kǝm-laarʋ dɩ. Tɩ dɩ yɔɔrɩ tɩ naɩ dɩ yi mʋ jaja. Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, tɩlʋ na ba naɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn dɩ bá wanɩ tɩ sǝgi.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na yɩ gambɛ yɩ ba tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba taa paɩ ba yum tiinǝ bam zulǝ zanzan mʋ. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o cɔgɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ dɩdaanɩ dɩbam zaasɩm dɩm.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Gambɛ sɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ ba paɩ ba yum tiinǝ balʋ dɩ na tɔgɩ Wɛ tɩn, kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba taa gooni-ba ba na yɩ ba ko-biǝ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba taa tʋŋɩ lanyɩranɩ mʋ ba pa-ba, bɛŋwaanɩ ba yum tiinǝ balʋ ba na tʋŋɩ ba paɩ tɩn dɩ yɩ ba ko-bu-sonnu mʋ ba na tɔgɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, yɩ ba nii ba baŋa nɩ lanyɩranɩ. Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ cɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ dɩ vwan zaasɩm dɩ sǝbu-swǝnǝ Nii wǝǝnu tɩlʋ n na maŋɩ sɩ n brɩ nɔɔna bam sɩ ba taa kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na brɩ zaasɩm dɩdoŋ, yɩ o wʋ sɛ sɩ o tɔgɩ dɩbam Yuutu Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam dɩdaanɩ Wɛ cwǝ-laa zaasɩm dɩm,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: kʋntʋ tu kɩ fɔŋɔ mʋ yɩ o yǝri kʋlʋkʋlʋ. Wʋntʋ doŋ tiini o lagɩ sɩ o taa magɩ kantɔgɔ mʋ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn baŋa nɩ. Kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ dwi mʋ pa nɔɔna wʋrʋ gwɩɩna dɩ ba donnǝ, yɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna jaanɩ daanɩ yɩ ba twɩ daanɩ, yɩ ba ta bʋŋɩ lwarɩm ba pa daanɩ,

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: yɩ ba niǝ dɩ ba maŋɩ daanɩ. Ba yǝni ba kɩ kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ mʋ, yɩ ba daa ba tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ. Kʋ maa paɩ ba bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm yɩ woŋo kʋlʋ ba na wʋ́ na nadunni ka wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm jɩgɩ nadunni zanzan kʋ paɩ balʋ na kɩ wʋpolo dɩ kʋlʋ ba na jɩgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ba na lʋgɩ dɩbam tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ jaanɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ́ ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Dɩ́ nan ta bá wanɩ dɩ́ ja kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ dɩ́ viiri.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ balʋ na lagɩ sɩ ba ji nadunǝ tɩn, sǝbu-laga mʋ yǝni ka ganɩ-ba kʋ pa ba tʋ maŋɩm wʋnɩ. Kʋ maa paɩ ba fra zʋʋrɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ zanzan tɩlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ-ba tɩn. Kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ yǝni kʋ paɩ ba yáalɩ ba cɔgɩ.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ sǝbu-swǝnǝ mʋ yɩ lwarɩm dwi maama pulim je. Nɔɔna badaara wʋra ba na pɛ ba wʋbʋŋa zʋ sǝbu-lagɩ yɩ ba yagɩ Wɛ cɩga kam, kʋ pa ba jɩgɩ ba tɩtɩ ba yaarɩ zanzan.

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nmʋ Timoti na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, n maŋɩ sɩ n ja n tɩtɩ mʋ dɩdaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ. Kɩ n tɩtɩ n kɩ daanɩ sɩ n ta n tɔgɩ cɩga, sɩ n sɛ Wɛ ni, sɩ n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, sɩ n ta n jɩgɩ sono dɩ pu-dɩa dɩ wʋ-bono.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ dɛɛn zɩgɩ Pɔnsɩ Pilatɩ yigǝ nɩ o pa o lwarɩ nɩ wʋm tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam mʋ. A nan lagɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ Zezi yigǝ nɩ, dɩdaanɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ woŋo dwi maama ŋwɩa tɩn yigǝ nɩ,

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ na maŋɩ tɩn na yiǝ, Wʋpolo Tu Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ yɩranɩ na yɩ dam-fɔrɔ tu tɩn laan wʋ́ pa Zezi Krisi joori o ba. Wɛ mʋ yɩ pwa maama Pɛ dɩ yum tiinǝ maama Yuutu.

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ yɩranɩ mʋ ŋwɩ maŋa kalʋ na ba jɩgɩ pulim dɩ gurim tɩn. DƖ nan zʋʋrɩ pooni dɩlʋ na tiini dɩ daga tɩn wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o twɛ da. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na nɛ-DƖ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan daa ta bá wanɩ o na-DƖ. Dɩntʋ mʋ maŋɩ tiǝ dɩ zulǝ dɩ dam dɩlʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na yɩ nadunǝ lʋgʋ kʋntʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, n maŋɩ sɩ n kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba yɩ taa bʋŋɩ kamunni ba pa ba tɩtɩ. Ba wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba tɩɩgɩ ba jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ tɩ nyɩ dɩ viu mʋ. Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba kwe ba wʋbʋŋa maama ba pa Wɛ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩntʋ mʋ yǝni DƖ pa dɩbam woŋo maama yɩ kʋ yi dɩbam, sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ́ di ywǝǝni.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ-ba sɩ ba taa kɩ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ ba tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ji ba nadunni, sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ wʋ-yoŋo sɩ ba taa ma ba wǝǝnu tɩm ba zǝni daanɩ.

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: Ba na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋ brɩ nɩ ba tiŋi ba nadunni cɩga cɩga mʋ ba pa ba tɩtɩ jwa ŋwaanɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa ba na ŋwɩa kalʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara mʋ wʋra ba na paɩ ba jɩgɩ yi-pʋrʋ kʋm kʋntʋ, yɩ kʋ laan pa ba ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli na yɩ Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ a pa nmʋ Timoti. Wɛ tɩtɩ mʋ kuri-nɩ dɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a taa yɩ DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ, sɩ a pa nɔɔna lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ goni ni sɩ DƖ pa-ba ŋwɩa, ba na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Nmʋ Timoti yɩ a bu-sono mʋ. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa nmʋ yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ duri nmʋ ŋwaŋa. Pooli na kɩ Wɛ le yɩ o pa Timoti na baarɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan kɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ a na tʋŋɩ a pa-DƖ yɩ a ye a bɩcarɩ nɩ nɩ kʋ lamma tɩn le, nɩ a nabaara bam dɩ dɛɛn na tʋŋɩ ba pa-DƖ te tɩn. A maa yǝni a loori-DƖ maŋa maama wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ, yɩ a guli nmʋ gulǝ a Wɛ-loro kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ swe nɩ n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi cɩga cɩga, nɩ n nu-nakwɩ Loyisi dɩ n nu Yunisi dɩ dɛɛn na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi te tɩn. A ye lanyɩranɩ nɩ nmʋ dɩ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a lagɩ sɩ n guli a dɛɛn na daŋɩ a jɩa nmʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ Wɛ pa nmʋ zǝnǝ yalʋ tɩn. Nan fɔgɩ n nii pɛɛrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ n ta n ma n tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ daa bá ta kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, Wɛ na zǝni dɩbam dɩ DƖ Joro kʋm tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ paɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ baarɩ dɩ sono, yɩ dɩ́ waɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ dɩ́ jaana.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Yɩ ta n kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ n ta dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi cɩga kam n brɩ nɔɔna. Yɩ pa fʋʋnɩ zʋ-m dɩ ba na kɩ amʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ Zezi cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ n dɩ sɛ yaara mʋ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam zaasɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa-m baarɩ yaara yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ mʋ vrɩ dɩbam yɩ DƖ bǝŋi dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna, sɩ kʋ daɩ dɩbam tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ mʋ maŋɩ DƖ lɩ wʋbʋŋa kʋ loori lʋgʋ pulim, sɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ na vrɩm zaanɩ.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Wɛ laan mʋ nan pɛ dɩ́ na DƖ zaanɩ dɩm kʋntʋ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ Zezi Krisi na tu lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ cɔgɩ tʋʋnɩ dam, yɩ o daarɩ o tɔgɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ o pa dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na bá ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ pɛ a ji DƖ tɩntʋŋnʋ sɩ a taa tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ, sɩ a brɩ nɔɔna DƖ cɩga kam.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a nɛ yaara yam kʋntʋ. A nan ba kwarɩ cavɩɩra. Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ye nɩ a kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi mʋ, yɩ a ye nɩ wʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o nii kʋlʋ maama Wɛ na kwe DƖ kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ tɩn baŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ taa ve dɛ dɩm o na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Nan fɔgɩ n ta n tɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ a na maŋɩ a brɩ nmʋ tɩn sɩ n ma n zaasɩ nɔɔna, sɩ n kwǝri n ta n jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ sono n na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ n ta n nii cɩga kalʋ Wɛ na kwe DƖ kɩ nmʋ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn baŋa nɩ dɩ Wɛ Joro kʋlʋ na ŋwɩ dɩbam wʋnɩ tɩn dam, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ cɔgɩ-ka.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Nmʋ maŋɩ n ye nɩ Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Azi tɩɩnɩ dɩm nɩ tɩn joori amʋ kwaga nɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ Fizɛɛlɩ dɩ Ɛrmɔzɛnɩ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ́ duri Onisifɔɔrɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ maama ŋwaŋa, bɛŋwaanɩ wʋntʋ mʋ yǝni o paɩ a jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru. Ba na kɩ-nɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn, o wʋ kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ o zǝni-nɩ.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: O nan na tu o yi Rom maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o tiini o kwaanɩ o beeri amʋ je mʋ taan, yɩ o laan ba o na-nɩ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ́ duri o ŋwaŋa sarɩya dɛ dɩm nɩ. Nmʋ maŋɩ n ye lanyɩranɩ Onisifɔɔrɩ na tiini o zǝni amʋ te Efɛɛzɩ nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: A bu Timoti, ta n zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ Zezi Krisi na pɛ nmʋ yu-yoŋo yɩ n ŋwɩ dɩd-o tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Cɩga kalʋ maama a na yǝni a brɩ nmʋ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maama yigǝ nɩ tɩn, n dɩ ma-ka n brɩ nɔɔna balʋ na tɔgɩ cɩga tɩn, sɩ ba dɩ daa wanɩ ba maa brɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ ba wǝli da.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na tʋŋɩ n pa Zezi Krisi tɩn, n maŋɩ sɩ n dɩ sɛ yaara mʋ, nɩnɛɛnɩ pamaŋ-ŋʋm na sɛ yaara te tɩn.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na yɩ pamaŋnʋ yɩ o lagɩ sɩ o poli o yuutu wʋ, o daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na daɩ pamaŋna tɩtʋŋa tɩn.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Kʋ ta nyɩ dɩ nɔɔnʋ na yɩ valʋ yɩ o tiini o tʋŋɩ te tɩn mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ o da yigǝ o na o wo-vaalʋ tɩm biǝ.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Bʋŋɩ n nii a na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi wʋ́ pa n lwarɩ woŋo maama kuri n ti.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Ta n guli Zezi Krisi na yɩ Pɛ Davidi dwi tu tɩn gulǝ. Wʋntʋ mʋ bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, nɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ a na yǝni a tɔɔlɩ tɩn na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Amʋ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ pɛ a wʋ yaara wʋnɩ, yɩ ba vɔ-nɩ dɩ capʋnnʋ nɩ a yɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ mʋ te. Ba nan bá wanɩ ba cɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam sɩ ka yɩ jagɩ.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ a sɛ yaara dwi maama, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ wǝli nɔɔna balʋ Wɛ na kuri sɩ ba taa yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn, sɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ ba na vrɩm dɩ zulǝ yalʋ na bá ti tɩn.
