english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Taanɩ dɩlʋ a na lagɩ a ta tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ: Dɩ́ na tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi dɩ́ tɩ, dɩ́ ta wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ na ŋwɩa.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na fɔgɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ cam wʋnɩ, dɩ́ wʋ́ tɔgɩ dɩd-o dɩ́ di paarɩ. Dɩ́ nan na vɩ-o, o dɩ wʋ́ vɩn dɩbam mʋ.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan na maŋɩ dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ cɩga, wʋntʋ ta yɩ cɩga tu mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ wʋm ba joori o kwanɩ o ni. Dɩ́ na wʋ́ ta tʋŋɩ te sɩ kʋ poli Wɛ wʋ tɩn

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Ta n guli amʋ zaasɩm dɩm n brɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam, sɩ n daarɩ n kaanɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ dɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ, sɩ ba yɩ taa magɩ kantɔgɔ kʋlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn bɩtarɩ baŋa nɩ, sɩ kʋ cɔgɩ balʋ dɩ na cǝgi tɩn wʋbʋŋa mʋ.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ n tʋŋɩ dɩ yawala sɩ kʋ poli Wɛ wʋ, sɩ cavɩɩra yɩ ja-m DƖ yigǝ nɩ dɩ kʋlʋ n na tʋŋɩ tɩn, sɩ n kwaanɩ n ta n brɩ nɔɔna Wɛ cɩga kam lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Ja n tɩtɩ dɩ bɩtar-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ na ba wǝli Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɩn. Balʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ-sɩ tɩn paɩ nɔɔna fɔgɩ ba joori ba maŋɩ kwaga nɩ mʋ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Ba na karɩ ba brɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, tɩ wʋ́ loŋi tɩ jagɩ je maama, nɩnɛɛnɩ nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ nasɩncɔgɔ yɩ kʋ woori kʋ wǝli da te tɩn. Yimene dɩ Filɛtɩ mʋ tɔgɩ ba wʋ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Ba tusi cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ, Wɛ daa bá bi nɔɔna DƖ pa ba yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, sɩ twa biim maŋɩ kʋ kɛ. Ba zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ ma pa balʋ na sɛ Wɛ tɩn badonnǝ wʋbʋŋa joori ya lǝni.

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ sɔ-fɔrɔ wʋnɩ kabǝli dɩ zwɩ dwi tǝri tǝri na wʋra te tɩn mʋ. Sɩdonnǝ yɩ can-na mʋ ba mɛ ba kɩ, dɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa. Sɩntʋ yɩ lʋnnɩ nyɩm mʋ. Sɩdonnǝ maa yɩ dɛ naa dɔgɔ mʋ ba mɛ ba kɩ, yɩ ba maɩ sɩntʋ mʋ ba tʋŋa.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na jɩgɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm kʋntʋ, kʋ tu wʋ́ ta yɩ lʋnnɩ nyɩm mʋ Wɛ tee nɩ. O yɩ wʋlʋ na kwe o tɩtɩ o kɩ o yuutu wʋm jɩŋa nɩ yɩ o jɩgɩ kuri o pa-o tɩn mʋ. O maŋɩ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna yalʋ maama o yuutu wʋm na lagɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, cʋ n tɩtɩ dɩ kǝm-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nɔn-dʋnnʋ wʋbʋŋa na yǝni ya zʋʋrɩ tɩn, sɩ n daarɩ n kwaanɩ n tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ sono dɩ wʋ-zuru, sɩ n ta n tɔgɩ dɩ balʋ bɩcara na lana yɩ ba sɛ nɩ ba yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na yɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ najajarʋ. O maŋɩ sɩ o taa nɩgɩ nɔɔna maama lanyɩranɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o brɩ-ba cɩga dɩ wʋ-zuru.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: O nan maŋɩ sɩ o zaasɩ balʋ na vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn dɩ wʋ-bono mʋ, sɩ kʋ waɩ kʋ kɩ sɩ Wɛ pa ba lǝni ba wʋbʋŋa sɩ ba joori ba sɛ DƖ cɩga kam.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, ba swan laan wʋ́ joori yɩ ba wanɩ ba vrɩ ba tɩtɩ sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ, dɩ ya na jaanɩ-ba nɩ cɩkʋ te yɩ dɩ pa ba kɩ dɩ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Ta n ye nɩ lʋgʋ tiim maŋa nɩ lɛɛrʋ zanzan wʋ́ ba lʋgʋ baŋa.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bá ta soe daanɩ, yɩ ba bá ta jɩgɩ da-ŋwaŋa. Baá ta yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna yɩ ba ba lagɩ sɩ ba ja ba tɩtɩ, baá ta yɩ wʋ-lʋn-nyɩna, yɩ baá ta culi wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na lamma tɩn.

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wʋ́ ta tusi ba cilonnǝ, yɩ ba bá ta zuri ba yɩra dɩ lwarɩm kǝm. Baá ta magɩ ba nyɔɔna ba brɩ ba tɩtɩ kamunni. Baá ta soe ba wʋbʋŋa wǝǝnu ba dwe Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ wʋ́ ta kɩ nɩ ba tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam mʋ te, yɩ Wɛ dam nan tǝri ba tee nɩ. Fɔgɩ n cɩ n tɩtɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ badaara yǝni ba sǝgi ba zʋʋrɩ sam mʋ ba ganɩ kaana balʋ na yɩ ka-kayɛ tɩn ba pa ba wʋbʋŋa cɔga. Kaana bam kʋntʋ wʋ cɔgɩ dɩ ba kǝm-balwaarʋ zanzan, yɩ ba wʋbʋŋa paɩ ba tɔgɩ woŋo kʋlʋ maama ba fra na zʋ tɩn.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Kaana bam kʋntʋ tiini ba kwaanɩ ba zaasɩ mʋ maŋa maama, yɩ ba nan ba fɔgɩ ba lwarɩ cɩga.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ kǝm dɩm nyɩ dɩ Zanɛsɩ dɩ Zambrɛsɩ dɛɛn na vɩn Moyisi ni faŋa faŋa te tɩn mʋ. Ba dɩ vɩn Wɛ cɩga kam mʋ. Ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ mʋ, yɩ ba Wɛ tɔgɩm dɩm yɩ kafɛ.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ba nan daa bá wanɩ ba vu yigǝ dɩ ba gana yam. Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna maama wʋ́ ba lwarɩ ba jwǝrim dɩm jaja, nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ dɛɛn na kɩ Zanɛsɩ dɩ Zambrɛsɩ te tɩn. Wɛ cɩga kam na jɩgɩ zǝnǝ lanyɩranɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ nmʋ Timoti, n maŋɩ n ye amʋ zaasɩm dɩm dɩ a ŋwɩa dɩ a wʋbʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn. Nmʋ nan ta ye a na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn, yɩ n ta ye a na jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru dɩ sono dɩ pu-dɩa dɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, balʋ maama na lagɩ sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ cɩga tɩn dɩ wʋ́ na bɛɛsɩm.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ dɩ kampin-nyɩna bam, bantʋ lwarɩm dɩm wʋ́ tiini dɩ puli kʋ ja gaalɩ. Baá ta ganɩ nɔɔna, yɩ baá ganɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ nmʋ, yɔɔrɩ n ta n tɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ nmʋ na maŋɩ n lwarɩ yɩ n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ ka tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ ye balʋ dɛɛn na brɩ-m wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn wʋ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: N biini nɩ mʋ n maŋɩ n ye Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ vɩɩrɩ-m yɩ n na swan yalʋ na wʋ́ pa n na vrɩm, n na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ maama na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ Joro mʋ pɛ dɩbam yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ kuri kʋ pa dɩbam, sɩ kʋ taa brɩ nɔɔna cɩga, naa kʋ brɩ-ba nɩ ba tusi, naa kʋ kwe-ba sɩ ba da cwǝŋǝ, naa kʋ zaasɩ-ba ba na wʋ́ ta tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ te tɩn,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: sɩ dɩbam balʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna tɩn laan yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ fasɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna dwi maama.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Timoti, a lagɩ a ta nmʋ Wɛ dɩ Zezi Krisi yigǝ nɩ, sɩ n kwaanɩ n ta n tɔɔlɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Zezi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ ba o di naŋʋna dɩ twa maama sarɩya tɩn. Oó joori o ba o di paarɩ nɔɔna tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, n maŋɩ sɩ n ta n tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Nɔɔna na cǝgi naa ba zɩ ba cǝgi dɩ, sɩ n ta n kwaanɩ n brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kam. Nan pa ba lwarɩ nɩ ba tusi mʋ sɩ ba joori ba tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ, sɩ n kaanɩ-ba, sɩ n daarɩ n pa ba taa jɩgɩ baarɩ, sɩ n ta n brɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ dɩ wʋ-zuru zanzan.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ maŋa wʋ́ ba, yɩ nɔɔna daa bá sɛ ba taa cǝgi zaasɩm dɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn. Ba laan wʋ́ daarɩ ba taa tɔgɩ ba tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn mʋ, yɩ baá kikili vwan karanyɩna tiinǝ zanzan sɩ ba taa brɩ-ba wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama ba na lagɩ sɩ ba taa ni tɩn.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ nmʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ n ja n tɩtɩ mʋ wǝǝnu maama wʋnɩ. Vɔ n wʋ yaara wʋnɩ. Kwaanɩ n ta n tʋŋɩ sɩ n pa nɔɔna lwarɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam. Tɩtʋŋɩ dɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ nmʋ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn, sɩ n tʋŋɩ-dɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ, amʋ ŋwɩa kam nyɩ nɩ ba na logi mun-na ba ma kɩ kaanɩm te tɩn mʋ. Kʋ lagɩ kʋ ta nɩ maŋa kam yiǝ sɩ a vu Wɛ te.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ pɛɛrɩ laan tigi Wɛ tee nɩ dɩ cǝgi-nɩ. Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ tɔgɩ cɩga o ma di nabiinǝ taanɩ tɩn. O ma wʋ́ kwe a pɛɛrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ o pa-nɩ sarɩya dɛ dɩm nɩ. Kʋ nan daɩ amʋ yɩranɩ mʋ oó pa pɛɛrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ. Oó pa balʋ maama dɩ na so-o yɩ ba jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ oó joori o ba tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Nan kwaanɩ lanyɩranɩ sɩ n ba amʋ te lɩla.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Demasɩ yagɩ amʋ, o fra na tiini ya zʋ zɩm lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o vu Tesaloniki mʋ. Kresan ma kɛ Galatɩ. Titi dɩ ma kɛ Dalɩmatɩ.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luki yɩranɩ mʋ wʋ a tee nɩ. Nmʋ nan na maa n bɩɩna, sɩ n pa Marɩkɩ tɔgɩ o ba, bɛŋwaanɩ wʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o wǝli-nɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ amʋ tʋŋɩ Tisiki Efɛɛzɩ nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na maa n bɩɩna, sɩ n kwe a gɔrɔ kʋm a na yagɩ Trʋasɩ nɩ Karɩpusi tee nɩ tɩn n ja n ba, dɩdaanɩ twaanʋ tɩm dɩ, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ vara twaanʋ tɩlʋ ba na pʋpʋnɩ tɩ wʋnɩ ba pri tɩn.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Alɛsandrɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ yarʋ tɩn tiini o kɩ amʋ lwarɩm kʋ ja gaalɩ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nan wʋ́ pa o na cam o kǝnǝ yam kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: N dɩ nan cʋ n tɩtɩ dɩd-o, bɛŋwaanɩ o kwaanɩ sɩ o cɔgɩ dɩbam na yǝni dɩ́ brɩ cɩga kalʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ a na puli sɩ a tʋlɩ a taanɩ dɩm sarɩya yam jǝgǝ kam nɩ tɩn, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ wʋ tu o zɩgɩ amʋ kwaga nɩ. Ba maama duri mʋ ba daarɩ amʋ yɩranɩ. Wɛ nan yɩ kwe ba taalɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nan mʋ zǝni-nɩ, yɩ o pa-nɩ dam yɩ a ma wanɩ a tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam, yɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ maama ni-ka. Kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ mʋ vrɩ amʋ tʋʋnɩ jɩŋa nɩ DƖ yagɩ.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nan wʋ́ vrɩ amʋ wo-lwaanʋ maama wʋnɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o ja-nɩ o vu o zʋ Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ dɩ yazurǝ. Wʋntʋ mʋ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ maŋa maama. Amina. Tiim kwǝrǝ

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ Prisili dɩ Akwila n pa-nɩ, dɩdaanɩ Onisifɔɔrɩ dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ bam maama.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasɩtɩ maŋɩ Korɛntɩ nɩ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ amʋ yagɩ Trofim Mileti nɩ, o na ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ n kɩ lɩla n ba kʋ loori waarʋ mɩmaŋa. Yubulusi dɩ Pudan dɩ Linusi dɩ Kloodɩa dɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam maama jɔɔnɩ-m lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩ nmʋ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Nmʋ Titi yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ tɩtɩ bu mʋ te, dɩ́ maama na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa nmʋ yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa na maŋɩ sɩ ba taa yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn na yagɩ nmʋ Krɛtɩ nɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ n kwaanɩ n kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na daarɩ sɩ n kɩ tɩn mʋ. Zezi nɔɔna bam na wʋ tɩʋ kʋlʋ maama nɩ tɩn, sɩ n lɩ nakwa tiinǝ da, nɩnɛɛnɩ a na maŋɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na lɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ tɩn, o maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ wʋlʋ nɔɔna na bá ta jɩgɩ o yɩra taanɩ tɩn mʋ. O nan maŋɩ sɩ o taa jɩgɩ kaanɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ o biǝ dɩ sɛ Wɛ, sɩ ba yɩ taa yɩ nɔn-kayɛ dɩ banɩ-nyɩna.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na jeeri vǝrǝ lanyɩranɩ tɩn. O maŋɩ sɩ o taa yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm wʋlʋ na cʋ o tɩtɩ yɩ o tɔgɩ Wɛ dɩ cɩga yɩ o waɩ o tɩtɩ o jaana tɩn.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ banɩ-nyɩna zanzan mʋ wʋ abam tee nɩ, ba na yǝni ba ŋɔɔnɩ bɩtarɩ sɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn ba ma ganɩ nɔɔna. Ba zanzan mʋ yɩ balʋ na tiini ba sɛ ba Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm tɩn.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Krɛtɩ tiinǝ bam tɩtɩ yiyǝn-yeenu dɛɛn mʋ tagɩ o wɩ: «Krɛtɩ tiinǝ yǝni ba fɔ vwan mʋ maŋa maama. Ba nyɩ dɩ varɩ-balwaarʋ mʋ te, yɩ ba ta yɩ yawɔrɩ-nyɩna dɩ nɔn-kwǝǝlu dɩ.»

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: O nan na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ o taga. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ n maŋɩ sɩ n tiini n kaanɩ Krɛtɩ tiinǝ bam, sɩ kʋ pa ba yɔɔrɩ ba taa tɔgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam lanyɩranɩ,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: sɩ ba daa yɩ sɛ Zwifǝ bam sɩnswalɩ sɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn, naa ba sɛ nabiinǝ tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa cullu tɩm ba na yagɩ cɩga kam yɩ ba daarɩ ba tɔgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo tɩn, kʋlʋkʋlʋ ba jɩgɩ digiru wʋntʋ tee nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ wʋlʋ na vɩn Wɛ yɩ o ba jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo tɩn, kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ kʋ na lana wʋntʋ tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ tu wʋbʋŋa cɔgɩ mʋ, yɩ o daa yǝri kʋlʋ na maŋɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ donnǝ nan tɛ ba wɩ, ba ye Wɛ mʋ, yɩ ba tɩtʋŋa laan yagɩ ya ba tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa. Ba yɩ banɩ-nyɩna mʋ, yɩ ba tiini ba kɩ lwarɩm kʋ ja gaalɩ. Ba warɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn ba kɩ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Nmʋ maŋɩ sɩ n brɩ nankwɩn sɩ ba taa yɩrɩ ba tɩtɩ mʋ, sɩ ba kwǝri ba taa yɩ balʋ nɔɔna na nɩgɩ-ba tɩn, sɩ ba taa cʋ ba tɩtɩ, sɩ ba yɔɔrɩ ba sɛ Zezi dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ sono dɩ pu-dɩa.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Nan brɩ kazɩna sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ ba tɩtɩ sɩ kʋ pa Wɛ na zulǝ ba tee nɩ, sɩ ba yɩ taa yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna naa sa-nyɔra. Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kwe nɔɔna kwiǝ yalʋ na lana tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ baá wanɩ ba brɩ ka-bwǝnǝ ba na wʋ́ ta soe ba banna dɩ ba biǝ te tɩn,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: sɩ ba daarɩ ba taa cʋ ba tɩtɩ, sɩ ba yɩ taa kɩ digiru, sɩ ba kwǝri ba taa yɩ ka-yʋʋrʋ tɩlʋ na tʋŋɩ sɔŋɔ tɩtʋŋa lanyɩranɩ yɩ ba sɛ ba banna ni tɩn. Kʋntʋ, nɔɔna daa bá wanɩ ba yáalɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Kʋ zɩ na yɩ nɔn-dʋnnʋ, sɩ n kwe-ba sɩ ba dɩ taa cʋ ba tɩtɩ woŋo maama wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Pa n ni-taanɩ taa jɩgɩ cɩga, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ wanɩ o yáalɩ-dɩ. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa dɩbam dʋna na cavɩɩra, ba daa na bá na woŋo sɩ ba maa ŋɔɔnɩ ba cɔgɩ dɩbam tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: N daarɩ n kwe gambɛ nɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba sɛ ba tiinǝ woŋo maama wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ pa ba tiinǝ bam wʋ poli. Ba yɩ vɩn ba tiinǝ bam ni.

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba ŋɔ-ba. Ba maŋɩ sɩ ba tʋŋɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ cɩga mʋ woŋo maama wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna lwarɩ nɩ dɩbam Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ tɩn zaasɩm dɩm lamma.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, Wɛ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ DƖ sono kʋm na dagɩ zanzan te, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna maama wanɩ ba na vrɩm DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ sɛ o tɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ, sɩ o ma vrɩ dɩbam lwarɩm dwi maama wʋnɩ, sɩ o daarɩ o fɔgɩ o kwɛ dɩ́ bɩcara sɩ dɩ́ taá yɩ o tɩtɩ nɔɔna, sɩ dɩ́ taá kwaanɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Nan ta n brɩ nɔɔna wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ, sɩ n daarɩ n kwe-ba, sɩ n kwǝri n kaanɩ-ba, nɩ Wɛ na pɛ nmʋ ni sɩ n kɩ te tɩn. Nan yɩ sɛ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ gooni-m.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Guli n brɩ nɔɔna bam nɩ ba maŋɩ sɩ ba taa nɩgɩ ba tɩʋ kʋm yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ balʋ na yɩ dɩdɛɛra tɩn, sɩ ba taa sɛ ba ni. Ba nan maŋɩ sɩ ba taa tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna dwi maama mʋ.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Ba nan yɩ zaŋɩ ba twɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ, naa ba taa yɩ najajara. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ ba taa zuli nɔɔna mʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba taa jɩgɩ wʋ-bono dɩ nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam maama dɛɛn yɩ nayǝri-nyɩna mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ tusi, yɩ dɩ́ vɩn Wɛ ni. Dɩbam fra dɛɛn mʋ te dɩbam, yɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ maama dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ maa yǝni dɩ́ jɩgɩ pu-sɩŋa dɩ wʋ-gʋʋ yɩ dɩ́ culi daanɩ.

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ dɩbam na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ na yɩ ŋwaŋa tu tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. DƖ ma pa DƖ Joro kʋm zarɩ wo-digiru tɩlʋ na wʋ dɩ́ bɩcara nɩ tɩn, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa dɩbam wʋbʋŋ-dʋʋra, sɩ dɩ́ na ŋwɩ-dʋŋa DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Kʋ maa yɩ dɩbam Vɩrnʋ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ tʋŋɩ DƖ Joro kʋm DƖ pa dɩbam zaanɩ,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ na Wɛ wo-laarʋ tɩm dɩ́ na yɩ DƖ biǝ yɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti DƖ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: A na tagɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ tɩn yɩ cɩga mʋ. Kʋntʋ, a lagɩ sɩ n kwaanɩ n brɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ kʋ pa balʋ na sɛ Wɛ tɩn tiini ba taa kɩ kǝm-laarʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ lana yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ kuri kʋ paɩ nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ n maŋɩ sɩ n cɩ n tɩtɩ dɩ kantɔgɔ dwi maama, kʋ na yɩ bɩtar-yɔɔrʋ baŋa nɩ dɩ dɩ́ kwǝ dwi natɔga kam baŋa nɩ dɩ Zwifǝ bam cullu tɩm baŋa nɩ, sɩ tɩ ba jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ tɩ yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ ye nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na yɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, o daa ba lagɩ sɩ o tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ. O tusim dɩm mʋ brɩ nɩ o bá na bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a tʋŋɩ Aritimasɩ naa Tisiki mʋ nmʋ tee nɩ. Ba wʋlʋ na yi nmʋ te tɩn, sɩ n kwaanɩ n ba amʋ te lɩla Nikopolisi nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ a lɩ wʋbʋŋa sɩ a maŋɩ dáanɩ mʋ sɩ waarʋ tɩm maŋa kɛ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Nan kwaanɩ n wǝli Zenasɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ bɩtar-yeenu tɩn dɩ Apolɔsɩ ba cwǝŋǝ kam vǝŋǝ ŋwaanɩ, sɩ n pa-ba kʋlʋ maama na muri-ba tɩn.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ balʋ na wʋ amʋ tee nɩ tɩn maama jɔɔnɩ nmʋ. Jɔɔnɩ balʋ maama na sɛ Zezi yɩ ba yɩ dɩbam cilon-sonnu tɩn n pa dɩbam. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ Zezi Krisi cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ, yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Timoti wʋ amʋ tee nɩ. Dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ dɩ́ pa nmʋ Filimɔn, n na yɩ dɩbam ciloŋ-sono yɩ n tɔgɩ dɩ dɩbam n tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ jɔɔnɩ-m, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ jɔɔnɩ dɩ́ ko-bu-kana Apɩa, dɩ Arisipi wʋlʋ na wǝli dɩ dɩbam o na cam Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ jɔɔnɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na yǝni kʋ jeeri daanɩ nmʋ sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn maama.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amʋ na yǝni a loori Wɛ, a guli nmʋ gulǝ DƖ yigǝ nɩ, yɩ a kɩ DƖ le nmʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ amʋ ni nɩ n jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩ n soe Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa nmʋ na jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ kʋlʋ dɩ dɩbam n na kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn pa n wanɩ n lwarɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ DƖ pa dɩbam Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: A ko-bu-sono, nmʋ na soe Wɛ nɔɔna bam te tɩn mʋ paɩ a wʋ poli zanzan, yɩ kʋ pa a jɩgɩ baarɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ n wǝli Wɛ nɔɔna bam yɩ n pa ba na baarɩ dɩ wʋpolo.

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: A nan lagɩ sɩ a loori-m dɩ sono mʋ. Amʋ Pooli wʋlʋ na yɩ nankwɩan yɩ ba kɩ-nɩ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ lele kʋntʋ Zezi Krisi cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn,

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: a lagɩ a loori-m nmʋ gambaa Onisim ŋwaanɩ mʋ. A na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn, o tu amʋ te, yɩ a brɩ-o Wɛ cɩga kam yɩ o sɛ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, wʋntʋ laan nyɩ nɩ a tɩtɩ bu mʋ te.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn na tʋŋɩ o pa nmʋ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o wʋ pɛ n na nyɔɔrɩ. Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, o laan jɩgɩ nyɔɔrɩ o pa amʋ dɩ nmʋ maama.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: A lagɩ a tʋŋ-o sɩ o joori o ba nmʋ te, wʋntʋ yɩ a tɩtɩ bɩcarɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Amʋ na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn, a yaá ta lagɩ sɩ o maŋɩ a tee nɩ mʋ, sɩ o lǝni nmʋ yuu nɩ o taa tʋŋɩ o pa-nɩ.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: A nan ba lagɩ sɩ a kɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ yɩ nmʋ na wʋ sɛ. A na kɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ ta yɩ nɩ a fɩn nmʋ sɩ n wǝli-nɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ n tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Onisim na duri o yagɩ nmʋ tɩn, dɛ doŋ kʋ yɩ sɩ o pɔɔrɩ dɩ nmʋ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ, sɩ o laan joori o ba o taa wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ maŋa maama.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: O na duri o yagɩ nmʋ tɩn, o dɛɛn yɩ gambaa mʋ. O na joori o ba, yɩ zaŋɩ n nii-o nɩ gambaa te, sɩ o laan dwe gambaa o na jigi nmʋ ko-bu dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Amʋ tiini a so-o. Nmʋ dɩ nan wʋ́ ta n tiini n so-o kʋ ja gaalɩ, o na yɩ n gambaa yɩ o kwǝri o yɩ n ko-bu dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na sɛ nɩ dɩbam sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ yɩ ciloŋo daanɩ, sɩ n kwaanɩ n jeeri Onisim lanyɩranɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ tɩtɩ te.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn na maŋɩ o kɩ woŋo kʋlʋ o cɔgɩ dɩ, naa o na jɩgɩ nmʋ jɩnɩ, sɩ n yagɩ kʋ maama dɩ amʋ.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Amʋ Pooli tɩtɩ mʋ mɛ a jɩŋa a pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ nɩ: Amʋ wʋ́ ŋwɩ jɩnɩ dɩm.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: A ko-bu, kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, a lagɩ sɩ n kɩ woŋo kʋlʋ a na loori-m tɩn mʋ dɩ́ Yuutu sono kʋm ŋwaanɩ, sɩ n pa a taa jɩgɩ wʋpolo Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafrasɩ dɩ jɔɔnɩ-m. Wʋntʋ dɩdaanɩ amʋ mʋ wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ Zezi Krisi cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Marɩkɩ dɩ Arisarɩkɩ dɩ Demasɩ dɩ Luki maama dɩ jɔɔnɩ-m. Bantʋ dɩ amʋ mʋ tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ Wɛ tɩtʋŋa yam.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, Wɛ dɛɛn ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ dɩbam nabaara bam kuni zanzan mʋ. DƖ dɛɛn yǝni DƖ pa DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ wǝǝnu dwi tǝri tǝri dɩ ba.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa kweelim maŋa tɩn, Wɛ laan pɛ DƖ Bu mʋ ba o ŋɔɔnɩ DƖ taanɩ dɩ dɩbam. Wɛ dɛ wʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ wɛyuu wǝǝnu maama, yɩ DƖ pa-o ni sɩ o ba o taa te wǝǝnu maama.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Wɛ Bu wʋm mʋ jɩgɩ pooni dɩlʋ na brɩ Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ yam na yɩ te tɩn. O maa jɩgɩ o Ko Wɛ nyɩnyʋgʋ fasɩ. O ni-taanɩ maa jɩgɩ dam yɩ dɩ paɩ wǝǝnu maama fɔgɩ tɩ zɩga. O ma ba o saarɩ nɔɔna lwarɩm o fɔgɩ-ba o pa ba ji lanyɩranɩ, yɩ o laan joori o di Baŋa-Wɛ te o vu o jǝni DƖ jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, Baŋa-Wɛ Bu dwe Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm, dɩ Wɛ na pɛ-o yɩrɩ dɩlʋ na daga dɩ dwe sɩntʋ na jɩgɩ yɩra yalʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Zezi Krisi dwe Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm maama

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ malɛsɩ sɩm, Wɛ wʋ fɔgɩ DƖ ta dɩ malɛka DƖ wɩ: «Nmʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ Bu, yɩ zɩm amʋ dɩ jigi nmʋ Ko.» Wɛ nan wʋ tagɩ malɛka kalʋkalʋ taanɩ DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ ka Ko, sɩ ka dɩ taa yɩ amʋ bu.»

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu-dʋa kam sɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, DƖ tagɩ DƖ wɩ: «Malɛsɩ sɩm maama maŋɩ sɩ sɩ kuni doonǝ mʋ sɩ zul-o.»

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ malɛsɩ sɩm, Wɛ tagɩ sɩ taanɩ DƖ wɩ: Sɩ yɩ dɩntʋ tɩntʋŋna mʋ, yɩ DƖ pa sɩ nyɩ nɩ viu dɩ min-vwɩ te, sɩ sɩ taa tʋŋɩ sɩ pa-DƖ.

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm, DƖ tagɩ o taanɩ DƖ wɩ: «Nmʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ, n paarɩ dɩm wʋ́ ta wʋra sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Nmʋ wʋ́ ta n te n nɔɔna bam dɩ cɩga.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Nmʋ soe cɩga cwǝŋǝ, yɩ n daarɩ n culi balɔrɔ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ n Ko Baŋa-Wɛ pɛ nmʋ na wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ dɩ zulǝ n dwǝni balʋ maama na wʋra dɩ nmʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wɛ ta tagɩ DƖ wɩ: «Nmʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ wǝǝnu maama Yuutu tɩn mʋ kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pulim nɩ, yɩ n ta kwǝri n ma n jɩa n kɩ wɛyuu wǝǝnu maama.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Tɩ wʋ́ ba tɩ lɩɩrɩ, yɩ n kukuli-tɩ n tiŋi nɩ n na kukuli gwar-doŋo n tiŋi yɩ n daarɩ n lǝni gwar-dʋŋʋ n zʋ te tɩn. Nmʋ nan ta wʋ́ ta n yɩ nɩ n na maŋɩ n yɩ te tɩn mʋ. N ŋwɩa bá fɔgɩ ka ti.»

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn wʋ fɔgɩ DƖ ta dɩ DƖ malɛsɩ sɩm kalʋkalʋ DƖ wɩ: «Ba n jǝni a jazɩm nɩ, sɩ a kɩ n dʋna maama n nɛ kuri nɩ sɩ n nɔ-ba nɩ tɩga te.» Kʋ yɩ DƖ Bu wʋm yɩranɩ mʋ DƖ tagɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kalʋ dɩ́ na ni tɩn lanyɩranɩ, sɩ dɩ́ yɩ ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Wɛ tɩtɩ dɩ ma brɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga, dɩ DƖ na pɛ ba kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla dwi tǝri tǝri dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na brɩ DƖ dam tɩn. DƖ ma daarɩ DƖ pa ba maama DƖ Joro kʋm dam, sɩ ba ma tʋŋɩ te dɩ te DƖ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn. Zezi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na vrɩ dɩbam tɩn

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Lʋ-dʋŋʋ kʋlʋ na maa bɩɩnɩ yɩ dɩ́ tɛ kʋ taanɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ malɛsɩ sɩm mʋ Wɛ pɛ dam sɩ sɩ taa te-kʋ.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋdoŋ tagɩ o wɩ: «Nabiinu yɩ bɛɛ mʋ, yɩ nmʋ Baŋa-Wɛ guli o gulǝ? Nabiinu bu yɩ bɛɛ mʋ, yɩ nmʋ nii o baŋa nɩ kʋntʋ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nmʋ pɛ o ba maɩ dɩ malɛsɩ sɩm maŋa fɩnfɩɩn wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ n laan pa o di paarɩ yɩ o na zulǝ.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: N ma n daarɩ n kɩ wǝǝnu maama o nɛ kuri nɩ.» Kʋ na tagɩ kʋ wɩ, «Wɛ kɩ wǝǝnu maama o dam kuri nɩ» tɩn, kʋ lagɩ kʋ ta nɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ o na ba te-kʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ cɩga mʋ nɩ, lele kʋntʋ dɩ́ daa ta wʋ nɛ nɩ wǝǝnu maama wʋ nabiinǝ dam kuri nɩ.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan ye nɩ, kʋ yɩ Zezi mʋ Wɛ pɛ o tu o tɩtɩ o wʋ yi malɛsɩ sɩm maŋa fɩnfɩɩn wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ o laan ba o na paarɩ-zulǝ dɩ tiǝ, o na sɛ o yaarɩ o tɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ tɔgɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ DƖ pa Zezi lǝni nabiinǝ maama yuu nɩ o tɩ ba vrɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na kɩ woŋo maama DƖ tɩtɩ ŋwaanɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa mʋ, sɩ DƖ pa Zezi na yaara, sɩ o laan wanɩ o vrɩ nabiinǝ zanzan sɩ ba ji Wɛ biǝ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba na paarɩ-zulǝ. Kʋ yɩ Zezi mʋ paɩ nɔɔna na vrɩm Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Zezi ta mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na paɩ nabiinǝ jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ dɩ o na pɛ balʋ maama jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo tɩn yɩ ko dɩdʋa biǝ mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ o bǝ-ba nɩ o ko-biǝ, yɩ kʋ ba jɩgɩ cavɩɩra dɩd-o.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri o tagɩ dɩ Wɛ o wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ pa nmʋ yɩrɩ zaŋɩ a ko-biǝ bam tɩtarɩ nɩ, yɩ a zɩgɩ ba wʋnɩ a leeni a zuli nmʋ.»

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: O daa ta maa wɩ: «Amʋ wʋ́ kwe a wʋ maama a pa Wɛ.» O ma daa ta ta o wɩ: «Nii-na amʋ dɩ biǝ balʋ Wɛ na kɩ amʋ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Balʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ biǝ tɩn yɩ nabiinǝ mʋ, yɩ ba jɩgɩ yɩra dɩ jana. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Zezi dɩ dɛɛn tɔgɩ o ji nabiinu, sɩ o wanɩ o tɔgɩ o tʋʋnɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ o cɔgɩ wʋlʋ na paɩ tʋʋnɩ jaanɩ nɔɔna tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ sʋtaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ laan nan lwarɩ nɩ kʋ daɩ malɛsɩ sɩm mʋ o tu sɩ o zǝni. O tu sɩ o zǝni Abraham dwi tiinǝ bam mʋ.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Zezi tɩtɩ na nɛ maŋɩm dɩ yaara tɩn, o laan wʋ́ wanɩ o zǝni balʋ na wʋ yaara dɩ maŋɩm wʋnɩ tɩn sɩ ba taa jɩgɩ pu-dɩa.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. DƖ ma bǝŋi abam sɩ á tɔgɩ á na ywǝǝni DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ. Nan lwarɩ-na nɩ Zezi mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ na tʋŋɩ, sɩ o ba o ji DƖ kaanɩm yuutu dɩbam Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ pɛ-o tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm kʋntʋ. O maa tʋŋɩ o pa Wɛ dɩ cɩga. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ Moyisi dɩ dɛɛn na nii Wɛ nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ dɩ cɩga te tɩn.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Zezi nan sɩɩnɩ o maŋɩ sɩ o na zulǝ o dwǝni Moyisi, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na lɔgɩ sɔŋɔ tɩn mʋ na zulǝ o dwe sɔŋɔ kʋm tɩtɩ.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ nan tǝrǝ yɩ kʋ daɩ nɔɔnʋ mʋ lɔgɩ-kʋ. Wɛ nan mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ woŋo maama tɩn.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Moyisi dɛɛn yɩ tɩntʋŋnʋ mʋ, yɩ o tʋŋɩ dɩ cɩga Wɛ nɔɔna bam ŋwaanɩ. O ma da yigǝ o brɩ-ba Wɛ cɩga kalʋ na wʋ́ ba ka lwarɩ jaja tɩn.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ Zezi Krisi mʋ yɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm tɩtɩ bu cɩga cɩga, yɩ o te sɔŋɔ kʋm. Dɩbam mʋ yɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm kʋntʋ, dɩ dɩ́ na zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa yɩ dɩ́ brɩ dɩ wʋpolo nɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ na wʋ́ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam siun te tɩn

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ sɛ-na Wɛ Joro kʋm na tagɩ te kʋ wɩ: «Abam zɩm na ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam,

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ amʋ banɩ zaŋɩ dɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ, yɩ a ta a wɩ: ‹Kʋ yɩ ba paalɩ ba ywǝri mʋ maŋa maama, yɩ ba vɩn sɩ ba tɔgɩ amʋ cwe sɩm.›

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Amʋ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm ma pa a ta a du dɩ ba a wɩ: ‹Amʋ brɩ a bá pa-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ amʋ woro kʋm wʋ ba na siun.› »

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, cʋ-na á tɩtɩ sɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ yɩ taá jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-lwaanʋ o bɩcarɩ nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa o yɩ kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Wɛ, sɩ o daarɩ o yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Nan taá zǝni-na daanɩ maŋa maama, sɩ kʋ pa á taá jɩgɩ pu-dɩa, nɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam ta na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ dɩbam zɩm te tɩn, sɩ abam wʋlʋwʋlʋ yɩ pa lwarɩm gan-o sɩ o pa o bɩcarɩ digili dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan tɔgɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ́ ji Wɛ biǝ mʋ, dɩ dɩ́ na zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ, nɩ dɩ́ na puli dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi kweelim.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Balʋ dɛɛn na ni Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam yɩ ba vɩn DƖ ni tɩn yɩ bra mʋ? Ba yɩ balʋ maama Moyisi dɛɛn na tɔgɩ ba yigǝ o ja-ba o nuŋi Ezipi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Wɛ na dugi DƖ wɩ, dɩntʋ brɩ DƖ bá pa-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ DƖ woro kʋm wʋ ba na siun tɩn, kʋ yɩ bra mʋ DƖ tɛa? Kʋ yɩ balʋ na wʋ sɛ DƖ ni tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ, Wɛ na wʋ pɛ-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ DƖ woro kʋm wʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ ba na wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maŋɩ dɩ́ ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam, nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩ́ nabaara bam dɛɛn dɩ na ni-ka te tɩn. Bantʋ nan na ni-ka tɩn, ba wʋ pɛ ka ja kuri dɩ ba, bɛŋwaanɩ ba wʋ kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa sɩ ba tɔgɩ Wɛ na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Dɩbam balʋ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ wʋ́ ba dɩ́ na siun DƖ woro kʋm wʋnɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ tagɩ bantʋ taanɩ DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm pɛ a ta a du dɩ ba a wɩ: ‹Amʋ brɩ a bá pa-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ amʋ woro kʋm wʋ ba na siun.› » Wɛ na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ DƖ ba jɩgɩ siun jǝgǝ mʋ ba ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ zɩgɩ maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa yɩ DƖ kɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa yam maama DƖ ti tɩn, mʋ DƖ daarɩ DƖ sin.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm tagɩ da yarpɛ dɛ dɩm taanɩ kʋ wɩ: «Da yarpɛ dɛ nɩ mʋ Wɛ sin dɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa yam maama.»

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Wɛ nan tagɩ DƖ siun kʋm taanɩ DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ brɩ a bá pa-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba zʋ amʋ woro kʋm wʋ ba sin.»

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, dɩ́ nabaara balʋ na dɛ yigǝ ba ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn wʋ wanɩ ba zʋ DƖ woro kʋm wʋ ba sin, ba na vɩn DƖ ni tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ laan daarɩ sɩ nɔɔna badaara mʋ na cwǝŋǝ ba zʋ.

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Zozwe dɛɛn ya na sɩɩnɩ o ja dɩ́ nabaara bam o vu o zʋ Wɛ woro kʋm wʋ sɩ ba sin, Wɛ ya daa bá ŋɔɔnɩ siun dɛ dɩdoŋ taanɩ daga.

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ ye nɩ cwǝŋǝ daa ta wʋra zɩm, sɩ Wɛ nɔɔna na siun, nɩ DƖ tɩtɩ na sin da yarpɛ dɛ dɩm nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na zʋ Wɛ woro kʋm wʋ tɩn, wʋntʋ wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ o na siun dɩ o tɩtʋŋa yam, nɩ Wɛ dɩ dɛɛn na sin dɩ DƖ tɩtʋŋa yam te tɩn.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kwaanɩ-na á pa dɩ́ zʋ Wɛ woro kʋm wʋ sɩ dɩ́ na siun. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ zaŋɩ o vɩn Wɛ ni sɩ o joori Wɛ kwaga nɩ, nɩ dɩ́ nabaara bam dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Wɛ taanɩ dɩm jɩgɩ ŋwɩa yɩ dɩ dana lanyɩranɩ. Dɩ jɩgɩ ni dɩ dwe sʋ-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ niǝ yale tɩn. Dɩ maa waɩ dɩ zʋʋrɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋ dɩ pɔɔrɩ o joro dɩ o bɩcarɩ wǝǝnu maama daanɩ, yɩ dɩ daarɩ dɩ ye o swan dɩ o wʋbʋŋa maama na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan jɩgɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu o na yɩ kamunu o diini o vu o yi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ. Wʋm mʋ yɩ Wɛ Bu Zezi. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ sɛ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm lanyɩranɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ baarɩ sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ yi Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ jǝŋǝ je, sɩ dɩ́ joŋi DƖ zaanɩ dɩm. Kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ wʋ́ duri dɩ́ ŋwaŋa yɩ DƖ pa dɩbam zaanɩ, sɩ kʋ wanɩ kʋ zǝni dɩbam maŋa kalʋ dɩ́ na lagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: O tɩtɩ dɩ nan na bwǝnǝ tɩn, o waɩ o jaanɩ o bɩcarɩ dɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ cɩga kam lanyɩranɩ yɩ ba tusi tɩn.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: O nan na bwǝnǝ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ fɩn mʋ sɩ o kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ o tɩtɩ lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ, dɩ nɔɔna bam dɩ lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o lɩ o tɩtɩ sɩ o taa yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ wʋ́ kur-o, nɩnɛɛnɩ DƖ dɛɛn na puli DƖ kuri Aarɔn te tɩn.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ Zezi Krisi dɩ na yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu te tɩn. Kʋ daɩ nɩ wʋm mʋ beeri zulǝ yam kʋntʋ o pa o tɩtɩ. Wɛ nan mʋ tagɩ dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: «Nmʋ mʋ yɩ amʋ Bu, yɩ zɩm amʋ dɩ jigi nmʋ Ko.»

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Zezi na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, o tiini o loori Wɛ dɩ baarɩ yɩ o yi-na nuŋǝ, o na ye nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ joŋ-o tʋʋnɩ wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ ma sɛ o loro kʋm, o na tu o tɩtɩ yɩ o sɛ-DƖ lanyɩranɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ o na maŋɩ o yɩ Wɛ Bu tɩn dɩ, o na yaarɩ te tɩn mʋ pɛ o lwarɩ Wɛ ni sɛɛm na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Wɛ ma brɩ nɩ o sɩɩnɩ o yɩ DƖ kaanɩm yuutu, nɩ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ dɛɛn na yɩ te tɩn. Cʋ-na á tɩtɩ sɩ á yɩ yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan mʋ sɩ a ta a brɩ abam kʋntʋ laŋa nɩ, kʋ nan tiini kʋ cana sɩ a pa á ni kʋ kuri, bɛŋwaanɩ abam laan jɩgɩ yawɔrɔ mʋ yɩ á bá wanɩ á ni kʋ kuri lɩla.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Balʋ na jɩgɩ bu-balɛ wʋbʋŋa kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ ba ta yǝri kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ tɩn daanɩ.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Nan pa-na dɩ́ kɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na maŋɩ ba da yigǝ ba brɩ abam Zezi Krisi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ zaasɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na wʋ́ pa dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa bɩ Wɛ cɩga kam wʋnɩ tɩn. Abam daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á joori á puli Wɛ taanɩ dɩm zaasɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ á maŋɩ á zaasɩ á na wʋ́ lǝni á wʋ á yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ na jɩgɩ abam tɩ ve tʋʋnɩ wʋnɩ tɩn, dɩ á na wʋ́ kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bantʋ dwi na yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa bá wanɩ o pa ba lǝni ba wʋ ba daa ta tɔgɩ Wɛ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ nyɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ bam tɩtɩ mʋ joori ba pa Wɛ Bu Zezi tʋʋn-dagara kam yuu nɩ ba gʋ yɩ ba paɩ nɔɔna mwan-o te.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Kʋ nyɩ dɩ dʋa na nɩa lanyɩranɩ nɔɔnʋ kara nɩ te tɩn mʋ. Tɩga kam na nyɔgɩ dʋ-na bam yɩ ka daarɩ ka kɩ wʋdiiru lanyɩranɩ ka pa balʋ na dugi ka baŋa nɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ kɩ tɩga kam kʋntʋ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ tɩga kam na nuŋi sabarɩ dɩ wo-kʋrrʋ yɩranɩ mʋ, kʋ brɩ nɩ ka yɩ kafɛ mʋ, yɩ fɩnfɩɩn na wǝli da Wɛ wʋ́ cɔgɩ-ka DƖ yagɩ, yɩ kʋ tiim nɩ baá zwɛ-ka dɩ mini mʋ.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, dɩbam na maŋɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, dɩ́ jɩgɩ abam cɩga nɩ á tɔgɩ cwǝ-ŋʋŋa kalʋ na wʋ́ pa á na vrɩm tɩn.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Wɛ yɩ cɩga tu mʋ. DƖ nan bá swe á na maŋɩ á tʋŋɩ tɩtʋŋ-ŋʋna yalʋ tɩn. DƖ ta bá swe á na soe-DƖ lanyɩranɩ yɩ á tʋŋɩ á wǝli DƖ nɔɔna bam kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm maama tɩn.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Á nan yɩ pa yawɔrɔ zʋ abam. Á lwǝni-na balʋ na fɔgɩ ba zɩgɩ dɩ pu-dɩa yɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn. Bantʋ laan mʋ wʋ́ ba ba joŋi wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa-ba tɩn. Wɛ bá fɔgɩ DƖ lǝni DƖ na goni ni sɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ tɩn

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn na goni DƖ ni dɩm dɩ Abraham tɩn, kʋ yɩ DƖ dugi dɩ DƖ tɩtɩ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ woŋo daa tǝrǝ kʋ na dwe-DƖ sɩ DƖ du dɩ kʋ.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ nabiinǝ na yǝni ba du durǝ, baá ma kʋlʋ na dwe-ba tɩn yɩrɩ mʋ ba du, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ ba taanɩ dɩm yɩ cɩga, sɩ bʋbwɛa daa ta tǝrǝ.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ na goni DƖ ni dɩm dɩ balʋ tɩn, DƖ dɩ lagɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ DƖ bá fɔgɩ DƖ yiri DƖ ni dɩm. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ dugi durǝ DƖ wǝli dɩ DƖ ni-gonim dɩm.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ba fɔɛ vwan tɩn ŋwaanɩ, wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩle bá wanɩ tɩ lǝni. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩbam balʋ na kɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ́ tiini dɩ́ zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa, sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ tɩɩna nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na kʋlʋ Wɛ na tiŋi sɩ DƖ pa dɩbam tɩn.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Tɩɩna yam dɩ́ na jɩgɩ Wɛ tee nɩ kʋntʋ tɩn tiini ya dana, yɩ ya bá wanɩ ya cɔgɩ. Ya maa paɩ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa tigi jǝgǝ dɩdʋa, yɩ ya paɩ dɩ́ yi Wɛ tɩtɩ jǝŋǝ je mɛ na cɩgɩ dɩ gɔrɔ sɩ nabiinǝ yɩ zʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: A laan lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ woŋo mʋ a brɩ abam. Wʋntʋ dɛɛn yɩ Salɛm tiinǝ pɛ mʋ, yɩ o kwǝri o yɩ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ kaanɩm tu. Abraham na kɩ jara o wanɩ pwa yɩ o laan ma joori maŋa kalʋ tɩn, mʋ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ jeer-o cwǝŋǝ nɩ o sɔɔlɩ Wɛ o pa-o.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Abraham laan ma kwe wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama o na nɛ jara yam je nɩ tɩn o cɛ kuni fugǝ, o kwe kuni bɩdwɩ dɩm o pa Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ. Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ yɩrɩ dɩm kuri mʋ yɩ pɛ wʋlʋ na yɩ Cɩga Tu tɩn. Kʋ wǝli da, o na yɩ Salɛm pɛ tɩn, kʋ dɩ kuri mʋ yɩ Yazurǝ Pɛ.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan wʋ ni Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ ko dɩ o nu ŋwa, yɩ dɩ́ yǝri o kuri na puli mɛ tɩn. Dɩ́ nan yǝri o lʋra dɛ dɩ o tʋʋnɩ maŋa. Kʋntʋ mʋ pɛ o nyɩ dɩ Wɛ Bu Zezi, yɩ o yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tu sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Bʋŋɩ-na á nii Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ dɛɛn na yɩ kamunu te tɩn. Dɩbam nabaarʋ Abraham dɛɛn ma cɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ o na nɛ jara yam je nɩ tɩn kuni fugǝ, yɩ o lɩ kuni bɩdwɩ o pa-o.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na nuŋi Leevi dwi dɩm wʋnɩ yɩ ba yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ tɩn, Wɛ ni dɩm pɛ-ba cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba joŋi kuni kuri fugǝ wʋnɩ kuni bɩdwɩ dɩm ba donnǝ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam tee nɩ woŋo maama wʋnɩ, yɩ bantʋ dɩ nan yɩ Abraham dwi tiinǝ mʋ.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ nan wʋ nuŋi Leevi dwi dɩm wʋnɩ. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, o ta joŋi o wǝǝnu tǝri Abraham tee nɩ. O ma daarɩ o sɔɔlɩ Wɛ o pa Abraham, yɩ Abraham nan ya mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ Wɛ na goni DƖ ni dɩd-o tɩn.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ba jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa nɩ, nɔɔnʋ na sɔɔlɩ Wɛ o pa o doŋ, wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kamunu o dwe o na sɔɔlɩ o pa wʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ balʋ na nuŋi Leevi dwi dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn dɛɛn yǝni ba joŋi ba wǝǝnu tǝri mʋ, bantʋ nan yɩ balʋ na tʋ tɩn mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ kʋ nan na yɩ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ, wʋntʋ ŋwɩ mʋ taan, nɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm na tagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn tɔgɩ Leevi dwi tiinǝ kaanɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ pa DƖ cullu tɩm Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ. Bantʋ nan na yǝni ba kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ te tɩn ya na maŋɩ fasɩ, Wɛ ya daa bá kuri kaanɩm tu wʋdoŋ wʋlʋ na daɩ Leevi dwi tu tɩn. Wɛ nan kuri wʋlʋ na yɩ kaanɩm tu nɩ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ dɛɛn na yɩ te tɩn, yɩ o wʋ nuŋi Aarɔn dwi dɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Wɛ na lǝni DƖ kaanɩm tu dwi dɩdoŋ wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ DƖ cullu tɩm dɩ tɔgɩ tɩ lǝni mʋ.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ jaja nɩ Wɛ lǝni kaanɩm tu wʋdoŋ mʋ, o na nyɩ dɩ Mɛlɩkisedɛkɩ dɛɛn na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Kʋ ma brɩ nɩ Wɛ yagɩ cwǝ-doŋǝ kam mʋ, ka na bwǝnǝ yɩ ka ba zǝni nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: Cullu tɩlʋ Wɛ na kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ tɩn warɩ tɩ pa nɔɔna maŋɩ fasɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, dɩ́ laan jɩgɩ tɩɩna lanyɩranɩ dɩ Wɛ na tiŋi cwǝ-laa kalʋ DƖ pa dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ ma wanɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ-ka dɩ́ vu dɩ́ yi DƖ te tɩn.

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, Zezi nan na jigi Wɛ kaanɩm tu tɩn, Wɛ dugi durǝ mʋ dɩd-o DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ dugi a durǝ, yɩ a bá fɔgɩ a za a ni. Nmʋ wʋ́ ta n yɩ amʋ kaanɩm tu sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, o waɩ o vrɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ o ŋwaanɩ ba yi Wɛ te tɩn maŋa maama, o na jɩgɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti yɩ o loori Wɛ o pa-ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Zezi nan mʋ yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋlʋ na maŋɩ tɩn dɩbam ŋwaanɩ. O jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo, o yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, o ba jɩgɩ lwarɩm. Wɛ ma lɩ-o nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩtarɩ nɩ, yɩ DƖ zǝŋ-o DƖ ja DƖ di wɛyuu DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuu tiinǝ bam dɛɛn na yɩ te tɩn, dɛ maama ba yǝni ba kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ sɩ DƖ yagɩ ba tɩtɩ lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ-ba, yɩ ba laan daarɩ ba kaanɩ Wɛ ba donnǝ bam dɩ lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ nan na yɩ Zezi, wʋntʋ kwe o tɩtɩ mʋ o ma kaanɩ Wɛ kuni bɩdwɩ yɩranɩ, yɩ kʋntʋ jɩgɩ kuri sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Taana yantʋ maama wʋnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ na yɩ kamunu tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ dɩbam jɩgɩ Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm kʋntʋ doŋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ je Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ, Dam-Paŋwa Tu Wɛ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: O maa wʋ Wɛ di-laa cɩga cɩga wʋnɩ o tʋŋɩ o pa-DƖ. Jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ yɩ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ mʋ, kʋ daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa vwe dɩlʋ nabiinǝ na pugi sɩ ba taa zuli-DƖ da tɩn.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Zezi nan ya ta na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, o bá ta yɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tu. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ maŋɩ ba wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, yɩ ba yǝni ba maɩ pɛɛra ba ma kaanɩ Wɛ, kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Moyisi cullu tɩm na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Bantʋ na yǝni ba tʋŋɩ ba pa Wɛ te tɩn yɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn nyɩnyʋgʋ dɩ tɩ luluŋu mʋ. Moyisi dɛɛn na lagɩ o pu vwe dɩlʋ nɔɔna na wʋ́ ta paɩ Wɛ zulǝ dɩ wʋnɩ tɩn, Wɛ dɛɛn brɩ-o o na wʋ́ kɩ te, yɩ DƖ ta DƖ wɩ: «Kwaanɩ n kɩ wǝǝnu tɩm maama sɩ tɩ taa nyɩ nɩ amʋ na maŋɩ a brɩ-m piu kʋm yuu nɩ te tɩn.»

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ ni dɩlʋ Wɛ na goni DƖ pa DƖ nɔɔna bam tɩn ya na maŋɩ fasɩ, DƖ ya daa bá go ni dɩdoŋ DƖ lǝni dɩntʋ yuu nɩ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn nan brɩ nɩ DƖ nɔɔna bam kɩ ba tusi mʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ DƖ tagɩ DƖ wɩ: «Maŋa maa bɩɩna, yɩ amʋ wʋ́ go ni-dʋʋrɩ a pa a nɔɔna bam, kʋ nan yɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ dɩ Zuda dwi tiinǝ bam maama mʋ.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Ni-dʋʋrɩ dɩntʋ bá ta nyɩ dɩ dayigǝ ni dɩlʋ amʋ na goni a pa ba nabaara bam maŋa kalʋ a na jaanɩ ba jɩŋa a pa ba nuŋi Ezipi tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn. Bantʋ dɛɛn wʋ sɛ ba tɔgɩ ni dɩlʋ amʋ na goni dɩ ba tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ pa a yigǝ daa tǝri ba wʋnɩ.» Mʋ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. DƖ daa ta ma ta DƖ wɩ:

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: «Kantʋ maŋa kam na kɛ, amʋ wʋ́ go ni a pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ dwi tiinǝ bam nɩ: ‹Amʋ wʋ́ pa a ni-taana yam zʋ ba wʋbʋŋa, yɩ a pa ya pǝni ba bɩcara nɩ. Amʋ wʋ́ ta yɩ ba Tu Wɛ, yɩ ba dɩ wʋ́ ta yɩ amʋ nɔɔna.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Bantʋ nabwǝnǝ dɩ ba dɩdɛɛra maama wʋ́ lwarɩ amʋ na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn. Ba wʋlʋwʋlʋ daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ o brɩ o doŋ nɩ amʋ mʋ yɩ ba Yuutu.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ amʋ wʋ́ duri ba ŋwaŋa dɩ ba lwarɩm dɩm, yɩ a daa bá guli ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm.› »

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ŋɔɔnɩ DƖ ni-dʋʋrɩ dɩm taanɩ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ DƖ dayigǝ ni dɩm laan jigi ni-doori mʋ. Woŋo kʋlʋ nan na doori yɩ kʋ wʋra kʋ cɔgɩ tɩn lagɩ kʋ kɛ lele mʋ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Vwe dɩm kʋntʋ wʋ nan cɛ di sɩle mʋ. Dɩ kwaga digǝ kam yɩrɩ mʋ Wɛ-di-laa, yɩ ka jɩgɩ min-zwǝn-kamunu. Taabʋlʋ maa zɩgɩ da, yɩ dɩpɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ Wɛ nyɩm tɩn tigi kʋ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Kaanɩm bimbim maa zɩgɩ da, dɩ yɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa mʋ ba mɛ ba zi, dáanɩ mʋ ba zwɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ lwǝm na ywǝmmǝ tɩn ba pa-DƖ. Wɛ ni-gonim daka kam dɩ maa wʋra ba na mɛ sǝbu-sɩŋa ba ma zi-ka. Ka wʋ kʋm maa jɩgɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa zʋŋa, ka dɩ wʋ na jɩgɩ wʋdiu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Maanɩ tɩn. Nacǝgǝ kalʋ na yɩ Aarɔn nyɩm yɩ ka dɛɛn puli vɔɔrʋ tɩn dɩ maa wʋ daka kam wʋnɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ kandwa-pɩlɛ sɩle Wɛ cullu tɩm na pʋpʋnɩ sɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Vwe dɩm dɩ dɩ wʋ wǝǝnu tɩm na fɔgɩ tɩ kwɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ kaanɩm tiinǝ bam yǝni ba zʋʋrɩ kwaga digǝ kam wʋ dɛ maama mʋ ba tʋŋɩ ba paɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ yigǝ digǝ kam, Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm yɩranɩ mʋ jɩgɩ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o zʋ ka wʋ bɩdwɩ bɩm maama wʋnɩ. Wʋntʋ nan na lagɩ o zʋ, o maŋɩ sɩ o ja varɩm jana mʋ o zʋ o ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ o tɩtɩ tusim dɩ nɔɔna bam dɩ tusim ŋwaanɩ, sɩ Wɛ yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ-ba.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Wɛ Joro kʋm laan brɩ dɩbam nɩ, maŋa kalʋ dayigǝ vwe dɩm ya ta na zɩgɩ tɩn, cwǝŋǝ dɛɛn ya tǝrǝ sɩ nɔɔna wanɩ ba zʋ Wɛ-di-laa cɩga cɩga kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi laan mʋ nan tu o ji kaanɩm yuutu dɩbam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ ma pa dɩ́ joŋi o ŋwɩ-dʋŋa wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ na maŋɩ tɩ wʋra tɩn. Zezi na zʋ Wɛ te dɩbam ŋwaanɩ tɩn, kʋ yɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ cɩga cɩga mʋ o zʋa, yɩ kʋntʋ tiini kʋ lana kʋ dwe lʋgʋ baŋa vwe dɩm. O na zʋ mɛ tɩn daɩ vwe dɩlʋ nabiinǝ na pugi tɩn.

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: O ma vu o zʋ Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋnɩ. Kʋ yɩ bɩdwɩ yɩranɩ mʋ o zʋa, maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O nan wʋ mɛ bʋbalɩ naa nabalɩ jana o zʋ o ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ. Kʋ yɩ o tɩtɩ jana mʋ o mɛ o ŋwɩ dɩbam lwarɩm jɩnɩ, yɩ o vrɩ dɩbam lwarɩm wʋnɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-doori dɩm brɩ nɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na cɔgɩ culu tɩn, ba maŋɩ sɩ ba ma bʋnɩ dɩ nabɛ jana mʋ dɩ na-pwala kalʋ ba na zwɛ tɩn tɩntwarɩm ba misi nɔɔnʋ wʋm yɩra nɩ. Ba na kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, kʋʋ́ kwɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋm sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ cullu tɩm na brɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Moyisi dɛɛn tɔɔlɩ Wɛ niǝ yam maama na yɩ te tɩn mʋ o brɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam. O laan ma kwe nabalɩ dɩ bʋbalɩ jana o wǝli dɩ na, yɩ o kwe daa, ka yɩrɩ mʋ Yisopi, o vɔ gungun-sʋŋʋ ka ni nɩ o lu jana kam wʋnɩ o ma misi tɔnɔ kʋlʋ Wɛ niǝ yam na pʋpʋnɩ kʋ wʋnɩ tɩn baŋa nɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o misi Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam maama yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: O dɛɛn na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, o ma ta dɩ ba o wɩ: «Jana kantʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ ni-gonim dɩm jɩgɩ kuri sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-dɩ.»

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Moyisi daa ta ma kwe jana kam o ma misi vwe dɩm dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ dɩ wʋnɩ yɩ ba ma zuli Wɛ tɩn.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa vwe dɩm wǝǝnu yɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ, yɩ tɩ maŋɩ sɩ tɩ fɔgɩ tɩ kwɛ dɩ jana kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ wǝǝnu tɩm tɩtɩ na wʋ́ fɔgɩ tɩ kwɛ te tɩn, kʋ fɩn mʋ sɩ ba kɩ kaanɩm dɩlʋ na wʋ́ ta dwe faŋa nyɩm dɩm tɩn ba pa Wɛ.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi nan na zʋ Wɛ te tɩn, kʋ daɩ vwe dɩlʋ nabiinǝ na pugi yɩ dɩ lwǝni Wɛ-sɔŋɔ na yɩ te cɩga cɩga tɩn mʋ o zʋa. O nan sɩɩnɩ o zʋ Wɛ te DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ mʋ, yɩ o zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ dɩbam zǝnǝ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Zwifǝ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm dɛɛn yǝni o maɩ vara jana mʋ o zʋ Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋ bɩnɩ maama o ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ. Kʋ nan na yɩ Zezi, wʋntʋ na zʋ Wɛ te tɩn, o mɛ o tɩtɩ mʋ o kɩ kaanɩm kuni bɩdwɩ o pa-DƖ.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Kʋ ya na daɩ kʋntʋ, Zezi ya wʋ́ ta yaarɩ o tʋ kuni zanzan mʋ, kʋ na zɩgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pulim nɩ sɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm. Kʋ nan na yɩ te tɩn, o laan tu lʋgʋ baŋa kweelim maŋa nɩ mʋ. O tu bɩdwɩ mʋ, yɩ o ba o tɩ o kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ sɩ kʋ pa nabiinǝ lwarɩm saarɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama maŋɩ sɩ o tɩ kuni bɩdwɩ mʋ, sɩ Wɛ laan di o sarɩya.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Zezi Krisi dɩ nan tu o tɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ o ma kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ, sɩ o lɩ nɔɔna zanzan lwarɩm o yagɩ. O nan ta wʋ́ joori o ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Kʋ nan daa daɩ nɔɔna lwarɩm saarɩm ŋwaanɩ, kʋ laan yɩ sɩ o joŋi balʋ na jɩgɩ tɩɩna sɩ o joori o ba tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Wɛ cullu tɩm ya na waɩ tɩ paɩ balʋ na zuli-DƖ tɩn lwarɩm saarɩ dɩ tiǝ, ba ya daa bá bʋŋɩ nɩ ba lwarɩm ta wʋ ba yuu nɩ, yɩ ba ya daa bá ta kaana.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm bá wanɩ dɩ saarɩ dɩ nabalɩ dɩ bʋbalɩ jana.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Amʋ maa wɩ: ‹A Ko Wɛ, nii amʋ da, sɩ a kɩ nmʋ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn, nɩ kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ amʋ taanɩ nmʋ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ faŋa faŋa te tɩn.› »

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: O laan ma daarɩ o ta o wɩ: «Nii amʋ da, sɩ a kɩ nmʋ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.» Kʋntʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ saarɩ DƖ dayigǝ kaanɩm ni dɩm DƖ yagɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ lǝni kaanɩm dɩdoŋ mʋ.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa kaanɩm tiinǝ yǝni ba zɩgɩ wɛɛnɩ mʋ ba tʋŋɩ dɛ maama, ba gʋ vara ba ma kaana maŋa maama, yɩ ba kaanɩm dɩm kʋntʋ nan warɩ lwarɩm dɩ saara.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: yɩ o laan cǝgi maŋa kalʋ Wɛ na wʋ́ kɩ o dʋna maama o nɛ kuri nɩ sɩ o nɔ-ba nɩ tɩga te tɩn.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, o kaanɩ Wɛ kuni bɩdwɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna taa jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo sɩ ba bɩcara kwɛ fasɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm dɩ nan brɩ dɩbam jaja nɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Kʋ dɛ yigǝ kʋ ta kʋ wɩ:

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: «Amʋ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ tagɩ a wɩ: ‹Kantʋ maŋa kam na kɛ, amʋ wʋ́ go ni a pa a nɔɔna bam nɩ: Amʋ wʋ́ pa a ni-taana yam zʋ ba bɩcara, yɩ a pa ya pǝni ba wʋbʋŋa nɩ.› »

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: DƖ daa ta ma ta DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ daa bá guli ba lwarɩm dɩ ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm.»

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, dɩ́ laan jɩgɩ ni sɩ dɩ́ zʋ Wɛ-di-laa cɩga cɩga kam wʋnɩ, Zezi Krisi na tɩga yɩ o jana nuŋi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan mʋ pʋrɩ cwǝ-dʋŋa o pa dɩbam, yɩ kantʋ mʋ paɩ ŋwɩa. O maa kaarɩ gar-jalɩ dɩm dɩ ya na wʋ dɩbam dɩ Wɛ laŋa nɩ tɩn, dɩ o na kwe o yɩra yam o kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩbam jɩgɩ Wɛ kaanɩm tu cɩga cɩga o na nii Wɛ tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ fʋfɔ dɩ́ twɛ Wɛ te dɩ wʋbʋŋ-ŋʋna dɩ baarɩ dɩlʋ na brɩ nɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa fasɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩn. Wɛ kwɛ dɩ́ bɩcara kʋ pa dɩ́ daa ba bʋŋɩ nɩ dɩ́ lwarɩm ta wʋ dɩ́ yuu nɩ, yɩ DƖ zarɩ dɩbam dɩ na-ŋʋna.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ yɩ bʋbwɛa tǝrǝ, DƖ na goni ni DƖ pa dɩbam yɩ DƖ bá fɔgɩ DƖ kwanɩ-dɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ taá ye da-ni nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá zǝni daanɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ, sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa dɩ́ yagɩ da-kikilim Wɛ zulǝ ŋwaanɩ nɩ badaara na yagɩ te tɩn. Nan kwaanɩ-na á tiini á taá wǝli daanɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa á na baarɩ, á na lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm dɛ dɩm twɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn, o ta na paalɩ o kɩ lwarɩm, kaanɩm daa tǝrǝ dɩ na wʋ́ pa o lwarɩm dɩm saarɩ.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ Wɛ cullu tɩlʋ DƖ na kɩ Moyisi jɩŋa nɩ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ na cɔgɩ-tɩ, yɩ nɔɔna bale naa batɔ na yɩ maana tiinǝ, baá gʋ kʋntʋ tu mʋ o kǝm-lɔŋɔ kʋm ŋwaanɩ yɩ ŋwaŋa bá ta wʋra.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan maŋɩ dɩ́ ye wʋlʋ wʋm o na tagɩ o wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɔɔna dɩ ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ pa ba joori ba na kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ ba tɩn.» Kʋ ta pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: «Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ di DƖ nɔɔna sarɩya.»

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Kʋ nan wʋ́ ta tiini kʋ yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ o cɔgɩ yɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ jɩŋa zʋ-o sɩ DƖ pa o na cam tɩn.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
