translation_verse: Maŋa kadoŋ nɩ ba yǝni ba twɩ abam yɩ ba bɛɛsɩ abam nɔn-kɔgɔ yigǝ nɩ. Maŋa kadoŋ nɩ dɩ, á yǝni á sɛ sɩ á tɔgɩ á wǝli balʋ dɩ na nɛ abam yaara yam doŋ tɩn,

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Á yɩ yagɩ á na jɩgɩ baarɩ te tɩn, sɩ kʋʋ́ pa á na nyɔɔrɩ zanzan Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Kʋ daarɩ fɩɩn mʋ sɩ wʋlʋ na lagɩ o ba tɩn laan ba. O bá daanɩ.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na jɩgɩ cɩga amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ tɩn, oó na ŋwɩa cɩga cɩga. O nan na joori kwaga, amʋ bá ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩd-o.»

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan daɩ balʋ na joori kwaga yɩ ba ga ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ yɩ balʋ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ yɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na ŋwɩa DƖ tee nɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ dɩbam dɩ na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ paɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ, Wɛ mɛ DƖ ni-taanɩ mʋ DƖ kɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ wɛyuu maama. Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ sɛ nɩ Wɛ kwe wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na ba naɩ dɩ yiǝ tɩn mʋ DƖ ma kɩ tɩlʋ dɩ́ na waɩ dɩ́ naɩ dɩ yiǝ tɩn.

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Abɛlɩ dɛɛn na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ o kaanɩm dɩm ja kuri dɩ dwǝni Kayin nyɩm dɩm. O wʋ-dɩdʋa kam mʋ pɛ Wɛ wɩ, o yɩ cɩga tu, Wɛ na sɛ o pɛɛra yam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. O daa tǝrǝ yɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa kam ŋwaanɩ nan paɩ o taanɩ ta wʋra.

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Nowe dɩ dɛɛn na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o sɛ DƖ ni. Wɛ dɛɛn tagɩ dɩd-o kʋlʋ na lagɩ kʋ ba kʋ kɩ yɩ nabiinǝ yiǝ ta wʋ nɛ-kʋ tɩn. O ma sɛ Wɛ ni yɩ o pa naboro kamunu, yɩ o dɩ o sɔŋɔ tiinǝ zʋ kʋ wʋ, yɩ Wɛ pa ba lu na-fara bam. O kǝm dɩm kʋntʋ ma brɩ nɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ sɛ Wɛ ni tɩn ba jɩgɩ bʋra. Wɛ ma pa o na cɩga DƖ tee nɩ o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Abraham dɛɛn na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o nuŋi o tɩtɩ tɩʋ kʋm nɩ, o vu jǝgǝ kalʋ Wɛ na goni ni nɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa-o sɩ o dwi tiinǝ taa te tɩn. Wɛ na bǝŋ-o nɩ o nuŋi kʋntʋ tɩn, o sɩɩnɩ o sɛ o maa ve, yɩ o maŋɩ o yǝri je sɩm o na ve tɩn.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: O na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ o vu o zʋʋrɩ tɩʋ kʋm Wɛ ya na maŋɩ DƖ go ni sɩ DƖ wʋ́ pa-o tɩn wʋnɩ nɩ vǝru te. O dɛɛn zʋʋrɩ vwe wʋnɩ mʋ. Yizakɩ dɩ Zakɔbɩ balʋ Wɛ na goni DƖ ni dɩm kʋntʋ dɩ ba dɩ tɩn dɩ zʋʋrɩ vwǝ wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Abraham kaanɩ Sara dɛɛn yɩ ka-dʋgʋ mʋ yɩ o kɛ lʋra. Dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o sɛ nɩ Wɛ bá kwanɩ DƖ ni dɩm DƖ na goni tɩn yɩ o wanɩ o lʋ bu.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋ zɩgɩ nɔn-dʋa kalʋ na yɩ Abraham yɩ o tiini o kwɩn zanzan tɩn yɩra nɩ mʋ Wɛ pɛ o lʋ dwi tiinǝ kɔgɔ kɔgɔ, nɩ calɩcwɩ na dagɩ wɛyuu nɩ naa nɩnɩʋ ni kasʋlʋ-wɩa na dagɩ yɩ kʋ warɩ kʋ ga te tɩn.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ dɛɛn na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ kʋntʋ tɩn nan tɩgɩ yɩ ba wʋ nɛ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ Wɛ na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa-ba tɩn. Ba dɛɛn maŋɩ ba maanɩ nɩ wǝǝnu tɩm dɛ wʋ́ daanɩ yɩ tɩ laan ba, yɩ ba nan ya ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo kʋ ŋwaanɩ. Ba ma ta jaja nɩ ba yɩ vǝrǝ mʋ, ba kugu je tǝri lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Balʋ maama na tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn brɩ nɩ ba daa ta jɩgɩ tɩɩna, sɩ baá na tɩʋ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ ta yɩ ba kugu je tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Ba daa ba jɩgɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ ba na nuŋi kʋ wʋnɩ tɩn wʋbʋŋa ba yuu nɩ. Ba ya na jɩgɩ kʋ wʋbʋŋa, ba ya wʋ́ wanɩ ba na cwǝŋǝ sɩ ba joori.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ te tɩn, ba wʋbʋŋa tiini ya zʋ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na lana kʋ ja gaalɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ sɔŋɔ kʋm. Kʋ ma pa Baŋa-Wɛ jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ ba na bǝ-DƖ nɩ ba Tu Wɛ tɩn. DƖ nan maŋɩ DƖ jɩgɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ DƖ na ti kʋ yigǝ sɩ DƖ pa-ba tɩn.

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn jɩgɩ cɩga nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ wanɩ DƖ bi Yizakɩ DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Kʋ nan na sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ te tɩn nyɩ dɩ DƖ bi-o tʋʋnɩ wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Zakɔbɩ dɩ na tu o ga fɩɩn sɩ o tɩ tɩn, o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o sɔɔlɩ Wɛ o pa o bu Zʋzɛfʋ biǝ bam maama bale. O dɛɛn ma zi o nacǝgǝ o zaŋɩ yɩ o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Zʋzɛfʋ dɩ maŋa na twɛ sɩ o tɩ tɩn, o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o ta dɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam nɩ baá nuŋi Ezipi tɩʋ nɩ. O ma pa-ba ni nɩ, ba na ma nuŋǝ, sɩ ba guri o kwi sɩm Ezipi nɩ ba ja vu ba tɩtɩ tɩʋ.

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Moyisi ko dɩ o nu dɩ dɛɛn na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ ba kwe-o ba sǝgi canɩ sɩtɔ ba na lʋg-o maŋa kalʋ tɩn. Ba ma na nɩ bu wʋm yɩ bu-laa, yɩ ba wʋ kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ ba vɩn pa-farʋ wʋm ni.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Moyisi dɛɛn na kɩ nɔɔnʋ tɩn, kʋ yɩ o na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ o wʋ sɛ sɩ ba taa bǝ-o nɩ Pa-farʋ wʋm bukɔ bu.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: O dɛɛn maa bʋŋɩ nɩ, o na tɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam o na yaara, kʋʋ́ ta garɩ o na yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ yɩ o daarɩ o di ywǝǝni dɩlʋ na bá daanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: O nan bʋŋɩ nɩ, nɔɔna na goon-o nɩ ba na wʋ́ gooni Krisi wʋm Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ tʋŋɩ tɩn, kʋ garɩ o na nɛ jɩjɩgɩrʋ zanzan Ezipi nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ o wʋbʋŋa dɛɛn tigi pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ o na wʋ́ ba o joŋi Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn baŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: O na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ o pa Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam di Pakɩ candiǝ ba sam nɩ. O ma pa ba kɩ jana ba misi ba di sɩm niǝ nɩ, sɩ tʋʋnɩ malɛka kalʋ na wʋ́ ba sɩ ka gʋ bǝkǝri-kwɩn sɩm maama tɩn daa yɩ kɩ ba tɩtɩ biǝ bam kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn mʋ pɛ ba vu ba kaagɩ Zeriko tɩʋ kʋm da yarpɛ, yɩ kʋ kǝbri sɩm laan tʋ tɩga nɩ.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Kaana dɩ ma na ba nɔɔna balʋ ya na tɩga tɩn na joori ba bi. Nɔɔna badonnǝ ma wʋ sɛ sɩ ba vrɩ ba tɩtɩ nɔɔna balʋ na jɩgɩ-ba ba yaarɩ tɩn jɩŋa nɩ. Ba sɛ sɩ ba tɩ, sɩ ba joori ba bi ba na ŋwɩa kalʋ na lana ka dwe tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Ba ma yáalɩ Wɛ nɔɔna badaara dɩ ba na mwanɩ-ba yɩ ba daarɩ ba magɩ-ba te tɩn. Ba ma vɔ nɔɔna badonnǝ dɩ capʋnnʋ yɩ ba kɩ-ba pɩɩna digǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Ba ma dʋlɩ ba badonnǝ dɩ kandwa ba gʋ. Ba ma sɩɩrɩ badaara yɩra kuni bɩle. Ba ma kwe sʋ-lwaanʋ ba ma gʋ ba badonnǝ. Wɛ nɔɔna badonnǝ maa beerǝ jǝgǝ maama, yɩ ba zʋ peeni dɩ bʋnɩ tankwaalʋ yɩranɩ. Zʋrɩ dɩ cam ma jɩgɩ-ba, yɩ nɔɔna dɩ bɛɛsɩ-ba.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam dɛɛn beeri kagʋa yuu nɩ dɩ pweeru yum nɩ mʋ, yɩ ba zʋʋrɩ ba tigi pweeru gugwǝǝru nɩ dɩ bɔɔna wʋnɩ. Lʋgʋ baŋa nan ya wʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa jɩgɩ nɔn-ŋʋna bam kʋntʋ dwi doŋ.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ maama yɩrɩ dɛɛn zaŋɩ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, ba wʋ nɛ Wɛ ya na goni ni sɩ DƖ kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn nan bʋŋɩ sɩ DƖ kɩ kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ lana tɩn mʋ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ, DƖ na lagɩ sɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ maama tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ ji lanyɩranɩ fasɩ DƖ yigǝ nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nan lwarɩ nɩ faŋa faŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm kʋntʋ ba na brɩ nɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn gilimi dɩbam ba brɩ cwǝŋǝ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ yagɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ maama na cʋ dɩbam tɩ pa dɩ́ warɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ Wɛ lanyɩranɩ tɩn, dɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ na jɩgɩ dɩbam tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ duri dɩ pu-dɩa cwǝŋǝ kalʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ yɔɔrɩ dɩ́ taá nii Zezi. Wʋntʋ mʋ pɛ dɩbam puli dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, yɩ o ta wʋ́ pa dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi gurim. O dɛɛn ma vɔ pu-dɩa yɩ o yaarɩ o tɩ tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ. O wʋ kwarɩ cavɩɩra sɩ o tɩ tʋʋnɩ dɩm kʋntʋ dwi, bɛŋwaanɩ o nɛ nɩ Wɛ tiŋi ywǝǝni mʋ sɩ DƖ pa-o. O laan ma daarɩ o vu o jǝni Baŋa-Wɛ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm jazɩm nɩ.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Nan bʋŋɩ-na á nii Zezi na tiini o vɔ pu-dɩa dɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ na cul-o yɩ ba yaar-o te tɩn. Á nan yɩ zaŋɩ á ga baarɩ sɩ á yagɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɔgɩm.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Abam na yǝni á kwaanɩ sɩ á jaŋɩ á cɔgɩ lwarɩm dam te tɩn, á wʋ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa ta wʋ tɩgɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Á na nɛ yaara, kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ ma kwe abam mʋ. Á na yɩ Wɛ biǝ tɩn mʋ paɩ DƖ kwe abam kʋntʋ doŋ. Bu tǝrǝ o ko na ba vaŋɩ o zwɛ sɩ o kʋrɩsɩ.

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan ya na wʋ vaŋɩ abam zwa nɩ DƖ na kɩ DƖ biǝ bam maama te tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ abam daɩ DƖ biǝ cɩga cɩga mʋ, á yɩ bu-tampirǝ mʋ.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Dɩbam kwǝ bam lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn yǝni ba vaŋɩ dɩ́ zwa mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ nɩgɩ-ba. Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na te dɩ́ jwǝǝru tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ tiini dɩ́ sɛ DƖ ni, sɩ dɩ́ laan na ŋwɩa DƖ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ kwǝ bam lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn yǝni ba vaŋɩ dɩ́ zwa bɩna fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ mʋ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn. Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ tɩtɩ nan kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ wǝli dɩbam mʋ, sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ na dɩntʋ wʋ-poŋo kʋm doŋ.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalʋ ba na yǝni ba vaŋɩ dɩ́ zwa tɩn, kʋ yǝni kʋ pa dɩ́ wʋ cɔgɩ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ, zwa vaŋɩm dɩm laan wʋ́ zǝni balʋ dɩ na kwe-ba tɩn dɩ pa ba na nyɔɔrɩ, dɩ ba ŋwɩa na tɔgɩ cɩga yɩ ba jɩgɩ bɩcarɩ-zuru tɩn.

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, na-na dam dɩ baarɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na sɩ á taá zʋʋra, sɩ ywǝǝni taa wʋ á dɩ nɔɔnʋ maama tɩtarɩ nɩ, sɩ á kwǝri á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo Wɛ yigǝ nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ na ba jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo, o bá wanɩ o na Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ-na á cɩ á tɩtɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ ga Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bɩcarɩ yɩ zaŋɩ dɩ ji nɩ vɩan na cana te tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa kʋ loŋi nɔɔna zanzan sɩ kʋ cɔgɩ-ba Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Abam na twɛ Wɛ te tɩn daɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ bam dɛɛn na zɩgɩ piu kʋlʋ tǝŋǝ nɩ yɩ ba yiǝ na-kʋ yɩ ba kwǝri ba waɩ ba dwe-kʋ dɩ ba jɩa te tɩn. Min-fɔrɔ dɩ lim dɛɛn mʋ wʋra, dʋa ma mumunǝ kʋ yuu nɩ.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: Ba ma ni nabɔnɔ wum dɩ kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ. Balʋ na ni kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ tɩn ma loori sɩ ka daa yɩ ŋɔɔnɩ ka wǝli da,

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan daɩ kʋntʋ abam tee nɩ. Abam laan twɛ piu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Siyɔn tɩn mʋ. Kʋ maa yɩ Ŋwɩa Tu Baŋa-Wɛ tʋ-kamunu Zeruzalɛm kʋlʋ na wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Wɛ malɛsɩ kɔgɔ kɔgɔ ma jeeri daanɩ jǝgǝ kam kʋntʋ nɩ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ Zezi wʋlʋ Wɛ na dɛ o ŋwaanɩ DƖ go DƖ ni-dʋʋrɩ dɩm tɩn te mʋ á yiǝ. Kʋ yɩ Zezi jana kam ŋwaanɩ mʋ pɛ á fɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ. O jana kam nan brɩ dɩbam woŋo kʋlʋ na lana kʋ dwe kʋlʋ Abɛlɩ jana kam na brɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Á taá ye sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á vɩn taanɩ dɩm Zezi na ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ abam tɩn. Nɔɔna balʋ dɛɛn na vɩn wʋlʋ na brɩ-ba Wɛ kwǝrǝ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, ba wʋ lugi cam wʋnɩ. Dɩbam dɩ nan na vɩn Zezi, o na wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ yɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ dɩbam tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lu na?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, Wɛ kwǝrǝ dɛɛn pɛ tɩga baŋa sisiŋi, yɩ DƖ laan go DƖ ni DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ daa ta wʋ́ joori a pa tɩga baŋa sisiŋi bɩdwɩ, yɩ kʋ daɩ kantʋ yɩranɩ, kʋ laan wʋ́ wǝli dɩ wɛyuu maama mʋ.»

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan pɛ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ di paarɩ dɩlʋ na bá wanɩ dɩ sisiŋi sɩ dɩ cɔgɩ tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ kɩ Wɛ le, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ pa-DƖ zulǝ yalʋ na tɔgɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ dɩ́ pa-DƖ, sɩ dɩ́ taá kwarɩ-DƖ lanyɩranɩ,

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ á yagɩ da-sono á na yɩ da-ko-biǝ Zezi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Taá ye-na sɩ á taá kɩ vǝrǝ voro. Nɔɔna badonnǝ dɛɛn na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ pɛ ba jeeri Wɛ malɛsɩ mʋ ba sam nɩ, yɩ ba wʋ lwarɩ ba na yɩ balʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Guli-na balʋ na wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ tɩn woŋo, nɩnɛɛnɩ abam dɩ tɔgɩ á wʋ pɩɩna digǝ nɩ mʋ te, sɩ á zǝni-ba. Guli-na balʋ nɔɔna na bɛɛsɩ-ba tɩn dɩ woŋo, nɩnɛɛnɩ abam dɩ tɔgɩ á yaarɩ mʋ te.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Á yɩ pa á ŋwɩa taa tɔgɩ sǝbu-lagɩ. Taá jɩgɩ-na wʋpolo dɩ á na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ ta DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ bá fɔgɩ a yagɩ abam maŋa dɩ maŋa.»

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ dɩbam wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ baarɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá wɩ: «Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ zǝnnu, dɩ́ bá ta kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o kɩ dɩbam kʋlʋkʋlʋ.»

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Yɩ pa-na nɔɔna ma zaasɩm-gɛ ba ganɩ abam dɩ wǝǝnu dwi tǝri tǝri sɩ kʋ pa á ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ nɩ. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ paɩ dɩ́ na baarɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ wʋdiiru culim ŋwaanɩ. Balʋ na tɔgɩ wʋdiiru culim cwǝŋǝ tɩn nan wʋ nɛ zǝnǝ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Kʋ na kɩ te tɩn, Wɛ kaanɩm yuutu wʋm yǝni o gʋ vara mʋ, yɩ o ja ba jana kam o zʋ Wɛ-di-laa kʋm wʋ o ma saarɩ nɔɔna bam lwarɩm. Kʋ daarɩ vara bam tɩtɩ, baá ja nuŋi tɩʋ kʋm daa mʋ ba zwɛ maama.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, pa-na dɩ́ nuŋi dɩ́ vu o te tɩʋ kʋm daa nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ sɛ o goonǝ yam doŋ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, lʋgʋ baŋa yo seeni dɩbam ba jɩgɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na wʋ́ ta yɩ dɩ́ kugu je maŋa maama tɩn, dɩ́ nan tɩɩnɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na lagɩ kʋ ba tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Á yɩ swe sɩ á taá kɩ kǝm-laarʋ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá zǝni daanɩ, sɩ kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kaanɩm dɩlʋ na poli Wɛ wʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Taá nɩgɩ-na á yigǝ tiinǝ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá sɛ ba ni, sɩ bantʋ mʋ nii abam na wʋ́ ta ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ te tɩn baŋa nɩ, yɩ baá ba ba zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ sɩ ba brɩ ba na tʋŋɩ kʋlʋ abam ŋwaanɩ tɩn. Nan taá nɩgɩ-ba sɩ ba wanɩ ba tʋŋɩ dɩ wʋpolo. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa ba wʋ cɔgɩ, yɩ kʋ daa bá ta jɩgɩ zǝnǝ kʋ pa abam.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Amʋ nan tiini a loori abam sɩ á taá warɩ Wɛ á pa-nɩ, sɩ kʋ pa a na cwǝŋǝ a joori abam te lele.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ zǝni abam sɩ á wanɩ á kɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama na tɔgɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa tɩn, yɩ DƖ wʋ́ tɔgɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ DƖ kwɛ dɩbam nɩ kʋ na wʋ́ poli DƖ wʋ te tɩn. Zezi mʋ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, a loori abam sɩ á zuri á yɩra á cǝgi amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ sɩ a ma pa á na baarɩ tɩn. Amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ tɩn nan ba dwara.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Amʋ lagɩ sɩ a pa abam lwarɩ nɩ ba yagɩ dɩ́ ko-bu Timoti yɩ o nuŋi pɩɩna digǝ nɩ. O nan na tu amʋ te lɩla, a laan wʋ́ pa dɩ́ tɔgɩ daanɩ dɩ́ ba dɩ́ na abam.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Jɔɔnɩ-na á yigǝ tiinǝ bam dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama á pa dɩbam. Yitali tiinǝ bam dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam maama yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Amʋ Zakɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ dɩ dɩbam Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ. A jɔɔnɩ abam balʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ á jagɩ á wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa je maama nɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Kwaanɩ-na á tiini á zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa sɩ á yɩ joori kwaga, sɩ kʋ laan wʋ́ pa á ji nɔn-ŋʋna yɩ á wʋbʋŋa bɩ fasɩ dɩ Wɛ tɔgɩm, sɩ á yɩ ga kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ maama nan na yǝri kʋlʋ na lana sɩ o kɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o loori swan mʋ Wɛ tee nɩ. Wɛ yǝni DƖ paɩ nɔɔna maama dɩ wʋpolo mʋ, yɩ DƖ ba vɩn nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ. Nmʋ na loori swan DƖ tee nɩ, DƖ wʋ́ pa-m.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan na loori woŋo Wɛ tee nɩ, sɩ n ta n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa nɩ nń na-kʋ. Yɩ ta n jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa kʋ baŋa nɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ bʋbwɛa tu nyɩ nɩ viu na fuli na kʋ pa ba ve yigǝ dɩ kwaga te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tu jɩgɩ wʋrʋ tɩle mʋ, yɩ o za o wʋbʋŋa dɩ kʋlʋ maama o na bʋŋɩ sɩ o kɩ tɩn. Nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ doŋ yɩ taa bʋŋɩ nɩ oó na woŋo dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm tee nɩ. Yinigǝ tiinǝ dɩ nadunǝ na maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nmʋ wʋlʋ na tɔgɩ Zezi yɩ yinigǝ jɩgɩ-m tɩn, sɩ n ta n jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ Wɛ na pɛ n jɩgɩ yɩrɩ DƖ tee nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Wɩa nan na bɩga, tɩ wʋ́ kwaarɩ mʋ tɩ siiri tɩ tɩ, yɩ tɩ lam dɩm je. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ nadunǝ na wʋ́ ba ba tɩ ba jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm lagɩm wʋnɩ te tɩn. Kʋlʋ na maŋɩ nɔɔna sɩ ba kɩ lwarɩm tɩn

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na wʋ cam wʋnɩ yɩ o zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ pu-dɩa sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi kweelim tɩn mʋ jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo. Bɛŋwaanɩ, cam dɩm na kɛ, o laan wʋ́ na pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa cɩga cɩga tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ. Ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ mʋ Wɛ goni ni sɩ DƖ pa balʋ maama na so-DƖ tɩn.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na nɛ maŋɩm, o yɩ zaŋɩ o ta nɩ Wɛ mʋ maŋ-o, sɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ kʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ maŋɩ Wɛ sɩ DƖ tusi, yɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ bá maŋɩ nɔɔnʋ sɩ o tusi.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Woŋo kʋlʋ na maŋɩ nɔɔnʋ tɩn yɩ o tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ. Yantʋ mʋ paɩ o fra zʋʋrɩ wo-balwaarʋ, yɩ ya gan-o ya paɩ o tʋɩ cɩgɩrʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Nmʋ na sɛ n tɔgɩ n wʋbʋŋ-balwaarʋ tɩm, tɩ laan wʋ́ pa n kɩ wo-lwaanʋ mʋ, yɩ wo-lwaanʋ tɩm na puli tɩ daga, tɩ laan wʋ́ ja-m tɩ zʋ tʋʋnɩ wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: A ko-bu-sonnu-ba, á yɩ zaŋɩ á ganɩ á tɩtɩ.

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ bam na zaŋɩ tɩn bá wanɩ o kɩ wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ na sui Wɛ wʋ tɩn.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ nɩ o tɔgɩ Wɛ yɩ o warɩ o ni-taanɩ o ja, kʋntʋ tu ganɩ o tɩtɩ mʋ yɩ o Wɛ tɔgɩm dɩm yɩ kafɛ mʋ.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ nan na lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ-DƖ te tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá zǝni bɩtara dɩ kadǝnǝ balʋ na yaarɩ tɩn, sɩ dɩ́ kwaanɩ dɩ́ cɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm. Wɛ tɔgɩm dɩm kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ tiini kʋ lamma yɩ tusim tǝri kʋ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam yɩ balʋ na sɩɩnɩ á sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ paarɩ zulǝ tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá kuri nɔɔna daanɩ dɩ á na zuli-ba te tɩn.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Abam na jeeri daanɩ sɩ á warɩ Wɛ, kʋ ba dwe sɩ nɔɔna bale ba abam te. Dɩdʋa maa yɩ nadum o zʋ gwar-ŋʋnnʋ, yɩ o kɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa jafʋlɩ o jɩŋa nɩ. O doŋ wʋm maa yɩ yinigǝ tu, yɩ o zʋ gan-zwaanʋ.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Kʋ waɩ sɩ á jeeri nadum wʋm lanyɩranɩ yɩ á pa-o jǝŋǝ je, á daarɩ á ta dɩ yinigǝ tu wʋm nɩ, o taa zɩgɩ daa nɩ, naa o jǝni tɩga nɩ á nɛ niǝ nɩ.

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Á na pɔɔrɩ-ba daanɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, kʋ brɩ nɩ á kuri nɔɔna daanɩ mʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ wʋbʋŋ-lwaanʋ mʋ paɩ á pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna daanɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: A ko-bu-sonnu-ba, fɔgɩ-na á cǝgi. Wɛ mʋ sɩɩnɩ DƖ kuri balʋ na yɩ yinigǝ tiinǝ nabiinǝ yibiyǝ nɩ tɩn, sɩ ba taa yɩ nadunǝ DƖ tee nɩ ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ ba tɔgɩ ba wǝli DƖ paarɩ dɩlʋ DƖ na maŋɩ DƖ go ni sɩ DƖ pa balʋ na so-DƖ tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Bantʋ mʋ jɩgɩ Zezi yɩr-ŋʋm dɩlʋ ba na bǝ abam nɩ o biǝ tɩn ba twɩa.

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ Baŋa-Wɛ ni dɩlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ dɩ wɩ: «Ta n soe n doŋ nɩ n tɩtɩ te» tɩn, á kɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, á na pɔɔrɩ nɔɔna daanɩ dɩ á na zuli-ba te tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ á kɩ lwarɩm mʋ, yɩ Wɛ niǝ yam brɩ nɩ á kɩ á cɔgɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam maama yɩ o daarɩ o cɔgɩ ya dɩdʋa yɩranɩ, kʋ brɩ nɩ o cɔgɩ ya maama mʋ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɛ mʋ pɛ DƖ ni DƖ wɩ: «Yɩ zaŋɩ n kɩ boorim.» Dɩntʋ nan ta mʋ wɩ: «Yɩ gʋ nɔɔnʋ.» Mʋ kʋ kuri, n na maŋɩ n wʋ kɩ boorim, yɩ n na gʋ nɔɔnʋ, kʋ brɩ nɩ n ta cɔgɩ Wɛ ni mʋ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, nɔɔnʋ na ba jɩgɩ o donnǝ ŋwaŋa, Wɛ na wʋ́ di kʋntʋ tu sarɩya maŋa kalʋ tɩn, DƖ bá duri o dɩ yibwǝnǝ. Wʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ o donnǝ ŋwaŋa tɩn, Wɛ dɩ wʋ́ duri o yibwǝnǝ sɩ o yɩ na cam. Wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn kɩ kǝm-laarʋ mʋ

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, nɔɔnʋ na tɛ o wɩ, wʋm kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, yɩ o laan ba kɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn, kʋ jɩgɩ kuri na? O Wɛ tɔgɩm dɩm kʋntʋ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ vrɩ-o dɩ yagɩ na?

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: yɩ nmʋ na tagɩ dɩd-o n wɩ, o ve sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ zǝn-o DƖ pa o na gɔrɔ dɩ o ni-wʋdiu, yɩ n laan daarɩ n wʋ pɛ-o kʋlʋ o na lagɩ tɩn, kʋ jɩgɩ kuri na?

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ waɩ o tɛ nɩ, nɔɔna babam kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa mʋ dɩ Wɛ, yɩ badaara kɩ kǝm-laarʋ. Amʋ nan na lǝri te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: «Nmʋ na ba kɩ kǝm-laarʋ tɩn, nń kɩ ta mʋ n brɩ nɩ n sɩɩnɩ n kɩ n wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ? Kʋ nan na yɩ amʋ, aá ma a kǝm-laarʋ tɩm mʋ a brɩ nɩ a sɩɩnɩ a kɩ a wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ.»

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Nmʋ sɛ nɩ Wɛ yɩ dɩdʋa yɩranɩ mʋ na? N na sɛ kʋntʋ, kʋ lana. Ciciri tɩtɩ dɩ ye kʋntʋ, yɩ kʋ paɩ sɩ yɩra saɩ.

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Kʋ brɩ nɩ o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn dɩdaanɩ o kǝm-laarʋ tɩm maama tɔgɩ daanɩ mʋ. O kǝm-laarʋ tɩm mʋ pɛ o Wɛ tɔgɩm dɩm ja kuri.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ, kʋlʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ kɩ dɩ kʋ na wɩ: «Abraham kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ, yɩ DƖ pa o na cɩga kʋ ŋwaanɩ». Ba maa bǝ-o nɩ «Wɛ ciloŋ».

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa á lwarɩ nɩ, kʋ yɩ nɔɔnʋ tɩtʋŋa mʋ wǝli da kʋ paɩ o na cɩga Wɛ tee nɩ, sɩ kʋ daɩ o na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ tɩn yɩranɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Dɩbam maama yǝni dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ tusǝ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na ba kɩ o tusǝ o ni-taanɩ wʋnɩ tɩn yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ, yɩ o waɩ o tɩtɩ o jaanɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na yǝni o lagɩ o di sisǝŋǝ, oó kwe gara mʋ o kɩ ka ni nɩ, sɩ o wanɩ o pa ka vu mɛ dɩ mɛ o na lagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Nan bʋŋɩ-na á nii, naboro na yɩ kamunu te yɩ vu-dɩʋ ta yǝni kʋ jɩgɩ-kʋ kʋ maga, yɩ wʋlʋ na co-kʋ tɩn ta waɩ o ma nanyuŋ-balaŋa o maa paɩ kʋ ve o na lagɩ mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ dindǝlimi dɩ nan nyɩ dɩ mini mʋ, yɩ dɩ su dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-lwaanʋ tɩm dwi maama. Dɩ yɩ yɩra yam daa dɩdʋa mʋ, yɩ dɩ wo-lwaanʋ tɩm laan waɩ tɩ loŋi yɩra yam maama. Dindǝlimi jɩgɩ mini mʋ dɩ maa zwɛ nɔɔnʋ dɩ o ŋwɩa maama dɩ pa ka ba lana. Mini dɩm kʋntʋ nan nuŋi sʋtaanɩ te mʋ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Nabiinu waɩ wǝǝnu dwi maama. Kʋ na yɩ ga-vara dɩ zunǝ dɩ tɩga wo-vǝǝlu dɩ kale, o sɩɩnɩ o wanɩ tɩ maama.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dindǝlimi, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na waɩ o dindǝlimi. Dɩ yɩ wo-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na warɩ kʋ cɩ tɩn mʋ, yɩ dɩ kwǝri dɩ jɩgɩ coŋo kʋlʋ na gʋɩ nɔɔna tɩn.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, tiǝ dɩ cɔgɩm maama nuŋi ni dɩm kʋntʋ dɩdʋa wʋnɩ mʋ. A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ wʋ maŋɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Buli-yi dɩdʋa bá wanɩ dɩ taa buri na-ywǝnǝ dɩ na-cɛɛra dɩ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kapʋrʋ bá wanɩ kʋ lǝ swan. Kakɔnɔ dɩ nan bá wanɩ kʋ lǝ mɔɔla. Kʋ nan yɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ dɩ n na bá wanɩ n mɔ na-ŋʋna bwǝru wʋnɩ te tɩn. Swan yalʋ na nuŋi Wɛ te tɩn

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na wʋ abam wʋnɩ yɩ o jɩgɩ swan dɩ yǝno, kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o taa tɔgɩ cwǝ-laa mʋ, sɩ o tu o tɩtɩ o kɩ kǝm-laarʋ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ o jɩgɩ swan.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Abam nan na jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ pu-sɩŋa yɩ á lagɩ á yɩranɩ zǝnǝ, sɩ á yɩ zaŋɩ á brɩ á tɩtɩ nɩ á jɩgɩ swan. Á na kɩ kʋntʋ, á fɔgɩ vwan mʋ sɩ kʋ daɩ cɩga.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Swan yantʋ doŋ daɩ swan yalʋ na nuŋi Wɛ te tɩn. Ya yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm mʋ. Ya maa yɩ nabiinǝ swan yalʋ na nuŋi sʋtaanɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, jǝgǝ kalʋ maama nɔɔna na lagɩ ba tɩtɩ yɩranɩ zǝnǝ yɩ ba jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ dɩ ba donnǝ tɩn, dáanɩ mʋ vuvugǝ dɩ kǝm-lwaanʋ dwi maama wʋra.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Bɛɛ mʋ paɩ jara dɩdaanɩ kantɔgɔ yǝni kʋ wʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ? Kʋ yɩ á fra na zʋʋrɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩm mʋ te kʋ jɩgɩ á bɩcara kʋ yaara, yɩ kʋ paɩ jara wʋ á wʋnɩ.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á paɩ á fra mʋ zʋʋrɩ wǝǝnu yɩ á nan ba na-tɩ. Kʋ ma pa á lagɩ sɩ á gʋ nɔɔna. Á yi tiini dɩ su wǝǝnu zanzan yɩ á warɩ-tɩ á na. Kʋntʋ mʋ paɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ jara tui. Á ba jɩgɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ á na lagɩ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ á wʋ loori Wɛ sɩ DƖ pa abam.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Abam nan na maŋɩ á loori Wɛ dɩ, DƖ bá pa abam, bɛŋwaanɩ á ma wʋbʋŋ-lwaanʋ mʋ á loorǝ. Á loori sɩ á taá ma kɩ á fra na zʋʋrɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Abam ba tɔgɩ Wɛ dɩ cɩga. Á yǝri nɩ á fra na zʋ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu á yɩ Wɛ dʋna mʋ na? Wʋlʋ maama na pɛ o fra zʋ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu tɩm tɩn jigi Wɛ dʋm mʋ.

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nan mʋ kɩ dɩbam yu-yoŋo kʋ ja gaalɩ. Kʋ daa ta pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Wɛ vɩn balʋ na yɩ kamun-nyɩna tɩn, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ zǝni balʋ na tu ba tɩtɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Fʋfɔ-na á twɛ Wɛ, sɩ DƖ dɩ wʋ́ twɛ abam. Abam lwarɩm-kǝrǝ-ba, lɩ-na á jɩa wo-lwaanʋ dwi maama baŋa nɩ. Abam pipiri-nyɩna-ba, zarɩ-na á bɩcara sɩ á daa yɩ taá jɩgɩ wʋrʋ tɩle.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Tu-na á tɩtɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yigǝ nɩ, sɩ oó ja abam o pa á zaŋɩ. Á yɩ zaŋɩ á taá co daanɩ

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á yɩ taá ŋɔɔnɩ wo-balwaarʋ da-yɩranɩ. Wʋlʋ maama na ŋɔɔnɩ wo-balɔrɔ o ko-bu yɩra nɩ naa o cog-o tɩn, kʋntʋ tu ŋɔɔnɩ o cɔgɩ Wɛ niǝ yam mʋ yɩ o yáalɩ-ya. Nmʋ nan na yáalɩ Wɛ niǝ yam, kʋ brɩ nɩ n daa n ba tɔgɩ-ya mʋ, yɩ n ta kwǝri n brɩ nɩ nmʋ mʋ yɩ sarɩya-diru.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Wɛ yɩranɩ mʋ te DƖ niǝ yam, yɩ DƖ tɔgɩ-ya DƖ ma di nɔɔna taanɩ. Dɩntʋ yɩranɩ mʋ waɩ DƖ vrɩ nɔɔna DƖ yaga, naa DƖ cɔgɩ-ba ba vɩʋn ŋwaanɩ. Nmʋ nan bʋŋɩ nɩ n yɩ wɔɔ mʋ, sɩ n di n doŋ taanɩ? Yɩ kɩ-na kamunni á swe Wɛ ni nɩ

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Fɔgɩ-na á cǝgi, abam balʋ na yǝni á tɛ á wɩ: «Zɩm naa jwaanɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ vu tɩʋ kʋdoŋ dɩ́ kɩ pipiu da bɩm dɩ́ na sǝbu» tɩn.

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Á yǝni á tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ yɩ á yǝri tɩga na wʋ́ pʋʋrɩ sɩ á ŋwɩa taa yɩ te. Á ŋwɩa kam nan nyɩ dɩ kunu na li yɩ kʋ bá daanɩ kʋ kɛ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Kʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ á taá tɛ nɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ na sɛ yɩ dɩ́ jwa ta ŋwɩ, dɩ́ wʋ́ kɩ kʋlʋ dɩ́ na bʋŋɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan yɩ á pa á tɩtɩ kamunni mʋ dɩ á na wʋ́ kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɩn. Kamunni dɩm kʋntʋ dwi maama nan ba lana.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na ye kʋlʋ na lana sɩ o kɩ tɩn, o na wʋ kɩ, kʋ tu kɩ lwarɩm mʋ.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam balʋ na yɩ nadunǝ tɩn, fɔgɩ á cǝgi-na. Taá keeri-na á coosǝ dɩ lɛɛrʋ tɩlʋ na lagɩ tɩ ba abam baŋa tɩn.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Abam jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm maama wʋ́ pɔ, yɩ cambʋrɩ dɩ wʋ́ di á gwaarʋ tɩm.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Abam sǝbu-sɩŋa kam dɩ á sǝbu kʋm maama wʋ́ sʋŋɩ. Sarɩya dɛ dɩm nɩ kʋ sʋŋɩm dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ brɩ nɩ á kɩ á tusi, yɩ dɩntʋ ta wʋ́ di abam yɩra yam nɩ mini te. Lʋgʋ baŋa tiim da yam nan twɛ, yɩ abam ta fɔgɩ á tiŋi á jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm mʋ.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Abam ta pini balʋ na tʋŋɩ á karɩ sɩm nɩ ba pa abam tɩn, á ba sɛ sɩ á ŋwɩ-ba. Cǝgi-na á nii ba na pʋʋna te tɩn. Balʋ na kɩ abam wʋdiiru tɩm ba kɩ digǝ nɩ tɩn kǝrǝ kam tʋ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ zwɛ nɩ.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Á ŋwɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ paarɩ wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ á kɩ á wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te. Á di á nuǝ nɩ ba na kɔnɩ varɩm sɩ ba gʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ abam dɩ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-zuru mʋ sɩ á vɔ á wʋ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm bá daanɩ yɩ o ba.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, á yɩ taá pʋʋnɩ daanɩ, sɩ kʋ pa á ga bʋra Wɛ tee nɩ. Nii-na, kʋ twɛ kʋ ti sɩ Wɛ di dɩbam taanɩ.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, guli-na Wɛ nijoŋnǝ balʋ dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ DƖ kwǝrǝ kam tɩn woŋo. Ba dɛɛn nɛ yaara zanzan yɩ ba vɔ ba wʋrʋ dɩ wʋ-zuru. Kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ abam dɩ lwǝni bantʋ na kɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ, á yɩ taá tɛ á duǝ. Yɩ du-na dɩ Wɛ naa tɩga naa dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ dɩ. Á pa-na á ɛɛn taa yɩ ɛɛn, sɩ á awo taa yɩ awo, sɩ kʋ yɩ pa Wɛ di á sarɩya.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na wʋ cam wʋnɩ, sɩ o loori Wɛ. Abam wʋlʋ nan na jɩgɩ wʋpolo, sɩ o taa leeni o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ nan na ba jɩgɩ yazurǝ, sɩ o bǝŋi Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa bam, sɩ ba ba ba kɩ nugǝ o yuu nɩ ba loori Wɛ ba pa-o dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ba na kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa ba loori Wɛ kʋntʋ doŋ, nɔɔnʋ wʋm wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ o na yazurǝ. Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm wʋ́ pa o wǝri, yɩ o na kɩ lwarɩm dɩlʋ maama tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ DƖ ma cɛ-o.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá vɩɩrɩ á tɛ á lwarɩm mʋ á brɩ daanɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá loori Wɛ á pa daanɩ, sɩ Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ. Nɔn-ŋʋm Wɛ-loro tiini kʋ dana lanyɩranɩ, kʋ waɩ kʋ paɩ wo-kamunǝ kɩa.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Guli-na Eli dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn. O dɩ yɩ nabiinu mʋ nɩ dɩbam te, yɩ o loori Wɛ dɩ o wʋ maama sɩ dʋa yɩ zaŋɩ ka nɩ, yɩ ka sɩɩnɩ ka wʋ nɩgɩ bɩna yatɔ dɩ canɩ sɩrdʋ.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: O daa ma joori o loori Wɛ, yɩ ka laan ba ka nɩ, yɩ tɩga baŋa wǝǝnu maama joori tɩ puli tɩ nuŋi tɩ kɩ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, abam wʋlʋ na ywǝri cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ yɩ o doŋ na wanɩ o pa o joori o ba ka wʋnɩ, kʋ lana.

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Á nan taá ye nɩ, wʋlʋ na wanɩ o pa lwarɩm kǝru joori o ba cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam wʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋm kʋntʋ vrɩ lwarɩm kǝru wʋm tʋʋnɩ jɩŋa nɩ, yɩ Wɛ yagɩ o wo-lwaanʋ tɩlʋ zanzan o na kɩ tɩn DƖ ma cɛ-o.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ mʋ dɛ yigǝ DƖ kɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa nɩ sɩ DƖ kuri abam kʋntʋ, yɩ DƖ tɔgɩ DƖ Joro kʋm ŋwaanɩ DƖ pa á ji nɔn-ŋʋna balʋ na yɩ DƖ nyɩm tɩn. Wɛ nan kɩ kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ pa á taá sɛ Zezi Krisi ni mʋ, sɩ DƖ fɔgɩ abam Zezi jana kam na nuŋi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo kʋ ja gaalɩ. Dɩ́ na jɩgɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ te tɩn

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Pa-na dɩ́ taá kɩ Wɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Yuutu Zezi Krisi Ko tɩn le. Dɩntʋ mʋ tiini DƖ yɩ ŋwaŋa tu, yɩ DƖ pa dɩ́ jɩgɩ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa, dɩ DƖ na pɛ Zezi Krisi bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ tɩɩna DƖ tee nɩ maŋa maama.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: DƖ maa maɩ DƖ dam dɩm DƖ yɩrɩ abam, á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi lʋgʋ baŋa tiim da yam, sɩ DƖ laan joŋi abam jaja.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ maa paɩ á jɩgɩ wʋpolo lanyɩranɩ, dɩ cam dwi tǝri tǝri ya zɩ maŋɩ abam zɩm yɩ kʋ pa á wʋ cɔgɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ dɩ.

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ cana yam kʋntʋ, kʋ yɩ sɩ ya maŋɩ abam mʋ ya nii á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn. Kʋ na yɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa, ba yǝni ba maɩ mini mʋ ba ma maŋɩ-ka sɩ ba nii ka lana na? Abam nan na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ te tɩn tiini kʋ dwe sǝbu-sɩŋa kalʋ na wʋ́ ba ka cɔgɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, cam na maŋɩ abam yɩ á ta na zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ, kʋʋ́ pa á na zulǝ dɩ tiǝ Wɛ tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ Zezi Krisi na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Abam yi ta wʋ nɛ-o, yɩ á nan so-o. Á maa kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o, yɩ á nan daa ta ba na-o lele kʋntʋ. Kʋ ma pa á tiini á jɩgɩ wʋpolo zanzan yɩ kʋ bá wanɩ kʋ ta dɩ nabiinǝ taanɩ,

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn tiini ba kwaanɩ ba tɔgɩ kʋ nɛ lanyɩranɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ Wɛ na wʋ́ vrɩ DƖ nɔɔna bam te tɩn. Ba dɛɛn ma maŋɩ ba wuuri ba ta Wɛ na wʋ́ pa abam pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi Joro kʋm maa wʋ ba tee nɩ yɩ kʋ pa ba wuuri ba lwarɩ nɩ Krisi wʋm wʋ́ ba o na yaara sɩ o laan daarɩ o na paarɩ-zulǝ Wɛ tee nɩ. Ba maa tiini ba kwaanɩ sɩ ba lwarɩ maŋa kam kʋntʋ dɩ kʋ na wʋ́ kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn ma pa DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam lwarɩ nɩ, DƖ na pɛ-ba kwǝrǝ kalʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ ba tɩtɩ ŋwaanɩ, kʋ yɩ abam ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Ba dɛɛn na brɩ cɩga kalʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ Zezi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ o tɩntʋŋna bam laan na tɔɔlɩ ba brɩ abam zɩm tɩn. Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ pɛ DƖ Joro kʋm ba bantʋ te, yɩ ba wanɩ ba brɩ abam kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam kʋntʋ. Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm dɩ nan lagɩ sɩ sɩ lwarɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ kuri na yɩ te tɩn. Wɛ na lagɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo te tɩn

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Taá sɛ-na á Ko Wɛ ni. Á daa yɩ taá ŋwɩ nɩ á dɛɛn na wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam yɩ á fra zʋʋrɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Á nan taá ŋwɩ dɩ wʋ-poŋo woŋo maama wʋnɩ, nɩ á Ko Wɛ dɩlʋ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn na jɩgɩ wʋ-poŋo te tɩn.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Kʋ nan maŋɩ kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Á taá yɩ wʋ-poŋo tiinǝ, sɩ amʋ Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu mʋ.»

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Abam na yǝni á loori Wɛ, á bǝ-DƖ nɩ á Ko mʋ, yɩ dɩntʋ nan mʋ wʋ́ di nabiinǝ maama sarɩya sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba tɩtʋŋa na yɩ te tɩn, yɩ DƖ ba kuri nɔɔna daanɩ. Kʋntʋ, á ta na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ maŋa kalʋ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá kwarɩ Wɛ kʋlʋ maama á na kɩ tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Á ye nɩ Wɛ vrɩ abam sɩ á daa yɩ taá tɔgɩ cullu tɩlʋ na nuŋi á nabaara bam jɩŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ. Wɛ na lɩ abam wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm kʋntʋ wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ lʋgʋ baŋa sǝbu naa sǝbu-sɩŋa, wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na waɩ tɩ cɔgɩ tɩn, mʋ DƖ mɛ DƖ ŋwɩ DƖ vrɩ abam.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ kuri wʋntʋ mʋ kʋ loori lʋgʋ pulim, sɩ o vrɩ nɔɔna ba lwarɩm wʋnɩ. Kʋ daarɩ lʋgʋ baŋa kweelim maŋa kam laan nan na yi tɩn, Wɛ pɛ á lwar-o, sɩ o vrɩ abam.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Á nan dɛ Zezi ŋwaanɩ mʋ á kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ. Dɩntʋ mʋ bi-o DƖ pa o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ pa o na paarɩ-zulǝ. Kʋ ma paɩ á sɩɩnɩ á jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ tɩɩna Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn mʋ pɛ á bɩcara fɔgɩ ya kwɛ, kʋ pa á jɩgɩ sono cɩga cɩga dɩ á ko-biǝ balʋ na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna tɩn. Kʋntʋ tɩn, á taá tiini á soe daanɩ dɩ á bɩcara maama.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam, kantʋ wʋ́ ta wʋra sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.» Kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ ba na brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ á ja á tɩtɩ dɩ pu-sɩŋa dwi maama dɩ sɩsɩɩna, sɩ á yɩ taá yɩ pipiri-nyɩna, naa á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-gʋʋ, naa á taá yɩ bɩbarɩ-nyɩna.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Pa-na á fra taa zʋʋrɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam yɩranɩ, nɩ bu-sɩsɩŋa fra na zʋʋrɩ o nu yɩlɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa á wʋbʋŋa bɩ dɩ Wɛ cɩga kam, sɩ á na vrɩm fasɩ.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Nan twɛ-na dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi, sɩ wʋm mʋ yɩ ŋwɩa tu, yɩ o nyɩ dɩ kandwɛ dɩlʋ nabiinǝ na vɩn tɩn. Wɛ nan maŋɩ DƖ kuri wʋntʋ mʋ, yɩ o jɩgɩ kuri dɩ DƖ kʋ ja gaalɩ.

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ abam balʋ na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o tɩn, o jɩgɩ kuri zanzan dɩ abam. Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ balʋ na vɩ-o tɩn, kʋ nyɩ dɩ kʋ na pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Kandwɛ dɩlʋ lwara na vɩn tɩn laan mʋ joori dɩ ba dɩ ji kandwɛ dɩlʋ na paɩ digǝ kam dana yɩ ka zɩga lana tɩn.»

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn ya daɩ Wɛ nɔɔna, yɩ á laan ba á ji DƖ nɔɔna. Abam dɛɛn ya daɩ balʋ Wɛ na jɩgɩ á ŋwaŋa tɩn, yɩ DƖ laan ba DƖ duri á ŋwaŋa. Dɩ́ na maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩa taa yɩ te nɔɔna maama yigǝ nɩ tɩn

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, abam na yɩ vǝrǝ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ á ba jɩgɩ kugu je tɩn, a loori abam sɩ á ja á tɩtɩ dɩ á fra na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ tɩn. Tɩntʋ mʋ kwaanɩ sɩ tɩ cɔgɩ á ŋwɩa.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Á pa-na á kikiǝ maama taa lana balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Wɛ tɩn tɩtarɩ nɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ, ba na yáalɩ abam ba wɩ á yɩ wo-lwaanʋ kǝrǝ, ba laan wʋ́ ba ba lwarɩ á kǝm-laarʋ na yɩ te tɩn, yɩ ba daarɩ ba zuli Wɛ maŋa kalʋ DƖ na lagɩ DƖ ba tɩn.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Á taá zuli nɔɔna maama. Á taá soe balʋ maama na yɩ á ko-biǝ Zezi cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn. Taá kwarɩ-na Wɛ. Á taá zuli-na Pa-farʋ wʋm. Dɩbam maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ lwǝni Zezi mʋ dɩ́ yaara wʋnɩ

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Abam balʋ na yɩ tɩntʋŋna tɩn maŋɩ sɩ á taá sɛ á yum tiinǝ niǝ, sɩ á taá nɩgɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ, kʋ na yɩ balʋ na jɩgɩ wʋ-bono yɩ ba kɩ abam lanyɩranɩ, naa kʋ zɩ yɩ balʋ kǝm na cana dɩ abam tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ba na yaarɩ abam vwan yaara á na sɛ Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ yɩ á vɔ pu-dɩa, kʋntʋ yɩ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Abam nan na kɩ balɔrɔ yɩ ba vaŋɩ á zwɛ kʋ ŋwaanɩ, yɩ á na maŋɩ á vɔ á wʋ dɩ yaara yam kʋntʋ dɩ, kʋ jɩgɩ kuri na? Kʋ daarɩ á na kɩ lanyɩranɩ yɩ ba ta yaarɩ abam, yɩ á na vɔgɩ á wʋ, kʋntʋ lana Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ á vɔ á wʋ mʋ yaara wʋnɩ. Zezi Krisi tɩtɩ dɛɛn maŋɩ o yaarɩ abam ŋwaanɩ, sɩ kʋ pa á taá tɔgɩ o na-bwǝrǝ mʋ á lwǝni o dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn:

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ nan wʋ kɩ lwarɩm dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ, yɩ o ni-taanɩ ba jɩgɩ vwan.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dɛɛn maa jɩg-o ba twɩa, yɩ o wʋ tɔgɩ o twɩ-ba. Ba ma kwǝri ba bɛɛs-o, yɩ o wʋ lǝri-ba balɔrɔ. O nan kɩ o tɩtɩ mʋ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ, dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩlʋ na tɔgɩ cɩga DƖ ma di nɔɔna sarɩya tɩn.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Abam ya nyɩ dɩ peeni sɩlʋ na je tɩn mʋ. Á laan ma joori á ba á kɩ á tɩtɩ Zezi jɩŋa nɩ, wʋlʋ na yɩ abam nayɩrʋ yɩ o nii abam baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Abam balʋ na yɩ kaana tɩn, abam dɩ maŋɩ sɩ á taá sɛ á banna ni kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ pa á banna bam badaara ya na vɩn Wɛ taanɩ dɩm, sɩ ba laan na á kǝm-laarʋ tɩm, sɩ kʋ pa ba ba ba sɛ Wɛ, dɩ á na maŋɩ á wʋ puri á ni dɩ.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ́ maanɩ ba lwarɩ nɩ á nɩgɩ-ba yɩ á sɩɩnɩ á tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ.

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: Abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á kwɛ á bɩcara mʋ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ wʋ-bono dɩ wʋ-zuru. Á na fɔgɩ á kwɛ á bɩcara yɩ ya lamma kʋntʋ doŋ, ya lam dɩm daa bá cɔgɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ ta jɩgɩ kuri lanyɩranɩ Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa kaana balʋ ya na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ ba jɩgɩ tɩɩna dɩ Wɛ tɩn dɩ dɛɛn kwɛ ba bɩcara kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ, dɩ ba na sɛ ba banna ni tɩn.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Sara dɛɛn kɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, yɩ o sɛ o barʋ Abraham ni, dɩ o na bǝ-o nɩ o yuutu tɩn. Abam dɩ nan yɩ wʋntʋ biǝ mʋ, dɩ á na kɩ kǝm-laarʋ yɩ á wʋ pɛ fʋʋnɩ zʋ abam dɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Abam balʋ dɩ na yɩ kan-banna tɩn maŋɩ sɩ á taá nɩgɩ á kaana bam kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ. Á na zʋʋrɩ dɩ á kaana bam tɩn, á taá ye nɩ ba ba dana nɩ abam te. Ba nan wʋ́ wǝli dɩ abam ba na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam dɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩm. Kʋntʋ tɩn, taá zuli-na-ba, sɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ yɩ cʋ abam Wɛ-loro. Dɩ́ taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ dɩ́ zɩ maŋɩ dɩ́ yaarɩ dɩ

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na kɩ abam wo-lɔŋɔ, sɩ á dɩ daa yɩ joori á kɩ-o wo-lɔŋɔ á ma ŋwɩ. Nɔɔnʋ na twɩ abam, á dɩ daa yɩ tɔgɩ á twɩ-o, sɩ á daarɩ á loori Wɛ á pa-o sɩ DƖ kɩ-o lanyɩranɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ Wɛ bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ, yɩ abam dɩ wʋ́ ba á joŋi lanyɩranɩ Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na lagɩ sɩ o na o ŋwɩa ywǝǝni dɩ wʋpolo tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o ja o tɩtɩ dɩ wo-balwaarʋ taanɩ dɩ vwan fɔm mʋ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tu maŋɩ sɩ o yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ, sɩ o daarɩ o taa kɩ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ o kwaanɩ o taa jɩgɩ ywǝǝni dɩ nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ nii balʋ na tɔgɩ cɩga tɩn baŋa nɩ mʋ, yɩ DƖ cǝgi ba loro. Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn, DƖ yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ ba.»

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Wɔɔ mʋ wʋ́ wanɩ o kɩ abam wo-lɔŋɔ dɩ á na tiini á kwaanɩ á kɩ lanyɩranɩ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Abam nan na maŋɩ á na yaara á na kɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ dɩ, á daa ta jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo. Á nan yɩ taá fʋna dɩ ba, naa á pa á wʋbʋŋa vugimi.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Taá zuli-na á Yuutu Zezi Krisi dɩ á bɩcara maama. Nan ti-na á yigǝ maŋa maama, sɩ á wanɩ á lǝri nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na wʋ́ bwe abam sɩ o lwarɩ tɩɩna yalʋ á na jɩgɩ dɩ Wɛ tɩn na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Á nan lǝri kʋntʋ tu dɩ wʋ-bono dɩ zulǝ. Á taá kɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ á na ye á bɩcara nɩ nɩ tɩ lana tɩn, sɩ kʋ pa cavɩɩra ja balʋ na culi abam dɩ á kǝm-laarʋ tɩm Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Á na kɩ lanyɩranɩ yɩ ba yaarɩ abam kʋ ŋwaanɩ yɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa, kʋ garɩ á na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ yɩ á yaarɩ tɩ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi dɛɛn nan tɩgɩ bɩdwɩ mʋ o ma saarɩ nabiinǝ lwarɩm. Kʋ maa yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ lǝri nɔn-balwaarʋ yuu nɩ o tɩ, yɩ o wanɩ o kɩ-ba Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ. Ba gʋ-o mʋ, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm joori kʋ pa-o ŋwɩa.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ yɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ mʋ, kʋ na mɛ kʋ brɩ nɩ abam dɩ na pɛ ba miisi abam na wʋnɩ tɩn mʋ pɛ Wɛ vrɩ abam Zezi Krisi na bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba na miisi abam na wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩ á ma swɛ á yɩra digiru. Kʋ nan yɩ á goni ni mʋ dɩ Wɛ, sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ dɩ wʋ-poŋo.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi mʋ diini Wɛ-sɔŋɔ o jǝni Wɛ jazɩm nɩ, yɩ malɛsɩ dɩ dɩdɛɛra dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na jɩgɩ dam tɩn wʋ o dam kuri nɩ.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, abam daa ta na jɩgɩ ŋwɩa lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, á daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nabiinǝ fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn. Á maŋɩ sɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Abam dɛɛn cɔgɩ á ŋwɩa kam maŋa zanzan, dɩ á na yǝni á tɔgɩ cwe sɩlʋ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ tɩn na lagɩ sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ tɩn. Abam dɛɛn yǝni á kɩ wo-digiru kikiǝ dɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ maama á fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn. Á dɛɛn maa yɩ sa-nyɔra, yɩ á yɩ nɔn-kwǝǝlu á nyɔ sana á bugǝ. Á maa kwǝri á tɔgɩ jwǝnǝ kaanɩm, mʋ kʋlʋ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na vaɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ, á daa na ba tɔgɩ dɩ balʋ na yǝri Wɛ á kɩ wo-zɔɔna kikiǝ kʋntʋ doŋ tɩn, kʋ kɩ-ba yǝǝu mʋ, kʋ pa ba jɩgɩ abam ba twɩa.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba dɛɛn tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam ba brɩ balʋ na tɩgɩ tɩn dɩ. Bantʋ yɩra yam mʋ tɩga, nɩnɛɛnɩ nabiinǝ maama na maŋɩ sɩ ba tɩ ba lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ te tɩn. Ba nan na ni Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn, kʋ yɩ sɩ ba jwǝǝru tɩm laan mʋ na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam.

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ kʋ wǝǝnu maama tiim twɛ. Nan fɔgɩ-na á ja á wʋbʋŋa sɩ á taá jɩgɩ yawala dɩ Wɛ-loro.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Taá kɩ-na vǝrǝ voro, sɩ pʋpʋna taa tǝri á tɩtarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa na joŋi pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, á taá ma-dɩ á tʋŋɩ á wǝli daanɩ. Kʋntʋ, á taá yɩ tɩntʋŋ-ŋʋna balʋ na joŋi Wɛ pɛɛra yam dwi tǝri tǝri á ma tʋŋɩ DƖ na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-o pɛɛrɩ sɩ o taa waɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o brɩ nɔɔna tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o taa ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam mʋ. Wʋlʋ Wɛ na pɛ sɩ o taa tʋŋɩ o wǝli o donnǝ tɩn dɩ maŋɩ sɩ o taa maɩ dam dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-o tɩn mʋ o ma tʋŋa. Kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa nɔɔna taa zuli Wɛ woŋo maama wʋnɩ Zezi Krisi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ nan mʋ te zulǝ dɩ dam sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina. Wʋlʋ na yaarɩ Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ tɩn jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, á yɩ pa kʋ sʋ abam dɩ can-kamunu na yi abam. Á nan yɩ pa kʋ sɔɔrɩ abam, nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ yɩ wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ mʋ te.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Taá kɩ-na wʋpolo dɩ abam na tɔgɩ á na Zezi Krisi yaara yam doŋ tɩn. Kʋntʋ, Zezi Krisi na joori o ba yɩ o paarɩ zulǝ yam na wʋ́ ba ya brɩ jaja maŋa kalʋ tɩn, á wʋpolo kʋm laan wʋ́ tiini kʋ gaalɩ.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna nan na twɩ abam á na yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn ŋwaanɩ, á jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm na jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ tɩn wʋ abam tee nɩ.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Abam wʋlʋ na nɛ yaara, sɩ kʋ yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ taa yɩ nɔn-gʋra ŋwaanɩ, naa ŋwɩɩnɩ naa wo-balwaarʋ kǝm naa bɩbara ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Maŋa kam yiǝ sɩ Wɛ di nabiinǝ sarɩya. Kʋ nan yɩ DƖ tɩtɩ nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ mʋ DƖ lagɩ DƖ puli. Kʋ nan na wʋ́ puli dɩbam tee nɩ mʋ tɩn, kʋ laan na tu kʋ yi balʋ na vɩn Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam tɩn, kʋʋ́ ta yɩ ta mʋ dɩ bantʋ? Kʋ bá tiini kʋ kɩ cam dɩ ba cɩga?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Kʋ pʋpʋnɩ Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ kʋ wɩ: «Kʋ na cɛ mʋ, yɩ nɔn-ŋʋna na ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn, balʋ laan na vɩn Wɛ yɩ ba yɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ tɩn, kʋʋ́ kɩ-ba tɛ?»

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, balʋ na nɛ yaara nɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba taa kɩ lanyɩranɩ mʋ, sɩ ba kɩ ba tɩtɩ ba naanʋ Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ. DƖ bá kwanɩ DƖ ni dɩm DƖ na goni tɩn.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Amʋ lagɩ a ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ balʋ na yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwa abam tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn mʋ. Amʋ dɩ yɩ nakwɩ mʋ. Amʋ yi dɛɛn nɛ Zezi Krisi na yaarɩ te o tɩ tɩn, yɩ a laan brɩ nɔɔna o cɩga kam. Amʋ nan wʋ́ tɔgɩ a na o paarɩ-zulǝ yam ya na wʋ́ ba ya brɩ jaja tɩn.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: A nan loori abam balʋ na yɩ nakwa tɩn, sɩ á taá nii Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm DƖ na kɩ á jɩŋa nɩ tɩn baŋa nɩ, nɩ nayɩra na nii ba peeni baŋa nɩ te tɩn. Kʋ nan daɩ dɩ fɩfɩʋn mʋ á wʋ́ ta maa nii-ba, kʋ yɩ sɩ á wʋbʋŋa mʋ taa lagɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm nɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn. Kʋ daɩ sɩ á taá tʋŋɩ sǝbu-lagɩ ŋwaanɩ. Á pa kʋ taa yɩ á na soe tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Á yɩ taá kɩ dam dɩ balʋ á na nii ba baŋa nɩ tɩn, á nan taá jɩgɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋlʋ na lana tɩn, sɩ ba wanɩ ba taa lwǝni abam na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ tɩn, abam Nayɩrɩ-pɛ wʋm na joori o ba, o laan wʋ́ pa abam pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ lam na bá fɔgɩ dɩ ti yɩ dɩ jɩgɩ paarɩ-zulǝ tɩn.

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, taá tu-na á tɩtɩ, sɩ á daarɩ á kɩ á tɩtɩ Dam-Paŋwa Tu Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ, sɩ dɩntʋ maŋa kam na tu ka yi, DƖ laan wʋ́ zǝŋi abam DƖ pa á na zulǝ.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Liǝ yalʋ maama na jɩgɩ abam tɩn, á kwe-ya á pa Wɛ, sɩ dɩntʋ mʋ nii abam baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Nan zɩgɩ-na kǝŋkǝŋ dɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa sɩ á vɩ-dɩ, sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ á ko-biǝ balʋ na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa je sɩm maama nɩ tɩn dɩ jɩgɩ yaara yantʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Abam nan na yaarɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn, Wɛ dɩlʋ na zǝni nabiinǝ dɩ DƖ zaanɩ dɩlʋ na daga tɩn laan wʋ́ pa á bɩcara fɔgɩ ya kwɛ. DƖ wʋ́ pa abam dam, sɩ á taá zɩgɩ kǝŋkǝŋ woŋo maama wʋnɩ. Dɩntʋ mʋ bǝŋi abam sɩ á tɔgɩ á na DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yalʋ na ba ti tɩn, á na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ mʋ jɩgɩ dam sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina. Tiim kwǝrǝ

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Amʋ pɛ Silivɛn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ, sɩ a pa abam. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩ́ ko-bu wʋlʋ amʋ na ye nɩ o yɩ cɩga tu Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ tɩn. A pʋpʋnɩ taanɩ dɩntʋ fɩnfɩɩn mʋ sɩ a ma pa abam na baarɩ, sɩ a daarɩ a pa á lwarɩ nɩ cɩga kalʋ á na sɛ tɩn mʋ yɩ Wɛ zaanɩ dɩm cɩga cɩga. Nan fɔgɩ-na á taá jɩgɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Wɛ kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Babilɔnɩ nɩ yɩ Wɛ kuri-ba nɩ DƖ na kuri abam dɩ te tɩn jɔɔnɩ abam. Marɩkɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ amʋ bu Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn dɩ jɔɔnɩ abam.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Á na jeeri daanɩ, sɩ á taá jɔɔnɩ daanɩ dɩ sono. Abam balʋ maama na yɩ Zezi Krisi nɔɔna tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Amʋ Simɔn Pɩyɛɛrɩ mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ. A yɩ Zezi Krisi gamba-sono mʋ, yɩ a kwǝri a yɩ o tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ o na kuri tɩn. Amʋ pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam balʋ Wɛ na pɛ á jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi Krisi kʋ maŋɩ dɩ dɩbam dɩ na jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩd-o te tɩn, o na yɩ cɩga tu tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Tu Wɛ dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa abam yu-yoŋo dɩ yazurǝ kʋ ja gaalɩ, dɩ á na tu á lwarɩ-DƖ yɩ á ta kwǝri á lwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tɩn. Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ na lagɩ te tɩn

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Wɛ dam tu Zezi Krisi pɛ dɩbam woŋo kʋlʋ maama na paɩ dɩ́ jɩgɩ ŋwɩa Wɛ tee nɩ yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ DƖ cwǝŋǝ lanyɩranɩ tɩn, dɩ o na pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ Baŋa-Wɛ dɩlʋ na kuri dɩbam sɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ dɩ́ na DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ, sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ dɩntʋ na kɩ lanyɩranɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Abam na sɩɩnɩ á jɩgɩ wo-laarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ kʋ ja gaalɩ, tɩ wʋ́ cɩ abam sɩ á yɩ taá yɩ yawɔrɩ-nyɩna, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa á fɔgɩ á tiini á lwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi á wǝli da.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na ba jɩgɩ wo-laarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu warɩ o lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam, o nyɩ dɩ lilwe mʋ te. O swe nɩ o dɛɛn na kɩ lwarma yalʋ tɩn maŋɩ ya saarɩ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a ko-biǝ-ba, Wɛ na bǝŋi abam sɩ á taá tɔgɩ-DƖ yɩ DƖ kuri abam sɩ á taá yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn, kwaanɩ-na á pa á na tɔgɩ-DƖ te tɩn tiini kʋ taa jɩgɩ kuri lanyɩranɩ. Á na kwaanɩ á kɩ kʋntʋ doŋ, á daa bá ywǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, Wɛ wʋ́ yagɩ cwǝŋǝ DƖ pa abam fasɩ, sɩ á na jǝŋǝ je Zezi Krisi paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Yuutu dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ, yɩ o paarɩ dɩm ba jɩgɩ tiim maŋa dɩ maŋa.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Mʋ kʋ kuri amʋ joori a paɩ á guli wo-laarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ woŋo maŋa maama. Abam nan maŋɩ á ye-tɩ, yɩ á sɩɩnɩ á tɔgɩ cɩga kalʋ á na lwarɩ tɩn.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: A nan bʋŋɩ nɩ kʋ lana, sɩ amʋ ta na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, sɩ a taa guli abam kʋntʋ doŋ, sɩ kʋ pa á taá jɩgɩ tɩ wʋbʋŋa.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: A ye nɩ kʋ daa bá daanɩ sɩ a tɩ, nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na pɛ a lwarɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Amʋ nan wʋ́ kwaanɩ a kɩ woŋo kʋlʋ na wʋ́ pa á taá waɩ á guli wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ gulǝ maŋa maama amʋ tʋʋnɩ kwaga nɩ tɩn. Dɩ́ na sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ Zezi cɩga kam te tɩn

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Dɩbam dɛɛn pɛ á lwarɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi na tu dɩ dam nabiinǝ tɩtarɩ nɩ te tɩn. Dɩ́ na pɛ á lwarɩ o cɩga kam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ daɩ sɩnswalɩ mʋ dɩ́ mɛ dɩ́ brɩ abam nɩ nɔɔna na maɩ ba tɩtɩ swan ba brɩ te tɩn. Dɩbam tɩtɩ yi nan mʋ nɛ o na jɩgɩ Wɛ paarɩ-zulǝ cɩga cɩga te tɩn.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ma na Zezi na joŋi tiǝ dɩ zulǝ o Ko Wɛ tee nɩ maŋa kalʋ o yibiyǝ na lǝni yɩ Paŋwa Baŋa-Wɛ ŋɔɔnɩ DƖ wɩ: «Amʋ Bu mʋ tɩntʋ, a so-o dɩ a wʋ maama. Amʋ tiini a jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩd-o.»

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: Dɩbam tɩtɩ ni kwǝrǝ kam kʋntʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ maŋa kalʋ dɩbam dɩ Zezi dɛɛn na wʋ piu kʋlʋ Wɛ na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋ yuu nɩ tɩn.
