english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ nan ta ye fasɩ nɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na brɩ faŋa faŋa tɩn sɩɩnɩ dɩ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Kʋ maŋɩ sɩ á taá maanɩ á nii dɩ na yɩ te tɩn. Taanɩ dɩntʋ nyɩ dɩ ba na tarɩgɩ kanɩa ba zɩgɩ lim je nɩ yɩ ka paɩ pooni wʋra sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi tɩ-pʋra te tɩn mʋ. Zezi Krisi pooni dɩm laan wʋ́ ba dɩ taa wʋ á bɩcara nɩ, nɩ naŋɔgɔ na fuŋi yɩ pooni wʋra te tɩn.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na dwe dɩdɩ sɩ á lwarɩ tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o ma o tɩtɩ wʋbʋŋa yɩranɩ o brɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kalʋ na pʋpʋnɩ DƖ tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn kuri.

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam DƖ nijoŋnǝ bam dɛɛn na tɔɔlɩ tɩn wʋ nuŋi nabiinǝ wʋbʋŋa wʋnɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm mʋ pɛ nɔɔna jɩgɩ dam yɩ ba waɩ ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ tɩtɩ kwǝrǝ kam.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa tɩn, nɔɔna dɛɛn mʋ wʋ Wɛ nɔɔna bam wʋnɩ ba na brɩ nɩ ba yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ. Vwan zaasɩm tiinǝ dɩ wʋ́ ŋɔ ba zʋ abam wʋnɩ kʋntʋ, yɩ ba kɩ swan ba brɩ abam zaasɩm dɩlʋ na daɩ Wɛ nyɩm yɩ dɩ cɔgɩ nɔɔna tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ vɩn ba Yuutu Zezi wʋlʋ na ŋwɩ ba lwarɩm jɩnɩ sɩ ba taa yɩ o nɔɔna tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ ba kikiǝ yam wʋ́ pa Wɛ cɔgɩ-ba lɩla.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ malɛsɩ sɩlʋ dɛɛn na cɔgɩ tɩn dɩ, Wɛ wʋ yagɩ-sɩ. DƖ dɩ-sɩ DƖ yagɩ min-tɩʋ nɩ mʋ, mɛ ba na kwaarɩ-sɩ lim wʋnɩ, sɩ sɩ taa wʋra taan, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi DƖ sarɩya dɛ dɩm tɩn.

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: Wɛ dɛɛn wʋ yagɩ faŋa faŋa nɔɔna balʋ na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ ba kɩ lwarɩm tɩn. Nowe mʋ Wɛ vrɩ DƖ wǝli dɩ nɔɔna barpɛ, dɩ wʋntʋ na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ cɩga kam o brɩ nɔɔna te tɩn. Wɛ ma daarɩ DƖ cɔgɩ balʋ na vɩn DƖ ni tɩn, DƖ pa dʋa tiini ka nɩ yɩ na li lʋgʋ baŋa, yɩ ba maama tɩ.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: O na yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm yɩ o zʋʋrɩ dɩ ba tɩn, o naɩ ba kǝm-lwaanʋ tɩm dɛ maama yɩ o ni ba niǝ-bɩtarɩ sɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Kʋ maa tiini kʋ jɩgɩ wʋ-cɔgɔ dɩd-o dɩ ba na tʋŋɩ ba cɔgɩ Wɛ cullu tɩm te tɩn.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ waɩ DƖ vrɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn sɩ ba yɩ cɔgɩ dɩ maŋɩm dɩlʋ na yi-ba tɩn. Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ na vɩ-DƖ tɩn, DƖ waɩ DƖ pɩɩna yɩ DƖ cǝgi-ba sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi DƖ sarɩya dɛ dɩm, sɩ DƖ laan pa ba na cam.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Kʋ na dwe dɩdɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ wo-digiru kikiǝ yalʋ ba fra na zʋʋrɩ yɩ ba ba lagɩ sɩ ba sɛ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ ni ba baŋa nɩ tɩn, Wɛ wʋ́ pa ba na cam kʋ ja gaalɩ. Vwan zaasɩm tiinǝ bam kʋntʋ ba kwarɩ cavɩɩra, ba nan ba nɩgɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ dɩ. Ba maa ba kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ sɩ ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ dɩdɛɛra balʋ na wʋ wɛyuu tɩlampolo nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nan dɩ Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm na tiini sɩ jɩgɩ dam sɩ dwe vwan zaasɩm tiinǝ bam kʋntʋ tɩn, sɩ ba sɛ sɩ twɩ dɩdɛɛra bam kʋntʋ sɩ ŋɔɔnɩ ba woŋo dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Vwan zaasɩm tiinǝ bam yǝni ba ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba na yǝri tɩ kuri tɩn mʋ. Ba ma kɩ yɔɔ yɔɔ nɩ ga-vara na ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa yɩ ba kɩ te tɩn. Ga-vara wʋra sɩ nɔɔna mʋ taa jaanɩ-ba ba gʋɩ. Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ dɩ nan wʋ́ cɔgɩ nɩ ga-vara mʋ te.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa ba na yaara sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ ba dɩ na pɛ nɔɔna na yaara te tɩn. Ba ma kɩ wʋpolo dɩ wo-digiru tɩlʋ ba fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn, yɩ ba kɩ-tɩ jaja wɩa tɩtarɩ nɩ. Ba kǝm dɩm yɩ digiru dɩ cavɩɩra mʋ abam tɩtarɩ nɩ, maŋa kalʋ á na yǝni á la daanɩ sɩ á di wʋdiu yɩ ba ta kɩ wʋpolo dɩ ba lwarɩm dɩm tɩn.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Bantʋ wʋbʋŋa zʋ boorim kikiǝ yɩranɩ mʋ. Ba brɩ ba ba jɩgɩ siun dɩ wo-balwaarʋ kǝm, yɩ ba sʋgɩ balʋ wʋbʋŋa dɩ na bwǝnǝ tɩn ba paɩ ba tusǝ. Ba maa tiini ba yɩ wo-swǝn-nyɩna dɩ. Wɛ nan wʋ́ cɔgɩ-ba.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Bantʋ ma yagɩ cwǝ-laa tɔgɩm, yɩ ba ywǝri ba vu ba tɔgɩ Bozori bu Balam cwǝŋǝ kam. Wʋntʋ yi dɛɛn ma su sǝbu kʋlʋ o na wʋ́ na o kǝm-balɔrɔ kʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: O na vɩn Wɛ ni tɩn, DƖ ma pa varɩm na ba ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn ŋɔɔnɩ nɩ nabiinu te. O tɩtɩ bɩnaga mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ ka kaan-o, sɩ kʋ cɩ Balam na yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu tɩn dɩ jwǝrim dɩlʋ o na lagɩ o kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ nyɩ dɩ buli-yiǝ yalʋ na ba buri tɩn mʋ, yɩ ba ta nyɩ dɩ kunkwǝǝnu tɩlʋ vu-fɔrɔ na kalɩ kʋ pa tɩ jagɩ tɩn. Wɛ nan lɩ jǝgǝ kalʋ na tiini ka yɩ lim tɩn mʋ sɩ DƖ kɩ-ba da.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ba maa tiini ba ŋɔɔnɩ kamunni-bɩtarɩ sɩlʋ na ba jɩgɩ kuri tɩn, yɩ ba maɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ nabiinǝ fra na zʋʋrɩ yɩ tɩ yɩ wo-digiru tɩn ba ma ganɩ balʋ laan na pɔɔrɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ nɔɔna balʋ na yǝri Wɛ cwǝŋǝ tɩn.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balʋ na lwarɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na yɩ dɩbam Yuutu dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ tɩn, ba lugi lʋgʋ baŋa wo-digiru tɩm mʋ. Ba laan nan na joori ba pipiri ba sɛ ba paɩ tɩ te-ba, ba kweelim je wʋ́ tiini kʋ taa yɩ lɛɛrʋ dɩ ba kʋ dwǝni pulim nɩ.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ, ba ya na wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam, kʋ ya wʋ́ ta lana kʋ pa-ba kʋ dwe ba na lwarɩ-ka yɩ ba laan pipiri ba za ba wʋbʋŋa dɩ Wɛ ni dɩlʋ DƖ na pɛ-ba sɩ ba taa tɔgɩ tɩn.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Bantʋ na kɩ te tɩn nyɩ dɩ bɩtar-dɩndɩa kalʋ na tagɩ cɩga ka wɩ: «Kakurǝ joori ka di ka tɩtwaanʋ.» Bɩtar-dɩndɩa kadoŋ dɩ ta wɩ: «Nmʋ na jaanɩ tǝru n swɛ o yɩra, o ta wʋ́ joori o bibili bwǝru wʋnɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ sɩ a ma guli abam faŋa faŋa Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam na maŋɩ ba brɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ, sɩ á daarɩ á guli dɩ́ Yuutu dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ Zezi ni dɩm o tɩntʋŋna bam na brɩ abam tɩn.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kʋlʋ na dwe dɩdɩ tɩn, á taá ye nɩ, lʋgʋ baŋa tiim da yam na yiǝ, nɔɔna badonnǝ wʋ́ ta wʋra ba na tɔgɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ ba tɩtɩ fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn, yɩ baá ta jɩgɩ abam ba mwana ba wɩ:

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Balʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ kʋntʋ tɩn paalɩ ba swe mʋ. Ba ba lagɩ sɩ ba sɛ nɩ wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa maŋɩ tɩ wʋra faŋa faŋa mʋ, yɩ Wɛ ni dɩm mʋ pɛ tɩ wʋra kʋntʋ. Wɛ dɛɛn pɛ tɩga kam nuŋi na wʋnɩ mʋ, yɩ na bam ŋwaanɩ pa lʋgʋ baŋa ta wʋra.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan ta yɩ Wɛ ni dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ paɩ zɩm wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa kam ta wʋra, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam DƖ na wʋ́ pa mini cɔgɩ-tɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ, Wɛ tiŋi-tɩ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi dɛ dɩlʋ DƖ na wʋ́ di nabiinǝ sarɩya, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ cɔgɩ balʋ na vɩ-DƖ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara bʋŋɩ nɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm daanɩ yɩ o wʋ tu nɩ o na goni ni te tɩn. O nan kɩ wʋ-zuru mʋ dɩ abam, bɛŋwaanɩ o ba lagɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ cɔgɩ, o lagɩ sɩ nɔɔna maama mʋ na cwǝŋǝ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi tum dɛ dɩm nan wʋ́ ba dɩ darɩ dɩbam nɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ na yǝni o ba te tɩn mʋ. Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ nɩ sɔɔ zanzan wʋ́ kɩ wɛyuu nɩ, yɩ wɛyuu kʋm wʋ́ ba kʋ je maama. Kʋ daarɩ mini mʋ wʋ́ di wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ wɛyuu nɩ, yɩ tɩga dɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ ka baŋa nɩ tɩn je.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Abam nan na cǝgi dɛ dɩm Wɛ na wʋ́ pa Zezi joori o ba tɩn, sɩ á kwaanɩ á taá kɩ te na wʋ́ pa o ba lɩla tɩn. Dɛ dɩm kʋntʋ na yiǝ, mini mʋ wʋ́ di wɛyuu maama dɩ cɔgɩ, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa kʋ wǝǝnu maama lʋnɩ yɩ tɩ nyɩɩnɩ tɩ cɔgɩ.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Wɛ nan goni ni sɩ DƖ kɩ wɛyuu-dʋŋʋ dɩ tɩ-dʋŋa mʋ. Dáanɩ mʋ DƖ wʋ́ pa wǝǝnu maama taa tɔgɩ cɩga. Tɩntʋ wǝǝnu tɩm mʋ dɩbam nan cǝgǝ yɩ dɩ́ tɩɩna.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm nan na kɩ wʋ-zuru yɩ kʋ daanɩ tɩn, lwarɩ-na nɩ kʋ yɩ sɩ kʋ ma pa nɔɔna mʋ na cwǝŋǝ ba na vrɩm. Dɩbam ko-bu-sono Pooli maŋɩ o pʋpʋnɩ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ o pa abam, kʋ nan tɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ na pɛ-o swan yalʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: O na pʋpʋnɩ twaanʋ tɩlʋ maama o ma brɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ cɩga kam tɩn, o yǝni o tɛ kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ tɩ wʋnɩ. O nan pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩdonnǝ tɩ na dana sɩ nɔɔna wanɩ ba ni tɩ kuri, kʋ pa balʋ na yǝri Wɛ cɩga kam lanyɩranɩ yɩ ba wʋbʋŋa bwǝnǝ tɩn jɩgɩ o zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ ba pipirǝ, nɩ ba na yǝni ba pipiri Wɛ twaanʋ tɩdaara dɩ te tɩn. Kʋ nan wʋ́ ja ba tɩtɩ cɔgɩm mʋ kʋ ba.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, a badon-sonnu-ba, á laan ye kʋ na wʋ́ ba kʋ taa yɩ te tɩn. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, taá cʋ-na á tɩtɩ, sɩ á yɩ pa nɔn-balwaarʋ na cwǝŋǝ ba dɩ abam ba tusim dɩm wʋnɩ sɩ kʋ pa á ga jǝgǝ kalʋ á ya na zɩgɩ da tɩn.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Á nan ta ve yigǝ, sɩ á taá ŋwɩ Zezi Krisi zaanɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, sɩ á fɔgɩ á lwar-o á wǝli da. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩbam Yuutu dɩ dɩ́ Vɩrnʋ. Zulǝ yɩ wʋntʋ nyɩm mʋ lele kʋntʋ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Dɩbam pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ sɩ dɩ́ pa á lwarɩ wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o wʋra pulim nɩ tɩn mʋ. Dɩbam dɛɛn ni o kwǝrǝ mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ na-o dɩ dɩ́ yiǝ dɩ. Dɩ́ ma fɔgɩ dɩ́ nii-o, yɩ dɩ́ ta kwǝri dɩ́ dwe-o dɩ dɩ́ jɩa. Kʋ yɩ Ŋwɩa Bɩtara woŋo mʋ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ abam.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ nan tu ka naɩ jaja. Dɩ́ ma na-ka, yɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ ka na yɩ te tɩn dɩ́ brɩ abam. Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn taanɩ mʋ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ ta. Ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ ya wʋ dɩbam Ko Wɛ tee nɩ mʋ, yɩ DƖ laan pa dɩ́ lwarɩ-ka.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na nɛ kʋlʋ yɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ ni kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ brɩ abam, sɩ kʋ pa abam taá jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ dɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ maama na ŋwɩ dɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Dɩ́ pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ dɩ́ brɩ abam, sɩ kʋ pa dɩbam maama tiini dɩ́ taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo mʋ. Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ yɩ pooni tu

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kalʋ dɩbam na ni Wɛ Bu Zezi tee nɩ yɩ dɩ́ lagɩ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ brɩ abam tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Baŋa-Wɛ yɩ pooni tu mʋ, lim tǝri DƖ tee nɩ dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na tɛ dɩ́ wɩ, dɩ́ ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ, yɩ dɩ́ ta na wʋ lim wʋnɩ, kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ fɔ vwan mʋ, yɩ dɩ́ kikiǝ ba tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, dɩ́ nan na ŋwɩ pooni wʋnɩ nɩ Wɛ na wʋ pooni wʋnɩ te tɩn, kʋntʋ wʋ́ pa dɩbam maama taá jɩgɩ wǝl-dɔnɔ daanɩ, yɩ Wɛ Bu Zezi Krisi jana kam wʋ́ saarɩ dɩ́ lwarɩm maama.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na tɛ dɩ́ wɩ, dɩ́ ba jɩgɩ lwarɩm, dɩ́ ganɩ dɩ́ tɩtɩ mʋ, cɩga tǝri dɩ́ tee nɩ.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na sɛ dɩ́ ta dɩ́ lwarɩm dɩ Wɛ, DƖ laan wʋ́ yagɩ-dɩ DƖ ma cɛ dɩbam, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ saarɩ dɩ́ wo-balwaarʋ tɩm maama. Bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ bá kwanɩ DƖ ni, DƖ yɩ cɩga tu mʋ.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, dɩ́ na tɛ dɩ́ wɩ, dɩ́ wʋ kɩ lwarɩm, dɩ́ paɩ Wɛ yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ, yɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ wʋ joŋi DƖ taanɩ dɩm mʋ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋbʋŋa nɩ.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, a pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ a pa abam, sɩ á yɩ kɩ lwarɩm mʋ. Dɩbam wʋlʋ nan na kɩ lwarɩm, dɩ́ jɩgɩ wʋlʋ na wʋ́ fɔgɩ dɩbam dɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ daanɩ tɩn. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ na ba jɩgɩ lwarɩm dɩ fɩnfɩɩn dɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Wʋntʋ mʋ mɛ o tɩtɩ o kaanɩ Baŋa-Wɛ, yɩ DƖ yagɩ dɩbam lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ dɩbam. Kʋ nan daɩ dɩbam yɩranɩ lwarɩm má, kʋ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna maama lwarɩm ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Dɩbam na sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam mʋ, kʋʋ́ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ ye-DƖ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ nan na tɛ o wɩ, wʋm ye Wɛ, yɩ o na ba sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam, kʋntʋ tu yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ, yɩ cɩga tǝri o tee nɩ.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na sɛ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu yɩ wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ Wɛ sono kʋm cɩga cɩga tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ brɩ nɩ dɩ́ sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, ni dɩlʋ a na pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam tɩn daɩ ni-dʋʋrɩ. Dɩ yɩ ni-doori mʋ, dɩ maŋɩ dɩ wʋra dɩ abam mʋ pulim nɩ. Ni dɩm kʋntʋ yɩ taanɩ dɩlʋ abam na maŋɩ á ni tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, dɩ nan daa ta yɩ ni-dʋʋrɩ mʋ amʋ na pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam, bɛŋwaanɩ Zezi mʋ brɩ ni dɩm kʋntʋ cɩga kam, yɩ abam dɩ brɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ. Kʋ maa pa lim maa kɛa, yɩ pooni dɩlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn laan zǝŋi.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na tɛ o wɩ, o ŋwɩ pooni wʋnɩ, yɩ o na culi o donnǝ, kʋntʋ tu ta wʋ lim wʋnɩ mʋ dɩ zɩm maama.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na soe o donnǝ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu mʋ ŋwɩ pooni wʋnɩ. Kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝri o ŋwɩa wʋnɩ, kʋ na wʋ́ pa nɔɔnʋ tʋ lwarɩm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na culi o donnǝ tɩn wʋ lim wʋnɩ mʋ o veǝ, o yǝri o na ve mɛ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ lim dɩm mʋ pɛ o yiǝ daa ba naɩ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, a pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ a pa abam, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ yagɩ á lwarɩm DƖ ma cɛ abam Zezi yɩrɩ ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: A pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam balʋ na yɩ kwǝ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ á maŋɩ á ye wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o wʋra pulim nɩ tɩn. A pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam nɔn-dʋnnʋ tɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ á wanɩ wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: A biǝ-ba, a pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam, bɛŋwaanɩ abam maŋɩ á ye dɩ́ Ko Wɛ. A pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam balʋ na yɩ kwǝ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ abam maŋɩ á ye wʋlʋ na maŋɩ o wʋra pulim nɩ tɩn. Nɔn-dʋnnʋ tɩm, a pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam, bɛŋwaanɩ abam dana. Wɛ taanɩ dɩm maa wʋ á wʋnɩ, yɩ á wanɩ wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Yɩ zaŋɩ-na á taá soe lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ kʋ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na soe lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu daa ba jɩgɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ sono o bɩcarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wǝǝnu tɩm maama, kʋ na yɩ nabiinǝ fra na yǝni ya zʋʋrɩ wo-yɔɔrʋ tɩlʋ tɩn, naa nabiinǝ yiǝ na sui wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɩn, naa nabiinǝ na magɩ ba nyɔɔna dɩ ba jɩjɩgɩrʋ te tɩn, tɩntʋ maama daɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ nyɩm, tɩ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm mʋ.

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: A biǝ-ba, lʋgʋ baŋa kweelim da yam twɛ ya ti. Abam nan maŋɩ á ni nɩ Zezi Krisi Dʋm wʋm maa bɩɩna. Lele kʋntʋ, Zezi Krisi dʋna zanzan mʋ laan nan tu ba wʋra. Kʋ ma pa dɩ́ ye nɩ da yam kʋntʋ twɛ ya ti.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ pwɛ ba tɩtɩ mʋ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ, ba nan maŋɩ ba daɩ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna cɩga cɩga. Ba ya na yɩ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm nɔɔna, ba ya bá yagɩ dɩbam te. Ba nan pwɛ ba tɩtɩ kʋntʋ, sɩ kʋ brɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ bantʋ wʋlʋwʋlʋ ya maŋɩ o daɩ dɩbam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋ nɔɔnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, á maŋɩ á joŋi Wɛ Joro kʋm Krisi na pɛ abam tɩn, yɩ kʋ pa á maama lwarɩ Wɛ cɩga kam.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, a nan na pʋpʋnɩ a pa abam tɩn, kʋ daɩ nɩ a wɩ, á yǝri cɩga mʋ. Woŋo kʋlʋ ŋwaanɩ a na pʋpʋnɩ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ á maŋɩ á ye kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga, yɩ á ye nɩ kʋlʋ maama na yɩ vwan tɩn bá wanɩ kʋ nuŋi cɩga wʋnɩ.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Wɔɔn nan yɩ vwa-nyɩm tɩn? Kʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tɛ nɩ Zezi daɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn mʋ. Kʋntʋ tu yɩ Zezi Krisi dʋm mʋ, yɩ o vɩn dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ Bu wʋm dɩ.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na vɩn Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, o vɩn o Ko Wɛ dɩ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ maama na brɩ nɩ o sɛ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, o Ko Wɛ dɩ wʋra dɩ kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, á taá jɩgɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ á na maŋɩ á ni pulim nɩ tɩn á bɩcara nɩ. Á na sɛ á jɩgɩ zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ, kʋʋ́ pa abam dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm dɩ o Ko Wɛ taa ŋwɩ daanɩ.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Amʋ pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ a pa abam, sɩ á wanɩ á lwarɩ balʋ na lagɩ ba ganɩ abam tɩn woŋo mʋ.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ abam, Wɛ Joro kʋm Zezi na pɛ abam tɩn wʋ á bɩcara nɩ, yɩ á daa wʋ maŋɩ sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ zaasɩ abam. Wɛ Joro kʋm brɩ abam woŋo maama kuri. Kʋ zaasɩm dɩm yɩ cɩga mʋ, dɩ daɩ vwan. Kʋntʋ tɩn, á taá ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi, nɩnɛɛnɩ kʋ na brɩ abam te tɩn.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, pa-na dɩ́ taá ŋwɩ dɩd-o, sɩ maŋa kam o na wʋ́ joori o ba tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ na baarɩ yɩ cavɩɩra bá ja dɩbam o yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Abam na ye nɩ Zezi yɩ cɩga tu tɩn, lwarɩ-na nɩ wʋlʋ maama kikiǝ na tɔgɩ cɩga Wɛ cwǝŋǝ nɩ tɩn yɩ Wɛ bu mʋ.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Nan bʋŋɩ-na á nii, dɩ́ Ko Wɛ na tiini DƖ soe dɩbam te yɩ DƖ maɩ dɩbam DƖ bǝ nɩ DƖ biǝ tɩn. Dɩ́ nan sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Kʋntʋ mʋ nɔɔna balʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nyɩm tɩn yigǝ tǝrǝ dɩ dɩbam, ba na yǝri Wɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, dɩbam laan yɩ Wɛ biǝ mʋ. Dɩ́ nan na wʋ́ ba dɩ́ taá yɩ te tɩn daa ta wʋ brɩ fasɩ. Dɩ́ nan na ye kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ: Zezi na wʋ́ joori o ba maŋa kalʋ tɩn, dɩ́ laan wʋ́ ta yɩ nɩ wʋm tɩtɩ na yɩ te tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na o na yɩ te tɩn fasɩ.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn vɩn Wɛ ni mʋ. Lwarɩm kǝm yɩ Wɛ ni vɩʋn mʋ.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, wʋlʋ maama na ŋwɩ dɩd-o tɩn yagɩ lwarɩm kǝm mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama nan ta na kɩ lwarɩm tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ o ta wʋ lwarɩ Zezi mʋ, yɩ o kwǝri o yǝri o na yɩ wʋlʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ maama nan ta na tɔgɩ lwarɩm kǝm tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ o yɩ sʋtaanɩ nɔɔnʋ mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ sʋtaanɩ maŋɩ dɩ kɩ lwarɩm kʋ zɩgɩ pulim nɩ mʋ. Wɛ Bu wʋm nan tu lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ o cɔgɩ sʋtaanɩ tɩtʋŋa mʋ.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ bu tɩn yagɩ lwarɩm kǝm mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ dam dɩlʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn wʋ o tee nɩ. Kʋntʋ tɩn, o daa bá wanɩ o ta taa kɩ lwarɩm, o na yɩ Wɛ bu tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ kʋlʋ na pɔɔrɩ balʋ na yɩ Wɛ biǝ dɩ balʋ na yɩ sʋtaanɩ biǝ tɩn daanɩ. Wʋlʋ maama kikiǝ na ba tɔgɩ cɩga yɩ o ba soe o donnǝ tɩn daɩ Wɛ nɔɔnʋ.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan wʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ Kayin na kɩ kʋlʋ faŋa faŋa tɩn. Wʋntʋ dɛɛn yɩ wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɔɔnʋ mʋ, yɩ o gʋ o nyaanɩ. Bɛɛ nan mʋ kɩ yɩ o gʋ-o? Kʋ yɩ wʋm tɩtɩ kikiǝ na ba lana, yɩ o nyaanɩ wʋm kikiǝ tɔgɩ cɩga tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ mʋ

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: A ko-biǝ-ba, lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna bam na culi abam, á yɩ pa kʋ sʋ abam.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ ye nɩ dɩ́ maŋɩ dɩ́ yagɩ tʋʋnɩ cwǝŋǝ, yɩ dɩ́ daarɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam cwǝŋǝ mʋ. Dɩ́ na soe dɩ́ donnǝ tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ kʋntʋ. Wʋlʋ maama nan na ba soe o doŋ tɩn ta wʋ tʋʋnɩ jɩŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na culi o donnǝ tɩn yɩ nɔn-gʋrʋ mʋ. Abam nan ye nɩ nɔn-gʋrʋ bá wanɩ o taa jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam o bɩcarɩ nɩ.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Zezi na tiini o soe dɩbam tɩn mʋ te o sɛ sɩ o tɩ dɩbam ŋwaanɩ. Kʋntʋ mʋ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ sono cɩga cɩga na yɩ te tɩn. Mʋ kʋ kuri dɩbam dɩ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ sɛ sɩ dɩ́ tɩ dɩ́ donnǝ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na yɩ jɩjɩgɩrʋ tu tɩn na nɛ nɩ o doŋ ba gara, yɩ o na wʋ pɛ o ŋwaŋa zʋ-o, kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ sono kʋm tǝri kʋntʋ tu bɩcarɩ nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, dɩ́ kikiǝ mʋ maŋɩ sɩ ya brɩ nɩ dɩ́ sono kʋm dɩ́ na jɩgɩ tɩn daɩ ni-taanɩ yɩranɩ, sɩ kʋ yɩ sono kʋlʋ na yɩ sono cɩga cɩga tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na jɩgɩ sono kʋm kʋntʋ doŋ, kʋʋ́ pa dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ sɩɩnɩ dɩ́ tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam, yɩ kʋʋ́ pa dɩ́ bɩcara taa tigi jǝgǝ dɩdʋa Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ bɩcara nan na pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ tusi, dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ ye DƖ dwe dɩ́ bɩcara yam na ye te tɩn, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ ye wǝǝnu maama.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, dɩbam bɩcara nan na bá wanɩ ya cɔgɩ dɩbam tɩn, dɩ́ wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ baarɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ wʋ́ na woŋo kʋlʋ maama dɩ́ na wʋ́ loori DƖ tee nɩ tɩn, dɩ́ na sɛ DƖ ni yɩ dɩ́ kɩ kʋlʋ na poli DƖ wʋ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Ni dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Dɩ́ maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi, sɩ dɩ́ kwǝri dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ wʋntʋ na pɛ dɩbam ni sɩ dɩ́ taá soe-da te tɩn.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam tɩn ŋwɩ dɩ DƖ mʋ, yɩ Wɛ dɩ wʋra dɩ kʋntʋ tu. Wɛ Joro kʋm DƖ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩ́ lwarɩ nɩ Wɛ sɩɩnɩ DƖ wʋra dɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, yɩ zaŋɩ-na á sɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na tɛ o wɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm wʋ o tee nɩ tɩn. Á nan maŋɩ sɩ á maasɩ mʋ á nii, sɩ á lwarɩ kʋ na yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm naa kʋ na daɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ vwa-Wɛ-nijoŋnǝ zanzan tu ba karɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ ba ganɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na vɩn Zezi tɩn, Wɛ Joro kʋm tǝri kʋntʋ tu tee nɩ, yɩ joro kʋlʋ na wʋ o tee nɩ tɩn yɩ Zezi Krisi Dʋm wʋm nyɩm mʋ. Abam maŋɩ á lwarɩ nɩ Dʋm wʋm kʋntʋ lagɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Lele kʋntʋ o nan maŋɩ o ba o wʋra.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, abam yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ, yɩ á wanɩ vwa-nyɩna bam kʋntʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ Joro na wʋ á wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ dam dwe joro kʋlʋ na wʋra dɩ lʋgʋ nɔɔna bam tɩn dam.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ dɩbam, dɩ́ yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama na ye Wɛ tɩn mʋ wʋ́ sɛ dɩbam na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn. Wʋlʋ nan na daɩ Wɛ nɔɔnʋ tɩn ba sɛa. Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ wʋ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ Joro kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga dɩ vwan joro kʋm daanɩ. Wɛ yɩ sono tu mʋ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, pa-na dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ sono nuŋi Wɛ te mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama na soe o donnǝ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu yɩ Wɛ bu mʋ, yɩ o kwǝri o ye Wɛ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama nan na ba soe o donnǝ tɩn ta wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ yɩ sono tu mʋ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan brɩ nɩ DƖ soe dɩbam, dɩ DƖ na tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu-dʋa sɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa sɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ na DƖ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kam wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Sono kʋm nan na yɩ te tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Kʋ daɩ nɩ dɩbam mʋ soe Wɛ, kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ soe dɩbam. Dɩntʋ sono kʋm mʋ pɛ DƖ tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu wʋm sɩ o ba o tɩ o ma o jana kam o saarɩ dɩ́ lwarɩm.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, Wɛ na tiini DƖ soe dɩbam kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam dɩ ta soe daanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o yi na nɛ Baŋa-Wɛ. Nan dɩ kʋ dɩ, dɩ́ na soe daanɩ, Wɛ wʋ́ ta wʋra dɩ dɩbam, yɩ DƖ sono kʋm wʋ dɩ́ bɩcara nɩ cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam DƖ Joro kʋm tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩ́ ye nɩ dɩ́ ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ, yɩ Wɛ dɩ wʋra dɩ dɩbam.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Dɩbam nɛ nɩ dɩ́ Ko Wɛ tʋŋɩ DƖ Bu wʋm sɩ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa o ji nabiinǝ Vɩrnʋ mʋ. Cɩga kam kʋntʋ mʋ dɩbam nan jɩgɩ dɩ́ brɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na brɩ jaja nɩ Zezi yɩ Wɛ Bu mʋ tɩn, Wɛ wʋra dɩ kʋntʋ tu, yɩ wʋntʋ dɩ ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Dɩbam tɩtɩ lwarɩ Wɛ na soe dɩbam te tɩn, yɩ dɩ́ sɛ DƖ sono kʋm kʋntʋ. Wɛ yɩ sono tu mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama na ŋwɩ sono wʋnɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ mʋ, yɩ Wɛ dɩ wʋra dɩd-o.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Wɛ sono kʋm na wʋ dɩbam bɩcara nɩ cɩga cɩga, kʋʋ́ pa dɩ́ na baarɩ dɛ dɩm Wɛ na wʋ́ ba DƖ di nabiinǝ sarɩya tɩn. Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, nɩ Zezi dɩ na ŋwɩ dɩ DƖ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ bá wanɩ dɩ taa wʋ sono wʋnɩ. Sono kʋlʋ na yɩ cɩga tɩn mʋ wʋ́ zǝli fʋʋnɩ kʋ pa dɩ viiri. Zwɛ vaŋɩm mʋ paɩ fʋʋnɩ wʋra. Kʋntʋ tɩn, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ tɩn, kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ sono kʋm tǝri o bɩcarɩ nɩ cɩga cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wɛ na dɛ yigǝ DƖ soe dɩbam tɩn mʋ paɩ dɩbam dɩ jɩgɩ sono.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na tɛ o wɩ, wʋm soe Wɛ, yɩ o ta na culi o donnǝ, kʋntʋ tu yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ. Bɛŋwaanɩ, nmʋ yi na naɩ n doŋ yɩ n ba so-o tɩn, n bá wanɩ n ta n soe Wɛ yɩ n yi ba na-DƖ.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Ni dɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam tɩn mʋ tɩntʋ: Wʋlʋ maama na soe dɩntʋ tɩn maŋɩ sɩ o ta soe o donnǝ dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa o sɛ nɩ Zezi yɩ Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu yɩ Wɛ bu mʋ. Wʋlʋ maama nan na soe ko tɩn soe ko wʋm biǝ dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, dɩ́ na soe Wɛ yɩ dɩ́ sɛ DƖ niǝ yam, dɩ́ ye nɩ dɩ́ soe DƖ biǝ dɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ na wʋ́ ta soe Wɛ te tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá sɛ DƖ niǝ yam. DƖ niǝ yam tɔgɩm nan bá ta cana dɩ dɩbam,

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ bu tɩn wanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-balwaarʋ tɩm. Kʋ yɩ dɩbam na kɩ dɩ́ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn mʋ pɛ dɩ́ wanɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na wʋ́ wanɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-balwaarʋ tɩm, kʋ na daɩ wʋlʋ maama na sɛ nɩ Zezi yɩ Wɛ Bu tɩn yɩranɩ. Baŋa-Wɛ brɩ nɩ Zezi yɩ DƖ Bu mʋ

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Kʋ yɩ DƖ Joro kʋm dɩ na bam dɩ jana kam mʋ. Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama brɩ cɩga dɩdʋa mʋ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, wʋlʋ maama na kɩ o wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu jɩgɩ Wɛ cɩga kam kʋntʋ o bɩcarɩ nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ, wʋlʋ maama na wʋ sɛ Wɛ tɩn, kʋntʋ tu brɩ nɩ Wɛ yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ, bɛŋwaanɩ o wʋ sɛ cɩga kalʋ Wɛ na tagɩ DƖ Bu wʋm ŋwaanɩ tɩn.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Cɩga kam kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ nan yɩ DƖ Bu wʋm ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu mʋ jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na ba ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, kʋntʋ tu ba jɩgɩ Wɛ ŋwɩa kam kʋntʋ.

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Amʋ pʋpʋnɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ a pa abam balʋ na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩn, sɩ á lwarɩ nɩ á sɩɩnɩ á na ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ dɩ́ ye fasɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ nɩ, dɩ́ na loori woŋo DƖ tee nɩ yɩ kʋ tɔgɩ DƖ wʋbʋŋa, DƖ wʋ́ cǝgi dɩ́ loro kʋm.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ nan na ye nɩ Wɛ cǝgi dɩbam loro kʋm, dɩ́ ye nɩ dɩ́ wʋ́ na woŋo kʋlʋ dɩ́ na loori DƖ tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ wʋlʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ bu tɩn daa ba paalɩ o ta kɩ lwarɩm, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm tɩtɩ mʋ nii wʋntʋ baŋa nɩ, yɩ o baá pa wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ wan-o.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Dɩbam ye nɩ dɩ́ yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ balʋ maama na jɩgɩ kugu je lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ wo-lwaanʋ tu sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ye nɩ Wɛ Bu wʋm mʋ tu lʋgʋ baŋa, yɩ o vɩɩrɩ dɩ́ swan yɩ dɩ́ wanɩ dɩ́ lwarɩ Baŋa-Wɛ cɩga cɩga. Dɩ́ nan ŋwɩ dɩ Cɩga Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Wɛ cɩga cɩga, o yɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn tu.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: A bu-sonnu-ba, á taá cʋ á tɩtɩ sɩ á yɩ tɔgɩ jwǝnǝ.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɩbam maama sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam, yɩ ka daa bá fɔgɩ ka ti dɩbam tee nɩ.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ Bu Zezi Krisi wʋ́ pa dɩbam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo, yɩ DƖ daarɩ DƖ duri dɩ́ ŋwaŋa, dɩbam balʋ na sɛ Wɛ cɩga kam yɩ dɩ́ soe daanɩ tɩn. Cɩga dɩ sono taanɩ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ poli lanyɩranɩ dɩ a na lwarɩ nɩ nmʋ biǝ bam badaara tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam, nɩnɛɛnɩ dɩbam Ko Wɛ na pɛ dɩbam ni sɩ dɩ́ taá kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: A nu, a lagɩ a ta dɩ nmʋ sɩ dɩ́ maama maŋɩ sɩ dɩ́ taá soe daanɩ. A na pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ tɩn daɩ ni-dʋʋrɩ, kʋ maŋɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ ni dɩm dɩ́ na ni pulim nɩ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Vwa-nyɩna zanzan mʋ tu ba karɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ ba ganɩ nɔɔna. Vwa-nyɩna bam kʋntʋ maa ba sɛ nɩ Zezi Krisi jigi nabiinu mʋ o ba lʋgʋ baŋa. Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na tɛ kʋntʋ tɩn yɩ vwa-nyɩm mʋ, yɩ o yɩ Zezi Krisi dʋm mʋ.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, á fɔgɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á na tʋŋɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ ŋwaanɩ tɩn yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ ji kafɛ, sɩ á wanɩ á na ŋwɩɩrʋ tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na wʋ́ pa abam tɩn.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Taá ye-na nɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ maama na yagɩ Zezi Krisi zaasɩm dɩm yɩ o daarɩ o brɩ wǝǝnu tɩdonnǝ o wǝli da tɩn, Wɛ tǝri kʋntʋ tu tee nɩ. Kʋ daarɩ, nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ nan na sɛ o tɔgɩ Zezi zaasɩm dɩm tɩn, dɩ́ Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ Bu wʋm wʋra dɩ kʋntʋ tu.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, nɔɔnʋ na tu abam te, yɩ o zaasɩm dɩm na daɩ Zezi Krisi nyɩm dɩm, á yɩ sɛ á pa o zʋ á sam. Nan brɩ á yɩ zaan-o dɩ.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na zaan-o tɩn, kʋntʋ tu dɩ tɔgɩ o wǝli o kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm wʋnɩ mʋ.

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Amʋ ya jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan sɩ a ta a brɩ abam. A nan ba lagɩ sɩ a pʋpʋnɩ a kɩ tɔnɔ nɩ. A nan bʋŋɩ nɩ, aá ba abam te sɩ a laan ŋɔɔnɩ dɩdaanɩ abam jaja, sɩ kʋ pa dɩbam wʋpolo kʋm tiini kʋ gaalɩ.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Dɩbam balʋ na yɩ nmʋ cʋrʋ biǝ yɩ Wɛ kuri dɩbam dɩ tɩn mʋ jɔɔnɩ nmʋ.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋlʋ na yɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm nakwɩ tɩn mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ a pa a ciloŋ-sono Gayusi. Amʋ soe nmʋ cɩga cɩga.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: A ciloŋ-sono, Wɛ wʋ́ kɩ-m lanyɩranɩ woŋo maama wʋnɩ. A loori Wɛ mʋ a pa nmʋ, sɩ n yɩra taa jɩgɩ yazurǝ, nɩ n bɩcarɩ na tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam lanyɩranɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ badaara tu ba ta nmʋ taanɩ, yɩ kʋ pa a tiini a na wʋpolo dɩ a na lwarɩ nɩ n tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam lanyɩranɩ tɩn. A nan ye nɩ n sɩɩnɩ n tɔgɩ cɩga kam kʋntʋ mʋ.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Kʋlʋkʋlʋ tǝrǝ kʋ na wʋ́ wanɩ kʋ pa a ja wʋpolo kʋ dwǝni a na lwarɩ nɩ a biǝ bam sɩɩnɩ ba tɔgɩ cɩga cwǝŋǝ kam tɩn.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: A ciloŋ-sono, nmʋ kɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ n na yǝni n zǝni dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam te tɩn, dɩ kʋ na maŋɩ kʋ yɩ vǝrǝ dɩ.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam tagɩ Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ nmʋ na kɩ-ba lanyɩranɩ te tɩn. Kʋ lana sɩ n ta n wǝli-ba ba cwǝŋǝ kam vǝŋǝ wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ Wɛ wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ nuŋi sɩ ba tɔɔlɩ Zezi Krisi kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kam mʋ. Ba nan ba joŋi kʋlʋkʋlʋ balʋ na ba tɔgɩ Zezi cɩga kam tɩn jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ kʋ maŋɩ sɩ dɩbam mʋ zǝni nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ dwi sɩ ba wanɩ ba tʋŋɩ, sɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ dɩbam dɩ tɔgɩ dɩ́ tʋŋɩ Wɛ cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Amʋ dɛɛn pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ a pa abam Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm. Diyotrɛfɩ wʋlʋ nan na lagɩ sɩ o taa yɩ á yigǝ tu tɩn ba lagɩ sɩ o joŋi kʋlʋ dɩbam na tɛ tɩn.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, a na tu abam te, aá ta wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama o na kɩ tɩn á maama yigǝ nɩ jaja. Wʋntʋ yǝni o ŋɔɔnɩ ta-balwaarʋ mʋ o paɩ dɩbam. Kʋntʋ nan ta ba poli o wʋ. Kʋlʋ na wǝli da tɩn, o yǝni o ba sɛ sɩ o jeeri dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam lanyɩranɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o cǝŋi balʋ na lagɩ sɩ ba jeeri-ba lanyɩranɩ tɩn dɩ, yɩ o ta zǝli-ba Zezi kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: A ciloŋ-sono, yɩ sɛ n lwǝni nɔn-balwaarʋ kikiǝ, nmʋ za n kwaanɩ n ta n kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Wʋlʋ maama na kɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn yɩ Wɛ nɔɔnʋ mʋ. Wʋlʋ nan na kɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩn ta wʋ lwarɩ Wɛ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Kʋ nan na yɩ Demɛtrisi, nɔɔna maama tɛ o na yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm te tɩn, yɩ o na tɔgɩ cɩga kam te tɩn dɩ brɩ nɩ o yɩ nɔn-ŋʋm mʋ. Dɩbam dɩ nan brɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ, yɩ abam ye nɩ dɩ́ na tɛ kʋlʋ tɩn sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: A ya jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan sɩ a ta a brɩ abam. A nan ba lagɩ sɩ a pʋpʋnɩ a kɩ tɔnɔ nɩ.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: A nan bʋŋɩ sɩ aá ba abam te lele, sɩ dɩ́ laan ŋɔɔnɩ daanɩ jaja.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Wɛ wʋ́ pa-m yazurǝ. Nmʋ cilonnǝ balʋ na wʋ yo seeni tɩn maama jɔɔnɩ nmʋ. N dɩ jɔɔnɩ dɩ́ cilonnǝ bam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa ba na wʋ nmʋ tee nɩ tɩn n pa dɩbam.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ mʋ ŋɔgɩ tɩ zʋ tɩ gwaanɩ abam kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ. Ba maa yǝni ba pipiri Wɛ cɩga kam, sɩ kʋ pa ba na cwǝŋǝ ba taa tɔgɩ wo-digiru kikiǝ yalʋ ba fra na zʋʋrɩ tɩn, yɩ ba ta bʋŋɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ duri ba ŋwaŋa DƖ na yɩ ŋwaŋa tu tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba maa vɩn Zezi Krisi wʋlʋ yɩranɩ na yɩ dɩbam Pɛ dɩ dɩ́ Yuutu tɩn. Faŋa faŋa tɩn Wɛ tɔnɔ kʋm maŋɩ kʋ brɩ nɩ Wɛ wʋ́ di nɔɔna bantʋ dwi sarɩya.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Á maŋɩ á ye Wɛ na kɩ te dɩ malɛsɩ sɩlʋ na lagɩ sɩ sɩ dam taa dwe Wɛ ya na pɛ-sɩ te tɩn. Sɩ ma yagɩ jǝgǝ kam Wɛ na pɛ-sɩ tɩn. Wɛ ma vɔ-sɩ dɩ capʋnnʋ DƖ dɩ je sɩlʋ na yɩ lim yɩranɩ tɩn wʋnɩ DƖ yagɩ da, sɩ sɩ taa wʋra taan, sɩ DƖ sarɩya dɛ kamunu kʋm na yiǝ, sɩ DƖ laan pa sɩ na cam.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Nan guli-na nɔɔna balʋ dɛɛn na zʋʋrɩ Sodɔm dɩ Gomɔɔrɩ nɩ tɩn dɩ tɩɩnɩ dɩlʋ na batwarɩ da tɩn woŋo. Bantʋ dɩ dɛɛn tɔgɩ boorim wo-digiru kikiǝ mʋ, yɩ kʋ daɩ dɩ nabiinǝ yɩranɩ má mʋ ba kɩa. Wɛ ma pa ba na cam dɩ mini dɩlʋ na ba di dɩ dwe tɩn, sɩ kʋ taa yɩ maana kʋ brɩ nɔɔnʋ maama.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Wɛ malɛsɩ dɩdɛɛrʋ Misɛɛlɩ tɩtɩ nan wʋ sɛ o kɩ kʋntʋ. O dɛɛn na magɩ kantɔgɔ dɩ sʋtaanɩ Moyisi yɩra yam kǝm ŋwaanɩ tɩn, o wʋ sɛ o twɩ-dɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ woŋo. O nan na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn mʋ yɩ sɩ: «Wɛ wʋ́ pa n na cam.»

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ vwan zaasɩm tiinǝ bam nan ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ woŋo kʋlʋ maama ba na yǝri kʋ kuri tɩn mʋ. Ba na ye wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama tɩn, ba yɩ nɩ ga-vara na ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa yɩ ba kɩ yɔɔ yɔɔ te tɩn mʋ. Ba nan wʋ́ da tɩntʋ kwaga mʋ ba na cɔgɩm.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Wɛ nan wʋ́ pa ba na lɛɛrʋ, sɩ ba tɩtʋŋa ba tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ nɩ Kayin tɩtʋŋa dɛɛn na ba tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ te tɩn mʋ. Ba yi ma su sǝbu kʋlʋ ba na wʋ́ na ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn, nɩ Balam dɛɛn na kɩ te tɩn. Ba ma vɩn Wɛ ni yɩ ba cɔgɩ, nɩ Kore dɩ dɛɛn na vɩn Wɛ ni yɩ o cɔgɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Enɔkɩ wʋlʋ na kɩ Adam naarʋ tɩm kuni bɩrdʋ tu tɩn dɛɛn maŋɩ o ta nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ taanɩ o wɩ: «Dɩ́ Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ wʋ́ ba dɩ DƖ malɛsɩ kuni mʋrrʋ mʋrrʋ, sɩ DƖ di nabiinǝ maama sarɩya.

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: Wɛ laan wʋ́ pa balʋ maama na ba tɔgɩ-DƖ tɩn na cam dɩ ba kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama ba na kɩ ba vɩn Wɛ ni dɩm tɩn, dɩ ta-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ maama lwarɩm kǝrǝ bam kʋntʋ na ŋɔɔnɩ ba gooni Wɛ tɩn.»

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amʋ badon-sonnu-ba, abam nan maŋɩ sɩ á guli dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi tɩntʋŋna bam dɛɛn na maŋɩ ba ta kʋlʋ dɩ abam tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ dwi mʋ yǝni ba paɩ nɔɔna pɔɔrɩ daanɩ. Ba wʋbʋŋa tɔgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-yɔɔrʋ mʋ, yɩ Wɛ Joro kʋm tǝri ba bɩcara nɩ.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: A badon-sonnu-ba, kʋ nan na yɩ abam, á kwaanɩ á taá wǝli daanɩ sɩ á bɩ lanyɩranɩ dɩ Wɛ cɩga kam á na kɩ á wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ ka tɩn. Á taá warɩ Wɛ dɩ DƖ Joro kʋm dam.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Á taá ŋwɩ dɩ Wɛ sono kʋm DƖ na pɛ abam tɩn, sɩ á taá cǝgi dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi na wʋ́ ba o pa á na Wɛ ŋwɩ-dʋŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn, o na jɩgɩ abam ŋwaŋa tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Á taá duri balʋ na jɩgɩ bʋbwɛa tɩn ŋwaŋa, sɩ á taá wǝli-ba.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Badaara wʋra á na maŋɩ sɩ á vrɩ-ba mini dɩlʋ na lagɩ dɩ cɔgɩ-ba tɩn wʋnɩ mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ balʋ wo-yɔɔrʋ kikiǝ na pɛ ba jɩgɩ digiru tɩn, sɩ á taá jɩgɩ ba ŋwaŋa, á nan taá yɩrɩ á tɩtɩ dɩ ba wo-digiru tɩm, sɩ á daarɩ á taá culi kʋlʋ maama na yɩ lwarɩm nyɩm tɩn.

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Dɩntʋ yɩranɩ mʋ yɩ Wɛ, DƖ doŋ daa tǝrǝ. DƖ dɛ dɩ́ Yuutu Zezi Krisi ŋwaanɩ mʋ DƖ vrɩ dɩbam lwarɩm wʋnɩ. Dɩntʋ mʋ maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ dɩ yɩrɩ kamunu dɩ paarɩ dɩ dam, kʋ na zɩgɩ pulim nɩ kʋ ba kʋ yi zɩm, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Tɔnɔ kʋntʋ wʋ wǝǝnu tɩm yɩ kʋlʋ Wɛ na brɩ Zezi Krisi sɩ o ma brɩ o tɩntʋŋna, sɩ ba wanɩ ba lwarɩ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ sɩ kʋ kɩ lele tɩn mʋ. Zezi pɛ o malɛka mʋ ba Zan wʋlʋ na yɩ o tɩntʋŋnʋ tɩn te, yɩ ka brɩ-o wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Zan laan maa pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ maama o na nɛ tɩn o tiŋi, yɩ o brɩ nɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ mʋ nɩ Zezi Krisi na vɩɩr-o te tɩn.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na karɩmɩ tɔnɔ kʋntʋ dɩ balʋ na cǝgi tɔnɔ kʋm wʋ wǝǝnu tɩm yɩ ba kwǝri ba sɛ-tɩ tɩn jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo. Kʋ sɩɩnɩ kʋ yɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ mʋ, yɩ maŋa kam yiǝ sɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ sɩɩnɩ tɩ kɩ.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Amʋ Zan mʋ pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ a pa Zezi kɔgɔ kuni bɩrpɛ kʋlʋ na wʋ Azi tɩ-niǝ yam wʋnɩ tɩn. Wɛ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ DƖ wʋra pulim nɩ yɩ DƖ ta wʋra zɩm sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn, dɩ DƖ dɩdɛɛra barpɛ balʋ na brɩ DƖ Joro kʋm dam yɩ ba zɩgɩ DƖ paarɩ yituŋu kʋm yigǝ nɩ tɩn, wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Zezi Krisi dɩ wʋ́ pa abam yazurǝ dɩ yu-yoŋo. Wʋntʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na brɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ cɩga tɩn. Wʋm mʋ dɛ yigǝ o bi o yagɩ tʋʋnɩ. Wʋntʋ nan ta mʋ yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam maama yuutu. Zezi soe dɩbam yɩ o vrɩ dɩbam dɩ́ lwarɩm wʋnɩ, o na tɩga yɩ o jana kam nuŋi tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o pa dɩbam dɩ tɔgɩ dɩ́ di paarɩ, yɩ dɩ́ zɩgɩ o Ko Wɛ yigǝ nɩ dɩ́ zuli-DƖ. Zezi Krisi maŋɩ zulǝ dɩ dam sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Nii-na, o maa bɩɩnɩ kunkwǝǝnu wʋnɩ. Nɔɔnʋ maama yi wʋ́ na-o, dɩ balʋ na zɔg-o dɩ cicwe tɩn dɩ, yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dwi maama wʋ́ ta keerǝ o tum dɩm ŋwaanɩ. Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Amina.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ wɩ: «Amʋ mʋ yɩ pulim dɩ gurim.» Dɩntʋ mʋ yɩ dɩlʋ na maŋɩ DƖ wʋra pulim nɩ, yɩ DƖ ta wʋra zɩm sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Zezi na vɩɩrɩ o tɩtɩ dɩ Zan te tɩn

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Amʋ Zan yɩ abam ko-bu mʋ, yɩ a tɔgɩ a na yaara nɩnɛɛnɩ abam dɩ na nɛ yaara te tɩn. A nan ta tɔgɩ dɩ abam dɩ a wǝli Wɛ paarɩ dɩm wʋnɩ, yɩ a tɔgɩ a na baarɩ, dɩ́ na ŋwɩ dɩ Zezi tɩn ŋwaanɩ. A na tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na vɩɩrɩ-nɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ ba jaanɩ amʋ ba vu ba yagɩ Patɩmɔsɩ zoŋo kʋlʋ na na kaagɩ tɩn yuu nɩ.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Dɛ dɩlʋ na yɩ siun dɛ tɩn nɩ mʋ Wɛ Joro kʋm tu amʋ te dɩ dam. Amʋ ma ni kwǝr-dɩa na ŋɔɔnɩ a kwaga nɩ, nɩ nɔɔnʋ na wui nabɔnɔ te tɩn.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kam ma ŋɔɔnɩ ka wɩ: «Pʋpʋnɩ kʋlʋ maama nmʋ na wʋ́ na tɩn n kɩ tɔnɔ wʋnɩ, sɩ n tʋŋɩ-kʋ n pa Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ tɩɩnɩ dɩrpɛ dɩm wʋnɩ tɩn. Tɩɩnɩ dɩm kʋntʋ yɩra mʋ yɩ: Efɛɛzɩ, Simirini, Pɛɛrgam, Tiyatiiri, Sarɩdɛsɩ, Filadɛlɩfi, dɩ Lawodise.»

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma pipiri sɩ a nii wɔɔ mʋ ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ amʋ. A ma na sǝbu-sɩŋa min-zwǝǝnu tɩrpɛ, tɩ zɩga.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na zɩgɩ tɩ tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn nyɩ dɩ nabiinu mʋ. O ma zʋ gwar-dɩdɔrɔ o dɩ o napra nɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o vɔ sǝbu-sɩŋa kilǝ o nyɔɔnɩ nɩ.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: O yuuywe maa tiini sɩ pɩɩrɩ carɩ carɩ nɩ lɔŋɔ te. O yiǝ maa nyɩ nɩ min-vʋgʋ te.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: O napra maa nyɩɩna nɩ ba na kɩ can-na mini nɩ yɩ kʋ nyɩɩnɩ te tɩn. O kwǝrǝ maa dwana nɩ na-fara na cuuri te tɩn.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: O maa ze calɩcwɩ sɩrpɛ o jazɩm nɩ. Sʋ-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ jɩgɩ ni yɩ kʋ yɩ niǝ yale tɩn maa nuŋi o ni nɩ. O yibiyǝ maa nyɩɩna nɩ wɩa na tiini ka nyɩɩnɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Amʋ na nɛ-o kʋntʋ tɩn, a ma tʋ o yigǝ nɩ, nɩ a tɩgɩ mʋ te. O ma kwe o jazɩm o daŋɩ a baŋa nɩ yɩ o wɩ: «Yɩ ta n kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ, sɩ amʋ mʋ yɩ pulim dɩ gurim.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Amʋ yɩ ŋwɩa tu mʋ. Amʋ ya tɩgɩ mʋ, yɩ a joori a bi a jɩgɩ ŋwɩa sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. A jɩgɩ dam tʋʋnɩ dɩ curu baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Amʋ wʋ́ brɩ nmʋ calɩcwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm nmʋ na nɛ amʋ jazɩm nɩ tɩn dɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa min-zwǝǝnu tɩrpɛ tɩm kuri na yɩ te tɩn. Calɩcwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm brɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋna balʋ na nii Wɛ-di sɩrpɛ sɩm nɔɔna bam baŋa nɩ tɩn mʋ. Kʋ daarɩ min-zwǝǝnu tɩrpɛ tɩm dɩ brɩ Wɛ-di sɩrpɛ sɩm nɔɔna bam tɩtɩ mʋ.»

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na nyɩ dɩ nabiinu tɩn daa ma ta dɩ amʋ o wɩ: «Nan pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Efɛɛzɩ nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ na ze calɩcwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm o jazɩm nɩ yɩ o kwǝri o wʋ sǝbu-sɩŋa min-zwǝǝnu tɩrpɛ tɩm tɩtarɩ nɩ o ve tɩn te mʋ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye kʋlʋ maama abam na kɩ tɩn. Amʋ ye abam na tiini á cɛ dɩ tɩtʋŋɩ dɩm dɩ pu-dɩa yɩ á wʋ yagɩ te tɩn. Amʋ ta ye nɩ abam ba sɛ sɩ nɔn-balwaarʋ na laŋa ba zʋ abam tɩtarɩ. Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋna yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ tɩn, a ye nɩ abam yǝni á maanɩ-ba á nii, yɩ á lwarɩ nɩ ba yɩ vwa-nyɩna mʋ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Abam jɩgɩ pu-dɩa lanyɩranɩ. Abam nɛ yaara amʋ ŋwaanɩ, yɩ á tiini á vɔ á wʋ sɩ á yɩ ga baarɩ.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam yɩra woŋo kʋlʋ na wʋ maŋɩ tɩn mʋ. Abam daa ba soe amʋ nɩ pulim nɩ kʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Bʋŋɩ-na á nii, abam dɛɛn ya na yɩ te yɩ á daa daɩ kʋntʋ tɩn. Lǝni-na á wʋbʋŋa, sɩ á daarɩ á taá kɩ lanyɩranɩ nɩ abam na puli á kɩ te tɩn. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, amʋ wʋ́ ba a lɩ á min-zoŋo kʋm kʋ jǝgǝ nɩ. Nan lǝni-na á wʋ, sɩ kʋ yɩ kɩ kʋntʋ.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam kwaanɩ dɩ á na culi kikiǝ yalʋ nɔɔna balʋ ba na bǝi nɩ Nikolayiti tɩn na kɩ tɩn. Amʋ tɩtɩ dɩ culi ba na kɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu cwǝŋǝ sɩ o zʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ o di tiu kʋlʋ biǝ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn.» Kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na pɛ Simirini tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm tɩn

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Simirini nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ na yɩ pulim dɩ gurim tɩn te mʋ. Wʋntʋ nan ta mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na tɩgɩ yɩ o joori o bi o jɩgɩ ŋwɩa tɩn.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan ye abam na yaarɩ te tɩn. A ye nɩ yinigǝ jɩgɩ abam. Kʋ daarɩ abam yɩ nadunǝ mʋ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ Zwifǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ tɩn, amʋ ye ba na yaalɩ abam te tɩn. Bantʋ nan yɩ sʋtaanɩ nɔɔna mʋ.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Yɩ taá kwarɩ fʋʋnɩ dɩ abam na wʋ́ na cam te tɩn. Nii-na, sʋtaanɩ lagɩ dɩ pa ba ja abam badaara ba pɩ, sɩ dɩ maŋɩ abam dɩ nii. Abam nan wʋ́ na cam sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ da fugǝ. Ba na maŋɩ ba kɩ abam sɩ kʋ yi á tʋʋnɩ dɩ, sɩ á ta taá jɩgɩ wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ amʋ. Abam na kɩ kʋntʋ, amʋ wʋ́ pa abam pɛɛrɩ, kʋ na yɩ ŋwɩa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn Wɛ tee nɩ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn, tʋʋnɩ dɩlʋ na yɩ bɩle tu tɩn daa bá wan-o dɩ ja.» Kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na pɛ Pɛɛrgam tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm tɩn

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Pɛɛrgam nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ sʋ-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na tiini kʋ jɩgɩ ni yɩ kʋ yɩ niǝ yale tɩn te mʋ.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye abam na zʋʋrɩ mɛ tɩn. Sʋtaanɩ mʋ te je sɩm kʋntʋ. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ dɩ, abam ta wʋ yagɩ amʋ. Antipasɩ dɛɛn kwaanɩ o brɩ nɔɔna amʋ cɩga kam dɩ o wʋ maama mʋ. Ba ma gʋ-o abam tee nɩ, sʋtaanɩ na zʋʋrɩ je sɩlʋ nɩ tɩn. Nan dɩ kʋntʋ na maŋɩ kʋ kɩ tɩn dɩ, abam daa ta wʋ yagɩ amʋ.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan lagɩ a ta abam yɩra woŋo mʋ. Nɔɔna mʋ wʋ abam wʋnɩ, ba na sɛ zaasɩm dɩlʋ na yɩ Balam nyɩm tɩn. Faŋa faŋa tɩn wʋntʋ mʋ brɩ Pɛ Balakɩ yɩ o sʋgɩ Yisɩrayɛlɩ tiinǝ o pa ba tʋ tusim wʋnɩ. Ba ma di jwǝnǝ wʋdiiru, yɩ ba daarɩ ba cɔgɩ nɔɔna kaana.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nikolayiti zaasɩm dɩm dɩ nan yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Nɔɔna badaara mʋ wʋ á wʋnɩ ba dɩ na tɔgɩ zaasɩm dɩm kʋntʋ.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Nan lǝni-na á wʋrʋ. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, amʋ wʋ́ ba abam te lɩla, yɩ aá lɩ sʋ-lɔŋɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ a ni nɩ tɩn a ma kɩ jara dɩdaanɩ ba.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu Wɛ wʋdiu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ ‹Maanɩ› yɩ kʋ sǝgi nabiinǝ yigǝ nɩ tɩn sɩ o di. Kʋ wǝli da, amʋ wʋ́ kwe kandwɛ-poŋo a pa kʋntʋ tu, yɩrɩ-dʋʋrɩ na pʋpʋnɩ kandwɛ dɩm kʋntʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yǝri-dɩ, kʋ na daɩ wʋlʋ na joŋi-dɩ tɩn yɩranɩ.» Kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na pɛ Tiyatiiri tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm tɩn

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Tiyatiiri nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi Wɛ Bu wʋm te mʋ. Wʋntʋ yiǝ mʋ nyɩ dɩ min-vʋgʋ, yɩ o napra nyɩɩna nɩ can-na te.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ a lagɩ a ta abam yɩra woŋo mʋ. Abam yǝni á yagɩ cwǝŋǝ á pa kaanɩ wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Zezabɛlɩ yɩ o paɩ o yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu tɩn mʋ ganɩ amʋ nɔɔna bam o paɩ ba tusǝ. O ma pa ba kɩ boorim, yɩ ba daarɩ ba di jwǝnǝ wʋdiiru.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Amʋ nan pɛ wʋntʋ maŋa mʋ sɩ o lǝni o wʋ dɩ o kikiǝ yam. O ma wʋ sɛ sɩ o yagɩ o kikiǝ yam.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Aá pa tʋʋnɩ ja balʋ na sɛ o zaasɩm dɩm tɩn, sɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam maama lwarɩ nɩ amʋ mʋ yɩ wʋlʋ na sɩɩnɩ a ye nabiinǝ bɩcara dɩ ba wʋbʋŋa tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ kɩ abam dɩdʋa dɩdʋa sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ á kikiǝ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ, abam badonnǝ balʋ na wʋ Tiyatiiri nɩ yɩ á wʋ tɔgɩ kaanɩ wʋm kʋntʋ zaasɩm dɩm, yɩ á ba lagɩ sɩ á lwarɩ sʋtaanɩ zaasɩm dɩlʋ na sǝgi tɩn, amʋ daa ba jɩgɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ sɩ a ta dɩ abam nɩ á kɩ.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Á nan taá jɩgɩ abam na maŋɩ á jɩgɩ te tɩn, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kalʋ a na wʋ́ ba tɩn.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ yɩ o tɔgɩ amʋ cwǝŋǝ kam yɩ o wʋ yagɩ-ka tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu dam sɩ o taa te lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama.

english_verse: I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ dam dɩlʋ amʋ Ko na maŋɩ o kwe o kɩ a jɩŋa nɩ tɩn. Amʋ wʋ́ daarɩ a pa-o tɩtɩɩtɩ calɩcʋa kalʋ na nyɩɩnɩ tɩn.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn.»

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Sarɩdɛsɩ nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ na te Wɛ dɩdɛɛra barpɛ bam yɩ o kwǝri o jɩgɩ calɩcwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm o jɩŋa nɩ tɩn te mʋ. Amʋ ye kʋlʋ maama abam na kɩ tɩn. Abam yɩrɩ zaŋɩ kʋ pa nɔɔna bʋŋɩ nɩ á jɩgɩ ŋwɩa mʋ Wɛ tee nɩ, yɩ abam nan nyɩ dɩ twa mʋ te Wɛ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: A nɛ nɩ abam na ŋwɩ te tɩn daa ta wʋ yi Wɛ wʋbʋŋa. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, kwaanɩ-na á zaŋɩ sɩ á cɩ á tɩtɩ, sɩ á ta na jɩgɩ kʋlʋ fɩnfɩɩn tɩn daa yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ ba kʋ cɔgɩ kʋ ti.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Nan guli-na ba na brɩ abam Wɛ cwǝŋǝ dɩ á na ni kʋlʋ ka wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ á kwaanɩ á taá tɔgɩ-ka. Lǝni-na á wʋrʋ dɩ á kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm. Kʋ na daɩ kʋntʋ, amʋ wʋ́ ba a darɩ abam nɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ te, yɩ á bá lwarɩ maŋa kam amʋ na wʋ́ ba tɩn.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ abam badaara na wʋ Sarɩdɛsɩ kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn kɩ lanyɩranɩ. Ba cɩgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ wo-digiru. Amʋ wʋ́ pa ba zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu yɩ ba taa tɔgɩ dɩ amʋ. Bantʋ yɩ balʋ na maŋɩ dɩ kʋntʋ tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn wʋ́ zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu tɩntʋ doŋ. Amʋ daa bá saarɩ kʋntʋ tu yɩrɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ ŋwɩa tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ. Amʋ nan wʋ́ ta jaja a Ko Wɛ dɩ DƖ malɛsɩ sɩm yigǝ nɩ, nɩ wʋntʋ yɩ amʋ nɔɔnʋ mʋ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn.» Kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na pɛ Filadɛlɩfi tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm tɩn

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Filadɛlɩfi nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ na yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu dɩ cɩga tu tɩn te mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ ze borbu wʋlʋ Wɛ dɛɛn na goni ni sɩ DƖ pa Pɛ Davidi naa tɩn. O na pʋrɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o pɩ. O nan daa na pɩ dɩ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ o pʋrɩ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye kʋlʋ maama abam na kɩ tɩn. Nii-na, amʋ pʋrɩ cwǝŋǝ mʋ abam yigǝ nɩ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ-ka o cɩ. Amʋ ye nɩ abam dam ba daga, yɩ á taá kwaanɩ á kɩ amʋ zaasɩm dɩm á bɩcara nɩ, yɩ á wʋ sǝgi amʋ yɩrɩ dɩm.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na paɩ ba yɩ Zwifǝ yɩ ba yagɩ ba daɩ tɩn, ba wʋ sʋtaanɩ cwǝŋǝ wʋnɩ mʋ yɩ ba fɔ vwan. Amʋ wʋ́ pa ba ba ba kuni doonǝ abam yigǝ nɩ, yɩ baá lwarɩ nɩ amʋ soe abam.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ amʋ ni dɩm dɩ pu-dɩa á cam wʋnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ, amʋ wʋ́ lɩ abam yaara yalʋ na wʋ́ ba ya maŋɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nabiinǝ maama tɩn wʋnɩ.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma bɩɩnɩ lele. Á nan fɔgɩ á taá jɩgɩ á na maŋɩ á jɩgɩ te tɩn, sɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ yɩ wanɩ o cɩ pɛɛrɩ dɩlʋ á na lagɩ á joŋi Wɛ tee nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu ji nɩnɛɛnɩ digǝ wʋ ywe amʋ Ko Wɛ sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ, yɩ o daa bá nuŋi da maŋa dɩ maŋa. Amʋ wʋ́ daarɩ a pʋpʋnɩ amʋ Ko Wɛ yɩrɩ dɩm dɩ DƖ tɩʋ kʋm yɩrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ tu yɩra nɩ. Wɛ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ Zeruzalɛm-dʋŋʋ kʋlʋ na lagɩ kʋ nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ amʋ Ko Wɛ te kʋ ba tɩn. Amʋ ta wʋ́ pʋpʋnɩ amʋ yɩrɩ-dʋʋrɩ dɩm kʋntʋ tu yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn.» Kwǝrǝ kalʋ Zezi na pɛ Lawodise tiinǝ kɔgɔ kʋm tɩn

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: «Pʋpʋnɩ tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ wʋlʋ na nii Zezi kɔgɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ Lawodise nɩ tɩn. Pʋpʋnɩ nɩ: Taanɩ dɩntʋ nuŋi wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ ‹Amina› yɩ o tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam dɩ cɩga tɩn te mʋ. Wɛ na kɩ kʋlʋ maama tɩn dɛ wʋntʋ jɩŋa mʋ.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: Amʋ ye kʋlʋ maama abam na kɩ tɩn. Abam ba tɔgɩ amʋ dɩ á wʋ maama, á nan bá yagɩ-nɩ dɩ. Á ya na tɔgɩ cwǝŋǝ dɩdʋa, kʋʋ́ ta lana kʋ garɩ á na tɔgɩ sɩ maama tɩn.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Á nan na ba jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋ-dɩdwɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn, a lagɩ a vɩn abam, nɩnɛɛnɩ nɔɔnʋ na twɩ na-bulu o ni nɩ o yagɩ te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Abam yǝni á tɛ nɩ, á yɩ nadunǝ mʋ kʋlʋkʋlʋ wʋ muri abam. Á nan wʋ lwarɩ nɩ á yɩ zʋra mʋ ŋwaŋa yɩranɩ. Á nyɩ dɩ loorǝ mʋ, yɩ yinigǝ jɩgɩ abam, yɩ á kwǝri á yɩ lilwǝ. Á maa ta yɩ kalambwǝǝlu dɩ.
