english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, ba-na amʋ te sɩ á yǝgi sǝbu-sɩŋa kalʋ ba na wɔgɩ mini nɩ yɩ ka nyɩɩnɩ tɩn. Kʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ pa á sɩɩnɩ á taá yɩ nadunǝ cɩga cɩga Wɛ yigǝ nɩ. Ba-na á yǝgi gwar-pwǝǝnu dɩ amʋ tee nɩ á zʋ sɩ tɩ kwǝli á cavɩɩra yam, dɩ yiǝ tiu kʋlʋ á na wʋ́ dɩ á yiǝ nɩ sɩ ya taa naɩ tɩn.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Amʋ na soe balʋ tɩn, a yǝni a kaanɩ-ba mʋ, yɩ a daarɩ a vaŋɩ ba zwa. Nan lǝni-na á wʋrʋ á yagɩ kǝm-balwaarʋ tɩm, sɩ á daarɩ á taá tɔgɩ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ lanyɩranɩ.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Nii-na, amʋ zɩgɩ digǝ ni nɩ mʋ a kʋkɔga. Wʋlʋ maama nan na ni amʋ kwǝrǝ yɩ o ba o pʋrɩ cwǝŋǝ o pa-nɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ zʋ kʋntʋ tu te, yɩ dɩ́ jǝni daanɩ dɩ́ di wʋdiu.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na wanɩ balɔrɔ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa kʋntʋ tu cwǝŋǝ sɩ o tɔgɩ o jǝni amʋ paarɩ jǝŋǝ kam je nɩ, nɩnɛɛnɩ amʋ dɩ na wanɩ balɔrɔ yɩ a tɔgɩ a jǝni a Ko Wɛ paarɩ jǝŋǝ kam je nɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ maama nan kwaanɩ o pʋrɩ o zwa, sɩ o cǝgi Wɛ Joro kʋm na tɛ kʋlʋ dɩ Zezi nɔɔna bam tɩn.»

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ amʋ daa na nɛ kʋlʋ a wǝli da tɩn mʋ yɩ a nɛ digǝ ni mʋ na pʋrɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ. A daa ma ni kwǝrǝ kalʋ ya na maŋɩ ka ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ amʋ tɩn, yɩ ka nyɩ dɩ ba na tiini ba wui nabɔnɔ te tɩn. Kwǝrǝ kam ma ta ka wɩ: «Diini n ba yoba seeni, sɩ a brɩ nmʋ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na lagɩ tɩ ba tɩ kɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kam na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, Wɛ Joro kʋm ma da kʋ ba amʋ te dɩ dam. Amʋ ma na paarɩ jangɔŋɔ na zɩgɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ, yɩ a na wʋlʋ na je kʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Jangwaanʋ fiinle-tɩna laan maa zɩgɩ tɩ gilimi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm kʋntʋ. Nakwa fiinle-bana maa je tɩ baŋa nɩ ba na zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pu sǝbu-sɩŋa yipwi.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Pooni dɩ sɔɔ ma nuŋi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn, nɩ dʋa na pɩpɩla ka baga ka wuuri te tɩn. Min-vʋrʋ tɩrpɛ maa wʋ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ tɩ di bilim bilim. Tɩntʋ mʋ brɩ Wɛ dɩdɛɛra barpɛ bam na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Kʋ maa nyɩ dɩ nɩnɩʋ mʋ tigi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ, yɩ kʋ nyɩɩna nɩ niu na yɩ te tɩn. Wǝǝnu tɩna tɩ na ŋwɩ maa zɩgɩ tɩ gilimi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm. Tɩ yigǝ dɩ tɩ kwaga maama maa yɩ yiǝ yɩranɩ.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ woŋo kʋm ma nyɩ nɩ nyoŋo te. Kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩle tɩn maa nyɩ dɩ nabala. Kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩtɔ tɩn yigǝ maa nyɩ dɩ nabiinu yigǝ te. Kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩna tɩn maa nyɩ dɩ kaloŋ-zɔŋɔ na jaanɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maama jɩgɩ vwana yardʋ yardʋ mʋ. Tɩ yɩra yam maama maa yɩ yiǝ yɩranɩ, tɩ yigǝ dɩ tɩ kwaga maama. Wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama tɩ ba dɔa, yɩ tɩ zuli Wɛ tɩ wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ mʋ yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu, wʋ-poŋo tu, wʋ-poŋo tu. O maŋɩ o wʋra pulim nɩ mʋ, yɩ o ta wʋra zɩm sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: «Dɩbam Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ sɩɩnɩ n maŋɩ dɩ zulǝ dɩ tiǝ dɩ dam. Bɛŋwaanɩ nmʋ mʋ kɩ wǝǝnu maama, yɩ kʋ yɩ nmʋ wʋbʋŋa mʋ laga yɩ n kɩ-tɩ, yɩ n pa tɩ wʋra.»

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma na tɔnɔ kʋ na pri kʋ wʋ wʋlʋ wʋm na je paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn jazɩm nɩ. Tɔnɔ kʋm yigǝ dɩ kʋ kwaga maama pʋpʋnɩ mʋ. Ba ma mǝǝni kʋ ni dɩm dɩ maarʋ kuni bɩrpɛ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: A ma daarɩ a na Wɛ malɛka kalʋ na dana tɩn, yɩ ka tɔɔlɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka wɩ: «Wɔɔ mʋ yi sɩ o wanɩ o dwanɩ maarʋ tɩlʋ na mǝǝni tɔnɔ kʋm ni dɩm nɩ tɩn, sɩ o daarɩ o puri-kʋ?»

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝri Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ naa tɩga baŋa nɩ naa curu nɩ, o na wʋ́ wanɩ o puri tɔnɔ kʋm sɩ o daarɩ o karɩmɩ-kʋ.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: A wʋ ma tiini kʋ cɔgɩ dɩ ba na wʋ nɛ nɔɔnʋ wʋlʋ na yi sɩ o puri tɔnɔ kʋm sɩ o daarɩ o karɩmɩ-kʋ tɩn.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Nakwa fiinle-bana bam wʋ dɩdʋa ma ta dɩ amʋ o wɩ: «Yɩ pa n wʋ cɔgɩ. Nii, Zuda dwi tu wʋlʋ ba na bǝi nɩ Zuda nyoŋo yɩ o yɩ Pɛ Davidi naa tɩn mʋ wanɩ o dʋna maama, yɩ wʋntʋ yi sɩ o puri tɔnɔ kʋm ni maarʋ tɩrpɛ tɩm.»

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma na Pǝlbu, o na zɩgɩ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm dɩ wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn dɩ nakwa bam tɩtarɩ nɩ. O maa nyɩ nɩ ba ya gʋ-o mʋ te. O jɩgɩ nyɩa yarpɛ mʋ dɩdaanɩ yiǝ yarpɛ. O yiǝ yarpɛ yam mʋ brɩ Wɛ dɩdɛɛra barpɛ bam, yɩ bantʋ mʋ Wɛ tʋŋɩ lʋgʋ baŋa je sɩm maama nɩ.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm laan ma vu wʋlʋ na je paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn te, o joŋi tɔnɔ kʋm na wʋ o jazɩm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: yɩ nmʋ pa ba tɔgɩ ba di paarɩ, yɩ ba zɩgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ yigǝ nɩ ba zuli-DƖ. Ba ma wʋ́ ta te nabiinǝ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma nii a na Wɛ malɛsɩ kɔgɔ zanzan, yɩ a ni sɩ kwǝri. Sɩ daga lanyɩranɩ, sɩ yɩ kuni mʋrrʋ zanzan mʋrrʋ yirrr mʋ. Sɩ maa zɩgɩ sɩ gilimi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm, dɩdaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn dɩ nakwa bam.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Sɩ laan ma leeni baŋa baŋa sɩ wɩ: «Pǝlbu wʋm ba na gʋ tɩn sɩɩnɩ o maŋɩ sɩ o joŋi paarɩ dɩ dam dɩ nadunni dɩ swan dɩ baarɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ zulǝ dɩ tiǝ.»

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma ni wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na wʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ dɩ tɩlʋ maama na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ dɩ curu nɩ tɩn, kʋ wǝli dɩ tɩlʋ maama na wʋ na-fara wʋnɩ tɩn dɩ. Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama Wɛ na kɩ tɩn ma leeni tɩ wɩ: «Wʋlʋ na je paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm maŋɩ dɩ paarɩ dɩ tiǝ dɩ zulǝ dɩ dam, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn ma wɩ: «Amina, kʋ yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ.» Kʋ daarɩ nakwa bam ma kuni doonǝ ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma nii a na Pǝlbu wʋm laan na puli sɩ o puri tɔnɔ kʋm tɩn. O ma dwanɩ dayigǝ maa kʋlʋ na mǝǝni tɔnɔ kʋm ni dɩm tɩn. Amʋ ma ni wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn dɩdʋa kwǝrǝ na dwana nɩ dʋa na mumunǝ te tɩn, yɩ kwǝrǝ kam ta ka wɩ: «Ba yo.»

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma nii a na sisǝŋ-pwǝŋǝ. Wʋlʋ na dɔgɩ ka baŋa nɩ tɩn maa ze taŋa. Ba ma pu paarɩ yipugǝ o yuu nɩ. O ma nuŋi dɩ dam, sɩ o vu o magɩ jara o wanɩ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm daa ma dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩle tɩn. A ma ni wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn tɩle tu wʋm na tagɩ o wɩ: «Ba yo.»

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma na sisǝŋǝ kadoŋ ka na nuŋi, yɩ ka yɩ nasɩŋa muri muri. Wʋlʋ na dɔgɩ ka baŋa nɩ tɩn ma joŋi dam sɩ o ba o lɩ ywǝǝni lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, sɩ nɔɔna bam taa magɩ jara ba gʋ daanɩ. Ba ma kwe sʋ-lɔŋɔ ba kɩ o jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm daa ma dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩtɔ tɩn. A ma ni wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn tɩtɔ tu wʋm na tagɩ o wɩ: «Ba yo.» A ma nii a na sisǝŋ-zwǝnǝ. Wʋlʋ na dɔgɩ ka baŋa nɩ tɩn maa ze luu kʋlʋ ba na maa maŋɩ duuni ba nii tɩn.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Amʋ ma ni dwanɩm wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn tɩtarɩ nɩ nɩ kwǝrǝ te ka wɩ: «Nń ma n dɛ wʋnɩ ŋwɩʋ maama mʋ n yǝgi mɩna zʋŋ-biǝ yi dɩdʋa yɩranɩ má, yɩ n ta wʋ́ daarɩ n kwe n dɛ wʋnɩ ŋwɩʋ maama dɩ mʋ n ma n yǝgi kamaana zʋŋ-bi sɩtɔ má má. Kʋ daarɩ kʋ na yɩ nugǝ dɩ sana, yɩ daŋɩ tɩntʋ sǝbu.»

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm daa ma dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩna tɩn. A ma ni wǝǝnu tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn tɩna tu wʋm na tagɩ kʋ wɩ: «Ba yo.»

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: A ma nii a na sisǝŋ-fufunu. Wʋlʋ na dɔgɩ ka baŋa nɩ tɩn yɩrɩ mʋ yɩ Tʋʋnɩ. Curu tɩtɩ maa tɔgɩ o kwaga. Ba ma joŋi dam sɩ ba vu lʋgʋ baŋa ba gʋ nɔɔna bana maama wʋnɩ nɔɔnʋ dɩdʋa. Ba jɩgɩ dam sɩ ba pa nɔɔna kɩ jara ba gʋ daanɩ, yɩ baá pa kana dɩ gʋ badaara, sɩ yawɩɩrʋ dɩ gʋ badaara, yɩ ba daarɩ ba pa jwaanʋ dɩ gʋ nɔɔna badonnǝ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm laan daa ma dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩnu tɩn. Amʋ ma na Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm, yɩ a na balʋ ba dɛɛn na gʋ Wɛ cwǝŋǝ kam tɔgɩm ŋwaanɩ tɩn jwǝǝru na wʋ dɩ tǝŋǝ nɩ. Ba dɛɛn gʋ bantʋ ba na kwaanɩ ba brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Ba ma ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa ba wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu mʋ dɩ cɩga tu. Nmʋ lagɩ sɩ kʋ yi maŋa kɔɔ mʋ, sɩ n di balʋ na wʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn taanɩ, sɩ n daarɩ n pa balʋ na gʋ dɩbam tɩn na cam.»

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma kwe gwar-pwǝn-dɩdwaarʋ ba pa ba maama. Ba ma ta-ba ba wɩ: «Á taá wʋ yo á siǝ, sɩ á kɔgɔ kʋm laan ba kʋ puli kʋ ti. Bɛŋwaanɩ á donnǝ ta daarɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, balʋ na maŋɩ sɩ ba wǝli á kɔgɔ kʋm wʋnɩ tɩn. Bantʋ yɩ balʋ dɩ na tʋŋɩ ba pa Wɛ tɩn mʋ, yɩ nɔɔna wʋ́ gʋ-ba nɩ ba na gʋ abam te tɩn.»

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: A ma na Pǝlbu wʋm daa na dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩrdʋ tɩn. Tɩga kam laan maa tiini ka sisiŋi. Wɩa kam ma ji nazono tim tim nɩ gwar-zono te. Cana kam ma tiini ka ji nasʋŋʋ cwɛn cwɛn nɩ jana te.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Calɩcwɩ sɩm ma siiri sɩ tʋɩ tɩga nɩ, nɩ vu-dɩʋ na sugi kapɩra kʋ pa ya siiri te tɩn.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kʋm ma pri kʋ kɛ, nɩ ba na pri sara te tɩn. Kʋ daarɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pweeru maama dɩ tɩga kalʋ maama na wʋ nɩnɩʋ tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn ma fɔɔrɩ tɩ tigǝ je nɩ.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Fʋʋnɩ laan ma zʋ nɔɔna maama lʋgʋ bana nɩ, kʋ na yɩ pwa dɩ dɩdɛɛra dɩ pamaŋna yigǝ tiinǝ dɩ nadunǝ dɩ nɔn-kamunǝ, kʋ wǝli dɩ gambɛ dɩ balʋ na te ba tɩtɩ tɩn maama. Ba maama laan ma duri ba vu ba sǝgi ba tɩtɩ pweeru wʋnɩ dɩ kandwa-gugwǝǝru wʋnɩ.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma loori kandwa yam dɩ pweeru tɩm ba na sǝgi tɩ wʋnɩ tɩn, sɩ tɩ tʋ ba baŋa nɩ tɩ kwǝli-ba. Ba maa wɩ: «Kwǝli-na dɩbam, sɩ wʋlʋ wʋm na je paarɩ yituŋu kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn daa yɩ na dɩbam, sɩ Pǝlbu wʋm ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ yi dɩbam.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ dɛ dɩm yiǝ sɩ ba banɩ zaŋɩ nabiinǝ baŋa nɩ, yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa bá wanɩ o lu.»

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: A daa ma na Wɛ malɛka kadoŋ na nuŋi wa-puli je nɩ ka maa bɩɩna. Ka ma jɩgɩ Ŋwɩa-Tu Baŋa-Wɛ nyɩnyʋgʋ, sɩ ka pa balʋ na yɩ DƖ nɔɔna tɩn. Ka ma tɔɔlɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka ta dɩ Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩna sɩm, Wɛ na pɛ-sɩ dam sɩ sɩ wanɩ sɩ cɔgɩ tɩga baŋa dɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋm tɩn, ka wɩ:

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: «Zɩgɩ-na. Á ta yɩ cɔgɩ tɩga baŋa naa nɩnɩʋ kʋm naa tweeru tɩm dɩ. Á cǝgi sɩ dɩ́ ba dɩ́ kɩ balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ́ Tu Wɛ tɩn nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm ba trǝ nɩ, sɩ dɩ́ daarɩ.»

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni balʋ na jɩgɩ Wɛ nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm tɩn ni na ma te. Kʋ yɩ nɔɔna mʋrrʋ bi dɩ fiinna-tɩna (

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: «Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Dɩbam Tu Wɛ maŋɩ dɩ tiǝ dɩ zulǝ dɩ swan dɩ le kǝm, kʋ wǝli dɩ paarɩ dɩ dam dɩ baarɩ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Amina.»

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ na kɛ tɩn, a ma daa na nɔn-kɔgɔ, kʋ na tiini kʋ daga yɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ bá wanɩ nɔɔna bam o ga o ti. Nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ nuŋi tɩɩnɩ dwi tǝri tǝri maama wʋnɩ, dɩ nabiinǝ dwi maama wʋnɩ, dɩ je tǝri tǝri, dɩ taana dwi maama wʋnɩ mʋ. Ba maa zɩgɩ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm yigǝ nɩ. Ba zʋ gwar-pwǝn-dɩdwaarʋ mʋ, yɩ ba daarɩ ba ze kʋrʋ-vɔɔrʋ ba jɩa nɩ.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ba laan maa ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ba wɩ: «Dɩbam Tu Wɛ mʋ je paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ. Dɩntʋ dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm mʋ vrɩ nɔɔna sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ ba yagɩ.»

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm maama maa zɩgɩ sɩ gilimi paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm dɩ nakwa bam, dɩdaanɩ wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn. Sɩ maama laan ma kuni doonǝ sɩ cɔɔlɩ sɩ yuni tɩga nɩ sɩ yɔɔrɩ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm sɩ zuli Wɛ sɩ wɩ:

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ na kɛ tɩn, nakwa bam dɩdʋa ma bwe amʋ o wɩ: «Nɔɔna balʋ na zʋ gwar-pwǝn-dɩdwaarʋ tɩm tɩn yɩ bra mʋ? Ba nuŋi yǝn mʋ?»

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: A ma lǝr-o a wɩ: «Amʋ tu, ta n brɩ-nɩ, sɩ nmʋ mʋ ye-ba.» O laan ma ta o brɩ amʋ o wɩ: «Nɔɔna bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ na nuŋi can-kamunǝ wʋnɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn. Ba zarɩ ba gwaarʋ tɩm dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm jana kam mʋ yɩ tɩ pɩɩrɩ carɩ carɩ.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ nan mʋ pɛ bantʋ ba ba zɩgɩ Wɛ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ, yɩ ba tʋŋɩ ba pa-DƖ wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama DƖ sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ. Wʋlʋ wʋm o na je paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ́ pa ba jǝni o woro nɩ.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Kana daa bá fɔgɩ ka ja bantʋ. Na-nyɔm dɩ nan bá ja-ba. Wɩa nan daa bá ja-ba, naa fʋnyʋgʋ.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ Pǝlbu wʋm o na wʋ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm je sɩm tɩtarɩ nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta nii ba baŋa nɩ nɩ nayɩrʋ te. O nan wʋ́ tɔgɩ ba yigǝ o ja-ba o vu o pa ba nyɔ na buli-yi dɩlʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn wʋnɩ, yɩ Wɛ wʋ́ guguni ba yi-na maama.»

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Pǝlbu wʋm laan ma dwanɩ maa kʋlʋ na kɩ tɩrpɛ tɩn. Kʋ ma kɩ yiritititi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ mɩmaŋa fɩnfɩɩn nɩnɛɛnɩ luu cicoro te.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: A laan ma na malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm sɩ na zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn. Ba ma kwe nabwaanʋ tɩrpɛ ba pa sɩ maama.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Malɛka kadoŋ laan ma ba ka zɩgɩ Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm tee nɩ, yɩ ka ze sǝbu-sɩŋa zʋŋ-tanlaŋa. Ba ma kwe wǝǝnu zanzan tɩlʋ lwǝm na ywǝnǝ tɩn ba kɩ malɛka kam zʋŋa kam wʋnɩ, sɩ ka wǝli dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama loro kʋm. Ba pɛ-ka kʋntʋ, sɩ ka kwe ka ja vu sǝbu-sɩŋa bimbim dɩm dɩ na zɩgɩ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm yigǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ ka zwɛ ka pa Wɛ.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ka na kwe ka zwɛ kʋntʋ tɩn, wǝǝnu tɩm nyʋa kam maa tɔgɩ dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam loro kʋm ka nuŋi malɛka kam jɩa nɩ ka yɔɔrɩ ka diini Wɛ te.

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm maama laan ma ti sɩ yigǝ, sɩ sɩ wu sɩ nabwaanʋ tɩm.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na yɩ dayigǝ tu tɩn ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kʋm. Ka na wugi-kʋ tɩn, dʋ-kambana dɩ mini dɩ jana na gwaanɩ daanɩ tɩn ma cuuri lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. Lʋgʋ baŋa pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ ma di mini. Tweeru tɩm dɩ pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ dɩ ma di mini, dɩ ga-lɛɛrʋ maama.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na saŋɩ tɩn dɩ ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kʋm. Ka na wugi kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma kwe woŋo, kʋ na nyɩ dɩ pu-kamunu yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ mini, ba dʋlɩ ba dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa na-fara bam wʋnɩ. Na-fara bam pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ ma ji jana.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩlʋ maama na ŋwɩ na wʋnɩ tɩn pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ ma tɩ, yɩ ba nabwǝǝru tɩm dɩ pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri dɩdʋa ma cɔgɩ.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩtɔ tɩn ma wu o nabɔnɔ kʋm. Calɩcʋ-kamunu ka na jɩgɩ mini nɩ mɔɔlɩ mini te tɩn laan ma nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ ka tʋ lʋgʋ baŋa bu-tʋlɩ sɩm pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ kuri bɩdwɩ wʋnɩ, dɩ buli sɩm dɩ wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Calɩcʋa kam kʋntʋ yɩrɩ mʋ Calɩcʋ-cɩa. Bwi sɩm kʋntʋ na bam ma ji na-cɛɛra. Nɔɔna zanzan maa nyɔ-ba yɩ ba tʋa.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Malɛsɩ sɩna tu wʋm dɩ laan ma wu o nabɔnɔ kʋm. Wɩa kam pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ ma cɔgɩ. Cana kam pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ dɩ ma cɔgɩ, kʋ wǝli dɩ calɩcwɩ sɩm dɩ kʋntʋ. Kʋntʋ ma pa tɩ maama pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ kʋm kuri bɩdwɩ yɩ lim. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ pooni ma daa tǝri dɛ wʋnɩ pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ kuri bɩdwɩ wʋnɩ, wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma nii a na kaloŋ-zɔŋɔ na tiini kʋ jaanɩ baŋa baŋa. A ma ni kʋ na tagɩ baŋa baŋa kʋ wɩ: «Lɛɛrʋ! Lɛɛrʋ! Lɛɛrʋ lagɩ tɩ ba balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn baŋa. Malɛsɩ sɩtɔ sɩlʋ na daarɩ tɩn na wugi sɩ nabwaanʋ tɩm sɩ pa tɩ kwǝri zaŋɩ, lɛɛrʋ tɩm kʋntʋ wʋ́ ba nabiinǝ baŋa.»

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na yɩ banu tu tɩn laan ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kʋm. Amʋ ma na calɩcʋa na kwǝri wɛyuu nɩ ka ba ka tʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. Ba ma kwe borbu ba pa-ka, sɩ ka ma pʋrɩ goŋ-canluŋu kʋm ni dɩm.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ka na pʋrɩ goŋo kʋm ni dɩm tɩn, nyʋa maa yɔɔrɩ ka pi ka nuŋi goŋo kʋm wʋnɩ, nɩ mini na daga yɩ dɩ jɩgɩ nyʋa te tɩn. Nyʋa kam ma nuŋi ka li wɩa kam dɩ wɛyuu kʋm maama.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Kayɩra laan ma nuŋi nyʋa kam wʋnɩ ka jagɩ tɩga baŋa je maama. Ka ma joŋi dam sɩ ka na dʋnɩ-m, sɩ kʋ taa wɔɛ nɩ nɔŋɔ na wɔɛ te tɩn.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Ba ma kaanɩ kayɩra kam sɩ ka yɩ cɔgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa gaarʋ dɩ tweeru naa vɔɔrʋ dwi maama, sɩ ka daarɩ ka yaarɩ nɔɔna balʋ na ba jɩgɩ Wɛ nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm ba trǝ nɩ tɩn yɩranɩ.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Ba nan wʋ pɛ-ka cwǝŋǝ sɩ ka gʋ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ. Kʋ yɩ sɩ ka pa nɔɔna bam yɩra mʋ taa wiirǝ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi canɩ sɩnu. Ba yɩra yam wʋ́ ta wiirǝ nɩ nɔŋɔ dʋnɩm na wiiri te tɩn mʋ.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɩ nɔɔna bam wʋ́ ta lagɩ sɩ ba tɩ, yɩ tʋʋnɩ bá ja-ba. Baá ta beeri tʋʋnɩ, yɩ tʋʋnɩ ba lagɩ-ba.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Kayɩra kam maa nyɩ dɩ ba na vɔgɩ sise sɩ sɩ vu jara je te tɩn. Ka yuni nyɩ dɩ ka pugi sǝbu-sɩŋa yipwi mʋ te. Ka yibiyǝ maa yɩ nɩnɛɛnɩ nabiinǝ yibiyǝ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Ka yuuywe maa nyɩ dɩ kaana yuuywe te, yɩ ka yǝlǝ nyɩ dɩ nywǝǝnu yǝlǝ te.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Kayɩra kam nyɔɔna maa nyɩ dɩ lu-pʋlwarʋ mʋ kwǝli-ya te. Ka vwana yam wuurim dɩm maa kɩ sɔɔ zanzan, nɩnɛɛnɩ sisǝŋ-kɔgɔ mʋ vaɩ trǝkooru sɩ duri sɩ maa ve jara je te.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Mʋ dayigǝ lɛɛrʋ tɩm. Kʋ nan ta daarɩ lɛɛrʋ kuni bɩle mʋ.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩrdʋ tɩn laan ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kʋm. Amʋ ma ni kwǝrǝ na nuŋi sǝbu-sɩŋa bimbim dɩm na zɩgɩ Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn nyɩa yana yam wʋnɩ.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Kwǝrǝ kam ma ta dɩ malɛsɩ sɩrdʋ tu wʋlʋ na ze nabɔnɔ kʋm tɩn ka wɩ: «Ve, n bwǝli malɛsɩ sɩna sɩm ba na lǝgǝ ba zɩgɩ Efratɩ bu-kamunu kʋm ni nɩ tɩn n yagɩ.»

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam laan ma vu ka bwǝli malɛsɩ sɩna sɩm ka yagɩ. Sɩntʋ ya maŋɩ sɩ ti sɩ yigǝ mʋ sɩ ma cǝgi maŋa kam kʋntʋ nɔ́ɔ, sɩ ka ba ka yi. Sɩ laan ma zaŋɩ sɩ sɩ vu sɩ gʋ nabiinǝ pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ tɩtɔ ma tʋ lʋgʋ baŋa nabiinǝ wʋnɩ, yɩ tɩ gʋ ba pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ. Kʋ nan yɩ mini dɩm dɩ nyʋa kam dɩ ciribi dɩm na nuŋi sise sɩm niǝ nɩ tɩn mʋ gʋ-ba.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Sise sɩm niǝ yam mʋ paɩ sɩ jɩgɩ dam, dɩ sɩ nabilǝ yam dɩ. Sɩ nabilǝ yam nyɩ dɩ bɩsankwɩ mʋ te, yɩ ya jɩgɩ yuni ya maa yaarɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Nabiinǝ balʋ na daarɩ yɩ wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ dam wʋ gʋ-ba tɩn nan wʋ sɛ sɩ ba lǝni ba wʋrʋ ba yagɩ wo-balwaarʋ tɩlʋ ba wʋbʋŋa na lagɩ tɩn. Ba ta yɔɔrɩ ba zuli sʋtaana mʋ, yɩ ba kwǝri ba zuli wǝǝnu tɩlʋ ba tɩtɩ na kɩ dɩ ba jɩa tɩn, kʋ na yɩ jwǝnǝ yalʋ ba na mɛ sǝbu-sɩŋa naa sǝbu-pwǝnǝ naa can-na naa kandwa naa dɛ ba ma kɩ tɩn. Jwǝnǝ yam kʋntʋ nan ba naɩ, yɩ ya kwǝri ya ba ni, yɩ ya warɩ ya vu dɩ.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma nii a na Wɛ malɛka kalʋ na dana tɩn. Ka ma nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka maa tuǝ. Ka mɛ kunkwǝǝnu mʋ ka ma kukwǝri ka tɩtɩ, yɩ manlaa-taŋa kɩkarɩ ka yuu nɩ. Ka yibiyǝ nyɩ dɩ wɩa mʋ, yɩ ka nɛ sɩm nyɩ dɩ min-vʋgʋ na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam maa ze tɔn-balaŋa kalʋ na puri tɩn ka jɩŋa nɩ. Ka ma cwi ka jazɩm naga na-fara bam baŋa nɩ. Ka daarɩ ka cwi ka jagwiǝ naga kam tɩga baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ka laan ma daarɩ ka bagɩ baŋa baŋa, yɩ ka kwǝrǝ kam kɩ sɔɔ nɩ nyoŋo na suuri te tɩn. Malɛka kam na bagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, dʋa dɩ ma bagɩ kuni bɩrpɛ.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Dʋa kam na bagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ maa lagɩ sɩ a pʋpʋnɩ ka na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn a tiŋi. Amʋ laan ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka wɩ: «Ta n cɩm, yɩ zaŋɩ n pʋpʋnɩ dʋa kam na bagɩ ka ta kʋlʋ tɩn.»

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ amʋ ya na maŋɩ a na ka na kwe ka naga ka nɔ na-fara bam baŋa nɩ yɩ ka nɔ kadoŋ tɩga baŋa nɩ tɩn laan ma zǝŋi ka jazɩm jɩŋa wɛɛnɩ,

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Malɛka kam na tagɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, amʋ daa ma joori a ni kwǝrǝ kalʋ ya na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn. Ka daa ma ta dɩ amʋ ka wɩ: «Ve malɛka kalʋ na zɩgɩ na-fara bam baŋa nɩ dɩ tɩga kam baŋa nɩ tɩn te, sɩ n joŋi tɔn-balaŋa kalʋ na puri ka wʋ ka jɩŋa nɩ tɩn.»

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: A ma vu a ta malɛka kam sɩ ka pa-nɩ tɔn-balaŋa kam. Ka ma ta-nɩ ka wɩ: «Joŋi tɔnɔ kʋm n di. Kʋ na wʋ nmʋ ni nɩ, kʋʋ́ ta sʋna nɩ tʋʋrʋ te. N nan na ligi-kʋ, kʋ laan wʋ́ ta cana mʋ n kana nɩ.»

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma joŋi tɔn-balaŋa kam malɛka kam jɩŋa nɩ a dɩ a ni nɩ. Ka maa sʋna nɩ tʋʋrʋ te. Kʋ daarɩ, amʋ na ligi-ka tɩn, ka ma lǝni ka ji cam yɩranɩ a kana nɩ.

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ba ma daarɩ ba ta amʋ, sɩ a yɩ maŋɩ kʋnkɔlɔ kʋlʋ na wʋ pooni nɩ Wɛ-digǝ kam yigǝ nɩ tɩn, bɛŋwaanɩ ba kwe je sɩm kʋntʋ ba kɩ dwi-gɛ tiinǝ bam jɩŋa nɩ mʋ. Bantʋ nan mʋ wʋ́ ba ba taa karɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na yɩ Wɛ nyɩm tɩn wʋnɩ, ba nwanɩ wǝǝnu ba cɔgɩ sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi canɩ fiinna-sɩle (

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Wɛ maana tiinǝ bam kʋntʋ mʋ brɩ Olivi tweeru tɩle tɩm, dɩ min-zwǝǝnu tɩle tɩlʋ na zɩgɩ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋlʋ na te lʋgʋ baŋa maama tɩn yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Mini mʋ wʋ́ nuŋi ba niǝ nɩ dɩ cɔgɩ ba dʋna balʋ na kwaanɩ sɩ ba kɩ-ba balɔrɔ tɩn. Wʋlʋ maama na lagɩ sɩ o kɩ-ba balɔrɔ tɩn, baá gʋ-o kʋntʋ doŋ mʋ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Bantʋ nan jɩgɩ dam sɩ ba ja wɛyuu kʋm, sɩ dʋa daa yɩ ta nɩa maŋa kam ba na wʋra ba tɔɔlɩ Wɛ kwǝrǝ kam tɩn. Ba nan daa ta jɩgɩ dam sɩ ba pa na ji jana. Ba ma ta jɩgɩ dam sɩ ba pa yaara dwi maama ba nabiinǝ baŋa maŋa kalʋ maama ba na lagɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: O na gʋ-ba, ba yɩra yam wʋ́ ta tigi pooni yigǝ nɩ tɩʋ kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ. Yɩra yalʋ na brɩ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ kuri cɩga cɩga tɩn mʋ yɩ Sodɔm dɩ Ezipi. Kʋ yɩ dáanɩ mʋ ba jaanɩ ba Yuutu wʋm ba pa tʋʋn-dagara baŋa nɩ ba gʋ.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna laan wʋ́ nuŋi tɩɩnɩ dwi maama wʋnɩ, dɩ nabiinǝ dwi maama wʋnɩ, dɩ taana dwi maama wʋnɩ, dɩ je tǝri tǝri, ba ba ba nii bantʋ yɩra yam na tigi da tɩn. Baá ta nii ba yɩra yam sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi da yatɔ dɩ cicoro, yɩ ba bá sɛ sɩ ba kwe-ba ba kɩ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo dɩ bantʋ bale tʋʋnɩ dɩm. Ba ma wʋ́ kɩ kwɛɛra, yɩ ba daarɩ ba paɩ-da pɛɛra. Baá ta jɩgɩ wʋpolo, Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam kʋntʋ bale ya na yaarɩ nabiinǝ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ dɩ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm ba na ŋɔɔnɩ tɩn ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ dɩ cicoro kʋm na kɛ, Wɛ wʋ́ pa DƖ siun kʋlʋ na paɩ ŋwɩa tɩn laan ba kʋ zʋ ba yɩra yam, yɩ ba joori ba bi ba zaŋɩ. Fʋʋnɩ ma wʋ́ tiini dɩ ja balʋ maama na wʋ́ na-ba tɩn.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Wɛ nijoŋnǝ bam bale laan ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka wɩ: «Diini-na á ba yo.» Kunkoŋo ma ba kʋ kwe-ba kʋ jɩgɩ kʋ ma diini wɛyuu, yɩ ba dʋna bam zɩgɩ ba nii-ba.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Kantʋ maŋa kam nɩ nɔ́ɔ, tɩga baŋa maama wʋ́ tiini ka sisiŋi. Kʋ ma pa tɩʋ kʋm pɔɔrɩm kuni fugǝ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ cɔgɩ maama. Tɩga kam sisiŋim dɩm maa gʋ nɔɔna mʋrr-tɩrpɛ (

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Mʋ lɛɛrʋ tɩlʋ na kɩ bɩle tu tɩn. Kʋ nan ta daarɩ lɛɛrʋ tɩlʋ na wʋ́ kɩ bɩtɔ tu tɩn. Tɩ lagɩ tɩ ba lele mʋ. Nabɔnɔ kʋlʋ na wugi kʋ ma kweeli tɩn

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na yɩ sɩrpɛ tu tɩn laan ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kʋm. Kwǝri ma ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ baŋa baŋa sɩ wɩ: «Lʋgʋ baŋa paarɩ dɩm laan wʋ dɩ́ Yuutu Wɛ jɩŋa nɩ mʋ, dɩ Krisi wʋm DƖ na tʋŋɩ tɩn jɩŋa nɩ. Paarɩ dɩm kʋntʋ wʋ́ ta wʋra sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.»

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: yɩ ba wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ maŋɩ n wʋra mʋ pulim nɩ, yɩ n daa ta wʋra maŋa maama. Dɩ́ kɩ nmʋ le, dɩ n laan na kwe n dam-fɔrɔ kʋm n ma n te lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiinǝ balʋ na daɩ nmʋ nɔɔna tɩn tiini ba jɩgɩ ban-zɔŋɔ dɩ nmʋ. Kʋ daarɩ lele kʋntʋ nmʋ banɩ nan wʋ́ zaŋɩ dɩ ba. Kʋ laan yi maŋa kalʋ nmʋ na wʋ́ di twa sarɩya tɩn, yɩ nmʋ wʋ́ pa balʋ maama na sɛ nmʋ tɩn na pɛɛra. Kʋ na yɩ nmʋ nijoŋnǝ bam dɩ balʋ maama na yɩ nmʋ nɔɔna yɩ ba kwarɩ n yɩrɩ dɩm tɩn, kʋ na yɩ nɔn-kamunǝ naa nabwǝnǝ dɩ. Kʋ nan na yɩ balʋ na cɔgɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tɩn, maŋa yiǝ sɩ nmʋ laan cɔgɩ-ba dɩ.»

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ba na zuli Wɛ kʋntʋ ba ti tɩn, Wɛ di-kamunu kʋlʋ na wʋ DƖ sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn ni laan ma pʋrɩ. Wɛ cullu tɩm na pʋpʋnɩ kandwa yɩra nɩ tɩ tiŋi daka kalʋ wʋnɩ tɩn ma naɩ jaja. Dʋa laan maa pɩpɩla, yɩ ka bagɩ ka wuurǝ. Tɩga ma sisiŋi, yɩ dʋ-kambana tiini ya tʋɩ zanzan.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm yɩ ka-puǝ mʋ, yɩ o pugǝ kam vri sɩ o lʋ. Kʋ na cana tɩn, o ma kaasɩ bagɩ bagɩ.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩdoŋ daa ma nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ. Amʋ ma na prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ, kʋ yɩ nasʋŋʋ mʋ yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ yuni tɩrpɛ dɩ nyɩa fugǝ. Yipwi ma pu kʋ yuni tɩm maama baŋa nɩ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma kwe kʋ nabili kʋ ma vaŋɩ calɩcwɩ sɩm pɔɔrɩm kuni bɩtɔ wʋnɩ kuri bɩdwɩ kʋ kwǝri wɛyuu nɩ kʋ dɩ tɩga nɩ. Kʋ ma ba kʋ zɩgɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na lagɩ o lʋ tɩn yigǝ nɩ, sɩ o na lʋgɩ bu wʋm, sɩ kʋ kwe kʋ di.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma lʋ o bu wʋm, o yɩ bǝkǝrǝ mʋ. Wʋntʋ mʋ wʋ́ ta te lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama dɩ o dam. Kaanɩ wʋm na lʋgɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma kwe bu wʋm ba ja vu Wɛ te, DƖ paarɩ yituŋu kʋm na wʋ mɛ tɩn.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm laan ma duri o vu kagʋa yuu, jǝgǝ kalʋ Wɛ na maŋɩ DƖ kwɛ sɩ DƖ pa-o tɩn. DƖ wʋ́ ta nii o baŋa nɩ je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ da mʋrʋ dɩ biǝ yale dɩ fusɩrdʋ (

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Jara dɛɛn ma tʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ. Wɛ malɛsɩ dɩdɛɛrʋ wʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Misɛɛlɩ tɩn dɩdaanɩ o kwaga malɛsɩ tiinǝ bam mʋ dɩ jara dɩ prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm dɩ dɩ kwaga malɛsɩ tiinǝ bam.

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm ma wʋ wanɩ jara yam. Kʋ dɩ kʋ kwaga malɛsɩ tiinǝ bam ma daa wʋ nɛ jǝŋǝ je Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ba ma zǝli-kʋ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ba dʋlɩ ba yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ, dɩ kʋ kwaga malɛsɩ tiinǝ bam maama. Prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm kʋntʋ mʋ yɩ bɩsankwɩa kalʋ na maŋɩ ka wʋra faŋa faŋa tɩn. Ka yɩrɩ nan mʋ yɩ Vwa-nyɩna pɛ, dɩ Sʋtaanɩ, yɩ ka ganɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni kwǝr-dɩa na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka wɩ: «Lele kʋntʋ dɩbam Tu Wɛ vrɩ DƖ nɔɔna sʋtaanɩ jɩŋa nɩ. Wɛ ma brɩ DƖ dam dɩ DƖ paarɩ dɩm na yɩ te tɩn. Krisi wʋm Wɛ na tʋŋɩ tɩn dɩ ma brɩ DƖ dam dɩm. Bɛŋwaanɩ wʋlʋ na yǝni o ŋɔɔnɩ o cɔgɩ dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam Wɛ yigǝ nɩ tɩn daa tǝrǝ. Wʋntʋ mʋ yǝni o zɩgɩ dɩ́ Tu Wɛ yigǝ nɩ o ŋɔɔnɩ o cɔgɩ ba yigǝ tɩtɩɩ dɩ wɩa maama. Ba laan nan dɩ-o ba yagɩ.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Dɩ́ ko-biǝ bam nan wan-o Pǝlbu wʋm jana kam nuŋim dɩm ŋwaanɩ, dɩ ba na brɩ Wɛ cɩga kam tɩn ŋwaanɩ mʋ. Ba ma sɛ sɩ ba kwe ba ŋwɩa ba ma lǝni tʋʋnɩ.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ, abam balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ tɩn, á taá jɩgɩ wʋpolo. Kʋ daarɩ, kʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa dɩ kʋ na-fara bam, lɛɛrʋ wʋ́ ba abam baŋa, bɛŋwaanɩ vwa-nyɩna pɛ wʋm tu abam te, yɩ o tiini o jɩgɩ ban-zɔŋɔ lanyɩranɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ o ye nɩ o da yam gɛ fɩɩn mʋ.»

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm na lwarɩ nɩ ba zǝli-kʋ ba yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋ ma pɛ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na lʋgɩ bǝkǝrǝ kam tɩn kwaga kʋ pu.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwe kaloŋ-zɔŋɔ vwana yale ba pa kaanɩ wʋm, sɩ o ma jaanɩ wɛɛnɩ o vu o yi kagʋa kam yuu, jǝgǝ kalʋ o na maŋɩ sɩ o taa wʋra tɩn. Dáanɩ mʋ Wɛ wʋ́ ta nii o baŋa nɩ bɩna yatɔ dɩ cicoro, sɩ prǝnyoŋo kʋm daa yɩ zaŋɩ kʋ ja-o.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Prǝnyoŋo kʋm ma twɩ na zanzan sɩ ba vu ba pɛ kaanɩ wʋm ba ja viiri, nɩ bugǝ na na duri te tɩn.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Tɩga kam ma zǝni kaanɩ wʋm, yɩ ka pʋrɩ ka ni ka nyɔ na balʋ maama prǝnyoŋo kʋm na twɩ tɩn.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Kʋ ma pa kʋ banɩ tiini dɩ zaŋɩ dɩ kaanɩ wʋm. Kʋ laan ma vu sɩ kʋ kɩ jara dɩ kaanɩ wʋm dwi tiinǝ balʋ na daarɩ tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ yɩ balʋ na sɛ Wɛ niǝ yam yɩ ba brɩ nɩ ba tɔgɩ Zezi cɩga kam tɩn.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm laan ma vu dɩ zɩgɩ na-fara bam ni nɩ.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma na varɩm wʋdoŋ o na nuŋi na-fara wʋnɩ. O jɩgɩ nyɩa fugǝ dɩ yuni tɩrpɛ mʋ. O nyɩa yam maama baŋa maa jɩgɩ yipwi. Ba ma pʋpʋnɩ yɩra yalʋ na twɩ Wɛ tɩn o yuni tɩm yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Amʋ na nɛ varɩm wʋm tɩn, o nyɩ dɩ gweeru mʋ. O nɛ maa nyɩ dɩ faa nɛ, yɩ o ni nyɩ dɩ nyoŋo ni. Prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm laan ma kwe kʋ paarɩ dɩm dɩ kʋ dam-fɔrɔ kʋm kʋ kɩ varɩm wʋm kʋntʋ jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: O yuu kʋm dɩdʋa maa tiini kʋ pogili nɩ o ya lagɩ o tɩ mʋ te, yɩ kʋ laan ba kʋ je. Kʋ maa sʋ nabiinǝ maama, yɩ ba tɔgɩ varɩm wʋm kʋntʋ kwaga.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama maa kuni doonǝ ba zuli prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm, dɩ kʋ na kwe kʋ dam dɩm kʋ pa varɩm wʋm kʋntʋ tɩn. Ba ma daarɩ ba zuli varɩm wʋm dɩ, yɩ ba tɛ ba wɩ: «Nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na maɩ dɩ varɩm wʋm. Nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ nan bá wanɩ o kɩ jara dɩd-o.»

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: O ma puli o ŋɔɔnɩ o gooni Wɛ, yɩ o twɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ dɩ DƖ sɔŋɔ kʋm, kʋ wǝli dɩ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ DƖ sɔŋɔ kʋm nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Varɩm wʋm ma kwǝri o joŋi dam sɩ o kɩ jara dɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam, sɩ o wanɩ-ba. O ma joŋi dam sɩ o taa te lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ maama, dɩ tɩɩnɩ dwi maama tiinǝ, dɩ taana dwi maama tiinǝ, dɩ je tǝri tǝri maama tiinǝ.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Nan pʋrɩ-na á zwa sɩ á cǝgi amʋ taanɩ dɩm:

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ maama na tu sɩ o dʋna ja-o ba kɩ ba na lagɩ te tɩn, baá ja kʋntʋ tu mʋ, o bá lu. Wʋlʋ maama dɩ nan na tu sɩ ba ma sʋ-zɔɔ ba gʋ-o tɩn, baá ma-kʋ mʋ ba ma gʋ-o, o bá wanɩ o lu. Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ Wɛ nɔɔna bam maŋɩ sɩ ba ta vɔ pu-dɩa mʋ, sɩ ba daarɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Wɛ. Varɩm wʋlʋ na nuŋi tɩga nɩ tɩn

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma na varɩm wʋdoŋ o na nuŋi tɩga nɩ. O jɩgɩ nyɩa yale mʋ nɩ pibala nyɩa na yɩ te tɩn. O maa ŋɔɔnɩ nɩ prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm na ŋɔɔnɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ varɩm wʋm ma pa-o wʋm dam-fɔrɔ kʋm sɩ o ma tʋŋɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o zɩgɩ o nii-o. O ma ma-dɩ o fɩn balʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn o pa ba zuli dayigǝ varɩm wʋlʋ yuu kʋm ya na pogili yɩ kʋ laan je tɩn.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Varɩm bɩle tu wʋm kʋntʋ ma tiini o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yalʋ na dana tɩn. O ma pa mini nuŋi wɛyuu nɩ dɩ ba tɩga baŋa, yɩ nɔɔna maama na-dɩ.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: O na nɛ cwǝŋǝ sɩ o kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla yantʋ doŋ dayigǝ varɩm wʋm yigǝ nɩ tɩn, kʋ ma pa o wanɩ o ganɩ nɔɔna balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn. O ma ta-ba sɩ ba mɔ kamɔgɔ, sɩ kʋ taa nyɩ dɩ dayigǝ varɩm wʋlʋ ba na mɛ sʋ-lɔŋɔ ba zagɩ o yuu ba pogili yɩ o ta ŋwɩ tɩn.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: O ma daarɩ o na cwǝŋǝ sɩ o kɩ siun kamɔgɔ kʋm kʋntʋ wʋnɩ, sɩ kʋ taa ŋwɩ. O na kɩ kʋntʋ tɩn, kamɔgɔ kʋm maa waɩ kʋ ŋɔɔna, yɩ kʋ jɩgɩ dam sɩ kʋ pa balʋ maama na vɩn sɩ ba zuli-kʋ tɩn tɩ.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: O ma pa nɔɔna maama kɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ ba jazɩna nɩ naa ba trǝ nɩ, kʋ na yɩ nabwǝnǝ dɩ nɔn-kamunǝ, naa nadunǝ dɩ yinigǝ tiinǝ, kʋ wǝli dɩ gambɛ dɩ balʋ na te ba tɩtɩ tɩn dɩ.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Nɔɔnʋ na ba jɩgɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm kʋntʋ, o bá wanɩ o yǝgi woŋo naa o kwe woŋo o yǝgi. Nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm kʋntʋ nan mʋ brɩ varɩm wʋm yɩrɩ dɩm, naa nimoro kʋlʋ na brɩ o yɩrɩ dɩm tɩn.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Yo seeni kʋ maŋɩ sɩ n ta n jɩgɩ swan mʋ. Wʋlʋ na bʋŋɩ lanyɩranɩ tɩn, oó wanɩ o lwarɩ varɩm wʋm nimoro kʋm kuri na yɩ te tɩn. Nimoro kʋm brɩ nabiinu yɩrɩ mʋ. Kʋ nan yɩ biǝ yardʋ dɩ fusɩrdʋ bardʋ mʋ (

english_verse: I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion! With him were
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma nii a na Pǝlbu wʋm o na zɩgɩ Siyɔn piu kʋm yuu nɩ. Nɔɔna mʋrrʋ bi dɩ fiinna-tɩna tɩm (

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: A ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ. Ka maa dwana nɩnɛɛnɩ na-fara na wuurǝ yɩ dʋa bagɩ te tɩn, yɩ ka nyɩ dɩ kwan-magɩna na magɩ ba kwaanʋ te tɩn.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kʋm maa zɩgɩ kʋ yɔɔrɩ Wɛ paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm dɩ wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn dɩ nakwa bam. Ba maa leeni lǝŋ-dʋŋa kalʋ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ na bá wanɩ o zaasɩ-ka tɩn, kʋ na daɩ nɔɔna mʋrrʋ bi dɩ fiinna-tɩna tɩm yɩranɩ (

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Bantʋ nan mʋ cɩgɩ ba tɩtɩ dɩ wo-digiru kǝm, yɩ ba wʋ kɩ boorim. Bantʋ yǝni ba tɔgɩ Pǝlbu wʋm kwaga mʋ ba ve je sɩlʋ maama o na wʋ́ vu tɩn. Zezi mʋ ŋwɩ ba lwarɩm jɩnɩ nabiinǝ maama wʋnɩ, sɩ bantʋ da yigǝ ba ji Wɛ nɔɔna dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm dɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Bantʋ nan wʋ fɔgɩ ba fɔ vwan. Ba ba jɩgɩ tusim. Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩtɔ na tagɩ wǝǝnu tɩlʋ tɩn

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma na malɛka kadoŋ ka na jaanɩ wɛyuu nɩ. Ka maa jɩgɩ Wɛ kwǝr-ywǝŋǝ kalʋ na ba lɩɩrɩ maŋa dɩ maŋa tɩn ka tɔɔlɩ ka brɩ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn, kʋ na yɩ je tǝri tǝri wʋnɩ, dɩ nabiinǝ dwi maama, dɩ taana dwi maama tiinǝ, dɩ tɩɩnɩ dwi maama tiinǝ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ka maa ŋɔɔnɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka wɩ: «Kwarɩ-na Wɛ, sɩ á daarɩ á taá pa-DƖ zulǝ, bɛŋwaanɩ maŋa kam yiǝ sɩ DƖ di nabiinǝ sarɩya. Nan kuni-na doonǝ á zuli Wɛ dɩlʋ na kɩ wɛyuu dɩ tɩga baŋa dɩ na-fara dɩdaanɩ buli tɩn.»

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Malɛka kadoŋ ma saŋɩ ka kwaga, yɩ ka tɛ ka wɩ: «Tʋ-kamunu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Babilɔnɩ tɩn tʋa. Kʋ tʋ kʋ ti. Kʋntʋ dɛɛn mʋ yǝni kʋ pa nabiinǝ dwi maama tɔgɩ ba kɩ kʋ boorim kikiǝ yam, nɩ ba na nyɔgɩ sa-dɛɛra ba su te tɩn.»

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩtɔ tɩn dɩ daa ma saŋɩ, yɩ ka tɛ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka wɩ: «Nɔɔna balʋ maama na zuli varɩm wʋm dɩ o kamɔgɔ kʋm yɩ ba daarɩ ba jɩgɩ o nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm ba trǝ nɩ naa ba jɩŋa nɩ tɩn,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm wʋ́ ba bantʋ baŋa, nɩnɛɛnɩ ba logi sa-dɛɛra balʋ na wʋ pugi tɩn mʋ ba su zʋŋa ba pa ba nyɔ ba su te. Balʋ maama na sɛ varɩm wʋm kʋntʋ tɩn, mini dɩ ciribi mʋ wʋ́ di-ba kʋ pa ba na cam zanzan. Baá yaarɩ kʋntʋ Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩm yigǝ nɩ dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm yigǝ nɩ mʋ.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Mini dɩm wʋ́ ta di-ba yɩ kʋ paɩ nyʋa zaŋɩ taan, baá yaarɩ sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn. Balʋ maama na zuli varɩm wʋm dɩ o kamɔgɔ kʋm tɩn, dɩ balʋ maama na jɩgɩ nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋlʋ na brɩ o yɩrɩ dɩm tɩn, ba bá na siun wɩa dɩ tɩtɩɩ maama.»

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ balʋ maama na yɩ Wɛ nɔɔna yɩ ba sɛ DƖ niǝ yam yɩ ba kɩ ba wʋ-dɩdʋa dɩ Zezi tɩn maŋɩ sɩ ba zɩgɩ dɩ pu-dɩa mʋ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni kwǝrǝ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka wɩ: «Nan pʋpʋnɩ tɩntʋ: Kʋ na zɩgɩ zɩm sɩ kʋ taa ve tɩn, balʋ na sɛ dɩ́ Yuutu wʋm yɩ ba ba ba tɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo.» Wɛ Joro kʋm ma lǝri kʋ wɩ: «Kʋ yɩ cɩga mʋ. Bantʋ wʋ́ sin dɩ ba tɩtʋŋ-cɛɛra yam, bɛŋwaanɩ ba kǝm-laarʋ mʋ wʋ́ ta tɔgɩ-ba.» Wɛ sarɩya maŋa kam na yɩ te tɩn

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma nii a na kunkoŋo kʋ yɩ napoŋo, yɩ wʋlʋ na nyɩ dɩ nabiin-bu tɩn je kʋ baŋa nɩ. Sǝbu-sɩŋa yipugǝ ma pu o yuu nɩ, yɩ o daarɩ o ze sʋkɔrɔ kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ ni tɩn.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Malɛka kadoŋ daa ma nuŋi Wɛ di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ. Ka tɔɔlɩ baŋa baŋa ka ta dɩ wʋlʋ na je kunkoŋo kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn ka wɩ: «Lʋgʋ baŋa faa kʋm laan bɩgɩ kʋ ti. Ma n sʋkɔrɔ kʋm n ma n gwe faa kʋm, sɩ kʋ maŋa kam yiǝ.»

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Wʋlʋ na je kunkoŋo kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn laan ma vuvugi o sʋkɔrɔ kʋm lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ o ma gwe faa kʋm.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Amʋ daa ma na malɛka kadoŋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ di-kamunu kʋm wʋnɩ, yɩ ka dɩ jɩgɩ sʋkɔrɔ kʋlʋ na jɩgɩ ni tɩn.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ dɩ na nii mini baŋa nɩ tɩn ma nuŋi Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm nɩ, ka tɔɔlɩ dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka ta dɩ malɛka kalʋ na ze sʋkɔrɔ kʋm tɩn ka wɩ: «Ma n sʋkɔrɔ kʋm n ma n gwǝri tiu-biǝ balʋ ba na maa kɩ sana tɩn, sɩ lʋgʋ baŋa tiu-biǝ bam kʋntʋ laan bɩgɩ ba ti.»

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam laan ma ma ka sʋkɔrɔ kʋm ka ba maa gwǝri lʋgʋ baŋa tiu-biǝ bam. Ka ma kwe-ba ka dɩ kazɔ-zɔŋɔ wʋnɩ sɩ ka tɛ, sɩ kʋ brɩ Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ na wʋ́ ba nabiinǝ baŋa te tɩn.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Kazɔgɔ kʋm zɩgɩ tɩʋ kʋm daa nɩ mʋ. Ba maa tɛ tiu-biǝ bam kʋ wʋnɩ sɩ ba nyʋa kam taa nuŋǝ. Ba nyʋa kam kʋntʋ yɩ jana mʋ. Jana kam ma nuŋi ka pɛɛlɩ tɩga ka duri ka vu nɩnɛɛnɩ kilomɛtra biǝ-yatɔ (

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma na wo-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩdoŋ wɛyuu nɩ, dɩ na tiini dɩ dana yɩ dɩ ba jɩgɩ doŋ. A ma na Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ, sɩ dɩdʋa dɩdʋa jɩgɩ yaara dwi tǝri tǝri mʋ, sɩ sɩ pa ya ja nɔɔna. Yaara yarpɛ yam kʋntʋ mʋ lagɩ ya ma kweeli, bɛŋwaanɩ yantʋ na kɩ ya ti, Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm laan wʋ́ ti.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Amʋ ma daarɩ a na woŋo kʋ na nyɩ dɩ nɩnɩʋ. Kʋ maa nyɩɩna nɩ niu na nyɩɩnɩ te tɩn, yɩ kʋ nyɩ nɩ kʋ gwaanɩ dɩ mini mʋ te. Amʋ ta ma na balʋ na wanɩ varɩm wʋm dɩ o kamɔgɔ kʋm kʋ wǝli dɩ o yɩrɩ dɩm nimoro kʋm dam dɩm tɩn. Ba zɩgɩ nɩnɩʋ kʋlʋ na nyɩɩna lanyɩranɩ tɩn ni nɩ, yɩ ba ze kwaanʋ tɩlʋ Wɛ na pɛ-ba tɩn.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Ba maa leeni lǝŋǝ kalʋ na yɩ Wɛ tɩntʋŋnʋ Moyisi lǝŋǝ dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm lǝŋǝ tɩn. Ba ma leeni ba zuli Wɛ ba wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ tɩtʋŋa yam tiini ya yɩ tɩtʋŋ-kamunǝ, ya ba jɩgɩ doŋ. Lʋgʋ maama Pɛ, nmʋ cwe sɩm yɔɔrɩ lanyɩranɩ, sɩ tɔgɩ cɩga.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ, nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ tǝrǝ o na bá kwarɩ nmʋ. Nɔɔna maama nan wʋ́ ta zuli nmʋ yɩrɩ dɩm. Nmʋ yɩranɩ mʋ yɩ wʋ-poŋo tu cɩga cɩga. Lʋgʋ baŋa dwi maama tiinǝ wʋ́ ba ba kuni doonǝ nmʋ yigǝ nɩ ba zuli-m, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔna maama wʋ́ na nmʋ tɩtʋŋa yam na jɩgɩ cɩga te tɩn.»

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Kʋntʋ kwaga nɩ amʋ ma na Wɛ-sɔŋɔ digǝ kam ni na pʋrɩ, yɩ ka yigǝ digǝ kam ni dɩ pʋrɩ.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm sɩ na jɩgɩ yaara dwi tǝri tǝri kuni bɩrpɛ tɩn ma nuŋi digǝ kam wʋnɩ. Sɩ ma zʋ gwar-pwǝǝnu tɩlʋ na tiini tɩ nyɩɩnɩ tɩn, yɩ sɩ daarɩ sɩ vɔ sǝbu-sɩŋa kili sɩ nyɔɔna nɩ.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Wǝǝnu tɩna tɩlʋ na ŋwɩ tɩn dɩdʋ laan ma zaŋɩ kʋ kwe sǝbu-sɩŋa zwɩ sɩrpɛ kʋ pa malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm. Zwɩ sɩm kʋntʋ nan mʋ su dɩ Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm. Dɩntʋ nan mʋ jɩgɩ ŋwɩa sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kalʋ na ba ti tɩn.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Wɛ dam dɩm dɩ DƖ paarɩ-zulǝ yam ma pa nyʋa nuŋi ka su DƖ digǝ kam ni maama. Nyʋa kam ma pa nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ warɩ digǝ kam wʋ o zʋ, sɩ kʋ taa ve maŋa kam malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm na wʋ́ pa yaara kuni bɩrpɛ kʋm na wʋ́ ba kʋ kɩ kʋ ti tɩn.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni kwǝr-dɩa na ŋɔɔnɩ baŋa baŋa Wɛ digǝ kam wʋnɩ ka ta dɩ Wɛ malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm ka wɩ: «Kwe-na zwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩlʋ Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm na wʋ sɩ wʋnɩ tɩn á ja vu á lo á yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ.»

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Dayigǝ malɛka kam ma kwe ka zʋŋa kam ka ja vu ka lo ka yagɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ. Ka na logi kʋntʋ tɩn, ŋwan-cɛɛra ma ja balʋ na jɩgɩ varɩm wʋm nyɩnyʋgʋ kʋm yɩ ba zuli o kamɔgɔ kʋm tɩn.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na saŋɩ tɩn ma lo ka zʋŋa kam ka yagɩ na-fara bam wʋnɩ. Na bam ma ji nɩ tʋ jana na yɩ te tɩn. Woŋo kʋlʋ maama na zʋʋrɩ na-fara bam wʋnɩ tɩn ma tɩ.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Malɛsɩ sɩtɔ tu wʋm ma lo o zʋŋa kam o yagɩ bu-tʋlɩ sɩm wʋnɩ dɩ buli sɩm dɩ wʋnɩ. Na bam ma ji jana.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma ni Wɛ malɛka kalʋ na nii bwi sɩm baŋa nɩ tɩn na wɩ: «Wʋ-poŋo Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ maŋɩ n wʋra pulim nɩ mʋ, yɩ n daa n ta wʋra maŋa maama, nmʋ kɩ cɩga dɩ n na vaŋɩ ba zwa te tɩn.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ bantʋ mʋ gʋ n nɔɔna bam dɩ n nijoŋnǝ bam ba pa ba jana nuŋi. Kʋntʋ mʋ nmʋ laan pɛ na ji jana sɩ ba dɩ nyɔ. Mʋ kʋlʋ na maŋɩ dɩ ba kǝm dɩm tɩn.»

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Amʋ ma daarɩ a ni kwǝrǝ kadoŋ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ kaanɩm bimbim dɩm tee nɩ ka wɩ: «Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ, nmʋ sarɩya yam yɔɔrɩ lanyɩranɩ, yɩ ya tɔgɩ cɩga mʋ.»

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩna tɩn ma kwe ka zʋŋa kam ka lo ka yagɩ wɩa kam yɩra nɩ. Wɩa kam ma joŋi dam sɩ ka pa ka wulim dɩm baanɩ nɔɔna.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Ka wulim dɩm na tiini dɩ baanɩ nɔɔna bam kʋntʋ tɩn, ba ma ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ Wɛ yɩrɩ dɩ DƖ na pɛ yaara yam kʋntʋ ja-ba tɩn. Ba nan wʋ lǝni ba wʋ dɩ ba kikiǝ yam sɩ ba daarɩ ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩnu tɩn ma lo ka zʋŋa kam varɩm wʋm paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm baŋa nɩ. Lim ma ba dɩ li varɩm wʋm paarɩ dɩm jǝgǝ kam maama. Nɔɔna ma dʋnɩ ba yǝlǝ dɩ ba yaara yam.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Ba ma ŋɔɔnɩ ba twɩ Baŋa-Wɛ ba yɩra ŋwana yam dɩ ba yaara yam ŋwaanɩ. Ba nan daa ta wʋ lǝni ba wʋ dɩ ba kikiǝ yam.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩrdʋ tɩn ma lo ka zʋŋa kam ka yagɩ bu-zaŋa kalʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Efratɩ tɩn wʋnɩ. Ka na bam ma wɩ, yɩ kʋ daarɩ cwǝŋǝ kʋ pa pwa balʋ na nuŋi wa-puli jǝgǝ nɩ tɩn sɩ ba wanɩ ba bɛ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Amʋ ma daarɩ a na ciciribiǝ batɔ, ba nyɩ dɩ yoorǝ te. Ba dɩdʋa ma nuŋi prǝnyoŋ-kɩnkagɩlɩ dɩm ni nɩ. Wʋdoŋ dɩ ma nuŋi varɩm wʋm ni nɩ, yɩ dɩdʋa kam dɩ nuŋi varɩm wʋlʋ na pa o yɩ Wɛ nijoŋnu yɩ o yagɩ o daɩ tɩn ni nɩ.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Ciciribiǝ bam kʋntʋ yɩ sʋtaanɩ nɔɔna mʋ yɩ ba waɩ ba kɩ wo-kɩnkagɩla. Ba ma zaŋɩ ba vu lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam maama te, sɩ ba maama la daanɩ ba ti ba yigǝ ba kɩ jara dɩ Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa-Wɛ DƖ dɛ kamunu kʋm dɛ nɩ.

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni Zezi na ŋɔɔnɩ o wɩ: «Cǝgi-na. A lagɩ a ba nɩ ŋwɩɩnʋ na darɩ o ba te tɩn mʋ. Wʋlʋ na fɔgɩ o cɩ o tɩtɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta jɩgɩ yu-yoŋo. Wʋlʋ na zʋ o gwaarʋ yɩ o yɩrɩ tɩn, amʋ na tuǝ, cavɩɩra bá ja-o nɔɔna yigǝ nɩ o na bá ta yɩ kalambolo tɩn ŋwaanɩ.»

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Malɛka kalʋ na kɩ sɩrpɛ tɩn laan ma lo ka zʋŋa kam viu wʋnɩ. Kwǝr-dɩa laan ma ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ digǝ kam paarɩ jangɔŋɔ kʋm jǝgǝ kam nɩ ka wɩ: «Kʋ kɩ kʋ ti.»

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Tʋ-kamunu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Babilɔnɩ tɩn ma yarɩ kuni bɩtɔ kʋ cɔgɩ. Lʋgʋ baŋa dwi tiinǝ tɩɩnɩ dɩm maama ma cɔgɩ. Wɛ ma wʋ swe tʋ-kamunu Babilɔnɩ ni nɩ yɩ DƖ waarɩ-kʋ. DƖ ban-zɔŋɔ kʋm ma tiini kʋ ba tɩʋ kʋm baŋa, nɩnɛɛnɩ DƖ logi sa-dɛɛra mʋ DƖ su zʋŋa DƖ pa kʋ nyɔ kʋ su te.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Malɛsɩ sɩrpɛ sɩlʋ na jɩgɩ zwɩ sɩrpɛ sɩm tɩn dɩdʋa ma ba ka ta dɩ amʋ ka wɩ: «Ba, sɩ a brɩ-m Wɛ na lagɩ DƖ pa ka-bor-zɔŋɔ kʋm na cam te. Ka-boro kʋm kʋntʋ mʋ maa brɩ tɩʋ kʋlʋ na lɔgɩ bwi zanzan ni nɩ tɩn.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam yǝni ba kɩ boorim dɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ tɩn maa tiini ba kɩ boorim dɩ kʋ, nɩ nɔɔnʋ na nyɔgɩ sana o bugi te tɩn.»

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Wɛ Joro kʋm ma ba amʋ te dɩ dam, Wɛ malɛka kam ma ja-nɩ ka vu kagʋa yuu. Je sɩm kʋntʋ nɩ mʋ amʋ nɛ kaanɩ o dɔgɩ varɩm na yɩ nasʋŋʋ cwɛn cwɛn tɩn baŋa nɩ, yɩ yɩra yalʋ na twɩ Wɛ tɩn pʋpʋnɩ varɩm wʋm yɩra nɩ. O maa jɩgɩ yuni tɩrpɛ dɩ nyɩa fugǝ.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Kaanɩ wʋm ma zʋ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ na yɩ nasʋn-pupweeru dɩ nasʋnnʋ cwɛn cwɛn tɩn. O yɩra maa jɩgɩ wǝǝnu zanzan tɩ na nyɩɩna, tɩ yɩ sǝbu-sɩŋa dɩ kandwa-ŋʋna mʋ. O ma ze sǝbu-sɩŋa zʋŋa, yɩ ka ni su dɩ wo-zɔɔna yalʋ na brɩ o boorim kikiǝ yam.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Ba ma pʋpʋnɩ yɩrɩ dɩlʋ kuri na ba lwarɩ jaja tɩn o tri nɩ, yɩ dɩ wɩ: «Babilɔnɩ kʋlʋ na yɩ tʋ-kamunu tɩn mʋ yɩ ka-bwǝǝru maama nu, dɩ lʋgʋ baŋa wo-zɔɔna maama nu.»

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Amʋ nɛ nɩ kaanɩ wʋm nyɔgɩ Wɛ nɔɔna balʋ ba na gʋ Zezi cɩga kam ŋwaanɩ tɩn jana mʋ o su, nɩ o nyɔgɩ sana mʋ o bugi te. Amʋ na nɛ-o kʋntʋ tɩn, kʋ ma tiini kʋ sʋ-nɩ.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam ma bwe-nɩ ka wɩ: «Kʋ sʋ nmʋ sɩ bɛɛ mʋ? Kʋ na yɩ varɩm wʋlʋ na jɩgɩ yuni tɩrpɛ tɩm dɩ nyɩa fugǝ kam tɩn, dɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na dɔgɩ o baŋa nɩ tɩn, amʋ wʋ́ pa n lwarɩ ba kuri na yɩ te tɩn.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Varɩm wʋlʋ nmʋ na nɛ tɩn ya ŋwɩ mʋ, o nan daa tǝrǝ. Kʋ daarɩ sɩ o nuŋi goŋ-canluŋu kʋm wʋnɩ mʋ, sɩ o laan vu o cɔgɩm jǝgǝ. Kʋ na yɩ balʋ na zʋʋrɩ lʋgʋ baŋa nɩ yɩ ba yɩra maŋɩ ya wʋ pʋpʋnɩ ya tiŋi Wɛ ŋwɩa tɔnɔ kʋm wʋnɩ maŋa kam lʋgʋ baŋa ta na tǝrǝ tɩn, ba na nɛ varɩm wʋm, kʋʋ́ sʋ ba maama. Bɛŋwaanɩ o dɛɛn ya ŋwɩ mʋ, o nan daa tǝrǝ. O nan wʋ́ joori o ba o nuŋi nabiinǝ yigǝ nɩ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Nmʋ nan maŋɩ sɩ n ta n jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋa mʋ dɩ swan, sɩ n wanɩ n lwarɩ wǝǝnu tɩntʋ kuri. Varɩm wʋm yuni tɩrpɛ tɩm brɩ pweeru tɩrpɛ mʋ. Tɩntʋ mʋ yɩ pweeru tɩlʋ kaanɩ wʋm na je tɩ baŋa nɩ tɩn. Yuni tɩrpɛ tɩm dɩ brɩ pwa barpɛ woŋo mʋ.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Pwa bam kʋntʋ banu maŋɩ ba tʋ mʋ. Ba dɩdʋa mʋ wʋra lele. Wʋlʋ na kweeli tɩn ta wʋ tu. O na tuǝ, o paarɩ dɩm bá daanɩ zanzan.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Varɩm wʋlʋ ya na ŋwɩ yɩ o laan daa tǝrǝ tɩn brɩ pɛ wʋlʋ na kɩ ba wʋnɩ nana tɩn mʋ. Wʋntʋ yɩ pwa barpɛ balʋ na dɛ yigǝ tɩn wʋ nɔɔnʋ mʋ. O nan na tuǝ, o dɩ laan wʋ́ vu o cɔgɩm jǝgǝ.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Nyɩa fugǝ yalʋ nmʋ na nɛ tɩn brɩ pwa fugǝ mʋ. Pwa bam kʋntʋ ta wʋ joŋi ba paarɩ dɩm. Ba nan wʋ́ ba ba joŋi dam, sɩ ba tɔgɩ dɩ varɩm wʋm ba taa te nɔɔna sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ maŋa fɩnfɩɩn yɩranɩ.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Pwa fugǝ kam maama jɩgɩ wʋbʋŋɩ dɩdʋa mʋ. Ba ma wʋ́ kwe ba dam maama ba kɩ varɩm wʋm jɩŋa nɩ.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Ba ma wʋ́ kɩ jara dɩ Pǝlbu wʋm. Pǝlbu wʋm nan wʋ́ wanɩ-ba, o na yɩ wʋlʋ na yɩ yum tiinǝ maama Yuutu dɩ pwa maama Pɛ tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Balʋ na tɔgɩ dɩ wʋntʋ yɩ ba wanɩ jara yam tɩn mʋ yɩ balʋ o na maŋɩ o kuri sɩ ba taa yɩ o nɔɔna tɩn. Bantʋ mʋ tɔg-o dɩ cɩga.»

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Nyɩa fugǝ yalʋ nmʋ na nɛ tɩn dɩ varɩm wʋm tɩtɩ wʋ́ ta culi ka-boro kʋm. Ba nan wʋ́ vrɩ o wǝǝnu tɩm maama o tee nɩ ba daar-o kalambolo, yɩ ba di o ya-nwana yam, ba daarɩ ba zwɛ-o dɩ mini.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Baá cɔg-o, bɛŋwaanɩ Wɛ maŋɩ DƖ pa ba wʋbʋŋa yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ. Kʋ yɩ Wɛ mʋ lagɩ sɩ ba kɩ ni-dɩdwɩ ba kɩ ba dam maama varɩm wʋm jɩŋa nɩ. Kʋ jɩgɩ sɩ kʋ taa yɩ kʋntʋ mʋ, sɩ kʋ vu kʋ yi maŋa kalʋ Wɛ taanɩ dɩm na tagɩ kʋlʋ tɩn na wʋ́ sɩɩnɩ kʋ ba kʋ kɩ tɩn.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Kʋ daarɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ nmʋ na nɛ yɩ o yɩ ka-boro tɩn mʋ yɩ tʋ-kamunu kʋlʋ na te lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam maama tɩn.»

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Malɛka kam na tagɩ kʋntʋ ka ti tɩn, amʋ ma na malɛka kadoŋ na nuŋi Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka maa bɩɩnɩ lʋgʋ baŋa. Ka maa jɩgɩ dam, yɩ ka tiini ka nyɩɩna ka pa pooni zǝŋi lʋgʋ baŋa maama nɩ.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Ka ma tɔɔlɩ baŋa baŋa dɩ kwǝr-dɩa ka wɩ: «Tʋ-kamunu kʋlʋ yɩrɩ na yɩ Babilɔnɩ tɩn tʋa. Kʋ tʋ kʋ ti. Tɩʋ kʋm laan jigi ciciri-balwaarʋ jǝgǝ mʋ, yɩ ciciri-zɔɔna dwi maama zʋʋrɩ da. Zunǝ balʋ nɔɔna na culi yɩ ba ba laɩ tɩn dwi maama laan zʋʋrɩ dáanɩ mʋ.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa dwi maama ma tʋ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ boorim cwe sɩm wʋnɩ, nɩ ba nyɔgɩ kʋ sa-dɛɛra mʋ ba su te. Lʋgʋ baŋa pwa bam ma tɔgɩ ba kɩ boorim dɩ kʋ. Lʋgʋ baŋa pipimpiinǝ ma tiini ba ji nadunǝ tɩʋ kʋm kʋntʋ ŋwaanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ nɔɔna bam soe sɩ ba taa cɔgɩ sǝbu zanzan.»

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Amʋ laan ma ni kwǝrǝ kadoŋ na ŋɔɔnɩ Wɛ-sɔŋɔ nɩ ka wɩ: «Amʋ nɔɔna-ba, nuŋi-na tɩʋ kʋm wʋnɩ, sɩ á yɩ tɔgɩ kʋ wo-balwaarʋ cwe sɩm, sɩ á yɩ tɔgɩ á na kʋ cam dɩm.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaanɩ kʋ wo-balwaarʋ tɩm daga zanzan, tɩ daŋɩ da-baŋa nɩ tɩ yi wɛyuu. Wɛ nan ye kʋ kǝm-lwaanʋ tɩm maama ni nɩ.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Cɔgɩ-na tɩʋ kʋm sɩ kʋ maŋɩ dɩ kʋntʋ na cɔgɩ nɔɔna badonnǝ te tɩn. Pa-na kʋ cɛ kʋ yɩra nɩ sɩ kʋ dwǝni kʋ na pɛ kʋ cɛ nɔɔna yɩra nɩ te tɩn. Fɩ-na-kʋ sɩ kʋ nyɔ sa-dɛɛra balʋ na tiini ba dana ba dwe kʋntʋ sana kam kʋ na paɩ nɔɔna nyɔ tɩn.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Pipiri-na tɩʋ kʋm ywǝǝni dɩm dɩ kʋ wo-laarʋ tɩm, sɩ tɩ joori tɩ ji cam dɩ yaara kʋ tɩtɩ ŋwaanɩ. Bɛŋwaanɩ tɩʋ kʋm nyɩ dɩ kaanɩ wʋlʋ na yǝni o tɛ o wɩ: ‹Amʋ di paarɩ mʋ, yɩ kʋlʋkʋlʋ bá yaarɩ-nɩ. Amʋ daɩ kadǝm, yɩ a yigǝ bá fɔgɩ ka nywanɩ.›

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Tɩʋ kʋm na brɩ kʋ tɩtɩ kamunni tɩn ŋwaanɩ, yaara dwi maama wʋ́ da yi-kʋ bɩdwɩ baŋa nɩ. Yawɩ-balwaarʋ dɩ yi-nywana dɩ kana wʋ́ ba tɩ ja-kʋ. Mini dɩ ma wʋ́ di-kʋ. Yuutu Baŋa-Wɛ jɩgɩ dam-fɔrɔ, yɩ dɩntʋ mʋ lagɩ DƖ di tɩʋ kʋm sarɩya.»

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Kʋ na yɩ lʋgʋ baŋa pwa balʋ na tɔgɩ ba kɩ tɩʋ kʋm boorim kikiǝ yam yɩ ba di ywǝǝni daanɩ tɩn, ba na nɛ tɩʋ kʋm na jɩgɩ mini tɩn, baá ta keerǝ yɩ ba frɩ ba tɩtɩ kʋ ŋwaanɩ.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Ba na kwarɩ kʋ yaara tɩn ŋwaanɩ, baá ta zɩgɩ yigǝ yigǝ yɩ ba nii kʋ nyʋa kam. Baá ta coosǝ ba wɩ: «Ei. Lɛɛrʋ, lɛɛrʋ! Babilɔnɩ yɩ tʋ-kamunu mʋ, yɩ kʋ tiini kʋ jɩgɩ dam. Kʋ laan nan tu kʋ cɔgɩ lɩla, maŋa fɩnfɩɩn wʋnɩ.»

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Lʋgʋ baŋa pipimpiinǝ bam dɩ wʋ́ ta keerǝ yɩ ba nywanɩ ba yigǝ tɩʋ kʋm cɔgɩm dɩm ŋwaanɩ, bɛŋwaanɩ nɔɔn-nɔɔnʋ daa tǝrǝ sɩ ba taa yǝgi ba zɩla yam.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Ba laan ma wʋ́ ta dɩ tɩʋ kʋm ba wɩ: «Wo-laarʋ tɩlʋ maama nmʋ fra na zʋ tɩn daa tǝrǝ. Nmʋ jɩjɩgɩrʋ tɩm dɩ n nɩnwaŋa kam maama laan je. Nmʋ daa n bá na wǝǝnu tɩm kʋntʋ maŋa dɩ maŋa.»

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Pipimpiinǝ balʋ na tiini ba na nyɔɔrɩ tɩʋ kʋm baŋa nɩ tɩn wʋ́ ta zɩgɩ yigǝ yigǝ, ba na kwarɩ kʋ yaara yam tɩn ŋwaanɩ. Ba ma wʋ́ ta keerǝ,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: yɩ ba coosi ba wɩ: «Ei. Lɛɛrʋ, lɛɛrʋ! Tʋ-kamunu kʋntʋ tiini kʋ jɩgɩ nɩnwaŋa. Kʋ nɔɔna bam maa zʋʋrɩ gwaarʋ tɩlʋ na nyɩɩnɩ tɩn, dɩ tɩlʋ na yɩ nasʋnnʋ cwɛn cwɛn tɩn, yɩ ba pu sǝbu-sɩŋa wǝǝnu dɩ kandwa-ŋʋna ba yɩra nɩ.

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
