translation_verse: O ma lɔɔre na-bala kam lara kam, de ka tapwale-bia bam, de chwɛ dem kuri seeni dem maama o kwei-te o zwɛ kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses ni se ba ke tei to.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne, Aron ma kwei varem wolo na wora zwɛɛm pɛɛre kaanem ŋwaane to o gwoni o ba. O bia bam ma ja ka jana bam ba vo ba pa‑o. O de ma kwei-ba o dole dole o yage kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem ne.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei varem wom nɔna yam yera yera ba ja vo ba pa‑o, de o yuu kom de. O ma zwɛ te maama kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: O ta ma zare varem wom wo-zela yam, de o nɛ sem, ye o laam kwei te maama o daŋe zwɛɛm pɛɛre dem baŋa ne o zwɛ o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: O laam ma kwei zwɛɛm pɛɛre dem o ke kaanem se ko maŋe de de chwoŋa kam na ye tei to.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: O déem ta ma kwei wodiu pɛɛre dem de o woli da. O ma zwɛ muni jaguli-yi de wone o kwei o woli dɛ maama ba na ke zwɛɛm pɛɛre delo tetete to wone, ye o zwɛ-te kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: O ta ma kwei na-bala kam de pi-bala kam na wora se se ke yazura pɛɛre kaanem nɔɔna bam ŋwaane to o gwoni se ba. O bia bam ma ja vara bam jana ba vo ba pa‑o. O de ma kwei-ba o dole dole o yage kaanem dakaa kam sɛ sena sem ne.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Ko daare vara bam nyɔɔna yam, de ba jazem chwa yam, Aron déem zeiŋi-te wɛɛne mo, se te ta ye pɛɛre te pae Baŋa Wɛ. Ko nam ke nenɛɛne Moses na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to mo.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Aron déem na ke kaanem dem dwi maama o ti to, o ma zeiŋi o je o jeeri Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom ye o kwei Wɛ zaane o ma swɛ ba swolim. O laam ma zege kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne o jwoori o tu tega.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Moses dedaane Aron ma zo wara-vwei dem wone. Ba daa na nwoŋi to, mo ba kwei Wɛ zaane ba ma swɛ nɔɔna bam swolim. Baŋa Wɛ ma veere o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Min-vogo ma pɔpɔ ko nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ tei ne ko chu ko di zwɛɛm pɛɛre dem, dedaane lara kam maama na wo kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne to kula! Nɔɔna bam maama na nɛ konto to, mo ba bage de kwor-dɛa ye ba daare ba vwi ba yibia tega ne ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Moses ma ta Aron o we, “Ko ye tento ŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋɔɔne o bere debam ye o we, ‘Balo na twɛ amo tei se ba toŋe ba pa-ne to jege se ba lɔre we amo ye wose mo. Amo nɔɔna bam maama de maa jege se ba pa-ne zula.’ ” Aron na nigi konto to, mo o maŋe da chemm.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Moses déem ma toŋe o bwoŋi Misayeli de Elizafan se ba ba. Banto déem ye Aron kwo nyaane Yuzeli bia mo. Moses ma ta-ba o we, “Ba-na á zeŋe á chorro tem á ja á nwoŋi wara-jei sem ni ne. Ja-ba á nwoŋi á vo dáa dáa tigisim jeiga kam ne.”

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Moses ta ma ta Aron dedaane o bia balei balo na daare to, Eleaza de Itamara, o we, “Yé vugimi á yu-ywei, nam yé kaare-na á gwaaro de á wo na chɔge tei maama to de. Abam ná ke konto, á de wó te mo. Baŋa Wɛ bane ta maa wó zaŋe Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama baŋa ne. Ko daare, á chorro Isarele dwi tiina bam wó wane ba keeri Nadab de Abihu lwi sem, de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ se mini di-ba de chɔge to.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Abam nam yé yage-na wara-vwei dem ni ne se á nwoŋi. Á ná ke konto leile, á wó te mo. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ swolim nuga kam wo abam yuu ne mo, ye ka pɔɔre abam se á ta‑á ye á yera Wɛ totoŋa ŋwaane.” Ba déem ma sɛ Moses ni dem.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Aron o we,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Nmo dedaane n bia bam ná yeini á zo wara-vwei dem wone, ko dae se á nyɔ sana. Abam ná ke konto, á wó te mo. Amo ni dento wó taa wora mo wuu ko pae abam de á dwi dem.

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: Ko ye abam totoŋe mo se á kwei a nia yalo a na tɔge Moses baŋa a pa Isarele tiina bam to, á bere ba maama.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Moses déem ma ta Aron de o bia balo na daare to, Eleaza de Itamara, o we, “Ko ná ye muni delo ta na daare Baŋa Wɛ pɛɛra yam wone to, se á kwei-de á wɔ bworobworo-memene selo sabɔle na tere de wone to. Á laam wó maŋe kaanem dakaa kam teiŋa ne mo á di bworobworo kom dáane, ko na yɔɔre ko ye ko yera ko pa Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Maŋe-na jei selo na ye wose to ne á di-ko. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ pɔɔre-ko se ko taa ye abam de á bia bam popɔra mo o wodiu pɛɛra yam wone. Mo ni delo o na pɛ amo to.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam jege se ba kwei varem chwei dem de o nyɔɔne dem ba woli de o lara kam ba zeiŋi-te wɛɛne se te taa ye wodiu pɛɛre te pae Baŋa Wɛ. Varem wom nyɔɔne dem de o chwei dem ye abam de á bia bam nyem mo. Baŋa Wɛ ni dem konto wó taa wora taa wuu mo.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Moses déem ma bwei wɛleere saarem pɛɛre boŋo kom bwia. O ma maane we ba maŋe ba zwɛ ko maama. O bane ma zaŋe de Eleaza dedaane Itamara ye o bwei-ba o we,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Bɛ mo ke ye abam wo maŋe wara-jei sem ne á di varem wom nɔna yam? Pɛɛre dem konto tiini de ye wose mo. Baŋa Wɛ kwei-de o pa abam Isarele tiina bam wɛleera saarem ŋwaane, se á ma‑á ke kaanem á le ba lwarem o yiga ne mo.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Nii-na! Ba wo jaane boŋo kom konto jana ba zo wara-vwei dem wone. Konto ŋwaane, ko ya ye se á di ko nɔna yam wara-jei sem ne mo, nenɛɛne amo na pɛ ni se á ke tei to.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Aron ma leiri Moses o we, “Nam nii! Nɔɔna bam zem kwei ba wɛleere saarem pɛɛre dem de ba zwɛɛm pɛɛre dem mo ba ke kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. De konto de, amo de nam nɛ lɛɛro dento dwoŋi. Konto to, a ya ná seene a di wɛleere saarem varem wom nɔna yam zem, Baŋa Wɛ ya wó jwoŋi a keim dem na?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Moses na nigi konto to, o wo ma to.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta Moses de Aron o we:

english_verse: But you must not eat animals such as camels, rock badgers, and rabbits that chew the cud but don't have divided hoofs. And you must not eat pigs—they have divided hoofs, but don't chew the cud. All of these animals are unclean, and you are forbidden even to touch their dead bodies.
translation_verse: Vara bam konto maama dwi dae se á done ba nɔna. Ba ná tega, bere á yé dwei-ya. Ba wo maŋe de chullu tem abam tei ne.

english_verse: You may eat anything that lives in water and has fins and scales. But it would be disgusting for you to eat anything else that lives in water, and you must not even touch their dead bodies.
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama na zoore na wone to ná ba jege nabili-pelwaro dedaane poro, ko ye wo-zɔɔne mo abam tei ne.

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Se ko ná daare wo-korro telo na jege vɔna ye te ta kare te tuuri tega ne to, te ye wo-zɔɔna mo te pae abam. Wo-zɔɔna chullu tem

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná zeŋe vara bam konto wo-teko, kotu jege se o zare o gwaaro mo se dedaan-ni maŋa ná yia, se o laam kwɛ o tete de chullu tem, vara bam konto na ye wo-digiru te pae abam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: de kachelachoro, de kweeru, de balei, de bwe, de puswollu, de manlɛ.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Wo-digiru tem konto dedoa ná tega ye ko to kɔɔro wone, woŋo kolo maama na wo kɔɔro wom wone to de wó taa jege digiru. Ba jege se ba lɔ kɔɔro wom mo.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Wo-digiru tem ná tega ye te to te dwei woŋo kolo maama, ko de wo taa jege digiru mo. Ko ná ye kura, naa kambia mo te dwei, abam jege se á chɔge kura yam, naa kambia kam mo.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Wo-digiru tem konto ná tega ye te to wo-dwa balo abam na lage á du to wone, wo-dwa bam ta bá taa jege digiru.

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: Se wo-dwa bam ná wo na wone ba bugi mo, ye wo-teko kom ná to ba wone, wo-dwa bam wó taa jege digiru te pae abam.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Varem wolo na maŋe de dim to ná tega ye wolo dwei‑o, kotu wó taa jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni mo se ko yi dedaan-ni maŋa.

english_verse: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.
translation_verse: Tento ná tuura, naa te ná vei nɛ sena baŋa ne, naa te ná jege nɛ dedɛ mo te via de, ko chula se á di-te. Te ye wo-zɔɔna mo.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Nam yé chɔge-na á tete de-te, se á tɔge te ŋwaane á ji wo-digiru.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Pɔɔre-na á tete de wo-digiru maama, se á ta‑á ye wose. Kokuri to, amo tete ye wose tu mo. Nam yé chɔge-na á tete de tega-veila, naa wo-korro telo na kare te vei tega kam baŋa ne to.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom. A déem jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne se a taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom mo. Nam ta‑á ye-na wose, amo tete na ye wose tu to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: Abam maa wó da ya baŋa se á wane á pɔɔre kolo na jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni ye ko wo maŋe de dim to, dedaane kolo na maŋe de chullu tem ye á jege chwoŋa se á di-ko to.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Kaane ná jaane puga ye o lo bakeira, o jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni se ko yi da yarepɛ mo. Ko ta nye de o na yeini o ye tei o chana zarem maŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Da nana dɛ dem ne, se o pa ba gwoni o bu wom peini.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Kaane wom nam ná loge busankana, o wó taa jege digiru se ko yi da fuga-yana mo, ne o na yeini o ye tei o chana zarem maŋa ne to. O ta wó peene se da fuseredo-yaredo mo kɛ, se o laam kwɛ de o jana-pworim digiru tem.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye bakeira mo, naa busankana mo o loga, ye o digiru kwɛɛm maŋa kam ná ti, se o ja pi-bala kalo na yi bene to o vo wara-jei sem manchwo-peena ni ne o kwei-ka o pa kaanem tu wom, se o ma o ke zwɛɛm pɛɛre kaanem o pa Wɛ. Kaane wom ta wó ja kunkwoŋa naa kunkwon-puuri o vo o pa‑o se o ma o ke wɛleere saarem kaanem.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ta ma ta Moses dedaane Aron o we,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Wolo ná maane we wo-zwanno zaŋe o yera ne, naa o yera yam ná birigi, naa ya-tora mo jege‑o, ye ko ná jigi jawe-chɛɔ kolo na lɔgese nɔɔna to, se ba ja kotu ba vo Aron naa o dwi tu na ye kaanem tu to tei.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ŋɔne dem nam ná ye ŋɔn-pwona, ye jei sem ba nye se peini gwoŋo se ko dwoni o yera yam mɛ na gilimi-de to, ye de ni koro tem de ná wo peere, kaanem tu wom wó pa se ba pe kotu mo dáa dáa o yerane se ko yi da yarepɛ.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: Wolo ná jege jawe-chɛɔ kolo na lɔgese nɔɔna to o yera yam ne, se ba ja kotu ba vo kaanem tu tei.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom ná maane we ko ye wo-zɔŋɔ mo ye ko peere pa se ko ni koro tem de peere, ye mwara ná wo ko wone,

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: o ta ná maane we jei sem konto ne woŋo daa ŋone mo ye ko peere, naa ko ná seene, o jege se o ja o tete mo o vo kaanem tu tei o bere‑o.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom nam ná nii o na we koro tem wo peere, ye jei sem de ba nye se tiŋi gwoŋo, ye o ta ná maane we ŋɔne dem wora de jia, o wó pe kotu o yage dáa dáa o yerane mo da yarepɛ.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Wo-zɔŋɔ kom ná jage kotu yera yam ne, kaanem tu wom wó pa se ko nwoŋi pwooni ne we kotu wo maŋe de chullu tem mo. Ko ye jaweo kolo na lɔgese nɔɔna to mo.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: Mini ná di wolo yera yam ye jei sem ya-nɔna yam ná peere naa ya ná ye nasoŋ-pupwiu,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: se kaanem tu nii kotu zii. Koro telo na wo ŋɔne dem ni ne to ná peere, ye jei sem de ná nye se tiŋi gwoŋo, ko bere we ko ye jawe-chɛɔ kolo na lɔgese nɔɔna to mo bobo ŋɔne dem wone konto. Kaanem tu wom wó pa se ko nwoŋi pwooni ne we kotu wo maŋe de chullu tem kikia.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Ko daare, kaanem tu wom ná nɛ we koro telo na wora to wo peere, ye jei sem de ba nye se tiŋi gwoŋo, ye o ta ná maane we ŋɔne dem wora de jia, o wó pe kotu mo dáa ne da yarepɛ.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Jaweo kom nam ná wo jage ye ŋɔne dem ná lage de jei, ko bere we ko ye kulu mo zaŋe zwɛɛm dem kwaga ne. Kaanem tu wom wó pa se ko nwoŋi pwooni ne we kotu maŋe de chullu tem. Kokuri, ko ye ŋɔn-lɔŋɔ mo mini na zwɛ ko daare to.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: Baaro naa kaane wolo ná jege ŋɔne o yuu ne naa o titwoga ne,

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom nam ná nɛ we ŋɔne dem ba nye de tiŋi gwoŋo, ye koro-zwonnu de tere jei sem ne, o wó pe kotu mo o ke dáa dáa o yerane da yarepɛ.

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: o wó pa se ba cheeri kotu yuu mo, se ba daare ba gigili ŋɔne dem jei ba yage. Kaanem tu wom ta wó pe kotu dáa dáa mo o yerane da yarepɛ o woli da.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: Baaro naa kaane wolo ná nɛ we o yera jei selo ke pwae ye ko nyeena,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: kaanem tu wó nii jei sem konto zii. Ko ná yɔɔre ko peere fee mo, ko bere we ko ye ya-tora yerane mo. Kotu maŋe de chullu tem kikia.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Yu-kapworo tu maŋe de chullu tem. Wolo yuu ná fane ko tete ne, naa o kolɔgɔ seeni, kotu maŋe de chullu tem.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom wó fɔge o nii kotu zii mo. O maa ná nɛ we ŋɔne dem seene de ye nasoŋo, nenɛɛne jaweo kolo na lɔgese nɔɔna to,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: Jawe-chɛɔ ná wo wolo maama yera ne, kotu wó taa zoore gare-zenzwara mo, ye o yage o yuu se ko vugimi. O laam maa wó yeini o kwei o je o kwoli o yibia ye o tɔɔle de kwor-dɛa we, ‘Amo wo maŋe de chullu tem ywoo!’

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom wó nii gɔrɔ kom konto zii, ye o daare o pe-ko o tiŋi dáa ne da yarepɛ.

english_verse: because the mildew has spread.” Then he will burn the clothing or the piece of leather.
translation_verse: Ko jege se kaanem tu wom zwɛ gɔrɔ kom mo kula, jaweo kom na wae ko lɔgese wonnu tedwonna ko chɔge to ŋwaane.

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: o wó pa ni mo se ba zare-ko, se ba daare ba tiŋi-ko dáa ne da yarepɛ ba woli da.

english_verse: Even if the spot completely disappears after being washed, it must be washed again before it is clean.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná zare gɔrɔ kom, ye jaweo kom ná seene ko nwoŋi ko yera ne, ba ta wó jwoori ba zare-ko se ko laam maŋe de chullu tem kikia.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we:

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: kaanem tu wom maa wó pa ni se ba ja zuna balei na maŋe de chullu tem ye ba ta ŋwe to, de Sedare daa dedoa, de gare-ŋon-seŋa, de Husopa vɔɔro ba ba ba pa‑o, se o ma-te o kwɛ nɔɔno wom.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: O ta wó pa ba ba mɔ buli yi na-doora ba daare ba lwo-ba kikeira wone. Ba laam maa wó gwoni zuŋa kam dedoa ba kikeira kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Then he will dip the other bird, the cedar, the red yarn, and the hyssop in the blood of the dead bird.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom laam wó kwei zuŋa kalo ta na ŋwe to, de Sedare daa kam, de gare-ŋon-seŋa kam, de Husopa vɔɔro tem maama o de-te zuŋa kalo ba na go to jana bam wone.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: O maa wó miisi jana bam mo nɔɔno wolo na lage kwɛɛm to yera ne kuni berepɛ, se o daare o ta se ko nwoŋi pwooni we nɔɔno wom maŋe de chullu tem. O laam wó yage zuŋa kalo na ŋwe to mo pwola ne se ka jaane ka viiri.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na lage kwɛɛm se o maŋe de chullu tem to nam ye se o zare o gwaaro mo, ye o cheeri o yuu maama, o daare o swɛ yera. Konto bere we o laam seene o kwɛ de chullu tem mo. O jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o zo kɔ-fɔrɔ kom wone, se o nam ba jege se o zo o vwei dem wone se ko ke da yarepɛ.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Da yarepɛ dɛ dem ná yia, se o fane o yera koro de o ywei maama nywa! Ko maa ye o yu-ywei, de o twana, de o yi-kunnu tem mo. O laam maa wó zare o gwaaro ye o daare o swɛ o yera. Konto bere we o laam kwɛ mo o maŋe de chullu tem.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wolo na lage o kwɛ‑o to maa wó ja nɔɔno wom de o pɛɛra yam o vo wara-vwei dem ni ne se ba jeeri Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom laam wó kwei pi-bale sem dedoa o woli de nuga kabɔɔ kom ye o daare o zeiŋi-te wɛɛne, se o ma o ke wɛleere jene kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔno wom ŋwaane.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: O maa jege se o gwoni pi-bala kam konto ba wara-jei sem ne, mɛ ba na yeini ba go wɛleere saarem vara de zwɛɛm kaanem vara da to. Pɛɛre dem na ye wɛleere jene kaanem to, pia kam ye Wɛ kaanem tu wom nyem mo, ne wɛleere saarem vara de na ye tei to. Pɛɛre dem konto tiini de ye wose mo.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom laam wó kwei wɛleere jene kaanem pia kam jana bam badwonna, ye o taŋe-ba wolo na lage kwɛɛm to jazem zwɛ dem ne, de o jazem no-kweo kom, dedaane o jazem namimbu-kweo kom ne.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: O ta wó pwori kabɔɔ kom wo nuga kam o ke o tete jagwia ja-bɔŋɔ wone.

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: O laam wó ma o jazem noa o laŋe nuga kam, ye o miisi-ka kuni berepɛ Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: O ta wó kwei nuga kam na daare o ja-bɔŋɔ ne to o ma o taŋe wolo na lage kwɛɛm to jazem zwɛ dem, de o jazem no-kweo kom, dedaane o jazem namimbu-kweo kom, se ko woli de pia kam jana bam na maŋe ba taare da to.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: O laam wó kwei-ka o woli de wodiu pɛɛre dem o zwɛ-te kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne. Kaanem tu wom jege se o tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo o le nɔɔno wom digiru Wɛ yiga ne pa se o maŋe de chullu tem.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Kotu nam ta wó kwei kunkwona balei naa kunkwon-puura balei se ko maŋe de o dam na wae tei to. Ba wó kwei ba dedoa ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem, se kadwoŋi kam taa ye zwɛɛm kaanem ŋwaane.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Da nana dɛ dem ne nɔɔno wom wó ja wonnu tem konto o vo wara-jei sem ni ne o pa kaanem tu wom, se o wane o kwɛ o tete Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: O ta wó gwoni wɛleere jene kaanem pi-bala kam ba, ye o daare o kwei ka jana bam badwonna o taŋe-ba wolo na lage kwɛɛm to jazem zwɛ dem ne, de o jazem no-kweo kom, dedaane o jazem namimbu-kweo kom mo.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: O ta wó pwori kabɔɔ kom wo nuga kam mo o ke o tete jagwia ja-bɔŋɔ wone.

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: O maa wó ma o jazem noa o laŋe nuga kam, ye o miisi-ka kuni berepɛ Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: O ta wó kwei nuga kam na daare o ja-bɔŋɔ kom ne to o ma o taŋe wolo na lage kwɛɛm to jazem zwɛ dem ne, de o jazem no-kweo kom, dedaane o jazem namimbu-kweo kom, ne o na maŋe o ke tei de pia kam jana bam to.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: O maa wó kwei ba dedoa o ma ke wɛleere saarem kaanem, ye o daare o ma kadwoŋi kam o ma ke zwɛɛm pɛɛre kaanem. O laam wó kwei wodiu pɛɛre dem o woli da o ke kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ. Kaanem tu wom jege se o tɔge chwoŋa kam konto o le nɔɔno wom digiru Wɛ yiga ne pa se o maŋe de chullu tem mo.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta Moses de Aron o we:

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Abam ná zo Kanaan tega kam wone, mɛ a na lage a pa abam se a ta‑á tei to, ye amo ná pɛ se jaweo jage á sɔŋɔ kolo kabiri ne pa se ko kokɔŋe,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: se sɔŋɔ kom konto tu vo kaanem tu tei o ta o bere‑o we, ‘A maane we a sɔŋɔ kabiri sem jege jaweo, nenɛɛne ko lage ko kokɔŋe mo tei.’

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: o laam wó nwoŋi sɔŋɔ kom ne mo ye o pa se ba pe-ko ba zege da yarepɛ.

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó kɔgese sɔŋɔ kom wo kabiri sem mo se ba ja-te ba vo ba dole ba yage jeiga kalo ba na pɔɔre wo-zɔɔna ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: O laam wó pa se ba de-ko tega ne. Ba maa wó chwooli ko kandwa maama, de ko dɛ maama, de ko teero maama ba vo ba dole ba yage jeiga kalo ba na pɔɔre wo-zɔɔna ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná pe sɔŋɔ kom konto ye nɔɔno ta ná zo ko wone, konto tu wó taa jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni se ko yi dedaan-ni maŋa.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Wolo de nam ná peini ko wone, naa o ná di wodiu ko wone, kotu jege se o zare o gwaaro mo.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: Ba nam ná jwoori ba fɔge sɔŋɔ kom kabiri sem, ye kaanem tu wom ná yi da o nii o na we jaweo kom wo jwoori ko jage jei jei, o laam wó ta se ko nwoŋi pwooni mo we sɔŋɔ kom maŋe de chullu tem. Kokuri to, jaweo kom ti maama.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom jege se o kwei zuna balei, de Sedare daa, de gare-ŋon-seŋa, de Husopa vɔɔro mo se o ma o kwɛ sɔŋɔ kom se ko maŋe de chullu tem.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom wó tɔge chwoŋa kam konto o ma zuŋa kam jana bam, de na-doora bam, de zuŋa kakam kam, de Sedare daa kam, de Husopa vɔɔro tem, de gare-ŋon-seŋa kam maama o kwɛ sɔŋɔ kom.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Á wó tɔge nia yanto mo á pɔɔre wonnu telo na maŋe de chullu tem to dedaane telo na jege digiru ye te wo maŋe to daane. Nia yanto mo bere jaweero telo na wae te lɔgese nɔɔna to chullu tem.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses dedaane Aron o we:
