translation_verse: Abam de nam ná ke konto dwoŋi á chɔge tega kam, ka lage ka ve abam ka dole ka yage, ne ka na maŋe ka ke tei de dwi-gɛ tiina bam to mo.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Ta á sɛ-na a nia yam. Nam yé tɔge á ke wo-zɔɔna yanto na chuli keim ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo ya na zoore tega kam ne to yeini ba ke-ya to. Abam ná ke-ya, á wó chɔge á tete de chullu tem mo. Amo nam mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama we: Pɔɔre-na á tete se á ta‑á ye wose, se amo wolo na ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to tete mo ye wose tu.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Yé lɔ-na amo kwaga ne á zuli jwona. Ta yé kwei-na luuru á ma‑á mɔ wa-yɔɔro á pa á tete. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Abam ná go varem se á ma‑á ke yazura pɛɛre á kaane á pa Baŋa Wɛ, tɔge-na ko totoŋe dem chwoŋa se amo sɛ a jwoŋi-de.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Á jege se á di varem wom konto nɔna yam mo á ti dɛ delo wone á na kwei‑o á ke kaanem to, naa tega ná poore se á di-ya. Nɔna yam konto ná yi da yatɔ dɛ dem, se á zwɛ-ya.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nɔna yam na yi da yatɔ, ye nɔɔno wolo ná di-ya, a bá jwoŋi kotu pɛɛre dem, ya na wo maŋe de chullu tem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná di da yatɔ nɔna bere we o kwei kolo na pɔɔre amo ŋwaane to mo o pa ko ye wo-yɔɔ. Konto tu daa bá tɔge o woli Isarele dwi dem wone.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: Abam ná vei á kare sem ne se á zage á wodiiru á jwoori sam, yé gwei-na wodiiru telo maama na wo á kare sem ni ne to, nam yé lare-na mena yalo wodi-zagena bam na daare to.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ko ye bedwe mo de á ná gwori Vini tio-bia á kadwi sem wone, se á yé jwoori á gwori-ba á ke belei, naa á twɛ tio-bia balo na to tega ne to. Yage-na tento maama á pa yiniga tiina, de veira balo na zoore de abam to, se ba de wane ba lare ba di. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: Yé ŋɔ n dwoŋi wonnu, nam yé gane‑o, naa n fɔ vwa n pa‑o.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Yé ma amo yere n du duuri vwa taane baŋa ne. Konto bere we n yaale amo yere dem mo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n twe zɔ-kɔgɔ. Nam yé tiŋi da-bunnu lilwei chwoŋa ne se o gare o to tega ne. Kɔre-na amo wolo na ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to.

english_verse: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.
translation_verse: Yé kweele-na chega á taane dim baŋa ne. Ko dae se á tɔge nɔɔno kwaga o yiniga ŋwaane, naa o dunni ŋwaane. Nam tɔge-na chega kam yerane.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á kare á jage sawea se á ma‑á chɔge á dwonna. Abam wolowolo yé kweele chega se o pa o dwoŋi ga o ŋwea. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n jege n dwoŋi joo n bochare ne. N dwoŋi wom nam ná tusi, se n yɔɔre n kaane‑o, se wonto wɛleere yé taa wo n yuu ne.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Yé pa n bane zaŋe n dwoŋi baŋa ne se n yiri jene o keim-balɔrɔ ŋwaane. Yé ta‑n chuli n dwoŋi. Nam ta‑n swoi‑o se ko maŋe de n na swoi n tete tei to. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: Ta‑á sɛ-na amo bera yam maama. Yé pa-na se vara dwi na ye yera yera to di daane ba lo. Yé kwei-na wo-dwa na ye dwi dwi to á du kara dedoa wone. Nam yé zo-na gɔrɔ kolo ba na mɛ gare-yia na ye yera yera ba ma sɔ-ko to.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná peini de kaba-kana kalo ba na boŋe se ba kwei ba pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi to, ye kotu ta ná wo ŋwe kaba-kana kam jene se o taa tei o tete, ba wó waare-ba mo. Ko dae se ba te. Kokuri to, kaba-kana kam ta wo yi se o taa tei o tete.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom de maa wó kwei pi-bala kam konto o ke kaanem o ma o le nɔɔno wom tusim dem Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Wɛ laam maa wó kwei konto tu wɛleera o ma o chɛ‑o.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: Abam ná zo Kanaan tega kam wone, ye á jeiri teeni delo na leiri bia pa se nɔɔna di to, se á chuli de wo-bia bam bena yatɔ. Yé di-na tio-bia bam konto, ba na wo maŋe de chullu tem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Bena yana bene dem ná yia, se á pɔɔre tio-bia bam maama se ba taa ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem, se á di ywoni amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Ko daare, bena yanu bene dem wone, á laam jege chwoŋa se á di á kare wo tio-bia bam. Abam ná ke tento maama, á teeni dem wó puli ye de taa leiri bia dedɛ de pa abam. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: Yé di-na nɔna de ya wo jana. Nam yé tɔge-na yi-nara de chichiri vora kikia kwaga.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Yé ke-na daale á yera yam ne, naa se á gwoni á yera, lua chullu ŋwaane. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: Yé yigi n bukɔ n de kabworim wone. Keim dem konto ye n jege‑o mo n yaala. Ko ta wó pa se á teo kom maama su de kabworim de puseŋa kikia mo.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na amo siu da yam ni ne, se á daare á ta‑á nege amo wara-jei sem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kwe ná yeini ba yi á tei, se á zaŋe wɛɛne á zuli-ba. Konto mo bere we á kɔre amo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye veira balo na zoore abam tetare ne to, se á yé bɛɛse-ba.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Á wó ta‑á ke-ba ne á na wó ke á dwonna Isarele tiina bam tei to mo. Nam ta‑á swoi-ba ne á na swoi á tete tei to. Guli-na we á de déem ye veira mo Ejipti teo kom wone. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Abam bwɛ sem, de wonnu telo á na mae á maŋe wonnu dunni na mae tei to jege se te taa ye chekke mo. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A déem mo jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne a ba ywo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta Moses o we:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam balo na ye Isarele dwi tiina de veira balo na zoore á wone to wolo maama ná kwei o bu o ke kaanem o pa Moleka jwoni dem, kotu jege se o te mo. Á teo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama wó dole‑o de kandwa mo ba go.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Amo wó nwoŋi kotu kwaga ne se o daa yé tɔge o woli Isarele dwi dem wone. Kokuri to, o ke o chɔge amo wara-jei sem mo ye o daare o yaale amo yere dem na ye wose to, de o na kwei o bu o ke Moleka jwoni dem jeŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: amo tete mo wó nwoŋi kotu dedaane o sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama kwaga ne se ba daa yé tɔge ba woli ba dwi tiina bam wone. Amo ta wó ke konto de balo maama na dɛ ba zuli Moleka ba daare amo to mo.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná ywori amo kwaga ne o daare o vo yi-nara naa chichiri vora tei se ba veere wonnu ba bere‑o, amo wó nwoŋi konto tu kwaga ne. A nam wó le‑o se o daa yé tɔge o woli Isarele dwi dem wone.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Pɔɔre-na á tete de wo-digiru maama, se á ta‑á ye wose. Kokuri to, amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Ta‑á sɛ-na amo bera yam, se á ta‑á tɔge-ya. Kokuri to, amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. A maa pae se abam ye wose.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná sɔɔle lwarem o pa o kwo naa o nu, konto tu jege se o te mo. Ko nam wó taa ye o tete yiga mo de o na wó te to.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ke kabwoŋa de o dwoŋi kaane, se ba go baaro wom de kaane wom maama.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná peini de o kwo kaane, o yaale o kwo wom mo konto. Baaro wom de kaane wom maama mo jege se ba te. Ko wó taa ye ba tete yiga de ba na wó te to.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná peini de o bu-kaane, ba maama balei jege se ba te mo. Ba yɔɔre ba toŋe kolo na jege chaveera to mo. Ko wó taa ye ba tete yiga de ba na wó te to.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Baaro de o dwoŋi baaro ná peini daane, ne baaro na yeini o peini de kaane tei to, ba yɔɔre ba toŋe wo-zɔɔne mo. Ba maama balei jege se ba te mo. Ko wó taa ye ba tete yiga de ba na wó te to.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná di kaane ye o ta swo o kaane wom nu o woli da, ko ye puseŋa kikia mo konto o kea. Ba jege se ba zwɛ banto batɔ maama mo ba go. Yé sɛ-na se keim-lɔŋɔ kom konto ke á tetare ne.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Kaane nam ná kwei o tete o pa varem peini ded‑o, á wó go kaane wom de varem wom maama mo. Ba jege se ba te mo. Ko wó taa ye ba tete yiga de ba na wó te to.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná peini de kaane wolo ta na jege o chana zarem o ke to, ba maama tusi chullu tem seeni pa se ba digiri. Ba jege se ba zeili ba maama mo, se ba daa yé tɔge ba woli ba dwi tiina bam wone.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Ko dae se baaro peini de o nu zembaaro, naa o nu nyaane, naa o kwo nakɔ. Wolo ná ke keim dem konto, kotu yaale o choro mo. Ba maama maŋe se ba na waarem mo.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: Nam yɔɔre á ta‑á tɔge amo bera yam de a nia yam, se á ta‑á ke ya maama. Abam ná wo ke konto, amo na lage a ja abam a zo tega kalo wone to wó ve abam mo.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo amo na lage a zeili-ba se ba daare tega kam ba pa abam to, se á yé ta‑á tɔge-na ba chwei sem. Amo nam chuli-ba mo, ba na ke wo-zɔɔna yanto dwoŋi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Amo nam gwoni ni mo de abam se a kwei ba tega kanto a pa abam se á ta‑á tei-ka ye á zoore ka wone. Tega kam konto tiini ka ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A ma pɔɔre abam se á ta‑á ye á yera de dwi-gɛ tiina maama.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Abam wone baaro wolo, naa kaane wolo ná ye yi-naro naa chichiri voro, kotu jege se o te mo. Á wó dole-ba de kandwa mo á go. Ko wó taa ye ba tete yiga de ba na wó te to.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we: “Ta de Aron dwi kaanem tiina bam we: Kaanem dwi tu ná tega, o nam yé da ko ŋwaane o digiri o tete de chullu tem.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Se ko ná ye balo na bwola ded‑o kadiri ŋwaane to mo, ko dae se o digiri o tete banto lwi baŋa ne.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina dae se ba cheeri ba yuni, naa ba fane ba twana nia yam, naa ba gwoni ba yera lua chullu ŋwaane.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu bukɔ ná digiri o tete ka-bworo totoŋa baŋa ne, kotu yaale o kwo yere mo. Ba jege se ba zwɛ‑o mo se o te.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: O ba jege se o twɛ too, ko ná maŋe ko ye o kwo, naa o nu de. O ná ve ye o ke konto, o wó digiri o tete de chullu tem mo.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Kaanem yiga tu wom nam maŋe se o beeri bukɔ wolo na yeiri baara to mo, se o di‑o o ke o kaane.

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Wolo ná ye lilwei, naa gwana, naa o yibia ná chɔge, naa o yera yam ná ba mae daane mɛ seeni,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: naa o naga ná bwori, naa o jeŋa ná bwori mo,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: o nam ná jege pɔnɔ, naa o ná ye naale, naa o yia ta ná chɔge, naa o ná jege ŋɔna naa pwooru o yera ne, naa ba ná lwe kotu manchala mo, o dae se o ke kaanem wara-vwei dem wone.

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Moses déem tage wonnu tem konto maama o bere Aron, de o bia bam, de Isarele tiina bam maama.

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ta Aron de o bia bam we, ba ta taa nii pɛɛra yalo Isarele tiina bam na jaane ba tui ba pa-ne to baŋa ne, se ba nege-ya, ya na ye wose to ŋwaane. Ko ná dae konto, ba wó yaale amo yere dem na ye wose to. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: or if you have touched an unclean creature of any sort, including an unclean person.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye bedwe mo de o ná dwei tega-veilu, naa o ná dwei nɔɔno wolo na jege digiru chullu tem seeni to.

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Wɛ ná zoa, konto tu laam wó maŋe de chullu tem. O maa jege chwoŋa se o di wodiu pɛɛra yam, wodiu kom konto na ye kaanem tiina bam nyem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu ba jege se o di varem wolo na tege o tete toone to, naa kago-vara na tore‑o ba go to. O ná di nɔna yam konto, ko wó pa se o digiri de chullu tem mo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu bukɔ nam ná zo wolo na dae kaanem tu to, wonto dae se o da o di kaanem wodiiru tem.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Abam wolo nam ná kwei varem wolo na jege gɛɛ o yera ne to se o ma ke kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ, Wɛ bá jwoŋi kotu kaanem dem.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam dae se ba gwooni pɛɛra yalo Isarele tiina bam na jaane ba tui ba pae Baŋa Wɛ to,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná boŋe se o ke yazura pɛɛre kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ, ko ná ye ni-gwonim ŋwaane, naa ko ye o wo-ywoŋo pɛɛre mo de, varem wom dae se o taa jege gɛɛ o yera ne. Konto baŋa ne mo Wɛ wó jwoŋi o pɛɛre dem.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Naao kolo naa pia kalo yera nam na ba mae daane to mo, á wó wane á kwei á ma‑á ke yazura pɛɛre kaanem delo na ye n wo-ywoŋo pɛɛre to. Ko daare, yé kwei-na vara bam konto dwoŋi á ma‑á ke kaanem delo na ye ni-gwonim ŋwaane to.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: Á ná jwoŋi vara bam konto dwoŋi dwi-gɛ tiina tei ne, se á yé kwei-ya á ke wodiu pɛɛre á pa á Tu Wɛ wom. Banto vara bam yera seene ya chɔge mo. Wɛ bá sɛ o jwoŋi kaanem dem.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta Moses o we:

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Sɔŋɔ vara ná loga, bu maama wó maŋe o nu tei ne mo da yarepɛ, ne ko ná ye noa, naa pipeila, naa bobona mo. Da nana dɛ dem ne se ko taa via, ka laam wó maŋe se ba kwei-ka ba ma ke wodiu pɛɛre ba pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Yé kwei-na varem de o bu á go á ma‑á ke kaanem dɛ dedwe wone.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná boŋe se o ke lei-keim kaanem o pa Baŋa Wɛ, se o tɔge kaanem dem chwoŋa chekke. Konto baŋa ne mo Wɛ wó jwoŋi kotu pɛɛre dem.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ba nam jege se ba di varem wom nɔna yam maama dɛ delo wone ba na ke kaanem dem to mo. Ba yé pa se tega poore ye ya ta wora. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: I demand respect from the people of Israel, so don't disgrace my holy name. Remember—I am the one who chose you to be priests and rescued all of you from Egypt, so that I would be your Lord.
translation_verse: Amo nam jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne a ba ywo, se a taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom mo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Da yalo á kɔgɔ kom na wó jeeri amo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne se á di kuri to mo tento: Wɛ siu dɛ Nwoŋim

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Kwei-na da yaredo á toŋe á totoŋa maama. Da yarepɛ dɛ dem nam ye siu dɛ mo de pae abam. Abam ná maŋe á wo jei selo maama ne, dɛ dem konto ye de yera mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Á wó jeeri daane se á zuli Wɛ ye á ba toŋa de fenfee de. Atɔgebabaŋa de Bworobworo-memene kuri dem Nwoŋim

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nam yé toŋe-na dɛ dem konto wone. Kokuri to, de ye Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem ba na wó le á wɛleera Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne de wone to mo.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: The first day of the seventh month must be a day of complete rest. Then at the sound of the trumpets, you will come together to worship and to offer sacrifices on the altar. The Great Day of Forgiveness (Numbers
translation_verse: Yé toŋe-na á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yam dento dɛ dem ne. Yɔɔre á ke-na wodiu pɛɛre kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ.” Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem Jeelim

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Boboa chana kam da fuga-yana dɛ dem dedaan-ni maŋa ne mo á wó bobo se á di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem á ma‑á zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Da yarepɛ yam maama wone se á yeini á ja wodiu pɛɛra kaanem á ba á ke á pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ko daare da yarepɛ dɛ dem ná yia, á wó jeeri daane mo se á zuli Wɛ, ye á bá toŋe á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yam.” Da-yiga wodiiru pɛɛra

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam ná tu á zo tega kalo amo na lage a kwei a pa abam to wone, ye á bobo á zage á wodiiru, ja-na men-zɔgɔ kolo á na bobo á vɔ to á vo kaanem tu wom tei á pa‑o.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Abam ná bobo á zage á wodiiru tem, se á yé di-na bworobworo, naa men-wɔa, naa men-gwoa, ye á ta wo jaane pɛɛra yam konto á ba á pa á Tu Wɛ wom. Abam de á kwaga kam wó ta‑á ke á tɔge ni dento na bere tei to mo se ko taa vei wuu. Ga-kwea kuri dem Nwoŋim

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto dae se abam toŋe de wone de fenfee de. Abam na wó ta‑á zoore jei selo maama ne to, abam de á kwaga kam maama jege se á ta‑á tɔge ni dem konto se ko taa vei wuu mo.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Abam ná zoore jei selo maama ne, se á ja bworobwooru telei telei á ba wara-jei sem ne se á zeiŋi-te Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Nɔɔno maama wó kwei mun-bwei bwɛ sena mo o woli de sabɔle o ma wɔ bworobworo kom konto. Ko wó taa ye á da-yiga wodiiru pɛɛra mo á kwei á pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Á kɔgɔ kom nam wó beeri pi-bale serepɛ na ye bene dedoa ye se ba jege gɛɛ se yera ne to, de na-bala dedoa, de pi-bɛ selei. Á maa wó kwei vara bam konto á woli de bworobwooru pɛɛra yam á ke zwɛɛm kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ. Á ta wó kwei wodiu pɛɛra de wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra á kaane á pa‑o. Pɛɛra yam konto lwom dem maa ywomma de pae Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Abam ta maa wó kwei bo-bala á ma‑á ke wɛleere saarem kaanem, se á daare á kwei pi-bale selei na ye bene bene to se á ma‑á ke yazura pɛɛre kaanem.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu wom nam mo wó zeiŋi pei selei sem wɛɛne, se se taa ye pɛɛre se pa Baŋa Wɛ, tento de bworobwooru pɛɛra yam maama. Pɛɛra yam konto mo Baŋa Wɛ pɔɔre o pa o tete, se ya taa ye kaanem tu wom nyem.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: Abam ná vei á kare sem ne se á zage á wodiiru á jwoori sam, yé gwei-na wodiiru telo maama na wo á kare sem ni ne to, nam yé lare-na mena yalo wodi-zagena bam na daare to. Yage-na tento maama á pa yiniga tiina, de veira balo na zoore de abam to, se banto de lare ba di. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.” Nabwanno wum kuri dem Jeelim

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga dɛ dem nam mo ye Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem. Dɛ dem konto wone á wó jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. Á jege se á peene á tete mo, se á daare á ke wodiu pɛɛre kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Chana kam da nogo dɛ dem dedaan-ni maŋa ne, se ko vo ko yi ka da fuga dɛ dem dedaan-ni maŋa ne, de wó taa ye siu dɛ mo de pa abam, se á peene á tete de wone.” Vwoa chwiim kuri dem Nwoŋim

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Da yam konto boboa dɛ dem ne, se á beeri tio bu-laaro, de konkwara tio-nɛ, de teeni dwi dwi vɔɔro, de nabara ni teeni, ye á kwei-ya á ma‑á zuli á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom da yarepɛ yam wone.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Bene maama wone chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga-yanu dɛ dem ne se á bobo á di Vwoa chwiim kuri dem. Ba nam wó di-de da yarepɛ mo.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kuri dem boboa dɛ dem wone, se á jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ ye á bá toŋe á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yam.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, da yarepɛ yam konto dɛ maama wone, á wó ta‑á jaane wodiu pɛɛra mo á tui á kaane á pae Baŋa Wɛ. Da nana dɛ dem ne, se á daa jeeri daane á zuli Wɛ. Á laam maa wó kwei wodiu pɛɛre á kaane á pa Baŋa Wɛ á kweeli. Dɛ dem konto ye de yera Wɛ ŋwaane mo. Á ba jege se á toŋe á dɛ dɛ totoŋa yam de wone.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: Abam nam wó taa di kura yanto á woli de Wɛ siu da yam maama. Pɛɛra yam konto mo á ta wó woli de pɛɛra yalo á na yeini á jaane á tui á pae Baŋa Wɛ to, dedaane pɛɛra yalo á na ke wo-ywoŋo ŋwaane naa ni-gwonim ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: Konto to, chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga-yanu dɛ dem ná yia ye á zage á kare wodiiru maama á ti, se á bobo á di kuri dem konto. Á wó kwei da yarepɛ mo á di-de. De boboa dɛ dem ne wó taa ye siu dɛ mo. De da nana dɛ dem na ti kuri dem to de maa ye konto.

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Konto mo wó pa se á bia lɔre we amo déem na jaane ba nabaara bam a nwoŋi Ejipti wone to, a pɛ se ba zoore vwoa wone mo. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná go varem, se o jwoori o yiri varem wom o pa o na go wolo varem to. Wolo nam ná go o dwoŋi nabiinu, se ba go o de.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam se ba ja Olivi nuga kalo na ye chekke to ba ba ba pa‑m min-zwonnu tem ŋwaane. Konto mo wó pa se te mini taa di taa, ye de ba dwia.

english_verse: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change. The Sacred Bread The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aron maa wó pa se min-zwonnu tem taa zege sabu-seŋa min-zwon-zego kom yuu ne konto, se te mini taa di taa Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Wara-vwei dem bworobworo kom

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: Nam viiri-na mun-bwei se á ma-de á wɔ bworobwooru fuga-telei. Abam wó kwei muni bwɛ sena mo á ma á ke bworobworo maama.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Laam kwei-na bworobwooru tem á tiŋi gene selei. Teredo wó taa wo gena maama wone. Te nam wó taa tigi tabolo kolo sabu-seŋa na kwoli ko maama ye ko zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Ta kwei-na talwoŋ-ywoŋa á ke gena maama wone, se kanto leiri bworobwooru tem yuu ne ka ji wodiu pɛɛre ka pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Wɛ siu dɛ maama wone, Aron wó tiŋi bworobwooru tem konto mo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Isarele tiina bam jege se ba taa ke konto mo maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Bworobwooru tem konto ye Aron de o bia bam nyem mo. Ba nam jege se ba di-te jeiga kalo na ye wose to ne mo, te na tiini te ye wose to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ pɔɔre-te o pɛɛra yam maama wone se te taa ye kaanem tiina bam nyem mo.” Nɔɔno ná lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ kotu na wó na waarem delo to

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem wora o kwo na ye Ejipti tu. O nu maa ye Isarele tu, o yere mo Selomifa. Wonto kwo yere mo Dibiri, ye o nwoŋi Dan dwi dem wone. Nɔɔno wom déem nwoŋi o ke jara de Isarele tu ba zoorem jei sem ne. Ba jara yam ne, mo nɔɔno wom sɔɔle lwarem o ma lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ yere dem. Ba ma ja‑o ba vo Moses tei.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja nɔɔno wom ba pe, ye ba daare ba cheigi se Baŋa Wɛ veere o boboŋa o bere-ba nɔɔno wom taane dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we:

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Ja-na nɔɔno wom á nwoŋi abam na zoore mɛ to á vo dáa. Balo maama na nigi nɔɔno wom ta-balɔrɔ to maa wó daŋe ba je o yuu ne. Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom laam maa wó dole‑o de kandwa ba go.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná yaale Baŋa Wɛ yere, konto tu jege se o te mo. Á kɔgɔ kom maama jege se á dole‑o á go mo. O ná ye Isarele tu, naa o ye veiru mo de, kotu maŋe se o te mo.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Nɔn-goro waarem ye se ba go o de mo.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Ni dento zege de pae Isarele tiina maama mo, de veira balo na zoore de abam to. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Nmo ná boŋe se n yeigi tega n dwoŋi tei ne, se n jeeli ka sabu se ko maŋe de bena yalo na maŋe ya kɛ ya gaale wonnu yirim bene dem to. N dwoŋi wom maa wó jwoŋi sabu se ko maŋe de bena yalo ta na daare se á ta‑á zage wodiiru ye wonnu yirim bene dem daa yi to.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Moses déem na wo Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to, Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we:

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Ta de Isarele tiina bam we: Abam ná zo tega kalo amo Baŋa Wɛ na lage a pa abam se á ta‑á tei to wone, se á pa tega kam sii bene delo maama na ke yarepɛ to wone.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: de á sɔŋɔ vara, de kago-vara maama di te wone mo. Á jege chwoŋa se á di wodiiru telo maama tega kam na ke to. Wonnu yirim bene dem

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Bena finnu bene dem ne, ko ná yi chane serepɛ chana kam da fuga dɛ ne, á wó pa se ba taa kare tega kam jei maama ne ba wui nabwanno. Wɛleera saarem dɛ dem ne mo á wó ke konto.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Bene dem konto maama ye de yera mo Wɛ ŋwaane. Nam di-na á kadwi de á kare wodiiru telo na ke te tete yerane to.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: Wonnu yirim bene dem konto wone, abam wolo maama ya ná kwei o nabaara tega o yeigi, se kotu jwoori o taa tei-ka.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Bena yalo na daare to ná daga, se tega kam sabu ke ko ke yiga ne. Wonnu yirim bene delo nam daa na beene to ná twɛ se de yi, se á pa sabu kom tu tega. Kokuri to, tega kam tu lage o yeigi wodiiru zagem bena mo o pa o dwoŋi wom.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Ta‑á kɔre-na á Tu Wɛ wom, se á yé pini daane. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Tega kam de nam wó ke wodiu lanyerane ka pa abam, se á ta‑á di á sui ye á jege yazura.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam wae o bwei we, ‘Bɛ mo dé nam wó di bena yarepɛ bene dem wone, ye dé ba jege chwoŋa se dé du tega ne, dé maa dae se dé zage wodiu dé zo diga?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ tega kam swolim pa se bena yaredo bene dem wone, abam kare sem, de á kadwi sem ke wodiu kolo na wó yi bena yatɔ to.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Bena nana bene dem ná yia ye á lage á du tega kam ne, á ta wó ta‑á jege wodiu kolo á na zage bena yaredo bene dem wone to á di. Á ta wó di wodiu kom konto se ko yi bena nogo bene dem wodiiru zagem maŋa kam.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Abam dae se á kwei tega á yeigi á pa nɔɔno se kotu taa tei-ka taa wuu. Tega kam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. Abam ye veira mo amo na sɛ se á ta‑á jege-ka á toŋa.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Á ná jege tega jei selo maama ne ye á yeigi-ka á pa daane, chwoŋa wó taa tigi mo se tega kam tu jwoori o yeigi-ka.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: Yiniga ná tiini ka ja abam wolo, pa se konto tu kwei o tega o yeigi, o yera nɔɔno wolo na maŋe se o nii‑o to wó jwoori o yeigi tega kam se ba taa tei-ka.

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: o jege chwoŋa se o ke konto. O nam wó jeeli bena yam se ko zege maŋa kalo o ya na yeigi-ka o pa nɔɔno wom to, ye o laam ŋwe tega kam sabu o pa‑o se ko maŋe de bena yalo ta na daare to. O daa maa wó jwoori o taa tei tega kam.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Kotu nam ná ba jege sabu se o ŋwe ne ko na maŋe tei to, wolo na yeigi tega kam o tei ne to nam mo wó taa tei-ka se ko yi wonnu yirim bene dem. Maŋa kam konto ne mo ba laam wó kwei tega kam ba jwoori ba pa ka tu.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: Wolo ná jege o sɔŋɔ teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone, ye o kwei-ko o yeigi o pa nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o jege chwoŋa se o kwei bene dedwe o jwoori o yeigi-ko nɔɔno wom tei ne.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Bene dedoa nam ná kɛ, ye kotu ná ware se o jwoori o yeigi o sɔŋɔ kom, chwoŋa daa tera se o jwoori o yeigi-ko. Ko lɛɛre ko ye wolo na yeigi-ko to de o dwi dem nyem mo se ko taa vei wuu. Wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, sɔŋɔ kom daa bá jwoori ko ji wolo na yeigi-ko o pa to nyem.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Ko daare sam na wo te-balwa balo na wo lɔge ba pe to wone, dento kikia nye de tega yeiga na ye tei to mo. Wolo ná kwei o sɔŋɔ kom konto o yeigi, kotu jege chwoŋa se o jwoori o yeigi-ko maŋa de maŋa. Ko maa ná yi wonnu yirim bene dem, ba wó jwoori ba kwei-ko ba pa kotu mo.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye vara pwoli selo na kaare Levi tiina teene dem to, chwoŋa tera se ba kwei-se ba yeigi. Tega kam konto ye ba nyem mo se ko taa vei wuu. Yiniga tiina wolim taane

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Abam chorro Isarele tiina bam wolo ná ware se o nii o tete baŋa ne o yiniga ŋwaane, se á woli kotu ne á na wó ke tei de veira balo na zoore abam tei ne to. Konto wó pa se o de wane o zo de abam.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Ko dae se á dɔne nyɔɔre á chorro tem baŋa ne de á na jene kolo maama á pa-ba to, ne ko ná ye sabu, naa wodiu de.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A déem jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne se a daare a pa abam Kanaan tega kam, se a taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom mo.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: Abam chorro Isarele tiina bam wolo yiniga ná jaane‑o pa se o kwei o tete o yeigi o pa‑m se n ta‑n tei‑o, ko dae se nmo pa o taa toŋa o pa‑m ne kabaa tei.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Yage se o taa zoore nmo tei ne, ne o ye veiru naa wolo n na jene se o toŋe o pa‑m to. O nam wó taa toŋa o pa‑m se ko taa nii wonnu yirim bene dem maŋa mo.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Chega to, Isarele tiina bam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena mo. Amo mo jaane-ba a nwoŋi Ejipti wone a ba ywo-seeni. Konto ŋwaane ko dae se nɔɔno yeigi-ba ne kabɛ tei to.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Yé bɛɛse-ba-na! Nam kɔre-na á Tu Wɛ wom se á ta‑á sɛ o ni.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Á ná tega á daare-ba, á wó wane á pa se ba ji á bia kabɛ, se ba toŋe ba pa banto de se ko taa vei ba toone. Ko daare ko ná ye á chorro Isarele tiina bam, yé bɛɛse-ba-na.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tu wolo na zoore abam jei sem ne to ná duni, ye yiniga ná jaane Isarele tu wodwoŋi pa se o kwei o tete o yeigi o pa dwi-gɛ tu wom naa o sɔŋɔ tiina,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: chwoŋa wora se ba jwoori ba yeigi Isarele tu wom veiru wom tei ne. Isarele tu wom choro mo wó jwoori o yeigi‑o. Ko ná ye o nyaane, naa o zembaaro,

english_verse: The longer the time until then, the more you will have to pay.
translation_verse: Bena yalo na daare to nam ná ba daga, se o jwoori o ŋwe sabu fenfee ne ba na jeeli-ko tei to.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Kotu ta ná wo veiru wom tei ne o toŋa, veiru wom jege se o ke‑o ne ba na jene nɔɔno bene de bene wone pa se o toŋe tei to mo. Yé sɛ-na se veiru wom taa jege Isarele tu wom o bɛɛsa.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ná wo wane se o tɔge chwei sento maama wone se o jwoori o yeigi o dwoŋi Isarele tu, wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, ba nam jege se ba yage Isarele tu wom se o de o bia viiri zɛɛra mo.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam ye amo Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena mo. Amo mo jaane-ba a nwoŋi Ejipti wone. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na amo siu da yam ni ne, se á daare á ta‑á nege amo wara-jei sem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: amo de wó toŋe doa se ka ne ka maŋa ne, se á wodiiru ke lanyerane. Abam teeni dem de maa wó lei bia dedɛ.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se á ta‑á zoore tega kam ne de yazura. Á maa wó peini á dɔ ye foone ba jege abam. Amo wó le kago-vara se ba yé taa wo abam tega kam wone, ye a daare a che á dona.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Amo yiga wó taa wora de abam, pa se á na bia dedɛ ye á puli de dam. A maa wó su ni-gwonim delo a na tiŋi de abam to.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Amo maa wó ba a taa zoore abam tetare ne. Amo bere a bá yaale abam.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa wo á tei ne. A maa wó taa ye abam Tu Wɛ wom, ye abam de wó taa ye amo nɔɔna.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A ma ja abam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne, se á daa yé ta‑á ye Ejipti tiina kabɛ. A ma chɔge dam delo ya na nye abam de se tega ne to, ye a jwoŋi abam pa se á vei ye á yuni wo wɛɛne.” Zwabania taane

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: á ná nwoŋi amo bera yam kwaga ne, á daare á chɔge ni-gwonim delo a na ke de abam to,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: amo laam wó waare abam tento mo: lɛɛro wó yi abam lela, nenɛɛne jawe-chɛɛro, de sesa-dwonnu, de paa. Tento mo lage te dwei á yia, se á daare á bugi á jei. Abam ná dugi wodiiru, ko bá jwoŋi abam. Kokuri to, á dona mo lage ba vere-te á tei ne ba di ba daare abam.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Amo tete mo lage a nwoŋi abam kwaga ne, pa se á dona di abam jara wone. Nɔɔna balo na chuli abam to wó di dam á baŋa ne. Á ta wó kwaane se á duri á lu ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba zeili abam.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Tento maama nam ná yi abam ye á ta ve se á sɛ amo kwora, a laam wó pa se á waarem dem puli de ke da kuni berepɛ mo á wɛleera yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Amo maa wó pa se á kamunim dem ba de tu tega. Amo wó che se doa yé ne ka pa abam, se á tega kam ko ye ka taa dana nenɛɛne luu na ye tei to.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Abam totoŋ-dɛɛra yam maama bá ja kuri ya pa abam. Kokuri to, tega kam bá ke wodiiru ka pa abam, á teeni dem de nam bá lei bia.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: Konto maama nam ná kea, ye abam ta ná ve-ne, ye á ba sɛ a kwora kam, amo laam wó pa se á cham dem puli mo de ke kuni berepɛ de woli da.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Amo wó saase kago-vara a yage abam yera ne mo. Ba maa wó go á bia, ye ba daare ba chɔge á vara bam. Á kɔgɔ kom wó ba ko mɔ, pa se nɔɔna daa bá taa wo á chwei sem yuu ne ba via.

english_verse: If you remain my enemies after this,
translation_verse: De konto maama de, abam ta ná ve amo koresem dem konto,

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: A lage a pa se jara mo zaŋe abam de á dona tetare ne, abam na chɔge ni-gwonim delo amo na ke de abam to ŋwaane. Abam ná duri se á zo á te-kamunnu tem wone á seigi da se á lu, amo wó pa se jawe-chɛɛro ja abam dáane. Abam dona laam maa wó na chwoŋa se ba wane abam.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se á ga wodiu se á di. Bworobworo wɔɔm jeiga dedoa wone mo kaana fuga wó lare muni ba wɔ bworobworo se ba di sem tiina di. Ba nam ná chɛ bworobworo kom se ba pa daane, diga maama wó na fenfee yerane mo. Á ná nɛ wodiu, á bá wane-ko á di á su.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Kana wó tiini ka ni abam mo pa se á ja á tete bia á di.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: A maa wó pa se á teene dem ji di-dwonnu yerane, ye a daare a chɔge wara-jei selo á na vei da á zuli á wa yam to. Á ná zwɛ wonnu á pa-ne, te lwom bá pwoli a wo.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Amo tete nam mo lage a chɔge á tega kam. Abam dona ná tu se ba zo ka wone, ko wó so-ba dedɛ.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Amo wó zeili abam a jage a yage teene dedwonna wone, jara-keim ŋwaane. Abam maama wó nwoŋi á daare á tega kam mo se ka ji di-dwonnu yerane.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Ko maa wó pa se tega kam na siu, ne ko ya na maŋe se ka na bena yarepɛ maama wone to. Abam ná zoore ka wone ye á wo pɔɔre siu bene dem á pa-ka, ka laam wó sii bena yalo maama abam na wó jage á ta‑á wo á dona bam teene dem wone to.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Abam nam wó duri á tiri á to á daŋe da-baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba pare abam. Abam bá ta‑á jege dam se á wane á dwoni de á dona.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Á wó te á dona teene dem wone, pa se á dwi dem jei dáane.

english_verse: and others of you will waste away in sorrow as the result of your sins and the sins of your ancestors.
translation_verse: Abam wone balo fenfee na wó daare á dona teene dem wone to de maa wó bugi ba jei. Ko nam wó taa ye wɛleera yalo ba de ba nabaara na ke to ŋwaane mo ba lage ba bugi ba jei konto.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: pa se amo de ve banto ye a daare a zeili-ba a ja vo ba dona teene dem ne tei to. Ba ná seene ba tu ba tete ba daare ba leiri ba boboŋ-balwaaro tem, ye ba sɛ waarem delo amo na pɛ-ba to,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: amo de wó guli a ni-gwonim dem a na ke de ba nabaara Jakob, de Izaak, de Abaraham to. Amo ta wó guli ba tega kam gula se a fɔge-ka.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: De ko de, ba ná maŋe ba wo ba dona teene dem wone, amo bá yɔɔre a ve-ba. Amo bá yiri ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to ye a daare a chɔge-ba a ti. Amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: A nam daa wó jwoori a guli ni-gwonim delo a na ke de ba nabaara bam to, ye a woli-ba. Amo déem jaane ba nabaara bam konto a ja nwoŋi Ejipti ne se a taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom, ye dwi-gɛ tiina bam zege ba nia. Amo seene a ye Baŋa Wɛ wom mo.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem zege Sinayi peo kom yuu ne o tɔge Moses baŋa o pa Isarele tiina bam o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem konto mo, se ba taa tɔga.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: Tega kam wodiu popɔre fuga maama wone popɔra dedoa ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo, ne ko ná ye wodiiru, naa tio-bia de. Abam nam wó pɔɔre-ko se ko taa ye wose Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you try to substitute any other animal, no matter how good, for the one you promised, they will both become holy and must be sacrificed.
translation_verse: Chwoŋa tera se kotu kwei vare-gaa o leiri wodwoŋi wom yuu ne. Ko ná maŋe ko ye o kwei vare-ŋom mo o leiri vare-nabwom yuu ne, o dae se o ke konto. Wolo nam ná ke konto, vara balei bam maama wó ji Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná ke ni-gwonim dem konto, ye o ba jege sabu kolo na maŋe de ni dem to, se kotu ja o nɔɔno wom o yi kaanem tu tei. Kaanem tu wom ná nii nɔɔno wom, o laam wó jeeli ni-gwonim tu wom na wó ŋwe bagera se ko maŋe de o dam na wae tei to.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná kwei vara balo na maŋe de kaanem to se o ke ni-gwonim o pa Baŋa Wɛ, vara bam konto dwoŋi maama wó ji wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná fɔge o nabaara tega wone se o ke-ka Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne, ba wó jeeli ka kwora se ko maŋe de wo-dwa na wó maŋe tei se ba du ka wone to mo. Ba wó maŋe lu-nyenno sabu-dala finnu mo mena ywollu tetɔ maama ŋwaane.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye wonnu yirim bene dem wone mo kotu kwei tega kam o pa Baŋa Wɛ, o wó ŋwe ka sabu jeelim maama na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Wonnu yirim bene dem ná kaare de yi, ye ba lage ba kwei tega kam konto ba pa, ka wó yɔɔre ka ji wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Ba jege se ba pɔɔre-ka ba pa Wɛ kaanem tiina se ba taa tei-ka taa wuu.

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: kaanem tu wom mo wó jeeli ka sabu ni se ko maŋe de bena yagera ta na daare se wonnu yirim bene dem yi to. Nɔɔno wom laam maa wó ŋwe ka sabu kom dɛ dem konto wone nɔɔ. Sabu kom konto ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Wonnu yirim bene dem ná yia, se nɔɔno wom kwei tega kam konto o jwoori o pa o na yeigi-ka wolo tei ne to, se wonto dwi dem taa tei-ka.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sabu kom konto maama dunni jege se ko tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke mo. Sɛkɛle dedoa maa ye gɛra kuni finlei.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná pɔɔre nabiinu wolo ba yɔɔre ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne chɔgem ŋwaane, chwoŋa daa tera se ba jwoori ba yeigi konto tu Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. Ba jege se ba go‑o mo.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná boŋe se o jwoori o yeigi wodiiru tento telo, se o ŋwe te sabu kom ni ne ye o ta woli sabu kom popɔra dedoa senu maama wone.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ vara fuga maama wone dedoa ye wose mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Nam jeeli-na á vara bam maama se á le wolo na ye fuga tu maama to á pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem zege Sinayi peo kom yuu ne mo o ta o nia yam konto o bere Moses Isarele tiina bam ŋwaane.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Bena yalei bene dem chane selei chana kam boboa dɛ delo Isarele tiina bam na nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋɔɔne de Moses Sinayi kagoa kam ne. Wara-vwei dem wone mo o déem ŋɔɔne ded‑o ye o we:

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: Á maa wó jeeli balo bam na yi bena finlei ba daŋe ye ba yi jara keim to ni, se á pɔɔre-ba kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ.

english_verse: The following twelve family leaders, one from each tribe, will help you: Elizur son of Shedeur from Reuben, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai from Simeon, Nahshon son of Amminadab from Judah, Nethanel son of Zuar from Issachar, Eliab son of Helon from Zebulun, Elishama son of Ammihud from Ephraim, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur from Manasseh, Abidan son of Gideoni from Benjamin, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai from Dan, Pagiel son of Ochran from Asher, Eliasaph son of Deuel from Gad, and Ahira son of Enan from Naphtali.
translation_verse: Baara balo na zege dwi maama ŋwaane se ba woli abam de á totoŋe dem to yera mo tento: Dwi dem Yiga tu wom Ruben Sedura bu Elizura Simeon Zurisadayi bu Selumeli Judah Aminadabi bu Naason Isakara Zuwara bu Netaneli Zebulun Helon bu Eliabi Josɛf bu Efrayim Amihuda bu Elisama Josɛf bu Manasɛ Pedazura bu Gamaleli Benjamin Gideoni bu Abidan Dan Amisadayi bu Ahiyezera Asere Ocharan bu Pageli Gad Deweli bu Eliasafe Nafitali Enan bu Ahira”

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: Chane selei chana kam boboa dɛ ne mo ba bwoŋi Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama ba ke daane. Ba ma popone ba sɔ-yuni tem de ba di sem yera ba tiŋi. Ko ná ye baara balo maama na yi bena finlei ba daŋe to, ba déem popone nɔɔno maama de o yere.

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Ba déem nam wo jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam ba woli de dwia yadwonna yam.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ déem ya maŋe o ta de Moses mo o we:

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Abam ná lage á jeeli Isarele tiina bam ni, se á yé jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam á woli da.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Abam ná lage á gɔ á vwoa yam se á vo jeiga kadwoŋi, ko ye banto mo wó gɔ wara-vwei dem, se ba ja-de ba kɛ. Á ná yi jeiga kam, banto mo wó chwi vwei dem jei-doŋa kam ne. Wolo maama ná dae Levi dwi tu ye o ná tiini o yi wara-vwei dem yera, se ba go konto tu.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Isarele tiina bam maama, ba jege se ba chwi ba vwoa mo sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, se kɔgɔ maama taa jege tuta na popone ko yere jaja to.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ta ma ta de Moses de Aron o we:

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Isarele tiina bam maama jege se ba chwi ba vwoa yam mo dwi de dwi na ye dáa dáa ba kaare wara-jei sem. Nɔɔno maama maa wó taa jege o kɔgɔ gwɛɛm yere de o sɔ-yuu kom yere na gweere ya bere jaja to.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Ba déem na jeeli Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu to, ba kɔgɔ kom maama na ke daane to ye baara morro bia yaredo de tetɔ, de bia yanu de finnu (

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem ma yɔɔre ba ke ba tɔge ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses se ba ke to. Ba déem yeini ba chwi ba vwoa konto dwoŋi mo, sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu, kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ. Ba déem ta na gwɛ ba maa kɛ to, nɔɔno maama tɔge de o sɔ-yuu tiina mo o via.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam pɛ se Nadab de Abihu te mo. Kokuri to, Sinayi kagoa kam seeni mo banto déem kwei min-yɔɔ ba zwɛ se ba ma zuli Baŋa Wɛ, ye o wo pɛ chwoŋa se ba zwɛ mini dem konto dwoŋi. english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de Moses o we:

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo déem na go Ejipti tiina bakeiri-kwe sem maama to, a daare Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem de ba vare-kwe sem mo se ba taa ye amo nyem. Levi tiina bam mo jege se ba leiri bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.” Ba jeeli Levi tiina bam ni

translation_verse: Sinayi kagoa kam ne mo Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Jeeli Levi dwi tiina bam ni se ko tɔge de ba sɔ-yuni tem, de ba di sem. Nam jeeli ba baara balo na yi chana se ko taa vei to n popone ba yera n tiŋi.”

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Levi bia bam yera mo tento: Gereson, de Kohafe, de Merari.

english_verse: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gereson sɔ-yuni tem ye Libini de Simeyi mo.

english_verse: Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohafe sɔ-yuni tem maa ye Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.

translation_verse: Libini de Simeyi di sem déem nwoŋi Gereson sɔ-yuu kom wone mo.

english_verse: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Gereson sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Layeli bu Eliasafe mo.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Ko déem ye Gereson sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii wara-vwei dem baŋa ne, de gwaaro telo na kwoli-de to, de gare-jale delo na leigi de ni dem ne to.

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.

translation_verse: Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli di sem déem nwoŋi Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom wone mo.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Yuzeli bu Elizafan mo.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye Kohafe sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam baŋa ne, de tabolo kom, de min-zwon-zego kom, de kaanem dakɛ sem, dedaane zela yalo kaanem tiina bam na yeini ba kwei ba ma toŋe ba totoŋa to, de gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to, dedaane wonnu tem konto maama totoŋa yam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tu Aron bu Eleaza déem mo ye Levi dwi dem yiga tiina bam yuu tu. Ba ma tiŋi wonto se o taa nii balo maama na toŋe wara-vwei dem totoŋa yam to baŋa ne. Merari sɔ-yuu kom de ba totoŋe dem

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Mahili de Musi di sem déem nwoŋi Merari sɔ-yuu kom wone mo.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Merari sɔ-yuu kom yiga tu wom déem ye Abihali bu Zureli mo. Banto sɔ-yuni tem déem mo jege se ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam wara-vwei dem baŋa seeni.

english_verse: Their duties included taking care of the tent frames and the pieces that held the tent up: the bars, the posts, the stands, and its other equipment. translation_verse: Ko ta ye Merari sɔ-yuu tiina totoŋe mo se ba taa nii wara-jei sem konkɔlɔ ywoa yam, de da-dɛɛra yam na zege luuru telo baŋa ne to, de paara yam, dedaane ŋone sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Moses, de Aron, de Aron bu-baara bam, ba yeini ba chwi ba vwoa yam wara-jei sem yiga ne mo, se ko jeeri wɛ-puli seeni. Banto mo lage ba taa nii wara-vwei dem de de totoŋa yam baŋa ne ba pae Isarele tiina bam. Nɔn-gaa ná tiini o yi wara-vwei dem yera, se ba go kotu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de Moses o we, “Jeeli Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe selo maama na yi chana se ko taa vei to se n popone ba yera n tiŋi.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Abam nam wó pa se Levi dwi tiina bam leiri á bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom! Levi tiina vara bam de wó leiri Isarele tiina maama vare-kwe sem yuu ne ba taa ye amo nyem.”

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Laam pɔɔre Levi tiina bam se banto leiri Isarele tiina bakeiri-kwe sem yuu ne ba ji amo nyem. Ta pɔɔre Levi tiina vara bam se banto de leiri Isarele tiina bam maama vare-kwe sem yuu ne. Levi dwi tiina bam wó taa ye amo nyem mo. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Á wó ŋwe sɛkɛle sabu-dala yanu mo bu-kwea maama ŋwaane. Sabu kom konto dunni jege se ko tɔge wara-jei sem maŋem chekke na ye tei to mo. Sɛkɛle dedoa maa ye gɛra kuni finlei.

english_verse: pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Moses laam ma kwei-ko o pa Aron de o bu-baara bam, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ ni se o ke tei to.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we:

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohafe tiina bam totoŋa yam konto ye se ba taa nii wonnu telo na tiini te ye wose to baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Ko ná yeini ko yi se á gɔ á vwoa yam se á vo jeiga kadwoŋi, Aron de o bia bam mo wó zo wara-vwei dem wone ba pare gare-jale delo na chege Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to, se ba ma-de ba kwoli Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó kwei twan-nyenno ba kwoli-ka, se ba daare ba kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ma ba pu-ka. Ko kwaga ne, se ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Ko maa ná ye tabolo kolo baŋa ne ba na yeini ba ke bworobworo kolo na tigi da Wɛ ŋwaane to, ba ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to mo ba kwoli-ko. Ba laam maa wó kwei zon-tanlɛ sem, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa zwe sem, de kabeili sem, de sana pɛɛra kikeiri sem, ba zege ko baŋa ne. Bworobworo kom jege se ko yeini ko taa wo tabolo kom baŋa ne mo maŋa maama.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to ba ma kwoli min-zwon-zego kom, de ko min-zwonnu tem, de wonnu telo na fɔge te kwɛ mini dem to, de tentwarem zon-tanlɛ sem, dedaane nuga kabɔɔro tem maama.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Ba jege se ba kukuli-ko mo, de ko yera zela yam maama, twan-nyenno wone, se ba laam kwei-ko ba daŋe ko zeŋem dɛ sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ba daa ta wó kwei gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to mo ba ma kwoli sabu-seŋa kaanem dakaa kam, se ba daare ba kwei twan-nyenno ba ma pu-ka. Ko kwaga ne se ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Aron de o bia bam ta wó kwaleme zela yalo maama ba na jege ba toŋe wara-jei sem wone to ye ba daare ba kukuli-te gare-yi delo nyenyego na ye nazwon-pupwia to wone. Ba laam maa wó kwei twan-nyenno ba ma ba pu te ni, ye ba daare ba kwei-te ba daŋe zeŋem dɛ sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó kwoori tentwarem delo maama na wo zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam wone to mo ba yage, se ba daare ba kwei gare-yi na ye nasoŋ-pupwiu to ba ma kwoli-ka.

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Ba nam ta wó kwei zela yalo ba na jege ba toŋe kaanem dakaa kam totoŋa to mo ba tiŋi gare-yi dem konto baŋa ne. Ko maa ye mini zon-tanlɛ sem, de dɛ selo ba na jege ba chu ba le nɔna to, de sɛbullu tem, dedaane na-zwe sem mo. Ba ta wó kwei twan-nyenno mo ba ma ba pu te maama, ye ba laam tore dakaa kam zeŋem dɛ sem ka yera ne.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu Aron bu Eleaza nam mo wó taa nii min-zwonnu tem wo nuga kam, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kalo na wó zwɛ to, de dɛ dɛ wodiu pɛɛra yam, de Wɛ swolim nuga kam baŋa ne. Wonto ta wó taa nii wara-vwei dem dedaane de yera zela yalo maama na pɔɔre Baŋa Wɛ zula ŋwaane to baŋa ne.”

english_verse: The Kohathites must not go near or even look at the sacred objects until Aaron and his sons have covered those objects. If they do, their entire clan will be wiped out.
