english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Ko nam na ke tei to, abam déem ma lɔ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem kwaga ne ye á ve se á zo logo kom wone.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Dé daa bá wane dé vo jei sem konto ne. Dé na toŋe dé chorro telo to jwoori mo ye ba ke foone debam kuri ne. Ba maa we, tega kam konto tiina bam damma mo ye ba daa ta dɔra ba dwoi debam. Ba maa zoore teene delo na lɔge de dam ye de kabiri sem diini vili vili se yi wɛyuu to mo. Nɔn-sawaara de maa wo ba wone.’

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Se abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó tɔge abam yiga se á vo. Wonto mo lage o jaŋe o pa abam, nenɛɛne á déem na nɛ o na toŋe tetei maama o pa abam Ejipti ne to.

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: Kagoa kam yuu ne de, abam daa ta nɛ Baŋa Wɛ na nii á baŋa ne tetei maama to. O maa jege abam konto mo ga taa, o ba o yi ywo-seeni, nenɛɛne kwo na jege o bu ye ba via chwoŋa yuu ne tei to.’

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Amo bá sɛ se nɔɔna banto dedoa zo te-ŋoŋa kalo a na pwooli de ba nabaara bam se a pa-ba to, ba na ye nɔn-lwanno to ŋwaane,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: ko ná dae Jefunɛ bu Kaleb yerane. Nɔɔna balo zem na wora to wone wonto yerane mo wó de o naga tega kam konto ne. Amo nam wó kwei-ka a pa o de o dwi dem, kokuri to wonto mo kwei o bochare maama o ma o tɔge-ne.’

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye abam ŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ bane zaŋe dedaane amo. O ma ta de amo o we, ‘Nmo tete de bá zo tega kam wone.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma daare o ta de nɔɔna bam maama o we, ‘Se ko ná ye abam bia balo ta na muri ye á ya kɔre we á dona wó go-ba to, de balo ta na wo yi se ba taa yei lam de lwarem daane to, banto mo wó wane ba zo tega kam wone. Amo wó pa-ba chwoŋa se ba taa tei tega kam.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: Á na nigi konto to, á ma leiri-ne á we, ‘Debam seene dé ve dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem. De laam nam wó vo se dé ke jara yam, nenɛɛne o na pɛ debam ni se dé ke tetei to.’ Abam déem tage konto dwoŋi ye á daare á kwei á jara zela yam se á vo jara-keim ne, kokuri to á ya boŋe we ko bá taa chana se á vo á jwoŋi zwonnu laŋa kam.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, ‘Nam kaane nɔɔna bam se ba yé zaŋe ba vo ba ke jara yam, bɛŋwaane amo bá taa wo ba tei ne. Ba dona maa wó da ko ŋwaane ba di-ba.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Amo ma ta konto a bere abam, ye á wo sɛ a taane dem. Abam na zeiŋi á tete to ŋwaane mo á nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ ni dem kwaga ne ye á vo zwonnu laŋa kam ne se á kwaare jara yam.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Amori tiina bam na zoore jei sem konto ne to déem ma nwoŋi ba jeeri abam. Ba ma zeili abam nenɛɛne twe mo ba chiŋi ba yage tei to. Ba ma pare abam konto taa ba vo ba yi Edom laŋa kam. Ba na yi Horama teo kom to dedaane ba di abam maama.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: ‘Abam tiini á kekare peero tento laŋa kam ne á dáane dedɛ. Ko laam maŋe mo se á pipiri á ta‑á vei baŋa seeni.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Nam pa nɔɔna bam amo nia yanto: Abam laam lage á tɔge Esawu dwi tiina bam tega kam ne mo á kɛ. Banto ye á chorro ye ba zoore Edom laŋa kam ne. Ba wó taa kɔre foone de abam. Nam zuri-na á yera de-ba.

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe á gwe ba jara. Kokuri to, amo ba lage a kwei ba tega kam a pa abam, de ka na-baare yi dedoa de. Amo maŋe a kwei Edom peero laŋa kam mo a pa Esawu dwi dem se ba taa tei.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Á ná maa tɔge ba tega kam wone á kɛa, á wó wane á ma sabu-seŋa á yeigi wodiiru dedaane na ba tei ne.’

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo, dé tɔge Edom laŋa kam wone mɛ dé chorro Esawu dwi tiina bam na zoore to dé kɛ. Dé ma lɔŋe chwoŋa kalo na tɔge Araba te-kampare ka kɛ to. Chwoŋa kam konto zege tega-kuri seeni mo Elafa de Ezion-Gebera ne. Dé laam ma pipiri dé kwei kagoa chwoŋa kalo na maa vei Moaba to.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de amo o we, ‘Yé daane-na Moaba tiina bam, se ba ye Lot dwi dem mo. Yé kwaare-na jara de-ba, se amo mo maŋe a kwei Ara jei sem a pa-ba. A ba lage a pa abam ba tega kam.’

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: Emi tiina déem ya mo zoore laŋa kam konto ne. Banto déem jege dam ye ba kɔgɔ kom gaale. Ba maa ye nɔn-sawaara se ko maŋe de Anaki tiina bam na ye tei to.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna déem yeini ba pa se Emi dwi dem de Anaki dwi dem ye Refayi tiina mo. Moaba tiina bam de maa bwoi-ba we Emi tiina.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Edom laŋa kam, Hori tiina mo ya zoore jei sem konto ne. Esawu dwi tiina bam laam ma zaŋe ba baŋa ne ye ba daare ba zeili-ba. Ba na chɔge ba teo kom konto to, ba ma jwoŋi ba tega kam ba tei, se ko maŋe de Isarele tiina bam de na lage ba ke tei ba zeili ba dona ba daare ba jwoŋi tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa-ba to.

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma pa debam ni se dé zaŋe dé bɛ Zereda nabara kam. Debam déem ma seene dé ke konto.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: Jar-keira bam konto dwi dem na tega maama ye ba wolowolo daa tera Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom wone to,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: mo Baŋa Wɛ tage o bere amo o we,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Zem dɛ dem ne mo abam wó tɔge Moaba tiina teo Ara seeni á kɛ.

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Á laam maa wó zo Amon tiina laŋa kam. Ta‑á yei-na se á yé daane-ba. Yé kwaare-na jara de-ba, se amo ba lage a pa abam Amon tiina tega kam. Amo maŋe a kwei tega kam konto mo a pa Lot dwi tiina bam se ba taa tei-ka.’

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: Jei sem konto maama de déem ye Refayi tiina tega mo. Banto badwonna maa zoore ka wone. Amon tiina bam déem jege-ba ba bwoi we Zamzummi tiina mo.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ya maŋe o ke konto dwoŋi mo o woli Esawu dwi tiina bam na zoore Edom ne to. O déem ya chɔge Hori tiina bam mo pa se Edom tiina bam wane ba zeili-ba ye ba daare ba jwoŋi ba tega kam. Ba ta zoore da de zem maama.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Ko daa ta ná ye Awa tiina bam, banto déem zoore te-balwa balo na wo Mediterania naneo kom ni ne to, se ko taa vei Gaza teo kom seeni. Filisi tiina bam na nwoŋi Kiriti ne to ma go-ba, ye ba daare ba jwoŋi Awa tiina tega kam ba zoore da.

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta debam o we, ‘Zaŋe-na á kwaleme á zela yam se á vo á bɛ Aranon nabara kam. Nii-na ywo! Amo mo lage a kwei Hesebon teo Pɛ Sihon a ke abam jeŋa ne se á wane‑o á di. A maa wó kwei o tega kam de a pa abam. Véi-na á kwaare jara ded‑o, se á daare á jwoŋi o jei sem á ta‑á tei.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ko zege zem dɛ dem ne se ko taa via, amo lage a pa se logo baŋa teene dem maama taa kɔre abam foone mo. Ba ná maŋe ba ni abam ŋwa, ko ye se ba yera mo taa sae vare-vare ye ba bochara di abam ŋwaane.’ ” Ba di Pɛ Sihon jara baŋa ne Jeelim

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: “Debam déem ta na wo Kedemofa kagoa kam ne to, mo amo toŋe kwora a pa Hesebon teo Pɛ Sihon. A déem tage ded‑o mo se o pa dé ke ni-sɛɛm daane se jara yé taa wora dé tetare ne.

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: A ma ta a we, ‘Debam ná maa tɔge nmo teo kom ne dé kɛa, dé wó kwei chwoŋa mo yɔrɔ-tɔtɔ dé taa via. Dé ba lage dé ywori jazem naa jagwia seeni.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: Debam nam jege se dé vo dé yi Jɔdan buga kam mo se dé bɛ-ka dé kɛ. Nam ta‑á yei-na we, Esawu dwi tiina balo na zoore Edom ne to dedaane Moaba tiina bam na zoore Ara ne to maŋe ba pa debam pwola pa dé tɔge ba laŋa kam ne dé kɛ.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we, ‘Nii-na! Amo lage a kwei Pɛ Sihon de o teo kom mo a ke abam jeŋa ne. Nam véi-na yiga se á mage jara de-ba á jwoŋi ba tega kam á ta‑á tei.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Jayaza ne mo Pɛ Sihon de o nɔɔna bam déem nwoŋi se ba kwaare jara dedaane debam.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ ma kwei‑o o ke debam jeŋa ne. Dé ma mage‑o dé go, ye dé daare dé go o bia dedaane o nɔɔna bam maama dé woli da.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo woli debam ye dé di teene dem maama. Ko na zege Arowa teo na wo Aranon bwolo kom ni ne to, dedaane teo kolo na wo bwolo kom tetare ne to, se ko taa vei Gilead laŋa kam to mo dé wane maama. Teo déem tera ko na dana ko dwoi debam wanem.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, ‘Nam yé ta‑n kɔre‑o, se amo mo lage a kwei Pɛ Oga de o jar-keira bam a ke abam jeŋa ne, se á jwoŋi ba tega kam á ta‑á tei. Abam nam jege se á chɔge pɛ wom konto dedaane o nɔɔna bam mo nenɛɛne á na ke Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon na di paare Hesebon ne tei to.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Dé ma yɔɔre dé chɔge Pɛ Oga teene dem maama dé ke-de Wɛ dam kuri ne, nenɛɛne dé na maŋe dé chɔge Pɛ Sihon laŋa kam tei to. Dé ma chɔge de nɔn-bia bam maama: baara, de kaana, dedaane bia.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Sihon dedaane Oga déem ye Amon tiina bam pwa mo. Banto paare laŋa kam wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ delo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni to mo. Ba laŋa kam déem tole ka zege Aranon nabara kam ne mo se ka yi Heremon peo kom na wo baŋa seeni to. Debam déem ma jwoŋi jei sem konto maama dé tei.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Dé déem mage jara mo dé vere teene delo maama na wo peero tem laŋa ne to. Dé ta ma wane Gilead laŋa kam de Basan maama se ko yi Saleka dedaane Ederi. Teene delei dem konto de déem tɔge de wo Basan laŋa kam ne mo, mɛ Oga na di o paare dem to.

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Pɛ Oga déem mo kweeli Refayi tiina bam jeŋa ne. Ba déem na mɛ kolo ba suli‑o ko wone to ye luuru mo ba mɛ ba ke-ko. Ko dedɔrem baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo maŋem kuni nogo. Ko daare ye ko kayɔlɔ baŋa seeni maŋem maa ye jatwogo maŋem kuni bena. Ko daa ta wo Amon tiina teo Raba ne mo.” Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni tega kam Jeelim

english_verse: At that time I told the men of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh: The Lord our God told me to give you this land with its towns, and that's what I have done. Now your wives and children can stay here with your large flocks of sheep and goats and your large herds of cattle. But all of you men that can serve in our army must cross the Jordan River and help the other tribes, because they are your relatives.
translation_verse: Se ko daare á kaana, de á bia, dedaane á vara bam maama mo, á wó pa se banto maŋe á teene delo amo na maŋe a kwei a pa abam to wone. Kokuri a yei we abam vara bam tiini ba daga dedɛ.

english_verse: Then I told Joshua, “You saw how the Lord our God helped us destroy King Sihon and King Og. So don't be afraid! Wherever you go, the Lord will fight on your side and help you destroy your enemies.” God Refused To Let Moses Enter Canaan Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de-ba. Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo lage o jaŋe o pa abam.’ ” Wɛ wo sɛ se Moses bɛ o vo o zo Kanaan tega kam

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: “Kanto maŋa kam ne, a déem ma tiini a lwoori Wɛ a we,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo ye n tontoŋeno mo. Nmo laam nam bobo se n bere-ne nmo jeŋa na jege dam se n ma‑n ke wo-kenkagela yalo to. Kokuri to, wɛ dedwoŋi tera wɛyuu ne naa tega baŋa ne se de wane de ke nmo wo-kamuna yam dwoŋi.

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Ja, pa amo chwoŋa se a de tɔge a bɛ Jɔdan buga kam a zo te-ŋoŋa kalo na wo bubɛ dedwoŋi dem ne to, se a wane a na zwonnu tem laŋa kam na tiini ka lana to, dedaane Lebanon jei sem.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wo sɛ se o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom. Abam kɔgɔ kom ŋwaane mo o bane déem tiini de zaŋe de amo, ye o ta o bere-ne o we, ‘Pa se ko kweeli! Daa‑n yé ŋɔɔne taane dem konto de amo!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Za n diini Pigisa peo kom yuu ne. Dáane mo n wó wane n nii n kaare tega kam jei maama. Nii n yiga ne, de n kwaga ne, ko woli de n jazem de n jagwia maama. Fɔge n nii n na, kokuri n bá‑n tɔge n bɛ Jɔdan buga kam.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Véi n ta de Josua se o bochare ke dam. Ke baare n ke o kuri ne, se wonto mo lage o da amo nɔɔna bam yiga se ba bɛ ba zo tega kam nmo na wó na to. O ta wó pa ba jwoŋi-ka ba taa tei.’

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: “Isarele dwi tiina bam, ta‑á cheigi-na Wɛ nia yalo amo na lage a bere abam zem tento to, dedaane o chullu tem maama. Á ná sɛ á tɔge-ya, ko wó pa se á wori ye á daare á zo á jwoŋi tega kalo á nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom na lage o pa abam se á ta‑á tei to.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á yé woli kolokolo nia yalo a na lage a pa abam to wone, nam yé le-na kolokolo ya wone á yage. Za á ke-na á tɔge Baŋa Wɛ nia yalo maama a na wó pa abam tento to.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Ko daare ye abam balo maama na sale Baŋa Wɛ to daa ta ŋwe de zem maama.

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: Guli-na dɛ dem abam déem na wo Sinayi peo kom teiŋa ne ye á zege Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to. Dento dɛ dem ne mo Baŋa Wɛ tage amo o we, ‘Moses, pa se nɔɔna bam la ba jeeri-ne se ba wane ba cheigi a kwora. Konto wó pa se ba taa kɔre amo maŋa kalo maama ba na jege ŋwea tega baŋa ne to, se ba daare ba bere ba bia se ba de taa zuli-ne.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Abam déem tu á zege peo kom teiŋa ne. Min-vogo ma zaŋe peo kom baŋa ne ko di wɛyuu. Kunkwon-lilirru ma kwoli jei sem maama pa ko ke lim.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma zege mini dem tetare ne o ŋɔɔne de abam. Abam ma ni o botare-bia bam ye á wo nɛ o nyenyego de fenfee de. O kwora kam yerane mo á niga.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: O déem pɛ se á lɔre ni-gwonim delo o na lage o ke de abam to. O ma pa abam ni se á sɛ á tɔge o Nia Fuga kam, ye o daare o popone-ya o tiŋi kandwa-pelɛ selei baŋa ne.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ka maŋa ne, mo Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ-ne ni se a bere abam o chullu tem de o nia yam se á sɛ á ta‑á tɔge-ya, nenɛɛne á ná tu á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam ye á zoore tega kalo á na wó jwoŋi á ta‑á tei to wone. Ko chula se ba taa kaane jwona

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: se á yé biini á tete se á mɔ nyenyego se ko ji jwoni ko pa abam. Ko ná maŋe ko ye baaro nyenyego, naa kaane nyenyego,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, abam na kwoni á yuni á na wea kam, naa chana kam, naa chalechwe sem, naa wonnu telo maama na wo wɛyuu ne to, nam yé ke-na fera se á tiiri á zuli-te. Baŋa Wɛ yage-te wɛyuu ne logo baŋa dwi maama ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: Abam ŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ bane déem zaŋe de amo. O ma ta o du o we, amo bá da a bɛ Jɔdan buga kam se a zo te-ŋoŋa kalo o na lage o pa abam se á ta‑á tei to wone.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, amo jege se a maŋe ywo-seeni mo a te. A bá da a bɛ Jɔdan buga kam. Abam nam wó bɛ á zo á jwoŋi te-ŋoŋa kam konto á ta‑á tei.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Nam tiini á ta‑á yei se á yé swei ni-gwonim delo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ke de abam to. Yé ke-na jwoni dwi delo maama nyenyego á zege se á zuli-ko, Baŋa Wɛ na chuli-ko to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ yi page abam baŋa ne mo. O maa nye de min-fɔrɔ kolo na di wo-yɔɔro maama to mo.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River and settle down in the land. Then in the years to come, you will have children, and they will give you grandchildren. After many years, you might lose your sense of right and wrong and make idols, even though the Lord your God hates them. So I am giving you fair warning today, and I call the earth and the sky as witnesses. If you ever make idols, the Lord will be angry, and you won't have long to live, because the Lord will let you be wiped out.
translation_verse: Zem dɛ dento ne a kwei wɛyuu kom de tega kam baŋa maama mo, se te taa ye maana abam de Baŋa Wɛ tetare ne. Abam ná ve Wɛ ni dento, se á dwi yɔɔre de jei tega kalo á na lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam á zo to baŋa ne. Abam ná zaŋe á zuli jwona, se á yé dáane te-ŋoŋa kam baŋa ne. Á wó na chɔgem mo.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó ja abam o jage o yage teene dem maama tetare ne. O ná zeili abam o yage teene delo wone, á lage á te mo se á nɔɔna bam fenfee yerane daare de wone.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Abam ná zoore jei sem konto maama ne, á wó ta‑á zuli nabiina na kwei dɛ dedaane kandwa ba ma ba ke jwona yalo to mo. Yanto ware se ya nii ya na wonnu naa se ya ni kwori. Ya nam ware wodiu se ya di, ya maa ba ni lwom.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Abam ná tu á zo cham wone, pa se wonnu tento maama yi abam, ko kwaga ne á laam wó pipiri á jwoori á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei, se á sɛ o ni.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege abam yibwona. O bá fɔge o de abam o yage. O nam bá chɔge abam. O bá swei ni delo o déem na gwoni dedaane abam nabaara bam ye o du duuri de baŋa ne to. Isarele dwi tiina bam ye ba yera

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Dwi dedwoŋi tiina wɛ ke kokeiri de vere de nɔɔna bam teo kodwoŋi jeŋa ne pa se ba ji wɛ dem konto tete tiina na? Se abam tete yi mo nɛ abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na toŋe de o dam-fɔrɔ o ke wo-kamunnu dedaane wo-kenkagela se o ma faŋe Ejipti tiina bam o nii ye o daare o tɔge jara baŋa ne o vere abam ba jeŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: O ma pa se o kwora mo zege wɛɛne ka ba á tei se o ma o kaane abam se á ta‑á sɛ o ni. O ta ma pa se á zege tega baŋa ne á na o min-fɔrɔ kom o na tɔge ko wone o ŋɔɔne de abam to.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: O na jege á nabaara bam swono to ŋwaane mo o kuri abam na ye ba naaro to, se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna. Baŋa Wɛ tete déem mɛ o dam-fɔrɔ mo o le abam Ejipti wone.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: O laam ma da á yiga o zeili dwi-gɛ tiina balo na daga ba dwoi abam, ye ba ta dana ba dwoi abam to, se o pa á kwei ba tega kam á ta‑á tei, nenɛɛne ko na ye tei zem tento to.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Laam nam kwei chega kam konto á ke á bochare ne zem, se á sɛ we Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na tei wɛyuu dedaane tega baŋa maama. Wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Ta‑á toŋe-na á tɔge Baŋa Wɛ nia yalo a na pɛ abam zem tento to. Abam ná sɛ o bera yam konto, á ŋwea wó ke lanyerane ka pa abam de á kwaga kam. Á laam maa wó ta‑á zoore tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kuri se á ta‑á tei taa wuu to wone á dáane.” Ka-duri-ka-zo-ka-seigi teene dem Jeelim

english_verse: Moses said, “People of Israel, you must set aside the following three towns east of the Jordan River as Safe Towns: Bezer in the desert highlands belonging to the Reuben tribe; Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gad tribe; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manasseh tribe. If you kill a neighbor without meaning to, and if you had not been angry with that person, you can run to one of these towns and find safety.” The Second Speech: Moses Tells What the Lord Demands Israel at Beth-Peor
translation_verse: Ruben dwi dem wone o déem le Bezere mo. Teo kom konto maa wo zwonnu yuu ne ye ka ta ye kagoa laŋa. O ta ma le Ramofa o pa Gad dwi dem. Teo kom konto maa wo Gilead laŋa kam ne. O ma daare o le Golan o pa Manasɛ dwi dem. Teo kom konto maa wo Basan laŋa kam wone. Wɛ nia yam pulim taane

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Ba déem ta ma vere o tega kam dedaane Basan teo Pɛ Oga tega kam maama. Pwa banto balei maa ye Amori tiina pwa balo na di ba paare Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to.

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Ba laŋa kam konto déem zege Arowa teo kom seeni mo, ko na wo Aranon nabara kam ni ne to, ka yi Sirion peo kom seeni.

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: Tega kam maa tɔge Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni dem maama mo ka yi Araba naneo kom. Pisiga peo kom teiŋa maa wo ka wɛ-puli seeni.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á go nɔɔno.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo déem gwoni ni dedaane debam Sinayi peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Ko dae dedaane de kwoa bam yerane mo o ke ni-gwonim dem de-ba. O déem ke-de dedaane debam balo ta na ŋwe zem tento to mo.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete déem ma zege mini dem wone o ŋɔɔne de abam jaja peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, abam déem kɔre foone mo se á di peo kom yuu, mini dem na wora to ŋwaane. Amo maa zege abam de Baŋa Wɛ tetare laŋa ne, se a lwoni Wɛ taane dem a bere abam. Baŋa Wɛ déem tage o we:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Amo maa ye wolo na jaane abam a ja nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne ye a vere abam á kabɛɛne dem ne a yage to.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: Daa á yé zuli-na jwona á woli amo wone.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á mɔ kamɔgɔ se ko taa ye jwoni ko pa abam. Á yé mɔ woŋo se ko lwoni wɛyuu wonnu, naa tega baŋa wonnu, naa tega kuri na wo wonnu.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Abam ba jege se á tiiri te yiga ne naa á zuli-te. Kokuri to, amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Amo yi page abam baŋa ne mo. Ko ná ye balo na ve amo to, a yeini a waare-ba de ba bia maama se ko vo ko yi ba dwi dem kuni betɔ naa bena laŋa ne.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na swoi-ne ye ba sɛ a nia yam to, a maa yeini a jege ba swono taa, se ko yi ba dwi dem kuni moro laŋa ne.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Á yé zaŋe á bwoŋi á Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere kafɛ ŋwaane, se Baŋa Wɛ wó waare wolo maama na ke konto to.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Da yarepɛ maama wone, abam jege da yaredo mo se á ma‑á toŋe totoŋa dwi maama.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: Yé ŋɔ-na kolokolo.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Isarele kɔgɔ kom maama déem na jeeri peo kom teiŋa ne to, mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa o pa debam o nia fuga kam konto. O ma zege mini dem de kunkwon-lilirru tem wone mo o ŋɔɔne o nia yam, ye kolokolo déem wo woli ya wone. O laam ma popone-ya o daŋe kandwa-pelɛ selei baŋa ne o kwei o pa-ne.

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Abam déem na nigi we kwora mo nwoŋi lim wone ka yi abam, ye peo kom de tɔre mini konto to, mo balo na ye yuu tiina de nakwa abam dwi maama wone to tu amo tei,

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: ye ba we, ‘Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom seene o bere debam o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom dedaane o kamunni dem na tiini de daga tei to. Zem dɛ dento, dé nigi o kwora kam na nwoŋi mini wone ka yi debam tei to, ye dé lɔre we nabiinu wó wane o ni Baŋa Wɛ na ŋɔɔne ded‑o ye kotu wó ta wo o ŋwea wone.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Debam nam ba lage se dé te! Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ná ŋɔɔne dedaane debam ye dé ni o kwora kam, min-fɔrɔ kom wó wane ko go debam.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wora nabiina maama wone o na wó wane o ni Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora na nwoŋi mini wone ka ŋɔɔne ded‑o nenɛɛne dé zem na nigi-ka to, ye kotu ta ŋwe?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Konto to, nmo nam tutwoni n twɛ debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, se n cheigi kolo maama o na jege se o ta o bere debam to, se n laam ba n lwoni n bere debam, se dé wó sɛ o ni dem.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ni abam na tage kolo to, ye o ta de amo o we, ‘Amo nigi nɔɔna bam na tage kolo maama ba bere‑m to. Ba na tage kolo to nam lamma!

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: Amo ya lage se ba boboŋa ja se ba taa kɔre amo ye ba sɛ a nia yam maŋa maama. Konto ya wó pa se banto ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa-ba de ba kwaga kam se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Véi n ta-ba se ba jwoori ba vwoa yam ne.

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Se ko ná ye nmo, nmo wó maŋe ywo-seeni mo se a bere‑m a ni dem maama. Ko ná ye a chullu tem de a bera yam maama, nmo wó lwoni n bere nɔɔna bam se ba taa tɔge-ya mo tega kalo a na lage a pa-ba se ba taa tei to wone.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Ta‑á tɔge-na abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na bere abam chwoŋa kalo se á da to. Konto wó pa se, á ná zo tega kalo o na lage o pa abam se á ta‑á tei to, á wó zo ka wone á dáane ye á ŋwea ke lanyerane.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento. O déem pɛ amo ni se a pa abam mo lɔre o chullu tem de o bera yam maama na ye tei to se á ta‑á tɔge-ya nenɛɛne á ná tu á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam, ye á zo se á jwoŋi á tega kam á ta‑á tei.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Cheigi-na Isarele tiina bam, se á ta‑á yei se á sɛ Wɛ nia yam maama. Konto wó pa se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam, se á ta puli de kɔgɔ á ji te-fɔrɔ. Á tega kam wó taa lana de varem de kɔnɔ, nenɛɛne á nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom déem na gwoni ni se o ke o pa abam tei to.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: Cheigi-na Isarele tiina bam, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye o yerane dedoa mo.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Ta‑á swoi-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ dedaane á bochare maama, de á boboŋa maama, ko woli de á dam maama.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Pa-na se á bia de lɔre-ya. Ta‑á tɛ-na ya taane maŋa maama, nenɛɛne á ná jei sɔŋɔ ne ye á lara, naa á ná tɔge daane á vei chwoŋa yuu ne, ko ta woli de á ná peini tete ne, naa á ná zaŋe zezeŋa maama ne.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Lwoni-na-ya á tiŋi tɔnɔ ne se á daare á vɔ-ya á je ne, dedaane á tira ne, se á ta‑á guli ya gula.

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Popone-na-ya á tiŋi á di sem ni-bworru tem ne, se á daare á ta popone-ya á yage á manchwo-nia dɛ sem ne.

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem nam ya maŋe o gwoni ni mo de á nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, dedaane Jakob, se o kwei tega kam konto o pa abam. Leile konto o lage o pa á zo ka wone. Te-kamuna maa wora, ye abam wo lɔge-de.

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: Sɔ-fwaaro de maa wora ye te jege zela dedɛ abam na wo tiŋi-ya da. Abam ta maa wó nyɔ vola yalo á na wo koge to na bam, ye á daare á di teeni delo á na wo jeiri to bia bam, Vini tio-bia de Olivi tio-bia de woli da. Abam nam ná tu á nae á di á sui,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: se á yé swei-na Baŋa Wɛ ni ne, kokuri wonto mo jaane abam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti ne, á déem na ye kabɛ mɛ to.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ta‑á kɔre-na abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, ye á toŋe á ke o boboŋa. Á ná gwoni ni de nɔɔno, se á ma Baŋa Wɛ yere dem yerane á du duuri.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Nam yé zaŋe-na á zuli wa yadwonna á woli da, nenɛɛne dwi-gɛ tiina na gilimi abam ye ba zuli wa yalo to.

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: Lɔre-na se abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wo á tetare ne, ye o yi page abam baŋa ne. Á ná tɔge wa yadwonna, o bane wó zaŋe de abam, ye o daare o chɔge abam tega kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á yé faŋe abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ á nii, nenɛɛne á déem na ke tei Massa ne to.

english_verse: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: Abam laam wó wane á dona maama á di, ye á daare á zeili-ba, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to.

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: Abam laam maa wó ta á bere-ba we: ‘Debam déem ye Ejipti Pa-faro wom kabɛ mo. Baŋa Wɛ déem ma tɔge o dam-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne o jwoŋi debam o yage.

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Debam yi déem mo nɛ o na ke wo-kenkagela dedaane totoŋ-kamuna yalo na jege foone to, ye o yage-ya Ejipti tiina bam de ba Pa-faro wom baŋa ne dedaane o nakwa maama yuu ne to.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Dé ná seene dé yia dé tɔge o bera yam konto maama, nenɛɛne o na pɛ debam ni tei to, ko wó pa dé na chega o yiga ne.’ ”

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á toŋe á tɔge Wɛ nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem, ne amo na pɛ abam zem to. Wɛ swolim na wó ba ba baŋa tei to

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wó ke-ba á jeŋa ne se á wane-ba á di. O ná seene o ke konto, se á yɔɔre á chɔge-ba. Abam nam yé ke-na ni-sɛɛm de-ba, naa á duri ba ŋwaŋa de fee de.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Abam ná sɛ pa se konto ke, ba wó soge á bia mo pa se ba tusi ba taa zuli wa-yɔɔro ye ba daare ba lɔ Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne. Konto nam wó pa se Baŋa Wɛ bane mo zaŋe abam baŋa ne se o chɔge abam lela.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam ná wane dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto, se á mage ba kaanem bimbina yam á de tega ne. Á ta jege se á lɔ kandwa yalo ba na chwi ba jwona ŋwaane to. Gwoni-na ba Asera nyenyego dɛ sem á de tega ne, se á daare á ke mini á zwɛ ba jwona yam maama.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, abam ye nɔɔna balo na ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nyem mo. O déem kuri abam mo logo baŋa dwi maama wone se á ta‑á ye wonto tete lonne jejegero.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye o na jege abam swono to ŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem. Ko ta maa ye o na pwooli dedaane á nabaara bam se o ke tei to ŋwaane mo. Mo kokuri o déem toŋe de dam o jwoŋi abam Ejipti Pa-faro wom jeŋa ne o yage pa se á nwoŋi teo kolo á ya na ye kabɛ da to wone.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na we abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yerane mo ye Wɛ chekke. Á wae á sale‑o, ye o bá kwane o ni de ni-gwonim delo o na ke o swono kom ŋwaane to. O ta wó taa swoi balo na swoi‑o ye ba tɔge o nia yam to, ye o bá yage-ba, se ko yi ba dwi dem kuni moro laŋa ne.

english_verse: But if you turn against the Lord, he will quickly destroy you.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na ve‑o to, o wó yɔɔre o waare-ba. O bá dáane ye o chɔge-ba lela.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Abam wó na Wɛ swolim á dwoni tega baŋa dwia yam konto maama. Wolo na ba lore to, naa varem wolo na ba lore to daa bá taa wo abam wone.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Yé ja-na wo-zɔɔna yam konto dwi á zo á sam wone, se konto ná kea abam de wó na chɔgem mo ne wonnu tem konto na maŋe de chɔgem tei to. Yɔɔre á ta‑á chuli-te-na, se te maŋe de chɔgem mo.”

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Abam ná cheigi Wɛ nia yanto ye á daare á toŋe á tɔge-ya de chega, Baŋa Wɛ swono kolo na ba ti to de wó taa wora de abam, ne o na gwoni ni tei de á nabaara bam to.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete mo wó che abam de jaweero dwi maama. O bá pa chwoŋa se jawe-chɛɛro telo dwi na to Ejipti tiina bam yera ne to ba abam baŋa. O nam wó kwei-te o ke á dona yera ne mo.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: Abam wae á boŋe á tete ne we, ‘Debam bá wane teene dento nɔɔna dé zeili, ba na tiini ba dana ba dwoi debam to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
translation_verse: Nam yé ta‑á fona de-ba. Guli-na abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe tei o chɔge Ejipti Pɛ wom de o nɔn-bia bam to.

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: Abam tete yi mo nɛ Baŋa Wɛ na tɔge o dam baŋa ne o toŋe wo-kamunnu dedaane wo-kenkagela pa se jawe-chɛɛro ja Ejipti tiina bam ye o daare o vere abam ba jeŋa ne tei to. Guli-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom déem na ke tei, se o ta wó ma dam dem konto mo o chɔge nɔɔna banto abam laam na kɔre tento to.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: O maa wó pa se vuvuga to á dona tetare ne, se balo na duri ba lu ba seigi to tete de na chɔgem.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, á ba jege se á ta‑á kɔre nɔɔna bam konto. Baŋa Wɛ wora de abam. Wonto nam mo jege dam-fɔrɔ ye o maŋe se nɔɔna taa kɔre‑o.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tete mo lage o taa zeili dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto o yage fee fee se abam zo ba tega kam wone. Abam bá yɔɔre á zeili-ba bedwe baŋa ne. Ko ná ke konto, kago-vara mo wó puli da ba daane abam.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: O maa wó kwei ba pwa o ke á jeŋa ne, se á go-ba pa se ba dwi saare logo baŋa ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane abam o che de á na lage á ke kolo to. Abam maa wó chɔge ba maama.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Zwɛ-na ba jwona yam. Yé pa-na se á fera zo sabu-seŋa, naa lu-nyenno telo na wo jwona yam yera ne to. Nam yé lɔɔne-na-te. Abam ná ke konto, te wó ja abam ne kalanchogo tei. Jwona kaanem ye totoŋ-vɛɛsa mo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Nam toŋe-na á tɔge Wɛ ni delo maama a na pɛ abam zem tento to de chega, se ko pa á ta‑á ŋwe ye á kɔgɔ kom puli dedɛ. Abam maa wó zo tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na gwoni ni de á nabaara bam se o pa abam to wo á ta‑á tei.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: O na pɛ se á tu á tete tei to, o pɛ se kana mo ni abam, ye o laam pa abam Manna se á di. Konto nam ye wodiu kolo abam de á nabaara ya na yeiri to mo. O nam ke konto se ko pa se abam lɔre we ko dae wodiu yerane mo pae se nabiina ŋwe, se ko ye Baŋa Wɛ ni taane dem maama mo pae nɔɔna ŋwea.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Nam maane-na á bochare ne we á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom de yɔɔre o korese abam mo, ne kwo na korese o bu tei to.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Konto to, yɔɔre á sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam. Ta‑á tɔge-na o chwei sem, se á daare á ta‑á kɔre‑o.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, abam Baŋa Wɛ wom jege abam o zoore te-ŋoŋa wone mo. Bu-tole, de chwaro mo wo ka wone, ye buli-yia tae ya nwoŋi ka bwollu de ka peero jei sem ne.

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Jei sem konto ne wodiiru gaale, ye kolokolo zore bá ja abam. Tega kam peero jege luuru te wone, ye channa-seŋa de wo ka zwonnu tem wone.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná di ka wodiiru á su, se á tei á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom de te-ŋoŋa kalo o na pɛ abam to.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: Ta‑á yere-na á tete se á yé swei abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Yé swei-na o ni ne, se á ve o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem a na pɛ abam zem to.

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Ko ná dae konto, abam ná di tega kam wodiiru á su, ye á ta lɔ sɔ-laaro á zoore te wone,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: ye á vara de ná puli dedɛ, ye á lu-nyenno de á sabu-seŋa daga pa se á jejegero tem puli te pa abam,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: á wó bere á tete, ye á swei á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ni ne. Wonto nam mo ye wolo na jaane abam o ja nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne pa se o vere abam á kabɛɛne dem ne o yage to.

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: O ma ja abam o tɔge kagoa kam wone, ka na yala ye ka tiini ka jege foone ka pa abam to. Basankwe selo ni na chamma to wora, ye nwanno de gaale. Jeiga kam konto na koge ye na tera jei jei to, o pɛ se na ta ba nwoŋi pe-liliru wone.

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: Kagoa kam wone mo Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o kwei Manna o kɔne abam. Ko nam ye wodiu kolo á nabaara na yeiri to mo. O ma pa se cham dedɛ yi abam se o ma pa á tu á tete, se o daare o faŋe abam o nii, se ko kwaga seeni á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam wolowolo yé fɔge o boŋe o tete ne we, ‘Amo dam de a jeŋa totoŋa mo pɛ-ne a jejegero tem.’

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Nam guli-na we, ko ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo pae abam dam se á ma á ji naduna. O nam ke konto se ni-gwonim delo o na ke de á nabaara bam to mo su lanyerane, ne ko na ye tei de zem maama tento to.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó ke abam ne o na lage o ke tei de teene delo na wora ye abam laam lage á zo ba tega kam wone to mo. O wó yɔɔre o chɔge abam mo, á na wo sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom kwora to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: “Isarele tiina bam, cheigi-na! Abam zem lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam mo, se á zeili dwia yalo na daga ye ba ta dana ba dwoi abam to ba tega kam ne. Nɔɔna bam konto zoore te-fwaaro wone, te kabiri sem na diini wɛɛne vili vili se yi wɛyuu to mo.

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: Ba maa dɔra ye ba ta dana. Ba ye nɔn-sawaara balo na nwoŋi Anaki dwi dem ne to mo. Abam nam nigi ba na tɛ ba taane we, ‘Wɔ mo wó wane o dwoni de Anaki tiina bam?’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom lage o da á yiga o bɛ buga kam, se o chɔge-ba mo. Ko wó taa nye de min-fɔrɔ na di wo-yɔɔro maama kula tei to mo. Maŋa kalo abam na wó vo á zo da to mo o lage o di-ba, se á wane-ba á zeili á daare á chɔge-ba lela ne Baŋa Wɛ na pwooli de abam tei to.

english_verse: After the Lord helps you wipe out these nations and conquer their land, don't think he did it because you are such good people. You aren't good—you are stubborn! No, the Lord is going to help you, because the nations that live there are evil, and because he wants to keep the promise he made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. When Israel Made an Idol (Exodus
translation_verse: Lɔre-na we abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ba lage o pa abam te-ŋoŋa kanto á na ye nɔn-ŋona to ŋwaane, se abam dae kɔtaa! Abam nam yɔɔre á ye zwabani-nyena mo. Sabu-seŋa na-mɔra jwoni dem gula

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Guli-na abam déem na wo kagoa kam ne ye á tiini á pa se á Tu Baŋa Wɛ bane zaŋe tei to. Ko na zege dɛ delo ne abam na nwoŋi Ejipti ne, se ko yi á na zege ywo leile to, abam yɔɔre á lɔ o kwaga ne mo maŋa maama.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Sinayi peo kom ne mo á tiini á chuchugi o bane pa se o lage se o chɔge abam.

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we, ‘Amo yei nɔɔna banto na ye balo to. Ba yɔɔre ba ye zwabani-nyena mo.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Nam ta‑n zege dáa ne n nii-ne. A lage a chɔge-ba mo se ba yere saare logo baŋa maama ne. Amo laam maa wó zege nmo baŋa ne, a pa se te-fɔrɔ bobo de nmo kwaga kam. Banto teo kom maa wó taa daga ye ko dana ko dwoi nɔɔna banto na ye tei leile to.’

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Amo na seene a nii to, a nɛ sabu-seŋa na-mɔra kalo abam na mɔɔne se ka taa ye á jwoni to. A ta nɛ we á ke lela á ywori Baŋa Wɛ chwoŋa wone ye á ke wɛleere o yiga ne.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane ya ta zaŋe de Aron de mo ye o boŋe se o chɔge wonto de. A maa na lwoori Wɛ a pa Aron to, Baŋa Wɛ déem sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom konto de.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: A déem ma kwei woŋo kolo na pɛ se á ke wɛleere dem to, sabu-seŋa na-mɔra kam mo konto. A ma nyeene-ka, ye a daare a nɔne-ka mura-mura. A laam ma kwei-ka a dole a yage bu-dura ne pa se na bam zeŋe-ka ba ja ba viiri.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: Abam déem ta na vei á yi Tabera ne, de Massa ne, de Kiberof-Hataava ne to, á pɛ se Baŋa Wɛ bane zaŋe mo.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Abam nam na yi Kadese-Baranea ne to mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ abam ni o we, ‘Zo-na tega kalo a na pɛ abam to á kwei-ka á ta‑á tei.’ Abam ma ve Baŋa Wɛ ni dem konto, ye á wo pɛ‑o chega.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Chega to, ko zege a na lɔre abam maŋa kalo ne to, á yɔɔre á ye balo na ve Baŋa Wɛ ni to mo.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nam mo pɛ se amo de to Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne, ye a ja o teiŋa da finna, wea de tete maama. Ko maa ye o na ti yiga se o chɔge abam de á na pɛ se o bane zaŋe to ŋwaane mo a ke konto.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Amo ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ ye a we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, ja! Yé chɔge nmo tete nɔɔna bam. Ba ye nmo nyɔn-mage nɔɔna balo n na kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom n ma‑n vere-ba n ja n nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to mo.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Guli n tontoŋena Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob ni ne, se n yé jeeli nɔɔna banto wo-dɛɔ de ba keim-lwanno, de ba wɛleera yam.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná chɔge nɔɔna banto, Ejipti tiina bam wó ta we nmo wo wane n nɔɔna bam se n ja n zo tega kalo n na gwoni ni se n pa-ba to. Ba ta wó ta we, “Baŋa Wɛ na chuli o nɔɔna bam to ŋwaane mo o jaane-ba o vo kagoa kam wone se o go-ba!”

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Nam nii! Nɔɔna banto ye nmo tete nɔɔna balo n na kuri se ba taa ye nmo nyɔn-mage nɔɔna to. N tɔge n dam baŋa ne n toŋe wo-kamunnu n ma‑n ja-ba n nwoŋi Ejipti ne n ba ywo.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Ka maŋa kam ne, Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, ‘Sare kandwa-pelɛ selei ne boboa nyena yam, n daare n kwei daa n ma‑n ke dakaa, se n laam di peo kom yuu n ba a tei.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Se a lage a jwoori a popone botare selo a na ke boboa kandwa yam ne ye n lɔ to mo a ke kandwa yanto baŋa ne. Ko kwaga ne, n jege se n kwei-ya mo n tiŋi dakaa kam wone.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: A ma kwei golesaa dɛ a ma a ke dakaa a daare a sare kandwa-pelɛ selei ne boboa nyena yam. A ma zeeri kandwa yam a ja a di peo kom yuu.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma jwoori o popone o nia fuga kam o tiŋi kandwa yam baŋa ne, nenɛɛne boboa poponem dem dwoŋi. O ya zege min-vogo wone o tɔɔle o nia yam konto se abam ni dɛ dem á déem na gilimi o yiga ne to. O na jwoori o popone-ya to, o laam ma kwei kandwa yam o pa amo.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: A ma zege peo kom yuu ne a tu tega, ye a daare a kwei kandwa yam a tiŋi dakaa kalo a na ke to wone. A ke Baŋa Wɛ na we a ke tei maama to ye ya ta wora de zem maama.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: Ta‑á kɔre-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye á toŋe á pa‑o. Ta‑á sale-na wonto. Á ná gwoni ni de nɔɔno, se á ma Baŋa Wɛ yere dem yerane á du duuri.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem ya zege Jaakan dwi tiina buli sem seeni mo ba vo ba yi Mosera. Ba na yi da to mo Aron tega ye ba suli‑o jei sem konto ne. O bu Eleaza ma leiri o yuu ne o ji Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ba ma zege dáane ba vo Gudigoda. Ba daa ma zege Gudigoda ne ba vo ba yi Jotibafa, mɛ bu-nwaro na daga da to.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Ka maŋa kam ne, Baŋa Wɛ ma pɔɔre Levi dwi dem o pa o tete, se ba taa zeeri dakaa kam, se ba kwori ba taa zege o yiga ne ba toŋe ba pa‑o ye ba kwei Wɛ yere ba ma swɛ Isarele dwi tiina bam maama swolim. Ba ta wora ba ke konto dwoŋi de zem maama.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, a zaŋe a da abam yiga se á wane á zo á ta‑á tei tega kam nenɛɛne o na pwooli de á nabaara bam se o ke tei to. Ta‑á kɔre-na Baŋa Wɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: Konto to, Isarele tiina bam, kikia dwi dɔ mo abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom beeri á tei ne? Ko ye se á ta‑á kɔre á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, se á ta‑á tɔge o chwei sem, se á ta‑á swoi‑o lanyerane, se á daare á ta‑á toŋe á pa‑o de á bochare de á boboŋa maama mo,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: ye á toŋe á tɔge o nia de o bera yalo maama amo na pɛ abam zem to. Á ná seene á ke konto dwoŋi, á ŋwea wó ke lanyerane ko pa abam.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tei wɛyuu baŋa kam maama, dedaane logo baŋa de kolo maama na wo ko wone to.

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa nam dɛ á nabaara bam se o taa jege ba swono. O ma daare o kuri abam balo na ye ba bia to logo baŋa dwi maama wone, se á ta‑á ye wonto tete nyem, nenɛɛne á ta na ye tei de zem maama to.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Konto to, kwɛ-na á bochara ne Wɛ na pɛ abam ni se á ke tei to, se á daa yé ke zwabania.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Kokuri, abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tei wa maama. O maa ye yuu tiina maama Yuu-tu. O ye Wɛ kamunu ye o tiini o jege foone. Wonto nam ba kuri nɔɔna daane de o na bore ba bora tei to ye o ba jwoŋi dim.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye botara de kadeina, o yeini o toŋe de chega mo o pa-ba. O ta kwori o swoi veira balo na zoore á wone to, ye o woli-ba de wodiiru de gwaaro.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Abam de jege se á ta‑á swoi veira mo, á de déem na ye veira Ejipti teo kom ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Wonto mo ye wolo á na jege se á ta‑á tei‑o to. O toŋe wo-kenkagela na jege foone to á yibia ne se o ma jwoŋi abam.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Konto to á jege se á ta‑á swoi abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo. Ta‑á toŋe á tɔge o nia yam, de o chullu tem, de o bera yam maama.

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: O déem toŋe wo-kenkagela Ejipti teo kom ne se o ma waare ko Pa-faro wom de o nɔɔna bam maama.

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: O ma chɔge ba jar-keira bam de ba sisei de se torokooro tem. Banto na kwaane se ba zeili abam ba ja to, Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se ba misi Nane-soŋo kom ne ba te. Ko dɛ konto mo ye ba na ba chɔgem se ko ba ko yi zem.

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: Á bia bam wo nɛ Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe tei o zeini abam maŋa kalo á na beeri taa kagoa kam wone á ba á yi ywo-seeni to.

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: Ba wo nɛ Baŋa Wɛ na ke Ruben dwi tu Eliabi bia Datan de Abiram tei to. Wɛ déem pɛ se tega kam puri Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom tetare ne ka li-ba, de ba sɔŋɔ tiina, de ba vwoa yam, dedaane ba jejegero maama.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Abam tete yia mo nɛ totoŋ-kamunnu telo maama Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe to.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, sɛ-na Wɛ nia yalo amo na pɛ abam zem to maama, se á jwoŋi dam á wane á bɛ á zo tega kam á ta‑á tei-ka.

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: Á laam maa wó ta‑á zoore tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na pwooli de á nabaara bam se o pa banto de ba bia bam to wone á dáane. Tega kam tiini ka ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Tega kalo á nam na lage á zo to jege zwonnu de bwollu mo, ye doa nena da lanyerane.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yi page tega kam konto baŋa ne mo. O maa nii-ka bene dem maama wone.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: Konto to, á jege se á sɛ Wɛ nia yalo amo na bere abam zem to, se á daare á ta‑á swoi á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye á toŋe á pa‑o de á bochare dedaane á wo maama.

english_verse: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.
translation_verse: Á vara de wó na gaao lanyerane se ba di. Wodiiru telo maama á na lage to wó yi abam se á ta‑á di á sui.

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na se ba yé soge abam se á ywori Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne á daare á ta‑á zuli wa-yɔɔro ye á toŋe á pa-ya.

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: Á ná ke konto, Baŋa Wɛ bane wó zaŋe de abam. O ta wó che doa kam se ka daa yé taa nena. Te-ŋoŋa kalo o na lage o pa abam to daa bá ke wodiiru ka pa abam, pa se á dwi ti lela logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Ta‑á guli-na Wɛ nia yalo a na bere abam to se á ke-ya á bochare ne. Lwoni-na-ya á tiŋi tɔnɔ ne se á daare á vɔ-ya á je ne, dedaane á tira ne, se á ta‑á guli ya gula.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Pa-na se á bia de lɔre-ya. Ta‑á tɛ-na ya taane maŋa maama, nenɛɛne á ná jei sɔŋɔ ne ye á lara, naa á ná tɔge daane á vei chwoŋa yuu ne, ko ta woli de á ná peini tete ne, naa á ná zaŋe zezeŋa maama ne.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Popone-na-ya á tiŋi á di sem ni-bworru tem ne, se á daare á ta popone-ya á yage á manchwo-nia dɛ sem ne.

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: Ke-na konto se abam de á kwaga kam wane á zo tega kam ne á dáane. Ka maa ye tega kalo Baŋa Wɛ na gwoni ni de á nabaara bam se o pa-ba to, ye á wó ta‑á tei-ka taa wuu, se ko maŋe de wɛyuu de logo baŋa ta na wora maŋa kalo to wone.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á ke á tɔge Wɛ ni dem maama, ne amo zem na bere abam se á ke tei to: Ta‑á swoi-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye á tɔge o chwei sem maama. Nam sale-na o yera ne.

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: Á ná seene á ke konto dwoŋi, Baŋa Wɛ wó zeili dwi tiina balo na maŋe ba wo logo kom wone to mo. O ta wó pa abam dam se á wane á jwoŋi teene delo na dana ba dwoi abam to se á ta‑á tei.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Á ná vei mɛ maama logo kom ne, á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó pa se abam foone mo ja jei sem nɔɔna bam, ne o na pwooli se o ke tei to. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane abam o cheiŋi.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: Nii-na! Amo zem kwei Wɛ swolim dedaane o sɔɔlem mo a tiŋi abam tetare ne, se á wane á kuri kolo á na lage to.

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Abam ná sɛ á tɔge Wɛ nia yalo amo zem na pɛ abam to, Wɛ wó swɛ abam swolim.

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Á nam ná ve o nia yanto ye á zuli dwi-gɛ tiina wa-yɔɔro tem, Wɛ wó sɔɔle lwarem mo o yage á baŋa ne.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Ne abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ná jaane abam o zo tega kam se á ta‑á tei, á jege se á zege Gerizim peo kom yuu ne á tɔɔle Wɛ swolim dem, ye á daare á zege Ebal peo kom yuu ne á tɔɔle o sɔɔlem dem.

english_verse: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.
translation_verse: Á yei we, peero tem konto wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi ne se ko taa vei wɛ-zoore seeni mɛ Kanaan tiina bam na zoore bwolo kom ne to. Te maa bwola de Giligal teo kom. Morɛ tei-zɔŋɔ kom seeni mo konto.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Abam laam lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam se á zo tega kalo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na pɛ abam se á ta‑á tei to mo. Á na tu á ba á jeini da á ti,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: se á tiini á ta‑á yei se á ta‑á toŋa á tɔge Wɛ nia yam de o chullu tem maama ne amo zem na pɛ abam tei to.”

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Wɛ nia yam de o chullu tem mo tento. Ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á tɔge-ya maŋa kalo maama á na zoore logo kolo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ abam se á ta‑á tei to wone. Wonto maa ye á nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom mo.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Abam ná tu á ba á zeili logo kom dwi tiina bam, se á chɔge jei selo maama ba na yeini ba kaane ba jwona da to. Ko ná ye peero yuu ne, naa zwonnu baŋa ne, naa tangwana baŋa ne, á jege se á yɔɔre á chɔge ba jwona kaanem jei sem maama mo.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Mage-na ba kaanem bimbina yam á de tega ne, se á daare á lɔ kandwa yalo ba na chwi ba jwona ŋwaane to. Gwoni-na ba Asera nyenyego dɛ sem á de tega ne, se á daare á ke mini á zwɛ-se, ye á chɔge ba jwona yam maama pa se ya yera saare jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná zuli á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, se á yé ke nenɛɛne nɔɔna banto na zuli ba jwona yam tei to.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Jeiga kalo Baŋa Wɛ na wó kuri se nɔɔna taa zuli o yere da to ná tiini ka ye yiga yiga de abam, á wae á le varem vara balo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ abam to wone á goe ye á daare á di á sam ne á sui, ne amo na bere abam tei to.
