english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: O ma ja debam o ja ba ywo-seeni ye o pa debam te-ŋoŋa kanto na ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri amo laam kwei wodiiru telo na lwoori yiga te ke tega kam ne to se a pa‑o. Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye nmo mo pɛ-ne wodiiru tem konto.’ Laam kwei kayaa kam n zege Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem yiga ne se n daare n tiiri n zuli‑o da.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nmo dedaane n sɔŋɔ tiina wó di ywoni lanyerane, wo-laaro telo Baŋa Wɛ na ke o pa abam to ŋwaane. Levi tiina de veira balo na zoore á tetare ne to dé wó tɔge de abam ba di ywoni. Wodiiru Wɛ-teiri

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: Bena yatɔ bene dem maama wone, á ná le popɔra dedoa á wodiiru tem popɔre fuga wone se á pa Wɛ, kwei-na Wɛ-teiri dem konto á pa Levi tiina, de veira, de botara, de kadeina. Á ná ke konto, balo na zoore á teene dem ne to wó na wodiu ba di ba su.

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Á laam maa wó daare á ware á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom á ta we: ‘Amo seene a tɔge n ni dem ye a le Wɛ-teiri delo na ye nmo nyem to a sɔŋɔ ne a kwei a pa Levi tiina, de veira, de botara, de kadeina mo. A bere a wo lɔge n bera yam kwaga ne naa a swei ya swia de fenfee de.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ-teiri dem, maŋa kalo a na wo lua wone to de, a wo di wodiiru tem konto kolokolo. A na digiri Wɛ chullu tem seeni to, a wo le kolokolo te wone a ja nwoŋi. A nam wo kwei-te a ma zuli twa. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a tɔge nmo ni dem chekke ye a ke nmo na bere-ne tei to maama.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Konto to, zege n wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne n tiiri n nii n nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam se n swɛ debam swolim, se n daare n nii tega kalo n na pɛ debam ne n na gwoni ni de dé nabaara bam se n ke tei to. Ka maa ye te-ŋoŋa na ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ to.’ Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna na maŋe se ba toŋe tei to

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom zem bere abam se á toŋe á tɔge o nia yanto de o chullu tento lanyerane. Ta‑á sɛ-na-ya de á boboŋa maama de á bochare maama.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Á zem tage jaja we Baŋa Wɛ mo ye abam Tu Wɛ, se á ta‑á tɔge o chwei sem chekke. Á nam ta wó toŋe á tɔge o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem maama, ye á sɛ o kwora kam.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ de zem tage jaja we o kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o tete nɔɔna balo o na jega lonne ŋwaane to, ne o na maŋe o pwooli tei to. Abam nam ye se á ta‑á sɛ o nia yam mo.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: O ta wó pa se á yere zaŋe de dwoni dwia yalo maama o na ke to, pa se á na zula de tia ba tei ne. Abam wó ta‑á ye nɔɔna balo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na pwɛ o pa o tete, ne o na maŋe o pwooli se o ke tei to.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Moses de Isarele nakwa bam laam ma ta de nɔɔna bam ba we, “Ta‑á tɔge-na Wɛ ni dem maama a na bere abam zem to.

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.
translation_verse: Á ná bɛ Jɔdan buga kam á kɛ á vo á yi Ebal peo kom, se á chwi kandwa yam konto á daare á fɔge-ya, ne a zem na bere abam se á ke tei to.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Á ta wó kwei kandwa yadwonna á ma lɔ bimbini á pa á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Á nam yé ma-na luuru á sare kandwa yam á ma á lɔ-de.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Beeri-na kandwa-dale se á ma á lɔ bimbini dem, se á daare á ke zwɛɛm kaanem de baŋa ne á pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: Á ta wó ke yazura kaanem da, ye á tɔge daane á di ye á ke wopwolo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yiga ne.

english_verse: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read. Curses on Those Who Disobey
translation_verse: Á jege se á popone Wɛ nia yanto maama á ke kandwa yalo á na chwi to baŋa ne mo, se botare sem taa nae jaja.” Zwabania wó ja sɔɔlem ka ba

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Moses de Levi dwi tiina balo na ye Wɛ kaanem tiina to déem ma ta de Isarele tiina bam maama ba we, “Isarele tiina bam, cheigi-na sɔɔ se á ni a taane dem. Abam zem jigi á Tu Baŋa Wɛ tete nɔɔna mo.

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne mo Moses déem tage de Isarele tiina bam o we:

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim wó taa wo á teene dem baŋa ne de á kare sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim wó taa wo á bia baŋa ne, de á wodiiru baŋa ne, de á vara baŋa ne, ne ko ná ye á naane, de á pei, de de bia maama.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim wó taa wo á mena tetwaro baŋa ne, de á nwanno tem baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ swolim o ke á tuli baŋa ne, de á jeŋa totoŋa maama baŋa ne, pa se á na swolim lanyerane tega kalo o na lage o pa abam to wone.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Abam ná sɛ Baŋa Wɛ ni maama ye á tɔge o chwei sem, o wó fɔge abam pa se á ta‑á ye o tete nɔɔna, ne o na pwooli se o ke tei to.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Ko maa wó pa se logo baŋa nɔɔna maama lɔre we á ye Baŋa Wɛ wom nyem, se ba ta kɔre abam.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se á ŋwea maama ke lanyerane, se á ta‑á jege bia dedɛ, de vara dedɛ, de wodiiru dedɛ, ne á ná tu á zo tega kalo ne o na pwooli de á nabaara se o pa abam to.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó zege o wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne o toŋe doa se ka ne á kare sem ne, pa se wodiiru telo á na dugi to ke lanyerane. O na wó ke zaane á totoŋa maama baŋa ne to wó pa se á ta‑á jene á pae dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ. Abam nam bá jwoŋi jena nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa á ta‑á wo nɔɔna maama yiga ne mo, ye á bá ta‑á wo ba kuri ne. Chega to, á ná sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom kwora ye á toŋe á tɔge o nia yam amo na pɛ abam zem tento to, á wó ta‑á vei yiga mo maŋa maama ye á daa bá jwoori kwaga.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Á ná tega, zuna de kago-vara mo wó ba ba di abam yera ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá daare se o zeili-ba o yage.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Tento maama mo wó taa ye maana se nɔɔna lɔre we Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ wo abam de á kwaga kam baŋa ne taa wuu.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: Abam ná ve á Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam ye á wo sɛ se á tɔge o nia yam amo na pɛ abam zem to chekke, lwarem dento maama wó ba á baŋa:

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó sɔɔle lwarem o yage á bia baŋa ne, de á wodiiru baŋa ne, de á vara baŋa ne, ne ko ná ye á naane, de á pei, de de bia maama.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó ja lɛɛro de cham o ba abam baŋa ne, pa se á boboŋa vugimi de kolo maama á na lage á toŋe to. Chɔgem wó ba de ti abam lela, á na toŋe lwarem totoŋa ye á lɔ Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Á na teene doa, ka bá ba, ye fwogo de kasol-koro yerane mo á wó na. Te wó ba te chɔge abam te ti.

english_verse: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se ŋɔn-pwoni lei abam yera ne, ne o déem na ke tei de Ejipti tiina bam to. O ta wó pa se sankwɛ, de tambwala, de kasili-nabiina to abam yera ne, ye yɔɔrem tera.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se á yuni vuvugi, á yia de wó dwei ye á boboŋa vugimi.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Wea tetare ne de á wó ta‑á kare á taane mo ne lilwoa tei. Á bá na nyɔɔre á totoŋa baŋa ne. Maŋa maama de, nɔɔna wó taa bɛɛse abam, ye ba vere á wonnu tem. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá taa wora se o jwoŋi abam o yage.

english_verse: A man will be engaged to a woman, but before they can get married, she will be raped by enemy soldiers. Some of you will build houses, but never get to live in them. If you plant a vineyard, you won't be around long enough to enjoy the first harvest.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná vei o cha kaane se o di, nɔn-gaa wó zi kaane wom. Wolo ná lɔge diga, kotu bá zo ka wone. Wolo ná dugi kara, kotu bá na ka wodiiru o di.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Ba wó zage á naane ba go á yibia ne, ye á bá na nɔna yam á done. Abam ná zege á nia, ba wó vere á bonɛ ba vaŋe ba ja kɛ, ye ba daa bá jwoori ba pa abam. Ba wó vere á pei sem ba kwei ba ke á dona jeŋa ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o woli abam.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó ja á bia bam, bakeiri de busankane, ba vo ba ke dwi-gɛ tiina jeŋa ne. Á wó ta‑á zege chwoŋa ni ne taa á nia se á bia bam jwoori ye á ga. Á bá wane kolokolo á ke.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Sa-teena mo wó ba ba vere wodiiru telo á na koore luluŋu á na to. Á wó yeini á ta‑á nae yaara de bɛɛsem yerane mo.

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: Keim-chɛɛre delo á yia na wó na to wó pa se á yu-punnu vugimi.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó waare abam pa se ŋɔn-pwoni jwoŋi á nɛ sem maama. Se wó kwoli á yera yam maama ye se ba jia.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó zeili abam de pɛ wolo á na wó kuri se o taa tei abam to se á jage á vo sa-teo yiga yiga, teo kolo abam de á nabaara bam ya na yeiri ko ni ne to. Jei sem konto ne á wó ta‑á zuli jwona yalo ba na mɛ dɛ dedaane kandwa ba ma ke-ya to.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Teene delo wone Baŋa Wɛ na wó jage abam to tiina ná nɛ kolo na wó ke abam to, ko wó so-ba dedɛ. Á wó ji memaŋa de wo-mɔnɔ á pa-ba.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: Á wó du dedɛ á kare ne, ye á ba á zage fenfee, kayere na wó di á wodiu kom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Á wó jeiri Vini teeni á daare á nii de baŋa ne, ye á bá gwori de bia bam naa á ŋoke nyoa bam se á nyɔ, kanzwa na wó chɔge á teeni dem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Olivi teeni wó nwoŋi á tega kam jei maama ne, ye á za bá na de nuga mo, de bia bam maama na wó siiri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Á teeni dedaane á wodiiru maama ye kayere mo wó deilimi se ti.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore abam teo kom ne to wó fɔge ba taa puli de dam, ye abam tete wó ta‑á jwoori kwaga.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Banto wó taa jege sabu ba jene ba pae abam. Abam nam bá ta‑á jega se á jene á pa-ba. Ba wó taa ye abam yuu tiina mo, se á ta‑á wo ba dam kuri ne.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, abam ná ve á Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam ye á wo sɛ se á tɔge o nia yam de o bera yam maama, lwarem dento dwoŋi wó ba á baŋa de bá yage se ko yi á laam na tu á chɔge á ti to.

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri á laam wó ta‑á toŋe á pae á dona balo Baŋa Wɛ na wó toŋe se ba wane abam to. Kana wó ja abam, na-nyɔm de wó ja abam. Zore de wó ja abam woŋo maama wone ye á ta‑á vei kalambwolo. Á wó ji kabɛ ye á na bɛɛsem se ko taa nii á ná tu á chɔge á ti.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó le dwi delo na wo yiga yiga ye á ba ni ba taane to se ba popo ba ba abam baŋa ne, ne maao na yeini ko chaale ko wodiu tei to.

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: Ba maa ye balo na jege wo-dɛɔ ye ba ba duri nɔɔn-nɔɔno ŋwaŋa, nɔn-kwe de bia de to mo.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Á dona wó nwoŋi ba ba tega kalo á Tu baŋa Wɛ wom na lage o pa abam to ba kaare á teene dem maama ba pu. Ko ná ye kabiri-dɛɛro telo na dɔra ye á boŋe we te wó che á dona yiga to, tento wó to tega ne buri-buri.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: Á dona na wó peene abam konto to, ko wó pa se á chɔɔre ye á laam di bia balo á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na pɛ se á lo to.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: Á dona ná kaare á teene dem maama ba pu, nɔn-yero wolo maama na bere o jege yibwona to de lage o di o tete bia mo, o na yaare de kana to ŋwaane. O nam bá sɛ se o chɛ nɔna yam o pa o choro, naa o ka-swono, naa o bia balo ta na daare to.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: O wó seigi o di bu-seseŋa kalo o na loge to de ka nyeene, ye o ba ke o chɛ o pa o diga tiina, kana na jege‑o ye wodiu tera to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: Abam ná wo sɛ se á toŋe á tɔge bera yalo maama na popone ya tiŋi tɔnɔ konto ne to, ye á ná ve se á zuli á Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere-kamunu kom,

english_verse: he will punish you and your descendants with incurable diseases,
translation_verse: o wó waare abam de á bia pa se jawe-chɛɛro lɔgese abam maama ye te bá jei.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta wó pa se jaweero de yaara yalo na maŋe ya wo popone ya tiŋi Wɛ nia tɔnɔ konto ne to ba abam baŋa se te chɔge abam fase.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Á kɔgɔ kom seene ko puli ne wɛyuu chalechwe sem na daga tei to mo. De ko de, abam fenfee yerane mo wó daare, á na ve á Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Ko ya pwoli Baŋa Wɛ wo mo se o ke abam lanyerane pa se á puli dedɛ. Ko laam nam wó pwoli o wo se o chɔge abam pa se á ti. O wó pa se ba vuuri abam ba gɔ tega kalo á na lage á zo to ne.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó zeili abam pa se á jage á vo á yi logo baŋa teene dem maama. Dáane mo á wó ta‑á zuli jwona yalo ba na mɛ dɛ dedaane kandwa ba ma ba ke to. Abam de á nabaara ya yeiri wa-yɔɔro tem konto ni ne.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Á ná zaŋe zezeŋa ne, á wó ta nenɛɛne, ‘Ko ya ná ye dedaan-ni mo tento, ko ya wó taa gara.’ Dedaan-ni ne á maa wó ta we, ‘Ko ya ná ye zezeŋa mo konto, ko wó taa gara.’ Á wó ta‑á tɛ konto dwoŋi de wo-lwanno telo á yia na wó na pa se foone ja abam to.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se á zo nabwooru á jwoori á vo Ejipti, de o na maŋe o pa abam ni se á daa yé da chwoŋa kam konto to. Á ná yi da, á wó kwaane se á yeigi á tete á pa á dona se á ji ba kabɛ, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o yeigi abam.”

english_verse: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai. The Third Speech: Israel Must Keep Its Agreement with the Lord The Lord Is Your God
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem na lage o gwoni ni de Isarele tiina bam Moaba laŋa ne to, taane delo o na tage de Moses se o lwoni o bere-ba to mo tento. Tento de nam ta lage te tɔge te woli de ni-gwonim delo Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o ke o pa-ba Sinayi peo yuu ne to mo.

english_verse: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.
translation_verse: Á yia mo nɛ chana yalo, de wo-kenkagela yalo, de wo-kamunnu telo Baŋa Wɛ na ke o ma faŋe Ejipti tiina bam o nii to.

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Dé na yi ywo-seeni to, Hesebon teo Pɛ Sihon de Basan teo Pɛ Oga ma nwoŋi se ba kwaare jara de debam. Dé déem ma wane-ba.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Dé ma kwei ba tega kam dé pɔɔre dé pa Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem, de Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom se ba taa tei.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á tɔge kolo maama na popone ko tiŋi ni-gwonim dem konto ŋwaane to, se ko pa kolo maama á na lage á toŋe to taa ke lanyerane ko pa abam.

english_verse: In this agreement, the Lord promised that you would be his people and that he would be your God. He first made this promise to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and today the Lord is making this same promise to you. But it isn't just for you; it is also for your descendants.
translation_verse: Ko dae abam balo zem na zege debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yiga ne to yerane mo o lage o du duuri o ma ke ni-gwonim dem konto de-ba, se ko ta ye á kwaga kam de mo o lage o ke o pa-ba.

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Á nɛ dwia yanto tiina na zuli wo-zɔɔna de jwona yalo ba na mɛ dɛ, de kandwa, de lu-nyenno, de sabu-seŋa ba ma ke to.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se abam wolowolo yé lɔ dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom kwaga ne se o daare o vo o zuli dwi-gɛ tiina jwona. Ko ná ye abam balo zem na wora to wone baaro, naa kaane, naa sɔŋɔ kolo, naa dwi delo maama, se á yé zaŋe á ke konto. Wolo maama ná tɔge jwo-yɔɔro, kotu wó taa nye de tei-kugu kolo na bege se ko laam ba ko lei tio-bi-balwaaro to mo.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: O wae o ni ni-gwonim dento na bere wonnu telo to ye o boŋe o yuu ne we, o ta wó na lanyerane de o na maŋe o jege yi-dɛɛre ye o ba tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to de. Kotu nam wó ja chɔgem o ba abam maama baŋa ne, nɔn-ŋona de nɔn-balwaaro maama.

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó le‑o Isarele dwia yam maama wone se o tiini o na chɔgem. Sɔɔlem delo maama na popone Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone o ni-gwonim dem ŋwaane to maa wó to kotu baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Abam kwaga kam de sa-teena balo na nwoŋi yiga yiga to jwa wó na chɔgem delo Baŋa Wɛ na wó pa de to tega kam baŋa ne se yaara dedɛ ta wora to.

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Á tega kam maama wó chɔge, yɛ de chilibugu na wó li-ka to ŋwaane. Ba bá wane kolokolo ba du ka wone. Wodiiru de bá ke da, ye gaaro tete bá wane te nwoŋi. Laŋa kam maama wó taa nye de Sodom, de Gomora, de Adema, de Zeboyiim teene dem déem na chɔge tei, Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane to.

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina maama ná nɛa, ba wó taa bwei nenɛɛne, ‘Bɛ laam mo ke ye Baŋa Wɛ chɔge ba tega kam konto dwoŋi? Bɛŋwaane mo o bane tiini de zaŋe de-ba konto?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó leiri-ba ba we: ‘Ko wó taa ye we, Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam chɔge ni-gwonim delo o na ke de-ba maŋa kalo o na jaane-ba o nwoŋi Ejipti ne to, de o na ye ba nabaara Wɛ wom to.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: De konto de, ba déem yage‑o ba daare ba zuli wa-yɔɔro mo, te na ye wa yalo ba ya na yeiri, ye Wɛ wo sɛ se ba zuli-ya to.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma vuuri-ba o le ba tega kam ne, ye o laam dole-ba o yage sa-teo ne, o ban-lom dem ŋwaane. Dáane mo ba ta wora de zem maama.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: Wo-siseigiru wora, te na maŋe te wo dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom boboŋa ne, se ko daare bera yalo o na veere o pa debam to, yanto mo ye debam de dé kwaga kam nyem se ko taa vei wuu, se dé wane dé taa tɔge o nia yam maama.”

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Amo laam nam bere abam Wɛ swolim dem de o sɔɔlem dem na wó taa ye tei to. Wonnu tento maama ná seene te ke abam baŋa ne, ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ná zeili abam o jage se á ta‑á zoore dwi-gɛ tiina tetare ne, á wó guli te gula.

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: Abam de á kwaga kam laam ná pipiri á jwoori á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei ye á sɛ o ni de á boboŋa maama de á wo maama, ne amo zem na bere abam tei maama to,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Á ná maŋe á jage mo a zo logo kom gugworru yiga yiga de, Baŋa Wɛ wó la abam dáane o ja jwoori ywo.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: O wó pa á jwoori á zo tega kalo á nabaara déem na tei to, se abam tete de taa tei-ka. O ta wó pa se á fɔge á puli á dwoni á nabaara bam déem na ye tei to.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó kwɛ abam de á bia bochara, se á ta‑á wae á swoi‑o de á boboŋa maama, de á wo maama, se á dáane tega kam ne.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: O ta wó pa se lwarem delo o ya na sɔɔle o ke abam baŋa ne to yage abam se de pipiri de ba á dona baŋa ne, de balo maama na chuli abam to.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó pa se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ye á totoŋa maama taa jege nyɔɔre. O ta wó pa á ta‑á jege bia dedɛ, de vara dedɛ, de wodiiru dedɛ. Ko wó pwoli o wo se o ke abam lanyerane, ne o yi déem na page á nabaara bam baŋa ne tei to mo.

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom kwora ye á toŋe á tɔge o nia de o bera yalo na popone ya tiŋi Wɛ nia tɔnɔ konto ne to mo. Á jege se á pipiri á jwoori o tei mo de á boboŋa maama de á wo maama. Ŋwea de toone taane

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yalo amo na pɛ abam zem to ba tiini ya dwoi á jaanem.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ko dae we ya tigi wɛyuu ne mo, se á ta‑á bwei da-tei ne we, ‘Wɔ mo wó wane o di o ja-ya o jwoori o ba o pa debam, se dé wane dé ni se de daare dé sɛ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ko dae we ya wo naneo kom kakam daa ne, se á ta‑á bwei nenɛɛne, ‘Wɔ mo wó yɛ na o bɛ naneo kom o ja-ya o jwoori o ba o pa debam, se dé wane dé ni ye dé daare de sɛ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Aawo, ya zege ywo mo ya bwola de abam. Ya maŋe ya wo á ni ne de á bochara ne. Konto to, sɛ-na-ya chekke.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: Amo zem pɛ abam chwoŋa mo se á kuri lanyerane de balɔrɔ tetare ne kolo á na lage to, se á ta kuri ŋwea de toone de tetare ne.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Zem dɛ dento ne a kwei wɛyuu kom de tega kam baŋa maama mo, se te taa ye maana abam de Baŋa Wɛ tetare ne. A pɛ abam chwoŋa se á kuri ŋwea de toone tetare ne, se á ta kuri Wɛ swolim de o sɔɔlem dem tetare ne. Konto to, twori-na ŋwea, se abam de á kwaga kam wane á ta‑á ŋwe,

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: se á daare á ta‑á swoi á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom á kwori á sɛ o kwora ye á sale‑o. Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na wó pa abam momwɛ-dɛɛre, ne á ná zo tega kalo o na pwooli de á nabaara Abaraham de Izaak de Jakob se o pa-ba to wone.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Moses daa ta ma vo o ta de Isarele tiina bam o we:

english_verse: But he has promised that he and Joshua will lead you across the Jordan to attack the nations that live on the other side. The Lord will destroy those nations just as he destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings. Just remember—whenever you capture a place, kill everyone who lives there.
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ wó ke-ba á jeŋa ne se á wane-ba. Ko nam jege se á tɔge nia yalo amo na pɛ abam to se á chɔge-ba á ti.

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Ke-na dam á ke á tete kuri ne se á ta‑á jege baare. Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de-ba. Á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wo á tei ne. O bá fɔge o yage abam. O nam bá pa se á to.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Moses laam ma bwoŋi Josua o ta tento ded‑o Isarele tiina bam maama yiga ne o we: “Yɔɔre n ke dam n ke n tete kuri ne, se n daare n ta‑n jege baare. Nmo mo jege se n da amo nɔɔna bam yiga se ba vo ba zo tega kalo ne Baŋa Wɛ na pwooli de ba nabaara se o pa-ba to. Nmo ta wó pɔɔre tega kam n pa-ba se ba taa tei.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete mo wó taa wo n tei ne se á ta‑á via. O bá fɔge o yage‑m. O nam bá pa se n to. Konto to, yé ta‑n lwia. Nam yé pa n vɔna pare.” Wɛ nia yam garem

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Moses laam ma popone Wɛ nia yam o tiŋi, ye o daare o kwei-ya o pa Wɛ kaanem tiina bam de Isarele nakwa bam. Kaanem tiina bam déem nwoŋi Levi dwi dem wone mo ye ba yeini ba zeeri Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam.

english_verse: Moses told these priests and leaders: Each year the Israelites must come together to celebrate the Festival of Shelters at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. You must read these laws and teachings to the people at the festival every seventh year, the year when loans do not need to be repaid.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we: “Bena yarepɛ bene dem maama ná yia, bene delo á na wó ma‑á chɛ balo na jege á jena to, se á ga Wɛ nia yam konto se Isarele tiina bam maama cheigi. Ko ye maŋa kalo ba na wó vo jeiga kalo Baŋa Wɛ na wó kuri ye ba jeeri o yiga ne se ba di Vwoa chwiim kuri dem to mo á jege se á ga á de ba zwa ne.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Ba kwaga kam de jwa wó ba ba cheigi Wɛ nia yam ye ba ya yeiri-ya. Banto de jege se ba lɔre ba na wó ke tei ba taa kɔre á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, maŋa kalo maama á na wó ta‑á zoore tega kalo ne á na lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam á jwoŋi se á ta‑á tei to.” Wɛ na bere Moses tei o kweeli to

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de Moses o we: “Ko gɛ fee se n te. Bwoŋi Josua se á laam ba á zo wara-vwei dem ne se á tiŋi‑o se o ji á yiga tu.” Moses de Josua ma vo ba zo vwei dem ne.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Kunkwoŋo na zege deiki to ma ba ko dɔge vwei dem ni dem ne, ye Baŋa Wɛ zege kunkwoŋo kom wone.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: O ma ta de Moses o we: “Ko bá dáane se n te. Nmo toone dem kwaga ne nam, nɔɔna banto bam wó zaŋe ba yage amo ba vo se ba taa zuli tega kalo ba na lage ba zo to wa-yɔɔro. Ba wó lɔ amo kwaga ne ye ba daare ba chɔge ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: Ko ná ke konto, a bane wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne lela, pa se a ma a kwaga a ya-ba. Amo yiga bá taa wo ba wone pa se ba na chɔgem. Yaara de chana dedɛ na wó ba ba baŋa ne to, ba wó ta nenɛɛne, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo yaara yanto wo debam baŋa ne? Ko dae debam Tu Wɛ wom na yage debam to ŋwaane mo na?’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, amo yiga bere ka bá ta wo ba wone, ba na toŋe lwarem delo ye ba pipiri ba vo ba zuli wa-yɔɔro to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, popone-na leiŋa kanto, se nmo, Moses, laam kwei-ka n ma‑n zamese Isarele tiina bam se ba wane ba taa leeni-ka. Leiŋa kam wó taa ye maana mo amo de banto laŋa ne we ba tusi.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Amo lage a kale-ba a ja zo te-ŋoŋa kanto na ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ, ne amo na pwooli de ba nabaara se a ke tei to mo. Ba nam ná zo ba jeini da, ba wó taa nae wodiu ba di ba sui pa se ba nu lanyerane, ye ba daare ba pipiri ba taa zuli wa-yɔɔro. Ba wó ve amo ba daare ba chɔge ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Yaara de chana dedɛ ná to ba baŋa ne, ba laam wó guli leiŋa kanto gula se ka taa ye maana mo we ba tusi. A maŋe a lɔre kolo ba na boŋe ba kana ne to ye a ta wo jaane-ba a zo tega kalo a na pwooli se a pa-ba to wone.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, Moses ma popone leiŋa kam ye o kwei-ka o zamese Isarele tiina bam.

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Moses ma popone Wɛ nia yam maama nyɔ o ke tɔnɔ ne.

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: O na ti to, o ma ta de Levi tiina balo na zeeri Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam to o we,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Jwoŋi-na Wɛ nia tɔnɔ konto á ja vo á tiŋi á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ni-gwonim dakaa kam teiŋa ne. Ko wó taa tigi da mo se ko taa ye maana we abam Isarele tiina bam tusi.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: A yei abam maama na jege wo-dɛɔ ye á zwa de ba ni tei to. Nii a ta na ŋwe a wo abam tei ne, ye á maŋe á ve Baŋa Wɛ ni dem, se a ná tega, ko bá dwoni konto na?

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Nam bwoŋi-na á dwia yam maama nakwa de á dedɛɛra se ba la daane se a ŋɔɔne wonnu tento de-ba se ba ni. A lage a kwei wɛyuu kom de tega kam baŋa maama mo, se te taa ye maana banto de Baŋa Wɛ tetare ne.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: A yei we amo toone dem kwaga ne, á wó biini á tete de wo-zɔɔna, ye á daare á ve Wɛ nia yalo a na bere abam to. Jwa seeni á wó toŋe lwarem kikia á chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga ye á zuli wonnu telo á na mɛ á jea á ke to. Baŋa Wɛ bane wó zaŋe pa se chanɛɛre to abam baŋa ne.” Moses leiŋa kam

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Moses laam ma leeni leiŋa kanto maama o vo o kweeli ye Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama cheigi:

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa a berem dem to á zwa ne ne kunkwoŋo na siiri tei to mo, ne nyɔnɔ de na to tega ne tei to. A botare sem wó taa nye de do-mimina na siiri men-chena de ga-lɛɛro baŋa ne tei to mo.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: A lage a zeiŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere! Ba-na dé zuli dé Tu Wɛ wom de o kamunni dem.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Abam Wɛ nɔɔna bam nam lɔge o kwaga ne. Á ye chaveera yerane mo, ye chwoŋa daa tera se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna, á na tiini á tusi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Agɛboŋa tiina, mo á na wó ke Baŋa Wɛ tei na? Á ba jege swa! Wonto mo ye á Kwo de á Keiru. O maa ye wolo na pɛ abam kugu jei logo baŋa ne to.

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Guli-na faŋa faŋa da yam de á nabaara bam gula. Bwei-na á kwoa de nɔn-kwe sem, se ba ta ba bere abam kolo déem na ke to.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: O déem nɛ o nɔɔna bam ba na kare ba beeri kagoa yuu ne, mɛ sam na tera ye vio yerane mo zɔre ko yaga to. O ma cho-ba ye o nii ba baŋa ne, o yi na page ba baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma korese-ba lanyerane, ne maao na kɔne ko bia ye ko yarege ko vɔna ko kɔgese-ba lanyerane tei to.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo yeini o kale o nɔɔna bam, ye wa-yɔɔro wo dɛ te zeini‑o.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: O ma pa-ba chwoŋa se ba taa tei logo kom zwonnu tem yuu, ye ba di wodi-twaro. Ba déem lɔɔne tooro mo peero jei ne, ba daare ba na nuga kandwa jei ne, mɛ Olivi teeni na leiri bia lanyerane to.

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: Ba naane de ba bone pɛ-ba nayela dedɛ de nayel-pepala. Ba vara de déem nugi lanyerane, pei, de bone, de naane maama. Ba ta ma na men-dala se ba di, de Vini sa-ywoŋo se ba nyɔ.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Ba déem kaane ba pa tangwana, ba ma leiri Wɛ yuu ne. Ba ya yeiri wa-yɔɔro tem konto. Te maa ye jwo-doora yalo ba nabaara ya na wo zuli to.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Ba swei Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom swia, de o na maŋe o ye wolo na pɛ-ba ŋwea to de. Ba mɛ ba kwaga ba ya wolo na loge-ba to.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma na ba na ke tei to, ye o daare o ve-ba, ba na ye o bia ye ba ke puseŋa ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: O déem tage o we: A yiga daa bá taa wo ba wone. Nam yage se dé nii ko na lage ko ke-ba tei to. Ba ye a bia ye ba ta ba kɔre amo, pa se ba tiini ba tusi.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Ba tɔge jwo-yɔɔro mo pa se a bane zaŋe, ye a ke kazwe ba ŋwaane. Mo kokuri a lage a tɔge dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ye nɔn-yɔɔro to baŋa ne a ma pa a tete nɔɔna bam bane zaŋe se ba de ke kazwe.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Amo bane dem wó zaŋe de tɔrege mo ne mini tei, se de di logo baŋa de ko wodiiru maama, de vo de yi tega kam kuri kuri, dedaane peero tem kura ga kula.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Kana, de paa, de jawe-chɛɛro dwi maama wó ja-ba, se ba yaare ba te. A ta wó toŋe kago-vara de tega-veila a yage ba yera ne se te done-ba te go.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: A ya wó ta we, ‘A lage a chɔge-ba zɔŋ-zɔŋ mo, se ba yera saare logo baŋa ne se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé guli ba gula.’

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: A nam ba lage se ba dona taa jege fia ye ba mage ba nyɔɔna ba we, ‘Debam mo wane Isarele tiina bam se ko dae Baŋa Wɛ mo kea.’

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo wó pa nɔɔno dedoa wane nɔɔna moro o zeili, ye nɔɔna balei wane nɔɔna morro kuni fuga? Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ na yage-ba to ŋwaane mo. Wolo na ye peo o pa-ba to mo kwei-ba o ke ba dona jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ba nye de Vini teeni na leiri tio-bi-balwaaro to mo. Ba kugu jei maa wo Sodom de Gomora ne.

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we: ‘Amo maŋe a yei a na wó ke Isarele tiina dona bam tei to. Ko wo a boboŋa ne se ka maŋa ná yia, se a le-de.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó zaŋe o bore o nɔɔna bam bora. O ná nɛ we ba dam ti ye ba wolowolo daa wo daare tembia dedaane kabɛ de, o laam wó duri ba yibwona.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: O maa wó bwei o nɔɔna we: ‘Á wa-yɔɔro tem nam bɛ, ye á ya boŋe se á sale ya yera ne?

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: Lɔre-na we, amo yerane mo ye Wɛ chekke. Wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera. Amo mo pae nabiina momwɛ tia, ye a daare a pae badwonna jege ŋwea. A maa ke zonne nɔɔna yera ne, ye a daare a yɔɔre-ba. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o dwoni de amo.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: A lage a zeiŋi a jeŋa wɛɛne se a du duuri we, Ne amo na jege ŋwea taa wuu to,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: a laam wó dwori a se-zɔɔ, se ko taa jege ni ye ko nyeena. A ta wó kwei-ko a taa zia se a zage a dona, ye a waare balo na chuli-ne to.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: A che-tɛɛra yam nia wó taare de jana. A se-zɔɔ kom de wó zɔ ba ya-nɔna yam. Ba jar-keira bam wolowolo bá lu. Ko ná ye balo na nɛ zonne de balo ba na jaane ba vɔ to, a wó go ba maama, ye a gwo ba yiga tiina bam yuni.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, tɔge-na de Wɛ nɔɔna bam se á ta‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ de wopwolo. O lage o ŋwe balo na goe o nɔɔna bam to jene, se o waare o dona bam maama. Ko nam ná ye o nɔɔna bam, o wó yage ba wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba, se o pa ba tega kam fɔge ka kwɛ lanyerane.”

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: o laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Ta‑á yei-na se á guli taane delo a na pɛ abam zem tento to. Lwoni-na á bere á bia, se ba de wane ba sɛ ba tɔge Wɛ bera yam maama na popone ya tiŋi tento to.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Bera yanto dae ta-gwoa. Ya jege ŋwea ya pae abam mo konto. Á ná tɔge-ya chekke, á wó wane á dáane tega kalo wone á na lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam á zo á ta‑á tei to.” Moses nii o na Kanaan tega kam

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne mo Baŋa Wɛ tage de Moses o we:

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Zaŋe n vo Abarim zwonnu laŋa kam na wo Moaba ne to. N ná yi da, diini Nebo peo kom yuu na jeeri Jeriko teo kom to se n nii n na Kanaan tega kam. A lage a kwei tega kam konto a pa Isarele tiina bam se ba taa tei.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne n wó te peo kom yuu ne mo, ne n zembaaro Aron na maŋe o te Hora peo yuu ne tei to.

english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Abam balei déem ve amo ni mo Isarele tiina bam yiga ne, maŋa kalo á na beeri Zin kagoa wone á vo á yi Meriba-kadese buli-yi seeni to. Á déem wo pɛ amo zula nɔɔna bam yiga ne.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, nmo wó zege yiga yiga mo n nii n na tega kam. N za‑n bá‑n na pwola se n zo tega kalo a na lage a pa Isarele tiina bam to wone.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim delo o tontoŋeno Moses déem na sɔɔle o ke Isarele tiina bam yuu ne ye o laam te to mo tento:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ déem zege Sinayi peo kom ne o ba o veere o tete o pa o nɔɔna bam. O ma zaŋe Edom zwonnu tem yuu ne nenɛɛne wea na puli tei to, ye o zege Paran peo yuu ne o nyeene pwooni ba baŋa ne. Malese kɔgɔ kɔgɔ mo wo o tei ne, ye mini de wo o jazem seeni de pepela.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ jege o nɔɔna bam swono. O maa cho balo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to. Konto ŋwaane mo ba chɔɔle ba tete o yiga ne se ba sɛ o bera yam.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Dé sɛ Wɛ nia yalo Moses na pɛ debam to, ya na ye debam dwi dem lonne na dwoi maama to.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: “Wɛ bá pa se Ruben dwi dem saare, de ba na maŋe ba ba daga to de.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Judah dwi dem yera taane: “Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi Judah dwi tiina bam, de ba na lwoori zeinim nmo tei ne to. Pa se ba jwoori ba fɔge de ba dwia yadwonna yam. Kwei dam n ke ba jeŋa ne, se ba dona yé wane-ba.”

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Ba nam bere ba chega de nmo, ye ba toŋe ba tɔge n bera yam de n ni-gwonim dem, se ko dwoni ba kwoa, de ba niina, de ba chorro, de ba bia.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, swɛ Levi dwi dem swolim, se ba taa jege dunni, se ba kikia de taa pwoli nmo wo. Chɔge ba dona maama, se ba daa yé jwoori ba zaŋe.”

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Benjamin dwi dem yera taane: “Dwi dento mo Baŋa Wɛ tiini o swoi. O maa cho-ba se kolokolo yé yi-ba. O maa wo ba tei ne maŋa maama, pa se ba sii o woro wone.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Josɛf dwi dem yera taane: “Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ ba tega kam swolim, pa se nyɔnɔ nwoŋi wɛyuu, se na de taa bura ba nwoŋi tega kuri ne ba pa-ba.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Wea wó taa pae se ba wodiiru taa bera lanyerane, ye ba na dedɛ chane sem maama wone.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa zwonnu tem wó faare de teeni-bia, ye wodiiru de wó ke lanyerane peero tem yuu ne.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Josɛf dwi tiina wó na wo-laaro telo maama na puli tega baŋa ne to. Baŋa Wɛ wolo déem na zege sabara kam wone o ŋɔɔne to wó ke zaane ba yuu ne. Wɛ wó zeini-ba konto, Josɛf déem na jigi o chorro tem yiga tu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Ba wó bwoŋi dwia yadwonna tiina se ba ba ba di peo kom yuu ye ba ke kaanem delo na ye chekke to ba pa Wɛ. Ba nae ba dunni dem pipiu baŋa ne mo, ye ba na tɔge naneo kom wo ba beeri to ba ta guri wonnu telo na seigi kasolo kom wone to de.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Gad dwi dem yera taane: “Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na wó pa Gad laŋa kam taa daga to. Tei-na o yere! Gad yɔɔre o pɔe mo ne nywoŋo tei. O lage o zi varem se o ja ko jeŋa naa ko yuu o kaare.

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Dan dwi dem yera taane: “Dan nye de nywoŋ-pɔla mo. O zege Basan ne mo o faŋe o nwoŋi.”

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Nafitali dwi dem yera taane: “Nafitali dwi tiina totoŋa yam mo su Baŋa Wɛ yi, ye Wɛ tiini o swɛ ba swolim. Ba laŋa kam wó tɔge naneo kom de tega-kuri seeni maama.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Asere dwi dem yera taane: “Wɛ wó swɛ Asere dwi tiina bam swolim, se ko dwoni dwia yadwonna yam maama. Ba chorro tem wó taa swoi-ba. Ba ta wó na Olivi nuga dedɛ ba tega kam ne.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Ba wó ma luuru de channa mo ba fɔge ba pe ba teene dem manchwo-nia yam. Ba ta wó na dam se ko yi ba ŋwea da yam maama.”

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-swonnu tem, wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera de na nye de Baŋa Wɛ wom. O jege nenɔŋa mo ye o dɔge kunkwonnu baŋa ne o kaare wɛyuu maama o duri o ba se o zeini abam.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Taa-wuu Baŋa Wɛ mo ye abam dalem jei. O maa teili abam o jea ne ye o ba yaga. O daa ta zeili á dona á yiga ne ye o we, ‘Yɔɔre á chɔge-ba-na!’

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Konto to, Isarele dwi tiina bam nɛ pwola se ba taa zoore de wo-zuru. Jakob kwaga kam nɛ ba kugu jei. Wɛyuu nyɔnɔ maa bugi tega kam ye ka su de mena de sa-ywoŋo.

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Moses déem ma zege Moaba pwaro tem ne o vo o yi Nebo peo kom. O ma di Pisiga peo kom yuu na jeeri Jeriko teo kom to. Dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ bere‑o tega kam maama, ko zege Gilead laŋa kam ne se ko vo ko yi Dan laŋa kam.

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ta bere‑o Nafitali laŋa kam maama, de Efrayim de Manasɛ jei sem, de Judah laŋa kam se ko taa vei wɛ-zoore seeni ko vo ko yi Mediterania naneo kom,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: ko ta woli de tega-kuri kagoa kam, de bwolo tega kalo na tole ka zege Jeriko ne se ko vo ko yi Zoara to. Ba déem jege Jeriko ba bwoi we ‘Konkware teo kom’.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de Moses o we, “Tega kanto mo amo dugi duuri ka ŋwaane a pwooli de Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob se a kwei-ka a pa ba kwaga kam. A laam nam pɛ se n na-ka de n yia mo, ko daare n bá‑n na chwoŋa se n bɛ n vo n zo ka wone.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses ma te dáane, Moaba laŋa kam ne. Ko déem ke nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na wuuri o ta tei to.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Ba ma suli‑o Moaba bwolo kodwoŋi ne, ko na jeeri Bɛte-Peora to. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam yeiri mɛ chekke ba na ke‑o to de zem maama.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem ma maŋe Moaba laŋa kam ne ba kwei da fintɔ ba ma keeri Moses lua kam se ba laam ke ba ti.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Nun bu Josua, Wɛ déem pɛ‑o swa lanyerane, Moses na kuri wonto se o leiri o yuu ne to ŋwaane. Mo kokuri Isarele tiina bam déem sɛ Josua ni ye ba toŋe ba tɔge nia yalo Baŋa Wɛ ya na pɛ Moses to.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ŋɔɔne de Moses jaja mo. Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu wodwoŋi daa ta wo zaŋe Isarele tiina bam wone o na nye de Moses

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: ye o toŋe wo-kamunnu de wo-kenkagela se ya ta nye de yalo Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe Moses se o toŋe Ejipti Pa-faro wom, de o nakwa, de o teo kom maama yiga ne to dwoŋi.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera o na jege dam konto dwoŋi se o wane o ke wo-kamunnu na jege foone se te maŋe de Moses na toŋe tei Isarele tiina bam maama yibia ne to.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses toone dem kwaga ne, Baŋa Wɛ ma ŋɔɔne dedaane Nun bu Josua. Wonto déem mo yeini o woli Moses. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Amo tontoŋeno Moses tega. Nmo laam nam zaŋe n to amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam yiga ne se á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam á zo tega kalo amo na wó pa abam to.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Abam laŋa kam siseini wó zege kagoa kalo na wo kuri seeni to, ka tole konto ka yi Lebanon peero tem na wo baŋa seeni to. Ka wɛ-puli seeni siseini dem maa wó zege Yuferata bu-zaŋa kam ne ka tɔge Hiti tiina tega kam maama seeni, se ka laam taa vei Mediterania naneo kom na wo wɛ-zoore seeni to.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa wo nmo tei ne maŋa maama, nenɛɛne a déem na wo Moses tei ne tei to. Amo bá fɔge a yage‑m. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno de nam bá wane o dwoni de nmo.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama, se n ta‑n zamese Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom, se n daare n zo ya wo n boŋe ya boboŋa. Nmo ma‑n ná sɛ o nia yam na bere tei maama to, nmo wó seene n na yiga-veiŋa chekke.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Amo nam maŋe a ta dede‑m we n ke dam n ke n tete kuri ne se n ta ta‑n jege baare. Yé ta‑n fona, nam yé pa se n vɔna pare. Kokuri, amo mo ye nmo Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Jei selo maama nmo na wó vo to, amo wó taa wora de nmo.”

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Véi-na nɔɔna bam tiga jei sem ne, se á ta de-ba we, ‘Ti-na á wodiiru yiga se da yatɔ maŋa ne mo á lage á bɛ Jɔdan buga kam se á zo tega kalo abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na gwoni ni se o pa abam to.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Josua ta ma ta de Ruben dwi dem, de Gad dwi dem dedaane Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom o we:

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Ba de ma leiri‑o ba we, “Dé wó sɛ nmo ni dem maama n na pɛ debam to, ye n ná toŋe debam jei selo maama, dé wó vo.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam ná gwooni‑m ye o ve se o sɛ nmo taane, se ba go‑o. Konto ŋwaane, yɔɔre n ke dam n tete kuri ne, se n daare n ta‑n jege baare de n totoŋa yam.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem maŋe Sitim ne mo ba tei ba vwoa. Ba na wora to mo Josua le nɔɔna balei o toŋe-ba ye o we, “Véi-na á ŋɔ á nii Kanaan tega kam maama, ko fɔge ko dae Jeriko teo kom.” Nɔɔna bam ma seene ba vo ba yi teo kom. Ba ma zo ka-bworo dedoa sɔŋɔ ba peini. Kaane wom yere mo Rahaba.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Jeriko teo Pɛ wom ma ni soswea we, “Isarele tiina badwonna mo tu debam teo tete dento, se ba ŋɔ-ko ba nii.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Tete dem konto ne Rahaba déem daa ma jwoori o di nɔɔna bam tei, ye ba ta ba dɔa.

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo yei we Baŋa Wɛ kwei tega kanto mo o pa abam. Debam maama yera sae mo abam ŋwaane, ye nɔɔna maama ywo-seeni tiini ba fona de abam.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Debam maŋe dé ni we á déem na maa nwoŋi Ejipti ne to, Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se Nane-soŋo kom pwɛ mo ye abam nɔne te-kora baŋa ne á kɛ. Dé ta yei abam na ke tei ye á yɔɔre á go Sihon de Oga to. Banto mo ye Amori tiina pwa balei bam na zoore Jɔdan buga kam wɛ-puli seeni to.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, kwei-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem á ma á pwooli de amo we, abam wó ke amo diga tiina bam lanyerane, nenɛɛne amo de na ke abam lanyerane tei to. Ta bere-ne-na memaŋe se a ma a lɔre we,

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: abam bá sɛ se á nɔɔna bam chɔge amo, de a kwo, de a nu, de a nabwa, de a chorro maama, de ba de kwaga kam, se ba yé ga ba ŋwea.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam de ma leiri‑o ba we, “Nmo ná lwoori n wo pɛ debam keim dento nwoŋi pwooni, debam de pwooli we, Baŋa Wɛ ná kwei jei sento o pa debam, dé wó ke‑m lanyerane. Wɛ wó le dé ŋwea nenɛɛne dé ná ve se dé ke dé na tage tei de nmo to.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Rahaba sɔŋɔ kom déem ya lɔge teo kom kabira yera ne mo. O ma lei ŋona pa se ka tɔge takworo ni ne se nɔɔna bam dɔɔle-ka ba tu tega.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: O ya maŋe o ta de-ba o we, “Mage-na á yum zwonnu laŋa kam seeni, se balo na pare abam to yé na abam. Maŋe-na da á seigi da yatɔ, se ba ná jwoori ywo-seeni, se á laam viiri.”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma sɛ ye o leiri-ba o we, “Dé nam jeini abam ni dem kwaga ne.” O ma bane-ba o yage chwoŋa ne, ye o daare o lei ŋon-naseŋa kam takworo kom ni ne o yage da.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Baara bam ma duri ba vo ba seigi zwonnu laŋa kam seeni. Pɛ wom nɔɔna bam ma pare-ba ba pwoli. Ba maa na nii chwei sem maama ye ba ga ba ŋwa to, mo ba jwoori Jeriko teo kom wone.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balei bam ma zege zwonnu tem seeni ba tu tega. Ba laam ma bɛ Jɔdan buga kam, ye ba jwoori ba vo Josua tei. Ba ma ta kolo maama na ke to ba bere‑o.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta‑o ba we, “Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o kwei tega kam mo o pa debam. Jei sem konto nɔɔna bam maama tiini ba fom mo debam ŋwaane, ye ba yera sae vare-vare.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Ba déem ma maŋe dáane ba peini ye tega poore. Josua dedaane Isarele tiina bam maama ma gwoni tega ba zaŋe Sitim ne ba vo ba yi Jɔdan buga kam. Ba ma tei ba vwoa ye ba laam cheigi maŋa kalo ba na wó bɛ buga kam to.

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: Abam ta na wo tɔge chwoŋa kanto to, Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam mo wó bere abam chwoŋa. Nam ta‑á yei á tete se á yé tiini á yi ka yera. Ta‑á ye dáa dáa se ko maŋe de naba-laara moro laŋa.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Josua laam ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Kwɛ-na á tete, se ko maŋe de Wɛ na lage tei to, kokuri Baŋa Wɛ jwa lage o ke wo-kenkagela mo á tetare ne.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Josua ta ma ta de kaanem tiina bam o we, “Kwei-na ni-gwonim dakaa kam á zeŋe, se á tɔge dé maama yiga se dé bɛ Jɔdan buga kam.” Ba de ma kwei-ka ba to nɔɔna bam yiga ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: Dento dɛ dem ne mo Baŋa Wɛ tage de Josua o we, “Ko zege zem se ko taa via, a lage a pa se nmo ji nɔn-yuu mo Isarele tiina maama wone. Leile konto mo ba lage ba lɔre we, amo wo nmo de tei ne, nenɛɛne a déem na wora de Moses tei to.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Nam ta de kaanem tiina balo na zeŋe amo ni-gwonim dakaa kam to se ba ná yi buga kam ni dem se ba zo na bam wone. Ba laam maa wó vo fee ba maŋe da ba zege.”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Josua de ma ta dedaane nɔɔna bam maama o we, “Ba-na ywo-seeni se á cheigi abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na jege kolo se o ta de abam to.

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Abam zem wó lɔre we, Wɛ wolo na jege ŋwea to wora de abam. Wonto mo lage o zeili Kanaan tiina bam, de Hiti tiina bam, de Hivi tiina bam, de Pɛrizi tiina bam, de Giragasi tiina bam, de Amori tiina bam, dedaane Jebusi tiina bam maama se ba nwoŋi ba daare tega kam ba pa abam.

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Dakaa kanto ye Baŋa Wɛ wolo na tei logo baŋa maama to nyem mo. Kaanem tiina balo na zeŋe-ka to maa ná nɔne ba nɛ Jɔdan buga kam wone, na balo na duri ba tui to wó kɔ, ye ba tigisi daane nenɛɛne kabira dwoŋi.”

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Bene maama wone, ko ná yeini ko yi wodiiru zagem maŋa, Jɔdan buga kam yeini ka su mo ka wɛɛle ka nia yam maama ne. De konto maama de, kaanem tiina balo na zeŋe ni-gwonim dakaa kam to na yɔɔre ba nɔne ba nɛ buga kam wone to,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam na zeŋe dakaa kam to de yɔɔre ba zege buga kam tetare ne mo. Ba maa zege te-kora baŋa ne taa, se ko taa nii maŋa kalo Isarele kɔgɔ kom maama na bɛ ba ti to.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama na bɛ Jɔdan buga kam ba ti to mo Baŋa Wɛ tage de Josua o we,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: Banto wó vo mɛ kaanem tiina bam na zege buga kam tetare ne to, ba kwei kandwa-kamuna fuga-yalei. Ba laam maa wó ja-ya ba nwoŋi ba vo ba tigisi jei selo abam na wó chwi á vwoa zem tete ne to.”

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
