translation_verse: Jehoyada ma pa jar-keira dedɛɛra bam ni o we, “Ja-na Atalia á nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone á ke‑o babɛ sem gena tetare ne. Nɔɔno ná kwaane se o woli‑o, se á kwei se-zɔɔ á go kotu.” Kokuri to, Jehoyada ya maŋe o ta we, ba yé go Atalia Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone.

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Ba ma zi Atalia ba ja ba nwoŋi ba vo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Ba ma pa o tɔge manchwoŋo ni mɛ sisei na tɔge da se zoore nabwoo kom to, ye ba daare ba go‑o jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada ma pa se pɛ wom de nɔɔna bam maama gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ we, ba wó taa ye Baŋa Wɛ tete nɔɔna. O ta ma pa se pɛ wom de nɔɔna bam gwoni ni ba pa daane.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Judah nɔn-bia bam déem ma vo ba zo Baal jwoni diga kam ba yigi ka maama ba de tega ne, ba daare ba chochoge kaanem bimbina yam de jwoni kamwaro tem maama. Ko ta ná ye Baal kaanem tu Matan, ba jaane‑o bimbina yam takeiri ne mo ba go. Jehoyada déem ma pa se nɔɔna zege ba yere Baŋa Wɛ diga kam.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: O laam ma tɔge de babɛ sem yiga tiina, de Kariti jar-keira bam, de pɛ sɔŋɔ yerena bam, ko ta woli de teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama, se ba vo ba ja pɛ Joasa ba ja ba nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba ma ja‑o ba vo ba tɔge babɛ ni dem ba zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Joasa ma vo o jeini paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɛ Joasa ŋwea maama wone o totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada na zamese‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye wɛleere jene pɛɛra yam, de wɛleere saarem pɛɛra yam, ba wo jaane yanto ba zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. Yanto maama ye Wɛ kaanem tiina bam nyem mo.

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: De ko de, o wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yalo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna déem ta ma yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Joasa déem na di paare ye o ke bena finlei-yatɔ to, Wɛ kaanem tiina bam ta wo wane ba kwɛ Wɛ diga kam de fenfee de.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo, Joasa bwoŋi Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Jehoyada de kaanem tiina badwonna bam o bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ke ye abam ta wo kwɛ Wɛ diga kam? Daa á yé ta‑á jwoŋi-na sabu á sabu-tiŋina bam tei ne á di, ne ko ná dae Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm yerane ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam ma sɛ we ba daa bá jwoŋi sabu nɔɔna bam tei ne. Ba ma kwei Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm totoŋa yam ba pa nɔɔna badwonna.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Jehoyada ma kwei dakaa o puri bɔɔne ka ni-pugu kom yera ne, o daare o ja-ka o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wo. O ma kwei-ka o zege kaanem bimbini dem jazem seeni. Wɛ kaanem tiina balo na yere Wɛ diga kam ni to wó jwoŋi sabia balo nɔɔna na jaane ba ba se ba pa Wɛ to ba ke dakaa kam wone.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo maama ba na maane we sabu kom su dakaa kam, pɛ sɔŋɔ tɔn-poponno wom de Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu wom mo wó ke daane ba kwei sabu kom ba jeeli ko ni ba kwei ba ke ywollu wone.

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: ko woli de kandwa-cherena. Ba maa ta wó ma sabu kom ba yeigi da-kwollu de kandwa yalo ba na yare peo yera ne to se ba ma ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ba daare ba ŋwe kwora yalo maama ta na wora totoŋe dem ŋwaane to.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Sabu kolo nɔɔna déem na jaane ba ba ba tiŋi Wɛ diga kam ne to, ba wo sɛ se ba kwei-ko ba ma ba mɔ lu-nyenno zon-tanlɛ, de min-zwonnu kwɛɛm fane, de zwe, de nabwanno, naa sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno wonnu telo maama na maŋe se te taa zege Wɛ diga kam ne to.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa ne mo Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli déem vei o kwaare jara de Gafa tiina. O ma wane teo kom o di. O ma zege dáane o daa vo se o kwaare jara de Jerusalem tiina.

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Joasa ma kwaleme lonne wonnu telo maama o kwoa Jehosafate, de Jehoram, de Ahazia na kwei ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to, de telo o tete na kwei o pa Wɛ to, ko ta woli de sabu-seŋa jejegero telo na tigi Wɛ diga kam de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone to. O ma kwei te maama o toŋe o pa Hazayeli se o ma o ware‑o. Hazayeli laam ma yage jara yam o kɛ o daare Jerusalem.

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Joasa déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra balo na ke konto to maa ye Simeafi bu Jozabad, de Somera bu Jehozabadi. Ba ma kwei Joasa ba suli o kwoa bam yibeeli ne David teo Jerusalem ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Amazia ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Ahazia bu Joasa paare dim bena finlei-yatɔ bene dem wone mo Jehu bu Jehohaza déem di Isarele teo paare. O ma jeini Samaria ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-yarepɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: Elisa ma ta de pɛ wom o we, “Pore takworo ni delo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni to.” O ma seene o ke konto. Elisa ma ta ded‑o se o ta chene, ye o seene o ke konto. Elisa ma ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wɔnɔ chene dem mo konto! Ko bere we Siria tiina bam wó to jara wone. Kokuri to, nmo wó yɔɔre n chɔge Siria jar-keira bam maama Afeka ne.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo de o na ke wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo. O wo sɛ se o yage.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri Baŋa Wɛ bane tiini de zaŋe Isarele tiina baŋa ne. O déem pɛ se Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli de o bu Ben-hadadi di dam ba baŋa ne taa.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Jehohaza ma lwoori yibwona Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ o wɛ-lworo kom, o na maane we Siria teo pɛ mo jege Isarele tiina bam o bɛɛsa dedɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Joasa paare dim bena fintɔ-yarepɛ bene dem wone mo Jehohaza bu Jehoasa déem di Isarele teo paare. O ma jeini Samaria ne o di paare dem o ke bena fuga-yaredo.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehohaza déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o bembɛɛne dem maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Elisa ma ta ded‑o se o saŋe taŋa kam. O na lage o ta konto to mo Elisa jaane pɛ wom jea.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehoasa déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o na ke baare o kwaare jara de Judah teo pɛ Amazia tei to maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Jehoasa ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli mɛ ba na suli Isarele tiina pwa badwonna bam Samaria ne to. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Jeroboam ma leiri o di paare dem.

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa déem ta na ŋwe to, jaweo ya mo jaane Wɛ sampwora Elisa ye ko ga fee se o te. O weelem dem maŋa ne Jehoasa ma vo o tei se o ware‑o. O ma zege Elisa yiga ne o ka yi-na ye o we, “Amo kwo! Amo kwo! Isarele jar-keira torokooro tem de te sisein-dira bam laam wó ke tɛ mo?”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Elisa daa ta ma ta de pɛ wom o we, “Kwei che-tɛɛra yalo na daare to.” Pɛ wom ma kwei-ya. Elisa ma ta ded‑o o we, “Fere-ya tega ne.” Pɛ wom ma fere chena yam tega ne kuni betɔ ye o yage.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tontoŋeno Elisa bane ma zaŋe ded‑o ye o we, “Nmo ya wó fere-ya tega ne kuni benu naa beredo mo. Konto mo ya wó pa se n wane n chɔge Siria tiina bam maama nyɔ. Ko nam na ye tei to, nmo lage n di-ba kuni betɔ yerane mo.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Elisa déem ma te ye ba kwei‑o ba suli. Ben-doore maama wone Moaba teo pawe-nyena mo yeini ba zo Isarele tega kam ba vuvugi nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe Isarele tiina badwonna déem mo jaane ba too ba vo se ba suli. Ba ma na Moaba tiina pawe-nyena na beene de kɔgɔ tei to. Ba ma ke lela ba kwei too wom ba dole ba yage Elisa yibeeli dem ne ye ba daare ba duri. Too wom yera na yɔɔre ya dwei Elisa kwi sem to, mo o bi o zaŋe o zega.

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo maama Jehohaza déem na ye pɛ to mo Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli tiini o bɛɛse Isarele tiina bam.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yiga nam wo Isarele tiina bam wone pa se o duri ba yibwona, o na gwoni ni delo de ba nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob to ŋwaane. De zem maama Baŋa Wɛ wo sɛ se o chɔge-ba o ti, naa se o zeili-ba o tei ne.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli ma ba o te. O bu Ben-hadadi ma leiri o yuu ne o di paare.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Jehohaza bu Jehoasa ma wane Ben-hadadi o di, pa se o jwoori o ja teene delo Hazayeli déem na vere Jehohaza tei ne to o tei. Kuni betɔ mo Jehoasa wane o di Ben-hadadi, ye o daare o jwoori o jwoŋi Isarele teene dem konto.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Jeroboam déem mo jwoori o jwoŋi tega kalo na zege Lebo-Hamafa ne ka tole ka yi Yɛ naneo kom to o pa Isarele tiina bam. Keim dem konto tɔge kwora kalo Isarele tiina Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na wuuri o pa Amitayi bu Jonah to. Wonto déem ye Wɛ sampwora kalo na nwoŋi Gafa-Hefera to.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Jehohaza bu Jehoasa paare dim bena yalei bene dem wone mo Joasa bu Amazia déem di Judah teo paare.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo. O wo sɛ se o yage wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: O totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, ye o totoŋ-laaro nam wo yi o nabaaro David déem na ke tei to. O déem yɔɔre o kwei o kwo Joasa totoŋ-naga mo.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: De ko de, Amazia wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yalo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna déem yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne ye ba wo yage.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: O na yɔɔre o jeini paare dem baŋa ne to, o ma go nɔɔna balo déem na jaane o kwo ba go to.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: O nam wo pɛ ba go nɔn-gora bam konto bia bam. O déem sɛ ni delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses to. Ni dem konto bere we, “Kwoa ba jege se ba te ba bia kikia ŋwaane. Bia de nam ba jege se ba te ba kwoa kikia ŋwaane. Nɔɔno ná maŋe se o te, ko wó taa ye o tete yuu lwarem ŋwaane mo.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nmo na seene n wane n di Edom tiina bam to mo pɛ se n cho n vɔna konto. Nam ya maŋe n sɔŋɔ ne se n ta‑n chaka. Bɛ mo ye n boŋe se n vaare lɛɛro n yage nmo tete yuu ne de Judah tiina de yuu ne?”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Pɛ Jehoasa ma jwoori o toŋe kwora o pa Judah teo pɛ Amazia o we, “Sabara kadwoŋi mo zege Lebanon ne ka toŋe kwora ka pa Sedare tei-zɔŋɔ Lebanon ne ka we, ‘Kwei n bukɔ wom n pa a bu se o di o ma o ke kaane.’ Konto nɛ sem ni ne mo ga-varem zege Lebanon ne ka nɔne sabara kam ka chɔge.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Amazia ma se o zwa de taane dem konto. Ko kwaga ne Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa ma la o jar-keira o ke daane ye ba vo ba kwaare jara de Amazia Judah teo Bɛte-Semesa ne.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Isarele jar-keira bam ma wane ba di Amazia de o nɔɔna bam pa se ba maama duri ba jwoori ba sam.

english_verse: and Jehoash captured Amaziah. Jehoash then marched to Jerusalem and broke down the city wall from Ephraim Gate to Corner Gate, a section nearly
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Jehoasa ma ja Amazia Bɛte-Semesa ne. Jehoasa ta ma daare o vo Jerusalem o bwori teo kom kabira kalo na zege Efrayim Ni dem ne se ka vo ka yi Gugworo Ni dem to. Ka laŋa kam déem ye naba-laara bia yalei mo.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehoasa déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o na kwaare jara de Judah teo pɛ Amazia tei to maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam maama ma kuri Azaria se o leiri o kwo Amazia yuu ne o ji pɛ. Ba na tiŋi‑o paare konto to, Azaria déem jege bena fuga-yaredo mo.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: O kwo Amazia toone dem kwaga seeni mo Azaria fɔge o lɔ Elafa teo pa se Judah tiina bam tei-ko. Isarele teo pɛ Jeroboam II taane

english_verse: Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Joasa bu Amazia paare dim bena fuga-yanu bene dem wone mo Jehoasa bu Jeroboam déem di Isarele teo paare. O ma jeini Samaria ne o di paare dem o ke bena finna-dedwe.

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ya maane Isarele tiina bam maama na nɛ cham tei to. Ba maama tiini ba yaare dedɛ, ko ná ye balo na ye kabɛ, de balo na tei ba tete to maama de. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno déem tera se o woli-ba.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam tɔge Jehoasa bu Jeroboam baŋa ne mo se o jwoŋi-ba o yage. Kokuri to Baŋa Wɛ wo tage we, o wó saare Isarele tiina bam yere logo baŋa maama ne.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jeroboam déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, de o totoŋa yam, de o bembɛɛne dem, ko woli de o na jwoori o jwoŋi Damasika de Hamafa teene dem o ke Isarele tiina bam jeŋa ne tei to maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Pekahia déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. Isarele teo pɛ Peka taane

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Azaria paare dim bena finnu bene dem wone mo Menahem bu Pekahia déem di Isarele teo paare. O jeini Samaria ne mo o di paare dem bena yalei.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: O totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, nenɛɛne o kwo Amazia na ke tei to.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: De ko de, o wo wane o chɔge wara-jei selo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna déem yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne ye ba wo yage.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa se naywaane jaweo kom lɔgese Pɛ Azaria. O dɛ de jaweo kom konto mo o vo o te. O déem zoore sɔŋɔ kolo na ye dáa dáa to wone mo. O bu Jotam ma leiri o nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom de teo kom nɔn-bia baŋa ne o pa‑o.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Azaria déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Azaria ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o kwoa bam yibeeli seeni David teo Jerusalem ne. O bu Jotam ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. Isarele teo pɛ Zekaria taane

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Azaria paare dim bena fintɔ-nana bene dem wone mo Jeroboam bu Zekaria déem di Isarele teo paare. O jeini Samaria ne mo o di paare dem chane seredo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Jabese bu Salum déem ke chichuŋu de Zekaria. O ma vo o li‑o Ibeleyam ne de jara o go. O ma daare o leiri o di paare dem.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: O toone dem konto ma pa se Baŋa Wɛ kwora kalo o na pɛ Jehu to ji chega, de o na tage o we, “Nmo dwi delo na wó saŋe n kwaga to wó di Isarele teo paare dem se ko taa vei dwia yana wɛɛne.” Isarele teo pɛ Salum taane

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Yuzia paare dim bena fintɔ-nogo bene dem wone mo Jabese bu Salum déem di Isarele teo paare. O jeini Samaria ne mo o di paare dem chana dedoa yerane.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Azaria paare dim bena fintɔ-nogo bene dem wone mo Gadi bu Menahem déem di Isarele teo paare. O jeini Samaria ne mo o di paare dem o ke bena fuga.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga. O paare dim maŋa kam maama wone o yɔɔre o ke wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to mo.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ Pulu déem cheiŋi Isarele tega kam mo. Pɛ Menahem ma kwei lu-nyenno na yi ywollu moro dedoa (

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: O totoŋa ma su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, nenɛɛne o kwo Yuzia déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Menahem déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Menahem ma te ye ba kwei‑o ba suli. O bu Pekahia ma leiri o di paare dem. Isarele teo pɛ Pekahia taane

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: Pekahia déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga. O ma yɔɔre o ke wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: O déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga. O ma yɔɔre o ke wɛleera dwi delo Nebat bu Jeroboam déem na ke pa se Isarele tiina de da ba ke to.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo Peka déem na ye Isarele teo pɛ to, mo Asiria teo pɛ Tigilaf-Pilesa tu o zo tega kam o wane Isarele teene dedwonna o jwoŋi o tei. Teene dem konto déem ye: Yijon, de Abel Bɛte-Maaka, de Janoa, de Kedesa, de Hazora. O déem ta wane Gilead, de Galili, de Nafitali laŋa kam maama. O ma daare o ja jei sem konto nɔn-bia bam o vo o yage Asiria teo ne.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Konto na ke to, Ela bu Hosea ma vo o ke chichuŋu de Remalia bu Peka. O ma li‑o de jara o go o daare o leiri o di paare dem. Yuzia bu Jotam paare dim bena finlei bene dem wone mo konto.

english_verse: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Jotham of Judah (
translation_verse: Peka déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone. Judah teo pɛ Jotam taane

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Peka wolo na ye Remalia bu to paare dim bena yalei bene dem wone mo Yuzia bu Jotam déem di Judah teo paare.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: De ko de, o wo wane o chɔge wara-jei selo ba na ke kaanem da to. Nɔɔna bam déem yeini ba ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra jei sem konto ne. Ko ye Jotam mo fɔge o lɔ Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ni delo na wo baŋa seeni to.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Jotam déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Ko ye o paare dim maŋa kam ne mo Baŋa Wɛ bobo se o toŋe Siria teo pɛ Rezin, de Remalia bu Peka se ba li Judah teo de jara.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Jotam ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o kwoa yibeeli ne o nabaaro David teo Jerusalem ne. O bu Ahaz ma leiri o di paare.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia bu Peka paare dim bena fuga-yarepɛ bene dem wone mo Jotam bu Ahaz déem di Judah teo paare.

english_verse: Uriah did everything Ahaz told him.
translation_verse: Yuria ma seene o ke ne Pɛ Ahaz na tage tei to.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: O déem tusi de o na kwei Isarele teo pwa bam totoŋ-naga tei to. O ma ja o tete bu o zwɛ o ma o ke kaanem. O keim dem konto bere we o lwoni totoŋ-zɔɔna yalo dwi-gɛ tiina na ke ye Wɛ zeili-ba tega kam ne o daare o pa Isarele tiina bam jeini to mo.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye wara-jei bimbina yam baŋa ne, de zwonnu tem baŋa ne, de teeni maama kuri ne, o déem yeini o ke kaanem de zwɛɛm pɛɛra mo jei sem konto maama ne.

english_verse: While Ahaz was ruling Judah, the king of Edom recaptured the town of Elath from Judah and forced out the people of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath, and they still live there. About the same time, King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel marched to Jerusalem and attacked, but they could not capture it.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne mo Siria teo pɛ Rezin déem zeili Judah tiina balo na zoore Elafa ne to o jwoori o ke teo kom o tete nɔɔna jeŋa ne. Edom tiina laam ma vo ba zoore Elafa ne ye ba ta wora de zem maama.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Pɛ Ahaz ma toŋe o tontoŋena se ba vo ba ta de Asiria teo pɛ Tigilaf-Pilesa we, “Amo ye nmo tontoŋeno mo ye a yɔɔre a sɛ a pa‑m. A nam lwoori‑m se n ba n jwoŋi-ne n yage Siria tiina de Isarele tiina bam jeŋa ne, ba na tu ba li amo de jara to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Ahaz ta ma kwei lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa wonnu telo na wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to dedaane telo na wo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone to o toŋe o pa Asiria pɛ wom.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ ma sɛ. O ma vo o kwaare jara de Damasika o wane-ko. O ma ja ko nɔn-bia bam o vo o yage Kiri teo ne o daare o go Pɛ Rezin.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Pɛ Ahaz déem ma vo Damasika se o ware Asiria teo pɛ Tigilaf-Pilesa. O na wo teo kom wone konto to mo o nɛ kaanem bimbini ba na lɔge ba zege da. O ma kwei bimbini dem nyenyego o toŋe o pa Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Yuria se o wane o lɔre ko na ye tei to chekke.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Yuria de ma lɔ bimbini dem dwoŋi se de yɔɔre de maŋe de nyenyego kom. O ma lɔ-de o ti ye Ahaz laam zege Damasika ne o jwoori.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Ahaz na jwoori o ba ye o na bimbini dem to, o ma yi de yera o ke kaanem de baŋa ne.

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: O déem ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de wodiu pɛɛra kaanem mo. O ma lwo wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra o ke da ye o daare o kwei yazura kaanem jana bam o miisi bimbini dem yera ne.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: O ma ta de Wɛ kaanem tu Yuria o we, “Ko ná ye bimbin-kamunu kolo dé laam na lɔge to, ta‑n ke zezeŋa maama zwɛɛm kaanem, de dedaan-ni maŋa maama wodiu pɛɛra yam de baŋa ne. Ta ke pɛ wom tete zwɛɛm kaanem dem, de o wodiu pɛɛra yam, ko woli de nɔɔna bam maama zwɛɛm kaanem, de ba wodiu pɛɛra, de ba wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yam maama bimbin-doore dem baŋa ne. Ta daare n kwei kaanem dem maama jana bam n miisi bimbini dem yera ne. Ko nam ná ye channa bimbini dem, amo wó taa mae dento a fɔge a yiga.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Pɛ Ahaz déem ma le channa wonnu telo na meeli ware-zwe zegem torokooro tem sɛ sem ne to. O ta ma le ware-zwe sem tete. Ko ná ye channa ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Naneo kom’ to, o ta ma zoore-ka ka na zege channa nabɛ selo baŋa ne to. O ma daare o kwei-ka o zege kandwɛ-polɔgɔ baŋa ne.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Ahaz ta ma gɔ vwei delo ba ya na pugi wara-jei sem ne siu dɛ ŋwaane to. O ta ma daare o se manchwoŋo ni delo ba ya na pore se pɛ wom taa tɔge da o zoore Wɛ diga kam wone to. Ahaz déem ke konto maama se ko pwoli Asiria teo pɛ wom wo mo.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Ahaz déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Ahaz paare dim bena fuga-yalei bene dem wone mo Ela bu Hosea déem di Isarele teo paare. O jeini Samaria ne mo o di paare dem bena nogo.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: Hosea déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga. O totoŋ-lwanno tem nam daa wo yi Isarele pwa balo na dɛ yiga ba di paare dem to.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ Salemanesa déem ma vo o kwaare jara de Isarele teo pɛ Hosea. Konto ŋwaane mo Hosea déem wo o dam kuri ne ye Isarele tiina bam yeini ba ŋwe lampwoo ba pa‑o bene maama wone.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Asiria pɛ wom déem nam maane we Hosea lɔge o kwaga ne mo de o na toŋe nɔɔna Ejipti teo pɛ Soo tei ne se ba sɔ ni daane to. Hosea ma daare o ve se o daa taa ŋwe lampwoo o pa Asiria pɛ wom, ne o ya na ke tei bene maama wone to. Konto ŋwaane Pɛ Salemanesa ma ja‑o o vo o pe peena diga ne.

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Hosea paare dim bena nogo bene dem wone mo Salemanesa wane o di Samaria teo kom. O ma ja Isarele tiina bam o vo o yage Asiria ne. O jaane ba badwonna o vo o yage Hala ne, de Gozan jei selo na wo Habora buga kam ni ne to. O ta ma ja ba badaara o vo o yage teene delo Media tiina na zoore da to. Ko na ke tei ye Isarele tiina bam na chɔgem to

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Tento maama déem kea Isarele tiina bam na ke wɛleera ba chɔge ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yiga to ŋwaane mo. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo jaane-ba o nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne mɛ ba ya na wo ko Pa-faro dam kuri ne to. Ba ma yeini ba zuli wa-yɔɔro mo,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: ba daare ba lwoni chullu telo dwi-gɛ tiina na yeini ba ke ye Wɛ zeili-ba tega kam ne o daare o pa Isarele tiina bam jeini to. Ba daa ta ma tɔge keim-balwaaro telo Isarele pwa bam déem na jege ba ke to.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem seigi mo ba toŋe lwarem ba chɔge ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga. Ba lɔge wara-jei mo se ba taa maa ke kaanem ba teene maama wone, ko ná maŋe ko ye teo balaŋa de teo kamunu maama wone de.

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: Ba déem ta chwi kandwa de Asera nyenyego dɛ ba zege zwonnu maama yuu ne de teeni maama kuri ne se ba taa zuli-te.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra ba zuli jwona yam, nenɛɛne dwi-gɛ tiina ya na ke tei ye Wɛ zeili-ba tega kam ne o daare o pa Isarele tiina bam jeini to. Konto to, ba déem ke wo-zɔɔna yalo na chuchugi Baŋa Wɛ bane to mo.

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam ya pɛ-ba ni o we, ba yé taa zuli jwona. De ko de, ba ta ke konto mo.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Kuni dedɛ mo Baŋa Wɛ déem tɔge o sampwori de o yi-nara baŋa ne o kaane Isarele tiina bam de Judah tiina bam o we, “Nam yage-na á keim-balwaaro tem, se á daare á sɛ amo ni-kaana yam de a bera yam. Yanto maama ye nia yalo amo déem na pɛ á nabaara bam se ba taa tɔge to mo. A ma daare a tɔge a tontoŋena bam baŋa ne a bere abam de.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: De ko de, Isarele tiina bam wo sɛ Baŋa Wɛ ni dem. Ba bochara digili mo, ne ba nabaara bam déem na ke tei ye ba ve ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ to.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Ba déem ve se ba taa tɔge o nia yam, de ni-gwonim delo o na ke de ba nabaara bam to. Ba ma daare ba ve o ni-kaana yam de. Ba ma zuli jwo-yɔɔro pa se ba de ji nɔn-kayɛ. Ba ma lwoni dwi-gɛ tiina balo na gilimi-ba to kikia. Baŋa Wɛ ya maŋe o kaane-ba se ba yé lwoni banto kikia.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Ba yiga déem tera de ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam. Ba ma kwei luu ba ma ba mɔ na-mɔre selei kamwaro, ba daare ba ke Asera nyenyego daa se ba zuli-te. Ba ta ma kuni dwoona ba zuli chalechwe sem de Baal jwoni dem.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane na tiini de zaŋe Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne konto to, o ma zeili-ba o yiga ne. Judah dwi tiina bam yerane mo daare.

english_verse: but they also disobeyed the Lord's commands and acted like the Israelites.
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam de déem wo sɛ ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam. Ba ma kwei Isarele tiina bam totoŋ-naga ye ba ke lwarem.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem na pɔɔre Isarele dwi dem o ja nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem jeŋa ne to mo Isarele tiina bam kwei Nebat bu Jeroboam ba tiŋi‑o paare. Jeroboam ma soge Isarele tiina bam pa se ba ywori Baŋa Wɛ chwoŋa kam ne, ye ba fɔge ba zo wɛleera dedɛ wone.

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: Ba ke konto mo taa ye Baŋa Wɛ laam zeili-ba o yiga ne. O déem maŋe o tɔge o sampwori sem baŋa ne o kaane-ba we, o wó ke konto mo. Mo kokuri Isarele tiina dona bam jaane-ba ba nwoŋi ba tete tega kam ne ba vo Asiria. Dáane mo ba ta wora de zem maama. Asiria tiina na nɛ jeiŋa jei Samaria ne

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ déem ma ja nɔɔna badwonna ya na zoore Babilon ne, de Kufa ne, de Awa ne, de Hamafa ne, dedaane Sefavayim ne to o ba o yage Samaria ne se banto leiri Isarele tiina bam yuu ne ba taa zoore da. Nɔɔna bam konto ma lɛɛre ba tei Samaria laŋa kam ye ba zoore ka teene dem wone.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Ba na bobo se ba taa zoore da to, ba wo kɔre Baŋa Wɛ. Baŋa Wɛ ma pa nywonnu zo ba wone pa se te go ba badwonna.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma ta ba bere Asiria teo pɛ ba we, “Nɔɔna bam nmo na jaane n ba n jeini Samaria teene dem wone to yeiri tega kam konto wɛ dem chullu tem. Konto ŋwaane mo wɛ dem konto pɛ se nywonnu zo ba wone ye te go ba badwonna.”

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Asiria pɛ wom ma pa ni dento o we, “Le-na nɔɔno dedoa Samaria kaanem tiina balo dé na jaane dé ba ywo to wone á daare á pa se o jwoori o vo o taa zoore o tete tega kam ne. Kotu laam wó wane o bere nɔɔna bam se ba lɔre tega kam wɛ dem chullu tem na ye tei to.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba ma seene ba pa Samaria kaanem tiina dedoa jwoori o vo o zoore Bɛtel ne. O ma bere nɔɔna bam ba na wó taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ tei to.

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Babilon tiina bam na mɔɔne jwoni delo to yere mo Sukof-Benofi. Kufa tiina bam jwoni dem yere maa ye Nɛgale. Hamafa tiina bam de maa kaane Asima.

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: Awa tiina bam maa kaane Nibaza de Tataka jwona yam. Sefavayim tiina bam maa yeini ba zwɛ ba bia ba ma kaane ba jwona Aderamɛlɛka de Anamɛlɛka.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Konto to, ba déem zuli Baŋa Wɛ ye ba ta vei ba zuli ba tete teene dem jwona, ne ba tete dwi tiina na yeini ba tɔge chullu telo to mo.

english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: De zem maama, nɔɔna bam ta wo yage ba faŋa chullu tem. Ba ba yɔɔre ba kɔre Baŋa Wɛ. Ba maa ba sɛ Baŋa Wɛ bera yam, de o chullu tem, de o nia yam, ne o déem na kwei o pa Jakob dwi tiina bam se ba taa tɔge to. Jakob yere dem konto mo Baŋa Wɛ déem leiri pa de ji Isarele.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem gwoni ni de Isarele dwi tiina bam, ye o kaane-ba we, “Abam daa á yé zuli-na wa yadwonna á woli amo wone. Á ba jege se á tiiri jwona yiga ne, naa á zuli-ya, naa á kaane-ya.

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: Á nam yé swei a na gwoni ni delo de abam to. Yé kɔre-na wa yadwonna á woli amo wone.

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: Á nam jege se á kɔre á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yerane mo. Ko ye wonto mo wó vere abam á dona maama jea ne o yage.”

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam nam wo sɛ Wɛ ni dem konto, ye ba ta ke ne ba na maŋe ba ke tei faŋa to.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: O totoŋa ma su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, nenɛɛne o nabaaro David déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: O déem yɔɔre o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yam mo o dole o yage. O ta ma guri kandwa yalo ba ya na chugi ba jege ba kaane to o chochoge, o daare o gwoni Asera nyenyego dɛ sem o de tega ne. Ko ta ná ye channa basankwea kalo Moses déem na mɔɔne o zege to, o ma chochoge-ka bɛŋwaane Isarele tiina bam yeini ba ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra mo ba ma kaane-ka. Ba déem pɛ ko yere we ‘Nehusitan’ mo.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: O ma yɔɔre o sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne, ye o wo ywori o chwei sem ne. O déem tɔge Baŋa Wɛ nia yalo o na pɛ Moses to chekke.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ de maa wo Hezekia tei ne, pa se o na yiga-veiŋa o totoŋa maama wone. O ma lɔ Asiria teo pɛ kwaga ne, ye o wo sɛ o pa‑o.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Hezekia paare dim bena yana bene dem wone mo Asiria teo pɛ Salemanesa de o jar-keira vei ba li Samaria teo kom ba ba pu de jara. Isarele teo pɛ Ela bu Hosea paare dim bena yarepɛ bene dem wone mo konto.

english_verse: The king of Assyria took the Israelites away as prisoners; he forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ ma le Isarele tiina bam o ja o vo o yage Hala ne, de Gozan jei selo na wo Habora buga kam ni ne to, dedaane teene delo Media tiina na zoore da to.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: Tento maama déem ke Isarele tiina bam, ba na wo sɛ ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam to ŋwaane mo. Ba ma chɔge ni delo o na gwoni de-ba to. Ba maa wo sɛ nia yalo Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses déem na kwei o pa-ba to. Ba bere ba wo cheigi-ya. Ba maa wo sɛ se ba tɔge-ya de. Asiria teo pɛ ke chichuŋu de Judah tiina

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, amo ta wó ja abam a vo a yage tega kalo na nye de abam tete tega kam to baŋa ne. Dáane Vini teeni wora se á na sana á nyɔ, de mena se á ma á ke bworobworo. Olivi teeni nuga, dedaane tooro dedɛ de maa wo dáane. Kuri-na ŋwea á leiri toone yuu ne! Yé cheigi-na pɛ Hezekia taane dem, de o na gane abam ye o we, Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi abam o yage to.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Ba na jeeri to mo Asiria teo pɛ dedɛɛra yiga tu wom taga de-ba se ba ja Asiria pɛ wom kwora ba vo ba ta de Pɛ Hezekia. O maa we: “Asiria Pa-faro wom we: Bɛ mo bere ko pa se n jege n tete chega konto?

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Nmo nam ta ná we, ‘Dé wó sale debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ yera ne mo,’ ko dae Wɛ dem konto wara-jei de kaanem bimbina mo Hezekia guri o yage o daare o pa ni se Jerusalem de Judah nɔɔna maama taa tui bimbini dem na wo Jerusalem ne ywo-seeni to yerane ba zuli‑o na?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hezekia paare dim bena fuga-yana bene dem wone mo Asiria teo pɛ Senakeribi tu o li Judah te-kamunnu telo na fɔge te pe to maama de jara. O ma wane-ba o di.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Hezekia ma toŋe kwora o pa Asiria pɛ wom Lakisi teo ne ye o we, “Amo toŋe a tusi nmo yiga ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó ŋwe lampwoo kolo maama nmo na boŋe we ko maŋe to a pa‑m. Nam yage jara yam n daare n viiri.” Asiria pɛ wom ma ta se Hezekia ŋwe lu-nyenno dunni na yi kilo morro fuga (

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne, Hezekia ta ma le sabu-seŋa kalo o ya na mɛ o taare Baŋa Wɛ diga kam bworru tem de ka ywoa yam to o kwei ka maama o pa Asiria pɛ wom.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Asiria pɛ wom ma toŋe o jar-keira yuu tu de o dedɛɛra balei se ba zege Lakisi ne ba nwoŋi de jar-keira kɔgɔ dedɛ ba vo Jerusalem ba gware Hezekia. Ba na yi da to, ba ma vo ba zege na-fera kalo na zoore baŋa seeni chɔgɔ kom to ni ne. Jeiga kam konto bwola de chwoŋa kalo ba na zare gwaaro ka ni ne to mo.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam ma toŋe ba bwoŋi Pɛ Hezekia. Pɛ wom de ma toŋe Hilikia bu Eliakim na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom totoŋa baŋa ne to, dedaane Sebena na ye tɔn-poponno to, ko woli de Asaf bu Joa na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom yera seina twanno baŋa ne to, se ba nwoŋi teo kom wone ba vo ba jeeri-ba.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe we ni-wɛɛle wae jara de ke mo na? Wɔ baŋa ne mo n teege ye n lɔ amo kwaga ne?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Nmo teena wo Ejipti teo ne mo na? Konto nam nye de nɔɔno na kwei kasogo o ji o nacheiga to mo. Kasogo kom wó seere mo ka zɔ wolo maama na zei-ka to jeŋa. Konto mo wó ke wolo maama na sale Ejipti Pa-faro wom yera ne to.

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Eliakim, de Sebena, dedaane Joa maama ma ta de Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom ba we, “Popo ŋɔɔne Aram tiina taane de debam, se dé wó ni. Nmo ná ŋɔɔne de Judah tiina taane dem, balo na dɔge kabira kam yuu ne ba cheigi to wó da ba ni n na tɛ kolo to mo.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Asiria teo yiga tu wom ma leiri-ba o we, “Á boŋe we amo tu kwora kam wora ka pa abam de á pɛ wom yerane mo na? Ko ye balo maama na dɔge kabira kam baŋa ne to de nyem mo. Banto de wó da ba di ba beinnu ba daare ba nyɔ ba fea ne abam na jege se á ke tei to mo.”

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Asiria yiga tu wom ma tɔɔle o yage de Judah tiina taane dem o we: “Abam maama cheigi-na Asiria teo pa-faro wom kwora kam.

english_verse: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Teo kɔ tete jwona mo dana pa se ya wane ya jwoŋi ya teene ya yage Asiria pa-faro wom jeŋa ne?

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Hamafa, de Arapade jwona yam bɛ? Sefavayim, de Hena, dedaane Ivaa jwona yam de nam wo yei ne mo? Ya wane ya vere Samaria tiina ya yage a dam kuri ne na?

english_verse: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?
translation_verse: Teene dem maama jwona yam wone, jwoni dɔ mo wane de jwoŋi de teo de yage amo jeŋa ne? Baŋa Wɛ de nam bá wane o vere Jerusalem o yage amo jeŋa ne.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Hilikia bu Eliakim na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom totoŋa baŋa ne to, de Sebena na ye tɔn-poponno to, dedaane Asaf bu Joa na tiŋi pɛ sɔŋɔ kom yera seina twanno tem to maama ma ja ba gwaaro ba kaare wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ye ba ja kwora kalo Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom na taga to ba vo ba ta de Pɛ Hezekia.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe, o déem ma zo o jwoni Nisiroka diga kam se o zuli-de. O bia balei Aderamɛlɛka, de Sarezera ma zo ba zage‑o ba go de se-zɔɔro. Ba ma duri ba vo Ararati laŋa kam ba zoore da. Senakeribi bu Esara-hadon déem ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hezekia déem na nigi kwora kam to, o wo ma tiini ko chɔge ye o kaare o gwaaro. O ma daare o kwei gare-nyenyaaro o zo ye o vo o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (Isaiah
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye Hamafa, de Arapade, de Sefavayim, de Hena, de Ivaa, teene dento pwa bam de wora na?’ ” Hezekia wɛ-lworo kom

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:
translation_verse: O ma toŋe Eliakim na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom totoŋa baŋa ne to, de Sebena na ye tɔn-poponno to, dedaane Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam se ba zo gare-nyenyaaro ba vo Amozi bu Izaya na ye Wɛ sampwora to tei.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ wom mo toŋe o dedɛɛra yiga tu se o ba o twe Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ. Dɛ delo tento nmo Tu Baŋa Wɛ nigi toro tem konto maama, ye o nam wó bwɛ dedɛɛro wom de o ta-balɔrɔ kom. Nam lwoori Wɛ n pa debam balo fee na daare de maŋe teo kom ne to.”

english_verse: When these leaders went to Isaiah,
translation_verse: Hezekia tontoŋena bam na pɛ Izaya kwora kam ba ti to,

english_verse: he told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: mo Izaya de kwei kwora o pa-ba o we, “Jwoori-na á vo á ta de Pɛ Hezekia we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Yé ta‑n kɔre foone de taane delo Asiria pɛ na tɔge o tontoŋena bam baŋa ne o ma o twe-ne to.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom déem nigi we ba pɛ wom yage Lakisi teo ye o vo se o kwaare jara de Libina teo tiina. O de ma kɛ o vo dáane.

english_verse: About this same time the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne de, Asiria teo Pɛ Senakeribi ta nigi kwora we Tirahaka na ye Kusi teo pɛ to mo beene se o jeeri‑o de jara. O ma toŋe nɔɔna Hezekia tei ne de kwora kanto o we:

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Nmo maŋe n ni Asiria teo pwa bam na toŋe tei de logo baŋa teene maama to. Ba yɔɔre ba chɔge de maama mo. Nmo nam boŋe tetɛ mo ye n teene se n lu?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Teene dedwonna dem jwona wane-de ya jwoŋi ya yage amo nabaara bam jeŋa ne na? A nabaara bam nam chɔge Gozan, de Haran, de Rezefe, de Eden tiina balo déem na zoore Telasara ne to ba ti.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom Asiria teo pɛ tontoŋena bam tei ne, ye o ga-ko. O ma ja-ko o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone o kwei o jare Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Isaiah went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, I heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.
translation_verse: Amozi bu Izaya ma toŋe kwora Pɛ Hezekia tei ne ye o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage kolo to mo tento: Nmo na lwoori amo tei se ko vo Asiria teo pɛ Senakeribi seeni to, a sɛ n wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: He prayed: Lord God of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ ye o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to, nmo paare di cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne mo. Nmo yerane mo ye Wɛ, ye n tei tega baŋa paare dim jei maama. Nmo nam mo naane wɛyuu de tega baŋa.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye chega mo we Asiria teo pwa déem seene ba chɔge teene de de nɔn-bia dedɛ, pa se de ji di-dwonnu yerane.

english_verse: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only God. The Lord's Answer to Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Konto to, dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yɔɔre n jwoŋi debam n yage Asiria teo pɛ jeŋa ne se logo baŋa teene dem maama lɔre we nmo Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo ye Wɛ.” Izaya na leiri pɛ wom tei to Izaya

english_verse: Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Kwora kanto mo Baŋa Wɛ jege se o pa‑o: Zion tiina bam yɔɔre ba neese nmo mo. Jerusalem teo tiina bam jege‑m mo ba mɔna.

english_verse: That same night the Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Tete dem konto ne Baŋa Wɛ maleka déem ma zaŋe ka vo Asiria jar-keira bam na tigisi mɛ to. Ka ma go Asiria tiina morro bi de funɔnɔ-banu (

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And this is how you bragged about yourself: “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Nmo tɔge n tontoŋena baŋa ne mo n twe amo. Nmo ta ma‑n bere n tete n we, ‘Amo pɛ se a sisei-torokooro dedɛ mo di peero tem yuu te yi Lebanon peero tem yuu chekke. A ta ma gwoni ba tei-dedwaaro tem a de tega ne, de ba tei-ŋonno tem maama. A ma vo a yi yiga yiga a zo ba goa mɛ na lini to wone.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Amo ta ma vo a ko vola sa-teene ne yiga yiga, ye a nyɔ na ya wone. A jar-keira bam ma nɔne Ejipti bwi sem de ba napera pa se we.’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all this long ago. And you don't even realize that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Nmo wo nigi we amo maŋe a boŋe boboŋe dem faŋa faŋa mo na?, A na boŋe tei faŋa faŋa konto to mo amo laam pɛ se ko seene ko ke. A boboŋa déem jaane se nmo zaŋe n chɔge teene delo ya na lɔge de pe to se de ji kandwa na dogele da-baŋa ne ya tigi to mo.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.

translation_verse: O ma bwei o we, “Wɔ yibeeli mo tento?” Bɛtel nɔɔna bam ma leiri ba we, “Ko ye mɛ ba na suli Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo déem na nwoŋi Judah ye o ta faŋa faŋa we kolo wó ke bimbini dento Bɛtel ne, ne nmo zem na yɔɔre n ke-de tei to mo.”

english_verse: Josiah replied, “Then leave it alone. Don't dig up his bones.” So they did not disturb his bones or the bones of the old prophet from Israel who had also been buried there.
translation_verse: Josia ma leiri o we, “Nam yage-na yibeeli dento se de taa wora. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé guri o kwi sem.” Ba ma seene ba yage wonto de Wɛ sampwora kalo ya na nwoŋi Samaria to kwi sem.

english_verse: Josiah told the people of Judah, “Celebrate Passover in honor of the Lord your God, just as it says in The Book of God's Law.”

translation_verse: Ba wo fɔge ba di kuri dento dwoŋi ko zege maŋa kalo ne yiga tiina na tei Isarele de Judah tiina bam ye ba ta wo tiŋi pɛ to.

english_verse: Josiah got rid of every disgusting person and thing in Judah and Jerusalem—including magicians, fortunetellers, and idols. He did his best to obey every law written in the book that the priest Hilkiah found in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Josia déem kwaane o kwɛ teo kom se ko tɔge nia yalo maama na popone tɔnɔ kolo wone Wɛ kaanem tu Hilikia na nɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to mo. O ma le chichiri vora, de yi-nara, de wa-yɔɔro, de jwona, de wo-zɔɔna maama pa se ya daa tere Jerusalem de Judah teene dem maama ne.

english_verse: But the Lord was still furious with the people of Judah because Manasseh had done so many things to make him angry.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, Baŋa Wɛ bane déem ta zaŋe mo de Judah tiina bam, Pɛ Manasɛ na tiini o toŋe o chaare ye o chuchugi Wɛ bane to ŋwaane.

translation_verse: Josia déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋa yam maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Judah Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

translation_verse: Josia tontoŋena bam ma kwei o yera yam ba ke toroko ne ba ja ba jwoori Jerusalem. Ba ma suli‑o o tete yibeeli dem ne. Judah tiina bam ma kuri Josia bu Jehohaza ba tiŋi‑o paare se o leiri o kwo wom yuu ne. Judah teo Pɛ Jehohaza taane

translation_verse: O de déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne o nabaara bam ya na ke tei to mo.

english_verse: Jehoiachin immediately surrendered, together with his mother and his servants, as well as his army officers and officials. Then Nebuchadnezzar had Jehoiachin arrested. These things took place in the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's rule in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Jehoyachin, de o nu, de o tontoŋena, de o dedɛɛra, de o nakwa bam maama ma sɛ ba pa Babilon pɛ wom. Babilon pɛ wom ma pa ba ja Jehoyachin ba pe. Konto déem ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza paare dim bena nana bene dem ne mo.

english_verse: The Lord had warned that someday the treasures would be taken from the royal palace and from the temple, including the gold objects that Solomon had made for the temple. And that's exactly what Nebuchadnezzar ordered his soldiers to do.
translation_verse: O ma vere lonne wonnu telo maama na wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne, de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne to o ja o viiri, ne Baŋa Wɛ na wuuri o ta we, ko wó ke tei to. O ma daare o kore sabu-seŋa wonnu telo Isarele teo pɛ Solomon déem na ke o zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to maama o ja o viiri.

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon, along with his mother, his wives, his officials, and the most important leaders of Judah.
translation_verse: Pɛ Nebukadeneza ma ja Jehoyachin, de o nu, de o kaana, de o dedɛɛra, ko woli de Jerusalem teo kom naduna bam maama o vo Babilon.

translation_verse: O ma pa Jehoyachin kwo choro Matania leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ. O ma leiri o yere dem pa se de ye Zedekia. Judah teo Pɛ Zedekia taane Jeremia

english_verse: It was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar. The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he turned his back on them. That's why these horrible things were happening.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro telo maama na ke Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam yera ne to tɔge Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane mo. Ko na kweeli tei to, o le o yiga mo ba baŋa ne. Jerusalem teo na to tei to Jeremia

translation_verse: Babilon tiina bam ma yigi teo kom kabiri sem ba de tega ne, ye ba tɔge pwoli sem ne ba zo ko wo. Zedekia de o jar-keira bam maama déem duri se ba lu tete ne mo. Ba ma kwei pɛ gaare chwoŋa kam, ba vo ba tɔge ni dem na wo teo kabiri selei sem tetare ne to, ye ba laam duri ba tu Jɔdan bwolo kom seeni.

english_verse: but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: De ko de, Babilon tiina jar-keira bam déem pare-ba mo. Ba ma vo ba yi Zedekia se ko maŋe de Jeriko te-kampare sem seeni. O jar-keira bam ma pwɛ da yiga ne, ye ba jage ba daare‑o.

english_verse: About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nebukadeneza déem na di Babilon teo paare o ke bena fuga-nogo bene delo ne to, chane senu chana kam da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne mo o kwaga-saŋeno Nebuzaradan zo Jerusalem teo kom wone. Wonto maa ye Babilon teo babɛ sem yiga tu.

english_verse: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan ma pa ni pa o jar-keira bam yɔɔre ba yigi Jerusalem teo kabiri sem ba de tega ne.

english_verse: He led away as prisoners the people left in the city, including those who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: O ma kale balo ta na daare teo kom wone to, ko ta woli de gwaro ta na daare to, de balo ya na duri ba zo Babilon tiina kɔgɔ kom wone to o ja o vo Babilon.

english_verse: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Babilon tiina bam ma zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ba bwori channa zela yam maama. Yanto maa ye ywoa yalei yam, de ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Naneo kom’ to, de ware-zwe zegem torokooro tem. Ba ma daare ba kwei te channa kam ba zeŋe ba ja ba vo Babilon.

english_verse: They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense,
translation_verse: Ba ta ma kwei zwe selo ba na wó taa mae ba pɛ tentwarem to, de sɛbullu, de wonnu telo na wó fɔge te kwɛ mini dem to, de zwe selo ba na zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa se wone to, de channa wonnu telo maama na jege te fɔge Wɛ diga chullu tem to.

english_verse: The pile of bronze from the columns, the stands, and the large bowl that Solomon had made for the temple was too large to be weighed.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye ywoa yalei yam, de ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kom, dedaane ware-zwe zegem torokooro tem, Pɛ Solomon déem ya pɛ ba mɔ wonnu tem konto maama Baŋa Wɛ diga chullu tem ŋwaane mo. Te yera channa kam déem tiini ka duna ka dwoi se ba maŋe.

english_verse: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
translation_verse: Nebuzaradan déem ta jaane Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Seraya, de o kwaga-saŋeno Zefania, de Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena batɔ bam mo o ja o viiri.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam to rule the few people still living in Judah.
translation_verse: Pɛ Nebukadeneza ma le Ahikam bu Gedalia se o taa nii balo ta na daare Judah laŋa kam ne to. Wonto déem maa ye Safan naa.

english_verse: When the army officers and troops heard that Gedaliah was their ruler, the officers met with him at Mizpah. These men were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from Netophah, and Jaazaniah from Maacah.
translation_verse: Judah teo jar-keira bam de ba yiga tiina na nigi we pɛ wom le Gedalia mo se o taa ye ba teo kom yuu tu to, ba déem ma vo Gedalia tei Mizipa ne. Yiga tiina bam yera mo tento: Netania bu Isameli, de Karea bia Johanan, de Jonatan, de Netofa tu Tanhumefa bu Seraya, de Maaka tu Jazania.

english_verse: Gedaliah said to them, “Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.”
translation_verse: Gedalia ma ke baare ba kuri ne ye o du duuri o ta de-ba o we, “Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de Babilon dedɛɛra bam. Maŋe-na ywo dé teo kom ne, se á sɛ á pa Babilon teo pɛ, se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam.”

english_verse: Ishmael was from the royal family. And about two months after Gedaliah began his rule, Ishmael and ten other men went to Mizpah. They killed Gedaliah and his officials, including those from Judah and those from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Bene dem konto chane serepɛ chana kam wone, mo Netania bu Isameli na ye Elisama naa to déem tɔge de nɔɔna fuga pa ba vo Mizipa. Wonto déem ye pa-diga kam wo nɔɔno mo. translation_verse: Jobaba de na tege to mo, Husam na nwoŋi Teman tiina bam teo kom to leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

translation_verse: Zera bu-baara bam mo tento: Zimiri, de Etan, de Heman, de Kalekole, dedaane Dara. Ba maama ye bakeiri senu.

translation_verse: Karimi déem loge Akane. Wonto pɛ se lɛɛro dedɛ yi Isarele tiina bam, de o na vere wonnu telo na ye Wɛ nyem to o ma chɔge chullu tem.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Etan déem ma lo Azaria.

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hezeron na loge bu-baara balo to mo tento: Jerameeli, de Ram, de Chelubayi.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram ma lo Aminadabi. Aminadabi de ma lo Naason. Wonto déem ye Judah dwi tiina bam dedɛɛro mo.

translation_verse: Naason ma lo Salimon. Salimon ma lo Bowaza.
