translation_verse: Jesse déem loge bukwa balei, ba yera na ye Zeruya, de Abigali. Zeruya ma lo bakeiri setɔ: Abisayi, de Joaba, de Asaheli.

english_verse: Abigail's husband was Jether, who was a descendant of Ishmael, and their son was Amasa. The Descendants of Hezron
translation_verse: Abigali de ma lo Amasa. Amasa kwo déem ye Isameli dwi tu Jefere.

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hezeron bu Kaleb ma swo Azuba o ma ke o kaane. Wonto yere dedwoŋi maa ye Jeriota. Ba déem ma lo bia banto: Jesera, de Sobabi, de Aredon.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Azuba na tege to, mo Kaleb di Eferata. Ba ma lo Hura.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hura de déem ma lo Yuri, ye Yuri lo Bezaleli.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hezeron déem na tege to, o bu Kaleb ma swo o kaane Eferata. Wonto ma lo Asuuri o pa‑o. Asuuri déem mo bobo Tekoa teo kuri.

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hezeron bu-kwea Jerameeli bu-baara bam mo tento: Ram ye o bu-kwea kam mo. Balo na saŋe to maa ye Buna, de Oren, de Ozem, de Ahija.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Jerameeli de déem swo kaane wodwoŋi, o yere mo Atara. Wonto ma lo Onam o pa‑o.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Jerameeli bu-kwea Ram bu-baara bam mo tento: Maazi, de Jamin, de Ekera.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam bu-baara de déem maa ye Samayi, de Jada. Samayi ma lo Nadab, de Abisuri.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Abisuri kaane yere mo Abihali. Wonto ma lo Aaban de Molida o pa‑o.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadab bia déem ye Seleda de Apayim. Seleda maa wo loge bia.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apayim déem loge Yisi. Yisi de ma lo Sesan, ye Sesan lo Aalayi.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Samayi nyaane Jada bia mo tento: Jefere, de Jonatan. Jefere maa wo loge bia.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Jonatan déem loge Peleti de Zaza. Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Jerameeli bia mo.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Sesan ma kwei o bukɔ o pa Jareha se o di o ma ke o kaane. Wonto ma lo Atayi o pa‑o.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Atayi ma lo Natan, ye Natan lo Zabadi.

english_verse: Zabad's descendants included Ephlal, Obed, Jehu, Azariah, Helez, Eleasah, Sismai, Shallum, Jekamiah, and Elishama. The Descendants of Caleb
translation_verse: Salum déem ma lo Jekamia, ye Jekamia lo Elisama.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Heboron bu-baara bam mo tento: Kora, de Tapua, de Rekem, de Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Sema déem ma lo Raham, ye wonto lo Jorakeam. Rekem de ma lo Samayi.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Samayi bu déem maa ye Maon. Maon ma lo Bɛte-Zura.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kaleb ka-bia Efa déem loge Haran, de Moza, de Gazezi o pa‑o. Haran de ma lo bakeira o yere na ye Gazezi to.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Jaadayi bia mo tento: Regem, de Jotam, de Gesan, de Peleti, de Efa, de Saafa.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kaleb ka-bia Maaka déem ma lo Sebera de Tirahana o pa‑o.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Maaka daa ta ma lo Saafa wolo de na loge Madamana to, dedaane Seeva wolo na loge Machabena de Gibea to. Kaleb déem jege bukɔ, o yere mo Akisa.

english_verse: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.
translation_verse: de Salema wolo na bobo Bɛtelehem kuri to, de Harefa wolo na bobo Bɛte-Gadere kuri to.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Sobal ma lo Harowɛ. O déem jigi Manahafa tiina bam chichworo nabaaro mo,

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: ko ta woli de sɔ-yuni telo na zoore Kiriaf-Jeerim seeni to nabaaro. Banto maa ye Ifiri tiina, de Pufi tiina, de Sumafi tiina, de Misarayi tiina bam. Zorafi tiina bam de Esatola tiina bam de nwoŋi banto dwi dem wone.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salema dwi dem déem ye Bɛtelehem tiina, de Netofa tiina, de Aterof-Bɛf-Joaba tiina, de Manahafa tiina bam chichworo, dedaane Zori tiina bam.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: Salema ta ma ji sɔ-yuni telo na zoore Jabezi ne ye ba ye tɔn-poponna to nabaaro. Banto maa ye Tirafi tiina, de Simeafi tiina, de Sukafi tiina bam. Sɔ-yuni tem konto déem ye Keni tu Hammafa dwi tiina mo. Hammafa maa ye Rekabi sɔ-yuu kom de nabaaro.

english_verse: more sons. His wife Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel gave birth to Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.
translation_verse: de wonto bu Ahaz, de wonto bu Hezekia, de wonto bu Manasɛ,

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Banto maama déem ye David bia, ko ta woli de bia balo o ka-bi sem na loge ba pa‑o to. Ba déem maa jege ba nakɔ, o yere na ye Tamara.

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Josia na loge bia balo to mo tento: Johanan déem ye o bu-kwea kam. Balei tu wom maa ye Jehoyakim. Batɔ tu wom maa ye Zedekia. Bana tu wom de maa ye Salum.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Jehoyakim bia déem ye Jehoyachin de Zedekia.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Ba déem jaane Jehoyachin ba vo Babilon. Wonto bia bam mo tento: Selateli,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: de Malichiram, de Pedaya, de Senazaa, de Jekamia, de Hosama, de Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaya de bia mo tento: Zerubabel, de Simeyi. Zerubabel bia maa ye Mesulam, de Hanania. Banto nakɔ yere mo Selomifa.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Zerubabel daa ta loge bia banu o woli da. Banto maa ye Hasuba, de Oheli, de Berekia, de Hasadia, de Jusabi-Hesedi.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sekania bu maa ye Semaya. Semaya de déem loge bia banu. Banto ye Hatusi, de Igale, de Baria, de Nearia, de Safate.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearia déem jege bia batɔ. Banto ye Elio-Enayi, de Hizikia, de Azerikam.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elio-Enayi de déem loge bia barepɛ. Banto maa ye Hodavia, de Eliasibi, de Pelaya, de Akuba, de Johanan, de Delaya, de Anani.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Judah dwi dem bia badwonna mo tento: Pɛreza, de Hezeron, de Karimi, de Hura, de Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal bu Reaya déem loge Jahafe. Jahafe ma lo Ahumayi de Lahadi. Banto déem ye Zorafi sɔ-yuni tem nabaara mo.

english_verse: Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath. Some of his descendants settled the town of Bethlehem. Hur's other descendants included Etam, Penuel, and Ezer. Etam's sons were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash, and his daughter was Hazzelelponi. Penuel settled the town of Gedor, and Ezer settled the town of Hushah.
translation_verse: Penweli déem ma lo Gedora. Ezere de déem ma lo Husa. Banto mo ye Hura dwi dem. Hura déem ye Eferata bu-kwea mo ye o ta ye Bɛtelehem tiina bam nabaaro.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Tekoa kwo Asuuri déem jege kaana balei mo. Ba yera maa ye Hela de Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Naara ma lo bakeiri sena o pa‑o. Banto mo ye Ahuzam, de Hefera, de Temeni, de Haahastari.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: O kaane Hela de ma lo Zerefa, de Zohare, de Etanan,

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: de Koza. Koza déem ma lo Anubi de Zobeba, ye o ta ye Harum bu Ahareli sɔ-yuni tem nabaaro.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora o yere na ye Jabezi. Wonto mo jege yere se ko dwoni o chorro tem maama. O nu déem nam ya bwoŋi o yere we Jabezi, ye o we, “A na loge‑o to, ko tiini ko chɛ a yera ne mo.”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Jabezi de déem ma zaŋe o keeri o jare Isarele tiina Wɛ wom o we, “Jan ja! Swɛ amo swolim, se n pa laŋa kalo amo na wó taa tei to yale ka gaale. Ta‑n wo a tei ne se n zeini-ne, se n daare n che se lwarem yé yi-ne se ko chɛ a yera.” Wɛ ma seene o ke Jabezi na lwoori kolo to o pa‑o.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Suha choro Kalubi déem loge Mehira. Mehira de ma lo Eseton.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Eseton de déem ma lo Bɛte-Rafa, de Pasea, de Tehinna wolo na ye Nahase tiina nabaaro to. Reka dwi dem mo konto.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenazi bia bam mo tento: Ofineli de Seraya. Ofineli de bia bam maa ye Hatafe de Meonotayi.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotayi déem ma lo Ofera. Seraya de ma lo Joaba, ye wonto déem mo jigi teo kolo ba na bwoi we “Gwaro jeiga” to kwo, ko nɔn-bia bam na tiini ba yei gɔgerem totoŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Jefunɛ bu Kaleb bia bam mo tento: Yiru, de Ela, de Naam. Ela ma lo Kenazi.

english_verse: Ezrah was the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Mered was married to Bithiah the daughter of the king of Egypt. They had a daughter named Miriam and two sons: Shammai and Ishbah. It was Ishbah who settled the town of Eshtemoa. Mered was also married to a woman from the tribe of Judah, and their sons were Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel. Jered settled the town of Gedor; Heber settled the town of Soco; and Jekuthiel settled the town of Zanoah.
translation_verse: Ezera bia bam mo tento: Jefere, de Mered, de Efere, de Jalon. Mered déem di Ejipti pa-faro bukɔ Bitia mo o ma o ke o kaane. Ba ma lo busankana o yere na ye Miriam to, ko woli de Samayi, de Esetemoa kwo Yisiba. Mered kaane wodwoŋi wom na nwoŋi Judea to ma lo Gedora kwo Jeredi, de Sokoo kwo Hebera, ko woli de Zanoa kwo Jekuteli.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodia kaane na ye Naham nakɔ to bia mo tento: Keila kwo wolo na ye Garimi tu to, ko woli de Esetemoa wolo na ye Maaka tu to.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Siimon bia mo tento: Aminon, de Rina, de Ben-Hanan, de Tilon. Yisi de bia bam maa ye Zohefe de Ben-Zohefe.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Banto déem daa ta ye kamɔ-mɔra balo na zoore Netayim de Gedera ne to mo. Ba na wora to, ba toŋe ba pa pɛ wom mo. Simeon dwi dem

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon dwi dem mo tento: Nemuweli, de Jamin, de Jaribi, de Zera, de Sawuli.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Sawuli bu déem mo ye Salum. Salum bu maa ye Mibisam, ye Mibisam bu de ye Misima.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Misima de dwi dem maa ye o bu Hamuweli, de wonto bu Zakura, ko woli de Zakura bu Simeyi.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: de Bɛte-Makabota, de Hazara-Susim, de Bɛte-Biri, de Saarayim. Teene dento maama déem wo ba dam kuri ne mo se ko taa nii maŋa kalo David laam na tu o di paare to.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Ba déem ta maa zoore te-balwa banto wone: Etam, de Ayin, de Rimon, de Tochen, de Asan,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: ko ta woli de teene dem konto nawuura yam se ko kɛ ko yi Baalafa. Mo teene delo ba déem na zoore de wone to. Ba déem nam popone ba nabaara bam natɔga kam ba tiŋi tɔnɔ wone mo.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Baara bam konto maama déem ye Simeon sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina mo. Ba dwi dem déem puli lanyerane.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Ba déem jage mo ba vo ba yi Gedora se ba beeri ga-lɛɛro se ba vara taa di. Laŋa kam konto déem bwola de bwolo kolo na wo teo kom wɛ-puli seeni to mo.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Ba ma na te-ywoŋa na yala ye ka maŋe de vara kɔnɔ to ba jeini da. Kolokolo wo daane-ba jei sem konto ne. Ham dwi tiina déem ya mo zoore tega kam konto baŋa ne.

english_verse: men from the Simeon tribe went into Edom under the command of Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel the sons of Ishi.
translation_verse: ) déem vei Seyira zwonnu laŋa kam ba ke jara de balo na zoore da to. Ko nam ye Yisi bia mo dɛ ba yiga ye ba vo. Pelatia, de Nearia, de Refaya, de Yuzeli mo konto.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Ruben ya mo ye Isarele bu-kwea. O nam gɛ o nakweene dem mo, o na peini de o kwo kaane to ŋwaane. O nyaane Josɛf bia balei bam mo leiri o yuu ne ba di nakweene dem. Konto ŋwaane Ruben yere wo dɛ de zo we o ye bu-kwea kam.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Isarele bu-kwea Ruben bia mo tento: Hanoki, de Pallu, de Hezeron, de Karimi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: de wonto bu Beera. Beera déem na ye Ruben dwi dem nakwe maŋa kalo ne to, mo Asiria teo pɛ Tigilaf-Pilesa jaane‑o o vo o tete teo.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: de Azaze bu Bela. Azaze déem ye Sema bu mo, ye Sema de ye Joweli bu. Dwi dento déem jeini laŋa kalo na zege Arowa ne se ka vo ka yi Nebo de Baal-Meon seeni to mo.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye wɛ-puli seeni, ba laŋa kam ta kɛ ka yi kagoa kam ni mo, mɛ na wo Yuferata buga kam bubɛ baŋa seeni to. Ba laŋa kam déem yala konto dwoŋi, ba vara bam kɔgɔ na puli dedɛ Gilead ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo Sɔɔl na di paare to, mo Ruben dwi tiina déem ke jara de Hagiri tiina bam ba di-ba. Ba laam ma vo ba jwoŋi Hagiri tiina bam jei sem maama na wo Gilead wɛ-puli seeni to ba tei. Gad dwi dem

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gad dem déem zoore Basan ne mo se ko vo ko yi Saleka. Jei sem konto bwola de Ruben dwi tiina bam na zoore mɛ to.

english_verse: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Joweli déem mo ye ba yiga tu Basan ne. Safam maa ye belei tu. Janayi de Safate de ma saŋe.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Abideli bu Ahi déem mo ye ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe. Abideli de déem maa ye Guni bu.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Gad dwi tiina bam déem zoore Basan de Gilead jei sem ne de se nawuura yam ne mo. Ba maa tei pwoli selo na wo Saron ne se ko vo ko yi se siseina yam maama to.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba déem popone ba natɔga kam konto ba tiŋi maŋa kalo Jotam na di Judah teo paare ye Jeroboam de di Isarele teo paare to mo.

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Ba déem ma ke jara de Hagiri tiina, de Jetura tiina, de Nafisi tiina, ko woli de Nodaba tiina maama.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem zeini babɛ sem konto mo pa se ba wane Hagiri tiina bam de balo na woli-ba jara wone to ba di, ba na keeri ba jare‑o jara yam wone to ŋwaane. Wɛ ma sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom, ba na ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Wɛ na woli-ba jara yam wone to, babɛ sem déem go ba dona bam dedɛ mo. Ba laam maa zoore jei sem konto ne mo se ko yi maŋa kalo Asiria tiina bam na jaane-ba ba vo ba tete teo to. Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom déem daga mo dedɛ. Ba maa zoore jei selo na zege Basan ne se ko vo ko yi Baal-Heremon, de Senira, de Heremon peo kom seeni to.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa bam mo tento: Efere, de Yisi, de Eleli, de Azireli, de Jeremia, de Hodavia, de Jaadeli. Nakwa banto maama déem ye babɛ mo jara wone ye ba tiini ba jege yere.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Ba nam nwoŋi ba nabaara Wɛ wom kwaga ne, ye ba daare ba kaane wa-yɔɔro telo Kanaan tiina bam déem na tɔge to mo. Wɛ nam ya chɔge nɔɔna bam konto o yage pa se o nɔɔna laam jwoŋi ba tega kam mo ba tei.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Wɛ ma pa se Asiria teo pɛ Pulu ke chichuŋu de-ba. Pɛ wom konto yere dedwoŋi maa ye Tigilaf-Pilesa. O ma wane o di Ruben dwi tiina bam, de Gad dwi tiina bam, de Manasɛ dwi chichworo tiina bam, ye o daare o ja-ba o ja viiri. O ma kale-ba o vo Hala, de Habora, de Hara, ko woli de Gozan buga kam seeni. Dáane mo ba zoora se ko ba ko yi zem maama.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohafe bia bam mo tento: Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amiram bia bam déem mo ye: Aron, de Moses, de Miriam. Aron de bia bam mo tento: Nadab, de Abihu, de Eleaza, de Itamara.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ déem na pɛ se Pɛ Nebukadeneza ja Judah tiina bam de Jerusalem tiina bam o ja o viiri to mo o jaane Jehozadaki o woli da.

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Levi bia bam mo tento: Gereson, de Kohafe, de Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gereson bia bam yera mo tento: Libini dedaane Simeyi.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohafe bia bam mo tento: Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Merari bia bam mo tento: Mahili de Musi. Levi sɔ-yuni tem nabaara bam mo tento.

english_verse: Kohath's descendants included Amminadab, Korah, Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph, Assir, Tahath, Uriel, Uzziah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: de wonto bu Tahafe, de wonto bu Yureli, de wonto bu Yuzia, de wonto bu Sawuli.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Elikana dwi dem mo tento: Amasayi, de Ahimofi,

english_verse: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.
translation_verse: de wonto bu Eliabi, de wonto bu Jeroham, de wonto bu Elikana, [de wonto de bu Samuwel].

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuwel bia bam mo tento: O bu-kwea Joweli, de wonto nyaane Abija.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: de wonto bu Simea, de wonto bu Hagia, dedaane wonto bu Asaya. Wɛ diga lein-leena bam

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ba déem na jaane Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba ja ba zo ba zege o wara-jei sem ne to, nɔɔna balo David na kuri se ba taa nii lein-leena totoŋa yam baŋa ne to mo tento.

english_verse: Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
translation_verse: Simeyi maa ye Jahafe bu. Jahafe maa ye Gereson bu. Gereson maa ye Levi bu.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: Semera maa ye Mahili bu. Mahili maa ye Musi bu. Musi maa ye Merari bu. Merari maa ye Levi bu.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina badwonna bam déem maa tei totoŋa yalo na daare Wɛ wara-vwei dem ne to.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Aron dwi dem déem nwoŋi Levi bu Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom ne mo. Ba na tage jɔrɔ se ba pɔɔre tega kam ba pa Levi dwi tiina to, banto mo di yiga. Tega kalo ba na jwoŋi se ba taa zoore da to mo tento:

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Ba déem pɛ-ba Judah teo Heboron de pwoli selo na na gilimi da to mo.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye teo kom kare sem de ko nawuura yam, ba kwei tento ba pa Jefunɛ bu Kaleb mo.

english_verse: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma kwei teene dento na wo Benjamin dwi dem laŋa ne to dedaane pwoli selo na gilimi-de to ba pa-ba: [Gibeon], de Geba, de Alemefi, de Anatofe. Teene dem maama déem ye teene fuga-detɔ mo ba kwei ba pa Aron dwi dem.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Kohafe dwi tiina balo maa na daare to, ba déem kwei teene fuga na wo Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom laŋa ne to mo ba pa-ba.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Merari dwi dem sɔ-yuu maama de ma jwoŋi teene fuga-delei na wo Ruben dwi dem laŋa ne, de Gad dwi dem laŋa ne, de Zebulun dwi dem laŋa ne to.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem ke konto mo ba kwei teene dem konto ko woli de pwoli selo na gilimi-de to ba pa Levi dwi tiina bam se ba taa zoore de wone.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Kohafe dwi dem sɔ-yuni tedwonna de déem ma jwoŋi teene delo na wo Efrayim dwi dem laŋa kam ne to.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Gereson dwi tiina bam déem jwoŋi teene dento mo se ba taa zoore de wone. Manasɛ dwi dem laŋa ne mo ba kwei teene dento ba pa-ba: Golan na wo Basan ne to, ko woli de Asetarof, de se pwoli sem maama.

english_verse: The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: de Ramofa, ko woli de Anem, dedaane de pwoli sem maama.

english_verse: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Nafitali dwi dem laŋa ne mo ba jwoŋi teene dento: Kedesa na wo Galili ne to, de Hamon, de Kiriafayim de de pwoli sem.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Isakara bia bana bam mo tento: Tola, de Pua, de Jasubi, de Simiron.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Ba kwo Efrayim ma kwei da kɔgɔ o keeri ba lua. O chorro ma zaŋe ba vo se ba ke o lei.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Yuzi bu déem ye Izarahia mo. Izarahia bia bam mo tento: Mikayeli, de Obadia, de Joweli, de Issiya. Banu bam konto maama déem ye nakwa mo.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Zofa bia bam mo ye Sua, de Hanefera, de Suwali, de Beri, de Imira,

translation_verse: Isakara sɔ-yuni tem maama nɔɔna balo na yi jara-keim ye ba yera popone ya tiŋi to maama ná ke daane, ba déem ye baara morro funɔnɔ-terepɛ (

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benjamin bia batɔ bam mo tento: Bela, de Bechere, de Jedayeli.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela bia banu bam maa ye: Ezibon, de Yuzi, de Yuzeli, de Jerimofa, de Yiri. Ba maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo. Ba dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara keim to maa ye baara morro finlei-telei de fintɔ-bana (

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bechere bia bam maa ye: Zemira, de Joasa, de Eliazera, de Elio-Enayi, de Omiri, de Jeremofa, de Abija, de Anatofe, de Alemefi.

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi dem na ye tei to mo tento: Sutela, de o bu Bereda, de wonto bu Tahafe, de wonto bu Eleada, de wonto bu Tahafe,

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Jedayeli bu mo ye Bilihan. Bilihan bia bam maa ye: Jewusi, de Benjamin, de Ehuda, de Kenaana, de Zetan, de Tarasisi, de Ahisahara.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Yulam de ma lo Bedan. Banto déem ye Makira bu Gilead bia mo. Makira de déem maa ye Manasɛ bu.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Supi tiina bam de Hupi tiina bam déem nwoŋi Iri dwi dem wone mo. Husim tiina bam de déem nwoŋi Ahiram dwi dem wone. Nafitali dwi dem

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Nafitali bia bam mo tento: Jahazeli, de Guni, de Jezera, de Salum. Banto maama déem ye Biliha mo loge-ba. Manasɛ dwi dem

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manasɛ dwi dem mo tento: O ka-bia kalo na nwoŋi Aram to mo loge Asireli o pa‑o. O daa ta ma lo Makira wolo bu na ye Gilead to.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Makira déem ma di kaane na ye Hupi de Supi tiina bam bukɔ. O ta maa jege nakɔ, o yere mo Maaka. Makira bu wolo na saŋe to yere maa ye Zelofehada ye wonto déem loge bukwa yerane mo.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makira kaane Maaka déem ma lo bakeira o pa o yere we Peresa. Wonto nyaane yere maa ye Seresa. Peresa ma lo bakeiri selei, ba yera mo Yulam de Rekem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Gilead nakɔ Hamolekefa ma lo Yisoda, de Abizeri, de Maala.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Semida de ma lo Ahian, de Sɛkɛm, de Liki, de Aniam. Efrayim dwi dem

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: de wonto bu Zabadi, de wonto bu Sutela. Efrayim bia Ezere de Eleadi déem vei se ba ŋɔ Gafa tiina bam vara mo ye nɔɔna balo na zoore jei sem konto ne to go-ba.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Efrayim daa ma peini de o kaane ye o ja puga o lo bakeira. O ma pa o yere we Beria, bɛŋwaane ba loge‑o maŋa kalo cham na yi o sɔŋɔ kom to mo.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi dem ta maa ye Refa, de o bu Resefa, de wonto bu Tela, de wonto bu Tahan,

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ba déem na zoore tega kalo baŋa ne to zege Bɛtel de ko nawuura yam ne, se ko yi Naaran jei sem na wo wɛ-puli seeni to. Ko ta ná ye wɛ-zoore seeni, ba tega kam tole konto mo ko yi Gezere de ko nawuura yam maama. Ko ta ma zege Sɛkɛm de ko nawuura yam ne ko tole ko yi Aya de ko nawuura yam.

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: Teene delo na wo Manasɛ laŋa kam siseini dem ne to maa ye Bɛte-san, de Taanaka, de Megido, de Dora, ko woli de de nawuura yam maama. Teene dem konto wone mo Isarele bu Josɛf dwi dem déem zoora. Asere dwi dem

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Asere bia bam mo tento: Imina, de Isiva, de Isivi, de Beria. Banto nakɔ yere mo Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Beria bia bam maa ye: Hebera, de Malikeli. Malikeli bu maa ye Berezati.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Hebera déem loge Jafelete, de Somere, de Hotam mo. O ta ma lo busankana, o yere mo Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Jafelete bia maa ye Pasake, de Bimale, de Asevafe.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Somere bia maa ye Ahi, de Roga, de Huba, de Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Jafelete nyaane Hotam de bia maa ye Zofa, de Imina, de Selesi, de Amali.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: de Bezere, de Hodi, de Samma, de Silisa, de Iferan, de Beera.

english_verse: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
translation_verse: Jefere bia bam maa ye Jefunɛ, de Pisipa, de Ara.

english_verse: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
translation_verse: Yulla bia bam de maa ye Ara, de Hanneli, de Rizia.

translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto maama déem ye Asere dwi dem mo. Ba maa ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa. Ba déem ye babɛ na yei jara keim chekke to, ye ba tiini ba jege yere. Asere dwi dem nɔɔna balo na yi jara keim to déem ye baara morro finlei-teredo (

translation_verse: Benjamin bia banu bam mo tento: O bu-kwea Bela, de Asabeli, de Ahara,

english_verse: Nohah, and Rapha.
translation_verse: de Noha, de Rafa.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud,
translation_verse: Bela bia bam maa ye: Adara, de Gera, de Abihudi,

english_verse: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
translation_verse: de Abisua, de Naaman, de Ahoa,

english_verse: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
translation_verse: de Gera, de Sefufana, de Huram.

english_verse: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.
translation_verse: Ehuda bia bam mo tento: Naaman, de Ahija, de Gera. Banto déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo Geba ne. Ba dona déem ma zeili-ba pa ba vo ba zoore Manahafa ne. Gera mo dɛ ba yiga pa se ba nwoŋi. Wonto ma lo Yuza de Ahihuda.

english_verse: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Elipaale bia bam mo tento: Ebera, de Misam, de Semeda. Semeda déem mo lɔge Ono de Loda teene dem, ko woli de de nawuura yam maama.

english_verse: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.
translation_verse: Elipaale ta ma lo Beria de Sema. Banto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo Ayijalon ne. Ba ma zeili balo maama ya na zoore Gafa ne to.

english_verse: Elpaal's descendants included Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber, Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab.
translation_verse: de Isimerayi, de Izila, de Jobaba.

english_verse: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri.
translation_verse: de Jaaresia, de Elija, de Zikiri.

english_verse: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye ba sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo ye ba yera yam popone ya tiŋi lonne twanno tem wone. Ba déem maa zoore Jerusalem ne.

english_verse: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there
translation_verse: Gibeon kwo Jeyeli déem zoore Gibeon teo ne mo. O kaane yere maa ye Maaka.

english_verse: along with their sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: O bia bam maa ye: O bu-kwea Abedon, de Zura, de Kisi, de Baal, [de Nera], de Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

translation_verse: de Mikilofa. Mikilofa de ma lo Simea. Banto maama déem zoore ba twɛ de ba chorro tedwonna mo Jerusalem ne.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nera déem mo loge Kisi. Kisi ma lo Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl de déem ma lo Jonatan, de Maliki-sua, de Abinadaba, de Esi-baal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah,
translation_verse: Jonatan bu mo ye Meri-baal. Meri-baal de ma lo Mika.

english_verse: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika bia bam maa ye: Piton, de Meleka, de Tarea, de Ahaz.

english_verse: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza,
translation_verse: Ahaz déem mo loge Jehoada. Jehoada de ma lo Alemefi, de Azimavefa, de Zimiri. Zimiri ma lo Moza.

english_verse: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azeli déem jege bia baredo mo. Ba yera mo ye: Azerikam, de Bokeru, de Isameli, de Searia, de Obadia, de Hanan.

english_verse: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Azeli nyaane Eseke de déem maa jege bia batɔ ye banto mo ye o bu-kwea Yulam, de Jewusi, de Elifeleti.
