translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na dɛ yiga ba jwoori ba tete teo to déem ye Wɛ kaanem tiina, de Levi dwi dem badaara, ko woli de Wɛ diga kam tontoŋena, dedaane Isarele tiina badaara mo.

english_verse: Here is a list of priests who settled in Jerusalem: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jachin; Azariah, who was a temple official, and whose ancestors included Hilkiah, Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub; Adaiah son of Jeroham, whose ancestors included Pashhur and Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, whose ancestors included Jahzerah, Meshullam, Meshillemith, and Immer.
translation_verse: Jeroham bu Adaya. Jeroham kwo maa ye Pasura. Pasura kwo maa ye Malakija. Malakija kwo maa ye Maasayi. Maasayi kwo maa ye Adeli. Adeli kwo maa ye Jaazera. Jaazera kwo maa ye Mesulam. Mesulam kwo maa ye Mesilemifa. Mesilemifa kwo maa ye Yimera.

english_verse: priests, all of them family leaders in their clan and trained in the work at the temple. The Levites Who Settled in Jerusalem
translation_verse: ) mo. Ba maa toŋe totoŋa dwi dwi Wɛ diga kam ne ye ba yei ba na wó ke tei to.

english_verse: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives were the guards at the temple gates. Shallum was the leader of this clan,
translation_verse: Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena balo na jwoori to mo tento: Salum, de Akuba, de Talemon, de Ahiman, de ba chorro tem. Salum déem mo ye ba totoŋa yiga tu.

english_verse: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.
translation_verse: De zem maama ba maa nii ni delo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni ye ba bwoi-de we ‘Pɛ Ni dem’ to. Banto déem ye Wɛ diga kam ni-yerena balo na nwoŋi Levi dwi dem wone to mo.

english_verse: Shallum son of Kore, as well as the other men in the Korahite clan, guarded the entrance to the temple, just as their ancestors had guarded the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kore bu Salum, de o dwonna Kora dwi tiina déem mo yere Wɛ wara-jei sem manchwo-peena yam. Ba nabaara bam totoŋa de déem maŋe ya ye se ba taa yere Baŋa Wɛ wara-vwei dem ni mo. Kore kwo déem ye Ebiasafa, ye Ebiasafa ye Kora dwi tu mo.

english_verse: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Faŋa to, Eleaza bu Finehase ya mo ye ni-yerena bam yuu tu. Baŋa Wɛ déem maa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.
translation_verse: Meselemia bu Zekaria de déem yere Wɛ wara-jei ni dem mo.

english_verse: There was a total of
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bia yalei de fuga-balei (

english_verse: guards, all of them listed in the family records in their towns. Their ancestors had been chosen by King David and by Samuel the prophet to be responsible for this work,
translation_verse: ) déem mo yere Wɛ wara-jei sem manchwo-peena yam. Ba déem popone ba yera ba tiŋi ko tɔge ba dwi dem mo kateiri de kateiri maama ne. Ko nam ye Pɛ David de Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Samuwel ya mo kuri ni-yerena bam se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam de chega.

english_verse: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.
translation_verse: Ni-yerena bam déem zege Wɛ wara-jei sem sɛ sena sem maama ne ba yere nia yam mo.

english_verse: Their assistants lived in the villages outside the city, and every seven days a group of them would come into the city and take their turn at guard duty.
translation_verse: Maŋa de maŋa ba chorro tem na zoore ba kateira yam ne to maa yeini ba ba ba ke da yarepɛ ba woli-ba.

english_verse: The four full-time guards were Levites, and they supervised the other guards and were responsible for the rooms in the temple and the supplies kept there.
translation_verse: Ni-yerena bana balo na ye ba yiga tiina to ye Levi dwi tiina mo. Ba nam pɛ-ba chega mo se ba taa yere Wɛ wara-jei zela di sem, ko woli de di selo lonne wonnu tem na tigi se wone to.

english_verse: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tu dedoa déem wora o yere mo Matitia. O maa ye Kora dwi tu Salum bu-kwea mo. Ba kuri wonto mo se o taa nii bworobworo kolo ba na ma ba ke Wɛ pɛɛra to fɔgem baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye Kohafe dwi tiina badaara totoŋe mo se ba fɔge ba kwɛ bworobworo kolo ba na tiŋi Wɛ yiga ne Wɛ siu dɛ maama to.

english_verse: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.
translation_verse: Balo na ye lein-leena ye ba ye Levi dwi dem nakwa to déem zoore Wɛ wara-jei di sem wone mo, se ba taa toŋe ba totoŋa yam wea de tete, ne ko na maŋe tei to. Mo kokuri ba daa ba jege totoŋa yadwonna se ba taa toŋe ba woli da.

english_verse: All of these men were family leaders in the Levi tribe and were listed that way in their family records. They lived in Jerusalem. King Saul's Family (
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto maama déem ye Levi dwi dem sɔ-yuni tem nakwa mo ye ba yera yam popone ya tiŋi lonne twanno tem wone. Ba déem maa zoore Jerusalem ne. Sɔɔl kwoa natɔga kam

english_verse: the father of Shimeam. Some of them went to live in Jerusalem near their relatives.
translation_verse: Mikilofa de ma lo Simeam. Banto maama déem zoore ba twɛ de ba chorro tedwonna mo Jerusalem ne.

english_verse: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.
translation_verse: Gibeon kwo Jeyeli déem zoore Gibeon teo ne mo. O kaane yere maa ye Maaka.

english_verse: They had ten sons, who were born in the following order: Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
translation_verse: O bia bam maa ye: O bu-kwea Abedon, de Zura, de Kisi, de Baal, de Nera, de Nadab,

english_verse: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth
translation_verse: de Gedora, de Ahio, de Zekaria, de Mikilofa.

english_verse: Ner was the father of Kish and the grandfather of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
translation_verse: Nera déem mo loge Kisi. Kisi ma lo Sɔɔl. Sɔɔl de déem ma lo Jonatan, de Maliki-sua, de Abinadaba, de Esi-baal.

english_verse: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
translation_verse: Mika bia bam maa ye: Piton, de Meleka, de Tarea, de Ahaz.

english_verse: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
translation_verse: Azeli déem jege bia baredo mo. Ba yera mo ye: Azerikam, de Bokeru, de Isameli, de Searia, de Obadia, de Hanan.

english_verse: The Philistines fought against Israel in a battle at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.
translation_verse: Filisi tiina bam déem kwaare jara dedaane Isarele tiina bam. Isarele jar-keira bam ma jage sae ye Filisi tiina bam pare-ba. Ba ma go Isarele tiina bam dedɛ Giliboa peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: Saul died because he was unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to spirits of the dead,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl déem tega o na nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo. O wo sɛ se o toŋe o tɔge Baŋa Wɛ nia yam. O déem vei kaane wolo na wae o bwei chira to se o wane o nii o yiga.

english_verse: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl de o bia bam ma duri, ye Filisi tiina bam pɛ ba kwaga ba pu. Ba ma go Sɔɔl bia Jonatan, de Abinadaba, de Maliki-Sua.

english_verse: The fighting was fierce around Saul, and he was badly wounded by enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Jara yam ma tiini ya peene Sɔɔl dedɛ. O dona bam ma na‑o ye ba ta ba chena ba tɔ‑o pa ko ke‑o zonne.

english_verse: Saul told the soldier who carried his weapons, “Kill me with your sword! I don't want those godless Philistines to torture and make fun of me.” But the soldier was afraid to kill him. Then Saul stuck himself in the stomach with his own sword and fell on the blade.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma ta de nɔn-doŋo wolo na zei o jara zela yam to o we, “Le n se-zɔɔ kom n ma n zɔ-ne n go. Amo ba lage se Filisi nɔn-yɔɔro tento yi amo yera ba zɔ-ne se ba mɔne-ne ba ke-ne chaveera.” Nɔn-doŋo kom maa wo sɛ se o go‑o, foone na tiini de jege‑o to ŋwaane. Konto baŋa ne, Sɔɔl ma vaŋe o tete se-zɔɔ kom o le. O ma kwei-ko o moore o puga ne, ye o daare o to ko baŋa ne o te.

english_verse: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.
translation_verse: Nɔn-doŋo kom na maane we Sɔɔl tege to, o de ma le o se-zɔɔ kom ye o to ko baŋa ne o te.

english_verse: Saul, three of his sons, and all his male relatives were dead.
translation_verse: Ko déem ke konto mo ye Sɔɔl de o bia batɔ bam, de o dwi tiina bam maama tɔge daane ba te.

english_verse: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina balo déem na zoore Jezerele bwolo kom ne to ma lɔre we Sɔɔl de o bia bam tege mo, ye Isarele jar-keira bam maama duri ba jage. Ba na nigi konto to mo ba duri ba lage jei ba daare ba teene dem. Filisi tiina bam ma vo ba zoore de wone.

english_verse: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa,
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Filisi tiina bam ma jwoori jara kapworo kom ne se ba zane ba le jejegero twa bam yera ne. Ba ma na we Sɔɔl de o bia bam tege mo ba tigi Giliboa peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: they took Saul's weapons, pulled off his armor, and cut off his head. Then they sent messengers everywhere in Philistia to spread the news among their people and to thank the idols of their gods.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ to, ba ma gwoni Sɔɔl yuu ba le, ye ba lɔɔre o jara zela yam na wo o yera ne to. Ba laam ma toŋe kwora se ka yi Filisi tiina teene dem maama we, ba di Sɔɔl. Ba ma tɔɔle se ba dwi tiina maama ni taane dem konto, ye ba daare ba jege-de ba bore ba jwona yiga ne.

english_verse: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Sɔɔl jara zela yam, ba kwei-ya ba ja zo ba tiŋi ba jwona diga kam ne mo. Ba ma daare ba kwei o yuu kom ba vo ba pale ba jwoni Dagon diga kam ne.

english_verse: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama déem na zoore Jabese Gilead ne to ma ni Filisi tiina bam na ke Sɔɔl tei maama to.

english_verse: some brave men went to get his body and the bodies of his three sons. The men brought the bodies back to Jabesh, where they buried them under an oak tree. Then for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Balo na tiini ba ye bembɛ ba wone to ma zaŋe ba vo ba pare Sɔɔl de o bia bam yera yam. Ba ma ja-ya ba jwoori Jabese, ye ba daare ba kwei ba kwi sem ba suli tio-kamunu kodwoŋi kuri ne, Jabese teo wone. Ba ta ma di ba lwi ye ba vɔ ba nia da yarepɛ.

english_verse: instead of asking the Lord. So the Lord had Saul killed and gave his kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: O nam wo sɛ se o bwei Baŋa Wɛ se o bere‑o chwoŋa. Mo kokuri Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se Sɔɔl te. O ma daare o jwoŋi Isarele teo paare dem o jeŋa ne o kwei o pa Jesse bu David.

english_verse: The Jebusites said, “You won't be able to get in here!” But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.
translation_verse: Jebusi tiina bam ma ta de David ba we, “Abam bá na chwoŋa á zo ywo-seeni.” De konto de, David wane Zion o di. Zion déem ye teo kom dam jeiga mo. Nɔɔna laam maa jege jei sem konto ba bwoi we, ‘David teo’.

english_verse: So we have come to crown you king of Israel.” David made an agreement with the leaders and asked the Lord to be their witness. Then the leaders poured olive oil on David's head to show that he was now king of Israel. This happened just as the Lord's prophet Samuel had said. David Captures Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Konto to, Isarele nakwa bam maama déem jeeri Pɛ David tei ne Heboron ne mo. Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo David ke ni-sɛɛm de-ba. Ba laam ma lwo nuga o yuu ne se o taa ye Isarele tiina bam maama pɛ, ne Baŋa Wɛ ya na tage de Samuwel we ko wó ke tei to. David wane o jwoŋi Jerusalem

english_verse: David had told his troops, “The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander.” And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.
translation_verse: David ya tage o we, “Wolo ná tɔge jar-keira bam yiga o kwaare jara de Jebusi tiina bam, kotu wó ji ba yiga tu.” Zeruya bu Joaba mo ye wolo na bobo o ja jara yam to. Mo kokuri wonto seene o ji jar-keira bam yiga tu.

english_verse: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto déem mo ye Pɛ David bembɛ sem yiga tiina. Ba ma tɔge de Isarele tiina bam maama ba zege David kwaga ne, pa se o laam ba o di paare tega kam maama baŋa ne, ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o pwooli we, ko wó ke tei to.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: David dam dem déem ma fɔge de puli de ke da, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na wo o tei ne to ŋwaane. Bembɛ selo na woli Pɛ David to

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Benaya ta go Ejipti nɔn-wagele dedwoŋi mo. Nɔɔno wom dedɔrem déem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu, ye o zei chichwei na maŋe de beiŋa to mo. Ko daare ye Benaya jege da-lɔŋɔ. O ma vo o vere chichwei dem Ejipti tu wom jeŋa ne, o jwoori o ma-de o zɔ‑o o go.

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Bembɛ sem yera mo tento: Hakimoni tu Jasobema déem mo ye ‘Bembɛ setɔ sem’ yiga tu wom. O déem jeeri nɔɔna bia yatɔ (

english_verse: men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors
translation_verse: ) jara wone o go. Konto ŋwaane o ma na yere bembɛ setɔ sem yiga ne.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Wolo na saŋe wonto kwaga bembɛ setɔ sem wone to déem ye Ahohi tu Dodo bu Eleaza mo.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: David de Eleaza ma zege kara kam tetare ne ba kwaane ba ke jara yam ka ŋwaane. Ba ma go Filisi tiina bam dedɛ. Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa se Isarele tiina bam di wɔnɔ dedɛ.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo bembɛ fintɔ sem wone setɔ déem vei David tei, o na seigi Adulam peo bɔɔne wone to. Filisi tiina jar-keira kɔgɔ kodwoŋi ya tu ba tigisi Refayim bwolo kom ne.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: O ma ta o we, “Amo Tu Wɛ, amo bá wane a nyɔ na banto! A ná nyɔge-ba, ko nye de a nyɔge nɔɔna banto jana mo, ba na sɛ se ba ga ba ŋwea se ba ma mɔ na banto to ŋwaane.” O ma ve se o nyɔ-ba. Bembɛ setɔ sento déem na toŋe tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Joaba nyaane Abisayi de déem mo ye ‘Bembɛ fintɔ kom’ yiga tu. O ma kwei o chichwei o jeeri nɔɔna bia yatɔ (

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Wonto déem mo tiini o na yere o dwoni bembɛ fintɔ kom maama, ye o ji ba yiga tu. O nam wo woli bembɛ setɔ sem wone.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Jehoyada bu Benaya de déem ye jar-keiru mo na ye bembea. O nwoŋi Kabezele mo, ye o toŋe baare dedɛ. Benaya déem go Moaba bembɛ selei. O ta ma tu gwoŋo wone o go nywoŋo dɛ dedwe waaro na tiini te wora maŋa kalo to.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Jehoyada bu Benaya déem na toŋe tei to mo konto. O de ma na yere bembɛ setɔ sem yiga ne.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: O ma tiini o na yere bembɛ fintɔ kom wone, ye o wo tɔge o woli bembɛ setɔ sem wone. David ma pa se Benaya ji balo na yere‑o to yiga tu.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Babɛ sem déem jege tɛ mo. Ba maa yei chena tam de napana dolem chekke jazem de jagwia maama. Ba maa ye Benjamin dwi tu Sɔɔl chorro mo.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Babɛ sedwonna de déem nwoŋi Gad dwi dem wone ba da ba woli David kɔgɔ kom wone. Ba ma vo o tei kagoa yuu ne. Ba de déem ye bembɛ selo na yei jara keim chekke to mo. Ba maa jege jara nantane de chichwoa. Ba maa jege foone ne nywoŋo tei, ye ba tiini ba wara ne feira na duri tei peero yuu ne to.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Babɛ sento na ye Gad tiina to déem ye jar-keira yiga tiina mo. Ba dedoa wó wane nɔɔna bi o zeili jara wone. Ba wone wolo dam na daga to wae nɔɔna moro o zeila.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Babɛ sem konto déem mo bɛ Jɔdan buga kam maŋa kalo ka ni na pɛɛle bene dem boboa chana kam ne to. Ba ma vo ba zeili nɔɔna balo maama na zoore bubɛ dem bwollu tem wɛ-puli de wɛ-zoore seeni to pa se ba duri ba viiri.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Baara badwonna na ye Benjamin dwi tiina de Judah dwi tiina to déem vei David tei o dam jei sem ne.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: David ma zaŋe o jeeri-ba ye o ta de-ba o we, “Á veiŋa kam ná ye zaane veiŋa mo á beene se á woli-ne, amo de nam sɛ se dé maama woli daane. Á nam ná tu se á yeigi-ne mo á pa a dona bam, se debam nabaara Wɛ wom taa yei ko ni ne se o daare o waare abam. Kokuri to a wo ke kolokolo a chɔge.”

english_verse: Some of the warriors who joined David were from the tribe of Manasseh. They had earlier gone with David when he agreed to fight on the side of the Philistines against King Saul. But as soon as the Philistine rulers realized that David might turn against them and rejoin Saul, they sent David away to the town of Ziklag.
translation_verse: Baara badwonna de déem nwoŋi Manasɛ dwi dem wone ba da ba woli David kɔgɔ kom wone maŋa kalo o na tɔge de Filisi tiina bam se ba kwaare jara de Sɔɔl to. Ko nam na ke tei to, David de o nɔɔna bam wo woli Filisi tiina bam, foone na jaane ba yiga tiina bam to ŋwaane. Ba déem boŋe we David wó wane o lɔ ba kwaga ne o jwoori Pɛ Sɔɔl tei o daare-ba pa se ba ga ba ŋwea mo. Mo kokuri ba jeini tega ne ba bwɛ daane ye ba pa David pwɛ o tete de-ba.

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Ba déem yeini ba woli David pa se o wane venverena balo na ke jara de-ba to, bɛŋwaane ba déem ye babɛ mo chekke ye ba kwori ba ye o jar-keira bam yiga tiina.

english_verse: of his relatives, who were also officers;
translation_verse: ) wo o tei ne, ba na ye o chorro to.

english_verse: from Ephraim, who were not only brave, but also famous in their clans;
translation_verse: ). Banto déem tiini ba jege yere mo ba sɔ-yuni tem wone.

english_verse: from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, who were armed with all kinds of weapons.
translation_verse: ). Ba de déem jege jara zela dwi dwi.

english_verse: leaders from Issachar, along with troops under their command—these leaders knew the right time to do what needed to be done;
translation_verse: ), de ba chorro telo maama na wo ba kwaga nɔɔna to. Dedɛɛra bam konto yei kolo na jege ko ke kanto maŋa kam ne to pa se ba lɔre chwoŋa kalo Isarele tiina na jege se ba tɔge to.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Ba nu-bia badwonna na wo Isakara, de Zebulun, de Nafitali dwia yam maama laŋa ne to de ma la wodiiru dedɛ ba toŋe ba pa-ba se ba taa di. Ba déem mɛ bonɛ, de kona, de bona-sisei, de nabɛ ba zeŋe wodiiru tem ba ba ba pa-ba. Wodiiru tem maa ye muni, de kapere-kora, de kekan-wogila, de sana, de nuga, ko ta woli de na-bale, de pei. Kokuri Isarele teo kom maama ne mo ba déem di ywoni lanyerane.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto maama déem maŋe David tei ne mo da yatɔ ba di wodi-fɔrɔ kuri. Kokuri to, ba chorro tem déem pɛ-ba ba na lage kolo to maama mo.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: O ma da ba yiga se ba maama vo Judah teo Baala kolo yere dedwoŋi na ye Kiriaf-Jeerim to. Ba déem vei se ba ja Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam mo ba jwoori Jerusalem. Dakaa kam konto wora Baŋa Wɛ yere ŋwaane mo. Wonto di paare cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne, se na zege dakaa kam baŋa ne to.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: Keim dem konto ma pa se David kɔre Wɛ. O ma bwɛ o we, “Amo wó ke tɛ mo a ja Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam a ba a tei?”

english_verse: and then announced to the people of Israel: While Saul was king, the sacred chest was ignored. But now it's time to bring the chest to Jerusalem. We will invite everyone in Israel to come here, including the priests and the Levites in the towns surrounded by pastureland. But we will do these things only if you agree, and if the Lord our God wants us to.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé kwaane dé kwei dé Tu Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam dé ja dé jwoori dé tei ne. Kokuri to, maŋa kalo Sɔɔl na jege paare dem o di to, dé wo bwei se dé lɔre Wɛ boboŋa.”

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Dakaa kam nam ya wo Abinadaba sɔŋɔ ne mo. Ba ma vo ba kwei-ka ba daŋe nabɛ toroko-doŋo baŋa ne. Abinadaba bia balei Yuza de Ahio maa tɔge toroko kom ye ba yere-ko.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: David de Isarele tiina bam maama ma leeni lei ba seini Wɛ de ba dam maama. Ba ta maa jege kwanno, de zwe, de gungwei, de nabwanno, dedaane kwɛɛra zela dwi dwi ba kwɛɛre, ye ba daare ba sae ba tɔge kwaga.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi Chidon na yeini o fere o mena mɛ to. Nabɛ sem ma gare se tete se lage se to. Yuza ma zi Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam se o pa ka fɔge ka zege.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane ma tiini de zaŋe Yuza baŋa ne, o na twe o jeŋa o dwei dakaa kam to ŋwaane. Nɛ sem konto ni ne, Wɛ ma mage Yuza o go.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: David wo ma fuli dedɛ de Baŋa Wɛ na tɔge o ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa o go Yuza to. Konto ma pa o bwoŋi jei sem konto yere we, ‘Pɛrezi Yuza.’ Mo jei sem yere de zem maama.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: O daa maa wo jaane-ka o ja o vo o zo o tete teo Jerusalem wone. O ma lɛɛre o pa se ba ywori ba ja-ka ba vo Gafa tu Obed-Edom sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ma maŋe Obed-Edom sɔŋɔ ne chane setɔ mo. Ka na wora to, Baŋa Wɛ ma swɛ wonto de o sɔŋɔ tiina, de o wonnu maama swolim.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: David ma vo o yi Baal Perazim. O ma wane Filisi tiina bam o di. O laam ma ta o we, “Wɛ tɔge amo dam baŋa ne mo o mage o pore a dona bam baŋa ne o zeili-ba, nenɛɛne na na mage ba pore tei to.” Ba ma lɛɛre ba jege jei sem konto ba bwoi we ‘Baal Perazim’.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: David ma seene o ke kolo Wɛ na bere‑o se o ke to. Ko ma pa se ba wane Filisi jar-keira bam ba di. Ba ma zege Gibeon ne ba pare-ba ba vo ba yi Gezere.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Tura teo Pɛ Hiram déem ma toŋe nɔɔna David tei ne se ba ke pipiu daane. O ma pa se ba ja Sedare da-kwollu ba vo ba pa‑o. O ta ma pa se kandwa-cherena, de gwaro tɔge ba vo, se ba wane ba lɔ pɛ sɔŋɔ ba pa David.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: David na zoore Jerusalem ne to, mo o daa ta di kaana badwonna o woli da. Ba ma lo bia, bakeiri de busankane, ba pa‑o.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Konto maama baŋa ne mo David yere déem zaŋe de jage tega baŋa jei maama ne. Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se dwi-gɛ tiina maama tiini ba kɔre foone ded‑o.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Filisi tiina bam déem ma ni we ba tiŋi David se o taa ye Isarele tiina maama pɛ. Ba ma la ba jar-keira bam maama ba ke daane ba vo ba beeri o jeiga se ba ja. David ma lɔre ko ni ne ye o nwoŋi teo kom ne o vo se o jeeri-ba.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Filisi tiina bam ma ba ba yi Refayim bwolo kom. Ba ma ke chichuŋu de nɔɔna balo na zoore da to.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: David ma bwei Wɛ o we, “A véi a jeeri Filisi tiina bam de jara, se nmo wó ke-ba a jeŋa ne na?” Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri‑o o we, “Ɛɛ, zaŋe n vo n jeeri-ba, se amo wó ke-ba n jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Dáane mo Filisi tiina bam duri ba daare ba jwona yam ba yage. David ma pa o nɔɔna bam ni se ba kwei mini ba zwɛ jwona yam.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Ko na ke da fenfee to, Filisi jar-keira bam daa ta ma jwoori Refayim bwolo kom ba ke chichuŋu de nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: David daa ma bwei Wɛ se o lɔre o na wó ke tei to. Wɛ ma ta o we, “Nmo ná jeeri-ba, se n yé yɔɔre ba yiga vekke. Nam kaare n tɔge Balesam teeni dem n kekare dáa kadwoŋi kam ne n yi-ba.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Ta‑n nii teeni dem yuu ne. Nmo ná tu n ni ko dɔna de baŋa ne, se n laam nwoŋi n jeeri-ba. Ko bere we amo tete mo dɛ á yiga se a jeeri Filisi tiina jar-keira bam de jara a daare a di-ba.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: David déem lɔge sam mo o tete teo Jerusalem ne se o taa zoore de wone. O ma daare o chwi vwei se o wane o kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam o zege da.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: David ma la Isarele tiina bam maama o ke daane Jerusalem ne, se ba laam wane ba kwei Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba ba ba zege o na ke jei selo o pa-ka to.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: O ma bwoŋi Aron dwi dem de Levi dwi tiina bam o ke daane. Banto déem mo ye:

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Elizafan sɔ-yuu kom wone: Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Semaya de o chorro bia yalei.

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Heboron sɔ-yuu kom wone: Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Eleli de o chorro fu-nɔnɔ (

english_verse: Amminadab, the leader of the Uzziel clan, with
translation_verse: Yuzeli sɔ-yuu kom wone: Ba sɔ-yuu kom nakwe Aminadabi de o chorro bi de fuga-balei (

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Dé na kwaane se dé ke konto boboa ne to, abam Levi dwi tiina ya tera se á zeŋe-ka, ne Wɛ chullu tem na bere tei to. Mo kokuri dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ bane fuli dé baŋa ne, dé na wo bwei‑o se dé lɔre dé na wó ke tei to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam ma kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane se ba wane ba zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to ni-gwonim dakaa kam.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: David ma ta de Levi tiina nakwa bam se ba kuri ba tete chorro tem wone balo na wae ba leeni to se ba taa leeni wopwolo lei. Badaara maa wó taa tae kwanno dwi dwi, ye badaara de taa jege zwe ba maga.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina Sebania, de Josafate, de Netaneli, de Amasayi, de Zekaria, de Benaya, de Eliazera maa ye se ba to Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne ba taa wui nabwanno. Obed-Edom, de Jehia de déem maa ye se ba taa yere dakaa kam ba woli da.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem yɔɔre o zeini Levi tiina balo na zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam to. Konto ŋwaane ba ma go nabɛ serepɛ de pi-bale serepɛ ba ma kaane ba zuli‑o.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Ba na yɔɔre ba jege Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ba zoore Jerusalem teo wone tei to, mo Sɔɔl bukɔ Mikaale tɔge o takworo seeni o nii o na kɔgɔ kom. O maa na nɛ Pɛ David na tiini o sae de wopwolo tei to, o ma gwooni‑o o bochare ne.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: David na ke kaanem dem o ti to, o laam ma kwei Baŋa Wɛ yere dem o ma o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o pa nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: O ta ma pa se ba chɛ wodiiru tem ba pa Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama, baara de kaana. Nɔɔno maama ma jwoŋi bworobworo dedoa, de nɔn-wɔa, de kekan-wogila bɔŋa dedoa.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: David déem ma kuri Levi tiina badwonna se ba taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to o dakaa kam yiga ne. Ba totoŋa maa ye se ba taa lwoori‑o, ye ba ke o lei, ye ba daare ba tei‑o.

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: Banto wone Asaf déem mo ye ba yiga tu. Zekaria ma saŋe, ko woli de Jeyeli, de Semiramofa, de Jeheli, de Matitia, de Eliabi, de Benaya, de Obed-Edom, de Jeyeli wodwoŋi. Banto maa ye balo na tae kwanno dwi dwi to. Asaf mo tei zwe sem magem.

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina Benaya de Jahazeli maa zege Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne ba wui nabwanno tem maŋa de maŋa. David lei keim leiŋa Lei

english_verse: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Chega to, á ye balo Wɛ na kuri o pa o tete mo. Á maa ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Isarele bia bam. Jakob dwi dem mo konto.

english_verse: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne mo David bobo o pa se Asaf de o dwonna bam leeni Wɛ seinim leiŋa kanto se ba ma ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei:

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se á daare á tei o yere! Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre o na toŋe kolo maama to.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Leeni-na tia lei á pa‑o. Ta-na kwanno á tei‑o! Bere-na nɔɔna o totoŋ-kamuna na ye tei to.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Véi-na Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne se o pa á jwoŋi dam. Ta‑á fɔɔre-na á twɛ‑o maŋa maama wone.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wonto nam mo ye debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. O maa tei logo baŋa maama de chega.

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Ba kɔgɔ kom déem ta ba daga. Ba maa ye nɔɔna fenfee yerane, ye ba kare Kanaan tega kam ne ba beera, ne veira mo tei.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Ba maa tole teene dem maama wone de dwi tiina maama wone.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: De konto de, Wɛ déem wo pɛ pwola se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba. Banto ŋwaane mo o déem kaane pwa ye o we:

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Yé dwei-na nɔɔna banto, se amo mo kuri-ba a pa a tete. Nam yé pa-na ko chɛ amo sampwori sem yera.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Leeni-na á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ! Nabiina maama, leeni-na á pa-o-na. Dɛ maama wone se á tɔɔle-na o taane we, o ye Verem Tu.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina lɔre we, o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom gaale. Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ni o totoŋ-kamuna yam ŋwa.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ tiini o ye kamunu mo. O ma seene o maŋe dedaane tia. Nɔɔna jege se ba taa kɔre‑o se ko dwoni wa yam maama.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wa yalo dwi-gɛ tiina na zuli to ye jwona mo. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu maama.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Kamunni dedaane paare mo wo o tei ne. Dam de ywoni de maa wo o tete diga kam ne.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, kwei-na zula á pa Baŋa Wɛ. O na jege dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to ŋwaane, kwei-na zula á pa‑o.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Pa se wɛyuu kom taa di ywoni! Ta pa se tega kam baŋa taa jege wopwolo! Pa se dwi maama tiina taa tɛ we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!’

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Pa se naneo kom taa wuura, konto de wonnu telo maama na wo ko wone to. Pa se kare sem de se wodiiru tem maama taa chaka!

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Teeni delo na wo goa ne to laam wó leeni lei-ywei de tei Baŋa Wɛ. Kokuri to, o maa beene se o di logo baŋa maama taane mo.

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o tiini o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to! Wonto maŋe de teem mo ko zege faŋa faŋa se ko taa vei wuu. Nɔɔna bam maama laam ma ta ba we, “Ameena!” Ba ma daare ba tei Baŋa Wɛ. Wɛ zula yam taane

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: Pɛ David déem na kuri Asaf de o chorro tem se ba taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ o ni-gwonim dakaa kam yiga ne to, o ma pa se ba toŋe ba pa Wɛ dɛ maama wone, ne chullu tem na bere tei to.

english_verse: of his relatives were their assistants, and Hosah and Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun were the guards.
translation_verse: ) de toŋe ba woli da. Obed-Edom dedaane Hosa déem yere Wɛ diga nia yam mo.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye Zadoki de o dwonna kaanem tiina bam, David déem pɛ se ba toŋe ba pa Baŋa Wɛ o wara-vwei dem ne mo. Wara-jei selo na wo Gibeon ne to mo konto.

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: Ba déem yeini ba jege se ba go vara ba zwɛ ba pa Baŋa Wɛ zwɛɛm kaanem dakaa kam baŋa ne tetete de dedaan-ni maama mo, ne Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere se Isarele tiina taa ke tei to.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Jedutuna de Heman déem mo woli ba wone, dedaane balo maama David na kuri dedoa dedoa to se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei, o swono kom na wora taa wuu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Heman de Jedutuna déem nii lein-leena bam baŋa ne mo. Ba maa jege nabwanno, de zwe, de kwɛɛra zela dwi dwi se ba taa mae ba zuli Wɛ. Jedutuna dwi dem maa jege se ba taa yere Wɛ diga kam ni dem.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Pɛ David déem laam maa zoore o sɔ-fɔrɔ kom ne. Dɛ dedwe o ma ta de Wɛ sampwora Natan o we, “Nii amo mo tento! A zoore sɔ-fɔrɔ kolo ba na kwei Sedare da-ŋonno ba ma lɔ-ko to, ko daare ye Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam laam zege vwei kuri ne.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, n ta boŋe se n ke-ne lanyerane n woli da! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ta ma‑n tiŋi ni a dwi dem ŋwaane se ko vo ko yi jwa seeni. Nmo maŋe n gare n pa a ye nɔn-kamunu mo.

english_verse: That night, the Lord told Nathan
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto tete ne mo Wɛ ŋɔɔne dedaane Natan o we:

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Véi n ta de amo tontoŋeno David we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Ko dae nmo mo wó lɔ sɔŋɔ n pa-ne se a taa zoore da.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, ko zege maŋa kalo a na jaane Isarele dwi dem a ba ywo-seeni to, se ko ba ko yi zem, amo ta wo fɔge a zo sɔŋɔ wone. Mɛ maama a ná jaane-ba a vo, a yeini a zoore vwei kuri ne mo.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Jei selo maama amo dedaane Isarele dwi dem na beeri dé vo to, amo ta wo fɔge a ta de dedɛɛra balo a na kuri se ba taa nii a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam to we, “Bɛ mo ke ye á wo kwei Sedare da-ŋonno á ma á lɔ sɔŋɔ á pa-ne?” ’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Mɛ maama nmo na yeini n vei to, a déem tɔge n kwaga konto mo, ye a pa se n dona dwi maama saare tega baŋa ne. Leile konto, amo wó pa n yere zaŋe, se n ta‑n tɔge n ye logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam wone dedoa.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Amo laam nam kwei tega kalo a nɔɔna bam na wó taa zoore ka wone to mo a pa-ba. Ko lage ko taa ye ba tete kugu jei nɔɔn-nɔɔno na bá wane o daane-ba ko wone to mo. Nankɔ-nyena daa bá bɛɛse-ba nenɛɛne ko déem na ke tei,

english_verse: Just then, David arrived, and when Araunah saw him, he stopped his work and bowed down.

english_verse: David said, “Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.”
translation_verse: David ma ta ded‑o o we, “Sɛ se n yeigi n mena ferem jei sem n pa-ne. A lage se a lɔ kaanem bimbini mo dáane a zuli Baŋa Wɛ se ko pa jawe-chɛɛro tem ti dé teo kom ne. Amo wó ŋwe ko sabu kom ni maama a pa‑m.”

english_verse: Araunah answered, “Take it, Your Majesty, and do whatever you want with it. I'll even give you the oxen for the sacrifice and the wheat for the grain sacrifice. And you can use the threshing-boards for the fire. It's all yours!”
translation_verse: Arawuna ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, nam kwei-ka zɛɛra n ma n ke kolo maama n na lage to. Nii amo nabɛ mo tento se n wane n ja n zwɛ n ma n ke kaanem dem. english_verse: Then the Lord commanded the angel to put the sword away.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de maleka kam se ka kwei se-zɔɔ kom ka jwoori ka ke ko pwolo kom ne.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem nam toŋe o kwora mo o ta de amo we, ‘Nmo tiini n go nɔɔna dedɛ jara-keim baŋa ne. Nmo nam bá‑n lɔ diga amo yere zula ŋwaane, amo na maane we n pwori jana dedɛ tega ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: David déem ma pa Isarele teo yiga tiina bam ni se ba woli Solomon.

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wo á tei ne mo, ye o pa se á jei á teo ne de yazura. Ko ná ye balo déem na zoore tega kam ne to, o ke-ba amo dam kuri ne mo. Baŋa Wɛ de o nɔɔna bam laam maa tei tega kam.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, yɔɔre á ta‑á zuli á Tu Baŋa Wɛ de á bochare maama, ko woli de á dam maama. Nam bobo-na á lɔ Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ diga kam, se á laam wane á ja o ni-gwonim dakaa kam, de o lonne zela yam á zo da. Ka maa wó taa ye diga kalo á na wó lɔ Baŋa Wɛ yere dem zula ŋwaane to.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Pɛ David déem na maane we o kwe o gaale to, o ma pa se o bu Solomon leiri o yuu ne o di Isarele teo paare dem.

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Tega ná yeini ka poore, Levi tiina bam jege se ba zege ba jeiga ne ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo ye ba leeni ba zuli‑o. Ba ta wó ke konto dedaan-ni maama ne,

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gereson bia bam mo tento: Ladan de Simeyi.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Ladan de déem jege bakeiri setɔ mo. Ba maa ye: O bu-kwea Jeheli, de Zetam, de Joweli.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Simeyi bia batɔ bam maa ye: Selomifa, de Hazeli, de Haran. Banto maama déem ye Ladan sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina mo.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohafe bia bana bam mo tento: Amiram, de Izehara, de Heboron, de Yuzeli.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Geresom dwi dem wone: Sebuwel mo ye ba nakwe.

english_verse: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.
translation_verse: Izehara bia bam wone: Selomifa mo ye ba nakwe.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Heboron bia bam mo tento: O bu-kwea Jeria. Balo na saŋe to maa ye Amaria, de Jahazeli, de Jekameam.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Merari bia bam mo tento: Mahili, de Musi. Mahili de bia bam maa ye: Eleaza de Kisi.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Eleaza déem tege ye o wo loge bakeira, se bukwa yerane mo o loga. Banto ma zo ba kwo wom nyaane Kisi bia badwonna.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina bam daa ba jege se ba taa zeŋe wara-vwei dem de de wo zela yam ba taa beera jeiga maama.”

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Samuwel, de Kisi bu Sɔɔl, de Nera bu Abenera, de Zeruya bu Joaba de déem jaane pɛɛra yadwonna ba ba ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Selomifa de o chorro tem mo nii te maama baŋa ne.

translation_verse: Izehara sɔ-yuu kom wone: Chenania de o bia bam déem ye dedɛɛra balo na toŋe Isarele teo jei sedwonna ne to mo. Ba totoŋa maa ye se ba taa nii teo kom taana baŋa ne.

translation_verse: Zeruya bu Joaba ma bobo se o ga Isarele tiina bam se o lɔre ba ni. O nam wo wane o ga-ba o ti, bɛŋwaane Wɛ bane zaŋe de Isarele tiina bam ba keim dem konto ŋwaane mo. Ba maa wo popone ba ni na mae tei to ba ke Pɛ David lonne twanno tem wone. Pɛ wom dedɛɛra bam taane

translation_verse: Efrayim dwi dem yuu tu maa ye: Azazia bu Hosea. Manasɛ dwi chichworo kom yuu tu maa ye: Pedaya bu Joweli.

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Adeli bu Azimavefa déem mo nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom zela yalo maama na jege lonne to baŋa ne. Yuzia bu Jonatan maa nii lonne zela yalo na wo kateira yam maama ne to baŋa ne.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Kalubi bu Eziri déem mo nii balo na vare pɛ wom kare to baŋa ne.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Rama tu Simeyi déem mo nii Vini teeni kare sem baŋa ne. Sefama tu Zabidi maa nii Vini tio-bia de ba ŋokem baŋa ne.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Gederi tu Baal-Hanan mo nii Olivi teeni de kaporro telo na wo wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne to. Joasa maa nii jei selo ba na tiŋi Olivi nuga kam da to baŋa ne.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Saron tu Sitirayi déem mo nii naane delo na wo Saron pwola kam ne to. Adali bu Safate de maa nii naane delo na wo bwollu tem kura ne to.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Isameli dwi tu Obili mo nii kona yam baŋa ne. Meronofa tu Jedeya maa nii bonɛ sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: These were the men in charge of David's royal property. David's Personal Advisors
translation_verse: Hagiri dwi tu Jazizi déem mo nii vare-balwa bam baŋa ne. Dedɛɛra banto maama déem mo nii Pɛ David wonnu baŋa ne ba pa‑o.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Jonatan na ye Pɛ David nabera to déem jege yi-poro chekke ye o yei tɔnɔ poponem. O maa woli David de kwea. Hakimoni bu Jeheli mo bere pɛ wom bia bam.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Ahitofeli déem mo woli pɛ wom de kwea. Ariki tu Husayi maa ye pɛ wom badwoŋ-swono.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Benaya bu Jehoyada, ko woli de Abiatara maama déem mo leiri Ahitofeli yuu ne. Joaba déem maa ye pɛ wom jar-keira bam yiga tu.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Ba na jeeri daane konto to, Pɛ David ma zege wɛɛne o ta o we: “A nu-bia bam, a déem jaane boboŋa mo se a lɔ diga se ba taa zege Baŋa Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam da, se dé Tu Wɛ wom na jeiga kalo o na wó chwi o nɛ da to. A nam bobo se a ti ka lɔɔm dem yiga.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam ve mo ye o we, ‘Nmo bá‑n lɔ diga amo yere zula ŋwaane, nmo na ye bembea ye n pwori nɔɔna dedɛ jana to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo le amo a kwo sɔŋɔ kom maama wone se a taa di Isarele teo paare taa wuu. O déem kuri Judah dwi dem mo se ba di yiga Isarele dwia yam maama wone. O ta ma kuri a kwo diga kam Judah dwi dem wone, ye o daare o zo a kwo bia bam wone o kuri amo se a taa ye Isarele teo maama pɛ, o yi na su amo kikia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se a lo bakeiri dedɛ. O ma nii ba maama wone o kuri Solomon se o leiri amo yuu ne o di paare Baŋa Wɛ tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo we, ‘Nmo bu Solomon mo ye wolo na wó lɔ a diga kam de ka konkwallo tem to. Kokuri to, a kuri wonto mo se o taa ye a bu, se amo de taa ye o kwo.

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, amo na zege abam Isarele tiina na ye Baŋa Wɛ kɔgɔ kom maama yiga ne, ye dé Tu Wɛ wom wora o maane dé keina yam to, amo zem kaane abam we, abam jege se á ta‑á toŋe a tɔge á Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam maama mo. Konto mo wó pa se á wane á jwoŋi te-ywoŋa kanto á ta‑á tei, ye á daare á kwei-ka á ta‑á pae á bia se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nmo Solomon na ye amo bu to, kwaane se n sɛ n pa n kwo Wɛ wom, se n ta‑n zuli‑o de n bochare maama, de n boboŋa maama. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o buŋi nɔɔna bochara wone ye o lɔre ba boboŋa maama na ye tei to mo. Nmo ná beeri o jei, o wó pa‑m chwoŋa se n na‑o. Nmo nam daa ná ve‑o, o de wó ve‑m se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑n yei n tete ni ne, kokuri to Baŋa Wɛ kuri nmo mo se n lɔ diga kalo na wó taa ye o wara-jei sem to n pa‑o. Konto to, ke dam n ke n tete kuri ne, se n kwaane n toŋe.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: David na ŋɔɔne konto o ti to, o ma kwei twanno telo na bere Wɛ diga kam zega to o pa o bu Solomon. Te bere ba na wó lɔ-ka tei maama to mo: ka napɔrɔ kom, de ka di-balwa bam, de ka zela di sem, de ka wɛyuu di sem, de ka wo di sem, ko woli de wɛleera saarem jeiga kam maama.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: David déem ma bere‑o o boboŋa na jaane se o lɔ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam konkwallo tem tei to, de ka pwooni yiga di sem, de ka lonne wonnu tiŋim di sem, de di selo ba na wó zege Wɛ pɛɛra da to.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: O ta ma bere‑o kaanem tiina bam de Levi dwi tiina bam totoŋa na jege se ya pɔɔre tei to, dedaane ba na wó taa toŋe tei maama Wɛ diga kam wone to, de zela yalo ba na wó taa mae ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ to.

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: David ta ma ta de o bu Solomon o we, “Yɔɔre n ke dam n tete kuri ne, se n daare n ta‑n jege baare ye n kwaane n toŋe. Yé ta‑n fona, nam yé pa se n vɔna pare. Kokuri to, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na ya amo Tu Wɛ to wó taa wo n tei ne. O wó yɔɔre o woli‑m ye o bá yage‑m, se n wane n toŋe Baŋa Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm totoŋe dem maama n ti.

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: Gwaro tem ta wó ma sabu-seŋa kam de lu-nyenno tem konto ba ma ba gɔgere Wɛ diga kam wonnu dwi dwi. Tɔ. Abam wɔ tete mo wó sɛ se o de kwei o wonnu o pa Baŋa Wɛ zem dɛ dento ne?”

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Balo maama de déem na jege kandwa-nyenno to de ma kwei-ya ba ja ba vo ba tiŋi lonne wonnu diga kam wone, ye Gereson tu Jeheli nii te baŋa ne.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam wo ma tiini ko pwoli de ba na pɛ wonnu dedɛ de ba wo maama ba ma ke pɛɛra ba pa Baŋa Wɛ to. Ba maama de Pɛ David tete maa tiini ba chaka. David wɛ-lworo

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: David ma zege kɔgɔ kom maama yiga ne o seini Baŋa Wɛ ye o we: “Pa-na se dé tei Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom debam nabaaro Isarele de déem na zuli to. Baŋa Wɛ, nmo maŋe se n jwoŋi zula se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Nmo kamunim, de dam, de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ, de paare daga dedɛ, nmo na tei logo baŋa de wɛyuu wonnu maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, dé ke nmo lei, ye dé daare dé tei n yere-kamunu kom mo.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: Amo de a nɔɔna bam nam ya muri se dé wane dé pa pɛɛra yanto de dé wo maama, jejegero maama na nwoŋi nmo tei ne to ŋwaane. Kolo na ye nmo nyem to mo dé jwoori dé kwei dé pa‑m.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Debam ye veira mo dé zoore logo konto wone, ne dé nabaara bam de déem na ye tei to. Dé ba jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne. Dé nam wó jei lela nenɛɛne luluŋu na pɔpɔ ko duri ko jei tei to mo.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ko ná ye pɛɛra yanto maama dé na jaane dé ba se dé ma dé lɔ diga kalo na wó taa zege nmo yere-kamunu kom zula ŋwaane to, ya maama maŋe ya ye nmo nyem mo.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: Yuu-Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye dé nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, de Isarele Wɛ to, nam pa n nɔɔna bam taa jege pempanno taa, se ba taa jege nmo chega se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Ta pa se amo bu Solomon yɔɔre o taa toŋe o tɔge n nia yam, de n chullu tem, de n bera yam maama. Woli‑o se o seene o yia o lɔ nmo diga kam a na maŋe a la ka yera zela yam a tiŋi se ba ma ba lɔ to.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: David laam ma ta de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama o we, “Tei-na abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ!” Ba maama ma tei Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye ba nabaara Wɛ to. Ba maa tiiri ba vwi ba yibia tega ne ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ, ba daare ba zuli Pɛ David tete de. Solomon leiri David yuu ne o ji pɛ

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne nɔɔna bam wo déem pwoli se ko gaale. Ba ma di wodi-fɔrɔ kuri Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Ba ma jwoori ba tiŋi Solomon paare dem se ko ke belei tu, se o wane o leiri o kwo David yuu ne o di paare dem. Ba ma kwei Wɛ swolim nuga ba lwo o yuu ne. Ba ta ma lwo nuga kam Zadoki yuu ne se o ji Wɛ kaanem tu.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Solomon ma leiri o kwo David yuu ne o di paare Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Wonnu maama déem ma ke lanyerane te pa Solomon. Isarele tiina bam maama maa sɛ o ni.

english_verse: Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him.
translation_verse: Teo kom dedɛɛra bam maama, de nɔn-yerro tem maama, ko woli de David bia bam maama déem ma sɛ se ba to ba pa Solomon.

english_verse: The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon. David Dies
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ Solomon tiini o na zula Isarele tiina bam maama tei ne. O ta ma pa se o paare dem jege nenɔŋa dedɛ se ko dwoni Isarele teo pwa balo na lwoori wonto na nɛ nenɔŋa kalo to. David paare dem seina

english_verse: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel
translation_verse: Jesse bu David déem mo di paare Isarele teo maama ne.

english_verse: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
translation_verse: David déem jege jejegero dedɛ ye nɔɔna nege‑o. O kwe o yi o maŋa mo ye o te. O bu Solomon ma leiri o yuu ne o di paare dem.

english_verse: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_verse: Ba déem popone ko tɔge o dam dem de o paare dem, de wonnu telo na yi o de Isarele tiina bam to, ko woli de wonnu telo na yi dwi-gɛ tiina de ba teene dem to mo ba tiŋi.

english_verse: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
translation_verse: O paare dim maŋa ne, lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa tiini te daga Jerusalem ne, ne kandwa mo tei. Sedare da-ŋonno de maa ba jege zore nenɛɛne kaporro na daga tei wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne to.

english_verse: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba na zege wara-vwei dem yiga ne konto to, mo Solomon fɔɔre o yi channa kaanem dakaa kam, ye o ke zwɛɛm kaanem kuni moro bimbini dem baŋa ne o pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Tete dem konto mo Wɛ veere o tete ded‑o, ye o we, “Solomon, lwoori n na lage kolo maama to, se amo wó pa‑m”.

english_verse: Solomon answered: Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel.
translation_verse: Solomon ma leiri o we, “Nmo déem jege a kwo David swono lanyerane, ye n daare n pa se a leiri o yuu ne a di paare dem.

english_verse: I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, laam pa se ni delo nmo na gwoni de amo kwo to ji chega. Kokuri to, nmo pɛ se amo mo ji pɛ se a taa tei kɔ-fɔrɔ kolo ni na daga dedɛ ne tega kasolo tei to.

english_verse: God replied: Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma leiri Solomon o we, “Nmo boboŋa yam lana dedɛ. Kokuri to, nmo wo lwoori-ne se n jwoŋi jejegero, naa nadunni, naa zula amo tei ne. Nmo ta ma‑n ba beeri toone se n pa n dona, naa se n jwoŋi momwɛ-dɛɛre n pa n tete. Ko nam ye swa de yeino mo n laga se n ta‑n mae n tei amo nɔɔna balo a na kwei a pa‑m se n ta‑n ye ba pɛ to.

english_verse: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel. Solomon's Wealth (
translation_verse: Solomon laam ma zege Gibeon wara-jei sem ne Wɛ wara-vwei dem na wo mɛ to o jwoori Jerusalem teo kom wo. O ma lɛɛre o jege Isarele teo paare dem o di.

english_verse: Solomon's merchants bought his horses and chariots in the regions of Musri and Kue. They paid

translation_verse: ) mo. Siseiŋa maa yeigi de lu-nyenno sabu-dala bi de finnu (

translation_verse: ). Pɛ wom pipim-piina bam déem yeini ba kwei torokooro de sisein-nɔɔna dedɛ ba yeigi ba pa Hiti tiina pwa bam de Aram tiina pwa mo.

english_verse: Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Solomon boboŋa déem nam ya jaane se o lɔ diga mo Baŋa Wɛ yere zula ŋwaane, se o daare o lɔ paare sɔ-fɔrɔ o pa o tete.

english_verse: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.
translation_verse: Diga kalo amo na lage a lɔ to wó taa tiini ka ye kamunu mo, debam Tu Wɛ wom na dwoi wa yadwonna yam maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
translation_verse: Hiram ta ma ta o we: “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina bam Wɛ to mo maŋe de tia. Wonto mo naane wɛyuu de tega baŋa maama. O nam pɛ bu wolo Pɛ David na loge to jege swa chekke, dedaane yi-poro, de boboŋ-laaro. O maa wó lɔ diga o pa Baŋa Wɛ, ye o ta lɔ sɔ-fɔrɔ o pa o tete.

english_verse: of them to cut stone from the hills. He chose
translation_verse: ) taa yare kandwa-zana peero jei sem ne, ye ba wo morro tetɔ de bia yaredo (

english_verse: others to supervise the workers and to make sure the work was completed.
translation_verse: ) de taa nii tontoŋena bam konto baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Amo ti a yiga mo se a lɔ diga a Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere zula ŋwaane. Ba laam maa wó pɔɔre-ka ba zege se ba yeini ba taa zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa da, se ba ta daare ba taa tigisi bworobworo kolo na tigi Wɛ yiga ne to ka wone maŋa de maŋa. Dáane mo ba ta wó yeini ba zwɛ kaanem pɛɛra tetete maama, de dedaan-ni maama, ko woli de Wɛ siu da yam ne, de chan-doŋa kura yam ne, de kura yalo maama na wora se dé taa mae dé zuli dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to. Mo o na pɛ debam Isarele tiina bam ni delo se dé taa ke taa wuu to.

english_verse: No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Wɔ nam mo yi se o lɔ diga o pa Baŋa Wɛ? Wɛyuu baŋa tete ne, pwola tera ka na maŋe ded‑o! Amo ye wɔ mo se a lɔ diga a pa‑o? Diga kam nam wó taa ye mɛ ba na wó taa zwɛ kaanem da ba pa‑o to mo.

english_verse: Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
translation_verse: Nam toŋe gɔgɔ na wae o kwei sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno, de channa, de luuru o toŋe totoŋa chekke to n pa-ne. english_verse: I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them,
translation_verse: Nam ta toŋe Lebanon teo Sedare da-kwollu, de teeni dedwonna da-ŋonno n pa-ne. Amo maane we, n nɔɔna bam tiini ba yei dɛ gwonim totoŋa abam jei sem ne. Amo nɔɔna wó woli de nmo nɔɔna bam,

english_verse: because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple.
translation_verse: se ba lage da-ŋonno se te taa daga. Kokuri to, diga kalo a na boŋe se a lɔ to jege se ka taa daga mo, ye ka jege nenɔŋa lanyerane.

english_verse: Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon: I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hiram na lage o leiri Solomon to, o popone tɔnɔ mo o pa‑o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na swoi o nɔɔna bam to ŋwaane mo o pɛ se nmo ji ba pɛ.”

english_verse: I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful.
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a toŋe Huram-Abi mo n tei ne, o na ye gɔgɔ chekke ye o jege yi-poro to ŋwaane.

english_verse: His mother was from the Israelite tribe of Dan, and his father was from Tyre. Not only is Huram an expert at working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, but he can also make colored cloth and fine linen. translation_verse: O nu maa ye Dan dwi dem bukɔ mo, ye o kwo de ye Tura teo tu. O yei ba na kwei sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno, de channa, de luuru, de kandwa, de dɛ ba gɔgere wonnu tei to. english_verse: I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there. Solomon's Work Force
translation_verse: Debam de wó gwoni Lebanon teo da-ŋonno se ko maŋe de nmo na lage tei maama to. Ba laam maa wó vɔ da-kwollu tem ba ke daane, ye ba daare ba de-te naneo kom ne ba yɛ ba vo ba yi Jopa. Nmo nɔɔna bam de laam maa wó jeeri da se ba kwei-te ba ja ba vo Jerusalem.”
