english_verse: He used precious stones to decorate the temple, and he used gold imported from Parvaim
translation_verse: O déem ta kwei kandwa-nyenno mo o ma o kwɛ Wɛ diga kam yera maama. Ba maa na mɛ sabu-seŋa kalo ba toŋe ka totoŋa to maa nwoŋi Paravayim ne.

english_verse: Five hundred and seventy grams of gold was used to cover the heads of the nails. The walls of the small storage rooms were also covered with gold.
translation_verse: Sabu-seŋa chena yalo ba na kwei ba ke da to dunni maa ma de sabu-dala finnu na ye tei to. Ba ta ma kwei sabu-seŋa ba taare di selo na lɔge se di to kabiri sem.

english_verse: Solomon had the inside walls of the temple's main room paneled first with pine and then with a layer of gold, and he had them decorated with carvings of palm trees and designs that looked like chains.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ diga kam tete, o déem pɛ se ba kwei da-pelwaro mo ba kwoli ka wo kabiri sem. O ta ma pa se ba kwei sabu-seŋa na ye chekke to ba taare se maama, ye ba daare ba gɔgere konkwara nyenyero, de nyenyero na lwoni chegero to ba ke da.

english_verse: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made to put in the most holy place, and he covered them with gold.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ di-yun-gala kam, Solomon pɛ se ba kwei dɛ mo ba sare cherubi selei nyenyero ba zege ka wone, ye ba taare-te de sabu-seŋa.

english_verse: Each creature had two wings and was four and a half meters from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing. Solomon set them next to each other in the most holy place, facing the doorway. Their wings were spread out and reached all the way across the nine-meter room.
translation_verse: Cherubi selei sem konto vɔna ná yarege ye ya dwei daane, ya maama ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei mo. Se nam zege se nɛ baŋa ne mo, ye se jeeri Wɛ diga kam ni dem.

english_verse: A curtain was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with designs of winged creatures. The Two Columns (
translation_verse: Ko ná ye gare-jale delo na wó lei de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to, Solomon ma pa ba kwei gare-ŋone selo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia, de nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to ba ma ba sɔ gare-fefale, ye ba daare ba gɔgere cherubi nyenyero ba ke se yera ne.

english_verse: Solomon had one of the columns placed on the south side of the temple's entrance; it was called Jachin. The other one was placed on the north side of the entrance; it was called Boaz.
translation_verse: O ma kwei ywoa yam o chwi Wɛ diga kam yiga ne, ka jazem seeni de ka jagwia seeni. O ma pa ba bwoi ywei delo na zege ka jazem seeni to we, ‘Jakim’. Delo maa na zege jagwia seeni to maa ye ‘Bowaza’.

english_verse: He also made ten small bowls and put five on each side of the large bowl. The small bowls were used to wash the animals that were burned on the altar as sacrifices, and the priests used the water in the large bowl to wash their hands.
translation_verse: O ta ma ke ware-zwe fuga, ye o zege senu diga kam jazem seeni, ye o daare o zege senu ka jagwia seeni. Ba déem jege vara balo ba na wó kwei ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem to mo ba zare zwe sem konto na bam wone. Ko daare, kaanem tiina bam de maa yeini ba sane ba je ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kom wo na bam wone.

english_verse: Solomon gave orders to build two courtyards: a smaller one that only priests could use and a larger one. The doors to these courtyards were covered with bronze.
translation_verse: O ma lɔ konkɔlɔ kolo na wora kaanem tiina bam ŋwaane to, dedaane konkɔlɔ-kamunu kom, de ko ni-bworru tem. O laam ma kwei channa o taare ko bworru tem maama.

english_verse: The large bowl called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the temple.
translation_verse: O ma kwei ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kom o zege Wɛ diga kam tega-kuri saŋa kam seeni se ko maŋe de ka gugworo kolo na jeeri wɛ-puli seeni to.

english_verse: Huram made shovels, sprinkling bowls, and pans for hot ashes. Here is a list of the other furnishings he made for God's temple:
translation_verse: Huram ta ma mɔ zwe selo ba na wó taa mae ba pɛ tentwarem to, de sɛbullu, de na-zwe. O déem ma toŋe Wɛ diga kam totoŋa yalo Pɛ Solomon na pɛ‑o to o ti.

english_verse: two columns, two bowl-shaped caps for the tops of these columns, two chain designs on the caps,
translation_verse: Ko maa ye: Channa ywoa yalei yam, de wo-sugila yalei yam na wo ya yuu ne to, de channa kam na lɛɛne daane ka kwoli wo-sugila yam to,

english_verse: the stands and the small bowls,
translation_verse: O déem ta mɔɔne torokooro tem, de te ware-zwe sem,

english_verse: the large bowl and the twelve bulls that held it up,
translation_verse: dedaane ware-zon-zɔŋɔ kom, de ko kuri channa nabɛ nyenyero fuga-selei sem,

english_verse: by pouring melted bronze into the clay molds he had set up near the Jordan River, between Succoth and Zeredah.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom déem pɛ ba mɔ tento maama kamɔ-mɔra jeiga kalo na wo Jɔdan bwolo kom ne se ko maŋe de Sukofa de Zereda tetare laŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: There were so many bronze furnishings that no one ever knew how much bronze it took to make them.
translation_verse: Solomon déem pɛ ba ke wonnu tento dedɛ mo. Mo kokuri ba wo lɔre te channa kam dunni na mae tei to.

english_verse: Solomon also gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar, the tables that held the sacred loaves of bread,
translation_verse: Solomon déem pɛ ba ke Wɛ diga kam wo zela yam maama. Ko maa ye: Sabu-seŋa bimbini dem, de tabollo telo baŋa ne ba na tiŋi bworobwooru tem na zege Wɛ yiga ne to mo.

english_verse: whose wings covered both the chest and the poles used for carrying it.
translation_verse: Cherubi selei sem vɔna yam twe mo wɛɛne ya kwoli dakaa kam de ka dɛ selo ba na mae ba zeŋe-ka to.

english_verse: The priests of every group had gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable to the Lord. The Levite musicians, including Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and relatives, were wearing robes of fine linen. They were standing on the east side of the altar, playing cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments. One hundred and twenty priests were with these musicians, and they were blowing trumpets. They were praising the Lord by playing music and singing: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.” Suddenly a cloud filled the temple as the priests were leaving the holy place.
translation_verse: Nabɔn-wura bam, de lein-leena bam kwɛɛra zela sɔɔ kom maŋe daane lanyerane pa kwora dedoa zaŋe wɛɛne ka seini Baŋa Wɛ. Ba ma leeni ba tei Baŋa Wɛ ye ba we: “O tiini o lamma, ye o swono kom wora taa wuu.” Kunkwoŋo ma pɔpɔ ko zo ko su Baŋa Wɛ diga kam maama.

english_verse: Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple.
translation_verse: se ba ja ba zo Wɛ diga kam. Levi tiina bam de kaanem tiina bam de ma zeŋe Wɛ wara-vwei dem dedaane de yera zela yam maama ba ja ba kɛ.

english_verse: The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.
translation_verse: Dɛ sem konto tiini se dɔra dedɛ. Ko ma pa se nɔɔno ná zo Wɛ diga kam o zege ka ni ne, o wae o tole o nae dɛ sem. Ko nam ná ye pwooni dem ne mo o zega, o ba nae-se. Se ta zege da de zem maama.

english_verse: The only things kept in the chest were the two flat stones Moses had put there when the Lord made his agreement with the people of Israel at Mount Sinai, after bringing them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo yerane déem na wo Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam wone to mo ye kandwa-pelɛ selei selo Moses déem na kwei o ke-da Sinayi peo kom baŋa ne to. Dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ déem gwoni ni de Isarele tiina bam maŋa kalo ba na nwoŋi Ejipti ne ba kɛ to.

english_verse: The Lord's glory was in that cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina bam ware ba jwoori ba zo da ba toŋe ba totoŋa, kunkwoŋo kom na wora ye Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom pwooni yɔɔre de pe jei sem maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now I've built a glorious temple where you can live forever.” Solomon Speaks to the People (
translation_verse: Amo nam lɔge sɔ-fɔrɔ mo a pa‑m, se n ta‑n zoore ko wone taa wuu.”

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: O ma lwoori Wɛ o we: “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to, wɛ dedwoŋi tera wɛyuu ne naa tega baŋa ne de na nye de nmo. Nmo yɔɔre n swoi balo na tɔge n chwei sem de ba wo maama to, de n na yeini n ke n sui ni delo n na gwoni de-ba se n ke to.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you, and so whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo de n nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam, dé ná zege dé jeeri nmo diga kam se dé lwoori‑m, se n jeini n wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom wone n cheigi dé wɛ-lworo n daare n yage n chɛ debam.

english_verse: and said: Praise the Lord God of Israel! He brought his people out of Egypt long ago and later kept his promise to make my father David the king of Israel. The Lord also promised him that Jerusalem would be the city where his temple will be built, and now that promise has come true.
translation_verse: Ko laam nam na ye tei to, amo mo kuri Jerusalem se ko taa ye teo kolo wone ba na wó taa zuli-ne to, ye a daare a kuri David se o taa di paare a nɔɔna bam baŋa ne.’ ”

english_verse: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build the temple to honor me.”
translation_verse: Ko nam dae nmo mo jege se n lɔ diga kam n pa-ne. Se ko ye nmo tete bu mo wó lɔ diga kam amo yere zula ŋwaane.’

english_verse: I've also put the sacred chest in the temple. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he rescued them from Egypt. Solomon Prays at the Temple (

translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ke o chɔge o dwoŋi yiga ye ba ja‑o ba zo nmo diga kam wone se o zege nmo kaanem bimbini dem yiga ne o du duuri we, o wo ke o chɔge,

english_verse: Earlier, Solomon had a bronze platform made that was about two meters square and over a meter high, and he put it in the center of the outer courtyard near the altar. Solomon stood on the platform facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven; he knelt down
translation_verse: O nam ya pɛ ba ke channa bimbini mo ba kwei ba zege Wɛ diga kam pwooni yiga konkɔlɔ kom tetare dem ne. De dedɔrem baŋa maŋem dedaane de kayɔlɔ baŋa maŋem déem ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni benu mo. De wɛ-baŋa maŋem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni betɔ. Solomon ma vo o zege bimbini dem konto baŋa ne o kuni nadwoona, ye o daare o zeiŋi o je sem wɛyuu ne.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo kwo David na ye nmo tontoŋeno to, nmo na tiŋi ni ded‑o se n ke tei to, mo n seene n ke te maama se ko ba ko yi zem.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo wó seene n ta‑n zoore de nabiina tega baŋa ne na? Wɛyuu de wɛ-baŋa jei sem maama ne, pwola tera ka na maŋe de nmo. Tetɛ mo diga kanto a na lɔge to wó wane ka yi n zoorem?

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: Popo, pa se n yia taa page diga kanto baŋa ne maŋa maama, tete de wea. Nmo maŋe n ta we ka zege n yere dem zula ŋwaane mo. Maŋa kalo maama ne a ná zege a jeeri diga kanto a lwoori‑m, se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: jeini telaao ne n cheigi ba keira kam konto. Seene n yage ba wɛleera yam n ma‑n chɛ-ba, n daare n ja-ba n jwoori tega kalo nmo na kwei n pa ba de ba nabaara bam to.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name,
translation_verse: Nmo nɔɔna bam wɛleera ná pɛ se n ja kunkwoŋo kom pa se doa ba nena, ye ba laam ná leiri ba wo ba zege ba jeeri n diga kam ba ma n yere dem ba lwoori wolim nmo tei ne de n na waare-ba tei to,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And send rain on the land you promised them forever.
translation_verse: nam jeini Wɛ telaao ne n cheigi ba keira kam. Yage n nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam wɛleera n chɛ-ba, se n daare n bere-ba chwo-laao se ba taa tɔga. Pa se doa jwoori ka ne tega kanto n na kwei n pa n nɔɔna se ba taa tei to baŋa ne.

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Da-kore de jawe-chɛɛro ná tu te yi ba tega kam, ye jaweero naa kayere dwi dwi ná chɔge ba kara wodiiru tem, ye ba dona ná zaŋe ba teo kolo maama baŋa ne, naa ko ná ye lɛɛro telo maama mo yi n nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam,

english_verse: Please listen when anyone in Israel truly feels sorry and sincerely prays with arms lifted toward your temple.
translation_verse: cheigi ba keira kam. Ba wolo maama ná zeiŋi o jea o jeeri n diga kanto ye o lwoori‑m naa o keeri o jare‑m, o wo na tiini ko chɔge to ŋwaane,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: se n jeini n wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne n cheigi o keira kam konto. Yage ba maama wɛleera n chɛ-ba se n daare n woli-ba. Ke de ba dedoa dedoa se ko maŋe de ba kikia na ye tei to, nmo yerane mo na yei nabiinu boboŋa na ye tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then your people will worship you and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa se n nɔɔna bam taa kɔre‑m, ye ba taa tɔge n chwei sem da yalo maama ba na wó taa ŋwe ye ba zoore tega kalo nmo na kwei n pa dé nabaara bam to wone.

english_verse: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: Nmo nɔɔna bam ná nwoŋi se ba vo mɛ maama n na toŋe-ba se ba kwaare jara de ba dona, ye ba ná zege ba jeeri teo konto n na kuri to, de Wɛ diga kanto a na lɔga nmo yere dem zula ŋwaane to ba lwoori wolim nmo tei ne,

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na ba ke wɛleera. Nmo nɔɔna bam nam ná ke wɛleera pa se nmo bane zaŋe de-ba, n wae n yage se ba dona di-ba pa se ba ji peena sa-teo ne yiga yiga naa bwola bwola de.

english_verse: Later, they may feel sorry for what they did and ask your forgiveness. translation_verse: se n jeini n wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne, n cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom de ba keira kam, se n daare n ke chega n pa-ba. Nam kwei n nɔɔna na ke kolo maama ba chɔge n yiga to n yage n chɛ-ba.

translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam zaŋe n ba n zo n jeiŋa jei sem ne! Tɔge de n ni-gwonim dakaa kam n ba n ta‑n zoore da, se n dam dem bere jaja! english_verse: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.

english_verse: When the crowd of people saw the fire and the Lord's glory, they knelt down and worshiped the Lord. They prayed: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.”
translation_verse: Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama na nɛ we, mini nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba tega, ye Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de jwoŋi Wɛ diga kam to mo ba vwi ba yibia tega ne ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. Ba ma ke o lei ba we: “O tiini o lamma, ye o swono kom wora taa wuu.”

english_verse: Solomon and the people dedicated the temple to the Lord by sacrificing
translation_verse: Pɛ wom déem kwei naane morro finlei-telei (

english_verse: Then they will answer, “It was because the people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.”

english_verse: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O de o jar-keira bam ma wane Judah kateiri teene delo maama na lɔge de pe to ba di, ye ba laam vo ba yi Jerusalem.

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah had gone to Jerusalem to escape Shishak's invasion. And while they were there, Shemaiah the prophet told them, “The Lord says that because you have disobeyed him, he has now abandoned you. The Lord will not help you against Shishak!”
translation_verse: Rehoboam de Judah teo dedɛɛra bam ya vei Jerusalem se ba duri ba lu Sisake jeŋa ne mo. Wɛ sampwora Semaya ma vo ba tei ye o ta de-ba o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Abam na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo amo de nwoŋi abam kwaga ne ye a ke abam Sisake jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: Rehoboam and the leaders were sorry for what they had done and admitted, “The Lord is right. We have deserted him.”
translation_verse: Pɛ Rehoboam de o dedɛɛra bam ma gwooni ba tete Wɛ yiga ne ye ba we, “Baŋa Wɛ seene o jege chega de kolo o na ke to.”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he told Shemaiah: The people of Judah are truly sorry for their sins, and so I won't let Shishak completely destroy them. But because I am still angry,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na nɛ ba na gwooni ba tete tei to, o daa ma pa o kwora yi Semaya we, “Nɔɔna bam na gwooni ba tete konto to, amo bá chɔge-ba fase. Ko ná ke fee, a daa ta wó jwoŋi-ba. A bá tɔge Sisake baŋa ne a waare Jerusalem.

english_verse: he will conquer and rule them. Then my people will know what it's like to serve a foreign king instead of serving me.
translation_verse: A nam wó pa chwoŋa se Sisake ja-ba o ke o dam kuri ne. Konto wó pa ba lɔre kɔ mo gara, ne ba ná toŋe ba pa amo, naa ba ná toŋe ba pa dwi-gɛ tiina pwa bam mo.”

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Pɛ Rehoboam ma kwei channa o ma o jwoori o ke nantane sedwonna o zege da. O ma kwei-se o ke babɛ selo na yere pɛ sɔŋɔ manchwoŋo ni dem to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he had finished worshiping.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo maama pɛ wom na wó vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem to, babɛ sem mo jege se ba zeŋe nantane sem ba tɔge o kwaga. Ba daa ná ti, banto ta mo wó zeŋe-se ba jwoori ba tiŋi pɛ sɔŋɔ yerena diga kam ne.

english_verse: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord, and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again. Rehoboam's Rule in Judah (
translation_verse: Rehoboam na gwooni o tete Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne konto to, Baŋa Wɛ ma de o bane na wone, ye o daa wo yɔɔre o chɔge‑o fase. Wonnu déem nam ke lanyerane te pa Judah laŋa kam.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king, including a history of his family, is written in the records of the two prophets, Shemaiah and Iddo. During Rehoboam's rule, he and King Jeroboam of Israel were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Rehoboam déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, ko zege o paare dem boboa ne se ko yi de na kweeli maŋa kalo to, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Wɛ sampwora Semaya tɔnɔ kom wone, de Yi-naro Ido veera yam tɔnɔ kom wone. O kwoa nakwa yera natɔga de popone ya tiŋi da. Maŋa kam konto maama ne tigura déem mo tigi Pɛ Rehoboam de Pɛ Jeroboam tetare ne.

english_verse: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Jeroboam paare dim bena fuga-nana bene dem wone mo Abija déem di Judah teo paare.

english_verse: and the troops let out a battle cry. Then with Abijah leading them into battle, God defeated Jeroboam and Israel's army.
translation_verse: ye Judah tiina bam maama kaase tiguri-kaasa. Jeroboam de Isarele jar-keira bam na nigi sɔɔ kom to, Wɛ ma pa ba duri se ba lu Abija de Judah tiina bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Now you and your powerful army think you can stand up to the kingdom that the Lord has given to David's descendants. The only gods you have are those gold statues of calves that Jeroboam made for you.
translation_verse: Abam de nam kwaane se á ve paare delo Baŋa Wɛ na tiŋi o pa David dwi dem to mo. Á kɔgɔ kom seene ko daga lanyerane. Abam ta maa jege Jeroboam na kwei sabu-seŋa o mɔ na-mɔre kamwaro telo se á ta‑á zuli to á tei ne.

english_verse: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.
translation_verse: O déem jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem bena yatɔ mo. O nu yere mo ye Maaka wolo na ye Gibea tu Yureli bukɔ to. Jara déem ma to Abija de Jeroboam tetare laŋa ne.

english_verse: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!
translation_verse: Abija déem ma vo o zege Zemarayim peo kom yuu ne. Peo kom konto wo Efrayim zwonnu laŋa kam ne mo. O ma tɔɔle baŋa baŋa o we: “Jeroboam, de Isarele tiina bam maama, cheigi-na a taane dem.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has made a solemn promise that every king of Israel will be from David's family.
translation_verse: Abam yɔɔre á yei we, Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to maŋe o gwoni ni de David we, o wó kwei Isarele teo paare dem o pa wonto de o dwi dem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Then right after Rehoboam became king, you and your bunch of worthless followers challenged Rehoboam, who was too young to know how to stop you.
translation_verse: O ma beeri nɔn-wo-korro o de o kwaga ne pa ba vo ba dwoni de Solomon bu Rehoboam. Ka maŋa ne de Rehoboam ta ware se o kuri o tete boboŋa o tɔge-ya. O maa bwona se o wane ba yiga o che.

english_verse: You don't even have descendants of Aaron on your side, because you forced out the Lord's priests and Levites. In their place, you appoint ordinary people to be priests, just as the foreign nations do. In fact, anyone who brings a bull and seven rams to the altar can become a priest of your so-called gods.
translation_verse: Nam yé swei-na we á zeili Aron bia bam na ye Baŋa Wɛ kaanem tiina to, de Levi dwi tiina bam mo. Abam laam ma lwoni teene dedwonna kikia de á na kuri á tete kaanem tiina to. Wolo maama maa ná wane o ja na-bala, de pi-bale serepɛ o ba o ma o ke pɛɛra, konto tu wae o kwɛ o tete se o ji kaanem tu o kaane abam wa-yɔɔro tem.

english_verse: But we have not turned our backs on the Lord God! Aaron's own descendants serve as our priests, and the Levites are their assistants.
translation_verse: Debam nam ta zuli dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo, ye dé wo yage‑o. Aron dwi dem nɔɔna mo ye Baŋa Wɛ kaanem tiina debam tei ne, ye Levi dwi tiina bam yeini ba toŋe ba woli-ba.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Tetete maama de dedaan-ni maama ne, ba yeini ba ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra mo, ye ba zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ba ta yeini ba kwei bworobworo mo ba tiŋi tabolo kolo ba na kwɛ Wɛ ŋwaane to baŋa ne, ye ba daare ba tɔre min-zwonnu tem na zege sabu-seŋa min-zwon-zego kom baŋa ne to dedaan-ni maama ne. Konto to, debam yɔɔre dé ke tei dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ na bere se dé taa ke to mo. Ko nam ná ye abam, á nwoŋi o kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na we, Wɛ seene o wo debam tei ne. Wonto mo ye debam yiga tu. O kaanem tiina bam mo ti ba yiga se ba wu nabwanno se dé laam kwaare jara de abam. Isarele tiina bam, yé dwoni-na de Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye á nabaara bam Wɛ to, bɛŋwaane á bá na ko kuri.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Abija ta na zege da o ŋɔɔne konto to, mo Jeroboam toŋe o jar-keira badwonna se ba dale ba tɔge Judah jar-keira bam kwaga seeni ba zaŋe ba baŋa ne de jara. Balo na daare to de maa wo Judah tiina bam yiga seeni.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abija de o nɔɔna bam ma pare Jeroboam taa. Ba ma vere teene dedwonna o tei ne ba tei. Teene dem konto nam ye Bɛtel, de Jesana, de Eforon, ko woli de de nawuura yam maama.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Abija paare dim maŋa kam maama wone, Jeroboam daa wo jwoori o na dam. Baŋa Wɛ ma waare Jeroboam pa o te.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Asa déem ke wo-laaro mo, ye o totoŋa su o Tu Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: O ma ja bimbin-yɔɔro tem, de zwonnu yuu wara-jei sem o chɔge. O ta ma lɔ kandwa yalo ba na jege ba zuli to, ye o daare o chochoge Asera nyenyego dɛ sem o yage.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: O laam ma pa Judah dwi tiina bam ni we, ba taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye ba nabaara bam Wɛ to, se ba daare ba taa sɛ o nia yam de o bera yam.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: O déem ma ta de Judah tiina bam o we, “Pa-na se dé fɔge dé pe teene dem dé zege de dam, se de taa jege kabiri-lilirru, de ni-bworru telo na jege luuru to. Tega kam ta ye debam nyem mo, dé na ke dé tɔge dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa to ŋwaane. Wonto mo chege debam dé dona jeŋa ne pa ba ba daane debam.” Ba ma seene ba lɔ ba teene dem ba pe, ye wonnu ke lanyerane te pa-ba.

english_verse: Asa had a large army of brave soldiers:
translation_verse: Asa déem jege jar-keira morro bia yatɔ (

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Asa déem ma lwoori o Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom o we, “Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yerane mo wae nabwona n jwoŋi n yaga dedɛɛra kɔgɔ jeŋa ne. Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, dé teege nmo baŋa ne mo se n woli debam. Ko nam ye nmo yere dem ŋwaane mo debam nwoŋi se dé jeeri kɔ-fɔrɔ konto de jara. Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye debam Wɛ wom. Nam yé sɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno dwoni de nmo o di.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma chɔge Kusi tiina bam pa se ba duri se ba lu Asa de Judah jar-keira bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Asa de o nɔɔna bam ma pare-ba taa ba vo ba yi Gerare seeni. Kusi tiina bam dedɛ ma te pa ba kɔgɔ kom daa ware jara yam se ba ke. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ de o jar-keira bam déem yɔɔre ba wane-ba mo. Judah tiina bam ma pɛ ba dona bam jejegero dedɛ ba ja ba viiri.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Ba déem ta ma chɔge te-balwa balo na gilimi Gerare teo kom to, Baŋa Wɛ foone na tiini de jege jei sem konto nɔn-bia bam to ŋwaane. Judah tiina bam ma lɛɛre ba pɛ teene dem konto maama jejegero ba ja ba viiri, te na tiini te daga to ŋwaane.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma vo ba li napɔra balo na yere vara bam to, ye ba kale pei, de bone, de kona dedɛ ba ja ba kɛ. Ba laam ma jwoori ba vo Jerusalem.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Wɛ Jworo déem tu Odeda bu Azaria baŋa.

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: O ma nwoŋi o vo Asa tei o ta ded‑o o we: “Pɛ Asa, de Judah tiina bam, de Benjamin tiina bam maama, cheigi-na a taane dento: Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo abam tei ne, ne á ná yɔɔre á me ded‑o. Á ná beeri o jei, o wó pa abam chwoŋa se á na‑o. Abam nam ná nwoŋi o kwaga ne, o de wó dole abam mo o yage.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Bena dedɛ wone Isarele tiina bam wo sɛ se ba tɔge Wɛ dem chekke, ye ba ba jege kaanem tu se kotu taa bere-ba. Ba maa wo lɔre Wɛ nia yam.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, nɔɔna déem ba beeri yɔɔ yɔɔ, vuvuga na to teene dem maama de de nɔn-bia baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Dwi dedwe yɔɔre de zaŋe de chɔge dedwoŋi dwi yɔɔ yɔɔ mo, ye teo dedoa nɔɔna de zaŋe teo kodwoŋi nɔɔna baŋa ne. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo jaane lɛɛro dwi maama o tui ba baŋa.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Asa na nigi Wɛ sampwora Azaria na pworisi taane delo maama to mo o nɛ baare. O ma le jwo-yɔɔro telo na wo Judah de Benjamin kateira yam maama wone to o dole o yage. Ko ta ná ye teene delo na wo Efrayim zwonnu laŋa kam ne ye o vere-de o tei to, o dole ba jwona yam de o yage. O laam ma pa ba fɔge ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem na zege Wɛ diga kam napɔrɔ kom yiga ne to.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Asa déem ma bwoŋi Judah dwi tiina, de Benjamin dwi tiina bam se ba la daane. O ta ma bwoŋi nɔɔna balo na nwoŋi Efrayim, de Manasɛ, de Simeon dwia yam wone ye ba laam ba ba zoore Judah laŋa kam ne to. Kokuri to, Isarele tiina dedɛ ya tu ba sɛ ba pa Asa, ba na maane we o Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wo o tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba maama déem nam jeeri Jerusalem ne Asa paare dim bena fuga-yanu chane setɔ chana kam wone mo.

english_verse: sheep and goats from what they had brought back from Gerar and sacrificed them as offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: ) ba ke kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Vara bam konto nam ye ba na vere balo ba dona bam jeŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ke ni-sɛɛm se ba yɔɔre ba taa tɔge Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye ba nabaara Wɛ to de ba bochara maama, ko woli de ba dam maama.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma du duuri Baŋa Wɛ yere dem ŋwaane ba vɔ ba tete. Ba nam yɔɔre ba kwei sɔɔ kolo na zaŋe baŋa baŋa to, de nabwanno wum, de namunnu wum mo ba du duuri dem de kwor-dɛa.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Asa nu nakwe Maaka ya chwi Asera nyenyego daa pa nɔɔna jege-ka ba kaana. O ma vo o gwoni-ka o de tega ne o daare o kwei-ka o zwɛ Kidoron nabara kam ni ne. O ta ma le Maaka se o daa yé taa jege dam pɛ sɔŋɔ ne.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Asa déem wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbini selo na wo Isarele laŋa kam maama wone to. De ko de, o ŋwea maama wone o yɔɔre o kwei o chega o pa Baŋa Wɛ mo.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Asa déem ma kwei lu-nyenno wonnu de sabu-seŋa wonnu telo na wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam de o tete sɔŋɔ wone to o pa se nɔɔna ja-te ba vo Siria teo pɛ Ben-hadadi tei Damasika ne.

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: O ma toŋe kwora o we, “Pa se dé gwoni ni daane, nenɛɛne ko déem na ye tei nmo kwo de amo kwo tetare laŋa ne to. Nii mo, a jege lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa mo se a pa‑m. Nam sɛ se n yiri ni delo n déem na ke de Isarele teo pɛ Baasa to, se ko pa o viiri o daare a laŋa kam.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Ben-hadadi ma sɛ Pɛ Asa na tage tei to. O ma toŋe o jar-keira de ba yiga tiina se ba vo ba kwaare jara de Isarele tiina bam. Jara yam wone, ba ma wane ba jwoŋi Yijon, de Dan, de Abel-Mayim, dedaane Nafitali teene delo ba na yeini ba kwei ba zela ba tiŋi de wone to maama.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Baasa na yɔɔre o ni konto to, o ma yage Rama teo kom lɔɔm de o totoŋe dwi maama.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: O na viiri to, Pɛ Asa ma pa se Judah tiina maama vo ba zeŋe kandwa yam, de da-kwollu tem Baasa nɔɔna bam ya na jege ba lɔ teo kom to ba ja ba kɛ. Pɛ Asa déem kwei wonnu tem konto mo o ma o lɔ Geba de Mizipa teene dem.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Konto na ke ko kɛ to, mo Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Hanani vei Judah teo pɛ Asa tei ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo na ve se n kwei n teena n daŋe n Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom baŋa ne, ye n pa n teena wo Siria pɛ wom wone to ŋwaane, nam ta‑n yei we Siria pɛ wom de o jar-keira bam yɔɔre ba lu n jeŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Kusi tiina bam, de Libia tiina bam déem jege jar-keira kɔ-fɔrɔ, de jara torokooro dedɛ, dedaane sisein-dira dedɛ. De ko maama de, Baŋa Wɛ déem kwei-ba o ke n dam kuri ne, n teena na daŋe o baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yia yam nam dole ya kaare tega baŋa ni maama se o nii balo na yɔɔre ba ke ba teena o wone to baŋa ne se o daare o pa-ba dam. Nmo nam toŋe jworim mo de n na ke tei to. Konto ŋwaane, ko zege zem se ko taa via, nmo laam wó ta‑n zoore jara-keim wone mo taa.”

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Asa na nigi Hanani taane dem to, o bane ma tiini de zaŋe pa o ja Hanani o pe peena diga ne. O déem ta yɔɔre o jege o nɔɔna bam badaara mo o bɛɛsa.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: O na di paare o ke bena fintɔ-nogo maŋa kalo ne to mo jaweo to o nɛ ne pa se o gwarege. O jaweo kom na tu ko chɛ to, o wo lwoori wolim Baŋa Wɛ tei ne, ye o tɔge liri-keira se ba nii o baŋa ne.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli yibeeli delo o ya na bɔɔre o tiŋi David teo Jerusalem wone to. Ba ma daŋe‑o gandwa baŋa ne, ye ba kwei talwoŋ-ywei de terale nwi dwi dwi ba ke da. Ba ta ma tɔrege min-vo-zɔŋɔ se ba zuli o yere.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: O ma kwei jar-keira o zege teene delo na lɔge de pe to maama wone o che-de. O ta ma pa jar-keira badwonna zege ba che Judah teene dedwonna, dedaane Efrayim teene delo o kwo Asa ya na wane o di jara baŋa ne to.

translation_verse: O nam sɛ se o taa zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom o kwo de déem na zuli to, ye o ke o tɔge Wɛ nia yam. O wo lwoni Isarele tiina kikia yam.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”

translation_verse: Mikaya laam ma ta o we, “A nɛ Isarele jar-keira bam maama na jage peero tem baŋa ne ye ba beeri yɔɔ yerane, nenɛɛne pei selo na ba jege nayero to. Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, ‘Nɔɔna banto ba jege yuu tu. Yage-na se ba jwoori sɔŋɔ chemm de yazura.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord asked, “Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed?” They talked about it for a while,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we, ‘Wɔ mo wó sɛ o vo o gane Isarele teo pɛ Ahab se o vo Ramofa-Gilead o ke jara de-ba se o ga o ŋwea?’ Kɔgɔ kom maama dedoa dedoa ma ta o boboŋa.

translation_verse: Chichira kam ma leiri ka we, ‘A lage a vo a pa se Ahab sampwori sem pworisi vwa pworisim mo.’ Baŋa Wɛ maa we, ‘Nmo wó na chwoŋa se n soge‑o. Nam véi n ke konto.’

english_verse: Jehoshaphat returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, but he often traveled through his kingdom, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north. He talked with the people and convinced them to turn back to the Lord God and worship him, just as their ancestors had done.
translation_verse: Jehosafate déem zoore Jerusalem teo kom wone mo. O ma yeini o kwei maŋa o tole o paare laŋa kam ni maama, ko zege Beeriseba ne se ko yi Efrayim zwonnu laŋa kam. O ma yeini o kaane-ba se ba pipiri ba jwoori ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye ba nabaara Wɛ to.

english_verse: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah
translation_verse: Judah laŋa kam maama ne mo o kuri yiga tiina o yage teene delo na lɔge de pe to wone.

english_verse: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Fɔge-na á ta‑á yei á tete. Kolo ŋwaane, abam ná bore nɔɔna bora, ko ye se ko tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa mo, se ko dae de nabiina na lage tei to. Wonto nam wó taa wo á tei ne se á ta‑á yeini á bore nɔɔna taane á pa-ba.

english_verse: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: O déem nam wo wane o chɔge wara-jei bimbina yam. Nɔɔna ya ta wo ke ba boboŋa ne se ba taa zuli ba nabaara Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Jehosafate déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo maama to, ko zege o paare dem boboa ne se ko yi de na kweeli maŋa kalo to, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Hanani bu Jehu memaŋa tɔnɔ kom wone, ye te ta wo Isarele teo pwa tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Jehosafate ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o kwoa bam yibeeli wone David teo Jerusalem ne. O toone dem kwaga ne o bu Jehoram ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Jehoram paare dim maŋa ne mo Edom dwi dem ve se ba taa wo Judah pɛ wom dam kuri ne. Ba ma lɛɛre ba tiŋi ba tete pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni mo Baŋa Wɛ chiŋi Filisi tiina bam, de Arabi tiina balo déem na zoore ba twɛ de Kusi tiina bam to o yage Jehoram yera ne.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Ba kwo déem kwei lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa zela yalo na jege kuri to mo o pa ba maama. O ta ma pa-ba teene delo na wo Judah ne ye de lɔ de pe to. Ko nam ná ye paare dem, o kwei-de o pa Jehoram mo, o na ye o bu-kwea to ŋwaane. Judah teo pɛ Jehoram taane

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Jehoram na yɔɔre o jeini o kwo paare dem ne o ti to, mo o go o nyaana bam maama, ko woli de Isarele teo dedɛɛra badaara.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Jehoram déem kwei Isarele pwa bam totoŋ-naga mo, ne Pɛ Ahab de o dwi dem na ke tei to, kokuri to o di Ahab bukɔ mo. Konto to, o déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wo sɛ se o chɔge Pɛ David dwi dem, bɛŋwaane o maŋe o gwoni ni ded‑o we, o diga kam wó taa tei paare dem taa wuu.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: De zem maama Edom tiina ta ve mo se ba taa wo Judah tiina dam kuri ne. Libina teo tiina de déem ke konto dwoŋi mo. Ko ye Jehoram na mɛ o kwaga o ya Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye o nabaara Wɛ to ŋwaane mo ko déem ke konto.

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: O déem ta lɔge wara-jei bimbina Judah zwonnu tem yuu ne mo. Konto ma pa Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam tusi mo de ba na dɛ ba zuli jwona ba daare Baŋa Wɛ to.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo Jehoram jwoŋi tɔnɔ Wɛ sampwora Elija jeŋa ne ye ko popone we: “Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye n kwo David Wɛ to mo taga o we: Nmo wo sɛ se n kwei n kwo Jehosafate totoŋ-naga kam, naa n kwo-nakwe Asa totoŋ-naga kam de.

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: Nmo nam na ke tei to, n kwei Isarele pwa totoŋ-naga kam mo n tɔga. N ma‑n da ko ŋwaane n pa Judah tiina de Jerusalem tiina bam yage Baŋa Wɛ, ba daa ba zuli‑o, nenɛɛne Ahab de o kwaga kam de na ke tei to. Ko woli da, n ta yɔɔre n go n nyaana balo na ye n tete kwo bia to. Banto nam ya gare‑m.

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ de laam nam yɔɔre o ti o yiga mo se o dole n nɔɔna bam jaguli-zane, ko woli de n bia, de n kaana, de n n na jege kolo maama to.

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Wonnu tento maama kwaga ne, Baŋa Wɛ ma pa jawe-chɛɔ ja Jehoram o wo loro tem ne, ye ko yɔɔrem tera.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Bena yalei na kɛ to mo o wo loro tem tage te nwoŋi, pa o na zonne dedɛ ye o te. O nɔɔna bam déem maa wo tɔrege min-vo-zɔŋɔ se ba ma zuli o yere, ne ba na yeini ba ke tei o nabaara bam toone baŋa ne to.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Jehu na yɔɔre o wora o chɔge Ahab dwi dem konto to, mo o nɛ Judah teo nakwa badaara, de Ahazia zembaara bam bia badwonna. Ahazia na vei se o daane Joram jaweo kom to, banto ya tɔge o kwaga mo. Jehu ma go ba maama.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, mo o toŋe o nɔɔna se ba beeri Ahazia jei. Ba ma na we, o vei o seigi o tete Samaria ne mo. Ba ma zi‑o ba ja ba vo Jehu tei ye o de go‑o. Ba ma da o kwo-nakwe Jehosafate yere ŋwaane ba kwei Ahazia ba suli. Kokuri to, ba déem tage ba tete ne mo ba we, “Jehosafate déem zuli Baŋa Wɛ de o bochare maama, ye Ahazia de ye o naa mo.” Nɔɔn-nɔɔno déem daa maa wo daare Ahazia dwi dem wone se kotu wane o di Judah paare dem. Atalia de Joasa taane

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: O tiini o toŋe lwarem o ma o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga, ne Ahab dwi dem na ke tei to. Kokuri to, o kwo toone kwaga ne, banto mo yeini ba bere‑o pa o tusa.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: O ma sɛ ba bera yam pa se o da de Isarele teo pɛ Ahab bu Joram o vo Ramofa-Gilead se ba kwaare jara de Siria teo pɛ Hazayeli. Siria tiina bam ma ke Joram zonne jara yam wone.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Ahazia na vei se o daane Joram jaweo kom to, Wɛ déem tɔge o keim dem konto baŋa ne mo se o pa o paare dem ti. O ta na wo Joram tei ne to mo ba tɔge daane ba vo se ba na Nimisi bu Jehu. Baŋa Wɛ nam ya maŋe o kuri Jehu mo se o pa Ahab dwi dem yere saare.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Ba na tu se ba go pɛ wom bia bam to, Pɛ Jehoram bukɔ Jehoseba ma ŋɔ Ahazia bu-seseŋa kam yere na ye Joasa to o seigi. O ma kwei bu wom de kaane wolo na jege‑o o kɔna to o vo o seigi o peiga jei ne se Atalia yé na‑o. Jehoseba déem ye Ahazia nakɔ ye o kwori o ye Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada kaane. Ko ma pa se o seigi Joasa pa se Atalia wo nɛ chwoŋa se o go‑o.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Pɛ Ahazia nu Atalia na maane we o bu wom tega to, o ma zaŋe se o pa ba go Judah pa-diga kam nɔn-bia maama.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Joasa déem maŋe ba tei ne bena yaredo mo, ye ba seigi‑o Wɛ wara-jei sem diga kadwoŋi wone. Maŋa kam konto ne Atalia ma nii Judah teo paare dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam konto ma tole Judah teene dem maama wone ba la Levi tiina bam, de Isarele sɔ-yuni yiga tiina bam ba ke daane. Ba maama laam ma vo Jerusalem

english_verse: Jehoiada and his sons brought Joash outside, where they placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of the instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, and the crowd cheered and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada de o bia bam déem ma ja pɛ wom bu Joasa ba ja ba nwoŋi. Ba ma kwei paare yipuga kam ba pu o yuu ne, ye ba daare ba kwei paare tiŋim seina tɔnɔ kom ba ke o jeŋa ne. Ba ma lwo nuga o yuu ne ba ma ba tiŋi‑o paare. Nɔɔna bam ma tɔɔle ba we, “Wɛ wó pa pɛ wom momwɛ-dɛɛre!”

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Abam na jege se á ke tei to mo tento: Abam balo na ye Wɛ kaanem tiina de Levi dwi tiina ye á pɔɔre kuni betɔ to, á kɔgɔ kolo na tui totoŋa siu dɛ ne to chichworo wó taa yere Wɛ diga kam nia yam.

english_verse: Everyone celebrated because Athaliah had been killed and Jerusalem was peaceful again.
translation_verse: Nɔn-bia bam maama maa chaka de wopwolo. Ko kwaga ne teo kom maama ma ke ziim, ba na go Atalia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Bena yarepɛ na kɛ to mo Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada déem jaane baare se o ke keim. O ma ke ni-sɛɛm de dedɛɛra balo na tei jar-keira bi bi to badwonna. Banto maa ye Jeroham bu Azaria, de Jehohanan bu Isameli, de Obeda bu Azaria, de Adaya bu Maaseya, de Zikiri bu Elisafate.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: ba zo Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba ma jeeri Joasa yiga ne, ye ba daare ba gwoni ni ded‑o. Jehoyada ma ta de ba maama o we: “Pɛ wom bu Joasa mo tento o zege á yiga ne. O nam jege se o jeini o di o kwo David paare dem, ne Baŋa Wɛ na maŋe o gwoni ni se ko taa ye tei David dwi dem seeni to mo.

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: Abam chicheiro de wó taa nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom, se chicheiro kodwoŋi kom de taa nii Biri-beira ni dem. Abam balo na daare to laam wó taa zege á yere Baŋa Wɛ diga kam konkwallo tem.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno dae se o zo Wɛ diga kam, ko ná dae kaanem tiina de Levi tiina balo na jege totoŋa se ba toŋe ka wone to yerane. Banto jege chwoŋa se ba zo, bɛŋwaane ba kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane mo. Balo maama na daare to jege se ba taa nii totoŋe delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba se ba taa ke to baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Levi tiina bam, de Judah tiina bam maama ma seene ba tɔge ni delo maama Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada na taga to. Ba dedoa dedoa ma ja ba nɔɔna ba ba Jehoyada tei, ne ko ná ye balo na tui totoŋa siu dɛ ne to, de balo na ti ba totoŋa siu dɛ ne to de. Kokuri to, Jehoyada wo pɛ ba popɔre maama chwoŋa se ba yage ba totoŋa.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Jehoyada ma kwei chichwoa de jara-keim nantane selo déem na ye David nyem ye te tigi Wɛ wara-jei sem ne to o pa jar-keira dedɛɛra bam.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: O ma pa se nɔɔna bam maama vo ba zege ba gilimi pɛ wom ba ke tetare ne, ye ba zei ba jara zela. Ba déem tigisi ba tete Wɛ diga kam jei maama ne, jagwia seeni de jazem seeni, ko zege kaanem bimbini dem takeiri ne de diga kam tete yiga ne.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalia na nigi nɔɔna bam na ke sɔɔ ye ba tei pɛ wom to, o ma ke lela o nwoŋi o vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem o daare o na nɔn-kɔgɔ kom.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: O ma na pɛ wom na zege ywei delo na wo Wɛ diga kam ni ne to teiŋa ne, ne ba na yeini ba ke tei ba tiŋi pɛ to. Dedɛɛra bam de balo na wui nabwanno to maa zege pɛ wom takeiri ne. Teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama maa chaka de wopwolo ye ba badwonna wui nabwanno. Lein-leena bam de maa zege da de ba kwɛɛra zela ba mɔɔne lei ba seini pɛ wom. Atalia na nɛ konto to, o ma ja o gwaaro tem o vaŋe o kaare ye o we, “Bebare-nyena mo zaŋe a baŋa ne!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Jehoyada ma ta de jar-keira dedɛɛra bam o we, “Ja-na Atalia á nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone á ke‑o babɛ sem gena tetare ne. Nɔɔno ná kwaane se o woli‑o, se á kwei se-zɔɔ á go kotu.” Kokuri to, Jehoyada ya maŋe o ta we, ba yé go Atalia Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone.

english_verse: She tried to escape, but the commanders caught and killed her near the gate where horses are led into the palace.
translation_verse: Ba ma zi Atalia ba ja ba nwoŋi ba vo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Ba ma pa o tɔge manchwoŋo ni mɛ sisei na tɔge da se zoore nabwoo kom to, ye ba daare ba go‑o jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada ma pa se o de pɛ wom de nɔɔna bam maama gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ we, ba wó taa ye Baŋa Wɛ tete nɔɔna.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama déem ma vo ba zo Baal jwoni diga kam ba yigi ka maama ba de tega ne, ba daare ba chochoge kaanem bimbina yam de jwoni kamwaro tem maama. Ko ta ná ye Baal kaanem tu Matan, ba jaane‑o bimbina yam takeiri ne mo ba go.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Jehoyada ta ma kuri balo na ye kaanem tiina de Levi dwi tiina to se ba taa nii Baŋa Wɛ diga kam totoŋa yam baŋa ne, ne Pɛ David déem na pɔɔre ba totoŋa yam tei to. Banto ye se ba taa zwɛ vara ba ke kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ, ba daare ba taa leeni lei de wopwolo, ne Moses nia yam de David bera yam déem na ye tei to.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: O laam ma tɔge de jar-keira dedɛɛra bam, de nakwa bam, de yiga tiina bam, ko ta woli de teo kom nɔn-bia bam maama, se ba vo ba ja pɛ Joasa ba ja ba nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba ma ja‑o ba vo ba tɔge ka ni delo na wo baŋa seeni to ba vo ba zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Ba ma ja Joasa ba pa o jeini paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tu Jehoyada ta na wo o ŋwea wone maŋa kalo to, Joasa totoŋa su Baŋa Wɛ yi mo.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom de Jehoyada ma kwei sabu kom ba ke nɔɔna balo na wó taa nii Baŋa Wɛ diga kam totoŋa baŋa ne to jeŋa ne. Banto de ma beeri lɔra, de gwaro, ye ba ŋwe-ba se ba taa toŋa ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. Ba déem ta beeri balo na yei luuru de channa totoŋa to mo se ba de taa kwɛ wonnu.

english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Ba ma ja‑o ba vo ba suli David teo Jerusalem ne mɛ ba na yeini ba suli pwa to. Ba ke konto o na toŋe wo-laaro Isarele teo kom ne o pa Wɛ, de Wɛ diga kam to ŋwaane mo. Joasa puseŋa kikia yam

english_verse: And now we need it to repair the temple because the sons of that evil woman Athaliah came in and wrecked it. They even used some of the sacred objects to worship the god Baal.”
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem Atalia bia bam nam ya ŋɔge ba zo Wɛ diga kam wone mo ba chɔge-ka. Ba ta bere ba vere wonnu telo na ye wose Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane to mo ba ja ba nwoŋi ba ma ba zuli Baal jwona yam.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Jehoyada ma kuri kaana balei o pa Joasa se o di o ma o ke o kaana. Ba de ma lo bia ded‑o, bakeiri de busankane.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Ko na wora ko wora to, Joasa boboŋa ma ja se o fɔge o kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: O ma la kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam o ke daane ye o ta de-ba o we, “Véi-na á tole Judah teene dem maama wone á jwoŋi bene dem wone lampwoo kom nɔɔna bam maama tei ne, se dé ma dé fɔge dé kwɛ Wɛ diga kam. Nam yé dáane-na de totoŋe dem.” Levi tiina bam nam wo ke ba yiga totoŋe dem wone.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom ma da ko ŋwaane o toŋe o bwoŋi kaanem nakwe tu Jehoyada ye o bwei‑o o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo nmo wo nii ko baŋa ne se Levi tiina bam kaare ba vo Jerusalem de Judah teene dem maama wone ba jwoŋi lampwoo kolo na ye Wɛ ni-gwonim vwei dem ŋwaane to? Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses déem tiŋi ni dem konto mo o pa Isarele kɔ-fɔrɔ kom ye ba de sɛ.”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom ma pa ni ye ba kwei dɛ ba mage dakaa ba daare ba zege-ka pwooni yiga ne, se ko maŋe de Baŋa Wɛ diga kam manchwo-peena yam.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Ba ma toŋe kwora Jerusalem de Judah teene dem maama wone se nɔɔna bam ja lampwoo ba ba ba pa Baŋa Wɛ, ne Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses déem na pɛ Isarele tiina bam ke tei kagoa yuu ne to.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam de nɔɔna bam maama ma ja ba sabia ba ba Jerusalem de wopwolo. Ba ma kwei ba pɛɛra yam ba de dakaa kam wone pa ka ba ka su.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone, Levi tiina bam ná kwei dakaa kam ba ja ba vo pɛ wom dedɛɛra bam tei, ye ba ná nɛ we sabia bam daga, pɛ wom tɔn-poponno wom, de kaanem nakwe tu zeinnu wom yeini ba lwo ka wo sabu kom mo ba tiŋi, ye ba jwoori ba ja dakaa kam ba vo ba zege ka ya na zege mɛ to. english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. translation_verse: Ba na toŋe ba ti konto to, ba ma ja sabu kolo ta na daare to ba vo ba pa Pɛ Joasa de Jehoyada. english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Ko daare, Jehoyada toone kwaga ne, mo Judah teo dedɛɛra bam vei Joasa tei ba jɔɔne‑o. Ba na lwori ba nia daane to, pɛ wom ma sɛ se o ke ba boboŋa yam ne.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne mo Judah tiina bam swei Wɛ diga kam swia. Ba ma da ba zuli Asera nyenyego dɛ, de jwona yadwonna, ba daare ba yage ba nabaara Wɛ wom zula. Ba na sage chwoŋa de ba wɛleera kikia yam konto to, Baŋa Wɛ bane ma zaŋe de Judah tiina bam, de Jerusalem tiina bam.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ Jworo déem ma chu kaanem tu Jehoyada bu Zekaria baŋa ne. O ma zege nɔɔna bam yiga ne o ta o we, “Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Bɛŋwaane mo abam yeini á ve Baŋa Wɛ nia yam? english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. translation_verse: Pɛ wom swei Jehoyada ya na ke‑o lanyerane tei to mo pa se o go o bu Zekaria. Zekaria na wora o to to, mo o taga o we, “Baŋa Wɛ wó nii o na kolo á na jege á ke to se o yiri jene o pa-ne.”

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.

english_verse: Joash was severely wounded during the battle, and as soon as the Syrians left Judah, two of his officials, Zabad and Jehozabad, decided to revenge the death of Zechariah. translation_verse: Ko déem ye Zabadi wolo nu na ye Amon tiina bukɔ Simeafi to, de Jehozabadi wolo nu na ye Moaba tiina bukɔ Simirifa to mo ke bana ba vo ba go Joasa.

english_verse: Some of his skilled workers invented machines that could shoot arrows and sling large stones. translation_verse: Yuzia déem jege bena fuga-yaredo mo ye ba tiŋi‑o paare. O ma jeini Jerusalem ne o di paare dem o ke bena finnu-yalei. O nu wom yere mo Jekolia ye o nwoŋi Jerusalem.

english_verse: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.
translation_verse: O nam na tu o na dam to, mo o bere o tete kamunim. Konto nam mo yɔɔre ko pa o to tega ne. Dɛ dedwe, o ma tusi o chɔge o Tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ye o zo Wɛ diga kam wone se o zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ka bimbini dem baŋa ne.

translation_verse: O totoŋa déem su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, nenɛɛne o kwo Amazia na ke tei to.

english_verse: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.
translation_verse: Zekaria déem mo yeini o bere‑o Wɛ chwoŋa na ye tei to. Zekaria ta na ŋwe to, Yuzia yɔɔre o zuli Baŋa Wɛ mo. O maa na zuli Wɛ konto to, Wɛ de pɛ o wonnu ke lanyerane mo te pa‑o.

english_verse: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.
translation_verse: Yuzia ma vo o kwaare jara de Filisi tiina bam. O ma vo o li Gafa, de Jabenɛ, de Asedodi teene dem o yigi de kabiri sem o de tega ne. O laam ma lɔ teene pa de bwola de Asedodi, dedaane Filisi tiina bam na zoore jei sedaara ne to.

english_verse: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.
translation_verse: Amon tiina bam de maa jaane pɛɛra ba tui ba pae Yuzia se ba sɛ ba pa‑o. O yere déem tiini de zaŋe jei maama ne se ko vo ko yi Ejipti teo siseini, o na tiini o jege dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.
translation_verse: Yuzia déem lɔge di-dedwaaro Jerusalem teo kabira kam ne mo o zege pa teo kom dana. O ke konto Gugworo Ni dem teiŋa ne, de Bwolo Ni dem teiŋa ne, dedaane mɛ seeni kabira kam na gugwoli to ne.

english_verse: He also built defense towers out in the desert. He owned such a large herd of livestock in the western foothills and in the flatlands, that he had cisterns dug there to catch the rainwater. He loved farming, so he had crops and vineyards planted in the hill country wherever there was fertile soil, and he hired farmers to take care of them.
translation_verse: O ta ma pa ba lɔ di-dedwaaro ba zege kagoa kam ne, ye ba daare ba ko vola dedɛ, o na jege vara dedɛ wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne, de te-kampare jei sem ne to ŋwaane. Zwonnu laŋa kam ne, de te-ywoŋa jei sem ne o tontoŋena maa vare tega kam ba pa‑o ye ba jeiri Vini teeni, o na swoi varem de kɔnɔ totoŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.

Ba ta ma kwei gwaaro, de natera, de wodiiru ba pa peena bam maama, ye ba daare ba kwei nuga ba ma ba lɛ ba fufwollu. Peena balo ta na bwomma to, ba ma kwei-ba ba daŋe bonɛ baŋa ne.
