english_verse: Some time later, the Edomites attacked the eastern part of Judah again and carried away prisoners. And at the same time, the Philistines raided towns in the western foothills and in the Southern Desert. They conquered the towns of Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo, including the villages around them. Then some of the Philistines went to live in these places. Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria and begged for help.
translation_verse: Filisi tiina bam de ma vo Judah wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem, de kagoa kalo na wo tega-kuri seeni to ba li teene dedwonna da. Teene delo ba na vere to maa ye Bɛte-Semesa, de Ayijalon, de Gederofa, de Sokoo, de Timina, de Gimizo, dedaane de nawuura yam maama. Ba ma lɛɛre ba zoore de wone.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: Ahaz ta ma kwei lonne wonnu telo na wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to dedaane telo na wo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone, de teo kom nakwa sam dem ne to o toŋe o pa Asiria pɛ wom. Konto nam ta wo wane‑o ko zeini.

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Cham na tu Pɛ Ahaz baŋa konto to, o yɔɔre o toŋe o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga se ko dwoni o ya na ke tei to mo.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: O ke kaanem mo o pa Siria teo Damasika jwona yam, o na boŋe we ya jege dam ya pa Siria tiina se ba wane‑o ba di to ŋwaane. O ya boŋe o tete ne mo we, “Ko ye Siria tiina jwona yam mo woli-ba. Amo de nam wó zuli-ya mo se ya zeini-ne.” O keim dem konto nam pɛ se lɛɛro ba o baŋa, dedaane o teo kom maama baŋa mo.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ahaz déem ta zo Wɛ diga kam wone mo o la ka zela yam o ja o nwoŋi. O ma chochoge-ya o yage. O ma fɔge o pe Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ni, ye o daare o chwi kaanem bimbina Jerusalem teo ni maama ne.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: Judah teene dem maama wone de, o ta lɔge wara-jei bimbina mo, se ba taa vei da ba kaane wa-yɔɔro. Kikia yam konto ŋwaane o ma chiŋi Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye o nabaara Wɛ to bane o yage.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: O totoŋa ma su Baŋa Wɛ yi lanyerane, nenɛɛne o nabaaro David déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo Pɛ Hezekia tei ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam wane Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem maama dé kwɛ dé ti. Ko ná ye zwɛɛm pɛɛre bimbini dem de de yera zela yam maama, ko woli de tabolo kolo ba na yeini ba tiŋi bworobworo ko baŋa ne Wɛ ŋwaane to de ko yera wonnu tem maama, dé fɔge dé kwɛ te maama mo.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Hezekia laam ma kwei Levi tiina o zege ba zega jei ne Wɛ diga kam wone. O ma pa-ba zwe, de kwanno, de kwɛɛra zela dwi dwi, ne Pɛ David, de Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Gad, de o sampwora Natan déem na bere we ba taa ke tei to. Baŋa Wɛ déem tɔge o sampwori sem baŋa mo o pa-ba o ni dem konto.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba na ke kaanem dem ba ti to mo Pɛ Hezekia de o kwaga nɔɔna bam maama tiiri tega ne ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: O ma bwoŋi Wɛ kaanem tiina bam, de Levi dwi tiina bam o ke daane se ba jeeri Wɛ diga kam konkɔlɔ kolo na yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni to.

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de-ba o we: “Abam Levi tiina bam, cheigi-na a taane dento! Kwɛ-na á tete se á maŋe de chullu tem, se á ta daare á fɔge á kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye á nabaara Wɛ to diga kam. Le-na wonnu telo maama na wora ye te pae ka jege digiru to ka wone.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Debam kwoa bam nam wo jaane chega de dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Ba ma ve‑o, pa se ba toŋe lwarem ba ma ba chɔge o yiga. Ba déem mɛ ba kwaga ba ya Baŋa Wɛ de o wara-jei sem maama mo.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Ba ma yɔɔre ba pe Wɛ diga napɔrɔ kom nia yam, ye ba yage pa min-zwonnu tem dwei. Ba ma ve se ba zwɛ talwoŋa, naa se ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem Isarele tiina Wɛ wom wara-jei sem ne.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se Baŋa Wɛ ban-lom dem to Jerusalem de Judah teo kom maama baŋa ne. O na ke tei o ma o waare-ba to ma so nɔɔna maama pa foone jege-ba, ye ba ta jege Judah tiina bam ba yaala, ne abam na nɛa ko na ye tei tento to.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo debam dona go dé kwoa bam jara wone, ye ba daare ba pɛ dé bia de dé kaana ba ja ba viiri.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Amo boboŋa nam jaane se dé jwoori dé ke ni-sɛɛm mo de Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to. Konto mo wó che se o ban-lom daa yé taa wo debam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a bia bam, daa yé ja-na á jeini. Kokuri to, abam mo Baŋa Wɛ kuri se á ta‑á zege o yiga ne á toŋa ye á kaane á pa‑o.”

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto de ma vo ba la ba chorro tem ba ke daane. Ba maama ma vo ba kwɛ ba tete de chullu tem, ye ba daare ba fɔge ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam, se ba pa ka maŋe de o chullu tem na bere tei to, nenɛɛne Pɛ Hezekia na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Ba déem bobo ba kwɛɛm totoŋa yam konto boboa chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo. Ba na toŋe ba ke da nana to, de ba kwɛ pwooni yiga jei sem ba vo ba yi Baŋa Wɛ diga napɔrɔ kom. Ba daa ma kwei da nana ba kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ diga kam tete ba woli da. Ko ye boboa chana kam da fuga-yaredo dɛ dem ne mo ba déem kwɛ Wɛ diga kam maama ba ti.

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye wonnu telo Pɛ Ahaz na yage o chega de Wɛ ye o le-te Wɛ diga kam wone o paare dim maŋa ne to, dé ta beeri tento maama dé na, ye dé daare dé kwɛ-te chullu tem seeni. Leile konto te maama laam zege Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem yiga ne.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Tega na poore tetete to, Hezekia ma la teo kom dedɛɛra bam o ke daane ye ba vo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Ba maa jege pɛɛra se ba ma ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem pɛ sɔŋɔ kom tiina ŋwaane, de Wɛ wara-jei sem ŋwaane, de Judah tiina bam maama ŋwaane. Ba pɛɛra yam déem ye na-bale serepɛ, de pi-bale serepɛ, de pipeili serepɛ, de bo-bale serepɛ mo. Pɛ wom ma pa kaanem tiina bam na ye Aron dwi dem to ni se ba kwei vara bam ba ma ba ke kaanem Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam laam ma go-de, ye ba daare ba kwei de jana bam ba lwo bimbini dem baŋa ne se ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem ba ma ba le Isarele tiina bam maama lwarem Wɛ yiga ne. Kokuri to, Pɛ wom ya pɛ ni mo se ba ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de wɛleere saarem pɛɛra Isarele tiina bam maama ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Levi tiina bam ma yɔɔre ba ke siri de David kwɛɛra zela yam, ye kaanem tiina bam de zege de ba nabwanno se ba wu-te.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Hezekia déem ma pa ni se ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem Wɛ diga kam bimbini dem baŋa ne. Ba na wora ba ke kaanem dem to, nɔɔna bam maa leeni lei, ye ba jege Isarele teo Pɛ David kwɛɛra zela yam, dedaane nabwanno tem ba ma ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom de o nakwa bam ma ta de Levi tiina bam se ba kwei seinim lei selo David de Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu Asaf déem na puli to ba ma ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. Ba maama ma seene ba leeni lei sem de ywoni zanzam ye ba tiiri tega ne ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Abam laam na seene á kwɛ á tete Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to ŋwaane, nam ja-na kaanem de lei-keim pɛɛra á ba á zo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne.” Ba ma seene ba ke konto. Ba badaara ta ma ja zwɛɛm pɛɛra ba woli da, se ko tɔge de ba boboŋa na jaane tei to.

english_verse: lambs were brought as sacrifices to please the Lord;
translation_verse: ) mo ba ma ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem dem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: sheep were brought as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: ) se ba kwei-te ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam kɔgɔ ni déem nam ya muri se ba wane vara bam konto maama ba pwoni ba daare ba zwɛ. Mo kokuri ba chorro Levi dwi tiina bam woli-ba pa ba toŋe totoŋe dem ba vo ba guri, ye ko maŋe de kaanem tiina badwonna de laam kwɛ ba tete pa ba maŋe de chullu tem. Kokuri to, Levi tiina bam boboŋa déem jaane se ba kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane, se ko dwoni kaanem tiina bam na ke tei to.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Vara balo nɔɔna bam na jaane ba ba se ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem to déem daga dedɛ. Ba ta maa jege lara kalo na ye yazura pɛɛra yam nyem to, dedaane wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛra yalo na woli zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam wone to. Konto baŋa ne mo ba déem daa jwoori ba bobo ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ o diga kam wone.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Hezekia de nɔɔna bam maama ma di ywoni de Wɛ na ke kolo o pa o nɔɔna bam to. Kokuri to, ba totoŋa yam maama yɔɔre ya ti lela mo.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom ma pa ni se nɔɔna kwei o kwora kam ba ja ba jage ba yi Isarele teo kom de Judah teo kom ni maama. Pɛ wom de o nakwa bam kwora na popone ka tiŋi ye ka bere kolo to mo tento: “Abam Isarele tiina bam, jwoori-na Baŋa Wɛ na ye á nabaara Abaraham, de Izaak, de Isarele Wɛ to tei. Abam ná ke konto, o de wó pipiri o jeeri abam balo ta na daare ye á lu Asiria pwa bam jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Nam yé pa se á bochara digili, ne á kwoa bam déem na ke tei to. Sɛ-na á pa Baŋa Wɛ, se á daare á ta‑á jeeri o wara-jei sem wone. Kokuri to, o pɔɔre jeiga kam konto se ka taa ye wose mo se ko taa vei wuu. Ta‑á zuli-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, se o de dɔne o ban-lom dem á baŋa ne.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná jwoori Baŋa Wɛ tei, balo na kale á chorro de á bia ba ja ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga to wó duri ba ŋwaŋa ye ba daare ba yage-ba se ba jwoori tega kanto ne. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege yibwona de ŋwaŋa. Abam maa ná jwoori á ba o tei, o daa bá ma o kwaga o ya abam.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Asere dwi dem wone, de Manasɛ dwi dem wone, de Zebulun dwi dem wone nɔɔna badaara déem gwooni ba tete mo ye ba vo Jerusalem.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam déem ma nwoŋi de kɔ-fɔrɔ ba jeeri Jerusalem ne chane selei chana kam wone, se ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja bimbin-yɔɔro telo na wo Jerusalem wone to, de yalo ba na zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ya baŋa ne to ba vo ba dole ba yage Kidoron bwolo kom ne.

english_verse: Most of the people that came from Ephraim, West Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun had not made themselves clean, but they ignored God's Law and ate the Passover lambs anyway. Hezekiah found out what they had done and prayed, “Lord God, these people are unclean according to the laws of holiness. But they are worshiping you, just as their ancestors did. So, please be kind and forgive them.”
translation_verse: ne konto tu ná ke o boboŋa ne se o yɔɔre o zuli Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye o nabaara Wɛ to. Wɛ wó duri kotu ŋwaŋa, de o na maŋe o wo tɔge Wɛ wara-jei sem chullu tem na bere tei to de.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ Hezekia na lwoori‑o kolo to ye o wo waare nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina balo maama déem na jeeri Jerusalem ne to kwei da yarepɛ mo ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem de wopwolo. Wɛ kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam ma leeni ba tei Baŋa Wɛ dɛ maama wone, ye ba ta jege gwa kwɛɛra zela ba mage de dam.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma yɔɔre o ŋɔɔne bochare-zuru taana de Levi tiina bam maama, ba na toŋe ba pa Baŋa Wɛ de yeino to ŋwaane. Nɔɔna bam ma kwei da yarepɛ yam ba di kuri dem. Ba ma kwei yazura pɛɛra ba ke kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ, ye ba ke o lei o na ye ba nabaara Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: So Hezekiah gave the people
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Hezekia ma kwei na-bale moro (

english_verse: sheep, and many more priests agreed to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean.
translation_verse: ). Kaanem tiina dedɛ ma kwɛ ba tete se ba maŋe de chullu tem.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hezekia déem pɔɔre Wɛ kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam pa ba maama jege popɔrem mo. Ba popɔre sem wone de, kaanem tu maama de Levi dwi tu maama jege o totoŋe mo. Ba badaara wó taa ke zwɛɛm kaanem, de yazura pɛɛra kaanem, se babam taa zege Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem nia yam seeni ba toŋa. Babam maa wó taa ke Wɛ lei ye ba leeni ba zuli‑o.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Banto maama yera popone ya tigi mo, ko woli de ba bu-sese, de ba kaana, de ba bia, de ba kɔgɔ kom maama. Kokuri to, ba tiini ba jege chega de ba na pɔɔre ba tete se ba taa ye wose Wɛ ŋwaane to.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: O déem ta ma pa ni se balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to yeini ba ja kolo de kolo na maŋe de kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam to ba ba ba pa-ba. Konto ná kea, ba de wó chɛ de ba totoŋa, ne Wɛ nia yam na bere tei to.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Ba na di kuri dem ba ti to, Isarele tiina balo maama na tu ba wo Jerusalem ne to ma nwoŋi ba vo ba tole Judah teene dem maama ba guri kandwa yalo ba ya na chugi ba jege ba kaane to ba chochoge, ba daare ba gwoni Asera nyenyego dɛ sem ba de tega ne. Ba ta ma yɔɔre ba chɔge jwona wara-jei de se kaanem bimbina yalo na wo Judah laŋa kam, de Benjamin laŋa kam, de Efrayim laŋa kam, de Manasɛ laŋa kam jei maama ne to. Ko kwaga ne nɔɔna bam maama laam ma viiri ba jwoori ba sam. Baŋa Wɛ zula taane

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma kuri o tete vara bam wone o pa-ba se ba taa ke zwɛɛm kaanem, ne Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere se ba yeini ba taa ke tei to. Ko maa ye tetete, de dedaan-ni maama ne, ko woli de Wɛ siu da yam ne, de chan-doŋa kura de kura yadwonna ne, ne ko na tɔge ko chwoŋa tei to.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam bobo se ba taa jaane wonnu tento maama ba tui chane setɔ chana kam wone mo, ye ba laam la te maama ba ti chane serepɛ chana kam wone.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma bwei kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam se o lɔre pwoa yam na tigi ya ke kolo to.

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Azaria na nwoŋi Zadoki sɔ-yuu kom ne to ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko na zege maŋa kalo nɔɔna bam na jaane ba pɛɛra ba tui Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to, debam yɔɔre dé di dé sui mo, ye dé daare dé tiŋa. Kokuri to, ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo swɛ o nɔɔna bam swolim pa tento maama ta daare te tiga kɛɛla-kɛɛla.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Pɛ wom déem ma pa ni se ba fɔge ba lɔ di Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone se ba taa zege zela da. Ba maa seene ba lɔ-se ba ti.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Balo de maa na wo banto balei dam kuri ne ba nii di sem baŋa ne to déem ye Jeheli, de Azazia, de Nahafi, de Asaheli, de Jerimofa, de Jozabadi, de Eleli, de Isimakia, de Mahafe, ko woli de Benaya mo. Ko nam ye Pɛ Hezekia, de Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu Azaria déem mo kuri-ba se ba taa toŋe totoŋa yam konto.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: Ba ma pɔɔre pɛɛra yam ba pa baara balo na yi bena yatɔ ba daŋe ye ba yera popone ya tigi dwi natɔga twanno tem wone to mo. Ko maa ye balo na wó zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone ba taa toŋe ba dɛ wone totoŋa, se ko maŋe de ba na pɔɔre-ba se ba taa ke tei popɔra de popɔra to mo.

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye Aron dwi dem na ye Wɛ kaanem tiina ye ba zoore teene delo maama wone, naa de pwoli sem ne to, ba déem le nɔɔna mo se ba yeini ba pɔɔre pɛɛra yam ba pa ba baara balo maama na wora to. Ba déem ta pɔɔre pɛɛra yam ba pa Levi dwi tiina balo yera na popone ya tigi dwi natɔga twanno tem wone to mo.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ diga kam totoŋa, de o na tɔge Wɛ nia yam de o bera yam tei to, o déem yɔɔre o ke o chega dedaane Wɛ mo, ye o toŋe de o wo maama. Konto to, wonnu déem ke lanyerane te pa‑o.

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Abam wo nigi amo de a kwoa bam na ke tei teene dedwonna nɔɔna bam maama baŋa ne to na? Teene dem konto wa yam wane ya jwoŋi ya nɔɔna amo jeŋa ne ya yage na?

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba déem lage kɔ-fɔrɔ mo, ye ba vo ba se buli-yia yam, ba daare ba che bu-nɔgɔ kolo na na tole jei sem konto wone ba kɛ to. Ba ma ta ba we, “Tetɛ ŋwaane mo Asiria teo pwa bam wó ba ywo-seeni ba na na dedɛ ba nyɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Hezekia ma yɔɔre o pa o tontoŋena fɔge ba che teo kom kabira kam ba zege. Ba ta lɔge di-dedwaaro mo ka yera ne, ye ba che pwooni yiga kabira kadwoŋi ba ke da. O ma fɔge o lɔ mɛ tega kam na suuri ka maŋe daane Pɛ David dalem jei sem ne to. O ta ma pa ba ke jara zela, de jara nantane dedɛ ba pa‑o.

english_verse: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:
translation_verse: O ma kuri o jar-keira dedɛɛra badwonna se ba taa nii teo kom nɔɔna bam baŋa ne. O laam ma pa ni se ba jeeri teo kom manchwo-peena yam kapworo ne, ye o ta de-ba o we,

english_verse: The Assyrian officials said terrible things about the Lord God and his servant Hezekiah.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra balo Senakeribi na toŋe to ta yɔɔre ba tɛ wonnu ba gwooni Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ yere, ye ba twe o tontoŋeno Hezekia.

english_verse: Sennacherib's letter even made fun of the Lord. It said, “The gods of other nations could not save their people from Assyria's army, and neither will the God that Hezekiah worships.”
translation_verse: Senakeribi ma toŋe twanno telo na yaale Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to. Te taane dem we, “Teene dedwonna wa yam wo wane-ba ya jwoŋi amo jeŋa ne ya yage. Wɛ delo Hezekia na zuli to de nam bá wane o nɔɔna bam de jwoŋi de yage.”

english_verse: People brought offerings to Jerusalem for the Lord and expensive gifts for Hezekiah, and from that day on, every nation on earth respected Hezekiah. Hezekiah Gets Sick and Almost Dies (
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ ma ja pɛɛra ba ba Jerusalem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ba ta jaane pɛɛra yalo na tiini ya jege kuri to mo ba ba ba pa Judah teo pɛ Hezekia. Ko maa na zege maŋa kam konto ne to, dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama yɔɔre ba tiini ba nege Hezekia mo. Hezekia toone

english_verse: About this same time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. He prayed, and the Lord gave him a sign that he would recover.
translation_verse: Da yam konto ne, Hezekia déem yɔɔre o weele mo ye o bwola de toone. O ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ, ye o de leiri o wɛ-lworo kom. Wɛ ma veere o bere‑o o we, o wó na yazura.

english_verse: But Hezekiah was so proud that he refused to thank the Lord for everything he had done for him. This made the Lord angry, and he punished Hezekiah and the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: De ko de, Hezekia wo sɛ se o ke Baŋa Wɛ lei de o na ke zaane delo maama o pa‑o to, o na jege teera to ŋwaane. Konto ma pa se Baŋa Wɛ bane zaŋe, pa se cham yi Hezekia, de Judah de Jerusalem tiina bam.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people later felt sorry and asked the Lord to forgive them. So the Lord did not punish them as long as Hezekiah was king. Hezekiah's Wealth (
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni mo Hezekia ma maane o teera yam na ye tei to, pa se o tu o tete tega ne. Jerusalem tiina bam de ma ke konto dwoŋi. Konto ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ ma peene o bane maŋa kalo maama Hezekia ta na ŋwe to.

english_verse: Hezekiah was very rich, and everyone respected him. He built special rooms to store the silver, the gold, the precious stones and spices, the shields, and the other valuable possessions.
translation_verse: Hezekia déem tiini o duni mo pa o yere zaŋe dedɛ. O ma lɔ di se o tiŋi o zela se wone. O jejegero tem maa ye lu-nyenno, de sabu-seŋa, de kandwa-nyenno, de talwoŋ-ywei, de jara nantane, de lonne wonnu dwi dwi.

english_verse: Storehouses were also built for his supply of grain, wine, and olive oil; barns were built for his cattle, and pens were put up for his sheep.
translation_verse: O ta ma lɔ di sedwonna se o taa maa zege mena, de sa-doora, de nuga se wone. O ma che najere se ba yage o naane dwi dwi de o pei da.

english_verse: God made Hezekiah extremely rich, so he bought even more sheep, goats, and cattle. And he built towns where he could keep all these animals.
translation_verse: O déem ma lɔ teene o pa o tete, ye o daare o yeigi vara dedɛ o yage de wone, Wɛ na pɛ o tiini o duni to ŋwaane.

english_verse: It was Hezekiah who built a tunnel that carried the water from Gihon Spring into the city of Jerusalem. In fact, everything he did was successful!
translation_verse: Hezekia déem nam mo ye wolo na pɛ ba che Gihon buli-yi dem de baŋa seeni to. O ma daare o pa na bam ywori ba tɔge na-fera ba zo Jerusalem teo wo, ko wɛ-zoore seeni. Totoŋa yalo maama Hezekia déem na ke to, o nɛ yiga-veiŋa mo ya baŋa ne.

english_verse: Even when the leaders of Babylonia sent messengers to ask Hezekiah about the sign God had given him, God let Hezekiah give his own answer to test him and to see if he would remain faithful. Hezekiah Dies (
translation_verse: Ko daare, Babilon teo dedɛɛra na toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo Hezekia tei ba bwei‑o wo-kenkagele delo na ke o teo kom ne to, Wɛ ma yage Hezekia o yerane, se o faŋe‑o o nii kolo na seene ko wo o bochare wone to.

english_verse: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including how faithful he was to the Lord, is included in the records kept by Isaiah the prophet. These are written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Hezekia déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o totoŋ-laaro tem maama, ba popone-te ba tiŋi Wɛ sampwora Izaya veera yam tɔnɔ wone, ya na wo Judah de Isarele pwa seina tɔnɔ kom wone to.

english_verse: When Hezekiah died, he was buried in the section of the royal tombs that was reserved for the most respected kings, and everyone in Judah and Jerusalem honored him. His son Manasseh then became king.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli zwoŋo kolo baŋa ne David dwi dem yibeela na wora to. O toone maŋa ne mo Judah de Jerusalem tiina bam maama zuli‑o lanyerane. O bu Manasɛ ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his prayer to the Lord God and the warnings from his prophets, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Manasɛ déem na di paare ye o ke wonnu telo to, de o na lwoori Wɛ tei to, ko woli de yi-nara bam na tɔge Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom yere ŋwaane ba ta kolo ded‑o to, ba popone te maama ba tiŋi Isarele Teo Pwa Seina tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: While Manasseh was held captive there, he asked the Lord God to forgive him and to help him.
translation_verse: O na wo yaara wone konto to, mo o gwooni o tete o Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye o nabaara bam Wɛ to yiga ne, o lwoori‑o se o duri o yibwona.

english_verse: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. And he continued to worship the stars.
translation_verse: O jwoori o lɔ jwona kaanem jei selo o kwo Hezekia déem na chochoge o yage to mo o zege. O ma lɔ bimbina o zege Baal jwona zula ŋwaane o daare o chwi Asera nyenyego dɛ. O ma tiiri o zuli chalechwe sem de.

english_verse: In the temple, where only the Lord was supposed to be worshiped, Manasseh built altars for the worship of pagan gods
translation_verse: O déem ta lɔge jwona kaanem bimbina mo o zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne. Baŋa Wɛ ya tage jeiga kam konto taane mo we, “Jerusalem ye teo kolo nɔɔna na wó taa zuli a yere da taa wuu to mo.”

english_verse: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courtyards of the temple
translation_verse: Manasɛ ta lɔge bimbina mo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam konkwallo telei tem wone se nɔɔna taa mae ba zuli chalechwe sem.

english_verse: and even set up a stone image of a foreign god. Manasseh practiced magic and witchcraft; he asked fortunetellers for advice and sacrificed his own sons in Hinnom Valley. He did many other sinful things and made the Lord very angry. Years ago, God had told David and Solomon: Jerusalem is the place I prefer above all others in Israel. It belongs to me, and there in the temple I will be worshiped forever.
translation_verse: Manasɛ déem pɛ ba sare jwoni nyenyego mo ye o kwei-ko o zege Wɛ wara-jei sem ne o jege o kaana. Wɛ déem tage jei sem konto taane de David, de o bu Solomon o we, “Diga kanto na zege Jerusalem ne to mo ye jeiga kalo amo na kuri Isarele dwia yam maama wone se nɔɔna taa zuli amo yere da se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: If my people will faithfully obey all the laws and teaching I gave to my servant Moses, I will never again force them to leave the land I gave to their ancestors.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam ná yɔɔre ba tɔge bera yalo amo na pɛ-ba to, ye ba ná sɛ nia de bera yalo maama a na tɔge Moses baŋa a pa-ba to, amo daa bá zeili-ba se ba nwoŋi da tega kalo amo na pɛ ba nabaara bam to.”

english_verse: The Lord tried to warn Manasseh and the people about their sins, but they ignored the warning.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem kaane Manasɛ de o nɔɔna bam ba tusim kikia yam ŋwaane, ye ba wo cheigi.

english_verse: So he let Assyrian army commanders invade Judah and capture Manasseh. They put a hook in his nose and tied him up in chains, and they took him to Babylon.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma pa Asiria teo pɛ jar-keira dedɛɛra bam chwoŋa se ba ba ba jeeri Judah tiina bam de jara. Ba ma wane-ba ye ba daare ba ja Manasɛ ba puri o momwa ba lei gwola da. Ba ta ma kwei channa chegero ba vɔ‑o ye ba vaŋe‑o ba ja ba vo Babilon.

english_verse: The Lord listened to Manasseh's prayer and saw how sorry he was, and so he let him go back to Jerusalem and rule as king. Manasseh knew from then on that the Lord was God.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma sɛ Manasɛ wɛ-lworo kom pa se o duri o ŋwaŋa ye o pa‑o chwoŋa se o daa jwoori Jerusalem o di paare da. Keim dem konto ma pa Manasɛ lɔre we Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o ye Wɛ chekke.

english_verse: Later, Manasseh rebuilt the eastern section of Jerusalem's outer wall and made it taller. This section went from Gihon Valley north to Fish Gate and around the part of the city called Mount Ophel. He also assigned army officers to each of the fortified cities in Judah.
translation_verse: Konto maama na ke ko kɛ to, Manasɛ ma fɔge o lɔ pwooni yiga kabira kam na wo David teo kom wɛ-puli seeni to, ko na zege jei selo na bwola de Gihon buli-yi dem to, se ko vo ko yi Ywona Ni dem. O ta ma kwɛ kabira kalo na kaare Ofeli peo kom seeni to o daŋe ka baŋa ne. O ma kwei jar-keira dedɛɛra o zege Judah teene delo na lɔge de pe to maama wone se ba taa yere-de.

english_verse: Manasseh also removed the idols and the stone image of the foreign god from the temple, and he gathered the altars he had built near the temple and in other parts of Jerusalem. He threw all these things outside the city.
translation_verse: O ta yɔɔre o le wa-yɔɔro nyenyero mo dedaane jwoni delo o ya na zege Wɛ diga kam ne to. O ta ma le kaanem bimbina yalo maama ya na lɔge ya zege Wɛ wara-jei sem ne, de Jerusalem ni maama ne to. O ma ja te maama o nwoŋi teo kom dáa ne o dole o yage.

english_verse: Then he repaired the Lord's altar and offered sacrifices to thank him and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He gave orders that everyone in Judah must worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Manasɛ laam ma fɔge o kwɛ Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem o zege, ye o daare o kwei yazura pɛɛra, de lei-keim pɛɛra o kaane de baŋa ne o pa Baŋa Wɛ. O déem ma pa Judah tiina bam ni se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to.

english_verse: Manasseh died and was buried near the palace, and his son Amon became king. King Amon of Judah (
translation_verse: Manasɛ ma te ye o vo o kwoa tei. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o tete sɔ-fɔrɔ kom wone. O bu Amon ma leiri o yuu ne o di paare. Judah teo pɛ Amon yera taane

english_verse: Amon disobeyed the Lord, just as his father Manasseh had done, and he worshiped and offered sacrifices to the idols his father had made.
translation_verse: Amon déem toŋe lwarem o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga mo ne o kwo Manasɛ na ke tei to. O ma ke kaanem o pa jwona yalo maama Manasɛ déem na ke o zege to ye o zuli-ya.

english_verse: Manasseh had turned back to the Lord, but Amon refused to do that. Instead, he sinned even more than his father.
translation_verse: Wonto ba nye de o kwo. O wo sɛ se o gwooni o tete Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Amon bere o kɛ o kwo yiga mo de wɛleera kikia.

english_verse: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.
translation_verse: Amon tete tontoŋena bam ma lɔ o kwaga ne ba ke ni daane ye ba go‑o pɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne.

english_verse: But the people of Judah killed the murderers of Amon and made his son Josiah king.
translation_verse: Judah teo nɔn-bia bam de ma zaŋe ba go balo maama na lɔge Amon kwaga ne to. Ba ma tiŋi Amon bu Josia pa o leiri Amon yuu ne o di paare.

english_verse: Hilkiah and the four other men left at once and went to talk with Huldah the prophet. Her husband was Shallum, who was in charge of the king's clothes. Huldah lived in the northern part of Jerusalem, and when they met in her home,
translation_verse: Hilikia, de dedɛɛra balo na wo o tei ne to ma zaŋe ba vo Jerusalem jei-doŋa laŋa kam ne se ba na de Wɛ sampwori-kana kalo yere na ye Hulida to. O maa ye Tokafe bu Salum kaane mo. Tokafe de déem ye Hasara wolo na nii pɛ wom gwaaro baŋa ne to bu mo. Nɔɔna bam ma vo ba ŋɔɔne de Hulida.

english_verse: In the eighteenth year of Josiah's rule in Judah, after he had removed all the sinful things from the land and from the Lord's temple, he sent three of his officials to repair the temple. They were Shaphan son of Azaliah, Governor Maaseiah of Jerusalem, and Joah son of Joahaz, who kept the government records.
translation_verse: Pɛ Josia paare dim bena fuga-nana bene dem ne mo o toŋe Azalia bu Safan, de teo kom dedɛɛro Maaseya, de Joahaza bu Joa na ye pɛ sɔŋɔ tɔn-poponno wom to, se ba vo ba kwɛ o Tu Baŋa Wɛ diga kam, o boboŋa na jaane se o le digiru o teo kom maama wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: After Josiah had finished reading, he stood in the place reserved for the king. He promised in the Lord's name to faithfully obey the Lord and to follow his laws and teachings that were written in the book.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom ma zege o zega jei ne o fɔge o gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ we, o wó kwei o wo maama o jwoori o tɔge Baŋa Wɛ, ye o sɛ o nia yam, de o bera yam, de o chullu tem maama, ne ko na popone Wɛ ni-gwonim tɔnɔ kom wone tei to.

english_verse: He watched as the altars for the worship of the god Baal were torn down, and as the nearby incense altars were smashed. The Asherah poles, the idols, and the stone images were also smashed, and the pieces were scattered over the graves of their worshipers.
translation_verse: O ta ma pa ni se ba yigi Baal jwona kaanem bimbina yam ba de tega ne, se ba daare ba chɔge mɛ maama ba ya na zwɛ talwoŋa da ba zuli-ya to. O ta ma pa ba chochoge Asera nyenyego dɛ sem, de jwona nyenyero dwi maama. Ba laam ma daare ba dole weero tem ba yage balo ya na jege jwona yam konto maama ba zuli to yibeela yam baŋa ne.

english_verse: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said,
translation_verse: O ma daare o bwoŋi Hilikia, de Safan bu Ahikam, de Mika bu Abedon, de o tɔn-poponno Safan, ko woli de Asaya na ye pɛ wom yera tontoŋeno to, ye o pa-ba ni o we,

english_verse: Shaphan took the book to Josiah and reported, “Your officials are doing everything you wanted.
translation_verse: Safan ma ja tɔnɔ kom o vo o ta de pɛ Josia o we, “Pɛ, nmo dedɛɛra bam ke nmo na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei maama to.

english_verse: Josiah then had the bones of the pagan priests burned on the altars. And so Josiah got rid of the worship of foreign gods in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O ta pɛ ba kwei balo na yeini ba kaane jwona yam konto to kwi mo ba zwɛ bimbina yalo ba déem na zege da ba kaane to baŋa ne. Josia déem tɔge chwoŋa kam konto ne mo o pa jwona kaanem ti Judah de Jerusalem laŋa kam ne.

english_verse: He did the same things in the towns and ruined villages in the territories of West Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as the border of Naphtali.
translation_verse: O déem ta ma ke konto dwoŋi teene delo wone Manasɛ dwi tiina, de Efrayim dwi tiina, de Simeon dwi tiina na zoore to, se ko kɛ ko yi Nafitali dwi dem laŋa kam seeni, dedaane di-dwonnu telo na wo jei sem konto ne to.

english_verse: Everywhere in the northern kingdom of Israel, Josiah tore down pagan altars and Asherah poles; he crushed idols to dust and smashed incense altars. Then Josiah went back to Jerusalem. Hilkiah Finds The Book of God's Law (
translation_verse: Josia déem tole Isarele teene dem maama mo o kare o gwɛɛne jwona bimbina yam, o daare o chochoge Asera nyenyego dɛ sem. O ta ma mumugi ba jwona pa ya ji fwogo, ye o daare o ja bimbina yalo ba na zwɛ talwoŋa da to o chɔge o yage. O laam ma jwoori Jerusalem.

english_verse: Then the money was turned over to the men who supervised the repairs to the temple. They used some of it to pay the workers,
translation_verse: Ba na kwei sabu kom ba pa Hilikia to, o laam ma kwei-ko o pa balo na nii Baŋa Wɛ diga kam kwɛɛm totoŋa baŋa ne to, se banto jwoŋi ba ma ŋwe tontoŋena balo na wora ba fɔge ba kwɛ diga kam to.

english_verse: and they gave the rest of it to the carpenters and builders, who used it to buy the stone and wood they needed to repair the other buildings that Judah's kings had not taken care of.
translation_verse: Ba de ma kwei sabu kom konto ba pa gwaro tem, de lɔra bam, se ba yeigi kandwa yalo ba na yare peo yera ne to, dedaane dɛ se ba ma-se ba ke bei de ywoa ba fɔge ba kwɛ di selo maama Judah pwa bam ya na yage pa se chɔge to.

english_verse: The workers were honest, and their supervisors were Jahath and Obadiah from the Levite clan of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam from the Levite clan of Kohath. Other Levites, who were all skilled musicians,
translation_verse: Tontoŋena bam déem ma toŋe de jawala. Levi tiina balo na nii ba totoŋa yam baŋa ne to déem ye: Jahafe, de Obadia na ye Merari sɔ-yuu kom tiina to, ko woli de Zekaria, de Mesulam na ye Kohafe sɔ-yuu kom tiina to mo. Levi tiina bam konto déem tiini ba yei kwɛɛra zela magem lanyerane mo.

english_verse: were in charge of carrying supplies and supervising the workers. Other Levites were appointed to stand guard around the temple.
translation_verse: Ba badaara ma nii tontoŋena bam de ba totoŋa dwi dwi baŋa ne. Ba badaara de maa ye tɔn-poponna, de totoŋa yiga tiina, de ni-yerena. Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom taane

english_verse: While the money was being given to these supervisors, Hilkiah found the book that contained the laws that the Lord had given to Moses.
translation_verse: Ba na yɔɔre ba kwei sabu kolo ba ya na tiŋi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne ba maa nwoŋi to, mo Wɛ kaanem tu Hilikia nɛ Baŋa Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kolo Wɛ ya na ke Moses jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: Hilkiah handed the book to Shaphan the official and said, “Look what I found here in the temple—The Book of God's Law.”
translation_verse: Hilikia ma ta de tɔn-poponno Safan o we, “Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom mo tento a na nɛa Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone.” O laam ma kwei-ko o pa Safan.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba déem ta yeini ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem delo maama na maŋe se de ke dɛ dɛ to mo, de yalo na jege se ya ke chan-doŋa maŋa ne to, ko ta woli de yalo na maŋe de kura yadwonna ya maŋa ne, nenɛɛne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba ni tei to. Ba ta yeini ba ja ba wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra ba ba ba pa Baŋa Wɛ mo.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Bene dem konto chane serepɛ chana kam boboa dɛ dem wone mo nɔɔna bam déem bobo se ba ke zwɛɛm kaanem ba pa Baŋa Wɛ. Ka maŋa ne de ba ya ta wo bobo se ba chwi Wɛ diga kam kabiri-beira.

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ŋwe lɔra de gwaro telo na toŋe dɛ totoŋa to se ba toŋe ba pa-ba. Ba ta ma kwei wodiu, de sana, de nuga ba toŋe ba pa Tura tiina de Sidon tiina se ba ma yeigi da-kwollu ba tei ne. Banto ma zage Sedare teeni na wo Lebanon peero tem ne to ye ba daare ba ja dɛ sem ba tɔge Mɛditeranea naneo kom ba vo ba yi Jopa. Pɛ Sarusi déem mo pɛ chwoŋa se konto maama ke. Ba bobo Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina balo na nii Wɛ diga kam tontoŋena baŋa ne to mo tento: Jesua de o bia, de o chorro tem, ko woli de Kadimeli de o bia, Binnui de Hodavia mo. Levi tiina balo de na ye Henadadi dwi nɔɔna to de ma woli da.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Lɔra bam déem na yɔɔre ba chwi Baŋa Wɛ diga kabiri-beira kam to, mo kaanem tiina bam zo ba gwaaro ye ba daare ba vo ba zege ba zega jei ne, se ba wu ba nabwanno tem. Levi tiina balo na nwoŋi Asaf diga kam ne to de ma kwei zwe ba zege da, se ba maama zuli Baŋa Wɛ nenɛɛne Isarele tiina Pɛ David déem na bere se ba taa ke tei to.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Ba déem ma mɔɔne lei ye ba sɛ-se ba ma seini Baŋa Wɛ ye ba ke‑o lei. Ba maa tɛ ba we: “O tiini o lamma! O swono kolo o na jege Isarele tiina ŋwaane to wora mo taa wuu!” Nɔɔna bam maama ma tiini ba tei Baŋa Wɛ de kwor-dɛa, ba na beiri Baŋa Wɛ diga kam kuri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Konto na jege ko ke to, kaanem tiina de Levi tiina de sam yiga tiina balo na ye nɔn-kwe to ma guli boboa Wɛ diga kam déem na ye tei to ye ba tiini ba laare de wo-chechɔgɔ. Ko nam ná ye balo na daare to, ba dedɛ laare de wopwolo mo.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Ba maama sɔɔ kom ma tiini ko di baŋa pa se nɔɔna ware se ba pɔɔre ywoni de wo-chechɔgɔ daane. Sɔɔ kom déem ma ni yiga yiga.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Judah dwi dem dedaane Benjamin dwi dem dona déem ma ni we balo na zege Babilon ne ba ba to wora ba jwoori ba lɔ Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom diga kam mo.

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Zerubabel, de Jesua, de Isarele sam yiga tiina badwonna bam ma leiri-ba ba we, “Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm dae debam de abam maama totoŋe. Debam yerane mo wó lɔ diga kam dé pa Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom, nenɛɛne pɛ Sarusi na pɛ debam ni se dé ke tei to.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo ya na maŋe ba zoore jei sem konto ne to laam ma kwaane se ba pa Judah tiina bam vɔna pare. Ba boboŋe déem ye se foone zo-ba se ba yage totoŋe dem mo.

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɛ Zeregese déem na tu o ji Peresia pɛ maŋa kalo to, mo Judah tiina dona bam popone tɔnɔ ba vugimi o boboŋa Judah tiina bam seeni, de Jerusalem teo kom nɔɔna seeni.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Konto na kɛ ye Atazeregese de daa ji Peresia pɛ maŋa kalo ne to, mo Biselam, de Miteredafe, de Tabeeli, de ba yuudwonna bam popone tɔnɔ ba toŋe ba pa pɛ wom. Ba déem popone tɔnɔ kom de Aram tiina taane mo ye ba daare ba leiri ko taane dem ba ga se nɔɔna lɔre ko kuri.

english_verse: A letter was also written to Artaxerxes about Jerusalem by Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors, including the judges, the governors, the officials, and the local leaders. They were joined in writing this letter by people from Erech and Babylonia, the Elamites from Susa, and people from other foreign nations that the great and famous Ashurbanipal had forced to settle in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: ko ta woli de nɔɔna balo maama Pa-faro Asurabanipali, o yere na tiini de zaŋe to, déem na wane o di ye o fe-ba se ba vo ba jeini Samaria teene dem ne, dedaane kateiri delo na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to.”

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Tɔnɔ kolo ba déem na popone ba pa pɛ wom to mo tento: “Debam balo na ye Pɛ Atazeregese tontoŋena, ye dé zoore Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore jei sem ne to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa‑m.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑n yei we ba ná jwoori ba lɔ ba teo kom ba zege, ye ko kabiri sem de kwaare daane se ti, Juu tiina bam daa bá sɛ se ba taa ŋwe lampwoo dwi maama. Konto ná kea, sabia yalo pɛ wom na yeini o jwoŋi o nɔɔna tei ne to wó muri mo.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Debam nam na ye balo n na nii dé baŋa ne to ŋwaane mo dé vae se wo-balwaaro tento yi‑m. Dé popone tento dé ma kwoori nmo

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: se n pa ba buŋi n nabaara lonne twanno tem wone ba nii. Nmo wó na we teo kom konto nɔɔna swoi chichuŋu mo. Ko zege faŋa faŋa to, ba yeini ba tiini ba daane pwa de dedɛɛra balo na tei-ba to mo. Ba na ye nankɔ-nyena to ŋwaane mo pɛ se nɔɔna déem chɔge ba teo kom.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nam pa-na-ba ni we ba daa yé lɔ teo kom, se ko taa nii amo ná pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba lɔ.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na se á ke lela á ke amo ni dem konto, se daanem daa yé ba amo paare dim baŋa ne.”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Ba na yɔɔre ba ga Pɛ Atazeregese tɔnɔ kom ba bere Rehum, de Simisayi, de ba dwonna bam to, mo ba ke lela ba vo Jerusalem. Ba ma fe Juu tiina bam de dam pa se ba yage teo kom lɔɔm.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Konto to ba déem fe Juu tiina bam mo pa se ba yage Jerusalem teo Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm. Totoŋa yam daa maa ba vei yiga se ko yi maŋa kam Darusi na jwoŋi Peresia paare o di ye ko ke bena yalei to.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Selateli bu Zerubabel de Jozadaki bu Jesua na nigi ba taane dem to, mo ba bobo se ba jwoori ba lɔ Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam. Wɛ sampwori sem déem maa wo ba tei ne se ba taa woli-ba.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Tatenayi déem mo ye Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem yiga tu. O ma tɔge de Sefa-Bozenayi, de ba dwonna yiga tiina bam o vo Juu tiina bam tei ye o bwei-ba o we, “Wɔ mo pɛ abam chwoŋa se á jwoori á lɔ Wɛ diga kam, se á daare á kwɛ-ka á zege?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Peresia teo dedɛɛra bam nam wo chege totoŋa yam, Baŋa Wɛ yi na page Juu tiina nakwa bam baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Dedɛɛra bam déem boŋe se ba popone tɔnɔ ba tole taane dem ba bere Pɛ Darusi mo, se o ná leiri-ko, se ba laam lɔre ba na wó ke tei to.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: “Pɛ Darusi, yazura taa wo n tei ne.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Dé lage se n lɔre we debam vei Judah kateiri dem ne, ye dé na diga kalo ba na wora ba lɔ se ba pa Wɛ-kamunu kom to. Nɔɔna bam jege kandwa-zana mo ba ma lɔ-ka, ye ba kwei da-kwoli-bigila ba ke ka yera ne. Tontoŋena bam nam zuri yera mo ba toŋa de yi-seena, ye lɔɔm dem vei yiga lanyerane.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Dé ma bwei ba nakwa dé we, ‘Wɔ mo pɛ abam chwoŋa se á jwoori á lɔ Wɛ diga kam, se á daare á kwɛ-ka á zege?’

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Dé nam ta bwei se dé lɔre tontoŋena bam yera mo se dé popone, se n lɔre balo na wo ba totoŋa yam yiga ne to.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Ba de ma leiri ba we, ‘Debam ye Wɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu de tega baŋa to tontoŋena mo. Dé nam wora dé jwoori dé lɔ Wɛ diga kalo Isarele pa-kamunu wodwoŋi déem na lɔge ye o fɔge o kwɛ-ka o zege to mo.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Debam nabaara déem ya pɛ se Telaao Tu Wɛ wom bane mo zaŋe de-ba. O de ma ve-ba o ke Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza na ye Chaladea dwi tu to jeŋa ne pa se o ba o chɔge ba Wɛ diga kam. O déem ta ma kale-ba o ja o vo o tete teo se ba taa zoore da.

english_verse: took its gold and silver articles, and put them in the temple of his own god in Babylon. They also said that during the first year Cyrus was king of Babylonia, he gave orders for God's temple to be rebuilt in Jerusalem where it had stood before. So Cyrus appointed Sheshbazzar governor of Judah and sent these gold and silver articles for him to put in the temple.
translation_verse: ye o daare o pa‑o ni se o ja zela yam konto o jwoori o vo Jerusalem o tiŋi Wɛ diga kam ne. O ta wó jwoori o lɔ Wɛ diga kam o zege ka déem na maŋe ka wo jei selo to ne.

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Pɛ, konto ŋwaane nam dé lwoori‑m mo se n pa se ba buŋi Babilon teo lonne twanno tem wone, se ba nii Pɛ Sarusi seene o pa ni we ba jwoori ba lɔ Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam naa o wo ke konto. Nmo laam ná nɛ kolo na wora to, se n bere debam n boboŋa na jaane tei to.”

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Ko déem nam ye Medea kateiri dem te-fɔrɔ Ekebatana wone mo ba nɛ tɔnɔ, ye ko wo taane mo tento:

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno zela yalo Pɛ Nebukadeneza déem na le Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam wone o ja o vo o tiŋi Babilon ne to ye se ba jwoori ba ja-te mo ba vo ba zege te ya na wo Wɛ diga kam jei selo wone to.”

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: Pɛ Darusi laam ma pa ni o we, “Tatenayi na ye Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri yiga tu to, de Sefa-Bozenayi, de á dwonna yiga tiina bam na wo Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni to, ta‑á yei-na se á yé twɛ ba lɔɔm jei sem!

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Yé daane-na nɔɔna bam na wora ba lɔ Wɛ diga kam to. Yage-na Juu tiina yiga tu wom de ba nakwa bam se ba jwoori ba lɔ ba Wɛ diga kam ka jeiga ne.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone nam ta pa-na kaanem tiina balo na wo Jerusalem ne to ba na lage kolo maama se ba ma ke kaanem ba pa Telaao Tu Wɛ wom to. Ba ná lage na-bale, de pi-bale, de pipeili se ba zwɛ ba ma ke kaanem, naa ba ná lage mena, de yɛ, de sana, de nuga, se á yɔɔre á pa-ba.

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: Ke-na konto maama á pa-ba se ba wane ba ke kaanem delo na wó pwoli Telaao Tu Wɛ wom wo to, se ba daare ba lwoori Wɛ se o pa amo de a bia yazura.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná ve amo ni dem, se ba le beiŋa kotu diga kam yera ne ba daare ba sare-ka ba ma zɔ‑o ba go. Ba ta wó pa kotu sɔŋɔ kom ji tampuuri.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Wɛ wolo na kuri Jerusalem teo kom se nɔɔna zuli o yere ko wone to nam wó pa se lɛɛro yi pɛ wolo, de nabiin-dwi delo maama na wó kwaane se o leiri amo ni dem to. Lɛɛro ta wó yi balo maama na boŋe se ba chɔge Wɛ diga kalo na wo Jerusalem ne to. Amo Darusi mo pɛ ni dento. Nɔɔno maama nam jege se o sɛ-de mo chekke.” Ba kwei Wɛ diga kam ba pa Baŋa Wɛ

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Juu tiina nakwa bam daa ta ma lɔ Wɛ diga kam ba vo yiga lanyerane, ye Wɛ sampwori Hagayi de Ido bu Zekaria de maa tɔɔle Wɛ kwora ba pae-ba baare. Ba ma seene ba lɔ-ka ba ti, nenɛɛne Isarele tiina Wɛ wom na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to, ye Peresia teo pwa Sarusi, de Darusi, de Atazeregese de pa-ba ni tei to.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Pɛ Darusi paare dim bena yaredo bene dem wone, Adare chana kam da yatɔ dɛ ne mo ba lɔge-ka ba ti.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam maama, de ba kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, dedaane nɔɔna balo maama na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to laam ma kwei Wɛ diga kam ba pa Wɛ de wopwolo.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba déem mɛ na-bale bi mo, de pi-bale bia yalei, de pipeili bia yana ba ke kaanem ba ma lwoori Wɛ swolim ba pa Wɛ diga kam. Ba ta kwei bo-bale fuga-selei mo ba ma ke wɛleera saarem kaanem Isarele dwia fuga-yalei yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Ba ma pɔɔre kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam kɔgɔ kɔgɔ se kɔgɔ maama taa jege ko totoŋa ba toŋe ba pae Wɛ Jerusalem wone, nenɛɛne ko na popone Moses nia tɔnɔ kom ne tei to. Ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to déem ma di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem boboa chana kam da fuga-yana dɛ ne.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam maama nam ya kwɛ ba tete Wɛ ŋwaane mo se ba maŋe de chullu tem. Levi tiina bam ma go Atɔgebabaŋa kaanem pipeili se ba ma kwɛ nɔɔna balo na jwoori to, de ba dwonna kaanem tiina bam, de ba tete de.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina balo maama na nwoŋi Babilon ne ba jwoori ba ba to ma di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem. Balo maama de na pɔɔre ba tete de wo-zɔɔna kikia yalo dwi-gɛ tiina bam na kare ba ke to, ye ba laam ba se ba zuli Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom to ma tɔge ba di kuri dem.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma kwei da yarepɛ ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem de wopwolo. Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se ba di ywoni de o na pipiri Asiria teo pɛ boboŋa pa se o woli-ba se ba wane ba jwoori ba lɔ Isarele tiina Wɛ wom diga kam ba zege tei to.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: Ezera déem ye tɔnɔ tu mo, ye o zamese Wɛ nia yam Moses na jwoŋi Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom tei ne o pa-ba to lanyerane. O de ma nwoŋi Babilon ne o jwoori Jerusalem. Pɛ wom nam ya pɛ‑o kolo maama o na lage to mo, kokuri to, o Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom zaane mo wo o yuu ne.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina badwonna, de ba kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, de lein-leena, de Wɛ diga ni yerena, de Wɛ diga tontoŋena bam maa tɔge ded‑o se ba vo Jerusalem. Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim bena yarepɛ bene dem ne mo ba vei da.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye boboa chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo Ezera nwoŋi Babilon teo ne se o vo Jerusalem. O ma yi Jerusalem chane senu chana kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo, o Tu Wɛ wom na to o yiga ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Pɛ Atazeregese nam ya kwei tɔnɔ mo o pa Ezera. Ezera déem ye Wɛ nia zamesem tu mo ye o ta ye Wɛ kaanem tu. O ma zamese Baŋa Wɛ nia yalo de o chullu telo o na pɛ Isarele tiina bam to. Tɔnɔ kom wo wonnu mo tento:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Amo Pɛ Atazeregese ye pwa maama pa-faro mo. Amo popone tɔnɔ konto a pa Ezera na ye kaanem tu, ye o zamese Telaao Tu Wɛ wom nia yam to. Yazura taa wo n tei ne.

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Amo de a nakwa barepɛ bam nam toŋe‑m se n vo n nii ko na ye tei nɔɔna balo na zoore Judah de Jerusalem jei sem ne to yera ne mo. Véi n nii nɔɔna bam kikia maŋe de n Tu Wɛ nia yalo o na ke n jeŋa ne to naa ya wo maŋe.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nam ta kwei lu-nyenno, de sabu-seŋa kalo amo de a nakwa bam na wó pa‑m to n woli da n ja n vo, se n ma-te n ke pɛɛre n pa Isarele tiina Wɛ wom na zoore Jerusalem teo wone to. Mo dé boboŋa na lage se n ke tei to.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nmo ná wae lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa kalo maama Babilon kateiri ne n lae, de wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yalo Isarele tiina bam, de ba kaanem tiina na wó pa‑m se ya woli Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam totoŋa ŋwaane to, se n ja-te n viiri.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑n yei se n kwei sabu kom konto n yeigi na-bale, de pi-bale, de pipeili, de wodiu pɛɛra, de sana pɛɛra. Nmo ma‑n wó ja-te n vo abam Wɛ wom diga kam Jerusalem ne, n ke kaanem o bimbini dem baŋa ne n pa‑o.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa kalo ná daare, se nmo de n dwonna bam kwei-te á ke á na lage tei to se ko maŋe de á Tu Wɛ boboŋa yam.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná gɛ woŋo se á ma á toŋe Wɛ diga kam totoŋe delo maama, n jege chwoŋa se n jwoŋi sabu dé teo paare dim sabia yam wone.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: Amo, Pɛ Atazeregese nam ta pɛ ni dento mo a sabu tiŋina balo maama na nii Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem to: Ke-na kolo maama Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera na lage to á pa‑o lela. Wonto nam ta ye Telaao Tu Wɛ wom nia yam zamesem tu mo.

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á kwei kolo maama Telaao Tu Wɛ wom na laga o diga kam totoŋa ŋwaane to á pa Ezera. Kokuri to, ko dae se o bane zaŋe de amo naa balo na saŋe amo kwaga ba di paare to.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Amo nam ta pɛ ni we, ko ná ye Wɛ kaanem tiina, de Levi tiina, de lein-leena, de Wɛ diga ni-yerena, de ka tontoŋena, de balo na toŋe totoŋa yadwonna Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane to, ko dae se á jwoŋi lampwoo banto tei ne.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nmo Ezera, kwei swa yalo n Tu Wɛ wom na pɛ‑m to, se n kuri nɔɔna badwonna se ba taa nii balo maama na zoore Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore seeni ye ba tɔge nmo Tu Wɛ wom nia yam to. Dedɛɛra bam konto wó tɔge chega ba di nɔɔna bam taana ba pa-ba. Balo nam na yeiri Wɛ nia yam to, se n kwei-ya n bere-ba.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Wolo ná ve nmo Wɛ wom nia yam, de amo paare nia yam, ba jege se ba yɔɔre ba waare kotu mo. Ba ná wo go‑o, se ba mage gulu ba zeili‑o o teo wone. Ko ná dae konto, se ba vere o jejegero, naa ba vɔ‑o ba pe diga ne.” Ezera ke Wɛ lei

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ezera ma ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na ye dé nabaara Wɛ to maŋe de tia mo! Wonto mo pɛ se pɛ wom boboŋa ja se Wɛ diga kalo na wo Jerusalem wone to na zula yanto dwoŋi.

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta tɔge o swono kom baŋa o pa se amo kikia su pɛ wom yi, ye o nakwa de o dedɛɛra de nege-ne. Amo Tu Wɛ zaane na wo amo yuu ne to ŋwaane mo a nɛ baare. Amo ma la Isarele yiga tiina badwonna a ke daane, a daare a pa se ba tɔge de amo ba vo Jerusalem.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim maŋa ne mo dé zege Babilon teo ne se dé jwoori dé vo Jerusalem. Ba na jeeli sam yiga tiina balo na tɔge de amo ba jwoori to yera mo tento:

english_verse: polished bronze articles as valuable as gold.
translation_verse: Geresom mo nwoŋi Finehase sɔ-yuu kom ne. Danyeli ma nwoŋi Itamara sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: other men of the Parosh family, who had family records; Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Parose sɔ-yuu kom ne. Baara bam konto nabaara natɔga kam déem popone ka tiŋi tɔnɔ ne mo.

english_verse: men of the Pahath Moab family; Shecaniah son of Jahaziel with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Pahafe-Moaba sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Zattu family; Ebed son of Jonathan with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Zaatu sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Adin family; Jeshaiah son of Athaliah with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Adin sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Shephatiah family; Obadiah son of Jehiel with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Sefatia sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Joab family; Shelomith son of Josiphiah with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Joaba sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Bani family; Zechariah son of Bebai with
translation_verse: ) ma nwoŋi Bani sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Amo ma ta de kaanem tiina bam a we, “Abam pɔɔre mo á ye á yera Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Zela yanto de nam pɔɔre mo ya ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem. Sabu-seŋa kam, de lu-nyenno tem maama ye nɔɔna bam wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra mo ba na kwei ba pa abam nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: men of the Azgad family; Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah who returned sometime later with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Azagadi sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: men of the Adonikam family; Uthai and Zaccur with
translation_verse: ) badwonna ma nwoŋi Adonikam sɔ-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Amo Ezera déem ma ta se dé kɔgɔ kom jeeri bu-nɔgɔ kolo na duri ko maa vei Ahava seeni to ni ne. Dé ma chwi dé vwoa dé ke da yatɔ dáane. Amo na nii to, mo a maane we Levi tiina tera dé kɔgɔ kom wone, se kaanem tiina yera mo wora.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: A laam ma toŋe a bwoŋi yiga tiina banto: Eliazera, de Areli, de Semaya, de Elinatan, de Jaribi, de Elinatan, de Natan, de Zekaria, de Mesulam. A ta ma toŋe Joyariba, de Elinatan kwaga ne, ba na ye yi-pore-nyena to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Wɛ wom nam na to debam yiga to ŋwaane mo ba toŋe Serebia se o ba dé tei. O déem ye Levi dwi tu na nwoŋi Mahili sɔ-yuu kom ne to mo. O maa ye boboŋa tu lanyerane. O bia de o chorro fuga-nana ma tɔge ded‑o ba ba.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Ba ta pɛ se Hasabia, de Jesaya, de ba chorro finlei mo tɔge ba ba dé tei ne. Banto ye Merari sɔ-yuu kom tiina mo.

english_verse: others came to help the Levites in the temple. The ancestors of these workers had been chosen years ago by King David and his officials, and they were all listed by name. Ezra Asks the People To Go without Eating and To Pray
translation_verse: ) mo ba dé tei. Pɛ David de o dedɛɛra bam déem mo kuri nɔɔna bam konto nabaara se ba yeini ba toŋe ba woli Levi tiina bam. Ba ma popone ba maama yera ba tiŋi tɔnɔ ne. Ba na ti ba yiga se ba kɛ tei to

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Dé déem na wo Ahava bu-nɔgɔ kom ni ne konto to, a ma pa ni se dé vɔ ni dé ma dé gwooni dé tete dé Tu Wɛ yiga ne. Dé ma lwoori Wɛ se o kwɛ dé chwoŋa se ka ke lam, se o daare o kwoli debam, de dé bia, dedaane dé jejegero chwoŋa kam yuu ne.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane dé ma vɔ ni ye dé ja Wɛ teiŋa se o woli debam. O ma sɛ dé wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Amo ma le nɔɔna fuga-balei kaanem yiga tiina bam wone. A ta ma kuri Serebia, de Hasabia, de ba chorro fuga badwonna a woli da.

english_verse: silver articles weighing
translation_verse: ) dunni ye kilo fuserepɛ (

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Ta‑á nii-na te baŋa ne lanyerane, se á ja-te á yi Jerusalem Wɛ diga kam wone. Á ná yi da, se á kwei-te á ja zo Wɛ diga kam wone á daare á maŋe te ni kaanem tiina di sem ne. Á laam wó kwei-te á ke Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam, de Levi tiina, de Isarele sɔ-yuni yiga tiina bam jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amo na tage konto a ti to, kaanem tiina bam de Levi tiina bam ma sɛ se ba ja lu-nyenno tem, de sabu-seŋa kam, de lonne zela yam konto maama ba vo Jerusalem ba tiŋi debam Tu Wɛ diga kam wone. Ba na zaŋe ba jwoori Jerusalem tei to

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Boboa chana kam da fuga-yalei dɛ dem wone mo dé zaŋe Ahava bu-nɔgɔ kom jei sem ne se dé vo Jerusalem. Debam na wo chwoŋa yuu ne dé maa vei to mo dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ déem wo dé tei ne, ye o che debam pa se dé dona de venverena wo daane debam.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Dé ma vo dé yi Jerusalem, ye dé maŋe da dé sii da yatɔ.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Da yana na kɛ to, mo dé zo dé Tu Wɛ wom diga kam. Dé ma maŋe lu-nyenno tem, de sabu-seŋa kam, de lonne zela yam maama, ye dé daare dé kwei-te dé ke kaanem tu Yuria bu Meremofa jeŋa ne.
