Finehase bu Eleaza de maa wo o tei ne, ko woli de Levi tiina balei: Jesua bu Jozabadi, dedaane Binnui bu Noadia.

english_verse: Those who had returned from exile offered sacrifices on the altar to the God of Israel. Twelve bulls were offered for all Israel. Ninety-six rams and
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori ba ba to ma kwei vara ba zwɛ ba ma ke kaanem ba pa Isarele tiina Wɛ wom. Ko nam ye na-bale fuga-selei (

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: ) ba ke wɛleere saarem kaanem.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ta ma kwei pɛ wom nia yalo o na popone tɔnɔ kom ne to ba pa yiga tiina de dedɛɛra balo na nii Yuferata wɛ-zoore seeni kateiri dem to. Ba de ma sɛ, ye ba woli nɔɔna bam de ba Wɛ diga kam totoŋa.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Wonnu tem konto maama na ke te kɛ to, Juu tiina yiga tiina badaara ma ba ba ta de amo ba we, “Isarele tiina bam, de ba kaanem tiina de Levi tiina badwonna wo sɛ se ba pwɛ ba tete de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na maŋe ba zoore tega kam wone to. Banto yɔɔre ba ke totoŋ-zɔɔna yalo Kanaan tiina, de Hiti tiina, de Pɛrizi tiina, de Jebusi tiina, de Amon tiina, de Moaba tiina, de Ejipti tiina, de Amori tiina bam maama na yeini ba ke to dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ke tei to, Isarele tiina baara mo vei ba kwei teene dem konto bukwa se ba taa ye ba kaana. Ba ta swo teene dem bukwa mo ba pa ba bia. Konto ma pa se dwi delo ya na ye de yera Wɛ ŋwaane to laam galeme ba tete de dwia yalo na gilimi-ba to. Ko nam ye ba dedɛɛra bam de ba yiga tiina bam mo chɔge ba dwoni.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Ba taane dem yɔɔre de chɔge a wo mo pa se a ja a gwaaro a kaare. A ta ma vaŋe a yu-ywei, de a twana a vuuri. A ma daare a jei tega ne de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Balo maama na kɔre foone de Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ nia yam to ma ba, ye ba de jeini amo tei ne, balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to na ke ba tusi tei to ŋwaane. Amo maa yɔɔre a jei de wo-chechɔgɔ konto taa, se ko yi dedaan-ni kaanem maŋa kam.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Dedaan-ni kaanem maŋa kam na yi to, a ma zege a ya na jei mɛ de a gare-kekwarro tem to a zaŋe wɛɛne. A laam ma kuni a nadwoona, ye a daare a zeiŋi a je sem a jeeri a Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: A ma lwoori Wɛ ye a we: “Amo Tu Wɛ, chaveera tiini ya jege-ne se a kwoni a yibia a nii nmo seeni. Debam wɛleera yam diini vili vili mo ya dwoni dé yuni tem na yi mɛ to. Dé na chɔge tei to maŋe ko di ko gaale wɛyuu na wo mɛ to mo.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Se ko nwoŋi faŋa to, debam dedaane dé nabaara bam yɔɔre dé ke dé chɔge nmo yiga mo. Dé wɛleera yam na wo dé yuu ne to ŋwaane nam mo pɛ se teene dedwonna pwa jege dam debam, de dé pwa, dedaane dé kaanem tiina bam baŋa ne, pa se ba go debam badwonna, ye ba ja debam badwonna de ba vo ba yage ba teene wone. Ba ta vere debam jejegero mo, ye ba ta kwori ba ke debam chaveera, nenɛɛne ko na ye tei dé yera ne zem to.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Leile konto debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ke zaane debam yuu ne maŋa kukua kanto wone, ye o pa dé kɔgɔ fenfee jwoori ko nwoŋi dé kabɛɛne dem wone se ko bwoŋi o yere. O ta pɛ se dé na kugu jei o tete teo kom ne, ye dé ŋwea jwoori ka ke lam. Dé laam nɛ siu fenfee dé kabɛɛne totoŋa yam baŋa ne.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, dé ye kabɛ mo. Dé Tu Wɛ wom nam wo ve debam o yage dé kabɛɛne dem wone. O dɛ o swono kom baŋa ne mo, o pa se Peresia pwa bam ke debam lanyerane. O ma pa debam chwoŋa se dé taa ŋwe ye dé wane dé jwoori dé lɔ dé Wɛ wom diga kam, dé daare dé jwoori dé kwɛ-ka pa ka zege. O ma daare o kwoli debam Jerusalem teo kom wone, de Judah jei sem maama ne.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, wonnu tento maama na ke to, dé nam daa jege bɛ mo se dé ta? Debam daa mo ve nmo nia yam,

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: nmo na tɔge n ni-jwoŋina bam baŋa n kwei-ya n pa debam to. Nmo sampwori sem konto déem kaane debam ba we, ‘Nɔɔna balo na zoore tega kalo á na wó zo ka wone á jwoŋi-ka to yɔɔre ba ke totoŋ-zɔɔna mo. Tega kam ni maama maa su dedaane ba wo-yɔɔro kikia, pa se ka maama chɔge.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam yé sɛ se á bukwa zo ba bia, se á ta yé pa á bia de di ba bukwa ba ma ji ba kaana. Daa á yé woli-ba kɔtaa, naa á ke kolo na wó pa-ba yazura to. Á ná pwɛ á tete de-ba konto, á kɔgɔ kom wó ke dam, ye á di tega kam ywoni. Á ta wó daare tega kam á pa á kwaga kam se ba de taa zoore da taa wuu.’

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Konto to, dé wó wane dé daa ve nmo nia yam se dé di puseŋ-nyena banto bukwa na? Dé ná ke konto, nmo bane wó tiini de zaŋe de debam mo, pa se n chɔge debam maama n ti, ye dé wolowolo bá daare.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye chega tu mo. Nmo nam pɛ se debam lu dé kabɛɛne dem wone pa se dé kɔgɔ fenfee zem wo n yiga ne. Dé wɛleera yam nam wo dé yuu ne mo, ye dé ba jege bora nmo tei ne.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Ezera déem lwoori Wɛ mo, ye o sɛ we Isarele tiina bam ke wɛleera yanto ba chɔge Wɛ yiga. O ma yɔɔre o ka yi-na, ye o vwi o yibia tega ne Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ne. Isarele tiina bam kɔ-fɔrɔ ma la daane ba yi o tei ba de tɔge ba keeri dedɛ. Ko maa ye baara, de kaana, de bia mo wora konto.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Jeheli na ye Elam dwi tu to bu Sekania ma ta de Ezera o we, “Chega ŋwaane to, debam ywori dé Tu Wɛ kwaga ne dedaane dé na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa banto na nwoŋi teene delo na gilimi debam to. De ko de, dé yei we teena ta wora ya pae Isarele tiina.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Debam nam zege se dé gwoni ni mo de dé Tu Wɛ wom we, dé wó yage kaana banto maama de ba bia se ba viiri. Debam ti yiga se dé sɛ nmo, de balo maama na kɔre foone de dé Tu Wɛ nia yam ye á ta se dé ke kolo to. Nam pa se ko ke ko tɔge Wɛ nia yam na bere tei to.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Nmo mo jege se n ke keim. Nam ta‑n jege baare, se dé zege n kwaga ne.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Ezera ma pɛ o zaŋe ye o pa se kaanem yiga tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam, dedaane Isarele tiina bam maama du duuri we, ba wó ke tei maama Sekania na tage to. Ba maama ma seene ba du duuri.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: O laam ma yage Wɛ diga kam jei sem ye o vo Eliasibi bu Jehohanan diga ne o peini da. O na wora konto to, o ma ve se o di wodiu, naa se o nyɔ na, o wo na chɔge de Isarele tiina balo na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to na ywori Wɛ kwaga ne tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: Nakwa de yiga tiina bam ni dem konto bere we, da yatɔ ná yia, ye wolo ná wo tɔge o jeeri da, konto tu wó ga o jejegero maama mo, se ba daare ba le‑o ba kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ dɛ dem na yi to, mo baara balo maama na zoore Judah de Benjamin jei sem ne to tu Jerusalem teo ne. Chane nogo chana kam da finlei dɛ ne mo ba déem jeeri Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ne. Nɔɔna bam na jei da konto to, ba yera maa sae, ba jeerim dem na ye wo-chɛɔ, ye doa ta na nena dedɛ de dɛ dem ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera ma zaŋe wɛɛne ye o ta de-ba o we, “Abam seene á ywori Wɛ kwaga ne de á na di ka-gɛ se ba taa ye á kaana to. Abam wɛleera yam konto maa wo Isarele tiina bam maama yuu ne.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Nam ve-na á wɛleera yam á nabaara Baŋa Wɛ wom yiga ne, se á daare á ke kolo na wó tɔge o boboŋa to. Pɔɔre-na á tete de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore tega kanto ne to, se á daare á yage á ka-gɛ sem se ba viiri.”

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Dé nam na zege ywo-seeni to, dé tiini dé daga, ye dé daa ware ywo se dé zege taa, ko na ye yadɛ ye doa nena dedɛ to ŋwaane. Taane dento dae se dé kwei dɛ dedwe naa da yalei yerane se dé kwɛ-de. Ko ye debam dedɛ mo zo wɛleere dento wone.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná sɛ, pa se dé yiga tiina bam ja taane dem ba pa debam maama. Dé teene dem maama wone wolo maama ná jege dwi-gɛ tiina bukɔ o di o ke kaane, kotu wó tɔge de o teo kom nakwa, de balo na nii ba teo kom taana baŋa ne to, ba ba maŋa kalo dedɛɛra bam na kuri se ba kwɛ o taane dem to. Konto wó pa se Wɛ bane zuri de de na zaŋe debam keim dento baŋa ne tei to.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama ma sɛ taane dem konto. Asaheli bu Jonatan, de Tikeva bu Jahazeya yerane mo ve-de, ye Mesulam, de Levi dwi tu Sabetayi pu ba kwaga.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Balo déem na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori to ma sɛ se ba ke kolo ba na tage to. Wɛ kaanem tu Ezera de ma le baara badwonna na ye sɔ-yuu yiga tiina to, ye o popone ba yera o tiŋi. Chane fuga kam boboa dɛ dem ne mo ba bobo se ba nii taane dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei chane setɔ ba buŋi ba lɔre Isarele tiina balo na jege ka-gɛ sem to. Balo na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa to yera

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: Ba déem ma pwooli we ba wó yage ba kaana bam. Ba maama dedoa dedoa ma kwei pi-bala ba ma ke kaanem ba wɛleera yam saarem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Imera sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Hanani, de Zebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Maaseya, de Elija, de Semaya, de Jeheli, de Yuzia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pasura sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Elio-Enayi, de Maaseya, de Isameli, de Netaneli, de Jozabadi, de Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina bam wone maa ye: Jozabadi, de Simeyi, de Kelaya , de Petahia, de Judah, de Eliazera.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Lein-leena bam wone maa ye: Eliasibi. Wɛ diga ni-yerena bam wone maa ye: Salum, de Telem, de Yuri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Isarele tiina kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama wone balo na di dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa to mo tento: Parose sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Ramia, de Izia, de Malakija, de Mijamina, de Eleaza, de Malakija, de Benaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Matania, de Zekaria, de Jeheli, de Abidi, de Jeremofa, de Elija.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Zaatu sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Elio-Enayi, de Eliasibi, de Matania, de Jeremofa, de Zabadi, de Aziza.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebayi sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Jehohanan, de Hanania, de Zabayi, de Atelayi.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Mesulam, de Maluki, de Adaya, de Jasubi, Seala, de Jeremofa.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahafe-Mowaba sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Adana, Chelali, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezaleli, Binnui, de Manasɛ.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hasum sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Matenayi, de Matata, de Zabadi, de Elifeleti, de Jeremayi, de Manasɛ, de Simeyi.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo sɔ-yuu kom nɔɔna bam wone ye: Jeyeli, de Matitia, de Zabadi, de Zebina, de Jadayi, de Joweli, de Benaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto maama mo nam ya jege dwi-gɛ tiina bukwa ba di. Ba ma yage ba kaana bam konto de ba bia pa se ba viiri.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Hakalia bu Nehemia mo bere taane dento. Ko na ke tei to mo tento: Ko déem maŋe de Peresia Pɛ Atazeregese paare dim bena finlei bene dem Kisilev chana kam ne mo. Amo Nehemia maa wo Susa te-fɔrɔ kom ne.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amo choro Hanani ma tɔge de nɔɔna badwonna o zege Judah teo ne o ba a tei. Amo ma bwei-ba se a lɔre Juu tiina balo fee na zege Babilon ne ba jwoori sɔŋɔ to yazura bwia. A daa ma bwei-ba Jerusalem teo kom bwia.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta ba bere-ne we, “Juu tiina balo na wora to wo cham de chaveera wone. Jerusalem kabiri maama sirimi, ye mini zwɛ teo kom ni bworru tem.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Amo na nigi tento maama to, mo a jeini tega ne a keeri. A kwei da dedɛ mo a vɔ ni, ye a yɔɔre a keera. A maa lwoori Wɛ ye a we:

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: “Telaao Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, nmo ye kamunu mo, ye dé tiini dé kɔre‑m. N zege de chega mo n swono kom baŋa ne n swoi balo na swoi‑m ye ba tɔge n nia yam to, ne n na gwoni ni se n ke n pa-ba tei to.

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: Jan ja! Nii amo seeni, se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kolo a na lwoori wea de tete maama nmo tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam ŋwaane to. A lage a ta jaja we debam Isarele tiina yɔɔre dé ke wɛleera dedɛ. Chega to, amo, de a nabaara de tɔge dé woli da.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Nam guli we n ya maŋe n ta de Moses n we, ‘Abam Isarele tiina bam ná wo jaane chega de amo, a lage a jage abam mo a yage teene dedwonna wone.

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Se á nam ná jwoori se á ba amo tei ye á sɛ a nia yam, amo wó ja abam a jwoori mɛ a na kuri se á ta‑á zuli-ne da to, nenɛɛne á ná maŋe á jage á vo á wo jei selo maama ne de.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, yé swei we banto ye n tete nɔɔna de n tontoŋena mo. Ko nam ye nmo mo kwei n dam dem n ma n vere-ba n yage.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Nam cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom se n daare n sɛ n tontoŋena bam maama na beeri nmo zula to de ba na lwoori kolo to. Pa se pɛ wom duri a yibwona se a na yiga-veiŋa zem.” Kanto maŋa kam ne amo zoore de pɛ wom mo a nii o wodiu baŋa ne.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne, chane sena mo kɛ ye Nisan chana kam yi. Dɛ dedwe pɛ Atazeregese na jei o di wodiu to, mo a jaane sana a zo o tei se a pa‑o. Pɛ wom nam maŋe o wo nɛ amo yi-nyɔna a totoŋa baŋa ne.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ne o we, “Bɛ mo ke ye n yibia nyɔne konto? A ba boŋe we n weela. Woŋo mo daane‑m na?” O taane dem ma yɔɔre de pa a bochare di,

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: pa se a leiri we, “Pɛ, Wɛ wó pa‑m momwɛ-dɛɛre. Amo wo wó ke tɛ mo ko pwoli ye teo kolo ba na suli a nabaara bam da to laam jigi di-dwonnu? Ko ni bworru tem maama de maa zwɛ zwɛ.”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Peresia teo pɛ wom maa bwei-ne o we, “Nmo nam lage se a ke bɛ mo a pa‑m?” A ma ware Telaao Tu Wɛ wom a wone se o woli-ne,

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Ka-pɛ wom déem jei pɛ wom saŋa ne mo. Pɛ wom ma bwei-ne a na wó dáane da tei, dedaane maŋa kalo a na wó jwoori to. O na sɛ se o toŋe-ne konto to, a ma ta a bere‑o a na wó ke kolo maama to.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: A ta lwoori pɛ wom a we, “Nmo ná sɛ se n ke-ne zaane, pa-ne twanno telo a na wó pa nmo dedɛɛra balo na tei Yuferata buga kam wɛ-zoore laŋa kam to. Twanno tem konto wó woli se a kɛ a yi Judah se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé daane-ne chwoŋa ne.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: A ta lwoori‑m se n pa-ne tɔnɔ se a ja vo a pa Asaf, o na nii pɛ goa kam baŋa ne to. A maa lage se o pa debam da-ŋwe se dé ma dé fɔge dé lɔ dalem jei sem na wo Wɛ diga kam yera ne to nia yam, de teo kom kabiri sem, dedaane sɔŋɔ kolo wone a na wó taa zoore to.” Pɛ wom ma pa-ne kolo maama a na lwoori o tei ne to, amo Tu Wɛ wom na to a yiga ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom déem ma pa se jar-keira yiga tiina de ba jar-keira na dɔge sisein-nɔɔna to tɔge-ne se dé vo. A laam ma vo a yi nawuura yalo na bɛ Yuferata buga kam to, ye a kwei pɛ wom twanno tem a pa dedɛɛra balo na tei laŋa kam konto to.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ko daare Sanbalati, wonto ye Bɛte-Horon teo tu mo. Tobia de maa ye Amon laŋa kam yiga tu. Ba na nigi we nɔɔno tua se o beeri Isarele dwi tiina lanyerane to, mo ba wo tiini ko fuli.

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: A na yi Jerusalem to, a ke da yatɔ da

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: ye a wo pɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno lɔre Wɛ na bere-ne se a ke kolo a pa Jerusalem to. Amo laam ma zaŋe tete-koro ne a nwoŋi de a yuudwonna fenfee. Bonaga kalo amo déem na diini to mo ya ye varem wolo yerane dé na kwei dé woli da.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Ko ta na ye tete to, mo a nwoŋi a tɔge Bwolo-seeni ni dem a kɛ. A laam ma tu a gaale Juru vole dem a vo a yi Tampuuri ni dem. A na kare a vei konto to, mo a nii a na teo kom kabiri sem na sirimi tei, dedaane mini dem na chɔge teo kom ni bworru tem tei to.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: A laam ma vo a yi Buli-yi ni dem, ye a ta vo Pɛ Chɔgɔ kom seeni. Bonaga kam a na diini to ma ga chwoŋa se ka tɔge kalankula de weero tem wone ka kɛ.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Teo kom nakwa bam wolowolo yeiri amo ya na vei to, de a na maŋe a ke kolo maama to. A nam wo tage kolokolo de a dwonna Juu tiina bam, ko ná ye ba kaanem tiina bam, naa ba nakwa bam, naa ba yiga tiina bam, naa balo maama na wó da ba toŋe totoŋe dem to de.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ta de-ba a we, “Nii-na dé na wo lɛɛro telo wone to. Jerusalem teo kom laam jigi di-dwonnu mo, ye ko bworru tem de zwɛ zwɛ. Nam pa-na se dé jwoori dé lɔ ko kabiri sem dé zege, se dé daa yé taa jei de chaveera.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: A ta ma ta a bere-ba a Tu Wɛ wom na to a yiga ne tei, dedaane pɛ wom na tage kolo de amo to. Ba de ma leiri ba we, “Dé wó zaŋe wɛɛne mo se dé toŋe!” Ba ma seene ba na dam se ba bobo totoŋe dem.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Horon tu Sanbalati, de Amon tu Tobia, de Gɛsem na ye Arabi tu to ma ni dé na ti yiga se dé ke tei to. Ba ma ke debam ba mɔne ye ba we, “Abam boŋe se á ke tɛ mo? Á kikia yam nye de á boŋe se á nwoŋi Pa-faro wom kwaga ne mo.”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: A ma leiri-ba a we, “Debam ye Telaao Tu Wɛ wom tontoŋena mo. Wonto nam mo wó pa se dé vo yiga dedaane dé totoŋe maama, se dé bobo lɔɔm dem. Ko nam ná ye abam, á ba jege kolokolo se á jwoŋi Jerusalem ne ywo. Á nam ba tɔge á jege keim se á ke de debam chullu kikia.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Ko ye Wɛ kaanem yiga tu Eliasibi de o dwonna kaanem tiina déem mo zaŋe ba lɔ kabira kam na wo Pei Ni dem seeni to. Ba ma fɔge ba ke teo kom ni bworru tem da. Ba ta ma lɔ kabira kam ba vo ba yi Wonnu Bi di-dedɔrɔ kom, dedaane Hananeli di-dedɔrɔ kom. Ba ma kwei te maama ba pa Wɛ.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Jeriko tiina bam ma lɔ kabira kalo na twoŋi da to. Imiri bu Zakura de ma lɔ o twoŋi da.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasena sɔ-yuu kom tiina de ma lɔ Ywona ni dem. Ba ma chwi de ywoa yam, ye ba daare ba ke de bworru tem te jei ne. Ba ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Yuria bu Meremofa, o ta na ye Hakoza naa to, de mo lɔge kabira kam o twoŋi da. Berekia bu Mesulam, o ta na ye Mesezabela naa to, de mo lɔge o twoŋi da. Baana bu Zadoki de maa lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tekoa teo kom tiina de ma nwoŋi ba lɔ ba twoŋi kabira kam. Ko daare, ba teo nakwa bam maa ve se ba ke totoŋ-dɛɛra yalo totoŋa yiga tiina bam na pɛ-ba se ba ke to.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Jesana ni dem, ko ye Pasea bu Joyada de Besodeya bu Mesulam déem mo kwɛ-de. Ba ma chwi de ywoa yam, ye ba daare ba ke de bworru tem te jei ne. Ba ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu mo se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Gibeon tu Melatia, de Meronofa tu Jadon, de Gibeon tiina bam, de Mizipa tiina mo ke daane ba lɔ kabira kam ba twoŋi da. Mizipa déem ye teo kolo Yuferata wɛ-zoore seeni laŋa dedɛɛro wom na zoore to mo.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Harahaya bu Yuzeli déem ye sabu-seŋa gɔgɔ mo. O de ma lɔ o twoŋi da. Hanania na yei terale nuga keim to, de ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi. Banto ma fɔge ba kwɛ Jerusalem kabiri sem se ko vo ko yi Kabiri-kayɔlɔ kom seeni.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Hura bu Refaya déem tei Jerusalem laŋa kam chichworo mo. O de ma lɔ o twoŋi da.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Harumafa bu Jedaya de ma lɔ o twoŋi mɛ na bwola de o tete sɔŋɔ to. Hasabeneya bu Hatusi de daa ma lɔ mɛ na twoŋi da to.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Harim bu Malakija dedaane Pahafe-Moaba bu Hasubi de déem ma lɔ ba twoŋi kabira kam ne, ye ba daare ba kwɛ Jugu di-dedɔrɔ kom.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohese bu Salum de déem na nii Jerusalem laŋa kadwoŋi kam to ma vo o lɔ o twoŋi da. O bukwa ma woli‑o de o totoŋa yam.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Rekabi bu Malakija na nii Bɛte-Hakerem laŋa kam to ma fɔge o lɔ Tampuuri Ni dem. O ma ke de bworru tem te jei ne ye o ta ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Kola-Hozɛ bu Salum déem na nii Mizipa laŋa kam to ma fɔge o lɔ Buli-yi Ni dem. O ma pu-de ye o daare o ke de bworru tem te jei ne. O ta ma ke luuru dedaane da-kamunnu se ba taa mae ba pe ka ni dem. Ko ná ye Sela Chɔgɔ kom, o lɔge kabira mo pa se ka saŋe pɛ wom kaduga kam. Kabira kam ta tole ka yi nateina yalo na maa diini ya zoore David teo kom to mo.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Azabuki bu Nehemia déem na nii Bɛte-Zura laŋa kam chichworo to ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da se ka vo ka yi David yibeeli dem seeni, ka daare ka yi chɔgɔ kom, ko woli de jar-keira tiga jei sem seeni. Levi tiina balo na lɔge kabira kam to

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Levi tiina badwonna de dɛ ba lɔ kabira kam: Ko maa ye Bani bu Rehum mo lɔge o twoŋi daa kadwoŋi. Hasabia na ye Keila laŋa chichworo kom yiga tu to zege o laŋa kam yuu ne o lɔ o twoŋi da.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Keila laŋa chichworo kodwoŋi kom, Henadadi bu Binnui na ye ka yiga tu to de o chorro tem mo lɔge ba twoŋi da.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Jesua bu Ezere déem na ye Mizipa yiga tu to ma lɔ o twoŋi kabira kam se ko maŋe de jara zela tigisim diga kam yiga ne. O ta lɔge-ka mo o vo o yi mɛ kabira kam na gugwoli to.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Zabayi bu Baruki daa ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da, o zege ka gugwolim jei sem ne o lɔ o yi kaanem tu Eliasibi sɔŋɔ ni ne mo.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Yuria bu Meremofa wolo ta na ye Hakoza naa to de ma lɔ o twoŋi kabira kam o vo o yi Eliasibi sɔŋɔ daa kadwoŋi kam ne. Kaanem tiina balo na lɔge kabira kam to

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Balo de déem na lɔge kabira kam ba twoŋi da to ye kaanem tiina balo na zoore Jerusalem laŋa kam ne to mo.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Benjamin de Hasubi ma lɔ mɛ na bwola de ba sam to ba twoŋi da. Maaseya bu Azaria wolo ta na ye Anania naa to de ma lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi mɛ na bwola de o sɔŋɔ to.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadadi bu Binnui de ma lɔ o twoŋi da se ko zege Azaria sɔŋɔ ne se ko yi mɛ kabira kam na gugwoli ye gugworo wora to.

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Yuzayi bu Palale de daa ma lɔ kabira kam o zege gugworo kom yiga ne, baŋa seeni pɛ sɔŋɔ di-dedɔrɔ kom na wo mɛ ye ko bwola de pa-tara bam konkɔlɔ to. Parose bu Pedaya de daa ma lɔ o twoŋi da se ko taa vei wɛ-puli seeni. O lɔge o vo o yi Na Ni dem seeni dedaane di-dedɔrɔ kolo na zege da to mo. Ofeli jei sem ne mo konto, Wɛ diga tontoŋena bam déem na zoore mɛ to.

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Tekoa teo tiina bam de daa ma lɔ ba twoŋi da. Banto toŋe di-dedɔrɔ-kamunu kom na zege mɛ to seeni, ye ba lɔ ba vo ba yi kabira kam na bwola de Ofeli to.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina badwonna de daa ma lɔ kabira kam ba twoŋi da. Ba zege Sisein-nɔɔno Ni dem ne mo ba lɔa ba vei baŋa kam seeni. Nɔɔno maama déem zege o tete sɔŋɔ ne mo o lɔa.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yimera bu Zadoki de ma lɔ o twoŋi kabira kam jei selo na zege o sɔŋɔ kom yiga ne to. Sekania bu Semaya wolo na ye Wɛ-puli seeni Ni yereno wom to ma lɔ o twoŋi da.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Selemia bu Hanania, de Hanun na ye Zalafe bia baredo tu wom to, de daa maa lɔ ba twoŋi da. Berekia bu Mesulam de ma zege o di sem yiga ne o lɔ kabira kam o twoŋi da.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Malakija na ye sabu-seŋa gɔgɔ to mo lɔge kabira kam o twoŋi da. O ma vo o yi sɔŋɔ kolo Wɛ diga tontoŋena de pipim-piina na zoore to. Jei sem konto déem bwola de Yerem Ni dem mo. O ta lɔge o yi mɛ kabira kam na jege gugworo ye wɛyuu diga wo ka yera ne to mo.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Sabu-seŋa gwaro tem de pipim-piina bam de laam ma zege gugworo kom diga kam na wo mɛ to ba lɔ kabira kam ba vo ba yi Pei Ni dem seeni.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Sanbalati na yɔɔre o ni we debam Juu tiina bam wora dé fɔge dé lɔ Jerusalem kabiri sem to, mo ko tiini ko fuli o wo. O laam ma bobo se o taa ke debam o mɔna.

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: O déem zege o yuudwonna yiga ne, dedaane Samaria jar-keira bam yiga ne mo ye o ta o we, “Juu tiina nabwona banto boŋe we ba wora ba ke bɛ mo? Ba boŋe se ba jwoori ba lɔ ba teo kom ba pe mo na? Ba teene we dɛ dedwe kaanem wó wane de gare de ti ba totoŋa yam mo na? Ba nam wó wane ba na kandwa se ya nwoŋi weero tento wone ye mini chɔge-ya to na?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Amon tu Tobia déem zege o tei ne mo. O de ma leiri o taane dem o we, “Nii kabira kalo ba na wora ba lɔa to! Yiru tete ná diini ka baŋa ne, o wó yigi-ka mo o de tega ne!”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Amo de ma lwoori Wɛ a we, “Debam Wɛ, nii ba na gwooni debam tei! Cheigi mwanno telo dwi ba na mɔne debam to! Nam pipiri ba mwanno tem se te jwoori ba tete yuu ne. Pa se nɔɔna vere ba jejegero maama, se ba daare ba zeŋe-ba ba ja ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga.

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Ko daare Sanbalati, de Tobia, de Arabi tiina bam, de Amon tiina bam, de Asedodi tiina bam maama na nigi we dé lɔge kabira kam pa se ka vo yiga, ye pwoli sem maama se to, mo ba bane tiini de zaŋe.

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Banto maama ma sɔ ni se ba jeeri Jerusalem teo kom de jara. Ba ta ma boŋe se ba pa se vuvuga taa wora jei maama wone.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Debam de ma yɔɔre dé ware Wɛ, ye dé daare dé pa se nɔɔna yere teo kom wea de tete maama dé dona bam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam déem yeini ba leeni mo ye ba toŋa. Ba maa we, “Debam tontoŋena bam zeŋe zela dé bugi! Nii teero de weero na daga tei! Dé zem wó ke tetɛ mo dé lɔ kabira kam?”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Dé dona de maa tɛ ba we, “Dé wó pɔpɔ dé ba ba baŋa ne! Ba bá wuuri ba lɔre ko ni ne. Dé laam maa wó go-ba se totoŋa yam kwori.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Ko nam na ke tei to, Juu tiina balo na zoore ba twɛ de dé dona bam to ma yeini ba ba kuni dedɛ wone, ba ta dé dona bam boboŋa yam ba bere debam.

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se a le nɔɔna badwonna ye ba zege kabira kam jei teiri teiri wone. Ba déem zege da dedaane se-zɔɔro, de chichwoa, de chena mo. A déem kuri-ba diga de diga mo se ba zege mɛ maama ta na wo lɔge ko di to.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Amo ma na we keim dem maama daane nɔɔna bam mo. A ma ta de nɔɔna bam, de ba yiga tiina, de ba nakwa bam a we, “Yé ta‑á kɔre-na dé dona bam. Nam guli-na we dé Teiru Wɛ wom ye kamunu, ye o totoŋa yɛ ni. Konto mo wó pa se á jaŋe á dwonna Isarele tiina bam, de á bia, de á kaana, de á sam dem ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Dé dona bam ma maane we dé lɔre ba na sɔge ni se ba ke tei to. Wɛ de ma pa se ba boboŋa yam ji kafɛ. Ba na ke ye ba ga dé ŋwa to ŋwaane, dé maama dedoa dedoa ma jwoori dé lɔɔm jei.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Lɔra bam tete kwei se-zɔɔro mo ba vɔ ba tei ne ye ba lɔa. Ko daare wolo wom na yeini o wui nabɔnɔ kom to yerane mo zege amo tei ne.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ta de dedɛɛra bam, de nakwa bam, dedaane nɔɔna bam maama a we, “Totoŋa yam laŋa yala, ye ya jage ya yi kabira kam ni maama pa se dé ba nae daane.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Abam nam ná wo mɛ maama ye á ni nabɔnɔ kom kwori, se á ba debam tei ywo-seeni. Dé Wɛ wom mo lage o jaŋe o pa debam.”

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to mo a déem tage nɔɔna bam we, “Nɔɔno maama de o wolinu jege se ba maŋe Jerusalem ne mo ba peini. Konto mo wó pa se ba taa yere dé teo kom tete ne, se wea ne ba wane ba taa toŋa.”

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo tete, de a chorro tem, de a tontoŋena bam, de balo na yere-ne to maama, debam wolowolo yeini dé ware se dé le dé gwaaro dé tiŋi wea ne, naa tete ne. Dé maama yɔɔre dé yeini dé vɔ dé jara zela mo kiri kiri dé zega.

english_verse: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power
translation_verse: Ko déem na woli fee to, mo nɔɔna dedɛ, kaana de baara maama bobo se ba taa tiini ba poona ba dwonna Juu tiina bam.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ déem mo tɛ ba we, “Dé bia tiini ba daga mo, dé nam ná wo nɛ wodiu se dé di, debam dedaane dé bia wó te mo.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Badwonna maa tɛ ba we, “Debam kwei dé te sem, de dé kare, dedaane dé sam mo dé tiŋi daare ye dé jwoŋi wodiiru se dé di sem tiina wori.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Badaara daa ta maa we, “Debam jene sabia mo se dé ma dé ŋwe Pɛ wom lampwoo kom o na tiŋi dé kare dedaane dé kadwi ŋwaane to.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Nam nii! Debam de dé dwonna Juu tiina bam ye woŋo dedoa mo, dé ye yera de jana daane. Debam bia de banto bia ba gare daane, ye dé laam kwei debam bia bam dé yeigi dé pa-ba se ba taa ye kabɛ. Ba fe debam se dé yeigi dé bukwa dé pa-ba. Ba ta ma vere debam kare, de dé kadwi pa se dé daa ware kolokolo se dé ke.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Amo na nigi ba ŋwaana yam to mo a bane yɔɔre de zaŋe.

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: ye a we, “Dé ya kwaane se dé jwoori dé yeigi Juu tiina balo ba na yeigi-ba ba pa veira to mo. Abam tete daa ma fe á chorro Juu tiina se ba yeigi ba tete ba pa abam se ba taa ye á kabɛ. Ko lana na?” Ba yiga tiina bam ma maŋe da chemm, ba na gɛ taane se ba leiri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Amo ma ta de-ba a we, “Abam na jege kolo á ke to ba lana. Abam maŋe se á kɔre Wɛ mo, se á daare á ta‑á ke lanyerane. Á ná ke konto, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ye dé dona to bá na chwoŋa se ba mɔne debam.

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Amo sɛ se nɔɔna bam ba a tei ba jene sabu de wodiu, ye balo na toŋe ba pa-ne to de ke a na ke tei to. Nam pa-na se dé daa yé taa pini dé chorro tem.

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: Kwei-na ba kadwi, de ba kare, de ba sam á jwoori á pa-ba leile. Nam ta yage-na jena yalo ba na jege to á chɛ-ba, ko ná ye mena, naa sana, naa nuga, naa sabia mo.”

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Ba de ma leiri ba we, “Dé wó seene dé ke nmo na tage tei to. Dé wó pa-ba ba wonnu maama, ye dé daa bá taa pini-ba.” Amo laam ma bwoŋi kaanem tiina bam ye a pa se nakwa bam du duuri ba yiga ne se ba ke ba tɔge ba na tage tei to.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Amo ma bwoli gɔrɔ kolo na vɔge a teiŋa ne to, ye a zezage-ko pa se wonnu telo ya na wo ka yera ne to siiri tega ne. A ma ta-ba a we, “Wolo maama ná ve se o toŋe o tɔge o ni dem, Wɛ wó zezage kotu tento dwoŋi mo se o ga o sɔŋɔ de o wonnu maama, ye o laam ta ye bwori.” Kɔgɔ kom maama ma sɛ ye ba we, “Ameena!” Ba ma tei Baŋa Wɛ ye ba daare ba ke ba tɔge ba ni dem.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra balo déem na lwoori yiga ba nii Judah laŋa kam to yeini ba fe nɔɔna bam ba jwoŋi ba lu-nyenno sabu-dala finna mo, ye ba wodiiru de sana ta zega. Ba tontoŋena de maa bɛɛse nɔɔna bam. Amo nam wo ke konto, a na kɔre Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Amo ma yɔɔre a kwei a dam de a boboŋa maama a ke kabira kam lɔɔm baŋa ne. Amo wo boŋe se a beeri tega a pa a tete. Amo tontoŋena bam maama de seene ba yia se ba taa toŋe totoŋa yam.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone, a déem yeini a go nabea mo, de pi-kamuna yaredo dedaane cheeni dedɛ. Da fuga maama wone, a maa yeini a pae se ba yeigi sana dedɛ se nɔɔna bam taa nyɔa. A nam na yei we ko tiini ko chamma ko pae nɔɔna bam to ŋwaane mo amo wo tage we ba pa-ne kolo a na ye ba dedɛɛro ye a maŋe se a jwoŋi to.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a nam lwoori‑m se n guli amo gula se n ke-ne lanyerane, a na ke kolo maama a pa nɔɔna banto to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Sanbalati, de Tobia, de Arabi tu Gɛsem, dedaane dé dona bam maama ma ni kwora we dé lɔge kabira kam dé ti, pa se pwoli daa tere ka wone. Kolo yerane na muri to, dé ya ta wo kwei ka bworru tem dé ke di-nia yam ne.

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Sanbalati de Gɛsem ma toŋe kwora ba pa-ne, se a jeeri-ba Ono te-kampare teo kodwoŋi ne se dé na daane. Ba nam ya boŋe se ba ke-ne lwarem mo.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Amo ma toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo ba ta-ba we, “Amo jege totoŋ-kuri mo a toŋa pa se a bá wane a jeeri da. Amo nam bá da we abam lage se a na-ne ŋwaane se a yage a totoŋa yanto.”

english_verse: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter,
translation_verse: Sanbalati laam ma toŋe o tete tontoŋena bam dedoa de kwora, se o pa-ne tɔnɔ kolo ni na puri to.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Ba ma popone ko wone we: “Gɛsem mo pɛ se a lɔre we sawea mo kare jei sem maama ka ŋɔɔne we nmo de Juu tiina bam maama boŋe se á nwoŋi pa-faro wom kwaga ne mo. Konto nam mo pɛ se á yɔɔre á seene á yia de á kabira kam lɔɔm. Ba ta we nmo kwaane se n tiŋi n tete mo se n ta‑n ye ba pɛ.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Ba we n maŋe n beeri n sampwori selo na wó zege Jerusalem ne ba ta we, ‘Ba tiŋi pɛ Judah ne!’ to. Pa-faro Atazeregese nam na wó ni taane dento to ŋwaane, nmo jege se n ba mo se dé ke dé yuni daane dé nii dé wó ke tɛ mo.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Amo ma leiri-ba a we, “Ko dae chega! Sawea bere ka tere jei jei ne ka kare ka ŋɔɔna. Abam tete mo loge wonnu tem konto a pa debam.”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Ba déem yɔɔre ba kwaane se ba fugi debam mo ye ba boŋe we, “Ba je sem ná bugi, totoŋa yam daa bá toŋe.” Amo de ma ware Wɛ ye a we, “Amo Tu Wɛ, pa-ne dam.”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo a vei Delaya bu Semaya sɔŋɔ se a ware‑o. O déem ta ye Mehetabeli naa mo. Semaya nam ya pe o tete mo o wo o sɔŋɔ ne. O ma ta de amo o we, “Nɔɔna mo boŋe se ba zaŋe n baŋa ne tete dedwe ba go‑m. Nam pa se dé duri dé vo dé zo Wɛ wara-jei sem di-yuu kom wone. Dé laam maa wó pe ka ni dé seigi dáane se ba yé yi‑m ba go.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: A ma leiri‑o a we, “Amo dae balo na duri ba seigi se cham yé yi-ba to. Bɛŋwaane mo amo wó duri a zo Wɛ diga wone se a lu toone? Amo bere a bá ke konto.”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: A na boŋe ko wone to mo a maane we ko ya dae Wɛ mo ŋɔɔne ded‑o, se ko ye Tobia de Sanbalati mo vei ba pa‑o sabu se o ta taane dem konto de amo.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Ba nam soge‑o se o pa foone zo-ne mo, se a daare a ke wɛleere. A ná chɔge a yere konto, ba ya wó ke-ne chaveera.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: “Amo Tu Wɛ, guli Tobia de Sanbalati na ke-ne tei to. Nam yé swei we sampwori-kana Noadia, de sampwori sesem sem maama ya kwaane mo se ba fugi-ne.” Ba na ti ba totoŋa yam tetei to

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Ba déem kwei da finnu-yalei mo ba lɔ kabira kam ba ti. Ko maa ye Eluli chana kam da finlei-yanu dɛ ne mo konto.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Debam dona bam dedaane teene delo na gilimi debam to na nigi konto to, mo ba baare maama ti, ye foone tiini de ja-ba. Kokuri to, ba maama lɔre we Wɛ mo woli debam pa se dé ke tento maama.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Konto maama to, de Judah yiga tiina bam badaara me de Tobia mo. Ba ma yeini ba toŋe kwori ba pa daane.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Judah tiina dedɛ de déem maa sɔ ni ded‑o, kolo ŋwaane Ara bu Sekania ye Tobia tembaaro mo. Ko ta woli da o bu Jehohanan de ya vei o di Berekia bu Mesulam bukɔ mo.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa yeini ba tui ba tɛ de amo Tobia keim na lana tei to. Ba ta ma jaane kolo maama amo na wó ta to ba vo ba lwei ba tiŋi o yiga ne. O de maa yeini o popone twanno o pa-ne se o fugi-ne.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Jerusalem teo kom ni déem daga lanyerane, ye nɔɔna balo na zoore ko wone to ba daga. Ko woli da, ba déem ta wo lɔge sam dedɛ.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, the people came together in the open area in front of the Water Gate. Then they asked Ezra, who was a teacher of the Law of Moses, to read to them from this Law that the Lord had given his people. Ezra the priest came with the Law and stood before the crowd of men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand.
translation_verse: Chane serepɛ boboa dɛ dem ne, mo Ezera jaane Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom o ba o zege nɔn-kɔgɔ kom yiga ne. Baara, de kaana, de balo maama na bege ba yi se ba ni taane kuri to déem mo wora.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Ba ya kwei dɛ mo ba ke bimbini tigisim dem ŋwaane. Ezera ma di o dɔge de baŋa ne ye o ŋɔɔne de nɔɔna bam. Matitia, de Sema, de Anaya, de Yuria, de Hilikia, de Maaseya déem wo o jazem ne mo. Pedaya, de Misayeli, de Malakija, de Hasum, de Hasabadana, de Zekaria, dedaane Mesulam maa zege o jagwia ne.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Ezera déem zege bimbini dem yuu ne mo pa se nɔɔna bam maama kwoni ba nii ba na‑o. O na yɔɔre o puri tɔnɔ kom to, mo ba maama zaŋe ba zege wɛɛne.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ezera ma ta o we, “Á pa-na se dé tei Baŋa Wɛ, se o ye Wɛ kamunu!” Nɔɔna bam maama ma zeiŋi ba je wɛɛne, ye ba daare ba ta we, “Ameena! Ameena!” Ba ta ma tiiri ye ba yibia vwi tega ne se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Ba ma ga Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom ye ba maŋe ko kuri lanyerane, se nɔɔna bam wane ba ni ko kuri chekke.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Ba déem na nigi Wɛ nia taane konto to mo ba yɔɔre ba keeri bɔge-bɔge. Teo kom dedɛɛro Nehemia, de Ezera na ye Wɛ nia zamesem tu de Wɛ kaanem tu to, de Levi tiina balo na jege nɔɔna bam ba zamese to laam ma ta de nɔɔna bam maama ba we, “Zem dɛ dem ye de yera mo de pae abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Konto ŋwaane, yé pa-na se á wo chɔge, nam yé ta‑á keera.”

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Nehemia ma ta-ba o we, “Jwoori-na á sam, se á di wodi-ywonnu, á daare á nyɔ sa-sona. Ta chɛ-na á wo-laaro tem de balo na ba jege to se ba de di ba su. Zem dɛ dem na ye de yera de pae Baŋa Wɛ to ŋwaane, yé pa-na se á wo chɔge. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ wopwolo kom o na pae abam to mo wó ji abam dam.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Levi tiina bam de ma zi nɔɔna bam bochwanno ye ba we, “Zuri-na á bochara. Zem dɛ dem ye de yera de pae Baŋa Wɛ. Yé pa-na se á wo chɔge.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama ma jwoori ba sam, ba vo ba di ba su de wopwolo. Ba ma chɛ ba wonnu de balo na gɛ to. Kokuri to, ba déem nigi Wɛ botara kalo ba na gage ba bere-ba to kuri lanyerane. Vwoa chwiim kuri

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Ko na ke da yalei to, mo sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina, de Wɛ kaanem tiina, dedaane Levi tiina bam jwoori ba gilimi Ezera tei ne se ba yɛ taane delo na nwoŋi Wɛ nia yam wone to.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Ba ma maane we ko maŋe ko popone ko tiŋi Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Moses to wone, we Baŋa Wɛ ya pɛ Isarele tiina bam ni se ba chwi vwoa. Ba wó ma-ya ba di kuri bene maama chane serepɛ chana kam wone se ba taa zoore ya wone maŋa fenfee.

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma seene ba beeri teeni nɛ de se vɔɔro ba ja ba jwoori ba sam. Ba laam ma tei pwei ba sam nayuni ne de ba konkwallo ne. Ba ma daare ba tei-se Wɛ diga kam konkɔlɔ kom ne, de kapworo kolo na maŋe de Na Ni dem to seeni, de kolo na maŋe de Efrayim Ni dem to seeni.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Balo maama déem na nwoŋi kabɛɛne ne ba jwoori to mo tei pwei sem ye ba zo se wone. Ko na zege Nun bu Josua maŋa ne se ko yi maŋa kam konto to, Isarele tiina bam déem daa wo di kuri dem konto. Nɔɔna bam maama wo ma pwoli dedɛ.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Ba déem kwei da yarepɛ mo ba di kuri dem. Dɛ maama wone, Ezera maa yeini o ga Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone o bere-ba. Da nana dɛ dem ne ba kɔgɔ kom maama ma gilimi daane Wɛ ŋwaane, nenɛɛne Wɛ ni dem na bere tei to.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Chana kam konto da finlei-yana dɛ dem ne, mo Isarele tiina bam maama jeeri se ba vɔ ni. Ba déem zo gare-nyenyaaro mo, ye ba daare ba ke teero ba taare ba yuni se ko bere we ba wo chɔge.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam nam ya maŋe ba pwɛ ba tete de veira dwi maama mo. Ba maa zege wɛɛne ye ba tɛ jaja wɛleera yalo ba de ba nabaara na ke to.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba ma zege da konto, ye ba ga Baŋa Wɛ nia yam tɔnɔ kom wone taa, nenɛɛne awa batɔ. Ba ma daare ba ke awa batɔ ba yɔɔre ba tɛ ba wɛleera jaja, ye ba zuli ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Bimbini de de nateini déem zege da Levi tiina ŋwaane. Jesua, de Bani, de Kadimeli, de Sebania, de Bunni, de Serebia, de Bani wodwoŋi wom, dedaane Kenani na ye Levi tiina to ma zege de baŋa ne ba ware ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom de kwor-dɛa.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Levi tiina badwonna ma pa nɔɔna bam maama baare se ba zuli Wɛ. Ko déem ye Jesua, de Kadimeli, de Bani, de Hasabenia, de Serebia, de Hodia, de Sebania, dedaane Petahia mo. Ba ma ta ba we: “Zaŋe-na wɛɛne se dé tei dé Baŋa Wɛ wom! Wonto mo wora taa wuu! Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yere dem tiini de jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ, pa se nɔɔna maama tei-de. Nɔɔna wó zeiŋi-de mo se ko dwoni woŋo maama.

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Wɛ, nmo yerane mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. N ma n ke wɛyuu dwi maama, de wɛ-baŋa chalechwe sem maama. Nmo mo ta ke tega baŋa, de naneero, de wonnu telo maama na wo te wone to. Nmo ma n pa nabiina de wonnu maama jege ŋwea. Wɛyuu maama wó tiiri ba zuli‑m mo.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Nmo Baŋa Wɛ déem mo kuri dé nabaaro Abaram. N ma-n ja‑o n nwoŋi Babilonia tiina teo Uri ne, ye n daare n leiri o yere dem se de taa ye Abaraham.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Nmo na nɛ we o jege chega de nmo to mo n gwoni ni ded‑o we, nmo wó pa‑o Kanaan tiina tega kam, de Hiti tiina tega, de Amori tiina tega, de Pɛrizi tiina tega, de Jebusi tiina tega, de Giragasi tiina te sem maama, se o dwi tiina taa zoore da. N ke n su n ni-gwonim dem konto, n na ye chega tu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: Nmo nam nɛ dé nabaara bam déem na yaare tei Ejipti wone, ye n daare n ni ba na keeri ba jare‑m tei Nane-soŋo kom ni ne to.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: N déem yɔɔre n ke wo-kenkagela mo ye n tɔge ya baŋa n pa se ko chɛ Ejipti Pa-faro wom yera, de o dedɛɛra de o teo kom tiina maama yera, n na yei ba na bɛɛse n nɔɔna bam tei to ŋwaane. Ko ta ma pa se nmo da ko ŋwaane n na yere kamunu, ye de ta wora de zem maama mo.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Nmo déem tiŋi chwoŋa mo naneo kom tetare ne n pa n nɔɔna bam, pa se ba nɔne te-kora baŋa ne ba bɛ. Balo na pare-ba to maŋe naneo kom wone mo, nenɛɛne kandwa mo to ya maŋe na-luŋa wone tei.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nmo déem yeini n tɔge ba yiga mo ye á via. Wea ne n nye de kunkwoŋo na zege deiki to mo, ye tete ne n nye de mini se ba taa nae chwoŋa ba via.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: N ma-n bere-ba se ba pɔɔre n siu dɛ dem ba pa‑m, se de taa ye de yera da yadwonna yam wone mo. Nmo ta dɛ n tontoŋeno Moses baŋa mo, n pa-ba n nia yam.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Kana déem na jege-ba to, n pɛ se wodiiru nwoŋi telaao ne pa ba di. N ta ma n pa se na nwoŋi peo wone, se ba nyɔ ba zuri ba na-nyɔm. Nmo ma n daare n pa-ba ni, se ba zo tega kalo n na gwoni ni se n pa-ba to wone, se ba taa tei-ka.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: Dé nabaara bam zwa déem nam kwareme mo, ye ba ta bere ba tete kamunim. Ba ma yɔɔre ba ve se ba sɛ nmo nia yam.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ba déem tiini ba twe‑m. Ba mɔɔne jwoni mo na nye de na-mɔra to, ye ba we dento mo vere-ba de ja nwoŋi Ejipti wone.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: Ba déem nam na wo kagoa kam wone to, n wo yage ba yera, n ŋwaŋa kam na daga to ŋwaane. Wea ne mo n kunkwoŋo kom zege deiki ba yiga ne se ko bere-ba chwoŋa. Tete maama ne n mini dem maa yeini de pa-ba pwooni.

english_verse: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.
translation_verse: Nmo ta pɛ-ba n Jwori-laao mo pa se ba yia poore. N ma n pa-ba Manna yam se ba di, ye n ta pa-ba na se ba zuri ba na-nyɔm.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Bena finna yam ba na ke kagoa kam wone to, n zeini-ba pa se ba wo gɛ kolokolo. Ba gwaaro tem wo zareme, ye ba nɛ de wo foose chwoŋa kam cham ŋwaane.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Nmo ta mo pɛ dé nabaara bam dwi dem puli dedɛ, nenɛɛne wɛyuu chalechwe sem na daga tei to. Nmo pɛ se ba bia bam di tega kalo n na gwoni ni de ba kwoa bam we ba jege se ba jwoŋi-ka ye ba laam zoore da to mo.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: De ko de, n nɔɔna bam se ba zwa mo ye ba lɔ n kwaga ne. Ba ma virigi ba kwaga ba ya n nia yam. Ba déem go n sampwori selo na kaane-ba se ba jwoori ba ba nmo tei ne to mo. Ba maa tiini ba twe‑m kuni dedɛ.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane n ma n pa ba dona chwoŋa se ba di-ba ye ba daare ba bɛɛse-ba. Nmo nɔɔna bam nam na keeri ba jare‑m ba cham dem ŋwaane to, n zege wɛyuu ne mo n cheigi ba keira kam. Nmo yibwon-dura kam ŋwaane mo n toŋe jwoŋina se ba jwoŋi-ba ba dona jeŋa ne ba yage.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Ba wo maa na yeini ko to to, mo ba daa jwoori ba ke wɛleera, ye n daa‑n pa se ba dona bam di-ba. Ba de na chuli ba wɛleera yam, ye ba lwoori‑m ba cham dem ŋwaane to, nmo ta zege wɛyuu ne mo n cheigi-ba. N déem jwoŋi-ba n yage kuni dedɛ wone, n yibwon-dura kam na gaale to ŋwaane.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: Debam maama mo tɔge de dé yiga tiina se dé gwoni ni dento dem: Dé nam dugi we, dé wó sɛ Wɛ nia yalo o na dɛ o tontoŋeno Moses baŋa o pa debam to. Dé sɛ se dé tɔge debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ chwei sem de chullu telo maama o na bere debam to. Lɛɛro taa wo dé baŋa ne nenɛɛne dé ná wo ke konto.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ siu dɛ dem, naa dé kura da yam ne, veira ná jaane ba zela ba ba se ba yeigi ba pa debam, dé bá ke pipiu de-ba. Bena yarepɛ maama wone, bene dedoa mo dé wó yɔɔre dé yage dé kare se se peini se sii. Dé ta maa wó kwei dé chɛ balo na jege dé jena to.

english_verse: Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Dé nam wó fe dé tete se dé la sabu se dé kwei dé kwɛ Wɛ diga kam. Nɔɔno maama wó ŋwe sabu se ko maŋe dedaane sɛkɛle chichworo mo.

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa se zela yalo maama na maŋe de Wɛ diga kam totoŋa to taa wora maŋa maama: ko maa ye bworobworo kolo ba na tigisi Wɛ ŋwaane to mo, dedaane dɛ maama wone wodiu pɛɛra yam, de vara zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam, de Wɛ siu dɛ pɛɛra yam, de chan-doŋa pɛɛra yam, de kura yadwonna pɛɛra yam, de Isarele tiina wɛleera saarem pɛɛra yam, de pɛɛra yalo maama ba na wó ma ba zuli Wɛ to.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Bene maama wone debam Isarele tiina bam, de dé kaanem tiina bam, de Levi tiina bam wó ta jɔrɔ se dé lɔre maŋa kalo sɔ-yuu de sɔ-yuu kolo na wó taa jaane dɛ ba tui Wɛ diga kam wone to. english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
