translation_verse: O taŋa chena foore ya tui amo baŋa. O ma ta-ne o zɔ a tapwale-bia bam seeni, ye yibwona tera. A wo loro tete tage te nwoŋi te to tega ne mo.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a wo keira ne mo, ye a daare a zo gare-nyenyaaro a jei. A kwei a dam maama a suli tega kuri ne.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: A yɔɔre a keeri mo taa pa a yia ba ya seene. A yibia maama foose mo a keira kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: Ko wo maŋe se a jana bam ba ba suli tega ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo lɔre ko ni ne. A keira kam ba jege se ka seigi.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Wolo na zege amo kwaga ne to nam maŋe o wo Wɛ telaao ne. Wonto mo wó ŋɔɔne o pa-ne.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Amo badwonna bam gwooni-ne mo. Amo nam keeri dedɛ a kane yi-na a lwoori Wɛ,

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Kokuri bena fenfee yerane mo daare, se amo laam kwei chwoŋa a vo mɛ nɔɔna na vei ye ba daa ba jwoori to.”

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: “A daa ba jege ŋwea teena. Amo da yam bwola se ya ti. Ba laam maa wó ke-ne yibeeli wone.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ mo jege-ne ba mɔna, pa se a yɔɔre a na ba na chuchugi-ne tei to.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: Wɛ, nmo yerane mo a nia se n zege daare n pa-ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera se kotu zege a kwaga ne.

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: N pɛ se a badwonna bam boboŋa se mo pa ba ba lɔre lɔra. Konto ŋwaane yé pa se ba wane amo ba di.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Wolo ná nwoŋi o badwonna bam kwaga ne se o ma o na nyɔɔre, kotu bia yia wó dwei mo.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛ se amo ji wo-mɔnɔ nɔɔna tei ne mo. Ba maa twe lileeru ba yage a yera ne.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: A yia yam yɔɔre ya dwei, a wo na tiini ko chɔge to ŋwaane. A yera maama ma yɔɔre ya ti.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona ye yaau mo de kolo na yi amo to. Ba bane maa wɔe balo na ve Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: A maa wó ware gwoŋo kom we, ‘A kwo,’ ye a daare a ta de tóa we, ‘A nu, de a nakɔ, de á lei.’

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Teena yam konto wó da ya vo churu se dé tɔge daane dé vo dé taa tigi da na?”

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Suuhi tu Bilidad ma leiri o we:

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Nmo lage n ŋɔɔne tento n vo n maŋe yein-seeni mo? Ja swa se dé laam taa ŋɔɔne daane.

english_verse: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe we debam ye vara mo n yiga ne na? N pae dé ye nɔn-jworru mo na?

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Ba daane ba nɔne ba na-baara yam bwom yerane mo. Ba kwea yam mo de-ba tega ne.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro dwi dwi mo fugi-ba jei maama ne, pa se foone tiini de jege-ba.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Jawe-chɛɔ wó di ba yera yam daa kadwoŋi, pa se ba ya-nɔna yam moore, ye toone de ja-ba.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔre ba fe-ba mo pa ba nwoŋi ba vwoa ne, mɛ ba ya na jei de yazura to, se ba vo ba te dam toone.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Nɔn-gɛ maa zoore ba vwoa yam wone, ye chilibugu mo ba kwei ba lwo da.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam nye de teeni delo kuru de de nɛ sem na kwaare to mo.

english_verse: without any children to carry on their name.
translation_verse: Ba maa wo daare dwi ba teo kom ne, se ko jwa bwoŋi ba yere.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, wɛleere-keira na wó guri tei to mo konto. Ba sam dem wó chɔge mo, ba na yeiri Wɛ to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Chaveera ta ba jege abam de á na bwɛ-ne kuni fuga tento to na?

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Abam boŋe se á bere á tete mo amo baŋa ne. Á ta maa pae ko ye amo tusim ŋwaane mo a nɛ a chaveera.

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we ko ye Wɛ yiga mo pa yaara yanto maama ba a baŋa. Wonto mo chege kalanchogo se o ma o ja-ne.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Amo ná laare mo we, ‘Vuvuga tu a baŋa!’ nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba leiri-ne. A nam ná beeri wolim, ba ba pae a jege chega.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: O ban-lom dem wo amo baŋa ne mo, ye o jeeli amo o ke balo na ye o dona to wone.

english_verse: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
translation_verse: Amo sɔŋɔ veira de a tontoŋ-kana bam maama laam nii-ne se a taa ye sa-teeno mo a pa-ba.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Bu-balwa tete lɔŋe-ne mo. A maa ná zaŋe wɛɛne, ba jege-ne ba ke ba mɔna.

english_verse: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu maama de daa vae a ni taane, ye ba duri ba daare-ne.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Amo badwonna bam, ja! Kwaane-na se á duri a ŋwaŋa, se Wɛ yɔɔre o mage-ne o de tega ne mo.

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we wolo na bore o pa-ne to ŋwe. Wonto maa wó zaŋe o ŋɔɔne o pa-ne se ko kweeli.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Jaweo nam ná di a ya-nɔna yam mo ko ti de, amo ta wó na Wɛ ko tɔge a yera yanto wone.

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Abam tɛ á tete ne we: ‘Pa-na dé yɔɔre dé pare‑o dé ja. O tete mo jaane cham dento o ba o pa o tete.’

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Naamatia tu Zofara ma ta o we:

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: De ko de, ba lage ba ba ba ji teero mo ba jei wuu, se balo ya na yei-ba to taa bwei we, ‘Ba wo yein-seeni mo?’

english_verse: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
translation_verse: Ba fara de ba sɔŋɔ tiina daa bá na-ba, ba daa na tera to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam bia mo jege se ba jwoori ba yiri jena yalo ba kwoa na vere yiniga tiina tei ne to.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane, ba ta ná wo ba nɔn-donne maŋa ne, ba wó ba ba te mo de ba dam maama.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: Lwarem kikia sona ya pae puseŋ-nyeno mo, pa o yɔɔre o jege-ya o tɔna.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye jejegero telo kotu na ligi puseŋa baŋa ne to, Wɛ nam wó pa o tɔne-te o yage.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: O wó mu kapaa vea mo. Basankwea maa wó done‑o ka go.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: O ná di o ti, kolokolo daa ba daara. Mo kokuri, o wonnu bá dáane ye te jei.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Kotu ná kwaane se o duri o daare luuru jara zela, channa chichwei mo wó zɔ‑o.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: De na moore de maŋe o yera ne to mo o vaŋe-de o le o wo loro ne, ye de ni dem nyeena. Foone ma tiini de zo‑o.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Lim wó yɔɔre de kwoli o lonne wonnu tem maama. Mini delo nabiina na wo ke to nam mo wó di‑o, ye de daare de zwɛ o jejegero telo maama na daare to kula.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Na-fwaaro mo lage te chuuri te chwooli o sɔŋɔ kom te ja te jei Wɛ ban-lom dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyeno wom na wó ba o guri tei to mo konto. Wɛ mo maŋe o sɛ we konto taa tiga kotu ŋwaane.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: “Fɔge á cheigi-na taane delo a na jege se a ta to, se ko pa amo bochare zuri.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Zuri-na á yera se á cheigi a taane dem. Ko kwaga seeni, á laam wae á daa ta‑á jege-ne á mɔna.

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Yɔɔre á nii-na amo, se á daare á ja á nia, ye á ta ta‑á teili á popwaano.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Amo ná boŋe kolo na yi-ne to boboŋa, a nagwola wó te mo. A yera maa sae pɔm-pɔm de foone.

english_verse: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
translation_verse: Ba jei mo ye ba nae ba bia nɔn-keiri, pa ba dwi dem puli de pa-ba.

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Kolokolo ba daane-ba ba sam wone. Wɛ bane de nam ba zaŋe de-ba se o waare-ba.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Ba naane tete de puli dedɛ mo de pa-ba, ye de dedoa de bá chaare ko puga ko yage.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Ba maa jege senyɛ de kwanno ba leeni lei. Ba ta wui wi mo ba ke sɔɔ ba ma di ywoni.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam ŋwea maama wone, ba yɔɔre ba jege wo-laaro mo ba di, ye ba laam ba ba te ba tete toone.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: De ko de, ba ta tɛ de Wɛ mo we, ‘Yage dé yera! Dé yiga tera de n bera yam.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae ba tete totoŋa baŋa ne mo ba wonnu vei yiga te pa-ba. Amo nam bá sɛ se a tɔge puseŋ-nyena bam konto bera yam.

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Ko yeini ko ke-ba ne ga-korro naa swanno telo vio na kale ko jege ko maa jia tei to mo na?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Abam tɛ we, ‘Wɛ wó pa wɛle-keiru bia ŋwe ba kwo wɛleera jene.’ Ko ya maŋe se Wɛ yɔɔre o waare wɛle-keiru tete mo se o lɔre ko ni ne.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe se kotu tete yia mo na o waarem, se o nyɔ Dam-fɔrɔ Tu wom ban-zɔŋɔ na-zoŋa kam wone.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Kokuri o ŋwea da yam ná tu ya kweeli ye o te, o yiga daa tere o kwaga kam wone.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Wɔ mo yi se o wane o bere Wɛ yeino? Kokuri Wɛ mo bore nɔɔna maama, de wɛyuu dedɛɛra bam de.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Abam nam kare á tɛ we, ‘Nɔn-yum sɔŋɔ kom laam wo yein-seeni mo? Puseŋ-nyena bam ya na zoore mɛ to daa bɛ?’

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Nabiinu jege bɛ nyɔɔre mo o pae Wɛ, o ná maŋe o ye swa tu tei maama de?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae konto! Chega to, n lwarem kikia tiini ya daga, ye n wɛleera de gaale.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Nmo fe n chorro se ba tiŋi daare n jene ŋwaane, ye n vere ba gwaaro kafɛ ŋwaane n daare-ba pa ba zege bwori.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: De ko de, n ve se n woli kadeina, ye n pa ba viiri de je-yaara. N ma‑n bɛɛse botara n woli da.

english_verse: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Konto nam mo tei pae n cham ba fɔge de tia, ye foone pɔpɔ de ja‑m.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se lim kwoli‑m pa n ba nae chwoŋa. Na-fɔrɔ de maa yeini ko ba ko lini n jei sem.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: Wɛ seene o wo wɛyuu ne mo baŋa baŋa. Ta fɔge n nii chalechwe sem na wo wɛɛne tei maama to.

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Kunkwon-lilirru kwoli‑o mo pa o ba nae debam. O ta maa kare wɛyuu siseina yam ne o via.’

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Ko déem nam ye Wɛ mo pɛ-ba wo-laaro, ye te su ba sam dem maama. Amo nam bá sɛ se a tɔge puseŋ-nyena bam konto bera.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Dé dona bam jei, ye mini zwɛ ba jejegero telo na daare to maama.’

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Nmo ná pipiri n jwoori Dam-fɔrɔ Tu wom tei ne mo, nmo wó na n tete. N nam jege se n le puseŋa kikia maama n sɔŋɔ ne,

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná to tega ne, ye n ná tage we, ‘Pa ba zaŋe wɛɛne’, Wɛ wó seene o zeiŋi balo na tu ba tete to wɛɛne.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Ko ná maŋe ko ye wolo na ba jege bora to, Wɛ wó jwoŋi‑o o yage, nmo je sem na toŋe chekke to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Amo ya ná yei mɛ a na wó vo se a na‑o, a ya wó vo o na zoore mɛ seeni to,

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: O ta ná vei jagwia seeni naa jazem seeni se o taa toŋa, amo ba na‑o dáane de.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Wonto nam yei amo na-veili maama. O wora o faŋe-ne mo o nia, ye o ná ke konto o ti, amo wó taa ye chekke mo ne sabu-seŋa dwoŋi to.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Amo de nam tɔge o nɛ-bwora kam chekke mo. A maa wo ywori o chwoŋa kam wone.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ye o yera mo, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware o yiga se o che. O ke kolo maama o boboŋa na lage to mo.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Amo nam na jei yibiri wone ye lim kwoli a yibia maama to, a ta bá maŋe da chemm.”

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Bɛŋwaane mo Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom wo kwei maŋa o tiŋi se o ma o di nɔn-balwaaro taane? Bɛ mo ke ye balo na sɛ‑o to beeri o borem da yam ba ga?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna swoi se ba taa di ba zoore ba dwonna siseina wo, ye ba daare ba vere ba dwonna vara ba jege ba kɔna.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Ba ta vere botara bonɛ mo ba kale ba ja viiri, ye ba daare ba jwoŋi kadeina nabɛ jena ŋwaane.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina wó taa kare kagoa yuu ne ba beeri wodiu, se ba de ba bia taa di, nenɛɛne kagoa wo bonɛ de na ke tei to.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Ba laam maa wó taa vei pwoli wone se ba zage se wodiiru tem. Ba ta maa vei puseŋ-nyena kare ne ba lare mena.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Ba wó taa kare peero tem gugworru ne mo ba seiga, ye do-fɔrɔ mage-ba, ba na ba jege dalem jei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná jene sabu ba pa yiniga tiina, ba laam wó vere ba bia mo jene dem ŋwaane, ko ná maŋe ko ye kadeim bu de.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina kare ba vei bwori mo, kolokolo tere ba yera ne. Ba maa toŋe kare wone de kan-wea.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba kane Olivi tio-bia se nuga nwoŋi, ye ba daare ba ŋoke Vini tio-bia se sa-doora taa nwoŋa. De ko de, na-nyɔm ta jege-ba mo.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ mo tigi teo kom pwoli ne, ye ba vuvuna de cham, ba na nɛ zonne ye ba lage ba te to ŋwaane. De ko maama de, Wɛ ba bwɛ wɛle-keira bam.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Wɛ dem ná yeini de zwori de ti, nɔn-gora jege yiniga tiina de nabwona mo ba goe. Badaara maa kare ba ŋɔne nɔɔna wonnu tete ne.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Baara badwonna maa jei ba cheiga se tega yi, se ba beeri nɔɔno wodwoŋi kaane ba peini ded‑o. Kokuri ba boŋe we tete ne mo nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá na-ba, ba na seigi ba yibia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Tete ne mo venverena zoore nɔɔna sam wone ba vere-ba. Se ko ná ye wea ne, ba pe ba ni mo diga ne, ba na vae pwooni dem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Banto maama swoi yibiri maŋa mo ba dwoi pwooni dem, Ba nam me de lɛɛro telo na yeini te tɔge de yibiri te tui to mo.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: Abam nam tɛ we: Puseŋ-nyena bam nam ba dáana, de na-fɔrɔ na kale-ba ba ja ba jei. Ko ná ye tega kalo ba na jege ba vare to, Wɛ sɔɔle lwarem mo o yage ka baŋa ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba vei o toŋe ba kare sem ne.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Ne tega kam wulim na pae se nyɔnɔ we tei to, konto mo toone de yeini de li wɛleere-keira dwi maama.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balwaaro tem konto ke ba chɔge kadeina yiga. Ba ba fɔge ba duri ba ŋwaŋa kɔtaa!

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo mae o dam o jaane dedɛɛra. O ná zaŋe ba baŋa ne, ba ŋwea daa dae kolokolo.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Wɛ wae o yage-ba pa ba jei de wo-zuru. O yi nam page ba baŋa ne mo ye o yere ba kikia maama.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Suuhi tu Bilidad ma leiri o we:

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Paare dim de fon-kɔrɔ ye Wɛ mo tei-te. Wonto mo pae wonnu tɔge chwoŋa wɛyuu baŋa jei sem ne.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware Wɛ jar-keira bam ni se o ga o ti. Jei wora Wɛ pwooni dem na wo yi da na?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam nii chana kam pwooni we de ba jege dam. O maa pae se chalechwe sem pwooni de ye kafɛ.

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Nii kwea yalo dwi n na kwei n pa wolo swa na muri to! N seene n bere we n yi poore lanyerane!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Chira tigi churu ne mo ye ba yera sae. Ba maa wo na-fwaaro tem kuri ne ye foone jege-ba.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Churu tete tigi bwori mo Wɛ yiga ne. Chɔgem jei sem konto maa wo seigi o yia ne.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: O ta maa yeini o pa kunkwoŋo li chana kam na peere to.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Naneo kom baŋa ne mo o lɔ siseini o kaare-ko, se ko pɔɔre pwooni de lim daane.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: O na sii o momwa vio to, tega yibia peere mo. O jeŋa ta ma zɔ naneo wo basankwe-kenkagele dem na duri se ka lu to ka go.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Wɛ kikia yam konto nam bere o dam chicheiro yerane mo. Ko bere we o waase tega-tega se dé wane dé ni ko kuri. Se o laam ná bage de kwor-dɛa, o dam dem wó kɛ jeŋa mo.”

english_verse: and while he gives me breath,
translation_verse: Amo ta na lwoori a ŋwe, ye a sii Wɛ vio to,

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Amo bá fɔge a sɛ we abam mo tɛ chega amo baŋa ne. Ko ná ye se a te mo de, amo ta wó taa zege de a chega mo.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Ba lɛɛro maŋa kam konto ne, Wɛ daa wó cheigi ba keira na?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Banto yeini ba di ywoni Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom ŋwaane na? Ba keeri ba jare‑o maŋa de maŋa mo na?

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Nii-na! Abam tete nam maŋe á na wonnu tento. Bɛ mo kea ye á daa jege ta-yɔɔro á ŋɔɔna?

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Ba bia kɔgɔ ná maŋe ko daga tei maama de, ba maama wó te jara wone mo. Ba kwaga kam de nam bá taa nae wodiiru ba di ba sui.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Ba bia balo ta ná daare, jaweero mo wó go-ba, ye ba kadeina bá keeri ba lwi.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena wae ba lae lu-nyenno wonnu, pa te daga ne tega kasolo tei to. Ba ta wae ba kwaleme gwaaro dedɛ ba tiŋa.

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona nam mo wó kwei ba gwaaro tem ba zo, ye ba daare ba pɔɔre ba lu-nyenno wonnu tem ba pa daane.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Vio kom laam maa wó yeeri‑o, ye ko daare ko chweese‑o o yaara yam ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: Maaro de kawuli yia ware ya na ya yi jei selo nɔɔna bam konto na vei ba toŋe da to.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Nywonnu de kago-vara tete ba nɔne te nɛ chwei sem konto baŋa ne.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: Nabiina mae ba jea ba yare kandwa-kamuna, ye ba daare ba guri peero te kugu jei ne ba dole ba yaga.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Ba ta buŋa ba lɔra bwi kuri na puli mɛ seeni to. Ba maa jaane wonnu telo ya na seigi to ba pa te nwoŋi pwooni.

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Nabiina bá wane ba ga sabu-seŋa ba ma ba yeigi-ko, naa ba kwei lu-nyenno ba ma ba leini-ko.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Sabu-seŋa de gelaase-laaro de wo yi-ko. N ta bá-n wane n kwei sabu-seŋa zoŋa n ma n leini-ko.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Ko maa ná ye Korale kandwa-ŋona, naa kandwa-nyenno dwi maama, te dunni bá maŋe de yi-poro na ye tei to.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Churu de toone de yeini ba tɛ we, “Yi-poro soswea yerane mo to dé zwa ne.”

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: Wɛ yerane nam mo yei chwoŋa kalo na yi-ko to. Wonto mo yei ko kuri na nwoŋi mɛ to.

english_verse: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
translation_verse: “Faŋa kam ye Wɛ déem nii amo baŋa ne to, da yam konto ya ná wae ya jwoora, ko wó taa lana.

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: A nɔn-donne maŋa kam ne mo konto, ye Wɛ lɔ o wo o bere-ne pa se a sɔŋɔ kom na yazura.

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: Amo naane déem puli pa nayela ba jege totoŋe a sɔŋɔ ne. Olivi nuga de maa nwoŋi amo kare sem ne ka duri ka siseiri ka tu peero tem kuri seeni.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nabwona ná lwoori wolim, a yeini a jwoŋi-ba a yaga. A maa woli botara balo na ba jege fara to de.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Balo na jei ba cheigi ba toone to de zuli-ne, ye kadeina de di ywoni amo wolim ŋwaane.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Amo déem mo jigi yia a pa lilwoa, ye a ta ye gwaaro de nɛ a pa-ba.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Amo maa ye nabwona kwo, ye a daare a jwoŋi veira taane a ŋɔɔne a pa-ba.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: Amo déem boŋe a tete ne we: ‘Amo ŋwea da yam wó taa daga ne kasolo bia na ye tei to, ye a daare a te a tete toone a sɔŋɔ kom ne.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: A ŋwea kam jege dam, ne tio kolo bonno na kwaare tega ne pa na yi-ko lanyerane, ye nyɔnɔ de toe tete ne ko peini ko nɛ sem baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Ba totoŋa maa ba jege nyɔɔre ya pa-ne, ba dam na ti de daare-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Ba mage gullu mo ba le-ba ba teene dem wone, ye ba yeeri-ba ba zeili, ne ba ye ŋweena mo tei.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Ba maa ye vare-yɔɔro na ba jege kugu jei tega kam ne, nɔɔna na zeili-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: Banto bia laam nam puli lei mo ba leeni ba mae ba mɔne amo, ye amo laam jigi ba ni sinseira mo.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Ba maa jege-ne ba neesa ye ba daare ba lɔŋe-ne. Ba nam ta yɔɔre ba twe lileeru mo ba yage amo yibia ne.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Chanɛɛre dwi dwi mo tiini de jege-ne de chɔga. Amo zula ti ya daare-ne, ne vio na kale-ya ko ja viiri tei to. A yazura de kɛ ya daare-ne mo.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: A ŋwea kam laam lage ka jei mo ka daare-ne. Amo yaara yam maa ba fɔge ya tia.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: O ta yɔɔre o dole-ne mo o de bworu wone, pa a maama laam ye teero de tentwarem yerane.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a keeri a jare nmo mo ye n ba leiri-ne. A ta maa zege n yiga ne se a ware‑m. N nam yɔɔre n saare tega mo, ye n yiga tera amo wone.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we ko bá dáane de n na wó pa se toone ja-ne, se a daare a zo churu ne mɛ na ye nabiina maama gurim jei to.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Amo wo yɔɔre ko jujugi mo taa. Dɛ maama wone cham yeini de che a chwoŋa de cheigi-ne.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a kare a vei de wo-chechɔgɔ mo, ye lim kwoli a chwoŋa kam. A ta maa zege nɔn-kɔgɔ tetare ne a keeri a lwoori wolim.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Amo ya-tana kam de laam zwori mo ye ka lɔɔre ka tete ne. Paa tiini ka birigi a yera yam maama.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Amo boboŋa nam yɔɔre ya ja mo we, amo bá pa a yia chwoŋa se ya nii bukɔ se a fera zo o wone.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam nae a na-veili na ye tei to, ye o daare o jeeli a naba-laara maama.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Kokuri, a keim dem konto ya wó taa ye keim-lɔŋɔ mo, ye ko maŋe se nakwa bam vane nɔɔno bora ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: A tontoŋena maa ná poone amo pompona, a wo ke siri se a cheigi-ba mo na?

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ko dae Wɛ mo mɔɔne amo o ke a nu puga ne, ye o daare o mɔ banto de na?

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Amo fɔge a jege a wodiu a di a yerane, ye a wo chɛ-ko de botara na?

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Ko zege a nɔn-donne maŋa ne mo a yɔɔre a jege botara a kɔna. A ŋwea maama wone a nii kadeina de baŋa ne.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: A liligi a noa botaro yiga ne se a fugi‑o, teo kom dedɛɛra na zege amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Kokuri amo ya fona we Wɛ wó pa lɛɛro yi-ne mo. A maa ware wo-lwanno tem konto se a ke, a na kɔre Wɛ de o paare dem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
translation_verse: Amo nam wo pɛ a ni chwoŋa se de tusi de sɔɔle lwarem de yage kotu baŋa ne.

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: Amo wo pe a tete a yage diga ne a jei da chemm, a na kɔre foone de nɔɔna na wó ta wonnu telo ba ma ba gwooni-ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: Amo de nam ya wó maŋe a na-veili maama a bere‑o. A maa wó vo a zege o yiga ne de baare ne pa-bu tei.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: A tega kam keeri ye ka ka yi-na, amo na ke a chɔge-ka to ŋwaane na?

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: Amo ná seene a ke wonnu tento dwoŋi, se sabare de ga-cheiŋo di a kare sem, se se wodiiru daa yé ke te pa-ne.” Job na tage kolo maama o kweeli to mo konto.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Ko na tu tei to, Job badwonna batɔ bam daa maa ba kwaane se ba ta taane ded‑o, kokuri o sɛ o tete ne we o jege chega.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: O bane ta zaŋe Job badwonna batɔ bam baŋa ne mo, de ba na wo wane se ba leiri Job taane dem de chega, ye ba ta ve se ba pa‑o bora to de.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu ya pɛ Job badwonna bam ŋɔɔne ba ti mo ye wonto de laam ŋɔɔne ded‑o, ba maama na koe‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo de nam we: Cheigi-na a taane dem, se amo de ta a na yei tei to.

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Job na tole o taane to, ko dae amo mo o lwɛ. Amo de nam bá kwei abam taana yam dwoŋi se a ma a leiri‑o.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: Nii mo! Ba jaane ba nia! Ba daa ba jege kolokolo se ba ta.

english_verse: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
translation_verse: Ba na zege da chemm konto to, amo de wó taa ye chemm mo na?

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ Jworo kom mo naane amo. O maa sii o siu o yage a yera ne pa se a jege ŋwea.

english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Wɛ yiga ne mo amo de nmo nam ye bedwe. Amo de nam ye dɔgɔ mo ba mɛ ba ke-ne.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑n kɔre foone de amo. A nam bá tiini a daane‑m.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: O kwei chegero mo o vɔ a nɛ diŋ-diŋ, ye o daare o yere a na-veili maama.’

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei we Wɛ yeini o tɔge chwei dwi dwi mo o ŋɔɔne de nɔɔna. Ba nam yeini ba ware se ba lɔre o kwora kam.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Wonto wae o cho se toone yé ja-ba, se ba yé tɔge churu chwoŋa ba jei.

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: pa se wodiu ji wo-zɔɔne ba yiga ne, ko ná maŋe ko ywomma tei maama de.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Konto maa pae ba yeini ba yɔɔre maama ba ti, pa ba kwi sem tete tigi se nia.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Ba laam maa ye bɔɔne ni veira, ye toone de jei de cheigi se de kwei-ba de ja de kɛ.

english_verse: Our health is restored, we feel young again,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom yera laam wó jwoori ya zuri, se o taa dana ne nɔn-doŋo tei.

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: O daa ta wó ware Wɛ, ye o kikia yam de su Wɛ yi. O laam maa wó zege Wɛ yiga ne o zuli‑o de ywoni. Wɛ de maa wó pa kotu jwoori o taa tɔge chwoŋa chekke.

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: Chega to, Wɛ yeini o ke konto dwoŋi o pa nabiina kuni dedɛ mo,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: se o wane o che se toone yé ja-ba. O ke konto se ba taa vei ŋwea pwooni dem wone mo.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Abam jege swa mo na? Nam cheigi-na a taane dem. Á zamese á yi na? Pore-na á zwa se á cheigi.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Nam pa-na dé yɛ dé lɔre kolo de kolo na maŋe to, se dé ke daane dé zamese chwo-laao tɔgem.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Kokuri Job taga o we: ‘Amo jege bora mo, Wɛ nam ta vane-ne chega.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: De amo na wo a chega wone to de, nɔɔna ta pae a ye vwa-nyem mo. Amo wo ke a sa chwoŋa, de ko de, ko nigi-ne se ko kɛ jeŋa.’

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: O swoi se o taa ye de wo-lwan-keira de puseŋ-nyena mo.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Kokuri o ya tage we, ‘Nɔɔno ná kwaane se o ke o su Wɛ yi, o bá na nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: Abam na boŋe we á ye boboŋa tiina to, nam cheigi-na a taane dem. Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom bere o bá toŋe lwarem kɔtaa! O bá wane o ke o sa chwoŋa de.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo fɔge o kwei tega baŋa kam o ke Wɛ jeŋa ne? Wɔ mo pɛ‑o ni se o taa nii logo kom maama baŋa ne?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ya ná jaane boboŋa se o le o jworo de o siu nabiina yera ne,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: nɔɔna maama wó tɔge daane ba te mo, pa ba jwoori ba ji tega teero.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba pɔpɔ ba te mo tete-koro ne. Wɛ ná fere-ba, ba wó te mo. Wɛ wó le ba momwa mɔle-mɔle mo, de ba ná maŋe ba ye dedɛɛra tei maama de.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Lim naa yibiri jei tera, wo-lwan-keira na wó vo ba seigi da se o yé na-ba to.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ba jege se o saŋe nabiina se ba ba o yiga ne, se o laam di ba taane.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: O yeini o chochoge dedɛɛra ye o ba bwei-ba. O laam ma daare o tiŋi babam o leiri ba yuu ne.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, o maane ba kikia yam na ye tei to, pa se o ja-ba tete ne o dole o yage, ye o daare o meere-ba.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Ba puseŋa totoŋa ŋwaane mo o yeini o waare-ba, ye nɔɔna maama zege ba nia.

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Ba na jege yiniga tiina bam ba fe tei to pɛ se ba keeri ba jare Wɛ, ye o de cheigi ba keira kam.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wae o tɛ de Wɛ nenɛɛne: ‘Amo ke a chɔge mo pa se a na waarem. A nam daa bá ke a sa chwoŋa.

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: Nam bere-ne a na tusi tei ye a wo lɔre ko ni ne to. A ná seene a toŋe lwarem, a daa bá ke a woli da.’

english_verse: Job, anyone with good sense can easily see
translation_verse: Boboŋa tiina de yi-pore-nyena ná nigi a taane, ba wó ta de amo we,

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Job kare o ŋɔɔne a-yeiri-ka taane mo. O maa yeini o ŋɔɔne ta-yɔɔro yerane.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Amo tete boboŋa ne, ko maŋe se Job na waarem se ko kɛ jeŋa, o na kare o ŋɔɔne puseŋ-nyena taana yam dwoŋi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: Amo nam wó leiri nmo de n badwonna batɔ bam.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Nmo nɔn-ŋonne jege zeinim ko pae Wɛ mo na? O lage o jwoŋi bɛ mo n jeŋa ne se o taa tei?

english_verse: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.
translation_verse: N puseŋa kikia yam chɔge n dwonna nabiina mo, ye n nɔn-ŋonne dem de woli banto yerane.

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: Chanɛɛre maŋa ne, nɔɔna yeini ba chwoosa mo. Ba maa keeri ba beeri wolim, dedɛɛra na bɛɛse-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ba tɛ o we: ‘Amo Keiru Wɛ nam bɛ? Wonto mo pae a ni wae de pura de leeni lei tete ne.

english_verse: though he makes us wiser than animals or birds.
translation_verse: O maa pae dé lɔre lɔra ye dé jege yi-poro dé dwoi vara de zuna dwi maama.’

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Zuri n yera se a daa taa ŋɔɔne a woli da fee, se n wane n lɔre kolo a ta na wó bere‑m Wɛ ŋwaane to.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: O ba pae puseŋ-nyena chwoŋa se ba taa ŋwe. Nabwona balo ba na jege ba bɛɛse to nam wó na chega o tei ne.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: O yi page nɔn-ŋona baŋa ne mo, se o pa ba tɔge de pwa ba di paare, ye ba daare ba na zula se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Ba nɛ sem nam ná vɔge de chegero mo diŋ-diŋ de, pa ba jege yaara ba di,

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Ba nam ná ve Wɛ koresem dem, ba laam wó tɔge churu chwoŋa ba jei mo. Ba maa wó ga ba ŋwea ye ba ta wo lɔre lɔra.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: Wɛ-lwɛɛna nam ba fɔge ba zuri ba bana. Wɛ ná maŋe o waare-ba tei maama de, ba ba lwoori wolim o tei ne.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam kwoori nmo mo se o le‑m n cham dem wone, se n vo n yi jei-kayɔlɔ mɛ kolokolo na bá daane‑m to. O nam ta kwei wodi-laaro o zege n yiga ne, se n ta‑n di n boboŋa.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena waarem boboŋa laam mo su n yuu. Chega borem nam wó seene de ke de pa‑m.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: Nii mo! Wɛ dam dem ba tia. Bereno wodwoŋi tera o na wó maŋe de Wɛ.

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Ke kokeiri se n tei‑o o totoŋa yam ŋwaane, ne nɔɔna na yeini ba leeni ba seini‑o tei to.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Nabiina maama nɛ kolo o na ke to. Ba nam zege yiga yiga mo ye ba tole ba nii ba na.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Chega to, Wɛ tiini o ye kamunu, pa dé ware se dé lɔre‑o dé ti. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o jeeli Wɛ bena yam ni na mae tei to.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wae o lɔre Wɛ na ke tei o lware kunkwonnu tem? Naa o na ke tei o jei o diga kam ne, o bage pina-pina to?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Nii o na ke tei o pa doa kam pepele wɛyuu ne, ye o ta kwoli naneo wo na-luŋa kam.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔge keina yam konto baŋa ne mo o nii logo baŋa teene dem baŋa ne, ye o pa nabiina nae ba wodiiru dedɛ.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Do-napana bere we do-vio mo zaŋe. Sɔŋɔ-vara tete de yeini ba bere konto mo.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: O maa pae se doa tene de kunkwon-lilirru, ye doa pepelem de jage kunkwonnu tem wone.

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Nmo ta yei o na teili kunkwonnu tem tei wɛyuu ne na? Te nam bere o na tɔge o yeino ŋwaane o ke totoŋ-kenkagela tei to mo.

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Vo-loŋo nam ná nwoŋi tega kuri seeni, pa se wulim jege tega baŋa maama, nmo luluŋ-bea wó chiiri mo ka bugi n gwaaro tem.

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: Nmo wó wane n woli de Wɛ se á ja wɛyuu kom á lware, se ko taa dana ne niu kolo ba na mɛ channa ba ke to na?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Nam pa dé lɔre kolo dé na jege se dé ta de Wɛ to. Debam ba jege ni se dé puri ded‑o, dé na jei yiram to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo nɔɔna yɔɔre ba kɔre‑o. Wɛ yiga nam tere balo na bere ba tete we ba jege swa to wone.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa zege vo-fɔrɔ kom wone o leiri Job taane dem, ye o ta we:

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Nmo ye wɔ mo se n bwɛ amo boboŋa na jaane tei to, ye n ŋɔɔne wonnu telo n na yeiri to?

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: Nmo déem wo yein-seeni mo ye amo chwi tega kam baŋa kuri? Nmo yi ná seene de poore, ta n bere-ne.

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: Amo déem pɛ se kunkwonnu mo kwoli naneo kom, pa se ko wo lim wone.

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: Amo laam maa ta de-ko a we, ‘Nmo ba jege se n lɛɛne n kɛ ywo-seeni. N na-ŋone sem ná popɔgele tei maama, se wó maŋe ywo-seeni mo.’

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: Nmo ŋwea maama wone n pɛ dɛ dem ni we, tega kam jege se ka poore na?

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se wea puli ka nye logo baŋa ni maama ne, ye ka pwooni pa se puseŋ-nyena duri ba seigi na?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Te-pora ni ne tega kam baŋa lam yeini ka nwoŋi mo jaja, ne gɔrɔ na gɔgere de nyenyero dwi dwi tei to.

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam daa ba jege pwooni se ba taa toŋa, ye ba nankɔɔre totoŋa dam dem laam chɔge mo.

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: Pwooni yeini de vei yein-seeni mo de tiga? Se lim, dento yeini de zoore yei ne mo?

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: Nmo ta zo di selo do-kandwa yam na tigisi ya tigi da to na?

english_verse: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
translation_verse: Wɔ mo lɔe chwoŋa se do-fɔrɔ taa tɔge da ka nena, ye do-napana de taa tɔge da ka baga?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa te-kora kam na zurim, se ga-lɛɛro wane te puli da.

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: Doa kam jege kwo na? Se nyɔnɔ kom, nabiinu ye ko kwo mo na?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Wɔ de nam mo jaane do-kandwa yam puga, naa do-zura kalo na jaane waaro ka ba to puga?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Ka maa pae se bwi sem na bam dɔ ba ke dam ne kandwɛ dwoŋi, ye naneo kom baŋa de zuri lɔge-lɔge?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Nmo nam wae-se n bere se se taa fuŋi se maŋa ne chekke, ye se bere se nyenyero ne vara to na?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Nmo yei chwei selo wɛyuu wonnu tem na tɔga pa te wora to na? N nam wó wane n pa chwei sem konto taa toŋa tega baŋa ne na?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo pɛ kunkwonnu tem jege swa doa nenem seeni, se kunu de taa yei ko totoŋa ni ne?

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: ne te ná tigi te bɔɔna ne, naa te ná vwɛ punnu wone mo de na?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo yeini o beeri wodiu o pae bachangaaro, ne te bia ná yeini ba keeri ba jare Wɛ, ye ba kare ba beeri wodiu?”

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: “Nmo yei maŋa kalo peero yuu bone na lore de bia to na? Se wei sem, nmo zege n nii-se pa se lore na?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Ga-vara banto bia yeini ba ke nɔɔna mo kagoa wone. Ba laam maa yeini ba viiri ba daare ba tiina ye ba daa ba jwoora.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: Ga-naao wó sɛ se ko toŋe ko pa‑m na? Tete ne, ko wó maŋe n nabwoo ne mo na?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Nmo wó wane n ma ŋona n vaŋe-ko se ko va ko pa‑m na? Ko wó sɛ se ko tɔge n kwaga ko lɔ pempala bwollu tem ne na?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Nmo nam ta wó ta‑n teege ko dam-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne, se ko toŋe n totoŋ-dɛɛra maama ko pa‑m na?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Nmo ta wó ke n chega de ga-naao we, ko wó ja n faao ko jwoori ko zo diga ko pa‑m, se n daare n fere n mena yam na?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: Nakelakɔgɔ yeini ko wuuri ko vɔna de dam. Ko vɔna koro tem nam ba maŋe de buga ni zuna vɔna yam na jege lam tei to.

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Ko yeini ko de ko chechara ko yage te-kampare ne mo, se kasolo kom fonyogo mage-ya.

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: Ko nam daa wo maane we kago-varem napɔɔna wae ya tui ya nɔne-ya ya lɔe.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ko maa jege ko bia ko yaara, ne ba dae o tete bia mo to. Ko yiga tera de ko na wowole ko lwei-ba kafɛ tei to.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: De ko de, ko ná zaŋe wɛɛne se ko duri de fora, ko wó mɔne sisein-nɔɔno de ka diru wom mo.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: Nmo ye wolo na kwei dam n pae sisein-nɔɔno to mo na? Nmo mo kwoli ka ba de koro na?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Nmo nam wae n pa ka faŋa ne kayera na ke tei, ye ka sii vio ka yage se ka ma fugi nɔɔna to na?

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ka napɔɔna yeini ya guri tega de baare mo, ye ka bere we ka yia seene jara ŋwaane. Ka ma yɔɔre ka duri ka zo jara yam wone.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Ka jege foone tete de mo ka mɔna. Ka maa ba duri se-zɔɔ de kɔtaa!

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Che-kɔŋɔ wo ka saŋa ne mo ko dɔna, ye jara chichwei de se-zɔɔro nyeena wea yiga ne.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Ka ye nyare-nyare mo se ka wurigi ka guri tega. Ba ná wugi nabɔnɔ jara ŋwaane, ka ware ka zege chemm.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: Ko ye nmo tete yeino baŋa ne mo kawula yarege ko vɔna ko jaane wɛyuu ne ko vei tega-kuri seeni na?

english_verse: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
translation_verse: Ko ná wo peo kom yuu ne konto, ko tole ko nii ko nae ko wodiu mo yiga yiga.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de Job o we:

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Job ma leiri Baŋa Wɛ o we:

english_verse: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
translation_verse: A maŋe a ŋɔɔne ko daga. Bɛ mo a daa wó ta? A bá wane a leiri.”

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa zege vo-fɔrɔ kom wone o ŋɔɔne de Job o we:

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe se n kweele a chega kam n se tega ne mo na? N ta wó lwɛ amo se ko pa n ta‑n jege bora na?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Nmo jeŋa toŋe wo-kamuna ne Wɛ jeŋa kam na ke tei to na? N wae n kwora n mumuni ne Wɛ kwora na bage tei to na?

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: La ba maama n ke daane, se n kwei-ba n suli kasolo wone. Vɔ-ba n daare n pe n yage ba yibeela wone.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: N ná wane wonnu tem konto n ke, amo laam wó sɛ a pa nmo we, n tete dam mo wó wane‑m de jwoŋi.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ko nam twe ko nabili mo tee, ne pono dwoŋi to, ye ko nɛ ŋwanno tem de dana chekke.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Ga-lɛɛro yɔɔre te puli peero jei sem ne mo se ko taa di, ye ga-vara dwi maama de kare dáane ba kwɛɛra.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Ko nam yeini ko vo ko tigi sabare kuri ne mo, ye ko seigi buga ni nanchan-gullu wone.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ware buga wo juru kom se o ja, ye ko zege da ko nia. N bá‑n wane n kwei kalanchogo n ma n ja-ko ko momwɛ seeni.”

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Ko ta ná ye naneo wo juru Leviatan, nmo wó wane n ma gwola n vaŋe-ko n le na wone na? N ta wó wane n kwei ŋona n vɔ ko ni na?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Nmo nam wó wane n puri ko momwa se n kwei ŋona n tore da, ye n daare n kwei gwola n gerege ko peyaa ne na?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó wane ba ke pipiu ko baŋa ne, ye ba cha ko yera yam muga-muga se ba pɔɔre-ya ba pa ba dwonna pipim-piina na?

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Chega to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege baare se o fe o tete o dwei juru kom konto. Wɔ laam nam mo wó na baare se o dwoni de amo?

english_verse: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
translation_verse: Wɔ jene mo amo wó taa jega se a ŋwe a pa kotu? Kokuri to, amo mo tei tega baŋa woŋo maama.

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware o pwoni ko tɔnɔ kom, naa o zɔ ko ya-tana kam na tiini ka lira to.

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege baare se kotu ja ko ni o kaŋe, ko yeila yam na tiini ya jege foone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Te na tiini te meeli daane konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware-te se o kore.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Nyoa de maa tae ka nwoŋi ko momwa ne, ne kambia na chora mini ne ye fonyogo fufuga tei to.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Ko ná zaŋe wɛɛne, foone yeini de ja dedɛɛra tete mo. Ba ná nigi ko dɔnne, ba boboŋa yeini ya vugimi mo.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Ko nii luuru se te taa nye de ga-korro mo ko tei ne. Channa de maa nye de da-popwanno ko yiga ne.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Che-tɛɛra ná jaane wɛɛne tei de, ya muri se ya pa ko duri. Ko daare pa napana kandwa ye weero ko tei ne.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Ko nii gwola se ya taa nye de swanno mo. Ba nam ná kwei chichwoa mo de se ba ma jeeri-ko de jara, ko yiga bere ka tera ya wone.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Juru kom konto ba kɔre kolokolo. Ko ba jege dwoŋi tega baŋa maama ne.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Vara balo maama ná bere ba tete kamunim, ko jege-ba ko gwoona mo. Konto mo maa ye vare-kamuna bam maama pɛ.”

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Chega to, amo zwa ya mo nigi nmo ŋwa. A tete laam nam mo nɛ‑m de a yia.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem na ŋɔɔne de Job o ti to, mo o tage de Teman tu Elifaza o we, “A bane zaŋe de nmo, de n badwonna balei bam mo. Kokuri to, á wo tage amo yera taane se ko yɔɔre chwoŋa se ko maŋe de a tontoŋeno Job na tage tei to.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Nam beeri-na nabɛ serepɛ, de pi-bale serepɛ á ja á vo Job tei se á kwei-te á ke zwɛɛm kaanem á tete ŋwaane. Ko kwaga seeni, a tontoŋeno Job wó lwoori-ne o pa abam. A maa wó jwoŋi o wɛ-lworo kom, se a yé waare abam de jworim delo á na ke to. Abam na tage amo yera taane tei to wo yɔɔre chwoŋa se ko yi Job na tage tei to.”

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: O chorro maama, de o nakwa, de o badwonna balo maama déem na vei ded‑o to ma ba o tei ye ba di kuri daane o sɔŋɔ ne. Ba ma ŋwane ba pa‑o ye ba zuri o bochare de lɛɛro telo maama Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe o yera ne to. Ba maama dedoa dedoa ma pa‑o lu-nyenno sabu-dala, de sabu-seŋa jafole.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: O ma pa Job daa lo bia fuga, bakeiri serepɛ, de bukwa batɔ.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Tega baŋa maama wone, kaane déem tera o lam na twɛ Job bukwa bam. Job ma pa-ba chwoŋa se ba woli ba nabwa bam wone se o ná tega, se ba chɛ o jejegero tem ba pa daane.

english_verse: years—long enough to see his great-grandchildren have children of their own—
translation_verse: ) o woli da. O déem ma na o bia de ba de bia, se ko yi dwia yana laŋa ne.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: O ma tiini o kwe ye o laam te o tete toone.

translation_verse: Chwei selei taane

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Kotu za pae se Baŋa Wɛ nia yam mo jege ywoni ya pa‑o. Wea de tete maama o yeini o boŋe ya wone zii mo lanyerane.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom konto nye de tio kolo na zege ko bwola de nabara ye ko vɔɔro ba siira kɔtaa to mo. Ko nam leiri bia mo ka maŋa ne chekke. O na ke kolo maama to vei yiga lanyerane.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam nam dae konto! Banto nye de swanno mo vio na kale ko maa jia to.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ná lage o di nabiina bora, puseŋ-nyena bam wó to mo. Wɛleere-keira de nam bá wane ba woli balo na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ fɔge o nii balo na kɔre-o to, de ba veiŋa maama mo. Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam, banto yɔɔre ba jei mo ba chwoŋa kam ne.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam bane zaŋe? Bɛ mo ye ba ke daane ba boŋe boboŋa kafɛ ŋwaane konto?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Ba pwa bam de ba dedɛɛra bam ma la daane, se ba ke chichuŋu de Baŋa Wɛ de o Dam Tu wolo o na kuri to.

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa jei o telaao paare jeiŋa jei ne ye o mɔne-ba. O maa nae ba boboŋa yam na muri tei to.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: O bane ma zaŋe ba baŋa ne ye o kaane-ba de ba keim-yɔɔro tem. O ma tiini o fugi-ba de o ban-zɔŋɔ kom.

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: “Amo laam wó pa se Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to nwoŋi pwooni, de o na tage de amo o we: ‘Nmo mo ye amo Bu, ye zem amo de ji nmo Kwo.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Nmo wó kwei luu-dedɔrɔ n ma n wane-ba, ye n daare n chɔge-ba, ne kambi mo ba chochoge to.’ ”

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Chɔɔle-na o Bu wom yiga ne á ma‑á zuli‑o, se o bane yé zaŋe abam baŋa ne. Ko ná dae konto, wonto wó wane o ba o chɔge abam bedwe baŋa ne. Balo nam na seigi ba tete o woro wone to, Wɛ wó ke zaane o ke banto maama yuu ne mo.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nii amo dona na daga tei! Balo na zege amo zega to gaale dedɛ!

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Jar-keira morro fuga mo ná jeeri-ne, ye ba peene-ne jei maama ba ke tetare ne de, amo ta bá kɔre foone.

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo zege amo chega kam kwaga ne. Cham na tu de peene amo to, nmo jwoŋi-ne n yage se a lu de wone. Nam ta duri amo yibwona, se n daare n cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Nabiina bam, á lage se á ta‑á ke-ne chaveera taa se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo? Á wó ta‑á swoi wo-yɔɔro, ye á kwori á sɛ vwa taane taa wuu mo na?

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we Baŋa Wɛ kuri chega tɔgena mo se ba taa ye o nyem. Amo ná yeini a lwoori‑o, o sɛ a taane dem mo.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á kɔre-na foone se á yera de taa sae! De konto de, yé ke-na wɛleere. Á ná yeini á tigi á sara ne ye á sii, se á ta‑á jege boboŋa yanto dwoŋi á bochara wone.

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Tɔge-na chega wone á kaane á pa Baŋa Wɛ, se á daare á sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ yeini ba bwei ba we, “Nɔɔno wora o na wó ke debam lanyerane na?” Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, pa se n yibia jeeri debam seeni se n lanyerane dem kwoli debam!

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi amo ni taane. Ko chɛ a yera ne ye a sisiga!

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo ye amo Pɛ, pa-ne chwoŋa se a ba nmo yiga ne. A lwoori zeinim mo nmo tei ne. Popo, se n sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, tega ná poore, nmo yeini n cheigi amo ni taane. Zezeŋa ne amo wó tiŋi a taane dem nmo yiga ne mo, ye a laam taa jei a cheiga se a nii.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: A Tu Wɛ, nmo na ye tei to, n wo ba pwoli de lwarem totoŋa. Nɔn-balwaaro bá wane ba zo nmo tei.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Balo na bere ba tete kamunim to de bá wane ba zege nmo yiga ne. Nmo chuli balo maama na ke lwarem to.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye vwa-fɔra, nmo wó chɔge-ba mo, ye n ve nɔn-gora de gengan-nyena maama.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye amo, nmo jege amo swono chekke. Konto ŋwaane, amo wó na chwoŋa se a zo n sɔŋɔ kom. Amo wó kuni dwoona nmo yiga ne, ye a zuli nmo yere nmo tete diga kam wone.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a taa tɔge nmo chega chwoŋa kam, amo dona na daga ba gaale to ŋwaane. Tiŋi chwoŋa kalo na yɔɔre to a yiga ne, se a yé ywori ka wone.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye a dona bam, ba nia yam ba nwoŋi chega kɔtaa. Ba beeri chɔgem yerane mo. Ba nia maa ŋɔɔre, ne yibeeli na puri to mo, ye ba tɔge ni-sone baŋa ne ba gane nɔɔna.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: A Tu Wɛ, pa ba to ba bora wone! Pa se ba tete bobwea yam de-ba. Ba wɛleera yam na daga to, zeili-ba n yiga ne, kokuri ba lɔge nmo kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Ko daare, ko ná ye balo maama na seigi nmo woro kom wone to, pa se ba wo pwoli. Pa se ba taa leeni lei de ywoni taa wuu. Balo na swoi nmo to, se n ta‑n cho-ba se ba taa zuli nmo yere de wopwolo.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yé tɔge n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne n bwɛ-ne. Ta yé da n ban-lom dem ŋwaane n waare-ne.

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, leiri n na ke tei to, se n daare n ba n vere-ne n yage. Jwoŋi-ne, nmo na yɔɔre n jege amo swono to ŋwaane.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Churu ne, ba ba guli nmo gula. Nɔɔno ná tega, kotu wó wane o tei nmo yere na?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Amo na tiini a sisigi to mo pɛ se a yera chɛ. Tete dem maama ne mo a keeri dedɛ pa se a sara kam bugi dedaane yi-na.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: A yia maama suli de yi-na, amo wo na tiini ko chɔge to ŋwaane. A daa ware se a taa nii lanyerane, a dona bam na daane-ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na toŋe lwarem to, lage-na jei á vo se á daare amo, kokuri amo keira kam to Baŋa Wɛ zwa ne.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a kwei a tete mo a seigi nmo woro wone. Nam jwoŋi-ne n yage balo na pare amo se ba ja to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Ko ná dae konto, ba wó yɔɔre ba ja-ne mo ba tore nenɛɛne nywonnu na ke tei, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se kotu jwoŋi-ne o yage.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: naa a ná toŋe a chɔge a badwoŋi yiga, naa a zeini o dono wolo na daane‑o to,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: se nmo laam pa chwoŋa se a dona bam pare-ne ba ja. Pa se ba nɔne amo baŋa ne ba se tega ne, se a ŋwea laam ti ye a maŋe tega kam ne.

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne de ban-zɔŋɔ! Zaŋe n che a dona bam de ba ban-lom dem! Zaŋe ba baŋa ne se n pa n chega kam taa zega.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Nam la logo baŋa dwi tiina bam se ba gilimi nmo yiga ne. Diini baŋa baŋa n ta‑n tei-ba.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Nmo ye wolo na ye chega tu ye n faŋe nɔɔna bochara de ba boboŋa n nii to. Nam cheiŋi puseŋ-nyena bam de ba nankɔɔre kikia yam, se n daare n pa se nɔn-ŋona taa zega.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye wolo na bore chega bora to mo. Dɛ maama wuu o yeini o bwɛ balo na toŋe lwarem to.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Banto ná wo leiri ba boboŋa, Wɛ wó dwori o se-zɔɔ ni mo, ye o daare o saŋe o taŋa kam lanyerane.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: O jara zela yam maŋe ya kwɛ. O che-tɛɛra yam sele mo de vea ya pɔe.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Puseŋ-nyena yeini ba ja chanɛɛre puga mo. Ba laam maa virigi lwarem puga, ye ba daare ba lore vwa yerane.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Banto yeini ba ko gwonnu mo, ye ba tete laam daare ba to te wone.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Lwarem delo ba na toŋe to jwoori de tui ba tete yuu ne mo. Ba nankɔɔre kikia mo jwoori ya ni-ba.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: Amo wó ke Baŋa Wɛ lei, o na yɔɔre o ke chega to ŋwaane. A ta wó leeni a tei o yere mo, de o na ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye debam Teiru. Nmo yere dem jege zula dedɛ logo baŋa jei maama wone. Nmo pɛ se n nenɔŋa taa nae jaja mo wɛyuu jeiga maama ne.

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se bia tete de bu-sese mo taa tei nmo yere. Nmo jege dam se n cheiŋi n dona maama pa se ba zege da chemm. Balo maama na lɔge nmo kwaga ne to mo jaane ba nia.

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: “Ko ná ye nabiina, bɛ mo ye n jege ba boboŋa? Bɛ mo ke ye n yiga wo nabiin-bia wone konto?”

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nmo nam pɛ se nabiina tiini ba jege paare, ye n ta pa-ba zula, pa se ba dam muri nmo nyem dem fenfee mo.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: N ma-n daare n pa se ba tei wonnu telo maama n jea na ke to, se wonnu maama taa wo ba dam kuri ne.

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye pei, de bone, de naane, de kago-vara bam maama de,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: ko woli de zuna, de ywona, dedaane wonnu telo maama na wo naneero wone to, te maama wo nabiina dam kuri ne mo.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye debam Teiru. Nmo yere dem jege zula dedɛ logo baŋa maama wone.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó tei nmo de a wo maama. A ta wó ŋɔɔne nmo wo-kenkagela yam taane a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó pa se a wo pwoli, ye a daare a di ywoni nmo ŋwaane. A ta wó leeni mo a zeiŋi n yere wɛɛne.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo ná di nɔɔna taane, n yɔɔre n pae chega bora mo. Nmo seene n bore amo bora n pa se a jege a chega.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n fugi dwi-gɛ tiina bam, ye n daare n chɔge puseŋ-nyena bam. N saare ba yere mo se nɔɔna daa yé guli ba gula taa wuu.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Chɔgem mo tu dé dona baŋa ne, Ba teene dem ma ji di-dwonnu se ko taa vei wuu, pa se nɔɔna yɔɔre ba swei de ni ne.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam jege o paare mo se ko taa vei wuu. O maa jei se o di nɔɔna taane.
