english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Leeni-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ, se o di paare mo Zion ne! Ta‑á tɛ o na ke tei maama to á bere logo baŋa dwi tiina bam.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye wolo na jwoori o ŋwe nɔn-gora jene to mo. Ko ná ye balo na wo cham wone to, o bá fɔge o ve ba keira kalo na jare‑o to.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam duri amo ŋwaŋa! Nii amo dona bam na daane-ne pa se a yaare tei! Nmo ye wolo na wó wane n che toone se de yé ja-ne to mo.

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Konto to, amo wó zege Zion teo pwooni ne a zuli nmo yere jaja. Amo wó taa chaka mo de wopwolo, de nmo na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina bam vei ba to gwoŋo kolo ba na koge to wone. Kalanchogo kolo ba na tiŋi to mo jwoori ko ja-ba.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ veere o tete se ko tɔge de o chega bora borem dem mo. Puseŋ-nyena bam nam na toŋe lwarem delo to jwoori de jaane-ba ne kalanchogo to.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam wó vo ba zo churu ne, dedaane dwi tiina balo maama na ve Wɛ to.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne! Yé pa nabiina chwoŋa se ba ve nmo. Ja logo baŋa dwi tiina bam n zege n yiga ne se n laam di ba taane.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pa se foone yɔɔre de zo-ba, se ba lɔre we ba ye nabiina mo ye ba dam wo yi nmo dam dem.

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, bɛ mo ke ye n wo yiga yiga amo tei ne? Bɛŋwaane mo cham yi amo ye n laam seigi n tete?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bere ba tete kamunim ye ba pare nabwona se ba ja. Ba maa tɔge ba boboŋ-lwanno tem baŋa ne mo ba jaane-ba.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena yeini ba zeiŋi ba tete mo de ba fera na zo wonnu telo to. Ba maa zuli kampin-nyena, ye ba daare ba lwɛ Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam yiga tera dedaane Wɛ, ba na jege teera to ŋwaane. Ba maa boŋe we, “Wɛ tera.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: De ko de, ba wonnu maama ke lanyerane. Ba maa ware se ba ni nmo bera yam kuri, ye ba jege ba dona bam ba gwoona.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ba maa boŋe ba we, “Dé bá fɔge dé gɔ naga. Dé bá fɔge dé zo cham wone kɔtaa!”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba sɔɔle lwarem yerane mo. Ba maa fɔ vwa ye ba fugi nɔɔna. Ba tiini ba swoi nankɔɔre de puseŋa ŋɔŋa mo.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ba maa seigi gugworru wone ne nywonnu mo tei, se ba dale ba zi balo na yeiri ko ni ne to. Ba tɔge konto dwoŋi ba jaane nabwona, ye ba daare ba tuuri-ba ba kɛa, ne ba wo ŋwe-choa wone mo tei.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ba maa boŋe ba we, “Wɛ yiga tera! O kwoli o yibia mo ye o ba nae.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne! Kwei n jeŋa n ma‑n waare puseŋ-nyena bam, se n daare n zeini nabwona.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye puseŋ-nyena swoi se ba taa lwɛ Wɛ konto? Bɛ mo ye ba tɛ ba tete ne we, “Wɛ nam bá bwei amo”?

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: Nam chɔge puseŋ-nyena de nɔn-balwaaro dam. Bwei-ba ba keim-lwanno tem ŋwaane, se ba totoŋa maama saare.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo di paare se ko taa vei wuu! Dwi-gɛ tiina bam jege se ba jei mo Wɛ tete tega kam wone.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yeini n cheigi nabwona na lwoori‑m tei to. Nmo ke dam n ke ba kuri ne, de n na cheigi ba keira tei to.

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: N zege botara de balo na nɛ bɛɛsem to kwaga ne, se nabiinu wolo maama na wo logo baŋa ne to daa yé fugi-ba.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: Amo wó sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne. Nam daa‑n yé ta de amo we: “Duri n vo n seigi peero jei ne, ne zuŋa na jaane wɛɛne tei to.

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: Nii puseŋ-nyena na saŋe ba tɛ, ye ba mole chena da tei to! Ba maa seigi ba tete, se ba ta balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam na chɔge dé teo kom lam to, nɔn-ŋona ware kolokolo se ba ke.”

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo wo o wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne. O maa jei o di paare mo Wɛ telaao ne. O yia laam dole jei maama ya yere nabiina, pa se o maane kolo maama ba na ke to.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o maane nɔn-ŋona de puseŋ-nyena mo o nia. O nam yɔɔre o chuli balo na swoi nankɔɔre kikia to mo.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam, o lage o lwo min-chala de chilibugu mo ba yuu ne, ye o daare o pa se vo-loŋo mage-ba.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa chekke mo. O maa swoi keim-laaro. Balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to wó ba ba na o yibia.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe n zeini debam! Kokuri to, balo na sɛ Wɛ to daa tera. Balo na jege chega de Wɛ to laam jei mo nabiina tetare ne.

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we: “Amo laam wó zaŋe wɛɛne a toŋe woŋo, yiniga tiina na nɛ bɛɛsem ye nabwona suuri cham wone to ŋwaane. Amo wó vere-ba cham wone se ba na siu, ne ko na maŋe de-ba tei to.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni taane dem yɔɔre de ye chekke mo. De tiini de lana jase nenɛɛne lu-nyenno telo na tiini te kwɛ to. De nye de ba na ke lu-nyenno mini wone kuni berepɛ pa se digiru daa tera to mo.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo wó yere nabwona se kolokolo yé yi-ba. Nmo ta wó ta‑n cho debam taa wuu de nɔn-balwaaro tem kikia.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam kare mo ba bere ba tete. Nɔɔna maama maa zuli balo na toŋe lwarem nabiina tetare ne to.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yɔɔre n nii amo seeni, se n leiri a wɛ-lworo kom. Pa se a ŋwea jwoori ka ke dam, se toone yé wane-ne de ja.

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: Ko ná dae konto, a dona bam wó ta we: “Debam wane‑o dé di!” Ba wó taa chaka de amo na to tei to.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Amo wó leeni lei a pa Baŋa Wɛ, o na ke-ne lanyerane to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworru yeini ba tɛ ba bochare ne we, “Wɛ tera.” Ba maama chɔge mo ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ, ba totoŋa de maa tiini ya lwara. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba wone kotu na tɔge chwo-laao.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa zege o telaao sɔŋɔ kom ne o tiiri o nii nabiina, se o lɔre ba wolo jege swa ye o tɔge Wɛ na?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Nii-ba mo! Foone tiini de jege-ba, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ zeini balo na zege chega wone to mo.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó lwoori Wɛ se o zege Zion ne o ba o vere Isarele tiina bam. Baŋa Wɛ ná seene o pa o nɔɔna bam jwoori ba zege de dam, Isarele dwi dem na ye Jakob dwi dem to wó taa chaka de wopwolo!

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Ko ye wolo veiŋa na tɔge chwo-laao chekke, ye o jege chega o kikia maama wone to mo. Kotu yeini o ŋɔɔne chega de o wo maama,

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: O yiga maa tera de nɔn-balwaaro, ye o za nege balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to mo. Konto tu yeini o tɔge o ni dem maama kwaga mo. O nam bá yiri-de, ne ko ná maŋe ko chamma tetei maama ko pa‑o de.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Amo taga de Baŋa Wɛ we, “Nmo ye amo Teiru. Wo-laaro telo maama amo na jege to nwoŋi nmo tei ne mo.”

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na duri ba tɔge jwona kwaga to, banto wo-chechɔgɔ kom wó tiini ko gaale mo. Amo nam bá tɔge a lwo ba na bam. A bá bwoŋi ba jwona yam yera se a kaane a pa-ya.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye wolo na maŋe de amo to. Nmo kuri chwoŋa kalo amo na wó taa tɔge to, ye n nii amo veiŋa baŋa ne.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: Amo wó tei Baŋa Wɛ o na pa-ne kwea se a wane a tɔge chwoŋa to ŋwaane. Tete ne nmo ta woli-ne a boboŋa ne mo se a yé tusi.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a yei we Baŋa Wɛ mo wo a tei ne maŋa maama. O na wo a jazem seeni to ŋwaane, o zeini-ne mo se a zege cheppe.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a jege wopwolo lanyerane. A ŋwea maama maa jege ywoni. Amo yera de daa bá taa sae.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, amo ná tega, n bá‑n yage-ne se a taa wo churu ne. Nmo bá‑n sɛ se n tete wo-pwoŋo tu wom yera pɔ.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se a lɔre chwei selo na pae ŋwea to se a taa tɔge-se. Amo ná yi nmo tei, nmo wó pa se a na ywoni dedɛ. A ná tu a jeini nmo jazem seeni, amo laam wó su de wopwolo dáane se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom de a na jege bora tei to. Pore n zwa n cheigi a na keeri a jare‑m tei to, se ko dae vwa mo a fɔe.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Nam zege amo kwaga ne se a na a bora. Pa se n yia taa nae kolo na ye chega to.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Nmo maane n nii amo boboŋa na ye tei. Nmo ma‑n fɔɔre n yi amo tei tete ne de. Nmo nam na faŋe-ne n nii tei maama to, kolokolo tera. A boboŋa maŋe ya ja we, amo bá tusi de a ŋɔŋa kam.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: A ma che a tete se a yé zo nankɔ-nyena chwei sem ne, a na tɔge n ni taane na bere tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a lwoori‑m mo, bɛŋwaane nmo mo wó leiri-ne. Pore n zwa se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
translation_verse: Pa se nmo na yɔɔre n swoi nɔɔna tei to taa bere jaja. Nmo yeini n kwei n jazem n ma n vere balo na sale nmo yera ne to n yage ba dona jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yere amo nenɛɛne n tete yi-chele-bu to. Pa se a vwɛ n woro kom wone, ne nmo na yarege n vɔna n kwoli-ne tei to.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Ŋwaŋa tera ba bochara ne. Ba ni taane maa ye boyerem yerane.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ amo kwaga mo ba pu. Ba laam tu ba gilimi-ne. Ba yia maa ye chɔɔ mo, ye ba nii se ba dole-ne ba de tega ne.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Ba maa nye de nywonnu telo wodiiru fera na jege-te to mo. Ba dale mo se ba laam nwoŋi ba ja-ne, nenɛɛne nywon-pɔle na ke tei to.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne n kwaare jara de-ba, se n daare n de-ba tega ne. Kwei n se-zɔɔ n ma‑n jwoŋi-ne puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne n yage.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ma n jeŋa n vere-ne nɔɔna bam konto dwi jeŋa ne n yage. Ba maa ye balo yiga na wo logo konto yerane wone ye ba nyɔɔre wo ŋwea kanto ne to mo. Nam pa se ba na waarem delo n na tiŋi ba ŋwaane to. Pa se ba di ba su ba daare ba pa ba bia, se banto de tiŋi waarem se ba bia jwa taa di.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, a wó ba a na nmo yibia, a na jege bora to ŋwaane. A ná dɔ a zaŋe, a wó su mo de ywoni, a na nae nmo nyenyego na ye tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a swoi nmo. Nmo mo ye amo dam.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: Amo yeini a bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere mo. O de maa jwoŋi-ne o yage a dona jeŋa ne. Wonto maŋe se nabiina taa tei‑o mo.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Toone déem kekare amo de vɔ. Ko nam ya gɛ fee mo se chɔgem pu amo kwaga de ja nenɛɛne na-fɔrɔ dwoŋi to.

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: Ko nye de churu chwoŋa ŋoge ŋone mo ka vɔ amo ka tiŋi. Toone de ma che kalanchogo a chwoŋa ne de cheigi-ne.

english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋi ye ka yera sae. Peero tem kura maama de ziziŋi mo ye ya dɔna, Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: O ma kɔɔre wɛyuu kom nenɛɛne diga ni gɔrɔ to, o daare o tu tega kam baŋa. O na maa tu to, kunkwon-lilirru wo o nɛ kuri ne mo.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: O diini cherubi mo o jaane o maa kɛa. Vio kom vɔna baŋa ne mo o tɔge da o via.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Lim mo o kwei o ma pu o tete se ko ji woro ko pa‑o. Kunkwon-lilirru telo na pae do-fɔrɔ to ma kwoli‑o.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo zege wɛyuu ne o bage de dam. O kwora kam ma dɔne ka to nɔɔna zwa ne.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo bane na zaŋe ye n bage n dona bam to, mo naneo kom na bam pɔgele pa ko kuri nae jaja. Nmo na fi n momwa to, tega kam gugworru maama ma ziziŋi pa te tigi ja.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma zege wɛyuu ne o twe o jeŋa o ja amo. O ma liiri-ne o ja o nwoŋi na-luŋa wone.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: O yɔɔre o jwoŋi-ne mo o yage a dona bam jeŋa ne, kokuri to, balo na chuli amo to tiini ba dana ba dwoi-ne.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: Amo ya wo lɛɛro wone mo ye a dona bam chuchugi-ne. Baŋa Wɛ nam tu o teili-ne pa se a zege cheppe.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ke-ne lanyerane a na tɔge chega chwoŋa to ŋwaane. Amo je sem na toŋe chega to, mo o jwoori o ŋwe-ne konto.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: O nia yam maama mo amo tɔga. A maa wo ve chullu telo o na pɛ to.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se Baŋa Wɛ jwoori o ke-ne lanyerane, de a na tɔge chega chwoŋa ye a je sem toŋe chekke to ŋwaane.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege wo-pwoŋo to, nmo de ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo n pa-ba. Ko daare balo na toŋe tusim kikia to, n ke swa mo pa ko chɛ ba yera ne.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ chwoŋa kam lamma fase mo! O ni taane dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo. O wae o cho balo na seigi o woro kom wone to, ne jara nantana na kwoli nɔɔna jara wone tei to.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: O ta pae se a nɛ kwaare tega mo, nenɛɛne woŋa nɛ na ye tei to mo. O maa cho-ne se a yé to peero tem yuu ne.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Wonto ta bere-ne jara keim laŋa mo, se a taa wae a saŋe taŋa kalo na vaŋe de dam to a tae.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ-ne jara-keim nantana se ka taa kwoli-ne, ye n jwoŋi-ne n yage cham wone. Nmo jazem dem teili-ne mo se a zege cheppe. Nmo na sɛ se n woli-ne tei to pɛ se a ji babea.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Nmo kwɛ chwoŋa kalo na yala to mo n tiŋi amo yiga ne, se a yé seeri a to tega ne.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Amo pare a dona bam mo a ja. A ma mage ba maama a go pa ba wolowolo wo daare.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: A popoge-ba mo a de tega ne pa se ba daa ware wɛɛne se ba zaŋe, a na nɔne-ba de a naga to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo pa-ne dam se a taa ma a ke jara. N ta ma‑n pae se a dona bam ba ba kuni dwoona amo yiga ne.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Ba maa beeri wolim. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera se o jwoŋi-ba o yage. Ba ma keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ, ye o wo sɛ ba wara yam.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Amo maa cho-ba a mumugi pa se ba ji nenɛɛne fwogo vio na kale tei to. A ma lwo-ba a yage nenɛɛne ba ye chwoŋa ni bworu to.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ seene o ŋwe! O maa ye peo kolo amo na dale da to. Ko maŋe mo se dé taa tei‑o. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Wonto nam mo jwoŋi-ne o yage!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Wonto mo jwoori o ŋwe jene a dona baŋa ne. O maa jaane dwi-gɛ tiina o tui o ke amo dam kuri ne.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom bere Wɛ nenɔŋa kam na ye tei to mo. Kunkwonnu tem de maa paale kolo maama o jea na naane to.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu wonnu tento ba ŋɔɔne botare-bia se ba taa zaŋa. Te kwori sem maa ye chemm mo.

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: De ko de, te ni taane dem yi tega baŋa jei maama mo. Te kwora ma jage ka yi dɔŋɔ ni maama. Wɛ chwi vwei mo wɛyuu kom ne o pa wea kam se ka taa zoore da.

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: Ka laam maa yeini ka puli, nenɛɛne ka-dooro baro na nwoŋi diga ne de wopwolo tei to, naa babea na duri de dam se o di yiga tei to.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nia yam yɔɔre ya ye chekke mo. Ya maa pae se nɔɔna jwoori ba na dam. Baŋa Wɛ bera yam jege kuri. Ya maa pae nayeiri-nyena swa mo.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam tɔge chwoŋa. Ka maa pae wopwolo dedɛ. Baŋa Wɛ ni-kaana yam bere chega mo jaja. Ya maa pae nɔɔna yi-poro.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ko lana. Konto jege kuri se ko taa vei wuu. Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa yam jege chega. Ya ba tusa de fenfee de.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam jege kuri ya dwoi sabu-seŋa dedɛ, ka ná maŋe ka lana tei maama de. Ya ywomma ya dwoi tooro, de tooro nuga maama.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nia yam kaane n tɔgena mo. Wolo maama ná sɛ-ya, kotu nae nyɔɔre dedɛ mo ya ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Ta‑n cho-ne se a yé paale a ke wo-lwanno. Yé pa se wɛleera taa jege dam amo baŋa ne. Konto mo a wó wane a taa jege bora de a kikia maama, ye a bá ywori nmo kwaga ne.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a ni taane dem de a boboŋa maama taa ye kolo na wó pwoli nmo wo to. Nmo nye de peo kolo amo na sale ko yera ne to mo. N ta ma‑n ye amo jwoŋinu.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Cham ná yi nmo, Baŋa Wɛ wó ba o zeini‑m. O maa ye dé nabaaro Jakob Wɛ wom mo. O wó taa cho‑m de n dona bam.

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: O wó zege o wara-jei sem ne o toŋe o zeini nmo. Zion peo kom ne mo konto, o lage o zege da o ba o zege n kwaga ne.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: O ta wó guli n pɛɛra yam maama gula. Kaanem delo maama nmo na zwɛ n pa‑o to wo su o yi.

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa n na n boboŋa na lage kolo to, se n na jeeli kolo maama to seene ko ke ko pa‑m.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Pɛ, nmo laam ná wane dé dona bam n di, dé wó taa chaka mo. Dé wó zeiŋi dé tuta wɛɛne de wopwolo dé Tu Wɛ wom yere ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ wó ke o su n wɛ-lworo kom maama o pa‑m.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Amo laam tu a lɔre we Baŋa Wɛ zeini pɛ wolo o na kuri to se o wane o dona bam. O zege o tete telaao ne mo o leiri pɛ wom na lwoori‑o tei maama to. O maa tɔge o dam-fɔrɔ jazem dem baŋa ne o jwoŋi‑o o yage.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna jege teera ba jara-keim torokooro ŋwaane. Badwonna de maa jege teera ba sisein-nɔɔna ŋwaane. Debam nam jege teera dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere dem ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Banto maa chɔɔle ba to tega ne. Debam nam wó zaŋe wɛɛne dé taa zege mo cheppe.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, pɛ wom wo mo pwoli, nmo dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane. O tiini o jege ywoni mo o di, nmo na pɛ o wane o dona bam o di to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ‑o kolo o boboŋa na lage to. Nmo ta wo ve‑o kolo maama o na lwoori n tei ne to.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Nmo jeeri‑o de wo-laaro, ye n yɔɔre n swɛ o swolim. N ma‑n kwei sabu-seŋa paare yipuga n pu o yuu ne.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: O lwoori nmo tei ne se n ta‑n nii o ŋwea kam baŋa ne. Nmo ma‑n seene n pa se o na momwɛ-dɛɛre, se o taa ŋwe taa wuu.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: O tiini o na zula dedɛ, nmo na zeini‑o to ŋwaane. Nmo ta daare n pa se o na nenɔŋa de paare lanyerane.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Chega to, nmo yeini n swɛ o swolim mo taa wuu. Nmo ta pɛ se o wo pwoli dedɛ, de n na wo o tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, pɛ wom sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne mo. O daa bá fɔge o to, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na jege o swono taa wuu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Nmo lage n kwei n jeŋa mo n ma n ja n dona bam maama. N jazem dem wó zi-ba de chɔge.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Nmo ná nwoŋi ye n zaŋe ba baŋa ne, n lage n di-ba mo dedaane min-vogo. Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo wó di-ba o ban-lom dem ŋwaane. O lage o pa se o mini mo di-ba kula.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Nmo wó pa se n dona bam bia jei mo logo kom baŋa ne. Ba daa bá na dwi se de daare.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Nmo nam wó saŋe n taŋa se n ta-ba, pa se ba pipiri ba duri ba kɛ.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: A Wɛ, a Wɛ, bɛ mo ke ye n yage a yera? Nmo ye yiga yiga amo tei ne. Bɛ mo ye n wo tu se n zeini-ne a cham wone, de a na tiini a lwoori‑m tetei to?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: A Tu Wɛ, dɛ maama a yeini a keeri a lage zeina ye n chem. Tete ne de a yeini a lwoori‑m ye siu tera.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, n ta ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo. N ma‑n jei n paare jeiŋa jei ne, ye n nɔɔna Isarele tiina de maa pa‑m tia.

english_verse: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
translation_verse: Debam nabaara bam déem ke ba wo-dedoa de nmo mo. N ma‑n jwoŋi-ba n yage.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Cham na jege-ba to mo ba keeri ba jare‑m. Nmo ma‑n pa se ba lu de wone. Ba na ke ba wo-dedoa dede‑m to, nmo wo yage-ba laŋa tetare ne.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama na yaale-ne ye ba gwooni-ne tei to nye de a ye kanzwɛ mo, se a dae nabiinu.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama yi na nɛ amo to mɔne mo. Ba maa dole ba yum ba twe-ne.

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: Ba tɛ ba we: “Pa n teena taa wo Baŋa Wɛ wone se o le‑m cham wone. Nmo kikia ná su Baŋa Wɛ yi, se o jwoŋi‑m o yage!”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Nmo nam mo jaane-ne n nwoŋi a nu puga ne de yazura. Amo ta na ye bu-seseŋa ye a ŋɔge a nu yele to mo nmo nii amo baŋa ne.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Ko zege a lora maŋa ne mo a teena maŋe ya wo nmo wone. Nmo ta ma‑n ye amo Tu Wɛ.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Chanɛɛre tiini de bwola se de ja-ne. Yé vei yiga yiga n daare-ne, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó woli-ne.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam daga ye ba gilimi-ne ne nabɛ mo tei. Ba nye de nabɛ kamunnu na nwoŋi Basan laŋa ne ye se beeri jara to mo.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: A ŋwea kam lwogi ka yage mo ne ba na lwogi na ba yage tega ne tei to. Amo kwi sem maama ywori mo. A bochare dem de maa nye de nuga kalo na nyeene to.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: A ni dem koge mo ne kanchua tei. A dindeilimi de maa meeri de maŋe a ni dem wone. Wɛ, nmo yage-ne se a to tega ne mo se a daare a te.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: A dona bam gilimi amo ne kukuri kɔgɔ tei to mo. Ba ma ja a jea dedaane a nɛ maama se ba vuuri-se.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Amo yera yam bugi pa se a kwi sem nae jaja, ye a ga se maama a vo a ti. A dona bam maa yɔɔre ba nii-ne ye ba mɔna.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yé ta‑n ye yiga yiga de amo. Amo zeinnu, ba lela n woli-ne!

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Cho-ne se a dona bam se-zɔɔro yé chɔge-ne. Jwoŋi a ŋwea kukuri sento nia ne n yage.

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Cho-ne se nywonnu yé ja-ne. Nam cheiŋi nabɛ sento se se yé chu-ne de se nyea. Nmo laam cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom!

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Abam balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to, laam tei‑o na! Se abam, Jakob dwi dem maama, zuli-na o yere dem! Isarele tiina maama, chɔɔle-na o yiga ne!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane Baŋa Wɛ ba chuli nabwona, o nam ba gwooni-ba. O wo pipiri o kwaga o ya amo. Amo ná kaase a jare‑o, o yiga wora de amo mo.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Amo ná zege nmo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne, a wó tei‑m n keina maama ŋwaane. Amo wó seene a ke kolo a na pwooli nmo yiga ne se a ke to, se balo maama na kɔre nmo to taa nae.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Nabwona wó di ba su. Balo na tu Baŋa Wɛ tei to wó tei‑o taa. Yazura taa wo ba tei ne se ko taa vei wuu!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Logo baŋa jei maama ne nɔɔna wó guli Baŋa Wɛ gula ye ba pipiri ba ba o tei. Nabiina dwi maama wó ba ba chɔɔle o yiga ne ye ba zuli‑o.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ logo kom maama wone. O di paare mo teene dem maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa naduna maama wó ba ba chɔɔle o yiga ne ba zuli‑o. Balo ŋwea na lage ka jei to maama wó ba ba tiiri o yiga ne.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Debam dwi delo ta na wo kwaga ne to wó zuli‑o. Ba jwa wó ni dé Teiru Wɛ ŋwa.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: O yeini o jaane-ne mo o vei ga-zuru jei se a sii. O maa kale-ne pa se dé vei mɛ seeni bwi na bwola da to.

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: O pae se a ŋwea jwoori ka jege dam mo. O maa tɔge a yiga pa se a tɔge chwo-laaro, se ko pa o yere dem zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Nmo wo amo tei ne mo maŋa maama. A ná maŋe a tɔge jei selo na ye lim nenɛɛne toone mo de, amo bá taa kɔre foone, nmo na zei n gwoli dem de n nacheiga kam n ma‑n cho-ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, dɛ delo maama wone a na wó taa ŋwe to, nmo lanyerane de n swono kom wó taa wo amo tei ne mo. Amo wó taa wo nmo Baŋa Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Tega kam baŋa dedaane kolo maama na wo ko wone to ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. Logo kom de ko nɔn-bia bam maama de maa ye wonto nyem.

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Ko ye balo yerane kikia na dɛ chwoŋa ye ba bochara lana fase to mo. Banto ba sɛ ba kaane jwona. Ba nam ba fɔ vwa ba du duuri.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ nɔɔna bam konto swolim. Wɛ na ye ba Vereno to, wonto wó pa se ba na bora.

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo a kwei a tete a pa‑m.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a ke a wo-dedoa dedaane nmo. Yé pa se chaveera di-ne. Nam yé sɛ se a dona bam taa jege-ne ba mɔna.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Bere-ne nmo chega kam, se a wane a tɔge ka chwei sem. Kolo ŋwaane nmo mo ye amo Vereno Wɛ wom. Amo teena maa wo nmo tei ne mo dɛ dem maama wone.

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lamma mo ye o yɔɔre o ke chega. Ko ná ye balo na tusi to, o yeini o bere-ba chwoŋa kalo na ye chekke to.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: O maa tɔge balo na tu ba tete to yiga, se ba taa ke kolo na maŋe to mo, ye o daare o bere-ba o chwoŋa kam.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: Chwei selo maama Baŋa Wɛ na tɔge to ye o swono kom ŋwaane mo. O maa ke o chega dedaane balo na sɛ ba tɔge ni delo o na gwoni de-ba to.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam da n yere dem ŋwaane n kwei a keim-lwanno n yage n ma‑n chɛ-ne, de te na maŋe te daga tei maama.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Wɛ ta wó pa se o di ywoni o ŋwea wone. O dwi dem de wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o lɔ o wo o bere balo na kɔre‑o to. O maa pae se ba lɔre o ni-gwonim dem na bere tei maama.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: A chanɛɛre dem laam tiini de zo-ne. Popo, jwoŋi-ne n yage ya maama wone.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Nii n na a dona bam laam na puli dedɛ tei to. Ba maa tiini ba chuli-ne dedaane puseŋa.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Amo nam tu se a dale nmo woro ne mo. Ta‑n cho a ŋwea se a na verem, pa se a yé di a chaveera.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: A kwei a teena a daŋe nmo baŋa ne. Nam ta‑n yere-ne, de a na yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa ye a jege chega tei to.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam n yage, se ba nwoŋi ba chanɛɛre maama wone.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, pa se a na a bora! Kokuri to, amo yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa mo a ŋwea maama wone. A ta ma ke a wo-dedoa de nmo ye bobwea tera.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, faŋe-ne n nii, se n maane a boboŋa de a bochare maama na ye tei to.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: A ba me de vwa-fɔra. A maa ba tɔge dedaane pipiri-nyena.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo sane a jea mo, se ko bere we a jege bora. A maa wó kaare nmo kaanem bimbini dem n yere zula ŋwaane

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Yé pa se a tɔge de wɛleere-keira a ga a ŋwea. Ta yé pa se a ŋwea ti, nenɛɛne ko na ke nɔn-gora tei to.

english_verse: or full of meanness or who bribe others.
translation_verse: Banto ye kampin-nyena mo ye ba je sem swoi puseŋa kikia.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Amo laam nam zege mo cheppe, tega kalo na mae daane to baŋa ne. Baŋa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ná jeeri daane, amo wó seini‑o ba tetare ne.

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balwaaro mo ná maŋe ba ba se ba ja amo, ye a dona bam ná boŋe se ba chɔge-ne, banto wó seeri mo ye ba to tega ne.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam ze ná ye kɔgɔ kɔgɔ, ye ba zaŋe se ba kwaare jara amo baŋa ne, amo bá taa kɔre foone de-ba. Amo ta wó taa jege baare mo.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Cham ná tu amo baŋa, Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho-ne o woro kom ne. O maa wó pa se a seigi o sɔŋɔ kom ne, ye o pa se a zege de dam peo baŋa ne.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam ná gilimi-ne, Wɛ wó zeiŋi a yuu mo ye a di dam ba baŋa ne. Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne mo amo wó ke kaanem a pa‑o, ye a ta wopwolo taane de kwor-dɛa. A ta wó leeni mo a maa tei‑o.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a ná lwoori‑m, popo duri amo ŋwaŋa se n sɛ a wara yam.

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Amo bochare tɛ de bere-ne se a ba nmo tei a ware‑m. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó seene a fɔɔre a twɛ nmo.

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Konto to, yé seigi n yibia amo tei ne. Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye amo zeinnu. Nam yé ve n tontoŋeno wom n bane na zaŋe to ŋwaane. Nmo na ye amo Vereno to, yé ma n kwaga n ya amo.

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: A kwo de a nu ná maŋe ba ve-ne ba yage de, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó ke-ne o ja-kukworo ne.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa tɔga. Da amo yiga se a taa vei chega chwoŋa kam ne, se a dona bam yé wane amo ba ja.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Yé sɛ se a to a dona bam jeŋa ne. Ba boŋe se ba fɔ vwa mo ba daŋe a yuu ne, ye ba kare ba lage se ba ke-ne zonne.

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó keeri a jare nmo mo, n na ye amo dalem jei to ŋwaane. Nmo nam ná maŋe da chemm, amo de balo na tega ye ba wo tega kuri ne to wó taa ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Amo na ŋwane n yiga ne to, nam leiri a keira kam. Kokuri to a zeiŋi a jea mo wɛɛne a jeeri n wara-jei selo na ye wose to.

english_verse: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Nam jwoori n ŋwe ba keim-balwaaro jene dem, pa ba na waarem delo na maŋe de-ba to.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Banto yiga tera Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe kolo maama to wone. Ba maa ve o totoŋ-laaro tem. Konto ŋwaane, o lage o yigi-ba mo o de tega ne, se ba daa yé jwoori ba zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ, a na ŋwane o yiga ne ye o leiri-ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye o nɔɔna bam zeinnu. O maa ye dalem jei o pa pɛ wolo o na tiŋi to se wonto wane o dona bam o di.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Wɛ telaao malese sem, pa-na se Baŋa Wɛ na zula, o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de o dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam bage mo naneero tem baŋa ne. Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom bage nenɛɛne do-napana tei to mo. O maa bage nane-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam bage mo ka jaane Lebanon teo Sedare teeni dem, ka mage-de ka chochoge.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: O maa pae se Lebanon tega kam ziziŋi, ne noa na wurigi tei to. Heremon peo kom de maa ziziŋa, nenɛɛne na-bala na faŋe tei to.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ná dɔne o kwora kam, doa mo pepela.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: O kwora kam maa pae se kagoa kam ziziŋa. Kadese kagoa kam yera sae mo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam didigi tei-kamunnu mo. Ka maa siiri goa wo teeni dem vɔɔro maama. Wɛ wara-jei sem ne nɔɔno maama wó ta we: “Wɛ jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo jei nane-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne o di paare. Wonto mo ye Pɛ se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo pae o nɔɔna bam dana. O maa ke zaane ba yuu ne pa ba jege yazura.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, a laam wó zeiŋi nmo yere wɛɛne, nmo na vaŋe-ne n le cham wone to ŋwaane. Nmo wo pɛ a dona bam pwola se ba taa jege-ne ba mɔna.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a lwoori zeinim nmo tei ne, ye nmo seene n pa a na yazura.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Abam balo na ke á chega dedaane Baŋa Wɛ to, ta‑á leeni-na á zuli‑o, o yere dem na ye wose to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: O bane ná zaŋe, de wó zuri lela mo. O nam ná ke zaane o ke n yuu ne, konto wó taa wora mo n ŋwea maama wone. Nmo ná keeri tete ne wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ko bá dáane. Tega ná tu ka poore, ko wó leiri ko ji wopwolo.

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo na ke zaane n ke a yuu ne to, n pɛ se a zege de dam lanyerane. Nmo laam na tu n seigi n yibia de amo to, a yiga ma nyɔne.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo keeri a jare‑m mo. Nmo na ye a Teiru Wɛ to, a ŋwane nmo yiga ne, ye a we:

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Amo ná tega ye a yera zo tega kuri ne ya pɔ, nmo wó na bɛ nyɔɔre mo? Teero tem tete wó wane te zuli‑m na? Te wó wane te tɔɔle we n yɔɔre n jege chega de nɔɔna na?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Nmo pipiri a wo-chechɔgɔ kom n pa ko leiri ko ji wopwolo pa a sae. N ma‑n pa se a lɔɔre a gare-nyenyaaro tem, se a daare a lɛ gare-nyenno wopwolo ŋwaane.

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó leeni a seini nmo de a bochare maama, ye a daa bá taa chem. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó taa ke n lei mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a tu a dale nmo woro ne. Yé pa se chaveera di-ne. Nam tɔge nmo chega kam ŋwaane n jwoŋi-ne n yage.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Tɔge n yere dem ŋwaane n bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa tɔga, nmo na ye amo dalem jei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, a kwei a jworo a ke nmo jeŋa ne mo. Jwoŋi-ne n yage, se nmo ye chega tu mo.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa chaka de wopwolo, nmo na yɔɔre n jege amo swono to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, nmo nɛ amo na yaare tei, ye n maane we ko tiini ko ni-ne.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Nmo wo kwei-ne n ke a dona bam jeŋa ne. Nmo nam le-ne cham wone, pa se a na pwola mo se a taa zege cheppe.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, duri a yibwona, cham na tiini de jege-ne to ŋwaane. A yia maama suli de yi-na wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ye a momwɛ lage de ti.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: A ŋwea daare fee se ka ti wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ye a tiini a suuri mo. Chanɛɛre mo pɛ se a yera maama bugi dedɛ, ye a kwi sem tete de chɔge.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam na daane-ne tei to mo pae se a lwoi a fara tete momwa ne. A badwonna bam de kɔre foone amo ŋwaane. Nɔɔna ná yeini ba jeeri-ne chwoŋa yuu ne, ba wó duri mo ba daare-ne.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Amo nigi nɔɔna dedɛ na jege a taane ba waasa. Ba fugi-ne jei maama ne. Ba maa bane bana ye ba ke ni daane se ba ja-ne ba go.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Amo nam ke a wo-dedoa de nmo, Baŋa Wɛ. A maa we, “A jege nmo mo se n ta‑n ye a Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Foone ya na jege-ne to mo amo tage we, “Wɛ vei yiga yiga o daare-ne!” Baŋa Wɛ nam cheigi a na ŋwane o yiga ne tei to, ye o daare o duri a yibwona.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na ye Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna to ta‑á swoi-o-na! Baŋa Wɛ cho balo na jege o chega to mo. Ko nam ná ye balo na bere ba tete kamunim to, o yɔɔre o vaŋe ba zwa mo.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ ba jege bora to, Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne, ba bochara na jege chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Amo déem na pugi a ni de a wɛleera yam to, a yera bugi ye a bwona mo. Dɛ maama wone a yɔɔre a suuri mo.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n yɔɔre n waare-ne wea de tete maama, pa se a dam dem nwoŋi de daare-ne. Ko nye de wea na dana ye ka zo a yera tei to mo.

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ga ko ŋwa ye a ta a wɛleera yam a bere‑m. A daa maa wo kwaane se a seigi-ya. A sɛ se a chuli a keim-lwanno tem, ye a ta te taane jaja a bere nmo Baŋa Wɛ. Nmo de ma‑n yage a wɛleera yam n chɛ-ne, pa se ya daa tera a yuu ne.

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Konto to, pwola ta ná wora, balo na tɔge nmo chwoŋa kam to jege se ba lwoori‑m, se cham ná yi-ba nenɛɛne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri tei to, se ba yé tɔge de-ko ba jei.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Nmo mo ye amo dalem jei, se cham yé yi-ne. Nɔɔna gilimi-ne ye ba tei nmo yere, n na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: Amo wó bere‑m chwoŋa kalo nmo na wó ta‑n tɔge to, ye a taa nii n baŋa ne se n yé to tega ne.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á toŋe-na jworim, nenɛɛne sisein-nɔɔna na ke tei to. Ba ná wo kwei gara ba ke se nia ne, se bá sɛ se taa ke se tɔge nɔɔna na lage tei to.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Yaara dedɛ mo yeini ya tui puseŋ-nyena baŋa ne. Ko daare balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Baŋa Wɛ to, Wɛ swono kolo na ba leiri to mo kwoli banto.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Abam balo na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to, leeni-na de wopwolo á tei Baŋa Wɛ! Ko maŋe se chega tɔgena bam mo zuli‑o.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Kwei-na kwanno á ta á ma á tei o yere. Ta-na kwanno dwi dwi á ma á kwɛɛre o yiga ne.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: O lage se keim-laaro de chega mo taa zega, ye o swono kom jage ko yi logo baŋa jei maama.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, o na puri o ni to mo logo kom bobo ko wora. O ni dem ŋwaane mo ko ke konto.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Se ko daare Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa yam wó taa zege mo taa wuu. Wonto boboŋa yam ba gɔe maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: O maa jei o paare jeiŋa jei ne mo o yere logo kom nɔn-bia bam maama.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Wonto mo mɔɔne nabiina maama de ba bochara. O yei ba keina yam maama na ye tei to.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Pɛ ná maŋe o jege jar-keira dedɛ, banto bá wane ba jwoŋi‑o ba yage. Babea de o dam dem maama ware o tete se o jwoŋi.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Wonto ŋwaane mo dé jege wopwolo, kokuri dé ke dé wo-dedoa mo de o yere-kamunu kom.

english_verse: Be kind and bless us! We depend on you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nam pa se n swono kom pu debam, se debam teena wo nmo tei ne mo.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: Amo wó zeiŋi o yere o keina maama ŋwaane, se balo maama vɔna na pare to ni ye ba daare ba na wopwolo.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé ke daane dé pa Baŋa Wɛ jwoŋi zula, ye dé zeiŋi o yere dem wɛɛne.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Balo na kwoni ba nii Wɛ se o zeini-ba to mo jege wopwolo. Ba daa bá na ba chaveera.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: A na maŋe a ye nɔn-kayaa to, a ta lwoori Wɛ, ye o sɛ o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom. O ma jwoŋi-ne o yage a cham maama wone.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam mo cho balo na kɔre‑o to, se cham yé wane-ba de ja.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Nam maane-na Baŋa Wɛ á nii, se á wó lɔre we o lana. Balo maama na tu ba seigi o woro kom wone to jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Ta‑á kɔre-o-na, abam balo Baŋa Wɛ na kuri o pa o tete to. Kolokolo gɛɛre bá fɔge ko ja balo na sɛ o ni to.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Ko ná maŋe ko ye nywonnu, kana wó ja-te maŋa de maŋa. Balo nam na kwaane se ba lɔre Baŋa Wɛ to bá fɔge ba ga wo-laaro.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Abam wolo maama ná lage se o na ŋwea ywoni, se o daare o na momwɛ-dɛɛre de wopwolo,

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: kotu jege se o ja o tete mo de ta-balwaaro ŋɔŋa de vwa fɔm.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: O nam yage totoŋ-lwanno keim se o daare o taa tɔge keim-laaro, ye o kwaane se o taa zoore de bochare-zuru.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nɔn-ŋona, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o nii ba baŋa ne, ye ba keira de zo o zwa.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye balo na swoi lwarem totoŋa to, Wɛ yeini o pipiri o kwaga mo o ya-ba, pa se ba daa ba jege yere logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Chega tɔgena bam yeini ba lwoori zeinim Baŋa Wɛ tei ne, ye o sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom. O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage ba cham maama wone.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa woli balo vɔna na pare to, ye o jwoŋi balo wo na pɛ to o yaga.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Chega tɔgena bam wae ba nae cham dwi dwi. Baŋa Wɛ nam wó le-ba o ja o nwoŋi ya maama wone.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó che-ba pa se ba kua dedoa tete bá bwori kɔtaa.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam tete totoŋ-balwaaro tem mo wó jwoori te go-ba. Wɛ wó waare balo na chuli chega tɔgena bam to.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o jwoŋi balo na zuli‑o to mo o yaga. Balo maama na seigi ba tete o woro kom wone to bá to de ba bora.

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Kwei n chichwei dem de n dwooru wom n zeili balo na pare-ne se ba ja to. Fɔge n ta de amo we, nmo mo ye amo vereno.

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Pa se balo na kwaane se ba go amo to na ba chaveera. Ba na boŋe se ba ke lwarem amo baŋa ne to, nam pa se ba boboŋa vugimi se ba laam pipiri ba jwoori kwaga.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Pa se Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam zeili-ba se ba duri ba jage da yiga ne, nenɛɛne vio na kale swanno ko ja jei tei to.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Sɛ se lim kwoli ba chwoŋa kam se ka daare ka taa seera, se Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam laam pɛ ba kwaga ka pu.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ba tiŋi kalanchogo se ba ja-ne, de a na wo ke kolokolo a chɔge ba yiga to de. Ba ma daare ba ko gwoŋo se a to ko wone a te.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Pa se lɛɛro pɔpɔ te to ba baŋa ne. Pa se kalanchogo kolo ba na tiŋi amo ŋwaane to jwoori ko ja banto tete. Ta pa se ba to gwoŋo kolo ba na koge to wone, se ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem!

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó taa chaka de wopwolo, Baŋa Wɛ na jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó ta de a dam maama we, “Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera! N yeini n vere nabwona balo dam na dwoi-ba to jeŋa ne n yaga. Nmo ta jwoŋi yiniga tiina balo na pini-ba to jeŋa ne n yaga.”

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Banto déem na weele to, amo mo zo gare-nyenyaaro. A ta ma bere a vɔ ni. A gwooni a tete mo ye a lwoori Wɛ.

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: A ma tiini a nyɔne a yiga, nenɛɛne a wora a keeri a choro, naa a badwoŋi, naa a nu lua dwoŋi mo to. Amo yɔɔre a tu a tete mo ba ŋwaane.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo wó ta‑n zege chemm n nii se ko vo ko maŋe yei ne mo? Jwoŋi-ne ba jeŋa ne n yage, de ba na kwaane se ba chɔge-ne nenɛɛne nywonnu mo jaane-ne se te go to.

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó ke nmo lei nmo nɔɔna bam na jeeri mɛ to ne. Amo wó zege n nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne a tei‑m.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Yé pa se a dona bam taa chaka amo chanɛɛre dem ŋwaane. Ba chuli-ne kafɛ ŋwaane mo. Yé sɛ se ba taa jege-ne ba mɔna.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Banto ba fɔge ba ŋɔɔne yazura taane. Ba nam fɔ vwa mo se ba chɔge balo na beeri zurim to yiga.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Ba maa kaŋe ba nia kayɔ-yɔlɔ ye ba tɛ amo taane ba we, “Yaa! Dé yia mo nɛ nmo na ke n chɔge tei to!”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam nɛ ko maama. Yé maŋe da chemm. Amo Tu, yé ta‑n wo yiga yiga se n yage a yera.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Ba na jege wopwolo a lɛɛro tem ŋwaane to, pa se ba yɔɔre ba di ba chaveera. Ko ná ye balo na bere ba tete amo baŋa ne to, sɛ se ba yuu yaale ye chaveera di-ba.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na zege a kwaga ne se a di bora to, pa se ba taa chaka de wopwolo, se ba daare ba taa tɛ maŋa maama we, “Baŋa Wɛ dam dem daga dedɛ! O lage se o tontoŋeno wom taa jege yazura mo.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Amo laam wó taa tɔɔle nmo chega kam taane mo. Dɛ dem maama wone, amo wó taa tei‑m mo ga wuu.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Wɛleere boboŋa yerane mo su puseŋ-nyena bochare. Ba maa bere ba ba kɔre Wɛ de fenfee de.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ba na nii ba nae ba tete kamunim tei to mo pae se ba daa ba maana ba tusim kikia se ba daare ba chuli-ya.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Ba ni taane su de ta-balwaaro dedaane vwa yerane mo. Boboŋa daa tera ba yuu ne se ba taa toŋe lanyerane de swa.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Tete ne ba maa tigi ba sare ne ba jeeli puseŋa kikia. Ba boboŋa ma ja se ba tɔge chwoŋa kalo na ba lana to. Ba maa ware se ba ve lwarem keim.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo swono kom wora mo taa, ye ko geene ko di wɛyuu. Nmo na yɔɔre n zege n chega wone tei to mo tiini ko yala ko gaale kunkwonnu tem.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Nmo nɔn-ŋonne dem maa zege cheppe nenɛɛne pe-kamunnu tem na zege tei to. Nmo na yeini n di chega bora tei to de maa luuna ne naneo kom kuri na luuna tei to. Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nii nabiina de vara maama baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Nmo pa-ba wodi-laaro se ba taa di ba sui, wodiiru na neene nmo sɔŋɔ kom wone to ŋwaane. Nmo ta pa ba nyɔ nmo bwi sem wo na mo se ba taa jege wopwolo de yazura.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo ye buli-yi delo na pae ŋwea to. Nmo pwooni dem maa pae se dé jege pwooni dé vei de yiga ne.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pa se n swono kom taa wora balo yiga na wo nmo wone to taa. Ta zege nmo chega kam wone n pa balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to.

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Yé pa pwola se bere-n-tete nyena nɔ amo baŋa ne. Yé pa puseŋ-nyena chwoŋa se ba zeili-ne se a yage a tega kam.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nii-na puseŋ-nyena bam na to ba tigi tei! Ba daa bá wane ba zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Yé pa se n boboŋa vugimi puseŋ-nyena ŋwaane. Nam yé ta‑n jege wo-goo de nɔn-balwaaro tem konto.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Beeri wopwolo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne, se o wó ke kolo maama n boboŋa na lage to o pa‑m.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Ja n wo se n ta‑n cheigi Baŋa Wɛ na wó toŋe tei. Pa n teena taa wo wonto wone. Ko ná ye balo na nɛ yiga-veiŋa de ba keim-balwaaro to, yé ta‑n pae se n boboŋa vugimi ba ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
translation_verse: Ja n tete ban-zɔŋɔ wone. Nam yé ta‑n fufuga. Konto fɔge ko chɔge wonnu mo.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei we puseŋ-nyena lage ba jei mo. Balo nam na ke ba teena dedaane Baŋa Wɛ to wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Ko bá daane se puseŋ-nyena jei. Nmo ná maŋe n beeri-ba tetei maama, n bá‑n na-ba.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam yeini ba bane mo se ba chɔge nɔn-laaro. Ba ma nyɔne ba yibia de-ba.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Wɛ nam jege puseŋ-nyena bam o mɔne mo. O yei we banto chɔgem dɛ lage de yi.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam yeini ba le ba se-zɔɔro mo, ye ba daare ba saŋe ba taŋa chena, se ba kwaane ba go nabwona de zora dedaane balo maama na tɔge chega chwoŋa to.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ba tete se-zɔɔro tem mo nam lage te jwoori te go-ba. Ba tɛ sem de maa wó bwori.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Chega tɔgeno ná maŋe o jege fenfee yerane o jeŋa ne, konto gare jejegero tem maama puseŋ-nyena bam na nɛ to.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, dam delo puseŋ-nyena bam na jege to wó jage de jei mo. Ko daare Baŋa Wɛ yiga wo nɔn-ŋona wone ye o cho-ba.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone Baŋa Wɛ nii balo na tɔge chwo-laao chekke to baŋa ne. Ba wó taa tei tega kam se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Cham maŋa ná yia, ko bá ni banto. Kana maŋa ne de, ba ta wó na ba ni-wodiu ba daare ba zege.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam nam lage ba te mo. Baŋa Wɛ dona maama wó jage ba jei mo, nenɛɛne nyoa na yeini ka jei tei to.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena ná jene woŋo nɔɔno tei ne, ba daa ba sɛ se ba ŋwe-ko ba pa kotu. Nɔn-laaro nam yeini ba kwei wonnu mo ba pae nɔɔna zɛɛra.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo totoŋa na su Baŋa Wɛ yi to, o yeini o bere-ba chwoŋa mo se ba taa vei yiga.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Ba ná maŋe ba mage ba nɛ tetei maama de, ba ta bá to tega ne, kokuri to Baŋa Wɛ mo jege ba je sem.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Amo kwe lanyerane. Ko nam na zege a biini ne se ko yi zem to, amo ta wo nɛ nɔn-ŋona na vei je-kora. Ba bia de nam ba nwoŋi de zon-kwaga se ba lwoori ba di.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Yage totoŋ-lwanno keim se n daare n ta‑n tɔge keim-laaro! Konto mo wó pa se nmo ta‑n zoore tega kam ne taa wuu.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Chega tɔgena bam mo wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei. Ba maa wó taa zoore da mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Swa taane yerane mo nwoŋi nɔn-laaro ni ne, ye banto ŋɔŋa mo jege chega.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Wɛ taane bera yam mo su ba bochara maama, ye ba bá seeri ba to Wɛ chwoŋa wone.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam dale mo ba beeri laŋa se ba go nɔn-laaro.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam zege nɔn-laaro tem kwaga ne. Ba ná maŋe ba zo taane wone, Wɛ wó le-ba ba dona jeŋa ne se ba yé to ba bora wone.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Amo yi nɛ puseŋ-nyeno na bɛɛse o dwonna tei to. O maa bere o tete ne tei-zɔŋɔ na zege de dam tei to.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Fɔge n ta‑n nii balo keim na lamma ye ba jege chega to. Balo na zoore de bochare-zuru to jwa wó na ba dwi dem.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Balo nam na chɔge Wɛ nia yam to wó jei mo. Puseŋ-nyena bam de jwa bá taa jege ba dwi dem.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o vere chega tɔgena mo o yaga. Cham maŋa ná yia, wonto mo ye ba dalem jei

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: Wɛ yeini o zeini-ba mo, o daare o jwoŋi-ba o yaga puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne, ba na tu ba seigi o woro kom wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yé tɔge n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne n bwɛ-ne. Ta yé da n ban-lom dem ŋwaane n waare-ne.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Nmo che-tɛɛra yam yɔɔre ya zɔ-ne mo. Nmo jaguli-zane dem de ma mage-ne, pa se a yera yam tiini ya chɛ.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Amo yera yam maama wɔe mo, n bane na zaŋe amo baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Amo kwi sem tete ba jege yazura, de a wɛleera yam na daane-ne tei to.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Amo fufwollu tem tiini te lwoi ye a yera moora, a na toŋe jworim de a wɛleera yam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Amo maama gwoori mo ye a yera yam de wiira. Wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo ye amo nyem.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Paa mo tiini ka jege-ne pa se a teiŋa maama ba sɛa. A yera yam maama maa wɔe.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, nmo maŋe n yei a boboŋa na lage kolo to maama. A na tiini a sisigi tei to kolokolo wo seigi nmo yiga ne.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: A bochare zage mo ye a dam dem de wora de tia. A yia maa beiri.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: A badwonna de a fara bam laam lɔŋe-ne mo a jawe-chɛɔ kom ŋwaane. A diga tiina de ba sɛ se ba yi amo yera.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Balo na beeri se ba go-ne to tiŋi kalanchorro mo se te ja-ne. Balo na kwaane se ba ke-ne zonne to de ŋɔɔne daane se ba chɔge-ne. Dɛ maama wone ba maa bane amo bana.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Amo jigi ne a ye zɔ-kɔgɔ mo. A bá sɛ se a mage ni-kantɔgɔ de-ba.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: A ma bere a wɛleera jaja Wɛ yiga ne, ye a chuli-ya.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, yé yage a yera! Amo Tu Wɛ, yé ta‑n wo yiga yiga de amo.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Nam ke lela n ba n zeini-ne. Nmo mo ye amo Vereno.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Amo tage de a tete mo we, “Amo wó taa cho a tete mo se a yé ke wɛleera de a ni taane. A maa wó kwei gara a ke a ni ne, ne puseŋ-nyena ná wo a tei ne.”

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
