translation_verse: Lwia ma tiini ya jege-ne dedɛ. Boboŋ-fara na daane-ne tei to nye de mini mo zwɛ a wo kom. A laam ma ga ga a ta we:

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Nabiina ná tɔge chwei selo maama, ba nye de lunlunnu yerane mo. Ba na yaare totoŋa baŋa ne tei to ba jege nyɔɔre. Ba maa yeini ba lae jejegero dedɛ ba tiŋa, ye ba yeiri wolo na wó di-te ba toone kwaga ne to.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, amo daa jei a cheiga bɛ mo? A nam daŋe a teena nmo baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: Ja, jwoŋi-ne n ja n nwoŋi a tusim dem wone. Ta yé sɛ se jworru tete taa jege-ne te gwoona.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: A ni dem jege se de meeri, se a daa yé puri-de, nmo mo na waare-ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Nmo yeini n jege nɔɔna n koresa se n pa ba yage ba tusim kikia. N ma‑n yeini n chɔge ba fera na zo kolo maama to, ne tóa na mu wonnu tei to. Chega to, nabiina maama momwɛ ye vio yerane mo.

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom! Pore n zwa se n sɛ amo keira kam. Amo na keeri a jare nmo to, yé maŋe da chemm. A na zoore logo baŋa ne to, a ye veiru mo na tu nmo sɔŋɔ kom, ne a nabaara bam maama de déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Nam daa‑n yé nii-ne de ban-zɔŋɔ, se a wane a jwoori a di ywoni, ye a laam daare a te a kɛ.

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Amo peene mo a cheiga Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. O de ma pipiri o nii amo seeni se o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: O pɛ a lɛɛro tem ti mo, ne o na vaŋe-ne o le gwoŋo kolo na su de bworu yerane wone to. O ma daare o ja a nɛ sem o vo o zege peo baŋa ne, se a wane a zege de dam.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: O ma bere-ne leiŋ-doŋa, se a leeni a seini dé Tu Wɛ wom. Nɔɔna dedɛ wó na Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe tei maama to pa se ba taa kɔre‑o, ye ba daare ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Baŋa Wɛ to, Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne lanyerane. Banto wo kwei ba chega ba pa jwona. Ba maa wo gwaane de balo na kaane-ya to.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo tiini n toŋe wo-kenkagela dedɛ n pa debam. N ma‑n tɔge n boboŋa ŋwaane n ke wo-kamunnu n woli debam, te ni na tiini te gaale jeelim to. Amo kwaane se a ta te maama taane a bere nɔɔna ye a ga. Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dwoŋi tera!

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Nmo yiga tera de nabiina na yeini ba kwei vara de wodiiru ba ma ke kaanem ba pa‑m tei to, ne ko ná ye vara zwɛɛm kaanem naa wɛleera saarem kaanem de. Nmo nam pore a zwa se a ni ko kuri chekke.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Mo kokuri amo laam maa tɛ a we, “Amo Tu Wɛ, nii-ne da! A tua! Ko ke ne ko na maŋe ko popone amo ŋwaane nmo faŋa faŋa tɔnɔ kom wone tei to mo.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Amo nɛ cham dedɛ ye de gilimi-ne de ke tetare ne. De daga de dwoi se a lɔre de na mae tei to. Amo wɛleera mo tu amo baŋa ya ja-ne. Amo yia daa ba nae ye a tusi chwoŋa. A wɛleera daga ya dwoi a yu-ywei sem. Konto laam maa pa se a tiini a bwona.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, popo se n ba n jwoŋi-ne n yage! Ke lela n ba n zeini-ne.

english_verse: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na beeri amo toone to, pa se vuvuga yi-ba se ba to tega ne. Pa balo maama na beeri amo chɔgem to jwoori kwaga de ba chaveera yam.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Sɛ se chaveera di banto dwi dem maama, ba na tɛ ba we, ba jeŋa zo amo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ko daare balo maama na beeri nmo jei to, pa se ba taa jege wopwolo, se ba di ywoni nmo ŋwaane. Ta pa se balo na swoi se n ta‑n jwoŋi-ba to taa tɛ maŋa maama we, “Dé wó zeiŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere dem wɛɛne.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, a ye nabwom mo, ye yiniga jege-ne. A Teiru Wɛ yiga daa ta wo amo wone. Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye a zeinnu de a vereno. Yé dáane se n laam ba n woli-ne!

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo yiga na wo nabwona wone to mo, Wɛ zaane wo o yuu ne lanyerane. Cham ná yi kotu, Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi‑o o yage.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Konto tu ná weela, Baŋa Wɛ wó teibi‑o mo pa se o jaweo kom jei ye o jwoori o na yazura.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Amo mo tage a we, “Baŋa Wɛ, duri amo yibwona! A tusi mo a chɔge n yiga. Nam ta pa se a jwoori a na yazura.”

english_verse: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
translation_verse: Ba wone dedoa ná tu amo tei, o yeini o ŋɔɔne ta-yɔɔro yerane mo. O maa kare o beeri sawe-taane se o ja o nwoŋi o jage jei maama ne.

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: ye ba we, “Ko ye jawe-chɛɔ mo yɔɔre ko jege‑o. O nam bá fɔge o zaŋe o na yazura.”

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: A yei we nmo wo pwoli de amo, kokuri to, n wo pɛ a dona bam chwoŋa se ba wane amo ba di.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Nmo wó ta‑n zeini-ne, a na yɔɔre a tɔge chega to ŋwaane. N ta wó pa se a taa zege n yiga ne taa wuu.

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo fera tiini ya zo amo, nenɛɛne na-nyɔm na jege feira ye ka beeri na-zura se ka nyɔ tei to.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo tiini a lage‑m ne na-nyɔm na jege-ne tei to. Maŋa kɔ mo amo wó na chwoŋa se a ba nmo tei a zege nmo yiga ne a zuli‑m?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Wea de tete maama a yeini a keeri dedɛ a kane yi-na, ye yi-na banto yerane mo ye a ni-wodiu. Balo na chuli amo to tɛ ba we, “N Wɛ wom nam bɛ?”

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Chega to, amo wo tiini ko chɔge. Amo nam wó guli nmo gula de n lanyerane dem na ye tei to. A maa wo ywo-seeni, Heremon dedaane Mizari peero tem laŋa ne mɛ Jɔdan buga kam na buli da to.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone Baŋa Wɛ pae a lɔre we o swono kom mo wo amo tei ne. Tete maama ne o pa se a leeni leiŋa mo a maa ware‑o, o na ye wolo na tei a ŋwea kam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Banto maa jege-ne ba twea ye ba mɔna pa se a yera chɛ ye a lage a te. Ba maa tɛ ba we, “Nmo Wɛ wom bɛ?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Amo bwei a tete wone a we, “Bɛ mo pɛ se a yiga nyɔne? Bɛ mo ye a wo tiini ko chɔge?” A nam wó pa se a teena taa wo Wɛ tei ne mo! A daa ta wó taa tei‑o, wonto na ye amo Wɛ ye o jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nam bere we amo jege chega nɔɔna yiga ne! Jwoŋi a taane dem n ŋɔɔne dedaane balo na yeiri nmo to. Vaŋe-ne n le puseŋ-nyena banto na ye vwa-nyena to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Nmo ye wolo a na seigi a tete n woro kom wone to mo. Bɛ mo ye n ma n kwaga n ya-ne? Amo dona bam ta wó taa bɛɛse-ne pa se a taa keeri konto taa mo na?

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: A ná yi da, a laam wó vo a yi Wɛ bimbini dem teiŋa. Amo wó fɔɔre a yi nmo tei, nmo wolo na pae a wo pwoli to. Amo Tu Wɛ, a laam wó ta kɔnɔ a ma a tei‑m.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Amo bwei a tete wone a we, “Bɛ mo pɛ se a yiga nyɔne? Bɛ mo ye a wo tiini ko chɔge?” A nam wó pa se a teena taa wo Wɛ tei ne mo! A daa ta wó taa tei‑o, wonto na ye amo Wɛ ye o jwoŋi-ne o yage to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Nmo tete mo zeili dwi-gɛ tiina bam ye n daare n kwei dé nabaara bam n jeini ba tega kam baŋa ne. Nmo yɔɔre n chɔge dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo, ye n pa se n tete nɔɔna bam zoore da de yazura.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Ba déem na wane tega kam maama ba tei to, ko dae ba jara-keim zela dam ŋwaane mo naa ba tete dam ŋwaane. Ko nam ye nmo dam-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane. Nmo lanyerane dem ma kwoli-ba, n yi na page ba baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nmo mo ye amo Pɛ, ye n ta ye a Wɛ wom. Nam pa se n nɔɔna Jakob dwi tiina bam di wɔnɔ!

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Dé wó da nmo dam dem ŋwaane dé yigi dé dona bam se ba jwoori kwaga. Dé laam maa wó nɔne-ba dé se tega ne.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Amo bá kwei a teena a daŋe a taŋa naa a se-zɔɔ baŋa ne. Tento bá wane-ne te jwoŋi te yage.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye nmo mo jwoŋi debam n yage dé dona bam jeŋa ne. Nmo ta pae se balo maama na chuli debam to nae ba lɛɛro mo.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone dé yeini dé jege teera Wɛ ŋwaane. Dé wó taa tei o yere mo taa wuu.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n pa se dé duri dé dona bam yiga ne, pa ba de ba ba vere dé jejegero.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n kwei n tete nɔɔna bam mo n yeigi zɛɛra n pa ba dona bam. N wo pɛ se ba jege yuu ba pa‑m.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina balo na gilimi debam to jege debam mo ba mɔna, ye ba ta yaale debam.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem maama wone chaveera mo di-ne. A maa nae a lɛɛro ga wuu.

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, dé dona bam yɔɔre ba twe debam mo, ye ba jege debam ba gwoona.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Dé wo lɔge nmo kwaga ne. Dé maa wo ywori nmo chwoŋa kam wone.

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: Nmo nam yɔɔre n chochoge debam mo, pa se nywoŋ-kuri gilimi debam se se di. Nmo ta pɛ se lim mo ba de kwoli debam.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Debam nam ya ná nwoŋi dé Wɛ wom kwaga ne, ye dé daare dé pipiri dé zuli wa-gaa,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: Wɛ tete ya bá lɔre ko ni ne na? Kokuri o maŋe o yei dé boboŋa wo-siseigiru tem maama.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Dé na ye o nɔɔna to mo pae dé da toone tei dé kɛ dɛ maama wone. Ba kwei debam ba ma ji pei selo ba na lage ba go to mo.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne! N ta dɔ mo na? Zaŋe n ba n zeini debam! Yé ma n kwaga n ya debam taa wuu.

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye n ke n yiga dáa dáa? Bɛŋwaane mo n yiga tere dé cham de dé yaara yam wone?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Debam yɔɔre dé to tega ne mo buri-buri. Dé yera yam maama taare de kasolo mo.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Konto to, zaŋe wɛɛne n ba n zeini debam! Jwoŋi debam n yage, nmo na yɔɔre n jege debam swono to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: A boboŋa yam maama su de wo-laaro mo se a ma a pane leiŋa a seini pɛ wom. A wó ma a kwora mo a leeni pore-pore, nenɛɛne tɔn-poponno na wó popone tei to.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Nmo tiini n lamma n dwoi nɔɔna maama. N ni taane ye ywoni yerane mo. Wɛ ke zaane mo n yuu ne se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Diini sisein-nɔɔno n nwoŋi pwooni n bere n paare dem se n daare n di wɔnɔ. Ke kokeiri n pa se chega tɔgem, de yibwona, de chega bora borem taa wora. Konto to nmo jazem dem wó toŋe wo-kamunnu dedɛ.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: Pɛ, n che-tɛɛra yam sele mo, se n ta-ya n zɔ n dona ba bochara ne. Dwi-gɛ tiina bam de maa wó to n yiga ne.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, n paare dem wó taa wora taa se ko taa vei wuu. Nmo wó ta‑n tei n nɔɔna se ko tɔge chwoŋa chekke.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n swoi chega tɔgem, ye n daare n chuli lwarem kikia. Konto ŋwaane mo, n Tu Wɛ wom kuri nmo, ye o lwo o swolim nuga kam n yuu ne se n di ywoni n dwoni n dwonna bam maama.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Talwoŋ-ywoŋa dwi dwi lwom mo taare n gwaaro tem maama. Nmo zoore pɛ sɔŋɔ kolo ba na mɛ tuu yeila ba kwɛ to wone, ye dáane mo ba yeini ba tae kwanno se ko pwoli nmo wo.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Kaana balo na wo n tei ne to badwonna ye pwa bukwa mo. Kaane wolo n na lage n di to maa wo n jazem seeni ye o yera kwɛ de sabu-seŋa kalo na nwoŋi Ofiri to.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: A bukɔ, pore n zwa se n cheigi a taane dem. Ta‑n yei se n yage n tete dwi tiina bam de n kwo sɔŋɔ tiina bam chwei sem.

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom yi mo su nmo lam dem. Wonto laam nam mo ye n teiru. Konto ŋwaane tu n tete se n sɛ o ni.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tura tiina wó ja pɛɛra ba ba nmo tei. Naduna de maa wó taa lage se n ke-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Ka-pɛ wom laam wo o diga wone mo, ye o tiini o jege lam dedɛ! O ma zo gɔrɔ kolo ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa ba bɛɛre ko maama to.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja‑o ba vo pɛ wom tei, ye o zo o gwaaro telo ba na gɔgere lanyerane to. O ka-nyaana bam de maa kwogili‑o ba via.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Konto dwoŋi mo ba vei ba zo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wone ye ba tiini ba jege wopwolo dedɛ.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Pɛ, nmo bia bam de wó ji pwa mo, nenɛɛne n kwoa bam de déem na ye tei to. N ma‑n wó pa ba taa tei teene dedɛ tega kam maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Dwi ná kɛ ye dedwoŋi saŋe, amo ta wó zeiŋi n yere dem wɛɛne taa wuu. Logo baŋa dwi tiina bam wó taa tei‑m se ko taa vei wuu mo.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane dé bá taa kɔre foone, tega kam ná maŋe ka tiini ka ziziŋi tei de, ye peero tem ta baga te toe buri-buri naneo kom wone de.

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Nabara kadwoŋi nam wora ka na jaane wopwolo ka tui Wɛ tete teo kom wone, mɛ Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom na wora to.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Wɛ tete mo zoore teo kom konto wone. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane-ko o chɔge. Tega na jege ka poore to, Wɛ wó ba o woli-ko de dam.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa teene dem vuvugi mo kafɛ ŋwaane. Paare jei maama maa to buru-tu-tu! Wɛ ma bage kwora pa se tega baŋa maama nyeene.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wo debam tei ne. Jakob Wɛ wom maa ye dé dalem jei.

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Ba-na á nii Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe wo-kamunnu telo logo baŋa ne ye te tiini te jege foone to.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: O maa pa se tigura kweeli mo logo baŋa jei maama ne. O ma kwei jar-keira tɛ sem dedaane ba chichwoa yam o bwori. O ma daare o vere ba jara-keim nantane sem o zwɛ de mini. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “Ta‑á ye-na konto chemm, se á maane we amo mo ye Wɛ! Amo mo tei logo baŋa teene dem maama, se de nɔn-bia bam taa zuli-ne.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wo debam tei ne. Jakob Wɛ wom maa ye dé dalem jei.

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Nabiin-dwi maama, ba-na á mage japwoora, á daare á bage tia á zuli Wɛ de wopwolo!

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tiini o maŋe se nabiina taa kɔre‑o. O maa ye Pa-faro wolo na tei logo baŋa maama to.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, logo baŋa maama Pɛ wom mo ye Wɛ. Leeni-na tia lei á zuli‑o.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Logo baŋa pwa de dedɛɛra maama jeeri daane mo. Ba maa woli debam wone, se dé maama zuli Abaraham Wɛ wom. Wɛ jege dam o dwoi pwa maama. O maŋe de zula jei maama ne.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege kamunim! O yɔɔre o maŋe mo se nɔɔna taa tei‑o o tete teo kom wone. Peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to baŋa ne mo konto.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo pɛ se ko ji dalem jei se nɔɔna taa tui ba seigi o woro kom wone.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Dé ya maŋe dé ni Wɛ totoŋa yam ŋwa, se leile konto dé tete yia laam mo nɛ-ya. Dé wo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tete teo kom ne. Debam Tu Wɛ wom teo kom mo konto. Wɛ wó pa ko zegem taa dana se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, dé tu dé zege nmo wara-jei sem ne, ye dé boŋe n swono chekke kom boboŋa.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri Zion tiina bam wo pwoli dedɛ. Judah teene dem de maa jege wopwolo, nmo na bore chega bora to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, cheigi-na! Abam balo maama na zoore tega baŋa ne to pore-na á zwa!

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Amo ni taane wó bere swa lanyerane. A boboŋ-lilirru tem de wó pa se nɔɔna yi poore.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Amo wó kwaane a zamese dende. A ta wó daare a ta kɔnɔ ye a leeni a maŋe se kuri a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Lɛɛro ná to a baŋa ne, a nam bá taa kɔre foone, nenɛɛne kampin-nyena ná gilimi-ne ba ke tetare ne.

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Banto ke ba chega dedaane ba jejegero mo, ye ba jege teera de ba na ye naduna to.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Nabiinu ŋwea tiini ka jege kuri. N bá‑n wane n ŋwe se ko yi ka kwora ko ti.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Nmo wó maane we nɔɔna maama toa, ko ná maŋe ko ye yi-pore-nyena, de nɔn-jworru, de nayeiri-nyena de. Ba maama wó te ye ba daare ba jejegero ba yage ba pa nɔɔna badwonna mo.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Tento mo jworru telo na boŋe ba tete kamunni to wó guri, ko ta woli de balo maama na tɔge banto chwei sem to.

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Banto maama lage ba te mo, ne pei tei to. Toone wó ja-ba de kale de ja vo churu. Tega ná poore, nɔn-ŋona wó di dam ba baŋa ne. Ba yera maa wó pɔ tega kuri ne. Ba daa bá taa jege ba tete sam se ba taa zoore de wone.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo wó vere amo toone jeŋa ne. O wó vaŋe-ne se a taa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná yɔɔre o ji nadum pa se o di paare o sɔŋɔ ne, yé pa se ko taa daane‑m.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Kokuri, kotu ná tega, o bá wane o ja kolokolo o woli da o kɛ. O jejegero tem bá tɔge‑o te zo tega kuri.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Kotu ta ná ŋwe, o wó boŋe we Wɛ yɔɔre o swɛ o swolim, nɔɔna na zuli‑o o yiga-veiŋa ŋwaane to.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: De konto maama, o de lage o te mo o vo o woli o nabaara bam wone. Dáane mo o daa bá fɔge o na wea pwooni dɛ de de dɛ.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: O ma bwoŋi wɛyuu de tega baŋa se te ba te nii, se o laam di o nɔɔna bam taane.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom tete tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam taane. Wɛ mo lage o bore nabiina bora! Wɛ tage o we:

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “Amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam, cheigi-na! A lage a ŋɔɔne a bere we á ke á tusi mo. Amo nam mo ye Wɛ chekke. A maa ye abam Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, kagoa wo vara bam maama ye amo nyem mo. Amo mo tei naane delo maama na wo zwonnu moro yuu ne to.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Zuna balo maama na jaane wɛɛne to mo amo nii ba baŋa ne. Amo daa ta mo tei ga-vara maama de.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: Nenɛɛne kana mo ya ná jege-ne, a ya bá ta a bere abam, logo baŋa de ko wo wonnu tem maama na ye amo nyem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nabɛ, amo mo di se nɔna na? Amo wó nyɔ bo-bwaalo jana na?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Nam pa-na se pɛɛre delo á na wó kwei á kaane á pa-ne to taa ye lei-keim. Tɔge-na ni delo á na pwooli de amo to, amo na ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Cham ná yi abam, lwoori-na wolim amo tei ne, se a laam wó jwoŋi abam a yage. Konto to, á wó zuli-ne ne ko na maŋe se á ke tei to.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Wɛ ma ta de puseŋ-nyena bam o we: “Abam ba jege chwoŋa se á tɔge á ŋɔɔne amo nia yam taane. Bɛ mo ye á bere we á sɛ amo ni-gwonim dem?

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Abam ná nɛ ŋweeno, o kikia mo su á yi. Á maa me de balo na tɔge kabwoŋa kikia to.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Á sɛ se á ni taane taa pae lwarem mo pula. Á kare á ŋɔɔne vwa yerane mo.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Abam na toŋe keim-balwaaro tento maama to, a chem mo. Abam ga boŋe we amo de abam maama ye bedwe mo. Amo laam nam wó zaŋe a bwɛ abam, se á lɔre jaja we á tusi mo.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná ke lei-keim pɛɛre o pa-ne, kotu zuli-ne chekke mo. Ko ná ye balo maama na seene ba yia ba tɔge chwoŋa to, amo Wɛ wó pa ba na amo verem dem.”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, da n swono kom ŋwaane se n duri amo yibwona. A lwoori‑m se n saare amo wɛleera n yage, nmo na tiini n jege nabiina ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Zare-ne se a daa yé taa jege totoŋ-lwanno, se n daare n kwɛ-ne se a nwoŋi tusim wone.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo yei a wɛleera yam ni ne. Wea de tete maama wone, a ware a swei a tusim dem.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Amo na ke a chɔge to, ko ye nmo yerane yiga ne mo. A ke lwarem dedɛ a chɔge nmo ni dem. Nmo jege chega de nmo na bwei amo tei to. Nmo na pɛ a to de a bora to, n ta jege chega.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: A lwoori‑m se n saare a wɛleera yam n yage, se n kwɛ amo bochare se a taa jege wo-pwoŋo fase.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Daa‑n yé pa a wɛleera taa wo n yiga ne. Saare amo keim-lwanno tem n yage dáa ne.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: A lwoori‑m se n yé zeili-ne nmo yiga ne. Nam yé le n Jwori-laao kom n daare amo.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Sɛ se amo daa jwoori a na ywoni a ŋwea wone, nmo na jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane. Woli-ne se a boboŋa jwoori ya taa tɔge nmo nia yam.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó wane a bere wɛleere-keira nmo chwo-laaro tem, se ba de pipiri ba jwoori ba ba nmo tei.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo ye wolo na jwoŋi-ne n yage to mo. Yage n chɛ-ne se a yé maŋe de toone. Konto to, amo wó ma a ni a ma zuli nmo yere, nmo na jege chega ye n vere nɔɔna to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, pa se a ni dem puri de taa ŋɔɔna, se a wane a leeni a seini‑m.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, kolo yerane nmo na lage se nɔɔno kwei o pa‑m to mo ye bochare delo na ba jege fia to. Wolo ná tu o tete nmo yiga ne, ye o ná chuli o keim-lwanno tem, nmo bá‑n ve kotu.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: A lwoori‑m, nmo tete lanyerane dem ŋwaane, se n woli Zion teo kom. Pa se Jerusalem kabiri sem jwoori se lɔ se zege wɛɛne de dam.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na ye nɔn-kamunu to, bɛ mo ye n bere n tete n lwarem kikia yam ŋwaane? Baŋa Wɛ nam zege o chega kam wone o pa-ne dɛ maama wuu.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: N ta swoi lwarem ko dwoi lam. N ma‑n kuri vwa fɔm ye n daare chega ŋɔŋa.

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Wonnu telo na wae te ke nɔɔna zonne to mo n swoi se n ta‑n ŋɔɔne-te. N yɔɔre n gane nɔɔna mo!

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wó yɔɔre o chochoge nmo se ko ti. O lage o zi‑m o ja o nwoŋi n sɔŋɔ kom ne, ye o daare o gɔ‑m o yage se n daa yé taa ŋwe logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Amo kugu jei nam wo Wɛ wara-jei sem ne, ne Olivi tio na tei ko tete tei mare-mare to mo. A ta wó taa sale Wɛ swono kom baŋa ne mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworru yeini ba tɛ ba bochare ne we, “Wɛ tera.” Ba maama yɔɔre ba chɔge mo ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ. Ba totoŋa de maa tiini ya tusi dedɛ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba wone o na tɔge chwo-laao.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma zege o telaao sɔŋɔ kom ne o tiiri o nii nabiina, se o lɔre ba wolo jege swa ye o tɔge Wɛ.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Ba maama ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone, ye ba boboŋa yɔɔre ya chɔge mo ga zɔŋ-zɔŋ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera ba wone o na tɔge chwo-laao, de dedoa de.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Wo-lwanno keira bá sɛ se ba zamese swa na? Ba jege a nɔɔna bam mo ba chɔga nenɛɛne ko ye wodiu mo ba di. Ba nam ba bwoŋi Wɛ yere ba zuli‑o.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Nii-ba mo! Kolokolo tera ko na fugi-ba, ye foone ta tiini de jege-ba. Ko ná ye á dona balo na tu á baŋa ne to, Wɛ lage o chɔge-ba mo o jage ba kwi sem. Á maa wó pa ba di ba chaveera, Wɛ na ve-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó lwoori Wɛ se o zege Zion ne o ba o vere Isarele tiina bam. Wɛ ná seene o pa o nɔɔna bam jwoori ba zege de dam, Isarele tiina na ye Jakob dwi dem to wó taa chaka de wopwolo!

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, tɔge n yere dem baŋa n jwoŋi-ne n yage. Da n dam dem ŋwaane n pa a na a bora.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: A Tu Wɛ, cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom, se n daare n sɛ a ni taane dem.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, veira mo zaŋe a baŋa ne. Nankɔ-nyena bam konto lage se ba ti a ŋwea, ba yiga na tera Wɛ wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Nii-na! Wɛ mo ye amo zeinnu. A Teiru Wɛ mo teili-ne se a yé to tega ne.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se a dona bam lwarem kikia jwoori ya to ba yuu ne. Wɛ, da n chega kam ŋwaane n chɔge-ba n ti.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Amo wó ja a wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra mo a ba a ma a ke kaanem a pa‑m. Baŋa Wɛ, a ta wó tei nmo yere, de na yɔɔre de lana to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Chega to, Wɛ seene o liiri-ne cham maama wone, pa se a wane a dona bam a di.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Nam pa n yiga taa wo a wone se n daare n leiri-ne, a cham dem na pɛ se a yera chɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: A wo kom maama chɔɔre mo. A maa tiini a kɔre foone de toone na lage de zi-ne lela tei to.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Lwia de foone yɔɔre ya jege-ne pa se a yera sae pɔm-pɔm.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: A maa we, “Wɛ ya ná pɛ se a puli vɔna mo tento, a ya wó jaane mo nenɛɛne kunkwoŋa dwoŋi to a vo yiga yiga se a wane a lu.”

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Kikia yanto yeini ya kaare teo kom ya vei ko kabiri sem baŋa ne wea de tete maama ne. Puseŋa de lwarem kikia de maa su teo kom wo,

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: ye chɔgem daga dedɛ. Kalipera de ganem yɔɔre ya wora mo ko yaga kam ne.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae a dono mo jege-ne o twea. Ko ya ná ye konto, a ya wó wane a taa cho a tete. Ko ya ná ye a dono mo bere o tete a baŋa ne, a ya wó wane a lɔŋe‑o.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Se ko ye nmo wolo na ye a yuudwoŋi to mo ke konto. Nmo ye a badwoŋ-ywoŋo ye dé me daane.

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: Dé déem yeini dé lare daane dé di ywoni. Dé maa tɔge daane de Wɛ kɔgɔ kom maama dé beeri Wɛ wara-jei sem ne.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nam pa se toone pɔpɔ de ja a dona bam! Pa se ba vo churu lela ŋweene ŋweene. Kokuri to, lwarem yerane mo su ba sam de ba bochara.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó keeri a jare Wɛ mo. Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ne o yage.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ chuli-ne, ye Wɛ liiri-ne o ja o nwoŋi jara yam wone se a wane a na yazura.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo ye wolo na maŋe o di paare faŋa faŋa to. Wonto nam wó sɛ a lworo kom ye o daare o waare a dona bam. Kokuri to, banto ba sɛ se ba leiri ba boboŋa. Ba maa ba kɔre Wɛ.

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: O yeini o ŋɔɔne ni-som ŋɔŋa ye chɔgem boboŋa wo o yuu ne. O ni taane swola nenɛɛne nuga to, ye de maama laam za ke nɔɔna zonne mo ne se-zɔɔro na ke nɔɔna zonne tei to.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Nmo na jege lwia yalo maama to, se n kwei-ya n pa Baŋa Wɛ, se wonto mo wó pa‑m dam. O bá sɛ se nɔn-ŋona tiri ba to tega ne.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo nam wó ja puseŋ-nyena banto n dole n yage gwoŋo kolo na luuna to wone se ba yera pɔ. Ba na ye nɔn-gora de vwa-fɔra to, n lage n pa ba te mo ye ba ta ye nɔn-donno. Amo tete nam wó kwei a teena mo a daŋe nmo wone.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, duri amo ŋwaŋa. A dona mo zaŋe a baŋa ne ye ba bɛɛse-ne dɛ dem maama wone.

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Foone nam ná yeini de ja-ne, a daa ta wó ke a wo-dedoa de nmo.

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem maama wone to, ba jege-ne ba daana. Ba boboŋa maama maa ye se ba ke-ne lwarem.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Ba na yɔɔre ba toŋe lwarem to, nmo wó pa-ba chwoŋa se ba lu na? Amo Tu Wɛ, nam pa n bane zaŋe de nɔɔna bam, pa se ba na chɔgem.

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye lwia yalo na yeini ya daane-ne to, n jeeli ya maama. N ta ma‑n la a yi-na bam n ke kunkwolo wone se n lɔre a na keeri tei maama. N popone ya maama n tiŋi n tɔnɔ kom ne.

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem a na wó bwoŋi Wɛ yere se o ba o zeini-ne to, a dona bam laam wó tutwoni ba jwoori kwaga. Konto maa pae se a yei we, Wɛ mo zege a kwaga ne.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: A seene a ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Mo kokuri a daa bá taa kɔre foone. Nabiina daa bá wane ba ke amo kolokolo.

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a jege se a tɔge ni delo a na dugi dede‑m to. A maa wó ja lei-keim pɛɛra a ba a pa‑m.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo mo kwoli-ne pa a wo tege. N ta ma‑n che-ne pa a wo to tega ne. N ke konto se a taa wae a vei Wɛ chwoŋa wone ye ŋwea pwooni wo a tei ne.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, duri a ŋwaŋa. Popo, se n duri a ŋwaŋa. A tu nmo tei mo se a seigi a tete. Pa se a vwɛ n woro kom wone, ne nmo na yarege n vɔna n kwoli-ne tei to, se lɛɛro tem maama kɛ.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó zege o telaao ne o toŋe zeina a ŋwaane ye o daare o jwoŋi-ne o yage. Ko nam ná ye balo na zaŋe a baŋa ne to, Wɛ wó waare-ba. Wɛ wó pa se o swono kom yi-ne, o na zege o chega kam wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: A dona bam gilimi-ne nenɛɛne a na tigi nywonnu tetare ne ye te lage se te tore nabiina ya-nɔna tei to mo. Nɔɔna bam konto yeila nye nenɛɛne chichwoa de che-tɛɛra mo. Ba dindeilima maa nye de se-zɔɔro telo na tiini te jege ni to.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe wɛyuu maama ne! Ta pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae logo baŋa jei maama ne!

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: A dona bam tiŋi kalanchogo mo se ba ja-ne. A vɔna ma pare wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Ba ta ma ko gwoŋo se a to ko wone, ye ba tete mo jwoori ba to ko wone.

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a wo kom yɔɔre ko da nmo mo. Chega to, a ke a wo-dedoa dede‑m. Konto to, a lage a leeni lei a seini‑m.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: A Teiru Wɛ, a wó ke nmo lei nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne. A ta wó leeni lei a seini‑m logo baŋa dwi tiina maama wone.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe wɛyuu baŋa maama ne! Ta pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae dɔŋɔ ni maama ne!

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nam bwori a dona bam yeila, ba na nye de nywon-pɔle na lage se se tore-ne to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ, guri ba yeila yam n yage!

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó ke lela o saare-ba o yage, ba nɔn-donno dedaane ba nɔn-kwe maama, pa se ba jei lela ba dwoni kambia na lone lela mini ne tei to.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona wo wó pwoli nenɛɛne puseŋ-nyena bam ná nɛ waarem delo na maŋe de-ba to. Ba ta wó vo ba zare ba nɛ de puseŋ-nyena jana bam.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna laam maa wó ta ba we, “Nii-na nɔn-ŋona bam na nɛ nyɔɔre tei to. Chega ŋwaane to, Wɛ wora ye o bore chega bora logo baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Jwoŋi-ne balo na toŋe lwarem to jeŋa ne, dedaane nɔn-gora de jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Nii mo! Ba dale gugworru wone mo ba cheiga, se ba laam nwoŋi ba zi-ne ba go. Nankɔ-nyena bam konto boŋe se ba ke-ne zonne mo. Baŋa Wɛ, ko nam dae we a ke woŋo a chɔge ba yiga.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye debam Isarele tiina Wɛ wom. Zaŋe wɛɛne se n waare dwi-gɛ tiina bam. Ko ná ye nɔn-ŋollo tem konto na toŋe lwarem to, yé duri ba yibwona kɔtaa!

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Ta‑n cheigi ba na ŋɔɔne boyerem ŋɔŋa tei to! Ba ni taane dem yeini de chɔge nɔɔna, nenɛɛne se-zɔɔro na ke nɔɔna zonne tei to. Ba maa boŋe we, “Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ni dé ŋɔŋa.”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jege-ba mo n mɔna. N jege dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama mo n gweela.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, tɔge n ban-lom dem baŋa n chɔge-ba fase, pa se ba jei. Konto mo wó pa se logo baŋa jei maama nɔɔna lɔre we, Wɛ mo seene o nii debam Jakob dwi dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Ba maa yeini ba kare ba beeri wodiiru se ba di. Ba ná wo di ba su, ba wó taa suura mo.

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Nmo mo sugi debam tega kam pa ka ziziŋi, ye n daare n pa se ka bɔke belei. Nam jwoori n kwoni lolwe sem, se tega kam daa yé taa ziziŋa.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na kɔre nmo to, n zeiŋi tuta mo n pa-ba, se ba wane ba duri ba vo da se jara yam yé yi-ba.

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Popo, leiri dé wɛ-lworo kom. Kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom n ma n jwoŋi debam n yage. Konto to, n nɔn-swonnu tem wó taa tei ba tete.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wɛ zege o tete diga kam ne mo o we: “Amo wó bere a dam jaja a chɛ chɛ Sɛkɛm laŋa kam, ye a daare a maŋe Sukofa bwolo kom a pɔɔre a pa a nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead laŋa kam ye amo nyem, ko ta woli de Manasɛ laŋa kam de. Efrayim maa nye de a yu-gwoŋo kom. Judah de maa nye de a paare nacheiga kam.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Wɔ nam mo wó ja amo o vo teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone? Wɔ mo wó ja-ne o vo o yi Edom teo kom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Ja, woli debam se dé wane dé dona bam, se nabiina na jege wolim delo to maama ba jege kuri.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: A maa zege logo kom yiga yiga ne ye a keeri a jare‑m. Amo teena maama ti mo. Nam da amo yiga se n ja-ne n vo n yi peo kolo na diini wɛyuu ko dwoi amo to, se a na jeiŋa jei dáane.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Pa se Pɛ wom taa jege momwɛ-dɛɛre. Sɛ se o taa ŋwe taa se o na dwi dedɛ.

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Wɛ, pa chwoŋa se o jeini o paare dem ne taa ye n nii o baŋa ne. Nmo na zege n chega wone to, pa se n swono kom taa cho‑o maŋa maama.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Wonto yerane mo ye peo kolo amo na sale ko yera ne to. O ta maa ye amo vereno. O kwori o ye amo dalem jei mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ne o di.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Abam maama wó ke chichuŋu de nɔɔno dedoa taa se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo? Á lage se á mage‑o á de tega ne mo na? O nam nye de kabira kalo na veele to mo.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Á boboŋe dem maama ye se á vaŋe‑o á de tega ne mo, de o ya na wo wɛyuu ne tei to. Á maa swoi vwa fɔm yerane. Á yeini á ŋɔɔne ni-som ŋɔŋa mo, ye á boboŋa maama ye se á sɔɔle lwarem á pa‑o.

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Chega to, amo wó peene mo a taa cheigi Wɛ se o zeini-ne. Wonto yerane mo jege a teena.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Wonto yerane mo ye peo kolo amo na sale ko yera ne to. O ta maa ye amo vereno. O kwori o ye amo dalem jei mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ne o di.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ a na verem dedaane zula. O maa ye peo-kamunu kolo amo na dale da pa se a seigi o woro wone to.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, ke-na á wo-dedoa dedaane Wɛ maŋa maama wone. Pa-na se o lɔre kolo maama na daane á boboŋa to. Wɛ mo ye dé dalem jei.

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Nabiina maama ye vio yerane mo, nabwona de dedɛɛra maama de. Nmo ya ná kwei-ba n maŋe ba dunni, n wó na we ba ba jege yuu. Ba nam nye de weero telo vio na kale ko ja jei to mo.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Nmo Baŋa Wɛ jege nabiina swono chekke. Nmo yeini n ŋwe nɔɔno maama mo se ko tɔge de o totoŋa na ye tei maama to.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo seene n ye a Wɛ mo. Nmo fera tiini ya zo-ne, nenɛɛne na-nyɔm na jege-ne tei to. Amo tiini a lage‑m de a wo maama, ne te-kora na tiga ye na tera to.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Amo na zo n wara-jei sem ne to, a nɛ nmo de n dam dem maama, ko woli de n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
translation_verse: Amo ta na jege ŋwea to, amo wó tei‑m. Amo wó zeiŋi a jea a lwoori‑m.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Amo bochare laam wó zuri, nenɛɛne a na nɛ wodi-fɔrɔ a di a su tei to. A maa wó daare a leeni lei a zuli‑m de wopwolo.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Tete ne, amo ná yeini a peini se a dɔ, a guli nmo gula mo maŋa maama, ye a boŋe nmo boboŋa.

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ko zege boboa ne, nmo maŋe n ye amo zeinnu mo. A maa vwɛ n woro kom wone. Mo kokuri a leeni lei de wopwolo.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa sale‑m mo, se n ma n jazem dem n ma‑n teili-ne.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Balo dwi maama na beeri se ba go-ne to, nmo wó chɔge. Banto wó te ba vo tega kuri kuri ba daare amo.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Jar-keira wó ma se-zɔɔro mo ba go-ba. Nywoŋ-kuri maa wó ja ba yera yam se di.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Wɛ ŋwaane mo Pɛ wom nam wó di ywoni lanyerane. Balo maama na yeini ba pwooli kampwoli Wɛ yere dem ŋwaane to wó zuli‑o. Ko daare se vwa-fɔra dwi maama nia pu.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Banto dindeilima yam gwoni mo fileim-fileim nenɛɛne se-zɔɔro nia tei to. Ba ni taane de maa zɔ nɔɔna nenɛɛne che-tɛɛra tei to.

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Ba ná jeini ba bane keim-lwanno bana konto, ba laam yeini ba ta mo we, “Ko ye wo-laao mo dé bane.” Chega to, nabiina bochare de ba boboŋa maama ba ŋwae kɔtaa.

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo wó kwei o che-tɛɛra yam o ta-ba, pa se ba pɔpɔ ba na zonne.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Banto tete ni taane dem mo lage de jwoori de di-ba, pa se ba to tega ne. Wolo maama ná nɛ-ba, kotu yera wó taa sae.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama laam maa wó taa kɔre foone. Ba ta wó tɔɔle Wɛ totoŋa yam tɔla, ye ba daare ba ke o kikia yam ba boboŋa ne.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Balo maama nmo na kuri se ba ba ba taa zoore nmo wara-jei sem wone to, banto jege yu-ywoŋo! Debam yi wó su dedaane wo-laaro telo na wo n di-laao kom ne to. Dé wó na zaane nmo tete sɔŋɔ kom ne.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye debam Vereno. Nmo yeini n sɛ dé wɛ-lworo kom, ye n toŋe totoŋa yalo na ke debam yaau to, se n ma‑n vere debam. Logo baŋa nɔɔna maama teena wo nmo tei ne mo, ko ta woli de balo na kare naneero tem ne ba vei to.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Balo na zoore logo baŋa gugworru ne yiga yiga to laam fona mo de wo-kenkagela yalo n na ke to. Ko na zege wɛ-puli seeni se ko taa vei wɛ-zoore seeni to nabiina maama wó taa leeni wopwolo lei nmo ŋwaane.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Nmo yiga wo tega kam wone ye n yeini n pa doa nene ka baŋa ne, pa se ka ywomma lanyerane. Nmo bwi sem su se wɛɛle. Se na bam maa pa se tega kam ke wodiiru dedɛ ka pa nɔɔna bam. Nmo na yeini n toŋe tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n pa doa yeini ka bugi te-kora kam. Do-mimina kam maa yeini ka zuri tega kam. Nmo ma‑n tɔge konto baŋa ne n pa pwola se wodiiru wane te ke lanyerane.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Vara mo su pwoli sem maama. Mena de maa li bwollu tem. Ko daare ye jei sem maama leeni de kwor-dɛa, wopwolo na wora to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Nabiina maama, yeeri-na de wopwolo sɔɔ á ma‑á tei Wɛ.

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: Leeni-na á zuli o yere-kamunu kom. Seini-na o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom se á ma‑á tei‑o.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Ta-na á bere Wɛ we: “Nmo tiini n toŋe wo-kenkagela naa! N dam dem de tiini de daga de gaale, pa se n dona maama kɔre foone ye ba sɛ ba pa‑m.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Nabiina maama tiiri tega ne mo ba zuli‑m. Ba maama leeni ba seini‑m. N yere dem mo ba leeni ba seini-de.”

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Ba-na á nii á na Wɛ na ke kolo maama to. O yɔɔre o ke wo-kenkagela mo o pa nabiina.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: O déem pɛ se naneo kom ji te-kora. Dé nabaara bam déem tɔge buga kam wo de ba nɛ ba bɛ. Pa-na se dé ke wopwolo o keina yam konto ŋwaane.

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: Wɛ jege dam mo o ma o di o paare taa wuu. O yia maa dole ya nii logo baŋa teene dem maama. Nankɔ-nyena nam yé bere ba tete o yiga ne.

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, seini-na debam Tu Wɛ wom. Bage-na o tia yam á yage wɛ-wɛ!

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: N jaane debam n zo kalanchogo wone, ye n daare n pa se cham jege debam de daana.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ dé dona bam pwola pa ba jege debam ba nɔna. Dé ma tɔge mini wone dedaane na-fɔrɔ wone dé kɛ. Nmo laam ma‑n pa dé vo dé jeini jei selo na ye falalala to ne.

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na kɔre Wɛ to, ba-na á cheigi woŋo. Amo laam wó lwoni woŋo kolo maama Wɛ na ke o pa-ne to a bere abam.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: A ya keeri mo a jare Wɛ se o woli-ne. A ma puri a ni a tei‑o.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Amo fera ya ná wo lwarem kikia wone, a Teiru Wɛ wom ya bá sɛ o cheigi-ne.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam seene o ni a kwora kam ye o daare o cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋe de tia. A na lwoori‑o to, o wo ve-ne. O ta wo dɔne o swono kom o daare-ne.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, ta‑n duri debam yibwona, se n zaane taa wo dé yuu ne! Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: Pa pwola se logo baŋa nɔɔna maama lɔre n chwei sem. Sɛ se teene dem maama nɔn-bia bam taa yei nmo na jege dam se n vere-ba n yage tei to.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Tega kam ke wodiiru lanyerane. Dé Tu Wɛ seene o ke zaane debam yuu ne!

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, Wɛ swɛ debam swolim. Ko jege se tega baŋa nabiina maama taa kɔre‑o mo.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋona, banto wó zege Wɛ yiga ne mo ba di ywoni, ye ba chake de wopwolo.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Leeni-na lei se á tei Wɛ, se á daare á seini o yere dem. O yere mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. O maa yeini o dɔge kunkwonnu baŋa ne o via. Zuli-o-na se á di ywoni o tei ne!

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: O maa pae balo na ye ba yerane to nae dwi. O ta maa yeini o pore peena o yaga pa se ba na zurim ba ŋwea wone. Ko daare nankɔ-nyena wó taa zoore kagoa yuu mɛ na na tera to wone mo.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Wɛ, nmo déem nwoŋi n tɔge n nɔɔna bam yiga n ja-ba n bɛ kagoa kam.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Wɛ wom tɔɔle o kwora mo, ye kaana kɔgɔ kɔgɔ de pa se ka jage jei maama ne.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: Ba maa we: “Pwa de ba jar-keira bam duri lela mo se ba lu.” Ka-yorro tem de ma pɔɔre jejegero telo banto na viiri ba daare to.

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: Abam balo de na maŋe kwaga ne ye á yere pei sem to, á nɛ kunkwona nyenyero telo ba na mɛ lu-nyenno ba kwoli ye ya vɔna yam de ye sabu-seŋa mo ba mɛ ba kwoli-ya to.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom na pɛ se pwa bam jage sae konto to, ko nye de do-kandwa mo nege Zalemon peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Basan peero tem jege nenɔŋa dedɛ. Te maa diini te yi wɛyuu baŋa baŋa.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Wɛ wom maa jege sisei-torokooro morro kuni morro dedɛ. O déem tɔge de-te o zege Sinayi peo kom ne mo o ba o zo o wara-jei sem ne.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: O na diini wɛyuu konto to, o kale o dona bam o na wane-ba to o ja vo. O ma daare o jwoŋi pɛɛra nɔɔna tei ne, de ba ná maŋe ba ye nankɔ-nyena mo de. Konto to, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ laam wó taa zoore dáane.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé taa tei dé Teiru Wɛ wom, de o na teili debam dɛ de ni too wone tei to. O maa ye wolo na vere debam o yage to.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Wɛ dona bam, o lage o lɔ ba yuni mo. O ta wó chochoge ba yu-kwoli, ba na swoi tusim kikia tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo mo ye amo Pɛ. Nɔɔna laam nae nmo kwaga kɔgɔ kom na twoŋi gena ba maa vei n wara-jei sem to.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Lein-leena mo wo kɔgɔ kom yiga ne. Wo-magena de ma saŋe ba kwaga. Bukɔ-pwoli maa wo ba tetare ne ye ba jege senyɛ ba wɔe.

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: Ba maa leeni ba we: “Pa-na dé kɔgɔ kom maama taa tei Baŋa Wɛ! Isarele dwi tiina maama, zuli-o-na!”

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Nii-na, Benjamin dwi dem na muri to mo wo ba maama yiga ne. Judah dwi dem nakwa de ba kɔgɔ kom maama maa tɔge ba wora, ko ta woli de Zebulun dwi dem de Nafitali dwi dem nakwa bam maama.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: N na zoore n wara-jei sem Jerusalem ne to, logo baŋa pwa bam wó ja pɛɛra ba ba ba pa‑m.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Nam zaŋe n bwɛ teo kolo na nye de ga-varem ye ko vwɛ nanchan-gullu wone to. Daa ta bwɛ teene delo na bere ba tete we ba ye nabɛ ye ba wo na-mɔre tetare ne to. Banto jege se ba tu ba tete mo ba daare ba ja lu-nyenno wonnu ba ba ba pa‑m. Pa se teene delo na swoi jara-keim to jage sae.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Ejipti tiina wó toŋe dedɛɛra se ba ba. Kusi tiina de wó ba ba sɛ ba pa Wɛ.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Logo baŋa teene dem maama, leeni-na á tei Wɛ. Leeni-na á seini Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Wonto mo maŋe o dɔge wɛyuu baŋa kam ne faŋa faŋa o via. Nii-na! O kwor-dɛa kam bage mo pina-pina.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Sɛ-na we Wɛ tiini o jege dam! Wonto mo di paare Isarele tiina baŋa ne. O dam dem maa bere jaja wɛyuu ne.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: A lage a moore mo mɔrɔ wone. A nɛ maa ware se zege cheppe. Amo maa yi na-luŋa jei, ye na-ŋone mo lage se ja-ne se jei.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: A kaase ni mo a beeri wolim ye a ga. A yera laam mo chɛ de keira kam, a kwora de ma ko. A yia maama suli de yi-na a na tiini a lwoori a Tu Wɛ taa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Balo na chuli amo kafɛ ŋwaane to mo tiini ba daga ba dwoi a yu-ywei sem. Ba maa done amo vwa chwoŋa wone, ye ba boŋe se ba chɔge-ne. Ba fe amo se a jwoori a ja woŋo kolo a na wo ŋɔge to a ja a ba a pa-ba.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ko ye a na sɛ nmo to ŋwaane mo nɔɔna jege-ne ba twea ye a daa ba jege yuu ba yiga ne.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Amo chorro laam ke nenɛɛne ba yeiri-ne mo tei. A daa ta maa nye de veiru a tete nu-bia bam tei ne.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a toŋe de yi-seena a pa nmo wara-jei sem mo. Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔna na jege nmo ba twea tei to mo jwoori ko tui amo baŋa ne.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: A maa yeini a keeri ye a vɔ ni, pa se nɔɔna jege-ne ba yaala.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: A maa zoore gare-nyenyaaro wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane ye ba jege-ne ba mɔna.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Teo kom nɔɔna na jeeri mɛ maama to, ba maa ke sawea amo ŋwaane. Sa-nyɔra tete pane lei mo amo ŋwaane ba leena.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye nmo mo a yeini a lwoori, se n nii amo baŋa ne de yibwona. Jan ja! Sɛ amo wɛ-lworo kom, se n daare n jwoŋi-ne n yage n swono kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: Vaŋe-ne n ja n nwoŋi mɔrɔ konto wone, se na bam yé kwoli-ne. Yé sɛ se balo na chuli-ne to wane-ne ba ja. Liiri-ne n ja n nwoŋi na-luŋa kam wone.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Nam yé sɛ se na-fwaaro tem ja amo ba jei. Yé pa se na-luŋa kam li amo. Yé yage se a zo toone gwoŋo.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, leiri amo wɛ-lworo kom, nmo swono kom na tiini ko lana to ŋwaane. Nam pipiri n nii amo seeni, se nmo tiini n duri nɔɔna yibwona mo.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Yé ma n kwaga n ya-ne, se amo ye nmo tontoŋeno mo, ye a tiini a wo cham wone. Ke lela n ba n woli-ne!

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Nmo nɛ a dona bam maama na ke tetei. Ba maa jege-ne ba twea ye ba yaala, pa se a na a chaveera.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Amo wo kom chɔɔre mo ba toro tem ŋwaane. A vɔna yam de ma pare. A ya boŋe we nɔɔno wó ba o duri amo ŋwaŋa, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tu. Nɔɔno tera o na wó pa a bochare zuri.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Ba nam kwei wo-chɛɛro mo ba ke a wodiu wone. Na-nyɔm na jege-ne to mo ba kwei sa-nyɔna ba pa-ne se a nyɔ.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Wɛ, pa se n bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne n daare n waare-ba. Pa se n ban-lom chɔge-ba.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se ba sam dem ji di-dwonnu se nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa yé daare jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, ko tiini ko ni amo, ye a vɔna de laam pare. Konto to, ba n jwoŋi-ne, se a wane a zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Amo wó zaŋe a leeni leiŋa a ma tei Wɛ yere! A ta wó ke o lei ye a pa o yere zaŋe.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Nabwona maa wó na Wɛ na jwoŋi-ne tei to ye ko pa ba wo pwoli dedɛ. Abam balo na kɔre Wɛ to, Wɛ wó pa á bochara fɔge ya ke dam!

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o cheigi yiniga tiina wɛ-lworo mo. O ba swia o tete nɔɔna na nɛ bɛɛsem to swia.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Woŋo maama jege se ko zuli Wɛ! Wɛyuu de tega baŋa wonnu, ko woli de wonnu telo na wo naneero tem wone to, te maama wó taa tei Wɛ!

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Wɛ mo wó vere Zion teo kom o yage ye o jwoori o lɔ Judah teene dem maama. O tete nɔɔna bam laam wó taa zoore jei sem konto ne. Ba wó taa tei tega kam konto.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: O tontoŋena dwi tiina bam wó jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei. Balo maama na swoi Wɛ to wó taa zoore da.

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na beeri amo toone to, pa se vuvuga yi-ba se ba to tega ne. Pa balo maama na beeri amo chɔgem to jwoori kwaga de ba chaveera yam.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Sɛ se banto dwi dem maama to tega ne, ba na tɛ ba we, ba jeŋa zo amo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ko daare balo maama na beeri nmo jei to, pa se ba taa jege wopwolo, se ba di ywoni nmo ŋwaane. Ta pa se balo na swoi se n ta‑n jwoŋi-ba to taa tɛ maŋa maama we, “Dé wó zeiŋi Wɛ yere dem wɛɛne.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Amo nam ye nabwom mo ye yiniga jege-ne. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ke lela n ba n zeini-ne. Nmo mo ye a zeinnu de a vereno. Yé dáane se n ba n woli-ne!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na beeri amo toone to, pa se vuvuga yi-ba se ba to tega ne. Pa balo maama na beeri amo chɔgem to jwoori kwaga de ba chaveera yam.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Sɛ se banto dwi dem maama to tega ne, ba na tɛ ba we, ba jeŋa zo amo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Ko daare balo maama na beeri nmo jei to, pa se ba taa jege wopwolo, se ba di ywoni nmo ŋwaane. Ta pa se balo na swoi se n ta‑n jwoŋi-ba to taa tɛ maŋa maama we, “Dé wó zeiŋi Wɛ yere dem wɛɛne.”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Amo nam ye nabwom mo ye yiniga jege-ne. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ke lela n ba n zeini-ne. Nmo mo ye a zeinnu de a vereno. Yé dáane se n ba n woli-ne!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a tu a dale nmo woro ne mo. Yé pa se chaveera di-ne.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Nam tɔge n chega kam ŋwaane n jwoŋi-ne n yage. Pore n zwa se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom, se n daare n ba n vere-ne n yage.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Ta‑n kwoli-ne se a wane a dale nmo woro ne, ne n ye peo mo tei to. Dáane mo amo wó yeini a duri a vo a seigi. Tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n vere-ne n yage, nmo na ye a dalem jei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, jwoŋi-ne n yage puseŋ-nyena jeŋa ne, se nankɔ-nyena yé wane-ne ba ja.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Chega to, ko zege a lora maŋa ne a sale nmo yera ne mo. N jaane-ne n nwoŋi a nu puga ne ye n nii amo baŋa ne. Amo wó taa tei‑m maŋa maama wone.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Amo laam jigi maana mo nɔɔna dedɛ yiga ne. Nmo nam ye amo dalem jei mɛ na damma to mo.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wuu a yeini a tei nmo, ye a tɔɔle nmo nenɔŋa taane a ba yaga.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: A lwoori‑m se n yé zeili-ne n yiga ne a kokweero maŋa kam ne. A dam dem ná tu de ti maama, nam yé viiri n daare-ne.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Ba maa ŋɔɔne ba we: “Wɛ mo maŋe o lɔ o kwaga ne. Pa-na dé vo dé pɔpɔ dé ja‑o, se o daa ba jege nɔɔno wolo na wó woli‑o to.”

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Pa se chaveera ja balo na jege-ne ba bɛɛse to se ba daare ba na chɔgem. Pa se balo na boŋe se ba ke amo zonne to to tega ne de kuri-nɔrɔ.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: A maa wó puri a ni a ta nmo na toŋe chega tei to. Dɛ maama wone a lage a ŋɔɔne n verem dem taane, ye a nam ware a ni de maama kuri a ti.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó ta nmo totoŋ-kamuna yam taane. A ta wó pa se nɔɔna lɔre we nmo yerane mo bore chega bora.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, ko maŋe ko zege a biini wone mo n yeini n pa-ne bera. De zem maama de, a ta tɛ nmo wo-kenkagela yam taane a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Amo nam ná tu a kwe dedɛ ye a yuu kom maama peere, yé lɔ amo kwaga ne. Kokuri to, a lage a ta nmo dam-fɔrɔ kom taane a bere a dwi delo na wó saŋe a kwaga to mo.
