english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo nɔn-ŋonne dem daga mo pa se ko geene ko di wɛyuu. Nmo dwoŋi tera, de n na tiini n ke totoŋ-kamuna tei to.

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ chwoŋa se a na cham de lɛɛro dedɛ. De ko de, nmo ta wó pa a ŋwea jwoori ka ke dam. Nmo wó le-ne tega kuri gwoŋ-chanluŋu wone se a jwoori a zege a zega jei sem ne.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: N ta wó pa a tiini a na yere, se n daare n jwoori n pa a wo taa tigi tega ne.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ wom na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom to, a lage a kwei kɔnɔ mo a ma a leeni a tei‑m, nmo na yɔɔre n zege n chega wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Amo lage a puri a ni mo a yeeri wopwolo sɔɔ, de a na leeni a tei‑m tei to. Kokuri to, amo ye wolo nmo na vere n yage to mo.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone amo wó taa tɛ jaja n na bore chega bora tei to. Kokuri to, ko ná ye balo ya na boŋe se ba ke-ne zonne to, vuvuga to ba tetare ne mo, ye chaveera di-ba.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Konto, o wó taa tɔge chega o di nmo tete nɔɔna bam taana, se nabwona tete de na ba bora.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom wó taa zeini o nɔɔna bam, nenɛɛne doa na nena tega baŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: O paare dem da yam ne, nmo chega kam wó nwoŋi ka puli lanyerane. Yazura wó taa wora taa wuu, nenɛɛne chana kam na wo wɛyuu ne tei to.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore kagoa yuu ne to wó ba ba tiiri o yiga ne ba zuli‑o. O dona bam de wó vwi ba yibia tega ne o yiga ne.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tarasisi de teene delo na wo naneo kom ni ne to pwa bam maama wó ja pɛɛra ba ba ba pa‑o. Pwa balo na tei Seba de Sebaa teene to de wó ke konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Pwa maama wó tiiri o yiga ne ba zuli‑o. Teene dem maama wó taa toŋe ba pa‑o.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom wó jwoŋi yiniga tu wolo maama na keeri o jare‑o to, ko woli de nabwona balo na gɛ zeinnu to maama.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nabwona de yiniga tiina maama, o wó taa jege yibwona o pa-ba. O ta wó vere balo na wo cham wone to ŋwea o yage.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: O wó ja-ba o ja o nwoŋi yaara de vuvuga maama wone, ba ŋwea na jege nyɔɔre ka pa‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se pɛ wom yere zaŋe de taa wora taa wuu, nenɛɛne wea kam ta na wo wɛyuu ne ka nyeena tei to. Dwi tiina maama wó ma o yere se ba taa lwoori Wɛ swolim. Ba maama wó sɛ we Wɛ zaane wo o yuu ne.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to! Ko ye wonto yerane mo toŋe wo-kenkagela.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé zeiŋi o yere-kamunu kom wɛɛne taa wuu! Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom jege se ko jage ko yi logo baŋa jei maama. Ameena! Ameena!

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Konto mo guri Jesse bu David wɛ-lworo kolo maama o na popone o tiŋi to. Lei Tɔnɔ

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Ko na ye chega to, Wɛ seene o ke Isarele dwi tiina bam lanyerane. O maa yeini o zeini balo bochara na ye chekke to mo.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane to, a na nɛ puseŋ-nyena bam jejegero tem to mo a zwe kazwe de-ba, ba na bere ba tete to ŋwaane.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam ba nae cham de fenfee de. Ba ta maa damma, ye yazura yi-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Ba na lage paare to ŋwaane mo ba yeini ba toŋe lwarem yerane. Ba bochara de maa tɔge puseŋa yerane.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Ba maa jege nɔɔna ba mɔna, ye ba ŋɔŋa maama ye lwarem. Ba na bere ba tete tei to, ba mae yaara mo ba fugi nɔɔna.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se nɔɔna bam boboŋa vugimi. Ba maa yɔɔre ba jwoŋi ba taane maama ba pa de ye chega.

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Mo puseŋ-nyena bam na ye tei! Kolokolo ba daane-ba. Ba jejegero tem yeini te puli mo te gaale.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, amo na chege a bochare de digiru se a yé biini a tete, ye a ve wɛleere keim to, ko maama ye kafɛ ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Amo yeini a na yaara mo dɛ maama wuu. A ná zaŋe zezeŋa maama ne, ko ye cham mo a yera ne.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Amo nam ya ná tage a we, “Amo wó taa ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi mo,” a ya wó taa ye pipiri-nyem mo ye a ywori nmo bia bam kwaga ne.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: Amo nam na vei a zo Wɛ diga kam to mo a laam tu a lɔre puseŋ-nyena bam gurim na wó taa ye tei to.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Amo wo ya chɔge dedɛ, ye a pa wonnu tiini te daane-ne.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, a ta sale nmo yera ne mo maŋa maama. Nmo yeini n jege amo jeŋa mo ye dé via.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Ko ye nmo bera yam mo yere-ne pa se a wo chwo-laao wone. Ko kwaga seeni, nmo wó pa a na zula nmo tei ne.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera wɛyuu ne o na wó zeini-ne, ko ná dae nmo. Tega baŋa ne amo daa ba beeri nɔɔn-nɔɔno a woli nmo wone.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Chega to, balo maama na wo yiga yiga nmo tei ne to wó ba ba jei. Nmo wó yɔɔre n chɔge balo na mɛ ba kwaga ba ya nmo to.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Se ko ná ye amo, ko lamma mo ko pa-ne de a na sale Wɛ yera ne tei to. Amo pɛ se nmo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ji amo dalem jei, se a daare a ta wo-kamuna yalo maama n na toŋe to, se nɔɔna lɔre jaja!

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Jeiga kalo nmo ya na yeini n jeeri debam to mo n dona bam kaase tiguri-kaasa ka tetare ne. Ba ma chwi ba jara-keim tuta dáane.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Ba déem tage ba tete boboŋa ne ba we, “Pa-na se dé chɔge-ba fase!” Tega kam wone jei selo maama nɔɔna na zuli Wɛ to mo ba zwɛ kula.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Dé daa ba nae wo-kenkagela yalo Wɛ na toŋe to. Wɛ sampwori de daa maa tera dé tei ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam yeiri yaara yanto na wó dáane debam tei ne tei to.

english_verse: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
translation_verse: Bɛ mo kea ye n wo kwei n jazem dem n waare-ba? Nam bwoli n jeŋa se n chɔge-ba fase!

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, ko zege faŋa mo nmo maŋe n ye amo Pɛ. Kuni dedɛ n yeini n toŋe tega kam baŋa ne mo se n jwoŋi debam n yage.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Nmo déem mɛ n dam-fɔrɔ mo n pɔɔre naneo kom. N ta ma‑n chochoge naneo wo jurru tem yuni.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Chega to, nmo mo chochoge naneo wo juru Leviatan yuni tem, ye n daare n kwei o yera yam n pa kagoa wo vara bam se ba kwei ba di.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n pa buli-yia ta ya nwoŋi ya bura. Ko ta ná ye bu-tole sem, n pɛ se se we mo.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se wea de tete pɔɔre daane ye te maama ye nmo nyem. N daa‑n ta ma‑n kwei chana kam de wea kam n zege se zega jei ne.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se tega dwi maama jege ka siseini mo. N ta pɛ se yadɛ dedaane te-pwoŋa wora.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nam guli n dona bam ya na jege‑m ba mɔna tei to. Nɔn-jworru de maa gwooni nmo yere dem.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: Nmo yeini n nii dé kɔgɔ kom ne ko ye kunkwoŋa to mo. Nam yé kwei n kunkwoŋa kam n pa ga-vara se ba wane-ka ba di. Yé yɔɔre n swei debam balo na ye n nɔɔna ye dé wo yaara wone to ni ne.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Nam guli n na gwoni ni se n ke kolo n pa debam to. Kokuri to, nankɔ-nyena mo seigi tega kam baŋa gugworru dwi maama wone.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Yé sɛ se debam balo nɔɔna na bɛɛse to jwoori kwaga, se chaveera ja debam. Nam pa se nabwona de yiniga tiina bam na chwoŋa se ba taa tei n yere dem.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, zaŋe wɛɛne se n zege n chega kam kwaga ne. Nam guli nɔn-jworru na jege‑m ba twea dɛ maama wone tei to.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: “Amo kuri maŋa mo a zege se a ma a bore nabiina bora dedaane chega.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Tega kam baŋa ná yeini ka ziziŋi ye nabiina yera de sae pɔm-pɔm, ko daa ta ye amo mo fɔge a jege ka kuri diŋ-diŋ.

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: A ma yeini a kaane bere-n-tete nyena we, ‘Yé ta‑á jege-na ni-wɛɛle konto!’ A daa ta maa tɛ de puseŋ-nyena we, ‘Yé ta‑á teera á dam ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Wɛ mo bore nɔɔna bora. O ma yeini o ja dedoa o de tega ne, ye o daare o zeiŋi wodwoŋi wɛɛne.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ zei na-zoŋa mo o jeŋa ne ka na su de sa-dɛɛra balo dwoa-bia na guuri ba wone to. O ma kwei-ka o teini puseŋ-nyena balo maama na wo logo baŋa ne to nia ne. Ko jege se ba nyɔ Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ sana bam maama mo se ba maama vo ba ti.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, a ta wó taa tɛ Wɛ totoŋa yam taane taa. A lage a leeni a seini Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ wom mo. Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: “Amo mo lage a chɔge puseŋ-nyena bam dam maama. A maa wó daare a pa se nɔn-laaro tem tiini ba na dam se ko ja gaale.”

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: O maa zoore Salem ne, Zion peo kom baŋa ne.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Nmo wane dé dona bam babɛ sem, pa se dé vere ba jejaano maama ba jeŋa ne. Ba maama tege mo ba tigi da chemm. Ba daa ware kolokolo ba ke, de ba na ye bembɛ tei de.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi tiina bam Wɛ wom, nmo na fugi de dona bam to mo ba sisein-nɔɔna bam de se dira bam zege ba maŋe da chemm.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Nmo yerane mo maŋe se nɔɔna taa kɔre‑m. Nmo bane ná zaŋe de wolo, kotu ware se o zege nmo yiga ne o na bora.

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Nmo nam zege Wɛ telaao ne mo n di n dona bam taane. Foone ma zo nabiina maama pa se ba ye chemm.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Du-na duuri á pa á Tu Baŋa Wɛ, se á daare á ke kolo á na pwooli se á ke to maama. O maŋe se nɔɔna taa kɔre‑o, se balo na bwola ded‑o to ja pɛɛra ba ba ba pa‑o.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: O pae se dedɛɛra gwooni ba tete mo. Logo baŋa pwa bam de maa kɔre‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Amo lage a keeri de kwor-dɛa mo a jare Wɛ. A ná lwoori‑o, o wó cheigi a taane dem.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: Amo cham maŋa kam ne mo a fɔɔre a twɛ a Teiru Wɛ tei. Tete dem maama ne mo a zeiŋi a je sem wɛɛne a lwoori‑o. Amo nam wo nɛ zurim a bochare ne.

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ se dɔɔm ba tui a yia ne. A bere a ware a ŋɔɔne de, a wo-chechɔgɔ kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: A nam yeini a guli faŋa faŋa da yam gula. A ma boŋe bena yalo na kɛ to boboŋa.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: ye a we, “Baŋa Wɛ wom wó ve-ne taa wuu mo na? O daa bá jwoori o ke-ne zaane na?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Wɛ swei se o duri dé ŋwaŋa mo na? O ta pɛ se o ban-zɔŋɔ kom leiri o zaane dem yuu ne mo na?”

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ta a we, “Woŋo kolo na pɛ se a wo chɔge to mo tento: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ba toŋe o woli debam.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó guli wo-kamunnu telo Baŋa Wɛ na ke to gula. Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ, a bá swei wo-kenkagela yalo nmo déem na ke to ni ne.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: A lage a boŋe n totoŋa yam maama boboŋa, se a daare a jeeli ya maama dedoa dedoa mo.

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Nmo yerane mo toŋe wo-kenkagela. N ta ma pa se dwi-gɛ tiina bam lɔre n dam dem ni ne.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye n tete nɔɔna bam na ye Jakob dedaane Josɛf dwi dem to, n déem kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom n ma n vere-ba n yage.

english_verse: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, na-fwaaro tem na nɛ nmo to, foone déem jaane-te. Na-luŋa kam yera de ma didigi.

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Kunkwonnu tem ma chuuri dedaane doa, ye doa kam de bage pina-pina. Ka ta daare ka pepele jei sem maama ne.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Nmo kwora kam na bage konto to, vio kom tiini ko wuuri mo. Doa kam de na pepele tei to pɛ se pwooni yi logo baŋa jei maama. Tega kam baŋa de ma tiini ka ziziŋi.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: Nmo déem tɔge naneo kom wo n bɛ. Nmo chwoŋa kam maa wo na-fwaaro tem tetare ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo nɛ n nɛ-bwora kam.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Nmo déem ma‑n tɔge Moses de Aron baŋa ne n da n nɔɔna bam yiga n vo, ne nayero na kale o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam, pore-na á zwa se á cheigi kolo a na jege se a ta a bere abam to.

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: A lage a puri a ni mo a ŋɔɔne botare-dende. A ta wó ŋɔɔne faŋa faŋa wo-siseigiru taane.

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: Te maa ye wonnu telo dé kwoa na tage ba bere debam ye dé cheigi to.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Wɛ déem kwei o bera yam de o nia yam mo o pa Isarele tiina bam na ye Jakob dwi tiina to. O ma daare o pa dé nabaara bam ni we, ba taa jege-ya ba bere ba bia bam.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina jar-keira bam déem fɔge ba che ba tete dedaane jara-keim zela. De ko de, jara yam dɛ dem laam na yi to, ba ma pipiri ba duri ba lu.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Ba bere ba wo ke ba tɔge Wɛ ni-gwonim dem na bere tei to. Ba maa wo tɔge o bera yam chwoŋa.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Ba déem swei Wɛ totoŋa yam ni ne mo, dedaane wo-kenkagela yalo o na ke o bere-ba to.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Wea maama ne o déem yeini o pa se kunkwoŋo mo tɔge ba yiga ko bere-ba chwoŋa se ba taa via. Ko daare tete ne, o tɔge min-vogo baŋa ne mo o pa-ba pwooni ye ba via.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Ba na wo kagoa yuu ne to mo o yare peero, pa se na ta ba nwoŋi tega kuri kuri ne, ye ba nyɔ ba su.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Ba déem yɔɔre ba paale mo ba faŋe Wɛ ba nii, de ba na lwoori‑o se o pa-ba wodiiru telo ba fera na zo to.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Ba ma tiini ba ŋwaane Wɛ ye ba we, “Wɛ za wó wane o na wodiu chekke se o pa debam kagoa kanto wone na?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Chega to, o mage peo kom pa se na dedɛ nwoŋi ko wone ba chuura. Se ko ná ye wodiu, o za wó wane o na nɔna o pa debam se dé do na?”

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ba wo ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Ba maa ba jege teena we o wó wane o jwoŋi-ba o yage.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa wɛyuu baŋa kam ni se ka pore nenɛɛne bworru mo tei.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Konto to, nabiina déem di malese sem wodiu mo. Wɛ déem pɛ-ba wodiu kolo maama na wó maŋe ba dim to.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa zuna bam jaane ba ba ba to o nɔɔna bam tigisim jeiga kam tetare ne, ba na chwi ba vwoa yam mɛ to.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Ba maama ma di ba su ba daare, Wɛ na pɛ-ba ba fera na zo wodiu kolo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɛ bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne. O ma go balo na tiini ba ye babɛ ba wone to. Isarele tiina nɔn-donno tem dedɛ mo o ti konto.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Wɛ na yeini o go ba badwonna to, balo na daare to laam pipiri ba fɔɔre ba yi o tei. Ba ma seene ba yia ba jwoori ba sɛ‑o.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Ba déem laam guli we Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo ye ba dalem jei, ye o ta kwori o ye ba Jwoŋinu wom.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Konto maama de, Wɛ ta duri ba yibwona. O yage ba wɛleera o ma o chɛ-ba, ye o peene o bane pa se o wo chɔge-ba.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: O nam ke o boboŋa ne we ba ye nabwona yerane mo. Ba maa nye de vio mo na dole ko kɛ tei to.

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ba na faŋe‑o ba nii tei konto to dae na-ni dedoa baŋa ne. Ba déem nam pɛ se Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom yera chɛ.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Ba ma swei o dam-fɔrɔ kom ni ne, de o na vere-ba ba dona bam jeŋa ne tei to maama.

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne Wɛ déem ke wo-kenkagela mo Zoan laŋa kam na wo Ejipti ne to wone.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: O déem leiri na balo na wo Ejipti bwi sem ne to mo pa se ba ji jana. Konto ŋwaane ba ma ga na se ba mɔ bwi sem ne ba nyɔ.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ta pɛ se zɔɔro mo ba te meeli Ejipti tiina bam te do. Nanchane de ma jwoŋi jei sem maama se chɔge tega kam.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye ba Vini teeni dem, de ba kaporro tem, Wɛ déem pɛ se do-kandwa dedaane do-fɔrɔ mo chɔge-te.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Do-kandwa mo o mɛ o dole ba naane dem o go. Doa kam ma pepele ka bage ba vare-mwa bam pa se ba de te.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem pɛ se o ban-lom yɔɔre de zaŋe ba baŋa ne mo. O wo ma tiini ko fuli pa se o toŋe lɛɛro ba yuu ne, te na nye de malese kɔgɔ kolo na jaane toone ko ba to.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Wɛ bane na tiini de zaŋe o tete nɔɔna bam baŋa ne konto to, o yage-ba mo pa ba tɔge jara baŋa ne ba te.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: Mini déem mo di ba nɔn-donno tem. Ba bukwa bam de daa ba nae baara se ba zo.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: Ba kaanem tiina bam de tege dam toone mo, ye ba kaana bam wo nɛ pwola se ba keeri ba lwi.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: O daa ta na lage zoorem jei to, o ve Josɛf bu Efrayim dwi tiina laŋa kam mo.

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: O ma kuri Judah dwi tiina laŋa kam, se o taa zoore Zion peo kom baŋa ne. Jeiga kalo o na swoi to mo konto.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: O ma fɔge o lɔ o wara-diga kam o zege ne wɛyuu baŋa kam na ye tei to. O ma pa ka tiini ka dana, ne o na naane tega baŋa kam se ka taa wora taa wuu tei to.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ta kuri David mo. O ma vaŋe‑o o ja o nwoŋi vara pwola ne se o taa ye o tontoŋeno.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Ba go n tete tontoŋena bam ye ba yage ba yera yam pwola ne, se duura dedaane kago-vara laam taa tui ba di-ya.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, n bane dem wó taa wo debam yuu ne taa se de vo de maŋe yei ne mo? N ban-lom dem wó taa wora wuu mo ne bulu mini na?

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ba nam yɔɔre ba ti Jakob dwi tiina bam ye ba daare ba chɔge ba tega kam mo.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Nam yé kwei dé kwoa bam wɛleera se n ma n waare debam ya ŋwaane. Nam ke lela n ba n duri dé yibwona, se dé teena maama ti mo.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane mo dwi-gɛ tiina bam wó taa jege debam ba gwoona ye ba tɛ we, “Banto Wɛ wom nam bɛ?” Dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto pɛ se n nɔɔna bam jana pwori. Jan ja! Ke keim se dé nii, se ba lɔre we n lage n ŋwe ba wɛleera jene mo ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Cheigi peena bam na vuvuni tei to! Ko ná ye balo na jege se ba go-ba to, jwoŋi ba ŋwea n yage se ba ta taa ŋwe.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Baŋa We, jwoori n ŋwe n jene teene delo na bwola dedaane debam to baŋa ne kuni berepɛ, de ba na tiini ba twe‑m tei to.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, cheigi debam lworo kom! Nmo ye Isarele dwi tiina bam nayero mo. N yeini n tɔge Josɛf dwi tiina bam yiga n via ne nayero na kale o pei tei to mo. Nmo ye wolo na di paare cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne. Nam pa n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nyeene ko lɔre jaja,

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: ko pa Efrayim, de Benjamin, de Manasɛ dwi tiina bam. Zaŋe de n dam se n daare n ba n jwoŋi debam n yage!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, pa dé jwoori dé zege de dam! Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni se dé na verem.

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se dé na tiini dé ka yi-na balo to mo ji debam ni-wodiu. Dé maa nyɔ dé yi-na bam dé su.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Nmo ta pɛ se teene delo na gilimi debam to bane zaŋe debam ŋwaane. Dé dona bam maa jege debam ba mɔna.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Wɛ wom, pa dé jwoori dé zege de dam! Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni se dé na verem.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: N kwɛ tega kam n pa debam, ye dé fɔge dé yerege dé su tega kam maama.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Konto to, bɛ nam daa mo kea ye n pa tega kam laam ji di-dwonnu? Veira de nɛ chwoŋa se ba zo ba vere ba boboŋa wonnu.

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Ko nye de ga-teira mo nwoŋi kagoa wone ya vei ya nɔne ya chɔge Vini tio kom, ye kago-vara de vei ba di tio-bia bam maama.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Wɛ wom, pipiri n jwoori n ba debam tei! Zege wɛyuu ne n tiiri n nii debam seeni. Fɔge n nii debam balo na ye n nɔɔna to baŋa ne.

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: Dé ye Vini tio kolo nmo tete na jeiri to mo. Nam ba n kwɛ n bu wolo n na kɔne se o ke nɔɔno to.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Dé dona bam gwoni nmo Vini tio kom ba de tega ne, ye ba daare ba zwɛ-ko. Zaŋe n bwɛ-ba se ba na chɔgem.

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Ko daare se n pa wolo n na kuri to zege de dam, o na ye nabiinu bu wolo n na kɔne se o ke nɔɔno to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Konto, dé daa bá jwoori dé lɔ nmo kwaga ne. Nam pa dé jwoori dé na ŋwea, se dé wane dé bwoŋi n yere dem dé pa‑m zula.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ pa dé jwoori dé zege de dam! Pa n yibia jeeri debam seeni se dé na verem.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo ye wolo na pae debam dam to. Leeni-na de kwor-dɛa á zuli‑o! Bage-na de wopwolo á zuli Jakob dwi tiina Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Bage-na leiŋa! Wɔ-na senyɛ, se á daare á ta-na kwanno dwi dwi se te kwori taa ywomma.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Wu-na nabwanno chan-doŋa kam maŋa ne, se ko woli de chan-pwoŋa maŋa kam de, dé na bobo dé kuri dim to ne.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi tiina bam Wɛ wom mo pɛ ni se á ke konto Isarele teo kom ne.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: O déem na nwoŋi se o vere Josɛf dwi tiina bam o yage Ejipti tiina bam jeŋa ne to mo o pɛ bera yam konto. Amo nigi kwora mo ye a wo lɔre ka tu. Ka maa we:

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Amo dɔne zela yalo ya na wo á bakale baŋa ne to a yage dáa ne, ye a daare a jwoŋi á totoŋ-dɛɛra yam á jeŋa ne se á sii.

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na, se amo mo lage a korese abam Isarele tiina bam, ko ya maŋe se á sɛ se á cheigi amo bera yam.

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Ko dae se á daa ta‑á jege wɛ-gaa á woli amo wone. Yé tiiri-na tega ne á zuli wɛ delo na ye sa-teena nyem to.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Amo yerane mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, a na jaane abam a ja a nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne to. Puri-na á nia jaja, se a lage a ke wo-laaro dedɛ mo da a pa abam.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: De konto maama de, amo nɔɔna bam ba lage se ba taa cheigi amo taane dem. Amo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam wo sɛ ba pa-ne.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Ko nam ya maŋe se a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam sɛ a ni, ye ba ta tɔge a chwei sem.

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Ba ya ná ke konto, a ya wó wane ba dona bam lela, de a jeŋa na yɔɔre ka zo-ba tei to.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Wolo maama de na chuli-ne to maa wó ba o gwane amo yiga ne de foone. Kotu maa wó na waarem taa wuu.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Amo nam ya wó pa abam wodi-laaro dedaane tooro se á ta‑á di á sui.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Wɛ mo tɔge de wɛyuu dedɛɛra badwonna o jei ba kɔgɔ kom yiga ne. O laam maa lage o zege ba maama tetare ne o di ba taane.

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á yiga taa wo nabwona de botara wone mo, se á daare á zege balo na nɛ bɛɛsem de chanɛɛre to kwaga ne.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye zora de yiniga tiina, se á jwoŋi-ba puseŋ-nyena bam jeŋa ne á yage.”

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam konto nam yeiri kolokolo ye ba boboŋa tera. Ba kare ba taane mo lim wone. Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋa ka tu ka yi ka kuri maama.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Amo déem tage a we, “Á ye wa mo. Abam maama ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom bia.

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: De konto de, abam jege se á te mo, nenɛɛne nabiina de dedɛɛra maama na jege se ba te tei to.”

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Wɛ wom, zaŋe wɛɛne n ke n totoŋa! Zaŋe n di nabiina taane! Kokuri, nmo mo tei logo baŋa teene dem maama.

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nii mo! N dona bam tiini ba vuvugi mo. Balo na chuli‑m to ke chichuŋu de nmo.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Ba bane daane mo ba we, “Ba-na se dé ke daane dé chɔge ba maama se ba dwi dem ti, se ba yere saare logo baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Nam zaŋe n chɔge banto maama nenɛɛne n déem na toŋe tei de Midian tiina bam to. Ke-ba ne n na ke Sisera de Jabin yera ne tetei ye n di-ba Kison buga kam seeni to.

english_verse: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.
translation_verse: Nmo de nam ke konto dwoŋi n kwei vo-fɔrɔ n ma n pare-ba se foone tiini de ja-ba.

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ta pa se chaveera yɔɔre de ja-ba se ba kwoli ba yibia, ye ba daare ba sɛ ba pa n yere dem.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Sɛ se chaveera de foone ja banto taa wuu, se ba daare ba yaale ba te.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Nmo wolo yere na ye Baŋa Wɛ to, pa se ba lɔre we nmo yerane mo ye Yuu-tu Wɛ wom ye n tei logo kom baŋa maama.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ! Jei selo nmo na zoore to tiini se lana se pa-ne!

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Balo maama na zoore nmo wara-jei sem wone to tiini ba jege yu-ywoŋo lanyerane. Banto wó taa leeni tia lei mo ba zuli‑m.

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Balo na dɛ nmo ŋwaane ba na dam to jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ. Banto mo ye balo na ke ba boboŋa ne se ba vo ba yi nmo tei Zion teo kom wone to.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Ba na wora ba tɔge Baka bwolo kom ba kɛ to, na-zura yeini ba buri jei sem konto ne mo. Doa de maa yeini ka nena ye ka tagele jei sem maama de chwaro.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Ba vei yiga de dam mo ba maa kɛa, se ba laam vo ba yi Zion teo kom ba vo ba zege Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, fɔge n nii dé pɛ wom baŋa ne, de o na cho debam dé cham wone to ŋwaane. Pa n yiga taa wo pɛ wolo nmo na kuri to wone.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye pwooni mo o pa debam. O daa ta maa cho debam dedaane cham. O maa nii debam baŋa ne ye o pa dé na zaane de zula lanyerane. Ko ná ye balo na tɔge chwoŋa ye ba ba tusi to, o ba ve-ba wo-laaro de dedoa de.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, balo maama na sɛ nmo de wo-dedoa to seene ba jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ!

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ se n zaane wo n tega kam baŋa ne. Nmo ma-n pa se Jakob dwi tiina bam jwoori ba zege de dam.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: N ta kwei n nɔɔna bam tusim dem mo n yage n ma‑n chɛ-ba, pa se ba wɛleera maama kwoli.

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n zuri n ban-lom dem se de daa yé taa wo debam yuu ne.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Nmo Wɛ ye debam Vereno mo. Ja, pa se dé jwoori dé fɔge dé zege de dam. Daa‑n yé ma n kwaga n ya debam.

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: N bá‑n jwoori n pa dé fɔge dé na yazura na? N ná ke konto, debam balo na ye n nɔɔna to daa wó taa di ywoni nmo ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, o lage o ke lela mo o jwoŋi balo na kɔre‑o to o yage. Konto maa wó pa se o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa nae jaja debam tega kam jei maama ne.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Swono dedaane chega tɔgem mo jeeri daane. Nɔn-ŋonne kikia de yazura maa kukwori daane.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Ka-zege-ka-chega-wone mo lage ka ta ka nwoŋi tega ne. Ka-tɔge-chega de maa zege wɛyuu ne ka nii tega baŋa seeni.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ wó pa dé na wo-laaro. Dé tega kam de maa wó ke wodiiru kɛɛla-kɛɛla ka pa debam.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Chega borem mo tɔge Wɛ yiga ka via, pa se o na chwoŋa o tɔge da.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pore n zwa se n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom, se amo ye nabwom mo ye yiniga jege-ne.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Ta‑n cho a ŋwea, a na ke a chega de nmo to ŋwaane. A ye n tontoŋeno mo, ye a ta ke a wo-dedoa dede‑m. Jwoŋi-ne n yage, se nmo mo ye amo Tu Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, duri amo yibwona, se a yɔɔre a keeri a jare nmo mo dɛ dem maama wone.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ta pa se a di ywoni. Amo Teiru, nmo mo a kwei a tete a pa‑m.

english_verse: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru, nmo dwoŋi tera wa yam maama wone. Nmo totoŋ-kamuna yam de ba jege dwoŋi.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo tiini n jege dam ye n toŋe wo-kenkagela dedɛ. Nmo yerane mo nam ye Wɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, amo wó tiini a tei‑m de a bochare maama. A ta wó zuli n yere dem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, nmo na tiini n swoi amo tei to gaale. N ma‑n che toone se de yé wane-ne de ja.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, banegero nyena mo zaŋe ba zege amo zega. Nankɔɔre nyena ma ke daane ba kwaane se ba go-ne. A dona bam konto yiga tera de nmo.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jege nabiina ŋwaŋa, ye n ke zaane n ke ba yuu ne. N ma‑n yeini n peene n bane. N swono kom gaale, ye n chega kam de bá fɔge ka ti.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Nam tiiri n nii amo seeni, se n daare n duri a ŋwaŋa. A ye n tontoŋeno mo. Pa se a fɔge a na dam. Chega to, a ye kabaa mo n sɔŋɔ ne. Nam jwoŋi-ne n yage.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: O nam tiini o swoi ko taane se ko dwoni teene delo maama Jakob dwi tiina na zoore de wone to.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Zion, nmo ye Wɛ tete teo mo! Ba yeini ba jege wo-kamuna dwi dwi mo ba ŋɔɔna ba pa‑m. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a tɛ balo na sɛ amo to taane, Ejipti de Babilon tiina mo wó woli ba wone. Nii-na, Filisi tiina, de Tura tiina, ko ta woli de Kusi tiina, ba maama wó ta ba we, “Ba loge wonto Zion wone mo.”

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó popone dwi tiina maama yera dedoa dedoa o tiŋi. O maa wó ta we, “Ba loge wonto de Zion wone mo.”

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Ba maama wó taa kwɛɛra ye ba leeni ba we, “Amo kuri dem nwoŋi Zion teo ne mo.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye wolo na vere-ne n yage to. Amo nam keeri a jare nmo mo wea dedaane tete maama.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ja, pore n zwa n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom, se n daare n zeini-ne.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Chanɛɛra dedɛ tiini ya daane a ŋwea maama mo, pa se toone lage de ja-ne lela.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Amo ba gare balo na maŋe ba te ye ba tigi ba bɔɔna wone to. A maa nye de balo n na swei ba ni ne ye n yiga daa tere ba wone to.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: N yɔɔre n dole-ne mo n yage gwoŋ-chanluŋu wone, pa se a jei yibiri wone.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: A laam keeri keeri pa a yia suli de yi-na, a wo na chɔge to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ, dɛ maama wone amo keeri a jare nmo mo. A maa yeini a zeiŋi a jea a lwoori zeinim n tei ne.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na tege to, nmo ta toŋe wo-kenkagela n pa-ba na? Banto daa wó wane ba zaŋe wɛɛne se ba taa tei‑m na?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ko na maŋe ko zege a nɔn-donne maŋa ne to a yɔɔre a yaare taa mo ye toone tiini de bwola a tei ne. Nmo pɛ se chanɛɛra yɔɔre ya fugi-ne mo, pa se a dam maama ti.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Nmo ban-lom dem dwoi amo jaanem. N ta na lwogi lɛɛro telo amo yuu ne to mo lage te pa a ŋwea kam chɔge.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se a fara de a badwoŋ-swonnu maama lɔŋe-ne. Leile konto yibiri yerane mo wo amo tei ne.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa leeni mo a seini Baŋa Wɛ swono kikia yam, ye a bá yage. Amo ni taane dem wó pa se nɔɔna maama de ba bia bam lɔre nmo na zege n chega kam wone tei to.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Chega to, n swono kom wora mo taa wuu ye ko bá jei. Maŋa maama n zege n chega wone, nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na fɔge ko jege dam taa wuu tei to.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Nmo, Baŋa Wɛ tage n we: “Amo ke ni-sɛɛm mo de Pɛ wolo a na kuri to. Wonto ye a tontoŋeno David ye a dugi duuri dedaane‑o we:

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, wɛyuu kom maama mo lage ko seini nmo totoŋ-kamunnu tem. Chega to, wɛyuu malese sem maa gilimi se tei nmo, de n na zege de chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Malese sem ná jeeri nmo yiga ne, se wó taa kɔre foone de nmo mo, nmo na tiini n maŋe de zula n dwoi balo maama na wora to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ba jege dwoŋi! Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na jege dam nenɛɛne nmo to. Nmo keina maama wone mo n zege n chega kam wone.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Nmo déem jaane naneo wo juru Rahaba n chochoge. N ta mɛ n dam dem n zeili n dona bam maama pa ba jage.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Wɛyuu dedaane tega baŋa maama ye nmo nyem mo. Logo baŋa de woŋo kolo maama na wo ko wone to, ko ye nmo mo naane te maama.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, balo na yei se ba zuli n yere dem to jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ. Nmo lanyerane dem mo kwoli-ba ba veiŋa maama wone.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem maama wone ba yeini ba tei n yere de wopwolo. Ba maa pa‑m zula, n na tɔge chega yerane to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Nmo mo ye wolo na pae debam dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to. Nmo na yeini n ke zaane debam yuu ne to mo pa dé di wɔnɔ.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to, n déem veere n tete de n ni-jwoŋina bam ye n we: “Amo zeini bembea dedoa pa se o jwoŋi dam. Chega to, a kuri nɔn-doŋo nabwona wone ye a daare a zeiŋi‑o se o na zula.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Amo mo lage a pa o zege cheppe. A ta wó twe a jeŋa se a pa o na dam.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: O dona bá fɔge ba zaŋe o baŋa ne ba wane‑o. Puseŋ-nyena de nam bá wane ba bɛɛse‑o.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa zege o kwaga ne maŋa maama. A swono kom de wó taa wo o tei ne. A ta wó pa o na dam de zula amo tete yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Pɛ David wó taa bwoi a yere ye o we, ‘Nmo mo ye amo Kwo. N ta maa ye amo Wɛ wom. N ye peo kolo na ye amo dalem jei to mo ye a na verem n tei ne.’

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Chega to, a lage a pa o ji amo bu-kwea mo. O wó di paare se ko taa dwoi logo baŋa pwa bam maama.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: A swono kom wó taa wo o tei ne taa wuu. A daa bá fɔge a lɔ ni-sɛɛm delo a na ke ded‑o to kwaga ne.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa o dwi dem taa wora taa wuu, de bá jei, pa se o bia wone nɔɔno taa di paare, nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na wora taa wuu tei to.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo o bia bam wó lɔ amo nia yam kwaga ne, ye ba ve se ba taa tɔge amo chwei sem.

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: Ba wae ba yage a bera yam, ye ba ve a ni-kaana yam.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, a daa bá chɔge a swono kom a na jege de David to. Amo ta wó taa zege a chega kam kwaga ne a pa‑o.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Bedwe baŋa ne mo a dugi duuri ded‑o a tete yere dem ŋwaane, ye ko ti. A bere a bá fɔ vwa ded‑o.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo bane laam nam zaŋe mo. Ko ná ye pɛ wolo nmo tete na kuri to, nmo mɛ n kwaga n ya wonto, ye n ve‑o.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: N ta ma chɔge ni delo n na gwoni de n tontoŋeno wom to ye n daare n dole o paare yipuga kam n de tega ne pa kasolo taare ka maama.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se o teo kom kabiri sem bwori se to tega ne. Dam jei selo ya na wó kwoli‑o to laam jigi di-dwonnu.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: N kwei o paare zela yam n dole n yage, pa se o daa ba jege nenɔŋa.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: N ta pɛ se kokweero mo yi‑o lela, ye o jege o chaveera o di. Wɛ-lworo zeinim ŋwaane

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Yé swei we amo ŋwea kam ye kukua mo. Bɛ mo ye n pa se nabiina maama ŋwea ye kafɛ yerane konto?

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo déem dugi duuri we n swono kom wó taa wo Pɛ David tei ne. N swono kom konto laam nam jei mo na? N ta zege n chega kam kwaga ne na?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to nɛ a chaveera, Nɔɔna jege-ne ba ke ba mɔna dedɛ. Laam nam guli amo gula.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de tia se ko taa vei wuu! Ameena! Ameena! Lei Tɔnɔ

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Peero tem ya ta na tera to, nmo maŋe n ye Wɛ mo. N maŋe n wora mo ye n ta wo naane tega kam de logo baŋa maama. Nmo ba jege pulim, ye n nam ta ba jege gurim.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Nmo pae nabiina jwoori ba jiri teero mo, ye n we: “Nɔn-bia bam, jwoori-na á ji teero!”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Bena moro dae kolokolo nmo tei ne! Yanto nye dedaane dɛ dedoa na ke lela de kɛ tei to mo. Ya nye de awa yalei naa yatɔ tete-koro ne mo ya pa‑m.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Nmo yeini n pa se dé ŋwea kam ba ka kweeli lela, nenɛɛne dendwea na ti ye ka jei tei to mo. Nabiina nye de ga-lɛɛro na nwoŋi te-pora ne to mo.

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: Zezeŋa ne mo te yeini te puli ye te lana. Ko daare dedaan-ni maŋa ne te wó kwaare mo.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Debam wɛleera mo jare nmo yiga ne. Keim-balwaaro telo dé na ke dé seigi to de maa lɔre jaja nmo tei ne.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Nabiinu ŋwea wae ka ye nenɛɛne bena fuserepɛ mo. Yazura ná wora, badwonna bere ba yi bena funɔnɔ. De ná maŋe dé jege teera yalo, dé ŋwea kam yeini ka jaane yaara de wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo ka tui. Dé da yam pɔpɔ ya ti mo, ye dé daare dé jei lela.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o lɔre nmo ban-zɔŋɔ kom na daga tei to. N bane dem jaane foone mo de tui de ma de fugi nɔɔna.

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Zezeŋa ná yia, pa n swono kom su debam bochara. Dé laam wó taa leeni de wopwolo, ye ywoni wora se ko vo ko yi dé ŋwea kam kweelim.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Nam zaŋe n toŋe wo-kamunnu n pa debam balo na ye n tontoŋena to. Pa dé bia bam lɔre n na tiini n jege nenɔŋa tei to.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Debam Teiru Wɛ, pa n zaane taa wo debam yuu ne! Ja, pa dé totoŋa yam ke lanyerane. Ɛɛ, pa ya tiini ya ke lanyerane.

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná zoore Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ woro kom wone, Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom wó kwoli kotu pa se o na siu.

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: Amo wó ta Baŋa Wɛ taane mo we, “Wonto mo ye amo dalem jei, amo na wó seigi o woro kom wone to ŋwaane. O maa ye amo Tu Wɛ, ye a ke a wo-dedoa ded‑o.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho‑m se zaana dwi maama yé wane‑m ya ja. Jawe-chɛɛro de bá na chwoŋa se te daane‑m.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Nmo bá‑n ta‑n kɔre tete dem dedaane de foone maama. Che-tɛɛra mo ná jaana ya tɔge n seeni wea ne de, nmo bá‑n kɔre foone.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna moro naa morro fuga ná wo nmo tei ne, ye ba maama ná maŋe ba te jara wone, kolokolo bá yi‑m.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nmo nam mo wó zege da n nii n na waarem na wó ba puseŋ-nyena bam baŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ji nmo dalem jei, pa se n zoore o woro kom wone.

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, lwarem daa bá wane‑m de ja. Kolokolo de bá chɔge‑m n sɔŋɔ kom ne.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó toŋe o malese sem nmo tei ne, se ba taa cho‑m de cham n chwoŋa maama wone,

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: se ba daare ba ma ba jea ba lwori‑m, se n yé mage n naga de kandwɛ n to tega ne.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Nmo wó ta‑n jege dam nywonnu de basankwe baŋa ne, se n wane n nɔne te baŋa ne. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: “Amo wó jwoŋi wonto a yage, o na jege amo swono to ŋwaane. Amo wó taa cho‑o, o na sɛ amo de wo-dedoa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: O ná bwoŋi amo yere se a woli‑o, amo wó sɛ a cheigi o wɛ-lworo kom. O ta ná wo cham wone, a wó le‑o de wone, a daare a pa o yere zaŋe.

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se dé taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, dé wó leeni dé tei nmo yere.

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Zezeŋa maama ne dé wó ta n swono kom taane. Tete ne de, dé ta wó bere n na yɔɔre n zege n chega kam wone tei to.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo toŋe totoŋ-zana dedɛ. Nmo boboŋa yam de tiini ya lira.

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena ná maŋe ba puli dedɛ ne gaaro na kwi tei to, ye nɔn-balwaaro de ná vei yiga mo de, ba maama wó ba ba jei mo.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Nmo Baŋa Wɛ nam jege n paare n di mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Nmo nam pɛ se a tiini a na dam mo, ne ga-naao na dana tei to. N ta ma lwo nuga a yuu ne pa se a yera yam zuri lanyerane.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona wó taa jege nyɔɔre mo ne suŋu na ye tei to. Ba wó taa damma ne Lebanon teo Sedare teeni na zege te ma da te ma da tei to.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Ba nye ne ba kugu mo wo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne to. Ba maa wó taa zoore de yazura Wɛ wara-jei sem ne.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Ba kokweero maŋa ne ba ta wó taa jege nyɔɔre, ne teeni delo na leiri bia to mo. Maŋa maama yazura wó yi-ba, ye ba ke totoŋ-laaro.

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: Ba maa wó taa tɛ jaja we, “Baŋa Wɛ toŋe chega mo. Tusim tera o tei ne. O maa nye de peo kolo amo na dale da to.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ! Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ mo ye gɔrɔ kolo o na zo to. Dam-fɔrɔ maa wo o jeŋa ne. O naane logo kom pa se ko zege mo ga cheppe. Ko bá fɔge ko gɔ maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ! Nii na-fwaaro tem na dɔne de kwor-dɛa tei! Te na-ŋone sem tiini se wuuri dedɛ!

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Naneero tem ná maŋe te wuuri de baare, ye te ná dɔne de dam tei maama, nmo nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nam mo dwoi tento maama. Baŋa Wɛ mo jege dam wɛyuu ne!

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ! Nmo nia yam yɔɔre ya zege mo. Nmo sɔŋɔ kom ye se ko taa ye wose mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye wolo na jwoori o ŋwe jene wɛle-keira baŋa ne to mo. Nam pa n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nye ko taa lɔre jaja!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n ye wolo na bore chega bora logo baŋa ne to. Konto to, zaŋe wɛɛne se n waare boyere-nyena bam se ko maŋe de ba kikia.

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, puseŋ-nyena bam wó taa chaka taa se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ná yeini n korese wolo maama, kotu tiini o jege yu-ywoŋo, nmo na kwei n nia yam n ma n bere‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: N ta yeini n pa kotu na siu de yaara yalo na wó yi‑o to, se ba laam ko gwoŋo se puseŋ-nyena to ko wone ba te.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, ba daa ta wó da chega kam ŋwaane ba bore nɔɔna bora. Balo maama na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone to wó sɛ ba tɔge chega kam konto mo.

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Ko ya ná dae Baŋa Wɛ mo tu o woli-ne, tento amo ya tega, ye a vo churu a maŋe da chemm.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Lwia ná tiini ya jege-ne, nmo wó pa a bochare jwoori de zuri mo.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Ko daare, Baŋa Wɛ nam mo ye amo dalem jei. O maa nye de peo kolo amo na sale ko yera ne to.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoori o ŋwe ba wɛleera yam jene. Chega to, o lage o yɔɔre o chɔge-ba mo ba totoŋ-lwanno tem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé vo o yiga dé ke o lei, ye dé leeni lei dé zuli‑o de wopwolo.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o ye Wɛ-kamunu kom! O maa ye Pa-faro, ye o dwoi wa yam maama wuu.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Tega kam kuri wo wonto ja-bɔŋɔ ne mo. Peero tem tete yupara maa ye o nyem.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Wonto mo tei naneo kom, o na ke-ko to ŋwaane. O daa ta mɛ o tete jea o ke tega baŋa maama.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Kokuri to, o ye debam Tu Wɛ mo. Dé maa ye wonto nɔn-kɔgɔ kom. O maa yeini o nii debam baŋa ne ne nayero na nii o pei tei to. Abam zem nam jege se á ni Wɛ kwora:

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: “Á yé pa á wo ke dam, ne á nabaara déem na ke tei Meriba de Massa ne, maŋa kalo ba na wo kagoa kam yuu ne to.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo bane zaŋe de á nabaara bam konto taa, se ko vo ko yi bena finna. A maa we: ‘Ba ye balo na yeini ba paale ba tusi to mo. Ba maa ba sɛa se ba tɔge amo chwei sem.’

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ. Nabiina maama, leeni-na á pa-o-na.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Leeni-na á zeiŋi o yere dem. Dɛ maama wone se á tɔɔle-na o taane we o ye verem tu.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina lɔre we o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom gaale. Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ni o totoŋ-kamunnu tem ŋwa.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ jege kamunni mo. O ma seene o maŋe dedaane tia. Nɔɔna jege se ba taa kɔre‑o se ko dwoni wa yam maama.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wa yalo dwi-gɛ tiina na zuli to ye jwona mo. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu maama.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Kamunni dedaane paare mo wo o tei ne. Dam de nenɔŋa de maa wo o tete diga kam ne.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, kwei-na zula á pa Baŋa Wɛ. O na jege dam de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to ŋwaane, kwei-na zula á pa‑o.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Ta-na jaja se dwi maama tiina ni we, “Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ!” O naane logo kom pa se ko zege mo ga cheppe. Ko bá fɔge ko gɔ maŋa de maŋa. O ta wó tɔge chega mo o ma bore nɔɔna maama bora.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Pa se wɛyuu kom taa di ywoni! Pa se tega kam baŋa taa jege wopwolo! Ta pa se naneo kom taa wuura, konto de wonnu telo maama na wo ko wone to.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Pa se kare dedaane se wodiiru tem maama taa chaka! Teeni delo maama na wo goa ne to laam wó leeni lei-ywei.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ. Logo baŋa maama di-na ywoni! Teene delo na wo naneo ni ne to wó taa chaka de wopwolo.

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Kunkwon-lilirru mo kaare‑o te ke tetare ne. O paare dem jege dam, o na tɔge chega o tei nɔɔna to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: O na pae se doa pepele tei to maa pae se pwooni yi logo baŋa jei maama. Tega kam baŋa maa nae ye ka ziziŋa.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo logo baŋa peero tem saare te to buri-buri, o na tei tega kam baŋa maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom tete tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam taane mo, se nabiina maama taa nae o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Balo maama na zuli jwona to lage ba di ba chaveera mo. Ba jege ni-wɛɛle ba ŋɔɔna ba jwo-yɔɔro tem ŋwaane mo. Wa-yɔɔro tem maama nam jege se te pipiri te ba te zuli Baŋa Wɛ mo!

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Balo na zoore Zion de Judah teene dedwonna dem ne to laam wó ni ko kuri ye ba di ywoni, Baŋa Wɛ na bore chega bora to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo Baŋa Wɛ ye Yuu-tu Wɛ wom na tei logo kom baŋa maama to mo. Nmo tiini n jege yere n dwoi wa yadwonna yam maama wuu.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na swoi Baŋa Wɛ to, ta‑á chuli-na lwarem totoŋa. Ko ná ye Wɛ tete nɔɔna bam, o yeini o cho-ba mo, ye o vere-ba puseŋ-nyena jeŋa ne o yaga.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Pwooni mo wó nye nɔn-laaro yiga ne. Ywoni maa wó yi balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao to.

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa á ma á tei Baŋa Wɛ, se o yɔɔre o toŋe wo-kenkagela mo. O mɛ o tete dam-fɔrɔ kom na ba jege dwoŋi to mo o yɔɔre o di wɔnɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se nabiina lɔre we o jege dam se o vere nɔɔna o yage. Dwi-gɛ tiina bam ma na o na zege o chega wone tei to.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa wonnu maama, bage-na de wopwolo á tei Baŋa Wɛ! Ta‑á chaka de ywoni ye á leeni-na tia lei!

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Ta-na kwanno á ma á kwɛɛre Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne, se á daare á leeni á seini‑o.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Wu-na nabwanno dwi dwi se te sɔɔ taa zaŋa. Véi-na Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye á Pɛ to yiga ne, á bage de wopwolo á zuli‑o.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Naneo kom de ko wo wonnu tem maama jege se te taa wuuri te ke sɔɔ mo! Logo kom baŋa de ko nɔn-bia de jege se ba bage de baare mo.

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Bu-tola dwi maama wó mage ka je mo. Peero tem de maa wó tɔge daane te leeni wopwolo lei.

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: Ba maama seini Baŋa Wɛ, de o na maa beene se o di nabiina taane to. Wɛ lage o da chega ŋwaane mo o bore logo baŋa dwi maama bora.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye Pɛ! Logo baŋa dwi maama jege se ba taa kɔre‑o mo ye ba yera sae. Wɛ di paare cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne mo. Tega baŋa maama wó ziziŋi!

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ jei de kamunni mo Zion ne. O jege dam logo baŋa teene dem maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se nɔɔna maama taa tei o yere dem, de na ye kamunu ye de ta jege foone to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wo-pwoŋo tu!

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Tei-na dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ se á zeiŋi o yere dem. Kuni-na nadwoona á zuli‑o, o na ye wo-pwoŋo tu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Moses de Aron déem wo Wɛ kaanem tiina bam wone mo. Samuwel de déem maa jege Wɛ yere dem o ma o ware‑o. Banto déem lwoori zeinim Baŋa Wɛ tei ne ye o sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo déem yeini n leiri ba wɛ-lworo. N déem yeini n kwei n nɔɔna bam wɛleera n ma‑n chɛ-ba mo. Ba nam ná toŋe lwarem, n déem ma‑n yeini n vaŋe ba zwa.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Tei-na dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ ye á zeiŋi o yere dem. Yi-na peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete to á zuli‑o. Kokuri to, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Tega baŋa nabiina maama, bage-na de kwor-dɛa á tei Baŋa Wɛ se á di ywoni!

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ dedaane wopwolo! Ba-na o yiga ne ye á leeni lei selo na ywona to.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Sɛ-na de á wo maama we Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o ye Wɛ chekke. Dé maa ye o nyem. Dé ye o nɔɔna mo. O maa yeini o nii debam baŋa ne ne nayero na nii o pei-kɔgɔ tei to.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Amo wó leeni a seini n swono kom de n na bore chega bora tei to. Amo wó leeni a tei nmo Baŋa Wɛ yere dem.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: A ta wó taa cho a tete mo se a yé tusi chwoŋa kam wone. Nmo nam bá‑n ba n woli-ne lela na? Amo tete sɔŋɔ kom ne a wó taa toŋe a tɔge chega kam.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná bae o dwoŋi bebara, amo wó chɔge kotu a yage. Ko ta ná ye balo na bere ba tete kamunim to, amo bá pa-ba pwola se ba toŋe.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Amo bá sɛ se kampin-nyena taa zoore a sɔŋɔ kom ne. Vwa-fɔra de nam bá taa twɛ-ne.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Zezeŋa maama wone amo wó chɔge balo na toŋe puseŋa tega kam ne to a yage. A ta wó che balo na toŋe lwarem dwi maama to se ba yé zo Baŋa Wɛ tete teo kom wone.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Cham na yi amo to, yé virigi n kwaga n ya-ne. Nam pore n zwa n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom. A ná keeri a jare‑m, se n ke lela n leiri-ne.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: A maa yɔɔre a suura, lwia na jege-ne to ŋwaane. Ko maa pae a yera kwi sem yɔɔre se nae jaja.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: A maa nye de a ye kagoa wo kunkworo, de ko na jei di-dwonnu wone tei to.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem maama wone a dona bam jege-ne mo ba twea. Balo na chuli-ne to ma bwoŋi a yere ba sɔɔle lwarem ba yage a baŋa ne.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Amo laam mɛ tentwarem mo a ma a ji a ni-wodiu, ye a yi-na lura na balo a na jege a nyɔ to wone.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, dwi-gɛ tiina bam wó ba ba taa kɔre n yere dem. Logo baŋa pwa bam maama wó taa tei‑m, n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
