translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ zege o wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne mo o dole o yia o nii logo kom baŋa na ye tei to.

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: O ma yɔɔre o ni peena bam na vuvuni tei to, ye o daare o jwoŋi balo ba na lage ba go to ŋwea o yage se ba taa ŋwe.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Amo nɔn-donne maŋa kam ne mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se amo dam ti. O pɛ se a ŋwea kam tiini ka ke kukua.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: A ma lwoori‑o a we, “Amo Tu Wɛ, yé pa se a te lela ye a dɛ wo yi. Nmo tete bena yam nam wó taa vei yiga mo wuu.

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to, nmo déem mo chwi tega kam kuri, ye n ta kwori n ma n jea n naane wɛyuu wonnu maama.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ta wó ta‑n ye ne n na maŋe n ye tei to mo. N bena yam bá fɔge ya ti.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!” O yere dem na ye wose to, amo wó tei‑o se ko nwoŋi a bochare-yi ne.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!” A bá fɔge a swei o na ke-ne lanyerane tetei maama to.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Wonto mo yeini o yage a wɛleera maama o ma chɛ-ne. O ta maa pa-ne yazura a jaweero maama wone.

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: O yeini o pa a ŋwea kam maama su de wo-laaro, pa se ka jwoori ka na dam-doore, ne maao na jege dam tei to.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: O déem pɛ se Moses lɔre o chwei sem. O ta ma pa se Isarele tiina bam lɔre o totoŋ-naga na ye tei to.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege yibwona dedaane zaane o maa zeini nɔɔna. O yeini o peene o bane mo. O swono kom maa tiini ko daga.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ko dae we o lage o taa bwɛ nɔɔna maŋa maama mo. O ban-zɔŋɔ kom wó ba ko zuri.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na kɔre Wɛ to, o swono kom tiini ko daga ko pa-ba! O swono kom daga ko gaale, nenɛɛne wɛyuu kom na diini vili-vili ko gaale tega kam baŋa tei to mo.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: O ta ma yage dé wɛleera yam o ma chɛ debam, o daare o dole-ya o yage yiga yiga, se ko yi wɛ-puli dedaane wɛ-zoore na ye yiga yiga daane tei to.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege balo na kɔre‑o to yibwona, ne kwo na yeini o duri o bia yibwona tei to.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Lon-wea vio ná tu ko dole te baŋa ne, te wó kwaare ye te jei lela, nenɛɛne te ya ga maŋe te tera mo to.

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ jei wɛyuu ne mo o di o paare. O maa tei maama wuu!

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Abam balo na ye Baŋa Wɛ malese to, ba-na á tei‑o! Abam balo na tɔge o nia yam á toŋe á pa‑o de baare to, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa na ke woŋo kolo maama to, ba-na á tei‑o, á ná maŋe á wo o paare dim jei selo maama ne. Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!” Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo tiini n jege kamunim! Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ dedaane paare mo kwoli‑m.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Nmo déem fɔge n chwi tega baŋa kuri dem, pa se ka zege mo ga cheppe ye ka daa ba gɔe.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Nmo daa‑n ta ma‑n pae se na-fwaaro kwoli logo kom, ne gɔrɔ na kwoli-ko tei to. Na-fwaaro tem bere te kwoli peero tem de.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n tiŋi siseina n pa na bam se ba yé lɛɛne-ya, se na-fwaaro tem daa yé li logo kom te di.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Nmo mo pae se buli-yia tae bwollu tem ne, ye bu-nwaro de maa tɔge peero tem laara ne te kɛa.

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: Bwi sem konto mo pae vara dwi maama yera zuri. Kagoa wo bonɛ sem de maa nyɔ na ba sui.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Bwi sem ni ne mo zuna sɔ ba pworu da. Ba maa dɔge teeni nɛ sem ne ba leena.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: Teeni delo Baŋa Wɛ na jeiri o zege to yeini de nae na mo dedɛ, ko ná maŋe ko ye Sedare teeni delo na wo Lebanon peero tem ne to.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: Zuna yeini ba sɔ ba pworu teeni dem konto nɛ ne. Buga ni zuna de wó taa zoore de wone.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Peero telo na dɔra to mo ye jei selo kagoa wo bone na beeri se wodiu to. Pe-ware de maa seigi peero tem gugworru ne.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Nmo ke chana kam mo se ka pɔɔre bene maama de de chane sem. Wea kam de maa yei maŋa kalo ka na wó zo diga to.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Nmo mo pae se tega yeini ka yi pa se lim wora ye kago-vara de nwoŋi ba beera.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Ko daare se nabiina de laam nwoŋi ba diga ne ba vo ba totoŋa ni, se tega kam jwoori ka yi.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Nii naneo kom mo! Ko tigi mo ga palalala ye ko yala lanyerane. Wonnu dwi dwi maa wo ko wone, te ná ye wo-kamuna de wo-baloa maama de, ye te daga te gaale jeelim.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: Nabwooru maa tɔge naneero tem wone te bɛa. Naneo wo juru Leviatan de maa wora, n na naane-ko n ke da se ko taa kwɛɛre to.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Wonnu tento maama n na ke to jege n teena mo, se n pa-ba ba ni-wodiu ko maŋa ne.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná pipiri n daare-ba, foone mo yeini de ja-ba. N ná le siu ba yera ne, ba jege se ba te mo, ye ba jwoori ba ji teero.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa wora taa wuu, se o taa jege wopwolo de o na ke wonnu telo maama to.

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Amo ná lwoori a wo a ŋwea wone, a lage a leeni mo a tei Baŋa Wɛ. A maa wó zuli‑o taa se a ŋwea ba ka ti.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: A ná leeni konto dwoŋi, Wɛ wó pa se a boboŋa yam taa pwoli o wo, kokuri to, ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo pae a di ywoni.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye wɛle-keira maama, pa se ba jei tega kam baŋa ne, se puseŋ-nyena de daa yé taa wora. Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!” Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se á daare á tei o yere! Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre o na toŋe kolo maama to.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Leeni-na tia lei á pa‑o! Ta-na kwanno á tei‑o! Bere-na nɔɔna o totoŋ-kamunnu na ye tei to.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Chega to, á ye balo Wɛ na kuri o pa o tete mo. Á maa ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Abaraham bia bam, ye á kwori á ye Jakob dwi dem.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wonto nam mo ye debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. O maa tei logo baŋa maama de chega.

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Ba kɔgɔ kom déem ta ba daga. Ba maa ye nɔɔna fenfee yerane, ye ba kare Kanaan tega kam ne ba beera ne veira mo tei.

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: Ba maa tole teene dem maama wone de dwi tiina maama wone.

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: De konto de, Wɛ déem wo pɛ pwola se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba. Banto ŋwaane mo o déem kaane pwa ye o we:

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: “Yé dwei-na nɔɔna banto, se amo mo kuri-ba a pa a tete. Nam yé pa-na ko chɛ amo sampwori sem yera.”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se kana to Kanaan tega kam baŋa, ye ba wodiiru maama jei.

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: O nam ya toŋe nɔɔno mo se o lwoori o yi Ejipti. Josɛf mo konto, ba na yeigi‑o ba de kabɛɛne wone to.

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem déem mo faŋe‑o de nii, se ko yi maŋa kalo o na wuuri o ta kolo to ji chega.

english_verse: Then the king of Egypt set Joseph free
translation_verse: Ejipti Pa-faro wom laam ma pa ni se ba pore‑o ba yage.

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom déem ta pɛ‑o dam se o taa korese o nakwa bam, se ba jwoŋi swa o tei ne.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Jakob de o kwaga kam déem ma vo Ham dwi tiina teo Ejipti ne ba ji veira ba zoore da.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se o nɔɔna bam puli dedɛ, pa se ba damma ba dwoi ba dona Ejipti tiina bam.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Wɛ ta ma pa se banto boboŋa pipiri se ba laam taa chuli o nɔɔna bam, se ba daare ba ke swa ba bɛɛse-ba.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma toŋe o tontoŋeno Moses ba tei ne. O ta ma kuri Aron se o da o woli Moses.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem pɛ se lim mo kwoli ba tega kam maama. Ba nam wo sɛ Wɛ ni taane dem.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: O ma pa se ba bwi sem na maama ji jana, pa se ywona yam maama te.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Nanchane déem ma yo se jwoŋi ba teo kom maama, dedaane pɛ sɔŋɔ peiga jei sem.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Wɛ ta ma pa ni, ye zɔɔro dedaane yeena laam ba ya jwoŋi ba teo kom jei maama ya su.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: O ma pa se doa ji do-kandwa ya ne, ye doa pepele ka bage ba teo kom maama.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: O ma tɔge konto baŋa o chɔge ba Vini teeni dem dedaane ba kaporro tem. O ma kaare kaare ba teo kom teeni dem maama o de tega ne.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: O ta ma puri o ni o ta, ye kayere laam wuuri se ba. Se kɔgɔ kom daga se gaale jeelim.

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Se ma meeli tega kam maama se di ga-lɛɛro de wodiiru tem maama kula.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ja Isarele tiina bam o nwoŋi Ejipti ne, ye ba zeŋe lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa wonnu dedɛ ba ja viiri. Ba dwia yam maama wone nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo maŋe kwaga ne.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Ba na viiri to, Ejipti tiina bam wo déem pwoli, ba ya na kɔre foone de-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: O ma kwei dwi-gɛ tiina teene o pa o nɔɔna bam, ye ba laam jwoŋi nɔɔna bam tega kam ba tei, ba daare ba di ba wodiiru tem.

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ke tento maama o pa-ba, se ba wane ba taa sɛ o nia yam mo, ye ba daare ba taa toŋe ba tɔge o bera yam maama. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o tiini o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wó wane o lwoni Baŋa Wɛ totoŋ-kamunnu tem? Wɔ mo yi se kotu wane o tei‑o se ko maŋe?

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Dé nabaara bam déem na wo Ejipti ne to, ba yiga tera wo-kenkagela yalo nmo na ke to wone. Ba ma swei swono kolo nmo na jege de-ba to ni ne. Ba déem na vei ba yi Nane-soŋo kom ni ne to, mo ba lɔge nmo kwaga ne.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, Wɛ déem ta jwoŋi-ba mo o yage o tete yere dem ŋwaane, se o wane o bere o dam-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei to.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: O ma bage Nane-soŋo kom pa se ko na bam pwɛ ba daare te-kora. O laam ma pa o nɔɔna bam nɔne te-kora kam baŋa ne ba bɛ na-fɔrɔ kom, ne ka na ye kagoa mo ba bɛ tei to.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Ba maa na wo kagoa yuu ne to, ba fera yam déem ware ya ja, ye ba daare ba maŋe Wɛ ba nii.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa-ba ba na beeri kolo to, ye o ta kwei jawe-chɛɔ o woli da o ke ba yuu ne.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo tega kam déem yare belei ka pɔpɔ ka li Datan, ka daare ka suli Abiram de o kɔgɔ kom.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: Mini déem mo to banto kwaga tɔgena bam tetare ne, pa se de zwɛ puseŋ-nyena bam konto maama kula.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Wɛ boboŋa ma ja se o chɔge-ba. Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses nam zege ba de Wɛ tetare laŋa ne, pa se o che Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom se o daa yé chɔge-ba.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Ko ma pa Wɛ seene o yia o du duuri we, o lage o pa ba te kagoa kam yuu ne,

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam déem ta kwei ba tete ba sale Baal-Peora jwoni dem yera ne mo. Ba ma tɔge ba di wodiiru telo ba na kaane ba pa chira to.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Ba totoŋ-naga kam konto déem mo chuchugi Wɛ bane, ye o pa se jawe-chɛɔ to ba tetare ne.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Finehase nam zaŋe o che chwoŋa se jawe-chɛɔ kom daa yé chɔge nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: Ba nam gwaane de dwi-gɛ tiina bam konto mo, pa se ba lɛɛre ba ke ba tɔge banto chullu tem.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Ba déem jege ba tete bia mo ba kaane ba pa tangwana.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: O ma kwei-ba o ke dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne. Balo na chuli-ba to mo laam di paare ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: Kuni dedɛ mo Wɛ yeini o vere-ba ba dona jeŋa ne o yage. Ba boboŋa nam jaane mo se ba lɔ Wɛ kwaga ne. Ko ma pa se ba bugi ba jei ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: Pa-na dé taa tei Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to! Wonto maŋe de tia mo ko zege faŋa faŋa se ko taa vei wuu. Pa-na se nɔɔna maama ta we, “Ameena!” Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Lei Tɔnɔ

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: Ba na jage ba yi logo baŋa sapɛ sena sem to mo o lage-ba o ke daane o ja jwoori ba tete teo kom.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Kana dedaane na-nyɔm ma tiini ko chɛ-ba. Ba déem gɛ fee mo se ba te.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ. O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo, o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane. O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela o pa nabiina.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: O goe nɔɔna na-nyɔm, ye o daare o pae kana na jege balo to wo-laaro, se ba taa di ba sui.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ba badaara déem ye peena mo ba na vɔge-ba de chegero. Ba maa jei lim wone de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, ba déem ve Wɛ kwora kam mo. Ba maa jege Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ bera yam ba gwoona.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: O ma pa se ba yera chɛ de totoŋ-dɛɛra. Ba ma chɔɔle ba to tega ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o woli-ba.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane, mo ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ. O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: O ma ja-ba o nwoŋi lim delo na kwoli-ba to wone. O ma kɔ ba chegero tem o yage se ba sii.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo, o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane. O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela o pa nabiina.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam badaara tɔge jworim mo. Ba déem nɛ cham dedɛ ba zwabania kikia de ba tusim ŋwaane.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Ba daa ba lage wodiu se ba di, ye ko gɛ fee se ba te.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ. O ma jwoŋi-ba o yage ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: O ma toŋe o kwora se ka yi-ba, ye ba na ba yazura. O ma jwoŋi-ba toone jeŋa ne o yage.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo, o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane. O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela o pa nabiina.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se ba ja lei-keim pɛɛra ba ke kaanem ba pa‑o. Ba wó guli o totoŋ-kamuna yam, ye ba daare ba leeni de wopwolo ya ŋwaane.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Ba ma na Baŋa Wɛ totoŋa yam na daga tei na-luŋa jei sem ne to.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Na bam ma dole nabwooru tem ba yage wɛɛne, ye te jwoori te tu tega kuri kuri. Yuŋina bam vɔna ma pare, cham na tiini de ja-ba to ŋwaane

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Ba cham dem konto ŋwaane mo ba keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ. O ma vere-ba o yage ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: O laam ma pa vo-dɛɔ kom maŋe da chemm. Na-ŋone sem de ya na fufugi to ke ziim.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Yuŋina bam wo ma pwoli, ba na nɛ siu ba cham dem wone to ŋwaane. Wɛ ma ja-ba o ja o yi bubɛ delo ba ya na lage ba yi to.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Ba jege se ba taa ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo, o swono kolo na bá fɔge ko jei to ŋwaane. O ta yeini o toŋe wo-kenkagela o pa nabiina.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam ta pɛ se kagoa pipiri ka ji jei selo bwi na daga da to mo. Na dedɛ de buri ba bugi te-kora.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa swɛ ba swolim pa se ba kɔgɔ kom puli dedɛ. Ba vara bam de daga ba maa vei yiga.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Ba laam ta ma daare ba na cham de wo-chechɔgɔ, ye ba dona bɛɛse-ba, pa se ba na ba chaveera.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam pae se nɔn-yum di ba chaveera mo, ye o daare o pae ba kare kagoa yuu ne ba beeri yɔɔ yerane.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nabwona, o yeini o jwoŋi-ba o ja nwoŋi ba yaara yam wone. O maa pae ba dwi dem puli dedɛ ne pei-kɔgɔ to.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nɔn-laaro mo nii ba na Wɛ kikia ye ba wo pwoli dedɛ. Puseŋ-nyena nia yam maama nam yɔɔre ya pu mo.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a wo kom yɔɔre ko da nmo mo. Konto to, a lage a leeni lei a seini‑m de a wo maama.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, a wó ke nmo lei nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne. A ta wó leeni lei a seini‑m logo baŋa dwi tiina maama tetare ne.

english_verse: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, pa n yere zaŋe wɛyuu maama ne! Pa se n nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taa nae logo baŋa jei maama ne!

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Popo, leiri a wɛ-lworo kom. Kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom n ma n jwoŋi debam n yage. Konto to, n nɔn-swonnu tem wó taa tei ba tete.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Wɛ zege o tete diga kam ne mo o ta we: “Amo wó bere a dam jaja a chɛ chɛ Sɛkɛm laŋa kam, ye a daare a maŋe Sukofa bwolo kom a pɔɔre a pa a nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gilead laŋa kam ye amo nyem, ko ta woli de Manasɛ laŋa kam de. Efrayim maa nye de a yu-gwoŋo kom. Judah de maa nye de a paare nacheiga kam.

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Wɔ nam mo wó ja amo o vo teo kolo na lɔge ko pe to wone? Wɔ mo wó ja-ne o vo o yi Edom teo kom?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Ja, woli debam se dé wane dé dona bam. Nabiina na jege wolim delo to maama ba jege kuri.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Ba maa zage-ne ni-chɛɛre, de amo na duri ba ŋwaŋa tei maama to de. Amo nam ta wó taa lwoori Wɛ a pa-ba mo.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: A ná yeini a ke-ba lanyerane, ba wó jwoori ba ke-ne zonne. A ta ná jege ba swono, ba maa wó ja puseŋa ba jeeri-ne.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Nam beeri puseŋ-nyeno se kotu di a dono wom taane. Ta pa se o seba-nyeno zaŋe o saŋe‑o.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ba maa ná di o taane dem, se ba ta we, o toa. Kwei o wɛ-lworo tete se ko taa ye wɛleere.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
translation_verse: Sɛ se o bia ji botara mo, se o kaane wom de ji kadeim.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Yé pa pwola se nɔɔn-nɔɔno duri kotu de o bia balo o na tege o daare to yibwona.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Nam pa se o dwi dem maama saare, se dwi delo na saŋe to swei ba swia lela.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, yé fɔge n swei o nabaara bam na ke wɛleera yalo dwi maama to. Nam yé saare o nu tusim kɔtaa.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Ta‑n guli ba wɛleera yam konto taa, se n daare n pa se ba dwi dem daa yé taa jege yere logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: O me de sɔɔlem taane mo, nenɛɛne de ye gɔrɔ kolo o na jege o zoore to. De maa nye de na balo o na yeini o nyɔa pa se ba tu o wo to, de nuga kalo o na mɛ o turi o yera to.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege amo kwaga ba chwo ye ba ta zage-ne ni-chɛɛre to, Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se ba jwoori ba na waarem konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam da n yere dem ŋwaane n nii amo baŋa ne lanyerane. Jwoŋi-ne n yage, n swono kolo na ye chekke to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo tiini a bwona mo lage-lage ye yiniga de jege-ne. A bochare de maa tiini de di.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: A lage a jei lela mo, nenɛɛne lunluŋu na yeini ko ke tei dedaan-ni seeni to. Ba lage ba peili-ne ba yage dáa ne, nenɛɛne kayera dwoŋi to.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: A nadwoona maa mage daane a kana na tiini ka wɔe to ŋwaane. A yera yam tiini ya bugi, pa se ya daare kwi yerane mo.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Balo na dwoni de amo to jege-ne ba gwoona. Ba maa ná yeini ba na-ne, ba dole ba yuni tem mo amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ba n zeini-ne! Da n swono kom ŋwaane n jwoŋi-ne n yage.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó wane ba sɔɔle lwarem ba yage amo yuu ne, se nmo nam wó ke zaane mo n ke a yuu ne. Ba ná boŋe se ba bɛɛse-ne, ba maa wó na ba chaveera. A nam wó di ywoni mo, a na ye nmo tontoŋeno to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Chega to, chaveera wó di balo na jege a kwaga kam ba chwo to. Kuri-nɔrɔ maa ye gɔrɔ kolo ba na wó zo to.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: A lage a puri a ni a tiini a ke Baŋa Wɛ lei mo. A maa wó zege nɔn-kɔgɔ tetare ne a tei‑o.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tage de amo Teiru wom o we: “Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni, se amo laam wane n dona bam a ke nmo dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa n paare dam-fɔrɔ kom yale ko yi jei maama. Nmo wó di paare Zion ne ye n wane n dona bam na gilimi abam to.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: N ná zaŋe n nwoŋi de dam dɛ delo wone, nmo nɔɔna bam wó tɔge n kwaga de wopwolo Wɛ tete zwonnu tem yuu ne. Tega ná poore tetete, nmo nɔn-donno tem wó ba nmo tei, ne nyɔnɔ na yeini ko to zezeŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ dugi duuri mo ye o daa bá fɔge o za o ni. O tage o we, “Nmo wó ta‑n ye amo kaanem tu taa wuu, ne Melkizedeka faŋa faŋa na ye tei to.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Wɛ wom maa wo n jazem seeni. O ban-zɔŋɔ dɛ dem ne o wó wane pwa o de tega ne.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Amo wó ke Baŋa Wɛ lei de a wo maama Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne, ne nɔn-laaro ná jeeri daane.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tiini o toŋe totoŋ-kamuna dedɛ. Balo maama wo na pwoli de o kikia to wó taa boŋe ya boboŋa mo maŋa maama.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: O totoŋa yam jege zula mo dedaane nenɔŋa. O na zege o chega wone tei to wó taa wora wuu.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: O na yɔɔre o ke wo-kenkagela yalo to, nɔɔna wó taa guli ya gula. Baŋa Wɛ ye zaane tu de yibwona tu mo.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: O déem kwei dwi-gɛ tiina ya na tei tega kalo to o pa o nɔɔna bam, se ba wane ba lɔre o na toŋe de dam tei to.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: Nabiina na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ mɛ to, yi-poro de puli dáane mo. Balo maama na toŋe ba tɔge o bera yam to wó taa jege yeino lanyerane. Wɛ maŋe se nɔɔna taa tei‑o se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Nɔɔno wolo ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ ye o pae se Wɛ nia yam jege ywoni ya pa‑o, Wɛ zaane wo kotu yuu ne lanyerane.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: O bia bam tete wó na yere tega kam baŋa ne. Wɛ wó yɔɔre o swɛ nɔn-ŋona dwi dem swolim.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Kotu sɔŋɔ kom wó na jejegero dwi dwi. Nɔɔna maa bá fɔge ba swei o nɔn-ŋonne kikia ni ne.

english_verse: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na yɔɔre chwo-laao wone ba vei to, pwooni wó zeiŋi de pa-ba, de ba na maŋe ba wo lim jei wone to de. Ko wó ke konto ko pa nɔn-ŋom wolo maama na jege nɔɔna yibwona ye o pae se chega toŋa to.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom nam bá fɔge o seeri o to. Nɔɔna de bá swei o swia se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwor-balɔrɔ nam ná yi‑o, o bá taa kɔre foone. O jege baare mo ye o wo kom yɔɔre ko da Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: O boboŋa maa zege chega kam wone ye foone ba jege‑o. O laam maa wó ba o wane o dona o di.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Kotu pɔɔre o wonnu o pa yiniga tiina zɛɛra mo. O nɔn-ŋonne dem wó taa wo o tei ne maŋa maama. O maa wó tiini o na dam, pa se nɔɔna zeiŋi o yere dem wɛɛne.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena wó na konto maama ye ba bana taa zaŋa ko ŋwaane. Ba maa wó done ba nwa lwia ŋwaane, ye ba taa bugi ba jia. Puseŋ-nyena bam fera ná zo woŋo kolo maama, ba nam bá na-ko kɔtaa.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Abam balo na ye o tontoŋena to, tei-o-na! Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem!

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé tei Baŋa Wɛ yere dem, ko zege leile se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ko na zege wɛ-puli seeni se ko vo ko yi wɛ-zoore seeni to, ko maŋe se jei maama nɔɔna mo taa tei Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ jege dam mo logo baŋa teene dem maama baŋa ne. O nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom nae jaja mo wɛyuu kom maama ne.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ dwoŋi tera. O maa jei o paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne wɛ-wɛ,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: ye wɛyuu de tega kam maama wo kuri kuri. O laam maa tiiri o nii o nae te maama.

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: O ma ja-ba o vo o jeini teo kom dedɛɛra tei ne, se nɔɔna taa nege-ba.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye kadega de, Wɛ wó pa kotu lo bia, se o wane o di ywoni o sɔŋɔ kom wone. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Naneo kom déem nii ko na ko na ye tei to mo, ye ko tutwoni dáa ko daare pwola. Jɔdan buga kam de ma pipiri ka kɛ dáa.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Peero tem de zwonnu tem déem ziziŋi mo, nenɛɛne pi-bale na faŋe wɛɛne tei to.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Naneo, ta‑n tɛa, bɛ mo ke ye n tutwoni n daare pwola? Jɔdan buga kam, bɛ mo ye n pipiri n kɛ dáa?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye peero tem de zwonnu tem, bɛ mo ye abam de faŋe wɛɛne nenɛɛne pei to?

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: Wonto déem pɛ se peo leiri ko ji chɔgɔ. Peo kom tete ma ji buli-yi, pa na ta ba nwoŋi da.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ko dae debam mo maŋe de zula, se nmo, Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo. Ko maŋe se nɔɔna taa tei nmo yere, nmo swono kom na gaale ye n ta jege chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye dwi-gɛ tiina bam bwei daane ba we, “Ba Wɛ wom bɛ?”

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ wom nam wo telaao ne mo. O maa toŋe kolo maama o wo na dɛ to.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye banto jwona yam, ko ye lu-nyenno dedaane sabu-seŋa mo nabiina kwei ba mɔ-ya de ba jea.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ya maŋe ya jege nia, ya nam ba ŋɔɔna. Ya ze jege yia mo de, ya nam ba nae.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Zwa mo ba jega, ye ya ba ni kolokolo. Ya momwa de ba ni lwom.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Balo maama na ke jwo-yɔɔro to wó ba ba taa nye de-ya. Balo de na ke ba wo-dedoa de-ya to wó ji nɔn-yɔɔro mo.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Isarele nɔn-kɔgɔ kom, ke-na á wo-dedoa dedaane Baŋa Wɛ! Wonto mo ye á zeinnu ye o ta daare o cho abam.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Aron dwi tiina bam, ke-na á wo-dedoa dedaane Baŋa Wɛ! Wonto mo ye á zeinnu ye o ta daare o cho abam.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to, ke-na á wo-dedoa ded‑o! Wonto mo ye á zeinnu ye o ta daare o cho abam.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o guli debam gula pa se o swɛ debam swolim. Chega to, o wó swɛ Isarele tiina bam swolim, ko fɔge ko dae Aron dwi tiina bam de.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: Balo maama na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to mo o lage o swɛ ba maama swolim, ba ná maŋe ba ye nabwona naa naduna mo de.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa abam de á dwi dem puli dedɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: O maa ye wolo na naane wɛyuu de tega baŋa to mo. Wonto wó swɛ abam swolim lanyerane.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom maama ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo. O nam kwei tega kam baŋa o ke nabiina jeŋa ne.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: O yeini o pore o zwa mo o ni amo ni taane. Mo kokuri, amo wó ware‑o se ko taa nii a ŋwea siseini.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Toone déem kekare amo de vɔ. A maa kɔre foone churu veiŋa ŋwaane. Cham de wo-chechɔgɔ yerane mo ya ye amo nyem.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma kaase a bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere a we, “Ja, amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ! Jwoŋi-ne n yage!”

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, amo wó taa jege a ŋwea tega baŋa ne ye a kɔre Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: A ta ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ mo, ye a we, “Cham tiini de jege-ne.”

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: A boboŋa na vugimi to, a maa we, “Nabiina maama ye vwa-fɔra mo.”

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: A na wó ke kolo to mo tento: Amo wó zeiŋi zoŋa mo de ka wo wo-nyɔɔro, a maa ke‑o lei o verem ŋwaane, ye a daare a bwoŋi o yere a maa zuli‑o.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege chega de Baŋa Wɛ to, ba dedoa ná tega, ko tiini ko jege kuri ko pa‑o.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a ye n tontoŋeno mo. Chega to, a ye kabaa mo n sɔŋɔ ne. Nmo nam bwoli ŋone selo ya na vɔge-ne to.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Amo wó ja lei-keim pɛɛre mo a ba a ke kaanem a pa‑m, ye a daare a bwoŋi nmo Baŋa Wɛ yere a maa zuli‑m.

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama ba-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ! Nabiina na nwoŋi teene delo maama wone to, zuli-o-na.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Pa-na se Wɛ kaanem tu Aron dwi tiina bam de tɔge ba ta we: “O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Pa-na se balo maama na kɔre Wɛ to de tɔge ba ta we: “O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: Amo wo ya na tiini ko pɛ to, a ma lwoori Baŋa Wɛ. O ma sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom pa se a jwoori a na a tete.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo zege amo kwaga ne. Konto to, a daa bá taa kɔre foone. Nabiina lage ba ke amo bɛ mo?

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná vei o dale Baŋa Wɛ woro ne, konto gare o teena ná wo nabiina baŋa ne.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina maama mo ya gilimi amo ba ke tetare ne. Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane amo nam wane-ba a yigi a de tega ne.

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, ba yɔɔre ba gilimi-ne, ye a wane-ba a yigi a de tega ne, Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane.

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔre ba meeli-ne mo nenɛɛne twe na meeli nɔɔna tei to. Ba nam jei mo lela nenɛɛne sabare selo mini na zwɛ to mo. A ma wane-ba a yigi a de tega ne, Baŋa Wɛ yere dem dam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Ba ya tiini ba jege-ne ba peena. Ko ma gɛ fee mo se a to tega ne. Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre o da o zeini-ne mo.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na yeini o pa-ne dam ye o ta kwori o cho amo cham wone. O maa ye wolo na jwoŋi-ne o yage to.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Cheigi-na! Wɛ nɔn-laaro tem zege ba vwoa wone ba bage ywoni de wɔnɔ ŋwaane mo ye ba we: “Baŋa Wɛ jazem dem mo toŋe wo-kamuna!

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ jazem dem jege dam! O ma tɔge de baŋa ne o toŋe wo-kamuna!”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Amo bá te, a lage a taa ŋwe mo. Amo laam maa wó taa tɔɔle a bere nɔɔna Baŋa Wɛ na ke totoŋ-kamuna yalo to.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ya tiini o pa ko chɛ a yera ne. De konto maama de, o wo pɛ se toone ja-ne.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: “Pore-na manchwoŋo ni dem á pa-ne se a zo Wɛ wara-jei sem mɛ nɔn-laaro na yeini ba zoore to. Se amo wó zo dáane mo a ke Baŋa Wɛ lei.”

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei di-nia yam mo tento. Wɛ nɔn-laaro tem yerane mo jege chwoŋa se ba tɔge da ba vo ba zuli‑o.”

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: “Amo nam wó ke nmo Baŋa Wɛ lei, nmo na sɛ a wɛ-lworo kom ye n jwoŋi-ne n yage to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Kandwɛ delo lɔra bam na ve to laam jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam damma to.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: Konto ye Baŋa Wɛ keim mo. Ko maa ye wo-kenkagele ko pa debam.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Zem mo ye Baŋa Wɛ totoŋ-kamuna dɛ dem! Pa-na se dé taa chaka de wopwolo de ŋwaane.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, dé lwoori nmo tei ne se n jwoŋi debam n yage! Pa se dé totoŋa taa vei yiga lanyerane!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu o yere ŋwaane to swolim. Debam zege Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne mo se dé ke o zaane dé yage n yuu ne!”

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ seene o ye debam Tu Wɛ wom mo. O maa pae pwooni taa wo dé tei ne. Konto to, di-na kuri á ma‑á zuli‑o! Kwei-na varem á vɔ de ŋone á ja á vo á lei kaanem bimbini dem nyea ne.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Banto ba sɛ ba toŋe lwarem kikia kɔtaa, ye ba nam yɔɔre ba tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa chekke mo.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Pa se a totoŋ-naga taa tɔge nmo kwora na bere kolo to!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Amo ná seene a yia se a taa sɛ n ni-kaana yam, chaveera bá ja-ne ya ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: A ná zamese n chega taana yam, a laam wó taa tei‑m de a wo maama.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Chega to, amo wó taa sɛ a ke nmo nia yam mo. Yé ma n kwaga n ya amo. Bet

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Amo kwei a wo maama mo a kwaane se a fɔɔre a twɛ nmo. Nam yé pa se a ywori nmo ni-kaana yam kwaga ne.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Amo kwei n ni taane dem mo a ke a bochare ne, se ko che-ne se a yé tusi a chɔge nmo yiga.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo maŋe dedaane tia mo! Bere-ne se a lɔre n nia yam chekke.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Amo jege n chullu telo n na pɛ debam to mo a yeini a tɛ a bere nɔɔna jaja.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a di ywoni mo n bera yam ŋwaane, ne ya pɛ a ye nadum mo tei.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Amo Tu, a lwoori‑m se n ta‑n ke lanyerane n pa-ne. Amo laam maa wó taa jege ŋwea ye a sɛ a tɔge n taane dem na bere tei to.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Pa se a yia puri, se a wane a lɔre wo-kenkagela yalo n taane dem na bere to.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Amo ye veiru mo logo baŋa ne. Yé seigi n ni-kaana yam amo tei ne, se a yé wane a lɔre-ya.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama wone n bera yam tiini ya jege fera mo ya pa-ne.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Yé pa se ba toro naa ba yu-yaalem yi amo, kokuri to, amo sɛ a tɔge nmo bera yam mo.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Pa-bia tete ná maŋe ba beeri chwoŋa se ba chɔge-ne mo de, amo ta wó taa jege n nia yam a boboŋa ne.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Nmo bera yam mo tiini ya pae amo na ywoni. Ya maa bere-ne chwo-laao se a taa tɔga. Daleta

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Amo laam to tega ne, ye toone lage de ja-ne. Nam tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n pa a jwoori a na ŋwea.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: A tage a ŋwea na ye tei to maama a bere‑m, ye nmo de leiri a taane dem. Laam nam bere-ne n nia yam lanyerane.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Woli-ne se a wane a ni n chullu tem kuri, se ko pae a taa boŋe n totoŋ-kenkagela yam boboŋa.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Amo wo-chechɔgɔ kom mo lage ko go-ne. Nam tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n pa a jwoori a na dam.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Pa se a nwoŋi vwa dwi maama wone, se n daare n tɔge n zaane dem baŋa ne n pa a taa yei nmo nia yam.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Amo kuri se a taa zege de chega mo a pa‑m. A ta maa yeini a guli nmo chullu tem gula.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo sɛ a tɔge n bera yam mo. Yé pa chaveera di amo!

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Amo seene a yia mo se a ke n ni-kaana yam na bere kolo to. Konto to, woli-ne se a ni ya kuri lanyerane. Hee

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, bere-ne se a wane a lɔre n nia yam kuri. Amo ba lage se a lɔ ya dedoa tete kwaga ne.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Nam pa se a yi poore, se a wane a sɛ nmo ni taane dem. Amo zege se a yɔɔre a tɔge-de de a wo maama mo.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Pa n ni-kaana yam taa bere-ne chwoŋa se a taa via. Kokuri to, amo tiini a ni ya ywoni lanyerane.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Pa se a boboŋa taa tɔge n bera yam, se a fera yé zo jejegero wone.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Dɔne amo yia wo-yɔɔro baŋa ne. Pa se a na ŋwea n chwoŋa kam tɔgem ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Amo Tu, a ye n tontoŋeno mo. Nam ke n na gwoni ni se n ke kolo ye n pwooli se n ke tei de balo na kɔre nmo to.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: A kɔre foone de balo na jege-ne ba yaale to mo. Yé pa a na chaveera ba ŋwaane. Kokuri nmo tete ni taane dem lana dedɛ.

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa se a wane a leiri balo na jege-ne ba twe to, a na ke a chega n taane dem wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Yé pa se n chega taane dem jei amo ni ne, se a teena maama wo nmo bora borem dem ne mo.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Amo lage se a taa sɛ nmo nia yam maŋa maama mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Amo laam vei mo ye kolokolo ba daane-ne, a na tiini a lage n chullu tem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: A ta wó taa tɛ n bera yam a bere pwa, ye chaveera bá ja-ne ya ŋwaane.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Amo wo mo pwoli dedɛ de nmo ni-kaana yam, a na tiini a swoi-ya to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Chega to, a swoi n nia yam ye a nege-ya lanyerane. A maa wó taa boŋe ya wone mo zii. Zayin

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n swei ni delo n na tiŋi de amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to, se a teena maama wo dáane mo.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: A ná wo cham wone, n ni taane dem yeini de pa a bochare peini tega ne mo, ye a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Banegero nyena jege amo mo ba ke ba mɔna. Amo nam wo sɛ se a yage n nia yam tɔgem.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Amo wo mo wiira dedɛ dedaane puseŋ-nyena bam na ve n nia yam to.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: A ná zoore mɛ maama logo baŋa ne, a yeini a leeni wopwolo lei mo nmo bera yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, a ta ná yeini a peini tete ne, a guli n yere dem gula mo. Konto to, a lage a taa tɔge n nia yam.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Amo na yeini a ke tei to mo tento: a yɔɔre a sɛ a tɔge n chullu tem mo. Het

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: A nam lwoori‑m de a wo maama mo se n yiga taa wo a wone. Tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n pa n zaane taa wo a yuu ne.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Amo maane a nii a ŋwea na ye tei to, pa se a yɔɔre a pipiri a tɔge n bera yam.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: A seene a yia mo ye a ke lela se a taa sɛ n ni-kaana yam.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Tete-koro ne mo a yeini a zaŋe se a ke nmo lei dedɛ, nmo chullu tem na zege chega baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye a yuudwonna balo a na tɔge de-ba to, banto kɔre nmo mo ye ba ta sɛ n chullu tem.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo swono kom mo yi logo baŋa jei maama. Konto to, bere-ne se a wane a lɔre n nia yam. Tet

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a ye n tontoŋeno mo. Nmo seene n tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n ke lanyerane n pa-ne.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo nmo ta na wo korese-ne to, a kare a tusi chwoŋa mo. Leile konto amo laam yɔɔre a sɛ n ni taane dem mo.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Nmo tiini n lamma, ye n keina de lana dedɛ. Konto to, bere-ne se a lɔre n nia yam chekke.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Banegero nyena yeini ba fɔ vwa mo ba daŋe a yuu ne. Amo nam ta wó taa tɔge nmo chullu tem mo de a wo maama.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: Banto boboŋa jei mo ye ba ba jege yibwona. Ko nam ná ye amo, a tiini a di ywoni n nia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Amo na nɛ koresem delo to tiini de woli-ne dedɛ, de ko na pɛ a zamese n bera yam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Nia yalo nmo na bere debam to tiini ya jege kuri ya pa-ne, ya dwoi sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno maama. Yod

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Nmo jea mo naane amo, ye ya fɔge ya pa a zega. Konto to, pa a yi poore se a wane a ni n ni-kaana yam kuri.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Balo dwi maama na zuli nmo to ná nɛ amo, ba wo wó pwoli, de amo teena na wo nmo taane dem wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Ta pa n yibwona yi amo se a wane a na ŋwea chekke. Kokuri to, a tiini a di ywoni n nia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Pa banegero nyena bam di chaveera, se banto fɔge vwa mo ba ma chɔge-ne. Ko nam ná ye amo, amo wó taa guli n chullu tem gula mo.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Pa se balo na kɔre nmo to fɔɔre ba yi amo tei, se ba wane ba me de nmo bera yam.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Pa se a yɔɔre a taa tɔge nmo nia yam ye tusim tera. Konto baŋa ne, chaveera bá di amo. Kaf

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a nii mo se n vere-ne n yage. A teena maama de maa wo nmo taane dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Amo yera yam kwaare mo nenɛɛne lɔa na koge tei to. De ko de, amo ta wo swei n bera yam ni ne.

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Banegero nyena bam yeini ba ve nmo nia yam mo, ye ba boŋe se ba ja-ne, ne ba na koge gwoŋo se a to ko wone tei to.

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Ko ya gɛ fee yerane mo se ba go-ne. Amo maa wo dole nmo chullu tem a yage.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Nam da n swono kom ŋwaane n pa se a taa jege a ŋwea ye a toŋe a tɔge n bera yam maama. Lameda

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ni taane dem wó taa jege kuri taa wuu wɛyuu jei maama ne.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: De zem maama nmo nia yam ta jege kuri. Wonnu maama de jege se te taa toŋe te pa‑m mo.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Amo ya ná wo di ywoni nmo nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane, tento wɛɛne yaara ya wó go-ne.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Amo ba lage a fɔge a swei nmo chullu tem swia, tento na pɛ se a ŋwea ke dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Jwoŋi-ne n yage, se a ye nmo nɔɔno mo. A maa tiini a nege n chullu tem.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam beeri chwoŋa mo se ba ja amo ba go. Amo nam wó taa jege n bera yam a boboŋa ne mo.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Nii amo na swoi n nia yam tei! Amo jege ya boboŋa mo dɛ dem maama wone.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Nmo ni-kaana yam mo pae a jege swa a dwoi a dona maama, a na jege ya boboŋa maŋa maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Amo yi poore se ko dwoni nɔn-kwe tete de, a na toŋe a tɔge n chullu tem to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Amo ba sɛ se a taa tɔge lwarem chwoŋa, pa se a taa ke n ni taane dem na bere kolo to.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Amo wo pipiri a lɔ n nia yam kwaga ne, nmo tete na bere-ne se a lɔre ya kuri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Nmo taane dem mo yeini de pa-ne pwooni pa a vei de wone, ne min-zwoŋo na nye pwooni chwoŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: A yeini a dole a ŋwea kam mo a yage, ye a daa ta ba swei n nia yam swia.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam kwaane mo se ba ja-ne, ne ba tiŋi kalanchogo mo tei. Amo nam wo pipiri a lɔ n chullu tem kwaga ne.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Nmo bera yam wó taa jege lonne ya pa-ne taa wuu. Yanto mo pae a di ywoni lanyerane.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a boŋe a ja mo we amo wó taa tɔge n nia yam na bere kolo to taa se a ŋwea ba ka ti. Sameka

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Nmo mo ye amo dalem jei. Nmo ta ma‑n cho-ne cham wone. Nmo taane dem yerane wone mo amo teena wora.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, da n ni dem ŋwaane n pa a ŋwea na dam. Amo teena na wo nmo tei ne to, yé pa se chaveera di-ne ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Fɔge n ta‑n jege-ne mɔpe, se cham yé yi-ne. Konto mo wó pa se amo yiga taa wo n nia yam wone maŋa maama.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Nmo nii puseŋ-nyena balo maama na wo tega baŋa ne to se ba taa ye weeru mo n yiga ne. Mo kokuri amo swoi n bera yam.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Amo yera mo tiini ya sae a na kɔre foone de nmo to ŋwaane. Nmo na di nɔɔna taane tei to maa pae a fona dedɛ. Ayin

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Amo ke kolo na lamma ye ko jege chega to mo. Yé yage-ne se a to balo na bɛɛse-ne to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Amo ye n tontoŋeno mo. Ta‑n zege n pa-ne, se lanyerane yi amo. Yé sɛ se banegero nyena bam taa bɛɛse-ne.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Amo kwaane a nii mo taa se n vere-ne n yage, se ni delo nmo na tiŋi to seene de ji chega.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane a yeini a tɔge n chullu tem maama mo. Amo ta chuli chwoŋa kalo maama na ye vwa chwoŋa to. Pei

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Nmo bera yam ye berem-kenkagela mo. Mo kokuri a yɔɔre a tɔge-ya.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a jege nmo ni-kaana yam fera, nenɛɛne na-nyɔm mo jege-ne to.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Ja, nii amo seeni se n duri a yibwona, ne n na yeini n ke tei n pa balo na zuli nmo yere to.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Tɔge n ni dem baŋa ne n pa se a yɔɔre a tɔge chwoŋa. Yé sɛ se wɛleera na dam amo baŋa ne.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Amo kane yi-na mo bare-bare, a na nɛ nɔɔna na ve n nia yam tɔgem to ŋwaane. Tesade

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo jege chega lanyerane. Nmo chullu tem de yɔɔre te tɔge chwoŋa mo.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Ko tiini ko daane-ne mo dedaane a dona bam na swei nmo taane dem swia to.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Nmo ni taane dem tiini de jege kuri. Amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to tiini a swoi-de dedɛ.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a muri ye nɔɔna jege-ne ba gwoona. Amo nam ba fɔge a swei n chullu tem ni ne.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Yaara de cham mo to amo baŋa ne. Nmo ni-kaana yam nam pae a di ywoni dedɛ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo keeri a jare nmo de a bochare maama! Nam leiri a wɛ-lworo kom, se a wane a taa tɔge n nia yam.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Ja, jwoŋi-ne n yage ne a na lwoori‑m tei to, se a taa ke a tɔge n bera yam.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Amo yeini a dɔ a zaŋe ye tega ta wo poore, se a lwoori zeinim nmo tei ne. A kwei a teena a daŋe n taane dem baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, da n swono kom ŋwaane n cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom. Ta tɔge n chega chwoŋa baŋa ne n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Balo na swoi puseŋa kikia to laam twɛ amo mo se ba ke-ne zonne. Banto yiga bere ka tera de n nia yam.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nmo, Baŋa Wɛ, nmo wo amo tei ne mo. Nmo ni-kaana yam maama maa yɔɔre ya ye chekke.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Ko na zege faŋa faŋa to mo a maane n bera yam wone we n pɛ ya zege mo taa wuu. Resa

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nii cham na tiini de jege-ne tei to se n daare n vere-ne n yage. Kokuri to, amo ba swei nmo nia yam swia.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam bá fɔge ba na verem, ba yiga na tere n nia yam wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo tiini n ye yibwona tu. Tɔge n chwo-laaro tem ŋwaane n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka na dam.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam de balo na bɛɛse-ne to mo tiini ba gaale. De konto maama de amo ba ywori a daare nmo bera yam.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na nwoŋi n chega kam kwaga ne to, amo chuli-ba mo, ba na ve n ni taane dem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nii amo na swoi n chullu tem tei! Nam da n swono kom ŋwaane n pa a na ŋwea chekke.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Nmo taane dem maama yɔɔre de ye chega mo. Nmo chega taana yam maama de maa wora taa wuu. Sin

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra jege-ne mo ba yaare kafɛ ŋwaane. Amo nam nege n taane dem mo de a bochare maama.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a chuli vwa dwi maama. Ko daare a swoi nmo nia yam mo lanyerane.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Kuni berepɛ mo dɛ maama wone amo wó zuli nmo, n nia yam na zege de chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na swoi n nia yam to, n yeini n pa ba bochare zuri lanyerane mo. Kolokolo tera ko na wó pa se banto to tega ne.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo teena wo nmo yerane wone mo se n vere-ne n yage. Amo sɛ a ke n ni-kaana yam na bere kolo to.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a tɔge n bera yam mo, kokuri a tiini a swoi-ya dedɛ.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Amo toŋe a tɔge n chullu tem de n bera yam. Nmo maŋe n yei amo totoŋ-naga maama ni ne. Tawe

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi amo na keeri a jare nmo tei to! Tɔge n taane dem baŋa ne n pa a na yi-poro.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Cheigi a wɛ-lworo kom, se n daare n da n ni dem ŋwaane n jwoŋi-ne n yage.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó leeni a seini n ni taane dem mo, nmo ni-kaana yam maama na ye chekke to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Kwei n jeŋa kam n ma‑n zeini-ne, amo na kuri se a sɛ n chullu tem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo yɔɔre a nii mo se n vere-ne n yage. Nmo nia yam mo pae a di ywoni.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Sɛ se amo yɔɔre a taa ŋwe, se a taa tei‑m a ŋwea kam wone. Pa se n nia yam taa jege wolim ya pa-ne.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Amo tusi chwoŋa mo ye a jei ne pi-jia dwoŋi to. Pa n yiga taa wo amo wolo na ye n tontoŋeno to wone, kokuri to, amo bere a wo swei n ni-kaana yam ni ne.

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro mo jege-ne! A zoore Meseka teo ne, de Kedare tiina tetare ne mo.

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a dáane nɔɔna banto tei ne, ye ba ba beeri ni-mɔrɔ de nɔɔna.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo, a lage se a taa zoore de-ba de bochare-zuru. Amo nam ná yeini a ŋɔɔne, banto beeri jara keim yerane mo!

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Amo yeini a kwoni a yuu wɛɛne mo a nii peero tem seeni. Yein-seeni mo amo wó na zeinim?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo wó zeini-ne. Wonto mo naane wɛyuu dedaane tega kam baŋa maama.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Wɛ lage o taa cho‑m mo se n yé tiri n to tega ne. Wɛ wó nii nmo baŋa ne maŋa maama ye o bá fɔge o dɔ.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: O na ye wolo na nii Isarele tiina baŋa ne to, o ba buga, o nam ba dɔa.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na cho nmo to mo. O wó taa wo n jazem seeni bwola bwola se o pa n na woro.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: O bá sɛ se wea kam daane‑m dɛ dem wone, naa se chana kam ke‑m kolokolo tete ne.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó taa cho nmo de lwarem dwi maama, se kolokolo yé chɔge n ŋwea kam.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Amo wo mo tiini ko pwoli dedɛ de ba na tage de amo ba we, “Pa-na se dé vo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam” to.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Jerusalem, dé laam tu dé zege ywo mo, teo kom manchwo-peena ni ne.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Jerusalem ye teo kolo na fɔge ko lɔ pa se ko lamma ye ko jege dam to mo.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Isarele dwia yam na ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem to yeini ba tui ywo se ba ke Baŋa Wɛ lei ne o na pɛ-ba ni se ba ke tei to.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Ta lwoori-na Wɛ se o nii Jerusalem baŋa ne se nɔɔna taa zoore da de yazura. Wɛ wó pa se balo na lage teo kom konto ni taane to na yiga-veiŋa.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se yazura taa wora teo kom wo jei maama ne, se ko dam jei sem de fɔge se zege lanyerane.

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Amo chorro de a yuudwonna bam ŋwaane, amo wó ta we, “Yazura taa wo á tei ne.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane, amo beeri kolo maama na wó pa á na yiga-veiŋa to mo.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Amo kwoni a yia wɛɛne a nii nmo Baŋa Wɛ mo. Nmo ye wolo paare na di Wɛ telaao ne to mo.

english_verse: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
translation_verse: Ne kabɛ de ka-nyaana na beeri yibwona ba teira tei ne tei to, debam de nii dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ seeni konto mo se o ba o duri dé yibwona.
