english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, popo tɔge n zaane dem baŋa n duri debam ŋwaŋa. Kokuri to, dé dona tiini ba twe debam se ko gaale.

english_verse: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
translation_verse: Chega to, dé yera yam laam mo chɛ de naduna na jege debam ba mɔna ye zwabani-nyena de gwooni debam tei to.

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ ya ná wo zege debam kwaga ne maŋa kalo dé dona bam na jeeri debam de jara to,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: tento ba ya ligi debam mela, ba ban-lom na zaŋe debam baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: Tento wɛɛne dé dona ya kale debam ba ja jei, ne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri ye ko chwooli wonnu tei to.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, de o na wo sɛ se dé dona ma ba yeila ba ma chɔge debam to.

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo zeini debam. Wonto mo naane wɛyuu dedaane tega kam baŋa maama.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Baŋa Wɛ to nye de Zion peo kom na zege de dam tei to mo. Peo kom konto ba bibiga. Ko wora mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Nenɛɛne peero na gilimi Jerusalem te pu tei to, konto mo Baŋa Wɛ de kaare o nɔɔna bam o pu, se kolokolo yé yi-ba ko zege zem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ke lanyerane n pa nɔn-ŋona dwi dem, de balo na tɔge chwo-laao to.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na tusi ba ywori nmo chwoŋa kam ne to, yɔɔre n waare-ba ne n na ke puseŋ-nyena tei to. Yazura taa wo Isarele tiina bam tei ne!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ se dé jwoori dé jeini Zion teo kom ne to, ko nye de dendwea mo dé dwɛ.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Mwanno déem su debam ni mo. Dé maa leeni wopwolo lei. Dwi-gɛ tiina laam maa tɛ debam taane ba we, “Baŋa Wɛ mo ke wo-kamunnu dedɛ o pa-ba.”

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ seene o ke wo-kamunnu o pa debam, ye ko pwoli dé wo!

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, pa se dé jwoori dé taa jege yu-ywoŋo, nenɛɛne doa ná nega pa se nabare jwoori se jege na tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne tei to.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Nam pa se balo na vei ba du wo-dwa ba kare ne ye wo-chechɔgɔ jege-ba to laam ba ba zage ba wodiiru tem ye ba bage de wopwolo sɔɔ.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Balo na keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane ye ba jege ba wo-dwa bam ba maa vei se ba du to laam wó jwoori maŋa kadwoŋi ne de ba wodiiru tem ye ba bage de wopwolo sɔɔ ba yaga.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Nmo ná gwoni tega n vo n totoŋa ni ne se n toŋe taa n na n ni-wodiu se ko chɛ n yera tei maama, ko bá taa jege kuri ko pa‑m. Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo nii o nɔn-swonnu tem baŋa ne, ne ba ná peini tete ne mo de.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Nmo na loge bakeiri selo n nɔn-donne maŋa ne to nye de bembea na zei che-tɛɛra o jeŋa ne tei to mo.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná jege bia dedɛ ne o che-kɔŋɔ na su de chena tei to, kotu tiini o jege yu-ywoŋo mo. Wonto ná vei o jeeri o dona teo kom manchwo-peena ni ne, chaveera bá di‑o.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo maama na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ ye ba tɔge o chwei sem to, Wɛ zaane wo ba yuu ne!

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Nmo wó di n totoŋa nyɔɔre pa se n ta‑n zoore de yazura de wopwolo.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Nmo kaane wó taa lore bia mo o pa‑m, nenɛɛne tei-ŋoŋo na leiri bia dedɛ tei to. Nmo bia bam wó taa kaare‑m nenɛɛne teeni na puli ye de ke nɔɔna tei to.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Chega to, wolo maama ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, Wɛ wó ke zaane kotu yuu ne.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó zege Zion ne o swoli nmo swolim. Maŋa maama ye n ta ŋwe to, Wɛ wó pa n maane we Jerusalem teo kom vei yiga lanyerane.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa n ta‑n ŋwe se n di wodiu n naaro jeŋa ne. Yazura taa wo Isarele tiina bam tei ne!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Ko na maŋe ko zege amo biini ne to mo a dona bam yɔɔre ba jege-ne ba daana. Isarele tiina bam jege se ba leiri ba ta we:

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: “Ko na maŋe ko zege amo biini ne to mo a dona bam yɔɔre ba jege-ne ba daana, ye ba wo wane-ne ba ja chɔge.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Amo kwaga kam laam nye de bwolo mo ba na mɛ nabɛ ba ma lɔ pempala ba tiŋi.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa chekke mo. O ma gwoni puseŋ-nyena bam ŋone sem se a wane a lu ba jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Balo maama na chuli Zion teo kom to mo Wɛ wó pa ba na ba chaveera, pa se ba pipiri ba jwoori kwaga.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se ba jei lela, nenɛɛne diga nayuu gaaro na kwaare te te lela tei to.

english_verse: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
translation_verse: Zagena bam yiga tera gaaro tem konto wone. Ba maa ba gaane-te ba tiŋa.

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Balo na tɔge banto seeni ba kɛ to bá sɛ se ba sɔɔle Wɛ swolim ba pa-ba. Ba bá ta nenɛɛne, “Baŋa Wɛ swolim taa wo á baŋa ne.”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a zege na-luŋa kuri ne mo a keeri a jare nmo.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: Amo Teiru, cheigi amo keira kam! Ja, pore n zwa se n cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ya ná jeeli nɔɔna tusim kikia n tiŋi, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá na bora n yiga ne.

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Nmo nam kwei nɔɔna wɛleera n ma n chɛ-ba, se ko pa dé taa kɔre‑m mo.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Amo zege a cheigi de a wo maama se Baŋa Wɛ laam ba o zeini-ne. Amo teena nam wo o taane dem wone mo.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a yere a nii mo se amo Teiru Wɛ laam ba o zeini-ne, ko dwoi tete yerena bam na jege teena se tega laam ba ka poore tei to. Chega to, a teena wo Baŋa Wɛ wone, ko dwoi yerena bam na jege teena we tega kam wó ba ka poore tei to.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Wonto tete mo lage o jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam ba tusim kikia yam maama wone o yage.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Amo nam jei mo chemm, ye a bochare zuri, nenɛɛne bu-seseŋa na ye tei o nu nɛ baŋa ne to.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, pa-na se á teena taa daŋe Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne, ko zege zem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, guli Pɛ David gula, de o na yaare totoŋa baŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Amo bá sɛ se a zo a diga, naa se a peini a sara ne,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: ko ná dae we amo nɛ jeiga a pa Baŋa Wɛ, pa se Jakob dwi tiina Dam maama Tu Wɛ wom taa zoore da.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Dé déem na wo Eferata ne to, mo dé nigi Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam ŋwa. Dé ma na-ka Jeerim kare sem ne.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne, se dé kuni dwoona o yiga ne dé zuli‑o.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Pa se n kaanem tiina bam zo nɔn-ŋonne ne, ne ba zo gare-laaro mo to. Pa se n tete nɔɔna bam taa chaka de wopwolo.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ déem dugi duuri de Pɛ David ye o daa bá jwoori o ni dem kwaga ne. O maa we: “Nɔɔno wó nwoŋi n dwi dem wone mo o ji pɛ.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Nmo dwi dem ná sɛ ni-gwonim delo a na ke de-ba to ye ba tɔge bera yalo a na pɛ-ba to, banto wó taa di nmo paare dem mo se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o kuri Zion mo se o pa ko taa ye o jeiŋa jei.

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: O maa we: “Ywo mo ye amo jeiŋa jei mɛ amo na wó taa zoore taa wuu to.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se Zion tiina bam jeŋa taa jega se ko gaale. Ba yiniga tiina bam de tete wó taa di ba sui mo.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ba kaanem tiina bam wó taa pae a verem dem yi nɔɔna. Amo tete nɔɔna balo na wo teo kom wone to wó taa leeni de wopwolo taa wuu.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Ywo-seeni mo amo wó pa se David dwi paare dem taa zege de dam. A ta wó pa se wolo amo na tiŋi se o ji pɛ to taa jege pwooni o ŋwea wone.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se chaveera di o dona bam. O tete paare dem nam wó taa jege nenɔŋa lanyerane.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Balo na ye nu-biu to ná zoore daane de ni dedwe, ko tiini ko lamma pa ba di ywoni lanyerane.

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ni-ywom dem konto nye de Wɛ swolim nuga mo ba kwei ba lwo Aron yuu ne pa se ka duri ka bɔɔre o twana yam maama ka ta tu ka yi o gwaaro tem nia yam de.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Nu-biu swono ta maa nye de Heremon nyɔnɔ kom dwoŋi na toe Zion peo yuu ne tei to. Ko maa ye dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ ni se o swolim taa wo o nɔɔna baŋa ne, pa se ba na ŋwea taa wuu.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Nii-na! Abam balo maama na ye Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena to, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Abam balo na zege o wara-jei sem ne á zuli‑o tete ne to, tei-o-na!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Zeiŋi-na á jea wɛɛne á jeeri Wɛ diga kam, á ma‑á seini Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu de tega baŋa maama, ye wonto wó zege Zion ne o swɛ abam swolim.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem! Abam balo na ye o tontoŋena to, tei-o-na!

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: Ko maa ye abam balo na zege Baŋa Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne ye á toŋe á pa‑o o wara-jei sem ne to.

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Tei-na Baŋa Wɛ, se o tiini o lamma. Leeni-na lei á seini o yere dem, ko na pae ywoni to ŋwaane.

english_verse: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ kuri Jakob dwi dem mo se ba taa ye o tete nɔɔna. Isarele tiina bam ye o tete nyɔn-mage nyem mo.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: O maa pae se kunkwonnu tigisa logo baŋa ni maama ne. O ta maa pae se doa nena ye ka ta yeini ka pepela. Ko ta ná ye vio kom, o yeini o pore-ko mo se ko nwoŋi ko dole jei maama ne.

english_verse: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem mo mage bu-kwea dwi maama Ejipti teo ne, pa se nabiina dedaane vara wo-kwe sem maama te.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: O ma ke wo-kenkagela dedaane totoŋ-kamuna Ejipti tiina bam tetare ne, ye o tɔge ya baŋa o chɔge Ejipti Pa-faro wom dedaane o nakwa bam maama.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: O déem wane teene dedɛ mo o di, ye o daare o ti pwa-kamuna momwɛ.

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Ko déem ye Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon, de Basan teo Pɛ Oga, dedaane Kanaan tiina pwa badwonna bam maama mo konto.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yere dem wó taa wora mo taa wuu. Ko zege zem se ko vo ko yi dwi delo na saŋe to maama, nɔɔna wó taa guli n yere dem gula.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ wó zege o nɔɔna bam kwaga ne pa se ba na ba bora. O maa wó duri o tontoŋena bam yibwona.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Ya maa jege nia ye ya ware ya ŋɔɔne. Ya ta jege yia. Ya nam ba nae de.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Balo maama na mɔɔne jwona to wó ba ba taa nye de-ya. Balo de na ke ba wo-dedoa de-ya to wó ji nɔn-yɔɔro mo.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Aron dwi dem de, abam de tei-na Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina bam, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Abam balo maama na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to, zaŋe-na á tei‑o!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Balo maama na wo Zion ne to, tei-na Baŋa Wɛ, o na zoore Jerusalem ne to ŋwaane! Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se o lamma. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Dé ke-na Wɛ wom na tei wa maama to lei. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Dé ke-na yuu tiina maama Yuu-tu lei. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O déem tɔge o yeino kom ŋwaane mo o ke wɛyuu kom maama. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ta ma jare tega kam ni maama pa se ka tigi na-fwaaro tem baŋa ne. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ke wo-nyen-kamuna yam wɛyuu ne. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ma pa se wea kam taa pae pwooni dɛ dem wone. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Se chana kam de chalechwe sem taa nii tete dem baŋa ne. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei! O déem go Ejipti tiina bu-kwe sem maama. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O mɛ o dam-fɔrɔ kom mo o ke totoŋ-kamunnu tem konto. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O déem pɛ se Nane-soŋo kom pɔɔre belei mo. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ma pa Isarele tiina bam da na bam tetare ne ba kɛ. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Ejipti Pa-faro wom de o jar-keira bam, o pɛ naneo kom lini-ba mo. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ma ti pwa-kamuna momwɛ. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, o go pwa balo na jege yere to. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amori tiina Pɛ Sihon déem ye ba dedoa mo. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Basan teo Pɛ Oga maa ye wodwoŋi. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O kwei banto tega kam mo o pa o nɔɔna bam. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ma kwei-ka o pa Isarele dwi tiina bam se ba taa tei-ka wuu, ba na ye o tontoŋena to ŋwaane. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: O ma vere debam o yage dé dona bam jeŋa ne. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Wonto mo pae nabiina de vara maama ba ni-wodiu. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Praise God in heaven! God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Pa se dé ke-na Telaao Tu Wɛ wom lei! O swono kom wora mo taa wuu.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Dé déem yeini dé jei Babilon teo bwi sem ni ne dé ka yi-na mo, dé na guli dé teo Zion gula to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, dé dona déem daane debam mo se dé leeni leiŋa dé pa-ba. Ba maa jege debam ba bɛɛsa se ba pa dé leeni wopwolo lei ye ba we, “Leeni-na leiŋa na vei Zion teo kom seeni to á bere debam.”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Debam nam na zoore sa-teo wone konto to, dé wó ke tɛ mo se dé leeni leiŋa kalo na vei Baŋa Wɛ seeni to?

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Amo ná ba yeini a guli Jerusalem gula, Wɛ wó pa se a ni dem laam meeri mo. Amo ná ba pae Jerusalem ye amo wopwolo maama, Wɛ wó waare-ne konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Babilon tiina bam, á nam yɔɔre á maŋe de chɔgem! Balo na wó jwoori ba ke abam se ko maŋe de á na ke debam tei to, Wɛ wó pa se banto taa jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Chega to, balo ná maŋe ba kwei á bu-sese ba feiri peero yera ne, Wɛ wó pa se banto de taa jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo kwei a bochare maama mo a ma a ke nmo lei. A maa wó zege wa yadwonna yam yiga ne a leeni a seini nmo yere dem.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Amo wó pipiri a jeeri n wara-jei selo na ye wose to ye a laam chɔɔle tega ne a tei‑m. Kokuri to, n swono kom wora mo taa wuu, ye n ta yɔɔre n zege n chega wone. N ma‑n pa se n yere dem zaŋe wɛɛne, ye ni delo n na tiŋi to tiini de jege kuri.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: A na keeri a jare nmo to, nmo leiri a wɛ-lworo kom lela. Nmo ma‑n pa se a na baare de dam.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, logo baŋa pwa bam maama wó tei nmo mo, ne ba ná nigi kwora kalo na nwoŋi n ni ne to.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Ba wó leeni mo ba ta Baŋa Wɛ totoŋa yam taane, o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na tiini ko gaale to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, n seene n wo wɛ-wɛ mo, ye n yiga ta wo nabwona wone. Ko nam ná ye balo na bere ba tete to, o zege dáane mo ye o yei ba chwei sem.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ zege amo kwaga ne pae a na bora. O swono kom wora mo taa wuu. Baŋa Wɛ, yé kwei debam balo nmo na ke to n dole n yage.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yɔɔre n buŋi a maama mo, pa se n lɔre amo na ye tei maama to.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Amo ná jeini tega ne naa a ná zaŋe wɛɛne, nmo maŋe n yei ko ni ne. Nmo ná maŋe n ye yiga yiga tei maama de, n ta lɔre a boboŋa yam.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n gilimi amo mo n ke tetare ne. Nmo daŋe n jeŋa a baŋa ne se n zeini-ne.

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Amo ná kwaane a di wɛyuu baŋa baŋa mo nmo maŋe n wo dáane. Amo nam ná koge gwoŋo mo luŋu luŋu se a vo a yi churu kuri kuri, nmo daa‑n ta wo dáane de!

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Amo wó ta nenɛɛne, “A lage a vo a seigi lim wone mo, pa se de kwoli-ne. Wea kam wó ji lim pa se nɔɔna yia daa ba nae.”

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Nmo mo naane a yera yam maama. Amo ta na wo a nu puga ne to, mo n kwei-ya n meeli n ke daane.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: A ke nmo lei dedɛ, de n na tɔge chwo-kenkagela n naane-ne se a taa kɔre‑m tei to. Nmo totoŋa yam maama maa ye wo-kenkagela, ye ko ba jege bobwea.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne nmo maŋe n na-ne, ye a ta wo bege a ti se ba lo-ne. Ba ta na wo loge-ne se a na wea pwooni to mo, nmo maŋe n jeeli da yalo maama amo na wó taa ŋwe to n tiŋi n tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo boboŋa yam gaale ya dwoi se a lɔre-ya. Nɔɔno ware ya ni se o jeeli o ja.

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Amo ná maŋe a kwaane mo se a ga ya ni, a ga ga mo a vo a pwoli, ya na daga ya dwoi buga ni kasol-bia bam to ŋwaane. Amo ta ná dɔ a zaŋe, nmo ta wora amo tei ne.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nam zaŋe n go puseŋ-nyena bam! Abam nɔn-gora bam, lage-na jei da amo yiga ne!

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: Banto kare ba ŋɔɔne wo-balwaaro mo ba pa‑m. Nmo dona bam fɔ vwa yerane mo.

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo yɔɔre a chuli balo na chuli nmo to. Ko na ye balo na lɔge nmo kwaga ne to, amo tiini a neese-ba mo.

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a chuli-ba mo chekke, ba na jigi a dona to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Kwaane se n nii, tusim chwoŋa wora amo na tɔge-ka na? Laam ta‑n tɔge amo yiga, se a kwei chwoŋa kalo na maŋe ka wora taa wuu to.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, jwoŋi-ne nɔn-balwaaro jeŋa ne n yage! Kwoli-ne se nankɔ-nyena yé wane ba ke-ne zonne.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Boyere-nyena tiŋi kalanchogo mo se ba ja-ne. Ba ma che bora amo chwoŋa ne se a to ka wone.

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Baŋa Wɛ, n jege dam se n vere-ne n yage. Jara ná yi amo dɛ delo wone, n yeini n kwoli a yuu.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, yé sɛ se puseŋ-nyena bam na wonnu telo ba fera na zoore to. Ba ná zaŋe amo baŋa ne, yé pa ba na pwola ba toŋe ba lwarem dem.

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Amo yei we Baŋa Wɛ mo yeini o zege o pa yiniga tiina, pa se nabwona wane ba na ba chega.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, nɔn-ŋona wó tei n yere dem. Balo na vei chwo-laao wone to wó taa zoore n woro kom wone.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo keeri a jare nmo mo. Ja, ke lela n ba n woli-ne. Pore n zwa se n cheigi amo wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, fɔge n yere amo ni taane dem, se n che se ta-balɔrɔ yé nwoŋi a ni ne.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Ta‑n cho-ne se a fera yé zo totoŋ-lwanno. A ba lage se a tɔge a woli de nɔn-balwaaro ba puseŋa kikia yam wone, ne ko ná maŋe ko ywomma tei de.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Yage se nɔn-ŋom mage-ne. Keim dem konto dwoŋi ye lanyerane mo ko pa-ne. Pa kotu chwoŋa se o korese-ne, se ko taa nye de nuga mo o mɛ o turi-ne. Amo bá ve se o lwo-ka a yuu ne. Amo nam na lwoori‑m tei to ye se n che nɔn-balwaaro totoŋ-lwanno tem mo.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo nam kwoni a nii nmo mo. A lage a seigi a tete nmo woro kom wone. Yé pa chwoŋa se lɛɛro yi-ne!

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Nam pa se puseŋ-nyena bam jwoori ba to ba tete kalanchorro tem wone, se amo tete laam wane a lu ba jeŋa ne.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: A ta yeini a ŋwane o yiga ne, ye a lwoni a yaara yam maama a bere‑o.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Kwaane n nii amo jazem seeni, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se kotu zeini-ne. A wo nɛ wolowolo se a sale o yera ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yiga tera a wone.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo keeri a jare nmo mo. A maa tɛ a we, “Nmo mo ye amo dalem jei. A ta na ŋwe tega baŋa ne to, nmo mo ye wolo na maŋe de amo to.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Pore-ne n ja n nwoŋi peena diga kanto wone, se a laam wó tei nmo yere dem. N nɔn-ŋona bam wó ba ba gilimi daane amo ŋwaane, dedaane n na ke-ne lanyerane tei to.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Yé ja-ne n ba n saŋe n tete yiga ne, se a ye nmo tontoŋeno mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na ŋwe ye o yɔɔre o jege bora nmo yiga ne.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Amo dona bam kwaane mo ba pare-ne se ba mage-ne ba de tega ne. Ba ma fe-ne ba ke lim jei ne nenɛɛne balo na tega ba dáane na ye tei to.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a vɔna tiini ya pare mo, ye a wo de chɔɔre dedɛ.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: A maa zeiŋi a je sem wɛɛne a ware‑m. A maa tiini a lage‑m de a wo maama, ne te-kora na tigi ye na tera tei to.

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ke lela n ba n leiri-ne, se a vɔna yam laam pare mo. Yé seigi n yibia amo tei ne, se a laam wó taa nye de balo na maa vei churu to.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a zaŋe zezeŋa maama ne, pa se a taa guli nmo swono kom gula. Kokuri to, a ke a wo-dedoa dedaane‑m. Nam pa se a lɔre chwoŋa kalo a na wó tɔge to, a na kwei a tete a pa‑m to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, jwoŋi-ne n yage a dona bam jeŋa ne . A duri mo a ba se a seigi n woro kom wone.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Bere-ne a na wó ke tei se a taa ke nmo boboŋa yam, nmo na ye amo Tu Wɛ wom to ŋwaane. Sɛ se n Jwori-laao kom tɔge amo yiga se a taa vei tega kalo na maŋe daane to baŋa ne.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, da n yere dem ŋwaane se n pa a ŋwea jwoori ka ke dam. Tɔge n nɔn-ŋonne dem baŋa ne n le-ne yaara wone.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maŋe dedaane tia, se wonto nye de peo kolo amo na dale da to mo. O maa bere-ne se a taa yei jara keim laŋa.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, bɛ mo ke ye n yiga wo nabiina wone? Bɛŋwaane mo n jege nabiin-bia boboŋa konto?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Nabiina maama momwɛ ye vio yerane mo. O ŋwea da yam yeini ya ti lela nenɛɛne lunluŋu na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, kɔɔre wɛyuu kom nenɛɛne diga ni gɔrɔ, se n daare n tu tega kam baŋa. Twe n jeŋa n dwei peero tem, se te tɔre min-vogo ye nyoa zaŋe gulululu.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, a lage a leeni leiŋ-doŋa mo a ma a seini‑m. A ta wó kwei kɔnɔ a ta, se a ma a zuli‑m.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo mo zeini pwa se ba wane ba dona ba di. N ta ma jwoŋi n tontoŋeno David n yage, se o dona yé go‑o jara wone.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Sɛ se dé bia bam ke nɔɔna lanyerane, nenɛɛne teeni na jege de bere lela tei to. Dé bukwa de wó taa jege lam, nenɛɛne ywoa yalo na teili pɛ di-kamunu ye ba gɔgere-ya lanyerane tei to.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Nam ta pa dé tuli sem taa sui de wodiiru dwi dwi, se dé pei sem de taa lore bia zanzam, moro moro laŋa ne, pa se se faare tega kam maama.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Pa se dé naane dem yɔɔre de taa lore bia dɛ dɛ. Yé pa dé dona chwoŋa se ba wane dé teo kom ba zo, se ba kale debam ba ja viiri. Che se nɔɔna yé taa chwoosa dé teo kom chwei sem ne.

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ, nmo ye a Pɛ. Amo wó taa tei‑m, ye a zuli nmo yere dem mo.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone a lage a taa seini‑m, ye a daare a taa zeiŋi n yere dem taa wuu mo.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ jege kamunni mo! O maa seene o maŋe dedaane tia. O kamunni dem daga de dwoi se dé wane dé lɔre de kuri maama.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Kwoa wó lwoni nmo totoŋ-zana yam ba bere ba bia se ba taa seini nmo.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: Ba lage ba ŋɔɔne nmo paare dem nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ taane mo ba bere nɔɔna. Amo de maa wó taa boŋe nmo totoŋ-kenkagela yam boboŋa.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó taa tɔɔle nmo na tɔge n dam dem baŋa ne n ke totoŋ-zana tei to. Amo de maa wó taa ŋɔɔne nmo kamunni dem taane.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó tɔɔle nmo na jege yere nmo lanyerane dem ŋwaane tei to, ye ba daare ba leeni de wopwolo ba seini nmo n bora borem ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o ke nɔɔna maama lanyerane. Ko ná ye woŋo kolo maama o na ke to, o maa duri ba maama yibwona.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama jege nmo teena mo. Nmo mo pa-ba ba ni-wodiu ko maŋa ne chekke.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n puri n jataala yam n kwei wo-laaro dedɛ n pa balo maama n na naane to pa se ba di ba su.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o zeini balo maama na lwoori‑o to, nenɛɛne ba ná lwoori‑o de ba wo maama.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: O toŋe o tɔge balo na kɔre‑o to boboŋa mo. Ba ná keeri ba jare‑o, o ta wó cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom, ye o daare o jwoŋi-ba o yage.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ cho balo na swoi‑o to mo. Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam, o lage o chɔge ba maama mo fase.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Amo tɛ a tete wone mo we, “Tei Baŋa Wɛ!”

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, ba siu kom ná kɔga, ba yeini ba jwoori tega kuri ne mo. Dɛ dem konto nɔɔ mo ba ya na jege boboŋa yalo maama to wó jei.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo naane wɛyuu kom, de tega kam, de naneo kom, dedaane kolo maama na wo te wone to. O maa yeini o zege o chega wone taa wuu.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nii balo na ye veira sa-teo wone to baŋa ne. O maa zeini botara de kadeina. Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena, o yeini o che ba yiga.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Ko lamma mo se dé leeni dé seini dé Tu Wɛ wom, ko na pae ywoni ye ko tɔge chwoŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: O jeeli chalechwe sem ni mo o ja, ye o daare o bwoŋi se maama dedoa dedoa de ka yere.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Leeni-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ ye á ke o lei. Kwei-na kwanno á ta á ma á zuli‑o.

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Wɛ yeini o pae se kunkwonnu kwoli wɛyuu kom maama. O ta maa pae se doa nene tega kam baŋa ne, se gaaro de nwoŋi te faare zwonnu tem.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Wonto mo pae vara ba ni-wodiu, ko ta woli de bachangaaro de, ne te ná keera wodiu ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Wɛ ba jege wopwolo de sisein-nɔɔna na dana tei to. O yiga maa tera jar-keira de ba baare dem wone.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wo nam pwoli de balo na kɔre‑o to, ba na kwei ba teena ba daŋe o swono kom baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Jerusalem teo nɔn-bia bam, zeiŋi-na Baŋa Wɛ yere dem. Zion tiina bam, tei-na á Tu Wɛ wom.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: O maa pae se yazura taa wo á tega kam ni maama ne, ye á na men-dala dedɛ se á ta‑á di á sui.

english_verse: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
translation_verse: O ma pa se kunu ba ko kwoli tega kam ye ka peere cha ne lɔŋɔ na ye tei to. Ko ta ná ye nyɔnɔ, o yeini o pa se ko jage lela mo ne tentwarem tei to.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: O maa dole do-kandwa o yage tega baŋa ne. O waaro tem ná bobo se te zuri, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o zege te yiga ne.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɛ toŋe o kwora mo se Jakob dwi tiina bam lɔre-ka. O ma kwei o bera yam de o nia yam o pa Isarele tiina bam se ba taa tɔge-ya.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina nam tera Wɛ na ke konto dwoŋi o pa-ba. Banto maŋe ba yeiri o bera yam ni ne. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Abam balo na wo wɛyuu kom ne to tei-na Baŋa Wɛ! Tei-o-na wɛ-wɛ baŋa jei sem maama ne!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Abam balo na ye o malese ye á wo o kwaga kɔgɔ kom wone to, tei-o-na!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wea kam de chana kam, ko maŋe se abam de taa tei‑o! Se abam chalechwe sem na pepele to de tei‑o!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Wonnu maama na wo wɛyuu kom baŋa ne to, tei-o-na! Ko ta woli de na balo na tigisi wɛyuu kom baŋa ne to, ba-na á tei‑o!

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se woŋo maama mo taa tei‑o, kokuri to, wonto mo dɛ o ni dem ŋwaane o naane-te.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: O déem pɛ se te zege te zega jei ne taa wuu, ye kolokolo daa ware o ni dem konto ko chɔge.

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ko ná ye doa pepelem, de do-kandwa, de kunu, de nyɔnɔ, ko woli de vo-dɛɔ dwi maama na sɛ o ni dem to, tei-o-na!

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ko ta woli de kago-vara, de sɔŋɔ-vara, dedaane tega-veila, de zuna dwi maama, tei-o-na!

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: Tega baŋa pwa bam, de dwi tiina maama, dedaane nakwa, de dedɛɛra maama,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: ko woli de nɔn-donno, de bukwa, de nɔn-kwe, de bu-balwa, á maama tei-o-na!

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Pa-na se wonnu maama tei Baŋa Wɛ, o yere dem na tiini de daga de gaale to ŋwaane! O nenɔŋa kam de daga ka dwoi woŋo kolo maama na wo tega baŋa ne dedaane wɛyuu maama ne to.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: O zeiŋi o tete nɔɔna bam mo pa se ba na dam de zula. O ke konto o pa o nɔn-swonnu Isarele tiina bam mo. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ. Jeeri-na de o nɔn-ŋona kɔgɔ kom á tei‑o.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Pa-na se Isarele dwi tiina bam di ywoni ba Keiru wom ŋwaane, se Zion tiina bam taa chaka de wopwolo ba Pɛ wom ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ wo pwoli de o nɔɔna bam kikia. O jwoŋi balo na tu ba tete to o yaga, pa se ba na nenɔŋa nɔɔna yiga ne.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se tia lei taa wo ba ni ne, ye ba ta zei jara se-zɔɔro ba jea ne.

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ba keim dem konto wó ŋwe jene delo ya na tigi ba dona bam baŋa ne to mo. Konto to, balo maama na kɔre Wɛ to wó na zula. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ! Pa-na o jwoŋi o tia o wara-jei sem ne! Pa-na o jwoŋi o tia wɛyuu ne mɛ na ye o dam jei sem to!

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Tei-o-na o totoŋ-zana yam ŋwaane, de o na daga o dwoi kamunim dwi maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Wu-na nabwanno á ma‑á tei‑o, se á daare á ta kwanno á tei‑o.

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se woŋo kolo maama na wae ko sii vio to mo tei Baŋa Wɛ. Pa-na dé tei Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Isarele teo pɛ Solomon na ye David bu to memaŋa mo tento.

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Memaŋa yanto nam ye se ya bere nɔɔna swa se ya daare ya korese-ba. Ya wó woli nɔɔna se ba taa ni yi-poro taane kuri, ye ba pɔɔre taana daane.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Memaŋa yam wae ya pae nayeiri-nyena ja boboŋ-ŋona. Ya ta wae ya pae nɔn-donno na yeino de yi-poro.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyena de ná cheigi-ya, ba wó zamese ba woli ba swa wone. Boboŋ-boŋena de wó fɔge ba lɔre chwoŋa ba taa tɔge-ka.

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: Ko maa wó pa se nɔɔna lɔre memaŋa yam kuri, ko woli de sinseiri, de dende selo maama swa tiina na yeini ba ŋɔɔne to.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: Nabiina na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ mɛ to, yeino de puli dáane mo. Ko daare jworru yerane mo wó gwooni swa taane de koresem. Yé pa ba soge‑m ba wane

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: Pa ba bera yam taa tigi n bochare ne, ne nenɔŋa zambili mo n de n ba ne to.

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tɔge daane dé vere ba wo-laaro tem dé taa tei, pa se dé sam su de ba jejegero tem.

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔn-balwaaro tem konto gare ba toŋe lwarem, ye ba lage lela de nɔn-gora totoŋa.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Wolo ná boŋe se o ja zuŋa, kotu bá pa ka na kalanchogo kolo o na chege ka ŋwaane to.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Venverena bam konto nam na vwɛ se ba go nɔɔna to, ko ye ba tete dwi mo ba lage ba ja.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Teo kom pwooni mɛ nɔɔna na jeeri ba ke sɔɔ to, de ko manchwo-nia yam ne mo ko zege da ko ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa ko we:

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Nayeiri-nyena, dɛ dɔ mo á wó yage á jworim dem? Nɔn-lwɛɛna, á de wó ta‑á lwɛ á dwonna taa, se á vo á maŋe yei ne mo? Nɔn-jworru, á wó yage ka-taa-chuli-yeino maŋa kɔ mo?

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: Foone maa wó ja abam nenɛɛne vo-dɛɔ dwoŋi, ye lɛɛro de ba á baŋa se te li abam ne vo-kekara na ke tei to.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó lwoori wolim amo tei ne, ye a ve se a leiri-ba. Ba maa ná beeri a jei tei de, ba bá na-ne.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ba yɔɔre ba chuli yeino mo, ye ba ve we, ba bá taa kɔre Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: Ba maa wo sɛ amo kwea yam, ye ba ta kwareme ba zwa de a bwɛa yam.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane ba wó su de yaara ba chwoori-ya, ba boboŋ-lwanno tem de ba kikia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Ko daare, wolo maama ná sɛ a bera yam, ko wó ke lam ko pa kotu. O bochare bá taa zaga de kolokolo, ye kolokolo foone de bá taa jege‑o.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Amo bu, sɛ se n jwoŋi a bera yam. Kwei nia yalo a na pɛ‑m to n ke n bochare ne.

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: Pore n zwa se n ja swa, n daare n kwei n boboŋa maama n pa yi-poro.

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: Yɔɔre n beeri yi-poro, se n daare n lwoori yeino de kwor-dɛa.

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: Chɛ se n beeri swa, ne ya ye lu-nyenno telo na seigi to mo.

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: N ná ke konto, n wó lɔre Baŋa Wɛ kɔrɔ na ye tei chekke, ye n daare n me ded‑o.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Kokuri Baŋa Wɛ mo kwei swa o pae nabiina. O ta maa woli-ba de yeino de yi-poro.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: O maa jege swa chekke se o kwei o pa nɔn-ŋona. Ko ta ná ye balo na yɔɔre ba tɔge chwoŋa to, o kwoli-ba ne jara nantana mo tei.

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: O nii ko baŋa ne mo se chega taa toŋa, ye o che balo na jege o chega to, se cham yé yi-ba.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: N boboŋa maa wó ja swa, ye yeino de pa n na wopwolo lanyerane.

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: Nmo na lɔre lɔra tei to mo wó taa kwoli‑m. N boboŋ-ŋona maa wó taa yere‑m.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: Konto to, n bá‑n ta‑n tɔge puseŋ-nyena chwei sem, naa n to pipiri-nyena chwoŋa ne.

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: Banto maŋe ba ywori chega chwoŋa kam ne mo, ye ba vei lim wone.

english_verse: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
translation_verse: Ba ta swoi se ba taa toŋe lwarem mo, ye ba wo de tiga de puseŋa kikia.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: Ba ye nɔn-ŋollo mo ye ba kikia ba tɔge chwoŋa.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Swa chekke wó che‑m de ka-tola, de o ná maŋe o ŋɔɔne ni-som ŋɔŋa se o ma soge‑m tei de.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Kotu yage o baro wolo o na zo o donne maŋa ne to, pa se o yiri ni delo o na gwoni Wɛ yiga ne to.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Chwoŋa kalo na vei o sɔŋɔ kom ne to guri de toone mo. Balo na tɔge da to maa zoore churu.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná vei o tei, kotu daa ba jwoora. O nam daa bá to ŋwea chwoŋa kam wone.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná jwoŋi swa, n laam wó ta‑n tɔge nɔn-ŋona nɛ-bwora mo, ye n vei chega tiina chwoŋa ne.

english_verse: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
translation_verse: Kokuri to, balo na yɔɔre ba tɔge chwo-laao to mo wó taa zoore dé tega kam wone.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: Ko daare puseŋ-nyena bam yere wó saare tega kam baŋa ne. Nɔn-ŋollo de maa wó jei ka wone.

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: Kokuri, n ná tɔge-ya, n wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre, ye wonnu da chwoŋa te pa‑m.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne mo Wɛ de nabiina wó taa lage n ni taane, ye n na yere-ŋom.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Kwei n chega maama n daŋe Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne. Nam yé teege nmo tete boboŋa baŋa ne.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Totoŋe delo maama n na wó ke to, ta‑n yei Baŋa Wɛ ni ne. Konto mo o wó pa wonnu maama kwei te chwoŋa te pa‑m.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Yé fɔge n jeeli n yuu ne we nmo mo yei n tia. Nam ta‑n kɔre Baŋa Wɛ ye n duri lwarem kikia.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Konto mo wó pa n na yazura, ye n dam dem wó jwoori n tete ne.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Kwei n jejaano tem n ma n zuli Baŋa Wɛ, se n daare n kwei n da-yiga wodiiru pɛɛra n pa‑o.

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne mo n tuli wó su de wodiiru, ye sa-doora de taa daga ba gaale, pa n yeiri n na wó ke-te mɛ.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Amo bu, ne Baŋa Wɛ ná jege‑m o koresa, se n sɛ koresem. O maa ná bwɛ‑m, se n yé pa n yiga nyɔne.

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ korese balo o na swoi to mo, ne kwo na ke tei de o bu-swono to. Swa na lana tei to

english_verse: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná lɔre swa ye o jege yi-poro, kotu yuu ywomma.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Swa tiini ya jege kuri ya dwoi lu-nyenno. Ya maa jege nyɔɔre ya dwoi sabu-seŋa de.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Ya ta maa jege lonne ya dwoi kandwa-nyenno. Nmo fera ná zo woŋo kolo maama, ko bá yi swa na ye tei to.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Swa zei momwɛ-dɛɛre mo o jazem ne. Jejegero de yere-kamunu maa wo pɛɛra yalo o na zei o jagwia ne to.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Swa chwei sem jege ywoni mo. Se tɔgem maa pae nɔɔna bochara zura.

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: O mɛ o yeino mo o pɔɔre naneero tem yera yera, ye o daare o pa doa taa zege kunkwonnu wone ka nena.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Amo bu, ta‑n mae swa chekke de boboŋ-laaro n toŋa. Yé pa se te vere n jeŋa ne te daare‑m.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Foone bá ja‑m, ne lɛɛro ná pɔpɔ te ba n baŋa, naa chɔgem ná to puseŋ-nyena yuu ne.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó pa n wo taa tiga. Wonto wó taa cho‑m cham wone, se kolokolo yé ja‑m pa n to.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: N dwoŋi ná maŋe se n woli‑o, ye nmo ná jege kolo na wó woli‑o to, se n yé vane‑o.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Nmo ná wae n dwoŋi n wola leile, nam yé ta ded‑o we, “Vei se n jwa jwoori n ba se a woli‑m.”

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye n faro wolo na pɛ nmo o chega to, yé boŋe lwarem se n ma n chɔge‑o.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Yé mage kantɔgɔ de nɔɔno yɔɔ yerane, ne kotu ná wo chɔge n yiga kolokolo baŋa ne.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Yé pa se n boboŋa zo nankɔ-nyena kikia wone. Nam yé lwoni ba totoŋ-naga kam.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ chuli nɔn-ŋollo mo. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋona, o lɔge o wo o bere banto mo.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ sɔɔle lwarem mo o yage puseŋ-nyem sɔŋɔ ne. Ko daare nɔn-ŋom sɔŋɔ su de o zaane mo.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nɔn-lwɛɛna, Wɛ nii-ba kafɛ mo. Ko daare ye o zaane wo balo na tu ba tete to yuu ne.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Swa tu yere wó zaŋe mo. Nɔn-jworo maa wó di o chaveera.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: A bia bam, cheigi-na á kwo bera. Ke-na á zwa keo se á wane á lɔre lɔra.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: A kwea yam jege kuri mo. Konto to, yé ve-na a bera yam.

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: o bere-ne o we: “Ta‑n jege a botare sem n boboŋa ne, ye n daare n ta‑n ke n tɔge a nia yam, se n wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Beeri swa dedaane yi-poro. Yé swei a bera yam ni ne, nam yé ve-ya.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Yé ma n kwaga n ya yi-poro, se o wó taa kwoli‑m. Nam yɔɔre n ta‑n swoi‑o se o taa nii n baŋa ne.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Yi-poro mo jege kuri ko dwoi wonnu maama. Konto to, kwaane n beeri swa jei. N ná maŋe n beeri kolo maama se n ta‑n tei, ta chɛ se n lɔre lɔra.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Pa yi-poro taa jege lonne o pa‑m, se o wó pa n na yere-zɔŋɔ. N ma‑n ná kukwori‑o, o wó pa n na zula.

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Amo bu, sɛ se n ke n tɔge amo bera yam, se ko pa‑m momwɛ-dɛɛre.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Amo kwei nmo mo a de swa chwoŋa kam ne, se n ta‑n tɔge chega chwei sem.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n ná via, kolokolo bá che n yiga. N nam ná duri lela, n bá‑n tiri n to tega ne.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Zamese bera n ke n boboŋa ne, se n yé yage-ya. Fɔge n nii ya baŋa ne, kokuri yanto mo wó pa n ni ŋwea ywoni.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Yé lwoni puseŋ-nyena kikia yam, naa n tɔge nɔn-balwaaro nɛ-bwora.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ba ná wo toŋe lwarem, ba bá peini ba dɔ. Dɔɔne ba tui ba yia, ne ba ná wo pɛ se nɔɔno to tega ne.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Puseŋa kikia de vuvuga totoŋa mo ye ba ni-wodiu.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona na jege ŋwea kalo to nye de te-pora ni pwooni dem mo. Pwooni dem konto lɔɔre de ke da mo se ko vo ko yi wea tetare maŋa.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena bam, ba ŋwea maama yɔɔre ka ye ligi-ligi mo. Ba maa yeiri wonnu telo na pae ba tiri ba toe tega ne to.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Yé swei a bera yam swia, de fenfee de. Nam yɔɔre n pa ya taa tigi n boboŋa ne.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Kokuri, balo na lɔre-ya to wó na ŋwea ya baŋa ne. Ya ta maa pae nɔɔna jege yazura chekke.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Kolo na dwoi maama to, fɔge n ta‑n yei n boboŋa yam ni ne. Kokuri to, n ŋwea totoŋe maama puli dáane mo.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ. Nam yé ta‑n kare n ŋɔɔne ta-yɔɔro.

english_verse: Keep looking straight ahead, without turning aside.
translation_verse: Kwaare n yuu n yiga ne, se n yé bare n nii jei jei.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei n tete na-veili ni ne, se n tɔge chwoŋa kalo na ye chekke to.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Yé lɔ chwoŋa n vo jazem seeni, naa jagwia seeni. Nam yɔɔre n ta‑n cho n tete de lwarem kikia.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Amo bu, ke n zwa keo se n cheigi swa de yi-poro taane delo a na jege se a ta de nmo to.

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: Ko wó pa n lɔre kolo na maŋe keim, ye yeino taane wó taa wo n ni ne.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ka-tola ke ni-som de nɔɔna, ne to-nuga na lura tei to mo. O ni taane maa yɔɔre de swola ne nuga na ye tei to.

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: Se ko kweeli to, o kikia maama wó pa n na chanɛɛre de zonne yerane mo.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: O nɛ-bwora guri de toone mo. Balo na tɔge‑o to maa vei churu.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: O yiga tera de chwoŋa kalo na pae ŋwea to. O ma tusi chwoŋa kam, ye o daa yeiri woŋo kolo o na jege o ke to.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Konto to, amo bu, cheigi a taane dem. Yé se n zwa de a na jege kolo a tɛ to.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Nam lɔŋe ka-dwi dem konto chwoŋa kam. Maŋe n yé twɛ o sɔŋɔ seeni.

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Yé dole n zula n yage. Ko ná dae konto, nankɔ-nyem wó ja‑m o go.

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: Se ko ba ti maama to, n yera maama wó bugi ya jei mo, pa se n ŋwana

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: Ta‑n jege swono lara de n kaane yerane, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na wó nyɔ o tete lɔɔ wone na tei to.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Ko dae se n pa n lɔɔ wo na bam taa tigi zɛɛra, se wolo maama ná yia, se o twei o nyɔ.

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Yé pa nɔn-gaa tɔge o nyɔ-ba, se nmo yerane mo wó taa nyɔ ko wone.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Pa o taa jege lam n yibia ne, ne woŋa dwoŋi to, se o yela yam taa jege fera ya pa‑m taa wuu, ye o swono kom de taa pae n su de wopwolo.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Amo bu, nmo wó pa ka-tola ja‑m o ke o ja-bɔŋɔ ne se bɛ mo? Bɛ mo wó pa n vo n kukwori nɔɔno wodwoŋi kaane?

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyeno tete wɛleera mo jwoori ya jaane‑o. Ya nye de ŋone mo ya vɔge‑o ya tiŋi.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Amo bu, nmo ná kwei n tete n zege daare ŋwaane se n ŋwe n dwoŋi jene n pa‑o, ko ná fɔge ko dae nɔn-veira,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: ko bere we nmo tete ni taane mo lage de ja‑m ne kalanchogo tei.

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: Amo bu, ko nam ye se n ke tento mo, se n wane n jwoŋi n tete, nmo je na wo n dwoŋi wom ni ne to ŋwaane. Nam véi n tu n tete o yiga ne, se n daare n lwoori‑o se o ma o chɛ‑m.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Ke lela n vo o tei, ye n ta wo sii de fenfee de.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: Nam ke nmo na wó ke tei maama se n wane n lu to, nenɛɛne feira naa zuŋa na kwaane ka lu ka jaro jeŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na ye jawɔre-nyem to, nmo wó ta‑n tigi n dɔa taa se n vo n maŋe yei ne mo? Nmo ba lage n zaŋe n tiga jei sem ne na?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Tɔ. Daa ta‑n dɔ fenfee n woli da. Kwogili n yia se n sii. Ta‑n tigi n peiga jei sem ne ziim.

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: Yiniga wó vɔɔre ka zi‑m, ne venvereno na zaŋe nɔɔno baŋa ne tei to mo. Gɛɛre de maa wó pɔpɔ de ja‑m lanyerane.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Kotu jeeli lwarem mo se o ke, o boboŋa na ywori to ŋwaane. O ná vei mɛ maama, nankɔɔre mo zaŋe dáane.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo lɛɛro wó pɔpɔ te ba o baŋa. O maa wó yɔɔre o na chɔgem ye o bá lu de wone.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Wonnu teredo mo Baŋa Wɛ chula. Chega to, wonnu terepɛ maa ye wo-zɔɔna o tei ne.

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: Te maa ye: Wolo na bere o tete kamunim to, de wolo na jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ to, de nɔn-goro,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: de wolo na jei o boŋe lwarem o pae o dwonna to, de wolo na yɔɔre o wuuri de lwarem keim to,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: de wolo na fɔ vwa taane dim baŋa ne to, dedaane wolo na pae vuvuga tui o dwonna tetare ne to. Gwalem taane

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Nmo ná vei mɛ maama, ya wó taa wo n yiga ne ya bere‑m chwoŋa. Nmo ná tigi n dɔa de, ya wó taa yere‑m. Nmo daa ná zaŋe, ya wó pa‑m kwea.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ba bera yam nye de min-zwoŋo mo. Ya maa ye pwooni ya pa‑m se n ta‑n via. Ba koresem dem de maa wó pa n ni ŋwea ywoni.

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: Taana yam konto wó che‑m de ka-balɔrɔ, ko fɔge ko dae ka-tola na wó kwei ni-som se o soge‑m tei to.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Yé ke n fera o ya-tega lam dem wone. Nam yé sɛ se o go o yia o ma-ya o ja‑m.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ŋwe woŋo fee mo ba pae ka-bworo ye ba peini ded‑o. Nmo ta ná peini de nɔɔno wodwoŋi kaane, o laam wó sɔ‑m mo wuu.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Nmo ná seigi min-chala n gare-fɛɛle ne, n gɔrɔ kom bá ja mini na?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná nɔne min-chala baŋa ne, n nɛ bá pwogili na?

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Ba ba ŋwane ba pae ŋweeno we, kana jege‑o ka ni pa o ŋɔ se o zuri o kana.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná jaane‑o, kotu wó ŋwe o na ŋɔge kolo to kuni berepɛ, pa se o ga o sɔŋɔ jejegero maama.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Agɛboŋa yerane mo wó ke bwoŋa de nɔn-gaa kaane. Kotu yɔɔre o beeri chɔgem mo o pa o tete.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Kokuri, kazwe wiiri kan-baro bane mo ko ke da. O ná lage o yiri o jena, o bá ja ŋwaŋa kɔtaa.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Amo bu, sɛ se n jwoŋi a bera yam. Kwei nia yalo a na pɛ‑m to n ke n yuu ne.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Ta‑n ke n tɔge a nia yam, se n wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre. Ta‑n ni a bera yam nenɛɛne ya ye n tete yi-chele-bu mo to.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Sɛ se swa chekke taa nye de n nakɔ mo, se yi-poro de taa ye n badwoŋ-swono.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a zege a sɔŋɔ takworo ni ne mo, ye a leesi a nii

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye wɛ-zwora maŋa mo, ye je-gwonnu ba nii te nae.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Kaane wom de maa yɔɔre o pi o nwoŋi se o jeeri‑o. O yɔɔre o zo ka-bworo gwaaro mo ye o laam jege o boboŋa o seiga.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Kaane wom tiini o pepera mo ye o ba kɔre nɔɔno yi. O nam ware jeiga dedoa se o jeini da.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: O laam ma yɔɔre o vaŋe nɔn-doŋo konto o kukwori‑o ye o mu o ni, o daare o ta o bere‑o de baare we:

english_verse: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
translation_verse: “Yazura pɛɛre nɔna ta daare a sɔŋɔ kom ne mo. A zem nam ke a su a ni-gwonim dem mo.

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a nwoŋi se a jeeri‑m. A ya yɔɔre a beeri nmo jei mo, wɛ-ywom nam nii‑m da!

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: A ta ma kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa dwi dwi a zezage a yage ko maama ne, se na ye Mura, de Alwo, de Kinamon to mo

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Amo baro beeri o kɛ yiga yiga mo. O tera sɔŋɔ ne.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: O nam kwei sabu na daga mo o ke o yera ne o ja o kɛ. Chana kam wó peere ka ti mo se o laam jwoori sɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ka-tola kam tɔge chwoŋa kam konto mo o ja nɔn-doŋo kom o ywori. O nam yɔɔre o kwei ni-som mo o soge‑o o wane.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Bedwe baŋa ne mo o pɛ o kwaga o pu, ne na-bala mo ba jege ba vei se ba go to. O ta nye de woŋa kalo kalanchogo na jaane

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: ye ko laam daare se che-tɛɛre moore o bochɔŋɔ ne to mo. Ne zuŋa kalo na zo kalanchogo wone to, o nam yeiri we o seene o to cham wone se o ga o ŋwea.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Yé pa-na kaane wom konto dwoŋi chwoŋa se o soge abam o wane. Nam yé sɛ-na se o ja abam o ywori á chwoŋa kam ne.

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: O pɛ baara dedɛ mo to tega ne, pa se nɔn-kɔgɔ dole ba ŋwea ba yage.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Balo na zo o sɔŋɔ kom ne to laam to chwo-fara kalo na vei churu to ne. Chwoŋa kam konto wó ba ka guri de toone mo.

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: O yeini o di zwonnu yuu mo o vo o zege mɛ seeni chwei sem na lɛɛne daane to.

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: O ta zege o maŋe de teo kom manchwo-nia, mɛ seeni ba na tɔge ba zoore ko wo to, o tɔɔla we:

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Amo tɔɔle a bwoi abam, se logo baŋa nabiina maama mo ni.

english_verse: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
translation_verse: Abam balo na ye nayeiri-nyena to, ja-na boboŋ-ŋona. Abam nɔn-jworru tem, ja-na yi-poro.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Amo ni taane yɔɔre de ye chega, a na chuli vwa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Amo ni-botare sem maama yɔɔre se tɔge chwoŋa mo. A ba jege ni-zɛ kolokolo baŋa ne.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyena nae a bera yam we, ya yɔɔre ya ye chekke mo. Balo na jege yeino to maa nae we, ya ba jege tusim.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Kokuri swa chekke jege kuri ya dwoi kandwa-nyenno. Woŋo kolo maama á fera na wó zo to bá maŋe de-ya.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Amo ye swa chekke mo. Amo dedaane boboŋ-ŋona mo vei daane. A maa beeri yeino dedaane yi-poro jei se a kwei-te a pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
