translation_verse: Wolo ná kɔre Wɛ, kotu lɔŋe lwarem mo. A yɔɔre a chuli ka-bere-ka-tete, de boyerem, de totoŋ-zɔɔna, de ni-zɛ ni-zɛ kikia mo.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Boboŋ-ŋona de swa chekke wo amo tei ne mo. A maa jege yi-poro de dam.

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Balo maama na swoi amo to, amo de swoi-ba mo. Ko ná ye balo na seene ba yia ba beeri amo jei to, banto wó ba ba yi amo tei.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Nyɔɔre delo nɔɔna na wó na amo tei ne to gare sabu-seŋa, ka ná maŋe ka tiini ka lana tei de. Pɛɛra yalo ba na wó jwoŋi amo jeŋa ne to gare lu-nyenno chekke.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: A maa kwei jejegero a pae balo dwi maama na swoi-ne to, pa se ba sam sui de wo-laaro.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: Se Baŋa Wɛ laam ke wonnu maama to, o naane amo mo yiga o jeŋa totoŋa maama wone.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa ye Baŋa Wɛ ta wo naane logo kom to, o maŋe o kuri-ne boboa kam ne mo.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Ba na loge-ne to, de naneero tem ta tera, de buli-yia de tera se ya taa tae.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Ba loge-ne mo ba daare, ye Wɛ laam chwi peero tem de zwonnu tem te jei ne.

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: Konto maama kea ye o laam mɔ tega kam, de ka pwoli sem, de logo baŋa kasolo kom.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: A tu a wora mo ye o kwei wɛyuu kom o ke ko jeiga ne, ye o daare o lɔ siseini delo na kaare naneo kom maama to.

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: A déem maa wora ye o kwei kunkwonnu tem o ke wɛyuu ne, ye o daare o fɔge buli-yia se ya pa na su naneo kom.

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: A wo o tei ne mo ye o lɔ pempala o ma che naneo kom, se ko wo na-fwaaro yé ve o ni ba gaale mɛ o na pɛ-ba to. O ta na fɔge o chwi tega kam kuri to mo a wora.

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: A yɔɔre a wo o tei ne mo a woli‑o ne gɔgɔ tei. O déem di ywoni amo ŋwaane mo, ye a de wo pwoli o yiga ne.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: A maa jege wopwolo de logo kolo o na ke to, de ko nɔn-bia bam.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: Amo bia bam, cheigi-na a taane dem. Balo na sɛ ba tɔge amo nia yam to mo jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Cheigi-na a bera yam se á ja swa. Yé dole-ya á yage.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Wolo ná cheigi amo taane, kotu jege yu-ywoŋo. Dɛ maama wone, o swoi se o taa tui a sɔŋɔ mo, ye o cheiga se a ŋɔɔne ded‑o.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná tu o lɔre amo, kotu nɛ ŋwea mo. O nam ta wó na zaane Baŋa Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: Ko daare, wolo maama na gɛ amo to beeri yaara mo o pa o tete. Balo na chuli amo to lage ba tete toone mo.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Swa chekke mo lɔge o sɔŋɔ. O ma chwi ywoa yarepɛ o teili-ko o zege.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: O go vara mo se o ke wodi-fɔrɔ, ye o daare o ke sa-sona o woli da. O ma ti ko maama yiga.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: O laam ma toŋe o ka-nyaana se ba kwei o kwora ba vo ba zege teo kom zwonnu yuu ne ba taa tɔɔla ba yaga.

english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: Ba á di-na wodiu kolo a na ke a zege abam, de sana balo a na ke á ŋwaane to.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Yage-na jworim kikia, se á wó ni ŋwea ywoni. Nam tɔge-na yi-poro chwoŋa kam.”

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n bwɛ nɔn-lwɛɛno, se o wó taa chuli‑m ko ŋwaane. Nmo nam ná bwɛ yi-pore-nyem, o wó taa swoi‑m ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Nmo ná woli boboŋa tu, o laam wó na swa o woli da. N ná bere nɔn-ŋom, o wó fɔge o lɔre wonnu.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: Nabiina na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ mɛ to, yi-poro de puli dáane mo. Nmo ná me de Wo-pwoŋo Tu Wɛ wom, nmo wó lɔre wonnu.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: N ná jege swa chekke, n laam wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre mo. N bena yam wó gaale logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem swa yam jaane nyɔɔre mo ya tui ya pa‑o. Wolo nam ná ye nɔn-lwɛɛno, kotu yerane mo wó yaare ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: O jei o sɔŋɔ manchwo-ni dem seeni mo de teo kom zwonnu yuu ne.

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: O maa tɛ de balo na gɛ boboŋa to o we: “Abam balo maama na ye nayeiri-nyena to ba-na á zo amo sɔŋɔ ywo!

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: Nɔn-gaa lɔɔ wo na bam tiini ba ywomma. Wodiu kolo n na wó seigi n di to de dim ywoni mo dwoi!”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Nayeiri-nyena nam yeiri we balo maama na lɛɛne ba zo Ajworo sɔŋɔ to jege se ba te mo. Churu nam yɔɔre ko su de o sɔŋɔ veira mo.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Pɛ Solomon memaŋa yam mo tento: Bu wolo na jege boboŋ-laaro to pae o kwo wo pwola. Se ko ná ye bu-jworo, wonto pae se o nu wo chɔge mo.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná dɛ lwarem baŋa o ma o na jejegero, o bá na nyɔɔre te baŋa ne. Chwo-laaro tɔgem nam wó jwoŋi nɔɔno toone jeŋa ne.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bá sɛ se kana ja nɔn-ŋona. Ko daare ko ná ye puseŋ-nyena, Wɛ wó che-ba de kolo maama ba fera na zoore to.

english_verse: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
translation_verse: Jawɔrɔ jaane yiniga mo ko tui ko pae nɔɔna. Ko daare jawale-nyem jeŋa yi o ni mo.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim wó taa wo nɔn-ŋona yuni ne. Puseŋ-nyeno ni taane nam pae nankɔɔre zaŋe mo.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Nmo ná guli nɔn-ŋom gula, ko ke‑m ywoni mo. Ko daare puseŋ-nyeno yere wó saare mo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Boboŋa tu jwoŋi bera mo. Wolo na ŋɔɔne yɔɔ yerane to wó na chɔgem.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Wolo ná vei chega chwoŋa ne, kotu nɛ jaane tega mo. Ko daare pipiri-nyena wó seeri ba to.

english_verse: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.
translation_verse: Wolo ná kweele chega, kotu beeri jara mo. Wolo na ŋɔɔne yɔɔ yerane to wó na chɔgem.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom ni taane nye de buli-yi delo na na pae ŋwea to mo. Puseŋ-nyeno ni taane nam pae nankɔɔre zaŋe mo.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Dono wiiri kantɔgɔ mo. Swono maa kwoli wɛleera dwi maama.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem ni taane bere swa chekke. Agɛboŋa nam maŋe se o na waarem mo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Swa tu mo tiŋi yeino o yuu ne. Nɔn-jworo ŋɔŋa nam jaane lɛɛro mo ka tui.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Nadum jejegero tem wae te che‑o de cham. Yini-gwia nam wó chɔge yiniga tiina.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona nyɔɔre ye ŋwea chekke. Puseŋ-nyena ŋweero nam wó taa ye waarem mo ba wɛleera ŋwaane.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná sɛ bera, kotu wo ŋwea chwoŋa ne mo o via. Wolo nam ná ve koresem, kotu wó pa se o dwonna de tusi.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: N ná mɔne de nɔɔno ye n wo ba ŋwae, n ye vwa-fɔro mo. N ná ye bebare nyem, n ye nɔn-jworo mo.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Ta-fara jaane tusim mo ya tui. Swa tu wó pu o ni mo chemm.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom ni taane jege nyɔɔre mo, ne lu-nyenno to. Puseŋ-nyem boboŋa maa ye weero yerane.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona bera jege nyɔɔre ya pae nɔɔna dedɛ. Ko daare jworru jworim dem mo jege-ba de goe.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ swolim mo pae ko gare nɔɔno yera ne. Kolokolo bá baare kotu kwaga.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo mae lwarem kikia o jiri kwɛɛra mo. Boboŋa tu wo nam pwoli keim-laaro ŋwaane.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena na duri kolo to mo wó yi-ba. Ko daare nɔn-ŋona wó na ba na beeri kolo to mo.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Vo-dɛɔ ná zaŋe, puseŋ-nyena ba jege zega jei. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋona, banto fɔge ba zege mo cheppe taa wuu.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Yé kwei n totoŋa n ke jawɔre-nyem jeŋa ne. Ko wó taa ye ne mia ná ŋaare yeila, naa nyoa na wiiri yia tei to mo.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, kotu wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre. Puseŋ-nyeno nam ba yi o dɛ.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona teena guri de ywoni mo. Ko daare puseŋ-nyena teena wó chɔge lela mo.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo pae chega tiina na dalem jei. O ta maa pae puseŋ-nyena na chɔgem.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona kuri ba gɔe. Puseŋ-nyena nam bá dáane tega kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom ni taane bere swa mo. Vwa-fɔro ni nam maŋe se ba pu-de mo.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Nɔn-laaro ni taane ywomma puga ne. Ko daare ye puseŋ-nyena mo ŋɔɔne ta-yɔɔro yerane.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ vae kampin-nyena ni taane. Ko daare balo na jege bwɛ chekke ba toŋe to mo pwoli o wo.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Bere n tete de chaveera vei daane mo, ne tu-n-tete de yi-poro na ye tei to.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom chega kam yere‑o pa o ŋwea lana mo. Nɔn-ŋolo vwa yam maa pipiri ya jaane‑o.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Wɛ ná wora o waare‑m, n jejegero daa ba jege kuri. N nɔn-ŋonne nam wó che‑m de toone.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Nɔn-laaro nɔn-ŋonne dem tiŋi chwoŋa jaja mo pa ba via. Ko daare puseŋ-nyena puseŋa kam pae ba saare ba toe mo.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Chega tiina nɔn-ŋonne dem mo jwoŋi-ba de yaga. Nɔn-ŋollo fera maa jaane-ba.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona wó lu cham wone, se de jwoori de to puseŋ-nyena baŋa ne.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Wɛ-lwɛɛno yeini o chɔge o dwonna de ni-chworu mo. Nɔn-ŋona nam mae yeino mo ba jwoŋi ba tete.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná gwooni o dwoŋi, kotu boboŋa mo muri. Boboŋa tu wó pu o ni mo chemm.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Nakwa ná tera se ba woli pɛ de kwea, o teo kom bá zege. Nakwa dedɛ nam ná wora, teo kom wó ke lam.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Ka-yero na nɛ yere delo to gare nankɔ-nyena na nae jejegero telo to.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Ŋwaŋa tu kikia yam kwɛ o tete mo. Ko daare keim-chɛ-nyeno jaane yaara mo o tui o tete baŋa.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Wolo ná seene o yia de nɔn-ŋonne totoŋa, kotu wó ni ŋwea ywoni. Wolo maa na seene yia de lwarem kikia to wó te mo.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Taane dento bá kwane: Nankɔ-nyena yɔɔre ba lage ba na waarem mo. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋona dwi dem, ba wó taa tei ba tete.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Kaane ná lana ye o ye ka-pwogo, ko nye de sabu-seŋa kwane na leigi teiri momwɛ ne to mo.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona fera na tɔge wonnu telo to wó guri lanyerane mo. Puseŋ-nyena teena nam guri de ban-zɔŋɔ mo.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Wo-ywoŋo tu pae mo ye o jwoori o nae o woli da. Wo-chɛ-nyem maa ve pɛɛre ye o ba o guri de yiniga.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Wo-ywoŋo tu wó na zaane nɔɔna tei ne. Wolo na twei na o pa nɔɔna to, ba wó twei na ba pa o de.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna sɔɔle lwarem ba pae balo na jege wodiiru ba seiga to mo. Ba maa tei balo na pae te nwoŋa se ba yeigi-te to.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Nmo ná toŋe n totoŋa de boboŋ-ŋona, nɔɔna wó pu n kwaga. Nmo nam ná kare n beeri lwarem jei, n wó na-de.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Wolo maama teena ná tigi o jejegero wone, kotu wó to mo, se nɔn-ŋom yera zura mo, ne vɔ-lɛɔ na kwi tio yera ne tei to.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Wolo ná jaane daanem o tui o diga tiina baŋa, kotu bá fɔge o ni o diga kam ywoni. Nɔn-jworo maa wó taa toŋe o pae swa tu.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom nye de tio kolo na pae nɔɔna ŋwea to mo. Wolo maa na jwoŋi o dwonna o yage to mo seene o jege swa.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona ná lage ba na ba totoŋa nyɔɔre tega baŋa ne, se wɛle-keira laam ná niga?

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ zaane wo nɔn-ŋona yuu ne mo, se ko ná ye balo na boŋe lwarem ba pa ba dwonna to, Wɛ wó vane ba bora mo.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem ba fɔge o jiri nɔɔno. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋom, o kuri ba gɔe.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Ka-yero mo pae se o baro jege zula. Ka-pwogo nam pae o baro ye bele-bele mo.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom yeini o boŋe se o ke wo-laaro mo. Puseŋ-nyem kwea nam su de sonsoga mo.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem ni-botare nye de o koge gwonnu mo o tiŋi se nɔɔna to da. Nɔn-ŋom ni taane maa jwoŋi nɔɔna de yaga.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Wɛ yeini o vuvugi puseŋ-nyena mo o de tega ne pa ba yɔɔre ba jei, Nɔn-ŋom sɔŋɔ nam zege mo cheppe.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem ye ba tei‑o mo o boboŋa ŋwaane. Ba maa gwooni wolo boboŋa na ywori to.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná tu o tete ye o laam za jege wolo na toŋe o pa‑o to, kotu gare wolo na bere o tete kamunim ye o ba yi o ni-wodiu to.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom nii o vara mo lanyerane, se ko ná ye puseŋ-nyem, o keim-laaro tete ye puseŋa mo.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Wolo na sɛ varem to jeŋa yi o ni. Wolo maa na kare o toŋe wo-yɔɔro to boboŋa mo muri.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem boboŋa tigi nɔn-balwaaro jejegero baŋa ne. Nɔn-ŋom zege mo ga cheppe, ne tio kolo bonno na jaane tega chekke to.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balɔrɔ vwa mo wó jwoori ya ja‑o. Ko daare nɔn-ŋom wó lu cham wone mo.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: N ná tɛ wo-laaro de nɔɔna, n wó na ko nyɔɔre, ne tontoŋeno na nae o totoŋa nyɔɔre tei to.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo boboŋa mo ko swa. Yi-pore-nyem nam yei we swa dae cheilima ya leiri nakwa wone.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Wolo na tɛ chega taane dim baŋa ne to pa chega mo toŋa. Wolo nam na fɔe vwa taane dim baŋa ne to jege nɔɔna mo o gana.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Chega tu taane ba jia. Ko nam ná ye vwa-nyem taane, de ba dáane de lɔra.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona ba zoore cham wone. Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena, ba cham ba fɔge de tia.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ba toŋe de vwa-nyena, se ko ná ye balo na toŋe chega to, o vei de banto mo.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Boboŋa tu ba bere o yeino yɔɔ yɔɔ. Nɔn-jworo nam kare jei maama ne mo o bere o jworim.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Jawale-nyem jei paare baŋa ne mo. Jawɔre-nyem maa toŋe totoŋ-dɛɛra o pae nɔɔna.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Boboŋ-fara ye zele-dunni mo ya daane nɔɔna. Ta-ywom nam pae nɔɔna boboŋa tigi mo.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom yeini o woli o badwoŋi mo se o to chwoŋa ne. Puseŋ-nyena maa na kwei chwoŋa kalo to jaane-ba ka jia.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem ba wɔa nɔna yalo o na jaane to. Jawale-nyem wó di o su o daare o yeigi o nɔna mo.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: N kikia na tɔge chwoŋa, n wó na ŋwea chekke. Ko ta wó che‑m de toone.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Bu wolo na jege boboŋ-laaro to wó jwoŋi o kwo bera. Ko daare nɔn-lwɛɛno ba sɛ bwɛa.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó taa di ba sui ba ni taane ŋwaane mo. Nɔn-ŋollo nam yɔɔre ba beeri nankɔɔre jei mo.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: N ná boŋe ye n tɛ taane, n ŋwea wó dáane. N nam ná kare n yaga, chɔgem wó ba n baŋa mo.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem fera zoore wonnu telo o na bá na to wone mo. Ko daare wolo ná chɛ de totoŋa, o wó taa di o sui mo.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona chuli vwa mo. Puseŋ-nyena nam swoi chaveera kikia mo.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Chega tu totoŋ-ŋona jege‑o ya kwoli mo. Puseŋ-nyena wɛleera yam maa chɔge-ba.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara pae ba jeŋa jege mo, ye ba ba yi ba teiŋa jɔgɔ. Badwonna de ke ne yiniga mo jege-ba, ye ba jejegero tiini te gaale.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Nadum wó wane o ma o sabu o ma o jwoŋi o ŋwea o yage. Se ko ná ye yiniga tu, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá daane‑o.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona ŋwea pwooni bere ba wopwolo jaja mo. Ko nam ná ye puseŋ-nyena, ba ŋwea pwooni dem wó pɔpɔ de dwei mo.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Boyerem jaane kantɔgɔ yerane mo de tui. Balo nam na sɛ bera to maa jege swa.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Nmo ná lɔgere se n na sabu, ko wó jei lela n jea ne. Nmo nam ná zuri n yera n beeri-ko fenfee, ko wó puli ko pa‑m.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: N ná ware n teena yam n yi, ko bwori nɛ. Ko daare n boboŋa yam ná toŋe ya pa‑m, wopwolo gaale mo.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Wolo na ve se o jwoŋi bera to wó na cham ko baŋa ne. Wolo maa na jwoŋi ni-kaanem to wó na nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Swa tu bera yam nye de buli-yi delo na na pae ŋwea to mo. Ya lage ya che nmo se toone yé ja‑m.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna lage yi-pore-nyena ni taane mo. Nɔn-ŋollo nam wó na ba chɔgem mo.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Boboŋa tu tɔge yeino baŋa ne mo o ke o wonnu maama. Nɔn-jworo maa kare o bere o jworim dem.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná ve se o jwoŋi koresem, yiniga de chaveera wó ja kotu. Wolo nam na sɛ bera to wó na zula.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Nabiinu ná ke o su o fera, ko ywomma ko pa‑o mo. Jworru nam ware se ba yage wɛleera kikia.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Cham zeili wɛle-keiru mo se de ja. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-ŋom, o nyɔɔre ye wo-laaro mo o wó na.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Nɔn-laao wó daare jejegero se o bia leini ba taa di. Wɛle-keiru maa lae o jejegero o tiŋa, se te ba te kweeli nɔn-ŋona jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Wodiiru ya ba jege totoŋe yiniga tu kara ne. Chega nam jei pa ba vere-te ba daare‑o.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Wolo na nii o bu de yi to ba lage‑o. N ná swoi n bu, n wó korese‑o mo se o da chwoŋa.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona di ba sui ba pwi. Ko daare puseŋ-nyena vei de kan-koro mo.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Ka-yero kale o diga o ke da mo. Ka-pwogo maa jage-ka o yaga.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Chega tu kikia bere we o kɔre Baŋa Wɛ lanyerane. Ko daare nɔn-ŋolo kikia bere we o yiga tera de Wɛ.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo ni taane mo beeri waarem de pa‑o. Yi-pore-nyem ni botare nam mo jwoŋi‑o se yaga.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: N ná ba jege nabɛ-vala se n ma n toŋe, n tula wó ji tuli-kora mo. N nabɛ nam ná toŋe de dam, n wodiu wó gaale.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Wolo na pae chega maana to ba fɔ vwa. Wolo na fɔe vwa taane dim baŋa ne to nam yɔɔre o gaane vwa mo o tiŋa.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Nɔn-lwɛɛno ná beeri yi-poro jei, o bá na-ko. Ko daare boboŋa tu ni wonnu kuri mɔle mɔle mo.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Pwɛ n tete de nɔn-jworo, kokuri, n bá‑n zamese kolokolo o tei ne.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Boboŋa tu yeino pa o boŋe o yi mo ye o ke keim. Nɔn-jworo jworim dem maa jege‑o de gana.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworru ba pae wɛleera saarem jege kuri. Wɛ zaane nam wo nɔn-ŋona yuu ne mo.

english_verse: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
translation_verse: Choa tu mo yei ka peiga. Nɔn-gaa ware se o lɔre n cham de n ywoni.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena sam wó ji di-dwonnu. Nɔn-ŋona di sem nam wó ke lanyerane mo.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Nmo wae n boŋe we n na vei chwoŋa kalo ne to lana. Ka nam wae ka tu ka guri de toone.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wae ba mɔna ye ba yiga nyɔne. Ywoni dim nam wae de guri de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Balo boboŋa na ywori to wó na ba totoŋa ŋweero. Nɔn-ŋona de maa wó na ba totoŋa nyɔɔre.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Nayeiri-nyem sɛ kolo maama na to o zwa ne to mo. Ko daare boboŋa tu jeeli kolo o na jege o ke to mo.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Swa tu zuri o yera mo se o lɔŋe lɛɛro. Nɔn-jworo nam lɔgere mo ye o kare o toŋe yɔɔ.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Ban-lom tu swoi se o taa toŋe jworim mo. Ba maa chuli wolo na ke swa de o dwonna to.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balwaaro wó chɔɔle nɔn-laaro yiga ne. Ba wó lwoori nɔn-ŋona se ba ke-ba zaane.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina fara tete yeini ba lɔŋe-ba mo. Ko nam ná ye naduna, ba badwonna gaale mo.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Wolo na yeini o neese o dwonna to ke wɛleere mo. Ko nam ná ye wolo na ke nabwona lanyerane to, Wɛ zaane wó taa wo kotu yuu ne.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Balo na jeeli lwarem kikia to tusi chwoŋa ba jei mo. Balo nam na jeeli lanyerane to bere swono kolo na ye chekke to mo.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Totoŋ-chɛɛra dwi maama jege nyɔɔre. Ni taane yerane nam jaane yini-gwia mo de tui.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Jejegero ye zula mo te pae swa tiina. Jworru maa kare ba toŋe jworim yerane.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, kotu boboŋa wó ke dam. O bia de wó na dalem jei.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Pɛ wolo teo na jege nɔn-bia dedɛ to wó na zula lanyerane. Pɛ wolo nɔn-kɔgɔ na muri to ba jege paare o di.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Wolo na wae o bochare o jaane to bere we o poore mo. Wolo na bere o ban-lom to maa bere jworim yerane.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wo ná tiga, kotu yera wó zuri. Kazwe nam ye jaweo mo ko goe.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Wolo ná pɛ ko zo yiniga tu yera, kotu twe o Keiru wom mo. Wolo nam ná ke nabwona lanyerane, kotu zuli Wɛ mo.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro ná tua, puseŋ-nyena bá wane ba zege. Nɔn-ŋona nam wó na dalem jei, de toone maŋa ne de.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Swa chekke mo wo yi-pore-nyena boboŋa ne. Ya nam ba lɔra jworru tetare ne.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Keim-laaro na su teo kolo to, ko yere zaŋe wɛɛne mo. Ko daare keim-lwanno jaane chaveera mo te tui te pae nɔɔna.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Nmo ná leiri taane de ni-bwom, ko gwi bane mo. Ko daare, kare-yɔgɔ fɔge ko wiiri-de ko ke da mo.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyena pae yeino jege kuri mo. Ko daare nɔn-jworo ni ná puri, jworim yerane mo nwoŋa.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo ba jwoŋi o kwo bera. Boboŋa tu sɛ koresem mo.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona sam su de jejegero mo. Puseŋ-nyena maa lae wonnu ba tiŋi ye cham ba de ja-ba.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyena jege yeino ba jage mo. Jworru nam ware konto ba ke.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ chuli puseŋ-nyena na kwei pɛɛra yalo ba pa‑o to. Ko daare o boboŋa tɔge wɛ-lworo kolo nɔn-ŋona na ke to mo.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ chuli puseŋ-nyena kikia yam mo. Ko nam ná ye balo na tɔge nɔn-ŋonne kikia to, o swoi banto mo.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Wolo ná ywori chega chwoŋa kam, ba wó waare‑o mo, Wolo de ná kɔre se ba bwɛ‑o, o wó te mo.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Toone de churu tete ye jase mo Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Nabiina bochara mo o laam bá taa yei na?

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Boyere nyem ba lage koresem. O maa pwɛ o tete de swa tiina.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem beeri se o lɔre chega mo. Nɔn-jworo nam yɔɔre o puuri jworim mo o su o puga.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Yiniga tu ŋwea yɔɔre ka ye yaara yerane mo. Ko nam ná ye wolo wo na pwoli to, dɛ maama nye de kuri-fɔrɔ mo o jege o di.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: N jeŋa ná ba gara ye n kɔre Baŋa Wɛ gare n jejegero ná gaale ye n wo cham wone.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Swono na wo mɛ ye ba di dwo-vɔɔro yerane to gare sebaŋa ná wora ye ba done nɔna ba sui.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Ban-lom tu fɔge o wiiri kantɔgɔ mo o ke da. Ban-peno tu maa zuri jara.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem ŋwea nye de sabare na vere kara tei to mo. Nɔn-ŋom chwei nam ye jase mo ne chwo-fara to.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Bu wolo na jege boboŋ-laaro to pae o kwo wo pwola mo. Ko nam ná ye nɔn-jworo, wonto bere o ba nege o nu.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Wolo boboŋa na muri to jege wopwolo de jwor-kikia mo. Boboŋa tu kikia maa tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Kwea na tere mɛ to wonnu ba tɔge chwoŋa. Berena nam ná daga, ko kwɛ wonnu mo.

english_verse: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
translation_verse: Ta-ywom ná nwoŋi de maŋa ne chekke, ko pae nɔɔna yɔɔre ba chake mo.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem kikia wó pa o na momwɛ-dɛɛre, se ko che‑o de toone.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó yigi boyere-nyem sɔŋɔ o de tega ne. O maa yere kadeina tega siseini dem.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ chuli puseŋ-nyena boboŋa yam mo, se ko ná ye ta-ŋona, o yi sui yanto mo.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Wolo na boŋe se o duni kampina baŋa ne to wó pa cham yi o diga tiina mo. Ko daare wolo na chuli kalipera to wó dáane.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom wó sigi belei mo se o ta taane. Puseŋ-nyeno ni nam ná puri, lwarem taane yerane mo nwoŋa.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ se o zwa de puseŋ-nyena keira. Ko daare, o yeini o cheigi nɔn-ŋona wɛ-lworo mo.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná bwoli o yibia o jeeri‑m, ko pae wopwolo mo. Ta-ŋona maa pae nɔɔna wo tiga.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Wolo ná sɛ bera yalo na jege jwa, kotu de swa tiina wó taa vei daane.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: N ná chuli se ba bwɛ‑m, n jege n tete mo n ni. Wolo maa na sɛ bera to yi wó poore.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ko pa‑o yi-poro mo. Ka-gwooni-ka-tete de maa tɔge zula yiga.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Nabiina boŋe we ba kikia maama yɔɔre ya tɔge chwoŋa mo. Baŋa Wɛ nam yeini o maŋe ba bochara mo o lɔre ya na ye tei to.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Ke Baŋa Wɛ yiga da n totoŋe maama wone, se n na boŋe n ja kolo to toŋe ko pa‑m.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: Ko kuri mo wora ye Baŋa Wɛ ke wonnu tem maama. Puseŋ-nyena de jege ba dɛ se o chɔge-ba.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ vae balo maama na bere ba kamunim to ni taane. Ko tigi ko nae we ba wó na ba waarem.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná jege swono de chega o pa Wɛ, Wɛ wó yage ba wɛleera o chɛ-ba mo. Nɔɔna ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ko cho-ba de lwarem mo.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno kikia ná tɔge de Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa, Wɛ pae o de balo ya na ware daane to me daane mo.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: N ná ye yiniga tu ye n tɔge chega gare n ná ye nadum ye n wo vwa wone.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Nabiinu wae o jeeli o tete ne o na wó ke kolo jwa seeni. Baŋa Wɛ nam mo wó bere chwoŋa se o taa tɔga.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lage se nɔɔna maŋe wonnu chekke mo ba pa daane. O maa nii o nae ba na jege bwɛ selo ba maa toŋe to.

english_verse: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
translation_verse: Pwa chuli lwarem kikia. Paare nam zega chega ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Pɛ bane ná zaŋe de wolo, kotu wó wane o te lela. Swa tu wó pa pɛ bane dem to mo.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Pɛ lanyerane dem ná kwoli wolo, kotu wó na ŋwea. O wo ná dɛ nɔɔno wolo kikia, ko nye de doa na nene duum maŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná jege yi-poro de yeino gare o ná jege sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋona chwoŋa yɔɔre mo ye ba lɔŋe lwarem. Wolo maa na yei o na-veili ni ne to wó jwoŋi o tete o yage.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Nmo ná tu n tete ye n jei de yiniga tiina gare n ná jei de boyere-nyena se ba pɔɔre wonnu telo ba na vere to wone ba pa‑m.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Wolo na ke o woŋo maama de yi-seena to vei yiga mo. Wolo nam na ke wo-dedoa de Baŋa Wɛ to jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Wolo na wae o maase wonnu to bere we o yi poore. Wolo taane na ywomma puga ne to, nɔɔna wó jwoŋi o bera.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Yi-poro nye de buli-yi delo na na pae ŋwea to mo balo na jege-ko to tei ne. Ko daare jworru jworim dem mo wó waare-ba.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Swa tu boboŋa mo pae se o ni taane jege kuri. Nɔɔna maa cheigi ye ba sɛ-de.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Botare-ŋona ywomma ne tooro to mo. Se maa pae bochare-zuru de yazura.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno kana mo yigi‑o ka de totoŋ-dɛɛra wone. O ni-wodiu ŋwaane mo o toŋa.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Nabiin-wo-korro mo boŋe lwarem ba pae ba dwonna. Ba ni botare tete di ne min-vogo mo tei.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Boyere nyem swoi kantɔgɔ mo. Bebare nyem maa jage badwoŋo.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Nankɔ-nyem soge o dwonna mo se ba tusi. O laam ma de-ba chwo-balɔrɔ ne.

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: Wolo yibia na nyɔne kiri-kiri to boŋe lwarem boboŋa mo. O maa ná merege o ni dem, o zege se o toŋe cham mo.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Yu-pwei ye nenɔŋa yipuga mo. Nɔn-ŋona nam mo wae-se ba yi.

english_verse: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
translation_verse: Ban-peno tu gare babea. Wolo ná wae o tete o jaana, kotu gare wolo na wae teo maama o di to.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Nabiina wó ta jɔrɔ mo. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ mo wó bere kolo na wora to.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Nmo ná di gole-kateiga de ni-mɔrɔ, ko gare balo na di ba sui ye ni-kantɔgɔ wo ba sɔŋɔ ne to.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kabaa yi ná poore, o wó di dam sɔŋɔ tu bu-kayaa baŋa ne. Ba ná lage ba pɔɔre sɔŋɔ tu wom jejegero, ba wó ga‑o ba woli sɔŋɔ kom bia wone se o na o nyem.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Min-vogo pae ba yei lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa lam mo. Ko daare Baŋa Wɛ mo wae o bere nabiinu bochare nyenyego.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: N ná mɔne yiniga tu, n twe wolo na naane‑o to mo. N ma‑n ná chake de n dwoŋi cham, waarem wó yi‑m.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Nankwe nae zula ba naaro ŋwaane mo. Bia de maa wó taa jege teera ba kwoa de ba niina ŋwaane.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Ta-ŋom wo maŋe de nɔn-wo-koro. Vwa fɔm tiini ko wo maŋe de Pa-bu.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Nmo ná kwei n dwonna keim-lwanno n chɛ-ba, n bere swono mo. Ko daare botare-gula chɔge sɔŋɔ mo.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: N ná bwɛ boboŋa tu bedwe, ko wó woli‑o, ko dwoni n ná kwei kafena n fere nɔn-jworo kuni bi.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balwaaro mo ba sɛ ba pae ba yiga tiina. Keim-chɛ-nyeno nam mo wó ba o pa ko zo ba yera.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: N ná vei n jeeri nywoŋ-kura kalo ba na vere ka bia ba daare-ka, gare n ná jeeri nɔn-jworo na wora o toŋe jworim.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: N ná kwei lwarem se n ma n ŋwe lanyerane keim, lwarem bá fɔge de nwoŋi n sɔŋɔ ne.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Jara ná bobo, ya yagem chamma, ne buga na pore pa ka na wuuri yɔɔ tei to mo. N ná chege da-lɔŋɔ ko yiga ne gara.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ chuli se nɔɔno pa puseŋ-nyeno bora, naa se nɔɔno vane chega tu o bora.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: N ná chɔge sabu nɔn-jworo baŋa ne se o beeri swa, ko ye kafɛ mo. Kokuri, o bá fɔge o ja swa.

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Badwoŋ-ŋom zege n kwaga ne mo maŋa maama. Chorro wora se ba woli‑m cham maŋa ne mo.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Wolo na lage kantɔgɔ to lage lwarem keim mo. Zeiŋi-n-tete tu maa beeri chɔgem.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Wolo boboŋa na ywori to kolokolo ba yɔɔre chwoŋa. Ni-zɛ ni-zɛ tu maa zoore cham wone.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: N bu ná ye jworo, bane mo wó go‑m. Nɔn-jworo kwo wo maa ba fɔge ko tiga.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Wolo wo ná pwola maŋa maama, kotu jege yazura mo, Yi-nyɔna nam ye jaweo mo ko goe lela.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem seigi o jwoŋi dim mo se o ma kweele chega kam.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Wo-pore-nyem jaŋa se o yi poore mo. Nɔn-jworo boboŋa nam kare ya beeri mo yɔɔ yerane.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ko dae ko chwoŋa ne se n waare wolo na yeiri woŋo ni ne to, naa se n fere nɔn-yuu de o chega.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Wolo ni taane na ba daga to mo bere we o lɔre chekke. Wolo maa na ba wuuri de o taane to mo seene o yei.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Wolo na ba ye de nɔɔna to nii o tete yerane mo. O ba nege yi-pore-nyem boboŋa.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Jworru yiga tera se ba zamese swa, Banto yɔɔre ba nii se ba ta ba boboŋa mo.

english_verse: Wrongdoing leads to shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Puseŋa kikia vei de chaveera mo. Totoŋ-vɛɛsa nam ba yaale nɔɔno belei.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Nabiinu ni-botare luuna ne naneo wo na-luŋa dwoŋi mo. Swa taane nam nye de bu-dura na zege buli-yi ne ka vei to mo.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo ni taane jaane jara mo de tui. O ŋɔŋa kam ŋwaane o wó su magero mo.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo ni taane mo jwoori de chɔge‑o. O tete taane yeini de de‑o mo.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Bebare nyem ni taane nye de wodi-ywoŋo na duri solololo ko tu nabiinu kana ne to mo.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: N ná kɔre jawɔrɔ de n totoŋa, n de wo-chɔgeno ba gare daane.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yere dem ye dalem jei chekke mo. Nɔn-ŋona maa duri ba zoore da ye ba nae siu.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Ka-zeiŋi-ka-tete mo yeini ko lwoori chɔgem. Ka-gwooni-ka-tete de maa tɔge zula yiga.

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem seene o yia se o zamese swa mo, Swa tiina maa cheigi bera.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Pɛɛre wó pore chwei dedɛ de pa‑m se nɔɔna maama cheigi n taane, de nɔn-kamuna de.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra balei ná mage ni-kantɔgɔ, ko maŋe se ba ta jɔrɔ mo se ba lɔre wɔ mo jege chega.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Ni-wodiu sui kana mo. Ni taane maa zuri bochare.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Balo na swoi ŋɔn-fara to wó na ka ŋweero, kokuri nabiinu ni taane mo jege toone de ŋwea dam.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: N ná di kaane, n nɛ wo-laao. Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ mo ke‑m zaane.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Yiniga tu ŋwane se o na yibwona mo. Nadum maa kare nɔɔna o yaga.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Yuudwoŋo wae ko chɔge nɔɔno. Ko daare chilwoŋ-zɔŋɔ wora o na gare nu-puga bu.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Yiniga tu ná jei de o chega gare nɔn-jworo ná jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: N ná lage keim ye n laam yeiri-ka, ko ba lana. Kokuri, lela lela kɔe bu-kaane nyeene.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Nabiina tete jworim mo jege-ba de chɔga, ye ba jwoori ba jege de Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Jejegero tu wó na badwonna dedɛ. Yiniga tu badwonna nam duri ba daare‑o mo.

english_verse: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ beeri se nadum mo taa lage ba taane. Nɔɔna maama maa lage wo-ywoŋo tu ni taane.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Yiniga tu chorro tete lɔŋe‑o mo. O badwonna de nam bá duri ba daare‑o na? O ná kwaane o tɔge-ba o lwoori tei de, o bá na-ba.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: N ná jege yeino, n wó nii n tete baŋa ne. Yi-poro maa wó pa‑m yiga-veiŋa.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo wo maŋe se o taa di o ni. Ko laam nam wó ke tɛ mo se kabaa di dam pa-bia baŋa ne?

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem peene o bane mo. Ba ná maŋe ba chɔge o yiga, o ke ne o ba nae mo to.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Pɛ bane ná zaŋe, ko nye de nywoŋo mo laara. O nam ná ke wolo zaane, ko nye de nyɔnɔ mo to ga-lɛɛro baŋa ne.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Bu-jworo yɔɔre o pae ko jege o kwo mo ko ni. Ka-wam ná swoi jara, ko nye de doa na nene ka ba waara to mo.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwoa kwei jejegero mo ba pae ba bia, se ko ná ye ka-yero, Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo pae.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: N yera ná duna, n wó ta‑n dɔ dedɛ mo. N ma‑n ná ba sɛ totoŋa, kana mo wó ni‑m.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Wolo na sɛ bera to wó jwoŋi o tete o yage. Ko daare, n ná jege Wɛ nia yam n gwoona, n wó te mo.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Wolo ná jege wo-ywoŋo de yiniga tiina, kotu jene o pa Baŋa Wɛ mo. Wɛ nam wó jwoori o yiri kotu jene o pa‑o.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: De n bia chwoŋa ne ye pwola ta tigi ka pa‑m. Yé woli-ba se ba jwa na chɔgem.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Ban-lom tu bane dem mo pae o nae cham. O dae ba woli, kokuri o ta wó to de wone.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: N ná cheigi kwea ye n jwoŋi bera, n jwa wó ji yi-pore-nyem mo.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Nabiinu na boŋe se o ke kolo to ba lɔre ko tia, Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa yam mo wó zege.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Kolo na ye wo-chɛɔ to mo ye se nɔɔna bere swono daane. Yiniga tu maa gare vwa-fɔro.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, o wó na ŋwea. O ta wó sii mo chɔnɔ, ye chɔgem bá yi‑o.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem ware o pa o jeŋa vo o ni.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: N ná mage nɔn-lwɛɛno, nayeiri-nyem wó tɔge da o zamese swa. N ma‑n ná bwɛ yi-pore-nyem, o wó lɔre o yi mo.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Amo bu, n ná yɔɔre n ve bera, n nam ywori lɔra chwoŋa kam ne mo konto.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Nɔn-wo-koro yeini o yaale taane dim mo de o maana. Puseŋ-nyena maa pae lwarem kikia jiri wodiu pa ba di.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Nɔn-lwɛɛna maŋe de waarem mo, ye jworru maŋe de magero.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Sa-nyɔre pae nɔɔno toŋe jworim mo. Sa-dɛɛra maa pae nɔɔno swoi jara. Sana na gane wolo maama to ba jege swa.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Pɛ bane ná zaŋe, ko nye de nywoŋo mo laara. Wolo ná gɔre‑o, kotu wó ga o ŋwea.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Wolo na lɔŋe jara to wó na yere. Ko daare nɔn-jworo beeri jara jei mo se o ke.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem na kɔre varem to, ba wó taa toŋe faao ye o jei o nii mo.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Nabiinu boboŋa luuna ne naneo wo na-luŋa dwoŋi mo. Boboŋa tu nam mo wae-ya o vaŋe o lea.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Dedɛ tɛ de ni-vɔɔ we, ba ye chega tiina. Chega tu nam ba yi.

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom ŋwe o ŋwea pa ka tɔge chwoŋa mo. O kwaga kam maama wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wó wane o ta we, o boboŋa maama yɔɔre ya ye chekke, ye biin tera o ŋwea wone?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye kampin-nyena na kwei bwɛ selo na dae chekke ba maa toŋe to, Baŋa Wɛ vae banto ni taane.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Ba lɔre bia ba kikia baŋa ne mo. Dáane mo n wó lɔre ba tɔge chwoŋa na.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Zwa na cheiga ye yia de nii to, Baŋa Wɛ mo ke-te.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n dɔ dedɛ, se yiniga wó ja‑m. Nam poore n yera se n ta‑n di n sui.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná sɛ se o zege se veiru di jene nmo tei ne, ko maŋe se n jwoŋi kotu gare-bwora mo n woli da.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Kampini wonnu dim ywomma. Te nam wó ba te ja n ba.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Bwɛ de n dwonna se n daare n tigisi n boboŋa jeiga dedoa. Nam yé vei jara ne ye n wo jwoŋi kwea.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Wolo ná jege o kwo naa o nu yere o chɔga, o momwɛ wó pɔpɔ de ti, ne mini na pɔpɔ de dwei tete ne tei to mo.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: N kwo ná tega o daare jejegero o pa‑m ye n muri, te bá kwɛ‑m n nɔn-keiri maŋa ne.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Yé boŋe n tete ne we, “Amo wó yiri lwarem kikia jene mo.” Ta‑n cheigi se Baŋa Wɛ jaŋe o pa‑m.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ vae kampin-nyena ni taane. Bwɛ selo na dae chekke to ba lana o tei ne.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo tiŋi chwoŋa o pa debam se dé taa via. Nabiinu nam wó ke tɛ mo o lɔre kolo na wo yiga ne to?

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Wɛ kwei boboŋa o ke nabiinu maama wone mo. Ya nye de min-mɔɔla mo ya bere dé wo kom chekke.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Pɛ ná dɛ chega ŋwaane o swoi nɔɔna, konto mo wó kwoli‑o. Ko ye o swono kom mo pae se o paare dem zega.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Nɔn-donno teere ba dam baŋa ne mo. Nɔn-kwe nam wó mage nenɔŋa de ba yu-pwei mo.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Ba ná ke‑m zonne pa ko chɛ n yera, n wó yage lwarem kikia mo. Magero dedɛ korese‑m mo se n leiri n wo.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna yeini ba boŋe we ba kikia maama tɔge chwoŋa mo. Baŋa Wɛ nam yeini o maŋe ba boboŋa yam mo o lɔre ya na ye tei to.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Nmo ná toŋe ko lɔɔre ye n tɔge chega, gare n ná zwɛ vara n ke kaanem n pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem na-veili ye wɛleere yerane mo, de o na pae o dwoi maama ye o bere o tete to ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Boboŋa tu ná chɛ de totoŋa, o wó vo yiga. Yiniga maa wó ja wolo na wuuri se o duni to.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Jejegero telo nɔɔna na fɔe vwa ba nae to ba dáana. Te nye de nyoa na maa jei to mo. Te maa wó ja‑o te go.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena nankɔɔre kikia yam wó jwoori ya chɔge-ba mo, ba na ve se ba ke chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Wolo na wo vwa wone to totoŋa ba tɔge chwoŋa. Chega tiina kikia nam yɔɔre ya ye chekke mo.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná beeri gugworo o nayuu ne o tigi da gare o ná zoore de ka-wam.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyeno jege lwarem puga mo o jei. Wonto ba duri o fara yibwona kɔtaa!

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: N ná mage nɔn-lwɛɛno, nayeiri-nyem wó tɔge da o zamese swa. N ma‑n ná bere boboŋa tu, o wó lɔre lɔra mo.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Chega Tu wom yei kolo na jege ko ke puseŋ-nyena sam ne to. O maa pae chɔgem tui ba baŋa.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Nabwona ná lwoori wolim ye n ve se n cheigi, nmo de ná lage zeinim, ba bá leiri.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Pɛɛre ná seigi de pa, de goe bane. Dim delo na kwoli de pa to de zuri ban-lom mo.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Chega ná jege ka toŋe jei selo ne, nɔn-ŋona chaka mo, ye nankɔ-nyena fona.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Wolo na ba boŋe o yi ye o ke keim to, wó kweeli yibeeli wone mo.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Yiniga mo wó ja wolo na swoi kajaŋa keim to. Wolo na swoi sa-nyɔre de wodi-fɔrɔ to bá duni.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena yeini ba jwoŋi nɔn-ŋona cham ba zeŋe mo, ye nɔn-ŋollo leiri ba jwoŋi chega tiina lɛɛro tem.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná duri o vo kagoa yuu o zoora, gara o ná zoore de ka-wam wolo na jege nyenyɔna to.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem lae wo-laaro dwi dwi de nuga mo o zege o sɔŋɔ wone. Nɔn-jworo nam ba di o daare o zega.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná beeri lam de swono jei, kotu wó na momwɛ-dɛɛre, de duni, de zula mo.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyem wó wane teo kolo na su de babɛ to. O maa wó vaare mɛ ba na dale to o de tega ne.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ke gara n ni ne, se n che n tete de cham.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Ba bwoi boyere nyem we, “Nɔn-tweeno” mo. Kotu ba fe nɔɔna o nae bu da.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Wolo fera ná zo wonnu dedɛ ye o jawɔrɔ gaale, kotu beeri toone o pa o tete mo.

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Wolo ná fɔe vwa taane dim baŋa ne, kotu taane wó maŋe tega ne mo. Wolo nam ná boŋe o yi, ba bá che kotu maana yam.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyem pa o ye mo ye o bere o dae da. Nɔn-ŋom nam boŋe mo ye o ke keim.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: N ná yei tega tei de, de n ná jeeli n tiŋi mɛ de mɛ de, n bá‑n dwoni de Wɛ se n di.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Nabiinu wó wane o kwɛ o sisein-nɔɔno o ti se o vo jara wone. Baŋa Wɛ nam mo lage o di jara yam.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Korese n bu se o da chwoŋa. O ná ke nɔɔno, o bá ywori ka wone.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Naduna di dam mo nabwona baŋa ne. Je-diru maa ye kabaa jene tu tei ne.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Wolo na du puseŋa to wó zage cham mo. O ban-jworo kom bá toŋe ko pa‑o.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Wɛ swolim wo wo-ywoŋo tu baŋa ne mo, kokuri, kotu yei we yiniga tiina de ni di.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Le-na nɔn-tweeno á wone se kantɔgɔ jei. Toro de jara maama de maa wó ti.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Wo-pwoŋo tu ni taane ná bwona, kotu de pɛ wó di badwoŋo mo.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o yere boboŋa tiina mo, se ko na ye nɔn-ŋollo, o jage ba boboŋa mo o yaga.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Jawɔre-nyem maŋe diga ne ye o we, “A ná nwoŋi pwooni ne, nywoŋo wó ja-ne!”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Ka-tola ni taane ye kalanchogo mo. Ko maa jaane balo Baŋa Wɛ bane na zaŋe de-ba to.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Bia boboŋa yɔɔre ya su de busɔɔne kikia mo. Nmo nam ná yɔɔre n korese-ba, ba wó to chwoŋa ne.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Wolo na bɛɛse nabwona se o ma o na nyɔɔre to, de wolo na woli naduna de pɛɛra to, yiniga wó ja ba maama. Faŋa tu bera yam

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Fɔge n cheigi faŋa tu bera yam, se n daare n tɔge kolo a na bere‑m to.

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, ya ná tigi n bochare ne, ye n wae-ya n lwoni n bere nɔɔna, n wó di ywoni ya baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nmo, a zem pɛ n lɔre wonnu tento maama, se ko pa n teena taa wo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: Memaŋa yam wó pa n lɔre taane delo na yɔɔre de jege chega to, se n wane n ta chega kam de balo na toŋe‑m to.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n vere nabwom wonnu o na bwona to ŋwaane. Nam yé vane yiniga tiina bora.

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo wó ŋɔɔne o pa-ba, ye o pa ko zo balo na jege-ba ba bɛɛse to.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Yé di badwoŋo dedaane ban-lom nyem. Nam lɔŋe wonto dwi dem.

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: N ná wo lɔre zega, n de wó ji kodwoŋi nɔɔno, pa se n ŋwea kam chɔge.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Yé le n yuu n zege se n ŋwe nɔn-gaa jene.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Nmo ná wo wane n ŋwe, ba wó ba ba kwei n sara ba daare‑m.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Yé fɔɔre siseini delo dé nabaara bam na lɔge ba tiŋi ba pa daane to.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno jeŋa totoŋa ná tɔge chwoŋa, kotu wó toŋe o pa pwa ye ko dae nɔn-yɔɔro.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Yé vei n jeini de wo-loŋ-nyem n di wodiu, ne ko ná maŋe ko ywomma tei de.

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro ná bwoŋi‑m se á di wodiu daane, ta‑n yei se n ja n tete lanyerane.

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: Peene n fera yam, se n yé di n ni.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Yé sa yera de wodiu kom na totoge ni tei to, kokuri, ko tigi da gana ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom konto dwi yeini o jeeli nmo na di tei to mo. O wae o tɛ de nmo we, “Di nmo na lage tei!” Ko nam wo yi o wo.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Yé go n tete se n ma‑n duni. Nam boŋe lanyerane se n zuri n yera.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: N ná yɔɔre n da n na sabu, ko nam jei mo konto, ne ko puli vɔna mo ko jaane wɛɛne ko jei to.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Nmo ná maŋe n di fee de, n wó tɔne-ko n yage. Nmo ya na seini‑o tei to maa wó ji kafɛ.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Yé ja swa taane n yi nɔn-jworo, se o bá nege-de.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Yé fɔɔre siseini delo dé nabaara bam na lɔge ba pa daane to. Nam yé di n zo botaro kara, o na bwona to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Amo bu, cheigi a taane se n ja swa. Pa n kikia taa tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n vei de balo na misi ba tete sa-nyɔre wone to, naa nɔn-kwollu telo na lage dim-fɔrɔ to.

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: Yiniga mo wó ja sa-nyɔra de nɔn-kwollu. Ba jawɔre kikia yam wó pa ba ji nɔn-kayɛ.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: N dɛ n kwo baŋa mo n ba logo baŋa. Ta‑n cheigi o taane. Nam yé ve n nu bera o kokweero baŋa ne.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Kwaane se n ja chega yera. N nam ná jaane-ka, yé kwei-ka n yeigi. Ta beeri se n na yi-poro, de boboŋ-ŋona, de lɔra.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Bu yi ná poore, o kwo jege wopwolo mo, ye o teere de o bu wom.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Amo bu, fɔge n cheigi a taane. Zamese a ŋwea na ye tei to, se n lɔre veiŋa.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei we ka-bworo ye gwoŋ-chanluŋu mo. Ka-tola kam ye vole delo ni na ye voloa to mo.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ba vwɛ mo nenɛɛne venverena, se ba vere baara ba kaana tei ne.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wo lɛɛro wone tento? Wɔ mo tiini o jege ŋwaŋa tento? Wɔ mo swoi jara? Wɔ pompona mo gaale? Wɔ fufwollu mo dwoi o tete? Wɔ yia mo seene ne jana tento?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Ko ye balo na kwei ba tete ba pa sana to mo. Ba maa vei ba jwoŋi sa-laŋa.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Yé pa n fera zo sana bam ba lam ŋwaane, ne ba ná maŋe ba fufugi tei maama zom-bia wone, naa ba ná duri ba tu puga wone solololo de.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: N yia wó taa kare ya nii mo liira liira ye n boboŋa maama vugimi wo-yɔɔro baŋa ne.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Nmo dɔɔm wone tega kam nye de ka gigili mo. N laam ma‑n pipira ye n ye bele-bele n sara wone.

english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Nmo laam maa wó ta nenɛɛne, “Wɔ mo jege-ne o yiga ye a ba na‑o? Sana banto bá lwoori a yia ne se a daa vo a jwoŋi sa-laŋa na?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Yé pa se n boboŋa vugimi nɔn-balwaaro ŋwaane. Ta yé ta‑n lage se n ta‑n nye de puseŋ-nyena.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Yé pa n boboŋa zo puseŋ-nyena wone. Nam yé di badwoŋo de-ba.

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: Kokuri ba yeini ba jeeli nankɔɔre kikia mo ba yuu ne, ye ba ná puri ba nia ko ye se ba chɔge nɔɔno mo.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔn-balɔrɔ ba jege jwa. O ŋwea pwooni dem wó pɔpɔ de dwei mo.
