translation_verse: Bu-sese wó taa jei kapɛ bɔɔna ni ne ba kwɛɛra. Bu-balɛ de wó kwei ba je ba tore anakɔbayi peiga jei ne. Kolokolo zonne nam bá yi-ba.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá ke o dwoŋi zonne, naa o chɔge kolokolo amo Baŋa Wɛ peo kom jei maama ne. Kokuri to, tega baŋa maama wó su de nɔɔna balo na yɔɔre ba me de Baŋa Wɛ to, ne na na yɔɔre ba su naneo kom wo maama tei to mo.

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, logo baŋa dwi maama wó ba Jesse dwi tu wom tei, o yere dem na wo wɛ-wɛ to ŋwaane. O maa na zoore mɛ to wó na zula lanyerane.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Baŋa Wɛ daa ta wó tɔge o dam dem baŋa ne se o ja o nɔɔna balo ta na daare ye ba wo teene dedɛ wone to o jwoori sɔŋɔ. Teene dem konto maa ye Asiria, de Ejipti, de Paforosi, de Kusi, de Elam, de Babilonia, de Hamafa, de jei selo na wo naneo kom ni ne to.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Wonto mo lage o zeiŋi tuta se teene dem maama na, se o daare o la Isarele tiina de Judah tiina balo na jage to o ke daane. Banto wó zege tega baŋa ni maama ne mo ba jwoori.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Ba nam wó tɔge daane mo ba siseiri ba tu Filisi teo na wo wɛ-zoore seeni to. Ba maa wó ke daane se ba vere nɔɔna balo na zoore wɛ-puli seeni to jejegero. Ba ta wó wane Edom teo, de Moaba teo se ba taa tei-de, ye Amon teo tiina wó ba ba zo banto dam kuri ne.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se te-kora peini Ejipti naneo kom wone. O maa wó twe o jeŋa o pa se vo-loŋo zaŋe Yuferata buga kam baŋa ne. Buga kam laam wó chɛ ka ji nabare serepɛ, se wolo maama ná vei de napera, se kotu wane o bɛ-ka.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Chwo-fara wó taa tigi ka pae Isarele tiina balo ta na daare ye ba zege Asiria teo ne ba jwoori sɔŋɔ to. Ko maa wó taa nye de Isarele tiina bam déem na nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne ye ko ye tei to mo.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, nmo wó ta we: “Baŋa Wɛ, amo wó ke nmo lei. Kokuri to, n bane ya zaŋe de amo mo. De laam nam toa, ye n jwoori n ke dam n ke amo kuri ne.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Chega to, Wɛ mo ye wolo na vere-ne o yage to. Amo wó ke a wo-dedoa ded‑o mo se foone yé taa jege-ne. Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na pa-ne dam to, ye wonto ŋwaane mo a leena. O ma bere o tete we o ye amo vereno wom mo.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Abam na wó na verem tei to wó pa á di ywoni dedɛ, ne á na mɔɔne na-ŋona vole wone á nyɔ tei to.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, abam wó taa tɛ we: “Ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se á daare á tei o yere! Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre o na toŋe kolo maama to. Pa-na se o yere dem tiini de zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Leeni á seini-na Baŋa Wɛ, wo-kenkagela yalo o na ke to ŋwaane! Pa-na se logo baŋa dwi tiina lɔre o na toŋe kolo maama to.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: Abam Zion teo tiina bam, ta‑á bage-na á yaga, ye á leena de wopwolo. Kokuri to, Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom mo wo abam tetare ne, ye o tiini o dana.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kalo Wɛ na kwei o pa Amozi bu Izaya se ka vo Babilon tiina seeni to mo tento:

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Zege-na zwoŋo yuu ne á zeiŋi tuta wɛɛne, se nɔɔna wane ba na jaja. Tɔɔle-na kwora se ka yi-ba, se á daare á yeese á jea á pa ba vo ba ke chichuŋu de naduna balo na zoore sɔ-fwaaro wone to.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á chwoosi-na á yaga, kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom bwola. De ná yia, ko wó taa ye Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom mo pɛ se chɔgem ba.

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nɔɔna maama vɔna wó pare. Ba maama wo maa wó leegi.

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: Foone wó ja ba maama ye ba yera chɛ yaara ŋwaane. Ba yera maa wó taa sae, ne kaane wolo na wowole se o lo bu to. Ba wó taa nii daane mo, ye ba jaane ba nia. Ba yibia maa wó bere jaja we, ko tiini ko chɛ ba yera ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Nii-na, Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom beene. De nam wó ja lɛɛro mo de ba, ye Wɛ ban-lom dem wó tiini de zaŋe de wone. Konto maa wó pa se tega kam jei maama ji kagoa, ye wɛleere-keira maama saare ka wone.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa bá wane ba na wɛyuu chalechwe sem maama pwooni. Wɛ nam ná jege de pula, ko wó taa ye lim mo. Chana kam de bá taa nyea de pwooni.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó pa se lɛɛro yi logo baŋa, nabiina totoŋ-lwanno ŋwaane. A ta wó waare puseŋ-nyena ba wɛleera ŋwaane. A maa wó pa se boyere-nyena kamunim dem ti, ye a daare a chɔge nankɔ-nyena dam dem de.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Balo nam na wo nɛ chwoŋa se ba lu to, nɔɔna wó ja-ba ba zɔ de se-zɔɔ ba go.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: A lage a chuchugi Media tiina mo se ba nwoŋi ba vo ba jeeri Babilon teo de jara. Banto yiga tera de lu-nyenno naa sabu-seŋa.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: Ba wó kwei ba chena mo ba tɔ nɔn-donno ba go. Ba bá duri bu-sese yibwona, ba nam bá duri bu-somwa de ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Babilon mo jege nenɔŋa ko dwoi teene maama. Babilon tiina bam maa jege fia ba teo kamunu kom ŋwaane. Wɛ nam wó chɔge-ko mo, ne o déem na ke tei o chɔge Sodom de Gomora to.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa bá jwoori ba taa zoore teo kom konto wone maŋa de maŋa. Arabi tiina bá chwi ba vwoa dáane. Nayera de nam bá ja ba vara ba vo da se ba peini ba sii.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Kago-vara yerane mo wó taa kare da ba beera. Nywoŋ-kuri maa wó su ba di-dwonnu tem. Dáane mo kunkwooru de wó taa zoora, ye tɔro de taa kare de faŋe jei maama.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lage o jwoori o duri Jakob dwi dem yibwona mo. O maa wó fɔge o kuri Isarele tiina bam se ba taa ye o tete nyem. O nam wó ja-ba o jwoori ba tete teo kom wone ye o pa ba jeini da. Veira laam maa wó ba ba gwaane ba wone, se ba de Jakob dwi tiina bam taa ye bedwe.

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: abam laam wó ta‑á ke Babilon teo pɛ mo á mɔna ye á we: Kachɛa kam tete dam ti! O daa bá yaare debam!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bwori puseŋ-nyena da-lwanno tem, ye o daare o nɔne pwa dam o se tega ne.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Tega baŋa jei maama laam nɛ bochare-zuru de yazura, ye ba maama jege wopwolo lei ba leena.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Lebanon teo Sedare teeni dem tete, dedaane tei-ŋonno tedaara tem de jege wopwolo mo de kolo na yi nmo to ye ba tɛ ba we: “Nmo laam na to n tigi tega ne tei to ŋwaane, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá ba ywo se kotu gwoni debam o de tega ne.”

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Nmo na maŋe n chɔge n teo kom ye n go n nɔɔna bam to ŋwaane, ba bá ke n yera yam tega ne ne ba na ke pwa badwonna bam tei to. Puseŋ-nyena dwi dem yera maama nam wó saare mo se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ti-na yiga se á go pɛ wom bia, ba nabaara wɛleera yam ŋwaane. Yé pa-ba chwoŋa se ba wane logo baŋa maama ba di, se ba fɔge ba lɔ teene jei maama ne ba zege.

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Amo na jege boboŋe delo tega baŋa maama ŋwaane to mo konto. Amo nam mo twe a jeŋa se a mage logo baŋa dwi tiina bam.”

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Wɛ déem pɛ se kwora kanto yi amo tei bene delo Pɛ Ahaz na tege to wone mo.

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filisi tiina bam, abam maama yé ta‑á chaka we, da-lɔŋɔ kolo ya na jege abam ko mage to laam bwori. Lɔre-na we basankwea done ye ka bu nii mo. Basankwea kam konto bu wom vea nam wó dwoni ka tete vea kam.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Yini-gwia na jege balo to wó na ba ni-wodiu. Nabwona de wó sii de ba yaara yam. Ko daare abam Filisi tiina bam wó te mo de kana. Abam kɔgɔ kom nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wori.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina ná toŋe nɔɔna debam tei ne, dé nam wó ta bɛ mo dé bere-ba? Dé wó ta de-ba mo we, “Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o chwi Zion teo mo o zege. Ko nam ye dáane mo o nɔɔna balo na yaare to wó zo ba na dalem jei.”

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibon teo tiina diini ba teo jwoni diga kam, dedaane de wara-jei bimbini dem mo, se ba keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Moaba tiina yɔɔre ba keeri mo Nebo de Medeba teene dem na chɔge to ŋwaane. Ba cheeri ba yuni mo ye ba daare ba fane ba twana ba wo na chɔge to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimirim bu-nɔgɔ kom we maama, ye gaao kolo na wo dáane to de kwaare. Ga-zuru de teeni maama jei mo.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Moaba tiina na nɛ jejegero telo ba tiŋi to mo ba laga ba ke daane, ye ba ja-te ba vo ba bɛ ‘Buga ni teeni’ nabara kam.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ba yini-keira kam kɛ ka yi Moaba laŋa kam siseini. Ba na laare tei to yi Egelayim seeni, ye ba ŋwana yam de vo ya yi Beeri-Elim teo kom.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Dibon teo buga kam su de jana mo. De ko de, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se ba cham dem dwoni konto. Ko nam ná ye balo na nɛ chwoŋa se ba lu ye ba ta daare Moaba laŋa kam ne to, nywoŋo mo wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne ko go-ba.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé kwei pei dé ŋwe dé pa wolo na nii tega kam baŋa ne to. Dé wó zege Sela teo ne mo dé toŋe-se se se tɔge kagoa kam yuu se vo se yi Zion peo kom.

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: Ba wó tɔge swono baŋa ba pa paare dedwoŋi taa zega, se nɔɔno tɔge chega kikia baŋa ne o di paare dem konto. Wolo nam na wó di-de to ye David dwi tu mo. Wonto wó bore nɔɔna bora de chega mo, se o daare o nii se nɔn-ŋonne taa toŋa.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Kare selo na wo Hesebon ne to, de Sibima teo Vini teeni kare sem maama kwaare mo. Tio-bia bam konto nyoa déem mo pɛ teene dedɛ dedɛɛra nyɔ sana ba bugi. Vini teeni dem ma ta nɛ se yi Jazera ye de ta jage se yi kagoa kam seeni. De nɛ sem ta kɛ se yi naneo kom ni na wo mɛ to.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Wopwolo de ywoni dim daa tera abam kare sem ne. Vini teeni kare sem ne, nɔɔna ware se ba leeni lei da. Ba maa ware se ba bage sɔɔ ba yage wɛɛne. Ba daa ware Vini tio-bia bam se ba ŋoke ba nyoa, kokuri to, amo pɛ se wopwolo sɔɔ keim ti ba tei ne.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Kwora kam konto mo Baŋa Wɛ déem ya maŋe o pa Moaba teo kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta na tage tei to mo tento: “Bena yatɔ ná yia, ne tontoŋeno na jeeli o totoŋa da yam chekke tei to, Moaba teo jejegero tem na pa-ba zula to daa bá taa jege kuri. Ko nɔn-bia bam na maŋe ba daga tei to de, ba fenfee yerane mo wó daare, ye ba de nam wó taa tiini ba bwona mo.”

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Ba wó duri ba daare Arowa teene dem se vare-mwa yerane taa tigi de wone, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane-ba se o zeili.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Efrayim teene dem ya na lɔge de pe de dam to wó chɔge. Damasika teo paare dam dem de maa wó ti. Siria tiina balo fenfee na daare to wó yaale mo, ne Isarele tiina déem na daga ye ba laam yaale tei to.” Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: “Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, Jakob dwi tiina nenɔŋa kam wó ba tega. Teo kom jejegero maa wó jei, ne kana na jege nadum pa se o zwale tei to.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Men-lara yadaara nam ta wó daare da. Ko wó ke ne ba na pore Olivi tio tei, ye ba daare ko tio-bia balei, naa batɔ, tio kom nɛ selo na tiini se wo wɛ-wɛ to yera ne. Tio-bi-laaro tena, naa tenu mo wó daare ko nɛ sem maama ne.” Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage konto.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto maa ná yia, nɔɔna wó kwoni ba nii ba Keiru wom se o zeini-ba. Ba wó kwei ba teena mo ba daŋe Isarele tiina Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom wone.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Ba yiga daa bá taa wo bimbina yalo ba na ke de ba je to wone. Ko ná ye jwona yalo ba na mɔɔne to, ba teena bá taa wo ya wone, ne ko ná ye Asera nyenyego dɛ sem naa talwoŋa zwɛɛm bimbina yam de.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, nɔɔna wó duri ba daare teene delo na lɔge de pe de dam ye Isarele tiina bam zeili-ba de wone to. Ga-cheiŋo de punnu yerane mo wó taa wora. Jei sem maama maa wó taa tigi yɔɔ yerane.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Abam nam swei á Wɛ wom na ye á Vereno to ni ne mo. Á daa maa ba guli Wɛ na ye á peo de á dalem jei to gula. Konto ŋwaane, abam ná maŋe á jeiri teeni delo na tiini de lana to, de delo á na zeŋe á ja á nwoŋi dwi-gɛ tiina teene wone á ba to,

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: abam nam ná nii de baŋa ne pa se de puli de nwoŋi lela, ye de be de ke punnu tetete delo wone á na jeiri-de to de, á bá na kolokolo á zage. Á nam wó na wo-chechɔgɔ de zonne delo na ba ti to yerane mo.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto kwora ná maŋe ka zaŋe, ne na-fɔrɔ na wuuri ko ke sɔɔ tei to de, Baŋa Wɛ nam ná puri o ni o bwɛ-ba, ba maama wó lage jei mo ba vo. Ko wó taa nye de vio na kale swanno zwonnu yuu ne ko ja jei tei to mo, naa vo-kekara na pɛ weeru ko ja kɛ tei to mo.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Abam logo baŋa nabiina maama, ba ná zeiŋi tuta peero tem yuu ne, fɔge-na á nii! Ba maa ná wugi nabɔnɔ, fɔge-na á cheigi!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei de amo to mo tento: “Amo wó zege a na zoore mɛ to ne mo se a taa ye chemm ye a nia. Amo wó toŋe mɛmɛ ne wulim na zaŋe wea maŋa ne tei to, naa nyɔnɔ na toe wodiu zagem maŋa ne tei to mo.”

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kalo na vei Ejipti teo seeni to mo tento: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ dɔge kunkwoŋo kolo na wurigi to baŋa ne o maa beene Ejipti. Ejipti teo jwona yam yera sae mo o yiga ne. Ko maa ná ye Ejipti tiina bam tete, ba wo maama chɔɔre mo.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Ejipti tiina bam nagwola lage ya te mo, amo na wó pa ba boboŋa yam ji kafɛ to ŋwaane. Ba wó nwoŋi beira se ba lɔre ba jwona yam de ba chira boboŋa. Ba maa wó vo chichiri vora de yi-nara tei.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a kwei Ejipti tiina bam mo a ke pɛ-balɔrɔ jeŋa ne. Wonto wó tɔge keim-chɛɛre baŋa ne o taa tei-ba.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Paŋwa to mo tage konto.

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Naili buga na bam wó we ba ti, pa se te-kora yerane daare.

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: Bu-nwaro tem wó taa lwoi mo, ye nabare sem de na ba ba we maama. Buga ni gaaro, de nanchan-gullu tem de maama wó kwaare.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Balo na toŋe gare-nyenno totoŋa to vɔna wó pare mo. Balo de na dole gare-yia to teena wó ti.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na sɔ gwaaro to, ba wo wó chɔɔre mo. Balo maama na toŋe ŋweero ŋwaane to wo maa wó chɔge.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Zoan teo dedɛɛra bam yɔɔre ba ye jworru yerane mo. Ejipti Pa-faro wom na jege nakwa balo to ba bere‑o swa. Abam lage á tɔge chwoŋa kɔ ne mo se á ta ded‑o we, “Amo de tɔge a ye swa tiina dwi dem wo nɔɔno mo. Ko na zege faŋa to mo dé nabaara bam jwoŋi swa pwa tei ne”?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Nmo swa tiina nam daa wo yein-seeni mo? Bwoŋi-ba se ba ba ba ta ba bere‑m kolo maama Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na boŋe se o ke de Ejipti teo kom to.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Zoan teo dedɛɛra bam seene ba ji jworru mo. Ko ta ná ye Memfisi teo yiga tiina bam, nɔɔna jege-ba ba gana mo. Balo na ye Ejipti sɔ-yuni tem yiga tiina to jaane ba nɔɔna bam ba ywori.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, Ejipti teo tiina maama wó na Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na twe o jeŋa tei se o waare-ba to. Konto maa wó pa ba taa fona ne kaana na jege foone tei to.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Judah teo tiina nam mo lage ba pa foone tiini de ja Ejipti teo nɔɔna bam. Ba maa ná yɔɔre ba bwoŋi Judah teo kom yere ba bere wolo, kotu wó fom mo, de Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na boŋe se o ke-ba tei to.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, Ejipti teene denu mo lage de taa jege Hiburu taane dem ba ŋɔɔna, ne ba na ŋɔɔne Kanaan ne tei to. Ba laam maa wó du duuri ba sɛ ba pa Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ. Ba wó taa bwoi teene dem konto dedoa yere we, “Wea Teo kom.”

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, ba wó lɔ bimbini Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane Ejipti teo kom tetare ne. Ba ta maa wó chwi kandwɛ nenɛɛne ywei dwoŋi Ejipti siseini dem ne ba pa‑o.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Wonnu tem konto wó taa ye memaŋe se te guli Ejipti tiina bam mo we Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ yɔɔre o jege dam. Ba dona ná jege-ba ba bɛɛsa, ye ba ná keeri ba jare‑o, o de wó toŋe dedɛɛro se o ba o jwoŋi-ba o yage.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam wó pa Ejipti tiina bam lɔre o na ye wolo to chekke, ye ba de sɛ ba pa‑o. Ba maa wó taa jaane pɛɛra ba tui ba ke kaanem ba pa‑o, se ba ma ba zuli‑o. Ba ta wó taa gwoni ba nia ded‑o, ba daare ba tɔge-ya.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete mo wó waare Ejipti tiina bam, ye wonto nam ta mo lage o pa-ba yazura. Ba maa ná pipiri ba jwoori o tei, o de wó sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom ye o daare o yɔɔre-ba.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, chwo-fara wó taa tigi yala-yala Ejipti de Asiria teene dem tetare ne. Teene dem konto delei nɔɔna wó taa kare ba vei da-teene dem wone. Ba ta wó yeini ba ke daane ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ Saregon déem toŋe o jar-keira yuu tu pa o vo o jeeri Asedodi teo de jara, se o wane-ko o di.

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ lage o ba o kale Ejipti de Kusi tiina balo o na wane to mo o ja o kɛ, ye ba wó taa vei bwori de napera mo ba maa kɛa. Ko nam wó taa ye ba nɔn-donno de ba nɔn-kwe mo, ye ba maama kura nae chaveera yerane.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, balo na zoore naneo kom ni seeni to laam maa wó ta we, ‘Debam ya sale banto yera ne ye dé duri dé vo ba tei se ba jwoŋi debam mo ba yage Asiria pɛ wom jeŋa ne. Nam nii kolo na yi-ba to! Debam laam nam wó tɔge yein-seeni mo se dé lu?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Kwora kanto wora kagoa kalo na tigi naneo kom ni ne to ŋwaane mo: Ne vo-kekara na yɔɔre ka dole tega-kuri seeni jei sem ne tei to, konto mo lɛɛro lage te nwoŋi kagoa kam seeni mɛ foone na daga to te ba abam baŋa.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Amo nii a na chanɛɛre mo Wɛ na le o bere-ne: Jei maama ne nɔɔno wó nwoŋi o dwoŋi kwaga ne. Venverena de wó zo ba vere wonnu. Elam jar-keira bam, ja-na jara yam á jeeri-ba! Abam Media tiina bam, á de kaare-na ba teo kom maama á pu! Amo lage a pa yaara yalo banto na ke nɔɔna yera ne to ti.

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Nam nii! Nɔɔno mo beene o na dɔge jara-keim toroko baŋa ne, ye sisein-nɔɔna vaŋe-ko.” Nɔɔno wom mo baga o yaga we: “Babilon teo kom chɔge ywoo! Ko yɔɔre ko chɔge mo! Ba teo jwona yam nyenyero maama chochoge mo, ye ya tigi tega kam jei maama ne.”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, ba pɛ ko zo á yera mo ne kaane na zɔge mena kazɔgɔ ne tei to. Amo nam jwoŋi kwora mo ye ka nwoŋi Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to tei ne. Kwora kam konto mo a laam nam tage a bere abam. Edom teo taane

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Kwora kanto wora Duma teo kom ŋwaane mo: Nɔɔno mo zege Seyira ne o bwei o we, “Maŋa kɔ mo tega kam wó poore? Ta n bere-ne maŋa kalo tega na wó poore to.”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Teo yereno wom ma leiri o we, “Ko bá dáane se tega poore. Ka nam ta wó jwoori ka yi. Nmo nam ná lage se n daa‑n bwei woŋo n woli da, se n jwoori n ba n bwei se n lɔre.” Arabia jei sem taane

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Kwora kalo na wora Arabia ŋwaane to mo tento: Abam Dedan pipim-piina bam ná yeini á tɔge daane á beeri Arabia te-kora kam ne, á wó peini teeni woro ne mo se tega laam poore.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: Beeri-na na á pa na-nyɔm na jege balo to! Abam balo de na zoore Tema teo ne to, ja-na wodiiru á ba á pa balo na duri se ba lu cham wone to.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ nam na tage tei de amo to mo tento: “Bene dedoa maŋa ne, ne tontoŋeno na jeeli o totoŋa da yam chekke tei to, de Kedare teo nenɔŋa kam ti.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Kedare che-tara bam mo ye bembɛ ba nɔɔna bam maama wone. Ba nam lage ba daare fenfee yerane mo.” Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage konto.

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Kwora kanto mo wora teo kolo yere na ye ‘Veerem Bwolo’ to ŋwaane: Bɛ mo jege ko ke á teo kom ne, pa nɔɔna bam maama di ba sam nayuni?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ke ye ba sɔɔ zaŋe teo kom jei maama ne, ye ba bage ba yaga de wopwolo? Balo na tege abam teo kom wone to wo tɔge jara-keim baŋa ne mo ba te.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo de laam maa we, “Yage-ne konto chemm, se a keeri lanyerane a nɔɔna bam ŋwaane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé gwi-ne de a keira kam, kokuri to, chɔgem mo yɔɔre de yi a nɔɔna bam.”

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Judah teo da ba jege dalem jei se ba ma che ba tete. Maŋa kam konto ne, abam boŋe se á le jara zela yalo ya na tigi ‘Goa’ diga kam ne to mo.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Abam nɛ we David teo kabiri sem su de lolwe dedɛ. Á ma la na á zege kuri seeni chɔgɔ kom ne, se á daare á mɔ-ba.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Á ma jeeli Jerusalem teo sam dem ni ye á daare á yigi de dedwonna á de tega ne, se á ma á fɔge á lɔ teo kabiri sem se se taa dana.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Á ta koge gwoŋo mo á yage kabiri selei sem tetare ne se á ta‑á ke na balo na nwoŋi chɔ-dwoŋo kom wone to dáane. De ko de, abam yiga nam tera de wolo na pɛ se wonnu tento ke to. Á maa wo nege wolo na boŋe te boboŋa faŋa faŋa to.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam ya tage de abam mo se á ka yi-na ye á ta keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, se á daare á cheeri á yuni, ye á kwei gare-nyenyaaro á zo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Amo nigi Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage o we, “Amo bere a bá kwei ba wɛleere dento a chɛ-ba se ko maŋe ko yi ba toone de.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tage tento mo o we: “Vei Sebena tei, wolo na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom kikia maama baŋa ne to, se n ta ded‑o we:

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Nmo bere n pa n ye wɔ mo? Ba suli n nabaara badwonna ywo, se n vo n lage n tete yibeeli pɛ-sɔŋɔ yibeela jei sem ne n tiŋi mo na? Bɛ mo ye n vo n bɔɔre bɔɔne peo kom ne wɛ-wɛ, ye n sare siu jei n tete ŋwaane.

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: A nɔɔno, nam ta‑n yei we, Baŋa Wɛ mo lage se o ja‑m o vuvugi o dole o yage de dam.

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: O wó ja‑m o kukuli o ke daane ne geili dwoŋi to, ye o laam dole‑m o yage tega kalo na tiini ka yala to wone. Nmo ma‑n wó te dáane, ye n sisei-torokooro telo na pɛ‑m zula to de maŋe da. Nmo nam ye wolo na tiini n yaale n tu wom sɔŋɔ kom to mo.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: A maa wó pa‑o chwoŋa se o taa zoore nmo gwaaro tem, ye o daare o vɔ nmo vovoa kam o teiŋa ne, ye a kwei n dam dem a pa‑o. O laam maa wó ji Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam, de Judah dwi tiina bam maama kwo.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: A lage a kwei David paare dem bwor-bu mo a ke o jeŋa ne. O maa ná jaane boboŋa se kolo ke, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o gwi o boboŋe dem. O nam ná we kolo bá ke, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o pa ko ke.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: A nam ta wó pa o kuri ja tega mo, ne ba na page paare delo tega ne to. Konto to Eliakim mo wó ja zula o ba o pa o kwo sɔŋɔ kom maama.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we, “Maŋa kam nam ná yia, chene dem wó kore de to tega ne. Wonnu telo maama ya na leigi de yera ne to maa wó pare te to tega ne.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: Ta‑á ye chemm, abam balo na zoore naneo kom ni ne to. Abam Sidon teo pipim-piina bam mo toŋe nɔɔna se ba tɔge naneo kom baŋa ba ke pipiu pa se á duni.

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: Ba ma beeri na-fwaaro tem baŋa ne ba ke pipiu de teene delo na ye yiga yiga to. Ba ma vo ba yi Sihora de Naili bwi sem ba yeigi wodiiru telo na ke dáane to ba ja ba jwoori sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Ejipti tiina ná nigi kolo na yi Tura teo tiina to, ba yera wó sɔɔre dedɛ.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na se á bɛ á yi Tarasisi se á nii. Keeri-na á wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, abam balo na zoore naneo kom ni ne to.

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ke teo konto ba na chwi faŋa faŋa to? Ko déem pɛ á na ywoni lanyerane, ye ko nɔɔna jage ba vo yiga yiga ba zoore teene dedwonna ne.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo boŋe se o chɔge-ba. O ma ke konto se o zoore-ba tega ne de ba nenɔŋa kam, se ko pa nɔn-yum dwi maama tu ba tete tega ne.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: Abam Tarasisi tiina bam, laam ta‑á vare-na á tega kam ne ba na ke tei Naili buga kam ni ne to. Kokuri to, abam daa ba jege jei selo á na wó ke pipiu da to.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete mo twe o jeŋa naneo kom baŋa ne, pa se logo baŋa teene dem ziziŋi. O pɛ ni se ko vo Kanaan laŋa kam seeni, ye o we ba chɔge banto dam jei sem maama.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: O ma ta de Sidon tiina bam o we, “Abam ywoni dim dem ti mo, ba na chɔge abam lam to ŋwaane. Abam ná maŋe á bɛ á vo Kitim, á ta bá na siu da.”

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: Ta‑á keeri-na, abam nabwoor-yuŋina balo na nwoŋi Tarasisi ye á beeri pipiu ŋwaane to, á dam jei sem maama na chɔge to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: “Ka-tola kalo ba na swei n swia to, nam kwei kɔnɔ se n ta‑n kare teo kom wone n via. Kwaane se n ta kɔnɔ kom lanyerane, se n ta‑n leeni lein-ywei. Konto mo wó pa se nɔɔna daa guli n gula.”

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: De ko de, nyɔɔre delo ba na wó na ba pipiu kom baŋa ne to, ba wó kwei ba pa Baŋa Wɛ mo. Ba bá kwei ba jejegero tem ba seigi, naa ba tiŋi-te jwa ŋwaane. Te nam wó woli se balo na zuli Baŋa Wɛ to na wodiiru dedɛ, de gare-laaro.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ mo lage o chɔge tega baŋa maama pa se ka ji di-dwonnu yerane. O maa wó ja ka ni maama o jujugi, ye o daare o jage ka nɔn-bia bam o yage jei maama ne.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Ba lage ba kɔgese tega kam maama mo ba daare-ka ba tiŋi yɔɔ yerane. Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Vini teeni dem maama kwaare pa sa-doora ji gweeru jana. Balo ya na di ywoni sana nyɔɔm baŋa ne to laam kare ba ŋwane mo.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Senyɛ sem daa ba wɔe. Kwɛn-kwɛɛra wopwolo sɔɔ de nam daa ba ni. Ko nam ná ye kwanno, ba yage tento tam.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa ba nyɔ ba sana ye ba leena. Sana de daa maŋe ba ba ywona ba nia ne.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna kare teo kom chwei sem yuu ne mo ba laare ba beeri sana se ba nyɔ. Ba ywoni dem maama leiri de ji wo-chechɔgɔ. Wopwolo yɔɔre ko jei mo tega kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Teo kom laam daare di-dwonnu yerane mo. Ko manchwo-peo kom ma chochoge muga-muga.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Balo na wo wɛ-zoore seeni to wó leeni de wopwolo. Ba wó bage de kwor-dɛa ba tei Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane abam balo na zoore wɛ-puli seeni to zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ. Abam balo maama na zoore naneo kom ni ne to de zeiŋi-na Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to yere.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Dɔŋɔ ni maama ne mo dé nigi ba na leena ba we, “Chega Tu wom maŋe de zula.” Amo nam ma ta a we, “A wo yɔɔre ko chɔɔre mo! Lɛɛro yi-ne ywoo! Nɔɔna nwoŋi ba dwonna kwaga ne mo. Ba bebare-kikia yam de maa fɔge ya vei yiga.”

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Wolo ná kwaane o lu vuvuga kam wone, kotu wó vo o to gwoŋo wone mo. Wolo maa ná wane o bɛ gwoŋo kom wone, kalanchogo mo wó ja kotu. Kokuri to, chɔgem dedɛ wó nwoŋi wɛyuu ne. Tega kam kugu jei de maa wó ziziŋi.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Tega kam nam kare ka yuŋi jei maama ne mo, ne sa-nyɔro na beiri tei to. Ka maa zuuli jei maama ne ne vio na jege vwei ko mage ye ko ye tei to. Nɔɔna bam wɛleera yɔɔre ya chɔge tega kam mo, pa se ka to buru-tu-tu, ye ka daa bá zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: O ta wó ja ba maama o kale o ke daane mo ye o daare o pe-ba peena diga ne. Ba ná maŋe da ba dáane fee, o laam wó yɔɔre o waare-ba.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó kwoli chana kam pwooni. Wea kam de wó pipiri ka ji lim. Kokuri to, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo wó jeini Zion peo kom yuu ne o di paare Jerusalem teo kom wone. Teo kom nakwa bam maa wó na o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se te-fɔrɔ kom laam ji kandwa-pwoa mo. Teo kolo ya na lɔge ko pe de dam to laam ma ji di-dwonnu. Sa-fwaaro telo sa-teena na lɔge to daa tera, ye ba daa bá wane-te ba fɔge ba lɔ ba zege.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina yeini ba seigi n woro kuri ne mo. N ma‑n ye dalem jei n pa nabwona ba cham maŋa ne. Nmo ye woro mo chekke vo-dɛɔ maŋa ne. N ta ma‑n ye pwoŋa n kwoli nɔɔna se wea yé yi-ba. Chega to, nankɔ-nyena yɔɔre ba pare debam mo vera-vera ne vo-fɔrɔ na tiini ko mage kabira ye ko ye tei to.

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: Ba keim dem ta nye ne kagoa yuu wulim na ye tei to mo. Nmo ma‑n che dé dona bam tiguri-kaasa pa ka ba ni, ko nye de kunkwoŋo na kwoli wea dam pa zurim wora tei to mo. Nankɔ-nyena bam daa maa ware ba lei sem se ba leeni.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam lage o ke kuri-fɔrɔ mo peo konto yuu ne, o pa logo baŋa dwi tiina bam maama. Sana de wodiiru wó bugi kuri dem wone, se ba di wodi-laaro dwi dwi, ye ba nyɔ sa-ŋona.

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yi page peo konto baŋa ne mo se o taa yere ko nɔɔna bam. Ko daare ko ná ye Moaba tiina bam, o lage o nɔne-ba mo o se tega ne, ne ba na nɔne ga-korro ba se bulu wone tei to.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, ba wó taa leeni leiŋa kanto mo Judah teo kom wone: Debam teo kom tiini ko dana mo. Baŋa Wɛ mo vere teo kom cham wone o yage, ne ko ye kabiri de taara mo chege-ko to.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Pore-na teo kom nia yam, se dwi delo nɔɔna na ye nɔn-ŋona to zo ko wone. Ba ye balo na yɔɔre ba jege chega to mo.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Kwei-na á wo-dedoa á pa Baŋa Wɛ, se ko taa vei wuu. Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ mo ye peo kolo debam na wó dale to.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Nɔɔna mo jege-ko ba nɔna ba se tega ne. Banto maa ye yiniga tiina, de balo na nɛ yaara to.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yeini n pa nɔn-ŋona chwoŋa tigi mo jase. N ma‑n yere-ba de ba veiŋa se ba yé tiri ba to tega ne.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, debam tɔge nmo bera yam mo ye dé teena maama wo nmo wone. Woŋo kolo na jege dé fera to ye se nmo yere dem taa jege zula mo.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n ke zaane mo n ke puseŋ-nyena yuu ne. De ko de, ba ba zamese chega tɔgem. Ba ná maŋe ba zoore nɔn-laaro teo wone de, ba ta swoi se ba taa ke lwarem mo, ye ba ba nege Baŋa Wɛ paare dem.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo twe n jeŋa se n waare-ba mo. De ko de, ba ta ba nae ko na ye tei to. Nam pa se ba lɔre we n yi page n nɔɔna bam baŋa ne, se chaveera ja-ba. Ta pa se n ban-lom dem to ba baŋa ne, ne ko na maŋe se n dona na waarem delo to.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo wó pa se dé jeini de yazura. Kokuri, totoŋa yalo maama dé na ke to ye nmo mo ke n pa debam.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, dedɛɛra badwonna de ya seene ba ba ba tei debam. Dé nam yɔɔre dé teege nmo yere dem yerane baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo pɛ se debam teo kom yale mo ko ke yiga ne. N yale dé tega kam mo jei maama wone, pa se n yere dem na zula dedɛ.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ko ke ne kaane na virigi puga se o lo ye o yɔɔre o wowole de cham tei to mo. Mo debam na yaare tei n yiga ne.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Chega to, dé jaane puga ye dé ye bele-bele mo se dé lo. Ko nam nye de vio yerane mo dé jwoori dé lo. Debam wo wane dé vere dé teo kom dé yage. Dé wo daare kwaga se ba jwa jwoŋi tega kam ba taa tei.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam, zo-na á di sem wone. Pe-na se ni á maŋe da á seigi maŋa fenfee wone, se ko taa nii Wɛ ban-lom dem ná zuri.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ nwoŋi o jeiga kam ne mo o beena. O nam lage o waare logo baŋa nɔɔna bam mo ba wɛleera ŋwaane. Tega kam laam wó pa se nɔn-gora na lwogi jana balo ka baŋa ne to lɔre jaja. Ka daa bá seigi balo ba na go to ka kuri ne.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, Baŋa Wɛ lage o kwei o se-zɔɔ kom, ko nia na di fileim-fileim de foone to mo. O maa wó waare basankwe-kenkagele dem yere na ye Leviatan ye ka tiini ka duri ye ka pipiri to. O laam maa wó go naneo wo juru kom konto.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, dé wó leeni dé ta Vini teeni kara kalo na lana to taane we:

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ tete mo nii ka baŋa ne. A maa pae na yi-ka maŋa de maŋa. A yɔɔre a yere-ka mo wea de tete maama se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane-ka o ja o chɔge.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: A bane wo zaŋe ka ŋwaane. Nɔɔno nam ya ná pɛ se ga-cheiŋo de sabare li-ka, amo ya wó nwoŋi se a jeeri kotu de jara, ye a zwɛ te maama nyɔ!

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam daa ná lage se o ba o to amo pwoa ne, o jege se o ke ni-mɔrɔ de amo. Chega to, o jege se o ba se dé ke ni-mɔrɔ mo daane.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Ko na wó ke tei ye Wɛ kwei Jakob dwi tiina bam wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba se ba tusim dem maama saare to mo tento: Ba jege se ba lɔ ba kandwa yam ba na mɛ ba ji kaanem bimbina to mo, ba daare ba cho-ya muga-muga. Ba nam ta dae se ba yage Asera nyenyego dɛ sem se se taa zege se zega jei ne.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Teeni dem nɛ jigi da-dwa mo ye se bwori se to tega ne. Kaana maa vei da ba twɛ-se se ba ma dwei mini. Ko na ye tei to, nɔɔna bam konto swa muri. Mo kokuri ba Keiru wom bá duri ba yibwona. O ta bá ke zaane o yage ba yuu ne, de o na maŋe o naane-ba to de.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ná yia, Baŋa Wɛ wó zege Yuferata buga kam ni ne mo o waare o nɔɔna bam ne o na fere mena tei to, se o vo o yi Ejipti bu-nɔgɔ kom seeni. O laam maa wó la abam Isarele tiina bam dedoa dedoa o ke daane.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, ba wó wu nabɔnɔ wɛ-wɛ, se ba bwoŋi Isarele tiina balo maama ba ya na kale ba vo ba yage Asiria de Ejipti teene dem wone ye ba dáane da to. Banto maa wó ba ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ peo kolo o na pɔɔre o pa o tete Jerusalem teo kom wone to.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wó yi Efrayim dwi tiina teo kamunu kom, de ko sa-nyɔra bam na jege fia ko ŋwaane tei to. Ko maa nye ne punnu telo nenɔŋa na lage ka ti to mo. Ko lam dem wó jei lela. Teo kom zege te-ywoŋa bwolo baŋa seeni mo. Ko nɔɔna bam maa nyɔ sana ba buga, ye ba jege teera ba teo kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Efrayim teo sa-nyɔra bam na jege teera de kolo to mo, ba lage ba nɔne-ko ba se tega ne.

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ lage o tɔge dwi-gɛ tiina baŋa ne se o ma ta-veiri mo o ŋɔɔne de o nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Abam nɔn-lwɛɛna balo na nii Jerusalem tiina baŋa ne to, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ na jege kwora kalo se o ta de abam to.

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Abam yɔɔre á teere mo we, “Debam gwoni ni mo de toone, ye dé daare dé ke ni-sɛɛm de churu. Konto ŋwaane, lɛɛro ná yɔɔre te yi dé teo kom, ne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri ko chwooli wonnu tei to de, te bá wane debam te ke kolokolo. Kokuri to, debam seigi vwa woro kuri ne mo, ye ka-gane-nɔɔna ji dé dalem jei.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Nii-na, amo lage a chwi kabiri-beira mo Zion ne. Ka maa ye kandwɛ delo na ye chekke ye de kwaare tega ne to. De tiini de jege kuri, pa se diga kam dana. Wolo maama nam ná sale de yera ne, kotu ba lwia de kolokolo.

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Ni-gwonim delo á na ke de toone de churu to daa bá taa jege kuri. Lɛɛro tem ná tu á baŋa, ne na-fɔrɔ na chwooli wonnu tei to, te lage te yɔɔre te chɔge abam mo.

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, daa yé ta‑á jege-ne á lwɛa. Ko ná dae konto, á cham dem wó puli dedɛ. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam maŋe o pa-ne kwora o we, o ti o yiga mo se o chɔge á tega kam maama.

english_verse: Farmers don't just plow and break up the ground.
translation_verse: Valo ná yɔɔre o chɛ swoori, o bá taa vare taa ye o wo dugi kolokolo.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: O nam ná guri tega kam ye bwogili peini da, o laam wó dole o wo-dwa bia bam mo ka baŋa ne. O ta wó du mena dwi dwi da, se ko maŋe de tega kam na ye tei to, ye o daare o du wodiiru tedwonna o kara kam nia ne.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye mena, ba wó fere-ya lanyerane. Ba nam bá ke konto taa se ya cho yɔle-yɔle ne muni na ye te to. Ba ná tuuri luu-zɔŋɔ ya baŋa ne, ba nam bá mumugi-ya.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Areli, nmo mo ye teo kolo wone David déem na zoore to, Lɛɛro nam wó yi teo kom konto nɔɔna bam! Abam ná laga, ta‑á di-na á kura yam bene maama.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Abam dona kɔgɔ kom wó taa daga ne fwogo mo tei. Ba nam wó ji ne swanno, vio na kale-te ko ja jei to. Bedwe baŋa ne mo

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ pɛ se á tiini á dɔ á kɛ mo. O ta ma ja á sampwori sem yia yam o kwoni. O ma pa ba kwoli abam yi-nara bam de yuni.

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam taga o we: “Nɔɔna banto zuli amo de ba ni mo, ye ba yeini ba ta we, ba sɛ amo ni. Ba boboŋa nam tera amo tei ne. Ba na pae amo zula tei to maama ye kafɛ mo, ko na tɔge nabiina boboŋa chullu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a daa wó jwoori a ke wo-kenkagela a saŋe daane se ko so-ba dedɛ. Swa tiina bam boboŋa maama wó jei mo, se yi-pore-nyena bam de yi-poro kom ji kafɛ.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wó yi balo na ko tega ba zoore se ba seigi ba boboŋa Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne to. Banto toŋe ba totoŋa lim ne mo ye ba boŋe ba we, “Wɔ mo nae debam? Wɔ mo yei dé na jege kolo dé ke to ni ne?”

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, zwa-kwarro wó ni tɔnɔ kom wo taane dem. Lilwoa na jei yibiri wone to yia wó puri se ba na kolo na jege ko ke to.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Nabwona laam maa wó jwoori ba di ywoni Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Yiniga tiina de maa wó ke wopwolo Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom ŋwaane.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Nankɔ-nyena wó jei. Boyere-nyena de daa maa bá taa wora. Balo maama na jege puseŋa kikia puga ba jei to de dwi wó saare.

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: Banto maa jege ba dwonna ba soga. Ba maa jaane chega ba jua se chega bora yé taa toŋa, ye ba fɔ vwa pa se chega tiina ba nae ba bora.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na jwoŋi Abaraham o yage to. O nam tɛ tento mo de Jakob dwi tiina bam: “Chaveera daa bá ja Jakob dwi tiina bam, se ba yuni taa veela.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Balo na tusi ba boboŋa ne to laam maa wó na yi-poro. Balo de na swoi pompona to wó sɛ se ba jwoŋi bera.”

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Abam duri á vo Ejipti teo ne mo ye á maŋe á wo bwei-ne se á lɔre a boboŋa. Abam ya teene we Ejipti teo pa-faro wom wó taa jege abam o kwola o woro wone mo.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Á dedɛɛra badwonna maŋe ba wo Zoan ne, ye á toŋe badwonna se ba vo ba yi Hanesi.

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Popone wonnu tento maama n tiŋi n pa nɔɔna bam. Ke-te tɔnɔ wone se te taa tigi da jwa seeni ŋwaane, se ko taa ye maana ko pa-ba taa wuu.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔre ba ye zwabani-nyena mo, ye ba swoi vwa totoŋa. Ba maa wo sɛ bera yalo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba to.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Ba maa tɛ de yi-nara bam ba we, “Daa yé ta‑á nii á nae veera!” Ba ta maa tɛ de Wɛ sampwori sem ba we, “Daa yé ta-na chega á bere debam! Nam ta-na wonnu telo na ywona puga ne to, se á ma á gane debam.

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Ywori-na chwoŋa kam wone, se á daa yé che dé yiga. Yage-na ka-taa-kare-ka-tɛ Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom taane á bere debam.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom nam tage tento: “Abam seene á ve amo kwora kanto mo, ye á daare á sɛ vuvuga totoŋa se á ta‑á ma á gane nɔɔna. Á na tɔge kikia yam konto dwoŋi to ŋwaane,

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Abam ta lage á to á chochoge ne kambia kalo ba na feiri tega ne pa se ka ji kanchwi muga-muga yerane to mo. Kanchua daa bá daare se ba wane min-chale ba kwei ba ke ka wone, naa se ba dane na ba ke kɔɔro wone.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu to na tage tei to mo tento: “Abam ya ná leiri á boboŋa pa se á jwoori amo tei, á ya wó na á verem, ye á ta sii. Á ya ná ye chemm mo, ye á daare á sale amo yera ne, á ya wó na á dam dem. Abam nam ba sɛ se á ke konto.

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Á dona bam wone nɔɔno dedoa ná bage tiguri-kaasa, á nɔɔna moro mo wó duri ba daare‑o. Ko laam ná ye á dona bam banu, ba yi se ba fugi abam maama se á duri á daare-ba. Se ko kweeli to, á wó duri á daare á nɔɔna fenfee. Ba wó taa ye ba yera, ne daa na zege geili-geili ka zeiŋi tuta peo yuu ne tei to.” Baŋa Wɛ wó duri o nɔɔna yibwona

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Baŋa Wɛ ta jei se o ke abam zaane mo. O ma yɔɔre o ti o yiga se o duri abam yibwona. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o bore chega bora mo. Balo na ke ba teena ded‑o to tiini ba jege yu-ywoŋo.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa wó taa zoore Zion ne. Abam daa yé ta‑á keeri-na Jerusalem teo ne. Baŋa Wɛ wó duri á ŋwaŋa ne á ná keeri á jare‑o. O ná yɔɔre o ni á keira kam, o wó leiri abam lworo.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ seene o kwei yaara de cham mo o pa abam, se te ji á ni-wodiu, de á na se á nyɔ. Wolo na jege Wɛ bera yam o zamese abam to daa bá seigi o tete. Á yia wó yɔɔre ya na‑o.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Abam ná ywori chwoŋa ye á vo jazem seeni, naa jagwia seeni de, á wó ni kwora na zege á kwaga ne ka ŋɔɔne de abam ka we, “Chwoŋa kam mo tento á yiga ne. Véi-na ka wone.”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Abam ná dugi á wo-dwa, Baŋa Wɛ wó pa do-ŋwe ne se á wodiiru ke lanyerane, se á zage wodiiru zanzam. Maŋa kam konto ná yia, á vara de wó na pwola yala-yala se ba taa di ga-zuru da.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Nabɛ de bonɛ selo na toŋe á kare sem ne to tete wó taa di mena yalo ba na chaare men-swanno tem lanyerane ba yage ba daare-ya to mo.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne á wó yɔɔre á di á dona se ba dalem jei sem vaare se to tega ne. Na maa wó taa bura peero de zwonnu maama yuu ne ba duri ba tu tega ne bare-bare.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Chana kam wó peere pa se ka pwooni de wea pwooni taa mae daane. Wea kam de wó tiini ka nye ka woli da kuni berepɛ, ne da yarepɛ pwooni na lage de ke daane tei to. Konto maama wó ke ne Baŋa Wɛ ná tu o twoŋi o nɔɔna kwi selo na bwori to, ye o daare o pa se ba fufwollu tem fɔge te kwɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ zege yiga yiga mo o beene, ye o yere dem nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ nii ko nae jaja. O wo tiini ko fuli mo ye nyoa zaŋa guli-guli. Ban-lom taane delo na nwoŋi o ni ne to ye ne min-vogo na di wonnu bugi-bugi tei to mo.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: O ná sii o momwa vio, ko nye de na-fɔrɔ na fufugi ba di ba maŋe nɔɔno ba seeni to mo. O maa jege dwi-gɛ tiina bam o chɔga ne o zɛ-ba yɔlɔ ne mo tei. O ta maa ke-ba ne o na kwei gara o ke ba nia ne, se o pa ba ywori ba chwoŋa wone tei to mo.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam, abam nam wó di ywoni, ne á na yeini á di kuri á ma‑á zuli Wɛ ye á leeni lei tete ne tei to. Á wó ke wopwolo se ko nwoŋi á bochara ne, ne á na mage kɔgɔ á diini Baŋa Wɛ peo kom to mo, se á vo á zuli wolo na ye Isarele tiina peo to, ye nɔɔna wui wi ba tɔge á yiga ba via.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa wó bage de kwor-dɛa, pa se nɔɔna lɔre o na jege nenɔŋa de dam tei to. O ta wó twe o jeŋa se o waare nɔɔna o ban-lom dem ŋwaane. O maa wó fugi-ba de min-vogo na di bugi-bugi to, de vo-fɔrɔ, de doa bagem, de do-kandwa.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora ná zaŋe konto, foone wó tiini de ja Asiria tiina bam. O lage o kwei da-lɔŋɔ mo o mage-ba o de tega ne.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ nam maŋe o kwɛ jeiga ba na wó zwɛ twa da to. Ba ti yiga se ba zwɛ Asiria teo pɛ wolo na tege to yera dáane. Mini jei sem konto luuna, ye se ta yala de. Ba ma dogele dɛ dedɛ ba ke da se mini taa di bileim-bileim. Baŋa Wɛ nam ná sii o momwa vio, ko nye de chilibugu mo nyeene ye ko duri ne buga to. Ko laam maa wó taa jege‑o ko di bugi-bugi!

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wó yi balo na kare ba vei Ejipti teo se ba beeri wolim, ye ba daare ba teege sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne to. Banto teena daŋe ba sisei-torokooro baŋa ne mo te na daga to ŋwaane. Ba teena ta daŋe ba sisein-dira baŋa ne, ba na jege baare to ŋwaane. Ba yiga nam tere Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom wone. Ba ba lwoori Baŋa Wɛ se o zeini-ba.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam jege swa! O wae o pae lɛɛro yi nɔɔna. O maa ba jwoori o ni dem kwaga ne. Ko ná ye nɔɔna balo dwi maama na toŋe lwarem to, ko woli de balo na zege ba kwaga ne to, o lage o zaŋe ba baŋa ne mo o waare-ba.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Ejipti tiina bam nam ye nabiina mo se ba dae Wɛ. Ba sisein-nɔɔna maa jege ye-daa, se se dae jworru telo toone na ware de ja to. Baŋa Wɛ nam ná twe o jeŋa se o waare-ba, teo kolo nɔɔna ya na jege dam to wó tiri ba to tega ne mo. Balo de na beeri wolim ba tei ne to de maa wó to, pa se ba maama laam tɔge daane ba jei.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ de ma ta tento de amo o we: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó ke ne nywoŋo mo suura, naa nywoŋ-pɔla na nɛ nɔne ye ka laare tei to. Nayere-kɔgɔ ná gilimi daane se ba zeili-ko ye ba kaase tei maama de, ko bá fom. Ba sɔɔ kom bá pa se ko yera taa sae. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ de wó foore o chu konto dwoŋi mo, se o ke jara Zion peo kom yuu ne.

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, pipiri-na á jwoori Baŋa Wɛ tei, de á ya na yɔɔre á kwei a kwaga á ya‑o tei de.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, abam dedoa dedoa wó ve jwona yalo á na tusi á ma á tete je á kwei lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa á ke-ya to.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: “Asiria tiina bam wó te jara wone. Ko nam dae nabiina se-zɔɔro mo lage te go-ba. Ko ye Wɛ se-zɔɔ kom mo lage ko go-ba. Ba jar-keira bam wó kwaane se ba duri ba lu. Wolo na wane-ba to wó fe ba nɔn-donno tem o de totoŋ-chɛɛra wone.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ba wó duri ba daare ba dam jei sem, foone na jaane-ba to ŋwaane. Ba dedɛɛra bam ná nɛ jara-keim tuta na zeiŋi wɛɛne to, ba boboŋa wó vugimi mo ye foone zo-ba.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. O maa ye wolo na tɔre mini Zion peo yuu ne, ye o dwei mini-fɔrɔ Jerusalem teo kom wone to.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Ba dedoa dedoa wó taa ye dalem jei, ne woro mo kwoli nɔɔna se vo-fɔrɔ yé ja-ba. Ba wó taa nye de na-dura mo kagoa yuu ne de peo kolo woro na jwoŋi nɔɔna se wea yé di-ba to.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Balo na nii ba nae to maa wó taa nae jaja. Balo zwa de na ni to wó taa fɔge ba cheiga.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Balo na ye wole-wole to wó boŋe ba yi de yi-poro. Balo de na ŋɔɔne ba bibeigi to wó taa ŋɔɔne jase.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa bá taa tɛ jworo we, o ye nɔn-yero. Ba bá taa pae nankɔ-nyena zula.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, jworo ŋɔɔne ko jworim mo. O boboŋa de maa jeeli lwarem kikia yerane. O ba lage se o taa tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa, ye o ni taane nye de o twe Baŋa Wɛ mo. O maa yage balo kana na jege-ba to se ka ni-ba. Ko ta ná ye na-nyɔm na jege balo to, o pae de chɛ-ba mo.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Nankɔ-nyem kikia yɔɔre ya ye puseŋa yerane mo. O yeini o jei o boŋe lwarem mo, se o ma vwa o chɔge nabwona, de ba ná maŋe ba beeri se ba na ba chega de.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nɔn-yero, o boŋe boboŋ-ŋona mo. O maa yeini o zege o totoŋ-ŋona yam kwaga ne. Jerusalem teo kaana bam taane

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Daŋe-na á je á nyɔɔna ne wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane de á kare sem na chɔge ye á Vini teeni ba leiri bia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó duri ba daare pɛ sɔ-fɔrɔ kom. Teo kom konto ya na su de sɔɔ to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá taa zoore ko wone. Ko dam jei sem de mɛ ba na zege da ba yere-ko to maama chɔge. Kagoa wo bonɛ de vare-mwa yerane laam mo jeeri da ba di gaao.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: abam ta wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo. Á wó vo á du á wo-dwa bu-dura maama ni ne. Á ta wó yage á naane de á bonɛ sem, se de taa kare de beeri yɔɔ de di gaao.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro lage te yi abam balo na kare á chɔge amo nɔɔna bam to mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo chɔge abam! Lɛɛro wó yi abam de á na baare nɔɔna kwaga ne to. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ya ta wo baare abam kwaga! Abam nam ná chɔge teene dedwonna á ti, mo ba laam wó chɔge abam de. Abam bebara kam na ti maŋa kalo ne to mo ba laam lage ba baare á de kwaga.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, pa n zaane dem ba dé baŋa, se dé teena wo nmo wone mo. Zezeŋa maama ne pa debam dam. Ta pa se dé na verem cham maŋa ne.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Dé dona bam, ne kayere na yeini se deilimi kara se ja tega tei to, konto mo nɔɔna wó pɛ á jejegero ba ja viiri, se kolokolo daa yé daare.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yere dem mo zaŋe wɛɛne. O maa zoore wɛyuu kom baŋa jei sem ne. O nam wó pa se Zion tiina bam taa tɔge chega de nɔn-ŋonne kikia yerane.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama ná ke abam, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó zege á kwaga ne de dam. O ta wó vere abam cham wone o yage, se á ta‑á tiini á jege swa de yeino lanyerane. Balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to, wo-laaro tento mo wó taa ye ba lonne wonnu.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Dé bembɛ sem tete chwoosi dé teo kom chwei sem yuu ne mo. Dé na toŋe balo se ba kwɛ wonnu to de keeri mo de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
