translation_verse: Tega kam maama koge mo ye ka ta leere. Lebanon teeni dem de kwaare mo ye chaveera di teo kom. Saron te-ywoŋa kam de jigi kagoa mo. Basan de Kamele jei sem teeni vɔɔro ma siiri.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Ko wó pa á teo tiina bam zwɛ kula mo, ne sabare na zwɛ ye se ji tentwarem tei to.

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Abam balo teene na wo yiga yiga to, lɔre-na totoŋ-kamunnu telo amo na ke to. Abam balo de na bwola to, ta‑á yei-na we, a dam dem daga dedɛ!”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye wolo na tɔge chwo-laao ye o yɔɔre o tɛ chega to mo. Kotu ba sɛ se o pini nɔɔna se o ma o duni, ye o ba sɛ o jwoŋi wonnu kalipera baŋa ne. O ba gwaane de balo na ke bana se ba go nɔɔna to. O nam bere o ba sɛ se o toŋe lwarem.

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ye konto dwoŋi, konto tu jei mo ye lwia ba jege‑o. Ko nye de o dale peo mo. Maŋa maama wone, wonto ba gae o ni-wodiu, na-nyɔm de nam bá ja‑o.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Abam wó nii á na pɛ wom na jei de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ, ye o paare laŋa kam jage ka yi jei maama.

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Abam nam daa bá na boyere-nyena bam konto maŋa de maŋa. Ba ye balo taane na ye de yera ye á ba ni de kuri to mo. Ba na ŋɔɔne tei to nye de ba bibeigi mo.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: Nii-na Zion teo kom! Ko ye mɛ dé na di dé kura yam da to mo. Abam ná nii á na Jerusalem teo kom, á wó na we ko zege cheppe mo, ne vwei delo na ba bebege to. Ba bá wane ba gɔ vwei dem konto paara. De yera ŋone de nam bá kɔ se de chɔge.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó jwoŋi debam o yage. O ye wolo na bore debam bora to mo. O maa pae debam o nia yam se dé taa tɔga. Wonto mo ye dé pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá taa zoore Zion teo ne se kotu ta we, “A weele mo.” Balo na zoore da to, Wɛ wó kwei ba wɛleera o yage o chɛ-ba.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó kwei ba twa bam ba dole ba yage, se ba yera yam lwom zaŋe tage-tage. Ba jana de maa wó faare peero jei sem maama.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Wɛyuu chalechwe sem maama wó jei, ye ba piri wɛyuu kom tete ne sara mo ba piri. Chalechwe sem maama wó taa toe tega ne mo, ne Vini tio vɔɔro naa kaporo vɔɔro na kwaare ye te siiri te toe tega ne tei to.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we, “A se-zɔɔ kom maŋe ko toŋe ko fera ko su wɛyuu ne. Nii-na! A laam wó kwei-ko a ma a waare Edom tiina bam mo. Banto ye balo a na pɔɔre a zege dáa ne se ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem to mo.”

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ se-zɔɔ kom maama yɔɔre ko ye jana yerane mo. Vara lara de maa taare ko maama. Ko nye de pei de bone jana, ko woli de pi-bale tapwale-bia bam lara mo taare-ko. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lage o ke kaanem mo Bozera teo ne. O maa wó go nɔɔna dedɛ Edom laŋa kam ne.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Ba dedɛɛra bam wó yɔɔre ba te, de ba na nye de na-bale selo na ware se ja to mo. Ba babɛ sem na dana ne nabɛ tei to de wó tɔge ba te. Ba jana mo wó bugi ba tega kam maama. Ba yera lara de maa wó ji popɔnɔ ka pɔɔne-ka.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ le dɛ mo se o ba o zeini Zion tiina bam. Bene dem konto wone o lage o yiri jene ba dona bam baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom bu-nwaro tem wó ji kɔtaale mo. Ba teo kasolo de maa wó ji chilibugu. Mini maa wó ja ba tega kam maama, ne mini na jege kɔtaale de di tei to.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Wea de tete maama wone, teo kom mini bá dwei. De nyoa kam de wó taa zaŋe wɛɛne mo wuu. Ba tega kam wó taa tigi yɔɔ yerane mo, ko zege dwi dedoa ne se ko yi dwi dedwoŋi maŋa ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá tɔge ba tega kam ne o kɛ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Kunkworru, de bachangaaro, de vara dwi dwi mo wó taa tei jei sem konto. Baŋa Wɛ lage o twe o jeŋa Edom tega kam baŋa ne, se o maŋe-ka ye o daare o jeeli ka chɔgem dem. O maa wó pa se tega kam taa tigi yɔɔ yerane.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Edom teo yiga tiina bam daa bá na pɛ se kotu taa nii ko baŋa ne. Ba nakwa bam maama wó jei mo.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Sabare mo wó jwoŋi ba sa-fwaaro tem. Bombwaano de ga-cheiŋo de maa wó cheiŋi ba dam jei sem maama. Teo kom laam maa wó taa ye mɛ nywoŋ-kuri de kunkworru na zoore to.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ga-kukuri de wiira mo wó taa tɔge daane ba beeri wodiiru. Tɔro maa wó taa kare da te keera, ye tete wo-korro laam taa tigi di-dwonnu tem gugworru wone.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Nii-na Baŋa Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone se á wó na ko na popone we: Wonnu tento dedoa bá lage kodwoŋi ko ga. Wo-bɛa bá ga wo-kana se te taa wo daane. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo pɛ ni dem konto, ye wonto Jworo kom mo lage ko la-te ko ja jeeri daane.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Jei sem konto wó tiini se ke punnu dedɛ, pa se se taa chaka de wopwolo. Tega kam wó ke lam, ne Lebanon peero tem na ye tei to. Ka nenɔŋa de wó nwoŋi jaja, ne Kamele de Saron jei sem na ye tei to mo. Nɔɔna laam maa wó na Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom, de o paare dem na ye tei to.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Nam pa balo vɔna na bugi to jwoori ba na dam, se balo nagwola na tege to daa jwoori ba na baare.

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Lilwoa yia laam maa wó puri ye zwa-kwarro de zwa yam pore.

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: Gwaaro de wó faŋe wɛɛne, ne woŋa dwoŋi to, ye memaaro de taa bage sɔɔ ba yage de wopwolo. Na de wó taa buri ba bugi kagoa yuu, ye nabare de taa wo te-kora kam ne se dura.

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: Kasolo kolo wea kam ya na yɔɔre ka jege ka mage to laam wó ji buga mo ko taa tiga. Te-kora kam ne, buli-yia wó taa tae ya nwoŋi jei maama ne. Jei selo maama nywoŋ-kuri ya na tigi da to, ga-zuru, de nanchan-gullu, de sangɛ mo laam wó taa wora.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Chwo-fara wó peini se nɔɔna taa tɔge da ba via. Ba wó taa bwoi-ka we, “Wose Chwoŋa” mo. Balo na jege digiru Wɛ chullu tem seeni to bá wane ba tɔge ka wone. Kokuri to, balo na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to yerane mo vei ka wone. Jworru bá na chwoŋa se ba beeri ka wone.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na jwoŋi balo o yage to wó tɔge da ba jwoori sɔŋɔ. Ba maa wó jwoori ba zo Zion teo kom wo ye ba leeni de wopwolo. Ywoni delo na ba ti to mo wó taa ye ba nyem. Ba wopwolo kom wó tiini ko gaale, ye ba wo-chechɔgɔ de ba keira kam wó jei.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Yé cheigi-na pɛ Hezekia taane dem, de o na gane abam ye o we, Baŋa Wɛ wó jwoŋi abam o yage to. Teo kɔ jwona mo dana pa se ya wane ya jwoŋi ya teene dem Asiria pa-faro wom jeŋa ne ya yage?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro wom ma tɔɔle o yage de Judah tiina taane dem o we: “Abam maama cheigi-na Asiria teo pa-faro wom kwora kam.

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Hamafa, de Arapade, de Sefavayim jwona yam bɛ? Ya wane ya vere Samaria tiina ya yage a dam kuri ne na?

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom ma toŋe Hilikia bu Eliakim na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom totoŋa baŋa ne to, dedaane Sebena na ye tɔn-poponno to, ko woli de Asafe bu Joa na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom yera seina twanno baŋa ne to, se ba nwoŋi teo kom wone ba vo ba jeeri‑o.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Ba na jeeri to mo Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom tage de-ba se ba ja Asiria pɛ wom kwora ba vo ba ta de Pɛ Hezekia. O maa we: “Asiria teo Pa-faro wom we: Bɛ mo bere ko pa se n jege n tete chega konto?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe we ni-wɛɛle wae jara de ke mo na? Wɔ baŋa ne mo n teege ye n lɔ amo kwaga ne?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Nmo teena wo Ejipti teo ne mo na? Konto nam nye de nɔɔno na kwei kasogo o ji o nacheiga to mo. Kasogo kom wó seere mo ko zɔ wolo maama na zei-ko to jeŋa. Konto mo wó ke de wolo maama na sale Ejipti Pa-faro wom yera ne to.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Nmo nam ta ná we, ‘Dé wó sale debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ yera ne mo,’ ko dae Wɛ dem konto wara-jei, de de kaanem bimbina mo Hezekia guri o yage o daare o pa ni se Jerusalem de Judah nɔɔna maama taa tui bimbini dem na wo ywo-seeni to yerane ba zuli‑o na?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Eliakim, de Sebena, dedaane Joa maama ma ta de Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom ba we, “Popo ŋɔɔne Aram tiina taane de debam, se dé wó ni. Nmo ná ŋɔɔne de Judah tiina taane dem, balo na dɔge kabira kam yuu ne ba cheigi to wó da ba ni n na tɛ kolo to mo.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Asiria teo dedɛɛro wom ma leiri o we, “Á boŋe we amo tu wom kwora kam ye abam de á pɛ wom yerane nyem mo na? Ka ta wora balo maama na dɔge kabira kam baŋa ne to ŋwaane mo. Banto de wó da ba di ba beinnu ba daare ba nyɔ ba fea, ne abam na jege se á ke tei to mo.”

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, amo ta wó ja abam a vo a yage tega kalo na nye de abam tete tega kam to baŋa ne. Dáane Vini teeni wora se á na sana á nyɔ, de mena se á ma á ke bworobworo.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Teene dem maama jwona yam wone, jwoni dɔ mo wane de jwoŋi de teo de yage amo jeŋa ne? Baŋa Wɛ de nam bá wane o vere Jerusalem o yage amo jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Hilikia bu Eliakim na nii pɛ sɔŋɔ kom totoŋa baŋa ne to, de Sebena na ye tɔn-poponno to, dedaane Asafe bu Joa na tiŋi pɛ sɔŋɔ kom yera seina twanno tem to maama ma ja ba gwaaro ba kaare wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ye ba ja kwora kalo Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom na taga to ba vo ba ta de Pɛ Hezekia.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hezekia déem na nigi kwora kam to, o wo ma tiini ko chɔge ye o kaare o gwaaro. O ma daare o kwei gare-nyenyaaro o zo, ye o vo o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye Hamafa, de Arapade, de Sefavayim, de Hena, de Ivaa, teene dem konto pwa bam de wo yein-seeni mo?’ ” Hezekia wɛ-lworo kom

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Asiria teo pɛ wom mo toŋe o dedɛɛra yiga tu se o ba o twe Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ. Dɛ delo tento nmo Tu Baŋa Wɛ nigi toro tem konto maama, ye o nam wó bwɛ dedɛɛro wom de o ta-balɔrɔ kom. Nam lwoori Wɛ n pa debam balo fee na daare pa de maŋe teo kom ne to.”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Hezekia tontoŋena bam na pɛ Izaya kwora kam ba ti to,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: mo Izaya de kwei kwora o pa-ba o we, “Jwoori-na á vo á ta de Pɛ Hezekia we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Yé ta‑n kɔre foone de taane delo Asiria pɛ na tɔge o nɔn-donno tem baŋa ne o ma o twe-ne to.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Nii mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se Asiria pɛ wom boboŋa vugimi pa se o ni sawea, ye o da ka ŋwaane o jwoori o tete teo. Dáane mo ba wó zɔ‑o de se-zɔɔ ba go.’ ” Asiria pɛ Senakeribi chichuŋu belei tu taane

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Asiria teo dedɛɛra yiga tu wom déem nigi we, ba pɛ wom yage Lakisi teo ye o vo se o kwaare jara de Libina teo tiina. O de ma vo dáane.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne de, Asiria teo pɛ Senakeribi ta nigi kwora we, Tirahaka na ye Kusi teo pɛ to mo beene se o jeeri‑o de jara. O ma toŋe nɔɔna Hezekia tei ne de kwora kanto o we:

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Nmo maŋe n ni Asiria teo pwa bam na toŋe tei de logo baŋa teene maama to. Ba yɔɔre ba chɔge de maama mo. Nmo nam boŋe tetɛ mo ye n teene se n lu?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Teene dedwonna dem jwo-dɛɛra wane-de ya jwoŋi ya yage amo nabaara bam jeŋa ne na? Gozam teo wɛ, de Haran teo wɛ, de Rezepa teo wɛ, de Eden tiina balo déem na zoore Tɛl-Asara ne to wɛ wo wane ba wolowolo ya jwoŋi ya yage.

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hezekia ma jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom Asiria teo pɛ tontoŋena bam tei ne, ye o ga-ko. O ma ja-ko o zo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam. O ma jare-ko Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to, nmo paare di cherubi sem tetare laŋa ne mo. Nmo yerane mo ye Wɛ, ye n tei tega baŋa paare dim jei maama. Nmo nam mo naane wɛyuu de tega baŋa.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye chega mo we Asiria teo pwa déem seene ba chɔge teene maama de de nɔn-bia dedɛ, pa se de ji di-dwonnu yerane.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asiria pɛ na tɔge chwoŋa kalo o ba to, mo o wó tɔge da o jwoori, se o bá zo teo konto wone.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: kwora kanto mo Baŋa Wɛ jege se o pa‑o: Zion tiina bam yɔɔre ba neese nmo mo. Jerusalem teo tiina bam jege‑m mo ba mɔna.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Nmo tɔge n tontoŋena baŋa ne mo n twe amo Baŋa Wɛ. Nmo ta ma n bere n tete n we, ‘Amo pɛ se a sisei-torokooro dedɛ mo di peero tem yuu te yi Lebanon peero tem yuu chekke. A ta ma gwoni ba tei-dedwaaro dem a de tega ne, de ba tei-ŋonno tem maama. A ma vo a yi yiga yiga a di ba peero tem yuu, ye a zo ba goa mɛ na lini to wone.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Amo ta ma vo a ko vola sa-teene ne yiga yiga, ye a nyɔ na ya wone. A jar-keira bam ma nɔne Ejipti bwi sem de ba napera pa se we.’

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: Nmo wo nigi we amo maŋe a boŋe boboŋe dem faŋa faŋa mo na?, A na boŋe tei faŋa faŋa konto to mo amo laam pɛ se ko seene ko ke. A boboŋa déem jaane se nmo zaŋe n chɔge teene delo ya na lɔge de pe to, se de ji kandwa na dogele da-baŋa ne ya tigi to mo.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: A ta pɛ se teene dem konto nɔn-bia bam dam ti, ye ba di ba chaveera nmo ŋwaane. Banto jigi ne ga-punnu de ga-lɛɛro mo nmo yiga ne. Ba maa nye de gaao na wora ko tae ko nwoŋi tei to, ye wea laam mage-ko pa se ko te lela.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Amo laam lage a waare‑m mo n na jege ni-wɛɛle delo n ke de amo to ŋwaane. N yi-dɛɛre kikia yam to amo zwa ne. Mo kokuri amo wó lei gwola n momwɛ ne, ye a daare a ke gara n ni ne. A laam maa wó vaŋe‑m se n tɔge chwoŋa kalo n na tɔge da n ba to n jwoori n tete teo.”

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: Izaya laam ma ta de Hezekia o we: “Keim dento mo wó ke se ko taa ye maana ko pa‑m: Dɔɔm bene dem ne, á wó di wodiiru telo na ke te tete ne to. Bene delo na saŋe-de to ne, á wó di kolo na tage ko nwoŋi boboa nyem kom yera ne to. Ko daare bena yatɔ bene dem ne, abam wó du wodiiru ye á pe-te. Á ta wó jeiri Vini teeni ye á daare á di de wo-bia bam.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Judah dwi tiina balo ta na daare to laam wó taa ye ne tio bonno na jaane tega ye ko nɛ sem leiri bia to mo.

english_verse: The Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka déem ma zaŋe ka vo Asiria jar-keira bam na tigisi mɛ to. Ka ma go Asiria tiina morro bi de funɔnɔ-banu (

english_verse: of them all in one night. The next morning, the camp was full of dead bodies.
translation_verse: ). Tega na poore to, ba ma na we ba jei sem su de twa yerane mo.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe, o déem ma zo o jwoni Nisiroka diga kam se o zuli-de. O bia balei Aderamɛlɛka, de Sarezera ma zo ba zage‑o ba go de se-zɔɔro. Ba ma duri ba vo Ararati laŋa kam ba zoore da. Senakeribi bu Esara-hadon déem ma leiri o yuu ne o ji pɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam lage o jwoŋi-ne o yage mo. Dé wó taa jege gwa kwɛɛra wonnu ye dé leeni dé zuli‑o. Dé nam wó zuli‑o taa mo Baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone, se ko yi dé ŋwea siseini.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Da yam konto ne, Hezekia déem yɔɔre o weele mo ye o bwola de toone. Wɛ sampwora Izaya na ye Amozi bu to ma vo o tei ye o ta‑o o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Bere n sɔŋɔ tiina bam ba na wó ke tei ne n ná tera. Kokuri to, n lage n te mo. N bá‑n wori de n jaweo kom.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: A ma boŋe we, a daa bá taa ŋwe logo baŋa ne se a na Baŋa Wɛ dáane. A ta maa bá na nabiina balo na ŋwe to de. A nam bá taa zoore ba tetare ne.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ, guli we amo yeini a tɔge‑m de a chega maama, dedaane a wo maama mo. A ma yɔɔre a ke kolo nmo na lage se a ke to.” Hezekia ma tiini o keeri dedɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora ma yi Izaya we:

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Véi n ta de Hezekia we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye n kwo David Wɛ to mo tage o we: A nigi n wɛ-lworo kom, ye a ta na n na kane yi-na tei to. A nam lage a woli bena fuga-yanu mo n bena yam wone.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo amo nam jege se a ta wonnu tento maama baŋa ne? Wɛ maŋe o ta taane o bere-ne, ye o seene o ke o boboŋa na jaane tei to. Amo wó gwooni a tete mo a ŋwea maama wone, a wo na tiini ko chɔge to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: Keim dento nam mo wó pa n lɔre we, Baŋa Wɛ wó seene o ke o na gwoni ni se o ke tei to:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Nii se n wó na wɛ dem na jege de zoora ye de ke luluŋu kolo Ahaz nateini dem yera ne to. Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa lunluŋu kom fɔɔre ko jwoori kwaga naba-laara yia kuni fuga mo.’ ” Wɛ dem na ke lunluŋu kolo to ma seene ko jwoori kwaga naba-laara yia kuni fuga.

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Amo ya boŋe a tete ne mo we, “A lage a te a nɔn-donne maŋa ne mo, se a zo churu ye a maŋe dáane taa wuu.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Amo ŋwea kam pɔpɔ ka ti mo. Ko nye de nayero na pɔpɔ o gɔ o vwei tei to mo. Ko ta nye de gare-yi delo gare-yi sɔɔno na pɔpɔ o vaŋe ŋona o kɔ de yera ne to mo. Nmo wora n pa a momwɛ ti lela, ne wea na pɔpɔ ka ji lim tei to mo.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: A yɔɔre a keeri mo taa pa se tega ba ka poore. Ko nye de nywoŋo ya mo jege a kwi sem ko yara. Nmo wora n pa a momwɛ ti lela, ne wea na pɔpɔ ka ji lim tei to mo.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: A keeri ne kawɛbidwoori naa koŋwaa na keeri tei to mo. A nam ta keeri ne kunkwoŋa mo. Amo na kwoni a yuu wɛɛne taa to, a yia seene mo de keira. Amo Teiru Wɛ, a cham dem gaale. Nam ba lela n jwoŋi-ne n yage.”

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Wɛ, nmo kikia mo pae nɔɔna jege ŋwea. Amo de maa tɔge ya ŋwaane a jege ŋwea. Nam pa se yazura yi-ne se a jwoori a na a ŋwea.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Nii mo. A na nɛ yaara yalo to jege nyɔɔre ya pa-ne. N na swoi-ne to ŋwaane, n wo sɛ se a to gwoŋo kolo na wó chɔge-ne to wone. N ta daare n yage a wɛleera yam maama n chɛ-ne.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Kokuri, balo na wo churu wone to ware se ba tei‑m. Twa ware ba leeni ba seini‑m. Balo de nam na zo tega kuri ne to, ware se ba lɔre nmo na toŋe chega tei to.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Izaya déem ya tage de Pɛ Hezekia mo o we, “Pa se ba zɔ mɔɔro se ba kwei-te ba taare n ŋɔn-pwona kam, se n wó na yazura.”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hezekia déem ma jeeri nɔɔna bam de wopwolo. O ma ja-ba o zo o jejegero tem na tigi mɛ to. O laam ma bere-ba o lu-nyenno tem maama, de o sabu-seŋa, de o talwoŋ-ywei sem, de o nu-ŋoŋa kam, de o jara zela yam maama, de kolo maama ba na tiŋi jejegero di sem wone to. Pɛ Hezekia déem wo daare kolokolo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne, naa o paare dim jei sem maama ne ye o wo kwei o bere-ba.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe de maŋa kam konto ne, Merodaki-Baladan laam mo jigi Babilon teo pɛ. O na nigi we Hezekia weele o zaŋe to, mo o toŋe nɔɔna o tei ne de twanno de pɛɛra.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Wɛ sampwora Izaya déem ma vo Hezekia tei o bwei‑o o we, “Nɔɔna banto nwoŋi yein-seeni mo ba ba nmo tei? Ba nam tage bɛ mo de nmo?” Hezekia ma leiri o we, “Ba nwoŋi Babilon teo yiga yiga mo ba ba amo tei.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Izaya daa ta ma ta de Pɛ Hezekia o we, “Nam cheigi Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na jege kwora kalo se o pa‑m to:

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Nmo tete dwi dem de wó tɔge ba woli da ba vo. Ba nam ná jaane-ba ba yi da, ba wó lwe n bia bam mo se ba taa toŋe Babilon teo pɛ sɔŋɔ ne.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Abam Tu Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: “Pa se a nɔɔna bam bochara taa tiga.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Ŋɔɔne-na bochare-zuru taane de Jerusalem tiina bam, se á ta de-ba we, ba totoŋ-chɛɛra maŋa kam ti. Bere-ba we, Baŋa Wɛ kwei ba wɛleera mo o yage o chɛ-ba. O maŋe o waare-ba mo se ko ma ko ŋwe ba jene dem kuni belei ko pa‑o.”

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Konto mo wó pa Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa nae jaja, se nabiina maama na-ko bedwe baŋa ne. Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ ni delo to mo konto.”

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Gaaro tem wó seene te kwaare, ye punnu tem de siiri. Ko nam ná ye Wɛ kwora kam, kanto wó taa wora mo ga wuu.”

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: Zion, nmo jege kwor-ywoŋa se n tɔɔle! Nam diini peo na tiini ko dɔra to yuu. Jerusalem, kwei kwor-ywoŋa kam n ta‑n bwooli n yaga wɛ-wɛ! Ta‑n tɔɔle n yaga ye n ba fona. Ta de Judah teene dedwonna dem we, “Nii-na. Abam Tu Wɛ wom wora!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom maa beene de baare. O nam tei nɔɔna de dam-fɔrɔ mo. Nii-na. O jege o ŋweero mo o beena. Nyɔɔre delo o na nɛ to ma to o yiga ne pa ba via.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Dento nam mo ye nɔɔna balo o na kuri to. O maa yere-ba ne nayero na nii o pei tei to. O ta bukki pipeili sem mo o ja-kukworo ne, ye o ja-se o ba o feiri o bochare ne. Ko ta ná ye pi-ni selo na jege bia to, o yeini o kale-se o vei mɛmɛ mo.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wane naneo na-fwaaro tem o maŋe o ke o jaguli ne? Wɔ mo wane o kwei o jeŋa o maŋe wɛyuu kom maama o ti? Wɔ nam mo wane tega kasolo kom maama o la o ke tetɔgɔ wone, ye o daare o kwei peero tem de zwonnu tem o maŋe te dunni se o lɔre?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo yi se o wane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa, naa se kotu bere‑o o na wó ke tei?

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon vara bam muri se ba kwei-ba ba ma ke zwɛɛm kaanem. Ko teeni dem de ma muri se ba ma de dɛ sem ba tɔre mini ba ma zwɛ kaanem dem konto.

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye jwoni, gɔgɔ mo wó mɔ-de, ye luru de kwei sabu-seŋa o taare-de, ye o daare o ma lu-nyenno o gɔgere de maama.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Yiniga tu ná ware lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa o yi, o wó beeri da-ŋoŋa kalo na ba pɔe to mo. O maa wó ta de gɔgɔ se kotu ke jwoni delo na ba toe tega ne to o pa‑o.

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na jei mɛ na gaale tega kam baŋa de wɛyuu kom to mo. O maa nii nabiina ne ba ye manchwanno mo to. O yɔɔre o lware wɛyuu kom ne gare-jale mo, naa vwei delo o na zoore de wone to.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Wonto mo wae o pae logo baŋa dedɛɛra jia, ye pwa de yɔɔre ba jiri kafɛ.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Ba nye de teeni delo ba na yɔɔre ba jeiri to mo. Ba ná chwi-de tega kam ne, ye de bonno ná wora te jaane tega, mo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se vio ba ko fuli-de pa se de kwaare lela. Ba ta nye de swanno mo vo-kekara na kale ko ja viiri.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Kwoni-na á yia á nii wɛɛne se á ta‑á bere-ne, wɔ mo naane wonnu tem konto maama? Ko ye Wɛ mo jaane chalechwe sem kɔgɔ kom dedoa dedoa o nwoŋa, ye o bwoŋi chalechoa maama de ka yere. Se dedoa tete wo fɔge ka jei, o dam-fɔrɔ kom na dwoi woŋo maama to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam na ye Jakob dwi tiina to, bɛ mo ye abam poona á we, “Baŋa Wɛ yeiri kolo na ke debam to.” Á ta ma‑á we, “Baŋa Wɛ yiga tera debam wone.”

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Abam yeiri tento na? Á wo nigi ko ŋwa na? Baŋa Wɛ ye Wɛ wolo na wora taa wuu to mo. Wonto mo naane logo baŋa de ko ni maama. O ba buga. O yera de nam ba chɛa. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba lɔre o yeino kom o tia.

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo teena na wo Baŋa Wɛ wone to, ba dam dem yeini de jwoori de jiri dam-doore mo. Ba wó zaŋe wɛɛne toge-toge, ne maaro na yaare te vɔna tei to mo. Ba ná duri tei maama de, ba yera bá chɛ. Ba maa ná vei taa tei de, ba ba beira.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: O na pare-ba lela tei to nye de o nɛ sem ba dwei tega mo tei. O maa kɛ yiga, ye o tete wo nɛ zonne.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo pɛ se wonnu tento maama ke, ne o boboŋa na jaane se o ke tei to? Wɔ mo tei dwi dedwe wora, ye dedwoŋi saŋe de kwaga? Ko ye amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tei konto maama. Amo déem mo maŋe a wora boboa ne, ye a ta wó taa wora kweelim maŋa ne.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Naneo ni teene dem nɛ a na ke kolo to, pa se foone ja-ba. Logo baŋa jei maama nɔɔna yera tiini ya sae mo. Ba ma ke daane ba fɔɔre ba ba.

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Nam yé ta‑n fona, se a wo n tei ne. Yé ta‑n jage lwia, kokuri to, amo mo ye n Tu Wɛ wom. Amo wó ke dam a ke n kuri ne, ye a ta woli‑m. A maa wó kwei a dam dem a toŋe de chega se a ma a zeini‑m.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Nii mo! Balo wo na wiiri de nmo to wó na ba lɛɛro mo ye chaveera ja-ba. Balo de nam na dwoni de nmo to wó jei mo.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Nmo wó beeri balo na chiŋi nmo to ye n bá‑n na-ba. Balo ná done nmo, banto yere mo lage de saare logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo wolo na ye nmo Isarele dwi dem Tu Baŋa Wɛ to mo yɔɔre a jege n jazem, ye a tɛ de nmo we, “Yé ta‑n fona, se amo wó woli‑m.”

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi dem, n seene n bwona ne kanzwɛ na ye tei to mo. Isarele tiina bam, nam yé ta‑á fona. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tɛ a we, “A lage a woli abam mo.” Amo wolo na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom to mo ye á Jwoŋinu.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi dem, a lage a pa se nmo ji ne ferem luu-zɔŋɔ ba na tuuri mena baŋa ne to dwoŋi mo, Ko maa ye wo-doŋo, ye ko jege chen-chechwɛ dedɛ. Nmo laam ma‑n wó mage peero tem n chochoge, ye n ta pa se zwonnu tem ji ne swanno dwoŋi.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Abam wó dole-te á yage wɛɛne, se vio kale ko ja jei. Vo-dɛɔ mo lage ko pɛ-ba ko ja jage jei maama ne. Nmo tete nam wó taa chaka de wopwolo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane, ye n ta ta‑n teera o baŋa ne, o na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina de nabwona beeri na mo ba ga se ba nyɔ. Ba dindeilima ma ko na-nyɔm ŋwaane. Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam wó leiri ba wɛ-lworo kom. Amo mo ye Isarele tiina Wɛ wom, ye a bá ve-ba a yage.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se bwi taa tole peero yuu ne se tua, se buli-yia de taa tae ya nwoŋi bwollu tem ne. A ta wó pa se kagoa pipiri ka ji jei selo bwi na daga da to, se te-kora kam leiri ka taa ye mɛ buli-yia na gaale.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se Sedare teeni ke kagoa yuu ne, se golesaa, de Motele, de Olivi teeni de nwoŋi dáane. Tei-ŋonno de punnu dwi dwi mo wó nwoŋi se te li te-kora kam maama.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na ye Jakob dwi dem pɛ wom to tɛ o we: “Nam ja-na á taane á ba, se dé nii. Ta-na á ni se dé cheigi.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Konto mo wó pa dé wane dé sɛ we, ya seene ya ye wa chekke. Ke-na woŋo, ko ná ye lam naa balɔrɔ de, se konto wó pa foone yɔɔre de ja debam.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo zege boboa kam ne o ta wonto taane, se dé wane dé lɔre ko ni ne? Wɔ mo wuuri o ta debam se dé wane dé ta we, ‘O wo o chega wone’? Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tage ko taane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo pworisi-ko se dé ni. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo nigi taane abam ni ne.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo lwoori yiga se a ta de Zion tiina bam we, ‘Nii-ba-na!’ A ma toŋe ni-jwoŋinu se o vo Jerusalem o bere-ba kwor-ywoŋa.

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: “Nii-na, amo tontoŋeno wolo a na teili to mo tento. Wonto mo amo kuri, ye o kikia su a yi. A nam kwei a Jworo mo a ke o wone. O maa wó toŋe chega o pa logo baŋa dwi tiina maama.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Wonto bá dɔne o kwora se o ke sɔɔ. O bá taa pae o kwora zaŋa teo pwooni ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ déem naane wɛyuu kom ye o lware-ko pa ko tigi palalala. O ta mo jare tega kam ni maama, de wonnu telo na ŋwe te wo ka baŋa ne to. O pae ka nabiina bam jege siu, se ba taa jege ŋwea ba vei ka wone. Wonto na tage kolo to mo tento:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ bwoŋi‑m mo se n pa chega taa toŋa. Amo mo lage a ja n jeŋa se a taa teili‑m. A ta wó tɔge nmo baŋa a ke ni-gwonim de nabiina, ye a pa n ji pwooni n nye dwi-gɛ tiina bam baŋa ne.

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: Nmo ma‑n wó puri lilwoa yia, se n daare n pore peena diga se balo ya na jei lim wone to nwoŋi pwooni.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. A yere dem mo konto! A nam bá sɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno tɔge o jwoŋi amo zula yam. Jwona de nam bá na amo tia yam dwi.

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Leeni-na leiŋ-doŋa se á ma‑á tei Baŋa Wɛ. Zege-na logo baŋa ni maama ne á tei‑o. Abam balo na zoore nabwooru wone á lɛɛne teene to, de wonnu telo maama na wo naneo kom wone to, ko woli de abam balo na zoore naneo ni teene dem ne to, ta‑á zuli-na Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: “A na peene a bane tei to tiini ko dáane. A ya ta ye chemm mo taa. A laam nam ti a yiga mo se a taa chwoosi a yage jei maama, ne kaane wolo na wowole se o lo bu ye o keeri tei to.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Amo lage a vaŋe lilwoa bam mo a pa ba tɔge chwei selo ba na maŋe ba yeiri to. A maa wó pa se lim delo ba na vei de wone to ji pwooni de pa-ba. Chwei selo ya na tigi de gwonnu to a wó pa se palese mo se pa-ba. Amo wó yɔɔre a ke wonnu tento mo a pa-ba, ye a bá dole-ba a yage.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: “Abam zɔ-kɔro tem, pore-na á zwa se á cheigi! Abam lilwoa bam de taa fɔge á nii á nae!

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na zege o chega wone to, o ya lage se o nia yam taa jege yuu de nenɔŋa nɔɔna tei ne.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: O nɔɔna bam dona nam mo wane-ba, ye ba daare ba vere ba wonnu ba ja viiri. Ba ma li ba maama ba yage gwon-chanlunnu dedaane peena di wone. Ba na jaane-ba konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera se kotu jwoŋi-ba o yage. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se kotu ta we, “Pa chwoŋa se ba jwoori.”

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo o bane tiini de fuli de-ba, ye o pa se ba na chɔgem jara baŋa ne. O bane dem jigi mini-vogo mo de li-ba, ye ba ta wo nigi ko kuri. De yɔɔre de zwɛ-ba mo, ye ba wo zamese keim dem konto baŋa ne, se ba kwei-ko ba ke ba boboŋa ne.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi dem na ye Isarele tiina to, Baŋa Wɛ mo naane abam pa se á wora. O nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Yé ta‑á fona, se a jwoŋi abam mo a pa a tete. A ma bwoŋi abam dedoa dedoa de á yera. Konto ŋwaane, á ye amo nyem mo.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A maa ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom na ye á Jwoŋinu to. Amo mo kwei Ejipti teo a pa se abam wane á ta‑á tei á tete. A nam ta kwei Kusi de Sebaa teene dem de a pa se a jwoŋi abam a yage.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Amo wó ga teene dedɛ de nabiina dwi maama se ko pa a vere abam se á ta‑á jege á ŋwea. Kokuri to, abam tiini á jege kuri á pa-ne, ye a tiini a swoi abam mo.

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: Banto ye amo nɔɔna balo a na mae a yere mo a bwoi-ba. A na naane-ba to, a kuri se a tɔge ba baŋa mo a ma na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ.”

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Nam ja nɔɔna balo na jege yia ye ya ba nae, ye ba ta jege zwa yalo na ba ni to, n pa ba zege amo yiga ne.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Amo yerane mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. Amo yiga ná le, jwoŋinu nam daa tera.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: “Chega to, ko na maŋe ko nwoŋi faŋa to de amo ye Wɛ mo chekke. Amo ná jege wolo de a jeŋa, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware kotu se o jwoŋi o yage. A nam ná chwi kolo, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware se o gɔ-ko o yage.” Wɛ wó duri Isarele tiina yibwona

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye abam Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom de á Jwoŋinu. O nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Abam ŋwaane mo a lage a toŋe jar-keira se ba li Babilon teo, se ba daare ba ja ko nɔɔna bam ba kale ba ja viiri. Babilon tiina bam wopwolo sɔɔ laam wó leiri ko ji wo-chechɔgɔ keira mo.

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ye wolo na pɛ se chwoŋa peini naneo kom wone, ka na tigi na-fwaaro tem tetare ne to.

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: O ma soge jar-keira dedɛ kɔgɔ, de ba jara-keim torokooro, de ba sisein-nɔɔna, pa se ba maama tu ba maŋe na bam wone. Ba yɔɔre ba to mo, se ba daa yé zaŋe wɛɛne. Ba maama jilli jei mo, ne ba na fuli min-zwoŋo mini ba dwei tei to. Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: “Swei-na faŋa wonnu telo na ke te kɛ to swia. Yé ta‑á guli-na wo-dwonnu gula.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Nii-na, amo lage a ke wo-doŋo mo! Keim dem nam bobo mo de wora de ke. Abam ba lɔre ko ni ne na? A lage a pa se chwoŋa mo peini kagoa yuu ne, se bu-nwaro de peini te-kora jei sem ne.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Kago-vara bam maama wó zuli-ne, ko woli de nywoŋ-kuri, de kunkworru. Kokuri to, amo wó pa se na taa bura kagoa kam yuu ne, ye bu-nwaro de taa tigi da, se amo nɔɔna balo a na kuri to nyɔ ba su.

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: Banto mo ye balo a na naane a pa a tete se ba taa leeni ba seini amo to.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi dem na ye Isarele tiina to, abam nam wo bwoŋi a yere se a woli abam. Á ta wo sɛ se ko chɛ á yera amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, amo Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo ye wolo na saare á wɛleera yam a yage to. Ko nam ye amo tete ŋwaane mo a ke konto. A nam daa bá guli á wɛleera yam gula.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a pa á kaanem tiina balo na kweere de ba totoŋa to di ba chaveera. A ta wó yɔɔre a chɔge Isarele dwi tiina bam, se nɔɔna maama taa jege-ba ba yaala.”

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo naane‑m a ke n nu puga ne, ye a ta wó woli‑m. Amo nam na tage tei to mo tento: Amo tontoŋeno Jakob, yé ta‑n fona. Kokuri to, a kuri Isarele tiina bam se á ta‑á ye a nɔn-swonnu mo.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Amo wó lwo na dedɛ te-kora baŋa ne, pa se bu-nwaro taa duri jei sem konto ne. A maa wó pa se a Jworo ba á bia baŋa ne, ye a daare a swɛ ba swolim.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Banto wó puli ne ga-lɛɛro na puli tei to mo, de teeni delo na zege bwi ni ne to.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ye Isarele dwi tiina bam Pɛ mo de ba Jwoŋinu. O nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo mo ye boboa kam de gurim tu. Amo yiga ná le, wɛ nam daa tera.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, yé ta‑á pa se á yera sae. Nam yé ta‑á fona-na. A wo wuuri a ta wonnu tem konto taane a bere abam mo na? Abam nam mo wó zege amo chega kam kwaga ne. Wɛ dedwoŋi nam daa mo wora ye ko dae amo na? Aawo! Peo kodwoŋi daa tera se nɔɔna dale da. Amo yeiri dedoa tete ni ne.”

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Balo maama na gɔgere jwona to ba jege kuri. Jwona yalo ba na pa-ya chega to de ye wo-yɔɔro mo. Balo na zege ya kwaga ne to ye lilwoa mo, ye ba yeiri kolo wone ba na wora to. Konto ŋwaane ba wó na ba chaveera.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo boŋe se o mɔ jwoni o pa de ji o wɛ? De bere de bá pa o na nyɔɔre.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Nii-na! Nɔɔno wom konto de o dwi maama wó di ba chaveera. Gwaro telo na ke jwona to maa ye nabiina yerane. Ba nam jege se ba ba ba zege amo yiga ne se dé ŋɔɔne. Foone yerane mo wó ja-ba ye ba ta di ba chaveera.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Luru mo yeini o kwei o yɔrɔ kom zela o ma o gɔgere luu mini wone. O ma kwei swoli mo o mage luu kom de o dam, se ko ji jwoni nyenyego na ye tei to. O kana laam maa wae ye na-nyɔm jege‑o pa se o bugi ye o dam de ti.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Kotu ná gwoni daa kanto dwoŋi, o laam wó kwei ka chichworo mo o ma o wiiri mini, ye o daare o kwei ka chichworo o ke jwoni. Konto to, o tɔge ka chichworo baŋa ne o weeri mini, naa o ma o wɔ bworobworo. O ta ma kwei ka chichworo kom o gɔgere jwoni se o taa zula.

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Ba ba fɔge ba jeeli wonnu. Ba wone wolowolo ba boŋe o yi se o ta we, “A kwei da kam chichworo mo a ma a dwéi mini. A ma wɔ bworobworo mini dem wulim wone. A ta wɔge nɔna wulim dem wone a done. A nam wó wane a kwei ka chichworo kolo na daare to a ma a ke jwo-yɔɔ na? Amo wó tiiri a zuli da-kwolo mo na?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Nɔn-jworo konto dwoŋi boboŋa gane‑o mo. Ko nye de o ni-wodiu ye tentwarem mo. O maa ware o tete o jwoŋi. O bá ta de o tete we, “Nii woŋo kolo a na zei a jazem ne to. Ko ba jege-ne ko gana mo na?” Baŋa Wɛ jwoŋi o nɔɔna o yage Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: “Abam Isarele tiina bam nam guli-na wonnu tento gula. Kokuri to, nmo Jakob dwi dem ye amo tontoŋeno mo. Amo mo naane‑m pa se n ye a tontoŋeno. Isarele tiina bam, amo bá swei abam swia.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: A kale á wɛleera yam a pa ya jei ne kunkwonnu na duri te kɛ tei to mo, naa tetete nyɔnɔ na jei tei to. Jwoori-na á ba amo tei, se amo mo vere abam a pa a tete.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: Wɛyuu jei sem maama, bage-na á yage de wopwolo! Tega kuri gugworru tem de, ta‑á bwoola á yage jei maama ne. Peero tem, de teeni delo maama na wo goa wone to, ta‑á chake-na de ywoni. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo vere Jakob dwi dem o pa o tete, se o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa nae jaja Isarele tiina bam tetare ne.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Amo mo pae vora ni taane jiri kafɛ, ye daare a pae yi-nara jworim dem bere jaja. A yeini a pa swa tiina jwoori kwaga mo, se ba yeino maama taa ba jege kuri.

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: A maa tɛ de naneero tem we, te na bam we, se bu-nwaro tem de we.

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de o dam tu Sarusi wolo o na kuri to mo tento: “Amo mo jaane n jazem se a woli‑m se n wane n di teene dedɛ, se n daare n vere ba pwa bam jara zela. A ta wó pa‑m dam se n pore teene ni-bworru se n wane de wo n zo, ye ba daa ware ba che n chwoŋa.

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: A nam wó to nmo yiga ne, ye a palese peero a tiŋi a pa‑m. Amo wó bwori channa ni-bworru tem se n zo, ye a daare a gwoni te luuru tem a de tega ne.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Ko ye a tontoŋeno Jakob dwi dem na ye Isarele tiina bam a na kuri to ŋwaane mo, a yɔɔre a bwoŋi nmo yere. N nam ta wo sɛ n pa amo. De konto de a kwei yere-kamunu mo a pa‑m.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ, ye wɛ dedwoŋi wo woli amo wone. Amo yiga ná le, wɛ nam daa tera. Amo wó taa pa‑m dam, de n na wo lɔre amo to de.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom maama, pa se doa taa nena. Se chega taa toŋe tega baŋa ne, ne kunkwonnu tem na siiri de doa tei to. Nam pa se tega baŋa ni maama de pore dedɛ, se verem de nɔn-ŋonne ta te nwoŋi ka wone, ye te yɔɔre te be tega kam baŋa ne. Ko ye amo Baŋa Wɛ mo pɛ ko ke konto.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wó yi wolo na mage kantɔgɔ de o keiru to. Kotu nye de kanchua mo na gwaane de kanchwi sedwonna ye se maama tigi tega ne to. Dɔgɔ ba jege chwoŋa se ko bwei kamɔ-mɔro we, ‘Bɛ mo ye n ke-ne tento?’ Ko bá ta ded‑o we, ‘N totoŋa yam ba lana.’

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wó yi bu wolo na wó ta de o kwo we, ‘Bu dwi dɔ mo tento n loga?’ naa wolo na wó ta de o nu we, ‘N virigi puga se n lo bɛ woŋo mo tento?’”

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye Sarusi, a lage a chiŋi‑o mo se o ke keim, pa se chega taa toŋa. A maa wó to o yiga ne se a pa o totoŋa ke mɔle ya pa‑o. O wó fɔge o lɔ amo tete teo Jerusalem, ye o daare o vere a nɔɔna balo ya na wo sa-teo ne to pa se ba taa tei ba tete, De ko de, o ba lage o toŋe ŋweero ŋwaane.” Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. Isarele tiina taane

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Wɛ wom na ye dé Vereno to, nmo seene n ye Wɛ wolo na yeini o seigi o tete to mo.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: A wo tage taane a seigi. A nam wo ke na a ni ne se a ta taane. A wo tage de Jakob dwi dem we, ‘Beeri-na amo kafɛ ŋwaane.’ Amo Baŋa Wɛ wom, a ŋɔɔne chega taane mo. A maa ná pɛ a ni, de ye chega mo.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Ba-na á tole taane dem se dé nii kolo na wora to. Pa-na se ba bane daane ba nii ba na wó ta kolo to. Wɔ mo wuuri o ta tento faŋa faŋa o pa ko nwoŋi pwooni. Wɔ déem mo bwooli-ko o yage? Ko dae amo Baŋa Wɛ mo na? Wɛ dedwoŋi wo woli amo wone, de na jege chega ye de ta ye jwoŋinu. Amo yiga ná le, wɛ nam daa tera.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa jei sem maama nɔɔna, pipiri-na á ba amo tei, se a jwoŋi abam a yage. Kokuri to, amo mo ye Wɛ chekke, se wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera.

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó ta amo taane we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ yerane wone mo chega de dam maama wora.’ ” Balo maama nam na chuli Wɛ to wó ba o yiga ne ba di ba chaveera.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wó pa se Isarele dwi tiina maama na ba bora, ye ba de wó taa jege teera Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Abam na kwe maŋa kalo ye á yum tem su de yu-pwei to, ko ta ye amo mo jege abam a nia. Amo mo naane abam, ye a wó taa nii á baŋa ne taa. Amo wó taa teili abam, ye a jwoŋi abam a yaga.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
translation_verse: Wɔ mo abam wó kwei á maŋe de amo? Wɔ mo á wó ta we, dé ye da-yuudwonna?

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó kwei-de mo ba daŋe ba bakale baŋa ne, ye ba jege-de ba via. Ba ná yɔɔre ba chwi-de mɛ, de lɛɛre de zege da mo, de daa ware se de gɔ naga de tete ne. Nɔɔno ná laare tei o jare-de se de woli‑o, de ware se de leiri kolokolo. De nam ware se de jwoŋi kotu o cham wone de yage.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: Abam balo na swoi se á ta‑á ve amo to, guli-na tento se á wane á ke dam á ke á kuri ne. Kwei-ko á ke á yuu ne.

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Guli-na wo-dwonnu telo na ke faŋa faŋa to. Amo mo ye Wɛ, ye wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera. Amo mo ye Wɛ, ye kolokolo tera ko na mae de amo.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: Abam zwabani-nyena bam cheigi-na a taane dem. Á swoi se á ta‑á pɔɔre á tete de a chega kam mo.

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a vaŋe a chega kam mo se ka yi abam. Ka daa dae yiga yiga de abam. Ko bá dáane se a ma a jwoŋi abam a yage. Amo wó pa se Zion tiina bam na verem, se Isarele tiina bam taa jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ amo ŋwaane.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Babilon tiina bam, tu-na á jeini bworu wone. Á laam wó ta‑á jei bwori mo ye a di pa-kateiga. Nmo Babilon teo kom, ba daa bá taa bwoi‑m we, ka-bwom wolo na jege lonne to.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Nmo wó ta‑n zege kalambwolo mo, se nɔɔna na n chaveera. A lage a yiri jene mo nmo nɔɔna bam maama baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane a yiga o che.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Debam Jwoŋinu wom na tage kolo to mo konto. O yere mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ. O maa ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: “Nmo Babilon teo kom, ta‑n jei chemm, se n ta ta‑n wo lim wone. Nɔɔna daa bá taa bwoi nmo yere we, logo baŋa teene ka-pɛ.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Amo bane ya mo zaŋe de a nɔɔna bam, pa se a chɔge-ba ne ba dae a nɔɔna mo to. A ma kwei-ba a ke nmo jeŋa ne, ye nmo wo duri ba ŋwaŋa. Ko ná maŋe ko ye ba nɔn-kwe de, n yɔɔre n pa ko zo ba yera mo,

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Nam fɔge n cheigi a taane dem, nmo wolo na swoi paare dim ye n yɔɔre n jei mo fae n ba lwei kolokolo to. Nmo ma‑n tɛ n tete ne n we, ‘Amo mo wora, ye a dwoŋi tera. Amo bere a bá ji kadeim. A bia de nam bá te ba daare-ne.’

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: Nmo toŋe puseŋa kikia mo ye n ba jege lwia. N ma‑n tɛ n we, ‘Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba nae a kikia yam.’ Nmo na yeini n tɛ de n tete we, ‘Amo mo wora, ye a dwoŋi tera’ to, nmo swa yam de n yeino kom mo jaane‑m ya jei.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Bera yalo maama nmo na jwoŋi to pɛ se n boboŋa vugimi. Pa se balo na nii chalechwe se ba jwoŋi swa to ba ba zege nmo yiga ne. Ba yeini ba nii chalechwe sem mo chana maama se ba lɔre wonnu telo jwa na wó ke to. Nam pa se ba jwoŋi nmo ba yage de cham delo na beene n baŋa to.

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Banto yɔɔre ba nye de ga-korro mo. Mini nam mo lage de di-ba kula. Ba ware ba tete se ba jwoŋi ba yage, min-vogo kom na tiini ko dana to ŋwaane. Mini dento dae delo ba na wó taa jeeri daane de yiga ne, naa se ba jeini ba twɛ-de ba weeri to.

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nmo na ke n chega de balo maama ye nmo de-ba toŋe daane ko nwoŋi n biini maŋa ne to, ba ba jege nyɔɔre ba pa‑m. Ba maama tusi chwoŋa mo ba vei ba tete veiŋa, pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se kotu jwoŋi‑m o yage.”

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Amo tete mo kwei a jeŋa a ma a chwi logo kom kuri. Amo ta mo lware wɛyuu kom de a jazem dem, pa se ko tigi palalala. A ná yeini a bwoŋi tento maama, te maama wó zaŋe wɛɛne mo te taa zega.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Amo tete mo yɔɔre a ta konto. Amo mo bwoŋi Sarusi, ye a na toŋe‑o se o ke kolo to wó seene ko ke.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Nam fɔɔre á yi-na se á cheigi a taane dento: Ko na zege boboa kam ne to, a wo ke na a ni ne, ye a ŋɔɔne de abam. Wonnu tem na bobo te ke to, de a maŋe a wora mo.” Leile konto, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ dɛ o Jworo baŋa ne mo o toŋe-ne.

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: Tento wɛɛne á dwi dem ya wó puli dedɛ ne naneo ni kasol-bia na daga tei to. A ya wó taa yere-ba se ba dwi dem daa yé ti, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé pa ba jei amo yiga ne.”

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Puseŋ-nyena bá fɔge ba na bochare-zuru.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: Abam sa-teena balo na zoore naneo kom ni ne yiga yiga to, cheigi-na a taane dem. Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o kuri-ne mo ye ba laam lo-ne. O ma le-ne a nu puga wone, ye o bwoŋi a yere se a ji o tontoŋeno.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Wonto ma pa se a ni taane nye de se-zɔɔ kolo ni na di lanyerane to. O maa jege-ne o ja-kukworo ne. A ta nye de taŋa chene delo o na fɔge o kwɛ to mo. O ma ke-ne o che-kɔŋɔ wone o seigi.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: O tage de amo mo o we, “Isarele dwi dem, nmo ye amo tontoŋeno mo, se n pa a nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom taa nae jaja.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Amo laam maa we: “Amo yɔɔre a toŋe totoŋ-zɛɛra mo. A na mɛ a dam a ke kolo maama to ba jege kuri.” Baŋa Wɛ yerane nam mo wó pa a na a totoŋa yam nyɔɔre. Wonto mo wó pa-ne ŋweero telo na maŋe to.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tage o we: “Nmo na ye amo tontoŋeno to, n jege totoŋ-fare mo se n ke. Nmo wó ja Isarele dwi tiina balo ta na daare to n jwoori n pa ba zege de dam, ye ko dae konto yerane mo n wó ke. Nmo ta wó ji pwooni n nye dwi-gɛ tiina bam baŋa ne, se n wane n pa nabiina na verem logo baŋa jei maama ne.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom ye o ta kwori o ye á Vereno to tage tento mo de wolo logo baŋa nɔɔna na gwooni ye ba ta chuli‑o, ye o toŋe o pa ba teene dem dedɛɛra to. Baŋa Wɛ tage de kotu o we: “Pwa laam ná nɛ nmo, ba wó zaŋe wɛɛne mo ba sɛ ba pa‑m. Dedɛɛra de ná nɛ nmo, ba wó tiiri n yiga ne mo. Ba nam wó ke konto Baŋa Wɛ na ye chega tu to ŋwaane mo. Wonto nam mo ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom, ye o kuri nmo se n toŋe n pa‑o.” Isarele tiina bam wó jwoori sɔŋɔ

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Maŋa kam ná yia se a ke zaane á yuu ne, a laam wó leiri á wɛ-lworo kom. Dɛ dem ná yi se a vere abam a yage to, amo wó zeini abam. A wó taa jege abam mɔpe se a tɔge abam baŋa a gwoni ni de nɔɔna. Á ta wó pa se á tega kam fɔge ka ji te-ŋoŋa, ye á daare á pɔɔre jei selo na chɔge to se nɔɔna jwoori ba taa zoore da.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Kana de na-nyɔm bá ja-ba. Wea, de kagoa vo-loŋo kom de bá daane-ba. Kokuri to, ŋwaŋa Tu Wɛ wom mo wó da ba yiga, ye o kale-ba o vo buli-yia na wo mɛ to se ba taa nyɔa.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Nii-na! A nɔɔna bam wó nwoŋi sa-teene yiga yiga ba jwoori ba ba ba tete teo. Ba badaara wó nwoŋi baŋa seeni teene dem mo, ye badwonna de nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni ba ba. Ba babam de maa wó nwoŋi Sayene laŋa kam ba jwoori ba ba.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu jei sem maama, bage-na á yage de wopwolo! Tega baŋa ni maama de taa di ywoni! Peero jei sem de bage leiŋa á yage jei maama! Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo pae o nɔɔna bam bochare tiga, ye o daare o duri ba ŋwaŋa ba yaara yam wone.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: De ko de, Zion teo kom ta tage mo ko we, “Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yage-ne, ye o swei amo swia.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: “Kaane wó swei o bu wolo na jege‑o o ŋɔge to swia se o daa yé ja bu wolo o tete na loge to ŋwaŋa na? Wonto nam ná maŋe o swei o bu wom swia de, amo Baŋa Wɛ bere a bá swei nmo ni ne.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Nii mo! Amo gweere n yere dem a tiŋi a jataala wone mo. A nam bá fɔge a swei nmo kabiri sem na chɔge to ni ne.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Nmo bia bam wó taa laga se ba jwoori ba ba lela. Ko nam ná ye balo ya na yɔɔre ba chɔge‑m to, banto wó viiri ba daare‑m.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: Kwoni n yuu se n nii jei maama ne. N bia bam maama maa tɔge daane ba beene n tei.” Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we, “Amo na lwoori a ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom to, ko ye chega mo we nmo yi wó su n bia bam, ne ba ye nenɔŋa zwanno kaane na lage o zo baro ye o kwei-te o ke o ba ne tei to mo.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Bia balo ba na loge ye ba wo sa-teo ne to wó jwoori ye ba ta pa ko zo n zwa we, ‘Dé tega kanto tiini ka muri dé zoorem. Nam beeri tega n woli da n pa debam se dé taa zoora.’

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Teene dedwonna pwa mo wó jwoŋi n bia bam ba kɔne. Ba bukwa wó pa-ba yele se ba taa ŋɔga. Ba wó tiiri nmo yiga ne se ba yibi sem ja tega. Ba maa wó deilimi nmo napera kuri kasolo. Nmo de n bia bam laam maa wó lɔre we, amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. Balo teena na wo amo wone to bá fɔge ba na ba chaveera.”

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye balo na bɛɛse‑m to, a lage a pa ba taa jege daane ba goe mo. Ba maa wó me de nɔn-gora kikia, se ko taa nye de ba nyɔ jana mo ba sui. Nabiina maama laam maa wó lɔre we, amo Baŋa Wɛ mo ye abam Vereno wom. A maa ye Jakob dwi tiina Dam maama Tu wom, ye a ta ye á Jwoŋinu wom.”

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Amo mo wae a pa se wɛyuu kom maama ke tim, ne nɔɔno na zo gare-nyenyaaro o ma keeri lua tei to.” Wɛ tontoŋeno wom taane

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na woli amo to ŋwaane, amo yuu bá fɔge ko yaale. Mo kokuri a nam jege baare se a zege, a na yei we a bá di a chaveera to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
