translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ zeini-ne mo. Wɔ nam mo wora se o di bora o vane-ne? Balo na chuli-ne to maama wó chɔge mo ba ti, ne tóa na mugi gɔrɔ maama tei to.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Abam maama wone wɔ mo kɔre Baŋa Wɛ ye o nege o tontoŋeno wom? Wolo nam ná vei lim wone, ye pwooni tera o tei ne, se kotu ke o teena o Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere dem ne, se o daare o sale o yera ne.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se Zion teo tiina bam bochare zuri. O maa wó fɔge o nii ko di-dwonnu tem baŋa ne. O lage o pa teo kom kagoa kam taa ye ne Eden teeni kara kam na lana tei to mo. Ka wó taa ye ne Baŋa Wɛ gaare dem na ye tei to mo. Wopwolo dedɛ wó taa wo dáane, ye ba wó taa bage lei-keim lei ba yage jei maama.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na a taane dem. Amo tete nɔɔna bam, pore-na á zwa! Amo wó pa se a bera yam yi nɔɔna maama. A ta wó pa se a chega kam taa toŋa, se logo baŋa dwi maama na pwooni.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: A ti a yiga se a bore chega bora a pa nɔɔna, se a daare a jwoŋi-ba a yage lela. A ta wó di dwi tiina bam maama taane. Balo na zoore naneo kom ni ne to de wó taa teene amo mo, se a ba a ma a dam dem a vere-ba.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: Abam balo na yei chega tɔgem ye á jege amo nia yam á boboŋa ne to, nam cheigi-na a taane dem. Yé ta‑á fona-na de nɔɔna na jege abam ba lwɛ tei to. Nam yé pa-na se ba toro tem daane abam.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Kokuri to, tóa mo lage ka mu-ba ka ti, ne kenkaao na mugi gɔrɔ tei to. Kanzwa de maa wó zo-ba ya ja chɔge, ne ya na chɔge lɔŋɔ tei to. Amo chega kam nam wó taa toŋa mo wuu. A verem dem de wó taa wora maŋa maama wone.”

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: “Amo tete mo yeini a pa‑m baare. Bɛŋwaane nam mo ye nmo kɔre foone de nabiina? Se banto bá dáane ye ba jei, ne gaaro na kwaare ye te te tei to.

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye n swei amo Baŋa Wɛ na ye n keiru to swia? Amo mo lware wɛyuu baŋa kam maama pa se ka tigi palalala. A ma daare a chwi logo kom kuri. Bɛ mo ye n pa se foone jege‑m dɛ maama wone, de balo na jege‑m ba bɛɛse de ban-lom ye ba yɔɔre ba beeri n chɔgem to? Banto bane nam zaŋe kafɛ mo.

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Ko bá dáane de ko na chɛ balo to jwoŋi ba tete ba yage. Ba bá maŋe peena diga kam wone ba te. Ba nam bá ga ba ni-wodiu de.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Amo nam mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A ná yeini a yuŋi naneo kom, ko na-ŋone sem laare mo bɔge-bɔge. A yere mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amo mo pɛ‑m ni se n ta‑n toŋe n pa-ne, ye a daare a seigi‑m a jaguli wone. A ma lware wɛyuu kom a yage ko na tigi mɛ to, ye a daare a chwi logo kom kuri de. Ko ta ná ye Zion tiina bam, a tage de-ba we, ‘Abam ye amo nɔɔna mo.’ ” Jerusalem tiina bam yaara wó ti

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Jerusalem tiina bam, zaŋe-na! Zaŋe-na dɔɔm wone! Abam nyɔge na-zoŋa kalo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ abam to wone mo, ka na su de o ban-zɔŋɔ kom to. Á ma nyɔ á su á ja á gaale, pa se á beiri ye á daa ware se á ta‑á zege cheppe.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam maama wone nɔɔno dedoa tete tera se o da á yiga o bere abam chwoŋa se á ta‑á tɔga.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na jei yaara ne pa n bugi n tiga, ye ko dae sana mo n nyɔge n bugi to, nam cheigi a taane dento.

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: Zion tiina bam, zaŋe-na dɔɔm wone! Zaŋe-na wɛɛne se á ke dam á ke á tete kuri ne! Jerusalem teo kolo na ye Wɛ tete nyem to, kwei nenɔŋa gwaaro n vɔ n teiŋa ne! Kokuri to, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na yeiri Wɛ to daa bá jwoori ba zo nmo wone.

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo na yeigi abam a pa sa-teena to, ba wo ŋwe kolokolo ba pa-ne. A nam ná lage a jwoori a jwoŋi abam, a bá ŋwe sabu ko ŋwaane.”

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Bɛ nam daa mo jege ko ke tento? Kafɛ ŋwaane mo ba seene ba kale a nɔɔna bam ba ja vo sa-teo yiga yiga. Ba dedɛɛra bam maa chwoosi dedɛ. Dɛ maama wone ba jege amo yere dem mo ba yaala.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Jerusalem teo di-dwonnu tem, abam de zaŋe-na á ta‑á leeni wopwolo lei. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo pɛ se o nɔɔna bam bochare zuri, de o na jwoŋi Jerusalem teo kom o yage to.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lage o bere dwi-gɛ tiina bam o dam-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei to mo. Ko maa wó pa se tega baŋa ni maama na dé Tu Wɛ wom na wó vere o nɔɔna o yage tei to.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nam nwoŋi-na da sa-teo kom konto ne! Yé digiri-na á tete de ba wo-zɔɔna yam! Nwoŋi-na á daare-ba. Abam balo na zeŋe Baŋa Wɛ diga zela yam to jege se á ta‑á ye wose mo.

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: “Amo tontoŋeno wom totoŋa wó vo yiga. O yere dem wó zaŋe wɛɛne pa se o na zula dedɛ.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Ko nam so nɔɔna dedɛ balo na nɛ‑o to mo. Kokuri to, ba ke‑o zonne pa se o yibia chɔge ye o daa ba jege nabiinu nyenyego o yera ne kɔtaa!

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: O nam ta wó yɛ teene dedɛ nɔɔna nia. Pwa de wó da o ŋwaane ba pu ba nia. Kokuri to, kolo nɔɔna na wo tage ba bere-ba to mo ba lage ba lɔre. Ba maa wó ni wonnu telo ba ya na yeiri te ni ne to kuri.”

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Wɛ tontoŋeno wom na bege tei to nye de wo-dwi na tage de nwoŋi te-kora ne tei ye de kuru tem kwaare tega ne to mo. O yibia ba jege lam de nenɔŋa se dé boboŋa vo o seeni. O ya-tega de maa ba jege kolo dé na wó nii dé na se dé taa lage‑o ko ŋwaane to.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: O ye wolo nabiina na yɔɔre ba gwoona, ye ba daare ba ve to mo. O ma tiini o me de wo-chechɔgɔ de yaara. Nɔɔna nyaŋe‑o mo ye ba seigi ba yibia o tei ne. Dé ma boŋe we, o ye wo-koro mo.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Dé maama tusi ne pei mo na ywori se chwoŋa wone. Nɔɔno maama pipiri mo o kwei o tete chwoŋa o tɔga. Baŋa Wɛ laam ma kwei dé maama tusim kikia yam o daŋe wonto baŋa ne.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Ba dɛ vwa chwoŋa ne mo ba di o taane ba de‑o se o te. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo ke o toone dem o boboŋa ne. O ŋwea yɔɔre ka ke kukua mo nabiina tetare ne. Ko nam ye o tete nɔɔna bam wɛleera ŋwaane mo o nɛ chɔgem.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: O nam ná yaare o ti, o wo wó pwoli, o na lɔre we o keBaŋa Wɛ boboŋa na lage kolo to ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “Amo tontoŋeno wom wó pa se nɔɔna dedɛ na ba bora, o na kwei ba wɛleera yam o daŋe o tete yuu ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo siseina wó yale ya yi jazem seeni de jagwia seeni maama mo. Nmo nɔn-bia bam lage ba di teene dedwonna mo, ye ba zeili de nɔɔna se ba laam taa zoore de wone.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: Nam yé ta‑n kɔre foone, se n bá di chaveera. Yé ta‑n lwia we, ba wó na n kuri, se ko bá ke konto. Ko ná ye chaveera yalo nmo na nɛ n nɔn-donne maŋa ne to, nmo wó swei ya swia. N daa bá‑n guli n ya na ye kadeim ye nɔɔna gwooni‑m tei to gula.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo Keiru wom mo ye n baro. Wonto yere nam mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ. Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom mo ye n Jwoŋinu. Wonto nam ta mo tei tega baŋa ni maama.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó bwoŋi‑m se n jwoori n ba o tei, ne ka-bwom wolo ya na zo baro o nɔn-donne maŋa ne ye o baro wom yage‑o lela, pa se o jei o yerane de wo-chechɔgɔ tei to mo.” Nmo Tu Wɛ wom mo tage konto.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: A bane ya na zaŋe de nmo to mo pɛ se a seigi a yibia dede‑m maŋa fenfee wone. A nam wó tɔge a swono kolo na ba ti to baŋa ne mo se a duri nmo ŋwaŋa.” Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye n Jwoŋinu to mo tage konto.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Amo tei ne, ko nye de a déem na ke tei Noah maŋa kam ne to mo. A déem tage a du mo we, a daa bá pa se na-fɔrɔ li logo kom. A laam nam ta tage a du mo we, a bane bá zaŋe nmo baŋa ne, a nam bá bwɛ nmo de.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Peero tem ná maŋe te ziziŋi ye zwonnu tem de jei mo de, amo bere a bá dɔne a swono kom nmo baŋa ne. A nam bá kwane ni delo a na gwoni de nmo bochare-zuru ŋwaane to.” Baŋa Wɛ wom na jege nmo ŋwaŋa to mo tage konto.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: Nmo ye teo kolo vo-dɛɔ na puri n baŋa ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o pa n bochare zuri to mo. Nii mo! Amo nam wó kwei kandwa-nyenno dwi dwi mo a fɔge a lɔ nmo jei sem. A lage a ma Safira mo a chwi n kabiri-beira kam.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Chega na toŋe n wone to mo wó pa se n kuri ja tega lanyerane. Yaara wó taa ye yiga yiga de nmo, se ko pa n yé ta‑n kɔre foone. Lɛɛro dwi maama de bá twɛ nmo tei.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Teo kolo nɔɔna ná li nmo de jara, ko dae amo mo pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba ke konto. Wolo maama nam ná ke chichuŋu de nmo, kotu wó ba o sɛ o pa‑m.

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: “Abam balo maama na-nyɔm na jege to, ba-na á nyɔ na! Á ná maŋe á ba jege sabu de, ta ba-na! Yeigi-na kolo á na lage to á di! Abam ná lage sana de nayela, ba-na á jwoŋi! Te maama ye zɛɛra mo. Á bá ŋwe kolokolo te ŋwaane.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Nii-na! A déem kuri‑o mo se o pa dwi-gɛ tiina lɔre a dam dem na ye tei to. A ta ma pa se o ji ba yiga tu ye o tei-ba.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Abam wó toŋe á bwoŋi teene delo á ya na yeiri to nɔɔna, ye ba de wó ke lela ba ba ba sɛ á beeri dem. Ba wó ke konto abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ŋwaane. Wonto mo ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom, ye o pa se á na nenɔŋa lanyerane.”

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: Abam ta jege chwoŋa se á na Baŋa Wɛ, nam kwaane-na se á lɔre-o. Bwoŋi-na o yere ye o ta bwola se o sɛ á beeri dem.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Ne wɛyuu kom de tega baŋa kam na pɔɔre daane tei to, konto mo amo chwei sem wo wɛɛne ye abam nyem wo kuri ne. Amo boboŋa yam de maa wo abam boboŋa yam yiga ne.

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: Ko ye bedwe mo de taane delo na nwoŋi amo ni ne to. De bá jwoori de ba a tei kafɛ. Ko nam ye se de ke a boboŋa na laga tei maama to mo, se de ke de su a na toŋe-de se de ke tei to.”

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: Abam wó nwoŋi sa-teo kom ne de wopwolo mo se á jwoori sɔŋɔ de bochare-zuru. Á ná ma‑á kɛa, peero tem de zwonnu tem wó taa bage lei mo. Teeni delo maama de na wo pwola ne to wó taa mage je mo wopwolo ŋwaane.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sabare ya na wo mɛ maama to laam wó ji tei-ŋonno jeiga mo. Swanno telo na ke bia to mo wó leiri sabare-mangwoli yuu ne. Keina yanto mo wó pa Baŋa Wɛ jwoŋi yere o pa o tete. Ko nam ye memaŋe na wó taa wora taa wuu ye de bá chɔge kɔtaa to mo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Ta‑á yei-na se á pa chega kam zege, se á ta‑á ke kolo na tɔge chwoŋa to. Kokuri to, ko bá dáane se a jwoŋi abam a yage, ye a pa se chega taa toŋa jaja.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tu wolo ná tu o kwei o tete o sale Baŋa Wɛ yera ne, kotu yé ta nenɛɛne, “Baŋa Wɛ wó pa popɔra taa tigi amo de o tete nɔɔna bam tetare laŋa ne.” Ba na lwe nɔɔno wolo to de yé ta nenɛɛne, “Amo ye wo-koro mo.”

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: amo laam wó pa se ba na jeiŋa jei a tete diga kam ne. A maa wó pa se ba na yere na gare ba ya ná jege bu-baara de bukwa se nɔɔna guli ba gula tei to. A maa wó pa-ba yere delo na wó taa wora wuu ye de bá fɔge de jei.

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: banto mo a lage a ja-ba a yi a peo kolo na ye wose to, se ba di ywoni amo wara-jei sem wone. A laam maa wó sɛ a jwoŋi ba zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de kaanem delo maama ba na ke a bimbini dem baŋa ne to. Kokuri to, ba wó taa bwoi amo sɔŋɔ kom we, wara-jei mo na zege dwi maama ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: “Ba-na abam ga-vara bam maama! Nwoŋi-na gaao wone de goa wone á ba á di á su!

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Balo na jege a nɔɔna bam ba nii to ye lilwoa mo. Ba maa yeiri kolokolo kuri. Ba ta nye de kukuri selo nia na pugi to mo, ba ware se ba wei kɔtaa. Ba yɔɔre ba tigi ba dwɛ dendwa yerane mo. Ba maa tiini ba swoi dɔɔm dedɛ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Ba fera yam yɔɔre ya daga ne kukuri fera na ye tei to mo. Ba ba fɔge ba di ba sui. Ba maa ye nayera balo yia na wo poore to. Ba maama ke ba na lage tei to mo, ye ba daare ba beeri nyɔɔre ba pa ba tete.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Balo na yɔɔre ba tɔge chwoŋa to nam ná tega, ba yeini ba na yazura mo, ye ba daare ba si.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Abam balo na nwoŋi vora dwi dem wone to, fɔɔre-na á yi amo tei! Á ye ka-tola de ka-bworru bia mo!

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Bera mo abam jege á ke á mɔna? Bera mo á kaŋe á nia kayɔ-yɔlɔ á jege-ba á twea? Abam nam yɔɔre á ye zwabani-nyena dwi, de vwa-fɔra yerane mo.

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Á na zuli á jwona tei-kamunnu tetare ne tei to, á tigi teeni maama kuri ne á ke kabwoŋa kikia mo. Á daa ta ma kwei á bia á kaane-ya bwollu tem ne, mɛ gugworru na wo peero tem wone to.

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Abam ta yeini á diini peo maama yuu mo á ke kabwoŋa kikia de á na kaane á jwona yam tei to.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Abam ta yeini á zo á di sem wone á pe se nia, ye á zege á jwona nyenyero da. Á ma ve amo ye á daare á sɛ á pa jwona. Á ma‑á yɔɔre á tɔge ya baŋa á ke sare-peiga, de á na to sare wone á tigi de balo á fera na zoora to.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Abam ta ma kwei nuga de talwoŋ-ywoŋa dedɛ á ja á vo se á ma á zuli pɛ wom. Á ma toŋe á nɔɔna se ba vo yiga yiga ba nii, ko ná maŋe ko ye churu ne mo de.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Abam nam kɔre foone de jwoni dɔ mo pa se á daa ba jege amo chega? Bɛŋwaane mo abam daa ba guli amo gula, á nam maŋe á ba boŋe amo boboŋa de? A na dáane ye a wo korese abam to ŋwaane mo, á daa ba kɔre-ne na?

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Abam nam ná keeri á lage wolim, á jwona yam wó wane ya woli abam na? Vio tete yerane yi se ko kale-ya ko ja ko jei. Siu fenfee yerane mo wó kale-ya ko ja ko kɛ. Ko daare wolo ná sale amo Baŋa Wɛ yera ne, kotu wó jwoŋi tega kam o taa tei, ye o daare o taa zuli-ne a tete peo kom baŋa ne. Balo wo na chɔge de ba wɛleera to wó sii

english_verse: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
translation_verse: Ba maa we: “Fɔge á tiŋi-na chwo-fara kam! Guri-na da-bunnu tem maama se a nɔɔna na chwoŋa ba kɛ.”

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wo wɛyuu baŋa baŋa mo ye o ba jege dwoŋi. O maa ŋwe taa wuu, ye o yere dem ye wose. Wonto nam tage tento mo: “Amo seene a jeini wɛyuu jei sem ne mɛ na ye wose to mo. De ko de, a ta wora de balo na zoore ba tete tega ne ye ba chuli ba wɛleera yam to, se a pa nɔɔna bam konto dwi bochara bi.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: A bá yɔɔre a taa bwɛ a nɔɔna taa. A bane dem nam bá taa wo ba baŋa ne wuu. Ko ná dae konto, nabiina nagwola wó yɔɔre ya te mo, de ko na maŋe ko ye amo mo pɛ ba jege ŋwea to de.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ba na tusi ba wo-loŋo ŋwaane to, mo a bane zaŋe de-ba. A ma waare-ba ye a daare a seigi a yibia ba tei ne. De ko de, ba ta yɔɔre ba ke zwabania ne ba boboŋa na lage tei to mo.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Amo seene a na ba kikia na ye tei to. A nam ta wó pa ba na zurim. Amo wó to ba yiga ne se ba lɔre chwoŋa kam, ye a daare a pa se ba bochara zuri.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: “Puseŋ-nyena bam bá fɔge ba sii.”

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wone ba fɔɔre ba twɛ amo tei mo. Ba maa bere ba tete we, ba seene yia se ba lɔre amo bera yam. Ba kare ba ke ne ba ye nɔɔna balo na tɔge chwoŋa ye ba wo yage ba Tu Wɛ wom nia yam to mo. Ba maa tɛ de amo we, a bore chega bora a pa-ba, ne ba ye balo na swoi se ba de Wɛ me daane to mo.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Ba ta bwei amo mo ba we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo dé vɔge dé nia, ye nmo ba nii dé seeni? Bɛ mo ke ye dé na gwooni dé tete tei to, nmo wo maane ko ni ne?’ Nii-na! Abam na yeini á vɔ ni maŋa kalo ne to, á ta ke á boboŋa na lage kolo to, ye á bɛɛse balo na toŋe ba pa abam to mo.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Á boŋe we, a wo pwoli de ni-vɔre dem konto dwoŋi mo na? Ko ye se nɔɔna zoore ba tete tega ne dɛ dedwe yerane wone, ye ba chɔɔle ba yuni tega ne, ne gaaro mo gwoori na? Ko ta ye se nɔɔna lware gare-nyenyaaro se ba peini da de tentwarem wone mo na? Abam jege konto mo á bwoi ni-vɔɔm na? Á boŋe we, amo Baŋa Wɛ wo pwoli de dɛ dem konto kikia mo na?

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná tɔge kikia yam konto dwoŋi, amo zaane dem wó ba á baŋa ne mo, ne wɛ-puli wea na yeini ka nwoŋi jaja tei to. Á maa wó na á zurim lela. Á nɔn-ŋonne kikia de wó nwoŋi ya taa vei á yiga ne, se Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de taa kwoli abam kwaga.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Abam laam maa ná lwoori kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ tei ne, o wó leiri abam ye o ke lela o ta we, ‘Nii-na ne da.’ Abam jege se á kwei á keim-chɛɛre dem á dole á yage, se á daa yé bwɛ daane, naa á chwo da-kwaga.

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: Á ta jege se á ta‑á pae kana na jege balo to wodiu, ye á daare á woli balo na wo cham wone to. Á ná ke wonnu tem konto dwoŋi, á wó pa se pwooni pɔpɔ de ba de zege lim wone de nye woŋaa, se ko taa nye de wea ko pae abam.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama mo Baŋa Wɛ wó taa nii á baŋa ne. Te-kora ne mɛ seeni wea na dana to, mo o lage o pa abam á na gɛ wonnu telo to, se á yera yam fɔge ya ke dam. Á wó ta‑á nye de gaare delo ba na yage na dedɛ da to mo, naa buli-yi delo na na ba kɔe to mo.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Á ná seene á ke keim dem konto dwoŋi, á laam wó di ywoni amo Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. A maa wó pa se á yere zaŋe tega kam maama ne, ye á di nyɔɔre tega kalo a na kwei a pa á nabaaro Jakob to baŋa ne.” Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo konto.

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, abam tusim kikia mo chege chwoŋa ye ya pɔɔre abam de á Tu Wɛ wom daane. Á wɛleera yam mo pɛ se o kwoli o yibia de abam, ye o ba ni á lworo kom.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Ba boboŋa yam nye de kapɛ chechara mo. Wolo ná di-ya, o wó te mo. Ya dedoa maa ná lɔga, kapaa mo wó nwoŋi da. Ba na jeeli chɔgem tei to nye de didwonkwogo na sɔ zwollu tei to mo.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ba yɔɔre ba wuuri mo de wɛleera keim. Ba maa ye lela se ba go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to. Ba boboŋa yɔɔre ya ye lwarem yerane mo. Ba chwei sem maama maa ye chɔgem yerane.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Banto yeiri bochare-zuru na ye woŋo kolo to. Ba totoŋa maama ba tɔge chega. Ba pipiri ba chwei sem pa se gugwoli mo. Wolo maama na vei se wone to yeiri yazura na ye tei to. Leirim

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo dé wo nɛ dé bora, ye verem de wo tu dé tei ne. Dé ya jei dé teene pwooni mo, ye jei maama ye lim yerane ko pae debam. Dé laam maa yɔɔre dé taana yibiri wone, wea na tera dé tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Dé nye de lilwoa balo na kare ba taane kabira yera ne to mo. Dé jege dé tete dé tiri dé toe wea tetare ne, ne ko ga ye wɛ-zwora maŋa mo to. Dé ná maŋe dé wo babɛ tei ne mo de, dé ta bwona ne twa mo tei.

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Dé zwabania gaale ye dé ta lɔ dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom kwaga ne. Dé ma pipiri dé kwɛ sem dé ya‑o. Dé ta pɛ se bɛɛsem de vuvuga ba dé dwonna baŋa. Dé maa na yeini dé boŋe vwa yalo to mo dé kare dé fɔe.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Chega daa tere jei jei ne. Wolo maama maa ná ve se o toŋe lwarem, ba wó gilimi kotu se ba ja‑o mo. Baŋa Wɛ bora borem Baŋa Wɛ ma nii o na ko na ye tei to, ye o wo chɔge zanzam de chega borem daa na tera to.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Balo na zoore wɛ-zoore seeni to wó taa kɔre Baŋa Wɛ yere dem. Balo na wo wɛ-puli seeni to de wó zuli‑o, o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane. O nam lage o li-ba ne na-fɔrɔ na fufugi tei de Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ vio dole ba baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Jwoŋinu wom nam wó ba Zion teo kom ne, se o jwoŋi Jakob dwi delo na ve ba wɛleera yam to o yage.

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Jerusalem, zaŋe wɛɛne, se nmo maŋa mo tento ka yia. Wea mo tu ka pa n na pwooni. Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom mo nye n baŋa ne.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Nii mo! Lim mo kwoli tega baŋa maama ye de li dwi-gɛ tiina bam. Ko nam ná ye nmo, Baŋa Wɛ tete mo nye pwooni n baŋa ne. O nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de bere jaja n baŋa ne.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina wó ba ba zo n pwooni dem wone. Pwa de maa wó ba se ba da ba na á tega kam na poore tei to.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: Kwoni n yuu se n nii kolo na jege ko ke jei maama ne to. Nɔɔna bam maama tɔge daane ba maa beene n tei. N bu-baara bam nwoŋi yiga yiga ne ba beene. Ba maa peili n bukwa bam ba maa jwoora.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Nmo laam ná nɛ konto maama, n wo wó pwoli, ye n yera taa sae de wopwolo, de n na jege teera ba ŋwaane to. Ba nam wó zeŋe sa-teene dem jejegero ba ja ba ba ba pa‑m, se dwi-gɛ tiina bam jejaano ji nmo nyem.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Kona dedɛ wó ba ya su nmo laŋa kam, ya na ye Midian teo kona de Efa teo kona. Seba tiina bam dé wó tɔge ba ba ye ba zeŋe sabu-seŋa de talwoŋ-ywoŋa ba ja ba ba. Ba wó taa leeni ba tei Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó ja Kedare teo pei-kɔgɔ maama ba ba ba pa nmo, ye ba daare ba ke Nebayofa teo pi-bale sem n jeŋa ne. Ba laam wó kwei-se ba ma ke kaanem a bimbini dem baŋa ne, ye a sɛ a jwoŋi-se. Ko maama wó pa se a tete di-laao kom na zula dedɛ.

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Te ye nabwooru telo na nwoŋi Tarasisi pipiu ŋwaane ye te tɔge naneo baŋa te beene to mo. Balo na zoore naneo ni teene dem ne to ke ba teena amo wone. Nabwooru tem konto zege yiga yiga ne te jege nmo Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam mo te maa beena. Lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa nam mo wo te wone, ba na jege-te ba beene se ba ma ba zuli n Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom to. Kokuri to, wonto yɔɔre o pa se nmo na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ mo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Sa-teena mo lage ba fɔge ba lɔ n kabiri sem ba zege, ye ba pwa de maa wó taa toŋe ba pa‑m. A ya dɛ a ban-zɔŋɔ ŋwaane mo a chɔge‑m. A zaane dem ŋwaane nam, a daa wó duri n ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Teo kolo tiina ná ve se ba zo abam dam kuri ne, banto wó na chɔgem mo pa se ba jei tega kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: Ba wó zeŋe Lebanon teo wo-laaro mo ba ja ba ba pa nmo. Tento ye ba tei-dedwaaro da-ŋonno tem dwi maama. Ba laam wó kwei-te ba fɔge ba kwɛ a diga kam, se a jeiŋa jei taa jege nenɔŋa lanyerane.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Balo déem na jege‑m ba bɛɛse to bia wó ba ba tiiri nmo yiga ne. Balo de ya na jege‑m ba gwooni to maa wó chɔɔle tega ne ba pa‑m. Ba laam wó taa bwoi n yere we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ tete teo kom’, dedaane ‘Zion na ye Isarele dwi dem Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom to teo’.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Sa-teene de pwa mo lage ba taa nii n baŋa ne, ne bu nu na jege‑o o kɔne tei to. Nmo laam wó lɔre we, amo Baŋa Wɛ mo ye n Jwoŋinu. A maa ye Jakob dwi tiina Dam Tu wom na wó vere‑m o yage to.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: Nmo ya na teene channa to, a lage a pa‑m sabu-seŋa mo. Nmo ya na teene luuru to, a maa wó pa‑m lu-nyenno. A ta wó kwei channa a pa‑m se ko leiri dɛ yuu ne, ye a daare a pa‑m luuru se te leiri kandwa yuu ne. A lage a pa yazura mo taa ye teo kom dedɛɛro. Nɔn-ŋonne de maa wó taa ye n yuu tu.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Chichuŋu sɔɔ daa bá taa ke n te-nia yam ne. Chɔgem de vuvuga nam bá zo n siseina yam maama ne. Nmo teo kabiri sem yere laam mo wó taa ye ‘Verem’, ye ni-bworru telo na pe teo kom to yere taa ye ‘Tia’.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Wɛ dem daa bá to de pa‑m. Chana kam de nam daa bá tu kuri nmo laŋa kam ne. Baŋa Wɛ wom tete mo wó taa ye pwooni o nye n baŋa ne taa wuu. Nmo wo-chechɔgɔ maŋa kam laam wó ti.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Wolo na muri ba wone to wó ji sɔ-yuu kamunu. Wolo de na ye balaŋa to de wó puli o ji te-fɔrɔ. Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom. Maŋa kam ná yia, a wó ke wonnu tento maama lela.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ Jworo kom mo wo amo baŋa ne. Kokuri to, o tiŋi-ne mo se a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere yiniga tiina. O toŋe-ne se a pa balo wo na chɔge to na zurim, se a daare a tɔɔle we, balo nɔɔna yiga na chege to wó taa tei ba tete, ye balo na wo peena diga ne to de nwoŋi pwooni yiga.

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó taa bwoi abam we, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ tete kaanem tiina balo na toŋe ba pa‑o to. Ba wó kwei dwi-gɛ tiina jejegero mo ba ma kɔne abam. Á de maa wó taa jege teera ba jejegero tem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina bam wó taa yei ba bia bam ni ne, ye nɔɔna maama ni ba kwaga kam ŋwa. Balo maama nam ná nɛ-ba, ba wó sɛ we, Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o swɛ ba swolim.”

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: N na wo Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne to, nmo wó ta‑n jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ n pa‑o, ne paare yipuga mo tei.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Nmo nɔɔna bam wó taa jege wopwolo se ba taa zoore nmo wone, ne nɔn-doŋo na swo ka-bwom o ma ji o kaane tei to mo. Nmo Tu Wɛ wom de maa wó di ywoni nmo ŋwaane, ne kan-baro na jege wopwolo de o ka-dooro tei to.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: Jerusalem, amo kwei yerena mo a zege n teo kabiri sem baŋa ne. Banto bá fɔge ba pu ba nia wea de tete maama ne. Abam balo na yeini á keeri á jare Baŋa Wɛ to, yé sii-na kɔtaa.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ dugi duuri mo ko tɔge o dam dem ŋwaane ye o we: “Amo daa bá kwei abam wodiiru tem a pa á dona se ba di ba daare abam. Veira de nam daa bá nyɔ sa-doora balo á na yaare á na to.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, balo na gwei ba wodiiru ba zo diga to mo wó di-te, ye ba daare ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. Balo de na gwori Vini tio-bia bam to wó zo amo wara-jei konkwallo tem mo ba nyɔ sa-doora balo ba tete na ke to.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Tɔge-na teo kom nia yam á nwoŋi ko wone! Ba-na á kwɛ chwoŋa kam á pa nɔɔna bam. Fɔge á lɔ-na pempale dem, se á daare á bibili kandwa-zana yam á yage dáa ne. Zeiŋi-na tuta wɛɛne se logo baŋa teene dem maama na.

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Ba maa wó taa bwoi banto we, ‘Nɔɔna balo na ye wose Wɛ ŋwaane to’, de ‘Nɔɔna balo Baŋa Wɛ na vere to’. Ba ta wó taa bwoi nmo Jerusalem teo we, ‘Teo kolo nɔɔna na jege ko fera to’, de ‘Teo kolo ba na wo nwoŋi ba yage-ko to’.

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Wɔ mo tento o nwoŋi Edom teo Bozera seeni o maa beene? O maa beene ye o zo gare-sonno chwɛ-chwɛ. Wɔ mo konto ye o zo nenɔŋa gwaaro? Kotu gwɛ de o dam-fɔrɔ o vei mo. “Ko ye amo mo beene konto. A kwora kam bere verem taane mo, ye a jege dam se a jwoŋi nɔɔna a yage.”

english_verse: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
translation_verse: Bɛ nam mo ke ye n gwaaro tem seene konto? Nmo nye de wolo na nɔne Vini tio-bia pa ba nyoa nwoŋi to mo.

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, a ke a boboŋa ne se a waare a dona bam mo, se a daare a jwoŋi a nɔɔna bam a yage.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: A maa nii jei maama ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o woli-ne. Ko so-ne de a na wo nɛ nɔɔno se o woli-ne to. A nam tɔge a tete dam ŋwaane mo a wane-ba. A ban-lom dem mo pɛ se a di-ba.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: A bane na zaŋe konto to, a nɔne logo baŋa teene dem baŋa ne mo. A ma pa se ba nyɔ a ban-lom dem sana ba su, ye a daare a lwo ba jana bam a yage tega ne.” Wɛ zaane dem taane

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Ba déem na wo yaara wone to, o de tɔge o yaare mo. O ma tɔge o tete maleka kam baŋa o jwoŋi-ba o yage. O swono de o ŋwaŋa kam ŋwaane mo o vere-ba. Faŋa faŋa to mo o gɔ-ba o zeŋe taa.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: De ko de, ba ta nwoŋi Wɛ kwaga ne mo, pa se o Jwori-laao kom wo chɔge. Ko ma pa se o pipiri o ji ba dono, ye o daare o ke chichuŋu de-ba.

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Wonto déem mɛ o dam-fɔrɔ kom o tɔge Moses baŋa ne o pɔɔre naneo kom belei ye Isarele tiina bam bɛ. Ko ma pa se Wɛ na yere delo na wora taa wuu to.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ Jworo kom de déem pɛ se ba na siu, ne naane na tɔge bwolo wone de kɛ to. Konto mo nmo déem nii n nɔɔna bam baŋa ne, se n na yere delo na tiini de lana to n pa n tete.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nam zege telaao ne, jeiga kalo na ye wose ye ka jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to, n tiiri n nii kolo na jege ko ke debam to. Nmo yi-seena de n dam-fɔrɔ kom daa bɛ? Bɛ mo ye n yiga daa tera dé wone se n duri dé ŋwaŋa?

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Nmo nam mo ye debam Kwo. Dé nabaaro Abaraham ná maŋe o yeiri debam, ye dé kwo Isarele yiga ná tera dé wone de, nmo Baŋa Wɛ ta wó ta‑n ye debam Kwo mo. Ko nwoŋi faŋa to, n yere dem mo ye debam Jwoŋinu.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, bɛŋwaane mo n sɛ pa se dé pipiri dé ywori n chwoŋa kam ne? N ta pɛ se dé wo ke dam mo, pa dé daa ba kɔre‑m. Jwoori n ba n woli debam, se dé ye n tontoŋena mo. Dé maa ye dwia yalo n na kuri se ba taa ye nyem to.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Maŋa fenfee wone n tete nɔɔna bam ya tei n tega kam mo. Nam nii, dé dona laam mo tu ba nɔne n tete diga kam baŋa ne.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Ko yeini ko ke ne debam ga dae nmo nɔɔna mo, naa nmo ga ba tei debam mo se n ta‑n nii debam baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Ko ya wó taa ye ne mini na jaane da-dwa pa se na chore de baŋa ne tei to. Nmo de nam tu se n pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam yera taa sae, n dona na wó lɔre n yere dem dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: N déem na ke wo-kenkagela yalo dé na ba teene ya teena to, n tete mo tu n ba, ye peero tem yɔɔre te ziziŋi n yiga ne.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Nmo yeini n woli balo na pae chega toŋa de ba wo-ywoŋo, ye ba daare ba tɔge n chwei sem to mo. Debam nam tiini dé tusi mo taa, pa se n bane zaŋe dé baŋa ne. Konto to, dé wó wane dé na verem tetɛ seeni mo?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Wɛleera mo lɔgese debam yera maama pa se dé digiri. Dé ná maŋe dé kwaane dé toŋe chega tei de, dé totoŋ-laaro ta ye ne kaane na liŋi o gare-zezɔŋɔ kolo to mo. Dé wɛleera yam maa wó kale debam maama ya ja jei, ne vɔɔro telo na kwaare ye vio pa te jei tei to.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nam yé tiini n pa n bane zaŋe de debam se ko kɛ jeŋa. Yé ta‑n yɔɔre n guli dé wɛleera yam gula taa wuu. Ja! Nii debam de ŋwaŋa, se debam maama ye nmo nɔɔna mo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: “Balo na wo bwei amo bwia to mo a pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba lɔre-ne. A ta ma le a tete a bere balo na wo beeri a jei to. Teo kolo nɔɔna na wo bwoŋi a yere se a woli-ba to mo a tage de-ba a we, ‘Nii-ne da ywoo!’

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: Tete ne ba ma vei yibeela jei ne, ye ba seigi ba tete gugworru wone. Ba ma daare ba di teira, ye ba furi wo-zɔɔna dwi dwi nɔna nyoa ba kabeili sem wone.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Ne nyoa ta ná yeini ba wo tio bu-zɔgɔ wone ye nɔɔna tɛ ba we, ‘Yé chɔge-ko, se ko ta jege nyɔɔre ko pa‑m’ tei to, konto mo amo de wó ke de a tontoŋena bam. A nam bá chɔge ba maama.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se Jakob na dwi, ye a ta pa se Judah de na kwaga, pa se ba jwoŋi amo peero laŋa kam ba taa tei. Nɔɔna balo a na kuri to mo wó taa tei-te, ye dáane mo a tontoŋena bam wó taa zoora.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam balo na ve amo Baŋa Wɛ ye á ba lage se á zuli-ne a tete peo kom baŋa ne to, a lage a chɔge abam mo. Á yeini á kwei wodiiru de sana dwi dwi mo, á ma á zuli á wa-yɔɔro tem, te yera na ye ‘Yu-ywoŋo’, de ‘Jwa taane’ to.

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: Amo jwa seeni wó pa se abam te jara wone. Abam wone nɔɔno maama wó kuni dwoona ye ba go‑o. Kokuri to, a na bwoŋi abam to, á wo leiri-ne. A ma ŋɔɔne de abam ye á wo cheigi a taane dem. Á nam yɔɔre á ke lwarem mo á chɔge amo yiga, ye á kuri kolo a na vae to á pa á tete.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo tontoŋena bam wó taa di ba sui mo, ye kana nam jege abam ka goe. A tontoŋena bam maa wó taa nyɔ ba sui ba boboŋa, ye na-nyɔm jege abam de ni. A tontoŋena bam wó taa chaka de wopwolo, ye chaveera nam yɔɔre ya ja abam.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam wó leeni wopwolo lei de ba bochara maama. Ko nam ná ye abam, á wó tiini á keeri de kwor-dɛa, de á wo na pɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam a na kuri to ná lage ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa nɔɔno, mo ba wó bwoŋi á yere ba yage kotu yera ne. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se abam te, se ko ná ye o tete nɔɔna bam, o wó kwei yere dedwoŋi o pa-ba.

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: Logo baŋa ne wolo maama ná yeini o boŋe se o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o yage o dwoŋi baŋa ne, kotu wó ke konto Chega Tu Wɛ wom yere ŋwaane mo. Logo baŋa ne wolo nam ná boŋe se o gwoni ni, kotu de wó kwei Chega Tu Wɛ wom yere o du. Kokuri to, faŋa faŋa lɛɛro tem daa tera ye amo de swei te ni ne mo. Wɛyuu-doŋo de te-doŋa taane

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Amo lage a naane wɛyuu-doŋo mo, ye a ke te-doŋa de. Ba laam wó swei boboa wonnu tem ni ne. Ba maŋe ba bá boŋe te boboŋa.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Amo yi wó taa page Jerusalem teo kom baŋa ne, ye a nɔɔna bam de ja ywoni ba ba ba pa-ne. Ba daa bá taa keera, naa ba kane yi-na teo kom konto wone maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Bu-sese daa bá taa jwoora te teo kom konto wone kɔtaa! Nɔn-kwe de nam bá te ye se wo yi se maŋa. Nɔɔno ná tega bena bi maŋa ne, ba wó ta we, bu mo jwoori. Wolo nam ná tega ye o wo yi bena bi, ba wó ta we, Wɛ sɔɔle lwarem o yage kotu yuu ne mo.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, nɔɔna wó lɔ ba sam ye ba zo de wone. Ba maa ná jeiri ba Vini teeni kare, ba wó di de bia bam.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Ba bá toŋe kafɛ ŋwaane. Ba nam bá lo bia se ba bia bam na lɛɛro. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lage o swɛ o nɔɔna bam swolim mo, ba de ba dwi dem maama.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Wiiru de pipeila wó taa zege jeiga dedoa ne ba di. Nywoŋo de maa wó taa di gaao, ne nabea na ke tei to. Basankwea nam wó yɔɔre ka taa di kasolo yerane mo. Amo tete peo kom na ye wose to ne mo nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá ke o dwoŋi zonne, naa o ke o chɔge woŋo baŋa ne.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Wɛyuu kom mo ye amo paare yituŋu. Ko daare tega baŋa kam maa ye amo na chwi a nɛ mɛ to. Abam wó wane á ke tɛ mo á lɔ diga á pa-ne? Jeiga kɔ mo amo wó vo a peini da a sii?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Amo tete je mo a mɛ a ke wonnu tento maama. Te ma da keim dem konto baŋa ne te seene te wora.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. “Nɔɔno wolo nam a yiga na wo o wone to mo tento: Ko ye wolo na tu o tete tega ne, ye o wo chɔge de o tusim kikia, ye o nege amo taane dem to mo.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Amo de nam wó kuri se a pa se ko ni-ba mo ye a pa kolo ba na vae to ba ba baŋa ne. Kokuri to, a na bwoŋi-ba to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo leiri-ne. A maa na ŋɔɔne de-ba to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo cheigi a taane dem. Ba nam yɔɔre ba ke lwarem mo ba chɔge amo yiga, ye ba kuri kolo a na vae to ba pa ba tete.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Abam balo na pae se Baŋa Wɛ taane dem sae á yera to, cheigi-na o kwora kam. Á chorro tem na chuli abam to mo pɛ se ba dole abam ba yage amo yere dem ŋwaane, ye ba daare ba tɛ ba we: “Pa-na se Baŋa Wɛ na zula, se dé wane dé na o na wó pa á wo pwoli tei to!” Ko nam ye banto mo lage ba di ba chaveera.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: Cheigi-na sɔɔ na zaŋe teo kom jei maama ne tei, se á wó ni sɔɔ na zege Wɛ diga kam seeni ko zaŋa! Ko nam ye Baŋa Wɛ kwori mo dɔna se o yiri jena o dona baŋa ne. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Kaane ta ná wo wowole de o puga, o wó lo bu na? O puga kam nam ná wo virigi ka ti, o wó wane bakeira o lo na?

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Yein-seeni mo abam nigi keim dento dwoŋi? Wɔ mo fɔge o ni wonnu tento ŋwa? Ba kwei dɛ dedwe ba lɔ teo ba zege na? Teo kɔ nam mo wó wane ko pɔpɔ ko taa wora? Zion teo kom nam nye de kaane wolo na virigi puga ye o lo o bia bam lela to mo.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na swoi Jerusalem teo kom to, tɔge-na de ko nɔn-bia bam maama se á ke wopwolo. Abam balo ya na ŋwane á pa-ko to, tiini á di-na ywoni teo kom yu-ywoŋo ŋwaane.

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, á wó tɔge Jerusalem ŋwaane á di ywoni dedɛ. Teo kom wó taa jege abam ko kɔna, nenɛɛne nu na kɔne o bia pa se ba ŋɔge yele ba sui tei to.

english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Á ma‑á ná nɛ we wonnu tento jege te ke, á wopwolo kom wó gaale. Á wó jwoori á na dam-doore, ne gaaro na kwi tei to. Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena bam laam maa wó lɔre jaja we, o seene o wo ba tei ne. O dona bam nam wó lɔre o ban-lom na wo ba baŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lage o kwei mini de se-zɔɔ mo, o ma o waare nabiina maama. Baŋa Wɛ maa wó tɔge ko baŋa ne o go nɔɔna dedɛ.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge balo na kwɛ ba tete ye ba daare ba pɛ da kwaga ba pu ba zoore tangwana wone ba zuli-ya to. Banto yeini ba di nɔna yalo na wo maŋe to, ne teira, de baywoa, de wo-zɔɔna tedwonna.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: A maŋe a yei ba keina de ba boboŋa maama na ye tei to mo. A nam lage a la logo baŋa teene dem de dwi tiina maama mo a ke daane, pa se ba ba ba na a nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei to.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: A maa wó kuri nɔɔna ba wone se ba taa ye kaanem tiina, se badwonna de taa ye Levi tiina na wó toŋe ba pa-ne to.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo na wó naane wɛyuu-doŋo kom de te-doŋa kam se te taa wora a yiga ne taa wuu to, konto dwoŋi mo abam bia bam de wó taa wora taa wuu, se á yere dem yé jei logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nabiina maama wó taa tui se ba zuli amo maŋa maama wone, chana de chana maama, de Wɛ siu dɛ maama wone de.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná maa nwoŋi pwooni, ba wó na balo na ve amo to na tega ye ba yera tigi pwola ne tei to. Toa kam na mu ba yera yam to bá na toone. Mini delo na jege-ba de zwɛ to de nam bá dwei. Ba wó taa ye wo-zɔɔna mo nabiina maama yiga ne.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Hilikia bu Jeremia ni taane mo tento. O déem nwoŋi Anatofe teo kolo na wo Benjamin laŋa kam ne to mo. O dwi tiina bam maa ye Wɛ kaanem tiina.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Bene delo Amon bu Josia déem na jege bena fuga-yatɔ Judah paare baŋa ne to, mo Baŋa Wɛ pɛ Jeremia kwora se o ta o bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Josia bu Jehoyakim de paare dim maŋa ne se ko taa vei o bu Zedekia na jege bena fuga-dedoa Judah paare baŋa ne to mo Baŋa Wɛ yeini o ŋɔɔne de Jeremia kuni dedɛ. Bene dem konto chane senu chana kam ne mo ba déem jaane Jerusalem tiina bam ba kale ba vo sa-teo yiga yiga. Wɛ kuri Jeremia se o taa toŋe o pa‑o

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Amo ma leiri‑o a we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo ta ye bu mo, ye a ni yeiri taane.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we, “Yé ta we, n ye bu. Nmo nam wó vo balo maama amo na wó toŋe‑m to tei mo, se n pa-ba ni delo maama amo na pɛ‑m se n ta de-ba to.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n fona de-ba, se amo wó taa wo n tei ne, se a jwoŋi‑m ba jeŋa ne a yage.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma twe o jeŋa o dwei amo ni, ye o daare o ta de amo o we, “Nii ywo! A taane dem mo tento a kwei a pa‑m se n ta‑n jege n ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma bwei-ne o we, “Jeremia, bɛ mo n nii n na?” Amo de ma leiri a we, “A nɛ Alimodi tio naga mo.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam maa we, “Nmo seene n na chekke! Amo de nam lage a nii mo se a taane dem ji chega lela.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma bwei-ne o we, “Bɛ mo nmo daa‑n nii n na?” A ma leiri‑o a we, “A nɛ kambia na mo na chora baŋa seeni, ye ka guni ka jeeri ywo-seeni.”

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: “A lage a bwoŋi baŋa seeni teene dem dwi tiina mo se ba maama ba ywo-seeni. Ba pwa bam lage ba ba ba jeini Jerusalem teo kom ni ne mo ba di paare. Ba maa wó ba ba gilimi Jerusalem de Judah teene dem maama ba pu, se ba daare ba di-de.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Jeremia, ti n yiga se n vo n ta de-ba kolo maama a na pɛ‑m ni se n ta to. Yé ta‑n fona de-ba. Ko ná dae konto, nmo ná yi ba tei, amo wó ke kolo na jege foone to n baŋa ne.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Banto maama wó taa dwoni dede‑m mo. Ba nam bá wane‑m kolokolo ba ke. Kokuri to, amo wo n tei ne se a jwoŋi‑m ba jeŋa ne a yage.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Ba maŋe ba wo bwei daane we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom nam bɛ? O déem jaane debam o nwoŋi Ejipti wone o daare o da debam yiga o ja o tɔge kagoa kam wone se dé kɛ. Ka maa ye te-kora na jege gwonnu, ye na tera ka wone to. Ka tɔgem tiini ka jege foone, ye nɔɔna ba zoore ka wone.’

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Abam teo kaanem tiina bam daa wo bwei daane we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom bɛ?’ Balo na jege amo nia yam ba bere nɔɔna to nam yeiri amo ni ne. Á yiga tiina bam ma lɔ amo kwaga ne. Ko ná ye amo sampwori sem, ba de yeini ba ma Baal yere ba pworisi mo, ye ba daare ba tɔge jwo-yɔɔro kwaga.

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Teo kolo wa ná maŋe ya ye kafɛ tei, ba wó ve-ya na? Nam nii! Amo nɔɔna bam dole amo ba yage, ye ba daare ba tɔge jwo-yɔɔro kwaga. Amo nam ye ba Nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo!

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam tusi belei mo ba daŋe ba yuu ne: Amo mo ye buli-yi delo na na pae ŋwea to, ye ba ve-ne. Ba ta ma lɛɛre ba mɔ kɔɔra se ba ke ba na ba wone, ye ba kɔɔra bam konto maŋe ba lɔ mo. Na bam nam ware kɔɔra bam konto wone se ba maŋe da kɔtaa!

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam dae kabɛ. Ba déem wo loge-ba kabɛɛne wone. Bɛ nam mo pɛ se ba dona wane ba ja-ba ba viiri?

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Chega to, Memfisi de Tapanahesi jar-keira mo tua ba cheeri á teo kom ba daare yu-kwolo ba tiŋi.

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: “Ko zege faŋa faŋa to mo á ywori amo chwoŋa kam ne. Á mɛ á kwaga á ya amo ye á we, á bá sɛ se á zuli-ne. Á ma kare zwonnu maama yuu ne se á zuli jwona, ye á daare á tigi teeni maama kuri ne á ke kabwoŋa kikia.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: “Bɛ mo ye á we, á wo biini á tete chullu tem seeni? Á wo zuli Baal jwona yam na? Nii-na lɛɛro telo á na ke bwollu tem tega ne to. Abam nye de kon-kana na lage se baara di-ka ye ka ke tei to mo. Ka ware ka tete se ka ja.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, yé ta‑á duri-na taa, se á napera peere ye na-nyɔm jege abam. Abam nam ve mo ye á we, ‘Yé kwaane se n che debam! Dé fera zo dwi-gɛ tiina wa yam mo. Dé wó yɔɔre dé da ya kwaga.’

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba zuli da-kwolo mo ye ba we, ‘Nmo ye amo kwo mo.’ Ba daa ta zuli kandwɛ ye ba we, ‘Nmo mo loge-ne.’ Ba ta ma pipiri ba lɔ amo kwaga ne, ye ba yiga tera amo wone. Cham laam ná yeini de yi-ba, ba duri ba tui ba keeri ba jare-ne se a jwoŋi-ba a yage.

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam, á jwona yam á na mɔɔne to nam bɛ? Pa-na se ya ba ya jwoŋi abam ya yage á cham maŋa ne! Á teo maama jege ko jwoni mo. Vwa mo na?

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: Abam jege-ne á bwɛ se bɛ mo? Ko nam ye abam mo ywori amo kwaga ne.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Abam zem nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane dem. O maa we: “Amo laam jigi kagoa mo a pa Isarele tiina bam na? A yage pa se lim mo gilimi-ba na? Bɛŋwaane mo a nɔɔna bam kare ba tɛ we, ‘De wó beeri dé vo dé na lage mɛ to mo, se de bá jwoori nmo tei’?

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: Abam tiini á lɔre chwei selo á na wó tɔge se á na bɔɔla dedɛ to. Ka-tole tete tui abam tei mo se á bere-ba!

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Abam gwaaro tem taŋe de nabwona jana mo, ye nɔɔna nae á na biini á tete tei to. Abam nam wo peere-ba ŋweene baŋa ne, ye ba jege bora. De ko maama de, abam nam ta tɛ á we,

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: ‘Debam wo ke dé chɔge mo. Wɛ zuri o bane o pa debam mo.’ Amo nam lage a waare abam mo, de á na kare á tɛ we ‘Debam seene dé wo tusi’ to.

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we: “Nɔɔno ná ve o kaane pa se kaane wom vo o zo baro wodwoŋi, kotu wó wane o jwoori o kwei kaane wom se o ji o kaane na? Keim dem konto bá chɔge tega kam mo na? Abam nam bwoori de bɔɔla dedɛ mo, ye á ta beeri chwoŋa se á jwoori amo tei.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: Kwoni-na á yuni se á nii zwonnu tem baŋa ne. Jeiga wora ye abam wo vei da se á ke kabwoŋa na? Abam vei á jei chwei sem maama ni ne mo á cheigi á bɔɔla bam, nenɛɛne venverena na jei kagoa yuu ne se ba zi nɔɔna tei to. Á kwei á lwarem de á kabwoŋa kikia mo á ma‑á chɔge tega kam.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nam a chege doa se ka yé ne, nenɛɛne ko ná ye duum doa de do-mimina de. Á yɔɔre á chɛ mo de á tolo kom, ye chaveera ba jege abam ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: you beg me to stop being angry, but you won't stop sinning. The Lord Asks Israel To Come Back to Him
translation_verse: Nmo bane bá tiini de zaŋe debam baŋa ne se ko dáane.’ Nam nii-na á na tɛ tei, ye á laam swoi lwarem kikia.” Isarele tiina jege se ba leiri ba wo Wɛ ŋwaane

english_verse: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
translation_verse: ye Isarele keim dem wo sage wonto de yera. A ma zeili Isarele se o viiri o daare amo o kabwoŋa kikia yam ŋwaane. Judah de nam yage amo mo, ye o nwoŋi o bwoora.

english_verse: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
translation_verse: O maŋe o wo nii o tolo kikia yam we ya jege chaveera ya pa‑o. O ma yage amo ye o daare o kare o zuli jwona yalo ba na kwei kandwa de dɛ ba ke-ya to. Konto baŋa ne o jege o tete dedaane amo tega kam mo o chɔga.

english_verse: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
translation_verse: Nam vei n yɔɔre tega-baŋa seeni n ta de Isarele tiina bam we: ‘Abam seene á ywori amo kwaga ne. Nam jwoori-na amo tei.’ Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. ‘Amo ye ŋwaŋa tu mo. A bane dem bá taa wo á baŋa ne taa wuu.’ Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo ye o we: “A bu-chechɔgero tem, amo mo tei abam. Nam jwoori-na amo tei! A lage a le abam dedoa dedoa á teo maama wone, se a daare a le balei balei sɔ-yuu maama wone, a ja-ba a jwoori Zion wone.

english_verse: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
translation_verse: A maa wó beeri yiga tiina balo na ke ba tɔge amo yiga to, se ba taa nii abam baŋa ne. Banto wó tɔge yeino de yi-poro baŋa ne mo ba woli abam lanyerane.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, ba wó taa bwoi Jerusalem teo kom we, Baŋa Wɛ paare yituŋu kom mo. Logo baŋa dwi maama tiina maa wó jeeri Jerusalem ne se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ yere dem. Ba daa bá tɔge ba wo-dɛɔ kom na lage puseŋa kikia yalo to.

english_verse: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná yi maŋa kam konto, Isarele dwi dem de Judah dwi dem wó ba ba ke daane se ba taa ye sɔŋɔ kodoo. Ba wó zege baŋa seeni teo kom ne ba jwoori ba zo tega kalo wone amo déem na pɛ ba nabaara bam se ba taa tei to.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Abam nam ba sɛa. Á bere á ba jege chega de amo, ne kaane wolo na yage o baro ye o daare o tɔge bɔɔla kwaga tei to mo.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
translation_verse: Keira zege zwonnu tem yuu ne ka tui ywo-seeni mo. Isarele tiina bam mo yɔɔre ba laare se ba na wolim. Banto nam mo ywori chwo-laaro wone ye ba daare ba swei ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ni ne.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: “Abam balo maama na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to, jwoori-na amo tei ne, se a wó yɔɔre abam a de chega chwoŋa wone.” “Dé wó seene dé jwoori nmo tei, Nmo na ye debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Ko nam na zege faŋa faŋa to, jwo-yɔɔro telo dé na zuli to mo chɔge dé wonnu. Te yɔɔre te chɔge wonnu telo maama dé nabaara bam na yaare ba na to mo. Ko ná ye dé vara de dé bia maama, dé gɛ-ba jwona kaanem baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we: “Isarele tiina bam, sɛ-na se á jwoori á ba amo tei. Dole-na wo-zɔɔna yalo á na zuli to á yage se á laam ba. Á nam ná tua, daa yé jwoori-na kwaga.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta tage tento mo de Jerusalem tiina, dedaane Judah tiina badaara bam: “Véi-na á kagwe sem wone se á chɛ-se. Nam yé kwei-na á wo-dwa bam á du á yage sabare wone.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
translation_verse: Kwɛ-na á tete dedaane amo Baŋa Wɛ, ne amo ni-gwonim dem na bere tei to. Abam Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam, kwɛ-na á bochara yam se ya taa tɔge amo boboŋa. translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na se amo na ke tei Siloo ne to, a ta wó ke konto mo amo tete diga kalo na wora a yere zula ŋwaane to baŋa ne. Ka ye diga kalo á na tiini á kwei á teena á daŋe ka baŋa ne to. A ya kwei-ka a pa abam de á nabaara bam mo. A nam wó chɔge-ka.

english_verse: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
translation_verse: Abam Judah tiina bam, a lage a le abam mo a dole a yage yiga yiga, nenɛɛne a déem na ke tei dedaane á chorro Efrayim tiina bam maama to.” Judah tiina bam na ve Baŋa Wɛ tei to

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Nam dole n yi se n na kolo ba na jege ba ke Jerusalem teo wone dedaane Judah teene dem maama wone to. N wo nɛ ba na ke tei to na?

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo we, “Mo kokuri amo wó tiini a lwo a ban-lom jei sem konto maama baŋa ne. Ko ná ye nabiina, de vara, de teeni, de wodiiru telo na ke tega kam baŋa ne to maama, te maama wó chɔge! Kolokolo bá che amo ban-lom dem.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento o we: “Á ná laga, ja-na á zwɛɛm pɛɛra yam, de á kaanem yadwonna yam á ba á di nɔna yam maama, se a yiga tera ya wone.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
