translation_verse: Amo déem na jaane á nabaara bam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne ye a daare a ŋɔɔne de-ba to, a wo pɛ-ba ni se ba kwei zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de kaanem dwi dwi ba pa-ne.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Amo déem na pɛ-ba ni delo to mo tento: ‘Ta‑á sɛ-na amo ni, se a taa ye abam Wɛ wom, se á de ta‑á ye amo nɔɔna. Ta‑á tɔge-na chwei selo a na tiŋi a pa abam to, se á ŋwea ke lanyerane ka pa abam.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Abam nabaara bam déem ma ve. Ba bere ba wo cheigi-ne de. Ba maa jege yi-dɛɛre ye ba tɔge keim-lwanno telo maama ba boboŋa na lage to. Ko ma pa se ba pipiri ba jwoori kwaga, ye ba ya maŋe se ba vo yiga mo.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Ko na zege abam nabaara bam déem na maŋe ba nwoŋi Ejipti ne to se ko yi zem, amo yeini a toŋe a sampwori sem mo á tei ne maŋa maama.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Nam vei n ta de-ba we, ‘Dwi dento tiina bam ba sɛ ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ni. Ba ve Wɛ koresem se ba wane ba leiri ba wo. Chega kam de ma jei ba tei ne, ye ba daa ba tɛ-ka.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, nam cheeri-na á yum, se á daare á dole á yu-ywei sem á yage. Ta diini-na peo yuu ne, á jeini da á leeni luseim lei. Kokuri abam ye dwi delo Baŋa Wɛ na ve to mo, o bane na tiini de zaŋe de abam to ŋwaane.’ ”

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Ba lɔge wara-jei bimbina mo ba zege Tofete ne na wo Ben-Hinom bwolo kom wone to. Ba maa yeini ba kwei ba bia ba zwɛ mini wone ba ke kaanem da. Amo nam wo fɔge a pa-ba ni se ba ke konto. Keim dem konto dwoŋi nam ya bere de tera a boboŋa ne.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we maŋa lage ka yi se nɔɔna daa yé taa bwoi jei sem konto we Tofete, naa Ben-Hinom bwolo kom. Ba laam wó taa bwoi-ko we ‘Ba-gwono bwolo’ mo. Kokuri, nɔɔna wó taa tigi Tofete ne se ba suli-ba, se ko dwoni pwola kalo na wó taa wora se ba suli-ba to.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Zuna de kago-vara mo wó ba ba di nɔɔna bam yera, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá daare se o zeili-te o yage.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se wopwolo de mwanno sɔɔ maama ti Jerusalem teo chwei sem ne, de Judah teene dem maama wone. Kadiri ywoni de daa bá taa wora. Kokuri to, abam tega kam laam lage ka ji di-dwonnu mo.”

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we: “Maŋa kam konto ne, ba wó jwoori ba ko Judah tiina pwa de ba nakwa bam yibeela ba le ba kwi. Ba ta wó ko ba le Wɛ kaanem tiina kwi, de Wɛ sampwori sem kwi, dedaane Jerusalem tiina bam maama kwi ba yibeela yam ne.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Ba kwi sem laam maa wó taa jare se tigi pwola ne se wea, de chana dedaane chalechwe sem mage-se. A nɔɔna bam nam ya swoi se ba taa zuli tento mo. Ba ma lwoori wolim te tei ne ye ba ke kaanem ba pa-te. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá suli ba kwi sem. Se wó taa tigi tega baŋa ne mo pare-pare, ne popɔnɔ tei.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Dwi-balɔrɔ tiina bam konto badaara nam wó wori. Amo nam ná pɛ se banto jage ba vo ba jeini sa-teo kolo maama ne, ba wó taa beeri toone da, se ko dwoni ba ŋwea.” Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. Wɛleere dedaane waarem taane

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: “Ta de nɔɔna bam we, Baŋa Wɛ mo tage o we: Ne nɔɔna ná yeini ba to tega ne, ba bá pɛ ba zaŋe se ba zege wɛɛne mo na? Nɔɔno nam ná ywori o chwoŋa ye o maane ko ni ne, kotu bá jwoori o pipiri o to chwoŋa ne mo na?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane mo a nɔɔna bam nwoŋi amo kwaga ne? Jerusalem tiina bam yɔɔre ba vae amo. Ba maa yeini ba gorege vwa mo, ye ba ve se ba pipiri ba jwoori amo tei.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Abam nam kare á tɛ nenɛɛne, ‘Debam yia poore! Dé jege Baŋa Wɛ nia yam dé tei ne!’ Ko nam na seene ko ye tei to, balo na jege abam ba bere to pipiri amo nia yam pa se ya ji vwa mo ya pa abam.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Á yi-pore-nyena bam konto lage ba ja ba nia mo, chaveera na wó ja-ba to ŋwaane. Chwoŋa bá taa wora se ba lu. Kokuri to, ba ve Baŋa Wɛ ni mo. Ba yi-poro kom nam bɛ?

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Ko ya maŋe se chaveera taa jege-ba ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam ŋwaane. Ko nam ba sae ba yera. Ba maŋe ba yeiri chaveera na ye kolo to. Konto ŋwaane, ba de wó to tega ne mo, nenɛɛne nɔɔna maama na toe tei to. Amo ná tu a waare-ba, ba kweelim jeiga mo konto.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: “Amo wó kwei ba faao wodiiru tem a ja viiri. Tio-bia daa bá daare ba Vini teeni dem yera ne. Mɔɔro de bá taa wo ba kaporro tem yuu ne. Teeni vɔɔro tem maama de maa wó kwaare. Kolo maama a ya na pɛ-ba to laam wó jei ba tei ne.” Nɔɔna bam maa we:

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Debam ya teene yazura mo, ye ko wo ke debam lanyerane. Dé ta maa beeri se dé na zurim, ye dé jwoori dé na vuvuga yerane.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: Debam dona bam sisein-nɔɔna napɔna kwori mo dɔne Dan teo ne yiga yiga. Ba sisei sem keira ma pa se Judah tiina bam yera sae. Dé dona bam beene se ba chɔge dé tega kam mo, de ka woŋo maama, dedaane Jerusalem teo kom, de ko nɔn-bia bam maama.”

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Nii-na ywo-seeni! A lage a toŋe basankwe mo se se ba á tetare ne. Se wó ba se done abam, ye á bá wane-se á che.” Jeremia keeri Judah tiina bam ŋwaane

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: Amo wo na jei tei to laam kɛ jaanem. A vɔna de ma pare.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Cheigi-na, se á wó ni a nɔɔna bam na keeri tei tega kam ni maama ne to. Ba maa we, “Baŋa Wɛ viiri o daare Zion mo na? Dé Pɛ wom daa tera mo na?” Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “A nɔɔna bam zuli jwona yalo ba jea na mɔɔne to, dedaane jwo-yɔɔro telo na ye dwi-gɛ tiina nyem to mo. Bɛŋwaane mo ba ke konto pa se a bane zaŋe de-ba?” Nɔɔna bam daa ma keeri ba we:

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: “Yadɛ de kwea maŋa tu te kɛ, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo jwoŋi debam o yage.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Ko tiini ko jege-ne ko ni de ko na nigi a nɔn-swonnu tem tei to. Lwia mo tiini ya jege-ne, ye a keeri dedɛ.

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Amo yuu ya ná wó wane ko ji vole, se a yia de ji buli-yia, amo ya wó keeri wea de tete maama, ba na go a nɔɔna balo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Amo ya wó lage jei kagoa yuu ne, mɛ chwo-veila na vei ba sii to a vo da. A laam maa wó vo dáa a daare a nɔɔna bam. Kokuri to, ba maama nwoŋi Wɛ kwaga ne, ye ba tɔge puseŋa kikia. Baŋa Wɛ na leiri Jeremia tei to

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: “Ne nɔɔna na saŋe tɛ tei to, konto mo a nɔɔna bam de ti ba yiga se ba taa fɔe vwa. Ba na kwaane se ba na dam tega kam ne tei to, ko dae chega mo ba tɔga, se vwa yerane mo. Ba maa toŋe lwarem ba daŋe da-baŋa ne, ye ba yiga tera de amo.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: A ná waare-ba ba kikia yam ŋwaane, ko dae ko chwoŋa ne mo na? Amo bá jwoori a ŋwe ba wɛleera jene, ba dwi dem na ye puseŋ-nyena to ŋwaane na?” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. Amo ma ta a we:

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: “Amo wó keeri peero tem ŋwaane mo. A maa wó chwoosi kagoa pwola kam ŋwaane, ka laam na jigi kapwor-pwoŋa to ŋwaane. Nɔɔna nam daa ware jei sem konto ne se ba tɔge ba kɛ. Naane daa tera dáane de keera. Zuna de vara dwi maama viiri ba daare jei sem konto.” Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: “Amo wó pa se Jerusalem ji di-dwoŋ-koro, se nywoŋ-kuri taa kare dáane se via. Amo ta wó pa se Judah teene dem taa ye yɔɔ yerane, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane de wone o zo.”

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: A nam ta wó jage-ba a yage sa-teene ne yiga yiga, mɛ ba de ba kwoa na wo nigi de ŋwa to! A ta wó toŋe jar-keira ba baŋa ne se ba ba ba zeili-ba taa, se ko yi ba maama chɔgem.” Jerusalem tiina keeri ba jare Baŋa Wɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: “Boŋe-na á nii kolo na jege ko ke to, se á daare á bwoŋi kaana balo na yei luseim mɔɔnem to se ba ba.” Amo maa we:

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Tɔ. Pa se ba ke lela ba ba ba leeni luseim lei, se se vaŋe debam dedɛ. Konto wó pa se debam yi-na tiini ba taa nwoŋa.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Jerusalem tiina bam yɔɔre ba keeri mo ye ba we, “Lɛɛro yi debam ywoo! Chaveera tiini ya ba debam baŋa ne! Dé jege se dé nwoŋi dé daare dé tega kam mo, dé sam dem maama na chɔge to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Kaana bam, nam cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane dem. Pa-na se o botara kam zo á boboŋa. Bere-na á bukwa de á badwonna ba na wó ke tei ba leeni luseim tento dwoŋi to:

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: “Toone laam dɔɔle dé takworru tem ne mo de zo dé sɔ-fwaaro tem wone. Ko ná ye dé bia ya na wo teo kom chwei sem ne ba kwɛɛre to, dedaane nɔn-donno telo na wo yaga kam ne to, toone go-ba mo.”

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ne se a ta kolo mo tento: “Twa wó taa tigi jase mo jei maama ne, nenɛɛne popɔnɔ na yeini ko tigi kare sem ne tei to. Ko ta wó taa nye de men-pwoa yalo nɔɔno na zage o tiŋi, ye nɔɔna tera se ba la-ya ba ke diga ne to mo.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Banto nam mo ye Ejipti tiina, de Judah tiina, de Edom tiina, de Amon tiina, de Moaba tiina, dedaane balo na cheeri ba yuni ye ba zoore kagoa yuu ne to. Kokuri banto maama ba tɔge pein-gwoŋa ni-sɛɛm delo amo na tiŋi to. Isarele dwi tiina bam de tete maŋe ba ba tɔge ni dem konto.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Abam yé lwoni-na dwi-gɛ tiina bam kikia. Yé nii-na wo-kenkagela yalo na wo wɛyuu ne to, se á pa se ya so abam, nenɛɛne dwi-gɛ tiina na yeini ba fone de-ya tei to.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó kwei sabu-seŋa de lu-nyenno ba ma fɔge-de ba kaare, ye ba daare ba ma chena ba mage-de ba ja daane, se de yé kwori de to yera yera.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Wa-yɔɔro tem konto nye de nabiinu nyenyego nɔɔno na kwei o chwi o kaduga ne, se o ma o saare zuna tei to mo. Ya ware ya ŋɔɔne. Ya maa ware ya vo ya tete ne. Nɔɔna jege se ba taa zeŋe-ya mo ba beera. Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑á fona de-ya. Ya bá wane abam ya chɔge, ya nam bá wane ya woli abam.”

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba yeigi lu-nyenno Tarasisi ne, ye ba ta yeigi sabu-seŋa Yupaza ne, se gwaro kwei-te ba ma ba kwɛ jwona yam. Ba ma daare ba gɔgere-ya de gare-yia yalo nyenyero na ye nazwon-pupwia, de nasoŋ-pupwia to. Nabiina ma swa mo ba mɔɔne-ya.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane nam, Baŋa Wɛ yerane mo ye Wɛ chekke! O maa ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom. O paare dem wora taa wuu. O bane nam ná zaŋe, tega baŋa maama ziziŋi mo. O ban-lom dem konto dwoi logo baŋa dwi maama jaanem.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Ta-na se ba lɔre ne Baŋa Wɛ mo we, “Ko dae abam wa yam mo naane wɛyuu dedaane tega baŋa. Ya nam wó jei tega baŋa ne, de wɛyuu maama ne.”

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Jwo-kaana bam maama jworim dem gaale mo, ye ba boboŋa tera. Chaveera wó ja gɔgɔ kolo maama na gɔgere jwona to, o jwona yam na ba jege ŋwea to ŋwaane. Ya ye wo-yɔɔro mo.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ya ba jege kuri. Ya maŋe se nɔɔna taa jege-ya ba mɔna mo. Ya waarem maŋa kam ná yia, ya maama wó chɔge mo fase.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Wolo Jakob dwi tiina bam na zuli to nam dae ne yanto na ye tei to. Wonto mo ye woŋo maama Naano wom. Isarele dwi tiina bam de ye balo o na kuri se ba taa ye wonto tete nyem to mo. O yere mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. Lɛɛro wó ba Jerusalem tiina baŋa ne

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Nam ke-na á zela á ke daane, se á duri á daare á teo kom, á dona na gilimi abam ba ke tetare ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wo a yuu ne! Nii ko na zoore a yera tei. A zonne dem ba tia! A ya boŋe we, “Jaweo mo jege-ne, a laam wó ba a wori.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Dé yiga tiina bam boboŋa tege mo. Ba ba bwei se ba lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa. Konto nam mo pɛ se ba zo gɛɛre wone, ye dé kɔgɔ kom maama de jage ko jei.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Konto to, Baŋa Wɛ, ta‑n jege-ne n koresa. Nam tɔge chega chwoŋa n korese-ne, se n ná dɛ n ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa n ke konto, a bá wori.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ba kɔre nmo to, de balo maama na ve nmo to, pa se n ban-lom dem to ba baŋa ne. Kokuri to, banto tiini ba chɔge debam Isarele tiina bam mo. Ba ma wane debam ba di ye ba daare ba pa se dé teo kom ji di-dwonnu ko zega.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Ta de-ba ne amo Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tage a we: Amo déem gwoni ni de á nabaara bam. A nam sɔɔle lwarem a yage wolo maama na ve se o ke de na bere tei to yuu ne mo.

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: A déem na jaane á nabaara bam a nwoŋi Ejipti ne ye a ke ni-gwonim delo de-ba to mo konto. Teo kom konto ya ye min-vogo yaara jei mo ko pa-ba. A déem tage de-ba a we, ‘Sɛ-na amo ni se á daare á ta‑á tɔge chullu telo maama a na pɛ abam to. Á ná ke konto, á wó ta‑á ye amo tete nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye abam Wɛ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we: “Vei n tɔɔle kwora kanto Jerusalem chwei sem ne de Judah teene dem maama wone se n ta we: Guli-na ni delo amo déem na gwoni to, se á ta‑á tɔge de na bere tei to.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Amo déem na yɔɔre a ja á nabaara bam á nwoŋi Ejipti ne to mo a maŋe a kaane-ba taa se ko yi zem. A maa yeini a ta de-ba a we, ‘Sɛ-na amo ni dem.’

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Ba nam wo sɛ. Ba bere ba wo cheigi-ne de. Ba maa jege yi-dɛɛre ye ba tɔge keim-lwanno telo maama ba boboŋa na lage to. Konto ŋwaane mo a nam pɛ se waarem delo maama ni-gwonim dem na bere to ba ba baŋa, ba na ve se ba tɔge ni delo amo na gwoni de-ba to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de amo o we: “Jerusalem teo kom tiina de Judah tiina bam maama mo ke ni daane se ba yé sɛ ba pa-ne.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne ye ba yɔɔre ba sɛ se ba ke ba nabaara wɛleera yam dwoŋi mo. Banto de déem ve se ba cheigi amo taane dem. Ba laam ma tɔge wa-yɔɔro kwaga se ba zuli-ya. Isarele dwi tiina bam, de Judah dwi tiina bam maama mo chɔge ni-gwonim delo amo na ke de ba nabaara bam to.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo we: ‘A lage a pa se chɔgem mo ba ba baŋa ne se ba yé lu. Ba nam ná kaase ba jare amo tei maama de, a bá cheigi ba keira kam.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Abam Judah dwi tiina bam, nii á kikia na ye tei! Abam teene dem na mae tei to, á jwona de ye konto mo. Bimbina yalo á na kaane Baal jwo-yɔɔ kom ya baŋa ne to de maa mae de chwei selo na wo Jerusalem teo kom wone to.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Jeremia, yé kwaane se n lwoori-ne n pa nɔɔna banto. Nam yé ŋwane a yiga ne ba ŋwaane, se ba cham maŋa ná yia, amo bá cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: A nɔn-swonno tem daa ba jege chwoŋa se ba jeeri a diga kam wone. Ba dedɛ mo ke puseŋa kikia. Á boŋe we, á ná sugi a yia de á vara kaanem dem, cham daa bá ba á baŋa ne mo na? Yé ta‑á jege-na wopwolo, se ko ba jege kuri.

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam ya pɛ se á nye de Olivi tio kolo na ke vɔɔro lanyerane ye ko tio-bia bam de tiini ba lana to mo. A nam wó bage mo ne do-fɔrɔ tei, ye a pa se mini ja tio kom konto de di. Ko nɛ sem maama de maa wó chochoge.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ déem mo jeiri abam á tega kam ne, ne tio tei to. Amo nam sɔɔle lwarem mo a yage á yuu ne. Kokuri to, Isarele dwi tiina de Judah dwi tiina bam maama pɛ se a bane zaŋe mo, de ba na zuli Baal jwoni dem to.” Nɔɔna na boŋe se ba go Jeremia tei to

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa se a yia puri se a wane a lɔre ko kuri. O ma pa se a taa yei nɔɔna bam keim-lwanno tem ni ne.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Anatofe teo tiina déem beeri amo mo se ba go, ye ba tɛ ba we a yé taa pworisi Baŋa Wɛ yere ŋwaane, se a ná ve, ba wó go-ne.

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tage ba taane o we, “Amo wó waare-ba mo. Ba nɔn-donno tem wó te jara wone mo, se kana laam go ba bia bam, bakeiri de busankane maama.

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ná yi se a waare Anatofe tiina bam, a laam wó pa se lɛɛro to ba baŋa ne, ye ba wolowolo bá daare.”

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo ná yeini a kwei taane a pa‑m, n yeini n nii de baŋa ne de chega mo. De ko de, a lage a bwei bwia nmo bora borem dem seeni. Bɛ mo tei pa se puseŋ-nyena vei yiga? Bɛŋwaane mo vwa-nyena ŋwea ke lanyerane?

english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Nmo jeiri-ba ne ba ye teeni mo tei. Ba ma ke bonno ye ba zege de dam, se ba daare ba taa leiri bia. Maŋa maama n taane wo ba nia ne. Ba bochara nam ba tɔge nmo.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Debam tega kam wó taa ye te-kora konto taa na? Nii gaaro na kwaare jei maama ne tei! Vara de zuna maama maa wora ba toa, dé nɔɔna bam puseŋa kikia ŋwaane. Ba nam ta jege ni mo ba tɛ ba we, “Baŋa Wɛ bá na kolo na lage ko ke debam to.” Baŋa Wɛ na leiri Jeremia tei to

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: “Nmo nam ná kwaane n duri n dwoni de nabiina n ga, n wó ke tetɛ mo n duri n dwoni de sisein-nɔɔna se n di? Nmo ná vei te-kampare baŋa ne n saare n toe, ko laam nam ná ye punnu na li mɛ Jɔdan buga kam ni ne to, ko bá ke dwono mo na?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Nmo tete chorro telo á na ye dwi daane to mo ba jege chega dede‑m. Ba maa chiŋi‑m ye ba bage ba yage wɛ-wɛ. Konto to, ba ná maŋe ba ŋɔɔne ni-som de nmo, yé kwei n chega n pa-ba.

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó nwoŋi a tete dwi tiina bam kwaga ne. A yiga daa bá taa wo nɔɔna balo na ye a nyem to wone. Ko ye balo a na tiini a swoi to mo a lage a kwei-ba a ke ba dona bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: Amo laam pɛ se a tete nɔɔna bam ji nenɛɛne kalwoŋo na ye tei, ye duura gilimi-ko ba zɔge to mo. Nam bwoŋi kago-vara bam se ba de ba ba di ba su ba boboŋa.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Yiga tiina dedɛ mo wó ba se ba nɔ ba chɔge te-ywoŋa kalo a na jeiri a nɔɔna bam ka wone to. Ba nam wó pa se a te-ywoŋa kam konto laam ji kagoa.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna bam ná dugi mena, ba wó jwoori ba gwei men-kayale mo. Ba maa wó yaare de totoŋ-chɛɛre ye ba bá na nyɔɔre ba totoŋa baŋa ne. Chaveera wó ja-ba de ba na wó zage wodiu fenfee kolo to. Kokuri to, amo ban-lom mo zaŋe ba baŋa ne.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Ko ná ye teene delo maama na gilimi tega kalo a na kwei a pa a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam se ba taa tei ye ba boŋe se ba chɔge-ka to, amo lage a gɔ-ba ba jei sem ne a dole a yage mo. A laam maa wó le Judah dwi tiina bam ba wone a jwoŋi a yage.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe se ba zamese amo tete nɔɔna bam chwei sem se ba tɔge-se. Ba déem soge amo nɔɔna bam pa se ba ma Baal yere ba du duuri. Ba laam jege se ba ma amo yere dem mo ba du duuri, ye ba we, ‘Ne Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ná sɛ.’ Ba ná ke konto maama, ba de wó wane ba na jeiŋa jei amo nɔɔna bam wone.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ko daare, teo kolo maama ná ve amo ni, amo wó yɔɔre a gɔ-ba mo a yage, se a daare a chɔge-ba fase!” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Véi n yeigi jɔgɔ kolo ba na mɛ gare-fefale ba sɔ to, se n daare n vɔ-ko n teiŋa ne. Nam yé pa se na dwei-ko.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Amo de ma vo a ke tei Baŋa Wɛ na bere-ne se a ke to, ye a vɔ-ko a teiŋa ne.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Kwei jɔgɔ kom na vɔge n teiŋa ne to n ja n vo Perata, se n beeri peo gugworo n kwei-ko n seigi ko wone.”

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: A ma seene a jwoori Perata, ye a vo a ko a le jɔgɔ kom ko seigim jeiga kam ne. A na nii to, de ko pɔge mo. Ko daa ba jege totoŋe.

english_verse: Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we,

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: A lage a chɔge wonnu telo Jerusalem tiina de Judah dwi tiina bam maama na mage ba nyɔɔna te baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Puseŋ-nyena bam konto yɔɔre ba ve se ba cheigi amo taane mo. Ba ma ke wo-dɛɔ ba beeri wa-yɔɔro se ba zuli. Amo nam ná waare-ba a ti, ba de wó ji nenɛɛne jɔgɔ konto na ye tei ye ko daa ba jege kuri to mo.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amo ya le Isarele dwi tiina bam de Judah dwi tiina bam maama se ba sale amo yera ne, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na wó vɔ jɔgɔ o teiŋa ne tei to mo. A kuri-ba se ba taa zuli-ne mo, se a na yere. Ba nam ve-ne mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.” Sana kɔɔra memaŋe

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de Isarele tiina bam to mo tento: ‘Abam sana kɔɔra bam maama ye se á lɛɛre-ba á su de sana mo!’ Ba wó jwoori ba leiri‑m ba ta we, ‘Debam maŋe dé yei we, dé jege se dé lɛɛre dé sana kɔɔra bam maama dé su de sana mo.’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Ba ná tage konto, se n leiri-ba n ta we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we: Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Judah laŋa kam ne to nyɔ sana ba su pa se ba bugi. A lage a ke konto a waare pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to, de kaanem tiina bam, de sampwori sem, de Jerusalem tiina bam maama mo.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: A laam maa wó kwei-ba a mage daane se ba chochoge ne kɔɔra mo tei. Ko ná ye ba nɔn-kwe de ba bia bam, ba maama wó na chɔgem. A nam bá duri ba ŋwaŋa naa a leiri a boboŋa kɔtaa! A lage a waare-ba mo.’ Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.” Jeremia kaane nɔɔna bam de ba kamunim dem

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Cheigi-na se á ni kolo Baŋa Wɛ na tage de abam to. Yé ta‑á jege-na kamunim.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: “Kwei amo ni n vo n pa pɛ wom de o nu wom we, ‘Zaŋe-na á paare yitunnu tem ne á tu tega ne. Kokuri to, abam paare yipwi sem lage se dɔne á yuni ne se to tega ne mo.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: Jerusalem tiina bam, kwoni-na á nii jar-keira balo na nwoŋi baŋa seeni ba beene á baŋa ne to. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo Wɛ na ke n jeŋa ne se n ta‑n nii-ba to nam bɛ? Á déem nam tiini á jege teera ba baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa se á na di badwoŋo de balo to jwoori ba di dam mo abam baŋa ne. Ko laam wó taa ye tetɛ mo á yera ne? Ko bá tiini ko ni abam, ne kaane na virigi puga se o lo ye ko ni‑o tei to mo na?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Nmo nam wae n bwei n tete ne we, “Bɛ mo pɛ se tento maama yi-ne?” Ko ye n wɛleera yam na gaale to ŋwaane mo. Mo kokuri n gwaaro kaare te daare‑m ye nɔɔna zi‑m ba chɔge.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Nɔn-zwono wó wane o leiri o ye-daa se ka peere na? Gweeru de nam wó wane o zare o yera se ya daa yé popore na? Abam de bá wane á leiri á wo se á ta‑á ke wo-laaro, á na yɔɔre á me de lwarem kikia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo nam lage a pa se á jage mo, nenɛɛne vio na nwoŋi kagoa ne ko kale weero ko ja jei tei to.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Amo boboŋa jaane se a ke konto mo á yera ne. Ko nam wó seene ko ke. Kokuri to, abam swei amo swia mo, ye á daare á tɔge jwo-yɔɔro kwaga.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa á tiini á di á chaveera nenɛɛne ba na le kaane gwaaro ba daare‑o de kuri-nɔrɔ tei to.

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia kwora kalo da-kore seeni to mo tento:

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Naduna bam toŋe ba kabɛ, se ba vo ba beeri na ba ba ba pa-ba. Kabɛ sem ná yi buli selo maama, se yeini se ko mo ye na tera. Ba laam maa wó zeŋe ba kɔɔra bam ba jwoori sɔŋɔ de je-kore, ye wo-chechɔgɔ de chaveera yerane jege-ba.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Doa daa ba nena, pa se tega kam maama bage lolwe. Mo kokuri vala bam vɔna pare. Ba maa vɔ ba je ba yum ne.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Woŋa mo loge ka bu pwola ne, ye ka duri ka daare‑o, gaao na tera jei jei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Bonɛ laam zege zwonnu tem yuni ne mo, se sii se dwoi nenɛɛne nywoŋ-kuri na sii tei to. Se yɔɔre se leesi jei maama se nii mo, se gaao ná zege ko wo jei selo ne. Wodiu nam tera se se di.” Nɔɔna bam maa tɛ ba we:

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: N ke ne n ye nabwom mo, naa babea kalo na ware ka nɔɔna se ka jwoŋi ka yage to. Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam wo debam tei ne mo. Dé yɔɔre dé ye n tete nɔɔna mo chekke. Nam yé viiri n daare debam!”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri o ta nɔɔna bam taane o we: “Ba swoi se ba taa kare jei maama ne mo ba beera. Ba ba jaane ba tete se ba maŋe amo tei ne. Konto ŋwaane amo yi daa ba sui ba kikia yam. Amo laam wó guli ba wɛleera de ba lwarem kikia, se a waare-ba ya ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we: “Yé lwoori amo se a pa nɔɔna banto jwoori ba na lam.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Ba ná maŋe ba vɔ ba nia se ba kaase ba jare-ne de, amo bá cheigi ba wɛ-lworo kom. Ba nam ná ke zwɛɛm pɛɛra de wodiiru pɛɛra se ba pa-ne de, a bá jwoŋi-te. A lage a pa se ba te jara wone mo, se jawe-chɛɛro de kana de ja-ba te go.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Amo de ma leiri a we: “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo sampwori sem yeini se ta de-ba se we, ‘Wonnu maama wó ke lam te pa abam. Á bá zo jara wone. Kana de nam bá ja abam, se yazura yerane mo wó taa wora.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma leiri-ne o we: “Sampwori sem konto tɔge amo yere baŋa mo se fɔe vwa yerane. Amo wo tiŋi-ba se ba taa ye a sampwori. A nam wo toŋe-ba a nɔɔna bam tei ne. Amo maŋe a wo pɛ-ba a kwora. Ba yi-nɛɛre totoŋa de veera yalo ba na jege ba tɛ ba bere abam to maama ba jege kuri. Ko ye ba tete boboŋa mo gane-ba pa se ba ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo: Ko nam ná ye sampwori selo amo na wo toŋe-ba ye ba jege amo yere ba fɔe vwa we jara de kana bá ba á teo kom ne to, amo wó pa se banto tete te jara wone, ye kana de go-ba.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma pa-ne ni se a vo a ta de nɔɔna bam we: “Wea de tete maama wone a yia su de yi-na mo. A keira kam bá wane ka kwori. Ko nam ye amo nɔn-swonnu tem ŋwaane mo. Ba tiini ba na zonne, ye de zo ba yera lanyerane.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: A ná nwoŋi a vo pwola ne, a yɔɔre a nae nɔɔna mo na tege jara wone ye ba tigi jei maama. Amo nam ná zo teo kom wone de, a nae nɔɔna mo kana na jege-ba ka goe. Sampwori sem de kaanem tiina bam maa kare jei maama ne mo ba toŋa. Ba nam yeiri ba na jege kolo ba toŋe to.” Nɔɔna bam na lwoori Baŋa Wɛ tei to

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Nmo tete yere dem ŋwaane, yé nwoŋi debam kwaga ne. Yé yaale n tete teo kom mɛ n na di paare to. Nam yé yiri ni delo n déem na gwoni de debam to.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina jwona yam wae ya pae doa nena na? Doa nam zege wɛyuu ne ka nene ka tete ne na? Chega to, debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ko ye nmo yerane mo wae konto n ke. Mo kokuri, dé teena tigi nmo baŋa ne.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we: “Moses de Samuwel tete ya ná tu se ba lwoori-ne, a bá duri nɔɔna banto ŋwaŋa. Pa se ba lage jei da a yiga ne, se a daa yé taa na-ba!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná bwei‑m ba we, ‘Dé nam véi yein-seeni?’ se n ta de-ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Balo na ye se ba te to wó te mo. Balo maa na ye se ba te jara wone to wó te jara wone. Balo de na ye se kana go-ba to, kana wó go-ba mo. Balo maa na ye se ba kale to, ba wó kale-ba ba vo sa-teo mo.’ ”

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “A nam lage a toŋe lɛɛro dwi dwi kuni bena mo ba baŋa ne. Se-zɔɔro wó go-ba jara wone. Kukuri maa wó tuuri ba yera yam se ja se kɛ. Duura de wó ba ba zɔge ba yera, ye kago-vara laam di ba yera yalo ta na daare to nyelamm.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Amo lage a pa se ba ji wo-zɔɔna mo logo baŋa teene maama yiga ne, Judah teo pɛ Hezekia bu Manasɛ na toŋe kolo Jerusalem wone to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we: “Jerusalem tiina bam, wɔ nam mo wó ŋwane o pa abam? Wɔ mo lage o keeri o pa abam? Wɔ mo wó zege se o ware abam? Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera!

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Abam yɔɔre á ve amo mo, ye á nwoŋi a kwaga ne kuni dedɛ. Konto ŋwaane, amo tete mo lage a twe a jeŋa a gorege abam a ja a chɔge. Amo daa bá duri abam yibwona kɔtaa!”

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Kaane wolo na loge bia barepɛ to wó beiri, ye o bochɔŋɔ fwei, ba maama na tege to ŋwaane. Ko nye de wea tetare ne mo wɛ zo de pa wonto. Chaveera maa jege‑o, o na tu o ga o bia bam to ŋwaane. Ko ná ye balo ta na daare to, amo wó pa se ba dona go-ba jara wone.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. Jeremia poone Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: A nu, lɛɛro mo jege-ne! Bɛŋwaane mo n loge-ne? Mɛ maama a ná via, nɔɔna yɔɔre ba chuli-ne mo. Amo wo vei a jene woŋo nɔɔno tei ne, a nam wo jene woŋo a pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno. De ko de, nɔɔna maama done-ne mo.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Amo nam lage a jwoŋi nmo se ko ke lanyerane ko pa‑m mo. Cham dedaane vuvuga ná tu ya daane n dona, ba laam wó ba ba lwoori wolim n tei ne.

english_verse: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
translation_verse: Abam nye de luuru telo na gwaane de channa to. Á bá wane á bwori luuru telo na nwoŋi baŋa seeni to.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se á dona kwei abam ba ja ba vo sa-teo kolo á ya na yeiri ko ni ne to, se á ji ba kabɛ dáane. Kokuri to, a ban-lom dem nye de mini na lage de di abam kula tei to mo!” Amo maa we:

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo maŋe n yei a na yaare tei maama to. Guli amo gula se n ta‑n nii amo baŋa ne. Nam pa se ko zo balo na chuli-ne to yera! Yé duri ba yibwona se n pa ba na chwoŋa ba go-ne. Ko ye nmo ŋwaane mo a nɛ yaara ba tei ne.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane nam mo ye amo yaara yam ba fɔge ya tia? Bɛ mo ke ye a zonne dem de ba fɔge de tia? Nmo na woli amo tei to nye de nabara na we te-pwoŋa ne, de buli-yi na yeini de ko tei to mo.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ tage tento: “Nmo ná yage n ta-yɔɔro tem konto, ye n jwoori n ba amo tei, a laam wó pa se n jwoori n zege chekke se n ta‑n toŋe n pa-ne. Nmo ná ŋɔɔne taane delo na jege kuri to, n wó ta‑n ye a ni-jwoŋinu. Nɔɔna bam laam maa wó ba ba tɔge nmo kwaga. Ko dae se n ta‑n tɔge banto kwaga.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amo wó jwoŋi‑m a yage nankɔ-nyena bam jeŋa ne, se ba yé wane‑m ba ke lwarem.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma pa amo ni ye o we:

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Yé di bukɔ n ma‑n ji n kaane, naa n lo bia teo konto ne.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Jawe-chɛɛro mo lage te ja-ba se ba te. Ba bá na nɔɔna se ba keeri ba lwi, naa balo na wó suli-ba to. Ba yera wó taa tigi tega baŋa ne, ne popɔnɔ mo tei. Jara wone mo ba lage ba te, se kana de go-ba. Ba yera yam maa wó ji wodiiru ya pa zuna de kago-vara.”

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Jeremia, yé vei n zo ba lwi wone se n da n keeri de-ba. Kokuri to, amo yiri a swolim de a swono kom ba tei ne, ye a daa bá duri ba yibwona.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Naduna de nabwona maama wó te tega kanto wone mo. Ba nam bá na nɔɔna se ba suli-ba, naa se ba keeri ba lwi. Ba bá gwe ba yera yam, naa ba cheeri ba yuni lwi sem ŋwaane.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa bá toŋe wodiu se ko vo lwi sem na wo mɛ to. Ko ná maŋe ko ye nɔɔno nu de o kwo lua de, nɔɔna bá vo ba yi kotu yera se ba weeri o yi-na.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Nam yé zo sɔŋɔ kolo wone ba na di wodi-fɔrɔ kɛɛla-kɛɛla to. Yé woli ba wone se n ta‑n di ye n nyɔa.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná vei n ta wonnu tem konto maama n bere nɔɔna bam, ba wó bwei‑m we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ ke se chanɛɛre dento ba debam baŋa ne? Bɛ mo dé ke dé tusi? Dé chɔge dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga tetɛ seeni mo?’

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Laam ta de-ba we, ‘Á nabaara bam na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane mo a ke konto. Ba ma kuri se ba tɔge wa-yɔɔro ye ba zuli-ya. Ba yɔɔre ba ve-ne mo ye ba wo sɛ a nia yam.

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: Abam keim-lwanno nam bere ya dwoi á nabaara bam na ke tei to! Á yɔɔre á ke á tɔge á wo-dɛɔ kom na lage puseŋa kikia yalo to mo, ye á ba cheigi amo taane.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a lage a le abam mo tega kanto ne, se a daare a dole abam a yage sa-teo ne yiga yiga, mɛ abam de á nabaara bam ya na yeiri ko ni ne to. Abam laam ná wo jei sem konto ne, á wó ta‑á zuli á wa-yɔɔro tem maŋa maama, wea de tete. Amo nam bá duri á ŋwaŋa kɔtaa.’ ” Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta o we:

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se balo ná lage ba du duuri, ba daa yé ta we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi debam Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to yere dem.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó taa tɛ we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom ne, dedaane jei selo maama o na jage-ba to yere dem mo.’ Kokuri to amo wó seene a ja-ba a ba se ba jwoori ba taa jei tega kalo wone a na pɛ ba nabaara se ba taa tei to.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a yere-ba mo jei maama wone. Ba bá wane ba seigi amo yiga ne. A maa nae wɛleera yalo ba na jege ba ke to.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Amo nam wó jwoori a ŋwe ba wɛleera de ba puseŋa kikia jene kuni belei. Kokuri to, ba chɔge amo tega kanto mo de ba jwona yalo na ba jege ŋwea ye a yɔɔre a chuli-ya to. Ba ta ma su a tete tega kam konto de ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam.” Amo maa we:

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ye amo dam de a dalem jei. Cham ná lage de yi-ne, a yeini a duri a seigi nmo woro wone mo. Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama nam wó ba nmo tei se ba zuli nmo. Ba maa wó zege tega baŋa jei maama ne ba ba ba ta we, “Dé nabaara déem jege wa-yɔɔro mo ba zula. Yanto nam wo wane-ba ya woli.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Amo laam nam wó yɔɔre a pa se ba lɔre a dam dem na mae tei to. Konto laam mo wó pa se ba taa yei we amo yere mo ye Taa-wuu Baŋa Wɛ wom.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: “Judah tiina bam yɔɔre ba me de ba wɛleera, nenɛɛne nɔɔno mo kwei luu o sare-ya o tiŋi ba bochara ne. Ko ta nye nenɛɛne ba kwei kandwɛ-fole mo ba popone-ya ba tiŋi ba bimbina yam nyea ne.

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: Ba bia de yeini ba boŋe ba jwona bimbina yam de ba Asera nyenyego dɛ sem boboŋa mo. Ba ke wonnu tem konto se ba taa maa zula ba jwona yam teeni maama kuri ne, de zwonnu tem maama yuu ne,

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Ba nye de tio kolo na zege ko bwola de buga ni, ye ko bonno zo tega lanyerane te yi na chekke to mo. Wulim wɛ ná yia, ko bá kɔre foone. Da-kore ná maŋe ko ba, ko ta jege vɔ-lɛɛro maŋa maama, ye ko yɔɔre ko leiri bia mo.

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Nabiinu bochare mo ba jege chega de dwoi woŋo maama. De tiini de chɔge mo, ye nɔɔna ware-de se ba yɔɔre. Wɔ mo wae-de o lɔre o tia?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam yɛ nabiinu maama boboŋa. A maa faŋe ba bochara a nia. A maa pae nɔɔna maama ba kikia ŋweero, se ko maŋe de chwoŋa kalo ba na tɔge to.

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná pini o dwonna se o ma o duni, ko nye de luga na vwɛ chechara yalo ka na wo de to baŋa ne se ka lwei-ya tei to mo. O nɔn-donne maŋa ne mo o jejegero tem wó ti. Kotu laam maa wó ba o kweeli ne nɔn-jworo na kweeli tei to.” Jeremia wɛ-lworo

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Ko na zege faŋa faŋa to, Baŋa Wɛ paare jeiŋa jei sem debam na zuli‑o da to zeiŋi wɛɛne de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ mo.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, yɔɔre-ne se a seene a na yazura. Jwoŋi-ne n yage, se a seene a zo n woro wone. Kokuri to, nmo mo amo yɔɔre a seina.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Nii mo! Nɔɔna mo tɛ de amo ba we, “Kolokolo ta wo ke debam. Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam nam bɛ? Pa se ka ji chega se dé nii!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: A wo yage totoŋe delo n na kwei n pa-ne se a ta nii n nɔɔna bam to. A nam ba kare a beeri ba chɔgem. Nmo yɔɔre n yei a na ye tei to, de kwora kalo a na jege a ŋɔɔne to.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Yé pa se foone ja-ne. Cham ná lage de yi amo, nmo mo ye amo dalem jei.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Pa se balo na chuli-ne to di chaveera. Nam che amo se a yé na a chaveera. Pa se banto vɔna pare ye ko dae amo. Pa se lɛɛro yi banto se ba tiini ba na chɔgem dedɛ. Wɛ siu dɛ taane

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: Laam ta de Judah tiina pwa bam de ba nɔn-bia bam, de balo maama na zoore Jerusalem teo ne ye ba yeini ba tɔge nia yam konto ba kɛ to we, ‘Cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kanto!

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: Nam ta‑á yei-na se á sɛ amo ni. Yé ta‑á zeŋe-na zela á tɔge teo kom manchwo-nia yam á zo ko wo siu dɛ dem ne. Pɔɔre-na dɛ dem konto á pa amo se á yé toŋe de wone.

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Abam ná ke konto, á teo kom pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to wó taa wora mo taa ye ba tɔge nia yanto wone ba kɛa. Ba nakwa bam de wó taa tɔge ba kwaga. Pwa bam konto dedaane Jerusalem teo kom tiina de Judah tiina bam maama wó yeini ba di sisei-torokooro de sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne ba tɔge manchwo-nia yam konto ba kɛ. Teo kom tete de maa wó taa sui de nɔɔna taa wuu.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna de wó nwoŋi Judah teene dem maama wone, de Jerusalem nawuura yam wone, de Benjamin laŋa kam ne, de wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne, de zwonnu laŋa kam seeni, de tega-kuri kagoa kam seeni, ba zo Jerusalem teo kom wo. Ba laam maa wó taa jaane zwɛɛm pɛɛra, de wodiu pɛɛra, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa, dedaane lei keim pɛɛra ba tui ba kaane ba pae Baŋa Wɛ o wara-jei sem ne.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Ko daare, abam ná wo sɛ se á cheigi a kwora kam, ye á ve se á pɔɔre Wɛ siu dɛ dem á pa‑o pa se á jaane zela á tɔge manchwo-nia yam á zoore teo kom wo siu dɛ dem ne, nam lɔre-na we, amo wó tɔre mini se de ja manchwo-nia yam. De laam maa wó lɔgese de ja á sɔ-fwaaro tem de di kula. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane-de se o dwei.’ ”

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Nam zaŋe n vo kamɔ-mɔro wom sɔŋɔ. N ná yi da, amo wó pa‑m a kwora.”

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: O ná mɔɔne kamɔgɔ kolo, ye ko ná wo dɛ chwoŋa lanyerane, o laam wó jwoori o fɔge o mɔ dɔgɔ kom se ko ji kamɔgɔ kodwoŋi, ne o boboŋa yam na tɔge tei to.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma pa amo ni dento o we:

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: Ba nam wó leiri ba ta we, ‘Yé ta‑n jege n tete n yaara, se dé lage dé taa ke dé zwabania kikia yam mo, ne dé boboŋa na lage tei to.’ ”

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Vei n bwei dwi-gɛ tiina bam se n nii, nɔɔno wora o na nigi woŋo konto dwoŋi ŋwa na? Isarele dwi dem ya nye de bukɔ-pwola mo. Ba laam ke kolo na tiini ko ye wo-zɔɔne to.

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo tete nɔɔna bam, ba yɔɔre ba swei amo ni ne mo. Ba maa ke kaanem ba zwɛ ba pae jwo-yɔɔro. Jwona yam konto ma soge-ba pa se ba ywori chwo-laaro tem ne. Ba ma yage ba nabaara chwei sem déem na ye tei to. Ba ma lɛɛre ba tɔge chwo-memene selo na wo kwɛ to.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ne vio kolo na nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni ye ko kale fwogo ko ja jei tei to, mo a lage a pa a nɔɔna bam de jage ba dona yiga ne. A nam wó ma a kwaga a ya-ba mo. Lɛɛro ná to ba baŋa ne, a yiga bá taa wo ba wone.” Ba na boŋe se ba chɔge Jeremia tei to

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam badwonna ma ta ba we, “Pa-na se dé ke ni daane se dé lɔre dé na wó ke tei dé chɔge Jeremia to. Wɛ kaanem tiina ta wó taa wora se ba bere debam Wɛ nia yam. Yi-pore-nyena de wó taa wora se ba zamese debam. Wɛ sampwori de wó pa se dé ni Wɛ kwora kam. Nam pa-na se dé ba bebara dé daŋe o baŋa ne. Dé daa bá taa cheigi o ni taane.” Amo ma lwoori Wɛ a we:

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: “Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, cheigi-ne! Nii a sebanyena banto na tɛ amo taane tei!

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Ko lana se nɔɔno kwei lwarem o jwoori o ŋwe lanyerane keim na? Banto nam yɔɔre ba gwaare gwoŋo mo se amo to ko wone. Guli amo déem na tiini a lwoori‑m tei ba fɔgem ŋwaane to. A ma zege nmo yiga ne ye a lwoori‑m se n zuri n bane de-ba.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Laam nam pa se kana ni ba bia. Dole-ba n yage se ba te jara wone. Pa se ba kaana ga ba bia, ye ba daare ba ji kadeina. Ta pa se jawe-chɛɛro go ba nɔn-kweero tem, se ba nɔn-donno de te jara-keim baŋa ne.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Pa se keira zaŋe ba sam dem wone bugi-bugi, ba dona mo na pɔpɔ ba zaŋe ba baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, ba koge gwoŋo mo ba tiŋi se amo to da, ye ba daare ba che kalanchorro jei maama se te ja-ne.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma ta de amo o we, “Vei kamɔ-mɔro tei n yeigi kikeira, se n daare n bwoŋi Isarele nakwa bam badaara de kaanem yiga tiina bam badwonna,

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Ta de-ba ne, ‘Judah tiina pwa bam, de Jerusalem teo nɔɔna bam, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento: Cheigi-na! Amo lage a pa se lɛɛro mo tiini te ba teo konto baŋa. Ko ta wó pa se balo maama ná nigi ko ŋwa, se ba nia mɔɔre.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Ba ta lɔge bimbina mo se ba ma ba zuli Baal jwoni dem, ye ba laam kwei ba bia ba zwɛ mini wone ba ke kaanem ba pa-de. Amo nam wo fɔge a pa-ba ni naa a ta de-ba se ba ke konto. Keim dem konto dwoŋi nam ya bere de tera a boboŋa ne.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we maŋa beene se nɔɔna daa yé taa bwoi jei sento we Tofete, naa Ben-Hinom bwolo kom. Ba laam wó taa bwoi-ko we “Ba-gwono bwolo” mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, a lage a pa se Jerusalem teo tiina de Judah tiina bam maama boboŋa ji kafɛ mo. Amo wó yage se ba dona wane-ba ba di ye ba daare ba go-ba. Ba twa wó taa tigi jei maama ne, se zuna de kago-vara taa tui ba di.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge Jerusalem teo kom. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ko ba yaala. Balo maama ná tɔge ko jei ne ba kɛ, ko wó ke-ba yaau ye ba yaale-ko ko chanɛɛre dem ŋwaane.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Jerusalem dona bam wó kaare teo kom ba pu se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lu ko wone. Teo kom nɔɔna bam laam wó di ba dwonna ya-nɔna, ba dona bam na tiini ba peene-ba ye wodiu tera se ba di to ŋwaane. Ba bere ba wó di ba tete bia ya-nɔna de.’ ” Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “Laam kwei kikeira kam n de n chochoge se nɔɔna balo na tɔge dede‑m ba nwoŋi teo kom wone to taa zege ba nia.

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: Ta de-ba we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a chochoge te-fɔrɔ konto, de ko nɔn-bia bam, ne kikeira kanto na chochoge tei to mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane-ko o la o ke daane. Nɔɔna wó taa tigi Tofete ne se ba suli-ba, se ko dwoni pwola kalo na wó taa wora se ba suli-ba to.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: A nam wó pa se Jerusalem sam dem de Judah pwa bam sɔ-fwaaro tem maama de chɔge, ne Tofete na biini de twa tei to. Kokuri to ba yeini ba di sam dem konto nayuni ne mo, ye ba zwɛ wonnu ba ma ke kaanem ba pa chalechwe, ne se ga ye wa mo to. Ba ta ma kwei sana pɛɛra ba pa wa yadwonna.’ ” Jeremia daa na ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora tei to

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Jeremia ma zege Tofete ne o jwoori o zo teo kom wone. Baŋa Wɛ nam ya toŋe‑o Tofete ne se o pworisi o kwora mo. O laam ma vo o zege Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei konkɔlɔ kom ne, ye o ta de nɔɔna bam maama o we,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo tage tento: Amo seene a lage a pa se lɛɛro mo ba teo konto baŋa, de ko nawuura yam baŋa, ne a na pwooli we a wó ke tei maama to. Ko nam ye ba na se ba zwa, ye ba ve se ba cheigi amo taane dem to ŋwaane mo a lage a ke-ba konto.”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Yimera bu Pasura déem mo ye kaanem tu wolo na nii Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem totoŋa yam baŋa ne to. O ma ni Jeremia na pworisi o pa Jerusalem tei to.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Pasura ma pa se ba bwoli‑o ba yage. Jeremia ma ta o bere‑o o we, “Baŋa Wɛ laam leiri n yere dem mo. De daa dae ‘Pasura’. De laam wó taa ye ‘Ba fugi-ne jei maama ne’ mo.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo wó pa se á dona ba ba fugi nmo de n badwonna bam maama. Nmo wó ta‑n zege n nii mo ye á dona bam go-ba de se-zɔɔro. A nam ta wó kwei Judah tiina bam maama a ke Babilon teo pɛ wom jeŋa ne, se o kale-ba o ja o vo Babilon, naa o go-ba jara-keim baŋa ne.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nmo Pasura, ba lage ba ja nmo, de n sɔŋɔ tiina maama mo ba kale ba vo Babilon. Dáane mo nmo wó te, se ba daare ba ke‑m da. Ko ta wó taa ye bedwe mo de n badwonna bam maama, kokuri to, n pworisi vwa mo n bere-ba.” Jeremia daa poone Wɛ yiga ne

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nmo soge amo mo, pa se a ji nmo tontoŋeno. Amo de ma pa nmo chwoŋa se n soge-ne konto. Nmo dam dem wane amo de di. Nɔɔna maama laam jege-ne mo ba mɔna. Ba maa twe-ne dɛ maama wone.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Amo yɔɔre a ni nɔɔna na jege a taane mo ba waasa ye ba we: “Ba fugi debam jei maama ne! Nam pa se dé ba bebara dé daŋe o baŋa ne! Dé wó pa se o to de o bora.” Amo badwoŋ-swonnu tem maama de maa lage se a seeri a to. Ba maa we: “Pa-na dé soge‑o se o ke o sa chwoŋa. Dé laam wó wane dé di dam o baŋa ne se dé jwoori dé ŋwe jene o baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yeini n faŋe balo na ye nɔn-ŋona to mo n nii. N maŋe n yei ba bochara de ba boboŋa na ye tei to. Nam zaŋe n waare-ba n pa-ne, se n jwoori n ŋwe jene ba baŋa ne. Kokuri to, a kwei a taane dem a ke nmo jeŋa ne mo.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Nam leeni-na leiŋa á pa Baŋa Wɛ! Tei-na o yere! Kokuri to o yeini o jwoŋi nabwona mo o yage puseŋ-nyena jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: A nam wó sɔɔle lwarem mo a yage a lora dɛ dem baŋa ne! Dɛ dem a nu na loge-ne to dae wopwolo dɛ!

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se kotu na chɔgem ne faŋa faŋa teene delo Baŋa Wɛ na chɔge, ye o wo jaane de ŋwaŋa to mo. Zezeŋa ne, kotu wó ni keira mo na zaŋe bugi-bugi. Wea tetare ne, tiguri-kaasa wó to o zwa ne.

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: Kotu ya ná go-ne ye a tigi a nu puga ne mo, ko ya wó taa gara. A nu puga kam ya wó lɛɛre ka ji a yibeeli. O ya wó taa jege a puga kam taa wuu.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane mo ba bere ba lo-ne? A ŋwea kam yɔɔre ka su de cham de wo-chechɔgɔ mo. Amo laam maa wó ba a kweeli de chaveera!

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento. Pɛ Zedekia déem toŋe Malakia bu Pasura, de Maaseya bu Zefania na ye Wɛ kaanem tu to se ba vo Jeremia tei ba ŋɔɔne ded‑o. Ba ma lwoori‑o ba we,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Lwoori Baŋa Wɛ se o jwoŋi debam o yage. Pɛ Nebukadeneza bobo se o kwaare jara dedaane dé teo kom mo. Dɛ delo, Baŋa Wɛ daa wó duri dé ŋwaŋa se o ke wo-kenkagele ne o na ke tei faŋa to, se o zeili Nebukadeneza se o jwoori o viiri o daare debam.”

english_verse: I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah: The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei Judah teo pɛ Zedekia, de o nakwa, dedaane teo konto nɔɔna balo maama jawe-chɛɛro tem, de jara yam, de kana kam ta na wo go-ba to, a ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza jeŋa ne, de abam dona balo na beeri á gom to jeŋa ne. Wonto bere o bá duri ba ŋwaŋa de fenfee de ye o pa se ba maama ga ba ŋwea. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Daa‑n ta ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: Amo zem pɛ abam chwoŋa mo se á kuri chwei selei tetare ne: kuri-na ŋwea, naa toone.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná maŋe teo konto wone, jara, naa kana, naa jawe-chɛɔ mo wó go kotu. Wolo nam ná nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo o sɛ o pa Babilon tiina bam, kotu wó jwoŋi o tete o yage.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, amo boboŋa jaane ya ti se a pa lɛɛro mo yi teo konto, ye ko dae lam. A lage a kwei-ko a ke Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne, se o zwɛ-ko kula! Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ” Judah teo pwa bam taane Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Daa‑n ta ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: Amo zem pɛ abam chwoŋa mo se á kuri chwei selei tetare ne: kuri-na ŋwea, naa toone.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
