translation_verse: Wolo maama ná maŋe teo konto wone, jara, naa kana, naa jawe-chɛɔ mo wó go kotu. Wolo nam ná nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo o sɛ o pa Babilon tiina bam, kotu wó jwoŋi o tete o yage.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, amo boboŋa jaane ya ti se a pa lɛɛro mo yi teo konto, ye ko dae lam. A lage a kwei-ko a ke Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne, se o zwɛ-ko kula! Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ” Judah teo pwa bam taane Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento. Pɛ Zedekia déem toŋe Malakia bu Pasura, de Maaseya bu Zefania na ye Wɛ kaanem tu to se ba vo Jeremia tei ba ŋɔɔne ded‑o. Ba ma lwoori‑o ba we,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Lwoori Baŋa Wɛ se o jwoŋi debam o yage. Pɛ Nebukadeneza bobo se o kwaare jara dedaane dé teo kom mo. Dɛ delo, Baŋa Wɛ daa wó duri dé ŋwaŋa se o ke wo-kenkagele ne o na ke tei faŋa to, se o zeili Nebukadeneza se o jwoori o viiri o daare debam.”

english_verse: I told them that the Lord God of Israel had told me to say to King Zedekiah: The Babylonians have surrounded Jerusalem and want to kill you and your people. You are asking me to save you, but you have made me furious. So I will stretch out my mighty arm and fight against you myself. Your army is using spears and swords to fight the Babylonians, but I will make your own weapons turn and attack you. I will send a horrible disease to kill many of the people and animals in Jerusalem, and there will be nothing left to eat. Finally, I will let King Nebuchadnezzar and his army fight their way to the center of Jerusalem and capture everyone who is left alive, including you and your officials. But Nebuchadnezzar won't be kind or show any mercy—he will have you killed! I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne, amo Baŋa Wɛ wó kwei Judah teo pɛ Zedekia, de o nakwa, dedaane teo konto nɔɔna balo maama jawe-chɛɛro tem, de jara yam, de kana kam ta na wo go-ba to, a ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza jeŋa ne, de abam dona balo na beeri á gom to jeŋa ne. Wonto bere o bá duri ba ŋwaŋa de fenfee de ye o pa se ba maama ga ba ŋwea. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: Daa‑n ta ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: Amo zem pɛ abam chwoŋa mo se á kuri chwei selei tetare ne: kuri-na ŋwea, naa toone.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná maŋe teo konto wone, jara, naa kana, naa jawe-chɛɔ mo wó go kotu. Wolo nam ná nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo o sɛ o pa Babilon tiina bam, kotu wó jwoŋi o tete o yage.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, amo boboŋa jaane ya ti se a pa lɛɛro mo yi teo konto, ye ko dae lam. A lage a kwei-ko a ke Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne, se o zwɛ-ko kula! Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ” Judah teo pwa bam taane Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say: I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Ta‑á tɔge-na chega de á na ke nɔɔna tei to. Á ná maane we ba vere nabwom wolo, se á jwoŋi kotu á yage wolo na bɛɛse‑o to jeŋa ne. Ko ná ye veira balo na zoore á tei ne to, de botara, de kadeina, se á yé bɛɛse-ba naa á ke-ba lwarem. Nam yé zaŋe-na á go balo na wo maŋe se ba te to jei sento ne.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Abam ná sɛ amo nia yam konto, á teo kom pwa balo na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem ne to wó taa wora mo taa, ye ba tɔge nia yanto seeni ba kɛa. Pwa bam konto dedaane ba nakwa wó yeini ba di sisei-torokooro de sisein-nɔɔna baŋa ne ba tɔge manchwo-peena yanto ba kɛ mo, ye ba nɔɔna bam de tɔge ba kwaga.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná wo sɛ amo nia yam konto, amo tage a du de a tete yere we, sɔ-fɔrɔ konto lage ko ji di-dwoŋo mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.’ ”

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo se ko vo Judah teo pɛ sɔŋɔ kom seeni: “Sɔ-fɔrɔ kom konto tiini ko lana amo yia ne, ne Gilead laŋa kam de Lebanon peero tem na ye tei to mo. Amo nam wó pa se ko ji ne kagoa dwoŋi, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé taa zoore ko wone.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Amo mo lage a toŋe jar-keira se ba ba ba chɔge-ko. Ba wó taa jege ba jara zela mo, se ba gwoni Sedare ywoa yam ba dole-ya ba de mini wone.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ wó tɔge teo konto seeni se ba kɛ, ye ba bwei daane ba we, ‘Bɛŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ chɔge teo kom tento dwoŋi, ye ko ya ye teo kamunu mo?’

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba maa wó leiri-ba ba ta we, ‘Ko ye ba na ve ni delo ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na gwoni de-ba to, ye ba daare ba zuli wa-gɛ to ŋwaane mo o ke-ba konto.’ ” Pɛ Jehohaza yera taane

english_verse: Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord, promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again. King Jehoiakim The Lord told me to say: *
translation_verse: O lage o te sa-teo ne mo yiga yiga, se o daa yé na o nabaara tega kam.” Pɛ Jehoyakim taane Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: O déem jwoŋi nabwona taane o ŋɔɔne o pa-ba. Mo kokuri wonnu maama kwei chwoŋa te pa‑o. O keina yam konto bere we o yɔɔre o yei amo. Ko dae konto na?” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord, have spoken. King Jehoiachin and the People of Jerusalem The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Ba lage ba suli‑o ne ba na suli bonaga tei to mo. Ba wó tuuri‑o mo ba ja ba nwoŋi Jerusalem teo kom wone, se ba kɛ ba dole‑o ba yage teo kom kabira kwaga ne.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Jerusalem tiina bam, véi-na Lebanon laŋa kam á laare dáane, Pa-na se á kwori zege Basan ne se zaŋe wɛɛne. Véi-na Abarim peero tem wone se á keeri. Kokuri to á fara bam maama daa tera jei jei se ba woli abam.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Abam yiga tiina bam maama lage ba jei, ne vio mo kale-ba ko ja jei tei to. Ba maa wó ja á fara bam ba viiri ba vo sa-teo. Chaveera laam wó di abam ye á yuu yaale, á puseŋa kikia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Jehoyakim bu Jehoyachin na ye Judah teo pɛ to, a lage a vaŋe nmo mo a le a yage, ne n ye jafole delo na bere amo dam ye a vaŋe-de a le a jazem jeŋa ne tei to mo.

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: A maa wó kwei‑m a ke balo na beeri‑m se ba go to jeŋa ne. Nmo nam yɔɔre n kɔre foone de-ba mo. A nam lage a kwei‑m a pa Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza de o jar-keira mo.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: A ta wó kwei nmo de n nu a dole a yage sa-teo ne yiga yiga. Ba wo loge abam teo kom konto ne. Á nam wó maŋe dáane se á te.

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Tega baŋa tiina bam, tega baŋa tiina bam, nam cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam!

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage nayera bam konto taane tei to mo tento: “Abam na zeili amo pei sem pa se jage, ye á wo nii se baŋa ne chekke to, amo lage a waare abam mo, á lwarem kikia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo nɔɔna balo ta na daare ye a zeili-ba jei selo maama ne to, amo lage a jwoori a la-ba se ba nwoŋi mɛ maama ba na vei to mo, se ba jwoori ba tete tega kam ne. Ba laam maa wó puli dedɛ.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: A ta wó beeri nayera balo yiga na wo ba wone to a pa-ba, se ba taa nii ba baŋa ne. Konto wó pa se foone daa yé ja a nɔɔna bam, ye ba wolowolo de bá jei.”

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: O paare dim maŋa ne, Judah tiina wó na verem, ye Isarele tiina maama taa zoore de yazura. Nɔɔna maa wó taa bwoi o yere we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ mo bore debam bora de chega.’

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se balo ná lage ba du duuri, se ba daa yé ta we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi debam Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne to yere dem.’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Ba laam wó taa tɛ we, ‘A dugi de Baŋa Wɛ wolo na jwoŋi Isarele tiina bam o ja o nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom ne, dedaane jei selo maama o na jage-ba to yere dem.’ Kokuri to ba laam wó taa zoore ba tete tega kam ne mo.” Vwa sampwori sem taane

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: A wo yɔɔre ko pɛ mo de sampwori sem kikia yam. A yera maa didigi de ba keim dem. Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ tete ŋwaane, de taane delo o na ŋɔɔne banto seeni to ŋwaane mo, amo nye de nɔɔno na nyɔge sana o bugi to.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: “Sampwori sem de kaanem tiina bam ba gare daane, ba wolowolo yeiri Wɛ. Ba bere ba ja ba totoŋ-lwanno tem ba zo amo wara-jei sem wone mo ba ke.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage sampwori sem konto taane tei to mo tento: “Amo wó pa ba na yaara dedɛ. Ko maŋe se ba di wodi-chɛɔ ye ba daare ba nyɔ na-chɛɛra mo. Kokuri to, Jerusalem sampwori sem kikia ŋwaane mo nɔɔna swei amo swia tega kam jei maama ne.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage tei to mo tento: “Jerusalem tiina bam, yé cheigi-na sampwori sento na pworisi tei de abam to. Ba pae se á jege teena kafɛ mo. Ko maa ye ba tete boboŋa mo ba jege ba tɛ ba bere abam, se ba wo nigi taane amo Baŋa Wɛ ni ne.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Ba swoi se ba taa tɛ de balo na ve amo taane to we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage we, abam wó na yazura.’ Ko ta ná ye zwabani-nyena bam de, ba tɛ de-ba mo we, ‘Cham bá ba á baŋa kɔtaa!’

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Sampwori sem konto wɔ nam mo me de Baŋa Wɛ, se kotu maane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ kwora? Ba wɔ mo bere o cheigi se o ni o taane dem?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ bane wó zaŋe lela, ne vo-dɛɔ na zaŋe tei to mo. Ko nam wó taa nye de vo-kekara na chugi nɔn-balwaaro yuu ne tei to mo.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane nam ná zaŋe de-ba, ko ná dae we o ke o su o boboŋa yam mo, o bochare dem ta bá zuri. Maŋa kam nam ná yia, abam laam wó ni ko kuri lanyerane.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Amo wo toŋe sampwori sem konto. De ko de, ba duri ba vo nɔɔna tei se ba ŋɔɔne amo yere ŋwaane. Amo nam wo kwei a taane a pa-ba, ye ba ta kare ba pworisa ba bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Ba nam ya ná me de amo chekke, ba ya wó tɔɔle amo taane dem ba bere a nɔɔna bam. Ba ya wó pa se a nɔɔna bam pipiri ba yage ba vwa chwei sem, de ba lwarem kikia yam.”

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Amo nigi vwa yalo sampwori sento na kare ba pworisi amo yere ŋwaane to. Ba yɔɔre ba tɛ mo ba we, ‘Wɛ ŋɔɔne de amo dendwɛ wone!’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Ko nam ye vwa mo ba jege ba pworisa. Ba tete boboŋa mo gane-ba pa se ba ŋɔɔna. Ba wó ke konto taa se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Tɔ. Sampwora ná dwɛ dendwɛ, se kotu ta o bere de na seene de ye tei to. Sampwora kalo nam ná jwoŋi amo taane, se kotu yɔɔre o bere-de chekke. Taana yanto dae bedwe, ne men-swanno na dae mena yam chekke tei to!” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Nii-na! Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage a we: A chuli balo na dwɛ dendwea ye ba daare ba pworisi vwa ya ŋwaane to. Ba na yɔɔre ba fɔe vwa ba bere a nɔɔna bam tei to maa pae se ba tusa. Amo wo kuri sampwori sem konto. A ta wo toŋe-ba a nɔɔna bam tei ne. Ba bere ba ba woli a nɔɔna bam de fenfee de.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta de amo o we:

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: “Nɔɔna banto wone, naa ba sampwori sem wone, naa ba kaanem tiina wone dedoa ná bwei‑m o we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ daa kwei zele dɔ mo se o pa dé zeŋe?’, se n ta de kotu we, ‘Abam mo ye zele delo na daane Baŋa Wɛ to mo! Baŋa Wɛ we o lage dole abam mo o yage!’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Sampwora kalo, naa kaanem tu wolo, naa nɔɔno wolo maama nam ná tage o we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ kwei zele dento mo o pa-ne’, amo wó waare kotu mo de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Abam nam na maŋe se á bwei daane tei to mo tento: ‘Baŋa Wɛ leiri debam o we bɛ mo?’ naa ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage o we bɛ mo?’.

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Á nam daa yé ta‑á tɛ we, ‘Zele delo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam to mo tento.’ Kokuri to, abam tete kwora mo ye zele delo na daane abam to. Á tɔge konto baŋa á kweele dé Tu Wɛ wom taane dem á yage tega ne, ye wonto mo ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ de Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Abam nam ná yeini á vo sampwora tei, se á bwei‑o nenɛɛne: ‘Baŋa Wɛ leiri‑m o we bɛ mo?’ naa ‘Baŋa Wɛ tage o we bɛ mo?’

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: amo yɔɔre a lage a gɔ abam a dole a yage yiga yiga mo. A ta wó zeili á teo kom maama amo déem na pɛ abam de á nabaara bam to se á viiri amo yiga ne.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza déem jaane Judah teo pɛ Jehoyakim bu Jehoyachin Jerusalem ne mo o kale o ja o vo Babilon. O ta kale Judah nakwa bam, de ba teo gwaro, de ba lura bam maama mo o ja o viiri. Konto kwaga ne mo Baŋa Wɛ le wonnu o bere-ne. O ma pa se a na mɔɔro tetwaro telei, te na zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam yiga ne.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Tetɔgɔ dedoa su de mɔɔro na lana to. Te maa ye telo na lwoori yiga te ke to mo. Tetɔgɔ kodwoŋi kom wo mɔɔro tem ma pɔ, te yɔɔre te wo maŋe de dim!

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma bwei amo o we, “Jeremia, bɛ mo n nii n na?” Amo ma leiri‑o a we, “Mɔɔro dwia yalei mo a nɛa. Tedwonna tiini te lana. Tetem tem ba lana. Te yɔɔre te dae ba ke ni ne.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem ma pa amo ni o we:

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa nii ba baŋa ne pa se ko ke lanyerane ko pa-ba. A ta wó jwoori a ja-ba a jwoori a ba ywo-seeni. A lage a fɔge a lɔ-ba a zege mo, se a daa bá vaare-ba a de tega ne a yage. A maa wó jeiri-ba te-ywoŋa jei ne, se a bá vuuri-ba a gɔ a yage.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: A maa wó pa se ba boboŋa ja se ba taa kɔre amo wolo na ye Baŋa Wɛ wom to. Ba laam maa wó taa ye amo tete nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye ba Wɛ. Kokuri to, ba lage ba jwoori amo tei de ba bochare maama mo.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we: Ko daare ko ná ye Judah teo pɛ Zedekia, de o nakwa bam, de nɔɔna balo maama ta na daare Jerusalem teo kom wone to, de balo na duri ba vo Ejipti teo ba zoore da to, amo lage a ke-ba ne mɔɔro telo na pɔga ye te dae se ba di to mo.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: A lage a pa se lɛɛro ba ba baŋa mo, se ba ji wo-zɔɔna logo baŋa teene maama yia ne. Nɔɔna maama wó neese-ba mo, ye ba ta lɔŋe-ba. Ba ta maa wó taa ye sinseira nɔɔna nia ne. Mɛ maama amo na wó pa se ba jage ba yi da to, nɔɔna wó taa mɔne-ba, ye ba daare ba mae ba yere ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: A lage a pa se ba te jara wone mo, se kana de jawe-chɛɛro de ja-ba te go, se ko ta nii maŋa kalo ba yere na saare tega kalo a déem na kwei a pa ba de ba nabaara bam to wone.”

english_verse: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, which was the first year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia, the Lord told me to speak to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. So I told them:
translation_verse: Wɛ sampwora Jeremia na tage kolo o bere balo na zoore Jerusalem ne to dedaane Judah tiina bam maama to mo tento:

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Nam yé tɔge-na wa-yɔɔro kwaga, se á zuli-ya. Yé pa-na se a bane zaŋe de á je na ke wonnu telo to. Abam ná sɛ amo ni konto, amo de bá chɔge abam.

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: Abam nam wo sɛ amo taane dem, ye á chuchugi a bane de á je na ke wonnu telo to. Á keim dem konto ma pa se á na chɔgem delo laam na tu á baŋa tento to.

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: amo de wó bwoŋi dwia yalo na zoore baŋa seeni to nɔɔna bam maama, de amo tontoŋeno Nebukadeneza wolo na ye Babilon teo Pɛ to se ba ba. A maa wó toŋe-ba se ba ke jara de abam balo na zoore tega kanto wone to, de teene delo maama na gilimi abam to. Ba wó yɔɔre ba chɔge á tega kam maama de jei selo na gilimi abam to fase, pa se ka maama ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ka ba yaala, ye ba dole ba yuni ka ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se wopwolo de ywoni sɔɔ maama ti jei sem maama ne. Kadiri ywoni de daa bá taa wora. Nɔɔna daa bá taa choe muni naa ba tɔre mini.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Tega kam maama jilli wó ji di-dwonnu mo ne kagoa tei. Judah tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina balo maama na gilimi-ba to maa wó taa wo Babilon teo pɛ dam kuri ne bena fuserepɛ.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Bena fuserepɛ sem nam ná yia, amo wó waare Babilon teo pɛ de o teo kom maama ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane. Amo ta wó pa se lɛɛro ba Babilon tiina tega kam maama baŋa ne pa se ka ji di-dwonnu se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: A lage a pa se cham delo maama a na tage se ko vo Babilon tega kam seeni to mo seene de yi-ba. Waarem delo maama na popone de tiŋi tɔnɔ konto wone to, dedaane wonnu telo maama Jeremia na pworisi o pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam maama to wó yi-ba.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Pa-kamuna de dwia yadwonna dedɛ mo wó di dam Babilon tiina bam baŋa ne pa se ba ji ba kabɛ. Amo wó jwoori a ŋwe ba keim-balwaaro tem jene se ko maŋe de ba je na ke wonnu telo to.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto. Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom ma ta de amo o we, “Nii na-zoŋa a jeŋa ne de ka wo sana bam. Ka su de a ban-zɔŋɔ kom mo ka pɛɛle. Nam jwoŋi-ka n vo n pa dwi tiina balo maama amo na pɛ se n vo ba tei to, se ba nyɔ ka wo sana bam.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Ba ná nyɔga, ba wó yirisi mo, jara yalo amo na wó pa se ya to ba tetare ne to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Amo ma seene a jwoŋi na-zoŋa kam Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne. A ma kwei ka wo sana bam a pa dwi tiina balo maama o na pɛ se a vo ba tei to, ye ba nyɔ.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: A vei Jerusalem mo, de Judah teene dedwonna dem, de ba pwa de ba nakwa bam tei. A ma pa ba nyɔ na-zoŋa kam wo sana bam, se ko bere we ba lage ba na chɔgem ye ba teene dem ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó taa jege-ba ba yaala ye ba mae ba yera ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane. Ko ta ye konto mo de zem maama.

english_verse: The second place I went was Egypt, where everyone had to drink from the cup, including the king and his officials, the other government workers, the rest of the Egyptians,
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo amo ta na pɛ ba nyɔ na-zoŋa kam wo sana bam to mo tento: Ejipti teo Pa-faro wom, de o nakwa, de o dedɛɛra, de o nɔn-bia bam,

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: dedaane veira balo maama na zoore ba tetare ne to. Yuzi laŋa pwa bam maama. Filisi tiina pwa bam maama. Banto maa ye Asekelon teo pɛ, de Gaza teo pɛ, de Ekoron teo pɛ, de balo ta na daare Asedodi teo wone to.

english_verse: Then I went to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon,
translation_verse: Edom tiina bam, de Moaba tiina bam, de Amon tiina bam.

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: Tura de Sidon teene pwa bam maama, ko ta woli de pwa balo na zoore naneo ni kateira yam ne to.

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Arabia laŋa pwa bam, de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore kagoa kam wone to pwa bam.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Nam ta nɔɔna bam we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to mo we: Nyɔ-na na-zoŋa kam wone sana á bugi, se á tɔne tetwanno. Ta‑á pare á toe tega ne, se á daa yé zaŋe wɛɛne, jara yalo amo na wó pa se ya to á tetare ne to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná ve se ba nyɔ na-zoŋa kam n na tei na pa-ba to wone, se n ta de-ba we, ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tage tento mo: Á jege se á nyɔ mo!

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo o we: “Nii mo! Lɛɛro lage te jage te yi logo baŋa teene maama. Jara zaŋe ne vo-dɛɔ mo tei. Ya ma nwoŋi logo baŋa jei selo na wo yiga yiga to ne ya beene.”

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Jara yam ná yia, nɔɔna balo Baŋa Wɛ na go to wó faare tega baŋa jei maama ne mo. Ba bá na nɔɔna se ba keeri ba lwi naa ba suli-ba. Ba yera wó taa tigi tega baŋa jei maama ne pare-pare, ne popɔnɔ mo tei.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Abam yiga tiina bam, keeri-na á sisigi. To-na tega ne á ta‑á bibila, abam balo na yere Wɛ nɔɔna bam to. Kokuri to, ko laam yi maŋa se ba go abam. Á lage á yɔɔre á to tega ne mo á chochoge, ne kabeila na to ka chochoge tei to.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Pwoli selo ya na jege ga-zuru lanyerane to lage se yɔɔre se chɔge mo, Baŋa Wɛ ban-lom dem na zaŋe to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam, de sampwori sem, de nɔɔna bam maama déem ma zege Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ne ye ba ni Jeremia na tage tei maama to.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Josia bu Jehoyakim déem na bobo se o di Judah teo paare to, mo kwora kanto tu Jeremia tei.

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Nam lɔre-na we, abam ná go-ne, á go wolo na wo ke kolokolo o chɔge to mo. Á wɛleere dem konto wó taa wo á yuu ne, dedaane teo konto de ko nɔn-bia bam maama yuu ne. Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o toŋe-ne se a ta kolo maama á na nigi to.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, “Véi n zege Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ne. Nɔɔna bam laam maa ná nwoŋi Judah teene dem maama wone ba ba ba zo da se ba zuli amo Baŋa Wɛ, se n ta kwora kanto maama n bere-ba. Yé seigi kolokolo ba yiga ne.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo nɔɔna bam wó cheigi amo kwora kam ye ba daare ba yage ba lwarem kikia yam. Ba ná sɛ ba ke konto, amo wó wane a leiri a boboŋa de lɛɛro telo a ya na jeeli se a ke ba baŋa ne ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Nam ta de-ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Abam nam jege se á cheigi amo taane, se á daare á sɛ nia yalo a na pɛ abam to mo.

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: A yeini a toŋe a sampwori sem á tei ne titwon-twono se ba tɔɔle a kwora kam ba bere abam. Ko ya maŋe se á sɛ ba ni-kaana yam, á nam ba sɛa.

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: Abam daa ta ná wo sɛ a taane dem, amo de nam wó chɔge Wɛ diga kanto mo, ne a déem na ke tei Siloo baŋa ne to. A laam maa wó pa se Jerusalem ji teo kolo logo baŋa dwi maama na wó ma ko yere ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane to.’ ”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo pɛ‑m chwoŋa se n pworisi de Baŋa Wɛ yere we, Wɛ diga kanto de lage ka chɔge mo, ne ko déem na ke tei Siloo baŋa ne to? Bɛ mo ye n ta ta we teo konto wó ji di-dwonnu se nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa yé taa zoore ko wone?” Ba déem ma ta konto Wɛ wara-jei sem ne ye ba peene Jeremia ba ke‑o ba tetare ne.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Judah teo nakwa bam na nigi kolo na ke to, mo ba de ke lela ba zege pɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne ba vo Wɛ wara-jei sem ne. Ba ma vo Wɛ diga konkɔlɔ kom ni delo yere na ye ‘Ni-doore dem’ to ba jeini da se ba nii taane dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Kaanem tiina bam, de sampwori sem laam ma ta de teo nakwa bam, de nɔn-bia bam maama ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto maŋe se o te mo. Kokuri to, o ŋɔɔne taane delo na yaale dé teo kom to mo. O na tage tei maama to to abam tete zwa wone.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Nam leiri-na á kikia yam se á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laaro. Pipiri-na á sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem. Konto mo wó pa se o leiri o boboŋa de lɛɛro telo o ya na jeeli se o pa te yi abam to.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, a wo á je ne mo, se á ke kolo maama á na boŋe we ko tɔge chwoŋa to.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Teo kom nakwa bam, de nɔɔna bam maama na nigi konto to, ba ma ta de kaanem tiina bam, de sampwori sem ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto wo ke kolo na maŋe se o te to. Ko ye o tɔge Baŋa Wɛ yere ŋwaane mo o ŋɔɔne de debam.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Ba taane dem kwaga ne mo nakwa badwonna zege ba ta de nɔɔna balo maama na jeeri da to ba we,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Hezekia déem na ye Judah teo pɛ to mo Moresɛf teo tu Mika pworisi o bere Judah tiina bam maama ye o we: ‘Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Wɛ tete teo Jerusalem wó to ko saare ko ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó ba ba va Zion tega kam konto ba tiŋi. Teeni maa wó li zwoŋo kolo Wɛ diga kam ya na zege da to.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Pɛ Hezekia de Judah tiina bam déem nam go Mika mo na? Aawo. Pɛ wom kɔre Baŋa Wɛ ye o lwoori‑o se o duri ba ŋwaŋa. Baŋa Wɛ de ma leiri o boboŋa de lɛɛro telo o ya na jeeli se o pa te yi-ba to. Debam nam ná go nɔɔno wonto, lɛɛro lage te ba dé baŋa ne lela mo!”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo de amo to mo tento: “Kwei tankɔlɔ n seere-ko, se n ma sesere sem konto n vɔ daa yera ne n ke nabɛ yɔgese se n daare n kwei-ka n de n ba ne.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to nam tage de amo se a pa-ba kwora kanto, se ba de ta ba bere ba pwa bam we:

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Teene maama nɔɔna wó taa toŋe ba pa‑o mo. Ba ta wó toŋe ba pa o bu, de o naa. Ko wó taa ye konto mo se ko yi maŋa kalo ba de teo kom na yi se a pa nɔɔna taa tei-ba to. Wonto de o teo tiina laam maa wó toŋe ba pa pa-kamuna de ba nɔɔna.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Teo kolo nɔɔna nam ná ve se ba ke ba tete Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza jeŋa ne se o taa tei-ba, amo wó pa se banto te jara wone mo, se jaweero de kana de ja-ba te go. Amo wó tɔge Pɛ Nebukadeneza baŋa ne mo a chɔge-ba konto se ba ba ba ti fase. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, á ba jege se á cheigi á sampwori, de á yi-nara, de á dendwea tɛɛna, de á chichiri vora, de á liri-mwa tiina taane. Banto yeini ba ta de abam ba we, á bá taa wo Babilon teo pɛ dam kuri ne.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Teo kolo nɔɔna nam ná sɛ se ba ke ba tete Babilon teo pɛ wom jeŋa ne se o taa tei-ba, amo de wó pa nɔɔna bam konto chwoŋa se ba maŋe ba tete tega wone, se ba taa zoore ka wone ye ba vara.’ ”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Amo déem ma daare a ja kwora kam konto a vo Judah pɛ Zedekia tei, ye a lwoni-ka a bere‑o. A ma ta ded‑o a we, “Ke n tete Babilon teo pɛ wom jeŋa ne se o taa tei á teo kom. Á ná sɛ á pa wonto de o nɔɔna, á wó jwoŋi á tete á yage.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tage o we teo kolo nɔɔna ná wo sɛ Babilon teo pɛ wom, banto wó te jara wone mo, se jaweero de kana de ja-ba te go. Bɛ mo wó ke se nmo de n nɔɔna bam ta‑á lage toone?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Nam yé cheigi-na sampwori selo na tɛ de abam ba we, á bá taa wo Babilon teo pɛ dam kuri ne to. Banto jege vwa mo ba pworisi de abam.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: ‘Amo wo toŋe sampwori sem konto. Ba jege vwa mo ba pworisi amo yere ŋwaane. Konto ŋwaane mo amo lage a zeili abam se á viiri. Abam de á sampwori sem konto maama wó te mo.’ ”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ta de kaanem tiina bam, de nɔɔna bam maama a we: “Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: ‘Yé cheigi-na sampwori selo na tɛ de abam ba we, Babilon tiina bam wó jwoori ba ja Wɛ diga zela yalo ba ya na jaane ba viiri to ba ba ba pa debam. Ko ye vwa mo ba jege ba pworisa.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Nam yé cheigi-na ba taane. Sɛ-na á pa Babilon teo pɛ wom, se á jwoŋi á tete á yage. Á lage á pa se teo konto ji di-dwonnu se bɛ mo?’

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná seene ba ye sampwori selo na jege Baŋa Wɛ kwora se ba ta to, se ba lwoori Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ se o yé pa chwoŋa se ba vere Wɛ diga kam zela yalo ta na daare Jerusalem ne to, de pɛ sɔŋɔ kom wo jejegero tem ba ja vo Babilon.

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Bene dem konto chane senu chana kam wone mo Azura bu Hanania déem zege Wɛ diga kam wone o ŋɔɔne de amo. Pɛ Zedekia paare dim bena yana bene dem ne mo konto. Hanania maa ye sampwora ye o nwoŋi Gibeon teo ne. O ma zege kaanem tiina bam, de nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne o ta de amo o we:

english_verse: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.
translation_verse: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage tei to mo tento: ‘Amo lage a chɔge Babilon teo pɛ wom dam delo o na jege o di abam baŋa ne nenɛɛne á jege nabɛ yɔgese mo á ba ne tei to.

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Bena yalei laŋa ne amo wó jwoori a ja Wɛ diga kam zela yalo Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza na vere o ja o vo Babilon to a ba a yage ywo.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: A nam ta wó ja Jehoyakim bu Jehoyachin na ye Judah teo pɛ to a jwoori ywo. Wonto de balo maama ba na kale ba ja vo Babilon ne to mo a lage a ja a jwoori ywo. Kokuri to, a lage a chɔge dam delo Babilon teo pɛ na jege o di abam baŋa ne to mo.’ Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.”

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: O ma ta o we, “Ameena. Baŋa Wɛ wó pa ko seene ko ke! A teene we n na pworisi tei to wó ji chega, se Baŋa Wɛ pa se jejegero telo Babilon tiina bam na vere Wɛ diga kam ne ba ja ba viiri to, de nɔɔna balo ba na kale ba ja ba viiri to jwoori ywo.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Nam cheigi taane delo a na jege se a pa nmo de nɔɔna banto maama to.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ko daare, sampwora kalo ná pworisi yazura taane, kotu na pworisi tei to ná seene ko ke, ko bere we wonto mo ye wolo Baŋa Wɛ na seene o toŋe to.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Hanania laam ma vaŋe nabɛ yɔgese delo na wo Jeremia ba ne to o le, ye o daare o bwori-de.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: O ta ma zege nɔɔna bam maama yiga ne, ye o ta o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: ‘Tento dwoŋi mo a lage a chɔge dam delo pɛ Nebukadeneza na jege o di dwi tiina maama baŋa ne to. Bena yalei laŋa ne mo amo wó ke konto.’ ” O na tage konto o ti to, Jeremia ma kɛ o daare-ba.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a kwei luuru yɔgese mo a de teene dem konto maama ba ne, se ko fe-ba se ba sɛ ba pa Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza. Ba wó taa toŋe ba pa‑o. A ta maa wó pa kago-vara de ni se ba sɛ ba pa‑o.’ ”

english_verse: Hananiah, I have never sent you to speak for me. And yet you have talked my people into believing your lies and rebelling against me. So now I will send you—I'll send you right off the face of the earth! You will die before this year is over.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo tento: A lage a le nmo se n jei tega baŋa ne. Bene dento ne mo n lage n te, n na bere nɔɔna bam se ba lɔ amo Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: I had been left in Jerusalem when King Nebuchadnezzar took many of the people of Jerusalem and Judah to Babylonia as prisoners, including King Jehoiachin, his mother, his officials, and the metal workers and others in Jerusalem who were skilled in making things. So I wrote a letter to the priests, the prophets, the leaders, and the rest of our people in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye ba déem na maŋe ba kale Pɛ Jehoyachin, de o nu, de pɛ sɔŋɔ dedɛɛra bam, de yiga tiina balo na nii Jerusalem de Judah kateira yam baŋa ne to, de ba teo kom gwaro, de ba lura ba ja ba viiri to kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Jeremia déem kwei tɔnɔ kom o ke Safan bu Elasa, de Hilikia bu Gemaria jeŋa ne mo. Judah teo pɛ Zedekia déem toŋe banto mo se ba vo Babilon ba zege ba pa‑o Pɛ Nebukadeneza tei ne. Tɔnɔ kom popone we:

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na jege kolo se o ta de balo o na pɛ se Nebukadeneza kale o nwoŋi Jerusalem ne o vo Babilon to mo tento:

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: “Lɔ-na sam dáane se á lɛɛre á jeini ba teo kom wone. Jeiri-na gaara, se á ta‑á di ya tio-bia bam.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Swo-na kaana, se á lo bia de-ba. Di-na kaana á pa á bakeiri sem, se á daare á kwei á bukwa á yei á pa banna. Konto wó pa se ba na naaro ba pa abam. Puli-na de kɔgɔ. Yé mɔ-na á kɔgɔ kom ni.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Ta‑á toŋe-na se teo kolo a na kale abam a vo a yage da to taa jege yazura, se wonnu taa ke lanyerane te pa-ba. Nam ta lwoori-na Baŋa Wɛ á pa-ba, kokuri to ko ná ke lanyerane ko pae banto, abam de wó na á yiga-veiŋa.”

english_verse: Some of your people there in Babylonia are fortunetellers, and you have asked them to tell you what will happen in the future. But they will only lead you astray with their dreams. And don't let the prophets fool you, either. They speak in my name, but they are liars. I have not spoken to them.
translation_verse: Se ko ye vwa mo ba jege ba pworisa ba pae abam amo yere ŋwaane. Amo bere a wo toŋe-ba.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Abam laam maa wó ba amo yiga ne se á ware-ne. Amo de maa wó cheigi á wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Abam maa wó beeri-ne, ye á na-ne. Chega to, á ná beeri-ne de á bochara maama,

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Abam nam wae á tɛ nenɛɛne, “Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o kuri sampwori o pa debam Babilon teo ne.”

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama a na zeili Jerusalem ne a kale a ja a vo Babilon teo to, nam cheigi-na amo Baŋa Wɛ taane dem.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage tei to mo tento: Nmo tɔge n tete yere ŋwaane mo n popone tɔnɔ n toŋe n pa Jerusalem tiina bam maama. N ma‑n pa ko yi Maaseya bu Zefania na ye kaanem tu to, de kaanem tiina badaara bam maama. N ma‑n ta de Zefania we:

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: ‘Baŋa Wɛ mo tiŋi‑m se n leiri Jehoyada yuu ne n ta‑n ye kaanem tu o wara-jei sem ne, ye n nii Wɛ diga kam baŋa ne. Nmo ná nɛ we chichwoo mo wora o na bere o tete we o ye Wɛ sampwora to, n jege se n ja kotu n vɔ o nɛ mo, se n daare n lei luu o ba ne.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Bɛ nam mo ye n wo ke Anatofe tu Jeremia kolokolo? Wonto yeini o pworisi mo o pa abam.

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se n che‑o mo, kokuri to o popone tɔnɔ o toŋe o pa debam balo na wo Babilon ne to ye o we, dé wó dáane ywo bena dedɛ. O we, dé lɔ sam se dé lɛɛre dé jeini ywo, ye dé daare dé jeiri gaara se dé taa di ya tio-bia.’ ”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Zefania na jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom to, mo o gage-ko o bere Jeremia.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ de laam ma kwei kwora kanto o pa Jeremia ye o we,

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Pa kwora kanto yi balo maama ba na kale ba ja vo Babilon to: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei se ko vo Nehelam tu Semaya seeni to mo tento: ‘Semaya yeini o pworisi mo o bere abam, ye amo wo toŋe‑o. O ma gane abam ye á sɛ o vwa yam.

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo Baŋa Wɛ lage a waare Nehelam tu Semaya de o dwi dem mo. O dwi dem wolowolo bá na wo-laaro telo a na boŋe se a ke a pa a nɔɔna bam to, o na bere nɔɔna bam se ba lɔ amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane.’ Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei to mo tento: “Popone wonnu telo maama a na tage a bere‑m to n ke tɔnɔ wone se te taa tiga.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: O na tage kolo to mo tento: “A nigi nɔɔna bam na keeri tei to. Ko nam ye foone keira mo, vuvuga na to ba wone to ŋwaane. Yazura maa tera jei jei.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Ba laam wó ke ba tete amo wolo na ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom to dam kuri ne mo. Ba ta wó zuli pɛ wolo a na wó kuri a pa-ba ye o ye David dwi tu to mo.”

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Kokuri to, amo Baŋa Wɛ wo abam tei ne se a jwoŋi abam a yage. Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge teene delo maama a ya na jage abam a yage de wone to. Se ko ná ye abam, a bá chɔge abam fase. A nam yeini a wae a korese abam. Amo ná waare abam maŋa de maŋa, ko nam wó taa tɔge chega chwoŋa mo.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Nɔɔno tera se kotu nii á taane dem baŋa ne. Wolim nam tera á zonne dem ŋwaane, ye yɔɔrem de tera de pae abam.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: A laam maa wó jwoori a pa abam á yazura, ye a daare a yɔɔre á fufwollu tem. Kokuri to, ba ya jege abam Zion tiina bam ba bwoi we, nɔn-yɔɔro telo Wɛ na zeili to, ye ba we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera kotu yiga na wo á wone.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo o we: “Amo wó jwoori a ja Jakob dwi dem a jwoori ba tete teo, pa se sɔ-yuu maama taa zoore de yazura. Ba wó jwoori ba chwi Jerusalem teo kom ko di-dwonnu baŋa ne mo. Pɛ sɔ-fɔrɔ kom de wó jwoori ko zege ko jeiga kam ne.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Ba nɔn-bia bam wó jwoori ba na dam, ne ba déem na ye tei faŋa faŋa to. Ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wó fɔge ba zege amo tei ne. A maa wó waare balo maama na wó bɛɛse-ba to.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Ba tete dwi tu laam mo wó di paare ba baŋa ne. Wolo na wó taa tei-ba to wó nwoŋi ba tete dwi dem wone. Amo laam maa wó pa kotu chwoŋa se o fɔɔre o ba o twɛ-ne. Wɔ mo nam wó sɛ o yi amo tei, ye amo wo bwoŋi kotu?

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Abam laam wó taa ye amo nɔɔna mo, se amo de taa ye abam Wɛ wom.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ bane wó zaŋe lela, ne vo-dɛɔ na zaŋe tei to mo. Ko nam wó taa nye de vo-kekara na chugi nɔn-balwaaro yuu ne tei to mo.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane nam ná zaŋe de-ba, ko ná dae we o ke o su o boboŋa yam, o bochare dem bá zuri. Maŋa kam nam ná yia, abam laam wó ni ko kuri lanyerane.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we, “Maŋa kam konto ná yia, amo wó taa ye Isarele sɔ-yuni maama Wɛ wom, se ba de taa ye amo nɔɔna.”

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Ko ná ye balo na lugi toone jara wone, ye ba kare ba vei kagoa wone to, banto nɛ wolim lanyerane. Isarele tiina bam na beeri siu konto to,

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: amo Baŋa Wɛ mo veere a tete de-ba jei selo na ye yiga yiga to ne. Isarele tiina bam, ko na zege faŋa faŋa ne to mo a tiini a swoi abam. Amo ta maa swoi abam de zem maama.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Maŋa beene se balo na yeini ba nii Efrayim zwonnu laŋa kam to zaŋe ye ba tɔɔle ba ta we, ‘Ba-na se dé vo Jerusalem, se dé zuli dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ Zion ne.’ ”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Nii mo! A lage a ja-ba a nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kom ne a ba ywo, se a daare a la ba maama a nwoŋi logo baŋa jei selo na wo yiga yiga ne to. Lilwoa, de gwane wó taa wo ba kɔgɔ kom wone. Kapwi de balo na virigi puga se ba lo to de wó taa wora. Chega to, kɔ-fɔrɔ mo lage ko jwoori.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Ba ná maa jwoora, ba wó taa keeri mo de wo-chechɔgɔ. Amo na to ba yiga ne ye dé jwoori to, Wɛ-lworo wó taa wo ba nia ne mo. Amo wó kale-ba se ba tɔge na-zura na duri ba tole mɛ to. Ba wó taa vei chwoŋa kalo na mae daane to ne mo se ba daa yé to. Kokuri to, amo mo ye Isarele dwi tiina bam kwo. Efrayim maa ye amo bu-kwea.”

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: Logo baŋa teene dem maama, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ taane. Tɔɔle-na o kwora kam se ka yi balo na zoore naneo ni ne to we: “Baŋa Wɛ ya mo jage Isarele dwi tiina bam o yage. O nam wó jwoori o la-ba o ke daane. O maa wó taa yere-ba ne nayero na nii o pei-kɔgɔ baŋa ne tei to.”

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Ba laam maa wó jwoori ba ba ba zege Zion peo kom yuu ne, ye ba leeni de kwor-dɛa. Ba wó taa di ywoni mo Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ba wo-laaro telo to ŋwaane. Tento maa ye mena, de sa-doora, de nuga, de vare-mɔra. Ba ta wó taa nye de gaare delo na na yage da ye de zura to mo. Ba vɔna daa bá pare maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se kaanem tiina bam ŋwea su de ywoni, se a daare a pa a nɔɔna bam wo-laaro telo maama ba na lage to.”

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Sɔɔ mo zaŋe Rama teo wone. Nɔɔna mo wora ba keera, ye ba chwoosa dedɛ. Racheli mo tiini o keeri o bia bam ŋwaane. O maa ba sɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno ja‑o, ba daa na tera to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: “Daa‑n yé ta‑n keera. Nam weeri n yi-na bam, se nmo wó na n totoŋa yam nyɔɔre. Amo wó jwoŋi n bia bam n dona bam jeŋa ne a pa ba jwoori ba tete teo ne.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: “Amo nigi Efrayim tiina wo na chɔge ye ba we, ‘Nmo Baŋa Wɛ waare debam ye dé sɛ nmo koresem dem. Dé déem nye de na-bala kalo ta na wo toŋe to mo. Nam pa debam chwoŋa se dé jwoori dé ba n tei. Dé maa wó seene dé ba, bɛŋwaane nmo mo ye debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Dé ya ywori chwoŋa mo. Dé nam chuli dé wɛleera yam. Dé boboŋa laam na jwoori to, mo dé mage dé takeira wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Chaveera ma di debam, ye dé yuu yaale, wo-zɔɔna yalo dé na ke dé nɔn-donne maŋa ne to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Efrayim ye amo bu-swono kolo na jei amo bochare ne to mo. A yeini a ŋɔɔne ta-balwaaro a pa‑o. De ko de, a nam ta yɔɔre a swoi‑o mo. Amo boboŋa vei o seeni maŋa maama mo, ye a tiini a jege o ŋwaŋa,” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: “Tiŋi-na memaŋa chwei sem nia ne, se ko pa á yé tusi chwoŋa kam ne. Fɔge á lɔre chwo-fara kalo á déem na tɔge da ye á kɛ to. A nɔn-swonnu Isarele tiina bam, nam jwoori-na se á zo á teene dem wone.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo ná jaane a nɔɔna bam se ba jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo, Judah tiina bam daa wó ta ba teene dem maama ne we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ swolim taa wo Jerusalem baŋa ne! Wɛ wó ke zaane o di-laao kom de o tete peo kolo na ye wose to baŋa ne!’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam wó taa zoore daane Judah laŋa kam de ka teene dem maama ne, ko ta woli de vala, de nayera.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Amo déem mo pɛ se ba wonnu gɔ te yage, se te maama dole te yage kafɛ ye te chɔge. A ta ma ja cham de lɛɛro a ba a pa-ba. De konto maama de, a nam ta wó jwoori a jeiri-ba te-ywoŋa jei ne, ye a daare a fɔge a lɔ-ba a zege lanyerane.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, nɔɔna daa bá taa tɛ ba we: ‘Kwoa mo ke ba wonnu, pa te zem laam gwori ba bia.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ko nam na wó taa ye tei to, nɔɔno maama wɛleera wó taa wo ba tete yuu ne, pa se ba te ya ŋwaane. Konto to, wolo ná done Vini tio bi-kanywaano tem, kotu tete yeila mo wó taa ŋaara.”

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Chega to, maŋa lage ka yi se amo jwoori a gwoni ni de Isarele dwi tiina bam de Judah dwi tiina bam, se ko taa ye amo ni-doore.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: “Maŋa kam ná yia, ni delo amo na wó gwoni de Isarele dwi tiina bam to mo tento: Amo wó kwei a nia yam a tiŋi ba boboŋa ne mo, ye a daare a popone-ya a yage ba bochara wone. Amo laam maa wó taa ye ba Wɛ, se ba de taa ye amo nɔɔna.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Ko daa bá taa ye fefeo se ba wolowolo bere o dwonna, naa se o ta de o chorro we, ba lɔre-na Baŋa Wɛ. Kolo ŋwaane, nɔɔna maama wó taa yei amo, ko ná maŋe ko ye nabwona de dedɛɛra de. Amo laam maa wó kwei ba keim-lwanno tem a ma chɛ-ba. A daa bá guli ba wɛleera yam gula.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wonto ma ta o we: “Amo wó sɛ se wonnu tento maama taa toŋa dɛ dɛ. Te ta ná wora, Isarele dwi dem wó taa ye teo kolo na zega, pa se ko nɔn-bia bam taa ye amo nɔɔna.

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Ne ba na ware wɛyuu kom se ba maŋe ko ni ba ti to, ye nɔɔna ta yeiri tega kuri ni na mae tei to, konto nam mo amo de bá ve Isarele dwi tiina bam ba totoŋ-balwaaro ŋwaane.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: “Maŋa lage ka yi ba na wó fɔge ba lɔ Jerusalem teo kom ba pa-ne. Ba nam wó zege Hananeli di-dedɔrɔ kom ne mo, ba lɔ ba yi Gugworo Ni dem.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Teo kom siseini dem wó zege dáane mo de yɔɔre de vo de yi Gareba zwoŋo kom, se de laam gugwoli de vo de yi Goa.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa na pɛ Jeremia ni delo to mo tento. Ko déem ke ko maŋe de Judah teo pɛ Zedekia na jege bena fuga o paare dim wone to mo. Babilon teo pɛ Nebukadeneza paare dim bena fuga-nana bene dem wone mo konto.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Babilon teo pɛ jar-keira bam mo tu ba kaare Jerusalem teo kom ba pu, de ba déem jaane Wɛ sampwora Jeremia ba pe Judah pɛ sɔŋɔ konkɔlɔ kom ne.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Judah teo pɛ Zedekia mo pe‑o da, Jeremia déem na pworisi wonnu telo Jerusalem seeni to ŋwaane. Zedekia déem ya bwɛ Jeremia o we, “Bɛ mo ye n bere we n jwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ kwora we, o lage o kwei teo kom o ke Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne mo se o di-ko?”

english_verse: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.
translation_verse: Jeremia ta tage Baŋa Wɛ kwora we, “Pɛ Zedekia bá lu Babilon tiina bam jeŋa ne. Ba wó ja‑o ba vo ba pa Babilon teo pɛ mo se ba ŋɔɔne daane.

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ba laam wó ja Zedekia ba vo Babilon. O nam wó taa wo dáane mo se amo laam ba a waare‑o. Abam ná kwaane á jaŋe de Babilon teo tiina bam, á lage á to mo. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.”

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Konto maama kwaga ne, Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta de Jeremia o we,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: “Nmo kwo choro Salum bu Hanameli wó ba n tei o ta dede‑m we, ‘Amo boŋe se a kwei a kara kalo na wo Anatofe ne to mo a yeigi a pa‑m. Nmo maŋe se n yeigi-ka, nmo na ye amo yera nɔɔno to ŋwaane.’ ”

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo dɛ n dam-fɔrɔ kom baŋa ne n toŋe wo-kamunnu mo n ke wɛyuu kom, de tega baŋa maama. Kolokolo nam tera ko na tiini ko chamma ko dwoi nmo keim.

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma kwei tɔnɔ kolo a na zi ye tega kam yera seina wo te wone to, dedaane tɔnɔ kodwoŋi na lwoni-ko ye ko ta puri to

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage kolo to mo tento: ‘Kwei twanno tento dé na popone tega kam yeilo ŋwaane to, se n laam ke-te kambia wone se te maŋe da bena dedɛ. Ke konto de tɔnɔ kolo ba na zi ba je ko baŋa ne to, de ko dwoŋi kom ta na puri to.’

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina Wɛ to na tage kolo to mo tento: ‘Maŋa wó ba se nɔɔna daa jwoori ba yeigi sam, de kare, de Vini kare teo konto wone.’ ” Jeremia wɛ-lworo

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nmo yɔɔre n jege swono mo n pae nɔɔna morro dedɛ. N nam ta pae bia yaare ba kwoa wɛleera ŋwaane. N ye Wɛ-kamunu mo ye n dam de gaale. N yere dem mo ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: N yeini n tɔge yeino dwi maama baŋa ne mo n ke totoŋ-kamunnu. Nmo yei nabiina maama kikia na ye tei to. N ma‑n ŋwe-ba se ko maŋe de chwei selo ba na tɔge to de kikia yalo ba na toŋe to.

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: Nmo déem ke totoŋ-kamunnu de wo-kenkagela Ejipti wone. Totoŋa yanto dwoŋi mo n ta jege n ke de zem maama Isarele tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina maama tei ne. Mo kokuri n yere zaŋe jei maama ne de zem.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Nmo tɔge n dam baŋa ne n toŋe wo-kamunnu dedaane wo-kenkagela se n ma‑n fugi Ejipti tiina bam ye n daare n vere n nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam ba jeŋa ne n yage.

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: N ma‑n kwei tega kanto n déem na gwoni ni ka ŋwaane de ba nabaara bam to n pa-ba. Ka maa ye tega kalo na ywomma de varem de kɔnɔ to.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Babilon tiina bam lɔge taare kamuna ba yeiri dé teo kom kabiri sem yera ne mo se ba tɔge-ya ba zo teo kom ba di debam. Jara-keim, de kana, de jawe-chɛɛro wó chɔge debam. Dé teo kom laam wo Babilon jar-keira bam jeŋa ne mo se ba wane debam. Nmo Baŋa Wɛ na tage we kolo wó yi debam to laam mo to dé baŋa ne, ye nmo tete nɛ-ko.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yei we ko bá dáane se Babilon tiina bam di dam dé teo kom baŋa ne. N nam ta pɛ amo ni se a kwei lu-nyenno a ma yeigi kara kam, se nɔɔna de maane a keim dem konto ye ba zi ba je ko ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wom. A nam ye nabiina bam maama Wɛ mo. Woŋo wora ko na tiini ko chamma ko dwoi amo keim na?

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: A lage a kwei teo konto mo a ke Pɛ Nebukadeneza de o jar-keira bam jeŋa ne se ba di-ko.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Jar-keira balo na tu se ba kwaare jara de teo kom to wó zo teo kom wone ye ba daare ba zwɛ-ko. Ba maa wó pa se mini di sam delo nɔɔna na diini de nayuni baŋa ne ye ba zwɛ wonnu ba ma ke kaanem ba pa Baal jwoni dem ba daare ba kwei sana pɛɛra ba pa wa yadwonna to. Ba totoŋa yam konto pɛ se a bane zaŋe ba baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: The kings and the officials, the priests and the prophets, and everyone else in Israel and Judah have turned from me and made me angry by worshiping idols. Again and again I have tried to teach my people to obey me, but they refuse to be corrected. I am going to get rid of Jerusalem, because its people have done nothing but evil.
translation_verse: Ba mɛ ba kwaga ba ya amo, ye ba yiga tera a wone. Amo yɔɔre a bere-ba maŋa maama mo. Ba nam wo cheigi a taane dem. Ba maa wo sɛ se a korese-ba.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Ba kwei wo-zɔɔna yalo ba na zuli to ba zege diga kalo na wora a yere zula ŋwaane to wone, ye ba da ko ŋwaane ba chɔge-ka.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma lɔ bimbina Ben-Hinom bwolo kom ne, ye ba zuli Baal jwoni dem ya baŋa ne. Ba maa yeini ba kwei ba bia ba zwɛ mini wone ba ke kaanem ba pa Moleka jwoni dem. Amo nam wo fɔge a pa-ba ni se ba ke konto. Keim-lɔŋɔ kom konto dwoŋi maŋe ko wo tu a boboŋa ne. Ba nam jege konto mo ba ke, pa se Judah tiina bam maama tiini ba tusi.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á tɛ teo konto taane á we, ‘Jara-keim, de kana, de jawe-chɛɛro mo lage te chɔge teo kom pa se ko taa wo Babilon teo pɛ jeŋa ne se o wane-ko.’ Amo Isarele tiina Baŋa Wɛ wom nam na tage tei to mo tento:

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye jei selo maama a na wó zeili a nɔɔna bam a yage da a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane to, a daa ta wó la-ba a zege da a ja a jwoori ba teo kom, se ba taa zoore ywo de yazura.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó taa ye a nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
