translation_verse: Ba ná sɛ n taane dem, naa ba ná ve-de, ko ba fea. Ba maŋe ba ye zwabani-nyena mo. Ko laam wó pa ba lɔre we Wɛ sampwora tu o wo ba tetare ne.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: Se ko ná ye nmo nabiinu, fɔge n cheigi a na jege kolo se a ta dede‑m to. Yé lwoni nankɔ-nyena dwi dem konto kikia yam dwoŋi. Puri n ni se n di kolo maama a na lage a pa‑m to.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: A laam ma nii a na jeŋa na twe ka jeeri amo, ye ka wo jege tɔnɔ na piri ko tigi da.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: O ma bwoli-ko o tiŋi a yiga ne. A ma na we ko yiga de ko kwaga maama ne, ba popone botare-bia ba ke da. Botare-bia bam bere luseim, de wo-chechɔgɔ, de lɛɛro taane yerane mo.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: O daa ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, done tɔnɔ konto a na kwei a pa‑m to maama n li n su n puga.” A ma seene a done-ko a li. Ko yɔɔre ko sona a ni ne mo, ne tooro na ye tei to.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: se ko dae sa-teene delo taane na ye de yera, ye de chana se n wane n ni de kuri to. Ko ya ná ye banto tei ne mo a toŋe‑m, ba ya wó cheigi taane dem.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Isarele dwi tiina bam bá sɛ se ba cheigi n taane dem, ba na vae se ba ni amo tete kwora to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, ba yɔɔre ba ye zwabani-nyena mo ye ba jege yi-dɛɛre.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Nmo laam ma‑n wó vo n dwi tiina balo ba na jaane-ba jara-keim baŋa ne ba kale ba vo Babilon teo ne to tei, se n ŋɔɔne de-ba. Ta de-ba we, ‘Taane dento ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage-de!’ Ba ná sɛ ba cheigi n taane dem, naa ba ná maŋe ba ve de, se n ta de-ba konto dwoŋi.”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Vio laam ma fuli ko gɔ-ne ko zege wɛɛne. A ma ni sɔɔ na nwoŋi a kwaga ne ye ko tiini ko mumuna. Ko ye wo-kenkagela na bere Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom to mo zaŋe ya jeiga kam ne.

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: A ma ni wo-kenkagela yam vɔna na mage daane ye ya sɔɔ kom zaŋe tei to, ko woli de wo-gigillu tem de na wo ya teiŋa ne to sɔɔ kom. Ko yɔɔre ko mumuni dedɛ.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Vio kom daa ta ma gɔ-ne ko ja ko viiri. A maa yɔɔre a vei ye a wo pɛ. A bane de ma tiini de zaŋe. Baŋa Wɛ dam dem nam ya tiini de daga a baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: A ma vo a yi balo ba na jaane jara-keim baŋa ne ba kale ba ba ye ba laam zoore Tɛl-Abibi ne to tei. Jei sem konto bwola de Chebara buga kam. A ma maŋe ba na zoore mɛ to da yarepɛ. A na jeini ba tetare ne konto to, a yera sɔɔre mo. Wɛ na kaane Isarele tiina tei to

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Da yarepɛ yam konto kwaga ne mo Baŋa Wɛ kwora tu amo tei ye o we:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, a le nmo mo a zege se n ta‑n yere Isarele dwi tiina bam n pa-ne. Nmo nam ye se n cheigi a kwora kam n daare n lwoni-ka n ma‑n kaane-ba mo n pa-ne.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Amo ná pɛ puseŋ-nyeno kwora we, ‘N jege se n te mo,’ ye nmo wo vei n kaane‑o, kotu wó seene o te o tusim kikia ŋwaane. Nmo ná wo maŋe ko kuri n bere‑o se o yage o keim-lwanno tem se o wane o ŋwea o jwoŋi, o jege se o te mo. A nam wó bwei nmo mo o toone dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná vei n kaane kotu, ye o ná ve se o za o puseŋa kikia yam de o totoŋ-lwanno tem, o ta wó te mo o tusim kikia yam ŋwaane. Nmo tete nam wó fwoli n ba ŋona.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Nɔn-ŋom ná yage totoŋ-laaro kikia ye o bobo se o taa toŋe lwarem, ye amo ná chege o chwoŋa, kotu de jege se o te mo. Nmo ná wo kaane‑o, o wó seene o te o wɛleera yam ŋwaane. Amo yiga bá taa wo o keim-laaro tem wone, ye a nam wó bwei‑m o toone dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná kaane kotu we o daa yé ke wɛleere pa o seene o wo ke-de, o daa bá te, o na sɛ kaanem dem to ŋwaane. Nmo de maa wó fwoli n ba ŋona.”

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: Dáane mo Baŋa Wɛ dam dem wo amo baŋa ne. O ma ta de amo o we, “Zaŋe n nwoŋi n vo te-kampare laŋa kam seeni, se a lage a ŋɔɔne dede‑m dáane mo.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: A ma seene a vo te-kampare sem. A ma na we Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom wo jei sem konto ne. Ko nye de a ya na nɛ-ko tei ye a wo Chebara buga kam ni ne to mo. A ma to a vwi a yibia tega ne.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Vio ma fuli ko zo-ne pa a zaŋe a zege wɛɛne. Baŋa Wɛ ma ŋɔɔne de amo o we, “Jwoori n vo sɔŋɔ, se n pe n tete n yage diga ne.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: A maa wó pa n ni meeri pa se n jeini da chemm. N bá‑n wane n kaane-ba, de ba na yɔɔre ba ye zwabani-nyena tei to de.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Maŋa nam ná yia se a ŋɔɔne dede‑m, a laam wó puri n ni se n daare n ta de-ba we, ‘Taane dento ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage-de.’ Balo na wó cheigi taane dem to wó yɔɔre ba sɛ-de. Balo de na wó ve-de to jege se ba taa ye konto. Kokuri to, ba dwi dem ye zwabani-nyena mo.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, kwei biri n tiŋi n yiga ne, se n daare n la bibeiri de yera ne se se lwoni Jerusalem teo kom na ye tei to.

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: Laam ke se ko bere we jar-keira kaare teo kom mo ba pu. Dogele kandwa, de teero n ja n di teo kom kabira kam yuu, se n daare n chwi vwoa se jar-keira bam taa zoore ya wone. Ta tiŋi da-kwollu telo ba na wó kwei ba ma mage kabira kam ba bwori to n kaare teo kom.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: N laam wó lage luu zon-tanlaŋa mo se ka ji kabira ka che nmo de teo kom kabira kam daane. Pipiri n yibia n jeeri teo kom nenɛɛne n tete mo li-ko n pu de jara. Keim dem konto ye se ko kaane Isarele dwi tiina bam mo.

english_verse: After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for
translation_verse: Nmo wó ta‑n tigi da da bia yatɔ de funogo (

english_verse: more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.
translation_verse: ), se ko bere we n zeŋe Judah dwi tiina bam wɛleera. Da yam konto de wó zege ya pa bena yalo Judah tiina de na yaare ba wɛleera ŋwaane to mo.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Pipiri n jeeri Jerusalem teo de ko jara yam nyenyego kom, se n pu n jagula ko baŋa ne n pworisi n chɔge-ko.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: La banina, de chaara, de swoona, de sia, de mena, de kadaga n ke-te kambi-zɔŋɔ wone, se n daare n ma-te n wɔ bworobworo n ta‑n jege n di. Wodiu kom konto mo nmo wó ta‑n di da bia yatɔ de funogo (

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma ta o we, “Tento bere Isarele tiina bam na wó ke tei ye ba di wodiiru telo na wo maŋe de chullu tem to dwi-gɛ tiina bam tetare ne, mɛ amo na wó zeili-ba se ba taa zoore to.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Amo ma ta a we, “Jan ja! Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, yé pa se a ke konto dwoŋi. Ko na zege a biini ne se ko yi leile, amo ta wo biini a tete de wodiiru telo na wo maŋe de chullu tem to. A bere a wo di wo-teko, naa woŋo kolo kago-vara na jaane ba go to.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Wɛ laam ma leiri o we, “Tɔ. A nam pɛ‑m chwoŋa se n kwei na-beinnu n ma n wɔ n bworobworo kom, se n daa‑n yé ma nabiinu beinnu n wɔ-ko.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: O ta ma ta o we, “Nabiinu, a lage a pa Jerusalem teo kom ga wodiu mo. Ko nɔn-bia bam wó taa lare wodiiru ba di fenfee ye lwia jege-ba. Ba ta wó taa twei na fenfee ba nyɔ de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: Kokuri to, wodiiru de na wó tiini te taa jege zore. Teo kom nɔɔna bam ná nii daane, ba yera wó sɔɔre mo. Ba maa wó bugi ba jei ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, kwei se-zɔɔ kolo ni na di lanyerane to n ma n fane n twana yam de n yu-ywei sem. Maŋe-te se n lɔre te dunni na mae tei to, se n daare n pɔɔre-te kuni betɔ.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Nmo ná kwaare jara de Jerusalem teo nyenyego kom n ti, se n kwei n twana yam, de n yu-ywei sem popɔra betɔ wone dedoa n zwɛ teo nyenyego kom wone. N ta wó kwei se popɔra betɔ wone dedoa n ja n nwoŋi teo kom dáa ne n zage n gwo de se-zɔɔ. Ta daare n kwei se popɔra betɔ wone dedoa n dole n yage se vio ja-se ko jage. Amo laam wó kwei a se-zɔɔ mo a ma a pare-se.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Nam daare yu-ywei fenfee se n kwei-se n vɔ n gɔrɔ ni ne.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: N daa‑n wó le yu-ywei sem konto wone mo, se n dole-se n de mini dem wone se se zwɛ. Mini dem konto mo lage de di de jage de yi Isarele dwi tiina bam maama.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Konto lage ko bere Jerusalem teo kom na ye tei to mo. A ya kwei-ko a zege dwi-gɛ tiina tetare ne mo, ye ba teene dem gilimi-ko de ke tetare ne.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Ko nɔn-bia bam nam nwoŋi a kwaga ne mo, ye ba toŋe puseŋa kikia yerane se ko dwoni dwi tiina balo na gilimi-ba to kikia na ye tei to. Ba yɔɔre ba ve a nia yam de a bera yam mo.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: Abam zwabania kikia maŋe ya dwoi teene delo na gilimi abam de ke tetare ne to, ye á ba tɔge a bera yam. Á nam ba sɛ a nia yam. Ko ná maŋe ko ye dwi tiina balo na gilimi abam to chullu tem, á wo kwaane á ke tento na bere tei to.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Kwoa wó tɔge ko baŋa ne ba di ba bia, ye bia de di ba kwoa, kana na jege-ba to ŋwaane. Amo wó waare abam á wɛleera ŋwaane. A ta wó jage abam wone balo na daare to a yage tega baŋa jei maama ne.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage tento mo we: Ne amo na jege ŋwea tei to, ko yɔɔre ko ye chega mo we a jaane boboŋa se a ti abam mo, á na biini amo wara-jei sem de wo-zɔɔna, de totoŋ-vɛɛsa dwi maama to ŋwaane. A bá ŋɔne a pa abam naa a duri á yibwona kɔtaa!

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Abam teo nɔɔna bam popɔra betɔ wone dedoa mo lage ba maŋe teo kom wone ba te jawe-chɛɛro, de kana ŋwaane. Popɔra betɔ wone dedoa maa wó nwoŋi ye á dona bam go-ba jara baŋa ne. Á popɔra betɔ wone dedoa kalo na daare to, a maa wó jage-ba jei maama ne, ye a ta kwei a se-zɔɔ a pare-ba se a go.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Abam ná nɛ á lɛɛro tento, dwi-gɛ tiina bam wó taa jege abam ba twea ye ba mɔna. Ba nam ta wó kɔre foone de amo na yɔɔre a chɔge abam tei a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane to. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se kana de kago-vara ba á baŋa de dam. Te nam wó ti á bia maama se á daa yé ta‑á jege bia. Jawe-chɛɛro, de tigura, de jara-keim wó to á tetare ne se te go abam. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora tu ka yi amo we:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, pa n yibia jeeri Isarele peero tem seeni se n daare n pworisi taane n chɔge-te

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: we, ‘Isarele peero tem, cheigi-na Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora. Tento mo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage de peero tem, de zwonnu tem, de gugworru tem, de bwollu tem: A lage a pa jara mo zaŋe á jei sem maama ne, se a chɔge mɛ nɔɔna bam na diini ba zuli jwona da to.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Amo wó yigi ba kaanem bimbina yam a de tega ne, ye a daare a chochoge bimbina yalo ba na zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa ya baŋa ne to. Nɔɔna bam ná zege ba jwona yam yiga ne ba zuli-ya, amo wó go-ba dáane mo.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Twa wó taa tigi jei maama abam tetare ne. Konto maama baŋa ne mo á wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: A nam wó pa abam badwonna chwoŋa se ba lu toone. Banto bá te jara wone, ba na jage ba zo teene dedwonna wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. A na tage we a lage a pa lɛɛro telo yi-ba to, ko dae we a tɛ de a ni yerane mo.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Mage n je sem daane, se n ta‑n nɔne n nɛ tega ne de dam, ye n daare n laare de wo-chechɔgɔ we, ‘Lɛɛro na!’ Ke konto Isarele dwi tiina bam totoŋ-lwanno, de ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam ŋwaane. Ba nam lage ba te jara, de kana, de jawe-chɛɛro baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Wolo na wo sa-teo wone to, jawe-chɛɔ mo wó go‑o. Wolo na bwola to de maa wó te jara wone. Wolo na daare ye o lu toone to de maa wó te de kana. A lage a tiini a waare-ba konto dwoŋi mo a ban-lom dem ŋwaane.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne ba wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. Ko nam wó ke ne ba ná nɛ we ba tete tiina twa tigi ba faare tega baŋa jei maama. Ko wó taa ye ba jwona yam tetare ne, de ba kaanem bimbina yam teiŋa ne, de zwonnu tem de peero tem maama yuni ne, de tei-kamunnu kura ne mɛ ba ya na kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa ba kaane ba pa ba jwona yam maama to mo.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Amo wó zeiŋi a jeŋa mo se a waare-ba se a daare a chɔge ba tega kam se ka ji di-dwonnu yerane, ko zege kagoa kam ne se ko yi Dibila. Amo wó chɔge jei selo maama ba na zoore to. Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora tu ka yi amo we:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de Isarele teo kom to mo tento: Lɛɛro maŋa yi ka ti! Maŋa yi se abam tega kam ni maama chɔge.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: A bá ŋɔne a pa abam naa a duri á yibwona. A nam lage a waare abam mo chwei selo á na tɔge to ŋwaane, de á na yɔɔre á ke totoŋ-vɛɛsa tei to. Konto baŋa ne á wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Chɔgem maŋa yia! Lɛɛro tem lage te yi lela! Te nam diini á baŋa mo. Fɔge-na á nii-na!

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Ba nankɔɔre kikia yam daga ya gaale, pa se ya ji da-lɔŋɔ kolo na wora puseŋa ŋwaane to mo. Ba wolowolo nam daa bá daare. Ba kɔ-fɔrɔ kom, de ba jejegero tem, de ba dunni dem maama wó ti mo.

english_verse: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
translation_verse: Ba wugi nabɔnɔ se nɔɔna ti ba yiga jara ŋwaane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá nwoŋi o vo o kwaare jara yam. Kokuri to, amo bane mo zaŋe ba kɔ-fɔrɔ kom maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Jara-keim mo wo pwola ne. Ko daare ye jaweero de kana wo sam dem wone. Balo na wo pwola ne to wó te jara yam baŋa ne mo. Jaweero de kana maa wó go balo na wo teo kom wone to.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Balo na maŋe se ba lu to wó duri ba vo peero jei ne mo ba taa wora. Ba maa wó taa keera ne kunkwona na keeri tei to, se nɔɔno maama taa keeri o tete wɛleera ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama vɔna wó pare, ye ba nadwoona taa mage daane.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Ba wó zo gare-nyenyaaro, ye foone de ja-ba. Ba yiga maa wó nyɔne chaveera ŋwaane, ye ba cheeri ba yuni wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Ba wó dole ba lu-nyenno tem ba yage teo kom chwei sem yuu ne, ye ba ke ba sabu-seŋa kam ne ka ye wo-yɔɔ mo to. Ba lu-nyenno tem de ba sabu-seŋa kam maama bá wane te jwoŋi-ba te yage Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom dɛ dem ne. Ba jejegero tem konto bá pa-ba wodiu se ba di ba su ba kana. Te nam ye wonnu telo na pɛ ba tusi to mo.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Ba ya jege teera mo de ba wo-nyenno tem, ye ba kwei-te ba ma ba ke wo-zɔɔna nyenyero se ba taa zuli-te. A nam wó pa wonnu tem konto pipiri te ji wo-yɔɔro te pa-ba.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: A lage a kwoli a yibia mo se dwi-gɛ tiina bam na chwoŋa ba zo jeiga kalo na jege a fera to, ye ba daare ba biini-ka. Venverena mo wó biini-ka konto.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Fɔge-na chegero á tiŋi a nɔɔna bam ŋwaane. Kokuri nɔɔna swoi nɔn-gora kikia de vuvuga totoŋa mo teo kom maama ne.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye ba sam dem, a lage a pa teene delo nɔɔna puseŋa na gaale to mo ba ba jwoŋi-de ba taa tei. A maa wó pa se ba babɛ sem dam ti, se venverena de ba ba biini ba wara-jei sem.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Chanɛɛre dem ná yi-ba, ba laam wó beeri yazura jei ba ga.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro tem wó ba te daŋe da-baŋa ne. Ba ta wó ni sawea ba woli sawea kadwoŋi baŋa ne. Ba ta wó vo Wɛ sampwora tei se o le wonnu o bere-ba ye ba ga ko ŋwa. Wɛ bera yam nam wó jei o kaanem tiina bam ni ne. Teo kom nakwa bam de daa bá taa tɛ yi-poro taane.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom wó taa keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane, ye o dedɛɛro wom teena de ti. Foone maa wó ja teo kom nɔɔna bam se ba yera taa sae. A lage a ke-ba se ko maŋe de ba kikia na ye tei to mo. A ta wó di ba taane se ko tɔge de ba tete chullu tem na bere tei to. Ba laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Bena yaredo bene dem chane seredo chana kam da yanu dɛ dem ne, mo a jei de Judah teo nakwa bam a tete sɔŋɔ ne. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ dam dem ma pɔpɔ de ba amo baŋa.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: A ma nii a na woŋo na nye de nabiinu to a yiga ne. O teiŋa seeni se ko taa tu to yɔɔre ko di mo ne mini na ye tei to. O teiŋa seeni se ko taa diini de maa nyeena ne channa na tiini ka nyeene tei to.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: O ma pa woŋo na nye de o jeŋa to twe ka ja-ne a yu-ywei sem seeni. Vio laam ma fuli ko gɔ-ne wɛɛne pa a jaane a lei tega kam de wɛyuu tetare laŋa ne. Ko ma tɔge wonnu telo Wɛ na veere o bere-ne to baŋa ne, ko kwei-ne ko ja ko vo Jerusalem. A ma vo a yi Wɛ diga kam tetare konkɔlɔ kom ni delo na jeeri baŋa seeni to. Dáane mo jwoni nyenyego kolo na chuchugi Wɛ bane to yɔɔre de zega.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: A ma nii a na we Isarele tiina Wɛ wom nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom wo dáane. Ko nye de nyenyego kolo Wɛ ya na le o bere-ne ye a wo bwolo kom tega ne to mo.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, kwoni n yuu n nii baŋa seeni.” A na nii baŋa seeni to, mo a nɛ jwoni delo na chuchugi Wɛ bane dem to. De maa zege de maŋe de bimbini dem baŋa seeni ni dem.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, n nɛ totoŋ-nɛ selo Isarele dwi tiina bam na jege ba ke ywo-seeni to na? Ba yɔɔre ba ke totoŋ-zɔɔna se ba zeili-ne pa se a vo yiga yiga a daare a wara-jei sem mo. Nam ta‑n yei we, n wó na totoŋ-vɛɛsa na dwoi tento.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: O laam ma ja-ne pa dé vo dé yi Wɛ diga kam konkɔlɔ kom ni dem. A ma nii a na bɔɔne de na wo kabiri kam yera ne.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, fɔge n bɔɔre bɔɔne n ke kabiri kam yera ne.” A na ke konto to, mo a nɛ ni na tigi da.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: O daa ma ta o we, “Tɔge ni dem n zo se n na lwarem de wo-zɔɔna kikia yalo ba na jege ba toŋe ywo-seeni to.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: A ma zo da, ye a na we ba gɔgere wo-zɔɔna dwi dwi nyenyero mo ba yage kabira kam yera maama ne. Nyenyero tem bere tega-veila, de vare-balwaaro, de Isarele dwi tiina na kaane jwona yalo dwi maama to mo.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina nakwa fuserepɛ maa zege nyenyero tem yiga ne, ye Safan bu Jazania wo ba tetare ne. Ba maa zei min-chala zwe ye ba zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa pa se ka nyoa zaŋa wɛɛne.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: O ma bwei amo o we, “Nabiinu, n nɛ Isarele dwi tiina nakwa bam na seigi lim wone ba ke wonnu telo na? Nɔɔno maama seigi o jwoni nyenyero diga ne mo o ke o na lage tei. Ba maa tɛ ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ ba nae debam. Baŋa Wɛ viiri o daare dé teo kom mo.’ ”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: O daa ma ja-ne o vo o yi Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ni delo na jeeri baŋa seeni to. A ma na kaana na jei da ye ba keeri Tammuza keira kam.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, n nɛ konto de na? Nam ta‑n yei we, n wó na totoŋ-vɛɛsa na dwoi tento.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, n nɛ konto de na? Judah dwi tiina bam na ke wo-zɔɔna yalo maama ywo-seeni to, ba boŋe we ya dae kolokolo mo na? Ba nam ta jege nankɔɔre totoŋa mo ba ke teo kom ni maama ne ba woli da, pa se ba chuchugi a bane se ko gaale. Nii ba na jege-ne ba twea tei!

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: O laam ma bage de kwor-dɛa ye a ni we, “Abam balo na jege se á waare teo kom to, fɔɔre-na á yi ywo, ye á maama zei jara zela se á ma‑á chɔge-ko!”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna baredo ma pi ba nwoŋi ba tɔge Wɛ diga kam ni delo na wo baŋa seeni to ba beene. Ba dedoa maama maa jege jara-keim zele na sele chekke to o jeŋa ne. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi maa wo ba tei ne. O déem zo gare-fefala mo ye o vɔ tɔnɔ poponem zela o teiŋa ne. Ba maama ma vo ba zege channa bimbini dem teiŋa ne.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Isarele tiina Wɛ wom nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma gɔ ko tete mɛ ko ya na dɔge cherubi wo-kenkagela yam baŋa ne to. Ko laam ma vo ko yi Wɛ diga kam ni dem seeni. Baŋa Wɛ ma bwoŋi nɔɔno wolo na zo gare-fefala kam ye o jege tɔnɔ poponem zela to

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Kaare Jerusalem teo kom ni maama se n beeri balo maama na suuri de wo-chechɔgɔ wo-zɔɔna kikia yalo na jege ya ke teo kom wone to ŋwaane, se n daare n ke daale n yage ba tira ne.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Yɔɔre á ta‑á goe nɔn-kwe, de nɔn-donno, de ka-bwona, ko ta woli de bia de kaana dwi maama. Nam yé go-na balo na jege daala yam ba tira ne to. Nam bobo-na amo diga kam ni ne se á ta‑á goe á via.” Ba ma seene ba bobo ba go nakwa balo na wo Wɛ diga kam yiga ne to.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: O ta ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Dole-na twa bam á yage Wɛ diga kam konkwallo tem jei maama ne se ko pa wara-jei sem biini. Véi-na á bobo totoŋa!” Ba ma seene ba zo teo kom wo ba kaare ko ni maama ba goe yɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ne o we, “Isarele de Judah dwi tiina bam na tusi tei to tiini ko kɛ jeŋa mo. Nɔɔna kare ba goe daane tega kam ni maama ne mo, ye chega kam ba toŋa teo kom wone. Ba ta maa tɛ ba we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ viiri o daare dé teo kom mo. Baŋa Wɛ ba nae dé kikia yam.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Amo nam bá ŋɔne a pa-ba naa a duri ba yibwona kɔtaa! A yɔɔre a lage a pa ko ni-ba mo se ko maŋe de ba totoŋ-lwanno tem.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na zo gare-fefala kam ye o jege tɔnɔ poponem zela to ma jwoori ye o ta de Baŋa Wɛ o we, “A ke n ni dem ne mo.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: A ma nii wɛyuu pwola kalo na tigi cherubi wo-kenkagela yam yuni tem baŋa seeni to a na woŋo na nye de paare yituŋu ye Safira mo ba mɛ ba ke-ko to.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de nɔɔno wolo na zo gare-fefala kam to o we, “Véi n zo wo-gigillu tem na viviriga cherubi wo-kenkagela yam kuri dem seeni to tetare ne. Laam le min-chala da tetei nmo na wó wane n pɛ to, se n daare n ja-ya n zo Jerusalem teo kom wone n laam dole n yage ko ni maama ne.” A maa zege da a nia ye o seene o zo.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom na zo wo-kenkagela yam tetare ne konto to, ya wo Wɛ diga kam tega-kuri seeni mo. Kunkwoŋo ma tu ko su konkɔlɔ kolo na wo tetare ne to maama.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma gɔ ko tete mɛ ko ya na dɔge cherubi wo-kenkagela yam baŋa ne to ko fɔɔre ko yi Wɛ diga kam ni dem seeni. Kunkwoŋo kom ma lware ko pe Wɛ diga kam maama, ye ka konkɔlɔ kom de yɔɔre ko nyeene de Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom pwooni.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Cherubi wo-kenkagela yam na vei ye ya vɔna wuuri tei to, ko sɔɔ kom ma ni ko yi Wɛ diga kam da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom. Ko maa nye de Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom kwora na dɔne tei to.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Cherubi wo-kenkagela yam dedoa ma kwei o jeŋa o tore mini delo na wo ya tetare ne de di to o twoŋi min-chala de wone. O ma kwei min-chala yam o ke nɔɔno wolo na zo gare-fefala kam to jeŋa ne, ye o de jwoŋi-ya o nwoŋi o kɛ.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: A ma nii a na woŋo kolo na nye de nabiinu jeŋa to cherubi wo-kenkagela yam dedoa maama vɔŋɔ maama kuri ne.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Wo-gigillu tena tem maama nye daane mo. Wo-gigilu maama maa nye de ko jege wo-gigilu kodwoŋi na wo ko wone ko gare-ko to mo.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Yia mo yɔɔre ya faare ya yera yam maama, ko ná ye ya kwaga kam, de ya je sem, de ya vɔna yam, ko ta woli de wo-gigillu telo na wo ya yana yam maama tei ne to.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Amo ma ni ba na bwoŋi wo-gigillu tem yere we, “Wo-gigillu telo na viviriga to.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Wo-kenkagele maama jege yibi sena mo. Boboa yibia kam ye nabea nyem mo. Yibia balei tu maa ye nabiinu nyem. Yibia batɔ tu wom ye nywoŋo nyem mo, ye kalo na kweeli to ye maao yibia.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Ya nam ná maŋe mɛ ya zege, wo-gigillu tem de wó taa zege konto mo. Ya daa ná zaŋe ya jaane wɛɛne, wo-gigillu tem de maa tɔge-ya te jaana. Kokuri to, wo-kenkagela yam jworo wo wo-gigillu tem wone mo.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom maa zaŋe Wɛ diga kam ni ne ko vo ko zege cherubi wo-kenkagela yam na wo mɛ to baŋa seeni.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: A na zege da a nii to, mo wo-kenkagela yam yarege ya vɔna yam ya jaane ya di wɛɛne. Ya na maa vei to, wo-gigillu tem tɔge te wo ya tei ne mo. Ya ma vo ya zege Wɛ diga kam wɛ-puli seeni ni dem ne. Isarele tiina Wɛ wom nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom maa wo ya baŋa kam seeni.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Wo-kenkagela yam konto mo a ya nɛ Chebara buga kam ni ne ye ya wo Isarele tiina Wɛ wom kuri ne. A laam lɔre we ya seene ya ye cherubi mo.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Ya yibi sem maa nye de yibi selo a ya na nɛ Chebara buga kam ni ne to. Wo-kenkagele delo yiga maa na yɔɔre mɛ to, de yɔɔre de vei konto mo yɔrɔ-tɔtɔ.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: ye a de lwoni kolo maama Wɛ na le o bere-ne to a bere nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta de amo o we, “Nabiinu, n nɛ nɔɔna banto na? Banto yɔɔre ba jei ba boŋe lwarem kikia yerane mo. Ba ta maa swoi se ba taa bere teo kom nɔɔna se ba ke puseŋa.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Ba maa tɛ ba we, ‘Ko dae se dé zaŋe dé lɔ sam lela. Dé teo kom nye de kambia mo, ye debam ye ne nɔna yalo na wo ka wone to.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, condemn them!”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, nabiinu, yɔɔre n pworisi n chɔge-ba.”

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ Jworo ma ba amo baŋa, ye o ta de amo o we, “Ja kwora kanto n vo n pa Isarele dwi tiina bam. Ta de-ba we, Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo yei kolo maama á na boŋe á yuni ne to.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Abam tiini á go teo konto nɔɔna dedɛ pa se ko chwei sem maama su de twa.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Abam dona wó taa goe abam mo jara ne ba vo ba kwaare Isarele laŋa kam siseini ni ne, se á laam wane á lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Teo konto bá taa nye de kambia se ko taa cho abam. Abam tete bá taa ye ne nɔna yalo na wo ka wone to. A nam lage a waare abam mo a vo a kwaare á teo kom siseini ni ne.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Á laam wó ba á lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ. Kokuri to, abam yɔɔre á ve a bera yam mo. Á wo toŋe á tɔge amo chullu tem, ye á jwoori á ke teene delo na gilimi abam to chullu tem na bere tei to.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, nii Jerusalem teo nɔn-bia bam na tɛ n chorro tem taane tei to. Ko ye n tete yera nɔɔna bam de Isarele dwi dem maama taane mo ba tɛ ye ba we, ‘Dé chorro tem laam vei yiga yiga pa se ba daa ba bwola de Baŋa Wɛ. Ko nam ye tega kanto mo Wɛ kwei o pa debam se dé taa tei.’

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ta tento we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: A seene a le a nɔɔna bam a pa ba vo yiga yiga se a yage-ba logo baŋa teene dem jei maama wone. De ko de, maŋa kalo ba ta na wo sa-teene wone to, amo tete mo wó taa ye wara-jei a pa-ba, se ba taa zuli-ne da.’

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná jwoori da, ba wó le jwo-yɔɔro de wo-zɔɔna dwi maama ka wone.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: A maa wó pa ba taa jege wo-dedoa ba ma zuli-ne, ye a pa-ba boboŋ-doora. A ta wó pa se ba wo daa yé ke dam, se a daare a pa ba yi taa bwona.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ko daare, balo wo na dɛ se ba taa kaane ba wo-zɔɔna nyenyero de ba jwo-yɔɔro to, a lage a waare-ba mo se ko maŋe de ba wɛleera na ye tei to. Amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.”

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na ŋɔɔne o ti to, cherubi wo-kenkagela yam ma gɔ ya tete ya yarege ya vɔna ya jaane ya di wɛɛne, ye wo-gigillu tem tɔge te wo ya tei ne. Isarele tiina Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom pwooni maa wo ya baŋa kam seeni.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, nmo zoore zwabani-nyena tetare ne mo. Ba seene ba jege yia, ya nam ba nae. Ba ta jege zwa, ba nam ba ni taane kuri. Kokuri to, ba yɔɔre ba ye zwabani-nyena mo.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, kwaleme n zela n ke daane ne wolo ba na fe se o viiri o daare o teo to. Laam zaŋe wea tetare ne se n nwoŋi n daare n na zoore mɛ to n vo jeiga kadwoŋi, se nɔɔna bam na n na ke tei to. Ba wó wane ba ni n kikia yam kuri, de ba na ye zwabani-nyena tei to de.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Lu n zela wea tetare ne n ja n nwoŋi n diga ne, ye nɔɔna bam maama zege ba nia. Dedaan-ni ne laam nwoŋi pwooni n ke ne wolo na lage o vo sa-teo to na wó ke tei to.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó taa nii‑m mo, ye n vo n lu bɔɔne n sɔŋɔ kom kabira yera ne se n tɔge de wone n nwoŋi de n zela yam.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Wɛ-zoore maŋa ne se n kwei n zela yam n daŋe n bakale baŋa ne n kɛ, ye ba zege ba nii‑m. Nmo nam jege se n kwoli n yibia mo se n yé ta‑n nii n nae tega kam. A kuri se nmo mo ji memaŋe n pa Isarele dwi tiina bam.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: A ma seene a ke ne Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ-ne ni se a ke tei to. Wea ne a lugi a zela mo a ja a nwoŋi diga ne, ne wolo na lage o viiri o daare o teo to. Wɛ-zoore maŋa ne a ma lu bɔɔne de a jea kabira kam yera ne. A ma tɔge da a nwoŋi de a zela, ya na daŋe a bakale baŋa ne, ye nɔɔna bam zege ba nia.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, Isarele dwi zwabani-nyena banto wo bwei‑m n keim dem kuri na?

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Nam ta de-ba we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Kwora kanto mo ye se ka pa Jerusalem teo dedɛɛro wom, de Isarele dwi tiina balo maama na zoore ko wone to.’

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Wolo na ye dedɛɛro ba wone to wó lu o zela o bukki o bakale baŋa ne mo wɛ-zoore maŋa ne. O maa wó tɔge bɔɔne delo ba na lugi kabira yera ne ba pa‑o to o viiri. O ná maa via, o wó kwoli o yibia mo se o yé taa nii o nae tega kam.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam wó che a kalanchogo se ko ja‑o. A maa wó pa ba kale‑o ba vo Babilon tiina teo. O wó te jei sem konto ne. O yi nam bá na teo kom na ye tei to.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye o kwaga nɔɔna bam de o jar-keira bam, a lage a pa ba jage jei maama ne sae mo, se a laam kwei a se-zɔɔ a ma a pare-ba.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: A ná jage-ba pa ba vo yiga yiga se a yage-ba logo baŋa teene dem jei maama wone, mo ba laam wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: A nam wó yage ba fee se ba lu jara yam wone, de kana, de jaweero wone. Konto to, ba ná yi sa-teene delo maama ba zoore de wone, ba laam wó maane ba lɔre ba wo-zɔɔna kikia yam maama ni ne. Ba maa wó wane ba lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, n ná yeini n di wodiu, pa n yera taa sae. N ta ná nyɔ na, se n bere we lwia de foone mo jege‑m.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: Ta de teo konto nɔɔna bam we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei se ko vo balo na zoore Jerusalem ne, de Isarele laŋa kam maama ne to mo tento: Ba wó taa di ba wodiiru de lwia mo, ye ba ta nyɔ ba na de wo-chechɔgɔ. Kokuri to, ba teo kom lage ko chɔge mo se kolokolo daa yé daare. Ko nam ye ba nankɔɔre kikia yam ŋwaane mo konto wó ke.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Teene delo nɔɔna na zoore de wone leile to wó ji di-dwonnu mo, se tega kam maama de chɔge. Abam laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, Isarele tiina bam boŋe bɛ mo ye ba tɛ memaŋe dento ba we, ‘Maŋa dedɛ maŋe ka kɛ, ye Wɛ na pɛ veera yalo maama to jigi kafɛ’?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Nam ta de-ba we, ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo lage a pa se Isarele tiina bam yage memaŋe dem konto taane mo.’ Laam nam bere-ba we, ‘Maŋa yia se veera maama laam ji chega.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam daa bá taa ni veera yalo na ye vwa to, de yi-nɛɛre taana yalo na soge-ba to.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam wó yɔɔre a ta a na lage tei to mo, ye ko bá dáane se a taane dem ji chega. Abam zwabani-nyena bam, ta‑á yei-na we, á ta ná ŋwe, amo na wó ta woŋo kolo maama to wó seene ko ji chega. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, Isarele dwi tiina bam kare ba tɛ nmo taane ba we, ‘Veera yalo o na nɛ to wó dáane se ya ji chega. O taana yam dae leile ŋwaane.’

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, pworisi taane n chɔge Isarele tiina sampwori selo zem na pworisi to. Ta de balo na jege ba tete boboŋa ba mae ba pworisi to we, ‘Cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Ko ná ye sampwori selo na tɔge ba tete boboŋa ŋwaane ba pworisi jworim ye ba wo nɛ kolokolo to, lɛɛro wo ba yuu ne.

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, á sampwori sem nye de nywoŋ-kuri na kare di-dwonnu baŋa ne ba beeri to mo.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Ba veera yam gane nɔɔna mo, ye ba yi-nɛɛre taana ye vwa yerane. Ba kare ba tɛ we amo Baŋa Wɛ mo toŋe-ba de a kwora, ye a wo toŋe-ba. Ba maa boŋe we a wó pa ba taane dem ji chega.

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Ta-yɔɔro telo á na jege á tɛ to, de á veera yalo na ye vwa to ŋwaane, amo dwoni de abam mo.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye sampwori selo maama veera na ye wo-yɔɔro ye ba yi-nɛɛre taana yam ye vwa to, a lage a dole-ba jaguli-zane mo. Ba daa bá tɔge ba woli a nɔɔna kɔ-fɔrɔ kom wone, naa ba popone ba yera Isarele dwi dem natɔga twanno tem wone. Ba nam bá jwoori ba zo ba tete teo kom. Konto to, á wó ba á lɔre we amo mo ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Sampwori sem konto pae a nɔɔna bam tusi mo. Ba kare ba tɛ we, “Yazura taa wo á tei ne”, ye yazura tera se ya yi a nɔɔna bam. Ko nye de nɔɔna na lɔge kabiri-memena tei, ye sampwori sem konto laam kwei tentwarem ba taare ka maama to mo.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Ka laam maa wó to buru-tu-tu, se nɔɔna bwei abam we, “Tentwarem dem á na mɛ á taare kabiri kam to laam bɛ?”

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: A lage a tɔge a ban-lom dem ŋwaane mo a toŋe vo-dɛɔ, de do-fɔrɔ, de do-kandwa se tento ba te chɔge kabira kam.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: A wó yigi kabira kalo á na kwei tentwarem á taare ka maama to mo a de tega ne ye a daare a guri-ka a ja tega. Ka nam wó to ka pane abam, pa se abam tete de chɔge. Konto to á wó ba á lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Amo bane wó tiini de zaŋe de kabira kam, de sampwori selo na jege tentwarem ba taare-ka to. A laam maa wó ta de abam we, “Kabiri kam de balo na jege-ka ba taare to maama jei.

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: Banto maa ye balo ya na kare ba pworisi Jerusalem teo kom taane ye ba bere we yazura wó taa wo ko baŋa ne, ye yazura nam tera to.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto!’

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: Nabiinu, ta ŋɔɔne n chɔge kaana balo na yeini ba jege ba tete boboŋa ba mae ba pworisi to. Pworisi n chɔge-ba,

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Kwora yalo á na yeini á jwoŋi amo nɔɔna bam tei ne to mo ye mena de bworobworo fenfee, ye konto ŋwaane á jege-ne á lwɛa ba yiga ne. Konto to á yeini á fɔ vwa á gane balo de na swoi se ba taa cheigi vwa to mo. Abam laam ma da ko ŋwaane á jege balo na wo maŋe se ba te to á goe, ye á ta pae se balo na maŋe de toone to kare ba via.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage tei to mo tento: Amo chuli liri selo á na jege á ma á vɔ nɔɔna se ba taa toe ba pae abam ne zuna dwoŋi to. A nam wó bwoli liri sem á je sem ne, pa se nɔɔna balo á na vɔge á pa á tete to viiri zɛɛra.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye á yu-kwale sem, a lage a kaare-se a yage, se a jwoŋi a nɔɔna bam á jeŋa ne a yage mo. Ba daa bá taa wo abam dam kuri ne. Abam de laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Abam pɛ nɔn-ŋona vɔna pare de á vwa yalo á na jege á gane-ba to, ye amo ya ba beeri ba wo-chechɔgɔ. Á ma daare á ke dam puseŋ-nyena kuri ne, se ba yé yage ba puseŋa kikia yam ye ba daare ba jwoŋi ba ŋwea.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane abam daa bá ta‑á nae veera na ye wo-yɔɔro to naa á tɔge yi-nɛɛre kikia. A maa wó jwoŋi a nɔɔna bam a yage á jeŋa ne. Konto to á laam wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.’ ”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo Isarele teo nakwa badwonna tu a tei ba jeini a yiga ne, se ba bwei ba lɔre Wɛ boboŋa na ye tei to.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora ma yi amo we:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, nɔɔna banto kwei jwona kaanem mo ba feiri ba bochara ne, ye ba puuri wo-yɔɔro telo na pa ba tusi to ba ja. Bɛŋwaane mo a nam wó pa se ba lɔre a boboŋa na ye tei to?

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: A lage a ke konto mo se a pipiri Isarele tiina bam boboŋa se ya jwoori ya tɔge-ne, ba na mɛ ba kwaga ba ya amo ye ba daare ba zuli jwona to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: Nam ta de Isarele dwi tiina bam we, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: ‘Leiri-na á boboŋa! Yage-na jwona kaanem, se á daare á ve totoŋ-zɔɔna yalo á na jege á ke to.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane, ko ná ye Isarele tu, naa veiru wolo maama na zoore Isarele teo kom ne to, kotu ná ve-ne ye o daare o kwei jwona kaanem o feiri o bochare ne, ye o puuri wo-yɔɔro telo na pa o tusi to o ja, ye o ná vei o bwei Wɛ sampwora se o nii, amo Baŋa Wɛ tete mo wó leiri kotu.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Amo wó dwoni de kotu pa se o ji maana o pa a nɔɔna bam se ba yé ke konto dwoŋi. A ta wó le‑o se o daa yé woli a nɔɔna bam wone. Abam laam maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye sampwora kam tete, o ná tusi pa se o pworisi taane o pa nɔɔno wom, ko ye amo Baŋa Wɛ mo gane‑o se o ke konto. A nam wó dwoni de kotu de, ye a chɔge‑o mo se o daa yé woli a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam wone.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye sampwora kam de wolo na vei o tei se o bwei o nii to, ko ye bedwe mo. Banto maama wɛleera wó taa wo ba yuu ne mo.

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: Konto mo wó che Isarele dwi tiina bam se ba daa yé ywori a chwoŋa kam ne. Ba daa bá taa biini ba tete ba wɛleera baŋa ne. Ba nam wó taa ye a nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.’ ” Baŋa Wɛ waarem dem taane

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, ne teo kolo nɔɔna ná ke wɛleera ba chɔge amo yiga de ba na ba jege chega ba pa-ne tei to, pa se a dole-ba jaguli-zane, ba bá wane ba tete ba jwoŋi. A ná pɛ ba teo kom ga wodiu mo se kana laam taa jege nabiina de vara maama ka goe,

english_verse: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.
translation_verse: Noah, de Danyeli, de Job mo ya ná maŋe ba zoore teo kom konto wone de, ba nɔn-ŋonne dem wó jwoŋi banto tete yerane mo, se nɔn-gaa daa bá lu. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Or suppose I punish a nation by sending wild animals to eat people and scare away every passerby, so that the land becomes a barren desert.
translation_verse: A nam daa ná pɛ se kago-vara mo chu ba puri teo kom wone ba jege ko nɔɔna bam ba goe yɔɔ, pa se ko ji di-dwonnu yerane ye nɔɔna ba beeri ko wone vara bam ŋwaane,

english_verse: As surely as I live, I promise that even if these three men lived in that nation, their own children would not be spared. The three men would live, but the land would be an empty desert.
translation_verse: nɔɔna batɔ bam konto ná maŋe ba wo teo kom wone, ko ta bá jwoŋi ba bia. Ba batɔ bam yerane mo wó lu, se ko ná ye teo kom maama, ko wó chɔge mo. Ne amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na jege ŋwea tei to, ko wó taa ye konto mo.

english_verse: Or suppose I send an enemy to attack a sinful nation and kill its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye we a pɛ chwoŋa se jara mo ba teo kom konto baŋa, ye a we, ‘Se-zɔɔ jege se ko chɔge teo kom maama,’ pa nabiina de vara maama te,

english_verse: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.
translation_verse: nɔɔna batɔ bam konto ná maŋe ba wo teo kom wone, ko ta bá jwoŋi ba bia. Ba batɔ bam yerane mo wó lu. Ne amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na jege ŋwea tei to, ko wó taa ye konto mo.

english_verse: And suppose I am so angry that I send a deadly disease to wipe out the people and livestock of a sinful nation.
translation_verse: A bane nam ná tiini de zaŋe de teo kom konto pa se a toŋe jawe-chɛɛro ko wone, pa nabiina de vara maama yɔɔre ba to yɔɔ,

english_verse: Again, even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, I, the Lord, promise that the children of these faithful men would also die. Only the three of them would be spared.
translation_verse: Noah, de Danyeli, de Job mo ná maŋe ba wo teo kom wone, ko ta bá jwoŋi ba bia. Ba batɔ bam yerane mo wó jwoŋi ba ŋwea ba nɔn-ŋonne dem ŋwaane. Ne amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na jege ŋwea tei to, ko wó seene ko taa ye konto mo.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I promise to punish Jerusalem severely. I will send war, starvation, wild animals, and deadly disease to slaughter its people and livestock.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Amo nam ná lage a waare Jerusalem teo kom, ko wó dwoni tento mo. A lage a pa lɛɛro dwia yana mo yi-ba. Tento ye tigura, de kana, de kago-vara daanem, de jawe-chɛɛro, se te chɔge nɔɔna bam de vara maama.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa tu ka yi amo we:

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, what happens to the wood of a grapevine after the grapes have been picked? It isn't like other trees in the forest,
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, goa wo teeni dem maama wone, Vini tio dɛ wó taa ye se yera de teeni dedwonna dem nɛ sem na? Ko nɛ sem jege kuri na?

english_verse: because the wood of a grapevine can't be used to make anything, not even a small peg to hang things on.
translation_verse: Ba wae ba gwoni-se ba ma ba ke woŋo na? Ba wó kwei ko daa ba ma sare paare tete de, se ba ma lei wonnu da na?

english_verse: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, nɔɔna mae ko nɛ sem ba dwéi mini yerane mo. Se nam ná di se daare, bɛ nyɔɔre mo se daa jega?

english_verse: The wood is useless before it is burned, and afterwards, it is completely worthless.
translation_verse: Vini tio nɛ ba jege totoŋe ye ba wo mɛ-se ba dwéi mini. Mini nam ná zwɛ-se ye se ta daare, se tiini se ye wo-yɔɔro mo.

english_verse: I will punish the people of Jerusalem with fire. Some of them have escaped one destruction, but soon they will be completely burned. And when that happens, you, Ezekiel, will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: A nam wó dwoni de-ba mo. Ba ná maŋe ba lu mini dem wone, mini dedwoŋi daa ta wó di-ba. Á maa wó lɔre we amo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ, de amo na dwoni de-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Amo wó chɔge ba tega kam pa se ka ji di-dwonnu yerane, ba na ba jege chega ba pa-ne to ŋwaane. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, remind the people of Jerusalem of their disgusting sins
translation_verse: “Nabiinu, tɔɔle Jerusalem tiina bam wo-zɔɔna kikia taane se ba taa yei ya ni ne.

english_verse: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Ta de-ba we, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei de Jerusalem teo kom to mo tento: Nmo nabaara bam yɔɔre ba ye Kanaan tiina mo, ye ba lo‑m tega kam konto ne. Nmo kwo déem ye Amori tu mo. N nu maa ye Hiti tu.

english_verse: When you were born, no one cut you loose from your mother or washed your body. No one rubbed your skin with salt and olive oil, and wrapped you in warm blankets.
translation_verse: Ba na loge nmo dɛ delo ne to, ba wo gwoni n wuri se ba vɔ-de. Ba maŋe ba wo swɛ‑m de. Ba nam wo kwei yɛ de nuga se ba ma wei n yera yam, naa se ba pu‑m de gwaaro se waaro yé yi‑m.

english_verse: Not one person loved you enough to do any of these things, and no one even felt sorry for you. You were despised, thrown into a field, and forgotten.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yiga déem tere n wone, naa se ba duri n ŋwaŋa ye ba ke konto dwoŋi ba pa‑m. Ba nam na yɔɔre ba lo‑m to, mo ba dole‑m ba yage pwola ne, nɔɔn-nɔɔno na va‑m to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I took care of you, like someone caring for a tender, young plant. You grew up to be a beautiful young woman with mature breasts and hair, but you were still naked.
translation_verse: A ma pa se n ji n ke da, ne pwola ni puŋu na ye tei to. N ta bege mo dam yerane, pa se n ji ka-bwom cheila. N yela yam tu ya zege mo chao-chao, ye n yu-ywei sem de ke dedwaaro. Nmo nam ta tigi pwola ne bwori mo.

english_verse: When I saw you again, you were old enough to have sex. So I covered your naked body with my own robe. Then I solemnly promised that you would belong to me and that I, the Lord God, would take care of you.
translation_verse: Ko na ke fee to, a daa ma tɔge n tei seeni. A ma na we n laam lwoni kaane ye n yi bwoŋ-dira. Amo ma kwei a gare-jale a pu‑m se ko kwoli n chaveera. A ma du duuri we, a gwoni ni dede‑m se a taa swoi‑m. Nmo laam ma‑n lɛɛre n ji amo nyem. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: a ring for your nose, some earrings, and a beautiful crown.
translation_verse: A ta ma pa‑m jafole se n ke n momwa ne, de zwa-kwana, de nenɔŋa yipuga se n pu n yuu ne.

english_verse: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen,
translation_verse: Konto to, n fɔge n kwɛ n tete de sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno zela mo. Gwaaro telo n na zo to de maa ye gare-fefale, de gare-nyenno telo ba na gɔgere to mo ba mɛ ba sɔ.

english_verse: You made shrines for yourself and decorated them with some of your clothes. That's where you took your visitors to have sex with them. These things should never have happened!
translation_verse: Nmo yeini n lɔɔre gare-laaro telo a na pɛ‑m to mo n ma n kwɛ n jwona wara-jei sem. Dáane mo n peini gwaaro tem baŋa ne n toŋe kabworim. Ko dae ko chwoŋa ne se wonnu tem konto taa jege te ke kɔtaa.

english_verse: You made idols out of the gold and silver jewelry I gave you, then you sinned by worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: N ta ma‑n kwei wo-nyenno telo amo na mɛ sabu-seŋa, de lu-nyenno a ke ye a daare a pa nmo to n ma n mɔ baara nyenyero, ye n sɛ n pa-te.

english_verse: You dressed them in the clothes you got from me, and you offered them the olive oil and incense I gave you.
translation_verse: N ma‑n kwei gare-nyenno telo a na pɛ‑m to n zwe nyenyero tem. N daa ta jege nuga de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kalo a na pɛ‑m to mo n zuli-te.

english_verse: I supplied you with fine flour, olive oil, and honey, but you sacrificed it all as offerings to please those idols. I, the Lord God, watched this happen.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye wodi-laaro telo a na pɛ nmo se n ta‑n di to, n jwoori n kwei mun-bwei dem, de nuga kam, de tooro tem mo n zege se te lwom taa ywomma nyenyero tem yiga ne. Ko seene ko ke konto dwoŋi mo. Amo Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: You slaughtered my children, so you could offer them as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo wó pa se n kwei amo bia bam n go n ma n ke kaanem n pa n jwona yam?

english_verse: You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.
translation_verse: Nmo nam na ke totoŋ-zɔɔna de kabworim delo maama to, n ta wo guli n nɔn-donne maŋa kam, we n déem tigi pwola ne bwori mo, ye n tae n jana bam wone.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord God, say you are doomed! Not only did you do these evil things,
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage n taane tei to mo tento: Lɛɛro wo n yuu ne! N totoŋ-balwaaro tem konto maama ne, n ta ke wonnu tento mo n woli da.

english_verse: So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.
translation_verse: Nii mo! Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo a dole‑m jaguli-zane pa se n jejegero tem muri. N dona Filisi tiina bam yi na su n wonnu tem to, a ma kwei nmo a ke ba bukwa jeŋa ne. Ba de yera maŋe ya sɔɔre de á wo-zɔɔna kikia yam mo.

english_verse: You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied,
translation_verse: N daa ta ma vo n toŋe kabworim de Asiria tiina bam, n ta na wo ke n su n fera to ŋwaane. De ko de, n fera ta wo nwoŋi tolo ne.

english_verse: You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute!
translation_verse: Nmo nam na pugi n vwoa chwoŋa maama yuu ne ye n ta lɔ bimbina kapworru maama wone to, n wo jwoŋi sabia n kabworim kikia baŋa ne, ne ka-tole na yeini se ke tei to.

english_verse: You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.
translation_verse: Nmo nam nye de ka-tola kalo na ve o baro, ye o laam swoi se o taa tigi de veira to mo.

english_verse: Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you.
translation_verse: Ka-bworru jwoŋi ŋweero mo tolo ŋwaane. Nmo nam mo yeini n pa n bɔɔla pɛɛra. N jwoori n yo baara balo na nwoŋi jei dwi dwi to se ba ba ba ke sare-peiga dede‑m.

english_verse: You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them! Jerusalem Must Be Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: Konto to, nmo kikia yam ye ya yera de ka-tole sesem sem. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo beeri n jei bwoŋa ŋwaane. Ko nam ye nmo mo ŋwe-ba, se ko dae banto mo ŋwe‑m. Nmo seene n ye n yera mo.

english_verse: You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Nmo pɛ se n fera tiini ya zo baara, ye n lɔɔre n gwaaro se n ke sare-peiga de n bɔɔla bam. N ta ma‑n kare n kaane jwo-yɔɔro, ye n go n bia n lwo ba jana n pa jwona yam konto.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo, amo lage a la n bɔɔla bam maama a ke daane jeiga dedoa ne, ko ná ye balo n na swoi to, de balo n na vae ba taane to. A laam wó vaŋe n gwaaro a lɔɔre a daare nmo a zege bwori ba yiga ne, se ba yɔɔre ba na‑m.

english_verse: I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death!
translation_verse: A nam lage a waare nmo ne ko na maŋe de ka-tola de nɔn-goro tei to mo. A wo na tiini ko fuli de n kikia yam ŋwaane to, a lage a pa se n totoŋ-zɔɔna yam jwoori ya saŋe n tete yuu ne mo.

english_verse: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.
translation_verse: A ta wó kwei‑m a ke n bɔɔla bam jeŋa ne. Ba maa wó yigi n vwoa yam ba de tega ne, ye ba daare ba chɔge n bimbina yam. Ba ta wó lɔɔre n gwaaro tem maama, de n wo-nyenno zela yam ba daare nmo ba zege bwori.

english_verse: Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces
translation_verse: Ba maa wó nwoŋi de kɔ-fɔrɔ ba jeeri‑m, se ba dole‑m de kandwa, ba daare ba kwei se-zɔɔro ba ma cha‑m muga-muga.

english_verse: and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.
translation_verse: Ba wó zwɛ n sam dem mo. Nmo na ba jege bora to, ba lage ba waare‑m ye kaana dedɛ zege ba nia mo. Amo nam wó tɔge konto baŋa a pa se n yage kabworim kikia mo, se n daa yé ta‑n ŋwe n bɔɔla bam se ba peini dede‑m.

english_verse: Only then will I calm down and stop being angry and jealous.
translation_verse: Konto maama ná kea, a bane laam wó to. A ban-lom dem daa bá zaŋe n baŋa ne ye a bochare maa wó zuri.

english_verse: You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken. Jerusalem's Two Sisters The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nmo nam na wo guli n nɔn-donne maŋa na ye tei, ye n pa se a wo fuli dede‑m to ŋwaane, a lage a pa se n kikia yam jene jwoori de taa wo n yuu ne mo. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. Nmo na ke tei to, n ke kabwoŋa mo n woli wo-zɔɔna yalo n na maŋe n ke to wone.

english_verse: People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: “If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.”
translation_verse: Nii mo! Nɔɔna maama wó maŋe memaŋe dento mo ba ke n yera ne we, ‘Basankwea done ye ka bu nii mo.’

english_verse: You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.
translation_verse: Nmo Jerusalem teo seene n ye n nu bukɔ mo. Kokuri to, n nu déem chuli o baro de o bia mo. N ta seene n ye n chorro tem choro mo chekke. Ba de chuli ba banna, de ba bia mo. N nu déem ye Hiti tu mo. N kwo maa ye Amori tu.

english_verse: Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages.
translation_verse: N zembaaro ye Samaria mo. Teo kom konto de ko bukwa ya zoore n teo kom baŋa seeni mo. N nyaane maa ye Sodom teo, ye ko de zoore n teo kom kuri seeni de ko bukwa.

english_verse: You followed their way of life and their wicked customs, and soon you were more repulsive than they were.
