translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a laam lage a kwoori‑o mo se a ja‑o a zo kagoa kam wone, se a daare a ma swono taane a ŋɔɔne ded‑o.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Dáane mo a wó jwoori a kwei o Vini teeni kare sem a ke o jeŋa ne. A ta wó pa se Akore bwolo kom pipiri ko ji teena jeiga ko pa‑o. Kaane wom laam wó leeni lei ne o déem na ke tei ye o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne o biini maŋa ne to.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento: Dɛ dem konto ne, nmo wó jwoori n bwoŋi-ne we n baro. N daa bá fɔge n bwoŋi-ne we n Baal jwoni dem.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Amo ta wó che Baal yere dem n ni ne, se n yé lwoori wolim Baal jwona yam tei ne.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se n ji a kaane ye n ta‑n wo a tei ne taa wuu. Amo wó tɔge chega, de swono, de ŋwaŋa baŋa ne mo a ke konto.

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta de amo o we, “N kaane wom ye ka-bworo ye baaro wodwoŋi mo swoi‑o. De ko de, jwoori n vo n bere‑o nmo na jege o swono tei to. Ko ye bedwe de amo Baŋa Wɛ de na swoi Isarele tiina bam tei to mo, de ba na maŋe ba ywori a kwaga ne ye ba zuli wa yadwonna tei to de. Ba ta swoi se ba taa kwei kekan-wogila ba pae ba jwona.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: A ma ta ded‑o we, “Nmo laam wó ta‑n zoore de amo mo taa, ye n yage ka-tola de kabwoŋa kikia. A de wó zuri a yera a pa‑m.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Mo Isarele tiina bam na wó taa zoore taa tei ye ba ba jege pɛ naa pa-bu to. Ba bá na chwoŋa se ba ke kaanem, naa ba zuli ba kandwa naa ba jwona, naa ba ma kaanem gare-wogo kom ba ke yi-nɛɛre kikia.

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná kɛ, Isarele tiina bam wó jwoori ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei, de ba pɛ wolo na nwoŋi David dwi dem wone to tei. Ba laam wó tiini ba kɔre Baŋa Wɛ, ye o de wó ke-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam, cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam! O jege taane de abam balo na zoore tega kanto wone to. Tega kam maama wone, nɔɔna ba tɔge chega naa swono kikia, ye ba ba kɔre Wɛ de.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Konto mo tei tega kam koga ka peere pa se balo maama na zoore ka wone to bugi. Kago-vara, de zuna, de naneo wo ywona yam maama de lage te te.

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á jege-na daane á bwɛa, se á pa ko ye nɔɔno wodwoŋi yiga. Ko nam ye abam kaanem tiina bam mo amo lage a bwɛ.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Wɛleera yalo a nɔɔna bam na ke to mo ye kaanem tiina bam ni-wodiu. Banto fera zo nɔɔna bam tusim kikia yam mo.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Peero tem yupare baŋa ne mo ba yeini ba ke ba kaanem. Ba maa zwɛ ba pɛɛra zwonnu tem yuu ne, mɛ teeni dwi dwi na wora ye de woro kom ye tima-tima to. Konto mo tei á bukwa bam zo tolo wone, ye á bu-kaana de tɔge kabwoŋa kikia.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Amo nam bá waare á bukwa bam ba tolo kikia yam ŋwaane. A ta bá waare á bu-kaana bam ba kabwoŋa kikia de ŋwaane. Kokuri to, á baara bam tete de peini de ka-tole mo. Ba maa tɔge de-ba ba ke kaanem ba pa jwona. Chega to, “Swa-mura tu ba jege sɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, á yeini á zo tolo wone. Nam yé pa-na se Judah dwi tiina bam de tɔge á na-bɔŋa kam, se banto de wɛleera taa wo ba yuu ne. Yé zaŋe-na á vo Giligal naa Bɛte-Aven se á zuli-ne. Yé ma-na Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ yere dem á du duuri.

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam ye zwabani-nyena mo, ne na-chwa na ye tei to. Baŋa Wɛ laam wó wane o nii ba baŋa ne ne pipeili dwoŋi tei na?

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi tiina bam me de jwona kaanem. Le-na á tete ba wone á daare-ba.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Ba ná nyɔge sana ba su, ba laam yɔɔre ba tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo. Ba swoi kuri-nɔrɔ ba dwoi zula.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Vo-dɛɔ lage ko ba ko kale-ba mo ko pu ko ja ko jage. Ba na ke kaanem ba pae jwona tei to wó guri-ba chaveera wone mo.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Zwabani-nyena bam tiini ba swoi nɔɔna gom. Amo nam wó waare ba maama.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Ba kikia yam konto chɔge-ba mo, ye ba daa ware se ba jwoori Wɛ tei. Ba boboŋa yeini ya zo jwona kaanem wone. Ba daa maa ba kɔre Baŋa Wɛ de fenfee tete de.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei ba vara ba ja ba vo ba ma ke kaanem se ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. Ba nam bá na‑o, o na nwoŋi ba tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ba baare Baŋa Wɛ kwaga ne mo. Bia balo ba na loge to dae o nyem. Chan-doŋa kuri dim ná yia, ba de ba tega kam wó na chɔgem lela. Jara chuga Judah teo de Isarele teo wone

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Wu-na jara-keim nabwanno Gibea teo wone! Kaane-na Rama nɔn-bia bam! Mage-na tiguri-kaasa Bɛte-Aven ne! Benjamin dwi tiina bam, cho-na á tete!

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Judah tiina nakwa bam jigi nenɛɛne balo na di ba zo ba dwonna siseini wone tei to mo. A ban-lom dem wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne, ne na-fɔrɔ na chuuri ko chɔge wonnu tei to.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro lage te yi Efrayim tiina bam. Amo wó waare-ba pa se ba na chɔgem, ba boboŋa na jaane se ba zuli jwona to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Amo lage a chɔge Efrayim tiina bam, ne kenkaao na chɔge gwaaro tei to mo. A ta wó pa se Judah tiina bam ji wo-popɔnɔ.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Amo wó zo Efrayim tiina bam de Judah tiina bam wo nenɛɛne nywoŋo na zo vara wone tei to mo. Amo tete wó tore ba yera yam yera-yera, ye a daare a ja-ba a viiri. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o jwoŋi-ba a jeŋa ne o yage.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó jwoori a tete jeiga kam a daare-ba pa ba na ba waarem dem ba ti. Ko ná zo ba yera konto dwoŋi, ba laam wó seene ba yia ba beeri amo jeiga.

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: “Pa-na se dé jwoori dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei. Wonto mo tore dé yera yam yera-yera, o nam wó jwoori o yɔɔre debam. O ma pa dé na zonne, se o laam pa dé na yazura.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Ko ná ke da yalei, o wó jwoŋi debam dé cham wone o yage. Ko ná yi da yatɔ wɛɛne o wó pa dé jwoori dé bi de yazura se dé taa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Pa-na dé seene dé yia, se dé taa me de Baŋa Wɛ! O laam wó veere o tete o bere debam, ne wɛ na jege de pula te-pora ni ne tei to. O wó ba o zeini debam, ne duum doa na bugi tega tei to mo.” Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gilead ye teo kolo kom puseŋ-nyena na su ko wone to mo. Ba maa yeini ba go nɔɔna jaja.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Amo nɛ totoŋ-zɔɔne Isarele dwi tiina bam tetare ne. Efrayim tiina bam biini ba tete mo de ba na bwoori jwona kaanem baŋa ne tei to.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Abam Judah dwi tiina bam, ko ta ye bedwe mo de abam. Á maŋa kam ná yia, amo lage a yɔɔre a waare abam mo.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: “Nɔɔna yeini ba toŋe lwarem mo ba ma pwoli pɛ wom wo. Ba maa tɔge vwa baŋa ne ba pwoli nakwa bam wo.

english_verse: Everyone burns with desire— they are like coals in an oven, ready to burst into flames.
translation_verse: Ba maama tɔge kabwoŋa kikia mo. Ba maa tiini ba jege ban-lom, ne jugu diga wo mini na guguli tei to.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam gwaane ba tete de dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo. Ba nye de maase delo ba na fɔge ba le ye de wo bege de ti to mo.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Sa-teena mo tu ba vere ba dam, ye ba wo maane ko ni ne. Ba yuu de laam peere ye ba wo lɔre ko ni ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam na bere ba tete kamunim tei to bere we ba ba jege bora. Ba nɛ kolo maama na yi-ba to, ye ba ta ve se ba jwoori ba ba amo tei. Amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom ye ba ba lwoori wolim amo tei ne.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Ba nam na maa vei to, a lage a ma ŋwe-choa mo a che-ba a ja ne zuna tei. A ta wó waare-ba, lwarem dem ba na ke to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wo ba yuu ne! Kokuri to, ba pipiri ba viiri amo tei ne. Cham wó yi-ba, ba na lɔge amo kwaga ne to ŋwaane. A ya lage a vere-ba mo a yage, ba nam fɔge vwa ba pa-ne.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Ba ba yeini ba lwoori-ne de ba wo maama. Ba tigi ba gadworu baŋa ne ye ba laam chwoosa. Ba maa yeini ba bɛ ba yera ba wara wone se ba na wodiu de sana mo. Ba nwoŋi amo kwaga ne mo konto.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Amo mo korese-ba se a pa ba na dam. De ko de, ba ta jege boboŋ-balwaaro de amo.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Ba na beeri wolim to, ba ba kwoni ba yum wɛɛne. Ba nye de taŋa kalo na gugwoli to mo. Ba nakwa bam wó to jara wone, ba na bere ba tete kamunim to ŋwaane. Mo kokuri Ejipti tiina bam wó taa jege-ba ba mɔna.”

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: “Wu-na jara nabwanno! Maao mo jaane wɛyuu ne ko foore se ko chaale amo Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam. Kokuri to, ba chɔge ni delo a na gwoni de-ba to. Ba ta ma nwoŋi a bera yam kwaga ne.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam mo lwoori-ne ye ba tɛ ba we, ‘Nmo mo ye debam Wɛ, ye dé me dede‑m.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Banto nɔɔ ta mo ve se ba taa tɔge chwo-laaro. Mo kokuri ba dona wó pare-ba se ba ja.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Samaria tiina bam, a chuli jwoni delo ba na mɔɔne ye de jege na-mɔra nyenyego to. A ban-lom zaŋe ba baŋa ne! Ba wó taa biini ba tete taa tento se ba vo ba maŋe yei ne mo?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Isarele teo tu gɔgɔ mo mɔɔne jwoni dem, ko dae wɛ chekke. Chega to, na-mɔra jwoni delo Samaria tiina na zuli to lage de ba de chochoge mura-mura mo.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Isarele teo kom wó ba ko ti. Ko daa ba jege kuri dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone, ne kam-boro tei.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam jaane ba tete ba vo ba pa Asiria teo kom tiina mo, ne kagoa wo bonaga na vei ka tete boboŋa veiŋa tei to. Ko nye de Efrayim tiina bam kwei sabu mo ba vo ba beeri bɔɔla tei.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi tiina bam lɔge kaanem bimbina dedɛ ba wɛleera saarem ŋwaane. Bimbina yam konto laam jigi jei selo ba na yeini ba toŋe wɛleera da to mo.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: Ba maa yeini ba ja ba pɛɛra ba ba ba ma ke kaanem ba pa-ne, ye ba daare ba di ya nɔna yam. Amo Baŋa Wɛ yi nam wo su de ba pɛɛra yam konto. A laam wó guli ba na tusi tei to, ye a daare a waare-ba ko ŋwaane. A ta wó pa ba jwoori Ejipti teo kom.

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, á yé ta‑á chake de wopwolo, ne dwi-gɛ tiina bam na di ba kura yam tei to. Kokuri to, á lɔge á Tu Wɛ wom kwaga ne, ye á ta tɔge wa-yɔɔro. Á swoi se á ta‑á jwoŋa kabworim kikia sabu mena ferem jei sem maama ne.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam bá na chwoŋa se ba maŋe Baŋa Wɛ tega kam wone. Efrayim tiina bam wó jwoori ba zo kabɛɛne wone mo, ne ko déem na ke-ba Ejipti ne tei to. Ba badwonna wó vo Asiria teo kom ye ba di wodiu kolo ya na chuli se ba di to.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Dáane ba bá taa kwei sana ba ke pɛɛra ba ma ba zuli Baŋa Wɛ. Kaanem delo maama ba na wó ke ba pa‑o to bá su o yi. Ba pɛɛra yam konto wó taa nye de wodiu kolo ba na di lua sɔŋɔ ne to. Wolo maama ná di-ko, kotu wó digiri o tete chullu tem seeni. Wodiu kom konto nam wó su banto kana yerane mo. Ko bá lɛɛne ko vo Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem wo.

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Ba ná maŋe ba duri ba jage da yiga ne se ba lu cham wone, Ejipti tiina bam ta wó ja-ba. Ba ta wó suli-ba Memfisi teo wone. Man-chaŋa wó nwoŋi ka li ba lu-nyenno jejegero tem, ye sabare de li ba di sem.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam waarem maŋa kam yi ka ti. Ba laam wó jwoŋi kolo na maŋe de ba lwarem kikia yam to. Ba taa yei ko ni ne! Ba boŋe we Wɛ sampwora kam yirisi mo. Ba ta maa nii nɔn-popore nyem pa o ye chichwoo. Ba yeini ba yaale Wɛ tontoŋena konto dwoŋi, ba lwarem kikia na daga ye ba nankɔɔre de gaale to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Sampwora kam nam ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo. O tu se o yere Efrayim tiina bam. O nam ná vei mɛ maama, ba yeini ba cho o chwoŋa. O ná maŋe o wo Wɛ diga kam ne, ba yeini ba chuli‑o mo.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Ba tiini ba chɔge ba tete de totoŋ-zɔɔna, ne ba déem na ke tei Gibea ne to. Wɛ nam wó guli ba lwarem kikia yam, ye o daare o waare-ba ya ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: “Amo déem na bobo a na Isarele tiina bam to, ba nye de Vini tio-bia mo na puli ba nwoŋi kagoa wone to. A na nɛ á nabaara bam to, ko nye de a nɛ mɔ-lelea na bega kaporo yuu ne to mo. Ba nam na tu ba yi Baal-Peora jei sem to, ba ma kwei ba tete ba pa wo-zɔɔne dem konto. Ba tete laam jigi wo-zɔɔna se ko maŋe de jwoni delo ba na zuli to.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam nenɔŋa lage ka jei mo, ne zuŋa na jaane ka di wɛyuu tei to. Bu-lore de pu-jara daa bá taa wora ba wone.

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Ba ná maŋe ba lo bia ye ba kɔne-ba, amo wó pa se ba maama te, pa se ba wolowolo daa yé daare. Lɛɛro wó ba ba baŋa, amo kwaga na wó ya-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: A nɛ Isarele teo kom na zege te-ywoŋa jei ne tei, ne Tura teo kom na ye tei to. Efrayim tiina bam nam jege se ba ja ba bia ba nwoŋi se nɔɔna mo go-ba.”

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, a nam wó lwoori‑m se n ke-ba tetɛ mo? Kɔ ba lora kam, se n daare n pa ba yele na de ko. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: “Giligal ne mo ba maŋe ba bobo ba lwarem kikia yanto. Mo kokuri a laam chuli-ba. Amo lage a zeili-ba se ba nwoŋi a tega kam baŋa ne, ba lwarem totoŋa yam ŋwaane. A daa bá taa jege ba swono. Ba nakwa bam maama baare amo kwaga.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam weele mo. Ba nye de tei-koro mo na koge ko zege ŋɔɔ ye ko ba leiri bia to. Ba nam ná maŋe ba lo, a wó go ba bu-swonnu tem konto.”

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Amo Wɛ wom wó ve-ba, de ba na wo sɛ o bera yam to ŋwaane. Mo kokuri, ba wó taa kare ba beera dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam déem nye de Vini tio kolo kom na leigi tio-bia zɔrɔtɔtɔ to mo. Ba nam na tiini ba puli dedɛ tei to, ba kaanem bimbina yam de ye konto mo. Ba tega kam maa na fɔge ka ke wodiiru lanyerane tei to, ba kandwa yam ba na chwi ba jege ba zuli to mo ba fɔge-ya se ya de taa tiini ya lamma.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: Ba ba jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Mo kokuri ba jege se ba ŋwe ba wɛleera yam jene. Baŋa Wɛ tete wó bwori ba kaanem bimbina yam, ye o daare o yigi ba jwona kandwa yam o de tega ne.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Ba nam wó taa ŋɔɔne ba we, “Dé ba jege pɛ, Baŋa Wɛ kɔrɔ na tera debam wone to ŋwaane. Dé nam ya ná jege pɛ, wonto wó wane o ke bɛ mo o pa debam?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Ba ni taane dem konto ye kafɛ mo. Ba maa tɔge vwa baŋa ne ba gwoni ni ye ba ta daare ba yiri-de. Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔna tiini ba jege da-taane, ne man-chaŋa na li tega tei to.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na zoore Samaria teo wone to yera sae mo ye ba wo chɔge de na-mɔra jwoni dem ba ya na zuli Bɛte-Aven ne to. Banto de balo na ke kaanem ba pa-de to wó keeri de ŋwaane, de na wó jei ba tei ne, dedaane de nenɔŋa kam maama to.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó zeŋe-de ba ja vo Asiria teo kom se de ji jejegero de pa pa-faro wom. Isarele dwi tiina bam wó di ba chaveera de ba na zuli jwoni delo na ye da-kora to.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Chega to, ba wó kale Samaria tiina bam de ba pɛ wom ba ja vo jeiga yiga yiga, ne na-dura na zeŋe da-kwolo ba ja viiri tei to.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Jei selo Isarele tiina bam na toŋe puseŋa kikia ye ba zuli jwona zwonnu yuu ne mɛ to wó ba se chɔge. Sabare de ga-cheiŋo wó nwoŋi te li bimbina yam maama. Ba laam wó lwoori peero tem de zwonnu tem we, te to ba baŋa ne te kwoli-ba. Baŋa Wɛ wó waare Isarele tiina bam Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Amo boboŋa yam ná jaane ya ti, a wó waare nɔn-lwanno tento mo. Teene dedwonna wó ke ni daane ba ba ba kwaare jara de-ba. Ba maa wó vɔ-ba de chegero, ba na tiini ba tusi ba daŋe da-baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam déem nye de na-chwɛ delo na wae de nɔne mena to mo. Amo tete laam nam wó daŋe yɔgesa de ba ne, se a pa de vaŋe naan-vɔrɔ. Judah dwi tiina bam de jege se ba va! Jakob dwi tiina bam de wó chɛ tega se ko zo ba yera.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane jara wó pɔpɔ ya to á wone, pa se á dam jei sem maama chɔge. Ko wó tiini ko zo á yera ne ko na ke tei dɛ dem Saleman na chɔge Bɛte-Arabel teo kom to. Ba déem yigi niina de ba bia ba de tega ne ye ba daare ba nɔ-ba ba go.

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: “Amo swoi Isarele ko nwoŋi o biini ne mo. A ma bwoŋi a bu-swono kom se o nwoŋi Ejipti ne o ba.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: A nam na tiini a kwoori Isarele dwi dem se de jwoori de ba amo tei to mo ba yɔɔre ba ma ba kwaga ba ya amo. A nɔɔna bam ma ke kaanem ba pa Baal jwona yam, ye ba kwei pɛɛra ba zwɛ ba zuli jwona yadwonna.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Amo mo taase Efrayim tiina bam pa ba lɔre veiŋa. A ma ja ba jea se ba taa via. Ba nam wo maane we ko ye amo mo nii ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: A ma tɔge swono wone a korese-ba, ne a vaŋe-ba de ŋone mo to. A kwei-ba mo a daŋe a nyɔɔne baŋa ne. A ma tiiri tega ne a pa-ba wodiu se ba di.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ba nam wó jwoori ba vo Ejipti. Asiria tiina de wó taa tei-ba, ba na ve se ba pipiri ba jwoori amo tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Ba boboŋa jaane se ba ja ba tete ba nwoŋi amo tei ne. Ba ma lwoori wolim wɛyuu ne. De ko de, Wɛ bá le-ba ba cham wone.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi tiina bam, a nam wó wane a yage abam mo na? A bá wane a dɔne a jeŋa Isarele tiina bam baŋa ne. A bá sɛ se á na chɔgem, nenɛɛne chɔgem delo na yi Adema de Zeboyiim tei to. A boboŋa bá pa-ne chwoŋa se a ke konto, a na tiini a jege abam ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: “Efrayim dwi tiina bam jaane vwa mo ba ba amo tei. Isarele tiina bam maa tiini ba jege-ne ba gana. Judah tiina bam nam tɔge Wɛ kwaga mo ba kare ba beera. Ba jege chega de Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam ni-wodiu ye vio mo. Ba maa yeini ba pare vio na nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni to se ba kwaane ba ja-ko. Vwa de puseŋa kikia mo ba jege ba toŋe maŋa maama. Ba maa jaane ba tete ba vei ba ke ni-sɛɛm de Asiria tiina, ye ba daare ba ke nuga pipiu de Ejipti tiina.”

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ti o yiga mo se o bwɛ Judah tiina bam. O lage o waare Jakob dwi tiina bam ba totoŋe nɛ ŋwaane mo. O maa wó jwoori o ŋwe ba tusim kikia yam jene ba yuu ne.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Jakob ta na wo o nu puga wone to, o déem zo jaŋa mo de o choro Esawu, de ba na ye yeywa daane to. O ta na ke nɔɔno to mo o dwoni de Wɛ.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: O ma jaŋe de Wɛ maleka kam o wane-ka o di. O déem keeri mo lanyerane se o wane o na Wɛ swolim. Bɛtel ne mo o jeeri de Wɛ, ye Wɛ de ŋɔɔne ded‑o.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo konto. Baŋa Wɛ mo o yere, de na maŋe de zula!

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: Abam nam maŋe se á jwoori á Tu Wɛ wom tei. Fɔge-na á ta‑á tɔge swono de chega, ye á jege Baŋa Wɛ teena maŋa maama.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam maa tɛ ba we, “Nii-na dé na duni tei! Dé nɛ jejegero dé pa dé tete! Dé na toŋe tei maama dé na nyɔɔre to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá na dé tusim se o ma o bwɛ debam.”

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo wom na jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to. A ta wó pa á jwoori á ta‑á zoore vwoa wone, ne á déem na zoore tei kagoa kam wone to.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Amo déem ŋɔɔne de a sampwori sem. A ma veere wonnu dedɛ a bere-ba. A tɔge ba baŋa mo a pa a nɔɔna bam lɔre a boboŋa.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Puseŋa kikia daga Gilead ne mo na? Balo na zoore da to nam lage ba jei mo! Giligal ne ba yeini ba ma nabɛ mo ba ke kaanem ba pa jwona na? Ba kaanem bimbina kandwa yam wó sirimi tega ne, ye ba dogele-ya ba tiŋi ba kare ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo wom na jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to. Wɛ dedwoŋi tera á na jege se á lɔre-de ye ko dae amo. Jwoŋinu wodwoŋi maa tera ko ná dae amo.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Abam déem na beeri kagoa wone mɛ na ye te-kora yerane to, amo mo nii á baŋa ne.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Amo wó zaŋe ba baŋa ne nenɛɛne nywoŋ-kura kalo ba na vere ka bia ba daare-ka tei to, ye a daare a kaare ba nyɔɔna. A ta wó chɔge-ba lela ko nɛ sem ni ne. A maa wó tore-ba yera yera, ne nywoŋo na tore vara tei to, naa kago-varem na yeini o ke tei to.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, lɛɛro wo á yuu ne! Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó zeini abam.

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amo ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne mo a déem tiŋi pɛ a pa abam. A nam ta daare a le wonto á wone, a ban-lom na fuli á baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam wó vere-ba toone jeŋa ne a yage na? Amo wó jwoŋi-ba se ba yé zo churu mo na? Toone, n dam dem nam daa bɛ? N daa‑n bá wane n chɔge-ba na? Amo nam bá duri a nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Ba ná maŋe ba puli lanyerane ba dwoni ba chorro tem tei, Baŋa Wɛ ta wó pa vo-loŋo nwoŋi wɛ-puli seeni ko ba ko chɔge-ba. Vio kom wó zege kagoa kam wone ko ba ko we ba bwi sem maama. Ko maa wó pa se ba ga wonnu telo maama na jege lonne te pa-ba to.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria tiina bam ye se ba na waarem, ba na nwoŋi ba Tu Wɛ wom kwaga ne to ŋwaane. Ba dona wó go-ba jara wone. Ba maa wó yigi ba bu-sese ba de tega ne ba go, ye ba daare ba lɔ ba kapwi ba pwi seeni ba go.

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, pipiri-na á jwoori á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei. Á wɛleera yam mo pɛ se á tiri á to tega ne.

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria tiina bam bá wane debam ba jwoŋi ba yage. Dé daa bá di sisein-nɔɔna baŋa dé zo jara wo. Ko ná ye wonnu telo dé je na mɔɔne to, dé daa bá kwei-te dé ma ji dé wa dé zuli. Nmo yerane mo jege yibwona n pae botara.” Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: “Amo wó yɔɔre a nɔɔna bam, de ba na nwoŋi amo kwaga ne to de. A maa wó taa swoi-ba de a wo maama. Amo laam peene a bane mo se de daa yé zaŋe ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Ba ta wó puli lanyerane, ne tio na kwi vɔɔro tei to. Ba lam de Olivi tio lam mo wó taa nye daane. Ba wó taa jege ywoni, ne Lebanon teeni lwom na ywomma tei to.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Efrayim tiina bam, amo yiga wo jwona wone na? Amo mo wó jwoŋi á wara yam, ye a nii á baŋa ne. A jege woro a pa abam, ne tio kolo na kwi vɔɔro maŋa maama to mo. Á na nɛ wo-laaro telo to nwoŋi amo tei ne mo.”

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Abam wolo maama ná jege boboŋa, kotu jege se o ni taane dento kuri. Wolo ná jege yi-poro, kotu jege se o ke-de o bochare ne. Baŋa Wɛ chwei sem yɔɔre se ye chega. Nɔn-ŋona wó taa tɔge-se. Ko nam ná ye balo na ve Wɛ to, banto wó chɔɔle ba to se wone.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo kwei taane dento o pa Petuweli bu Joweli: Kayere kɔgɔ na yo tega kam tei to

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Sa-nyɔra bam, zaŋe-na dɔɔm wone se á ta‑á keera, kokuri sa-ywoŋo daa tera se á nyɔ.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Ta‑á keeri-na nenɛɛne bukɔ-pwola kalo na gɛ ka baro to na wó taa keeri o lua tei to.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, wodiu de sana daa tera se ba ma ba ke pɛɛra Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Wɛ kaanem tiina bam keeri mo ga bɔge-bɔge kolo ŋwaane pɛɛra daa tera se ba ma zuli Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Vala bam, abam de pa se á wo chɔge! Ta‑á keeri-na se ko zaŋe wɛɛne bɔge bɔge, kokuri, mena yam maama chɔge. Faao kom wo jaane kuri.

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina bam, abam balo na yeini á toŋe Baŋa Wɛ bimbini dem ŋwaane to, lɛ-na gare-nyenyaaro se á daare á ta‑á keera. Ko ye se á zo Wɛ diga mo tete ne, ye á laam keeri se ko taa nii te-pora maŋa, kokuri wodiiru de sana tera se á kaane á pa á Tu Wɛ wom.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Dé yɔɔre dé zege dé nii mo, ye dé wodiiru jege te chɔga. Debam Tu Wɛ zula diga kam ywoni maama ti.

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Wo-dwa bam maama maŋe tega ne mo ba pɔ. Dé tuli sem maama laam chɔge mo se zega, wodiu na tera se dé tiŋi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Vara bam maama keeri kana mo. Ba maa beeri yɔɔ yerane, ba tɔge wodiu kwaga. Bone de pei sem maama yɔɔre se yaare mo.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, amo nam wó keeri a jare nmo mo! Kokuri to, ko nye de mini mo zwɛ gaao maama kula! Teeni dem maama de maa kwaare de zega.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Kago-vara tete de keeri mo ba jare nmo, kokuri to, bwi sem koge mo ye na daa tera se ba nyɔ. Chega to, mini zwɛ gaao kom maama mo kula!

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Dento dɛ dem wó taa ye lim yerane mo. Kunkwonnu tem wó zwori te li tega kam maama! Kokuri to, nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ mo maa beena, ye ba kwoli zwonnu laŋa kam maama. Ko zege faŋa faŋa, lɛɛro konto dwoŋi ta wo yi logo kom, ye ko dwoŋi de nam ta bá fɔge ko ke.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ba ba yeini ba peene daane. Nɔɔno maama tɔge o chwoŋa mo. Kolokolo ware ba yiga se ko che, ko ná maŋe ko ye chichwoa de chena maama de.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Tega kam baŋa maa ziziŋi ba yiga ne. Wɛyuu kom de maa sua. Wea kam de chana kam maama ma ji lim. Chalechwe sem pwooni de daa maa tera.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ di o jar-keira bam yiga. O kwora kam maa tiini ka zaŋa de baare! Ko ná ye kɔ-fɔrɔ kolo na tɔge o kwaga ye ba sɛ o ni to, n bá‑n wane n jeeli n lɔre ba ni. Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom jege foone dedɛ! Wɔ mo wó wane o zege de wone? Leiri-na á bochara yam

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam tage tento mo o we: “De konto maama, maŋa ta wo kɛ. Jwoori-na á ba amo tei ne dedaane á wo maama. Ta‑á vɔ-na á nia ye á keera, se á ba amo yiga ne de á wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Pa-na se á wom tem seene te chɔge, ye ko dae á na vaŋe á gwaaro á kaare kaare tei to yerane.” Jwoori-na á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom tei, kokuri to o zaane dem gaale, ye o jege nɔɔna yibwona. O maa yeini o peene o bane, ye o swono gaale. O ba swoi se o taa toŋe waarem nɔɔna baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wó wane o lɔre? Dɛ delo abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó leiri o boboŋa, se o daare o duri abam ŋwaŋa, ye o ke zaane á yuu ne. Abam laam maa wó neene de wodiiru dedaane sana, se á ma‑á ke kaanem á pa Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Wu-na nabɔnɔ kom Zion peo kom yuu ne. Ta-na se nɔɔna bam jeeri ba vɔ ni Wɛ ŋwaane! Bwoŋi-na ba maama se ba la daane ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam bere we o yiga wo o tega kam wone mo. O ma duri o nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o ta o we, “A lage a pa á na wodiiru mo, de sa-ywoŋo, dedaane nuga. Abam laam ma‑á wó di á boboŋa á su. Amo daa bá sɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina bam taa ke abam ba mɔna.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Kago-vara bam de yé taa kɔre foone, kokuri pwola kam maama su mo dedaane ga-lɛɛro. Teeni dem de maa lei bia zwase! Mɔɔro dedaane Vini tio-bia wora mo yɔɔ!

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Mena ferem jei sem lage se su dedaane wodiiru mo, se sana de nuga de taa daga se gaale. Baŋa Wɛ mo we:

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: “A nam wó jwoori a ŋwe á wodiiru telo kayere sem ya na chɔge bena yalo wone se kɔgɔ de kɔgɔ na tu abam baŋa ne to. Ko ye amo mo déem toŋe-se abam tetare ne, ne jar-keira tei.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Abam laam wó ta‑á di á sui, á wodiiru na wó gaale to ŋwaane. Abam laam maa wó seini á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom yere, de amo na toŋe wo-kenkagela a pa abam tei to. Amo nɔɔna bam daa bá di ba chaveera.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Abam Isarele tiina bam laam wó lɔre we amo mo wo abam tetare ne. Amo mo ye abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, ye wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera se de dwoni de amo. Chega to, a nɔɔna bam daa bá di ba chaveera.” Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom taane

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: “Ko maama kwaga ne, amo wó lwo a Jworo nabiina maama baŋa ne. Konto nam wó pa se á bu-baara de á bukwa taa pworisi amo kwora kam, se á nɔn-kwe de dwɛ dendwea amo ŋwaane, ko daare se abam nɔn-donno na wo-kenkagela yalo a na wó veere a bere-ba to.

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: Chega to, da yam konto ne a lage a lwo a Jworo mo a tontoŋena baŋa ne, baara de kaana de.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó pa se wo-kenkagela taa nae wɛyuu ne dedaane tega baŋa ne. Kanto maŋa kam ne jana wó taa wora, de mini, de nyoa kalo na tiini ka zwora to.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Wea kam wó ba ka vaŋe ka li lim, ye chana kam de ji nasoŋo ne jana tei. Ko laam daare se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom ba ko yi, se o nenɔŋa kam de bere jaja.

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
translation_verse: “Nii-na! Maŋa kam konto ne, amo wó pa se Jerusalem de Judah tiina bam jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo lanyerane.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Tura tiina, de Sidon tiina, dedaane Filisi tiina na wo jei selo maama ne to, abam boŋe se á ke amo tetɛ mo? Á lage se á yiri á jene mo amo baŋa ne na? Konto nam ná ye á boboŋe dem, lɔre-na we amo wó ke lela a jwoori a ŋwe kolo á na ke amo baŋa ne to.

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: Abam vere lu-nyenno de sabu-seŋa jejegero tem na ye amo tete lonne nyem to á ja á vo á tiŋi á jwona di sem wone.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: A lage a kwei abam bia mo a yeigi a pa Judah tiina bam. Banto laam wó kwei á bia bam ba yeigi ba pa Sabea tiina bam na zoore sa-teo ne yiga yiga to.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage tento maama.

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: Tɔɔle-na kwora kanto se ka yi dwi tiina maama: “Ti-na á yiga jara-keim ŋwaane! Bwoŋi-na á babɛ sem de á jar-keira bam maama se ba zaŋe ba la daane, ba daare ba vo ba kwaare jara de ba dona bam.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Nɔn-balwaaro tem maŋa yia se ba na chɔgem! Konto to, kwei-na á sekware á ja á zo ba wone á ma á gaane-ba, nenɛɛne ba na yeini ba gwei mena yalo na bege tei to. Nam ta nɔne-na ba baŋa ne, nenɛɛne ba na ke tei ba ŋoke Vini tio-bia to. Maŋa kam yia! Sana bam su ba wɛɛle!

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Wea kam dedaane chana kam maama wó ji lim. Chalechwe sem pwooni de daa bá taa nyeena.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo zaŋe Zion peo kom yuu ne ka suura. O kwor-dɛa maa bage Jerusalem teo kom wone, pa se tega baŋa dedaane wɛyuu maama ziziŋi. Ko nam ná ye o tete nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam, Baŋa Wɛ mo ye ba dalem jei, se ba sale o yera ne. Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ o nɔɔna bam swolim Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Abam Isarele tiina bam laam wó lɔre we amo mo ye á Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom. A maa zoore a tete peo Zion yuu ne mo. Amo ta ma pɔɔre Jerusalem se ko taa ye a tete teo kom. Veira daa bá wane-ko ba di maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, Vini teeni delo á na wó jeiri peero jei sem ne to wó pa á na sa-sona dedɛ. Á vara de maa wó puli ba su zwonnu laŋa kam maama, pa se nayela de gaale. Judah wo bwi sem maama de maa wó su se wɛɛle. Bu-nɔgɔ wó zege Baŋa Wɛ diga kam ne ka duri ka vo ka yi Sitim bwolo kom ka bugi tega kam.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Amo laam maa wó jwoori a ŋwe nɔn-gora tusim dem jene, amo na wo ŋwe-de to ŋwaane. Chega to, amo Baŋa Wɛ zoore Zion wone.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Amo Amosi ye nayero mo na nwoŋi Tekoa, ye a laam bere taane dento. Yuzia déem na ye Judah teo pɛ, ye Jehoasa bu Jeroboam de ye Isarele tiina pɛ, ye ko daare bena yalei se tega kam ziziŋi to mo Wɛ le wonnu tento ya na seigi to o bere-ne.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Damasika nɔɔna bam yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba nɔne Gilead tiina bam mo pa se ba twanno peere.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini zwɛ Pɛ Hazayeli na lɔge sɔ-fɔrɔ kolo to, se a daare a zwɛ Pɛ Ben-Hadadi dam jei sem.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Amo wó chɔge Damasika teo ni bworru tem, se a daare a go ko nɔn-bia bam a vo a yi Aven bwolo kom. Ko ta ná ye pɛ wolo na di paare Bɛte-Eden teo kom ne to, amo wó zeili‑o mo pa se o lage jei. Amo ta wó pa ba kale Siria tiina bam ba ja ba vo Kiri teo se ba ji peena da.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Filisi tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Gaza teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba jaane teo kodwoŋi nɔn-bia maama ba kale-ba ba vo ba ke Edom tiina jeŋa ne.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini ja Gaza teo kom, ye de zwɛ ko dam jei sem.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Asedodi teo kom nɔn-bia bam, de wolo na di paare Asekelon teo kom ne to, amo wó chɔge-ba, se a daare a ma a dam-fɔrɔ a waare Ekoron teo kom tiina. Filisi tiina balo maama na daare to maa wó te.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Tura tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Tura teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba jaane teo kodwoŋi nɔn-bia maama mo ba kale ba vo ba ke Edom tiina jeŋa ne. Konto to, ba yage ba ni-gwonim dem ba ya na ke de teo kom konto to.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini di Tura teo kom, ye de zwɛ ko dam jei sem mo.” Edom tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Edom nɔɔna bam yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba zeili ba chorro tem mo se ba go. Ba maa ba jege ba ŋwaŋa de fenfee de, ye ba wo pɛ se ba ban-zɔŋɔ kom zuri.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini ja Teman teo kom maama, ye de zwɛ Bozera dam jei sem.” Amon tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Amon teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba na beeri tega se ba woli ba tega wone ye ba kwaare jara to, mo ba lɔge Gilead kapwi sem ba pwi seeni ba go-se.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Moaba teo kom nɔɔna yeini ba tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba yaale Edom teo pɛ de ba na puri o yibeeli dem, ye ba ta zwɛ o kwi pa se ji tentwarem to.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini ja Moaba teo kom maama ye de daare de zwɛ Keriofa dam jei sem. Jar-keira bam ta na wora ba kaase tiguri-kaasa, ye ba wu nabwanno to, mo Moaba tiina bam wó te jara wone.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Amo wó ba a go Moaba tiina pɛ wom de ba teo kom dedɛɛra maama.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Judah tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Judah tiina bam tiini ba ke wɛleera ba daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare-ba. Ba gwooni amo Baŋa Wɛ berem dem ye ba wo sɛ a nia yam. Ba tɔge wa yalo ba nabaara déem na tɔge to, ye ya gane-ba pa se ba ywori amo chwoŋa kam ne.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane amo wó ke-ba tento: Amo wó pa se mini ja Judah teene dem ye de zwɛ Jerusalem dam jei sem.” Isarele tiina taane

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Se abam, Isarele tiina bam, á yeini á tiini á ke wɛleera á daŋe da-baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane amo wó yɔɔre a waare abam. Jena ŋwaane mo Isarele tiina jege nɔn-ŋona ba yeiga, pa se ba ji kabɛ. Ba ta ma yeigi nabwona balo na ware ba naga natera jena ba ŋwe to.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Ba ta nii yiniga tiina mo se ba taa ye kafɛ, nenɛɛne nɔɔna na nɔne tega kasolo baŋa ne tei to. Ba maa yeini ba che nabwona chwoŋa se ba yé na ba bora. Nɔɔno de o kwo sɛ se ba peini de kaba-kana dedoa, ye ba yaale amo yere dem na ye wose to.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Nii-na, Isarele tiina bam! Abam ŋwaane mo amo déem zeili Amori tiina bam. Banto ya ye nɔn-sawaara mo, ye ba ta dana, nenɛɛne tei-kamunnu na ye tei to. A ma yɔɔre a chɔge-ba, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na guri tio de ko bonno maama tei to.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Amo déem ya jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne, ye a kwei bena finna a to á yiga ne, pa se dé vei kagoa kam wone. A laam ma kwei Amori tiina tega kanto a pa abam, se ka taa ye á tete nyem.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: A ma daare a kuri abam nɔn-donno tem wone se ba badwonna taa ye sampwori ba pa-ne, se ba badaara de taa ye Naziri tiina na pɔɔre ba tete amo ŋwaane to. Isarele tiina bam, ko dae konto na? Ko ye amo Baŋa Wɛ mo ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: Abam nam soge Naziri tiina bam pa ba nyɔ sana. Á ma kwori á fe amo sampwori sem se ba pu ba ni de amo kwora kam.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Balo na wae ba duri lela to bá lu. Dedɛɛra dam wó jei. Babɛ de bá wane ba vere ba tete ba yage.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Che-tara wó chichei ba ga. Balo na wae ba duri chekke to bá wane ba duri ba lu. Nɔɔna balo na diini sisein-nɔɔna to de bá wane ba vere ba tete ba yage.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, babɛ wó de ba jara zela ba yage, ye ba daare ba duri se ba lu.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: “Amo kuri abam yerane mo a le dwi maama na wo logo baŋa ne to wone, ye a nii á baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane mo amo jege se a waare abam á keim-lwanno tem ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balei wó taa vei daane ye ba wo ŋɔɔne ba maŋe daane na?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Nywoŋo ná wo zi woŋo, ko wó suuri gaao ne na? Nywoŋo-balaŋa ná wo jaane woŋo, ko wó taa ŋuuri ko tiga jei ne na?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná wo chege kalanchogo o tiŋi, ko wó wane zuŋa ko ja na? Kalanchogo nam wae ko pɔpɔ ko faŋe wɛɛne ye kolokolo tera se ko ja na?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Ba ná wugi tigura nabɔnɔ teo wone, foone bá ja nɔɔna bam na? Baŋa Wɛ ná wo pɛ chwoŋa, chɔgem wó wane de ba teo wone na?

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Nywoŋo nam seene ko suuri! Wɔ mo bá taa kɔre foone? Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ŋɔɔne ja! Wɔ mo wó ve se o tɔɔle o taane dem? Samaria teo chɔgem

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Nam tɔɔle-na kwora se ka yi balo na zoore Ejipti de Asedodi sɔ-fwaaro tem wone to we, “Jeeri-na daane Samaria peero tem yuu ne se á nii á lɔre wo-yɔɔro de lwarem delo Isarele tiina bam na ke ba pa daane to.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we, “Nɔɔna banto yeiri chega chwoŋa tɔgem. Ba yeini ba vere nɔɔna wonnu de dam ba vei ba sui ba sɔ-fwaaro tem.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane ba dona wó ba ba gilimi ba teo kom pa se ba chɔge ba dam jei sem ye ba vere ba jejegero ba sɔ-fwaaro tem wone.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Nywoŋo ná jaane pia se ko di, nayero wó kwaane se o jwoŋi pia kam ko ni ne, ko ná maŋe ko ye ka nɛ selei de ka zwa chichworo yerane de. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de Isarele tiina balo na zoore Samaria wone to. Ba ná maŋe ba na verem, ba jejegero fenfee yerane mo wó daare, nenɛɛne jangɔŋɔ naga chichworo naa pulu na zareme tei to.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “Cheigi-na, se á kaane Jakob dwi tiina bam we:

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem amo na wó waare Isarele tiina bam ba wɛleera yam ŋwaane to, amo wó chɔge Bɛtel kaanem bimbina yam ye a pa se ya nyea yam maama bwori ya to tega ne.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amo wó yɔɔre a chɔge ba sam dem maama. Ko ná ye sɔŋɔ kolo ba na lɔge teo kamunu wone naa teo balaŋa wone to, de kolo ba na kwei tuu yeila ba ma kwɛ to de, amo wó chochoge ba sɔ-fwaaro tem maama.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Cheigi-na a taane dem, abam kaana balo na nwoŋi Samaria to. Á na nugi tei to nye de Basan naane dem mo. Abam yeini á daane nabwona, ye á bɛɛse yiniga tiina. Á ta daare á fe á banna se ba pa abam sana se á nyɔ á su.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na ye wose to nam dugi de o tete mo o we: “Maŋa lage ka yi se nɔɔna zi abam ba vaŋe á momwa ba ja kɛ. Ba wó vaŋe á maama ba ja kɛ ne ba na mɛ gwoli ba ja ywona tei to.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ba wó le abam á sam dem ne ba ja tɔge kabiri sem na bwori mɛ to laŋa ne ba kɛ ba de abam ba yage Haremon seeni.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Isarele tiina na yeini ba ve Wɛ ni dem tei to

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Kwei-na bworobworo á ja á ba se á pa Wɛ se ko taa ye abam lei keim. Ko daare á wo-ywoŋo pɛɛra yam, á jege se á mage á nyɔɔna ya ŋwaane se nɔɔna maama lɔre á na ke tei to. Wonnu telo abam Isarele tiina bam na lage se á ta‑á ke to mo konto.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “Amo nam mo pɛ se kana zo á teene dem maama wone. De ko de, á ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: “Chane setɔ ta na daare se á pe á wodiiru to, amo pɛ se doa wo nege ye á wodiiru chɔge. Amo pɛ doa ne teo dedoa ne ye ka wo nege kodwoŋi ne. Ka ta nege kara dedoa ne ye kadwoŋi mena kwaare kwaare.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma nwoŋi ba teo wone ba kare teene dedwonna ba lage na se ba nyɔ, ye na bam wo yi ba nyɔɔm. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Amo ta pɛ se jaweero ba te chɔge abam kare sem wodiiru. Kayere maa yeini se di á teeni maama, pa se á kaporro tem de á Olivi tio-bia de á Vini tio-bia bam maama chɔge. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Amo pɛ jawe-chɛɛro ba abam baŋa, ne amo déem na ke tei a ma a chɔge Ejipti tiina bam faŋa faŋa to. Amo pɛ á nɔn-donno te jara wone, ye nɔɔna kale á sisein-nɔɔna bam maama ba ja ba viiri. Twa yera lwom ma zaŋe de su á na tigi mɛ maama to. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Amo chɔge abam badwonna ne a na chɔge Sodom de Gomora tiina tei to. Abam balo na daare ye á wori to déem jwoŋi á ŋwea ne daa kalo na jaane mini ye ba le-ka de wone tei to. Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á jwoori amo tei.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam, cheigi-na, se a lage a leeni abam lua luseim leiŋa mo:

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Isarele dwi dem nye de busankan-pwola na to tega ne to mo. O daa bá zaŋe. O tigi tega ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri ko ni ne, se o ja‑o se o zaŋe.”

english_verse: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ta maa we: “Abam teo dedoa ná pɛ nɔɔna morro nwoŋi ba vo ba kwaare jara, nɔɔna bi yerane mo wó jwoori ye ba ŋwe. Á teo kodwoŋi ná pɛ nɔɔna bi nwoŋi, nɔɔna fuga yerane mo wó jwoori.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa tɛ de Isarele dwi dem o we: “Jwoori-na á ba amo tei se á ta‑á ŋwe.

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: Nam fɔɔre-na á yi Baŋa Wɛ tei se á ta‑á ŋwe! Á ná wo sɛ se á jwoori, Wɛ bane wó zaŋe Josɛf dwi dem baŋa ne, ye o daare o chɔge-ba ne mini na zwɛ wonnu tei to. Bɛtel maama mo wó chɔge, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o dwei mini dem.

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo ke chalechwe dwi dwi o tigisi daane. Wonto mo pae se tete leiri ko jiri te-pora. O maa pae se wea jiri tete. Wonto mo yeini o kwoori naneero tem na bam o jwoori o lwoi tega kam baŋa ne. O yere mo Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: O yeini o pae se chɔgem tui dedɛɛra baŋa ne mo lela, ye o daare o chɔge ba dam jei sem.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, boboŋa tiina wó taa ye chemm, kokuri to, ko ye lwarem maŋa mo.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Yage-na totoŋ-lwanno keim, á daare á ta‑á ke wo-laaro, se á ta‑á ŋwe. Ko maa wó pa se Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ taa wo abam tei ne, nenɛɛne abam na yeini á tɛ tei to.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Ta‑á chuli lwarem á daare á ta‑á swoi kolo na lamma to. Á nakwa bam jege se ba taa tɔge chega mo de ba na di nɔɔna taane tei to. Dɛ delo, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó duri á ŋwaŋa, abam balo na daare ye á ye Josɛf dwi dem to.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Abam na tusi to ŋwaane, dé Teiru Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei mo tento: “Nɔɔna keira wó zaŋe teo kom pwola maama ne. Ba wó taa keeri ba we, ‘Lɛɛro! Lɛɛro!’. Ba ta wó ware vala bam se ba taa tɔge ba keera ko woli de balo na wae luseim ba leeni to.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Wopwolo bá taa wo á kare sem maama wone, keira yerane mo wó taa wora, amo na wó tɔge abam tetare ne a waare abam to ŋwaane.” Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom taane

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Abam balo na jege teena se Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem ba de yi to, lɛɛro taa wo á yuu ne! Bɛŋwaane mo á lage se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ dem ba? Dɛ dem konto wó taa ye yibiri mo de pae abam, se de bá ja pwooni de ba.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Ko wó taa ye nenɛɛne nɔɔno ná duri se o lu nywoŋo jeŋa ne tei to mo. O ma duri o vo o jeeri ga-naao na cheiŋi‑o to. O ma daare o vo o yi sɔŋɔ se o daŋe o jeŋa kabira baŋa ne, ye tega-veilu laam done‑o o jeŋa seeni!

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Chega to, Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem wó taa ye yibiri dedaane lim mo. Pwooni bá taa wora de fenfee de. Wɛ na chuli wonnu telo to Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: “Amo chuli abam na yeini á di kura yalo maama amo ŋwaane to. Amo yi ba sui de abam na jeeri daane se á zuli-ne tei to.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Nam pa-na se chega borem de lanyerane keim taa wora maŋa maama, ne bu-dura na duri ka via ye ka ba we tei to.

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Abam laam nam jege á jwona yalo abam tete na mɔɔne-ya to á zeŋe á maa kɛa. Á maa bwoi ya dedoa we abam pɛ Sakuti. Dedwoŋi dem maa ye á jwoni Kayiwan, á na zuli-de ne chalechoa tei to.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: Abam balo na zoore Zion ne ye á di ywoni to, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam balo na zoore Samaria peo yuu ne de bochare-zuri to, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam pae á ye nɔn-kamuna á te-fɔrɔ kom ne. Isarele dwi tiina yeini ba tui abam tei ba lwoori wolim.

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: Á yeini á ma tuu yeili á kwɛ á gadworu tem pa se te lana dedɛ. Á laam maa tigi á konkwallo tem ne á sii ywoni yerane. Á yeini á done pipeili nɔna, de na-mɔre nɔna mo á sui.

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: Abam swoi se á ta‑á leeni lein-doora, ye á tae á kwanno, nenɛɛne Pɛ David déem na leeni tei to.

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: Abam maa swoi se á ta‑á nyɔ sana dedɛ á sui. Á maa yeini á kwei nu-ywoŋa kalo na jege kwora to á ma á turi á yera. Á yiga nam tera de Josɛf dwi dem na wora de chɔga tei to.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ dugi o tete yere ŋwaane o ta konto mo. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “A wo mo nwoŋi Jakob dwi dem de ba na pae ba tete kamunim tei to. A yiga tera de ba sɔ-fwaaro tem! Amo wó kwei ba teo kamunu kom de ba jejegero tem maama a ke ba dona jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna fuga ná daare sɔŋɔ kolo wone ye ba seigi da, ba maama wó te.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa ni mo, se o pa sɔ-kamuna de sɔ-balwa maama mumugi mura-mura.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Abam ta bere á tete we, á mage jara de Lo-Debara teo kom á wane-ba. Á ta kwori á we, “Debam mɛ dé dam mo dé di Karenayim teo kom!”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we: “Isarele dwi dem, amo lage a pa teo kodwoŋi dwi tiina mo zaŋe ba kwaare jara de abam. Nɔɔna banto wó tiini ba bɛɛse abam á tega kam maama wone, ko zege Lebo-Hamafa ne, se ko taa vei Araba nabara kam na wo mɛ to.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ na le kolo o bere-ne to mo tento: Dɛ dedwe ba na zage pɛ wom mena ba ti, ye kare sem wodiiru tedwonna ta wora te kwi to, mo Wɛ toŋe kayere se se ba se chɔge tega kam.

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Amo ma nii a na we kayere sem deilimi wo-lɛɔ dwi maama na wo tega kam ne to mo nyɔ! Amo laam maa we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, popo, yage n ma n chɛ n nɔɔna bam! Nmo ná wo ke konto, Jakob dwi dem daa bá wane ba wori, ba na tiini ba bwona to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma sɛ ye o leiri o boboŋa. O maa we, “Nmo na nii n na tei to daa bá ke.” Mini taane

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa na veere kolo o bere-ne to mo tento: Amo nɛ we Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ boŋe se o tɔre min-lɔŋɔ o ma waare o nɔɔna bam. Mini dem ma di naneo kom maama nyɔ, ye de laam wora de di tega kam.

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ma leiri o boboŋa ye o we, “Nmo na nii n na tei to de daa bá ke.” Lɔra ŋona taane

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ta na le kolo o bere-ne to mo tento: Amo nii a na kabira kalo lɔra bam na kwei ŋona ba ma lɔ-ka ba fɔge ba zege deiki to mo. A ta ma na we Baŋa Wɛ zege ka teiŋa ne ye o zei lɔra ŋona kam o jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma bwei-ne o we, “Amosi, bɛ mo n nɛa?” Amo ma leiri a we, “Amo nɛ lɔra ŋona mo.” O laam maa we, “Amo wó kwei lɔra ŋona kanto mo a maŋe a nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam se ko bere we ba ba zege chekke. Amo nam daa bá yage ba wɛleera a ma chɛ-ba.

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Amazia déem ye kaanem tu mo Bɛtel ne. Wonto ma toŋe kwora o pa Isarele tiina pɛ Jeroboam o we, “Amosi jege nmo ta-balwaaro mo o ŋɔɔna debam Isarele tiina teo kom tetare ne. O ni taane dem lage de soge nɔɔna bam pa se ba lɔ nmo kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: O maa tɛ o we, ‘Jeroboam wó te jara wone, se ba daare ba ja Isarele tiina bam ba nwoŋi ba tete teo kom wone ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.’ ”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Amazia laam ma toŋe o ta de Amosi o we “Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, ko maŋe konto! Laam jwoori n vo n tete teo Judah, se n ta‑n pworisi dáane. Nmo ma‑n wó ta‑n nae n ni-wodiu da.

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: Daa‑n yé pworisi Bɛtel ywo-seeni. Jei sento ye pɛ wom tete wara-jei mo, ye dé teo kom maama zuli da!”
