english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Amosi ma leiri Amazia o we: “Amo maŋe a dae sampwora! A wo nwoŋi sampwori selo na pworisi ŋweero ŋwaane to kɔgɔ kom wone. Amo ye nayero mo! A maa kale a vara. A ta maa nii kaporro baŋa ne ye a pore kapera yam.

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma le-ne a vara bam kwaga ne, ye o ta o we, a véi a pworisi a bere omo nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam.

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: Amazia, nam lɔre se n kaane wó ji ka-bworo o taa kare teo kom ne o beeri baara. Nmo bia bam wó te jara wone, bakeiri de busankane sem maama. Ba maa wó pɔɔre nmo tega kam ba pa nɔɔna badwonna. Nmo tete nam wó te dwi-gɛ teo ne. Ba maa wó seene ba ja Isarele tiina bam ba nwoŋi ba tete teo kom wone ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi.”

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ne o we, “Amosi, bɛ mo n nɛa?” Amo ma leiri a we, “Tetɔgɔ mo a nɛa, ye ko su de tio-bia na bege to.” Baŋa Wɛ laam maa we: “A nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam kikia laam bege ya yi se a waare-ba. Amo nam daa yage ba wɛleera a ma chɛ-ba.

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ná yia, pɛ sɔŋɔ wopwolo lei sem wó ji keira mo. Twa wó taa tigi teo kom jei maama ne, ye ba daare ba zeŋe-ba ba ja nwoŋi chemm.” Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto. Isarele tiina lɛɛro tem taane

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: Abam yeini á tɛ á we, “Dé lage se Wɛ siu dɛ dem naa chan-doŋa kuri dem ti lela se dé jwoori dé vo dé kwei dé mena yam dé taa yeiga. Dé maa wó kwei bwɛ selo na muri to dé ma pini dé yeilla bam dé jwoŋi ba sabia dedɛ.

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Dé ta wó kwei mena yalo na gwaane de swanno to dé laam yeigi-ya dé jwoŋi sabu dedɛ. Dé ta wae dé beeri yiniga tu wolo na ware o jene o ŋwe to, se dé yeigi kotu dé ma dé ji dé kabaa, o jene dem ná maŋe de mae de o naga natera yam yerane.”

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ta ma ta o we: “Maŋa kam konto ná yia, a lage a pa wɛ vo de zo wea tetare ne, pa se yibiri taa wo jei maama ne wea maŋa ne.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa ne, na-nyɔm wó go abam nɔn-donno de busankan-pwoli tete.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye balo na kwei Samaria jwona yam yera ba ma du duuri to, de balo na tɛ ba we, ‘Dan jwoni dem yere ŋwaane’, naa ‘Beeriseba jwoni dem yere ŋwaane’ to, nɔɔna bam konto wó to. Ba nam daa bá jwoori ba zaŋe wɛɛne.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Amo daa na nii to, mo a nɛ we Baŋa Wɛ zege bimbini dem teiŋa ne. O laam ma pa ni o we: “Tiini n mage Wɛ diga kam nayuu bei sem de dam pa se diga kam kuri maama ziziŋi. Zage bei sem n pa se maama to nɔɔna bam yuni ne se go-ba. Amo nam wó pa se balo na daare ye ba ŋwe to te jara wone, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lu.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: Ba ná maŋe ba ko tega mo se ba zo churu, amo wó yi da a vaŋe-ba a ja a nwoŋi. Ba ze ná diini telaao ne, amo wó ja-ba a tu tega.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná kwaane ba di Kamele peo kom yuu ba seigi da, amo ta wó beeri ba jei a daare a zi-ba. Ba nam ze ná zo naneo kuri kuri mo se ba seigi amo yiga ne de, amo wó pa naneo wo juru kom done-ba ko go.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Ba dona bam ná jaane-ba ba kale ba vo sa-teo kodwoŋi, a ta wó pa ba te jara wone. Kokuri to, a boboŋa jaane se a chɔge-ba mo, se a daa yé woli-ba.”

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lɔge o sɔŋɔ mo. Ko nayuu kom wo wɛyuu ne mo baŋa baŋa, ko kugu kom maa wo tega baŋa ne. Wonto mo yeini o kwoori naneero tem na bam o jwoori o lwoi tega kam baŋa ne. O yere mo Baŋa Wɛ!

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta o we: “Isarele tiina bam, á yé ta‑á boŋe-na we abam gare Kusi tiina bam amo yiga ne. Ko ye chega mo we a vere abam a ja nwoŋi Ejipti ne. Amo nam jaane Filisi tiina bam a nwoŋi Kiriti ne mo, ye a ta kwori a ja Aram tiina bam a nwoŋi Kiri ne. Ko dae konto na?

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: Amo lage a pa se Isarele tiina bam mo na yaara teene dedwonna dem maama wone. Ko wó ta nye de ba na zezɛ muni yɔlɔ wone se weero nwoŋi tei to mo. Amo wó pa se ba le nɔn-yɔɔro tem maama ba daare nɔn-ŋona bam.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Amo nɔɔna balo maama na tusi to mo lage ba te jara wone, ko ná maŋe ko ye balo na tɛ ba we, Wɛ bá sɛ se kolokolo yi-ba to.” Isarele teo kom na wó jwoori ko zege tei to

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: “Dɛ dem konto ná yia, amo wó fɔge a lɔ Pɛ David sɔŋɔ kom na chɔge to. A maa wó jwoori a kwɛ ko kabiri sem pa se ko di-dwonnu tem jwoori te ji sɔ-doŋo.

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: Ko maa wó pa se Isarele tiina laam di Edom laŋa kalo ta na daare to, dedaane teene delo maama ya na ye amo nyem to. Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto, ye a wó pa se wonnu tento maama seene te ke.”

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amo tete mo lage a jeini a nɔɔna bam tega kalo a na pɛ-ba to wone. Ba nam ná jeini ka wone, a daa bá le-ba maŋa de maŋa.” Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom mo tage konto maama.

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: “Nii ywo! Amo lage a pa se á teo kom mo tiini ko taa bwona teene dem maama wone. Nɔɔna wó taa jege abam ba tiini ba yaala.

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Abam ná maŋe á di wɛyuu, nenɛɛne maao na jaane wɛ-wɛ tei to, naa á ná lage á sɔ pwogo chalechwe sem tetare ne de, amo ta wó vaare abam a de tega ne.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: “Lɛɛro mo wo á baŋa ne! Ŋweena ná tu á sɔŋɔ se ba ŋɔ tete ne, ba bá ŋɔ wonnu telo yerane ba na beeri to mo na? Nɔɔna ná tu se ba gwori Vini tio-bia, ba yeini ba ba gwori ba daare tio-bia badwonna na?

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nɔn-babɛ selo na zoore Teman teo wone to, foone wó ja-ba. Ko daare balo maama na ye Esawu dwi dem to wó jei mo.” Esawu dwi tiina na chɔge Jakob dwi tiina tei to

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ dɛ dem lage de yi se a di logo baŋa dwi maama taane. Edom tiina bam, á de wó na á nyem, nenɛɛne á na ke nɔɔna badwonna tei to. Á keim-balwaaro tem lage te jwoori te to á tete yuu ne mo.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Abam déem na wo amo tete peo kom yuu ne ye á nyɔ sana á su tei to, konto dwoŋi mo dwi-gɛ tiina bam de wó su de a ban-zɔŋɔ kom. Ba wó tiini ba nyɔ taa ba su, pa se ba yera laam saare logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Ko daare Zion peo kom ne mo nɔɔna wó na verem. Jei sem konto wó taa ye wose se pa-ne. Jakob dwi tiina bam wó jwoori ba jwoŋi ba tega kam balo na vere-ka to tei ne ba taa tei.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina balo na zoore tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne to mo wó zo Esawu peero jei sem ne ba taa zoore da. Balo de na zoore wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem ne to maa wó jwoŋi Filisi tiina tega kam ba taa tei. Ba ta wó jwoŋi Efrayim laŋa kam de Samaria laŋa kam. Benjamin dwi dem wó jwoŋi Gilead laŋa kam ba taa tei.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina balo maama ya na jage to wó jwoori ba zo Kanaan tega kam. Ba kɔgɔ kom wó jeini tega kam maama ne se ko vo ko yi Zarefate. Jerusalem tiina balo na jage ye ba wo Sefarade ne to de wó vo ba jeini teene delo na wo tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam ne to.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Babɛ selo na jwoŋi ba nɔɔna ba yage to mo wó di Zion peo kom yuu. Ba wó taa tei Esawu peero laŋa kam maama. Kanto maŋa kam ne, Baŋa Wɛ mo wó di paare o nɔɔna baŋa ne.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem mo ŋɔɔne de Amitayi bu Jonah o we,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Zaŋe n vo Ninevɛ te-fɔrɔ kom n ta‑n kaane ko nɔɔna bam we, ba lwarem dem gaale amo yiga ne.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Jonah ma ve ye o zaŋe o duri se o vo Tarasisi. O déem vei Jopa mo se o ná nɛ nabworo na maa vei jei sem konto, se o duri o lu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. O laam ma ŋwe o sabu, ye o da o zo nabworo kom ne.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se vo-dɛɔ zaŋe ko mage na bam dedɛ. Vio kom na tiini ko fufugi konto to, nabworo kom maa ga fee se ko bwori.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Foone ma tiini de ja nabworo kom yuŋina bam, ye ba dedoa dedoa bobo o kaase o lwoori o teo wɛ se de jwoŋi‑o de yage. Ba ma daare ba dole ba zela ba yage na bam ne se nabworo kom taa pwona. Jonah déem nam ya tu nabworo kom kuri gugworo ne mo o tigi da, ye o dɔ o kɛ.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Yuŋina bam yiga tu wom ma vo o na‑o, ye o bwei‑o o we, “Bɛ mo ye nmo tigi n dɔa? Nmo de zaŋe n bwoŋi n Wɛ yere, se dɛ delo wonto wó duri dé ŋwaŋa, se dé yé maŋe na banto wone.”

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Nabworo yuŋina bam ma bane daane ba we, “Pa-na se dé ta jɔrɔ se dé lɔre wolo ŋwaane cham dento na yi debam to.” Ba na tage to, ko ma ja Jonah.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Ta‑n tɛa, wɔ mo pɛ se lwarem dento ba debam baŋa? Bɛ totoŋe mo nmo jega se n toŋe ywo? Nmo nwoŋi yei ne mo? Nmo dwi ye dɔ mo?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Jonah ma leiri o we, “Amo ye Hiburu dwi tu mo. Amo nam tɔge Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu ye o kwori o ke tega baŋa de naneo maama to mo.”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Ba na nigi konto to, foone déem ma tiini de ja nɔɔna bam. Kokuri to, Jonah ya maŋe o ta o bere-ba we o kwaane se o duri o lu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne mo. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Bɛ mo ye nmo ke keim dento?”

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Nabworo yuŋina bam ma bwei‑o ba we, “Bɛ mo dé wó ke de nmo se naneo kom ke ziim?” Vio kom déem yɔɔre ko taa tiini ko dana ko pa-ba mo pa se ba bwei‑o konto.

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Jonah ma leiri o we, “Ja-na amo á dole á de naneo kom wone, se ko wó ke ziim ko pa abam. Ko ye chega, amo yiga mo pɛ se abam zo vo-dɛɔ konto wone.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Ba maa wo sɛ ye ba ya ta kwaane ba yuŋa de ba dam maama se nabworo kom wane ko bɛ buburu baŋa, ye ba ware. Vio kom ma bole ye ko fɔge ko tiini ko dana ko ja gaale.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Ba ma kaase ba bwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ yere ba we, “Jan ja, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ! Dé lwoori‑m, yé chɔge debam dé na lage dé le nɔɔno wom ŋwea to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, nmo ná wo pɛ chwoŋa, tento maama bá ke.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma dole Jonah ba de naneo kom wone, ye ko de ke ziim bedwe baŋa ne.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ kolo maama na ke to, mo Wɛ kɔrɔ zo-ba lanyerane. Ba ma kwei kaanem ba ke ba pa Baŋa Wɛ, ye ba ta pwooli se ba taa zuli‑o.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Jonah, Baŋa Wɛ toŋe ywoni kamunu mo pa se de ba de li‑o. O maa wo ywoni dem wone da yatɔ wea de tete maama.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Jonah déem maa wo ywoni dem puga wone, ye o ware o Tu Baŋa Wɛ o we:

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: “Amo Tu, amo na wo cham ne to, a bwoŋi nmo yere ye n seene n leiri-ne. Twa gugworru jei sem ne kuri kuri mo a keeri a lage zeina n tei ne, ye n ni a keira kam.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: N dole-ne n de luŋu luŋu naneo kuri ne chekke, mɛ na bam na kaare-ne ba pu to. Na-ŋon-kamuna ma bibili amo baŋa ne se kɛa.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Amo ya boŋe we n zeili-ne n yiga ne mo, pa se a daa yé na nmo tete diga kam dɛ de dɛ.

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Na bam kwoli-ne ye ba kerege-ne. Naneo kom de ma pu amo maama. Na wone gaaro tem de déem jujugi amo yuu maama.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: A ma tu na wone a dwei pelwaaro kura, mɛ chwoŋa na tera se nɔɔno wane o lu kɔtaa to. Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo nam jaane-ne, ye a nwoŋi gwoŋo wone de a ŋwea.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Jwona ye wo-yɔɔro mo. Balo maama na zuli-ya to dole ba chega de nmo mo ba yage.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó taa leeni tia lei mo a pa‑m. A ta wó kwei kaanem mo a pa‑m, se a daare a ke kolo a na pwooli se a ke a pa‑m to. Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na pae nɔɔna na verem to mo!”

english_verse: Once again the Lord told Jonah
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ŋɔɔne de Jonah o ke belei o we,

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Nam zaŋe n vo Ninevɛ na ye te-fɔrɔ to, se a laam pa‑m a kwora se n tɔɔle-ka n pa ko nɔɔna bam.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Jonah ma sɛ Baŋa Wɛ ni ye o daare o vo Ninevɛ. Teo kom konto tiini ko yala ye ba kwei da yatɔ mo ba maa kaare ko ni maama.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Jonah na vei dɛ wone veiŋa teo kom wone to, mo o bobo se o taa tɔɔle taane dem ye o we, “Da finna mo daare se Baŋa Wɛ chɔge Ninevɛ teo kom zɔŋ-zɔŋ!”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ninevɛ tiina bam ma sɛ Wɛ kwora kam. Ba ma tɔɔle se nɔɔna maama vɔ ni se ba daare ba zo gare-nyenyaaro, se ko bere ba wo-chechɔgɔ kom. Nɔɔna maama jege se ba ke konto dwoŋi mo, ko ná ye nɔn-kamuna naa nabwona de.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Ba pɛ wom na nigi kwora kam to, o ma zaŋe o daare o paare yituŋu kom. O ma lɔɔre o paare gwaaro o tiŋi dáa ne ye o lɛ gare-nyenyaaro. O ma daare o vo o jei tentwarem wone.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ déem maane ba kikia yam de ba na yage ba totoŋ-lwanno tem to. O ma seene o duri ba ŋwaŋa ye o wo waare-ba ne o ya na tage we o wó ke tei to.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: O ma ware Baŋa Wɛ o we, “Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, amo ya ta na wo a tete teo ne to, a maŋe a lɔre we tento mo wó ke. Konto ŋwaane mo a nam maŋe a kwaane se a duri a vo Tarasisi to. Kokuri to, amo yei nmo na ye swono tu Wɛ, ye n tiini n jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa tei to. N ma‑n yeini n peene n bane ye n leiri n boboŋa se n yé chɔge nɔɔna.

english_verse: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nam yage se a te, se a toone gare a ŋwea.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma bwei‑o o we, “Wɔ mo pɛ‑m chwoŋa se n pa n bane zaŋe konto dwoŋi?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Jonah na nigi konto to, o ma nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo ko wɛ-puli seeni o tei pwoŋa o jei ka kuri ne. O laam maa jei ka woro ne o cheiga se o nii kolo na wó ke Ninevɛ teo kom to.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ma pa se nyambɔle nwoŋi de milimi de kwoli pwoŋa kam maama pa woro wora lanyerane. Ko ma pa Jonah zurim ye o jege wopwolo de nyambɔle dem vɔɔro.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Tega na yi ye ka jwoori ka poore to, Wɛ ma pa kanzwɛ dedwoŋi ba de done nyambɔle dem pa de kwaare de te maama.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Wea na bega to, Wɛ ma toŋe vo-loŋo se ko zege wɛ-puli seeni ko ba ko mage Jonah yupare baŋa. O yuu maa wɔe. O déem gɛ fee mo se o beiri, we-dɛa kam ŋwaane. O ma tiini o boŋe o beeri toone, ye o we, “A toone maŋe de gare a ŋwea.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ma bwei‑o o we, “Chwoŋa kɔ mo n jega se n pa n bane zaŋe nyambɔle dem ŋwaane?” Jonah ma leiri o we, “Chwoŋa wora chekke se a bane zaŋe dedɛ. Ko ná maŋe ko ye se a te de, a jege chega.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ko ná ye nyambɔle dem, tete dedoa ne mo a pɛ de zaŋe de be. A daa ma pa se de jei tete dedwoŋi ne. Nmo wo ke kolokolo n pa-de, se de maa zaŋe de be. Bɛ mo ye n wo chɔge de ŋwaane?

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na ŋɔɔne taane delo o bere Mika, o na nwoŋi Moresɛf teo to mo tento. Ko maa ye maŋa kalo Jotam, de Ahaz, de Hezekia déem na saŋe daane ba ye pwa Judah teo kom ne to. Samaria dedaane Jerusalem nɔɔna bam na toŋe tei to mo Wɛ veere o bere Mika. Samaria de Jerusalem borem taane

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na zoore tega baŋa ne to, pore-na á zwa á cheigi taane dento lanyerane. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo jei o wɛyuu sɔŋɔ kom ne ye o lage o saŋe abam.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Peero tem tete wó nyeene kalia kalia, ne ba na saŋe nuga mini ne tei to mo. Zwonnu tem de wó jage te jei, nenɛɛne na na chuuri ba kɛ tei to.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Marofa tiina bam maama yɔɔre ba wowole mo ba teene verem, Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe lɛɛro ye te ga fee se te yi Jerusalem teo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam, véi-na á ke bana de Moresɛf-Gafa tiina bam. Á daa bá na-ba. Akiziba teo kom nam lage ko lɔ Isarele tiina pwa bam kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Abam balo na zoore Maresa ne to, Baŋa Wɛ lage o pa á dona bam wane á teo kom ba di mo. Wolo na jege yere Isarele tiina bam wone to wó duri o vo o seigi Adulam peo bɔɔne dem wone.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam, cheeri-na á yum se á daare á ta‑á laara, ba na lage ba ja á bu-swonnu tem ba kale ba vo sa-teo to ŋwaane. Chega to, tiini á cheeri-na á yum nenɛɛne duura yum na ye tei to.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege lwarem boboŋa to, lɛɛro wo ba yuu ne! Ba yeini ba peini tete ne ba boŋe boboŋ-balwaaro mo. Tega ná poore, ba wó seene ba ke kolo na su ba yia to, ba na jege ko dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam na tage kolo to mo tento: “Amo tete jege boboŋa se a pa cham mo ba abam baŋa ne. Nɔɔno tera á wone o na wó wane o jwoŋi o tete o yage. Maŋa kam konto ne, á wó na lɛɛro pa se á de á kamunni dem maama tega ne.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó taa jege abam ba mɔna ye ba leeni wo-chechɔgɔ leiŋa ba we: ‘Lɛɛro wo dé yum ne! Ba vere dé tega kam ba daare debam. Ka laam wo dé dona bam jeŋa ne mo!’ ”

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto yeini ba pworisi ba ta de amo ba we, “Yé ta‑n pworisi konto dwoŋi! Debam bere dé bá na dé chaveera!”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Ko wo maŋe se Jakob dwi tiina bam taa ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi. Á boŋe we Baŋa Wɛ wó peene o bane de abam, se o yé ke abam kolokolo mo na? Ko nam ná ye balo na tɔge chwoŋa to, amo ni taane dem wó fɔge-ba lanyerane. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: “Abam na ke tei to, á tiini á pa ko zo amo nɔɔna bam yera, ne á ye a dona mo tei. Á yeini á zi á dwonna balo na nwoŋi jara jei ba jwoori ba sam to, ye á daare á vere ba gwaaro tem.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Abam mo zeili amo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom kaana bam pa ba nwoŋi sam delo na ye ba kugu jei sem to wone. Ko ta ná ye ba bia bam, á ma vere wo-laaro telo amo na ke ba jeŋa ne se ba taa tei to.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Zaŋe-na á lage jei! Á daa bá ta‑á zoore jei sem konto ne se á na siu. Abam lwarem totoŋa mo pɛ se teo kom maama chɔge.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Jakob dwi tiina bam, amo wó jwoori a la abam a ke daane. Chega to, a wó kale balo maama na daare Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom wone to, ne nayero na kale o pei o pa se jwoori se zo se peiga jei tei to. Konto to, tega kam wó ba ka su de kɔgɔ dedɛ.”

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: Abam nam chuli kolo maama na jege lam to ye á daare á tɔge totoŋ-balwaaro kwaga. Á yeini á ja amo nɔɔna bam á pwoni ba tɔn-zwona kam á daare ba kwi sem yerane.

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Maŋa beene, se nɔn-balwaaro tem konto ba ba lwoori zeina Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. O nam bá sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom. O wó ma o kwaga o ya-ba, ba na toŋe lwarem kikia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ni taane dem mo tento: “A lage a ta woŋo de sampwori selo na gane a nɔɔna bam to. Nɔɔno wolo ná pɛ-ba ba ni-wodiu, ba wó ta de kotu we, ‘Yazura taa wo n tei ne.’ Wolo nam ná wo pɛ-ba kolokolo, ba wó fugi kotu we tigura beene o baŋa.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, Baŋa Wɛ mo ke o Jworo kom a bochare ne pa se a jege dam. Konto ŋwaane mo a wane a lɔre chwoŋa kalo na lana to, ye a na baare se a ta chega de Isarele tiina bam se ba lɔre ba na tusi tei to.

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Abam kikia yam konto ŋwaane Wɛ tete teo Jerusalem wó to ko saare ko ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna wó ba ba va Zion tega kam konto ba tiŋi. Teeni wó li zwoŋo kolo Wɛ diga kam ya na zege da to.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Maŋa wó ba ye Baŋa Wɛ diga kam na zege peo kolo yuu ne to na yere ko dwoni logo baŋa jei maama. Ko wó taa zege wɛɛne vili-vili se ko dwoni peero tem maama. Dwi dedɛ tiina wó taa nwoŋi ba teene dem ne ba twoŋi daane taa ba yɔɔre da.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama laam wó taa zoore ba sam wone ye lwia tera. Ba wó jeini ba tete teeni dem woro ne ba sii. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o fugi-ba. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni taane mo konto.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina boŋe se ba taa tɔge ba tete wa yam chwei mo. Debam dwi dem nam wó taa tɔge dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom se ko taa vei wuu. Isarele tiina wó jwoori sɔŋɔ

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “Da yam konto ne, amo wó la nɔɔna balo a na pɛ ba yaare sa-teo ne to a ke daane.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ke ye á keeri de baare konto? Ko ye á pɛ wom de á nakwa bam ŋwaane mo na? Ba daa ta tera na? Konto ŋwaane mo pɛ á wo zonne wone ne kapua na wowole se o lo tei to na?

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Jar-keira mo nwoŋi teene dedɛ wone ba la daane se ba kwaare jara de abam. Ba maa we, “Pa-na dé yɔɔre dé chɔge Jerusalem teo kom zɔŋ-zɔŋ, se dé daare dé pa chaveera ja-ko!”

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: “Ko nam ná ye nmo, Bɛtelehem Eferata, nmo muri Judah dwi tiina sɔ-yuni tem maama wone. De ko de, amo lage a le dedɛɛro abam wone se o taa tei Isarele tiina bam o pa-ne. O wó taa ye wolo dwi dem na zege faŋa faŋa to mo.”

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro wom wó zaŋe o taa tei o nɔɔna bam ne nayero na nii o pei baŋa ne tei to. Baŋa Wɛ wó pa‑o dam se o ke konto omo Tu Wɛ tete yere-kamunu kom ŋwaane. Logo baŋa jei sem maama wó ni o kamunni dem ŋwa pa se nɔɔna bam taa zoore de yazura.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Wonto wó ja wo-zuru o ba o pa-ba. Isarele tiina bam wó taa tei ba tete Asiria tiina jar-keira bam wó wane ba ba ba nɔ dé tega kam se ba daare ba chɔge dé sɔ-fwaaro tem. Dé nam wó pa se dedɛɛra dedɛ zaŋe dé wone ba zeili-ba.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Ba wó wane Asiria tiina bam ba ke-ba ba dam kuri ne. Ba ta wó zo Nimrodi teo kom ba di ko nɔn-bia bam. Chega to, Asiria tiina bam ná kwaare jara de debam, dé dedɛɛra bam wó jwoŋi debam ba jeŋa ne ba yage.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Jakob dwi tiina balo na daare to wó taa zoore dwi-gɛ tiina tetare ne. Baŋa Wɛ nam wó pa ba taa nye de nyɔnɔ de doa kalo na li tega kam pa ka zuri to mo. Ko dae nabiina mo ba daŋe ba teena ba baŋa ne, se ko ye Wɛ yerane mo.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam, á wó wane á dona bam pa se ba saare tega kam baŋa ne!

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta o we: “Maŋa kam konto ne amo wó chaale á sisein-nɔɔna bam ye a daare a chɔge á jara-keim torokooro tem maama.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: A ta maa wó chɔge á liri-mwa kikia yam, ye yi-nara bam daa bá wane ba taa toŋa ba totoŋa.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Amo wó tɔge a ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne a waare dwi-gɛ tiina balo na wo sɛ se ba tɔge amo ni to.”

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Cheigi-na Baŋa Wɛ na lage o ta kolo to: “Isarele tiina bam, zaŋe-na se á tole á taane dem se peero tem de zwonnu tem maama ni.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Amo, Baŋa Wɛ mo jege taane se a ja a jeeri abam balo na ye a tete nɔɔna bam to. Logo baŋa peero tem dedaane tega kuri dem maama wó zege amo chega kam kwaga ne.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, a bere a ke bɛ mo a ma chɔge abam? A bɛɛse abam tetɛ mo? Á jege taane se á ta na?

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Amo nam jaane abam a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom ne a ma vere abam á kabɛɛne dem ne a yage. A déem pɛ se Moses de Aron de Miriam mo tɔge abam yiga.

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: Amo ná tu Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne se a zuli‑o, a nam wó ja pɛɛre dwi dɔ mo a ba a pa‑o, de o na ye wolo na tei wɛyuu maama to? Ko maŋe se a ja na-bale selo na yi bene to a zwɛ a ma ke kaanem a pa‑o na?

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ŋɔɔne de teo kom nɔɔna bam. Wolo maama na jege swa chekke to wó taa kɔre‑o mo. O maa we: “Cheigi-na, abam balo na gilimi daane teo kom ne to de á dwi dem maama.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye wolo na kwei bwɛ selo na muri o ma pini o yeilla bam to, a bá yage kotu wɛleera yam a ma chɛ‑o.

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Á totoŋ-balwaaro tem konto ŋwaane mo a lage a waare abam lela. Á daa bá ta‑á jege dam.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Abam wó du mena ye á bá zage-ya. Á ta wó ŋoke Olivi tio-bia ye á bá ma nuga kam á turi á yera. Á maa wó ŋoke Vini tio-bia ye á bá nyɔ ba sana bam.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, abam tɔge chwei selo Pɛ Omiri de o bu Pɛ Ahab de ba dwi dem maama déem na tɔge to mo. Á na lwoni banto totoŋ-balwaaro tem to ŋwaane mo pɛ se á zo cham dento wone. Amo wó chɔge á teo kom maama pa se chaveera di abam fase. Dwi-gɛ tiina wó taa jege abam ba mɔna, ye ba twe abam dedɛ.”

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Yé pa n dwoŋi chega, ne o ná maŋe o ye n chilwoŋ-zɔŋɔ mo de. Nmo de n kaane wolo na tigi daane to, ta‑n yei n ni lara ded‑o.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, bu-baara bá taa nege ba kwoa, ye bukwa de wó lɔ ba niina kwaga ne. Kaane maa bá sɛ o nege o baro nu. Nmo tete diga tiina mo wó zaŋe ba done‑m.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, amo teena wo Baŋa Wɛ tei ne mo. Amo Tu Wɛ mo ye amo Vereno. Amo wó taa pɔ‑o mo se o ba o zeini-ne, ne amo na lwoori‑o tei to. Wɛ wó zeiŋi o nɔɔna bam

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: A dona bam, yé ta‑á jege-ne á mɔna. Amo na zo yaara yalo wone to, a daa ta wó zaŋe a yage-ya. A jei yibiri wone mo tento. Baŋa Wɛ nam wó zeiŋi o pwooni dem o pa-ne.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: Amo seene a toŋe wɛleere Baŋa Wɛ yiga ne. Konto ŋwaane ko maŋe se o bane zaŋe amo baŋa ne. O ná waare-ne o ti, o laam wó ba o zege amo kwaga ne se a zege de chega. O ta wó jwoŋi-ne o ja o zo o pwooni dem wone se a taa tɔge o chwoŋa kam.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: A dona bam yeini ba tɛ ba we, “Nmo Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom bɛ?” Ba nam ná nɛ we Baŋa Wɛ jwoŋi-ne, chaveera wó ja-ba dedɛ. Amo yi wó na ba na toa tei to. Nɔɔna wó ba ba nɔ ba baŋa ne, nenɛɛne ba ye chwoŋa ni bworu mo tei.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Jerusalem tiina bam, maŋa wó ba se á jwoori á lɔ á teo kom kabiri sem. Abam na wó ta‑á tei jei selo maama to wó yale se gaale.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Tega baŋa kalo maama na daare to laam wó ji kafɛ, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na zoore da to totoŋ-balwaaro tem ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ na duri o nɔɔna ŋwaŋa tei to

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, ta‑n nii n nɔɔna bam baŋa ne, ne nayero na yere o pei tei to. Ba ye nmo tete nyem ye ba zoore kagoa wone mo ba yerane. Nam kale-ba n vo te-ywoŋa jei selo na gilimi-ba to. Pa-ba chwoŋa se ba vo Basan de Gilead ye ba di ga-lɛɛro ne ko déem na maŋe ko ye tei to.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Daa ta n toŋe wo-kenkagela n pa debam, ne n déem na toŋe tei n ma n ja debam n nwoŋi Ejipti ne to.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina bam ná nɛ tento, chaveera wó ja-ba de ba na maŋe ba jege dam ye de ti tei to. Ko wó so-ba pa ba ja ba nia ye ba daare ba se ba zwa ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Ba ta wó ma ba pwi ba fɛɛle tega ne ne tega-veila tei, pa se kasolo yerane mo wó taa ye ba ni-wodiu. Ba wó nwoŋi ba gugworru wone ba ba nmo yiga ne ye ba yera sae, ba na kɔre foone de nmo wolo na ye debam Tu Baŋa Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Debam Tu Wɛ, wɛ dedwoŋi daa tera de na maŋe de nmo to. Nmo yerane mo kwei dé wɛleera n ma n chɛ debam. Debam mo ye balo yerane na daare n tete nɔɔna bam wone to. Nmo bane ná zaŋe debam baŋa ne, ko bá dáane ye de jwoori de to, nmo na jege debam swono to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Kwora kanto déem mo tua Elikosi tu Nahum tei Ninevɛ tiina bam ŋwaane. Nahum ma popone wonnu telo Wɛ na veere o bere‑o to o tiŋi tɔnɔ ne. Wɛ bane zaŋe de Ninevɛ tiina

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yeini o peene o bane mo. O dam-fɔrɔ nam gaale pa se o yɔɔre o waare balo na gɛ bora to. Chwei selo maama ne Baŋa Wɛ na wó tɔge da to, vo-dɛɔ mo yeini ko dola. O na wó nɔne mɛ maama to, kunkwonnu de maa jaane kulululu, ne fwogo mo tei.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ná bere o dam dem, peero tem wó ziziŋi mo. Zwonnu tem maa wó saare te to buri-buri. Tega kam baŋa maama de wó chɔge, pa se logo baŋa de nabiina maama yera taa sae.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ bane ná zaŋe, wɔ mo yi se o zege o yiga ne? O bane ná tutugi, wɔ daa mo wó wori? O ná lwogi o bane logo baŋa ne, kandwa tete wó chochoge mo muga-muga.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Abam jeeli se á ke bɛ mo á ma‑á chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga? Wonto nam wó pa á boboŋa yam konto jei. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá dwoni ded‑o se ko ke belei.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ninevɛ tiina bam, puseŋ-nyeno mo nwoŋi abam wone o jeeli keim-balɔrɔ se o ke o chɔge Baŋa Wɛ yiga.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento: “Asiria tiina bam ná maŋe ba damma ye ba daga tei de, amo wó pa ba na chɔgem, pa se ba jage da-yiga ne. A nɔɔna bam, amo seene a pa se cham yi abam. A nam daa bá ke konto.

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ta pɛ ni dento, se de taa wora abam Asiria tiina bam ŋwaane: “Á dwi dem wó jei mo pa se á yera saare. Amo lage a chɔge á jwona yam mo se á daa yé zuli-ya ya di sem ne. A ta maa wó suli abam tega ne, á na ye nɔn-yɔɔro to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Judah tiina bam, nii-na peero tem seeni! Tontoŋeno mo maa beena. O nɛ sem nɔne peero tem yuu ne ye wopwolo de yazura taane wo o ni ne. Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á di-na á kura yam, se á daare á ke kolo á na gwoni ni de Baŋa Wɛ se á ke to. Puseŋ-nyena bam konto daa bá wane ba kwaare jara de abam, Wɛ na wó chɔge-ba o ti to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ lage o jwoori o pa Isarele tiina de Judah tiina mo na nenɔŋa ne ka déem na ye tei to, de ba dona bam na maŋe ba chɔge ba tega kam de ba wodiiru tem tei maama to de.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwoŋi jar-keira dedɛɛra bam se ba ba. Ba na duri ba maa vei to mo ba chɔɔle ba to tega ne. Ba ma vo ba yi teo kom kabira kam yera, ye ba daare ba kwoli ba yum se ba wane ba bwori manchwoŋo ni dem ba zo teo kom.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Ninevɛ teo nɔn-bia jege se ba viiri de chaveera! Ba lage ba kale-ba mo ba ja ba kɛ. Pɛ sɔŋɔ kaba-kane sem laam ma keeri wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Ba maa ŋuura nenɛɛne kunkwona na ŋuuri tei to, ye ba daare ba mage ba takeira ŋwaŋa yerane.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Ninevɛ teo kom nye de buga kalo na na duri ba nwoŋi yɔɔ tei to mo! Ko nɔn-bia bam nwoŋi ba maa kɛa. Ba ma bage-ba ba we, ‘Zege-na! Zege-na!’, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo pipiri o jwoori.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: Vere-na ba lu-nyenno wonnu tem, de ba sabu-seŋa wonnu tem á ja á viiri! Teo kom su mo dedaane wo-laaro. Ba jejegero tem tiini te jege lonne se ko gaale.

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Bɛ laam mo ke á teo kom? Ko déem nye dedaane nywonnu tiga jei, ye nywon-bia mo nɛ ba wodiu da ba di. Nywon-bɛ de nywon-kane déem tigi da de ba bia ba sii ye foone tera.

english_verse: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
translation_verse: Nywon-bɛ yeini se go ga-vara ye se ja nɔna se pa se bia de se kaana se ba di ba su. Teo kom maama déem su de jejegero dedɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we, “Amo done abam mo. A lage a zwɛ á jara-keim torokooro tem mo. Á nɔn-donno tem maa wó te jara wone. Jejegero telo á na vere nɔɔna tei ne to daa bá daare. Abam daa bá toŋe á tontoŋena bam se ba ja á kwora ba vo jei jei.”

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Lɛɛro lage te yi teo kom, ko na su dedaane vwa-fɔra dedaane nɔn-gora to ŋwaane. Ba jejegero tem daga te dwoi jaanem.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tage o we, “Amo done abam mo. A maa wó le á gwaaro tem a daare pa se á zege kalambwolo. Á wó di chaveera dwi tiina badaara yiga ne, de ba na nɛ abam kuri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó lwo weeru á baŋa ne se á lɔre we a yaale abam mo. Nɔɔna de maa wó di tega á yera ne.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na wó nii ba na abam to wó kɔɔre ba tete mo ba jwoori kwaga ye ba we, ‘Ninevɛ teo kom to ko saare! Wɔ mo wora se o keeri ba lua?’ Amo wó na nɔɔna se ba zege á kwaga ne na?”

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Tebesi déem nii Kusi de Ejipti maama baŋa ne mo. Teo kom dam dem gaale dedɛ. Puti de Libia tiina maa ye ko fara.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: De konto maama de, ba déem ta jaane Tebesi tiina bam mo ba kale ba nwoŋi ba vo teo yiga yiga. Ba ma yigi ba bu-sese ba de tega ne ba go teo kom chwoŋa yuu maama ne. Ko ná ye teo kom nakwa de dedɛɛra bam, ba dona ma ta jɔrɔ se ba kuri ba wone, ye ba daare ba vɔ-ba dedaane chegero ba ja ba viiri.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Abam Ninevɛ tiina de nam lage á nyɔ sa-dɛɛra bam konto dwoŋi mo pa se á beiri. Abam de wó kwaane se á duri á lu á dona bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: Á dam jei sem á na lɔge to nye de kaporro telo mɔɔro na dɛ yiga te be te yi to mo. Ba ná sugi kaporro tem, mɔɔro tem wó yɔɔre te to nɔɔna bam nia wone mo.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Abam jar-keira bam bwona ne kaana dwoŋi mo. Á teo kom de maa zege bwori á dona bam yiga ne. Mini mo lage de zwɛ á teo kom ni-bworru tem.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Abam nam ná maŋe á ke tetei maama de, mini wó zwɛ abam kula mo! Á dona bam ta wó go abam jara wone. Ba lage ba ti abam mo nenɛɛne kayere na yeini se deilimi wodiiru tei maama nyɔ to! Puli-na dedɛ, ne kayere na tiini se yo tei to!

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Á teo kom pipim-piina bam tiini ba daga zanzam, se ko dwoni wɛyuu chalechwe sem kɔgɔ na mae tei to. Leile konto, ba nam daa tera. Ba jei mo, nenɛɛne kayere na di kara wodiu se ti, ye se laam jaane se viiri tei to.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: Abam nakwa de á dedɛɛra bam nye de kayere mo na nwoŋi de kɔgɔ, ye se laam vo se meeli kabira yera ne se waaro yé yi-se tei to mo. Wea laam ma mage, pa se maama jaane se jei, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri se na vei mɛ to.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Asiria pɛ, nmo teo yiga tiina bam mo dɔ ba lusi. Naduna bam de maa tigi ba dɔa, ye ba daa bá zaŋe. Nmo nɔn-bia bam maama ma jage ba yi jei maama peero tem baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera se o ja-ba o jwoori o ke daane.

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa o ni-jwoŋinu Habakuki to mo tento: Habakuki na poone Baŋa Wɛ tei to

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ! Amo wó lwoori tetɛ mo a jare‑m se n laam wane n cheigi-ne, ye n daare n jwoŋi debam n yage vuvuga kanto wone?

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe we ko lamma se amo taa nae puseŋa kikia dedaane vwa totoŋa yanto na gilimi-ne to na? Bɛ mo ye nmo sɛ pa se nankɔɔre dedaane tigura de chɔgem tiini ko wora jei maama ne konto?

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Nɔɔna daa ba tɔge nmo nia yam, ba kweele-ya mo ba yage tega ne ye chega kam jei. Nɔn-balwaaro bere ba che nɔn-ŋona, pa se ba borem daa ba tɔge chwoŋa. Baŋa Wɛ na leiri tei to Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Nii-na teene delo na gilimi abam to seeni, se ko wó sɔɔre á yera. Amo lage a ke woŋo kodwoŋi mo abam da yam wone, ye ba ná maŋe ba ta ba bere abam ko kuri tei maama de, á bá sɛ we ko ye chega.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Ba tiini ba jege foone mo ba pa nɔɔna, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno maa ware-ba o che ba keim-chɛɛre dem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Ba fere mo ba kɛa ne vio tei. Ba maa vei yiga ba ke yanto chaveera yam. Ba jege kamunni mo de ba jwona yam na pa-ba dam to. Habakuki poone Baŋa Wɛ o ke belei

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Nmo na ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu to, n bá‑n wane n sɛ wo-lwanno. Nmo ba lage se nɔɔna tusi chwoŋa. Nmo na ba lage puseŋ-nyena to, bɛ mo ye n yage pa se nɔn-balwaaro tem chɔge debam balo na gare banto to?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se nabiina nye de ywona dedaane wo-korro telo na wo naneo wone ye te ba jege yuu tu to mo.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Mo kokuri Babilonia tiina bam yeini ba ma gwoli-dole ba ja nɔɔna nenɛɛne ba ye ywona mo tei. Ba jaane nɔɔna mo ba ke ba chworu tem wone ye ba mɔna.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Ba ke kaanem ba zuli ba chworu tem, bɛŋwaane te pae se ba nae wodi-laaro ba di, ye ba ŋwea ywomma.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Konto to, nmo nam daa‑n ta wó pa se ba chɔge teene dem maama taa, ye yibwona tera na?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Amo wó zege nayuu kom baŋa ne mo a cheigi se a nii Baŋa Wɛ lage o ta bɛ mo o bere-ne se o leiri a pompona kam.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma leiri o ta de amo o we: “Popone a na le wonnu telo a bere‑m to jaja n ke tɔnɔ wone. Konto wó pa se balo na wó pa taane dem yi nɔɔna to ni ko kuri se ba de lwoni ba bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Maŋa ta wo yi se wonnu telo a na wó le a bere‑m to ji chega. Ko nam bá dáane se maŋa kalo te na wó ji chega to ba ka yi. Ko ná nye de ko wora ko dáane mo de, daa‑n ta peene n cheigi, se ka maŋa kam wó seene ka yi se veera yam ji chega.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Nii! Bere-n-tete nyena bam mo wó ga ba ŋwea. Wolo maama na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to wó na ŋwea o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Jejegero nam gane nɔɔna pa se ba to mo. Siu de maa tera ko pa bere-n-tete nyena bam. Ba jege puseŋa mo ye ba kaŋe ba nia kayɔn-yɔlɔ ne toone de yibeela to. Ba yeini ba le teene dedɛ se ba taa jega, ye ba wane de nɔn-bia bam.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wo á baŋa ne, de á na ke dam á ma á vere wonnu zanzam se á ma á ji naduna to. Á ma‑á kwaane se abam sɔŋɔ kom taa zege lanyerane se ko yé chɔge.

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Abam na ke keim-balwaaro ye á chɔge nɔɔna dedɛ konto to, chaveera mo jaane abam dwi dem maama pa se á ga á ŋwea.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Nii! Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam mo wó pa se teene dem jejegero dwi maama ji kafɛ. Ba na yaare ba lɔ kolo maama ba zege to wó ji tentwarem.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom wó ba ko lɔre jaja, pa logo baŋa su dedaane balo na yei-ko to, ne na na yɔɔre ba su naneo kom wo maama tei to mo.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Jwoni jege bɛ nyɔɔre mo de pae nabiina? De za jege wolim dɔ mo ye nɔɔna maa jege teena de baŋa ne konto to? Jwoni fɔ vwa yerane mo. Nabiinu mo ke-de o zege, ye de nam ware se de puri de ni de ŋɔɔne.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Lɛɛro wo abam baŋa ne! Abam yeini á kwei daa naa kandwɛ ye á tɛ á we, de zaŋe wɛɛne de jwoŋi abam de yage! Jwoni wae de ŋɔɔne na? Nabiinu mo kwei sabu-seŋa naa lu-nyenno o ma o kwoli de maama, ye de ba ŋwe.”

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wo o telaao sɔŋɔ kom ne mo. Logo baŋa nɔɔna maama jege se ba taa ye chemm mo o yiga ne.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ, nɔɔna taga ba bere-ne kolo maama nmo na ke to. Konto ma pa se a kɔre‑m lanyerane. Nam ta jwoori n ke konto zem dɛ dem ne, ne nmo déem na maŋe n ke tei to. Nmo bane ná maŋe de zaŋe de, daa ta duri dé ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ zege Teman ne mo o beena. Wo-pwoŋo Tu Wɛ mo zege Paran peero tem seeni o maa beena. O nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma kwoli wɛyuu kunkwonnu tem maama. Nabiina maama laam ma pa‑o zula tega baŋa ne.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: O nyeena mo nenɛɛne doa na pepele tei to. Mini ma pepele de nwoŋi o jeŋa wone, mɛ seeni o dam dem na seigi to.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: O pae se jaweero da o yiga, ye toone de maa tɔge o kwaga.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: O na zege mɛ to, tega kam ziziŋi mo. O ma nii logo baŋa nɔɔna bam, ye ba maama yera sae mo vare-vare. Faŋa faŋa peero tem ma bwori yera yera. Zwonnu telo o déem na vei te baŋa ne to ma jwoori te palese.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Amo nɛ we foone mo zo Kusan dwi tiina bam. Midian dwi tiina bam de yera maa tiini ya sae.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Nmo ma saŋe n taŋa kam mo se n ta n chena yam. Nmo pɛ se doa tiini ka mage tega kam, pa se nabare laam dura.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Peero tem na nɛ nmo keim dem to, te ziziŋi mo. Doa ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ka chuura tega ne. Naneo kom de maa wuura de dam, ye na bam popɔgele dedɛ.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Nmo chena yam na vei de fora ye n chichwei dem de pepele to, ko ma pa se wea kam dedaane chana kam zege chemm wɛyuu ne.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Nmo na zaŋe n nwoŋi de dam konto to, ko ye se n jwoŋi balo na ye nmo jeŋa nɔɔna to, se n daare n vere n dam-fɔrɔ tu wom. N ma n chɔge nɔn-balwaaro yiga tu wom, dedaane o kwaga kam maama.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: O na nwoŋi de o jar-keira bam se o jage debam to, nmo mɛ o tete chichwei mo n ma n zɔ‑o o yuu seeni, ye ba ya boŋe we ba wó wane debam lela, nenɛɛne nɔɔna na bɛɛse nɔn-zora tei to.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Nmo nɔne naneo kom baŋa ne de n sisein-nɔɔna, pa se na bam popɔgele mo ye ba zaŋe de puŋa.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Amo nigi tento maama, ye a yera sae vare-vare. Foone tiini de zo-ne lanyerane, pa se a bochare di ye a yera nyɔne. Amo laam nam wó taa ye chemm mo ye a cheigi se Wɛ ba o waare balo na bɛɛse debam to.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Amo Teiru Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na pa-ne dam to. O ma pa se a nɛ kwaare tega, nenɛɛne tɔgɔ nɛ na ye tei to mo. O laam cho-ne se a yé to peero tem yuu ne.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa Zefania maŋa kam Amon bu Josia na ye Judah teo pɛ to mo tento. Zefania ye pɛ Hezekia dwi tu wolo de na nwoŋi Amaria, de Gedalia, de Kusi dwia yam wone to mo.

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ taga o we: “Amo lage a saare woŋo kolo maama na wo tega baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: Amo wó chɔge nabiina bam, de vara bam, de zuna bam, de ywona yam maama. Amo wó pa se puseŋ-nyena bam to tega ne, ye nɔɔno de dedoa de bá daare. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó chɔge balo maama na yeini ba diini nayuu ba jɔɔne wea, de chana, de chalechwe sem to, ko woli de balo na zuli amo Baŋa Wɛ ye ba ta du duuri de Moleka jwoni dem to.

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ borem dɛ dem bwola. Konto ŋwaane ta‑á ye-na chemm o yiga ne. Baŋa Wɛ wora o ti o yiga se o kwei Judah tiina bam o ke ba dona jeŋa ne, ne o na lage o ke kaanem tei to.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, keira wó zaŋe teo kom Ywona Ni dem ne. Abam ta wó ni nɔɔna na chwoosa teo kom jei-doŋa laŋa kam ne. Sɔɔ-balɔrɔ de maa wó nwoŋi peero telo na gilimi da to.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Abam balo na zoore teo kom yaga jei sem ne to, ta‑á keeri-na, pipim-piina de sabu-leinna bam maama na jei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Banto tete dona mo lage ba vere ba jejegero tem ba daare ba chochoge ba sam dem. Ba wó lɔ sam, ba nam bá zo de wone. Ba ta wó jeiri Vini teeni bia, ba nam bá na de sana ba nyɔ.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom konto bwola. Dɛ dem duri mo lela se de yi. Baŋa Wɛ dɛ dem wó ja chanɛɛre de ba. Babɛ maa wó keeri ba wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ban-lom wó tiini de zaŋe dɛ dem konto ne. De wó ja wo-chechɔgɔ de cham de ba. Chɔgem de wó tiini de taa wora. Dento dɛ dem wó taa ye lim yerane mo. Kunkwonnu tem wó zwori te li tega kam maama biramm.

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: Nabwanno wó wu. Tiguri-kaasa de maa wó zaŋe. Jara yam wó yi teene delo na lɔge de pe to, dedaane de di-dedwaaro tem.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa we: “Amo wó pa se chanɛɛre yi nabiina se ba taa vei ne lilwoa tei, ba na ke wɛleere ba chɔge a yiga to ŋwaane. Ba yera jana wó lwo nenɛɛne na na chuuri tei to, ye ba ya-nɔna faare tega ya pɔ.”

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ban-lom dɛ dem ná yia, nabiina lu-nyenno de ba sabu-seŋa bá wane te jwoŋi-ba te yage. O ban-zɔŋɔ kom wó chɔge logo baŋa maama, ne mini na zwɛ wonnu tei to. Wɛ wó ke lela o saare nabiina bam, pa ba maama jei kula!

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Abam balo na zoore logo kom wone ye á tu á tete á daare á tɔge Wɛ nia yam to, kwaane-na se á lɔre Baŋa Wɛ. Ta‑á ke-na kolo na lana to, se á daare á tu á tete Wɛ yiga ne. Dɛ delo Baŋa Wɛ wó kwoli abam se chɔgem dem yé tɔge de yi abam o ban-zɔŋɔ dɛ dem ne. Filisi tiina taane

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Abam Filisi tiina balo na zoore naneo kom ni ne to, lɛɛro wo á yuu ne! Abam Filisi tiina na zoore Kanaan ne to, Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o di abam taane ye o we, “Amo nam wó yɔɔre a chɔge abam ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá lu.”

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Abam teene delo na bwola de naneo kom to wó ji naane pwola de najere mo.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Judah dwi tiina balo na daare to mo wó jwoori ba jwoŋi á tega kam ba taa tei. Ba vara wó taa beeri ba di jei sem konto ne. Tega ná yeini ka yi, nayera bam wó peini Asekelon di-dwonnu ne. Ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wó taa nii ba baŋa ne pa se ba jwoori ba taa jege yu-ywoŋo. Moaba de Amon tiina taane

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Konto to, Moaba de Amon tiina bam wó na ba nyɔɔre ba teera yam baŋa ne, de ba na jege Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam ba twea ye ba mɔne-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ mo lage o yɔɔre o fugi-ba, ye o pa se tega baŋa wa yam maama dam ti. Logo baŋa teene dem maama ná maŋe ba zoore mɛ maama, ba laam wó ba ba taa zuli wonto Baŋa Wɛ. Kusi tiina taane

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye abam Kusi tiina bam, Baŋa Wɛ mo lage o pa á te jara wone. Asiria tiina taane

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Naane de pei wó taa peini teo kom wone ko ta woli de ga-vara dwi maama. Kunkworru de bachangaaro maa wó taa tigi di-dwonnu tem ne te keera. Te da-ŋonno tem maama wó taa tigi mo ja, pa se nɔɔna taa tui ba le-te.

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ba tiini ba jege yi-dɛɛre ye ba ve koresem. Ba wo ke ba wo-dedoa de ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom naa ba sale o yera ne.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Teo kom nakwa bam yeini ba fugi nɔɔna nenɛɛne nywonnu na ŋuuri tei to mo. Ko dedɛɛra bam jege wo-loŋo ne wiira na ba di ba daara se tega poore-ko tei to mo.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Ba sampwori sem maa ye kampin-nyena na jege nia yalei to. Ba kaanem tiina bam ve Wɛ nia yam pa se ba chɔge Wɛ diga kam chullu tem.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: “Amo chɔge logo baŋa dwi tiina dedɛ, pa se ba dam jei sem to buru-tu-tu. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera ba teene dem wone. Nɔɔna maa ba tɔge de chwei sem ba via. Ba te-fwaaro tem maama tigi mo zɛɛra, ye nɔɔno de dedoa de wo daare.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: A nam ya boŋe we abam laam wó taa kɔre amo ye á sɛ a koresem dem. A nɔɔna bam ya ná ke konto, ba sam dem ya bá na chɔgem, ye a waarem dem bá yi-ba. Ba nam yɔɔre ba kwaane mo ba toŋe lwarem ba dɛ dɛ totoŋa baŋa ne.”

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Amo laam wó leiri nɔɔna bam ni-taana, pa se ba maama taa lwoori amo Baŋa Wɛ ne ko na maŋe se ba ke tei to. Ba maama wó tɔge daane ba zuli-ne de ni dedwe.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ná yia, abam daa bá taa wo chaveera wone de á na nwoŋi a kwaga ne tei to ŋwaane. Kokuri to, amo wó le balo maama na bere ba tete kamunim to á wone. Nɔɔna daa bá taa jege teera peo kolo amo na zoore da to baŋa ne.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nɔɔna balo na wó daare á wone to, banto wó taa ye nabwona balo na gwooni ba tete to. Ba ta wó taa sale amo Baŋa Wɛ yera ne.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina balo ta na daare to bá ke nɔɔn-nɔɔno lwarem. Ba bá fɔ vwa, ye ba nam bá gane ba dwonna. Ba wó na peiga jei ye ba sii. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá fugi-ba.”

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Baŋa Wɛ lage o le abam á waarem dem maama wone. O ta wó zeili á dona bam maama o yage. Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye Isarele tiina pɛ to wo abam tei ne. Foone daa ba jege se ko ja abam daga.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, ba wó ta de Jerusalem tiina bam we: “Zion tiina bam, yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone. Nam yé pa-na á vɔna pare.

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: Abam Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom wo abam tei ne. O jege dam ne babea tei se o ma o vere abam. Baŋa Wɛ yiga wó taa wo abam baŋa ne, ye á jwoori á na dam o swono kom ŋwaane. O daa ta wó puli seinim lei á ŋwaane,

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Maŋa kam ná yia, amo wó waare balo na bɛɛse abam to. A ta wó jwoŋi balo na ye gwaaro to, a daare a la balo maama na jage to a ke daane. Amo wó pa se ba chaveera leiri ya ji zula, pa se ba na yere logo baŋa jei maama ne.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, a lage a la abam a ke daane, pa se á jwoori sɔŋɔ mo. A ta wó pa se á na zula ye á yere zaŋe logo baŋa dwi maama tei ne, ye á jwoori á ta‑á jege yu-ywoŋo. Abam yia wó na amo keim dem konto.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Bene delo Pɛ Darusi na di paare o ke bena yalei to chane seredo boboa dɛ dem ne mo Baŋa Wɛ kwora déem yi o sampwora Hagayi. Kwora kam nam ye se ka pa Selateli bu Zerubabel mo. Wonto déem mo ye Judah teo kom maama yuu tu. Ka ta maa jege se ka yi Jehozadaki bu Josua, o na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu to.

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Diini-na peero tem yuu ne á beeri da-ŋonno á ja á ba. Laam kwei-na-se á ma á fɔge á lɔ diga kalo amo yi na wo taa sui to, se á daare á ta‑á zuli-ne ka wone.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Abam ya teene se á zage wodiu dedɛ mo, ye ko ji fenfee ko pa abam. Kolo á na maŋe á ja á zo diga to mo a fuli de vio a yage a daare abam. Bɛ mo ye a ke konto? Ko ye abam yia na seene á tete sam lɔɔm baŋa ne, ye á yage amo diga kam pa se ka ji di-dwoŋo ka zega to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nam mo pa se nyɔnɔ daa ba toe. Tega kam de maa ware wodiu se ka ke ka pa abam.
