english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno Hagayi déem ma kwei Wɛ ni dem o pa nɔɔna bam ye o we, “Baŋa Wɛ pwooli we, o wora de abam mo.”

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: O ma ta‑o se o lwoni o kwora kam o bere Selateli bu Zerubabel na ye Judah teo kom yuu tu to, de Jehozadaki bu Josua na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu to, dedaane nɔɔna balo na dɛ ba nwoŋi sa-teo ba jwoori to maama. Wɛ ma bwei-ba o we:

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo á kwoa bam déem na nwoŋi Ejipti ne to mo a yɔɔre a gwoni ni de-ba we, amo wó taa wora de abam. Amo Jworo ta maa wo abam tei ne. Nam yé ta‑á fona.

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se tega baŋa teene dem maama ziziŋi pa se de nɔn-bia bam zeŋe ba jejegero ba ba ywo-seeni. Amo diga kam laam wó tiini ka na nenɔŋa ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Di-doŋa kanto abam na wora á lɔ to wó taa jege nenɔŋa se ko dwoni di-dwoŋa kam. Jei sem konto ne amo wó pa se a nɔɔna maama na yazura de bochare-zuru. Amo, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo tage konto.” Hagayi lare dedaane Wɛ kaanem tiina

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná kwei nɔne delo ba na pɔɔre-de ba tiŋi Wɛ kaanem ŋwaane, ye o kukuli-de o ke o gɔrɔ wone, o ná tu o kwei gɔrɔ kom konto o dwei wodiu kolo dwi maama, keim dem konto wó wane de pa se wodiu kolo o gɔrɔ kom na dwei to lɛɛre ko taa ye wose na? Ko ná ye bworobworo, naa dwoa, naa sana, naa nuga, naa wodiu kolo dwi maama, ko wó ke konto na?” Kaanem tiina bam ma leiri we, “Aawo.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Hagayi daa ma bwei-ba o we, “Se nɔɔno nam ná dwei too yera pa se ko bere we o digiri o tete de chullu tem mo, ye o laam ná tu o dwei wodiiru tento maama, o keim dem konto wó pa se wodiiru tem digiri na?” Kaanem tiina bam ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ɛɛ, te de wó digiri mo.”

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto na ye chana kam da finlei-yana to, mo Baŋa Wɛ daa pɛ Hagayi kwora o ke kuni belei.

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Ko ye amo mo pɛ se we-chera, de do-kandwa, de wodiiru jaweero ja á jeŋa totoŋa te chɔge. De konto maama nam, abam ta wo jwoori amo tei.

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: O maa we: “Zaŋe n vo Judah teo kom yuu tu Zerubabel tei n ta we: Amo lage a pa se wɛyuu kom de tega baŋa maama vuvugi.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Nam ta de nɔɔna bam we: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Jwoori-na á ba amo tei, se amo de pipiri a jeeri abam.

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo nia yam de a bera yam a déem na pɛ a sampwori sem konto to, ya wo seene ya ke ya ja á kwoa bam na? Banto de ma pipiri ba jwoori ba ba amo tei, ye ba we, “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ seene o waare debam mo dé kikia ŋwaane, se ko maŋe de o boboŋa na maŋe ya ja se o ke tei to.” Wɛ veere wonnu o bere Zekaria

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: Tete dem ne mo amo Zekaria nii a na nɔɔno na dɔge sisein-nɔɔno baŋa ne, ka na ye nasoŋo. Mɛ seeni o na zega da to ye bwolo mo ye Motele teeni su ko maama. O laam maa wo de tetare ne. A ta ma na we sisein-nɔɔna sedwonna mo zega o kwaga ne, se na ye nasonno, de nason-pupwiu, de napwonnu, ye nɔɔna de dɔge se baŋa ne.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Wɛ maleka kadwoŋi déem zege da, ka na ŋɔɔne de-ne. A ma bwei‑o a we, “Amo tu, bɛ mo ye banto maama zege da?” O de ma leiri-ne o we, “Amo wó ta ko kuri a bere‑m.”

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na wo teeni dem tetare ne to laam ma ta o we, “Banto ye balo Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe se ba taa kare logo ni maama se ba lɔre kolo na jege ko ke da to.”

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Balo na dɔge sisein-nɔɔna bam baŋa ne to de maa lwoni ba kwori ba bere Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam na wo teeni dem tetare ne to ba we, “Debam kaare tega baŋa ni maama, ye dé maane we logo kom maama ye ziim mo, ye kolokolo ba dɔna.”

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: A bane nam tiini de zaŋe de teene dedwonna dem na boŋe we kolokolo bá daane-ba to mo. Kokuri to, a bane ya zaŋe de a nɔɔna bam fenfee yerane mo. Dwi-gɛ tiina bam laam ma yɔɔre ba pa ko zo ba yera se ko dwoni a ya na boŋe se a ke-ba tei to.’

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Amo ma kwoni a yuu wɛɛne a nii a na nyea yana.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: A ma bwei‑o a we, “Banto beene ywo se ba ke bɛ totoŋe mo?” O ma leiri o we, “Nyea yam ya jage Judah tiina bam mo se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o le o yuu o ke keim. Gwaro tento nam mo lage ba fugi nyea yam, se ba daare ba chochoge ya dam, se teene delo na daane a nɔɔna Judah tiina bam ye ba jage-ba to dam ti.”

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: A ma bwei‑o a we, “Nmo ma‑n vei yei ne mo?” O ma leiri o we, “A maa vei se a maŋe Jerusalem teo kom ni mo, se a lɔre ko dedɔrem, de ko kayɔlɔ maŋem na ye tei to.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: A daa ma na we maleka kalo ya na zege ka ŋɔɔne de amo to fɔɔre ka kɛ dáa, ye maleka kadwoŋi de fɔɔre ka yi kanto de tei.

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: Ka maa we: “Ke lela n vo n ta de nɔn-doŋo kom we, ‘Jerusalem wó tiini ko taa yala se ko daa yé taa jege siseini. Ko nɔn-bia de ko vara de nam wó gaale pa ba bá wane ba lɔ kabiri ba che-ko.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ tete mo wó ji kabira kalo na ye mini yerane to, ye a kaare teo kom maama a pu. A nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom de wó taa wo teo kom tetare ne ko bere a dam jaja. Amo Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.’ ” Balo na wo sa-teo ne to taane

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Hei! Duri-na á nwoŋi baŋa seeni teo kolo wone ba na peene abam to! Kokuri to, amo mo ya seene a jage abam a yage logo baŋa sapɛ sena sem maama seeni.

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ pɛ-ne ni mo se a da o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane a vo a kaane dwi-gɛ tiina balo na bɛɛse abam to, o yi na page abam baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Wolo ná ke abam zonne, ko nye de kotu ke Wɛ tete yi-chele-bu mo zonne.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Baŋa Wɛ tɛ dwi-gɛ tiina bam taane o we, “A lage a kwei a dam mo a chochoge-ba, se a daare a pa ba kabɛ selo ya na toŋe se pa-ba to laam zi-ba ba daare ba vere ba wonnu.” Abam laam maa wó lɔre we Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o toŋe-ne.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Zion tiina bam, leeni-na wopwolo lei! Kokuri to, a lage a ba a taa zoore á tetare ne mo.

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ wó pipiri ba ba ba sɛ amo Baŋa Wɛ ye ba daare ba ji a nɔɔna. A maa wó taa zoore á tetare ne.” Ko ná ke konto, abam de laam wó lɔre we Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo seene o toŋe-ne abam tei ne.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pɔɔre Judah laŋa kam o tete tega kam maama wone se o taa tei-ka. O daa ta wó le Jerusalem se ko taa ye o tete nyem.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma le woŋo o bere-ne ye a na Josua na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu to. O déem zege Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam yiga ne mo, ye Setaane de wo o jazem seeni se o ŋɔɔne Josua yera taane o chɔge‑o.

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma ta de balo na zege ka tei ne to ka we, “Lɔɔre-na gare-digiru tem na wo o yera ne to.” O laam ma daare o ta de Josua o we, “Nii mo. Ko bere we a yage n wɛleera yam mo a ma a chɛ‑m. A laam wó kwei gare-nyenno mo a lɛ‑m.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Amo de ma ta a we, “Jan ja! Kwei-na yuu gare-yi delo na lana to á ma á ba o yuu kom.” Ba ma seene ba ke konto ye ba kwei gare-nyenno tem maama ba zo‑o. Ba déem ke konto ye Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam zege ka nia mo.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam laam ma pa Josua ni dento ye ka we:

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: A kwei kandwɛ dedoa mo a zege Josua yiga ne, ye de jege sɛ serepɛ. A nam lage a sare poponem mo a yage de baŋa ne. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. A ta wó kwei dɛ dedwe yerane mo se a saare teo konto wɛleera yam maama a yage dáa ne.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto nam ná yia, abam dedoa dedoa wó toŋe o bwoŋi o fara se ba ba ba jeini ded‑o o sɔŋɔ woro ne, se ba di wodiu daane ye lwia tera. Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo ya na ŋɔɔne de amo to ma ba o susugi-ne, nenɛɛne a ya yɔɔre a dɔ mo to.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ne o we, “Bɛ mo nmo nɛa?” A ma leiri a we, “A nɛ min-zwon-zego ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa ba mɔ ko maama to mo. Zoŋa mo wo ko yuu kom seeni de ka wo nuga. Min-zwonnu terepɛ maa wo zego kom baŋa ne. Te maama dedoa dedoa maa jege nia yarepɛ.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: A nam ta nɛ Olivi teeni delei, pa dedoa zege zoŋa kam jazem seeni, ye kokom kom de zege ka jagwia seeni.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de amo o we, “Baŋa Wɛ na jege kwora kalo se o pa Zerubabel to mo tento: ‘Ko dae nmo bembɛɛne ŋwaane, naa n dam ŋwaane mo n lage n na yiga-veiŋa, se ko ye amo tete Jworo ŋwaane mo.’ Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ laam ma pa-ne o kwora o we:

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Zerubabel mo nii pa ba bobo Wɛ diga kanto kuri ba chwi ka biri-beira kam. Wonto nam ta mo wó pa ba lɔ-ka ba guri. Abam laam wó lɔre we ko seene ko ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo toŋe-ne abam tei ne.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná nɛ Wɛ diga kam lɔɔm na bobo mɛmɛ tei to ye o gwooni totoŋe dem, kotu wó ba o taa chaka de Zerubabel na zei lɔra ŋona ye diga kam lɔɔm kɛ yiga tei to.” Maleka kam ta ma leiri-ne ka we: “Min-zwonnu terepɛ tem nam zege te pae Baŋa Wɛ yia yam na dole ya kaare tega baŋa ni maama to mo.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Amo daa ma bwei maleka kam a we, “Olivi teeni delei dem na zege min-zwon-zego kom jazem seeni de ko jagwia seeni to kuri ye bɛ mo?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: A ta ma bwei a we, “Se ko ná ye Olivi teeni nɛ selei sem na wo sabu-seŋa wo-worru telei tem nuga kam na tɔge te wone ka lwoi ka yage to saŋa ne to, se kuri ye bɛ mo?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: O de ma jwoori o bwei-ne o we, “Nmo yeiri wonnu tento kuri na?” A ma leiri a we, “Aawo.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: O laam ma ta o we, “Nɛ selei sem konto zege se pae yiga tiina balei balo ba na tiŋi se ba taa toŋe ba pa ba Tu Wɛ wom na tei logo baŋa ni maama to mo.”

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma bwei-ne ka we, “Bɛ mo n nii n na?” Amo de ma leiri a we, “A nɛ tɔnɔ mo na jaane wɛɛne. Ko dedɔrem maa ye jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni finlei. Ko kayɔlɔ maŋem de maa ye jatwogo de noa ni kuni fuga.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de amo o we, “Tɔnɔ konto jege sensɔle-balɔrɔ mo se ko ja vo ko yi tega baŋa ni maama. Tɔnɔ kom saŋa dedoa wone, ba sɔɔle lwarem mo ba yage balo na ŋɔne to yuu ne we, Wɛ wó saare-ba tega kam wone. Saŋa kadwoŋi kam wone, ba sɔɔle lwarem ba yage balo na bore vwa bora ba ma ba vane ba dwonna to yuu ne we, Wɛ wó saare ba de tega kam wone.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam na pɛ ni delo to mo tento: Amo wó toŋe tɔnɔ konto se ko zo ŋweeno sɔŋɔ, de wolo na mae amo yere o bore vwa bora to de sɔŋɔ. Ko nam ná yi da, ko wó maŋe kotu sɔŋɔ ne mo ko chɔge wonnu maama, se ko kabiri tete, de ko bei sem de da te chɔge.”

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na ŋɔɔne de amo to laam ma fɔɔre ka yi a tei ye ka ta de amo ka we, “Nam daa‑n kwoni n yuu wɛɛne n nii kolo na zege da ko beene to.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Amo de ma bwei‑o a we, “Woŋo kom konto nam ye bɛ mo?” Maleka kam ma leiri ka we, “Woŋo kolo na beene to ye garewaa mo.” O daa ta maa we, “Ko zege ko pae tusim kikia yalo nɔɔna na ke tega kam maama wone to mo.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: A ma nii a na we ba dɔne luu kolo ya na pugi garewaa kam ni to. A laam ma na we kaane mo jei ka wone.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: A ma bwei maleka kam a we, “Ba jege garewaa kam ba maa vei yei ne mo?”

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Sisein-nɔɔna balo na vaŋe boboa toroko kom to ye nasonno mo. Sisein-nɔɔna balo de na vaŋe torokooro telei tu wom to maa ye nazwona.

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ka de ma leiri-ne ka we, “Tento lage te jage te yi logo baŋa sapɛ sena sem maama. Te nam yɔɔre te nwoŋi Wɛ wom na tei logo baŋa ni maama to yiga ne mo.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Sisein-zwonnu tem vaŋe se toroko kom se yɔɔre baŋa seeni laŋa kam mo. Kolo sisein-pwonnu tem na vaŋe to ma yɔɔre wɛ-zoore seeni, ye kolo sisein-pupweeru tem na vaŋe to de ma yɔɔre tega-kuri seeni.”

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: O laam ma tɔɔle o ta de amo o we, “Nii mo. Sisei selo na maa vei baŋa seeni laŋa kam ne to mo pɛ se Baŋa Wɛ bane dem zuri jei sem konto ne.” Paare yipuga wó pu Josua yuu ne

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora déem tu ka yi amo we:

english_verse: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.
translation_verse: Nmo laam wó kwei ba lu-nyenno, de ba sabu-seŋa pɛɛra yam n ma n ke paare yipuga, se n kwei-ka n pu Jehozadaki bu Josua na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu to yuu ne.

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Chega to, wonto mo wó lɔ-ka o zege. Wonto wó taa jege paare nenɔŋa mo ye o jei o paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne o tei o nɔɔna bam. Wɛ kaanem tu mo wó taa wo o yituŋu kom saŋa ne. Banto balei wó taa toŋe daane de ni-mɔrɔ.’

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Paare yipuga kam wó maŋe Wɛ diga kam ne mo se nɔɔna taa guli Helidai, de Tobija, de Jedaya, de Zefania bu Josia gula.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na wo sa-teo wone to wó ba ba woli se Baŋa Wɛ diga kam fɔge ka lɔ. Abam laam wó lɔre we ko seene ko ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo toŋe-ne abam tei ne. Tento nam wó seene ko ke, ne abam ná yɔɔre á sɛ á Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem chekke.”

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Pɛ Darusi paare bena yana bene dem chane nogo chana kam da yana dɛ dem ne mo Baŋa Wɛ kwora déem tu ka yi Zekaria. Kisilev chana kam ne mo konto.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: Ba ma vo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem ba bwei o kaanem tiina bam, de o sampwori sem ba we, “Ko ye ko chwoŋa ne se dé ta taa vɔ ni wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane chane senu chana kam wone, ne dé na maŋe dé ke tetei bena dedɛ wone to na?”

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: O kwora kam konto ta ye ne o déem na pɛ o faŋa faŋa sampwori sem tɔɔle kwora kalo Jerusalem teo ne to mo. Maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔna dedɛ zoore Jerusalem teo de ko nawuura yam wone ye ba na nyɔɔre ba totoŋa baŋa ne. Tega-kuri seeni kagoa kam, de wɛ-zoore seeni bwollu tem de déem su de nɔɔna mo.

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: Ta‑á bore-na chega bora á pa daane, se á daare á ta‑á jege-na da-swono ye á duri da-ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: Yé bɛɛse-na kadeina, de botara, de veira, de yiniga tiina. Yé jeeli-na lwarem á bochara ne se á ke á ma á chɔge á dwonna.”

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Ba pɛ ba wo ke dam mo ko dwoni peo na ye tei to, se ba yé wane ba cheigi Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nia yam de bera yalo o na dɛ o Jworo kom ŋwaane o pa faŋa faŋa sampwori sem to. Konto ŋwaane mo Baŋa Wɛ bane déem yɔɔre de zaŋe ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo ya na ŋɔne de banto to, ba wo sɛ ba cheigi-ne. Konto ŋwaane, ba de na ŋɔne a yiga ne to, amo de wo cheigi.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa ta ma yi amo we,

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Amo lage a jwoori a ba Zion teo se a taa zoore Jerusalem teo kom wone. Nɔɔna laam maa wó taa jege Jerusalem teo kom ba bwoi we, ‘Chega tɔgem teo,’ ye ba daare ba bwoi Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ peo kom we, ‘Peo kolo na ye wose to’.”

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: A maa wó ja-ba a jwoori se ba taa zoore Jerusalem teo kom wone. Ba maa wó taa ye amo tete nɔɔna, se amo de taa ye ba Wɛ. Dé ta wó taa jege chega dé pa daane.”

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Se ko na lwoori maŋa kam konto to, nabiina de vara ya ba nae ba totoŋa yam nyɔɔre. Nɔɔna nam ware se ba nwoŋi ba vo jei jei ba toŋe totoŋa, ba dona bam ŋwaane. Amo ta mo pɛ se nɔɔna vae daane.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, a daa bá ke de a nɔɔna balo na daare to ne a ya na waare a nɔɔna bam tei faŋa to.” Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: “Amo nɔɔna balo ta na daare to ná dugi wodiiru telo maama, te wó ke se yazura taa wora. Ba Vini teeni dem maa wó ke bia lanyerane. Tega kam wó taa ke wodiiru, ye wɛyuu nyɔnɔ de taa toe ko pa-ba.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: Judah de Isarele dwi tiina bam, ne dwi-gɛ tiina bam déem na mɛ á yera ba sɔɔle lwarem ba pa daane tei to, konto mo a lage jwoŋi abam a yage se á lɛɛre á ja Wɛ swolim á ba á pa-ba. Konto to, yé ta‑á fona. Nam ke-na dam á ke á tete kuri ne.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Á kwoa bam déem na chuchugi a bane to, a ke a boboŋa ne se a waare abam mo ye a boboŋa wo leiri.

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: Konto dwoŋi mo a nam daa ke a boboŋa ne se a fɔge a ke Jerusalem teo kom de Judah dwi tiina bam lanyerane. Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑á fona-na.

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Nam ta ta‑á ke-na wonnu tento: Ta‑á tɛ-na chega á bere daane, se á daare á ta‑á bore chega bora taane dim baŋa ne, se yazura taa wora.

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: Nam yé jeeli-na lwarem á bochara ne se á ke á ma á chɔge á dwonna. Ta yé du-na duuri vwa chwoŋa ne. Amo yɔɔre a chuli kikia yam konto maama mo.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ kwora daa ta ma yi amo we,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Abam déem na vɔge á nia amo ŋwaane chane sena chana kam wone, de chane senu chana kam wone, de chane serepɛ chana kam wone, de chane fuga chana kam wone tei to laam wó ji kura yalo Judah dwi tiina bam maama na wó di ywoni ye ba chaka ya baŋa ne to mo. Nam ta‑á swoi-na se chega de bochare-zuru jeini á tetare ne.”

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Konto to, dwi-gɛ tiina dedɛ na nwoŋi te-fwaaro to laam wó ba Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tei Jerusalem ne se ba lwoori swolim o tei ne.”

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Maŋa kam konto ná yia, dwi-gɛ nɔɔna fuga na ŋɔɔne taane dwi dwi to wó vo ba to ba gorege Juu tu dedoa. Ba maa wó ta ded‑o we, ‘Popo pa debam chwoŋa se dé tɔge‑m dé vo, kokuri to dé nigi we Wɛ mo wo abam tei ne.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento. Ka nam jege se ka vo Haderake laŋa kam seeni, ko fɔge ko dae Damasika teo kom mo. Isarele dwia yam maama, ko woli de nabiina maama yia page Baŋa Wɛ baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Hamafa teo kolo na bwola da to tiina yia de page o baŋa ne, ko woli de Tura teo tiina, de Sidon teo tiina, de ba yiyiu kom na ye tei to de.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tura tiina bam lɔge dam jei mo ba pa ba tete. Ba ma kwaleme lu-nyenno wonnu, pa te daga ne tega kasolo tei to. Ba ta ma la sabu-seŋa jejegero dedɛ ba tiŋi ne te ye chwoŋa yuu weeru mo tei.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ nam wó vere ba jejegero tem, o daare o dole ba dam maama o de naneo kom wone. Mini mo wó zwɛ teo kom maama.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Nɔn-gongwaaga mo wó jwoŋi Asedodi teo ba taa tei. Amo Baŋa Wɛ lage a pa Filisi tiina bam kamunim dem ti mo.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó pa se ba daa bá do nɔna de ya yera jana, se wodi-zɔɔna daa yé taa wo ba nia ne. Ba nɔɔna balo na daare to wó woli amo tete nɔɔna bam wone mo, pa se ba ji nenɛɛne Judah dwi tiina sɔ-yuu kodwoŋi. Konto to, Ekoron teo tiina wó gwaane de a nɔɔna bam, ne Jebusi tiina bam de déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye a tete teo kom, a lage a che-ko mo se ko dona bam daa yé tɔge da ba kɛ. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá na chwoŋa se o bɛɛse a nɔɔna bam. Amo tete yi laam mo wó taa page ba baŋa ne. Wɛ Dam Tu wom tutuuri dem taane

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: Zion tiina bam, ta‑á di-na ywoni lanyerane! Jerusalem teo tiina bam, ta‑á chaka de kwor-dɛa! Nii-na á pɛ wom na vei o beene á tei! O ye chega tu mo ye o di wɔnɔ. O nam tu o tete mo ye o di bonaga o beene. Chega to, o dɔge bona-pɔla baŋa ne mo o via.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se jara-keim torokooro ti Efrayim laŋa kam ne, se jara-keim sisein-nɔɔna de ti Jerusalem teo ne. Taŋa kalo maama ba na mae ba ke jara to de wó bwori. Pɛ wom wó tɔɔle we, yazura taa wo dwi tiina maama tei ne falalala. O paare wó di de zege naneo dedoa ni ne, se ko yi kadwoŋi ni. De ta wó zege Yuferata buga kam ne mo, se de vo de yi tega baŋa ni maama.

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam Zion tiina bam, amo na tɔge jana baŋa ne a ke ni-gwonim de abam to ŋwaane mo a lage a liiri balo ba na jaane á wone ba peene to a ja a nwoŋi ba vole-kore dem wone.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: Pipiri á jwoori-na á dalem jei sem ne, abam peena balo teena na daga to. Amo tɛ de abam we, a wó pa á jwoori á na kolo á na gɛ to kuni belei.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: A lage a ke de Judah ne a taŋa mo a saŋe to, se a daare a kwei Efrayim a ke da, ne ko ye a chena mo tei to. Zion tiina bam, a lage a kwei abam mo a pa á zaŋe á kwaare jara de Girisi tiina bam. Á wó ta‑á nye de jara-keim se-zɔɔ mo a jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wó pi o nwoŋi o nɔɔna bam baŋa ne se o woli-ba. O taŋa chena yam lage ya taa vei mo de fora ne doa na pepele tei to. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wó wu o nabɔnɔ. O maa wó tɔge tega-kuri seeni vo-dɛɔ baŋa ne o vo o zo jara yam wone.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tete wó kwoli o nɔɔna bam. Ba dona bam ná dole-ba de kandwa tei maama, ba wó nɔne-ba ba se tega ne. Ba maa wó nyɔ sana ye ba bage de dam, ne sa-nyɔra na ke tei to. Ba wó di ywoni ba su, ne zoŋa na su de jana ye ba kwei-ba ba miisi kaanem bimbini dem yera ne tei to.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Nii ba lam na tiini de jege fera tei! Nɔn-donno, de bukwa wó di tega kam wodiiru mo, ye ba nyɔ ka sa-doora se ba ma na dam.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Lwoori-na Baŋa Wɛ se o pa doa ne duum maŋa ne. Wonto mo pae do-vio kale kunkwonnu, ye o ta pae do-na tui se tega kam ke wodiiru lanyerane.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Jwona yam jege nɔɔna mo ya gana. Vora bam de maa tɔge yi-nɛɛre ŋwaane ba fɔe vwa. Ba yeini ba maŋe dendwa kuri ba bere nɔɔna ye ko dae chega. Ba ta na pa wolim delo to maa ye kafɛ. Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔna bam maa beeri yɔɔ yerane ye ba nae yaara dedɛ, ne pei selo na ba jege nayero se o taa nii-se to. Baŋa Wɛ maa we:

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: “A bane mo yɔɔre de wiira de nayera bam. A maa wó waare dedɛɛra bam. Kokuri to, amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó taa nii a nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na ye Judah dwi tiina to baŋa ne mo. A laam maa wó pa ba leiri ba taa jege dam nenɛɛne sisein-nɔɔna balo na wurigi ba vei jara wone tei to.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Ba maama ná ke daane, ba wó ji babɛ mo ye ba nɔne ba dona bam ba se chwoŋa ni bworu wone. Ba ta wó kwaare jara ba wane ba dona sisein-dira bam ba de tega ne, Baŋa Wɛ na wo ba tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó pa Judah dwi dem taa jege baare, ye a daare a jwoŋi Josɛf dwi tiina bam a yage. A wó pa ba jwoori ba zege ba faŋa zega jei sem ne, a na jege ba ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane. Ko wó taa nye de a ya maŋe a wo ve-ba mo to, kolo ŋwaane amo mo ye ba Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom, ye a nam wó sɛ ba wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Efrayim dwi tiina bam wó ji jara-keim bembɛ mo. Ba maa wó taa jege wopwolo lanyerane, ne nɔɔna na nyɔge sana ye ba wo pwoli tei to. Ba bia bam de wó na konto maama pa se ba de taa jege wopwolo. Ba maa wó di ywoni Baŋa Wɛ zeinim ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: Amo wó bwoŋi a nɔɔna bam se ba ba ba jeeri ba ke daane mo. Kokuri, amo lage a vere-ba mo a yage. Ba maa wó puli de kɔgɔ ne ba déem na daga tei to.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam wó bɛ naneo kom de ko chanɛɛre dem ba kɛ. Ba wó pa se buga kam na-ŋone sem peini tega ne. Naili buga kam maama de wó we ba ŋwaane. Asiria tiina kamunim dem wó tu tega. Ejipti teo paare dam dem de maa wó ti.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó pa ba fɔge ba zege amo dam dem ŋwaane. Ba maa wó taa kɔre-ne ba kikia maama wone.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Lebanon, pore n teo kom ni, se mini na chwoŋa de zo de di n Sedare teeni dem.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Tei-ŋonno de, ta‑á chwoosi-na, Sedare teeni dem na toa to ŋwaane. Tei-kamunnu tem maama to te pɔ mo! Basan tei-lilirru tem, keeri-na bugi-bugi! Ko ná ye goa kalo ya na lini de teeni to, ba laam gwoni ka teeni dem maama mo ba de tega ne!

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Cheigi-na se á wó ni nayera bam na laare tei to, ba vara pwoli sem maama laam na chɔge to ŋwaane. Cheigi-na se á wó ni nywonnu tem na suura, Jɔdan buga ni goa kam tete de na chɔge to ŋwaane. Nayera balei taane

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Fɔge n kɔne pei selo ba na lage ba go to.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Balo na yeigi pei sem to mo kwei-se ba go, ye ba ba boŋe we ba tusi. Balo na jege pei sem ba yeigi to de maa tɛ ba we, ‘Dé ke-na Baŋa Wɛ lei, se dé nɛ nyɔɔre dedɛ.’ Pei sem nayera tete de yiga tere se wone.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: A nam daa bá duri teo kom konto nɔɔna bam ŋwaŋa.” Baŋa Wɛ na tage kolo to mo konto. “Nii-na. Amo wó kwei nɔɔno maama a ke o dwoŋi jeŋa ne, de o pɛ wom jeŋa ne. Banto laam maa wó chɔge tega kam maama zɔŋ-zɔŋ. A nam bá jwoŋi nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jeŋa ne a yage.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a jege pei selo ba na lage ba go to a kɔna a pa balo na jege-se ba yeigi to. A nam jege gwola yalei mo. A ma pa dedoa yere ye ‘Zaane’. Dedwoŋi dem yere ye ‘Ni-mɔrɔ’. A maa jege-ya a mae a nii a pei sem baŋa ne.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Chana dedoa wone, a ma zeili nayera batɔ bam, a na wo wane a ja a tete de-ba to ŋwaane. Pipim-piina bam tete de maa vae a ni taane.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: A ma ta a we, “Amo daa bá taa kɔne pei sem a pa abam. Selo na maŋe se se te to wó te, se selo na ye se se jei to de jei. Selo maa na daare to de wó taa di da ya-nɔna.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Amo ma ja a gwoli delo yere na ye Zaane to a bwori, se ko bere we a yiri ni delo a ya na gwoni de nɔɔna bam maama to.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne nɔɔ mo ni-gwonim dem seene de chɔge. Pipim-piina bam nɛ-ne, ye ba lɔre we kwora kam konto yɔɔre ka nwoŋi Baŋa Wɛ tei ne mo.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: A laam ma bwori a gwoli dedwoŋi dem, de yere na ye Ni-mɔrɔ to, se ko bere we Judah tiina bam de Isarele tiina bam choro kom chɔge.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ daa ma ta de amo o we, “Daa ta kwei nayero zela se n ke ne n ye nayere-jworo mo to.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Nii-na, a lage a pa nayero wodwoŋi mo ba o taa nii tega kam nɔɔna baŋa ne. Wonto yiga bá taa wo pei selo na lage se jei to wone, de pei selo na beeri yɔɔ to wone. O nam bá taa nii selo na nɛ zonne to se o yɔɔre-se, naa se o kɔne pei selo na dana to. O nam wó di pi-bigila yam mo, ye o tore se napɔɔna yam nywa.

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: Kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na toŋe se ka vo Isarele tiina bam seeni to mo tento: Baŋa Wɛ ye wolo na lware wɛyuu kom pa se ko tigi palalala, ye o daare o chwi tega kam kuri to. O ta daare ke jworo o yage nabiina wone. Wonto tage o we:

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Nii-na! Amo wó pa Jerusalem teo ji nenɛɛne zoŋa de ka wo sana. Dwi-gɛ tiina balo na bwola da to wó nyɔ ka wone ye ba beiri. Ko ta wó ke konto dwoŋi ko pa Judah tiina bam mo de ba na tɔge ba kwaare jara de Jerusalem tei to.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, dwi tiina bam maama ná jeeri se ba ke jara de Jerusalem teo kom, amo wó pa ko ji nenɛɛne kandwɛ-polɔgɔ mo ko pa-ba. Wolo maama ná kwaane se o guri-ko, ko wó tiini ko ke kotu zonne.”

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Judah yiga tiina bam laam wó ta ba tete ne we, ‘Jerusalem teo nɔn-bia bam nɛ dam, Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na ye ba Wɛ to ŋwaane.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, amo wó pa se Judah yiga tiina bam taa nye de min-zoŋa na to dɛ wone tei to mo. Ba ta wó taa ye ne min-vogo na to men-zwaro wone. Konto to, ba wó pa teene delo maama na bwola da to chɔge kula. Ko daare ye Jerusalem teo kom tete taa zege cheppe de ko nɔn-bia bam maama.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam lage a pa Judah jar-keira bam mo da yiga ba na wɔnɔ, se Pɛ David dwi tiina bam de Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam maama yé na zula ba dwoni Judah tiina bam.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, amo Baŋa Wɛ tete mo lage a taa kwoli balo na zoore Jerusalem teo kom wone to. Wolo na ye nabwom ba maama wone to wó jwoŋi dam ne David na dana tei to mo. David dwi tiina bam wó taa nii ba baŋa ne, ne ko ye Baŋa Wɛ maleka kam tete mo wo ba yiga ne.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, amo yia wó seene dwi tiina balo maama na kwaare jara de Jerusalem to baŋa ne, se a yɔɔre a chɔge-ba.” Ba keeri ba pa wolo nɔɔna na zɔge to

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ nam lage a kwei teiŋ-jara jworo de ka-duri-nɔɔna-ŋwaŋa mo a ke David dwi dem, de Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam maama wone. Ko maa wó pa se ba kwoni ba nii amo ye ba keeri ba pa wolo wom ba na zɔge to. Ba wó taa tiini ba keeri wonto lua ye ba chwoosa, ne nɔɔna na gɛ ba bu-doa, naa ba bu-kwea tei to mo.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Jerusalem tiina wó keeri bugi-bugi, ne nɔɔna déem na keeri tei Hadad-Rimon ne, teo kolo na wo Megido te-kampare sem ne to mo.

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne amo wó pa se buli-yi puri de taa bura de pa David dwi tiina bam, de Jerusalem nɔn-bia bam, pa se ba wɛleera de ba digiru tem saare te yage.” Jwona de sampwori taane

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Dɛ dem konto ná yia, amo wó pa se jwona yera yam saare tega kam maama ne, se nɔɔna daa yé taa guli ya gula kɔtaa! A nam ta wó zeili sampwori sem de ba chichiri-lwanno tega kam ne.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Ba wolo ta ná zaŋe o pworisi o bere nɔɔna, o tete tiina balo na loge‑o to mo wó ta ded‑o we, ‘Nmo maŋe se n te mo, de n na mɛ Baŋa Wɛ yere n pworisi vwa to.’ Ba laam wó zɔ‑o ba go, o na pworisi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Kotu maa wó ta we, ‘Ko zege a nɔn-donne maŋa ne varem yerane mo ye a totoŋe. Amo dae Wɛ sampwora.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa ná bwei‑o we, ‘Bɛ mo ke ye n na fufwollu tento dwoŋi n nyɔɔne ne?’, o ta wó leiri-ba we, ‘A nɛ fufwollu tem a badwoŋi sɔŋɔ ne mo.’ ” Nayero de pei taane

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento: “Se-zɔɔ, zaŋe dɔɔm wone se n jeeri a nayero wom na bwola de amo to. Yɔɔre n mage nayero wom, se pei sem maama jage se jei. Amo tete jeŋa nam mo wó zo se bia bam.”

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Popɔra dedoa kalo na daare to, a lage a faŋe-ba a nii mo, se a daare a fɔge a kwɛ-ba. Ko wó taa nye de nɔɔno na kwei lu-nyenno naa sabu-seŋa o de mini wone se o pa te taa lana fase tei to mo. Nɔɔna bam konto laam maa wó ma amo yere dem ba lwoori-ne, ye amo de leiri-ba. Amo wó ta ba taane we, ‘Ba ye a nɔɔna mo,’ ye ba de ta we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ mo ye debam Wɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ jege dɛ de na beene. Dɛ dem konto ná yia, á dona bam wó ba ba vere á jejegero ba daare ba chɛ-te ba pa daane ye á zege á nia.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete nam mo lage o nwoŋi o vo o jeeri dwi tiina bam konto, ne o déem na ke jara tei to.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Abam laam maa wó tɔge Baŋa Wɛ bwolo kom konto á duri á lu, bwolo kom na wó kɛ ko yi Azeli to ŋwaane. Á na wó duri á lu tei to nye de á nabaara déem na ke tei ye ba lu cham wone maŋa kalo Judah teo pɛ Yuzia na di paare ye tega kam ziziŋi to mo. Konto kwaga ne, amo Tu Baŋa Wɛ laam wó pi o nwoŋi, ye o malese-laaro tem maama de tɔge ded‑o.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, wea pwooni bá taa wora. Waaro, de zurim de bá taa wora.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, na-ŋona wó ta ba nwoŋi Jerusalem teo kom wone ba taa dura maŋa maama, yadɛ de te-pwoŋa maama. Na bam chichworo wó duri ba vo ba zo wɛ-puli seeni naneo kom. Ba badwonna de maa wó duri ba vo ba zo wɛ-zoore seeni naneo kom.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa wó taa ye logo baŋa jei maama pɛ. Maŋa kam konto ne, Baŋa Wɛ wó taa ye o yerane dedoa mo, pa se nɔɔna taa zuli‑o o yere dem na ye dedoa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye teene delo maama na jeeri Jerusalem teo kom de jara to, Baŋa Wɛ na wó waare-ba de jawe-chɛɛro telo to mo tento: O wó pa ba ya-nɔna yam moore ye ba ta zege wɛɛne. Ba yi-chele-bia de maa wó chɔge ya gwonnu tem ne, ye ba dindeilima de maŋe ba nia ne ya pɔ.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: Jawe-chɛɔ konto dwoŋi de maa wó ja sisein-nɔɔna bam, de sisei-bonɛ sem, de kona yam, de bonɛ sem, dedaane vara balo maama na wo ba dona bam tigisim jei sem wone to.

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni, teene delo nɔɔna ya na kwaare jara de Jerusalem teo kom ye ba wori to maama laam wó yeini ba vo Jerusalem bene maama ne, se ba zuli Pɛ wom na ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ to, ye ba daare ba di Vwoa chwiim kuri dem.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Dwi delo maama na wo logo baŋa ne to nam ná ve se ba vo Jerusalem ba zuli Pɛ wom na ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ to, doa bá ne ka pa-ba.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro tento dwoŋi mo wó yi Ejipti tiina bam de dwia yalo maama na ve se ba vo ba tɔge ba di Vwoa chwiim kuri dem to.

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Chega to, kambi selo maama na wo Jerusalem ne de Judah teene dem maama ne to wó taa ye wose mo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ŋwaane. Nɔɔna balo maama na lage ba ke kaanem ba pa Wɛ to maa wó wane ba kwei kambia kalo maama ba na lage to ba saŋe kaanem dem nɔna ka wone. Maŋa kam konto ne, pipim-piinu daa bá vo o jeini Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wara-jei sem wone.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: Kwora kalo Baŋa Wɛ na kwei o pa Malaki se o lwoni o bere Isarele tiina bam to mo tento. Baŋa Wɛ swoi Isarele dwi dem

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Esawu dwi Edom tiina bam wó wane ba ta we, “Debam teo kom seene ko chɔge mo. Dé nam wó jwoori dé lɔ-ko dé zege.” Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam tɛ we, “Ba ná ke dam ba jwoori ba lɔ ba teo kom, amo ta lage a vaare-ko mo a de tega ne. Nɔɔna wó taa yaale ba teo kom ba we ko ye te-balɔrɔ mo, ye ba bwoi Edom tiina bam we ba ye balo Baŋa Wɛ bane na fɔge de wo ba baŋa ne to.”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ jege kwora kanto mo se o pa kaanem tiina bam: “Bia jege se ba taa nege ba kwoa mo, se balo na toŋe ba pae nɔɔna to de taa nege balo na tei-ba to. Amo nam mo ye abam kwo de á yuu tu de. Á nam ba nege-ne. Bɛ mo tei keim dento maama? Abam tiini á gwooni amo, ye á ta kare á bwei we, ‘Tetɛ seeni mo dé gwooni nmo?’

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Abam na yeini á ja vare-lilwoa de vare-gwane dedaane vare-jaweena bam se á ma‑á ke kaanem á pa amo to, konto dae wɛleere mo na? Á wó wane á ja vara konto dwoŋi á vo á pa á teo kom yuu tu mo na? Á ya ná ke konto, á boŋe we o wo wó pwoli de abam se o wane o nii á seeni na?

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná vei yiga se á ta‑á jaane vara konto dwoŋi á tui á ke kaanem á pa amo, ye á laam ba á lwoori lanyerane a tei ne, á boŋe we amo wó cheigi abam taane mo na?”

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na jege kolo se o ta to mo tento: “Abam wone dedoa ya mo ná maŋe o pi Wɛ diga kam ni dem, ko ya wó taa gara. Konto wó pa se á daa bá ja kaanem delo na ba jege kuri to á ba á zwɛ á pa-ne. Amo ba jege wopwolo de abam kaanem tiina bam na ke tei to. Konto ŋwaane mo a bá jwoŋi á pɛɛra yam.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, á gwooni-ne mo, nenɛɛne á na yeini á boŋe we amo bimbini dem mo ba jege kuri to. Abam ma yeini á ja wodi-yɔɔro á ba dáa ne se á pa-ne.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Abam na kare á ŋɔɔne tei to mo tento: ‘Wɛ totoŋa yam tiini ya chamma mo’, ye á daare á virigi á kwaga á ya amo. Abam ná ŋɔge vara á ja á ba, naa á ná jaane vare-jaweena dedaane vare-gwane mo á ba se á pa amo, á boŋe we amo ta wó jwoŋi tento maama ye a wo pwoli na?

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ nam ta na jege kolo se o ta ta dedaane abam kaanem tiina bam to mo tento:

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: “Abam nam ye se á ta‑á zuli amo yere dem mo. Abam nam ná ve se á ke konto, amo wó sɔɔle lwarem a yage abam yuu ne. Ko ná ye wo-laaro telo á na yeini á jwoŋi amo jeŋa ne to, amo wó jwoori a pipiri-te se te ji sɔɔlem á baŋa ne. Chega ŋwaane to, amo maŋe a sɔɔle mo a yage á yuni ne, kokuri abam ba jege yi-seena de á kaanem totoŋe dem.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Amo pɛ abam ni-kaana yanto se á wane á lɔre we ni-sɛɛm delo amo dedaane á nabaaro Levi na ke daane to wó taa vei yiga mo.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: Ni-gwonim delo amo dedaane Levi dwi dem déem na zo daane to ye se de ja ŋwea dedaane yazura mo de ba ba tei ne. Banto totoŋe mo ye se ba taa zuli amo yere dem. Ba ma seene ba ke konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Levi dwi dem bere chega mo ye ba ve vwa fɔm. Ba ŋwea kam tɔge chwoŋa, ye ba sɛ amo ni, pa se nɔɔna dedɛ mo pipiri ba yage wɛleera totoŋa.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Kaanem tu mo jege yeino Wɛ wonnu seeni ye o nii te baŋa ne. Nɔɔna maa wó taa vei o tei ne se o bere-ba, wonto na ye Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋeno to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Debam maama dae kwo dedoa bia mo na? Ko dae Wɛ dedoa mo naane debam maama na? Konto to, ko wó ke tɛ mo se debam taa baare da-kwaga ne ye dé daare dé chɔge ni-sɛɛm delo dé nabaara bam na tiŋi de Wɛ to?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Abam Judah tiina bam ywori Wɛ kwaga ne mo de á na jege wo-zɔɔna á ke Jerusalem wone dedaane Isarele teo kom maama ne to. Á ta chɔge chullu á ma‑á biini Wɛ diga kam o na swoi to dedaane á na kwei kaana balo na yeini ba kaane dwi-gɛ tiina jwona to se ba taa ye abam kaana to.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Amo lwoori Wɛ mo nenɛɛne nɔn-dwoa bam konto dwonna maama wó ti Isarele tega baŋa ne, de ba na maŋe ba jaane pɛɛra ba tui ba pae Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ to de.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Abam ta jege woŋo dedoo mo á ke. Abam yeini á jeeri Wɛ bimbini dem baŋa ne mo, ye á keera á ta daare á lwoi yi-na bare-bare. Á laam maa tɛ á we, Baŋa Wɛ ve se o jwoŋi á pɛɛra yam.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Abam nam tɛ á we, bɛŋwaane mo á pɛɛra yam wo su Wɛ yi ? Ko ye Baŋa Wɛ na maane baaro maama na ke tei o pa kaane wolo o na di o nɔn-donne maŋa kam ne to ŋwaane mo. Baaro maama jwoori o lɔ o kaane wom kwaga ne mo, ye wonto ye kaane wolo o na pwooli kampwola Wɛ yiga ne o pa‑o to.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ke nmo dedaane n kaane wom se á ta‑á ye yera dedoa mo. Ko dae chega na? Bɛ nam mo pa se o lage se abam ta‑á ye woŋo dedoa? Ko maama mo ye se abam wane á lo bia se ba taa ye Wɛ nɔɔna. Nii n yuu ne se n yé yage kaane wolo n na di n ma n ke kaane n nɔn-donne maŋa kam ne to laŋa tetare ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Nii mo! Amo lage a toŋe a tontoŋeno mo se o da amo yiga o vo o kwɛ chwoŋa kalo amo na wó tɔge da to. Konto ná kea, á Teiru wom á na beeri o jei to mo wó pɔpɔ o ba o zo o diga kam wone. Amo tontoŋeno wolo á na jei á cheigi to wó ba o ta ni delo a na gwoni de abam to taane o bere abam.”

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo dem Baŋa Wɛ nam na wó ba to, o lage o taa nye nenɛɛne mini na kwɛ lu-nyenno pa se digiru daa tera to, de chanfene na wo ware-zoŋa wone de zare gwaaro to mo. O ná tua se o lɔre nɔɔna lɔra konto, ba bá wane ba zege o yiga ne.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne mo Baŋa Wɛ daa wó jwoori o jwoŋi pɛɛra yalo Judah tiina dedaane Jerusalem tiina na wó ja ba ba ba pa‑o to. Ko daa wó taa nye nenɛɛne faŋa kam ne o yi na su ba kikia tei to mo.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ni dem mo tento: “Jakob bia bam, cheigi-na! Amo nam bá fɔge a leiri a ji wo-gaa. Konto nam mo pɛ se abam dwi dem ta wo jei tega baŋa ne to.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Ko na maŋe ko nwoŋi á nabaare wone to, abam ye dwi delo na ve se á ta‑á sɛ amo nia yam mo. Abam nam ná sɛ se á pipiri á jwoori amo tei ne, amo de wó pipiri a jeeri abam mo. Abam ma‑á kare á tɛ we, ‘Debam wó ke tɛ mo dé jwoori dé ba?’

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Abam nam na yeiri to, konto ŋwaane mo amo sɔɔle a yage á teo kom maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Abam ná laga, faŋe-na amo á nii. Ja-na woŋo maama fuga wone popɔra dedoa kam na ye amo nyem to á ja á ba á tiŋi amo sɔŋɔ kom ne. Wodiu ná su amo sɔŋɔ kom wone, amo laam wó puri wɛyuu kom a jeeri abam se á neene dedaane Wɛ zaane amo na wó ke a yage á yuu ne to. Amo zaane dem wó taa tiini de daga de dwoi abam jaanem. Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo konto.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Konto laam maa wó pa logo baŋa teene dem nɔɔna bam maama ta we, abam jege yu-ywoŋo dedɛ. Kolo ŋwaane to, abam tega kam wó taa lamma ka pae nɔɔna se ba taa zoore da.” Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento:

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Abam ŋɔɔne wo-balwaaro mo ye á we, ‘Bɛ nyɔɔre mo bere ko wo Wɛ totoŋa yam wone? Dé ná sɛ Paŋwa Tu Wɛ nia yam, bɛ nyɔɔre mo dé wó na? Debam ná maŋe dé bere we dé wo mo chɔge dedaane dé totoŋ-lwanno tem de, konto ta ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Debam tei ne, balo na bere ba tete kamunim to mo jwoori ba jege yu-ywoŋo. Nɔn-balwaaro jege yiga-veiŋa mo. Banto tiini ba gigili Wɛ yiga, ye de ko de, kolokolo ba daane-ba.’ Mo abam na yeini á tɛ tei to.”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye balo na kɔre Baŋa Wɛ to, banto ŋɔɔne ba taane mo ba bere daane. Baŋa Wɛ de ma ni kolo ba na ŋɔɔne to. Wɛ ma pa ba popone balo na kɔre‑o to yera ba tiŋi tɔnɔ wone, se ko taa ye gulim.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ laam maa we: “Dɛ dem a na lage a zaŋe se a toŋe to, banto wó taa ye amo tete nyem amo yi na su-ba to mo. Amo wó duri ba yibwona nenɛɛne kwo na duri o bu wolo na toŋe o pa‑o to yibwona tei to.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne mo abam wó lɔre amo na ke tei de nɔn-laaro dedaane nɔn-balwaaro to. Konto mo wó bere we balo na toŋe ba pa amo de balo na ba toŋe ba pa amo to dae bedwe.”

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ daa ta ma ta o we: “Chega ŋwaane to, dɛ dem maa beena se bere-n-tete nyena bam dedaane nɔn-balwaaro tem zwɛ kula nenɛɛne gaao tei to. Ko ná maŋe ko ye yuu dedaane nɛ maama, kolokolo daa bá daare.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto wone, abam lage á nɔne nɔn-balwaaro tem baŋa ne mo, nenɛɛne ba na mɛ napera ba tɔ fwogo tei to. Amo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei to mo tento.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Wonto ni taane dem lage de jwoori de ja bia dedaane ba kwoa bochara mo de ja ba jeiga dedoa. Ko ná dae konto, amo wó ba a sɔɔle lwarem a pa á tega kam.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Busankan-pwola wó ba o ja puga o lo bakeira. Ba maa wó bwoŋi bu wom yere we Imanuwel.” O yere dem konto kuri mo ye ‘Wɛ wora dedaane debam’.

english_verse: From David to the time of the exile in Babylonia, the ancestors of Jesus were: David, Solomon , Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram; Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, Josiah, and Jehoiachin and his brothers.
translation_verse: Josia ma lo Jekonia de o nyaana. Jekonia na wora to mo ba jaane Isarele tiina bam ba vo ba yage Babilon teo ne.

english_verse: From the exile to the birth of Jesus, his ancestors were: Jehoiachin, Shealtiel, Zerubbabel, Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Zadok, Achim; Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob, and Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
translation_verse: Jakob ma lo Josef, ye wonto ji Mary baro. Mary déem ma lo Yezu wolo ba na bwoŋi we Wɛ Dam Tu Krista to.

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Azora ma lo Zadoki. Zadoki ma lo Achim. Achim ma lo Elidu.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba na loge Yezu Krista tei to mo tento. O nu Mary de Josɛf tiina maama déem ya sɛ se ba pa ba zo daane, ye Mary ta wo vei o baro wom tei. Maŋa kam konto ne o laam ma ba o ja puga Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Josɛf wolo o na lage o zo to maa ye nɔn-ŋom. O maa ba lage se o pa chaveera ja o kaane wom nɔɔna maama yiga ne. O ma boŋe se o daane o yage‑o.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: O na maa boŋe konto to, Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma ba o tei o dendwɛ wone, ye ka ta ded‑o ka we, “Josef, nmo na ye Pɛ David dwi tu to, yé pa se n wo chɔge se n kwei Mary n ma‑n ji n kaane. O na jege puga kam to, ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pɛ ko ke konto.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: O lage o lo bakeira mo, se n pa o yere we Yezu, kolo ŋwaane o wó ba o jwoŋi o nɔɔna ba wɛleera wone o yage.”

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Josɛf na dɔ o zaŋe to, o ma sɛ o ke Baŋa Wɛ maleka tu wom na tage we o ke tei to. O ma sɛ o di Mary o ja vo sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: O maa wo peini ded‑o fase se ko ba ko yi o na loge bu wom to. O laam ma pa o yere we, Yezu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ba déem loge Yezu Judea teo kodwoŋi ne, ko yere mo Bɛtelehem. Ko maa ye maŋa kalo Herodi déem na ye pɛ to. Yiyein-yeena badaara déem ma nwoŋi wɛ-puli jei ne ba ba ba yi Jerusalem.

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma bwei nɔɔna ba we, “Bu wom ba na loge se o ji Juu tiina pɛ to wo yei ne mo? Debam nam nɛ chalechoa kalo na bere o lora to na fuŋi bira-kwaga seeni. Debam nam tu se dé pa‑o zula mo.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɛ Herodi déem na nigi konto to, o wo ma tiini ko chɔge. Nɔɔna balo maama na wo Jerusalem ne to de wo ma chɔge.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: O laam ma bwoŋi Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam maama dedaane Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam se ba ba ba la daane. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Ko ná ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, yei ne mo ba jege se ba lo‑o?”

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ko wó taa ye Judea teo Bɛtelehem ne mo. Kolo ŋwaane faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwora kadwoŋi déem popone we:

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: ‘Bɛtelehem, teo kolo na ye Judah dwi tiina bam nyem to, nmo dae teo kolo na muri Judah dedɛɛra bam tei ne to. Kokuri ba wó lo dedɛɛro wodwoŋi ba woli n wone, ye wonto wó taa tei amo Wɛ nɔɔna Isarele tiina bam.’ ”

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: O laam ma yage-ba se ba vo Bɛtelehem, ye o we, “Véi-na á kwaane á beeri bu wom jei, se á ná nɛ‑o, se á pa-ne ni, amo de na lage se a vo a zuli‑o to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom na tage konto de-ba to, ba laam ma zaŋe ba maa kɛa. Ba na maa kɛ konto to, ba ma pɔpɔ ba na chalechoa kalo ya na maŋe ka fuŋi ye ba na to. Ka laam maa wo ba yiga ne ka via. Ka ma vo ka zege ka maŋe de bu wom na wo mɛ to.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Ba maa tiini ba jege wopwolo lanyerane chalechoa kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba zo sɔŋɔ kom wo. Ba ma na bu wom de o nu Mary. Ba ma kuni dwoona ba zuli‑o. Ba laam ma bwoli ba zela ba le pɛɛra se ba pa‑o. Ba pɛɛra yam ye sabu-seŋa, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa kalo ba na zwɛ to, de terale nuga kalo yere na ye Mura to.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Tete ne Wɛ ma pa se ba lɔre ba dendwɛ wone we, ba daa yé jwoori ba vo Herodi tei. Konto ma pa se ba tɔge chwo-gaa ba jwoori ba vo ba tete teo kom. Herodi kwaane se o go bu wom

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Sa-teena bam na kɛ ba daare konto to, Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma pɔpɔ ka ba Josɛf tei o dendwɛ wone ye ka we, “Zaŋe n ja bu wom de o nu wom n ja n duri n vo Ejipti teo, se á ta‑á zoore da se ko yi maŋa kam amo na wó pa abam ni se á jwoori to. Kokuri Herodi lage o zaŋe o beeri bu wom jei se o go‑o mo.”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Josɛf na nigi konto to, o ma seene o zaŋe o ja bu wom de o nu wom o nwoŋi tete dem konto o vo Ejipti.

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Herodi déem na tu o lɔre we veira bam liisi o yiga ne to, o bane ma tiini de zaŋe. O ma pa ni se o nɔɔna vo Bɛtelehem de ko nawuura yam se ba go bakeiri selo na yi bena yalei de balo na muri to maama. O nam ke konto se ko maŋe de chalechoa kam fuŋim dem maŋa kam o na lɔre yiyein-yeena bam tei ne to.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Bia bam gom dem ma pa se Wɛ sampwora Jeremia na tage Wɛ kwora kalo faŋa faŋa to ba ka ji chega we:

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Sɔɔ mo zaŋe Rama teo wone. Nɔɔna mo wora ba keera, ye ba chwoosa dedɛ. Racheli mo tiini o keera, o bia bam na tega ye ba daa tera to ŋwaane. O maa ba sɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno ja‑o.”

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Herodi déem ma ba o te, ye Josɛf daa ta wo Ejipti ne. Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma pɔpɔ ka ba Josɛf tei o dendwɛ wone ye ka we,
