english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: “Zaŋe n ja bu wom de o nu wom n jwoori n vo Isarele teo. Kokuri wolo ya na lage se o go bu wom to laam tega.”

english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: O laam ma vo o yi teo kodwoŋi, ko yere na ye Nazarete to, ye o zoore da. Konto ma pa se Wɛ sampwori sem na tɔɔle o kwora kalo faŋa faŋa to ba ka ji chega we, “Ba wó bwoŋi‑o we, Nazarete tu.”

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á ta‑á tɔge kikia yalo na wó bere we á seene á leiri á wo to mo.

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: O maa yeini o tɛ o bere-ba se ba leiri ba wo Wɛ ŋwaane, se maŋa kam laam yia se Wɛ telaao paare dem ba o nɔɔna baŋa.

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Jɔn déem zoore gɔrɔ kolo ba na sɔge de kone koro to mo. O maa jege tankila o ma ja o teiŋa. O wodiu mo ye kayere de tooro.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ maa yeini ba nwoŋi Jerusalem, de Judea teene dem maama, de Jɔdan buga kam ni jei sem, ba vei o tei.

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam maŋe o jege dwooru o jeŋa ne se o taa mae o gwoni teeni mo o de tega ne. Tio kolo maama na ba leiri bu-ŋona to, o jege se o gwoni-ko mo o de tega ne, ye o kwei-ko o de mini wone se ko di.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Wonto maa zei da-lɔŋɔ se o ma mage o mena, se o laam chaare ka maama o pɛ o ke o tula ne, ye o daare men-swanno tem o zwɛ de mini delo na ba di de dwei to. Mo o na lage o pɔɔre nɔɔna daane o ke-ba tei.” Yezu jwoŋi sɛɛm Maake

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Jɔn déem na wo Jɔdan buga kam ni ne to, Yezu ma nwoŋi Galili laŋa kam o vo da se o de jwoŋi sɛɛm o tei ne.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Jɔn déem ma kwaane se o pipiri Yezu boboŋa, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Amo mo jege se a jwoŋi sɛɛm nmo tei ne. Ko ke tɛ mo ye nmo ba amo tei se n jwoŋi sɛɛm?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o we, “Yage se ko taa ye konto leile. Ko maŋe se dé ke konto, se dé wane dé tɔge kolo maama na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to mo.” O laam ma sɛ.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Yezu na jwoŋi sɛɛm konto to, o ma yɔɔre o nwoŋi na bam wone. O laam ma na wɛyuu na pore o baŋa ne, ye o na Wɛ Sin-laao kom na nwoŋi da ko maa beene o baŋa, ye ko nye de kunkwoŋa tei.

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Kwora laam ma ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Wonto mo ye amo bu-doa a na jege o swono to. O kikia su amo yi.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma maane we, ba jaane Jɔn ba ke peena diga ne. O na lɔre konto to, o ma zaŋe o jwoori Galili.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: O maa daa ba zoore Nazarete ne, ye o kɛ o vo Galili teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Kaparenia, o zoore da. Teo kom konto wo naneo ni ne, jei selo Zebula dwi tiina de Nafitali dwi tiina ya na zoore da to mo.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Setaana pɛ wom laam ma ba o tei, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo ná seene n ye Baŋa Wɛ Bu, se n ta de kandwa yanto se ya ji wodiu se n di.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o we, “Ko ta popone we, ‘N yé faŋe n Teiru Baŋa Wɛ n nii.’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Setaana pɛ wom daa ma ja‑o o ja vo o di peo kolo na tiini ko dɔra to yuu. O laam ma bere‑o logo kom teene dem maama de wo-laaro telo maama na wora to.

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo ná sɛ n kuni dwoona n zuli amo, amo wó pa se n ta‑n tei wonnu tem maama.”

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: O déem we: “Ko ná ye Zebula de Nafitali teene dem jei sem, de jei selo na wo naneo kom seeni to, de jei selo na wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem kwaga ne to, de Galili jei selo dwi-gɛ tiina na zoore da to,

english_verse: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ba ma zaŋe lela ba yage ba chworu tem ye ba vo ba tɔge o kwaga.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Yezu déem maa wo Galili naneo kom ni ne o via. O ma na nɔɔna balei, ba na ye chorro to. Ba dedoa yere mo Simon, o yere dedwoŋi maa ye Piita. Wodwoŋi wom maa ye o nyaane, o yere mo Anduru. Ba ye ywon-jara mo, ye ba wo na bam wone ba dole chworu ba ma jaane ywona.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: O na bwoŋi-ba konto to, ba ma zaŋe lela ba yage ba kwo wom de nabworo kom ye ba daare ba vo ba tɔge‑o.

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yezu déem maa tole Galili teene dem maama. O maa yeini o vei Juu tiina jeerim di sem se o taa bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam. O maa tɔɔle Wɛ paare dem kwor-ywoŋa kam, ye o kwori o yɔɔre jaweena de jaweo kolo dwi maama na jege-ba to.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma ba ba ni o ŋwa jei sem konto ne de Siria teo kom maama ne. Ba maa yeini ba jaane jaweena dwi dwi ba tui, balo yera na tiini ya wɔe to, ko woli de balo setaana na daane-ba to, de balo na sae kɔɔro to, de gwaaro. Ba na tu Yezu tei konto to, o maa yeini o yɔɔre-ba.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ ma ba ba tɔge‑o. Ba déem nwoŋi Galili teene dem, de jei selo ba na bwoi we ‘Teene Fuga’ to, de Jerusalem, de Judea maama, de jei selo na wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem ne to, ye ba tɔge ded‑o ba beera.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma na nɔn-kɔgɔ na tɔge‑o tei. O ma pwɛ o tete o vo o di peo kodwoŋi o jeini da. O na jei to, o kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo o tei.

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Á nam ta‑á yei we, abam ná ba tɔge chwoŋa se ko taa dwoi Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, á bere á bá na chwoŋa se á tɔge á di Wɛ telaao paare dem. Ban-zɔŋɔ na nye de nɔɔno gom tei to Luka

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, nmo ná lage n kwei n pɛɛra n pa Wɛ, ye n laam ná guli we n dwoŋi jege n ban-zɔŋɔ,

english_verse: and he taught them:
translation_verse: O laam ma bobo se o bere-ba we:

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: “Balo na yei we yiniga jege-ba Wɛ seeni to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, ba na tɔge ba di Wɛ telaao paare dem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: Balo wo na chɔge to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, Wɛ na wó pa ba bochara zuri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: Balo na tu ba tete to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, Wɛ na wó pa ba taa tei logo kom baŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: Balo na jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, Wɛ na wó duri ba de ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: Balo bochara na lana fase to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, ba na wó ba ba na Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: Abam nye ne pwooni mo á pae nabiina. Teo kolo ba na lɔge peo yuu ne to tiini ko nae mo jaja.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a ta a bere abam se á yé zaŋe á du de kolokolo. Yé zaŋe á du duuri Wɛ telaao ŋwaane, kokuri dáane mo ye Wɛ jeiŋa jei.

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: Yé du-na de tega baŋa de, ka na ye o nɛ chwiim jei to ŋwaane. Ko nam ná ye Jerusalem, se á yé zaŋe á du de konto de, se konto de ye Wɛ Pa-faro teo kom mo.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: Yɛ na kwɛ wodiu tei to, abam de nam ye konto mo de nabiina. Ko ye abam mo pae ywoni wora ba tei ne. Yɛ ni nam ná ti, n daa‑n bá‑n wane n pa de jwoori de ja ni. Dento daa ba jege kuri. Ba nam wó dole-de ba yage, se nɔɔna taa nɔne de baŋa ne.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ o tɔre min-zwoŋo o pu zoŋa kuri ne. O nam wó kwei-ko o zege wɛyuu ne, se ko pwooni taa wora nɔɔna maama tei ne diga kam wone.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: Abam yei we ba déem bere debam kwoa bam we, ‘Yé zaŋe n go n dwoŋi. Wolo nam ná ke konto, ba jege se ba di o taane mo.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Ko daare amo laam nam tɛ de abam we, nɔɔno wolo ná jege ban-zɔŋɔ de o dwoŋi, ko maŋe se ba di konto tu de taane mo. Wolo ná tage o dwoŋi o we, o ba jege boboŋa, ko maŋe se debam nakwa bam mo di konto tu taane. Nɔɔno wolo de ná tage o dwoŋi o we, o ye wo-koro, ko maŋe se konto tu na waarem de mini te-seŋa ne.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: se n yage n pɛɛra yam n tiŋi, se n jwoori n vo n dwoŋi wom tei se á fɔge daane. Nmo ná ke konto, se n laam jwoori n ba n kwei n pɛɛra yam n pa Wɛ.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno nam ná jaane‑m o vo o saŋe, se n ke lela n pa á fɔge daane ye á daa ta wo yi taane dim jei sem. Ko ná dae konto, o laam wó ke nmo taane dim tu wom jeŋa ne se o waare‑m. Wonto de laam maa wó ke‑m o tontoŋeno jeŋa ne se o ja‑m o vo o ke peena diga ne.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, nmo wó ta‑n wora taa. Nmo ná wo ŋwe jene dem maama ye bi ná daare, ba bá yage‑m. Ka-laga boboŋa na nye de bwoŋa tei to

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: Ba ta maŋe ba ta ba we, ‘Nɔɔno wolo ná yage o kaane, kotu jege se o pa‑o tɔnɔ kolo na bere we ba yage daane to.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: Ko woli da, abam yei we ba déem bere debam kwoa bam we, ‘Yé zaŋe n kwane n ni. Nam ke kolo maama n na dugi n pa Baŋa Wɛ to.’

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: Abam ta yei we ba maŋe ba ta ba we, ‘Nɔɔno ná chugi n yi, se n de chu konto tu yi. Ko daa ná ye n yeili, se n de guri o yeili.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Amo nam tɛ de abam we, nɔɔno ná ke‑m lwarem, se n yage‑o. Nɔɔno ná lɔge nmo jazem popɔŋɔ, se n pa o lɔ kodwoŋi kom de.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ta ná saŋe‑m se o jwoŋi n gare-bu o jene ŋwaane, se n pa o kwei n gare-bwora o woli da.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro nam ná jaane‑m se n zeŋe o zela n vo chwo-kukua laŋa ne, se n zeŋe n gaale dáane.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná lwoori woŋo n tei ne, se n kwaane n pa-o-ko. Nɔɔno nam ná lage se o jene woŋo n tei ne, se n yé ve‑o. Swono taane Luka

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: Á ná ke konto, ko wó bere we á Kwo mo ye Baŋa Wɛ, de á na tɔge o kikia yam dwoŋi to. Wonto ba pɔɔre nɔɔna daane de o na pae se wea nye ba maama baŋa ne, ko ná ye nɔn-balwaaro naa nɔn-laaro de. O ta kwori o pae se doa nena ka pae balo na tɔge chwoŋa de balo na ywori to.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná swoi balo de na swoi abam to yerane, konto jege nyɔɔre Wɛ tei ne na? Lampwoo lara de yeini ba ke konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Abam nam ná ke lanyerane de á chorro yerane, ko ba bere kolokolo. Balo na yeiri Wɛ to de yeini ba ke konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Ta‑á yei-na se á yé ta‑á bere á tete nɔɔna yiga ne de á na ke keim-laaro tei to. Á ná ke konto dwoŋi, ko bá pa á na nyɔɔre á Kwo Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: Abam ná yeini á lage á ware Wɛ, se á yé zaŋe á ta‑á bere á tete ne pipiri-nyena bam na ke tei to. Banto swoi se ba taa zaŋe wɛɛne mo ba ware Wɛ ba jeerim di sem ne, de pwooni yiga ne, se nɔɔna maama taa na-ba. A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, banto maŋe ba na ba nyɔɔre ba ti.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná lage n ware Wɛ, se n zo n diga kam wo n ja ka ni n pe, se n laam ware n Kwo Wɛ wom na seigi nɔɔna yiga ne to. Wonto nae kolo n na seigi n ke to. O maa wó pa se n na nyɔɔre ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: Abam ná wora á ware Wɛ, se á yé tiini á ma ta-yɔɔro nenɛɛne balo na yeiri Wɛ na yeini ba ke tei to. Banto yeini ba boŋe we, ba ná tiini ba ŋɔɔne ta-fare mo, Wɛ wó cheigi ba warem dem.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Abam nam maŋe se á ta‑á ware Wɛ tento dwoŋi mo: ‘Debam Kwo na wo telaao ne, nmo yere dem maŋe de tia mo.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: Nmo paare dem de ma maŋe se de ba de jeini de dam. Pa se nmo boboŋa wonnu taa ke tega baŋa ne, se ko maŋe de te na ke tei telaao ne to.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, abam ná yage nɔɔna na ke tusim delo ba yage á yuu ne to á ma chɛ-ba, á Kwo Wɛ wó yage á na ke kolo á tusi to o ma chɛ abam de.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Ko daare, abam ná wo sɛ se á ke konto, á Kwo Wɛ de nam bá yage á na ke kolo á tusi to o ma chɛ abam.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á ta‑á ke kolo na wó pa se á na wo-laaro dedɛ Wɛ telaao ne to mo. Dáane mo kolokolo daa bá wane ko chɔge á wo-laaro tem, ye ŋweena de bá wane ba ŋɔ-te.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ta‑á ke-na konto bɛŋwaane á wonnu tem na wo mɛ maama to, á boboŋa yɔɔre ya tigi dáane mo.

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: O yia nam ná ba lae, ko pae se o ŋwea maama wo lim wone mo. Pwooni ná tera nɔɔno tei ne ye ko ye lim yerane, ko bá taa tiini ko ye lɛɛro mo o tei ne na?

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o kwei boboŋe dedwe se o ma toŋe o pa o yuu tiina balei. O wó taa chuli dedoa kam ye o daare o swoi wodwoŋi wom, naa o wó taa nege dedoa kam ye o daare o gwooni wodwoŋi wom. Konto ŋwaane, abam bá wane á pa se Wɛ taa ye á tu, ye á daare á tɔge sabu-laga de.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, á yé ta‑á jege lwia de á na wó ke tei se á na wodiu de gwaaro to.

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Nam maane-na á nii zuna na ye tei to. Banto ba dua, ye ba ta ba zage mena ba ke ba tuli ne. Ko nam ye á Kwo Wɛ mo nii zuna bam baŋa ne de ba ni-wodiu. Wɛ nam bá pa se abam ta‑á jege kuri á dwoi zuna bam na?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye gwaaro, á jege te lwia wo bɛ mo? Maane-na á nii gaao punnu tem na wora to. Tento ba ke totoŋa, ye te ba sɔ gwaaro.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na we, tento jege lam te dwoi Pɛ Solomon déem na maŋe o zoore gare-nyenno telo to.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye gaaro tem konto, tento ba jege dɛ ye nɔɔna yeini ba zwɛ-te. De konto de, Wɛ ta mo pae te jege lam konto dwoŋi. Konto ŋwaane ko ná ye abam, Wɛ bá tiini o nii abam baŋa ne mo na? Abam boboŋa muri de Wɛ.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Balo na yeiri Wɛ to mo tiini ba boŋe wonnu tem konto maama boboŋa. Abam Kwo Wɛ nam maŋe o yei á na lage-te tei to.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: Abam nam yé ta‑á jege nɔɔna á yaala, se Wɛ de wó yaale abam.

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: Kokuri, abam na yaale á dwonna tei to, Wɛ wó tɔge konto dwoŋi mo o ma di á taane. Abam na ke á dwonna tei to, Wɛ wó ke abam de konto se ko taa mae daane.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Abam nye de nɔɔno mo ná nii o dwoŋi yi ne o na weo balaŋa da, ye o yiga tera de o tete yi na jege da-lɔŋɔ to. Ko maŋe se ko taa ye konto na?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam na jege da-lɔŋɔ o yi ne to wó taa jege chwoŋa se o ta de o dwoŋi we, ‘Pa se a le weo n yi ne’ na?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Abam ye pipiri-nyena de á na ke á dwonna tei to. Abam nam jege se á le á tete yi da-lɔŋɔ kom mo, se á laam wane á nii lanyerane se á le á dwoŋi yi weo kom.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Aawo. Abam wo ba lana ye á ta yei se á pae á bia wo-laaro telo ba na lage to. Ko daare á Kwo Wɛ na gare abam to, wonto nam bá kwei wo-laaro dedɛ o pa balo na lwoori‑o to mo na?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná jege bu, ye o ná lwoori bworobworo n tei ne, nmo wó sɛ n kwei kandwɛ n pa‑o na?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ, se á wó na kolo á na gɛ to. Beeri-na kolo á na lage to, se á wó na. Ta ta‑á dɔne-na manchwo-peena yam, se ba wó pore ba pa abam.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, wolo maama na lwoori Wɛ se o pa‑o woŋo to wó jwoŋi. Wolo maama na beeri woŋo to wó na-ko. Ba wó pore ba pa wolo maama na dɔne manchwo-peena yam to.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: O nam ná lwoori‑m se n pa‑o ywoni, n wó sɛ n pa‑o basankwea na?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Ta‑á ke-na á dwonna lanyerane, se ko maŋe de á na lage se banto taa ke abam tei to. Konto mo ye chega kalo Moses de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem twanno tem na maŋe te bere to. Yezu tɔgena na wó tɔge chwoŋa kalo to Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, wolo maama ná jwoŋi a taane dem ye o daare o tɔge-de, konto tu nye de boboŋa tu wolo na chwi o sɔŋɔ kuri pelɔrɔ baŋa ne ye o laam lɔ to mo.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Ba kikia nam mo wó pa se á lɔre ba na seene ba ye tei to. Kokuri, tio tera ko na wó wane ko lei ko dwoŋi bia. N bá‑n na mɔɔro sabara yuu ne.

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Tei-ŋonno mo yeini te leiri bu-ŋona. Tei-jawone mo yeini te leiri bu-kokwaaro.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Tei-ŋoŋo tera ko na wó lei bu-kokwaaro. Tei-jawona nam tera ko na wó lei bu-ŋona.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Tio kolo maama na ba leiri bu-ŋona to, nɔɔna wó gwoni-ko mo ba de tega ne ba zwɛ de mini.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Ko nam wó tɔge konto mo se á seene á lɔre banto na ye balo to de ba na ke kolo to.

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo maama nam na jwoŋi amo taane dem ye o ba tɔge-de to nye de nɔn-jworo kolo na pɔpɔ ko lɔ ko sɔŋɔ kasolo baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Doa ma ba ka ne pa se bwi su se pɛɛle, ye vo-dɛɔ de mage sɔŋɔ kom pa se ko tiini ko to tega ne buri-buri.”

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: Ko dae we nɔɔno wolo maama na bwoŋi-ne o we, ‘Amo Teiru, amo Teiru’ to mo wó tɔge o woli amo Kwo Wɛ paare dem wone. Ko nam wó taa ye balo na seene ba tɔge amo Kwo Wɛ boboŋa to mo.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Bora borem dɛ dem ná yia, nɔɔna dedɛ wó ta de amo we, ‘Dé Teiru, dé tɔge nmo yere dem ŋwaane mo dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Dé ta mɛ nmo yere dem dé zeili setaana nɔɔna tei ne, ye dé daare dé ma dé ke wo-kenkagela dedɛ.’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Amo nam wó ta-ba we, ‘A nam maŋe a wo fɔge a lɔre abam mo de. Á ye wo-lwan-keira mo. Konto to, véi-na dáa a tei ne.’

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Doa ma ba ka ne pa se bwi su se pɛɛle. Vo-dɛɔ de ma ba ko mage sɔŋɔ kom. Ko maa wo to, ko kuri na chwi pelɔrɔ kom baŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: O na bere-ba tei to mo pɛ se ba lɔre we o jege dam ko dwoi ba tete zamesem tiina bam.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔna balo Wɛ na tiŋi o paare dem se ba zo to, banto daa bá na chwoŋa se ba zo. Wɛ wó zeili-ba o yage lim jei ne, yaara na wora mɛ to, ye ba wó taa keera ye ba done ba nwa.”

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Tega na tu ka wora ka yi to, nɔɔna maa jaane setaana na daane balo to dedɛ ba tui Yezu tei. O maa yeini o mae o ni taane o zeili setaana yam, ye o daare o pa jaweena maama na yazura.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: O na maa kɛ to, nayɔŋɔ kodwoŋi ma vo o tei. O ma kuni dwoona o yiga ne ye o lwoori‑o we, “Amo tu, nmo ná laga, n wó wane n pa se a na yazura.”

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Yezu ma seene o sɛ. O ma twe o jeŋa o dwei‑o, ye o we, “A lage konto. Zaŋe de yazura.” O na tage konto bedwe baŋa ne to mo nɔɔno wom yera yam fɔge ya kwɛ fase.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o we, “Amo wó tɔge a vo se a pa o na yazura.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi konto to, ko ma tiini ko so‑o. O ma ta de balo na tɔge ba wora to o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, amo wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno o na jege wo-dedoa de amo se ko yi nɔɔno wonto na jege tei to, ne ko ná maŋe ko ye Isarele dwi tiina bam wone de.

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Á ta‑á yei we nɔɔna dedɛ wó nwoŋi logo baŋa jei maama ne ba ba ba zo Wɛ woro kom wo. Dáane mo ba laam wó jeini de debam nabaara Abaraham de Izaak de Jakob, ye ba di ywoni daane.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de soja yiga tu wom o we, “Nam véi. Nmo na ke n wo-dedoa de amo se a ke kolo to, Wɛ wó pa ko ke.” Ko ma seene ko ke. Maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo tontoŋeno wom nɛ yazura.

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Ba ma laare baŋa baŋa ba we, “Baŋa Wɛ Bu, nmo tu debam tei se n ke bɛ mo? Nmo tu se n waare debam ye Wɛ borem dɛ dem ta wo yi mo na?”

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se teo kom nɔɔna bam maama nwoŋi ba vo se ba jeeri Yezu. Ba na nɛ‑o to, ba ma lwoori‑o se o nwoŋi ba teo kom ne o viiri.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma vo Piita ba sɔŋɔ. O ma na Piita tenkaane na tiga o weela. Ko ye paa mo jege‑o.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Yezu ma vo o tei o ja o jeŋa, ye paa kam nwoŋi o yera ne. Kaane wom laam ma zaŋe wɛɛne o ke wodiu o pa‑o.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: O na ke tei konto to, ko ye se ko pa Wɛ sampwora Izaya na maŋe o ta kolo faŋa faŋa to mo ba ko ji chega, de o na we, “Wonto mo le jaweero de lwia yalo na jege debam to o yage.” Balo na lage se ba tɔge Yezu na ke tei to Luka

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba zaŋe‑o, ye ba we, “Debam tu, jwoŋi debam ŋwea, se dé lage dé te mo.”

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma vo o zo nabworo wo, ye o kwaga tɔgena bam tɔge ded‑o ba kɛ.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Vo-dɛɔ ma pɔpɔ ko zaŋe ko mage nabworo kom pa se ko wora ko liri na se ko tu na bam kuri. Yezu maa tigi o dɔa.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maa tiini ba ye yaau, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto ke tɛ mo o ye konto? O dam dem pae se vio kom de na bam sɛ o ni.” Yezu zeili setaana nɔɔna balei tei ne Maake

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma vo ba bɛ bubɛ dedwoŋi dem mɛ Gadara tiina na zoore to. Nɔɔna balei maa wora setaana na daane-ba. Banto tigi yibeela jei ne mo, ye ba jege foone pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware o tɔge chwoŋa kam konto o kɛ. Ba laam ma nwoŋi ba peiga jei sem ne ba vo ba jeeri Yezu.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Jei sem konto ne teira dedɛ ya wora ya beeri ya wodiu se ya di.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Setaana yam ma gare ya lwoori Yezu ya we, “Nmo ná lage n zeili debam, se n pa dé vo dé taa tɔge teira yanto.”

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: O ma ta o we, ya véi. Ya ma seene ya nwoŋi nɔɔna bam tei ne ya vo ya tɔge teira yam. Teira yam maama ma duri ya siseiri ya tu buga kam wo ya nyɔ na ya te.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo ya na nii teira yam baŋa ne to ma duri ba vo teo kom wo. Ba ma ta kolo maama na ke to, de Yezu na zeili setaana yam nɔɔna balei bam tei ne tei to.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma jwoori o vo o zo nabworo kom. O ma bɛ buga kam o vo o yi o tete teo Kaparenia.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Ko woli da, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ o kwei sa-doora o lwo o ke lɔ-dwoŋa wone. O ná ke konto ye sana bam ná lage ba keeri, lɔa kam wó bage mo. Sana bam maa wó lwo ba yage, ye lɔa kam de chɔge. Nɔɔno nam maŋe se o kwei sa-doora o ke lɔ-doŋa wone, se te maama maŋe daane.” Yezu yɔɔre nɔɔna badwonna Maake

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: O keim dem konto ma jage de yi teo kom jei sem maama ne.

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam zamesem tiina badwonna maa wora, ye ba ŋɔɔne ba tete yera ne ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto ŋɔɔne o twe Wɛ yere mo.”

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre ba na boŋe kolo to. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ye á jege wo-balwaaro tem konto á boboŋa ne?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Amo nam wó pa se abam lɔre we amo wolo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to jege dam logo baŋa ne se a yage nɔɔno wɛleera a ma chɛ‑o.” O laam ma ta de gɔrɔ kom o we, “Zaŋe wɛɛne se n kwei n gungwolo kom n ja n vo sɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, nɔɔno wom ma seene o zaŋe o viiri.

english_verse: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, ‘Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others.’ I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Mark
translation_verse: Wɛ tete maŋe o ta we, ‘Nɔɔna ná jege ba dwonna yibwona, konto pwoli amo wo ko dwoni ba ná ke kaanem ba pa-ne.’ Véi-na á zamese taane dem konto kuri chekke. Amo na tu logo baŋa to, ko dae balo na maŋe ba ye nɔn-ŋona to ŋwaane. A nam tu se a bwoŋi nɔn-chechɔgero mo se ba tɔge chwoŋa.” Yezu berem dem ye berem-doore Maake

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma zaŋe o maa kɛa. O na maa vei to, lilwoa balei ma zaŋe ba tɔge o kwaga ye ba tɛ baŋa baŋa ba we, “Pɛ David dwi tu! Duri debam yiniga!”

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto na maa kɛ to, nɔɔna badwonna ma ja memaa ba ba Yezu tei. Ko maa ye setaane mo tɔge‑o pa se o ware o ŋɔɔne.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma kɛ. O na maa vei to, o ma na nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Matiyu. O déem jei mɛ seeni o na yeini o jwoŋi lampwoo nɔɔna tei ne to mo. Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Zaŋe n ta‑n tɔge-ne.” O ma seene o zaŋe o tɔge o kwaga.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo Matiyu sɔŋɔ se o di wodiu. O de o kwaga tɔgena bam na wora to, lampwoo lara de nɔn-chechɔgero dedɛ maa tɔge ba wora ba di wodiu de-ba.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Yezu déem na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to, Juu tiina nakwe wodwoŋi ma ba o tei. O ma kuni dwoona o yiga ne ye o we, “Amo bukɔ mo tega leile. Nam ba se n ma n jea n zi‑o, se konto wó pa o jwoori o na ŋwea.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: O na dwei‑o konto to, Yezu ma pipiri o na‑o ye o we, “Amo bukɔ, poore n yera. Nmo na ke n wo-dedoa de amo to mo pɛ se n na yazura.” Maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo kaane wom seene o na yazura.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma zeili setaane dem o tei ne. Nɔɔno wom laam maa wae o ŋɔɔna. Ko ma so nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Debam wo fɔge dé na wo-kenkagele dento dwoŋi ywo-seeni Isarele teo ne.”

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Jɔn kwaga tɔgena déem ma vo Yezu tei, ye ba bwei‑o ba we, “Debam de Farisi tiina bam yeini dé vɔ ni maŋa maama. Bɛ mo kea ye nmo kwaga tɔgena bam ba vɔ ni konto?”

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o kwei gare-yi-doore o ma feiri gare-dwoŋo kolo na kaare to. O ná ke konto, ko feirim dem laam wó vuuri gɔrɔ kom ko pa ko chɔge dedɛ.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Yezu ma seene o zaŋe o tɔge‑o, de o kwaga tɔgena bam maama.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma vo o zo Juu tiina nakwe wom sɔŋɔ. O ma zo o na balo na tu se ba leeni lua kam lei to, de nɔɔna dedɛ na wora ba fere ba tete to.

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, ba zaŋe ba viiri, se bu wom wo tege, se o tigi o dɔ mo. O na tage konto to, nɔɔna bam maa jege‑o ba mɔna.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Ba na pɛ se kɔgɔ kom maama nwoŋi to, Yezu laam ma vo o zo diga kam bu wom na wora to. O ma ja o jeŋa pa se o zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: O ma vo o zo sɔŋɔ kodwoŋi. Lilwoa balei bam ma tɔge ba zo da. O laam ma bwei-ba o we, “Abam sɛ we amo wó wane a ke á na lage kolo to na?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Debam tu, dé sɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: O laam ma dwei ba yia yam, ye o we, “Abam na ke á wo-dedoa de amo se a ke kolo to, Wɛ wó pa ko ke.”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ba yia yam ma seene ya jwoori ya nae. O ma kaane-ba we, ba yé pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno lɔre ko ni ne.

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: O na tage-ba konto to, ba ta ma zaŋe ba kare ba tɛ o taane jei sem maama ne.

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam déem maa wo sɛ ye ba we, “Wonto na wae o zeili setaana to, ko ye setaana pɛ dam ŋwaane mo.”

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yezu déem maa kare nawuura yam maama wone o tola. O maa yeini o vei Juu tiina jeerim di sem se o taa bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam. O maa tɔɔle Wɛ paare dem kwor-ywoŋa kam, ye o kwori o yɔɔre jaweena de jaweo kolo dwi maama na jege-ba to.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Ko nye de wodiu faao na ke lanyerane, ye tontoŋena fenfee yerane wora se ba zage tei to mo.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Nam lwoori-na faao totoŋa yam yuu tu se o toŋe nɔɔna dedɛ se ba vo ba zage faao kom ba pa‑o.”

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Filipi de Batoloma. Tomas de Matiyu wolo na ye lampwoo laro to. Jemsi wolo na ye Alafayu bu to, de Tadayus.

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná jaane abam konto, se á yé ta‑á jege lwia de á na wó ta kolo, naa á na wó leiri-ba tei to. Abam na wó ta‑á zege ba yiga ne maŋa kalo to, Wɛ wó pa á lɔre á na wó ta kolo to.

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: O maa we, “Á nam jege se á vo Isarele dwi tiina bam tei, se banto nye de pei selo na beeri kafɛ to mo.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: Simon wolo na nwoŋi Zɛlota tigisim wone to, de Judas Yisakara wolo na tu o yeigi Yezu o pa nɔɔna to.

english_verse: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma toŋe banto fuga-balei bam se ba nwoŋi ba beeri. Ba na lage ba kɛ konto to, o ma kaane-ba we, ba yé zaŋe ba vo dwi-gɛ tiina na zoore mɛ to, naa ba vo Samaria tiina teo.

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: Nam yé kwei-na tampɔgɔ kolo á na wó ta‑á jwoŋi wodiu á ke da to. Á nam yé kwei gwaaro telei telei, naa natera, naa nacheiga á woli da. Kokuri, tontoŋeno maŋe se o taa jwoŋi o ni-wodiu mo.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná vei á yi teo kolo, se á lage wolo na ye nɔn-ŋom to, se á laam vo o sɔŋɔ á ta‑á wora se ko ba ko yi á viirim.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, Sodom de Gomora tiina bá tiini ba na lɛɛro se ko maŋe de teo kom konto. Yaara yalo na wó yi-ba to taane Maake

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna wó ja ba tete chorro ba ke nɔɔna jeŋa ne se ba go-ba. Kwoa de wó ke ba bia konto dwoŋi. Bia de wó zaŋe ba tiina baŋa ne ye ba pa ba ja-ba ba go.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔge amo to ŋwaane, ba wó ja abam ba vo ba saŋe dedɛɛra de pwa tei ne. Konto mo á wó wane á bere-ba Wɛ chega kam, ye á daare á bere dwi-gɛ tiina de.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ko bá taa ye abam tete taane, se ko ye á Kwo Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo wó tɔge abam baŋa pa se á ŋɔɔne.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama wó taa chuli abam, á na ye amo nyem to ŋwaane. Wolo maama nam ná tiini o jege pu-dɛa se ko vo ko kweeli, Wɛ wó jwoŋi konto tu ŋwea.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Ba nam ná bɛɛse abam teo kolo ne, se á duri á vo kodwoŋi. A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam bá wane á tole teene delo maama na wo Isarele ne to á ti ye amo Nabiin-bu wom daa ta wo jwoori a ba.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: Zenzamso nam tera o na dwoi o berem tu. Kabaa de nam tera ka na dwoi ka tu.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Zenzamso nam ná tu o yi ne o berem tu wom tei, konto mo lana ko pa‑o. Kabaa de ná tu ka yi ne o tu wom tei, konto mo lana ko pa‑o. Ba ná jege sɔŋɔ tu ba bwoi we, ‘Setaana pɛ Bɛlzabula’, ba nam wó tiini ba twe o sɔŋɔ tiina bam se ko dwoni konto.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nabiina, banto wae ba goe á yera ye ba ware á jworru ba go. Konto ŋwaane, á yé ta‑á kɔre foone de-ba. Á jege se á ta‑á kɔre Wɛ mo, kokuri wonto wae o chɔge á yera de á jworru maama te-seŋa ne.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye zun-kabeili, ba yeini ba yeigi sento mɔle mo. Á Kwo Wɛ nam nii sento baŋa ne, ye se dedoa bá wane ka to tega ne ka te ye o wo sɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, á yé ta‑á kɔre foone, se abam dedoa dedoa tiini á jege fera á dwoi zun-kabeili dedɛ.

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná zege nabiina yiga ne o bere jaja we wonto ye amo nyem, amo de nam wó zege konto tu kwaga ne a bere we o ye a nyem a Kwo Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno wolo maama ná ve amo nabiina yiga ne, amo de wó ve konto tu a Kwo Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: Amo na tu logo baŋa to, á yé ta‑á boŋe we ko ye se a pa nɔɔna mo na ywoni daane. A nam tu se a de jara mo nabiina tetare ne.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: A tu se a pa nɔɔna de ba kwoa mo chɔge daane, se a daare a pa bukwa de ba niina de ke konto, se kaana de ba banna niina de chɔge daane.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Ko maa wó pa se nɔɔno de o tete sɔŋɔ tiina taa done daane.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Wolo ná swoi o tete kwo de o nu se ko dwoni amo, konto tu wo yi se o taa ye amo nyem, ko woli de wolo maama na swoi o bia o dwoi amo to.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná wo sɛ se o tɔge amo kwaga se o na yaara ne wolo na zeŋe dagara o maa vei o toone tei to, konto tu wo yi se o taa ye amo nyem.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Wolo nam na kwaane se o taa jege o tete ŋwea to wó ga-ka Wɛ tei ne. Ko daare wolo na gɛ o ŋwea amo ŋwaane to wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná jeeri Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu lanyerane, de Wɛ na toŋe‑o to ŋwaane, Wɛ wó pa konto tu de tɔge o na nyɔɔre ne o ni-jwoŋinu wom tei. Ko woli da, nɔɔno wolo ná jeeri nɔn-ŋom o nɔn-ŋonne dem ŋwaane, Wɛ wó pa konto tu tɔge o na nyɔɔre delo o na wó pa nɔn-ŋom wom to.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná jeeri abam lanyerane, konto tu jeeri amo mo. Wolo maa ná jeeri amo, konto tu jeeri Baŋa Wɛ wolo na toŋe-ne to mo.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nɔɔno wolo ná nɛ amo nɔn-balaŋa dedoa, ye o ná pɛ‑o na-zura se o nyɔ o na ye amo tɔgeno to ŋwaane, konto tu wó tiini o na nyɔɔre Wɛ tei ne mo.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Jɔn kwaga tɔgena bam ma zaŋe se ba viiri. Ba na maa kɛ to, Yezu laam ma ta Jɔn taane o bere nɔn-kɔgɔ kom. O ma ta de-ba o we: “Abam déem na vei Jɔn tei kagoa yuu ne to, á boŋe we á wó na bɛ mo? Á vei se á nii gaaro telo vio na jege ko dole to mo na?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Zem nɔɔna bam de ye konto mo. Jɔn na tu to, o peene o kana mo ye o ba nyɔ sana. Nɔɔna na nɛ‑o to, ba maa jege‑o ba yaala we, ko ye setaane mo tɔge‑o.

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: se ba daare ba bwei‑o we, “Nmo mo ye wolo Wɛ na bere debam we o wó ba to na? Naa dé ta wó taa teene nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo?”

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: “Á ta á bere‑o we, lilwoa jwoori ba nae, gwaaro de wae te via, naywanno yera de maa kwɛ lanyerane, zwa-kwarro de zwa ni, twa de jwoori ba bi. Ko woli da, yiniga tiina de maa ni Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Wolo maama na ba jwoori Wɛ kwaga ne amo ŋwaane to mo ye yu-ywoŋo tu.”

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Aawo. Se bɛ mo? Á vei se á nii nɔn-yero na zo gare-nyenno to mo na? Aawo. Nɔn-yero nam wó taa zoore sɔ-fɔrɔ wone mo, se ko dae kagoa yuu ne.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Bɛ nam mo ye á vo? Á vei se á na Wɛ sampwora mo na? Ɛɛ, ko ye konto mo. Á nam na nɛ wolo to tiini o dwoi faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na ye tei to.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nabiina balo ba na maŋe ba lo to wone nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na yi Wɛ tontoŋeno Jɔn na ye tei to. Ko daare leile konto, nɔn-yɔɔ kolo maama na zo Wɛ woro kom wone to laam tu o dwoi Jɔn.

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘Dé mage gullu mo se á sa, ye á wo sage. Dé ma daare dé leeni luseim dé pa abam, ye á wo sɛ se á pa á yiga nyɔne.’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Ko daare amo Nabiin-bu wom nam na tu to, amo wo vɔge ni. Nɔɔna daa ta ma yaale amo de ye ba we, a ye nɔn-kwolo mo, ye a ye sa-nyɔro de. Ba daa ta maa we, a me de lampwoo lara de nɔn-chechɔgero mo. Abam nam wó ba á lɔre swa yalo na ye chekke to de ya na pae se nɔɔna tɔge kikia yalo to.” Lɛɛro wó yi balo na ve Yezu to Luka

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto o ti to, o laam maa jege balo na nɛ o wo-kenkagela yam ye ba ta wo sɛ se ba leiri ba wo to taane o ŋɔɔna. O ma kaane balo na zoore teene delo o na ke wo-kenkagela dedɛ da to, ye o we,

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam Kaparenia tiina, á ga boŋe we Wɛ lage o zeiŋi abam wɛyuu ne mo na? Aawo. Abam nam wó to á zo tega kuri kuri ne mo. Kokuri, wo-kenkagela yalo maama amo na ke abam tei ne to, ya dwoŋi ya ná kea Sodom tiina tei ne, ba ya wó leiri ba wo pa se Wɛ ya bá chɔge ba teo kom.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Á ta‑á yei we, Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, Sodom teo kom bá tiini ko na lɛɛro se ko maŋe de abam.” Yezu wó pa nɔɔna na siu de ba cham Luka

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: A Kwo Wɛ mo kwei wonnu maama o ke a jeŋa ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre Wɛ Bu wom o ti, ko ná dae o Kwo yerane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ta bá lɔre a Kwo Wɛ, ko ná dae amo wolo na ye o Bu wom to yerane, ko woli de amo na boŋe se a pa nɔɔno wolo maama lɔre o na ye tei to.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.

translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, ‘Abam de ba á tɔge á toŋe amo kara ne, se amo wó ŋwe abam kolo na wó maŋe to.’

english_verse: So they went. At noon and again about three in the afternoon he returned to the market. And each time he made the same agreement with others who were loafing around with nothing to do.
translation_verse: Ba ma sɛ ba vo. Wea tetare ne o daa ma jwoori o vo o lage nɔɔna badwonna o woli da. Wɛ-guni maŋa ne o ta ma vo o lage nɔɔna badwonna de.

english_verse: Finally, about five in the afternoon the man went back and found some others standing there. He asked them, “Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?”
translation_verse: Dedaan-ni ne o daa ma vo yaga o na nɔɔna badwonna ta na zege da. O ma bwei-ba o we, ‘Bɛ mo ye abam zege ywo-seeni dɛ dem wone maama ye á ba ke kolokolo?’

english_verse: “Because no one has hired us,” they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, ‘Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo kwei debam se dé toŋe dé pa‑o.’ O ma ta de banto de se ba vo ba tɔge ba toŋe o kara kam ne.

english_verse: That evening the owner of the vineyard told the man in charge of the workers to call them in and give them their money. He also told the man to begin with the ones who were hired last.
translation_verse: Tega na lage ka yi to, o laam ma ta de o totoŋa yiga tu wom se o ta tontoŋena bam se ba zaŋe ba ba ba jwoŋi ba ŋweero. O ma ta‑o se o bobo o ŋwe tontoŋena balo na tu ba kweeli to.

english_verse: When the workers arrived, the ones who had been hired at five in the afternoon were given a full day's pay.

english_verse: The owner answered one of them, “Friend, I didn't cheat you. I paid you exactly what we agreed on.

translation_verse: Nam ja n sabu kom n viiri, se taane daa tera. Amo lage se a ŋwe nɔɔno wolo na tu kwaga o toŋe to se ko maŋe de nmo na jwoŋi tei to mo.

english_verse: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Why should you be jealous, if I want to be generous?”
translation_verse: Amo nam jege chwoŋa se a kwei a sabu kom a ma ke kolo a na lage to. Nmo wo chɔge de amo na jege wo-ywoŋo to mo na?’

english_verse: Jesus then said, “So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.” Jesus Again Tells about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Tɔ. Ko maa bere we balo na wo kwaga ne to wó ba ba ji yiga tiina, ye balo na wo yiga ne to jwoori ba ji kwaga tiina.” Yezu daa ŋɔɔne o toone taane Maake

english_verse: When Jesus heard them, he stopped and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi to, o ma zege ye o bwoŋi-ba o bwei o we, “Abam lage se a ke bɛ mo a pa abam?”

english_verse: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.
translation_verse: Yezu ma duri ba ŋwaŋa. O ma dwei ba yia yam, ye ya yɔɔre ya nae bedwe baŋa ne. Ba laam ma zaŋe ba tɔge o kwaga.

english_verse: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma bwɛ-ba se ba pu ba ni. Ba laam ma fɔge ba ke sɔɔ dedɛ ye ba laare ba we, “Debam Tu! Pɛ David dwi tu! Duri debam yiniga!”

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma tole o maa kɛ Jerusalem. O na wo chwoŋa ne to, o ma pɔɔre o kwaga tɔgena fuga-balei bam kɔgɔ kom wone, o pa ba tɔge ded‑o ba via.

english_verse: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death. A Mother's Request (Mark
translation_verse: Ba laam maa wó daare ba ke-ne dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne. Banto de maa wó ke amo ba mɔne ye ba daare ba fere-ne. Ba laam maa wó ja-ne ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go. Da yatɔ dɛ ne a maa wó jwoori a bi toone wone.” Yezu chwoŋa kam tɔge yaara ŋwaane Maake

english_verse: The mother of James and John came to Jesus with her two sons. She knelt down and started begging him to do something for her.
translation_verse: Zebedi bia bam nu déem ma vo Yezu tei de o bia balei bam. O ma kuni dwoona o yiga ne se o lwoori‑o woŋo.

english_verse: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, “When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo lage bɛ mo se a pa‑m?” O ma leiri‑o o we, “Popo ta n ni n pa amo we, nmo ná tu n di n paare dem, se n pa amo bia balei banto jeini nmo tei ne, n jazem de n jagwia ne.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from?” James and John said, “Yes, we are!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam nam yeiri á na lwoori kolo to. Abam wó wane á tɔge á yaare ne amo na lage a yaare tei to na?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ɛɛ, dé wó wane.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You certainly will drink from my cup! But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for my Father to say.”
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam nam wó seene á tɔge á yaare amo yaara yam dwoŋi. Ko daare ko ná ye jeiŋa jei amo paare dem ne, amo ba jege chwoŋa se a kuri nɔɔna se ba jeini da. Amo Kwo Wɛ mo maŋe o tiŋi jei sem konto se o pa balo na wó jeini da to.”

english_verse: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with the two brothers.
translation_verse: O tɔgena fuga bam na lɔre ba dwonna balei bam na lwoori kolo Yezu tei ne to, ba bane ma tiini de zaŋe de-ba.

english_verse: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma bwoŋi ba maama, ye o ta de-ba o we, “Abam maŋe á yei logo baŋa pwa na yeini ba jege ba nɔɔna ba bɛɛse tei to, ye ba dedɛɛra mo di dam ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: But don't act like them. If you want to be great, you must be the servant of all the others.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, ko ba jege se ko taa ye konto á tei ne. Kokuri abam wolo ná boŋe se o ji nɔn-kamunu á wone, konto tu mo jege se o ji tontoŋeno o pa abam.

english_verse: And if you want to be first, you must be the slave of the rest.
translation_verse: Wolo ná boŋe se o ji abam yiga tu, konto tu mo jege se o ji á kabaa.

translation_verse: Ko ye konto dwoŋi mo de amo Nabiin-bu wom na wo tu se nɔɔna toŋe ba pa-ne to. Amo nam tu se a toŋe a pa nabiina, se a daare a kwei a ŋwea a ma leini nɔɔna dedɛ ŋwea.” Yezu yɔɔre lilwoa balei Maake

english_verse: Jesus was followed by a large crowd as he and his disciples were leaving Jericho.

english_verse: Two blind men were sitting beside the road. And when they heard that Jesus was coming their way, they shouted, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Lilwoa balei ya wora ba na jei chwoŋa kam ni ne. Ba ma lɔre we Yezu tɔge dáane o maa kɛa. Ba laam ma laare baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Debam tu! Pɛ David dwi tu! Duri debam yiniga!”

english_verse: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, “Go work in the vineyard today!”
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta o we, “A lage a ta taane a bere abam se á boŋe á nii. Nɔɔno mo wora de o bia balei. O ma vo o ta de bu-kwea kam o we, o véi o toŋe o kara ne zem dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: But when they saw the man's son, they said, “Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.”
translation_verse: O bu wom na maa vei ye nɔɔna bam na‑o to, ba maa bane daane ba we, ‘Mo gaare dem tu bu-kwea kam, ye wonto mo lage o ba o taa tei o kwo wom wonnu. Nam pa-na se dé go‑o, se dé daare wonnu tem dé taa tei.’

english_verse: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, ‘The Lord needs them.’ He will at once let you have the donkeys.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná bwei abam taane, se á ta ded‑o we, ko ye dé Teiru wom mo lage-se. Konto tu laam wó sɛ o yage-se o pa abam.”

english_verse: “Announce to the people of Jerusalem: ‘Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey.’ ”
translation_verse: “Véi-na á ta de Zion tiina bam we, ‘Nii-na á pɛ wom na vei o beene á tei. Wonto nam gwooni o tete mo ye o di bonaga o beene. Chega to, ko ye bona-pɔla mo o dɔge ka baŋa ne o via.’ ”

english_verse: The disciples left and did what Jesus had told them to do.
translation_verse: Yezu kwaga tɔgena balei bam ma seene ba tɔge yiga ba vo ba ke kolo o na tage se ba ke to.

english_verse: They brought the donkey and its colt and laid some clothes on their backs. Then Jesus got on.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja bona-kweo kom de bona-pɔla kam ba ba, ye ba lɔɔre ba gwaaro ba daŋe se baŋa ne. Yezu laam ma di bona-pɔla kam, ye ba vei ba maa kɛa.

english_verse: When Jesus came to Jerusalem, everyone in the city was excited and asked, “Who can this be?”
translation_verse: Ba déem ma vo ba yi Jerusalem teo kom ni. Teo kom tiina bam maama ma zaŋe ba ye zulimaa jei sem maama. Ba maa bwei ba we, “Nɔɔno wɔ mo tento?”

english_verse: But the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were angry when they saw his miracles and heard the children shouting praises to the Son of David.

english_verse: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.

translation_verse: O na wora o zeili-ba konto to, o ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, ‘Ba wó taa bwoi amo sɔŋɔ kom we, wara-jei mo.’ Abam nam pɛ se ko ji ŋweena tigisim jei.”

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray, you will be given whatever you ask for.” A Question about Jesus' Authority (Mark
translation_verse: Ko woli da, abam ná lwoori woŋo kolo maama Wɛ tei ne, ye á jege boŋem-dɛɔ we á wó na, Wɛ wó pa á seene á jwoŋi-ko.” Yezu dam dem nwoŋi yei ne mo? Maake

english_verse: Then Jesus left the city and went out to the village of Bethany, where he spent the night. Jesus Puts a Curse on a Fig Tree (Mark
translation_verse: O laam ma viiri ba tei ne. O ma nwoŋi teo kom ne o vo Bɛtania o peini da. Yezu ŋɔɔne o chɔge kaporo Maake

translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Yage-na se a bwei abam taane dedwe se, á ná leiri-de á pa-ne, se a laam bere abam amo na ke tei a jege chwoŋa to.

english_verse: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city,
translation_verse: Tega na poore tetete to, o ma zaŋe se o jwoori Jerusalem. O na wo chwoŋa ne to, o kana maa wɔe.

translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, á ná yɔɔre á ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ ye á ba jege bobwea, abam de wó wane á ke kaporo kom keim dento dwoŋi. translation_verse: Ba na bane daane ba ga konto to, ba ma leiri Yezu ba we, “Dé yeiri kotu.” Yezu laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko na ye konto to, amo de nam bá ta wolo na pɛ-ne chwoŋa se a taa toŋe to.” Nɔɔno de o bia balei memaŋe

english_verse: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, “What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority?”
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma jwoori o vo o zo Wɛ diga kam. O maa wora o bere nɔɔna bam. Juu tiina nakwa bam de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam ma vo o tei ba bwei‑o ba we, “Wɔ mo pɛ nmo chwoŋa se n ke wonnu telo maama n na ke to?”

english_verse: Who gave John the right to baptize? Was it God in heaven or merely some human being?” They thought it over and said to each other, “We can't say God gave John this right. Jesus will ask us why we didn't believe John.
translation_verse: A lage a bwei abam a nii, Jɔn na pɛ nɔɔna sɛɛm to, ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ‑o chwoŋa naa nabiina mo?” O na bwei-ba konto to, ba maa wora ba bane daane se ba nii ba na wó ta kolo to, ye ba we, “Debam ná leiri dé we, ko ye Wɛ mo, o laam wó bwei debam we, bɛ mo ye dé nam wo sɛ Jɔn taane dem?

english_verse: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.”
translation_verse: Ko daare, dé ná we ko ye nabiina mo pɛ‑o chwoŋa, nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wó pa se foone mo ja debam, de ba maama na pɛ se Jɔn ye Wɛ sampwora to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: His son told him he would not do it, but later he changed his mind and went.

english_verse: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe. Renters of a Vineyard (Mark
translation_verse: Kokuri Jɔn na tu abam tei to, o déem bere abam chwoŋa kalo á na wó da se á na chega Wɛ tei ne, ye á wo sɛ o taane dem. english_verse: When it was harvest time, the owner sent some servants to get his share of the grapes.
translation_verse: Tio-bia gworim maŋa na yi to, o ma toŋe o tontoŋena se ba vo nɔɔna balo na nii o gaare dem baŋa ne to tei se ba pɔɔre tio-bia bam wone ba pa‑o.

english_verse: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.
translation_verse: O tontoŋena bam na yi da to, nɔɔna bam ma ja-ba. Ba ma mage dedoa lanyerane. Ba ma go wodwoŋi, ye ba daare ba dole dedoa de kandwa.

english_verse: He then sent more servants than he did the first time. But the renters treated them in the same way.
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ tu wom ta ma jwoori o toŋe o tontoŋena badwonna nɔɔna bam tei ne, ye banto kɔgɔ dwoi boboa nɔɔna bam. Nɔɔna bam ta ma ke banto de konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.
translation_verse: Ko kweelim ne to, o laam ma toŋe o tete bu nɔɔna bam tei ne, ye o boŋe we, ba wó nege wonto.

english_verse: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ja‑o ba vaŋe ba ja nwoŋi gaare dem ne, ye ba mage‑o ba go.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters?”

english_verse: The chief priests and leaders answered, “He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.”
translation_verse: Yezu na bwei-ba konto to, ba laam ma leiri ba we, “O jege se o go nɔn-wo-korro tem konto mo, se o daare gaare dem o pa nɔɔna badwonna se ba taa nii-de, se tio-bia bam gworim maŋa ná yia, se ba taa pɔɔre o nyem ba pa‑o.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “You surely know that the Scriptures say, ‘The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.’
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: ‘Kandwɛ delo lɔra na ve to laam mo jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam dana to. Konto ye Baŋa Wɛ keim mo. Ko maa ye wo-kenkagele ko pa debam.’ Abam maŋe á wo gage konto na?

english_verse: So they looked for a way to arrest Jesus. But they were afraid to, because the people thought he was a prophet.

english_verse: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.
