english_verse: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma maŋe memaŋe dedwoŋi o bere nɔɔna bam ye o we,

english_verse: The kingdom of heaven is like what happened when a king gave a wedding banquet for his son.
translation_verse: “Wɛ telaao paare dem nam nye de pɛ wodwoŋi na lage se o ke kadiri o pa o bu.

english_verse: He sent other servants to say to the guests, “The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet!”
translation_verse: O laam ma jwoori o toŋe o tontoŋena badwonna se ba vo nɔɔna bam tei. O maa we ba ta de nɔɔna bam we, ‘Ba-na, se amo ti woŋo maama yiga, ye a pa ba go na-bale de naane delo na nugi lanyerane to. Nam ba-na se dé di kadiri dem wodiu kom.’

english_verse: But the guests did not pay any attention. Some of them left for their farms, and some went to their places of business.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo ba na bwoŋi konto to yiga maa tera. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo ba boboŋa jei. Ba dedoa vei o kara mo. Dedoa ma vo se o ke o pipiu.

english_verse: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara bam ma ja pɛ wom tontoŋena bam ba bɛɛse ba go.

english_verse: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom bane ma tiini de zaŋe. O ma toŋe o babɛ pa se ba vo ba go nɔn-gora bam konto ye ba daare ba zwɛ ba teo kom maama.

english_verse: Then he said to the servants, “It is time for the wedding banquet, and the invited guests don't deserve to come.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de o tontoŋena bam o we, ‘Kadiri dem woŋo maama ti ko yiga se dé di. Amo nam na tage se nɔɔna balo ba ba tɔge ba di to ya wo maŋe de kuri dem.

english_verse: Go out to the street corners and tell everyone you meet to come to the banquet.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nwoŋi-na á vo teo kom pwooni, se á ná nɛ nɔɔno wolo maama, se á bwoŋi‑o se o ba o tɔge o di.’

english_verse: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.
translation_verse: Pɛ wom laam ma nwoŋi se o zaane nɔɔna bam. O ma na nɔɔno dedoa na wora o na wo zo gare-ŋoŋo kolo na maŋe de kadiri dim to.

english_verse: Tell us what you think! Should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not?”
translation_verse: Dé nam lage se dé bwei nmo dé nii, debam Juu tiina ná ŋwe lampwoo dé pa logo kom Pa-faro wom, ko chɔge debam chullu na?”

english_verse: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.
translation_verse: O de ma te, ye ko ke ba maama konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ba ma le ba tɔgena badwonna se ba tɔge de Pɛ Herodi kwaga nɔɔna badwonna se ba vo Yezu tei. Ba ma vo ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Berem tu, dé yei we nmo ye chega tu, ye n yeini n bere nɔɔna Wɛ chwoŋa chekke. Nmo yiga tera de nɔɔna na boŋe kolo ba pa nmo to, ye n ta ba pɔɔre nɔɔna daane de n na ke-ba tei to.

english_verse: Let me see one of the coins used for paying taxes.” They brought him a silver coin,
translation_verse: Nam bere-ne sabu-dale delo dé na yeini dé ma ŋwe lampwoo to.” Ba ma le sabu-dale dem ba bere‑o.

english_verse: His answer surprised them so much that they walked away. Life in the Future World (Mark
translation_verse: O na leiri-ba konto to, ko ma so-ba dedɛ. Ba laam ma yage o tei ye ba viiri. Wɛ telaao ŋwea na wó taa ye tei to Maake

english_verse: All the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets are based on these two commandments. About David's Son (Mark
translation_verse: Moses de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem bera yam maama yɔɔre ya zege nia yalei yanto yera ne mo.”

english_verse: The Sadducees did not believe people would rise to life after death. So that same day some of the Sadducees came to Jesus and said:
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, Saduka tiina badwonna déem ma zaŋe ba vo Yezu tei. Banto mo bere we, nɔɔno ná tega, o daa bá jwoori o bi.

english_verse: Jesus answered: You are completely wrong! You don't know what the Scriptures teach. And you don't know anything about the power of God.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam tiini á tusi mo. Abam nam wo lɔre Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom berem dem, ye á ta yeiri Wɛ dam dem na ye tei to.

english_verse: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔna ná tu ba bi toone wone, banto lage ba taa nye de Wɛ malese sem na ye tei to mo, ye ba ba di kaana, naa ba zo banna de.

english_verse: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said,
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye twa biim dem, abam maŋe á wo gage kolo Wɛ na tage o bere abam ye ko popone o tɔnɔ kom ne to na?

english_verse: “I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.
translation_verse: O nam tage we, ‘Amo ye Abaraham Wɛ, de Izaak Wɛ, de Jakob Wɛ mo.’ Ko bere we banto daa ta jege ŋwea mo o tei ne, kolo ŋwaane Baŋa Wɛ ye ŋwea tiina nyem mo se o dae twa nyem.”

english_verse: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching. The Most Important Commandment (Mark
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na nigi Yezu berem dem na ye tei to, ko ma tiini ko ke-ba yaau. Wɛ nia yam wone dɔ mo dana de dwoi maama? Maake

english_verse: “Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law?”
translation_verse: “Berem tu, Wɛ nia yam maama wone dɔ mo tiini de dana de dwoi?”

english_verse: This is the first and most important commandment.
translation_verse: Dento nam mo ye Wɛ ni delo na ye yiga tu ye de dana to.

english_verse: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Delo na saŋe to de tɔge konto dwoŋi ye de we: Ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n tete.

english_verse: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them,
translation_verse: Farisi tiina badwonna déem ma ba ba gilimi daane. Yezu ma zaŋe o bwei-ba o we,

english_verse: ‘The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.’
translation_verse: ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage de amo Teiru wom o we, Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni se a laam wane n dona bam a ke nmo dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.’

english_verse: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose family will he come from?” They answered, “He will be a son of King David.”
translation_verse: “Ko ná ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, abam boŋe we o jege se o nwoŋi wɔ dwi wone mo?” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “O wó taa ye Pɛ David dwi tu mo.”

english_verse: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David?”
translation_verse: David nam na seene o bwoŋi Wɛ Dam Tu wom o we o Teiru to, dé nam wó ke tɛ mo ye dé daa ta bwoi‑o we David dwi tu mo?”

english_verse: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.
translation_verse: Yezu nam na tage konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ma ware se o leiri kolokolo. Ko ma zege dɛ dem konto ne nɔɔna maama kɔre se ba daa bwei‑o taane.

english_verse: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná zeiŋi o tete, konto tu wó ba o tu tega mo. Wolo nam ná tu o tete, Wɛ wó zeiŋi konto tu.

english_verse: Whoever is the greatest should be the servant of the others.
translation_verse: Abam nɔn-kamunu mo ye wolo na ye tontoŋeno á wone to.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Ei! Jerusalem tiina bam, á yeini á go Wɛ sampwori selo o na toŋe abam tei ne to ye á dole-ba de kandwa. Kuni dedɛ mo a ya lage se a la abam nɔn-bia a ke daane se a taa nii á baŋa ne, nenɛɛne chworo na kukwori ko bia ko ke ko vɔna kuri ne tei to. Abam maa ba sɛa.

english_verse: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ŋɔɔne de o kwaga tɔgena bam de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama.

english_verse: So obey everything they teach you, but don't do as they do. After all, they say one thing and do something else.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, á jege se á ta‑á tɔge kolo maama ba na bere abam to. Ko nam ná ye ba kikia yam, se á yé zaŋe á ta‑á lwoni-ya, kolo ŋwaane ba tete nam ba tɔge kolo ba na bere nɔɔna to.

english_verse: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, ba yeini ba bere ba kikia mo jaja se nɔɔna maama taa nae. Ba yeini ba bere ba tete nɔɔna tei ne we ba jege Wɛ tɔnɔ kom swono, de ba na tiini ba vɔ-ko ba yera ne jaja to. Ba maa tiini ba ke zɔla ba gwaaro nia ne se ko pa nɔɔna taa nege-ba.

english_verse: And when they are in the market, they like to have people greet them as their teachers.
translation_verse: Ba ná vei yaga, ba lage se nɔɔna maama taa tui ba tei-ba mo, ye ba ta lage se nɔɔna taa bwoi-ba we ‘Berem tu’.

english_verse: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, á yé ta‑á boŋe se nɔɔna taa bwoi abam we ‘Berem tu’, kolo ŋwaane á maama ye nu-bia mo daane, ye á jege Berem Tu dedoa mo.

english_verse: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Á na ye nu-bia logo baŋa ne to, se á yé ta‑á jege á wolowolo á bwoi we á kwo. Abam maama ye Kwo dedoa mo. Wonto ye Baŋa Wɛ mo.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á yeini á gane kadeina se á jwoŋi wonnu ba tei ne. Á maa bere á tete de á na tiini á ware Wɛ tei to. Konto ŋwaane Wɛ wó tiini o waare abam se ko dwoni á dwonna.]

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á yeini á beeri logo jei maama mo se á nii, á wó wane á na dwi-gɛ tu dedoa se o ba o sɛ Wɛ na. Wonto nam ná tu o sɛ, á maa wó bere‑o á tete chullu tem pa se o tiini o ji te-seŋa nyem se ko dwoni abam tete na ye tei to.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro yi abam! Abam nye de lilwoa na vaŋe ba dwonna lilwoa to mo. Á yeini á bere nɔɔna we, nɔɔno ná dugi duuri Wɛ diga kam ŋwaane, konto ba bere kolokolo. Á ma daare á bere we, nɔɔno nam ná dugi de sabu-seŋa kalo na wo Wɛ diga kam wone to, ko ye fefeo mo konto tu tei ne.

english_verse: You also teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the altar. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gift on the altar.
translation_verse: Abam daa ta bere we, nɔɔno ná dugi de Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem, konto ba bere kolokolo. Á ma daare á bere we, nɔɔno ná dugi de pɛɛra yalo maama na tigi bimbini dem baŋa ne to, ko ye fefeo mo ko pa konto tu.

english_verse: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.
translation_verse: Wolo de na dugi de Wɛ diga kam to seene o du de Wɛ tete de mo, Wɛ na zoore ka wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo daa ta ná dugi de Wɛ telaao kom, konto tu dugi de Wɛ paare dim jei mo. Wɛ tete na jeini dáane to, ko bere we konto tu dugi de Baŋa Wɛ de mo.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your garden, such as mint, dill, and cumin. Yet you neglect the more important matters of the Law, such as justice, mercy, and faithfulness. These are the important things you should have done, though you should not have left the others undone either.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Ko ná ye dwoa wo-sworru, te ná maŋe te ye fenfee tei de, á yeini á pɔɔre Wɛ-teiri á pa‑o. Ko lamma. Ko daare á yiga tera de Wɛ nia yadaara yalo na tiini ya jege yuu to, nenɛɛne chega tɔgem, de da-ŋwaŋa durim, de wo-pwoŋo kikia. Ko ya maŋe se á ta‑á ke wonnu tem konto mo á woli tedaara tem wone.

english_verse: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.
translation_verse: Farisi tu, nmo nye de lilwei mo tei. Nmo maŋe se n da yiga n se n zoŋa wo mo, se ka kwaga de daa yé taa jege digiru.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo. Á nye de yibeela yalo ba na fɔge ya kwaga se ya taa lamma nɔɔna yia ne to mo. Yibeela yam konto wo ma su de twa kwi, ye ya tiini ya ye digiru yerane.

english_verse: That's what you are like. Outside you look good, but inside you are evil and only pretend to be good.
translation_verse: Abam de nam ye konto mo. Á pae á jege chega nɔɔna yia ne, ye lwarem yerane mo su á wo, dedaane pipira kikia.

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam! Abam ye pipiri-nyena. Á yeini á fɔge á ke faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem yibeela, ye á daare á pa se nɔn-ŋona bam de yibeela yam tiini ya kwɛ lanyerane.

english_verse: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.
translation_verse: Á ma daare á bere we, á ya ná wora á kwoa nakwa bam maŋa kam ne, á bá sɛ á tɔge de-ba á go Wɛ sampwori sem.

english_verse: But you prove you really are the relatives of the ones who killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Abam tete ni mo bere we á ye balo na go Wɛ sampwori sem to bia. Bia nam tɔge ba kwoa kikia mo.

english_verse: You are nothing but snakes and the children of snakes! How can you escape going to hell?
translation_verse: Abam nye de basankwe mo de á kwoa maama. Á bere á bá lu te-seŋa waarem dem wone.

english_verse: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things! Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Luke
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, kikia yam konto waarem dem maama jege se de ba zem nɔɔna bam baŋa ne mo. Yezu wo chɔge Jerusalem tiina ŋwaane Luka

english_verse: You won't see me again until you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na we, á daa bá na-ne se ko taa vei maŋa kalo á na wó ta we, ‘Dé Teiru Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu o yere ŋwaane to swolim.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Do you see these buildings? They will certainly be torn down! Not one stone will be left in place.” Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Á nɛ ka na ye tei to na? A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, ka maama wó ba ka to ka saare tega ne. Kandwɛ dedwe daa bá daare de dwoŋi baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.
translation_verse: Kokuri nɔɔna dedɛ wó ba abam tei ye ba ma amo yere ba ta de abam we, banto mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom. Konto dwoŋi mo ba wó gane nɔɔna dedɛ.

english_verse: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, “When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world?”
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo o jeini Olivi peo kom yuu ne. O na wora konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam yerane ma vo o tei, ye ba bwei‑o ba we, “Maŋa kɔ mo Wɛ diga kam lage ka ba ka chɔge konto? Bɛ mo lage ko pa debam maana se dé lɔre we maŋa kam yi se n jwoori n ba logo baŋa, se ko maama laam ba ko kweeli?”

english_verse: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.
translation_verse: Dwi tiina wó zaŋe ba ke jara de ba dwonna dwi-gɛ tiina, ye teo de ko dwoŋi teo wó zaŋe te mage jara. Kana de maa wó ba ka taa wora jei dedɛ ne, ye tega de wó ziziŋi jei sedwonna ne.

english_verse: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne ko wó tiini ko taa ye lɛɛro kaana balo na jege pwi to tei ne, de balo na jege bia ye ba ŋɔge yele to tei ne.

english_verse: You will be arrested, punished, and even killed. Because of me, you will be hated by people of all nations.
translation_verse: Konto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna wó ja abam ba ke dedɛɛra jeŋa ne se ba bɛɛse abam, ye ba daare ba go abam. Abam na ye amo nyem to ŋwaane, logo baŋa nɔɔna maama wó taa chuli abam.

english_verse: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ wó ba ba bere we ba ye Wɛ sampwori ye ba seene ba dae. Ba maa wó gane nɔɔna dedɛ.

english_verse: Someone may say, “Here is the Messiah!” or “There he is!” But don't believe it.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne, nɔɔno wolo maama ná tage de abam o we, ‘Nii Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, o wo ywo-seeni’, se á yé sɛ konto tu.

english_verse: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ se cham durim dem konto yé ba doa nenem maŋa ne, naa á siu dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: Someday you will see that “Horrible Thing” in the holy place, just as the prophet Daniel said. Everyone who reads this must try to understand!
translation_verse: Abam nam wó ba á na wo-zɔɔne delo na chɔge Wɛ yere to na wó ba ko zege Wɛ tete diga kam ne. Wɛ sampwora Danyeli maŋe o ta wo-zɔɔne dem konto taane.” A tɛ abam wolo ná gaga, se n kwaane n ni ko kuri lanyerane.

english_verse: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná wo kara ne, se o daa yé jwoori sɔŋɔ se o kwei o gare-laao o zo.

english_verse: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.
translation_verse: Wɛ ya ná wo pɛ se yaara yam da yam tiri, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ya bá wori. O nam wó pa se yaara yam da yam tiri, o tete nɔɔna bam o na kuri to ŋwaane.

english_verse: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.
translation_verse: Ko maa ye bedwe mo de á ná nɛ wonnu tento maama ná wora te ke, se á lɔre we maŋa kam laam twɛ ka ti mo.

english_verse: When the Son of Man appears, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Nabiin-bu wom na wó ba to, ko dɛ dem wó pɔpɔ de ba nɔɔna baŋa nenɛɛne ko déem na ke Noah maŋa kam ne tei to mo.

english_verse: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Ba ta maa wo lɔre woŋo kolo na lage ko ba ko ke to, ye na bam wɛɛlem dem laam pɔpɔ de ba de pɛ ba maama. Nabiin-bu wom de wó pɔpɔ o ba konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna balei ná wo kara ne ba toŋa, Wɛ wó chaale ba dedoa o daare wodwoŋi wom.

english_verse: Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.
translation_verse: Kaana balei de ná wora ba choe muni nɔŋɔ ne, Wɛ wó chaale ba dedoa o daare wodwoŋi wom.

english_verse: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane fɔge-na á che á tete, se á yeiri dɛ dem á Teiru wom na wó ba to.

english_verse: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.
translation_verse: Á nam maŋe á yei we, sɔŋɔ tu ya ná lɔre maŋa kalo ŋweeno na lage o ba tete ne to, o ya wó taa nii o sɔŋɔ kom se ŋweeno wom yé na chwoŋa o ba o ŋɔ.

english_verse: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come. Faithful and Unfaithful Servants (Luke
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane abam jege se á che á tete mo, se Nabiin-bu wom lage o ba maŋa kam á na ba jege o teena to mo.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.
translation_verse: O nam ná ye tontoŋeno-balɔrɔ, wonto ya wó boŋe we omo tu wom wó dáane ye o jwoori.

english_verse: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?
translation_verse: Abam jege se á ta‑á tɔge chega de á boboŋ-dɛɛra, nenɛɛne tontoŋeno wolo yuu tu na yage o totoŋa o pa‑o ye o daare o beeri to. O tu wom ma le‑o se o taa nii o dwonna tontoŋena bam baŋa ne se o daare o taa pa-ba ba ni-wodiu.

english_verse: You may be sure a servant who is always faithful will be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, o tu wom laam wó pa se o taa nii o jejegero maama baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Suppose this evil servant starts beating the other servants and eats and drinks with people who are drunk.
translation_verse: O maa wó taa jege o dwonna tontoŋena bam mo o maga, ye o daare o tɔge de sa-nyɔra o di ye o nyɔ sana de-ba.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will surely come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him.
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ tu wom laam wó jwoori o ba dɛ dem tontoŋeno wom na ba jege o teena de maŋa kalo o na wó ba o zo to.

english_verse: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.
translation_verse: O tu wom nam ná tu o peere‑o konto, o laam wó zeili‑o o sɔŋɔ kom wone, ye o daare o pa se o tɔge de pipiri-nyena o na yaara dedɛ jei selo ne ba na wó taa keera ye ba done ba nwa to.

english_verse: The foolish ones took their lamps, but no extra oil.
translation_verse: Jworru tem maa wo ke nuga ba woli da se ba taa ke ba min-zwonnu tem ne.

english_verse: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.
translation_verse: Ko daare swa tiina bam ma ke nuga wonnu wone ba zia.

english_verse: Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, “Here's the groom! Come to meet him!”
translation_verse: Tega na tu ka kweere to, nɔɔna ma tɔɔle ba we, ‘Kan-baro wom maa beena! Zaŋe-na á nwoŋi á jeeri‑o.’

english_verse: When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready,
translation_verse: Bukwa bam ma zaŋe ba tɔre ba min-zwonnu tem.

english_verse: the foolish ones said to the others, “Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.”
translation_verse: Jworru tenu tem min-zwonnu tem maa lage te dwei. Ba ma ta de ba dwonna swa tiina bam we, ba ke nuga ba pa-ba, se ba min-zwonnu tem lage te dwei.

english_verse: Those who were wise answered, “There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.”

translation_verse: Yezu laam ma zaŋe o yage Tura nawuura yam seeni ye o daare o da Sidon o kɛ. O laam ma tɔge jei selo ba na bwoi we ‘Teene Fuga’ to o vo o yi Galili naneo kom jei sem.

english_verse: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus just to touch him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno mo wora o na ye zɔ-kɔgɔ ye o wae o ŋɔɔne fenfee yerane. Nɔɔna ma ja‑o ba vo Yezu tei. Ba ma lwoori‑o se o kwei o jeŋa o daŋe nɔɔno wom baŋa ne se o yɔɔre‑o.

english_verse: After Jesus had taken him aside from the crowd, he stuck his fingers in the man's ears. Then he spit and put it on the man's tongue.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ja‑o o vo dáa o yerane o daare kɔgɔ kom. O ma kwei o noa o turi nɔɔno wom zwa ne ye o daare o twe lileeru o ke o noa ne o ma dwei o dindeilimi.

english_verse: Jesus looked up toward heaven, and with a groan he said, “Effatha!” which means “Open up!”
translation_verse: O ma kwoni o yuu wɛɛne o nii ye o suuri. O ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Effata”, ko kuri mo “Pore!”

english_verse: At once the man could hear, and he had no more trouble talking clearly.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o zwa yam seene ya pore ye o dindeilimi de wae de pipira. O maa wae o ŋɔɔne lanyerane.

english_verse: Jesus told the people not to say anything about what he had done. But the more he told them, the more they talked about it.
translation_verse: Yezu ma kaane nɔɔna bam maama se ba yé ta kolo na ke to ba bere nɔɔn-nɔɔno. O na tiini o kaane-ba o woli da to, ba ma tiini ba ŋɔɔne ko taane ko ja gaale.

english_verse: They were completely amazed and said, “Everything he does is good! He even heals people who cannot hear or talk.”
translation_verse: Balo maama na nigi to tiini ba ye yaau. Ba maa we, “Woŋo kolo maama o na ke to ye lanyerane. O maŋe o pae zɔ-kɔro jwoori te ni, ye memaaro de wae te ŋɔɔna.”

english_verse: Jesus warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ta‑á yei-na se á yé pa Farisi tiina bam de abam sabɔle, de Pɛ Herodi de.”

english_verse: Then Jesus explained clearly what he meant. Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that.
translation_verse: O maa ŋɔɔne konto ja o bere-ba. Piita ma ja‑o o vo dáa, ye o bwɛ‑o o we o yé taa ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat.
translation_verse: “Amo jege nɔɔna banto ŋwaŋa de ba na tu ba wo amo tei ne da yatɔ, ye ba laam daa ba jege wodiu se ba di.

english_verse: Some of them live a long way from here. If I send them away hungry, they might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Amo ná pɛ ba viiri ye ba wo di kolokolo, kana wó pa ba beiri chwoŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane ba badaara ya nwoŋi yiga yiga mo ba ba amo tei.”

english_verse: After Jesus told the crowd to sit down, he took the seven loaves and gave thanks. He then broke the loaves and handed them to his disciples, who passed them out to the crowd.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de kɔgɔ kom se ba maama jeini tega ne. O ma kwei bworobwooru terepɛ tem ye o ke Wɛ lei te ŋwaane. O ma ja-te o fɔ fɔ o pa o kwaga tɔgena bam ye banto de laam kwei ba ja vo ba pa nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: They also had a few little fish, and after Jesus had blessed these, he told the disciples to pass them around.
translation_verse: Ba déem jege ywona fenfee ba woli da. Yezu ma kwei-ya o ke Wɛ lei ye o daare o ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam se ba kwei yanto de ba maŋe ba pa nɔɔna bam maama.

english_verse: he got into the boat with the disciples and crossed to the territory near Dalmanutha. A Sign from Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma daare o vo o zo nabworo kom de o kwaga tɔgena bam. Ba ma vo ba yi jei sedwoŋi yere na ye Dalemanuta to. Farisi tiina taane Matiyu

english_verse: The Pharisees came out and started an argument with Jesus. They wanted to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.
translation_verse: Farisi tiina badwonna déem ma vo Yezu tei se ba ŋɔɔne ded‑o, ye ba nam lage ba maŋe‑o mo ba nii. Ba ma lwoori‑o se o ke wo-kenkagele delo na wó bere-ba we o dam seene de ye Wɛ nyem to.

english_verse: The disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, and they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
translation_verse: Ba déem na wo nabworo kom wone ba maa vei ba bɛ to, Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ma maane we ba ya swei se ba ja bworobworo ba woli da, ye dedoa yerane mo ba jega.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, “Why are you talking about not having any bread? Don't you understand? Are your minds still closed?
translation_verse: Yezu ma maane ba na tɛ kolo to, ye o we, “Bɛ mo ye á pa lwia jege abam de bworobworo na tera to ŋwaane? Abam ta wo lɔre Wɛ na jege dam tei to na? Á boboŋa muri mo.

english_verse: Jesus took him by the hand and led him out of the village, where he spit into the man's eyes. He placed his hands on the blind man and asked him if he could see anything.
translation_verse: O ma ja lilwei wom jeŋa o vaŋe o ja nwoŋi teo kom dáa. O ma twe lileeru o ke o yia ne. O ma daare o kwei o jea o zi o baŋa ne. O laam ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo nae woŋo mo na?”

english_verse: The man looked up and said, “I see people, but they look like trees walking around.”
translation_verse: Lilwei wom ma zeiŋi o yuu o nii, ye o we, “Amo wae a nae nɔɔna na via. Ba nam nye de teeni mo ye ba via.”

english_verse: Once again Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes, and this time the man stared. His eyes were healed, and he saw everything clearly.
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma kwei o jea o daŋe nɔɔno wom yia ne. O laam ma fi o yia yam, ye ya jwoori ya nae. O maa wae o nae woŋo maama lanyerane.

english_verse: Jesus said to him, “You may return home now, but don't go into the village.” Who Is Jesus? (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o we, o yɔɔre o vo sɔŋɔ, se o daa yé jwoori o zo teo kom wo. Piita tage Yezu chega kam Matiyu

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?” “You are the Messiah!” Peter replied.
translation_verse: O laam ma bwei-ba o we, “Ko nam ná ye abam, á boŋe se amo ye wɔ mo?” Piita ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista mo.”

english_verse: Jesus warned the disciples not to tell anyone about him. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta-ba we, ba yé ta o chega kam konto ba bere nɔɔn-nɔɔno. Yezu bere o toone na wó taa ye tei to Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “The nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make the Son of Man suffer terribly. He will be rejected and killed, but three days later he will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Ko zege kanto maŋa kam ne Yezu ma ŋɔɔne o bere-ba we omo Nabiin-bu wom maŋe se o na yaara dedɛ. O maa we, “Juu tiina nakwa bam, de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam mo wó chuli amo. Ba maa wó ja amo ba go, se a laam jwoori a bi da yatɔ dɛ ne.”

english_verse: But when Jesus turned and saw the disciples, he corrected Peter. He said to him, “Satan, get away from me! You are thinking like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma guni o nii o kwaga tɔgena bam seeni, ye o leiri o bwɛ Piita o we, “Setaana pɛ, véi dáa a tei ne! Nmo boboŋa yam ye nabiina nyem mo ye ya ba tɔge Wɛ na lage tei to.”

english_verse: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: O laam ma bwoŋi nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama de o kwaga tɔgena bam se ba ba o tei. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Nɔɔno wolo maama ná lage se o taa tɔge amo kwaga, konto tu jege se o ve o tete boboŋa ye o sɛ yaara, ne wolo na zeŋe dagara o maa vei o toone jei tei to, se o laam ba o taa tɔge-ne.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me and for the good news, you will save it.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam ná lage se o jwoŋi o tete ŋwea, konto tu wó ga-ka mo. Ko daare wolo maama ná sɛ se o ga o ŋwea amo ŋwaane de Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane, konto tu wó jwoŋi ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná kwaane o jwoŋi logo baŋa wonnu tem maama, ye o laam ná gɛ ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, bɛ nyɔɔre mo o nɛa?

english_verse: What could you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Kolokolo nam tera nɔɔno na wó wane o kwei o ma jwoŋi o ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
translation_verse: Zem nɔɔna bam yiga tera de Wɛ ye ba ke ba tusi dedɛ. Konto to, wolo maama ná kɔre chaveera amo ŋwaane de a taane dem ŋwaane, amo Nabiin-bu wom de wó taa jege chaveera konto tu ŋwaane dɛ dem amo na wó jwoori a ba de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ ne a Kwo Wɛ na jege tei to, ye Wɛ malese de wó tɔge-ne.”

english_verse: I can assure you that Elijah has already come. And people treated him just as they wanted to, as the Scriptures say they would. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na we, Elija maŋe o ba, ye nɔɔna tiini ba bɛɛse‑o se ko yi ba boboŋa na lage tei to, ne ko na maŋe ko popone o ŋwaane Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne tei to.” Yezu yɔɔre bu wodwoŋi Matiyu

english_verse: After Jesus and the disciples had gone back home and were alone, they asked him, “Why couldn't we force out that demon?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma jwoori o vo sɔŋɔ. O na zo to, o kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo o tei ba yerane ye ba bwei‑o ba we, “Bɛŋwaane mo debam ware dé zeili chichira kam?”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked a child to stand near him. He put his arm around the child and said,
translation_verse: O ma ja bu-balaŋa o pa o zege ba maama tetare ne. O ma kwei‑o o ke o ja-kukworo ne. O ma ta de-ba o we,

english_verse: And his clothes became much whiter than any bleach on earth could make them.
translation_verse: O gwaaro tem ma tiini te peere cha ye te nyeena. Te peere te gaale nabiinu na bá wane o zare o gwaaro pa te peere tei to.

english_verse: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Elija de Moses ma pɔpɔ ba nwoŋi ba yiga ne, ye ba ŋɔɔne de Yezu.

english_verse: The shadow of a cloud passed over and covered them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my Son, and I love him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Kunkwoŋo laam ma ba ko li-ba. Ba ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne ko wone ka we, “Amo bu-doa mo tento ye a swoi‑o lanyerane. Nam ta‑á cheigi-na o ni taane lanyerane.”

english_verse: At once the disciples looked around, but they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwaane ba nii lela, ye ba daa wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno jei sem ne, ko ná dae Yezu yerane.

english_verse: So they kept it to themselves. But they wondered what he meant by the words “raised from death.”
translation_verse: Ba ma sɛ ye ba ŋɔɔne ba yerane ba bwɛ ba nii, ka-bi-toone-wone taane dem kuri mo bɛ.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma bwei‑o ba we, “Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam yeini ba tɛ ba we, Elija mo jege se o ba yiga, se Wɛ Dam Tu wom laam da kwaga. Ko ye chega mo naa vwa mo?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko ye chega mo. Elija jege se o da yiga o ba o kwɛ woŋo maama se Wɛ Dam Tu wom laam ba. Bɛ nam mo ye ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, Nabiin-bu wom jege se o yaare dedɛ ye nɔɔna chuli‑o?

english_verse: When Jesus and his three disciples came back down, they saw a large crowd around the other disciples. The teachers of the Law of Moses were arguing with them.
translation_verse: Yezu de o nɔɔna batɔ bam laam ma jwoori ba vo ba yi o kwaga tɔgena babam tei. Ba ma na kɔgɔ dedɛ na gilimi-ba. Wɛ nia zamesem tiina badwonna maa wora ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ dedaane-ba.

english_verse: They brought the boy, and as soon as the demon saw Jesus, it made the boy shake all over. He fell down and began rolling on the ground and foaming at the mouth.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja‑o ba vo o tei. Chichira kam na nɛ Yezu to, ka ma su bu wom pa o sa kɔɔro. O ma to tega ne ye o bibila. Lilei-puŋa ma nwoŋi o ni ne.

english_verse: “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me.” For or against Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: “Wolo maama na wó zuli bu-balwa banto dwoŋi dedoa lanyerane amo yere ŋwaane to zuli amo mo. Wolo nam ná zuli amo, ko dae amo yerane mo o ke konto, se ko ye o zuli Baŋa Wɛ wolo na toŋe-ne to de mo.”

english_verse: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama na nɛ Yezu to, ko ke-ba yaau lanyerane. Ba ma duri ba vo o tei ba jɔɔne‑o.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “What are you arguing about?”
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ba o we, “Á wora á mage ni-kantɔgɔ bɛ baŋa ne mo?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi konto to, o ma ta o we, “Abam zem nɔɔna bam bere á ba jege wo-dedoa de amo. A nam wó tiini a dáane abam tei ne se ko vo ko maŋe yei ne mo? A nam wó ke tɛ mo a zuri a bochare de abam? Ja-na bu wom á ba.”

english_verse: Jesus asked the boy's father, “How long has he been like this?” The man answered, “Ever since he was a child.
translation_verse: Yezu ma bwei bu wom kwo o we, “Maŋa kɔ mo ka bobo ka ja‑o?” O ma leiri‑o we, “O biini ne mo.

english_verse: At once the boy's father shouted, “I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.”
translation_verse: Bu wom kwo laam ma laare o we, “Amo seene a jege wo-dedoa de nmo. Nam woli-ne se a taa fɔge a jega.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, “I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma na nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ na dura ko maa beene ba tei. O laam ma bage chichira kam ye o ta de-ka we, “Nmo wolo na pae nɔɔna jiri memaaro de zɔ-kɔro to, a ta de nmo se n yage bu wom yera n viiri, se n daa‑n yé jwoori n yaare‑o.”

english_verse: The spirit screamed and made the boy shake all over. Then it went out of him. The boy looked dead, and almost everyone said he was.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, chichira kam ma chwoosi ye ka tiini ka su bu wom pa o sa kɔɔro. Ka ma daare ka yage‑o. Ka na yage‑o to, bu wom laam nye de too mo. Nɔɔna dedɛ maa we, “O tege mo.”

english_verse: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ja o jeŋa o pa o zaŋe wɛɛne ye o zega.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Only prayer can force out this kind of demon.” Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Chichira kanto dwoŋi zeilim chamma. Ko ná dae we á seene á yia á lwoori Wɛ, ko ya bá wane.”

english_verse: Jesus left with his disciples and started through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know about it,
translation_verse: Ba déem ma yage jei sem konto ye ba vo ba tɔge Galili wo ba kɛ. Yezu maa ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno lɔre ba jei,

english_verse: because he was teaching the disciples that the Son of Man would be handed over to people who would kill him. But three days later he would rise to life.
translation_verse: o na jege o kwaga tɔgena bam o tei ne ye o bere-ba to ŋwaane. O maa bere-ba o we, “Leile konto ba lage ba ja Nabiin-bu wom ba ke nɔɔna jeŋa ne, ye ba laam wó go‑o. Da yatɔ dɛ ne o maa wó jwoori o bi.”

english_verse: The disciples did not understand what Jesus meant, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam maa wo nigi o taane dem kuri, ye ba kɔre se ba bwei‑o ba nii. Wɔ mo ye nɔn-kamunu Wɛ tei ne? Matiyu

english_verse: If your foot causes you to sin, chop it off. You would be better off to go into life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Jei sem konto ne, ‘Toa wó taa mu ba yera ye ka fɔge ka bá te. Mini wó taa di-ba ye de fɔge de bá dwei.’]

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples went to his home in Capernaum. After they were inside the house, Jesus asked them, “What were you arguing about along the way?”
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi Kaparenia. Ba ma vo sɔŋɔ. Ba na zo to, Yezu ma bwei o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Dé na wo chwoŋa ne dé maa beene to, á ya wora á mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane. Ko ye bɛ ŋo ŋwaane mo?”

english_verse: They had been arguing about which one of them was the greatest, and so they did not answer.
translation_verse: Ba ma chem. Ba ya na maa beene to, ba mage kantɔgɔ daane se ba nii, banto wone wɔ mo ye kamunu o dwoi maama.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, “If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma jeini tega ne. O ma bwoŋi o nɔɔna fuga-balei bam se ba ba o tei. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Wolo ná lage se o taa ye nɔɔna yiga tu, konto tu maŋe se o ji ba maama kwaga tu, se o taa toŋe o pa ba maama mo.”

english_verse: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.
translation_verse: Yɛ de lamma ye de wae de kwɛ wodiu. Yɛ ni nam ná ti, n daa‑n bá‑n wane n pa de jwoori de ja ni. Pa-na á wo taa ywomma da-ŋwaane, ne yɛ na pae wodiu ywomma tei to.”

english_verse: John said, “Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.”
translation_verse: Jɔn ma ta de Yezu o we, “Berem tu, dé ya nɛ nɔɔno wodwoŋi o na tɔge nmo yere ŋwaane o zeili setaana nɔɔna tei ne. O nam na dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem to, de ma ta ded‑o we, o yage, o daa yé taa ke konto.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Á ya ba jege se á che‑o. Nɔɔno wolo maama na tɔge amo yere ŋwaane o ke wo-kenkagele to bá wane o pipiri lela o ŋɔɔne ta-balɔrɔ o pa-ne.

english_verse: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane wolo maama na ba chuli debam to ye debam nɔɔno mo.

english_verse: And anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name, just because you belong to me, will surely be rewarded. Temptations To Sin (Matthew
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nɔɔno wolo ná nɛ abam, ye o ná dɛ amo yere ŋwaane o pa abam na se á nyɔ, á na ye amo Yezu Krista nyem to ŋwaane, konto tu wó tiini o na nyɔɔre Wɛ tei ne mo.

english_verse: So if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed than to have two hands and be thrown into the fires of hell that never go out.
translation_verse: Jei sem konto ne, ‘Toa wó taa mu ba yera ye ka fɔge ka bá te. Mini wó taa di-ba ye de fɔge de bá dwei.’]

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, get rid of it. You would be better off to go into God's kingdom with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell.
translation_verse: Nmo yi nam ná pae n tusa, se n guri-de n yage. Nmo ná ye yi-doa tu ye n vo n woli Wɛ paare dem wone, konto gare nmo ta ná jege yia yalei ye ba laam de‑m ba yage te-seŋa ne.

english_verse: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma zaŋe o yage jei sem konto ye o vo o yi Judea laŋa kadwoŋi. O ma vo o bɛ Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem. Nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ daa ma ba ba gilimi‑o. O daa ma bere-ba Wɛ chega kam, ne o na yeini o ke tei to.

english_verse: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Kaane de ná ve o baro ye o vo o zo baro wodwoŋi, o de keim dem de bwoŋa ye bedwe mo.” Bu-balwa maŋe de Wɛ paare dem Matiyu

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.
translation_verse: Farisi tiina badaara déem ma zaŋe ba vo o tei se ba maŋe o boboŋa ba nii. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nɔɔno jege chwoŋa se o yage o kaane na?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What does the Law of Moses say about this?”
translation_verse: O ma jwoori o bwei-ba o we, “Moses déem pɛ abam ni se á ke tɛ mo?”

english_verse: They answered, “Moses allows a man to write out divorce papers and send his wife away.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Moses pɛ ni we nɔɔno jege chwoŋa se o popone tɔnɔ o pa o kaane se ko bere we o yage‑o.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Moses gave you this law because you are so heartless.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “Moses nam popone konto o pa abam, á boboŋa na lira de o berem dem to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: But in the beginning God made a man and a woman.
translation_verse: Boboa ne Wɛ na naane woŋo maama to, o ke nabiina se ba taa ye baara de kaana mo.

english_verse: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.
