translation_verse: O ma vere o tete o daare o gɔrɔ kom o yage, ye o duri o viiri kalambwolo. Ba ŋɔɔne Yezu taane Matiyu

english_verse: Finally, some men stood up and lied about him. They said,
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni nɔɔna badaara ma zaŋe wɛɛne ye ba fɔ vwa ba pa Yezu ba we,

english_verse: Peter replied, “That isn't true! I don't know what you're talking about. I don't have any idea what you mean.” He went out to the gate, and a rooster crowed.
translation_verse: O ma fo o we, “Amo yeiri woŋo kolo n na tɛ to. A ba ni ko kuri.” O ma zaŋe o nwoŋi o vo manchwoŋo ni. Chebɛɔ ma pɔpɔ ko keeri.

english_verse: Peter had followed at a distance, and when he reached the courtyard of the high priest's house, he sat down with the guards to warm himself beside a fire.
translation_verse: Piita ma dale o tɔge ba kwaga o da o vo o yi kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ. O ma zo konkɔlɔ kom o vo o jeini de sɔŋɔ kom tontoŋena bam ye o tɔge o weeri mini.

english_verse: The chief priests and the whole council tried to find someone to accuse Jesus of a crime, so they could put him to death. But they could not find anyone to accuse him.
translation_verse: Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nakwa kɔgɔ kom maama maa kwaane se ba lɔre chwoŋa kalo ba na wó da ba ma saŋe Yezu se ba laam pa o te to. Ba ma kwaane taa ba ga.

english_verse: This time Peter began to curse and swear, “I don't even know the man you're talking about!”
translation_verse: O laam ma sɔɔle o pa o tete se ko bere o chega ye o we, “Amo bere a yeiri nɔɔno wolo á na tɛ o taane to.”

english_verse: “We heard him say he would tear down this temple that we built. He also claimed that in three days he would build another one without any help.”
translation_verse: “Dé nigi nɔɔno wonto na tage o we, ‘Ko ná ye Wɛ diga kanto nabiina na lɔge-ka to, amo wó yigi-ka a de tega ne, ye a jwoori a ma da yatɔ a lɔ kadwoŋi ye kanto dae nabiina mo wó lɔ-ka.’ ”

english_verse: But even then they did not agree on what they said.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na maŋe ba ta konto to, ba daa ta wo wane ba sɛ woŋo dedoa.

english_verse: The high priest stood up in the council and asked Jesus, “Why don't you say something in your own defense? Don't you hear the charges they are making against you?”
translation_verse: Kaanem yuu tu wom laam ma zaŋe ba maama tetare ne, ye o bwei Yezu o we, “Nɔɔna banto balei na tage kolo ba pa nmo to, nmo ba jege taane se n leiri na?”

english_verse: But Jesus kept quiet and did not say a word. The high priest asked him another question, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the glorious God?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma chem ye o wo leiri kolokolo. Kaanem yuu tu wom ma jwoori o bwei‑o o we, “Nmo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista na ye Nenɔŋa Tu Baŋa Wɛ Bu mo na?”

english_verse: You heard him claim to be God! What is your decision?” They all agreed he should be put to death.
translation_verse: Abam maama maŋe á ni o na ŋɔɔne Wɛ o chɔge de o na pa se o ma de Wɛ to. Konto to, abam we bɛ mo?” Ba maama ma sɛ we o maŋe se o te mo.

english_verse: Some of the people started spitting on Jesus. They blindfolded him, hit him with their fists, and said, “Tell us who hit you!” Then the guards took charge of Jesus and beat him. Peter Says He Doesn't Know Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara ma twe lileeru ba yage o yera ne. Ba ma kwei gɔrɔ ba pu o yia ye ba daare ba mage‑o. Ba maa we, “Lɔre n bere debam wolo na mage‑m to.” Soja tiina bam ma ja‑o ye ba jege‑o ba maga. Piita seene o ve Yezu kuni betɔ Matiyu

english_verse: The servant girl saw Peter again and said to the people standing there, “This man is one of them!”
translation_verse: Ka-nyaane wom daa ma na‑o. O daa ta ma ta de nɔɔna balo na zege da to o we, “Nɔɔno wonto tɔge o ye ba kɔgɔ kom wo dedoa mo.”

english_verse: While Peter was still in the courtyard, a servant girl of the high priest came up
translation_verse: Piita ya daa ta tɔge o jei konkɔlɔ kom ne. Kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ ka-nyaane ma tɔge da o maa kɛa.

english_verse: and saw Peter warming himself by the fire. She stared at him and said, “You were with Jesus from Nazareth!”
translation_verse: O ma na Piita na jei o weeri mini. O ma fɔge o nii‑o lanyerane, ye o we, “Nmo de tɔge de Nazarete tu Yezu mo.”

english_verse: “No, I'm not!” Peter replied. A little while later some of the people said to Peter, “You certainly are one of them. You're a Galilean!”
translation_verse: O daa ma fo we o dae. Ko na ke fee to, nɔɔna balo na zege da to ma ta de Piita ba we, “Nmo seene n ye ba wo dedoa. Nmo de ye Galili tu mo.”

english_verse: At once the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered that Jesus had told him, “Before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me.” So Peter started crying.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, chebɛɔ laam ma pɔpɔ ko keeri ko ke kuni belei. Piita laam ma guli Yezu ya na tage kolo ded‑o o we, “Chebɛɔ ta ná wo keeri kuni belei, nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we n yeiri amo.” O na guli konto to, o wo ma tiini ko chɔge dedɛ ye o keeri lanyerane.

english_verse: Early the next morning the chief priests, the nation's leaders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met together with the whole Jewish council. They tied up Jesus and led him off to Pilate.
translation_verse: Tega na tu ka poore tetete to, Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam, de ba teo kom nakwa bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam, de ba kɔgɔ kom maama ma ba ba ke ni daane. Ba ma ja Yezu ba vɔ, ye ba ja‑o ba vo ba ke Pilata jeŋa ne.

english_verse: But the chief priests told the crowd to ask Pilate to free Barabbas.
translation_verse: Kaanem yiga tiina bam ma soge kɔgɔ kom pa se ba ta de Pilata we, o jege se o yage Barabas mo o pa-ba.

english_verse: Pilate asked, “But what crime has he done?” “Nail him to a cross!” they yelled even louder.
translation_verse: O ma jwoori o bwei-ba o we, “Wonto chɔge bɛ mo?” Ba laam ma tiini ba laare baŋa baŋa ba we, “Pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go.”

english_verse: But Jesus did not answer, and Pilate was amazed. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu daa ta maa wo sɛ se o leiri ba taane dem delodelo. Pilata maa ye yaau ded‑o.

english_verse: They made fun of Jesus and shouted, “Hey, you king of the Jews!”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma seini‑o ba we, “Juu tiina pɛ, denlei.”

english_verse: Then Pilate questioned him again, “Don't you have anything to say? Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done?”
translation_verse: Pilata ma jwoori o bwei‑o se o nii, ye o we, “Nmo ba lage n leiri ba taane dem na? Nmo wo nigi ba na ŋɔɔne kolo maama ba pa nmo to na?”

english_verse: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross. Soldiers Make Fun of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilata maa lage se o pa kɔgɔ kom bochare zuri mo. Mo kokuri o ma le Barabas o yage o pa-ba. O ma pa ba fere Yezu, ye o pa-ba chwoŋa se ba ja‑o ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go. Ba jaane Yezu ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne Matiyu

english_verse: On it was a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, “This is the King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Ba ya popone tɔnɔ se ko bere kolo o na chɔge ye ba go‑o to ba meeli da, ye ko we, JUU TIINA PƐ.

english_verse: They yelled, “Nail him to a cross!”
translation_verse: Ba ma laare baŋa baŋa ba we, “Pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go.”

english_verse: It was about nine o'clock in the morning when they nailed him to the cross.
translation_verse: Ba na page‑o maŋa kalo to maŋe de wɛ na puli de peere tei to.

english_verse: A Roman army officer was standing in front of Jesus. When the officer saw how Jesus died, he said, “This man really was the Son of God!”
translation_verse: Soja tiina yiga tu wolo na zege Yezu yiga ne to ma na o na tega tei to. O na nɛ to, o maa we, “Nɔɔno wonto ya seene o ye Baŋa Wɛ Bu mo.”

english_verse: The soldiers led Jesus inside the courtyard of the fortress and called together the rest of the troops.
translation_verse: Soja tiina bam laam ma ja Yezu ba vo ba zo gɔmena tu Pilata sɔŋɔ kom konkɔlɔ ye ba daare ba la ba kɔgɔ kom maama ba ke daane.

english_verse: And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot.
translation_verse: Peeno wodwoŋi déem maa wora, o yere mo Barabas. Ba déem pe‑o mo de balo na dwoni de ba teo kom dedɛɛra ye ba go nɔɔna to.

english_verse: The crowd now came and asked Pilate to set a prisoner free, just as he usually did.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma ba ba la kɔgɔ ye ba daare ba ta de Pilata se o le peeno dedoa o pa-ba ne o na yeini o ke tei to.

english_verse: Pilate asked them, “Do you want me to free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilata ma bwei-ba o we, “Á lage se a le wolo na ye Juu tiina pɛ to a yage a pa abam na?”

english_verse: Pilate knew that the chief priests had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.
translation_verse: O bwei-ba konto kolo ŋwaane o yei we ko ye wo-goo ŋwaane mo kaanem yiga tiina bam ya jaane Yezu ba ke o jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Then Pilate asked the crowd, “What do you want me to do with this man you say is the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilata laam ma bwei-ba o we, “Ko nam ná ye wolo á na bwoi‑o we Juu tiina pɛ to, amo nam wó ke‑o tɛ mo?”

english_verse: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the purple robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ba na ke‑o ba mɔne ba ti to, ba ma le gare-soŋo kom ye ba jwoori ba zo‑o o tete gɔrɔ kom. Ba laam ma ja‑o ba nwoŋi ba vo se ba pa‑o dagara kam yuu ne.

english_verse: Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba na maa kɛ to, ba ma na nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Simon. O nwoŋi Kurene mo. O maa ye Alezanda de Rufus kwo. O déem ya nwoŋi kara mo o ba o yi teo wo o maa kɛa. Soja tiina bam na nɛ‑o to, ba ma fe‑o se o kwei dagara kam o zeŋe se ba vo.

english_verse: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses also made fun of Jesus. They said to each other, “He saved others, but he can't save himself.
translation_verse: Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba zamesem tiina bam de maa ke‑o ba mɔna ba bere daane konto dwoŋi. Ba maa tɛ daane ba we, “O yeini o jwoŋi nɔɔna ŋwea, ye o laam ware o tete ŋwea o jwoŋi.

english_verse: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, and he called in the army officer to find out if Jesus had been dead very long.
translation_verse: Pilata na lɔre we Yezu maŋe o te to mo ko so‑o lanyerane. O ma toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo ba bwoŋi soja tiina yiga tu wom se o ba. O na tu to, o ma bwei‑o se o nii, Yezu seene o te na.

english_verse: The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means “Place of a Skull.”
translation_verse: Ba ma ja Yezu ba vo ba yi jeiga kadwoŋi ba na bwoi we ‘Goligota’ to. Yere dem konto kuri mo ye ‘Yu-kwoli-champoa Peo’.

english_verse: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, “Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na tɔge da ba kɛ to maa nia ye ba dole ba yuni ba twe‑o. Ba ma yaale‑o ye ba we, “Nii! Nmo ye wolo ya na boŋe se n yigi Wɛ diga kam mo n de tega ne, se n daare n ma da yatɔ n jwoori n fɔge n lɔ-ka.

english_verse: If he is the Messiah, the king of Israel, let him come down from the cross! Then we will see and believe.” The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus. The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: O bere o tete we o ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, de Isarele dwi tiina pɛ. O nam tu dagara kam yuu ne leile se dé nii. Dé ná nɛ konto, dé wó sɛ we o ye chega tu.” Nɔɔna balo ba na tɔge ba pa dagare sem baŋa ne to de maa jege‑o ba twea.

english_verse: After the officer told him, Pilate let Joseph have Jesus' body.
translation_verse: O na lɔre we o tege to, o ma sɛ se Josɛf vo o kwei o yera yam o taa tei.

english_verse: Then about that time Jesus shouted, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, my God, why have you deserted me?”
translation_verse: Ko na yi luu batɔ to mo Yezu laare baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa o we, “Eli, Eli, lema sabaktani?” Taane dento kuri mo, “Amo Wɛ, amo Wɛ, bɛ mo ke ye n yage a yera?”

english_verse: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, “He is calling for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na zege da ye ba ni taane dem to badaara maa we, “Cheigi-na! O lage o bwoŋi Elija mo se o ba.”

english_verse: One of them ran and grabbed a sponge. After he had soaked it in wine, he put it on a stick and held it up to Jesus. He said, “Let's wait and see if Elijah will come and take him down!”
translation_verse: Ba dedoa laam ma duri o vo o kwei sɔsɔɔ. O ma de-ko sa-nyɔna wone, ye o daare o ke-ko kasogo ni ne o vo o tei o pa Yezu se o nyɔ. O maa we, “Yage se dé cheigi dé nii, Elija wó ba o woli‑o se o tu da na?”

english_verse: Some women were looking on from a distance. They and many others had come with Jesus to Jerusalem. But even before this they had been his followers and had helped him while he was in Galilee. Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of the younger James and of Joseph were two of these women. Salome was also one of them. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Kaana banto déem ya tɔge de Yezu Galili ne mo, ye ba yeini ba toŋe ba zeini‑o. Kaana badaara dedɛ de maa wora, ba ya na tɔge ded‑o ba ba Jerusalem. Ba ke Yezu yera yam yibeeli wone Matiyu

english_verse: Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.
translation_verse: Josɛf ma nwoŋi o vo o yeigi gare-jale delo na lana to. O ma vo o pare Yezu yera yam dagara kam yuu ne. O ma kwei-ya o pipiri de gɔrɔ kom, ye o daare o ja-ya o vo o tiŋi peo bɔɔne wone. Dento maa ye yibeeli ba déem na luga peo yera ne mo. O laam ma bibili kandwɛ-polɔgɔ o ma pe bɔɔne dem ni.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.
translation_verse: Mary Magadala de Mary wolo na ye Josɛf wodwoŋi nu to maa zege ba nii mɛ o na tiŋi Yezu yera yam to.

english_verse: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni, Yezu ma leiri o yibia ye o bere o tete o nɔɔna bam balei tei ne. Ba déem ya nwoŋi Jerusalem mo ba maa vei te-balaŋa kadwoŋi.

english_verse: Very early on Sunday morning, just as the sun was coming up, they went to the tomb.
translation_verse: Wɛ na wora de puli dɛ dem na saŋe siu dɛ dem to, ba maa wo chwoŋa ne ba maa vei yibeeli dem ni.

english_verse: On their way, they were asking one another, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance for us?”
translation_verse: Ba na maa kɛ to, ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Wɔ mo wó bibili kandwɛ-kamunu kom o yage o pa debam?”

english_verse: But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!
translation_verse: Kandwɛ dem na maŋe de ye kamunu to mo pɛ ba ŋɔɔne konto. Ba na yi jei sem to, ba ma fɔge ba nii dedaane kandwɛ dem bibili de tigi dáa ne.

english_verse: The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba zo bɔɔne dem wo. Ba na zo to, ba ma na nɔn-doŋo na jei da ba jazem seeni. O déem zo gare-pwon-dedɔrɔ mo. Ba na nɛ‑o to, ko ma pa ba yera sɔɔre.

english_verse: Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.”
translation_verse: Nam véi-na á ta de Piita de o kwaga tɔgena bam maama we, o lage o tɔge yiga o vo Galili se á vo á na‑o dáane. Ko wó ke ne o na maŋe o ta o bere abam tei to.”

english_verse: They will handle snakes and will drink poison and not be hurt. They will also heal sick people by placing their hands on them. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: Ba ná jaane basankwe de ba jea, se bá ke-ba kolokolo. Ba ta ná nyɔge chɔŋɔ kolo na goe nɔɔna to, konto de bá chɔge-ba. Ba wó wane ba daŋe ba jea jaweena baŋa ne pa se ba na yazura.”

english_verse: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ‑o to, ba ma jwoori ba vo Jerusalem ba ta ba bere ba dwonna kwaga tɔgena bam. Banto daa ta wo sɛ we ko ye chega.

english_verse: Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná sɛ taane dem ye o daare o jwoŋi sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane, Wɛ wó jwoŋi konto tu ŋwea. Ko daare balo maama na ba sɛ to wó ga bora Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu na ŋɔɔne o bere-ba konto to, Wɛ laam ma kwei‑o o ja di telaao. O ma vo o jeini Baŋa Wɛ jazem seeni o wora.

english_verse: Afterwards, Jesus appeared to his eleven disciples as they were eating. He scolded them because they were too stubborn to believe the ones who had seen him after he had been raised to life.
translation_verse: Ko maama na ke to, Yezu laam ma ba o bere o tete o nɔɔna fuga-dedoa bam tei ne, ba na wora ba di wodiu maŋa kalo to. O ma bwɛ-ba de ba boboŋa na muri Wɛ tei ne, kolo ŋwaane ba ve se ba sɛ balo na tage ba bere-ba we wonto jwoori o bi ye ba na‑o to.

english_verse: Then he told them: Go and preach the good news to everyone in the world.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Zaŋe-na á vo logo baŋa jei maama se á tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam á bere nabiina maama.

english_verse: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.
translation_verse: Balo na sɛ amo to wó wane ba taa ke wo-kenkagela yalo na bere Wɛ dam to. Ba wó tɔge amo yere ŋwaane ba zeili setaana nɔɔna tei ne. Ba wó taa ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ.

english_verse: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard. An Angel Tells about the Birth of John
translation_verse: Konto to, amo wó wane a popone wonnu tento na ke tei to chekke, se n wane n lɔre lanyerane we, wonnu telo ba na tage ba bere‑m to seene te ye chega. Zekaria bu lora kam taane

english_verse: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Herodi déem na ye Judea pɛ to, nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo wora, o yere mo Zekaria. Wonto mo ye Wɛ kaanem tu. O nwoŋi Abija dwi tiina wone mo. O kaane yere mo Elizabet. Wonto de déem nwoŋi Wɛ kaanem dwi tiina bam wone mo.

english_verse: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.
translation_verse: Banto maama ke lanyerane Wɛ yiga ne. Ba maa tɔge Wɛ nia yam maama, ye ba daa ta ba jege tusim Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.
translation_verse: Elizabet déem ye kadega mo pa se o ba jege bu. Ba maama bena déem gaale.

english_verse: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem déem ma yi se Abija dwi tiina bam zo Wɛ diga kam ba taa toŋa ba pa Wɛ. Zekaria maa tɔge o wora o toŋa.

english_verse: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense,
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem tiina bam yeini ba le ba wone dedoa mo se o zo Wɛ wara-jei di-yuu kom o zwɛ talwoŋ-ywoŋa o pa Wɛ. Dɛ dem konto na yi to, ba ma ta jɔrɔ se ba nii wɔ mo wó zo. Zekaria ma di.

english_verse: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka laam ma pɔpɔ ka ba o tei ka zege wonnu zwɛɛm bimbini dem jazem ne.

english_verse: Zechariah was confused and afraid when he saw the angel.
translation_verse: Zekaria na nɛ-ka to, o maa ye yaau ye foone zo‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: But the angel told him: Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God has heard your prayers. Your wife Elizabeth will have a son, and you must name him John.
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma ta ded‑o ka we, “Zekaria, yé ta‑n kɔre foone. Wɛ nigi nmo na lwoori‑o kolo to. Nmo kaane wom laam wó ja puga o lo bu o pa‑m. Nmo jege se n pa o yere we Jɔn.

english_verse: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.
translation_verse: O lora kam wó pa se n di ywoni dedɛ. Nɔɔna dedɛ de wó tiini ba taa jege wopwolo de o lora kam,

english_verse: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane o wó taa ye nɔn-kamunu Baŋa Wɛ tei ne. O nam yé zaŋe o nyɔ sa-soŋo naa sa-dɛɛra. Wɛ Sin-laao kom wó taa wo o tei ne maŋa maama, ko zege maŋa kam ba na wó lo‑o to.

english_verse: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: O maa wó pa se Isarele dwi tiina dedɛ boboŋa jwoori ya taa tɔge ba Teiru Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: He will go ahead of the Lord with the same power and spirit that Elijah had. And because of John, parents will be more thoughtful of their children. And people who now disobey God will begin to think as they ought to. This is how John will get people ready for the Lord.
translation_verse: O wó tɔge dé Teiru wom yiga ne, ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam wó taa wo o tei ne, se ko maŋe de Elija déem na ye tei to. O wó pa se kwoa jwoori ba taa swoi ba bia, ye o kwori o pa yi-dɛɛre tiina jwoori ba taa jege nɔn-ŋona boboŋa, se o fɔge o kwɛ dé Teiru wom nɔɔna bam yiga o pa‑o, ye o daare o ke-ba o jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: The angel answered, “I am Gabriel, God's servant, and I was sent to tell you this good news.
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma leiri‑o ka we, “Amo nam ye Gabireli mo, wolo na zege Wɛ tei ne to. O toŋe-ne se a ba a ŋɔɔne de nmo, se a ta ta-ŋom dem a bere‑m.

english_verse: You have not believed what I have said. So you will not be able to say a thing until all this happens. But everything will take place when it is supposed to.”
translation_verse: Nmo nam na wo sɛ amo taane dem to, Wɛ wó pa se n ni meeri. Maŋa kam ná yia, wonnu telo a na tage a bere‑m to wó seene te ke. Nam ta‑n yei we, nmo bá‑n wane n ŋɔɔne se ko taa vei maŋa kam wonnu tem na wó ke to.”

english_verse: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.
translation_verse: O laam ma nwoŋi, ye o ware o ŋɔɔne de-ba. O ni na meeri to, o maa mae o jea o maŋe o bere-ba. Ba ma maane we o nɛ wo-kenkagele mo Wɛ di-yuu kom ne.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Da yalo o na jege se o taa toŋe Wɛ diga kam ne to ma ba ya kweeli. O ma jwoori o vo sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Ko maa wora ye o kaane wom laam ma ja puga. O maa wo sɔŋɔ ne taa, chane senu.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Ka ma zo o tei ka jɔɔne‑o ye ka we, “Baŋa Wɛ wo nmo tei ne ye o swɛ nmo swolim dedɛ.”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Mary na nigi o na tage kolo to, o bochare ma di. O ma boŋe o we, “Taane dento kuri mo bɛ?”

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Maleka kam laam ma ta ka we, “Mary, ye ta‑n kɔre foone. Wɛ yɔɔre o ke zaane o ke nmo yuu ne.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Nmo wó ba n ja puga n lo bakeira. Á nam wó pa o yere we Yezu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Wonto wó taa ye nɔn-kamunu mo. Ba wó taa bwoi‑o we, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom Bu. Dé Teiru Baŋa Wɛ wó pa se o di paare, ne o kwo nakwe David déem na di paare faŋa faŋa tei to.

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: O maa wó taa ye Jakobdwi tiina bam pɛ, se ko taa vei wuu. O paare dem daa bá ti maŋa de maŋa.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Mary ma bwei maleka kam o we, “Konto wó ke tɛ mo ko ke, ye amo ta wo zo baro?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma leiri ka we, “Ko na wó taa ye tei to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom wó ba nmo tei, pa se Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tete dam-fɔrɔ kom ba ko kwoli‑m. Konto ŋwaane, wolo wom nmo na wó lo to wó taa ye Wɛ tete nyem, ye ba taa bwoi‑o we Wɛ Bu wom.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Maane n nii nmo choro Elizabet na ye tei. Wonto jaane puga mo se o lo bu, ye o bena gaale. Nɔɔna de ya pɛ se o ye kadega mo, ye o laam jege puga nenɛɛne chane seredo.

english_verse: Nothing is impossible for God!”
translation_verse: Kolokolo tera Wɛ na bá wane o ke.”

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Mary ma ta o we, “Amo ye dé Teiru Wɛ nabwom mo. N ni ye Wɛ mo. Wɛ wó pa se ko ke.” Maleka kam laam ma viiri. Mary de Elizabet taane

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Da yam konto ni ne Mary ma zaŋe o ke lela o maa diini Judea teo kodwoŋi na wo peero jei ne.

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: O ma vo o yi Zekaria sɔŋɔ. O ma zo o na Elizabet. O ma ke o peiga.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Elizabet na nigi Mary na jɔɔne‑o to, o bu wom maa tigi o wone o jaŋa. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ba o tei,

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: ye o ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa o we, “Wɛ tiini o swɛ nmo swolim se ko dwoni kaana maama. Ko ná ye bu wolo na wo n wone to, Wɛ swɛ wonto de swolim dedɛ.

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Nmo ye amo Teiru nu wom ye a muri se n ba amo tei.

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: N jɔɔnem dem na tu de to amo zwɛ ne to, bu wom na wo a wone to tigi o jaŋa mo, o na di ywoni to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Nmo na sɛ we Baŋa Wɛ jege chega to, nmo ye yu-ywoŋo tu. Kolo maama Wɛ na tage o bere‑m to wó seene ko ji chega.” Mary leeni o seini Wɛ

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Mary laam ma ta o we: “Amo wó tei Baŋa Wɛ de a bochare maama.

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: Wonto na ye amo Vereno to pae se a na ywoni de a wo maama,

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane amo ye Wɛ nabwom mo, ye o nii amo baŋa ne. Ko zege zem ko taa via, nɔɔna maama wó pa a taa ye yu-ywoŋo tu,

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ na ke wo-kamunnu o pa-ne to ŋwaane. Wonto maa ye wo-pwoŋo tu chekke.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Balo maama na kɔre‑o to, o yeini o jege ba ŋwaŋa lanyerane taa wuu.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: O jwoŋi balo na ye pwa to paare, ye o pa se balo na ye nabwona to zaŋe de zula.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: O maa pae balo kana na jege-ba to wo-laaro dedɛ, ye o daare o pa naduna viiri de je-yaara.

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Mary déem ma maŋe Elizabet tei ne nenɛɛne chane setɔ, ye o laam jwoori sɔŋɔ. Jɔn lora kam na ke tei to

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: O teo kom tiina de o chorro de ma lɔre kolo na ke‑o, de Baŋa Wɛ na tiini o duri o ŋwaŋa tei to. Ba maama ma tɔge ba di ywoni dedɛ.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Bu wom na yi da nana to, ba ma pa se ba gwoni o peini. Nɔɔna bam ma la daane se ba pa bu wom yere. Ba maa lage se ba pa o yere we Zekaria, ne o kwo wom yere na ye tei to.

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Bɛ ŋwaane mo ye n ta konto? Nɔɔno maŋe o tera á sɔŋɔ ne o yere na ye Jɔn.”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Ba ma daare ba ma ba jea ba maŋe ba bere o kwo wom, se ba nii o na lage se ba pa bu wom yere tei to.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Foone déem ma ja ba teo kom nɔɔna bam maama. Balo maama déem na zoore Judea zwonnu laŋa kam ne to de déem ma ni wonnu telo na ke to, ye ba jege te taane ba ŋɔɔna.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Ba maa jege kolo ba na nigi to ba bochara ne, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Bu wonto nam lage o ji wɔ mo?” Baŋa Wɛ dam dem maa wo bu wom tei ne pa se ko kagele-ba konto. Zekaria na bere Wɛ kwora kam tei to

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Bu wom kwo Zekaria déem ma na dam Wɛ Sin-laao kom tei ne, pa se o pworisi o we:

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: O ma pa se wolo na ye o tontoŋeno David dwi tu to zaŋe dé wone, se o ba o ji debam Vereno.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: Faŋa to Wɛ pɛ se o sampwori ba ba tɔɔle o kwora,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: ye ba we Wɛ wó vere debam dé dona jeŋa ne, de balo maama na chuli debam to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: O daa ta jege o ni-gwonim delo o na ke de dé nabaara se o duri ba ŋwaŋa to.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Amo bu, ko ná ye nmo, ba wó taa jege nmo ba bwoi we, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, kolo ŋwaane nmo wó da dé Teiru wom yiga, se n fɔge n kwɛ o chwoŋa kam o na lage o ba o tɔge da to.

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Nmo ta wó pa se Wɛ nɔɔna bam lɔre we o wó jwoŋi-ba, o na wó yage ba wɛleera yam o ma chɛ-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: Wɛ maa jege debam ŋwaŋa lanyerane. O maa wó pa se pwooni nwoŋi telaao ne de ba debam tei, ne wea na puli ka nye te-pora ni ne tei to.

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: O pwooni dem konto wó taa nye de pa balo ya na zoore lim wone to, de balo na kɔre foone de toone to. O maa wó pa se dé nɛ sem taa tɔge chwoŋa kalo na jege bochare-zuru to.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Zekaria bu Jɔn déem ma ke nɔɔno, ye o bochare be lanyerane. O déem maa zoore kagoa yuu ne taa, se ko taa vei dɛ dem o na wó nwoŋi Isarele tiina bam tetare ne jaja to.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne logo kom Pa-faro wolo yere na ye Agusita to déem ma pa ni se ba ga o teo kom maama nɔn-bia bam se o lɔre ba ni.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem maa zoore Jerusalem teo kom wone, o yere mo Simeon. O ye nɔn-ŋom mo, ye o kɔre Wɛ lanyerane. O maa yɔɔre o pɔe dɛ dem Wɛ na wó ba o jwoŋi Isarele dwi tiina bam o yage to. Wɛ Sin-laao kom maa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Konto maa ye boboa garem dem, ye ko ke maŋa kalo Kwirinusi de déem na ye Siria teo kom yuu tu to.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Garem dem na lage de bobo konto to, nɔɔno maama ma vo o tete teo se ba ga‑o.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Josɛf de déem ma zaŋe o nwoŋi Nazarete kolo na ye Galili teo to. O ma vo Judea teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Bɛtelehem, ba na loge faŋa faŋa Pɛ David mɛ to. O déem vei dáane, o na ye David dwi tu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Mary wolo ba na sɛ se o taa ye Josɛf kaane to de ma tɔge ded‑o o vo se ba ga-ba. O déem jege puga mo.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: O ma lo bakeira. Mo o boboa bu. O ma kwei bu wom o kukuli de gwaaro o tiŋi vara wodiu tiŋim jeiga ne, pwola na wo daare veira diga kam wone to ŋwaane. Nayera nigi Yezu lora kam taane

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto tete ne nayera déem mo wora jei sem konto ne, ba na wo gaao ne ba yere ba vara.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma nwoŋi ba yia ne, ye Wɛ zeiŋi o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom pwooni ba baŋa ne pa se de nyeene de gilimi-ba. Foone ma tiini de zo-ba dedɛ.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Maleka kam laam ma ta de-ba ka we, “Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone. Ko ye kwor-ywoŋa mo a tu se a ta a bere abam, ye ka lage ka pa Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama di ywoni dedɛ.

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Zem dɛ dem ne mo ba loge abam Vereno David teo Bɛtelehem ne. Wonto mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom. O maa ye dé Teiru.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Á ná vei á nii, á wó na bu-seseŋa ba na kukuli ba tiŋi vara wodiu tiŋim jei ne. Mo kolo na wó bere abam we, ko ye chega mo a tɛa.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Maleka kam na tage konto o ti to, Wɛ telaao malese kɔgɔ dedɛ ma pɔpɔ se nwoŋi se woli de-ka. Se maama maa leena se seini Wɛ se we:

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de tia wɛyuu ne. Ko daare tega baŋa ne, balo kikia na su o yi to wó taa zoore de bochare-zuru.”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Malese sem laam ma jwoori telaao. Se na kɛ to, nayera bam maa tɛ daane ba we, “Pa-na se dé vo Bɛtelehem de nii kolo na ke da ye Wɛ pa se de lɔre to.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋe lela ba kɛ teo kom wo. Ba ma vo ba na Mary dedaane Josɛf. Ba ma na bu wom na tigi vara wodiu tiŋim jeiga ne.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ‑o konto to, ba ma ta maleka kam na maŋe o ta bu wom taane tei to.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Mary de na nigi wonnu telo na ke to, o maa tiini o jege te boboŋa o bochare ne.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Nayera bam ma jwoori ba viiri, ye ba leeni ba seini Wɛ de kolo ba na nɛ ye ba ta kwori ba ni to. Ko déem seene ko ke nenɛɛne maleka kam ya na wuuri o ta o bere-ba tei to.

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Bu wom na yi nenɛɛne da nana to, ba ma pa se ba gwoni o peini. Ba ma pa o yere we Yezu. Mo yere delo maleka kam na maŋe ka pa‑o ye ba ta wo jaane o puga to. Ba ke Yezu Wɛ jeŋa ne

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Maŋa kam laam ma yi se Mary zare o digiru se o kwɛ o tete de Wɛ, se ko tɔge Wɛ nia yalo o na ke Moses jeŋa ne na bere tei to. Josɛf de Mary ma zaŋe ba ja bu wom ba vo Jerusalem, se ba vo ba zo Wɛ diga kam ba ke‑o Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ne.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: Ba ta ma vo se ba kaane Wɛ, ne o ni dem na bere tei to. O ni dem we, ba jege se ba kwei kunkwona balei naa kunkwon-puura balei ba ma kaane‑o.

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Ko déem ya pɛ se o lɔre we, o wó na Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom mo, ye o laam te.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem ma pa se Simeon zaŋe o vo o zo Wɛ diga kam. O na wora konto to, Yezu kwo de o nu ma ja‑o ba vo ba zo se ba ke kolo Wɛ ni dem na bere se ba ke o ŋwaane to.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen what you have done to save your people,
translation_verse: Amo yi nɛ wolo nmo na wó tɔge o ŋwaane n jwoŋi n nɔɔna n yage to.

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: Ko wó pa se dwi maama tiina lɔre nmo chega kam jaja, ne wea pwooni na nye ba baŋa ne tei to. Ko ta wó pa se nmo tete nɔɔna Isarele dwi tiina bam na zula.”

english_verse: and you, Mary, will suffer as though you had been stabbed by a dagger. But all this will show what people are really thinking.” Anna Speaks about the Child Jesus
translation_verse: Mo kokuri nɔɔna dedɛ boboŋa ya na seigi to wó ba ya lɔre jaja. Nmo tete tei ne, ko wó pa se n bochɔŋɔ chɛ ko di, ne se-zɔɔ na zo n wo tei to.”

english_verse: years old. Night and day she served God in the temple by praying and often going without eating.
translation_verse: ). O maa zoore Wɛ diga kam jei sem wone maŋa maama. Wea de tete maama o maa zuli Wɛ de ni-vɔɔm de wɛ-lworo.

english_verse: At this time Anna came in and praised God. She spoke about the child Jesus to everyone who hoped for Jerusalem to be set free. The Return to Nazareth
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo o vei o yi bu wom na wo mɛ to. O ma ke Wɛ lei, ye o wora o tɛ bu wom taane o bere balo maama na wora ye ba pɔe maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó ba o jwoŋi Isarele dwi tiina bam o yage to.

english_verse: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.
translation_verse: Yezu kwo de o nu déem ma ke kolo maama Baŋa Wɛ nia yam na bere se ba ke to. Ba na ti to, ba ma jwoori ba vo Galili teo Nazarete mɛ na ye ba tete teo to.

english_verse: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.
translation_verse: Yezu déem na yi bena fuga-yalei to, ba daa ma vo kuri dem nenɛɛne ba na yeini ba vei ba di tei to.

english_verse: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.
translation_verse: Ba na di kuri dem ba ti to, ba ma zaŋe ba maa jwoori sɔŋɔ. Yezu ma maŋe Jerusalem ne, ye o kwo de o nu yeiri ko ni ne.

english_verse: When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.
translation_verse: Ba maa wo nɛ‑o. Ba ma jwoori ba vo Jerusalem teo wo se ba beeri‑o.

english_verse: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.
translation_verse: Balo maama na jei ba cheigi o taane dem to maa ye yaau de o na jege yi-poro de taane dem leirim tei to.

english_verse: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, “Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you!”
translation_verse: Yezu kwo de o nu na nɛ‑o konto to, ko ma pa ba yera sɔɔre. O nu wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “A bu, bɛ mo ye n ke konto dedaane debam? Ta‑n nii amo de nmo kwo na tiini de beeri nmo taa, ye lwia jege debam.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Why did you have to look for me? Didn't you know that I would be in my Father's house?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ye abam kare á beeri amo jei? Amo jege se a ta wo a Kwo sɔŋɔ ne mo. Abam yeiri konto na?”

english_verse: But they did not understand what he meant.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ba maa wo nigi o taane dem kuri.

english_verse: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma tɔge de-ba o jwoori Nazarete, ye o sɛ ba ni. O nu wom maa jege wonnu tem konto maama o bochare ne.

english_verse: Jesus became wise, and he grew strong. God was pleased with him and so were the people.
translation_verse: Yezu yera de o bochare déem ma be lanyerane, ye o jege boboŋ-dɛɛra. Wɛ de nabiina maa tiini ba lage o ni taane.

english_verse: When tax collectors came to be baptized, they asked John, “Teacher, what should we do?”

translation_verse: Herodi ma zaŋe o ja Jɔn o ke peena diga ne. Konto to, o daa ta ke wo-balɔrɔ mo o woli da.

english_verse: Jesus closed the book, then handed it back to the man in charge and sat down. Everyone in the synagogue looked straight at Jesus.
translation_verse: Yezu na gage o ti to, o laam ma pu tɔnɔ kom ye o kwei o pa ba diga kam tontoŋeno. O ma jeini tega ne se o bere-ba. Nɔɔna bam maama maa nii o yia ne se ba cheigi.

english_verse: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, “Isn't he Joseph's son?”
translation_verse: Ba maama maa zuli‑o ye ba we, “O taane dem lamma.” O kwora kam na ywomma to, ko ke-ba yaau. Ba daa ta maa we, “Ko dae Josɛf bu mo tento na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: You will certainly want to tell me this saying, “Doctor, first make yourself well.” You will tell me to do the same things here in my own hometown that you heard I did in Capernaum.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo nam yei we abam wó ta sinseira de amo nenɛɛne, ‘Nmo wolo na yɔɔre nɔɔna to, se n yɔɔre n tete!’ Abam daa ta wó ta we, ‘Dé lɔre wonnu telo nmo na ke Kaparenia ne to. Konto ŋwaane daa‑n ke konto dwoŋi n tete teo wone ywoba seeni.’ ”

english_verse: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.
translation_verse: O ta ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nɔɔno ná ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, o tete teo kom tiina yeini ba ba nege‑o.

english_verse: Once during the time of Elijah there was no rain for three and a half years, and people everywhere were starving. There were many widows in Israel,

english_verse: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away. A Man with an Evil Spirit (Mark
translation_verse: Ba ma ware. Yezu ma pipiri o vo o tɔge ba tetare o nwoŋi o maa kɛa. Yezu yɔɔre nɔɔna dedɛ Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo Galili teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Kaparenia. Juu tiina siu dɛ ma yi. O ma vo o zo ba jeerim diga kam se o bere nɔɔna bam da.

english_verse: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.
translation_verse: Ba maa tiini ba ye yaau de o berem dem, o ni taane na jege dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem maa wo ba jeerim diga kam wone ye chichira daane‑o.

english_verse: Jesus ordered the evil spirit to be quiet and come out. The demon threw the man to the ground in front of everyone and left without harming him.
translation_verse: Yezu ma bwɛ chichira kam o we, “Cheigi sɔɔ, se n yage o yera se n viiri.” Setaane dem na nigi konto to, de ma yigi nɔɔno wom de de tega ne. De laam ma yage‑o ye de wo ke‑o kolokolo. Konto ma ke nɔɔna bam maama yia ne mo.

english_verse: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, “What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people!”
translation_verse: Ko ma so-ba lanyerane. Ba maama maa ŋɔɔne daane ba we, “Bɛ mo ye o wane o ta tento? Nii o na mae o dam o tɛ de chichiri sem pa se se sɛ o ni ye se viiri.”

english_verse: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Many People (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore jei sem konto ne to laam ma ni Yezu ŋwa.

translation_verse: Yezu déem ma nwoŋi jeerim diga kam wone. O ma vo Simon ba sɔŋɔ. O na yi da to, de paa mage Simon tenkaane lanyerane. Ba ma lwoori Yezu se o zeini kaane wom o jaweo kom baŋa ne.

english_verse: So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.

english_verse: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.
translation_verse: Tega na poore tetete to Yezu daa ma nwoŋi o vo jei selo nɔɔn-nɔɔno na tera to. Teo kom nɔɔna bam ma zaŋe ba nwoŋi se ba beeri o jei. Ba laam ma na‑o ye ba vo o tei. Ba ma kwaane se ba che o chwoŋa se o yé viiri o yage-ba.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.”
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo nam jege se a vo a tole teene dedem mo a tɔɔle Wɛ paare dem kwor-ywoŋa kam. Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ toŋe-ne nabiina tei ne.”

english_verse: But Jesus would often go to some place where he could be alone and pray. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Walk (Matthew
translation_verse: O déem ná lage o ware Wɛ, o yeini o beeri mɛ seeni nɔɔna na tera to mo se o ware Wɛ.

english_verse: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, “My friend, your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre we ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o. O ma ta o we, “A badwoŋi, nmo wɛleera yam saare.”

english_verse: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.
translation_verse: Nabworo dedoa maa ye Simon nyem mo. Yezu ma zo ko wone. O ma ta dedaane Simon o we, “Chwo bworo kom n ja n vo yiga fenfee n pa-ne.” Ko na seene ko ke to, o laam maa jei nabworo kom wone o tɛ Wɛ taane o bere nɔn-kɔgɔ kom.

english_verse: “Master,” Simon answered, “we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, debam maŋe dé de chworu tem taa dé ga. Tega poore ye dé wo nɛ kolokolo. Dé nam bugi dedɛ. Nmo nam na tage we dé daa jwoori dé ke to, amo wó pa ba de chworu tem se dé nii.”

translation_verse: Ba ma yeese ba jea ba bwoŋi ba dwonna bam se ba ba ba woli-ba. Banto de ma kwei nabworo kokom kom ba ja vo ba woli-ba. Bworru tem telei maama ma su de ywona. Te ma ga fenfee se te misi na bam wone.

translation_verse: Ba ma jwoori ba ja nabwooru tem ba nwoŋi ba tiŋi buburu kom ni ne. Ba na ke konto ba ti to, ba yage ba wonnu maama ye ba laam daare ba tɔge Yezu. Yezu daa ta yɔɔre nɔɔna Matiyu

translation_verse: Ko ya maa ware, kɔgɔ kom na daga to ŋwaane. Ba wo nɛ chwoŋa se ba zo. Ba ma ja gɔrɔ kom ba di nayuu. Ba laam ma puri bɔɔne ye ba daare ba pa gungwolo kom tɔge da ko tu diga kam wo. Ko ma pa se gɔrɔ kom zo ko tigi nɔɔna bam tetare ne Yezu yiga ne konto.

english_verse: Is it easier for me to tell this man that his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and walk?
translation_verse: Yage-na se a bwei abam a nii kɔ mo ye mɔle, amo ná tage nɔɔno wonto we, o wɛleera yam saare, naa a ná tage‑o a we, o zaŋe o taa via?

translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama na nɛ kolo na ke to, ko ma ke-ba yaau. Foone ma ja-ba. Ba ma daare ba tei Wɛ, ye ba we, “Dé zem nɛ wo-kenkagele lanyerane!” Yezu bwoŋi Levi se o ta tɔge‑o Matiyu

translation_verse: Yezu daa ma maŋe memaŋa kadwoŋi o bere-ba o we, “Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ o kwei gare-doŋo o kaare se o ma feiri gare-dwoŋo. O nam ná ke konto, o wó kaare gare-doŋo kom o chɔge mo, ye ko bá wane ko maŋe de gare-dwoŋo kom.

translation_verse: Farisi tiina de tɔge ba wora. Ba ma bwei we, bɛ mo ye banto ke totoŋe delo na chɔge dé siu dɛ chullu tem to?

translation_verse: se á ta‑á jege wopwolo lanyerane dɛ dem konto ne. Ta‑á yei-na we ba nabaara de déem ke faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem konto mo. Á faŋe á ta‑á yei ko ni ne, se á wó na nyɔɔre dedɛ Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Everyone was trying to touch Jesus, because power was going out from him and healing them all. Blessings and Troubles (Matthew

translation_verse: de Matiyu, de Tomas. Jemsi wolo na ye Alafayu bu to, de Simon wolo ba na bwoi‑o we Zɛlota tigisim nyem to,

english_verse: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!
translation_verse: Abam balo na jege wodi-fɔrɔ á di leile to, lɛɛro yi abam, á na wó ba á yaare de kana to ŋwaane. Abam balo na di ywoni leile to, lɛɛro yi abam, á na wó ba á keeri ye á yi-na lu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
translation_verse: Ba déem tu Yezu tei se ba cheigi o taane dem, se ba daare ba na yazura de ba jaweero tem. Nɔɔna badaara wora chichiri na jege-ba se daana. Ko ma gare banto de yera ne.

english_verse: God will bless you hungry people. You will have plenty to eat! God will bless you people who are now crying. You will laugh!
translation_verse: Kana na jege abam balo leile to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, Wɛ na wó pa á bochara peini de á fera yam to ŋwaane. Abam balo yiga na nyɔne leile to mo jege yu-ywoŋo, Wɛ na wó pa á ba á di ywoni to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.

translation_verse: Zenzamso bá wane o dwoni wolo na bere‑o to. Ko daare zenzamso ná zamese o ti maama, o de wolo na bere‑o to wae ba ye bedwe.

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye? You show-offs! First, get the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye. A Tree and Its Fruit (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná wo maane we o jege da-lɔŋɔ o yi ne, kotu wó taa jege chwoŋa se o ta de o dwoŋi we, ‘A badwoŋi, pa se a le weo n yi ne’ na? english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.

english_verse: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, ‘Go!’ and he goes. I can say to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes. I can say to my servant, ‘Do this!’ and he will do it.”
translation_verse: Amo de ye nɔɔno wolo nɔɔna badwonna na jege dam amo baŋa ne to, ye amo de daa ta jege dam badaara baŋa ne. A ná tage we nɔɔno wolo véi, o jege se o vo mo. A nam daa ná we nɔɔno wolo ba, o de wó ba mo. Ko ta ná ye a tontoŋeno, a ná we o ke woŋo, o jege se o ke mo.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi konto to, ko ma so‑o. O ma pipiri o nii kɔgɔ kolo na tɔge‑o to, ye o ta o we, “A tɛ abam, amo wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno o na jege wo-dedoa de amo se ko yi wonto na jege wo-dedoa tei to, ko ná maŋe ko ye Isarele dwi tiina bam wone de.”

english_verse: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.
translation_verse: O na yi teo kom ni to, o ma jeeri nɔɔna na zeŋe too de gandwa ba maa nwoŋa. Too wom nu ye kadeim mo. Mo o bu-doa. Teo kom kɔgɔ kamunu de maa tɔge too wom kwaga.

translation_verse: O na tage konto to, too wom ma seene o zaŋe ye o bobo ŋɔŋa. Yezu ma jwoŋi‑o o pa o nu wom.
