english_verse: There is nothing hidden that will not be found. There is no secret that will not be well known.
translation_verse: Wɛ chega kalo maama zem na seigi nɔɔna tei ne to wó ba ka lɔre ja mo. Kolo maama zem na pugi to wó puri mo, se nɔɔna lɔre ko kuri na ye tei.

english_verse: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.
translation_verse: Ba na maa kɛ to, Yezu ma to dɔɔm ne. Vo-fɔrɔ ma pɔpɔ ko zaŋe ko ba buga kam baŋa ko mage bworo kom pa se ko wora ko liri na se ko tu na bam kuri. Ba déem maa wo cham wone.

english_verse: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message,
translation_verse: Memaŋe dem kuri mo tento: Men-dwa yam bere Wɛ taane dem na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: Those seeds that fell on good ground are the people who listen to the message and keep it in good and honest hearts. They last and produce a harvest. Light (Mark
translation_verse: Men-dwa yalo nam na to te-ŋoŋa jei sem ne to bere balo na ni Wɛ taane dem, ye ba jwoŋi-de lanyerane ba ke ba bochara ne to. Banto mo jege boboŋ-laaro ye ba vɔ ba wo de Wɛ chega kam tɔgem. Wɛ taane dem ma ja kuri de pa-ba, ne mena yalo na ke bia dedɛ to.” Kanea memaŋe Maake

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the disciples, “Don't you have any faith?” But they were frightened and amazed. They said to each other, “Who is this? He can give orders to the wind and the waves, and they obey him!” A Man with Demons in Him (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma bwei o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Bɛ mo ye á ba jege wo-dedoa de amo?” Foone ma ja-ba, ye ko ke-ba yaau. Ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Wonto nam ye wɔ mo? O bage vio kom de na bam ye te sɛ o ni.” Yezu zeili setaana nɔɔno tei ne Matiyu

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma ta o we, “Nɔɔno ná jege kanea, o bá sɛ se o tɔre-ka o pu zoŋa wone, naa o zege-ka gadwogo kuri ne. O nam wó kwei-ka o pale wɛɛne mo, se ka taa jege pwooni ka pae balo na lage ba zo diga kam wo to.

english_verse: But Jesus answered, “Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Ko ye nɔɔno mo dwei-ne. Amo yei we a dam nwoŋi a yera ne.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, “Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi konto to, o ma ta de Jarusi o we, “Yé ta‑n fona. Ke n wo-dedoa de amo, se ko wó gare bu wom yera ne.”

english_verse: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.
translation_verse: Setaana yam ma tiini ya lwoori Yezu se o yé zeili-ya pa ya zo tega kuri gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom wone.

english_verse: The people went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they also found the man. The demons had gone out of him, and he was sitting there at the feet of Jesus. He had clothes on and was in his right mind. But the people were terrified.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma nwoŋi ba vo se ba nii ko na ke tei. Ba ma vo ba yi Yezu tei. Ba ma na nɔɔno wolo setaana yam na yage‑o to. O maa jei Yezu tei ne dedaane o boboŋa jwoori ya ba, ye o zo gwaaro. Ba na nɛ‑o konto to, foone ma zo-ba.

english_verse: Jesus' mother and brothers went to see him, but because of the crowd they could not get near him.
translation_verse: Yezu nu de o nyaana ma ba o tei se ba na‑o. Ba ma ware ba yi o tei, kɔgɔ kom na daga to ŋwaane.

english_verse: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.
translation_verse: Yezu ma nwoŋi nabworo kom wone. Teo kom nɔɔno dedoa ma ba o jeeri‑o. Setaana mo jege nɔɔno wom konto ya daana ko zege faŋa faŋa. O maa wo zo kolokolo, ye o ba zoore sɔŋɔ ne. O yeini o tigi yibeela jei ne mo.

english_verse: Just then the man in charge of the synagogue came and knelt down in front of Jesus. His name was Jairus, and he begged Jesus to come to his home
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi maa tɔge o wora, o yere mo Jarusi. O maa ye Juu tiina jeerim diga kam yiga tu. O ma vo Yezu tei o tiiri tega ne o yiga ne o lwoori‑o o we, “Popo, ba debam sɔŋɔ.”

english_verse: One day, Jesus and his disciples got into a boat, and he said, “Let's cross the lake.” They started out,
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam ma zo nabworo. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Pa se dé bɛ buga kam ni dedwoŋi dem.” Ba ma bobo se ba yɛ ba kɛ.

english_verse: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, “Master, Master! We are about to drown!” Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba dwei Yezu pa o zaŋe, ye ba we, “Dé Tu, nii, dé lage de nyɔ na dé te.” O laam ma zaŋe wɛɛne ye o daare o bage vio kom de na bam we, te yage! Vio kom laam ma yage, ye na bam de maŋe da chemm.

english_verse: The man saw Jesus and screamed. He knelt down in front of him and shouted, “Jesus, Son of God Most High, what do you want with me? I beg you not to torture me!”
translation_verse: O na nɛ Yezu to, o ma bobo se o chwoosi wɛ-wɛ. O ma vo o to Yezu yiga ne, ye o kaase de kwor-dɛa o we, “Yezu, Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ Bu, nmo tu amo tei se n ke bɛ mo? Popo, yé waare-ne.”

english_verse: When the men taking care of the pigs saw this, they ran to spread the news in the town and on the farms.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo ya na yere tera yam to ma na ko na ke tei to. Ba ma duri ba vo ba ta kolo na ke to ba bere teo kom nɔɔna bam de balo na toŋe ba kare ne to.

english_verse: He said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to go out of him. The man had often been attacked by the demon. And even though he had been bound with chains and leg irons and kept under guard, he smashed whatever bound him. Then the demon would force him out into lonely places.
translation_verse: O tage konto kolo ŋwaane Yezu maŋe o pa chichira kam ni se ka yage nɔɔno wom yera. Kuni dedɛ chichira kam déem yeini ka ja‑o. Konto mo pɛ se ba yeini ba kwei chaponno ba ma vɔ o jea de o nɛ, se ba taa yere‑o. Ba ná yeini ba ke‑o konto, o yeini o kɔ-te mo. Setaane dem laam wó zeili‑o pa se o duri o vo kagoa wo.

english_verse: Jesus asked the man, “What is your name?” He answered, “My name is Lots.” He said this because there were “lots” of demons in him.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma bwei‑o o we, “N yere mo bɛ?” O ma leiri o we, “A yere mo Akɔgɔ”, kolo ŋwaane setaana dedɛ mo tɔge‑o.

english_verse: A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and Jesus let them go.
translation_verse: Teira kɔgɔ dedɛ déem maa wora jei sem ne ya beeri ya wodiu peo teiŋa ne ya di. Setaana yam ma lwoori Yezu se o pa-ya chwoŋa se ya zo teira yam wone ya taa tɔge-ya. O ma sɛ.

english_verse: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Setaana yam laam ma yage nɔɔno wom yera ye ya vo ya tɔge teira yam. Teira yam maama ma duri ya siseiri ya tu buga kam wo ya nyɔ na ya te.

english_verse: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back,
translation_verse: Gerasa tiina teo kom de ko nawuura yam maama nɔn-bia bam ma lwoori Yezu se o viiri, kolo ŋwaane foone tiini de jege-ba. Yezu laam ma jwoori o vo o zo nabworo kom se o kɛ.

english_verse: the man who had been healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him off and said,
translation_verse: O na maa viiri to, nɔɔno wolo setaana yam na yage‑o to ma lwoori‑o se o pa o da o vo. Yezu maa wo sɛ.

english_verse: “Go back home and tell everyone how much God has done for you.” The man then went all over town, telling everything that Jesus had done for him. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Jwoori n vo sɔŋɔ se n ta kolo Wɛ na ke o pa nmo to n bere-ba.” Nɔɔno wom ma kɛ o vo o tole teo kom maama o ta kolo Yezu na ke o pa‑o to. Yezu yɔɔre nɔɔna badwonna Matiyu

english_verse: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.
translation_verse: Kaane wodwoŋi maa tɔge o wora, o na tiini o wɔe wo mo taa, bena fuga-yalei. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno maa ware o yɔɔre‑o.

english_verse: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma jwoori o bɛ buga kam ni dedwoŋi dem. O na nwoŋi nabworo kom wone to, dedaane kɔgɔ dedɛ mo maŋe ko gilimi daane ko pɔ‑o. Ba na nɛ‑o to mo ba jeeri‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: because his twelve-year-old child was dying. She was his only daughter. While Jesus was on his way, people were crowding all around him.
translation_verse: O tage konto kolo ŋwaane o jege bu dedoa yerane mo ye o lage o te. Bu wom ye busankana mo, nenɛɛne bena fuga-yalei tei. Yezu ma sɛ se o vo. O na maa kɛ to, kɔgɔ kom tiini ko peene‑o.

english_verse: As soon as she came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes, her bleeding stopped.
translation_verse: O ma kɛ Yezu kwaga o vo o laare o dwei o gɔrɔ kom ni. O na dwei‑o konto to, jana bam ma kɔ bedwe baŋa ne.

english_verse: The woman knew that she could not hide, so she came trembling and knelt down in front of Jesus. She told everyone why she had touched him and that she had been healed at once.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma lɔre we o bá lu. Foone maa jege‑o ye o yera sae. O ma vo Yezu tei o tiiri tega ne o yiga ne. O ma ta ded‑o kolo maama na pɛ se o dwei‑o konto to, de o na nɛ yazura bedwe baŋa ne tei to. Kɔgɔ kom maama ma ni o na tage kolo to.

english_verse: Jesus said to the woman, “You are now well because of your faith. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “A bukɔ, nmo na ke n wo-dedoa de amo tei to mo pɛ se n na yazura. Véi, se Wɛ wó pa‑m yazura.”

english_verse: Jesus went into the house, but he did not let anyone else go with him, except Peter, John, James, and the girl's father and mother.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi sɔŋɔ kom. Yezu ma zo. O maa wo sɛ se nɔɔna da‑o ba zo, ko ná dae Piita, de Jɔn, de Jemsi, de bu wom kwo, de o nu yerane.

english_verse: Everyone was crying and weeping for the girl. But Jesus said, “The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.”
translation_verse: Balo maama na maŋe ba wo sɔŋɔ kom wone to maa chwoosa, ye ba keera busankana kam ŋwaane. Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Á yé ta‑á keera. O wo tege, o dɔ mo.”

english_verse: The people laughed at him because they knew she was dead.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ba maama ma mɔne‑o, kolo ŋwaane ba yei we bu wom seene o te.

english_verse: Jesus took hold of the girl's hand and said, “Child, get up!”
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma vo o ja busankana kam jeŋa, ye o ta de-ka o we, “A bu, zaŋe wɛɛne.”

english_verse: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o ŋwea ma jwoori. O ma zaŋe wɛɛne bedwe baŋa ne. Yezu ma ta-ba se ba ke wodiu ba pa bu wom se o di.

english_verse: Her parents were surprised, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
translation_verse: Ko ma so bu wom kwo de o nu lanyerane. Yezu ma kaane-ba o we, ba yé zaŋe ba ta ba bere nɔɔn-nɔɔno woŋo kolo na ke to.

english_verse: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam déem ma jwoori ba vo o tei. Ba ma ta ba bere‑o ba na ke kolo maama to. O ma pa ba tɔge ded‑o ba vo jeiga kadwoŋi ba yerane, ye ba daare nɔn-kɔgɔ kom. Jeiga kam bwola de teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Bɛtasida.

english_verse: They did this, and all the people sat down.
translation_verse: Ba ma ke konto. Nɔɔna bam maama ma jeini tega ne.

english_verse: Herod the ruler heard about all that was happening, and he was worried. Some people were saying John the Baptist had come back to life.
translation_verse: Galili kateiri dem pɛ Herodi déem nigi kolo maama Yezu de o nɔɔna bam na wora ba ke to. Ko ma pa se o boboŋa vugimi, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna badaara tɛ ba we Jɔn mo jwoori o bi toone wone.

english_verse: He told them, “Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.
translation_verse: O ma ta-ba o we, “Á ná maa via, á yé zaŋe á kwei kolokolo á woli da á ja á vo. Á yé kwei nacheiga, naa tampɔgɔ, naa wodiu, naa sabu. Á yé kwei gwaaro telei telei de á woli da.

english_verse: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.
translation_verse: Á ná vei á zo sɔŋɔ kolo maama á peini da, se á ta‑á zoore dáane se ko ba ko yi á viirim maŋa.

english_verse: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, “Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo wɛ na wora de zoore to, Yezu nɔɔna fuga-balei bam ma ba o tei ba we, “Wodiu tera ywo-seeni se nɔɔna bam yeigi ba di. Konto ŋwaane nam pa se ba vo sam wone ba lage wodiu ba di, de peiga jei ba peini.”

english_verse: While he was praying, his face changed, and his clothes became shining white.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam o na wora o ware Wɛ to, ba ma na we o yibia leiri. O gwaaro tem de maa peere cha, ye te nyeena.

english_verse: Jesus strictly warned his disciples not to tell anyone about this. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma tiini o kaane-ba se ba yé ta konto ba bere nɔɔn-nɔɔno.

english_verse: “Pay close attention to what I am telling you! The Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies.”
translation_verse: “Cheigi-na taane delo a na tɛ de abam to, se de ye abam nyem mo. Leile konto ba lage ba ja Nabiin-bu wom ba ke‑o nɔɔna jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: But a lot of people found out about this and followed him. Jesus welcomed them. He spoke about God's kingdom and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma lɔre Yezu de o tontoŋena bam na vei mɛ. Ba laam ma tɔge ba kwaga. Ba ma vo ba yi Yezu tei. O ma zaane-ba de wopwolo. O ma ŋɔɔne o bere-ba Wɛ paare dem chega kam, ye o daare o yɔɔre balo maama na lage yazura to.

english_verse: men in the crowd. Jesus said to his disciples, “Tell the people to sit in groups of
translation_verse: ) mo, ko woli de kaana de bia de. Yezu ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, ba pa nɔɔna bam pɔɔre finnu finnu ba jeini tega ne.

english_verse: “Don't stop him!” Jesus said. “Anyone who isn't against you is for you.” A Samaritan Village Refuses To Receive Jesus
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Á ya ba jege se á che‑o. Wolo maama na ba chuli abam to ye abam nɔɔno mo.” Yezu kwei chwoŋa o maa vei Jerusalem

english_verse: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up on a mountain to pray.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, ko maŋe de da nana na kɛ to, o laam ma ja Piita, de Jɔn, de Jemsi o vo o di peo yuu se o ware Wɛ.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam ná lage se o jwoŋi o tete ŋwea, konto tu wó ga-ka mo. Ko daare, wolo maama ná sɛ se o ga o ŋwea amo ŋwaane, konto tu wó jwoŋi ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself or waste your life?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná kwaane o jwoŋi logo baŋa jejegero tem maama, ye o laam ná gɛ ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, ko jege bɛ nyɔɔre mo ko pa‑o?

english_verse: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná kɔre chaveera amo ŋwaane, de a taane dem ŋwaane, chaveera wó taa jege amo Nabiin-bu wom konto tu de ŋwaane dɛ dem a na wó jwoori a ba logo baŋa de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ, ne a Kwo Wɛ de o malese sem na jege tei to.

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.
translation_verse: O na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to mo kunkwoŋo tu ko ba ko li ba maama. Ko na kwoli-ba to, foone ma ja Piita ba lanyerane.

english_verse: From the cloud a voice spoke, “This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne kunkwoŋo kom wone ka we, “Mo amo Bu wom a na kuri to. Á nam ta‑á cheigi o taane lanyerane.”

english_verse: After the voice had spoken, Peter, John, and James saw only Jesus. For some time they kept quiet and did not say anything about what they had seen. Jesus Heals a Boy (Matthew
translation_verse: Kwora kam na ŋɔɔne ka ti to, ba ma daa wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba woli Yezu ne. Da yam konto ni ne, ba ŋɔɔne kolo na ke to ba yerane mo. Ba maa wo tage kolo ba na nɛ to ba bere nɔɔn-nɔɔno. Yezu yɔɔre bu wodwoŋi Matiyu

english_verse: A demon often attacks him and makes him scream. It shakes him until he foams at the mouth, and it won't leave him until it has completely worn the boy out.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama chichira kam yeini ka zi‑o, ye o pɔpɔ o ke sɔɔ mo. Ka maa pae se bu wom yera sae pɔm-pɔm, ye lilei-puŋa nwoŋi o ni ne. Ka maa tiini ka yaare‑o maŋa maama, ye ka ba sɛ se ka yage‑o de fenfee de.

english_verse: Jesus said to them, “You people are stubborn and don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you?” Then Jesus said to the man, “Bring your son to me.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Abam zem nɔɔna bam bere á ba jege wo-dedoa de amo, ye á ba sɛ se á tɔge chwoŋa. Ko fe mo se a tiini a dáane abam tei ne, ye a zuri a bochare de abam na?” O daa ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Ja n bu wom n ba.”

english_verse: While the boy was being brought, the demon attacked him and made him shake all over. Jesus ordered the demon to stop. Then he healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
translation_verse: Bu wom na maa vei o tei konto to, setaane dem daa ta ma zi‑o de de tega ne, ye de pa se o yera sae pɔm-pɔm. Yezu ma bage chichira kam pa se ka yage‑o. O ma yɔɔre bu wom pa o na yazura. O laam ma jwoori o ke‑o o kwo jeŋa ne.

english_verse: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask. Who Is the Greatest? (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba maa wo nigi o taane dem kuri. De ma seigi ba tei ne, pa se ba ware ba jwoŋi-de. Ba ma kɔre se ba bwei‑o ba nii. Wɔ mo ye nɔn-kamunu Wɛ tei ne? Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus' disciples were arguing about which one of them was the greatest.
translation_verse: Ni-kantɔgɔ déem ma ba Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam wo. Ba déem lage ba nii banto wɔ mo wó taa ye nɔn-kamunu o dwoi maama.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he had a child stand there beside him.
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre ba na jege kolo ba boboŋa ne to. O ma ja bu-balaŋa o pa o zege o takeiri ne.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me. Whichever one of you is the most humble is the greatest.” For or against Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Wolo maama ná zuli bu wonto dwoŋi lanyerane amo yere ŋwaane, konto tu zuli amo mo. Wolo maama nam ná zuli amo, kotu zuli Baŋa Wɛ wolo na toŋe-ne to de mo. Wolo nam na muri abam maama wone to mo ye nɔn-kamunu chekke o dwoi maama.”

english_verse: John said, “Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.”
translation_verse: Jɔn ma ta o we, “Dé Tu, dé ya nɛ nɔɔno na tɔge nmo yere ŋwaane mo o zeili setaana nɔɔna tei ne. O nam na dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem to, dé ma kwaane se de che‑o se o daa yé taa ke konto.”

english_verse: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam déem ma ba ka twɛ se Wɛ kwei Yezu o ja di telaao. Yezu boboŋa ma ja se o yɔɔre o kwei chwoŋa o vo Jerusalem.

english_verse: He sent some messengers on ahead to a Samaritan village to get things ready for him.
translation_verse: O ma toŋe nɔɔna se ba da o yiga ba vo. Ba ma vo ba yi Samaria tiina teo kodwoŋi, se ba ti woŋo maama yiga se o laam ba.

english_verse: But he was on his way to Jerusalem, so the people there refused to welcome him.
translation_verse: Teo kom nɔɔna bam maa wo sɛ se ba jeeri‑o, ba na lɔre we o to chwoŋa ne o maa vei Jerusalem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, “Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people?”
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam balei Jemsi de Jɔn na nɛ konto to, ba ma ta ba we, “Dé Teiru, nmo ná sɛ, dé wó pa mini nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba de chɔge-ba.”

english_verse: But Jesus turned and corrected them for what they had said.
translation_verse: Yezu ma pipiri o nii ba seeni, ye o bwɛ-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: Then they all went on to another village. Three People Who Wanted To Be Followers (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba maama daa ma yɔɔre ba vo teo kodwoŋi. Balo na lage se ba tɔge Yezu kwaga na ke tei to Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus said, “Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko ná ye yira, banto jege peiga jei. Zuna de jege pworu ba tigi da. Ko daare Nabiin-bu wom ba jege jei se o peini da o sii.”

english_verse: Jesus told someone else to come with him. But the man said, “Lord, let me wait until I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma ta de nɔɔno wodwoŋi o we, “Zaŋe n ta n tɔge-ne.” Nɔɔno wom ma ta o we, “Amo Teiru, yage se a ná ke a kwo lua, se a laam ba a tɔge nmo kwaga.”

english_verse: Then someone said to Jesus, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi de ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo Teiru, amo wó ba a taa tɔge nmo kwaga. Nam pa-ne chwoŋa se a vo a bane a sɔŋɔ tiina, se a laam jwoori a ba.”

english_verse: followers returned, they were excited and said, “Lord, even the demons obeyed when we spoke in your name!”
translation_verse: ), se o toŋe-ba balei balei se ba da yiga ba vo mɛ maama o na lage o vo to.

english_verse: He said to them: A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers. Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.
translation_verse: O na lage o toŋe-ba konto to, mo o tage de-ba o we, “Ko nye de wodiu faao mo ke lanyerane, ye tontoŋena fenfee yerane mo wora se ba zage. Nam lwoori-na faao totoŋa yam yuu tu wom se o toŋe nɔɔna dedɛ se ba vo ba zage faao kom ba pa‑o.”

english_verse: Don't take along a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals. And don't waste time greeting people on the road.
translation_verse: Á ná maa via, á yé kwei sabia ganlɔgere, naa á kwei tampɔgɔ, naa á ta‑á jege natera á woli da. Yé zege-na chwoŋa ne á daane nɔɔn-nɔɔno peiga.

english_verse: As soon as you enter a home, say, “God bless this home with peace.”
translation_verse: Á nam ná yi sɔŋɔ kolo maama á na lage á zo to, se á ta de sɔŋɔ kom tiina we, ‘Wɛ wó pa abam zaane.’

english_verse: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.
translation_verse: Wɛ zaane nyem ná wora, wonto wó seene o na zaane ne á na tage tei to. Wɛ zaane nyem nam ná tera, abam tete mo wó jwoori á jwoŋi.

english_verse: Stay with the same family, eating and drinking whatever they give you, because workers are worth what they earn. Don't move around from house to house.
translation_verse: Ta‑á zoore-na sɔŋɔ kom konto wone, se ko taa vei maŋa kam á na wó viiri to. Wodiu kolo maama ba ná ke ba pa abam, se á ta‑á di konto. Tontoŋeno maŋe se o taa jwoŋi o ŋweero mo. Á yé zaŋe á vo sɔŋɔ kodwoŋi á ta‑á zoore da.

english_verse: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say,
translation_verse: Ko daare, á ná zo teo kolo maama ye ba ná wo sɛ se ba jeeri abam, se á nwoŋi teo kom pwooni ye á ta-ba we,

english_verse: I tell you that on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than the people of that town! The Unbelieving Towns (Matthew
translation_verse: Amo nam tɛ abam we, Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, Sodom tiina bá tiini ba na lɛɛro se ko maŋe de teo kom konto.

english_verse: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven! Jesus Thanks His Father (Matthew
translation_verse: Á na jege dam dem konto to, á nam yé ta‑á jege wopwolo de chichiri na kɔre abam to ŋwaane. Nam ta‑á jege-na wopwolo dedɛ de á yera na popone Wɛ telaao ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone to.”

english_verse: Many prophets and kings were eager to see what you see and to hear what you hear. But I tell you they did not see or hear.” The Good Samaritan
translation_verse: Lɔre-na we, faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori dedɛ, de pwa dedɛ déem jege teena se ba na kolo maama abam na nae leile to, ye ba wo wane ba na. Ba maa jege teena se ba ni Wɛ taane delo abam na nigi to, ye ba wo wane ba ni-de.” ‘Wɔ mo ye a dwoŋi?’ memaŋe

english_verse: On the day of judgment the people of Tyre and Sidon will get off easier than you will.
translation_verse: Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, Tura de Sidon tiina bá tiini ba na lɛɛro se ko maŋe de abam.

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? Well, you will go down to hell!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam Kaparenia tiina, á ga boŋe we Wɛ lage o zeiŋi abam wɛyuu ne mo na? Aawo. Abam nam wó to á zo tega kuri kuri ne mo.”

english_verse: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.
translation_verse: Nii-na, a pɛ abam dam se á wane basankwe á taa nɔna, de nwanno, se á wane setaana pɛ de o dam maama, ye te kolokolo bá wane te ke abam woŋo.

english_verse: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to have eternal life?”
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam zamesem tu dedoa déem zaŋe Yezu tei ne se o maŋe‑o o nii o swa na ye tei. O ma bwei‑o o we, “Berem tu, amo nam wó ke tɛ mo se a jwoŋi ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to?”

english_verse: The man replied, “The Scriptures say, ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, strength, and mind.’ They also say, ‘Love your neighbors as much as you love yourself.’ ”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma leiri o we, “Ko popone we, ta‑n swoi n Tu Baŋa Wɛ de n bochare maama, de n wo maama, de n dam maama, de n boboŋa maama, se n kwori n ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n tete.”

english_verse: At that same time, Jesus felt the joy that comes from the Holy Spirit, and he said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people. Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem pɛ Yezu di ywoni lanyerane. O laam ma ke o Kwo Baŋa Wɛ lei ye o we, “A Kwo, nmo ye wolo na tei wɛyuu de tega baŋa maama. Nmo nam pɛ se n chega kam seigi swa tiina de yi-pore-nyena tei ne, ye n daare n pa se balo boboŋa ta na wo bege to lɔre ka kuri. A Kwo, a ke nmo lei. Nmo na ke konto to, ko ye n boboŋa na lage kolo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: A Kwo mo kwei wonnu maama o ke a jeŋa ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre Wɛ Bu wom na ye tei, ko ná dae o Kwo yerane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ta bá lɔre a Kwo Wɛ na ye tei, ko ná dae amo wolo na ye o Bu wom to yerane, ko woli de amo na boŋe se a pa nɔɔno wolo maama lɔre o na ye tei to.”

english_verse: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, “You are really blessed to see what you see!
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma pipiri o nii o kwaga tɔgena bam seeni, ye o ŋɔɔne de banto ba yerane o we, “Á jege yu-ywoŋo de á yi na nae wo-kamunnu telo to.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “What is written in the Scriptures? How do you understand them?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Bɛ mo popone Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone? Bɛ mo n yeini n gare da?”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You have given the right answer. If you do this, you will have eternal life.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “N pɔɔre chega. Nam ta‑n ke konto, se n wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom maa lage se o taa jege bora. O ma pipiri o taane dem, ye o bwei Yezu o we, “Amo dwoŋi mo wɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma maŋe memaŋe o ma leiri‑o tento: “Nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo zege Jerusalem teo ne o nwoŋi o maa vei Jeriko. O ma vo o maŋe de venverena. Venverena bam ma zi‑o ba vere o gwaaro de o wonnu maama. Ba ma mage‑o lanyerane pa se o da toone tei o kɛ, ye ba daare ba duri ba viiri.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: O na tigi da konto to, Wɛ kaanem tu dedoa de ya wo chwoŋa kam konto ne o maa via. O na maa vei to, o ma na nɔɔno wom na tigi o yiga ne. O ma lɛɛne o tɔge dáa o kɛ.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Wɛ diga tontoŋeno wolo na ye Levi dwi tu to de maa tɔge da o maa kɛa. O na yi jei sem to, o ma na nɔɔno wom na tiga. O de daa ma lɛɛne o tɔge dáa o kɛ.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Samaria tu wodwoŋi de déem maa wo beira ne. O ma vo o yi nɔɔno wom na tigi mɛ to. O na nɛ‑o to, o ma duri o ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: O ma vo o tei. O ma kwei nuga de sana o ma zare o fufwollu tem, ye o daare o vɔ-te. O laam ma kwei‑o o daŋe o tete bonaga baŋa ne o ja vo nɔɔno wodwoŋi veira diga. Ba na yi da to, o maa jege‑o o nii lanyerane.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Tɔ. Nam ta n bere-ne, nɔɔna batɔ bam wone wɔ mo bere we o ye wolo venverena bam na vere to dwoŋi chekke?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Zamesem tu wom maa we, “Wolo wom na jege o ŋwaŋa to.” Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nam véi n lwoni n ta‑n ke konto dwoŋi.” Marita de Mary taane

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam daa maa wo chwoŋa ne ba via. O ma vo o yi teo kodwoŋi. Kaane wodwoŋi maa wora, o yere mo Marita. O ma jeeri Yezu lanyerane ba sɔŋɔ ne.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Marita nyaane de maa wora, o yere mo Mary. O ma jeini tega ne Yezu tei ne, ye o cheigi o taane dem maama.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Mary na jei konto to, Marita déem tiini o chɛ totoŋa ne mo de boboŋ-fara. O ma vo Yezu tei ye o we, “Amo tu, nii amo na zege a toŋa dedɛ a yerane, ye a nyaane wom chem. Nmo yiga tera na? Ta n bere‑o se o zaŋe o woli-ne.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Marita, n boboŋa dedɛ yam mo jege‑m ya daana.

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: Woŋo kodwoŋi yerane mo daare. Mary mo le kolo na lana to se o ke, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o che-ko.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ, se á wó na kolo á na lage to. Beeri-na kolo á na lage to, se á wó na. Ta ta‑á dɔne-na manchwo-peena yam, se ba wó pore ba pa abam.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Aawo. Abam wo ba lana ye á ta yei se á ta‑á pae á bia wo-laaro telo ba na lage to. Ko daare á Kwo Wɛ na gare abam to, wonto nam bá kwei o Sin-laao kom o pa balo na lwoori‑o to mo na?” Wɔ dam mo Yezu mae o zeili setaana? Matiyu

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Nmo badwoŋi wom maa zege diga kam wone o ta de nmo o we, ‘Yé ta‑n jege-ne n daana, se manchwo-peena yam pe ye amo de a bia maama tigi dé dɔa. Amo bá wane a zaŋe a woli‑m.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná jege bu, ye o ná lwoori‑m se n pa‑o ywoni, nmo wó sɛ n pa‑o basankwea na?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam ná lage á ware Wɛ, se á ta tento dwoŋi: ‘Debam Kwo, nmo yere dem maŋe de tia mo. Nmo paare dem de ma maŋe se de ba de jeini de dam.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: Yage dé wɛleera n ma n chɛ debam, se debam de yeini dé ma chɛ wolo maama na ke o chɔge debam yiga to mo. Yé pa se dé na cham delo na wó maŋe dé boboŋa to.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, wolo maama na lwoori Wɛ se o pa‑o woŋo to wó jwoŋi. Wolo maama na beeri woŋo to wó na-ko. Ba wó pore ba pa wolo maama na dɔne manchwo-peena yam to.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Wonto déem bere Wɛ dam Ninevɛ tiina tei ne se ko taa ye maana ko pa-ba. Amo wolo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to de wó ji maanem zem nɔɔna bam tei ne, ne ko déem na ke Jonah tei to.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Yezu na zege o ŋɔɔne konto to, kaane wodwoŋi na tɔge o wo kɔgɔ kom wone to ma ta baŋa baŋa o we, “Kaane wolo na loge‑m ye n ŋɔge o yele to mo ye yu-ywoŋo tu.”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedoa mo Yezu déem zeili setaane nɔɔno wodwoŋi tei ne. Setaane dem ya pɛ se nɔɔno wom ji memaa mo. De na yage o yera to, o laam maa ŋɔɔna. Ko ma so nɔn-kɔgɔ kom lanyerane.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Ba badaara maa kwaane ba maŋe o dam ba nii, ye ba we o jege se o ke wo-kenkagele delo na wó bere-ba we o seene o nwoŋi Wɛ tei to mo.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre ba boboŋa na ye tei to. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Teo kolo maama paare ná pɔɔre belei pa ba jege daane, ko bá dáane ye ko chɔge. Sɔŋɔ kolo maama ná pɔɔre ko tete wone, ko jege se ko to mo.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Setaana pɛ dam dem ná seene de pɔɔre belei, o paare dem bá dáane ye de chɔge. Abam na tɛ we ko ye Bɛlzabula dam ŋwaane mo a wae a zeili setaana to mo pɛ a ta konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Ko ná seene ko ye amo tɔge Bɛlzabula dam ŋwaane mo a maa zeili setaana, abam nɔɔna bam de nam mae dam dem konto mo ba maa zeili-ya na? Abam tete nɔɔna bam na ke tei to mo bere we chega tera á tei ne.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: Setaana pɛ nam nye de nɔn-babea na jege taŋa de chena o maa nii o sɔŋɔ tei to. O ta ná zege da konto, o jejegero tem bá jei.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: Abam Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam. Á ná zo á jeerim di sem, á lage jei-kamunnu mo se á jeini yiga ne. Á ná vei yaga, á lage se nɔɔna maama taa tui ba zuli abam.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam zamesem tu dedoa laam ma zaŋe o ta de Yezu o we, “Berem tu, nmo na jege wonnu telo n ŋɔɔne to pa se n twe debam de mo.”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: Setaane ná nwoŋi nɔɔno tei ne, o laam wó vo o beeri mɛ seeni na ye te-kora to se o lage jei o sii da. O ma beeri o ga. O laam maa we, ‘A jege se a jwoori a vo a na nwoŋi mɛ to mo a taa wora.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: O ma jwoori o vo nɔɔno wom tei, ye o lɔre we o jei sem fɔge se kwɛ lanyerane.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: O laam ma jwoori o vo o lage o dwonna barepɛ balo na maŋe ba ye puseŋ-nyena ba dwoi o tete to. Ba ma tɔge daane ba vo ba zoore da. Ko maama laam na kweeli tei to ye lɛɛro mo wó taa jege nɔɔno wom konto se ko dwoni o boboa kam na maŋe ka ye tei to.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Se balo na ni Wɛ kwora kam ye ba sɛ o ni to mo jege yu-ywoŋo ko ja gaale.” Balo na ve Wɛ chega kam to wó na bora na? Matiyu

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Farisi tu wom ma na we Yezu wo sane o jea se ko tɔge ba chullu tem chwoŋa. Ko ma so‑o.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: Abam Farisi tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam. Ko ná ye dwoa wo-sworru dwi maama, te ná maŋe te ye memeeno tei, á yeini á pɔɔre Wɛ-teiri á le á pa‑o. Ko lana. Ko daare abam yiga tera de chega tɔgem de Wɛ swono. Ko ya maŋe se á ta‑á tɔge keim-laaro tem konto maama, se á yé yage tedaara.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma tiini ko peene daane. Yezu daa ma ta o we, “Zem nɔɔna ye nɔn-balwaaro mo. Ba lage se a ke wo-kenkagele mo a bere-ba se ko taa ye maana ko pa-ba. Ba nam bá na, ko ná dae wo-kenkagele delo na maŋe de ke Jonah baŋa ne faŋa faŋa to.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, ka-pɛ wolo déem na tei Seba faŋa faŋa to wó zaŋe o bere we abam ba jege chega. Wonto déem zaŋe o tete teo kolo na tiini ko ye yiga yiga to ne o ba Pɛ Solomon tei se o cheigi o swa yam na ye tei to. Wolo nam na dwoi Solomon to wo abam tei ne ye á yiga tera ded‑o.

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ninevɛ tiina de wó zaŋe dɛ dem konto ne ba bere we abam ba jege chega, kolo ŋwaane Jonah na vei ba tei o bere-ba Wɛ chega kam to, ba leiri ba wo. Wolo na dwoi Jonah to nam wo abam tei ne ye á wo sɛ konto tu. Wɛ chega kam pae debam pwooni Matiyu

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná jege kanea, o bá sɛ o tɔre-ka o zege gugworo wone, naa o pu-ka zoŋa kuri ne. O nam wó kwei-ka o pale wɛɛne mo, se balo na zo diga kam wo to taa nae pwooni dem.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Nmo yia mo pae se n yera jege pwooni. Konto to, nmo yia ná lana, ko pae se n ŋwea maama taa tɔge pwooni mo. Ya nam ná ba lae, ko pae se n ŋwea maama wo lim wone.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Abam ye jworru mo. Wɛ nam wo ke woŋo maama kwaga de ko yiga na?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro yi abam! Abam yeini á fɔge á ke faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem yibeela. Ko nam ye á nabaara mo go-ba.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Yezu déem na ŋɔɔne wonnu tem konto o ti to, Farisi tu dedoa ma bwoŋi‑o se o da o vo o sɔŋɔ o di wodiu. O ma vo o zo sɔŋɔ kom o jeini se o di.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Á nam jege se á kwei wodiiru telo á na jege á zwe sem wone to á maŋe á pa yiniga tiina. Á ná ke konto, á woŋo maama bá taa jege digiru.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro yi abam! Á nye de yibeela yalo na saare ya daare tega, pa se nɔɔna tɔge ya baŋa ba kɛ ye ba ta yeiri ya ni ne to mo.”

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Á kikia yam bere we á sɛ keim-lwanno telo á nabaara bam na ke to. Banto déem go Wɛ sampwori sem, ye abam tete laam fɔge á kwɛ ba yibeela yam.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Abam na tɔge á kwoa kikia konto to, Wɛ dɛ o swa ŋwaane ye o we, ‘Amo wó toŋe a sampwori de a tontoŋena ba tei ne. Ba maa wó ja ba badaara ba go, ye ba pa ba badaara na yaara.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Wɛ waarem dem wó ba á baŋa, ne ko ye abam tete mo go Wɛ sampwori selo maama ba na go boboa ne se ko ba ko yi zem to.

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: Konto maa zege Abel ne, se ko ba ko woli de Zekaria wolo ba na go Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem de o tete diga kam tetare laŋa ne to. A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, keim-lwanno tem konto maama wó taa wo zem nɔɔna bam yuu ne.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam zamesem tiina bam, lɛɛro yi abam. Á yeini á che nɔɔna se ba yé jwoŋi yeino chekke. Abam tete wo sɛ se á jwoŋi-ko, ye á daare á wo pɛ balo na lage ba jwoŋi-ko to chwoŋa se ba jwoŋi.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma yage jei sem konto ye o viiri. Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam maa ba lage o ni taane kɔtaa. Ba maa daane‑o ye ba bwei‑o wonnu dedɛ.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, kɔ-fɔrɔ dedɛ ya lage daane Yezu tei ne. Ba déem yi nenɛɛne morro dedɛ ye ba peene daane pa se ba wora ba nɔne daane. Yezu ma bobo o ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Fɔge-na á che á tete se á yé pa Farisi tiina bam de abam sabɔle, de ba na ye pipiri-nyena ye ba seigi ba ke wo-lwanno tei to.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye gaaro tem konto, tento ba jege dɛ ye nɔɔna yeini ba zwɛ-te. De konto de Wɛ ta mo pae te jege lam konto dwoŋi. Konto ŋwaane ko ná ye abam, Wɛ wó tiini o nii abam baŋa ne. Abam boboŋa muri de Wɛ.

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Abam jege se á pa á boboŋa taa tɔge Wɛ paare dem mo. Á ná ke konto, Wɛ laam wó woli abam de á logo baŋa wonnu tem.

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: A badwonna bam, a tɛ abam se á yé ta‑á kɔre foone de nabiina. Ba wae ba goe á yera yam ye ko kwaga seeni ba daa ware ba ke abam kolokolo.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋe o yei abam tete yu-ywei sem ni na mae tei to. Á yé ta‑á kɔre foone, se abam dedoa dedoa tiini á jege fera á dwoi zun-kabeili dedɛ.

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: Amo kɔgɔ fenfee, yé pa-na foone taa jege abam. Abam Kwo Wɛ boboŋa mo lage se o pa abam tɔge á di o paare dem.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.
translation_verse: Kwei-na á jejegero tem á yeigi se á daare á maŋe te sabu kom á ma á woli yiniga tiina. Konto mo á wó kwei á jejegero á tiŋi Wɛ telaao ne, sabia ganlɔgera na bá chɔge mɛ to. Á ná tiŋi wo-laaro Wɛ tei ne, te daa bá ba te muri. Ŋweena daa bá wane ba ŋɔ-te. Kolokolo bá wane ko mu-te ko chɔge.

english_verse: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say. A Rich Fool
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom wó pa á lɔre á na jege se á ta kolo to.” Jejegero memaŋe

english_verse: But God said to him, “You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up?”
translation_verse: Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, ‘Nmo ye nɔn-jworo mo. Tete dento wone n ŋwea jege se ka ti. Konto to, nmo tete wó wane n di wonnu tento maama n na ke n pa n tete to na?’

english_verse: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná zege nabiina yiga ne o bere jaja we o ye amo nyem, amo Nabiin-bu wom de wó zege konto tu kwaga ne a bere we o ye a nyem Wɛ malese sem yiga ne.

english_verse: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo maama ná ve amo nabiina yiga ne, amo de wó ve konto tu Wɛ malese sem yiga ne.

english_verse: A man in a crowd said to Jesus, “Teacher, tell my brother to give me my share of what our father left us when he died.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno dedoa na tɔge o wo kɔgɔ kom wone to ma ta de Yezu o we, “Berem tu, popo se n ta a zembaaro wom se o kwei wonnu telo debam kwo na tege o daare to o pɔɔre amo nyem o pa-ne.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “A nɔɔno, amo jege chwoŋa se a bore abam taane na?”

english_verse: and he said to himself, “What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.”
translation_verse: O ma boŋe o we, ‘Amo nam wó ke tɛ mo? Jei daa tera se a ke a wodiiru tem maama da.

english_verse: Later, he said, “Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.
translation_verse: A wó yigi a tuli sem maama mo a de tega ne, se a daare a lɔ tuli-zɛ se a wane a pɛ a wodiiru tem de a wonnu maama a ke da.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.
translation_verse: Yezu daa ta ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we: “Konto ŋwaane mo a tɛ abam se á yé ta‑á jege-na lwia de logo baŋa kolokolo, ko ná ye á ni-wodiu, naa á na wó zo gwaaro telo to de.

english_verse: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.
translation_verse: Maane-na á nii gaao punnu tem na ye tei to. Tento nam ba ke totoŋa ye te ba sɔ gwaaro. Nam ta‑á yei-na we, tento jege lam te dwoi Pɛ Solomon déem na maŋe o zoore gare-nyenno telo to.

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father knows what you need.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina balo na yeiri Wɛ to mo tiini ba boŋe wonnu tem konto maama boboŋa. Abam Kwo Wɛ nam maŋe o yei á na lage-te tei to.

english_verse: But suppose one of the servants thinks that the master won't return until late. Suppose that servant starts beating all the other servants and eats and drinks and gets drunk.
translation_verse: Tontoŋeno wom nam ná boŋe we, omo tu wom dáane dedɛ ye o ta wo tu, ko wó ke‑o tɛ mo? O maa wó taa jege o dwonna tontoŋena bam mo o maga, baara bam de kaana bam de. O maa di wodiiru o chɔga, ye o nyɔ sana o sui.

english_verse: Do you think that I came to bring peace to earth? No indeed! I came to make people choose sides.
translation_verse: Amo na tu logo baŋa to, á boŋe we ko ye se a pa nɔɔna fɔge daane mo na? Aawo. A tu se a pa nɔɔna pɔɔre daane mo.

english_verse: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ tu wom ná jwoori o ba, ye o tontoŋena ta ná jege ba tete ba nia, wopwolo wó taa wo ba tei ne. A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, sɔŋɔ tu wom laam wó pa ba jeini se ba di wodiu. O maa wó kwɛ o tete se o kwei wodiu kom o vo o tiŋi pa ba di.

english_verse: Those servants are really fortunate if their master finds them ready, even though he comes late at night or early in the morning.
translation_verse: O nam ná jwoori o ba tete kokoro ne de, ye o sɔŋɔ tontoŋena bam ta ná jege ba tete ye ba ba dɔa, wopwolo wó taa wo ba tei ne.

english_verse: You would surely not let a thief break into your home, if you knew when the thief was coming.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na we, sɔŋɔ tu wom ya ná lɔre maŋa kalo ŋweeno na lage o ba to, o ya bá pa ŋweeno wom na chwoŋa o zo o ŋɔ.

english_verse: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane abam jege se á che á tete mo, se Nabiin-bu wom lage o ba maŋa kam á na ba jege o teena to mo.”

english_verse: Peter asked Jesus, “Did you say this just for us or for everyone?”
translation_verse: Piita ma bwei Yezu o we, “Dé Teiru, nmo na maŋe memaŋe dem to, ko ye debam ŋwaane mo naa nɔɔna maama ŋwaane mo?”

english_verse: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, o tu wom laam wó pa se o taa nii o jejegero maama baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: If that happens, the master will come on a day and at a time when the servant least expects him. That servant will then be punished and thrown out with the servants who cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Tontoŋeno wom konto tu wom laam wó jwoori o ba dɛ dem tontoŋeno wom na ba jege o teena de maŋa kalo o na wó ba o zo to. O tu wom nam ná tu o peere‑o konto, o laam wó zeili‑o o sɔŋɔ kom wone, ye o daare o pa se kotu tɔge de balo na ve Wɛ chega kam to o na waarem.

english_verse: If servants are not ready or willing to do what their master wants them to do, they will be beaten hard.
translation_verse: Tontoŋeno wolo maama ná lɔre o tu wom boboŋa na lage se o ke kolo to, ye o ná wo sɛ se o ja o tete o ke konto, konto tu wó na waarem dedɛ.

english_verse: But servants who don't know what their master wants them to do will not be beaten so hard for doing wrong. If God has been generous with you, he will expect you to serve him well. But if he has been more than generous, he will expect you to serve him even better. Not Peace, but Trouble (Matthew
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo ná yeiri o tu wom na lage se o ke kolo to, ye o ná ke kolo na maŋe se o na waarem to, konto tu wó na waarem fenfee yerane mo. Wolo maama ná jege Wɛ yeino dedɛ, Wɛ wó jeeli se o na wo-laaro dedɛ konto tu tei ne. Nɔɔno wolo ná jwoŋi wonnu dedɛ se o taa nii te baŋa ne, Wɛ wó jeeli se o jwoŋi dedɛ wonto tei ne ko ja gaale.”

english_verse: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.
translation_verse: Amo nam jege se a zo yaara wo. Ko maa pae se a boboŋa chɔge se ko taa nii maŋa kam ko na wó ke ko kɛ to.

english_verse: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.
translation_verse: Ko zege zem ko taa via, sɔŋɔ dedoa wone nɔɔna banu wó pɔɔre mo, batɔ de balei.

english_verse: Fathers and sons will turn against one another, and mothers and daughters will do the same. Mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law will also turn against each other. Knowing What To Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Kwo de o bu wó chɔge daane. Nu de o bukɔ de wó chɔge daane. Kaane de o baro nu de maa wó chɔge daane.”

english_verse: When the south wind blows, you say, “It's going to get hot,” and it does.
translation_verse: Ko daare gungun-koro vio ná wora ko maga, á yeini á we, lon-wea maa beena, ye ko seene ko ke konto.

english_verse: Are you trying to fool someone? You can predict the weather by looking at the earth and sky, but you don't really know what's going on right now.
translation_verse: Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo! Abam wae á nii wɛyuu de tega baŋa ye á lɔre te na bere tei to chekke. Bɛ nam mo ye á ware á lɔre wonnu telo na wora te ke leile to kuri?

english_verse: Why don't you understand the right thing to do?
translation_verse: Bɛŋwaane mo abam ba sɛ se á pɔɔre kolo na lana se á ta‑á ke to?

english_verse: When someone accuses you of something, try to settle things before you are taken to court. If you don't, you will be dragged before the judge. Then the judge will hand you over to the jailer, and you will be locked up.
translation_verse: Ko nye de nɔɔno ná jaane‑m o vo o saŋe kɔɔte ne. Abam ta ná wo chwoŋa ne á via, se n kwaane n pa á fɔge daane. Ko ná dae konto, o laam wó ja nmo o ke dedɛɛro wom jeŋa ne se o waare‑m. Wonto de laam maa wó ke nmo o tontoŋeno jeŋa ne, se o ke nmo peena diga ne.

english_verse: You won't get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.
translation_verse: A tɛ nmo, nmo wó ta‑n wora taa. Nmo ná wo ŋwe jene dem maama ye bi wo daare, ba bá yage‑m.”

english_verse: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna badwonna maa wora ye ba vo ba ta Galili tiina badwonna taane ba bere Yezu. Gɔmena tu Pilata ya jaane banto o go maŋa kalo ba na wora ba kaane Wɛ to, pa se ba jana bam nwoŋi ba gwaane de vara jana.

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri nɔɔna bam o we, “Galili tiina banto bam na tiini ba na cham konto dwoŋi to, á boŋe we ko ye ba na tiini ba ye nɔn-chechɔgero ba dwoi ba dwonna bam to ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also be killed.
translation_verse: Aawo, ko dae konto. Abam tete de ná wo leiri á wo de á keim-balwaaro tem, abam maama de wó na chɔgem.

english_verse: Not at all! But you can be sure that if you don't turn back to God, every one of you will also die. A Story about a Fig Tree
translation_verse: Aawo, ko dae konto. Abam tete ná wo leiri á wo Wɛ ŋwaane, abam maama de wó na chɔgem.”

english_verse: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma maŋe memaŋe o bere-ba o we, “Nɔɔno mo wora. O maa jege kaporo o gaare wone. O ma vo se o nii, o wó na ko bia o gwori na. O maa wo nɛ.

english_verse: The gardener answered, “Master, leave it for another year. I'll dig around it and put some manure on it to make it grow.
translation_verse: Tontoŋeno wom ma leiri‑o o we, ‘Amo tu, yage se ko daa ke bene dedoa. Amo wó ko gwoŋo a gilimi ko maama ye a ke popɔnɔ da.

english_verse: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.” Healing a Woman on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Ko ná yi bene dedoa ye ko ná leigi bia, ko wó taa lana. Ko nam ta ná wo leigi, de laam wó gwoni-ko de de tega ne.’ ” Yezu yɔɔre kaane wodwoŋi siu dɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Are you trying to fool someone? Won't any one of you untie your ox or donkey and lead it out to drink on a Sabbath?
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Abam ye pipiri-nyena mo! Abam wolo ná jege nabea naa bonaga, n bá‑n sɛ n bwoli-ka n ja n vo buga se ka nyɔ na á siu dɛ dem ne na?

english_verse: Jesus' words made his enemies ashamed. But everyone else in the crowd was happy about the wonderful things he was doing. A Mustard Seed and Yeast (Matthew
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ko ma pa balo na ve‑o to na ba chaveera. Ko daare nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maa jege wopwolo dedɛ de wo-kenkagela yalo maama o na ke to. Wɛ paare dem taane Matiyu

english_verse: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, “You had better get away from here, because Herod wants to kill you!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne Farisi tiina badwonna ma vo Yezu tei ye ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Yage ywo-seeni se n vo jei sedwoŋi. Pɛ Herodi lage se o pa ba go nmo mo.”

english_verse: But I am going on my way today and tomorrow and the next day. After all, Jerusalem is the place where prophets are killed. Jesus Loves Jerusalem (Matthew
translation_verse: Amo nam jege se a daa kwei a chwoŋa a taa kɛa se ko ke da yatɔ, kolo ŋwaane ko bá wane se wolo na ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu to ga o ŋwea ye ko dae Jerusalem ne.

english_verse: There the ones who are now least important will be the most important, and those who are now most important will be least important. Jesus and Herod
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na we, nɔɔna badaara zem na ye kwaga tiina to wó ba ba ji yiga tiina. Badaara de na maŋe ba ye yiga tiina to wó jwoori ba ji kwaga tiina.” Yezu wo chɔge Jerusalem tiina ŋwaane Matiyu

english_verse: Jesus said to them: Go tell that fox, “I am going to force out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and three days later I'll be through.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Wonto ye nasea mo! Véi-na á ta á bere‑o we, zem da yanto ne amo jege se a taa zeili setaana ye a kwori a yɔɔre nɔɔna jaweero. Da yatɔ ná kɛ, amo laam wó yi a kweelim jeiga.

english_verse: It is like what happens when someone plants a mustard seed in a garden. The seed grows as big as a tree, and birds nest in its branches.”
translation_verse: Wɛ paare dem nye de nɔɔno na kwei tio-bu-memeeno o vo o du o kara ne. Tio-bu wom konto ma nwoŋi, ye tio kom tiini ko ji kamunu. Zuna laam ma ba ba sɔ ba pworu da.”

english_verse: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he taught the people in the towns and villages.
translation_verse: Yezu déem wo chwoŋa ne o maa vei Jerusalem. O na maa vei to, o tole teene dem maama ye o bere Wɛ taane.

english_verse: Do all you can to go in by the narrow door! A lot of people will try to get in, but will not be able to.
translation_verse: “Ta‑á cho-na á tete se á kwaane á da ni delo na peene to á zo Wɛ woro kom wo. A tɛ abam, nɔɔna dedɛ wó kwaane se ba zo, ye ba bá wane ba na chwoŋa.

english_verse: Once the owner of the house gets up and locks the door, you will be left standing outside. You will knock on the door and say, “Sir, open the door for us!” But the owner will answer, “I don't know a thing about you!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam wó yi, ye sɔŋɔ tu wom zaŋe o pe manchwoŋo kom. Abam laam wó ba á zege pwooni ne á dɔne dɛ sem ye á lwoori‑o á we, ‘Debam tu, popo, pore n pa debam.’ O laam wó leiri o we, ‘Amo nam yeiri abam kɔtaa.’

english_verse: But he will say, “I really don't know who you are! Get away from me, you evil people!”
translation_verse: O nam ta wó leiri abam o we, ‘Amo nam yeiri abam kɔtaa. Lage-na jei! Abam maama ye wo-lwan-keira mo.’

english_verse: Then when you have been thrown outside, you will weep and grit your teeth because you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Ko ná ke abam konto, á wó na Abaraham, de Izaak, de Jakob na jeini Wɛ woro kom wone, ko woli de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem maama. Abam tete nam bá na chwoŋa se á zo. Abam wó maŋe dáa ne, yaara na wora pa se nɔɔna keera ye ba done ba nwa mɛ to.

english_verse: People will come from all directions and sit down to feast in God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna wó nwoŋi logo baŋa jei maama ne ba ba ba zo Wɛ woro kom wo, ye ba jeini ba di ywoni daane.

english_verse: Jerusalem, Jerusalem! Your people have killed the prophets and have stoned the messengers who were sent to you. I have often wanted to gather your people, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings. But you wouldn't let me.
translation_verse: Ei! Jerusalem tiina bam, á yeini á go Wɛ sampwori selo o na toŋe abam tei ne to, ye á dole-ba de kandwa. Kuni dedɛ mo a ya lage se a la abam nɔn-bia a ke daane se a taa nii á baŋa ne, nenɛɛne chworo na kukwori ko bia ko ke ko vɔna kuri ne tei to. Abam maa ba sɛa.

english_verse: Now your temple will be deserted. You won't see me again until the time when you say, “Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wó dɔne o jea abam teo kom baŋa ne se ko ji di-dwonnu. Á ta‑á yei we, á daa bá na-ne se ko taa vei maŋa kalo á na wó ta we, ‘Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu o yere ŋwaane to swolim.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus turned and asked the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses, “Is it right to heal on the Sabbath?”

translation_verse: Nadum wom ma ta o we, ‘Amo kwo, ko na ye konto to, a lwoori‑m se n toŋe Lazaru se o vo amo kwo sɔŋɔ.

english_verse: Let him warn my five brothers, so they won't come to this horrible place.”
translation_verse: A jege nyaana banu mo ye a ba lage se ba tɔge ba ba yaara jei sento. Nam toŋe‑o se o vo o kaane-ba.’

english_verse: Abraham answered, “Your brothers can read what Moses and the prophets wrote. They should pay attention to that.”
translation_verse: Abaraham ma ta ded‑o o we, ‘Ba maŋe ba jege twanno telo Moses de Wɛ sampwori sem na popone to se ba taa tɔga. Ba nam jege se ba sɛ berem dento mo.’

english_verse: Then the rich man said, “No, that's not enough! If only someone from the dead would go to them, they would listen and turn to God.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, ‘Amo kwo Abaraham, ba bá sɛ konto. Nɔɔno nam ná bi toone wone ye o vo ba tei o bere-ba, ba laam wó leiri ba wo Wɛ ŋwaane.’

english_verse: Why was this foreigner the only one who came back to thank God?”
translation_verse: Ba wolowolo wo jwoori o ba se o ke Wɛ lei, ko ná dae dwi-gɛ tu wonto yerane na?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If you had faith no bigger than a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this mulberry tree to pull itself up, roots and all, and to plant itself in the ocean. And it would!
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Á ná jege wo-dedoa de amo, ye ko ná maŋe ko ye fenfee yerane se ko maŋe de tio-bu-memeeno tei de, á wó wane á tɔge ko ŋwaane á toŋe totoŋ-kamuna. Á wó wane á ta de kanyɔnɔ konto we, ko gɔ ko vo ko jeiri naneo kom wone, ye ko wó sɛ á ni.”

english_verse: There is no use saying, ‘Look! Here it is’ or ‘Look! There it is.’ God's kingdom is here with you.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bá ta we, ‘Nii-na ywo-seeni’, naa ba we, ‘Nii jei sento ne’, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ paare dem maŋe de wo abam wone.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Maŋa wó ba ye á tiini á lage se á na da yalo Nabiin-bu wom na wó ba o veere o tete to, ko ná maŋe ko ye ya da dedoa de. Á nam bá na.

english_verse: Servants don't deserve special thanks for doing what they are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Nmo bá‑n ke n tontoŋeno wom lei de o na ke kolo nmo na pɛ‑o ni se o ke to.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: There will always be something that causes people to sin. But anyone who causes them to sin is in for trouble. A person who causes even one of my little followers to sin
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we: “Wonnu telo na soge nɔɔna pa se ba tusi Wɛ chwoŋa wone to jege se te taa wora mo. Ko nam ná ye wolo na soge nɔɔna pa se ba tusi to, lɛɛro wo kotu tei ne.

english_verse: So be careful what you do. Correct any followers of mine who sin, and forgive the ones who say they are sorry.
translation_verse: Konto to, á ta‑á yei á tete. Nmo nu-bu ná ke wɛleere, se n kaane‑o de o na ke kolo to. O nam ná sɛ ye o leiri o wo, se n yage n ma n chɛ‑o.

english_verse: Even if one of them mistreats you seven times in one day and says, “I am sorry,” you should still forgive that person.
translation_verse: O ná maŋe o ke lwarem o chɔge nmo wo kuni berepɛ dɛ wone, ye o ná jwoori o ba nmo tei kuni berepɛ ye o sɛ we o ke o chɔge, nmo ta jege se n ma n chɛ‑o mo.”

english_verse: No, you wouldn't say that. You would say, “Prepare me something to eat. Get ready to serve me, so I can have my meal. Then later on you can eat and drink.”
translation_verse: Aawo. Nmo nam wó ta ded‑o we, ‘Véi n ke wodiu se n laam kwɛ n tete n ja wodiu kom n ba n pa-ne se a di. Amo ná di a ti, se n laam vo n di n tete nyem.’

english_verse: And that's how it should be with you. When you've done all you should, then say, “We are merely servants, and we have simply done our duty.” Ten Men with Leprosy
translation_verse: Ko ye bedwe mo de abam de. Abam ná ke kolo maama Wɛ na pɛ abam ni se á ke to, á jege se á ta we, ‘Debam maŋe dé ye tontoŋena mo, ye dé ba jwoŋi teem ko ŋwaane. Dé nam ke kolo na maŋe se dé ke to yerane.’ ” Yezu yɔɔre naywanno fuga

english_verse: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
translation_verse: Yezu déem maa wo chwoŋa ne o maa vei Jerusalem. O ma da Samaria de Galili tetare laŋa o maa kɛa.

english_verse: As he was going into a village, ten men with leprosy came toward him. They stood at a distance
translation_verse: O ma vo se o zo teo kodwoŋi. O na lage o zo ko wo to mo naywanno fuga jeeri‑o chwoŋa ne. Ba ma zege yiga yiga,

english_verse: and shouted, “Jesus, Master, have pity on us!”

translation_verse: Ba wo dedoa na nɛ we o jaweo kom jei to, o ma pipiri o jwoori Yezu tei ye o tiini o tei Wɛ de kwor-dɛa.

english_verse: He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. The man was from the country of Samaria.
translation_verse: O ma vo o to Yezu yiga ne ye o ke o lei. Wolo na ke konto to ye Samaria teo nɔɔno mo.

english_verse: Jesus asked, “Weren't ten men healed? Where are the other nine?
translation_verse: Yezu ma bwei o we, “Ko dae nɔɔna fuga kam maama yera yam mo fɔge ya kwɛ na? Nogo kom nam bɛ?

english_verse: Then Jesus told the man, “You may get up and go. Your faith has made you well.” God's Kingdom (Matthew
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Nmo na ke n wo-dedoa de amo tei to mo pɛ se n na yazura. Nam zaŋe n viiri.” Wɛ paare dem na wó ba nɔɔna baŋa tei to Matiyu

english_verse: When people say to you, “Look there,” or “Look here,” don't go looking for him.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne, nɔɔna wó ta de abam ba we, ‘Nii-na! O wo ywo-seeni.’ Á nam yé sɛ ba taane se á vo á nii.

english_verse: Then Jesus' disciples spoke up, “But where will this happen, Lord?” Jesus said, “Where there is a corpse, there will always be vultures.”
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Debam Teiru, ko nam wó ke yei ne mo?” O ma leiri-ba o we, “Nɔɔna maama wó taa yei ko ni ne, nenɛɛne wo-teko na wo mɛ ye duura de jege se ba taa wora to.”

english_verse: But first he must suffer terribly and be rejected by the people of today.
translation_verse: Da-yiga ye konto ta wo ke to, ko fe mo se amo Nabiin-bu wom na yaara dedɛ ye zem nɔɔna bam chuli-ne.

english_verse: When the Son of Man comes, things will be just as they were when Noah lived.
translation_verse: Amo Nabiin-bu wom na wó ba maŋa kalo to wó taa ye nenɛɛne ko déem na ke Noah da yam ne tei to.

english_verse: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day when Noah went into the big boat. Then the flood came and drowned everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔna déem wora yɔɔ yerane mo. Ba maa di ba wodiiru, ye ba daare ba di kaana, ye kaana de maa zoore banna, se ko vo ko yi dɛ dem Noah na zo nabwor-kamunu kom wo to. Na-fɔrɔ laam ma ba ba wɛɛle ba lini logo kom ba chɔge nɔɔna bam maama.

english_verse: The same will happen on the day when the Son of Man appears.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem Nabiin-bu wom na wó ba o veere o tete nabiina tetare ne to wó pɔpɔ de ba nɔɔna baŋa konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: At that time no one on a rooftop should go down into the house to get anything. No one in a field should go back to the house for anything.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, nɔɔno wolo ná wo nayuu ne ye o wonnu ná wo diga wone, konto tu yé tu o zege se o kwei o wonnu tem o ja duri. Nɔɔno wolo nam ná wo kara ne, se kotu daa yé jwoori sɔŋɔ.

translation_verse: Wolo maama ná lage se o taa jege o tete ŋwea, konto tu wó ga-ka mo. Wolo maama nam ná sɛ se o ga o ŋwea, konto tu wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.
