english_verse: Jesus told his disciples a story about how they should keep on praying and never give up:
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma maŋe memaŋe o bere o kwaga tɔgena bam we, ba jege se ba taa lwoori Wɛ taa, se ba yé yage teenem.

english_verse: In a town there was once a judge who didn't fear God or care about people.
translation_verse: O ma maŋe o bere-ba o we: “Teo kodwoŋi ne mo pɛ wodwoŋi ya wora ye o ba kɔre Wɛ. O maa ba jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: In that same town there was a widow who kept going to the judge and saying, “Make sure that I get fair treatment in court.”
translation_verse: Kadeim wodwoŋi de maa wora teo kom konto ne. O maa yeini o vei pɛ wom tei maŋa maama ye o lwoori wolim o tei ne o we, ‘Nam pa se a di bora a dono wom tei ne.’

english_verse: For a while the judge refused to do anything. Finally, he said to himself, “Even though I don't fear God or care about people,
translation_verse: Pɛ wom maa ba sɛ o taane dem. Ko maa wora ko wora ye o laam boŋe o tete ne o we, ‘Amo ba kɔre Wɛ, ye a ba jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: I will help this widow because she keeps on bothering me. If I don't help her, she will wear me out.”
translation_verse: Ko daare kadeim wonto nam jege-ne o daana. Konto ŋwaane mo a jege se a bore bora a pa‑o. Ko ná dae konto, o wó taa tui a tei mo taa se ko taa nii a toone.’ ”

english_verse: He will surely hurry and help them. But when the Son of Man comes, will he find on this earth anyone with faith? A Pharisee and a Tax Collector
translation_verse: A tɛ abam we, o wó pa se ba di bora ye o bá dáane. Ko daare Nabiin-bu wom ná jwoori o ba logo baŋa, nɔɔna ta wó taa jege wo-dedoa ded‑o na?” Farisi tu de lampwoo laro memaŋe

english_verse: Jesus told a story to some people who thought they were better than others and who looked down on everyone else:
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma maŋe memaŋe dedwoŋi se o bere balo na boŋe ba pa ba tete we ba jege chega Wɛ tei ne ye ba gwooni ba dwonna to.

english_verse: The Pharisee stood over by himself and prayed, “God, I thank you that I am not greedy, dishonest, and unfaithful in marriage like other people. And I am really glad that I am not like that tax collector over there.
translation_verse: Ba na zo to, Farisi tu wom ma zege o ware Wɛ o tete ne ye o we, ‘Wɛ, a ke nmo lei de amo na dae nɔn-balɔrɔ ne nɔɔna badwonna na ye tei to. Banto ye ŋweena, de wo-lwan-keira, de ka-lagena. A ke nmo lei de a na dae nenɛɛne lampwoo laro wonto.

english_verse: I go without eating for two days a week, and I give you one tenth of all I earn.”
translation_verse: Da yalei bakwɛ maama wone amo yeini a vɔ ni mo Wɛ ŋwaane. Wonnu telo maama a na nɛ to, a yeini a le Wɛ-teiri pɛɛra te wone a pa nmo.’

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Matthew
translation_verse: Tɔ. Nɔɔna banto balei na ware Wɛ ba ti ye ba laam jwoori sɔŋɔ to, ko ye lampwoo laro wom mo nɛ chega Wɛ tei ne, ye ko dae Farisi tu wom. Kolo ŋwaane wolo ná bere o tete kamunim, konto tu wó ba o ji nɔn-balaŋa mo. Wolo nam ná gwooni o tete, Wɛ wó zeiŋi konto tu nɔɔna yiga ne.” Bu-balwa maŋe de Wɛ paare dem Matiyu

english_verse: Some people brought their little children for Jesus to bless. But when his disciples saw them doing this, they told the people to stop bothering him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna maa jaane ba bu-balwa ba tui Yezu tei se o daŋe o jea ba baŋa ne. O kwaga tɔgena bam na nɛ ba na ke tei to, ba ma zaŋe ba bwɛ-ba se ba yé taa ke konto.

english_verse: Jesus took the twelve apostles aside and said: We are now on our way to Jerusalem. Everything that the prophets wrote about the Son of Man will happen there.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma pwɛ o nɔɔna fuga-balei bam kɔgɔ kom wone, ye o ta de-ba o we, “Ta‑á yei-na we, dé na maa vei Jerusalem to, wonnu telo maama faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na popone Nabiin-bu wom ŋwaane to jege se te ji chega mo.

english_verse: He told Jesus, “I have obeyed all these commandments since I was a young man.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma ta o we, “Ko zege amo biini ne mo amo maŋe a tɔge nia yanto maama.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi o na tage kolo to, o ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ko nam ta gɛ ŋo dedoa se n ke. Kwei wonnu telo maama n na jege to n yeigi, se n laam maŋe te sabu kom n pa yiniga tiina. Konto wó pa se n wo-laaro tiini te puli Wɛ telaao ne. Nmo ná ke konto, se n laam ba n ta n tɔge-ne.”

english_verse: When the man heard this, he was sad, because he was very rich.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom na nigi konto to, o wo ma chɔge dedɛ, o na ye jejegero dedɛ tu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, “It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre ko na ke‑o tei to. O ma ta o we, “Naduna ná lage ba zo Wɛ paare dem wone, ko wó taa tiini ko chana ko pa-ba.

english_verse: In fact, it's easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to get into God's kingdom.”
translation_verse: Ko wó taa chana ko pa-ba ko dwoi kone ná lage se de da gare-lwei bɔɔne de kɛ tei to.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “There are some things that people cannot do, but God can do anything.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Kikia yalo nabiina na bá wane ba ke to mo Wɛ wae o ke-ya.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Remember, we left everything to be your followers!”
translation_verse: Piita laam ma ta o we, “Nii mo. Debam yage dé tete wonnu mo ye dé daare dé tɔge nmo.”

english_verse: He will be handed over to foreigners, who will make fun of him, mistreat him, and spit on him.
translation_verse: Ba wó ja amo ba ke dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne. Ba wó ke amo ba mɔne, ye ba twe-ne. Ba maa wó twe lileeru ba yage a yera ne,

english_verse: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.
translation_verse: ye ba kwei kaasa ba ma fere-ne, ye ba laam daare ba go-ne. Da yatɔ dɛ ne a maa wó jwoori a bi toone wone.”

english_verse: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo o twɛ teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Jeriko. Lilwei maa jei chwoŋa kam ni ne ye o lwoora.

english_verse: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.
translation_verse: O ma ni nɔn-kɔgɔ na tɔge da ko maa kɛa. O ma bwei se o lɔre kolo na ke to.

english_verse: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.
translation_verse: Ba ma ta ba bere‑o we, ko ye Nazarete tu Yezu mo tɔge dáane o maa kɛa.

english_verse: So the blind man shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: O ma laare baŋa baŋa o we, “Yezu, Pɛ David dwi tu, duri amo yiniga!”

english_verse: The people who were going along with Jesus told the man to be quiet. But he shouted even louder, “Son of David, have pity on me!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na wo kɔgɔ kom yiga ne ba maa vei to ma bwɛ‑o se o pu o ni. O laam ma tiini o laare dedɛ ye o we, “Pɛ David dwi tu, duri amo yiniga!”

english_verse: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked,
translation_verse: Yezu ma zege ye o pa se ba vaŋe lilwei wom ba ja ba o tei. O na yi o tei to, Yezu ma bwei‑o o we,

english_verse: “What do you want me to do for you?” “Lord, I want to see!” he answered.
translation_verse: “Nmo lage se a ke bɛ mo a pa nmo?” O ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, amo lage se a jwoori a taa nae mo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Look and you will see! Your eyes are healed because of your faith.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ta‑n nae. Nmo na ke n wo-dedoa de amo tei to mo pɛ se n na yazura.”

english_verse: At once the man could see, and he went with Jesus and started thanking God. When the crowds saw what happened, they praised God.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto bedwe baŋa ne to mo lilwei wom yia jwoori ya nae. O ma zaŋe o tɔge Yezu ye o tei Wɛ lanyerane. Nɔɔna bam maama na nɛ kolo na ke to, ba de maa tei Wɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was heading his way, and Zacchaeus wanted to see what he was like. But Zacchaeus was a short man and could not see over the crowd. So he ran ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree.
translation_verse: O ma duri o kɛ kɔgɔ kom yiga o vo o di kaporo yuu se o kwaane o nii o na Yezu, o na lage o tɔge da to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma vo o yi jei sem. O ma kwoni o yuu wɛɛne o nii, ye o we, “Zakeya, ke lela n tu tega, se zem amo jege se a ba a peini nmo sɔŋɔ ne mo.”

english_verse: Everyone who saw this started grumbling, “This man Zacchaeus is a sinner! And Jesus is going home to eat with him.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na nɛ Yezu na ke tei to, ba maama maa poona ba we, “Ta‑á nii-na o na vei o zo nɔn-chechɔgɔ sɔŋɔ mo se o taa ye o veiru.”

english_verse: Later that day Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “I will give half of my property to the poor. And I will now pay back four times as much to everyone I have ever cheated.”
translation_verse: Zakeya laam ma zaŋe wɛɛne o ta de dé Teiru Yezu o we, “Amo Tu, nii amo na wó ke tei. Amo wó pɔɔre a jejegero tem chichworo mo a maŋe a pa yiniga tiina. Amo nam na pini wolo maama se a jwoŋi lampwoo dedɛ o tei ne to, amo wó jwoori a ŋwe kuni bena mo a pa kotu.”

english_verse: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, “Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.

translation_verse: Nabiin-bu wom na tu logo baŋa to, ko ye se o beeri balo na jei to mo, se o daare o jwoŋi-ba o ke Wɛ jeŋa ne.” Nɔɔno de o tontoŋena memaŋe Matiyu

translation_verse: Konto to, á wó ba á zo amo woro kom wo ye á tɔge de amo á jeini á di ywoni dedɛ. Á wó ba á jeini paare yitunnu baŋa ne, se á ta‑á tei Isarele dwia fuga-yalei yam.” Yezu wuuri o bere Piita na wó ve‑o tei to Matiyu

english_verse: The day had come for the Festival of Thin Bread, and it was time to kill the Passover lambs.
translation_verse: Ko ma ba ko yi dɛ delo ba na bobo se ba di Bworobworo-memene kuri dem to. Dɛ dem konto ne Juu tiina bam yeini ba goe pipeili mo ba ma di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem.

english_verse: So Jesus said to Peter and John, “Go and prepare the Passover meal for us to eat.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma le Piita de Jɔn ye o ta de-ba o we, “Véi-na á kwɛ woŋo maama á pa debam se dé ba dé di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem.”

english_verse: But they asked, “Where do you want us to prepare it?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo lage se dé vo jeiga kɔ mo se dé ke konto?”

english_verse: The Son of Man will die in the way that has been decided for him, but it will be terrible for the one who betrays him!”
translation_verse: Ko nam jege se Nabiin-bu wom vo o te ne Wɛ boboŋa na jaane tei to mo. Ko nam wó taa ye lɛɛro mo ko pa nɔɔno wolo na wó yeigi‑o o pa to.”

english_verse: Then the apostles started arguing about who would ever do such a thing. An Argument about Greatness
translation_verse: Ba na nigi o na tage kolo to, ba ma bobo se ba taa bwei daane ba nii banto wone wɔ mo wó wane o ke konto.

english_verse: he said to them, “I have very much wanted to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo ya tiini a lage se a di kuri dento de abam, se a laam daare a yaare a te.

english_verse: After the meal he took another cup of wine in his hands. Then he said, “This is my blood. It is poured out for you, and with it God makes his new agreement.
translation_verse: Ba na di ba ti to, o daa ma kwei zoŋa ye o ta ke konto dwoŋi, ye o we, “Zoŋa kam wo sana banto bere we Wɛ gwoni ni-doore dedaane nabiina mo amo jana bam ŋwaane. Amo jana bam konto lage ba pwori se ko jwoŋi abam ko yage mo.

english_verse: You have stayed with me in all my troubles.
translation_verse: Abam nam ye balo na tɔge de amo a cham maama wone ye á wo yage a kwaga.

english_verse: So I will give you the right to rule as kings, just as my Father has given me the right to rule as a king.
translation_verse: Amo wó pa se abam tɔge á di paare, ne amo Kwo Wɛ na pɛ se a di paare tei to.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Simon, listen to me! Satan has demanded the right to test each one of you, as a farmer does when he separates wheat from the husks.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de Simon Piita o we, “Simon, Simon, setaana pɛ seene o na chwoŋa se o maŋe abam o nii, ne nɔɔno na kwei yɔlɔ o jege o maa zezɛ wonnu tei to.

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples, “When I sent you out without a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals, did you need anything?” “No!” they answered.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de ba maama o we, “Amo ya na toŋe abam se á tole teene ye á ba jege sabia ganlɔgere, de tampɔgɔ, de natera to, á gɛ wonnu na?” Ba ma leiri ba we, “Aawo, de wo gɛ kolokolo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Peter, I tell you that before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.” Moneybags, Traveling Bags, and Swords
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Piita, a tɛ nmo we, chebɛɔ daa ta ná wo keeri zem, nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we, n yeiri amo.”

english_verse: He said to them, “Why are you asleep? Wake up and pray that you won't be tested.” Jesus Is Arrested (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ye á dɔa? Zaŋe-na se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ, se á yé to cham delo na wó soge á boboŋa to wone.” Ba jaane Yezu Matiyu

english_verse: “Father, if you will, please don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.”
translation_verse: “Amo Kwo, nmo ná sɛ, se n pa cham delo na lage de ba amo baŋa ne to kɛ de daare-ne. Nam ke kolo na tɔge nmo boboŋa to, ye ko dae amo boboŋa na lage kolo to.”

english_verse: Jesus went out to the Mount of Olives, as he often did, and his disciples went with him.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma nwoŋi teo kom wone o vo Olivi peo kom seeni, ne o na yeini o ke tei to. O kwaga tɔgena bam de ma tɔge‑o ba vo.

english_verse: Jesus walked on a little way before he knelt down and prayed,
translation_verse: O laam ma fɔɔre ba tei ne o vo o zege dáa ne. O ma kuni dwoona o lwoori Wɛ o we,

english_verse: Jesus was in great pain and prayed so sincerely that his sweat fell to the ground like drops of blood.
translation_verse: O wo na tiini ko chɔge dedɛ to ma pa se o tiini o lwoori Wɛ de o bochare maama. O luluŋu ma ji nenɛɛne jana mo tei ye ko lura tega ne.

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, a crowd came up. It was led by Judas, one of the twelve apostles. He went over to Jesus and greeted him with a kiss.
translation_verse: Yezu ta na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to, nɔn-kɔgɔ laam ma ba ko yi o tei. Judas wolo na ye o nɔɔna fuga-balei bam wo dedoa to ma tɔge ba yiga. O ma fɔɔre o yi Yezu tei se o kukwori‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: and a servant girl saw him. Then after she had looked at him carefully, she said, “This man was with Jesus!”
translation_verse: O na jei da mini dem pwooni yiga ne konto to, sɔŋɔ kom ka-nyaane wodwoŋi ma yɔɔre o nii o yibia ne ye o we, “Nɔɔno wonto de tɔge o wo Yezu tei ne mo.”

english_verse: One of the disciples even struck at the high priest's servant with his sword and cut off the servant's right ear.
translation_verse: Ba wo dedoa ma le o seo kom o ma zage kaanem yuu tu wom tontoŋeno jazem zwɛ o de tega ne.

english_verse: Jesus asked Judas, “Are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Judas, n tu se n pa ba ja Nabiin-bu wom, ye n ta lage n kukwori-ne mo na?”

english_verse: When Jesus' disciples saw what was about to happen, they asked, “Lord, should we attack them with a sword?”
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena balo na wo o tei ne to ma na ko na lage ko ke‑o tei to. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Dé Teiru, dé le dé se-zɔɔro tem dé ma zage-ba na?”

english_verse: “Enough of that!” Jesus said. Then he touched the servant's ear and healed it.
translation_verse: Yezu na nɛ konto to, o ma ta o we, ba yage! O ma vo o dwei nɔɔno wom zwɛ dem, ye de jwoori de kwɛ lanyerane.

english_verse: Jesus spoke to the chief priests, the temple police, and the leaders who had come to arrest him. He said, “Why do you come out with swords and clubs and treat me like a criminal?
translation_verse: O ma daare o ta de Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de Wɛ diga kam soja tiina dedɛɛra balo na tu se ba ja‑o to o we, “Abam na kwei seene de da-lwanno á ba se á ja amo to, amo ye ŋweeno mo na?

english_verse: Peter said, “Woman, I don't even know that man!”
translation_verse: Piita ma fo ye o we, “A nakɔ, a yeiri‑o.”

english_verse: A little later someone else saw Peter and said, “You are one of them!” “No, I'm not!” Peter replied.
translation_verse: Ko na ke fee to, nɔɔno wodwoŋi de daa ma na‑o, ye o we, “Nmo tɔge n ye ba kɔgɔ kom wo dedoa mo.” Piita ma leiri o we, “A nɔɔno, amo tɔge a dae.”

english_verse: Jesus was arrested and led away to the house of the high priest, while Peter followed at a distance.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma zi Yezu ye ba ja‑o ba kɛ. Ba ma vo ba yi kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ. Piita ma dale o tɔge ba kwaga o da o vo.

english_verse: At daybreak the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses got together and brought Jesus before their council.
translation_verse: Tega déem na tu ka poore to, Juu tiina nakwa kɔgɔ kom maama ma la daane, de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam, de ba zamesem tiina maama. Ba laam ma pa se Yezu nwoŋi o ba o zege ba yiga ne.

english_verse: Peter replied, “I don't know what you are talking about!” Right then, while Peter was still speaking, a rooster crowed.
translation_verse: Piita ma leiri‑o o we, “A nɔɔno, ta-yɔɔro mo n jege n ŋɔɔna.” O ta na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to, chebɛɔ ma pɔpɔ ko keeri.

english_verse: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. And Peter remembered that the Lord had said, “Before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.”
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu laam ma pipiri o nii Piita seeni. Piita ma guli Yezu ya na tage kolo ded‑o o we, “Chebɛɔ ta ná wo keeri zem, nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we n yeiri amo.”

english_verse: The men who were guarding Jesus made fun of him and beat him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo déem na yere Yezu to maa jege‑o ba ke ba mɔna ye ba kwori ba mage‑o.

english_verse: They kept on insulting Jesus in many other ways. Jesus Is Questioned by the Council (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ta maa ŋɔɔne wonnu dwi dwi ba ma chɔge o yuu ye ba twe‑o dedɛ. Ba ŋɔɔne Yezu taane Matiyu

english_verse: And if I asked you a question, you wouldn't answer.
translation_verse: Amo daa ná bwei abam taane, abam bá sɛ se á leiri á pa-ne.

english_verse: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of God All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ko nam zege leile konto, Nabiin-bu wom wó vo o jeini Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ jazem seeni.”

english_verse: Everyone in the council got up and led Jesus off to Pilate.
translation_verse: Juu tiina nakwa kɔgɔ kom maama déem ma zaŋe ba ja Yezu ba ja vo gɔmena tu Pilata tei.

english_verse: They started accusing him and said, “We caught this man trying to get our people to riot and to stop paying taxes to the Emperor. He also claims that he is the Messiah, our king.”
translation_verse: Ba ma bobo se ba taa ŋɔɔne taane dem ba pa‑o ye ba we, “Debam nɛ nɔɔno wonto na jege dé teo kom nɔɔna mo o gane-ba pa ba tusi. O maa bere-ba we ba yé taa lae lampwoo ba pae logo kom Pa-faro wom. O maa kwori o bere o tete we o ye pɛ mo, Wɛ Dam Tu wom.”

english_verse: Herod and his soldiers made fun of Jesus and insulted him. They put a fine robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.
translation_verse: Herodi de o soja tiina bam laam ma twe Yezu dedɛ, ye ba jege‑o ba mɔna. Ba ma pa o zo gare-nyenno, ye ba daare ba pa se o jwoori o vo Pilata tei.

english_verse: He told them, “You brought Jesus to me and said he was a troublemaker. But I have questioned him here in front of you, and I have not found him guilty of anything that you say he has done.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam na saŋe nɔɔno wonto amo tei ne to, á tɛ á we o ye wolo na gane á teo kom nɔɔna bam pa ba tusi to. Amo nam bwei‑o mo abam tei ne se a nii, ye a wo nɛ kolo o na ke o chɔge ye á ja‑o ko ŋwaane to.

english_verse: But they all kept on saying, “He has been teaching and causing trouble all over Judea. He started in Galilee and has now come all the way here.” Jesus Is Brought before Herod
translation_verse: Ba ma tiini ba ŋɔɔne taane dem ye ba kwaane ba ta ba we, “O nam yeini o tole Judea teene dem maama o pae se bobɔga to nɔɔna bam wone. O déem bobo o ke konto dwoŋi Galili ne mo ye o laam yi ywo-seeni.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “Those are your words,” Jesus answered.
translation_verse: Pilata na nigi konto to, o ma bwei Yezu o we, “Nmo mo ye Juu tiina bam pɛ na?” Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo na tage kolo to mo konto.”

english_verse: After Pilate learned that Jesus came from the region ruled by Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem at that time.
translation_verse: O na tu o lɔre we Yezu nwoŋi teo kolo Herodi na tei to, o ma pa se ba ja‑o ba vo wonto tei se o di taane dem, kolo ŋwaane Herodi de tɔge o wo Jerusalem ne maŋa kam konto ne.

english_verse: For a long time Herod had wanted to see Jesus and was very happy because he finally had this chance. He had heard many things about Jesus and hoped to see him work a miracle.
translation_verse: Pɛ Herodi na nɛ Yezu to, o maa jege wopwolo dedɛ, kolo ŋwaane o ya maŋe o ni o ŋwa ye o tiini o lage se o na‑o. O maa lage se o nii, Yezu wó ke wo-kenkagele o bere‑o na.

english_verse: Herod asked him a lot of questions, but Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: O ma kwaane o bwei‑o wonnu dedɛ. Yezu maa wo sɛ se o leiri‑o kolokolo.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses stood up and accused him of all kinds of bad things.
translation_verse: Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba zamesem tiina bam maa tɔge ba zege da ye ba tiini ba ŋɔɔne taane dem de baare ba pa‑o.

english_verse: That same day Herod and Pilate became friends, even though they had been enemies before this. The Death Sentence (Matthew
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne Herodi de Pilata ma di badwoŋo daane, ye ba déem ya chuli daane mo.

english_verse: As Jesus was being led away, some soldiers grabbed hold of a man named Simon who was from Cyrene. He was coming in from the fields, but they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
translation_verse: Soja tiina laam ma ja Yezu ba maa kɛa. Ba na maa vei to, ba ma na nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Simon. O nwoŋi Kurene mo. O déem ya nwoŋi gaao mo o ba o yi teo wo o maa kɛa. Ba ma zi‑o ye ba daare ba daŋe dagara kam o bakala baŋa ne pa se o zeŋe-ka o tɔge Yezu kwaga o ja vo.

english_verse: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he spoke again to the crowds.
translation_verse: Pilata maa lage se o le Yezu o yage. O daa ma ta de nɔɔna bam se ba sɛ konto.

english_verse: Pilate spoke to them a third time, “But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.”
translation_verse: O daa ta ma ta de-ba o ke betɔ o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo? Bɛ wo-lɔŋɔ mo o kea? Amo wo nɛ kolo o na ke o chɔge pa se ko maŋe se dé go‑o to. Konto to, amo wó pa se o na waarem ye a daare a yage‑o.”

english_verse: He freed the man who was in jail for rioting and murder, because he was the one the crowd wanted to be set free. Then Pilate handed Jesus over for them to do what they wanted with him. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: O ma pa ni we, ba le nɔɔno wolo ba na lage se o yage o pa-ba to. Wonto mo ye wolo ba ya na jaane ba ke peena diga ne o na ke jara de ba teo kom dedɛɛra ye o go nɔɔna to ŋwaane. O ma daare o ke Yezu ba jeŋa ne se ba wane ba ke‑o ne ba boboŋa na lage tei to. Ba jaane Yezu ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne Matiyu

english_verse: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?
translation_verse: Ta‑á nii-na ba na ke wo-lwanno tei leile konto. Mini na jege da-lɛa de di konto to, ko ná tu ko ye da-kora, ko bá tiini ko taa ye lɛɛro ko dwoi konto na?”

english_verse: Around noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until the middle of the afternoon.
translation_verse: Ko ma vo ko yi maŋa kam wɛ na tu de wo yupare baŋa ne to. Tega kam maama ma ba ka ji lim se ko vo ko yi wɛ-guni maŋa ne.

english_verse: Two criminals were led out to be put to death with Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba déem ma ja ŋweena balei ba vo se ba woli de Yezu ba go.

english_verse: Jesus said, “Father, forgive these people! They don't know what they're doing.” While the crowd stood there watching Jesus, the soldiers gambled for his clothes. The leaders insulted him by saying, “He saved others. Now he should save himself, if he really is God's chosen Messiah!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maa zege da ba nia. Juu tiina nakwa bam nam ke‑o ba mɔna ye ba we, “O yeini o jwoŋi nɔɔna ŋwea. O ná seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wolo o na kuri to, o nam jege se o jwoŋi o tete ŋwea mo.”

english_verse: The soldiers made fun of Jesus and brought him some wine.
translation_verse: Soja tiina bam de maa ke‑o ba mɔna, ye ba jege sa-nyɔna ba suŋi o yiga ne.

english_verse: They said, “If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself!”
translation_verse: Ba maa we, “Nmo ná seene n ye Juu tiina bam pɛ, se n jwoŋi n tete ŋwea se dé nii.”

english_verse: But the other criminal told the first one off, “Don't you fear God? Aren't you getting the same punishment as this man?
translation_verse: Ŋweeno wodwoŋi wom ma bwɛ o badwoŋi wom o we, “Nmo ba kɔre Wɛ na? Debam maama jege waarem dedwe mo se dé te.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.” The Death of Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, zem dɛ dem ne nmo wó taa wo amo tei ne Wɛ ywoni jei sem ne.”

english_verse: The sun stopped shining, and the curtain in the temple split down the middle.
translation_verse: Wea kam daa ba jege pwooni. Gare-jale delo na leigi de che Wɛ di-yun-gala kam to ma kaare belei.

english_verse: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na tu ba la daane se ba nii kolo na lage ko ke to de ma na ko na ke tei to. Ba na nɛ to, ba ma jwoori ba viiri ye ba wo chɔge dedɛ.

english_verse: All of Jesus' close friends and the women who had come with him from Galilee stood at a distance and watched. Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Ko daare balo maama na maŋe ba yei‑o to, de kaana balo ya na tɔge ded‑o ba nwoŋi Galili ba ba to maa zege dáa ne ba nia. Ba ke Yezu yera yam yibeeli wone Matiyu

english_verse: There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Josɛf. O nwoŋi Judea teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Arimatea. O maa ye Juu tiina nakwa kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno. O maa kwori o ye nɔn-ŋom ye o tɔge chega Wɛ tei ne. Ba kɔgɔ kom ya na ke ni daane se ba ja Yezu to, o wo sɛ ba na boŋe se ba ke‑o kolo to. O maa jege teena we Wɛ paare dem wó ba o nɔɔna baŋa.

english_verse: He took the body down from the cross and wrapped it in fine cloth. Then he put it in a tomb that had been cut out of solid rock and had never been used.
translation_verse: Pilata na sɛ to, Josɛf ma vo o pare Yezu yera yam dagara kam yuu ne. O ma kwei gare-jale o ma pipiri o yera yam, ye o daare o ja vo o tiŋi-ya peo bɔɔne wone. Dento maa ye yibeeli delo ba déem na lugi-de peo yera ne ye ba maŋe ba wo ke nɔɔno da to.

english_verse: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.
translation_verse: Kaana balo ya na tɔge de Yezu ba nwoŋi Galili to déem ma da Josɛf kwaga ba vo ba na yibeeli dem jei de o na tiŋi Yezu yera yam da tei to.

english_verse: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.
translation_verse: Kaana bam konto mo ye Mary Magadala, de Joanna, de Mary wolo na ye Jemsi nu to, ko woli de kaana balo na tɔge de-ba to. Banto maama maa wora ba tɛ kolo na ke to ba bere Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam.

english_verse: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus,
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba zo bɔɔne dem wo. Ba maa wo nɛ dé Teiru Yezu yera yam da.

english_verse: and they did not know what to think. Suddenly two men in shining white clothes stood beside them.
translation_verse: Ba boboŋa ma vugimi de ba na wó ke tei. Ba na zege da konto to, nɔɔna balei ma pɔpɔ ba nwoŋi ba zege ba tei ne, ye ba zo gwaaro telo na nyeene pele-pele to.

english_verse: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, “Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?
translation_verse: Foone ma ja kaana bam. Ba ma tiiri ba chɔɔle ba yuni tega ne. Nɔɔna bam laam ma ta de-ba ba we, “Bɛŋwaane mo á kare á beeri wolo na ŋwe to twa wone?

english_verse: ‘The Son of Man will be handed over to sinners who will nail him to a cross. But three days later he will rise to life.’ ”
translation_verse: ye o we, ba jege se ba ja omo Nabiin-bu wom ba ke nɔn-chechɔgero jeŋa ne, se ba daare ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne ba go, ye o laam jwoori o bi da yatɔ dɛ ne.”

english_verse: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne mo Yezu tɔgena bam balei maa wo chwoŋa ne ba maa vei teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Emayus. Teo kom konto ye nenɛɛne mɛɛla yarepɛ mo de Jerusalem.

english_verse: Jesus asked them, “What were you talking about as you walked along?” The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.
translation_verse: Yezu ma bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ wonnu mo abam jege á ŋɔɔna ye á via?” Ba na nigi konto to, ba ma zege ye ba yiga nyɔne.

english_verse: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.
translation_verse: Debam nam ya jege teena we wonto mo ye wolo na wó ŋwe Isarele dwi tiina bam wɛleera jene o ma jwoŋi-ba o yage to. De konto maama, zem mo jege da yatɔ konto na ke to.

english_verse: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning,
translation_verse: Kolo na daare to mo ye debam kɔgɔ kom kaana badwonna vei o yibeeli dem jei sem ba na kolo na sɔɔre debam yera to. Ba ma vo tetete

english_verse: Some men from our group went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said. But they didn't see Jesus either.
translation_verse: Debam nɔɔna bam badwonna de ma zaŋe ba vo yibeeli dem ne. Ba ma na we ko seene ko ye nenɛɛne kaana bam na tage tei to. Ko daare Yezu tete mo ba wo nɛ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus asked the two disciples, “Why can't you understand? How can you be so slow to believe all that the prophets said?
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Á boboŋa tera na? Bɛ mo ye á ware á sɛ Wɛ kwora kalo o sampwori sem na yeini ba tɔɔle faŋa faŋa to?

english_verse: Didn't you know that the Messiah would have to suffer before he was given his glory?”
translation_verse: Ko dae mo Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom na jege se o na yaara yalo, ye o daare o di Wɛ telaao o jwoŋi o paare to na?”

english_verse: They begged him, “Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down.” So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maa wo sɛ ye ba kwoori‑o ba we, “Tega lage ka yi. Nam zo n peini debam tei ne.” O ma sɛ ye o da o zo.

english_verse: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.
translation_verse: O ma jeini se o di wodiu de-ba. O ma kwei bworobworo ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane. O laam ma fɔ bworobworo kom o maŋe o pa-ba.

english_verse: They said to each other, “When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts?”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ta daane ba we, “Nmo wo nɛ na? Dé na tɔge daane chwoŋa ne ye o ŋɔɔne o bere debam Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wonnu tem kuri na ye tei to, dé ya ba tiini dé jege wopwolo na?”

english_verse: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋe lela ba jwoori ba vo Jerusalem teo kom wo. Ba na yi da to, ba ma na o nɔɔna fuga-dedoa kam de nɔɔna badwonna bam na lage daane jeiga dedoa.

english_verse: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.
translation_verse: Banto maa tɛ ba we, “Ko ye chega mo. Dé Teiru Yezu seene o bi toone wone. O tu o bere o tete de Simon mo.”

english_verse: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread. What Jesus' Followers Must Do (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balei bam de ma maŋe kolo na ke chwoŋa ne to ba bere-ba. Ba ma daare ba maŋe Yezu na fɔge bworobworo kom ye ba laam lɔre‑o tei to. Yezu bere o tete o tɔgena bam Matiyu

english_verse: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.
translation_verse: Ba bochare ma di ye foone ja-ba dedɛ. Ba ma boŋe we ba nɛ chiru mo.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo á yera sae konto? Bɛ mo ye á jege bobwea amo ŋwaane?

english_verse: Look at my hands and my feet and see who I am! Touch me and find out for yourselves. Ghosts don't have flesh and bones as you see I have.”
translation_verse: Fɔge-na á nii amo jea de a nɛ na ye tei to. Ko seene ko ye amo. Taane-na amo á nii. Chira ba jege ya-nɔna de kwi ne á na nae amo na ye tei to.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o ma bere-ba o jataala de o nɛ sem.

english_verse: The disciples were so glad and amazed that they could not believe it. Jesus then asked them, “Do you have something to eat?”
translation_verse: Ko na tiini ko jege wopwolo ko pa-ba to, ba ta ware ba sɛ we ko ye chega, ye ba ja ba nia. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Á jege wodiu ywo-seeni se dé di na?”

english_verse: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.
translation_verse: Ba ma twori ywon-saŋe ba pa‑o.

english_verse: He took it and ate it as they watched.
translation_verse: O ma jwoŋi-de o di ba yibia ne.

english_verse: He told them: The Scriptures say that the Messiah must suffer, then three days later he will rise from death.
translation_verse: O ma ta o bere-ba o we, “Ba popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ba we, Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom lage o na yaara dedɛ mo o te, ye o laam jwoori o bi toone wone da yatɔ dɛ ne.

english_verse: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven. Jesus Returns to Heaven (Mark
translation_verse: Amo nam wó toŋe wolo wom amo Kwo na pwooli o ŋwaane to se o ba abam tei. Wonto wó pa se á na dam delo na nwoŋi Wɛ tei to. Á nam ta ta‑á wora teo kom wone, se á laam wó jwoŋi dam dem konto.”

english_verse: Jesus led his disciples out to Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ja-ba o nwoŋi teo kom wone o ja vo o yi Bɛtania seeni. O ma zeiŋi o jea wɛyuu ne ye o swɛ ba swolim.

english_verse: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.
translation_verse: O na wora o ke Wɛ zaane o yage ba yuu ne konto to, o ma yage ba tei ye Wɛ kwei‑o o ja di telaao.

english_verse: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.
translation_verse: Ba ma kuni dwoona ba zuli‑o ye ba laam daare ba jwoori Jerusalem de wopwolo dedɛ.

english_verse: From the very beginning the Word was with God.
translation_verse: O maŋe o wo Wɛ tei ne mo boboa kam ne.

english_verse: received its life from him, and his life gave light to everyone.
translation_verse: Wonto mo pɛ nabiina na ŋwea. Ŋwea kam konto nam ta mo pae nabiina na pwooni.

english_verse: The light keeps shining in the dark, and darkness has never put it out.
translation_verse: Pwooni dem konto na tu to, de zeili lim. Lim daa ware pwooni dem konto de zeili.

english_verse: God sent a man named John,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora Wɛ na toŋe‑o, o yere mo Jɔn.

english_verse: who came to tell about the light and to lead all people to have faith.
translation_verse: O déem tu se o ta wolo na ye pwooni dem to taane mo o bere nɔɔna, se nabiina maama wane ba lɔre‑o se ba daare ba sɛ‑o.

english_verse: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.
translation_verse: O déem ma ba logo baŋa o wora. Wɛ ya dɛ o ŋwaane mo o ke logo baŋa. De konto de, nabiina daa ta wo lɔre‑o.

english_verse: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.
translation_verse: O ma ba o tete teo, ye o dwi tiina wo jeeri‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.
translation_verse: Ba na jigi Wɛ bia konto to, ko dae nabiina mo loge-ba, ye ko dae ka-laga ŋwaane, naa nabiina boboŋa ŋwaane. Ko ye Wɛ tete boboŋa ŋwaane mo ba jigi Wɛ bia.

english_verse: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.
translation_verse: Konto to, Botara kam déem jigi nabiinu. O ma ba o zoore debam nabiina wone. Dé ma na o dam na mae tei. O dam dem daga lanyerane, o na ye dé Kwo Wɛ Bu-doa kam to ŋwaane. Wɛ zaane de chega maama tiini te wo o tei ne.

english_verse: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.
translation_verse: Wɛ Bu wom tiini o jege Wɛ zaane lanyerane, ye o daare o pae debam maama zeinim taa taa.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like. John the Baptist Tells about Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo maŋe o na Baŋa Wɛ. Ko daare o Bu-doa kam mo pɛ se dé lɔre‑o. Wonto ye Wɛ. O maa wo dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ takeiri ne. Jɔn ŋɔɔne Yezu yera taane Matiyu

english_verse: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, “I am not the Messiah.”
translation_verse: Jɔn ma yɔɔre o leiri-ba o we, “Ko dae amo mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom.”

english_verse: Then when they asked him if he were Elijah, he said, “No, I am not!” And when they asked if he were the Prophet, he also said “No!”
translation_verse: Ba ta ma jwoori ba bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo nam bere n tete we n ye wɔ mo? Nmo ye Elija mo na?” O ma leiri-ba o we, omo dae. Ba daa ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo ye Wɛ sampwora kalo ya na maŋe se o ba to mo na?” O maa we, “Aawo.”

english_verse: Finally, they said, “Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are!”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ta ba we, “Nam ta n bere debam nmo na ye wolo to. Dé jege se dé ja nmo ni taane mo dé vo dé ta dé bere balo na toŋe debam to. Nmo lage n ta n tete taane we bɛ mo?”

english_verse: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, “I am only someone shouting in the desert, ‘Get the road ready for the Lord!’ ”
translation_verse: Ba na bwei‑o konto to, Jɔn ma da Wɛ sampwora Izaya taane dem ŋwaane o leiri-ba o we, “Amo ye wolo na kaase a kwora kagoa yuu ne we: ‘Pa-na se chwoŋa kalo dé Teiru wom na lage o ba o tɔge da to fɔge ka yɔɔre lanyerane.’ ”

english_verse: Some Pharisees had also been sent to John.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna de tɔge ba wora, ba na nwoŋi Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: John told them, “I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.
translation_verse: Jɔn ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko ná ye amo, a yeini a ma na mo a pa nɔɔna sɛɛm. Abam nam na zege to, nɔɔno wo á wone ye á yeiri‑o.

english_verse: Even though I came first, I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Wonto lage o saŋe amo kwaga o ba, ye amo wo maŋe se a le o nɛ natera a pa‑o.”

english_verse: John said this as he was baptizing east of the Jordan River in Bethany. The Lamb of God
translation_verse: Konto maama déem ke Bɛtania ne, Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ ne mɛ Jɔn na pae nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane to. Jɔn bere we Yezu ye Wɛ Pipeila kam

english_verse: The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Jɔn ma na Yezu na vei o maa beene o tei. O ma ta de balo na wora to o we, “Nii-na Wɛ Pipeila kalo na saare nabiina wɛleera to.

english_verse: He is the one I told you about when I said, “Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.”
translation_verse: Amo ya tage a we, ‘Nɔɔno wó saŋe amo kwaga o ba, ye o ye kamunu o dwoi amo, kolo ŋwaane o maŋe o wora ye amo ta tera.’ Ko nam ye wonto taane mo a tɛa.

english_verse: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.
translation_verse: Amo tete déem maŋe a yeiri‑o, ye a laam ba a lɔre‑o. Amo nam tu se a pa amo dwonna Isarele dwi tiina bam mo lɔre‑o. Konto ŋwaane mo a yeini a kwei na a pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane.”

english_verse: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God. The First Disciples of Jesus
translation_verse: Amo seene a na kolo Wɛ na tage to, ye a tɛ abam chekke we Yezu mo ye Wɛ Bu wom.” Yezu bwoŋi nɔɔna se ba taa tɔge‑o

english_verse: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Jɔn de o tɔgena balei daa ta maa wora.

english_verse: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Here is the Lamb of God!”
translation_verse: Jɔn ma na Yezu na vei o maa kɛa. O ma ta o we, “Nii-na Wɛ Pipeila kam.”

english_verse: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.
translation_verse: Jɔn tɔgena balei bam ma ni o na tage kolo to. Ba ma pɛ ba pu Yezu kwaga.

english_verse: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, “What do you want?” They answered, “Rabbi, where do you live?” The Hebrew word “Rabbi” means “Teacher.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma pipiri o nii o na ba na tɔge‑o to. O ma bwei-ba o we, “Á beene amo tei mo na?” Ba ma leiri ba we, “Ɛɛ, Rabi, n zoore yei ne mo?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Come and see!” It was already about four o'clock in the afternoon when they went with him and saw where he lived. So they stayed on for the rest of the day.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Ba-na á nii.” Ba ma tɔge ded‑o ba vo ba na mɛ o na zoore to. Ko ye dedaan-ni ne mo. Ba ma maŋe o tei ne ba ti dɛ dem.

english_verse: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto dedoa yere mo Anduru. O ye Simon Piita nyaane mo. Anduru de o dwoŋi ya nigi Jɔn na tage Yezu taane tei, ye ba daare ba tɔge Yezu.

english_verse: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother and tell him, “We have found the Messiah!” The Hebrew word “Messiah” means the same as the Greek word “Christ.”
translation_verse: Ba na jwoori to, Anduru ma ke lela o vo o zembaaro Simon tei. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Debam nɛ Wɛ Dam Tu wom.”

english_verse: Andrew brought his brother to Jesus. And when Jesus saw him, he said, “Simon son of John, you will be called Cephas.” This name can be translated as “Peter.” Jesus Chooses Philip and Nathanael
translation_verse: O laam ma ja‑o o vo Yezu tei. Yezu ma nii o yibia ne ye o we, “Nmo ye Simon wolo na ye Jɔn bu to mo. Nmo yere laam wó taa ye Kefa mo.” Yere dem konto de Piita ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him, he said, “Here is a true descendant of our ancestor Israel. And he isn't deceitful.”
translation_verse: Ba na maa vei to, Yezu ma na Natanayel na maa beene o tei. O ma ta o taane o we, “Wonto seene o ye Juu tu mo chekke, ye o wo lana.”

english_verse: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
translation_verse: Natanayel ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo ke tɛ mo n yei amo?” O ma leiri‑o o we, “A ya nɛ nmo maŋa kam nmo na wo kaporo kom kuri ne ye Filipi laam ba o bwoŋi‑m to mo.”

english_verse: Nathanael said, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God and the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Natanayel ma leiri‑o o we, “Berem tu, nmo ye Wɛ Bu mo, ye n ta ye Isarele dwi tiina Pɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo na sɛ amo konto to, ko ye amo na tage a we, a nɛ nmo kaporo kom kuri ne to ŋwaane mo na? Nmo nam wó na wo-kenkagela yalo na tiini ya dana ya dwoi konto to.”

english_verse: Three days later Mary, the mother of Jesus, was at a wedding feast in the village of Cana in Galilee.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ dɛ dem déem na yi to, ba maa wora ba ke kadiri Galili teo kodwoŋi ne, ko yere mo Kana. Yezu nu maa tɔge o wora.

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.
translation_verse: Ba déem bwoŋi Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam mo se ba de ba da.

english_verse: When the wine was all gone, Mary said to Jesus, “They don't have any more wine.”
translation_verse: Ba na wora to, sa-soŋo kom ba na jege ba nyɔ to ma ti. Yezu nu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ba daa ba jege sana se ba nyɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “A nu, nam yage a yera. Amo maŋa kam ta wo yi.”

english_verse: Mary then said to the servants, “Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.”
translation_verse: O nu wom laam ma ta de wodi-keira bam o we, “O ná tage kolo maama, se á ke.”

english_verse: At the feast there were six stone water jars that were used by the people for washing themselves in the way that their religion said they must. Each jar held about
translation_verse: Kambi-zɛ seredo déem maa zege da. Kikeiri-bia finlei naa fintɔ mo wó su se dedoa. Se ya maŋe se zege da mo se nɔɔna taa mae se wo na bam ba se ba jea de ba nɛ, ne Juu tiina chullu tem na bere tei to.

english_verse: Jesus told the servants to fill them to the top with water. Then after the jars had been filled,
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de wodiu keira bam se ba mɔ na ba su kambi sem ni. Ba ma mɔ ba pɛɛle se ni.

english_verse: he said, “Now take some water and give it to the man in charge of the feast.” The servants did as Jesus told them,
translation_verse: O daa ma ta-ba o we, ba laam mɔ kambi sem wone ba ja ba vo ba pa wolo na nii kuri dem baŋa ne to. Ba ma seene ba ke konto.

english_verse: and the man in charge drank some of the water that had now turned into wine. He did not know where the wine had come from, but the servants did. He called the bridegroom over
translation_verse: O ma nyɔ na bam, dedaane ba maŋe ba ji sa-soŋo mo. O ma yeiri sana bam konto na nwoŋi mɛ, ye wodi-keira balo na mɔɔne na bam to mo yei. Nɔɔno wolo na nii kuri dem baŋa ne to laam ma bwoŋi kan-baro wom o ta ded‑o o we,

english_verse: and said, “The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last!”
translation_verse: “Nɔɔno maama yeini o pa sa-ŋona mo yiga ye ba nyɔ. Ba laam ná yeini ba nyɔ ba su, o ma pa-ba sa-yɔɔ se ba nyɔ. Nmo nam kwei sa-ŋona bam n zege, se n laam daare n kwei n pa debam kwaga ne. Ko kuri mo bɛ?”

english_verse: But Jesus was talking about his body as a temple.
translation_verse: Yezu nam na ŋɔɔne Wɛ diga kam taane konto to, ko ye o tete yera yam taane mo o taga.

english_verse: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ko déem ma daare fee se Juu tiina di ba kuri delo yere na ye Atɔgebabaŋa to. Yezu ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem.

english_verse: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.
translation_verse: O ma kwei ŋone o ma ke fena, ye o daare o zeili pei sem de naane dem maama pa de nwoŋi lela. O ma ja sabu-leinna bam tabollo o pipiri o de tega ne pa se ba sabu-mumugu kom jage.

english_verse: The disciples then remembered that the Scriptures say, “My love for your house burns in me like a fire.”
translation_verse: Yezu na ke tei konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam ma guli ko na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne tei ko we, “Amo tiini a toŋe de yi-seena a pa nmo wara-jei sem mo.”

english_verse: years to build this temple. What makes you think you can rebuild it in three days?”
translation_verse: ) mo ba ma ba lɔ Wɛ diga kanto ba ti. Nmo nam lage n ke tɛ mo n ma da yatɔ yerane n ma‑n pa ka zege?”

english_verse: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.
translation_verse: O na yi da to, o ma vo o zo Wɛ diga kam. O ma na nɔɔna na jege naane, de pei, de kunkwon-puura ba yeiga ka konkɔlɔ kom ne. Nɔɔna balo na leini sabia to de maa jei da.

english_verse: Jesus said to the people who had been selling doves, “Get those doves out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace.”
translation_verse: O ma daare o ta nɔɔna balo de na yeigi kunkwon-puura bam to o we, “Nam kwei-ba á ja á nwoŋi ywo-seeni. Amo bá sɛ se á pa amo Kwo Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom taa ye pipiu jeiga.”

english_verse: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, “What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this?”
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam laam ma bwei Yezu ba we, “Bɛ ŋo wo-kenkagele mo nmo wó ke se ko pa dé maane we nmo jege chwoŋa se n zeili nɔɔna bam konto?”

english_verse: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus. Jesus Knows What People Are Like
translation_verse: Ko déem na tu ko yi maŋa kam Yezu na tega, ye o jwoori o bi da yatɔ dɛ ne to, o kwaga tɔgena bam laam guli o na tage tei to. Ba ma sɛ kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to de Yezu ni taane dem.

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.
translation_verse: Yezu déem nam wo yage o wo o pa-ba, kolo ŋwaane o yei nɔɔna maama na ye tei to.

english_verse: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.
translation_verse: O maa ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bere‑o nabiina na ye tei to, o na maŋe o yei kolo na wo nabiinu maama bochare ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Nikodema. O nwoŋi Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone mo. O maa tɔge o ye Juu tiina bam yiga tu dedoa.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “I tell you for certain that you must be born from above before you can see God's kingdom!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, ba ná wo jwoori ba lo nɔɔno wolo, konto tu bere o bá lɔre Wɛ paare dem na ye tei to.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that before you can get into God's kingdom, you must be born not only by water, but by the Spirit.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Chega ŋwaane to, ba ná wo dɛ na baŋa ba lo nɔɔno wolo, ye ba kwori ba wo dɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom baŋa ba lo‑o, konto tu bá wane o woli Wɛ paare dem wone.

english_verse: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.
translation_verse: Nabiina ná yeini ba lo nɔɔno, ko ye logo baŋa momwɛ mo o jega. Ko daare ko ná ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom, konto mo pae nɔɔno jege Wɛ telaao ŋwe-doŋa kam.

english_verse: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑n ye yaau de amo na tage kolo we, abam jege se ba jwoori ba lo abam to.

english_verse: Only God's Spirit gives new life. The Spirit is like the wind that blows wherever it wants to. You can hear the wind, but you don't know where it comes from or where it is going.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye vio, ko yeini ko dole mɛ de mɛ ko na lage to mo. N ma‑n yeini n ni ko sɔɔ kom, ye n yeiri ko na nwoŋi mɛ, de ko na maa vei mɛ to. Ko ye bedwe mo de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ wolo maama ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: How can you be a teacher of Israel and not know these things?
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo ye wolo na zamese Isarele dwi tiina bam to mo. Bɛ mo ye n yeiri tento?

english_verse: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, dé yeini dé ta wonnu telo dé na yei to mo, ye dé kwori dé ŋɔɔne kolo dé na nɛ to dé bere nɔɔna. De konto de, á ta ba sɛ debam berem dem.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Amo tage logo baŋa wonnu taane a bere abam, ye á ba sɛ amo ni. Konto to, amo ná ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao wonnu taane a bere abam, á wó ke tɛ mo á sɛ amo ni?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na diini Wɛ telaao, ko ná dae wolo wom na maŋe o tu o ba to yerane. Ko ye Nabiin-bu wom mo konto.

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Moses déem na wo kagoa wone faŋa faŋa to, o ma pale channa basankwea daa yuu ne, ye o zeiŋi-ka wɛɛne se o nɔɔna yé na chɔgem. Ba nam jege se ba kwei Nabiin-bu wom de ba zeiŋi wɛyuu ne konto mo,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: se ko pa nɔɔno wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o to na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.”

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Wɛ tiini o jege nabiina swono ye o toŋe o Bu-doa se o ba logo baŋa, se wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o to daa yé na chɔgem, se o daare o na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: Wɛ na toŋe o Bu wom se o ba logo baŋa konto to, ko dae se o di nabiina taane o vane ba bora. Ko nam ye se o jwoŋi-ba o yage mo.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to bá to de o bora. Ko daare wolo maama na ba lage se o sɛ‑o to maŋe o to mo, o na ve Wɛ Bu-doa kam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Wɛ na di nabiina taane tei to mo tento: Wɛ pɛ se wolo na ye pwooni tu to ba logo baŋa o wora. Nabiina nam swoi lim ba dwoi pwooni dem, kolo ŋwaane ba kikia ba lana.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama na ke keim-balwaaro to wó chuli pwooni dem mo, ye o bá sɛ se o nwoŋi de yiga ne, se o keim-balwaaro tem ba te taa nae jaja.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Wolo maama na tɔge chega chwoŋa to nam wó nwoŋi pwooni dem yiga ne, se nɔɔna lɔre we o kikia maama tɔge Wɛ boboŋa mo. Jɔn daa ŋɔɔne Yezu yera taane

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Konto déem na kɛ to, Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba beeri Judea te-balwa bam wone. O ma dáane de-ba jei sem konto ne, ye o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Jɔn tɔgena badwonna déem ma mage ni-kantɔgɔ de Juu tu wodwoŋi de nɔɔna na jege se ba zare ba tete tei se ko tɔge ba chullu tem chekke to.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Ba ma vo Jɔn tei ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Berem tu, dé nɛ nɔɔno wolo daama na wo nmo tei ne ye n wo Jɔdan buga kam bubɛ dedwoŋi dem ne to. Nmo tage o taane n bere debam. Leile konto o laam wora o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm, ye nɔɔna dedɛ tiini ba vei o tei ba daare debam. Ko lana na?”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Jɔn ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko wo chɔge. Nɔɔno ná tɔge chwoŋa kalo, ko ye Wɛ mo tiŋi-ka o pa‑o.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Abam tete wó zege amo kwaga ne de a na tage a we, amo dae Wɛ Dam Tu wom, se ko ye Wɛ mo toŋe-ne se a tɔge o Bu wom yiga a ba.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Yezu yere dem jege se de taa zaŋa mo, se amo yere dem taa wo tega ne.

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Wolo wom na nwoŋi Wɛ tei o ba to mo ye nɔn-kamunu o dwoi nɔɔno maama. Ko daare wolo na nwoŋi logo baŋa to ye logo baŋa nyem mo. O ni taane de maa ye logo baŋa nyem. Wolo wom na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao to nam mo dwoi maama.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: O yeini o tɛ kolo o na lɔre Wɛ tei ne to mo o bere nɔɔna. De konto de, nɔɔna ba sɛ o berem dem.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná sɛ o berem dem, konto tu sɛ we Wɛ ye chega mo.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, ko ná ye wolo wom Wɛ na toŋe to, Wɛ pɛ‑o o Sin-laao kom mo se ko tiini ko gaale, pa se ko ye Wɛ tete ni taane mo o tɛa.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ swoi o Bu wom. O ma pa se woŋo maama dam wo o jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. Ko daare nɔɔno wolo na ve Wɛ Bu wom to bá fɔge o na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Wɛ ban-lom nam wó taa wo o baŋa ne taa.”

english_verse: But Jesus' disciples were really the ones doing the baptizing, and not Jesus himself. Jesus and the Samaritan Woman
translation_verse: Ko nam dae Yezu tete mo pɛ ba jwoŋi sɛɛm, se ko ye o kwaga tɔgena bam mo ke konto.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: O na maa vei konto to, o jege se o tɔge Samaria wo mo o kɛ.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma ta de Yezu o we, “Nmo ye Juu tu mo, ye amo ye Samaria tiina kaane. Bɛ mo ye n ta we, a ke na a pa‑m?” Kaane wom tage konto kolo ŋwaane ko ke‑o yaau mo, kokuri Juu tiina de Samaria tiina ware daane.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, nmo ba jege gwoŋo, ye vole dem luuna. Nmo nam wó ke tɛ mo n mɔ na balo na jege jworo ba pae nabiina to?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Nmo nam bá wane n ta‑n dwoi dé nabaaro Jakob wolo déem na koge vole dento o pa debam to. Wonto tete, de o bia, de o vara maama déem mɔɔne na ywo-seeni mo faŋa faŋa ye ba nyɔa.”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye na balo amo na wó pa nɔɔna to, na-nyɔm daa bá ja wolo na nyɔge-ba to. Na bam a na wó pa to wó ji buli-yi o yera ne, ye de wó taa bura na balo na wó pa‑o ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Kaane wom daa ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, pa-ne na bam konto dwoŋi, se na-nyɔm daa yé ja-ne se a taa tui ywo a mɔɔne na.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta‑o o we, o véi o bwoŋi o baro se o da o ba.

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: Nmo nam zo banna banu mo, ye nmo na wo nɔɔno wolo tei ne leile to seene o dae n baro. Ko ye chega mo n tage n bere-ne.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, amo lɔre we n ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Debam Samaria tiina nabaara bam déem tui peo konto yuu mo ba ware Wɛ. Ko daare abam Juu tiina bere we, ko maŋe se nɔɔna taa ware Wɛ Jerusalem teo ne mo.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Kaane, jwoŋi a taane dem. Maŋa wó ba ye nɔɔna ná lage ba ware dé Kwo Wɛ, ko bá taa ye peo kom yuu ne, naa Jerusalem teo wone.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Abam Samaria tiina yeiri wolo á na zuli to. Debam Juu tiina nam yei wolo dé na zuli to, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ yeini o da Juu tiina bam jeŋa mo o vere nabiina.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa maa beena leile konto, ye balo na seene ba zuli dé Kwo Wɛ chekke to wó tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo ba zuli‑o de ba bochara de chega. Mo dé Kwo Wɛ na lage se nabiina taa zuli‑o tei to.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye siu mo. Balo maama na lage ba pa‑o zula to jege se ba tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane ba zuli‑o de ba bochara de chega.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma ta o we, “Amo yei we Wɛ Dam Tu wolo yere na ye Krista to mo wó ba. O nam ná tua, o wó ta Wɛ chega kam maama o bere debam.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Ko ye amo mo konto, a zege a ŋɔɔne de nmo.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam laam ma jwoori ba ba. Ba na nɛ Yezu na zege o ŋɔɔne de kaane konto to, ko ma tiini ko ke-ba yaau. De konto de, ba wolowolo nam wo bwei ba we, “Bɛ mo nmo laga?” naa “Bɛ mo ye n ŋɔɔne de kaane wom?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Kaane wom laam ma yage o kɔɔro wom ye o daare o vo teo kom wo. O na yi da to, o ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Ba-na á nii nɔɔno, o na tage amo na ke kolo maama to o bere-ne. A yeiri wonto mo wó taa ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom naa wɔ mo.”

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Konto déem na wora ko ke to, Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ma lwoori‑o se o di wodiu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo maŋe a jege wodiu se a di, ye abam yeiri ko ni ne.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam laam ma bwei daane ba we, “Nɔɔno ga mo jaane wodiu o ba o pa‑o na?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko ná ye amo ni-wodiu, ko ye se a tɔge wolo wom na toŋe-ne to boboŋa mo, se a toŋe o totoŋa yam a ti.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á tɛ á we, ‘Ko daare chane sena mo se dé zage mena.’ Amo nam tɛ abam se á fɔge á nii kadwi sem na ye tei. Se nye de se mena yam bege ya ti, ye ya laam daare zagem mo.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Taane dento ye chega mo: ‘Nɔɔno mo dugi mena, wodwoŋi laam ma zage.’

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Samaria tiina kaane wom ya tage o bere o teo kom tiina we, Yezu tage omo na ke kolo maama to o bere-o. Ko ma pa Samaria tiina dedɛ ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Samaria tiina bam ma vo Yezu tei ba lwoori‑o se o dáane ba tei ne. O ma ke da yalei de-ba.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ daa ta ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o, o ni taane dem ŋwaane.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Ba ma ta de kaane wom ba we, “Dé laam ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o, ye ko dae nmo na tage kolo n bere debam to ŋwaane, se debam tete nigi o taane, ye dé kwori dé lɔre we, wonto mo seene o ye nabiina Vereno wom.” Yezu yɔɔre dedɛɛro wodwoŋi bu

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Yezu tete nam mo yeini o tɛ o we, ba ba nege Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu o tete teo ne.

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Yezu na vei o yi Galili to, nɔɔna ma jeeri‑o lanyerane, kolo ŋwaane ba ya na vei Jerusalem se ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem to, ba nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo maama o na ke da to.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma jwoori o vo Galili teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Kana. Ko maa ye jei selo o ya na pɛ na bam ji sa-soŋo da to. O na yi da to, dedɛɛro wodwoŋi maa wora o na nwoŋi Kaparenia, ye o bu laam daare sɔŋɔ ne, o ba jege yazura.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: O na lɔre we Yezu nwoŋi Judea ne o ba Galili to, o ma vo o tei o lwoori‑o se o vo Kaparenia o yɔɔre o bu wom, o na lage o te to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Abam ná wo nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo na bere we Wɛ toŋe-ne to, abam bá fɔge á sɛ amo.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Véi, se n bu wom daa bá te.” Nɔɔno wom ma ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu na tage tei to, ye o zaŋe o viiri.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: O ta na wo chwoŋa ne o maa vei sɔŋɔ to mo o tontoŋena jeeri‑o, ye ba ta ba we, “N bu wom yera yam gara.”

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ba o we, “Maŋa kɔ mo ko gare bu wom yera ne?” Ba ma ta ba we, “Ko ye diim, wea tetare ne mo, o paa kam yage‑o.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba na tage konto to, nɔɔno wom ma guli we ko ye maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo Yezu tage o we, o bu wom daa bá te. O de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama laam ma ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Konto to, Yezu na nwoŋi Judea ne o jwoori o ba Galili ye o ke wo-kenkagele delo to mo ke kuni belei.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe Yezu ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem se o tɔge o di Juu tiina kuri dedwoŋi.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Chɔgɔ kodwoŋi mo wora, ko na bwola de teo kom ni delo yere na ye ‘Pei Ni dem’ to. Ko yere de Juu tiina taane dem mo ye Bɛtezada. Ba déem tei pwei senu mo chɔgɔ kom ni ne.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo wora o na ye jaweeno nenɛɛne bena fintɔ-nana (

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: Abam wo jwoŋi o taane dem á ke á bochara ne, kolo ŋwaane á wo sɛ wolo wom o na toŋe to.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma na o na tigi da to, ye o maane we o weele ko dáane. O ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, “Nmo lage se n na yazura na?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Jaweeno wom ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, chɔgɔ kom na bam ná yeini ba pɔgele konto dwoŋi, amo ba jege nɔɔno wolo na wó kwei-ne o ja tu na bam wone to. Amo ná yeini a kwaane se a tu, nɔɔno mo wó tu lela o daare amo.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Zaŋe wɛɛne se n kwei n sara kam n ta‑n via.”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, nɔɔno wom ma seene o na yazura bedwe baŋa ne, ye o kwei o sara kam o maa via. Ko déem ye Juu tiina siu dɛ ne mo konto kea.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam ma ta de nɔɔno wom ba we, “Zem ye debam siu dɛ mo, ye ko chula se nɔɔno taa toŋe totoŋa. Konto ŋwaane, yé ta‑n zei n sara kam.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Nɔɔno wolo na pɛ amo na yazura to mo tage we, a kwei a sara kam a taa via.”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nɔɔno wom konto ye wɔ mo, ye o ta konto?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: O maa yeiri wolo na pɛ o na yazura yam to, kolo ŋwaane Yezu zo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wo pa o daa wo nɛ‑o.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Ko na ke fee to, Yezu ma vo Wɛ diga kam o na‑o da. O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nii mo! Nmo laam nɛ yazura. Nam daa‑n yé ke wɛleere. Ko ná dae konto, wo-lɔŋɔ kolo na dwoi konto to daa wó ke nmo.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom laam ma vo o ta de Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam o we, ko ye Yezu ya mo yɔɔre omo. Yezu jege dam

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam déem maa wora ba daane Yezu, o na yɔɔre jaweeno ba siu dɛ dem ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “Amo Kwo Wɛ yeini o ke kolo o boboŋa na lage to mo maŋa maama, ko woli de zem de. Amo de nam jege se a ke konto mo.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ko ma pa Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam tiini ba boŋe o gom. Ko nam dae we o na chɔge ba siu dɛ chullu tem yerane to ŋwaane, se ko ye o na tage we, Wɛ ye omo tete Kwo mo to. O keim dem konto ma pa se o de Wɛ ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, amo na ye Wɛ Bu wom to, a bá wane a ke kolokolo a tete ne, se kolo yerane a na nae a Kwo tei ne to mo a yeini a ke. A Kwo na ke kolo to mo amo de wó ke.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Kokuri Baŋa Wɛ swoi o Bu wom, ye o maa bere‑o kolo maama o tete na ke to. O nam wó bere‑o wo-kamunnu telo na dwoi tento to se o ke, pa se ko ke abam yaau.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ na bi nɔɔna toone wone ye o pa-ba ŋwea tei to, konto dwoŋi o Bu wom de wó pa balo o na lage to na ŋwea o Kwo Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Baŋa Wɛ tete bá di nɔɔn-nɔɔno bora. O nam seene o pa o Bu wom chwoŋa se o taa di nɔɔna bora.

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa se nɔɔna maama zuli Wɛ Bu wom, ne ba na zuli o Kwo tete tei to. Wolo maama na ba zuli Wɛ Bu wom to ta ba zuli o Kwo na toŋe‑o to de.”

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: Yezu ta ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo maama na nigi amo taane ye o daare o ke o wo-dedoa de wolo na toŋe-ne to jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to. O daa bá to bora borem dɛ dem ne. O maŋe o jege ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne, ye toone daa bá wane de ja‑o Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, maŋa maa beena leile konto, ye balo na ba jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to wó ni amo kwora. Balo na sɛ-ka to wó daare ba na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete na ye ŋwea tu to, o ma pa se amo wolo na ye o Bu wom to de ji ŋwea tu.

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: O ma kwori o pa-ne chwoŋa se a taa bore nabiina bora, amo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Yé pa se ko ke abam yaau de amo na tage kolo to. Maŋa maa beena, ye twa balo maama na wo ba yibeela wone to wó ni amo kwora,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: ye ba zaŋe ba nwoŋi ba yibeela yam wone. Balo maama na ke lanyerane to wó bi ba taa ŋwe Wɛ tei ne. Ko daare balo maama na ke wo-lwanno to wó bi, ye ba laam na chɔgem Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: Amo bá wane a ke kolokolo amo tete ne. Amo tɔge a Kwo ni mo a maa bore nɔɔna bora. Konto ŋwaane a borem dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo, kolo ŋwaane amo ba kwaane se a ke tei amo tete boboŋa na lage to. Baŋa Wɛ nam toŋe-ne, ye a ke kolo o na lage to mo.”

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Yezu ta ma ta de Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam o we, “Amo tete yerane ya ná bere a chega kam, ko bá bere we a taane dem seene de ye chega.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
