translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi nam zege amo chega kam kwaga ne, ye a yei we wonto jege chega de o na tɛ amo taane tei to.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Abam ya toŋe nɔɔna Jɔn tei ne. O ma ta chega o bere-ba amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo, a ya ba lage se nabiinu zaŋe o bere we a jege chega. Amo nam tage Jɔn taane abam ŋwaane mo, se ko wane ko woli abam se á na verem.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Jɔn déem nye de kanea na jege mini ye ka pae pwooni tei to. Abam ma sɛ se á ta‑á tɔge o berem dem de wopwolo, ne nɔɔna na swoi mini pwooni tei to, ye á daa wo peene se á da-o.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Amo nam jege woŋo kolo na wó bere we a jege chega to ye ko dwoi Jɔn na tage tei to. Totoŋa yam amo Kwo Wɛ na pɛ-ne se a toŋe a ti to, ko ye yanto mo a jege a ke, ye yanto mo pa-ne chega we, Wɛ mo seene o toŋe-ne.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, amo Kwo Wɛ tete de zege amo chega kam kwaga ne mo. Abam nam wo fɔge á ni o kwora, naa á nɛ o yibia na nye tei to.

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Abam yeini á kwaane á zamese Wɛ twanno tem, kolo ŋwaane á boŋe we á wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne tento ŋwaane mo. Ko nam ye amo yera taane mo twanno tem konto tete na tɛa.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Abam nam ta ba sɛ se á ba amo tei, se ko pa á na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: Amo nam ba boŋe se nabiina pa amo zula.

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye abam, amo yei á wo. A yei we Wɛ swono tera á bochara ne.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Amo nam jaane a Kwo yere mo a ba, ye abam nam ve se á jeeri-ne. Nɔɔno wolo nam ná jaane o tete yere o ba, á wó jeeri konto tu.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Abam nam lage se á ta‑á jwoŋi zula mo da-tei ne, ye á ba lage se á ke kolo na wó pa á na zula Wɛ wolo na ba jege dwoŋi to tei ne. Konto mo á ve se á sɛ Wɛ.

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ko dae we amo mo wó saŋe abam a Kwo Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye Moses mo lage o saŋe abam, ye abam ya boŋe we á wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne wonto ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Abam ya ná seene á sɛ Moses na tage tei to, á ya wó sɛ amo de, kolo ŋwaane wonto popone amo yera taane mo.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Abam nam maŋe á wo sɛ o na popone tei to. Konto to, abam bere á bá sɛ amo na tage kolo to.”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Ba ma twɛ ka maama ba su kayɛ fuga-selei. Bworobworo tenu tem ba na di ba daare to mumuga yerane mo konto.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Ba ma boŋe se ba pa Yezu zo nabworo kom, de ba pɔpɔ ba yi bubɛ jei selo ba na maa vei to. Yezu pae nɔɔna nae ŋwea Wɛ tei ne

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Wo-kenkagele dwi dɔ mo nmo wó ke se dé wane dé lɔre we Wɛ seene o toŋe nmo, se dé laam sɛ dé pa nmo? Nmo wó ke bɛ mo?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ba amo tei, ye ko dae we amo Kwo Wɛ mo wó vaŋe konto tu jeŋa se o ba amo tei. Amo wó bi konto tu logo baŋa kweelim dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Nii bu wodwoŋi mo wo ywo-seeni, o jege bworobworo-balɛ senu de ywona yalei. Tento nam bá wane te yi nɔɔna banto maama.”

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: Ba ma zo nabworo ba tɔge naneo kom wo ba maa vei Kaparenia. Tega maa fɔge ka yia ye Yezu daa ta wo tu ba tei.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe Yezu ma zaŋe o vo o bɛ naneo kolo yere na ye Galili to. Nɔɔna badaara bwoi-ko we Tiberia mo.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ maa tɔge o kwaga, ba na nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo o na ke o yɔɔre jaweena to ŋwaane.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Jewish festival of Passover, and Jesus went up on a mountain with his disciples and sat down.
translation_verse: Ko ma daare fenfee se Juu tiina di ba kuri delo yere na ye Atɔgebabaŋa to. Yezu ma vo o di peo yuu o jeini da de o tɔgena bam.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Filipi ma leiri‑o o we, “Dé ná lage se dé yeigi bworobworo se nɔɔno maama na fenfee o di, ko sabu kom wó dwoni nɔɔno dedoa chane seredo ŋweero mo.”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: O tɔgena bam dedoa, Anduru wolo na ye Simon Piita nyaane to ma ta o we,

english_verse: men were in the crowd.
translation_verse: ), ko woli de kaana de bia.

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Yezu ma kwei bworobworo-balɛ sem ye o ke Wɛ lei. O ma daare o maŋe-te o pa nɔɔna bam na jei tega ne to. O ma ke ywona yam de konto dwoŋi. Nɔɔna bam maama ma di ne ba na lage tei to.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Ba ma di ba su ba daare. Yezu ma ta de o tɔgena bam o we, “Véi-na á twɛ mumuga kalo na daare to, se á yé pa dé yage kolokolo.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma lɔre we ba lage ba ma dam mo ba ja‑o ba pa o ji ba pɛ. O na lɔre konto to, o ma zaŋe o jwoori o vo o di peo yuu o wora o yerane. Yezu vei na baŋa ne Matiyu

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo na maŋe naneo kom bubɛ dedwoŋi dem ne to ma maane we nabworo dedoa yerane ya mo wora. Ba maa yei we Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam kɛ ba daare‑o mo, ye o wo dɛ o zo ba nabworo kom o kɛ.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Abam nam yé ta‑á toŋa á lage wodiu kolo na wó ba ko pɔ to yerane. Ko daare, ta‑á ke kolo na wó pa á na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to. Amo wolo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to wó pa á na wodiu konto dwoŋi, kolo ŋwaane a Kwo Wɛ mo tiŋi-ne se a taa toŋa a pa‑o.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Ko popone faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori tɔnɔ kom ne ko we, ‘Ba maama wó zamese Wɛ tete tei ne.’ Wolo maama nam na jwoŋi a Kwo Wɛ taane dem ye o kwori o zamese-de to wó ba amo tei.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam laam ma tiini ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto wó ke tɛ mo o pa debam o ya-nɔna yam se dé di?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Tega na yi to, Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ma vo ba yi naneo kom ni.

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Vo-dɛɔ laam ma zaŋe ko fula ye ko mage na bam.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena bam ma yuŋi nabworo kom ba vo ba yi nenɛɛne mɛɛla yatɔ. Ba laam ma na Yezu na vei na bam baŋa ne o maa beene ba tei. Foone ma zo-ba.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone, se ko ye amo mo.”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Nabwooru tedwonna na nwoŋi Tiberia te ba to laam ma yi bubɛ delo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na wora to. Ko maa ye jei selo dé Teiru Yezu ya na ke Wɛ lei wodiiru tem ŋwaane ye o daare o pa nɔɔna bam di to.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na lɔre we Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam daa tera to, ba ma zo nabwooru tem wo ba maa vei Kaparenia se ba beeri‑o.

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na bɛ naneo kom to, ba ma na Yezu. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Berem tu, maŋa kɔ mo n tu ywoba?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam na kare á beeri amo tei to, ko dae á na nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo na bere we Wɛ toŋe-ne to ŋwaane. Ko nam ye á na di wodiiru tem á daare to ŋwaane mo á lage amo.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma bwei‑o ba we, “Debam nam wó ke tɛ mo se dé taa toŋe Wɛ totoŋa?”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to, dé nabaara déem na wo kagoa yuu ne maŋa kalo to, ba di wodiu kolo yere na ye ‘Manna’ to, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na tage tei ko we, ‘O pɛ-ba wodiu kolo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to pa ba di.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, ko dae Moses mo pɛ abam wodiu kolo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to. Ko nam ye amo Kwo Wɛ mo pae abam wodiu chekke kolo na seene ko nwoŋi telaao ne to.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Wɛ wodiu kom ye kolo na nwoŋi telaao ne ye ko tu logo baŋa ko pae nabiina ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam tu, ta‑n pae debam wodiu kom konto maŋa maama.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta-ba o we, “Amo mo ye wodiu kolo na pae nɔɔna ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to. Wolo maama ná sɛ se o ba amo tei, kana daa bá ja konto tu. Wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa de amo, na-nyɔm daa bá ja kotu.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Amo maŋe a ta a bere abam we, á yia nɛ-ne ye á ta ba jege wo-dedoa de amo.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo maama amo Kwo Wɛ na ke amo jeŋa ne to wó ba a tei. Wolo maama nam ná tu amo tei, a bá fɔge a zeili kotu.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane amo nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne a ba se a ke wolo wom na toŋe-ne to boboŋa mo, se ko dae amo tete boboŋa.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Wolo wom na toŋe-ne to boboŋa na lage kolo to mo ye se a yé yage pa balo maama o na ke amo jeŋa ne to wolowolo jei, se a daare a pa ba maama bi logo baŋa kweelim dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Amo Kwo Wɛ boboŋa lage se wolo maama ná jege teena o Bu wom tei ne ye o ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o, se konto tu na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim o tei ne to. Amo wó seene a bi konto tu logo baŋa kweelim dɛ dem ne pa se o na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam konto.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam maa jege‑o ba poona de o na tage o we, omo mo ye wodiu kolo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to.

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Ba maa tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto dae Yezu wolo na ye Josɛf bu to mo na? Dé yei o kwo de o nu. Bɛ mo ye o wane o ta we, o nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne mo o ba?”

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Yage-na á pompona kam.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we nɔɔno yia mo nɛ amo Kwo Wɛ, se amo wolo na nwoŋi o tei to yerane mo nɛ‑o.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo na ke o wo-dedoa de amo to mo jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Amo ye wodiu kolo na pae nɔɔna ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye wodiu kolo na seene ko nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne to, wolo ná di-ko, toone daa bá ja konto tu Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam wolo ná wo di amo Nabiin-bu wom ya-nɔna yam ye o daare o nyɔ a jana bam, Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam bá zo kotu bochare.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná di a ya-nɔna yam ye o daare o nyɔ a jana bam, konto tu jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Amo wó bi‑o logo baŋa kweelim dɛ dem ne.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Amo ya-nɔna yam mo ye wodiu kolo na ye chekke to, de a jana bam de.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Wolo na di amo ya-nɔna yam, ye o daare o nyɔ a jana bam to me de amo, ye amo tigi konto tu bochare ne.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Amo Kwo Wɛ na ye ŋwea tu to mo toŋe-ne. Ko nam ye wonto ŋwaane mo amo de jege ŋwea. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de wolo ná di amo ya-nɔna yam, konto tu wó taa ŋwe amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Mo Yezu déem na tage tei Kaparenia ne o bere balo na wo Juu tiina jeerim diga kam wone to.

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam dedɛ na nigi konto to, ba ma ta ba we, “O taane dem tiini de dana. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o jwoŋi-de.”

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, á ná nɛ Nabiin-bu wom na maa jwoori o diini Wɛ telaao o na maŋe o nwoŋi mɛ to, abam wó wane á sɛ konto na?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pae nɔɔna ŋwea o tei ne. Ko daare nabiina dam bá wane kolokolo de ke. Amo na tage taane delo de abam to bere Wɛ na wó fɔge nabiina bochara de o ŋwe-doŋa kam tei to.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: De konto de, abam badaara ta wo sɛ.” Yezu tage konto kolo ŋwaane boboa ne mo o maŋe o yei balo na bá sɛ‑o to, de wolo na wó ba o yeigi‑o o pa nɔɔna to.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: O daa ma ta o we, “Konto ŋwaane mo amo tage a bere abam we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ba amo tei, ye ko dae we amo Kwo Wɛ mo tiŋi chwoŋa o pa kotu.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Konto na ke to, o tɔgena dedɛ ma jwoori o kwaga ne, ye ba daa ba tɔge‑o.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de o tontoŋena fuga-balei bam o we, “Abam de wó taa lage se á yage amo na?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Simon Piita ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo tu, se dé laam vo wɔ tei? Nmo mo ŋɔɔne taane delo na pae nɔɔna ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: Debam laam sɛ nmo, ye dé ba dé lɔre we, nmo ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu wolo Wɛ na toŋe to mo.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo le abam fuga-balei bam, abam dedoa nam ye setaane nyem mo.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ko ye Judas wolo na ye Simon Yisakara bu to taane mo. Wonto tɔge o wo Yezu tontoŋena fuga-balei bam wone, ye o laam wó ba o yeigi Yezu o pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Yezu déem maa wo Galili ne o beera. O déem maa ba lage se o vo Judea o beeri da, kolo ŋwaane Juu tiina balo na wo dáane to lage chwoŋa mo se ba go‑o.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Yezu nyaana ma ta ded‑o ba we, o yage Galili jei sem se o daare o vo Judea se o kwaga tɔgena bam wane ba na totoŋa yalo o na jege o ke to.

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Ba na tage tei to bere we ba tete ta wo ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Nabiina bá wane ba taa chuli abam. Ba nam chuli amo, kolo ŋwaane amo yɔɔre a tɛ-ba jaja mo we ba kikia ba tɔge chwoŋa.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Abam nam véi-na á di kuri dem, se amo ta bá vo leile, kolo ŋwaane amo maŋa kam ta wo yi ka ti se a bere a tete jaja.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o ma maŋe Galili ne.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Juu tiina balo na wo kuri dem ne to maa kare ba beeri‑o ye ba we, “O wo yei ne mo?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na wora to maa tiini ba jege o taane ba waasa. Nɔɔna badwonna maa tɛ ba we, “O ye nɔn-ŋom mo.” Badaara maa tɛ ba we, “Aawo, o dae konto, se o jege nɔɔna bam o gane mo.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo tage o taane jaja, ba na kɔre Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Ba na di kuri dem ba yi de da yam tetare to, Yezu laam ma vo o zo Wɛ diga kam o wora o bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo na bere tei to dae amo tete nyem, se ko ye wolo na toŋe-ne to nyem mo.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná ŋɔɔne de o tete dam, konto tu kwaane se o na yere mo o pa o tete. Ko daare wolo nam ná kwaane se o lage yere o pa wolo na toŋe‑o to, konto tu mo ye wolo na jege chega, ye o ba jege tusim kolokolo baŋa ne.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Moses nam maŋe o pa abam lɔre Wɛ nia yam. Abam wolowolo nam ba tɔge-ya. Bɛ mo ye abam kwaane á lage chwoŋa se á go amo?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “N yirisi mo. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba lage nmo gom.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo ke totoŋ-kamunu dedoo siu dɛ ne, ye abam ye yaau.

english_verse: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
translation_verse: Moses déem pɛ abam ni se á ta‑á gwoni á bia peina. Ko nam maŋe ko dae we Moses mo pɛ se ko bobo. Ko nam ye abam nabaara mo bobo-ko. Moses na pɛ abam ni dem konto to, abam wae á gwoni á bia peina siu dɛ dem ne, se ko yé pa á chɔge Wɛ ni dem konto.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Abam na jege chwoŋa se á ke konto dwoŋi siu dɛ dem ne to, bɛ mo ye abam jege ban-zɔŋɔ de amo na yɔɔre jaweeno siu dɛ dem ne pa o na yazura to ŋwaane?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na zoore Jerusalem ne to badaara laam maa tɛ Yezu taane ba we, “Ko dae nɔɔno wonto mo ba kwaane se ba go na?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Nii-na o na ke tei. O zege o ŋɔɔne mo jaja, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ba tɛ kolokolo se ba che‑o. Debam dedɛɛra bam daa wo boŋe we wonto mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom naa bɛ mo?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Debam maama yei wonto na nwoŋi mɛ to. Ko nam ná ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá taa yei o na nwoŋi mɛ.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Yezu déem na wo Wɛ diga kam wone o bere nɔɔna to, o ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa mo o we, “Ko ye chega mo, abam yei amo, ye á kwori á yei amo na nwoŋi mɛ to. Amo nam wo tu a tete ne, se ko ye nɔɔno mo toŋe-ne, ye wonto ye chekke mo. Abam nam yeiri‑o.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Amo mo yei‑o, kolo ŋwaane a nwoŋi o tei mo, ye wonto nam mo toŋe-ne.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, ba laam ma kwaane se ba ja‑o. O maŋa kam ta na wo yi to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo nɛ chwoŋa se o ke‑o kolokolo.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna dedɛ ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Wɛ Dam Tu wom ná tua, o bá wane o ke wo-kenkagela dedɛ se ko dwoni wonto na maŋe o ke tei to.”

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam ma ni nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na waasa wonnu tento ba tɛ Yezu taane tei to. Ba de Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam laam ma toŋe ba nɔɔna se ba vo ba ja Yezu.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta o we, “Amo bá tiini a dáane abam tei ne. Ko ná ke fee, amo wó jwoori a vo wolo wom na toŋe-ne to tei.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Abam nam wó beeri amo jei á ga, kolo ŋwaane amo na wo mɛ to, abam bá wane da á vo.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam maa ŋɔɔne daane ba we, “O boŋe se o vo yei ne mo ye debam bá na‑o? O ga boŋe se o vo Juu tiina balo na zoore Girisi tiina teene dem ne to tei mo, se o taa bere-ba na?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Dé yeiri o taane dem kuri de o na tage o we, debam wó beeri omo jei dé ga, ye o ta we, omo na wo mɛ to, debam bá wane da dé vo.”

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Ko déem ma ba ko yi kuri dem tiim dɛ. Dɛ dem konto mo ye kuri dem dɛ-kamunu. Dɛ dem konto ne Yezu maa zege da o ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa o we, “Na-nyɔm ná jege wolo maama, se o ba amo tei o nyɔ.

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Yezu na tage na bam taane konto to, ko ye se o bere Wɛ na wó ke o Sin-laao kom balo na sɛ omo to bochara ne tei to mo. Kanto maŋa ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ya daa ta wo tu ba tei, Yezu daa ta na wo jwoori o bi o na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Wɛ tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom déem na nigi Yezu na tage tei to, nɔɔna badaara maa tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto seene o ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu wolo na maŋe se o ba to mo.”

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere we, Wɛ Dam Tu wom wó taa ye Pɛ David dwi tu mo ye o nwoŋi Bɛtelehem, teo kolo David déem na zoore da to.”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Konto baŋa ne, popɔra déem ma ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom wo Yezu ŋwaane.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Badaara lage se ba ja‑o, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo nɛ chwoŋa se kotu ke‑o kolokolo.

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam na toŋe nɔɔna balo to ma jwoori ba vo ba tei. Ba ma bwei-ba ba we, “Bɛ mo ye á wo jaane‑o á ba?”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam ma ta-ba ba we, “Abam pɛ se o gane abam de mo na?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Debam de dé dedɛɛra bam wolowolo wo sɛ‑o. Abam yeiri konto na?

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam nɔɔno dedoa déem maa tɔge o wora, o yere mo Nikodema. Wonto mo ye wolo ya na maŋe o vo Yezu tei to. O ma zaŋe o ta de o dwonna bam o we,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam Moses na tiŋi o pa debam to, ya bere we ko chula se dé chɔge nɔɔno, ye dé ta wo bwei‑o dé nii o na ke kolo to.”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Ba laam ma leiri ba we, “Nmo de ye Galili tu mo na? Buŋi jei maama ne, se nmo wó na we, Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu tera o na wó nwoŋi Galili ne.” [

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Ba maama ma jage ba vo ba sam.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Tega na poore tetete to, Yezu ma jwoori o vo o zo Wɛ diga kam. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama ma ba ko gilimi‑o. O ma jeini tega ne o wora o bere-ba.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia zamesem tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam ma ja kaane wolo ba na peere‑o bwoorim baŋa ne to ba ba ba zege ba maama yiga ne.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Ba ma ta de Yezu ba we, “Berem tu, debam peere kaane wonto bwoorim baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Moses na tiŋi Wɛ nia yam o pa debam to, o pɛ debam ni se, kaane ná ke keim dento dwoŋi, se dé dole‑o dé go. Ko nam ná ye nmo, n we dé ke tɛ mo?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Ba na bwei‑o konto to, ba lage se ba maŋe Yezu mo ba nii, ba wó wane ba ja‑o na, se ba laam saŋe‑o. Yezu ma tiiri o ma o noa o la tega ne.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Ba maa zege da ba tiini ba bwei‑o taane dem. O laam ma kwoni wɛɛne ye o ta-ba o we, “Abam wolo na wo ke wɛleere to wae o tɔge yiga o kwei kandwɛ o ma dole kaane wom.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: O laam ma jwoori o tiiri ye o wora o la tega kam de o noa.

english_verse: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
translation_verse: Ba na nigi o na tage tei to, ba nakwa bam mo dɛ yiga ba nwoŋi dedoa dedoa ba viiri. Ba maama ma nwoŋi ba daare Yezu yerane, ye kaane wom daa ta zege da.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: O ma kwoni wɛɛne, ye o bwei kaane wom o we, “Ba vei yei ne mo? Nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo daare se o ŋɔɔne o chɔge nmo na?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, ba wolowolo daa wo daare.” Yezu ma ta o we, “Amo de nam bá ŋɔɔne a chɔge‑m. Véi, se ko zege zem se n daa‑n yé tusi.”] Yezu bere we o jege chega

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma ta de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom o we, “Amo mo ye pwooni a pae nabiina maama. Wolo nam ná tɔge amo, konto tu daa bá beeri lim wone. Konto tu na nɛ ŋwea chekke to, pwooni wó taa wo o tei ne.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Nmo na pae n tete chega to bere we n taane dem ba jege kuri.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo ni taane dem seene de ye chega mo. Amo ná maŋe a pa a tete chega, ko ta ye chega mo, kolo ŋwaane amo yei we Wɛ mo toŋe-ne. Abam nam yeiri amo na nwoŋi mɛ, de mɛ amo na wó vo to.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Abam ná bore nɔɔna daane, á yeini á ma nabiina boboŋa mo, ye ko dae Wɛ boboŋa. Amo nam ba bore nɔɔn-nɔɔno bora.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
translation_verse: Ko daare, amo ná bore nɔɔna bora, amo borem dem wó taa ye chega, kolo ŋwaane a Kwo mo toŋe-ne ye o zege a chega kam kwaga ne. Ko dae amo yerane mo wó di nɔɔna taane.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Amo ye wolo na pae a tete chega, ye amo Kwo na toŋe-ne to de zege a kwaga ne o ŋɔɔna, ye dé jege ni dedwe.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “N kwo wom bɛ?” O ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam yeiri amo na ye wolo to, de amo Kwo wom de. Á ya ná yei amo, á ya wó lɔre amo Kwo wom de.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Yezu déem tage wonnu tento o bere nɔɔna Wɛ diga kam konkɔlɔ kom ne, jeiga kalo Wɛ pɛɛra dakaa kam na wora to. O na tage konto o ti to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno maa wo nɛ chwoŋa se o ja‑o, o maŋa kam ta na wo yi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma ta de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom o we, “Amo wó viiri a daare abam, ye á nam wó beeri amo jei á ga, kolo ŋwaane abam wɛleera yam wó taa wo á yuu ne taa, se ko vo ko yi á toone maŋa. Amo na wó vo mɛ to, abam bá wane da á vo.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam maa tɛ ba we, “O na tage o we, debam bá wane dé vo o na wó vo mɛ to, ko bere we o lage o go o tete mo na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: O ta ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam ye logo baŋa nɔɔna mo, amo nam nwoŋi wɛyuu mo. Abam kugu jei ye logo baŋa ywo mo. Amo kugu jei nam dae logo konto.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo tage a bere abam we, á wɛleera yam wó taa wo á yuu ne taa, se ko vo ko yi á toone maŋa. Abam ná wo sɛ we, amo mo seene a ye wolo na wora taa to, á wó te ye á wɛleera yam ta wo á yuu ne.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo ye wɔ mo?” O ma ta-ba o we, “Ko ye kolo amo na maŋe a ta a bere abam to mo.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Amo jege wonnu dedɛ se a maa ŋɔɔne abam taane a chɔge abam. Wolo wom na toŋe-ne to nam tiini o ye chega tu mo. Amo na nigi kolo o tei ne to yerane mo a tɛ a bere nabiina.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage wonnu tem konto to, ba wo lɔre we ko ye o Kwo Baŋa Wɛ taane mo o ŋɔɔne de-ba.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta de-ba o we, “Maŋa wó ba ye á kwei amo wolo na ye Nabiin-bu wom to á zeiŋi wɛɛne. Á laam wó lɔre we amo seene a ye wolo na wora taa to. Abam ta wó lɔre we amo ba ke kolokolo a tete ne. Amo nam yeini a tɛ wonnu telo amo Kwo wom na bere-ne to yerane mo a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Wolo wom na toŋe-ne to wo amo tei ne, ye o wo yage-ne a yerane, kolo ŋwaane a yeini a ke kolo na pwoli o wo to mo.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Yezu déem na wora o ŋɔɔna konto dwoŋi to, nɔɔna dedɛ laam ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o. Bia tɔge ba kwoa kikia

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta de Juu tiina balo na sɛ‑o to o we, “Abam ná tɔge amo berem dem ye á wo yage, á wó yɔɔre á ta‑á ye amo tɔgena mo.

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: Abam laam wó ba á lɔre chega, ye chega kam wó jwoŋi abam ka yage se á ta‑á tei á tete.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Debam ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo, ye dé nam wo fɔge dé ji nɔɔn-nɔɔno kabɛ. Bɛ ŋwaane mo ye n ta n we, dé wó taa tei dé tete?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo maama na paale o ke wɛleera to ye wɛleera kabaa mo.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye kabaa, ka yeini ka ba zoore ka tu sɔŋɔ ne taa taa. Ko nam ná ye sɔŋɔ kom bu, wonto jege kugu jei se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ Bu wom ná jwoŋi abam o yage, á wó seene á ta‑á tei á tete.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Amo yei we abam seene á ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo. Abam nam ta maa kwaane se á go amo, kolo ŋwaane amo berem dem tera á bochara ne.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Amo déem na wo a Kwo tei ne ye a lɔre wonnu telo to mo a yeini a ŋɔɔna. Abam nam yeini á ke kolo abam kwo na pɛ á lɔre to mo.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Debam kwo mo Abaraham.” O ma ta-ba o we, “Abam ya ná seene á ye Abaraham bia, á ya wó ta‑á ke kikia yalo Abaraham déem na ke to mo.

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: Amo tage chega kalo a na nigi Wɛ tei ne to a bere abam, ye abam kwaane se á go-ne. Abaraham nam wo ke abam keim dem konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Abam yeini á ke kikia yalo á kwo na ke to mo.” Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Debam dae tampira. Wɛ tete yerane mo ye debam Kwo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Baŋa Wɛ ya ná ye abam Kwo, á wó ta‑á swoi amo, kolo ŋwaane amo nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo, ye a laam wora de abam. Amo wo tu a tete ne. Wɛ nam mo toŋe-ne.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye abam ba lɔra amo taane dem? Ko nam na ye tei to, á boboŋa mo ware ya tɔge amo berem dem.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Abam nam ye á kwo setaane nyem mo. Á ma‑á lage se á ta‑á ke wonto boboŋa na lage tei to. Boboa ne to o maŋe o ye nɔn-goro mo. O ba fɔge o tɔge chega chwoŋa, kolo ŋwaane chega tera o bochare ne. O ná yeini o fɔ vwa, ko ye mo o boboŋa na maŋe ya ye tei. O ye vwa-fɔro mo. Wonto nam mo ye vwa-nyena kwo.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo, a yeini a tɛ chega mo. Konto ŋwaane mo abam ba sɛ amo.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Abam wɔ mo wó wane o bere we amo ke a chɔge? Amo na ŋɔɔne chega to, bɛ mo ye á ba sɛ-ne?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Wolo na ye Wɛ nyem to cheigi Wɛ botare mo. Abam nam na dae Wɛ nɔɔna to mo pae á ba cheiga.” Yezu bere we o dwoi Abaraham

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam ma ta de Yezu ba we, “Nmo seene n ye Samaria tu. N nam yirisi mo. Vwa mo dé fɔ na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “A ba yirisa. Amo pae a Kwo wom mo zula. Ko daare abam yiga nam tera amo wone.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo maama ná toŋe o tɔge amo berem dem, toone daa bá ja konto tu.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam laam ma ta ded‑o ba we, “N taane dem nmo na tage to pɛ se dé lɔre we n yirisi mo. Abaraham déem tega, ye Wɛ sampwori sem de maama te. Nmo nam ta tage n we, wolo ná toŋe o tɔge nmo berem dem, toone daa bá ja konto tu.

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Nmo ye nɔn-kamunu n dwoi debam kwo Abaraham mo na? Wonto nam tega. Wɛ sampwori sem de ma te. Nmo bere n tete we n ye wɔ mo?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo ya ná lage yere a pa a tete, konto ye kafɛ mo. Ko ye amo Kwo Wɛ mo zeiŋi a yere, ye ko nam ye wonto ŋwaane mo abam yeini á mage á nyɔɔna á tɛ we, Wɛ delo á na sɛ to.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Abam nam yeiri‑o, ye amo yei‑o. Amo ya ná tage a we, a yeiri‑o, a ya wó taa ye vwa-nyem mo, nenɛɛne abam tei. Amo nam seene a yei‑o, ye a toŋe a tɔge o berem dem.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, ba déem ta na wo loge Abaraham to, amo maŋe a wora mo.”

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, ba ma kwei kandwa se ba ma dole‑o ba go. O laam ma seigi o nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo o maa kɛa. O ma na nɔɔno wodwoŋi ba na maŋe ba lo‑o ye o ye lilwei.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam ma bwei‑o ba we, “Berem tu, wɔ keim-balwaaro mo pɛ ba lo nɔɔno wom ye o ye lilwei? Ko ye o tete keim-balwaaro mo naa o tiina keim-balwaaro mo tei konto?”

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo toŋe-ne. Debam nam jege se dé taa ke o totoŋa yam mo ye wea ta wora. Maŋa daare fenfee yerane se dé taa toŋa. Tega lage ka yi, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Amo ye pwooni tu mo. Amo ta ná wo logo baŋa ne, pwooni wó taa wo nabiina tei ne.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: O na tage konto o ti to, o laam ma twe lileeru o de tega ne. O ma viiri teero de-te, ye o daare o ke-te nɔɔno wom yia ne o pupugi.

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: O ma ta de nɔɔno wom o we, o véi o su o yia yam Siloam chɔgɔ kom ne. Nɔɔno wom ma vo o su o yia yam. O ma jwoori o ba ye o laam nae fase.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: O sɔŋɔ tiina de balo maama na maŋe ba yei‑o ye o ye lwooru to ma na‑o, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Ko dae nɔɔno wonto mo yeini o jei o lwoori to na?”

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Badaara maa tɛ ba we, “Ko ye wonto mo.” Badaara maa we, “Ko dae wonto, se ba nye daane mo.” Nɔɔno wom tete ma ta o we, “Amo mo konto.”

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo yia yam ke tɛ mo ya puri?”

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, “Nɔɔno wolo yere na ye Yezu to mo ke teero o ma pupugi amo yia yam, ye o ta-ne o we, a véi Siloam chɔgɔ kom a su a yia yam. A ma vo a su, ye a laam nae.”

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Konto nɔɔno wom bɛ?” O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo yeiri o jei.”

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem Yezu déem na ke teero tem o ma puri nɔɔno wom yia yam to ya ye Juu tiina siu dɛ mo.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Farisi tiina bam daa ma bwei nɔɔno wom ba we, o yia yam ke tɛ mo ya puri? O ma ta-ba o we, “O ke teero mo a yia ne. A ma su-ya, ye a laam nae.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam badaara ma ta ba we, “Nɔɔno wom na ke konto to, o wo nwoŋi Wɛ tei, kolo ŋwaane o ba tɔge siu dɛ chullu tem.” Badaara de maa tɛ ba we, “O nam na ke wo-kenkagela yanto dwoŋi to, o bá wane o taa ye nɔn-chechɔgero. Wɛ mo wo o tei ne.” Konto ma pa popɔra ba ba wone.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma jwoori ba bwei nɔɔno wom ba we, “O nam na pɛ nmo yia yam puri to, nmo nam tɛ o taane n we bɛ mo?” O ma leiri o we, “O ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam maa ba lage se ba sɛ we nɔɔno wom ya maŋe o ye lilwei mo, ye o laam ba o nae. Konto ŋwaane, ba ma bwoŋi nɔɔno wom tiina se ba bwei ba nii.

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei-ba ba we, “Abam bu mo tento na? Ba loge‑o lilwei mo na? O nam ke tɛ mo o nae leile konto?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom tiina bam ma leiri ba we, “Debam yei we o ye debam bu mo. Dé ta yei we ba loge‑o lilwei mo.

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: Dé nam yeiri o laam na ke tei o nae, ye dé ta yeiri wolo na puri o yia yam. Abam nam bwei-na o tete, se o ye nɔn-kweo mo. O tete wó wane o leiri abam.”

english_verse: The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri o tiina bam chem, ye ba ta ba we, ba nam bwei nɔɔno wom tete, se o ye nɔn-kweo mo.

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Ba ma jwoori ba bwoŋi nɔɔno wom ba na loge‑o lilwei to, ye ba ta ded‑o ba we, “Nam kɔre Wɛ se n ta chega. Debam yei we nɔɔno wom konto ye nɔn-chechɔgɔ mo.”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo yeiri nɔɔno wom konto ye nɔn-chechɔgɔ naa o dae. Kolo yerane amo na yei to mo ye a déem ye lilwei mo, ye a laam ba a nae.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “O ke tɛ mo o puri nmo yia yam?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, “Amo maŋe a ta a bere abam, ye á wo sɛ se á cheigi. Bɛ mo ye abam daa lage se á bwei á nii? Abam de ga wó ta‑á lage se á ta‑á tɔge nɔɔno wom kwaga mo na?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ba ma twe‑o ye ba we, “Ko ye nmo mo tɔge o kwaga. Ko dae debam mo tɔge‑o. Debam nam tɔge Moses bera yam mo.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Dé yei we Wɛ déem ŋɔɔne de Moses. Ko daare ko ná ye nɔɔno wonto, dé maŋe dé yeiri o na nwoŋi mɛ to.”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Aaa. Ko ye kolo na tiini ko so amo to mo! Abam yeiri o na nwoŋi mɛ, ye wonto mo puri amo yia yam.

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Dé yei we Wɛ ba jwoŋi nɔn-chechɔgero taane. Ko ye nɔɔna balo na nege‑o ye ba kikia tɔge o boboŋa na lage tei to mo o jwoŋa.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Ko zege logo baŋa boboa ne se ko ba ko yi zem to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo puri wolo ba na loge‑o lilwei to yia kɔtaa.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wonto ya bá wane o ke wo-kenkagele dento dwoŋi, ko ná dae we o seene o nwoŋi Wɛ tei.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Ba ma jwoori ba leiri‑o ba we, “Bɛ mo ye n boŋe se n kwaane n bere debam? Ba loge nmo ye n maŋe n ye wo-balwaaro tu mo.” Ba laam ma zeili‑o se o daa yé tɔge o zo ba jeerim diga kam.

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma ni we ba le nɔɔno wom ba jeerim diga kam wone. O ma vo o beeri nɔɔno wom. O na nɛ‑o to, o ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo sɛ Nabiin-bu wom de n wo maama na?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, ta n bere-ne o na ye wolo to, se a wane a sɛ‑o.”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo maŋe n na‑o. Amo mo ye Nabiin-bu wom, a zege a ŋɔɔne de nmo.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: O laam ma ta o we, “Amo tu, a sɛ.” O ma kuni dwoona Yezu yiga ne o zuli‑o.

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta o we, “Amo tu logo konto baŋa se a pɔɔre nɔɔna daane de ba bochara na ye tei to mo. Balo na ye lilwoa to yia wó ba ya puri. Balo nam na jege yi-poro to yia wó ba ya dwei.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam ya ná ye lilwoa Wɛ chega kam seeni, á wɛleera ya bá taa wo á yuu ne. Ko daare, á nam na bere we á jege yi-poro to, á wɛleera ta wo á yuu ne mo.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma maŋe memaŋe o bere nɔɔna bam o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nɔɔno wolo ná zo nabwoo se o pore pei, ye o ná wo dɛ manchwoŋo ni o zo ye o ná tɔge jei sedwoŋi o chu ko wone, konto tu ye ŋweeno mo.

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: O ná lage o zo, ba wó pore ba pa‑o. Pei sem wó lɔre o kwora. O maa wó bwoŋi o tete pei sem yera, ye o ja-se o nwoŋi.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: O ná jaane-se o nwoŋi, o maa tɔge se yiga, ye pei sem tɔge o kwaga, kolo ŋwaane se yei o kwora.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nɔn-gaa, se bá sɛ se tɔge‑o. Se nam wó duri se viiri mo, kolo ŋwaane se yeiri o kwora.”

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yezu na mɛ memaŋe dem konto o bere-ba to, ba maa wo lɔre ko kuri.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Yezu daa ma ta o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, amo mo ye ni delo pei sem na tɔge da to.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Nayera balo maama na dɛ yiga ba ba ye ba lwoori amo to nye de ŋweena de venverena mo. Pei sem maa wo sɛ ba ni.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Ŋweeno ná tu o zo, o lage se o ŋɔ mo o go o di o daare o ja o chɔge. Ko nam ná ye amo, a tu se a pa nabiina mo na ŋwea de ka ywoni maama.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye nayero chekke ye a swoi a nɔɔna. Nayero chekke wó sɛ se o te o pei sem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye wolo na yere pei sem o jwoŋi sabu to, wonto dae nayero wolo na tei pei sem to. Wonto ná nɛ nywoŋ-kura na maa beena, o wó duri mo o daare pei sem. Nywoŋ-kura kam maa wó zo pei sem wo pa se jage.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Wolo wom na tɔge pei sem o jwoŋi sabu to yiga tera se wone. Konto ŋwaane mo o wó duri o daare-se.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye nayero wom chekke. Amo me de a nɔɔna bam, ye ba de me de amo,

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: nenɛɛne amo Kwo na me de amo, ye amo de me ded‑o tei to. Amo maa sɛ se a te a nɔɔna bam ŋwaane, ne nayero chekke na wó te o pei sem ŋwaane tei to.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: Amo pei sem sedaara wora, se na tere Juu tiina kɔgɔ kom wone. Amo nam jege se a vo a kale-se mo a ja ba a ke daane. Pei sento de wó ni amo kwora. Konto to, a pei sem maama wó taa ye pei-kɔgɔ dedoa ye nayero dedoa nii-se.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: A Kwo Wɛ swoi amo, de a na sɛ se a te a pa a nɔɔna bam, se a daare a bi a na ŋwea to ŋwaane.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o pa a ga a ŋwea. Amo tete nam mo wó kwei-ka a tiŋi dáa ne de a boboŋa. A jege chwoŋa se a pa a ŋwea kam jei. A nam ta jege chwoŋa se a jwoori a bi a daa na-ka. Mo ni delo amo Kwo na pɛ-ne se a ke to.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto o ti to, popɔra daa ma ba Juu tiina bam wo o taane dem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Ba dedɛ maa tɛ ba we, “Setaane mo tɔge‑o pa se o yuu tera. Bɛ mo ye á cheigi o taane?”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Ko daare badaara maa tɛ ba we, “Setaane na tɔge nɔɔno wolo to bá wane o ta taana yanto dwoŋi. Setaane nyem bá wane o puri lilwei yia.” Yezu bere we o de o Kwo Wɛ ye bedwe

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma vo Wɛ diga kam. O maa wo Solomon konkɔlɔ kom ne o kaaga.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Juu tiina badaara laam ma ba ba zege ba gilimi‑o, ye ba bwei‑o ba we, “Nmo ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom mo na? Bɛ mo ye n pa dé jege boboŋa taa taa? Ta chega n bere debam se dé kɔ ko jworo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo maŋe a ta a bere abam, ye á ba sɛ a ni. Totoŋa yalo amo Kwo Wɛ na pɛ-ne se a taa ke to mo bere we a jege chega.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Abam nam ba sɛ amo ni, kolo ŋwaane abam dae amo nyem. Abam dae amo pei sem.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Amo pei sem yei amo kwora. Amo maa me de-se, ye se tɔge-ne.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: Amo pae a nɔɔna bam na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne mo, ye ba dwi bá ti maŋa de maŋa. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o vere-ba amo tei ne.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Ko ye amo Kwo Wɛ mo kwei-ba o ke a jeŋa ne. Wonto nam dwoi woŋo maama. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o vere-ba o tei ne.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Amo de a Kwo Wɛ ye bedwe mo.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, Juu tiina bam daa ma kwei kandwa se ba ma ba dole‑o ba go.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: O ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo Kwo toŋe-ne se a ke totoŋ-laaro dedɛ a bere abam. Totoŋa yanto wone dɔ tete mo pɛ se á kwaane se á go-ne?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ko dae keim-laaro ŋwaane mo dé lage dé dole‑m dé go. Ko ye nmo na twe Wɛ yere tei to mo. Nmo ye nabiinu mo, ye n bere we n ye Wɛ.”

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to bá wane ko taa ye kafɛ. Ko bere we Wɛ déem toŋe o kwora o pa nɔɔna bam konto, ye o bwoŋi-ba we, ‘wa’.

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: Amo nam ye wolo a Kwo Wɛ na le se a ke o boboŋa, ye o daare o toŋe-ne se a ba logo baŋa to mo. Konto to, a na tage we amo ye Wɛ Bu wom to, bɛ mo ye á ba sɛ konto? Bɛ mo ye á bere-ne we a twe Wɛ yere?

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Abam ná maŋe á ba sɛ amo, maane-na á nii a totoŋa yam na ye tei to. Ko ná dae a Kwo Wɛ totoŋa mo a toŋa, se á yé sɛ-ne. Ko nam ná ye Wɛ totoŋa, se á sɛ totoŋa yam na bere tei to. Á ná sɛ totoŋa yam konto, á wó seene á lɔre we amo de a Kwo Wɛ me daane chekke.”

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma jwoori o vo o bɛ Jɔdan buga kam. O ma vo jei selo Jɔn déem na yeini o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm to, o zoore dáane.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ déem maa tui o tei. Ba maa yeini ba tɛ ba we, “Jɔn nam wo ke wo-kenkagele, de dedoa de. Ko daare o na tage kolo maama Yezu ŋwaane to ye chega mo.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Jei sem konto ne nɔɔna dedɛ ma ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Mary dedaane Marita ma toŋe ni ba pa Yezu ba we, “Debam Tu, nmo badwoŋ-swono kom weela.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Yezu na nigi konto to, o maa we, “Jaweo konto kweelim jei bá taa ye o toone. Ko nam ke se ko pa Wɛ mo na zula. Ko maa wó pa amo Wɛ Bu wom de na zula ko ŋwaane.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: O na nigi we Lazaru weele to, o ma ke da yalei o na maŋe o zoore mɛ to,

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: ye o laam daare o ta de o kwaga tɔgena bam o we, “Pa-na dé jwoori dé vo Judea.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Ko nam jege se a vo mo. Awa fuga-yalei mo wora wea ne. Ko dae konto na? Nɔɔno ná vei wea ne, o daa ba tiri o toe, kolo ŋwaane logo kom konto pwooni dem pae o nae.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: O nam ná vei tete ne, o wó yɔɔre o taa tiri o toe mo, kolo ŋwaane pwooni tera o tei ne.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, o daa ma ta o woli da o we, “Debam badwoŋi Lazaru wo dɔɔm ne. Amo nam maa vei da se a pa o zaŋe mo.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: O kwaga tɔgena bam ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam tu, o ná dɔa, ko wó gare o yera ne.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Yezu nam na tage tei to, o bere we Lazaru tege mo. Banto maa boŋe we ko bere we o dɔ dɔɔm tete mo.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: Amo na tere o tei ne to mo pae a jege wopwolo abam ŋwaane. Ko wó wane ko pa á ke á wo-dedoa á sɛ-ne. Nam pa-na se dé vo o tei.”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Tomas wolo ba na bwoŋi we ‘Yeywɛ’ to ma ta de o dwonna bam o we, “Nam pa-na se dé maama tɔge dé vo dé woli de dé Teiru wom dé te.”

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: Juu tiina dedɛ déem ya tu se ba ke Marita de Mary lei de ba nabɔ wom toone dem.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Marita na nigi we Yezu maa beene to, o ma nwoŋi o vo se o jeeri‑o. Mary ma maŋe sɔŋɔ ne.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Marita na yi Yezu tei to, o ma ta o we, “Amo tu, nmo ya ná wo ywo, amo nabɔ wom ya bá te.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “N nabɔ wom wó bi o taa ŋwe.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Marita ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo yei we o wó jwoori o bi dɛ dem Wɛ na wó bi twa to mo.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo mo ye twa biim de ŋwea tu. Wolo ná ke o wo-dedoa de amo, o ná tega naa o ná ŋwe, konto tu ta wó na ŋwea.

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: O ma leiri‑o o we, “Ɛɛ. Amo tu, a sɛ we nmo mo ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, ye n kwori n ye Wɛ Bu wolo na jege se o ba logo baŋa to.”

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Marita na tage konto o ti to, o ma jwoori o vo o na o nyaane Mary o yerane, ye o bwoŋi‑o o we, “Berem tu wom tua, ye o lage se o na‑m.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
translation_verse: Mary na nigi konto to, o ma zaŋe o ke lela o nwoŋi o vo se o jeeri‑o.

english_verse: He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him.
translation_verse: Yezu daa ta wo jei selo Marita na jeeri‑o da to mo. O ta wo yi teo kom wo.

english_verse: Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
translation_verse: Juu tiina balo na wo sɔŋɔ kom ne ye ba lare de Mary se ko gane o boboŋa to ma na o na ke lela o zaŋe o nwoŋi. Ba ma zaŋe ba tɔge‑o, ye ba boŋe we o ga lage o vo yibeeli dem jeiga mo o keeri.

english_verse: Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
translation_verse: Mary na vei o na Yezu na wo mɛ to, o ma to o yiga ne ye o we, “Amo tu, nmo ya ná wo ywo, a nabɔ wom ya bá te.”

english_verse: When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset
translation_verse: Yezu ma na o na keera, ye Juu tiina balo na tɔge ded‑o ba ba to de keera. O wo ma chɔge, ye o yera sɔɔre.

english_verse: and asked, “Where have you put his body?” They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
translation_verse: O ma bwei-ba o we, “Abam ke‑o yei ne mo?” Ba ma leiri ba we, “Debam tu, ba n nii‑o da.”

english_verse: Jesus started crying,
translation_verse: Yezu ma ka yi-na.

english_verse: and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam na nɛ konto to, ba ma ta ba we, “Nii o na swoi‑o tei.”

english_verse: Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translation_verse: Ko daare badaara ma ta ba we, “Wonto nam mo puri lilwei wom yia. Ko nam ke tɛ mo ye o wo chege Lazaru toone dem?”

english_verse: Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance.
translation_verse: Yezu ma vo yibeeli dem ni, ye o wo daa chɔge dedɛ. Yibeeli dem déem wo peo yera ne mo, ye ba ma kandwɛ-kamunu ba pe de ni.

english_verse: Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta se ba bibili kandwɛ dem ba yage dáa ne. Too wom nakɔ Marita ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, ba na kwei‑o ba ke to jege da yana mo zem. Konto to, o wó taa tiini o lwoi.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “A maŋe a ta de nmo we, nmo ná ke n wo-dedoa de amo, nmo wó na Wɛ na jege dam tei to.”

english_verse: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei kandwɛ dem ba yage dáa ne. Yezu ma kwoni o yuu wɛɛne, ye o ta o we, “Amo Kwo, de n lei de nmo na cheigi amo taane to.

english_verse: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
translation_verse: A maŋe a yei we nmo yeini n cheigi amo taane maŋa maama. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo na zege ywo to ŋwaane mo amo nam tage konto, se ko pa ba sɛ we nmo mo toŋe-ne.”

english_verse: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.” The Plot To Kill Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Too wom ma zaŋe o nwoŋi, de gare-yia mo ba ya mɛ ba ba o jea de o nɛ, ye gɔrɔ de kekare o yibia. Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Bwoli-na gare-yia yam á yage se o wane o vo.” Juu tiina dedɛɛra ke ni daane se ba go Yezu Matiyu

english_verse: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Juu tiina balo ya na tu Mary tei to ma na Yezu na bi Lazaru tei to. Ba dedɛ ma ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o.

english_verse: Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done.
translation_verse: Ba badaara ma jwoori ba vo Farisi tiina bam tei, ye ba daare ba ta de-ba Yezu na ke kolo to.

english_verse: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam laam ma la daane de ba nakwa kɔgɔ kom. Ba ma bwɛ daane ba we, “Nii-na nɔɔno wonto na ke wo-kenkagela yalo maama, ye dé nam ba ke kolokolo.

english_verse: If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
translation_verse: Dé ná yage‑o se o taa ke konto, nɔɔna maama wó ba ba sɛ‑o mo. Konto maa wó pa se Rom dedɛɛra bam laam ba ba chɔge wara-jei sento de dé teo kom maama.”

english_verse: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all!
translation_verse: Balo na bwɛ daane konto to dedoa yere mo Kayafa. Wonto mo ba kuri se o taa ye ba kaanem yuu tu wom bene dem konto wone. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam yeiri kolokolo.

english_verse: Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?”
translation_verse: Dé ná pɛ nɔɔno dedoa te debam nɔɔna bam maama ŋwaane, ko wó taa lana ko pa debam ko gare dé teo kom maama ná chɔge. A fɔ vwa na?”

english_verse: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation.
translation_verse: Kayafa na tage konto to, ko dae o tete boboŋa mo o mɛ o ta. O nam na ye Wɛ kaanem yuu tu to mo pɛ o pworisi we, Yezu lage o te Juu tiina dwi dem maama ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we o lage o te banto dwi dem yerane ŋwaane. Ko nam daa ta ye Wɛ bia bam na jage jei maama to de ŋwaane mo, se ba wane ba ke daane ba taa ye kɔgɔ dedoa.

english_verse: From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
translation_verse: Ko nam zege dɛ dem konto ne to, Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam maa lage chwoŋa se ba go Yezu.

english_verse: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
translation_verse: Konto ma pa Yezu daa ba beeri jaja Judea ne. O ma yage dáane o vo jei selo na bwola de kagoa ni to. Ko ye Efrayim ne mo o vei o zoore da de o kwaga tɔgena bam.

english_verse: It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival.
translation_verse: Juu tiina kuri delo yere na ye Atɔgebabaŋa to déem ma daare fee se de yi. Nɔɔna dedɛ ma zaŋe teo kom jei maama ne ba vo Jerusalem se ba fɔge ba tete de Wɛ ye kuri dem ta wo yi.

english_verse: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma beeri Yezu jei. Ba ma la daane Wɛ diga kam ne, ye ba bwei daane ba we, “O lage o ke tɛ mo? O wó ba o di kuri dem na?”

english_verse: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam de Farisi tiina bam déem ya pɛ ni we, nɔɔno wolo ná yei Yezu na wo mɛ to, o jege se o ta o bere-ba mo se ba wane ba ja‑o.

english_verse: If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná lage se o toŋe amo totoŋa, konto tu jege se o tɔge amo kwaga mo. Konto wó pa se amo na wo mɛ to, se a tontoŋeno wom de taa tɔge o wora. Wolo maama ná toŋe amo totoŋa, amo Kwo wó pa kotu na zula.”

english_verse: Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.
