translation_verse: O na tage konto to, ko dae we o jege yiniga tiina ŋwaŋa. O nam ye ŋweeno mo. Wonto mo nii ba kɔgɔ kom sabu kom baŋa ne, ye o yeini o ŋɔne-ko o lea.

english_verse: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, “Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel!”
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba kaare konkwara vɔɔro, ye ba nwoŋi ba maa vei se ba jeeri‑o. Ba na maa vei to, ba maa seini‑o ba we: “Hozaana! Dé ke Wɛ lei! Baŋa Wɛ wó swɛ wolo na tu o yere ŋwaane to swolim. Wonto mo ye Isarele dwi tiina bam Pɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Yezu ma vo o na bonaga o di, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko ta tei we,

english_verse: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
translation_verse: Mary laam ma kwei terale nuga kalo yere na ye ‘Naade’ to. Ka déem ye kunkwolo yi mo, ye ka tiini ka lana. Nuga kam konto yeilo chana dedɛ. O ma kwei-ka o ma turi Yezu nɛ. O ma daare o ma o yu-ywei o guguni o nɛ sem. Terale nuga kam lwom dem ma su sɔŋɔ kom ni maama.

english_verse: A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death.
translation_verse: Juu tiina kɔgɔ dedɛ ma lɔre we Yezu wo Bɛtania ne. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo da. Ba na vei to, ko dae Yezu yerane ŋwaane, se ko nam ye se ba na Lazaru wolo Yezu na bi toone wone to mo.

english_verse: A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
translation_verse: Ba ma ke wodiu ba pa‑o jei sem konto ne. Marita maa wora o ke wodiiru tem. Lazaru mo tɔge o jeini o wora o di de Yezu.

english_verse: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked,
translation_verse: Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam dedoa wolo yere na ye Judas Yisakara to de tɔge o wora. Wonto mo ye wolo na wó ba o yeigi Yezu o pa nɔɔna to.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma leiri o we, “Yage o yera. Ko maŋe se o tiŋi nuga kanto mo se ko taa vei a toone dɛ ne, se o ma turi a yera.

english_verse: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.” A Plot To Kill Lazarus
translation_verse: Yiniga tiina bá ti abam tei ne. Amo nam bá taa wo abam tei ne taa taa.”

english_verse: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina bam laam ma ke ni daane se ba go Lazaru de,

english_verse: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.”
translation_verse: Wonto nwoŋi Galili teo kolo yere na ye Bɛtasida to mo. Ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam lage se dé na Yezu mo.”

english_verse: But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.” Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
translation_verse: Farisi tiina bam laam maa tɛ daane ba we, “Á nɛa, debam bere dé bá na kolokolo. Nii-na! Logo kom nɔɔna bam maama mo tɔge o kwaga.” Yezu tage o toone dem taane

english_verse: So Father, bring glory to yourself. A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!”
translation_verse: A nam wó lwoori a Kwo se o pa o yere zaŋe de zula mo.” Kwora laam ma ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Amo maŋe a pa a yere dem zaŋe de zula, ye a nam ta wó ke konto.”

english_verse: “The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.”
translation_verse: “Wonto mo dwei ba yia, ye o pa ba boboŋa jei, se ba yia yam yé wane ya taa nae, se ba boboŋa yam de yé wane ya lɔre Wɛ taane dem kuri, se ba yé pipiri ba sɛ Wɛ se o pa ba na fɔgem.”

english_verse: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival,
translation_verse: Tega déem ma poore. Nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo na tu Jerusalem se ba di ba kuri dem to ma lɔre we Yezu maa beena.

english_verse: “People of Jerusalem, don't be afraid! Your King is now coming, and he is riding on a donkey.”
translation_verse: “Abam balo na zoore Zion teo kom ne to, á yé ta‑á kɔre foone. Nii-na á pɛ wom, o diini bona-pɔla mo o maa beena.”

english_verse: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, Yezu kwaga tɔgena bam ya maa wo lɔre wonnu tem konto kuri. Ko daare maŋa kam Yezu na nɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Wɛ tei ne to mo ba laam guli Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na tage o taane tei to, de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na ke kolo ba zuli‑o to.

english_verse: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo nɔn-kɔgɔ kom nwoŋi teo kom ne ba jeeri‑o, ba na nigi we o ke wo-kenkagele dem konto to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him. The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
translation_verse: Filipi ma sɛ ye o vo o ta o bere Anduru. Banto balei ma vo ba ta ba bere Yezu.

english_verse: Jesus said: The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Maŋa kam laam yia se Wɛ pa Nabiin-bu wom na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, nmo ná jege men-bu dedoa se n du, ye n ná dugi-de tega ne, de wó nwoŋi de ke bia dedɛ. Nmo nam ná jege-de ye n wo dugi, de ta wó taa ye de yerane mo taa. Nmo ná wo sɛ se n ke-de tega ne, n bá‑n na nyɔɔre de baŋa ne.

english_verse: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.
translation_verse: Wolo ná swoi o tete ŋwea, konto tu bá na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Wolo nam ná ve o ŋwea logo konto ne, kotu wó taa jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer.
translation_verse: Yezu ta ma ta o we, “Amo bochare mo maga. Amo nam wó ta bɛ mo? A nam wó lwoori a Kwo se o che amo se a yé zo chanɛɛre dento wone mo na? Aawo. Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo amo maŋe a ba se a na toone dem konto.

english_verse: When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo na zege da to ma ni kwora kam, ye ba ta ba we, doa mo mumuna. Badaara maa we, ko ye maleka mo ŋɔɔne de Yezu.

english_verse: Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Ko dae amo ŋwaane mo kwora kanto ŋɔɔne, se ko ye abam ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out!
translation_verse: Maŋa kam yia se Wɛ di nabiina taane. Ba maa wó zeili logo baŋa dedɛɛro wom.

english_verse: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, ba ná kwei-ne ba zeiŋi wɛɛne, amo wó pa se nabiina maama ba amo tei.”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o bere o na lage o te cham toone tei to mo.

english_verse: The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna ma leiri‑o ba we, “Ko ná ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista wom, nia yalo Wɛ na tiŋi o pa debam to bere we o jege se o taa wora mo taa wuu. Bɛ nam mo ye n ta n we, ba jege se ba kwei Nabiin-bu wom ba zeiŋi wɛɛne? Nmo na tage Nabiin-bu wom taane to, wɔ mo konto?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta o tete taane o leiri-ba o we, “Pwooni bá tiini de dáane abam tei ne. Pwooni dem ta na wo á tei ne to, se á ta‑á via, se lim dem yé ba de yi abam. Wolo na vei lim wone to yeiri o na lage o vo mɛ to.

english_verse: Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.” The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding.
translation_verse: Pwooni dem ta na wo á tei ne to, se á sɛ wolo wom na ye pwooni dem to, se á daare á ta‑á ye pwooni dem bia.” Yezu déem na tage wonnu tem konto o ti to, o ma vo o seigi o tete ba tei ne.

english_verse: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.
translation_verse: O déem ya ke wo-kenkagela dedɛ ba yibia ne. De konto de, ba ta wo sɛ‑o.

english_verse: The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo nɔɔna bam wo wane ba sɛ Yezu taane dem. Kokuri to, Izaya ta tage o we:

english_verse: Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: De konto de, Juu tiina yiga tiina dedɛ ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu. Ba na kɔre Farisi tiina bam to ŋwaane mo ba wo ŋɔɔne-ko jaja, ba na wó zeili-ba ba jeerim diga kam ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God. Jesus Came To Save the World
translation_verse: Ba na ke tei to bere we, ba swoi se nabiina taa zuli-ba ko dwoi Wɛ wo ná pwoli de-ba. Yezu tu se o vere nabiina

english_verse: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yezu déem ma ta de kwor-dɛa o we, “Wolo na ke o wo-dedoa de amo to, ko dae we o sɛ amo yerane mo, se ko ye wolo wom na toŋe-ne to de mo o sɛ.

english_verse: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Wolo na nɛ amo to nɛ wolo wom na toŋe-ne to mo.

english_verse: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
translation_verse: Amo tu logo baŋa ye a jege pwooni a pae nabiina, se wolo maama na sɛ amo to daa yé taa zoore lim wone.

english_verse: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.
translation_verse: Wolo ná nigi amo taane dem ye o ba sɛ o toŋe o tɔge-de, amo tete bá chɔge konto tu, kolo ŋwaane amo na tu to, ko dae se a di nabiina taane a chɔge-ba. Ko nam ye se a vere-ba a yage mo.

english_verse: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we balo na tɔge ni delo a Kwo Wɛ na pɛ-ne se a ŋɔɔne to wó na ŋwe-doŋa o tei ne. Amo na yeini a ŋɔɔne tei maama mo ye a Kwo na tage kolo o bere-ne to.”

english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe na daare se ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem to, Yezu déem maa yei we o maŋa kam yia se o yage logo baŋa se o daare o vo o Kwo tei. O maa swoi balo na ye o nyem logo baŋa ne to, ye o ta tiini o swo-ba se ko yi o ŋwea tiim.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Yezu de o kwaga tɔgena bam déem maa jei ba di wodiu. Setaana pɛ boboŋa ma maŋe ya ja se o pa Judas wolo na ye Simon Yisakara bu to yeigi Yezu o pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Yezu maa yei we o Kwo mo pɛ‑o dam wonnu maama baŋa ne, ye o ta yei we o nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo, ye o ta wó jwoori o vo Wɛ tei.

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: Konto to, o ma zaŋe wodiu kom baŋa ne. O ma le o na zo gɔrɔ kolo o daŋe to, ye o daare o vɔ pepaao o teiŋa ne.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: O ma ke na kanchua wone o wora o maa zare o tɔgena bam nɛ, ye o ma pepaao kom o guguni-se.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: O ma ba o yi Simon Piita tei. Wonto ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, nmo mo wó zare amo nɛ na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo bá‑n lɔre amo na wora a ke kolo to kuri leile, ye n laam wó ba n lɔre ko kuri.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Piita ma ta o we, “N bere n bá‑n zare a nɛ kɔtaa.” Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Amo ná wo zare n nɛ sem, n daa‑n bá ta‑n ye amo nɔɔno.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Simon Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, yé zare amo nɛ yerane, zare a jea de a yuu de n woli da.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Wolo na swɛ o yera to daa ba jege digiru, ye o daa ba jege se o zare o yera, ko ná dae o nɛ yerane. Abam ba jege digiru, ye ko dae abam maama.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yezu maŋe o yei wolo na lage o yeigi‑o o pa nɔɔna to. Mo kokuri o tage o we, ko dae ba maama mo ba jege digiru.

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Yezu na zare ba nɛ sem o ti to, o ma jwoori o zo o gɔrɔ kom ye o vo o jeini o jeiŋa kam jei ne. O laam ma bwei-ba o we, “Abam lɔre kolo amo na ke de abam to kuri na?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Á yeini á bwoi amo we, Berem tu, de abam Teiru. Abam na ke konto to, ko maŋe, kolo ŋwaane amo seene a ye konto mo.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Amo nam ke a bere abam se á lwoni amo na ke abam tei to mo.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, kabaa tera ka na dwoi ka yuu tu. Tontoŋeno nam tera o na dwoi wolo na toŋe‑o to.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: Ko nam dae abam maama taane mo a tɛa. Amo yei balo a na kuri to. Ko daare kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to jege se ko ji chega mo, ko we, ‘Wolo na jeini o di wodiu de amo to mo jwoori o zege amo zega.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Amo nam wuuri a ta wonnu tento a bere abam mo ye te ta wo ke, se te ná tu te ke, se á wane á sɛ we amo ye wolo Wɛ na toŋe to.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma fɔɔre o yi Yezu o sale‑o, ye o bwei o we, “Amo Teiru, ko ye wɔ mo?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto o ti to, o wo ma tiini ko chɔge pa se o ŋɔɔne jaja o we, “A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam dedoa mo lage o yeigi amo o pa nɔɔna.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Wolo Yezu na swoi lanyerane ba wone to maa jei o takeiri ne.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Simon Piita ma yeese o jeŋa o bere wonto se o bwei Yezu o nii, ko ye wɔ taane mo o tɛa.

english_verse: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Balo maama na jei ba di to wolowolo maa wo lɔre Yezu na tage kolo ded‑o to kuri.

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Judas nam na nii ba kɔgɔ kom sabu kom baŋa ne to, ba badaara maa boŋe we Yezu toŋe‑o se o vo o yeigi wodiu mo se ba ma di kuri dem, naa o ga toŋe‑o se o vo o pa yiniga tiina wonnu mo.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Judas na seene o jwoŋi bworobworo kom to, o ma nwoŋi pwooni. Ko déem ye tete ne mo.

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Wɛ na nɛ zula amo ŋwaane to, o laam wó pa a na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ o tete tei ne. Wɛ nam wó ke lela o ke konto o pa-ne.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: A bia bam, amo daa bá tiini a dáane abam tei ne. Abam nam wó ba á beeri amo jei. A nam lage a ta a bere abam kolo amo na maŋe a ta a bere Juu tiina bam a we, amo na lage a vo mɛ to, abam bá wane da á vo.

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Piita ma ta o we, “Amo tu, bɛ mo ye a bá wane a tɔge nmo leile konto? Amo wó sɛ se a te nmo ŋwaane.”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo wó seene n sɛ se n te amo ŋwaane na? A tɛ nmo chega ŋwaane to, nmo wó fo kuni betɔ we n yeiri amo, ye chebɛɔ laam keeri.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: Yezu laam ma ta o we, “Á yé pa á bochara taa maga. Ta‑á jege-na wo-dedoa de Wɛ, se á ke á wo-dedoa de amo de.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: A Kwo wom sɔŋɔ ne, di daga da dedɛ. A nam lage a vo da a kwɛ jei mo a pa abam. Ko ya ná dae chega, a ya bá ta konto de abam.

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Amo ná vei a kwɛ jei sem a ti a pa abam, a laam wó jwoori a ba a ja abam se á tɔge á vo á ta‑á wo amo na wo mɛ to.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Abam nam yei chwoŋa kalo na vei mɛ amo na lage a vo to.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Tomas ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tu, debam yeiri nmo na lage n vo mɛ to. Dé nam wó ke tɛ mo dé lɔre ka chwoŋa?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo mo ye chwoŋa kam, de chega kam, de ŋwea kam. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o vo a Kwo wom tei ye o wo dɛ amo baŋa o vo.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Abam ná maŋe á yei amo, á laam wó ta‑á yei a Kwo wom de. Leile konto abam yei‑o, ye á nam ta nɛ‑o de.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Filipi ma ta o we, “Amo tu, pa se dé lɔre n Kwo wom, se konto wó maŋe debam.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Filipi, amo dáane abam tei ne ye nmo ta yeiri amo na? Wolo maama na nɛ amo to nɛ amo Kwo wom mo. Bɛŋwaane mo ye n ta n we, a pa se á na a Kwo wom?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Amo tigi a Kwo bochare ne ye dé me daane. Nmo nam ba sɛ konto na? Taane delo amo na tage a bere abam to dae amo nyem. Ko nam na ye tei to, amo Kwo wom me de amo, ye o da amo ŋwaane o ke o totoŋa.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na wo-dedoa de amo we, amo tigi a Kwo wom bochare ne ye dé me daane. Ko ná dae konto, se á ke á wo-dedoa de amo, totoŋa yalo amo na toŋe to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, wolo na ke o wo-dedoa de amo to wó ke kikia yalo dwoŋi amo na ke to. O nam wó ke totoŋ-kamunnu se ko taa dwoi amo na ke tei to, amo na lage a vo a Kwo tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Amo wó ke kolo maama abam na wó lwoori amo yere ŋwaane to, se ko pa a Kwo Wɛ na zula amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Abam na wó lwoori woŋo kolo maama amo yere ŋwaane to, amo wó ke-ko a pa abam.

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: Abam ná swoi amo, á wó toŋe á tɔge a nia yam.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Amo nam wó ta de a Kwo wom se o pa abam Zeinnu wodwoŋi. Wonto wó taa wo abam tei ne se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: Wonto mo ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom. O maa ye chega tu. Nɔɔna balo kugu jei na wo logo baŋa ne to nam ware ba sɛ‑o, kolo ŋwaane ba ware ba na‑o, ye ba ta yeiri‑o de. Ko daare abam nam yei‑o, kolo ŋwaane o me de abam, ye o lage o taa wo á bochara ne mo.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: Amo bá kwei abam a yage á yerane. A nam wó jwoori a ba abam tei.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Ko ná ke fee, logo baŋa nɔɔna daa bá na amo. Abam nam wó na-ne. Amo na jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to, abam de wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Abam ná nɛ ŋwea kam konto dwoŋi, dɛ dem konto ne á wó lɔre we amo de a Kwo me daane. Abam ta wó lɔre we á tigi amo bochare ne, ye amo de me de abam.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama na sɛ amo nia yam ye o toŋe o tɔge-ya to mo ye wolo na swoi amo to. Amo Kwo Wɛ wó taa jege wolo na swoi amo to swono. Amo de nam wó taa swoi‑o, ye a kwori a pa o lɔre amo wo na ye tei to.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, nɔɔno wodwoŋi de yere na ye Judas ye ko dae Yisakara bu wom to ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, nmo wó ke tɛ mo n pa se debam lɔre nmo wo na ye tei, ye logo baŋa nɔɔna bam bá lɔre?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Wolo na swoi amo to wó taa tɔge chega kalo amo na bere to. Amo Kwo wó taa jege konto tu swono, ye amo de a Kwo wó ba o tei dé me ded‑o.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam na ba swoi amo to ba cheigi amo berem dem. Amo ni taane delo abam na nigi to nam dae amo nyem, se de nwoŋi amo Kwo wolo na toŋe-ne to tei ne mo.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam a ta na wo abam tei ne to mo a maŋe a ta a bere abam wonnu tem konto.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Ko daare se Zeinnu wom laam mo ba abam tei. Wonto mo ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom, a Kwo Wɛ na wó toŋe‑o se o ba amo yere ŋwaane to. Wonto wó ta wonnu maama taane jase o bere abam. O maa wó pa se á guli kolo maama amo na maŋe a ta a bere abam to gula.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: Amo yage bochare-zuru mo a pa abam. Ko ye amo tete nyem mo a kwei a pa abam. Amo na lage a pa abam bochare-zuru kolo to, logo baŋa nɔɔna nam yeiri ko dwoŋi. Á yé pa se á bochara taa maga. Á nam yé ta‑á jege lwia de.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Abam maŋe á ni amo na tage de abam we, a lage a viiri, ye a ta wó jwoori a ba á tei. Abam ya ná swoi amo, á wó ta‑á jege ywoni dedaane amo na lage a vo a Kwo Wɛ tei to, o na dwoi amo to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Amo nam wuuri a ta wonnu tento a bere abam mo ye te ta wo ke, se te ná tu te ke, se á wane á sɛ amo taane dem.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Amo daa bá na chwoŋa se a ŋɔɔne taane dedɛ de abam, logo baŋa dedɛɛro wom na lage o ba to ŋwaane. Wonto nam bá wane o dwoni de amo.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Amo nam jege se a pa balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to lɔre we, amo jege a Kwo wom swono. Konto ŋwaane mo a ke kolo maama a Kwo na pɛ-ne ni se a ke to. Á nam zaŋe-na ywo-seeni se dé viiri.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: Yezu ta ma ta o we, “Amo mo ye Vini tio kolo na ye chekke to. A Kwo maa ye valo wolo na fɔge o nii ko baŋa ne to.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Naga kalo na nwoŋi tio kom yera ne ye ka ba leiri bia to, o wó gwo-ka o yage mo. Ko daare naga kalo na leiri bia to, o wó fɔge o kwɛ-ka mo se ka taa leiri bia dedɛ.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Abam bochara nam maŋe ya kwɛ lanyerane, á na sɛ taane delo amo na ŋɔɔne a bere abam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Me-na de amo, se amo de wó taa tigi abam bochara ne. Tio naga bá wane ka taa leiri bia ka tete yerane. Ka jege se ka taa wo tio kom yera ne mo se ka laam wane bia ka lei. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de abam. Abam jege se á me de amo, se á laam wane á ta‑á ke keim-laaro.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye Vini tio kom, ye abam ye ko nɛ sem. Wolo maama de amo na me daane to nye de naga kalo na leiri bia dedɛ to mo. Amo nam ná tera á bochara ne, á bá wane kolokolo á ke.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Wolo na wo me de amo to nye de tio naga kalo ba na gwoni ba yage ye ka ko to mo. Tio nɛ selo na koge konto dwoŋi to, ba laam wó pɛ se maama ba de mini ne mo ye se di.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná me de amo, ye amo taane dem ná wo á bochara ne, á wó wane á lwoori kolo maama á boboŋa na tɔge to, ye á wó na-ko.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a jege abam swono ne amo Kwo wom de na swoi-ne tei to mo. Ta‑á jege-na amo swono kom á bochara ne.

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Abam ná toŋe á tɔge amo nia yam, á wó wane á ta‑á jege amo swono kom konto. Ko ye bedwe mo de amo na sɛ a Kwo nia yam ye a jege o swono kom a bochare ne tei to.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: Amo ni dem nam mo tento: Á ta‑á swoi daane, se ko maŋe de amo na swoi abam tei to.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná sɛ se o te o dwonna ŋwaane, kotu tiini o jege ba swono mo se ko ja gaale.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná ke á tɔge amo ni dem, á wó ta‑á ye a badwonna mo.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Amo daa bá taa bwoi abam we, amo tontoŋena. Ko ná ye tontoŋeno, o yeiri kolo o tu na lage se o ke to. Ko nam ná ye abam, amo tage kolo maama a na lɔre a Kwo wom tei ne to a bere abam. Konto ŋwaane mo amo laam bwoi abam we a badwonna.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae abam mo kuri amo se á ta‑á tɔge-ne. Amo nam mo kuri abam, ye a daare a tiŋi abam se á ta‑á ke keim-laaro. Keim-laaro tem konto wó taa wora taa taa. Abam ná toŋe keim-laaro tem konto dwoŋi, a Kwo wom wó pa abam kolo maama á na wó lwoori o tei ne amo yere ŋwaane to.

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Ko ná ye balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to, ba ná chuli abam, se á ta‑á yei we ba maŋe ba da yiga ba chuli amo mo.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Abam ya ná ye logo baŋa nyem, ko nɔɔna bam ya wó taa swoi abam, á na ye ba dwonna to ŋwaane. Ko nam na ye tei to, amo mo kuri abam logo baŋa nɔɔna bam wone, ye á daa dae ba nyem. Konto ŋwaane mo balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to wó taa chuli abam.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Guli-na amo na maŋe a ta kolo a bere abam to we: kabaa tera ka na dwoi ka yuu tu to. Ba na jaane amo ba yaare to, ba ta wó yaare abam de mo. Ba nam ná sɛ amo ni taane, ba wó sɛ abam de ni taane mo.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Ba nam wó ke abam konto maama amo ŋwaane, kolo ŋwaane ba yeiri wolo wom na toŋe-ne to.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Amo ya ná wo tu a ŋɔɔne chega a bere-ba, wɛleera ya bá taa wo ba yuu ne. Ko nam na ye tei to, ba daa bá wane ba bere we ba jege bora.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná chuli amo, konto tu chuli amo Kwo wom de mo.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Amo ke totoŋ-laaro a bere-ba, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno ta wo fɔge o ke totoŋa yanto dwoŋi. Amo ya ná wo ke a bere-ba, wɛleera ya bá taa wo ba yuu ne. Ba nam nɛ amo na ke kolo to, ye ba ta chuli amo de a Kwo wom maama.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ke se kolo na popone Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom wone to mo ji chega we, ‘Ba chuli-ne kafɛ ŋwaane.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: Zeinnu wom nam wó ba. Wonto mo ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom. O maa ye chega tu, ye o nwoŋi a Kwo wom tei. A nam wó toŋe‑o se o nwoŋi a Kwo wom tei o ba abam tei. O laam wó ŋɔɔne amo chega kam mo o bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: Abam de nam wó ŋɔɔne a chega kam taane, kolo ŋwaane ko zege boboa ne mo, abam maŋe á wora de amo.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Amo nam ŋɔɔne wonnu tento a bere abam se ko pa á yé ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam ne.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Ba nam wó le abam ba jeerim di sem ne. Maŋa lage ka ba ye nɔɔno wolo ná go abam, kotu wó boŋe we o ke totoŋ-laao mo o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Ba nam wó ke abam wonnu tem konto, kolo ŋwaane ba yeiri amo Kwo wom, ye ba ta yeiri amo de.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Amo tɛ wonnu tento maama se te maŋa kam ná yia, se á wane á guli we amo maŋe a ta te taane a bere abam. Amo wo tage wonnu tem konto a bere abam boboa ne, kolo ŋwaane amo ya ta wo abam tei ne mo.

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto amo lage a vo wolo wom na toŋe-ne to tei. Abam wolowolo nam wo bwei-ne we, ‘Nmo lage n vo yei ne mo?’

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Ko daare a laam tɛ abam chega mo we, amo ná viiri, ko wó taa lana ko pa abam. Kolo ŋwaane amo ná wo viiri, Zeinnu wom bá ba abam tei. Amo nam ná viiri, a laam wó toŋe‑o se o ba abam tei.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: O nam ná tua, o wó pa logo baŋa nɔɔna lɔre we ba tusi mo wɛleera keim seeni, de Wɛ chega kam seeni, de Wɛ borem dem seeni.

english_verse: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
translation_verse: O wó bere-ba we ba tusi wɛleera seeni de ba na wo sɛ amo to mo.

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: O ta wó bere-ba we ba tusi Wɛ chega kam seeni, kolo ŋwaane a lage a vo a Kwo Wɛ tei, ye á daa bá na-ne.

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: O ta wó bere-ba we ba tusi Wɛ borem dem seeni, kolo ŋwaane logo baŋa dedɛɛro wom maŋe o to de o bora.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: Amo ya ta jege wonnu dedɛ se a ta a bere abam, ye te nam wó taa tiini te chamma te dwoi á jaanem.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ko daare Wɛ Sin-laao kom ye chega tu mo. O ná tua, o laam wó pa se á ba á lɔre chega kam maama. Ko nam dae o tete nyem mo o lage o ŋɔɔne. O wó ŋɔɔne kolo o na nigi Wɛ tei ne to mo, o ma daare o ta wonnu telo na lage te ba to o bere abam.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: O nam wó pa amo na zula, kolo ŋwaane o wó kwei amo chega kam mo o bere abam.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Amo Kwo wom na jege kolo maama to ye amo de nyem mo. Mo kokuri a tage a we, o Sin-laao kom wó kwei amo nyem dem o ma bere abam.

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: Ko ná ke fee, abam daa bá na amo, ye ko daa ta ná ke fee ko woli da, á daa wó jwoori á na-ne.” Wo-chechɔgɔ wó pipiri ko ji wopwolo

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, o kwaga tɔgena badaara maa tɛ daane ba we, “O na tage o we, ko ná ke fee dé daa bá na‑o, ye ko daa ta ná ke fee, dé daa wó na‑o to, konto kuri mo bɛ? O nam ta tage o we, ko ye o na lage o vo o Kwo tei to ŋwaane mo. Dé yeiri ko kuri.”

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Ba ta maa tiini ba bwɛ daane ba we, “O na tage o we, ‘ko ná ke fee’ to, ko kuri mo bɛ? Dé yeiri o na tɛ kolo to kuri.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yezu ma lɔre we ba lage se ba bwei‑o taane. O ma ta de-ba o we, “Á na bwɛ daane tei to, ko ye amo na tage a we, ‘ko ná ke fee á daa bá na-ne, ye ko daa ná ke fee, á wó na-ne’ to ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, abam wó ba á keeri dedɛ wo-chechɔgɔ ŋwaane. Ko daare logo baŋa nɔɔna bam wó taa jege wopwolo. Abam wo maa wó chɔge, ye á wo-chechɔgɔ kom laam wó pipiri ko ji wopwolo.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, kaane ná lage o lo bu, o wó taa jege lwia mo, kolo ŋwaane o chanɛɛre maŋa yia. O nam ná loge bu wom, o laam wó swei o chanɛɛre dem ni ne, ye o wó taa jege wopwolo de o na loge bu wom to.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye konto mo de abam de. Leile konto á jege lwia. Amo nam daa wó jwoori a na abam pa se á tiini á di ywoni, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o chɔge á wopwolo kom konto.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ná yia, abam bá bwei kolokolo amo tei ne. A tɛ abam chega ŋwaane to, amo Kwo wom wó pa abam kolo maama abam na wó lwoori amo yere ŋwaane to.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: De leile konto de, á maŋe á ta wo lwoori kolokolo amo yere ŋwaane. Nam lwoori-na, se á wó na, se ko pa abam wopwolo kom tiini ko gaale.

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: Amo na tage wonnu tento a bere abam to, ko ye memaŋa mo a mɛ a ta. Maŋa nam wó ba ye amo daa bá maŋe memaŋa a ma bere abam. Amo nam wó ba a ŋɔɔne a Kwo Wɛ taane jaja mo a bere abam.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, amo daa bá taa jege se a lwoori a Kwo Wɛ abam ŋwaane. Abam mo wó lwoori‑o amo yere ŋwaane,

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane Wɛ tete maŋe o jege abam swono, abam na swoi amo ye á kwori á sɛ we a nwoŋi o tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Amo seene a nwoŋi a Kwo Baŋa Wɛ tei mo a ba logo baŋa. Leile konto a lage a yage logo baŋa se a jwoori a vo o tei.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage konto to, o kwaga tɔgena bam laam ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Nii, nmo laam tiini n ŋɔɔne jaja mo, ye n daa‑n ba maŋe memaŋa.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Leile konto dé laam lɔre we nmo yei wonnu maama. Nmo daa‑n ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno bwei‑m taane. Konto nam pɛ se debam sɛ we, nmo seene n nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam laam sɛ na?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Nii-na, maŋa lage ka yi leile konto, ye abam wó jage. Abam dedoa dedoa maa wó jwoori o kwei o chwoŋa o daare amo yerane. Amo nam bá taa ye a yerane, kolo ŋwaane a Kwo wom wó taa wo a tei ne.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Amo tage wonnu tento a bere abam se ko pa á na bochare-zuru mo, á na me de amo to ŋwaane. Logo baŋa ne á wó na yaara. Nam ta‑á jege-na pu-dɛa. Amo maŋe a wane logo kom baŋa maama.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Yezu na tage taane dem konto o ti to, o ma kwoni o yuu wɛɛne ye o we: “Amo Kwo, a toone maŋa kam laam yia. Amo ye nmo Bu mo. Nam pa se a na zula, se amo de wó pa n na zula.

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane nmo pɛ-ne dam nabiina maama baŋa ne se a wane a pa balo maama nmo na pɛ-ne to jwoŋi ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to mo ye se nabiina taa yei nmo wolo yerane na ye chega tu Baŋa Wɛ to, se ba daare ba taa yei amo, Yezu Krista wolo nmo na toŋe to.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Amo pɛ se nmo na zula logo baŋa ne, de amo na ti totoŋe dem nmo na pɛ-ne se a toŋe to.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Amo Kwo, pa se a na nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ nmo tei ne leile konto, se ko maŋe de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kolo a na maŋe a jege de nmo ye logo baŋa ta tera to.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: Amo pɛ se nɔɔna balo nmo na kuri logo baŋa nɔɔna wone n ke amo jeŋa ne to lɔre nmo na ye wolo to. Banto ye nmo nyem mo, ye n kwei-ba n ke amo jeŋa ne. Ba nam sɛ nmo ni taane dem mo.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Leile konto ba yei we kolo maama nmo na pɛ amo to nwoŋi nmo tei mo.

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nmo na pɛ-ne kwora kalo to mo a pɛ-ba, ye ba sɛ. Ba nam yei lanyerane we amo nwoŋi nmo tei mo, ye ba ta sɛ we nmo mo toŋe-ne.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: Amo nam lwoori nmo banto ŋwaane mo, se a ba lwoori nmo a pa logo baŋa nɔɔna maama. Ko nam ye balo nmo na ke a jeŋa ne to, kolo ŋwaane banto ye nmo nyem mo.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Leile konto amo daa bá taa wora logo baŋa ne, ye banto ta wora mo. Amo laam maa beene nmo tei mo. Amo Kwo, Wo-pwoŋo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo yere dem ye amo de nyem mo, ye dento bere nmo dam dem na ye tei to. Ta‑n mae n dam dem konto n nii n nɔɔna baŋa ne, se ko pa ba taa ye woŋo dedoa, ne nmo de amo na ye woŋo dedoa tei to.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Amo ya na wo ba tei ne to, a mɛ nmo dam dem mo a nii ba baŋa ne. Amo ma che-ba se ba yé ywori nmo chwoŋa kam wone. Ba wolowolo wo jei, ko ná dae wolo wom na maŋe se o na chɔgem to yerane. Nmo tɔnɔ kom bere we wonto jege se o na chɔgem mo.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Leile konto amo maa beene nmo tei. Amo nam tage wonnu tento logo baŋa ne mo se ko pa nmo nɔɔna bam taa jege amo wopwolo kom dwoŋi ba bochara ne se ko tiini ko gaale.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: A ma ke nmo ni taane dem ba jeŋa ne. Balo kugu jei na wo logo baŋa ne to ma chuli-ba, ba na dae logo baŋa nyem to ŋwaane, ne amo de na dae logo baŋa nyem tei to.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we a lwoori nmo se n le-ba logo kom baŋa ne. A nam lwoori‑m se n che-ba wo-lwanno tu setaane jeŋa ne mo.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Ba dae logo baŋa nyem, ne amo de na dae logo baŋa nyem tei to.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Fɔge n kwɛ-ba de n chega kam se ba taa ye nmo nyem. Nmo ni taane dem ye chega mo.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Amo toŋe-ba a yage logo baŋa ne, ne nmo na toŋe amo de n yage logo baŋa ne tei to mo.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye banto ŋwaane mo amo kwei a tete a ke nmo jeŋa ne, se ko pa banto de wane ba taa ye nmo nyem, nmo chega kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: Amo nam ba lwoori nmo a pae banto yerane, se ko ye balo de na wó ba ba sɛ amo banto taane dem ŋwaane to mo.

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: Amo nam lwoori nmo se ko pa ba maama taa ye woŋo dedoa mo. Amo Kwo, nmo me de amo, ye amo tigi nmo bochare ne. Nam pa se banto me de debam konto dwoŋi. Konto wó wane ko pa se logo baŋa nɔɔna sɛ we, nmo mo toŋe-ne.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Amo pɛ-ba nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kolo dwoŋi nmo na pɛ-ne to, se ba wane ba ji woŋo dedoa, ne amo de nmo na ye woŋo dedoa tei to.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Amo me de-ba, ye nmo me de amo, se ko pa ba taa tiini ba ye woŋo dedoa, se logo baŋa nɔɔna wane ba lɔre we nmo mo toŋe-ne, ye n jege nmo nɔɔna bam swono, nenɛɛne nmo na swoi amo tei to.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: Amo Kwo, a lage se balo nmo na ke a jeŋa ne to taa tɔge ba wo amo na wo mɛ to, se ko pa ba na amo na jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kolo to. Ko ye nmo na maŋe n jege amo swono faŋa faŋa ye logo baŋa daa ta wo ke to ŋwaane mo n pɛ-ne nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom konto.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: Amo Kwo, nmo ye Chega Tu. Logo baŋa nɔɔna bam nam yeiri nmo. Ko daare amo yei nmo, ye a nɔɔna bam yei we nmo mo toŋe-ne.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Amo nam pɛ se ba lɔre nmo na ye wolo to, ye a daa ta wó taa ke konto mo se ko pa swono kolo nmo na jege amo ŋwaane to taa wo banto de tei ne. Amo tete de maa wó me de-ba.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yuu tu wom tontoŋeno dedoa wolo choro Piita na zage o zwɛ o pere to ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo wo nɛ nmo ded‑o gaare dem ne na?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: O ma jwoori o bwei-ba o we, “Wɔ mo abam laga?” Ba ma ta ba we, “Yezu wolo na ye Nazarete tu to mo dé laga.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yezu ma ta de-ba o we, “Amo maŋe a ta a bere abam we, amo mo konto. Ko nam ná ye amo mo á laga, se á yage banto se ba viiri.”

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Simon Piita maa jege se-zɔɔ. O ma le-ko o ma o zage Wɛ kaanem yuu tu wom tontoŋeno jazem zwɛ o pere. Tontoŋeno wom yere mo Malachu.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Soja tiina bam kɔgɔ kom de ba dedɛɛro wom de Juu tiina bam nɔɔna bam ma ja Yezu ba vɔ.

english_verse: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,
translation_verse: Piita ma maŋe manchwoŋo ni ne o zege da. Yezu tɔgeno wolo wom de kaanem yuu tu wom na yei daane to ma jwoori o nwoŋi o ta de busankana kalo na nii manchwoŋo ni dem baŋa ne to, ye o daare o ja Piita o zo.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Busankana kam ma bwei Piita o we, “Nmo tɔge n ye Yezu kwaga tɔgeno mo na?” O ma leiri o we, “Amo dae.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Waaro déem mo wora. Konto ŋwaane tontoŋena bam de Juu tiina dedɛɛra bam ma dwei mini ba zege da ba weera. Piita de ma vo o tɔge o zege da o weeri mini dem. Ba bwei Yezu taane Matiyu

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Wɛ kaanem yuu tu wom laam ma bwei Yezu o tɔgena bam taane, de o berem dem na ye tei to.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Bɛ nam mo ye n bwei amo se n nii? Nam bwei balo na cheigi amo bera yam to n nii amo na tage kolo de-ba to, se banto mo yei amo na tage kolo to.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Anas laam ma pa se ba ja‑o ba vo Kayafa wolo na ye Wɛ kaanem yuu tu to tei, ye ba ta wo bwoli‑o. Piita daa jwoori o fo we o yeiri Yezu Matiyu

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ja Yezu ba nwoŋi Kayafa sɔŋɔ ne ba vo teo kom gɔmena tu wom sɔŋɔ. Ko déem ye tetete mo. Juu tiina bam maa wo dɛ ba zo sɔŋɔ kom wo ba chullu tem ŋwaane. Ba jege se ba che ba tete de digiru se ba wane ba na chwoŋa ba di Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Gɔmena tu Pilata ma nwoŋi ba tei, ye o bwei-ba o we, “Bɛ mo ye abam saŋe nɔɔno wonto?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto ya ná wo ke o chɔge, dé ya bá ja‑o dé ba nmo tei.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Konto nam ke se Yezu na tage kolo to mo ji chega, ne o na wó te toone delo dwi to.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Pilata laam ma jwoori o zo sɔŋɔ kom wo o bwoŋi Yezu, ye o bwei‑o o we, “Nmo ye Juu tiina bam pɛ mo na?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Yezu de daa ma jwoori o bwei‑o o we, “Nmo na tage konto to, ko ye nmo tete boboŋa taane mo naa nɔɔna badwonna mo tage amo taane de nmo?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, “Amo dae Juu tu. Ko ye nmo tete Juu tiina de ba kaanem yiga tiina bam mo jaane nmo ba ba ba ke amo jeŋa ne. Kɔ mo n kea?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri o we, “Amo paare dem wo nwoŋi logo baŋa, se de ya ná ye logo baŋa nyem, amo nɔɔna bam ya wó ke jara se ba che se Juu tiina bam yé na chwoŋa se ba ja amo. Ko nam na ye tei to, amo paare dem ye jeiga kadwoŋi nyem mo.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Pilata ma bwei‑o o we, “Konto to, nmo ye pɛ mo na?” Yezu ma leiri o we, “Nmo tete mo tage n we, a ye pɛ. A tu se a ŋɔɔne chega kam taane mo a bere nɔɔna logo baŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane mo ba loge amo. Wolo maama na ye chega nɔɔno to mo cheigi amo taane.”

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Abam nam yeini á jege meo kodwoŋi. Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem maŋa ne amo yeini a le peeno dedoa a yage a pa abam se o viiri. Abam nam lage se a yage Juu tiina pɛ wom mo na?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Ba ma laare de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Ko dae wonto, ko ye Barabas mo dé laga se n yage.” Barabas ya ye venvereno mo.

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Pilata laam ma pa se ba yɔɔre ba ja Yezu ba fere.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Soja tiina bam ma kwei sabare ba ma sɔ yipuga ba pu o yuu ne. Ba ma kwei gare-soŋo ba zo‑o ne o ye pɛ mo tei.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Ba maa vei o tei kuni dedɛ, ye ba tɛ ded‑o ba we, “Juu tiina Pɛ, de n lei”. Ba maa jege o popwaano ba lɔe.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Pilata daa ta ma jwoori o nwoŋi pwooni, ye o ta de kɔgɔ kom o we, “Nii-na, amo wó pa se nɔɔno wom nwoŋi o ba o zege abam yiga ne se á wane á lɔre we, amo wo nɛ o na ke kolo o chɔge to.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Yezu ma nwoŋi de o yuu sabare yipuga kam de o gare-soŋo kom. Pilata ma ta de-ba o we, “Nii-na nɔɔno wom da.”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba nɔɔna bam na nɛ‑o to, ba maa tɛ de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Go‑o! Pa‑o dagara yuu ne n go!” O ma ta de-ba o we, “Abam tete nam ja‑o á pa dagara yuu ne, se amo wo nɛ kolo o na ke o chɔge se a ma vane o bora to.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam ma jwoori ba leiri‑o ba we, “Debam jege Wɛ ni delo na bere we o jege se o te to, kolo ŋwaane o bere o tete we o ye Wɛ Bu.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Pilata na nigi ba na tage konto to, foone ma tiini de zo‑o.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: O ma jwoori o zo sɔŋɔ kom wo, ye o bwei Yezu o we, “Nmo nwoŋi yei ne mo?” Yezu ma chem.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: O ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nmo chem mo de amo na? Ta‑n yei we amo jege dam se a yage nmo, naa se a pa ba pa nmo dagara yuu ne ba go.”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yezu ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo ya bá ta‑n jege dam amo baŋa ne, ko ná dae Wɛ mo pɛ‑m. Konto ŋwaane, nɔɔno wolo na kwei amo o ke nmo jeŋa ne to mo tiini o ke wo-lɔŋɔ o dwoni nmo.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Pilata na nigi konto to, o maa kwaane o lage chwoŋa se o pa ba yage Yezu. Ko daare Juu tiina bam maa tiini ba tɛ de kwor-dɛa ba we, “Nmo ná yage nɔɔno wonto, ko wó bere we n chuli logo kom Pa-faro wom mo. Nɔɔno wolo ná pɛ o tete paare, konto tu dwoni de Pa-faro wom mo.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Pilata na nigi konto to, o ma ja Yezu o nwoŋi, ye o daare o jeini taane dim jeiŋa kam jei ne. Ba bwoi jei sem konto we, ‘Kandwa-pelwaaro jeiga’ mo. Ko yere de Juu tiina taane dem mo ye ‘Gabata’.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Ko déem ye wea tetare ne mo, dɛ dem tega na wó poore se Atɔgebabaŋa kuri dem di to. Pilata laam ma ta de Juu tiina bam o we, “Nii-na á pɛ wom da.”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Pilata laam ma kwei Yezu o ke ba jeŋa ne se ba pa‑o dagara yuu ne ba go. Ba jaane Yezu ba vo ba pa dagara yuu ne Matiyu

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, soja tiina bam ma vo balo ba na go ba woli de Yezu to tei, ye ba bwori da-yiga nɔɔno wom nɛ, de o dwoŋi wom nɛ.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam na nɛ to, ba ma vo ba ta de Pilata ba we, “Ko wo maŋe se n popone we, ‘Juu tiina Pɛ’. Nam popone we, ‘Nɔɔno wonto mo bere o tete we o ye Juu tiina Pɛ.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Yezu na nɛ o nu wom de o kwaga tɔgeno wolo o na jege o swono lanyerane, ye ba zege da to, o ma ta de o nu wom o we, “A nu, nii nmo bu wom da.”

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ko ye dáane mo ba jaane‑o ba pa dagara kam yuu ne. Ba ma ja nɔɔna balei de ba pa dagare baŋa ne. Yezu maa wo banto balei tetare ne.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Pilata ma popone maanem tɔn-kamunu ye o pa ba tane-ko dagara kam yuu ne. Ko poponem dem we: YEZU, NAZARETE TU, JUU TIINA PƐ.

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam dedɛ déem ma ga tɔnɔ kom, kolo ŋwaane jeiga kalo ba na page Yezu da to bwola de teo kom ni. Tɔnɔ kom déem popone de Juu tiina taane, de Rom tiina taane, de Girisi tiina taane mo.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: O ma leiri-ba o we, “Amo na popone tei to daa ba kwana.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, ba ma ta daane ba we, “Yé pa-na se dé kaare-ko. Nam pa-na dé ta jɔrɔ se dé nii wolo na wó jwoŋi-ko to.” Ko déem ke konto mo se ko pa kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone to mo ji chega de ko na we, “Ba pɔɔre amo gwaaro ba pa daane, ye ba daare ba ta jɔrɔ amo gare-bu wom ŋwaane.” Soja tiina bam ma seene ba ke konto.

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Balo déem na zega ba bwola de Yezu dagara kam to mo ye o nu wom, de o nu nyaane, de Mary wolo na ye Kalopa kaane to, de Mary wolo na ye Magadala tu to.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi Yezu. Ba ma na we o maŋe o te mo ye ba daa wo bwori wonto nɛ.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Gaare mo wo jei selo ne ba na page Yezu dagara yuu ne to. Peo maa wo gaare dem wone, ye yibeeli-doore wora peo kom yera ne, ba ta na wo ke nɔɔn-nɔɔno da.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne Yezu maa yei we woŋo maama ke ko ti. O na lage se Wɛ tɔnɔ kom seene ko ji chega to, o laam ma ta o we, na-nyɔm jege‑o.

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Zoŋa déem mo zege da, ye ka ni su de sana balo na nyɔna to. Ba ma kwei sɔsɔɔ ba de sa-nyɔna bam wone, ye ba vɔ-ko daa ni ne ba tei wɛɛne ba pa se ko yi o ni.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Yezu ma nyɔ sa-nyɔna bam, ye o ta o we, “Ko laam ke ko ti.” O ma daare o chɔɔle o yuu tega ne, ye o laam pa o jworo kom nwoŋi o tei ne.

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye dɛ delo Juu tiina maama na yeini ba ti ba yiga se ba siu dɛ dem laam yi to mo. Tega na wó poore se ko taa ye ba siu dɛ-kamunu kom to, ba maa ba lage se nɔɔna bam yera yam taa wo dagare sem yera ne dɛ dem konto ne. Konto ŋwaane Juu tiina badwonna ma vo Pilata tei ba ta ded‑o se o pa chwoŋa se ba bwori nɔɔna bam nɛ se ba daare ba pare ba yera yam.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Ko daare soja tu dedoa ma kwei o chichwei o ma zɔ Yezu saŋa ne. Jana de na maa tae ba nwoŋa.

translation_verse: ko zege maŋa kam Jɔn na bobo o pa nɔɔna sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane to se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam Yezu na yage debam tei o di Wɛ telaao to. Dé na lage dé kuri nɔɔno wolo to wó zege dé Teiru Yezu chega kam kwaga ne de o na bi toone wone tei to.”

english_verse: Two men were suggested: One of them was Joseph Barsabbas, known as Justus, and the other was Matthias.
translation_verse: Piita na tage konto o ti to, ba ma le nɔɔna balei yera. Dedoa mo ye Josɛf wolo ba na bwoŋi we Basaba ye ba daa ta bwoi‑o we Jusitu to. Wodwoŋi wom maa ye Matias.

english_verse: to be an apostle and to serve in place of Judas, who got what he deserved.”
translation_verse: se o ji nmo tontoŋeno to, se o taa toŋe totoŋa yalo Judas na kwei o yage ye o daare o vo o na maŋe se o vo mɛ to.”

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Sɔɔ ma pɔpɔ ko nwoŋi wɛyuu ne nenɛɛne vo-dɛɔ na fuli tei to. Sɔŋɔ kom ba na jei ko wone to ni maama ma su de sɔɔ kom konto.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ba ba maama tei ne de dam, ye ba bobo se ba taa ŋɔɔne taana dwi dwi, nenɛɛne Sin-laao kom na pɛ-ba dam se ba ŋɔɔne taane delo to.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Ba yera ma sɔɔre ye ba ye yaau. Ba maa tɛ ba we, “Nii-na. Banto maama ye Galili tiina mo ye ba zege ba ŋɔɔne tento dwoŋi.

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Ko nam ke tɛ mo ye debam maama ni ba na ŋɔɔne debam dedoa dedoa dwi taane?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Dé nwoŋi jei dwi dwi mo. Debam badwonna nwoŋi Patia, de Media, de Elam, ko woli de Mesopotamia, de Judea, de Kapadokia, dedaane Pontusi, de Asia teene dem maama.

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Debam ye Juu tiina mo, ko woli de dwi-gɛ tiina balo laam na sɛ Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to. Debam badwonna maa nwoŋi Kiriti, de Arabia. De konto de, debam maama nam ta ni ba na mae debam dedoa dedoa taane ba ŋɔɔne wo-kamunnu telo Wɛ na ke to.”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na ye yaau ye ba boboŋa vugimi konto to, ba maa bwei daane ba we, “Keim dento kuri mo bɛ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Ba badaara nam maa jege Yezu tontoŋena bam ba mɔna ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔna banto nyɔge sana mo ba su.”

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Piita laam ma zaŋe wɛɛne dedaane o dwonna fuga-dedoa bam. O ma ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa o ta de nɔn-kɔgɔ kom o we: “Amo badwonna bam, Juu tiina de abam balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to, cheigi-na se a ta keim dento kuri a bere abam.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Abam na boŋe we nɔɔna banto nyɔge sana mo ba su to, ko nam dae konto. Ko daa ta ye tetete mo. Wea ta wo bege se ba nyɔ sana.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Ko nam ye kolo Wɛ sampwora Joweli déem na ŋɔɔne ko taane to mo.

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: Chega to, da yam konto ne a lage a lwo a Jworo mo a tontoŋena baŋa ne, baara de kaana de, pa se ba pworisi amo kwora kam.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó pa se wo-kenkagela taa nae wɛyuu ne, ye a daare a ke maana tega baŋa ne. Kanto maŋa kam ne jana wó taa wora, de mini, de nyoa kalo na tiini ka zwora to.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Wea kam wó ba ka vaŋe ka ji lim, ye chana kam de ji nasoŋo ne jana tei. Ko laam daare se Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom ba ko yi, se o nenɔŋa kam de bere jaja.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Dɛ dem konto ne, wolo maama na wó bwoŋi dé Teiru Wɛ wom yere o ma lwoori zeinim to wó na verem.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: A badwonna Isarele tiina bam, cheigi-ne. A lage a ta Nazarete tu Yezu taane. Wɛ tɔge wonto baŋa ne mo o ke wo-kamunnu, de wo-kenkagela, de maana se ko bere abam we o seene o nwoŋi Wɛ tei. Abam tete nam maŋe á yei konto, kolo ŋwaane wonnu tem konto maŋe te ke abam tei ne.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋe o yei ko na wó taa ye tei to. O boboŋa déem ya maŋe ya ja pa se ba ja Yezu ba ke abam jeŋa ne. Abam ma daare á tɔge nɔn-balwaaro jeŋa mo á pa se ba ja‑o ba pa dagara yuu ne. Konto mo á mɛ á go‑o.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo bi‑o toone wone. Toone déem wo wane de cheiŋi‑o de yage yibeeli dem wone. Mo kokuri Wɛ jwoŋi‑o toone yaara yam wone o yage.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to Pɛ David tage Wɛ Bu wom taane o we: ‘Amo nɛ a Teiru Wɛ a tei ne maŋa maama. O maa wo a jazem seeni mo se o zeini-ne se a zege cheppe.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a jege wopwolo lanyerane, ye amo ni taane dem de jege ywoni. Amo ye nabiinu mo ye a nam jege teena Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane amo ná tega, nmo Wɛ bá‑n yage-ne se a taa wo churu ne. Nmo bá‑n sɛ se n tete Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom yera pɔ.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Nmo pɛ se a lɔre chwei selo na pae ŋwea to se a taa tɔge-se. Amo ná yi nmo tei, nmo wó pa se a na ywoni dedɛ.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, mo kolo debam nabaaro David déem na tage to. Amo nam lage a ŋɔɔne wonto taane mo jaja a bere abam we o tega. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli, ye o yibeeli ta wora de zem maama.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: O déem nam ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu mo. Wɛ déem dugi duuri o pa‑o we, omo wó pa se o dwi tiina bam dedoa zaŋe o di paare o jeiŋa kam jei ne. David ma guli Wɛ na gwoni o ni ded‑o konto to.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: O ma wuuri o lɔre kolo Wɛ na wó ke to. Konto ŋwaane mo o tage o we, ‘Wɛ wo sɛ se o yage‑o churu ne. O yera yam de nam wo pɔge.’ O na tage konto to, ko ye Wɛ Dam Tu Krista toone biim taane mo o taga.

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: Chega to, Wɛ mo bi Yezu wom tete, ye debam maama zege chega kam konto kwaga ne.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bi‑o konto to, o ma daare o pa se o vo o jeini o jazem seeni. Yezu laam ma jwoŋi Sin-laao kom o Kwo Wɛ tei ne, ne Wɛ na pwooli se o pa‑o tei to. Abam zem nam na nae wonnu telo ye á kwori á ni telo to ye Yezu mo pɛ te ke.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ko dae David tete mo Wɛ kwei o ja di telaao. Wonto nam tage o we: ‘Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tage de amo Teiru o we: Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: se a laam wane nmo dona maama a ke nmo dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Tɔ. Isarele dwi tiina maama nam jege se ba taa yei lanyerane we, ko ná ye Yezu wom abam na jaane á pa dagara yuu ne á go to, ko ye wonto tete mo Wɛ laam pɛ se o taa ye Dam Tu Krista wom ye o kwori o ye debam Teiru.”

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na nigi Piita na tage kolo konto to, ko ma tiini ko chɔge ba wo dedɛ. Ba ma bwei Piita de o dwonna totoŋa nakwa bam ba we, “Dé nu-bia bam, dé nam wó ke tɛ mo?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Piita ma leiri-ba o we, “Abam maama jege se á leiri á wo de á keim-balwaaro tem, se á daare á jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane, se Wɛ wó yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam. Wɛ laam wó pa se o Sin-laao kom taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Piita ta ma jwoori o fɔge o ma taane dedɛ o kaane-ba o we, ba kwaane ba jwoŋi ba tete zem nɔɔna bam wone de ba na tusi tei to.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama déem maa kɔre Wɛ lanyerane. Wɛ ma pa Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam dam se ba taa ke wo-kenkagela de maana dedɛ.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
