translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena bam maama maa yeini ba la daane ye ba kwori ba jege ba wonnu ba maŋe ba pa daane.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Ba maa yeini ba kwei ba jejegero de ba zela ba yeiga, ye ba maŋe te sabu kom ba ma woli nɔɔno maama ne ba dedoa dedoa na lage tei to.

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: Ba maa tei Wɛ maŋa maama. Nɔɔna maama maa pae ba ye nɔn-ŋona. Dɛ maama wuu dé Teiru wom maa pae se balo na tu ba na verem to woli ba kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo Piita de Jɔn déem zaŋe ba vo Wɛ diga kam maŋa kalo nɔɔna na yeini ba ware Wɛ to. Wɛ-guni maŋa ne mo konto.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi wara-jei sem ni dem ba na bwoi we ‘Ni-laao’ to. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem tigi da o na maŋe o ye gɔrɔ o biini ne to. Nɔɔna maa yeini ba zeiŋi‑o ba vo ba jeini da dɛ maama se o taa lwoori sabia nɔɔna balo na tɔge da ba zo diga kam to tei ne.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma na Piita de Jɔn na maa zoora. O ma lwoori-ba se ba pa‑o woŋo.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Ba ma yɔɔre ba nii‑o. Piita laam ma ta ded‑o o we, “Nii debam seeni!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: O ma seene o nii-ba ye o jege teena se ba pa‑o woŋo.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Amo ba jege sabia se a pa‑m. A nam wó pa nmo a na jege wolim delo to. A tɛ nmo Nazarete tu Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane, zaŋe n ta n via.”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Piita na tage konto o ti to, o laam ma ja o jazem o woli‑o pa se o zaŋe wɛɛne. O na zaŋe konto bedwe baŋa ne to mo o nɛ sem de o nakwollu tem maama ke dam lanyerane.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma faŋe wɛɛne o jwoori o ba o chu o nɛ baŋa ne ye o bobo se o taa via. O ma tɔge-ba o zo Wɛ diga kam wo. O maa via ye o faŋa wɛɛne ye o tei Wɛ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma na o na vei ye o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: Ba ma lɔre we nɔɔno wom konto mo ye lwoonu wolo ya na jei wara-jei sem Ni-laao kom ne to. Ba na lɔre‑o to, ko ma tiini ko kagele-ba ye ba yeiri kolo na ke‑o to.

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma yɔɔre o meeli Piita de Jɔn. Nɔɔna bam maama maa ye yaau. Ba ma zaŋe ba duri ba vo ba tei, konkɔlɔ kom na jege napɔrɔ mɛ to, ko yere mo Solomon napɔrɔ kom.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Piita na nɛ nɔɔna bam konto to, o ma ta de-ba o we: “A badwonna Isarele tiina bam, bɛŋwaane mo abam ye yaau de kolo na ke to? Bɛ mo ye abam yɔɔre á nii debam konto? Abam boŋe we ko ye debam dam mo pɛ o zaŋe o vei na? Á boŋe we ko ye debam na kɔre Wɛ lanyerane to ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Abaraham Wɛ wom, de Izaak de Jakob Wɛ wom na ye dé nabaara maama Wɛ to laam mo pɛ se o tontoŋeno Yezu jwoŋi paare. Abam jaane wonto mo á pa ba go‑o. Pilata déem boŋe se o yage‑o ye abam nam wo sɛ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Yezu Krista ye Wo-pwoŋo Tu mo de Chega Tu. Abam nam ve‑o, ye á daare á lwoori Pilata se o le nɔn-goro mo o yage o pa abam.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Abam na ke tei to, á go wolo na ye ŋwea tu to mo. Wɛ ma daare o bi‑o toone wone, ye debam zege chega kam konto kwaga ne.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Ko ye Yezu yere dem ŋwaane mo pɛ gɔrɔ kom na dam o yera ne. Dé na ke dé wo-dedoa de Yezu to mo pɛ ko ke ne á na nɛ tei, ye á maŋe á yei nɔɔno wom to. Ko ye wo-dedoa kalo na tɔge Yezu ŋwaane to mo pɛ o laam na yazura chekke abam maama yiga ne.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: Amo nu-bia bam, abam de á yiga tiina bam na ke Yezu tei to, amo yei we abam ya yeiri woŋo kolo á na ke to.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane nam leiri-na á wo se á daare á pipiri á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ, se Wɛ wó yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Konto to, dé Teiru Wɛ wó wane o pa se abam bochara taa zura maŋa de maŋa, ye o laam daare o toŋe o Dam Tu Krista wom, o na maŋe o tiŋi‑o o pa abam to. Yezu mo konto.

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: O jege se o taa wo telaao ne se ko taa vei maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge o kwɛ wonnu maama to, ne o na maŋe o pa o sampwori sem tɔɔle o kwora faŋa faŋa tei to.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kam o déem na pɛ o sampwori sem se ba tɔɔle to ye abam nyem mo. Wɛ ni dem o déem na gwoni o pa dé nabaara bam to de daa ta ye abam nyem. O déem gwoni ni de Abaraham o we, ‘Ko wó tɔge nmo dwi tiina ŋwaane mo pa amo swɛ logo baŋa dwi maama swolim.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ na pɛ o tontoŋeno wom zaŋe o ba to, o bobo o toŋe‑o abam tei ne mo se o ke abam zaane de o na wae o pa se abam dedoa dedoa yage o keim-lwanno tem to.”

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Ba bane tiini de zaŋe de Yezu nɔɔna bam de ba na bere tei ba we, Yezu bi toone wone ye konto bere we twa wó jwoori ba bi ba taa ŋwe.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja Piita de Jɔn ba ke peena diga ne. Tega na maŋe ka yi to, ba ma yage-ba da se tega poore.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Ko daare kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna dedɛ ma sɛ taane delo ba na nigi to. Balo na sɛ to kɔgɔ kom déem ma ba ko yi nenɛɛne nɔɔna morro tenu (

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Juu tiina yiga tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam ma la daane Jerusalem ne.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Ba ma jeeri dedaane Anas wolo na ye ba kaanem yuu tu wom to, de Kayafa, de Jɔn, de Alezanda, de baara balo na tɔge ba ye kaanem yuu tu wom sɔŋɔ tiina to.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Ba ma pa se Piita de Jɔn ba ba zege ba yiga ne. Ba ma bwei-ba ba we, “Abam ke tɛ mo á wae á ke konto? Bɛ ŋo dam mo á jege á ma á ke? Wɔ yere ŋwaane mo á ma á ke?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba Piita tei de dam. O ma leiri-ba o we, “Dé teo kom yiga tiina de nakwa bam, cheigi-na!

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: Abam zem na bwei debam kolo taane to, ko ná ye debam na zeini gɔrɔ kom pa se o na yazura tei to,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: dé wó pa se abam de Isarele dwi tiina bam maama lɔre ko na ke tei. Ta‑á yei-na we Nazarete tu Yezu Krista yere dem ŋwaane mo pɛ se nɔɔno wonto yɔɔre o na yazura ye o laam ba o zege abam yiga ne. Abam nam page Yezu Krista dagara yuu ne á go, ye Wɛ nam bi‑o toone wone.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Wonto mo ye wolo Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko ta o taane we: ‘Kandwɛ delo abam lɔra bam na ve to laam mo jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam dana to mo.’

english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista yerane mo wae o jwoŋi nɔɔna o yaga. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi yere daa tera logo baŋa ne Wɛ na pɛ nabiina se dé wane dé na verem o ŋwaane.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Juu tiina nakwa bam na nɛ Piita de Jɔn na jege baare de ba na ŋɔɔne tei to, ko ma ke-ba yaau de ba na ye nɔn-yɔɔro ye ba dae tɔn-yeena to ŋwaane. Ba ma jeeli we banto ya me de Yezu mo.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Ba na nɛ gɔrɔ kom na zege Piita de Jɔn tei ne ye o jege yazura to, ba maa ware kolokolo se ba daa ta.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Ba ma ta-ba we, ba nwoŋi ba kɔgɔ kom ne se ba daare. Ba laam maa wora ba bane daane se ba nii.

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Dé nam wó ke nɔɔna bam konto tɛ mo? Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Jerusalem ne to lɔre we banto mo ke wo-kenkagele dem konto. Dé daa bá wane dé ta we, vwa.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Dé nam na lage se keim dento yé jage de vo yiga to, dé jege se dé kaane nɔɔna bam mo se ba daa yé ŋɔɔne de nɔɔn-nɔɔno Yezu yere ŋwaane.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma jwoori ba bwoŋi-ba, ye ba zo. Ba ma ta-ba we, ba ba jege chwoŋa se ba daa tɔge Yezu yere ŋwaane ba ŋɔɔna, naa se ba taa bere nɔɔna konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Piita de Jɔn ma leiri-ba ba we, “Ko maŋe se dé sɛ abam mo naa Wɛ mo? Kɔ mo lana Wɛ yiga ne? Abam tete boŋe-na á nii.

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: Debam nam bá wane dé yage kolo dé na nɛ ye dé kwori dé ni to ŋɔŋa.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Kokuri nɔɔno wolo wo-kenkagele dem na ke o baŋa ne ye o na yazura to dwoi bena finna. Yezu tɔgena tiini ba lwoori Wɛ

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Ba maa na yage Piita de Jɔn konto to, ba ma jwoori ba vo ba kɔgɔ kom tei. Ba ma ta de-ba Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam de ba teo kom nakwa bam na tage kolo to.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ba na nigi konto to, ba maama ma woli daane ba ware Wɛ ye ba we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo mo ke wɛyuu, de tega baŋa, de naneo, de wonnu telo maama na zoore te wone to.

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: Dé nabaaro David déem mo ye nmo tontoŋeno. Nmo déem ma pa se n Sin-laao kom tɔge David ŋwaane ye o ta nmo kwora o we: ‘Bɛ mo ye logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam bane zaŋe? Bɛ mo ye ba ke daane ba boŋe boboŋa kafɛ ŋwaane?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Ba pwa bam de ba dedɛɛra bam ma la daane se ba ke chichuŋu dedaane Baŋa Wɛ de o Dam Tu Krista wom.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Ko seene ko ke konto mo. Teo konto ne mo Herodi de Pontusi Pilata jeini daane de Isarele dwi tiina, de dwi-gɛ tiina, se ba ŋɔɔne Yezu taane ba ma chɔge‑o, ye wonto ye n tontoŋeno-laao nmo na tiŋi‑o se o ba to.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Wɛ, nii ba na lage ba yaare debam tei to! Debam nam mo ye n tontoŋena. Nam pa debam chwoŋa se dé wane dé taa ŋɔɔne nmo kwora kam de baare.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Nam twe n je-dɛa kam se n pa nɔɔna taa nae yazura, ye n pa se wo-kenkagela de maana taa ke nmo tontoŋeno-laao Yezu yere ŋwaane.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Ba na ware Wɛ ba ti to, jeiga kam ba na lage daane mɛ to maa ziziŋa. Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba ba maama tei de dam, ye ba ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora kam de baare.

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena bam kɔgɔ kom maama boboŋa de ba ŋwea maama déem ye bedwe mo. Ba wolowolo wo tage we, o yerane mo tei o wonnu. Ba maama maŋe wonnu telo ba na jege to mo ba pa daane.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam maa jege dam-fɔrɔ, ye ba fɔge ba bere dé Teiru Yezu chega kam we o seene o bi toone wone. Wɛ ma zeini ba maama de o zaane dem lanyerane.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera ba kɔgɔ kom wone o na ye yiniga tu. Balo na jege kare naa di to wó yeigi-se mo,

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: ye o daare o twori sabu kom wone se o taa jega. O kaane wom maa yei o na ke tei to. Anania ma kwei o na twori o daare kolo to o ke Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: O na ke konto to, Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Anania, bɛ mo ke ye nmo pa se setaana pɛ wae n bochare konto dwoŋi, pa se n fɔ vwa de Wɛ Sin-laao kom de nmo na twori kara kam sabu kom wone n pa n tete to?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam nmo ta na wo yeigi kara kam to, ko ya ye nmo nyem mo. Nmo nam na kwei n yeigi to, sabu kom ta ye nmo nyem. Bɛŋwaane mo n boŋe n bochare ne we nmo wó ke keim dem konto? Nmo na fɔge vwa konto to, n ke n chɔge Wɛ yiga mo, se ko dae nabiina yerane.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Anania na nigi konto to, o ma to tega ne o te. Ko déem ma pa se foone ja balo maama na lɔre ko ni ne to.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Nɔn-donno na wora to ma zaŋe ba vo ba pipiri too wom, ye ba daare ba kwei‑o ba ja nwoŋi ba suli.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Ko na ke fenfee nenɛɛne awa batɔ to, o kaane wom de daa ma ba o zo Piita ba tei. O daa ta ma wo lɔre kolo na ke to.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Piita ma ta ded‑o o we, “Ta n bere-ne, mo sabu kolo nmo de n baro wom na jwoŋi á kara kam ŋwaane to na?” O ma sɛ ye o we, “Ɛɛ, ko maama mo tento.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Piita laam ma bwei‑o o we, “Bɛŋwaane mo nmo de n baro wom boŋe se á maŋe Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ Sin-laao kom á nii? Leile konto, nɔɔna balo ya na kwei n baro wom ba suli to ta zege diga kam ni ne. Ba nam wó zeŋe nmo de ba ja nwoŋi.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: O na tage konto o ti to bedwe baŋa ne mo kaane wom to tega ne Piita yiga ne ye o te. Nɔn-donno tem ma ba te nii de o tega. Ba ma kwei‑o ba ja nwoŋi ba suli o baro wom saŋa ne.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Foone déem ma ja Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam de balo maama de na nigi kolo na ke to.

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam déem ma pa se maana de wo-kenkagela dedɛ ke nɔɔna tetare ne. Yezu nɔɔna bam maama déem yeini ba tigisi daane de ni dedwe Solomon napɔrɔ kom ne.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Yezu nɔɔna bam na ye konto to, nɔɔna maa zeŋe jaweena ba nwoŋi ba tiŋi chwei sem nia ne. Ba déem tiŋi-ba sare de gungwollu baŋa ne se Piita ná maa tɔge da o kɛa, se o lunluŋu yerane wane ko tɔge ba badwonna baŋa.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ maa yeini ba nwoŋi Jerusalem nawuura yam maama wone ba jaane jaweena de balo chichiri na daane-ba to ba tui, pa ko gare ba maama yera ne. Ba jege Yezu tontoŋena bam ba yaara

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma zaŋe ba ja-ba ba vo ba ke peena diga kalo ba na pe ŋweena da to.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Tega na yi to, Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma ba ka pore peena diga kam nia yam, pa se Yezu tontoŋena bam nwoŋi pwooni. Ka ma ta de-ba ka we,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: ba véi ba zo Wɛ diga kam se ba taa bere nɔɔna bam Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane chekke.

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Ba ma seene ba sɛ Wɛ maleka kam ni. Tega na poore tetete to, ba ma vo ba zo Wɛ diga kam ba wora ba bere nɔɔna bam. Kaanem yuu tu wom de o nɔɔna bam laam ma bwoŋi Juu tiina nakwa bam maama pa se ba tigisi daane. Ba ma daare ba toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo ba le Yezu tontoŋena bam peena diga kam ne ba ja ba ba pa-ba.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Ba nɔɔna bam na yi da to mo ba wo nɛ Yezu tontoŋena bam. Ba ma jwoori ba vo Juu tiina nakwa bam tei ye ba we,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Dé na yi da to, peena diga kam nia mo pe de dam. Nɔɔna balo na wora ba nii jei sem se nɔɔna yé lu to maa zege da. Dé nam na pore diga kam to, dé wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno ka wone.”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Kaanem yiga tiina bam dedaane Wɛ diga kam soja tiina dedɛɛro wom na nigi konto to, ba boboŋa ma vugimi. Ba maa yeiri kolo na lage ko ke se ko kweeli to.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi laam ma ba o zo ba na wo mɛ to o ta de-ba o we, “Nii-na, nɔɔna balo abam ya na jaane á ke peena diga ne to laam wo Wɛ diga kam ne ba zege ba bere nɔɔna bam.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro wom na nigi konto to, o de o nɔɔna bam ma zaŋe ba vo ba ja Yezu tontoŋena bam ba ba. Ba ma wo mɛ dam ba zi-ba, kolo ŋwaane ba kɔre mo we nɔɔna bam wó dole-ba de kandwa.

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Ba laam ma pa se ba zo ba zege Juu tiina nakwa bam kɔgɔ kom yiga ne. Kaanem yuu tu wom laam ma bwei-ba se o nii.

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: O ma ta o we, “Debam maŋe dé kaane abam se á daa yé ta‑á bere kolokolo nɔɔno wonto yere ŋwaane. Nii abam na ke tei to. Á pɛ se á berem dem yerane mo jage Jerusalem maama wone, ye á ta lage á pa se wonto toone dem taa ye debam yiga.”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Piita de o dwonna nakwa bam ma leiri ba we, “Debam jege se dé sɛ Wɛ ni mo, se ko dae nabiina yerane.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wom dé nabaara na tɔge to mo bi Yezu toone wone. Ko ye abam ya mo jaane‑o á pa dagara yuu ne á go.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo seene o bi‑o o daare o pa se o jeini o jazem seeni, se o taa ye debam Yiga tu, de dé Vereno. Konto wae ko pa se Isarele tiina na chwoŋa ba leiri ba wo se Wɛ laam yage ba wɛleera o ma chɛ-ba.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Debam nam mo zege chega kam konto kwaga ne, ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom de tɔge ko zege ka kwaga ne. Kokuri Wɛ pɛ se o Sin-laao kom taa wo balo na sɛ o ni to tei ne.”

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Juu tiina nakwa bam na nigi Yezu tontoŋena bam na tage kolo to, ba bane ma tiini de zaŋe de-ba. Ba boboŋa ma ja se ba go-ba.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: O ma daare o ta de nakwa bam kɔgɔ kom o we, “Amo dwonna Isarele tiina bam, á ta‑á yei á tete de á na boŋe se á ke nɔɔna banto tei to.

english_verse: men joined him. But he was killed, and all his followers were scattered. That was the end of that.
translation_verse: ). Ba déem nam go‑o mo ye o tɔgena bam jage da yiga ne. Kolokolo daa maa wo daare.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, Galili tu wodwoŋi de daa ma zaŋe, o yere mo Judas. Maŋa kam ba déem na wora ba gare dé logo kom nɔn-bia to mo o zaŋe o la kɔgɔ o ke o kwaga ne. Ba ma go wonto de. O de kwaga tɔgena bam ma jage da yiga ne.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a nam tɛ abam se á yé zaŋe á ke nɔɔna banto kolokolo. Nam yage-na ba yera, kolo ŋwaane ba boboŋa de ba totoŋa maama ná tɔge nabiina yerane ŋwaane, ya wó taa ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Wɛ kikia mo, abam bá wane á che-ba. Á nam wó ba á lɔre we, á ke chichuŋu de Wɛ mo.” Gamaleli na tage konto o ti to, ba ma sɛ o taane dem.

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwoŋi Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam pa se ba jwoori ba zo ba tei. Ba ma fere-ba de kaasa ye ba daare ba kaane-ba se ba daa yé ŋɔɔne kolokolo Yezu yere ŋwaane kɔtaa. Ba laam ma yage-ba se ba viiri.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yezu tontoŋena bam ma nwoŋi nakwa bam tei ne ye ba jege wopwolo lanyerane de Wɛ na pɛ se ba maŋe se ba na yaara Yezu yere ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama wuu ba maa yeini ba tigisi daane Wɛ diga kam ne, ye ba daare ba tole sam ba bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam. Ba maa tɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ba bere nɔɔna we Yezu mo seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne Yezu tɔgena bam kɔgɔ kom maa wora ko pula dedɛ. Ba kɔgɔ kom wone Juu tiina balo na ye veira ye ba ŋɔɔne Girisi tiina taane dem to maa jege balo na ŋɔɔne ba tete Juu tiina taane dem to ba poona. Woŋo kolo ŋwaane ye ba poona konto to ye sabu kolo ba na yeini ba maŋe ba pa kadeina se ba maa lage ba ni-wodiu dɛ maama to. Veira bam maa we ba kadeina bam ba jwoŋi kolo na maŋe de-ba to.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Yezu tontoŋena fuga-balei bam ma bwoŋi ba kɔgɔ kom maama ba ke daane ye ba ta ba we, “Ko wo maŋe se debam tete mo yage Wɛ kwora kam berem se dé daare dé taa nii wodiiru tem sabu kom.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, abam nam jege se á le nɔɔna barepɛ á wone se dé pa ba taa nii wonnu tento baŋa ne. Banto wó taa ye balo á na yei we Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo ba tei ne lanyerane ye ba jege boboŋ-dɛɛra to.

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam tete, dé wó seene dé yia mo Wɛ warem de o kwora kam berem baŋa ne.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Ba na tage konto to, ko ma pwoli ba kɔgɔ kom maama wo. Ba ma nii ba kuri nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Stiiven. Wonto maa tiini o jege wo-dedoa de Yezu ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo o tei ne lanyerane. Ba ma kuri Filipi, de Porokora, de Nikano, de Timon, de Pamena, de Nikola wolo na nwoŋi Antioka ye o ye dwi-gɛ tu na tu o sɛ Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to ba woli da.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Ba ma le-ba ba ja vo ba zege Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam yiga ne. Ba ma ware Wɛ ba pa-ba ye ba kwei ba jea ba daŋe ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kam déem ma fɔge ka jage ka yi jei maama. Yezu nɔɔna bam kɔgɔ kom ma puli dedɛ Jerusalem ne. Juu tiina kaanem tiina dedɛ de déem ma ba ba sɛ Yezu chega kam. Ba jaane Stiiven

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna nam wora ba na mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o. Banto nwoŋi Juu tiina kɔgɔ kolo ba na bwoi we ‘Libatiina’ to wone. Ba déem nwoŋi Kurene de Alɛzandaria mo. Ba ma tɔge ba woli de Juu tiina badaara na nwoŋi Kilikia de Asia teene dedwonna to.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Ba nam na zaŋe ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o to, o ma ŋɔɔne de swa taane, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ‑o dam tei to, pa se ba daa ware o taane ba leiri.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma nwoŋi ba ke ni dedaane nɔɔna badwonna pa se ba fɔ vwa ba ta o taane ba we, “Debam nigi nɔɔno wonto na ŋɔɔne o chɔge Moses de Wɛ yuu.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Ba na jege Stiiven ba yaala konto to, ko ma pa se Juu tiina bam, de ba nakwa bam, de ba zamesem tiina bam maama bane zaŋe ded‑o. Ba ma zaŋe ba zi‑o ba ja vo ba nakwa kɔgɔ kom yiga ne se ba di o taane.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ba ma pa se nɔɔna badwonna zo ba fɔ vwa ba pa‑o, ye ba ta ba we, “Maŋa maama nɔɔno wonto yɔɔre o ŋɔɔne ta-balwaaro o pae Wɛ diga kam, de Wɛ nia yam.

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: Dé ma ni o na tage tei o we, Nazarete tu Yezu mo wó ba o chɔge Wɛ diga kam, ye o daare o pipiri chwei selo maama Moses déem na bere dé nabaara se dé taa tɔge to.”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Juu tiina nakwa balo maama na jei da to laam ma yɔɔre ba nii Stiiven. Ba ma nii ba na o yibia na nye de maleka yibia tei to.

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ma ta ded‑o o we, o yage o tete teo kom de o sɔŋɔ tiina, se o daare o vo jei selo omo na wó bere‑o to.

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: O ma seene o zaŋe o nwoŋi Chaladea tiina teo kom o vo o yi Haran o zoore da. O na wo dáane to, o kwo ma te. Wɛ ma pa se o daa nwoŋi o fɔɔre o vo o yi teo konto mɛ abam na zoore zem to.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wo pɛ Abaraham tega ywo-seeni se o taa tei, de fenfee de o wo pɛ‑o. Wɛ nam pwooli mo we, omo wó pa‑o tega kanto se o taa tei, ye o ná tega o daare, se o dwi tiina ta taa tei-ka. Wɛ tiŋi o ni dem konto ye Abaraham ta ba jege bu.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Wɛ na tage kolo ded‑o to mo tento: ‘Abaraham, nmo dwi tiina wó vo ba taa zoore sa-teo ne. Ba wó taa ye kabɛ mo teo kom konto ne, pa se nɔɔna bɛɛse-ba taa, bena bia yana (

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Amo Wɛ nam wó pa se teo kolo nɔɔna na fe-ba se ba toŋe kabɛ totoŋa to na waarem. Konto kwaga ne ba laam wó nwoŋi teo kom konto ne ba ba ba taa zuli amo jei sento ne.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma daare o gwoni ni de Abaraham. O ma pa se Abaraham dwi tiina taa gwoni ba peina se ko bere we ba sɛ o ni dem konto. Abaraham ma ba o lo Izaak. Da nana dɛ ne o ma gwoni o peini. Izaak de déem ma ba o lo Jakob. Jakob ma lo dé nabaara fuga-balei bam.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: Nabaara bam dedoa yere mo Josɛf. O chorro tem maa jege puseŋa ded‑o. Konto ŋwaane mo ba jaane‑o ba yeigi ba pa o vo Ejipti se o taa ye kabaa. Wɛ ta maa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: O ma pa se o nwoŋi cham maama wone de yazura. Josɛf na tu o zege Ejipti Pa-faro wom yiga ne to mo Wɛ pɛ‑o swa pa se o kikia su Pɛ wom yi lanyerane. Pɛ wom ma pa se o ji o sɔŋɔ kom tu de Ejipti teo kom maama yuu tu.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Kana déem ma ba ka wora Ejipti de Kanaan teene dem maama ne. Ko ma tiini ko chɛ ba yera ne. Dé nabaara bam déem maa ware se ba na wodiu ba di.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Jakob déem ma ni we wodiu wo Ejipti ne. O ma toŋe dé nabaara bam pa se ba vo ba nii.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, ba daa ma jwoori ba vo ba ke belei. Josɛf laam ma pa se o chorro tem lɔre‑o. Ejipti Pa-faro wom de laam ma ba o lɔre Josɛf sɔŋɔ tiina bam.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Jakob ma seene o zaŋe o vo Ejipti. Dáane mo wonto tega. Dé nabaara bam de ma ba ba te.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja ba yera yam ba jwoori ba vo Sɛkɛm ba suli-ba yibeeli delo ne Abaraham déem na yeigi de sabu Hamora bia bam tei ne to.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ma twɛ se Wɛ ke o su o na pwooli de Abaraham se o ke kolo to. Maŋa kam konto ne debam nɔɔna balo na wo Ejipti ne to maa tiini ba wora ba pula dedɛ.

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: Pa-faro wodwoŋi de daa ma zaŋe se o taa tei Ejipti. O maa yeiri Josɛf ni ne.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: O déem maa jege debam nabaara bam o bɛɛsa. Swa mo o kea ye o fe-ba se ba kwei ba bu-sese ba yage pwooni yiga ne se ko pa ba te.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Konto maŋa kam ne mo ba loge Moses. O déem maa ye bu-laao chekke Wɛ yiga ne. Ba maa jege‑o ba kɔna o kwo sɔŋɔ ne chane setɔ.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ja‑o ba nwoŋi ba tiŋi pwooni ne. Pa-faro wom bukɔ ma kwei‑o o jege o nia, ne o ye o tete bu mo tei.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Ba ma bere Moses Ejipti tiina yi-poro kom maama. O ma ji nɔn-babea o ni taane de o kikia maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: O na vei to, o ma na Ejipti tu wodwoŋi na jege Isarele tu o maga. Moses ma vo se o woli o tete dwi tu wom jara yam wone. O ma mage Ejipti tu wom o go.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: O déem ya boŋe we o tete dwi tiina bam wó lɔre we Wɛ lage o pa se wonto mo jwoŋi-ba Ejipti tiina bam jeŋa ne o yage. Ba ma ware se ba lɔre konto.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, o daa ma na Isarele tiina balei na jege daane. O ma kwaane se o lwɛ-ba ye o ta de-ba o we, ‘Amo nɔɔna bam, abam ye chorro mo daane. Bɛ mo ke ye abam jege daane konto?’

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Nmo nam boŋe se n go amo mo, ne n diim na go Ejipti tu wom tei to na?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Moses na nigi konto to, o laam ma duri o nwoŋi Ejipti ne o vo o zoore Midian teo ne. Dáane mo o di kaane ye ba lo bia balei.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Moses yera ma sɔɔre de o na nɛ kolo to. O ma fɔɔre o yi mini dem se o nii. O laam ma ni Baŋa Wɛ kwora ye ka we,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Amo mo ye nmo nabaara bam Wɛ wom. Amo mo ye Abaraham Wɛ, de Izaak, de Jakob Wɛ.’ Foone ma ja Moses ye o ware se o daa nii.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ma ta ded‑o o we, o le o natera yam se jei selo o na zege da to ye omo tete nyem mo.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ma ta o we, ‘Amo nɛ a nɔɔna bam na wo Ejipti ne ye ba yaare tei to. A ma kwori a ni ba na kona tei to. Amo laam tu ba tei mo se a jwoŋi-ba a yage. Nii ywo, a lage a toŋe‑m se n jwoori Ejipti.’ ”

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: Stiiven ta ma ta o we, “Moses déem ye wolo Isarele tiina bam na ve‑o to. Ba déem bwei‑o ba we, ‘Wɔ mo pɛ nmo chwoŋa se n ta‑n ye debam yuu tu se n daare n ŋɔɔne debam taane?’ Moses nam ta mo ye wolo Wɛ na toŋe‑o se o taa tei o nɔɔna bam, se o daare o jwoŋi-ba o yage to. Wɛ ma toŋe maleka ye ka nwoŋi o yiga ne sabare wone ka bere‑o konto.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Moses ta mo ye wolo na tage de Isarele dwi tiina bam o we, ‘Wɛ wó toŋe o ni-jwoŋinu abam tei ne, ne o na toŋe amo Moses tei to. Wonto wó nwoŋi abam tete dwi dem wone mo.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Moses mo ye wolo na tɔge o wo Isarele dwi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone kagoa kam yuu ne to. O maa tɔge o wora dedaane dé nabaara bam, de maleka kalo na ŋɔɔne ded‑o Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to. Wonto mo jwoŋi Wɛ botare selo na pae ŋwea to se o ke debam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: De konto maama, dé nabaara bam ma ve se ba sɛ Moses ni. Ba ma yigi‑o ba yage dáa ne, ye ba daare ba boŋe se ba jwoori ba vo Ejipti.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne ba ma seene ba mɔ kamɔgɔ pa ko nye de na-mɔra, ye ba pa ko ye ba jwoni. Ba maa jege-de ba kaana. Ba ma daare ba ke kuri ba pa ba tete de ba na mɛ ba jea ba mɔ kolo to.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Ba na kaane jwoni dem konto to, mo Wɛ mɛ o kwaga o ya-ba. O ma yage-ba se ba taa zuli chalechwe selo na wo wɛyuu ne to. Ko ke nenɛɛne ko na maŋe ko popone Wɛ sampwori sem tɔnɔ kom ne we: ‘Isarele dwi tiina bam, á déem na wo kagoa kam wone bena finna ye á kwei vara de pɛɛra dwi dwi á ma á ke kaanem to, ko dae amo mo á kaane á pa konto.

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Moleka jwoni dem wara-vwei mo abam zeŋe, dedaane chalechoa kalo na ye abam jwoni Refana to. Tento maama nam ye kamwaro telo á na ke se á ta‑á zuli-te mo. Konto ŋwaane amo wó ja abam a nwoŋi á teo kom wone a kale a vo jei selo na gaale Babilon to.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: Debam nabaara bam na beeri kagoa kam wone to, ba déem jege Wɛ wara-vwei dem ba via. Wɛ déem ya bere Moses o na wó ke tei o pu vwei dem to. Ba déem seene ba ke-de ne Wɛ na tage tei to.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga seeni to, dé nabaara bam mo jwoŋi vwei dem ba kwoa tei ne ba zeŋe-de ba ja ba tɔge Josua. Ba ma vo ba wane teene delo Wɛ na lage o pa-ba se ba taa zoore da to. Wɛ déem zeili tega kam konto nɔɔna bam o yage ba yiga ne. Vwei dem maa wora taa, se ko ba ko yi David na zaŋe o ji pɛ maŋa kalo to.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: O kikia ma su Wɛ yi ye o lwoori Wɛ se o pa‑o chwoŋa se o lɔ diga o ma leiri vwei dem yuu ne, se Wɛ taa zoore da Jakob dwi tiina bam tetare ne.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye David bu Solomon mo lɔge diga o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ wom nam ba zoore di selo nabiina na lɔge to wone. Wɛ sampwora dedoa déem tage o we:

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Baŋa Wɛ kwora mo tento: Wɛyuu kom mo ye amo paare yituŋu. Ko daare tega baŋa kam maa ye amo na chwi a nɛ mɛ to. Abam wó ke tɛ mo á lɔ diga á pa-ne? Jeiga kɔ mo amo wó vo a peini da a sii?

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Wɛ sampwori sem wolowolo tera abam nabaara bam na wo zeili kotu. Ba déem go balo na wuuri ba ta we Wɛ wó toŋe Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom se o ba to. Leile konto abam nam mo kwei wonto á ke nɔɔna jeŋa ne pa ba go‑o.

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: Abam ye balo na jwoŋi Wɛ nia yalo o na tɔge malese jeŋa o pa abam to mo. De konto de, á ta wo sɛ-ya.”

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom maa wo Stiiven tei ne lanyerane. O ma kwoni o yuu wɛɛne o yɔɔre o nii Wɛ telaao seeni o na Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ na daga tei to. O ma daare o nii o na Yezu na zege Baŋa Wɛ jazem seeni tei to.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: O laam ma ta o we, “Nii-na! Amo nɛ Wɛ telaao ni na pore, ye Nabiin-bu wom zege Wɛ jazem seeni.”

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Ba ma zeili-o pa o nwoŋi da teo kom wone. Ba laam ma daare ba jege‑o ba dola de kandwa se ba go. Balo na wora to ma le ba gwaaro ba pa nɔn-doŋo kodwoŋi se o taa nia. Nɔɔno wom yere mo Sɔɔl.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Ba na jege Stiiven ba dola konto to, o ma lwoori Wɛ o we, “Amo Teiru Yezu, jwoŋi amo jworo.”

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma kwaane se o chɔge Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama. O maa yeini o tole sam dem wone o jaane balo na tɔge Yezu to o vei o ke peena diga ne, baara de kaana maama. Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam jage

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Yezu nɔɔna balo na duri ba jage to maa yeini ba vei jei maama ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filipi ma zaŋe o vo Samaria teo kodwoŋi o ta Wɛ Dam Tu Krista taane o bere nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ma seene ba yia ba cheigi Filipi na ŋɔɔne kolo to. Ba maama déem cheigi o taane dem ye ba kwori ba na wo-kenkagela yalo o na ke to.

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: Ba ma na chichiri na yage nɔɔna dedɛ ye se chwoosi baŋa baŋa. Gwaaro dedɛ, de gwane de ma na yazura.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane wopwolo déem maa tiini ko wora Samaria tiina bam tei ne.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Teo kom konto ne nɔɔno déem ya wora, o yere mo Simon. O maa pae se Samaria tiina bam ye yaau o liri kikia baŋa ne. O déem bere o tete we o ye nɔn-kamunu mo.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Teo kom nɔɔna maama ma kwaane ba cheigi‑o lanyerane, dedɛɛra de nabwona maama. Ba maa pae se Wɛ dam mo wo o tei ne, ye ba jege‑o ba bwoi we ‘Dam-fɔrɔ tu’.

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: O déem ya pɛ se ba ye yaau de o liri sem taa, se ko dáane dedɛ. Konto ŋwaane mo ba déem seene ba yia ba cheigi‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Filipi laam ma ba o da Yezu Krista yere dem ŋwaane o tɔɔle Wɛ paare dem kwor-ywoŋa kam. Nɔɔna bam ma sɛ o taane dem. Ba ma jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu ŋwaane, baara de kaana de.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Simon tete de ma sɛ ye o daare o jwoŋi sɛɛm. O ma tɔge dedaane Filipi ye o na wo-kenkagela de maana yalo o na ke ye ya bere Wɛ dam to. O na nɛ-ya to, ko ma ke‑o yaau.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam na wo Jerusalem ne to ma ni we Samaria tiina bam tu ba sɛ Wɛ taane dem. Ba ma toŋe Piita de Jɔn se ba vo ba nii.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ba na vei ba yi da to, ba ma lwoori Wɛ ba pa balo na sɛ Yezu to, se ba wane ba jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ Sin-laao kom daa ta wo tu banto wolowolo tei. Ba na jwoŋi sɛɛm to déem ye dé Teiru Yezu yere ŋwaane yerane mo.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Piita de Jɔn laam ma daŋe ba jea ba baŋa ne pa ba jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom ba bochara ne.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam na daŋe ba jea nɔɔna bam baŋa ne pa ba jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom konto to, Simon ma na ko na ke tei to. O ma kwei sabu o ma lwoori Piita de Jɔn o we,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: “Amo lage se á pa amo de taa jege dam dento dwoŋi se, amo ná kwei a je a daŋe nɔɔno wolo baŋa ne, se konto tu jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Piita ma leiri‑o o we, “Wɛ wó chɔge nmo, de n sabu kom maama, nmo na boŋe we n wó wane n ma n sabu n yeigi Wɛ pɛɛre to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Nmo bochare ba tɔge chega Wɛ yiga ne. Konto to, n bá‑n na chwoŋa se n tɔge de debam n toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Kokuri amo nɛ we n jege puseŋa dedɛ, ye wɛleera jege‑m ya dam kuri ne.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Simon ma leiri o we, “Nam lwoori-na Wɛ á pa-ne se wonnu telo maama á na tage amo baŋa ne to yé ba te chɔge-ne.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Piita de Jɔn déem ma ta Yezu chega kam ba bere nɔɔna bam ye ba kwori ba ŋɔɔne Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam. Ba laam ma jwoori ba maa vei Jerusalem. Ba na maa jwoori to, ba ma tole Samaria te-nia yam wone ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Filipi pɛ dedɛɛro ni Wɛ taane kuri

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Filipi ma zaŋe o kɛ. Etiopia tu de déem maa wo chwoŋa kam ne o maa vei sɔŋɔ. Wonto mo ye dedɛɛro ye o toŋe o pae o teo kom ka-pɛ wom ba na bwoi we ‘Kandake’ to. O maa nii o jejegero tem maama baŋa ne. O déem ya vei Jerusalem mo se o ware Wɛ,

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: ye o laam maa jwoori o vei sɔŋɔ de toroko kolo siseiŋa na vaŋe to. O toroko kom na maa dura konto to, o maa jei o gare tɔnɔ kolo Wɛ sampwora Izaya na popone faŋa faŋa to.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma bere Filipi ko we, “Véi n ta‑n tɔge toroko kom.”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: O ma duri o vo o yi nɔɔno wom tei. O ma ni nɔɔno wom na jege Wɛ sampwora Izaya tɔnɔ kom o gara. O ma bwei‑o o we, “Nmo wó wane n ni n na jege kolo n gare to kuri na?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: O ma leiri o we, “Amo nam wó ke tɛ mo a lɔre ko kuri ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo maŋe-ko o bere ne?” O laam ma pa se Filipi di toroko kom baŋa o jeini o tei ne.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: O na wora o gare wonnu telo tɔnɔ kom wone to mo tento: “Wonto déem mo nye de pia ba na vaŋe ba ja ba vo se ba go to. O ta nye de pipeila kalo ba na fane ka koro ye ka wo ke sɔɔ to. Konto dwoŋi mo o wo puri o ni o ta kolokolo.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa jege‑o ba gwoona. Ba wo mɛ chega ba di o taane. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera o na wó ŋɔɔne o dwi dem taane, kolo ŋwaane o dwi ti logo baŋa ne.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro wom ma ta de Filipi o we, “A lage a bwei a nii, wɔ taane mo Wɛ sampwora kam tɛa, o tete mo o tɛ naa nɔɔno wodwoŋi mo?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Filipi ma jwoori o bobo nɔɔno wom na gage mɛ to o bere‑o ko kuri, ye o daare o ta Yezu kwor-ywoŋa kam maama o bere‑o.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: Filipi ma leiri‑o o we, “Nmo ná sɛ Wɛ chega kam de n wo maama, nmo wó wane n jwoŋi sɛɛm.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛro wom laam ma pa se toroko kom zege. Ba maama ma tu tega ba vo ba zo na bam wo. Filipi ma pa‑o sɛɛm Yezu ŋwaane.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Ba ma nwoŋi na bam wone. Ba na nwoŋi to, dé Teiru wom Sin-laao kom ma chaale Filipi ko ja viiri. Dedɛɛro wom ma daa wo nɛ‑o. O ma jwoori o kwei chwoŋa o maa kɛa, ye o tiini o jege wopwolo dedɛ.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Filipi ma na we o tu o wo Azota ne mo. O ma tole teene maama o tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam taa, o vo o yi Kazaria.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl déem nam mo tu o na baare dedɛ de o na bere nɔɔna tei to. O maa bere nɔɔna we, Yezu seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom mo. Ko ma pa se Juu tiina balo na zoore Damasika ne to daa ware se ba leiri o ni taane.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: Nam zaŋe n zo teo kom wo. Nmo ná yi da, ba laam wó ta kolo nmo na jege se n ke to.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Amo tete nam wó bere‑o yaara yalo maama o na jege se o na amo yere ŋwaane to.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl laam ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem. O maa kwaane se o tɔge o woli Yezu tɔgena bam wone. Ba maama maa fona ded‑o, ye ba wo sɛ we o seene o ji Yezu tɔgeno.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: O ya dwɛ mo o na nɔɔno, o yere mo Anania. O ma na‑o ye o ba o daŋe o jea o yuu ne, se o yia yam jwoori ya taa nae.”

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: O na nɛ tɔnɔ kom to, o ma zaŋe o maa vei Damasika. O na twɛ teo kom to, pwooni ma pɔpɔ de nwoŋi wɛyuu de pepele de gilimi‑o.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: O ma to tega ne ye o ni kwora na bwoŋi o yere ka we, “Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, bɛŋwaane mo nmo jege-ne n bɛɛsa konto?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: O de ma bwei o we, “Amo tu, nmo nam ye wɔ mo?” Kwora kam ma ta ka we, “Amo ye Yezu mo, nmo na jege n bɛɛse to.

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na tɔge de Sɔɔl to maa yɔɔre ba zega ye ba ware kolokolo se ba ta. Ba déem nigi kwora kam ye ba nam wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma zaŋe wɛɛne o puri o yia ye o ware se o na kolokolo. Ba ma ja o jeŋa ba vaŋe‑o ba ja zo Damasika teo wone.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: O déem jege da yatɔ mo o yia na dwei. Maŋa kam konto ne o ba di kolokolo ye o ta ba nyɔa.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgeno wodwoŋi déem maa wo Damasika ne, o yere mo Anania. O ma dwɛ o na dé Teiru wom na ŋɔɔne ded‑o. O ma bwoŋi o yere o we, “Anania!” O ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, nii-ne.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom ma ta ded‑o o we, “Zaŋe n vo Judas sɔŋɔ, ko na zege chwoŋa kalo ba na bwoi we ‘Chwo-yɔɔro’ to ni ne. Nmo ná yi da, se n bwei nɔɔno wolo yere na ye Sɔɔl to bwia. O ye Tasusi tu mo. Nmo wó na o na wora o ware Wɛ.

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Anania na nigi konto to, o ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, nɔɔna dedɛ maŋe ba ta nɔɔno wom konto taane ba bere amo de o na ke wo-balwaaro telo maama o ma chɔge nmo nɔɔna balo na wo Jerusalem ne to.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: O laam tu ywo Damasika ne mo de o na jwoŋi chwoŋa Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam tei ne se o ja balo maama na tɔge nmo yere ŋwaane ba zuli Wɛ to.”

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Anania laam ma zaŋe o vo o yi sɔŋɔ kom o zo. O ma na Sɔɔl o daare o vo o daŋe o jea o baŋa ne ye o we, “Amo nu-bu Sɔɔl, dé Teiru Yezu tete mo toŋe amo nmo tei ne. Wonto ya mo veere o tete nmo yiga ne, n ya na wo chwoŋa ne n ma‑n beene to. O toŋe-ne se a ba a pa n jwoori n ta‑n nae mo, se n daare n jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom de ko dam maama.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: O laam ma di wodiu pa se o jwoori o na dam. O ma maŋe Damasika ne da fenfee o woli Yezu tɔgena bam wone.

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl déem na wo Damasika ne konto to, o ma yeini o vo Juu tiina jeerim di sem o bere-ba Yezu taane. O maa tɛ o we, Yezu ye Wɛ Bu mo.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na nigi o berem dem to maa ye yaau ded‑o. Ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Ko dae nɔɔno wonto déem mo wo Jerusalem ne o kwaane o chɔge balo na tɔge yere dento ŋwaane ba zuli Wɛ to na? Ko nam dae konto ŋwaane mo o tu ywo-seeni se o taa jaane Yezu tɔgena o vei o ke Juu tiina kaanem yiga tiina bam jeŋa ne na?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ na kɛ to, Juu tiina bam ma ke ni daane se ba go Sɔɔl.

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: O ma lɔre ba na boŋe se ba ke‑o kolo to. Dɛ maama wea de tete ba zege ba nii teo kom nia yam se ba nii, Sɔɔl wó tɔge da se ba laam go‑o na.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe tete ne o nɔɔna bam ma pa se o zo tetɔ-kamunu wo, ye ba lei ŋona ko ni ne ba pa o tɔge takworo o nwoŋi o chu tega ne ye o lu.

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Banabas ma vo o tei se o woli‑o. O ma ja‑o o vo Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam tei. O ma ta o bere-ba Sɔɔl na wo chwoŋa ne o via ye o na dé Teiru wom na ŋɔɔne ded‑o tei to. O ta ma ta o bere-ba Sɔɔl na yɔɔre o ŋɔɔne de baare Yezu yere ŋwaane tei to, pa se balo na wo Damasika ne to lɔre Wɛ chega kam.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɔɔl ma maŋe Yezu tɔgena bam tei ne ye o tole Jerusalem ni maama o bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam dé Teiru wom yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: O maa yeini o ŋɔɔne de Juu tiina balo na ŋɔɔne Girisi tiina taane to ye o mage ni-kantɔgɔ de-ba. Ba laam ma kwaane se ba go‑o.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: O dwonna bam na lɔre konto to, ba ma ja‑o ba ja vo Kazaria. Ba laam ma pa se o kɛ o vo Tasusi.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna balo maama na wo Judea, de Galili, de Samaria jei sem ne to déem ma na siu ba yaara yam wone. Ba kɔgɔ kom ma fɔge de dam ye ko puli lanyerane, Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini-ba to ŋwaane. Ba maa kɔre dé Teiru wom ba ŋwea maama wone. Piita na toŋe Wɛ totoŋa tei to

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Piita déem yeini o beeri o tole jei maama mo. Dɛ dedwe o daa ma zaŋe o vo se o nii Wɛ nɔɔna balo na zoore Lida ne to.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: O na yi da to, o ma na nɔɔno, o yere mo Ayinea. O déem ye gɔrɔ mo, ye o tigi o sara ne taa, bena nana, o ware o zaŋe wɛɛne.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Lida ne de Sarɔn jei sem maama ne to ma na‑o. Ba laam ma ba ba sɛ dé Teiru Yezu.

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Kaane wodwoŋi déem mo wo Jopa ne, o yere mo Tabita. O maa ye Yezu tɔgeno. O maa chɛ de keim-laaro ye o woli yiniga tiina dedɛ.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne o ma ba o weele o te. Nɔɔna ma kwei o yera yam ba swɛ, ye ba ja‑o ba di wɛyuu diga ba tiŋi da.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Jopa maa bwola dedaane Lida. Konto to, Yezu tɔgena balo na wo Jopa ne to ma lɔre we Piita tu Lida o wora. Ba ma toŋe nɔɔna balei o tei ne. Ba ma vo ba lwoori‑o ba we, “Popo, ke lela n ba debam teo kom.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Piita ma zaŋe o tɔge de-ba o kɛ. O na yi Jopa to, ba ma ja‑o ba di wɛyuu diga kam. Kadeina bam maama maa zege ba gilimi‑o ye ba keera. Ba ma bere‑o gwaaro telo maama Dɔkase ya na ŋwe ye o sɔ to.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Piita laam ma pa se ba maama nwoŋi diga kam wone ba daare‑o. O ma daare o kuni dwoona tega ne o ware Wɛ. O laam ma pipiri o nii too wom ye o we, “Tabita, zaŋe wɛɛne.” O ma puri o yia o na Piita na wora. O ma zaŋe o jei.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Piita ma tei o jeŋa o woli‑o pa se o zaŋe wɛɛne o zega. O laam ma bwoŋi kadeina bam de Yezu tɔgena bam maama. O ma pa Tabita zege ba yiga ne ye o ŋwe.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Keim dem konto taane ma jage de yi Jopa jei sem maama. Ko ma pa se nɔɔna dedɛ ke ba wo-dedoa de dé Teiru Yezu.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Piita ma maŋe Jopa ne taa, da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. O déem zoore gɔgɔ kodwoŋi tei ne mo, o yere mo Simon.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wodwoŋi déem mo wora, o yere mo Kɔnilusi. O maa zoore Kazaria ne. O déem ye Rom soja tiina dedɛɛro mo. Soja tiina kɔgɔ kolo o na tɔge o wo ko wone to yere mo ‘Yitalia tiina kɔgɔ’.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: O déem kɔre Wɛ mo. O de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama maa zuli Wɛ lanyerane. O maa woli Juu tiina balo yiniga na jege-ba to. O maa yeini o ware Wɛ maŋa maama.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe wɛ na guni maŋa kalo to, o ma dwɛ o na wo-kenkagele. O ma yɔɔre o na Wɛ maleka na tu ka bwoŋi o yere ka we, “Kɔnilusi!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: O ma fi o yia o nii maleka kam seeni ye foone jege‑o. O ma ta o we, “Amo tu, n tu amo tei mo na?” Maleka kam ma leiri‑o ka we, “Nmo na yeini n ware Wɛ ye n kwori n woli yiniga tiina to mo pɛ se n kikia yam konto su Wɛ yi. O nam guli nmo gula mo.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Leile konto nmo jege se n toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo Jopa ba bwoŋi nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Simon Piita.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: O ye veiru mo gɔgɔ kodwoŋi sɔŋɔ ne. Gɔgɔ kom yere mo Simon. O sɔŋɔ kom maa wo naneo kom ni ne.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Maleka kam na tage konto ka ti to, ka ma viiri. Kɔnilusi ma bwoŋi o sɔŋɔ kom tontoŋena balei, de soja tu dedoa wolo na toŋe o pa‑o ye o de kɔre Wɛ to.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: O ma ta kolo maama na ke to o bere-ba ye o daare o toŋe-ba se ba vo Jopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, nɔɔna bam ma daare fenfee se ba yi Jopa. Piita déem diini sɔŋɔ kom nayuu se o ware Wɛ. Ko ye wea tetare ne mo.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Kana laam maa jege‑o ye o lage wodiu se o di. Ba na wora ba ke wodiu kom to, Wɛ ma pa se o na wo-kenkagele ne dendwɛ mo tei.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: O nɛ wɛyuu na pore o baŋa ne ye woŋo nwoŋi da ko maa tu tega. Woŋo kom nye de gɔr-kamunu mo ye ba zei ko nia yana pa se ko maa tu tega.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Vara dwi maama mo tigi ko wone, dedaane tega-veila, de zuna.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: O na nɛ to, o ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne ded‑o ka we, “Piita, zaŋe n go wonnu tem n di.”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Piita ma leiri o we, “Amo tu, a bá sɛ. Amo wo fɔge a di woŋo kolo na ba lana ye ko wo maŋe de dim to.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: O daa ma jwoori o ni kwora kam na we, “Yé zaŋe n chuli woŋo kolo Wɛ na pɛ se ko maŋe de dim to.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ko ke konto mo kuni betɔ. Wonnu tem laam ma jwoori te vaŋe te di wɛyuu.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Piita maa bwɛa wo-kenkagele dem o na nɛ to kuri. O na wora konto to, mo nɔɔna balo Kɔnilusi na toŋe o tei ne to maŋe ba lɔre Simon sɔŋɔ kom jei. Ba laam ma vo ba yi manchwoŋo kom ba zega.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Ba ma bwoŋi ba bwei ba we, “Nɔɔno zoore ywo, o yere mo Simon Piita na?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Piita daa ta maa kwaane se o lɔre wo-kenkagele dem o na nɛ to kuri. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ta ded‑o ko we, “Nii! Nɔɔna batɔ mo tu ywo ba lage nmo.

english_verse: Hurry down and go with them. Don't worry, I sent them.”
translation_verse: Zaŋe n tu tega. Yé ta‑n jege boboŋa yalei se n tɔge de-ba n kɛ, kolo ŋwaane amo mo toŋe-ba.”

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Piita ma tu tega ye o ta de-ba o we, “Amo mo ye wolo abam na lage to. Bɛŋwaane mo ye á ba?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri ba we, “Soja tiina dedɛɛro Kɔnilusi mo toŋe debam. O ye nɔn-ŋom mo ye o kɔre Wɛ lanyerane. Juu tiina bam maama maa pa‑o zula. Wɛ maleka mo tage ded‑o se o bwoŋi nmo o sɔŋɔ ne se o wane o ni kolo nmo na lage n ta to.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Piita ma pa se ba zo sɔŋɔ kom ba peini. Tega na poore to, o ma zaŋe o tɔge de-ba o kɛ. Yezu nɔɔna badaara de ma zaŋe Jopa ne ba tɔge ded‑o ba kɛ.

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Tega daa na poore to mo o yi Kazaria. O yi da dedaane Kɔnilusi, de o sɔŋɔ tiina, de o badwonna o na bwoŋi to maŋe ba jei ba cheigi‑o.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Piita na yi sɔŋɔ kom to, o maa boŋe se o zo. Kɔnilusi ma zaŋe o nwoŋi o jeeri‑o, ye o daare o to o yiga ne o jɔɔne‑o.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Piita ma pa se o zaŋe wɛɛne o zege, ye o ta ded‑o o we, “Amo tete ye nabiinu mo.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: O daa ta maa ŋɔɔne ded‑o ye ba maa zoore sɔŋɔ kom. O ma na nɔn-kɔgɔ na gilimi da ba jei.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: O ma ta de nɔɔna bam o we, “Abam maŋe á yei we ko chula se Juu tu taa zoore dedaane dwi-gɛ tiina, naa o taa tɔge de-ba. Wɛ nam mo bere amo we, ko wo maŋe se a taa chuli nɔɔn-nɔɔno, naa a pae o taa ye nɔn-diku.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam na toŋe á bwoŋi-ne to, a wo ve ye a ba. Amo nam lage a bwei a nii, bɛ mo ye á toŋe á bwoŋi-ne?”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kɔnilusi ma ta o we, “Zem mo jege da yana, ko maŋe de maŋa kanto ne, wɛ na guni to, ye a wora a ware Wɛ sɔŋɔ ne. Nɔɔno ma pɔpɔ o ba o zege amo yiga ne. O maa zo gare-nyenno.

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: O ma ta de amo o we, ‘Kɔnilusi, Wɛ mo jwoŋi nmo wara yam. Nmo na woli yiniga tiina to ŋwaane mo o guli nmo gula.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
