translation_verse: Nam toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo Jopa ba bwoŋi nɔɔno wodwoŋi, o yere mo Simon Piita. O ye veiru mo Simon wolo na ye gɔgɔ to sɔŋɔ ne. O maa zoore naneo kom ni ne.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, a ma toŋe nɔɔna lela se ba vo ba bwoŋi‑m se n ba. A ke nmo lei de nmo na tu to. Debam maama nam zege Wɛ yiga ne mo dé cheigi se dé ni kolo maama dé Teiru wom na pɛ‑m se n ta to.”

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Piita laam ma zaŋe o ta o we, “Amo zem lɔre we ko ye chega mo we Wɛ ba kuri nɔɔna daane.

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: Wɛ jwoŋi nɔɔno wolo maama na kɔre‑o ye o daare o ke kolo na tɔge chwoŋa to mo, ko ná ye Juu tu naa dwi tu wolo de.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Abam maŋe á yei Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam o na toŋe Isarele dwi tiina bam tei ne we Yezu Krista mo wae o jwoŋi nɔɔna o fɔge ba de Wɛ daane tei to. Wonto mo ye nabiina maama Teiru.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Abam ta yei wo-kamunnu telo maama na ke Judea ne to. Ko déem bobo Galili ne mo, maŋa kam Jɔn na bere nɔɔna se ba jwoŋi sɛɛm Wɛ ŋwaane ye ko kɛ to.

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Abam lɔre Nazarete tu Yezu yera seina na ye tei to. Wɛ déem lwogi o Sin-laao kom o yera ne ye o kwori o pa‑o dam. Wɛ na wo o tei ne konto to, o maa yeini o vei jei maama o zeini nɔɔna lanyerane, ye o kwori o jwoŋi balo na wo setaana pɛ jeŋa ne to o yaga.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Debam nam mo nɛ wonnu telo maama o na ke Jerusalem ne de Juu tiina teene dem maama ne to ye dé zege te chega kam kwaga ne. Ba laam jaane‑o mo ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go.

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma pa se o jwoori o bi toone wone da yatɔ dɛ ne. O ma pa se o veere o tete nɔɔna yiga ne pa ba na‑o.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we nɔɔna maama mo nɛ‑o, ko ye balo yerane Wɛ na maŋe o kuri se ba taa zege o kwaga ne to mo. Debam mo konto. Yezu na bi toone wone to, debam tɔge ded‑o dé di wodiu ye dé nyɔ na.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: O ma pa debam ni se dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam dé bere nɔɔna se dé daare dé pa ba lɔre we, omo ye wolo Wɛ na tiŋi se o bore nɔn-ŋwena de twa taane to.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem maama déem tage wonto taane ye ba ta ba we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa ded‑o, Wɛ wó yage konto tu wɛleera o ma chɛ‑o wonto yere ŋwaane.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Piita ta na wora o ŋɔɔne konto to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma tu ko ba balo maama na jei ba cheigi o taane dem to tei.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Juu tiina balo na maŋe ba sɛ Yezu ye ba tɔge de Piita ba ba to maa ye yaau de Wɛ na lwogi o Sin-laao kom o pa dwi-gɛ tiina o woli da to.

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane ba nigi ba na ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ mo ye ba kwori ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: Piita laam ma ta o we, “Nɔɔna banto seene ba jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom ne debam de na jwoŋi tei to mo. Konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ve se dé kwei na dé pa ba jwoŋi sɛɛm.”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: O ma daare o ta se ba pa-ba sɛɛm Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane. Ba laam ma lwoori‑o se o maŋe ba tei ne da fenfee.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Piita déem ma zaŋe o vo Jerusalem. O na yi da to, Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu to ma bwɛ‑o.

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Piita ma zaŋe o tole kolo maama na ke to o bere-ba ye o we:

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Amo ya wo Jopa ne ye a wora a ware Wɛ. Wɛ ma pa a na wo-kenkagele. Amo dwɛ a na wo-kamunu na nwoŋi wɛyuu ko maa tu tega. Ko nye de gɔr-kamunu mo ye ba zei ko nyea yana pa se ko maa tu tega. Ko ma ba ko zege amo yiga ne.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: A ma nii ko wone ye a na vara na wora, ga-vara, de sɔŋɔ vara, de tega-veila, de zuna.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: A laam ma ni kwora ye ka ŋɔɔne de amo ka we, ‘Piita, zaŋe n go n di.’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Amo ma leiri a we, ‘Amo tu, a bá sɛ. Amo wo fɔge a di woŋo kolo na ba lana ye ko wo maŋe de dim to.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Kwora kam daa ta ma jwoori ka zege wɛyuu ne ka ŋɔɔne ka we, ‘Yé zaŋe n chuli woŋo kolo Wɛ na pɛ se ko maŋe de dim to.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Ko ke konto mo taa, kuni betɔ, ye wonnu tem maama jwoori te vaŋe te di wɛyuu.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma nii a na nɔɔna batɔ ba tu ba zege sɔŋɔ kolo a na zoore to ni ne. Ba ya toŋe-ba Kazaria ne mo pa ba ba.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ta ko bere-ne we, a yé taa jege boboŋa yalei se a tɔge de-ba a kɛ. Dé nu-bia banto baredo de ma da amo ba vo. Dé maama ma vo dé yi Kazaria, ye dé vo dé zo Kɔnilusi sɔŋɔ kom.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: O ma ta o bere debam we o nɛ Wɛ maleka na tu o sɔŋɔ ka zega ye ka ta ded‑o we, ‘Toŋe nɔɔna se ba vo Jopa ba bwoŋi nɔɔno wodwoŋi o yere na ye Simon Piita to se o ba.

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: Wonto ná tua, o laam wó ŋɔɔne taane de nmo se ko pa nmo de n sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama na verem.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Tɔ. Amo laam ma bobo se a ŋɔɔne de-ba. A na wora a ŋɔɔne konto to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma tu ko ba ba tei, nenɛɛne ko na bobo ko ba debam tei tei to.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma guli dé Teiru wom déem na tage tei we, ‘Jɔn déem kwei na mo o ma pa nɔɔna sɛɛm. Ko nam ná ye abam, Wɛ wó tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo o pa abam sɛɛm.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Ko seene ko ye chega mo we, Wɛ pɛ dwi-gɛ tiina banto o pɛɛre dem ne o na maŋe o pa debam de maŋa kalo dé na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ dé Teiru Yezu Krista to. Ko maama ye bedwe mo. Konto to, amo ya wó kwaane se a cheiŋi Wɛ na?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Piita na tage konto ye ba ni to, ba ma yage taane dem ye ba daare ba tei Wɛ. Ba maa we, “Wɛ seene o pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam de chwoŋa se ba leiri ba wo ye ba daare ba na o ŋwe-doŋa kam.” Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Antioka ne to taane

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ba déem na go Stiiven to, Yezu tɔgena bam nɛ yaara nɔɔna tei ne pa se ba jage da yiga ne. Balo na jage to badwonna ma vo ba yi Fonikia, de Kupirus, de Antioka. Ba na beeri konto to, ba yeini ba tɛ Wɛ kwora kam ba bere Juu tiina yerane.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ko daare Yezu tɔgena badaara na nwoŋi Kupirus de Kurene to ma zaŋe ba vo Antioka ba ta dé Teiru Yezu kwor-ywoŋa kam ba bere dwi-gɛ tiina de.

english_verse: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ dam maa wo ba tei ne. Nɔɔna dedɛ ma ke ba wo-dedoa ba sɛ dé Teiru wom ye ba daare ba tɔge‑o.

english_verse: News of what was happening reached the church in Jerusalem. Then they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Jerusalem ne to ma ni kolo na ke to. Ba ma toŋe Banabas se o vo Antioka o nii.

english_verse: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.
translation_verse: O na vei o yi da to, o ma na Wɛ na seene o ke nɔɔna bam zaane tei to. O maa jege wopwolo lanyerane. O ma kwoori ba maama se ba taa tɔge dé Teiru wom de ba wo maama se ba yé zaŋe ba yage.

english_verse: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.
translation_verse: Banabas maa ye nɔn-ŋom. O maa tiini o jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo o tei ne de dam. Nɔɔna dedɛ déem ma ba ba sɛ dé Teiru wom ye ba woli o kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.
translation_verse: Banabas laam ma zaŋe o vo Tasusi se o beeri Sɔɔl jei.

english_verse: He found Saul and brought him to Antioch, where they met with the church for a whole year and taught many of its people. There in Antioch the Lord's followers were first called Christians.
translation_verse: O na vei o na‑o to, o ma ja‑o o jwoori Antioka. Ba na wora to, ba maa yeini ba woli daane ba bere Yezu kɔgɔ kom. Ba ke konto taa se ko yi bene, ye nɔɔna balo ba na bere to daga dedɛ. Ko ye Antioka ne mo ba bobo se ba bwoŋi Yezu tɔgena bam we Krista bia.

english_verse: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.
translation_verse: Da yam konto ne Wɛ ni-jwoŋina badwonna na tɔɔle o kwora to ma zege Jerusalem ne ba vo Antioka.

english_verse: One of them was Agabus. Then with the help of the Spirit, he told that there would be a terrible famine everywhere in the world. And it happened when Claudius was Emperor.
translation_verse: Ba dedoa yere mo Agabu. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma pa se o ta Wɛ kwora kam we, kana lage ka ba ka zo logo baŋa maama. Ko déem seene ko ke konto mo maŋa kalo Kaludu na di paare to.

english_verse: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne Pɛ Herodi ma zaŋe o ja Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna badwonna se o pa ba na yaara.

english_verse: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.
translation_verse: O ma ja Jemsi wolo na ye Jɔn zembaaro to o pa ba go‑o de se-zɔɔ.

english_verse: While Peter was being kept in jail, the church never stopped praying to God for him. Peter Is Rescued
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Piita maa wo peena diga kam ne taa, ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam maa tiini ba lwoori Wɛ ba pa‑o.

english_verse: The night before Peter was to be put on trial, he was asleep and bound by two chains. A soldier was guarding him on each side, and two other soldiers were guarding the entrance to the jail.
translation_verse: Ko déem ma yi tete delo tega na wó poore se Herodi pa Piita nwoŋi pwooni se o di o taane to. Piita maa tigi soja tiina balei tetare ne o dɔa. Ba ya vɔge‑o de chaponno telei mo, jazem de jagwia. Soja tiina badwonna de wo peena diga kam ni ne ba yera.

english_verse: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, “Quick! Get up!” The chains fell off his hands,
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maleka laam ma pɔpɔ ka ba ka zege da. Pwooni ma su diga kam. Maleka kam ma pepage Piita yera ka pa o zaŋe ye ka ta ka we, “Ke lela n zaŋe wɛɛne!” Chaponno tem ma kɔ Piita jea ne te to tega ne.

english_verse: and the angel said, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, “Now put on your coat and follow me.”
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma ta‑o ka we, “Faŋe n zo n gɔrɔ kom de n natera yam.” O ma seene o ke konto. Ka daa ma ta ka we, “Vɔ n gɔrɔ kom se n daare n ta‑n tɔge-ne.”

english_verse: They went past the two groups of soldiers, and when they came to the iron gate to the city, it opened by itself. They went out and were going along the street, when all at once the angel disappeared.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba tɔge jei selo soja tiina bam na wora ba yere to. Ba ma da yiga de kwaga jei sem ba kɛ. Ba ma daare ba vo ba yi luu-bworo kolo na pore ko vei teo kom wo to. Bworo kom tete ma pore ye ba kɛ ba nwoŋi. Ba ma kwei chwoŋa ba vei ba maa kɛa. Maleka kam laam ma pɔpɔ ka viiri ka daare Piita.

english_verse: Peter now realized what had happened, and he said, “I am certain that the Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod and from everything the Jewish leaders planned to do to me.”
translation_verse: Piita boboŋa laam ma jwoori. O ma ta o we, “Amo laam lɔre we konto ye chega mo. Wɛ seene o toŋe o maleka mo ye o daare o jwoŋi-ne Herodi jeŋa ne o yage, se Juu tiina bam daa yé wane ba ke amo ne ba na boŋe tei to.”

english_verse: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.
translation_verse: Piita na maane ko na ye tei to, o ma vo Mary ba sɔŋɔ. Wonto maa ye Jɔn Maake nu. Nɔɔna dedɛ déem mo tigisi daane sɔŋɔ kom ne ba wora ba ware Wɛ.

english_verse: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.
translation_verse: O na vei to, o ma lɔre Piita kwora kam. O maa tiini o jege wopwolo lanyerane pa se o duri o jwoori ye o wo pore bworo kom. O ma vo o ta de nɔɔna bam we Piita mo zege manchwoŋo ne.

english_verse: “You are crazy!” everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, “It must be his angel.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, o chwo mo. O ma chem ye o ta o we, ko seene ko ye chega mo. Ba daa ma leiri ba we, ko wó taa ye o tete maleka mo.

english_verse: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.
translation_verse: Ko na wora ko ke konto to, Piita maa mage bworo kom taa. Ba laam ma ba ba pore. Ba na nɛ‑o to, ko ma tiini ko ke-ba yaau.

english_verse: Peter motioned for them to keep quiet. Then he told how the Lord had led him out of jail. He also said, “Tell James and the others what has happened.” After that, he left and went somewhere else.
translation_verse: O ma zeiŋi o jea se ba cheigi sɔɔ. O ma daare o maŋe dé Teiru wom na ke tei o ja‑o o nwoŋi peena diga kam ne tei to. O daa ma ta-ba o we, ba véi ba ta kolo na ke to ba bere Jemsi de ba nu-bia bam maama. O laam ma yage-ba ye o vo jei sedwoŋi.

english_verse: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.
translation_verse: Tega na poore tetete to, soja tiina balo ya na jege Piita ba yere to ma kɔre foone dedɛ ye ba boboŋa vugimi. Ba ma bwei daane ba we, “Bɛ mo ke ye Piita tera?”

english_verse: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while. Herod Dies
translation_verse: Herodi ma yage ni se ba kwaane ba beeri o jei. Ba ma beeri taa ba ga. Herodi ma bwei soja tiina bam taane o nii, ye o daare o pa se ba go-ba. Konto na ke ko kɛ to, Herodi ma zaŋe Judea ne o vo Kazaria o zoore da. Ko na ke tei ye Herodi te to

english_verse: Herod and the people of Tyre and Sidon were very angry with each other. But their country got its food supply from the region that he ruled. So a group of them went to see Blastus, who was one of Herod's high officials. They convinced Blastus that they wanted to make peace between their cities and Herod,
translation_verse: Herodi bane déem tiini de zaŋe Tura de Sidon tiina baŋa ne. Jei sem nɔɔna bam ma zaŋe ba la kɔgɔ se ba vo ba kwoori Herodi se o yage. Herodi déem jege dedɛɛro wolo na nii o sɔŋɔ kom baŋa ne, o yere mo Bilasitu. Nɔɔna bam ma bobo ba di badwoŋo dedaane wonto, ye ba daare ba vo Herodi tei ba ŋɔɔne ded‑o se o yage o ban-zɔŋɔ kom. Ba déem lage ni-sɛɛm ba tete teo kom na yeini ko jwoŋi ko wodiiru pɛ wom teo kom ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.
translation_verse: Ba ma tiŋi dɛ se ba jeini daane ba ŋɔɔne taane dem. Dɛ dem na yi to, Herodi ma kwei o paare zela yam o zo. O laam ma jeini o paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne se o ŋɔɔne de nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: At once an angel from the Lord struck him down because he took the honor that belonged to God. Later, Herod was eaten by worms and died.
translation_verse: Herodi na sɛ ba zula yam ye o wo pɛ se ba zuli Wɛ chekke to, Baŋa Wɛ maleka ma pa se jaweo ja‑o lela. Kanzwa ma zo o wo ya di‑o ya go.

english_verse: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabas de Sɔɔl ma ti totoŋe delo ba na vei Jerusalem se ba ke to. Ba laam ma ja Jɔn Maake ba woli ba tete ne ye ba nwoŋi Jerusalem ba jwoori ba vo Antioka.

english_verse: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way. Barnabas and Saul in Cyprus
translation_verse: Yezu nɔɔna bam na nigi konto to, ba daa ta ma vɔ ba nia ye ba lwoori Wɛ ba pa-ba. Ba ma daare ba daŋe ba jea ba baŋa ne, ye ba laam bane-ba pa ba viiri.

english_verse: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem na pɛ Banabas de Sɔɔl zaŋe ba kɛ konto to, ba ma vo ba yi Selukia. Ba ma zo nabworo ba tɔge naneo kom wo ba vo ba bɛ ba yi Kupirus.

english_verse: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba zo Kupirus teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Salamis. Ba na wora to, ba maa zoore Juu tiina jeerim di sem ba bere Wɛ taane. Jɔn Maake maa wo ba tei ne o woli-ba.

english_verse: Barnabas and Saul went all the way to the city of Paphos on the other end of the island, where they met a Jewish man named Bar-Jesus. He practiced witchcraft and was a false prophet.
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋe Salamis ne ba tole jei sem maama ba kɛ. Ba ma vo ba yi Pafos. Ba ma jeeri liri tu wodwoŋi dáane, o yere mo Ba-yezu, ye o ye Juu tu. O déem pɛ se o ye Wɛ sampwora mo ye o dae.

english_verse: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.
translation_verse: O maa ye gɔmena tu Sɛgiu Pɔɔla kwaga nɔɔno mo. Gɔmena tu wom maa ye yi-pore-nyem. O ma bwoŋi Banabas de Sɔɔl se ba ba o tei. O maa lage se o ni Wɛ kwora kam.

english_verse: But Bar-Jesus, whose other name was Elymas, was against them. He even tried to keep the governor from having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Liri tu wom ma zaŋe o wora o tɔne ba berem dem. O maa kwaane se o che gɔmena tu wom se o yé sɛ Wɛ chega kam. Liri tu wom yere dedwoŋi mo ye Elumas de Girisi tiina taane dem.

english_verse: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas
translation_verse: Sɔɔl yere dedwoŋi daa ta maa ye Pɔɔl. Wɛ Sin-laao kom maa wo o tei ne ye ko dam su‑o lanyerane. O ma yɔɔre o nii liri tu wom ye o we,

english_verse: and said, “You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?
translation_verse: “Nmo ye setaana pɛ jeŋa nɔɔno mo. Nmo chuli wonnu telo maama na lana to. Nmo kwaane se n ma n swa n gane nɔɔna mo. Nmo yeini n kwaane se n pipiri dé Teiru wom chega kam se ko taa ye vwa.

english_verse: The Lord is going to punish you by making you completely blind for a while.” Suddenly the man's eyes were covered by a dark mist, and he went around trying to get someone to lead him by the hand.
translation_verse: Nii, Baŋa Wɛ wó ba o waare nmo de o je-dɛa leile konto. Nmo wó ba n ji lilwei ye n daa‑n bá‑n na wea pwooni se ko taa vei maŋa kalo Wɛ na lage to.” O na tage konto to, bedwe baŋa ne mo Yɛlumas yia yam dwei ya ji lim yerane. O maa kare o kekara ye o lage vaŋeno se o ja o jeŋa.

english_verse: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord. Paul and Barnabas in Antioch of Pisidia
translation_verse: Gɔmena tu wom ma na kolo na ke to. O laam ma ba o ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu. Dé Teiru wom chega kam ba na bere‑o to ma kagele‑o.

english_verse: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de o badwonna bam laam ma zaŋe Pafos ne ba zo nabworo ba vo ba yi Panfilia teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Pɛɛga. Jɔn Maake ma yage-ba dáane ye o daare o jwoori Jerusalem.

english_verse: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.
translation_verse: Ba daa maa zege Pɛɛga ne ba vo Antioka kolo na wo Pisidia ne to. Juu tiina siu dɛ dem na yi to, ba ma vo ba zo ba jeerim diga kam wo ba jei da.

english_verse: After the reading of the Law and the Prophets, the leaders sent someone over to tell Paul and Barnabas, “Friends, if you have anything to say that will help the people, please say it.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ma zaŋe ba ga Moses de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem twanno tem wone. Ba na gage ba ti to, ba yiga tiina bam ma toŋe ni ba pa Pɔɔl ba ye ba we, “Dé nu-bia bam, abam ná jege taane delo na wó fɔge nɔɔna bam to, se á zaŋe á ta.”

english_verse: Paul got up. He motioned with his hand and said: People of Israel, and everyone else who worships God, listen!
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma zaŋe wɛɛne o zeiŋi o jeŋa ba baŋa ne, ye o laam daare o ta o we: “Amo dwonna Isarele dwi tiina bam dedaane dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu á sɛ Wɛ to, cheigi-na amo.

english_verse: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out,
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam Wɛ wom déem le dé nabaara bam se ba taa ye o nyem. Maŋa kam ba déem na ye veira Ejipti ne to mo Wɛ pɛ se ba puli lanyerane. O ma daare o ma o tete je-dɛa kam o le-ba pa ba nwoŋi teo kom konto ne.

english_verse: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said,
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na á tete ni ne, se lɛɛro telo Wɛ sampwori sem na popone te taane to yé seene te ke abam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, “David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.”
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ma ba o le Sɔɔl paare dem wone, ye o daare o pa se David ji ba pɛ. Wɛ déem tage wonto taane o we, ‘Ko ná ye Jesse bu David, o ye nɔɔno wolo kikia na dɛ amo wo to. Wonto wó ke kolo maama a boboŋa na lage to.’

english_verse: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.
translation_verse: Ko maa ye wonto dwi dem wone mo Wɛ pɛ Yezu zaŋe o ba. Wɛ ma tɔge ni delo o na tiŋi o pa o nɔɔna bam to o pa Yezu ba o ji debam Isarele tiina bam Vereno.

english_verse: Then, when John's work was almost done, he said, “Who do you people think I am? Do you think I am the Promised One? He will come later, and I am not good enough to untie his sandals.”
translation_verse: Ko ta na daare fenfee se Jɔn ti o totoŋa yam to, o ma bwei nɔɔna bam o we, ‘Abam boŋe we amo ye wɔ mo? Amo dae wolo wom á na jege o teena to. Wonto nam lage o saŋe amo kwaga o ba, ye amo wo maŋe se a bwoli o nɛ natera de.’

english_verse: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.
translation_verse: Amo nu-bia bam, Abaraham dwi tiina, de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu á kɔre Wɛ to, ko ye debam mo Wɛ pɛ se dé ni o taane dem konto se dé wane dé lɔre o na lage o jwoŋi debam o yage tei to.

english_verse: They did exactly what the Scriptures said they would. Even though they couldn't find any reason to put Jesus to death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed. After Jesus had been put to death, he was taken down from the cross and placed in a tomb.
translation_verse: Ba ma ke kolo maama na maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ye ko ta o taane to ba ti. O na tege to, ba laam ma pare‑o dagara kam yuu ne ba daare ba ke‑o yibeeli wone.

english_verse: But God raised him from death!
translation_verse: Wɛ laam ma pa o bi toone wone.

english_verse: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.
translation_verse: O maa wora da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. O na wora to, kuni dedɛ mo o veere o tete o tɔgena bam yia ne. Balo ya na tɔge ded‑o Galili ne ba beeri ba vo Jerusalem to mo konto. Banto laam zege o chega kam kwaga ne ba pa debam Isarele tiina bam.

english_verse: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news
translation_verse: Debam laam tu abam tei se dé ta Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam. Ko maa ye we, Wɛ déem na pwooli de dé nabaara bam we o wó ke kolo to mo

english_verse: that he has kept this promise to us. It is just as the second Psalm says about Jesus, “You are my son because today I have become your Father.”
translation_verse: o laam seene o ke o pa debam balo na ye ba naaro to. Ko ye o bi Yezu toone wone mo konto. Ko ta ye nenɛɛne ko na maŋe ko popone Wɛ Seinim Lei tɔnɔ belei tu wone to ye ko we: ‘Nmo mo ye amo Bu, ye zem amo de ji nmo Kwo.’

english_verse: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, “I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom daa ta bere Wɛ na wó bi‑o toone wone pa se o yera daa bá pɔ to. Ko maa we: ‘Amo wó pa se n na wo-laaro telo na ye chekke ye a maŋe a tiŋi ni se a pa David na-te to.’

english_verse: And in another psalm it says, “God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom jei sedwoŋi ne ko popone we: ‘Nmo bá‑n sɛ se n tete Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom yera pɔ.’

english_verse: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye David tete, wonto déem toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam maŋa kalo o na ŋwe to ye o laam ba o te. Ba ma kwei‑o ba suli o nabaara bam tei ne. O yera ma seene ya pɔ.

english_verse: But God raised Jesus from death, and his body did not decay.
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo wom Wɛ na pɛ o bi toone wone to, wonto yera nam wo pɔge kɔtaa.

english_verse: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, abam jege se á lɔre we ko ye Yezu ŋwaane mo dé jege chwoŋa se dé bere abam we, Wɛ wó wane o yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam.

english_verse: “Look, you people who make fun of God! Be amazed and disappear. I will do something today that you won't believe, even if someone tells you about it!”
translation_verse: Ba déem we: ‘Nii-na, wɛ-lwɛɛna bam, abam yera wó sɔɔre ye á daare á te. Kolo ŋwaane amo lage a ke woŋo abam da yam wone, ye nɔɔno ná maŋe o bere abam ko kuri tei maama de, á bá sɛ we ko ye chega’ ”

english_verse: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam ma zaŋe ba jage se ba vo sam. Ba dedɛ ma tɔge Pɔɔl de Banabas, Juu tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Wɛ to de. Pɔɔl de Banabas maa tɛ de nɔɔna bam se ba taa kwaane ba dale Wɛ, de zaane delo o na ke ba yuu ne to.

english_verse: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam na nɛ kɔgɔ kom na su jei sem maama to, ba maa tiini ba jege puseŋa de-ba. Ba ma yaale Pɔɔl na tɛ kolo to ye ba kwori ba twe‑o.

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas bravely said: We had to tell God's message to you before we told it to anyone else. But you rejected the message! This proves that you don't deserve eternal life. Now we are going to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de Banabas laam fɔge ba ŋɔɔne de baare ye ba we, “Dé ya jege se dé bobo abam tei ne mo dé ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora kam. Abam nam na maŋe á wo sɛ-ka to, ko bere we á ba boŋe se á maŋe de Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam. Konto ŋwaane mo dé laam wó vo dwi-gɛ tiina bam tei dé daare abam.

english_verse: The Lord has given us this command, “I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Baŋa Wɛ na pɛ debam o ni tei to mo tento: ‘Amo tiŋi nmo se n ji pwooni n nye dwi-gɛ tiina bam baŋa ne, se n wane n pa nabiina na verem logo baŋa jei maama ne.’ ”

english_verse: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina balo na wora to na nigi konto to, ba maa jege wopwolo ye ba pa se Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam jege dam. Balo maama Wɛ na kuri se ba na o ŋwe-doŋa kam to mo seene ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu.

english_verse: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ kwora kam ma jage laŋa kam konto maama wone.

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders went to some of the important men in the town and to some respected women who were religious. They turned them against Paul and Barnabas and started making trouble for them. They even chased them out of this part of the country.
translation_verse: Ko daare Juu tiina bam ma kwaane ba pa se nɔɔna bane zaŋe de Pɔɔl de Banabas. Ko ná ye kaana balo jeŋa na gare ye ba kɔre Wɛ to, de teo kom dedɛɛra bam, ba déem pɛ se ba yaare Pɔɔl de Banabas, ye ba daare ba zeili-ba pa ba nwoŋi ba teo kom ne.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.
translation_verse: Ko na ke-ba konto to, Pɔɔl de Banabas ma kokɔge ba nɛ fwogo kom ba yage da se ba kaane nɔɔna bam. Ba laam ma daare ba vo Ikonium.

english_verse: But the Lord's followers in Antioch were very happy and were filled with the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena bam déem tiini ba di ywoni. Wɛ Sin-laao kom maa wo ba tei ne ko su-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ko daare Juu tiina badwonna ve Wɛ taane dem. Banto ma zaŋe ba vugimi dwi-gɛ tiina bam boboŋa pa se ba wo chɔge de Yezu nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de Banabas maa zoore da taa se ko dáane. Ba na wora konto to, ba maa ŋɔɔne dé Teiru wom taane de baare. Ba maa tɛ dé Teiru wom na ke nɔɔna zaane tei to, ye o zege ba taane dem kwaga ne de o na pɛ-ba dam se ba taa ke wo-kenkagela de maana tei to.

english_verse: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.
translation_verse: Teo kom nɔɔna bam maama déem pɔɔre belei mo. Ba badaara tɔge Juu tiina bam mo, ye badaara bam de maa tɔge Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam.

english_verse: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina de Juu tiina badwonna boboŋa laam ma ja se ba tɔge dedaane ba yiga tiina bam ba ke lwarem ba pa Yezu tontoŋena bam, se ba dole-ba de kandwa ba go.

english_verse: In Lystra there was a man who had been born with paralyzed feet and had never been able to walk.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno déem mo wo Lustera ne ye o nɛ sem gwarege. Ko zege o lora maŋa ne o maŋe o ye gɔrɔ mo, o ware o vo.

english_verse: The man was listening to Paul speak, when Paul saw that he had faith in Jesus and could be healed. So he looked straight at the man
translation_verse: O déem maa tɔge o jei o cheigi Pɔɔl na ŋɔɔne taane delo to. Pɔɔl ma yɔɔre o nii‑o ye o lɔre we o jege wo-dedoa de Yezu se o wane o na yazura.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they yelled out in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have turned into humans and have come down to us!”
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na nɛ kolo Pɔɔl na ke to, ba ma tiini ba ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa de ba tete teo kom taane dem ba we, “Ko ye debam wa yam mo jigi nabiina ya tu ya ba debam tei.”

english_verse: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.
translation_verse: Ba ma pa Banabas yere we Zeusa. Pɔɔl de yere maa ye Hɛmesi, kolo ŋwaane ko ye wonto ya mo ŋɔɔne taane dem.

english_verse: The temple of Zeus was near the entrance to the city. Its priest and the crowds wanted to offer a sacrifice to Barnabas and Paul. So the priest brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates.
translation_verse: Ba déem maa jege diga ba teo kom manchwoŋo ni ne ba na yeini ba kaane ba wɛ Zeusa da to. Ba kaanem yuu tu wom ma zaŋe o ja nabɛ de teeni punnu telo ba na sɔge to o ba o zege teo kom ni dem ne. Wonto dedaane nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama déem maa lage se ba go nabɛ sem ba ma kaane Yezu nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: But he showed he was there by the good things he did. God sends rain from heaven and makes your crops grow. He gives food to you and makes your hearts glad.
translation_verse: De konto de o ta yeini o ke abam lanyerane se ko pa á lɔre we o ye Wɛ chekke. O yeini o pa se doa nena ye wodiiru ke te maŋa ne. O maa pae abam wodiu ye á di, ye o pa se á na ywoni á bochara ne lanyerane.”

english_verse: Even after Paul and Barnabas had said all this, they could hardly keep the people from offering a sacrifice to them.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na tage konto to, ko ya gɛ fenfee mo se nɔɔna bam kwei wonnu tem ba ma kaane-ba, ye ba laam yage.

english_verse: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.
translation_verse: Juu tiina badwonna ya nwoŋi Pisidia teo Antioka mo ba ba. Badaara de ma nwoŋi Ikonium ba ba. Banto ma pa se kɔgɔ kom maama boboŋa leiri de Pɔɔl. Ba laam ma dole‑o de kandwa ye ba daare ba tuuri‑o ba ja nwoŋi teo kom wone. Ba ya boŋe we o tege mo.

english_verse: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe. Paul and Barnabas Return to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena bam laam ma vo ba gilimi‑o. O ma zaŋe ba tetare ne o jwoori o zo teo kom wo. Tega na poore to, o ma tɔge dedaane Banabas ye ba vo Dɛɛbe. Ba jwoori ba vo Antioka

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de Banabas na wo Dɛɛbe ne to, ba ma tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ba bere nɔɔna pa se ba dedɛ ji Yezu tɔgena. Ba daa ma jwoori ba vo Lustera de Ikonium, ye ba daare ba kɛ ba yi Antioka kolo na wo Pisidia wone to.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas chose some leaders for each of the churches. Then they went without eating and prayed that the Lord would take good care of these leaders who had trusted in the Lord.
translation_verse: Jei selo maama ba na vei to, ba déem le nakwa Yezu kɔgɔ kom wone se ba taa nii-ba. Ba ma yeini ba lwoori Wɛ ba pa nakwa bam ye ba vɔ ba nia Wɛ ŋwaane. Ba tɔge konto dwoŋi mo ba fɔge ba ke nakwa bam dé Teiru wom jeŋa ne, o na ye wolo ba na ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas went on through Pisidia to Pamphylia,
translation_verse: Ba déem ma da Pisidia ni maama ba kɛ. Ba ma vo ba yi Panfilia jei sem.

english_verse: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia
translation_verse: Ba na wora to, ba ma vo Pɛɛga ba bere Wɛ kwora kam da, ye ba daare ba vo Atalia.

english_verse: After arriving in Antioch, they called the church together. They told the people what God had helped them do and how he had made it possible for the Gentiles to believe.
translation_verse: Ba na yi Antioka to, ba ma pa se Yezu kɔgɔ kom la daane, ye ba laam tole ba bere-ba kolo maama Wɛ na tɔge ba ŋwaane o ke to, de o na pore chwoŋa o pa dwi-gɛ tiina se ba wane ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu to.

english_verse: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.
translation_verse: Ba maa zoore Yezu tɔgena bam tei ne taa.

english_verse: Some people came from Judea and started teaching the Lord's followers that they could not be saved, unless they were circumcised as Moses had taught.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna ma zaŋe Judea ne ba vo Antioka. Ba na yi da to, ba maa wora ba bere Yezu nɔɔna bam ba we, “Abam ná wo sɛ á tɔge Moses nia yam na bere tei se á gwoni á peina, á bá wane á na verem.”

english_verse: This caused trouble, and Paul and Barnabas argued with them about this teaching. So it was decided to send Paul and Barnabas and a few others to Jerusalem to discuss this problem with the apostles and the church leaders. The Church Leaders Meet in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de Banabas na nigi konto to, ba ma tiini ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ de nɔɔna bam. Konto ŋwaane Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam boboŋa ma ja se ba le Pɔɔl, de Banabas, de nɔɔna badwonna ba wone se ba ja taane dem ba vo Jerusalem ba ke Yezu tontoŋena bam de o totoŋa nakwa bam jea ne.

english_verse: The men who were sent by the church went through Phoenicia and Samaria, telling how the Gentiles had turned to God. This news made the Lord's followers very happy.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom ma bane-ba ye ba kɛ. Ba ma vo ba tɔge Fonikia de Samaria jei sem. Ba na maa vei to, ba maa tɛ dwi-gɛ tiina na pipiri ba sɛ Wɛ tei to ba bere nɔɔna. Yezu tɔgena bam na nigi konto to, ko ma pa se ba maama jege wopwolo lanyerane.

english_verse: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church, including the apostles and the leaders. They told them everything God had helped them do.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi Jerusalem. Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama, de ba nakwa bam, de Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam tete ma jeeri-ba lanyerane. Ba laam ma tole taane dem ba bere-ba Wɛ na dɛ ba ŋwaane o ke kolo to.

english_verse: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, “Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.”
translation_verse: Juu tiina badaara balo na wo Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone ye ba ba ba sɛ Yezu to maa wora. Ba na nigi taane dem to, ba ma zaŋe ba ta ba we, “Nɔɔna banto jege se ba gwoni ba peina mo, se ba kwori ba tɔge Moses nia yam maama.”

english_verse: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.
translation_verse: Yezu tontoŋena bam de o kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam ma la daane se ba bwɛ taane dem ba nii.

english_verse: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.
translation_verse: Ba na ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi taa to, Piita ma zaŋe ba wone o ta o we, “A nu-bia bam, abam yei we Wɛ déem kuri amo mo abam wone se a vo dwi-gɛ tiina bam tei se a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere-ba se ba daare ba sɛ-ka.

english_verse: He knows what is in everyone's heart. And he showed he had chosen the Gentiles, when he gave them the Holy Spirit, just as he had given his Spirit to us.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam yei nabiina bochara na ye tei to. O ma pa-ba o Sin-laao kom, ne o na maŋe o ke o pa debam tei to, se ko bere we o seene o jwoŋi-ba.

english_verse: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.
translation_verse: O maa wo pɔɔre banto de debam daane. O fɔge o kwɛ ba bochara ba na ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now why are you trying to make God angry by placing a heavy burden on these followers? This burden was too heavy for us or our ancestors.
translation_verse: Konto to, bɛ mo ke ye á boŋe se á maŋe Wɛ á nii de á na lage á pa Yezu tɔgena bam zeiŋi zela yalo na dumma ya dwoi-ba to? Ko ná ye dé nabaara bam naa debam tete, dé ware dé tɔge kikia yanto chwoŋa, ye á lage á pa banto tɔge-ka.

english_verse: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae konto. Wɛ na jwoŋi debam o yage tei to tɔge dé Teiru Yezu zaane dem ŋwaane de dé na ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o to mo. Ko ta ye bedwe mo de banto de.”

english_verse: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ba kɔgɔ kom maa jei ye ba cheigi sɔɔ se ba ni taane dem. Pɔɔl de Banabas ma zaŋe ba ta Wɛ na dɛ ba baŋa o ke wo-kenkagela de maana dwi-gɛ tiina bam tetare ne tei to.

english_verse: After they had finished speaking, James said: My friends, listen to me!
translation_verse: Ba na ŋɔɔne ba ti to, Jemsi ma zaŋe o ta o we, “A nu-bia bam, cheigi-na amo.

english_verse: Simon Peter has told how God first came to the Gentiles and made some of them his own people.
translation_verse: Simon Piita maŋe o ta o bere debam Wɛ na bobo o veere o tete dwi-gɛ tiina bam tei ne se o le nɔɔna ba wone se ba taa ye o nyem tei to.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.
translation_verse: ‘Ko kwaga ne amo Wɛ wó jwoori a ba ye a fɔge a lɔ David sɔŋɔ kom na chɔge to. Amo wó fɔge a kwɛ ko di-dwonnu tem pa se ko jwoori ko ji sɔ-doŋo.

english_verse: And so, my friends, I don't think we should place burdens on the Gentiles who are turning to God.
translation_verse: Jemsi ta ma ta o we, “Konto ŋwaane amo boŋe we, dé ba jege se dé daane dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Wɛ to.

english_verse: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.
translation_verse: Dé nam na wó ke kolo to mo ye dé wó popone tɔnɔ mo dé pa-ba, ye dé bere-ba we ba yé di wodiu kolo nɔɔna na mɛ ba kaane jwona pa se ko wo maŋe de dim to, se ba daare ba ja ba tete de kabwoŋa kikia maama. Dé wó ta-ba se ba yé di varem wolo ba na jujugi ba go to, de woŋo kolo maama na jege jana to.

english_verse: We must remember that the Law of Moses has been preached in city after city for many years, and every Sabbath it is read in our synagogues. A Letter to Gentiles Who Had Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Kokuri ko zege faŋa faŋa ba maŋe ba ga Moses tɔnɔ kom Juu tiina jeerim di sem ne ba siu dɛ maama wone, ye nɔɔna yeini ba bere wonnu telo na popone da to teo maama wone.”

english_verse: The apostles, the leaders, and all the church members decided to send some men to Antioch along with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Silas and Judas Barsabbas, who were two leaders of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Ba maama na ŋɔɔne daane konto to, Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam de o kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam boboŋa ma ja se ba le nɔɔna ba wone se ba tɔge de Pɔɔl de Banabas ba vo Antioka. Ba déem ma le nɔɔna balei balo na ye yiga tiina ba dwonna wone to. Ba dedoa yere mo Judas wolo yere dedwoŋi na ye Basaba to. Wodwoŋi wom yere mo Silas.

english_verse: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ba ma popone tɔnɔ se ba toŋe-ba de-ko. Ko maa we: Debam balo na ye á nu-bia to, Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam de o kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam, dé jɔɔne abam, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu á sɛ Yezu ye á zoore Antioka ne, de Siria de Kilikia ne to.

english_verse: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!
translation_verse: Debam maane we dé kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna badwonna mo zaŋe ba ba abam tei ba daane abam, pa se á boboŋa chɔge de kolo ba na bere abam to. Debam nam wo pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba ke konto.

english_verse: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane debam maama mo ke ni daane se dé le nɔɔna dé toŋe-ba abam tei ne, se ba tɔge de debam badwoŋ-swonnu Banabas de Pɔɔl ba ba.

english_verse: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Banto balei ya mo dɛ toone tei ba kɛ de ba na toŋe ba pa dé Teiru Yezu Krista tei to.

english_verse: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.
translation_verse: Debam nam mo le Judas de Silas dé toŋe-ba abam tei ne, se ba ba ba fɔge ba ŋɔɔne ba bere abam kolo dé na wora dé popone to.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit has shown us that we should not place any extra burden on you.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom dedaane debam mo jege boboŋe dedwe ye dé sɛ se dé yé daane abam dedɛ. Kolo yerane dé na wó ta de abam to mo tento:

english_verse: But you should not eat anything offered to idols. You should not eat any meat that still has the blood in it or any meat of any animal that has been strangled. You must also not commit any terrible sexual sins. If you follow these instructions, you will do well. We send our best wishes.
translation_verse: Á yé zaŋe á di wodiu kolo ba na mɛ ba kaane jwona to. Á yé di woŋo kolo na jege jana to. Á yé di varem wolo ba na jujugi ba go to. Á ja á tete de kabwoŋa kikia maama. Á ná jege á tete de wonnu tento maama, á wó ta‑á ke lanyerane. Wɛ wó pa abam yazura.

english_verse: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na gage-ko to, ba maa jege wopwolo lanyerane de ko na fɔge ba boboŋa tei to.

english_verse: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Judas de Silas maŋe ba ye balo na wae ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to. Ba déem tiini ba ŋɔɔne de nɔɔna bam pa se ba na pu-dɛa de baare.

english_verse: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.
translation_verse: Ba na dáane ba tei ne konto to, Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam ma bane-ba pa ba jwoori ba vo balo na toŋe-ba to tei de yazura. [

english_verse: But Paul and Barnabas stayed on in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached about the Lord. Paul and Barnabas Go Their Separate Ways
translation_verse: Ko daare Pɔɔl de Banabas ma maŋe Antioka ne ba dáane da fenfee. Ba déem maa tɔge de nɔɔna dedɛ ba tɔɔle dé Teiru wom kwora kam ye ba bere Wɛ chega kam. Pɔɔl de Banabas pɔɔre daane

english_verse: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.”
translation_verse: Ko na wora ko wora to, Pɔɔl ma ta de Banabas o we, “Pa se dé jwoori dé vo dé nii dé nu-bia bam teo maama wone dé na maŋe dé tɔɔle dé Teiru wom kwora kam mɛ to, se dé nii ko na ke-ba tei to.”

english_verse: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.
translation_verse: Banabas ma sɛ ye o lage se Jɔn Maake taa tɔge dedaane-ba o toŋa.

english_verse: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma boŋe we ko wo maŋe se ba ja‑o ba woli ba wone, kolo ŋwaane maŋa kalo ba déem na wo Panfilia ne to wonto yage-ba mo ye o daa ba tɔge-ba o toŋa.

english_verse: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus,
translation_verse: Ba ma tiini ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane pa se ba pwɛ da-tei ne. Banabas ma ja Maake ye ba vo ba zo nabworo se ba vo Kupirus.

english_verse: Paul and Silas went back to Derbe and Lystra, where there was a follower named Timothy. His mother was also a follower. She was Jewish, and his father was Greek.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl daa ta ma beeri o vo o yi Dɛɛbe de Lustera. Yezu tɔgeno wodwoŋi maa wora, o yere mo Timoti. O nu maa ye Juu tu ye o de sɛ Yezu. O kwo maa ye Girisi tu.

english_verse: The Lord's followers in Lystra and Iconium said good things about Timothy,
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna balo na zoore Lustera ne de Ikonium ne to maa pae o ye nɔn-ŋom lanyerane.

english_verse: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma zaŋe ba vo ba tole teene dem se ba nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna maama. Ba na beeri konto to, ba ma bere-ba nia yalo Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam de o kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam na tage Jerusalem ne to. Ba ma kwoori-ba se ba taa tɔge nia yam konto.

english_verse: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord. Paul's Vision in Troas
translation_verse: Konto mo wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam déem nɛ dam de ba Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem, ye dɛ maama ba kɔgɔ kom puli ko ke da.

english_verse: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de o dwonna bam daa ma vo ba tole Firijia de Galatia te-nia yam wone, kokuri Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem mo chege-ba se ba yé vei ba bere Wɛ kwora kam Asia teene dem wone.

english_verse: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba yi Musia siseini dem ni. Ba ma kwaane se ba zo Bitunia wo. Yezu Sin-laao kom maa wo pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba zo da.

english_verse: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.
translation_verse: Ba na kwaane ba ga konto to, ba ma yɔɔre ba tɔge Musia wo ba kɛ, ye ba vo ba yi Torase.

english_verse: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us!”
translation_verse: Ba na yi da ye tega yi to, Pɔɔl ma dwɛ o na nɔɔno na zege o yiga ne. O maa ye Makedonia tu mo. O ma lwoori Pɔɔl o we, “Popo, zaŋe n tɔge naneo kom wo n bɛ se n woli debam Makedonia ne.”

english_verse: After Paul had seen the vision, we began looking for a way to go to Macedonia. We were sure that God had called us to preach the good news there. Lydia Becomes a Follower of the Lord
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na dwɛ konto to, debam ma ke lela dé ke siri se dé vo Makedonia, kolo ŋwaane dé maane we ko ye Wɛ mo bwoŋi debam se dé vo dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere nɔɔna jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: We sailed straight from Troas to Samothrace, and the next day we arrived in Neapolis.
translation_verse: Dé laam ma kwei nabworo Torase ne dé yɔɔre dé vo dé yi Samotaraka. Tega na poore to, dé daa ma zaŋe dé tɔge naneo kom dé vo Niyapola.

english_verse: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.
translation_verse: Dé laam ma zege dáane dé vo tega ne dé vo dé yi Filipi. Teo kom konto ye Makedonia kateiri dem teo kamunu mo. Rom tiina bam maa tei-ko. Dé ma ke da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ teo kom konto ne.

english_verse: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.
translation_verse: Juu tiina siu dɛ dem na yi to, dé ma nwoŋi teo kom wo dé vo buga ni. Dé ya boŋe we jeiga wó taa wora dáane Juu tiina bam na yeini ba ware Wɛ da to. Dé na nɛ to, dé ma jeini tega ne ye dé ŋɔɔne de kaana balo na lage daane jei sem ne to.

english_verse: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.
translation_verse: Kaane wodwoŋi déem tɔge o wora, o yere mo Lidia. O nwoŋi Tuatera mo, ye o kɔre Wɛ lanyerane. O maa jege gwaaro telo na tiini te jege nenɔŋa to o yeiga. Dé Teiru wom ma pa se o bochare sɛ wonnu telo Pɔɔl na jege o tɛ to.

english_verse: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, “If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home.” Finally, we accepted her invitation. Paul and Silas Are Put in Jail
translation_verse: O déem ma ba o jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu ŋwaane, de o sɔŋɔ tiina de. O laam ma zaŋe o lwoori debam o we, “Abam na sɛ we amo seene a ke a wo-dedoa dedaane dé Teiru Yezu to, se á ba á ta‑á zoore debam sɔŋɔ ne.” O maa wo sɛ se dé viiri. Ba ke Pɔɔl de Silas peena diga ne

english_verse: One day on our way to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl. She had a spirit in her that gave her the power to tell the future. By doing this she made a lot of money for her owners.
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe mo dé zaŋe dé maa vei Wɛ wara-jei sem. Dé na maa vei to, dé ma jeeri busankana kalo na ye nɔɔna kabaa to. Chichira déem maa tɔge‑o pa se o wae o pworisa. O na wuuri o bere wonnu telo na lage te ke konto to, o yuu tiina bam déem nɛ sabu dedɛ ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: The girl followed Paul and the rest of us, and she kept yelling, “These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how to be saved.”
translation_verse: O maa tɔge Pɔɔl de debam kwaga ye o baga o we, “Nɔɔna banto ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋena mo. Ba tu se ba bere abam chwoŋa mo se á tɔge da á na verem.”

english_verse: This went on for several days. Finally, Paul got so upset that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ, I order you to leave this girl alone!” At once the evil spirit left her.
translation_verse: O déem yeini o ke konto mo taa, da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. Pɔɔl bane laam ma zaŋe. O ma pipiri o ta de chichira kam o we, “A ta de nmo Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane, nwoŋi o tei ne n kɛ!” O na tage konto to, chichira kam ma yage‑o bedwe baŋa ne.

english_verse: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.
translation_verse: Busankana kam yuu tiina bam ma maane ba lɔre we ba daa ware ba na sabu o ŋwaane. Ba ma zi Pɔɔl de Silas ba vaŋe ba ja ba vo yaga ni ne se ba saŋe-ba dedɛɛra bam tei ne.

english_verse: They are telling us to do things we Romans are not allowed to do.”
translation_verse: Ba bere wonnu telo na chɔge debam chullu tem to mo. Debam nam ye Rom tiina mo ye dé bá wane dé sɛ banto na bere kolo to.”

english_verse: The crowd joined in the attack on Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off the two men and ordered them to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Kɔgɔ kom maama ma tɔge ba chiŋi Pɔɔl de Silas. Rom tiina dedɛɛra bam ma ja-ba ba vaŋe ba gwaaro tem ba kaare ye ba daare ba pa se nɔɔna fere-ba.

english_verse: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.
translation_verse: Ba na tiini ba mage-ba konto to, ba laam ma ke-ba peena diga ne. Dedɛɛra bam ma ta de wolo na nii peena diga kam baŋa ne to se o fɔge o pe nɔɔna bam lanyerane.

english_verse: The jailer did as he was told. He put them deep inside the jail and chained their feet to heavy blocks of wood.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom na nigi konto to, o ma pa se ba zo tetare diga kam wo ye o daare o ja ba nɛ o tore da-kwolo bɔɔna ne.

english_verse: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing praises to God, while the other prisoners listened.
translation_verse: Tega na kweere maŋa kalo to, Pɔɔl de Silas maa wora ba ware Wɛ ye ba leeni Yezu kɔgɔ kom lei ba zuli Wɛ. Peena badwonna bam maa jei ba cheiga.

english_verse: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the jail to its foundations. The doors opened, and the chains fell from all the prisoners.
translation_verse: Tega kam laam ma pɔpɔ ka ziziŋi, ye peena diga kam sua se ko yi ka kuri maama. Diga kam bworru tem maama ma pɔpɔ te pore, ye chaponno tem kɔ peena bam maama yera ne.

english_verse: When the jailer woke up and saw that the doors were open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped. He pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na yere diga kam to ma zaŋe ye o na peena diga kam na pore to. O ma boŋe we peena bam maama nwoŋi ba duri mo. Konto ŋwaane o ma le se-zɔɔ se o ma go o tete.

english_verse: The jailer asked for a torch and went into the jail. He was shaking all over as he knelt down in front of Paul and Silas.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wom ma bwoŋi se ba ja mini ba pa‑o. O ma ke lela o zo diga kam o to Pɔɔl de Silas yiga ne, ye o yera sae de foone.

english_verse: After he had led them out of the jail, he asked, “What must I do to be saved?”
translation_verse: O ma pa se ba nwoŋi pwooni, ye o daare o bwei-ba o we, “A nɔɔna bam, amo nam wó ke tɛ mo se Wɛ jwoŋi-ne o yage?”

english_verse: They replied, “Have faith in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved! This is also true for everyone who lives in your home.”
translation_verse: Ba ma leiri‑o ba we, “Nmo jege se n ke n wo-dedoa dedaane dé Teiru Yezu mo, se Wɛ wó jwoŋi nmo de n sɔŋɔ tiina bam de.”

english_verse: Then Paul and Silas told him and everyone else in his house about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ba ma daare ba ta Wɛ kwora kam ba bere o de balo maama na wo o sɔŋɔ kom ne to.

english_verse: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.
translation_verse: Tete dem maŋa kam konto ne nɔɔ mo o jaane-ba o vo o zare ba fufwollu tem maama. O na ke konto o ti to, o de o sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama laam ma jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu ŋwaane.

english_verse: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.
translation_verse: O ma daare o pa se Pɔɔl de Silas zo o sɔŋɔ kom. O ma ke wodiu pa ba di. O na tu o sɛ Wɛ de wo-dedoa to, o maa jege wopwolo lanyerane, de o sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama de.

english_verse: The next morning the officials sent some police with orders for the jailer to let Paul and Silas go.
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, Rom tiina dedɛɛra bam ma toŋe polisi tiina se ba vo peena diga kam ye ba we, “Yage-na nɔɔna bam se ba viiri.”

english_verse: The jailer told Paul, “The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.”
translation_verse: Peena diga kam tu wom ma ta dedɛɛra bam na tage kolo to o bere Pɔɔl. O maa we, “Ba pɛ abam chwoŋa se á viiri. Véi-na de yazura.”

english_verse: But Paul told the police, “We are Roman citizens, and the Roman officials had us beaten in public without giving us a trial. They threw us into jail. Now do they think they can secretly send us away? No, they cannot! They will have to come here themselves and let us out.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl laam ma ta de polisi tiina bam o we, “Debam nam ye Rom teo jeŋa nɔɔna mo. Ba wo nɛ debam keim-balɔrɔ ye ba daa ta ja debam ba fere nɔɔna maama yiga ne, ba daare ba ke debam peena diga ne. Ba ya ba jege chwoŋa se ba ke konto. Bɛ mo ye ba laam lage se dé viiri chemm? Dé bá sɛ kɔtaa. Ba tete mo jege se ba ba ba le debam ba yage.”

english_verse: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.
translation_verse: Ba ma vo ba kwoori Pɔɔl de Silas se ba yage taane dem. Ba ma daare ba le-ba ba yage, ye ba ta-ba se ba nwoŋi teo kom wone ba viiri.

english_verse: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl de Silas ma nwoŋi peena diga kam ne ba vo ba zo Lidia ba sɔŋɔ. Dáane mo ba jeeri dedaane Yezu nɔɔna bam ye ba ŋɔɔne de-ba, pa se ba su de dam. Ba laam ma zaŋe ba viiri.

english_verse: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.
translation_verse: Ba déem ma tole Anfipola de Apolonia ba kɛ ba vo ba yi Tɛsaloni. Teo kom konto ne mo Juu tiina jeerim diga wora.

english_verse: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma vo da, ne o na maŋe o yeini o ke tei to. O déem wora mo ba siu da yatɔ wone o gare Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ye o bere-ba ko kuri se ba ni.

english_verse: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.
translation_verse: O ma maŋe o bere-ba chekke ye o we, ko déem ya maŋe se Wɛ Dam Tu wom na yaara o te ye o daare o bi toone wone. O maa we, “Yezu wom, amo na jege o taane a tɛa a bere abam to mo seene o ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom.”

english_verse: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam na nigi konto to, ba badwonna ma sɛ o na tage kolo to, ye ba laam tɔge ba woli Pɔɔl de Silas ne. Girisi tiina balo na tu ba kɔre Wɛ to kɔgɔ dedɛ de ma sɛ Pɔɔl taane dem, dedaane kaana balo jeŋa na gare to dedɛ.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.
translation_verse: Juu tiina badaara maa jege puseŋa de-ba. Ba ma vo yaga ba la nɔn-wo-korro ba ke daane. Ba kɔgɔ kom ma pa se bobɔga ja teo kom maama. Ba ma vo ba chiŋi jara Jason sɔŋɔ ne, ye ba kwaane ba lage Pɔɔl de Silas jei se ba zi-ba ba ja nwoŋi ba ke nɔɔna bam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: But when they did not find them there, they dragged out Jason and some of the Lord's followers. They took them to the city authorities and shouted, “Paul and Silas have been upsetting things everywhere. Now they have come here,
translation_verse: Ba maa wo nɛ-ba. Ba ma zi Jason de Yezu tɔgena badwonna ba ja vo teo kom dedɛɛra bam tei, ye ba bage ba we, “Nɔɔna banto yeini ba beeri logo baŋa jei maama mo ba daane nɔɔna. Ba laam tu ywo mo.

english_verse: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.”
translation_verse: Jason mo pɛ se ba zoore o sɔŋɔ ne. Ba maama yeini ba chɔge dé Pa-faro wom nia yam mo, ye ba tɛ ba we pɛ wodwoŋi mo wora, o yere mo Yezu.”

english_verse: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.
translation_verse: Teo kom dedɛɛra bam de kɔgɔ kom maama na nigi konto to, ba bane ma zaŋe dedɛ.

english_verse: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go. People in Berea Welcome the Message
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam ma pa se Jason de o dwonna bam tiŋi sabu kolo na wó pa-ba chwoŋa se ba jwoŋi ba tete to. Ba laam ma yage-ba pa ba viiri. Ko na ke tei Berea ne to

english_verse: That same night the Lord's followers sent Paul and Silas on to Berea, and after they arrived, they went to the synagogue.
translation_verse: Tega na tu ka yi to, Yezu nɔɔna bam ma pa se Pɔɔl de Silas nwoŋi teo kom ne ba vo Berea. Ba na vei ba yi da to, ba ma vo ba zo Juu tiina jeerim diga kam.

english_verse: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.
translation_verse: Teo kom konto Juu tiina bam maa jege boboŋ-ŋona ba dwoi Tɛsaloni nɔɔna bam. Ba ma cheigi Wɛ kwora kam lanyerane de ba wo maama. Dɛ maama wone mo ba yeini ba zamese Wɛ tɔnɔ kom se ba nii Pɔɔl na bere kolo to seene ko ye chega na.

english_verse: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.
translation_verse: Ba dedɛ ma sɛ Pɔɔl taane dem, de Girisi tiina dedɛ de sɛ, baara de kaana balo jeŋa na gare to dedɛ.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.
translation_verse: Tɛsaloni Juu tiina bam ma ni we Pɔɔl wo Berea ne o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo Berea ye ba la kɔgɔ ba pa se teo kom nɔɔna bam bane zaŋe de Pɔɔl.

english_verse: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.
translation_verse: Yezu nɔɔna bam na nɛ konto to, ba ma pa se Pɔɔl zaŋe lela o nwoŋi o vo naneo kom ni. Ko ma daare Silas de Timoti mo maŋe Berea ne.

english_verse: Some men went with Paul as far as Athens, and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible. Paul in Athens
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna ma tɔge dedaane Pɔɔl ba vo ba yi Atena. Pɔɔl ma toŋe-ba se ba jwoori ba vo ba pa Silas de Timoti ni we, ba zaŋe ba tɔge o kwaga ba ba lela. Ko na ke tei Atena ne to

english_verse: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl déem na wo Atena ne o cheigi Silas de Timoti se ba ba to, o wo ma tiini ko di de o na nɛ we jwona dedɛ su teo kom to.

english_verse: He went to the synagogue to speak to the Jews and to anyone who worshiped with them. Day after day he also spoke to everyone he met in the market.
translation_verse: O maa yeini o zo Juu tiina jeerim diga kam o ŋɔɔne dedaane ba de dwi-gɛ tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Wɛ to. Dɛ maama o ta maa yeini o vei yaga ni o ŋɔɔne de balo na maŋe ba wora to.

english_verse: Some of them were Epicureans and some were Stoics, and they started arguing with him. People were asking, “What is this know-it-all trying to say?” Some even said, “Paul must be preaching about foreign gods! That's what he means when he talks about Jesus and about people rising from death.”
translation_verse: Yi-pore-nyena badwonna de ma ba ba dwoni ded‑o. Ba badaara déem tɔge Epikuri berem dem, badaara de maa tɔge Sitoka berem dem. Ba badaara tage ba we, “Yiyira kanto boŋe se o bere bɛ mo?” Badwonna de ma ta ba we, “Ko nye de o ŋɔɔne sa-teena jwona taane mo.” Ba tage tento kolo ŋwaane o tɔɔle kwor-ywoŋa kalo na tɛ Yezu de twa biim taane to mo.

english_verse: They brought Paul before a council called the Areopagus, and said, “Tell us what your new teaching is all about.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ja‑o ba vo Arɛpaga, mɛ ba yiga tiina bam na tigisi daane to. Ba ma bwei‑o ba we, “Debam ya lage se dé lɔre berem-doore dem nmo na jege n ŋɔɔne to mo.

english_verse: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.”
translation_verse: Wonnu tedwonna nmo na bere to, dé ta wo fɔge dé ni te dwi. Dé nam wó taa lage se dé lɔre te kuri na ye tei to.”

english_verse: More than anything else the people of Athens and the foreigners living there loved to hear and to talk about anything new.
translation_verse: Atena tiina bam maama dedaane veira balo na zoore ba tei ne to déem tiini ba lage se ba taa lare daane mo maŋa maama, se ba lɔre wonnu telo ba na ni leile to kuri.

english_verse: So Paul stood up in front of the council and said: People of Athens, I see that you are very religious.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma zaŋe o zege Arɛpaga yiga tiina bam tetare ne ye o we: “Atena tiina bam, amo na nii to, abam ŋwea maama wone á tiini á zuli jwona mo dedɛ.

english_verse: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, “To an Unknown God.” You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.
translation_verse: Amo beeri abam teo kom wone a nii a na jei sem maama á na zuli á jwona da to. Amo na beeri to mo a nɛ kaanem bimbini dedoa ye ko popone de yera ne we, ‘WƐ DELO DÉ NA YEIRI TO’ mo ko zege ko pae. Tɔ. Wɛ delo abam na jege á zuli ye á ta yeiri-de to mo a lage a ta dento taane a bere abam.

english_verse: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.
translation_verse: Wonto mo ye Baŋa Wɛ wolo na ke logo baŋa de wonnu telo maama na wo ko wone to. O maa tei wɛyuu de tega baŋa maama, ye o ba zoore di selo nabiina na lɔge ba pa‑o to wone.

english_verse: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wo gɛ kolokolo se nabiina taa toŋa ba pa‑o, ko na ye wonto tete mo kwei ŋwea, de siu, de woŋo maama o pa nabiina to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God has done all this, so that we will look for him and reach out and find him. He isn't far from any of us,
translation_verse: Wɛ na ke nabiina konto to ye se ba kwaane se ba lɔre-o mo. Ba jege se ba taane mo ba nii o jei, se ba laam wane ba lɔre‑o. Wɛ nam maŋe o dae yiga yiga dedaane debam maama.

english_verse: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. “We are his children,” just as some of your poets have said.
translation_verse: Konto nam tɔge nɔɔno wodwoŋi na tage o we, ‘Wonto ŋwaane mo dé ŋwe dé wora ye dé via.’ Abam tete lein-leenu dedoa de tage konto dwoŋi o we, ‘Debam de maŋe dé ye o bia mo.’

english_verse: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.
translation_verse: Debam na seene dé ye Wɛ bia to, dé ba jege se dé boŋe we dé Keiru Wɛ wó taa nye de kamɔgɔ nabiinu na mɛ o tete boboŋa o mɔ de o jea to, ko ná ye sabu-seŋa naa lu-nyenno naa kandwa mo o mɛ o ke.

english_verse: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa ye nabiina ta yeiri kolo na lana se ba ke to, Wɛ wo ke-ko o boboŋa ne. Ko daare leile konto o laam pɛ ni we, nɔɔna maama logo baŋa ne jege se ba leiri ba wo de ba wo-balwaaro keim.

english_verse: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane o tiŋi dɛ mo o na wó di nabiina maama taane. O wó tɔge chega mo o di ba bora. O nam maŋe o kuri wolo o na wó tɔge o ŋwaane o ke konto to. O pɛ se nabiinu wom konto bi toone wone mo se ko pa nɔɔna maama lɔre we ko seene ko ye chega.”

english_verse: As soon as the people heard Paul say a man had been raised from death, some of them started laughing. Others said, “We will hear you talk about this some other time.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na ŋɔɔne twa biim taane konto to, nɔɔna bam badwonna maa ke‑o ba mɔna. Ko daare badaara maa tɛ ba we, “Dé lage se n jwoori n ŋɔɔne taane dem konto mo se dé daa cheigi.”

english_verse: When Paul left the council meeting,
translation_verse: Pɔɔl laam ma zaŋe o nwoŋi o daare-ba.

english_verse: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna déem ma sɛ ba tɔge Pɔɔl, ye ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu. Ba dedoa yere mo Dionusi. O tɔge o wo Arɛpaga kɔgɔ kom nɔɔno dedoa mo. Kaane wodwoŋi de wora, o yere mo Damaris. Nɔɔna badwonna de ta wora ye ba sɛ Yezu.

english_verse: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth,
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, Pɔɔl déem ma zege Atena ne o vo Korinti.

english_verse: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla
translation_verse: O na yi da to, o ma maŋe dedaane Juu tu wodwoŋi, o yere mo Akwila. Ba déem loge‑o Pɔntus ne mo. Maŋa kalo Pɔɔl na nɛ‑o to, o ya yɔɔre o nwoŋi Yitalia mo o ba, de o kaane Pirisila, kolo ŋwaane Rom Pa-faro Kaludu déem ya zeili Juu tiina bam maama pa ba nwoŋi Rom ne ba viiri. Pɔɔl ma zaŋe o vo ba tei,

english_verse: and found out they were tent makers. Paul was also a tent maker, so he stayed with them, and they worked together.
translation_verse: ye o zoore de-ba pa se ba toŋe daane, ba déem na toŋe totoŋe bedwe to ŋwaane. Ba déem nyaane gwaaro mo ba pu vwoa se ba ma lage ba ni-wodiu.

english_verse: Finally, they turned against him and insulted him. So he shook the dust from his clothes and told them, “Whatever happens to you will be your own fault! I am not to blame. From now on I am going to preach to the Gentiles.”
translation_verse: Ba maa wo sɛ o taane dem ye ba twe‑o. O laam ma ja o gwaaro tem o peese te fwogo kom ba yiga ne, ye o ta-ba o we, “Abam ná nɛ lɛɛro Wɛ tei ne, ko wó taa ye abam tete yiga mo. Ko daa tɔge ko dae amo yiga. Ko zege leile konto amo laam wó vo dwi-gɛ tiina bam tei a daare abam.”

english_verse: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.
translation_verse: O ma seene o nwoŋi Juu tiina bam tei ne, ye o daare o vo o zoore dwi-gɛ tu wodwoŋi sɔŋɔ ne, o yere mo Titia Jusitu. Wonto maa kɔre Wɛ. O sɔŋɔ kom maa zege ko saŋe Juu tiina jeerim diga kam.

english_verse: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.
translation_verse: Jeerim diga kam yuu tu wom yere mo Kirisipu. Wonto de o sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama déem tu ba sɛ dé Teiru Yezu. Korinti tiina dedɛ de déem ma ni Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ye ba daare ba sɛ. Ba laam ma jwoŋi sɛɛm Yezu ŋwaane.

english_verse: One night, Paul had a vision, and in it the Lord said, “Don't be afraid to keep on preaching. Don't stop!
translation_verse: Dɛ dedwe tete ne mo Pɔɔl ma dwɛ o na dé Teiru wom na ŋɔɔne ded‑o o we, “Yé ta‑n kɔre foone. Ta ta‑n ŋɔɔna, se n yé kwei n yage chemm,

english_verse: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.”
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane amo wo nmo tei ne. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ja nmo o chɔge, kokuri teo konto nɔn-bia dedɛ ye amo nɔɔna.”

english_verse: Paul stayed on in Corinth for a year and a half, teaching God's message to the people.
translation_verse: Ko déem ma pa se Pɔɔl zoore da taa, bene de chane seredo. O na wora to, o maa tɛ Wɛ kwora kam o bere nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: and said, “This man is trying to make our people worship God in a way that is against our Law!”
translation_verse: Ba ma ta de Galio ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto mo jege nɔɔna o soga se o pa ba tɔge Wɛ ne ko na chuli tei to.”

english_verse: Even before Paul could speak, Gallio said, “If you were charging this man with a crime or some other wrong, I would have to listen to you.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ya maa boŋe se o ŋɔɔne ye Galio wuuri o ta de Juu tiina bam o we, “Ko ya ná ye ŋweeno taane naa keim-balɔrɔ kodwoŋi taane mo á jege se á ta, ko ya maŋe se amo zuri a yera a cheigi abam.

english_verse: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.”
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, abam mage ni-kantɔgɔ abam tete chullu tem baŋa ne, ye ko ye botare-bia de wonnu yera ŋwaane. Konto ŋwaane abam tete mo jege se á nii ko baŋa ne. Amo bá sɛ se a di abam taana yam dwoŋi.”

english_verse: Then he sent them out of the court.
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, o ma zeili-ba o yiga ne.

english_verse: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio. Paul Returns to Antioch in Syria
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maama laam ma zaŋe ba zi Sɔsɔdane wolo na ye ba jeerim diga kam yuu tu to ba tiini ba mage‑o taane dim jeiga kam yiga ne. Galio yiga nam maŋe ka tera de ba keim dem. Pɔɔl daa ta na beeri ye o ke tei to

english_verse: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl déem ma ke da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ Korinti ne Yezu tɔgena bam tei ne. O laam ma zaŋe o bane-ba se o kɛ. O ma pa se Pirisila de Akwila mo tɔge ded‑o, ye ba zo nabworo se ba vo Siria. Ba ta na wo zo nabworo kom se ba kɛ to, Pɔɔl ya zege Kɛnkaria ne o pa se ba fane o yuu se ko bere we o tiŋi o ni de Wɛ.

english_verse: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.
