english_verse: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.
translation_verse: Tega na poore to, dé ma vo dé yi Sidon. Juliu ma duri Pɔɔl ŋwaŋa ye o pa‑o chwoŋa se o vo o badwonna tei se ba ke kolo o na lage to ba pa‑o.

english_verse: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.
translation_verse: Dé ma zaŋe dé yage dáane se dé kɛ naneo kom wo. Vo-dɛɔ maa jeeri debam ko maga. Konto ŋwaane dé ma jwoori dé dale Kupirus teo buburu kom yera dé kɛ.

english_verse: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.
translation_verse: Dé ma daare dé tɔge naneo kom wo dé vo dé da Kilikia dé Panfilia tei dé kɛ. Dé ma vo dé yi Lukia teo kodwoŋi, ko yere mo Mura.

english_verse: There the army captain found a ship from Alexandria that was going to Italy. So he ordered us to board that ship.
translation_verse: Dé na yi da to, soja yiga tu wom ma na nabworo kodwoŋi ko na nwoŋi Alɛzandaria ko maa vei Yitalia to. O ma pa se dé zo-ko.

english_verse: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.
translation_verse: Dé maa wo naneo kom wone dé vei fenfee ye dé ke da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. Ko ma tiini ko chamma ye dé vo dé yi Kanidu na bwola mɛ to. Vio kom na jeeri debam ko mage konto to, dé daa ma ware dé yɔɔre yiga dé kɛ. Konto ŋwaane dé ma vo dé dale Kiriti buburu kom yera dé kɛ dé da Salimwoni jei sem.

english_verse: We went slowly along the coast and finally reached a place called Fair Havens, not far from the town of Lasea.
translation_verse: Dé ma yɔɔre dé dale buburu kom yera. Ko ma tiini ko chamma ye dé laam yi jei selo yere na ye ‘Nabwooru Gugwor-laao’ to. Lasea teo kom bwola de jei sem konto.

english_verse: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.
translation_verse: Debam ma tiini dé dáane jei sem konto ne. Ko ma ba ko yi maŋa kam ko na damma se nɔɔna ja nabworo ba zo naneo kom wo to. Juu tiina ni-vɔɔm dɛ dem maŋe de kɛ ye ko daare se bene dem mo ti. Pɔɔl ma kaane-ba o we,

english_verse: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, “Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.”
translation_verse: “A badwonna bam, amo na nɛ kolo to, dé ná zaŋe se dé daa kɛ, dé wó na dé chaveera. Dé wonnu maama lage te chɔge mo. Ko dae nabworo kom de ko zela yam yerane, ko wae se debam tete de ga dé ŋwea.”

english_verse: The harbor at Fair Havens wasn't a good place to spend the winter. Because of this, almost everyone agreed that we should at least try to sail along the coast of Crete as far as Phoenix. It had a harbor that opened toward the southwest and northwest, and we could spend the winter there. The Storm at Sea
translation_verse: Nabwooru gugworo kom mɛ ba na wora to ba lana se ba taa tigi da se vo-dɛɔ kom maŋa kam ba ka kɛ. Nɔɔna bam dedɛ boboŋa ma ja se ba zaŋe ba kɛ naneo kom wo se ba kwaane ba nii ba wó wane ba yi Fonikas na. Fonikas wo Kiriti ne ye ko jege nabwooru gugworo kolo kwaga na yage vio kom to mo. Ba ná yi da, ba wó wane ba taa tigi da se vio kom maŋa kɛ.

english_verse: When a gentle wind from the south started blowing, the men thought it was a good time to do what they had planned. So they pulled up the anchor, and we sailed along the coast of Crete.
translation_verse: Vio laam ma nwoŋi tega-kuri seeni ko dole mɛmɛ. Nɔɔna bam maa boŋe we, ba wó wane ba na chwoŋa ba ke kolo ba na boŋe to mo. Ba ma ti ba yiga se ba kwei nabworo kom ba kɛ. Ba maa dale Kiriti buburu kom yera ba maa kɛa.

english_verse: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.
translation_verse: Vio kom na tiini ko mage debam konto to, dé daa ma ware se dé pa nabworo kom yɔɔre vio kom na nwoŋi mɛ to. Dé na kwaane dé ga to, dé ma yage nabworo kom dé pa vio kom.

english_verse: We went along the island of Cauda on the side that was protected from the wind. We had a hard time holding the lifeboat in place,
translation_verse: Vio kom ma ja debam ko vo ko pa se dé dale buburu kodwoŋi yera pa se vio kom daa ba mage debam dedɛ. Bubɛ dem konto yere mo Kɔda. Dé ma tiini dé toŋe cham dé liiri nabworo-balaŋa kam dé ke nabworo-kamunu kom wone se ka yé chɔge.

english_verse: but finally we got it where it belonged. Then the sailors wrapped ropes around the ship to hold it together. They lowered the sail and let the ship drift along, because they were afraid it might hit the sandbanks in the gulf of Syrtis.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam na ke konto to, ba ma kwei ŋone ba pa se tɔge nabworo-kamunu kom kuri ye ba vɔ ko maama. Ba maa kɔre foone we vio kom wó zege ko mage-ba ko ja vo na-kwala jei selo yere na ye Suritis to. Konto ŋwaane ba ma kwaane ba cheiŋi nabworo kom pa se ko daa ba tiini ko dura, ye ba yage-ko ba pa vio kom.

english_verse: Then on the third day, with their bare hands they threw overboard some of the ship's gear.
translation_verse: Tega daa na poore to, ba tete ma ma ba jea ba le nabworo kom yera wonnu ba de na bam wone.

english_verse: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Ko déem ye da kɔgɔ kɔgɔ mo debam na wo nɛ wea kam de chalechwe sem. Vo-dɛɔ daa ta maa tiini ko mage debam ye ko ba yaga. Debam daa ba teena we dé wó wori.

english_verse: Since none of us had eaten anything for a long time, Paul stood up and told the men: You should have listened to me! If you had stayed on in Crete, you would not have had this damage and loss.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam maa na vei taa ye ba ba di wodiu to, Pɔɔl ma zaŋe o zege ba wone o ta-ba o we, “A badwonna bam, abam ya ná sɛ amo ni ye dé wo yage Kiriti, dé ya bá na chɔgem de chaveera yanto dwoŋi.

english_verse: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.
translation_verse: Amo laam nam lwoori abam se á ta‑á jege pu-dɛa. A yei we abam wolowolo bá ga o ŋwea, se ko ye nabworo kom yerane mo wó chɔge.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Ko ye diim tete ne mo Wɛ wolo na tei amo ye a ye o tontoŋeno to toŋe o maleka amo tei ne.

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: Ka ma ta ka we, ‘Pɔɔl, ye ta‑n kɔre foone, se nmo jege se n vo n zege Pa-faro wom yiga ne mo. Wɛ ye ŋwaŋa tu ye o wó pa se nɔɔna balo na tɔge ba wo nabworo kom wone to de jwoŋi ba ŋwea.’

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Ba ma gwoni ŋone selo na leigi nabworo kom zegem luuru tem to ba yage pa se te misi na bam wone. Ba ma daare ba bwoli ŋone selo na vɔge nabworo kom naywi sem to se ba taa pae ko vei ne ba na lage tei to. Ba laam ma kwei gɔrɔ ba lei nabworo kom yiga ne se vio kom taa maga se ko yɔɔre ko bɛ.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Nabworo kom chwoona bam ma boŋe se ba lu se ba daare nabworo kom. Ba ma le nabworo-balaŋa kam ba de na bam wone ye ba ke nenɛɛne ba lage ba vo se ba le nabworo kom yiga luuru tem mo tei.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Ba ma kɔre foone we, vio kom wó mage nabworo kom ko ja vo ko mage de peero. Konto ŋwaane ba ma le nabworo kom zegem luuru tena ko kwaga ne ba de na bam wone. Ba ma daare ba lwoori Wɛ taa, se tega ba ka poore.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na lɔre ba na boŋe se ba ke tei to, o ma ta de soja yiga tu wom de o nɔɔna bam o we, “Nɔɔna banto ná nwoŋi ba daare nabworo kom, abam bá wane á jwoŋi á ŋwea.”

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na tage konto to, soja tiina bam ma gwoni ŋone selo ba na mɛ ba lei nabworo-balaŋa kam to ba de-ka ba yage.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: A nam lwoori abam se á zaŋe á di wodiu. Á ná wo ke konto, á bá wori. Á ta‑á yei we abam ba lage á yu-yua tete á ga.”

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na tage konto o ti to, o ma kwei bworobworo o zege ba maama yiga ne o ke Wɛ lei ye o daare o fɔ-ko o wora o di.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa se ba maama laam ke pu-dɛa ye ba di wodiu.

english_verse: people on the ship,
translation_verse: ) mo nabworo kom wone.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama na di o zaŋe to, ba ma le mena ywollu tem nabworo kom wone ba de na bam wone, se ko daa yé taa duna.

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Tega laam na poore to, nɔɔna bam maa yeiri buburu kolo ni ne ba na wora to. Ba ma nii ba na gugworo na na vei ba tigi da to. Ba maa boŋe se ba nii ba wó wane ba pa se nabworo kom tɔge dáane ko bɛ na.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Nabworo kom ma vo ko yi na-kwala jei ko cheiŋi da. Ko yiga kam ma moore kasolo wone ye ka daa ware ka le. Ko daare na bam maa tiini ba pɔgele ye ba mage nabworo kom kwaga kam pa se ka wora ka chɔga yera yera.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Soja tiina bam déem ma ke ni daane se ba ja peena bam ba go, se ba wolowolo yé zaŋe o yɛ o vere o tete ba jea ne.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Ba yiga tu wom maa lage se o jwoŋi Pɔɔl ŋwea. O ma che-ba se ba yé ke kolo ba na boŋe to. O ma daare o pa ni se nɔɔna balo na wó wane ba yɛ ba nwoŋi to, se ba da yiga ba faŋe ba chu na bam wone se ba yɛ ba bɛ,

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: se balo na daare to kwei nabworo kom da-dedwaaro tem naa ko wonnu telo na bwori to ba ma yɛ ba bɛ. Konto mo debam maama ke dé ma jwoŋi dé tete.

english_verse: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translation_verse: Dé na wori dé bɛ bubɛ konto to, dé ma lɔre we bubɛ dem konto yere mo Maleta.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na zoore dáane to maa tiini ba jege debam ŋwaŋa. Doa maa bobo ka wora ka nena pa se waaro wora. Ba ma dwei mini ba pa debam maama se dé weeri.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma puuri dɛ o wora o ke mini dem wone. Mini dem fonyogo ma pa se basankwea nwoŋi dɛ sem wone ka kekare Pɔɔl jeŋa ka lei da.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Teo kom tiina bam ma na basankwea kam na leigi Pɔɔl jeŋa kam ne to. Ba maa tɛ daane ba we, “Keim dento bere we nɔɔno wonto ye nɔn-goro mo. O na lugi naneo kom wone to, ko nam wo maŋe se o taa ŋwe. Wɛ wo sɛ se o wori.”

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl ma miisi basankwea kam o de mini dem wone ye kolokolo wo ke‑o.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Ba maa zege ba cheigi ba nii se o yera ga wó fole mo naa o pɔpɔ o to tega ne o te. Ba na cheigi konto taa to, ba maa wo nɛ we kolokolo ke‑o. Ba ma leiri ba boboŋa o ŋwaane ye ba daare ba we, “Nɔɔno wonto ye wɛ dedwoŋi mo!”

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Jeiga kam konto seeni nɔɔno wodwoŋi kara bwola da. Nɔɔno wom yere mo Pubilu. Wonto mo ye teo kom konto dedɛɛro. O ma jeeri debam lanyerane o sɔŋɔ ne. Dé ma ke da yatɔ da.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: O kwo maa tigi o weela. Paa de wo-zuru mo jege‑o. Pɔɔl ma zo o diga kam se o na‑o. O ma lwoori Wɛ o pa‑o, ye o zi o jea o baŋa ne pa se jaweo kom jei.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: O na ke konto to, teo kom tiina balo maama na weele to maa tui o tei ye o pa ba na yazura.

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: Dé déem ke chane setɔ mo teo kom konto ne ye dé laam na nabworo kodwoŋi kolo ba na bwoŋi we ‘Wa-yeywa’ to. Ko déem nwoŋi Alɛzandaria mo ko ba ko zege bubɛ dem konto ni ne taa ye vo-dɛɔ kom maŋa kɛ. Dé déem ma zo ko wo se dé kɛ.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: Dé ma tɔge naneo kom wo dé vo dé yi Sirakuza. Dé ma peini da da yatɔ.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: Dé ma zaŋe dáane dé tɔge naneo kom wo dé vo dé yi Rɛgimu. Tega na poore to, vio ma zaŋe dé kwaga ne ko bobo se ko taa maga. Dé ma ke da yalei ye dé vo dé yi Putioli dé zege da.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: Dé ma nwoŋi nabworo kom wone dé vo dé maŋe de Yezu tɔgena badwonna. Ba ma lwoori debam se dé ke da yarepɛ ba tei ne. Dé ke konto mo ye dé laam vo dé yi Rom.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: Yezu tɔgena balo na wo Rom ne to ma ni debam ŋwa. Ba ma zaŋe Rom ne se ba nwoŋi ba jeeri debam chwoŋa ne. Ba déem tu ba yi Apiu yaga kam na wo mɛ to, ye badaara de déem ba jei selo ba na bwoi we ‘Veira Di Setɔ’ to se ba jeeri debam. Pɔɔl na nɛ-ba konto to, o ma ke Wɛ lei ye o daare o su de dam.

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: Dé na vei dé yi Rom konto to, ba ma pa Pɔɔl chwoŋa se o taa zoore o na lage mɛ to, ye ba pa soja tu taa tɔge‑o o yera. Pɔɔl bere Wɛ chega kam Rom ne

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ na kɛ to, Pɔɔl ma bwoŋi teo kom Juu tiina nakwa se ba tigisi daane. Ba na tu ba wora konto to, Pɔɔl ma ta de-ba o we, “A nu-bia bam, amo wo ke kolokolo a chɔge debam nɔɔna bam wo, naa a chɔge chullu telo dé nabaara bam na tiŋi ba pa debam to. De konto de, ba jaane amo Jerusalem ne ye ba laam ke-ne Rom tiina jeŋa ne se a taa ye peeno.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Ba déem bwei-ne taane se ba nii. Ba maa wo nɛ amo na ke kolo a chɔge se ko pa ba go-ne to. Konto ŋwaane ba ya maa lage se ba yage amo.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Juu tiina bam maa wo sɛ konto. Mo kokuri ko déem ye fefeo mo ko pa-ne se a ke a tete Rom Pa-faro wom jeŋa ne se o di a taane. Ko nam dae we amo ya jege taane mo de a tete dwi tiina bam.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo bwoŋi abam se á ba se dé ŋɔɔne daane dé nii. Ba na vɔge amo de chaponno tem to, ko ye amo na sɛ wolo wom Juu tiina bam na jege o teena to ŋwaane mo.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Pɔɔl na tage konto to, ba ma ta ded‑o ba we, “Debam nam wo jwoŋi tɔnɔ Judea tiina bam tei ne ba na popone ba ta nmo taane to. Debam ta wo nɛ dé nu-bu wolowolo na nwoŋi da o ba o ta nmo taane o bere debam, naa o ta wo-balɔrɔ o pa nmo.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Debam nam wó taa lage se dé lɔre nmo na jege kolo n boboŋa ne to. Kolo ŋwaane ko ná ye nmo na tɔge chwo-doŋa kalo to, dé maŋe dé yei we nɔɔna yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaale-ka jei maama ne mo.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma lage dɛ ba pa Pɔɔl. Dɛ dem na yi to, nɔɔna dedɛ ma ba jeiga kalo Pɔɔl na zoore da to. Ba na tu konto to, o ma tiini o ŋɔɔne o bere-ba taa, ko zege zezeŋa ne se ko vo ko yi dedaan-ni. O ma ta Wɛ paare dem na ye tei to o bere-ba. O ma ma Wɛ chega kalo na popone Moses nia tɔnɔ kom ne, de faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem twanno tem wone to o bere-ba, ye o kwaane se o pa ba sɛ chega kalo o na tɛ Yezu ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: O na bere-ba konto to, badaara ma sɛ o taane dem. Badaara de maa wo sɛ.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Ba ma zaŋe se ba viiri ye ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane Pɔɔl ya na tage kolo to baŋa ne. Ba ta na wo viiri to mo Pɔɔl tage taane dento o woli da: “Wɛ Sin-laao kom déem tɔge Wɛ sampwora Izaya kwora mo ko ta chega de abam nabaara bam we:

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Véi a nɔɔna bam tei n ta de-ba we: ‘Abam wó fɔge á ta‑á cheigi Wɛ taane dem, ye á bá ni de kuri. Abam yia nam wó kwaane ya nii, ye á na nɛ kolo to bá zo á yuu.’

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: O na tage konto to, Juu tiina bam ma nwoŋi o tei ne. Ba na maa viiri to, ba ma tiini ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ ba pa daane.]

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: O maa yeini o bere Wɛ paare dem chega kam ye o tɔɔle dé Teiru Yezu Krista kwora. O déem ŋɔɔne de baare mo ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo chege o yiga.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl wolo na ye Yezu Krista kabaa to mo popone tɔnɔ konto. Wɛ mo tiŋi-ne se a taa ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe, ye o kuri-ne se a taa tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam.

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam wo o tei ne de dam, ye Wɛ tɔge ko ŋwaane o bi‑o toone wone se ko bere we o seene o ye Wɛ Bu wom.

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Abam de tɔge á ye balo Wɛ na kuri se á ba á ta‑á ye Yezu Krista nyem to mo.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Amo popone a pa abam balo na wo Rom ne ye Wɛ swoi abam pa se o kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna to. Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Lei keim

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Da-yiga to, amo lage a da Yezu Krista ŋwaane a ke amo Tu Wɛ lei a pa abam maama, de nɔɔna na ŋɔɔne abam taane jei maama ne we á ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu to.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a toŋe a pa Wɛ mo de a wo maama de a na tɔɔle o Bu Yezu kwor-ywoŋa kam tei to. Wɛ wó zege amo kwaga ne we, amo yeini a lwoori‑o,

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: ye a guli abam gula o yiga ne maŋa maama. Amo ta yeini a lwoori‑o se, o ná sɛ, se o pa-ne chwoŋa se a ba abam tei leile konto.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Abam fera tiini ya jege amo. A lage se a na abam, se Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam wane ko da amo ŋwaane ko zeini abam de Wɛ pɛɛre delo na wó pa á ta‑á jege dam to.

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: Amo na lage kolo to mo ye se dé na baare da-tei ne, debam maama na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, lɔre-na we amo kwaane mo kuni dedɛ se a lage chwoŋa a ba a na abam, ye a daa ta wo nɛ chwoŋa de zem maama. A lage a ba se a wane a jwoŋi nɔɔna abam wone a ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne, ne amo na maŋe a ke tei dwi-gɛ tiina badwonna tei ne to.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo tiini a lage se a ba a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere abam balo na wo Rom ne to de.

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amo ba kɔre chaveera se a bere nɔɔna Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Wɛ kwora kam konto mo jege dam ye Wɛ tɔge ka ŋwaane o vere nɔɔna balo maama na ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to, ko bobo de Juu tiina bam mo ye ko laam ba ko woli dwi-gɛ tiina da.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Ka ta bere nɔɔna Wɛ na wó ke tei o pa ba na chega o tei ne to. Ko maama nam zege wo-dedoa ŋwaane mo, boboa de kweelim maama. Wɛ tɔnɔ kom maŋe ko bere we, “Wolo maama na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to wó na ŋwea o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane.” Nabiina maama gɛ bora

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam vaŋe ba zwa, kolo ŋwaane o maŋe o pa nɔɔna chwoŋa se ba lɔre o chega kam. Wɛ tete bere-ba o chega kam jaja ye ba wo sɛ.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Nabiina ware se ba na Baŋa Wɛ de ba yia. Ko nam zege o na ke logo baŋa to, nabiina seene ba nae wonnu telo o na naane to. Ko ma pa ba wane ba lɔre lanyerane we o jege dam delo na ba jege tiim to ye o ye Wɛ chekke. Konto ŋwaane nabiina bá wane ba jwoŋi chwoŋa Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Ba maŋe ba yei Wɛ na ye wolo to, ye ba nam ba lage se ba taa ke‑o lei, naa ba zeiŋi o yere dem wɛɛne. Ko nam na ye tei to, ba boboŋa yam jigi kafɛ, ye ba bochare-fulwooru tem ye lim yerane mo.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Ba maa pae se ba jege swa, ye ba nam ye nɔn-jworru mo.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Ba ba sɛ se ba taa zuli Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ, ye ba daare ba zuli wonnu telo ba na mɔɔne de ba jea to. Ba yeini ba ke wonnu tem konto se te taa nye de nabiina na bá dáane ye ba te to, naa zuna, de vara, de tega-veila mo.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Wɛ yage-ba se ba taa tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo ba tete boboŋa na lage to. Ba maa yeini ba ke wo-zɔɔna, ye ba tɔge ka-laga kikia yalo na pae chaveera jaane-ba to.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ yage-ba se ba taa tɔge wo-zɔɔna kikia yalo ba boboŋa na laga ye ya jege chaveera to. Kaana bam yeini ba chɔge ba tete baaro de kaane laŋa ne, pa se ba tɔge kikia yalo na wo maŋe de kaana to.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto mo de baara de. Ba yeini ba ba lage kaana, ye ba pae se ba fera zoore ba dwonna baara se ba peini de-ba, nenɛɛne ko na wo maŋe se ba ke tei to. Baara yeini ba ke chaveera keim da-tei ne, ye ko pa ba na waarem delo na maŋe de ba tusim kikia yam to.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, nɔɔna bam konto maa boŋe we, Wɛ chega kam ba jege kuri se ba taa jege-ka ba boboŋa ne. Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ ma yage-ba se ba taa tɔge ba boboŋ-yɔɔro tem kwaga, se ba taa ke wonnu telo ba na ba jege chwoŋa se ba ke to.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Ba boboŋa maa sui de wo-balwaaro telo na ba tɔge chega chwoŋa to, de keim-lwanno dwi maama. Ba yi maa sui wonnu dedɛ. Ba tiini ba jege puseŋa, ye ba lage nɔɔna gom. Ba maa swoi nankɔɔre kikia ye ba gane ba dwonna. Ba maa yeini ba yaale nɔɔna. Ba ye bebare-nyena mo,

english_verse: say cruel things about others, and hate God. They are proud, conceited, and boastful, always thinking up new ways to do evil. These people don't respect their parents.
translation_verse: ye ba ŋɔɔne ba chɔge ba dwonna yere. Ba maa chuli Wɛ, ye ba twe ba dwonna. Ba ta kwori ba ye banegero nyena, ye ba bere ba tete nɔɔna yiga ne. Ba tiini ba boŋe keim-balwaaro boboŋa. Ba ba nege ba tiina.

english_verse: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.
translation_verse: Ba ba jege boboŋa. Ba maa yeini ba kwane ba ni. Ba ba jege ba dwonna swono, ye ba ba jege ba ŋwaŋa de.

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Ba nam maŋe ba yei Wɛ kwora kam na bere kolo we, balo na tɔge keim-balwaaro tento dwoŋi to maŋe se toone mo chɔge-ba. De konto de, ba ta yeini ba ke-te, ye ba lage se ba dwonna de tɔge ba ke-te.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: A nɔɔna bam, á boŋe we á jege chwoŋa se á yaale á dwonna mo na? Nmo nam ná yaale n dwoŋi, ko ye nmo tete yuu mo n chɔge, kolo ŋwaane nmo tete de ke wo-yɔɔro tem konto dwoŋi. Konto to, n bá‑n wane n jwoŋi chwoŋa Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Dé nam yei we, Wɛ na waare nɔɔna balo na ke wo-yɔɔro konto dwoŋi tei to tɔge chega mo.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Se nmo na ye nabiinu to, nmo yaale n dwoŋi de o kikia yam konto, ye nmo tete yeini n ke-ya. Konto to, nmo bá wane n lu Wɛ waarem dem wone.

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Wɛ nam tiini o jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa mo, de wo-zuru, de ban-peno. Nmo nam pae se wonnu tento ye kafɛ mo na? Ta‑n yei we, Wɛ na jege nmo ŋwaŋa tei to lage ka pa n na chwoŋa se n leiri n wo mo.

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Nmo nam jege yi-dɛɛre ye n ve Wɛ zaane dem. Konto wó pa se, Wɛ borem dɛ dem ná yia, n waarem dem wó tiini de puli nmo baŋa ne. Dɛ dem konto ne Wɛ bane wó zaŋe de nɔɔna, ye ba lɔre o borem dem na jege chega tei to.

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se nɔɔno maama na o nyem se ko maŋe de o kikia yam na ye tei to.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara yeini ba vɔ ba wo ye ba ke wo-laaro mo, se ko pa ba na paare, de zula, de ŋwea kalo na ba pae toone to Wɛ tei ne. Wɛ wó pa banto ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim o tei ne to.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara nam wora ba na lage ba tete yerane wonnu. Ba maa yeini ba ve Wɛ chega kam ye ba daare ba tɔge tusim kikia. Wɛ waarem dem de o ban-zɔŋɔ kom wó ba banto baŋa.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Nabiina balo maama na yeini ba ke wo-lwanno to wó yaare de cham delo Wɛ na ke ba yuu ne to. Juu tiina bam jege se ba yaare konto mo yiga, se ko laam ke dwi-gɛ tiina bam de da.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo maama na tɔge keim-laaro to, Wɛ wó pa-ba paare, de zula, de ywoni. Juu tiina bam wó na konto mo yiga, se ko laam yi dwi-gɛ tiina bam de.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Balo na yeiri Wɛ nia yalo o na ke Moses jeŋa ne to ná ke ba tusi, ba wó na chɔgem mo ye ko dae Wɛ nia yam ŋwaane. Ko daare balo Wɛ nia yam na tei-ba to ná ke ba tusi, Wɛ wó tɔge o nia yam konto baŋa ne mo o chɔge-ba.

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: Nmo maŋe n yei Wɛ boboŋa na lage se n ke tei to. Nmo na zamese Wɛ nia yam to mo pɛ se n lɔre woŋo kolo na ye chega to.

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: Nmo boŋe we n jege Wɛ pwooni n pae balo ta na wo lim wone to, ye n nye de lilwei vaŋeno se n pa nɔɔna tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa.

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: Nmo nam na bere n tete konto to, ko lana na? N yeini n jege n dwonna n bera. Bɛŋwaane mo ye n tete ba jwoŋi bera? N bere nɔɔna we, ba yé taa ŋɔna. Nmo tete ba ŋɔne na?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: N tɛ we, ba yé ke kabwoŋa kikia. Nmo tete ba ke kabwoŋa na? N chuli jwona. Nmo tete nam ba ŋɔne wonnu jwona yam di sem ne na?

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Ko ye abam Juu tiina kikia ŋwaane mo pae se dwi-gɛ tiina jege Wɛ yere dem ba yaala.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á gwoni á peina se ko bere we á ye Wɛ nɔɔna mo. Á ná kwaane á tɔge Wɛ nia yam, á peina gwonim jege kuri á tei ne. Ko daare, á ná chɔge Wɛ nia yam, á peina gwonim dem ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Dwi-gɛ tiina wó bere we abam Juu tiina ba jege chega. Á jege Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom á tei ne, ye á gwoni á peina. De ko de, á ta yeini á chɔge Wɛ nia yam mo. Banto peina nam wo gwoni ye ba nam tɔge Wɛ nia yam mo.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Wɛ yiga ne, Juu tu chekke ye wolo bochare na pae o ye Wɛ nyem to mo. Wonto bochare na fɔge de kwɛ tei to mo nye de o peini dem gwonim chekke. Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom bá wane ko fɔge nɔɔno bochare. Ko maa ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom keim mo. Nɔɔno wom konto dwoŋi nae zula Wɛ tei ne mo, se ko dae nabiina tei ne.

english_verse: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?
translation_verse: Juu tu nam nɛ nyɔɔre se ko dwoni dwi-gɛ tu na? Ba ná gwoni Juu tu peini, ko jege wolim ko pa‑o na?

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Ɛɛ, ko tiini ko jege kuri. Yiga to, Juu tiina bam mo ye balo Wɛ na kwei o ni-botare sem o ke ba jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?
translation_verse: Ba badaara nam wo ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Konto nam bá wane ko pa Wɛ taa ye wolo na nwoŋi o chega kam kwaga ne to.

english_verse: No, indeed! God tells the truth, even if everyone else is a liar. The Scriptures say about God, “Your words will be proven true, and in court you will win your case.”
translation_verse: Kɔtaa. Nɔɔna maama ná maŋe ba ye vwa-nyena, Wɛ jege se o ta taa ye chega tu mo. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nmo jege chega de nmo na ŋɔɔne taane delo to. Nmo ná bore nɔɔna taane, n ta jege chega mo.”

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, dé ná maŋe dé tɔge tusim kikia, ko ta bere jaja we Wɛ tiini o jege chega. Konto maa pae se nɔɔna wae ba tɛ we, Wɛ ná waare-ba ba tusim kikia ŋwaane, o wo ke lanyerane.

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Konto nam ba jege kuri. Wɛ ya ná ba jege chega, o ya bá wane o di nabiina bora.

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ta wae ba tɛ we, “Amo ná yeini a fɔ vwa, konto wae ko pa nɔɔna lɔre jaja we Wɛ tiini o ye chega tu mo, pa se o jwoŋi yere lanyerane. Ko na ye konto to, bɛ mo ye a jege se a na chɔgem a keim-balwaaro ŋwaane?”

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Konto ya ná ye chega, dé ya wó wane dé ta we, “Pa-na se dé taa toŋe lwarem, se ko wane ko ja lanyerane ko ba.” Nɔɔna badwonna bere we amo yeini a tɛ konto dwoŋi. Ba nam lage se ba chɔge amo yere mo. Ba tete wó na chɔgem se ko maŋe de ba kikia. Wɔ mo jege chega Wɛ yiga ne?

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Ko bere we debam Juu tiina bam gare dwi-gɛ tiina bam na? Aawo, kɔtaa. Amo ya maŋe a ta jaja we nɔɔna maama wo wɛleera jeŋa ne mo, ko ná ye Juu tiina naa dwi-gɛ tiina bam de.

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na jege chega Wɛ tei ne, de nɔɔno dedoa de.

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na lɔre swa chekke. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na lage Wɛ se o zuli‑o.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama mɛ ba kwaga ba ya Wɛ, ye ba maama tusi. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na ke lanyerane, de nɔɔno dedoa de.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Ba nia maa ŋɔɔre, ne yibeeli na puri to. Ba maa mae ba dindeilima ba gane nɔɔna. Ba ni taane goe nɔɔna, ne kapaa vea na ke tei to.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Ba maa sɔɔle wo-balwaaro ba pa nɔɔna.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: Ba tiini ba lage lela de nɔɔna gom.

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: Ba yeini ba chɔge nɔɔna pa ba na yaara dedɛ.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ba maa yeiri ywoni chwoŋa se ba tɔge-ka.

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: Ba maa bere ba ba kɔre Wɛ.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Dé yei we kolo maama Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom na bere to, ko popone ko pa balo ni-kaana yam na tei-ba to mo. Konto ŋwaane, nabiina maama wó ba ba zege Wɛ yiga ne se o bwei-ba, ye ba wolowolo bá wane o pore o ni se o jwoŋi o tete.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-kaana yam pae se nabiina lɔre we ba ke ba tusi. Nɔɔno ná maŋe o yɔɔre o tɔge-ya tei, konto bá wane ko pa o na chega Wɛ yiga ne. Dé na wó na chega Wɛ tei ne tei to

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Leile konto dé laam lɔre Wɛ na tɔge chwoŋa kalo o pae se nɔɔna jege chega o tei ne to, ye ko ba zege o nia yam tɔgem baŋa ne. Moses de Wɛ sampwori sem de na bere tei faŋa faŋa to nam maŋe ko bere ko na wó taa ye tei to.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Nabiina maama tusi ye ba ware ba maŋe de Wɛ paare dem.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam tɔge o zaane dem baŋa ne mo o pae se nɔɔna na chega o tei ne, Yezu Krista na ŋwe ba wɛleera jene o ma jwoŋi-ba to ŋwaane. Wɛ pae nɔɔna o zaane dem zɛɛra mo.

english_verse: God sent Christ to be our sacrifice. Christ offered his life's blood, so by faith in him we could come to God. And God did this to show that in the past he was right to be patient and forgive sinners. This also shows that God is right when he accepts people who have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto mo Wɛ bere we o ye chega tu de o na jwoŋi nɔɔna ba wɛleera wone ye o pa ba na chega o tei ne to. Konto maa bere we Wɛ jege chega ye o ta pae se balo maama na ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu to de jege chega o tei ne.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, dé wó wane dé mage dé nyɔɔna bɛ baŋa ne mo? Kolokolo tera. Kolo ŋwaane ko dae dé na tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam to mo wó pa dé na chega. Ko nam ye dé na jege wo-dedoa to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Kokuri dé yei we nɔɔna wó na chega Wɛ tei ne ba wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane mo, ye ko dae ni-kaana yam tɔgem ŋwaane.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Wɛ yiga wo Juu tiina bam yerane wone mo na? O yiga tera de dwi-gɛ tiina na? Aawo. O nii nabiina maama baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye dedoa mo. Juu tiina ná ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o, o wó pa ba na chega o yiga ne. Dwi-gɛ tiina de ná ke konto, o wó ke-ba bedwe mo.

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ ya ná pɛ‑o chega o na ke keim-laaro to ŋwaane, o ya wó taa jege woŋo se o mage o nyɔɔne ko baŋa ne, se ko dae Wɛ yiga ne mo o wae o ke konto.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, “Abaraham sɛ Wɛ de wo-dedoa, ye Wɛ pa o na chega ko ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nɔɔno ná toŋe totoŋa, o wó jwoŋi o ŋweero o totoŋa yam baŋa ne, ye ko dae pɛɛre mo o jwoŋi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Pɛ David de maŋe o ŋɔɔne taane dento dwoŋi. O déem tage we, nɔɔno wolo Wɛ na pɛ se o na chega ye ko dae o keim-laaro ŋwaane to ye wopwolo tu mo.

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na jege wɛleera ye Wɛ ba ke-ya o bochare ne to jege yu-ywoŋo.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: David na ŋɔɔne wopwolo kom taane to, o ŋɔɔne o pa balo peina na gwoni to yerane mo na? O nam ŋɔɔne o pa balo peina na wo gwoni to de mo. Dé maŋe dé lɔre we, “Abaraham ke o wo-dedoa o sɛ Wɛ, ye Wɛ pa o na chega ko ŋwaane.”

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ o jege chega o tei ne konto to, ko ye o peini na maŋe de gwoni to mo na? Aawo, o peini ya ta wo gwoni mo.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Ko ye ko kwaga ne mo ba gwoni o peini se ko taa ye maana we Wɛ maŋe o pa o jege chega o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane ye ba ta wo gwoni o peini. Konto to, balo maama peina na wo gwoni ye ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ pa se ba na chega o tei ne to ye Abaraham dwi tiina chekke mo.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Balo maama na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ ye ba maŋe ba gwoni ba peina to de ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo, de ba na tɔge Abaraham déem na jege wo-dedoa ye ba ta wo gwoni o peini tei to.

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Ko dae Abaraham na tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam tei to ŋwaane mo pɛ se Wɛ pwooli se o zeini Abaraham de o dwi tiina bam. Ko nam ye Abaraham na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ ye o na chega o tei ne to ŋwaane mo pɛ Wɛ pwooli we, o wó pa o ba o taa tei logo kom.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Ko ya ná ye balo na boŋe se ba na chega Wɛ tei ne de ba ni-kaana tɔgem to mo wó ba ba taa tei logo kom, ko ya wó pa se wo-dedoa tɔgem daa ta ba jege kuri, ye Wɛ kampwola kam de wó ji kafɛ mo.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-kaana yam mo pae o bane zaŋe de nɔɔna de ba na chɔge-ya to ŋwaane. Ni-kaana nam ná tera, nɔɔna bá wane ba lɔre we ba chɔge-ya.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Dé lɔre we ko ye Abaraham wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane mo pɛ se Wɛ pwooli kampwola ded‑o, se o wane o pa-ka zɛɛra. Konto to, Abaraham dwi tiina bam maama wó seene ba na wo-laaro telo Wɛ na tiŋi o ni se o pa-ba to. Ko dae balo na jege Wɛ ni-kaana yam ba tɔge to yerane mo wó na-te, se ko ye balo de na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ ne Abaraham de na jege tei to mo. Konto ŋwaane, debam maama wó wane dé bwoŋi Abaraham we dé nabaaro.

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem tage de Abaraham o we, “Amo gwoni a ni se a pa n ji dwi tiina dedɛ nabaaro.” Abaraham na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ to, o seene o ye dé nabaaro Wɛ yiga ne. Wɛ nam mo bi nɔɔna toone wone o pa-ba ŋwea, ye o ŋɔɔne wonnu telo ta na tera to, ne te na maŋe te wora tei to.

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: O maa ba jege boboŋa yalei de Wɛ na pwooli se o pa‑o kolo to. O nam tiini o zege lanyerane de o wo-dedoa kam mo, ye o zeiŋi Wɛ yere.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: O maa seene o yei lanyerane we, Wɛ wó wane o ke kolo o na pwooli se o ke to.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Ko nam na popone we, “Wɛ ma pa o na chega” to, ko dae Abaraham yerane ŋwaane mo ko popone konto.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Ko nam popone debam de ŋwaane mo. Kokuri, Wɛ wó pa debam de na chega o tei ne, dé na ye balo na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ‑o to ŋwaane. Wonto nam mo ye wolo na bi dé Teiru Yezu toone wone to.

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo ke Yezu nabiina jeŋa ne pa se o te debam wɛleera ŋwaane. O ma daare o bi‑o toone wone pa se o jwoori o na ŋwea, se ko pa dé na chega o tei ne.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Dé na ke dé wo-dedoa de Wɛ to mo pae dé jege chega o yiga ne. Konto ŋwaane, dé na me de dé Teiru Yezu Krista to mo pae debam de Wɛ fɔge daane.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Yezu mo jaane debam o vo o zege Wɛ yiga ne, ye Wɛ ke debam zaane dé wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane. Konto to, dé jege teena we dé wó na paare Wɛ tei ne, ye ko pae debam wo pwoli lanyerane.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Dé nam ta jege wopwolo dé yaara yam baŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane dé yei we yaara wae ya pae se dé fɔge dé zege mo de pu-dɛa.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Dé na jege teena konto to bá pa dé na dé chaveera, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ tiini o ke o swono debam bochara ne, de o na pɛ o Sin-laao kom ta wo debam tei ne to.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá sɛ se o zaza o te o dwoŋi ŋwaane, de o dwoŋi wom na ye chega tu tei to de. Dɛ delo nɔɔno bá kɔre foone se o te o dwoŋi nɔn-ŋom ŋwaane.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Baŋa Wɛ, wonto bere debam o na tiini o jege debam swono tei to de o na pɛ se Yezu Krista ba o te debam ŋwaane ye dé daa ta tɔge wɛleera chwoŋa to.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Yezu na tega ye o jana bam nwoŋi to mo pɛ dé na chega Wɛ yiga ne. Konto to, ko tiini ko ye chega we, o laam wó jwoŋi debam Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Debam ya ye Wɛ dona mo. O Bu wom toone dem nam mo pɛ se debam de Wɛ fɔge daane. Debam laam na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to, ko tiini ko ye chega we, Wɛ wó da o Bu wom ŋwea ŋwaane o jwoŋi debam ŋwea.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, dé jege wopwolo lanyerane de Wɛ na zeini debam dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. Wonto mo pore chwoŋa se debam de Wɛ ba dé fɔge daane. Adam de Yezu Krista memaŋe

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dedoa ŋwaane mo pɛ se wɛleera ba logo baŋa, ye wɛleera de ja toone ya woli da ya ba. Konto to, nabiina maama jege se ba te, ba maama na ke wɛleera to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ta na wo ke o ni-kaana yam o nɔɔna jeŋa ne to, de wɛleera maŋe ya wora mo logo baŋa ne. Ni-kaana nam na tera to, Wɛ ba ke nɔɔna wɛleera o boboŋa ne.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, ko zege Adam maŋa kam ne se ko vo ko yi Moses maŋa kam, toone nam maŋe de wae nabiina pa se ba maama toa. Toone maa wae balo de na ke ba tusi, ye ko dae nenɛɛne Adam déem na ke tei ye o chɔge Wɛ ni dem to. Adam nam bere debam Yezu ya na lage o ba se ko taa ye tei to. Ba nam dae bedwe.

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Adam déem na ke o tusi tei to dae bedwe de Wɛ na ke tei o zeini debam zɛɛra to. Nabiinu dedoa kam konto tusim dem mo pɛ se nɔɔna dedɛ tɔge ba te. Wɛ zaane dem nam dwoi konto ye o toŋe nabiinu dedoa Yezu Krista o pa nɔɔna zɛɛra se wonto ke zaane o ke ba yuu ne.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Wɛ na kwei pɛɛre dem o pa nɔɔna zɛɛra konto to dae bedwe de nabiinu dedoa kam na ke o tusi tei to. Wonto na ke o tusi bedwe to mo pɛ se Wɛ bore nɔɔna o chɔge. Ko daare nɔɔna dedɛ na ke ba tusi to, Wɛ zeinim dem nam pɛ se ba wɛleera dedɛ saare ye ba na chega o tei ne.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dedoa kam tusim dem mo pɛ se toone tɔge wonto ŋwaane de ba, ye de ta wae nɔɔna de dam. Ko nam tiini ko ye chega mo we, nabiinu dedoa Yezu Krista mo pɛ nɔɔna chwoŋa se ba taa jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam de dam. Balo maama Wɛ na yɔɔre o ke zaane ba yuu ne pa se ba jege chega o yiga ne to mo wó na o ŋwe-doŋa kam konto Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Dé nam lɔre we Adam na ke o tusi bedwe to mo pɛ se nabiina maama na chɔgem Wɛ tei ne. Yezu Krista keim-laao dedoa kam nam mo pɛ se nɔɔna maama na chega Wɛ tei ne, ye ba jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Nabiinu dedoa kam na ve Wɛ ni dem to mo pɛ se nɔɔna dedɛ tɔge o ŋwaane ba taa ye nɔn-chechɔgero. Nɔɔno dedoa kam nam na sɛ Wɛ ni to de wó pa se nɔɔna dedɛ taa jege chega Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ke o ni-kaana yam nɔɔna jeŋa ne se ko pa tusim mo fɔge de puli jaja. Wɛleera nam na puli konto to, Wɛ na ke nɔɔna zaane tei to mo tiini ko puli dedɛ.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Konto to, wɛleera tɔge toone ŋwaane mo ya maa tei nɔɔna. Wɛ zaane dem nam tɔge o na pae nɔɔna chega tei to baŋa ne de maa zeini nɔɔna lanyerane se ba taa jege ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Wɛ zaane dem na daga to, dé nam wó ta bɛ mo? Dé wó wane dé ta we, dé jege chwoŋa se dé taa ke wɛleera se ko wane ko pa Wɛ zaane dem tiini de puli dé tei ne mo na?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Aawo, dé bá ta konto dwoŋi. Wɛleera seeni debam nye de twa mo. Konto to, dé ba jege chwoŋa se dé taa ke wɛleera dé ŋwea wone.

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Debam balo maama na jwoŋi sɛɛm se dé taa ye Yezu Krista nyem to, ko bere we dé tɔge dé sɛ o toone dem mo. Abam yeiri konto na?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, dé na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, ko nye de ba suli debam de Yezu daane mo, se ko bere we dé tɔge ded‑o de te. Konto ma pa dé tɔge de Yezu Krista dé na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam, ne dé Kwo Wɛ na mɛ o paare dem dam o bi Yezu toone wone o pa o na ŋwea tei to.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Debam na me de Yezu to mo pɛ dé tɔge ded‑o dé te wɛleera seeni. Konto ŋwaane, dé daa ta wó tɔge ded‑o dé bi toone wone.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Dé yei we, ba na page Yezu dagara kam yuu ne ba go to, dé ŋwe-dwoŋa kam de tɔge da ka te mo, pa se wɛleera daa yé taa wae dé yera yam. Konto to, dé laam tei dé tete mo wɛleera jeŋa ne,

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Dé na tɔge de Yezu Krista dé te to, dé jege teena we dé wó tɔge dé na ŋwea o tei ne.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Kokuri dé yei we Yezu Krista bi toone wone ye o daa bá jwoori o te. Konto ŋwaane, toone daa bá wane‑o de taa tei.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Yezu na tege konto to, ko ye se o che wɛleera dam mo. O tege bedwe yerane mo o ma kweeli. O laam na jege ŋwea tei to mo o ŋwe o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye konto mo abam de tei ne. Ko ná ye wɛleera seeni, se á maane we á nye de twa mo. Ko nam ná ye ŋwea kalo á na jege to, á ŋwe á pa Wɛ mo, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane abam daa yé pa se wɛleera di dam á yera yam na wó te to baŋa ne. Á nam yé sɛ á pa wo-zɔɔna yalo á fera na zoore to.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Yé sɛ-na á kwei á yera yam á ke wɛleera dam jeŋa ne, se ko pa á ta‑á ke keim-balwaaro. Nam kwei-na á tete á ke Wɛ jeŋa ne, á na ye balo Wɛ na jwoŋi toone wone ye á jege ŋwea o tei ne to ŋwaane. Kwei-na á maama á pa Wɛ se o wane o ma o toŋe kolo na ye chega to.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Wɛleera daa ba jege se ya taa tei abam, kokuri to, á na jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to dae o nia yam ŋwaane, ko nam ye o zaane dem ŋwaane mo. Wɛ vere debam wɛleera jeŋa ne

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Ko nam bere debam we bɛ mo? Dé na jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne o zaane dem ŋwaane ye ko dae o nia yam ŋwaane to bere we dé jege chwoŋa se dé taa ke wɛleera na? Aawo, dé bá sɛ konto.

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Amo nam ke Wɛ lei de abam déem na ye kabɛ wɛleera jeŋa ne, ye á laam ke á tete Wɛ chega kam jeŋa ne se á ta‑á tɔge-ka de á bochara maama.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo vere abam wɛleera jeŋa ne, ye á laam ba á ji kabɛ o chega kam tei ne.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Abam nam na ba jege boboŋ-dɛɛra to mo pae se amo maŋe nabiina memaŋa a ma bere abam konto dwoŋi. Abam déem kwei á maama á sɛ wo-digiru de lwarem kikia se á ta‑á ye kabɛ ya tei ne, ye á toŋe wo-lwanno ko ja gaale. Abam laam nam jege se á kwei á maama mo á sɛ Wɛ chega kam, se á ta‑á ye ka kabɛ ye á bochara ba ya kwɛ fase.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Abam déem na ye wɛleera kabɛ to, á tei á tete mo Wɛ chega kam jeŋa ne.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Abam na ke wo-yɔɔro telo to déem jege bɛ nyɔɔre mo te pa abam? Chaveera laam jege abam te baŋa ne. Wonnu tento kweelim jei nam pae toone mo.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, Wɛ vere abam wɛleera jeŋa ne ye á laam ye o kabɛ mo. Konto ŋwaane, á jege nyɔɔre de á bochara na fɔge ya kwɛ tei to, ye ko kweelim jei mo wó pa á na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, á maama yei ni-kaana na ye tei to. Konto ŋwaane á yei we ni-kaana yam wó taa tei nɔɔno se ko taa vei o toone. O ná tega, ya daa ba tei‑o.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: A lage a bere abam ko na ye tei to. Kaane ná zo baro, Wɛ ni dem bere we o baro wom ta ná ŋwe, o ba jege chwoŋa se o yage o baro wom. O baro wom nam ná tega, o yiga le Wɛ ni dem konto ne.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, ko ye konto mo de abam de. Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni ko nye de debam maama tege mo, dé yera yam na gwaane de Yezu Krista yera yam na tege to ŋwaane. Konto ma pa dé yiga le ni-kaana yam wone, ye dé jege chwoŋa se dé ke dé tete nɔɔno wodwoŋi jeŋa ne. Wonto ye wolo na bi toone wone to mo. Ko maa pae se dé jege nyɔɔre dé pa Wɛ.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Dé déem na ke dé boboŋ-yɔɔro na lage kolo to, ko ye Wɛ ni-kaana yam mo pa se dé fera zoore keim-lwanno ye dé tɔge-te. Ko déem ma pa se dé jege nyɔɔre dé pa toone yerane.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Ni-kaana yam déem peene debam de dam. Leile konto dé yiga laam le ya wone, dé na tɔge de Yezu dé te to ŋwaane. Konto to, dé na toŋe dé pwoli Wɛ wo tei to tɔge o Sin-laao kom na wo dé bochara ne to ŋwaane mo. Dé tɔge chwo-doŋa kam konto, ye ko dae chwo-dwoŋa kalo na zege ni-kaana yalo na popone tɔnɔ ne to ŋwaane. Ni-kaana na ye tei to

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Bɛ mo dé nam wó ta Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni? Ya tete jege tusim mo na? Aawo, ko dae konto. Wɛ ni-kaana yam nam mo pɛ se amo lɔre tusim na ye tei to. Wɛ ni-kaana yam ya ná wo bere-ne we, “Yé pa n yi taa sui n dwonna wonnu”, a ya bá taa yei we yi sum n dwonna wonnu ye wɛleere mo.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni dem konto nam mo pɛ tusim na chwoŋa de zo a boboŋa pa a yi taa sui wonnu dedɛ. Ni-kaana nam ná tera, tusim bá taa jege dam.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Amo tei ne, a déem ya yeiri Wɛ nia yam ye a ta jege ŋwea. Amo laam ma ba a lɔre Wɛ ni dem na bere kolo to. Tusim ma na dam se de ja-ne,

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: ye a lɔre we a seene a ga a ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ ni delo na jege se de pa nɔɔna ŋwea to laam ma pa se toone ja amo.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni dem mo pɛ se tusim na chwoŋa se de gane amo. Tusim ma tɔge Wɛ ni dem baŋa ne mo de pa toone ja-ne.

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Dé yei we Wɛ ni-kaana yam tɔge o boboŋa na lage tei to mo. Amo nam ye logo baŋa nabiinu mo ye a ye kabaa wɛleera tei ne.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Amo ta yeiri a kikia yam kuri. A ba yeini a ke kolo a na lage se a ke to, ye a daare a ke kolo a na chuli to.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a ke kolo a na ba lage se a ke to, ko bere we a sɛ we Wɛ ni-kaana yam jege chega mo.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, ko dae we amo tete mo seene a ke wonnu tem konto, ko nam ye tusim delo na wo a bochare ne to mo ke-te.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we lam tera a tei ne, de a na ye nabiinu ye a fera zoore logo baŋa wonnu to. Kokuri, amo ná yeini a jege boboŋa se a ke lanyerane, a ta ware lanyerane a ke.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a ke kolo a boboŋa na ba lage se a ke to, ko bere we ko dae a tete mo seene a ke wonnu tem konto, ko ye tusim delo na wo a bochare ne to mo ke-te.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Amo lɔre ko na yeini ko ke amo tei to. Amo ná yeini a boŋe se a ke kolo na lana to, lwarem yerane mo tui.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Amo bochare ne a tiini a jege wopwolo de Wɛ ni-kaana yam.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Amo nam lɔre we a yera yam mo lage se ya taa tɔge chwoŋa kadwoŋi. Amo yera yam na ke tei to mo lage ko chɔge amo boboŋa yam na lage chwoŋa kalo to. Konto maa peene amo, ye a yera yam jege se ya taa tɔge tusim.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Lɛɛro jege-ne. Amo yera yam lage se ya pa toone ja-ne. Wɔ mo wó wane o vere-ne ya jeŋa ne?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Amo ke Wɛ lei dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Wonto mo wó jwoŋi-ne. Ko na ye konto amo tei ne to, amo boboŋa yam mo pae se a sɛ Wɛ ni-kaana yam. A nam na ye logo baŋa nabiinu to mo pae se a tɔge tusim.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Konto to, balo na me de Yezu Krista to daa bá ga bora Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pae dé jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Konto dam dem mo pɛ dé na verem tusim dedaane toone jeŋa ne.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Debam na ye nabiina ye dé bwona to mo pae se dé ware Wɛ nia yam dé taa tɔga. Konto ŋwaane dé daa bá wane dé na chega Wɛ tei ne o nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane. Mo kokuri pa se Wɛ déem toŋe o tete Bu se o ba o ji nabiinu, ye o nye de nabiina balo tusim na wae-ba to. O ma ba o te nabiina wɛleera saarem ŋwaane, se o ma chɔge tusim na jege dam delo nabiina baŋa ne to.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno boboŋa ná tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo nabiina fera na zoore to, toone wó ja konto tu Wɛ yiga ne. Wolo boboŋa nam na tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom chwoŋa to wó na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne de bochare-zuru.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔno ná tɔge nabiina boboŋ-yɔɔro tem, kotu ye Wɛ dono mo, o na ba sɛ o tɔge Wɛ nia yam ye o ware-ya o ke to ŋwaane.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Balo maama na tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo nabiina boboŋa na lage to nam bá wane ba pwoli Wɛ wo.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Abam nam ba tɔge nabiina boboŋ-yɔɔro na lage kolo to. Ko ná ye chega we Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo á bochara ne, á wó ta‑á tɔge ko na bere abam chwoŋa kalo to mo. Yezu Krista Sin-laao kom nam na tere nɔɔno wolo tei ne to seene o dae Yezu nyem.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista nam na wo abam tei ne to, á jworru tem mo jege ŋwea Wɛ yiga ne, á na jege chega o tei ne to ŋwaane. Á yera yam nam jege se ya te, tusim na tei-ya to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Yet God raised Jesus to life! God's Spirit now lives in you, and he will raise you to life by his Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo bi Yezu toone wone. Konto ŋwaane, o Sin-laao kom ná wo á bochara ne, Wɛ wó pa se abam yera yalo na jege se ya te to jwoori ya na ŋwea, o Sin-laao kom na wo á bochara ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Balo maama na pae se Wɛ Sin-laao kom taa tei-ba to mo ye Wɛ bia.

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Amo boŋe we, dé na yeini dé na yaara yalo leile to bá wane ya taa mae de paare delo Wɛ na wó pa dé na o tei ne to.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Wɛ na naane wonnu telo maama to tiini te jege teena se te na dɛ dem Wɛ na wó pa o bia bam lɔre jaja to.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Dé yei we wonnu maama tɔge daane te nae cham de zem maama. Te maa cheigi maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge-te to, ne kaane puga na virigi ye o kone tei to.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Wɛ na jwoŋi debam to, ko pae dé jege teena o tei ne. Dé nam ná maŋe dé na kolo dé ya na jege teena ko ŋwaane to, dé daa bá taa jege ko teena. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba teena kolo o na maŋe o na to.

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Dé nam ta wo nɛ Wɛ wo-laaro tem maama, ye dé jege teena se dé na-te. Konto ŋwaane, dé zuri dé yera dé cheigi se te maŋa kam laam yi.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom de nam woli debam, dé na bwona to ŋwaane. Debam yeiri dé na wó lwoori Wɛ se ko maŋe tei to. O Sin-laao kom nam lwoori‑o o pa debam. Ko vuvuna mo dé tei ne ye botare-bia tera de wone.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam yeini o buŋi dé bochara wone ye o lɔre dé boboŋa na ye tei to. O ta kwori o yei o Sin-laao kom boboŋa yam, kolo ŋwaane Sin-laao kom tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to, ye o lwoori Wɛ o pa debam balo na ye o nɔɔna to.

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na swoi Wɛ to, dé yei we Wɛ yeini o toŋe o woli-ba wonnu maama baŋa ne se lanyerane taa tui. Wɛ ke konto o pa balo o na maŋe o jege ba boboŋa ye o bwoŋi-ba se ba taa tɔge‑o to.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem maŋe o jege banto boboŋa o bochare ne faŋa faŋa, ye o daare o kuri-ba se ba laam ba ba taa nye de o Bu wom na ye tei to. Konto maa wó pa Wɛ Bu Yezu na nyaana dedɛ, balo de na ye Wɛ bia ye ba saŋe o kwaga to.

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, dé nam wó ta bɛ mo? Wɛ ná zege debam kwaga ne, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o chɔge debam.

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Wɛ wo cheiŋi o tete Bu wom de yaara, ye o nam sɛ o ke‑o nabiina jeŋa ne se o te debam maama ŋwaane. Wɛ na zeini debam konto to, o ta wó kwei wo-laaro maama o pa debam zɛɛra o woli de o Bu wom.

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ŋɔɔne taane o chɔge debam balo Wɛ na kuri to. Ko ye Wɛ tete mo pae dé jege chega.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pa se dé ga bora Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye Yezu Krista tete mo tega debam ŋwaane, ye o ta jwoori o bi toone wone pa se o na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne. O laam maa jege paare Wɛ jazem seeni ye o lwoori Wɛ o pa debam.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o chɔge debam de Yezu Krista swono kom daane. Yaara wó wane ya chɔge debam konto na? Naa cham mo, naa nabiina bɛɛsem, naa kana, naa yiniga, naa keim-chɛɛre, naa tigura mo? Aawo, ya bá wane.

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Debam na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to mo pae dé da toone tei dé kɛ dɛ maama wone. Ba kwei debam ba ma ji pei selo ba na lage ba go to mo.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam na maŋe o jege debam swono to, wo-chɛɛro tento kolokolo bá wane debam te chɔge, ye dé wae dé di dam te maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Amo na ye Yezu Krista nyem to, a ŋɔɔne chega mo ye ko dae vwa. Wɛ Sin-laao kom na wo a bochare ne to mo pae a yɔɔre a yei we,

english_verse: They are the descendants of Israel, and they are also God's chosen people. God showed them his glory. He made agreements with them and gave them his Law. The temple is theirs and so are the promises that God made to them.
translation_verse: Ba ye Isarele dwi tiina mo. Ko ye banto mo Wɛ déem pɛ ba ji o bia, ye o bere-ba o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom. O ma gwoni ni o pa-ba, ye o daare o ke o nia yam ba jeŋa ne. O ma bere-ba ba na jege se ba taa zuli‑o tei to. O ma pwooli se o taa nii ba baŋa ne.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ba kuri nwoŋi debam nabaaro Isarele bia fuga-balei bam wone mo. Ba na loge Yezu Krista logo baŋa ne to, ko ye banto dwi tiina wone mo o nwoŋi. Wonto mo ye wonnu maama Tu Wɛ wom na maŋe se o taa jwoŋi teem taa wuu to. Ameena.
