english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Isarele dwi tiina bam na ve Wɛ to nam ba bere we Wɛ na gwoni o ni se o ke kolo to jigi kafɛ. Kokuri to, ko dae we Isarele dwi tiina bam maama mo seene ba ye Isarele tiina chekke Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Ko bere we, ko dae bia balo maama ba na loge to mo ye Wɛ bia chekke. Ko nam ye bia balo Wɛ na pwooli kampwola kam ba ŋwaane ye ba laam lo-ba to mo seene ba ye Abaraham dwi tiina chekke.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ déem pwooli we, “Maŋa kam ná yia, amo wó jwoori a ba, dedaane Sara laam jege bakeira o jeŋa ne.”

english_verse: Even before they were born or had done anything good or bad, the Lord told Rebekah that her older son would serve the younger one. The Lord said this to show he makes his own choices and it wasn't because of anything either of them had done.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam Rabɛka ta na wo loge o bia balei bam, ye ba daa ta wo maŋe se ba ke keim-laaro naa keim-balwaaro to, Wɛ déem tage ded‑o o we, “Zembaaro wom mo wó taa toŋe o pa o nyaane wom.” Ko ke konto se Wɛ na kuri-ba daane tei to mo tɔge o boboŋa na maŋe ya ja tei to. Ko bere we Wɛ kurim dem tɔge o na bwoŋi wolo wom se o taa ye o nyem to mo, ye ko dae nɔɔno wom kikia ŋwaane.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Wɛ na tage kolo to popone o tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Amo jege Jakob swono, ye a chuli Esawu ni taane.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ déem tage de Moses o we: “Amo wó duri wolo maama a na kuri to yibwona, ye a ke zaane kotu yuu ne.”

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Wɛ déem na tage kolo de Ejipti Pa-faro wom to popone o tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Woŋo kolo ŋwaane amo na pɛ chwoŋa se n yere zaŋe to mo ye se a wane a tɔge nmo ŋwaane a bere nɔɔna amo dam dem na mae tei to, ye a daare a jwoŋi yere logo baŋa jei maama ne.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Ko bere we Wɛ duri balo ŋwaŋa nenɛɛne o na boŋe tei to mo, ye o daare o pa badwonna taa jege yi-dɛɛre nenɛɛne o na boŋe tei to.

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Abam dedoa wae o bwei amo we, “Bɛŋwaane mo Wɛ nam yaale nɔɔna de ba kikia? Dé bá wane dé ve keim delo Wɛ na jaane boboŋa se dé ke to.”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Nmo nam na ye nabiinu to, n ye wɔ mo se n jwoori n bwei Wɛ? Ko ná ye kamɔgɔ, ko bá wane ko bwei ko mɔro wom we, “Bɛ mo ye n ke-ne tento dwoŋi?”

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye konto mo de Wɛ. O ná lage se o bere nɔɔna o ban-zɔŋɔ kom de o dam dem na mae tei to, o jege chwoŋa se o peene o bane mo de balo na chuchugi o bane ye ba maŋe de chɔgem to.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Wɛ maŋe o tɔge Hosea baŋa ne o we: “Nɔɔna balo ya na dae amo nyem to mo a laam wó bwoŋi-ba we, amo nɔɔna bam. Dwi tiina balo amo ya na ba jege ba swono to mo a laam wó bwoŋi-ba we, amo nɔn-swonnu tem.

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Jeiga kalo Wɛ ya na tage de-ba we, ba dae o nɔɔna to, jeiga kam konto ne nɔɔ mo ba laam wó bwoŋi-ba we, Ŋwea Tu Wɛ wom bia bam.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Izaya de déem ŋɔɔne Isarele tiina bam taane o we: “Isarele tiina bam ná maŋe ba daga, ne naneo ni kasolo bia na ye tei, ba fenfee yerane mo wó na verem.

english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane Baŋa Wɛ wó ke lela mo o pa se nabiina maama lɔre o boboŋa na jaane se o waare-ba tei to ye taane daa tera.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Ko ta ye nenɛɛne Izaya na maŋe o ta tei o we: “Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ ya ná wo daare debam badaara o yage dé dwi dem ne, dé dwi dem ya ti mo, ne ko déem na ke Sodom teo tiina tei to. Dé ya wó ji ne Gomora teo déem na ye tei to.”

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Dé nam wó ta bɛ mo? Dé lɔre we dwi-gɛ tiina balo ya na ba kwaane ba nii se ba na chega Wɛ tei ne to laam seene ba jege chega Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye ba na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ to ŋwaane mo ba nɛ chega kam konto.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Bɛ mo ye ba nam ga? Kolo ŋwaane banto boŋe se ba na chega mo ba keim-laaro ŋwaane ye ko dae ba na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to. Ba na ve Wɛ konto to nye de ba mage ba naga de kandwɛ delo na pae nɔɔna chɔɔle ba toe to ye ba seene ba to tega ne.

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ko maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nii-na! Amo lage a chwi kandwɛ mo Zion ne. De maa ye pelɔrɔ kolo na cheili pa nɔɔna gare-ko ba to tega ne to mo. Ko daare nɔɔno ná ke o wo-dedoa de wolo na ye kandwɛ dem to, chaveera bá fɔge ya ja kotu.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo tiini a jege teena a bochare ne we Isarele dwi tiina wó na verem, ye a yeini a lwoori Wɛ a pa-ba ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Yezu Krista mo pɛ se Wɛ nia yam tɔgem chwoŋa kam laam ba ka kweeli, pa se balo maama na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ to laam na chega o tei ne.

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Moses déem popone ko na ye tei ye nɔɔna wae ba na chega Wɛ tei ne o nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane. Moses popone we, “Wolo kikia na tɔge Wɛ nia yam to wó na ŋwea ya baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: “Daa‑n yé bwei nenɛɛne, wɔ mo wó wane o zo tega kuri ne?” Dé ba jege se dé vo dáane dé pa Yezu bi toone wone o ba.

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Ko nam popone we, “Ko ba dana se n wane n lɔre Wɛ kwora kam. Ka maŋe ka wo nmo tei ne, de nmo ni ne, de nmo bochare ne.” Kwora kam konto zege wo-dedoa yera ne mo, ye kanto mo dé jege dé bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ka maa we, nmo ná tɛ jaja we Yezu mo ye Teiru wom, ye nmo ná sɛ de n bochare maama we Wɛ seene o bi‑o toone wone, Wɛ wó jwoŋi nmo ŋwea.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Dam Tu wom, chaveera bá ja kotu.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Ko ye bedwe mo nɔɔna maama tei ne, Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina bam de. Ba maama Teiru ye dedoa mo, ye o yeini o swɛ balo maama na lwoori zeinim o tei ne to swolim.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, “Wolo maama ná bwoŋi dé Teiru wom yere o ma lwoori zeinim, kotu wó na verem.”

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye konto to, nɔɔna ná wo ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista, ba wó ke tɛ mo ba lwoori zeinim o tei ne? Ba ta wó wane ba ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o ye ba wo nigi o kwora na? Ba nam wó wane ba ni o kwora ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tɔɔle-ka o bere-ba na?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam wó ke tɛ mo o vo o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam o bere-ba ye Wɛ wo toŋe‑o? Ko nam popone we, “Balo na jege kwor-ywoŋa ba beeri ba bwooli to veiŋa jege ywoni mo.”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we nɔɔna maama mo sɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Izaya déem tage o we, “Dé Teiru Wɛ, debam na tɔɔle kwora kalo to, wɔ mo sɛ we ka ye chega?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Amo lage a bwei a nii, Isarele tiina bam wo nigi Wɛ ni taane dem mo na? Ba seene ba ni-de. Ko ye chega mo Wɛ tontoŋena bam seeni we: “Ba kwora kam yi logo baŋa jei maama mo. Ba ni taane jage de yi dɔŋɔ ni maama.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Amo ta lage a bwei a nii, Isarele tiina bam wo lɔre taane dem kuri na? Ba nam lɔre. Da-yiga to, Wɛ déem tɔge Moses ŋwaane o ta de-ba o we, “Amo wó tɔge dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ye nɔn-yɔɔro to baŋa ne a ma pa se abam taa jege kazwe á zwe de-ba, ye á bane zaŋe ba ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Izaya de déem jege baare ye o ta Wɛ taane o we: “Ko ná ye balo na wo beeri a jei se ba lɔre-ne to, banto mo tu ba lɔre amo. A ta ma le a tete a bere balo na wo bwei amo bwia to.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Isarele tiina bam, Wɛ maa we, “Dɛ wone maama amo tei a jeŋa se a zaane a nɔɔna bam, de ba na maŋe ba ye zwabani-nyena tei to de.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Amo ta lage a bwei a nii, ko bere we Wɛ ve o tete nɔɔna bam maama o yage mo na? Kɔtaa! Nii-na, amo tete mo ye Isarele dwi tu. Abaraham mo ye a nabaaro, ye a nwoŋi Benjamin dwi dem wone.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Wɛ seene o wo ve o nɔɔna balo o na maŋe o jege ba boboŋa boboa ne to. Abam maŋe á yei Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere Elija taane tei to. O déem lwoori Wɛ se o waare Isarele tiina bam,

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: ye o we, “Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, ba go nmo sampwori sem, ye ba daare ba chochoge nmo kaanem bimbina yam. Ko laam ta daare amo yerane mo ye ba kwaane se ba go-ne.”

english_verse: But the Lord told Elijah, “I still have
translation_verse: Wɛ nam leiri‑o o we bɛ mo? O we, “Amo nam le nɔɔna morro terepɛ (

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Ko bere we Isarele tiina bam wo nɛ chega kalo ba na seene ba yia se ba na Wɛ tei ne to. Kɔgɔ kolo Wɛ na kuri to nam mo nɛ-ka. Balo na daare to nam maa jege yi-dɛɛre.

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye bedwe mo de zem maama. Kɔgɔ fenfee ta mo daare, Wɛ na tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane o kuri balo to.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam na dɛ o zaane dem baŋa ne o kuri-ba to, ko bere we ko dae ba kikia ŋwaane. Ko ya ná ye ba kikia ŋwaane mo o kuri-ba, ko bá taa ye o zaane dem mo o pɛ-ba zɛɛra.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: Ko ke-ba ne ko na popone tei Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Wɛ mo pɛ se ba tiini ba dɔ ba kɛ. De zem maama, ba yia ta ba nae, ye ba zwa de kwareme Wɛ chega kam seeni.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: David de déem tage ba taane o we, “Wɛ wó pa se ba kuri wodi-fɔrɔ kom jwoori ko ja chɔgem ko ba ba baŋa ne, ne kalanchogo na jaane-ba ye ba to tega ne tei to,

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se ba yia dwei ye ba daa ware ba nae. Wɛ wó pa se ba yera chɛ de yaara taa wuu.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Amo ta lage a bwei a nii, Isarele tiina bam na chɔɔle ba to konto to, ko bere we ba daa bá na chwoŋa se ba jwoori ba zaŋe mo na? Kɔtaa! Banto na chɔge Wɛ chega kam tei to mo pɛ se dwi-gɛ tiina na chwoŋa se Wɛ jwoŋi-ba. Wɛ ke konto se ko pa Isarele tiina bam taa jege kazwe ba ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Ko ye abam dwi-gɛ tiina bam mo a tɛ taane dento. Amo na ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe se a ta o taane a bere dwi-gɛ tiina bam to tiini ko ye totoŋ-kamunu amo tei ne.

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: Amo kwaane a toŋe se ko wane ko pa amo dwonna Isarele tiina bam taa jege puseŋa, se a laam jwoŋi ba badwonna a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ve banto o yage to, ko pɛ se logo baŋa dwi tiina laam ba ba fɔge de Wɛ. Ko daare maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó jwoŋi-ba to, ko wó taa nye de twa na jwoori ba na ŋwea tei to mo.

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Dé yei we, nmo ná dɛ yiga n fɔ bworobworo n tiŋi n pa Wɛ, ko chichworo kom na daare to daa ta ye o nyem. Ko woli da, tio kuu ná ye Wɛ nyem, ko nɛ sem maama de ye o nyem mo.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam nye de Olivi tio ba na jeiri gaare wone to. Ko ye nenɛɛne Wɛ bwori tio kom konto nɛ sedaara o yage, ye o daare o kwei Olivi tio kolo na wo gaao wone to naga kadwoŋi o twoŋi o gwaane nɛ sedwonna sem wone. Nmo wolo na ye dwi-gɛ tu to nye de naga kam konto mo. Nmo laam wori ye n tɔge n nae tio kom kugu kom nyoa kam.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Nmo nam yé ta‑n gwooni nɛ selo na bwori se yage to. Nmo ná boŋe se n bere n tete konto, se n ta‑n yei we, ko dae nmo mo pae tio kom kugu kom wori ye ko zega. Ko ye kugu kom mo jege nmo ko teila.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Nmo nam wó wane n ta we, “Wɛ bwori nɛ sedaara sem o yage tega ne se ko pa amo mo na laŋa a twoŋi da.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Ko seene ko ke konto mo. Wɛ nam bwori nɛ sem konto o yage ba na wo sɛ‑o to ŋwaane. Nmo nam na nɛ jeiga to tɔge n wo-dedoa kam yerane ŋwaane mo. Nam yé ta‑n boŋe kamunim n pa n tete, se n daare n kɔre Wɛ de foone.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ wo sɛ se o yage tio kom tete nɛ sem se jei ne. Nmo ná ba jege wo-dedoa ded‑o, o bá yage nmo de.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Ko maama bere Wɛ na jege nɔɔna ŋwaŋa tei, de o na daare o vaŋe nɔɔna zwa tei to mo. Ko ná ye balo na ke ba chɔge to, o vaŋe ba zwa mo. Ko daare nmo, n ná tɔge o ŋwaŋa kam na ye tei to, o wó taa jege nmo ŋwaŋa. Nmo nam ná yage Wɛ ŋwaŋa kam, o laam wó bwori nmo de o yage tega ne.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam nam ná jwoori ba ke ba wo-dedoa ba sɛ Wɛ, ba laam wó jwoori ba na ba jeiga. Wɛ wó wane o jwoori o twoŋi-ba da.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na ye dwi-gɛ tu to nye de naga kalo Wɛ na gwoni Olivi tio kolo na wo gaao ne to yera ne. O ma kwei nmo o twoŋi Olivi tio kolo na jeiri gaare ne to yera ne ye ko dae nmo tete kuu jei. Konto ŋwaane ko bá taa chana Wɛ tei ne se o jwoori o twoŋi nɛ selo o ya na bwori to se tete kuu kom jei ne.

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo lage se á lɔre Wɛ chega kalo déem na seigi to mo. Abam ná seene á lɔre konto, á daa bá ta‑á boŋe kamunim á pa á tete. Ko na ye tei to, leile konto Isarele tiina badaara jege yi-dɛɛre mo, ye ko bá taa ye konto taa taa. Ko nam wó taa ye konto se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam dwi-gɛ tiina balo na sɛ Wɛ to kɔgɔ kom ná puli ko ti.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Ko ná ke konto dwoŋi, Isarele tiina kɔgɔ kom maama laam wó na verem, ne ko na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Vereno wom wó zaŋe Zion ne o ba. O maa wó pa se Jakob dwi tiina bam yage ba wɛleera kikia yam.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Amo Wɛ wó ke ni-gwonim dento a pa-ba we, amo wó saare ba wɛleera yam a yage.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Isarele tiina bam na ve Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to, ba ye Wɛ dona mo, ye konto laam pa se abam dwi-gɛ tiina bam na wolim. Ko daare Wɛ na kuri nɔɔna se ba taa ye o nyem tei to seeni, o jege Isarele tiina bam swono, o déem na gwoni ni de ba nabaara bam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ba zae o boboŋa de o na kuri nɔɔna ye o ke-ba lanyerane tei to.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Abam dwi-gɛ tiina bam déem ya ve Wɛ ye á laam ba á jwoŋi o zeinim dem, Isarele tiina bam na ve Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam pɛ se nɔɔna maama wo yi-dɛɛre jeŋa ne mo, se o laam wane o taa jege ba maama ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: Maane-na á nii Wɛ zaane dem na tiini de daga tei! O boboŋa maa tiini ya lira, de o yeino kom de. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre o boboŋa na jaane tei to naa o lɔre chwei selo o na tɔge to.

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: “Wɔ mo yi se o wane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa, naa o bere‑o o na wó ke tei?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wó wane o kwei o woŋo o ma jene Wɛ, se Wɛ ŋwe o pa kotu?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wonnu maama nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo, ye o jege te maama o nia. Te maama maa jege kuri te pa‑o. Wɛ maŋe de zula se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, Wɛ na tiini o jege abam ŋwaŋa konto to, a lwoori abam se á kwei á tete á ke kaanem á pa Wɛ ye á daa ta ŋwe, se ko pwoli o wo lanyerane. Konto mo ye zulim delo na maŋe se á ke á pa‑o to.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Á yé pa se á boboŋa taa tɔge nabiina chwei sem. Pa-na se Wɛ pipiri abam de o na pɛ á jege boboŋ-doora tei to. Abam laam wó ba á lɔre Wɛ boboŋa na lage se á ke kolo to, ye á lɔre we ko tiini ko lana chekke ye ko pwoli o wo.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ-ne o zaane dem se a taa ye o tontoŋeno to, a lage a ta de abam maama se á yé ta‑á boŋe kamunim á pa á tete se á ta‑á dwoi á na maŋe á ye tei to. Á nam boŋe á nii se á lɔre totoŋe delo Wɛ na lage se á ke to, se ko maŋe de o na pɛ abam dedoa dedoa jege wo-dedoa ye ka mae tei to.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Nabiinu yera ye woŋo dedoa mo ye ya laam pɔɔre teiri teiri. Ya daa maama jege ka totoŋa mo.

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye bedwe mo de debam balo na me de Yezu Krista to. Dé tiini dé daga ye dé nam ye kɔgɔ dedoa. Debam maama dedoa dedoa maa toŋa dé woli daane.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛɛra yalo dé na jwoŋi to ye teiri teiri mo, se ko tɔge Wɛ na ke zaane debam yuu ne tei to. Wɛ ná pɛ wolo wae o tɔɔle o kwora kam, konto tu jege se o tɔge o na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to o ma tɔɔle-ka.

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Wɛ ná pɛ wolo wae o pa se o dwonna bochara peini tega ne, o jege se o taa ke konto mo. Wolo na pɔɔre o wonnu o pae o dwonna to jege se o ma o wo-ywoŋo mo o woli-ba lanyerane. Wolo nam na ye nɔɔna yiga tu to jege se o taa seene o yia ko ŋwaane mo. Wolo nam na duri o dwonna yiniga to jege se o taa ke de wopwolo mo.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Á yé ta‑á jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ de á na jege nɔɔna swono tei to. Nam ta‑á chuli-na wo-lwanno maama, se á daare á ta‑á jege wo-laaro á bochara ne.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Á na ye nu-bia Yezu ŋwaane to, se á ta‑á jege da-swono konto dwoŋi. Á ta ta‑á swoi da-zula.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Á na jege Wɛ teena tei to, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo ko ŋwaane. Cham ná tu abam baŋa, se á vɔ pu-dɛa. Kwaane-na á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ lanyerane.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Pɔɔre-na á wonnu á pa balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye yiniga jege-ba to. Ta‑á jeeri-na nɔɔna á sam ne lanyerane.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege abam ba bɛɛse to, se á sɔɔle Wɛ swolim á pa-ba. Á nam yé sɔɔle lwarem á chɔge-ba.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na boboŋe dedwe á pa daane. Á yé ta‑á bere á tete. Gwooni-na á tete se á ta‑á zoore de nabwona. Á yé ta‑á boŋe kamunim á pa á tete.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na lanyerane se á ta‑á zoore dedaane nɔɔno maama de ywoni, ne á na wae tei to.

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ta popone we: “Nmo dono kana ná wɔe, se n pa‑o wodiu se o di. Na-nyɔm ná jege‑o, se n pa‑o na se o nyɔ. Kikia yam konto wó pa se chaveera tiini ya ja‑o, ne Wɛ zeiŋi mini mo o yuu ne to.”

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Abam nam yé pa se lwarem wane abam. Ta‑á tɔge-na keim-laaro se te wane lwarem dam te chɔge.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Abam maama jege se á sɛ á pa dedɛɛra balo na tei á teene dem to, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔn-nɔɔno ba jege dam se o taa tei nɔɔna ye Wɛ wo pɛ kotu chwoŋa. Dedɛɛra balo na wora to ye Wɛ mo tiŋi-ba.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná ve dedɛɛra bam konto, kotu boŋe se o chɔge Wɛ boboŋa yam mo. Balo na ke konto dwoŋi to wó na chɔgem.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Dedɛɛra bam nam ba pae se foone jege balo na ke keim-laaro to. Foone nam wó ja balo na tɔge keim-balwaaro to mo. Nmo ná ba lage se foone taa jege‑m de dedɛɛra bam, n jege se n ta‑n ke keim-laaro mo se ko pa n na zula ba tei ne.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam tiŋi dedɛɛra bam se ba taa toŋe ba pa‑o abam fɔgem ŋwaane mo. Abam nam ná ke wo-balwaaro, se á ta‑á kɔre foone, kolo ŋwaane dedɛɛra bam seene ba jege dam se ba taa maa chɔge nɔɔna. Banto mo ye balo Wɛ na tiŋi se ba tɔge o ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane ba ma waare balo na ke lwarem to.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo á jege se á sɛ ba ni. Ko ye abam boboŋa na pae á lɔre we á tɔge chega chwoŋa to ŋwaane mo, se ko dae á na kɔre Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom to yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Ko ta tɔge konto ŋwaane mo á wó ta‑á ŋwe lampwoo. Dedɛɛra bam toŋe ba pa Wɛ mo de ba na seene ba yia ba totoŋa yam baŋa ne to.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam bere we, “N yé ke kabwoŋa, n yé go nɔɔno, n yé ŋɔ, n yé pa n yi su n dwonna wonnu.” Nia yanto dedaane Wɛ nia yam maama nam tɔge ni dedwe mo. Dento dem nam mo we, “Ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n na swoi n tete tei to.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Nmo ná jege n dwoŋi swono, n daa‑n bá‑n wane n ke‑o n chɔge. Wɛ nia yam maama nam zege swono kom konto yera ne mo.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ta‑á ke-na konto, se abam yei we Wɛ maŋa kam yia. Ta‑á cho-na á tete se dɔɔm yé taa jege abam. Maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó ba o jwoŋi dé ŋwea to daare fee se ka yi, ye ko daa dae nenɛɛne maŋa kalo dé déem na bobo dé ke dé wo-dedoa ded‑o to.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé tɔge chwoŋa se ko maŋe de balo na wo wea pwooni ne to. Á nam pa-na dé yage paweeni, de sa-nyɔre, de bwoŋa, de wo-digiru kikia maama. Á yé ta‑á jaane daane naa á ta‑á ke wo-goo daane.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Pa-na se abam ŋwea dedaane dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwea taa ye bedwe. Nam yé ta‑á boŋe á na wó ke tei se á ta‑á tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo á fera na zoore to.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye o boboŋa ta ná ba dana Wɛ yiga ne, se á jwoŋi konto tu lanyerane. Á nam yé mage ni-kantɔgɔ ded‑o de o na boŋe tei to.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wó taa wora o boboŋa na dana o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane pa se o ba chuli kolokolo dim. Ko daare nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa na ba dana de o wo-dedoa kam to wó taa chuli nɔna.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Nmo ye wɔ mo se n yaale nɔɔno wodwoŋi tontoŋeno kikia? Ko ye o tu wom mo jege se o nii, o ke chega naa o wo ke. Wolo na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ke lanyerane, dé Teiru wom na wae o pa o zege de chega to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wó taa wora o na pɔɔre dɛ o pa de dwoi da yadwonna. Ko daare nɔɔno wodwoŋi maa wora o na ba kuri da yam daane. Nɔɔno maama nam na boŋe tei de tei to, o jege se o taa zege ko baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na kuri dɛ se de taa ye dɛ-kamunu to yeini o ke konto dé Teiru wom ŋwaane mo. Wolo na di woŋo maama to ke konto o ma zuli dé Teiru wom, o na yeini o ke Wɛ lei wodiu kom baŋa ne to ŋwaane. Wolo nam na ba di woŋo maama to de ke konto o ma zuli dé Teiru wom ye o ke Wɛ lei.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Debam wolowolo ba ŋwe o tete yerane ŋwaane. Wolo ná tega, ko bá taa ye o tete yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Dé ze ná ŋwe, dé ŋwe dé Teiru wom ŋwaane mo. Dé nam ná tega, ko ta ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Mo kokuri, dé ná ŋwe naa dé ná tega, dé ta ye dé Teiru wom nyem mo.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista déem na tega ye o jwoori o bi o na ŋwea to, ko ye se o na chwoŋa se o taa ye balo na tege to Teiru, de nɔn-ŋwena de Teiru wom mo.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, bɛ mo ye n yaale n nu-bu? Ko daare nmo, bɛ mo ye n gwooni n nu-bu? Debam maama nam wó ba dé zege Wɛ yiga ne se o di debam taane.

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Ko bere we debam maama wó ba dé zege Wɛ yiga ne se dé tole dé kwora dé bere‑o.

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, dé daa yé taa yaale dé dwonna yuu. Nam pa se á boboŋa ja se á yé ke kolo na wó pa á nu-bu wo chɔge naa ko pa o tusi to.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Amo na me de dé Teiru Yezu to, amo yei lanyerane we wodiu tera ko tete na jege digiru Wɛ tei ne. Nɔɔno nam ná pɛ se woŋo kolo ye wo-digiru, ko seene ko ye wo-digiru ko pa nɔɔno wom konto mo.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Yé pa se nɔɔna na chwoŋa se ba yaale woŋo kolo na lana nmo tei ne to.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Debam na ye Wɛ paare dem nɔɔna tei to ba tɔge wodiiru dim ŋwaane. Ko nam tɔge keim-laaro ŋwaane mo, de bochare-zuru de wopwolo ŋwaane, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pae debam tei to.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam ná sɛ o tɔge Yezu Krista konto dwoŋi, konto tu wó pwoli Wɛ wo ye nɔɔna de wó pa‑o chega.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane pa-na dé kwaane dé taa ke kolo maama na pae nɔɔna jege ywoni daane ye ko fɔge-ba Wɛ chwoŋa ne to.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Yé pa se wodiiru dim chɔge totoŋa yalo Wɛ na ke de nɔɔna to. Wodiiru dwi maama maŋe de dim mo. Nmo nam ná di kolo na wó pa se n dwoŋi wo chɔge ko ŋwaane to, se n yage wodiu kom konto dim.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ko lana se n yé ke kolo maama na wó pa se n nu-bu tusi Wɛ chwoŋa ne to, ko ná ye nɔm dim, naa sana nyɔɔm, naa kolo maama.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Nmo boboŋa ná jaane tei n wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane, se n pa ko taa ye nmo de Wɛ laŋa ne. Nɔɔno wolo ná yei kolo na lana se o ke to ye o ba jege boboŋa yalei ko ŋwaane, konto tu yuu ywomma.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno wolo ná jege bobwea de o na di wodiu kolo to, konto tu bá na bora Wɛ tei ne. Ko bere we o ba jege wo-dedoa o dim dem wone. Kikia yalo maama na ba tɔge wo-dedoa keim to ye wɛleera mo.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Debam balo boboŋa na dana Wɛ yiga ne to jege se dé taa woli balo boboŋa ta na ba dana to mo, de ba boboŋa na daane-ba tei to. Dé yé taa tɔge dé tete boboŋa keim.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Debam maama nam jege se dé taa ke kolo na tɔge dé dwoŋi boboŋa na lage tei to mo, ye dé ke‑o lanyerane se ko pa o fɔge o tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Yezu Krista tete nam wo lage lanyerane o pa o tete. Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere Yezu taane de ko na we, “Nɔɔna na jege nmo ba twea tei to mo jwoori ko tui amo baŋa.”

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo ye wolo na pae nɔɔna pu-dɛa de baare to, ye wonto wó pa abam taa jege boboŋe dedwe daane, ne Yezu Krista na lage tei to.

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: Ko laam wó pa se abam maama sɛ daane ye á jege ni dedwe á ma‑á zuli Wɛ wom na ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo to.

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Jwoŋi-na daane lanyerane, ne Yezu Krista na jwoŋi abam tei to. Konto wó pa se Wɛ na zula.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Amo nam tɛ abam we, Yezu Krista déem tu se o toŋe o pa Juu tiina bam mo Wɛ chega kam ŋwaane, se ko pa Wɛ na pwooli de ba nabaara bam tei to taa jege chega.

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: Konto ma kwori ko pa dwi-gɛ tiina bam de ba ba zuli Wɛ, o na jege ba ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere tei ko we: “Amo wó tei nmo, se dwi-gɛ tiina taa yei n ni ne. A ta wó leeni a zeiŋi nmo yere.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Ko ta popone we: “Abam dwi-gɛ tiina bam, tɔge-na de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama se á ta‑á chaka de wopwolo.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ko ta we: “Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama, ba-na á tei Baŋa Wɛ. Pa-na se nabiina na nwoŋi teene delo maama wone to taa zuli‑o.”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Izaya de déem we: “Jesse dwi dem tu dedoa wó zaŋe o ba se o taa tei logo baŋa teene dem, ye banto wó taa jege teena o tei ne.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ye teena tu, ye wonto wó pa abam taa jege wopwolo de bochare-zuru, á na jege wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam laam wó pa se á na jege teena de Wɛ tei to fɔge ko puli ko ja gaale. Pɔɔl kwaane o toŋe o pa dwi-gɛ tiina

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo tei ne a yei lanyerane we abam tɔge keim-laaro yerane mo ye á tiini á jege yeino dwi maama pa se á wae á bere daane Wɛ chega kam.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Amo nam na popone se a bere abam taana yadwonna tei to, a ke de a wo maama mo se a pa á guli-ya. Amo ke konto de Wɛ na pɛ-ne zaane se a taa toŋe totoŋe delo to.

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: O ta ma pa-ne chwoŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista tontoŋeno dwi-gɛ tiina bam wone. Amo na toŋe a pa Wɛ tei to mo ye a yeini a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam se a wane a jwoŋi dwi-gɛ tiina a ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne, se ba pa o wo pwoli, o Sin-laao kom na fɔge ko kwɛ ba bochara to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, amo na me de Yezu Krista to, a jege chwoŋa se a bere a tete de a na toŋe a pa Wɛ tei to.

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: O ma pa se ba ba ba sɛ Wɛ, de o na dɛ o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane o pa se ba na wo-kenkagela de maana yalo na bere o dam to. Konto dwoŋi mo a zege Jerusalem ne a tole jei maama a vo a yi Ilirikum, ye a tiini a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo na bere Yezu Krista chega kam to.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Amo boboŋa déem ya maŋe ya ja se a kwaane a taa tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam jei selo ne ba ta na wo lɔre Yezu Krista taane dem to mo. Amo ba lage se a taa toŋe a gwaane de totoŋe delo nɔɔno wodwoŋi na maŋe o ke to.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: Ko nam ye ko na maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne tei to we: “Ba ta na wo tage o taane ba bere balo to laam wó ba ba lɔre-de. Balo ta na wo nigi o ŋwa to laam wó ba ba ni o chega kam kuri.”

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo amo gɛ laŋa kuni dedɛ se a ba abam tei.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto amo daa ba jege chwoŋa se a taa toŋe jei sem konto ne. Amo na jege abam fera bena dedɛ se a ba a na abam to,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: amo laam boŋe se a ba maŋa kalo a na wó zaŋe a vo Sapeeni to. Amo lage se a tɔge abam tei, se a wane a di wopwolo de abam da fenfee. Abam laam wó wane á woli-ne se a kwei chwoŋa a kɛ.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna balo na wo Makedonia ne de Akaya ne to mo mɛ ba boboŋa se ba la sabu ba ma woli Yezu nɔɔna balo na wo Jerusalem ne ye yiniga jege-ba to.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ko ye ba tete boboŋa mo ba mɛ ba ke konto. Ko nam maŋe se ba woli-ba konto dwoŋi, kolo ŋwaane Juu tiina bam ya maŋe ba kwei Wɛ wo-laaro mo ba chɛ de dwi-gɛ tiina bam. Konto ŋwaane dwi-gɛ tiina bam jege se ba de daa woli Juu tiina bam de wonnu telo na wó fɔge ba yera to.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Amo ná ti totoŋe dento ye a kwei sabu kom maama a ke nɔɔna bam jeŋa ne, amo laam wó tɔge abam tei se a daare a vo Sapeeni.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we, a ná tu abam tei, amo wó taa jege Yezu Krista dam se o swɛ abam swolim ko ja gaale.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo lage a kwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane, de swono kolo Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ debam to ŋwaane, se á ta‑á woli-ne a totoŋ-chɛɛra wone de á na lwoori Wɛ á pa-ne tei to.

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: Lwoori-na Wɛ se o jwoŋi-ne balo na wo Judea ne ye ba ve Yezu to jeŋa ne, se o daare o pa se Yezu nɔɔna balo na wo Jerusalem ne to sɛ totoŋa yalo amo na wó ke a pa-ba Wɛ ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: Wɛ ná sɛ, amo laam wó wane a ba abam tei de wopwolo, se a daare a na ywoni abam tei ne.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Bochare-zuru Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo abam tei ne. Ameena.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Amo lage a bere abam dé nu-bu Fwibi chega na ye tei to. Wonto ye kaane wolo na toŋe o woli Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Kɛnkaria ne to.

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á jwoŋi‑o lanyerane dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ne ko na maŋe se Yezu nɔɔna taa ke tei to. Á ta‑á pa‑o wolim delo maama o na lage abam tei ne to, kokuri to o maŋe o toŋe o woli nɔɔna dedɛ, de amo de.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Pirisila de Akwila á pa-ne. Banto mo tɔge de amo ye dé toŋe dé pa Yezu Krista.

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: Ba ya sɛ se ba da toone tei amo ŋwaane. Amo nam ke-ba lei, ye ko dae amo yerane, se ko ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo maama na tu ba sɛ Yezu to de mo ke ba lei.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ kom ne to á pa-ne. Jɔɔne-na amo badwoŋ-swono Epanitu, wolo na dɛ yiga o sɛ Yezu Krista Asia teene dem maama wone to.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Mary wolo na tiini o toŋe o pa abam to.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na amo chorro Andarika de Junia. Banto ya tɔge de amo ba wo peena diga ne. Ba maa jege yere lanyerane Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam tei ne, ye ba sɛ Yezu Krista ba daare amo.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Ampaliata wolo a na tiini a jege o swono dé Teiru wom ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Yubana wolo na tɔge de debam o toŋe Yezu Krista totoŋa to, dedaane amo badwoŋ-swono Setache.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Apɛla wolo na jege pu-dɛa de o na tɔge Yezu Krista tei to. Jɔɔne-na Arisobulu sɔŋɔ tiina bam.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na amo choro Hɛrodion. Jɔɔne-na balo na ye Nakisa sɔŋɔ tiina ye ba ye dé Teiru wom nyem to á pa-ne.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Tirifana de Tirifosa, kaana balo na tiini ba toŋe dé Teiru wom totoŋa to. Jɔɔne-na Perisa, kaane wolo de na tiini o toŋe o pa dé Teiru wom ye a jege o swono to.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Rufus wolo na yɔɔre o ye dé Teiru wom nyem to, de o nu wom na ke amo ne o tete bu tei to.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Asinkaritu, de Felegon, de Hɛmesi, de Pataroba, de Hɛmasa, dedaane de nu-bia balo maama na wo ba tei ne to.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Filologa, de Julia, de Neria de o nakɔ, de Olimpa, dedaane Yezu nɔɔna balo maama na wo ba tei ne to.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane á pa Wɛ zula. Yezu Krista kɔgɔ kom na wo jei selo maama ne to de jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lage a kwoori abam se á fɔge á che á tete de balo na pɔɔre nɔɔna pa se ba jaane daane ye ba to tusim wone to. Banto nam mo yaale berem delo abam na maŋe á lɔre to. Konto ŋwaane yɔɔre á nyaŋe-ba.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama yei abam na tɔge Wɛ lanyerane tei to, ye konto mo pa se amo tiini a jege wopwolo abam ŋwaane. Amo nam lage se abam yia poore de kolo na lana to, se á daare á ta‑á yei á tete se lwarem yé chɔge abam.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Wɛ wolo na pae nɔɔna bochare-zuru to bá dáane se o ba o chɔge setaana pɛ wom nenɛɛne á na kwei á nɛ á nɔ o baŋa ne tei to. Dé Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Amo dwoŋi tontoŋeno Timoti de jɔɔne abam. Amo dwi tiina Lukia, de Jason, de Sosipata de jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Amo Tɛtius mo popone Pɔɔl ni taane dento a tiŋi, ye a jɔɔne abam dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Dé ke Wɛ lei. Wonto dam dem mo pae á fɔge á zege lanyerane de á na sɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo amo na tɔɔle Yezu Krista ŋwaane to. Konto mo abam laam tu á lɔre Wɛ chega kalo déem na seigi o wone faŋa faŋa to.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na kuri-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Sɔsɔdane mo tɔge o woli-ne.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amo yeini a ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane, de o na ke zaane abam yuu ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Konto to, Yezu Krista taane dem dé déem na tage de abam to tiini de ji chega abam tei ne.

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: Á nɛ Wɛ pɛɛra yalo maama á na lage to ye á cheigi dé Teiru Yezu Krista se o jwoori o ba se dé na‑o.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Wɛ zege o chega wone mo, ye wonto mo kuri abam se á me de o bu Yezu Krista na ye debam Teiru wom. Korinti tiina jege popɔra daane

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane se á ta‑á jege ni-mɔrɔ, se á yé ta‑á pɔɔre daane. Kwaane-na á ke á boboŋa daane se á ke ni dedwe.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Kokuri, Cheloa ba sɔŋɔ tiina badaara tage de amo we, á mage ni-kantɔgɔ mo daane.

english_verse: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, abam badaara we, á tɔge Pɔɔl mo. Abam badwonna maa we, á tɔge Apolo. Badwonna maa we, ba tɔge Piita. Badwonna de maa we, ba tɔge Yezu Krista.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Á na pɔɔre pɔɔre Yezu Krista konto to, ko jege kuri na? Amo Pɔɔl mo tege dagara kam yuu ne naa wɔ mo? Á na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, á jwoŋi se á sɛ Pɔɔl mo na?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: A ke Wɛ lei, kolo ŋwaane amo wo pɛ abam wolowolo sɛɛm, ko ná dae Kirisipu de Gayus yerane.

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: Konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o ta we, á jwoŋi sɛɛm amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: A ya swei woŋo fee. A pɛ Stefana sɔŋɔ tiina de sɛɛm. Ko daare konto kwaga ne, wolo ná woli da, a daa ware a guli.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yezu Krista toŋe-ne se a taa tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam mo a bere nɔɔna, ye ko dae se a taa pae nɔɔna sɛɛm. A na ŋɔɔne Wɛ taane tei to, ko dae logo baŋa swa mo a maa ŋɔɔna. A ya ná ŋɔɔne konto dwoŋi, a ya wó kwoli Yezu yere, pa se o toone dem dagara kam yuu ne ya bá taa jege chega nɔɔna tei ne. Wɛ swa yam gare nabiina swa

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo we, Yezu toone dem dagara kam yuu ne ye jworim taane mo balo yiga na tera de Wɛ to tei ne. Ko nam ná ye debam balo o na jwoŋi o yage to tei ne, ko bere Wɛ tete dam jaja mo.

english_verse: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó chɔge swa tiina bam boboŋa, ye a daare a pa yi-pore-nyena bam yi-poro kom yaale.”

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Swa tiina swa yam daa jege kuri na? Tɔn-yeena, de nɔɔna balo na yei ŋɔŋa to yi-poro kom jege kuri na? Wɛ nam bere debam we, logo baŋa swa yam maama ye jworim mo.

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Wɛ tete swa ŋwaane mo pae nabiina bá wane ba ma ba tete swa ba lɔre‑o. O nam ke o boboŋa ne se o tɔge taane delo dé na bere nɔɔna ye ba pae de ye jworim to ŋwaane mo o ma jwoŋi balo na sɛ-de to o yage.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye debam, dé ŋɔɔne Yezu Krista wolo na tege dagara yuu ne to taane mo. Taane dem konto maa ye ta-balɔrɔ mo Juu tiina tei ne. De maa ye jworim mo de pae dwi-gɛ tiina.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo nɔɔna na pae ko ye jworim Wɛ tei ne to gare nabiina swa maama, ye kolo na bwomma o tei ne to dana ko dwoi nabiina dam.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, boŋe-na á nii á déem na ye tei ye Wɛ laam ba o kuri abam to. Ko dae á dedɛ yi déem mo poore, nenɛɛne nabiina na lage yi-poro kolo to. Ko dae á dedɛ mo ye dedɛɛra, naa á dedɛ mo nwoŋi naduna sam.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam paale o kuri wonnu telo nabiina na pae te ye wo-jworru to mo, se o ma pa chaveera di swa tiina. O ma kuri wonnu telo nabiina na pae te ye wo-bwonnu to, se o ma pa chaveera di dedɛɛra.

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: O ma daare o kuri wo-yɔɔro de wo-korro telo maama nabiina na gwooni to, se o ma pa wonnu telo nabiina na pae te jege nyɔɔre to ji kafɛ.

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: Wɛ kuri wonnu tento dwoŋi mo, se nabiina yé na chwoŋa se ba taa jege fia o yiga ne.

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a déem na tu abam tei to, amo wo bere a tete se a pa a ni taane de a swa taa gare abam, de a na tɔɔle Wɛ taane dem a bere abam tei to.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: A wo ke a boboŋa ne se a bere abam kolokolo, ko ná dae Yezu Krista de o toone dem dagara kam yuu ne to taane yerane.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: A ŋɔŋa kam de a na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam tei to dae swa mo a kea se a pa á sɛ taane dem. Ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom de o dam mo pɛ se á lɔre we, taane dem ye chega.

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: Konto to, á na ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu to, ko tɔge Wɛ dam dem ŋwaane mo, se ko dae nabiina swa ŋwaane.

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Dé nam yeini dé bere balo boboŋa na kweere to mo swa, ye ko dae nabiina swa, naa logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam swa. Banto wó ba ba ti de ba dam dem maama.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dedɛɛra bam wolowolo nam wo lɔre ya kuri. Ba ya ná yei, ba ya bá ja Wɛ telaao paare tu Yezu ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere o swa yam taane we: “Wɛ fɔge o ke wo-laaro o tiŋi, se o pa balo na swoi‑o to. Nabiina yi wo nɛ wonnu tem konto dwoŋi, ye ba zwa wo nigi te ŋwa. Ba maa ba jege te boboŋa de.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: De ko de, Wɛ dɛ o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo o ma pa dé lɔre wonnu tem konto. Wɛ Sin-laao kom yeini ko da woŋo maama naga mo. Ko maa yei Wɛ wo de o boboŋa de.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo wó wane o lɔre nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa, ye ko dae o tete jworo? Ko nam na ye konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri Wɛ boboŋa, ko ná dae o tete Jworo kom yerane.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Jworo kolo Wɛ na ke debam bochara ne to dae logo baŋa nyem. Ko nam nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo se ko pa dé lɔre wo-laaro telo o na pɛ debam zɛɛra to.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Wɛ Jworo kom na tere wolo bochare ne to ba sɛ se o jwoŋi ko wo-laaro tem. Te maama ye wo-jworru mo o tei ne. O bá wane o lɔre te kuri, kolo ŋwaane ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo bere te kuri chekke.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Wolo maama Wɛ Jworo kom na wo o bochare ne to mo wae o yei woŋo maama kuri chekke. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o mage banto puga o nii.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo, de Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na bere tei we: “Nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre Baŋa Wɛ boboŋa, se o bere‑o o na wó ke tei to.” Dé Teiru Yezu Krista boboŋa dedaane debam boboŋa nam ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo déem na wo abam tei ne to, a ware a ŋɔɔne Wɛ taane de abam ne Jworo kom na wo balo tei ne to. A déem ŋɔɔne de abam nenɛɛne á ye balo logo baŋa wonnu fera na jege-ba to ye á ta ye bu-balɛ mo Yezu Krista tei ne.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: A déem na bere abam wo-mwaalo telo to nye de a pɛ abam nayela mo se á nyɔ. A déem wo pɛ abam wodiu, kolo ŋwaane á déem wo yi ko dim. De zem de, á daa ta wo yi wodiu dim,

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane á ta ye balo logo baŋa wonnu fera na jege-ba to mo. Abam jege wo-goo ye á mage ni-kantɔgɔ daane. Konto bere we logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro fera mo ta jege abam, ye á tɔge balo ta na yeiri Wɛ to kikia. A fɔ vwa na?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Abam dedoa ná tɛ o we, o tɔge Pɔɔl mo, ye wodwoŋi de ná we, o tɔge Apolo mo, ko dae balo na yeiri Wɛ to kikia mo konto na?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Wɔ mo ye Apolo? Wɔ mo ye amo Pɔɔl? Debam maama ye Wɛ tontoŋena mo, ye Wɛ dɛ debam ŋwaane mo o pa á sɛ Yezu Krista. Debam maama toŋe kolo dé Teiru wom na pɛ debam se dé ke to mo.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl mo dugi wonnu abam bochara ne. Apolo ma yage na da, ye te puli. Ko daare ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ te be.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, wolo na dugi to, de wolo na yage na da to maama dae kolokolo. Wɛ yerane mo wae o pae o taane dem ke dam nɔɔna bochara ne.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Wolo na dugi to de wolo na yage na to maama ye bedwe mo. Wɛ wó pa ba maama jwoŋi ba ŋweero ko maŋe de ba na toŋe tei to mo.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Debam maama toŋe daane mo dé pa Wɛ. Abam nye de Wɛ kara kalo dé na dugi ka wone to mo. Abam daa ta nye de diga kalo Wɛ na wora o lɔ to mo.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Wɛ na zeini amo se a toŋe totoŋe delo to ye amo beiri diga kam kuri mo, ne lɔro na yei o totoŋa chekke tei to. Nɔɔno wodwoŋi de maa wora o lɔa o daŋe da. Wolo maama nam na lage se o lɔ o daŋe da to jege se o taa yei o na lɔ tei to mo.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama na toŋe kolo to nam wó ba ko lɔre jaja. Yezu Krista tutuuri dɛ dem ná yia, de wó ba de mini mo. Mini dem mo wó bere nɔɔno maama totoŋa na ye tei.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Balo na mɛ wo-laaro ba lɔ ye mini dem wo wane de di to wó jwoŋi ba ŋweero.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Ko daare balo mini dem na wane de di ba lɔɔm dem to wó ga woŋo maama. Nɔɔna bam tete bá te. Ba nam wó taa nye de mini na di nɔɔno ye o wori tei to mo.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Wɛ Jworo kom na wo abam bochara ne to, á nye de Wɛ tete diga kalo o na zoore ka wone to mo. Á yeiri konto na?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná chɔge Wɛ diga kam, Wɛ wó chɔge kotu de. Wɛ diga kam ye wose mo. Abam tete nam mo ye o diga kam konto.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o gane o tete. Abam wolo ná boŋe we o jege swa, ne zem logo baŋa swa na ye tei to, konto tu jege se o jwoori o ji nɔn-jworo mo, se o laam wane o na swa chekke.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Kokuri logo baŋa swa yam ye jworim mo Wɛ yiga ne. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Wɛ vugimi swa tiina swa yam pa ya jwoori ya ja-ba.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Ko daa ta popone we, “Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o yei swa tiina na boŋe ba ja kolo to. O yei we ba boboŋa yam ye kafɛ mo.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo Pɔɔl, de Apolo, de Piita, debam de ye abam nyem mo. Ko nam ná ye logo baŋa, de ŋwea, de toone, de zem, de jwa de, abam mo tei te maama.

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista nam mo tei abam, ye Wɛ tei Yezu Krista tete de.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná kwei n wonnu n ke nɔɔno jeŋa ne se o taa nii te baŋa ne, ko maŋe se konto tu taa ye jawala tu mo.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, cheigi-na dé Teiru wom, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wuuri o di o dwoŋi taane. O ná tua, o wó ja pwooni o ba o pa woŋo kolo maama na seigi lim wone to taa nae jaja. Wonto wó pa nɔɔna boboŋ-lilirru tem lɔre jaja. Maŋa kam konto ne mo nɔɔno maama wó na zula yalo na maŋe se o na Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Abam boŋe we, á maŋe á jege kolo maama á na lage to, á kwori á ye naduna, ye á ta boŋe we abam di paare á daare debam. Ko ya maŋe se á seene á di paare, se debam de taa tɔge dé ye pwa.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Amo na boŋe tei to, ko nye de Wɛ kwei debam balo na ye o totoŋa nakwa to o zege kwaga kwaga mo, nenɛɛne ba na jaane balo ba vei se ba go to mo. Debam ye balo na jigi nɔn-mwanno to mo woŋo maama tei ne, de nabiina de malese de tei ne.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Debam jigi nɔn-jworru mo Yezu Krista ŋwaane, ye abam pa á ye swa tiina mo o tei ne. Debam maa bwomma, ye abam pae á dana. Nɔɔna zuli abam, ye ba daare ba ba nege debam.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: De zem de, kana de na-nyɔm jege debam, ye dé zo gare-zenzwanno. Nɔɔna maa bɛɛse debam, ye dé ba jege dé tete diga se dé peini da.

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: Dé mae dé tete jea mo dé toŋa pa dé yera nyɔna. Nɔɔna ná jege debam ba twea, dé yeini dé kwei Wɛ zaane mo dé ma swɛ ba swolim. Nɔɔna ná bɛɛse debam, dé yeini dé vɔ pu-dɛa mo.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná yaale debam, dé yeini dé jwoori dé tɛ wo-ŋonno mo de-ba. Dé jigi logo baŋa weero mo. De zem maama, dé ye wo-yɔɔro mo nɔɔno maama tei ne.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Amo na popone kolo to, a popone se ko woli abam se á tɔge chwo-laao mo, á na ye amo bu-swonnu to ŋwaane, se ko dae we a lage se chaveera mo ja abam.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, a lwoori abam se á ta‑á lwoni amo totoŋ-naga kam.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a toŋe Timoti á tei ne. Wonto ye a bu-swono, ye o jege jawala de o na tɔge dé Teiru Yezu tei to. Wonto wó guli o bere abam amo na yeini a tɔge Yezu Krista chwoŋa kam tei to, ne ko na maŋe de chega kalo amo na bere Yezu kɔgɔ kom jei maama ne tei to.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Abam badaara pae á tete kamunni mo, ye á daa ba teene we amo wó jwoori abam tei.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Wɛ ná sɛ, a nam wó ba abam tei leile. A ná tua, a laam wó wane a lɔre dam delo kamun-nyena bam na seene ba jega, ye ko dae ba ŋɔŋa yerane to.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Wɛ paare dem pae dam mo, se ko dae ni-ŋɔŋa yerane.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Ko daare abam tei ne mo se á bwɛ á nii, a ba a vaŋe á zwɛ, naa a bere swono se a fɔge a ke abam lanyerane?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Amo nam nigi abam labaare we, abam wone nɔɔno dedoa kare o ke bwoŋa mo. Baaro mo tigi de o kwo kaane. Balo na yeiri Wɛ to de maŋe ba ba sɛ ba ke wo-zɔɔna yanto dwoŋi.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: O na ke konto to, bɛ mo ye á pae á tete kamunni? Ko ya maŋe se á wo chɔge ko ŋwaane, se á daare á le nɔɔno wom konto á wone.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Abam teera yam ba lana. Á yei we sabɔle fenfee ná wora bworobworo mun-lɛɛre wone, ko laam wó pa te maama fole mo. Keim-lɔŋɔ de ye konto mo.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Amo déem na dɛ yiga a popone tɔnɔ kolo a pa abam to, a tage de abam se á yé ta‑á tɔge dedaane balo na kare ba ke kabwoŋa to.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Amo na kaane abam konto to, ko dae balo na yeiri Wɛ ye ba ye ka-lagena, naa nɔn-kwollu, naa venverena, naa jwo-kaana to taane mo a tɛa. Abam bá wane á pwɛ á tete de logo baŋa nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná jege taane de o dwoŋi, ye á ye nu-biu Yezu ŋwaane, bɛ mo ye nmo wó ja taane dem n vo kɔɔte, se balo na yeiri Wɛ to di abam taane dem? Ko nam maŋe se Wɛ nɔɔna bam mo di á taane dem.

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam mo wó ba ba di nabiina maama taane. Á yeiri konto na? Konto ŋwaane, bɛ mo kea ye á ware á di ta-balwa á pa á tete?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Á yeiri we debam mo wó di malese sem taane na? Konto to, dé bá wane zem taana yam dé di na?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Abam nam ná jege taane konto dwoŋi á wone, bɛ mo ye á ja á vo balo na dae kolokolo Yezu nɔɔna bam yiga ne to tei?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: A tage tento maama se chaveera mo ja abam. Ko wó taa ye chega we, swa tu tere abam wone se o wane o fɔge abam balo na ye nu-biu to daane na?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná saŋe daane konto, ko bere we á maŋe á ga bora mo. N nu-bu ná ke‑m wo-lɔŋɔ, naa o ná ŋɔge‑m, ko ya lana se n yage n ma n chɛ‑o mo.

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Á yeiri we balo na ba tɔge chwo-laao to bá na jeiŋa jei Wɛ paare dem ne na? Yé zaŋe-na á gane á tete. Balo na ye ka-lagena, naa jwo-kaana, naa ka-ziina, naa baywallo, naa balo na peini de-ba to,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
