translation_verse: naa ŋweena, naa nɔn-kwollu, naa sa-nyɔra, naa nɔn-tweena, naa venverena to bá na jeiŋa jei Wɛ woro kom ne.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Abam badaara déem ke konto dwoŋi mo. Wɛ nam saare á wɛleera yam maama, se á ta‑á ye wose ye á jege chega o tei ne. Wɛ dɛ dé Teiru Yezu de o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane mo o ke konto o pa abam. Dé yera yam chɔgem taane

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: Abam badaara we, kolokolo daa tera ko na chula á tei ne. Amo nam tɛ we, ko dae woŋo maama mo jege nyɔɔre ko pa abam. Amo ná tage a we, kolokolo daa tera ko na chula amo tei ne, amo nam bá sɛ se a pa kolokolo taa jege dam se ko wane ko fe amo.

english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á we, Wɛ ke wodiu de kana mo se ba taa zeini daane. Maŋa nam wó ba ye Wɛ ja wodiu de kana maama o chɔge. Wɛ nam wo mɔɔne dé yera yam o pa debam se dé taa mae dé ke kabwoŋa. Wɛ mɔɔne dé yera yam se dé Teiru Yezu mo taa tei-ya, ye dé kwori dé taa ma-ya dé toŋe dé pa‑o.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Wɛ mɛ o dam mo o bi dé Teiru Yezu toone wone. Maŋa nam wó ba ye o bi debam de toone wone.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Á yeiri we á yera yam ye Yezu Krista yera yam daa dedoa mo na? Abam yera yam de Yezu yera yam na ye bedwe konto to, á yé zaŋe á kwei-ya á ma á peini de ka-tola, kokuri á yera yam de wonto yera yam wó ji bedwe mo.

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Kokuri, wolo ná peini de ka-tola, kotu de ka-tola kam maama laam jigi woŋo dedoa mo. Á yeiri konto na? Wɛ tɔnɔ kom tage we, “Banto balei wó ji yera dedoa mo.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Wolo nam ná me de dé Teiru Yezu, kotu jworo de Yezu jworo maama ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Nam yage-na kabwoŋa kikia maama. Keim-balwaaro telo maama nɔɔno na wó ke to, o bá ke o yage o yera wone. Nɔɔno nam ná ke kabwoŋa, konto ye keim-balɔrɔ kolo o na ke o yage o yera wone to mo.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Á yeiri we á yera yam nye de Wɛ tete diga kam ye o Sin-laao kom mo zoore ka wone na? Wɛ seene o ke o Jworo kom á bochara ne mo. Konto ŋwaane, á daa ba tei á tete.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Á ye Wɛ nyem mo. O yeigi abam de o kwora mo. Konto ŋwaane, kwei-na á yera yam á ma á toŋe se ko pa Wɛ na yere.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: A lage a leiri á na popone á bwei amo taana yalo to mo a pa abam. Baaro ná wane o ja o tete kaana baŋa ne, ko wó taa lana.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Baaro yé zaŋe o ve se o peini de o kaane. Kaane nam yé ve se o peini de o baro.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Kaane ba tei o tete yera, ko ye o baro mo tei-ya. Baaro de nam ba tei o tete yera, ko ye o kaane de mo tei-ya.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á ve se á ta‑á tigi daane, ko ná dae we á maama mo sɛ se á yage da-peiga, se á wane á seene á yia á lwoori Wɛ se ko taa vei maŋa kalo á na lage to. Maŋa kam konto ná yia, se á jwoori á ta‑á tigi daane. Ko ná dae konto, setaana pɛ wó soge abam pa á tusi, á na ware á tete á ja to ŋwaane.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Amo na popone banna de kaana taane konto to, a tage se ko woli abam mo, se ko dae we a lage a fe abam.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Amo ya wó taa lage se nɔɔno maama taa ye ne amo na ye tei to. Wɛ pɛɛra nam ye teiri teiri mo ye o pa nɔɔno maama o nyem.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Ko daare abam balo na ye badeina de kadeina to, a lage a ta de abam we, ko lana se á ta‑á ye á yerane konto, ne amo de na ye tei to.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Á nam ná ware á tete á ja, ko maŋe se á di kaana naa á zo banna mo. Konto gare á ná pae ka-laga fera tiini ya zo abam.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Ko daare baaro wolo na tɔge Yezu to ná jege kaane wolo na ba tɔge Yezu to, ye kaane wom ná sɛ se ba taa zoore daane, baaro wom ba jege chwoŋa se o yage o kaane wom. Ko ye amo mo pɛ ni dem konto, se ko dae dé Teiru Yezu mo pɛ-de.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Wolo wom na ba tɔge Yezu to ná boŋe se o viiri, ko ná maŋe ko ye kaane wom naa baro wom de, se á yage‑o se o viiri. Wolo na daare ye o tɔge Yezu to laam wó taa tei o tete. Wɛ na bwoŋi debam se dé taa tɔge‑o to, ko ye se dé taa zoore daane de wo-zuru mo.

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Abam déem na ye tei ye Wɛ bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, á ta ta‑á ye konto, se ko maŋe de dé Teiru wom na mɔɔne abam tei to. Mo kolo a na bere Yezu kɔgɔ kom jeiga maama ne to.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama déem na ye tei ye Wɛ bwoŋi‑o to, ko maŋe se o ta taa ye konto mo.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem ná bwoŋi wolo ye o ye kabaa, se kotu yé pa ko taa daane‑o. O nam ná nɛ chwoŋa se o taa tei o tete, se o sɛ se ko taa ye konto.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Á ye Wɛ nyem mo. O yeigi abam de o kwora mo. Mo kokuri yé zaŋe-na á ji kabɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne.

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ko daare bukwa balo ta na wo zo banna to, dé Teiru Yezu wo pɛ-ne o ni ba ŋwaane. Amo nam ye wolo dé Teiru wom na duri a yibwona pa se a zege a chega wone to mo. Amo boboŋa na jaane tei to mo tento:

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Amo boŋe we, yaara yalo na wo debam baŋa ne leile to ŋwaane, ko lamma se nɔɔno taa ye o na maŋe o ye tei to mo.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Konto to, nmo ná jege kaane, se n yé zaŋe n yage‑o. Nmo nam ná ba jege kaane, se n yé zaŋe n ta‑n kwaane se n di kaane.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Ko dae we, n ná di kaane, n ga n ke wo-lɔŋɔ. Ko nam ta dae we, bukɔ ná zo baro, o ke wo-lɔŋɔ. Banna de ba kaana nam bá sii logo baŋa yaara yam wone. Konto mo a ba lage se á yaare konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: Balo na ye pipim-piina logo baŋa ne to taa zoore ne ba yi wo su ba jejegero tem mo tei. Kokuri logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama lage te ti mo.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Amo ba lage se lwia taa jege abam. Wolo na ba jege kaane to yeini o kwei o boboŋa maama o pa dé Teiru Yezu mo, se o taa toŋe o pwoli o wo.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Wolo na jege kaane to yeini o kwei o boboŋa o ke logo baŋa wonnu wone mo, ye o kwaane o taa toŋa o pwoli o kaane wo.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Konto bere we, o boboŋa ye yalei mo. Ko ye bedwe mo de busankana, naa kaane wolo na ba jege baro to. Wonto kwei o boboŋa maama mo o pa dé Teiru Yezu, o na lage se o yera de o jworo maama taa ye Wɛ nyem to ŋwaane. Ko daare kaane wolo na jege baro to kwei o boboŋa o ke logo baŋa wonnu wone mo, ye o kwaane se o taa toŋe o pwoli o baro wom wo.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Amo nam tɛ botare sento se ko woli abam mo. A ba kwaane se ko taa ye fefeo á tei ne. Amo nam lage se a pa á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laao mo, se á seene á yia á ta‑á toŋa á pa dé Teiru Yezu ye á ba jege boboŋa yalei ko wone.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná boŋe we, o wo ke o katɔgɔ lanyerane, ye o fera ná tiini ya zo‑o pa o daa ware o tete o ja, ko maŋe se kotu kwaane o di‑o mo, ne o na boŋe tei to. O ná ke konto, o wo ke wo-lɔŋɔ.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Konto to, wolo na di o katɔgɔ to ke lanyerane. Wolo de nam na yage o katɔgɔ kom ye o wo di‑o to tiini o ke lanyerane.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaane ná jege baro, ye o baro wom ta ná ŋwe, o ba jege chwoŋa se o yage‑o. O baro wom nam ná tega, o laam jege chwoŋa se o zo o na lage wolo to. O nam jege se o tɔge dé Teiru wom boboŋa mo o zo baro wodwoŋi.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: A lage a ta jwona wodiiru taane mo. Dé yei we, dé maama jege yeino. Nam ta‑á yei-na we, nɔɔno ná jege yeino, ko pa‑o kamunni mo. Nɔɔno nam ná jege swono, ko pae zeinim mo.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná boŋe we o yei o tia, ko bere we o ta yeiri kolo na maŋe se o taa yei to mo.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Wolo nam na swoi Wɛ to, Wɛ yei o de.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye jwona wodiu kom dim taane dem, dé yei we jwona ba ŋwe, ye Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Nabiina jege wonnu tedwonna mo ba maa bwoi we ‘wa’, ko ná ye tega baŋa wonnu naa wɛyuu wonnu de. Wonnu tento daga dedɛ ye nɔɔna bwoi-te we, ba wa de ba yuu tiina.

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam, Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora. Debam Kwo wom na ke woŋo maama ye dé ŋwea wo o tei ne to mo konto. Ko daa ta woli da, debam Teiru ye dedoa mo, ye wonto mo ye Yezu Krista. Wɛ na dɛ wolo ŋwaane o ke woŋo maama ye dé ŋwe o ŋwaane to mo wonto.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae nɔɔno maama mo yei we jwona ba jege dam. Nɔɔna badaara déem me de jwona kaanem mo, ye ba laam ba ba sɛ Wɛ. Konto ŋwaane ba kɔre foone ye ba boŋe we, ba ná di jwoni wodiu, ko wó taa ye nenɛɛne ba jwoori ba sɛ jwona kaanem mo. Ba boboŋa ta na wo kweere Wɛ seeni to, ba boŋe we ba ke ba chɔge mo.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Wodiu dim dae kolokolo debam de Wɛ laŋa ne. Dé ná chuli wodiiru naa dé ba chula, dé bá jwoŋi kolokolo naa dé ga kolokolo Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na jege yeino ye n boboŋa kweere to ná vei n zo jwoni diga n tɔge n di de wodiu kom, ye n nu-bu wolo boboŋa ta na wo kweere to ná nɛ‑m, konto bá wane ko pa se o boboŋa ja se o de vo o tɔge o di na?

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, wodiu dim ná lage ko pa amo nu-bu tusi, a daa bá fɔge a do nɔna. A ba lage se a pa a nu-bu ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone.

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Amo ba jege chwoŋa se a jwoŋi a ni-wodiu a totoŋa yam baŋa ne na?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Amo ba jege chwoŋa se a ke nenɛɛne dé Teiru Yezu totoŋa nakwa babam bam, de o nyaana, de Piita na yeini ba ke tei, ye ba jege ba kaana balo de na sɛ Yezu pa ba tɔge daane ba toŋe Wɛ totoŋa to na?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Amo de Banabas yerane nam mo jege se dé taa toŋa dé lage dé tete ni-wodiu na?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ye soja tu, o bá wane o jwoori o ŋwe o tete. Nɔɔno ná jege o kara, o ba di ka wonnu na? Nɔɔno ná jege naane o tɔga, o ba di de nayela na?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ nia yalo o na pɛ Moses to tɔnɔ kom wone we, “Nmo ná jege nabea n ma n toŋe n faao, yé vɔ ka ni se ka yé di men-bia bam.” Wɛ bera yam konto zege nabɛ yerane ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Ko na ye chega to, o tage konto se ko woli debam mo. Ko bere we nɔɔno wolo na vare to de wolo na fere mena o le to maama teene we ba wó na ba teiri mo.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Debam na toŋe abam tei ne to, ko nye de dé dugi Wɛ chega kam mo á bochara ne. Ko nam wo maŋe se dé jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu abam tei ne na?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ se á ta‑á pae nɔɔna badwonna ba ni-wodiu to, ko ya wo maŋe se debam ta dwoi konto na? De ko de, debam nam wo bwei se dé jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu abam tei ne, ne ko ya na jege chwoŋa se dé ke tei to. Dé nam vɔge dé wo woŋo maama baŋa ne, se ko yé wane ko kweele Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam ko yage tega ne.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na toŋe Wɛ totoŋa o diga kam ne to, ba yeini ba jwoŋi ba ni-wodiu dáane mo. Balo de na jwoŋi vara ba kaane ba pa Wɛ to de jwoŋi ba teiri ko wone mo. Á yeiri konto na?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye bedwe mo de balo de na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to. Dé Teiru Yezu pɛ ni we, ba de jwoŋi ba ni-wodiu dáane.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: De ko de, amo nam wo bwei se a jwoŋi kolokolo abam tei ne. Ko nam ta dae we a popone tento se a bobo a taa jwoŋi-te leile mo. Amo nam wó te mo, se a bá za a na ye tei to. A bá sɛ a pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno chwoŋa se o chɔge woŋo kolo a na jege teera ko ŋwaane to.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: A nam bá wane a mage a nyɔɔne a na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to ŋwaane. Konto ye fefeo mo se a ke. Amo ya ná yage Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam tɔɔlem, ko wó taa ye lɛɛro mo a tei ne.

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: A nam ya ná tɔɔle-ka a tete fera ŋwaane, a ya wó taa teene se a jwoŋi ŋweero ka baŋa ne. Ko nam dae a tete boboŋa mo a ke, se ko ye Wɛ mo kwei-de o ke amo jeŋa ne.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, bɛ ŋweero mo amo wó jwoŋi? Amo nyɔɔre mo ye we, a yeini a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam zɛɛra, ye a ba bwei se a jwoŋi kolokolo ko ŋwaane, ne a ya na jege chwoŋa se a ke tei to.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: A tei a tete mo ye a dae nɔɔn-nɔɔno kabaa. Amo tete nam mo pɛ a ji kabaa a pa nɔɔna maama, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi nɔɔna dedɛ a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye dwi-gɛ tiina balo na ba tɔge Wɛ nia yam to, a na wo ba tei ne to, a tɔge a zoore ne banto mo tei, se a wane a na chwoŋa a jwoŋi-ba a ke Wɛ jeŋa ne. Ko nam dae we a yiga tera dedaane Wɛ nia yam, se Yezu Krista nia yam mo tei amo.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Amo na ke tei maama to ye Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane mo, se a wane a na a teiri ka wo-laaro tem baŋa ne.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Konto mo pae a ba yeini a duri ne wolo na duri yɔɔ yɔɔ to dwoŋi. A nam ba ke jara ne wolo na yeiri jara keim to.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Amo nam peene a tete mo se a pa a yera lɔre we, amo mo tei-ya. A ke konto se ko yé wane ko pa a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam a bere nɔɔna, se a tete laam ba a ga pɛɛre dem.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Konto maama déem na ke to, ko nye de banto maama jwoŋi sɛɛm se ba taa ye Moses tɔgena.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: De konto de, ba dedɛ kikia déem wo su Wɛ yi. O ma pa ba te ba maŋe kagoa kam ne.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Wonnu tento maama na ke to, te ke se te bere debam mo se dé yé pa dé fera taa zoore wo-zɔɔna, nenɛɛne banto na ke tei to.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á ye jwo-kaana ne banto badaara déem na ye tei to. Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Nɔɔna bam déem lɛɛre ba di wodi-fɔrɔ mo ye ba nyɔa, ba daare ba zaŋe ba kwɛɛre yɔɔ yɔɔ.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á pa dé taa tɔge dé ke kabwoŋa, ne banto badaara déem na ke tei ye ba morro finlei-tetɔ (

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Abam na we, kolokolo tera ko na chula debam tei ne to, ko ye chega. Ko nam dae we, woŋo maama mo jege nyɔɔre ko pa debam. Ko ta dae we, woŋo maama mo pae zeinim.

english_verse: died. Don't do shameful things as they did.
translation_verse: ) te dɛ dedwe wone to.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Yé pa-na dé faŋe Baŋa Wɛ dam dé nii, ne banto badaara déem na ke tei ye basankwe done-ba se go to.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á poona-na de Wɛ, ne banto badaara na ke tei ye toone maleka kam go-ba to.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Wonnu tento maama déem ke dé kwoa nakwa bam se te taa ye maana mo te pa debam. Te nam popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne se ko wane ko kaane debam balo ta na ŋwe ye logo baŋa kweelim da yam bwola to mo.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Wolo na boŋe we o zege lanyerane to taa yei, se o wó to.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama na ke abam ye ko soge á boboŋa se á tusi to tui nɔɔna maama baŋa mo. Wɛ na ye chega tu to, o bá sɛ se woŋo kolo na soge á boboŋa to taa dana ko dwoi á jaanem. O nam wó pa abam dam se á wane á zege ye á daare á na chwoŋa á nwoŋi ko wone.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, le-na á tete jwona kaanem wone.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: A ŋɔɔne tento dwoŋi de abam, á yi na poore to ŋwaane. Nam boŋe-na á nii, a taane dem ye chega na.

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Debam maama na fɔge fɔge bworobworo dedoo kom dé di to bere we debam maama ye nɔɔno dedoa mo, dé ya ze maŋe dé daga tei maama de.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Boŋe-na Isarele tiina bam déem na kaane wonnu ba pa Wɛ ye ba daare ba di te wone to, se á ma á lɔre lɔra. Balo maama na dɛ ba di to wo tɔge ba sɛ kaanem dem mo na?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Amo na tage tei to bere bɛ mo? Ko bere we wodiu kolo ba na mɛ ba kaane jwona to jege kuri mo na? Ko bere we jwona yam tete jege kuri mo na?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Aawo, ko dae konto. A na tage tei to mo ye a lage a bere we, jwo-kaana na kwei wonnu telo ba ma ba ke kaanem to, ba kwei ba pae chichiri mo se ko dae Wɛ. Amo nam ba lage se abam tɔge á me de chichiri.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ko wo maŋe se á nyɔ dé Teiru Yezu Krista zoŋa kam wone, se á daare á vo á nyɔ chichiri zoŋa wone. Abam nam bá wane á jeini á di dé Teiru wom gula wodiu kom, ye á daare á vo á da á di wodiu kolo na wó pa á me de chichiri to.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Yé pa-na dé ke kolo na wó zaŋe dé Teiru wom wo to. Debam wó taa dana dé dwoi‑o na? Wodiu dim taane

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Á jege chwoŋa se á yeigi nɔna yalo maama ba na jege ba yeigi yaga ne to á di. Nam yé bwei-na ya bwia á nii, ya ye jwoni nɔna mo na, se lwia wó zo á boboŋa ya ŋwaane.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama ye Baŋa Wɛ nyem mo.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na ba tɔge Yezu Krista to ná bwoŋi nmo se n vo o sɔŋɔ n di wodiu ded‑o, ye n ná sɛ n vo, o ná kwei wodiu kolo de kolo maama o zege n yiga ne, se n di. Yé zaŋe n bwei ko bwia, se lwia wó zo n boboŋa ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Ko dae se n yage ko dim lwia na wó zo nmo tete boboŋa to ŋwaane, se ko ye lwia na wó ja nɔɔno wodwoŋi wom to ŋwaane mo. Abam wó wane á bwei amo we, bɛŋwaane mo dé wó yage dé na jege chwoŋa se dé ke kolo to, lwia na wó zo nɔɔno wodwoŋi boboŋa to ŋwaane?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Abam ta wó bwei amo we, dé na ke Wɛ lei wodiu kom ŋwaane ye dé daare dé di to, bɛ mo ye nɔɔno wodwoŋi daa wó yaale debam ko ŋwaane?

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á ke-na kolo na wó chɔge nɔɔna boboŋa to, ko ya ze ye Juu tiina, naa dwi-gɛ tiina, naa Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna de.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Ta‑á lwoni-na amo kikia, ne amo na lwoni Yezu Krista tei to. Baaro de kaane yuu tu na ye wolo to

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Abam ke chega lanyerane dedaane á na yeini á guli amo gula, ye á kwori á tɔge chega kalo a na bere abam to.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Amo nam lage se abam lɔre we, Yezu Krista mo ye baaro maama yuu tu, ye baaro de maa ye o kaane yuu tu. Baŋa Wɛ nam mo ye Yezu Krista de yuu tu.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Kaane de nam ná zaŋe o lwoori Wɛ, naa o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam, ye o ná wo mɛ woŋo o kwoli o yuu, o de yaale o yuu tu wom mo. O ná ke konto, o de wolo na cheeri o yuu to ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Kaane ná wo sɛ se o kwoli o yuu, ko ya maŋe se o chɔ-ko mo, naa o cheeri-ko. Ko nam na jege chaveera se kaane ke konto to, ko maŋe se o taa kwoli-ko mo.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Baara nam ba jege se ba kwoli ba yuni, kolo ŋwaane banto mo bere Wɛ seina de o dam na ye tei. Ko nam ná ye kaana, banto mo bere baara dam na ye tei.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Kokuri, Wɛ mɛ baaro yera mo o ke kaane, se ko dae kaane yera mo o mɛ o ke baaro.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Wɛ wo ke baaro kaane zeinim ŋwaane, o ke kaane mo baaro zeinim ŋwaane.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo kaana jege se ba taa kwoli ba yuni, se ko bere dam delo na tei-ba to. Konto wó pa Wɛ malese sem na zula.

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: Wɛ déem seene o ma baaro yera mo o ke kaane, ye kaana de nam mo lore baara. Woŋo maama nam nwoŋi Wɛ tei mo.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Abam tete nam boŋe-na konto wone á nii. Kaane ná zaŋe se o ware Wɛ, ye o ná wo kwei woŋo o ma kwoli o yuu, ko ye ko chwoŋa ne na?

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná wo sɛ amo berem dem konto ye o mage ni-kantɔgɔ de baŋa ne, konto tu taa yei we, debam maama tɔge kanto chwoŋa kam mo. Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kom jei maama ne to de tɔge-ka mo. Chwoŋa kadwoŋi daa tera ka woli da. Yezu Krista gula wodiu kom dim Matiyu

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Kolo maama amo na lage a ta de abam to, a bá wane a ta we á ke lanyerane. Abam ná yeini á tigisi daane Wɛ ŋwaane, á chɔgem mo dwoi á fɔgem.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Yiga to, amo nigi we, á ná tigisi daane se á zuli Wɛ, á yeini á jege da-popɔra mo. Amo boŋe we ko seene ko ye chega mo.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo, popɔra wó taa wo abam tei ne se ko pa balo na tɔge chega to taa nae jaja.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane nɔɔno maama yeini o gare o di o tete wodiu mo o ti lela. Ko maa pae se kana jege abam badwonna, ye á badwonna nyɔ á su.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná di ye o kwori o nyɔ, ye o ná wo lɔre dé Teiru Yezu yera yam kuri chekke, konto tu vaŋe taane mo o pa o tete, de o na di ye o kwori o nyɔ tei to.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Ba na di ba ti to, o daa ma kwei zoŋa, ye o ta ke konto dwoŋi. O maa we, “Zoŋa kam bere we, Wɛ tɔge amo jana bam ŋwaane o gwoni ni-doore dedaane nabiina mo. Maŋa maama á ná lage á nyɔ konto dwoŋi, se á ke amo na ke tei to, se á ma á guli amo gula.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Amo lɔre dé Teiru Yezu gula wodiu kom dim chega kam o tete tei ne mo, ye a daare a bere abam chega kam konto, nenɛɛne Yezu na ke kolo dɛ dem ba na boŋe se ba ja‑o to. Tete dem konto ne o ma kwei bworobworo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ye o ke Wɛ lei ko ŋwaane o daare o ja-ko o fɔ fɔ. O ma ta de o tontoŋena bam o we, “Amo yera yam mo tento, ya na ye abam nyem. Ta‑á ke-na konto dwoŋi se á ta‑á ma á guli amo gula.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, nɔɔno wolo ná di dé Teiru wom gula bworobworo kom naa o nyɔge zoŋa kam wone, ye o ke ne o yiga tera ko wone mo tei, konto tu ke keim-balɔrɔ mo o ma yaale dé Teiru wom yera yam de o jana bam.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Konto nam mo pae se á dedɛ weela ye á bwona, ye á badwonna de toa.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Debam nam ya ná yeini dé bwɛ de tete, Wɛ ya daa bá bwɛ debam kolokolo baŋa ne.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a nu-bia bam, á ná tigisi á ti se á di wodiu kom konto dwoŋi, se á zuri á yera á cheigi da-tei ne.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Wolo kana ná wɔe, se kotu di sɔŋɔ ne se o daare o ba, se ko yé wane ko pa Wɛ bwɛ abam á tigisim dem baŋa ne. Ko daare ko ná ye taana yalo na daare to, amo ná tua, a wó pɔɔre ya laŋa a bere abam.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Guli-na maŋa kalo á ta na yeiri Wɛ ye á déem tɔge jwo-yɔɔro to, nenɛɛne á boboŋa na yeini ya gane abam se á sa chwoŋa tei to.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛɛra ye teiri teiri mo, ye o Sin-laao kom dedoa yerane mo jege-ya ko pae nɔɔna.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Wɛ na zeini nɔɔna de yu-punnu telo maama to ye teiri teiri mo. Wɛ nam ye dedoa yerane mo, ye wonto nam mo pae nɔɔno maama o yu-punnu tem se o taa maa toŋa.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo pae nɔɔno maama o Sin-laao kom se o wane o taa tɔge ko zeinim baŋa ne o woli o dwonna.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ wae o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o pa nɔɔna badwonna ŋɔɔne swa taane ba bere ba dwonna. Nɔɔna badwonna de maa wae ba ŋɔɔne yeino taane o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Konto nam ta mo pae nɔɔna badwonna yɔɔre ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye ko ta pae badwonna dam se ba taa maa yɔɔre jaweena.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Ko ta pae badwonna dam se ba taa maa ke wo-kenkagela, ko daare se badwonna taa wae ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Ko ta pae nɔɔna badwonna wae ba pɔɔre Wɛ Sin-laao kom totoŋa de chichiri totoŋa daane. Ko ta pae badwonna wae ba ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ dwi dwi, ye badwonna de ta maa wae ba tɛ ta-gɛ sem konto kuri ba bere ba dwonna.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛɛra yanto maama ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom dedoa yerane mo jege-ya ko pae nɔɔna. Ko nam jege-ya konto dwi dwi mo ko pɔɔre ko pae nɔɔno de nɔɔno, se ko maŋe de ko boboŋa na jaane tei to. Yezu nɔɔna bam maŋe se ba nii da-baŋa ne

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Debam balo maama na sɛ Yezu to jwoŋi sɛɛm pa dé ji kɔgɔ dedoo mo. Dé ya ze maŋe dé ye Juu tiina naa dwi-gɛ tiina, naa dé ye kabɛ naa balo na tei ba tete to, ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom tete mo zeini debam maama. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ye dedoa yerane, ye wonto mo Wɛ lwogi o ke debam maama bochara ne.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye chega mo we nabiinu yera pɔɔrem daga, se ko dae we ya ba jege pɔɔrem.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Naga ná tage ka we, ka dae jeŋa, se konto ŋwaane yera yam ba tei-ka, konto bá seene ko pa ka ta dae yera yam nyem.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Zwɛ de nam ná we, de dae yi, se yera yam ba tei-de, konto bá seene ko pa de ta dae yera yam nyem.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Yera yam maama nam ya ná ye yi yerane, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya taa ni taane? Ya nam ya ná ye zwɛ yerane, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya taa ni lwom?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ mo ke-ya teiri teiri konto, ko maŋe de o boboŋa na lage tei to.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Ya maama nam ya ná ye pɔɔrem bedwe, ya wó ke tɛ mo ya ji yera?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye konto to mo pae pɔɔrem dem daga ye ya maama laam ye yera bedwe.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, yi bá wane de ta de jeŋa we, “A ba lage‑m”. Yuu de ba jege chwoŋa se ko ta de naga we, ko ba lage-ka.

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, dé bá wane dé dole dé yage dé yera yam daa kalo maama dé na pae ka bwona to.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ko daare dé yera yam daa kalo maama na lana to, dé daa ba fɔge dé nii ka baŋa ne. Wɛ mo ke nabiinu yera yam maama o ke daane, ye o pae daa kalo ya na gɛ zula to na zula lanyerane.

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane popɔra tera yera yam wone. Ya maama nii da-baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Ko ná chana yera yam daa kalo yera ne, yera yam maama wó tɔge ya na cham dem konto dwoŋi mo. Daa kalo ná nɛ zula, yera yam maama de wó tɔge ya na wopwolo mo.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Abam maama ye Yezu Krista yera yam mo, ye á dedoa dedoa ye ya pɔɔrem dem dwi dwi mo.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we abam maama ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa, naa Wɛ ni-jwoŋina, naa balo na bere o chega kam to. Ko ta dae we abam maama mo wae á ke wo-kenkagela,

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: naa á ta‑á yɔɔre jaweena, naa á wae á ŋɔɔne Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem, naa á wae á tɛ se kuri.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Amo ná maŋe a wae a ŋɔɔne nabiina taane dwi dwi, de malese sem taane de, ye swono ná tera a tei ne, ko nye de sɔɔ mo a ke, ne ba na mage kwaŋa de konkɔŋɔ pa te ke sɔɔ tei to.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Amo ná kwei a jejegero maama a maŋe a pa yiniga tiina, ye a ta kwori a sɛ se ba kwei a yera ba de mini ne, ye swono ná tera a tei ne, ko ta maŋe ko ba jege nyɔɔre ko pa-ne.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: O maa ba jege boyerem, ye ko dae o tete yerane wonnu mo o laga. O ta kwori o jege ban-peno. Nɔɔno ná ke‑o lwarem, o ba yeini o kwei o ke o wone.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Swono tu ba jege wopwolo keim-lwanno baŋa ne, o jege wopwolo chega baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Swono ba ti kɔtaa. Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem wó ba ko kɛ. Wɛ pɛɛre delo nɔɔna na maa ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ to de wó ba de kweeli. Yeino de wó ba ko kɛ.

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó fɔge wonnu maama pa te suuri to, wo-chichwooru tem maama wó jei mo.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Amo busɔɔne maŋa ne, a déem ŋɔɔne ne bu mo tei. A boboŋa maa nye de bu boboŋa, ye a jeeli ne bu tei. A nam na ke nɔɔno to, a kwei busɔɔne wonnu tem konto maama a yage.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, wonnu tetɔ mo wó taa wora taa, te ye wo-dedoa, de teena, de swono mo. Kolo nam na dwoi te maama to mo ye swono.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, kwaane-na se á ta‑á jege swono, se á daare á seene á yia se á jwoŋi Wɛ pɛɛra yalo o Sin-laao kom na pae nɔɔna to á woli da, ye ko fɔge ko dae Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam se o taa maa pɔpɔe o ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, kotu ŋɔɔne de Wɛ mo. Ko dae we o ŋɔɔne o bere nabiina, ba na ba ni o taane dem kuri to ŋwaane. Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo pae o ŋɔɔne wo-siseigiru.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno wolo na wae o tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to ŋɔɔne o bere nabiina mo. O ni taane dem maa zeini-ba se ba taa fɔge ba zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Wolo na ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem to fɔge o tete mo. Wolo nam na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to fɔge Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama mo.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, a nu-bia bam, amo ná tu abam tei, ye a ná ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ yerane, á wó na bɛ nyɔɔre mo amo tei ne? Kolo na wó woli abam to mo ye se a ŋɔɔne taane delo Wɛ na le o bere-ne to, naa de pa abam yuu-yeino, naa de bere abam Wɛ kwora, naa de pa á lɔre o chega kam.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná jege jara nabɔnɔ o wui yɔɔ yɔɔ, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o lɔre ko na ye tei, se o chichei o zege jara ŋwaane.

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Ko nam ta ye bedwe mo de n ni taane ná dae jaja, nɔɔna wó ke tɛ mo ba lɔre n na tɛ kolo to kuri chekke? Konto nam bere we n ŋɔɔne n yage gaao wone mo.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná ŋɔɔne taane de amo ye a ba ni de kuri, konto bere we debam maama balei ye veira mo da-tei ne.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam wolo ná wae o ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ, kotu nam lwoori Wɛ se o taa wae se kuri de o tɛa.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Nmo ná mɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom ta-gaa n ma n ware Wɛ, ko ye n jworo mo ŋɔɔna, se nmo tete boboŋa tɔge ya tere ko wone.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Kolo na maŋe se n ke to mo ye se n yeini n ware Wɛ de n jworo de n boboŋa maama, se n daare n ta‑n leeni de n jworo de n boboŋa maama n seini Wɛ.

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Nmo na ke Wɛ lei tei to ná maŋe ko lamma tei, ko bá zeini balo na jei ba cheigi to.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo, a ke Wɛ lei de o na pɛ-ne dam se a taa ŋɔɔne Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ a dwoi abam maama to.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, pa-na á boboŋa kweere, se á daa yé ta‑á jege bu-balwa boboŋa. Ko nam ná ye keim-lwanno seeni, ta ta‑á nye de bu-sese na yeiri te ni ne to.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom wone we: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ wó toŋe sa-teena mo se ba ba ba ŋɔɔne amo kwora de abam. Dwi-gɛ tiina wó ŋɔɔne ta-veiri de abam. De konto de, á ta bá sɛ a ni.”

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, abam kɔgɔ kom maama ná tigisi daane Wɛ zula ŋwaane, ye á maama ná wora á ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, ye veira badwonna naa balo na wo sɛ Wɛ to laam ná tu ba zo á wo, nɔɔna bam konto bá ta we, abam yirisi mo na?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Abam maama nam ná tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam á bere daane, ye veira naa balo na wo sɛ Wɛ to ná tu ba zo á wo, banto wó lɔre we Wɛ dam mo wo á tei ne. Ba dedoa na nigi kolo abam maama tei ne to wó pa o lɔre we, o tusi mo ye o bá na bora Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Boboŋ-lilirru telo maama ya na seigi o wone to laam wó ba ya jare pwooni yiga ne mo ja. O maa wó vwi o yibia tega ne o zuli Wɛ, ye o sɛ we, Wɛ seene o wo á tei ne. Yezu kɔgɔ kom tigisim dem na wó da chwoŋa tei to

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Abam badaara ná lage á pɔpɔ á ŋɔɔne ta-gɛ, ko maŋe se á ta‑á ye balei naa batɔ yerane mo. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á zaŋe á ŋɔɔne á daare á pa daane mo, se á dedoa zaŋe o ta ŋwɛ sem kuri.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ná tere á wone se o wane o ta ta-gɛ sem kuri, wolo ya na lage o ŋɔɔne-se to maŋe se o yage mo, se o ná wo o yerane, se o taa ŋɔɔne-se de Wɛ.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Wɛ chega kam ná tu balo na jei ba cheigi to dedoa yuu ne se o ta o bere, ko maŋe se wolo na zege o ŋɔɔne to mo pu o ni se o dwoŋi wom ta-ka.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Konto to, abam maama wae á tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam dedoa dedoa, se ko pa á zamese Wɛ chega kam da-tei ne, ye á bochara ke dam.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-jwoŋina balo na jwoŋi dam se ba taa tɔɔle o kwora kam to wae ba tete ba jaana ka tɔɔlem dem baŋa ne.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Wɛ lage se woŋo maama taa jege ywoni mo, se o ba lage boremaa boremaa keim.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Ba ná lage se ba lɔre kolo kuri, ba jege se ba bwei ba banna mo sɔŋɔ ne. Ko tiini ko ye chaveera mo se kaane zaŋe o ŋɔɔne á tigisim dem ne.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kam ga zege abam tei ne mo ka jage jei maama na? Abam yerane mo ka yi ka kweeli na?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná boŋe we o Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu, naa o boboŋa kweere Wɛ Sin-laao kom pɛɛra seeni, kotu jege se o taa yei we, amo na popone kolo a pa abam to ye dé Teiru wom kwora mo.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná ve amo ni dem konto, se á yé pa á yiga taa wo konto tu wone.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, kwaane-na á seene á yia Wɛ kwora kam tɔɔlem baŋa ne. Yé ta‑á chuli-na Sin-laao kom ta-gɛ sem ŋɔŋa.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Amo na pɛ á lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam konto to, Wɛ tɔge ka baŋa ne mo o vere abam o yage, nenɛɛne á ná wo jwoori ka kwaga ne. Naa á sɛ Yezu kafɛ ŋwaane mo na?

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Wɛ chega kalo na dwoi maama to ye kalo amo na jwoŋi ye a laam daare a lwoni a bere abam to mo. Kanto nam mo tento: Yezu Krista tege debam wɛleera ŋwaane mo, ne Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na maŋe ko ta tei to.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ba ma suli‑o. Da yatɔ dɛ ne o ma jwoori o bi toone wone, ye konto de ta ye Wɛ tɔnɔ kom na wuuri ko ta kolo to mo.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: O na bi to, Piita ma na‑o, ye o tontoŋena fuga-balei bam de na‑o.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Konto kwaga ne, o tɔgena dedɛ ma na‑o bedwe baŋa ne, ba na dwoi nenɛɛne nɔɔna bia yanu (

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Jemsi de daa ma na‑o, ye ko daare pa o totoŋa nakwa bam maama na‑o.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Ko na kweeli to, o laam ma veere o tete de amo, de amo na maŋe a nye de wolo ba na loga ye o lora maŋa ta wo yi to de mo.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, amo tiini a muri Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam maama wone. A muri se ba taa bwoi-ne we Yezu tontoŋeno, kolo ŋwaane a déem bɛɛse o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom mo.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Wɛ tete zaane dem nam mo pɛ se a ji a na ye wolo zem to. O na ke-ne zaane tei to dae kafɛ. Amo tiini a toŋe a pa‑o, se ko dwoni o tontoŋena bam maama. Ko nam dae a tete dam ŋwaane mo a wae a toŋa. Ko ye Wɛ zaane dem o na ke a yuu ne to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Debam balo na ye Yezu tontoŋena to maama yeini de bere chega dedoa mo. Ko ná ye amo na bere kolo to, naa banto de na bere kolo to, ko ye chega kalo abam na sɛ to mo. Twa biim taane

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Debam maama na tɔɔle Wɛ chega kam we, Yezu Krista bi toone wone to, bɛ nam mo ye abam badwonna tɛ á we, twa biim tera?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ko ya ná ye chega we twa biim tera, ko bere we Yezu Krista tete de wo bi mo.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Ko ta bere we, dé na bere Wɛ chega kam tei to, ko ye vwa mo dé fɔge dé pa‑o, kolo ŋwaane dé yeini dé bere nɔɔna we, Wɛ mo bi Yezu Krista toone wone. Twa biim nam ya ná seene de tera, kokuri mo Wɛ wo bi Yezu.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Twa biim ná tera, ko bere we Yezu Krista de maŋe o wo bi mo.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Wonto ya ná wo bi toone wone, ko bere we abam na ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o tei to ye kafɛ mo, ye á wɛleera yam ta wo á yuu ne.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Ko ta bere we, balo na sɛ Yezu Krista ye ba laam te to gɛ ba ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye logo baŋa ŋwea kanto yerane ŋwaane mo dé jege teena Yezu Krista wone, ko bere we dé tiini dé ye zora mo nɔɔna maama tei ne.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Toone zege nabiinu dedoa yera ne mo de wora. Ko ta ye bedwe mo de twa biim de na zege nabiinu dedoa yera ne tei to.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama de o na tu tei to mo. Yezu Krista nam mo dɛ yiga o bi o vo Wɛ tei. Ko daare balo de na ye o nɔɔna to wó bi maŋa kam o na wó jwoori o ba to.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Toone nam mo ye o dono wolo o na wó wane o ma kweeli to.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Abam nɔɔna badwonna yeini ba jwoŋi sɛɛm ba pa twa. Twa biim nam ná tera, bɛ nyɔɔre mo wó taa wora ba sɛɛm dem baŋa ne? Bɛ mo ye ba yeini ba jwoŋi sɛɛm twa bam ŋwaane konto?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, dɛ maama amo yeini a tɔge toone tei mo a kɛa. Ko ye chega mo. Amo tiini a jege teera abam baŋa ne dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Konto mo pɛ a ta konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Pa-na á boboŋa jwoori ya taa tɔge chwoŋa, se á daare á yage keim-lwanno tem. Abam badaara ta yeiri Wɛ. A tage konto se ko pa chaveera mo zo abam. Nɔɔna na wó bi de yera yalo to

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Abam dedoa wó bwei we, “Ko wó ke tɛ mo se twa bi? Ba yera yam wó taa ye tetɛ mo?”

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Wo-dwi dem ná nwoŋi, Wɛ mo wó pa-de yera, ne o boboŋa na lage tei to. Wɛ nam ta mo pae wo-dwi maama de tete nyenyego.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Ko dae we woŋo maama ya-nɔna mo ye bedwe. Nabiina, de vara, de zuna, de ywona maama jege ba ya-nɔna yera yera mo.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu wonnu de wora mo, ye tega baŋa wonnu de wora. Wɛyuu wonnu tem jege te lam mo, ye tega baŋa wonnu tem de jege te lam.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Wea kam jege ka lam mo, ye chana kam de jege ka lam. Chalechwe sem de maa jege se lam, ye se lam dem nam dwoi daane.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Tento maama bere twa biim na ye tei to mo. Nɔɔno ná tega, o yera yalo ba na suli to ye yera yalo na wó pɔ to mo. O yera yalo nam na bi toone wone to daa bá pɔ maŋa de maŋa.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Yera yalo ba na suli to ye logo baŋa ŋwea nyem mo, ko daare yalo na bi to ye ŋwe-doŋa kam nyem mo. Ne logo baŋa yera yam na wora tei to, ŋwe-doŋa kam yera de jege se ya taa wora mo.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Boboa ne to Adam mo jwoŋi siu kolo na pae ŋwea to.” Ko daare Adam wolo na kweeli to jege jworo kolo na pae ŋwea to mo.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye logo baŋa ŋwea mo yeini ka tui yiga, ye Wɛ telaao ŋwe-doŋa kam laam saŋe ka tui.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Wɛ mɛ teero mo o ke nabiinu wolo na tu yiga to. Konto ŋwaane, wonto ye tega baŋa nyem mo. Nabiinu wolo nam na saŋe to nwoŋi Wɛ telaao mo.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Nabiina maama ye tega baŋa nyem mo, ye ba nye de Wɛ na mɛ teero o ke nɔɔno wolo to mo. Nɔɔna balo maama nam na ye Wɛ telaao nyem to nye de wolo na nwoŋi Wɛ telaao to mo.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Debam na maŋe dé jege tega baŋa nɔɔno wom nyenyego to, dɛ wora dé wó ba dé taa jege Wɛ telaao nɔɔno wom nyenyego.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lage a ta a bere abam we, dé logo baŋa yera yam bá wane ya na jeiŋa jei Wɛ woro kom ne. Ya na bá dáane ye ya pɔ to, ya bá wane ya maŋe de ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim to.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Fɔge-na á cheigi, se a lage a ta Wɛ chega kalo ya na seigi to a bere abam. Debam maama bá te. Dé nam ná tega naa dé ta wo tege, dé yera yam maama jege se ya leiri mo.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Ko wó pɔpɔ ko ke ne yi na bogese tei to mo, maŋa kam ba na wó wu Wɛ nabɔnɔ kolo na kweeli to. Nabɔnɔ kom ná wuga, twa wó bi ba zaŋe de yera yalo na ba jege pɔm to, ye debam yera yam maama wó leiri.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Konto maama ná seene ko leiri, ko laam wó pa kolo na popone Wɛ tɔn-dwoŋo kom wone to ji chega we, “Wɛ wane toone de de dam maama o di.”

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: “Toone, n dam dem daa bɛ? N daa‑n wó wane a nɔɔna bam n chɔge na?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ko ye nɔɔna wɛleera ŋwaane mo toone jege dam se de chɔge-ba. Wɛleera de nam jwoŋi ya dam Wɛ nia yam baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Dé ke Wɛ lei de o na pae se dé jwoŋi zeinim dé Teiru Yezu Krista tei ne se dé wane toone dam maama to.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Konto to, a nu-bi-swonnu bam, fɔge á zege-na lanyerane de pu-dɛa. Chɛ-na dé Teiru wom totoŋa yam baŋa ne maŋa maama, kolo ŋwaane á yei we totoŋa yalo maama á na toŋe á pa dé Teiru wom to dae kafɛ.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Ko daare á na wó ta‑á lae sabu tei á ma á zeini Wɛ nɔɔna to mo tento. Ta‑á ke-na nenɛɛne amo na tage a bere Yezu kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo Galatia te-nia yam ne se ba taa ke tei to.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Wɛ siu dɛ maama ne se nɔɔno maama twori nyɔɔre delo o na nɛ to wone o tiŋi, se ko pa amo ná tua, se ko daa yé taa jege se á la sabu.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Amo ná tu abam tei, a laam wó toŋe á na kuri nɔɔna balo to de twanno, se ba ja á sabu kom ba ja vo Jerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Ko nam daa ná maŋe se amo tete mo vo, dé wó tɔge daane dé vo. Pɔɔl lage se o na Korinti tiina

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: A lage se a da Makedonia mo se a laam daare a ba abam tei.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Amo ná tua, a lage se a dáane fee abam tei ne. Dɛ dedwoŋi ne a wó ti yadɛ dem. Abam laam wó wane á woli-ne se a vo a daa na wó vo mɛ to.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Amo ba lage se a wuuri a ba a na abam, se ko bá pa-ne chwoŋa se a dáane ye a daa vo jeiga kadwoŋi. Wɛ ná sɛ, a ya lage se a dáane abam tei ne mo.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Chwoŋa pore lanyerane ka pa-ne se a taa toŋe ywo-seeni de dam, ye nɔɔna dedɛ nam wora ba kwaana se ba che a yiga.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Timoti nam ná tu abam tei, se á ta‑á nii o baŋa ne se o bochare taa tiga. Kokuri o de toŋe dé Teiru wom totoŋa yam mo, ne amo de na ke tei.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno gwooni‑o. Kwaane-na se á woli‑o o chwoŋa baŋa ne, se o wane o vo de yazura o jwoori o ba amo tei. Amo nam nii‑o mo chwoŋa ne se o ba de dé nu-bia bam.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye dé nu-bu Apolo, amo tiini a kwoori‑o mo se o tɔge de dé nu-bia bam o ba abam tei. De ko de, o ta wo boŋe o ja se o ba leile. O nam ná nɛ chwoŋa maŋa de maŋa, o wó ba.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ta‑á pa-na á kikia maama tɔge de swono.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, á maŋe á yei Stefana de o sɔŋɔ tiina na yɔɔre ba tɔge Wɛ tei to. Banto mo dɛ yiga ba sɛ Yezu Akaya ne, ye ba kwei ba tete maama ba toŋe ba zeini Wɛ nɔɔna.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Konto to, a lwoori abam se á kwei á tete á ta‑á tɔge nɔɔna bam konto dwonna ni, dedaane balo na tɔge ba toŋe Wɛ totoŋa ne banto tei.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Amo jege wopwolo de Stefana, de Fɔtunata, de Achaku na tu amo tei to. Banto mo pɛ a wo lɔre we abam tera.

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: Banto mo pɛ a wo tiga, ne ba na ke abam de tei to. Ko ná ye nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi, ko maŋe se á ta‑á jege ba chega.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom maama na wo Asia te-nia yam wone to jɔɔne abam. Akwila de Pirisila, de Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na jeeri ba sɔŋɔ ne to de jɔɔne abam lanyerane dé Teiru wom yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam maama de jɔɔne abam. Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná ba jege dé Teiru wom swono, Wɛ wó yaale kotu o yiga ne. Dé Teiru wom wó ba.

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo á tei ne.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Amo swono taa wo á tei ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na tiŋi-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Timoti mo tɔge o woli-ne. Dé popone se dé pa abam balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á zoore Korinti ne to, ko woli de Wɛ nɔɔna balo na zoore Akaya teene dem maama ne to.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, dedaane dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Wɛ na tiini o zeini debam tei to

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri dé tiini dé jege abam teena, kolo ŋwaane dé yei we, abam na tɔge á na debam yaara yam dwoŋi to, á wó tɔge á na zeinim Wɛ tei ne, ko maŋe de o na zeini debam tei to.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé lage dé pa abam maane dé na kare Asia teene dem ne ye dé na yaara tei to. Dé na nɛ cham delo to tiini de dana de dwoi debam jaanem, ye dé boŋe we, dé wó ga dé ŋwea.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Dé nam na zege toone yiga ne konto to, ko ye se ko pa dé daa yé taa boŋa dé tete dam na ye tei to, se dé daare dé ke dé wo-dedoa de Wɛ, o na jege dam se o pa nɔɔna bi toone wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Abam nam wó zeini debam de á na lwoori Wɛ á pa debam tei to. Konto to, nɔɔna dedɛ ná lwoori Wɛ pa dé na zeinim, ko wó pa se nɔɔna dedɛ de seene ba ke‑o lei de o na jwoŋi ba wɛ-lworo kom to. Pɔɔl na leiri o boboŋa tei to

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Debam na jege teera tei to mo ye dé na tɔge chwoŋa abam tetare ne ye chaveera tera dé tei ne. Dé maa jege wo-pwoŋo mo ye dé yɔɔre dé bere dé wo de abam. Wɛ zaane dem mo zeini debam pa dé ye konto. Debam wo tɔge nabiina swa ŋwaane. Debam tɔge chwoŋa konto dwoŋi de nɔɔna maama ye ko fɔge ko ye abam ŋwaane.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Dé na popone kolo dé pa abam to ba jege wo-siseigiru. Á wó wane á ga-te ye á ni ko kuri.

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Amo na tiini a yei konto lanyerane to, a boŋe a ja se a bobo a ba abam tei, se ko pa á na zeinim kuni belei.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Kokuri a boŋe se a tɔge abam tei mo a vo Makedonia, se a ná maa jwoori dáane, se a daa tɔge á tei, se á laam wane á woli-ne se a kɛ Judea seeni.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nam jege chega ye o yei we debam na tɛ kolo de bere abam to dae nia yalei, nenɛɛne “Ɛɛ” de “Aawo” na gwaane daane tei to.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Ko ye Wɛ mo pae se dé tɔge de abam dé zege lanyerane Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Ko ta ye wonto mo kuri debam se dé taa ye o nyem.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we debam lage se dé fe abam de á na wó sɛ Wɛ chega kam tei to, kolo ŋwaane abam maŋe á sɛ‑o de pu-dɛa. Dé nam lage se dé woli abam, se á ta‑á jege ywoni Wɛ ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a jwoori a boŋe a ja se a daa yé ba abam tei, se ko pa wo-chechɔgɔ yé taa wora.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Abam mo ye balo na wó wane á pa se amo na ywoni. Konto to, amo ya ná tua, ye a pa se á wo chɔge, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá taa wora o na wó wane o pa se a na wopwolo.

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo a daama popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam. Amo déem ba lage se a ba á tei se ko pa amo wo chɔge abam ŋwaane. Ko nam maŋe se á ta‑á ye balo na pae amo wo pwoli to. Amo nam ke a wo dedaane abam we, amo ná jege wopwolo, abam de jege wopwolo mo.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Amo daama na popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam to, a boboŋa vugimi lanyerane, ye lwia jege-ne pa se a yi-na nwoŋi dedɛ abam ŋwaane. Amo na popone tei to, ko dae se ko pa á wo chɔge. Ko nam ye se á wane á lɔre amo na tiini a jege abam swono se ko ja gaale tei to mo. Ŋwaŋa durim taane

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam na ke o chɔge o dwoŋi yiga to pɛ abam maama wo chɔge, se ko dae amo yerane wo mo. Ko nam dae wo-chɛɔ amo tei ne. Kotu keim dem wo tiini de daane abam.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Abam dedɛ na pɛ se o na waarem to, ko maŋe se á laam yage.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane a lwoori abam se á pa kotu lɔre we, á jege o swono.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Amo daama na popone tɔnɔ kom to, ko ye se a maane abam a nii, á wó sɛ á tɔge amo ni dem woŋo maama baŋa ne, naa á bá sɛ.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Abam ná yage nɔɔno wolo keim á ma chɛ‑o, amo de tɔge konto mo. Nɔɔno wom za na ke kolo o chɔge to, amo yage a ma chɛ‑o. Ko nam ye abam ŋwaane mo a ke konto Yezu Krista yiga ne.

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: Dé nam jege se de duri nɔɔno wom ŋwaŋa konto, se ko yé pa setaana pɛ na chwoŋa o wane debam. De nam maŋe de yei wonto na boŋe se o pa debam tusi tei to. Wɛ chega kam tɔɔlem

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Amo na vei a yi Torase, ye a lage se a tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere nɔɔna da to, amo maane we dé Teiru wom ya pore chwoŋa se a ke konto.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: De konto de, a bochare ma tiini de di, de a na beeri Titusi jei a ga to. A na wo nɛ‑o konto to, a ma bane nɔɔna bam ye a daare a kɛ Makedonia.

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Nam pa-na se dé taa ke Wɛ lei. Maŋa maama wone wonto mo pae se dé tɔge Yezu Krista kwaga ye dé zeiŋi o yuu nɔɔna tei ne. Wɛ maa pae se nɔɔna tɔge debam ŋwaane mo ba lɔre Yezu taane jei maama ne, nenɛɛne woŋo kolo lwom na ywomma ye de jage de yi jei maama tei to.

english_verse: In fact, God thinks of us as a perfume that brings Christ to everyone. For people who are being saved, this perfume has a sweet smell and leads them to a better life. But for people who are lost, it has a bad smell and leads them to a horrible death. No one really has what it takes to do this work.
