translation_verse: Debam na yeini dé tɔɔle Yezu Krista chega kam dé bere nɔɔna maama tei to maa pae se dé nye de lwom delo na zaŋe de yi Wɛ tei pa o jege wopwolo to. Ko ná ye balo na lage ba ga ba ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to, lwom dem konto maa pae se ba jege maana we, toone wó ja-ba. Ko nam ná ye balo Wɛ na wora o jwoŋi-ba to, lwom dem wó taa jege ywoni ba tei ne, pa se ba jege maana we, ba wó na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam. Bera mo wó maŋe de totoŋ-kamunu kom konto dwoŋi?

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ na bere Wɛ kwora kam tei to, ba pae se ko nye de kolo ba na jege ba pipia se ba na nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne to. Debam nam dae konto dwoŋi. Wɛ na toŋe debam to, dé yeini dé kwei dé wo maama mo dé maa bere o chega kam, nenɛɛne dé zege o yiga ne dé ŋɔɔna Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Abam tete nam mo bere debam chega na ye tei to, nenɛɛne á ye tɔnɔ kolo nɔɔna maama na wane ba ga ye ko popone debam bochara ne to.

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: Abam na jege á ŋwea tei to mo nye de tɔnɔ kolo Yezu Krista na tɔge debam ŋwaane o popone to. O nam na popone tei to, o mɛ Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo o ke, ye ko dae bera mo o mɛ o ke. Poponem dem konto nam wo ke kandwa-pelɛ baŋa ne, se o ke-de abam nabiina bochara ne mo.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Dé yɔɔre dé yei we konto ye chega mo, Yezu Krista na pɛ dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: Kolokolo nam tera debam tete tei ne ko na wó pa debam chwoŋa se dé taa toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam konto to. Ko nam ye Wɛ zeinim dem mo pae se dé maŋe dé o totoŋa yam.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: O ma pa dé maŋe se dé taa bere nɔɔna o ni-doore dem na ye tei. O ni-doore dem o na gwoni o pa nabiina to nam ba tɔge ni-kaana yalo na popone tɔnɔ ne to. De nam tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo. Ni-kaana yam pae se toone mo nae chwoŋa de jaane nabiina. Ko daare Sin-laao kom nam mo pae se nabiina na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: Ko daare Wɛ Sin-laao kom na woli nɔɔna tei to laam wó pa se Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom tiini ko taa nae jaja mo.

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Ko na ye chega to, Wɛ laam na woli nɔɔna ye o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom tiini ko wora tei to bere we o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom déem na bere tei to maŋe ko dae kolokolo.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-kaana yam déem wora de o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ye yanto ba ya kɛ. Ko daare o zeinim delo na wó taa wora taa taa to wó pa se o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom tiini ko taa wora ko gaale.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Debam na jege Wɛ teena konto dwoŋi to, dé wae dé bere o chega kam de baare.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Dé nam bá seigi Wɛ chega kam nenɛɛne Moses déem na ke tei ye o kwei gɔrɔ o ma kwoli o yibia to. O ke konto se Isarele tiina bam mo yé taa nae o yibia kam nyeenem dem na wora de ti to.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Banto boboŋa ma kwaale pa se ba ná gage Wɛ ni-dwoora yam twanno tem, ba ware ba lɔre o chega kam kuri. Ko ye nenɛɛne gɔrɔ kom ta mo kwoli ba yia de zem maama. Nɔɔno ná me de Yezu Krista, konto mo wó pa se gɔrɔ kom dɔne konto tu yia ne.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná pipiri se o tɔge dé Teiru wom, ko wó pa se gɔrɔ kom dɔne konto tu yia ne.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Dé nam yei we dé Teiru wom de Wɛ Sin-laao kom maama ye bedwe mo. Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam ná wo nɔɔno wolo tei ne, kotu nɛ verem mo.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Debam na woli nɔɔna se ba lɔre Wɛ chega kam tei to ye o zaane dem mo pɛ dé toŋe konto. Konto mo pɛ dé vɔna bá pare.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Dé nam chuli wonnu telo nɔɔna na seigi ba ke ye te pa chaveera to. Dé ba tɔge swa baŋa dé gane nɔɔna, ye dé ba lage se dé pipiri Wɛ taane dem. Wɛ na nii dé kikia to, dé nam bere o chega kam mo jaja, se ko pa nɔɔna maama lɔre we, dé na ke tei to tɔge chwoŋa.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Dé na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam tei to kuri ná seigi nɔɔna tei ne, ko ye balo na lage ba ga ba ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to yerane mo ka seigi ba tei ne.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Debam na yeini dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam tei to dae dé tete mo dé jege dé bere nɔɔna. Dé nam bere nɔɔna we, Yezu Krista mo ye nabiina Teiru, ye debam ye balo na toŋe dé pa abam o ŋwaane to mo.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Yaara yeini ya peene debam, ye ya ware dé yiga ya che. Dé boboŋa maa tiini ya vugimi, ye ya ware se ya pa dé vɔna pare.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna yeini ba bɛɛse debam, ye dé ba fɔge dé gɛ fara. Dé dona maa pae se dé toe tega ne, ye dé ba fɔge dé gɛ dé ŋwea.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Dé ŋwea wone toone maa yeini de kwaana se de go debam maŋa maama, dé na sɛ Yezu to ŋwaane. Konto to, dé yera yalo na wó ba ya te to wae ya bere we, Yezu pɛ dé na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Dé na yaare abam ŋwaane tei to bere we, toone wora de chɔge debam, se ko pa abam wane á na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ko maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Amo na ke a wo-dedoa de Wɛ to mo pɛ a ŋɔɔna.” Debam de na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ konto dwoŋi to mo pae dé ŋɔɔne o chega kam.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Dé yei we, Wɛ mo bi dé Teiru Yezu toone wone, ye o ta wó bi debam de se dé na ŋwea o tei ne, dé na me de Yezu to ŋwaane. Konto mo Wɛ wó pa se debam de abam maama tɔge daane dé vo dé zege o yiga ne.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Dé na ke tei to maama ye abam zeinim ŋwaane mo. Konto ŋwaane, Wɛ na pae se o zaane dem zaŋe de yi nɔɔna dedɛ tei to mo pae se ba ke o lei dedɛ, se ko pa o jwoŋi zula lanyerane.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Debam yera yam dé na jege logo baŋa ne to nye de vwei mo dé na zoore de wone. Dé nam yei we, vwei dem konto ná chɔge, Wɛ wó pa dé na sɔŋɔ telaao ne se dé taa zoore da. Ko dae nabiina mo lɔge sɔŋɔ kom konto. Ko maa wó taa wora taa se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: O ná pɛ dé zo sɔŋɔ kom konto, nenɛɛne dé na zo gɔrɔ tei to, dé daa bá taa nye de nɔn-kalambwollu tei.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Dé ta ná zoore dé logo baŋa vwei dem wone, dé yeini dé kone mo de cham. Ko nam dae we dé lage se dé de dé yera yam mo dé yage. Dé nam lage se dé zo kolo Wɛ na tiŋi o telaao ne se o pa debam to, se o ŋwe-doŋa kam laam pa dé yera yalo na tege to daa yé taa jege kuri.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Kolo na ye wo-chɛɔ ko pa debam to ye se dé taa pwoli o wo maŋa maama, nenɛɛne de ná tega dé daare dé yera yam, naa dé daa ta ná jege-ya dé ŋwe.

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane dé yei ko kuri dé na jege se dé taa kɔre dé Teiru wom to. Mo kokuri dé kwaana se dé pa nɔɔna boboŋa tɔge chega chwoŋa. Wɛ nam yei debam wo lanyerane. Amo boŋe we abam de wó ta‑á yei dé boboŋa na lana tei to.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we debam daa kwaana se dé bere dé chega mo de abam. Dé nam lage se dé zeini abam mo, se á wane á ta‑á jege teera debam ŋwaane. Ko nam ná ye balo na jege teera ba nenɔŋa ŋwaane ye ba bochara ba lana to, ba ná tu abam tei, á wó wane á ve-ba mo.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Á pae se dé ba jege boboŋa mo na? Ko ná seene ko ye konto, ko nam maŋe ko ye Wɛ ŋwaane mo. Dé swa nam ná wora, konto ye abam zeinim ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Dé na ke kolo maama to tɔge Yezu Krista swono kom ŋwaane mo. Kokuri dé laam maane we, nɔɔno dedoa mo tega se o leiri nɔɔna maama yuu ne, ye konto bere we ba maama de tɔge ba te mo.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: O na tege o pa ba maama konto to, ko ye se balo na jege ŋwea o ŋwaane to mo daa yé taa ŋwe ba tete fɔgem ŋwaane. Ba nam wó taa ŋwe Yezu fɔgem ŋwaane mo, de o na tega se o leiri ba yuu ne ye o daare o bi toone wone to.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Ko maama ye Wɛ kikia mo. O tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o fɔge debam de o tete daane, ye o daare o pa se dé taa woli nɔɔna se ba na o fɔgem dem konto.

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: Dé yeini dé bere nɔɔna we, Baŋa Wɛ dɛ Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o fɔge nabiina de o tete daane, pa se o daa ba jeeli ba wɛleera o ke o boboŋa ne. O ma kuri debam se dé taa bere nɔɔna o fɔgem dem konto na ye tei to.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Mo Wɛ na tiŋi debam se dé leiri Yezu Krista yuu ne dé taa bere nɔɔna o chega kam tei to. Ko maa nye de Wɛ tete mo wo debam tei ne o ŋɔɔna. Dé nam lwoori abam Yezu Krista yere ŋwaane se á sɛ se á de Wɛ fɔge daane.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Debam na sale Wɛ dé toŋe o totoŋa yam to, dé lwoori abam se á yé zaŋe á pa Wɛ zaane dem o na pɛ abam to ji kafɛ.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maŋe o ta we: “Maŋa kalo na maŋe se a ke zaane á yuu ne to, amo cheigi á wɛ-lworo kom. Dɛ dem na yi se a vere abam a yage to, a seene a zeini abam.” Nii-na! Maŋa kam yia se Wɛ ke zaane o ke abam yuu ne. Ko ye zem mo o lage o vere abam o yage. Pɔɔl yaara yam taane

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Dé ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o yaale dé totoŋa yam. Konto ŋwaane dé ba ke kolo na wó chɔge nɔɔno yiga to.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Dé nam na ke tei to, dé kwaane dé bere dé chega mo se ko pa nɔɔna lɔre we, dé ye Wɛ tontoŋena. Kolo maama ná yeini ko ke debam, dé yeini dé vɔ dé wo dedaane yaara, de cham, de lwia yalo na daane debam to.

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: Ba fere debam de kaasa. Ba ma ja debam ba ke peena diga ne kuni dedɛ. Ba ta maa yeeri debam. Dé maa yeini dé toŋe totoŋ-chɛɛra. Dé maa ba dɔ dé sui. Kana maa tiini ka ni debam.

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: Dé mae boboŋ-laaro, de yeino, de ban-peno dé maa toŋa, ye dé kwori dé nege nɔɔna lanyerane. Dé maa tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam baŋa dé toŋa, ye dé jege nɔɔna swono chekke.

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: Dé maa bere nɔɔna wonnu telo na ye chega to Wɛ dam ŋwaane. Dé na yɔɔre dé tɔge chega chwoŋa tei to pae dé cho de tete, nenɛɛne dé na zei jara wonnu jagwia ne de jazem ne to.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badwonna pae debam zula, ye badaara yaale debam. Badwonna maa twe debam, ye badaara pae debam chega. Badaara maa pae dé ye balo na gane nɔɔna to, ye dé nam yɔɔre dé tɔge chega mo.

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: Badaara pae dé ye nɔn-yɔɔro mo, ye dé nam jege yere nɔɔna dedɛ tei ne. Badwonna pae dé lage dé te mo, ye dé nam ta ŋwe. Ba mage debam yera, ye ba nam wo wane ba go debam.

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maa ke ba pa dé yiga nyɔne, ye dé ta di ywoni maŋa maama. Nɔɔna pae se yiniga jege debam, ye dé nam woli nɔɔna dedɛ de wo-laaro. Nɔɔna pae se dé ba jege kolokolo, ye wonnu maama nam wo debam jeŋa ne mo Wɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: Amo badwonna Korinti tiina bam, a kwei a bochare maama a ma ŋɔɔne de abam jaja. Amo maa tiini a swoi abam de a bochare.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Ko dae amo mo chege debam swono kom daane, se ko nam ye abam mo.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Amo nam lwoori abam, ne á ye amo bia mo tei, se á ta‑á jege amo swono kom dwoŋi á bochara ne. Jwona de Baŋa Wɛ ware ya toŋe daane

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Abam nam yé zaŋe á kwei á tete á gwaane de balo na ve se ba tɔge Yezu to. Ko nye de nabea de bonaga na bá wane se tɔge daane se va tei to. Lam de lwarem ware ya tɔge daane. Pwooni de lim ware ya taa wo jeiga dedoa.

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Yezu Krista de setaana pɛ nam bá wane ba taa jege boboŋe dedwe. Wolo na sɛ Yezu to de wolo na wo sɛ‑o to bá wane ba me daane.

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Ko ná ye jwona, yanto bá na chwoŋa se ya taa wo Wɛ diga kam ne. Debam nam mo nye de Wɛ tete diga kam, de o na zoore debam tei ne to. Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ déem tage o we: “Amo wó taa zoore a nɔɔna bam tei ne, ye a tɔge de-ba a via. A maa wó taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom, ye ba de wó taa ye amo tete nɔɔna.

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, nwoŋi-na da banto tei ne, ye á daare á pɔɔre á tete de-ba.” Wɛ daa ta we: “Yé digiri-na á tete de wonnu telo maama na ye wo-zɔɔna to. Konto mo amo wó sɛ a jwoŋi abam.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Amo wó taa ye abam Kwo, ye abam de wó ta‑á ye amo bu-baara de a bukwa.” Mo Paŋwa Tu Baŋa Wɛ wom na tage tei.

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, Wɛ na pwooli kampwola de o nɔɔna bam konto to, ko maama ye debam ŋwaane mo. Mo kokuri á pa-na se dé le dé tete wo-zɔɔna yalo maama na lage ya chɔge dé kikia dedaane dé boboŋa to wone. Pa-na se dé taa kwaana dé jege wo-pwoŋo fase, dé na kɔre Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Pa-na chwoŋa se debam swono taa wo á bochara ne. Debam nam wo ke dé chɔge abam wolowolo yiga. Dé wo pɛ se nɔɔn-nɔɔno tusi. Dé ta maa wo pini abam wolowolo wonnu.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Amo na tage tei to, ko dae we a lage se a yaale abam mo. Amo maŋe a ta de abam we, dé ná ŋwe, naa dé ná tega, dé ta tiini dé jege abam swono mo dé bochara ne.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a yei abam wo, ye a jege teera abam ŋwaane. Abam maa pae se amo bochare peini tega ne. Konto ŋwaane mo, yaara yalo maama na jege debam to, amo ta nae ywoni ya wone.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye chega mo we, debam na vei dé yi Makedonia to, dé wo nɛ siu de fenfee de. Yaara dedɛ ma tiini ya ja debam. Nɔɔna déem mage ni-kantɔgɔ de debam, ye foone tiini de zo debam.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Amo nam yei we, amo na popone tɔnɔ kolo a pa abam to mo pɛ á jege wo-chechɔgɔ. Amo boboŋa nam wo jwoori ya za ko poponem dem ŋwaane. Boboa ne to amo boboŋa ya zaga de a tɔnɔ kom na pɛ abam wo chɔge tei to. Ko nam wo tiini ko daane abam ko kɛ.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Amo laam jege wopwolo ye ko dae abam wo na chɔge to ŋwaane mo, se ko ye á wo-chechɔgɔ kom na pɛ se á leiri á wo tei to. Wɛ nam mɛ á wo-chechɔgɔ kom o jwoŋi abam, se á yé na lɛɛro debam ŋwaane.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔno ná jege wo-chechɔgɔ Wɛ ŋwaane, ko wó wane ko pa o leiri o wo se o daare o na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, ye konto mo lana nɔɔna maama tei ne. Ko daare nɔɔno nam ná jege wo-chechɔgɔ ne logo baŋa nabiina na jege-ko tei to, ko pae se wonto ba o ga o ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Maane-na á nii á na jege wo-chechɔgɔ Wɛ ŋwaane ye ko pa se á ye tei to. Ko pɛ se á yia seene o ŋwaane, ye á ta kwaane se á bere á na jege bora tei to. Bane de foone maa jege abam. Á jege amo fera. Abam maa chana Wɛ ŋwaane, ye á kwaane se á waare wɛleere-keira. Abam na ke kolo maama to maa bere we, á jege bora ye taane daa tera.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Amo na popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam to, ko dae wolo na ke o chɔge to ŋwaane, ye ko dae wolo chɔgem dem na ke o yuu ne to ŋwaane. Amo nam lage se a pa abam mo lɔre jaja Wɛ yiga ne we, abam seene á yia debam ŋwaane lanyerane.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo dé bochara peini tega ne. Debam na nɛ Titusi to, dé ma na wopwolo ko gaale se ko woli de dé bochara na maŋe ya peini tega ne tei to. Kokuri dé ma lɔre we, Titusi jege wopwolo abam ŋwaane, de á na pɛ se lwia daa tera o tei ne to.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Amo na toŋe‑o se o ba abam tei to, a déem seini abam a bere‑o. Abam nam wo yaale amo tia yam. Konto to, debam na tei abam dé bere Titusi tei to jigi chega, ne dé na yeini dé tɛ chega de abam maŋa maama tei to.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: O ná yeini o guli abam gula, ko pae se o tiini o jege abam swono se ko gaale. O maa yeini o guli abam na sɛ á pa debam lanyerane, ye á daare á jeeri‑o lanyerane de foone tei to.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Amo na yei abam wo lanyerane woŋo maama baŋa ne to mo pae a jege wopwolo dedɛ.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, dé lage se dé pa abam lɔre Wɛ na ke Yezu kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo Makedonia te-nia yam ne to zaane tei to mo.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: Yaara dedɛ ma yi-ba ye ba nam ta di ywoni dedɛ pa se ba wo ywomma de nɔɔna. Yiniga na maŋe ka jege-ba to, ba daa ta ma woli nɔɔna lanyerane.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Ko na ye chega to, ba woli nɔɔna se ko maŋe de ba tete na jege tei to, ye ba ta pa se ko dwoni ba tete na wó daare kolo to.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Ba nam mo mɛ ba boboŋa ba tiini ba lwoori debam se dé pa-ba chwoŋa se ba tɔge ba woli Wɛ nɔɔna balo yiniga na jege-ba to.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo dé maŋe dé kwoori Titusi se o daa woli abam, se abam de tɔge Wɛ zaane dem ŋwaane á ta‑á lae sabu. Wonto mo bobo o kwoori abam se á ta‑á ke konto, ye o laam wó woli abam se ko ba ko kweeli.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa tei to maŋe ko lana se ko gaale, ne ko ná ye á wo-dedoa keim, de á ŋɔŋa kam, de á yeino kom. Á ta kwori á seene á yia de Wɛ totoŋa, ye á tiini á jege debam swono. Nam kwaane-na se á ta‑á jege wo-ywoŋo dedɛ á woli da, pa se á zeini á dwonna lanyerane.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Amo nam ba lage se a fe abam de á na wó la sabu tei to. Amo nam kwaana se a pa abam mo lɔre nɔɔna badwonna na seene ba yia ba woli ba dwonna tei to. Konto mo amo wó wane a lɔre abam swono kom ye chekke naa ko dae.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Abam déem na boŋe se á ke konto to, á boboŋa yɔɔre ya tɔge-ko mo. Leile konto, daa ta ta‑á tɔge konto dwoŋi se ko ba ko kweeli. Pɔɔre-na á wonnu wone se ko maŋe de á jeŋa na jege tei to.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Amo nam ba kwaana se a pa abam na woli nɔɔna tei to taa chana á baŋa ne, se ko daare ko pa á na woli balo to na paare. Ko nam ye se á ta‑á teili daane mo.

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: Leile konto abam jeŋa gara, pa se á wane á woli balo yiniga na jege-ba to. Ko daare, yiniga ná tu ka ja abam, banto de daa wó wane ba pɔɔre ba wonnu tem wone ba ma woli abam. Konto mo á maama wó ta‑á teili daane.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Ko nye de ko na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nɔɔna balo na pɛ wodiu dedɛ to daa wo nɛ se ko dwoni ba dim. Ko nam wo muri ko pa balo na pɛ fenfee yerane to.”

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Dé ke Wɛ lei de o na pɛ se Titusi yiga wo abam wone, se ko yi debam de na ye tei de abam to.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: O ma yɔɔre o sɛ debam na lwoori‑o se o ke kolo abam wolim ŋwaane to. Wonto boboŋa nam maŋe ya ja se o ba abam tei, de o na seene o yia se o woli abam to.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Dé nam lage se dé pa dé nu-bu wodwoŋi mo tɔge de Titusi o ba. Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo jei maama ne to nege‑o lanyerane de o na tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam tei to.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Ba ma daare ba kuri‑o se o woli debam wone o tole o la sabu kolo dé na yeini dé ma dé zeini nɔɔna to. Dé na lage se dé pa nɔɔna na wolim konto to, ko ye se dé Teiru wom mo na zula, ye se dé bere we dé boboŋa tɔge nɔɔna wolim dem konto.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Debam na lage sabu-fɔrɔ kom ye dé pɔɔre-ko dé pa nɔɔna tei to mo, dé ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o yaale debam ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Dé nam kwaane se dé ke kolo na lana dé Teiru wom yiga ne, dedaane nabiina de yiga ne to mo.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo dé daa ta lage se dé toŋe dé nu-bu wodwoŋi se o tɔge de banto o ba á tei. Kuni dedɛ mo dé maane we wonto yɔɔre o tɔge chwoŋa, ye dé lɔre we o yia seene de Wɛ totoŋa yam. O laam ma ba o lɔre á wo na ye tei to lanyerane, ye ko pa se o tiini o boŋe á wolim.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Titusi, debam ye bedwe mo, ye dé tɔge daane dé toŋe abam ŋwaane. Ko daare ko ná ye badaara bam, ko ye wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam mo le-ba se ba taa toŋa, se ko pa Yezu Krista na zula.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Amo nam boŋe se a pa dé nu-bia bam ba abam tei, se ko pa debam na jege teera á ŋwaane tei to yé ba ya ji kafɛ. Konto mo wó pa á wane á ti á yiga nenɛɛne amo na maŋe a ta a bere-ba we á wó ke tei to.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Ko ná dae konto, Makedonia tiina ná tɔge de amo ba ba abam tei, ye ba lɔre we, á ta wo ti á yiga, ko wó pa chaveera ja debam de dé na jege á chega tei to. Ko maa wó pa chaveera ja abam de.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a boboŋa jaane se a ta dé nu-bia bam se ba da amo yiga ba wuuri ba ba abam tei. Konto wó pa á wane á la pɛɛra yam á ti, nenɛɛne á na tiŋi ni se á ke tei to, se amo laam ba a jwoŋi-ya. Amo lage se á ma á wo-ywoŋo mo á pa sabu kom, se á yé tɔge kɔro ŋwaane.

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Ko nye de nɔɔno ná dugi wonnu fenfee, konto tu wó jwoori o ba o na fenfee mo. Ko daare wolo ná dugi dedɛ de o boboŋa, konto tu wó ba o na dedɛ.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama jege se o pa pɛɛra se ko maŋe de o boboŋa na jaane tei to mo, ko dae se o fe o tete o ke kolo na wó chɔge o wo to. Ko nam ná ye wolo na pae de o wo-ywoŋo to, Wɛ swoi konto tu mo.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Wɛ na jege abam swono to, o maa wae o zeini abam de o zaane maama, se ko pa á seene á ta‑á jege kolo maama á na lage to maŋa maama, ye á daa ta jege dedɛ se á ta‑á ma á ke wo-laaro á woli á dwonna.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se á jeŋa taa gara de wo-laaro maama, se á wane á woli nɔɔna maŋa maama. Konto maa wó pa nɔɔna dedɛ taa ke Wɛ lei, ba na jwoŋi abam pɛɛra yam debam tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Abam na jege Wɛ nɔɔna á woli tei to mo pae se ba nae kolo ba ya na gɛ to. Ko nam dae konto yerane, se ko ta wó pa nɔɔna dedɛ tiini ba taa ke Wɛ lei ko ja gaale.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Abam wolim dem konto mo wó bere we á yɔɔre á tɔge Wɛ, ye ko pa se Wɛ na zula dedɛ, de nɔɔna bam na lɔre we, á seene á sɛ Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam, ne á na tage we á ye tei to. Wɛ ta wó na zula nɔɔna tei ne, de á na pɔɔre á wonnu á pa-ba, ye á daare á pa nɔɔna badwonna de tei to.

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó taa lwoori Wɛ abam ŋwaane, ye ba jege abam swono ba bochara ne, Wɛ na tiini o ke abam zaane to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Pa-na dé ke Wɛ lei, de o na woli debam maama de o zaane delo na ba jege dwoŋi to.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, dé ta yaale berem delo maama na zaŋe se de che nabiina Wɛ chega kam wone to. Dé maa vere boboŋa yam konto maama dam, ye dé pae ya leiri ya tɔge Yezu Krista ni dem.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Maane-na á nii ko na ye tei to. Abam wolo boboŋa ná bere we o ye Yezu Krista nyem, se konto tu ma o boboŋa yam o lɔre we, debam de ye Yezu nyem mo ne wonto tei.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye chega we, amo tiini a bere a tete de Wɛ na pɛ debam dam delo to, amo nam ba kɔre chaveera de konto. Dé Teiru wom pɛ debam dam dem konto se dé taa mae dé fɔge abam mo, ye ko dae se dé ma chɔge abam.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Amo ba lage se abam boŋe we, a popone a twanno tem mo se a ma fugi abam.

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: Abam badaara tɛ we, wonnu telo amo na ke a twanno tem wone to mo chana á tei ne, ye te ta kwori te dana. Ko daare amo tete ná wora á tei ne, amo ye zurim yerane mo ye a ni taane dae kolokolo.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam, dé bá sɛ se dé bere dé tete se ko gaale. Dé na bere dé tete tei to bá gaale Wɛ na pɛ debam chwoŋa se dé taa tɔge-ka tei to. Chwoŋa kam konto mo dé jege dé maa toŋe abam tei ne.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Dé bá sɛ se dé bere dé tete de totoŋa yalo nɔɔna badaara na ke to, se konto ya mo wó gaale kolo na maŋe de debam to. Dé nam na jege teena abam ŋwaane tei to, ko ye se abam na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to mo fɔge ko ke dam, se ko pa totoŋa yalo dé na ke abam tetare ne to wane ya puli dedɛ, ye ya ta maŋe de totoŋa yalo Wɛ na pɛ debam to.

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: Ko daa ta wó pa dé na chwoŋa dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé gaale abam na zoore jei selo ne to. Konto mo dé bá taa bere dé tete de totoŋa yalo na maŋe ya ke ye ya ye Wɛ tontoŋeno wodwoŋi nyem to.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere we, “Wolo ná boŋe se o taa mage o nyɔɔne, se o pa ko taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔno wolo ná bere o tete chega, ko dae we kotu seene o jege chega, se ko nam ye wolo dé Teiru wom na bere o chega to mo.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Amo nam jege lwia mo de abam we, nɔɔna badaara wó soge á boboŋa se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge Yezu Krista de á bochara maama, nenɛɛne setaana pɛ wom déem na jigi basankwea ye ka ke swa ka gane Awa tei to.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔno wodwoŋi ná tu abam tei, ye o bere abam Yezu wonnu telo na ba tɔge debam berem dem to, á yeini á sɛ mo mɔle mɔle. Á ma‑á yeini á sɛ á tɔge jworo kodwoŋi, ye ko dae kolo á na maŋe á jwoŋi debam tei ne to. Á daa ta sɛ kwora kadwoŋi, ka na dae kwor-ywoŋa kalo debam na bere abam to.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Amo mo ware a ŋɔɔne pore-pore ne banto tei, ye yeino nam wo a tei ne. Maŋa maama dé maŋe dé pa á lɔre konto jaja woŋo maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a ga woŋo maŋa kam a na wo á tei ne to, a ba yaare abam wolowolo. Ko nam ye dé nu-bia balo na nwoŋi Makedonia ba ba to mo jaane kolo maama a na lage to ba ba ba pa-ne. Amo déem na maŋe a ba yaare abam to, a daa ta bá yaare abam.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Amo nam na ke tei to, ko bere we a ba jege abam swono mo na? Wɛ nam yei ko na ye tei to.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Amo ta wó taa toŋe zɛɛra, ne a na maŋe a ke tei to, se ko pa balo na lage ba bere we ba toŋe ne debam tei to daa yé na chwoŋa se ba bere ba tete konto.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Banto nam na toŋe tei to ye ba gane nɔɔna mo. Ba maa pae se ba tete ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa, ye ko maama ye vwa mo.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Konto nam dae wo-kenkagele. Setaana pɛ tete wae o leiri o tete o bere we, o ye maleka kalo na nwoŋi Wɛ tei to.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ko bá taa chana se setaana pɛ tontoŋena bam bere ba tete we, ba ye tontoŋena balo na tɔge Wɛ chega kam to. Ko kweelim jei ne mo banto wó na waarem se ko maŋe de ba kikia na ye tei to.

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Amo daa ta lwoori abam se á yé ta‑á boŋe we amo ye nɔn-jworo mo. Abam nam ná maŋe á boŋe we amo ye konto mo, se á kwaane á ja á bochara se a wane a na chwoŋa a bere a tete fenfee ne banto tei.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Amo na lage a ŋɔɔne tei a bere a tete kamunim to, ko ba tɔge dé Teiru wom boboŋa, se ko nye de jworim mo.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ nam na yeini ba tɔge nabiina boboŋa ba ma bere ba tete to, amo de wó bere a tete konto dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á sɛ balo na ye nɔn-jworru to de wopwolo, ye á nam pae ko ye swa mo á jega.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Á yeini á ja á bochara de wolo maama na tu abam tei ye o jege fefeo to. Ko ta ná ye wolo na di nyɔɔre á baŋa ne to, naa wolo jeŋa na zo abam to, naa wolo na gwooni abam to, naa wolo na lɔge abam popɔŋɔ to, á yeini á sɛ kotu.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam, dé kɔre foone se dé bɛɛse abam konto dwoŋi. Konto nam wó pa-ne chaveera na? Nɔɔno nam ná wora ye o ba kɔre chaveera se o bere o tete de kolo maama to, amo de bá kɔre chaveera se a ke konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Banto ná bere we ba toŋe Yezu Krista totoŋa mo, amo nam tiini a dwoi-ba. Amo na toŋe a pa Yezu tei to tiini ko chɛ a yera ne se ko dwoni banto. Ba jaane amo ba ke peena diga ne kuni dedɛ se ko dwoni banto. Ba daa ta ma fere amo dedɛ se ko dwoni banto. Amo dɛ toone tei kuni dedɛ se ko gaale.

english_verse: Five times my own people gave me
translation_verse: Kuni benu mo Juu tiina bam jaane amo ba fere fintɔ-nogo (

english_verse: lashes with a whip.
translation_verse: ) de kaasa.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara de ma ja-ne kuni betɔ ba mage de da-lɔŋɔ. Maŋa kadwoŋi ne ba ma dole-ne de kandwa se ba go. Kuni betɔ mo a zo nabworo a tɔge naneo kom wo, ye ko ba ko chɔge ko maŋe na bam wone. Dɛ dedwe amo ma yɛ na bam baŋa ne tete de wea maama.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Amo yeini a beeri mo maŋa maama. Amo na beeri konto to, wonnu dedɛ mo daane-ne, ko maa ye bwi na su se wɛɛle, de venverena mo daane-ne, ko woli de amo tete nɔɔna Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina de daane-ne. Ko woli da, amo nɛ cham teene dem wone, de kagoa wone, de naneo kom wone, ko ta woli de nɔɔna balo na pae ba ye dé nu-bia ye ba dae to tei ne.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Amo maa yeini a toŋa pa se ko chɛ a yera ne. Ko ma pae se a ba dɔ a sui. Kana de na-nyɔm maa jege-ne ye a peena. Waaro maa yeini te zoore-ne ye a ba jege gwaaro.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Kolo nam na woli da to, amo na jege lwia a pae wɛ-di sem maama nɔɔna to mo tiini ko daane a boboŋa dɛ maama.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno bochare ná bwona Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem seeni, ko pae amo de tɔge a ye konto mo. Nɔɔno ná dɛ o dwoŋi ŋwaane o to tusim wone, ko pae a bane fuli mo.

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye fefeo se a bere a tete, amo jege se a taa jege teera de wonnu telo na bere we a bwona to.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ yei we amo ba fɔ vwa. Wonto maa ye dé Teiru Yezu Kwo, ye o maŋe se o taa jwoŋi teem taa wuu.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Amo déem na wo Damasika teo kom wone to, gɔmena tu wolo na nii teo kom o pa Pɛ Areta to ma tiŋi nɔɔna teo kom ni dem ne, se ba yere amo ba ja ba pa‑o.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ko fe-ne mo se a taa bere a tete. Ko nam ba jege nyɔɔre, ye a ta wó ta dé Teiru wom na veere wo-kenkagela yalo o bere-ne se a na to.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Leile konto amo ti a yiga se a ba abam tei, se ko ke kuni betɔ mo. Amo nam daa ta bá daane abam se á pa-ne wolim. Ko nam dae á wonnu naa á sabu mo a laga, se ko ye á tete mo. Ko nam maŋe ko ye kwoa mo lage wonnu se ba tiŋi ba bia ŋwaane, se ko dae bia mo wó ke konto ba pa ba kwoa. Abam nam nye de a bia mo.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Amo wó taa jege teera nɔɔno wom konto ŋwaane mo. A nam bá sɛ se a bere a tete, ko ná dae wonnu telo na bere we a bwona to yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Amo ya ná boŋe se a bere a tete, ko ya bá taa ye jworim mo ko pa-ne, a na wó yɔɔre a ta chega to ŋwaane. Amo nam bá sɛ a bere a tete konto. Amo ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno boŋe kolo na dwoi amo ŋɔŋa de a totoŋa to o pa-ne.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Wɛ le wo-kenkagela dedɛ o bere-ne se ko gaale, ye o nam ba lage se a tɔge te baŋa a bere a tete kamunim. Mo kokuri o pɛ se cham jege-ne ko daana, ne sabare na zɔge-ne tei to. Ko maa ye kolo setaana pɛ wom na tɔge ko ŋwaane o yaare-ne to.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Kuni betɔ mo a lwoori dé Teiru wom se o le cham dem konto a tei ne o yage.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: O nam wo sɛ, ye o ta o we, “Amo zaane dem nam wó yi se ko maŋe de nmo. Nmo ná bwona, ko wó pa se amo dam dem tiini de taa jege kuri nmo tei ne.” Mo kokuri amo wó taa jege teera de wonnu telo na bere we a bwona to. A maa wó taa jege wopwolo te ŋwaane, se ko pa Yezu Krista dam dem taa kwoli-ne.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo, amo ná yeini a bwona, naa nɔɔna ná jege-ne ba twea, naa cham de bɛɛsem de lwia ná jege-ne, amo ta jege wopwolo konto baŋa ne Yezu Krista ŋwaane. Kokuri to, amo ná yeini a bwona maŋa kalo to, a nae dam lanyerane. Pɔɔl na jege lwia o pa-ba tei to

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Amo na bere a tete tei to ye jworim mo, ye ko ye abam na chuchugi-ne to ŋwaane mo a ke konto. Abam ya mo jege se á bere amo chega kam. Ko ye chega mo we, amo dae kolokolo. Ko nam ná ye balo na pae ba ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa ye ba pa ba dwoi maama to, a wo muri banto yiga ne de fenfee de.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Amo déem na wo abam tei ne to, á nɛ wo-kenkagela yalo na bere we, amo seene a ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe to. Amo na ke tei to, a vɔge a wo mo ye a ke wo-kamunnu telo na bere Wɛ dam to.

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Abam laam lɔre we, amo déem ba daane abam wolim ŋwaane. Nɔɔna badaara nam tɛ we, amo ke swa mo abam baŋa ne.

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Titusi, a déem kwoori‑o mo se o ba abam tei, ye a toŋe dé nu-bu wodwoŋi se o tɔge ded‑o. Titusi nam wo maŋe o pini abam kolokolo. Abam pae se Titusi de amo boboŋa dae bedwe mo na? Debam na tɔge chwoŋa tei to dae bedwe mo na?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Abam boŋe we, ko ye abam yiga ne mo dé ŋɔɔne se dé jwoŋi dé tete na? Dé nam na me de Yezu Krista to, ko ye Wɛ yiga ne mo dé ŋɔɔna. A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, dé na ke kolo maama to seene ko ye abam fɔgem ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Amo daa ta jege lwia a pa abam we, amo ná tua, amo Tu Wɛ wó pa se a daa na chaveera abam ŋwaane, abam dedɛ na wo leiri á wo de wo-zɔɔna yalo á na maŋe á ke to ŋwaane. Amo ná nɛ konto, ko wó pa se a wo chɔge dedɛ de á ta na ke wo-digiru kikia yalo maama na tɔge ka-laga seeni, ye á wo yage to.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Amo na lage a ba abam tei leile to, ko laam lage ko ke betɔ mo. Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere we, “Nɔɔno ná lage se o saŋe o dwoŋi, ko jege se nɔɔna balei naa batɔ mo pu o kwaga.”

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye chega we, o na jigi nabiinu ye o bwona to mo pɛ se o te dagara yuu ne. Ko daare o laam jege ŋwea Wɛ dam dem ŋwaane mo. Debam na me ded‑o to, debam de bwona mo. Dé nam ná tu abam tei ye dé toŋe tei to wó tɔge Wɛ dam dem ŋwaane, dé na me de Yezu ye dé ŋwe to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á maane á tete mo, se á daare á nii, á tɔge Wɛ de wo-dedoa na. Abam ná faŋe á tete konto, á bá lɔre we Yezu Krista wo á tei ne na? Naa ko ye abam faŋe á tete mo ye á ga?

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Amo nam boŋe se á lɔre we, debam mo wo faŋe dé tete dé ga.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Dé yeini dé lwoori Wɛ dé pa abam se á yé ta‑á ke tusim kikia. Ko dae we dé lage se nɔɔna mo taa jege debam chega. Dé nam lage se á ta‑á ke kolo na lana to, de nɔɔna ná maŋe ba bere we debam mo toŋe dé ga de.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Debam bá sɛ se dé ke kolo na wó chɔge Wɛ chega kam to. Dé nam wó taa ke kolo na wó fɔge-ka to mo.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Abam ná jege Wɛ dam dem, ye debam ná maŋe de bwona, dé ta jege wopwolo mo. Dé nam wó taa lwoori Wɛ se o taa fɔge abam fase.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo a popone wonnu tento a pa abam ye a tera á tei ne, se amo ná tu á tei, se a daa yé ke keim-chɛɛre abam baŋa ne de dam delo dé Teiru wom na pɛ-ne to. Dam dem konto ye se a ma a fɔge abam mo, se ko dae se a ma a chɔge abam.

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, Wɛ wó pa á jeini lanyerane. Kwaane á pa se Wɛ fɔge abam fase. Ke-na á boboŋa ne amo na kwoori abam tei to. Ta‑á jege-na boboŋe dedwe, se á daare á ta‑á jege bochare-zuru. Wɛ wolo na pae swono de bochare-zuru to wó taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane á pa Wɛ zula.

english_verse: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia balo maama na wo amo tei ne to de jɔɔne abam balo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á zoore Galatia wone to.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista nam mo dɛ dé Kwo Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to maama, ye o sɛ se o te debam wɛleera ŋwaane, se o ma wane o vere debam leile logo baŋa wo-lwanno tem dam wone.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maŋe de zula maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena. Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Abam na ke tei to nam mo pɛ se amo yera sɔɔre. Wɛ dɛ Yezu Krista zaane dem ŋwaane mo o kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem, ye á laam zaŋe á ma á kwaga á ya wonto, se á daare á sɛ kwor-ywoŋa kadwoŋi.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Ko na ye chega to, kwor-ywoŋa kadwoŋi maŋe ka tera. Nɔɔna badaara nam tu á tei ye ba pa á boboŋa vugimi de ba na kwaana se ba pipiri Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam tei to.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná tu á tei ye o bere abam kwora kadwoŋi, ye ka dae kwor-ywoŋa kalo dé na maŋe dé bere abam to, se á yé sɛ konto tu. Ko ná maŋe ko ye debam tete wo nɔɔno dedoa, naa ko ná ye Wɛ telaao maleka, ye o ná bere abam kwor-ywoŋa kadwoŋi, Wɛ wó yaale konto tu o yiga ne.

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Amo nam ta wó jwoori a fɔge a ta, nenɛɛne debam na maŋe dé ta kolo de abam to. Nɔɔno ná tɔɔle kwora kadwoŋi o bere abam, ye ko dae kwor-ywoŋa kalo á na maŋe á sɛ to, Wɛ wó yaale konto tu o yiga ne.

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Amo na tɛ tei to wó pa se á lɔre we, a lage a na zula mo Wɛ tei ne, ye ko dae nabiina tei ne. Amo daa ta ba boŋe se a pa nabiina mo me de amo. A ya ná boŋe konto, a daa bá taa ye Yezu Krista kabaa. Ko na ke tei ye Pɔɔl ji Yezu nɔɔno to

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lage se á lɔre we, kwor-ywoŋa kalo amo déem na tɔɔle a bere abam to wo tɔge nabiina dam ŋwaane.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Ko dae nabiinu mo kwei-ka o pa-ne se a tɔɔle. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam wo kwei-ka o ma o zamese-ne. Yezu Krista tete mo le-ka o bere-ne.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Abam maŋe á ni amo déem na tɔge chwoŋa kalo ye a sɛ Juu tiina chullu tem to. Amo déem tiini a bɛɛse Wɛ kɔgɔ kom maama. A ya kwaana se a chɔge-ba de ba dwi maama.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye amo yuudwonna bam, a déem dwoi ba dedɛ de a na tɔge Juu tiina chullu tem tei to. Amo chɛ lanyerane de a na sɛ dé nabaara bam chwei sem tei to.

english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Amo daa ta wo vei Jerusalem se a na balo na maŋe ba ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa to. Amo nam na ke kolo to, a yɔɔre a vo Arabia seeni mo a wora. A daa ma jwoori a vo Damasika.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Bena yatɔ na kɛ to, a laam ma zaŋe a vo Jerusalem se a na Piita se dé lɔre daane. A ma ke bakwa yalei o tei ne.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Amo daa wo nɛ Yezu totoŋa nakwe wodwoŋi a woli da, se dé Teiru Yezu nyaane Jemsi yerane mo a nɛa.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Amo na popone wonnu telo to maama ye chega mo. Wɛ yei amo wo. Ko nam dae vwa mo a fɔe.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Ko kwaga ne a laam ma zaŋe a tole a vo Siria de Kilikia jei sem.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Yezu Krista tɔgena balo na tigisi daane Judea te-nia yam ne to, banto yi déem ta wo nɛ amo.

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Ba na nigi amo taane konto to, ko ma pa ba zuli Wɛ lanyerane.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Bena fuga-yana na kɛ to, a ma jwoori a vo Jerusalem. A ma tɔge de Banabas a vo, ye a ja Titusi a woli da.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ko nam ye Wɛ mo bere-ne pa a vo dáane. A ma vo a na balo na ye nenɛɛne Yezu tɔgena yiga tiina to. A na nɛ-ba to, a ma pa debam yerane mo jeini dé ŋɔɔne daane, se a pa ba lɔre kwor-ywoŋa kalo amo na yeini a tɔɔle a bere dwi-gɛ tiina bam to. A ba lage se a déem na tɔge chwoŋa kalo to, de a na wo kalo wone leile to ji kafɛ.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Titusi wolo na tɔge de amo o vo Jerusalem to maa ye Girisi tu. Ba nam wo fe‑o ba pa se o gwoni o peini, ne Juu tiina bam na ke tei to.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara nam wora ba na pae se ba ye Yezu tɔgena ye ba dae to. Nɔɔna bam konto ya ŋɔge mo ba zo Yezu kɔgɔ kom wo, se ba maane debam ba nii dé na jege dé tete ye dé me de Yezu Krista tei to. Ba nam lage se ba pa dé jwoori dé ji kabɛ mo Juu tiina chullu tem ŋwaane ye de maŋe dé le dé tete te wone.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Dé nam wo pɛ ba na chwoŋa se ba ke konto dwoŋi de fenfee de, se ba yé wane ba chɔge chega kalo abam na maŋe á tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane á sɛ to.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Banto nam nɛ we, Wɛ seene o tiŋi-ne se a kwei o kwor-ywoŋa kam a ja vo a bere dwi-gɛ tiina, se ko maŋe de o na ke-ka Piita jeŋa ne se o ma bere Juu tiina tei to.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Piita maa ye Yezu totoŋa nakwe se o vo o woli Juu tiina bam. Amo de maa ye o tontoŋeno se a vo a woli dwi-gɛ tiina. Ko maama nam ye Wɛ dam ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Jemsi, de Piita, de Jɔn balo na ye nenɛɛne Yezu tɔgena dedɛɛra to ma lɔre we, ko ye Wɛ mo pɛ-ne zaane se a taa toŋe totoŋe dem konto. Konto ŋwaane ba ma sɛ amo de Banabas dedaane dé na toŋe de-ba tei to, ye ba ja dé jea. Debam maama ma sɛ we, amo de Banabas jege se dé vo dwi-gɛ tiina jei sem ne mo dé bere-ba Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Banto de maa wó vo ba tɔɔle-ka Juu tiina jei sem ne.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Woŋo kodwoŋi yerane ŋwaane mo ba lwoori debam se dé yé swei ko ni ne. Ko ye se dé kwaane dé woli yiniga tiina balo na wo ba kɔgɔ kom wone to. Amo ya maŋe a lage se a ke konto dwoŋi mo. Chullu tɔgem taane

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa kalo Piita na tu Antioka ye a na‑o to, a laam ma bwɛ‑o nɔɔna yiga ne se a bere‑o we, o daa ba tɔge chega chwoŋa.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Konto mo a nɛ we, ba daa ba tɔge chega kalo Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere to. A laam ma zege ba maama yiga ne ye a ta de Piita a we, “Nmo ye Juu tu mo. N kikia nam tɔge dwi-gɛ tiina chwei mo, ne n dae Juu tu mo tei. Bɛ mo ye n laam boŋe se n fe dwi-gɛ tiina bam se ba taa sɛ Juu tiina chullu tem?”

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Debam balo na me de Yezu Krista to jege teena we, dé wó na chega Wɛ tei ne. Debam nam ná tu dé ji nɔn-chechɔgero Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni, konto wó bere we Yezu tete mo gane debam se dé tusi mo na? Konto bere ko bá taa ye chega.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Amo nam tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam ŋwaane a le a tete ya dam kuri ne. Ko nye de a tega mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam seeni, se a wane a na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Amo bá sɛ se a ve Wɛ zaane dem o na pɛ-ne to. Nɔɔno nam ná wane o na chega Wɛ tei ne de o na tɔge o ni-kaana yam tei to, ko ya wó bere we Yezu Krista toone dem ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: Abam Galatia tiina boboŋa tera á yuu ne. Bera mo tulimi abam pa se á swa daa tera? Ba déem tɔɔle ba bere abam jaja ko na ke tei ye Yezu Krista te dagara kam yuu ne to.

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Amo lage se a bwei abam woŋo kodwoŋi yerane mo a nii: Abam déem na sɛ Wɛ Sin-laao kom se ko taa wo á tei ne to, bɛ mo pɛ ko ke? Ko ye abam kikia na tɔge Wɛ ni-kaana yam to ŋwaane mo na? Aawo. Ko ye á na sɛ o kwor-ywoŋa kam á na nigi to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Wonnu telo maama na yi abam to wó ji kafɛ mo á tei ne na? Aawo. Te bá wane te ji kafɛ!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Wɛ nam woli abam de o Sin-laao kom, ye o daare o ma o dam o ke wo-kenkagela á tei ne. O na ke konto to, ko ye á kikia na tɔge o nia yam to ŋwaane mo na? Aawo. Ko nam ye á na sɛ o kwor-ywoŋa kam á na nigi to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa á lɔre we, Abaraham dwi tiina chekke ye balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ to mo.

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Konto to, balo maama de na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ne Abaraham déem na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo wó jwoŋi swolim Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Dé nam yei lanyerane we, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá na chega Wɛ tei ne de o ná tɔge o nia yam yerane. Ko nam popone we, “Wolo na jege chega Wɛ tei ne to wó na ŋwea o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Yezu Krista déem sɛ se o na chɔgem dem konto, se ko wane ko pa dwi-gɛ tiina de na chwoŋa se ba na Wɛ swolim o ŋwaane, ne Abaraham na nɛ Wɛ swolim tei to. Konto ŋwaane, debam wó wane dé jwoŋi Wɛ Sin-laao kom, ne Wɛ na pwooli se o pa debam tei to, dé na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ‑o to ŋwaane. Wɛ ni-kaana yam kuri na ye tei to

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lage a ma logo baŋa chega mo a ma bere abam Wɛ chega kam na ye tei to. Nɔɔna balei ná ke ni-sɛɛm, ye ba ná gwoni ni ba pa daane, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o chɔge ba ni dem konto, naa o ke woŋo kodwoŋi o daa woli da.

english_verse: What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made
translation_verse: Wɛ déem gwoni ni de Abaraham ye o pwooli kampwola de ŋwaane. Konto kwaga ne, bena bia yana de fintɔ (

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam ya ná wae ba jwoŋi o wo-laaro tem o ni-kaana yam ŋwaane, ko ya daa bá taa ye o kampwola kam ŋwaane. Dé nam yei we, Wɛ déem zeini Abaraham o kampwola kam ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Yiŋinu maŋe se o taa wora nɔɔna balei laŋa ne mo. Wɛ nam na ye ŋo dedoa to mo pa se o tete gwoni o ni de Abaraham ye yiŋinu tera.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa kam Wɛ ta na wo pore chwoŋa se dé ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ Yezu to mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam cheiŋi debam, ye dé laam ba dé lɔre wo-dedoa chwoŋa kam na ye tei to.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Konto mo Wɛ ni-kaana yam déem jege debam ya kwɛa, se ko vo ko yi maŋa kam dé na lɔre Yezu Krista to, se dé laam na chega Wɛ tei ne dé wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Wɛ laam na pore chwoŋa se dé ke dé wo-dedoa de Yezu to, woŋo daa tera ko na wó taa tei debam.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Abam na me de Yezu Krista to, á maama ye Wɛ bia, á na jege wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Abam wolo maama na jwoŋi sɛɛm pa se o me de Yezu Krista to laam nye de Yezu tete mo.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Konto to, popɔra tera Juu tu de dwi-gɛ tu laŋa ne. Popɔra ta tera kabaa de wolo na tei o tete to laŋa ne. Ko ná ye baaro naa kaane de, popɔra ta tera. Abam na me de Yezu Krista to, á maama ye ŋo dedoa mo.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Abam na ye Yezu nyem to, ko pa se á tɔge á ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo. Á maa wó jwoŋi wo-laaro, nenɛɛne Wɛ déem na pwooli kampwola de Abaraham tei to.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: O na ye nɔn-doŋo konto to, nɔɔna mo wora ba na nii o wonnu baŋa ne ba pa‑o, se ko taa vei maŋa kam o kwo na kuri se o taa tei o wonnu tem to.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Ko ye bedwe mo de debam de. Dé boboŋa déem ta na wo kweere se dé lɔre Wɛ chega kam na ye tei to, logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro mo tei debam ne dé ye kabɛ mo tei.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa kam dé Kwo Wɛ na kuri to na seene ka yi to mo o déem toŋe o tete Bu se o ba logo baŋa. O na tu to, ko ye kaane mo loge‑o, ye o sɛ o tɔge Wɛ nia yam,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: se o wane o jwoŋi balo bam ni-kaana yam na tei to. O ma ŋwe dé wɛleera jene se ko pa dé wane dé ji Wɛ bia.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Dé na seene dé ye Wɛ bia to, o ma toŋe o Bu wom Jworo kom se ko ba ko taa wo dé bochara ne, ye ko pae dé bwoi Wɛ we, “Dé Kwo, Baba.”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Konto maa bere we, dé daa dae kabɛ, se dé laam ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ bia mo. Dé nam na ye Wɛ bia konto to, Wɛ wó pa dé jwoŋi o wo-laaro tem maama dé taa tei. Pɔɔl jege lwia Galatia tiina ŋwaane

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Á wó wane á guli we, amo na bobo a ba abam tei ye a tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere abam to, ko ye jaweo mo jege-ne ye a ke konto.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: De konto de, a jaweo kom na tiini ko daane abam tei to, á wo sɛ se á yaale-ne. Abam nam ke-ne lanyerane, ne a ye Wɛ maleka mo tei. Ko maa nye de á na wó zuli Yezu Krista tete tei to.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Abam déem jege wopwolo de amo. Amo yei lanyerane we, á ya ná wae á yera, á ya wó fɔ á pa-ne, ne ko ya ná wó wane ko woli-ne. Bɛ nam mo kea ye á wopwolo kom chɔge?

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Amo na pɛ se á lɔre chega kam to ŋwaane mo pɛ se a ji abam dono na?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nɔɔna balo na pipiri Wɛ chega kam ye amo maŋe a ta ba taane to, banto kwaane ba ke abam lanyerane mo se á boboŋa tɔge-ba, ye ba nam ba boŋe se ba zeini abam. Ba lage se ba chɔge amo de abam mo daane, se á daare á ta‑á ke banto lanyerane.

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Abam balo na boŋe se á kwei á tete á pa Wɛ ni-kaana yam to daa ta wo lɔre Wɛ nia tɔnɔ kom na bere tei to.

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom bere debam we, dé nabaaro Abaraham déem jege bia balei. Kaane wodwoŋi na ye kabaa o sɔŋɔ ne to mo loge bakeira dedoa o pa‑o. Ko daare o tete kaane wom de ma lo bakeira o woli da. O tete nenɔŋa kaane wom yere mo Sara, ko daare kabaa kam yere mo Hagara.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Bakeira kalo kabaa kam na loge to lora tɔge nabiina chwoŋa na ye tei to mo. Ko daare bakeira kalo o nenɔŋa kaane wom na loge to lora nam tɔge Wɛ kampwola kam ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ko maa ye memaŋe mo de kaana bam konto, se ko bere debam chwei selei tɔgem na ye tei to. Kaana balei bam ta bere debam Wɛ na gwoni ni de o nɔɔna kuni belei tei to mo. Hagara mo bere ni-gwonim delo Wɛ na ke o pa Juu tiina bam Sinayi peo kom yuu ne to. Balo na tɔge ni-gwonim dem konto nye de kabɛ mo, ne Hagara de o bia na ye kabɛ tei.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nmo wolo na ye kadega ye n ta wo jaane puga n lo bu to, bage n yage de wopwolo, nmo na wó di ywoni to ŋwaane. Kokuri kaane wolo baro ya na yage‑o to laam wó ba o taa jege bia, se ko dwoni kaane wolo de o baro ta na wo daane to.”

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to Abaraham bu wolo lora na tɔge nabiina chwoŋa to mo bɛɛse o bu wolo lora na tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom chwoŋa to. Wɛ tete bia bam ta nae bɛɛsem konto dwoŋi de zem maama.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, “Zeili kaane wolo na ye kabaa to de o bu-baaro wom se ba viiri. Kolo ŋwaane kaane wonto bu wom bá tɔge de n tete nenɔŋa kaane bu wom o pɔɔre nmo wonnu tem o taa tei.”

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista na jwoŋi debam o yage to, ko ye se dé taa tei dé tete mo. Konto ŋwaane, á fɔge á che á tete se á daa yé sɛ á tɔge chwoŋa kalo na wó pa á jwoori á ji kabɛ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Abam balo na boŋe se á na chega Wɛ tei ne o nia yam tɔgem ŋwaane to yiga nam le mo de Yezu Krista, ye o zaane dem daa tere á tei ne.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ko daare Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam wo debam balo na ke dé wo-dedoa dé sɛ Yezu to tei ne, ye dé jege teena lanyerane we, dé wó na chega Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
