translation_verse: Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, dé ná gwoni dé peina, naa ya ná wo gwoni, ko dae kolokolo. Woŋo kolo nam na ye wo-chɛɔ to mo ye se dé taa jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, se ko pa dé taa tɔge da-swono kikia lanyerane.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Abam déem yɔɔre á tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa lanyerane. Wɔ nam mo chege á chwoŋa se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge chega kam?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Ko bere ko bá taa ye Wɛ mo chege abam konto. Wonto nam mo bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Debam maama na me de dé Teiru Yezu Krista to, a yei we dé wó taa jege boboŋa bedwe. Wolo wom na jege abam boboŋa o chɔge to nam jege se o na chɔgem de o keim-lɔŋɔ kom, o na maŋe o ye tei de.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, amo ba bere we, nɔɔno ná tɔge Wɛ, o jege se o gwoni o peini. Amo ya ná bere konto dwoŋi, nɔɔna bá bɛɛse-ne de a berem dem, kolo ŋwaane amo na bere Yezu toone dem dagara kam yuu ne tei to ya bá taa ye ta-balɔrɔ nɔɔna tei ne.

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, ko ye se á laam ta‑á tei á tete mo. Á na seene á tei á tete konto to, á nam yé pa se á kikia taa tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo maama á fera na zo to. Nam ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á tɔge swono chwoŋa se á ta‑á ma woli daane.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Kokuri Wɛ nia yam maama bere woŋo dedoa mo we, nɔɔno maama jege se o taa swoi o dwoŋi se ko maŋe de o na swoi o tete tei to.

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Abam nam ná yeini á ke daane ne vara mo chiŋi ye ba done daane tei to, á ta‑á yei se á wó ba á chɔge á tete de á dwi maama.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom nam ná cho abam, Wɛ ni-kaana yam daa ba jege se ya taa tei abam.

english_verse: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
translation_verse: Ya ta tɔge jwona kaanem de liri kikia. Ya pae se nɔɔna chuli daane ye ba jaane daane. Ya maa pa-ba puseŋa, de ban-zɔŋɔ, ye ba lage kamunim ba pa ba tete. Ya maa pae se nɔɔna pɔɔre daane yera yera.

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: Ya daa ta pae se nɔɔna wo gweena de ba dwonna, ba daare ba ye sa-nyɔra, ye ba ke poweeni de. Ya maa daare ya pae se ba ke wo-yɔɔro tedaara konto dwoŋi. Amo nam ta wó fɔge a kaane abam a woli da we, abam balo na yeini á ke wonnu tento dwoŋi to bá tɔge á na jeiŋa jei Wɛ paare dem wone.

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: de ka-taa-nege-daane, de ka-ja-n-tete. Ni-kaane nam tera de na vae keim-laaro tento dwoŋi.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ dé na ŋwe-doŋa to, dé pa-na se ko taa cho debam dé ŋwea wone.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Dé nam yé bere dé tete de dé dwonna, se dé yé lwɛ-ba, naa dé ke-ba puseŋa.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, á ná lɔre we nɔɔno ke keim o tusi, abam balo na jege Wɛ Sin-laao kom dam to wó pa se o jwoori o tɔge chwoŋa, ye á ta zuri á yera se á ta‑á nege‑o. Á nam ta‑á yei á tete, se ko yé wane ko soge abam se á de tɔge á tusi.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná bere o tete kamunni ye o dae kolokolo, konto tu gane o tete mo.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ba na zamese‑o Wɛ taane to jege se o pɔɔre wo-laaro telo o na tu o na to o pa o berem tu wom mo.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, dé nam yé pa se jawɔrɔ zo debam se dé yage wo-laaro keim. Dé ná fɔge dé zege konto dwoŋi, dé laam wó ba dé na nyɔɔre delo na lana to.

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Ta‑á nia, amo tete laam na mɛ a jeŋa a popone botare-bi-kamuna yanto se a pa abam.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, woŋo kolo yerane amo na wó paale-ko to ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista na tege dagara kam yuu ne se o jwoŋi nɔɔna tei to. Ko maa nye de amo de tɔge ded‑o mo a te, se ko bere we logo baŋa boboŋa daa tera a bochare ne, ye logo baŋa nɔɔna yiga tera amo wone, ne a ye too mo tei.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Nmo ná gwoni n peini, naa n ná wo gwoni-de, konto dae kolokolo. Woŋo kolo nam na ye wo-chɛɔ to mo ye se n jwoŋi ŋwe-doŋa Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na tɔge ŋwe-doŋa chwoŋa kam to, Wɛ wó pa ba na bochare-zuru, ye o daare o duri ba ŋwaŋa lanyerane, ko woli de balo maama na ye o tete nɔɔna chekke to.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Amo daa ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno jwoori o daane-ne, kokuri amo na maŋe a jege kalwanno telo a yera ne to bere we Yezu mo tei-ne.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo á bochara ne. Ameena.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Wɛ na zeini o bia tei to

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: Boboa ne ye logo baŋa daa ta tera to, Wɛ tɔge Yezu ŋwaane mo o kuri debam se dé taa jege wo-pwoŋo o yiga ne ye tusim tera.

english_verse: Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding,
translation_verse: ye o ma-de o zeini debam se ko ja gaale, ye o pa dé na swa de yi-poro lanyerane.

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye debam balo na dɛ yiga dé kwei dé teena dé daŋe Yezu Krista baŋa ne to, Wɛ déem kuri debam se dé taa ye balo na wó pa o na zula o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane to mo.

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a ke Wɛ lei ye a kwori a lwoori‑o a pa abam.

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ maa ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Yuu-tu, ye o ye debam Kwo wom na jege paare telaao ne to. A maa yeini a lwoori‑o se o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o zeini abam de swa de boboŋ-dɛɛra, se á wane á lɔre o chega kam maama.

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa á yia poore se á wane á lɔre o na kuri abam se á ta‑á jege teena o tei ne tei to, se á daare á lɔre o wo-laaro tem na tiini te beiŋi tei ye o tiŋi o ni se o kwei-te o pa balo na ye o nyem to.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa se á lɔre o dam dem na daga de gaale tei, ye o ma-de o zeini debam balo maama na sɛ‑o to. O dam-fɔrɔ kom konto bere o na wae o toŋe totoŋ-kamunnu tei to.

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: O déem mɛ-de o bi Yezu Krista toone wone mo, ye o daare o ma-de o zeiŋi‑o o pa o jeini o jazem seeni telaao ne.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Wɛ ma kwei wonnu maama o ke Yezu Krista dam kuri ne, ye o daare o tiŋi‑o se o taa ye o kɔgɔ kom yuu tu, se o taa tei wonnu maama o pa-ba.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Abam déem ye balo na ve Wɛ ni, ye á to tusim chwoŋa ne to mo. Ko ma pa se á ŋwea tera Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: Á déem ma tɔge chwei selo na ye logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem nyem to, ye á daare á tɔge setaana pɛ wolo na tei wɛyuu telaŋ-pwolo chichiri sem to. Wonto maa ye setaane delo laam na tei balo na ve Wɛ ni to.

english_verse: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo o pɛ debam o ŋwe-doŋa kam, dé na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. Wɛ na zeini debam konto to, ko ye maŋa kalo dé déem na tɔge tusim chwoŋa ye dé ba jege ŋwea o tei ne to mo. Wɛ nam mɛ o zaane dem mo o jwoŋi abam o yage.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, Wɛ ma pa dé tɔge ded‑o dé bi dé na o ŋwe-doŋa kam, ye o daare o zeiŋi debam se dé tɔge de Yezu dé na jeiŋa jei telaao ne.

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ke debam lanyerane Yezu ŋwaane konto to ye se ko taa bere nɔɔna maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu we, o zaane dem tiini de beiŋi.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Wɛ zaane dem mo o mɛ o jwoŋi abam o yage, á na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu to ŋwaane. O nam tɔge de ŋwaane o chɛ abam zɛɛra mo,

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: ye ko dae abam kikia ŋwaane, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o ke teera Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Wɛ ye debam Keiru mo. Dé na me de Yezu Krista to, o ma fɔge debam de o ŋwe-doŋa kam, se dé taa tɔge keim-laaro chwoŋa kalo o na maŋe o tiŋi o pa debam se dé da to.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne, abam de Yezu Krista déem yeiri da-jei. Ko ná ye Isarele dwi tiina kɔgɔ kom, á déem tere ba wone. Ko ta ná ye Wɛ nia yalo o na gwoni de o nɔɔna ye ya tɔge o kampwola kam ŋwaane to, abam yiga ta tɔge ka tera de-ya. Á déem na jege á ŋwea logo baŋa ne tei to, Wɛ tera á tei ne, ye á ba jege teena kolokolo baŋa ne.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Ko daare abam laam tu á me de Yezu Krista. Wonto toone jana bam ŋwaane ma pa se á ba á yi Wɛ tei, ye á ya maŋe á ye balo na ye yiga yiga ded‑o to mo.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Yezu Krista mo ye bochare-zuru tu ye o pa se ywoni wo debam laŋa ne, de o na pɛ Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina bam ba ba ji bedwe to. O ma saare siseini delo na pwɛ-ba ye ba chuli daane to.

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: O na sɛ se ba go o yera to mo pɛ se Juu tiina ni-kaana yam ji kafɛ, de ya na bere chullu telo maama to. Konto baŋa ne mo o fɔge Juu tiina bam de dwi-gɛ tiina bam o ke daane, se ba maama ji Wɛ kɔgɔ dedoa, ba na me ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: Ba maama na ye kɔgɔ dedoa konto to, o ma fɔge ba de Wɛ daane. O tɔge o toone dem dagara yuu ne ŋwaane mo o pa se ba daa ba chuli daane.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista na tu to, o ma pa dé lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam we, debam maama fɔge daane, ko ná ye abam dwi-gɛ tiina balo déem na ye yiga yiga ded‑o to, naa debam Juu tiina balo na maŋe dé bwola ded‑o to de.

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo debam maama jege chwoŋa se dé taa vei Wɛ tei, Wɛ Sin-laao kom na ye dedoa ye ko wo dé maama tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Abam balo na ye dwi-gɛ tiina to daa dae veira, nenɛɛne balo yiga na tera Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone to. Abam laam ye tembia mo Wɛ nɔɔna bam wone, ye á tɔge á ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom bia.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: O maa pae se sɔŋɔ kom lɔɔm maama tɔge daane lanyerane, ye o pa ko puli dedɛ se ko taa ye dé Teiru wom wara-jei.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Abam wó ta‑á yei amo ni ne, de Wɛ na pɛ se a toŋe a pa abam o zaane dem ŋwaane to.

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Abam nam nigi we, Wɛ mo le chega kalo déem na seigi o wone to o bere-ne. Amo maŋe a popone chega kam konto taane fenfee.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná gaga amo na popone kolo to, á wó lɔre amo boboŋa na zo Yezu Krista chega kam tei to.

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ wo pɛ se nabiina lɔre o chega kam konto. O laam tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa mo o le-ka o bere Yezu totoŋa nakwa bam de o ni-jwoŋina bam.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Wɛ chega kam konto tɔge o kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane mo, ye ka bere we, dwi-gɛ tiina balo na me de Yezu Krista to wó tɔge de Juu tiina ba jwoŋi wo-laaro telo Wɛ na tiŋi se o pa o nɔɔna bam to. Ba na me de Yezu Krista to, ba de ye Wɛ tete kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna mo, ye ba laam wó jwoŋi kolo maama Wɛ na pwooli se o pa o nɔɔna bam to.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane mo o zeini-ne de o dam-fɔrɔ kom se a taa toŋe o kwor-ywoŋa kam totoŋa.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Amo nam mo ye wolo na tiini a muri Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wone, ye Wɛ daa ta pa-ne totoŋ-ŋom dem konto, se a taa vei dwi-gɛ tiina tei a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere-ba, se ba lɔre Yezu Krista wo-laaro tem na tiini te beiŋi ye te ba jege tiim to.

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: Amo maa jege se a pa nabiina maama mo lɔre Wɛ chega kam jaja, de Wɛ na pɛ se ka tɔge chwei selo to. Wonto mo naane wonnu maama. Ko zege boboa ne, chega kam konto maŋe ka seigi o wone.

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: O ma seigi-ka se ko ba ko yi zem maŋa kam, se o laam tɔge Yezu kɔgɔ kom ŋwaane o pa se dedɛɛra balo maama na jege dam wɛ-baŋa jei sem ne to lɔre o swa yam na daga yera yera tei to.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: O maa tɔge o boboŋa yalo o na maŋe o ja faŋa faŋa to, ye o laam pa se ya seene ya ke dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Abam nam yé pa se á boboŋa chɔge de amo na yaare tei abam ŋwaane to, se ko ye abam yuu zeiŋim ŋwaane mo. Yezu swono kom na ye tei to

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo yeini a kuni dwoona dé Kwo Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: Wɛ zaane dem na tiini de beiŋi to ŋwaane, amo yeini a lwoori‑o mo se o tɔge o Sin-laao kom baŋa o pa á bochara na dam,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: se Yezu Krista taa tigi á boboŋa ne, de á na ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane. Amo ta lwoori‑o mo se o pa á ta‑á jege swono kolo na wó pa á nɛ tiini se kwaare tega ne to,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: O swono kom maa dwoi se nabiina lɔre ko na ye tei to ba ti. Wɛ nam wó pa se abam lɔre-ko, se Wɛ ŋwea kam laam su á bochara maama.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: Debam balo na ye o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom ye dé me de Yezu Krista to, Wɛ maŋe se o taa nae zula debam tei ne maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Amo na wo peena diga ne dé Teiru wom ŋwaane to, a lwoori abam se á pa á totoŋ-naga taa tɔge chwoŋa, se ko maŋe de Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye tei to.

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se abam ta‑á gwooni á tete mo, se á ta‑á nege daane maŋa maama, se á daare á ta‑á jege ban-peno, ye á woli daane de swono.

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: Seene-na á yia se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe, ne Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini abam ye á fɔge daane de bochare-zuru tei to.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Yezu nɔɔna bam ye kɔgɔ dedoa mo. Wɛ Sin-laao kom de maa ye dedoa, ne Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o ye á jege teenem bedwe ded‑o tei to.

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye dedoa mo, ye o ye debam maama Kwo. Wonto maa ye dé maama Yuu-tu. O maa tɔge debam maama baŋa o toŋa, ye o kwori o me de dé maama.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Ko nam popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “O na diini wɛyuu to mo o kale o dona bam o na wane-ba to o ja vo. O ma daare o pɔɔre o pɛɛra yam o pa o nɔɔna bam.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Ko na popone we, “o diini wɛyuu” to, ko kuri mo bɛ? Ko bere we o ya maŋe o tu tega baŋa ye o yi ka kuri.

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Wolo na tu tega baŋa konto to daa ta mo diini wɛyuu o kɛ Wɛ telaao wonnu tem maama yiga, se o wane o pa wonnu telo maama na wora to taa jege kuri.

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, debam maama laam wó ba dé taa ye bedwe, de dé na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom ye dé yei o chega kam tei to. Dé boboŋa laam maa wó tiini ya be lanyerane, se Yezu Krista ŋwea kam taa sui dé bochara maama.

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: Dé boboŋa daa bá taa bwona, nenɛɛne bu-balɛ boboŋa na ye tei to. Dé daa bá pa se dé boboŋa taa vei yiga de kwaga de nɔɔna berem, ne vio na fuli wonnu ko yage yiga de kwaga tei to. Dé daa bá sɛ dé tɔge nɔɔna balo na ke swa ba gane ba dwonna se ba tusi to.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Dé nam wó taa bere Wɛ chega kam mo ye dé jege da-swono, se ko pa dé boboŋa kweere ye dé me de Yezu Krista na ye debam Yuu-tu to.

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a kaane abam dé Teiru Yezu ŋwaane, se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge chwei selo dwi-gɛ tiina na tɔge de ba boboŋ-yɔɔro tem to.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Banto boboŋa ye lim mo, ye ba ŋwea ba tɔge Wɛ ŋwea kam na ye tei to, kolo ŋwaane ba wo lɔre Wɛ chega kam mo, ba na jege yi-dɛɛre to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Á na nigi Yezu taane to, ba seene ba bere abam o chega kam chekke.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Ba ma bere abam se á yage á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam de ka na pɛ á ye tei to. Á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam konto lage ka chɔge abam mo, de ka na gane abam se á fera taa zoore wo-yɔɔro telo na ba jege kuri to.

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: Á boboŋa maama nam jege se ya pipiri ya ji nadoora mo,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: se á daare á tɔge Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo o na ke o pa abam to. Ŋwe-doŋa kam konto nye de Wɛ tete ŋwea mo, ye ka pa á tɔge chega chwoŋa de wo-pwoŋo chwoŋa chekke.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane pa-na dé yage vwa fɔm, se dé daare dé taa tɛ chega dé bere daane, dé maama na ye kɔgɔ dedoa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: and don't give the devil a chance.
translation_verse: Á yé pa setaana pɛ na laŋa o chɔge abam.

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Wolo na lage ŋweene to daa yé taa ŋɔna. O nam jege se o taa toŋe o pa o tete mo de jawala, se o daare o wane o zeini yiniga na jege balo to.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Á yé pa se á ni taane taa jege lwarem. Nam ta‑á ŋɔɔne-na botare selo na wó fɔge nɔɔna ne ba na lage tei, ye se daare se zeini-ba lanyerane.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Yage-na puseŋa, de ban-lom, de wo-zɔŋɔ, se á daare á yage ni-kantɔgɔ, de toro, ko woli de keim-lwanno dwi maama.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ta‑á nege-na daane se á daare á ta‑á jege da-ŋwaŋa. Ta‑á ma‑á chɛ daane, ne Wɛ na yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam Yezu Krista ŋwaane tei to.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Abam na maŋe á ye Wɛ bu-swonnu to, se á ta‑á lwoni o kikia.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye vɛɛsa taane, de wo-jworru dwi maama taane, tento wo maŋe de abam, se á nam ta‑á ke Wɛ lei.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na lanyerane we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná tɔge wo-zɔɔna keim, naa ka-laga kikia, naa wolo ná ye nɔn-kwolo, konto tu bá fɔge o na kolokolo Yezu Krista de Baŋa Wɛ paare dem seeni. Nɔɔno ná pae o yi su wonnu, ko bere we o pa tento mo zula ne jwona tei to.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nam yé pa-na se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chwoŋa o gane abam de ta-yɔɔro. Keim-balwaaro tem konto dwoŋi mo lage te pa se Wɛ ban-lom dem zaŋe de balo na ve o ni to.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane lɔŋe-na balo na ke konto dwoŋi to.

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: Abam déem ya yeiri Wɛ pa se á wo lim wone. Abam nam na tu á me de dé Teiru Yezu Krista to, ko pɛ se pwooni laam wo á tei ne. Ta‑á tɔge-na chwoŋa se ko maŋe de balo na ye pwooni dem nyem tei.

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye kikia yalo maama na tɔge pwooni dem chwoŋa to, yanto mo ye wo-laaro telo maama na jege chega to.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Ja-na á tete se á lɔŋe wo-yɔɔro telo na ye lim dem nyem to, se á daare á pa nɔɔna lɔre jaja we, wonnu tem konto ba lana.

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Kokuri wonnu telo Wɛ-lwɛɛna bam na yeini ba seigi ba ke to tiini te jege chaveera se dé ŋɔɔne te taane.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Kokuri woŋo kolo maama kuri na lɔre jaja to laam wo pwooni yiga ne mo. Konto ŋwaane mo ba yeini ba tɛ ba we: “Dondɔɔno, zaŋe wɛɛne, se n bi toone wone, se Yezu Krista mo nye pwooni n baŋa ne.”

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á tɔge-na jworim chwoŋa, se á nam kwaane á lɔre kolo dé Teiru Yezu na lage se á ta‑á ke to.

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: se á ta‑á tɔge o ŋwaane á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei maŋa maama, de woŋo kolo maama o na pɛ abam to. Baara de ba kaana na wó ta nege daane tei to

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaana jege se ba taa sɛ ba pa ba banna, ne ba na sɛ dé Teiru Yezu tei to.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane kaane baro mo ye o yuu tu, ne Yezu Krista de na ye o kɔgɔ kom yuu tu tei to. O kɔgɔ kom maa nye de o yera yam mo, ye o ye ba fɔgeno.

english_verse: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna bam na sɛ ba pa‑o konto to, ko maŋe se kaana de sɛ ba pa ba banna mo wonnu maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye kan-banna, se á ta‑á swoi á kaana, ne Yezu Krista de na jege o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom swono ye o sɛ se o leiri ba yuu ne o te tei to.

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: O na tege ba ŋwaane konto to, ko ye se o saare ba bochara wo-digiru mo, se ba taa ye wose Wɛ ŋwaane. O tɔge Wɛ botare sem ŋwaane mo o zare-ba de na.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Ko ná maŋe ko ye kan-banna, ba jege se ba taa swoi ba kaana, nenɛɛne ba na lage ba tete yera yam tei to. Nɔɔno wolo nam na swoi o kaane to bere we o swoi o tete mo.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Kokuri nɔɔno tera o na vae o yera kwɛɛm. O nam wó nii ya baŋa ne, ye o di wodiu o ma kɔne-ya. Ko ye bedwe mo de Yezu Krista na nii debam balo na ye o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom to baŋa ne,

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: dé na tɔge dé nye de o yera yam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere debam we, “Baaro ná di kaane, o boboŋa daa ba tɔge o kwo de o nu boboŋa. O laam yeini o me de o kaane wom mo, ye ba balei bam ji yera dedoa.”

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Taane dem konto bere wo-lilirru mo. Amo laam kwei-de a ma ŋɔɔne Yezu Krista de o kɔgɔ kom taane mo.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye chega mo we, abam kan-baro maama jege se o taa swoi o kaane, ne o na swoi o tete tei to. Kaane maama de jege se o taa nege o baro mo.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye bia, á na sɛ dé Teiru Yezu to, ko maŋe se á ta‑á sɛ á tiina ni. Konto nam mo tɔge chega chwoŋa.

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na ye kabɛ to, se á ta‑á toŋe á tɔge á yuu tiina boboŋa. Ta‑á kɔre-na-ba ye á toŋe de jawala, nenɛɛne á na wó toŋe á pa dé Teiru Yezu tei to.

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae ba na zege ba nii abam maŋa kalo to yerane mo á wó ta‑á toŋe konto se á jwoŋi zula ba tei ne. Maŋa maama ta‑á toŋe-na de á wo maama, se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to, nenɛɛne á ye Yezu Krista tete kabɛ mo tei.

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: Ta‑á toŋe-na de wopwolo ye á pa se ko taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ye ko dae nabiina yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Kokuri á yei we, nɔɔno maama wó na nyɔɔre dé Teiru wom tei ne de keim-laaro telo maama o na ke to, ko ná ye kabaa mo naa nɔɔno de nɔɔno de.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na á jwoŋi Wɛ zeinim dem maama, se á wane á fɔge á che á tete ne á na lage á mage jara tei to, se setaana pɛ swa kikia maama yé wane abam.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, jwoŋi-na Wɛ jara zela dwi maama á ma á fɔge á che á tete, se lɛɛro maŋa kam ná yia, se á wane á chichei á fɔge á zege de baare, ye ko maama ná ti, á ta wó ta‑á zega á zega kam jei ne.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, ta‑á jege-na wo-dedoa de Wɛ se ko taa nye de nantana kalo á na zei á je ne se á ma che á tete de wo-lwanno tu wom che-tɛɛra na jege mini to.

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ko ye kwor-ywoŋa kam konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a leiri Yezu yuu ne a taa bere nɔɔna. Ba laam ke-ne peena diga ne a na bere-ka to ŋwaane. Nam ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ se o zeini-ne se a taa wae a tɔɔle-ka de baare, ne ko na maŋe se a taa ke tei to.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa dé nu-bia bam maama yazura, se ba taa jege da-swono de boboŋ-dɛɛra.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na yɔɔre ba jege dé Teiru Yezu Krista swono ba ba yaga to, Wɛ zaane dem taa wo ba maama tei ne.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Pɔɔl na lwoori Wɛ tei to

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amo na guli abam gula, a yeini a ke a Tu Wɛ lei mo abam ŋwaane.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amo na lwoori Wɛ a pa abam maama to, a yeini a di ywoni,

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: de abam na tɔge á toŋe á woli-ne de Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam totoŋa yam, ko zege boboa ne ko ba ko yi zem to.

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: Amo yei lanyerane we, Wɛ mo ye wolo wom na maŋe o bobo se o kwɛ abam bochara to, ye wonto wó yɔɔre o taa ke konto se ko vo ko ti dɛ dem Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba to.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Abam maama na jege fera amo tei ne to tɔge Yezu Krista tete na jege abam swono tei to mo. Wɛ wó zege amo kwaga ne we konto ye chega.

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: Konto mo á wó wane á kuri kolo na lamma chekke se á ke, ye Yezu Krista dɛ dem ná yia, se digiru yé taa wo á bochara ne, se á daare á na bora Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: Ko woli da, á kikia maama wó taa tɔge chwo-laao lanyerane, Yezu Krista na zeini abam to ŋwaane. Konto wó pa se Wɛ na zula de teem. Yezu Krista dwoi woŋo maama

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lage se á lɔre we, yaara yalo na yi amo to nam pɛ se Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam jage ka yi yiga mo.

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo we nɔɔna badaara tɔge wo-goo de ni-kantɔgɔ baŋa ne mo ba tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwora kam. Ko daare badaara nam bere-ka de ba boboŋ-laaro mo.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Banto bere-ka de swono mo, kolo ŋwaane ba yei we Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a zege o kwor-ywoŋa kam kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: Badwonna bam nam bere Yezu kwora kam se ko pa ba tete mo kamunni, ye ba ba jege wo-pwoŋo. Ba nam boŋe we, ba wó wane ba chɔge amo yuu mo, amo na wo peena diga ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Ko nam ba chɔga. Amo ta jege wopwolo de ba maama na tɔɔle Yezu Krista kwora kam ba bere nɔɔna tei to. Ba ná bere-ka de boboŋ-laaro naa boboŋ-balwaaro de, ko ye Yezu taane dem mo ba bera. Amo nam wó tiini a taa jege wopwolo,

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: kolo ŋwaane a yei we, Wɛ wó jwoŋi-ne o yage, abam na lwoori‑o á pa-ne tei, de Yezu Krista Sin-laao kom na pa-ne zeinim tei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a jege teena we, a bá zaŋe a ke kolokolo na wó pa a na a chaveera. Amo nam wó taa jege pu-dɛa se, a ta ná ŋwe naa a ná tega, se Yezu Krista na zula a kikia maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Amo tei ne, a ŋwea ye Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo. A nam ná tega, ko wó taa ye nyɔɔre mo ko pa-ne.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Wonnu tento telei mo pae a boboŋa vugimi. Kolo na jege fera ko pa-ne to mo ye se a yage logo baŋa, ye a daare a vo Yezu Krista tei a taa wora. Konto wó tiini ko taa lana amo tei ne.

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: A yei we konto ye chega, ye ko pɛ a lɔre we, ko maŋe se a taa wo logo baŋa ne. Amo wó taa wo abam maama tei ne se ko pa á fɔge á tɔge Wɛ chega kam, ye á tiini á di ywoni ka ŋwaane.

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: Konto to, amo ná jwoori a ba a wo abam tei ne, ko wó pa se á tiini á ta‑á zuli Yezu Krista de wopwolo amo ŋwaane.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Kolo maama ná lage ko ke, se abam nii á kikia yam se á pa ya taa tɔge de Yezu Krista kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere tei to. Konto to, amo ná nɛ chwoŋa se a ba abam tei, naa a ná wo nɛ, amo ta wó lɔre we, abam zege lanyerane de boboŋe dedwe, ye á tɔge daane á kwaana á toŋa á pa chega kalo Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam na bere to.

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: Amo daa ta wó lɔre we, abam dona bam wo nɛ chwoŋa se ba pa foone ja abam de fenfee de. Á na jege á tete tei to wó pa ba maane we, Wɛ wó ba o chɔge-ba ye o daare o jwoŋi abam o yage. Wɛ tete mo wó pa ko ke.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Wɛ na zeini abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o tei to, ko dae se á sɛ Yezu Krista de á wo-dedoa yerane, ko ye se á kwori á na yaara de mo o ŋwaane.

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: Abam déem nɛ amo na toŋe a pa Wɛ ye a yaare tei to, ye á ta kwori á ni we, ko ye bedwe mo de zem. Abam laam tɔge á toŋe konto dwoŋi ye á yaara.

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: Ko na seene ko ye konto to, a lwoori abam se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe daane, de swono bedwe, se á daare á ta‑á jege ni-sɛɛm á pa daane. Abam ná ke á tɔge konto dwoŋi, ko wó pa amo tiini a taa jege wopwolo.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Á yé mage á nyɔɔna naa á lage kamunim á pa á tete. Nam gwooni-na á tete á pa daane, se á ta‑á nege á dwonna maama lanyerane.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Á boboŋa yam jege se ya taa ye nenɛɛne Yezu Krista na boŋe tei to mo.

english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: O nam na ke tei to, o tiŋi tento maama dáa ne mo, ye o pa o tete ji ne kabaa tei. O déem ma ba o nye de nabiina.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane Wɛ laam ma zeiŋi Yezu yuu wɛ-wɛ de zula, ye o daare o pa‑o yere delo na dwoi yera maama to.

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: Ba maama ni taane wó ta jaja we, Yezu Krista ye ba Teiru. Konto wó pa dé Kwo Wɛ na zula lanyerane. Dé wó pa pwooni taa wora logo baŋa ne

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, ko maŋe se á maane á nii maŋa kalo amo ya na wo á tei ne ye á sɛ amo ni to. Amo nam na tera leile to, á jege se á tiini á ta‑á sɛ amo ni se ko ja gaale. Ta‑á kɔre-na Wɛ lanyerane ye á yera sae, se á kwaane á pa o na jwoŋi abam o yage tei to ja kuri lanyerane.

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane Wɛ mo yeini o ke dam á bochara ne, pa se á lage kikia yalo na wó su o yi ye á wane-ya á ke.

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: Konto mo á wó ta‑á jege chega Wɛ tei ne, ye lwarem bá taa wo á bochara ne. Á wó ta‑á ye Wɛ bia balo na ba jege tusim ye á zoore nɔn-balwaaro balo boboŋa na ba tɔge chwoŋa to tetare ne. Á wó ta‑á jege pwooni á pa logo baŋa, ne chalechwe tei,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: de á na ŋɔɔne Wɛ ŋwea botara kam á bere nɔɔna tei to. Á ná ke konto dwoŋi, ko wó bere we, amo na chɛ a toŋe Wɛ totoŋa abam ŋwaane tei to dae kafɛ. Amo wó taa jege teera de abam, dɛ dem Yezu Krista na wó jwoori o ba to.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Abam na kwei á wo-dedoa á sɛ Yezu to nye de á kwei woŋo mo á ma á kaane Wɛ ye ko pwoli o wo. Dɛ delo amo laam wó ga a ŋwea, pa se ka ji wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre ka woli abam kaanem dem wone ka pa Wɛ. Amo ná lage a te se ko pa Wɛ zula konto, amo wó taa jege wopwolo, ye a lage se abam de na wopwolo ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Ɛɛ, ko maŋe se abam de taa jege wopwolo lanyerane, se dé maama tɔge daane dé na ywoni dedɛ. Timoti de Epafarodi taane

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Debam Teiru Yezu ná sɛ, amo boŋe se a toŋe Timoti se o ba abam tei leile. Konto wó wane ko pa se, o ná jwoori o ba o pa-ne abam labaare, se a daa yé taa jege lwia a pa abam.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera amo tei ne o na jege amo boboŋa yam dwoŋi, ye o yiga wo abam wone, ko ná dae Timoti yerane.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Balo maama na daare to lage ba tete wonnu yerane mo, ye ba ba lage Yezu Krista wonnu tem.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Timoti, abam maŋe á yei o wo na tɔge chega tei to. O déem tɔge de amo o tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam, nenɛɛne bu na lage se o tɔge o kwo o toŋe tei to.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri a boŋe se a toŋe‑o abam tei ne, ne amo ná lɔre we, ba wó pore-ne ba yage, naa ba bá pore-ne.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom nam pɛ a jege teena we, ba wó pore-ne ba yage leile ye a laam ba abam tei.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Amo boŋe we ko ya maŋe se a toŋe Epafarodi se o jwoori o ba abam tei. Wonto ye dé nu-bu mo. O ma tɔge de amo o toŋe Wɛ totoŋa, ye dé kwori dé chana ya baŋa ne. O maa ye abam tontoŋeno wolo á na le á wone se o ba o woli-ne a yaara yam ŋwaane to.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: Abam fera laam maa jege‑o, ye o lage se o daa na abam. O wo ya chɔge de á na lɔre we, o ya ba jege yazura to.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo we, o ya weela ye o da toone tei o kɛ. Wɛ nam mo duri o yiniga. Ko nam dae wonto yiniga yerane mo o duri. Wɛ duri amo de yiniga, de o na pɛ o wori ye amo wo daa wo tiini ko chɔge ko daŋe da-baŋa ne to.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, amo yɔɔre a lage se o yi abam tei lela, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo de á na jwoori á na‑o to, ye amo de lwia yam laam jei.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: O ná tua, se á jeeri‑o lanyerane de wopwolo dedɛ, o na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ŋwaane. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á nege nɔɔna nenɛɛne wonto dwoŋi tei.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Kokuri o ya dɛ toone tei o kɛ Yezu Krista totoŋa yam ŋwaane mo. O déem lage o ga o ŋwea de o na leiri abam yuu ne se o taa toŋa o woli-ne to.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a jege kolo fenfee na daare to se a ta a woli da. Wɛ wó pa á ta‑á jege wopwolo dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Amo na maŋe a popone kolo a ma bere abam to, ko bá taa chamma se a jwoori a bere-te abam, se ko wane ko che abam wo-lwanno wone.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Fɔge-na á che á tete de wo-lwan-keira balo na kwaane se ba taa gwoni nɔɔna yera ba yage to. Banto ye vara mo.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Debam nam mo ye Wɛ nɔɔna chekke, ye ko dae dé na gwoni dé peina to ŋwaane, ne banto na bere tei to. Debam tɔge Wɛ Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo dé zuli Wɛ. Yezu Krista mo ye wolo dé na maa teere to, ye dé bá ke dé boboŋa de chullu telo na bere we nɔɔna yera gwonim jege kuri ko pa Wɛ.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Amo déem na nɛ da nana to mo ba gwoni a peini, ne Juu tiina chullu tem na bere tei to. Ba na loge-ne to, a ye Isarele tu mo, ye a nwoŋi Benjamin dwi tiina bam wone. Amo yɔɔre a ye Hiburu dwi tu chekke mo. Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam tɔgem, amo déem wo Farisi tiina kɔgɔ kom wone mo.

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: Amo na toŋe de yi-seena a pa Wɛ tei to, a tiini a bɛɛse Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna. Ko ta ná ye Wɛ ni-kaana yam sɛɛm, amo déem tɔge chwoŋa chekke ye tusim tera.

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: Konto to, amo wó wane a maŋe se Wɛ bi amo de toone wone. Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem taane

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye debam balo boboŋa na kweere de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to, ko maŋe se debam maama sɛ we, amo na tage tei to ye chega mo. Abam badaara boboŋa nam ná ba tɔge konto dwoŋi, Wɛ wó pa á lɔre woŋo kolo na ye chega to.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: De konto de, ko maŋe se dé yɔɔre dé taa tɔge chwoŋa kalo dé na maŋe dé lɔre we ka ye chega to mo.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, ko maŋe se á ta‑á lwoni amo kikia yam mo, se á maane á nii balo na tɔge chwo-laao, nenɛɛne dé na bere abam se á ta‑á tɔge tei to.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Ko kweelim jei ne Wɛ wó chɔge banto de ba dwi maama. Ba yeini ba zuli wonnu telo fera na jege-ba to ko dwoi Wɛ. Ba maa jege teera de kolo na maŋe de ba chaveera to, ye logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro boboŋa jege-ba.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam, dé kugu jei wo Wɛ telaao woro kom ne mo. Konto ŋwaane, dé cheigi dé Vereno wom se o nwoŋi dáane mo o ba. Debam Teiru Yezu Krista mo konto.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a swoi abam lanyerane ye á fera jege-ne. Abam pae amo ywoni jege wopwolo, ye a kwori a jege teera de abam. A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, kwaane-na á fɔge á zege lanyerane dé Teiru wom ŋwaane.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: A nam lwoori Yuodia de Sintika lanyerane se á ta‑á jege boboŋe dedwe, á maama na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye nmo wolo na ye a dwoŋi tontoŋeno chekke to, a lwoori‑m se n zeini kaana banto se ba taa sɛ daane, kolo ŋwaane ba déem tɔge de amo ye dé tiini dé toŋe dé bere nɔɔna Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Kelɛmɛn de nɔɔna badaara na wo a tei ne to de déem toŋe konto dwoŋi. Wɛ maŋe o popone banto yera o ŋwe-doŋa kam tɔnɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na wopwolo maŋa maama dé Teiru wom ŋwaane. Amo ta wó jwoori a ta we, á ta‑á jege wopwolo.

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Pa-na se nɔɔna maama lɔre á na zuri á yera mo tei. Kokuri dé Teiru wom bá dáane ye o ba.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Konto mo Wɛ wó pa á bochara taa zura se ko taa dwoi nabiina na wó wane ba lɔre ko na ye tei to, se kolokolo yé wane ko chɔge á bochara de á boboŋa maama, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Ta‑á toŋe-na á tɔge wonnu telo amo na bere abam ye á sɛ-te to. Abam maŋe á lɔre amo ni taane dem de a kikia maama na bere wonnu tem konto tei. Á ná seene á tɔge-te, bochare-zuru tu Baŋa Wɛ wó taa wo á tei ne. Lei keim

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Amo tiini a jege wopwolo dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, kokuri ko dáane ye abam daa wo guli a gula se á woli-ne, ye leile konto á laam jwoori á zeini-ne. Ko nam dae we abam ba jege a boboŋa mo ya, ko ye á wo nɛ chwoŋa mo se á woli-ne.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Amo na tɛ konto dwoŋi to, ko dae we amo na gɛ kolokolo to ŋwaane mo. Woŋo kolo maama ná ke-ne, a maŋe a lɔre mo ye a ba gwooni kolokolo.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Yiniga ná jege-ne, amo yei a na wó ja a tete tei. A jeŋa nam ná jega, a ta yei a na wó ke tei. Kolo maama ná yi-ne, a maŋe a yei ko kuri. Wodiiru ná daga pa a di a boboŋa, naa kana ná jege-ne, ye a jejegero ná daga, naa te ná muri, amo ta yei chwoŋa kalo a na wó da to.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: De konto de, á ke lanyerane de á na woli-ne de a yaara yam to.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Abam Filipi tiina tete de yei lanyerane we, maŋa kalo a na nwoŋi Makedonia ye a bobo a wora a tɛ Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere nɔɔna to, ko ye abam yerane mo woli-ne. Yezu nɔn-kɔgɔ kodwoŋi daa tera ko na woli-ne se dé yaare dé pa daane, ko ná dae abam yerane.

english_verse: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
translation_verse: Amo déem na wo Tɛsaloni ne to, abam toŋe kolo amo na gɛ to á pa-ne, ye ko dae kuni bedwe yerane.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae we amo yi zo á pɛɛra yam tete mo, se ko ye nyɔɔre delo abam na wó na Wɛ tei ne ya ŋwaane to mo. Konto mo pɛ-ne wopwolo.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Amo Tu Wɛ wó pa abam kolo maama á na gɛ to, de o na jege wo-laaro telo na tiini te beiŋi ye te jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ Yezu Krista tei ne to.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wom na ye debam Kwo to maŋe de zula maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na Wɛ nɔɔna balo na me de Yezu Krista to maama á pa-ne. Dé nu-bia balo na wo amo tei ne to de jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama jɔɔne abam, ko fɔge ko dae balo na zoore Rom Pa-faro wom sɔŋɔ ne to.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Debam Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa o zaane dem taa wo á bochara ne.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl wolo Wɛ na tiŋi-ne de o tete boboŋa se a taa ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Timoti mo tɔge o woli-ne.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Dé popone se dé pa abam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye á zoore Kolosia ne to. Abam maa ye dé nu-bia balo na tɔge Yezu Krista de á wo maama to. Dé Kwo Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Lei keim

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo maama debam ná yeini dé lwoori Wɛ dé pa abam, dé ta ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane. Wonto maa ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Kokuri to, dé lɔre abam na jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, ye á kwori á jege Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama swono tei to.

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: Konto maa pae se á jege teena we, á wó na ywoni Wɛ tei ne. Ko ye abam na bobo á ni Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to mo pɛ á lɔre we, o tiŋi ywoni dem konto telaao ne o pa abam. Wɛ kwora kam konto maa ye ta-ŋom delo na seene de ye chega to mo.

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: O kwor-ywoŋa kam konto laam jage ka yi logo baŋa jei maama, ye ka fɔge nɔɔna lanyerane, ne ka na maŋe ka fɔge abam tei, ko zege maŋa kalo á na bobo á lɔre Wɛ zaane dem na seene de ye tei to.

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: Ko ye Epafera déem mo bere abam Wɛ chega kam konto. Wonto maa ye debam nu-bu-swono ye o toŋe de o wo maama o pa Yezu Krista debam ŋwaane.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Wonto ta mo tage o bere debam Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ abam taa jege swono á bochara ne tei to.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Abam na yɔɔre á tɔge Yezu konto to, dé yeini dé lwoori Wɛ mo maŋa maama dé pa abam, ko zege maŋa kam dé na lɔre abam ni ne to. Dé lwoori‑o se o pa á ta‑á yei o boboŋa na lage tei to, se o daare o pa á na swa de yi-poro maama, ne o Sin-laao kom na pae tei to.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Abam laam wó wane á tɔge chwoŋa se ko maŋe de dé Teiru wom na lage tei to, ye á kikia maama wó su o yi. Dé lwoori Wɛ se o woli abam se á ta‑á ke totoŋ-laaro dwi dwi lanyerane, se á boboŋa taa pula maŋa maama Wɛ taane wone.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wó tɔge o paare dem ŋwaane o woli abam de o dam-fɔrɔ kom, se á wane á fɔge á zege lanyerane, ye á jege pu-dɛa wonnu maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: Á wó wane á ta‑á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei de wopwolo, kolo ŋwaane o pɛ abam chwoŋa se á tɔge á na wo-laaro telo o na tiŋi se o pa nɔɔna balo na ye o nyem to. Wɛ nɔɔna bam jeiŋa jei maa tiini de jege pwooni lanyerane o tei ne.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ ma vere debam lim wone o yage, se wo-lwanno daa yé taa jege dam dé baŋa ne. O ma daare o ja debam o zo o tete Bu-swono kom paare dem wo.

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Yezu yɔɔre o jege Baŋa Wɛ nyenyego, ye nabiina yia na‑o. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam ba nae Baŋa Wɛ tete. O ye Wɛ Bu-doa mo ye o zege wonnu telo maama Wɛ na naane to yiga ne.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Yezu nɔɔna bam tei ne, wonto mo ye ba yuu tu, ye ba kɔgɔ kom nye de o yera yam mo. O ta maa ye ba pulim jei. Ko ye Yezu mo dɛ yiga o bi toone wone ye o na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam, se ko pa o taa wo wonnu maama yiga ne.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ tete boboŋa mo lage se o Bu Yezu taa nye ded‑o fase.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Wɛ boŋe se o da o Bu wom ŋwaane mo o jwoori o ke wonnu maama o tete jeŋa ne. O Bu Yezu na tege dagara kam yuu ne ye o jana nwoŋi to mo pɛ se wonnu maama jwoori te fɔge daane de Wɛ, ne ko ná ye logo baŋa wonnu tem de wɛyuu wonnu tem maama de.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, á déem ye Wɛ dona mo. Abam boboŋa de á kikia maama déem lage wo-lwanno yerane mo pa se á ba lage Wɛ ni taane.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, Wɛ laam pɛ se abam ded‑o fɔge daane, o Bu wom na jigi nabiinu ye o daare o te to ŋwaane. Wɛ ke konto se á wane á ba á zege o yiga ne de wo-pwoŋo, ye á ye nɔn-laaro balo na ba jege tusim to.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á yɔɔre á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ chega kam de á wo-dedoa, se á yé ywori ka wone. Á yé pa se á boboŋa leiri de teena yalo á na jege Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane to. Ka ye Wɛ kwora kalo abam na maŋe á ni ye ba tɔɔle-ka dɔŋɔ ni maama ne to mo. Wɛ nam kuri amo mo se a taa ye o tontoŋeno ye a tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam konto. Pɔɔl na toŋe o pa Yezu nɔɔna tei to

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Amo na yaare tei abam ŋwaane to mo yeini ko pa-ne wopwolo. Ko na chɛ amo yera ne tei to ye Yezu Krista na yaare o daare tei to mo konto. Amo yaara yam nam mo wó woli Yezu yaara yam wone se ko pa o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom na zeinim lanyerane.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: O nɔɔna bam nye de o tete yera mo, ye Wɛ tiŋi-ne se a taa toŋa a pa-ba. Amo na toŋe tei a pa abam to mo ye a yeini a kwaane a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam maama jilli.

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: Ko zege faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ chega kam konto déem seigi nabiina tei ne, ye Wɛ laam le-ka o bere o tete nɔɔna bam.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: A lage a ta a bere abam amo na tiini a toŋe tei abam ŋwaane to mo. A ta toŋe a pa Wɛ nɔɔna balo na wo Ladika ne to, de nɔɔna balo yi na wo nɛ amo to maama.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Amo yeini a zeini Wɛ nɔɔna bam se ko pa ba wane ba taa jege baare, se ba daare ba me daane de swono. Konto wó pa ba zege lanyerane de ba na tiini ba yei Wɛ chega kam tei to. Ba maa wó ba ba lɔre Wɛ chega kalo ya na seigi to, ye kanto nam mo ye Yezu Krista tete.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: A nam tage konto a bere abam se á yé pa nɔɔn-nɔɔno gane abam, de o ná maŋe o ŋɔɔne swa taane tei maama de.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Amo na seene a tera abam tei ne to, amo boboŋa mo wora abam tei ne. Konto ŋwaane, ko pɛ-ne wopwolo de amo na lɔre we, abam zege lanyerane de ni dedwe de á na yɔɔre á jege wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista tei to. Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam taane

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Abam nam na sɛ Yezu Krista se o taa ye abam Teiru to, se á yɔɔre á ta‑á ye ded‑o konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Nam sale-na á tete ded‑o se o fɔge abam de dam. Kwaane-na se á ta‑á jege o chega kam á bochara ne, ne ba na maŋe ba bere abam tei to. Á nam ta‑á ke Wɛ lei se ko gaale.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Abam ta‑á yei se nɔɔna wó kwaane ba ma ba tete swa ba gane abam, ye swa yam konto dae Yezu Krista nyem. Ya nam ye nabiina boboŋa yalo na tɔge logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem dedaane dé nabaara chullu tem ŋwaane mo. Ya maama maa ye kafɛ.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: O nam tei woŋo kolo maama na jege dam nabiina baŋa ne to mo. Abam na me ded‑o to, á maŋe á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam fase.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Kokuri, abam na jwoŋi sɛɛm to, ko bere we ba ya suli abam de, nenɛɛne Yezu Krista na tega ye ba suli‑o tei to mo. Ko kwori ko bere we, á jwoori á bi á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam, kolo ŋwaane á sɛ we Wɛ dam daga, de o na mɛ-de o bi Yezu toone wone to.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Banto nam daa ba jege meem de Yezu. Wonto nam mo ye debam Yuu-tu, ye dé me ded‑o nenɛɛne nɔɔno yera na twoŋi de o yuu tei to. Yezu ŋwaane mo dé jege ŋwea Wɛ tei ne, ye dé gwaane daane dé toŋa dé tɔge chwoŋa kalo Wɛ na lage to. Wɛ maa woli debam se dé toŋe dé vo yiga. Ko nye de nɔɔno yera na jege pɔɔrem dwi dwi, ye ya ke totoŋa bedwe, ye ya ke ya ke da tei to mo.

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Abam na sɛ Yezu Krista to, ko nye de á tɔge ded‑o á te. Konto ŋwaane logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro daa ba jege dam á baŋa ne. Bɛ mo ye á nam ta ke nenɛɛne á ye logo baŋa nyem? Bɛ mo ye á sɛ chullu telo na bere we,

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Yé dwei konto”, naa “Yé ta‑n di konto”, naa “Yé ja konto”?

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Chullu tento dwoŋi wora wodiiru yerane ŋwaane mo. Wodiiru nam ba jege kuri taa taa. Nmo ná di n ti, mo ko maama. Chullu telo ba na bere abam konto dwoŋi to ye nabiina boboŋa mo. Te wo nwoŋi Wɛ tei.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Te nam bere nɔɔna ba na wó fe ba tete ba zuli Wɛ tei to, de ba na jege se ba yaare ba tete ye ba waare ba yera tei to. Chullu tem konto dwoŋi bere we te jege kuri, ye te nam ye kafɛ. Te ware te woli nɔɔna se ba ja ba tete de wo-zɔɔna yalo ba fera na zoore to.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Abam na nɛ Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to, ko nye de á tɔge de Yezu Krista mo á jwoori á bi toone wone. Yezu laam jege o jeiŋa jei Wɛ jazem seeni. Abam na me ded‑o to, pa-na se Wɛ telaao wonnu tem taa jege fera á tei ne.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Pa-na se á boboŋa tiini ya zo wo-laaro tem konto, ye ko dae logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, kikia yanto dwoŋi ŋwaane mo Wɛ bane wó zaŋe nabiina baŋa ne.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Abam tete ŋwea déem tɔge chwei sento dwoŋi mo.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, abam nam jege se á de wo-balwaaro tem konto maama mo á yage. Yage-na ban-zɔŋɔ de ban-lom maama. Á yé ta‑á boŋe nɔɔna chɔgem. Á yé ta‑á twe nɔɔna. Á yé pa se ta-zɔɔna taa wo á ni ne.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á fɔ vwa á pa daane. Kokuri abam dole á ŋwe-dwoŋa kam á yage de ka kikia maama,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: ye á laam daare á jege ŋwe-doŋa mo. Wɛ mo ye á ŋwe-doŋa kam keiru. O maa wora o fɔge-ka se ka taa nye de o tete ŋwea, se á wane á lɔre o na ye tei to chekke.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ko ná ye balo na jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to, pɔɔrem tera ba wone. Juu tiina de dwi-gɛ tiina maama ye bedwe mo. Balo peina na gwoni to de balo na wo gwoni to de maama ye bedwe. Balo na ye veira to de balo yi na wo poore to, ko woli de kabɛ de balo na tei ba tete to maama ye bedwe mo. Ba maama ŋwea wora Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo ye o me de ba maama.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem, ye o jege abam swono. Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á jege-na da-ŋwaŋa, de da-zula. Ta‑á gwooni-na á tete da-tei ne, se á ta‑á nege daane de ban-peno.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Ta‑á zuri-na á yera á pa daane. Abam wolo ná jege o dwoŋi taane, se á yage á ma á chɛ daane, ne dé Teiru Yezu na yage abam wɛleera o ma chɛ abam tei to.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Konto maama wone ta‑á jege-na da-swono, se ko pa á wane á tɔge chwoŋa de ni dedwe.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Pa-na se á boboŋa maama taa tɔge bochare-zuru, ne Yezu Krista na pɛ á jege tei to. Abam na ye kɔgɔ dedoa to, Wɛ kuri abam se á ta‑á tɔge daane de bochare-zuru konto dwoŋi mo. Maŋa maama se á ta‑á ke Wɛ lei.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Pa-na se Yezu Krista taane dem tiini de zo abam bochara de fɔge-ya lanyerane. Á ta‑á mae boboŋ-dɛɛra á bere daane Wɛ chega kam, se ko pa á lɔre chwoŋa kalo na lana to. Ta‑á leeni-na Wɛ seinim lei, de Yezu kɔgɔ kom lei, de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na pɛ abam lei selo to. Ta‑á leeni-na konto á pa Wɛ, ye á ke‑o lei.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama abam na wora á ke de á ni, naa de á jeŋa to, se á pa ko taa ye dé Teiru Yezu yere ŋwaane, ye á daare á tɔge o ŋwaane á ta‑á ke dé Kwo Wɛ lei. Nɔɔna maama na jege se ba tɔge chwoŋa kalo to

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Kaana jege se ba sɛ ba pa ba banna, ne ko na maŋe de balo na tɔge dé Teiru Yezu to.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye kan-banna, se á ta‑á swoi á kaana, se á yé ta‑á ke keim-chɛɛre de-ba.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye bia tiina, se á yé ta‑á chuchugi á bia bana, se konto wó pa ba boboŋa chɔge chwoŋa kalo na lana to wone.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na ye kabɛ to, se á ta‑á toŋe á tɔge á yuu tiina boboŋa woŋo maama baŋa ne. Ko nam dae ba na zege ba nii abam maŋa kalo to yerane mo á wó ke konto se á jwoŋi zula ba tei ne. Maŋa maama ta‑á toŋe-na de á wo maama, á na kɔre dé Teiru wom to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama á na toŋe to, se á ta‑á toŋe de jawala. Pa-na se á na ke tei to taa ye dé Teiru wom ŋwaane, ye ko dae nabiina yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Kokuri á yei we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam nyɔɔre delo o na tiŋi se o pa o nɔɔna bam to. Wonto mo ye á yuu tu wolo á na toŋe á pa to.

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Abam maama nam tiini á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ, se á pa á boboŋa maama taa wora, ye á kwori á ke‑o lei.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Á nam ta‑á lwoori Wɛ konto á pa debam de, se o pa dé na chwoŋa se dé taa tɔɔle o kwora kam dé bere nɔɔna Yezu Krista chega kam na ye tei to. Ko nam ye amo na bere Yezu chega kam to ŋwaane mo pɛ se a laam wo peena diga ne.
