english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Pa-na se á ni taane taa jege ywoni de mwanno, se á daare á ta‑á yei á na wó leiri nɔɔna maama taane tei to.

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: A lage a toŋe dé nu-bu-swono Tichika se o ba abam tei. Wonto toŋe o pa dé Teiru Yezu de o wo maama, ne debam de na toŋe tei to.

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: Debam nu-bu-swono Onesima de wó tɔge o ba. O déem nwoŋi abam kɔgɔ kom wone mo, ye dé yei o wo lanyerane. Banto balei wó ta woŋo kolo maama na wora ko ke debam tei ne to ba bere abam.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Arisaka wolo na tɔge de amo o wo peena diga ne to jɔɔne abam. Maake wolo na ye choro de Banabas to de jɔɔne abam. Abam maŋe á jwoŋi ni se, o ná tua, se á jeeri‑o lanyerane.

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yesua wolo yere dedwoŋi na ye Jusitu to de jɔɔne abam. Ko ná ye Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu to, nɔɔna banto batɔ yerane mo ye balo na tɔge ba toŋe Wɛ paare dem totoŋa ba woli amo. Ba kwaane ba pa se a bochare ke dam lanyerane.

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Epafera wolo na nwoŋi abam kɔgɔ kom wone ye o toŋe o pa Yezu Krista to de jɔɔne abam. O kwaane mo o lwoori Wɛ maŋa maama o pa abam, se á wane á zege lanyerane de baare, se á boboŋa kweere de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem, ye á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to maama.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Amo tete mo zege o chega kam kwaga ne we, o tiini o toŋe o pa abam, de nɔɔna balo na zoore Ladika de Hirapoli ne to.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Debam badwoŋ-swono Luka wolo na ye dɔkta tu to, dedaane Demas jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na dé nu-bia balo na tɔge Yezu ye ba zoore Ladika ne to á pa debam, ko woli de Numifa, de Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na yeini ko tigisi o sɔŋɔ ne to.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Abam ná jwoŋi amo tɔnɔ konto ye á ná gage á ti, se á laam pa-ko Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na zoore Ladika ne to se ba de ga. Ko daare se abam de jwoŋi amo tɔnɔ kodwoŋi Ladika kɔgɔ kom tei ne á ga á nii.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Ta-na á bere Achipu se o kwaane o ti totoŋe delo dé Teiru Yezu na pɛ‑o se o ke to.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl tete mo mɛ a jeŋa a popone jɔɔnem dento na kweeli to. Abam yé zaŋe á swei amo na wo peena diga ne tei to. Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl dedaane Silas de Timoti mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa abam Tɛsaloni tiina balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á tɔge á ye dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista nyem to. Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Tɛsaloni tiina na tɔge Wɛ tei to

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Maŋa maama dé yeini dé ke Wɛ lei á maama ŋwaane, ye dé kwori dé lwoori‑o dé pa abam.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé yei we Wɛ mo swoi abam, ye o daare o kuri abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Kokuri, dé déem na kwei Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé ja ba dé tɔɔle dé bere abam to, ko dae ni taane yerane mo dé tu dé bere. Wɛ dam wo debam tei ne, de o Sin-laao kom de, ye dé zege o chega kam kwaga ne. Á déem nɛ dé na zoore abam tetare ne ye dé ke tei to. Ko maa ye se ko zeini abam mo.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Á déem lwoni debam de dé Teiru wom na ye tei to. Á na jwoŋi Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to, ko pɛ se á na yaara dedɛ. Á nam ta jwoŋi-ka de wopwolo, Wɛ Sin-laao kom na zeini abam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔɔle dé Teiru wom kwora kam á bere nɔɔna tei to, ka yi Makedonia de Akaya ka gaale ka kɛ ka yi jei maama, ye nɔɔna maama lɔre á na ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei. Mo kokuri dé daa ba jege se dé ta abam kolokolo.

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: ye á kwori á cheigi o Bu wom se o jwoori o ba. Wɛ bi‑o toone wone mo, ye o lage o nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne o ba logo baŋa. Wonto mo ye Yezu wolo na wó jwoŋi debam Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wó ba nɔɔna baŋa to wone.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, abam tete yei lanyerane we, dé na tu abam tei to, ko dae kafɛ ŋwaane.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Á yei debam na maŋe dé na yaara dedɛ Filipi ne tei to, ye dé laam ba abam tei. Ba déem bɛɛse debam ye ba twe debam dedɛ. Dé na tu abam tei to, nɔɔna déem kwaane se ba che dé chwoŋa. De ko de, dé Tu Wɛ nam pɛ debam pu-dɛa se dé ŋɔɔne o kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam de baare.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Dé na yeini dé kwoori abam se á tɔge Wɛ to, ko dae we dé ŋɔɔne tusim laŋa ne mo, naa dé jege boboŋ-balwaaro mo. Ko dae swa mo dé kea se dé gane abam wolowolo.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Á yei lanyerane we, dé wo tu se dé ŋɔɔne ni-sone ŋɔŋa de abam. Dé maa wo kwaane se dé kwoli nɔɔna swa se dé na wonnu ba tei ne. Wɛ nam mo wó zege dé chega kam kwaga ne.

english_verse: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye abam, naa nɔɔno wolo maama de, dé wo ke dé boboŋa ne se nabiina taa pae debam zula.

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Dé na ye Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa to, dé ya jege chwoŋa se dé daane abam. Dé nam wo ke konto. Dé déem jege abam lanyerane, ne kaane na jege o bia o nii tei to.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Dé na jege abam swono lanyerane to, dé sɛ se dé kwei Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé maŋe dé bere abam, ye dé kwei dé ŋwea maama de mo dé woli da dé ke á jeŋa ne, á na tiini á tigi dé boboŋa ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, guli-na debam déem na toŋe dé pa abam ye ko chɛ dé yera ne tei to. Dé na wora dé tɔɔle Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam to, dé ba lage se dé daane abam de fenfee de. Konto ŋwaane mo dé yeini dé tiini dé toŋe wea de tete maama se dé ma na dé ni-wodiu.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Á yei we dé jaane abam de je selei mo, ne kwo na yeini o jege o bia tei to.

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: Dé déem kwoori abam se á bochara zuri. Dé ma daare dé kaane abam se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa se ko maŋe de Wɛ na lage tei to. Kokuri Wɛ mo kuri abam se á zo o woro kom wo ye á na paare o tei ne.

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Woŋo kodwoŋi daa ta wora ye dé ke Wɛ lei maŋa maama abam ŋwaane. Ko ye dé na jaane Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam dé ba dé tɔɔle dé bere abam to, á sɛ ye á jwoŋi-ka lanyerane. Á ma sɛ we ko ye Wɛ kwora mo, se ko dae nabiina nyem. Ko ye chega mo, ka seene ka ye Wɛ tete kwora mo, ye ka fɔge abam balo na sɛ Yezu to boboŋa.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye yaara yalo na ke abam to, konto dwoŋi mo maŋe ko ke Wɛ kɔgɔ kolo maama na wo Judea te-nia yam ne to. Ko maama ye bedwe mo. Á déem nɛ yaara á dwi tiina bam jea ne. Juu tiina balo na tu ba sɛ Yezu Krista to de nɛ yaara ba tete Juu tiina bam tei ne.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Juu tiina bam, banto dwi mo go dé Teiru Yezu de Wɛ sampwori selo déem na tɔɔle o kwora to, ye ba kwori ba bɛɛse debam de. Ba maa yɔɔre ba chuchugi Wɛ bane. Ba yeini ba done nɔɔna maama mo.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Ba déem kwaane se ba che debam se dé yé tɔɔle Wɛ kwora dé bere dwi-gɛ tiina balo na dae Juu tiina to, se ka wane ka jwoŋi-ba ka yage. Ba na ve Wɛ kwora kam konto to, ko ma pa ba keim-lwanno tem fɔge te puli te daŋe da-baŋa ne. Ko laam yi se Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ ba ba baŋa ko chɔge-ba. Pɔɔl lage se o ni ba labaare

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé na yage abam ye ko ke fee to, dé jege lwia dedɛ dé pa abam. Ko nam dae we dé boboŋa mo pɔɔre daane, se ko ye dé yia na ware ya na daane to mo. Dé déem tiini dé kwaane se dé jwoori dé ba dé na abam.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Chega to, dé lage se dé ba abam tei. Amo Pɔɔl ya kwaane se a ba, ye ko dae bedwe yerane. Ko nam ye setaana pɛ mo chege dé chwoŋa.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Ko seene ko ye abam boboŋa mo tiini ya wo debam tei ne. Ko ye abam ŋwaane mo dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne de wopwolo. Dé Teiru Yezu ná jwoori o ba, dé wó mage dé nyɔɔna, dé na jege teera de abam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo, abam seene á pae dé jege teera de wopwolo.

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: se yaara yalo á na nɛ to yé wane ya pa á jwoori kwaga. Abam yei we yaara yanto dwoŋi maŋe ya jege se ya ba debam baŋa.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Debam déem ta na wo abam tei ne maŋa kalo to, dé maŋe dé ta dé bere abam we, nɔɔna wó bɛɛse debam. Á laam na nɛ to, mo kolo na seene ko ke.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Leile konto Timoti laam jwoori o ba debam tei ye o pa dé boboŋa peini tega ne, de o na tage á taane o we, á ta tɔge Yezu de á wo-dedoa de swono. O daa ta tage o we, á seene á jege debam boboŋa de wopwolo, ye á tiini á lage se á na debam, ne debam de na lage se dé na abam tei to.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, yaara jege debam dedɛ. Dé bochara nam tiga de abam, á na tɔge Yezu de á wo-dedoa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: Á na tɔge dé Teiru wom de pu-dɛa konto to, ko pae dé ŋwea dae kafɛ.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Dé wó tiini dé ke dé Tu Wɛ lei á ŋwaane, dedaane dé na nɛ wopwolo dedɛ o yiga ne abam ŋwaane to.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu nam wó pa debam chwoŋa se dé ba abam tei.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom wó pa á swono kom puli dedɛ ko ja gaale, se á ta‑á swoi á dwonna de nɔɔna maama lanyerane, ne debam de na swoi abam tei to.

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: Konto dwoŋi mo o wó pa á bochara ke dam, se á laam ba á zege dé Kwo Wɛ yiga ne de wo-pwoŋo, ye á ba jege tusim, maŋa kalo dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba de o nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama to.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko ta daare woŋo fee se dé popone dé woli da. Dé lwoori abam dé Teiru Yezu ŋwaane se á da chwoŋa se ko pwoli Wɛ wo. Dé maŋe dé bere abam chwoŋa kam konto ye á jege-ka á tɔga de zem maama. Dé nam tiini dé lwoori abam se á ja jawala se ko dwoni á na maŋe á ke tei to.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Abam yei nia yalo dé na bere abam ye ya tɔge dé Teiru Yezu dam ŋwaane to.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Wɛ na lage se á ta‑á ye tei to mo tento: O lage se á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo o yiga ne, se á lɔŋe ka-laga kikia.

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: Á nam yé pa á fera taa zoore ka-laga. Mo nɔn-yɔɔro telo na yeiri Wɛ to na yeini ba ke kolo.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Baaro de kaane laŋa ne, nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o chɔge o nu-bu naa o ke o de‑o. Dé maŋe dé kaane abam lanyerane we, nɔɔno ná ke wo-zɔɔna konto dwoŋi, dé Teiru wom wó waare‑o.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, nɔɔno wolo ná ve dé na bere tei to, konto tu mɛ o kwaga o ya Wɛ mo. Ko dae nabiina mo o ve, se ko ye Wɛ wolo na ke o Sin-laao kom á bochara ne to mo.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye á na swoi á nu-bia tei to, ko daa wo maŋe se dé popone dé woli da. Wɛ tete maŋe o bere abam á na wó ta‑á jege da-swono tei.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo, á seene á swoi á nu-bia balo maama na zoore Makedonia teene dem ne to. Mo kokuri, dé nu-bia bam, dé lwoori abam se á tiini á ta‑á ke konto se ko ja gaale.

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na se á ta‑á zoore chemm. Ta‑á nii-na á tete kikia se á yage á dwonna. Á ta ta‑á toŋa se á na á tete ni-wodiu á di. Dé maŋe dé ta abam konto mo se á ta‑á ke.

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: Á ná dɛ chwoŋa kanto, balo na dae Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna to wó taa nege abam lanyerane. Ko maa wó pa se á daa bá daane nɔɔn-nɔɔno se o pa abam á na gɛ kolo to. Dé Teiru wom tutuuri dem taane

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye nɔɔna balo na tege to, dé lage se á lɔre chega de ko na ke-ba tei to, se á wo daa yé chɔge toone ŋwaane, ne ko na yeini ko ke balo na ba jege teena Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Debam sɛ we, Yezu tega ye o laam jwoori o bi toone wone. Konto ŋwaane, ko ná ye balo na sɛ‑o ye ba te to, dé yei we, o ná tua, Wɛ wó kale banto se ba tɔge ded‑o ba yi o tei.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ko nam na wó ke tei to, dé Teiru wom wó nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne o chu o ba. Kwor-dɛa wó bage ka ta taane. Wɛ malese dedɛɛro wom kwora de wó zaŋe ka woli da. Wɛ nabɔnɔ de maa wó keeri. Balo na sɛ Yezu Krista ye ba te to wó da yiga ba bi toone wone.

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: Wɛ laam wó ja debam balo na daare ye dé daa ta ŋwe to, se o pa dé la daane de banto kunkwonnu tem wone, se dé maama jeeri dé Teiru wom wɛyuu ne. Konto mo dé wó taa wora dé Teiru wom tei ne maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko daa wo maŋe se dé popone dé ta dé bere abam maŋa kalo wonnu tem konto na wó ke to.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Abam tete maŋe á yei lanyerane we, dé Teiru wom dɛ dem wó pɔpɔ de ba, ne ŋweeno na yeini o pɔpɔ o ba tete ne tei to.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo nɔɔna na tɛ ba we, ko ye chemm mo, ye ywoni wora jei maama to, konto maŋa kam ne de cham wó pɔpɔ de ba ba baŋa, ye ba bá lu. Ko wó taa nye de kaane puga na pɔpɔ ka virigi ye ka wɔe tei to mo.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Abam maama wo Wɛ pwooni wone mo, ye á tɔge wea chwoŋa. Dé nam dae tete kokoro nɔɔna, ye dé kikia dae lim wone kikia.

english_verse: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
translation_verse: Tete ne mo nɔɔna yeini ba dɔa, ye ba kwori ba nyɔ sana ba buga.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á woli-na daane se ko pa á bochara taa tiga, se á fɔge á zeini daane ne á na maŋe á ke tei to.

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé nam lwoori abam se á ta‑á nege nɔɔna balo na toŋe á tetare ne to. Nɔɔna banto mo leiri dé Teiru wom yuu ne ba nii abam baŋa ne, ye ba korese abam.

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: Á ta‑á zuli-ba lanyerane de swono ba totoŋ-ŋona yam ŋwaane. Pa se ywoni taa wora á wone.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé kwoori abam se á ta‑á woli nɔɔna lanyerane. Ko ná ye jawɔre-nyena, se á kaane-ba. Ko ná ye balo na kɔre foone to, se á pa ba na baare. Ko ná ye nabwona, se á zeini-ba. Ta‑á zuri-na á bochara de nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Á ta‑á yei se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé ma wo-lɔŋɔ o ma jwoori o ŋwe wo-lɔŋɔ o pa o dwoŋi. Maŋa maama se á kwaane á ta‑á tɔge chwo-laao de á nu-bia bam, ko woli de nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na wopwolo maŋa maama.

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ.

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Kolo maama ná kea, se á ta‑á ke Wɛ lei. Mo Wɛ na lage se á ta‑á ke tei, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Yé kwoli-na Wɛ Sin-laao kom.

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: Abam nam maŋe-na woŋo maama á nii. Ko ná lana se á ta‑á tɔge-ko.

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Se á nam fɔge á che á tete de lwarem dwi maama.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wom na pae nɔɔna bochare-zuru to wó taa jege abam de je selei, se á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo fase o yiga ne, se á ŋwea maama taa jege chega, ko ná ye á yera de á jworo de. Konto to, dé Teiru Yezu Krista ná tua, á bá ta‑á jege tusim Wɛ tei ne de fenfee de.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa debam de.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na dé nu-bia bam maama, ye á kukwori daane á zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: A nam tɛ abam dé Teiru wom dam ŋwaane se á ga tɔnɔ konto á bere dé nu-bia bam maama.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo á tei ne.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl, dedaane Silas de Timoti mo popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa abam Tɛsaloni tiina balo na ye Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wo nɔɔna ye á tɔge á ye dé Kwo Baŋa Wɛ de dé Teiru Yezu Krista nyem to.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Lei keim dedaane wɛ-lworo

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, maŋa maama dé jege se dé ke Wɛ lei abam ŋwaane nenɛɛne ko na maŋe tei to, kokuri á na ke á wo-dedoa de Yezu tei to ke ko daŋe da-baŋa ne. Á maama tiini á swoi á dwonna lanyerane, ye á swono kom konto wora ko pula dedɛ.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Á na ye konto dwoŋi to, dé yeini dé ta á taane dé bere Wɛ kɔgɔ kom na wo jeiga kalo maama ne to, ye dé jege teera abam ŋwaane. Dé tɛ-ba we, nɔɔna yeini ba bɛɛse abam ye á nae yaara dedɛ. Á nam ta zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa, ye á yɔɔre á tɔge Yezu de wo-dedoa.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Wɛ nam zege o chega wone mo. O maa wó waare balo na jege abam ba yaare to pa se ba de jwoori ba na yaara.

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: ye min-vɔɛ zaŋe se kekare-ba. O maa wó waare balo na ve Wɛ to, ko woli de balo na wo sɛ omo kwor-ywoŋa kam to.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Konto maama wó ke maŋa kalo dé Teiru Yezu na wó jwoori o ba to. Dɛ dem konto ne o wó na zula o tete nɔɔna bam tei ne. Balo maama na sɛ‑o to wó taa seini‑o lanyerane. Abam nam wó ta‑á wo banto wone, á na sɛ Wɛ chega kalo dé na bere abam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo dé yeini dé lwoori dé Tu Wɛ wom maŋa maama dé pa abam, se o pa á maŋe de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ne o na twori abam se á ta‑á ye tei to. Dé lwoori‑o se o pa abam dam, se á wane á tɔge chwo-laao nenɛɛne á boboŋa na lage tei to maama, ye á ke totoŋa yalo maama á wo-dedoa kam na wae ka pa á ke to.

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: Konto mo wó pa dé Teiru Yezu taa nae zula abam ŋwaane. Abam de maa wó na zula, á na me ded‑o to ŋwaane. Dé Tu Baŋa Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista na ke abam zaane to mo wó pa konto maama ke.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, á yei we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó jwoori o ba, ye Wɛ wó la debam o ke daane se dé taa wo Yezu tei ne. Dé nam lage dé kwoori abam

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: se á yé pa á bochara taa di konto baŋa ne. Á yé zaŋe á pa á boboŋa vugimi de nɔɔna na tɛ ba we, dé Teiru Yezu dɛ dem maŋe de yi. Nɔɔna ná tɛ abam ba we, Wɛ Sin-laao kom pɛ-ba o kwora, naa ba ná we ko ye Wɛ chega mo ba bere abam, naa ba ná we ba jwoŋi tɔnɔ debam tei ne,

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Amo ta na wo abam tei ne maŋa kalo to, a yeini a bere abam wonnu tento. Á nam wo guli-te na?

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Keim-lwanno dam delo na seigi nɔɔna yia ne to maŋe de wora de chɔge nabiina. Ko nam ná ye wolo wom na wora o cho keim-lwanno tem chwoŋa leile se te yé tiini te ke to, konto tu wó taa wora se ko taa vei maŋa kam o na wó lage jeiga to.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: O ta maa wó ke keim-lwanno dwi maama o ma gane balo na lage ba ga ba ŋwea Wɛ tei ne to. Ko wó ke-ba konto, ba na ba sɛ se ba jwoŋi Wɛ chega kam de swono se ko pa o jwoŋi-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Wɛ nam wó ke konto se balo maama na wo sɛ o chega kam ye ba daare ba swoi puseŋa kikia to mo to de ba bora. Pu-dɛa taane

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, dé jege se dé ke Wɛ lei maŋa maama abam ŋwaane, á na ye balo dé Teiru wom na swoi to. Ko zege boboa ne mo Wɛ kuri abam se o jwoŋi abam o yage. O dɛ o Sin-laao kom dam ŋwaane mo o pa á ji o tete nɔɔna, á na sɛ o chega kam de á wo-dedoa to ŋwaane. O tɔge tento baŋa ne mo o jwoŋi abam o yage.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye konto to, o mɛ debam na tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam dé bere abam tei to mo se o pa á tɔge de dé Teiru Yezu Krista á na zula.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko ta daare fee se dé popone dé woli da. Ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa debam, se dé Teiru wom kwor-ywoŋa kam jage ka yi jei maama, se nɔɔna daare ba sɛ-ka lanyerane, ne abam de na sɛ-ka tei to.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Lwoori-na Wɛ se o jwoŋi debam nɔn-balwaaro jeŋa ne, kokuri ko dae nɔɔna bam maama mo sɛ Wɛ chega kam.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Á na ye dé Teiru wom nyem to mo dé jege abam chega we, á wora á tɔge dé na maŋe de bere abam kolo to, ye á ta wó ta‑á ke konto mo taa.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom wó zeini abam, ye o pa á boboŋa tiini ya tɔge Wɛ swono kom, ye o daare o pa á zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa, ne Yezu Krista de na ye tei to. Jawɔre-nyena taane

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam, ko ná ye á nu-bu wolo maama na ye jawɔre-nyem ye o ba tɔge berem delo dé na pɛ abam to, se á lɔŋe konto tu. Ko ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista dam ŋwaane mo dé kaane abam konto.

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: Dé wo jwoŋi dé ni-wodiu nɔɔn-nɔɔno tei ne zɛɛra ŋwaane. Dé nam tiini dé toŋe mo se ko chɛ dé yera wea de tete, se dé yé daane abam wolowolo wodiu ŋwaane.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Dé wora dé tɛ taane dem konto, kolo ŋwaane dé lɔre we abam badwonna ye jawɔre-nyena mo. Konto dwoŋi nɔɔna bam yeini ba ba toŋa, ye ba kare jei maama ba gigili ba dwonna yia.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Dé nam tiini dé kwoori nɔɔna bam konto dé Teiru Yezu Krista dam ŋwaane, se ba taa toŋe chemm se ba wane ba nii ba tete baŋa ne de ba ni-wodiu.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná wora ye o wo sɛ debam na popone tɔnɔ konto wone dé bere kolo to, se á maane konto tu, se á wane á ja á tete ded‑o, se ko pa chaveera ja‑o.

english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Á nam yé pa se o ji á dono. Ko nam maŋe se á kaane‑o, ne o ye á nu-bu mo tei.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom mo ye bochare-zuru tu. O maa wó zeini abam se á ta‑á jege bochare-zuru maŋa maama wone, de kolo maama na ke abam to. Dé Teiru wom taa wo á maama tei ne.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo abam maama tei ne.

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: Nmo mo ye nenɛɛne amo bu chekke, dedaane n na sɛ Yezu Krista to. Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa nmo zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri nmo ŋwaŋa. Vwa berena taane

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam amo déem na lage se a vo Makedonia to, a lwoori nmo se n maŋe Efesia ne. Nmo jege se n maŋe dáane mo, se n kaane nɔɔna badwonna ba na jege vwa ba bere nɔɔna to se ba yage ba bera yam.

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: N jege se n ta-ba se ba yage ba boboŋa sensɔle selo na dae chega to, se ba daare ba yage ba kwoa kwoa yera natɔga kalo na ba jege kweelim jei to. Kolo ŋwaane wonnu tem konto pae se nɔɔna boboŋa ye kafɛ mo. Te nam ba woli nɔɔna se ba ke ba wo-dedoa dedaane Wɛ se ba taa tɔge‑o.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto nam ywori wo-laaro tem konto wone mo, ye ba tusi ba tɔge taane delo na ba jege kuri to.

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: Ba lage se ba taa ye Wɛ nia yam berena mo, ye ba nam ba ni ba tete ni taane kuri. Ba yeini ba seene ba yia mo ba ŋɔɔne wonnu tem, ye ba ta yeiri te kuri.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yam, dé yei we ya lana ya pae nɔɔno wolo maama na tɔge-ya chekke to.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei we, Wɛ na pɛ o ni-kaana yam to, o wo pɛ ya zege nɔn-laaro ŋwaane. O nam pɛ-ya balo na yeini ba chɔge chullu to ŋwaane mo, dedaane zwabani-nyena ŋwaane. O ta pɛ-ya Wɛ-lwɛɛna, de wo-lwan-keira, de nɔn-chechɔgero, de balo na ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone to ŋwaane mo. O ta tage-ya balo de na go ba kwoa naa ba niina naa ba dwonna to ŋwaane mo,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: dedaane balo na bwoori to, de baara balo na mae ba dwonna ba jiri kaana to, dedaane balo na cho ba jaane nɔɔna de dam ba yeigi to, dedaane vwa-fɔra, de balo na du de Wɛ ye ko dae chega to ŋwaane. O nam tage o ni-kaana yam o pa balo na ke kolo maama ba chɔge berem delo na ye chekke

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu Krista mo pɛ amo dam se a taa toŋa a pa‑o. A ke‑o lei dedaane o na boŋe we amo jege wo-dedoa, ye o le-ne o zege o totoŋa yam baŋa ne to.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Faŋa to amo déem yeini a ŋɔɔne mo a chɔge Wɛ yere, ye a ta yaare o nɔɔna. A déem jege nankɔɔre mo ye Wɛ ta duri amo ŋwaŋa, kolo ŋwaane amo ya yeiri woŋo kolo a na jege a ke to, a na wo sɛ‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Ko daare dé Teiru wom nam mo ke-ne zaane dedɛ ko ja gaale, ye o daare o pa se a taa jege wo-dedoa dedaane Yezu Krista, ye a swoi‑o.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Taane dento ye chega ye de jege se nɔɔna yɔɔre ba sɛ-de mo: “Yezu Krista tu logo baŋa se o jwoŋi nɔn-chechɔgero mo o daare o ke-ba Wɛ jeŋa ne.” Amo nam mo ye nɔn-chechɔgɔ a dwoi nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ta ma duri amo ŋwaŋa se ko pore chwoŋa se Yezu Krista wane o tɔge-ka o bere nɔɔna o na zuri o yera de amo tei to. O tiini o zuri o yera de amo wolo na ye nɔn-chechɔgero tem yiga tu to. Ko maa ye maana ko pae nɔɔna balo na wó da amo kwaga ba ba ba sɛ‑o se ba daare ba na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ ye pɛ wolo paare na bá ti maŋa de maŋa to mo. O ye ŋwea tu, ye o yera ba nae de yia. O dwoŋi tera. Konto to, zula de paare taa wo o tei ne se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: Ta‑n tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa se n daare n ta‑n ke kolo maama n na yei we ko lamma to. Nɔɔna badwonna wora ye ba ba sɛ se ba taa tɔge kolo ba na yei we ko lamma to. Konto ma pa se ba daa ware ba da Wɛ chwoŋa.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Humenaya de Alezanda mo tɔge ba wo nɔɔna bam konto wone. Amo maŋe a ke banto setaana pɛ jeŋa ne se o vaŋe ba zwɛ, se ko bere-ba we, ba daa yé ŋɔɔne ba twe Wɛ yere.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Kolo amo na lage se a da yiga a ta mo tento. Á jege se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ á pa nɔɔna maama. Lwoori-na Wɛ se o taa nii ba baŋa ne, se á daare á ta‑á ke‑o lei ko ŋwaane.

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: Ta‑á ke-na konto dwoŋi á pae pwa, dedaane dedɛɛra maama na jege dam nɔɔna baŋa ne to, se ko pa dé taa zoore de ni-ywom de yazura, se dé na chwoŋa dé seene dé yia dé taa tɔge Wɛ.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Wɛ-lworo kom konto dwoŋi mo lamma, ye ko pwoli Wɛ wo, wolo na ye dé Vereno to.

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: Wonto mo lage se nɔɔna maama na verem, se ba kwori ba taa yei o chega kam.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Wɛ dedoa yerane mo wora. Wolo de na fɔge nabiina de Wɛ daane to de ye dedoa yerane mo. Kotu nam mo ye nabiinu Yezu Krista.

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo Wɛ pɛ se a ji o totoŋa nakwe, se a taa tɔɔle o kwora a bere nɔɔna. A ŋɔɔne chega mo se ko dae vwa. Wɛ seene o toŋe-ne mo se a taa tɛ o chega kam a bere dwi-gɛ tiina balo na maŋe ba ba tɔge‑o to.

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Abam ná lage á lwoori Wɛ mɛ maama, ko maŋe se baara mo zaŋe ba ware Wɛ, ne ko ná ye baara balo na wó wane ba zeiŋi je-ŋwe wɛɛne, ye ba ba jege ban-zɔŋɔ naa ni-kantɔgɔ to.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Amo ba sɛ se kaana taa bere baara, naa ba taa jege dam ba baŋa ne. Ba jege se ba taa jei chemm mo.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, ko déem dae Adam mo setaana pɛ wom gane, se ko déem ye kaane wom mo o gane pa se o chɔge Wɛ ni.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Taane dento seene de ye chega mo: “Nɔɔno boboŋa ná jaane se o ji Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga tu, konto tu lage totoŋ-ŋom mo.”

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: O nam ba jege se o taa ye sa-nyɔro, naa kantɔ-mageno, naa wolo na jege ban-lom to. Ko maŋe se o taa ye nɔn-cheno mo. O nam ba jege se o taa ye sabu-lageno.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: O jege se o taa wae o nii o sɔŋɔ tiina baŋa ne mo lanyerane, se o daare o pa o bia taa nege‑o dedɛ.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Kokuri mo nɔɔno ná ware o nii o tete sɔŋɔ tiina baŋa ne, o nam wó ke tɛ mo o nii Wɛ kɔgɔ kom baŋa ne?

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: Ba nam jege se ba ke boboŋe dedwe mo dedaane chega kalo Wɛ na le o bere debam to, se chaveera yé ja-ba.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná lage se o ji Yezu kɔgɔ kom wolim tu, ba jege se ba da yiga ba maŋe‑o mo ba nii, ye o kolokolo ná tera, se ba laam pa o bobo o totoŋa.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se ba kaana de taa ye balo nɔɔna na nege to mo, se ba yé taa ye bebare-nyena. Ba jege se ba taa ye jawale-nyena mo, se nɔɔna taa jege ba chega wonnu maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Yezu kɔgɔ kom wolim tu jege se o taa jege kaane dedoa yerane mo, se o daare o taa wae o nii o bia de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama baŋa ne lanyerane.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Kokuri mo wolim tu wolo maama na toŋe o totoŋa lanyerane to wó na yere. Wonto wó na zula dedɛ nɔɔna tei ne, ye o daare o na baare de o na ke o wo-dedoa de Yezu Krista tei to.

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Amo boŋe se a ba nmo tei leile. Amo nam popone wonnu tento se a bere nmo se,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: a ná dáane fenfee, se n wane n lɔre nɔɔna balo na ye Wɛ sɔŋɔ tiina to na wó taa jege ba tete tei to. Banto mo ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna. Banto mo ye balo na fɔge ba nii Wɛ chega kam baŋa ne, nenɛɛne ywoa na woli diga se ka yé vi to mo.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Ko seene ko ye chega mo we, Wɛ tɔgem ye wo-kamunu mo. Wɛ laam mo pɛ se dé lɔre wolo o na toŋe debam nabiina tei ne to: Wonto mo jigi nabiinu. Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma bere we o jege chega. Wɛ malese ma na‑o. Nɔɔna ma ja o kwora ba zo teene maama wo ba tɔɔle. Nabiina ma sɛ‑o logo baŋa ne. O laam ma di Wɛ telaao de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ.

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: Wɛ ni taane dem dedaane debam wɛ-lworo kom mo pae se ko ba jege digiru Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Nmo jege se n ta wonnu tento mo n bere n nu-bia bam. N ná ke konto, ko wó pa se n ta‑n ye Yezu Krista tontoŋeno-ŋom. N ná yɔɔre n sɛ Wɛ chega kam de berem chekke delo n na maŋe n tɔge to mo, n bochare wó be lanyerane.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n cheigi sensɔle selo na ba jege kuri ye se ba woli Wɛ chwoŋa to. Nam fɔge n che n tete se n ta‑n tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa chekke.

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo pae se dé fe dé yera dé toŋe de dam, kolo ŋwaane Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ jege debam teena. Wonto mo ye nɔɔna maama Vereno, ko fɔge ko dae balo na sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa to.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Ta‑n bere wonnu tem konto se n pa nɔɔna taa tɔge-te.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Amo ta ná wo tu, yɔɔre n ta‑n gare Wɛ tɔnɔ kom se nɔɔna taa cheiga, se n daare n bere-ba Wɛ chega kam se ba sɛ.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo nɔɔna déem na pworisi nmo ŋwaane, ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam de daŋe ba je nmo baŋa ne to, Wɛ mo pɛ‑m wolim se n ta‑n toŋe n pa‑o. Nmo nam ba jege se n dole n yage Wɛ pɛɛre dem konto.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei n tete, se n daare n ta‑n yei n berem dem ni ne. Seene n yia se n ta‑n ke wonnu tem konto, se nmo wó jwoŋi n tete, ye n ta wó kwori n jwoŋi balo na cheigi‑m to de.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe n bwɛ Wɛ chwoŋa nɔn-kwea. N jege se n kwoori‑o mo, nenɛɛne o ye n kwo mo tei. Ko ná ye nɔn-donno, n jege se n ke-ba nenɛɛne ba ye n nyaana mo tei.

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye kazena, se n ta‑n ke-ba nenɛɛne ba ye n niina mo. Ko ná ye ka-donno, se n ke-ba nenɛɛne n nakɔa tei de n boboŋ-dɛɛra.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Ko daare kadeim ná jege bia naa naaro, banto mo jege se ba taa nii‑o, ba na ye o tete sɔŋɔ tiina to ŋwaane. Mo Wɛ chwoŋa berem dem na ye tei to. Kadeim bia ná woli‑o konto, ko wó pa se ba jwoori ba ŋwe ba tiina jene de ba na yaare ba ŋwaane to. Konto nam mo pwoli Wɛ wo.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Kaane wolo nam ná seene o ye kadeim ye o ba jege nɔɔn-nɔɔno se o taa nii o baŋa ne, kotu daŋe o teena Wɛ baŋa ne mo. Tete de wea maama o tiini o ware Wɛ mo ye o lwoori wolim o tei ne.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Ko daare kadeim wolo na lage ka jaŋa kikia yerane to maŋe o te mo ye o ŋwe.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Nam pa se ba maama lɔre wonnu tento se ba taa ke, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o zaŋe o yaale ba yuu.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno yiga ná tera de o chorro, ko fɔge ko dae o tete sɔŋɔ tiina, konto tu ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone mo. Wonto mo tiini o ye nɔn-balɔrɔ o dwoi balo na maŋe ba ba tɔge Wɛ to.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Ko daare kadeina balo na ye ka-bwona to, abam ba jege se á ga-ba á woli da. Kolo ŋwaane banto wo daa ná zaga se ba yé taa ye kadeina, ba wó ywori mo Yezu Krista tei ne ye ba lage se ba daa zo banna.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Ko nam ta woli da, kadeina balo na ye ka-bwona to yeini ba tɔge jawɔrɔ chwoŋa mo, ye ba swoi se ba taa tole ba vei sɔŋɔ de sɔŋɔ. Ko ma pa se ba ji bebare-nyena de ka-gɔɛ ba woli ba jawɔrɔ kom wone, ye ba ŋɔɔne wonnu telo na dae se ba ya ŋɔɔne to.

english_verse: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane kadeina badaara maŋe ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone ye ba daare ba tɔge setaana pɛ wom.

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Kaane wolo ná tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa, ye kadeina ná wora o tete sɔŋɔ ne, konto tu mo jege se o taa nii ba baŋa ne mo. Ko dae se o yage-ba o pa Yezu kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna se ba taa nii ba baŋa ne. O ná yage-ba konto, ko wó daane Yezu nɔɔna bam mo, pa se ba daa bá wane ba nii kadeina balo na ba jege nɔɔn-nɔɔno to baŋa ne.

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone mo we, “Nmo ná jege nabea n ma n toŋe n faao, yé vɔ ka ni se ka yé wane men-bia bam ka di.” Ko ta popone we, “Tontoŋeno maŋe se o taa jwoŋi o ŋweero mo.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná zaŋe o ŋɔɔne Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwe taane de nmo, se n yé sɛ, ko ná dae we nɔɔna balo yi na nɛ o keim-balwaaro tem to yi balei naa batɔ.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Ko daare nakwa balo na seene ba ke keim-balwaaro to, se n bwɛ-ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom yibia ne. Konto mo wó pa se foone ja badaara bam de.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: A nam lage a kaane‑m mo Wɛ yiga ne, de Yezu Krista yiga ne, de Wɛ tete malese sem yiga ne, se n yɔɔre n sɛ kolo a na tage to. Yé kuri nɔɔna daane de n na bere-ba ye n ke-ba tei to.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Yé gare n zi n jea nɔɔn-nɔɔno baŋa ne se n pa o ji Wɛ tontoŋeno. Yé pa se nɔɔno keim-balwaaro tɔge te lɔgese‑m. Fɔge n ja n tete de boboŋ-dɛɛra ye tusim tera.

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: A ya boŋe se a ta de nmo we, n wo kom na yeini ko wɔe maŋa maama to, ta‑n nyɔ sa-gwoo fenfee, se ko dae na yerane mo nmo wó ta‑n nyɔa.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara wo-balwaaro yɔɔre te nae mo jaja. Banto taane dem ná tua, nɔɔna maama maŋe ba yei ba wo-balwaaro tem ni ne. Ko daare babam wo-balwaaro nae kwaga yerane mo.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye bedwe mo de keim-laaro, te de yɔɔre te nae mo ja. De konto de, telo na ba nae lanyerane to de maŋe te bá wane te seigi.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Balo maama na ye kabɛ ye ba tɔge Wɛ chwoŋa to jege se ba taa pae ba yuu tiina mo zula dedɛ. Konto wó che se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé na chwoŋa se o ŋɔɔne o yaale Wɛ yere dem dedaane debam berem dem.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Kabɛ selo na toŋe ba pae ba yuu tiina balo de na tɔge Wɛ to, ko wo maŋe se ba taa gwooni-ba de ba na ye nu-bia Wɛ chwoŋa wone to. Ba nam jege se ba tiini ba toŋe ba pa-ba se ko gaale, kolo ŋwaane ba yuu tiina balo ba na toŋe ba totoŋa to tɔge ba ye Yezu nɔɔna mo, ye Wɛ swo-ba. Nmo jege se n ta‑n bere nɔɔna wonnu tem konto maama mo se ba taa tɔge-te.

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná wo sɛ se o tɔge debam Teiru Yezu Krista bera yam, dedaane Wɛ chwoŋa berem chekke dem, ye o nam ná bere wo-gaa,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: konto tu pae se o jege swa mo ye o nam yeiri kolokolo. Wonto dwoŋi tiini o lage se o taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ wonnu telo na ba jege kuri to baŋa ne mo. O na ke konto to mo pae se nɔɔno wo gweena de o dwoŋi. Ko ta maa pae se nɔɔna jaane daane, ye ba twe daane, ye ba ta boŋe lwarem ba pa daane,

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ye chega mo we, Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem jege nyɔɔre dedɛ ko pae balo na jege ba wonnu ye ba boŋe we tento mo maŋe to.

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: Ba na loge debam to, dé wo jaane kolokolo dé ba logo baŋa. Dé nam ná lage dé yage logo baŋa, dé bá wane kolokolo dé ja dé viiri.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye balo na boŋe se ba taa ye naduna to, sabu-laga yeini ko soge-ba mo, pa se ba to tega ne, nenɛɛne kalanchogo mo jaane-ba tei. Ba fera maa zoore wo-yɔɔro telo na wó yaare-ba to dedɛ. Konto keim dem mo yeini ko pae ba yuu yaala, ye ba yɔɔre ba na chɔgem.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Kokuri to, nɔɔno boboŋa ná dɛ sabu-laga, wo-lwanno dwi maama wó ba da mo. Nɔɔna badaara wora ba na pɛ se ba yi zo sabu-laga, ye ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone pa se ba jege ba tete ba yaare dedɛ.

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Ko daare nmo Timoti na ye Wɛ tontoŋeno to, n jege se n ja n tete mo dedaane wonnu tem konto. Ke n tete n ke daane se n ta‑n jege boboŋ-dɛɛra, de Wɛ kɔrɔ, ye n jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ, de swono, de pu-dɛa, de ban-peno.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista de déem zege Pontusi Pilata yiga ne o pa se o lɔre we, omo tɔge chega chwoŋa kam. Amo nam lage a ta a bere nmo Yezu yibia ne, dedaane Wɛ wolo na pae wonnu maama ŋwea to yibia ne we,

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Maŋa kalo na maŋe to ná yia, Lam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ wolo yerane na tei nɔɔna maama to laam wó pa se Yezu Krista jwoori o ba konto. Wɛ mo ye pwa maama Pɛ de dedɛɛra maama Teiru,

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: ye wonto yerane mo maŋe o jege ŋwea taa wuu. O nam zoore pwooni jeiga kalo na pepele yia to wone mo, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o twɛ da. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na nɛ o yibia yam kɔtaa, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam tera o yia na wó wane ya na‑o. Zula taa wo o tei ne, dedaane dam delo na ba jege tiim to. Ameena.

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na ye naduna zem logo kom ne to, n jege se n kaane-ba se ba yé boŋe kamunim ba pa ba tete. Ba ba jege se ba kwei ba teena ba daŋe jejegero baŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane te nye de vio mo. Ba nam jege se ba kwei ba teena ba pa Wɛ, kolo ŋwaane o yeini o pa debam wonnu dedɛ se dé taa di ywoni te maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Kaane-ba se ba taa ke wo-laaro dedɛ, se ba totoŋ-ŋona ji ba nadunni, se ba taa jege wo-ywoŋo ye ba pɔɔre ba wonnu tem ba zeini daane.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara wora ba na pae se ba jege yi-poro kom konto, ye ko laam pa se ba ywori Wɛ chwoŋa kam wone. Konto to, fɔge n ja n tete de wonnu tem konto. Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: Nmo Timoti ye amo bu-swono. Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa nmo zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri nmo ŋwaŋa. Lei keim

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Amo nam ke Wɛ lei. A maa toŋe a pa‑o nenɛɛne a nabaara bam déem na ke tei to, ye a bochare ba maga ko baŋa ne. A maa yeini a lwoori‑o maŋa maama wea de tete, ye a guli nmo gula a wɛ-lworo kom wone.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Amo guli nmo na kane yi-na debam na pwɛ da-tei ne maŋa kalo to. Konto ŋwaane a tiini a lage se a jwoori a ba a na nmo, se a wane a di ywoni a su.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Amo maane we n ke n wo-dedoa n sɛ Yezu. Nmo nu-nakwe Lowisi, de n nu Yunika de déem jege wo-dedoa de Yezu konto dwoŋi. Amo maa yei lanyerane we nmo de jega.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo a lage a pa nmo guli a déem na daŋe a jea nmo baŋa ne ye Wɛ pa nmo wolim to. Nam fɔge n nii Wɛ pɛɛre dem konto baŋa ne, se n ta‑n ma n tiini n toŋe Wɛ totoŋa yam lanyerane.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, yé ta‑n kɔre chaveera se n zege dé Teiru Yezu chega kam kwaga ne. Ta yé pa foone zo‑m de ba na ke amo peena diga ne Yezu chega kam ŋwaane to. Ko nam maŋe se n de sɛ yaara yalo na wó yi‑m Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam berem ŋwaane to mo. Wɛ wó pa‑m baare se n tɔge n yaare konto dwoŋi nenɛɛne amo tei.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: O nam maŋe o jwoŋi debam o pa se dé tɔge chwo-laao. O na zeini debam konto to, ko dae debam keim-laaro ŋwaane, se ko ye o tete boboŋa ŋwaane mo. Faŋa faŋa to, ko zege logo baŋa boboa ne, Wɛ déem maŋe o boŋe se o tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o ke debam zaane.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Wɛ laam ma pa se dé lɔre o boboŋa yam konto, dé Vereno Yezu Krista na tu logo baŋa o veere o tete to ŋwaane. Wonto mo chɔge toone dam. O ma daare o tɔge Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam ŋwaane o pa se dé yi poore, ye dé wae dé nae ŋwea kalo na bá ti Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo tiŋi-ne se a taa ye o totoŋa nakwe se a taa tɔɔle o kwor-ywoŋa kam a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Ko ye konto ŋwaane mo amo nɛ yaara yam konto. Amo nam bá taa kɔre chaveera. A ke a wo-dedoa de Yezu, ye a yei o wo lanyerane. Amo daŋe a teena wonto baŋa ne. A maa tiini a yei we o wae o nii amo na kwei kolo maama a ke o jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, se ko taa vei dɛ dem o na wó ba to.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Nam fɔge n ta‑n tɔge chega chwoŋa kalo amo na maŋe a bere nmo to, se n kwori n ta‑n jege wo-dedoa de swono, ne Yezu Krista na woli debam tei to.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo debam bochara ne. Tɔge wonto dam ŋwaane se n fɔge n nii chega kalo Wɛ na kwei o ke nmo jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé chɔge-ka.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Nmo maŋe n yei we, Wɛ nɔɔna balo maama na zoore Asia jei sem ne to mo jwoori amo kwaga ne, ko woli de Figela, de Hɛmɔgena.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Onesifɔrɔ nam mo yeini o pa a na ywoni a bochare ne. Wɛ wó duri o ŋwaŋa, de o sɔŋɔ tiina maama. Ba na ke amo peena diga ne to, o wo kɔre chaveera se o taa woli-ne.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: O na tu o yi Rom maŋa kalo to, o déem beeri amo jei mo taa, ye o laam ba o na amo.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa o na chega dé Teiru Yezu dɛ dem ne. Nmo ta maŋe n yei lanyerane Onɛsifɔrɔ na tiini o woli-ne Efesia ne tei to.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Amo bu Timoti, ta‑n zege de dam, se Yezu Krista wó zeini‑m de o zaane dem, nmo na me ded‑o to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Chega kalo maama amo déem na yeini a bere nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maama yiga ne ye n yei-ka to, ma-ka n bere nɔɔna badwonna balo na ye jawale-nyena to, se ba de daa wane ba maa bere nɔɔna badwonna.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, nɔɔno ná ye valo, ye o ná tiini o toŋa, ko maŋe se wonto mo da yiga o jwoŋi o teiri wodiiru tem wone.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Boŋe n nii amo na tɛ se n che n tete tei to. Dé Teiru Yezu wó pa n lɔre amo taane dem kuri n ti.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Ta‑n boŋe Yezu Krista boboŋa. Wonto mo bi toone wone. O déem mo ye Pɛ David dwi tu. Kwor-ywoŋa kalo a na yeini a tɔɔle to bere kam konto.

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: Amo na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam konto to mo tei a wo yaara wone, ye ba vɔ-ne de chaponno ne a ye ŋweeno mo tei. Ba nam bá wane ba che Wɛ kwora kam se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé lɔre-ka.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Taane dento seene de ye chega mo: Dé ná tɔge de Yezu dé te, dé wó na ŋwea o tei ne.

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: Dé ná fɔge dé zege lanyerane cham wone, dé wó da dé di paare o tei ne. Dé nam ná ve‑o, o de wó ve debam mo.

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: Dé ná maŋe dé ba jege o chega, wonto ta wó zege o chega wone mo, kolo ŋwaane o ware se o jwoori o tete kwaga ne. Dé kikia na wó su Wɛ yi tei to

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Ta‑n guli amo berem dem konto n bere Yezu nɔɔna bam, se n daare n ma Wɛ n kaane-ba lanyerane se ba yé taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ botare baŋa ne. Kantɔgɔ konto dwoŋi ba jege kuri, ye ko pae se balo na jei ba cheigi-ko to boboŋa chɔge Wɛ chega kam tɔgem seeni.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Kwaane n ta‑n tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane se ko su Wɛ yi, se chaveera yé ja‑m o yiga ne. Ta‑n toŋe de jawala de n na wó kwaane n ta‑n bere nɔɔna Wɛ chega kam tei to.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Ja n tete de lare-yɔɔro telo na dae Wɛ chega kam to. Balo na lare konto dwoŋi to pae se nɔɔna jwoori ba maŋe kwaga kwaga mo Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: Ba tusi chega chwoŋa kam wone mo. Ba maa tɛ ba we, Wɛ daa bá bi nɔɔna toone wone, se twa biim maŋe ko kɛ. Ba berem dem konto ma pa se balo na sɛ Wɛ to badwonna boboŋa jwoori ya leiri.

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Ko nye de sɔ-fɔrɔ wone kabeili de zwe dwi dwi na wora tei to. Sedwonna ye lu-nyenno naa sabu-seŋa mo ba mɛ ba ke. Sento ye lonne nyem mo. Sedwonna maa ye dɛ naa dɔgɔ mo ba mɛ ba ke, ye ba mae sento yɔɔ yerane.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Ko bere we, nɔɔno ná chege o tete de wo-yɔɔro tem konto, kotu wó taa ye lonne nyem mo. O maa ye wolo na kwei o tete o ke o tu wom jeŋa ne pa se o jege kuri o pa‑o to mo. O maŋe se o taa toŋe totoŋ-laaro telo maama o tu wom na lage to.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, se n yage keim-yɔɔro telo nɔn-donno boboŋa na yeini ya zoore to, se n daare n kwaane n tɔge chega chwoŋa, de wo-dedoa, de swono, de bochare-zuru. Ta‑n vei de balo bochara na lana ye ba ke ba tete dé Teiru wom jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo na ye dé Teiru wom tontoŋeno to nam ba jege se o taa mage ni-kantɔgɔ. Ko nam maŋe se o taa nege nɔɔna maama lanyerane, se o daare o bere-ba chekke de ban-peno.

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: Ko ta maŋe se o zuri o yera o pa se balo na dwoni ded-o to jwoori ba tɔge chwoŋa. Dɛ delo Wɛ wó pa-ba chwoŋa se ba leiri ba boboŋa, ye ba daare ba ba ba lɔre o chega kam.

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: Konto to, ba swa wó jwoori pa se ba wane ba lu setaana pɛ jeŋa ne. Wonto ya jaane-ba ne kalanchogo tei, ye o pa ba ke o boboŋa na lage tei to.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Ta‑n yei we lɛɛro dedɛ wó taa wora maŋa de maŋa logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne.

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bá taa jege ba dwonna swono, naa ba ŋwaŋa. Ba wó taa ye vwa-nyena. Badwonna maa wó taa ye nankɔ-nyena ye ba ware ba tete ba jaana. Ba wó taa chuli wonnu telo na lamma to.

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto bere ba tete we ba tɔge Wɛ chega kam, ye Wɛ dam nam tera ba tei ne. Nam lɔŋe nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto badwonna yeini ba ke swa ba vei ba zoore sam ba gane kaana balo na ye ka-kayɛ to pa ba boboŋa chɔge. Kaana bam konto wo chɔge de ba keim-balwaaro dedɛ, ye ba boboŋa pae se ba tɔge woŋo kolo maama ba fera na zoore to.

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama kaana bam konto maa boŋa se ba na yi-poro, ye ba nam ware se ba lɔre Wɛ chega kam ba ti.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto na ke tei to nye de Janese de Jambere déem na ve Moses ni faŋa faŋa tei to mo. Ba de ve Wɛ chega kam mo. Ba boboŋa jei mo, ye ba na tɔge Wɛ tei to ye kafɛ.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Ba nam daa bá wane ba kɛ yiga de ba gana yam. Ba na ye nɔn-jworru tei to wó ba ko lɔre ja nɔɔna maama yiga ne, nenɛɛne ko déem na ke Janese de Jambere tei to. Wɛ chega kam jege wolim lanyerane

english_verse: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nmo Timoti, n maŋe n yei amo berem dem na ye tei to, de a totoŋ-naga, de a boboŋa na ye tei to de. Nmo nam ta yei amo na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to, ye n ta yei a na jege ban-peno, de swono, de pu-dɛa tei to.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Ko ye chega mo we, balo maama na boŋe se ba seene ba yia ba taa tɔge Wɛ chega kam Yezu Krista ŋwaane to wó na yaara nɔɔna tei ne.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye nɔn-balwaaro de kampin-nyena, banto keim-lwanno tem wó tiini te puli te gaale. Ba wó taa gane nɔɔna, ye nɔɔna wó taa gane ba de.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye nmo, se n yɔɔre n ta‑n tɔge chega kalo nmo na maŋe n lɔre ye n jwoŋi-ka n ke n boboŋa ne to, kolo ŋwaane balo déem na bere‑m wonnu tem konto to, n yei ba wo lanyerane mo.

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: Nmo na maŋe n ye bu-balaŋa wɛɛne to, nmo yei Wɛ chega twanno tem na bere kolo to. Te berem dem konto wae de pae se n yi poora, se Wɛ jwoŋi‑m o yage, nmo na sɛ Yezu Krista de wo-dedoa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Kolo maama na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom wone to, ko ye Wɛ kikia mo ye ko jege nyɔɔre ko pa debam. Ko wae ko bere debam chega, naa ko kaane debam, naa ko pae dé na koresem, naa ko pae dé wae dé zamese chega tɔgem.

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Konto to, debam balo na ye Wɛ nɔɔna to mo yɔɔre dé maŋe se dé taa toŋe totoŋ-laaro dwi maama.

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri n jege se n ta‑n tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam. Fɔge n ta‑n ke konto, ne nɔɔna ná sɛa, naa ba ná ba sɛa de. Nam bwɛ-ba n pa ba lɔre ba na tusi tei to, se ba daare ba jwoori ba tɔge chwoŋa. Kwoori nɔɔna se ba taa jege pu-dɛa, se n bere-ba lanyerane de ban-peno.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Kokuri, maŋa wó ba ye nɔɔna daa bá sɛ ba taa cheigi berem delo na ye chekke to. Ba laam wó daare ba taa tɔge ba tete boboŋa na lage tei to mo, ye ba pa se berem tiina dedɛ taa wo ba tei ne ba bere-ba wonnu telo maama ba na lage se ba ni to.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Ko daare nmo nam jege se n ja n tete mo de wonnu maama. Vɔ n wo yaara wone. Kwaane n ta‑n toŋa se n pa nɔɔna lɔre Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam. Totoŋe delo maama Wɛ na ke nmo jeŋa ne to, se n toŋe-de n ti maama.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye amo, a ŋwea lage ka ti mo, ne ba na pwori wo-nyɔɔro pɛɛre ba yage tega ne tei to. Maŋa kam yia se amo yage logo baŋa se a vo Wɛ tei.

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Nam kwaane se n ba amo tei lela.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Demas zaŋe o jwoori amo kwaga ne mo, ye o daare o kɛ Tɛsaloni, o boboŋa na tiini ya zo logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem to ŋwaane. Kerɛseka ma kɛ Galatia. Titusi de ma kɛ Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka yerane mo wo a tei ne. Nmo nam ná ma‑n beena, se n pa Maake tɔge o ba, kolo ŋwaane wonto wae o woli-ne de Wɛ totoŋa yam.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
