translation_verse: Nmo ná ma‑n beena, se n ja amo gɔrɔ kom a na yage Torase ne Kapusi tei ne to n ja n ba n pa-ne, dedaane twanno tem de. A tiini a lage tɔn-lilirru tem se a ga.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Alezanda wolo na ye luru to tiini o ke lwarem mo o pa-ne. Dé Teiru wom nam wó waare‑o de o kikia yam konto.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Nam ja n tete ded‑o, kolo ŋwaane o kwaane se o chɔge debam na yeini dé bere chega kalo to mo.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Bobo ye a zege a tole a taane dem se a jwoŋi a tete to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno wo tu o zege amo kwaga ne. Ba maama duri ba yage amo yerane mo. Wɛ nam bere o yé taa jege taane de-ba konto ŋwaane.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom nam zege amo kwaga ne, ye o pa-ne dam se a kwaane a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora se dwi-gɛ tiina maama cheigi-ka. Konto to, Wɛ nam mo jwoŋi amo toone jeŋa ne o yage.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom nam wó jwoŋi-ne wo-lwanno maama wone o yage, ye o daare o ja-ne o vo o zo o telaao paare dem wone de yazura. Wonto maŋe de zula se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne Pirisila de Akwila n pa-ne, dedaane Onesifɔrɔ sɔŋɔ tiina bam maama.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Erasitu laam maŋe Korinti ne mo. Ko daare amo yage Torofima Militus ne, o na ba jege yazura to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Kwaane se n ke lela n ba ye yadɛ ta wo yi. Yubulu, de Pudɛnza, de Linusi, de Kaludia, ko ta woli de dé nu-bia bam maama jɔɔne‑m lanyerane.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom wó taa wo nmo bochare ne. Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: Ko daare ka maŋa kam na yi to, debam ma ba dé lɔre o ni-gwonim dem konto jaja. Ko maa ye kwora kam konto mo dé Vereno Wɛ pɛ amo ni se a taa tɔɔle a bere nɔɔna.

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: Nmo Titusi ye nenɛɛne amo bu chekke mo dedaane dé na tɔge daane dé jege wo-dedoa de Yezu tei to. Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Vereno Yezu Krista wó pa nmo zaane de yazura. Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa taane

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Nmo ná kuri wolo, o jege se o taa ye wolo nɔɔna na bá taa jege o yera taane to mo. O nam maŋe se o taa jege kaane dedoa yerane mo. Ko maŋe se o bia de taa jege wo-dedoa de Yezu, se nɔɔna yé pa ba ye nɔn-wo-korro de zwabani-nyena.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Kokuri, ko maŋe se wolo na jege Yezu nɔɔna bam o nii to taa ye wolo nɔɔna na bá taa jege o yera taane to mo, Wɛ na ke o nɔɔna bam wonto jeŋa ne se o taa nii-ba to ŋwaane. O yé taa ye boyere-nyem, naa ban-lom tu, naa sa-nyɔro, naa jar-keiru, naa nɔn-kwolo, naa kampin-nyeno.

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe se o taa ye nɔn-ŋom na jeeri veira o sɔŋɔ ne to. O jege se o taa ye jawale-nyem wolo na tɔge Wɛ ni de chega, ye o wae o tete o jaana to.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Nam tiŋi yiga tiina konto dwoŋi, kolo ŋwaane zwabani-nyena dedɛ wora abam tei ne. Banto yeini ba gane nɔɔna mo ye ba bere-ba wo-yɔɔro. Ba dedɛ mo ye balo na tiini ba sɛ Juu tiina chullu tem to.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Kiriti tiina bam tete sampwora déem mo wora, ye o ta o we, “Kiriti tiina yeini ba fɔ vwa mo maŋa maama. Ba maa nye de vare-balwaaro tei, ye ba ta ye jawɔre-nyena de nɔn-kwollu de.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: O nam na tage konto to, ko ye chega mo o taga. Mo kokuri nmo nam jege se n tiini n kaane Kiriti tiina bam lanyerane se ko pa ba yɔɔre ba taa tɔge Wɛ chega kam chekke,

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: se ba daa yé sɛ Juu tiina sensɔle selo na dae chega to, naa se ba sɛ chullu telo nɔɔna na ve Wɛ chega kam ye ba jege ba bere-ba to.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na jege wo-pwoŋo to, kolokolo ba jege digiru wonto tei ne. Ko daare wolo na ve Wɛ ye o bochare ta jege digiru to, kolokolo tera ko na lana wonto tei ne. Konto tu boboŋa chɔge mo ye o yu-punnu vugimi.

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto dwoŋi nam tɛ ba we ba me de Wɛ, ye ba nam yeiri‑o. Ba kikia nam mo bere konto. Ba jege yi-dɛɛre, ye ba ke wo-zɔɔna Wɛ yiga ne. Ba ma bere ba wo maŋe de kolo maama na lana to keim.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Nmo jege se n bere nɔn-kweero se ba taa nege ba tete mo, se ba kwori ba taa ye jawale-nyena, se ba yɔɔre ba sɛ Yezu de wo-dedoa, de swono, de pu-dɛa.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye kazena, se n pa ba taa jege ba tete se ko pa Wɛ taa nae zula ba tei ne. Ba nam yé taa ye bebare-nyena, naa ba taa pae sana nyɔɔm wae-ba. Ba nam jege se ba taa bere nɔɔna chwo-laao tɔgem na ye tei to.

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: Ko maŋe se ka-bwona bam taa ye jawale-nyena balo na cho ba tete de digiru to, se ba kwori ba taa ye ka-yerro telo na toŋe sɔŋɔ totoŋa lanyerane ye ba sɛ ba pa ba banna to. Konto to, nɔɔna daa bá na chwoŋa se ba yaale Wɛ taane dem, kaana banto kikia yam ŋwaane.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye nɔn-donno, se n kwoori-ba se ba de taa ye jawale-nyena wonnu maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Pa se n ni taane taa jege chega, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o yaale-de. Konto to, wolo maama na done debam to wó na o chaveera de woŋo na tera se o maa ŋɔɔne o chɔge debam yiga to.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye kabɛ, ko maŋe se ba sɛ ba pa ba tiina wonnu maama wone, se ko pa ba tiina bam wo pwoli. Ba yé ve ba tiina bam ni,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: naa ba ŋɔ-ba. Ba nam pa se nɔɔna taa yei ba wo lanyerane de wonnu maama, se ko pa nɔɔna lɔre we, berem delo na vei dé Vereno Wɛ chega kam seeni to jege kuri lanyerane.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, Wɛ pɛ se nɔɔna lɔre o zaane dem na ye tei, se ko pa ba maama na verem o tei ne.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: O ma kwei o tete o ke nabiina jeŋa ne, ye o sɛ se o te se o ma ŋwe debam wɛleera jene, se o daare o fɔge o kwɛ dé bochara se dé taa ye o tete nɔɔna, ye dé tiini dé seene dé yia wo-laaro kikia baŋa ne.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Guli n bere nɔɔna bam se ba taa nege ba yiga tiina de balo na ye dedɛɛra to, se ba taa sɛ ba ni. Ba nam taa yei se ba ke wo-laaro dwi maama.

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: Ba nam yé zaŋe ba yaale nɔɔn-nɔɔno yuu, naa ba mage ni-kantɔgɔ. Ko nam maŋe se ba taa zuli nɔɔna, ye ba gwooni ba tete nɔɔna maama yiga ne.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Kokuri debam maama déem ye bedwe mo. Debam yi déem wo poore. Dé maa jege yi-dɛɛre ye dé kwori dé tusi. Dé déem wo wo-yɔɔro jeŋa ne mo ye dé tɔge kolo maama dé boboŋa na lage to. Dé maa yeini dé ke lwarem de puseŋa, ye dé chuli daane.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: De ko de, debam Vereno Wɛ wom laam bere jaja we, o jege nabiina swono lanyerane,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: ye o vere debam wɛleera jeŋa ne o yage. O na jwoŋi debam o yage to, ko ye o na ye ŋwaŋa tu to ŋwaane mo, ye ko dae debam na ke keim-laaro telo to ŋwaane. O ma tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo o saare wo-digiru dé bochara wone, pa se dé pipiri dé taa jege boboŋ-doora, ye dé na ŋwe-doŋa o tei ne.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Ko maa ye debam Vereno Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo Wɛ toŋe o Sin-laao kom o pa debam zɛɛra,

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Amo na tɛ taane delo to ye berem chekke mo. Konto ŋwaane, a lage se n kwaane n zege wonnu tem konto chega kam kwaga ne, se ko pa balo na sɛ Wɛ to seene ba yia ba taa tɔge keim-laaro. Dento berem dem lana, ye de jege nyɔɔre de pae nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye ta-yɔɔro, naa dé kwoa kwoa yera natɔga taane, naa ni-kantɔgɔ Juu tiina chullu tem baŋa ne, se n che n tete de tento maama. Te nam ba jege nyɔɔre ye te ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Kokuri, nɔɔno ná ye konto dwoŋi, n yei we o daa ba lage se o tɔge chwoŋa. O na maŋe o tusi tei to mo bere we, o bá na bora Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Amo lage a toŋe Atimasa naa Tichika nmo tei ne. Ba wolo ná yi nmo tei, se n kwaane n ba lela n na amo Nikopola ne, kokuri amo boŋe se yadɛ dem ti amo dáane mo.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Nmo nam kwaane se n woli Apolo, de Zenase wolo na ye lɔya tu to, se ba zaŋe ba bobo ba chwoŋa kam veiŋa, se n daare n pa-ba kolo maama ba na lage to.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia balo na wo amo tei ne to maama jɔɔne nmo. Jɔɔne balo na sɛ Yezu ye ba jege debam swono to. Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam maama tei ne.

english_verse: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
translation_verse: Amo Pɔɔl wolo na ye Yezu Krista nyem ye ba ja-ne ba ke peena diga ne o chega kam ŋwaane to mo popone tɔnɔ konto, ye dé nu-bu Timoti wo amo tei ne. Dé popone dé pa nmo Filimon, nmo na ye debam badwoŋ-swono ye n tɔge de debam n toŋe Wɛ totoŋa to.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: Dé jɔɔne nmo, ye dé daare dé jɔɔne dé nakɔ Afia, de Achipu wolo de na chana Wɛ totoŋa baŋa ne to. Dé daare dé jɔɔne Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na yeini ko tigisi daane nmo sɔŋɔ ne to maama.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ, de dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó pa abam zaane de yazura.

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama amo ná yeini a lwoori Wɛ, a guli nmo gula o yiga ne ye a ke‑o lei nmo ŋwaane.

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane a lɔre we, n jege Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama swono lanyerane, ye n ta kwori n ke n wo-dedoa de dé Teiru Yezu.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Nmo na jege n dwonna swono tei to mo pae se amo wo pwoli dedɛ, ye ko fɔge amo de baare, nmo na woli Wɛ nɔɔna bam se ba na ywoni ba bochara ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: Amo nam wó tɔge swono ŋwaane mo a lwoori‑m. Amo Pɔɔl wolo na ye nɔn-kwea ye ba ke-ne peena diga ne leile konto Yezu Krista chega kam ŋwaane to,

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: a lage a lwoori‑m nmo kabaa Onesima ŋwaane. Wonto nye de a tete bu mo. Amo na wo peena diga ne to mo a jigi o kwo Wɛ chwoŋa seeni.

english_verse: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
translation_verse: O déem na toŋe o pa nmo to, o wo pɛ se n na nyɔɔre. Ko daare leile konto o jege nyɔɔre o pa nmo de amo maama.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Amo na wo peena diga ne Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam berem ŋwaane to, a ya wó taa lage se o maŋe a tei ne, se o wane o leiri nmo yuu ne o taa toŋa o pa-ne.

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: Amo nam ba lage se a ke kolokolo ye nmo yeiri ko ni ne. Ko wó taa ye nmo ná sɛ se n woli-ne, ye ko bá taa ye fefeo ŋwaane.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Onesima na duri o yage nmo to, o pɔɔre nmo tei ne maŋa fenfee wone. Ko nam wó wane ko pa se o laam jwoori o ba o taa wo nmo tei ne taa wuu.

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: O na duri o yage nmo to, o déem ye kabaa mo. O ná jwoori, o laam wó taa dwoi kabaa na ye tei to, de o na jigi nmo nu-bu dé Teiru wom ŋwaane to. Amo tiini a jege o swono. Nmo nam wó tiini n ta‑n swoi‑o se ko gaale, o na ye n kabaa ye o kwori o ye n nu-bu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Nmo ná sɛ we debam seene dé me daane Wɛ ŋwaane, se n kwaane n jeeri Onesima lanyerane ne amo mo tei.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: O déem ná maŋe o ke o chɔge nmo yuu, naa o ná jege nmo jene, se n kwei ko maama n pa amo.

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafera mo jɔɔne‑m. Wonto dedaane amo mo wo peena diga ne Yezu Krista chega kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: Maake, de Arisaka, de Demas, de Luka maama de jɔɔne‑m. Banto de amo tɔge daane dé toŋa dé pa Wɛ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu Krista zaane dem taa wo abam bochara ne.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to, Wɛ déem tɔge o sampwori sem baŋa ne mo o ŋɔɔne dedaane dé nabaara bam. O déem yeini o da chwei dwi dwi mo o ŋɔɔne de-ba kuni dedɛ.

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, logo baŋa kweelim da yam na daare fee maŋa kalo to, Wɛ laam ma pa se o Bu mo ba o ŋɔɔne o taane de debam. Wɛ dɛ wonto ŋwaane mo o ke logo baŋa de wɛyuu wonnu maama, ye o tiŋi‑o se o ba o taa tei wonnu telo maama na wora to.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Wɛ Bu wom maa jege pwooni delo na bere Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na ye tei to. O maa jege o Kwo Wɛ nyenyego chekke, pa se dé lɔre Wɛ na ye tei to ja. O ni taane maa jege dam ye de pae se wonnu maama taa fɔge te wora taa taa. O ma ba o saare nɔɔna wɛleera pa ba bochara fɔge ya kwɛ, ye o laam daare o jwoori o di wɛyuu o vo o jeini Baŋa Wɛ jazem seeni.

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Konto to, o tu o dwoni Wɛ malese sem, de Wɛ na pɛ o jege yere delo na daga de dwoi sento na jege yere tei to.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ko ná ye malese sem, Wɛ wo fɔge o ta de se wolowolo o we: “Nmo mo ye amo Bu, ye zem amo de ji nmo Kwo.” Wɛ daa ta wo tage o maleka tu wolowolo taane o we: “Amo wó taa ye o Kwo, se o de taa ye amo bu.”

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Ko daare maŋa kalo Wɛ na boŋe se o toŋe o Bu-doa kam se o ba logo baŋa to, o tage o we, “Wɛ malese sem maama jege se se zuli‑o mo.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye malese sem tete, Wɛ tage se taane o we, se ye omo tontoŋena mo, ye se toŋe ne vio mo tei. O ta pae se ji ne min-vogo mo tei, se se taa toŋa se pa‑o.

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Ko daare ko ná ye Wɛ Bu wom, Wɛ tage o taane o we: “Wɛ, nmo paare dem wó taa wora taa, se ko taa vei wuu. Nmo wó ta‑n tei n nɔɔna se ko tɔge chwoŋa chekke.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Nmo swoi chega tɔgem, ye n daare n chuli lwarem kikia. Konto ŋwaane mo, n Tu Wɛ wom kuri nmo, ye o lwo o swolim nuga kam n yuu ne pa se n di ywoni n dwoni n dwonna bam maama.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Wɛ ta tage dé Teiru wom taane o we: “Boboa ne to, nmo déem mo chwi tega kam kuri, ye n ta kwori n ma n jea n naane wɛyuu wonnu maama.

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: Te wó ba te leiri, ye n kukuli-te n tiŋi, ne nmo na kukuli gare-dwoŋo n tiŋi ye n daare n kwei gare-doŋo n zo tei to. Nmo nam ta wó ta‑n ye ne n na maŋe n ye tei to mo. N bena yam bá fɔge ya ti.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Wɛ déem wo fɔge o ta de o malese sem wolowolo o we: “Ba n jeini amo jazem seeni, se a daare a wane n dona bam a ke n dam kuri ne se n ta‑n tei-ba.”

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo ko fe se dé kwaane dé taa jege Wɛ kwora kalo dé na nigi to se ko gaale, se dé yé tutwoni dé nwoŋi o chega kam wone.

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam balo Wɛ na dɛ o Bu wom ŋwaane o pa dé lɔre o kwora kam to, dé yiga ná tera o verem dem wone, dé wó wane dé lu na? Dé Teiru Yezu mo dɛ yiga o ŋɔɔne Wɛ verem dem konto taane o bere nɔɔna. Balo na nigi-de to laam ma daare ba ta ba bere debam we ko ye chega mo.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Wɛ tete mo zege ba kwaga ne de o na pɛ ba ke maana de wo-kenkagela dwi dwi na bere o dam to. O ma daare o woli ba maama de o Sin-laao kom dam, nenɛɛne o na boŋe se o ke o pa ba dedoa dedoa tei to. Yezu tu o ji nabiinu se o jwoŋi debam

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Wɛ wo pɛ o malese sem di dam logo kolo na lage ko ba ko taa wora to baŋa ne. Ko ye lo-doŋo kom konto taane mo dé tɛa.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere David na ŋɔɔne de Wɛ o we: “Amo Tu Wɛ, ko ná ye nabiina, bɛ mo ye n jege ba boboŋa? Bɛ mo ke ye n yiga wo nabiin-bia wone konto?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nmo nam pɛ se nabiina tiini ba jege paare, ye n ta pa-ba zula, ye ba laam daare fee se ba taa mae de malese sem.

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: N ma‑n daare n ke wonnu maama ba dam kuri ne.” Ko bere debam we, Wɛ ke wonnu maama nabiina dam kuri ne mo. Kokuri mo kolokolo tera Wɛ na wo ke-ko ba dam kuri ne. Ko nam ye chega mo we, leile konto dé ta wo nɛ we, wonnu maama wo nabiina dam kuri ne.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Dé na nɛ kolo to mo ye Yezu de o dam-fɔrɔ kom. Wonto déem jigi nabiinu mo ye o daare fee se o taa mae de malese sem. O ma tu o tete ye o yaare o te. Konto ŋwaane Wɛ laam ma pa se o tiini o na paare de zula telaao ne. Konto baŋa ne mo Wɛ tɔge o zaane dem ŋwaane o pa se Yezu wane o leiri nabiina maama yuu ne o te ba zeinim ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo ye wolo na tɔge o tete ŋwaane o ke wonnu maama to. O boboŋa déem ma ja se o pa nabiina dedɛ ji o bia, se ba daare ba taa jege paare o tei ne. Mo kokuri ko maŋe se Wɛ pa o Bu Yezu tɔge yaara ŋwaane o vo o yi o jeiŋa jei o ti. Wonto mo jwoŋi Wɛ bia bam ba wɛleera wone, ye o tɔge ba yiga o jaane-ba o vei Wɛ tei.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Yezu mo ye wolo na pae nabiina ye wose Wɛ yiga ne to. Wonto de balo o na pɛ ba ji wose to ye nɔn-doa bia mo. Konto ŋwaane mo o bwoi-ba we o nu-bia, ye ko ba jege chaveera o tei ne.

english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Mo kokuri o tage de Wɛ o we: “Amo wó pa nmo yere zaŋe a nu-bia bam yiga ne. A maa wó zege ba nɔn-kɔgɔ kom tetare ne a leeni a seini nmo yere dem.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: O daa ta maa we: “Amo tete wó kwei a teena maama a pa Wɛ.” O daa ta we: “Nii-na amo de bia balo Wɛ na ke amo jeŋa ne to mo tento dé zega.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Chega ŋwaane to, balo na ye Wɛ bia to ye nabiina mo, ye ba jege yera de jana. Konto ŋwaane mo Yezu de déem tɔge o ji nabiinu, se o wane o tɔge o toone dem ŋwaane o chɔge wolo na jege toone dam to. Wonto mo ye setaana pɛ.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Dé lɔre we, ko dae malese sem mo o tu se o zeini. O nam tu se o zeini Abaraham dwi tiina mo.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Kokuri Yezu na nɛ yaara ye o wo sɛ se ya soge‑o to, o laam wae o zeini balo yaara na wora ya faŋe-ba to se ba de taa jege pu-dɛa.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: A nu-bia balo na ye Wɛ nyem to, Wɛ bwoŋi abam se á tɔge á na ywoni telaao ne. Nam boŋe-na á nii Yezu na ye tei to. Wonto mo ye Baŋa Wɛ tontoŋ-kweo de Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu wolo dé na jege o chega to.

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo tiŋi‑o se o taa ye konto, ye o toŋa o pa Wɛ de jawala. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de Moses déem na jege jawala o nii Wɛ nɔɔna bam o pa‑o tei to.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Yezu nam seene o maŋe se o na zula ko dwoni Moses, kokuri nɔɔno ná bobo sɔŋɔ kuri, wonto jege se o na zula se ko dwoi sɔŋɔ kom tete.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Sɔŋɔ nam tera ye ko dae nɔɔno mo bobo ko kuri. Wɛ nam mo ye wolo na bobo wonnu maama kuri.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Ko daare Yezu Krista mo ye sɔŋɔ kom tete bu chekke, ye o tei Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom. Debam maa ye o sɔŋɔ kom tiina, ne dé ná maŋe dé jege pu-dɛa ye dé ta bere we, dé jege teena o tei ne to. Dé yé taa jege yi-dɛɛre dé pa Wɛ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Ko maa nye de Wɛ Sin-laao kom na bere debam tei ko we: “Abam zem ná nigi Wɛ kwora,

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Wɛ maa we: “Abam nabaara bam déem nɛ amo na ke-ba tei taa, bena finna to, ye ba ta kwaane se ba maŋe amo ba nii.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo amo bane zaŋe de á nabaara bam konto, ye a ta a we, ‘Ba yeini ba paale ba tusi mo maŋa maama. Ba maa ba sɛa se ba tɔge amo chwei sem.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Mo kokuri amo tɔge a ban-zɔŋɔ kom baŋa a ma du duuri a pa-ba a we, amo bere a bá pa-ba chwoŋa se ba zo amo woro kom wone ba sii.”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, ta‑á yei-na se abam wolowolo yé taa jege boboŋ-lwanno o bochare ne se ko pa o ve Ŋwea Tu Wɛ ni ye o daare o ywori o kwaga ne.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á woli-na daane maŋa maama, se ko pa á ta‑á jege pu-dɛa. Ko ta ná ye zem da yam ye á ni Wɛ kwora kam, se abam wolowolo yé pa lwarem gane‑o pa se o ke yi-dɛɛre o pa Wɛ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Debam nam tu dé tɔge de Yezu Krista dé ye Wɛ bia mo, ne dé ta ná jege teena de Wɛ, nenɛɛne dé na maŋe dé jege tei boboa ne to, se ko vo ko yi dé ŋwea kweelim.

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo déem na nigi Wɛ kwora kam ye ba daare ba jege yi-dɛɛre to, banto ye bera mo? Ba ye balo maama Moses na tɔge ba yiga o ja o nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to mo.

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Wɛ na dugi o we, omo bere o bá pa-ba chwoŋa se ba zo o woro kom wo ba sii to, ko ye balo na ve o ni to taane mo. Ko dae konto na?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Ko ma pa dé lɔre we, Wɛ na wo pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba zo o woro kom wo to, ko ye ba na wo ke ba wo-dedoa ded‑o to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Debam maŋe dé ni Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam, nenɛɛne dé nabaara bam de na nigi-ka tei to. Banto nam na nigi-ka to, ba wo nɛ nyɔɔre ka baŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane ba wo ke ba wo-dedoa se ba tɔge Wɛ na tage kolo to.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Debam balo na ke dé wo-dedoa de Wɛ to mo wó ba dé sii o woro kom wone. Wɛ nam tage nɔɔna banto taane o we: “Amo tɔge a ban-zɔŋɔ kom ŋwaane a du duuri a pa-ba a we, amo bere a bá pa-ba chwoŋa se ba zo amo woro kom wo ba sii.” Wɛ na tage konto to, ko nam dae we o ba jege woro mo se ba zo da ba sii. Ko zege maŋa kalo o na naane logo baŋa to mo o totoŋa yam ti ye o daare o sii.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom tage Wɛ totoŋa da yarepɛ siu dɛ dem taane ko we, “Da yarepɛ dɛ dem ne mo Wɛ laam jeini o sii o totoŋa yam maama wone.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Wɛ daa ta tage o siu kom taane o we, “Amo bere a bá pa-ba chwoŋa se ba zo amo woro kom wo ba sii.”

english_verse: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.
translation_verse: Konto mo dé yei we, chwoŋa ta wora zem se Wɛ nɔɔna bam na siu o tei ne.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane pa-na dé kwaane se dé zo Wɛ woro kom wo dé sii. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé zaŋe o ve Wɛ ni se o jwoori Wɛ kwaga ne, ne dé nabaara bam déem na ke tei to.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora kam jege ŋwea ye ka dana lanyerane. Ka nye de se-zɔɔ kolo na jege nia yalei to mo. Ka maa wae ka zoore nɔɔno wo ka pɔɔre o jworo de o bochare wonnu maama, ye ka daare ka lɔre o swa de o boboŋa maama na ye tei to.

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Debam nam jege wolo na nɛ chwoŋa se o zo Wɛ tei telaao ne, o na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu debam ŋwaane to. Wonto mo ye Wɛ Bu Yezu, ye o dwoi logo baŋa kaanem yiga tiina bam maama. Konto ŋwaane pa-na se dé tiini dé sɛ Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem lanyerane.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, pa-na se dé taa jege baare ye dé vo dé yi Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Wɛ wom jeiŋa jei, se dé jwoŋi zaane o tei ne. Konto mo Wɛ wó duri dé ŋwaŋa ye o pa debam zaane se ko wane ko zeini debam maŋa kalo dé na lage wolim to.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: O tete nam na bwona ye o yeini o tusi to, o wae o jaane o bochare de balo na yeiri Wɛ chega kam lanyerane ye ba tusi to.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: O na bwona konto to, ko fe mo se o kaane Wɛ o tete wɛleera saarem ŋwaane, se ko woli de balo o na toŋe o pa-ba to de wɛleera ŋwaane.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o le o tete se o ji Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu. Ko ye Wɛ mo wó kuri‑o se o taa ye konto, nenɛɛne o déem na bobo o kuri Aron tei to.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Ko ta ye bedwe mo de Yezu Krista na jigi Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu to. O wo boŋe kamunim o pa o tete se o taa ye konto. Wɛ nam mo tage ded‑o o we: “Nmo mo ye amo Bu, ye zem amo de ji nmo Kwo.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Yezu na wo logo baŋa ne maŋa kalo to, o yeini o tiini o ware Wɛ, ye o ka yi-na o kaase o ma lwoori‑o, o na yei we Wɛ wó wane o jwoŋi‑o toone wone to ŋwaane. Wɛ ma sɛ o wɛ-lworo kom, o na tu o tete ye o zuli‑o lanyerane to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: O maŋe o ye Wɛ Bu mo. De konto de, o na yaare tei to mo pɛ o lɔre o na wó ke tei o tɔge Wɛ ni to.

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: Wɛ ma le‑o se o taa ye o kaanem nakwe tu, ne Melkizedeka faŋa faŋa na ye tei to. Dé yé ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Amo ya jege taane dedɛ se a ta a bere abam konto baŋa ne, ye ko nam tiini ko chana se a pa á ni ko kuri, kolo ŋwaane abam laam jege jawɔrɔ á boboŋa ne.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Balo na jege bu-balɛ boboŋa konto to bere we, ba ta wo lɔre Wɛ kwora kalo na bere o chega kam to chekke.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane pa-na se dé yage Yezu Krista taane wo-mwaalo tem, se dé laam pa dé boboŋa kweere Wɛ chega kam seeni. Abam daa ba jege se á jwoori á bobo Wɛ taane dem zamesem, bɛŋwaane á maŋe á lɔre á na wó yage wo-yɔɔro kikia tei to, de á na wó ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to.

english_verse: But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
translation_verse: Nɔɔna banto dwi ná ywori Wɛ chwoŋa wone, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o pa ba leiri ba wo se ba daa taa tɔge Wɛ, kolo ŋwaane ba yeini ba pa Wɛ Bu Yezu na chaveera nɔɔna yiga ne, nenɛɛne ba tete na jwoori ba ke‑o dagara kam yuu ne ba go tei to.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Ko nye de doa ná wora ka nena lanyerane nɔɔno kara ne. Tega kam ná nyɔge doa na bam, ye ka daare ka ke wodiiru lanyerane ka pa balo na dugi ka baŋa ne to, Wɛ wó swɛ tega kam konto swolim.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Ko daare tega kam ná ke sabare de wo-korro yerane, ko bere we ka ye kafɛ mo ye ka maŋe se Wɛ mo sɔɔle-ka o yage. Ko kweelim nam ye se ba ma mini mo ba zwɛ-ka ba chɔge.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: De konto de, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, abam wó taa gara. Amo yei we abam ta wo Wɛ chwoŋa wone á maa vei o tei se o jwoŋi abam.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Wɛ ye chega tu mo. O nam bá swei á na maŋe á tɔge keim-laaro tei to. O ta bá swei á na jege o swono lanyerane, ye á toŋe á woli o nɔɔna bam ko ba ko yi zem maama to.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Á yé pa se jawɔrɔ zo abam. Nam lwoni-na balo na fɔge ba zege de pu-dɛa ye ba jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ to. Banto laam wó ba ba jwoŋi wonnu telo Wɛ na pwooli we, o wó pa-ba to. Wɛ kampwola bá fɔge ka leiri

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Wɛ na dugi konto to, Abaraham déem ma vɔ pu-dɛa taa, ye o laam ba o na Wɛ na pwooli se o pa‑o kolo to.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye nabiina ná yeini ba du duuri, ba wó ma wolo na dwoi ba tete to yere mo ba du, se ko bere we ba taane dem ye chega, se bwɛa daa ta tera.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ na pwooli kampwola de balo to, o lage se ba lɔre lanyerane we, o bá fɔge o yiri o ni dem. Konto ŋwaane mo o dugi duuri o woli de o kampwola kam.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Kikia yanto yalei bá wane ya leiri ya ji vwa, ko na ye Wɛ tete kikia to ŋwaane. Konto ŋwaane mo debam balo na ke dé tete Wɛ jeŋa ne to wó tiini dé ke pu-dɛa ye dé ta jege teena ded‑o we, dé wó na wonnu telo o na tiŋi o pa debam to.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Teena yam dé na jege Wɛ tei ne konto to tiini ya dana ye ya bá wane ya chɔge. Ya maa pae se dé boboŋa tigi jeiga dedoa, ye ya zo Wɛ tete jeiŋa jei mɛ na chege de gare-jale se nabiina yé zo to.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: A laam lage a ta Melkizedeka taane dem a bere abam. Wonto déem ye Salem tiina pɛ mo ye o kwori o ye Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ kaanem tu. Abaraham na wane pwa badwonna jara wone ye o laam jwoori maŋa kalo to mo Melkizedeka jeeri‑o chwoŋa ne o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o ke o yuu ne.

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: Abaraham laam ma kwei nyɔɔre delo o na nɛ jara yam baŋa ne to o pɔɔre teiri delo na ye Melkizedeka nyem to o pa‑o. Melkizedeka yere dem kuri mo ye ‘Chega tu’. Ko woli da, o na ye Salem pɛ to, ko ta bere we o ye ‘Yazura pɛ’ mo.

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Debam nam wo nigi Melkizedeka kwo de o nu ŋwa, ye dé yeiri o kuri na bobo mɛ to. Dé maa yeiri o lora dɛ de o toone maŋa. Konto pa se o nye de Wɛ Bu wom, ye o ye Wɛ kaanem tu taa wuu.

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Boŋe-na á nii Melkizedeka déem na jege kamunim tei to. Konto ŋwaane mo debam nabaaro Abaraham déem le o nyɔɔre dem o na nɛ jara yam baŋa ne to o pa‑o.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na nwoŋi Levi dwi tiina wone ye ba kaane ba pa Wɛ to, Wɛ ni dem pɛ-ba chwoŋa se ba jwoŋi ba teiri wonnu ba dwonna Isarele tiina bam tei ne, ye ba maama maŋe ba ye Abaraham dwi tiina mo.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Melkizedeka nam wo nwoŋi Levi dwi dem wone. De konto de, o jwoŋi o teiri wonnu Abaraham tete tei ne. O ma daare o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o yage Abaraham yuu ne, ye Abaraham nam ya mo ye wolo Wɛ na pwooli kampwola ded‑o to.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Ko nam ba jege bobwea we, nɔɔno ná sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o pa o dwoŋi, wonto mo ye nɔn-kamunu o dwoi wodwoŋi wom.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Levi dwi tiina bam déem yeini ba jwoŋi ba teiri wonnu mo, ye banto mo ye balo na bá lu toone jeŋa ne to. Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam bere we, Melkizedeka ye wolo na ŋwe to mo ye o jwoŋi o teiri wonnu.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Wɛ na leiri o kaanem tu dwi konto to, ko jege se o nia yam de tɔge ya leiri mo.

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Dé nam seene dé lɔre Wɛ na tiŋi chwo-doŋa tei to. Ko maa ye o kaanem tu Yezu laam na nwoŋi dwi-gaa wone, ye o nye de Melkizedeka déem na ye tei to.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Yezu na jigi Wɛ kaanem tu tei to wo tɔge nabiina chullu ŋwaane, se ko tɔge o ŋwea kalo toone na ba jege dam ka baŋa ne to ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nam tage o taane o we: “Nmo mo wó ta‑n ye amo kaanem tu taa wuu, ne Melkizedeka faŋa faŋa na ye tei to.”

english_verse: God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is, “I, the Lord, promise that you will be a priest forever! And I will never change my mind!”
translation_verse: Ko daare Yezu na jigi Wɛ kaanem tu to, Wɛ dugi duuri o ŋwaane, ye o ta ded‑o o we: “Amo Baŋa Wɛ mo dugi a duuri ye a bá fɔge a za a ni. Nmo wó ta‑n ye amo kaanem tu taa wuu.”

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: Ko daare Yezu mo jege ŋwea taa wuu, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa ba jege se o leiri o yuu ne o ji Wɛ kaanem tu.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Konto to, o wae o jwoŋi balo na tɔge o ŋwaane ba vei Wɛ tei to o yaga, se kolokolo daa yé chɔge-ba, o na jege ŋwea maŋa maama ye o lwoori Wɛ o pa-ba to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Yezu na ye Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu tei to maŋe de debam boboŋa. O jege wo-pwoŋo de chega Wɛ yiga ne, ye tusim tera o tei ne. Wɛ ma pwɛ‑o nɔn-chechɔgero tei ne, ye o daare o zeiŋi‑o pa o zo o tei wɛyuu baŋa seeni.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina déem na ye tei to, dɛ maama ba yeini ba da yiga ba kaane Wɛ ba ma saare ba tete wɛleera, ye ba laam daare ba kaane Wɛ ba dwonna bam wɛleera ŋwaane. Yezu nam ba jege se o ke konto dwoŋi. Wonto kwei o tete mo o ma kaane Wɛ kuni bedwe yerane, ye konto jege kuri se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Taane dem maama wone de jei sento mo bere we, dé seene dé jege Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu wom konto dwoŋi. O ma na jeiŋa jei telaao ne Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ paare yituŋu kom jazem seeni.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: O maa wo Wɛ wara-jei sem ne mo o toŋa o pa‑o. Jei sem konto ye Baŋa Wɛ tete nyem chekke mo, ye ko dae logo baŋa vwei delo nabiina na pugi se ba taa zuli‑o da to.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: O nam ba jege se o taa wo logo baŋa ne se o kwei woŋo o ma kaane Wɛ. Wɛ kaanem tiina maŋe ba wo logo baŋa ne, ye ba kwei pɛɛra ba ke Wɛ jeŋa ne, se ko maŋe de Moses nia yam na bere tei to.

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Da-yiga ni-gwonim delo Wɛ na ke o pa o nɔɔna to ya ná ba jege gɛɛre, ni dedwoŋi ya daa bá wane de leiri dento yuu ne.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, Wɛ déem bere we gɛɛre wora, ye o ta de o nɔɔna o we: “Maŋa lage ka yi se amo jwoori a gwoni ni de Isarele dwi tiina bam de Judah dwi tiina bam, se ko taa ye amo ni-doore.

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: Dento nam bá taa ye bedwe de ni delo a déem na gwoni de ba nabaara bam maŋa kam a na mɛ a jeŋa a ja-ba a nwoŋi Ejipti teo kom wone to. Banto déem wo sɛ ba tɔge amo ni-gwonim dem konto. Ko ma pa a yiga daa tere ba wone.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam ná yia, ni delo amo na wó gwoni de Isarele dwi tiina bam to mo tento: Amo wó kwei a nia yam a tiŋi ba boboŋa ne mo, ye a daare a popone-ya a yage ba bochara wone. Amo maa wó taa ye ba Tu Wɛ wom, se ba de taa ye amo nɔɔna.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Ba wolowolo daa ba jege se o bere o dwonna, naa se o ta de o chorro we, ba lɔre Baŋa Wɛ. Kolo ŋwaane ba maama wó taa yei amo, ko ná maŋe ko ye nabwona de dedɛɛra de.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne amo wó duri ba ŋwaŋa de ba keim-lwanno tem. A daa bá guli ba wɛleera yam gula.” Mo Baŋa Wɛ na tage tei.

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Wɛ na ŋɔɔne o ni-doore dem taane konto dwoŋi to, ko bere we o da-yiga ni dem laam jigi ni-dwoori mo. Ko maa bere we dento daa ba jege kuri, ye de da yam lage ya kɛ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Wɛ wara-vwei dem konto wo nam pɔɔre di selei mo. De kwaga diga kam yere mo ‘Wɛ di-yuu kom’, ye ka jege min-zwon-zego kom. Tabolo de maa wora ye bworobwooru telo na ye Wɛ nyem to maa tigi ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Sabu-seŋa Wɛ kaanem dakaa maa zege da, ba na zwɛ wonnu telo lwom na ywomma to ka baŋa ne ba pa‑o. Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam de maa wora ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa ba ma kwoli-ka. Ka wo kom maa jege sabu-seŋa zoŋa kalo de wo na jege wodiu kolo yere na ye ‘Manna’ to. Nacheiga kalo na ye Aron nyem ye ka déem puli vɔɔro to de maa wora Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam wone, ko woli de kandwa-pelɛ selei Wɛ nia fuga kam na popone se baŋa ne to.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Dakaa kam baŋa maa ye jeiga kalo Wɛ na saare nabiina wɛleera mɛ to. Ba déem ma ke cherubi selei nyenyero ba zege da. Se maa bere Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ye se vɔna yam kwoli dakaa kam baŋa. Ko nam daa dae se dé ŋɔɔne wonnu tem konto taane dedɛ.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Wara-vwei dem de de wonnu tem na wora konto to, Wɛ kaanem tiina bam yeini ba zo de kwaga diga kam dɛ maama mo se ba toŋe ba totoŋa yalo na pae Wɛ jege zula to.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye di-yun-gala kam, Wɛ kaanem nakwe tu wom yerane mo jege chwoŋa se o zo ka wo bedwe bene maama wone. Wonto nam ná lage o zo, o wó kwei vara jana mo o ja zo se o ma kaane Wɛ, se ko saare o tete wɛleera, se ko daare ko saare tusim kikia yalo o dwonna nabiina na ke ye ba yeiri ya ni ne to.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam mae kikia yam konto maama na ye tei to mo ko bere debam we, chwoŋa déem ya tera se nɔɔna wane ba zo Wɛ di-yun-gala kam. Vwei dem dedaane de kwaga diga kam maama ta na zege to bere we di-yun-gala kam ni ta wo pore mo.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Kaanem kikia yanto dwoŋi jege kuri logo baŋa seeni yerane mo, ko ná ye wodiu dim, naa bochare digiru zarem ŋwaane. Ya maama tɔge nabiina chullu mo, ye ya jege kuri se ko taa vei maŋa kam Wɛ na wó fɔge o tiŋi o chwo-doŋa kam to. Yezu Krista jana bam taane

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: O ma vo o zo Wɛ tete di-yun-gala kam. Ko ye bedwe yerane mo o zoa, ye o laam wora taa wuu. O nam wo kwei bone naa na-bale jana o ja zo se o ma kaane Wɛ. Ko maa ye o tete jana mo o mɛ o ŋwe debam wɛleera jene, ye o jwoŋi debam o ke Wɛ jeŋa ne se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni-dwoori dem bere we, nɔɔno wolo bochare ná jege digiru, ba jege se ba kwei bone jana naa na-bale jana ba gwaane de na-chwɛ delo ba na zwɛ to tentwarem mo ba ma mi nɔɔno wom yera. Keim dem konto mo yeini de zare o yera digiru tem ye de daare de fɔge‑o Wɛ chwoŋa wone.

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: Ko na ye konto to, Yezu na tega ye o jana nwoŋi to, ko bá tiini ko fɔge nɔɔna bochara mo na? O ma tɔge Wɛ Jworo kom na wo o tei ne taa wuu to baŋa o ji kaanem delo na lana fase to o ke o pa Wɛ. O na kaane Wɛ debam ŋwaane konto to, ko wae ko pae dé bochara taa lana fase, pa se dé boboŋa daa yé zo wo-yɔɔro kikia, ye dé daare dé zuli Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ.

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Moses daa ta ma kwei jana bam o ke konto dwoŋi o ma mi vwei dem de wonnu telo maama na wora Wɛ zula ŋwaane to.

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa vwei dem wonnu telo na wora ye te lwoni Wɛ telaao wonnu chekke na ye tei to jege se te zare de vara jana mo konto dwoŋi. Ko daare Wɛ telaao wonnu tem tete na wó fɔge te kwɛ tei to, ko fe mo se ba kaane Wɛ se ko taa dwoi faŋa kaanem dem na ye tei to.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista nam na zo Wɛ tei to, ko dae wara-vwei delo nabiina na pugi ye de lwoni Wɛ sɔŋɔ chekke to mo o zoa. O nam seene o zo Wɛ tei telaao ne mo chekke. O maa wo dáane o zege Wɛ yiga ne debam zeinim ŋwaane.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: O na zo Wɛ tei chekke konto to, o zo kuni bedwe mo, ko dae bene maama wone, nenɛɛne Wɛ kaanem yiga tiina déem na ke tei to. Banto yeini ba kwei vara jana mo ba ja zo Wɛ di-yun-gala kam, ko dae ba tete jana.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Yezu ya ná jege se o kwei o tete o ma kaane Wɛ bene maama wone, o ya wó yaare o te kuni dedɛ, ko zege logo baŋa boboa ne ko ba ko yi zem. Ko nam na ye tei to, o laam tu o veere o tete nabiina tetare ne mo logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne. O tu bedwe mo ye o ba o te o kaane Wɛ se ko pa nabiina wɛleera saare se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista de nam tu o te o ma kaane Wɛ bedwe mo, se o wane o le nɔɔna dedɛ wɛleera o yage. O nam ta wó jwoori o ba logo baŋa, ye ko bá taa ye nɔɔna wɛleera saarem ŋwaane. Ko ye se o jwoŋi balo na jege o teena se o ba to o yage mo.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Wɛ nia yam ya ná wae ya pae balo na zuli‑o to wɛleera saare ya tia, ba ya daa bá lɔre we ba wɛleera ta wo ba yuu ne, ye ba ya bá boŋe se ba jwoori ba daa kaane Wɛ konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
translation_verse: Kokuri nabiina wɛleera bá wane ya saare de na-bale de bone jana kɔtaa.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Ko ná ye vara zwɛɛm kaanem de wɛleera saarem kaanem, ba kikia yam konto maama wo su nmo yi.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Amo maa we, ‘Amo Kwo Wɛ, nii-ne da! Amo tu se a toŋe nmo boboŋa na lage tei to, ne ko na maŋe ko popone amo taane nmo faŋa faŋa tɔnɔ kom ne tei to.’ ”

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: O laam ma daare o ta o we, “Amo Kwo Wɛ, nii-ne da! Amo tu se a ke nmo boboŋa na lage tei to.” Konto bere we Wɛ saare o da-yiga vara kaanem ni dem o yage, ye o daare o tiŋi chwo-doŋa se nɔɔna tɔge-ka.

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: ye o ta wora o cheigi maŋa kalo Wɛ na wó wane o dona maama o ke o dam kuri ne to.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane o kaane Wɛ kuni bedwe se ko pa nɔɔna balo o na wora o kwɛ ba bochara to taa ye wose se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Wɛ Sin-laao kom de zege wonnu tem konto chega kam kwaga ne o bere debam. Baŋa Wɛ déem dɛ ko baŋa o we:

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Maŋa kam ná yia, ni delo amo na wó gwoni de a nɔɔna bam to mo tento: Amo wó kwei a nia yam a tiŋi ba bochara ne mo, ye a daare a popone-ya a yage ba boboŋa ne.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Wɛ ma daare o ta o we, “Amo daa bá guli ba wɛleera de ba tusim kikia yam gula kɔtaa.”

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, dé laam nɛ baare se dé zo Wɛ di-yun-gala kam na ye o swono jeiga to, Yezu Krista toone jana bam ŋwaane.

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: Konto to, debam jege wolo na seene o ye Wɛ kaanem tu chekke ye o nii Wɛ tete sɔŋɔ tiina baŋa ne to.

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, pa-na se dé fofɔ de yi Wɛ tei de boboŋ-ŋona, de baare delo na bere we dé jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ to. Wɛ fɔge dé bochara pa se dé daa ba boŋa we, dé wɛleera ta wo dé yuu ne, ye dé yera na zarem de na-ŋona. Konto ŋwaane mo dé jege baare se dé zo Wɛ tei.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé bere we, dé jege teena Wɛ tei ne ye bobwea tera. O nam tiŋi o ni o pa debam, ye o bá fɔge o kwane-de.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé taa yei da-ni ne, se dé taa zeini daane, ye dé jege da-swono, ye dé ke keim-laaro.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Á yé pa se dé yage ka-taa-gilimi-daane Wɛ zula ŋwaane, ne badaara na ke tei to. Nam kwaane-na se á woli daane se ko pa á yera poore. Á na lɔre we dé Teiru wom dɛ dem lage de yi to, se á tiini á ta‑á ke konto.

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná lɔre Wɛ chega kam ye o ke-ka o boboŋa ne, ye o ta ná yeini o paale o ke o tusa, kaanem daa bá taa wora de na wó pa kotu wɛleera yam saare.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye Wɛ nia yalo o na ke Moses jeŋa ne to, nɔɔno wolo ná yaale-ya, ye nɔɔna balei naa batɔ ná lɔge o kwaga ne, ba wó go konto tu ye ŋwaŋa bá taa wora.

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Kokuri debam maŋe dé yei wolo wom na tage o we: “Amo mo wó jwoori a ŋwe ba keim-balwaaro jene, se ba na kolo na maŋe de-ba to.” Ko ta popone we: “Baŋa Wɛ wó di o nɔɔna bam bora.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ke o tusi, ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ jeŋa ná zo‑o, ko wó tiini ko taa ye lɛɛro ko pa‑o.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Maŋa kadwoŋi ne ba yeini ba twe abam nɔɔna yiga ne, ye ba bɛɛse abam. Maŋa kadwoŋi ne de, á yeini á sɛ se á tɔge á woli balo de na nɛ yaara konto dwoŋi to.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Kokuri á tɔge á na yaara de balo na wo peena diga ne to. Nɔɔna maa yeini ba vere abam wonnu ye á sɛ de wopwolo, kolo ŋwaane á yei we, á maŋe á jege kolo na tiini ko lana ye ko wó taa ye abam nyem taa wuu to.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: Wɛ kwora mo ye: “Ko laam daare fee se wolo na lage o ba to laam ba. O nam bá dáane.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Wolo nam na jege chega amo tei ne to wó na ŋwea o wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane. Konto tu nam ná kɔre foone ye o jwoori o kwaga, o kikia bá su amo yi.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Debam nam tɔge dé dae balo na jwoori ba kwaga pa se ba na chɔgem to. Dé tɔge dé wo balo na ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ pa se ba jwoŋi ba ŋwea to wone mo.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ko ye debam de na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pae dé lɔre we, Wɛ mɛ o ni taane mo o ke logo baŋa de wɛyuu maama. Konto mo dé sɛ we Wɛ kwei wonnu telo na ba nae de yia to o ma ke telo na wora ye dé wae dé nae de yia to. Abel

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Enoki de na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ se Wɛ le‑o logo baŋa ne ye toone wo jaane‑o. Wɛ na le‑o konto to, nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa wo nɛ o jei. Konto ta na wo ke to, o maŋe o jege yere de o na pwoli Wɛ wo tei to.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: O wo-dedoa kam ŋwaane mo pɛ se o vo o zoore jei sem konto ne, ne o ye veiru mo tei. O déem zoore vwei wone mo. Izaak de Jakob de maa tɔge ba zoore da konto dwoŋi, ye Wɛ ya pwooli kampwola o pa banto de.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ko bere we, Abaraham déem pɔe se o zo Wɛ tete teo kolo kuri na fɔge ko chwi lanyerane to mo. Ko ye Wɛ tete mo tei teo kom konto lɔɔm maama.

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Abaraham kaane Sara déem ye kadega mo ye o kɛ lora. De konto de, o na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ se o sɛ we, Wɛ bá kwane o ni dem o na tiŋi to ye o wane o lo bu.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ko zege nɔn-doa wolo na ye Abaraham ye o tiini o kwe to yera ne mo Wɛ pɛ o jege dwi kɔgɔ kɔgɔ. Nmo bá‑n wane n lɔre ba ni, ne chalechwe na daga wɛyuu ne de kasolo bia na wo naneo ni ne tei to.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto maama nam tega, ye ba ta jege ba wo-dedoa. Ba nam wo nɛ wonnu telo Wɛ na pwooli se o pa-ba to. Ba déem maane we, wonnu tem dɛ wó dáane ye te laam ba, ye ba wo pwoli ko ŋwaane. Ba nam seene ba sɛ mo ja we, ba ye veira balo na ba jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to mo.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Balo na yeini ba tɛ konto dwoŋi to bere we, ba daa ta jege teena se ba na teo kolo na wó taa ye ba kugu jei to mo.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Ba daa ba jege teo kolo ba na nwoŋi ko wone to boboŋa ba yuu ne. Ba ya ná jege boboŋa konto dwoŋi, ba ya wó wane ba na chwoŋa se ba jwoori.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, ba boboŋa tiini ya zo teo kolo na tiini ko lana ko gaale to. Konto mo ye Wɛ tete telaao kom. Konto ŋwaane, chaveera ba jege Wɛ de ba na bwoi‑o we ba Wɛ to. O nam maŋe o jege teo kolo o na wó pa-ba to. Abaraham de o dwi tiina

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: O boboŋa nam maŋe ya ja we, Wɛ wó wane o bi Izaak toone wone. Ko laam na seene ko ke tei to nye de o jwoŋi‑o toone wone mo.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Jakob de na daare fee se o te to, o wo-dedoa kam mo pɛ se o sɔɔle Wɛ swolim o yage o bu Josɛf bia bam maama yuu ne. O déem ma chwi o nacheiga o tiiri ka baŋa ne ye o zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Josɛf de maŋa na twɛ se o te to, o na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ se o ta de Isarele tiina bam we, ba wó nwoŋi Ejipti teo ne. O ma pa-ba ni we, ba ná nwoŋi, ba jege se ba guri o kwi sem mo Ejipti ne ba ja vo ba tete teo. Moses

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, Moses tiina déem na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ se ba kwei‑o ba seigi chane setɔ ba na loge‑o maŋa kalo to. Ba ma lɔre we, bu wom ye bu-laao, ye ba wo kɔre foone se ba ve Pa-faro wom ni dem.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Moses déem na ke nɔɔno to, ko ye o wo-dedoa ŋwaane mo pɛ o wo sɛ se ba taa bwoi‑o we, Pa-faro wom bukɔ bu.

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: O déem maa boŋe we, o ná tɔge de Wɛ nɔɔna bam o na yaara, ko wó taa gare o ná yage Wɛ chwoŋa ye o daare o di ywoni delo na bá dáane to.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: O nam boŋe o ja se nɔɔna taa yaale‑o Wɛ Dam Tu Krista ŋwaane, ye ko gare o ná nɛ jejegero dedɛ Ejipti ne, kokuri o boboŋa yeini ya tɔge nyɔɔre delo o na wó jwoŋi Wɛ tei ne to mo.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: O na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ se o sɛ Wɛ ni, ye o pa Isarele tiina bam maama ke Atɔgebabaŋa wodiu ba sam ne ba di. O ma pa ba kwei jana ba ma mi ba sam nia ne, se toone maleka kalo na tu se ka go bakeiri-kwe sem maama to daa yé ke ba tete bia bam kolokolo. Isarele tiina bam

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Wɛ nɔɔna bam na jege wo-dedoa tei to mo pɛ ba vo ba kaage Jeriko teo kom da yarepɛ, ye ko kabiri sem laam to tega ne.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Kaana de jwoori ba jwoŋi ba nɔɔna balo ya na tega ye ba jwoori ba bi to. Nɔɔna badwonna maa wo sɛ se ba jwoŋi ba tete balo na jege ba yera ba maga se ba go-ba to tei ne. Ba ma sɛ se ba te se ba wane ba jwoori ba bi ba na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara yuu yaale de nɔɔna na mɔne-ba, ye ba daare ba fere-ba tei to. Ba ma vɔ nɔɔna badwonna, ye ba daare ba ke-ba peena diga ne.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei kandwa ba ma dole ba badwonna ba go. Ba ma gwoni badwonna yera yam kuni belei. Ba ma kwei se-zɔɔro ba ma go ba badwonna. Wɛ nɔɔna badwonna maa kare ba beera, ye ba zo pei de bone tankwallo yerane. Yiniga de cham ma ja-ba, ye nɔɔna de bɛɛse-ba.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to nam wo yi se ba de nɔɔna bam konto taa wora daane. Wɛ nɔɔna bam déem beeri kagoa yuu ne, de zwonnu jei ne. Ba maa zoore peero gugworru wone, de bɔɔna wone, ba na ba jege kugu jei to ŋwaane.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto maama yere zaŋe de ba na jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to. De konto de, ba nam wo nɛ kolo Wɛ ya na pwooli se o pa o nɔɔna to ba ti.

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: Kokuri Wɛ boboŋa déem jaane se o ke kolo na tiini ko lana to debam ŋwaane. Konto ŋwaane, faŋa faŋa Wɛ nɔɔna bam déem wo nɛ chwoŋa se ba yi Wɛ wo-laaro tem ba ti ye debam ta wo woli ba wone.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Pa-na se dé yɔɔre dé taa nii Yezu seeni. Wonto nam mo bere debam dé na wó taa jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to, ye o pa se dé taa jege wo-dedoa taa, se dé ja dé vo dé kweeli. O déem vɔge pu-dɛa mo ye o yaare o te dagara kam yuu ne. O wo pɛ se chaveera ja‑o ko ŋwaane, kolo ŋwaane o nɛ we Wɛ tiŋi ywoni mo se o pa‑o. O laam ma daare o vo o jeini Baŋa Wɛ paare yituŋu kom jazem seeni.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Boŋe-na á nii Yezu na tiini o vɔ pu-dɛa de nɔn-chechɔgero na jege‑o ba yaale tei to. Á yé pa se jawɔrɔ zo abam se á yage Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Abam na yeini á kwaane se á chɔge wo-balwaaro dam tei to daa ta wo yi se á na toone nɔɔna tei ne.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Wɛ tɔnɔ kom nam jege taane delo na wó wane ko pa abam yera poore lanyerane, á na ye Wɛ bia to ŋwaane. Nam guli-na ko na bere abam tei ko we: “Amo bu, Baŋa Wɛ ná jege‑m o koresa, se n sɛ koresem. O maa ná bwɛ nmo, se n yé pa n nagwola te.

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam ná wo korese abam ne o na ke o bia bam maama tei to, ko bere we abam dae o bia chekke, á ye tampira mo.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Dé logo baŋa kwoa bam na yeini ba vaŋe dé zwa tei to mo pae se dé nege-ba. Ko nam ná ye dé Kwo wolo na tei dé jworru to, ko maŋe se dé taa sɛ o ni se dé laam na ŋwea o tei ne.

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Dé logo baŋa kwoa bam yeini ba vaŋe dé zwa bena fenfee yerane mo se ko maŋe de ba boboŋa na lage tei to. Dé Kwo Wɛ nam ke konto se ko woli debam mo, se dé wane dé tɔge dé taa ye wose, ne wonto na ye tei to.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye á koresem maŋa kam ne, ko yeini ko pa á wo chɔge mo ye á ba jege wopwolo. Ko kwaga ne, zwɛ vaŋem dem wó zeini balo de na pɛ ba korese to pa se ba na nyɔɔre, de ba ŋwea na jege chega de bochare-zuru tei to.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Fɔge-na á kwɛ chwoŋa kalo á na wó tɔge to se balo de na tɔge-ka ye ba ye gwane to yé to ba ŋoleme ba nɛ sem, se ko nam pa ba na yɔɔrem. Dé yé ve Wɛ zaane dem

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na se á ta‑á zoore dedaane nɔɔno maama de ywoni, se á kwori á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo Wɛ yiga ne, kolo ŋwaane, nɔɔno ná ba jege wo-pwoŋo, o bá wane o na dé Teiru Wɛ.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Fɔge-na á che á tete se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé ga Wɛ zaane dem. Yé yage-na chwoŋa se nɔɔno wolo wo na ba lana to zaŋe á wone ye o daane abam pa se abam dedɛ na chɔgem Wɛ yiga ne.

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: ko woli de nabɔnɔ wum, de kwora na ŋɔɔne. Balo na nigi Wɛ kwora kam konto to ma lwoori‑o se o daa yé jwoori o ta taane o woli da,
