english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Ko nam dae konto abam tei ne. Abam nam tu á yi peo kolo yere na ye Zion to mo. Ko maa ye Ŋwea Tu Baŋa Wɛ teo Jerusalem kolo na wo telaao ne to. Á na tu da to, Wɛ malese morro kɔgɔ kɔgɔ ma tigisi daane ye se wora se di ywoni.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Abam tu á woli Wɛ kɔgɔ kom wone. Ko maa ye o bu-kwe sem kɔgɔ kom, ba yera na popone ya tiŋi Wɛ telaao tɔnɔ kom ne to. Ko ye Wɛ wolo na wó di nabiina maama taane to tei mo á tu á yi da. Balo na jege chega o yiga ne ye o laam pa se ba bochara kwɛ ya ti fase to jworru maa wo o tei ne.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Á nam ta tu Yezu tei, wolo Wɛ na dɛ o ŋwaane o gwoni o ni-doore dem to. Ko ye Yezu jana bam ŋwaane mo pɛ á fɔge de Wɛ, ye ba dae nenɛɛne Abel jana bam na bere Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom tei to.

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á yé zaŋe á ve wolo wom na ŋɔɔne to taane. Isarele tiina bam déem ve wolo na bere-ba Wɛ kwora logo baŋa ne to, ye ba wo wane ba lu Wɛ jeŋa ne. Debam nam ná ve wolo na wo telaao ne ye o ŋɔɔne de debam to, dé wó wane dé lu na?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa to Wɛ kwora kam déem pɛ se tega baŋa maama ziziŋi. O laam nam pwooli we: “Amo daa ta wó jwoori a pa tega kam ziziŋi bedwe, ye ko dae kanto yerane, ko laam wó woli de wɛyuu kom maama mo.”

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam pɛ se dé tɔge dé di paare delo na bá wane de ziziŋi to mo. Konto ŋwaane dé wó ke‑o lei. Dé maa wó pa‑o zula yalo na tɔge o boboŋa to, ye dé taa kɔre‑o lanyerane,

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na da-swono se á yé yage, á na ye nu-bia daane to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á jeeri veira á sam ne lanyerane. Nɔɔna badwonna déem na ke konto dwoŋi to, ko ye Wɛ malese mo ba jeeri ye ba yeiri ba na ye balo to.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jege-na balo na wo peena diga ne to boboŋa, nenɛɛne abam de tɔge á wo peena diga ne mo tei, ye á zeini-ba. Ko ta ná ye balo nɔɔna na bɛɛse-ba to, se á ta‑á jege ba boboŋa nenɛɛne abam de tɔge á yaare mo tei.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Á yé pa se á ŋwea taa tɔge sabu-laga. Kolo maama á na jege to, se á pa ko maŋe abam ye á ba gwooni-ko. Kokuri Wɛ maŋe o ta o we, “Amo bá fɔge a yage abam kɔtaa.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane debam wó taa jege baare se dé ta we: “Baŋa Wɛ mo ye amo zeinnu. A daa bá taa kɔre foone. Nabiina lage ba ke amo bɛ mo?”

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Maŋa maama Yezu Krista ye nenɛɛne o na maŋe o ye tei to mo, diim de zem maama, se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Yé pa-na se nɔɔna taa mae berem-gɛ ba gane abam de wonnu dwi dwi se ko pa á ywori Wɛ tei ne. Nmo ná lage se n bochare ke dam de Wɛ, ko ye Wɛ zaane dem mo wó pa konto, ye ko bá taa ye wodiiru tedwonna dim ŋwaane. Balo na tɔge wodiiru dim chwoŋa to nam wo nɛ nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, pa-na se dé nwoŋi dé vo o tei teo kom dáa ne, se dé tɔge dé na o chaveera yam dwoŋi.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Kokuri logo baŋa ywo-seeni debam ba jege teo kolo na wó taa ye dé kugu jei taa to, ye dé nam jege teena se dé na teo kolo na lage ko ba to mo.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Á yé swei se á ta‑á ke keim-laaro, se á daare á ta‑á woli daane. Dé ná yeini dé kwei kikia yanto dwoŋi dé ma kaane Wɛ, konto mo pa‑o wopwolo.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Ta‑á nege-na á yiga tiina, se á daare á ta‑á sɛ ba ni. Banto kwaane ba nii abam ŋwea baŋa ne mo, ye ba yei we ba laam wó ba ba zege Wɛ yiga se o bwei-ba ba totoŋa yam ŋwaane. Nam ta‑á nege-ba se ba wane ba toŋe de wopwolo. Ko ná dae konto, ko wó pa ba wo chɔge, ye ko daa bá taa jege wolim ko pa abam.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Ta‑á lwoori-na Wɛ á pa debam. Dé yeini dé kwaane se dé da chega chwoŋa mo maŋa maama, ye chaveera tera dé tei ne.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Amo nam lage a kwoori abam se á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ á pa-ne, se ko pa a na chwoŋa a jwoori abam tei leile.

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Bochare-zuru Tu Baŋa Wɛ wó zeini abam. Wonto mo bi de Teiru Yezu toone wone de o na dɛ o jana bam ŋwaane o gwoni ni delo na wó taa wora taa wuu to. O laam ma pa o ye nayero chekke ye o wae o nii debam balo na nye de o pei sem to lanyerane.

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó zeini abam de wo-laaro telo maama na maŋe se á wane á ta‑á tɔge o boboŋa to, ye o tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane o fɔge abam, ne ko na wó pwoli o wo tei to. Yezu maŋe de zula se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, a lwoori abam se á zuri á yera á cheigi amo na popone kolo a ma kwoori abam to. Amo na popone taane delo to nam ba dɔra.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: A lage se abam ta‑á yei we, ba yage dé nu-bu Timoti se o nwoŋi peena diga ne. O ná tu amo tei lela, a laam wó pa dé tɔge daane dé ba dé na abam.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Jɔɔne-na á yiga tiina bam, de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama á pa debam. Dé nu-bia balo na nwoŋi Yitalia to de jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Wɛ zaane dem taa wo abam maama tei ne.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Amo Jemsi wolo na ye Wɛ kabaa de debam Teiru Yezu Krista kabaa to mo popone tɔnɔ konto. A jɔɔne abam dwi kuni fuga-balei bam na ye Wɛ nɔɔna ye á jage á yi logo baŋa jei maama to. Wɛ zeini nɔɔna lanyerane

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Kwaane-na se á ta‑á zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa se á yé jwoori kwaga. Keim dem konto wó fɔge abam fase, pa se á boboŋa kweere de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem, se á yé wane á ga kolokolo.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Abam wolo maama nam ná yeiri kolo na lana se o ke to, konto tu jege se o lwoori swa mo Wɛ tei ne. Wɛ yeini o woli nɔɔna maama lanyerane mo, ye o ba ŋwaana. Nmo ná lwoori swa o tei ne, o wó ke konto mo o pa‑m.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná lwoori woŋo Wɛ tei ne, se n ta‑n jege boŋem-dɛɔ we, n wó seene n na. Yé ta‑n jege bobwea ko baŋa ne, kokuri bobwea tu nye ne vio na dole na-ŋone, pa se vei yiga de kwaga tei to mo.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: Konto tu bere o wo ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye o yeini o za o boboŋa de kolo maama o na boŋe se o ke to. Nɔɔno wom konto dwoŋi yé taa boŋe we, o wó na woŋo dé Teiru wom tei ne.

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Nmo wolo na tɔge Yezu ye yiniga jege‑m to, se n ta‑n jege wopwolo de Wɛ na pɛ n jege yere o tei ne to ŋwaane.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Wea nam ná bega, ka wó baane-te mo pa te kwaare. Punnu tem ma siiri ye te daa ba jege lam. Ko nam ye bedwe mo de naduna na wó ba ba te ba jejegero tem lagem wone tei to.

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná wo cham wone ye o ná zege lanyerane de pu-dɛa, konto tu jege yu-ywoŋo mo. O yaara yam ná faŋe‑o ya ti, ye o ta ná zege lanyerane, o laam wó na Wɛ pɛɛre delo na ye ŋwea chekke to. Wɛ pwooli se o pa ŋwea kam konto mo balo maama na swoi‑o to.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: A nu-bi-swonnu bam, ta‑á yei-na á tete.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Pɛɛre delo maama na lana ye de jege chega to mo dé yeini dé jwoŋi Wɛ tei ne. Wonto mo ke wonnu telo maama na wo wɛyuu ne ye te pae pwooni to. Wonnu tem konto mo yeini te wae te pipira wea de tete. Wɛ nam ba leira ne tento wonnu tem tei.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: O boboŋa jaane mo se o tɔge o chega taane dem ŋwaane o pa dé na o ŋwe-doŋa kam. Ko nye nenɛɛne o le debam mo o ke nɔɔna maama yiga ne se dé taa ye o bia. Kikia yalo na maŋe de Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane n bá‑n wane n tɔge ban-zɔŋɔ ŋwaane n ke wo-laaro ne Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to mo.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Nam ta‑á yei-na se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ kwora kam, se ko dae we á ta‑á cheigi o taane dem yerane.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná cheigi Wɛ taane ye o ba tɔge de na bere tei to, kotu gane o tete mo. O nye nenɛɛne nɔɔno mo kwei niu se o ma o nii o tete.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná boŋe we o kɔre Wɛ, ye o ná ware o ni taane o ja, wonto gane o tete mo. O Wɛ kɔrɔ kom maa ye kafɛ mo.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ nam na lage se dé sɛ‑o tei to mo ye se dé taa zeini botara de kadeina balo na yaare to, ye dé kwaane dé che dé tete de logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yam. Wɛ kɔrɔ konto dwoŋi mo su Wɛ yi, ye tusim tere ko wone.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, abam ye balo na seene á sɛ dé Teiru Yezu Krista wolo na di paare telaao ne to mo. Konto ŋwaane, ko wo maŋe se á ta‑á kuri nɔɔna daane de á na zuli-ba tei to.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Abam ná tigisi daane se á ware Wɛ, dɛ delo nɔɔna balei ma ba á tei. Dedoa maa ye nadum. O ma zo gare-nyenno ye o ke sabu-seŋa jafolo o jeŋa ne. O dwoŋi wom maa ye yiniga tu, ye o zo gare-zenzwanno.

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo á wó jeeri nadum wom lanyerane, ye á pa o na jeiŋa jei, á daare á ta de yiniga tu wom we, o zege dáa ne, naa o jeini tega ne á nɛ ni ne.

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: Á ná pɔɔre-ba daane konto dwoŋi, ko bere we á pae se nɔɔna ba mae daane mo. Ko nam ye boboŋ-lwanno mo pae á kuri nɔɔna daane konto.

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: A nu-bi-swonnu bam, cheigi-na amo. Wɛ mo seene o kuri balo na ye yiniga tiina nɔɔna tei ne to, se ba taa ye naduna o tei ne, de ba na ke ba wo-dedoa de Yezu tei to. O wó pa ba woli o paare dem wone, ne o na maŋe o pwooli se o ke o pa balo na swoi‑o to.

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Ba maa jege Yezu yere-ŋom dem ba twea, ye abam mo ye o bia.

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni delo na bere o paare dem to popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we, “Ta‑n swoi n dwoŋi se ko maŋe de n na swoi n tete tei to.” Abam ná sɛ á tɔge ni dem konto, ko lana.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Ko daare á ná pɔɔre nɔɔno de nɔɔno daane de á na zuli-ba tei to, ko bere we á ke wɛleere mo. Wɛ ni dem bere we á ke á tusi mo.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná tɔge Wɛ nia yam maama ye o ná chɔge ya woŋo dedoa yerane, ko bere we o chɔge ya maama mo.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Wɛ mo pɛ o ni we, dé yé zaŋe dé ke kabwoŋa. Wonto nam ta mo we, dé yé go nɔɔno. Mo kokuri, n ná maŋe n wo ke kabwoŋa, ye n ná go nɔɔno, ko bere we, n ta chɔge Wɛ ni mo.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, Wɛ ná di wolo na ba jege o dwonna ŋwaŋa to taane, o bá duri konto tu de ŋwaŋa. Wolo nam na jege o dwonna ŋwaŋa to wó lɔre we, Wɛ duri nɔɔna ŋwaŋa se ba yé na waarem mo. Wo-dedoa keim de keim-laaro taane

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, nɔɔno ná tɛ o we, omo ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye o laam ba tɔge kikia yalo na maŋe to, ko jege kuri na? O Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem dem konto wó wane de jwoŋi‑o de yage na?

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: Nmo laam ná tage ded‑o n we, o véi, se Wɛ wó zeini‑o pa o na gɔrɔ de o ni-wodiu, ye n ná wo pɛ‑o wonnu telo o na lage to, ko jege kuri na?

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wae o tɛ we, omo ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Amo nam ke keim-laaro mo. Nmo na ba ke keim-laaro to, nmo nam wó ke tɛ mo n bere-ne we n seene n ke n wo-dedoa de Wɛ? Ko nam ná ye amo, amo wó kwei a keim-laaro tem a ma bere‑m we a sɛ Wɛ de wo-dedoa.

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: N sɛ we Wɛ ye dedoa yerane mo na? N ná sɛ konto, ko lana. Setaana tete de maŋe ya sɛ konto mo, ye ko pae ya yera sae.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: N ba jege boboŋa mo na? N yeiri we Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem delo na ba tɔge de keim-laaro to ye kafɛ mo na?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Ko bere we o Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem dem dedaane o keim-laaro maama tɔge daane mo. O keim-laaro tem déem mo pɛ se o Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem dem ji chega.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Konto mo, kolo na popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne to jigi chega ye ko we, “Abaraham ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ, ye Wɛ pa o na chega ko ŋwaane.” Nɔɔna déem maa bwoi‑o we “Wɛ badwoŋi”.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Konto wó pa á lɔre we, ko ye nɔɔno kikia mo pae o na chega Wɛ tei ne, se ko dae o na ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ to yerane ŋwaane.

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Konto maama bere we, nɔɔno Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ná ba jege keim-laaro, ko ye kafɛ mo. Ko ye bedwe mo de nɔɔno yera ná ba jege jworo, wonto ye too mo.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Debam maama yeini dé ke dé tusa. Nɔɔno wolo nam na ba ke o tusa o ni taane wone to yɔɔre o ye nɔn-ŋom mo, ye o wae o tete o jaane lanyerane.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná yeini o lage o di siseiŋa, o wó kwei gara mo o ke ka ni ne se o wane o pa ka vo mɛ de mɛ o na lage to.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Nam boŋe-na á nii nabworo na ye kamunu tei, ye vo-dɛɔ taa jege-ko ko maga. Ko tu wom nam ta wae o ma nayuŋ-balaŋa o pa ko vei o na lage mɛ to.

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno dindeilimi de nam ye mini mo, ye logo baŋa wo-lwanno maama wo de tei ne. De maa ye yera yam daa dedoa mo, ye de wo-lwanno tem laam wae te lɔgese yera yam maama. Dindeilimi jege mini mo de maa zwɛ nɔɔno ŋwea maama pa ka chɔge, ye mini dem konto nwoŋi te-seŋa ne mo.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Nabiinu wae o tulimi wonnu dwi maama. O tulimi ga-vara, de zuna, de tega-veila, de ywona.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye dindeilimi, nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wae o tulimi-de. De maa ye wo-lɔŋɔ kolo na ware ko che to mo, ye de kwori de jege chɔŋɔ kolo na goe nɔɔna to.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Konto to, teem de chɔgem maama nwoŋi ni dem konto dedoa wone mo. A nu-bia bam, ko wo maŋe se ko taa ye konto.

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Ko ná ye buli-yi, na-ŋona de na-chɛɔ maama bá wane ba taa buri de wone.

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, kaporo bá wane ko lei swa. Kansɔlɔ de nam bá wane ko lei mɔɔro. Ko ye bedwe mo de n na bá wane n mɔ na-ŋona bworu jei ne tei to. Wɛ na pae swa yalo to

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: A lage a ta woŋo de abam wolo maama na boŋe we o jege swa de yi-poro lanyerane to. Konto tu jege se o taa tɔge chwo-laao mo, ye o gwooni o tete o ke keim-laaro, ne ko na maŋe de o swa yam tei to.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná jege wo-goo de puseŋa, ye n lage n yerane wonnu, se n yé zaŋe n mage n nyɔɔne n ta we, n jege swa. N fɔ vwa n ma n kweele chega kam mo konto.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Swa yam konto dwoŋi dae swa yalo na nwoŋi Wɛ tei to. Yanto ye logo baŋa nyem mo. Ya maa ye nabiina swa yalo na nwoŋi setaana tei to.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Mɛ maama nɔɔna na lage ba yerane wonnu ye ba jege puseŋa de ba dwonna to, dáane mo kantɔgɔ de keim-lwanno dwi maama wora.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Jara dedaane ni-kantɔgɔ yeini ya wora abam tei ne. Bɛ nam mo pae ya tui? Á na lage á boboŋa wonnu tei to mo tei á bochara jege daanem, pa se jara wo á wone.

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ko na ye tei to, á fera zoore wonnu ye á nam ba na-te. Ko maa pae á lage se á go nɔɔna. Á yi tiini de su wonnu dedɛ ye á ware-te á na. Konto mo pae kantɔgɔ de jara tui á tetare ne. Á ba jege wonnu telo á na lage to kolo ŋwaane á wo lwoori Wɛ te ŋwaane se o pa abam.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Á nwoŋi Wɛ kwaga ne mo na? Á nam yeiri we, á ná me de logo baŋa wonnu, á ye Wɛ dona mo na? Wolo maama na lage se o me de logo baŋa wonnu tem to wó ji Wɛ dono mo.

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo ke debam zaane se ko gaale. Ko ta popone we: “Wɛ ve balo na bere ba tete kamunim to, ye o daare o ke zaane balo na tu ba tete to yuu ne.”

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Fofɔ-na á twɛ Wɛ tei, se o de wó taa bwola de abam. Sane-na á je á yage á wo-lwanno kikia yam. Kwɛ-na á bochara se á daa yé ta‑á jege woro telei.

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Nyɔne-na á yiga á ta‑á kona ye á keera. Pa-na á mwanno tem leiri te ji keira, se á wopwolo kom leiri ko ji wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Tu-na á tete dé Teiru wom yiga ne, se o laam wó ja abam o pa á zaŋe.

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, yé ta‑á ŋɔɔne-na ta-balwaaro á pa daane. Wolo maama ná ŋɔɔne ta-balɔrɔ o pa o nu-bu, naa o yaale o yuu, konto tu ŋɔɔne o chɔge Wɛ nia yam mo ye o yaale-ya. Nmo nam ná yaale Wɛ nia yam, ko bere we n daa‑n ba tɔge-ya mo, ye n jege dam ya baŋa ne.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Wɛ yerane mo tei o nia yam ye o tɔge-ya o ma bore nɔɔna bora. Wonto yerane mo wae o jwoŋi nɔɔna o yaga, naa o chɔge-ba. Nmo nam boŋe we n ye wɔ mo se n di n dwoŋi taane?

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Fɔge á cheigi-na, abam balo na yeini á tɛ we, “Zem naa jwa ne dé wó vo teo kodwoŋi dé ke pipiu da bene dé na sabu” to.

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Á tɛ konto dwoŋi ye á yeiri tega na wó poore se á ŋwea taa ye tei. Á ŋwea nam nye de kunu mo. Ko wó li ye ko bá dáane ye ko jei.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Ko ya maŋe se á ta‑á tɛ we, “Wɛ ná sɛ pa dé jwa ŋwe, dé wó ke kolo dé na boŋe to.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Ko nam na ye tei to, á pa á tete kamunni mo de á na wó ke wonnu telo to. Kamunni dem konto nam ba lana.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Konto to, nɔɔno wolo ná yei kolo na lana se o ke to, ye o ná wo ke, kotu ke wɛleere mo.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Ko daare abam balo na ye naduna to, fɔge á cheigi-na. Ta‑á keeri-na se á ta‑á chwoosa de lɛɛro telo na lage te ba abam baŋa to.

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Abam jejegero tem maama pɔga, ye charebombore de di á gwaaro tem.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Abam sabu-seŋa kam de á sabia maama maa soŋe. Bora borem dɛ dem ne te soŋem dem konto mo wó bere we á ke á tusi, ye dento ta wó di abam yera yam ne mini tei. Logo baŋa kweelim da yam nam twɛ, ye abam ta fɔge á la á jejegero tem á tiŋi.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Ko ta woli da, á ba sɛ se á ta‑á ŋwe balo na toŋe ba pa abam to. Cheigi-na á nii ba na poona de á na pini-ba tei to. Balo na ke abam wodiiru tem ba ke diga ne to keira kam to Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ zwɛ ne.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Á logo baŋa ŋwea kam ye paare yerane mo, ye á ke á boboŋa na lage tei. Á di á nu, ne ba na kɔne varem se ba go tei to.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ko maŋe se abam de zuri á bochara mo ye á vɔ á wo lanyerane, se dé Teiru wom bá dáane ye o ba.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, yé ta‑á poone daane, se ko wó pa á ga bora Wɛ tei ne. Nii-na, ko twɛ ko ti se Wɛ di debam taane.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na jege pu-dɛa kanto dwoŋi to, dé yei we ba nɛ wopwolo Wɛ tei ne. Abam maŋe á yei Job déem na ke pu-dɛa o yaara yam wone tei, ye á kwori á yei Wɛ na pɛ o kweeli ya wone tei to. Chega ŋwaane to, Baŋa Wɛ tiini o jege debam ŋwaŋa ye o duri debam yibwona lanyerane.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, konto maama baŋa ne, ta‑á yei-na se, á ná lage á gwoni ni, se á yé zaŋe á du duuri á woli da. Yé du-na de Wɛ, naa tega, naa de kolokolo de. Á nam wó ta we, “ɛɛ” naa “aawo”, se á yé du duuri á woli da. Ko ná dae konto, á wó ga bora Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná wo cham wone, se kotu lwoori Wɛ. Abam wolo nam ná jege wopwolo, se kotu taa leeni o seini Wɛ.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Abam wolo nam ná ba jege yazura, se o bwoŋi Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa bam se ba ba ba lwoori Wɛ ba pa‑o, se ba daare ba kwei nuga ba ke o yuu ne dé Teiru Yezu yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ba ná ke ba wo-dedoa ba lwoori Wɛ konto dwoŋi, jaweeno wom wó seene o na yazura mo. Dé Teiru wom wó pa o wori, ye wɛleera yalo maama o na ke to Wɛ wó yage o ma chɛ‑o.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ko maŋe se á ta‑á tɛ á wɛleera taane jaja mo á bere daane, se á daare á ta‑á lwoori Wɛ á pa daane, se Wɛ wó pa á na yazura. Nɔn-ŋom wɛ-lworo tiini ko dana lanyerane ko wae ko pae wonnu ke.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Guli-na Elija déem na ke tei to. O ye nabiinu ne debam na ye tei to mo, ye o seene o yia o lwoori Wɛ se doa daa yé taa nena. Ka ma seene ka wo nege bena yatɔ de chane seredo.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: O daa ma jwoori o lwoori Wɛ. Ka daa ma seene ka ne, ye tega baŋa wonnu maama jwoori te puli te nwoŋi te ke wodiiru.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, abam wolo ná ywori chega chwoŋa kam wone, ye o dwoŋi ná wane o pa o jwoori o to ka wone, ko lana.

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Á nam ta‑á yei we, wolo maama ná wane o che wɛle-keiru pa o yage o tusim dem, kotu wó wane o vere nɔɔno wom toone jeŋa ne, ye o wɛleera maama de wó saare.

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ ma wuuri o ke o boboŋa ne se o kuri abam konto, ye o tɔge o Sin-laao kom ŋwaane mo o pa se á ji o nyem. Wɛ nam ke konto se ko pa á ta‑á sɛ á pa Yezu Krista, ye á bochare fɔge ya kwɛ o toone jana bam ŋwaane. Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura se ko gaale. Dé na jege teena Wɛ tei ne tei to

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Baŋa Wɛ wolo na ye dé Teiru Yezu Krista Kwo to maŋe de teem. Wonto na tiini o ye ŋwaŋa tu to, o ma pa se dé jege ŋwe-doŋa, ye dé ta jege teena o tei ne maŋa maama, o na pɛ se Yezu Krista bi toone wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: Á na sɛ‑o de wo-dedoa to, o maa mae o dam dem o cho abam se ko vo ko yi logo baŋa kweelim da yam, se o laam fɔge o jwoŋi abam fase, ne o boboŋa na jaane se o ke tei nɔɔna maama yiga ne to.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Konto maa pae á jege wopwolo lanyerane. Ko daare leile konto, cham dwi dwi wae ya tui ya maŋe abam maŋa fenfee yerane, ye ko pa se á wo chɔge.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Abam yi nam ta wo nɛ‑o, ye á ta jege o swono. Á ta maa ba na‑o, ye á ke á wo-dedoa ded‑o, pa se á tiini á jege ywoni de wopwolo kolo na ye wo-kenkagele ye ko taane bá wane ko ta to.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem déem kwaane ba tɔge ko nɛ lanyerane se ba lɔre Wɛ na wó jwoŋi o nɔɔna ŋwea tei to. Ba déem maŋe ba wuuri ba ta Wɛ na wó ke abam zaane tei to.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista Sin-laao kom maa wo ba tei ne ye ko pa ba wuuri ba lɔre we, Yezu wó ba o na yaara se o laam daare o na paare Wɛ tei ne. Ba maa tiini ba kwaane se ba lɔre maŋa kam konto, de ko na wó ke tei to.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Wɛ ma guri o chega kam o pa o sampwori sem konto lɔre we, ko dae ba tete ŋwaane mo ba toŋa, se ko ye abam ŋwaane mo. Ba déem na bere chega kalo to ye bedwe mo de kwor-ywoŋa kalo Wɛ tontoŋena badwonna zem na tɔɔle ba bere abam to. Baŋa Wɛ mo pɛ se o Sin-laao kom nwoŋi telaao ne ko ba banto tei, ye ba wane ba bere abam o kwora kam konto. Wɛ malese sem tete maŋe se lage se se lɔre chega kam konto kuri na ye tei to. Wɛ lage se dé taa jege wo-pwoŋo

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Ta‑á sɛ-na á Kwo Wɛ ni. Ko nam ná ye á déem ta na wo lɔre Wɛ chega kam ye á fera zo wo-yɔɔro telo to, se á daa yé pa te taa tei á boboŋa.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Wɛ nam mo bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á ye o nyem, ye wonto yɔɔre o ye wo-pwoŋo tu. Mo kokuri á jege se á ta‑á jege wo-pwoŋo á ŋwea maama wone.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne ko we, “Pɔɔre-na á tete se á ta‑á ye wose, se amo mo ye wose.”

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Kokuri á yei we, Wɛ jwoŋi abam se á daa yé ta‑á tɔge chullu telo na nwoŋi á nabaara jeŋa ne to. Wɛ na le abam wo-yɔɔro tem konto wone to, ko dae logo baŋa sabu kolo na wae ko chɔge to mo o mɛ o ŋwe o jwoŋi abam o yage.

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Boboa ne ye logo baŋa ta tera to, Wɛ maŋe o kuri wonto mo se o ma jwoŋi o nɔɔna ba wɛleera wone. Ko daare logo baŋa kweelim maŋa kam laam yia, ye Wɛ le‑o o bere nabiina abam zeinim ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Á nam dɛ Yezu ŋwaane mo á ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Ko maa ye Wɛ mo bi wonto toone wone, ye o daare o pa o di paare Wɛ telaao ne. Konto ma pa á seene á jege wo-dedoa de teena Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Abam laam na sɛ Wɛ chega kam to mo pɛ á bochara fɔge ya kwɛ, pa se á jege swono chekke de á nu-bia balo de na ye Wɛ nyem to. Konto to, yɔɔre á ta‑á jege da-swono de á bochara maama.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ko nam popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Ko ná ye nabiina, ba maama nye de gaaro mo. Ba nenɔŋa maa nye de gaao wo punnu. Ba ba dáana ye ba toa. Gaao kom maa yeini ko kwaare, ye ko punnu tem de siiri.

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Wɛ kwora kam, kanto wó taa wora mo taa wuu.” Kwora kam konto mo ye kwor-ywoŋa kalo ba na tɔɔle ba bere abam to.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri, ja-na á tete de lwarem kikia dwi maama. Á daa yé ta‑á gane á dwonna, naa á jege ni-zɛ ni-zɛ, naa wo-goo. Yé ta‑á twe-na daane.

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: Abam nam maŋe á maane á nii dé Teiru wom na tiini o lana tei to.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nii-na amo Wɛ na lage a chwi kandwɛ delo na tiini de lana to, se a ma lɔ sɔŋɔ Zion ne. Amo kuri kandwɛ-zane dem konto se de taa ye kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam zega lana to mo. Wolo nam ná sale wonto yera ne, chaveera bá fɔge ya ja konto tu.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye abam balo na jege wo-dedoa ded‑o to, o jege lonne mo á tei ne. Ko daare, ko ná ye balo bam na ve‑o to, “O maa nye de kandwɛ delo lɔra bam na ve, ye de laam jwoori de ba de ji kandwɛ delo na pae diga kam dana to mo.”

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Abam déem ya ye nɔɔna mo yɔɔ yerane, ye á laam ba á ji Wɛ tete nɔɔna. Abam déem ya dae balo Wɛ na jege á ŋwaŋa to, ye o laam ba o duri á ŋwaŋa.

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, abam na ye veira logo baŋa ne ye á ba jege kugu jei to, a lwoori abam se á ja á tete de á fera na zoore logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yalo to. Tento mo kwaane se te chɔge á ŋwea de Wɛ.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Abam na jege á tete tei to, se á pa á kikia taa lana balo na dae Wɛ nɔɔna to yiga ne. Konto mo, ba ná yaale abam ba we, á ye wo-lwan-keira, ba laam wó ba ba lɔre á keim-laaro na ye tei to mo, ye ba daare ba pa Wɛ zula maŋa kalo o na lage o ba o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne to. Dé wó sɛ dé pa dedɛɛra

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: de o dedɛɛra balo o na pɛ-ba dam to, se á ta‑á nege ba maama. O tiŋi banto se ba taa waare balo kikia na ba lana to mo, se ba daare ba taa tei balo kikia na lana to.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Á ta‑á pae nɔɔna maama zula. Á ta‑á swoi á nu-bia bam. Ta‑á kɔre-na Wɛ. Ta‑á zuli-na Pa-faro wom.

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Abam balo na ye tontoŋena to jege se á ta‑á sɛ á pa á yuu tiina, ye á tiini á nege-ba lanyerane. Ba ná jege á ŋwaŋa ye ba ke abam lanyerane, naa ba ná chana de abam, se á ta sɛ á pa-ba.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná ke á tusi, ye ko pa ba vaŋe á zwɛ lanyerane, á ná vɔge á wo de yaara yam konto, ko jege taane na? Á nam ná nɛ yaara á keim-laaro baŋa ne, ye á vɔ á wo, Wɛ yi wó su á keim dem konto.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Wonto nam bere o wo ke kolokolo o tusi, ye o ni taane ba jege ganem.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna déem maa jege‑o ba twea, ye o wo tɔge o twe-ba. Ba ma kwori ba bɛɛse‑o, ye o wo jwoori o chiŋi-ba. O nam ke o tete mo Wɛ jeŋa ne, wonto na ye wolo na tɔge chega o ma di nɔɔna bora to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Abam ya nye de pei selo na beeri se jei to mo. Á laam ma pipiri se á jwoori á ke á tete Yezu jeŋa ne. Wonto mo nye de abam nayero ye o nii á baŋa ne.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Ko ná ye abam balo na ye kaana to, abam de jege se á sɛ á pa á banna konto dwoŋi mo. Ko maa wó pa se á banna bam badaara ya ná ve Wɛ taane dem, se ba laam maane á nɛ-bwora na ye tei, ye ba pipiri ba ba ba sɛ Wɛ, de á ná maŋe á wo puri á ni de.

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó lɔre á na kɔre Wɛ, ye á seene á tɔge chwoŋa de boboŋ-dɛɛra.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Kokuri, faŋa faŋa kaana balo na ye Wɛ nyem ye ba ke ba teena ded‑o to déem fɔge ba tete konto dwoŋi, de ba na sɛ ba pa ba banna to.

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: Sara déem ye konto dwoŋi mo, ye o sɛ o baro Abaraham ni, de o na bwoŋi‑o we o yuu tu to. Abam de nam ye wonto bia mo, ne á ná ke keim-laaro ye á wo pɛ foone zo abam de kolokolo.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Abam balo de na ye kan-banna to maŋe se á ta‑á nege á kaana de boboŋ-laaro konto dwoŋi mo. Á na zoore de á kaana bam tei to, ta‑á yei-na we ba yera bwona ya dwoi baara. Ba nam wó tɔge de abam ba na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam o zaane dem ŋwaane. Konto to, á ta‑á pa-ba zula, se kolokolo yé che abam na lwoori kolo Wɛ tei ne to. Yaara taane

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná ke wo-lɔŋɔ o yage abam yuu ne, se á yé jwoori á ke‑o konto dwoŋi. Nɔɔno ná twe abam, á daa yé tɔge á twe‑o, se á nam sɔɔle Wɛ swolim á yage o yuu ne. Kokuri, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, ko ye se á ba á jwoŋi o swolim mo.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nɔɔno wolo maama ná lage se o na ŋwea ywoni, kotu jege se o ja o tete mo de ta-balwaaro ŋɔŋa de vwa fɔm.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: O nam jege se o yage totoŋ-lwanno keim, se o daare o taa tɔge keim-laaro, ye o kwaane o taa zoore de wo-zuru de ni-ywom.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Kokuri, Baŋa Wɛ yeini o nii nɔn-ŋona baŋa ne mo, ye ba wɛ-lworo de zo o zwa. Ko nam ná ye wo-lwan-keira, o yiga tera de-ba.”

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Abam ná seene á yia keim-laaro baŋa ne, wɔ mo wó wane o ke wo-lɔŋɔ o yage á yuu ne?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná tɔge chega, ye nɔɔna yaare abam ko ŋwaane, á daa ta jege yu-ywoŋo mo. Á nam yé ta‑á fona de-ba, naa á ta‑á jege lwia.

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista na ye abam Teiru to, á ta‑á kɔre‑o de boboŋ-laaro. Fɔge-na á che á boboŋa maŋa maama se á wane á leiri nɔɔno wolo maama na wó bwei abam se o lɔre á na ke tei á daŋe á teena Wɛ baŋa ne to.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Ko nam maŋe se á leiri‑o de bochare-zuru de zula. Ta‑á ke-na wonnu telo á boboŋa na bere we te lana to, se nɔɔna ná yaale abam, se ko pa chaveera ja-ba, de ba na ŋɔɔne ba chɔge keim-laaro telo á na yeini á ke Yezu Krista ŋwaane to.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Wɛ boboŋa mo ná lage se á ta‑á nae yaara á keim-laaro tem baŋa ne, konto lana ko dwoi á ná ke keim-balwaaro ye á yaare te ŋwaane.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Kokuri, Yezu Krista déem tege bedwe mo se o ma ŋwe nabiina wɛleera jene maama. Ko maa ye nɔn-ŋom mo leiri nɔn-balwaaro yuu ne o te, se o wane o ke abam Wɛ jeŋa ne. O yera yam mo ba goa, ye o jworo kom pa se o daa ta na ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Wonto mo diini wɛyuu o jeini Wɛ jazem ne, ye malese sem, de dedɛɛra, de wonnu telo maama na jege dam to maa wo o dam kuri ne.

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: Konto to, abam daa ta ná jege ŋwea logo baŋa ne, á daa ba jege se á ta‑á tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo nabiina fera na zoore to. Á nam jege se á ta‑á tɔge Wɛ boboŋa na lage kolo to mo.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Ko daare leile konto, á daa ba tɔge de balo na yeiri Wɛ to, de ba na ke wo-zɔɔna kikia konto dwoŋi to. Ko ma ke-ba yaau, pa se ba jege á yere ba chɔga.

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa de ko wonnu maama laam lage te kweeli. Nam fɔge-na á che á boboŋa se á ta‑á jege jawala de á na lwoori Wɛ tei to.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Ta‑á swoi-na daane de á wo maama. Konto tiini ko ye wo-chɛɔ ko pa abam, kolo ŋwaane á ná jege da-swono, ko wó pa se á wɛleera dedɛ saare á boboŋa ne.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Ta‑á jeeri-na á dwonna á sam ne lanyerane, se á yé ta‑á poone daane.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Abam dedoa dedoa mo nɛ zeinim Wɛ tei ne, se á ta‑á ma‑á woli daane, ne o na pɛ se á ta‑á ye tei to. Abam maama jege se á ta‑á ke á dwonna zaane, ne Wɛ na ke abam zaane tei to.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Abam wolo Wɛ na pɛ se o taa ŋɔɔne o bere nɔɔna to jege se o taa ŋɔɔne Wɛ kwora kam chekke mo. Wolo Wɛ na pɛ se o taa toŋe o woli o dwonna to de jege se o taa mae dam delo Wɛ na pɛ‑o to o maa toŋa. Konto maama wó pa se nɔɔna tɔge Yezu Krista ŋwaane ba pa Wɛ zula. Wonto nam mo maŋe se o jwoŋi zula de dam maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena. Dé yaara yam kuri na ye tei to

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, chanɛɛre na wora de daane abam to, de tu se de maŋe abam de nii mo. Á nam yé pa se ko sɔɔre abam yera, nenɛɛne ko ye wo-kenkagele mo tei.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔge de Yezu Krista á na o yaara yam dwoŋi to, se á ta‑á jege wopwolo ko ŋwaane. Konto to, Yezu Krista ná jwoori o ba ye o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom bere jaja, á wopwolo kom laam wó tiini ko gaale.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna nam ná yaale abam á na ye Yezu Krista nyem to ŋwaane, á jege yu-ywoŋo mo, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ Sin-laao kom na jege nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ to wo abam tei ne.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Abam wolo ná nɛ yaara, se ko yé taa ye o na ye nɔn-goro, naa ŋweeno, naa wo-lwan-keiru dwi maama, naa bebare-nyem to ŋwaane.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Maŋa kam yia Wɛ na wó bobo se o di nabiina taane to. Ko maa ye o tete nɔn-bia bam baŋa ne mo o lage o bobo. Ko na wó bobo debam tei ne to, ko wó taa ye tetɛ mo de balo bam na ve Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kam to? Ko ná tu ko kweeli, ko bá taa chamma ba tei ne na?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Ko popone Wɛ tɔnɔ kom ne we: “Nɔn-ŋona ná lage ba na verem, ko wó chɛ mo. Konto to, ko ná ye wɛle-keira, ko wó ke-ba tɛ mo?”

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: A lage a ta woŋo de abam balo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwa to. Amo de ye abam dwoŋi nakwe mo. Amo yi déem nɛ Yezu Krista na yaare ye o daare o te tei to, ye a laam bere nɔɔna o chega kam. Amo wó tɔge a vo a na paare o tei ne, o na wó ba o veere-de jaja to.

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: Amo nam kwoori abam balo na ye nakwa to, se á ta‑á nii Wɛ nɔn-kɔgɔ kolo o na ke á jeŋa ne to baŋa ne, ne nayera na nii ba pei baŋa ne tei to. Ko nam dae fefeo ŋwaane mo á jege se á ta‑á nii-ba konto, se ko ye á boboŋa na tɔge totoŋe dem, ne Wɛ na lage tei to mo. Ko dae se á ta‑á toŋe sabu-laga ŋwaane. Á nam pa ko taa ye á yiga na wo totoŋe dem wone to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: Á yé ta‑á bɛɛse balo á na jege á nii to, se á nam ta‑á ke keim-laaro se ba wane ba taa lwoni á totoŋ-naga na ye tei to.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Konto to, abam Nayero-pɛ wom ná jwoori o ba se nabiina na‑o, o laam wó pa á jwoŋi pɛɛre delo lam na bá fɔge de ti ye de jege nenɔŋa se á ma á ke teera lanyerane.

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á tu-na á tete, se á ke á tete Wɛ dam-fɔrɔ kom jeŋa ne, se wonto maŋa kam ná tu ka yi, o laam wó zeiŋi abam pa á na zula.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Lwia yalo maama na jege abam to, se á kwei-ya á pa Wɛ, se wonto mo nii abam baŋa ne.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei á tete ni ne, se á fɔge á che á tete. Abam dono setaana pɛ kare o lage chwoŋa se o chɔge abam, nenɛɛne kana na jege nywoŋo ye ko kare ko lage varem se ko zi ko di tei to.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Nam fɔge á che á tete se á ve‑o, de á na yɔɔre á jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ tei to. Kokuri, á yei we yaara yam konto dwoŋi mo maŋe ya daane á nu-bia bam logo baŋa jei maama ne.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Abam nam ná yaare ye ko ná ke fenfee, Wɛ laam wó fɔge o kwɛ abam. Wonto jege zaane delo maama na zeini nabiina to, ye o kuri abam se á tɔge á ta‑á jege paare o tei ne se ko taa vei wuu, á na me de Yezu Krista to ŋwaane. O maa wó fɔge abam de dam se á ta‑á zege lanyerane.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Wɛ jege dam maŋa maama se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Amo na popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam to, ko ye Silas mo woli-ne. Wonto maa ye dé nu-bu wolo amo na yei o wo to. Amo popone taane dento fenfee mo se a ma pa abam na baare, se a daare a pa á lɔre we, chega kalo á na sɛ to mo zege Wɛ zaane delo na ye chekke to baŋa ne. Nam fɔge-na á ta‑á jege chega kam konto.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Wɛ kɔgɔ kolo na wo Babilon ne ye Wɛ kuri-ba se á ta‑á ye nu-bia daane to jɔɔne abam. Maake wolo na ye amo bu Wɛ chwoŋa kam ŋwaane to de jɔɔne abam.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Á ná jeeri daane, se á ta‑á kukwori daane de swono. Abam balo maama na ye Yezu Krista nyem to, Wɛ wó pa abam yazura.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura se ko gaale, de á na tu á lɔre o chega kam, ye á ta kwori á lɔre dé Teiru Yezu chega kam to. Wɛ na bwoŋi debam se dé taa tɔge‑o tei to

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista tɔge Wɛ dam ŋwaane o pa debam woŋo kolo maama na wó fɔge dé ŋwe-doŋa kam dedaane dé Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem to. O fɔgem dem konto tɔge dé na tu dé lɔre Baŋa Wɛ chega kam tei to. Wonto maa ye wolo na bwoŋi debam se dé tɔge dé na o tete nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ de o zaane dem to mo.

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Abam ná seene á jege wo-laaro tem konto se te gaale, te wó che abam se á yé ta‑á ye jawɔre-nyena. Te ta pae á dae kafɛ Wɛ chwoŋa wone de á na tu á lɔre dé Teiru Yezu Krista chega kam to.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Wo-laaro tem konto nam ná tera nɔɔno wolo tei ne, konto tu ware o lɔre Wɛ chega kam, nenɛɛne nɔɔno wolo yia na ba nae chekke to. O ma swei we, o déem na ke wɛleera yalo to maŋe ya saare.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, a nu-bia bam, Wɛ na bwoŋi abam se á ba á ta‑á tɔge‑o to, seene-na á yia se á kwaane se ko pa á na tɔge‑o tei to tiini ko ja kuri lanyerane. Á ná kwaane á ke konto dwoŋi, á daa bá sa Wɛ chwoŋa wone.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri amo boŋe se a taa pae abam ta‑á guli wo-laaro tem konto gula maŋa maama. Abam nam maŋe á yei-te, ye á seene á tɔge chega kalo á na lɔre to.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Amo nam boŋe we ko lana se, amo ta ná wora logo baŋa ne, se a taa guli abam konto dwoŋi, se ko pa á ta‑á jege te jawala.

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: Amo yei we ko bá dáane ye a te, nenɛɛne dé Teiru Yezu Krista na pɛ a lɔre tei to.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Amo nam wó kwaane a ke woŋo kolo na wó pa se á ta‑á wae á guli wonnu tem konto gula maŋa maama ye amo daa bá taa wora logo baŋa ne. Dé na lɔre Yezu chega kam tei to

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Debam déem pɛ se á lɔre chega kalo na vei dé Teiru Yezu dam dem seeni de o tutuuri dem seeni to. Dé na pɛ se á lɔre o chega kam konto to, ko dae sensɔle mo dé mɛ dé bere abam, ne nɔɔna na mae ba tete swa ba bere tei to. Debam tete yi nam mo nɛ Yezu na jege Wɛ paare dem chekke to.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Dé ma na o na jwoŋi zula dé Kwo Wɛ tei ne maŋa kalo kwora na ŋɔɔne Baŋa Wɛ paare jeiga kam ne ka ta ded‑o ka we: “Amo Bu mo tento ye a swoi‑o. O kikia su amo yi.”

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Ko woli da, dé yɔɔre dé yei we, taane delo Wɛ sampwori sem na bere faŋa faŋa to seene de ye chega de dwoi maama. Ko maŋe se á ta‑á maane á nii Wɛ tɔnɔ berem dem na ye tei ye de nye de kanea ba na tɔre ba zege lim jei ne ye ka pae pwooni to mo. Berem dem konto wó woli nɔɔna se ko vo ko yi te-pora ye dé Teiru wom jwoori o ba. Wonto pwooni dem laam wó ba de taa wo á bochara ne, ne naŋɔgɔ na fuŋi te-pora ne tei to.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye malese selo déem na tusi to, Wɛ wo duri se ŋwaŋa. O nam de-se o yage te-seŋa ne mo. O ma pe-se bɔɔna wone mɛ na ye lim yerane to, se se taa wora taa se ko taa vei o borem dɛ dem o na wó chɔge-se to.

english_verse: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
translation_verse: O na ye nɔn-ŋom ye o zoore de-ba to, o ma na ba keim-lwanno tem maama ye o ta kwori o ni ba ni-botare sem. Ko maa tiini ko jege o boboŋa ko daana de ba na toŋe ba chɔge Wɛ nia yam tei to.

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ko maama bere we, Baŋa Wɛ wae o jwoŋi balo na sɛ‑o to o yage se ba yé na cham delo na maŋe-ba to. Ko nam ná ye balo na ve‑o to, o wae o peene-ba de waarem se ko vo ko yi o borem dɛ dem o na wó chɔge-ba de wone to.

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: Ko ta ná ye balo yera na maŋe de wo-zɔɔna kikia, de balo na ba kɔre nɔɔn-nɔɔno dam to, Wɛ wó waare banto ko ja gaale. Ni-gane-nyena bam na wo á wone to de ye konto mo. Ba ba kɔre chaveera ye ba ta ba nege nɔɔn-nɔɔno. Ba maa yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaale dedɛɛra balo na jege paare Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɛ malese sem tete nam jege dam se dwoi ni-gane-nyena bam, ye se nam ba sɛ se ŋɔɔne se yaale wɛyuu dedɛɛra bam dé Teiru wom yiga ne.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Ni-gane-nyena bam nam yeini ba ŋɔɔne ba yaale woŋo kolo maama ba na yeiri ko kuri to mo. Ba na ke wo-yɔɔro telo to, ba maa nye de ga-vara mo ye ba ba jege boboŋa. Ba na loge-ba to, ko ye se nɔɔna ja-ba ba go mo. Nɔɔna bam konto wó na chɔgem ne ga-vara bam tei.

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó chɔge-ba se ko maŋe de ba tete na chɔge nɔɔna tei to. Wonnu telo na pae se ba na ywoni to mo ye kachaare kikia yalo ba na paale ba ke jaja to. Ba maa tɔge de abam ba di wodiu kolo á na yeini á la daane se á di to, ye ba gane abam de ba na ke kachaare kikia á wone to. Ba na ye nɔn-digiru to ma pae se ba chɔge abam lam, nenɛɛne sambinnu na dwei wo-napwoŋo tei to.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Banto yi maa sui ka-laga yerane mo. Ba maa ba jege siu de wo-balwaaro kikia, ye ba soge balo boboŋa na bwona to se ba de tusa. Ba maa ye nɔn-kwollu ye ba me de konto. Wɛ wó sɔɔle lwarem o yage ba yuu ne.

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Banto ma tusi ye ba daare ba ve chwo-laao tɔgem. Ba maa ke kikia yalo dwoŋi Beyora bu Balaam déem na ke to. O yi déem ma su nyɔɔre delo o na wó na o keim-balwaaro tem baŋa ne to.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ba maa tiini ba ŋɔɔne wo-kenkagela yalo na ba jege bu to. Ba maa yeini ba soge balo na bobo se ba pɔɔre ba tete de nɔɔna balo na tɔge tusim to. Ba maa mae wo-zɔɔna yalo nabiina yera na lage to mo ba soge-ba se ba ke wo-digiru kikia.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna ná tu ba lɔre Yezu Krista wolo na ye debam Teiru de de Vereno to chega kam, ko wó pa se ba lu logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna yam wone. Ba laam ná pipiri ba sɛ-ya ye ya jwoori ya wane-ba, ko kweelim jei ne ko wó taa ye lɛɛro mo ko pa banto se ko dwoni boboa kam ne.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane, ba ya ná wo lɔre Wɛ chega tɔgem chwoŋa kam, ko ya wó taa lana ko pa-ba ko dwoi ba ná tu ba lɔre-ka ye ba laam pipiri ba za ba boboŋa de Wɛ ni delo o na pɛ-ba se ba taa tɔge to.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Ko na ke banto tei to nye de sinseira kadwoŋi ye ka bere chega ka we: “Kukura jwoori ka di ka tetwanno.” Sinseira kadwoŋi ta we: “Nmo ná jaane teiri n swɛ de yera, de nam ta wó jwoori de bibili bworu wone mo.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: Ko maa ye se á guli faŋa faŋa Wɛ sampwori sem na maŋe ba bere taane delo to gula, se á daare á guli dé Teiru Yezu na ye dé Vereno to ni dem, ne o na pɛ o totoŋa nakwa badwonna ba ba bere abam tei to.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Kolo na ye wo-chɛɔ se á ta‑á yei to mo tento: Logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne nɔɔna badwonna wó taa wora ba na yaale Wɛ chega kam. Banto wó taa tɔge wo-yɔɔro telo ba tete boboŋa na lage to mo, ye ba jege abam ba mɔna ba we,

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna badaara boŋe we dé Teiru wom dáane ye o wo tu. Wɛ nam ba wuura de o na pwooli se o ke kolo to. O nam peene o bane mo de abam, kolo ŋwaane o ba lage se nɔɔn-nɔɔno na chɔgem, ye o lage se nɔɔna maama mo na chwoŋa ba leiri ba wo de ba tusim kikia yam.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru Yezu tutuuri dɛ dem nam wó pɔpɔ de ba mo, ne ŋweeno na yeini o pɔpɔ o ba to. Dɛ dem konto ne wura dedɛ wó taa wora wɛyuu ne, ye wɛyuu kom ba ko jei maama. Ko daare mini mo wó di wonnu telo woŋo maama kuri na nwoŋi da to de ja chɔge, pa se logo baŋa de ko wonnu tem maama daa bá taa wora.

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: Abam nam na cheigi dɛ dem Wɛ na wó pa se Yezu jwoori o ba to, se á kwaane á ta‑á ke kolo na wó pa se dɛ dem ba lela to. Dɛ dem konto ná yia, mini mo wó di wɛyuu wonnu maama de ja chɔge, pa se woŋo maama de ko kuri lone ye te nyeene te chɔge.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Debam nam jege teena se dé na wo-donno telo Wɛ na pwooli se o ke to. Tento maa ye wɛyuu de tega baŋa o na wó fɔge o ke to mo, ye chega kam wó yɔɔre ka taa toŋa jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Dé Teiru wom nam na peene o bane se ko dáane to, se á pa ko taa ye chwoŋa kalo o na lage o ma o jwoŋi abam o yage to. Debam nu-bu-swono Pɔɔl maŋe o popone konto dwoŋi mo o pa abam, ne Wɛ na zeini‑o de boboŋ-dɛɛra tei to.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: O na popone twanno telo maama ye o bere wonnu tento chega kam to, o yeini o tɛ konto dwoŋi te wone. Wonnu tedwonna o na popone to nam dana se nɔɔna wane ba ni te kuri, pa se balo boboŋa na bwona ye ba yeiri Wɛ chega kam lanyerane to maa jege o berem dem konto ba pipira. Banto maa yeini ba pipiri Wɛ tɔnɔ jei sedaara de na bere kolo to, pa se chɔgem ba ba tete ŋwea wone.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, a badwoŋ-swonnu bam, á maŋe á yei ko na wó ba ko taa ye tei to. Konto ŋwaane, ta‑á cho-na á tete se á yé pa puseŋ-nyena na chwoŋa ba de abam ba tusim dem wone, se ko wó pa á daa ba jege zega jei Wɛ chega kam seeni.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Abam nɛ fɔgem de Yezu Krista zaane dem ye á lɔre o chega kam lanyerane. Nam pa-na se á boboŋa kweere konto baŋa ne. Yezu Krista maa ye debam Teiru de dé Vereno. Wonto maŋe de teem leile konto se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Debam popone tɔnɔ konto se dé pa á lɔre wolo na maŋe o wora boboa ne to. Debam nam seene dé ni o kwora mo, ye dé kwori dé na o yibia. Dé fɔge dé nii‑o ye dé tiini dé me ded‑o. Ko ye ŋwea botara taane mo dé lage dé ta.

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: Ŋwea kam konto nam tu ka ba ka nae de yia. Dé ma na-ka, ye dé lage dé maŋe ka na ye tei to dé bere abam. Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo na ba ti to taane mo dé lage dé ta. Ŋwea kam konto ya wo debam Kwo Wɛ tei ne mo, ye o laam pa se dé ba dé lɔre-ka.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Dé na nɛ kolo ye dé kwori dé ni to mo dé lage dé ta dé bere abam, se ko pa abam wane á me de debam. Debam nam me de dé Kwo Wɛ de o Bu Yezu Krista.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Dé popone wonnu tem konto dé bere abam, se ko pa dé tiini dé di ywoni abam ŋwaane. Baŋa Wɛ ye pwooni tu

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Kwora kam dé na nigi Wɛ Bu Yezu ni ne ye dé lage dé ta dé bere abam to mo tento: Baŋa Wɛ ye pwooni yerane mo, ye lim tera o wone de fenfee de.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Dé ná tɛ dé we, dé me ded‑o, ye dé ta ná wo lim wone dé beera, ko bere we dé fɔ vwa mo, ye dé kikia ba tɔge chega chwoŋa kam.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Ko daare dé ná jege dé ŋwea dé wo pwooni wone, ne Wɛ na wo pwooni wone tei to, konto wó pa debam maama me daane, ye Wɛ wó saare dé wɛleera maama o Bu Yezu toone jana bam ŋwaane.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Dé nam ná tɛ dé we, dé ba jege wɛleera, dé gane dé tete, ye chega tera dé tei ne.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ko daare, dé ná tɛ dé we, dé wo ke wɛleere, dé pae se Wɛ mo ye vwa-nyem. Ko bere we dé seene dé wo jwoŋi o ni taane dem dé ke dé boboŋa ne.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: A bia bam, amo popone tɔnɔ konto a pa abam se á yé ta‑á ke wɛleere mo. Debam wolo nam ná ke wɛleere, dé jege wolo na wó zege debam de dé Kwo Wɛ laŋa ne o fɔge debam to. Wonto mo ye Yezu Krista na yɔɔre o ye chega tu to.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Wonto toone dem ŋwaane mo Wɛ saare debam wɛleera, ye ko nam dae debam wɛleera yerane, se ko ye de logo baŋa nɔɔna maama wɛleera mo.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno nam ná tɛ o we omo yei Wɛ, ye o ná ba toŋe o tɔge Wɛ nia yam, konto tu ye vwa-nyem mo, ye chega tera o tei ne.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná tɛ o we, o me de Wɛ, konto tu jege se o taa tɔge Yezu nɛ-bwora na ye tei to mo. Wɛ ni-doore dem na bere tei to

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, ni delo amo na popone se a pa abam to dae ni-doore. Ni dem nam maŋe de ye ni-dwoori mo, ye de maŋe de wora abam tei ne boboa ne. Ni dem konto ye taane delo abam na maŋe á ni to mo.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Ko daare, de daa ta ye ni-doore mo, kolo ŋwaane Yezu mo pɛ de ji chega, ye de kwori de ji chega abam de tei ne. De maa nye de lim na wora de kɛa, ye pwooni delo na ye chekke to laam maa wora de nyea.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama ná tɛ o we, omo wo pwooni wone de o ŋwea, ye o ta ná chuli o dwonna, konto tu ta wo lim wone mo de zem maama.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno wolo nam ná swoi o dwonna, konto tu mo zoore pwooni wone. Kolokolo tera ko na wó wane ko pa se o to tusim wone.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam na chuli o dwonna to wo lim wone mo. O maa kare o beera lim dem wone, ye o yeiri o na wó vo mɛ to, kokuri lim dem mo pɛ se o yia daa ba nae.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: A bia bam, amo popone tɔnɔ kom a pa abam, se á lɔre we Wɛ yage á wɛleera o ma chɛ abam Yezu yere ŋwaane.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: A kwoa bam, amo popone a pa abam, á na maŋe á yei wolo wom na maŋe o wora boboa ne to ŋwaane. Nɔn-donno tem, amo popone a pa abam, á na wane wo-lwanno tu setaane to ŋwaane.
