english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: A bu-swonnu tem, amo popone a pa abam, kolo ŋwaane abam maŋe á yei dé Kwo Wɛ. A kwoa bam, amo popone a pa abam, á na maŋe á yei wolo wom na maŋe o wora boboa ne to ŋwaane. Nɔn-donno tem, amo popone a pa abam, abam na jege pu-dɛa to ŋwaane. Á maa jege Wɛ ni taane dem á boboŋa ne, ye á wane wo-lwanno tu setaane.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Yé zaŋe-na á ta‑á swoi logo baŋa de ko wo-yɔɔro tem. Nɔɔno wolo ná swoi logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem, konto tu daa ba jege dé Kwo Wɛ swono.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro tem maama, ko ná ye nabiina fera na yeini ya zoore wo-zɔɔna yalo to, de nabiina yia na yeini ya su wonnu telo to, naa nabiina na mage ba nyɔɔna de ba jejegero tei to, tento maama dae dé Kwo Wɛ nyem, se te kuri nam nwoŋi logo baŋa ne mo.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Logo baŋa de ko wo-yɔɔro telo maama nabiina fera na zoore to lage te jei mo. Ko daare wolo nam na ke kolo Wɛ boboŋa na lage to wó taa wora taa, se ko taa vei wuu. Yezu Krista Dono wom taane

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: A bia bam, logo baŋa kweelim da yam yi ya ti. Abam maŋe á ni we Yezu Krista Dono wom maa beena. Ko na ye tei to, Yezu dona dedɛ mo maŋe ba wora. Ko ma pa dé yei we da yam konto yi ya ti.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Dona bam konto pwɛ ba tete debam kɔgɔ kom wone, ye ba maŋe ba dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem. Ba ya ná ye debam kɔgɔ kom nyem, ba ya bá yage debam tei. Ba nam na pwɛ ba tete konto to, ko bere lanyerane we banto wolowolo tɔge o dae debam kɔgɔ kom nyem.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, á maŋe á na zeinim Wo-pwoŋo Tu wom tei ne, pa se á maama lɔre Wɛ chega kam.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Konto to, amo na popone a pa abam to, ko dae we á na yeiri chega kam to ŋwaane. Woŋo kolo ŋwaane a na popone to ye á na maŋe á yei kolo na ye chega, ye á yei we vwa de chega ba tɔge daane to mo.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye wolo na seene o ye vwa-nyem to, o ye wolo na tɛ we, Yezu dae Vereno wolo Wɛ na toŋe to. Konto tu maa ye Yezu Krista dono mo, ye o ve dé Kwo Wɛ de o Bu wom de.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam ná ve Wɛ Bu wom, o Kwo Wɛ de tere konto tu tei ne. Ko daare wolo maama ná bere we o sɛ Wɛ Bu wom, o Kwo Wɛ de wora konto tu tei ne.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Nii-na, amo popone wonnu tem konto a pa abam, se á wane á lɔŋe balo na lage ba gane abam to mo.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye abam, zeinim delo á na jwoŋi Wɛ Bu wom tei ne to ta wora abam tei ne. Á daa ba jege se nɔɔn-nɔɔno zaŋe o bere abam á na wó tɔge chega tei to. Wɛ Bu wom na zeini abam to, ko ye se á lɔre wonnu maama mo. O berem dem ye chega mo ye de dae vwa. Konto to, me-na ded‑o, nenɛɛne o na bere abam se á ta‑á ye tei to.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: A bia bam, pa-na dé me de Wɛ Bu Yezu Krista. Konto mo dé wó na baare o yiga ne maŋa kam o na wó jwoori o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne to, ye chaveera bá ja debam.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Abam yei we wonto mo ye chega tu, ye ko pa á lɔre we wolo maama kikia na tɔge chega to seene o ye Wɛ bu mo.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Boŋe-na á nii dé Kwo Wɛ na tiini o swoi debam tei to. Ba ma debam ba bwoi we Wɛ bia. Dé nam seene dé ye konto mo. Nɔɔna balo na ye logo baŋa nyem to yiga nam tera de debam, ba na yeiri Wɛ to ŋwaane.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, debam laam ye Wɛ bia mo, ye dé ta wo lɔre jaja dé na wó taa ye tei to. Dé nam yei we, Yezu na wó jwoori o nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne maŋa kalo to, dé wó ba dé taa nye ded‑o mo, dé na wó yɔɔre dé na o yibia to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na yeini o ke wɛleera to paale o chɔge Wɛ ni dem mo. Wɛleera keim de Wɛ ni chɔgem ye bedwe mo.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Konto to, wolo maama na me ded‑o to ba tɔge wɛleera keim. Wolo maama nam na yeini o ke wɛleera to maŋe o wo lɔre‑o, ye o wo me ded‑o.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ko daare wolo maama nam na tɔge wɛleera keim to bere we o ye setaane nyem mo, kolo ŋwaane setaana pɛ wom maŋe o yɔɔre o tɔge wɛleera chwoŋa mo ko zege boboa ne. Wɛ Bu wom nam tu logo baŋa se o chɔge setaana pɛ wom kikia yam mo.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na seene o ye Wɛ bu to ba tɔge wɛleera keim, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ ŋwea mo wo o bochare ne. Konto to, o daa bá wane o tɔge wɛleera keim, o na ye Wɛ bu to ŋwaane.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Konto mo dé wó wane dé pɔɔre balo na ye Wɛ bia to de balo na ye setaane bia to daane. Wolo maama kikia na ba tɔge chega to dae Wɛ nyem, ko woli de wolo de na ba jege o dwonna swono to.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Dé nam ba jege se dé ke nenɛɛne Kain déem na ke kolo faŋa faŋa to. Wonto déem ye wo-lwanno tu setaane jeŋa nɔɔno mo. O ma mage o nyaane o go. O déem ke konto kolo ŋwaane o tete kikia mo ye wo-lwanno, ye o nyaane wom kikia yɔɔre ya tɔge chega. Wɛ swono kom taane

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: A nu-bia bam, balo na jege kugu jei logo baŋa ne to ná chuli abam, yé pa-na ko kagele abam.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye debam, dé yei we dé maŋe dé yage toone chwoŋa kam, ye dé daare dé tɔge Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa chwoŋa kam mo. Dé na swoi dé dwonna tei to mo pae dé lɔre konto. Wolo maama nam na ba swoi o dwonna to ta wo toone jeŋa ne mo.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na chuli o dwonna to nye de nɔn-goro mo. Abam yei we nɔn-goro tera o na wó wane o taa jege Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam o bochare ne.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama na ye jejegero tu to ná lɔre we o dwoŋi ba gara, ye kotu ná wo pɛ se o ŋwaŋa zo‑o, ko bere we Wɛ swono kom tera o bochare ne.

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: A bia bam, dé kikia mo jege se ya bere we, dé swono kom dé na jege to dae ni taane yerane, se ko ye swono kolo na seene ko tɔge chega to mo.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, debam bochara na bá wane ya chɔge debam to, dé wó taa jege baare se dé taa ye de Wɛ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Wɛ ni dem mo tento: dé jege se dé ke dé wo-dedoa de o Bu Yezu Krista, se dé kwori dé taa swoi daane, nenɛɛne wonto na pɛ debam ni se dé taa ke tei to.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na tɔge Wɛ nia yam to me ded‑o mo, ye Wɛ wo o tei ne. Wɛ Sin-laao kom o na pɛ debam to mo pae se dé lɔre we, Wɛ seene o wo debam tei ne.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, yé zaŋe-na á sɛ nɔɔno wolo maama na tɛ o we, Wɛ Sin-laao kom wo o tei ne to. Á nam jege se á faŋe á nii se á lɔre ko ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom mo, naa jworo kodwoŋi mo, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna dedɛ balo na pae ba ye Wɛ sampwori to tu ba kare logo baŋa ne mo ba gane nɔɔna.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Ko daare nɔɔno wolo maama ná ve Yezu, Wɛ Jworo kom tera konto tu tei ne. Wonto jworo kom nam mo ye Yezu Krista Dono wom nyem. Abam maŋe á lɔre we, Dono wom konto lage o ba logo baŋa. Leile konto o laam maŋe o ba o wora.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: A bia bam, abam ye Wɛ nyem mo. Abam maŋe á wane vwa-nyena bam konto, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ wo abam tei ne, ye wonto dam dwoi dam delo na wo logo baŋa nyena bam tei ne to.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye debam, dé ye Wɛ nyem mo. Wolo maama na me de Wɛ to mo wó sɛ debam na tɛ kolo to. Wolo nam na dae Wɛ nyem to mo ba sɛa. Konto mo dé wó wane dé lɔre jworo kolo na tɛ chega, de kolo na gane nɔɔna to daane. Da-swono taane

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, pa-na dé taa swoi daane, kolo ŋwaane swono nwoŋi Wɛ tei ne mo. Wolo maama ná jege o dwonna swono, konto tu ye Wɛ bu mo, ye o kwori o me de Wɛ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Wolo maama nam na ba swoi o dwonna to ta wo me de Wɛ, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ mo ye swono tu.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Wɛ na jege debam swono tei to mo tu ko bere jaja de o na toŋe o Bu-doa se o ba logo baŋa, se dé wane dé na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam omo ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Swono chekke na ye tei to mo tento: Ko dae nenɛɛne debam mo swoi Wɛ, ko ye Wɛ mo swoi debam. Wonto swono kom mo pɛ o toŋe o Bu wom se o ba o te o ma o toone jana bam o saare dé wɛleera.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: A badwoŋ-swonnu bam, Wɛ na tiini o swoi debam konto to, ko maŋe se debam de taa swoi daane mo.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o yi na nɛ Baŋa Wɛ. De konto de, dé ná jege da-swono, Wɛ wó me de debam, ye o swono kom wó ji chega debam tei ne.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Wɛ na pɛ debam o Sin-laao kom to mo pae se dé yei we dé me de Wɛ, ye o wo dé tei ne.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Debam nɛ we, dé Kwo Wɛ toŋe o Bu wom se o ba logo baŋa o ji nabiina Vereno mo. Debam laam zege chega kam konto kwaga ne mo.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná seene o bere we Yezu mo ye Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu bere we Wɛ wo o tei ne, ye wonto me de Wɛ.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Debam tete lɔre Wɛ na swoi debam tei to, ye dé sɛ o swono kom lanyerane. Wɛ ye swono tu mo. Wolo maama ná swoi swono kikia, konto tu me de Wɛ, ye Wɛ wo o tei ne.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Wɛ swono kom na jigi chega debam tei ne to, ko ye se dé na baare dɛ dem Wɛ na wó bore nɔɔna bora to. Dé bá kɔre foone, kolo ŋwaane debam ŋwea de Yezu ŋwea maama ye bedwe mo logo baŋa ne.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Foone bá wane de taa wora swono wone. Swono kolo na ye chekke to mo wó zeili foone pa de viiri. Zwɛ vaŋem mo pae foone wora. Konto to, nɔɔno wolo ná kɔre foone, ko bere we Wɛ swono kom ta wo jigi chega konto tu tei ne.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Wɛ na dɛ yiga o swoi debam to mo pae dé swoi dé dwonna.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo ná tɛ o we, omo swoi Wɛ, ye o ta ná chuli o dwonna, konto tu ye vwa-nyem mo. Kolo ŋwaane, nɔɔno wolo yi na nae o dwoŋi ye o ba jege o swono to, konto tu nam bá wane o taa swoi Wɛ wolo o yi na ba nae to.

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Wɛ pɛ debam o ni we, wolo maama na swoi omo to jege se o taa swoi o dwonna de mo.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa o sɛ we Yezu ye Wɛ Dam Tu wom, konto tu ye Wɛ bu mo. Wolo maama nam na swoi kwo to swoi kwo wom na loge bu wolo to de mo.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Dé na wó taa jege Wɛ swono tei to mo ye se dé taa tɔge o nia yam. O nia yam tɔgem bá taa chana ya pae debam,

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na wó wane o chɔge logo baŋa wo-lwanno tem, ko ná dae wolo yerane na sɛ we Yezu ye Wɛ Bu wom to.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Mo kokuri Wɛ dɛ wonnu tetɔ ŋwaane o zege o Bu wom chega kam kwaga ne.

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Te ye Wɛ Jworo kom, de na bam, de jana bam, ye te maama jege ni dedwe.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, wolo maama ná ke o wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu jege Wɛ chega kam o bochare ne. Ko daare wolo maama ná wo sɛ Wɛ, konto tu lage o bere we Wɛ ye vwa-nyem mo, kolo ŋwaane o wo sɛ chega kalo Wɛ na tage o Bu wom ŋwaane to.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Chega kam konto mo ye Wɛ na seene o pa debam ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim o tei ne to. Ŋwea kam konto nam ye o Bu wom ŋwaane mo.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná me de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu mo jege Wɛ ŋwea kam konto. Wolo nam ná ba jege meem de Wɛ Bu wom, konto tu ta wo nɛ ŋwea Wɛ tei ne.

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Amo popone wonnu tento maama a pa abam balo na ke á wo-dedoa de Wɛ Bu wom to, se á lɔre we á seene á na ŋwea kalo na ba jege kweelim Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Dé wó taa jege baare Wɛ yiga ne, kokuri dé yei we, dé ná lwoori woŋo o tei ne ye ko tɔge o boboŋa, o wó cheigi dé wɛ-lworo kom.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Dé yei we Wɛ yeini o sɛ debam wɛ-lworo kom, ne ko ná ye tei maama. Konto ŋwaane dé yei we dé wó jwoŋi woŋo kolo dé na lwoori o tei ne to.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Dé yei we wolo maama na ye Wɛ bu to ba yeini o ke wɛleera, kolo ŋwaane Wɛ Bu wom tete mo nii wonto baŋa ne pa se wo-lwanno tu setaane bá wane‑o o chɔge.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Debam yei we de ye Wɛ nyem mo, ye balo kugu jei na wo logo baŋa ne to maama nam wo wo-lwanno tu setaane jeŋa ne mo.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: A bia bam, ta‑á cho-na á tete se á yé tɔge jwona.

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: Kokuri debam maama sɛ Wɛ chega kam, ye ka daa bá fɔge ka ti debam tei ne.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Dé Kwo Wɛ wó pa debam zaane de yazura, ye o daare o duri dé ŋwaŋa. Yezu Krista wolo na ye dé Kwo Wɛ Bu wom to de wó zeini debam konto, Wɛ chega kam de o swono kom ŋwaane.

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Ko déem pɛ amo wo pwoli lanyerane de a na lɔre we nmo bia bam badaara tɔge chega chwoŋa kam, nenɛɛne debam Kwo Wɛ na pɛ debam ni se dé taa ke tei to.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Amo nu, a lage a ta de nmo se n pa debam maama taa swoi daane. Amo na popone kolo to dae ni-doore, se ko maŋe ko ye Wɛ ni delo na wora debam tei ne boboa ne to mo.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna dedɛ tu ba kare logo baŋa ne ba gane nɔɔna. Vwa-nyena bam konto maa ba sɛ we Yezu Krista jigi nabiinu o ba logo baŋa. Nɔɔno ná ye konto dwoŋi, o ye wolo na gane nɔɔna to mo. Wonto maa ye Yezu Krista Dono mo.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, á fɔge á che á tete se á wane á na á nyɔɔre maama Wɛ tei ne, se á yé pa á ga á na toŋe á lage kolo to.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Ta‑á yei-na we, nɔɔno wolo maama ná yage Yezu Krista berem dem, ye o daare o bere wonnu tedwonna o woli da, Wɛ tera konto tu tei ne. Nɔɔno wolo nam ná yɔɔre o tɔge Yezu berem dem, Baŋa Wɛ de o Bu wom wo konto tu tei ne.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Konto to, nɔɔno ná tu abam tei, ye o ba jege Yezu berem dem tete, se á yé sɛ á pa o zo á sam. Nam bere á yé zaane‑o de.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo nam ná zaane‑o, konto tu de tɔge o woli o totoŋ-balwaaro tem wone mo.

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Amo ya jege taane dedɛ se a ta a bere abam. Amo nam ba lage se a popone a ke tɔnɔ ne. A nam boŋe we, a wó ba abam tei mo se a ŋɔɔne dedaane abam jaja, se ko pa debam wopwolo kom tiini ko gaale.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Debam balo na ye nmo choro bia ye Wɛ kuri debam to mo jɔɔne nmo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Amo wolo na ye Yezu kɔgɔ kom nakwe to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa a badwoŋ-swono Gayus. Chega ŋwaane to, amo swoi nmo lanyerane.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Amo badwoŋ-swono, amo yeini a lwoori Wɛ a pa nmo se n ta‑n jege yazura de yiga-veiŋa woŋo maama wone, ne n bochare de na fɔge tei Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem ŋwaane to.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Amo ná yeini a lɔre we a bia bam seene ba tɔge chega chwoŋa kam, ko pae wopwolo tiini ko wora a tei ne se ko gaale.

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Amo badwoŋ-swono, nmo tɔge chwoŋa lanyerane de n na yeini n woli dé nu-bia bam tei to, ne ba ná maŋe ba ye veira mo de.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Dé nu-bia bam zege Yezu kɔgɔ kom yiga ne ba ta nmo na jege ba swono tei to. Ko lana se n ta‑n woli-ba ba chwoŋa kam veiŋa wone, se ko maŋe de Wɛ boboŋa na lage tei to.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna bam konto na nwoŋi se ba kekare logo kom to, ko ye se ba zeiŋi Yezu Krista yere dem mo. Ba maa ba sɛa se ba jwoŋi kolokolo balo na yeiri Wɛ to jeŋa ne.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane ko maŋe se debam mo woli nɔɔna bam konto dwi ba totoŋa yam seeni, se ko bere we debam de tɔge dé toŋe Wɛ chega kam ŋwaane.

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Amo déem popone tɔnɔ a pa Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo nmo tei ne to. Dioterefa yiga nam tera debam wone. O maa lage se o taa ye á kɔgɔ kom yiga tu.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane, amo ná tu abam tei, a laam wó ta o kikia yam maama jaja se nɔɔna lɔre. Wonto yeini o ŋɔɔne ta-balwaaro mo o ke debam yuu ne. Konto nam ta ba pwoli o wo. Kolo na woli da to, o yeini o ba sɛ se o jeeri dé nu-bia bam lanyerane o daare o cheiŋi balo na lage se ba jeeri-ba lanyerane to, ye o ta zeili-ba Yezu kɔgɔ kom wone.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Amo badwoŋ-swono, yé sɛ n lwoni keim-lwanno, se n daare n ta‑n tɔge keim-laaro. Wolo maama na toŋe keim-laaro to ye Wɛ nyem mo. Wolo nam na toŋe keim-lwanno to ta wo lɔre Wɛ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ko nam ná ye Demetiru, nɔɔna maama pae o ye nɔn-ŋom. O na tɔge chega kam tei to de bere we o ye nɔn-ŋom. Debam ywo-seeni de zege o chega kam kwaga ne, ye á yei we dé na tɛ kolo to seene ko ye chega mo.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Amo ya jege wonnu dedɛ se a ta a bere abam. A nam ba lage se a popone a ke tɔnɔ ne.

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: Wɛ ná pɛ chwoŋa, a nam wó ba abam tei leile, se dé laam ŋɔɔne daane jaja.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Wɛ wó pa‑m yazura. Dé badwoŋ-swonnu na wo ywo-seeni to mo jɔɔne nmo. Nmo de jɔɔne dé badwonna bam dedoa dedoa n pa debam.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amo Judi wolo na ye Yezu Krista kabaa ye a kwori a ye Jemsi nyaane to mo popone tɔnɔ konto se a pa abam balo Wɛ na bwoŋi se á ta‑á ye o nɔɔna to. Abam mo ye balo dé Kwo Wɛ na swoi ye Yezu Krista jege abam o jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Wɛ wó taa jege abam ŋwaŋa, ye o pa abam yazura de swono se ko gaale. Vwa berena taane

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Kokuri to, a lɔre we Wɛ-lwɛɛna mo ŋɔge ba zo ba gwaane abam kɔgɔ kom wone. Ba maa ba kɔre Wɛ ye ba yeini ba pipiri o chega kam, se ko pa ba na chwoŋa ba taa tɔge wo-digiru kikia, ye ba ta boŋe we Wɛ wó duri ba ŋwaŋa, o na ye ŋwaŋa tu to ŋwaane. Ba kikia maa bere we, ba ve Yezu Krista wolo yerane na ye debam Yuu-tu de dé Teiru to. Faŋa faŋa to Wɛ tɔnɔ kom maŋe ko bere we, nɔɔna banto dwi wó na ba lɛɛro.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Ko ta ye bedwe mo de Wɛ na ke tei o waare nɔɔna balo déem na zoore Sodom de Gomora ne, de teene delo na bwola da to. Banto de déem tɔge bwoorim wo-zɔɔna kikia, ne ko na wo maŋe se nabiina taa ke tei to. Wɛ ma pa ba na waarem de mini delo na ba ti to, se ko taa ye maana ko pae nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Wɛ malese dedɛɛro Mikayeli tete nam wo sɛ se o ke konto dwoŋi. Wonto na mage kantɔgɔ de setaana pɛ wom Moses yera yam keim ŋwaane to, o kɔre se o ŋɔɔne o yaale o yuu. O nam na tage kolo to mo ye we, “Wɛ wó vaŋe n zwa.”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Ko daare vwa-nyena bam nam ŋɔɔne ba yaale woŋo kolo maama ba na yeiri ko kuri to. Ba nam na pae se ba yei wonnu telo to, ba tɔge-te ne ga-vara na ke tei ye ba ba jege boboŋa to. Ba kikia yam konto mo wó pa ba na chɔgem.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Lɛɛro taa wo ba yuu ne! Ba tɔge Kain nɛ-bwora déem na ye tei to mo. Ba yi maa sui nyɔɔre delo ba na wó na ba keim-balwaaro tem baŋa ne, ne Balaam déem na ke tei ye o tusi to. Ba ma ve Wɛ ni, ne Kora déem na ve-de ye Wɛ go‑o to. Banto de wó ba ba na chɔgem konto dwoŋi.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Enoki déem ya wuuri o ta nɔɔna bam konto taane faŋa faŋa. Wonto déem ke Adam dwi tiina kuri berepɛ tu mo, ye o we, “Nii-na! Baŋa Wɛ wó seene o ba de o malese-laaro tem morro kuni morro,

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: se o di nabiina maama taane. O laam wó pa se Wɛ-lwɛɛna na ba chaveera, de ba na paale ba tusi ba tɔge wɛleera yerane, ye ba ŋɔɔne ba chɔge o yuu tei to.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Vwa-nyena bam konto yeini ba poona mo ye ba gwooni ba dwonna. Ba maa tɔge wo-zɔɔna yalo maama ba fera na zoore to. Ba maa ŋɔɔne kamunni ba pa ba tete, ye ba ŋɔɔne ni-sone ŋɔŋa de nɔɔna se ba na nyɔɔre ba baŋa ne. Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem taane

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Amo badwoŋ-swonnu bam, abam nam jege se á guli dé Teiru Yezu Krista totoŋa nakwa bam déem na maŋe ba ta kolo de abam to mo.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Ba déem we, “Logo baŋa kweelim da yam ne nɔɔna badwonna wó taa wora ba na yaale Wɛ chega kam ye ba tɔge wo-lwanno telo ba tete fera na zoore to.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna bam konto dwi mo yeini ba pae abam pɔɔre daane. Ba boboŋa tɔge logo baŋa wo-yɔɔro mo ye Wɛ Sin-laao kom tere ba bochara ne.

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Á ta‑á jege á ŋwea de Wɛ swono kom o na pɛ abam to, ye á jege teena we dé Teiru Yezu Krista wó ba o pa á na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kalo na ba jege kweelim to, o na jege abam ŋwaŋa to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Badaara nam wora á na jege se á vere-ba mini delo na lage de chɔge-ba to wone pa ba wori. Ko daare balo wo-zɔɔna kikia na pɛ se ba jege digiru to, se á ta‑á jege ba ŋwaŋa, ye á nam ta‑á yei á tete de ba wo-digiru tem se te yé lɔgese abam.

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: O yerane mo ye Wɛ ye o dwoŋi tera. O maa ye dé Vereno. Dé Teiru Yezu Krista ŋwaane mo o maŋe de zula, de paare, de yere-zɔŋɔ, de dam, ko na zege faŋa faŋa ye logo baŋa ta tera to, de zem maama de, se ko taa vei wuu. Dé ke Wɛ lei. Ameena.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Tɔnɔ konto wo wonnu tem ye kolo Wɛ na bere Yezu Krista se o ma le o bere o tontoŋena, se ba wane ba lɔre kolo na jege se ko ke leile to mo. Yezu pɛ o maleka mo ba amo tei se ka bere-ne wonnu tem konto.

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn ye Yezu tontoŋeno mo, ye a popone kolo maama a na nɛ to a tiŋi. Amo zege Wɛ kwora kam kwaga ne mo, ne Yezu Krista na veere o bere-ne tei to.

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn mo popone tento a pa Yezu kɔgɔ kuni berepɛ kolo na wo Asia te-nia yam wone to. Wɛ wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Wonto maŋe o wora mo boboa ne, ye o ta wora zem se ko taa vei wuu. Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ balo na bere o Jworo kom dam ye ba zege o paare yitiŋu kom yiga ne to de wó pa abam zeinim konto.

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Yezu Krista de wó pa abam zaane de yazura. Wonto mo ye wolo na yɔɔre o zege Wɛ chega kam kwaga ne to. Wonto ta mo ye wolo na dɛ yiga o bi toone wone ye o na Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa kam to. O nam ta mo ye logo baŋa pwa bam maama yuu tu. Yezu swoi debam ye o vere debam dé wɛleera wone o yage, o na tega ye o jana bam nwoŋi to ŋwaane.

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: O ma daare o pa dé ji dwi delo na wó zege o Kwo Wɛ yiga ne ye dé zuli‑o ne kaanem tiina to. Zula de dam taa wo Yezu tei ne se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Wonto tɔge de kunkwonnu mo o beene. Nɔɔno maama yi wó na‑o, de balo na zɔge‑o de chichwei to de. Ko daare logo baŋa dwi maama wó keeri o ŋwaane. Ko ye chega mo. Ameena.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ mo we: “Amo mo ye pulim jei de kweelim jeiga.” Wonto mo maŋe o wora boboa ne, ye o ta wora zem se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn ye abam nu-bu mo. Amo na ye Yezu nyem to, ko ma pa se a tɔge a na yaara nenɛɛne abam de na nɛ yaara tei to. Amo nam kwori a tɔge de abam a woli Wɛ paare dem wone, ye a tɔge a na baare Yezu ŋwaane. Amo na kwaane a bere Wɛ kwora kalo Yezu na le o bere-ne to ŋwaane mo ba jaane-ne ba yage Patama buburu kom yuu ne.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Dɛ delo na ye Wɛ siu dɛ to mo o Sin-laao kom tu amo tei de dam. Amo ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa a kwaga ne, ne nɔɔno na wui nabɔnɔ tei to.

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: Kwora kam ma ŋɔɔne ka we, “Nam popone kolo maama nmo na wó na to n ke tɔnɔ ne, se n toŋe-ko n pa Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo teene derepɛ dem wone to. Teene dem konto mo ye: Efesia, Semuna, Pɛregama, Tuatera, Sadisa, Filafia, de Ladika.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Amo ma pipiri se a nii wɔ mo ŋɔɔna de amo. A ma na sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ mo na zega.

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maa zege te tetare ne, o na nye de nabiinu bu. O ma zo gare-dedɔrɔ o de o napera ne, ye o daare o vɔ sabu-seŋa kila o nyɔɔne ne.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: O yu-ywei maa tiini se peere cha, ne lɔŋɔ tei. O yia maa nye ne min-vogo tei.

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: O napera maa nyeena, ne channa kolo ba na ke mini ne pa ko be to. O kwora maa dɔna ne na-fwaaro mo chuuri tei.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: O maa zei chalechwe serepɛ o jazem ne. Se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni ye ko ye nia yalei to maa nwoŋi o ni ne. O yibia maa nyeena, ne wea na tiini ka nye tei to.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Amo na nɛ‑o ye o jege dam konto to, a ma to o yiga ne, ne a tega mo tei. O ma kwei o jazem o daŋe a baŋa ne, ye o we: “Yé ta‑n kɔre foone. Amo mo ye boboa kam de gurim tu.

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Amo ye ŋwea tu mo. Amo ya tege mo, ye a laam jwoori a jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu. Amo jege dam toone baŋa ne de churu de baŋa ne.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Amo wó bere‑m chalechwe serepɛ sem nmo na nɛ amo jazem ne to, de sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ tem kuri na ye tei to chekke. Chalechwe serepɛ sem bere Wɛ tontoŋena balo na nii wɛ-di serepɛ sem nɔɔna baŋa ne to mo. Ko daare min-zwonnu terepɛ tem de bere wɛ-di serepɛ sem nɔɔna bam tete na ye tei to mo.”

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Nam popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Efesia ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na zei chalechwe serepɛ sem o jazem ne, ye o kwori o wo sabu-seŋa min-zwonnu terepɛ tem tetare ne o vei to tei mo.

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Amo yei á na tiini á chɛ de á totoŋa tei to, ye á wo fɔge á yage. Amo ta yei we, abam ba pae se nɔn-balwaaro na chwoŋa abam tetare ne. Ko ná ye balo na bere we ba ye Yezu totoŋa nakwa ye ba dae to, a yei we á yeini á maane-ba á nii, ye á lɔre we ba ye vwa-nyena mo.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Abam jege pu-dɛa lanyerane. Abam nɛ yaara amo ŋwaane ye á tiini á vɔ á wo de-ya, se á vɔna yé pare.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Ko daare amo nam jege abam taane se a ta. Á daa ba jege amo swono se ko maŋe de boboa ne ko na ye tei to.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Ko daare, abam kwaane de á na chuli kikia yalo Nikolayi nɔɔna bam na ke to. Amo tete de chuli ba na ke tei to.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu chwoŋa se o zo Wɛ ywoni jei sem wo o di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to. Semuna tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Semuna ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na ye boboa kam de kweelim tu to tei mo. Wonto nam ta mo ye wolo na tega ye o jwoori o bi o jege ŋwea to.

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Amo maŋe a yei cham delo na yi abam to ni ne. A yei we yiniga jege abam. Ko daare, abam nam ye naduna mo Wɛ tei ne. Ko ná ye balo na pae ba ye Juu tiina ye ba ba tɔge chwoŋa to, amo yei ba na yaale abam tei to. Banto wo setaana pɛ chwoŋa wone mo.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Yé ta‑á kɔre-na foone de á na wó na yaara yalo to. Nii-na! Setaana pɛ lage o pa ba ja abam badaara ba pe, se o maŋe abam o nii. Abam nam wó na cham se ko maŋe de da fuga. Ko ná maŋe ko twɛ á toone de, se á ta ta‑á jege wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Abam ná ke konto, amo wó pa á na Wɛ pɛɛre delo na ye ŋwea chekke to.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, toone delo na ye belei tu to daa bá wane‑o de chɔge. Pɛregama tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Pɛregama ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo wom na jege se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni ye ko ye nia yalei to tei mo.

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: Amo yei abam na zoore mɛ to, ye setaana pɛ mo tei jei sem konto. De konto de, abam ta wo kwei amo á yage. Antipa déem zege amo chega kam kwaga ne de o wo maama mo. Ba ma daare ba go‑o abam tei ne, setaana pɛ na zoore jei selo ne to. De konto na maŋe ko ke to de, abam daa ta wo leiri á wo de amo.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Amo nam jege abam taane fenfee se a ta. Nɔɔna wora abam wone ye ba sɛ berem delo na ye Balaam nyem to. Faŋa faŋa to wonto mo bere Pɛ Balaki se o soge Isarele tiina o pa ba to tusim wone. Ba ma di wodiiru telo na ye jwona nyem to, ye ba daare ba chɔge nɔɔna kaana.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Nikolayi berem dem de maŋe de ye konto mo. Nɔɔna badaara wora á wone ba de na tɔge berem dem konto.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Nam leiri-na á wo. Ko ná dae konto, amo wó ba abam tei lela. A maa wó le se-zɔɔ kom na wo a ni ne to a ma ke jara dedaane-ba.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu Wɛ wodiu kolo yere na ye ‘Manna’ ye ko seigi nabiina yiga ne to se o di. Ko woli da, amo wó kwei kandwɛ-pwoŋo a pa konto tu. Yere-doore wó taa wo kandwɛ dem konto baŋa ne ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri-de, ko ná dae wolo na jwoŋi-de to yerane. Tuatera tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Tuatera ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi Wɛ Bu wom tei mo. Wonto yia mo nye de min-vogo, ye o napera nyeena ne channa tei.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Ko daare, amo jege abam taane se a ta. Abam yeini á yage chwoŋa á pa kaane wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ ni-jwoŋinu to, o yere mo Jezebele. Wonto na yeini o bere amo nɔɔna bam tei to, o gane-ba mo o pae ba tusa. O ma pa ba ke bwoorim, ye ba daare ba di wodiiru telo na ye jwona nyem to.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Amo nam pɛ wonto maŋa mo se o leiri o wo de o kikia yam. O maa wo sɛ se o yage o wo-zɔɔna kikia yam.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Amo wó mage balo na sɛ o berem dem to a go. Konto to, wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam maama wó ba ba lɔre we, amo mo ye wolo wom na seene o yei nabiina bochara de ba boboŋa to. Amo wó ke abam dedoa dedoa se ko maŋe de á kikia na mae tei to.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Ko daare abam badwonna na wo Tuatera ne to wo tɔge kaane wom konto bera yam. Abam nam wo kwaane se á lɔre setaana pɛ berem dem, nɔɔna badaara na bwoi-de we setaane boboŋ-lilirru to. Amo nam daa bá che abam de chullu tedwonna a woli da.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Á nam ta‑á jege abam na maŋe á tɔge tei to, se a laam ba abam tei.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná wane wo-balwaaro dam ye o toŋe o tɔge amo boboŋa se ko vo ko kweeli, amo wó pa konto tu dam se o taa tei logo baŋa dwi tiina maama.

english_verse: I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
translation_verse: Konto mo ye dam delo amo Kwo na maŋe o kwei o ke a jeŋa ne to. Amo wó daare a pa se tetete chalechoa kam taa wo konto tu tei ne.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama nam kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kom na wo Sadisa ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na tei Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam ye o kwori o jege chalechwe serepɛ sem o jeŋa ne to tei mo. Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Abam yere zaŋe pa se nɔɔna boŋe we á jege ŋwea mo Wɛ tei ne, ye á nam nye de twa mo tei.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Zaŋe-na á che á tete se á ta‑á tɔge kikia yalo na maŋe to, se kolo fenfee á ta na ke to yé chɔge ko ti. Kokuri, amo na nɛ tei to, abam kikia yam ta wo yi amo Kwo Wɛ boboŋa.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Nam fɔge-na á guli ba na bere abam Wɛ chwoŋa ye á ni kolo to, se á kwaane á ta‑á tɔge-ka. Leiri-na á wo de á keim-balwaaro tem. Á ta ná tigi á dɔa, ta‑á yei-na we, amo wó ba a dare abam ne ŋweeno tei, ye á bá lɔre maŋa kam amo na wó ba to.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Ko daare, abam fenfee na wo Sadisa kɔgɔ kom wone to ke lanyerane, de ba na chege ba tete de wo-digiru to. Amo wó pa ba zo gare-pwonnu ye ba taa tɔge de amo ba via, ba na maŋe se ba taa ye konto to ŋwaane.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to wó zo gare-pwonnu tento dwoŋi. Amo daa bá saare konto tu yere Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone. Amo nam wó sɛ o yere dem a bere a Kwo Wɛ de o malese sem.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Filafia tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Filafia ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo na ye wo-pwoŋo tu de chega tu to tei mo. Wonto mo zei Pɛ David bwor-bu. Diga kalo maama o ná pore, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pe-ka. O nam ná pe diga kalo, nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane o pore-ka.

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Amo maŋe a yei abam na ke tei to. Nii-na! Amo pore chwoŋa a pa abam ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane-ka o che. Amo yei we abam dam ba tiini de daga, ye á ta kwaane á ke amo berem dem á bochare ne. Á ta maa wo seigi amo yere dem.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo na pae ba ye Juu tiina ye ba ba tɔge chwoŋa to, ba wo setaana pɛ chwoŋa wone mo ye ba fɔ vwa. Amo wó pa se ba ba ba kuni dwoona abam yiga ne. Ba maa wó maane we amo swoi abam.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Abam na tɔge amo ni dem ye á vɔ á wo cham wone to ŋwaane, lɛɛro maŋa kam ná yia, amo wó che abam de yaara yalo na wó ba ya maŋe nabiina maama logo baŋa ne to.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Amo bá dáane ye a ba. Abam nam fɔge á ta‑á jege á na maŋe á tɔge tei to, se nɔɔn-nɔɔno yé wane o che abam pɛɛre delo á na lage á jwoŋi Wɛ tei ne to.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Wolo maama ná wane wo-balwaaro dam, amo wó pa konto tu na kugu jei amo Kwo Wɛ sɔŋɔ kom ne, ye o daa bá nwoŋi da maŋa de maŋa. Amo wó daare a popone amo Kwo Wɛ yere dem de o teo kom yere dem konto tu yera ne. Wɛ teo kom konto mo ye Jerusalem kolo na fɔge ko kwɛ to, ye amo Kwo Wɛ wó pa ko nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ko tu ko ba to. Amo ta wó popone amo yere-doore dem konto tu yera ne.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to. Ladika tiina kɔgɔ kom tɔnɔ

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Daa‑n popone tɔnɔ n pa Wɛ tontoŋeno wolo na nii Yezu kɔgɔ kolo na wo Ladika ne to. Popone we: Taane dento nwoŋi wolo yere na ye ‘Ameena’ ye o yɔɔre o zege Wɛ chega kam kwaga ne de o wo maama to tei mo. Wɛ na naane kolo maama to dɛ wonto jeŋa mo.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Abam nam na ba jege boboŋe dedwe to, a lage a ve abam, nenɛɛne nɔɔno na twe wodi-baywoŋo o ni ne o yage tei to mo.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Abam yeini á tɛ we, á ye naduna mo ye kolokolo wo muri abam. Á nam wo lɔre we yini-gwia mo jege abam. Á nye de lwoona mo, ye á yia ba nae. Á ta ye kalambwolo mo de.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Abam nam jege se á ba amo tei mo, se á yeigi sabu-seŋa kalo ba na tiini ba wɔ mini ne pa ka be to. Konto mo wó pa se á seene á ta‑á ye naduna Wɛ yiga ne. Ba-na á yeigi gare-pwonnu de amo tei ne á zo se te kwoli á chaveera yam. Nam yeigi-na yia nuga amo tei ne se á ke á yia ne se ya taa nae.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye balo amo na swoi to, a yeini a kaane-ba mo ye a daare a korese-ba. Nam seene-na á yia Wɛ chwoŋa tɔgem seeni se á leiri á wo de á tusim kikia yam.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Nii-na! Amo zege manchwo-peena ne mo a dɔne dɛ sem. Wolo nam ná nigi amo kwora kam ye o ba o pore chwoŋa o zaane-ne, amo wó zo konto tu tei, ye a pa dé jeini daane dé di wodiu.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Wolo maama na wane wo-balwaaro dam to, amo wó pa konto tu chwoŋa se o tɔge o jeini amo paare jeiŋa kam jei ne, nenɛɛne amo de na tɔge a jeini a Kwo Wɛ paare jeiŋa kam jei ne tei, amo na wane wo-balwaaro dam to ŋwaane.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno maama kwaane o pore o zwa se o cheigi Wɛ Sin-laao kom na tɛ kolo de wɛ-di sem nɔɔna bam to.”

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn daa na nɛ kolo a woli da to mo ye a nɛ diga ni na pore Wɛ telaao ne. A daa ma ni kwora kalo ya na maŋe ka ŋɔɔne de amo ye ka nye de nabɔnɔ ba na tiini ba wu to. Kwora kam we, “Diini n ba ywoba seeni se a bere nmo wonnu telo na lage te ba te ke to.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Kwora kam na tage konto to, Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma ba amo tei de dam. Amo ma yɔɔre a na paare yituŋu na zege telaao ne, ye a na wolo na jei ko baŋa ne to.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Wolo na jei da to maa tiini o nyeena, ne kandwɛ-nyeno kolo na nyeene pele-pele to de kolo na seene chwɛ-chwɛ to. Manlaataŋa maa wora ka kekare paare yituŋu kom, ye ka nyeena nenɛɛne kandwɛ-nyeno kolo yere na ye Emeraleda to.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Paare yitunnu finlei-tena laam maa zege te gilimi yituŋu kom konto. Nakwa finlei-bana maa jei te baŋa ne ba na zo gare-pwonnu ye ba daare ba pu sabu-seŋa yipwi.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Pwooni de sɔɔ ma nwoŋi paare yituŋu kom na wo mɛ to, ne doa na pepela ka baga ka wuuri tei to. Mɔɔla yarepɛ maa wo paare yituŋu kom yiga ne ye te zege te di bileim-bileim. Tento mo bere Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam na ye tei to.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Ko maa nye de naneo mo tigi paare yituŋu kom yiga ne, ye ko nyeena ne gelaase na ye tei to. Wonnu tena na ŋwe to maa zege te gilimi paare yituŋu kom sɛ sena sem maama. Yia ma faare te yiga de te kwaga maama.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Da-yiga woŋo kom nye ne nywoŋo mo tei. Kolo na ke telei to maa nye de na-bala. Kolo na ke tetɔ to yiga maa nye de nabiinu yiga. Kolo na ke tena to maa nye de kawula na jaane wɛɛne tei to.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Wonnu tem konto maama jege vɔna yaredo yaredo mo. Te yera yam maama maa ye yia yerane te yiga de te kwaga maama. Wea de tete maama te ba dɔa ye te seini Wɛ te we: “Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo. O maa yɔɔre o ye wose ye o dwoŋi tera. O maŋe o wora mo boboa ne, ye o ta wora zem, se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to yeini te zuli wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to, ye te seini‑o, ye te kwori te ke‑o lei. Wonto mo ye wolo na jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu to.

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Debam Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo seene n maŋe se n jwoŋi zula, de teem, de dam. Kolo ŋwaane nmo mo naane wonnu maama. Ko maa ye nmo tete boboŋa mo laga pa se n ke-te ye n pa te wora.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma na tɔnɔ na wo wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to jazem ne. Tɔnɔ kom dɛ sem maama maa jege poponem. Ko ni dem ma meeni de maaro kuni berepɛ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: A ma daare a na Wɛ maleka na dana to ye ka tɔɔle de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Wɔ mo yi se o wane o kore maaro telo na meeli tɔnɔ kom ni dem ne to, se o daare o puri-ko?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera telaao ne, naa tega baŋa ne, naa tega kuri jei ne, o na wó wane o puri tɔnɔ kom o daare o ga-ko.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: A wo ma tiini ko chɔge de ba na wo nɛ nɔɔn-nɔɔno wolo na yi se o puri tɔnɔ kom o daare o ga-ko to.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Nakwa finlei-bana bam wo dedoa ma ta de amo o we, “Yé pa se n wo chɔge. Nii. Judah dwi tu wolo na dana ne nywoŋo tei to mo wora, ye o kuri nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone. Wonto mo wane o dona maama o di, ye o na chwoŋa se o puri tɔnɔ kom de ko maaro terepɛ tem.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Amo daa ma na Pipeila, ka na zege paare yituŋu kom, de wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam tetare laŋa ne. Ka maa nye de ba ya gwoni-ka mo ba go. Ka jege nyea yarepɛ mo dedaane yia yarepɛ. Ka yia yarepɛ yam mo bere Wɛ dedɛɛra barepɛ bam na ye tei to, ye banto mo Wɛ toŋe logo baŋa ni maama ne.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Pipeila kam laam ma vo wolo na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to tei ka jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom na wo o jazem ne to.

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Amo daa ma nii a na Wɛ malese kɔgɔ dedɛ, ye a ni se kwori. Se daga lanyerane ne morro kuni morro dedɛ mo tei. Se maa zege se gilimi paare yituŋu kom, dedaane wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Se laam ma leeni baŋa baŋa se we: “Pipeila kam ba na go to seene ka maŋe se ka jwoŋi dam, de nadunni, de swa, de baare, ko woli de seinim, de zula, de teem.”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Amo daa ma ni wonnu maama na wo Wɛ telaao ne to, de telo maama na wo logo baŋa ne de tega kuri jei ne to, ko woli de wonnu maama na wo naneo wone to de. Ko maa ye wonnu telo maama Wɛ na ke to mo leeni te we: “Wolo na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to, dedaane Pipeila kam maŋe de teem, de seinim, de zula, de dam, se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to ma sɛ ye te we, “Ameena. Ko ye konto mo.” Ko daare nakwa bam ma kuni dwoona ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Amo daa ma nii a na Pipeila kam laam na bobo se ka puri tɔnɔ kom. Ka ma kore boboa maao kolo na meeli-ko to. Amo ma ni wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to dedoa kwora na dɔna, ne doa na mumuna tei to, ye ko we, “Ba ywo.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Pipeila kam daa ma kore maao kolo na ke tena to. A ma ni woŋo kolo na ŋwe ye ko kweeli te wone to na tage ko we, “Ba ywo.”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: A ma nii a na sisein-fufunu na zege da. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to yere mo ye Toone. Wolo yere na ye Churu to maa tɔge‑o o nɔne o nagwola. Ba ma jwoŋi dam se ba go nɔɔna bana maama wone nɔɔno dedoa. Ba jege dam se ba pa jara mo go nɔɔna badaara, se ba pa kana de go badaara, se jaweo de go badaara, se ba daare ba pa kago-vara de go badaara. Tɔnɔ kom maao

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Pipeila kam laam ma kore maao kolo na ke tenu to. Amo laam ma na Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem, ye a na balo ba déem na go Wɛ chwoŋa kam tɔgem ŋwaane to jworru na wo de teiŋa ne. Banto na kwaane ba bere Wɛ chega kam to ŋwaane mo ba déem go-ba.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Ba ma ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa ba we: “Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo ye wo-pwoŋo tu mo de chega tu. Yé dáane se n laam di logo baŋa nabiina taane, se n daare n waare-ba, ba na go debam to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma kwei gare-napwon-dedwaaro ba pa ba maama. Ba ma ta-ba ba we, “Zuri-na á yera se á kɔgɔ kom laam ba ko puli ko ti. Kokuri á dwonna ta daare logo baŋa ne, balo na maŋe se ba woli á kɔgɔ kom wone to. Banto ye balo de na toŋe ba pa Wɛ to, ye nɔɔna wó go-ba, ne ba na go abam tei to.” Tɔnɔ kom maao

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: A ma na Pipeila kam daa na kore maao kolo na ke teredo to. Tega kam laam maa tiini ka ziziŋa. Wea kam ma ji nazwono tim-tim, ne gare-zwono tei. Chana kam maama ma ji nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ, ne jana tei.

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: Chalechwe sem ma siiri se toe tega ne, ne vo-dɛɔ mo na sugi kapera ko pa ya siiri tei to.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Wɛyuu kom ma piri ko kɛ, ne nɔɔno na piri sara tei to. Ko daare logo baŋa peero maama de tega kalo maama na wo naneo tetare ne to ma fɔɔre te tiga jei ne.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa nɔɔna maama laam ma kɔre foone. Ko ná ye logo baŋa pwa, de dedɛɛra, de jar-keira yiga tiina, de naduna, de nɔn-kamuna, ko woli de kabɛ, de balo na tei ba tete to maama, ba maama fona ye ba duri ba vo ba seigi ba tete peero bɔɔna de gugworru wone.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma lwoori kandwa yam de peero tem ba na seigi te wone to se te to ba baŋa ne te kwoli-ba. Ba maa we, “Kwoli-na debam, se wolo wom na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to daa yé na debam. Ta‑á cho-na debam de Pipeila kam ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wo debam baŋa ne to.

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: Kokuri to, dɛ dem yia se ba bane zaŋe debam nabiina baŋa ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá wane o lu.”

english_verse: from Benjamin. People from Every Nation
translation_verse: ) Benjamin dwi dem wone.

english_verse: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,
translation_verse: A daa ma na Wɛ maleka kadwoŋi na zaŋe ka nwoŋi wɛ-puli jei ne ka maa beena. Ka nam tu se ka la gwona mo ka pa balo na ye Ŋwea Tu Wɛ nyem to. Ka ma bage ka ta de Wɛ malese sena sem, Wɛ na pɛ-se dam se se wane se chɔge tega baŋa de naneo kom to, ka we,

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: “Zege-na. Á yé chɔge tega baŋa, naa naneo kom, naa teeni dem de. Nam cheigi-na se dé ná tu dé la dé Tu Wɛ tontoŋena bam gwona ba tira ne, se dé daare.”

english_verse: Then I heard how many people had been marked on the forehead. There were
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ba a lɔre balo na lage Wɛ gwona yam to ni na mae tei to. Ko ye nɔɔna morro bi de finna-tena (

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: “Ko ye chega mo. Debam Tu Wɛ maŋe de teem, de zula, de swa, de lei keim, ko woli de seinim, de dam, de baare, se ko taa vei wuu. Ameena.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Konto na kɛ to, a ma daa nii a na nɔn-kɔgɔ na tiini ko wora, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno bá wane nɔɔna bam o ga o ti. Nɔɔna bam konto nwoŋi paare dim jei sem maama wone, de nabiina dwi maama wone, de teene maama wone, de taana dwi maama tiina wone mo. Ba maa zege paare yituŋu kom de Pipeila kam yiga ne. Ba zo gare-napwon-dedwaaro mo, ye ba daare ba zei konkwara vɔɔro ba jea ne.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Ba laam maa ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa ba we: “Debam Tu Wɛ mo jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne. Pa-na dé tei‑o, o na vere debam lɛɛro wone o yage to ŋwaane, ye dé tei Pipeila kam de.”

english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Wɛ malese sem maama maa zege se gilimi paare yituŋu kom, de nakwa bam, dedaane wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to. Malese sem laam ma chɔɔle se yuni tega ne se yɔɔre paare yituŋu kom se zuli Wɛ se we:

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Konto na kɛ to, nakwa bam dedoa ma bwei amo o we, “Nɔɔna bam na zo gare-napwon-dedwaaro tem to ye bera mo? Ba nwoŋi yei ne mo?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Amo ma leiri‑o a we, “Amo tu, ta n bere-ne, se nmo mo yei-ba.” O laam ma ta o bere amo o we, “Nɔɔna banto mo ye balo na wo logo baŋa ne maŋa kalo lɛɛro na tiini te wora ye ba nwoŋi te wone to. Ba nam zare ba gwaaro tem de Pipeila kam jana bam mo pa te peere.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Konto nam mo pɛ banto ba ba zege Wɛ paare yituŋu kom yiga ne, ye ba toŋe ba pa‑o wea de tete maama o sɔŋɔ kom ne. Wolo wom nam na jei paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne to wó pa ba jeini o woro ne.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Kana daa bá fɔge ka ja banto. Na-nyɔm de nam bá ja-ba. Wea nam daa bá ja-ba, naa fonyogo.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Kokuri Pipeila kam na wo paare yituŋu kom jei sem tetare ne to wó taa nii ba baŋa ne, ne ka ye nayero mo tei. Ka nam wó tɔge ba yiga ka ja-ba ka vo buli selo na na pae ŋwea to se ba nyɔ. Wɛ nam wó weeri nɔɔna bam maama yi-na, se ba daa yé taa jege yi-nyɔna.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Pipeila kam laam ma kore maao kolo na ke terepɛ to. Dɔnne maa wo ke Wɛ telaao ne nenɛɛne awa chichworo tei.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: A laam ma na malese serepɛ sem na zega Wɛ yiga ne to. Ba ma kwei nabwanno terepɛ ba pa se maama.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Maleka kadwoŋi ma ba ka zege Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem tei ne, ye ka zei sabu-seŋa min-chala zoŋa. Ba ma kwei talwoŋ-ywoŋa dedɛ ba ke maleka kam zoŋa kam ne, se ka kwei ka woli de Wɛ nɔɔna bam maama wɛ-lworo kom. Ba na pɛ-ka konto to, ko ye se ka kwei ka ja vo sabu-seŋa bimbini dem na zege paare yituŋu kom yiga ne to, se ka zwɛ ka pa Wɛ.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Ka na kwei ka zwɛ konto to, wonnu tem nyoa kam maa tɔge de Wɛ nɔɔna bam wɛ-lworo kom ka nwoŋi maleka kam jea ne ka yɔɔre ka diini Wɛ tei.

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Malese serepɛ sem maama laam ma ti se yiga se se wu se nabwanno tem.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na ye da-yiga tu to ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Ka na wugi-ko to, doa kandwa, de mini, de jana na gwaane daane to ma chuuri logo baŋa ne. Logo baŋa pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma di mini. Teeni dem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe de ma di mini, de ga-lɛɛro maama.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na saŋe to de ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Ka na wugi konto to, ba ma kwei woŋo na nye de peo-zɔŋɔ ye ko jege mini to ba dole ba de logo baŋa naneo kom wone. Naneo kom ma ji jana.

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: Wonnu telo na ŋwe naneo kom wone to pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma te, ye nabwooru tem pɔɔrem dem konto de chɔge.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Malese setɔ tu wom ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Chalecho-kamunu na jege mini ne mɔɔle mini tei to laam ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne ka to logo baŋa bu-tole sem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ kom kuri bedwe wone, de buli sem de wone.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Chalechoa kam konto yere mo ‘Nywaane’. Bwi sem konto na bam ma ji na-chɛɛra. Nɔɔna dedɛ maa nyɔ-ba ye ba toa.
