english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Malese sena tu wom de laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Wea kam pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ma chɔge. Chana kam pɔɔrem dem konto de ma chɔge, ko woli de chalechwe sem de konto. Konto ma pa se te maama pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ye lim. Konto ŋwaane, pwooni daa tera dɛ wone pɔɔrem kuni betɔ kom kuri bedwe wone, wea de tete maama.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma nii a na kawula na tiini ka jaane wɛyuu wɛyuu. A ma ni ka na tage baŋa baŋa ka we, “Lɛɛro naa! Lɛɛro naa! Lɛɛro lage te yi balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to. Malese setɔ selo na daare to ná wugi se nabwanno tem pa te kwori zaŋe, lɛɛro tem konto wó ba nabiina baŋa.”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na ye banu tu wom to laam ma wu ka nabɔnɔ kom. Amo ma na chalechoa na kwori wɛyuu ne ka ba ka to logo baŋa ne. Ba ma kwei bwor-bu ba pa-ka se ka ma pore gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom ni dem.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Ka na pore gwoŋo kom ni dem to, nyoa maa yɔɔre ka pi ka nwoŋi ko wone, ne mini delo na daga ye de jege nyoa tei to. Nyoa kam ma nwoŋi ka li wea kam de wɛyuu kom maama.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Kayere laam ma nwoŋi nyoa kam wone se tu tega baŋa. Se ma jwoŋi dam se se donem taa wɔe, ne nɔŋɔ donem na ye tei to.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Ba ma kaane-se se se yé chɔge logo baŋa gaaro de teeni, naa vɔɔro dwi maama. Se ma jwoŋi chwoŋa se se chɔge nɔɔna balo yerane na wo lage Wɛ gwona yam ba tira ne to.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Ba maa wo pɛ kayere sem chwoŋa se se go nɔɔna bam konto. Se nam nɛ chwoŋa se se pa nɔɔna bam yera mo taa wiira, se ko vo ko yi chane senu. Ba yera yam wó taa wiira ne nɔŋɔ donem na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Maŋa kam konto ne, nɔɔna bam wó taa lage se ba te, ye toone bá ja-ba, de ba ná maŋe ba beeri toone tei maama de.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Kayere sem maa nye de sisei mo ba na vɔga se se vo jara jei to. Kayere sem yuni nye de se pugi sabu-seŋa yipwi mo tei. Se yibia maa ye nenɛɛne nabiina yibia na ye tei to.

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: Se yu-ywei maa nye de kaana yu-ywei tei. Se yeila maa nye de nywonnu yeila.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Kayere sem nyɔɔna maa nye de lu-polwaro mo kwoli-ya tei. Se vɔna yam wuurim dem maa ke sɔɔ dedɛ, nenɛɛne sisein-kɔgɔ mo vaŋe torokooro se duri se maa vei jara jei tei.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Se maa jege pɛ se o taa nii se baŋa ne. Wonto mo ye maleka kam na nii gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom baŋa ne to. Ka yere de Juu tiina taane mo ye ‘Abadon’. Ka yere dem de Girisi tiina taane maa ye ‘Apolua’.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Mo lɛɛro telo na bobo se te ba to. Ko nam ta daare lɛɛro kuni belei mo.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Malese seredo tu wom laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Amo ma ni kwora na nwoŋi sabu-seŋa bimbini dem na zege Wɛ yiga ne to nyea yana yam seeni.

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: Kwora kam ma ta de malese seredo tu wom na zei nabɔnɔ kom to ka we, “Véi n bwoli malese sena sem ba na leiga ba zege Yuferata bu-zaŋa kam ni ne to n yage.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Maleka kam laam ma vo ka bwoli malese sena sem ka yage. Sento maŋe se wora mo se pɔe maŋa kam konto nɔɔ se ka ba ka yi. Se laam ma zaŋe se se vo se go nabiina pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Wonnu tem konto tetɔ ma to logo baŋa nabiina wone, ye te go ba pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe. Ko nam ye mini dem, de nyoa kam, de chilibugu kom na nwoŋi sisei sem nia ne to mo go-ba.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Sisei sem nia yam mo pae se jege dam, de se nabila yam de. Se nabila yam nye de basankwe mo, ye ya jege yuni ya maa yaare nɔɔna.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Nabiina balo na daare ye wonnu tem konto dam wo go-ba to maama nam wo sɛ se ba leiri ba wo de ba keim-balwaaro tem. Ba yɔɔre ba zuli wonnu telo ba tete jea na ke to mo. Ba ta zuli setaana, dedaane jwona yalo ba na mɛ sabu-seŋa, naa lu-nyenno, naa channa, naa kandwa, naa dɛ ba ma ke to mo. Jwona yam konto dwoŋi nam ba nae, ye ya kwori ya ba ni, ye ya ware ya vo de.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Amo daa ma nii a na maleka kadwoŋi na tiini ka dana to. Ka ma nwoŋi Wɛ telaao ne ka maa tua. Ka mɛ kunkwoŋo mo ka kukwori ka yera, ye manlaataŋa kekare ka yuu seeni. Ka yibia nye de wea kam mo, ye ka nɛ sem nye de min-vogo na ye tei to.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Maleka kam maa jege tɔn-balaŋa kalo na puri to ka jeŋa ne. Ka ma kwei ka jazem naga ka chwi naneo kom wone. Ka ma daare ka chwi ka jagwia naga kam tega baŋa ne.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Ka laam ma daare ka bage baŋa baŋa, ye ka kwora kam ke sɔɔ ne nywoŋo na suuri tei to. Maleka kam na bage konto to, doa bagem kuni berepɛ ma leiri-ka.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Doa kam na bage konto to, amo maa lage se a popone ka kwora kam a tiŋi. Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Ta‑n chem, se n yé zaŋe n popone doa kam na bage ka ta kolo to n tiŋi.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo amo ya na maŋe a na ka na zege naneo kom wone de tega baŋa ne to laam ma zeiŋi ka jazem jeŋa wɛɛne,

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: Malese serepɛ tu wom ná lage o ba o wu o nabɔnɔ kom wɛɛne to, Wɛ boboŋa yalo ya na seigi to laam wó ba ya ke ya ti. O sampwori selo déem na tɔɔle o kwora to maŋe ba lɔre o boboŋa yam konto.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Maleka tu wom na tage konto to, amo ma jwoori a ni kwora kalo na wo telaao ne ka ŋɔɔne to. Ka daa ma ta de amo ka we, “Véi maleka tu wolo na zege naneo kom baŋa ne de tega kam baŋa ne to tei, se n jwoŋi tɔn-balaŋa kalo na puri ka wo o jeŋa ne to.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: A ma vo a ta maleka kam se ka pa-ne tɔn-balaŋa kam. Ka ma ta-ne ka we, “Jwoŋi tɔnɔ kom n kwei n di. Ko ná yi nmo kana, ko wó taa chamma. Ko nam ta ná wo nmo ni ne, ko wó taa sona ne tooro tei.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Amo ma kwei tɔn-balaŋa kam maleka kam jeŋa ne a de a ni ne. Ka maa sona ne tooro tei. Ko daare, amo na ligi-ka to, ka ma leiri ka ji cham yerane a kana ne.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ta ba bere-ne ba we, amo daa taa jege se a tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam se ko vo logo baŋa dwi tiina dedɛ seeni, de teene dedɛ seeni, dedaane taana dwi dwi tiina dedɛ de ba pwa de seeni.

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Ba ma daare ba ta amo se a yé maŋe ka da-yiga konkɔlɔ kom, kolo ŋwaane ba kwei jei sem konto ba ke dwi-gɛ tiina bam jeŋa ne mo. Banto nam mo wó ba ba taa kare teo kolo Wɛ na pɔɔre o pa o tete to wone ba nɔne wonnu ba chɔge taa, chane finna-selei (

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Olivi teeni delei de min-zwonnu telei na zege logo baŋa Teiru wom yiga ne to mo bere Wɛ nɔɔna bam konto balei na ye tei to.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Mini mo wó nwoŋi ba nia ne de chɔge ba dona balo na dwoni de-ba to. Wolo maama ná lage se o ke-ba lwarem, ko ye konto dwoŋi mo ba wó go kotu.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Banto nam jege dam se ba ja wɛyuu kom se doa daa yé taa nena maŋa kam ba na wora ba tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to. Ba nam daa ta jege dam se ba pa bwi sem na leiri ba ji jana. Ba ta jege dam se ba pa jawe-chɛɛro dwi maama ba nabiina baŋa maŋa kalo maama ba na lage to.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ko ná go-ba, ba yera yam maa wó taa tigi pwooni yiga ne teo kamunu kom wone. Yera yalo na bere teo kom konto kuri chekke to mo ye ‘Sodom’ de ‘Ejipti’. Ko ye dáane mo ba jaane banto Teiru wom ba pa dagara yuu ne ba go.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Nɔɔna laam wó nwoŋi teene maama wone, de nabiina dwi maama wone, de taana dwi maama tiina wone, de paare dim jei maama wone, ba ba ba nii banto yera yam na tigi da to. Ba wó taa yɔɔre ba nii banto yera yam da yatɔ de chichworo, ye ba bá sɛ se ba kwei-ba ba suli.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Da yatɔ de chichworo kom nam na kɛ to, Wɛ ma pa o siu kolo na pae ŋwea to laam ba ko zo ba yera yam, ye ba jwoori ba bi ba zaŋe. Foone ma tiini de ja balo maama na nɛ-ba to.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Wɛ sampwori sem laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne telaao ne ka we, “Diini-na á ba ywo.” Kunkwoŋo ma ba ko kwei-ba ko ja di wɛyuu, ye ba dona bam zege ba nia.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Kanto maŋa kam ne nɔɔ, tega baŋa maama maa tiini ka ziziŋa. Ko ma pa se teo kom pɔɔrem kuni fuga wone kuri bedwe chɔge maama. Tega kam ziziŋim dem ma go nɔɔna morro terepɛ (

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Mo lɛɛro telo na ke belei tu to. Ko nam ta daare lɛɛro telo na wó ke betɔ tu to mo. Tento nam lage te ba leile mo. Nabɔnɔ kolo na wugi ko ma kweeli to

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Wɛ malese serepɛ tu wom laam ma wu o nabɔnɔ kom. Kwori laam ma ŋɔɔne telaao ne baŋa baŋa se we, “Logo baŋa paare dem laam wo dé Yuu-tu Wɛ jeŋa ne mo de o Dam Tu Krista jeŋa ne. O nam wó taa di paare logo baŋa ne se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: ye ba we: “Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo maŋe n wora boboa ne, ye n ta wora de zem maama. Dé ke nmo lei de n laam na kwei n dam-fɔrɔ kom n ma n tei logo baŋa to.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi-gɛ tiina bam tiini ba jege ban-zɔŋɔ mo. Leile konto nmo ban-lom dem nam wó zaŋe de-ba. Ko laam yi maŋa kalo nmo na wó di twa taane to. Nmo wó pa se balo maama na sɛ nmo to na pɛɛra. Ko ná ye nmo ni-jwoŋina balo na tɔɔle nmo kwora to, de balo maama na ye nmo nɔɔna ye ba kɔre n yere dem to, ko ná ye nɔn-kamuna de nabwona de, ba maama wó di nyɔɔre. Ko nam ná ye balo na chɔge logo baŋa to, maŋa yia se nmo laam chɔge-ba.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Ba na zuli Wɛ konto ba ti to, Wɛ diga kalo na wo telaao ne to ni laam ma pore. Wɛ ni-gwonim dakaa kam na wo Wɛ di-yun-gala kam ne to ma ba ka nae jaja. Doa laam maa pepela ye ka baga ka wuura. Tega maa ziziŋa ye do-kandwa tiini ya toe dedɛ.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ye kapua mo ye o puga kam virigi se o lo. Ko na chana to, o ma kaase baŋa baŋa.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Wo-kenkagele dedwoŋi daa ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne. Amo ma na kayanchɔrɔ na wora, ko na nye de vare-kamunu. Ko ye nasoŋo mo chwɛ-chwɛ ye ko jege yuni terepɛ, de nyea fuga. Paare yipwi ma pu ko yuni tem maama baŋa ne.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Ko ma kwei ko nabili dem ko ma vaŋe chalechwe sem pɔɔrem kuni betɔ wone kuri bedwe ko kwori wɛyuu ne ko de tega ne. Ko ma ba ko zege kaane wolo na lage o lo to yiga ne, se o ná loge bu wom, se ko kwei ko di.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma lo o bu wom, o ye bakeira mo. Wonto mo wó taa tei logo baŋa dwi tiina maama de o dam. Kaane wom na loge konto to, ba ma chaale bu wom ba ja vo Wɛ tei, o paare yituŋu kom na wo mɛ to.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Kaane wom laam ma duri o vo kagoa yuu, jeiga kalo Wɛ na maŋe o kwɛ se o pa‑o to. Wɛ wó taa nii o baŋa ne jei sem konto ne da moro de bia yalei de fuseredo (

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: Ko maa wo wane jara yam ko ke ko di. Ko de ko kwaga malese sem ma daa wo nɛ jeiŋa jei Wɛ telaao ne.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Ba ma zeili-ko Wɛ telaao ne ba dole ba yage logo baŋa ne, de ko kwaga malese sem maama. Kayanchɔrɔ kom konto mo ye basankwea kalo na maŋe ka wora faŋa faŋa to. Ka yere nam mo ye ‘Vwa-nyena pɛ’, de ‘Setaane’, ye ka gane logo baŋa nɔɔna maama.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we, “Leile konto debam Tu Wɛ tu o vere o nɔɔna setaana pɛ jeŋa ne. O ma pa o dam de o paare dem bere jaja. O Dam Tu Krista de tu se o taa tei nɔɔna de dam. Kokuri wolo wom na yeini o ŋɔɔne o chɔge dé nu-bia bam Wɛ yiga ne to daa tera. Wonto mo yeini o zege dé Tu Wɛ yiga ne tete de wea maama o ŋɔɔne o chɔge-ba. Ba laam nam de‑o ba yage.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Ba na wane‑o konto to, ko ye Pipeila kam toone jana bam de ba na bere Wɛ chega kam tei to ŋwaane mo. Ba ma sɛ se ba kwei ba ŋwea ba ma leini toone.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Abam balo maama na zoore wɛ telaao jei sem ne to, á ta‑á chaka de wopwolo. Ko daare ko ná ye logo baŋa de ko naneo kom, lɛɛro wó ba abam nɔɔna bam baŋa, vwa-nyena pɛ wom na tu abam tei to ŋwaane. O nam tiini o jege ban-zɔŋɔ lanyerane, kokuri o yei we o da yam gɛ fee mo.”

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Kayanchɔrɔ kom na lɔre we ba zeili-ko ba yage logo baŋa ne to, ko ma pɛ kaane wolo na loge bakeira kam to kwaga ko pu.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Ba ma kwei kawul-zɔŋɔ vɔna yalei ba pa kaane wom se o ma jaane wɛɛne o vo o yi kagoa kam yuu jei sem o na maŋe se o taa wora to. Dáane mo Wɛ wó nii o baŋa ne bena yatɔ de chichworo, ye o daare o che‑o kayanchɔrɔ kom yiga ne.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Kayanchɔrɔ kom ma twe na dedɛ se ba vo ba pɛ kaane wom ba ja viiri, ne bu-tola na na duri tei to.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Tega kam ma zeini kaane wom, ye ka pore bɔɔne ka nyɔ na balo maama kayanchɔrɔ kom na twe to.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Konto ŋwaane mo kayanchɔrɔ kom bane tiini de zaŋe de kaane wom. Ko laam ma vo se ko ke jara de kaane wom dwi tiina balo na daare to. Banto mo ye balo na sɛ Wɛ nia yam, ye ba bere we ba tɔge Yezu chega kam to.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Kayanchɔrɔ kom laam ma vo ko zege naneo kom ni ne.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Amo daa ma na juru kodwoŋi ko na nwoŋi naneo kom wone. Ko maa jege nyea fuga de yuni terepɛ. Ko nyea yam baŋa maama maa jege paare yipwi. Ko yuni tem yera ne ma popone yere delo na twe Wɛ to.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Amo na nɛ juru kom konto to, ko nye de gweeru mo. Ko nɛ maa nye de faao nɛ, ye ko ni nye de nywoŋo ni. Kayanchɔrɔ kom laam ma kwei ko paare dem de ko dam-fɔrɔ kom ko ke juru kom jeŋa ne.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Juru kom yuu dedoa maa jege fufwolo, nenɛɛne ba zage-ko mo tei. Fufwolo kom konto laam ma ba ko jei. Ko ma so nabiina maama logo baŋa ne, ye ba sɛ ba pa juru kom.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Nɔɔna maama maa kuni dwoona ba zuli kayanchɔrɔ kom, de ko na kwei ko dam dem ko pa juru kom to. Ba ma daare ba zuli juru kom de, ye ba tɛ ba we, “Nɔɔno tera o na mae de juru kom. Nɔɔn-nɔɔno nam bá wane o ke jara de‑ko.”

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Ko ma kwaane ko sɔɔle lwarem ko pa Wɛ, ye ko ta twe Wɛ yere dem, de o sɔŋɔ kom, ko woli de balo na zoore Wɛ telaao ne to.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Juru kom ma kwori ko na dam se ko kwaare jara de Wɛ nɔɔna bam, se ko wane-ba ko di. Ko ma jwoŋi dam se ko taa tei logo baŋa dwi maama, de teene maama tiina, de taana dwi maama tiina, de paare dim jei sem maama tiina.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Nam pore-na á zwa se á cheigi amo taane dem.

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Wolo maama na yɔɔre o ba se o dona ja‑o ba pe to, ba wó ja konto tu mo ye o bá lu. Wolo maama de na yɔɔre o ba se ba ma se-zɔɔ ba go‑o to, ba wó ma-ko mo ba go‑o ye o bá wane o lu. Konto mo tei Wɛ nɔɔna bam jege se ba taa vɔ pu-dɛa, se ba daare ba ke ba wo-dedoa de Wɛ. Juru kolo na nwoŋi tega ne to

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma na juru kodwoŋi ko na nwoŋi tega ne. Ko maa jege nyea yalei, ne pi-bala nyea na ye tei to. Ko ŋɔŋa maa nye de kayanchɔrɔ ŋɔŋa kam na ye tei to.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Da-yiga juru kom ma pa‑ko chwoŋa se ko ma ko dam-fɔrɔ kom ko toŋe ko pa-ko. Ko ma ma dam dem konto ko fe balo maama na zoore logo baŋa ne to pa ba zuli da-yiga juru kolo yuu ba na zage ye ko fufwolo kom laam jei to.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Juru kolo na saŋe to ma tiini ko ke wo-kenkagela yalo na dana to. Ko ma pa se mini nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba tega baŋa ye nabiina maama zege ba nia.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Ko na nɛ chwoŋa se ko ke wo-kenkagela yanto dwoŋi da-yiga juru kom ŋwaane tei to ma pa ko wane ko gane nɔɔna balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to. Ko ma ta-ba se ba mɔ kamɔgɔ se ko taa nye de juru kolo ba na mɛ se-zɔɔ ba zage ye ko ta ŋwe to.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Ko ma daare ko na chwoŋa se ko kwei siu ko ke da-yiga juru kom kamɔgɔ kom wone, se ko taa ŋwe. Ko na ke konto to, kamɔgɔ kom maa wae ko ŋɔɔna, ye ko jege dam se ko pa balo maama na ve se ba zuli-ko to te.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Ko ma fe nɔɔna maama se ba taa jege gwona ba jazena ne naa ba tira ne. Ko ná ye nabwona de nɔn-kamuna de, naa ko ná ye naduna de yiniga tiina, ko woli de kabɛ de balo na tei ba tete to de, ba maama wó la gwona yam konto mo.

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno ná wo lage gwona yam konto, kotu bá wane o yeigi woŋo naa o kwei woŋo o yeigi. Gwona yam konto nam mo bere juru kom yere, naa namba kalo na bere ko yere dem to.

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Konto nam tei se n ta‑n jege swa mo. Nmo yi ná poore, n wó wane n boŋe n lɔre juru kom namba kam kuri. Namba kam bere nabiinu yere mo. Ka nam ye bia yaredo de fuseredo-baredo (

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: A ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne. Ka maa dɔna nenɛɛne na na wuuri ye doa bage tei to. A na nigi kwora kam konto to, ka kwori dem maa nye de kɔn-magena na mage ba kwanno tei to.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Nɔn-kɔgɔ kom maa zege ko yɔɔre Wɛ paare yituŋu kom, de wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to, de nakwa bam. Ba maa leeni leiŋ-doŋa kalo nɔɔn-nɔɔno na bá wane o zamese-ka to ko ná dae nɔɔna morro bi de finna-tena bam yerane (

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Banto nam mo chege ba tete de wo-digiru keim, ye ba wo tɔge ka-laga wo-zɔɔna kikia. Banto yeini ba tɔge Pipeila kam kwaga mo ba vei jei selo maama ka na wó vo to. Wɛ mo le-ba nabiina wone o ŋwe ba wɛleera jene, pa se banto da yiga ba ji o nyem, de Pipeila kam de nyem.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Banto nam wo fɔge ba fɔ vwa. Ba maa jege bora ye tusim tera. Wɛ malese setɔ na tage wonnu telo to

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma na maleka tu wodwoŋi, ka na jaane wɛyuu ne. Ka maa jege Wɛ kwor-ywoŋa kalo na jege kuri taa wuu to se ka tɔɔle ka bere balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to. Ko nam ye paare dim jei sem maama ne mo, de nabiina dwi maama, de taana dwi maama tiina, de teene maama tiina.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Ka maa ŋɔɔne de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Nam kɔre-na Wɛ se á daare á ta‑á pa‑o zula, kolo ŋwaane maŋa kam yia se o di nabiina taane. Nam kuni-na dwoona á zuli wolo na ke wɛyuu jei sem, de tega baŋa kam, de naneo kom, dedaane buli sem to.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Maleka kadwoŋi ma saŋe ka kwaga ye ka tɛ ka we, “Babilon te-fɔrɔ kom chɔge ywoo! Ko yɔɔre ko chɔge mo zɔŋŋ. Ko déem nam yeini ko pa nabiina dwi maama mo tɔge ba ke ko kabwoŋa kikia yam, nenɛɛne sa-dɛɛra mo ba nyɔge ba su tei.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Malese setɔ tu de ma saŋe, ye ka tɛ de kwor-dɛa ka we, “Wolo maama ná zuli varem wom de o kamɔgɔ kom, ye ba daare ba la ba gwona yam o tiri ne naa o jeŋa ne,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: Wɛ ban-lom dem laam wó ba kotu baŋa ne, ne ba lwogi sa-dɛɛra mo ba su na-zoŋa ba pa o nyɔ o su tei. Wolo maama ná sɛ varem wom konto, chilibugu kolo na jege mini to mo wó di kotu pa o na cham dedɛ Wɛ malese sem yiga ne, de Pipeila kam yiga ne.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Mini dem na di ba yera yam tei to wó pa se nyoa nwoŋi da ka yɔɔre ka taa zaŋe mo taa taa se ko taa vei wuu. Balo maama na zuli varem wom de o kamɔgɔ kom to, de balo maama de na lage gwona yalo na bere o yere dem to bá na siu kɔtaa, wea de tete maama.”

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Konto mo tei Wɛ nɔɔna bam jege se ba taa fɔge ba zege de pu-dɛa. Banto mo ye balo na sɛ Wɛ nia yam ye ba kwori ba jege wo-dedoa de Yezu to.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni kwora na ŋɔɔne telaao ne ka we, “Nam popone tento: Ko na zege zem se ko taa vei to, balo na sɛ dé Teiru wom ye ba ba ba te to, wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo.” Wɛ Sin-laao kom ma leiri ko we, “Ko ye chega mo. Banto wó sii de ba totoŋ-chɛɛra yam, kolo ŋwaane ba keim-laaro mo wó taa tɔge-ba.” Wɛ borem maŋa kam na ye tei to

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma nii a na kunkwoŋ-pwoŋo, ye wolo na nye de nabiinu bu to jei ko baŋa ne. Sabu-seŋa yipuga ma pu o yuu ne, ye o daare o zei sekwara kalo na jege ni to.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Maleka kadwoŋi ma nwoŋi Wɛ diga kam wone. Ka ma tɔɔle baŋa baŋa ka ta de wolo wom na jei kunkwoŋo kom baŋa ne to ka we, “Logo baŋa faao kom laam bege ko ti. Kwei n sekwara kam n ma n gaane faao kom, se ko maŋa kam yia.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Wolo wom na jei kunkwoŋo kom baŋa ne to laam ma vuvugi o sekwara kam logo baŋa ne o ma gaane ko wodiiru tem.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Amo daa ma na maleka kadwoŋi na nwoŋi Wɛ diga kalo na wo telaao ne to wone, ye ka de jege sekwara kalo na jege ni to.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Maleka kadwoŋi na nii mini baŋa ne to ma nwoŋi Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem seeni. Ka ma tɔɔle de kwor-dɛa ka ta de maleka kalo na zei sekwara kam to ka we, “Kwei n sekwara kam na jege ni to n ma n gwori Vini tio-bia bam, se logo baŋa tio-bia bam konto laam bege ba ti.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Maleka kam laam ma kwei ka sekwara kam ka fere Vini tio-bia bam ka gwori. Ka ma kwei-ba ka de kazɔ-zɔŋɔ wone se ba tɛ ba ma ke sana, se ko bere Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom na wó ba nabiina baŋa tei to.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma na wo-kenkagele dedwoŋi wɛyuu ne, de na tiini de dana ye de ba jege dwoŋi. A ma na Wɛ malese serepɛ na wora, ye se dedoa dedoa jege yaara dwi dwi se se pa ya ja nɔɔna. Yaara yarepɛ yam konto mo lage ya kweeli, kolo ŋwaane yanto ná ke ya ti, Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom laam wó ti.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a na woŋo na nye de naneo. Ko maa nyeena ne gelaase na nyeene tei to, ye ko nye ne mini mo gwaane da tei. Amo ta ma na balo na wane varem wom dam dem, de o kamɔgɔ kom dam dem, ko woli de o yere dem namba kam dam dem de to. Banto maa zege naneo kolo na nyeena lanyerane to ni ne. Ba maa zei kwanno telo Wɛ na pɛ-ba to.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Ba maa leeni leiŋa kalo na ye Wɛ tontoŋeno Moses nyem to. Ka ma kwori ka ye Pipeila kam de nyem mo. Ba ma leeni ba seini Wɛ ba we, “Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo kikia yam tiini ya dana ye ya ba jege dwoŋi. Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama Pɛ, nmo chwei sem yɔɔre se tɔge chega mo.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ, nɔɔn-nɔɔno tera o na bá kɔre nmo. Nɔɔna maama nam wó taa zuli nmo yere dem. Nmo yerane mo ye wo-pwoŋo tu chekke. Logo baŋa dwi maama tiina wó ba ba kuni dwoona nmo yiga ne ba zuli‑m, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔna maama wó na nmo kikia yam na jege chega tei to.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Ba leiŋa kam na ti konto to, amo ma nii Wɛ telaao ne a na Wɛ wara-vwei dem de de di-yuu kom ni na pore.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Wɛ malese serepɛ sem na jege yaara dwi dwi kuni berepɛ to ma nwoŋi diga kam wone. Se ma zo gare-fefale selo na tiini se nyeena pele-pele to, ye se daare se vɔ sabu-seŋa kili se nyɔɔna ne.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Wonnu tena tem na ŋwe to dedoa laam ma zaŋe ko kwei sabu-seŋa zwe serepɛ ko pa malese serepɛ sem. Zwe sem konto nam mo su de Wɛ ban-lom dem. Wonto nam mo jege ŋwea se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Wɛ dam dem de o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ma pa nyoa nwoŋi ka su o diga kam ni maama. Nyoa kam ma pa se nɔɔn-nɔɔno ware diga kam wo o zo, se ko taa nii maŋa kam yaara yarepɛ yam na ke ya ti malese serepɛ sem jeŋa ne to.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni kwor-dɛa na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa Wɛ diga kam wone, ye ka ta de Wɛ malese serepɛ sem ka we, “Kwei-na zwe serepɛ selo Wɛ ban-lom dem na wo se wone to á ja vo á lwo á yage logo baŋa ne.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Da-yiga maleka kam ma kwei ka zoŋa kam ka ja vo ka lwo ka yage logo baŋa ne. Ka na ke konto to, ŋɔn-zana ma ja balo na lage varem wom gwona yam ye ba zuli ko kamɔgɔ kom to.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na saŋe to ma lwo ka zoŋa kam ka yage naneo kom wone. Ko na bam ma ji ne too jana na ye tei to. Woŋo maama na zoore naneo kom wone to ma te.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Malese setɔ tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam o yage bu-tole sem wone de buli sem de wone. Se na bam ma ji jana.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Amo ma ni Wɛ maleka kalo na nii bwi sem baŋa ne to na we: “Wo-pwoŋo Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo na maŋe n wora boboa ne ye n daa‑n ta wora to, nmo tɔge chega de nmo na ke tei n waare-ba to.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Kokuri banto go n nɔɔna bam de n sampwori sem pa se ba jana nwoŋi. Nmo laam ma‑n pa na bam ji jana se nɔɔna bam konto de nyɔ. Mo kolo na maŋe de ba keim dem to.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a ni kwora kadwoŋi na ŋɔɔne Wɛ kaanem bimbini dem seeni ka we: “Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ, nmo na di nɔɔna taane tei to yɔɔre ko tɔge chega mo.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Malese sena tu wom ma kwei o zoŋa kam o lwo o yage wea kam yera ne. Wea kam ma jwoŋi dam se ka wulim dem zwɛ nɔɔna de mini.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Ka mini dem na tiini de zwɛ nɔɔna konto to, ba ma twe Wɛ yere dem, o na tei yaara yam konto to ŋwaane. Ba nam wo leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam se ba daare ba zuli Wɛ.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Malese senu tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam varem wom paare yituŋu kom baŋa ne. Lim ma ba de li varem wom paare dim jei sem maama. Nɔɔna ma done ba yeila de ba yaara yam.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Ba ma ŋɔɔne ba twe Telaao Tu Wɛ wom, ba yaara yam de ba yera ŋɔna yam ŋwaane. Ba nam daa ta wo leiri ba wo de ba kikia yam.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Malese seredo tu wom ma lwo o zoŋa kam o yage Yuferata bu-zaŋa kam wone. Ka na bam ma we, ye ko daare chwoŋa ko pa pwa balo na nwoŋi wɛ-puli jei sem ne to se ba wane ba bɛ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a na chichiri-zɔɔna yatɔ na nye de mantwaaro to. Ba dedoa ma nwoŋi kayanchɔrɔ kom ni ne. Wodwoŋi de ma nwoŋi varem wom ni ne, ye dedoa kam de nwoŋi varem wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to ni ne.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Chichiribia bam konto ye setaane nyena mo, ye ba wae ba ke wo-kenkagela. Ba ma zaŋe ba vo logo baŋa pwa bam maama tei se ba maama la daane ba ti ba yiga jara ŋwaane Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ dɛ-kamunu kom dɛ ne. Yezu tage o we:

english_verse: Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
translation_verse: “Cheigi-na. A lage a ba ne ŋweeno na dare o ba tei to mo. Wolo na fɔge o che o tete to wó taa jege yu-ywoŋo. Wolo na yei o gwaaro tem tiŋim to, amo ná pɔpɔ a ba konto, chaveera bá ja‑o nɔɔna yiga ne, o na bá zaŋe de kuri-nɔrɔ to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Malese serepɛ tu wom laam ma lwo o zoŋa kam wɛyuu ne. Kwor-dɛa laam ma ŋɔɔne Wɛ diga kam paare yituŋu kom jei sem ne ka we, “Ko ke ko ti.”

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Malese serepɛ sem na jege zwe serepɛ sem to dedoa ma ba ka ta de amo ka we, “Ba se a bere‑m Wɛ na lage o pa ka-tola kalo na dana to na waarem tei to. Ka-tola kam konto jeiŋa jei mo ye jeiga kalo bwi na daga da to.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Logo baŋa pwa bam yeini ba ke bwoorim de ka-tola kam konto. Balo na zoore logo baŋa ne to de maa tiini ba bwoori de-ka, ne nɔɔno na nyɔge sana o bugi tei to.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Wɛ Sin-laao kom laam ma ba amo tei de dam, ye a na we maleka kam kale-ne ka ja ka vo kagoa yuu. Jei sem konto ne mo amo nɛ kaane, o na dɔge juru kodwoŋi na ye nasoŋo chwɛ-chwɛ to baŋa ne. Yera yalo na twe Wɛ to ma popone juru kom yera ne. Ko maa jege yuni terepɛ de nyea fuga.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Kaane wom ma zo gwaaro telo na ye nason-pupwiu de nasonno chwɛ-chwɛ to. O yera maa jege wonnu dedɛ telo na nyeene to. Te nam ye sabu-seŋa de kandwa-nyenno mo. O ma zei sabu-seŋa zoŋa, ye ka ni su de wo-zɔɔna yalo na bere o bwoorim kikia yam na jege digiru tei to.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Yere delo kuri na seigi to ma popone o tiri ne de we: Babilon kolo na ye te-fɔrɔ to. Ka-tole maama nu, de logo baŋa wo-zɔɔna maama nu.

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Amo na nɛ kaane wom to mo a maane we o nyɔge Wɛ nɔɔna balo na bere Yezu chega kam ye ba go-ba to jana bam mo o su, ne o nyɔge sana mo o bugi tei. Amo na nɛ‑o konto to, ko ma tiini ko so-ne.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma bwei-ne ka we, “Ko ke‑m yaau se bɛ mo? Ko ná ye juru kolo na jege yuni terepɛ tem de nyea fuga to, de kaane wolo na dɔge o baŋa ne to, amo wó pa n lɔre ba kuri na ye tei to.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Juru kolo nmo na nɛ to ya ŋwe mo. Ko nam daa tera. Ko daare se ko nwoŋi gwoŋ-chanluŋu kom wone mo, se ko laam vo ko na chɔgem. Ko ná ye balo na zoore logo baŋa ne ye ba yera maŋe ya wo popone ya tiŋi Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone maŋa kam logo baŋa ta na tera to, ba ná nɛ juru kom, ko wó so ba maama. Ko déem ya ŋwe mo, ye ko laam daa tera. Ko nam wó jwoori ko ba ko nwoŋi nabiina yiga ne.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: Konto mo tei n jege se n ta‑n jege boboŋ-dɛɛra de swa. Juru kom yuni terepɛ tem bere zwonnu terepɛ na ye tei to mo. Tento maa ye zwonnu telo kaane wom na jei te baŋa ne to mo. Yuni tem ta kwori te bere pwa barepɛ na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Pwa bam konto banu maŋe ba to mo. Ba dedoa mo wora leile. Wolo na kweeli to ta wo tu. Ko daare, o ná tua, o paare dem bá dáane dedɛ.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Juru kom tete kolo déem ya na ŋwe ye ko laam daa tera to bere pɛ wolo na ke ba wone nana to mo. Wonto mo ye pwa barepɛ balo na dɛ yiga to wo nɔɔno. O nam ná tua, o de laam wó vo o na chɔgem.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: Nyea fuga yalo nmo na nɛ to bere pwa fuga na ye tei to mo. Pwa bam konto ta wo jwoŋi ba paare dem. Ba nam wó ba ba jwoŋi dam se ba tɔge de varem wom ba taa tei nɔɔna, se ko maŋe de awa dedoa yerane.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Pwa fuga bam maama jege boboŋe dedwe mo. Ba maa wó kwei ba dam maama ba ke juru kom jeŋa ne.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Nyea fuga yalo nmo na nɛ to, de juru kom tete wó taa chuli ka-tola kam. Ba nam wó vere o wonnu tem maama o tei ne ba daare‑o kalambwolo. Ba laam wó di o ya-nɔna yam, ye ba daare ba zwɛ‑o de mini.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Ko daare kaane wolo nmo na nɛ ye o ye ka-tola to mo ye te-fɔrɔ kolo na tei logo baŋa pwa bam maama to.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Maleka kam na tage konto ka ti to, amo ma na maleka kadwoŋi na nwoŋi telaao ne ka maa beene logo baŋa. Ka maa tiini ka jege dam ye ka nenɔŋa kam zeiŋi pwooni ka pa logo baŋa maama peere.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Ka ma tɔɔle baŋa baŋa de kwor-dɛa ka we: “Babilon te-fɔrɔ kom chɔge ywoo! Ko yɔɔre ko chɔge mo. Setaana yerane laam mo zoore ko wone, ye chichiri-zɔɔna dwi maama de zoore da. Zuna de vara balo nɔɔna na chula ye ba ba lae to dwi maama maa tɔge ba wora.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina maama ma to teo kom konto kabwoŋa chwei sem wone, ne ba nyɔge ko sa-dɛɛra mo ba su tei. Logo baŋa pwa bam ma tɔge ba ke bwoorim de-ko. Logo baŋa pipim-piina ma tiini ba di nyɔɔre teo kom konto baŋa ne, kolo ŋwaane ko nɔɔna bam swoi se ba taa chɔge sabu dedɛ.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni kwora kadwoŋi na ŋɔɔne Wɛ telaao ne ka we: “Amo nɔɔna bam, nwoŋi-na teo kom wone, se á yé tɔge ko wo-balwaaro chwei sem, se á yé tɔge á na ko yaara yam.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Kokuri ko wɛleera yam daga dedɛ te daŋe da-baŋa ne te yi wɛyuu. Wɛ nam yei ko keim-lwanno tem maama ni ne.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Chɔge-na teo kom se ko maŋe de konto na chɔge nɔɔna badwonna tei to. Pa-na ko chɛ ko yera ne se ko dwoni ko na pɛ ko chɛ nɔɔna yera ne tei to. Fe-na-ko se ko nyɔ sa-dɛɛra balo na tiini ba dana ba dwoi konto sana bam ko na pae nɔɔna nyɔ to.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Pipiri-na teo kom ywoni dem de ko wo-laaro tem se te jwoori te ji cham de yaara te pa-ko. Kokuri teo kom nye de kaane wolo na yeini o tɛ o we, ‘Amo di paare mo ye kolokolo daa bá daane-ne. Amo dae kadeim, ye a yiga bá fɔge ka nyɔne.’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Teo kom na bere ko tete kamunni to ŋwaane, yaara dwi maama wó pɔpɔ ya ba ko baŋa dɛ dedwe wone. Jawe-chɛɛro de yi-nyɔna de kana wó ba te ja-ko. Mini de maa wó di-ko. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ jege dam-fɔrɔ, ye wonto mo wó pa teo kom na waarem.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Ko ná ye logo baŋa pwa balo na tɔge ba ke teo kom kabwoŋa kikia yam ye ba di ywoni daane to, ba ná nɛ teo kom na jege mini tei to, ba wó taa keera de wo-chechɔgɔ.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Ba na kɔre ko yaara yam to ŋwaane, ba wó taa zege yiga yiga ye ba nii ko nyoa kam. Ba wó taa chwoosa ye ba we: “Ei! Lɛɛro wora! Lɛɛro yi te-fɔrɔ kom! Babilon ya tiini ko jege dam. Ko laam nam tu ko chɔge lela, awa dedoa wone.”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa pipim-piina bam de wó taa keera ye ba nyɔne ba yiga teo kom chɔgem ŋwaane, kolo ŋwaane nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa tera se ba taa yeigi ba zela yam.

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: Zela yalo ba na jege ba yeigi to ye sabu-seŋa wonnu, de lu-nyenno wonnu, de kandwa-nyenno, ko woli de gwaaro dwi dwi, te na ye gare-fefale, de gare-nyenno, de gare-sonno telo na ye chwɛ-chwɛ to mo. Ba ta maa jege da-ŋwe dwi maama, de wonnu dedɛ telo ba na mɛ tuu yeila, de da-laaro, de channa, de luu, de pe-siswollu ba ke to.

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: Ba ta maa kwori ba jege terale nuga dwi maama, de talwoŋ-ywoŋa dwi maama, de liri sedwonna, ko woli de sana, de nuga, de bworobworo muni, de kamaana, ko woli de naane, de pei, de sisei, de se torokooro. Ba ta jaane kabɛ ba yeiga.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: Ba laam maa wó ta de teo kom ba we, “Wo-laaro telo maama nmo fera na zo to daa tera. Nmo jejegero tem de n nenɔŋa kam maama laam jei. Nmo daa‑n bá‑n na wonnu tem konto maŋa de maŋa.”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Pipim-piina balo na tiini ba na nyɔɔre teo kom baŋa ne to wó taa zege yiga yiga, ba na kɔre ko yaara yam to ŋwaane. Ba maa wó taa keera

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: ye ba chwoosa ba we: “Ei! Lɛɛro wora! Teo kamunu konto tiini ko jege nenɔŋa. Ko nɔɔna bam maa zoore gare-nyenno, ye ba yera jege sabu-seŋa wonnu de kandwa-nyenno.

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: Banto ná nɛ nyoa kam na zaŋe teo kom ne, ba wó ta baŋa baŋa ba we, “Teo kamunu konto dwoŋi tera.”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó nyɔne ba yiga, ye ba chwoosa ba we, “Ei! Lɛɛro wora! Lɛɛro yi te-fɔrɔ kom! Ko na tiini ko jege jejegero tei to pɛ se balo maama na tei nabwooru to di nyɔɔre ko baŋa ne. Ko laam ma ba ko chɔge lela, awa dedoa wone.”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Wɛ maleka kadwoŋi na tiini ka dana to laam ma kwei kandwɛ-kamunu, ne nɔŋ-zɔŋɔ na ye tei to. Ka ma dole-ko ka yage naneo kom wone ye ka we, “Ba nam wó kwei te-fɔrɔ Babilon de ba dole ba yage konto dwoŋi mo, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno daa bá na ko jei.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Ko wó ji di-dwonnu yerane. Nɔɔna daa bá taa wo ko wone se ba taa mage kwanno, naa ba taa leena, naa ba taa wui wi naa nabwanno. Gɔgɔ dwi maama de bá taa wo ko wone, ye nɔŋɔ kwori de daa bá taa zaŋe ko wone.

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: Min-zwoŋo mini de daa bá tɔrege ko wone. Kadiri sɔɔ de daa bá ke ko wone. Te-fɔrɔ kom pipim-piina bam déem mo ye logo baŋa dedɛɛra yiga tiina. Ko liri kikia yam ma soge logo baŋa dwi tiina maama boboŋa.

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni kwor-dɛa, ka na nye de nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa telaao ne ba we: “Aleluya! Debam Tu Wɛ mo ye verem tu, de nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ tu, de dam tu.

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: O borem dem yɔɔre de ye chega mo. Ko ná ye ka-tola kalo na dana ye ka bwoŋa kikia yam jage jei maama ya chɔge logo baŋa to, Wɛ di ka taane pa ka to. O ma waare-ka, ka na pɛ o tontoŋena bam te to ŋwaane.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Ba daa ma ta baŋa baŋa ba we: “Aleluya! Mini na di-ka to, ko nyoa kam wó taa zaŋa mo taa, se ko taa vei wuu.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Kwora kadwoŋi laam ma ŋɔɔne paare yituŋu kom seeni ka we: “Abam balo maama na ye Wɛ tontoŋena to, ta‑á tei-na dé Tu Wɛ wom. Abam balo maama na kɔre‑o to, ko ná ye nɔn-kamuna de nabwona, á ta‑á zuli‑o.”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma ni sɔɔ, ko na nye de nɔn-kɔgɔ dedɛ na ŋɔɔne baŋa baŋa, ye ko dɔna ne na mo wuuri ye doa baga tei. Ko maa ŋɔɔne ko we: “Aleluya! Debam Tu, Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ mo di paare.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Pa-na dé taa chaka de wopwolo, ye dé zuli‑o o nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom ŋwaane. Kokuri to, wolo na ye Pipeila kam to kadiri dem maŋa laam yia. O kaane wom ti o yiga se o zo‑o.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Ba kwei gare-fefale selo na tiini se nyeena pele-pele to mo ba pa kaane wom se o zo.” Gwaaro tem konto nam mo bere Wɛ nɔɔna bam keim-laaro tem na ye tei to.

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Maleka kam laam ma ta de amo ka we, “Popone tento n tiŋi: Ko ná ye balo ba na bwoŋi se ba tɔge ba di Pipeila kam kadiri dem wodiu kom to, banto jege yu-ywoŋo mo.” Ka daa ma ta ka we, “Nmo na nigi kolo maama to ye Wɛ kwora chekke mo.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Amo ma kuni dwoona ka yiga ne se a zuli-ka. Ka ma ta ka we, “Yé ke konto. Amo de ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo, ne nmo de n nu-bia balo maama na bere we ba tɔge Yezu chega kam to de na ye tei to. N maŋe se n zuli Wɛ mo.” Ko ye Yezu chega kam konto mo pae Wɛ sampwori sem tɔɔle o kwora.

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Amo laam ma nii a na Wɛ telaao ni na pore. A ma na siseiŋ-pwoŋa. Wolo na dɔge ka baŋa ne to ye ‘Wo-dedoa Tu’ de ‘Chega Tu’. O na bore nɔɔna taane tei to yɔɔre ko tɔge chega mo, ye o kwori o jaane jara de chega.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: O yia maa seene ne min-vogo tei. Paare yipwi dedɛ ma pu o yuu ne. Yere dedwoŋi ma popone o yera ne, ye nɔɔn-nɔɔno yeiri-de, ko ná dae o tete yerane.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Gare-dedɔrɔ kolo o na zo to ma bugi de jana. Ba maa bwoi‑o we, “Wɛ Botara kam”.

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Wɛ telaao jar-keira kɔgɔ kom ma pu o kwaga. Ba ma dɔge sisein-pwonnu baŋa ne, ye ba zo gare-fefale selo na ye napwonnu fase to.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Se-zɔɔ kolo na tiini ko jege ni to maa nwoŋi o ni ne. O nam wó ma-ko o mage logo baŋa dwi tiina bam o de tega ne. O ta wó kwei luu-dedɔrɔ mo o ma wane-ba de o dam. O maa wó pa se Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ ban-zɔŋɔ kom tiini ko ba ba baŋa, nenɛɛne o nɔne Vini tio-bia mo se ba nyoa bam taa nwoŋa tei.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Yere dedwoŋi ma popone o gare-dedɔrɔ kom yera ne, de o chwei ne de we: “Pwa maama Pɛ, de yuu tiina maama Yuu-tu.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Amo laam ma na maleka kadwoŋi ka na zege wea kam tetare ne. Ka ma bage baŋa baŋa ka ta de zuna balo maama na jaane wɛyuu ne to ka we, “Ba-na á la daane se á tɔge á di wodi-fɔrɔ kolo Wɛ na ke to.

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a na varem wom, de logo baŋa pwa bam maama, de ba jar-keira bam na lage daane se ba ke jara de wolo wom na dɔge siseiŋa kam baŋa ne to de o jar-keira kɔgɔ kom.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Ba ma ja varem wom ba vɔ, de wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to. Wonto ya mo ke wo-kenkagela o ma woli varem wom. O na ke wo-kenkagela yam konto to, o mɛ o gane balo na lage varem wom gwona yam ye ba daare ba zuli o kamɔgɔ kom to mo. Ba ma kwei banto balei ŋweene, ba ja vo ba de buga wone. Buga kam kanto ye kalo na jege mini ye chilibugu wora ko di to mo.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ba jar-keira kɔgɔ kom na daare to maama ma te. Se-zɔɔ kolo na nwoŋi sisein-diru wom ni ne to mo go-ba. Zuna bam maama ma ba ba di ba ya-nɔna yam ba su.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a na paare yitunnu, ye nɔɔna jei te baŋa ne. Banto ma jwoŋi dam se ba di nɔɔna taane. Ba maa ye balo ba ya na gwoni ba yuni ba na tɔge Yezu chega kam ye ba bere Wɛ kwora kam to ŋwaane. Ba maa wo sɛ se ba zuli varem wom naa o kamɔgɔ kom. Ba nam ta wo sɛ ba la varem wom gwona yam ba tira ne naa ba jea ne. Amo na nɛ ba jworru tem konto to, ba ma jwoori ba bi ba na ŋwea, ye ba tɔge de Yezu Krista ba di paare se ko yi bena moro.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Balo maama na tɔge ba woli da-yiga twa biim dem wone to jege yu-ywoŋo, ba na ye Wɛ tete nɔɔna to ŋwaane. Toone delo na lage de ke belei to daa bá wane-ba. Banto wó taa zege Baŋa Wɛ de Yezu Krista yiga ne mo ba pa zula ne kaanem tiina tei. Ba maa wó tɔge ded‑o ba di paare se ko yi bena moro kom.

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: O maa wó vo o gane dwi tiina balo na wo logo baŋa jei sem maama ne to. Banto maa ye Wɛ dona mo, ye ba yera ye ‘Goga’ de ‘Magoga’. O maa wó pa ba la daane se ba ke jara. Ba kɔgɔ kom nɔn-bia wó taa daga dedɛ, ne buga ni kasolo bia na ye tei to mo.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó tɔge logo baŋa jei maama ba vo ba gilimi Wɛ nɔɔna bam kɔgɔ kom na lage daane mɛ to. Teo kom konto mo ye kolo Wɛ na swoi dedɛ to. Mini laam ma nwoŋi wɛyuu ne de ba de chɔge Wɛ dona bam kɔgɔ kom maama.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Ko daare setaana pɛ wom na gane-ba to, ba ma dole wonto ba de buga kalo na jege mini ye chilibugu wora ko di to wone. Kanto mo ye buga kalo ba na maŋe ba de varem wom de wolo na bere we o ye Wɛ sampwora ye o gane nɔɔna to ba yage ka wone to. Dáane mo ba maama wó na cham wea de tete maama se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Amo ma daare a na paare yituŋ-kamunu kolo na ye napwoŋo to, de wolo na jei ko baŋa ne to. Tega baŋa de wɛyuu maama ma duri te kɛ o yiga ne, ye te daa tera.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Amo ma na balo na tege to, dedɛɛra de nabwona maama, ba zege paare yituŋu kom yiga ne. Nɔɔna ma puri twanno se ba nii. Ba ma daare ba puri tɔnɔ kodwoŋi na ye Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom to. Ba ma bore twa bam taane se ko maŋe de ba na ke kolo to, nenɛɛne ko na popone ko tiŋi twanno tem wone tei to.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Naneo kom ma pa twa balo na maŋe ko wone to chwoŋa se ba nwoŋi. Toone de ma yage balo de na jaane to. Churu de ma yage ko nɔɔna bam. Ba ma bore twa bam konto maama taane se ko maŋe de ba na ke kolo to.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Ba laam ma ja Toone de Churu ba dole ba de buga kam na jege mini to wone. Buga kam de ka mini dem mo bere toone belei tu na ye tei to.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Nɔɔno wolo maama yere na maŋe de wo popone de ke Wɛ ŋwe-doŋa tɔnɔ kom wone to, ba dole konto tu ba de buga kam na jege mini dem to wone mo.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Teo kom sɛ sem maama jege nia yatɔ yatɔ mo. Yatɔ yɔɔre wɛ-puli seeni. Yatɔ maa wo wɛ-puli jagwia seeni. Yatɔ maa wo wɛ-puli jazem seeni. Yatɔ maa daare ya wo wɛ-zoore seeni.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Teo kom kabira kam kuri ma chwi pelwaaro fuga-telei baŋa ne. Pipeila kam totoŋa nakwa fuga-balei bam yera ma popone pelwaaro tem konto yera ne.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Maleka kalo na ŋɔɔne de amo to maa zei sabu-seŋa nacheiga se ka ma maŋe teo kom na mae tei to, de ko nia yam de ko kabira kam de na mae tei to.

translation_verse: Ka ma daare ka maŋe teo kom kabira kam. Ka ma maŋe de jatwogo de noa ni maŋem kuni bi de finna-bena (

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
translation_verse: Pelwaaro telo teo kom kabira kam na chwi te baŋa ne to mo ba mɛ kandwa-nyenno dwi maama ba ma gɔgere te yera. Pelɔrɔ maama jege ko kandwɛ-nyeno mo, ye te yera mo tento:

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Amo nam nɛ we Wɛ diga tera teo kom wone, kolo ŋwaane Dam-fɔrɔ Tu Baŋa Wɛ dedaane Pipeila kam tete mo wora ye nɔɔna zuli-ba teo kom jei maama ne.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Wɛ nenɔŋ-fɔrɔ kom na pae teo kom jege pwooni to, ko daa ba lage se wea kam de chana kam daa taa zeiŋi ko baŋa ne. Pipeila kam de pae ko jege pwooni ne min-zwoŋo na pae pwooni tei to.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Logo baŋa dwi tiina bam wó taa jege ba ŋwea pwooni dem konto wone. Logo baŋa pwa bam maa wó ja ba jejegero ba ba ba ke teo kom wone.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Dɛ maama ba bá pe teo kom nia yam, kolo ŋwaane tega daa bá yi jei sem konto ne.

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: Ba maa wó kwei logo baŋa dwi tiina jejegero tem de ba nenɔŋa maama ba ja ba ba ke da.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Ko daare kolo maama na jege digiru to bá zo ko wo. Nɔɔno wolo maama na ke wo-zɔɔna to, de wolo maama na ye vwa-fɔro to bá zo ko wo. Balo yera na popone ya tiŋi Pipeila kam ŋwea tɔnɔ kom wone to yerane mo wó na chwoŋa se ba zo teo kom konto wo.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Maleka kam ma daare ka bere-ne bu-tola kalo na na pae ŋwea to. Na bam tiini ba nyeena pele-pele ne gelaase na nyeene tei to. Bu-tola kam na bam maa bura ba nwoŋa Wɛ de Pipeila kam paare yituŋu kom seeni ba dura.

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: Teo kom pempale dem de bu-tola kam tetare laŋa ne mo tio wora kolo bia na pae ŋwea to. Tio kom konto maa yeini ko leiri bia kuni fuga-belei bene maama wone. Chana maama wone ko leiri bia mo. Ko vɔɔro tem wó wane te pa logo baŋa dwi tiina bam na yazura ba jaweero wone.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Woŋo kolo maama na wora teo kom ne to, Wɛ sɔla bá taa wo ko baŋa ne. Wɛ de Pipeila kam paare yituŋu kom wó taa wo teo kom ne, ye Wɛ tontoŋena bam zuli‑o dáane.

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: Ba wó taa nae o yibia. O yere dem maa wó popone ba tira ne.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Tega daa bá yi teo kom ne. Ba bá taa lage min-zwonnu se te taa pae pwooni, naa wea de. Yuu-tu Baŋa Wɛ nam wó taa zeiŋi pwooni ba baŋa ne. Ba wó taa tɔge ba di paare se ko taa vei wuu.

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: “Nii-na! A bá dáane ye a ba. Wolo maama na sɛ o tɔge Wɛ kwora kalo na popone ka tiŋi tɔnɔ konto ne to jege yu-ywoŋo.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn mo seene a ni wonnu tem konto, ye a kwori a na-te. Ko maama na tu ko ti to, a laam ma kuni dwoona maleka kalo na le wonnu tem ka bere-ne to yiga ne se a zuli-ka.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Ka ma ta de amo ka we, “Yé ke konto. Amo de ye Wɛ tontoŋeno mo, ne nmo de n nu-bia balo na tɔɔle Wɛ kwora kam to, ko ta woli de balo maama na sɛ ba tɔge kolo na popone tɔnɔ konto wone to de na ye tei to. N maŋe se n zuli Wɛ mo.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Nii-na! A bá dáane ye a ba. A ná maa beena, a maa wó taa jege ŋweero a jeŋa ne, ye a kwei-te a pa nɔɔno maama nyɔɔre delo na maŋe de o kikia to.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Amo mo ye pulim jei de kweelim jeiga. Amo ta mo ye boboa kam de gurim tu, dedaane da-yiga tu de tiim tu.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Balo na zare ba gwaaro pa te lana fase to jege yu-ywoŋo. Banto jege chwoŋa se ba di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to, ye ba kwori ba jege chwoŋa se ba da Wɛ tete teo kom manchwo-nia yam ba zo ko wo.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Amo mo toŋe a maleka se ka ba ka ta amo chega kam ka bere abam balo na ye amo kɔgɔ kom nɔɔna to. Amo ye wolo kuri na nwoŋi Pɛ David dwi dem wone to. Amo ye tetete chalechoa kalo yere na ye naŋɔgɔ ye ka tiini ka nyeene to mo.”

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Amo Jɔn nam lage a kaane balo maama na cheigi wonnu telo na popone tɔnɔ konto wone ye te ye Wɛ kwora to. Nmo ná kwei woŋo n woli tɔnɔ konto wonnu tem wone, Wɛ wó pa n na waarem se ko woli de yaara yalo tɔnɔ kom na bere to.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Nmo nam ná le woŋo tɔnɔ kom wone n yage, Wɛ wó le nmo de yiga o yage, se n yé da n di tio kolo bia na pae ŋwea to, naa n tɔge n zo Wɛ tete teo kom wo, ne tɔnɔ konto na maŋe ko bere tei to.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Wolo wom na zege wonnu tem konto chega kam kwaga ne to mo tɛ o we: “Ko ye chega mo. A bá dáane ye a ba.” Ameena. Dé sɛ konto. Dé Teiru Yezu, nam ba!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Debam Teiru Yezu zaane dem taa wo Wɛ tete nɔɔna bam maama tei ne. Ameena.
